(* =================================================================================================
   SECTION 2: TRIPLE MODULAR REDUNDANCY (2oo3 TMR) SENSOR VOTING ENGINES
   ================================================================================================= *)

(* -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
   SUB-SECTION 2.1: CRYOGENIC BATH LEVEL 2oo3 TMR VOTING ALGORITHM
   Channel A: Capacitive Probe | Channel B: Hydrostatic DP | Channel C: Multi-Point Thermal Rake
   ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)

(* Calculate Cross-Channel Absolute Discrepancies *)
rLevelDiscrepancy_AB := ABS(rBathLevel_SensorA_mm - rBathLevel_SensorB_mm);
rLevelDiscrepancy_BC := ABS(rBathLevel_SensorB_mm - rBathLevel_SensorC_mm);
rLevelDiscrepancy_CA := ABS(rBathLevel_SensorC_mm - rBathLevel_SensorA_mm);

(* Individual Sensor Health and Plausibility Assessment *)
IF (rBathLevel_SensorA_mm < 5.0) OR (rBathLevel_SensorA_mm > 350.0) THEN
    bLevelA_Healthy := FALSE;
END_IF;
IF (rBathLevel_SensorB_mm < 5.0) OR (rBathLevel_SensorB_mm > 350.0) THEN
    bLevelB_Healthy := FALSE;
END_IF;
IF (rBathLevel_SensorC_mm < 5.0) OR (rBathLevel_SensorC_mm > 350.0) THEN
    bLevelC_Healthy := FALSE;
END_IF;

(* Cross-Channel Drift and Discrepancy Fault Discrimination *)
IF bLevelA_Healthy AND bLevelB_Healthy AND (rLevelDiscrepancy_AB > rLevelTolerance_mm) THEN
    IF rLevelDiscrepancy_CA > rLevelTolerance_mm THEN
        (* Channel A deviates from both B and C -> Shed Channel A *)
        bLevelA_Healthy := FALSE;
    ELSIF rLevelDiscrepancy_BC > rLevelTolerance_mm THEN
        (* Channel B deviates from both A and C -> Shed Channel B *)
        bLevelB_Healthy := FALSE;
    END_IF;
END_IF;

IF bLevelB_Healthy AND bLevelC_Healthy AND (rLevelDiscrepancy_BC > rLevelTolerance_mm) THEN
    IF (rLevelDiscrepancy_CA > rLevelTolerance_mm) AND bLevelA_Healthy THEN
        (* Channel C deviates from both A and B -> Shed Channel C *)
        bLevelC_Healthy := FALSE;
    END_IF;
END_IF;

(* Recompute Healthy Sensor Tally *)
iLevelHealthyCount := 0;
IF bLevelA_Healthy THEN iLevelHealthyCount := iLevelHealthyCount + 1; END_IF;
IF bLevelB_Healthy THEN iLevelHealthyCount := iLevelHealthyCount + 1; END_IF;
IF bLevelC_Healthy THEN iLevelHealthyCount := iLevelHealthyCount + 1; END_IF;

(* 2oo3 Voting / Degraded 1oo2 Averaging / Fail-Safe Selection *)
IF iLevelHealthyCount = 3 THEN
    (* Full 2oo3 Median Select Logic *)
    IF ((rBathLevel_SensorA_mm >= rBathLevel_SensorB_mm) AND (rBathLevel_SensorA_mm <= rBathLevel_SensorC_mm)) OR
       ((rBathLevel_SensorA_mm <= rBathLevel_SensorB_mm) AND (rBathLevel_SensorA_mm >= rBathLevel_SensorC_mm)) THEN
        rVotedLevel_mm := rBathLevel_SensorA_mm;
    ELSIF ((rBathLevel_SensorB_mm >= rBathLevel_SensorA_mm) AND (rBathLevel_SensorB_mm <= rBathLevel_SensorC_mm)) OR
          ((rBathLevel_SensorB_mm <= rBathLevel_SensorA_mm) AND (rBathLevel_SensorB_mm >= rBathLevel_SensorC_mm)) THEN
        rVotedLevel_mm := rBathLevel_SensorB_mm;
    ELSE
        rVotedLevel_mm := rBathLevel_SensorC_mm;
    END_IF;
    tLevelDiscrepancyTimer(IN := FALSE, PT := T#2S);
ELSIF iLevelHealthyCount = 2 THEN
    (* Degraded 1oo2 Operational Mode: Average the two healthy channels *)
    IF bLevelA_Healthy AND bLevelB_Healthy THEN
        rVotedLevel_mm := 0.5 * (rBathLevel_SensorA_mm + rBathLevel_SensorB_mm);
        rDiffAbs := ABS(rBathLevel_SensorA_mm - rBathLevel_SensorB_mm);
    ELSIF bLevelB_Healthy AND bLevelC_Healthy THEN
        rVotedLevel_mm := 0.5 * (rBathLevel_SensorB_mm + rBathLevel_SensorC_mm);
        rDiffAbs := ABS(rBathLevel_SensorB_mm - rBathLevel_SensorC_mm);
    ELSE
        rVotedLevel_mm := 0.5 * (rBathLevel_SensorA_mm + rBathLevel_SensorC_mm);
        rDiffAbs := ABS(rBathLevel_SensorA_mm - rBathLevel_SensorC_mm);
    END_IF;
    
    (* Raise Maintenance Warning Word Bit 4: Cryo Level Sensor Degraded to 1oo2 *)
    dwWarningWord := dwWarningWord OR 16#00000010;

    (* Check if remaining two sensors diverge beyond tolerance *)
    tLevelDiscrepancyTimer(IN := (rDiffAbs > rLevelTolerance_mm), PT := T#2S);
    IF tLevelDiscrepancyTimer.Q THEN
        (* Divergence in 1oo2 mode causes immediate shutdown trip *)
        dwActiveAlarmsWord := dwActiveAlarmsWord OR 16#00000004; (* Cryo Level 2oo3 Total Failure *)
    END_IF;
ELSIF iLevelHealthyCount = 1 THEN
    (* Severe Degradation: Single Sensor Operating - Raise Warning Bit 5 *)
    dwWarningWord := dwWarningWord OR 16#00000020;
    IF bLevelA_Healthy THEN
        rVotedLevel_mm := rBathLevel_SensorA_mm;
    ELSIF bLevelB_Healthy THEN
        rVotedLevel_mm := rBathLevel_SensorB_mm;
    ELSE
        rVotedLevel_mm := rBathLevel_SensorC_mm;
    END_IF;
ELSE
    (* Total Sensor Loss (0 Healthy) -> Immediate Emergency Stop Trip *)
    rVotedLevel_mm := 0.0;
    dwActiveAlarmsWord := dwActiveAlarmsWord OR 16#00000004; (* Cryo Level Total Sensor Loss *)
END_IF;


(* -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
   SUB-SECTION 2.2: CRYOGENIC BATH TEMPERATURE 2oo3 TMR VOTING ALGORITHM
   Channel A, B, C: Triplicated Ultra-Stable Class-A RTD Pt100 Cryogenic Sensors
   ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)

rTempDiscrepancy_AB := ABS(rCryoBathTemp_SensorA_K - rCryoBathTemp_SensorB_K);
rTempDiscrepancy_BC := ABS(rCryoBathTemp_SensorB_K - rCryoBathTemp_SensorC_K);
rTempDiscrepancy_CA := ABS(rCryoBathTemp_SensorC_K - rCryoBathTemp_SensorA_K);

(* Plausibility Checks: Sub-cooled Nitrogen Bath [65.0 K .. 120.0 K] *)
IF (rCryoBathTemp_SensorA_K < 65.0) OR (rCryoBathTemp_SensorA_K > 120.0) THEN
    bTempA_Healthy := FALSE;
END_IF;
IF (rCryoBathTemp_SensorB_K < 65.0) OR (rCryoBathTemp_SensorB_K > 120.0) THEN
    bTempB_Healthy := FALSE;
END_IF;
IF (rCryoBathTemp_SensorC_K < 65.0) OR (rCryoBathTemp_SensorC_K > 120.0) THEN
    bTempC_Healthy := FALSE;
END_IF;

(* Identify Outlier Channel *)
IF bTempA_Healthy AND bTempB_Healthy AND (rTempDiscrepancy_AB > rTempTolerance_K) THEN
    IF rTempDiscrepancy_CA > rTempTolerance_K THEN
        bTempA_Healthy := FALSE;
    ELSIF rTempDiscrepancy_BC > rTempTolerance_K THEN
        bTempB_Healthy := FALSE;
    END_IF;
END_IF;

IF bTempB_Healthy AND bTempC_Healthy AND (rTempDiscrepancy_BC > rTempTolerance_K) THEN
    IF (rTempDiscrepancy_CA > rTempTolerance_K) AND bTempA_Healthy THEN
        bTempC_Healthy := FALSE;
    END_IF;
END_IF;

(* Recompute Healthy RTD Count *)
iTempHealthyCount := 0;
IF bTempA_Healthy THEN iTempHealthyCount := iTempHealthyCount + 1; END_IF;
IF bTempB_Healthy THEN iTempHealthyCount := iTempHealthyCount + 1; END_IF;
IF bTempC_Healthy THEN iTempHealthyCount := iTempHealthyCount + 1; END_IF;

(* Voted Temperature Synthesis *)
IF iTempHealthyCount = 3 THEN
    (* 2oo3 Median Select *)
    IF ((rCryoBathTemp_SensorA_K >= rCryoBathTemp_SensorB_K) AND (rCryoBathTemp_SensorA_K <= rCryoBathTemp_SensorC_K)) OR
       ((rCryoBathTemp_SensorA_K <= rCryoBathTemp_SensorB_K) AND (rCryoBathTemp_SensorA_K >= rCryoBathTemp_SensorC_K)) THEN
        rVotedTemp_K := rCryoBathTemp_SensorA_K;
    ELSIF ((rCryoBathTemp_SensorB_K >= rCryoBathTemp_SensorA_K) AND (rCryoBathTemp_SensorB_K <= rCryoBathTemp_SensorC_K)) OR
          ((rCryoBathTemp_SensorB_K <= rCryoBathTemp_SensorA_K) AND (rCryoBathTemp_SensorB_K >= rCryoBathTemp_SensorC_K)) THEN
        rVotedTemp_K := rCryoBathTemp_SensorB_K;
    ELSE
        rVotedTemp_K := rCryoBathTemp_SensorC_K;
    END_IF;
    tTempDiscrepancyTimer(IN := FALSE, PT := T#2S);
ELSIF iTempHealthyCount = 2 THEN
    IF bTempA_Healthy AND bTempB_Healthy THEN
        rVotedTemp_K := 0.5 * (rCryoBathTemp_SensorA_K + rCryoBathTemp_SensorB_K);
        rDiffAbs := ABS(rCryoBathTemp_SensorA_K - rCryoBathTemp_SensorB_K);
    ELSIF bTempB_Healthy AND bTempC_Healthy THEN
        rVotedTemp_K := 0.5 * (rCryoBathTemp_SensorB_K + rCryoBathTemp_SensorC_K);
        rDiffAbs := ABS(rCryoBathTemp_SensorB_K - rCryoBathTemp_SensorC_K);
    ELSE
        rVotedTemp_K := 0.5 * (rCryoBathTemp_SensorA_K + rCryoBathTemp_SensorC_K);
        rDiffAbs := ABS(rCryoBathTemp_SensorA_K - rCryoBathTemp_SensorC_K);
    END_IF;
    dwWarningWord := dwWarningWord OR 16#00000040; (* Warning Bit 6: Cryo Temp Sensor Degraded to 1oo2 *)

    tTempDiscrepancyTimer(IN := (rDiffAbs > rTempTolerance_K), PT := T#2S);
    IF tTempDiscrepancyTimer.Q THEN
        dwActiveAlarmsWord := dwActiveAlarmsWord OR 16#00000008; (* Cryo Temp 2oo3 Total Failure Trip *)
    END_IF;
ELSIF iTempHealthyCount = 1 THEN
    dwWarningWord := dwWarningWord OR 16#00000080; (* Warning Bit 7: Cryo Temp Single Sensor Remaining *)
    IF bTempA_Healthy THEN
        rVotedTemp_K := rCryoBathTemp_SensorA_K;
    ELSIF bTempB_Healthy THEN
        rVotedTemp_K := rCryoBathTemp_SensorB_K;
    ELSE
        rVotedTemp_K := rCryoBathTemp_SensorC_K;
    END_IF;
ELSE
    rVotedTemp_K := 300.0; (* Failsafe high temperature default *)
    dwActiveAlarmsWord := dwActiveAlarmsWord OR 16#00000008; (* Cryo Temp Total Sensor Loss Trip *)
END_IF;

(* =================================================================================================
   SECTION 3: ULTRASONIC CAVITATION, THERMAL VITRIFICATION & LASER PSD ANALYSIS
   ================================================================================================= *)

(* -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
   SUB-SECTION 3.1: LANG-RAYLEIGH HIGH-FREQUENCY ULTRASONIC ATOMIZATION PHYSICS
   ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
IF rPiezoFreq_kHz > 50.0 THEN
    (* Capillary wavelength: lambda_cap = ((8.0 * PI * sigma) / (rho * f^2))^(1/3) *)
    rAcousticWaveLength_um := ( (8.0 * rPI * rSurfaceTension_Npm) / 
                               (rLiquidDensity_kgm3 * (rPiezoFreq_kHz * 1000.0) * (rPiezoFreq_kHz * 1000.0)) ) ** (0.333333);
    rAcousticWaveLength_um := rAcousticWaveLength_um * 1000000.0; (* Convert [m] to [um] *)

    (* Lang Droplet Median Diameter Prediction: d_p = 0.340 * lambda_cap *)
    rTheoreticalDropletD50_um := rLangConstant * rAcousticWaveLength_um;

    (* Acoustic Energy Dissipation & Cavitation Inception Number *)
    (* PZT-8 mechanical quality factor Qm approx 600. Effective radiating horn area ~ 2.8e-4 m^2 *)
    rAcousticEnergyDensity_Jm3 := (rPiezoPower_W * 0.72) / (0.00028 * 1480.0); (* E = P_ac / (A * c) *)
    rCavitationIndex := rAcousticEnergyDensity_Jm3 / (101325.0 + 100.0 * rAtomizerChamberPress_mbar);
ELSE
    rTheoreticalDropletD50_um := 20.0;
    rCavitationIndex := 0.0;
END_IF;

(* Co-Axial Core-to-Shell Hydrodynamic Coupling and Shell Thickness *)
IF rShellFlowRate_mLmin > 0.001 THEN
    rEffectiveCoreShellRatio := rCoreFlowRate_mLmin / rShellFlowRate_mLmin;
    (* Volumetric core microsphere diameter: d_core = d_p * (R_cs / (1.0 + R_cs))^(1/3) *)
    rCalculatedShellThickness_um := 0.5 * rLaserD50_um * 
        (1.0 - (rEffectiveCoreShellRatio / (1.0 + rEffectiveCoreShellRatio)) ** (0.333333));
ELSE
    rEffectiveCoreShellRatio := 99.0;
    rCalculatedShellThickness_um := 0.0;
END_IF;


(* -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
   SUB-SECTION 3.2: CRYOGENIC THERMAL VITRIFICATION & BOIL-OFF MASS BALANCE
   ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* Total Heat Influx into Nitrogen Bath: Q_total = Q_ambient + Q_spray + Q_piezo_scatter *)
(* Droplet Enthalpy Quench: m_dot_spray * [cp_liq*(T_in - T_f) + L_fusion + cp_ice*(T_f - T_LN2)] *)
(* Average specific heat ~ 3800 J/kg/K, Latent heat ~ 280 kJ/kg, subcooling to 77.4 K *)
rBoilOffMassFlow_kgs := ( rAmbientHeatLeak_W + 
                          ((rCoreFlowRate_mLmin + rShellFlowRate_mLmin) * (1.12 / 60000.0) * 850000.0) +
                          (rPiezoPower_W * 0.18) ) / rLatentHeatVap_Jkg;

rEstimatedBoilOffRate_kgh := rBoilOffMassFlow_kgs * 3600.0;

(* Droplet Vitrification Dynamics & Lumped Biot Number Verification *)
(* h_cryo during micro-acoustic boiling agitation ~ 1450 W/m^2/K, k_droplet ~ 0.56 W/m/K *)
IF rLaserD50_um > 1.0 THEN
    rThermalBiotNumber := (1450.0 * (rLaserD50_um * 0.0000005)) / (3.0 * 0.56);
    (* Vitrification cooling rate: dT/dt = (6.0 * h * Delta_T) / (rho * cp * d_p) *)
    rDropletQuenchRate_Ks := (6.0 * 1450.0 * (293.15 - rVotedTemp_K)) / 
                             (rLiquidDensity_kgm3 * 3800.0 * (rLaserD50_um * 0.000001));
    rDropletFreezingTime_ms := (293.15 - 135.0) / (rDropletQuenchRate_Ks + 0.001) * 1000.0;
ELSE
    rThermalBiotNumber := 0.05;
    rDropletQuenchRate_Ks := 2500.0;
    rDropletFreezingTime_ms := 65.0;
END_IF;


(* -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
   SUB-SECTION 3.3: IN-LINE LASER DIFFRACTION PARTICLE SIZE DISTRIBUTION (PSD) ANALYSIS
   ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* Polydispersity Span Calculation: Span = (D90 - D10) / D50 *)
IF rLaserD50_um > 0.50 THEN
    rCurrentSpan := (rLaserD90_um - rLaserD10_um) / rLaserD50_um;
ELSE
    rCurrentSpan := 0.80;
END_IF;

(* 1st-Order Exponential Smoothing Filters for Noise Rejection (Tau = 0.25 s) *)
rLaserFilteredD50_um := rLaserFilteredD50_um + 0.1667 * (rLaserD50_um - rLaserFilteredD50_um);
rLaserFilteredSpan   := rLaserFilteredSpan   + 0.1667 * (rCurrentSpan - rLaserFilteredSpan);

(* Optical Obscuration Health & Anti-Frosting Purge Management *)
(* Ideal Obscuration window: 12.0% to 22.0% *)
IF rLaserObscuration_pct < 6.0 THEN
    (* Plume loss or insufficient density *)
    dwWarningWord := dwWarningWord OR 16#00000100; (* Warning Bit 8: Optical Obscuration Low *)
ELSIF rLaserObscuration_pct > 28.0 THEN
    (* Severe multiple scattering or window cryo-frosting *)
    dwWarningWord := dwWarningWord OR 16#00000200; (* Warning Bit 9: Optical Obscuration High *)
    bWindowPurgeRequest := TRUE;
END_IF;

(* Window Quartz Defrosting Cycle: 1.5s Purge burst every 45 seconds *)
tWindowPurgeCycleTimer(IN := NOT tWindowPurgeCycleTimer.Q, PT := T#45S);
IF tWindowPurgeCycleTimer.Q OR bWindowPurgeRequest THEN
    tWindowPurgeTimer(IN := TRUE, PT := T#1500MS);
    bOpticalWindowPurgeActive := TRUE;
    rWindowHeaterPower_W      := 35.0; (* Energize heating blanket *)
    IF tWindowPurgeTimer.Q THEN
        tWindowPurgeTimer(IN := FALSE);
        bOpticalWindowPurgeActive := FALSE;
        bWindowPurgeRequest       := FALSE;
        rWindowHeaterPower_W      := 10.0; (* Keep-warm standby *)
    END_IF;
ELSE
    tWindowPurgeTimer(IN := FALSE);
    bOpticalWindowPurgeActive := FALSE;
    rWindowHeaterPower_W      := 10.0;
END_IF;

(* Critical Quality Attribute (CQA) Status Verification *)
bMicrosphereQualityOK := (rLaserFilteredD50_um >= (rTargetD50_um - 2.5)) AND
                         (rLaserFilteredD50_um <= (rTargetD50_um + 2.5)) AND
                         (rLaserFilteredSpan <= rTargetSpan) AND
                         (rEffectiveCoreShellRatio >= (rTargetCoreShellRatio * 0.85)) AND
                         (rEffectiveCoreShellRatio <= (rTargetCoreShellRatio * 1.15)) AND
                         (rVotedTemp_K <= 82.0);

(* =================================================================================================
   SECTION 4: 5x5 STATE-SPACE KALMAN FILTER OBSERVER & PROJECTED GRADIENT MPC
   ================================================================================================= *)

(* Pack Actual Measurements Vector: y[k] = [D50_filtered, Span_filtered, Voted_Bath_Level]^T *)
vecMeas_y[1] := rLaserFilteredD50_um;
vecMeas_y[2] := rLaserFilteredSpan;
vecMeas_y[3] := rVotedLevel_mm;

(* Formulate State Target Vector: x_sp *)
vecTarget_x[1] := rTargetD50_um;
vecTarget_x[2] := rTargetSpan;
vecTarget_x[3] := rTargetBathLevel_mm;
vecTarget_x[4] := 77.36;                   (* Liquid Nitrogen boiling point at ambient pressure [K] *)
vecTarget_x[5] := rTargetTransducerPower_W;

(* -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
   SUB-SECTION 4.1: DISCRETE KALMAN FILTER MEASUREMENT UPDATE & TIME PROPAGATION
   1. Compute Innovation Residual: e[k] = y[k] - C_d * x_pred[k]
   2. State Measurement Correction: x[k|k] = x_pred[k] + K * e[k]
   3. Time Propagation for Next Cycle: x_pred[k+1] = A_d * x[k|k] + B_d * u[k]
   ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
FOR iRow := 1 TO 3 DO
    rTempSum := 0.0;
    FOR iCol := 1 TO 5 DO
        rTempSum := rTempSum + matC[iRow, iCol] * vecState_x_pred[iCol];
    END_FOR;
    vecResidual_y[iRow] := vecMeas_y[iRow] - rTempSum;
END_FOR;

(* Kalman State Correction: x = x_pred + K * e *)
FOR iRow := 1 TO 5 DO
    rTempSum := 0.0;
    FOR iCol := 1 TO 3 DO
        rTempSum := rTempSum + matK_Kalman[iRow, iCol] * vecResidual_y[iCol];
    END_FOR;
    vecState_x[iRow] := vecState_x_pred[iRow] + rTempSum;
END_FOR;

(* Measurement Residual Plausibility Check (Innovation Monitoring) *)
IF (ABS(vecResidual_y[1]) > 12.0) OR (ABS(vecResidual_y[2]) > 0.65) THEN
    (* Severe innovation divergence -> Flag Optical Path Anomaly *)
    dwWarningWord := dwWarningWord OR 16#00000400; (* Warning Bit 10: Kalman Innovation Anomaly *)
END_IF;


(* -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
   SUB-SECTION 4.2: CONSTRAINED MULTIVARIABLE MODEL PREDICTIVE CONTROL (MPC) OPTIMIZER
   Iterative Projected Gradient Descent over Quadratic Cost:
   J = 0.5 * sum( Q_i * (x_i - x_target_i)^2 ) + 0.5 * sum( R_j * (u_j - u_prev_j)^2 )
   ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
IF bAutoMPC_Mode AND (iMachineState = 70) AND (dwActiveAlarmsWord = 16#00000000) THEN

    (* Initialize Input Candidate from Previous Solution *)
    FOR iCol := 1 TO 5 DO
        vecInput_u[iCol] := vecInput_u_prev[iCol];
    END_FOR;

    (* Projected Gradient Iteration Loop *)
    FOR iIter := 1 TO iMpcMaxIterations DO
        
        (* Gradient Calculation: nabla_J_u = B_d^T * Q * (A_d*x + B_d*u - x_sp) + R * (u - u_prev) *)
        FOR iCol := 1 TO 5 DO
            (* Direct sensitivity approximation for gradient computation *)
            rTempSum := 0.0;
            FOR iRow := 1 TO 5 DO
                rTempSum := rTempSum + matB[iRow, iCol] * vecWeight_Q[iRow] * (vecState_x[iRow] - vecTarget_x[iRow]);
            END_FOR;
            (* Add Actuator Slew Rate Regularization *)
            rTempSum := rTempSum + vecWeight_R[iCol] * (vecInput_u[iCol] - vecInput_u_prev[iCol]);
            vecGradient_g[iCol] := rTempSum;
        END_FOR;

        (* Gradient Descent Step: u = u - alpha * nabla_J *)
        vecInput_u[1] := vecInput_u[1] - rMpcStepSize * vecGradient_g[1];
        vecInput_u[2] := vecInput_u[2] - rMpcStepSize * vecGradient_g[2];
        vecInput_u[3] := vecInput_u[3] - rMpcStepSize * vecGradient_g[3];
        vecInput_u[4] := vecInput_u[4] - rMpcStepSize * vecGradient_g[4];
        vecInput_u[5] := vecInput_u[5] - rMpcStepSize * vecGradient_g[5];

        (* Hard Saturation Box Constraint Projection *)
        (* u1: Piezo Power [W] *)
        IF vecInput_u[1] < rMinPiezoPower_W THEN vecInput_u[1] := rMinPiezoPower_W; END_IF;
        IF vecInput_u[1] > rMaxPiezoPower_W THEN vecInput_u[1] := rMaxPiezoPower_W; END_IF;

        (* u2: Piezo Frequency [kHz] *)
        IF vecInput_u[2] < rMinPiezoFreq_kHz THEN vecInput_u[2] := rMinPiezoFreq_kHz; END_IF;
        IF vecInput_u[2] > rMaxPiezoFreq_kHz THEN vecInput_u[2] := rMaxPiezoFreq_kHz; END_IF;

        (* u3: Core Pump Delivery [mL/min] *)
        IF vecInput_u[3] < rMinCorePump_mLmin THEN vecInput_u[3] := rMinCorePump_mLmin; END_IF;
        IF vecInput_u[3] > rMaxCorePump_mLmin THEN vecInput_u[3] := rMaxCorePump_mLmin; END_IF;

        (* u4: Shell Pump Delivery [mL/min] *)
        IF vecInput_u[4] < rMinShellPump_mLmin THEN vecInput_u[4] := rMinShellPump_mLmin; END_IF;
        IF vecInput_u[4] > rMaxShellPump_mLmin THEN vecInput_u[4] := rMaxShellPump_mLmin; END_IF;

        (* u5: Cryogenic Valve Demand [%] *)
        IF vecInput_u[5] < rMinCryoValve_pct THEN vecInput_u[5] := rMinCryoValve_pct; END_IF;
        IF vecInput_u[5] > rMaxCryoValve_pct THEN vecInput_u[5] := rMaxCryoValve_pct; END_IF;

    END_FOR;

    (* Apply Slew Rate Limiters to Prevent Actuator Shocks *)
    (* Delta u1: Piezo Power *)
    vecDeltaU[1] := vecInput_u[1] - vecInput_u_prev[1];
    IF vecDeltaU[1] > rMaxDeltaU1_Power THEN vecInput_u[1] := vecInput_u_prev[1] + rMaxDeltaU1_Power; END_IF;
    IF vecDeltaU[1] < -rMaxDeltaU1_Power THEN vecInput_u[1] := vecInput_u_prev[1] - rMaxDeltaU1_Power; END_IF;

    (* Delta u2: Piezo Frequency *)
    vecDeltaU[2] := vecInput_u[2] - vecInput_u_prev[2];
    IF vecDeltaU[2] > rMaxDeltaU2_Freq THEN vecInput_u[2] := vecInput_u_prev[2] + rMaxDeltaU2_Freq; END_IF;
    IF vecDeltaU[2] < -rMaxDeltaU2_Freq THEN vecInput_u[2] := vecInput_u_prev[2] - rMaxDeltaU2_Freq; END_IF;

    (* Delta u3: Core Pump Flow *)
    vecDeltaU[3] := vecInput_u[3] - vecInput_u_prev[3];
    IF vecDeltaU[3] > rMaxDeltaU3_CorePump THEN vecInput_u[3] := vecInput_u_prev[3] + rMaxDeltaU3_CorePump; END_IF;
    IF vecDeltaU[3] < -rMaxDeltaU3_CorePump THEN vecInput_u[3] := vecInput_u_prev[3] - rMaxDeltaU3_CorePump; END_IF;

    (* Delta u4: Shell Pump Flow *)
    vecDeltaU[4] := vecInput_u[4] - vecInput_u_prev[4];
    IF vecDeltaU[4] > rMaxDeltaU4_ShellPump THEN vecInput_u[4] := vecInput_u_prev[4] + rMaxDeltaU4_ShellPump; END_IF;
    IF vecDeltaU[4] < -rMaxDeltaU4_ShellPump THEN vecInput_u[4] := vecInput_u_prev[4] - rMaxDeltaU4_ShellPump; END_IF;

    (* Delta u5: Cryo Valve Demand *)
    vecDeltaU[5] := vecInput_u[5] - vecInput_u_prev[5];
    IF vecDeltaU[5] > rMaxDeltaU5_CryoValve THEN vecInput_u[5] := vecInput_u_prev[5] + rMaxDeltaU5_CryoValve; END_IF;
    IF vecDeltaU[5] < -rMaxDeltaU5_CryoValve THEN vecInput_u[5] := vecInput_u_prev[5] - rMaxDeltaU5_CryoValve; END_IF;

    (* Assign Manipulated Actuator Demands *)
    rPiezoPowerSP_W        := vecInput_u[1];
    rPiezoFreqSP_kHz       := vecInput_u[2];
    rCorePumpRateSP_mLmin  := vecInput_u[3];
    rShellPumpRateSP_mLmin := vecInput_u[4];
    rCryoValveDemand_pct   := vecInput_u[5];

ELSE
    (* =============================================================================================
       GRACEFUL DEGRADATION: DECOUPLED GAIN-SCHEDULED PID FALLBACK CONTROLLERS
       Active when bAutoMPC_Mode is FALSE, optical obscuration is degraded, or machine state < 70
       ============================================================================================= *)
    IF (iMachineState = 70) THEN
        (* Raise Warning Bit 11: Degradation Fallback PID Mode Active *)
        dwWarningWord := dwWarningWord OR 16#00000800;

        (* 1. D50 Droplet Size Control Loop -> Modulates Piezo Active Power Setpoint *)
        rPidD50_Error    := rTargetD50_um - rLaserFilteredD50_um;
        rPidD50_Integral := rPidD50_Integral + (rPidD50_Error * rSamplingTime_s);
        (* Anti-windup clamping *)
        IF rPidD50_Integral > 15.0 THEN rPidD50_Integral := 15.0; END_IF;
        IF rPidD50_Integral < -15.0 THEN rPidD50_Integral := -15.0; END_IF;

        rPiezoPowerSP_W := rTargetTransducerPower_W - (rPidD50_Kp * rPidD50_Error) - 
                           ((rPidD50_Kp / rPidD50_Ti) * rPidD50_Integral) - 
                           (rPidD50_Td * (rPidD50_Error - rPidD50_PrevError) / rSamplingTime_s);
        rPidD50_PrevError := rPidD50_Error;

        (* Clamp Piezo Output *)
        IF rPiezoPowerSP_W < rMinPiezoPower_W THEN rPiezoPowerSP_W := rMinPiezoPower_W; END_IF;
        IF rPiezoPowerSP_W > rMaxPiezoPower_W THEN rPiezoPowerSP_W := rMaxPiezoPower_W; END_IF;
        rPiezoFreqSP_kHz := rOptimalResonanceFreq_kHz;

        (* Feed Pumps at Programmed Target Ratio *)
        rCorePumpRateSP_mLmin  := 0.850;
        rShellPumpRateSP_mLmin := 0.850 / (rTargetCoreShellRatio + 0.001);

        (* 2. Cryogenic Nitrogen Bath Level Control Loop -> Modulates Cryo Injection Valve *)
        rPidLevel_Error    := rTargetBathLevel_mm - rVotedLevel_mm;
        rPidLevel_Integral := rPidLevel_Integral + (rPidLevel_Error * rSamplingTime_s);
        IF rPidLevel_Integral > 100.0 THEN rPidLevel_Integral := 100.0; END_IF;
        IF rPidLevel_Integral < -100.0 THEN rPidLevel_Integral := -100.0; END_IF;

        rCryoValveDemand_pct := 15.0 + (rPidLevel_Kp * rPidLevel_Error) + 
                                ((rPidLevel_Kp / rPidLevel_Ti) * rPidLevel_Integral) + 
                                (rPidLevel_Td * (rPidLevel_Error - rPidLevel_PrevError) / rSamplingTime_s);
        rPidLevel_PrevError := rPidLevel_Error;

        IF rCryoValveDemand_pct < rMinCryoValve_pct THEN rCryoValveDemand_pct := rMinCryoValve_pct; END_IF;
        IF rCryoValveDemand_pct > rMaxCryoValve_pct THEN rCryoValveDemand_pct := rMaxCryoValve_pct; END_IF;

        (* Store Demands into Vector for Bumpless Transition Back to MPC *)
        vecInput_u[1] := rPiezoPowerSP_W;
        vecInput_u[2] := rPiezoFreqSP_kHz;
        vecInput_u[3] := rCorePumpRateSP_mLmin;
        vecInput_u[4] := rShellPumpRateSP_mLmin;
        vecInput_u[5] := rCryoValveDemand_pct;
    END_IF;
END_IF;

(* Update Previous Input Vector *)
FOR iCol := 1 TO 5 DO
    vecInput_u_prev[iCol] := vecInput_u[iCol];
END_FOR;

(* Time Propagation for Next Execution Cycle: x_pred[k+1] = A_d * x[k|k] + B_d * u[k] *)
FOR iRow := 1 TO 5 DO
    rTempSum := 0.0;
    FOR iCol := 1 TO 5 DO
        rTempSum := rTempSum + matA[iRow, iCol] * vecState_x[iCol] + matB[iRow, iCol] * vecInput_u[iCol];
    END_FOR;
    vecState_x_pred[iRow] := rTempSum;
END_FOR;

(* =================================================================================================
   SECTION 5: ISA-18.2 MULTI-STAGE SEQUENTIAL STATE MACHINE
   ================================================================================================= *)

(* Cumulative State Residence Timer *)
tStateTimer(IN := (iMachineState = iPreviousState), PT := T#120M);
iPreviousState := iMachineState;

CASE iMachineState OF

    0: (* -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
          STATE 0: UNINITIALIZED / STANDBY
          Awaiting master enable command and safety interlock verification.
          ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
        rPiezoPowerSP_W        := 0.0;
        rPiezoFreqSP_kHz       := 120.0;
        rCorePumpRateSP_mLmin  := 0.0;
        rShellPumpRateSP_mLmin := 0.0;
        rCryoValveDemand_pct   := 0.0;
        bSystemReady           := FALSE;
        bMicrosphereQualityOK  := FALSE;
        dwSystemStatusWord     := 16#00000000;

        IF bEnableSystem AND (dwActiveAlarmsWord = 16#00000000) THEN
            iMachineState := 10; (* Transition to Power-On Self Test *)
        END_IF;


    10: (* ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
           STATE 10: POWER-ON SELF TEST & INSTRUMENTATION INTEGRITY AUDIT
           Validates 2oo3 sensor channels, transducer temperature, and chamber pressure.
           ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
        dwSystemStatusWord := 16#0000000A;
        
        IF (iLevelHealthyCount >= 2) AND (iTempHealthyCount >= 2) AND 
           (rTransducerTemp_degC < 45.0) AND (rAtomizerChamberPress_mbar > -50.0) THEN
            iMachineState := 20; (* Proceed to Optical Alignment *)
        ELSE
            IF rTransducerTemp_degC >= 45.0 THEN
                dwActiveAlarmsWord := dwActiveAlarmsWord OR 16#00000080; (* PZT Overtemperature Trip *)
            END_IF;
        END_IF;


    20: (* ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
           STATE 20: OPTICAL ALIGNMENT & LASER DARK-BACKGROUND CALIBRATION
           Energizes window defroster, validates zero obscuration baseline without spray plume.
           ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
        dwSystemStatusWord := 16#00000014;
        rWindowHeaterPower_W := 25.0;

        IF tStateTimer.ET >= T#3S THEN
            IF (rLaserObscuration_pct <= 2.5) THEN
                iMachineState := 30; (* Optical path clear, advance to Cryo Chilldown *)
            ELSE
                (* Quartz window fouled prior to run *)
                bWindowPurgeRequest := TRUE;
                IF tStateTimer.ET >= T#15S THEN
                    dwActiveAlarmsWord := dwActiveAlarmsWord OR 16#00000100; (* Laser Zero Calibration Timeout *)
                END_IF;
            END_IF;
        END_IF;


    30: (* ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
           STATE 30: CRYOGENIC BATH CHILLDOWN & PRE-FILL
           Ramps liquid nitrogen injection until bath level reaches initial target (150 mm).
           ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
        dwSystemStatusWord := 16#0000001E;

        IF rVotedLevel_mm < (rTargetBathLevel_mm - 5.0) THEN
            rCryoValveDemand_pct := 38.0; (* Proportional pre-fill demand *)
        ELSE
            rCryoValveDemand_pct := 12.0; (* Pre-fill level reached, thermal soaking *)

(* ==================================================================================================================== *)
(* Safety Instrumented Function (SIF) 101: Emergency de-energize and fail-safe bypass opening on trip.                 *)
(* Ensures compliance with IEC 61508 / IEC 61511 functional safety standards for supercritical thermal processes.      *)

IF NOT bEmergencyStop THEN
    bSystemReady := FALSE;
    bSystemRunning := FALSE;
    bSystemTripped := TRUE;
    iState := 100; (* Branch immediately into emergency depressurization and trip state *)
    dwAlarmWord1 := dwAlarmWord1 OR 16#0000_0001; (* E-Stop tripped bit *)
END_IF;

(* -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)

END_IF;
IF ABS(rBrineInletPressure_B_bar - rBrineInletPressure_C_bar) > 2.20 THEN
    bPres_SensorB_Fail := TRUE;
END_IF;

(* 3.0 GEOTHERMAL BRINE THERMOPHYSICAL PROPERTIES & AMORPHOUS SILICA SATURATION MODEL                                   *)
(* ==================================================================================================================== *)
(* Evaluates temperature-dependent silica equilibrium solubility C_eq via empirical 3rd order polynomial.              *)
(* Determines supersaturation index S, logarithmic saturation SI, and homogeneous nucleation induction time tau_ind.  *)

rSilicaEquilibriumSolubility_mgL := 55.40 + (1.280 * rVotedBrineTemp_degC) + (0.00410 * rVotedBrineTemp_degC * rVotedBrineTemp_degC);
IF rSilicaEquilibriumSolubility_mgL < 15.0 THEN
    rSilicaEquilibriumSolubility_mgL := 15.0;
END_IF;

(* Supersaturation Ratio: S = [SiO2] / C_eq *)
rSilicaSupersaturationRatio := rDissolvedSilicaConc_mgL / rSilicaEquilibriumSolubility_mgL;

(* Logarithmic Saturation Index: SI = log10(S) *)
IF rSilicaSupersaturationRatio > 0.05 THEN
    IF (rSilicaSupersaturationRatio > 0.50) AND (rSilicaSupersaturationRatio < 2.00) THEN
        (* Quadratic Taylor expansion approximation of ln(S) *)
        rSilicaSaturationIndex := ((rSilicaSupersaturationRatio - 1.0) - (0.50 * (rSilicaSupersaturationRatio - 1.0) * (rSilicaSupersaturationRatio - 1.0))) / 2.302585;
    ELSE
        rSilicaSaturationIndex := (rSilicaSupersaturationRatio - 1.0) / 2.302585;
    END_IF;
ELSE
    rSilicaSaturationIndex := -1.0;
END_IF;

(* Silica Polymerization Induction Time Kinetics *)
IF rSilicaSupersaturationRatio > 1.05 THEN
    bSilicaPolymerizationHazard := TRUE;
    rSilicaPolymerizationRate_mgL_s := 0.0450 * (rSilicaSupersaturationRatio - 1.0) * (rSilicaSupersaturationRatio - 1.0);
    rSilicaInductionTime_sec := 3600.0 / (1.0 + (12.50 * (rSilicaSupersaturationRatio - 1.0)));
    IF rSilicaInductionTime_sec < 180.0 THEN
        bSilicaGelationImminent := TRUE;
        dwWarningWord := dwWarningWord OR 16#0000_0020; (* Silica gelation hazard alert *)
    ELSE
        bSilicaGelationImminent := FALSE;
    END_IF;
ELSE
    bSilicaPolymerizationHazard := FALSE;
    bSilicaGelationImminent := FALSE;
    rSilicaPolymerizationRate_mgL_s := 0.0;
    rSilicaInductionTime_sec := 99999.0;
END_IF;


(* ==================================================================================================================== *)
(* 4.0 SORBENT BED DYNAMIC ADSORPTION FRONT TRACKING & 10-NODE AXIAL DISCRETIZATION                                    *)
(* ==================================================================================================================== *)
(* Implements a continuous mass balance across 10 spatial nodes along bed height L = 3.80 m.                            *)
(* Couples interstitial fluid velocity to modified Bohart-Adams sorption kinetics.                                     *)

IF (rVotedBrineFlow_m3h > 10.0) AND bSystemRunning AND (iState = 30) THEN
    (* Interstitial superficial velocity u_s = Q / (3600 * A_bed) [m/s] *)
    rSuperficialVelocity_ms := (rVotedBrineFlow_m3h / 3600.0) / rBedCrossSection_m2;

    (* Lithium Mass Influx rate [kg/h] *)
    rRawLithiumHarvestRate_kgh := (rVotedBrineFlow_m3h * (rInletLithiumConc_mgL - rEffluentLithiumConc_mgL)) / 1000.0;
    IF rRawLithiumHarvestRate_kgh < 0.0 THEN rRawLithiumHarvestRate_kgh := 0.0; END_IF;

    (* Wave Front Propagation Velocity along axial coordinate z [m/s] *)
    IF rInletLithiumConc_mgL > 10.0 THEN
        rAdsorptionFrontPosition_m := rAdsorptionFrontPosition_m + 
            ((rSuperficialVelocity_ms / (rSorbentVoidFraction + (rSorbentBulkDensity_kgm3 * rSorbentMaxCapacity_mg_g * rSorbentHealthFactor / rInletLithiumConc_mgL))) * rCycleTime_sec);
    END_IF;

    (* Mass integration accumulators *)
    rCumulativeLiMassFed_kg := rCumulativeLiMassFed_kg + ((rVotedBrineFlow_m3h * rInletLithiumConc_mgL / 1000.0) * (rCycleTime_sec / 3600.0));
    rCumulativeLiMassAdsorbed_kg := rCumulativeLiMassAdsorbed_kg + (rRawLithiumHarvestRate_kgh * (rCycleTime_sec / 3600.0));

    (* Breakthrough percentage relative to total column height *)
    rEstimatedBreakthrough_pct := (rAdsorptionFrontPosition_m / rBedLength_m) * 100.0;
    IF rEstimatedBreakthrough_pct > 100.0 THEN rEstimatedBreakthrough_pct := 100.0; END_IF;

    (* Update Discretized 10-Node Axial Saturation Profile *)
    IF rAdsorptionFrontPosition_m >= 0.38 THEN rSorbentSaturation_Node0 := 0.999; END_IF;
    IF rAdsorptionFrontPosition_m >= 0.76 THEN rSorbentSaturation_Node1 := 0.995; END_IF;
    IF rAdsorptionFrontPosition_m >= 1.14 THEN rSorbentSaturation_Node2 := 0.980; END_IF;
    IF rAdsorptionFrontPosition_m >= 1.52 THEN rSorbentSaturation_Node3 := 0.950; END_IF;
    IF rAdsorptionFrontPosition_m >= 1.90 THEN rSorbentSaturation_Node4 := 0.890; END_IF;
    IF rAdsorptionFrontPosition_m >= 2.28 THEN rSorbentSaturation_Node5 := 0.750; END_IF;
    IF rAdsorptionFrontPosition_m >= 2.66 THEN rSorbentSaturation_Node6 := 0.520; END_IF;
    IF rAdsorptionFrontPosition_m >= 3.04 THEN rSorbentSaturation_Node7 := 0.280; END_IF;
    IF rAdsorptionFrontPosition_m >= 3.42 THEN rSorbentSaturation_Node8 := 0.110; END_IF;
    IF rAdsorptionFrontPosition_m >= 3.80 THEN rSorbentSaturation_Node9 := 0.035; END_IF;

    (* Carousel Index Permissive Trigger: Advance when front exceeds 88% or slip > 15% *)
    IF (rEstimatedBreakthrough_pct >= 88.0) OR ((rInletLithiumConc_mgL > 50.0) AND ((rEffluentLithiumConc_mgL / rInletLithiumConc_mgL) > 0.15)) THEN
        bAdsorptionLeadLagSwapReq := TRUE;
    ELSE
        bAdsorptionLeadLagSwapReq := FALSE;
    END_IF;
ELSE
    rSuperficialVelocity_ms := 0.0;
END_IF;
(* ==================================================================================================================== *)
(* 5.0 STATE-SPACE PLANT MATRICES & MODEL PREDICTIVE CONTROL (MPC) ENGINE                                               *)
(* ==================================================================================================================== *)
(* Implements a discrete-time linear state-space observer and predictive controller with analytical rate-of-change      *)
(* optimization and projected gradient constraint handling.                                                             *)

(* 5.1 Update State Vector Estimates *)
rState_x1_FrontPos_m := rAdsorptionFrontPosition_m;
rState_x2_BedDeltaP_bar := rColumnDiffPressure_bar;
rState_x3_ElutionPH := rVotedElutionPH_pH;
rState_x4_TurbineSpeed_rpm := rVotedTurbineSpeed_rpm;
rState_x5_SilicaIndex := rSilicaSaturationIndex;

(* 5.2 One-Step Ahead State Prediction: x(k+1) = A_d * x(k) + B_d * u(k) *)
rPred_x1_k1 := (A_11 * rState_x1_FrontPos_m) + (B_11 * rMpcOutput_u1_Bypass_pct);
rPred_x2_k1 := (A_21 * rState_x1_FrontPos_m) + (A_22 * rState_x2_BedDeltaP_bar) + (A_25 * rState_x5_SilicaIndex) +
               (B_21 * rMpcOutput_u1_Bypass_pct) + (B_23 * rMpcOutput_u3_Nozzle_pct) + (B_24 * rMpcOutput_u4_Inhibitor_pct);
rPred_x3_k1 := (A_33 * rState_x3_ElutionPH) + (B_32 * rMpcOutput_u2_Acid_pct);
rPred_x4_k1 := (A_42 * rState_x2_BedDeltaP_bar) + (A_44 * rState_x4_TurbineSpeed_rpm) +
               (B_41 * rMpcOutput_u1_Bypass_pct) + (B_43 * rMpcOutput_u3_Nozzle_pct);
rPred_x5_k1 := (A_51 * rState_x1_FrontPos_m) + (A_52 * rState_x2_BedDeltaP_bar) + (A_53 * rState_x3_ElutionPH) + (A_55 * rState_x5_SilicaIndex) +
               (B_51 * rMpcOutput_u1_Bypass_pct) + (B_52 * rMpcOutput_u2_Acid_pct) + (B_54 * rMpcOutput_u4_Inhibitor_pct);

(* 5.3 MPC Analytical Unconstrained Rate Optimization & Constraint Projection *)
(* Quadratic Cost: J = e^T * Q * e + delta_u^T * R * delta_u                                                           *)

(* Delta U1: Brine Bypass Valve Command Adjustment *)
rDeltaU1 := - (1.0 / (rWeight_R1 + 0.10)) * (
                (B_21 * rWeight_Q2 * (rPred_x2_k1 - rSetpoint_x2_BedDeltaP_bar)) +
                (B_41 * rWeight_Q4 * (rPred_x4_k1 - rSetpoint_x4_TurbineSpeed_rpm))
             );

(* Delta U2: Elution Acid Metering Stroke Adjustment *)
rDeltaU2 := - (1.0 / (rWeight_R2 + 0.10)) * (
                (B_32 * rWeight_Q3 * (rPred_x3_k1 - rSetpoint_x3_ElutionPH))
             );

(* Delta U3: HERT Turbine Spear Valve Nozzle Position Adjustment *)
rDeltaU3 := - (1.0 / (rWeight_R3 + 0.10)) * (
                (B_43 * rWeight_Q4 * (rPred_x4_k1 - rSetpoint_x4_TurbineSpeed_rpm)) +
                (B_23 * rWeight_Q2 * (rPred_x2_k1 - rSetpoint_x2_BedDeltaP_bar))
             );

(* Delta U4: Silica Inhibitor Dosing Injection Adjustment *)
rDeltaU4 := - (1.0 / (rWeight_R4 + 0.10)) * (
                (B_54 * 25.0 * (rPred_x5_k1 - 0.0)) +
                (B_24 * rWeight_Q2 * (rPred_x2_k1 - rSetpoint_x2_BedDeltaP_bar))
             );

(* Slew-Rate Limiting on Manipulated Increments *)
IF rDeltaU1 > 1.50 THEN rDeltaU1 := 1.50; ELSIF rDeltaU1 < -1.50 THEN rDeltaU1 := -1.50; END_IF;
IF rDeltaU2 > 2.00 THEN rDeltaU2 := 2.00; ELSIF rDeltaU2 < -2.00 THEN rDeltaU2 := -2.00; END_IF;
IF rDeltaU3 > 2.50 THEN rDeltaU3 := 2.50; ELSIF rDeltaU3 < -2.50 THEN rDeltaU3 := -2.50; END_IF;
IF rDeltaU4 > 1.80 THEN rDeltaU4 := 1.80; ELSIF rDeltaU4 < -1.80 THEN rDeltaU4 := -1.80; END_IF;

(* Integrate Increments into Absolute Actuator Positions *)
rMpcOutput_u1_Bypass_pct    := rMpcOutput_u1_Bypass_pct + (rDeltaU1 * rCycleTime_sec * 10.0);
rMpcOutput_u2_Acid_pct      := rMpcOutput_u2_Acid_pct + (rDeltaU2 * rCycleTime_sec * 10.0);
rMpcOutput_u3_Nozzle_pct    := rMpcOutput_u3_Nozzle_pct + (rDeltaU3 * rCycleTime_sec * 10.0);
rMpcOutput_u4_Inhibitor_pct := rMpcOutput_u4_Inhibitor_pct + (rDeltaU4 * rCycleTime_sec * 10.0);

(* Enforce Physical Actuator Saturation Envelopes [0.0% to 100.0%] *)
IF rMpcOutput_u1_Bypass_pct > 100.0 THEN rMpcOutput_u1_Bypass_pct := 100.0; ELSIF rMpcOutput_u1_Bypass_pct < 0.0 THEN rMpcOutput_u1_Bypass_pct := 0.0; END_IF;

    b) Solid phase plugging of variable inlet guide vane (VIGV) clearance channels, causing mechanical binding;
    c) Dynamic rotor imbalance, critical sub-synchronous whirl, and magnetic bearing trip;
    d) Catastrophic thermal-acoustic oscillations (Taconis oscillations) in cold-box piping.

  3. CYBER-PHYSICAL AUTOMATION ARCHITECTURE IMPLEMENTED IN THIS FUNCTION BLOCK:
  - TRIPLE MODULAR REDUNDANCY (2oo3) VOTING ENGINE: Triplicated physical instrumentation channels
    for HP Inlet Pressure, Cryogenic Inlet Temperature, and Turbine Shaft Rotational Speed with
    median selection, inter-channel discrepancy timers, dynamic channel health diagnostics, and
    bumpless degradation to 1oo2 fail-operational and 1oo1 fail-safe fallback modes.
  - REAL-TIME SLUSH FORMATION PROBABILITY ESTIMATOR: Non-linear Clapeyron pressure-dependent triple-point
    shift coupled with empirical Henry's law CO2 solubility depression and moisture dew point offset.
  - 6-STATE MULTIVARIABLE MODEL PREDICTIVE CONTROL (MPC): Discrete-time state-space model formulation
    with state vector x = [delta_T_in, delta_omega, delta_T_coldstore, slush_nucleation, delta_P_inter,
    delta_T_exhaust], control vector u = [VIGV_pos, Thermal_Bypass, Interstage_Heat, Gen_Torque],
    and measured disturbance vector d = [CryoAir_Flow, CO2_ppm]. Projected gradient descent quadratic
    programming (QP) solver running deterministically in the cyclic scan cycle with a barrier slack
    penalty guaranteeing enforcement of the solidification margin constraint.
  - DISCRETE KALMAN FILTER / STATE OBSERVER: Observer gain matrix L providing dynamic state estimation
    and sensor noise filtering.
  - ISA-18.2 COMPLIANT ALARM REGISTER & MULTI-TIER SAFETY INTERLOCKS: Complete trip matrix, warning bitmasks,
    and a 10-stage deterministic finite state machine (FSM).
====================================================================================================
*)

(* ============================================================================================= *)
(* SECTION 1: HARDWIRED SAFETY INTERLOCK VERIFICATION & SIL-3 EMERGENCY TRIP                     *)
(* ============================================================================================= *)
(* Active-low fail-safe emergency trip circuit check *)
IF NOT bEmergencyTrip THEN
    bEmergencyTripActive := TRUE;
    bTrip_Hardwire_Latched := TRUE;
    iStateStep := 90; (* Jump directly to STATE_EMERGENCY_TRIP_RAPID_ISOLATION_BLOWDOWN *)
END_IF;

(* Operator Diagnostic Reset & Latch Clear Handler *)
IF bAcknowledgeFaults THEN
    IF bEmergencyTrip THEN
        bTrip_Hardwire_Latched := FALSE;
    END_IF;
    IF rN_ExpanderSpeed_Voted_Rpm < 100.0 THEN
        bTrip_OverSpeed_Latched := FALSE;
    END_IF;
    IF rSlushSolidificationRisk < 0.15 THEN
        bTrip_SlushSevere_Latched := FALSE;
    END_IF;
    IF (rVibration_DE_X_Um < 16.0) AND (rVibration_DE_Y_Um < 16.0) THEN
        bTrip_VibrationHigh_Latched := FALSE;
    END_IF;
    IF rP_ColdBoxVacuum_Mbar < 0.01 THEN
        bTrip_VacuumLoss_Latched := FALSE;
    END_IF;
    IF rP_DryGasSeal_Diff_Bar > 1.25 THEN
        bTrip_SealGasLoss_Latched := FALSE;
    END_IF;
    IF rT_BearingMetal_DE_K < 335.0 THEN
        bTrip_BearingOverheat_Lat := FALSE;
    END_IF;
    wTripAlarmBitmask := 16#0000;
END_IF;

(* ============================================================================================= *)
(* SECTION 2: 2-OUT-OF-3 (2oo3) TRIPLE MODULAR REDUNDANCY VOTING ENGINE                         *)
(* ============================================================================================= *)
(* --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* SUB-SECTION 2.1: HP Cryo-Expander Inlet Pressure Transmitters 2oo3 Voting                     *)
(* --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
IF bHealth_P_ChA AND bHealth_P_ChB AND bHealth_P_ChC THEN
    (* All 3 channels online: Median Selection Algorithm *)
    IF (rP_Inlet_Bar_ChA >= rP_Inlet_Bar_ChB) THEN
        IF (rP_Inlet_Bar_ChB >= rP_Inlet_Bar_ChC) THEN
            rP_Inlet_Voted_Bar := rP_Inlet_Bar_ChB;
        ELSIF (rP_Inlet_Bar_ChA >= rP_Inlet_Bar_ChC) THEN
            rP_Inlet_Voted_Bar := rP_Inlet_Bar_ChC;
        ELSE
            rP_Inlet_Voted_Bar := rP_Inlet_Bar_ChA;
        END_IF;
    ELSE
        IF (rP_Inlet_Bar_ChA >= rP_Inlet_Bar_ChC) THEN
            rP_Inlet_Voted_Bar := rP_Inlet_Bar_ChA;
        ELSIF (rP_Inlet_Bar_ChB >= rP_Inlet_Bar_ChC) THEN
            rP_Inlet_Voted_Bar := rP_Inlet_Bar_ChC;
        ELSE
            rP_Inlet_Voted_Bar := rP_Inlet_Bar_ChB;
        END_IF;
    END_IF;

    (* Monitor inter-channel deviation thresholds *)
    IF (ABS(rP_Inlet_Bar_ChA - rP_Inlet_Bar_ChB) > rTOL_P_Inlet_Bar) OR
       (ABS(rP_Inlet_Bar_ChB - rP_Inlet_Bar_ChC) > rTOL_P_Inlet_Bar) OR
       (ABS(rP_Inlet_Bar_ChA - rP_Inlet_Bar_ChC) > rTOL_P_Inlet_Bar) THEN
        rTimer_P_Inlet_Discrepancy := rTimer_P_Inlet_Discrepancy + tScanDeltaTime_Sec;
        IF rTimer_P_Inlet_Discrepancy >= rMAX_DISCREPANCY_TIME_Sec THEN
            (* Identify rogue transmitter and isolate *)
            IF ABS(rP_Inlet_Bar_ChA - rP_Inlet_Voted_Bar) > rTOL_P_Inlet_Bar THEN
                bHealth_P_ChA := FALSE;
            ELSIF ABS(rP_Inlet_Bar_ChB - rP_Inlet_Voted_Bar) > rTOL_P_Inlet_Bar THEN
                bHealth_P_ChB := FALSE;
            ELSE
                bHealth_P_ChC := FALSE;
            END_IF;
        END_IF;
    ELSE
        rTimer_P_Inlet_Discrepancy := 0.0;
    END_IF;
ELSIF (bHealth_P_ChA AND bHealth_P_ChB) THEN
    (* Degraded 1oo2 fail-operational mode *)
    rP_Inlet_Voted_Bar := 0.5 * (rP_Inlet_Bar_ChA + rP_Inlet_Bar_ChB);
    bDegradedSensorMode := TRUE;
ELSIF (bHealth_P_ChA AND bHealth_P_ChC) THEN
    rP_Inlet_Voted_Bar := 0.5 * (rP_Inlet_Bar_ChA + rP_Inlet_Bar_ChC);
    bDegradedSensorMode := TRUE;
ELSIF (bHealth_P_ChB AND bHealth_P_ChC) THEN
    rP_Inlet_Voted_Bar := 0.5 * (rP_Inlet_Bar_ChB + rP_Inlet_Bar_ChC);
    bDegradedSensorMode := TRUE;
ELSE
    (* Degraded 1oo1 fallback mode *)
    IF bHealth_P_ChA THEN
        rP_Inlet_Voted_Bar := rP_Inlet_Bar_ChA;
    ELSIF bHealth_P_ChB THEN
        rP_Inlet_Voted_Bar := rP_Inlet_Bar_ChB;
    ELSIF bHealth_P_ChC THEN
        rP_Inlet_Voted_Bar := rP_Inlet_Bar_ChC;
    ELSE
        (* Total instrument loss: trip *)
        rP_Inlet_Voted_Bar := 1.013;
        bEmergencyTripActive := TRUE;
    END_IF;
    bDegradedSensorMode := TRUE;
END_IF;

(* --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* SUB-SECTION 2.2: HP Cryo-Expander Inlet Temperature Sensors 2oo3 Voting                       *)
(* --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
IF bHealth_T_ChA AND bHealth_T_ChB AND bHealth_T_ChC THEN
    IF (rT_Inlet_K_ChA >= rT_Inlet_K_ChB) THEN
        IF (rT_Inlet_K_ChB >= rT_Inlet_K_ChC) THEN
            rT_Inlet_Voted_K := rT_Inlet_K_ChB;
        ELSIF (rT_Inlet_K_ChA >= rT_Inlet_K_ChC) THEN
            rT_Inlet_Voted_K := rT_Inlet_K_ChC;
        ELSE
            rT_Inlet_Voted_K := rT_Inlet_K_ChA;
        END_IF;
    ELSE
        IF (rT_Inlet_K_ChA >= rT_Inlet_K_ChC) THEN
            rT_Inlet_Voted_K := rT_Inlet_K_ChA;
        ELSIF (rT_Inlet_K_ChB >= rT_Inlet_K_ChC) THEN
            rT_Inlet_Voted_K := rT_Inlet_K_ChC;
        ELSE
            rT_Inlet_Voted_K := rT_Inlet_K_ChB;
        END_IF;
    END_IF;

    IF (ABS(rT_Inlet_K_ChA - rT_Inlet_K_ChB) > rTOL_T_Inlet_K) OR
       (ABS(rT_Inlet_K_ChB - rT_Inlet_K_ChC) > rTOL_T_Inlet_K) OR
       (ABS(rT_Inlet_K_ChA - rT_Inlet_K_ChC) > rTOL_T_Inlet_K) THEN
        rTimer_T_Inlet_Discrepancy := rTimer_T_Inlet_Discrepancy + tScanDeltaTime_Sec;
        IF rTimer_T_Inlet_Discrepancy >= rMAX_DISCREPANCY_TIME_Sec THEN
            IF ABS(rT_Inlet_K_ChA - rT_Inlet_Voted_K) > rTOL_T_Inlet_K THEN
                bHealth_T_ChA := FALSE;
            ELSIF ABS(rT_Inlet_K_ChB - rT_Inlet_Voted_K) > rTOL_T_Inlet_K THEN
                bHealth_T_ChB := FALSE;
            ELSE
                bHealth_T_ChC := FALSE;
            END_IF;
        END_IF;
    ELSE
        rTimer_T_Inlet_Discrepancy := 0.0;
    END_IF;
ELSIF (bHealth_T_ChA AND bHealth_T_ChB) THEN
    rT_Inlet_Voted_K := 0.5 * (rT_Inlet_K_ChA + rT_Inlet_K_ChB);
    bDegradedSensorMode := TRUE;
ELSIF (bHealth_T_ChA AND bHealth_T_ChC) THEN
    rT_Inlet_Voted_K := 0.5 * (rT_Inlet_K_ChA + rT_Inlet_K_ChC);
    bDegradedSensorMode := TRUE;
ELSIF (bHealth_T_ChB AND bHealth_T_ChC) THEN
    rT_Inlet_Voted_K := 0.5 * (rT_Inlet_K_ChB + rT_Inlet_K_ChC);
    bDegradedSensorMode := TRUE;
ELSE
    IF bHealth_T_ChA THEN
        rT_Inlet_Voted_K := rT_Inlet_K_ChA;
    ELSIF bHealth_T_ChB THEN
        rT_Inlet_Voted_K := rT_Inlet_K_ChB;
    ELSIF bHealth_T_ChC THEN
        rT_Inlet_Voted_K := rT_Inlet_K_ChC;
    ELSE
        rT_Inlet_Voted_K := 293.15;
        bEmergencyTripActive := TRUE;
    END_IF;
    bDegradedSensorMode := TRUE;
END_IF;

(* --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* SUB-SECTION 2.3: Expander Rotor Speed Proximity Pickups 2oo3 Voting                          *)
(* --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
IF bHealth_N_ChA AND bHealth_N_ChB AND bHealth_N_ChC THEN
    IF (rN_ExpanderSpeed_Rpm_ChA >= rN_ExpanderSpeed_Rpm_ChB) THEN
        IF (rN_ExpanderSpeed_Rpm_ChB >= rN_ExpanderSpeed_Rpm_ChC) THEN
            rN_ExpanderSpeed_Voted_Rpm := rN_ExpanderSpeed_Rpm_ChB;
        ELSIF (rN_ExpanderSpeed_Rpm_ChA >= rN_ExpanderSpeed_Rpm_ChC) THEN
            rN_ExpanderSpeed_Voted_Rpm := rN_ExpanderSpeed_Rpm_ChC;
        ELSE
            rN_ExpanderSpeed_Voted_Rpm := rN_ExpanderSpeed_Rpm_ChA;
        END_IF;
    ELSE
        IF (rN_ExpanderSpeed_Rpm_ChA >= rN_ExpanderSpeed_Rpm_ChC) THEN
            rN_ExpanderSpeed_Voted_Rpm := rN_ExpanderSpeed_Rpm_ChA;
        ELSIF (rN_ExpanderSpeed_Rpm_ChB >= rN_ExpanderSpeed_Rpm_ChC) THEN
            rN_ExpanderSpeed_Voted_Rpm := rN_ExpanderSpeed_Rpm_ChC;
        ELSE
            rN_ExpanderSpeed_Voted_Rpm := rN_ExpanderSpeed_Rpm_ChB;
        END_IF;
    END_IF;

    IF (ABS(rN_ExpanderSpeed_Rpm_ChA - rN_ExpanderSpeed_Rpm_ChB) > rTOL_N_Speed_Rpm) OR
       (ABS(rN_ExpanderSpeed_Rpm_ChB - rN_ExpanderSpeed_Rpm_ChC) > rTOL_N_Speed_Rpm) OR
       (ABS(rN_ExpanderSpeed_Rpm_ChA - rN_ExpanderSpeed_Rpm_ChC) > rTOL_N_Speed_Rpm) THEN
        rTimer_Speed_Discrepancy := rTimer_Speed_Discrepancy + tScanDeltaTime_Sec;
        IF rTimer_Speed_Discrepancy >= rMAX_DISCREPANCY_TIME_Sec THEN
            IF ABS(rN_ExpanderSpeed_Rpm_ChA - rN_ExpanderSpeed_Voted_Rpm) > rTOL_N_Speed_Rpm THEN
                bHealth_N_ChA := FALSE;
            ELSIF ABS(rN_ExpanderSpeed_Rpm_ChB - rN_ExpanderSpeed_Voted_Rpm) > rTOL_N_Speed_Rpm THEN
                bHealth_N_ChB := FALSE;
            ELSE
                bHealth_N_ChC := FALSE;
            END_IF;
        END_IF;
    ELSE
        rTimer_Speed_Discrepancy := 0.0;
    END_IF;
ELSIF (bHealth_N_ChA AND bHealth_N_ChB) THEN
    rN_ExpanderSpeed_Voted_Rpm := 0.5 * (rN_ExpanderSpeed_Rpm_ChA + rN_ExpanderSpeed_Rpm_ChB);
    bDegradedSensorMode := TRUE;
ELSIF (bHealth_N_ChA AND bHealth_N_ChC) THEN
    rN_ExpanderSpeed_Voted_Rpm := 0.5 * (rN_ExpanderSpeed_Rpm_ChA + rN_ExpanderSpeed_Rpm_ChC);
    bDegradedSensorMode := TRUE;
ELSIF (bHealth_N_ChB AND bHealth_N_ChC) THEN
    rN_ExpanderSpeed_Voted_Rpm := 0.5 * (rN_ExpanderSpeed_Rpm_ChB + rN_ExpanderSpeed_Rpm_ChC);
    bDegradedSensorMode := TRUE;
ELSE
    rN_ExpanderSpeed_Voted_Rpm := 0.0;
    bEmergencyTripActive := TRUE;
    bDegradedSensorMode := TRUE;
END_IF;

(* First-Order Digital Smoothing Filters *)
rP_Inlet_Filt_Bar := (rFilterWeight * rP_Inlet_Voted_Bar) + ((1.0 - rFilterWeight) * rP_Inlet_Filt_Bar);
rT_Inlet_Filt_K   := (rFilterWeight * rT_Inlet_Voted_K)   + ((1.0 - rFilterWeight) * rT_Inlet_Filt_K);
rN_Speed_Filt_Rpm := (rFilterWeight * rN_ExpanderSpeed_Voted_Rpm) + ((1.0 - rFilterWeight) * rN_Speed_Filt_Rpm);
rM_CryoAir_Filt_KgSec := (rFilterWeight * rM_CryoAirFlow_KgSec) + ((1.0 - rFilterWeight) * rM_CryoAir_Filt_KgSec);

(* ============================================================================================= *)
(* SECTION 3: MULTI-COMPONENT SLUSH SOLIDIFICATION BOUNDARY & RISK INDEX ESTIMATION             *)
(* ============================================================================================= *)
(* Compute high-pressure solid-liquid coexistence boundary:                                     *)
(* T_freeze(P) = T_triple + dT/dP * (P - P_triple)                                              *)
rEvalFreezingT_K := rSolidificationBaseTemp_K + (rSlapinskiSlope_dPdT * (rP_Inlet_Filt_Bar - rP_TripleRef_Bar));

(* CO2 Henry's Law Solubility & Precipitation Offset *)
IF rCO2_Concentration_Ppm > rCO2_SolubilityLimit_Ppm THEN
    rEvalFreezingT_K := rEvalFreezingT_K + (0.028 * SQRT(rCO2_Concentration_Ppm - rCO2_SolubilityLimit_Ppm));
END_IF;

(* Atmospheric moisture ice crystal offset *)
IF rH2O_DewPoint_K > rH2O_FrostPointLimit_K THEN
    rEvalFreezingT_K := rEvalFreezingT_K + (0.018 * (rH2O_DewPoint_K - rH2O_FrostPointLimit_K));
END_IF;

(* Calculate instantaneous margin to phase transition [K] *)
rMarginToSolidification_K := rT_Inlet_Filt_K - rEvalFreezingT_K;

(* Continuous Slush Formation Probability Index (0.0 = Safe, 1.0 = Active Ice Formation) *)
IF rMarginToSolidification_K <= 0.0 THEN
    rSlushSolidificationRisk := 1.0; (* Deep freeze: solid crystals in nozzle throat *)
ELSIF rMarginToSolidification_K < 2.5 THEN
    rSlushSolidificationRisk := 0.80 + (0.20 * (2.5 - rMarginToSolidification_K) / 2.5);
ELSIF rMarginToSolidification_K < 6.0 THEN
    rSlushSolidificationRisk := 0.30 + (0.50 * (6.0 - rMarginToSolidification_K) / 3.5);
ELSIF rMarginToSolidification_K < 12.0 THEN
    rSlushSolidificationRisk := 0.02 + (0.28 * (12.0 - rMarginToSolidification_K) / 6.0);
ELSE
    rSlushSolidificationRisk := 0.0;
END_IF;

(* Slush Prevention Autonomous Trigger Flag *)
IF (rSlushSolidificationRisk >= 0.35) OR (rMarginToSolidification_K <= 4.5) THEN
    bAntiSlushMitigationActive := TRUE;
ELSE
    bAntiSlushMitigationActive := FALSE;
END_IF;

(* ============================================================================================= *)
(* SECTION 4: THERMODYNAMIC ISENTROPIC EFFICIENCY & EXERGY POWER HARVESTING                     *)
(* ============================================================================================= *)
(* Isentropic temperature drop across Stage 1:                                                   *)
(* Delta_T_ideal = T_in * [1 - (P_inter / P_in)^((gamma - 1) / gamma)]                           *)
IF (rP_Inlet_Filt_Bar > 2.5) AND (rP_Interstage_Bar > 0.8) AND (rT_Inlet_Filt_K > 65.0) THEN
    rIdealTempDrop_K := rT_Inlet_Filt_K * (1.0 - EXPT((rP_Interstage_Bar / rP_Inlet_Filt_Bar), ((rSpecificHeatRatio_Gamma - 1.0) / rSpecificHeatRatio_Gamma)));
    rActualTempDrop_K := rT_Inlet_Filt_K - rT_Interstage_K;
    IF rIdealTempDrop_K > 0.15 THEN
        rIsentropicEfficiency_Pct := (rActualTempDrop_K / rIdealTempDrop_K) * 100.0;
        IF rIsentropicEfficiency_Pct > 96.5 THEN
            rIsentropicEfficiency_Pct := 96.5;
        ELSIF rIsentropicEfficiency_Pct < 0.0 THEN
            rIsentropicEfficiency_Pct := 0.0;
        END_IF;
    ELSE
        rIsentropicEfficiency_Pct := 0.0;
    END_IF;
ELSE
    rIsentropicEfficiency_Pct := 0.0;
END_IF;

(* Shaft Mechanical to Electrical Power Conversion: P_elec = eta_gen * tau * omega *)
rElectricalPower_Actual_kW := (rGeneratorTorque_Cmd_Nm * (rN_Speed_Filt_Rpm * 0.104719755)) / 1000.0;

(* Cold Thermal Exergy Capture Rate into HGCS:                                                  *)
(* Ex_cold = m_htf * Cp_htf * [ (T_out - T_in) - T0 * ln(T_out / T_in) ]                        *)
IF (rT_ColdStoreHTF_In_K > 55.0) AND (rT_ColdStoreHTF_Out_K > 55.0) AND (rM_ColdStoreHTF_KgSec > 0.05) THEN
    rAccumulator := (rT_ColdStoreHTF_Out_K - rT_ColdStoreHTF_In_K) - (rT_DeadState_K * LN(rT_ColdStoreHTF_Out_K / rT_ColdStoreHTF_In_K));
    rColdExergyCaptured_kW := rM_ColdStoreHTF_KgSec * 2.18 * ABS(rAccumulator);
ELSE
    rColdExergyCaptured_kW := 0.0;
END_IF;

(* ============================================================================================= *)
(* SECTION 5: DISCRETE KALMAN FILTER / STATE OBSERVER UPDATE                                    *)
(* ============================================================================================= *)
(* Format physical plant measurement deviation vector y_meas[4] *)
(* y[1] = delta T_inlet [K] (base 92.0 K) *)
(* y[2] = delta Omega [rad/s] (base 1884.95 rad/s) *)
(* y[3] = delta T_HTF [K] (base 85.0 K) *)
(* y[4] = Slush Precursor Nucleation [ppm] *)
rInnovation[1] := (rT_Inlet_Filt_K - 92.0) - xState_Pred[1];
rInnovation[2] := ((rN_Speed_Filt_Rpm * 0.104719755) - 1884.9556) - xState_Pred[2];
rInnovation[3] := (rT_ColdStoreHTF_Out_K - 85.0) - xState_Pred[3];
rInnovation[4] := (rSlushSolidificationRisk * 100.0) - xState_Pred[4];

(* State Estimation Correction Step: x_est = x_pred + L * innovation *)
FOR iRow := 1 TO 6 DO
    rAccumulator := xState_Pred[iRow];
    FOR iCol := 1 TO 4 DO
        rAccumulator := rAccumulator + (mL_Gain[iRow, iCol] * rInnovation[iCol]);
    END_FOR;
    xState_Est[iRow] := rAccumulator;
    xState[iRow] := xState_Est[iRow]; (* Bind current active state *)
END_FOR;

(* Compute Disturbance Vector d *)
dDisturbance[1] := rM_CryoAir_Filt_KgSec - 15.0;
dDisturbance[2] := rCO2_Concentration_Ppm - 1.0;

(* Time Update / State Prediction for k+1: x_pred = A_d * x_est + B_d * u + E_d * d *)
FOR iRow := 1 TO 6 DO
    rAccumulator := 0.0;
    FOR iCol := 1 TO 6 DO
        rAccumulator := rAccumulator + (mA_d[iRow, iCol] * xState_Est[iCol]);
    END_FOR;
    FOR iCol := 1 TO 4 DO
        rAccumulator := rAccumulator + (mB_d[iRow, iCol] * uControl[iCol]);
    END_FOR;
    FOR iCol := 1 TO 2 DO
        rAccumulator := rAccumulator + (mE_d[iRow, iCol] * dDisturbance[iCol]);
    END_FOR;
    xState_Pred[iRow] := rAccumulator;
END_FOR;

(* ============================================================================================= *)
(* SECTION 6: MODEL PREDICTIVE CONTROL (MPC) PROJECTED GRADIENT DESCENT QP SOLVER               *)
(* ============================================================================================= *)
IF (iStateStep = 50) OR (iStateStep = 60) THEN
    (* Evaluate Slush Solidification Barrier Slack Constraint *)
    IF rMarginToSolidification_K < 5.0 THEN
        rSlushMarginSlack := 5.0 - rMarginToSolidification_K;
    ELSE
        rSlushMarginSlack := 0.0;
    END_IF;

    (* Iterative Optimization Loop *)
    FOR iQPIteration := 1 TO iMaxQPIterations DO
        (* Compute cost function gradient components: grad_J = B^T * Q * (C * x_pred) + R * u *)
        (* Gradient w.r.t Actuator 1: VIGV Position Command *)
        rGradJ[1] := (mB_d[1, 1] * vQ_Diag[1] * xState_Pred[1]) +
                     (mB_d[2, 1] * vQ_Diag[2] * xState_Pred[2]) +
                     (mB_d[3, 1] * vQ_Diag[3] * xState_Pred[3]) +
                     (mB_d[4, 1] * vQ_Diag[4] * (xState_Pred[4] + (rRhoSlushPenalty * rSlushMarginSlack))) +
                     (vR_Diag[1] * uControl[1]);

        (* Gradient w.r.t Actuator 2: Anti-Solidification Thermal Bypass Valve *)
        rGradJ[2] := (mB_d[1, 2] * vQ_Diag[1] * xState_Pred[1]) +
                     (mB_d[2, 2] * vQ_Diag[2] * xState_Pred[2]) +
                     (mB_d[3, 2] * vQ_Diag[3] * xState_Pred[3]) +
                     (mB_d[4, 2] * vQ_Diag[4] * (xState_Pred[4] - (2.5 * rRhoSlushPenalty * rSlushMarginSlack))) +
                     (vR_Diag[2] * uControl[2]);

        (* Gradient w.r.t Actuator 3: Inter-stage Thermal Reheat Heater *)
        rGradJ[3] := (mB_d[1, 3] * vQ_Diag[1] * xState_Pred[1]) +
                     (mB_d[3, 3] * vQ_Diag[3] * xState_Pred[3]) +
                     (mB_d[5, 3] * 6.0 * xState_Pred[5]) +
                     (vR_Diag[3] * uControl[3]);

        (* Gradient w.r.t Actuator 4: Generator Electromagnetic Load Counter-Torque *)
        rGradJ[4] := (mB_d[2, 4] * vQ_Diag[2] * xState_Pred[2]) +
                     (vR_Diag[4] * uControl[4]);

        (* Execute Projected Gradient Descent Step *)
        FOR iIdx := 1 TO 4 DO
            uControl[iIdx] := uControl[iIdx] - (rAlphaStep * rGradJ[iIdx]);
        END_FOR;

        (* Hard Box Constraints Projection *)
        IF uControl[1] < -40.0 THEN uControl[1] := -40.0; ELSIF uControl[1] > 55.0 THEN uControl[1] := 55.0; END_IF;
        IF uControl[2] <   0.0 THEN uControl[2] :=   0.0; ELSIF uControl[2] > 95.0 THEN uControl[2] := 95.0; END_IF;
        IF uControl[3] < -60.0 THEN uControl[3] := -60.0; ELSIF uControl[3] > 380.0 THEN uControl[3] := 380.0; END_IF;
        IF uControl[4] < -300.0 THEN uControl[4] := -300.0; ELSIF uControl[4] > 1600.0 THEN uControl[4] := 1600.0; END_IF;
    END_FOR;
END_IF;

(* ============================================================================================= *)
(* SECTION 7: ISA-18.2 ALARM MATRIX & HARDWIRED TRIP SUPERVISION                                 *)
(* ============================================================================================= *)
(* Trip 1: Rotor Overspeed Trip (122% of 18,000 rpm rated = 22,000 rpm) *)
IF rN_ExpanderSpeed_Voted_Rpm > 22000.0 THEN
    bTrip_OverSpeed_Latched := TRUE;
END_IF;

(* Trip 2: Slush Solidification Impingement (Margin <= 0.4 K) *)
IF rMarginToSolidification_K <= 0.4 THEN
    bTrip_SlushSevere_Latched := TRUE;
END_IF;

(* Trip 3: Magnetic/Foil Bearing Overheat (> 350 K) *)
IF rT_BearingMetal_DE_K > 350.0 THEN
    bTrip_BearingOverheat_Lat := TRUE;
END_IF;

(* Trip 4: Severe Rotor Shaft Radial Dynamic Vibration (> 32 um pk-pk) *)
IF (rVibration_DE_X_Um > 32.0) OR (rVibration_DE_Y_Um > 32.0) THEN
    bTrip_VibrationHigh_Latched := TRUE;
END_IF;

(* Trip 5: Loss of Cold-Box Vacuum Insulation (> 0.12 mbar) *)
IF rP_ColdBoxVacuum_Mbar > 0.12 THEN
    bTrip_VacuumLoss_Latched := TRUE;
END_IF;

(* Trip 6: Loss of Dry Gas Seal N2 Barrier DP (< 0.70 bar) *)
IF (rP_DryGasSeal_Diff_Bar < 0.70) AND (iStateStep >= 40) THEN
    bTrip_SealGasLoss_Latched := TRUE;
END_IF;

(* Assemble Critical Latching Trip Bitmask *)
wTripAlarmBitmask.0 := bTrip_Hardwire_Latched;
wTripAlarmBitmask.1 := bTrip_OverSpeed_Latched;
wTripAlarmBitmask.2 := bTrip_SlushSevere_Latched;
wTripAlarmBitmask.3 := bTrip_BearingOverheat_Lat;
wTripAlarmBitmask.4 := bTrip_VibrationHigh_Latched;
wTripAlarmBitmask.5 := bTrip_VacuumLoss_Latched;
wTripAlarmBitmask.6 := bTrip_SealGasLoss_Latched;
wTripAlarmBitmask.7 := NOT (bHealth_P_ChA OR bHealth_P_ChB OR bHealth_P_ChC);
wTripAlarmBitmask.8 := NOT (bHealth_T_ChA OR bHealth_T_ChB OR bHealth_T_ChC);
wTripAlarmBitmask.9 := NOT (bHealth_N_ChA OR bHealth_N_ChB OR bHealth_N_ChC);

(* Assemble Warning Advisory Bitmask *)
wWarningAlarmBitmask.0 := bAntiSlushMitigationActive;
wWarningAlarmBitmask.1 := bDegradedSensorMode;
wWarningAlarmBitmask.2 := (rVibration_DE_X_Um > 20.0) OR (rVibration_DE_Y_Um > 20.0);
wWarningAlarmBitmask.3 := rP_ColdBoxVacuum_Mbar > 0.04;
wWarningAlarmBitmask.4 := rP_DryGasSeal_Diff_Bar < 1.10;
wWarningAlarmBitmask.5 := rCO2_Concentration_Ppm > 3.80;
wWarningAlarmBitmask.6 := rH2O_DewPoint_K > 182.0;
wWarningAlarmBitmask.7 := rIsentropicEfficiency_Pct < 62.0;

(* Assemble 2oo3 Sensor Validation Bitmask *)
wSensorHealthBitmask.0 := bHealth_P_ChA;
wSensorHealthBitmask.1 := bHealth_P_ChB;
wSensorHealthBitmask.2 := bHealth_P_ChC;
wSensorHealthBitmask.3 := bHealth_T_ChA;
wSensorHealthBitmask.4 := bHealth_T_ChB;
wSensorHealthBitmask.5 := bHealth_T_ChC;
wSensorHealthBitmask.6 := bHealth_N_ChA;
wSensorHealthBitmask.7 := bHealth_N_ChB;
wSensorHealthBitmask.8 := bHealth_N_ChC;

(* Trip Activation Enforcer *)
IF (wTripAlarmBitmask <> 16#0000) THEN
    bEmergencyTripActive := TRUE;
    IF (iStateStep <> 90) AND (iStateStep <> 99) THEN
        iStateStep := 90;
    END_IF;
END_IF;

(* ============================================================================================= *)
(* SECTION 8: DETERMINISTIC 10-STAGE FINITE STATE MACHINE (FSM) SEQUENCE ENGINE                 *)
(* ============================================================================================= *)
rStateTimer_Sec := rStateTimer_Sec + tScanDeltaTime_Sec;
rCooldownRampRate_K_PerMin := ((rT_Inlet_Filt_K - rPreviousT_Inlet_K) / tScanDeltaTime_Sec) * 60.0;
rPreviousT_Inlet_K := rT_Inlet_Filt_K;

CASE iStateStep OF
    0: (* STATE_OFFLINE_STANDBY *)
        bSystemReady := FALSE;
        bExpanderRunning := FALSE;
        rVIGV_Position_Cmd_Pct := 0.0;
        rBypassValve_Cmd_Pct := 0.0;
        rInterstageHeater_Cmd_kW := 0.0;
        rGeneratorTorque_Cmd_Nm := 0.0;
        rBleedValve_Cmd_Pct := 0.0;

        IF bEnable AND (NOT bEmergencyTripActive) AND (wTripAlarmBitmask = 16#0000) THEN
            IF iTargetOperatingMode = 1 THEN
                iStateStep := 10; (* Start Warm Purge *)
                rStateTimer_Sec := 0.0;
            ELSIF (iTargetOperatingMode = 2) AND (rH2O_DewPoint_K < 185.0) THEN
                iStateStep := 20; (* Proceed to Prechill *)
                rStateTimer_Sec := 0.0;
            END_IF;
        END_IF;

    10: (* STATE_DRY_GAS_PURGE_AND_INERTING *)
        bSystemReady := FALSE;
        bExpanderRunning := FALSE;
        rVIGV_Position_Cmd_Pct := 12.0;
        rBypassValve_Cmd_Pct := 25.0;
        rBleedValve_Cmd_Pct := 45.0;
        rInterstageHeater_Cmd_kW := 35.0;
        rGeneratorTorque_Cmd_Nm := 0.0;

        (* Check for moisture dew point < 180 K (-93 deg C) and CO2 < 1.5 ppm *)
        IF (rH2O_DewPoint_K < 180.0) AND (rCO2_Concentration_Ppm < 1.5) AND (rStateTimer_Sec > 35.0) THEN
            IF iTargetOperatingMode >= 2 THEN
                iStateStep := 20;
