    rVotedBldgAccX_ms2          : REAL;     (* 2oo3 TMR resolved skyscraper horizontal acceleration X [m/s2] *)
    rVotedBldgAccY_ms2          : REAL;     (* 2oo3 TMR resolved skyscraper horizontal acceleration Y [m/s2] *)
    rEstimatedBldgDispX_mm      : REAL;     (* Observer reconstructed structural sway roof displacement X [mm] *)
    rEstimatedBldgDispY_mm      : REAL;     (* Observer reconstructed structural sway roof displacement Y [mm] *)
    rEstimatedBldgVelX_mms      : REAL;     (* Observer reconstructed structural sway roof velocity X [mm/s] *)
    rEstimatedBldgVelY_mms      : REAL;     (* Observer reconstructed structural sway roof velocity Y [mm/s] *)
    rDampingRatioAchieved_Pct   : REAL;     (* Estimated effective total equivalent structural damping ratio [%] *)

    (* --- Diagnostics, Status Words & ISA-18.2 Alarm Registers --- *)
    wAlarmWord1                 : WORD;     (* ISA-18.2 packed Priority 1 & 2 alarms (E-Stop, Pressure Collapse, Limit) *)
    wAlarmWord2                 : WORD;     (* ISA-18.2 packed Priority 3 alarms & TMR sensor discrepancy flags *)
    wSystemStatusWord           : WORD;     (* State machine status, active modes, and interlock diagnostics *)
END_VAR

VAR
    (* --- Execution Timing & Sampling Interval --- *)
    rDt_s                       : REAL := 0.005; (* Hard real-time cycle period dt = 5 ms (200 Hz) *)

    (* --- State Machine Registers --- *)
    iState                      : INT := 0; (* Active operational state index *)
    iPrevState                  : INT := 0; (* Preceding operational state index *)
    tStateTimer                 : TON;      (* State residence duration timer *)
    tBrakeReleaseDwell          : TON;      (* Hydraulic caliper brake pressurization delay timer *)
    tHpuWarmupTimer             : TON;      (* Hydraulic power unit warmup and accumulator charge timer *)
    tCalibDwellTimer            : TON;      (* Zero-point sensor calibration stability timer *)

    (* --- Triple Modular Redundancy (2oo3) Voting Engine Registers: X-Axis --- *)
    bAccX1_Valid                : BOOL := TRUE;
    bAccX2_Valid                : BOOL := TRUE;
    bAccX3_Valid                : BOOL := TRUE;
    iHealthySensorsX            : INT  := 3;
    rDeltaX_12                  : REAL := 0.0;
    rDeltaX_23                  : REAL := 0.0;
    rDeltaX_31                  : REAL := 0.0;
    tDiscrepTimerX1             : TON;
    tDiscrepTimerX2             : TON;
    tDiscrepTimerX3             : TON;

    (* --- Triple Modular Redundancy (2oo3) Voting Engine Registers: Y-Axis --- *)
    bAccY1_Valid                : BOOL := TRUE;
    bAccY2_Valid                : BOOL := TRUE;
    bAccY3_Valid                : BOOL := TRUE;
    iHealthySensorsY            : INT  := 3;
    rDeltaY_12                  : REAL := 0.0;
    rDeltaY_23                  : REAL := 0.0;
    rDeltaY_31                  : REAL := 0.0;
    tDiscrepTimerY1             : TON;
    tDiscrepTimerY2             : TON;
    tDiscrepTimerY3             : TON;

    rTmrTolerance_ms2           : REAL := 0.035; (* Maximum allowable inter-sensor acceleration divergence [m/s2] *)
    tTmrPersistDuration         : TIME := T#150MS; (* Persistence window before flagging sensor channel fault *)

    (* --- Accelerometer Zero-Bias Offset & Washout High-Pass Filter Registers --- *)
    rAccBiasX                   : REAL := 0.0;
    rAccBiasY                   : REAL := 0.0;
    rWashoutStateX              : REAL := 0.0;
    rWashoutStateY              : REAL := 0.0;
    rWashoutTau_s               : REAL := 15.0; (* Washout filter time constant [s] to block DC tilt/gravity drift *)
    rFilteredAccX               : REAL := 0.0;
    rFilteredAccY               : REAL := 0.0;

    (* --- Structural Dynamics Parameters & Discretized State-Space Matrices --- *)
    rBuildingModalMass_kg       : REAL := 65000000.0; (* Tower fundamental generalized mass [kg] *)
    rDamperMass_kg              : REAL := 800000.0;   (* Pendulum inertial mass [kg] *)
    rPendulumLength_m           : REAL := 12.5;       (* Physical suspension cable pendulum length [m] *)
    rGravitationalAcc_ms2       : REAL := 9.80665;    (* Standard gravitational acceleration [m/s2] *)
    rDamperOmega0               : REAL := 0.0;        (* Pendulum natural circular frequency [rad/s] *)
    rBuildingOmega0             : REAL := 0.0;        (* Tower natural circular frequency [rad/s] *)

    (* Discrete-Time State Vector Estimates: X-Axis (x1=bldg_disp, x2=bldg_vel, x3=stroke, x4=stroke_vel) *)
    rX_hat_x1_BldgDisp_m        : REAL := 0.0;
    rX_hat_x2_BldgVel_ms        : REAL := 0.0;
    rX_hat_x3_Stroke_m          : REAL := 0.0;
    rX_hat_x4_StrokeVel_ms      : REAL := 0.0;

    (* Discrete-Time State Vector Estimates: Y-Axis (y1=bldg_disp, y2=bldg_vel, y3=stroke, y4=stroke_vel) *)
    rY_hat_y1_BldgDisp_m        : REAL := 0.0;
    rY_hat_y2_BldgVel_ms        : REAL := 0.0;
    rY_hat_y3_Stroke_m          : REAL := 0.0;
    rY_hat_y4_StrokeVel_ms      : REAL := 0.0;

    (* Observer Gain Matrix Coefficients (L_obs mapping acceleration and stroke innovation) *)
    rL_obs11                    : REAL := 0.0820; (* Innovation gain from stroke residual to building displacement *)
    rL_obs21                    : REAL := 0.3450; (* Innovation gain from stroke residual to building velocity *)
    rL_obs31                    : REAL := 0.8500; (* Innovation gain from stroke residual to stroke displacement *)
    rL_obs41                    : REAL := 1.2500; (* Innovation gain from stroke residual to stroke velocity *)
    rL_obs22                    : REAL := 0.9200; (* Innovation gain from acceleration residual to building velocity *)

    (* Optimal LQR State-Feedback Gain Vector Coefficients *)
    rK_lqr_BldgDisp             : REAL := 12500.0; (* [kN/m] Active stiffness coupling on building displacement *)
    rK_lqr_BldgVel              : REAL := 85000.0; (* [kN/(m/s)] Skyhook damping gain on building absolute velocity *)
    rK_lqr_Stroke               : REAL := 180.0;   (* [kN/m] State feedback stroke coupling *)
    rK_lqr_StrokeVel            : REAL := 620.0;   (* [kN/(m/s)] State feedback stroke relative velocity damping *)

    (* Model Predictive Stroke Centering & Virtual Barrier Potential Field Coefficients *)
    rK_center_Linear            : REAL := 250.0;   (* Nominal linear centering stiffness [kN/m] *)
    rK_center_Cubic             : REAL := 450.0;   (* Progressive cubic centering stiffness [kN/m3] *)
    rK_barrier_Stiff            : REAL := 1800.0;  (* Virtual boundary cushion penalty stiffness [kN/m2] *)
    rC_barrier_Damp             : REAL := 1200.0;  (* Virtual boundary cushion approach damping [kN/(m/s)] *)
    rStrokeSoftLimit_m          : REAL := 1.100;   (* Boundary threshold for soft deceleration cushion [m] *)
    rStrokeHardLimit_m          : REAL := 1.350;   (* Absolute safety stop limit switch boundary [m] *)

    (* Electro-Hydraulic Actuator Physical Geometry & Servo Valve Constants *)
    rCylBoreDiameter_m          : REAL := 0.200;   (* Servo cylinder internal bore diameter [m] *)
    rCylRodDiameter_m           : REAL := 0.140;   (* Double-rod equal-area cylinder rod diameter [m] *)
    rPistonEffectiveArea_m2     : REAL := 0.0;     (* Computed net effective annular piston working area [m2] *)
    rValveRatedPressureDrop_bar : REAL := 70.0;    (* Moog D661 valve catalog rated pressure drop DeltaP_N [bar] *)
    rValveRatedCurrent_mA       : REAL := 40.0;    (* Moog D661 valve rated input command current [mA] *)
    rValveMaxForce_kN           : REAL := 400.0;   (* Maximum structural load rating of actuator cylinder [kN] *)

    (* Closed-Loop Force Servo PI Controller Registers: X-Axis *)
    rForceErrX_kN               : REAL := 0.0;
    rForceIntX_kN               : REAL := 0.0;
    rForceKp                    : REAL := 0.085;   (* Servo valve proportional gain [mA/kN] *)
    rForceKi                    : REAL := 0.420;   (* Servo valve integral gain [mA/(kN*s)] *)
    rMaxIntegralWindup_mA       : REAL := 15.0;    (* Anti-reset windup clamp limit [mA] *)

    (* Closed-Loop Force Servo PI Controller Registers: Y-Axis *)
    rForceErrY_kN               : REAL := 0.0;
    rForceIntY_kN               : REAL := 0.0;

    (* Dither Signal Generation (100 Hz Triangular Wave for Anti-Stiction) *)
    iDitherCycleCounter         : INT := 0;
    rDitherAmplitude_mA         : REAL := 1.20;    (* Micro-dither amplitude [mA] (3% of rated current) *)
    rDitherSignal_mA            : REAL := 0.0;

    (* Auxiliary Variables & Intermediate Scratchpad Calculation Registers *)
    rStrokeX_m                  : REAL := 0.0;
    rStrokeY_m                  : REAL := 0.0;
    rDeltaPressX_bar            : REAL := 0.0;
    rDeltaPressY_bar            : REAL := 0.0;
    rNetHydForceRawX_kN         : REAL := 0.0;
    rNetHydForceRawY_kN         : REAL := 0.0;
    rAvailDeltaPressX_bar       : REAL := 0.0;
    rAvailDeltaPressY_bar       : REAL := 0.0;
    rValveFlowScalingX          : REAL := 1.0;
    rValveFlowScalingY          : REAL := 1.0;
    rLqrForceX_kN               : REAL := 0.0;
    rLqrForceY_kN               : REAL := 0.0;
    rCenterForceX_kN            : REAL := 0.0;
    rCenterForceY_kN            : REAL := 0.0;
    rBarrierForceX_kN           : REAL := 0.0;
    rBarrierForceY_kN           : REAL := 0.0;
    rTotalDemandedForceX_kN     : REAL := 0.0;
    rTotalDemandedForceY_kN     : REAL := 0.0;
    rRawServoCmdX_mA            : REAL := 0.0;
    rRawServoCmdY_mA            : REAL := 0.0;

    (* Diagnostic Watchdogs & Peak Tracking Registers *)
    rPeakBldgAccObserved_ms2    : REAL := 0.0;
    rPeakStrokeObserved_mm      : REAL := 0.0;
    tSeismicOverdriveTimer      : TON;
    bSeismicOverdriveActive     : BOOL := FALSE;
END_VAR

(*
========================================================================================================================
    EXECUTION LOGIC BODY
========================================================================================================================
*)

(* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
   SECTION 1: GEOMETRIC INITIALIZATION & CONSTANT DERIVATION
   --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* Compute effective annular piston area for double-rod cylinder: A = pi/4 * (D_bore^2 - D_rod^2) *)
IF rPistonEffectiveArea_m2 <= 0.0001 THEN
    rPistonEffectiveArea_m2 := 3.1415926535 * (rCylBoreDiameter_m * rCylBoreDiameter_m - rCylRodDiameter_m * rCylRodDiameter_m) / 4.0;
END_IF;

(* Compute structural and pendulum natural circular frequencies [rad/s] *)
IF rBldgFundFreq_Hz > 0.05 THEN
    rBuildingOmega0 := 2.0 * 3.1415926535 * rBldgFundFreq_Hz;
ELSE
    rBuildingOmega0 := 2.0 * 3.1415926535 * 0.215; (* Default 0.215 Hz (~4.65 s fundamental period) *)
END_IF;

IF rPendulumLength_m > 1.0 THEN
    rDamperOmega0 := SQRT(rGravitationalAcc_ms2 / rPendulumLength_m);
ELSE
    rDamperOmega0 := SQRT(9.80665 / 12.5);
END_IF;

(* Normalize relative stroke measurements from [mm] to engineering [m] *)
rStrokeX_m := rMassStrokeX_mm / 1000.0;
rStrokeY_m := rMassStrokeY_mm / 1000.0;

(* Calculate instantaneous hydraulic differential forces across servo cylinders [kN] *)
(* F = Delta_P [bar] * 100 [kPa/bar] * A [m2] *)
rDeltaPressX_bar := rCylPressA_X_bar - rCylPressB_X_bar;
rDeltaPressY_bar := rCylPressA_Y_bar - rCylPressB_Y_bar;
rNetHydForceRawX_kN := rDeltaPressX_bar * 100.0 * rPistonEffectiveArea_m2;
rNetHydForceRawY_kN := rDeltaPressY_bar * 100.0 * rPistonEffectiveArea_m2;
rMeasuredHydForceX_kN := rNetHydForceRawX_kN;
rMeasuredHydForceY_kN := rNetHydForceRawY_kN;

(* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
   SECTION 2: 2oo3 TRIPLE MODULAR REDUNDANCY (TMR) SENSOR VOTING ENGINE
   --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* --- X-AXIS ACCELEROMETER 2oo3 VOTING --- *)
rDeltaX_12 := ABS(rBldgAccX_Ch1 - rBldgAccX_Ch2);
rDeltaX_23 := ABS(rBldgAccX_Ch2 - rBldgAccX_Ch3);
rDeltaX_31 := ABS(rBldgAccX_Ch3 - rBldgAccX_Ch1);

(* Discrepancy timers for X channels *)
tDiscrepTimerX1(IN := (rDeltaX_12 > rTmrTolerance_ms2) AND (rDeltaX_31 > rTmrTolerance_ms2), PT := tTmrPersistDuration);
tDiscrepTimerX2(IN := (rDeltaX_12 > rTmrTolerance_ms2) AND (rDeltaX_23 > rTmrTolerance_ms2), PT := tTmrPersistDuration);
tDiscrepTimerX3(IN := (rDeltaX_23 > rTmrTolerance_ms2) AND (rDeltaX_31 > rTmrTolerance_ms2), PT := tTmrPersistDuration);

IF tDiscrepTimerX1.Q THEN bAccX1_Valid := FALSE; END_IF;
IF tDiscrepTimerX2.Q THEN bAccX2_Valid := FALSE; END_IF;
IF tDiscrepTimerX3.Q THEN bAccX3_Valid := FALSE; END_IF;

IF bResetFaults THEN
    bAccX1_Valid := TRUE;
    bAccX2_Valid := TRUE;
    bAccX3_Valid := TRUE;
END_IF;

iHealthySensorsX := 0;
IF bAccX1_Valid THEN iHealthySensorsX := iHealthySensorsX + 1; END_IF;
IF bAccX2_Valid THEN iHealthySensorsX := iHealthySensorsX + 1; END_IF;
IF bAccX3_Valid THEN iHealthySensorsX := iHealthySensorsX + 1; END_IF;

(* Median voting resolution for X axis *)
IF iHealthySensorsX = 3 THEN
    (* Standard 2oo3 Median Selection *)
    IF ((rBldgAccX_Ch1 >= rBldgAccX_Ch2) AND (rBldgAccX_Ch1 <= rBldgAccX_Ch3)) OR
       ((rBldgAccX_Ch1 <= rBldgAccX_Ch2) AND (rBldgAccX_Ch1 >= rBldgAccX_Ch3)) THEN
        rVotedBldgAccX_ms2 := rBldgAccX_Ch1;
    ELSIF ((rBldgAccX_Ch2 >= rBldgAccX_Ch1) AND (rBldgAccX_Ch2 <= rBldgAccX_Ch3)) OR
          ((rBldgAccX_Ch2 <= rBldgAccX_Ch1) AND (rBldgAccX_Ch2 >= rBldgAccX_Ch3)) THEN
        rVotedBldgAccX_ms2 := rBldgAccX_Ch2;
    ELSE
        rVotedBldgAccX_ms2 := rBldgAccX_Ch3;
    END_IF;
ELSIF iHealthySensorsX = 2 THEN
    (* 2oo2 Average Degraded Mode *)
    IF bAccX1_Valid AND bAccX2_Valid THEN
        rVotedBldgAccX_ms2 := (rBldgAccX_Ch1 + rBldgAccX_Ch2) * 0.5;
    ELSIF bAccX2_Valid AND bAccX3_Valid THEN
        rVotedBldgAccX_ms2 := (rBldgAccX_Ch2 + rBldgAccX_Ch3) * 0.5;
    ELSE
        rVotedBldgAccX_ms2 := (rBldgAccX_Ch3 + rBldgAccX_Ch1) * 0.5;
    END_IF;
ELSIF iHealthySensorsX = 1 THEN
    (* 1oo1 Highly Degraded Fallback Mode *)
    IF bAccX1_Valid THEN rVotedBldgAccX_ms2 := rBldgAccX_Ch1;
    ELSIF bAccX2_Valid THEN rVotedBldgAccX_ms2 := rBldgAccX_Ch2;
    ELSE rVotedBldgAccX_ms2 := rBldgAccX_Ch3;
    END_IF;
ELSE
    (* Total Sensor Redundancy Loss: Freeze Acceleration *)
    rVotedBldgAccX_ms2 := 0.0;
END_IF;

(* --- Y-AXIS ACCELEROMETER 2oo3 VOTING --- *)
rDeltaY_12 := ABS(rBldgAccY_Ch1 - rBldgAccY_Ch2);
rDeltaY_23 := ABS(rBldgAccY_Ch2 - rBldgAccY_Ch3);
rDeltaY_31 := ABS(rBldgAccY_Ch3 - rBldgAccY_Ch1);

tDiscrepTimerY1(IN := (rDeltaY_12 > rTmrTolerance_ms2) AND (rDeltaY_31 > rTmrTolerance_ms2), PT := tTmrPersistDuration);
tDiscrepTimerY2(IN := (rDeltaY_12 > rTmrTolerance_ms2) AND (rDeltaY_23 > rTmrTolerance_ms2), PT := tTmrPersistDuration);
tDiscrepTimerY3(IN := (rDeltaY_23 > rTmrTolerance_ms2) AND (rDeltaY_31 > rTmrTolerance_ms2), PT := tTmrPersistDuration);

IF tDiscrepTimerY1.Q THEN bAccY1_Valid := FALSE; END_IF;
IF tDiscrepTimerY2.Q THEN bAccY2_Valid := FALSE; END_IF;
IF tDiscrepTimerY3.Q THEN bAccY3_Valid := FALSE; END_IF;

IF bResetFaults THEN
    bAccY1_Valid := TRUE;
    bAccY2_Valid := TRUE;
    bAccY3_Valid := TRUE;
END_IF;

iHealthySensorsY := 0;
IF bAccY1_Valid THEN iHealthySensorsY := iHealthySensorsY + 1; END_IF;
IF bAccY2_Valid THEN iHealthySensorsY := iHealthySensorsY + 1; END_IF;
IF bAccY3_Valid THEN iHealthySensorsY := iHealthySensorsY + 1; END_IF;

(* Median voting resolution for Y axis *)
IF iHealthySensorsY = 3 THEN
    IF ((rBldgAccY_Ch1 >= rBldgAccY_Ch2) AND (rBldgAccY_Ch1 <= rBldgAccY_Ch3)) OR
       ((rBldgAccY_Ch1 <= rBldgAccY_Ch2) AND (rBldgAccY_Ch1 >= rBldgAccY_Ch3)) THEN
        rVotedBldgAccY_ms2 := rBldgAccY_Ch1;
    ELSIF ((rBldgAccY_Ch2 >= rBldgAccY_Ch1) AND (rBldgAccY_Ch2 <= rBldgAccY_Ch3)) OR
          ((rBldgAccY_Ch2 <= rBldgAccY_Ch1) AND (rBldgAccY_Ch2 >= rBldgAccY_Ch3)) THEN
        rVotedBldgAccY_ms2 := rBldgAccY_Ch2;
    ELSE
        rVotedBldgAccY_ms2 := rBldgAccY_Ch3;
    END_IF;
ELSIF iHealthySensorsY = 2 THEN
    IF bAccY1_Valid AND bAccY2_Valid THEN
        rVotedBldgAccY_ms2 := (rBldgAccY_Ch1 + rBldgAccY_Ch2) * 0.5;
    ELSIF bAccY2_Valid AND bAccY3_Valid THEN
        rVotedBldgAccY_ms2 := (rBldgAccY_Ch2 + rBldgAccY_Ch3) * 0.5;
    ELSE
        rVotedBldgAccY_ms2 := (rBldgAccY_Ch3 + rBldgAccY_Ch1) * 0.5;
    END_IF;
ELSIF iHealthySensorsY = 1 THEN
    IF bAccY1_Valid THEN rVotedBldgAccY_ms2 := rBldgAccY_Ch1;
    ELSIF bAccY2_Valid THEN rVotedBldgAccY_ms2 := rBldgAccY_Ch2;
    ELSE rVotedBldgAccY_ms2 := rBldgAccY_Ch3;
    END_IF;
ELSE
    rVotedBldgAccY_ms2 := 0.0;
END_IF;

(* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
   SECTION 3: WASHOUT HIGH-PASS FILTERING & SENSOR DRIFT REJECTION
   --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* High-pass filter removes slow tilt drift, thermal bias, and gravity component from horizontal accelerations *)
(* Transfer function: H(s) = s / (s + 1/tau) -> Discretized: y[k] = (tau/(tau+dt)) * (y[k-1] + x[k] - x[k-1]) *)
rFilteredAccX := (rWashoutTau_s / (rWashoutTau_s + rDt_s)) * (rFilteredAccX + rVotedBldgAccX_ms2 - rWashoutStateX);
rWashoutStateX := rVotedBldgAccX_ms2;

rFilteredAccY := (rWashoutTau_s / (rWashoutTau_s + rDt_s)) * (rFilteredAccY + rVotedBldgAccY_ms2 - rWashoutStateY);
rWashoutStateY := rVotedBldgAccY_ms2;

(* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
   SECTION 4: DYNAMIC STATE OBSERVER & REAL-TIME KALMAN ESTIMATION
   --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* Discrete prediction and innovation update for X-axis state vector *)
(* Innovations: e_stroke = Measured_Stroke - Estimated_Stroke; e_acc = Measured_Acc - Model_Acc *)
VAR_TEMP
    rInnovStrokeX_m : REAL;
    rInnovAccX_ms2  : REAL;
    rPredAccX_ms2   : REAL;
    rInnovStrokeY_m : REAL;
    rInnovAccY_ms2  : REAL;
    rPredAccY_ms2   : REAL;
END_VAR;

(* X-Axis Observer Evolution *)
rInnovStrokeX_m := rStrokeX_m - rX_hat_x3_Stroke_m;
rPredAccX_ms2   := -(rBuildingOmega0 * rBuildingOmega0 * rX_hat_x1_BldgDisp_m) -
                   (2.0 * 0.010 * rBuildingOmega0 * rX_hat_x2_BldgVel_ms) -
                   (rMeasuredHydForceX_kN * 1000.0 / rBuildingModalMass_kg);
rInnovAccX_ms2  := rFilteredAccX - rPredAccX_ms2;

(* State vector integration with observer innovation corrections *)
rX_hat_x1_BldgDisp_m   := rX_hat_x1_BldgDisp_m + (rX_hat_x2_BldgVel_ms * rDt_s) + (rL_obs11 * rInnovStrokeX_m * rDt_s);
rX_hat_x2_BldgVel_ms   := rX_hat_x2_BldgVel_ms + (rPredAccX_ms2 * rDt_s) + (rL_obs21 * rInnovStrokeX_m * rDt_s) + (rL_obs22 * rInnovAccX_ms2 * rDt_s);
rX_hat_x3_Stroke_m     := rX_hat_x3_Stroke_m + (rX_hat_x4_StrokeVel_ms * rDt_s) + (rL_obs31 * rInnovStrokeX_m * rDt_s);
rX_hat_x4_StrokeVel_ms := rX_hat_x4_StrokeVel_ms + ((- (rDamperOmega0 * rDamperOmega0 * rX_hat_x3_Stroke_m) +
                         ((rMeasuredHydForceX_kN * 1000.0) / rDamperMass_kg) - rPredAccX_ms2) * rDt_s) +
                         (rL_obs41 * rInnovStrokeX_m * rDt_s);

(* Y-Axis Observer Evolution *)
rInnovStrokeY_m := rStrokeY_m - rY_hat_y3_Stroke_m;
rPredAccY_ms2   := -(rBuildingOmega0 * rBuildingOmega0 * rY_hat_y1_BldgDisp_m) -
                   (2.0 * 0.010 * rBuildingOmega0 * rY_hat_y2_BldgVel_ms) -
                   (rMeasuredHydForceY_kN * 1000.0 / rBuildingModalMass_kg);
rInnovAccY_ms2  := rFilteredAccY - rPredAccY_ms2;

rY_hat_y1_BldgDisp_m   := rY_hat_y1_BldgDisp_m + (rY_hat_y2_BldgVel_ms * rDt_s) + (rL_obs11 * rInnovStrokeY_m * rDt_s);
rY_hat_y2_BldgVel_ms   := rY_hat_y2_BldgVel_ms + (rPredAccY_ms2 * rDt_s) + (rL_obs21 * rInnovStrokeY_m * rDt_s) + (rL_obs22 * rInnovAccY_ms2 * rDt_s);
rY_hat_y3_Stroke_m     := rY_hat_y3_Stroke_m + (rY_hat_y4_StrokeVel_ms * rDt_s) + (rL_obs31 * rInnovStrokeY_m * rDt_s);
rY_hat_y4_StrokeVel_ms := rY_hat_y4_StrokeVel_ms + ((- (rDamperOmega0 * rDamperOmega0 * rY_hat_y3_Stroke_m) +
                         ((rMeasuredHydForceY_kN * 1000.0) / rDamperMass_kg) - rPredAccY_ms2) * rDt_s) +
                         (rL_obs41 * rInnovStrokeY_m * rDt_s);

(* Populate Diagnostic Output Reconstructions *)
rEstimatedBldgDispX_mm := rX_hat_x1_BldgDisp_m * 1000.0;
rEstimatedBldgDispY_mm := rY_hat_y1_BldgDisp_m * 1000.0;
rEstimatedBldgVelX_mms := rX_hat_x2_BldgVel_ms * 1000.0;
rEstimatedBldgVelY_mms := rY_hat_y2_BldgVel_ms * 1000.0;

(* Track Peak Accelerations and Displacements for Diagnostic Profiling *)
IF ABS(rVotedBldgAccX_ms2) > rPeakBldgAccObserved_ms2 THEN rPeakBldgAccObserved_ms2 := ABS(rVotedBldgAccX_ms2); END_IF;
IF ABS(rVotedBldgAccY_ms2) > rPeakBldgAccObserved_ms2 THEN rPeakBldgAccObserved_ms2 := ABS(rVotedBldgAccY_ms2); END_IF;
IF ABS(rMassStrokeX_mm) > rPeakStrokeObserved_mm THEN rPeakStrokeObserved_mm := ABS(rMassStrokeX_mm); END_IF;
IF ABS(rMassStrokeY_mm) > rPeakStrokeObserved_mm THEN rPeakStrokeObserved_mm := ABS(rMassStrokeY_mm); END_IF;

(* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
   SECTION 5: MODEL PREDICTIVE CONTROL (MPC) & STROKE CENTERING FORCE SYNTHESIS
   --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* Component 1: Linear Quadratic Regulator (LQR) Optimal Sway Mitigation Force *)
(* Primary goal: Generate skyhook damping opposing structural roof sway velocity *)
rLqrForceX_kN := - ((rK_lqr_BldgDisp * rX_hat_x1_BldgDisp_m) +
                    (rK_lqr_BldgVel  * rX_hat_x2_BldgVel_ms) +
                    (rK_lqr_Stroke   * rStrokeX_m) +
                    (rK_lqr_StrokeVel* rX_hat_x4_StrokeVel_ms));

rLqrForceY_kN := - ((rK_lqr_BldgDisp * rY_hat_y1_BldgDisp_m) +
                    (rK_lqr_BldgVel  * rY_hat_y2_BldgVel_ms) +
                    (rK_lqr_Stroke   * rStrokeY_m) +
                    (rK_lqr_StrokeVel* rY_hat_y4_StrokeVel_ms));

(* Component 2: Nonlinear Progressive Stroke Centering Restoration *)
(* Restores damper mass toward physical geometric null, countering steady wind aerodynamic drag offsets *)
rCenterForceX_kN := - ((rK_center_Linear * rStrokeX_m) +
                       (rK_center_Cubic * rStrokeX_m * rStrokeX_m * rStrokeX_m));

rCenterForceY_kN := - ((rK_center_Linear * rStrokeY_m) +
                       (rK_center_Cubic * rStrokeY_m * rStrokeY_m * rStrokeY_m));

(* Component 3: Virtual Barrier Deceleration Potential Field (MPC Soft Boundary Penalty) *)
(* Injects progressive hydraulic pushback if stroke exceeds safe operating threshold (rStrokeSoftLimit_m = 1.10 m) *)
IF ABS(rStrokeX_m) > rStrokeSoftLimit_m THEN
    IF rStrokeX_m > 0.0 THEN
        rBarrierForceX_kN := - (rK_barrier_Stiff * (rStrokeX_m - rStrokeSoftLimit_m) * (rStrokeX_m - rStrokeSoftLimit_m)) -
                             (rC_barrier_Damp * MAX(0.0, rX_hat_x4_StrokeVel_ms));
    ELSE
        rBarrierForceX_kN := + (rK_barrier_Stiff * (ABS(rStrokeX_m) - rStrokeSoftLimit_m) * (ABS(rStrokeX_m) - rStrokeSoftLimit_m)) -
                             (rC_barrier_Damp * MIN(0.0, rX_hat_x4_StrokeVel_ms));
    END_IF;
ELSE
    rBarrierForceX_kN := 0.0;
END_IF;

IF ABS(rStrokeY_m) > rStrokeSoftLimit_m THEN
    IF rStrokeY_m > 0.0 THEN
        rBarrierForceY_kN := - (rK_barrier_Stiff * (rStrokeY_m - rStrokeSoftLimit_m) * (rStrokeY_m - rStrokeSoftLimit_m)) -
                             (rC_barrier_Damp * MAX(0.0, rY_hat_y4_StrokeVel_ms));
    ELSE
        rBarrierForceY_kN := + (rK_barrier_Stiff * (ABS(rStrokeY_m) - rStrokeSoftLimit_m) * (ABS(rStrokeY_m) - rStrokeSoftLimit_m)) -
                             (rC_barrier_Damp * MIN(0.0, rY_hat_y4_StrokeVel_ms));
    END_IF;
ELSE
    rBarrierForceY_kN := 0.0;
END_IF;

(* Synthesize Net Demand Force and clamp to maximum cylinder hydraulic authority (+/- 400 kN) *)
rTotalDemandedForceX_kN := rLqrForceX_kN + rCenterForceX_kN + rBarrierForceX_kN;
rTotalDemandedForceY_kN := rLqrForceY_kN + rCenterForceY_kN + rBarrierForceY_kN;

IF rTotalDemandedForceX_kN > rValveMaxForce_kN THEN rTotalDemandedForceX_kN := rValveMaxForce_kN; END_IF;
IF rTotalDemandedForceX_kN < -rValveMaxForce_kN THEN rTotalDemandedForceX_kN := -rValveMaxForce_kN; END_IF;
IF rTotalDemandedForceY_kN > rValveMaxForce_kN THEN rTotalDemandedForceY_kN := rValveMaxForce_kN; END_IF;
IF rTotalDemandedForceY_kN < -rValveMaxForce_kN THEN rTotalDemandedForceY_kN := -rValveMaxForce_kN; END_IF;

rCalculatedForceX_kN := rTotalDemandedForceX_kN;
rCalculatedForceY_kN := rTotalDemandedForceY_kN;

(* Estimate equivalent modal damping ratio achieved: base structural 1.0% + active augmentation *)
rDampingRatioAchieved_Pct := 1.0 + (ABS(rCalculatedForceX_kN) + ABS(rCalculatedForceY_kN)) / 80.0;
IF rDampingRatioAchieved_Pct > 14.5 THEN rDampingRatioAchieved_Pct := 14.5; END_IF;

(* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
   SECTION 6: ELECTRO-HYDRAULIC SERVO DRIVER, VALVE LINEARIZATION & MICRO-DITHER
   --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* 100 Hz Micro-Dither Generator (Cycle period 10 ms = 2 cycles of 5 ms PLC task) *)
iDitherCycleCounter := (iDitherCycleCounter + 1) MOD 4;
CASE iDitherCycleCounter OF
    0: rDitherSignal_mA := 0.0;
    1: rDitherSignal_mA := rDitherAmplitude_mA;
    2: rDitherSignal_mA := 0.0;
    3: rDitherSignal_mA := -rDitherAmplitude_mA;
END_CASE;

(* Calculate instantaneous available pressure drop across servo valve spools *)
rAvailDeltaPressX_bar := rHydraulicSupplyPres_bar - ABS(rDeltaPressX_bar) - rHydraulicReturnPres_bar;
IF rAvailDeltaPressX_bar < 25.0 THEN rAvailDeltaPressX_bar := 25.0; END_IF;
rValveFlowScalingX := SQRT(rValveRatedPressureDrop_bar / rAvailDeltaPressX_bar);

rAvailDeltaPressY_bar := rHydraulicSupplyPres_bar - ABS(rDeltaPressY_bar) - rHydraulicReturnPres_bar;
IF rAvailDeltaPressY_bar < 25.0 THEN rAvailDeltaPressY_bar := 25.0; END_IF;
rValveFlowScalingY := SQRT(rValveRatedPressureDrop_bar / rAvailDeltaPressY_bar);

(* Closed-Loop Force PI Controller for X-Axis *)
rForceErrX_kN := rCalculatedForceX_kN - rMeasuredHydForceX_kN;
rForceIntX_kN := rForceIntX_kN + (rForceKi * rForceErrX_kN * rDt_s);
IF rForceIntX_kN > rMaxIntegralWindup_mA THEN rForceIntX_kN := rMaxIntegralWindup_mA; END_IF;
IF rForceIntX_kN < -rMaxIntegralWindup_mA THEN rForceIntX_kN := -rMaxIntegralWindup_mA; END_IF;

rRawServoCmdX_mA := ((rForceKp * rForceErrX_kN) + rForceIntX_kN) * rValveFlowScalingX + rDitherSignal_mA;
IF rRawServoCmdX_mA > rValveRatedCurrent_mA THEN rRawServoCmdX_mA := rValveRatedCurrent_mA; END_IF;
IF rRawServoCmdX_mA < -rValveRatedCurrent_mA THEN rRawServoCmdX_mA := -rValveRatedCurrent_mA; END_IF;

(* Closed-Loop Force PI Controller for Y-Axis *)
rForceErrY_kN := rCalculatedForceY_kN - rMeasuredHydForceY_kN;
rForceIntY_kN := rForceIntY_kN + (rForceKi * rForceErrY_kN * rDt_s);
IF rForceIntY_kN > rMaxIntegralWindup_mA THEN rForceIntY_kN := rMaxIntegralWindup_mA; END_IF;
IF rForceIntY_kN < -rMaxIntegralWindup_mA THEN rForceIntY_kN := -rMaxIntegralWindup_mA; END_IF;

rRawServoCmdY_mA := ((rForceKp * rForceErrY_kN) + rForceIntY_kN) * rValveFlowScalingY + rDitherSignal_mA;
IF rRawServoCmdY_mA > rValveRatedCurrent_mA THEN rRawServoCmdY_mA := rValveRatedCurrent_mA; END_IF;
IF rRawServoCmdY_mA < -rValveRatedCurrent_mA THEN rRawServoCmdY_mA := -rValveRatedCurrent_mA; END_IF;

(* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
   SECTION 7: MULTI-STAGE FINITE STATE MACHINE (FSM)
   --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* State timer execution *)
tStateTimer(IN := (iState = iPrevState), PT := T#24H);
iPrevState := iState;

(* Hardwired E-Stop and Catastrophic Limit Interlock Check *)
IF NOT bSafetyEStopOk THEN
    iState := 99; (* Transition directly to emergency latched trip *)
ELSIF (ABS(rMassStrokeX_mm) > (rStrokeHardLimit_m * 1000.0)) OR (ABS(rMassStrokeY_mm) > (rStrokeHardLimit_m * 1000.0)) THEN
    iState := 99; (* Mechanical overstroke limit switch hit *)
ELSIF rHydraulicSupplyPres_bar < 140.0 AND (iState >= 30) THEN
    iState := 90; (* Hydraulic pressure rail collapse: initiate controlled brake clamping *)
END_IF;

CASE iState OF
    0: (* STATE_SYSTEM_BOOT_INIT *)
        bSystemReady            := FALSE;
        bActiveDampingEngaged   := FALSE;
        bDegradedModeActive     := FALSE;
        bHydraulicBrakeRelease  := FALSE; (* Keep parking brakes fully engaged *)
        rServoCurrentCmd_X_mA   := 0.0;
        rServoCurrentCmd_Y_mA   := 0.0;
        rForceIntX_kN           := 0.0;
        rForceIntY_kN           := 0.0;

        IF bSafetyEStopOk AND bMasterEnable THEN
            iState := 10;
        END_IF;

    10: (* STATE_HYDRAULIC_WARMUP_AND_PRESSURIZATION *)
        bSystemReady            := FALSE;
        bActiveDampingEngaged   := FALSE;
        bDegradedModeActive     := FALSE;
        bHydraulicBrakeRelease  := FALSE;
        rServoCurrentCmd_X_mA   := 0.0;
        rServoCurrentCmd_Y_mA   := 0.0;

        tHpuWarmupTimer(IN := (rHydraulicSupplyPres_bar >= 240.0) AND (rHydraulicOilTemp_DegC >= 25.0), PT := T#3S);
        IF tHpuWarmupTimer.Q THEN
            tHpuWarmupTimer(IN := FALSE);
            iState := 20;
        END_IF;

    20: (* STATE_SENSOR_CALIBRATION_AND_LVDT_ZEROING *)
        bSystemReady            := FALSE;
        bActiveDampingEngaged   := FALSE;
        bDegradedModeActive     := FALSE;
        bHydraulicBrakeRelease  := FALSE;
        rServoCurrentCmd_X_mA   := 0.0;
        rServoCurrentCmd_Y_mA   := 0.0;

        (* Check sensor sanity and stable zeroing *)
        tCalibDwellTimer(IN := (iHealthySensorsX >= 2) AND (iHealthySensorsY >= 2), PT := T#2S);
        IF tCalibDwellTimer.Q THEN
            tCalibDwellTimer(IN := FALSE);
            iState := 25;
        END_IF;

    25: (* STATE_HYDRAULIC_BRAKE_RELEASE_SEQUENCE *)
        bSystemReady            := TRUE;
        bActiveDampingEngaged   := FALSE;
        bHydraulicBrakeRelease  := TRUE; (* Command caliper brake release solenoids *)
        rServoCurrentCmd_X_mA   := 0.0;
        rServoCurrentCmd_Y_mA   := 0.0;

        tBrakeReleaseDwell(IN := TRUE, PT := T#1500MS);
        IF tBrakeReleaseDwell.Q THEN
            tBrakeReleaseDwell(IN := FALSE);
            iState := 30;
        END_IF;

    30: (* STATE_DORMANT_STANDBY (CALM WEATHER / LOW STRUCTURAL EXCITATION) *)
        bSystemReady            := TRUE;
        bActiveDampingEngaged   := FALSE;
        bDegradedModeActive     := (iHealthySensorsX < 3) OR (iHealthySensorsY < 3) OR (rHydraulicSupplyPres_bar < 250.0);
        bHydraulicBrakeRelease  := TRUE;

        (* Apply gentle centering current to hold mass precisely at origin *)
        rServoCurrentCmd_X_mA   := - (0.012 * rMassStrokeX_mm) + rDitherSignal_mA;
        rServoCurrentCmd_Y_mA   := - (0.012 * rMassStrokeY_mm) + rDitherSignal_mA;

        (* Seismic early warning priority bypass *)
        IF bSeismicPWaveTrigger THEN
            iState := 60;
        (* Wake-up threshold: Wind velocity > 12 m/s OR Top acceleration > 0.040 m/s2 *)
        ELSIF bAutoModeSelect AND ((rAnemometerSpeed_ms > 12.0) OR (ABS(rVotedBldgAccX_ms2) > 0.040) OR (ABS(rVotedBldgAccY_ms2) > 0.040)) THEN
            IF bDegradedModeActive THEN
                iState := 50;
            ELSE
                iState := 40;
            END_IF;
        END_IF;

    40: (* STATE_ACTIVE_SWAY_CONTROL (FULL CLOSED-LOOP LQR + MPC CENTERING) *)
        bSystemReady            := TRUE;
        bActiveDampingEngaged   := TRUE;
        bDegradedModeActive     := FALSE;
        bHydraulicBrakeRelease  := TRUE;

        rServoCurrentCmd_X_mA   := rRawServoCmdX_mA;
        rServoCurrentCmd_Y_mA   := rRawServoCmdY_mA;

        (* Degradation transition *)
        IF (iHealthySensorsX < 3) OR (iHealthySensorsY < 3) OR (rHydraulicSupplyPres_bar < 250.0) THEN
            iState := 50;
        (* Seismic override *)
        ELSIF bSeismicPWaveTrigger THEN
            iState := 60;
        (* Quiet weather decay transition to Standby *)
        ELSIF (rAnemometerSpeed_ms < 8.0) AND (ABS(rVotedBldgAccX_ms2) < 0.020) AND (ABS(rVotedBldgAccY_ms2) < 0.020) AND (tStateTimer.ET > T#10M) THEN
            iState := 30;
        END_IF;

    50: (* STATE_DEGRADED_ACTIVE_CONTROL (REDUCED ENVELOPE / REDUNDANCY LOSS) *)
        bSystemReady            := TRUE;
        bActiveDampingEngaged   := TRUE;
        bDegradedModeActive     := TRUE;
        bHydraulicBrakeRelease  := TRUE;

        (* Limit servo current to 70% rated capacity to protect stressed hydraulic plant *)
        rServoCurrentCmd_X_mA   := rRawServoCmdX_mA * 0.70;
        rServoCurrentCmd_Y_mA   := rRawServoCmdY_mA * 0.70;

        (* If all sensors on an axis fail, or supply pressure severely degrades, abort to centering deceleration *)
        IF (iHealthySensorsX = 0) OR (iHealthySensorsY = 0) OR (rHydraulicSupplyPres_bar < 180.0) THEN
            iState := 80;
        (* Recovery to full mode if issues cleared *)
        ELSIF (iHealthySensorsX = 3) AND (iHealthySensorsY = 3) AND (rHydraulicSupplyPres_bar >= 260.0) THEN
            iState := 40;
        END_IF;

    60: (* STATE_SEISMIC_EMERGENCY_DISSIPATION *)
        bSystemReady            := TRUE;
        bActiveDampingEngaged   := TRUE;
        bDegradedModeActive     := FALSE;
        bHydraulicBrakeRelease  := TRUE;

        (* Maximum energy dissipation mode: Command maximum skyhook damping and stroke resistance *)
        rServoCurrentCmd_X_mA   := rRawServoCmdX_mA;
        rServoCurrentCmd_Y_mA   := rRawServoCmdY_mA;

        IF NOT bSeismicPWaveTrigger AND tSeismicOverdriveTimer.Q THEN
            tSeismicOverdriveTimer(IN := FALSE);
            iState := 40;
        END_IF;

    80: (* STATE_CONTROLLED_DECELERATION_AND_HYDRAULIC_SNUBBING *)
        bSystemReady            := FALSE;
        bActiveDampingEngaged   := FALSE;
        bDegradedModeActive     := TRUE;
        bHydraulicBrakeRelease  := TRUE;

        (* Ramp stroke toward zero with heavy velocity damping *)
        rServoCurrentCmd_X_mA   := - (0.025 * rMassStrokeX_mm) - (0.015 * rX_hat_x4_StrokeVel_ms * 1000.0);
        rServoCurrentCmd_Y_mA   := - (0.025 * rMassStrokeY_mm) - (0.015 * rY_hat_y4_StrokeVel_ms * 1000.0);

        IF (ABS(rMassStrokeX_mm) < 15.0) AND (ABS(rMassStrokeY_mm) < 15.0) AND (tStateTimer.ET > T#4S) THEN
            iState := 90;
        END_IF;

    90: (* STATE_HYDRAULIC_BRAKE_CLAMP_PARKING *)
        bSystemReady            := FALSE;
        bActiveDampingEngaged   := FALSE;
        bDegradedModeActive     := FALSE;
        bHydraulicBrakeRelease  := FALSE; (* De-energize brake solenoid -> Spring clamps engage *)
        rServoCurrentCmd_X_mA   := 0.0;
        rServoCurrentCmd_Y_mA   := 0.0;
        rForceIntX_kN           := 0.0;
        rForceIntY_kN           := 0.0;

        IF bResetFaults AND bMasterEnable AND (rHydraulicSupplyPres_bar >= 240.0) THEN

        END_IF;

    99: (* STATE_SAFETY_ESTOP_LATCHED *)
        bSystemReady            := FALSE;
        bActiveDampingEngaged   := FALSE;
        bDegradedModeActive     := FALSE;
        bHydraulicBrakeRelease  := FALSE; (* Calipers clamped immediately *)
        rServoCurrentCmd_X_mA   := 0.0;
        rServoCurrentCmd_Y_mA   := 0.0;
        rForceIntX_kN           := 0.0;
        rForceIntY_kN           := 0.0;

        IF bResetFaults AND bSafetyEStopOk AND (ABS(rMassStrokeX_mm) < (rStrokeHardLimit_m * 1000.0)) AND (ABS(rMassStrokeY_mm) < (rStrokeHardLimit_m * 1000.0)) THEN

        END_IF;

END_CASE;

wAlarmWord1 := 16#0000;
wAlarmWord2 := 16#0000;
wSystemStatusWord := 16#0000;

IF NOT bSafetyEStopOk THEN wAlarmWord1 := wAlarmWord1 OR 16#0001; END_IF;                  (* Bit 0: Emergency Stop Tripped *)
IF ABS(rMassStrokeX_mm) > (rStrokeHardLimit_m * 1000.0) THEN wAlarmWord1 := wAlarmWord1 OR 16#0002; END_IF; (* Bit 1: X-Axis Overstroke Hard Limit *)
IF ABS(rMassStrokeY_mm) > (rStrokeHardLimit_m * 1000.0) THEN wAlarmWord1 := wAlarmWord1 OR 16#0004; END_IF; (* Bit 2: Y-Axis Overstroke Hard Limit *)
IF rHydraulicSupplyPres_bar < 140.0 THEN wAlarmWord1 := wAlarmWord1 OR 16#0008; END_IF;  (* Bit 3: Hydraulic Pressure Collapse Trip *)
IF rHydraulicOilTemp_DegC > 75.0 THEN wAlarmWord1 := wAlarmWord1 OR 16#0010; END_IF;     (* Bit 4: Hydraulic Oil Critical High Temp *)
IF (iHealthySensorsX = 0) OR (iHealthySensorsY = 0) THEN wAlarmWord1 := wAlarmWord1 OR 16#0020; END_IF; (* Bit 5: Complete Sensor TMR Redundancy Loss *)
IF ABS(rForceErrX_kN) > 90.0 THEN wAlarmWord1 := wAlarmWord1 OR 16#0040; END_IF;          (* Bit 6: X-Axis Cylinder Force Tracking Deviation *)
IF ABS(rForceErrY_kN) > 90.0 THEN wAlarmWord1 := wAlarmWord1 OR 16#0080; END_IF;          (* Bit 7: Y-Axis Cylinder Force Tracking Deviation *)

(* --- Priority 3 Alarms & Warnings (wAlarmWord2) --- *)
IF (iHealthySensorsX = 2) THEN wAlarmWord2 := wAlarmWord2 OR 16#0001; END_IF;            (* Bit 0: X-Axis Sensor Degraded to 2oo2 *)
IF (iHealthySensorsX = 1) THEN wAlarmWord2 := wAlarmWord2 OR 16#0002; END_IF;            (* Bit 1: X-Axis Sensor Degraded to 1oo1 *)
IF (iHealthySensorsY = 2) THEN wAlarmWord2 := wAlarmWord2 OR 16#0004; END_IF;            (* Bit 2: Y-Axis Sensor Degraded to 2oo2 *)
IF (iHealthySensorsY = 1) THEN wAlarmWord2 := wAlarmWord2 OR 16#0008; END_IF;            (* Bit 3: Y-Axis Sensor Degraded to 1oo1 *)
IF (ABS(rMassStrokeX_mm) > 950.0) OR (ABS(rMassStrokeY_mm) > 950.0) THEN wAlarmWord2 := wAlarmWord2 OR 16#0010; END_IF; (* Bit 4: High Stroke Soft Pre-Warning *)
IF rHydraulicSupplyPres_bar < 220.0 THEN wAlarmWord2 := wAlarmWord2 OR 16#0020; END_IF;  (* Bit 5: Hydraulic Rail Low Pressure Warning *)
IF rHydraulicOilTemp_DegC > 65.0 THEN wAlarmWord2 := wAlarmWord2 OR 16#0040; END_IF;     (* Bit 6: Hydraulic Oil High Temp Warning *)
IF bSeismicPWaveTrigger THEN wAlarmWord2 := wAlarmWord2 OR 16#0080; END_IF;              (* Bit 7: Active Seismic Event Detected *)
IF rAnemometerSpeed_ms > 35.0 THEN wAlarmWord2 := wAlarmWord2 OR 16#0100; END_IF;        (* Bit 8: Hurricane Force Wind Velocity Warning *)

(* --- System Status Diagnostic Word (wSystemStatusWord) --- *)
wSystemStatusWord := INT_TO_WORD(iState) AND 16#00FF;                                    (* Bits 0-7: Active State Machine Index *)
IF bSystemReady THEN wSystemStatusWord := wSystemStatusWord OR 16#0100; END_IF;           (* Bit 8: System Ready Flag *)
IF bActiveDampingEngaged THEN wSystemStatusWord := wSystemStatusWord OR 16#0200; END_IF;  (* Bit 9: Closed-Loop Active Damping Engaged *)
IF bDegradedModeActive THEN wSystemStatusWord := wSystemStatusWord OR 16#0400; END_IF;    (* Bit 10: Degraded Mode Running *)
IF bHydraulicBrakeRelease THEN wSystemStatusWord := wSystemStatusWord OR 16#0800; END_IF; (* Bit 11: Hydraulic Calipers Released *)

END_FUNCTION_BLOCK

(*
 * =========================================================================================
 * SECTION 0: SAFETY EMBARGO & HARDWIRED INTERLOCK EVALUATION
 * =========================================================================================
 *)
IF NOT bEmergencyShutdown THEN
    (* Hardwired Marine Safety ESD Loop Broken (Active-Low Logic) *)
    rCV_BOG_CompressorSpeed    := 0.0;
    rCV_RefrigExpansionValve   := 0.0;
    rCV_SubcoolBypassValve     := 100.0;  (* Fail-Safe: Full Open Bypass to Equalize & Prevent Subcooling *)
    rCV_AntiDryIceHeaterDemand := 0.0;
    bTripSolidificationRisk    := FALSE;
    bSystemReady               := FALSE;
    wSystemStatusWord          := 16#E5D0; (* ESD Tripped / Lockout State *)
    wAlarmWord                 := wAlarmWord OR 16#2000; (* Bit 13: Emergency Shutdown Engaged *)
    iState                     := 99;
    RETURN;
END_IF;

(* Normalize Execution Scan Interval if not provided by hardware task configuration *)
IF rCycleTimeSec <= 0.001 OR rCycleTimeSec > 5.0 THEN
    rCycleTimeSec := 0.100; (* Standard 100ms Marine IEC 61131-3 Periodic Task Fallback *)
END_IF;

(*
 * =========================================================================================
 * SECTION 1: 2oo3 TRIPLE MODULAR REDUNDANCY (TMR) SENSOR VOTING & INTEGRITY CHECKING
 * =========================================================================================
 *)
(* Evaluate Plausibility Bounds for Pressure Transducers (CO2 Marine Operating Range: 3.5 to 30.0 bar) *)
bPressSensorA_Fail := (rPT_TankPress_A < 3.5) OR (rPT_TankPress_A > 30.0);
bPressSensorB_Fail := (rPT_TankPress_B < 3.5) OR (rPT_TankPress_B > 30.0);
bPressSensorC_Fail := (rPT_TankPress_C < 3.5) OR (rPT_TankPress_C > 30.0);

(* Channel-to-Channel Discrepancy Diagnostics *)
bDiscrepancyPress_AB := ABS(rPT_TankPress_A - rPT_TankPress_B) > rP_SENSOR_DISCREPANCY_MAX;
bDiscrepancyPress_BC := ABS(rPT_TankPress_B - rPT_TankPress_C) > rP_SENSOR_DISCREPANCY_MAX;
bDiscrepancyPress_CA := ABS(rPT_TankPress_C - rPT_TankPress_A) > rP_SENSOR_DISCREPANCY_MAX;

(* Qualify Sensor Failures via Discrepancy Cross-Check *)
IF bDiscrepancyPress_AB AND bDiscrepancyPress_CA THEN
    bPressSensorA_Fail := TRUE; (* Sensor A is odd-man-out *)
END_IF;
IF bDiscrepancyPress_AB AND bDiscrepancyPress_BC THEN
    bPressSensorB_Fail := TRUE; (* Sensor B is odd-man-out *)
END_IF;
IF bDiscrepancyPress_BC AND bDiscrepancyPress_CA THEN
    bPressSensorC_Fail := TRUE; (* Sensor C is odd-man-out *)
END_IF;

(* Count Valid Pressure Sensors *)
iHealthyPressSensors := 3;
IF bPressSensorA_Fail THEN iHealthyPressSensors := iHealthyPressSensors - 1; END_IF;
IF bPressSensorB_Fail THEN iHealthyPressSensors := iHealthyPressSensors - 1; END_IF;
IF bPressSensorC_Fail THEN iHealthyPressSensors := iHealthyPressSensors - 1; END_IF;

(* 2oo3 Voting & Graceful Degradation Logic for Pressure Transducers *)
IF iHealthyPressSensors = 3 THEN
    (* Full 2oo3 Median Selection Algorithm *)
    IF (rPT_TankPress_A >= rPT_TankPress_B AND rPT_TankPress_A <= rPT_TankPress_C) OR
       (rPT_TankPress_A <= rPT_TankPress_B AND rPT_TankPress_A >= rPT_TankPress_C) THEN
        rVotedTankPressure := rPT_TankPress_A;
    ELSIF (rPT_TankPress_B >= rPT_TankPress_A AND rPT_TankPress_B <= rPT_TankPress_C) OR
          (rPT_TankPress_B <= rPT_TankPress_A AND rPT_TankPress_B >= rPT_TankPress_C) THEN
        rVotedTankPressure := rPT_TankPress_B;
    ELSE
        rVotedTankPressure := rPT_TankPress_C;
    END_IF;
    wSystemStatusWord := (wSystemStatusWord AND 16#F0FF) OR 16#0300; (* 3 Healthy Sensors *)
ELSIF iHealthyPressSensors = 2 THEN
    (* Degraded 1oo2 Dual Redundancy Averaging *)
    IF NOT bPressSensorA_Fail AND NOT bPressSensorB_Fail THEN
        rVotedTankPressure := 0.5 * (rPT_TankPress_A + rPT_TankPress_B);
    ELSIF NOT bPressSensorB_Fail AND NOT bPressSensorC_Fail THEN
        rVotedTankPressure := 0.5 * (rPT_TankPress_B + rPT_TankPress_C);
    ELSE
        rVotedTankPressure := 0.5 * (rPT_TankPress_A + rPT_TankPress_C);
    END_IF;
    wSystemStatusWord := (wSystemStatusWord AND 16#F0FF) OR 16#0200; (* 2 Healthy Sensors (Degraded 1oo2) *)
    wAlarmWord := wAlarmWord OR 16#0400; (* Bit 10: 1oo2 Degraded Mode *)
ELSIF iHealthyPressSensors = 1 THEN
    (* Critical Single Sensor Surviving *)
    IF NOT bPressSensorA_Fail THEN
        rVotedTankPressure := rPT_TankPress_A;
    ELSIF NOT bPressSensorB_Fail THEN
        rVotedTankPressure := rPT_TankPress_B;
    ELSE
        rVotedTankPressure := rPT_TankPress_C;
    END_IF;
    wSystemStatusWord := (wSystemStatusWord AND 16#F0FF) OR 16#0100; (* 1 Healthy Sensor (Degraded 1oo1) *)
    wAlarmWord := wAlarmWord OR 16#0800; (* Bit 11: 1oo1 Degraded Mode Critical *)
ELSE
    (* Total Sensor Blackout - Zero Healthy Transducers *)
    rVotedTankPressure := rP_TRIPLE_POINT_ABS; (* Conservative Fallback: Force Critical Safeguard Action *)
    wAlarmWord := wAlarmWord OR 16#1000;        (* Bit 12: Total Sensor Blackout Trip *)
    bTripSolidificationRisk := TRUE;
    iState := 60;
END_IF;

(* Evaluate Plausibility Bounds for Temperature Transducers (Range: -65.0 to +30.0 deg C) *)
bTempSensorA_Fail := (rTT_TankTemp_A < -65.0) OR (rTT_TankTemp_A > 30.0);
bTempSensorB_Fail := (rTT_TankTemp_B < -65.0) OR (rTT_TankTemp_B > 30.0);
bTempSensorC_Fail := (rTT_TankTemp_C < -65.0) OR (rTT_TankTemp_C > 30.0);

bDiscrepancyTemp_AB := ABS(rTT_TankTemp_A - rTT_TankTemp_B) > rT_SENSOR_DISCREPANCY_MAX;
bDiscrepancyTemp_BC := ABS(rTT_TankTemp_B - rTT_TankTemp_C) > rT_SENSOR_DISCREPANCY_MAX;
bDiscrepancyTemp_CA := ABS(rTT_TankTemp_C - rTT_TankTemp_A) > rT_SENSOR_DISCREPANCY_MAX;

IF bDiscrepancyTemp_AB AND bDiscrepancyTemp_CA THEN bTempSensorA_Fail := TRUE; END_IF;
IF bDiscrepancyTemp_AB AND bDiscrepancyTemp_BC THEN bTempSensorB_Fail := TRUE; END_IF;
IF bDiscrepancyTemp_BC AND bDiscrepancyTemp_CA THEN bTempSensorC_Fail := TRUE; END_IF;

iHealthyTempSensors := 3;
IF bTempSensorA_Fail THEN iHealthyTempSensors := iHealthyTempSensors - 1; END_IF;
IF bTempSensorB_Fail THEN iHealthyTempSensors := iHealthyTempSensors - 1; END_IF;
IF bTempSensorC_Fail THEN iHealthyTempSensors := iHealthyTempSensors - 1; END_IF;

IF iHealthyTempSensors = 3 THEN
    IF (rTT_TankTemp_A >= rTT_TankTemp_B AND rTT_TankTemp_A <= rTT_TankTemp_C) OR
       (rTT_TankTemp_A <= rTT_TankTemp_B AND rTT_TankTemp_A >= rTT_TankTemp_C) THEN
        rVotedTankTemp := rTT_TankTemp_A;
    ELSIF (rTT_TankTemp_B >= rTT_TankTemp_A AND rTT_TankTemp_B <= rTT_TankTemp_C) OR
          (rTT_TankTemp_B <= rTT_TankTemp_A AND rTT_TankTemp_B >= rTT_TankTemp_C) THEN
        rVotedTankTemp := rTT_TankTemp_B;
    ELSE
        rVotedTankTemp := rTT_TankTemp_C;
    END_IF;
ELSIF iHealthyTempSensors = 2 THEN
    IF NOT bTempSensorA_Fail AND NOT bTempSensorB_Fail THEN
        rVotedTankTemp := 0.5 * (rTT_TankTemp_A + rTT_TankTemp_B);
    ELSIF NOT bTempSensorB_Fail AND NOT bTempSensorC_Fail THEN
        rVotedTankTemp := 0.5 * (rTT_TankTemp_B + rTT_TankTemp_C);
    ELSE
        rVotedTankTemp := 0.5 * (rTT_TankTemp_A + rTT_TankTemp_C);
    END_IF;
ELSIF iHealthyTempSensors = 1 THEN
    IF NOT bTempSensorA_Fail THEN
        rVotedTankTemp := rTT_TankTemp_A;
    ELSIF NOT bTempSensorB_Fail THEN
        rVotedTankTemp := rTT_TankTemp_B;
    ELSE
        rVotedTankTemp := rTT_TankTemp_C;
    END_IF;
ELSE
    rVotedTankTemp := rT_TRIPLE_POINT;
    bTripSolidificationRisk := TRUE;
    iState := 60;
END_IF;

(*
 * =========================================================================================
 * SECTION 2: THERMODYNAMIC EQUILIBRIUM & TRIPLE-POINT MARGIN CALCULATIONS
 * =========================================================================================
 *)
(* Real-time Margin Quantification Above Critical Solid Phase Boundary *)
rMarginToTriplePoint_Bar  := rVotedTankPressure - rP_TRIPLE_POINT_ABS;
rMarginToTriplePoint_DegC := rVotedTankTemp - rT_TRIPLE_POINT;

(* Low-Pass Filter Incondensable Gas Concentration *)
rIncondensablePpmFilter := (0.95 * rIncondensablePpmFilter) + (0.05 * rAT_IncondensableGas_ppm);
(* Dalton Law: Ullage Partial Pressure Contribution from Incondensable Gaseous Species *)
rIncondensablePartialP  := rVotedTankPressure * (rIncondensablePpmFilter / 1000000.0);
rEffectiveCO2VaporP     := rVotedTankPressure - rIncondensablePartialP;

(* Empirical Wagner-type High-Precision Saturation Curve Approximation for CO2 / R744 *)
(* Approximating saturation temperature in deg C from effective CO2 pressure in bar *)
rTempTau := LN(MAX(rEffectiveCO2VaporP / 73.773, 0.05));
rCalculatedSatTemp := -56.57 + 38.6 * (rEffectiveCO2VaporP - 5.18) / (1.0 + 0.12 * (rEffectiveCO2VaporP - 5.18));
rDegreesSuperheat := rVotedTankTemp - rCalculatedSatTemp;

(* Calculate Derivative Pressure Dynamics (Rate of Depressurization) *)
rRateOfPressureDrop := (rVotedTankPressure - (rState_X_Prior[0] + rP_TankSetpoint)) / MAX(rCycleTimeSec, 0.001);

(*
 * =========================================================================================
 * SECTION 3: STATE-SPACE OBSERVER & MODEL PREDICTIVE PREDICTION
 * =========================================================================================
 *)
(* Calculate Observer Innovation Residuals (Actual Measurement - Predicted Output) *)
rInnovationResidual_P := (rVotedTankPressure - rP_TankSetpoint) - (rMatrix_C[0, 0] * rState_X_Prior[0] + rMatrix_C[0, 3] * rState_X_Prior[3]);
rInnovationResidual_T := (rVotedTankTemp - rCalculatedSatTemp) - (rMatrix_C[1, 2] * rState_X_Prior[2]);

(* State Correction Step: X_hat(k) = X_prior(k) + L * Innovation *)
FOR iRowIdx := 0 TO 3 DO
    rState_X[iRowIdx] := rState_X_Prior[iRowIdx] +
                         (rMatrix_L[iRowIdx, 0] * rInnovationResidual_P) +
                         (rMatrix_L[iRowIdx, 1] * rInnovationResidual_T);
END_FOR;

(* Horizon Projection: Predict Ullage Pressure 30 Seconds Forward *)
(* Fast linear projection based on observed rate of change and thermal capacitance *)
rPredictedPress30s := rVotedTankPressure + (rState_X[1] * 30.0);

(*
 * =========================================================================================
 * SECTION 4: ALARM WORD EVALUATION (ISA-18.2 TAXONOMY)
 * =========================================================================================
 *)
(* Reset Transitory Alarm Bits before Recalculation *)
wAlarmWord := wAlarmWord AND 16#FF00;

(* Bit 0: Pressure Low-Low (Imminent Solidification Barrier Breached) *)
IF rVotedTankPressure <= rP_HARD_MIN_LIMIT THEN
    wAlarmWord := wAlarmWord OR 16#0001;
END_IF;

(* Bit 1: Temperature Low-Low (Cryogenic Freezing Risk) *)
IF rVotedTankTemp <= rT_HARD_MIN_LIMIT THEN
    wAlarmWord := wAlarmWord OR 16#0002;
END_IF;

(* Bit 2: Pressure High (Cargo Ullage Overpressure Warning) *)
IF rVotedTankPressure >= (rP_TankSetpoint + 1.20) THEN
    wAlarmWord := wAlarmWord OR 16#0004;
END_IF;

(* Bit 3: Temperature High (Reliquefaction Capacity Deficit) *)
IF rVotedTankTemp >= (rCalculatedSatTemp + 8.0) THEN
    wAlarmWord := wAlarmWord OR 16#0008;
END_IF;

(* Bit 4 & 5: TMR Discrepancy Enunciation *)
IF bDiscrepancyPress_AB OR bDiscrepancyPress_BC OR bDiscrepancyPress_CA THEN
    wAlarmWord := wAlarmWord OR 16#0010;
END_IF;
IF bDiscrepancyTemp_AB OR bDiscrepancyTemp_BC OR bDiscrepancyTemp_CA THEN
    wAlarmWord := wAlarmWord OR 16#0020;
END_IF;

(* Bit 6: High Inert Gas Accumulation in Tank Ullage *)
IF rIncondensablePpmFilter > 1500.0 THEN
    wAlarmWord := wAlarmWord OR 16#0040;
END_IF;

(* Bit 14: Dangerous Depressurization Gradient (Risk of Cavitation / Flash Dry Ice Formation) *)
IF rRateOfPressureDrop < -0.050 THEN (* Pressure falling faster than 50 mbar/s *)
    wAlarmWord := wAlarmWord OR 16#4000;
END_IF;

(* Bit 15: Trip Solidification Condition *)
IF (rVotedTankPressure <= rP_HARD_MIN_LIMIT) OR (rVotedTankTemp <= rT_HARD_MIN_LIMIT) OR
   (rPredictedPress30s <= rP_TRIPLE_POINT_ABS + 0.15) THEN
    bTripSolidificationRisk := TRUE;
    wAlarmWord := wAlarmWord OR 16#8000;
END_IF;

(*

 * =========================================================================================
 *)
iPrevState := iState;

CASE iState OF
    0: (* STATE 0: INITIALIZATION & INTERLOCK CHECKING *)

(* Handle Fault Reset Command *)
IF bResetFaults THEN
    dwAlarmWord_1               := 16#0000_0000;

(* 2.0 TRIPLE MODULAR REDUNDANCY (2oo3 TMR) SENSOR VOTING ALGORITHMS                    *)
(* ===================================================================================== *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* 2.1 UV-280nm Multi-Channel Absorbance Voting & Drift Screening                        *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* Out-of-Range Screening: Optical Range [-50.0 mAU .. 3500.0 mAU] *)
bUV280_ChA_Healthy := (rUV280_SensA_mAU >= -50.0) AND (rUV280_SensA_mAU <= 3500.0);
bUV280_ChB_Healthy := (rUV280_SensB_mAU >= -50.0) AND (rUV280_SensB_mAU <= 3500.0);
bUV280_ChC_Healthy := (rUV280_SensC_mAU >= -50.0) AND (rUV280_SensC_mAU <= 3500.0);

rDiffUV_AB := ABS(rUV280_SensA_mAU - rUV280_SensB_mAU);
rDiffUV_BC := ABS(rUV280_SensB_mAU - rUV280_SensC_mAU);
rDiffUV_CA := ABS(rUV280_SensC_mAU - rUV280_SensA_mAU);

(* 2oo3 Median Selection when All 3 Channels are Healthy *)
IF bUV280_ChA_Healthy AND bUV280_ChB_Healthy AND bUV280_ChC_Healthy THEN
    bUV280_Degraded_1oo2 := FALSE;
    IF (rUV280_SensA_mAU >= rUV280_SensB_mAU AND rUV280_SensA_mAU <= rUV280_SensC_mAU) OR
       (rUV280_SensA_mAU >= rUV280_SensC_mAU AND rUV280_SensA_mAU <= rUV280_SensB_mAU) THEN
        rVoted_UV280_mAU := rUV280_SensA_mAU;
    ELSIF (rUV280_SensB_mAU >= rUV280_SensA_mAU AND rUV280_SensB_mAU <= rUV280_SensC_mAU) OR
          (rUV280_SensB_mAU >= rUV280_SensC_mAU AND rUV280_SensB_mAU <= rUV280_SensA_mAU) THEN
        rVoted_UV280_mAU := rUV280_SensB_mAU;
    ELSE
        rVoted_UV280_mAU := rUV280_SensC_mAU;
    END_IF;
    (* Cross-Channel Drift Screening: Flag if discrepancy > 75.0 mAU *)
    IF (rDiffUV_AB > 75.0) OR (rDiffUV_BC > 75.0) OR (rDiffUV_CA > 75.0) THEN
        dwAlarmWord_2 := dwAlarmWord_2 OR 16#0000_0001; (* UV Sensor Drift Warning *)
    END_IF;
(* Degraded 1oo2 Voting on Single Channel Failure *)
ELSIF bUV280_ChA_Healthy AND bUV280_ChB_Healthy THEN
    bUV280_Degraded_1oo2 := TRUE;
    rVoted_UV280_mAU     := 0.5 * (rUV280_SensA_mAU + rUV280_SensB_mAU);
    dwAlarmWord_2        := dwAlarmWord_2 OR 16#0000_0002; (* UV Ch C Failed - 1oo2 Degraded *)
ELSIF bUV280_ChB_Healthy AND bUV280_ChC_Healthy THEN
    bUV280_Degraded_1oo2 := TRUE;
    rVoted_UV280_mAU     := 0.5 * (rUV280_SensB_mAU + rUV280_SensC_mAU);
    dwAlarmWord_2        := dwAlarmWord_2 OR 16#0000_0004; (* UV Ch A Failed - 1oo2 Degraded *)
ELSIF bUV280_ChC_Healthy AND bUV280_ChA_Healthy THEN
    bUV280_Degraded_1oo2 := TRUE;
    rVoted_UV280_mAU     := 0.5 * (rUV280_SensC_mAU + rUV280_SensA_mAU);
    dwAlarmWord_2        := dwAlarmWord_2 OR 16#0000_0008; (* UV Ch B Failed - 1oo2 Degraded *)
(* 2 Channels Failed - Emergency Fallback to Short-Path UV-300nm *)
ELSIF bUV280_ChA_Healthy THEN
    rVoted_UV280_mAU     := rUV280_SensA_mAU;
    dwAlarmWord_1        := dwAlarmWord_1 OR 16#0000_0002; (* Critical UV TMR Loss *)
ELSIF bUV280_ChB_Healthy THEN
    rVoted_UV280_mAU     := rUV280_SensB_mAU;
    dwAlarmWord_1        := dwAlarmWord_1 OR 16#0000_0002;
ELSIF bUV280_ChC_Healthy THEN
    rVoted_UV280_mAU     := rUV280_SensC_mAU;
    dwAlarmWord_1        := dwAlarmWord_1 OR 16#0000_0002;
ELSE
    (* Complete Loss of Primary UV-280nm: Synthesize proxy from UV-300nm (Pathlength Factor ~ 4.8) *)
    rVoted_UV280_mAU     := rUV300_Sens_mAU * 4.80;
    dwAlarmWord_1        := dwAlarmWord_1 OR 16#0000_0004; (* Total UV-280 Hardware Failure *)
    bDegradedControlActive := TRUE;
END_IF;

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* 2.2 Pre-Column Inlet Hydraulic Pressure Transducer 2oo3 Voting                        *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
bPress_ChA_Healthy := (rPressPreCol_SensA_bar >= -0.2) AND (rPressPreCol_SensA_bar <= 8.0);
bPress_ChB_Healthy := (rPressPreCol_SensB_bar >= -0.2) AND (rPressPreCol_SensB_bar <= 8.0);
bPress_ChC_Healthy := (rPressPreCol_SensC_bar >= -0.2) AND (rPressPreCol_SensC_bar <= 8.0);

rDiffPress_AB := ABS(rPressPreCol_SensA_bar - rPressPreCol_SensB_bar);
rDiffPress_BC := ABS(rPressPreCol_SensB_bar - rPressPreCol_SensC_bar);
rDiffPress_CA := ABS(rPressPreCol_SensC_bar - rPressPreCol_SensA_bar);

IF bPress_ChA_Healthy AND bPress_ChB_Healthy AND bPress_ChC_Healthy THEN
    bPress_Degraded_1oo2 := FALSE;
    IF (rPressPreCol_SensA_bar >= rPressPreCol_SensB_bar AND rPressPreCol_SensA_bar <= rPressPreCol_SensC_bar) OR
       (rPressPreCol_SensA_bar >= rPressPreCol_SensC_bar AND rPressPreCol_SensA_bar <= rPressPreCol_SensB_bar) THEN
        rVoted_PressPreCol_bar := rPressPreCol_SensA_bar;
    ELSIF (rPressPreCol_SensB_bar >= rPressPreCol_SensA_bar AND rPressPreCol_SensB_bar <= rPressPreCol_SensC_bar) OR
          (rPressPreCol_SensB_bar >= rPressPreCol_SensC_bar AND rPressPreCol_SensB_bar <= rPressPreCol_SensA_bar) THEN
        rVoted_PressPreCol_bar := rPressPreCol_SensB_bar;
    ELSE
        rVoted_PressPreCol_bar := rPressPreCol_SensC_bar;
    END_IF;
    IF (rDiffPress_AB > 0.45) OR (rDiffPress_BC > 0.45) OR (rDiffPress_CA > 0.45) THEN
        dwAlarmWord_2 := dwAlarmWord_2 OR 16#0000_0010; (* Pressure Sensor Discrepancy Warning *)
    END_IF;
ELSIF bPress_ChA_Healthy AND bPress_ChB_Healthy THEN
    bPress_Degraded_1oo2   := TRUE;
    rVoted_PressPreCol_bar := 0.5 * (rPressPreCol_SensA_bar + rPressPreCol_SensB_bar);
    dwAlarmWord_2          := dwAlarmWord_2 OR 16#0000_0020; (* Press Ch C Failed - 1oo2 Degraded *)
ELSIF bPress_ChB_Healthy AND bPress_ChC_Healthy THEN
    bPress_Degraded_1oo2   := TRUE;
    rVoted_PressPreCol_bar := 0.5 * (rPressPreCol_SensB_bar + rPressPreCol_SensC_bar);
    dwAlarmWord_2          := dwAlarmWord_2 OR 16#0000_0040; (* Press Ch A Failed - 1oo2 Degraded *)
ELSIF bPress_ChC_Healthy AND bPress_ChA_Healthy THEN
    bPress_Degraded_1oo2   := TRUE;
    rVoted_PressPreCol_bar := 0.5 * (rPressPreCol_SensC_bar + rPressPreCol_SensA_bar);
    dwAlarmWord_2          := dwAlarmWord_2 OR 16#0000_0080; (* Press Ch B Failed - 1oo2 Degraded *)
ELSE
    (* Multiple Pressure Sensors Offline - Default to maximum surviving or trip *)
    IF bPress_ChA_Healthy THEN rVoted_PressPreCol_bar := rPressPreCol_SensA_bar;
    ELSIF bPress_ChB_Healthy THEN rVoted_PressPreCol_bar := rPressPreCol_SensB_bar;
    ELSIF bPress_ChC_Healthy THEN rVoted_PressPreCol_bar := rPressPreCol_SensC_bar;
    ELSE rVoted_PressPreCol_bar := 6.0; (* Fail-safe artificial high pressure *)
    END_IF;
    dwAlarmWord_1          := dwAlarmWord_1 OR 16#0000_0008; (* Critical Pressure TMR Loss *)
END_IF;

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* 2.3 Elution In-Line Conductivity Transducer 2oo3 Voting                               *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
bCond_ChA_Healthy := (rCond_SensA_mScm >= 0.0) AND (rCond_SensA_mScm <= 150.0);
bCond_ChB_Healthy := (rCond_SensB_mScm >= 0.0) AND (rCond_SensB_mScm <= 150.0);
bCond_ChC_Healthy := (rCond_SensC_mScm >= 0.0) AND (rCond_SensC_mScm <= 150.0);

rDiffCond_AB := ABS(rCond_SensA_mScm - rCond_SensB_mScm);
rDiffCond_BC := ABS(rCond_SensB_mScm - rCond_SensC_mScm);
rDiffCond_CA := ABS(rCond_SensC_mScm - rCond_SensA_mScm);

IF bCond_ChA_Healthy AND bCond_ChB_Healthy AND bCond_ChC_Healthy THEN
    bCond_Degraded_1oo2 := FALSE;
    IF (rCond_SensA_mScm >= rCond_SensB_mScm AND rCond_SensA_mScm <= rCond_SensC_mScm) OR
       (rCond_SensA_mScm >= rCond_SensC_mScm AND rCond_SensA_mScm <= rCond_SensB_mScm) THEN
        rVoted_Cond_mScm := rCond_SensA_mScm;
    ELSIF (rCond_SensB_mScm >= rCond_SensA_mScm AND rCond_SensB_mScm <= rCond_SensC_mScm) OR
          (rCond_SensB_mScm >= rCond_SensC_mScm AND rCond_SensB_mScm <= rCond_SensA_mScm) THEN
        rVoted_Cond_mScm := rCond_SensB_mScm;
    ELSE
        rVoted_Cond_mScm := rCond_SensC_mScm;
    END_IF;
    IF (rDiffCond_AB > 3.5) OR (rDiffCond_BC > 3.5) OR (rDiffCond_CA > 3.5) THEN
        dwAlarmWord_2 := dwAlarmWord_2 OR 16#0000_0100; (* Conductivity Drift Warning *)
    END_IF;
ELSIF bCond_ChA_Healthy AND bCond_ChB_Healthy THEN
    bCond_Degraded_1oo2 := TRUE;
    rVoted_Cond_mScm    := 0.5 * (rCond_SensA_mScm + rCond_SensB_mScm);
    dwAlarmWord_2       := dwAlarmWord_2 OR 16#0000_0200; (* Cond Ch C Failed - 1oo2 Degraded *)
ELSIF bCond_ChB_Healthy AND bCond_ChC_Healthy THEN
    bCond_Degraded_1oo2 := TRUE;
    rVoted_Cond_mScm    := 0.5 * (rCond_SensB_mScm + rCond_SensC_mScm);
    dwAlarmWord_2       := dwAlarmWord_2 OR 16#0000_0400; (* Cond Ch A Failed - 1oo2 Degraded *)
ELSIF bCond_ChC_Healthy AND bCond_ChA_Healthy THEN
    bCond_Degraded_1oo2 := TRUE;
    rVoted_Cond_mScm    := 0.5 * (rCond_SensC_mScm + rCond_SensA_mScm);
    dwAlarmWord_2       := dwAlarmWord_2 OR 16#0000_0800; (* Cond Ch B Failed - 1oo2 Degraded *)
ELSE
    IF bCond_ChA_Healthy THEN rVoted_Cond_mScm := rCond_SensA_mScm;
    ELSIF bCond_ChB_Healthy THEN rVoted_Cond_mScm := rCond_SensB_mScm;
    ELSE rVoted_Cond_mScm := rCond_SensC_mScm;
    END_IF;
    dwAlarmWord_1       := dwAlarmWord_1 OR 16#0000_0010; (* Critical Conductivity TMR Loss *)
END_IF;

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* 2.4 Feed Coriolis Flow Rate Median Selector                                          *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
IF (rFeedFlow_SensA_mLmin >= rFeedFlow_SensB_mLmin AND rFeedFlow_SensA_mLmin <= rFeedFlow_SensC_mLmin) OR
   (rFeedFlow_SensA_mLmin >= rFeedFlow_SensC_mLmin AND rFeedFlow_SensA_mLmin <= rFeedFlow_SensB_mLmin) THEN
    rVoted_FeedFlow_mLmin := rFeedFlow_SensA_mLmin;
ELSIF (rFeedFlow_SensB_mLmin >= rFeedFlow_SensA_mLmin AND rFeedFlow_SensB_mLmin <= rFeedFlow_SensC_mLmin) OR
      (rFeedFlow_SensB_mLmin >= rFeedFlow_SensC_mLmin AND rFeedFlow_SensB_mLmin <= rFeedFlow_SensA_mLmin) THEN
    rVoted_FeedFlow_mLmin := rFeedFlow_SensB_mLmin;
ELSE
    rVoted_FeedFlow_mLmin := rFeedFlow_SensC_mLmin;
END_IF;

(* ===================================================================================== *)
(* 3.0 DIGITAL EXPONENTIAL FILTERING & PROCESS HYDRAULIC MODELING                       *)
(* ===================================================================================== *)
(* 1st-Order Recursive Exponential Smoothing *)
rFilteredFeedFlow_mLmin   := (rFilterAlpha_Flow * rVoted_FeedFlow_mLmin) + ((1.0 - rFilterAlpha_Flow) * rFilteredFeedFlow_mLmin);
rFilteredEluentFlow_mLmin := (rFilterAlpha_Flow * rEluentFlow_Sens_mLmin) + ((1.0 - rFilterAlpha_Flow) * rFilteredEluentFlow_mLmin);
rFilteredWashFlow_mLmin   := (rFilterAlpha_Flow * rWashFlow_Sens_mLmin) + ((1.0 - rFilterAlpha_Flow) * rFilteredWashFlow_mLmin);
rFilteredCIPFlow_mLmin    := (rFilterAlpha_Flow * rCIPFlow_Sens_mLmin) + ((1.0 - rFilterAlpha_Flow) * rFilteredCIPFlow_mLmin);
rFilteredPressPreCol_bar  := (rFilterAlpha_Press * rVoted_PressPreCol_bar) + ((1.0 - rFilterAlpha_Press) * rFilteredPressPreCol_bar);
rFilteredPressPostCol_bar := (rFilterAlpha_Press * rPressPostCol_bar) + ((1.0 - rFilterAlpha_Press) * rFilteredPressPostCol_bar);
rFilteredUV280_mAU        := (rFilterAlpha_UV * rVoted_UV280_mAU) + ((1.0 - rFilterAlpha_UV) * rFilteredUV280_mAU);
rFilteredUV254_mAU        := (rFilterAlpha_UV * rUV254_Sens_mAU) + ((1.0 - rFilterAlpha_UV) * rFilteredUV254_mAU);
rFilteredUV300_mAU        := (rFilterAlpha_UV * rUV300_Sens_mAU) + ((1.0 - rFilterAlpha_UV) * rFilteredUV300_mAU);
rFilteredCond_mScm        := (rFilterAlpha_Cond * rVoted_Cond_mScm) + ((1.0 - rFilterAlpha_Cond) * rFilteredCond_mScm);
rFilteredAmbientTemp_degC := (0.05 * rAmbientTemp_degC) + (0.95 * rFilteredAmbientTemp_degC);

(* Column Differential Hydraulic Pressure *)
rColumnDeltaP_bar := rFilteredPressPreCol_bar - rFilteredPressPostCol_bar;
IF rColumnDeltaP_bar < 0.0 THEN
    rColumnDeltaP_bar := 0.0; (* Negative delta-P clamp *)
END_IF;

(* Column Dimensional Geometry & Fluid Velocity Computations *)
IF rColumnDiameter_mm < 5.0 THEN rColumnDiameter_mm := 26.0; END_IF; (* Standard 26 mm ID default *)
IF rResinBedHeight_mm < 20.0 THEN rResinBedHeight_mm := 100.0; END_IF; (* Standard 100 mm bed length *)

(* Area = pi * (D/2)^2 in cm^2: D in mm -> radius in cm = (D / 20.0) *)
rColumnCrossSection_cm2 := 3.14159265 * (rColumnDiameter_mm / 20.0) * (rColumnDiameter_mm / 20.0);
rColumnVolume_CV_mL     := rColumnCrossSection_cm2 * (rResinBedHeight_mm / 10.0);
rTotalCarouselVolume_mL := rColumnVolume_CV_mL * 8.0;
rSafetyFrontLimit_mm    := 0.85 * rResinBedHeight_mm; (* 85% bed length threshold *)

(* Linear Superfacial & Interstitial Velocity [cm/hour] *)
IF rColumnCrossSection_cm2 > 0.1 THEN
    (* Flow in mL/min = cm^3/min -> cm^3/h = Flow * 60.0. Linear velocity u_s = Flow*60 / Area *)
    rInterstitialVelocity_cm_h := (rFilteredFeedFlow_mLmin * 60.0) / (rColumnCrossSection_cm2 * rResinBedPorosity_eps_b);
ELSE
    rInterstitialVelocity_cm_h := 0.0;
END_IF;

(* Darcy / Blake-Kozeny Differential Pressure Formulation *)
(* Delta_P = 150 * mu * u * L * (1 - eps_b)^2 / (dp^2 * eps_b^3) *)
(* Fluid viscosity temperature correction: mu(T) = mu_20 * exp(-0.023 * (T - 20)) *)
rFluidViscosity_mPas := 1.002 * EXP(-0.023 * (rFilteredAmbientTemp_degC - 20.0));
IF rFluidViscosity_mPas < 0.5 THEN rFluidViscosity_mPas := 0.5; END_IF;

rBlakeKozenyDeltaP_bar := (150.0 * (rFluidViscosity_mPas * 1.0E-3) * ((rInterstitialVelocity_cm_h / 3600.0) * 1.0E-2) *
                           (rResinBedHeight_mm * 1.0E-3) * ((1.0 - rResinBedPorosity_eps_b) * (1.0 - rResinBedPorosity_eps_b))) /
                          ((85.0E-6 * 85.0E-6) * (rResinBedPorosity_eps_b * rResinBedPorosity_eps_b * rResinBedPorosity_eps_b) * 1.0E5);

(* Bed Compaction Loss & Fouling Hysteresis Tracking *)
IF rBlakeKozenyDeltaP_bar > 0.05 THEN
    rResinBedCompressionFactor := rColumnDeltaP_bar / rBlakeKozenyDeltaP_bar;
    IF rResinBedCompressionFactor > 2.25 THEN
        bBedCompactionWarning := TRUE;
        dwAlarmWord_3 := dwAlarmWord_3 OR 16#0000_0001; (* Bed Compaction / Permeability Loss *)
    ELSE
        bBedCompactionWarning := FALSE;
    END_IF;
END_IF;

(* Critical Hydraulic Pressure Trips *)
tonOverpressureTrip(IN := (rColumnDeltaP_bar >= 4.80) OR (rFilteredPressPreCol_bar >= 5.50), PT := T#1500MS);
IF tonOverpressureTrip.Q THEN
    dwAlarmWord_1 := dwAlarmWord_1 OR 16#0000_0020; (* Column Overpressure Burst Protection Trip *)
    iState := 99; (* EMERGENCY SHUTDOWN *)
END_IF;

(* Air Bubble Ultrasonic Trip Debounce *)
tonBubbleDebounce(IN := bAirBubbleDetected, PT := T#250MS);
IF tonBubbleDebounce.Q THEN
    dwAlarmWord_3 := dwAlarmWord_3 OR 16#0000_0002; (* Air Bubble In Feed Line Trip *)
    iState := 99; (* Halt Immediately to Prevent Resin Bed Dewetting *)
END_IF;

(* ===================================================================================== *)
(* 4.0 THOMAS KINETIC ADSORPTION & RESIN BINDING CAPACITY FRONT TRACKING                 *)
(* ===================================================================================== *)
(* Integrate Feed Mass onto Lead Column during Active Capture (State 40) *)
IF (iState = 40) AND (rFilteredFeedFlow_mLmin > 0.5) AND (rFeedTiter_mg_mL > 0.01) THEN
    (* dVol = Flow [mL/min] * (dt [ms] / 60000.0) [min] *)
    rCumulativeFeedVolume_mL := rCumulativeFeedVolume_mL + (rFilteredFeedFlow_mLmin * (tScanCycleTime_ms / 60000.0));
    rCumulativeMassLoaded_mg := rCumulativeFeedVolume_mL * rFeedTiter_mg_mL;
END_IF;

(* Total Column Equilibrium Static Binding Capacity [mg] *)
(* Q_max_column = q_0 [mg/mL] * ColumnVolume [mL] *)
rResinRemainingCapacity_mg := (rResinStaticCapacity_q0_mg_mL * rColumnVolume_CV_mL) - rCumulativeMassLoaded_mg;
IF rResinRemainingCapacity_mg < 0.0 THEN
    rResinRemainingCapacity_mg := 0.0;
END_IF;

(* Lead Column Remaining Capacity Percentage [%] *)
IF (rResinStaticCapacity_q0_mg_mL * rColumnVolume_CV_mL) > 1.0 THEN
    rResinBindingCapacityRem_pct := (rResinRemainingCapacity_mg / (rResinStaticCapacity_q0_mg_mL * rColumnVolume_CV_mL)) * 100.0;
ELSE
    rResinBindingCapacityRem_pct := 0.0;
END_IF;

(* Thomas Kinetic Non-Linear Breakthrough Model Equation:                                 *)
(*   Arg = (k_Th / Q_feed) * (q_0 * V_col - C_0 * V_feed)                                 *)
(*   C/C0 = 1.0 / (1.0 + exp(Arg))                                                       *)
IF (rFilteredFeedFlow_mLmin > 1.0) AND (rFeedTiter_mg_mL > 0.05) THEN
    VAR_TEMP
        rThomasArg : REAL;
    END_VAR
    rThomasArg := (rThomasRateConst_kTh / rFilteredFeedFlow_mLmin) *
                  ((rResinStaticCapacity_q0_mg_mL * rColumnVolume_CV_mL) - (rFeedTiter_mg_mL * rCumulativeFeedVolume_mL));
    (* Numerical clamp on exponential argument to prevent floating-point overflow *)
    IF rThomasArg > 35.0 THEN rThomasArg := 35.0; END_IF;
    IF rThomasArg < -35.0 THEN rThomasArg := -35.0; END_IF;
    rInstantaneousC_over_C0 := 1.0 / (1.0 + EXP(rThomasArg));
ELSE
    rInstantaneousC_over_C0 := 0.0;
END_IF;

(* Estimate Breakthrough Front Axial Location z_f [mm] *)
(* When C/C0 reaches 0.5, front is centered at L/2. Normalized progression: *)
IF (rResinStaticCapacity_q0_mg_mL * rColumnVolume_CV_mL) > 0.1 THEN
    rBreakthroughFront_mm := rResinBedHeight_mm * (rCumulativeMassLoaded_mg / (rResinStaticCapacity_q0_mg_mL * rColumnVolume_CV_mL));
ELSE
    rBreakthroughFront_mm := 0.0;
END_IF;
IF rBreakthroughFront_mm > rResinBedHeight_mm THEN
    rBreakthroughFront_mm := rResinBedHeight_mm;
END_IF;
rBindingFrontPosition_mm := rBreakthroughFront_mm;

(* Safety Breakthrough Warning when front penetrates beyond 85% of Bed Depth *)
IF rBindingFrontPosition_mm >= rSafetyFrontLimit_mm THEN
    dwAlarmWord_2 := dwAlarmWord_2 OR 16#0000_1000; (* Dynamic Binding Front Overrun Warning *)
END_IF;

(* ===================================================================================== *)
(* 5.0 UV-280nm PEAK DECONVOLUTION & REAL-TIME MOMENTS ADAPTIVE ZONE SHIFTING            *)
(* ===================================================================================== *)
(* Compute Numerical Time Derivatives of Voted UV-280nm Absorbance *)
(* dt in seconds = tScanCycleTime_ms / 1000.0 *)
IF tScanCycleTime_ms > 0.1 THEN
    rdUV_dt   := (rFilteredUV280_mAU - rUV280_Prev1_mAU) / (tScanCycleTime_ms / 1000.0);
    rd2UV_dt2 := (rdUV_dt - ((rUV280_Prev1_mAU - rUV280_Prev2_mAU) / (tScanCycleTime_ms / 1000.0))) / (tScanCycleTime_ms / 1000.0);
END_IF;
rUV280_Prev2_mAU := rUV280_Prev1_mAU;
rUV280_Prev1_mAU := rFilteredUV280_mAU;

(* Low-pass filter derivatives to eliminate optical vibration noise *)
rdUV_dt_Filtered   := (0.25 * rdUV_dt) + (0.75 * rdUV_dt_Filtered);
rd2UV_dt2_Filtered := (0.20 * rd2UV_dt2) + (0.80 * rd2UV_dt2_Filtered);

(* Running Baseline Tracking outside elution window *)
IF (NOT bPeakActiveWindow) AND (rFilteredUV280_mAU < 60.0) THEN
    rUV_Baseline_mAU := (0.01 * rFilteredUV280_mAU) + (0.99 * rUV_Baseline_mAU);
END_IF;

(* Chromatographic Peak Onset Detection Logic *)
IF (NOT bPeakActiveWindow) AND (rFilteredUV280_mAU > (rUV_Baseline_mAU + 25.0)) AND (rdUV_dt_Filtered > rSlopeStartThreshold) THEN
    bPeakActiveWindow           := TRUE;
    rPeakStartTime_s            := rCycleTimer_s;
    rPeakApex_mAU               := rFilteredUV280_mAU;
    rPeakArea_Total_mAU_s       := 0.0;
    rPeakFirstMoment_Num        := 0.0;
    rPeakSecondMoment_Num       := 0.0;
    rHeartCutMonomerArea_mAU_s  := 0.0;
END_IF;

(* Active Peak Integration & Statistical Moment Accumulation *)
IF bPeakActiveWindow THEN
    VAR_TEMP
        rScanDt_s : REAL;
        rNetUV    : REAL;
    END_VAR
    rScanDt_s := tScanCycleTime_ms / 1000.0;
    rNetUV    := rFilteredUV280_mAU - rUV_Baseline_mAU;
    IF rNetUV < 0.0 THEN rNetUV := 0.0; END_IF;

    (* Peak Apex Tracking *)
    IF rFilteredUV280_mAU > rPeakApex_mAU THEN
        rPeakApex_mAU := rFilteredUV280_mAU;
    END_IF;

    (* Trapezoidal Integration of Zeroth, First, and Second Moments *)
    rPeakArea_Total_mAU_s := rPeakArea_Total_mAU_s + (rNetUV * rScanDt_s);
    rPeakFirstMoment_Num  := rPeakFirstMoment_Num + (rCycleTimer_s * rNetUV * rScanDt_s);

    (* Real-Time Peak Centroid mu [s] *)
    IF rPeakArea_Total_mAU_s > 1.0 THEN
        rPeakMeanCentroid_s := rPeakFirstMoment_Num / rPeakArea_Total_mAU_s;
    END_IF;

    (* Dynamic Cut-Point Identification for Center-Cut Monomer Harvest *)
    (* High-Molecular Weight Aggregates (HMWS) elute on leading edge: cut after positive inflection *)
    rAggregateLeadingCut_s := rPeakStartTime_s + 22.0;
    (* Low-Molecular Weight Fragments (LMWS) elute on tail: cut before baseline return *)
    rFragmentTrailingCut_s := rPeakMeanCentroid_s + 45.0;

    (* Diverter Valve Control: Collect Pure Heart-Cut Monomer *)
    IF (rCycleTimer_s >= rAggregateLeadingCut_s) AND (rCycleTimer_s <= rFragmentTrailingCut_s) AND
       (rFilteredUV280_mAU >= 120.0) AND (rFilteredUV254_mAU / (rFilteredUV280_mAU + 0.01) < 0.65) THEN
        bActiveElutionCut := TRUE;  (* Route to Target mAb Bulk Harvest Tank *)
        bActiveRecycleCut := FALSE;
        rHeartCutMonomerArea_mAU_s := rHeartCutMonomerArea_mAU_s + (rNetUV * rScanDt_s);
    ELSIF (rFilteredUV280_mAU >= 65.0) THEN
        bActiveElutionCut := FALSE;
        bActiveRecycleCut := TRUE;  (* Recycle Front/Tail Cuts Back into MCSGP Zone II *)
    ELSE
        bActiveElutionCut := FALSE;
        bActiveRecycleCut := FALSE; (* Route Solvent Waste to Raffinate Header *)
    END_IF;

    (* Peak Termination Condition: Fall below threshold with negative slope *)
    IF (rCycleTimer_s > (rPeakStartTime_s + 40.0)) AND
       ((rFilteredUV280_mAU <= (rUV_Baseline_mAU + 20.0)) OR (rCycleTimer_s >= rCycleStepTimeSetpt_s - 10.0)) THEN
        bPeakActiveWindow   := FALSE;
        rPeakEndTime_s      := rCycleTimer_s;
        rPeakDuration_s     := rPeakEndTime_s - rPeakStartTime_s;
        bActiveElutionCut   := FALSE;
        bActiveRecycleCut   := FALSE;

        (* Deconvoluted Main Peak Monomer Fraction Percentage *)
        IF rPeakArea_Total_mAU_s > 5.0 THEN
            rDeconvolutedMonomerFrac_pct := (rHeartCutMonomerArea_mAU_s / rPeakArea_Total_mAU_s) * 100.0;
        ELSE
            rDeconvolutedMonomerFrac_pct := 95.0; (* Default assumption *)
        END_IF;
    END_IF;
ELSE
    bActiveElutionCut := FALSE;
    bActiveRecycleCut := FALSE;
END_IF;

(* Compute Peak Retention Centroid Error & Export Metrics *)
rPeakCentroidTime_s := rPeakMeanCentroid_s;
rCentroidError_s    := rPeakMeanCentroid_s - rTargetElutionCentroid_s;

(* Adaptive Rotary Step-Time Correction: Shift switching interval to re-center elution window *)

x3_Next := (Ad_31 * x1_FrontPosErr_mm) + (Ad_32 * x2_CentroidErr_s) + (Ad_33 * x3_DeltaPressErr_bar) +
           (Ad_34 * x4_CondErr_mScm) + (Ad_35 * x5_PurityErr_pct) + (Ad_36 * x6_AngleErr_deg);

x4_Next := (Ad_41 * x1_FrontPosErr_mm) + (Ad_42 * x2_CentroidErr_s) + (Ad_43 * x3_DeltaPressErr_bar) +

           (Ad_64 * x4_CondErr_mScm) + (Ad_65 * x5_PurityErr_pct) + (Ad_66 * x6_AngleErr_deg);

(* Real-Time Quadratic Cost Function Hessian Elements: H = Bd^T * Q * Bd + R *)
rHess_11 := (Bd_11 * Bd_11 * rMPC_Weight_FrontPos) + (Bd_21 * Bd_21 * rMPC_Weight_Centroid) +
            (Bd_31 * Bd_31 * rMPC_Weight_DeltaP)   + (Bd_51 * Bd_51 * rMPC_Weight_Purity) + rMPC_Weight_dFeedFlow;

rHess_22 := (Bd_12 * Bd_12 * rMPC_Weight_FrontPos) + (Bd_22 * Bd_22 * rMPC_Weight_Centroid) +
            (Bd_32 * Bd_32 * rMPC_Weight_DeltaP)   + (Bd_52 * Bd_52 * rMPC_Weight_Purity) + rMPC_Weight_dEluFlow;

rHess_33 := (Bd_13 * Bd_13 * rMPC_Weight_FrontPos) + (Bd_23 * Bd_23 * rMPC_Weight_Centroid) +
            (Bd_33 * Bd_33 * rMPC_Weight_DeltaP)   + (Bd_53 * Bd_53 * rMPC_Weight_Purity) + rMPC_Weight_dStepTime;

rHess_44 := (Bd_14 * Bd_14 * rMPC_Weight_FrontPos) + (Bd_24 * Bd_24 * rMPC_Weight_Centroid) +
            (Bd_44 * Bd_44 * rMPC_Weight_Conductivity) + (Bd_54 * Bd_54 * rMPC_Weight_Purity) + rMPC_Weight_dBufferB;

rHess_12 := (Bd_11 * Bd_12 * rMPC_Weight_FrontPos) + (Bd_21 * Bd_22 * rMPC_Weight_Centroid) +
            (Bd_31 * Bd_32 * rMPC_Weight_DeltaP)   + (Bd_51 * Bd_52 * rMPC_Weight_Purity);
rHess_21 := rHess_12;

rHess_13 := (Bd_11 * Bd_13 * rMPC_Weight_FrontPos) + (Bd_21 * Bd_23 * rMPC_Weight_Centroid) +
            (Bd_31 * Bd_33 * rMPC_Weight_DeltaP)   + (Bd_51 * Bd_53 * rMPC_Weight_Purity);
rHess_31 := rHess_13;

rHess_23 := (Bd_12 * Bd_13 * rMPC_Weight_FrontPos) + (Bd_22 * Bd_23 * rMPC_Weight_Centroid) +
            (Bd_32 * Bd_33 * rMPC_Weight_DeltaP)   + (Bd_52 * Bd_53 * rMPC_Weight_Purity);
rHess_32 := rHess_23;

rHess_24 := (Bd_22 * Bd_24 * rMPC_Weight_Centroid) + (Bd_52 * Bd_54 * rMPC_Weight_Purity);
rHess_42 := rHess_24;

(* Compute Cost Gradients: g = Bd^T * Q * x_Next *)
rGrad_1 := (Bd_11 * rMPC_Weight_FrontPos * x1_Next) + (Bd_21 * rMPC_Weight_Centroid * x2_Next) +
           (Bd_31 * rMPC_Weight_DeltaP * x3_Next)   + (Bd_51 * rMPC_Weight_Purity * x5_Next);

rGrad_2 := (Bd_12 * rMPC_Weight_FrontPos * x1_Next) + (Bd_22 * rMPC_Weight_Centroid * x2_Next) +
           (Bd_32 * rMPC_Weight_DeltaP * x3_Next)   + (Bd_52 * rMPC_Weight_Purity * x5_Next);

rGrad_3 := (Bd_13 * rMPC_Weight_FrontPos * x1_Next) + (Bd_23 * rMPC_Weight_Centroid * x2_Next) +
           (Bd_33 * rMPC_Weight_DeltaP * x3_Next)   + (Bd_53 * rMPC_Weight_Purity * x5_Next);

rGrad_4 := (Bd_24 * rMPC_Weight_Centroid * x2_Next) + (Bd_44 * rMPC_Weight_Conductivity * x4_Next) +
           (Bd_54 * rMPC_Weight_Purity * x5_Next);

    rBarrierSlackPressure := (rColumnDeltaP_bar - 3.80) * 45.0;
    rGrad_1 := rGrad_1 + (rBarrierSlackPressure * 0.85); (* Strong feed throttle *)
    rGrad_2 := rGrad_2 + (rBarrierSlackPressure * 0.50); (* Eluent throttle *)
END_IF;

IF rBindingFrontPosition_mm > (0.75 * rResinBedHeight_mm) THEN
    rBarrierSlackFront := (rBindingFrontPosition_mm - (0.75 * rResinBedHeight_mm)) * 30.0;
    rGrad_1 := rGrad_1 + rBarrierSlackFront; (* Reduce feed loading *)

END_IF;

    rDelta_u2_EluentFlow := - (rGrad_2 / rHess_22) * rMPCStepSize;

ELSE
    bMPC_IllConditioned := TRUE;

    rDelta_u2_EluentFlow := 0.0;
    rDelta_u3_StepTime   := 0.0;

END_IF;

IF rDelta_u1_FeedFlow > 3.0 THEN rDelta_u1_FeedFlow := 3.0; END_IF;
IF rDelta_u1_FeedFlow < -3.0 THEN rDelta_u1_FeedFlow := -3.0; END_IF;

tonValveStallTimer(IN := bValveInMotion, PT := T#6000MS);
IF tonValveStallTimer.Q THEN

END_IF;

CASE iValveStepSubState OF
    0: (* DORMANT: Waiting for Step-Timer Expiration *)
        bValveInMotion          := FALSE;
