    rMat_Bd_00                      : REAL := 0.0000000035714; (* 0.5 * dt^2 / Mass *)
    rMat_Bd_01                      : REAL := -0.0000000035714;
    rMat_Bd_10                      : REAL := 0.0000142857;    (* dt / Mass *)
    rMat_Bd_11                      : REAL := -0.0000142857;
    rMat_Bd_20                      : REAL := 0.0285714;       (* 1.0 / Mass *)
    rMat_Bd_21                      : REAL := -0.0285714;
    rMat_Bd_30                      : REAL := 0.0;
    rMat_Bd_31                      : REAL := 0.0;

    (* Measurement Matrix C_d [3x4] *)
    rMat_Cd_00                      : REAL := 1.0;
    rMat_Cd_01                      : REAL := 0.0;
    rMat_Cd_02                      : REAL := 0.0;
    rMat_Cd_03                      : REAL := 0.0;
    rMat_Cd_10                      : REAL := 1.0;
    rMat_Cd_11                      : REAL := 0.0;
    rMat_Cd_12                      : REAL := 0.0;
    rMat_Cd_13                      : REAL := 0.0;
    rMat_Cd_20                      : REAL := 1.0;
    rMat_Cd_21                      : REAL := 0.0;
    rMat_Cd_22                      : REAL := 0.0;
    rMat_Cd_23                      : REAL := 0.0;

    (* Observer Gain Matrix L_d [4x3] (Sub-millimeter tracking tuning) *)
    rMat_Ld_00                      : REAL := 0.2850;
    rMat_Ld_01                      : REAL := 0.1250;
    rMat_Ld_02                      : REAL := 0.0900;
    rMat_Ld_10                      : REAL := 12.500;
    rMat_Ld_11                      : REAL := 5.8000;
    rMat_Ld_12                      : REAL := 4.2000;
    rMat_Ld_20                      : REAL := 45.000;
    rMat_Ld_21                      : REAL := 22.000;
    rMat_Ld_22                      : REAL := 18.000;
    rMat_Ld_30                      : REAL := 85.000;
    rMat_Ld_31                      : REAL := 42.000;
    rMat_Ld_32                      : REAL := 35.000;

    (* Observer Internal State Estimates *)
    rObs_Pos_m                      : REAL := 0.0;      (* Estimated absolute longitudinal position [m] *)
    rObs_Vel_ms                     : REAL := 0.0;      (* Estimated longitudinal velocity [m/s] *)
    rObs_Accel_ms2                  : REAL := 0.0;      (* Estimated vehicle acceleration [m/s2] *)
    rObs_DisturbanceForce_kN        : REAL := 0.0;      (* Estimated external drag/parasitic force [kN] *)
    rIntegrated_Laser_Pos_m         : REAL := 0.0;      (* Raw integrated laser position accumulator [m] *)
    rIntegrated_Radar_Pos_m         : REAL := 0.0;      (* Raw integrated radar position accumulator [m] *)
    rIntegrated_Grating_Pos_m       : REAL := 0.0;      (* Raw integrated grating position accumulator [m] *)

    (* ============================================================================================
       DYNAMIC AERODYNAMIC NORMAL-FORCE NULLING MODEL
       ============================================================================================ *)
    rAirDensity_Ambient_kgm3        : REAL := 0.085;    (* Dynamic calculated tube air density [kg/m3] *)
    rMachNumber                     : REAL := 0.0;      (* Vehicle instantaneous Mach number [-] *)
    rDynamicPressure_q_kPa          : REAL := 0.0;      (* Calculated freestream dynamic pressure [kPa] *)
    rEstimated_Aerodynamic_Lift_kN  : REAL := 0.0;      (* Estimated aerodynamic ground-effect lift [kN] *)
    rAerodynamic_PitchMoment_kNm    : REAL := 0.0;      (* Dynamic pitching moment on magnet chassis [kNm] *)
    rAirGap_Regulator_P_Gain        : REAL := 125.0;    (* Proportional gain for air-gap nulling [kA/m] *)
    rAirGap_Regulator_I_Gain        : REAL := 35.0;     (* Integral gain for air-gap nulling [kA/(m*s)] *)
    rAirGap_Regulator_D_Gain        : REAL := 4.5;      (* Derivative gain for damping air-gap [kA*s/m] *)
    rAirGap_Integral_Accumulator    : REAL := 0.0;      (* Anti-windup air-gap integrator state [kA] *)
    rAirGap_Error_Previous_mm       : REAL := 0.0;      (* Previous cycle air-gap error [mm] *)
    rCompensating_Id_Bias_kA        : REAL := 0.0;      (* Injected d-axis normal force nulling current [kA] *)

    (* ============================================================================================
       MODEL PREDICTIVE CONTROL (MPC) QUADRATIC COST SOLVER
       Minimization of: J = 0.5 * Delta_U^T * H * Delta_U + g^T * Delta_U
       Controls: U = [I_d_cmd, I_q_cmd]^T
       ============================================================================================ *)
    rMPC_Hessian_00                 : REAL := 145.0;    (* H(1,1): d-axis current variance weight *)
    rMPC_Hessian_01                 : REAL := 12.5;     (* H(1,2): cross-coupling d-q weight *)
    rMPC_Hessian_10                 : REAL := 12.5;     (* H(2,1): cross-coupling q-d weight *)
    rMPC_Hessian_11                 : REAL := 220.0;    (* H(2,2): q-axis thrust tracking weight *)
    rMPC_Gradient_0                 : REAL := 0.0;      (* Linear cost gradient g(1) for d-axis *)
    rMPC_Gradient_1                 : REAL := 0.0;      (* Linear cost gradient g(2) for q-axis *)
    rMPC_Delta_Id_Opt               : REAL := 0.0;      (* Optimal computed d-axis current step [kA] *)
    rMPC_Delta_Iq_Opt               : REAL := 0.0;      (* Optimal computed q-axis current step [kA] *)
    rMPC_MAX_DELTA_I_kA             : REAL := 0.350;    (* Maximum slew rate per control cycle [kA/step] *)
    rMPC_TARGET_ACCEL_ms2           : REAL := 28.5;     (* Desired launch acceleration profile [m/s2] *)
    rMPC_Accel_Error_ms2            : REAL := 0.0;      (* Acceleration tracking error [m/s2] *)
    rMPC_Velocity_Error_ms          : REAL := 0.0;      (* Velocity trajectory tracking error [m/s] *)

    (* ============================================================================================
       INVERTER FIELD-ORIENTED CONTROL (FOC) AND d-q DECOUPLING
       ============================================================================================ *)
    rCurrent_Alpha_kA               : REAL := 0.0;      (* Clarke transform stationary alpha-axis current [kA] *)
    rCurrent_Beta_kA                : REAL := 0.0;      (* Clarke transform stationary beta-axis current [kA] *)
    rCurrent_Direct_Id_kA           : REAL := 0.0;      (* Park transform rotating d-axis feedback current [kA] *)
    rCurrent_Quad_Iq_kA             : REAL := 0.0;      (* Park transform rotating q-axis feedback current [kA] *)
    rElectrical_Angle_Theta_rad     : REAL := 0.0;      (* Stator electrical rotor flux angle [rad] *)
    rElectrical_AngularVelocity_w_rads : REAL := 0.0;  (* Stator electrical frequency omega_e [rad/s] *)
    rSin_Theta                      : REAL := 0.0;      (* Trigonometric sine accumulator *)
    rCos_Theta                      : REAL := 1.0;      (* Trigonometric cosine accumulator *)
    
    (* PI Current Regulators *)
    rPI_Direct_Kp                   : REAL := 4.85;     (* d-axis current regulator proportional gain [kV/kA] *)
    rPI_Direct_Ki                   : REAL := 185.0;    (* d-axis current regulator integral gain [kV/(kA*s)] *)
    rPI_Direct_Integrator_kV        : REAL := 0.0;      (* d-axis integrator accumulator [kV] *)
    rPI_Quad_Kp                     : REAL := 5.20;     (* q-axis current regulator proportional gain [kV/kA] *)
    rPI_Quad_Ki                     : REAL := 210.0;    (* q-axis current regulator integral gain [kV/(kA*s)] *)
    rPI_Quad_Integrator_kV          : REAL := 0.0;      (* q-axis integrator accumulator [kV] *)
    
    (* Dynamic Decoupling Feedforward Voltages *)
    rDecoupling_Vd_Comp_kV          : REAL := 0.0;      (* -omega_e * L_q * I_q feedforward term [kV] *)
    rDecoupling_Vq_Comp_kV          : REAL := 0.0;      (* +omega_e * (L_d * I_d + Psi_f) feedforward term [kV] *)
    rUnsaturated_Vd_kV              : REAL := 0.0;      (* Pre-limit d-axis voltage command [kV] *)
    rUnsaturated_Vq_kV              : REAL := 0.0;      (* Pre-limit q-axis voltage command [kV] *)
    rVoltage_Magnitude_Total_kV     : REAL := 0.0;      (* Resultant stator voltage vector magnitude [kV] *)
    rMAX_VOLTAGE_INVERTER_kV        : REAL := 5.80;     (* Maximum continuous inverter output voltage [kV] *)

    (* ============================================================================================
       MULTI-SEGMENT STATOR BLOCK HIGH-SPEED HANDOVER CONTROLLER
       ============================================================================================ *)
    rBlock_Relative_Position_m      : REAL := 0.0;      (* Vehicle position relative to block ingress [m] *)
    rHandover_Zone_Start_m          : REAL := 95.0;     (* Track position where handover begins [m] *)
    rHandover_Normalized_Sigma      : REAL := 0.0;      (* Handover progress parameter sigma in [0.0, 1.0] *)
    rWeight_ActiveBlock             : REAL := 1.0;      (* Active block current blending weight [1.0 .. 0.0] *)
    rWeight_NextBlock               : REAL := 0.0;      (* Next block current blending weight [0.0 .. 1.0] *)
    bHandover_Trigger_Armed         : BOOL := FALSE;    (* Armed for inter-inverter commutation *)
    iActive_Stator_Segment          : DINT := 1;        (* Stator segment number currently driving *)
    iNext_Stator_Segment            : DINT := 2;        (* Stator segment number in standby / pre-flux *)
    rHandover_Phase_Offset_rad      : REAL := 0.0;      (* Inter-block physical spatial phase alignment [rad] *)

    (* ============================================================================================
       EMERGENCY REGENERATIVE BRAKING & ABORT TRAJECTORY
       ============================================================================================ *)
    rAbort_TargetDecel_ms2          : REAL := 32.5;     (* Controlled emergency abort deceleration [m/s2] *)
    rRegenBrake_Iq_Cmd_kA           : REAL := 0.0;      (* Reverse torque dynamic braking current [kA] *)
    rTotal_Kinetic_Energy_MJ        : REAL := 0.0;      (* Vehicle instantaneous kinetic energy 0.5*m*v^2 [MJ] *)
    rBrakingResistor_Power_MW       : REAL := 0.0;      (* Active crowbar braking dissipation power [MW] *)

    (* ============================================================================================
       ALARM TREE MASK CONSTANTS & INTERNAL FAULT REGISTERS
       ============================================================================================ *)
    udiFaultRegister_Cat0_Emergency : UDINT := 0;       (* Category 0 Immediate Trip bitfield *)
    udiFaultRegister_Cat1_FastAbort : UDINT := 0;       (* Category 1 Controlled Decel bitfield *)
    udiFaultRegister_Cat2_Degraded  : UDINT := 0;       (* Category 2 Graceful Warning bitfield *)
    
    (* Bit definitions for Category 0 Emergency Abort *)
    (* Bit 0: SIL-3 Safety Loop Interrupted
       Bit 1: Manual Operator Abort
       Bit 2: Air Gap Severe Collapse (< 6.5 mm)
       Bit 3: Air Gap Severe Flyaway (> 18.5 mm)
       Bit 4: Superconducting Magnet Cryo Quench Trip
       Bit 5: Inverter DC Overvoltage Flashover (> 6.6 kV)
       Bit 6: Stator Core Over-temperature (> 145 deg C)
       Bit 7: Active Inverter Hardware Desaturation Trip *)
    
    (* Graceful Degradation Counter and Latch *)
    bDegraded_Mode_Active           : BOOL := FALSE;    (* Operating on 2oo2 or 1oo1 sensor consensus *)
    bPower_Derate_Enforced          : BOOL := FALSE;    (* Inverter thermal derate active *)
    rThermal_Derate_Factor          : REAL := 1.0;      (* Current derating multiplier [0.5 .. 1.0] *)

    (* Mathematical & Intermediate Loop Variables *)
    iLoopIdx                        : INT := 0;
    rTempCalc1                      : REAL := 0.0;
    rTempCalc2                      : REAL := 0.0;
    rTempCalc3                      : REAL := 0.0;
    rDetH                           : REAL := 0.0;      (* Determinant of 2x2 MPC Hessian *)
    rInvH_00                        : REAL := 0.0;
    rInvH_01                        : REAL := 0.0;
    rInvH_10                        : REAL := 0.0;
    rInvH_11                        : REAL := 0.0;
END_VAR
(* ================================================================================================
   SECTION 1: CYCLIC EXECUTION PREPARATION & TIME BASE SYNCHRONIZATION
   ================================================================================================ *)
udiCycleCounter := udiCycleCounter + 1;

(* Compute physical scan period with boundary protection *)
IF tSampleCycle_DeltaT_ms > 0.05 AND tSampleCycle_DeltaT_ms < 10.0 THEN
    rDeltaTime_Sec := tSampleCycle_DeltaT_ms * 0.001;
ELSE
    rDeltaTime_Sec := 0.0005; (* Fallback to 500 microsecond deterministic base *)
END_IF;

(* Clear cycle transient status indicators *)
bMuzzleReleaseSignal := FALSE;
bQuenchProtectionTriggered := FALSE;
bInverterTrip_ActiveBlock := FALSE;
bInverterTrip_NextBlock := FALSE;

(* Total vehicle kinetic energy monitoring: E_k = 0.5 * m * v^2 [MJ] *)
rTotal_Kinetic_Energy_MJ := 0.5 * (rVEHICLE_MASS_NOMINAL_kg / 1000000.0) * (rObs_Vel_ms * rObs_Vel_ms);

(* ================================================================================================
   SECTION 2: 2oo3 TRIPLE MODULAR REDUNDANCY (TMR) KINEMATIC SENSOR FUSION ENGINE
   ================================================================================================
   Evaluates heterogeneous sensor channels:
     Channel A: Laser Doppler Velocimeter (LDV)
     Channel B: 77 GHz FMCW Radar
     Channel C: Track Magnetic Grating Encoder
   Performs pairwise divergence cross-checks and bumpless degradation to 2oo2 or 1oo1 modes.
*)
(* Evaluate Channel A Health *)
IF (rVelocity_Vehicle_ChA_kmh < -5.0) OR (rVelocity_Vehicle_ChA_kmh > 1200.0) OR (rLaserDoppler_SignalQuality < 6.0) THEN
    udiChannelA_FaultCounter := udiChannelA_FaultCounter + 1;
    IF udiChannelA_FaultCounter > 6 THEN
        bChannelA_Healthy := FALSE;
    END_IF;
ELSE
    IF udiChannelA_FaultCounter > 0 THEN
        udiChannelA_FaultCounter := udiChannelA_FaultCounter - 1;
    END_IF;
    IF udiChannelA_FaultCounter = 0 THEN
        bChannelA_Healthy := TRUE;
    END_IF;
END_IF;

(* Evaluate Channel B Health *)
IF (rVelocity_Vehicle_ChB_kmh < -5.0) OR (rVelocity_Vehicle_ChB_kmh > 1200.0) OR (rRadar_SignalQuality < 0.25) THEN
    udiChannelB_FaultCounter := udiChannelB_FaultCounter + 1;
    IF udiChannelB_FaultCounter > 6 THEN
        bChannelB_Healthy := FALSE;
    END_IF;
ELSE
    IF udiChannelB_FaultCounter > 0 THEN
        udiChannelB_FaultCounter := udiChannelB_FaultCounter - 1;
    END_IF;
    IF udiChannelB_FaultCounter = 0 THEN
        bChannelB_Healthy := TRUE;
    END_IF;
END_IF;

(* Evaluate Channel C Health *)
IF (rVelocity_Vehicle_ChC_kmh < -5.0) OR (rVelocity_Vehicle_ChC_kmh > 1200.0) OR (rEncoder_SignalQuality < 0.30) THEN
    udiChannelC_FaultCounter := udiChannelC_FaultCounter + 1;
    IF udiChannelC_FaultCounter > 6 THEN
        bChannelC_Healthy := FALSE;
    END_IF;
ELSE
    IF udiChannelC_FaultCounter > 0 THEN
        udiChannelC_FaultCounter := udiChannelC_FaultCounter - 1;
    END_IF;
    IF udiChannelC_FaultCounter = 0 THEN
        bChannelC_Healthy := TRUE;
    END_IF;
END_IF;

(* Calculate Pairwise Channel Discrepancies *)
rDev_AB_kmh := ABS(rVelocity_Vehicle_ChA_kmh - rVelocity_Vehicle_ChB_kmh);
rDev_BC_kmh := ABS(rVelocity_Vehicle_ChB_kmh - rVelocity_Vehicle_ChC_kmh);
rDev_CA_kmh := ABS(rVelocity_Vehicle_ChC_kmh - rVelocity_Vehicle_ChA_kmh);

(* 2oo3 Voting Decision Matrix *)
IF bChannelA_Healthy AND bChannelB_Healthy AND bChannelC_Healthy THEN
    (* All 3 channels nominally healthy - execute median selection *)
    IF (rVelocity_Vehicle_ChA_kmh >= rVelocity_Vehicle_ChB_kmh AND rVelocity_Vehicle_ChA_kmh <= rVelocity_Vehicle_ChC_kmh) OR
       (rVelocity_Vehicle_ChA_kmh <= rVelocity_Vehicle_ChB_kmh AND rVelocity_Vehicle_ChA_kmh >= rVelocity_Vehicle_ChC_kmh) THEN
        rTMR_Voted_Velocity_kmh := rVelocity_Vehicle_ChA_kmh;
    ELSIF (rVelocity_Vehicle_ChB_kmh >= rVelocity_Vehicle_ChA_kmh AND rVelocity_Vehicle_ChB_kmh <= rVelocity_Vehicle_ChC_kmh) OR
          (rVelocity_Vehicle_ChB_kmh <= rVelocity_Vehicle_ChA_kmh AND rVelocity_Vehicle_ChB_kmh >= rVelocity_Vehicle_ChC_kmh) THEN
        rTMR_Voted_Velocity_kmh := rVelocity_Vehicle_ChB_kmh;
    ELSE
        rTMR_Voted_Velocity_kmh := rVelocity_Vehicle_ChC_kmh;
    END_IF;
    bDegraded_Mode_Active := FALSE;
ELSIF bChannelA_Healthy AND bChannelB_Healthy THEN
    (* Degraded 2oo2 Mode: Channel C failed *)
    IF rDev_AB_kmh < rMAX_TMR_TOLERANCE_kmh THEN
        rTMR_Voted_Velocity_kmh := 0.5 * (rVelocity_Vehicle_ChA_kmh + rVelocity_Vehicle_ChB_kmh);
        bDegraded_Mode_Active := TRUE;
    ELSE
        (* Divergence in 2oo2 - prioritize high-precision Laser Doppler *)
        rTMR_Voted_Velocity_kmh := rVelocity_Vehicle_ChA_kmh;
        bDegraded_Mode_Active := TRUE;
        udiFaultRegister_Cat2_Degraded := udiFaultRegister_Cat2_Degraded OR 16#00000001;
    END_IF;
ELSIF bChannelA_Healthy AND bChannelC_Healthy THEN
    (* Degraded 2oo2 Mode: Channel B failed *)
    IF rDev_CA_kmh < rMAX_TMR_TOLERANCE_kmh THEN
        rTMR_Voted_Velocity_kmh := 0.5 * (rVelocity_Vehicle_ChA_kmh + rVelocity_Vehicle_ChC_kmh);
        bDegraded_Mode_Active := TRUE;
    ELSE
        rTMR_Voted_Velocity_kmh := rVelocity_Vehicle_ChA_kmh;
        bDegraded_Mode_Active := TRUE;
        udiFaultRegister_Cat2_Degraded := udiFaultRegister_Cat2_Degraded OR 16#00000002;
    END_IF;
ELSIF bChannelB_Healthy AND bChannelC_Healthy THEN
    (* Degraded 2oo2 Mode: Channel A failed *)
    IF rDev_BC_kmh < rMAX_TMR_TOLERANCE_kmh THEN
        rTMR_Voted_Velocity_kmh := 0.5 * (rVelocity_Vehicle_ChB_kmh + rVelocity_Vehicle_ChC_kmh);
        bDegraded_Mode_Active := TRUE;
    ELSE
        rTMR_Voted_Velocity_kmh := rVelocity_Vehicle_ChB_kmh;
        bDegraded_Mode_Active := TRUE;
        udiFaultRegister_Cat2_Degraded := udiFaultRegister_Cat2_Degraded OR 16#00000004;
    END_IF;
ELSIF bChannelA_Healthy THEN
    (* Degraded 1oo1 Mode: Sole remaining Laser Doppler channel *)
    rTMR_Voted_Velocity_kmh := rVelocity_Vehicle_ChA_kmh;
    bDegraded_Mode_Active := TRUE;
    udiFaultRegister_Cat1_FastAbort := udiFaultRegister_Cat1_FastAbort OR 16#00000010;
ELSIF bChannelB_Healthy THEN
    (* Degraded 1oo1 Mode: Sole remaining Radar channel *)
    rTMR_Voted_Velocity_kmh := rVelocity_Vehicle_ChB_kmh;
    bDegraded_Mode_Active := TRUE;
    udiFaultRegister_Cat1_FastAbort := udiFaultRegister_Cat1_FastAbort OR 16#00000020;
ELSIF bChannelC_Healthy THEN
    (* Degraded 1oo1 Mode: Sole remaining Magnetic Grating channel *)
    rTMR_Voted_Velocity_kmh := rVelocity_Vehicle_ChC_kmh;
    bDegraded_Mode_Active := TRUE;
    udiFaultRegister_Cat1_FastAbort := udiFaultRegister_Cat1_FastAbort OR 16#00000040;
ELSE
    (* COMPLETE SENSOR BLACKOUT: Trigger SIL-3 Category 0 Emergency Abort *)
    rTMR_Voted_Velocity_kmh := rObs_Vel_ms * 3.6; (* Hold last observer state *)
    udiFaultRegister_Cat0_Emergency := udiFaultRegister_Cat0_Emergency OR 16#00000100;
END_IF;

(* Convert voted velocity to SI units [m/s] *)
rTMR_Voted_Velocity_ms := rTMR_Voted_Velocity_kmh / 3.6;

(* Plausibility rate-of-change jerk check *)
IF ABS(rTMR_Voted_Velocity_ms - rPrev_Voted_Velocity_ms) / rDeltaTime_Sec > rMAX_ACCEL_RATE_PLAUSIBILITY_ms2 THEN
    udiFaultRegister_Cat1_FastAbort := udiFaultRegister_Cat1_FastAbort OR 16#00000200;
END_IF;
rPrev_Voted_Velocity_ms := rTMR_Voted_Velocity_ms;

(* Encode Sensor Health Telemetry Word *)
wSensorHealthBitmask := 16#0000;
IF bChannelA_Healthy THEN wSensorHealthBitmask := wSensorHealthBitmask OR 16#0001; END_IF;
IF bChannelB_Healthy THEN wSensorHealthBitmask := wSensorHealthBitmask OR 16#0002; END_IF;
IF bChannelC_Healthy THEN wSensorHealthBitmask := wSensorHealthBitmask OR 16#0004; END_IF;
IF bDegraded_Mode_Active THEN wSensorHealthBitmask := wSensorHealthBitmask OR 16#0010; END_IF;
(* ================================================================================================
   SECTION 3: SUB-MILLIMETER KINEMATIC OBSERVER (STATE-SPACE KALMAN-LUENBERGER FILTER)
   ================================================================================================
   Discrete State Equation:
     x_hat[k+1] = A_d * x_hat[k] + B_d * u[k] + L_d * (y[k] - C_d * x_hat[k])
   Where:
     x_hat = [Position (m), Velocity (m/s), Acceleration (m/s2), DisturbanceForce (kN)]^T
     u     = [ThrustForce_kN, AeroForce_kN]^T
     y     = [Integrated_Laser_Pos_m, Integrated_Radar_Pos_m, Integrated_Grating_Pos_m]^T
*)
(* Numerical Integration of Position Measurements from Heterogeneous Sensors *)
rIntegrated_Laser_Pos_m   := rIntegrated_Laser_Pos_m + (rVelocity_Vehicle_ChA_kmh / 3.6) * rDeltaTime_Sec;
rIntegrated_Radar_Pos_m   := rIntegrated_Radar_Pos_m + (rVelocity_Vehicle_ChB_kmh / 3.6) * rDeltaTime_Sec;
rIntegrated_Grating_Pos_m := rIntegrated_Grating_Pos_m + (rVelocity_Vehicle_ChC_kmh / 3.6) * rDeltaTime_Sec;

(* Re-synchronize integrated sensor accumulators at physical block boundaries *)
IF rBlock_Entry_Position_mm > 0.0 AND ABS(rObs_Pos_m - (rBlock_Entry_Position_mm * 0.001)) < 2.5 THEN
    rIntegrated_Laser_Pos_m   := rBlock_Entry_Position_mm * 0.001;
    rIntegrated_Radar_Pos_m   := rBlock_Entry_Position_mm * 0.001;
    rIntegrated_Grating_Pos_m := rBlock_Entry_Position_mm * 0.001;
END_IF;

(* Compute Measurement Innovation Vector: e = y - C_d * x_hat *)
rTempCalc1 := rIntegrated_Laser_Pos_m   - (rMat_Cd_00 * rObs_Pos_m);
rTempCalc2 := rIntegrated_Radar_Pos_m   - (rMat_Cd_10 * rObs_Pos_m);
rTempCalc3 := rIntegrated_Grating_Pos_m - (rMat_Cd_20 * rObs_Pos_m);

(* Apply Health Weighting to Innovation Vector *)
IF NOT bChannelA_Healthy THEN rTempCalc1 := 0.0; END_IF;
IF NOT bChannelB_Healthy THEN rTempCalc2 := 0.0; END_IF;
IF NOT bChannelC_Healthy THEN rTempCalc3 := 0.0; END_IF;

(* Matrix State Propagation: x_next = A_d * x + B_d * u + L_d * e *)
rObs_Pos_m := (rMat_Ad_00 * rObs_Pos_m) +
              (rMat_Ad_01 * rObs_Vel_ms) +
              (rMat_Ad_02 * rObs_Accel_ms2) +
              (rMat_Ad_03 * rObs_DisturbanceForce_kN) +
              (rMat_Bd_00 * rCalculated_ThrustForce_kN) +
              (rMat_Bd_01 * rEstimated_Aerodynamic_Lift_kN) +
              (rMat_Ld_00 * rTempCalc1) +
              (rMat_Ld_01 * rTempCalc2) +
              (rMat_Ld_02 * rTempCalc3);

rObs_Vel_ms := (rMat_Ad_10 * rObs_Pos_m) +
               (rMat_Ad_11 * rObs_Vel_ms) +
               (rMat_Ad_12 * rObs_Accel_ms2) +
               (rMat_Ad_13 * rObs_DisturbanceForce_kN) +
               (rMat_Bd_10 * rCalculated_ThrustForce_kN) +
               (rMat_Bd_11 * rEstimated_Aerodynamic_Lift_kN) +
               (rMat_Ld_10 * rTempCalc1) +
               (rMat_Ld_11 * rTempCalc2) +
               (rMat_Ld_12 * rTempCalc3);

rObs_Accel_ms2 := (rMat_Ad_20 * rObs_Pos_m) +
                  (rMat_Ad_21 * rObs_Vel_ms) +
                  (rMat_Ad_22 * rObs_Accel_ms2) +
                  (rMat_Ad_23 * rObs_DisturbanceForce_kN) +
                  (rMat_Bd_20 * rCalculated_ThrustForce_kN) +
                  (rMat_Bd_21 * rEstimated_Aerodynamic_Lift_kN) +
                  (rMat_Ld_20 * rTempCalc1) +
                  (rMat_Ld_21 * rTempCalc2) +
                  (rMat_Ld_22 * rTempCalc3);

rObs_DisturbanceForce_kN := (rMat_Ad_30 * rObs_Pos_m) +
                            (rMat_Ad_31 * rObs_Vel_ms) +
                            (rMat_Ad_32 * rObs_Accel_ms2) +
                            (rMat_Ad_33 * rObs_DisturbanceForce_kN) +
                            (rMat_Bd_30 * rCalculated_ThrustForce_kN) +
                            (rMat_Bd_31 * rEstimated_Aerodynamic_Lift_kN) +
                            (rMat_Ld_30 * rTempCalc1) +
                            (rMat_Ld_31 * rTempCalc2) +
                            (rMat_Ld_32 * rTempCalc3);

(* Clamp Observer State to Physical Rails *)
IF rObs_Pos_m < 0.0 THEN rObs_Pos_m := 0.0; END_IF;
IF rObs_Vel_ms < 0.0 THEN rObs_Vel_ms := 0.0; END_IF;

(* Export Observer Quantities to Telemetry *)
rEstimated_AbsolutePosition_mm  := rObs_Pos_m * 1000.0;
rEstimated_AbsoluteVelocity_kmh := rObs_Vel_ms * 3.6;
rEstimated_AbsoluteAccel_ms2    := rObs_Accel_ms2;
(* ================================================================================================
   SECTION 4: DYNAMIC AERODYNAMIC NORMAL-FORCE NULLING & LEVITATION GAP REGULATOR
   ================================================================================================
   At velocities approaching 1,000 km/h (Mach > 0.8 in evacuated guide-way), compressible flow
   and ground-effect create extreme aerodynamic lift forces F_lift(v) tending to destabilize the
   levitation air gap. The controller executes active electromagnetic normal force injection
   via direct-axis current I_d bias to maintain nominal clearance (12.0 mm +/- 0.2 mm).
*)
(* Calculate Local Gas Dynamics in Partially Evacuated Tube *)
IF rTubeStaticPressure_kPa > 0.1 AND rTubeStaticPressure_kPa < 105.0 THEN
    rAirDensity_Ambient_kgm3 := (rTubeStaticPressure_kPa * 1000.0) / (287.05 * 293.15);
ELSE
    rAirDensity_Ambient_kgm3 := rVACUUM_AIR_DENSITY_kgm3;
END_IF;

(* Calculate Mach Number & Dynamic Pressure q = 0.5 * rho * v^2 *)
rMachNumber := rObs_Vel_ms / rSPEED_OF_SOUND_TUBE_ms;
rDynamicPressure_q_kPa := 0.5 * rAirDensity_Ambient_kgm3 * (rObs_Vel_ms * rObs_Vel_ms) * 0.001;

(* Aerodynamic Lift Model: F_lift = C_L * A_ref * q, where C_L increases with Mach near transonic *)
IF rMachNumber < 0.70 THEN
    rEstimated_Aerodynamic_Lift_kN := (0.280 + (0.120 * rMachNumber)) * rVEHICLE_FRONTAL_AREA_m2 * rDynamicPressure_q_kPa;
ELSE
    (* Transonic compressibility amplification factor *)
    rEstimated_Aerodynamic_Lift_kN := (0.364 + (0.450 * (rMachNumber - 0.70) * (rMachNumber - 0.70))) * rVEHICLE_FRONTAL_AREA_m2 * rDynamicPressure_q_kPa;
END_IF;

(* Levitation Air-Gap Error Computation *)
rDynamic_AirGap_Error_mm := rNOMINAL_AIRGAP_SETPOINT_mm - rAirGap_Levitation_mm;

(* Safety Trip Checks on Air Gap Boundaries *)
IF rAirGap_Levitation_mm < rAIRGAP_MIN_TRIP_LIMIT_mm THEN
    udiFaultRegister_Cat0_Emergency := udiFaultRegister_Cat0_Emergency OR 16#00000004; (* Severe collapse trip *)
END_IF;
IF rAirGap_Levitation_mm > rAIRGAP_MAX_TRIP_LIMIT_mm THEN
    udiFaultRegister_Cat0_Emergency := udiFaultRegister_Cat0_Emergency OR 16#00000008; (* Severe flyaway trip *)
END_IF;

(* Closed-Loop PID Air-Gap Regulator with Anti-Windup Clamping *)
rTempCalc1 := (rDynamic_AirGap_Error_mm * 0.001); (* Error in meters *)

(* Proportional Term *)
rTempCalc2 := rAirGap_Regulator_P_Gain * rTempCalc1;

(* Integral Term with Saturation Bounds *)
rAirGap_Integral_Accumulator := rAirGap_Integral_Accumulator + (rAirGap_Regulator_I_Gain * rTempCalc1 * rDeltaTime_Sec);
IF rAirGap_Integral_Accumulator > 1.80 THEN
    rAirGap_Integral_Accumulator := 1.80;
ELSIF rAirGap_Integral_Accumulator < -1.80 THEN
    rAirGap_Integral_Accumulator := -1.80;
END_IF;

(* Derivative Term on Error Slope *)
rTempCalc3 := rAirGap_Regulator_D_Gain * ((rDynamic_AirGap_Error_mm - rAirGap_Error_Previous_mm) * 0.001) / rDeltaTime_Sec;
rAirGap_Error_Previous_mm := rDynamic_AirGap_Error_mm;

(* Feedforward Lift Nulling Injection: Delta_Id_ff = -F_aero / NormalForceSensitivity *)
rCompensating_Id_Bias_kA := (rTempCalc2 + rAirGap_Integral_Accumulator + rTempCalc3) - (rEstimated_Aerodynamic_Lift_kN / rNORMAL_FORCE_COEFF_kN_per_kA);

(* Clamp Direct-Axis Bias to Thermal / Converter Limits [-2.5 kA .. +2.0 kA] *)
IF rCompensating_Id_Bias_kA > 2.00 THEN
    rCompensating_Id_Bias_kA := 2.00;
ELSIF rCompensating_Id_Bias_kA < -2.50 THEN
    rCompensating_Id_Bias_kA := -2.50;
END_IF;
(* ================================================================================================
   SECTION 5: MODEL PREDICTIVE CONTROL (MPC) QUADRATIC COST APPROXIMATION
   ================================================================================================
   Solves optimal current increments [Delta_I_d, Delta_I_q] over receding horizon:
     min J = 0.5 * Delta_U^T * H * Delta_U + g^T * Delta_U
   Analytical unconstrained minimum: Delta_U* = -H^(-1) * g
   Subjected to Euclidean projection onto box and rate constraints.
*)
(* Trajectory Error Evaluation *)
rMPC_Accel_Error_ms2 := rMPC_TARGET_ACCEL_ms2 - rObs_Accel_ms2;
rMPC_Velocity_Error_ms := (rTarget_LaunchVelocity_kmh / 3.6) - rObs_Vel_ms;

(* Update Linear Gradient Vector g based on tracking errors and air-gap deviation *)
rMPC_Gradient_0 := -1.0 * (rDynamic_AirGap_Error_mm * 15.0) + (rCompensating_Id_Bias_kA * 8.5);
rMPC_Gradient_1 := -1.0 * (rMPC_Accel_Error_ms2 * 18.5) - (rMPC_Velocity_Error_ms * 0.45);

(* 2x2 Matrix Inversion for Quadratic Hessian H *)
rDetH := (rMPC_Hessian_00 * rMPC_Hessian_11) - (rMPC_Hessian_01 * rMPC_Hessian_10);

IF ABS(rDetH) > 0.001 THEN
    rInvH_00 :=  rMPC_Hessian_11 / rDetH;
    rInvH_01 := -rMPC_Hessian_01 / rDetH;
    rInvH_10 := -rMPC_Hessian_10 / rDetH;
    rInvH_11 :=  rMPC_Hessian_00 / rDetH;

    (* Analytical Gradient Projection Step: Delta_U = -H_inv * g *)
    rMPC_Delta_Id_Opt := -1.0 * ((rInvH_00 * rMPC_Gradient_0) + (rInvH_01 * rMPC_Gradient_1));
    rMPC_Delta_Iq_Opt := -1.0 * ((rInvH_10 * rMPC_Gradient_0) + (rInvH_11 * rMPC_Gradient_1));
ELSE
    (* Fallback Steepest Descent step in case of ill-conditioned Hessian *)
    rMPC_Delta_Id_Opt := -0.001 * rMPC_Gradient_0;
    rMPC_Delta_Iq_Opt := -0.001 * rMPC_Gradient_1;
END_IF;

(* Rate Constraint Slew Rate Limiting *)
IF rMPC_Delta_Id_Opt > rMPC_MAX_DELTA_I_kA THEN
    rMPC_Delta_Id_Opt := rMPC_MAX_DELTA_I_kA;
ELSIF rMPC_Delta_Id_Opt < -rMPC_MAX_DELTA_I_kA THEN
    rMPC_Delta_Id_Opt := -rMPC_MAX_DELTA_I_kA;
END_IF;

IF rMPC_Delta_Iq_Opt > rMPC_MAX_DELTA_I_kA THEN
    rMPC_Delta_Iq_Opt := rMPC_MAX_DELTA_I_kA;
ELSIF rMPC_Delta_Iq_Opt < -rMPC_MAX_DELTA_I_kA THEN
    rMPC_Delta_Iq_Opt := -rMPC_MAX_DELTA_I_kA;
END_IF;

(* Accumulate Optimal Commanded Currents *)
IF iMainState = 30 THEN (* Running in Trajectory Acceleration *)
    rInverter_DirectAxisCurrent_kA    := rCompensating_Id_Bias_kA + rMPC_Delta_Id_Opt;
    rInverter_QuadratureAxisCurrent_kA := rInverter_QuadratureAxisCurrent_kA + rMPC_Delta_Iq_Opt;
ELSIF iMainState = 60 THEN (* Emergency Regenerative Braking *)
    rInverter_DirectAxisCurrent_kA    := rCompensating_Id_Bias_kA;
    rInverter_QuadratureAxisCurrent_kA := -rRegenBrake_Iq_Cmd_kA;
ELSIF iMainState = 20 THEN (* Alignment and Pre-flux *)
    rInverter_DirectAxisCurrent_kA    := 0.50;
    rInverter_QuadratureAxisCurrent_kA := 0.25;
ELSE
    rInverter_DirectAxisCurrent_kA    := 0.0;
    rInverter_QuadratureAxisCurrent_kA := 0.0;
END_IF;

(* Boundary Saturation for Motor Peak Thermal Limits *)
IF rInverter_QuadratureAxisCurrent_kA > (rMAX_STATOR_CURRENT_RMS_kA * rThermal_Derate_Factor) THEN
    rInverter_QuadratureAxisCurrent_kA := rMAX_STATOR_CURRENT_RMS_kA * rThermal_Derate_Factor;
ELSIF rInverter_QuadratureAxisCurrent_kA < -(rMAX_STATOR_CURRENT_RMS_kA * rThermal_Derate_Factor) THEN
    rInverter_QuadratureAxisCurrent_kA := -(rMAX_STATOR_CURRENT_RMS_kA * rThermal_Derate_Factor);
END_IF;
(* ================================================================================================
   SECTION 6: MULTI-SEGMENT STATOR BLOCK HIGH-SPEED HANDOVER CONTROLLER
   ================================================================================================
   Handles spatial tracking and seamless power transfer across 120-meter stator segments.
   At 1,000 km/h (277.8 m/s), the 25-meter overlap zone is traversed in exactly 90 milliseconds.
   The smooth quintic S-curve crossfader eliminates inverter DC-link voltage surges and thrust dip:
     S(sigma) = 10 * sigma^3 - 15 * sigma^4 + 6 * sigma^5
*)
(* Calculate Position Relative to Current Active Block Ingress *)
IF rBlock_Length_m > 10.0 THEN
    rBlock_Relative_Position_m := rObs_Pos_m - (rBlock_Entry_Position_mm * 0.001);
ELSE
    rBlock_Relative_Position_m := 0.0;
END_IF;

(* Determine Handover Zone Threshold *)
rHandover_Zone_Start_m := rBlock_Length_m - rHandover_Zone_Length_m;

IF (rBlock_Relative_Position_m >= rHandover_Zone_Start_m) AND (rBlock_Relative_Position_m <= rBlock_Length_m) THEN
    bHandoverInProgress := TRUE;
    
    (* Normalized Handover Parameter sigma in [0.0, 1.0] *)
    IF rHandover_Zone_Length_m > 0.1 THEN
        rHandover_Normalized_Sigma := (rBlock_Relative_Position_m - rHandover_Zone_Start_m) / rHandover_Zone_Length_m;
    ELSE
        rHandover_Normalized_Sigma := 1.0;
    END_IF;

    IF rHandover_Normalized_Sigma < 0.0 THEN rHandover_Normalized_Sigma := 0.0; END_IF;
    IF rHandover_Normalized_Sigma > 1.0 THEN rHandover_Normalized_Sigma := 1.0; END_IF;

    (* Quintic Polynomial S-Curve Weighting Function (C2 Continuous) *)
    rWeight_NextBlock := (10.0 * (rHandover_Normalized_Sigma * rHandover_Normalized_Sigma * rHandover_Normalized_Sigma)) -
                         (15.0 * (rHandover_Normalized_Sigma * rHandover_Normalized_Sigma * rHandover_Normalized_Sigma * rHandover_Normalized_Sigma)) +
                         (6.0  * (rHandover_Normalized_Sigma * rHandover_Normalized_Sigma * rHandover_Normalized_Sigma * rHandover_Normalized_Sigma * rHandover_Normalized_Sigma));
    
    rWeight_ActiveBlock := 1.0 - rWeight_NextBlock;
    rHandover_Progress_Pct := rWeight_NextBlock * 100.0;

    (* Verify Next Block Inverter Readiness *)
    IF NOT bInverterReady_NextBlock THEN
        (* Handover failure interlock - abort to dynamic braking *)
        udiFaultRegister_Cat1_FastAbort := udiFaultRegister_Cat1_FastAbort OR 16#00001000;
    END_IF;

ELSIF rBlock_Relative_Position_m > rBlock_Length_m THEN
    (* Handover Complete: Increment Segment Pointers and Reset Weights *)
    bHandoverInProgress := FALSE;
    rHandover_Progress_Pct := 100.0;
    rWeight_ActiveBlock := 1.0;
    rWeight_NextBlock := 0.0;
    iActive_Stator_Segment := iActive_Stator_Segment + 1;
    iNext_Stator_Segment := iActive_Stator_Segment + 1;
ELSE
    (* Steady-State Single-Block Conduction *)
    bHandoverInProgress := FALSE;
    rHandover_Progress_Pct := 0.0;
    rWeight_ActiveBlock := 1.0;
    rWeight_NextBlock := 0.0;
END_IF;
(* ================================================================================================
   SECTION 7: INVERTER FIELD-ORIENTED CONTROL (FOC) & ROTATIONAL d-q DECOUPLING
   ================================================================================================
   Implements high-speed Clarke/Park transformations, back-EMF decoupling voltage generation,
   and closed-loop PI current control with anti-windup clamping.
*)
(* Electrical Frequency & Rotor Flux Spatial Phase Calculation *)
rElectrical_AngularVelocity_w_rads := (3.14159265 / rPOLE_PITCH_TAU_m) * rObs_Vel_ms;
rInverter_ElectricalFreq_Hz := rElectrical_AngularVelocity_w_rads / (2.0 * 3.14159265);

(* Continuous Integration of Electrical Rotor Flux Phase Angle theta_e *)
rElectrical_Angle_Theta_rad := rElectrical_Angle_Theta_rad + (rElectrical_AngularVelocity_w_rads * rDeltaTime_Sec);
WHILE rElectrical_Angle_Theta_rad >= (2.0 * 3.14159265) DO
    rElectrical_Angle_Theta_rad := rElectrical_Angle_Theta_rad - (2.0 * 3.14159265);
END_WHILE;
WHILE rElectrical_Angle_Theta_rad < 0.0 DO
    rElectrical_Angle_Theta_rad := rElectrical_Angle_Theta_rad + (2.0 * 3.14159265);
END_WHILE;

rSin_Theta := SIN(rElectrical_Angle_Theta_rad);
rCos_Theta := COS(rElectrical_Angle_Theta_rad);

(* Clarke Transformation (3-phase stationary ABC -> 2-phase stationary Alpha-Beta) *)
rCurrent_Alpha_kA := rCurrent_PhaseA_LSM_kA;
rCurrent_Beta_kA  := (0.577350269) * (rCurrent_PhaseB_LSM_kA - rCurrent_PhaseC_LSM_kA);

(* Park Transformation (Stationary Alpha-Beta -> Synchronous Rotating d-q) *)
rCurrent_Direct_Id_kA :=  (rCurrent_Alpha_kA * rCos_Theta) + (rCurrent_Beta_kA * rSin_Theta);
rCurrent_Quad_Iq_kA   := -(rCurrent_Alpha_kA * rSin_Theta) + (rCurrent_Beta_kA * rCos_Theta);

(* d-q Cross-Coupling Decoupling Voltage Terms:
     V_d_comp = -omega_e * L_q * I_q
     V_q_comp = +omega_e * (L_d * I_d + Psi_f) *)
rDecoupling_Vd_Comp_kV := -1.0 * (rElectrical_AngularVelocity_w_rads * rINDUCTANCE_Lq_Henry * rCurrent_Quad_Iq_kA);
rDecoupling_Vq_Comp_kV :=  1.0 * (rElectrical_AngularVelocity_w_rads * ((rINDUCTANCE_Ld_Henry * rCurrent_Direct_Id_kA) + rHTS_FLUX_LINKAGE_Psi_Wb * 0.001));

(* Direct-Axis PI Current Controller *)
rTempCalc1 := rInverter_DirectAxisCurrent_kA - rCurrent_Direct_Id_kA; (* Error in kA *)
rPI_Direct_Integrator_kV := rPI_Direct_Integrator_kV + (rPI_Direct_Ki * rTempCalc1 * rDeltaTime_Sec);

(* Anti-Windup Limits on Direct-Axis Integrator *)
IF rPI_Direct_Integrator_kV > 3.0 THEN rPI_Direct_Integrator_kV := 3.0; END_IF;
IF rPI_Direct_Integrator_kV < -3.0 THEN rPI_Direct_Integrator_kV := -3.0; END_IF;

rUnsaturated_Vd_kV := (rPI_Direct_Kp * rTempCalc1) + rPI_Direct_Integrator_kV + rDecoupling_Vd_Comp_kV;

(* Quadrature-Axis PI Current Controller *)
rTempCalc2 := rInverter_QuadratureAxisCurrent_kA - rCurrent_Quad_Iq_kA; (* Error in kA *)
rPI_Quad_Integrator_kV := rPI_Quad_Integrator_kV + (rPI_Quad_Ki * rTempCalc2 * rDeltaTime_Sec);

(* Anti-Windup Limits on Quadrature-Axis Integrator *)
IF rPI_Quad_Integrator_kV > 4.5 THEN rPI_Quad_Integrator_kV := 4.5; END_IF;
IF rPI_Quad_Integrator_kV < -4.5 THEN rPI_Quad_Integrator_kV := -4.5; END_IF;

rUnsaturated_Vq_kV := (rPI_Quad_Kp * rTempCalc2) + rPI_Quad_Integrator_kV + rDecoupling_Vq_Comp_kV;

(* Vector Voltage Limiting & Modulation Index Synthesizer *)
rVoltage_Magnitude_Total_kV := SQRT((rUnsaturated_Vd_kV * rUnsaturated_Vd_kV) + (rUnsaturated_Vq_kV * rUnsaturated_Vq_kV));

IF rVoltage_Magnitude_Total_kV > rMAX_VOLTAGE_INVERTER_kV AND rVoltage_Magnitude_Total_kV > 0.01 THEN
    (* Over-modulation saturation - scale voltage vector proportionally *)
    rInverter_DirectAxisVoltage_kV     := (rUnsaturated_Vd_kV / rVoltage_Magnitude_Total_kV) * rMAX_VOLTAGE_INVERTER_kV;
    rInverter_QuadratureAxisVoltage_kV := (rUnsaturated_Vq_kV / rVoltage_Magnitude_Total_kV) * rMAX_VOLTAGE_INVERTER_kV;
    rModulationIndex_ActiveInverter    := 1.15;
ELSE
    rInverter_DirectAxisVoltage_kV     := rUnsaturated_Vd_kV;
    rInverter_QuadratureAxisVoltage_kV := rUnsaturated_Vq_kV;
    IF rDCBus_Voltage_kV > 0.5 THEN
        rModulationIndex_ActiveInverter := (rVoltage_Magnitude_Total_kV * 1.4142) / (rDCBus_Voltage_kV * 0.612);
    ELSE
        rModulationIndex_ActiveInverter := 0.0;
    END_IF;
END_IF;

(* Developed Electrodynamic Force Equations *)
rCalculated_ThrustForce_kN := (1.5 * (3.14159265 / rPOLE_PITCH_TAU_m) * rHTS_FLUX_LINKAGE_Psi_Wb * rCurrent_Quad_Iq_kA) +
                              (0.75 * (3.14159265 / rPOLE_PITCH_TAU_m) * (rINDUCTANCE_Ld_Henry - rINDUCTANCE_Lq_Henry) * rCurrent_Direct_Id_kA * rCurrent_Quad_Iq_kA);

rCalculated_NormalForce_kN := (rNORMAL_FORCE_COEFF_kN_per_kA * rCurrent_Direct_Id_kA) - rEstimated_Aerodynamic_Lift_kN;

(* Instantaneous Electrical Active and Reactive Power Computation *)
rInverter_ActivePower_MW   := 1.5 * ((rInverter_DirectAxisVoltage_kV * rCurrent_Direct_Id_kA) + (rInverter_QuadratureAxisVoltage_kV * rCurrent_Quad_Iq_kA));
rInverter_ReactivePower_MVAR := 1.5 * ((rInverter_QuadratureAxisVoltage_kV * rCurrent_Direct_Id_kA) - (rInverter_DirectAxisVoltage_kV * rCurrent_Quad_Iq_kA));
(* ================================================================================================
   SECTION 8: FINITE STATE MACHINE (FSM) - MULTI-STAGE ACCELERATOR SEQUENCE
   ================================================================================================
   Manages the deterministic transition across operational phases:
     0:  COLD INITIALIZATION
     10: STANDBY PRELAUNCH
     20: ALIGNMENT & LEVITATION LOCK
     30: TRAJECTORY ACCELERATION
     40: BLOCK HANDOVER EXECUTION
     50: COAST & TERMINAL MUZZLE RELEASE
     60: CONTROLLED REGENERATIVE BRAKING
     99: SIL-3 EMERGENCY SHUTDOWN
*)
(* Detect State Transition Edge *)
IF iMainState <> iPreviousState THEN
    bStateFirstScan := TRUE;
    iPreviousState := iMainState;
ELSE
    bStateFirstScan := FALSE;
END_IF;

(* Evaluate SIL-3 Critical Interlock Override *)
IF NOT bSafetyLoopClosed OR bManualAbort_Command OR (udiFaultRegister_Cat0_Emergency <> 0) THEN
    iMainState := 99; (* Immediate jump to Category 0 Emergency Trip *)
END_IF;

CASE iMainState OF
    0: (* STATE_COLD_INITIALIZATION *)
        bSystemReady := FALSE;
        bLaunchActive := FALSE;
        bEmergencyDecelActive := FALSE;
        rLaunchElapsedTime_Sec := 0.0;
        
        (* Reset Observers and Integrators *)
        rObs_Pos_m := 0.0;
        rObs_Vel_ms := 0.0;
        rObs_Accel_ms2 := 0.0;
        rObs_DisturbanceForce_kN := 0.0;
        rIntegrated_Laser_Pos_m := 0.0;
        rIntegrated_Radar_Pos_m := 0.0;
        rIntegrated_Grating_Pos_m := 0.0;
        rPI_Direct_Integrator_kV := 0.0;
        rPI_Quad_Integrator_kV := 0.0;
        rAirGap_Integral_Accumulator := 0.0;
        
        (* Verify DC Bus and Cryogenic Preconditions *)
        IF bSafetyLoopClosed AND (rDCBus_Voltage_kV >= rMIN_DC_BUS_VOLTAGE_kV) AND bCryoSystem_Operational THEN
            iMainState := 10;
        END_IF;

    10: (* STATE_STANDBY_PRELAUNCH *)
        bSystemReady := TRUE;
        bLaunchActive := FALSE;
        bEmergencyDecelActive := FALSE;
        
        (* Check All Subsystem Readies for Launch Arming *)
        IF bMasterEnable AND bTrackClearance_Verified AND bVacuumTube_PressureOK AND
           bInverterReady_ActiveBlock AND (rCryo_MagnetTemperature_degC < -196.0) THEN
            iMainState := 20;
        END_IF;

    20: (* STATE_ALIGNMENT_LEVITATION *)
        bSystemReady := TRUE;
        bLaunchActive := FALSE;
        
        (* Establish initial flux field and lock levitation air-gap *)
        IF ABS(rDynamic_AirGap_Error_mm) < 0.50 THEN
            (* Levitation stabilized at nominal 12.0 mm setpoint - initiate trajectory *)
            iMainState := 30;
            rLaunchElapsedTime_Sec := 0.0;
        END_IF;

    30: (* STATE_TRAJECTORY_ACCEL *)
        bSystemReady := TRUE;
        bLaunchActive := TRUE;
        bEmergencyDecelActive := FALSE;
        rLaunchElapsedTime_Sec := rLaunchElapsedTime_Sec + rDeltaTime_Sec;

        (* Check for Target Muzzle Velocity Achievement (1,000 km/h) *)
        IF rEstimated_AbsoluteVelocity_kmh >= rTarget_LaunchVelocity_kmh THEN
            iMainState := 50;
        END_IF;

        (* Check for Intermediate Stator Handover Trigger *)
        IF bHandoverInProgress THEN
            iMainState := 40;
        END_IF;

        (* Check for Category 1 Abort Trigger *)
        IF udiFaultRegister_Cat1_FastAbort <> 0 THEN
            iMainState := 60;
        END_IF;

    40: (* STATE_BLOCK_HANDOVER_EXEC *)
        bSystemReady := TRUE;
        bLaunchActive := TRUE;
        rLaunchElapsedTime_Sec := rLaunchElapsedTime_Sec + rDeltaTime_Sec;
        rHandoverElapsedTime_Sec := rHandoverElapsedTime_Sec + rDeltaTime_Sec;

        (* Check for Handover Completion *)
        IF NOT bHandoverInProgress THEN
            rHandoverElapsedTime_Sec := 0.0;
            iMainState := 30; (* Return to primary acceleration *)
        END_IF;

        (* Handover Timeout Protection (> 250 milliseconds in overlap zone) *)
        IF rHandoverElapsedTime_Sec > 0.250 THEN
            udiFaultRegister_Cat1_FastAbort := udiFaultRegister_Cat1_FastAbort OR 16#00002000;
            iMainState := 60;
        END_IF;

        IF udiFaultRegister_Cat1_FastAbort <> 0 THEN
            iMainState := 60;
        END_IF;

    50: (* STATE_COAST_TERMINAL_RELEASE *)
        bSystemReady := TRUE;
        bLaunchActive := FALSE;
        bMuzzleReleaseSignal := TRUE; (* Trigger electromagnetic separation latch *)

        (* Ramp Down Inverter Currents Smoothly *)
        rInverter_DirectAxisCurrent_kA := 0.0;
        rInverter_QuadratureAxisCurrent_kA := 0.0;

        IF NOT bMasterEnable THEN
            iMainState := 0; (* Return to cold init on sequence completion *)
        END_IF;

    60: (* STATE_REGENERATIVE_BRAKE *)
        bSystemReady := FALSE;
        bLaunchActive := FALSE;
        bEmergencyDecelActive := TRUE;

        (* Apply Maximum Controlled Dynamic Regenerative Retardation *)
        rRegenBrake_Iq_Cmd_kA := (rAbort_TargetDecel_ms2 * rVEHICLE_MASS_NOMINAL_kg * 0.001) / rTHRUST_FORCE_COEFF_kN_per_kA;
        IF rRegenBrake_Iq_Cmd_kA > rMAX_STATOR_CURRENT_RMS_kA THEN
            rRegenBrake_Iq_Cmd_kA := rMAX_STATOR_CURRENT_RMS_kA;
        END_IF;

        (* If Vehicle Stopped, De-energize completely *)
        IF rObs_Vel_ms < 0.25 THEN
            rInverter_DirectAxisCurrent_kA := 0.0;
            rInverter_QuadratureAxisCurrent_kA := 0.0;
            bEmergencyDecelActive := FALSE;
            IF NOT bMasterEnable THEN
                iMainState := 0;
            END_IF;
        END_IF;

    99: (* STATE_EMERGENCY_SHUTDOWN (SIL-3 Category 0) *)
        bSystemReady := FALSE;
        bLaunchActive := FALSE;
        bEmergencyDecelActive := FALSE;
        bInverterTrip_ActiveBlock := TRUE;
        bInverterTrip_NextBlock := TRUE;
        
        (* Invalidate Voltage Commands *)
        rInverter_DirectAxisVoltage_kV := 0.0;
        rInverter_QuadratureAxisVoltage_kV := 0.0;
        rInverter_DirectAxisCurrent_kA := 0.0;
        rInverter_QuadratureAxisCurrent_kA := 0.0;

        (* Quench Protection Activation if Magnet Cryo Compromised *)

IF NOT bEmergencyStop THEN
    (* Fail-Safe Deterministic De-energization: Trip all active heating, pumping, and acoustic power *)
    bSystemReady                := FALSE;
    bProcessActive              := FALSE;
    bBatchComplete              := FALSE;
    rPiezoDrivePower_W          := 0.0;
    rFeedPumpSpeed_RPM          := 0.0;
    rGasHeaterPower_kW          := 0.0;
    rAcousticIntensity_dB       := 0.0;
    bBlowbackSolenoidCmd        := FALSE;
    bHarvestValveCmd            := FALSE;

    (* Isolate cryogenic LN2 valve immediately to prevent thermal shock / over-pressurization *)
    rCryoN2InjValve_Pct         := 0.0;

    (* Maintain minimum nitrogen purge blower circulation if power intact to prevent duct condensation *)
    IF rChamberPressure_mbar > 50.0 THEN
        rFluidizationBlower_Pct := 10.0;
    ELSE
        rFluidizationBlower_Pct := 0.0;
    END_IF;

    dwFaultCode.0               := TRUE;      (* Bit 0: Emergency Stop Loop Tripped *)
    wStatusCode                 := 16#F000;   (* Emergency Trip Status Code *)
    wDegradationLevel           := 3;         (* Level 3: Hard Safety Shutdown *)
    bAlarmPresent               := TRUE;
    iState                      := 99;        (* Transfer directly to Emergency Trip Safe-Park *)
    RETURN;
END_IF;

dwFaultCode.0 := FALSE;

(* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
   LAYER 2: TRIPLE MODULAR REDUNDANCY (2oo3 TMR) SENSOR VOTING ENGINES
   --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* === 2.1: Ultrasonic Transducer Resonant Frequency TMR Voting Engine === *)
bFreqChA_Valid := (rUltrasonicFreq_A_kHz >= 25.0) AND (rUltrasonicFreq_A_kHz <= 75.0);
bFreqChB_Valid := (rUltrasonicFreq_B_kHz >= 25.0) AND (rUltrasonicFreq_B_kHz <= 75.0);
bFreqChC_Valid := (rUltrasonicFreq_C_kHz >= 25.0) AND (rUltrasonicFreq_C_kHz <= 75.0);

rFreqDeltaAB := ABS(rUltrasonicFreq_A_kHz - rUltrasonicFreq_B_kHz);
rFreqDeltaBC := ABS(rUltrasonicFreq_B_kHz - rUltrasonicFreq_C_kHz);
rFreqDeltaCA := ABS(rUltrasonicFreq_C_kHz - rUltrasonicFreq_A_kHz);

IF bFreqChA_Valid AND bFreqChB_Valid AND bFreqChC_Valid THEN
    IF (rFreqDeltaAB <= rTmrFreqTolerance_kHz) AND (rFreqDeltaBC <= rTmrFreqTolerance_kHz) AND (rFreqDeltaCA <= rTmrFreqTolerance_kHz) THEN
        (* All three frequency channels within tight resonance band - 3oo3 Consensus *)
        rVotedResonantFreq_kHz  := (rUltrasonicFreq_A_kHz + rUltrasonicFreq_B_kHz + rUltrasonicFreq_C_kHz) / 3.0;
        iHealthyFreqSensorCount := 3;
        dwFaultCode.1           := FALSE; (* Clear frequency divergence flag *)
    ELSIF (rFreqDeltaAB <= rTmrFreqTolerance_kHz) AND (rFreqDeltaBC > rTmrFreqTolerance_kHz) AND (rFreqDeltaCA > rTmrFreqTolerance_kHz) THEN
        (* Channel C divergent: Vote Channels A & B *)
        rVotedResonantFreq_kHz  := (rUltrasonicFreq_A_kHz + rUltrasonicFreq_B_kHz) / 2.0;
        bFreqChC_Valid          := FALSE;
        iHealthyFreqSensorCount := 2;
        dwFaultCode.1           := TRUE;  (* Frequency Channel C Divergence Warning *)
    ELSIF (rFreqDeltaBC <= rTmrFreqTolerance_kHz) AND (rFreqDeltaAB > rTmrFreqTolerance_kHz) AND (rFreqDeltaCA > rTmrFreqTolerance_kHz) THEN
        (* Channel A divergent: Vote Channels B & C *)
        rVotedResonantFreq_kHz  := (rUltrasonicFreq_B_kHz + rUltrasonicFreq_C_kHz) / 2.0;
        bFreqChA_Valid          := FALSE;
        iHealthyFreqSensorCount := 2;
        dwFaultCode.1           := TRUE;  (* Frequency Channel A Divergence Warning *)
    ELSIF (rFreqDeltaCA <= rTmrFreqTolerance_kHz) AND (rFreqDeltaAB > rTmrFreqTolerance_kHz) AND (rFreqDeltaBC > rTmrFreqTolerance_kHz) THEN
        (* Channel B divergent: Vote Channels C & A *)
        rVotedResonantFreq_kHz  := (rUltrasonicFreq_C_kHz + rUltrasonicFreq_A_kHz) / 2.0;
        bFreqChB_Valid          := FALSE;
        iHealthyFreqSensorCount := 2;
        dwFaultCode.1           := TRUE;  (* Frequency Channel B Divergence Warning *)
    ELSE
        (* Complete Frequency TMR Incoherence: Fallback to Channel A, latch critical diagnostic *)
        rVotedResonantFreq_kHz  := rUltrasonicFreq_A_kHz;
        iHealthyFreqSensorCount := 1;
        dwFaultCode.2           := TRUE;  (* Severe Ultrasonic Transducer TMR Loss *)
    END_IF;
ELSIF bFreqChA_Valid AND bFreqChB_Valid THEN
    rVotedResonantFreq_kHz      := (rUltrasonicFreq_A_kHz + rUltrasonicFreq_B_kHz) / 2.0;
    iHealthyFreqSensorCount     := 2;
    dwFaultCode.1               := TRUE;
ELSIF bFreqChB_Valid AND bFreqChC_Valid THEN
    rVotedResonantFreq_kHz      := (rUltrasonicFreq_B_kHz + rUltrasonicFreq_C_kHz) / 2.0;
    iHealthyFreqSensorCount     := 2;
    dwFaultCode.1               := TRUE;
ELSIF bFreqChC_Valid AND bFreqChA_Valid THEN
    rVotedResonantFreq_kHz      := (rUltrasonicFreq_C_kHz + rUltrasonicFreq_A_kHz) / 2.0;
    iHealthyFreqSensorCount     := 2;
    dwFaultCode.1               := TRUE;
ELSIF bFreqChA_Valid THEN
    rVotedResonantFreq_kHz      := rUltrasonicFreq_A_kHz;
    iHealthyFreqSensorCount     := 1;
    dwFaultCode.2               := TRUE;
ELSIF bFreqChB_Valid THEN
    rVotedResonantFreq_kHz      := rUltrasonicFreq_B_kHz;
    iHealthyFreqSensorCount     := 1;
    dwFaultCode.2               := TRUE;
ELSIF bFreqChC_Valid THEN
    rVotedResonantFreq_kHz      := rUltrasonicFreq_C_kHz;
    iHealthyFreqSensorCount     := 1;
    dwFaultCode.2               := TRUE;
ELSE
    (* Total Transducer Sensor Loss: Default safe resonance frequency 48.0 kHz *)
    rVotedResonantFreq_kHz      := 48.0;
    iHealthyFreqSensorCount     := 0;
    dwFaultCode.2               := TRUE;
END_IF;

(* === 2.2: Fluidized Bed Core Temperature (PT100) 2oo3 TMR Voting Engine === *)
bTempChA_Valid := (rBedTemp_SensorA_degC >= -180.0) AND (rBedTemp_SensorA_degC <= 50.0);
bTempChB_Valid := (rBedTemp_SensorB_degC >= -180.0) AND (rBedTemp_SensorB_degC <= 50.0);
bTempChC_Valid := (rBedTemp_SensorC_degC >= -180.0) AND (rBedTemp_SensorC_degC <= 50.0);

rTempDeltaAB := ABS(rBedTemp_SensorA_degC - rBedTemp_SensorB_degC);
rTempDeltaBC := ABS(rBedTemp_SensorB_degC - rBedTemp_SensorC_degC);
rTempDeltaCA := ABS(rBedTemp_SensorC_degC - rBedTemp_SensorA_degC);

IF bTempChA_Valid AND bTempChB_Valid AND bTempChC_Valid THEN
    IF (rTempDeltaAB <= rTmrTempTolerance_degC) AND (rTempDeltaBC <= rTmrTempTolerance_degC) AND (rTempDeltaCA <= rTmrTempTolerance_degC) THEN
        rVotedBedTemp_degC      := (rBedTemp_SensorA_degC + rBedTemp_SensorB_degC + rBedTemp_SensorC_degC) / 3.0;
        iHealthyTempSensorCount := 3;
        dwFaultCode.3           := FALSE;
    ELSIF (rTempDeltaAB <= rTmrTempTolerance_degC) AND (rTempDeltaBC > rTmrTempTolerance_degC) AND (rTempDeltaCA > rTmrTempTolerance_degC) THEN
        rVotedBedTemp_degC      := (rBedTemp_SensorA_degC + rBedTemp_SensorB_degC) / 2.0;
        bTempChC_Valid          := FALSE;
        iHealthyTempSensorCount := 2;
        dwFaultCode.3           := TRUE;  (* Temperature Channel C Divergence Warning *)
    ELSIF (rTempDeltaBC <= rTmrTempTolerance_degC) AND (rTempDeltaAB > rTmrTempTolerance_degC) AND (rTempDeltaCA > rTmrTempTolerance_degC) THEN
        rVotedBedTemp_degC      := (rBedTemp_SensorB_degC + rBedTemp_SensorC_degC) / 2.0;
        bTempChA_Valid          := FALSE;
        iHealthyTempSensorCount := 2;
        dwFaultCode.3           := TRUE;  (* Temperature Channel A Divergence Warning *)
    ELSIF (rTempDeltaCA <= rTmrTempTolerance_degC) AND (rTempDeltaAB > rTmrTempTolerance_degC) AND (rTempDeltaBC > rTmrTempTolerance_degC) THEN
        rVotedBedTemp_degC      := (rBedTemp_SensorC_degC + rBedTemp_SensorA_degC) / 2.0;
        bTempChB_Valid          := FALSE;
        iHealthyTempSensorCount := 2;
        dwFaultCode.3           := TRUE;  (* Temperature Channel B Divergence Warning *)
    ELSE
        (* Total Temperature Incoherence: Max selector for safety against cake melting *)
        rVotedBedTemp_degC      := MAX(rBedTemp_SensorA_degC, MAX(rBedTemp_SensorB_degC, rBedTemp_SensorC_degC));
        iHealthyTempSensorCount := 1;
        dwFaultCode.4           := TRUE;  (* Severe Temperature TMR Incoherence Fault *)
    END_IF;
ELSIF bTempChA_Valid AND bTempChB_Valid THEN
    rVotedBedTemp_degC          := (rBedTemp_SensorA_degC + rBedTemp_SensorB_degC) / 2.0;
    iHealthyTempSensorCount     := 2;
    dwFaultCode.3               := TRUE;
ELSIF bTempChB_Valid AND bTempChC_Valid THEN
    rVotedBedTemp_degC          := (rBedTemp_SensorB_degC + rBedTemp_SensorC_degC) / 2.0;
    iHealthyTempSensorCount     := 2;
    dwFaultCode.3               := TRUE;
ELSIF bTempChC_Valid AND bTempChA_Valid THEN
    rVotedBedTemp_degC          := (rBedTemp_SensorC_degC + rBedTemp_SensorA_degC) / 2.0;
    iHealthyTempSensorCount     := 2;
    dwFaultCode.3               := TRUE;
ELSIF bTempChA_Valid THEN
    rVotedBedTemp_degC          := rBedTemp_SensorA_degC;
    iHealthyTempSensorCount     := 1;
    dwFaultCode.4               := TRUE;
ELSIF bTempChB_Valid THEN
    rVotedBedTemp_degC          := rBedTemp_SensorB_degC;
    iHealthyTempSensorCount     := 1;
    dwFaultCode.4               := TRUE;
ELSIF bTempChC_Valid THEN
    rVotedBedTemp_degC          := rBedTemp_SensorC_degC;
    iHealthyTempSensorCount     := 1;
    dwFaultCode.4               := TRUE;
ELSE
    (* Total RTD Sensor Loss: Force conservative safe trip value *)
    rVotedBedTemp_degC          := 0.0;
    iHealthyTempSensorCount     := 0;
    dwFaultCode.4               := TRUE;
END_IF;

(* Evaluate Overall Redundancy Degradation Level *)
IF (iHealthyFreqSensorCount = 3) AND (iHealthyTempSensorCount = 3) THEN
    wDegradationLevel := 0; (* Nominal Dual-TMR Integrity *)
ELSIF (iHealthyFreqSensorCount >= 2) AND (iHealthyTempSensorCount >= 2) THEN
    wDegradationLevel := 1; (* 1oo2 Degraded Redundancy *)
ELSE
    wDegradationLevel := 2; (* Severely Degraded / Fallback Limp Mode *)
END_IF;

(* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
   LAYER 3: PROCESS FILTERING, PSYCHROMETRIC MASS TRANSFER & KALMAN OBSERVER
   --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* First-order lag (PT1) digital filtering *)
rFilteredDewPoint_degC     := rFilteredDewPoint_degC + rFilterAlphaDewPoint * (rExhaustDewPoint_degC - rFilteredDewPoint_degC);
rFilteredBedDP_mbar        := rFilteredBedDP_mbar + rFilterAlphaDP * (rBedPressureDrop_mbar - rFilteredBedDP_mbar);
rFilteredChamberPress_mbar := rFilteredChamberPress_mbar + rFilterAlphaPress * (rChamberPressure_mbar - rFilteredChamberPress_mbar);

(* Real-Time Atmospheric Ice Sublimation Mass Flux Calculation:
   Gaseous nitrogen carrier mass flow carrying sublimated vapor:
   P_sat_ice (Pa) = 611.15 * exp(22.542 * (T_dew / (T_dew + 273.15)))
   Y_vapor (kg H2O / kg dry gas) = 0.622 * (P_vapor / (P_total - P_vapor))
   Sublimation Rate (g/min) = Flow (m3/h) * rho_N2 * Y_vapor * 1000 / 60
*)
IF rFilteredDewPoint_degC > -75.0 THEN
    rSublimationRate_g_min := (rFluidBedGasFlow_m3_h * 1.16) * (EXP(0.082 * (rFilteredDewPoint_degC + 50.0))) * 0.42;
    IF rSublimationRate_g_min < 0.0 THEN
        rSublimationRate_g_min := 0.0;
    ELSIF rSublimationRate_g_min > 85.0 THEN
        rSublimationRate_g_min := 85.0; (* Physical sublimation rate ceiling *)
    END_IF;
ELSE
    rSublimationRate_g_min := 0.0;
END_IF;

(* State-Space Observer / Kalman Innovation Update:
   Compute innovation between measured voted temperature and model prediction *)
rObserverInnovation_Temp := rVotedBedTemp_degC - (rSublimationCeiling_degC + rState_EstTempDev_degC);

(* Correct estimated states using Kalman observer gains *)
rState_EstTempDev_degC  := rState_EstTempDev_degC + rKalmanGain_K1 * rObserverInnovation_Temp;
rState_EstMoisture_Pct := rState_EstMoisture_Pct - (rKalmanGain_K2 * (rSublimationRate_g_min * 0.025));

IF rState_EstMoisture_Pct < 0.5 THEN
    rProductMoistureEst_Pct := 0.5;
ELSIF rState_EstMoisture_Pct > 100.0 THEN
    rProductMoistureEst_Pct := 100.0;
ELSE
    rProductMoistureEst_Pct := rState_EstMoisture_Pct;
END_IF;

(* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
   LAYER 4: REVERSE PULSE-JET FILTER CLEANING EXECUTIVE
   --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
tBlowbackIntervalTimer(IN := (iState = 30) OR (iState = 40), PT := T#45S);
IF tBlowbackIntervalTimer.Q OR bFilterBlowbackTrigger THEN
    tBlowbackIntervalTimer(IN := FALSE);
    bFilterBlowbackActive := TRUE;
END_IF;

tBlowbackPulseTimer(IN := bFilterBlowbackActive, PT := T#250MS);
IF tBlowbackPulseTimer.Q THEN
    tBlowbackPulseTimer(IN := FALSE);
    bFilterBlowbackActive   := FALSE;
    bBlowbackSolenoidCmd    := FALSE;
ELSIF bFilterBlowbackActive THEN
    bBlowbackSolenoidCmd    := TRUE; (* Fire high-pressure sterile N2 reverse jet *)
END_IF;

(* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
   LAYER 5: ISA-88 CONTINUOUS STATE MACHINE SEQUENCING
   --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
CASE iState OF

    0: (* STATE_STANDBY_INERT: Aseptic nitrogen purging & pre-flight diagnostics *)
        bSystemReady                := FALSE;
        bProcessActive              := FALSE;
        bBatchComplete              := FALSE;
        rPiezoDrivePower_W          := 0.0;
        rFeedPumpSpeed_RPM          := 0.0;
        rCryoN2InjValve_Pct         := 0.0;
        rFluidizationBlower_Pct     := 15.0; (* Low purge velocity to displace air *)
        rGasHeaterPower_kW          := 0.0;
        rAcousticIntensity_dB       := 0.0;
        bBlowbackSolenoidCmd        := FALSE;
        bHarvestValveCmd            := FALSE;
        wStatusCode                 := 16#0001;

        (* Interlock: Vessel headspace residual O2 must be < 20 PPM for aseptic solvent inertness *)
        IF (rVesselOxygenPPM < 20.0) AND (wDegradationLevel <= 1) AND bSystemEnable THEN
            bSystemReady := TRUE;
            IF bRecipeStart THEN
                iState := 10; (* Advance to Cryogenic Pre-Chill *)
            END_IF;
        ELSE
            bSystemReady := FALSE;
            IF rVesselOxygenPPM >= 20.0 THEN
                dwFaultCode.5 := TRUE; (* Headspace Inertization Incomplete Warning *)
            END_IF;
        END_IF;

    10: (* STATE_CRYOGENIC_PRECHILL: Freezing tower and bed pre-cooling down to -125.0 deg C *)
        bSystemReady                := TRUE;
        bProcessActive              := TRUE;
        rPiezoDrivePower_W          := 0.0;
        rFeedPumpSpeed_RPM          := 0.0;
        rFluidizationBlower_Pct     := 20.0;
        rGasHeaterPower_kW          := 0.0;
        rAcousticIntensity_dB       := 0.0;
        wStatusCode                 := 16#0010;

        (* Modulate Cryogenic Liquid Nitrogen valve to cool freezing tower *)
        IF rFreezingChamberTemp_degC > -125.0 THEN
            rCryoN2InjValve_Pct := MIN(100.0, (rFreezingChamberTemp_degC - (-125.0)) * 2.2);
        ELSE
            rCryoN2InjValve_Pct := 12.0; (* Base maintenance cryogenic frost trim *)
        END_IF;

        (* Dwell until cryogenic tower and fluidized bed basin reach equilibrium *)
        tStateTimer(IN := (rFreezingChamberTemp_degC <= -120.0) AND (rVotedBedTemp_degC <= -40.0), PT := T#60S);
        IF tStateTimer.Q THEN
            tStateTimer(IN := FALSE);
            iState := 20; (* Advance to Ultrasonic Atomization & Droplet Freezing *)
        END_IF;

        IF bRecipeAbort THEN
            iState := 80;
        END_IF;

    20: (* STATE_ULTRASONIC_ATOMIZATION_FREEZE: Piezo excitation, micro-droplet flash freezing *)
        bSystemReady                := TRUE;
        bProcessActive              := TRUE;
        wStatusCode                 := 16#0020;

        (* Lock Ultrasonic Generator to voted resonance frequency (e.g. 48.0 kHz) at 220 W RF power *)
        rPiezoDrivePower_W          := 220.0;
        
        (* Low-frequency acoustic field in bed to prevent early frozen droplet sintering *)
        rAcousticIntensity_dB       := 95.0;

        (* Cryogenic nitrogen injection loop maintains -125.0 deg C counter-current freezing plume *)
        IF rFreezingChamberTemp_degC > -120.0 THEN
            rCryoN2InjValve_Pct := 85.0;
        ELSE
            rCryoN2InjValve_Pct := 42.0;
        END_IF;

        (* Maintain light bed fluidization to distribute arriving frozen micro-spheres *)
        rFluidizationBlower_Pct     := 30.0;
        rGasHeaterPower_kW          := 0.0;

        (* Stabilize ultrasonic acoustic horn prior to engaging liquid formulation feed pump *)
        tUltrasonicStabilizeTimer(IN := TRUE, PT := T#5S);
        IF tUltrasonicStabilizeTimer.Q THEN
            (* Meter sterile API formulation at recipe setpoint (e.g. 35.0 mL/min) *)
            rFeedPumpSpeed_RPM := 75.0; (* Corresponds to 35.0 mL/min *)
            rTotalFormulationDosed_mL := rTotalFormulationDosed_mL + (rFeedFlowRate_mL_min / 60.0);
        END_IF;

        (* Complete atomization phase after target batch volume dosed (e.g. 5000 mL) *)
        IF rTotalFormulationDosed_mL >= 5000.0 THEN
            rFeedPumpSpeed_RPM := 0.0;
            tUltrasonicStabilizeTimer(IN := FALSE);
            
            (* Dwell for final falling micro-droplets to freeze and settle into bed *)
            tStateTimer(IN := TRUE, PT := T#20S);
            IF tStateTimer.Q THEN
                tStateTimer(IN := FALSE);
                rPiezoDrivePower_W  := 0.0;
                rCryoN2InjValve_Pct := 0.0; (* Isolate cryogenic liquid N2 injection *)
                iState              := 30;  (* Transition to Primary Fluidized Bed Sublimation *)
            END_IF;
        END_IF;

        IF bRecipeAbort THEN
            iState := 80;
        END_IF;

    30: (* STATE_PRIMARY_ATMOSPHERIC_SUBLIMATION: Acoustic fluidization & Model Predictive Control *)
        bSystemReady                := TRUE;
        bProcessActive              := TRUE;
        rPiezoDrivePower_W          := 0.0;
        rFeedPumpSpeed_RPM          := 0.0;
        rCryoN2InjValve_Pct         := 0.0;
        wStatusCode                 := 16#0030;

        (* Engage high-intensity acoustic field to break Geldart Group C cohesive powder channeling *)
        rAcousticIntensity_dB       := rAcousticSublimation_dB; (* 118 dB sound pressure *)

        (* Superficial fluidization gas velocity regulation: maintain bubbling regime above U_mf *)
        rFluidizationBlower_Pct     := 68.0;

        (* --- DISCRETE MODEL PREDICTIVE HEATER REGULATION --- *)
        (* Target: Sublimation ceiling = -31.0 deg C (safe below Tg' -28.5 deg C).
           Solve 1-step receding horizon thermal compensation:
           delta_T_bed = rA11 * delta_T_prev + rA12 * delta_Moisture + rB11 * u_heater + rB12 * u_flow
        *)
        IF rVotedBedTemp_degC < (rSublimationCeiling_degC - 0.5) THEN
            (* Bed colder than ceiling: Modulate gas heater power to provide endothermic sublimation latent heat *)
            rGasHeaterPower_kW := ((rSublimationCeiling_degC - rVotedBedTemp_degC) * 2.8) 
                                + (rSublimationRate_g_min * 0.125);
            (* Respect SCR thyristor mechanical rating *)
            IF rGasHeaterPower_kW > rHeaterMax_kW THEN
                rGasHeaterPower_kW := rHeaterMax_kW;
            ELSIF rGasHeaterPower_kW < 0.0 THEN
                rGasHeaterPower_kW := 0.0;
            END_IF;
        ELSE
            (* Critical thermal margin approach: Instantly drop electric heater to zero *)
            rGasHeaterPower_kW := 0.0;
        END_IF;

        (* Integrate cumulative sublimated water mass *)
        rTotalSublimatedMass_g := rTotalSublimatedMass_g + (rSublimationRate_g_min / 60.0);

        (* Sublimation Endpoint Detection: Exhaust dew point drops below -52.0 deg C and moisture < 8.0% *)
        IF (rFilteredDewPoint_degC <= rCriticalDewPointDry_degC) AND (rProductMoistureEst_Pct <= 8.0) THEN
            tStateTimer(IN := TRUE, PT := T#90S);
            IF tStateTimer.Q THEN
                tStateTimer(IN := FALSE);
                iState := 40; (* Advance to Secondary Desorption *)
            END_IF;
        ELSE
            tStateTimer(IN := FALSE);
        END_IF;

        (* Graceful degradation check *)
        IF wDegradationLevel >= 2 THEN
            iState := 80;
        END_IF;

        IF bRecipeAbort THEN
            iState := 80;
        END_IF;

    40: (* STATE_SECONDARY_DESORPTION: Controlled thermal ramp to +22 deg C to desorb bound water *)
        bSystemReady                := TRUE;
        bProcessActive              := TRUE;
        wStatusCode                 := 16#0040;

        (* Reduce acoustic intensity to prevent excessive particulate attrition of dry porous cakes *)
        rAcousticIntensity_dB       := rAcousticSecondary_dB; (* 85 dB *)

        (* Maintain gentle fluidization *)
        rFluidizationBlower_Pct     := 52.0;

        (* Controlled temperature ramp (+0.3 deg C/min) towards secondary terminal setpoint +22.0 deg C *)
        IF rVotedBedTemp_degC < rSecondaryDesorptionTemp_degC THEN
            rGasHeaterPower_kW := (rSecondaryDesorptionTemp_degC - rVotedBedTemp_degC) * 0.85;
            IF rGasHeaterPower_kW > 6.0 THEN
                rGasHeaterPower_kW := 6.0; (* Limit heater power during secondary drying *)
            END_IF;
        ELSE
            rGasHeaterPower_kW := 0.5; (* Base holding heat *)
        END_IF;

        (* Secondary Drying Termination: Target final moisture reached (< 1.25% w/w) and dew point < -60 deg C *)
        IF (rProductMoistureEst_Pct <= rTargetFinalMoisture_Pct) AND (rFilteredDewPoint_degC <= -60.0) THEN
            tStateTimer(IN := TRUE, PT := T#120S);
            IF tStateTimer.Q THEN
                tStateTimer(IN := FALSE);
                iState := 50; (* Advance to Product Harvest *)
            END_IF;
        ELSE
            tStateTimer(IN := FALSE);
        END_IF;

        IF bRecipeAbort THEN
            iState := 80;
        END_IF;

    50: (* STATE_PRODUCT_HARVEST: Filter blowback, bed cooling, aseptic bottom discharge *)
        bSystemReady                := FALSE;
        bProcessActive              := TRUE;
        rPiezoDrivePower_W          := 0.0;
        rFeedPumpSpeed_RPM          := 0.0;
        rCryoN2InjValve_Pct         := 0.0;
        rGasHeaterPower_kW          := 0.0;
        wStatusCode                 := 16#0050;

        (* Step 5.1: Execute multi-pulse HEPA filter reverse blowback to dislodge all cake fines *)
        tStateTimer(IN := TRUE, PT := T#30S);
        IF NOT tStateTimer.Q THEN
            rFluidizationBlower_Pct := 15.0;
            bBlowbackSolenoidCmd    := TRUE;
            bHarvestValveCmd        := FALSE;
            rAcousticIntensity_dB   := 100.0; (* Assist powder dislodgement *)
        ELSE
            (* Step 5.2: Open bottom harvest valve and empty fluidized bed vessel *)
            bBlowbackSolenoidCmd    := FALSE;
            rFluidizationBlower_Pct := 10.0;
            rAcousticIntensity_dB   := 75.0;  (* Hopper discharge acoustic fluidization *)
            bHarvestValveCmd        := TRUE;

            (* Confirm harvest butterfly valve fully opened via position feedback *)
            IF rHarvestValvePosFeedback >= 98.0 THEN
                tSafePurgeDwellTimer(IN := TRUE, PT := T#60S);
                IF tSafePurgeDwellTimer.Q THEN

                    tStateTimer(IN := FALSE);

    rSolubility_T2                  : REAL;     (* Equilibrium solubility Stage 2 [g/L] *)

    rBarrierGradient_S2             : REAL;     (* Stage 2 MSZW barrier gradient *)

    rProposedU                      : REAL;     (* Actuator candidate value *)
    bHardwarePermissivesMet         : BOOL;     (* Hardware permissive status *)

(*
====================================================================================================
  CYCLIC EXECUTION MODULE 1: SIL-3 HARDWARE WATCHDOG, PERMISSIVES & SAFETY TRIP LOGIC
====================================================================================================
*)
dwCycleCounter := dwCycleCounter + 1;

tHeartbeatBlinker(IN := NOT tHeartbeatBlinker.Q, PT := T#500MS);
IF tHeartbeatBlinker.Q THEN
    bHeartbeatBit := NOT bHeartbeatBit;
END_IF;

(* Master Safety Circuit Interlock (Active Low: FALSE = Immediate Safety Trip) *)
IF NOT bEmergencyTrip THEN
    iStateStep := 70; (* Emergency Abort Solvent Quench *)
    bEmergencyDumpActive := TRUE;
    bContinuousRunning := FALSE;
    bSystemReady := FALSE;
    bGeneralAlarm := TRUE;
    wAlarmBitmask.0 := TRUE; (* SIL-3 Emergency Stop Tripped *)

    rStage1_JacketValveCmd := 0.0;
    rStage2_JacketValveCmd := 0.0;
    rInterstagePumpSpeedCmd := 0.0;
    rSlurryProductDischargeCmd := 0.0;
    rUltrasonicPowerCmd := 0.0;
    rSeedSlurryDosingCmd := 0.0;
    iCurrentOperatingState := iStateStep;
    RETURN;
END_IF;

bHardwarePermissivesMet := bEnable AND (rStage1_SlurryLevel > 50.0) AND (rStage2_SlurryLevel > 50.0);
IF NOT bHardwarePermissivesMet AND (iStateStep > 20) AND (iStateStep < 60) THEN
    iStateStep := 60; (* Controlled Depletion Hold *)
    wAlarmBitmask.1 := TRUE; (* Operational Interlock Tripped *)
END_IF;

IF bAcknowledgeFaults THEN
    wAlarmBitmask.1 := FALSE;
    wAlarmBitmask.4 := FALSE;
    wAlarmBitmask.7 := FALSE;
    wAlarmBitmask.8 := FALSE;
    wAlarmBitmask.11 := FALSE;
    wAlarmBitmask.12 := FALSE;
    wAlarmBitmask.14 := FALSE;
    wAlarmBitmask.15 := FALSE;
    IF iStateStep = 99 THEN
        iStateStep := 0;
    END_IF;
END_IF;

(*
====================================================================================================
  CYCLIC EXECUTION MODULE 2: TRIPLE MODULAR REDUNDANCY (2oo3) TEMPERATURE INSTRUMENTATION VOTING
====================================================================================================
*)
(* Stage 1 Slurry Temperature 2oo3 Evaluation *)
rTempMedianBuffer[1] := rStage1_TempSensors[1];
rTempMedianBuffer[2] := rStage1_TempSensors[2];
rTempMedianBuffer[3] := rStage1_TempSensors[3];

FOR iIdx := 1 TO 2 DO
    FOR jIdx := 1 TO 3 - iIdx DO
        IF rTempMedianBuffer[jIdx] > rTempMedianBuffer[jIdx + 1] THEN
            rSwapTemp := rTempMedianBuffer[jIdx];
            rTempMedianBuffer[jIdx] := rTempMedianBuffer[jIdx + 1];
            rTempMedianBuffer[jIdx + 1] := rSwapTemp;
        END_IF;
    END_FOR;
END_FOR;

iS1_HealthyCount := 0;
FOR iIdx := 1 TO 3 DO
    IF ABS(rStage1_TempSensors[iIdx] - rTempMedianBuffer[2]) > rDiscrepancyThreshold THEN
        rS1_SensorDiscrepancyTimer[iIdx] := rS1_SensorDiscrepancyTimer[iIdx] + 0.100;
        IF rS1_SensorDiscrepancyTimer[iIdx] > 2.000 THEN
            bS1_SensorHealthy[iIdx] := FALSE;
        END_IF;
    ELSE
        rS1_SensorDiscrepancyTimer[iIdx] := 0.0;
        bS1_SensorHealthy[iIdx] := TRUE;
    END_IF;
    IF bS1_SensorHealthy[iIdx] THEN
        iS1_HealthyCount := iS1_HealthyCount + 1;
    END_IF;
END_FOR;

IF iS1_HealthyCount = 3 THEN
    rVotedStage1_Temp := rTempMedianBuffer[2];
    bDegradedSensorMode := FALSE;
ELSIF iS1_HealthyCount = 2 THEN
    rTempAccumulator := 0.0;
    FOR iIdx := 1 TO 3 DO
        IF bS1_SensorHealthy[iIdx] THEN
            rTempAccumulator := rTempAccumulator + rStage1_TempSensors[iIdx];
        END_IF;
    END_FOR;
    rVotedStage1_Temp := rTempAccumulator / 2.0;
    bDegradedSensorMode := TRUE;
    wAlarmBitmask.2 := TRUE; (* Stage 1 Single Channel Failure (1oo2 Active) *)
ELSIF iS1_HealthyCount = 1 THEN
    FOR iIdx := 1 TO 3 DO
        IF bS1_SensorHealthy[iIdx] THEN
            rVotedStage1_Temp := rStage1_TempSensors[iIdx];
        END_IF;
    END_FOR;
    bDegradedSensorMode := TRUE;
    wAlarmBitmask.3 := TRUE; (* Stage 1 Dual Channel Failure (1oo1 Fallback) *)
ELSE
    wAlarmBitmask.4 := TRUE; (* Stage 1 Complete Sensor Loss *)
    iStateStep := 70;
END_IF;

(* Stage 2 Slurry Temperature 2oo3 Evaluation *)
rTempMedianBuffer[1] := rStage2_TempSensors[1];
rTempMedianBuffer[2] := rStage2_TempSensors[2];
rTempMedianBuffer[3] := rStage2_TempSensors[3];

FOR iIdx := 1 TO 2 DO
    FOR jIdx := 1 TO 3 - iIdx DO
        IF rTempMedianBuffer[jIdx] > rTempMedianBuffer[jIdx + 1] THEN
            rSwapTemp := rTempMedianBuffer[jIdx];
            rTempMedianBuffer[jIdx] := rTempMedianBuffer[jIdx + 1];
            rTempMedianBuffer[jIdx + 1] := rSwapTemp;
        END_IF;
    END_FOR;
END_FOR;

iS2_HealthyCount := 0;
FOR iIdx := 1 TO 3 DO
    IF ABS(rStage2_TempSensors[iIdx] - rTempMedianBuffer[2]) > rDiscrepancyThreshold THEN
        rS2_SensorDiscrepancyTimer[iIdx] := rS2_SensorDiscrepancyTimer[iIdx] + 0.100;
        IF rS2_SensorDiscrepancyTimer[iIdx] > 2.000 THEN
            bS2_SensorHealthy[iIdx] := FALSE;
        END_IF;
    ELSE
        rS2_SensorDiscrepancyTimer[iIdx] := 0.0;
        bS2_SensorHealthy[iIdx] := TRUE;
    END_IF;
    IF bS2_SensorHealthy[iIdx] THEN
        iS2_HealthyCount := iS2_HealthyCount + 1;
    END_IF;
END_FOR;

IF iS2_HealthyCount = 3 THEN
    rVotedStage2_Temp := rTempMedianBuffer[2];
ELSIF iS2_HealthyCount = 2 THEN
    rTempAccumulator := 0.0;
    FOR iIdx := 1 TO 3 DO
        IF bS2_SensorHealthy[iIdx] THEN
            rTempAccumulator := rTempAccumulator + rStage2_TempSensors[iIdx];
        END_IF;
    END_FOR;
    rVotedStage2_Temp := rTempAccumulator / 2.0;
    bDegradedSensorMode := TRUE;
    wAlarmBitmask.5 := TRUE; (* Stage 2 Single Channel Failure *)
ELSIF iS2_HealthyCount = 1 THEN
    FOR iIdx := 1 TO 3 DO
        IF bS2_SensorHealthy[iIdx] THEN
            rVotedStage2_Temp := rStage2_TempSensors[iIdx];
        END_IF;
    END_FOR;
    bDegradedSensorMode := TRUE;
    wAlarmBitmask.6 := TRUE; (* Stage 2 Dual Channel Failure *)
ELSE
    wAlarmBitmask.7 := TRUE; (* Stage 2 Complete Sensor Loss *)
    iStateStep := 70;
END_IF;

(*
====================================================================================================
  CYCLIC EXECUTION MODULE 3: THERMODYNAMIC SOLUBILITY, KINETICS & SUPERSATURATION ENGINE
====================================================================================================
*)
rSolubility_T1 := rSolub_a0 + (rSolub_a1 * rVotedStage1_Temp)
                 + (rSolub_a2 * rVotedStage1_Temp * rVotedStage1_Temp)
                 + (rSolub_a3 * rVotedStage1_Temp * rVotedStage1_Temp * rVotedStage1_Temp);
IF rSolubility_T1 < 1.0 THEN
    rSolubility_T1 := 1.0;
END_IF;

rSolubility_T2 := rSolub_a0 + (rSolub_a1 * rVotedStage2_Temp)
                 + (rSolub_a2 * rVotedStage2_Temp * rVotedStage2_Temp)
                 + (rSolub_a3 * rVotedStage2_Temp * rVotedStage2_Temp * rVotedStage2_Temp);
IF rSolubility_T2 < 1.0 THEN
    rSolubility_T2 := 1.0;
END_IF;

IF bFirstScan THEN
    rEstimatedSoluteConc_C1 := rFeedSoluteConc * 0.75;
    rEstimatedSoluteConc_C2 := rFeedSoluteConc * 0.40;
    bFirstScan := FALSE;
ELSE
    rEstimatedSoluteConc_C1 := rEstimatedSoluteConc_C1 + 0.005 * (rFeedSoluteConc - rEstimatedSoluteConc_C1)
                              - 0.001 * (rFBRM_MediumCounts_Filtered * 0.05);
    rEstimatedSoluteConc_C2 := rEstimatedSoluteConc_C2 + 0.005 * (rEstimatedSoluteConc_C1 - rEstimatedSoluteConc_C2)
                              - 0.001 * (rFBRM_CoarseCounts_Filtered * 0.08);
END_IF;

rEstimatedSupersaturation_S1 := rEstimatedSoluteConc_C1 / rSolubility_T1;
rEstimatedSupersaturation_S2 := rEstimatedSoluteConc_C2 / rSolubility_T2;

IF rEstimatedSupersaturation_S1 < 0.80 THEN
    rEstimatedSupersaturation_S1 := 0.80;
ELSIF rEstimatedSupersaturation_S1 > 2.50 THEN
    rEstimatedSupersaturation_S1 := 2.50;
END_IF;

IF rEstimatedSupersaturation_S2 < 0.80 THEN
    rEstimatedSupersaturation_S2 := 0.80;
ELSIF rEstimatedSupersaturation_S2 > 2.50 THEN
    rEstimatedSupersaturation_S2 := 2.50;
END_IF;

IF rEstimatedSupersaturation_S1 > (1.0 + rDelta_S_MSZW_Base) THEN
    wAlarmBitmask.8 := TRUE; (* Stage 1 Metastable Limit Exceeded *)
END_IF;
IF rEstimatedSupersaturation_S2 > (1.0 + rDelta_S_MSZW_Base) THEN
    wAlarmBitmask.9 := TRUE; (* Stage 2 Metastable Limit Exceeded *)
END_IF;

rCrystalSuspensionDensity_M_T := rCrystalDensity_rho_c * rCrystalShapeFactor_kv
                               * (rFBRM_CoarseCounts_Filtered * 1.8E-5 + rFBRM_MediumCounts_Filtered * 3.5E-6);
IF rCrystalSuspensionDensity_M_T < 0.0 THEN
    rCrystalSuspensionDensity_M_T := 0.0;
ELSIF rCrystalSuspensionDensity_M_T > 350.0 THEN
    rCrystalSuspensionDensity_M_T := 350.0;
    wAlarmBitmask.10 := TRUE; (* Slurry Rheological Choke Warning *)
END_IF;

(*
====================================================================================================
  CYCLIC EXECUTION MODULE 4: IN-SITU FBRM CHORD LENGTH DISTRIBUTION (CLD) FILTERING & METRICS
====================================================================================================
*)
rFBRM_FinesCounts_Filtered := (rEWMA_Alpha_FBRM * rFBRM_FinesCounts_1_10um)
                            + ((1.0 - rEWMA_Alpha_FBRM) * rFBRM_FinesCounts_Filtered);
