           - Exhalation stroke (+v_ax, air rushing from OWC chamber to atmosphere) creates positive relative velocity W,
             generating aerodynamic lift L and drag D whose resultant tangential force F_tangential drives the rotor forward.
           - Inhalation stroke (-v_ax, air rushing from atmosphere into OWC chamber) inverts the sign of lift and drag,
             producing an identical positive tangential driving torque vector in the EXACT SAME rotational direction:
                 F_tangential = L * sin(alpha) - D * cos(alpha) > 0
       The non-dimensional blade flow coefficient phi is defined as the ratio of axial duct velocity to blade peripheral speed:
           phi = |v_ax| / U_mean = |v_ax| / (omega * r_mean)
       where:
           alpha = arctan(phi) = Aerodynamic effective angle of attack at mean blade radius [rad],
           omega = Rotor angular rotational velocity [rad/s] = (2 * pi * N_rpm) / 60.0.

       CRITICAL STALL COLLAPSE MECHANISM:
       For typical thick NACA profiles, boundary-layer detachment occurs when the flow coefficient exceeds the critical
       aerodynamic stall limit:
           phi > phi_stall_crit (approx. 0.280 .. 0.300, corresponding to alpha_stall approx. 14.5 .. 15.8 deg).
       Upon boundary layer separation:
           a) Rotor aerodynamic driving torque drops abruptly by up to 70-80% (aerodynamic stall cliff),
           b) Pneumatic impedance of the turbine increases sharply, spiking OWC chamber internal pressure p_c,
           c) Intense cyclically fluctuating pressure pulses induce destructive aero-elastic blade flutter,
           d) The Permanent Magnet Synchronous Generator (PMSG) loses load matching, inducing shaft torsion resonance.
       Therefore, active prevention of aerodynamic stall via coordinated fast bypass relief valve throttling and
       high-bandwidth PMSG electromagnetic torque damping is the primary mission-critical cyber-physical mandate.

    3. MULTIVARIABLE DISCRETE STATE-SPACE MODEL & MODEL PREDICTIVE CONTROL (MPC):
       To prevent stall while maximizing electrical wave power harvesting (Maximum Power Point Tracking - MPPT),
       the subsystem executes a discrete linear parameter-varying state-space formulation with receding horizon:
           x[k+1] = A_d * x[k] + B_d * u[k] + E_d * d[k]
           y[k]   = C_d * x[k] + D_d * u[k]
       State Vector x:
           x[0] = Delta_p_c : Deviation of chamber pressure from hydrostatic baseline [mbar]
           x[1] = Delta_omega: Deviation of rotor speed from wave-adapted optimal trajectory [rpm]
           x[2] = phi       : Dimensionless Wells turbine blade flow coefficient [-]
       Control Input Vector u:
           u[0] = T_gen_cmd : PMSG electromagnetic counter-torque demand [kNm]
           u[1] = Theta_byp : High-speed pneumatic bypass valve angular position [deg] (0=Closed, 90=Full Vent)
       Disturbance Vector d:
           d[0] = v_wave    : Estimated vertical water column piston velocity A_owc * dz_w/dt [m/s]
           d[1] = Hs        : Ocean significant wave height [m]
       The discrete cost function minimized over prediction horizon N_p = 2 penalizes stall proximity and power loss:
           J = SUM_j=1..Np [ (phi[k+j] - phi_target)^2 * Q_phi + (p_c[k+j])^2 * Q_press + (omega[k+j] - omega_opt)^2 * Q_spd ]
               + SUM_j=0..Nu-1 [ (Delta_T_gen[k+j])^2 * R_tau + (Theta_byp[k+j])^2 * R_byp ]
       Subject to hard constraints:
           phi[k+j] <= 0.260 (Safety stall margin below 0.285 critical cliff)
           0.0 <= Theta_byp <= 90.0 deg
           0.0 <= T_gen_cmd <= T_gen_max [kNm]

    4. TRIPLE MODULAR REDUNDANCY (2oo3 TMR) VOTING & FAULT TOLERANCE:
       Marine installations suffer from severe bio-fouling, saline aerosol deposition, and sea-spray salt crusting.
       Triple redundant physical instrumentation is deployed:
           - PT_01, PT_02, PT_03: Piezoresistive marine differential chamber pressure transmitters.
           - FT_01, FT_02, FT_03: Bi-directional ultrasonic / multi-point differential pitot duct flowmeters.
           - ST_01, ST_02, ST_03: Dual-core optical / magnetic absolute shaft encoders on PMSG rotor.
       The voting core implements median-select 2oo3 logic with inter-channel discrepancy detection.
       If any sensor drifts beyond calibrated engineering tolerances for > 150 ms, the voting engine isolates
       the degraded channel, generates an ISA-18.2 Priority 2 alarm, and gracefully transitions to 1oo2 or 1oo1.

    5. ISA-88 STATE MACHINE & ISA-18.2 COMPREHENSIVE ALARM ENGINE:
       Automates system lifecycle across 9 deterministic operating states:
           0  : UNINITIALIZED_COLD_BOOT
           10 : HYDROSTATIC_STANDBY_EQUILIBRIUM
           20 : PNEUMATIC_PRE_SYNC_ACCELERATION
           30 : OPTIMAL_BIDIRECTIONAL_MPPT_GENERATION
           40 : PROACTIVE_AERODYNAMIC_STALL_SHEDDING
           50 : EXTREME_SEA_STORM_DEPRESSURIZATION
           60 : WATER_SLUG_CREST_INTERCEPT
           90 : CONTROLLED_REGENERATIVE_DECELERATION
           99 : EMERGENCY_FAILSAFE_SHUTDOWN_LATCH
========================================================================================================================
*)

(*
========================================================================================================================
  LAYER 1: SENSOR INGESTION & TRIPLE MODULAR REDUNDANCY (2oo3 TMR) VOTING ENGINE
========================================================================================================================

(* --- 1.1 OWC Air Chamber Differential Pressure Transducers (PT_01, PT_02, PT_03) --- *)
(* Plausibility range check: -150.0 mbar to +150.0 mbar *)
bPT01_Valid := (rChamberPressure_PT01 >= -150.0) AND (rChamberPressure_PT01 <= 150.0);
bPT02_Valid := (rChamberPressure_PT02 >= -150.0) AND (rChamberPressure_PT02 <= 150.0);
bPT03_Valid := (rChamberPressure_PT03 >= -150.0) AND (rChamberPressure_PT03 <= 150.0);

(* Inter-channel delta computation *)
rDeltaPT12 := ABS(rChamberPressure_PT01 - rChamberPressure_PT02);
rDeltaPT23 := ABS(rChamberPressure_PT02 - rChamberPressure_PT03);
rDeltaPT31 := ABS(rChamberPressure_PT03 - rChamberPressure_PT01);

(* Check divergence timer *)
tPT_DivergenceTimer(
    IN := ((rDeltaPT12 > rPT_ToleranceLimit_mbar) OR (rDeltaPT23 > rPT_ToleranceLimit_mbar) OR (rDeltaPT31 > rPT_ToleranceLimit_mbar)),
    PT := T#150MS
);

(* Channel isolation upon sustained discrepancy *)
IF tPT_DivergenceTimer.Q THEN
    IF (rDeltaPT12 > rPT_ToleranceLimit_mbar) AND (rDeltaPT31 > rPT_ToleranceLimit_mbar) THEN
        bPT01_Valid := FALSE; (* PT01 isolated *)
    ELSIF (rDeltaPT12 > rPT_ToleranceLimit_mbar) AND (rDeltaPT23 > rPT_ToleranceLimit_mbar) THEN
        bPT02_Valid := FALSE; (* PT02 isolated *)
    ELSIF (rDeltaPT23 > rPT_ToleranceLimit_mbar) AND (rDeltaPT31 > rPT_ToleranceLimit_mbar) THEN
        bPT03_Valid := FALSE; (* PT03 isolated *)
    END_IF;
END_IF;

iHealthy_PT_Count := BOOL_TO_INT(bPT01_Valid) + BOOL_TO_INT(bPT02_Valid) + BOOL_TO_INT(bPT03_Valid);

(* 2oo3 Voting / Graceful Degradation Resolution *)
IF iHealthy_PT_Count = 3 THEN
    (* Standard Median-Select 2oo3 Logic *)
    IF ((rChamberPressure_PT01 >= rChamberPressure_PT02) AND (rChamberPressure_PT01 <= rChamberPressure_PT03)) OR
       ((rChamberPressure_PT01 >= rChamberPressure_PT03) AND (rChamberPressure_PT01 <= rChamberPressure_PT02)) THEN
        rChamberPressure_Voted_mbar := rChamberPressure_PT01;
    ELSIF ((rChamberPressure_PT02 >= rChamberPressure_PT01) AND (rChamberPressure_PT02 <= rChamberPressure_PT03)) OR
          ((rChamberPressure_PT02 >= rChamberPressure_PT03) AND (rChamberPressure_PT02 <= rChamberPressure_PT01)) THEN
        rChamberPressure_Voted_mbar := rChamberPressure_PT02;
    ELSE
        rChamberPressure_Voted_mbar := rChamberPressure_PT03;
    END_IF;
ELSIF iHealthy_PT_Count = 2 THEN
    (* 1oo2 Degraded Mode: Average of two surviving channels *)
    IF bPT01_Valid AND bPT02_Valid THEN
        rChamberPressure_Voted_mbar := (rChamberPressure_PT01 + rChamberPressure_PT02) * 0.5;
    ELSIF bPT02_Valid AND bPT03_Valid THEN
        rChamberPressure_Voted_mbar := (rChamberPressure_PT02 + rChamberPressure_PT03) * 0.5;
    ELSE
        rChamberPressure_Voted_mbar := (rChamberPressure_PT01 + rChamberPressure_PT03) * 0.5;
    END_IF;
ELSIF iHealthy_PT_Count = 1 THEN
    (* 1oo1 Degraded Mode: Sole survivor *)
    IF bPT01_Valid THEN
        rChamberPressure_Voted_mbar := rChamberPressure_PT01;
    ELSIF bPT02_Valid THEN
        rChamberPressure_Voted_mbar := rChamberPressure_PT02;
    ELSE
        rChamberPressure_Voted_mbar := rChamberPressure_PT03;
    END_IF;
ELSE
    (* Total Sensor Collapse *)
    rChamberPressure_Voted_mbar := 0.0;
    bTrip_AllSensorsFailed := TRUE;
END_IF;


(* --- 1.2 Bi-Directional Duct Airflow Velocity Transmitters (FT_01, FT_02, FT_03) --- *)
(* Plausibility range check: -45.0 m/s to +45.0 m/s *)
bFT01_Valid := (rDuctAirVelocity_FT01 >= -45.0) AND (rDuctAirVelocity_FT01 <= 45.0);
bFT02_Valid := (rDuctAirVelocity_FT02 >= -45.0) AND (rDuctAirVelocity_FT02 <= 45.0);
bFT03_Valid := (rDuctAirVelocity_FT03 >= -45.0) AND (rDuctAirVelocity_FT03 <= 45.0);

rDeltaFT12 := ABS(rDuctAirVelocity_FT01 - rDuctAirVelocity_FT02);
rDeltaFT23 := ABS(rDuctAirVelocity_FT02 - rDuctAirVelocity_FT03);
rDeltaFT31 := ABS(rDuctAirVelocity_FT03 - rDuctAirVelocity_FT01);

tFT_DivergenceTimer(
    IN := ((rDeltaFT12 > rFT_ToleranceLimit_ms) OR (rDeltaFT23 > rFT_ToleranceLimit_ms) OR (rDeltaFT31 > rFT_ToleranceLimit_ms)),
    PT := T#150MS
);

IF tFT_DivergenceTimer.Q THEN
    IF (rDeltaFT12 > rFT_ToleranceLimit_ms) AND (rDeltaFT31 > rFT_ToleranceLimit_ms) THEN
        bFT01_Valid := FALSE;
    ELSIF (rDeltaFT12 > rFT_ToleranceLimit_ms) AND (rDeltaFT23 > rFT_ToleranceLimit_ms) THEN
        bFT02_Valid := FALSE;
    ELSIF (rDeltaFT23 > rFT_ToleranceLimit_ms) AND (rDeltaFT31 > rFT_ToleranceLimit_ms) THEN
        bFT03_Valid := FALSE;
    END_IF;
END_IF;

iHealthy_FT_Count := BOOL_TO_INT(bFT01_Valid) + BOOL_TO_INT(bFT02_Valid) + BOOL_TO_INT(bFT03_Valid);

IF iHealthy_FT_Count = 3 THEN
    IF ((rDuctAirVelocity_FT01 >= rDuctAirVelocity_FT02) AND (rDuctAirVelocity_FT01 <= rDuctAirVelocity_FT03)) OR
       ((rDuctAirVelocity_FT01 >= rDuctAirVelocity_FT03) AND (rDuctAirVelocity_FT01 <= rDuctAirVelocity_FT02)) THEN
        rAirVelocity_Voted_ms := rDuctAirVelocity_FT01;
    ELSIF ((rDuctAirVelocity_FT02 >= rDuctAirVelocity_FT01) AND (rDuctAirVelocity_FT02 <= rDuctAirVelocity_FT03)) OR
          ((rDuctAirVelocity_FT02 >= rDuctAirVelocity_FT03) AND (rDuctAirVelocity_FT02 <= rDuctAirVelocity_FT01)) THEN
        rAirVelocity_Voted_ms := rDuctAirVelocity_FT02;
    ELSE
        rAirVelocity_Voted_ms := rDuctAirVelocity_FT03;
    END_IF;
ELSIF iHealthy_FT_Count = 2 THEN
    IF bFT01_Valid AND bFT02_Valid THEN
        rAirVelocity_Voted_ms := (rDuctAirVelocity_FT01 + rDuctAirVelocity_FT02) * 0.5;
    ELSIF bFT02_Valid AND bFT03_Valid THEN
        rAirVelocity_Voted_ms := (rDuctAirVelocity_FT02 + rDuctAirVelocity_FT03) * 0.5;
    ELSE
        rAirVelocity_Voted_ms := (rDuctAirVelocity_FT01 + rDuctAirVelocity_FT03) * 0.5;
    END_IF;
ELSIF iHealthy_FT_Count = 1 THEN
    IF bFT01_Valid THEN
        rAirVelocity_Voted_ms := rDuctAirVelocity_FT01;
    ELSIF bFT02_Valid THEN
        rAirVelocity_Voted_ms := rDuctAirVelocity_FT02;
    ELSE
        rAirVelocity_Voted_ms := rDuctAirVelocity_FT03;
    END_IF;
ELSE
    rAirVelocity_Voted_ms := 0.0;
    bTrip_AllSensorsFailed := TRUE;
END_IF;


(* --- 1.3 PMSG Rotor Shaft Speed Encoders (ST_01, ST_02, ST_03) --- *)
(* Plausibility range check: 0.0 rpm to 2500.0 rpm *)
bST01_Valid := (rRotorSpeed_ST01 >= 0.0) AND (rRotorSpeed_ST01 <= 2500.0);
bST02_Valid := (rRotorSpeed_ST02 >= 0.0) AND (rRotorSpeed_ST02 <= 2500.0);
bST03_Valid := (rRotorSpeed_ST03 >= 0.0) AND (rRotorSpeed_ST03 <= 2500.0);

rDeltaST12 := ABS(rRotorSpeed_ST01 - rRotorSpeed_ST02);
rDeltaST23 := ABS(rRotorSpeed_ST02 - rRotorSpeed_ST03);
rDeltaST31 := ABS(rRotorSpeed_ST03 - rRotorSpeed_ST01);

tST_DivergenceTimer(
    IN := ((rDeltaST12 > rST_ToleranceLimit_rpm) OR (rDeltaST23 > rST_ToleranceLimit_rpm) OR (rDeltaST31 > rST_ToleranceLimit_rpm)),
    PT := T#150MS
);

IF tST_DivergenceTimer.Q THEN
    IF (rDeltaST12 > rST_ToleranceLimit_rpm) AND (rDeltaST31 > rST_ToleranceLimit_rpm) THEN
        bST01_Valid := FALSE;

                               + (aB_Matrix[1,0] * rCand_T)     + (aB_Matrix[1,1] * rCand_B)     + (aE_Disturb[1] * rAirVelocity_Voted_ms);

            aState_X_Pred1[2] := (aA_Matrix[2,0] * aState_X[0]) + (aA_Matrix[2,1] * aState_X[1]) + (aA_Matrix[2,2] * aState_X[2])
                               + (aB_Matrix[2,0] * rCand_T)     + (aB_Matrix[2,1] * rCand_B)     + (aE_Disturb[2] * rSignificantWaveHeight_Hs);

                               + (aB_Matrix[0,0] * rCand_T)          + (aB_Matrix[0,1] * rCand_B);

            aState_X_Pred2[1] := (aA_Matrix[1,0] * aState_X_Pred1[0]) + (aA_Matrix[1,1] * aState_X_Pred1[1]) + (aA_Matrix[1,2] * aState_X_Pred1[2])

*)

VAR

    (* Controls u = [u_PumpB_pct, u_TotalFlow_mLmin]^T                           *)

    vecX_Pred : ARRAY[0..3] OF REAL;  (* Receding horizon predicted state vector *)

    (* ========================================================================= *)
    (* MODEL PREDICTIVE CONTROL (MPC) QUADRATIC COST SOLVER                      *)
    (* Minimizes: J = sum (y_hat - y_ref)^T * Q * (y_hat - y_ref) + delta_u^T * R * delta_u *)
    (* Horizon: N_p = 5 prediction steps, N_c = 2 control steps                  *)
    (* ========================================================================= *)
    rMPC_RefCond_mScm               : REAL := 2.5; (* Real-time conductivity reference trajectory [mS/cm] *)
    rMPC_RefFlow_mLmin              : REAL := 15.0;(* Real-time flow reference trajectory [mL/min] *)
    rMPC_WeightQ_Cond               : REAL := 12.5;(* State tracking weight on conductivity error *)
    rMPC_WeightQ_DeltaP             : REAL := 4.0; (* State tracking weight on pressure drop penalty *)
    rMPC_WeightR_PumpB              : REAL := 0.85;(* Control penalty on Buffer B slew rate *)
    rMPC_WeightR_Flow               : REAL := 0.15;(* Control penalty on flow rate slew rate *)
    rMPC_uB_Optimal_pct             : REAL := 0.0; (* Optimized control action for Pump B [%] *)
    rMPC_uFlow_Optimal_mLmin        : REAL := 15.0;(* Optimized total delivery flow [mL/min] *)
    rMPC_Last_uB_pct                : REAL := 0.0; (* Stored prior control command for slew rate limiting *)
    rMPC_Last_uFlow_mLmin           : REAL := 15.0;(* Stored prior flow command for slew rate limiting *)
    rCondModelTrackingError_mScm    : REAL := 0.0; (* Kalman/Luenberger observer innovation residual *)
    rObserverGain_L0                : REAL := 0.35;(* Observer correction gain for state 0 *)
    rObserverGain_L2                : REAL := 0.42;(* Observer correction gain for state 2 *)
    rMPC_Gradient_uB                : REAL := 0.0; (* Computed gradient vector element for Pump B *)
    rMPC_Gradient_uFlow             : REAL := 0.0; (* Computed gradient vector element for Flow *)
    rMPC_StepSize                   : REAL := 0.08;(* Gradient descent adaptation step size *)

    (* ========================================================================= *)
    (* 2oo3 TRIPLE MODULAR REDUNDANCY (TMR) SENSOR VOTING LOGIC                  *)
    (* Mid-value selection with discrepancy timers and graceful degradation      *)
    (* ========================================================================= *)
    bCond_SensorA_Valid             : BOOL := TRUE;
    bCond_SensorB_Valid             : BOOL := TRUE;
    bCond_SensorC_Valid             : BOOL := TRUE;
    rCond_DiscrepancyTimerA_s       : REAL := 0.0;
    rCond_DiscrepancyTimerB_s       : REAL := 0.0;
    rCond_DiscrepancyTimerC_s       : REAL := 0.0;

    bUV260_SensorA_Valid            : BOOL := TRUE;
    bUV260_SensorB_Valid            : BOOL := TRUE;

    rUV260_DiscrepancyTimerB_s      : REAL := 0.0;

    rUV280_DiscrepancyTimerB_s      : REAL := 0.0;

    (* ========================================================================= *)
    arrUV260_Window                 : ARRAY[0..4] OF REAL; (* Rolling historical buffer for UV260 *)
    arrUV280_Window                 : ARRAY[0..4] OF REAL; (* Rolling historical buffer for UV280 *)
    arrCond_Window                  : ARRAY[0..4] OF REAL; (* Rolling historical buffer for Cond *)
    iFilterSampleCount              : INT := 0;            (* Initializing buffer fill counter *)

    rUV260_Smoothed_mAU             : REAL := 0.0;
    rUV260_Slope_mAUs               : REAL := 0.0; (* First derivative d(UV260)/dt [mAU/s] *)
    rUV260_Curvature_mAUs2          : REAL := 0.0; (* Second derivative d2(UV260)/dt2 [mAU/s2] *)
    rPriorUV260_Slope_mAUs          : REAL := 0.0; (* Prior scan slope for zero-crossing detection *)

    rUV280_Smoothed_mAU             : REAL := 0.0;
    rUV280_Slope_mAUs               : REAL := 0.0; (* First derivative d(UV280)/dt [mAU/s] *)
    rUV280_Curvature_mAUs2          : REAL := 0.0; (* Second derivative d2(UV280)/dt2 [mAU/s2] *)

    bPeakLiftoffDetected            : BOOL := FALSE; (* UV signal rising above threshold slope *)
    bPeakApexDetected               : BOOL := FALSE; (* UV slope crossed zero with negative curvature *)
    bValleyNadirDetected            : BOOL := FALSE; (* Inter-peak valley minimum detected *)
    bBaselineReturnDetected         : BOOL := FALSE; (* Signal returned to baseline window *)

    (* ========================================================================= *)
    (* DUAL-WAVELENGTH (260/280) BEER-LAMBERT MATRIX PEAK DECONVOLUTION          *)

    rPathLength_cm                  : REAL := 0.20; (* [cm] Optical flow-cell path length *)
    rMatrixDeterminant              : REAL := 0.0;  (* Inversion matrix denominator *)

    rBaselineOffset280_mAU          : REAL := 0.0;  (* Autozero tare baseline offset at 280nm *)
    rDeconvolutedFull_mgmL          : REAL := 0.0;  (* Real-time resolved full capsid mass conc *)
    rDeconvolutedEmpty_mgmL         : REAL := 0.0;  (* Real-time resolved empty capsid mass conc *)
    rDeconvolutedTotal_mgmL         : REAL := 0.0;  (* Real-time resolved total capsid mass conc *)

    (* ========================================================================= *)

    rCriticalBreakthroughFrac       : REAL := 0.05; (* 5% breakthrough alert limit *)
    rCurrentBreakthroughFrac        : REAL := 0.0;  (* Instantaneous modeled C/C0 ratio *)

    rResinBedHeight_cm              : REAL := 10.0; (* Nominal packed bed length [cm] *)
    rResinCrossSection_cm2          : REAL := 2.50; (* Nominal bed cross-sectional area [cm2] *)
    rResinPorosity                  : REAL := 0.38; (* Interstitial bed void fraction *)

    (* ========================================================================= *)

    arrDelayBuffer_VolumeStamp_mL   : ARRAY[0..99] OF REAL; (* Circular queue storing cumulative volume stamp *)

    iDelayBufferTail                : INT := 0;             (* Extraction pointer *)
    iDelayBufferCount               : INT := 0;             (* Active entries count *)
    rLastQueuedVolume_mL            : REAL := 0.0;          (* Stamp of most recently queued transition *)

    (* ========================================================================= *)

    rCumulativeFullMassHarvest_mg   : REAL := 0.0;  (* Integrated mass of full capsids harvested [mg] *)
    rCumulativeEmptyMassDump_mg     : REAL := 0.0;  (* Integrated mass of empty capsids diverted [mg] *)
    rCumulativeTotalLoadedMass_mg   : REAL := 0.0;  (* Total estimated capsid mass loaded [mg] *)
    rMassConversionFactor_vg_to_mg  : REAL := 8.42E-12; (* [mg/vg] Nominal molar mass conversion for AAV *)

    (* ========================================================================= *)

    tEStopDebounceTimer             : TON;

    tGradientHoldTimer              : TON;

    (* ========================================================================= *)

    iLoopIdx                        : INT := 0;
    jLoopIdx                        : INT := 0;
    kLoopIdx                        : INT := 0;
    rTempCalcA                      : REAL := 0.0;
    rTempCalcB                      : REAL := 0.0;
    rTempCalcC                      : REAL := 0.0;
    rTempAbsDiffAB                  : REAL := 0.0;
    rTempAbsDiffBC                  : REAL := 0.0;
    rTempAbsDiffCA                  : REAL := 0.0;
    bFirstScan                      : BOOL := TRUE;
    rDeltaVolumeCycle_mL            : REAL := 0.0;
    rPredictedError_Cond            : REAL := 0.0;
    rPredictedError_DP              : REAL := 0.0;
    rStepGradientBaseConductivity   : REAL := 0.0;
    rTargetRampSlopeConductivity    : REAL := 0.0;
END_VAR


(* ==================================================================================================== *)
(* BLOCK INITIALIZATION & SYSTEM FIRST SCAN SETUP                                                       *)
(* ==================================================================================================== *)
IF bFirstScan THEN
    (* Initialize 4x4 State-Space Plant Dynamic Matrices *)
    (* State vector: x = [C_mix, dC_mix/dt, C_col_eff, Delta_P]^T *)
    matA[0,0] := 0.8845; matA[0,1] := 0.0421; matA[0,2] := 0.0000; matA[0,3] := 0.0000;
    matA[1,0] :=-0.1250; matA[1,1] := 0.7420; matA[1,2] := 0.0000; matA[1,3] := 0.0000;
    matA[2,0] := 0.0950; matA[2,1] := 0.0050; matA[2,2] := 0.8920; matA[2,3] := 0.0000;
    matA[3,0] := 0.0000; matA[3,1] := 0.0000; matA[3,2] := 0.0012; matA[3,3] := 0.9450;

    matB[0,0] := 0.1155; matB[0,1] := 0.0020;
    matB[1,0] := 0.1250; matB[1,1] := 0.0080;
    matB[2,0] := 0.0050; matB[2,1] := 0.0125;
    matB[3,0] := 0.0000; matB[3,1] := 0.0520;

    matC[0,0] := 0.0000; matC[0,1] := 0.0000; matC[0,2] := 1.0000; matC[0,3] := 0.0000;
    matC[1,0] := 0.0000; matC[1,1] := 0.0000; matC[1,2] := 0.0000; matC[1,3] := 1.0000;

    matD[0,0] := 0.0000; matD[0,1] := 0.0000;
    matD[1,0] := 0.0000; matD[1,1] := 0.0000;

    vecX[0] := 2.50; (* Initial buffer A conductivity at mixer *)
    vecX[1] := 0.00; (* Zero initial rate of change *)
    vecX[2] := 2.50; (* Initial column effluent conductivity *)
    vecX[3] := 0.25; (* Baseline hydraulic differential pressure *)

    (* Compute Beer-Lambert 2x2 Extinction Matrix Determinant *)
    rMatrixDeterminant := (rEpsilon_260_Full * rEpsilon_280_Empty) - (rEpsilon_260_Empty * rEpsilon_280_Full);

    (* Initialize Quaternary Ammonium Resin Bed Static Capacity *)
    IF (rResinStaticBindingCap_vgmL > 0.0) AND (rColumnVolume_mL > 0.0) THEN
        rResinBedCapacityTotal_vg := rResinStaticBindingCap_vgmL * rColumnVolume_mL;
    ELSE
        rResinBedCapacityTotal_vg := 1.50E14; (* Nominal default capacity 1.5e14 vg for 1 mL CIMac-QA *)
    END_IF;

    (* Initialize Savitzky-Golay FIR Filter Delay Windows with Baseline Estimates *)
    FOR iLoopIdx := 0 TO 4 DO
        arrUV260_Window[iLoopIdx] := 0.0;
        arrUV280_Window[iLoopIdx] := 0.0;
        arrCond_Window[iLoopIdx] := 2.5;
    END_FOR;

    (* Reset Circular Volumetric Dead-Leg Delay Queue *)
    FOR iLoopIdx := 0 TO 99 DO
        arrDelayBuffer_TargetPort[iLoopIdx] := 0;
        arrDelayBuffer_VolumeStamp_mL[iLoopIdx] := 0.0;
    END_FOR;
    iDelayBufferHead := 0;
    iDelayBufferTail := 0;
    iDelayBufferCount := 0;
    iQueuedPortPending := 0;

    (* Reset TMR Sensor Health Flags *)
    bCond_SensorA_Valid := TRUE;
    bCond_SensorB_Valid := TRUE;
    bCond_SensorC_Valid := TRUE;
    bUV260_SensorA_Valid := TRUE;
    bUV260_SensorB_Valid := TRUE;
    bUV260_SensorC_Valid := TRUE;
    bUV280_SensorA_Valid := TRUE;
    bUV280_SensorB_Valid := TRUE;
    bUV280_SensorC_Valid := TRUE;

    bFirstScan := FALSE;
END_IF;

(* ==================================================================================================== *)
(* SAFETY INSTRUMENTED SYSTEM (SIS) & CATEGORY A / B ALARM INTERLOCKS                                   *)
(* ==================================================================================================== *)

(* 1. Emergency Stop Hardwired Relay Loop Verification *)
tEStopDebounceTimer(IN := NOT bEStop_SafetyOK, PT := T#40MS);
IF tEStopDebounceTimer.Q THEN
    bSystemSafeHalt := TRUE;
    wPrimaryAlarmWord := wPrimaryAlarmWord OR 16#0001; (* Bit 0: Emergency Stop Loop De-energized *)
END_IF;

(* 2. Column Bed Differential Mechanical Overpressure Interlock *)
rColumnDeltaP_bar := rColInletPress_bar - rColOutletPress_bar;
tOverpressureDebounceTimer(IN := (rColumnDeltaP_bar > rMaxDeltaP_bar) AND (rMaxDeltaP_bar > 0.1), PT := T#150MS);
IF tOverpressureDebounceTimer.Q THEN
    bSystemSafeHalt := TRUE;
    wPrimaryAlarmWord := wPrimaryAlarmWord OR 16#0002; (* Bit 1: Packed Bed Delta-P Exceeded Structural Limit *)
END_IF;

(* 3. Ultrasonic Feed Line Air/Bubble Ingress Interlock (Protects Q-Resin Bed From Channeling) *)
tAirBubbleTripTimer(IN := bAirSensorInlet_Trip, PT := T#100MS);
IF tAirBubbleTripTimer.Q THEN
    wPrimaryAlarmWord := wPrimaryAlarmWord OR 16#0004; (* Bit 2: Optical/Ultrasonic Air Bubble Detected in Line *)
    (* Force bypass valve to waste without halting complete skid if enabled *)
    iQueuedPortPending := 0; (* Divert to waste *)
END_IF;

(* 4. Inappropriate CIP Mode Interlock Inhibit *)
IF bCIP_SIP_ModeActive AND (iSequenceState > 0) AND (iSequenceState < 110) THEN
    bSystemSafeHalt := TRUE;
    wPrimaryAlarmWord := wPrimaryAlarmWord OR 16#0008; (* Bit 3: CIP Mode Commanded During Active Separation Run *)
END_IF;

(* 5. Master Safety Fail-Safe Actuation Handler *)
IF bSystemSafeHalt THEN
    (* Immediate hydraulic safe posture: stop all metering pumps, close elution valve, vent to waste *)
    rPumpA_SpeedSetp_pct := 0.0;
    rPumpB_SpeedSetp_pct := 0.0;
    rMixerValve_PosSetp_pct := 0.0;
    rSystemFlowRate_mLmin := 0.0;
    wValveClusterStateWord := 16#0001; (* Bit 0: All fluid diverted to Waste / Dump line *)
    iActiveFractionIndex := 0;
    bFullCapsidHarvestActive := FALSE;
    bEmptyCapsidDivertActive := FALSE;
    iSequenceState := 130; (* Force Sequencer to EMERGENCY_SHUTDOWN_HALT *)
    wSkidStateWord := 16#F000 OR INT_TO_WORD(iSequenceState);
    
    (* If manual reset commanded with cleared conditions, allow restart *)
    IF bAckAlarms AND bEStop_SafetyOK AND (rColumnDeltaP_bar <= rMaxDeltaP_bar) THEN
        bSystemSafeHalt := FALSE;
        wPrimaryAlarmWord := 16#0000;
        iSequenceState := 0; (* Return to IDLE_SAFE *)
    END_IF;
    RETURN;
END_IF;

(* ==================================================================================================== *)
(* TRIPLE MODULAR REDUNDANCY (2oo3 TMR) ANALYTIC SENSOR VOTING LOGIC                                     *)
(* ==================================================================================================== *)

(* --- Sub-System 1: Post-Column Conductivity 2oo3 Voter --- *)
rTempAbsDiffAB := ABS(rPostCol_Cond_ChA_mScm - rPostCol_Cond_ChB_mScm);
rTempAbsDiffBC := ABS(rPostCol_Cond_ChB_mScm - rPostCol_Cond_ChC_mScm);
rTempAbsDiffCA := ABS(rPostCol_Cond_ChC_mScm - rPostCol_Cond_ChA_mScm);

(* Discrepancy accumulation and fault tagging for Channel A *)
IF (rTempAbsDiffAB > rTMR_MaxCondTolerance_mScm) AND (rTempAbsDiffCA > rTMR_MaxCondTolerance_mScm) THEN
    rCond_DiscrepancyTimerA_s := rCond_DiscrepancyTimerA_s + rCycleTime_s;
    IF rCond_DiscrepancyTimerA_s >= rTMR_DiscrepancyTimeout_s THEN
        bCond_SensorA_Valid := FALSE;
    END_IF;
ELSE
    rCond_DiscrepancyTimerA_s := MAX(0.0, rCond_DiscrepancyTimerA_s - (0.5 * rCycleTime_s));
END_IF;

(* Discrepancy accumulation and fault tagging for Channel B *)
IF (rTempAbsDiffAB > rTMR_MaxCondTolerance_mScm) AND (rTempAbsDiffBC > rTMR_MaxCondTolerance_mScm) THEN
    rCond_DiscrepancyTimerB_s := rCond_DiscrepancyTimerB_s + rCycleTime_s;

    END_IF;
ELSE
    rCond_DiscrepancyTimerB_s := MAX(0.0, rCond_DiscrepancyTimerB_s - (0.5 * rCycleTime_s));
END_IF;

(* Discrepancy accumulation and fault tagging for Channel C *)
IF (rTempAbsDiffBC > rTMR_MaxCondTolerance_mScm) AND (rTempAbsDiffCA > rTMR_MaxCondTolerance_mScm) THEN
    rCond_DiscrepancyTimerC_s := rCond_DiscrepancyTimerC_s + rCycleTime_s;

END_IF;

(* Mid-Value Selection and Graceful Degradation for Conductivity *)
IF bCond_SensorA_Valid AND bCond_SensorB_Valid AND bCond_SensorC_Valid THEN
    (* All 3 channels healthy: True Mid-Value Selection (Median) *)
    IF ((rPostCol_Cond_ChA_mScm >= rPostCol_Cond_ChB_mScm) AND (rPostCol_Cond_ChA_mScm <= rPostCol_Cond_ChC_mScm)) OR
       ((rPostCol_Cond_ChA_mScm >= rPostCol_Cond_ChC_mScm) AND (rPostCol_Cond_ChA_mScm <= rPostCol_Cond_ChB_mScm)) THEN
        rBlendedConductivity_mScm := rPostCol_Cond_ChA_mScm;
    ELSIF ((rPostCol_Cond_ChB_mScm >= rPostCol_Cond_ChA_mScm) AND (rPostCol_Cond_ChB_mScm <= rPostCol_Cond_ChC_mScm)) OR
          ((rPostCol_Cond_ChB_mScm >= rPostCol_Cond_ChC_mScm) AND (rPostCol_Cond_ChB_mScm <= rPostCol_Cond_ChA_mScm)) THEN
        rBlendedConductivity_mScm := rPostCol_Cond_ChB_mScm;
    ELSE
        rBlendedConductivity_mScm := rPostCol_Cond_ChC_mScm;
    END_IF;
    bWarningDegradedSensorMode := FALSE;
ELSIF bCond_SensorA_Valid AND bCond_SensorB_Valid THEN
    (* 2oo3 degraded to 1oo2: Average Channels A & B *)
    rBlendedConductivity_mScm := (rPostCol_Cond_ChA_mScm + rPostCol_Cond_ChB_mScm) * 0.50;
    bWarningDegradedSensorMode := TRUE;
    wSecondaryAlarmWord := wSecondaryAlarmWord OR 16#0001; (* Bit 0: Cond Channel C Divergence Warning *)
ELSIF bCond_SensorB_Valid AND bCond_SensorC_Valid THEN
    (* 2oo3 degraded to 1oo2: Average Channels B & C *)
    rBlendedConductivity_mScm := (rPostCol_Cond_ChB_mScm + rPostCol_Cond_ChC_mScm) * 0.50;
    bWarningDegradedSensorMode := TRUE;
    wSecondaryAlarmWord := wSecondaryAlarmWord OR 16#0002; (* Bit 1: Cond Channel A Divergence Warning *)
ELSIF bCond_SensorA_Valid AND bCond_SensorC_Valid THEN
    (* 2oo3 degraded to 1oo2: Average Channels A & C *)
    rBlendedConductivity_mScm := (rPostCol_Cond_ChA_mScm + rPostCol_Cond_ChC_mScm) * 0.50;
    bWarningDegradedSensorMode := TRUE;
    wSecondaryAlarmWord := wSecondaryAlarmWord OR 16#0004; (* Bit 2: Cond Channel B Divergence Warning *)
ELSIF bCond_SensorA_Valid THEN

    rBlendedConductivity_mScm := rPostCol_Cond_ChA_mScm;
    bWarningDegradedSensorMode := TRUE;

ELSIF bCond_SensorB_Valid THEN

ELSE
    (* Total TMR Analytical Sensor Collapse: Revert to State-Space Predictive Observer Estimate *)
    rBlendedConductivity_mScm := vecX[2];
    wPrimaryAlarmWord := wPrimaryAlarmWord OR 16#0010; (* Bit 4: Total Loss of Column Conductivity Sensing *)

(* --- Sub-System 2: Dual UV Absorbance at 260 nm 2oo3 Voter --- *)
rTempAbsDiffAB := ABS(rUV260_ChA_mAU - rUV260_ChB_mAU);
rTempAbsDiffBC := ABS(rUV260_ChB_mAU - rUV260_ChC_mAU);
rTempAbsDiffCA := ABS(rUV260_ChC_mAU - rUV260_ChA_mAU);

IF (rTempAbsDiffAB > rTMR_MaxUVTolerance_mAU) AND (rTempAbsDiffCA > rTMR_MaxUVTolerance_mAU) THEN

IF bUV260_SensorA_Valid AND bUV260_SensorB_Valid AND bUV260_SensorC_Valid THEN

    ELSIF ((rUV260_ChB_mAU >= rUV260_ChA_mAU) AND (rUV260_ChB_mAU <= rUV260_ChC_mAU)) OR

ELSIF bUV260_SensorA_Valid AND bUV260_SensorB_Valid THEN

ELSIF bUV260_SensorB_Valid AND bUV260_SensorC_Valid THEN

ELSIF bUV260_SensorA_Valid AND bUV260_SensorC_Valid THEN

ELSIF bUV260_SensorA_Valid THEN

ELSIF bUV260_SensorB_Valid THEN

    ELSIF ((rUV280_ChB_mAU >= rUV280_ChA_mAU) AND (rUV280_ChB_mAU <= rUV280_ChC_mAU)) OR
          ((rUV280_ChB_mAU >= rUV280_ChC_mAU) AND (rUV280_ChB_mAU <= rUV280_ChA_mAU)) THEN

ELSIF bUV280_SensorA_Valid AND bUV280_SensorB_Valid THEN

ELSIF bUV280_SensorB_Valid AND bUV280_SensorC_Valid THEN

    bWarningDegradedSensorMode := TRUE;
ELSIF bUV280_SensorA_Valid AND bUV280_SensorC_Valid THEN
    rUV280_Voted_mAU := (rUV280_ChA_mAU + rUV280_ChC_mAU) * 0.50;

(* ==================================================================================================== *)
(* SAVITZKY-GOLAY 5-POINT FILTER & CHROMATOGRAPHIC PEAK DERIVATIVES                                     *)
(* ==================================================================================================== *)

(* Roll History Buffers (Window index 0 is newest, 4 is oldest) *)
arrUV260_Window[4] := arrUV260_Window[3];
arrUV260_Window[3] := arrUV260_Window[2];
arrUV260_Window[2] := arrUV260_Window[1];
arrUV260_Window[1] := arrUV260_Window[0];
arrUV260_Window[0] := rUV260_Voted_mAU - rBaselineOffset260_mAU;

arrUV280_Window[4] := arrUV280_Window[3];
arrUV280_Window[3] := arrUV280_Window[2];
arrUV280_Window[2] := arrUV280_Window[1];
arrUV280_Window[1] := arrUV280_Window[0];
arrUV280_Window[0] := rUV280_Voted_mAU - rBaselineOffset280_mAU;

arrCond_Window[4] := arrCond_Window[3];
arrCond_Window[3] := arrCond_Window[2];
arrCond_Window[2] := arrCond_Window[1];
arrCond_Window[1] := arrCond_Window[0];
arrCond_Window[0] := rBlendedConductivity_mScm;

(* Compute Savitzky-Golay 2nd Order Polynomial Smoothing & Derivatives *)
(* Gram Polynomial Filter Coefficients for N=5, M=2 *)
rUV260_Smoothed_mAU := ((-3.0 * arrUV260_Window[4]) + (12.0 * arrUV260_Window[3]) + (17.0 * arrUV260_Window[2]) + (12.0 * arrUV260_Window[1]) - (3.0 * arrUV260_Window[0])) / 35.0;

IF rCycleTime_s > 0.001 THEN
    (* 1st Derivative (Slope) d(UV)/dt *)
    rUV260_Slope_mAUs := ((-2.0 * arrUV260_Window[4]) - (1.0 * arrUV260_Window[3]) + (0.0 * arrUV260_Window[2]) + (1.0 * arrUV260_Window[1]) + (2.0 * arrUV260_Window[0])) / (10.0 * rCycleTime_s);
    
    (* 2nd Derivative (Curvature) d2(UV)/dt2 *)
    rUV260_Curvature_mAUs2 := ((2.0 * arrUV260_Window[4]) - (1.0 * arrUV260_Window[3]) - (2.0 * arrUV260_Window[2]) - (1.0 * arrUV260_Window[1]) + (2.0 * arrUV260_Window[0])) / (7.0 * rCycleTime_s * rCycleTime_s);

    rUV280_Smoothed_mAU := ((-3.0 * arrUV280_Window[4]) + (12.0 * arrUV280_Window[3]) + (17.0 * arrUV280_Window[2]) + (12.0 * arrUV280_Window[1]) - (3.0 * arrUV280_Window[0])) / 35.0;
    rUV280_Slope_mAUs := ((-2.0 * arrUV280_Window[4]) - (1.0 * arrUV280_Window[3]) + (0.0 * arrUV280_Window[2]) + (1.0 * arrUV280_Window[1]) + (2.0 * arrUV280_Window[0])) / (10.0 * rCycleTime_s);
    rUV280_Curvature_mAUs2 := ((2.0 * arrUV280_Window[4]) - (1.0 * arrUV280_Window[3]) - (2.0 * arrUV280_Window[2]) - (1.0 * arrUV280_Window[1]) + (2.0 * arrUV280_Window[0])) / (7.0 * rCycleTime_s * rCycleTime_s);
END_IF;

(* Real-Time Peak Feature Extraction Logic *)
bPeakLiftoffDetected := (rUV260_Smoothed_mAU > 12.0) AND (rUV260_Slope_mAUs > 0.85);

(* Apex detection: slope crosses zero downwards with substantial negative curvature *)
bPeakApexDetected := (rPriorUV260_Slope_mAUs > 0.0) AND (rUV260_Slope_mAUs <= 0.0) AND (rUV260_Curvature_mAUs2 < -0.15);

(* Valley nadir detection: slope crosses zero upwards between resolving peaks with positive curvature *)
bValleyNadirDetected := (rPriorUV260_Slope_mAUs < 0.0) AND (rUV260_Slope_mAUs >= 0.0) AND (rUV260_Curvature_mAUs2 > 0.15);

(* Baseline return detection *)
bBaselineReturnDetected := (rUV260_Smoothed_mAU < 6.0) AND (ABS(rUV260_Slope_mAUs) < 0.25);

rPriorUV260_Slope_mAUs := rUV260_Slope_mAUs;

(* ==================================================================================================== *)
(* DUAL-WAVELENGTH IN-LINE UV RATIO & BEER-LAMBERT MATRIX DECONVOLUTION                                 *)
(* ==================================================================================================== *)

(* Calculate Stoichiometric Absorbance Ratio *)
IF rUV280_Smoothed_mAU > 1.0 THEN
    rUV_Ratio_260_280 := rUV260_Smoothed_mAU / rUV280_Smoothed_mAU;
ELSE
    rUV_Ratio_260_280 := 0.0;
END_IF;

(* Analytical Matrix Inversion for 2-Component Capsid Mass Resolution *)
(* [A260 / 1000] = (eps260_F * C_F + eps260_E * C_E) * L *)
(* [A280 / 1000] = (eps280_F * C_F + eps280_E * C_E) * L *)
IF (ABS(rMatrixDeterminant) > 0.0001) AND (rPathLength_cm > 0.01) THEN
    rDeconvolutedFull_mgmL := ((rEpsilon_280_Empty * (rUV260_Smoothed_mAU * 0.0010)) - 
                               (rEpsilon_260_Empty * (rUV280_Smoothed_mAU * 0.0010))) / 
                              (rMatrixDeterminant * rPathLength_cm);

    rDeconvolutedEmpty_mgmL := ((-rEpsilon_280_Full * (rUV260_Smoothed_mAU * 0.0010)) + 
                                (rEpsilon_260_Full * (rUV280_Smoothed_mAU * 0.0010))) / 
                               (rMatrixDeterminant * rPathLength_cm);
END_IF;

(* Non-Negative Constraint Bounds Clamping *)
IF rDeconvolutedFull_mgmL < 0.0 THEN rDeconvolutedFull_mgmL := 0.0; END_IF;
IF rDeconvolutedEmpty_mgmL < 0.0 THEN rDeconvolutedEmpty_mgmL := 0.0; END_IF;

rCapsidConcentration_Full_mgmL := rDeconvolutedFull_mgmL;
rCapsidConcentration_Empty_mgmL := rDeconvolutedEmpty_mgmL;
rDeconvolutedTotal_mgmL := rDeconvolutedFull_mgmL + rDeconvolutedEmpty_mgmL;

IF rDeconvolutedTotal_mgmL > 0.002 THEN
    rCapsidFullPurity_pct := (rDeconvolutedFull_mgmL / rDeconvolutedTotal_mgmL) * 100.0;
    rCapsidEmptyPurity_pct := (rDeconvolutedEmpty_mgmL / rDeconvolutedTotal_mgmL) * 100.0;
ELSE
    rCapsidFullPurity_pct := 0.0;
    rCapsidEmptyPurity_pct := 0.0;
END_IF;

(* ==================================================================================================== *)
(* QUATERNARY AMMONIUM RESIN BINDING FRONT TRACKING & BOHART-ADAMS MODEL                                *)
(* ==================================================================================================== *)

(* Calculate Incremental and Cumulative Hydraulic Volume *)
rDeltaVolumeCycle_mL := rFeedFlowRate_mLmin * (rCycleTime_s / 60.0);
rCumulativeVolume_mL := rCumulativeVolume_mL + rDeltaVolumeCycle_mL;

(* Compute Interstitial Linear Fluid Velocity through Chromatographic Pores *)
IF (rResinCrossSection_cm2 > 0.01) AND (rResinPorosity > 0.05) THEN
    rInstantaneousPoreVelocity_cm_s := (rFeedFlowRate_mLmin / 60.0) / (rResinCrossSection_cm2 * rResinPorosity);
END_IF;

(* During Sample Loading (State 40), Track Quaternary Ammonium Ligand Adsorption Front *)
IF (iSequenceState = 40) THEN
    (* Accumulate Vector Genomes Loaded *)
    rCumulatedLoadedGenome_vg := rCumulatedLoadedGenome_vg + (rLoadAAVTiter_vgmL * rDeltaVolumeCycle_mL);
    
    (* Track Total Mass Loaded *)
    rCumulativeTotalLoadedMass_mg := rCumulativeTotalLoadedMass_mg + 
        (rLoadAAVTiter_vgmL * rDeltaVolumeCycle_mL * rMassConversionFactor_vg_to_mg);

    (* Resin Bed Saturation Fraction *)
    IF rResinBedCapacityTotal_vg > 0.0 THEN
        rResinBindingSaturation_pct := (rCumulatedLoadedGenome_vg / rResinBedCapacityTotal_vg) * 100.0;
    END_IF;

    (* Bohart-Adams Breakthrough Model: ln(C/C0 - 1) = (k*N0*Z)/v - k*C0*t *)
    IF (rInstantaneousPoreVelocity_cm_s > 0.001) AND (rLoadAAVTiter_vgmL > 0.0) THEN
        rTempCalcA := ((rMassTransferCoeff_ka_s1 * rResinStaticBindingCap_vgmL * rResinBedHeight_cm) / 
                       (rInstantaneousPoreVelocity_cm_s * 1.0E12)) - 
                      ((rMassTransferCoeff_ka_s1 * (rLoadAAVTiter_vgmL / 1.0E12) * rStateTimer_s));
        
        IF rTempCalcA > 35.0 THEN
            rCurrentBreakthroughFrac := 0.00001; (* Extremely tight binding near column inlet *)
        ELSIF rTempCalcA < -35.0 THEN
            rCurrentBreakthroughFrac := 0.99999; (* Breakthrough front fully saturated *)
        ELSE
            rCurrentBreakthroughFrac := 1.0 / (1.0 + EXP(rTempCalcA));
        END_IF;
    END_IF;

    (* Trigger Saturation Warning Before Breakaway Loss of Vector *)
    IF (rCurrentBreakthroughFrac >= rCriticalBreakthroughFrac) OR (rResinBindingSaturation_pct >= 85.0) THEN
        bBindingSaturationWarning := TRUE;
        wSecondaryAlarmWord := wSecondaryAlarmWord OR 16#0040; (* Bit 6: Dynamic Binding Capacity Exceeded *)
    END_IF;
ELSE
    rCurrentBreakthroughFrac := 0.0;
END_IF;

(* ==================================================================================================== *)
(* STATE-SPACE PROPAGATION & RECEDING-HORIZON MPC QUADRATIC SOLVER                                      *)
(* ==================================================================================================== *)

(* 1. Luenberger Observer State Estimation & Innovation Residual *)
rCondModelTrackingError_mScm := rBlendedConductivity_mScm - vecX[2];

vecX[0] := vecX[0] + (rObserverGain_L0 * rCondModelTrackingError_mScm);
vecX[2] := vecX[2] + (rObserverGain_L2 * rCondModelTrackingError_mScm);

(* 2. Discrete Time State Propagation: x[k+1] = A*x[k] + B*u[k] *)
vecX[0] := (matA[0,0] * vecX[0]) + (matA[0,1] * vecX[1]) + (matB[0,0] * rMPC_uB_Optimal_pct);
vecX[1] := (matA[1,0] * vecX[0]) + (matA[1,1] * vecX[1]) + (matB[1,0] * rMPC_uB_Optimal_pct);
vecX[2] := (matA[2,2] * vecX[2]) + (matA[2,0] * vecX[0]) + (matB[2,1] * rMPC_uFlow_Optimal_mLmin);
vecX[3] := (matA[3,3] * vecX[3]) + (matB[3,1] * rMPC_uFlow_Optimal_mLmin);

(* 3. Receding Horizon Multi-Step Quadratic Optimization (N_p=5 Prediction Steps) *)
FOR iLoopIdx := 0 TO 3 DO
    vecX_Pred[iLoopIdx] := vecX[iLoopIdx];
END_FOR;

rMPC_Gradient_uB := 0.0;
FOR iLoopIdx := 1 TO 5 DO
    (* Propagate virtual state prediction forward in horizon *)

 1. HIGH-ENTHALPY BOUNDARY LAYER TRANSITION & LAMINAR FLOW PHYSICS (MACH 5 - MACH 8)
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 In hypersonic flight, laminar flow dramatically diminishes skin friction drag (C_f_turb / C_f_lam ~ 4.5 to 6.2) and
 reduces aerodynamic heat transfer rates by up to 75% compared to fully turbulent boundary layers. The primary
 instability mechanisms governing transition at hypersonic Mach numbers are:
 
   a) Mack's First Mode (Vortical / Tollmien-Schlichting Waves):
      - Operates as a generalized viscous/inviscid instability.
      - Dominates transition at Mach numbers below Mach 4.0.
      - Destabilized by adverse pressure gradients and cooled walls; stabilized by favorable pressure gradients
        and normal wall suction.
 
   b) Mack's Second Mode (Acoustic Mode Trapping):
      - Operates as an acoustic wave trapped between the sonic line (where relative flow is sonic with respect to
        the phase speed: u - c = a) and the solid wall.
      - Dominates transition for Mach > 4.5. The characteristic most amplified frequency scales as:
          f_Mack2 ~ U_boundary_layer_edge / (2 * delta)
        where delta is the boundary layer thickness. In our flight regime, f_Mack2 spans 120 kHz to 380 kHz.
      - Highly destabilized by wall cooling, but extraordinarily sensitive to porous surface admittance and
        wall suction:
          C_q = - (rho_w * v_w) / (rho_inf * U_inf)
        where:
          rho_w = air density at the perforated titanium surface [kg/m^3]
          v_w   = normal wall suction velocity [m/s] (v_w < 0 implies suction into the plenum)
          rho_inf, U_inf = freestream density [kg/m^3] and true airspeed [m/s].
        By regulating C_q within an optimum aerodynamic corridor [0.0004 <= C_q <= 0.0011], the sonic line reflection
        coefficient is damped, suppressing the growth of second mode disturbance wave packets (N-factor < 9.0).
 
   c) Crossflow Instability:
      - Occurs on swept wings due to crossflow velocity profiles possessing an inflection point.
      - Stationary crossflow vortices are controlled by targeted micro-suction along the wing attachment line
        (Plenum 1).

------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 2. MICRO-PERFORATED TITANIUM SKIN (MPTS) AEROTHERMODYNAMIC RESISTANCE MODEL
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 The micro-perforated titanium skin consists of laser-drilled conical micro-apertures (diameter d_h = 65 um,
 pitch p_h = 450 um, sheet thickness t_skin = 1.5 mm, surface porosity sigma = 3.8%).
 Flow through the porous skin is governed by the modified compressible Darcy-Forchheimer equation:
 
   DeltaP_skin / t_skin = (mu(T_w) / kappa_D) * v_w + beta_F * rho_w * v_w^2
 
 where:
   DeltaP_skin = P_external_static - P_plenum [Pa] (Dynamic Differential Pressure)
   t_skin      = Titanium sheet thickness [m]
   kappa_D     = Darcy viscous permeability coefficient [m^2] (empirically 4.85e-11 m^2)
   beta_F      = Forchheimer inertial non-Darcy drag form coefficient [m^-1] (empirically 1.42e+6 m^-1)
   mu(T_w)     = Dynamic viscosity of air at the skin temperature T_w, computed via Sutherland's Law:
                   mu(T_w) = mu_ref * (T_w / T_ref)^(1.5) * (T_ref + S_u) / (T_w + S_u)
                   where mu_ref = 1.716e-5 Pa*s, T_ref = 273.15 K, S_u = 110.4 K (Sutherland constant)
   rho_w       = Local fluid density at the porous wall, determined via ideal gas state equation:
                   rho_w = P_plenum / (R_specific * T_w), where R_specific = 287.058 J/(kg*K).
 
 Given measured DeltaP_skin and local temperature T_w, the normal suction velocity v_w is solved online via a
 deterministic, quadratically-convergent Newton-Raphson iteration loop:
   f(v_w) = beta_F * rho_w * v_w^2 + (mu / kappa_D) * v_w - (DeltaP_skin / t_skin) = 0
   f'(v_w) = 2.0 * beta_F * rho_w * v_w + (mu / kappa_D)

------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 3. SHOCK-WAVE BOUNDARY LAYER INTERACTION (SWBLI) UNSTEADINESS SUPPRESSION
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 Shock-Wave Boundary Layer Interaction (SWBLI) occurs where oblique shocks generated by fuselage forebody compression
 ramps or engine cowls impinge upon the wing boundary layer. This imposes a severe adverse pressure gradient (dP/dx >> 0).
 
 Physics of SWBLI Instability:
   - Free Interaction Theory (Chapman): When the pressure rise exceeds the critical separation threshold:
       (P_plateau - P_upstream) / q_inf ~ 1.2 * (M_upstream^2 - 1)^(-0.25) * (C_f0)^0.5
     the boundary layer separates, forming a separation bubble.
   - Low-Frequency Unsteadiness: The separation bubble undergoes large-scale low-frequency expansion and contraction
     (breathing mode) with shock foot oscillations at Strouhal numbers St_L = f * L_sep / U_inf ~ 0.02 - 0.05
     (corresponding to 40 Hz - 350 Hz). This generates extreme acoustic vibration, localized peak aerothermal heating
     (Stanton number amplification up to 10x), and structural fatigue.
   - Suppression Mechanism: High-rate localized boundary layer suction at the separation foot evacuates the low-momentum
     fluid near the wall, shifting the sonic line closer to the titanium surface, pinning the shock foot location, and
     annihilating the separation bubble.
   - Dynamic Sensor Metric: A high-frequency dynamic pressure transducer array samples p_wall(t). The signal is filtered
     through a 2nd-order discrete Butterworth bandpass filter (50 Hz - 500 Hz), and the unsteadiness metric is computed:
       p_rms_swbli = sqrt( (1 / T_int) * integral( [p_filt(t)]^2 dt ) )
     When p_rms_swbli exceeds critical thresholds, the fast piezo-actuated SWBLI micro-suction slit loop is commanded.

------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 4. DISTRIBUTED TURBOCOMPRESSOR BLEED SIPHON & ANTI-SURGE CONTROLLER
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 Siphon suction vacuum is generated by distributed high-speed centrifugal turbocompressors driven by auxiliary electric
 drives / bleed air turbines. The turbocompressor operating state is mapped in the (W_corr, PR) domain:
   - Pressure Ratio: PR = P_discharge / P_suction_plenum
   - Corrected Mass Flow: W_corr = W_actual * sqrt(T_t_in / T_ref) / (P_t_in / P_ref)
   - Corrected Spool Speed: N_corr = N_actual / sqrt(T_t_in / T_ref)
   - Surge Line Polynomial: PR_surge(W_corr) = c0 + c1 * W_corr + c2 * (W_corr)^2
   - Surge Margin: SM = (PR_surge(W_corr) - PR_actual) / PR_surge(W_corr) * 100.0 [%]
 
 Safe compressor operation requires maintaining SM >= 12.0%. If SM drops below 12.0%, active Variable Inlet Guide Vanes
 (VIGV) and rapid pneumatic bypass / blow-off valves are actuated to deload the compressor within 40 ms.

------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 5. MODEL PREDICTIVE CONTROL (MPC) STATE-SPACE FORMULATION
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 A discrete-time state-space aerodynamic plant model is defined at sample period T_s = 10 ms (100 Hz):
 
   x(k+1) = A * x(k) + B * u(k) + E * d(k)
   y(k)   = C * x(k) + D * u(k)
 
 State Vector x in R^6:
   x[1] = DeltaP_plenum_pert  : Plenum differential pressure perturbation from trim [mbar]
   x[2] = rho_vw_pert         : Porous wall suction mass flux perturbation [kg/(m^2*s)]
   x[3] = delta_disp_pert     : Boundary layer displacement thickness perturbation [mm]
   x[4] = H12_shape_pert      : Boundary layer shape factor perturbation (H12 = delta* / theta) [-]
   x[5] = x_shock_pert        : SWBLI shock foot displacement from nominal station [mm]
   x[6] = N_spool_pert        : Turbocompressor spool speed dynamic lag [rpm]
 
 Control Input Vector u in R^4:
   u[1] = Delta_N_cmd         : Turbocompressor spool speed command trim [rpm]
   u[2] = Delta_theta_VIGV    : Turbocompressor Variable Inlet Guide Vane angle trim [deg]
   u[3] = Delta_theta_bypass  : Siphon bypass throttle valve angle trim [deg]
   u[4] = Delta_u_SWBLI_slit  : SWBLI fast piezo micro-slit aperture command trim [%]
 
 Output Vector y in R^4:
   y[1] = C_q_suction_coeff   : Global suction coefficient [dimensionless * 1e4]
   y[2] = DeltaP_skin_mbar    : Average skin differential pressure [mbar]
   y[3] = p_rms_SWBLI_kPa     : Shock unsteadiness fluctuating RMS pressure [kPa]
   y[4] = Margin_Surge_pct    : Turbocompressor surge margin [%]
 
 Disturbance Vector d in R^3:
   d[1] = Delta_q_inf_kPa     : Freestream dynamic pressure gust [kPa]
   d[2] = Delta_Mach_inf      : Flight Mach number transient disturbance [Mach]
   d[3] = Delta_T_skin_K      : Aerothermal heating skin temperature drift [K]
 
 Quadratic Cost Formulation:
   J = sum_{j=1..Np} [ (y(k+j) - r(k+j))^T * Q_y * (y(k+j) - r(k+j)) ] + sum_{j=0..Nc-1} [ Delta_u(k+j)^T * R_u * Delta_u(k+j) ]
 
 In this embedded implementation, the condensed Quadratic Programming (QP) problem is solved online via an unrolled
 projected gradient descent algorithm with Hessian pre-conditioning, box constraints on actuator travel [u_min, u_max],
 and hard actuator slew rate limits [Delta_u_min, Delta_u_max].

 dissimilar transducer channels: Channel A, Channel B, and Channel C.
 The 2oo3 voter performs:
   - Median Signal Selection: y_voted = median(Ch_A, Ch_B, Ch_C)
   - Pairwise Deviation Checks: |Ch_A - Ch_B|, |Ch_B - Ch_C|, |Ch_C - Ch_A|
   - Discrepancy Persistence Counters: If deviation exceeds epsilon_tol for N_persist consecutive scan cycles,
     the outlying channel is declared degraded and latched faulty.
   - Graceful Degradation Transition Matrix:
       3 Channels Healthy -> 2oo3 TMR Median Voting
       1 Channel Faulty   -> 1oo2 Dual-Channel Midpoint Voting with Discrepancy Abort
       2 Channels Faulty   -> 1oo1 Single-Channel Degraded Mode with Conservative Setpoint Clamps
       3 Channels Faulty   -> Emergency Failsafe Trip to Passive Aerodynamic Bypass
