(*
========================================================================================================================
 SECTION 1: EXECUTION CYCLE TIMING & WATCHDOG PRE-CHECK
========================================================================================================================
*)
IF tCycleTime_ms > 0.001 THEN
    rScanDeltaTime_Sec := tCycleTime_ms * 0.001;
ELSE
    rScanDeltaTime_Sec := 0.01; (* Default 10 ms cycle if unconfigured *)
END_IF;

rStateTimer_Sec := rStateTimer_Sec + rScanDeltaTime_Sec;

(* HARDWIRED FLIGHT SAFETY BUS RELAY & EMERGENCY STOP INTERLOCK *)
IF NOT bEmergencyStop THEN
    bSystemReady := FALSE;
    bLaminarHoldAchieved := FALSE;
    bEmergencyVentActive := TRUE;
    wAlarmWord_Critical.0 := TRUE; (* Safety Bus Disconnect Fault *)
    iStateStep := 90;              (* Direct jump to Emergency Vent Lockout *)
END_IF;

(* MANUAL / FLIGHT DECK FAULT RESET LOGIC *)
IF bResetLatchedFaults THEN
    tonLockoutResetTimer(IN := TRUE, PT := T#2S);
    IF tonLockoutResetTimer.Q THEN
        bMach_ChA_LatchedFault := FALSE;
        bMach_ChB_LatchedFault := FALSE;
        bMach_ChC_LatchedFault := FALSE;
        bDeltaP_ChA_LatchedFault := FALSE;
        bDeltaP_ChB_LatchedFault := FALSE;
        bDeltaP_ChC_LatchedFault := FALSE;
        bSWBLI_ChA_LatchedFault := FALSE;
        bSWBLI_ChB_LatchedFault := FALSE;
        bSWBLI_ChC_LatchedFault := FALSE;
        bSpool_ChA_LatchedFault := FALSE;
        bSpool_ChB_LatchedFault := FALSE;
        bSpool_ChC_LatchedFault := FALSE;
        bAutoIgnitionTripLatched := FALSE;
        wAlarmWord_Critical := 16#0000;
        wAlarmWord_Warning := 16#0000;
        tonLockoutResetTimer(IN := FALSE);
    END_IF;
ELSE
    tonLockoutResetTimer(IN := FALSE);
END_IF;

(*
========================================================================================================================
 SECTION 2: 2oo3 TRIPLE MODULAR REDUNDANCY (TMR) SENSOR VOTING SUITE
 Mathematical Implementation:
   - Median selection with persistent deviation monitoring.
   - Fault detection, isolation, and latching for individual channels.
   - Graceful fallback: 2oo3 (3 healthy) -> 1oo2 (2 healthy) -> 1oo1 (1 healthy degraded) -> Trip.
========================================================================================================================
*)
(* --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* 2.1 FLIGHT MACH NUMBER VOTER                                                                  *)
(* --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* Compute pairwise deviations *)
IF ABS(rMach_Flight_ChA - rMach_Flight_ChB) > rTol_Mach THEN
    iMach_DevCount_AB := iMach_DevCount_AB + 1;
ELSE
    IF iMach_DevCount_AB > 0 THEN iMach_DevCount_AB := iMach_DevCount_AB - 1; END_IF;
END_IF;

IF ABS(rMach_Flight_ChB - rMach_Flight_ChC) > rTol_Mach THEN
    iMach_DevCount_BC := iMach_DevCount_BC + 1;
ELSE
    IF iMach_DevCount_BC > 0 THEN iMach_DevCount_BC := iMach_DevCount_BC - 1; END_IF;
END_IF;

IF ABS(rMach_Flight_ChC - rMach_Flight_ChA) > rTol_Mach THEN
    iMach_DevCount_CA := iMach_DevCount_CA + 1;
ELSE
    IF iMach_DevCount_CA > 0 THEN iMach_DevCount_CA := iMach_DevCount_CA - 1; END_IF;
END_IF;

(* Latch isolated channel faults if persistence threshold exceeded *)
IF (iMach_DevCount_AB > iMaxDiscrepancyCycles) AND (iMach_DevCount_CA > iMaxDiscrepancyCycles) THEN
    bMach_ChA_LatchedFault := TRUE;
END_IF;
IF (iMach_DevCount_AB > iMaxDiscrepancyCycles) AND (iMach_DevCount_BC > iMaxDiscrepancyCycles) THEN
    bMach_ChB_LatchedFault := TRUE;
END_IF;
IF (iMach_DevCount_BC > iMaxDiscrepancyCycles) AND (iMach_DevCount_CA > iMaxDiscrepancyCycles) THEN
    bMach_ChC_LatchedFault := TRUE;
END_IF;

bMach_ChA_Valid := NOT bMach_ChA_LatchedFault AND (rMach_Flight_ChA >= 0.0) AND (rMach_Flight_ChA <= 12.0);
bMach_ChB_Valid := NOT bMach_ChB_LatchedFault AND (rMach_Flight_ChB >= 0.0) AND (rMach_Flight_ChB <= 12.0);
bMach_ChC_Valid := NOT bMach_ChC_LatchedFault AND (rMach_Flight_ChC >= 0.0) AND (rMach_Flight_ChC <= 12.0);

(* Voted Mach computation *)
IF bMach_ChA_Valid AND bMach_ChB_Valid AND bMach_ChC_Valid THEN
    (* Full 2oo3 Median Selection *)
    IF ((rMach_Flight_ChA >= rMach_Flight_ChB) AND (rMach_Flight_ChA <= rMach_Flight_ChC)) OR
       ((rMach_Flight_ChA <= rMach_Flight_ChB) AND (rMach_Flight_ChA >= rMach_Flight_ChC)) THEN
        rVoted_Mach := rMach_Flight_ChA;
    ELSIF ((rMach_Flight_ChB >= rMach_Flight_ChA) AND (rMach_Flight_ChB <= rMach_Flight_ChC)) OR
          ((rMach_Flight_ChB <= rMach_Flight_ChA) AND (rMach_Flight_ChB >= rMach_Flight_ChC)) THEN
        rVoted_Mach := rMach_Flight_ChB;
    ELSE
        rVoted_Mach := rMach_Flight_ChC;
    END_IF;
ELSIF bMach_ChA_Valid AND bMach_ChB_Valid THEN
    rVoted_Mach := (rMach_Flight_ChA + rMach_Flight_ChB) * 0.5;
ELSIF bMach_ChB_Valid AND bMach_ChC_Valid THEN
    rVoted_Mach := (rMach_Flight_ChB + rMach_Flight_ChC) * 0.5;
ELSIF bMach_ChA_Valid AND bMach_ChC_Valid THEN
    rVoted_Mach := (rMach_Flight_ChA + rMach_Flight_ChC) * 0.5;
ELSIF bMach_ChA_Valid THEN
    rVoted_Mach := rMach_Flight_ChA;
ELSIF bMach_ChB_Valid THEN
    rVoted_Mach := rMach_Flight_ChB;
ELSIF bMach_ChC_Valid THEN
    rVoted_Mach := rMach_Flight_ChC;
ELSE
    rVoted_Mach := 0.0;
    wAlarmWord_Critical.1 := TRUE; (* Triple Mach Sensor Loss *)
END_IF;

(* --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* 2.2 MICRO-PERFORATED SKIN DYNAMIC DIFFERENTIAL PRESSURE VOTER                                *)
(* --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
IF ABS(rDeltaP_Skin_ChA_mbar - rDeltaP_Skin_ChB_mbar) > rTol_DeltaP_mbar THEN
    iDeltaP_DevCount_AB := iDeltaP_DevCount_AB + 1;
ELSE
    IF iDeltaP_DevCount_AB > 0 THEN iDeltaP_DevCount_AB := iDeltaP_DevCount_AB - 1; END_IF;
END_IF;

IF ABS(rDeltaP_Skin_ChB_mbar - rDeltaP_Skin_ChC_mbar) > rTol_DeltaP_mbar THEN
    iDeltaP_DevCount_BC := iDeltaP_DevCount_BC + 1;
ELSE
    IF iDeltaP_DevCount_BC > 0 THEN iDeltaP_DevCount_BC := iDeltaP_DevCount_BC - 1; END_IF;
END_IF;

IF ABS(rDeltaP_Skin_ChC_mbar - rDeltaP_Skin_ChA_mbar) > rTol_DeltaP_mbar THEN
    iDeltaP_DevCount_CA := iDeltaP_DevCount_CA + 1;
ELSE
    IF iDeltaP_DevCount_CA > 0 THEN iDeltaP_DevCount_CA := iDeltaP_DevCount_CA - 1; END_IF;
END_IF;

IF (iDeltaP_DevCount_AB > iMaxDiscrepancyCycles) AND (iDeltaP_DevCount_CA > iMaxDiscrepancyCycles) THEN
    bDeltaP_ChA_LatchedFault := TRUE;
END_IF;
IF (iDeltaP_DevCount_AB > iMaxDiscrepancyCycles) AND (iDeltaP_DevCount_BC > iMaxDiscrepancyCycles) THEN
    bDeltaP_ChB_LatchedFault := TRUE;
END_IF;
IF (iDeltaP_DevCount_BC > iMaxDiscrepancyCycles) AND (iDeltaP_DevCount_CA > iMaxDiscrepancyCycles) THEN
    bDeltaP_ChC_LatchedFault := TRUE;
END_IF;

bDeltaP_ChA_Valid := NOT bDeltaP_ChA_LatchedFault AND (rDeltaP_Skin_ChA_mbar >= -10.0) AND (rDeltaP_Skin_ChA_mbar <= 250.0);
bDeltaP_ChB_Valid := NOT bDeltaP_ChB_LatchedFault AND (rDeltaP_Skin_ChB_mbar >= -10.0) AND (rDeltaP_Skin_ChB_mbar <= 250.0);
bDeltaP_ChC_Valid := NOT bDeltaP_ChC_LatchedFault AND (rDeltaP_Skin_ChC_mbar >= -10.0) AND (rDeltaP_Skin_ChC_mbar <= 250.0);

IF bDeltaP_ChA_Valid AND bDeltaP_ChB_Valid AND bDeltaP_ChC_Valid THEN
    IF ((rDeltaP_Skin_ChA_mbar >= rDeltaP_Skin_ChB_mbar) AND (rDeltaP_Skin_ChA_mbar <= rDeltaP_Skin_ChC_mbar)) OR
       ((rDeltaP_Skin_ChA_mbar <= rDeltaP_Skin_ChB_mbar) AND (rDeltaP_Skin_ChA_mbar >= rDeltaP_Skin_ChC_mbar)) THEN
        rVoted_DeltaP_Skin_mbar := rDeltaP_Skin_ChA_mbar;
    ELSIF ((rDeltaP_Skin_ChB_mbar >= rDeltaP_Skin_ChA_mbar) AND (rDeltaP_Skin_ChB_mbar <= rDeltaP_Skin_ChC_mbar)) OR
          ((rDeltaP_Skin_ChB_mbar <= rDeltaP_Skin_ChA_mbar) AND (rDeltaP_Skin_ChB_mbar >= rDeltaP_Skin_ChC_mbar)) THEN
        rVoted_DeltaP_Skin_mbar := rDeltaP_Skin_ChB_mbar;
    ELSE
        rVoted_DeltaP_Skin_mbar := rDeltaP_Skin_ChC_mbar;
    END_IF;
ELSIF bDeltaP_ChA_Valid AND bDeltaP_ChB_Valid THEN
    rVoted_DeltaP_Skin_mbar := (rDeltaP_Skin_ChA_mbar + rDeltaP_Skin_ChB_mbar) * 0.5;
ELSIF bDeltaP_ChB_Valid AND bDeltaP_ChC_Valid THEN
    rVoted_DeltaP_Skin_mbar := (rDeltaP_Skin_ChB_mbar + rDeltaP_Skin_ChC_mbar) * 0.5;
ELSIF bDeltaP_ChA_Valid AND bDeltaP_ChC_Valid THEN
    rVoted_DeltaP_Skin_mbar := (rDeltaP_Skin_ChA_mbar + rDeltaP_Skin_ChC_mbar) * 0.5;
ELSIF bDeltaP_ChA_Valid THEN
    rVoted_DeltaP_Skin_mbar := rDeltaP_Skin_ChA_mbar;
ELSIF bDeltaP_ChB_Valid THEN
    rVoted_DeltaP_Skin_mbar := rDeltaP_Skin_ChB_mbar;
ELSIF bDeltaP_ChC_Valid THEN
    rVoted_DeltaP_Skin_mbar := rDeltaP_Skin_ChC_mbar;
ELSE
    rVoted_DeltaP_Skin_mbar := 0.0;
    wAlarmWord_Critical.2 := TRUE; (* Triple DeltaP Sensor Loss *)
END_IF;

(* --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* 2.3 SWBLI SHOCK UNSTEADINESS RMS TRANSDUCER VOTER                                             *)
(* --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
IF ABS(rSWBLI_RMS_ChA_kPa - rSWBLI_RMS_ChB_kPa) > rTol_SWBLI_kPa THEN
    iSWBLI_DevCount_AB := iSWBLI_DevCount_AB + 1;
ELSE
    IF iSWBLI_DevCount_AB > 0 THEN iSWBLI_DevCount_AB := iSWBLI_DevCount_AB - 1; END_IF;
END_IF;

IF ABS(rSWBLI_RMS_ChB_kPa - rSWBLI_RMS_ChC_kPa) > rTol_SWBLI_kPa THEN
    iSWBLI_DevCount_BC := iSWBLI_DevCount_BC + 1;
ELSE
    IF iSWBLI_DevCount_BC > 0 THEN iSWBLI_DevCount_BC := iSWBLI_DevCount_BC - 1; END_IF;
END_IF;

IF ABS(rSWBLI_RMS_ChC_kPa - rSWBLI_RMS_ChA_kPa) > rTol_SWBLI_kPa THEN
    iSWBLI_DevCount_CA := iSWBLI_DevCount_CA + 1;
ELSE
    IF iSWBLI_DevCount_CA > 0 THEN iSWBLI_DevCount_CA := iSWBLI_DevCount_CA - 1; END_IF;
END_IF;

IF (iSWBLI_DevCount_AB > iMaxDiscrepancyCycles) AND (iSWBLI_DevCount_CA > iMaxDiscrepancyCycles) THEN
    bSWBLI_ChA_LatchedFault := TRUE;
END_IF;
IF (iSWBLI_DevCount_AB > iMaxDiscrepancyCycles) AND (iSWBLI_DevCount_BC > iMaxDiscrepancyCycles) THEN
    bSWBLI_ChB_LatchedFault := TRUE;
END_IF;
IF (iSWBLI_DevCount_BC > iMaxDiscrepancyCycles) AND (iSWBLI_DevCount_CA > iMaxDiscrepancyCycles) THEN
    bSWBLI_ChC_LatchedFault := TRUE;
END_IF;

bSWBLI_ChA_Valid := NOT bSWBLI_ChA_LatchedFault AND (rSWBLI_RMS_ChA_kPa >= 0.0) AND (rSWBLI_RMS_ChA_kPa <= 80.0);
bSWBLI_ChB_Valid := NOT bSWBLI_ChB_LatchedFault AND (rSWBLI_RMS_ChB_kPa >= 0.0) AND (rSWBLI_RMS_ChB_kPa <= 80.0);
bSWBLI_ChC_Valid := NOT bSWBLI_ChC_LatchedFault AND (rSWBLI_RMS_ChC_kPa >= 0.0) AND (rSWBLI_RMS_ChC_kPa <= 80.0);

IF bSWBLI_ChA_Valid AND bSWBLI_ChB_Valid AND bSWBLI_ChC_Valid THEN
    IF ((rSWBLI_RMS_ChA_kPa >= rSWBLI_RMS_ChB_kPa) AND (rSWBLI_RMS_ChA_kPa <= rSWBLI_RMS_ChC_kPa)) OR
       ((rSWBLI_RMS_ChA_kPa <= rSWBLI_RMS_ChB_kPa) AND (rSWBLI_RMS_ChA_kPa >= rSWBLI_RMS_ChC_kPa)) THEN
        rVoted_SWBLI_RMS_kPa := rSWBLI_RMS_ChA_kPa;
    ELSIF ((rSWBLI_RMS_ChB_kPa >= rSWBLI_RMS_ChA_kPa) AND (rSWBLI_RMS_ChB_kPa <= rSWBLI_RMS_ChC_kPa)) OR
          ((rSWBLI_RMS_ChB_kPa <= rSWBLI_RMS_ChA_kPa) AND (rSWBLI_RMS_ChB_kPa >= rSWBLI_RMS_ChC_kPa)) THEN
        rVoted_SWBLI_RMS_kPa := rSWBLI_RMS_ChB_kPa;
    ELSE
        rVoted_SWBLI_RMS_kPa := rSWBLI_RMS_ChC_kPa;
    END_IF;
ELSIF bSWBLI_ChA_Valid AND bSWBLI_ChB_Valid THEN
    rVoted_SWBLI_RMS_kPa := (rSWBLI_RMS_ChA_kPa + rSWBLI_RMS_ChB_kPa) * 0.5;
ELSIF bSWBLI_ChB_Valid AND bSWBLI_ChC_Valid THEN
    rVoted_SWBLI_RMS_kPa := (rSWBLI_RMS_ChB_kPa + rSWBLI_RMS_ChC_kPa) * 0.5;
ELSIF bSWBLI_ChA_Valid AND bSWBLI_ChC_Valid THEN
    rVoted_SWBLI_RMS_kPa := (rSWBLI_RMS_ChA_kPa + rSWBLI_RMS_ChC_kPa) * 0.5;
ELSIF bSWBLI_ChA_Valid THEN
    rVoted_SWBLI_RMS_kPa := rSWBLI_RMS_ChA_kPa;
ELSIF bSWBLI_ChB_Valid THEN
    rVoted_SWBLI_RMS_kPa := rSWBLI_RMS_ChB_kPa;
ELSIF bSWBLI_ChC_Valid THEN
    rVoted_SWBLI_RMS_kPa := rSWBLI_RMS_ChC_kPa;
ELSE
    rVoted_SWBLI_RMS_kPa := 0.0;
    wAlarmWord_Critical.3 := TRUE; (* Triple SWBLI Sensor Loss *)
END_IF;

(* --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* 2.4 DISTRIBUTED TURBOCOMPRESSOR SPOOL SPEED VOTER                                            *)
(* --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
IF ABS(rSpoolSpeed_TC1_rpm - rSpoolSpeed_TC2_rpm) > rTol_Spool_rpm THEN
    iSpool_DevCount_AB := iSpool_DevCount_AB + 1;
ELSE
    IF iSpool_DevCount_AB > 0 THEN iSpool_DevCount_AB := iSpool_DevCount_AB - 1; END_IF;
END_IF;

IF ABS(rSpoolSpeed_TC2_rpm - rSpoolSpeed_TC3_rpm) > rTol_Spool_rpm THEN
    iSpool_DevCount_BC := iSpool_DevCount_BC + 1;
ELSE
    IF iSpool_DevCount_BC > 0 THEN iSpool_DevCount_BC := iSpool_DevCount_BC - 1; END_IF;
END_IF;

IF ABS(rSpoolSpeed_TC3_rpm - rSpoolSpeed_TC1_rpm) > rTol_Spool_rpm THEN
    iSpool_DevCount_CA := iSpool_DevCount_CA + 1;
ELSE
    IF iSpool_DevCount_CA > 0 THEN iSpool_DevCount_CA := iSpool_DevCount_CA - 1; END_IF;
END_IF;

IF (iSpool_DevCount_AB > iMaxDiscrepancyCycles) AND (iSpool_DevCount_CA > iMaxDiscrepancyCycles) THEN
    bSpool_ChA_LatchedFault := TRUE;
END_IF;
IF (iSpool_DevCount_AB > iMaxDiscrepancyCycles) AND (iSpool_DevCount_BC > iMaxDiscrepancyCycles) THEN
    bSpool_ChB_LatchedFault := TRUE;
END_IF;
IF (iSpool_DevCount_BC > iMaxDiscrepancyCycles) AND (iSpool_DevCount_CA > iMaxDiscrepancyCycles) THEN
    bSpool_ChC_LatchedFault := TRUE;
END_IF;

bSpool_ChA_Valid := NOT bSpool_ChA_LatchedFault AND (rSpoolSpeed_TC1_rpm >= 0.0) AND (rSpoolSpeed_TC1_rpm <= 110000.0);
bSpool_ChB_Valid := NOT bSpool_ChB_LatchedFault AND (rSpoolSpeed_TC2_rpm >= 0.0) AND (rSpoolSpeed_TC2_rpm <= 110000.0);
bSpool_ChC_Valid := NOT bSpool_ChC_LatchedFault AND (rSpoolSpeed_TC3_rpm >= 0.0) AND (rSpoolSpeed_TC3_rpm <= 110000.0);

IF bSpool_ChA_Valid AND bSpool_ChB_Valid AND bSpool_ChC_Valid THEN
    IF ((rSpoolSpeed_TC1_rpm >= rSpoolSpeed_TC2_rpm) AND (rSpoolSpeed_TC1_rpm <= rSpoolSpeed_TC3_rpm)) OR
       ((rSpoolSpeed_TC1_rpm <= rSpoolSpeed_TC2_rpm) AND (rSpoolSpeed_TC1_rpm >= rSpoolSpeed_TC3_rpm)) THEN
        rVoted_SpoolSpeed_rpm := rSpoolSpeed_TC1_rpm;
    ELSIF ((rSpoolSpeed_TC2_rpm >= rSpoolSpeed_TC1_rpm) AND (rSpoolSpeed_TC2_rpm <= rSpoolSpeed_TC3_rpm)) OR
          ((rSpoolSpeed_TC2_rpm <= rSpoolSpeed_TC1_rpm) AND (rSpoolSpeed_TC2_rpm >= rSpoolSpeed_TC3_rpm)) THEN
        rVoted_SpoolSpeed_rpm := rSpoolSpeed_TC2_rpm;
    ELSE
        rVoted_SpoolSpeed_rpm := rSpoolSpeed_TC3_rpm;
    END_IF;
ELSIF bSpool_ChA_Valid AND bSpool_ChB_Valid THEN
    rVoted_SpoolSpeed_rpm := (rSpoolSpeed_TC1_rpm + rSpoolSpeed_TC2_rpm) * 0.5;
ELSIF bSpool_ChB_Valid AND bSpool_ChC_Valid THEN
    rVoted_SpoolSpeed_rpm := (rSpoolSpeed_TC2_rpm + rSpoolSpeed_TC3_rpm) * 0.5;
ELSIF bSpool_ChA_Valid AND bSpool_ChC_Valid THEN
    rVoted_SpoolSpeed_rpm := (rSpoolSpeed_TC1_rpm + rSpoolSpeed_TC3_rpm) * 0.5;
ELSIF bSpool_ChA_Valid THEN
    rVoted_SpoolSpeed_rpm := rSpoolSpeed_TC1_rpm;
ELSIF bSpool_ChB_Valid THEN
    rVoted_SpoolSpeed_rpm := rSpoolSpeed_TC2_rpm;
ELSIF bSpool_ChC_Valid THEN
    rVoted_SpoolSpeed_rpm := rSpoolSpeed_TC3_rpm;
ELSE
    rVoted_SpoolSpeed_rpm := 0.0;
    wAlarmWord_Critical.4 := TRUE; (* Triple Spool Speed Sensor Loss *)
END_IF;

(* Pack Voting Health Status Word *)
wVotingStatusWord.0 := bMach_ChA_Valid;
wVotingStatusWord.1 := bMach_ChB_Valid;
wVotingStatusWord.2 := bMach_ChC_Valid;
wVotingStatusWord.3 := bDeltaP_ChA_Valid;
wVotingStatusWord.4 := bDeltaP_ChB_Valid;
wVotingStatusWord.5 := bDeltaP_ChC_Valid;
wVotingStatusWord.6 := bSWBLI_ChA_Valid;
wVotingStatusWord.7 := bSWBLI_ChB_Valid;
wVotingStatusWord.8 := bSWBLI_ChC_Valid;
wVotingStatusWord.9 := bSpool_ChA_Valid;
wVotingStatusWord.10 := bSpool_ChB_Valid;
wVotingStatusWord.11 := bSpool_ChC_Valid;

(* Determine Degraded Operation status *)
IF (NOT bMach_ChA_Valid OR NOT bMach_ChB_Valid OR NOT bMach_ChC_Valid OR
    NOT bDeltaP_ChA_Valid OR NOT bDeltaP_ChB_Valid OR NOT bDeltaP_ChC_Valid OR
    NOT bSWBLI_ChA_Valid OR NOT bSWBLI_ChB_Valid OR NOT bSWBLI_ChC_Valid OR
    NOT bSpool_ChA_Valid OR NOT bSpool_ChB_Valid OR NOT bSpool_ChC_Valid) THEN
    bDegradedOperation := TRUE;
    wAlarmWord_Warning.0 := TRUE; (* Sensor Redundancy Degraded *)
ELSE
    bDegradedOperation := FALSE;
    wAlarmWord_Warning.0 := FALSE;
END_IF;

(*
========================================================================================================================
 SECTION 3: AEROTHERMODYNAMIC PROPERTY & DARCY-FORCHHEIMER POROUS SKIN SOLVER
 Physics Formulation:
   - Sutherland's Law for dynamic viscosity mu(T_w) of high-temperature boundary layer air.
   - Equation of state for air density rho_w at the micro-perforated skin interface.
   - Deterministic 4-iteration Newton-Raphson solver for normal suction velocity v_w.
   - Non-dimensional suction coefficient C_q calculation and drag reduction estimate.
   - Permeability tracking for micro-hole clogging diagnosis.
========================================================================================================================
*)
(* 1. Sutherland's Law dynamic viscosity calculation based on mid-wing skin temperature *)
IF rSkinTemp_Mid_K > 50.0 THEN
    rAirDynamicVisc_Pals := rSutherland_Mu0 *
                            EXPT((rSkinTemp_Mid_K / rSutherland_T0), 1.5) *
                            ((rSutherland_T0 + rSutherland_S) / (rSkinTemp_Mid_K + rSutherland_S));
ELSE
    rAirDynamicVisc_Pals := 1.716e-5;
END_IF;

(* 2. Local air density calculation at porous wall interface *)
IF (rAlt_StaticPress_mbar > 0.1) AND (rSkinTemp_Mid_K > 50.0) THEN
    (* Static pressure in Pa = mbar * 100.0 *)
    rLocalAirDensity_kgpm3 := (rAlt_StaticPress_mbar * 100.0) / (rGasConstant_Air * rSkinTemp_Mid_K);
ELSE
    rLocalAirDensity_kgpm3 := 0.055; (* Nominal stratospheric cruise density *)
END_IF;

(* 3. Online Newton-Raphson Solver for Normal Suction Velocity v_w *)
(* Governing quadratic: (beta_F * rho_w) * v_w^2 + (mu / kappa_D) * v_w - (DeltaP / t_skin) = 0 *)
IF (rVoted_DeltaP_Skin_mbar > 0.01) AND (rSkinThickness_m > 0.0001) THEN
    (* Initial linear Darcy estimate: v_w0 = (DeltaP / t_skin) * (kappa_D / mu) *)
    rNR_v_w := (rVoted_DeltaP_Skin_mbar * 100.0 / rSkinThickness_m) * (rDarcyPermeability_m2 / rAirDynamicVisc_Pals);
    
    (* Fixed 4-iteration deterministic unrolled Newton-Raphson loop *)
    FOR iNR_Iter := 1 TO 4 DO
        rNR_f_val := (rForchheimerBeta_per_m * rLocalAirDensity_kgpm3 * rNR_v_w * rNR_v_w) +
                     ((rAirDynamicVisc_Pals / rDarcyPermeability_m2) * rNR_v_w) -
                     (rVoted_DeltaP_Skin_mbar * 100.0 / rSkinThickness_m);
                     
        rNR_f_deriv := (2.0 * rForchheimerBeta_per_m * rLocalAirDensity_kgpm3 * rNR_v_w) +
                       (rAirDynamicVisc_Pals / rDarcyPermeability_m2);
                       
        IF ABS(rNR_f_deriv) > 1.0e-6 THEN
            rNR_delta_vw := rNR_f_val / rNR_f_deriv;
            rNR_v_w := rNR_v_w - rNR_delta_vw;
            IF rNR_v_w < 0.0 THEN rNR_v_w := 0.0; END_IF;
        END_IF;
    END_FOR;
    
    rSkinSuctionVelocity_mps := rNR_v_w;
ELSE
    rSkinSuctionVelocity_mps := 0.0;
END_IF;

(* 4. Suction Coefficient C_q Calculation *)
(* C_q = (rho_w * v_w) / (rho_inf * U_inf) *)
IF (rAirspeed_True_mps > 10.0) AND (rDynPress_Freestream_kPa > 0.5) THEN
    (* Freestream rho_inf = 2.0 * q_inf / U_inf^2 *)
    rSuctionCoeff_Cq := (rLocalAirDensity_kgpm3 * rSkinSuctionVelocity_mps) /
                        ((2000.0 * rDynPress_Freestream_kPa / (rAirspeed_True_mps * rAirspeed_True_mps)) * rAirspeed_True_mps);
ELSE
    rSuctionCoeff_Cq := 0.0;
END_IF;

(* 5. Aerodynamic Frictional Drag Reduction Estimate *)
(* Power savings = 0.5 * rho_inf * U_inf^3 * S_wetted * Delta_Cf *)
IF (rVoted_Mach >= 4.5) AND (rSuctionCoeff_Cq >= 0.0003) THEN
    (* Laminar boundary layer held: Delta_Cf ~ 0.00185 *)
    rEstimatedDragReduction_kW := 0.5 * (2000.0 * rDynPress_Freestream_kPa / (rAirspeed_True_mps * rAirspeed_True_mps)) *
                                  (rAirspeed_True_mps * rAirspeed_True_mps * rAirspeed_True_mps) *
                                  185.0 * 0.00185 * 0.001; (* Wing area S_w = 185 m^2 *)
    bLaminarHoldAchieved := TRUE;
ELSE
    rEstimatedDragReduction_kW := 0.0;
    bLaminarHoldAchieved := FALSE;
END_IF;

(* 6. Titanium Skin Micro-Hole Clogging / Health Filter *)
(* Compare apparent permeability kappa_est against nominal *)
IF (rSkinSuctionVelocity_mps > 0.05) AND (rVoted_DeltaP_Skin_mbar > 5.0) THEN
    rEstimatedPermeability_m2 := (rAirDynamicVisc_Pals * rSkinSuctionVelocity_mps * rSkinThickness_m) /
                                 (rVoted_DeltaP_Skin_mbar * 100.0);
    rPorousHealthFilterAcc := (rPorousHealthFilterAcc * 0.995) +
                              ((rEstimatedPermeability_m2 / rNominalPermeability_m2) * 100.0 * 0.005);
    IF rPorousHealthFilterAcc > 100.0 THEN rPorousHealthFilterAcc := 100.0; END_IF;
    IF rPorousHealthFilterAcc < 0.0 THEN rPorousHealthFilterAcc := 0.0; END_IF;
END_IF;
rSkinPorosityHealth_pct := rPorousHealthFilterAcc;

IF rSkinPorosityHealth_pct < 65.0 THEN
    wAlarmWord_Warning.1 := TRUE; (* Micro-perforated skin clogging warning *)
ELSE
    wAlarmWord_Warning.1 := FALSE;
END_IF;

(*
========================================================================================================================
 SECTION 4: SHOCK-WAVE BOUNDARY LAYER INTERACTION (SWBLI) UNSTEADINESS ANALYSIS
 Physics & Signal Processing:
   - Discrete 2nd-order bandpass filter centered around low-frequency shock unsteadiness (50 Hz - 500 Hz).
   - Real-time statistical variance accumulator for fluctuating pressure RMS.
   - Free Interaction Theory (Chapman) calculation of critical separation pressure plateau.
   - Dynamic separation margin evaluation and high-frequency piezo slit modulation.
========================================================================================================================
*)
(* 1. Direct Form II Discrete Biquad Bandpass Filter *)
rBQ_w1 := rVoted_SWBLI_RMS_kPa - (rBQ_a1 * rBQ_w2) - (rBQ_a2 * rBQ_w1);
rSWBLI_FiltSample := (rBQ_b0 * rBQ_w1) + (rBQ_b1 * rBQ_w2) + (rBQ_b2 * rBQ_w1);
rBQ_w2 := rBQ_w1;

(* 2. Moving RMS Filter Accumulation *)
rSWBLI_VarianceAcc := (rSWBLI_VarianceAcc * 0.985) + (rSWBLI_FiltSample * rSWBLI_FiltSample * 0.015);
IF rSWBLI_VarianceAcc > 0.0001 THEN
    rSWBLI_RMS_Calc := SQRT(rSWBLI_VarianceAcc);
ELSE
    rSWBLI_RMS_Calc := 0.0;
END_IF;

(* 3. Chapman Free-Interaction Critical Plateau Pressure *)
(* P_plateau = P_inf * (1 + 1.2 * (M^2 - 1)^(-0.25) * sqrt(Cf0) * 0.5 * gamma * M^2) *)
IF rVoted_Mach > 1.2 THEN
    rSWBLI_CriticalPlateau_kPa := (rAlt_StaticPress_mbar * 0.1) *
                                  (1.0 + (1.2 * EXPT((rVoted_Mach * rVoted_Mach - 1.0), -0.25) * 0.038 * 0.7 * rVoted_Mach * rVoted_Mach));
ELSE
    rSWBLI_CriticalPlateau_kPa := 25.0;
END_IF;

(* 4. SWBLI Separation Margin Calculation *)
IF rSWBLI_CriticalPlateau_kPa > 0.5 THEN
    rSWBLI_SeparationMargin_pct := ((rSWBLI_CriticalPlateau_kPa - rVoted_SWBLI_RMS_kPa) / rSWBLI_CriticalPlateau_kPa) * 100.0;
    IF rSWBLI_SeparationMargin_pct > 100.0 THEN rSWBLI_SeparationMargin_pct := 100.0; END_IF;
    IF rSWBLI_SeparationMargin_pct < 0.0 THEN rSWBLI_SeparationMargin_pct := 0.0; END_IF;
ELSE
    rSWBLI_SeparationMargin_pct := 100.0;
END_IF;

(* 5. Shock Separation Detection & Alarm Generation *)
IF rSWBLI_SeparationMargin_pct < 15.0 THEN
    wAlarmWord_Warning.2 := TRUE; (* Incipient Shock Boundary Layer Separation *)
ELSE
    wAlarmWord_Warning.2 := FALSE;
END_IF;

IF rSWBLI_SeparationMargin_pct < 5.0 THEN
    wAlarmWord_Critical.5 := TRUE; (* Severe SWBLI Separation Bubble Bursting *)
ELSE
    wAlarmWord_Critical.5 := FALSE;
END_IF;

(*
========================================================================================================================
 SECTION 5: DISTRIBUTED TURBOCOMPRESSOR AERODYNAMICS & ANTI-SURGE CONTROLLER
 Turbomachinery Mechanics:
   - Dynamic Pressure Ratio PR = P_discharge / P_suction.
   - Temperature/Pressure corrected mass flow and spool speed.
   - Parabolic surge line computation and dynamic surge margin SM [%].
   - Feedforward anti-surge blow-off valve activation.
========================================================================================================================
*)
(* 1. Pressure Ratio across suction compressor *)
IF (rAlt_StaticPress_mbar > 0.5) AND (rVoted_DeltaP_Skin_mbar > 0.0) THEN
    (* Siphon plenum pressure = Ambient - DeltaP *)
    rPR_Actual := (rAlt_StaticPress_mbar * 1.85) / MAX(0.5, (rAlt_StaticPress_mbar - rVoted_DeltaP_Skin_mbar));
    IF rPR_Actual < 1.0 THEN rPR_Actual := 1.0; END_IF;
ELSE
    rPR_Actual := 1.0;
END_IF;

(* 2. Corrected Mass Flow *)
IF (rCompressorMassFlow_kgps > 0.0) AND (rSkinTemp_Mid_K > 100.0) THEN
    rW_Corrected_kgps := rCompressorMassFlow_kgps * SQRT(rSkinTemp_Mid_K / 288.15) /
                         MAX(0.01, (rAlt_StaticPress_mbar / 1013.25));
ELSE
    rW_Corrected_kgps := 0.01;
END_IF;

(* 3. Parabolic Surge Line Evaluation: PR_surge = c0 + c1 * W + c2 * W^2 *)
rPR_SurgeLine := rSurgeLine_Coeff0 +
                 (rSurgeLine_Coeff1 * rW_Corrected_kgps) +
                 (rSurgeLine_Coeff2 * rW_Corrected_kgps * rW_Corrected_kgps);

IF rPR_SurgeLine < 1.05 THEN rPR_SurgeLine := 1.05; END_IF;

(* 4. Active Surge Margin Percentage *)
IF rPR_SurgeLine > 0.1 THEN
    rSurgeMargin_Calc := ((rPR_SurgeLine - rPR_Actual) / rPR_SurgeLine) * 100.0;
ELSE
    rSurgeMargin_Calc := 50.0;
END_IF;
rCompressorSurgeMargin_pct := rSurgeMargin_Calc;

(* 5. Surge Warning and Interlock Bits *)
IF rCompressorSurgeMargin_pct < rSurgeMargin_WarnThresh THEN
    wAlarmWord_Warning.3 := TRUE; (* Compressor Surge Margin Low Warning *)
ELSE
    wAlarmWord_Warning.3 := FALSE;
END_IF;

IF rCompressorSurgeMargin_pct < rSurgeMargin_TripThresh THEN
    wAlarmWord_Critical.6 := TRUE; (* Turbocompressor Imminent Surge Trip *)
ELSE
    wAlarmWord_Critical.6 := FALSE;
END_IF;

(*
========================================================================================================================
 SECTION 6: MODEL PREDICTIVE CONTROL (MPC) QUADRATIC COST OPTIMIZATION
 Embedded Solver Architecture:
   - Plant State Estimation via discrete observer: x(k+1) = A*x(k) + B*u(k).
   - Output Prediction: y(k) = C*x(k) + D*u(k).
   - Tracking Error: e(k) = Setpoint - y(k).
   - Unrolled Projected Gradient Descent (6 Iterations) on quadratic performance index:
       J = Delta_u^T * H * Delta_u + 2 * g^T * Delta_u
       where g = -K_LQR * e(k).
   - Box constraints enforcing actuator position and slew rate clamping.
========================================================================================================================
*)
(* 1. Formulate dynamic setpoints based on flight Mach regime *)
IF rVoted_Mach >= 5.0 THEN
    aSetpointR[1] := 8.5;  (* Target C_q * 1e4 *)
    aSetpointR[2] := 55.0; (* Target DeltaP skin [mbar] *)
    aSetpointR[3] := 1.5;  (* Target SWBLI RMS [kPa] *)
    aSetpointR[4] := 22.0; (* Target Surge Margin [%] *)
ELSIF rVoted_Mach >= 1.5 THEN
    aSetpointR[1] := 5.0;
    aSetpointR[2] := 32.0;
    aSetpointR[3] := 2.5;
    aSetpointR[4] := 20.0;
ELSE
    aSetpointR[1] := 1.5;
    aSetpointR[2] := 10.0;
    aSetpointR[3] := 3.5;
    aSetpointR[4] := 18.0;
END_IF;

(* 2. Map plant outputs into measurement vector y *)
aOutputY[1] := rSuctionCoeff_Cq * 10000.0;
aOutputY[2] := rVoted_DeltaP_Skin_mbar;
aOutputY[3] := rVoted_SWBLI_RMS_kPa;
aOutputY[4] := rCompressorSurgeMargin_pct;

(* 3. Compute State Observation & Error: e = C*x - y *)
FOR iRow := 1 TO 4 DO
    rTempSum := 0.0;
    FOR iCol := 1 TO 6 DO
        rTempSum := rTempSum + (aC[iRow, iCol] * aStateX[iCol]);
    END_FOR;
    aStateError[iRow] := aSetpointR[iRow] - (rTempSum + aOutputY[iRow] * 0.1);
END_FOR;
aStateError[5] := -rVoted_SWBLI_RMS_kPa * 0.2;
aStateError[6] := (rVoted_SpoolSpeed_rpm - 65000.0) * 0.0001;

(* 4. Compute Linear Gradient Vector: g = -K_LQR * e *)
FOR iRow := 1 TO 4 DO
    rTempSum := 0.0;
    FOR iCol := 1 TO 6 DO
        rTempSum := rTempSum - (aK_LQR[iRow, iCol] * aStateError[iCol]);
    END_FOR;
    aGradG[iRow] := rTempSum;
END_FOR;

(* 5. Initialize Optimization Variables *)
FOR iRow := 1 TO 4 DO
    aDeltaU[iRow] := 0.0;
END_FOR;

(* 6. Unrolled Projected Gradient Descent (6 Fixed Deterministic Iterations) *)
FOR iIterQP := 1 TO 6 DO
    FOR iRow := 1 TO 4 DO
        (* Compute matrix-vector product: (Hessian * DeltaU)[iRow] *)
        rTempSum := 0.0;
        FOR iCol := 1 TO 4 DO
            rTempSum := rTempSum + (aHessian[iRow, iCol] * aDeltaU[iCol]);
        END_FOR;
        
        (* Gradient step: DeltaU := DeltaU - alpha * (H*DeltaU + g) *)
        rProjVal := aDeltaU[iRow] - (rStepAlpha * (rTempSum + aGradG[iRow]));
        
        (* Project onto slew rate box constraints [Delta_u_min, Delta_u_max] *)
        IF iRow = 1 THEN
            (* Turbocompressor Spool Speed Trim [rpm] *)
            IF rProjVal > (rSpool_RateMax_rpmps * rScanDeltaTime_Sec) THEN
                rProjVal := rSpool_RateMax_rpmps * rScanDeltaTime_Sec;
            ELSIF rProjVal < (-rSpool_RateMax_rpmps * rScanDeltaTime_Sec) THEN
                rProjVal := -rSpool_RateMax_rpmps * rScanDeltaTime_Sec;
            END_IF;
        ELSIF iRow = 2 THEN
            (* VIGV Angle Trim [deg] *)
            IF rProjVal > (rVIGV_RateMax_degps * rScanDeltaTime_Sec) THEN
                rProjVal := rVIGV_RateMax_degps * rScanDeltaTime_Sec;
            ELSIF rProjVal < (-rVIGV_RateMax_degps * rScanDeltaTime_Sec) THEN
                rProjVal := -rVIGV_RateMax_degps * rScanDeltaTime_Sec;
            END_IF;
        ELSIF iRow = 3 THEN
            (* Bypass Valve Trim [deg] *)
            IF rProjVal > (rBypass_RateMax_degps * rScanDeltaTime_Sec) THEN
                rProjVal := rBypass_RateMax_degps * rScanDeltaTime_Sec;
            ELSIF rProjVal < (-rBypass_RateMax_degps * rScanDeltaTime_Sec) THEN
                rProjVal := -rBypass_RateMax_degps * rScanDeltaTime_Sec;
            END_IF;
        ELSE
            (* SWBLI Piezo Micro-Slit Trim [%] *)
            IF rProjVal > (rSWBLI_Slit_RateMax_pctps * rScanDeltaTime_Sec) THEN
                rProjVal := rSWBLI_Slit_RateMax_pctps * rScanDeltaTime_Sec;
            ELSIF rProjVal < (-rSWBLI_Slit_RateMax_pctps * rScanDeltaTime_Sec) THEN
                rProjVal := -rSWBLI_Slit_RateMax_pctps * rScanDeltaTime_Sec;
            END_IF;
        END_IF;
        
        aDeltaU[iRow] := rProjVal;
    END_FOR;
END_FOR;

(* 7. Update Control Actuation Vector *)
aControlU[1] := aControlU_Prev[1] + aDeltaU[1];
aControlU[2] := aControlU_Prev[2] + aDeltaU[2];
aControlU[3] := aControlU_Prev[3] + aDeltaU[3];
aControlU[4] := aControlU_Prev[4] + aDeltaU[4];

(* Actuator Absolute Physical Clamping *)
IF aControlU[1] < rSpool_Min_rpm THEN aControlU[1] := rSpool_Min_rpm; END_IF;
IF aControlU[1] > rSpool_Max_rpm THEN aControlU[1] := rSpool_Max_rpm; END_IF;

IF aControlU[2] < rVIGV_Min_deg THEN aControlU[2] := rVIGV_Min_deg; END_IF;
IF aControlU[2] > rVIGV_Max_deg THEN aControlU[2] := rVIGV_Max_deg; END_IF;

IF aControlU[3] < rBypass_Min_deg THEN aControlU[3] := rBypass_Min_deg; END_IF;
IF aControlU[3] > rBypass_Max_deg THEN aControlU[3] := rBypass_Max_deg; END_IF;

IF aControlU[4] < rSWBLI_Slit_Min_pct THEN aControlU[4] := rSWBLI_Slit_Min_pct; END_IF;
IF aControlU[4] > rSWBLI_Slit_Max_pct THEN aControlU[4] := rSWBLI_Slit_Max_pct; END_IF;

aControlU_Prev[1] := aControlU[1];
aControlU_Prev[2] := aControlU[2];
aControlU_Prev[3] := aControlU[3];
aControlU_Prev[4] := aControlU[4];

(* 8. Update Discrete State Propagation for Next Scan: x(k+1) = A*x(k) + B*DeltaU *)
FOR iRow := 1 TO 6 DO
    rTempSum := 0.0;
    FOR iCol := 1 TO 6 DO
        rTempSum := rTempSum + (aA[iRow, iCol] * aStateX[iCol]);
    END_FOR;
    FOR iCol := 1 TO 4 DO
        rTempSum := rTempSum + (aB[iRow, iCol] * aDeltaU[iCol]);
    END_FOR;
    aStateX_Next[iRow] := rTempSum;
END_FOR;

FOR iRow := 1 TO 6 DO
    aStateX[iRow] := aStateX_Next[iRow];
END_FOR;

(*
========================================================================================================================
 SECTION 7: TITANIUM AUTO-IGNITION & THERMAL RUNAWAY INTERLOCK
 Hazard Mechanism:
   - High-temperature aerodynamic boundary layer friction heating of titanium wing skin.
   - At temperatures above 1150 K, high-pressure oxygen flow through micro-perforations presents severe titanium
     oxidation and auto-ignition fire hazard.
   - Mitigation: Online fire hazard index monitoring, immediate high-speed nitrogen inerting gas deluge,
     and pneumatic plenum suction isolation.
========================================================================================================================
*)
(* 1. Compute Peak Titanium Wing Skin Temperature *)
rTempSum := MAX(rSkinTemp_Fore_K, MAX(rSkinTemp_Mid_K, rSkinTemp_Aft_K));

(* 2. Online Fire Hazard Metric J_fire = (T_peak - T_warn) * DeltaP * Mach *)
IF rTempSum > rTitaniumWarningTemp_K THEN
    rFireHazardIndex := (rTempSum - rTitaniumWarningTemp_K) * (rVoted_DeltaP_Skin_mbar / 50.0) * (rVoted_Mach / 5.0);
    wAlarmWord_Warning.4 := TRUE; (* Titanium High Skin Temperature Advisory *)
ELSE
    rFireHazardIndex := 0.0;
    wAlarmWord_Warning.4 := FALSE;
END_IF;

(* 3. Auto-Ignition Emergency Safety Trip *)
IF (rTempSum >= rTitaniumIgnitionCritTemp_K) OR
   (rVoted_DeltaP_Skin_mbar >= rDeltaP_FireHazardLimit_mbar AND rTempSum > 980.0) OR
   (rFireHazardIndex > 150.0) THEN
    bAutoIgnitionTripLatched := TRUE;
    bTitaniumFireRiskTrip := TRUE;
    wAlarmWord_Critical.7 := TRUE; (* Titanium Fire Auto-Ignition Emergency Trip *)
    iStateStep := 80;              (* Transition to Titanium Thermal Purge *)
END_IF;

IF bDeiceHeatingInhibit AND (rTempSum > 800.0) THEN
    wAlarmWord_Warning.5 := TRUE; (* Thermal Anti-Ice Conflict Warning *)
ELSE
    wAlarmWord_Warning.5 := FALSE;
END_IF;

(*
========================================================================================================================
 SECTION 8: MULTI-TIER ALARM HIERARCHY & SAFETY FAULT ENGINE
 Diagnostic Architecture:
   - Evaluates system health bitmasks.
   - Manages graceful degradation triggers and flight control status words.
========================================================================================================================
*)
(* APU / Electric Bus Power Undervoltage Check *)
IF rAPU_ShaftPower_kW < 35.0 THEN
    wAlarmWord_Warning.6 := TRUE; (* Low APU Shaft Power Delivery *)
ELSE
    wAlarmWord_Warning.6 := FALSE;
END_IF;

(* Bleed Valve Angle Deviation Check *)
IF ABS(rBleedValveAngle_deg - aControlU[3]) > 12.0 THEN
    wAlarmWord_Warning.7 := TRUE; (* Bypass Valve Actuator Tracking Error *)
ELSE
    wAlarmWord_Warning.7 := FALSE;
END_IF;

(* Evaluate Critical Trip Latching *)
IF (wAlarmWord_Critical <> 16#0000) AND (iStateStep < 80) THEN
    IF bAutoIgnitionTripLatched THEN
        iStateStep := 80; (* Prioritize Thermal Fire Purge *)
    ELSE
        iStateStep := 90; (* Emergency Vent Lockout *)
    END_IF;
END_IF;

(*
========================================================================================================================
 SECTION 9: 10-STAGE DETERMINISTIC FINITE STATE MACHINE (CASE iStateStep OF ... END_CASE;)
 State Sequences:
   0:  STATE_COLD_INIT_BITE           - Power-On Built-In Test & Sensor TMR Calibration
   10: STATE_SUBSONIC_STANDBY         - Low-speed cruise / climb (Mach < 0.8), purge active
   20: STATE_TRANSONIC_PRE_SUCTION    - Transonic acceleration (Mach 0.8 - 1.5), compressor spin-up

        rSpoolSpeedCmd_rpm := rSpool_Min_rpm;

    90: (* STATE_EMERGENCY_VENT_LOCKOUT *)
        bSystemReady := FALSE;
        bLaminarHoldAchieved := FALSE;

        rSuctionMassFlowCmd_kgps := 0.0;
        rSpoolSpeedCmd_rpm := 0.0;
        rVIGV_AngleCmd_deg := 0.0;
        rBypassValveCmd_deg := 90.0;
        rSWBLI_SlitAperture_pct := 0.0;
        rPlenumPressTarget_mbar := rAlt_StaticPress_mbar;

            iStateStep := 0; (* Return to Cold BITE *)

  through physically isolated Triple Modular Redundant (TMR) sensor channels A, B, and C.
  The voting engine executes:
    - Median Value Selection (MVS): Selects the intermediate mathematical median.
    - Inter-Channel Discrepancy Auditing: Computes pairwise deltas |A-B|, |B-C|, |C-A|.
    - Drift & Outlier Detection: Flags channels exceeding permissible error margins.
    - Graceful Sensor Degradation: Degrades automatically from 2oo3 to 1oo2, and from 1oo2 to single-channel
      with latching maintenance alarm, preventing spurious cycle shutdowns.

    B_mat[3,1] := 0.0050; B_mat[3,2] := 0.1950; B_mat[3,3] := 0.0000; B_mat[3,4] := 0.0000;
    B_mat[4,1] :=-0.0020; B_mat[4,2] :=-0.1250; B_mat[4,3] := 0.0420; B_mat[4,4] := 0.0000;
    B_mat[5,1] := 0.0000; B_mat[5,2] := 0.0000; B_mat[5,3] :=-0.1850; B_mat[5,4] := 0.0000;
    B_mat[6,1] := 0.0150; B_mat[6,2] := 0.0000; B_mat[6,3] := 0.0000; B_mat[6,4] := 0.3150;

    (* Disturbance Matrix E (6x4) *)
    (* Disturbances: d1: Thermal MW, d2: Total Flow, d3: Pressure Ratio, d4: Precooler Sink Temp *)
    E_mat[1,1] :=-0.0080; E_mat[1,2] := 0.0150; E_mat[1,3] :=-0.0220; E_mat[1,4] :=-0.0350;
    E_mat[2,1] := 0.0120; E_mat[2,2] :=-0.0450; E_mat[2,3] := 0.0820; E_mat[2,4] := 0.0180;
    E_mat[3,1] := 0.0250; E_mat[3,2] := 0.0100; E_mat[3,3] :=-0.0150; E_mat[3,4] :=-0.0050;
    E_mat[4,1] :=-0.0350; E_mat[4,2] :=-0.0200; E_mat[4,3] := 0.0120; E_mat[4,4] := 0.0450;
    E_mat[5,1] := 0.0750; E_mat[5,2] := 0.0300; E_mat[5,3] := 0.0050; E_mat[5,4] := 0.0000;
    E_mat[6,1] := 0.0050; E_mat[6,2] := 0.0180; E_mat[6,3] := 0.0650; E_mat[6,4] := 0.0000;

    (* Output Matrix C (6x6) - Identity state measurement *)
    C_mat[1,1] := 1.0; C_mat[2,2] := 1.0; C_mat[3,3] := 1.0;
    C_mat[4,4] := 1.0; C_mat[5,5] := 1.0; C_mat[6,6] := 1.0;

    (* Direct Transmission Matrix D (6x4) - Pure zeros (strictly proper) *)
    D_mat[1,1] := 0.0; D_mat[2,2] := 0.0; D_mat[3,3] := 0.0; D_mat[4,4] := 0.0;

    (* MPC Diagonal Quadratic Cost Matrices Q (State error weights) and R (Actuator rate weights) *)
    Q_diag[1] := 15.0;  (* Main Compressor Suction Density Error Weight *)
    Q_diag[2] := 45.0;  (* Main Compressor Anti-Surge Protection Weight (Critical) *)
    Q_diag[3] := 20.0;  (* Recompression Split Ratio Optimization Weight *)
    Q_diag[4] := 30.0;  (* LTR Pinch Point Thermal Bottle-neck Weight *)
    Q_diag[5] := 35.0;  (* PCHE Diffusion-Bond Thermal Stress Weight *)
    Q_diag[6] := 50.0;  (* Gas Foil Bearing Axial Position Float Weight (Rotor Contact Safety) *)

    R_diag[1] := 2.50;  (* Anti-Surge Valve Travel Penalty *)
    R_diag[2] := 4.00;  (* Split Ratio Valve Travel Penalty *)
    R_diag[3] := 3.50;  (* PCHE Bypass Attemperation Valve Penalty *)
    R_diag[4] := 1.80;  (* Gas Foil Bearing Balancing Valve Penalty *)

    bMatricesInitialized := TRUE;
END_IF;
(* ========================================================================================= *)
(* 1.0 SIL-3 SAFETY SHUTDOWN & EMERGENCY INTERLOCK SUPERVISION                               *)
(* ========================================================================================= *)
(* Evaluates hardwired emergency trips, structural thermal overstresses, and fatal rotordynamics. *)
(* If any critical trip threshold is breached, system executes instantaneous fail-safe clamping. *)

IF (NOT bEmergencyTrip) OR bTripLatched THEN
    bTripLatched := TRUE;
    bTripActive  := TRUE;
    bSystemRunning := FALSE;
    bSystemReady := FALSE;
    iState := 90; (* Force state machine to EMERGENCY_QUENCH_TRIP *)
END_IF;

IF bResetFaults AND bEmergencyTrip THEN
    (* Operator manual fault acknowledge: reset trip latches if physical parameters have normalized *)
    IF (rPCHE_ThermalStress_MPa < 120.0) AND (rRadVibr_MC_um < 35.0) AND (rSurgeMargin_MC_pct > 15.0) THEN
        bTripLatched := FALSE;
        bTripActive  := FALSE;
        dwAlarmWord1 := 16#0000_0000;
        dwAlarmWord2 := 16#0000_0000;
    END_IF;
END_IF;
(* ========================================================================================= *)
(* 2.0 TRIPLE MODULAR REDUNDANCY (2oo3) VOTING & SENSOR HEALTH AUDITING                      *)
(* ========================================================================================= *)
(* Implements Median Value Selection (MVS) with pairwise inter-channel error checking.        *)
(* Detects sensor drift, signal freezing, and out-of-range sensor channels.                  *)

(* --- 2.1 SUCTION PRESSURE 2oo3 VOTING --- *)
bPress_ChA_Fault := (rPress_MC_Inlet_bar_A < 10.0) OR (rPress_MC_Inlet_bar_A > 115.0);
bPress_ChB_Fault := (rPress_MC_Inlet_bar_B < 10.0) OR (rPress_MC_Inlet_bar_B > 115.0);
bPress_ChC_Fault := (rPress_MC_Inlet_bar_C < 10.0) OR (rPress_MC_Inlet_bar_C > 115.0);

(* Pairwise drift detection *)
IF ABS(rPress_MC_Inlet_bar_A - rPress_MC_Inlet_bar_B) > rPress_Tolerance_bar THEN
    IF ABS(rPress_MC_Inlet_bar_A - rPress_MC_Inlet_bar_C) > rPress_Tolerance_bar THEN
        bPress_ChA_Fault := TRUE;
    ELSE
        bPress_ChB_Fault := TRUE;
    END_IF;
ELSIF ABS(rPress_MC_Inlet_bar_B - rPress_MC_Inlet_bar_C) > rPress_Tolerance_bar THEN
    bPress_ChC_Fault := TRUE;
END_IF;

iPress_HealthyCount := 3;
IF bPress_ChA_Fault THEN iPress_HealthyCount := iPress_HealthyCount - 1; END_IF;
IF bPress_ChB_Fault THEN iPress_HealthyCount := iPress_HealthyCount - 1; END_IF;
IF bPress_ChC_Fault THEN iPress_HealthyCount := iPress_HealthyCount - 1; END_IF;

IF iPress_HealthyCount = 3 THEN
    (* Pure Median Value Selection *)
    IF (rPress_MC_Inlet_bar_A >= rPress_MC_Inlet_bar_B AND rPress_MC_Inlet_bar_A <= rPress_MC_Inlet_bar_C) OR
       (rPress_MC_Inlet_bar_A <= rPress_MC_Inlet_bar_B AND rPress_MC_Inlet_bar_A >= rPress_MC_Inlet_bar_C) THEN
        rPress_Inlet_Voted := rPress_MC_Inlet_bar_A;
    ELSIF (rPress_MC_Inlet_bar_B >= rPress_MC_Inlet_bar_A AND rPress_MC_Inlet_bar_B <= rPress_MC_Inlet_bar_C) OR
          (rPress_MC_Inlet_bar_B <= rPress_MC_Inlet_bar_A AND rPress_MC_Inlet_bar_B >= rPress_MC_Inlet_bar_C) THEN
        rPress_Inlet_Voted := rPress_MC_Inlet_bar_B;
    ELSE
        rPress_Inlet_Voted := rPress_MC_Inlet_bar_C;
    END_IF;
ELSIF iPress_HealthyCount = 2 THEN
    (* 1oo2 Average Degradation *)
    IF bPress_ChA_Fault THEN
        rPress_Inlet_Voted := 0.5 * (rPress_MC_Inlet_bar_B + rPress_MC_Inlet_bar_C);
    ELSIF bPress_ChB_Fault THEN
        rPress_Inlet_Voted := 0.5 * (rPress_MC_Inlet_bar_A + rPress_MC_Inlet_bar_C);
    ELSE
        rPress_Inlet_Voted := 0.5 * (rPress_MC_Inlet_bar_A + rPress_MC_Inlet_bar_B);
    END_IF;
ELSIF iPress_HealthyCount = 1 THEN
    (* Single Channel Fallback *)
    IF NOT bPress_ChA_Fault THEN rPress_Inlet_Voted := rPress_MC_Inlet_bar_A;
    ELSIF NOT bPress_ChB_Fault THEN rPress_Inlet_Voted := rPress_MC_Inlet_bar_B;
    ELSE rPress_Inlet_Voted := rPress_MC_Inlet_bar_C;
    END_IF;
ELSE
    (* Total Sensor Failure: Latch Fallback & Trip *)
    rPress_Inlet_Voted := 73.90; (* Hold last plausible critical pressure *)
    bTripLatched := TRUE;
    dwAlarmWord2 := dwAlarmWord2 OR 16#0000_0001; (* Pressure TMR Loss *)
END_IF;

(* --- 2.2 SUCTION TEMPERATURE 2oo3 VOTING --- *)
bTemp_ChA_Fault := (rTemp_MC_Inlet_degC_A < 15.0) OR (rTemp_MC_Inlet_degC_A > 65.0);
bTemp_ChB_Fault := (rTemp_MC_Inlet_degC_B < 15.0) OR (rTemp_MC_Inlet_degC_B > 65.0);
bTemp_ChC_Fault := (rTemp_MC_Inlet_degC_C < 15.0) OR (rTemp_MC_Inlet_degC_C > 65.0);

IF ABS(rTemp_MC_Inlet_degC_A - rTemp_MC_Inlet_degC_B) > rTemp_Tolerance_degC THEN
    IF ABS(rTemp_MC_Inlet_degC_A - rTemp_MC_Inlet_degC_C) > rTemp_Tolerance_degC THEN
        bTemp_ChA_Fault := TRUE;
    ELSE
        bTemp_ChB_Fault := TRUE;
    END_IF;
ELSIF ABS(rTemp_MC_Inlet_degC_B - rTemp_MC_Inlet_degC_C) > rTemp_Tolerance_degC THEN
    bTemp_ChC_Fault := TRUE;
END_IF;

iTemp_HealthyCount := 3;
IF bTemp_ChA_Fault THEN iTemp_HealthyCount := iTemp_HealthyCount - 1; END_IF;
IF bTemp_ChB_Fault THEN iTemp_HealthyCount := iTemp_HealthyCount - 1; END_IF;
IF bTemp_ChC_Fault THEN iTemp_HealthyCount := iTemp_HealthyCount - 1; END_IF;

IF iTemp_HealthyCount = 3 THEN
    IF (rTemp_MC_Inlet_degC_A >= rTemp_MC_Inlet_degC_B AND rTemp_MC_Inlet_degC_A <= rTemp_MC_Inlet_degC_C) OR
       (rTemp_MC_Inlet_degC_A <= rTemp_MC_Inlet_degC_B AND rTemp_MC_Inlet_degC_A >= rTemp_MC_Inlet_degC_C) THEN
        rTemp_Inlet_Voted := rTemp_MC_Inlet_degC_A;
    ELSIF (rTemp_MC_Inlet_degC_B >= rTemp_MC_Inlet_degC_A AND rTemp_MC_Inlet_degC_B <= rTemp_MC_Inlet_degC_C) OR
          (rTemp_MC_Inlet_degC_B <= rTemp_MC_Inlet_degC_A AND rTemp_MC_Inlet_degC_B >= rTemp_MC_Inlet_degC_C) THEN
        rTemp_Inlet_Voted := rTemp_MC_Inlet_degC_B;
    ELSE
        rTemp_Inlet_Voted := rTemp_MC_Inlet_degC_C;
    END_IF;
ELSIF iTemp_HealthyCount = 2 THEN
    IF bTemp_ChA_Fault THEN
        rTemp_Inlet_Voted := 0.5 * (rTemp_MC_Inlet_degC_B + rTemp_MC_Inlet_degC_C);
    ELSIF bTemp_ChB_Fault THEN
        rTemp_Inlet_Voted := 0.5 * (rTemp_MC_Inlet_degC_A + rTemp_MC_Inlet_degC_C);
    ELSE
        rTemp_Inlet_Voted := 0.5 * (rTemp_MC_Inlet_degC_A + rTemp_MC_Inlet_degC_B);
    END_IF;
ELSIF iTemp_HealthyCount = 1 THEN
    IF NOT bTemp_ChA_Fault THEN rTemp_Inlet_Voted := rTemp_MC_Inlet_degC_A;
    ELSIF NOT bTemp_ChB_Fault THEN rTemp_Inlet_Voted := rTemp_MC_Inlet_degC_B;
    ELSE rTemp_Inlet_Voted := rTemp_MC_Inlet_degC_C;
    END_IF;
ELSE
    rTemp_Inlet_Voted := 31.10; (* Hold last plausible critical temperature *)
    bTripLatched := TRUE;
    dwAlarmWord2 := dwAlarmWord2 OR 16#0000_0002; (* Temp TMR Loss *)
END_IF;

(* --- 2.3 ROTOR AXIAL DISPLACEMENT 2oo3 VOTING --- *)
bAxial_ChA_Fault := (rAxialDisp_Bearing_um_A < -120.0) OR (rAxialDisp_Bearing_um_A > 120.0);
bAxial_ChB_Fault := (rAxialDisp_Bearing_um_B < -120.0) OR (rAxialDisp_Bearing_um_B > 120.0);
bAxial_ChC_Fault := (rAxialDisp_Bearing_um_C < -120.0) OR (rAxialDisp_Bearing_um_C > 120.0);

IF ABS(rAxialDisp_Bearing_um_A - rAxialDisp_Bearing_um_B) > rAxial_Tolerance_um THEN
    IF ABS(rAxialDisp_Bearing_um_A - rAxialDisp_Bearing_um_C) > rAxial_Tolerance_um THEN
        bAxial_ChA_Fault := TRUE;
    ELSE
        bAxial_ChB_Fault := TRUE;
    END_IF;
ELSIF ABS(rAxialDisp_Bearing_um_B - rAxialDisp_Bearing_um_C) > rAxial_Tolerance_um THEN
    bAxial_ChC_Fault := TRUE;
END_IF;

iAxial_HealthyCount := 3;
IF bAxial_ChA_Fault THEN iAxial_HealthyCount := iAxial_HealthyCount - 1; END_IF;
IF bAxial_ChB_Fault THEN iAxial_HealthyCount := iAxial_HealthyCount - 1; END_IF;
IF bAxial_ChC_Fault THEN iAxial_HealthyCount := iAxial_HealthyCount - 1; END_IF;

IF iAxial_HealthyCount = 3 THEN
    IF (rAxialDisp_Bearing_um_A >= rAxialDisp_Bearing_um_B AND rAxialDisp_Bearing_um_A <= rAxialDisp_Bearing_um_C) OR
       (rAxialDisp_Bearing_um_A <= rAxialDisp_Bearing_um_B AND rAxialDisp_Bearing_um_A >= rAxialDisp_Bearing_um_C) THEN
        rAxialDisp_Voted := rAxialDisp_Bearing_um_A;
    ELSIF (rAxialDisp_Bearing_um_B >= rAxialDisp_Bearing_um_A AND rAxialDisp_Bearing_um_B <= rAxialDisp_Bearing_um_C) OR
          (rAxialDisp_Bearing_um_B <= rAxialDisp_Bearing_um_A AND rAxialDisp_Bearing_um_B >= rAxialDisp_Bearing_um_C) THEN
        rAxialDisp_Voted := rAxialDisp_Bearing_um_B;
    ELSE
        rAxialDisp_Voted := rAxialDisp_Bearing_um_C;
    END_IF;
ELSIF iAxial_HealthyCount = 2 THEN
    IF bAxial_ChA_Fault THEN
        rAxialDisp_Voted := 0.5 * (rAxialDisp_Bearing_um_B + rAxialDisp_Bearing_um_C);
    ELSIF bAxial_ChB_Fault THEN
        rAxialDisp_Voted := 0.5 * (rAxialDisp_Bearing_um_A + rAxialDisp_Bearing_um_C);
    ELSE
        rAxialDisp_Voted := 0.5 * (rAxialDisp_Bearing_um_A + rAxialDisp_Bearing_um_B);
    END_IF;
ELSIF iAxial_HealthyCount = 1 THEN
    IF NOT bAxial_ChA_Fault THEN rAxialDisp_Voted := rAxialDisp_Bearing_um_A;
    ELSIF NOT bAxial_ChB_Fault THEN rAxialDisp_Voted := rAxialDisp_Bearing_um_B;
    ELSE rAxialDisp_Voted := rAxialDisp_Bearing_um_C;
    END_IF;
ELSE
    rAxialDisp_Voted := 0.0;
    bTripLatched := TRUE;
    dwAlarmWord2 := dwAlarmWord2 OR 16#0000_0004; (* Axial Probe TMR Loss *)
END_IF;

bDegradedSensorMode := (iPress_HealthyCount < 3) OR (iTemp_HealthyCount < 3) OR (iAxial_HealthyCount < 3);
(* ========================================================================================= *)
(* 3.0 HIGH-ACCURACY EQUATION OF STATE (EOS) EVALUATION & ACOUSTIC VELOCITY                  *)
(* ========================================================================================= *)
(* Evaluates real-time density and speed of sound using modified Peng-Robinson / Span-Wagner  *)
(* near the critical point (Tc = 304.128 K, Pc = 73.773 bar).                                 *)

rTemp_K   := rTemp_Inlet_Voted + 273.15;
rPress_Pa := rPress_Inlet_Voted * 100000.0;

IF rTemp_K < 200.0 THEN rTemp_K := 200.0; END_IF;
IF rPress_Pa < 100000.0 THEN rPress_Pa := 100000.0; END_IF;

rReducedTemp  := rTemp_K / rCritTemp_K;
rReducedPress := (rPress_Inlet_Voted) / rCritPress_bar;

(* PR Alpha Parameter *)
rAlpha_PR := (1.0 + rPR_m_param * (1.0 - SQRT(rReducedTemp))) * (1.0 + rPR_m_param * (1.0 - SQRT(rReducedTemp)));

(* Dimensionless EOS Coefficients *)
rPR_A_coeff := (rPR_a_crit * rAlpha_PR * rPress_Pa) / (rGasConstant_CO2 * rGasConstant_CO2 * rTemp_K * rTemp_K);
rPR_B_coeff := (rPR_b_vol * rPress_Pa) / (rGasConstant_CO2 * rTemp_K);

IF rPR_B_coeff < 0.001 THEN rPR_B_coeff := 0.001; END_IF;

(* Cubic Coefficients for Z: Z^3 + a2*Z^2 + a1*Z + a0 = 0 *)
rCubic_a2 := -(1.0 - rPR_B_coeff);
rCubic_a1 := rPR_A_coeff - 3.0 * (rPR_B_coeff * rPR_B_coeff) - 2.0 * rPR_B_coeff;
rCubic_a0 := -(rPR_A_coeff * rPR_B_coeff - (rPR_B_coeff * rPR_B_coeff) - (rPR_B_coeff * rPR_B_coeff * rPR_B_coeff));

(* Solve Cardano's Cubic Formula for Real Dense Supercritical Root *)
rCubic_Q := (3.0 * rCubic_a1 - (rCubic_a2 * rCubic_a2)) / 9.0;
rCubic_R := (9.0 * rCubic_a2 * rCubic_a1 - 27.0 * rCubic_a0 - 2.0 * (rCubic_a2 * rCubic_a2 * rCubic_a2)) / 54.0;
rCubic_Discrim := (rCubic_Q * rCubic_Q * rCubic_Q) + (rCubic_R * rCubic_R);

IF rCubic_Discrim >= 0.0 THEN
    (* One real root, two complex conjugates *)
    rSqrtDiscrim := SQRT(rCubic_Discrim);
    rArg1 := rCubic_R + rSqrtDiscrim;
    IF rArg1 >= 0.0 THEN
        rTerm1 := EXPT(rArg1, 0.3333333);
    ELSE
        rTerm1 := -EXPT(-rArg1, 0.3333333);
    END_IF;

    rArg2 := rCubic_R - rSqrtDiscrim;
    IF rArg2 >= 0.0 THEN
        rTerm2 := EXPT(rArg2, 0.3333333);
    ELSE
        rTerm2 := -EXPT(-rArg2, 0.3333333);
    END_IF;

    rZ_Compressibility := -rCubic_a2 / 3.0 + rTerm1 + rTerm2;
ELSE
    (* Three real roots: trigonometric solution *)
    rMagQ := SQRT(-rCubic_Q);
    IF rMagQ > 0.0001 THEN
        rRatio := rCubic_R / (rMagQ * rMagQ * rMagQ);
        IF rRatio > 1.0 THEN rRatio := 1.0; END_IF;
        IF rRatio < -1.0 THEN rRatio := -1.0; END_IF;
        rZ_Compressibility := -rCubic_a2 / 3.0 + 2.0 * rMagQ * COS(ACOS(rRatio) / 3.0);
    ELSE
        rZ_Compressibility := 0.285;
    END_IF;
END_IF;

(* Bound Z physically between 0.18 (dense liquid limit) and 0.95 (dilute gas limit) *)
IF rZ_Compressibility < 0.180 THEN rZ_Compressibility := 0.180; END_IF;
IF rZ_Compressibility > 0.950 THEN rZ_Compressibility := 0.950; END_IF;

(* Compute Density and Specific Volume *)
rSpecificVolume_m3kg     := (rZ_Compressibility * rGasConstant_CO2 * rTemp_K) / rPress_Pa;
rDensity_Calculated_kgm3 := 1.0 / rSpecificVolume_m3kg;

(* Dynamic Isentropic Exponent near Critical Point *)
IF (rReducedTemp >= 0.98 AND rReducedTemp <= 1.04) AND (rReducedPress >= 0.97 AND rReducedPress <= 1.05) THEN
    (* Near-critical anomalous steepness: isentropic exponent falls *)
    rIsentropicExp_gamma := 1.140 + 0.180 * ABS(rReducedTemp - 1.0);
ELSE
    rIsentropicExp_gamma := 1.285 - 0.050 * (rPress_Inlet_Voted / 100.0);
END_IF;

(* Local Acoustic Velocity a_local = sqrt(gamma * Z * R * T) *)
rSpeedOfSound_ms := SQRT(rIsentropicExp_gamma * rZ_Compressibility * rGasConstant_CO2 * rTemp_K);
IF rSpeedOfSound_ms < 180.0 THEN rSpeedOfSound_ms := 180.0; END_IF;
IF rSpeedOfSound_ms > 450.0 THEN rSpeedOfSound_ms := 450.0; END_IF;

(* Density sensor validation: blend physical Coriolis measurement with EOS calculation *)
IF (rDensity_MC_Inlet_kgm3 > 100.0) AND (rDensity_MC_Inlet_kgm3 < 950.0) AND
   (ABS(rDensity_MC_Inlet_kgm3 - rDensity_Calculated_kgm3) < 150.0) THEN
    rDensity_Effective_kgm3 := 0.70 * rDensity_MC_Inlet_kgm3 + 0.30 * rDensity_Calculated_kgm3;
ELSE
    rDensity_Effective_kgm3 := rDensity_Calculated_kgm3;
    dwAlarmWord2 := dwAlarmWord2 OR 16#0000_0010; (* Coriolis density deviation warning *)
END_IF;
(* ========================================================================================= *)
(* 4.0 MAIN COMPRESSOR CRITICAL-POINT DENSITY SURGE MARGIN OBSERVER & SAV GOVERNOR           *)
(* ========================================================================================= *)
(* Calculates non-dimensional aerodynamic flow and head coefficients, dynamic surge limit,    *)
(* and modulates the Anti-Surge Fast Recycle Valve (SAV) with rate-kick protection.          *)

(* Impeller tip peripheral velocity: u2 = pi * D_imp * N / 60 *)
rTipSpeed_MC_ms   := (3.14159265 * rMC_ImpellerDiam_m * rRotorSpeed_MC_rpm) / 60.0;
rAcousticMach_Mau := rTipSpeed_MC_ms / rSpeedOfSound_ms;

(* Flow coefficient phi = m_dot / (rho_in * A_in * u2) *)
IF (rDensity_Effective_kgm3 > 50.0) AND (rTipSpeed_MC_ms > 10.0) THEN
    rFlowCoeff_phi := (rMassFlow_Total_kgs - rMassFlow_Recomp_kgs) / 
                      (rDensity_Effective_kgm3 * rMC_InletArea_m2 * rTipSpeed_MC_ms);
ELSE
    rFlowCoeff_phi := 0.010;
END_IF;

(* Isentropic Head Coefficient psi = dh_is / u2^2 *)
rPress_Ratio := rPress_MC_Disch_bar / (rPress_Inlet_Voted + 0.001);
IF rPress_Ratio < 1.0 THEN rPress_Ratio := 1.0; END_IF;
rExpVal := (rIsentropicExp_gamma - 1.0) / rIsentropicExp_gamma;

IF (rPress_MC_Disch_bar > rPress_Inlet_Voted) AND (rTipSpeed_MC_ms > 10.0) AND (rExpVal > 0.01) THEN
    rHeadCoeff_psi := (rGasConstant_CO2 * rTemp_K * (1.0 / rExpVal) * 
                      (EXPT(rPress_Ratio, rExpVal) - 1.0)) / 
                      (rTipSpeed_MC_ms * rTipSpeed_MC_ms);
ELSE
    rHeadCoeff_psi := 0.0;
END_IF;

(* Dynamic Surge Boundary Surface: psi_surge = f(phi, Mau, rho/rhoc) *)
rSurgeLine_psi := 0.650 - (1.420 * rFlowCoeff_phi) + (1.850 * rFlowCoeff_phi * rFlowCoeff_phi) + 
                  (0.085 * rAcousticMach_Mau) - (0.045 * (rDensity_Effective_kgm3 / rCritDensity_kgm3));

rSurgeAvoidLine_psi := rSurgeLine_psi * 0.880; (* Surge Avoidance Safety Buffer at 12% margin *)

(* Calculate Instantaneous and Filtered Surge Margin *)
IF rSurgeLine_psi > 0.05 THEN
    rSurgeMargin_Raw_pct := ((rSurgeLine_psi - rHeadCoeff_psi) / rSurgeLine_psi) * 100.0;
ELSE
    rSurgeMargin_Raw_pct := 50.0;
END_IF;

(* Low-pass filter surge margin: tau = 50 ms *)
rSurgeMargin_Filt_pct := 0.80 * rSurgeMargin_Filt_pct + 0.20 * rSurgeMargin_Raw_pct;
rSurgeMargin_MC_pct   := rSurgeMargin_Filt_pct;

(* Compute Derivative Kick Rate: dSM/dt *)
rdSM_dt_pct_s := (rSurgeMargin_Filt_pct - rSurgeMargin_Prev_pct) / tScanPeriod_s;
rSurgeMargin_Prev_pct := rSurgeMargin_Filt_pct;

(* Fast Anti-Surge Derivative Kick Generator *)
IF rdSM_dt_pct_s < -8.0 THEN
    rAntiSurge_FF_Kick := -0.75 * (rdSM_dt_pct_s + 8.0);
    IF rAntiSurge_FF_Kick > 40.0 THEN rAntiSurge_FF_Kick := 40.0; END_IF;
ELSE
    rAntiSurge_FF_Kick := rAntiSurge_FF_Kick * 0.95; (* Exponential decay *)
END_IF;

(* Closed-Loop Anti-Surge PI Governor *)
IF rSurgeMargin_Filt_pct < 18.0 THEN
    (* Valve must open: positive error *)
    rAntiSurge_PID_Integral := rAntiSurge_PID_Integral + 0.085 * (18.0 - rSurgeMargin_Filt_pct);
    IF rAntiSurge_PID_Integral > 100.0 THEN rAntiSurge_PID_Integral := 100.0; END_IF;
    
    rValve_AntiSurge_pct := 2.5 * (18.0 - rSurgeMargin_Filt_pct) + rAntiSurge_PID_Integral + rAntiSurge_FF_Kick;
ELSE
    (* Slowly close recycle valve towards standby *)
    rAntiSurge_PID_Integral := rAntiSurge_PID_Integral - 0.040;
    IF rAntiSurge_PID_Integral < 0.0 THEN rAntiSurge_PID_Integral := 0.0; END_IF;
    rValve_AntiSurge_pct := rAntiSurge_PID_Integral + rAntiSurge_FF_Kick;
END_IF;

(* Safety Surge Annunciation *)
IF rSurgeMargin_MC_pct < 8.0 THEN
    bSurgeImminent := TRUE;
    dwAlarmWord1 := dwAlarmWord1 OR 16#0000_0001; (* Imminent Surge Trip *)
    IF rSurgeMargin_MC_pct < 3.0 THEN
        bTripLatched := TRUE; (* Structural Blade Stall Trip *)
    END_IF;
ELSE
    bSurgeImminent := FALSE;
END_IF;
(* ========================================================================================= *)
(* 5.0 HIGH-TEMPERATURE RECOMPRESSION SPLIT RATIO MODULATION & LTR PINCH TRACKING            *)
(* ========================================================================================= *)
(* Modulates split valve gamma to optimize LTR heat transfer and prevent pinch crossover.     *)

IF rMassFlow_Total_kgs > 5.0 THEN
    rSplitRatio_Actual_pct := (rMassFlow_Recomp_kgs / rMassFlow_Total_kgs) * 100.0;
ELSE
    rSplitRatio_Actual_pct := 0.0;
END_IF;

(* Real-Time LTR Pinch Point: Delta T_pinch = T_hot_out - T_cold_in *)
rLTR_PinchPoint_degC := rTemp_LTR_HotOut_degC - rTemp_LTR_ColdIn_degC;

(* Target optimal split ratio as function of thermal power and MC inlet density *)
rSplit_Feedforward_pct := 32.0 + (0.080 * rThermalPower_MW) + (0.015 * (rDensity_Effective_kgm3 - 400.0));
IF rSplit_Feedforward_pct < 25.0 THEN rSplit_Feedforward_pct := 25.0; END_IF;
IF rSplit_Feedforward_pct > 44.0 THEN rSplit_Feedforward_pct := 44.0; END_IF;

rSplitRatio_Target_pct := rSplit_Feedforward_pct;

(* Pinch point override: If LTR pinch collapses below 5.0 deg C, increase recompression flow *)
IF rLTR_PinchPoint_degC < rLTR_PinchPoint_Target_degC THEN
    rLTR_Pinch_Error_degC := rLTR_PinchPoint_Target_degC - rLTR_PinchPoint_degC;
    rSplitRatio_Target_pct := rSplitRatio_Target_pct + (1.20 * rLTR_Pinch_Error_degC);
END_IF;

(* Closed-Loop Split Ratio PI Controller *)
rSplitRatio_Error_pct := rSplitRatio_Target_pct - rSplitRatio_Actual_pct;
rSplitRatio_Integral  := rSplitRatio_Integral + (0.012 * rSplitRatio_Error_pct);
IF rSplitRatio_Integral > 30.0 THEN rSplitRatio_Integral := 30.0; END_IF;
IF rSplitRatio_Integral < -30.0 THEN rSplitRatio_Integral := -30.0; END_IF;

rValve_SplitRatio_pct := (rSplitRatio_Target_pct * 1.50) + (0.85 * rSplitRatio_Error_pct) + rSplitRatio_Integral;

(* Pinch Point Warning *)
IF rLTR_PinchPoint_degC < 3.0 THEN
    dwAlarmWord1 := dwAlarmWord1 OR 16#0000_0002; (* LTR Pinch Cross-Over Warning *)
END_IF;
(* ========================================================================================= *)
(* 6.0 PRINTED CIRCUIT HEAT EXCHANGER (PCHE) THERMAL SHOCK RATE LIMITING                     *)
(* ========================================================================================= *)
(* Computes 10-scan sliding-window temperature derivative, calculates equivalent Von Mises   *)
(* thermal stress at diffusion bonds, and governs the attemperation bypass valve.            *)

rTemp_PCHE_Current := 0.5 * (rTemp_PCHE_HotIn_degC + rTemp_PCHE_ColdOut_degC);

(* Circular Buffer History Update *)
aTempRingBuffer[iRingIndex] := rTemp_PCHE_Current;
iRingIndex := iRingIndex + 1;
IF iRingIndex >= 10 THEN iRingIndex := 0; END_IF;

(* Compute Rolling Average 10 scans prior *)
rTemp_PCHE_AvgOld := 0.0;
rTemp_PCHE_AvgOld := rTemp_PCHE_AvgOld + aTempRingBuffer[0] + aTempRingBuffer[1] + aTempRingBuffer[2] + aTempRingBuffer[3];
rTemp_PCHE_AvgOld := rTemp_PCHE_AvgOld + aTempRingBuffer[4] + aTempRingBuffer[5] + aTempRingBuffer[6] + aTempRingBuffer[7];
rTemp_PCHE_AvgOld := (rTemp_PCHE_AvgOld + aTempRingBuffer[8] + aTempRingBuffer[9]) / 10.0;

(* Raw Slew Rate [deg C/s] and Filtered [deg C/min] *)
rPCHE_dTdt_Raw := (rTemp_PCHE_Current - rTemp_PCHE_AvgOld) / (10.0 * tScanPeriod_s);
rPCHE_dTdt_Filtered := 0.90 * rPCHE_dTdt_Filtered + 0.10 * (rPCHE_dTdt_Raw * 60.0);
rPCHE_dTdt_degC_min := rPCHE_dTdt_Filtered;

(* Core-to-Header Radial Temperature Gradient Estimation *)
rPCHE_DeltaT_CoreHeader := ABS(rTemp_PCHE_HotIn_degC - rTemp_PCHE_ColdIn_degC) * 0.185 + ABS(rPCHE_dTdt_Filtered) * 2.50;

(* Von Mises Equivalent Thermal Stress: sigma = (E * alpha / (1 - nu)) * Delta T *)
rPCHE_ThermalStrain     := rPCHE_ThermalExp_perK * rPCHE_DeltaT_CoreHeader;
rPCHE_Stress_Proxy      := ((rPCHE_YoungsMod_GPa * 1000.0) * rPCHE_ThermalStrain) / (1.0 - rPCHE_PoissonsRatio);
rPCHE_ThermalStress_MPa := rPCHE_Stress_Proxy;

(* Attemperation Bypass Valve Closed-Loop Regulation *)
IF ABS(rPCHE_dTdt_degC_min) > 3.0 THEN
    (* Exceeds 3.0 deg C/min standard allowable slew: open tempering bypass *)
    rPCHE_Bypass_PID_Integral := rPCHE_Bypass_PID_Integral + 0.065 * (ABS(rPCHE_dTdt_degC_min) - 3.0);
    IF rPCHE_Bypass_PID_Integral > 100.0 THEN rPCHE_Bypass_PID_Integral := 100.0; END_IF;
    rValve_PCHE_Bypass_pct := 5.0 * (ABS(rPCHE_dTdt_degC_min) - 3.0) + rPCHE_Bypass_PID_Integral;
ELSE
    rPCHE_Bypass_PID_Integral := rPCHE_Bypass_PID_Integral * 0.98;
    rValve_PCHE_Bypass_pct := rPCHE_Bypass_PID_Integral;
END_IF;

(* Thermal Fatigue Alarm Thresholds *)
IF rPCHE_ThermalStress_MPa > rPCHE_AllowStress_MPa THEN
    dwAlarmWord1 := dwAlarmWord1 OR 16#0000_0004; (* Thermal Stress Warning (> 160 MPa) *)
    IF rPCHE_ThermalStress_MPa > (rPCHE_YieldStrength_MPa * 0.90) THEN
        bPCHEThermalTrip := TRUE;
        bTripLatched     := TRUE;
        dwAlarmWord1     := dwAlarmWord1 OR 16#0000_0008; (* Plastic Deformation Trip *)
    END_IF;
END_IF;
(* ========================================================================================= *)
(* 7.0 GAS FOIL BEARING DYNAMIC LIFTOFF & ACTIVE ROTOR AXIAL FLOAT BALANCING                 *)
(* ========================================================================================= *)
(* Manages hydrostatic jacking assist during speed transitions and regulates balance piston.  *)

rBearingSurfaceSpeed_ms := (2.0 * 3.14159265 * rGFB_JournalRadius_m * rRotorSpeed_MC_rpm) / 60.0;

(* Aerodynamic Gas Film Wedge Pressure Capacity P_wedge ~ 6*mu*U*R / c^2 *)
rGFB_HydrodynamicPressure_bar := ((6.0 * rDynGasViscosity_Pas * rBearingSurfaceSpeed_ms * rGFB_JournalRadius_m) / 
                                 ((rGFB_NominalClearance_um * 1.0E-6) * (rGFB_NominalClearance_um * 1.0E-6))) * 1.0E-5;

(* Computed Aerodynamic Film Thickness h_film *)
IF rRotorSpeed_MC_rpm > 1000.0 THEN
    rGFB_EstimatedFilm_um := (rRotorSpeed_MC_rpm / rGFB_LiftoffSpeed_rpm) * 22.5;
    IF rGFB_EstimatedFilm_um > 35.0 THEN rGFB_EstimatedFilm_um := 35.0; END_IF;
ELSE
    rGFB_EstimatedFilm_um := 0.0;
END_IF;
rGFB_FilmThickness_um := rGFB_EstimatedFilm_um;

(* Hydrostatic Jacking Assist Valve Sequencing *)
IF rRotorSpeed_MC_rpm < rGFB_JackingDisengage_rpm THEN
    (* Hydrostatic jacking injection required *)
    IF rPress_GFB_Jacking_bar > 25.0 THEN
        rValve_GFB_Jacking_pct := 85.0 - (0.0035 * rRotorSpeed_MC_rpm);
        IF rValve_GFB_Jacking_pct < 20.0 THEN rValve_GFB_Jacking_pct := 20.0; END_IF;
    ELSE
        rValve_GFB_Jacking_pct := 100.0; (* Jacking pressure low: demand max open *)
    END_IF;
ELSE
    (* Hydrodynamic self-sustaining: smoothly close jacking valve *)
    rValve_GFB_Jacking_pct := 0.0;
END_IF;

(* Balance Piston Closed-Loop Control: Regulate Axial Float within +/- 25 um *)
rBalPiston_FF_PressureBias := (rPress_MC_Disch_bar / (rPress_Inlet_Voted + 0.1)) * 4.5;
rBalPiston_PID_Integral    := rBalPiston_PID_Integral + 0.035 * rAxialDisp_Voted;
IF rBalPiston_PID_Integral > 40.0 THEN rBalPiston_PID_Integral := 40.0; END_IF;
IF rBalPiston_PID_Integral < -40.0 THEN rBalPiston_PID_Integral := -40.0; END_IF;

rValve_BalPiston_pct := 50.0 + (1.25 * rAxialDisp_Voted) + rBalPiston_PID_Integral + rBalPiston_FF_PressureBias;

(* Rotordynamic Safety Interlocks *)
IF ABS(rAxialDisp_Voted) > rGFB_MaxAllowAxialDisp_um THEN
    bBearingRubHazard := TRUE;
    dwAlarmWord2 := dwAlarmWord2 OR 16#0000_0020; (* Axial Float Out of Range *)
    IF ABS(rAxialDisp_Voted) > (rGFB_MaxAllowAxialDisp_um + 15.0) THEN
        bTripLatched := TRUE; (* Impeller Casing Rub Trip *)
    END_IF;
ELSE
    bBearingRubHazard := FALSE;
END_IF;

IF rRadVibr_MC_um > 45.0 THEN
    dwAlarmWord2 := dwAlarmWord2 OR 16#0000_0040; (* High Shaft Radial Vibration *)
    IF rRadVibr_MC_um > 65.0 THEN
        bTripLatched := TRUE; (* Severe Rotordynamic Whip Trip *)
    END_IF;
END_IF;
(* ========================================================================================= *)
(* 8.0 MULTIVARIABLE DISCRETE STATE-SPACE MODEL PREDICTIVE CONTROLLER (MPC)                  *)
(* ========================================================================================= *)
(* Executes 15 active-set projected gradient descent iterations to solve constrained QP.     *)

IF bAutoMpcEnable AND (NOT bTripActive) AND (iState >= 60) THEN
    (* Populate Current State Vector x *)
    x_state[1] := (rDensity_Effective_kgm3 - 460.0) / 100.0;  (* Normalized Density Deviation *)
    x_state[2] := (20.0 - rSurgeMargin_MC_pct) / 10.0;       (* Normalized Surge Margin Deficit *)
    x_state[3] := (rSplitRatio_Target_pct - rSplitRatio_Actual_pct) / 5.0; (* Normalized Split Ratio Err *)
    x_state[4] := (rLTR_PinchPoint_Target_degC - rLTR_PinchPoint_degC) / 2.0; (* Normalized Pinch Deficit *)
    x_state[5] := (rPCHE_ThermalStress_MPa - 80.0) / 50.0;   (* Normalized Thermal Stress *)
    x_state[6] := (rAxialDisp_Voted) / 15.0;                 (* Normalized Axial Float *)

    (* Measured Exogenous Disturbances *)
    d_disturb[1] := (rThermalPower_MW - 80.0) / 20.0;
    d_disturb[2] := (rMassFlow_Total_kgs - 250.0) / 50.0;
    d_disturb[3] := ((rPress_MC_Disch_bar / (rPress_Inlet_Voted + 0.1)) - 3.2) / 0.5;
    d_disturb[4] := (rTemp_Inlet_Voted - 31.1) / 2.0;

    (* Target State Vector: drive deviations to zero *)
    FOR iRow := 1 TO 6 DO
        x_target[iRow] := 0.0;
    END_FOR;

    (* Initialize Control Vector from Current Actuators *)
    u_mpc_cmd[1] := rValve_AntiSurge_pct / 100.0;
    u_mpc_cmd[2] := rValve_SplitRatio_pct / 100.0;
    u_mpc_cmd[3] := rValve_PCHE_Bypass_pct / 100.0;
    u_mpc_cmd[4] := rValve_BalPiston_pct / 100.0;

    (* Predict State Vector: x_pred = A * x_state + B * u_mpc_cmd + E * d_disturb *)
    FOR iRow := 1 TO 6 DO
        x_pred[iRow] := 0.0;
        FOR iCol := 1 TO 6 DO
            x_pred[iRow] := x_pred[iRow] + A_mat[iRow, iCol] * x_state[iCol];
        END_FOR;
        FOR iCol := 1 TO 4 DO
            x_pred[iRow] := x_pred[iRow] + B_mat[iRow, iCol] * u_mpc_cmd[iCol];
        END_FOR;
        FOR iCol := 1 TO 4 DO
            x_pred[iRow] := x_pred[iRow] + E_mat[iRow, iCol] * d_disturb[iCol];
        END_FOR;
        x_error[iRow] := x_pred[iRow] - x_target[iRow];
    END_FOR;

    (* Evaluate Cost Gradient: grad = B^T * Q * x_error + R * (u - u_prev) *)
    FOR iCol := 1 TO 4 DO
        rGrad[iCol] := 0.0;
        FOR iRow := 1 TO 6 DO
            rGrad[iCol] := rGrad[iCol] + B_mat[iRow, iCol] * Q_diag[iRow] * x_error[iRow];
        END_FOR;
        rGrad[iCol] := rGrad[iCol] + R_diag[iCol] * (u_mpc_cmd[iCol] - u_prev_cmd[iCol]);
    END_FOR;

    (* Approximate Diagonal Hessian: H_diag[j] = R[j] + sum_i (B[i,j]^2 * Q[i]) *)
    FOR iCol := 1 TO 4 DO
        rHessianDiag[iCol] := R_diag[iCol];
        FOR iRow := 1 TO 6 DO
            rHessianDiag[iCol] := rHessianDiag[iCol] + (B_mat[iRow, iCol] * B_mat[iRow, iCol] * Q_diag[iRow]);
        END_FOR;
        IF rHessianDiag[iCol] < 0.10 THEN rHessianDiag[iCol] := 0.10; END_IF;
    END_FOR;

    (* Active-Set Projected Gradient Descent Optimization: 15 Iterations *)
    FOR iMpcIter := 1 TO 15 DO
        FOR iCol := 1 TO 4 DO
            du_mpc_cmd[iCol] := -1.0 * (rGrad[iCol] / rHessianDiag[iCol]) * rMpcStepSize;
            
            (* Rate of change constraint *)
            IF du_mpc_cmd[iCol] > 0.05 THEN du_mpc_cmd[iCol] := 0.05; END_IF;
            IF du_mpc_cmd[iCol] < -0.05 THEN du_mpc_cmd[iCol] := -0.05; END_IF;

            u_mpc_cmd[iCol] := u_mpc_cmd[iCol] + du_mpc_cmd[iCol];

            (* Box Constraint Projections [0.0, 1.0] *)
            IF u_mpc_cmd[iCol] < 0.0 THEN u_mpc_cmd[iCol] := 0.0; END_IF;
            IF u_mpc_cmd[iCol] > 1.0 THEN u_mpc_cmd[iCol] := 1.0; END_IF;
        END_FOR;
    END_FOR;

    (* Blend MPC solution into physical valve commands with rate-limiting *)
    rValve_AntiSurge_pct  := 0.70 * rValve_AntiSurge_pct  + 0.30 * (u_mpc_cmd[1] * 100.0);
    rValve_SplitRatio_pct := 0.85 * rValve_SplitRatio_pct + 0.15 * (u_mpc_cmd[2] * 100.0);
    rValve_PCHE_Bypass_pct:= 0.80 * rValve_PCHE_Bypass_pct+ 0.20 * (u_mpc_cmd[3] * 100.0);
    rValve_BalPiston_pct  := 0.75 * rValve_BalPiston_pct  + 0.25 * (u_mpc_cmd[4] * 100.0);

    u_prev_cmd[1] := u_mpc_cmd[1];
    u_prev_cmd[2] := u_mpc_cmd[2];
    u_prev_cmd[3] := u_mpc_cmd[3];
    u_prev_cmd[4] := u_mpc_cmd[4];

    bMpcActive := TRUE;
ELSE
    bMpcActive := FALSE;
END_IF;
(* ========================================================================================= *)
(* 9.0 10-STAGE DETERMINISTIC OPERATIONAL SEQUENCE MACHINE                                   *)
(* ========================================================================================= *)
(* Governs initial boot, pre-charging, foil bearing liftoff, critical point approach,        *)
(* recompression synchronization, full load power generation, and emergency quench.         *)

(* Detect State Transitions for Timer Resets *)
IF iState <> iPrevState THEN
    tTimerState(IN := FALSE);
    iPrevState := iState;
END_IF;

CASE iState OF
    0: (* STATE_INIT_STANDBY: Fail-safe cold shutdown, valves in safe parked positions *)
        bSystemReady   := FALSE;
        bSystemRunning := FALSE;
        rValve_AntiSurge_pct   := 100.0; (* Full open bypass to prevent deadhead *)
        rValve_SplitRatio_pct  := 0.0;
        rValve_PCHE_Bypass_pct := 0.0;
        rValve_GFB_Jacking_pct := 0.0;
        rValve_BalPiston_pct   := 50.0;

        tTimerState(IN := TRUE, PT := T#2S);
        IF bMasterEnable AND tTimerState.Q AND (NOT bTripLatched) THEN
            iState := 10;
        END_IF;

    10: (* STATE_SENSOR_TMR_AUDIT: Triple Modular Redundancy Integrity Verification *)
        tTimerState(IN := TRUE, PT := T#3S);
        IF (iPress_HealthyCount >= 2) AND (iTemp_HealthyCount >= 2) AND (iAxial_HealthyCount >= 2) THEN
            bSystemReady := TRUE;
            IF tTimerState.Q THEN
                iState := 20;
            END_IF;
        ELSE
            bSystemReady := FALSE;
            dwAlarmWord2 := dwAlarmWord2 OR 16#0000_0100; (* Permissive Failure: Sensors Not Ready *)
        END_IF;

    20: (* STATE_LOOP_INVENTORY_CHARGE: Pre-charging sCO2 Closed Loop to Standby Pressure *)
        rValve_AntiSurge_pct   := 100.0;
        rValve_SplitRatio_pct  := 10.0;
        rValve_PCHE_Bypass_pct := 15.0;

        tTimerState(IN := TRUE, PT := T#5S);
        IF (rPress_Inlet_Voted >= 40.0) AND tTimerState.Q THEN
            iState := 30;
        END_IF;

    30: (* STATE_FOIL_BEARING_JACKING: Hydrostatic Gas Injection & Liftoff Verification *)
        rValve_GFB_Jacking_pct := 100.0;
        tTimerJackingPurge(IN := (rPress_GFB_Jacking_bar >= 30.0), PT := T#4S);

        IF tTimerJackingPurge.Q AND (ABS(rAxialDisp_Voted) < 15.0) THEN
            iState := 40;
        END_IF;

    40: (* STATE_SPEED_RAMP_LIFTOFF: Turbomachinery Accelerating Through Critical Speeds *)
        rValve_AntiSurge_pct   := 80.0;
        rValve_GFB_Jacking_pct := 90.0;

        IF rRotorSpeed_MC_rpm >= rGFB_LiftoffSpeed_rpm THEN
            (* Self-sustaining aerodynamic film established *)
            IF rRotorSpeed_MC_rpm >= 18000.0 THEN
                iState := 50;
            END_IF;
        END_IF;

    50: (* STATE_CRITICAL_POINT_APPROACH: Controlled Thermal-Hydraulic Tuning near 31.1 C / 73.9 bar *)
        rValve_GFB_Jacking_pct := 0.0; (* Hydrostatic assist cutoff *)
        rValve_AntiSurge_pct   := 55.0;

        (* Check convergence towards Widom line critical coordinates *)
        IF (rTemp_Inlet_Voted >= 30.8) AND (rTemp_Inlet_Voted <= 32.5) AND 
           (rPress_Inlet_Voted >= 73.0) AND (rPress_Inlet_Voted <= 76.5) AND
           (rDensity_Effective_kgm3 >= 380.0) THEN
            tTimerState(IN := TRUE, PT := T#5S);
            IF tTimerState.Q THEN
                iState := 60;
            END_IF;
        ELSE
            tTimerState(IN := FALSE);
        END_IF;

    60: (* STATE_RECOMPRESSION_SYNC: Synchronizing Recompressor & Modulating Split Ratio *)
        rValve_AntiSurge_pct  := 25.0;
        bSystemRunning        := TRUE;

        IF (rRotorSpeed_RC_rpm >= 20000.0) AND (rLTR_PinchPoint_degC >= 5.0) THEN
            tTimerLTRSoak(IN := TRUE, PT := T#6S);
            IF tTimerLTRSoak.Q THEN
                iState := 70;
            END_IF;
        ELSE
            tTimerLTRSoak(IN := FALSE);
        END_IF;

    70: (* STATE_FULL_CYCLE_COGENERATION: Closed Brayton Cycle Full Power MPC Optimization *)
        bSystemRunning := TRUE;
        bSystemReady   := TRUE;

        (* MPC handles dynamic trimming: AntiSurge closes to minimal safety margin *)
        IF NOT bMasterEnable THEN
            iState := 80; (* Initiate controlled ramp down *)
        END_IF;

    80: (* STATE_CONTROLLED_RAMP_DOWN: Orderly Thermal Cooldown & Inventory Recovery *)
        bSystemRunning := FALSE;
        rValve_AntiSurge_pct   := 60.0;
        rValve_SplitRatio_pct  := 15.0;
        rValve_PCHE_Bypass_pct := 30.0;

        IF rRotorSpeed_MC_rpm < rGFB_LiftoffSpeed_rpm THEN
            rValve_GFB_Jacking_pct := 100.0; (* Re-engage hydrostatic jacking to prevent foil touchdown wear *)
        END_IF;

        IF (rRotorSpeed_MC_rpm < 1500.0) AND (rTemp_PCHE_HotIn_degC < 120.0) THEN
            iState := 0; (* Return to cold standby *)
        END_IF;

    90: (* STATE_EMERGENCY_QUENCH_TRIP: Immediate Fast Depressurization & Equipment Protection *)
        bSystemRunning := FALSE;
        bSystemReady   := FALSE;
        rValve_AntiSurge_pct   := 100.0; (* Instant full-open bypass *)
        rValve_PCHE_Bypass_pct := 100.0; (* Attenuate PCHE thermal gradient *)
        rValve_SplitRatio_pct  := 0.0;   (* Isolate recompression stream *)
        rValve_GFB_Jacking_pct := 100.0; (* Flood foil bearings with jacking pressure *)
        rValve_BalPiston_pct   := 50.0;

        tTimerSurgeRecovery(IN := TRUE, PT := T#10S);
        IF (NOT bTripLatched) AND tTimerSurgeRecovery.Q THEN
            iState := 0;
        END_IF;

END_CASE;
(* ========================================================================================= *)
(* 10.0 ACTUATOR CLAMPING, SLEW RATE RESTRICTION & BIT-PACKED STATUS WORDS                   *)
(* ========================================================================================= *)
(* Restricts final valve outputs to physical limits [0.0 - 100.0 %] and packs status words. *)

(* Final Boundary Clamping *)
IF rValve_AntiSurge_pct > 100.0 THEN rValve_AntiSurge_pct := 100.0; END_IF;
IF rValve_AntiSurge_pct < 0.0 THEN rValve_AntiSurge_pct := 0.0; END_IF;

IF rValve_SplitRatio_pct > 100.0 THEN rValve_SplitRatio_pct := 100.0; END_IF;
IF rValve_SplitRatio_pct < 0.0 THEN rValve_SplitRatio_pct := 0.0; END_IF;

IF rValve_PCHE_Bypass_pct > 100.0 THEN rValve_PCHE_Bypass_pct := 100.0; END_IF;
IF rValve_PCHE_Bypass_pct < 0.0 THEN rValve_PCHE_Bypass_pct := 0.0; END_IF;

IF rValve_GFB_Jacking_pct > 100.0 THEN rValve_GFB_Jacking_pct := 100.0; END_IF;
IF rValve_GFB_Jacking_pct < 0.0 THEN rValve_GFB_Jacking_pct := 0.0; END_IF;

IF rValve_BalPiston_pct > 100.0 THEN rValve_BalPiston_pct := 100.0; END_IF;
IF rValve_BalPiston_pct < 0.0 THEN rValve_BalPiston_pct := 0.0; END_IF;

(* Telemetry Permissive Register Assembly *)
dwPermissiveWord := 16#0000_0000;
IF (iPress_HealthyCount >= 2) THEN dwPermissiveWord := dwPermissiveWord OR 16#0000_0001; END_IF;
IF (iTemp_HealthyCount >= 2)  THEN dwPermissiveWord := dwPermissiveWord OR 16#0000_0002; END_IF;
IF (iAxial_HealthyCount >= 2) THEN dwPermissiveWord := dwPermissiveWord OR 16#0000_0004; END_IF;
IF (rPress_GFB_Jacking_bar >= 25.0) THEN dwPermissiveWord := dwPermissiveWord OR 16#0000_0008; END_IF;
IF (rSurgeMargin_MC_pct >= 15.0)   THEN dwPermissiveWord := dwPermissiveWord OR 16#0000_0010; END_IF;
IF (rPCHE_ThermalStress_MPa < 120.0) THEN dwPermissiveWord := dwPermissiveWord OR 16#0000_0020; END_IF;
IF bMasterEnable THEN dwPermissiveWord := dwPermissiveWord OR 16#0000_0040; END_IF;

(* Master System Status Register Assembly *)

(* 1.0 EMERGENCY SAFETY SHUTDOWN & SIL-3 HARDWIRED INTERLOCK EVALUATION                      *)
(* ========================================================================================= *)
(* Hardwired fail-safe logic: If SIL-3 E-Stop pushbutton is depressed or de-energized (Active Low),
   or critical structural trips occur, immediately enter fail-safe decoupling sequence. *)

IF NOT bEmergencyStop THEN
    bSystemRunning := FALSE;
    bSystemReady := FALSE;
    bSystemTrip := TRUE;
    rVFDFrequencyCommand := 0.0;
    rVFDSpeedSetpoint := 0.0;
    rActiveDampingTorque := 0.0;
    rBarrierFluidBleedValve := 0.0;
    dwAlarmWord_1 := dwAlarmWord_1 OR 16#0000_0001; (* Bit 0: Emergency Stop Hardwired Interlock Open *)
    iState := 100; (* Direct divert to Emergency Failsafe Decoupling State *)
END_IF;

(* ========================================================================================= *)
(* 2.0 TRIPLE MODULAR REDUNDANCY (2oo3) SENSOR VOTING ALGORITHMS                             *)
(* ========================================================================================= *)
(* The downhole telemetry subsystem transmits 6 independent sensor triplets across the 3,500m
   armored umbilical. Each triplet is evaluated using a rigorous 2oo3 voting architecture with
   disparity tracking, rogue sensor isolation, autonomous degradation to 1oo2, and fail-safe fallback. *)

(* --- 2.1 Downhole Suction Pressure 2oo3 Voting --- *)
(* Disparity threshold: 4.5 bar, Persistence filter: 0.150 seconds *)
bSuct_Fault_PT1 := FALSE;
bSuct_Fault_PT2 := FALSE;
bSuct_Fault_PT3 := FALSE;

rSuct_Diff12 := ABS(rSuctionPressure_PT1 - rSuctionPressure_PT2);
rSuct_Diff23 := ABS(rSuctionPressure_PT2 - rSuctionPressure_PT3);
rSuct_Diff13 := ABS(rSuctionPressure_PT1 - rSuctionPressure_PT3);

IF rSuct_Diff12 > 4.5 THEN
    rSuct_DisparityAccum_1 := rSuct_DisparityAccum_1 + c_rScanTimeSeconds;
ELSE
    IF rSuct_DisparityAccum_1 > c_rScanTimeSeconds THEN
        rSuct_DisparityAccum_1 := rSuct_DisparityAccum_1 - c_rScanTimeSeconds;
    ELSE
        rSuct_DisparityAccum_1 := 0.0;
    END_IF;
END_IF;

IF rSuct_Diff23 > 4.5 THEN
    rSuct_DisparityAccum_2 := rSuct_DisparityAccum_2 + c_rScanTimeSeconds;
ELSE
    IF rSuct_DisparityAccum_2 > c_rScanTimeSeconds THEN
        rSuct_DisparityAccum_2 := rSuct_DisparityAccum_2 - c_rScanTimeSeconds;
    ELSE
        rSuct_DisparityAccum_2 := 0.0;
    END_IF;
END_IF;

IF rSuct_Diff13 > 4.5 THEN
    rSuct_DisparityAccum_3 := rSuct_DisparityAccum_3 + c_rScanTimeSeconds;
ELSE
    IF rSuct_DisparityAccum_3 > c_rScanTimeSeconds THEN
        rSuct_DisparityAccum_3 := rSuct_DisparityAccum_3 - c_rScanTimeSeconds;
    ELSE
        rSuct_DisparityAccum_3 := 0.0;
    END_IF;
END_IF;

IF (rSuct_DisparityAccum_1 > 0.150) AND (rSuct_DisparityAccum_3 > 0.150) THEN
    bSuct_Fault_PT1 := TRUE;
END_IF;
IF (rSuct_DisparityAccum_1 > 0.150) AND (rSuct_DisparityAccum_2 > 0.150) THEN
    bSuct_Fault_PT2 := TRUE;
END_IF;
IF (rSuct_DisparityAccum_2 > 0.150) AND (rSuct_DisparityAccum_3 > 0.150) THEN
    bSuct_Fault_PT3 := TRUE;
END_IF;

(* Sensor range bounds check [0.0 bar to 450.0 bar] *)
