    IF rBarr_DisparityAccum_3 > c_rScanTimeSeconds THEN
        rBarr_DisparityAccum_3 := rBarr_DisparityAccum_3 - c_rScanTimeSeconds;
    ELSE
        rBarr_DisparityAccum_3 := 0.0;
    END_IF;
END_IF;

IF (rBarr_DisparityAccum_1 > 0.100) AND (rBarr_DisparityAccum_3 > 0.100) THEN bBarr_Fault_DPT1 := TRUE; END_IF;
IF (rBarr_DisparityAccum_1 > 0.100) AND (rBarr_DisparityAccum_2 > 0.100) THEN bBarr_Fault_DPT2 := TRUE; END_IF;
IF (rBarr_DisparityAccum_2 > 0.100) AND (rBarr_DisparityAccum_3 > 0.100) THEN bBarr_Fault_DPT3 := TRUE; END_IF;

IF (rBarrierDiffPressure_DPT1 < -0.50) OR (rBarrierDiffPressure_DPT1 > 1.50) THEN bBarr_Fault_DPT1 := TRUE; END_IF;
IF (rBarrierDiffPressure_DPT2 < -0.50) OR (rBarrierDiffPressure_DPT2 > 1.50) THEN bBarr_Fault_DPT2 := TRUE; END_IF;
IF (rBarrierDiffPressure_DPT3 < -0.50) OR (rBarrierDiffPressure_DPT3 > 1.50) THEN bBarr_Fault_DPT3 := TRUE; END_IF;

IF NOT bBarr_Fault_DPT1 AND NOT bBarr_Fault_DPT2 AND NOT bBarr_Fault_DPT3 THEN
    IF ((rBarrierDiffPressure_DPT1 >= rBarrierDiffPressure_DPT2) AND (rBarrierDiffPressure_DPT1 <= rBarrierDiffPressure_DPT3)) OR
       ((rBarrierDiffPressure_DPT1 <= rBarrierDiffPressure_DPT2) AND (rBarrierDiffPressure_DPT1 >= rBarrierDiffPressure_DPT3)) THEN
        rVotedBarrierDiffPress_Int := rBarrierDiffPressure_DPT1;
    ELSIF ((rBarrierDiffPressure_DPT2 >= rBarrierDiffPressure_DPT1) AND (rBarrierDiffPressure_DPT2 <= rBarrierDiffPressure_DPT3)) OR
          ((rBarrierDiffPressure_DPT2 <= rBarrierDiffPressure_DPT1) AND (rBarrierDiffPressure_DPT2 >= rBarrierDiffPressure_DPT3)) THEN
        rVotedBarrierDiffPress_Int := rBarrierDiffPressure_DPT2;
    ELSE
        rVotedBarrierDiffPress_Int := rBarrierDiffPressure_DPT3;
    END_IF;
    bBarr_Degraded_1oo2 := FALSE;
    bBarr_Failed_Total := FALSE;
ELSIF bBarr_Fault_DPT1 AND NOT bBarr_Fault_DPT2 AND NOT bBarr_Fault_DPT3 THEN
    rVotedBarrierDiffPress_Int := (rBarrierDiffPressure_DPT2 + rBarrierDiffPressure_DPT3) * 0.5;
    bBarr_Degraded_1oo2 := TRUE;
    bBarr_Failed_Total := FALSE;
ELSIF bBarr_Fault_DPT2 AND NOT bBarr_Fault_DPT1 AND NOT bBarr_Fault_DPT3 THEN
    rVotedBarrierDiffPress_Int := (rBarrierDiffPressure_DPT1 + rBarrierDiffPressure_DPT3) * 0.5;
    bBarr_Degraded_1oo2 := TRUE;
    bBarr_Failed_Total := FALSE;
ELSIF bBarr_Fault_DPT3 AND NOT bBarr_Fault_DPT1 AND NOT bBarr_Fault_DPT2 THEN
    rVotedBarrierDiffPress_Int := (rBarrierDiffPressure_DPT1 + rBarrierDiffPressure_DPT2) * 0.5;
    bBarr_Degraded_1oo2 := TRUE;
    bBarr_Failed_Total := FALSE;
ELSE
    bBarr_Failed_Total := TRUE;
    dwAlarmWord_2 := dwAlarmWord_2 OR 16#0000_0020; (* Bit 5: Total Barrier Delta-P TMR Failure *)
END_IF;

rVotedBarrierDiffPress := rVotedBarrierDiffPress_Int;

(* --- 2.7 Downhole Bearing Housing Tri-Axial Vibration Velocity & Crest Factor --- *)
(* Composite Vibration Magnitude: sqrt(Vx^2 + Vy^2 + Vz^2) *)
rCompositeVibrationRMS := SQRT((rPumpVibration_X * rPumpVibration_X) +
                               (rPumpVibration_Y * rPumpVibration_Y) +
                               (rPumpVibration_Z * rPumpVibration_Z));

bDegradedSensorMode := bSuct_Degraded_1oo2 OR bDisc_Degraded_1oo2 OR
                       bSuctT_Degraded_1oo2 OR bMotT_Degraded_1oo2 OR
                       bFlow_Degraded_1oo2 OR bBarr_Degraded_1oo2;
(* ========================================================================================= *)
(* 3.0 HIGH-ENTHALPY GEOTHERMAL BRINE FLASHING & NPSH THERMODYNAMICS                        *)
(* ========================================================================================= *)
(* Real-time thermodynamic model calculating in-situ hypersaline brine density, steam bubble
   point saturation pressure, non-condensable gas partial pressure, Net Positive Suction Head
   Available (NPSHA), required NPSH (NPSHR), and two-phase drift-flux vapor quality. *)

(* In-situ water density: Polynomial approximation for pure water at high temp (T: 20..320 deg C)
   rho_w(T) = 1000.0 - 0.0195 * (T - 20) - 0.00345 * (T - 20)^2 [kg/m3] *)
rBaseWaterDensity := 1000.0 - 0.0195 * (rVotedSuctionTemp - 20.0) - 0.00345 * (rVotedSuctionTemp - 20.0) * (rVotedSuctionTemp - 20.0);
IF rBaseWaterDensity < 700.0 THEN rBaseWaterDensity := 700.0; END_IF;

(* Brine density elevation due to Total Dissolved Solids (TDS [g/L]):
   Delta_rho_salinity = TDS * 0.735 kg/m3 per g/L *)
rSalinityDensityDelta := rBrineSalinityTDS * 0.735;
rBrineMixtureDensity := rBaseWaterDensity + rSalinityDensityDelta;

(* Pure water vapor saturation pressure: Antoine-Clapeyron parameterization [bar]
   log10(P_sat_pure) = 5.20389 - 1733.926 / (T + 233.665) *)
rTmp1 := 5.20389 - (1733.926 / (rVotedSuctionTemp + 233.665));
rPureWaterSatPress := EXPT(10.0, rTmp1);

(* Boiling Point Elevation & Raoult Salinity Depression of Vapor Pressure:
   P_sat_brine = P_sat_pure * (1.0 - 0.000537 * TDS) *)
rTmp2 := 1.0 - (0.000537 * rBrineSalinityTDS);
IF rTmp2 < 0.70 THEN rTmp2 := 0.70; END_IF;
rBrineSaturationPressure := rPureWaterSatPress * rTmp2;

(* Non-Condensable Gas (CO2 / H2S) Outgassing Partial Pressure via Henry's Law:
   K_H_CO2(280 deg C) ~ 4500 bar / mol_frac. Linearized partial pressure calculation *)
rNCGPartialPressure := rNCGMassFraction * 142.5;
rTotalBubblePointPress := rBrineSaturationPressure + rNCGPartialPressure;

(* Fluid linear velocity through first-stage impeller suction eye: v = Q / A *)
(* Q in [m3/h] converted to [m3/s]: Q / 3600.0 *)
rImpellerEyeVelocity := (rVotedBrineFlow / 3600.0) / c_rImpellerEyeArea;

(* Dynamic velocity head term: v^2 / (2 * g) [m] *)
rDynamicVelocityHead := (rImpellerEyeVelocity * rImpellerEyeVelocity) / (2.0 * c_rGravityAcc);

(* Suction bell and casing inlet frictional head loss: h_loss = K_loss * v^2 / 2g *)
rEyeFrictionalHeadLoss := 0.35 * rDynamicVelocityHead;

(* Net Positive Suction Head Available (NPSHA) at first impeller eye:
   NPSHA = 100,000 * (P_suct - P_bubble) / (rho * g) + v^2/2g - h_loss *)
rCalculatedNPSHA_Int := ((100000.0 * (rVotedSuctionPress - rTotalBubblePointPress)) /
                         (rBrineMixtureDensity * c_rGravityAcc)) +
                         rDynamicVelocityHead - rEyeFrictionalHeadLoss;
rCalculatedNPSHA := rCalculatedNPSHA_Int;

(* Net Positive Suction Head Required (NPSHR) scaling with speed and flow:
   NPSHR = NPSHR_bep * (N / N_nom)^2 + K_q * (Q / Q_nom)^2 *)
rSpeedRatio := rPumpSpeedFeedback / c_rRatedMotorSpeed;
IF rSpeedRatio < 0.20 THEN rSpeedRatio := 0.20; END_IF;

rFlowRatio := rVotedBrineFlow / c_rPumpBestEfficiencyFlow;
IF rFlowRatio < 0.10 THEN rFlowRatio := 0.10; END_IF;

rCalculatedNPSHR_Int := (8.5 * (rSpeedRatio * rSpeedRatio)) + (6.2 * (rFlowRatio * rFlowRatio));
rCalculatedNPSHR := rCalculatedNPSHR_Int;

(* Cavitation Safety Index Margin: C_margin = NPSHA / NPSHR *)
IF rCalculatedNPSHR_Int > 0.1 THEN
    rCavitationIndexMargin := rCalculatedNPSHA_Int / rCalculatedNPSHR_Int;
ELSE
    rCavitationIndexMargin := 5.0;
END_IF;

(* Two-Phase Flashing Expansion & Vapor Void Fraction Estimation (Drift-Flux Model):
   If P_suct < P_bubble, flashing occurs. Mass vapor quality x = (h - h_L) / h_LV *)
IF rVotedSuctionPress < rTotalBubblePointPress THEN
    (* Thermodynamic flash quality approximation *)
    rTmp3 := (rTotalBubblePointPress - rVotedSuctionPress) / rTotalBubblePointPress;
    IF rTmp3 > 0.25 THEN rTmp3 := 0.25; END_IF;
    rVaporQuality_x := rTmp3 * 0.145;

    (* Vapor density at saturation pressure: Ideal gas approximation rho_v = P / (R_steam * T) *)
    rVaporDensity := (rTotalBubblePointPress * 100000.0) / (461.5 * (rVotedSuctionTemp + 273.15));
    IF rVaporDensity < 0.5 THEN rVaporDensity := 0.5; END_IF;

    (* Volumetric void fraction alpha = (1 + ((1-x)/x) * (rho_v / rho_L) * S)^(-1) *)
    IF rVaporQuality_x > 0.0001 THEN
        rTmp4 := 1.0 + (((1.0 - rVaporQuality_x) / rVaporQuality_x) *
                        (rVaporDensity / rBrineMixtureDensity) * rSlipRatio_S);
        rVoidFraction_alpha := 1.0 / rTmp4;
    ELSE
        rVoidFraction_alpha := 0.0;
    END_IF;
ELSE
    rVaporQuality_x := 0.0;
    rVoidFraction_alpha := 0.0;
END_IF;
rTwoPhaseVaporFraction := rVoidFraction_alpha;

(* Head degradation under two-phase flashing: H = H_ideal * (1 - 1.85 * alpha) *)
rTmpA := 1.0 - (1.85 * rVoidFraction_alpha);
IF rTmpA < 0.15 THEN rTmpA := 0.15; END_IF;
rDifferentialHeadDeveloped := (c_rStagesCount * c_rStageBaseHead * (rSpeedRatio * rSpeedRatio)) * rTmpA;

(* Flashing Cavitation Warning & Hard Interlock Evaluation *)
IF rCavitationIndexMargin < c_rMinCavitationMarginWarn THEN
    bCavitationAlarm := TRUE;
    dwAlarmWord_1 := dwAlarmWord_1 OR 16#0000_0002; (* Bit 1: Incipient Cavitation Flashing Warning *)
ELSE
    bCavitationAlarm := FALSE;
END_IF;

IF rCavitationIndexMargin < c_rMinCavitationMarginTrip THEN
    dwAlarmWord_1 := dwAlarmWord_1 OR 16#0000_0004; (* Bit 2: Critical Cavitation Trip Interlock *)
END_IF;

(* Critical Void Fraction Vapor Locking Interlock *)
IF rVoidFraction_alpha > c_rMaxTwoPhaseVaporTrip THEN
    dwAlarmWord_1 := dwAlarmWord_1 OR 16#0000_0800; (* Bit 11: Severe Two-Phase Vapor Lock Trip *)
END_IF;

(* ========================================================================================= *)
(* 4.0 DOWNHOLE DRIVE TRAIN TORSIONAL HARMONICS & VSD ACTIVE DAMPING                         *)
(* ========================================================================================= *)
(* High-order discrete state observer and dual biquad bandpass filter isolating dynamic shaft
   torsional vibrations across the 3,500m string at resonant poles (14.5 Hz and 32.1 Hz).
   Injects synthetic counter-phase damping torque directly into the VFD torque command loop. *)

(* Biquad Bandpass Filter 1 (Centered at f_res1 = 14.5 Hz, Q = 5.0, Ts = 0.010 s)
   Transfer function discrete bilinear transform coefficients:
   b0 = 0.0835, b1 = 0.0, b2 = -0.0835, a1 = -1.6350, a2 = 0.8330 *)
rTmp1 := (rPumpSpeedFeedback * 0.10471975) - (rVFDOutputFrequency * 6.2831853); (* Delta_omega [rad/s] *)

rBPF1_y := (0.0835 * rTmp1) - (0.0835 * rBPF1_x2) - (-1.6350 * rBPF1_x1) - (0.8330 * rBPF1_x2);
rBPF1_x2 := rBPF1_x1;
rBPF1_x1 := rBPF1_y;

(* Biquad Bandpass Filter 2 (Centered at f_res2 = 32.1 Hz, Q = 6.0, Ts = 0.010 s)
   b0 = 0.0520, b1 = 0.0, b2 = -0.0520, a1 = -1.1240, a2 = 0.8960 *)
rBPF2_y := (0.0520 * rTmp1) - (0.0520 * rBPF2_x2) - (-1.1240 * rBPF2_x1) - (0.8960 * rBPF2_x2);
rBPF2_x2 := rBPF2_x1;
rBPF2_x1 := rBPF2_y;

(* Composite observed torsional twist velocity *)
rTorsionalVelocityTwist := rBPF1_y + (0.65 * rBPF2_y);

(* Active synthetic damping torque injection: T_damp = -K_damp * d(theta)/dt *)
rTorsionalDampingTorque_Int := -34.5 * rTorsionalVelocityTwist;

(* Saturate maximum synthetic damping injection to +/- 15% rated motor torque (Rating: ~3270 N*m) *)
IF rTorsionalDampingTorque_Int > 490.0 THEN
    rTorsionalDampingTorque_Int := 490.0;
ELSIF rTorsionalDampingTorque_Int < -490.0 THEN
    rTorsionalDampingTorque_Int := -490.0;
END_IF;
rActiveDampingTorque := rTorsionalDampingTorque_Int;

(* Dynamic Shaft Angular Twist Deflection integration: d(delta_theta)/dt = omega_twist *)
rDynamicShaftDeflectionRad := rDynamicShaftDeflectionRad + (rTorsionalVelocityTwist * c_rScanTimeSeconds);
(* High-pass wash-out filter on twist angle to eliminate steady-state integration drift *)
rDynamicShaftDeflectionRad := rDynamicShaftDeflectionRad * 0.995;

(* Peak Dynamic Shear Stress Amplitude: tau = (G * r * delta_theta) / L = T_dyn / Wp *)
rPeakShearStress_MPa := (ABS(rTorsionalDampingTorque_Int * 3.8) / c_rShaftPolarModulus) * 1.0E-6;
rEstimatedTorsionalStress := rPeakShearStress_MPa;

(* Detect dominant torsional oscillation frequency *)
IF ABS(rBPF1_y) > ABS(rBPF2_y) THEN
    rTorsionalOscillationFreq := c_rTorsionalResonanceFreq1;
ELSE
    rTorsionalOscillationFreq := c_rTorsionalResonanceFreq2;
END_IF;

(* Torsional Resonance Lock Condition Flag *)
IF (rPeakShearStress_MPa > (c_rMaxTorsionalShearLimit * 0.65)) AND (ABS(rTorsionalVelocityTwist) > 1.85) THEN
    bTorsionalResonanceLock := TRUE;
    dwAlarmWord_1 := dwAlarmWord_1 OR 16#0000_0008; (* Bit 3: Torsional Harmonic Resonance Lock Alert *)
ELSE
    bTorsionalResonanceLock := FALSE;
END_IF;

IF rPeakShearStress_MPa > c_rMaxTorsionalShearLimit THEN
    dwAlarmWord_1 := dwAlarmWord_1 OR 16#0000_0010; (* Bit 4: Critical Shaft Shear Fatigue Trip *)
END_IF;
(* ========================================================================================= *)
(* 5.0 DIELECTRIC BARRIER FLUID EXPANSION PRESSURE REGULATION                                *)
(* ========================================================================================= *)
(* Regulates the internal dielectric oil overpressure inside the ESP motor protector section.
   Guarantees a positive differential (0.10 to 0.40 bar) above wellbore hydrostatic pressure to
   strictly prevent corrosive, hypersaline brine ingress while protecting shaft seals from blowout. *)

(* Thermal Volumetric Expansion Model for Synthetic Polyol-Ester Oil:
   Delta_V = V_0 * [beta_1 * (T - 20) + beta_2 * (T - 20)^2]
   beta_1 = 8.42E-4 [1/K], beta_2 = 5.20E-7 [1/K^2] *)
rTmp1 := rVotedMotorTemp - 20.0;
IF rTmp1 < 0.0 THEN rTmp1 := 0.0; END_IF;

rThermalExpansionFactor := (c_rDielectricBeta1 * rTmp1) + (c_rDielectricBeta2 * rTmp1 * rTmp1);
rTargetExpandedOilVolume := c_rBaseDielectricVolume * (1.0 + rThermalExpansionFactor);
rBellowsVolumeExpansion := rTargetExpandedOilVolume - c_rBaseDielectricVolume;

(* Expected Bellows Linear Stroke Position: x_bellows = Delta_V / A_bellows *)
rBellowsPositionMeters := (rBellowsVolumeExpansion * 0.001) / c_rBellowsArea;

(* Closed-Loop Differential Pressure Error: e = Delta_P_barrier - Delta_P_target *)
rBarrierDiffError := rVotedBarrierDiffPress_Int - c_rBarrierTargetDeltaP;

(* Solenoid Relief Valve Modulation: Proportional-Integral with Anti-Windup *)
IF bBarrierBleedPermissive THEN
    rBarrierIntegralAccum := rBarrierIntegralAccum + (rBarrierDiffError * c_rScanTimeSeconds * 12.5);
    IF rBarrierIntegralAccum > 100.0 THEN
        rBarrierIntegralAccum := 100.0;
    ELSIF rBarrierIntegralAccum < 0.0 THEN
        rBarrierIntegralAccum := 0.0;
    END_IF;

    rBarrierBleedDemand := (45.0 * rBarrierDiffError) + rBarrierIntegralAccum;
    IF rBarrierBleedDemand > 100.0 THEN
        rBarrierBleedDemand := 100.0;
    ELSIF rBarrierBleedDemand < 0.0 THEN
        rBarrierBleedDemand := 0.0;
    END_IF;
ELSE
    rBarrierBleedDemand := 0.0;
    rBarrierIntegralAccum := 0.0;
END_IF;
rBarrierFluidBleedValve := rBarrierBleedDemand;

(* Dielectric Barrier Overpressure and Underpressure Interlocks *)
IF (rVotedBarrierDiffPress_Int < c_rBarrierMinDeltaPWarn) OR
   (rVotedBarrierDiffPress_Int > c_rBarrierMaxDeltaPWarn) THEN
    bBarrierPressureAbnormal := TRUE;
    dwAlarmWord_2 := dwAlarmWord_2 OR 16#0000_0040; (* Bit 6: Barrier Differential Warning *)
ELSE
    bBarrierPressureAbnormal := FALSE;
END_IF;

IF rVotedBarrierDiffPress_Int < c_rBarrierMinDeltaPTrip THEN
    dwAlarmWord_1 := dwAlarmWord_1 OR 16#0000_0020; (* Bit 5: Critical Brine Ingress Hazard Trip *)
END_IF;

IF rVotedBarrierDiffPress_Int > c_rBarrierMaxDeltaPTrip THEN
    dwAlarmWord_1 := dwAlarmWord_1 OR 16#0000_0040; (* Bit 6: Barrier Seal Overpressure Blowout Trip *)
END_IF;

(* ========================================================================================= *)
(* 6.0 6-STATE STATE-SPACE OBSERVER & MODEL PREDICTIVE CONTROL (MPC)                         *)
(* ========================================================================================= *)
(* Computes state innovation updates using discrete state-space matrices (A, B, C, D) and
   solves a deterministic Quadratic Programming (QP) optimization for VFD frequency and choke
   commands with anti-windup rate limiting and anti-flashing speed derating. *)

(* --- 6.1 Luenberger / Kalman Filter State Observer Prediction & Innovation --- *)
(* Measured output perturbations: y[1] = P_suct - P_suct_nominal, y[2] = P_disc - P_disc_nominal *)
y1_Meas := rVotedSuctionPress - 350.0;
y2_Meas := rVotedDischargePress - 480.0;

(* Output estimate: y_est = Cd * x_hat *)
y1_Est := (Cd_11 * x1_SuctDev) + (Cd_12 * x2_DiscDev) + (Cd_13 * x3_VoidFracDev) +
          (Cd_14 * x4_TwistAngDev) + (Cd_15 * x5_TwistVelDev) + (Cd_16 * x6_BarrierDev);

y2_Est := (Cd_21 * x1_SuctDev) + (Cd_22 * x2_DiscDev) + (Cd_23 * x3_VoidFracDev) +
          (Cd_24 * x4_TwistAngDev) + (Cd_25 * x5_TwistVelDev) + (Cd_26 * x6_BarrierDev);

(* Output innovation: y_innov = y_meas - y_est *)
y1_Innov := y1_Meas - y1_Est;
y2_Innov := y2_Meas - y2_Est;

(* State propagation: x_next = Ad * x_hat + Bd * u + L * y_innov *)
x1_Next := (Ad_11 * x1_SuctDev) + (Ad_12 * x2_DiscDev) + (Ad_13 * x3_VoidFracDev) +
           (Ad_14 * x4_TwistAngDev) + (Ad_15 * x5_TwistVelDev) + (Ad_16 * x6_BarrierDev) +
           (Bd_11 * Delta_u1_opt) + (Bd_12 * Delta_u2_opt) +
           (L_11 * y1_Innov) + (L_12 * y2_Innov);

x2_Next := (Ad_21 * x1_SuctDev) + (Ad_22 * x2_DiscDev) + (Ad_23 * x3_VoidFracDev) +
           (Ad_24 * x4_TwistAngDev) + (Ad_25 * x5_TwistVelDev) + (Ad_26 * x6_BarrierDev) +
           (Bd_21 * Delta_u1_opt) + (Bd_22 * Delta_u2_opt) +
           (L_21 * y1_Innov) + (L_22 * y2_Innov);

x3_Next := (Ad_31 * x1_SuctDev) + (Ad_32 * x2_DiscDev) + (Ad_33 * x3_VoidFracDev) +
           (Ad_34 * x4_TwistAngDev) + (Ad_35 * x5_TwistVelDev) + (Ad_36 * x6_BarrierDev) +
           (Bd_31 * Delta_u1_opt) + (Bd_32 * Delta_u2_opt) +
           (L_31 * y1_Innov) + (L_32 * y2_Innov);

x4_Next := (Ad_41 * x1_SuctDev) + (Ad_42 * x2_DiscDev) + (Ad_43 * x3_VoidFracDev) +
           (Ad_44 * x4_TwistAngDev) + (Ad_45 * x5_TwistVelDev) + (Ad_46 * x6_BarrierDev) +
           (Bd_41 * Delta_u1_opt) + (Bd_42 * Delta_u2_opt) +
           (L_41 * y1_Innov) + (L_42 * y2_Innov);

x5_Next := (Ad_51 * x1_SuctDev) + (Ad_52 * x2_DiscDev) + (Ad_53 * x3_VoidFracDev) +
           (Ad_54 * x4_TwistAngDev) + (Ad_55 * x5_TwistVelDev) + (Ad_56 * x6_BarrierDev) +
           (Bd_51 * Delta_u1_opt) + (Bd_52 * Delta_u2_opt) +
           (L_51 * y1_Innov) + (L_52 * y2_Innov);

x6_Next := (Ad_61 * x1_SuctDev) + (Ad_62 * x2_DiscDev) + (Ad_63 * x3_VoidFracDev) +
           (Ad_64 * x4_TwistAngDev) + (Ad_65 * x5_TwistVelDev) + (Ad_66 * x6_BarrierDev) +
           (Bd_61 * Delta_u1_opt) + (Bd_62 * Delta_u2_opt) +
           (L_61 * y1_Innov) + (L_62 * y2_Innov);

(* Update state vector registers *)
x1_SuctDev     := x1_Next;
x2_DiscDev     := x2_Next;
x3_VoidFracDev := x3_Next;
x4_TwistAngDev := x4_Next;
x5_TwistVelDev := x5_Next;
x6_BarrierDev  := x6_Next;

(* --- 6.2 Model Predictive Control (MPC) Quadratic Programming Solver --- *)
(* Cost Function: J = 0.5 * Delta_u^T * H * Delta_u + g^T * Delta_u
   Gradient computation: g = H_grad_x * x_hat - H_ref * ref *)
Grad_1 := (1.250 * x1_SuctDev) + (0.450 * x2_DiscDev) - (1.100 * rRef_SuctionPressDelta);
Grad_2 := (-0.380 * x1_SuctDev) + (0.820 * x2_DiscDev) - (0.950 * rRef_DischargePressDelta);

(* Unconstrained QP step: Delta_u_unc = -H_inv * Gradient *)
Delta_u1_unc := -((HessInv_11 * Grad_1) + (HessInv_12 * Grad_2));
Delta_u2_unc := -((HessInv_21 * Grad_1) + (HessInv_22 * Grad_2));

(* Apply Dynamic Anti-Flashing Speed Derating Factor K_derate:
   If cavitation margin ratio is low, heavily damp positive frequency accelerations *)
IF rCavitationIndexMargin < 1.35 THEN
    rCavitationSpeedDerate := (rCavitationIndexMargin - 1.05) / 0.30;
    IF rCavitationSpeedDerate < 0.0 THEN rCavitationSpeedDerate := 0.0; END_IF;
    IF rCavitationSpeedDerate > 1.0 THEN rCavitationSpeedDerate := 1.0; END_IF;
ELSE
    rCavitationSpeedDerate := 1.00;
END_IF;

IF Delta_u1_unc > 0.0 THEN
    Delta_u1_opt := Delta_u1_unc * rCavitationSpeedDerate;
ELSE
    Delta_u1_opt := Delta_u1_unc;
END_IF;
Delta_u2_opt := Delta_u2_unc;

(* Enforce Hard Box Constraints on Actuator Slew Rates *)
IF Delta_u1_opt > c_rDeltaU1_Max THEN
    Delta_u1_opt := c_rDeltaU1_Max;
ELSIF Delta_u1_opt < c_rDeltaU1_Min THEN
    Delta_u1_opt := c_rDeltaU1_Min;
END_IF;

IF Delta_u2_opt > c_rDeltaU2_Max THEN
    Delta_u2_opt := c_rDeltaU2_Max;
ELSIF Delta_u2_opt < c_rDeltaU2_Min THEN
    Delta_u2_opt := c_rDeltaU2_Min;
END_IF;

(* Integrate Actuator Demands *)
IF bSystemRunning THEN
    rVFDFreqDemand_Internal := rVFDFreqDemand_Internal + Delta_u1_opt;
    rChokeDemand_Internal := rChokeDemand_Internal + Delta_u2_opt;
ELSE
    IF iState < 30 THEN
        rVFDFreqDemand_Internal := 0.0;
        rChokeDemand_Internal := 15.0;
    END_IF;
END_IF;

(* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* 1.1 SMES Magnet Primary Fluxgate Transductor Current 2oo3 Voting Routine                             *)
(* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
rI_Mag_Dev_12_kA := ABS(rI_Magnet_Sens1_kA - rI_Magnet_Sens2_kA);
rI_Mag_Dev_23_kA := ABS(rI_Magnet_Sens2_kA - rI_Magnet_Sens3_kA);
rI_Mag_Dev_31_kA := ABS(rI_Magnet_Sens3_kA - rI_Magnet_Sens1_kA);

(* Evaluate Health of Individual Current Sensor Channels *)
bI_Mag_Sens1_Healthy := (rI_Mag_Dev_12_kA <= rI_Mag_Tol_kA) OR (rI_Mag_Dev_31_kA <= rI_Mag_Tol_kA);
bI_Mag_Sens2_Healthy := (rI_Mag_Dev_12_kA <= rI_Mag_Tol_kA) OR (rI_Mag_Dev_23_kA <= rI_Mag_Tol_kA);
bI_Mag_Sens3_Healthy := (rI_Mag_Dev_23_kA <= rI_Mag_Tol_kA) OR (rI_Mag_Dev_31_kA <= rI_Mag_Tol_kA);

IF bI_Mag_Sens1_Healthy AND bI_Mag_Sens2_Healthy AND bI_Mag_Sens3_Healthy THEN
    (* Full 2oo3 Normal Operation: Select Exact Median of 3 Channels *)
    iI_Mag_Degraded_Mode := 3;
    IF (rI_Magnet_Sens1_kA >= rI_Magnet_Sens2_kA AND rI_Magnet_Sens1_kA <= rI_Magnet_Sens3_kA) OR
       (rI_Magnet_Sens1_kA <= rI_Magnet_Sens2_kA AND rI_Magnet_Sens1_kA >= rI_Magnet_Sens3_kA) THEN
        rI_Mag_Voted_kA := rI_Magnet_Sens1_kA;
    ELSIF (rI_Magnet_Sens2_kA >= rI_Magnet_Sens1_kA AND rI_Magnet_Sens2_kA <= rI_Magnet_Sens3_kA) OR
          (rI_Magnet_Sens2_kA <= rI_Magnet_Sens1_kA AND rI_Magnet_Sens2_kA >= rI_Magnet_Sens3_kA) THEN
        rI_Mag_Voted_kA := rI_Magnet_Sens2_kA;
    ELSE
        rI_Mag_Voted_kA := rI_Magnet_Sens3_kA;
    END_IF;
    nI_Mag_Discrepancy_Counter := 0;

ELSIF bI_Mag_Sens1_Healthy AND bI_Mag_Sens2_Healthy THEN
    (* Degraded 1oo2 Operation: Channel 3 Failed *)
    iI_Mag_Degraded_Mode := 2;
    rI_Mag_Voted_kA := 0.5 * (rI_Magnet_Sens1_kA + rI_Magnet_Sens2_kA);
    dwAlarm_Warnings := dwAlarm_Warnings OR 16#00000001; (* Bit 0: Mag Current Sensor 3 Fault *)

ELSIF bI_Mag_Sens2_Healthy AND bI_Mag_Sens3_Healthy THEN
    (* Degraded 1oo2 Operation: Channel 1 Failed *)
    iI_Mag_Degraded_Mode := 2;
    rI_Mag_Voted_kA := 0.5 * (rI_Magnet_Sens2_kA + rI_Magnet_Sens3_kA);
    dwAlarm_Warnings := dwAlarm_Warnings OR 16#00000002; (* Bit 1: Mag Current Sensor 1 Fault *)

ELSIF bI_Mag_Sens3_Healthy AND bI_Mag_Sens1_Healthy THEN
    (* Degraded 1oo2 Operation: Channel 2 Failed *)
    iI_Mag_Degraded_Mode := 2;
    rI_Mag_Voted_kA := 0.5 * (rI_Magnet_Sens3_kA + rI_Magnet_Sens1_kA);
    dwAlarm_Warnings := dwAlarm_Warnings OR 16#00000004; (* Bit 2: Mag Current Sensor 2 Fault *)

ELSE
    (* Multiple Sensor Failure Discrepancy -> Increment Discrepancy Accumulator *)
    nI_Mag_Discrepancy_Counter := nI_Mag_Discrepancy_Counter + 1;
    IF nI_Mag_Discrepancy_Counter > 10 THEN (* Persisted > 2.0 ms *)
        iI_Mag_Degraded_Mode := 0;
        dwAlarm_Critical_Trips := dwAlarm_Critical_Trips OR 16#00000001; (* Bit 0: 2oo3 Current Total Loss *)
        rI_Mag_Voted_kA := rI_Magnet_Sens1_kA; (* Freeze or use last channel for fail-safe dump *)
    ELSE
        rI_Mag_Voted_kA := rI_Magnet_Sens1_kA;
    END_IF;
END_IF;

(* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* 1.2 Cryogenic Coil Core Temperature 2oo3 Conservative Voting Routine                                 *)
(* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
rT_Coil_Dev_12_K := ABS(rT_Cryo_Coil_Top_K - rT_Cryo_Coil_Mid_K);
rT_Coil_Dev_23_K := ABS(rT_Cryo_Coil_Mid_K - rT_Cryo_Coil_Bot_K);
rT_Coil_Dev_31_K := ABS(rT_Cryo_Coil_Bot_K - rT_Cryo_Coil_Top_K);

bT_Coil_Sens1_Healthy := (rT_Cryo_Coil_Top_K >= 1.5) AND (rT_Cryo_Coil_Top_K <= 150.0);
bT_Coil_Sens2_Healthy := (rT_Cryo_Coil_Mid_K >= 1.5) AND (rT_Cryo_Coil_Mid_K <= 150.0);
bT_Coil_Sens3_Healthy := (rT_Cryo_Coil_Bot_K >= 1.5) AND (rT_Cryo_Coil_Bot_K <= 150.0);

(* For Superconducting Protection, Select Conservative Maximum Across Healthy Channels *)
IF bT_Coil_Sens1_Healthy AND bT_Coil_Sens2_Healthy AND bT_Coil_Sens3_Healthy THEN
    iT_Coil_Degraded_Mode := 3;
    rT_Coil_Voted_K := MAX(rT_Cryo_Coil_Top_K, MAX(rT_Cryo_Coil_Mid_K, rT_Cryo_Coil_Bot_K));
ELSIF bT_Coil_Sens1_Healthy AND bT_Coil_Sens2_Healthy THEN
    iT_Coil_Degraded_Mode := 2;
    rT_Coil_Voted_K := MAX(rT_Cryo_Coil_Top_K, rT_Cryo_Coil_Mid_K);
    dwAlarm_Warnings := dwAlarm_Warnings OR 16#00000010; (* Bit 4: Cryo Temp Sensor Bot Failed *)
ELSIF bT_Coil_Sens2_Healthy AND bT_Coil_Sens3_Healthy THEN
    iT_Coil_Degraded_Mode := 2;
    rT_Coil_Voted_K := MAX(rT_Cryo_Coil_Mid_K, rT_Cryo_Coil_Bot_K);
    dwAlarm_Warnings := dwAlarm_Warnings OR 16#00000020; (* Bit 5: Cryo Temp Sensor Top Failed *)
ELSIF bT_Coil_Sens3_Healthy AND bT_Coil_Sens1_Healthy THEN
    iT_Coil_Degraded_Mode := 2;
    rT_Coil_Voted_K := MAX(rT_Cryo_Coil_Bot_K, rT_Cryo_Coil_Top_K);
    dwAlarm_Warnings := dwAlarm_Warnings OR 16#00000040; (* Bit 6: Cryo Temp Sensor Mid Failed *)
ELSE
    iT_Coil_Degraded_Mode := 0;
    rT_Coil_Voted_K := 99.9; (* Force High Temp Fail-Safe *)
    dwAlarm_Critical_Trips := dwAlarm_Critical_Trips OR 16#00000002; (* Bit 1: Total Loss Cryo Temp Telemetry *)
END_IF;

(* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* 1.3 REBCO Azimuthal Hoop Microstrain 2oo3 Voting Routine                                             *)
(* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
rStrain_Dev_12_uE := ABS(rStrain_Tape_Hoop_Sens1_uE - rStrain_Tape_Hoop_Sens2_uE);
rStrain_Dev_23_uE := ABS(rStrain_Tape_Hoop_Sens2_uE - rStrain_Tape_Hoop_Sens3_uE);
rStrain_Dev_31_uE := ABS(rStrain_Tape_Hoop_Sens3_uE - rStrain_Tape_Hoop_Sens1_uE);

bStrain_Sens1_Healthy := (rStrain_Tape_Hoop_Sens1_uE >= -1000.0) AND (rStrain_Tape_Hoop_Sens1_uE <= 10000.0);
bStrain_Sens2_Healthy := (rStrain_Tape_Hoop_Sens2_uE >= -1000.0) AND (rStrain_Tape_Hoop_Sens2_uE <= 10000.0);
bStrain_Sens3_Healthy := (rStrain_Tape_Hoop_Sens3_uE >= -1000.0) AND (rStrain_Tape_Hoop_Sens3_uE <= 10000.0);

IF bStrain_Sens1_Healthy AND bStrain_Sens2_Healthy AND bStrain_Sens3_Healthy THEN
    iStrain_Degraded_Mode := 3;
    (* Conservative Maximum of 3 Strain Channels for Structural Safety *)
    rStrain_Hoop_Voted_uE := MAX(rStrain_Tape_Hoop_Sens1_uE, MAX(rStrain_Tape_Hoop_Sens2_uE, rStrain_Tape_Hoop_Sens3_uE));
ELSIF bStrain_Sens1_Healthy AND bStrain_Sens2_Healthy THEN
    iStrain_Degraded_Mode := 2;
    rStrain_Hoop_Voted_uE := MAX(rStrain_Tape_Hoop_Sens1_uE, rStrain_Tape_Hoop_Sens2_uE);
    dwAlarm_Warnings := dwAlarm_Warnings OR 16#00000100; (* Bit 8: Strain Sensor 3 Fault *)
ELSIF bStrain_Sens2_Healthy AND bStrain_Sens3_Healthy THEN
    iStrain_Degraded_Mode := 2;
    rStrain_Hoop_Voted_uE := MAX(rStrain_Tape_Hoop_Sens2_uE, rStrain_Tape_Hoop_Sens3_uE);
    dwAlarm_Warnings := dwAlarm_Warnings OR 16#00000200; (* Bit 9: Strain Sensor 1 Fault *)
ELSIF bStrain_Sens3_Healthy AND bStrain_Sens1_Healthy THEN
    iStrain_Degraded_Mode := 2;
    rStrain_Hoop_Voted_uE := MAX(rStrain_Tape_Hoop_Sens3_uE, rStrain_Tape_Hoop_Sens1_uE);
    dwAlarm_Warnings := dwAlarm_Warnings OR 16#00000400; (* Bit 10: Strain Sensor 2 Fault *)
ELSE
    iStrain_Degraded_Mode := 0;
    rStrain_Hoop_Voted_uE := 7000.0; (* Overlimit Trip Injection *)
    dwAlarm_Critical_Trips := dwAlarm_Critical_Trips OR 16#00000004; (* Bit 2: Total Loss of Strain Telemetry *)
END_IF;

rMax_Hoop_Microstrain_uE := rStrain_Hoop_Voted_uE;

(* ==================================================================================================== *)
(* SUBSYSTEM 2: SOGI-PLL & POSITIVE/NEGATIVE SEQUENCE VOLTAGE/CURRENT EXTRACTION                         *)
(* ==================================================================================================== *)

(* 2.1 Clarke Transformation: Convert 3-Phase Instantaneous (abc) to Stationary Frame (alpha/beta/zero) *)
rV_Alpha := SQRT_2_OVER_3 * (rV_Grid_L1_kV - 0.5 * rV_Grid_L2_kV - 0.5 * rV_Grid_L3_kV);
rV_Beta  := SQRT_2_OVER_3 * (SQRT_3 * 0.5 * rV_Grid_L2_kV - SQRT_3 * 0.5 * rV_Grid_L3_kV);
rV_Zero  := SQRT_2_OVER_3 * (INV_SQRT_3 * (rV_Grid_L1_kV + rV_Grid_L2_kV + rV_Grid_L3_kV));

rI_Alpha := SQRT_2_OVER_3 * (rI_Grid_L1_kA - 0.5 * rI_Grid_L2_kA - 0.5 * rI_Grid_L3_kA);
rI_Beta  := SQRT_2_OVER_3 * (SQRT_3 * 0.5 * rI_Grid_L2_kA - SQRT_3 * 0.5 * rI_Grid_L3_kA);

(* 2.2 Discrete SOGI (Second-Order Generalized Integrator) for Phase A In-Phase & Quadrature Generation *)
(* Trapezoidal Numerical Integration Formulation *)
rTemp_Val1 := rV_Alpha - rSOGI_v_prime;
rTemp_Val2 := rSOGI_Gain_k * rTemp_Val1 - rSOGI_qv_prime;

rSOGI_v_prime  := rSOGI_v_prime_prev + (rDt_Seconds * rSOGI_Omega_Grid * rTemp_Val2);
rSOGI_qv_prime := rSOGI_qv_prime_prev + (rDt_Seconds * rSOGI_Omega_Grid * rSOGI_v_prime);

rSOGI_v_prime_prev  := rSOGI_v_prime;
rSOGI_qv_prime_prev := rSOGI_qv_prime;

(* 2.3 Instantaneous Symmetrical Component Decomposition in Alpha-Beta Frame *)
rV_Alpha_Pos := 0.5 * (rV_Alpha - rSOGI_qv_prime);
rV_Beta_Pos  := 0.5 * (rV_Beta + rSOGI_v_prime);

rV_Alpha_Neg := 0.5 * (rV_Alpha + rSOGI_qv_prime);
rV_Beta_Neg  := 0.5 * (rV_Beta - rSOGI_v_prime);

(* 2.4 Park Transformation to Synchronous Rotating Frame (d-q Pos and Neg) *)
rV_d_Pos :=  rV_Alpha_Pos * COS(rSOGI_Phase_Angle) + rV_Beta_Pos * SIN(rSOGI_Phase_Angle);
rV_q_Pos := -rV_Alpha_Pos * SIN(rSOGI_Phase_Angle) + rV_Beta_Pos * COS(rSOGI_Phase_Angle);

rV_d_Neg :=  rV_Alpha_Neg * COS(-rSOGI_Phase_Angle) + rV_Beta_Neg * SIN(-rSOGI_Phase_Angle);
rV_q_Neg := -rV_Alpha_Neg * SIN(-rSOGI_Phase_Angle) + rV_Beta_Neg * COS(-rSOGI_Phase_Angle);

rI_d_Pos :=  rI_Alpha * COS(rSOGI_Phase_Angle) + rI_Beta * SIN(rSOGI_Phase_Angle);
rI_q_Pos := -rI_Alpha * SIN(rSOGI_Phase_Angle) + rI_Beta * COS(rSOGI_Phase_Angle);

(* 2.5 Phase-Locked Loop (PLL) Loop Filter Updates *)
rPLL_Integ_State := rPLL_Integ_State + (rPLL_Integ_Gain * rV_q_Pos * rDt_Seconds);
(* Anti-Windup Clamping on Grid Frequency (45 Hz to 65 Hz) *)
IF rPLL_Integ_State < (TWO_PI * 45.0) THEN
    rPLL_Integ_State := TWO_PI * 45.0;
ELSIF rPLL_Integ_State > (TWO_PI * 65.0) THEN
    rPLL_Integ_State := TWO_PI * 65.0;
END_IF;

rSOGI_Omega_Grid := rPLL_Integ_State + (rPLL_Prop_Gain * rV_q_Pos);
rSOGI_Phase_Angle := rSOGI_Phase_Angle + (rSOGI_Omega_Grid * rDt_Seconds);

(* Modulo 2*PI Wrap Around *)
WHILE rSOGI_Phase_Angle >= TWO_PI DO
    rSOGI_Phase_Angle := rSOGI_Phase_Angle - TWO_PI;
END_WHILE;
WHILE rSOGI_Phase_Angle < 0.0 DO
    rSOGI_Phase_Angle := rSOGI_Phase_Angle + TWO_PI;
END_WHILE;

(* 2.6 Compute Symmetrical Component Per-Unit Magnitudes *)
rV_Pos_Magnitude_kV := SQRT(rV_d_Pos * rV_d_Pos + rV_q_Pos * rV_q_Pos);
rV_Neg_Magnitude_kV := SQRT(rV_d_Neg * rV_d_Neg + rV_q_Neg * rV_q_Neg);

rV_Grid_Positive_Seq_pu := rV_Pos_Magnitude_kV / rV_Base_L_N_Peak_kV;
rV_Grid_Negative_Seq_pu := rV_Neg_Magnitude_kV / rV_Base_L_N_Peak_kV;

(* 2.7 Substation Grid Instantaneous Delivered Active and Reactive Power *)
rP_Delivered_MW   := 1.5 * (rV_d_Pos * rI_d_Pos + rV_q_Pos * rI_q_Pos);
rQ_Delivered_MVAR := 1.5 * (rV_q_Pos * rI_d_Pos - rV_d_Pos * rI_q_Pos);

(* ==================================================================================================== *)
(* SUBSYSTEM 3: REBCO COATED CONDUCTOR MULTIAXIAL STRAIN & CRITICAL SURFACE ENGINE                       *)
(* ==================================================================================================== *)

(* 3.1 Calculate Multiaxial Effective Equivalent Microstrain Tensor *)
(* Combining Azimuthal Hoop, Axial Solenoid Compressive, and Inter-Turn Radial Delamination Shear *)
rEffective_Strain_uE := SQRT(
    (rStrain_Hoop_Voted_uE * rStrain_Hoop_Voted_uE) +
    (0.50 * rStrain_Tape_Axial_uE * rStrain_Tape_Axial_uE) +
    (2.00 * rStrain_Tape_Radial_uE * rStrain_Tape_Radial_uE)
);

(* 3.2 Peak Internal Magnetic Bore Flux Density B from Biot-Savart Solenoid Matrix *)
(* For this 8.45 H Solenoid, Core Bore Constant k_b = 2.45 Tesla / kA *)
rSelf_Magnetic_Field_T := 2.450 * rI_Mag_Voted_kA;

(* 3.3 Compute Non-Linear Critical Current I_c(B, T, eps) Characteristic Surface *)
(* Thermal Degradation Term *)
IF rT_Coil_Voted_K >= T_CRITICAL_ZERO_K THEN
    rThermal_Derating_Factor := 0.0;
ELSE
    rTemp_Val1 := rT_Coil_Voted_K / T_CRITICAL_ZERO_K;
    rThermal_Derating_Factor := EXPT(MAX(0.0, 1.0 - EXPT(rTemp_Val1, 1.70)), 1.50);
END_IF;

(* Magnetic Field Degradation Term (Kim-Anderson Model) *)
rB_Field_Derating_Factor := EXPT(1.0 + (rSelf_Magnetic_Field_T / 18.50), -0.85);

(* Mechanical Strain Degradation Factor (Parabolic Ekin Scaling) *)
IF rEffective_Strain_uE <= STRAIN_REVERSIBLE_LIMIT_UE THEN
    rStrain_Derating_Factor := 1.00;
ELSIF rEffective_Strain_uE <= STRAIN_IRREVERSIBLE_LIMIT_UE THEN
    rTemp_Val2 := (rEffective_Strain_uE - STRAIN_REVERSIBLE_LIMIT_UE) / 1000.0;
    rStrain_Derating_Factor := MAX(0.0, 1.0 - (0.185 * rTemp_Val2 * rTemp_Val2));
ELSE
    (* Irreversible Delamination Plastic Rupture Zone *)
    rStrain_Derating_Factor := 0.05;
END_IF;

(* Total Computed Real-Time Critical Current *)
rCritical_Current_Est_kA := I_CRITICAL_ZERO_KA * rThermal_Derating_Factor *
                            rB_Field_Derating_Factor * rStrain_Derating_Factor;

(* Instantaneous Operating Safety Margin to Critical Current *)
rCritical_Current_Margin_kA := rCritical_Current_Est_kA - rI_Mag_Voted_kA;

(* 3.4 Magneto-Mechanical Stress Accumulators *)
(* Lorentz Force Density F_L = J x B [MN/m^3] *)
rLorentz_Force_Density_MN_m3 := (rI_Mag_Voted_kA / 0.0012) * rSelf_Magnetic_Field_T;
rTotal_Hoop_Stress_MPa := rEffective_Strain_uE * 0.165; (* Young Modulus for Hastelloy C-276 Substrate: 165 GPa *)

(* 3.5 Mechanical Strain Safety Interlocks & Tripping *)
IF rEffective_Strain_uE >= STRAIN_IRREVERSIBLE_LIMIT_UE THEN
    bTape_Strain_Overlimit_Trip := TRUE;
    dwAlarm_Critical_Trips := dwAlarm_Critical_Trips OR 16#00000008; (* Bit 3: Plastic Strain Fracture Trip *)
ELSIF rEffective_Strain_uE >= (STRAIN_REVERSIBLE_LIMIT_UE * 0.90) THEN
    dwAlarm_Warnings := dwAlarm_Warnings OR 16#00001000; (* Bit 12: Strain Near Reversible Limit Warning *)
END_IF;

IF rCritical_Current_Margin_kA <= 0.400 THEN (* Less than 400A margin to quench *)
    dwAlarm_Warnings := dwAlarm_Warnings OR 16#00002000; (* Bit 13: Critical Current Margin Depleted *)
END_IF;

(* ==================================================================================================== *)
(* SUBSYSTEM 4: SAVITZKY-GOLAY NUMERICAL DIFFERENTIATOR & RESISTIVE QUENCH DETECTION                   *)
(* ==================================================================================================== *)

(* 4.1 Update Circular History Buffer for 5-Point Numerical Differentiation *)
aI_Hist_Buffer[4] := aI_Hist_Buffer[3];
aI_Hist_Buffer[3] := aI_Hist_Buffer[2];
aI_Hist_Buffer[2] := aI_Hist_Buffer[1];
aI_Hist_Buffer[1] := aI_Hist_Buffer[0];
aI_Hist_Buffer[0] := rI_Mag_Voted_kA;

(* 4.2 5-Point Savitzky-Golay Filtered Numerical Derivative (di/dt) *)
(* Formula: di/dt = (-2*I[k-2] - I[k-1] + I[k+1] + 2*I[k+2]) / (10 * dt) *)
rDi_Dt_Filtered_kA_s := (
    -2.0 * aI_Hist_Buffer[4]
    - 1.0 * aI_Hist_Buffer[3]
    + 1.0 * aI_Hist_Buffer[1]
    + 2.0 * aI_Hist_Buffer[0]
) / (10.0 * rDt_Seconds);

(* 4.3 Mutual Inductive Voltage Compensation *)
(* Total Magnet Terminal Voltage v_term = L*(di/dt) + v_resistive *)
rV_Inductive_Theoretical_kV := L_COIL_HENRIES * rDi_Dt_Filtered_kA_s;

(* Compute Pure Compensated Resistive Voltage Drop (kV to V conversion) *)
(* Incorporates Hardware Rogowski Co-Wound Loop Voltage rV_Pickup_Compensation_V *)
rV_Resistive_Quench_V := ABS((rV_Magnet_Terminal_kV - rV_Inductive_Theoretical_kV) * 1000.0) - ABS(rV_Pickup_Compensation_V);

IF rV_Resistive_Quench_V < 0.0 THEN
    rV_Resistive_Quench_V := 0.0;
END_IF;

(* 4.4 Multi-Tap Threshold & Time Integration *)
IF rV_Resistive_Quench_V >= V_RESISTIVE_QUENCH_THRESH_V THEN
    nQuench_Persistence_Ticks := nQuench_Persistence_Ticks + 1;
    rQuench_Integral_VoltSec := rQuench_Integral_VoltSec + (rV_Resistive_Quench_V * rDt_Seconds);
ELSE
    IF nQuench_Persistence_Ticks > 0 THEN
        nQuench_Persistence_Ticks := nQuench_Persistence_Ticks - 1;
    END_IF;
    rQuench_Integral_VoltSec := MAX(0.0, rQuench_Integral_VoltSec - (0.010 * rDt_Seconds));
END_IF;

(* 4.5 Hotspot Adiabatic Action Integral MIITs Accumulator *)
(* Action Integral: Integral of I^2(t) dt in [MA^2 * s] *)
rAction_Integral_MIITs := rAction_Integral_MIITs + (
    (rI_Mag_Voted_kA * rI_Mag_Voted_kA) * (rDt_Seconds * 0.0010)
);

(* Non-Linear Adiabatic Hotspot Temperature Estimation for REBCO/Copper Matrix *)
IF rAction_Integral_MIITs > 0.0001 THEN
    (* Semi-Empirical Polynomial Correlation: T_hotspot = T_0 + c1*U + c2*U^2 *)
    rHotspot_Adiabatic_Temp_K := T_OPERATING_NOMINAL_K +
                                 (84.50 * rAction_Integral_MIITs) +
                                 (12.30 * rAction_Integral_MIITs * rAction_Integral_MIITs);
ELSE
    rHotspot_Adiabatic_Temp_K := rT_Coil_Voted_K;
END_IF;
rHotspot_Estimated_Temp_K := rHotspot_Adiabatic_Temp_K;

(* 4.6 Quench Trip Criteria Evaluation *)
(* Trigger Criterion 1: Continuous Resistive Voltage > 50 mV for > 5 ticks (1.0 ms) *)
(* Trigger Criterion 2: Integrated Resistive Energy > 0.00025 V*s *)
(* Trigger Criterion 3: Estimated Hotspot Core Temperature Exceeds 85 Kelvin *)
IF (nQuench_Persistence_Ticks >= 5) OR
   (rQuench_Integral_VoltSec >= 0.000250) OR
   (rHotspot_Adiabatic_Temp_K >= 85.0) THEN
    bQuench_Detected_Imminent := TRUE;
    dwAlarm_Critical_Trips := dwAlarm_Critical_Trips OR 16#00000010; (* Bit 4: Quench Detected *)
END_IF;

(* ==================================================================================================== *)
(* SUBSYSTEM 5: LUENBERGER STATE OBSERVER & MODEL PREDICTIVE CONTROL (MPC) ENGINE                       *)
(* ==================================================================================================== *)

(* 5.1 Measurement Assignment & Residual Innovation Calculation *)
(* State Vector: x[1]=i_d, x[2]=i_q, x[3]=v_dc, x[4]=i_mag *)
aObserver_Residual[1] := rI_d_Pos - aState_x_est[1];
aObserver_Residual[2] := rI_q_Pos - aState_x_est[2];
aObserver_Residual[3] := rV_DCLink_kV - aState_x_est[3];
aObserver_Residual[4] := rI_Mag_Voted_kA - aState_x_est[4];

(* Update State Estimate with Observer Innovation Correction: x_hat = x_pred + L * residual *)
FOR iIndex_i := 1 TO 4 DO
    rScratch_Sum := 0.0;
    FOR iIndex_j := 1 TO 4 DO
        rScratch_Sum := rScratch_Sum + (aMatrix_L_Obs_Gain[iIndex_i, iIndex_j] * aObserver_Residual[iIndex_j]);
    END_FOR;
    aState_x_est[iIndex_i] := aState_x_pred[iIndex_i] + rScratch_Sum;
END_FOR;

(* 5.2 Disturbance Vector Assignment *)
aDisturbance_d[1] := rV_d_Pos;
aDisturbance_d[2] := rV_q_Pos;

(* 5.3 Reference Trajectory Target Generation Based on Active Operating Mode *)
IF iState = STATE_FOUR_QUADRANT_COMP_ACTIVE THEN
    (* Active Sag Compensation: Inject High Active & Reactive Current *)
    aState_x_ref[1] := (rP_Comp_Target_MW / 1.5) / MAX(10.0, rV_d_Pos);
    aState_x_ref[2] := -(rQ_Comp_Target_MVAR / 1.5) / MAX(10.0, rV_d_Pos);
    aState_x_ref[3] := V_DCLINK_NOMINAL_KV;
    aState_x_ref[4] := rI_Mag_Voted_kA; (* Floating Magnet Reference during Compensation *)

ELSIF iState = STATE_MAGNET_RAMP_CHARGING THEN
    (* Charging Mode: Regulate DC Bus & Constant Inductive Ramp Current *)
    aState_x_ref[1] := 0.0;
    aState_x_ref[2] := 0.0;
    aState_x_ref[3] := V_DCLINK_NOMINAL_KV;
    aState_x_ref[4] := I_MAGNET_RATED_KA;

ELSIF iState = STATE_CONTROLLED_MAGNET_DISCH THEN
    (* Orderly Discharge Mode *)
    aState_x_ref[1] := -(rP_Dispatch_Ref_MW / 1.5) / MAX(10.0, rV_d_Pos);
    aState_x_ref[2] := 0.0;
    aState_x_ref[3] := V_DCLINK_NOMINAL_KV;
    aState_x_ref[4] := 0.050; (* Target Zero Current *)

ELSE
    (* Standby / Persistent / Idle Tracking *)
    aState_x_ref[1] := (rP_Dispatch_Ref_MW / 1.5) / MAX(10.0, rV_d_Pos);
    aState_x_ref[2] := -(rQ_Dispatch_Ref_MVAR / 1.5) / MAX(10.0, rV_d_Pos);
    aState_x_ref[3] := V_DCLINK_NOMINAL_KV;
    aState_x_ref[4] := rI_Mag_Voted_kA;
END_IF;

(* 5.4 Explicit Quadratic MPC Law Evaluation: u = -K_mpc * (x_est - x_ref) - K_dist * d *)
FOR iIndex_i := 1 TO 3 DO
    rScratch_Sum := 0.0;
    (* State Feedback Term *)
    FOR iIndex_j := 1 TO 4 DO
        rScratch_Sum := rScratch_Sum - (
            aMatrix_K_MPC_Gain[iIndex_i, iIndex_j] * (aState_x_est[iIndex_j] - aState_x_ref[iIndex_j])
        );
    END_FOR;
    (* Disturbance Feedforward Rejection Term *)
    FOR iIndex_j := 1 TO 2 DO
        rScratch_Sum := rScratch_Sum - (
            aMatrix_K_Dist_Gain[iIndex_i, iIndex_j] * aDisturbance_d[iIndex_j]
        );
    END_FOR;
    aControl_u[iIndex_i] := rScratch_Sum;
END_FOR;

(* 5.5 Polyhedral Constraints & Actuator Anti-Windup Clamping *)
(* Inverter Space-Vector Modulation Vectors m_d, m_q Clamping to Over-Modulation Boundary *)
rTemp_Val1 := SQRT(aControl_u[1] * aControl_u[1] + aControl_u[2] * aControl_u[2]);

(* ========================================================================================= *)
(* 1.0 EMERGENCY STOP & LEVEL 1 SAFETY INTERLOCK EVALUATION                                  *)
(* ========================================================================================= *)
(* Immediate fail-safe execution: de-energizes plasma arc power supplies, closes primary   *)
(* oxygen isolation valves, opens emergency nitrogen blanket, and diverts raw gas to flare. *)

(* Evaluate Critical Process Safety Conditions *)
dwAlarmWord1 := 16#0000_0000;
IF NOT bEmergencyStop THEN
    dwAlarmWord1 := dwAlarmWord1 OR 16#0000_0001; (* E-Stop Actuated *)
END_IF;

(* Plasma Torch Cooling Water Loss of Flow *)
IF rTorchCoolingWaterFlow_m3h < 12.0 THEN
    dwAlarmWord1 := dwAlarmWord1 OR 16#0000_0002; (* Torch cooling water starvation *)
END_IF;

(* Torch Cooling Water Delta T Runaway (> 48 deg C risk of copper boiling & arc explosion) *)
IF rTorchCoolingDeltaTemp_DegC > 48.0 THEN
    dwAlarmWord1 := dwAlarmWord1 OR 16#0000_0004; (* Torch thermal boiling hazard *)
END_IF;

(* Gasifier Vessel Dome Extreme Overpressure (> 3.8 bar burst disc protection) *)
IF (rGasifierVesselPress_A_bar > 3.80) OR (rGasifierVesselPress_B_bar > 3.80) OR (rGasifierVesselPress_C_bar > 3.80) THEN
    dwAlarmWord1 := dwAlarmWord1 OR 16#0000_0008; (* Dome critical overpressure *)
END_IF;

(* Gasifier Vessel Vacuum Ingress Risk (< 0.85 bar air ingress deflagration hazard) *)
IF (rGasifierVesselPress_A_bar < 0.85) AND (rGasifierVesselPress_B_bar < 0.85) THEN
    dwAlarmWord1 := dwAlarmWord1 OR 16#0000_0010; (* Negative pressure vacuum hazard *)
END_IF;

(* Taphole Copper Stave Critical Burn-Through Warning (> 220 deg C) *)
IF rTapholeCopperTemp_DegC > 220.0 THEN
    dwAlarmWord1 := dwAlarmWord1 OR 16#0000_0020; (* Taphole refractory / copper breach *)
END_IF;

(* Syngas Severe Oxygen Inversion Risk (> 1.5% O2 in downstream duct represents explosion) *)
IF (rSyngasCO_Concentration_pct < 5.0) AND (rOxygenFlowRate_Nm3h > 400.0) AND bSystemRunning THEN
    dwAlarmWord1 := dwAlarmWord1 OR 16#0000_0040; (* Oxidizer flameout runaway *)
END_IF;

(* Trip Handling Execution *)
IF dwAlarmWord1 <> 16#0000_0000 THEN
    bSystemTripped := TRUE;
    bSystemRunning := FALSE;
    bSystemReady := FALSE;
    bInductionActive := FALSE;
    bBackwashActive := FALSE;
    
    (* Forcibly clamp all energetic demands to zero / safe shutdown states *)
    rTorchPowerDemand_kW := 0.0;
    rOxygenFlowDemand_Nm3h := 0.0;
    rSteamFlowDemand_kgh := 0.0;
    rInductionCoilPowerDemand_kW := 0.0;
    rWasteFeederSpeedDemand_pct := 0.0;
    rFlareDiverterValve_pct := 100.0; (* 100% divert to emergency flare stack *)
    
    (* Maintain max cooling on copper staves to preserve vessel integrity *)
    rTapholeCoolingFlowDemand_m3h := 25.0;
    
    (* Force state machine directly to State 100 *)
    iState := 100;
END_IF;

(* ========================================================================================= *)
(* 2.0 2oo3 TRIPLE MODULAR REDUNDANCY (TMR) SENSOR VOTING ALGORITHM                         *)
(* ========================================================================================= *)
(* Robust voting for 5 distinct critical process channels: Hearth Temperature, Freeboard   *)
(* Temperature, Dome Pressure, Syngas H2/CO Ratio, and Ceramic Filter Differential Pressure. *)

dwWarningWord := 16#0000_0000;

(* --- Channel 1: Hearth Bottom Slag Temperature 2oo3 Voting --- *)
bHearth_SensorA_Valid := (rHearthSlagTemp_A_DegC >= 750.0) AND (rHearthSlagTemp_A_DegC <= 1850.0);
bHearth_SensorB_Valid := (rHearthSlagTemp_B_DegC >= 750.0) AND (rHearthSlagTemp_B_DegC <= 1850.0);
bHearth_SensorC_Valid := (rHearthSlagTemp_C_DegC >= 750.0) AND (rHearthSlagTemp_C_DegC <= 1850.0);

IF bHearth_SensorA_Valid AND bHearth_SensorB_Valid AND bHearth_SensorC_Valid THEN
    (* Triple Healthy: Select Mathematical Median *)
    IF ((rHearthSlagTemp_A_DegC >= rHearthSlagTemp_B_DegC) AND (rHearthSlagTemp_A_DegC <= rHearthSlagTemp_C_DegC)) OR
       ((rHearthSlagTemp_A_DegC >= rHearthSlagTemp_C_DegC) AND (rHearthSlagTemp_A_DegC <= rHearthSlagTemp_B_DegC)) THEN
        rVotedHearthSlagTemp_DegC := rHearthSlagTemp_A_DegC;
    ELSIF ((rHearthSlagTemp_B_DegC >= rHearthSlagTemp_A_DegC) AND (rHearthSlagTemp_B_DegC <= rHearthSlagTemp_C_DegC)) OR
          ((rHearthSlagTemp_B_DegC >= rHearthSlagTemp_C_DegC) AND (rHearthSlagTemp_B_DegC <= rHearthSlagTemp_A_DegC)) THEN
        rVotedHearthSlagTemp_DegC := rHearthSlagTemp_B_DegC;
    ELSE
        rVotedHearthSlagTemp_DegC := rHearthSlagTemp_C_DegC;
    END_IF;
    bHearth_Degraded_1oo2 := FALSE;
    
    (* Cross-channel spread discrepancy check *)
    IF (ABS(rHearthSlagTemp_A_DegC - rHearthSlagTemp_B_DegC) > rTempDiscrepancyThreshold_DegC) OR
       (ABS(rHearthSlagTemp_B_DegC - rHearthSlagTemp_C_DegC) > rTempDiscrepancyThreshold_DegC) OR
       (ABS(rHearthSlagTemp_A_DegC - rHearthSlagTemp_C_DegC) > rTempDiscrepancyThreshold_DegC) THEN
        dwWarningWord := dwWarningWord OR 16#0000_0001; (* Hearth temp sensor spread warning *)
    END_IF;
ELSIF bHearth_SensorA_Valid AND bHearth_SensorB_Valid THEN
    rVotedHearthSlagTemp_DegC := (rHearthSlagTemp_A_DegC + rHearthSlagTemp_B_DegC) * 0.5;
    bHearth_Degraded_1oo2 := TRUE;
    dwWarningWord := dwWarningWord OR 16#0000_0002; (* Hearth sensor C failed *)
ELSIF bHearth_SensorA_Valid AND bHearth_SensorC_Valid THEN
    rVotedHearthSlagTemp_DegC := (rHearthSlagTemp_A_DegC + rHearthSlagTemp_C_DegC) * 0.5;
    bHearth_Degraded_1oo2 := TRUE;
    dwWarningWord := dwWarningWord OR 16#0000_0004; (* Hearth sensor B failed *)
ELSIF bHearth_SensorB_Valid AND bHearth_SensorC_Valid THEN
    rVotedHearthSlagTemp_DegC := (rHearthSlagTemp_B_DegC + rHearthSlagTemp_C_DegC) * 0.5;
    bHearth_Degraded_1oo2 := TRUE;
    dwWarningWord := dwWarningWord OR 16#0000_0008; (* Hearth sensor A failed *)
ELSIF bHearth_SensorA_Valid THEN
    rVotedHearthSlagTemp_DegC := rHearthSlagTemp_A_DegC;
    bHearth_Degraded_1oo2 := TRUE;
ELSIF bHearth_SensorB_Valid THEN
    rVotedHearthSlagTemp_DegC := rHearthSlagTemp_B_DegC;
    bHearth_Degraded_1oo2 := TRUE;
ELSIF bHearth_SensorC_Valid THEN
    rVotedHearthSlagTemp_DegC := rHearthSlagTemp_C_DegC;
    bHearth_Degraded_1oo2 := TRUE;
ELSE
    rVotedHearthSlagTemp_DegC := 1450.0; (* Failsafe fallback anchor *)
    dwAlarmWord2 := dwAlarmWord2 OR 16#0000_0001; (* Complete Hearth sensor failure *)
END_IF;

(* --- Channel 2: Freeboard Gasifier Syngas Temperature 2oo3 Voting --- *)
bFreeboard_SensorA_Valid := (rFreeboardTemp_A_DegC >= 500.0) AND (rFreeboardTemp_A_DegC <= 1650.0);
bFreeboard_SensorB_Valid := (rFreeboardTemp_B_DegC >= 500.0) AND (rFreeboardTemp_B_DegC <= 1650.0);
bFreeboard_SensorC_Valid := (rFreeboardTemp_C_DegC >= 500.0) AND (rFreeboardTemp_C_DegC <= 1650.0);

IF bFreeboard_SensorA_Valid AND bFreeboard_SensorB_Valid AND bFreeboard_SensorC_Valid THEN
    IF ((rFreeboardTemp_A_DegC >= rFreeboardTemp_B_DegC) AND (rFreeboardTemp_A_DegC <= rFreeboardTemp_C_DegC)) OR
       ((rFreeboardTemp_A_DegC >= rFreeboardTemp_C_DegC) AND (rFreeboardTemp_A_DegC <= rFreeboardTemp_B_DegC)) THEN
        rVotedFreeboardTemp_DegC := rFreeboardTemp_A_DegC;
    ELSIF ((rFreeboardTemp_B_DegC >= rFreeboardTemp_A_DegC) AND (rFreeboardTemp_B_DegC <= rFreeboardTemp_C_DegC)) OR
          ((rFreeboardTemp_B_DegC >= rFreeboardTemp_C_DegC) AND (rFreeboardTemp_B_DegC <= rFreeboardTemp_A_DegC)) THEN
        rVotedFreeboardTemp_DegC := rFreeboardTemp_B_DegC;
    ELSE
        rVotedFreeboardTemp_DegC := rFreeboardTemp_C_DegC;
    END_IF;
    bFreeboard_Degraded_1oo2 := FALSE;
    
    IF (ABS(rFreeboardTemp_A_DegC - rFreeboardTemp_B_DegC) > rTempDiscrepancyThreshold_DegC) OR
       (ABS(rFreeboardTemp_B_DegC - rFreeboardTemp_C_DegC) > rTempDiscrepancyThreshold_DegC) OR
       (ABS(rFreeboardTemp_A_DegC - rFreeboardTemp_C_DegC) > rTempDiscrepancyThreshold_DegC) THEN
        dwWarningWord := dwWarningWord OR 16#0000_0010; (* Freeboard temperature spread *)
    END_IF;
ELSIF bFreeboard_SensorA_Valid AND bFreeboard_SensorB_Valid THEN
    rVotedFreeboardTemp_DegC := (rFreeboardTemp_A_DegC + rFreeboardTemp_B_DegC) * 0.5;
    bFreeboard_Degraded_1oo2 := TRUE;
ELSIF bFreeboard_SensorA_Valid AND bFreeboard_SensorC_Valid THEN
    rVotedFreeboardTemp_DegC := (rFreeboardTemp_A_DegC + rFreeboardTemp_C_DegC) * 0.5;
    bFreeboard_Degraded_1oo2 := TRUE;
ELSIF bFreeboard_SensorB_Valid AND bFreeboard_SensorC_Valid THEN
    rVotedFreeboardTemp_DegC := (rFreeboardTemp_B_DegC + rFreeboardTemp_C_DegC) * 0.5;
    bFreeboard_Degraded_1oo2 := TRUE;
ELSIF bFreeboard_SensorA_Valid THEN
    rVotedFreeboardTemp_DegC := rFreeboardTemp_A_DegC;
    bFreeboard_Degraded_1oo2 := TRUE;
ELSIF bFreeboard_SensorB_Valid THEN
    rVotedFreeboardTemp_DegC := rFreeboardTemp_B_DegC;
    bFreeboard_Degraded_1oo2 := TRUE;
ELSIF bFreeboard_SensorC_Valid THEN
    rVotedFreeboardTemp_DegC := rFreeboardTemp_C_DegC;
    bFreeboard_Degraded_1oo2 := TRUE;
ELSE
    rVotedFreeboardTemp_DegC := 1300.0; (* Fallback *)
    dwAlarmWord2 := dwAlarmWord2 OR 16#0000_0002; (* Complete Freeboard sensor loss *)
END_IF;

(* --- Channel 3: Vessel Dome Pressure 2oo3 Voting --- *)
bPress_SensorA_Valid := (rGasifierVesselPress_A_bar >= 0.70) AND (rGasifierVesselPress_A_bar <= 4.20);
bPress_SensorB_Valid := (rGasifierVesselPress_B_bar >= 0.70) AND (rGasifierVesselPress_B_bar <= 4.20);
bPress_SensorC_Valid := (rGasifierVesselPress_C_bar >= 0.70) AND (rGasifierVesselPress_C_bar <= 4.20);

IF bPress_SensorA_Valid AND bPress_SensorB_Valid AND bPress_SensorC_Valid THEN
    IF ((rGasifierVesselPress_A_bar >= rGasifierVesselPress_B_bar) AND (rGasifierVesselPress_A_bar <= rGasifierVesselPress_C_bar)) OR
       ((rGasifierVesselPress_A_bar >= rGasifierVesselPress_C_bar) AND (rGasifierVesselPress_A_bar <= rGasifierVesselPress_B_bar)) THEN
        rVotedVesselPressure_bar := rGasifierVesselPress_A_bar;
    ELSIF ((rGasifierVesselPress_B_bar >= rGasifierVesselPress_A_bar) AND (rGasifierVesselPress_B_bar <= rGasifierVesselPress_C_bar)) OR
          ((rGasifierVesselPress_B_bar >= rGasifierVesselPress_C_bar) AND (rGasifierVesselPress_B_bar <= rGasifierVesselPress_A_bar)) THEN
        rVotedVesselPressure_bar := rGasifierVesselPress_B_bar;
    ELSE
        rVotedVesselPressure_bar := rGasifierVesselPress_C_bar;
    END_IF;
    bPress_Degraded_1oo2 := FALSE;
    
    IF (ABS(rGasifierVesselPress_A_bar - rGasifierVesselPress_B_bar) > rPressDiscrepancyThreshold_bar) OR
       (ABS(rGasifierVesselPress_B_bar - rGasifierVesselPress_C_bar) > rPressDiscrepancyThreshold_bar) OR
       (ABS(rGasifierVesselPress_A_bar - rGasifierVesselPress_C_bar) > rPressDiscrepancyThreshold_bar) THEN
        dwWarningWord := dwWarningWord OR 16#0000_0020; (* Dome pressure spread *)
    END_IF;
ELSIF bPress_SensorA_Valid AND bPress_SensorB_Valid THEN
    rVotedVesselPressure_bar := (rGasifierVesselPress_A_bar + rGasifierVesselPress_B_bar) * 0.5;
    bPress_Degraded_1oo2 := TRUE;
ELSIF bPress_SensorA_Valid AND bPress_SensorC_Valid THEN
    rVotedVesselPressure_bar := (rGasifierVesselPress_A_bar + rGasifierVesselPress_C_bar) * 0.5;
    bPress_Degraded_1oo2 := TRUE;
ELSIF bPress_SensorB_Valid AND bPress_SensorC_Valid THEN
    rVotedVesselPressure_bar := (rGasifierVesselPress_B_bar + rGasifierVesselPress_C_bar) * 0.5;
    bPress_Degraded_1oo2 := TRUE;
ELSE
    rVotedVesselPressure_bar := 1.15; (* Fallback safe pressure *)
    dwAlarmWord2 := dwAlarmWord2 OR 16#0000_0004; (* Complete Dome pressure sensor failure *)
END_IF;

(* --- Channel 4: Syngas H2/CO Molar Ratio 2oo3 Voting --- *)
bRatio_SensorA_Valid := (rSyngasRatio_H2_CO_A_molmol >= 0.15) AND (rSyngasRatio_H2_CO_A_molmol <= 4.50);
bRatio_SensorB_Valid := (rSyngasRatio_H2_CO_B_molmol >= 0.15) AND (rSyngasRatio_H2_CO_B_molmol <= 4.50);
bRatio_SensorC_Valid := (rSyngasRatio_H2_CO_C_molmol >= 0.15) AND (rSyngasRatio_H2_CO_C_molmol <= 4.50);

IF bRatio_SensorA_Valid AND bRatio_SensorB_Valid AND bRatio_SensorC_Valid THEN
    IF ((rSyngasRatio_H2_CO_A_molmol >= rSyngasRatio_H2_CO_B_molmol) AND (rSyngasRatio_H2_CO_A_molmol <= rSyngasRatio_H2_CO_C_molmol)) OR
       ((rSyngasRatio_H2_CO_A_molmol >= rSyngasRatio_H2_CO_C_molmol) AND (rSyngasRatio_H2_CO_A_molmol <= rSyngasRatio_H2_CO_B_molmol)) THEN
        rCalculatedSyngasRatio_molmol := rSyngasRatio_H2_CO_A_molmol;
    ELSIF ((rSyngasRatio_H2_CO_B_molmol >= rSyngasRatio_H2_CO_A_molmol) AND (rSyngasRatio_H2_CO_B_molmol <= rSyngasRatio_H2_CO_C_molmol)) OR
          ((rSyngasRatio_H2_CO_B_molmol >= rSyngasRatio_H2_CO_C_molmol) AND (rSyngasRatio_H2_CO_B_molmol <= rSyngasRatio_H2_CO_A_molmol)) THEN
        rCalculatedSyngasRatio_molmol := rSyngasRatio_H2_CO_B_molmol;
    ELSE
        rCalculatedSyngasRatio_molmol := rSyngasRatio_H2_CO_C_molmol;
    END_IF;
    bRatio_Degraded_1oo2 := FALSE;
ELSIF bRatio_SensorA_Valid AND bRatio_SensorB_Valid THEN
    rCalculatedSyngasRatio_molmol := (rSyngasRatio_H2_CO_A_molmol + rSyngasRatio_H2_CO_B_molmol) * 0.5;
    bRatio_Degraded_1oo2 := TRUE;
ELSIF bRatio_SensorA_Valid AND bRatio_SensorC_Valid THEN
    rCalculatedSyngasRatio_molmol := (rSyngasRatio_H2_CO_A_molmol + rSyngasRatio_H2_CO_C_molmol) * 0.5;
    bRatio_Degraded_1oo2 := TRUE;
ELSIF bRatio_SensorB_Valid AND bRatio_SensorC_Valid THEN
    rCalculatedSyngasRatio_molmol := (rSyngasRatio_H2_CO_B_molmol + rSyngasRatio_H2_CO_C_molmol) * 0.5;
    bRatio_Degraded_1oo2 := TRUE;
ELSE
    (* Analytical fallback based on feed composition and stoichiometry *)
    rCalculatedSyngasRatio_molmol := 1.85;
    dwWarningWord := dwWarningWord OR 16#0000_0040; (* Analytical ratio inference fallback *)
END_IF;

(* --- Channel 5: Ceramic Filter Differential Pressure 2oo3 Voting --- *)
bFilterDP_SensorA_Valid := (rCeramicFilterDiffPress_A_mbar >= 0.0) AND (rCeramicFilterDiffPress_A_mbar <= 280.0);
bFilterDP_SensorB_Valid := (rCeramicFilterDiffPress_B_mbar >= 0.0) AND (rCeramicFilterDiffPress_B_mbar <= 280.0);
bFilterDP_SensorC_Valid := (rCeramicFilterDiffPress_C_mbar >= 0.0) AND (rCeramicFilterDiffPress_C_mbar <= 280.0);

IF bFilterDP_SensorA_Valid AND bFilterDP_SensorB_Valid AND bFilterDP_SensorC_Valid THEN
    IF ((rCeramicFilterDiffPress_A_mbar >= rCeramicFilterDiffPress_B_mbar) AND (rCeramicFilterDiffPress_A_mbar <= rCeramicFilterDiffPress_C_mbar)) OR
       ((rCeramicFilterDiffPress_A_mbar >= rCeramicFilterDiffPress_C_mbar) AND (rCeramicFilterDiffPress_A_mbar <= rCeramicFilterDiffPress_B_mbar)) THEN
        rVotedFilterDiffPress_mbar := rCeramicFilterDiffPress_A_mbar;
    ELSIF ((rCeramicFilterDiffPress_B_mbar >= rCeramicFilterDiffPress_A_mbar) AND (rCeramicFilterDiffPress_B_mbar <= rCeramicFilterDiffPress_C_mbar)) OR
          ((rCeramicFilterDiffPress_B_mbar >= rCeramicFilterDiffPress_C_mbar) AND (rCeramicFilterDiffPress_B_mbar <= rCeramicFilterDiffPress_A_mbar)) THEN
        rVotedFilterDiffPress_mbar := rCeramicFilterDiffPress_B_mbar;
    ELSE
        rVotedFilterDiffPress_mbar := rCeramicFilterDiffPress_C_mbar;
    END_IF;
    bFilterDP_Degraded_1oo2 := FALSE;
ELSIF bFilterDP_SensorA_Valid AND bFilterDP_SensorB_Valid THEN
    rVotedFilterDiffPress_mbar := (rCeramicFilterDiffPress_A_mbar + rCeramicFilterDiffPress_B_mbar) * 0.5;
    bFilterDP_Degraded_1oo2 := TRUE;
ELSE
    rVotedFilterDiffPress_mbar := 45.0;
END_IF;

(* Sensor degradation composite flag *)
bDegradedSensorMode := bHearth_Degraded_1oo2 OR bFreeboard_Degraded_1oo2 OR
                       bPress_Degraded_1oo2 OR bRatio_Degraded_1oo2 OR bFilterDP_Degraded_1oo2;

(* ========================================================================================= *)
(* 3.0 SLAG TAPHOLE INDUCTION FREEZE-LINING STEFAN THERMAL EQUILIBRIUM SOLVER                *)
(* ========================================================================================= *)
(* Computes 1D transient boundary phase change at taphole copper stave / molten slag bath.   *)
(* Preserves a protective autogenous skull (15-35 mm) against aggressive corrosive slag,    *)
(* dynamically balancing stave forced-water cooling against mid-frequency induction heating.*)

(* Calculate convective heat flux from liquid slag bath to solidus interface *)
IF rVotedHearthSlagTemp_DegC > rSlagLiquidusTemp_DegC THEN
    rHeatFluxInward_Wm2 := rSlagConvectiveCoeff_Wm2K * (rVotedHearthSlagTemp_DegC - rSlagSolidusTemp_DegC);
ELSE
    rHeatFluxInward_Wm2 := 1500.0; (* Minimum convective creep *)
END_IF;

(* Clamp thickness to prevent division by zero in conduction formula *)
IF rCalculatedLiningThickness_m < 0.002 THEN
    rCalculatedLiningThickness_m := 0.002; (* 2mm minimum refractory skin *)
END_IF;

(* Calculate outward conductive heat flux extracted through frozen slag & copper stave *)
(* Total thermal resistance: R_total = (s_skull / k_skull) + (s_copper / k_copper) + (1 / h_coolant) *)
rHeatFluxOutward_Wm2 := (rSlagSolidusTemp_DegC - rTapholeCoolingReturnTemp_DegC) /
    ((rCalculatedLiningThickness_m / rSlagThermalConductivity_WmK) +
     (rCopperStaveThickness_m / rCopperStaveConductivity_WmK) +
     (1.0 / rCoolantHeatTransferCoeff_Wm2K));

(* Induction power energy deposition at taphole interior perimeter *)
(* P_induction deposits volumetric Joule heating in the near-boundary slag zone *)
IF bInductionActive AND (rInductionCoilPowerDemand_kW > 0.0) THEN
    (* Effective surface heat flux equivalent: P_kW * 1000 / A_taphole (A_taphole approx 0.35 m2) *)
    rHeatFluxInward_Wm2 := rHeatFluxInward_Wm2 + (rInductionCoilPowerDemand_kW * 1000.0 / 0.35);
END_IF;

(* Stefan phase change interface velocity: ds/dt = (Q_outward - Q_inward) / (rho * L_fus) *)
rStefanFrontVelocity_ms := (rHeatFluxOutward_Wm2 - rHeatFluxInward_Wm2) / (rSlagDensity_kgm3 * (rSlagLatentHeat_kJkg * 1000.0));

(* Integrate freeze-lining thickness over deterministic cycle time *)
rCalculatedLiningThickness_m := rCalculatedLiningThickness_m + (rStefanFrontVelocity_ms * rCycleTime_sec);
IF rCalculatedLiningThickness_m > 0.080 THEN rCalculatedLiningThickness_m := 0.080; END_IF; (* 80mm Max *)
IF rCalculatedLiningThickness_m < 0.001 THEN rCalculatedLiningThickness_m := 0.001; END_IF; (* 1mm Min *)
rEstimatedFreezeLiningThickness_mm := rCalculatedLiningThickness_m * 1000.0;

(* Closed-Loop Induction Coil Power Regulation for Freeze-Lining Equilibrium *)
IF bInductionPermissive AND (iState >= 40) AND (iState < 90) THEN
    bInductionActive := TRUE;
    (* If freeze lining is thicker than target, increase induction power to melt back *)
    (* Error = Estimated - Target *)
    rInduction_Integral := rInduction_Integral + (rInduction_Ki * (rEstimatedFreezeLiningThickness_mm - rFreezeLiningTarget_mm) * rCycleTime_sec);
    IF rInduction_Integral > rInduction_MaxPower_kW THEN rInduction_Integral := rInduction_MaxPower_kW; END_IF;
    IF rInduction_Integral < 0.0 THEN rInduction_Integral := 0.0; END_IF;
    
    rInductionCoilPowerDemand_kW := (rInduction_Kp * (rEstimatedFreezeLiningThickness_mm - rFreezeLiningTarget_mm)) + rInduction_Integral;
    
    (* Viscosity Compensation Trim: high viscosity demands additional induction heat *)
    IF rTapholeSlagViscosity_Pas > 15.0 THEN
        rInductionCoilPowerDemand_kW := rInductionCoilPowerDemand_kW + ((rTapholeSlagViscosity_Pas - 15.0) * 3.5);
    END_IF;
    
    IF rInductionCoilPowerDemand_kW > rInduction_MaxPower_kW THEN rInductionCoilPowerDemand_kW := rInduction_MaxPower_kW; END_IF;
    IF rInductionCoilPowerDemand_kW < 0.0 THEN rInductionCoilPowerDemand_kW := 0.0; END_IF;
ELSE
    bInductionActive := FALSE;
    rInductionCoilPowerDemand_kW := 0.0;
END_IF;

(* Dynamic Taphole Copper Cooling Pump Control *)
rCoolingPump_Integral := rCoolingPump_Integral + (rCoolingPump_Ki * (rTapholeCopperTemp_DegC - 85.0) * rCycleTime_sec);
IF rCoolingPump_Integral > 30.0 THEN rCoolingPump_Integral := 30.0; END_IF;
IF rCoolingPump_Integral < 5.0 THEN rCoolingPump_Integral := 5.0; END_IF;
rTapholeCoolingFlowDemand_m3h := (rCoolingPump_Kp * (rTapholeCopperTemp_DegC - 85.0)) + rCoolingPump_Integral;
IF rTapholeCoolingFlowDemand_m3h > 30.0 THEN rTapholeCoolingFlowDemand_m3h := 30.0; END_IF;
IF rTapholeCoolingFlowDemand_m3h < 5.0 THEN rTapholeCoolingFlowDemand_m3h := 5.0; END_IF;

(* Freeze-Lining Alarm Hazards *)
IF rEstimatedFreezeLiningThickness_mm < 8.0 THEN
    dwAlarmWord2 := dwAlarmWord2 OR 16#0000_0010; (* Freeze lining dangerously thin: erosion hazard *)
END_IF;
IF rEstimatedFreezeLiningThickness_mm > 55.0 THEN
    dwWarningWord := dwWarningWord OR 16#0000_0080; (* Taphole choking / freeze-lock warning *)
END_IF;

(* ========================================================================================= *)
(* 4.0 MODEL PREDICTIVE CONTROL (MPC) SYNGAS RATIO & STOICHIOMETRIC REGULATOR               *)
(* ========================================================================================= *)
(* Solves dynamic multivariable cross-coupling between Secondary Oxygen, Superheated Steam, *)
(* and Plasma DC Torch Power. Optimizes H2/CO molar ratio, gasifier freeboard temperature,   *)
(* dome pressure, and Syngas LHV via quadratic cost minimization over receding horizon.    *)

IF bAutoRatioMode AND bSystemRunning AND (iState >= 60) AND (iState < 90) THEN
    (* 4.1 Compute State Tracking Deviations *)
    rStateX_0 := rVotedFreeboardTemp_DegC - rTargetFreeboardTemp_DegC;      (* Temp error [deg C] *)
    rStateX_1 := rCalculatedSyngasRatio_molmol - rTargetSyngasRatio_molmol;  (* Ratio error [mol/mol] *)
    rStateX_2 := rVotedVesselPressure_bar - rTargetVesselPress_bar;          (* Press error [bar] *)
    rStateX_3 := rSyngasLowerHeatingValue_MJNm3 - 8.50;                     (* LHV deviation [MJ/Nm3] *)
    
    (* 4.2 Disturbance Estimation (Waste Feed & Moisture Swings) *)
    rDistD_0 := (rSolidWasteFeedRate_kgh - 1500.0) / 1000.0;                (* Normalized feed disturbance *)
    rDistD_1 := (rWasteMoistureContent_pct - 20.0) / 10.0;                  (* Normalized moisture disturbance *)
    
    (* 4.3 State Space Prediction: x_next = A * x + B * u_delta + E * d *)
    (* Normalized Delta Control Inputs relative to operating nominals *)
    rPredX_0 := (rMatA_00 * rStateX_0) + (rMatA_01 * rStateX_1) + (rMatA_02 * rStateX_2) + (rMatA_03 * rStateX_3) +
                (rMatB_00 * (rControlU_0 - 650.0) * 0.01) + (rMatB_01 * (rControlU_1 - 1200.0) * 0.005) + (rMatB_02 * (rControlU_2 - 850.0) * 0.01) +
                (rMatE_00 * rDistD_0) + (rMatE_01 * rDistD_1);
                
    rPredX_1 := (rMatA_10 * rStateX_0) + (rMatA_11 * rStateX_1) + (rMatA_12 * rStateX_2) + (rMatA_13 * rStateX_3) +
                (rMatB_10 * (rControlU_0 - 650.0) * 0.01) + (rMatB_11 * (rControlU_1 - 1200.0) * 0.005) + (rMatB_12 * (rControlU_2 - 850.0) * 0.01) +
                (rMatE_10 * rDistD_0) + (rMatE_11 * rDistD_1);
                
    rPredX_2 := (rMatA_20 * rStateX_0) + (rMatA_21 * rStateX_1) + (rMatA_22 * rStateX_2) + (rMatA_23 * rStateX_3) +
                (rMatB_20 * (rControlU_0 - 650.0) * 0.01) + (rMatB_21 * (rControlU_1 - 1200.0) * 0.005) + (rMatB_22 * (rControlU_2 - 850.0) * 0.01) +
                (rMatE_20 * rDistD_0) + (rMatE_21 * rDistD_1);
                
    rPredX_3 := (rMatA_30 * rStateX_0) + (rMatA_31 * rStateX_1) + (rMatA_32 * rStateX_2) + (rMatA_33 * rStateX_3) +
                (rMatB_30 * (rControlU_0 - 650.0) * 0.01) + (rMatB_31 * (rControlU_1 - 1200.0) * 0.005) + (rMatB_32 * (rControlU_2 - 850.0) * 0.01) +
                (rMatE_30 * rDistD_0) + (rMatE_31 * rDistD_1);
                
    (* 4.4 Analytical Quadratic Cost Gradient: Grad_J = B^T * Q * x_pred + R * u + S * (u - u_prev) *)
    rGradJ_0 := (rMatB_00 * rWeightQ_Temp * rPredX_0) + (rMatB_10 * rWeightQ_Ratio * rPredX_1) +
                (rMatB_20 * rWeightQ_Press * rPredX_2) + (rMatB_30 * rWeightQ_LHV * rPredX_3) +
                (rWeightR_O2 * (rControlU_0 - 650.0) * 0.01) + (rWeightS_O2 * (rControlU_0 - rControlU_Prev_0) * 0.05);
                
    rGradJ_1 := (rMatB_01 * rWeightQ_Temp * rPredX_0) + (rMatB_11 * rWeightQ_Ratio * rPredX_1) +
                (rMatB_21 * rWeightQ_Press * rPredX_2) + (rMatB_31 * rWeightQ_LHV * rPredX_3) +
                (rWeightR_Steam * (rControlU_1 - 1200.0) * 0.005) + (rWeightS_Steam * (rControlU_1 - rControlU_Prev_1) * 0.02);
                
    rGradJ_2 := (rMatB_02 * rWeightQ_Temp * rPredX_0) + (rMatB_12 * rWeightQ_Ratio * rPredX_1) +
                (rMatB_22 * rWeightQ_Press * rPredX_2) + (rMatB_32 * rWeightQ_LHV * rPredX_3) +
                (rWeightR_Torch * (rControlU_2 - 850.0) * 0.01) + (rWeightS_Torch * (rControlU_2 - rControlU_Prev_2) * 0.05);
                
    (* 4.5 Projected Gradient Descent Step *)
    rControlU_Prev_0 := rControlU_0;
    rControlU_Prev_1 := rControlU_1;
    rControlU_Prev_2 := rControlU_2;
    
    rControlU_0 := rControlU_0 - (rMpcStepSize * rGradJ_0 * 450.0);
    rControlU_1 := rControlU_1 - (rMpcStepSize * rGradJ_1 * 850.0);
    rControlU_2 := rControlU_2 - (rMpcStepSize * rGradJ_2 * 350.0);
    
    (* 4.6 Slew Rate Limiting Enforcement *)
    IF (rControlU_0 - rControlU_Prev_0) > (rMaxSlewO2_Nm3hs * rCycleTime_sec) THEN
        rControlU_0 := rControlU_Prev_0 + (rMaxSlewO2_Nm3hs * rCycleTime_sec);
    ELSIF (rControlU_Prev_0 - rControlU_0) > (rMaxSlewO2_Nm3hs * rCycleTime_sec) THEN
        rControlU_0 := rControlU_Prev_0 - (rMaxSlewO2_Nm3hs * rCycleTime_sec);
    END_IF;
    
    IF (rControlU_1 - rControlU_Prev_1) > (rMaxSlewSteam_kghs * rCycleTime_sec) THEN
        rControlU_1 := rControlU_Prev_1 + (rMaxSlewSteam_kghs * rCycleTime_sec);
    ELSIF (rControlU_Prev_1 - rControlU_1) > (rMaxSlewSteam_kghs * rCycleTime_sec) THEN
        rControlU_1 := rControlU_Prev_1 - (rMaxSlewSteam_kghs * rCycleTime_sec);
    END_IF;
    
    IF (rControlU_2 - rControlU_Prev_2) > (rMaxSlewTorch_kWs * rCycleTime_sec) THEN
        rControlU_2 := rControlU_Prev_2 + (rMaxSlewTorch_kWs * rCycleTime_sec);
    ELSIF (rControlU_Prev_2 - rControlU_2) > (rMaxSlewTorch_kWs * rCycleTime_sec) THEN
        rControlU_2 := rControlU_Prev_2 - (rMaxSlewTorch_kWs * rCycleTime_sec);
    END_IF;
    
    (* 4.7 Hard Actuator Saturation Clamping *)
    IF rControlU_0 > rMaxO2Flow_Nm3h THEN rControlU_0 := rMaxO2Flow_Nm3h; END_IF;
    IF rControlU_0 < rMinO2Flow_Nm3h THEN rControlU_0 := rMinO2Flow_Nm3h; END_IF;
    IF rControlU_1 > rMaxSteamFlow_kgh THEN rControlU_1 := rMaxSteamFlow_kgh; END_IF;
    IF rControlU_1 < rMinSteamFlow_kgh THEN rControlU_1 := rMinSteamFlow_kgh; END_IF;
    IF rControlU_2 > rMaxTorchPower_kW THEN rControlU_2 := rMaxTorchPower_kW; END_IF;
    IF rControlU_2 < rMinTorchPower_kW THEN rControlU_2 := rMinTorchPower_kW; END_IF;
    
    rOxygenFlowDemand_Nm3h := rControlU_0;
    rSteamFlowDemand_kgh := rControlU_1;
    rTorchPowerDemand_kW := rControlU_2;
    
    (* 4.8 Compute Total Scalar MPC Objective Cost J *)
    rMpcObjectiveCost := (rWeightQ_Temp * rPredX_0 * rPredX_0) +

    rAnodePositionDemand_mm         := 0.0; (* Immediate servo full retract above slag *)
    dwAlarmWord_1                   := dwAlarmWord_1 OR 16#0000_0001; (* Bit 0: Emergency Stop Loop Broken *)
    iCurrentState                   := 99;  (* Immediate Trip State *)
    iState                          := 99;
    sStateDescription               := 'SIL-3 EMERGENCY TRIP: E-STOP';
    RETURN;
END_IF;

(* Refractory Catastrophic Hoop Strain Interlock *)
IF (rRefractoryStrain_ustrain_A > c_rMaxRefractoryStrain) AND (rRefractoryStrain_ustrain_B > c_rMaxRefractoryStrain) THEN
    bSystemTrip                     := TRUE;
    dwAlarmWord_1                   := dwAlarmWord_1 OR 16#0000_0002; (* Bit 1: Refractory Rupture Trip *)
    iState                          := 99;
END_IF;

(* Severe Slag Over-Temperature Thermal Runaway Interlock *)
tonOverTempDebounce(IN := (rSlagTemp_C_A > c_rMaxAllowableTemp) AND (rSlagTemp_C_B > c_rMaxAllowableTemp), PT := T#250MS);
IF tonOverTempDebounce.Q THEN
    bSystemTrip                     := TRUE;
    dwAlarmWord_1                   := dwAlarmWord_1 OR 16#0000_0004; (* Bit 2: Extreme Slag Over-Temp Trip *)
    iState                          := 99;
END_IF;

(* Induction Coil Cooling Water Loss Interlock *)
IF (rInductionCoolingWaterFlow_Lmin < 180.0) OR (rInductionCoolingWaterTemp_C > 65.0) THEN
    rInductionPowerDemand_kW        := 0.0;
    dwAlarmWord_1                   := dwAlarmWord_1 OR 16#0000_0008; (* Bit 3: Coil Cooling Water Failure *)
    IF bSystemRunning THEN
        bDegraded_InductionOnly     := FALSE;
    END_IF;
END_IF;

(* ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* 2.0 TRIPLE MODULAR REDUNDANCY (2oo3) SENSOR VOTING ALGORITHMS                             *)
(* Rigorous pair-wise Euclidean evaluation, health gating, median synthesis, drift alarms    *)
(* ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)

(* --- 2.1 Cell DC Current 2oo3 Voting (0 to 300 kA range) --- *)
bCurr_A_OK := (rCellCurrent_kA_A >= -2.0) AND (rCellCurrent_kA_A <= 320.0);
bCurr_B_OK := (rCellCurrent_kA_B >= -2.0) AND (rCellCurrent_kA_B <= 320.0);
bCurr_C_OK := (rCellCurrent_kA_C >= -2.0) AND (rCellCurrent_kA_C <= 320.0);

IF bCurr_A_OK AND bCurr_B_OK AND bCurr_C_OK THEN
    bCurr_Degraded_1oo2 := FALSE;
    IF (ABS(rCellCurrent_kA_A - rCellCurrent_kA_B) <= c_rTolCurrent_kA) AND
       (ABS(rCellCurrent_kA_A - rCellCurrent_kA_C) <= c_rTolCurrent_kA) THEN
        rVotedCellCurrent_kA := (rCellCurrent_kA_A + rCellCurrent_kA_B + rCellCurrent_kA_C) / 3.0;
        bCurr_Discrepancy_Alarm := FALSE;
    ELSIF ABS(rCellCurrent_kA_A - rCellCurrent_kA_B) <= c_rTolCurrent_kA THEN
        rVotedCellCurrent_kA := (rCellCurrent_kA_A + rCellCurrent_kA_B) / 2.0;
        bCurr_Discrepancy_Alarm := TRUE;
        dwAlarmWord_2 := dwAlarmWord_2 OR 16#0000_0001; (* Current Channel C Deviation *)
    ELSIF ABS(rCellCurrent_kA_A - rCellCurrent_kA_C) <= c_rTolCurrent_kA THEN
        rVotedCellCurrent_kA := (rCellCurrent_kA_A + rCellCurrent_kA_C) / 2.0;
        bCurr_Discrepancy_Alarm := TRUE;
        dwAlarmWord_2 := dwAlarmWord_2 OR 16#0000_0002; (* Current Channel B Deviation *)
    ELSIF ABS(rCellCurrent_kA_B - rCellCurrent_kA_C) <= c_rTolCurrent_kA THEN
        rVotedCellCurrent_kA := (rCellCurrent_kA_B + rCellCurrent_kA_C) / 2.0;
        bCurr_Discrepancy_Alarm := TRUE;
        dwAlarmWord_2 := dwAlarmWord_2 OR 16#0000_0004; (* Current Channel A Deviation *)
    ELSE
        (* All channels diverge: take middle median value *)
        IF (rCellCurrent_kA_A >= rCellCurrent_kA_B AND rCellCurrent_kA_A <= rCellCurrent_kA_C) OR
           (rCellCurrent_kA_A >= rCellCurrent_kA_C AND rCellCurrent_kA_A <= rCellCurrent_kA_B) THEN
            rVotedCellCurrent_kA := rCellCurrent_kA_A;
        ELSIF (rCellCurrent_kA_B >= rCellCurrent_kA_A AND rCellCurrent_kA_B <= rCellCurrent_kA_C) OR
              (rCellCurrent_kA_B >= rCellCurrent_kA_C AND rCellCurrent_kA_B <= rCellCurrent_kA_A) THEN
            rVotedCellCurrent_kA := rCellCurrent_kA_B;
        ELSE
            rVotedCellCurrent_kA := rCellCurrent_kA_C;
        END_IF;
        bCurr_Discrepancy_Alarm := TRUE;
        dwAlarmWord_2 := dwAlarmWord_2 OR 16#0000_0008; (* Current Severe Triple Discrepancy *)
    END_IF;
ELSIF bCurr_A_OK AND bCurr_B_OK THEN
    bCurr_Degraded_1oo2 := TRUE;
    rVotedCellCurrent_kA := (rCellCurrent_kA_A + rCellCurrent_kA_B) / 2.0;
    dwAlarmWord_2 := dwAlarmWord_2 OR 16#0000_0001;
ELSIF bCurr_A_OK AND bCurr_C_OK THEN
    bCurr_Degraded_1oo2 := TRUE;
    rVotedCellCurrent_kA := (rCellCurrent_kA_A + rCellCurrent_kA_C) / 2.0;
    dwAlarmWord_2 := dwAlarmWord_2 OR 16#0000_0002;
ELSIF bCurr_B_OK AND bCurr_C_OK THEN
    bCurr_Degraded_1oo2 := TRUE;
    rVotedCellCurrent_kA := (rCellCurrent_kA_B + rCellCurrent_kA_C) / 2.0;
    dwAlarmWord_2 := dwAlarmWord_2 OR 16#0000_0004;
ELSIF bCurr_A_OK THEN
    bCurr_Degraded_1oo2 := TRUE;
    rVotedCellCurrent_kA := rCellCurrent_kA_A;
    dwAlarmWord_1 := dwAlarmWord_1 OR 16#0000_0010; (* Dual Current Channel Loss *)
ELSIF bCurr_B_OK THEN
    bCurr_Degraded_1oo2 := TRUE;
    rVotedCellCurrent_kA := rCellCurrent_kA_B;
    dwAlarmWord_1 := dwAlarmWord_1 OR 16#0000_0010;
ELSIF bCurr_C_OK THEN

ELSIF bVolt_A_OK AND bVolt_B_OK THEN

ELSIF bVolt_A_OK AND bVolt_C_OK THEN

ELSE
    bSystemTrip := TRUE;

END_IF;

(* --- 2.3 Slag Core Temperature 2oo3 Voting (1200 to 1800 °C range) --- *)
bTemp_A_OK := (rSlagTemp_C_A >= 1200.0) AND (rSlagTemp_C_A <= 1800.0);
bTemp_B_OK := (rSlagTemp_C_B >= 1200.0) AND (rSlagTemp_C_B <= 1800.0);

(* --- 2.4 Off-Gas Oxygen Flow 2oo3 Voting (0 to 5000 Nm3/h range) --- *)
bO2_A_OK := (rOxygenOffGas_Nm3h_A >= -5.0) AND (rOxygenOffGas_Nm3h_A <= 5500.0);
bO2_B_OK := (rOxygenOffGas_Nm3h_B >= -5.0) AND (rOxygenOffGas_Nm3h_B <= 5500.0);

    rVotedOxygenFlow_Nm3h := (rOxygenOffGas_Nm3h_A + rOxygenOffGas_Nm3h_C) / 2.0;

ELSE

(* --- 2.5 Cathodic Liquid Iron Pool Depth 2oo3 Voting (0 to 1200 mm range) --- *)
bLvl_A_OK := (rLiquidIronPoolLevel_mm_A >= 0.0) AND (rLiquidIronPoolLevel_mm_A <= 1250.0);
bLvl_B_OK := (rLiquidIronPoolLevel_mm_B >= 0.0) AND (rLiquidIronPoolLevel_mm_B <= 1250.0);
bLvl_C_OK := (rLiquidIronPoolLevel_mm_C >= 0.0) AND (rLiquidIronPoolLevel_mm_C <= 1250.0);

IF bLvl_A_OK AND bLvl_B_OK AND bLvl_C_OK THEN

       (ABS(rLiquidIronPoolLevel_mm_A - rLiquidIronPoolLevel_mm_C) <= c_rTolLevel_mm) THEN
        rVotedIronLevel_mm := (rLiquidIronPoolLevel_mm_A + rLiquidIronPoolLevel_mm_B + rLiquidIronPoolLevel_mm_C) / 3.0;
    ELSIF ABS(rLiquidIronPoolLevel_mm_A - rLiquidIronPoolLevel_mm_B) <= c_rTolLevel_mm THEN
        rVotedIronLevel_mm := (rLiquidIronPoolLevel_mm_A + rLiquidIronPoolLevel_mm_B) / 2.0;
    ELSIF ABS(rLiquidIronPoolLevel_mm_A - rLiquidIronPoolLevel_mm_C) <= c_rTolLevel_mm THEN
        rVotedIronLevel_mm := (rLiquidIronPoolLevel_mm_A + rLiquidIronPoolLevel_mm_C) / 2.0;

ELSIF bLvl_A_OK AND bLvl_B_OK THEN

    rVotedIronLevel_mm := (rLiquidIronPoolLevel_mm_A + rLiquidIronPoolLevel_mm_C) / 2.0;

END_IF;

(* --- 2.6 Hearth Refractory Microstrain 2oo3 Voting (0 to 2500 ustrain range) --- *)
bStrn_A_OK := (rRefractoryStrain_ustrain_A >= 0.0) AND (rRefractoryStrain_ustrain_A <= 2600.0);
bStrn_B_OK := (rRefractoryStrain_ustrain_B >= 0.0) AND (rRefractoryStrain_ustrain_B <= 2600.0);
bStrn_C_OK := (rRefractoryStrain_ustrain_C >= 0.0) AND (rRefractoryStrain_ustrain_C <= 2600.0);

IF bStrn_A_OK AND bStrn_B_OK AND bStrn_C_OK THEN

    IF (ABS(rRefractoryStrain_ustrain_A - rRefractoryStrain_ustrain_B) <= c_rTolStrain_ustrain) AND
       (ABS(rRefractoryStrain_ustrain_A - rRefractoryStrain_ustrain_C) <= c_rTolStrain_ustrain) THEN
