bDegraded_1oo2_Mode := bCurr_Degraded_1oo2 OR bVolt_Degraded_1oo2 OR bTemp_Degraded_1oo2 OR bO2_Degraded_1oo2 OR bLvl_Degraded_1oo2;

(* Apply First-Order Butterworth Digital Low-Pass Filters to Voted Analogs *)
rCellCurrent_Filt_kA    := (0.90 * rCellCurrent_Filt_kA) + (0.10 * rVotedCellCurrent_kA);
rCellVoltage_Filt_V     := (0.92 * rCellVoltage_Filt_V) + (0.08 * rVotedCellVoltage_V);
rSlagTemp_Filt_C        := (0.95 * rSlagTemp_Filt_C) + (0.05 * rVotedSlagTemp_C);
rOxygenFlow_Filt_Nm3h   := (0.85 * rOxygenFlow_Filt_Nm3h) + (0.15 * rVotedOxygenFlow_Nm3h);
rIronLevel_Filt_mm      := (0.94 * rIronLevel_Filt_mm) + (0.06 * rVotedIronLevel_mm);
rRefractoryStrain_Filt  := (0.98 * rRefractoryStrain_Filt) + (0.02 * rVotedRefractoryStrain);

(* ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* 3.0 HIGH-TEMPERATURE ELECTROCHEMICAL, INDUCTION & HYDRODYNAMIC PHYSICS ENGINES            *)
(* ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)

(* --- 3.1 Slag Liquidus Temperature & Urbain Optical Basicity Viscosity Model --- *)
(* Slag system: SiO2 - Al2O3 - CaO - MgO - FeOx *)
(* Absolute temperature conversion *)
rSlagTempKelvin := rSlagTemp_Filt_C + 273.15;

(* Optical Basicity calculation: Lambda = Sum(x_i * Lambda_i) *)
(* Elemental basicities: CaO=1.00, MgO=0.78, Al2O3=0.60, SiO2=0.48, FeO=0.93 *)
rOpticalBasicity := (0.01 * rSlagBasicity_B2 * rSiO2_wt_pct * 1.00) +
                    (0.01 * rMgO_wt_pct * 0.78) +
                    (0.01 * rAl2O3_wt_pct * 0.60) +
                    (0.01 * rSiO2_wt_pct * 0.48) +
                    (0.01 * rFeTotal_wt_pct * 0.93);

(* Non-Bridging Oxygen per Tetrahedrally Coordinated Cation: NBO/T *)
(* NBO/T = 2 * (x_CaO + x_MgO + x_FeO - x_Al2O3) / (x_SiO2 + 2*x_Al2O3) *)
rTmpA := (rSlagBasicity_B2 * rSiO2_wt_pct) + rMgO_wt_pct + rFeTotal_wt_pct - rAl2O3_wt_pct;
rTmpB := rSiO2_wt_pct + (2.0 * rAl2O3_wt_pct);
IF rTmpB > 5.0 THEN
    rNonBridgingOxygenRatio := 2.0 * rTmpA / rTmpB;
ELSE
    rNonBridgingOxygenRatio := 1.80;
END_IF;

(* Slag Liquidus Temperature Empirical Estimation based on Phase Equilibrium *)
rEstimatedSlagLiquidus_C := 1420.0 + (35.0 * rAl2O3_wt_pct / 15.0) + (18.0 * (rSlagBasicity_B2 - 0.85) * 50.0) - (12.0 * rFeTotal_wt_pct);
IF rEstimatedSlagLiquidus_C < 1380.0 THEN
    rEstimatedSlagLiquidus_C := 1380.0;
ELSIF rEstimatedSlagLiquidus_C > 1560.0 THEN
    rEstimatedSlagLiquidus_C := 1560.0;
END_IF;

(* Urbain / Weymann-Frenkel Viscosity Calculation: mu = A * T * exp(1000 * B / T) *)
(* Parameters A and B are mapped as polynomials of optical basicity and silica fraction *)
rUrbain_Param_B := 6200.0 + (5500.0 * (1.0 - rOpticalBasicity)) + (1200.0 / (rNonBridgingOxygenRatio + 0.1));
rUrbain_Param_A := 0.00018 * EXP(-0.00025 * rUrbain_Param_B);

IF rSlagTempKelvin > 1400.0 THEN
    rEstimatedSlagViscosity_Pa_s := rUrbain_Param_A * rSlagTempKelvin * EXP(rUrbain_Param_B / rSlagTempKelvin);
ELSE
    rEstimatedSlagViscosity_Pa_s := 2.50; (* Massive freeze skull viscosity *)
END_IF;

(* Check Slag Superheat Margin above Liquidus *)
IF (rSlagTemp_Filt_C - rEstimatedSlagLiquidus_C) < c_rMinLiquidusMargin THEN
    dwAlarmWord_2 := dwAlarmWord_2 OR 16#0000_4000; (* Slag Skull Freeze Threat Warning *)
END_IF;

(* --- 3.2 High-Frequency Induction Heating (HFIH) Skin Effect & Joule Dissipation --- *)
(* Inverter tank angular frequency: omega = 2 * pi * f *)
rAngularFreq_rads := 2.0 * 3.14159265 * (rInductionFreqFeedback_kHz * 1000.0);

(* Slag High-Frequency Electromagnetic Skin Depth: delta = sqrt( 2 / (omega * mu_0 * sigma) ) *)
IF (rSlagConductivity_Sm > 5.0) AND (rAngularFreq_rads > 1000.0) THEN
    rSkinDepth_m := SQRT(2.0 / (rAngularFreq_rads * c_rPermeabilityVacuum * rSlagConductivity_Sm));
    rSkinDepth_Induction_mm := rSkinDepth_m * 1000.0;
ELSE
    rSkinDepth_Induction_mm := 15.0;
END_IF;

(* Crucible steady-state conductive and surface radiation thermal dissipation [kW] *)
(* Radiation P_rad = epsilon * sigma_SB * A * (T^4 - T_amb^4) *)
rTmpA := rSlagTempKelvin / 1000.0;
rEffectiveSlagThermalLoss_kW := 280.0 + (38.5 * (rTmpA * rTmpA * rTmpA * rTmpA));

(* --- 3.3 Iridium-Based Inert Anode OER Kinetics & Butler-Volmer Overpotential --- *)
(* Anodic reaction: 2 O^(2-) -> O2(g) + 4 e- *)
(* Anode superficial current density: j = I_cell / A_anode *)
IF c_rAnodeEffectiveArea > 0.1 THEN
    rAnodeCurrentDensity_A_m2 := (rCellCurrent_Filt_kA * 1000.0) / c_rAnodeEffectiveArea;
ELSE
    rAnodeCurrentDensity_A_m2 := 0.0;
END_IF;

(* Nernst Reversible Decomposition Potential at 1600°C for Fe2O3 -> 2 Fe + 1.5 O2 *)
(* E_rev(T) = Delta_G0 / (n*F) + (R*T / (n*F)) * ln( a_Fe^2 * p_O2^1.5 / a_Fe2O3 ) *)
(* Baseline E_rev ~ 1.285 V at 1600°C with p_O2 = 1.0 atm, FeOx activity proxy *)
IF rFeTotal_wt_pct > 0.1 THEN
    rCalculatedNernstPotential_V := 1.285 + ((c_rGasConstR * rSlagTempKelvin) / (6.0 * c_rFaradayConst)) * LN(10.0 / rFeTotal_wt_pct);
ELSE
    rCalculatedNernstPotential_V := 1.450;
END_IF;

(* Bulk Electrolyte Ohmic (IR) Drop: V_IR = I * R_slag = I * (d_gap / (sigma * A_c)) *)
IF (rSlagConductivity_Sm > 10.0) AND (c_rHearthArea > 1.0) THEN
    rCalculatedOhmicDrop_V := (rCellCurrent_Filt_kA * 1000.0) * (c_rInterElectrodeGap / (rSlagConductivity_Sm * c_rHearthArea));
ELSE
    rCalculatedOhmicDrop_V := 0.50;
END_IF;

(* Tafel Slope: b = 2.302585 * R * T / (alpha_a * z * F) with z = 4 for OER *)
rTafelSlope_V_dec := (2.302585 * c_rGasConstR * rSlagTempKelvin) / (rAnodicTransferCoeff_alpha * 4.0 * c_rFaradayConst);

(* Butler-Volmer High-Field Kinetic Overpotential Approximation: *)
(* eta_OER = b * log10( j / j0 ) *)
IF (rAnodeCurrentDensity_A_m2 > 10.0) AND (rExchangeCurrentDensity_j0 > 1.0) THEN
    rTmpA := rAnodeCurrentDensity_A_m2 / rExchangeCurrentDensity_j0;
    IF rTmpA > 1.0 THEN
        rCalculatedOER_Overpotential_V := rTafelSlope_V_dec * (LN(rTmpA) / 2.302585);
    ELSE
        rCalculatedOER_Overpotential_V := 0.050;
    END_IF;
ELSE
    rCalculatedOER_Overpotential_V := 0.0;
END_IF;

(* Iridium Inert Anode Surface Wear / Dissolution Rate in nm/h *)
(* r_wear = k0 * exp(-Ea / RT) * (1 + beta * eta^2) *)
rTmpA := rCalculatedOER_Overpotential_V / c_rMaxOEROverpotential;
rIridiumAnodeWearRate_nm_h := (2.50 * EXP((rSlagTemp_Filt_C - 1600.0) / 45.0)) * (1.0 + (3.2 * (rTmpA * rTmpA)));

(* Passivity Breakdown Warning Debounce *)
rAnodePassivityFailureMargin := c_rMaxOEROverpotential - rCalculatedOER_Overpotential_V;
tonPassivityExcursionDebounce(IN := (rCalculatedOER_Overpotential_V > c_rMaxOEROverpotential), PT := T#500MS);
IF tonPassivityExcursionDebounce.Q THEN
    dwAlarmWord_1 := dwAlarmWord_1 OR 16#0000_0200; (* Anode Passivation Breakdown Trip *)
    bSystemTrip := TRUE;
END_IF;

(* --- 3.4 Cathodic Iron Direct Reduction & Mass Balance --- *)
(* Instantaneous Faraday Current: I_fe = I_cell * FaradaicEfficiency *)
(* Faradaic Efficiency proxy based on dissolved FeOx and cell temperature *)
IF rFeTotal_wt_pct > 2.0 THEN
    rFaradaicEfficiency_pct := 94.5 - (0.015 * (rSlagTemp_Filt_C - 1600.0)) - (12.0 / rFeTotal_wt_pct);
ELSE
    rFaradaicEfficiency_pct := 65.0;
END_IF;

IF rFaradaicEfficiency_pct > 98.0 THEN rFaradaicEfficiency_pct := 98.0; END_IF;
IF rFaradaicEfficiency_pct < 40.0 THEN rFaradaicEfficiency_pct := 40.0; END_IF;

(* Pure Iron Reduction Mass Rate: m_dot_Fe [kg/h] = (I_cell * 1000 * eta_F * M_Fe * 3600) / (z * F * 1000) *)
(* For Fe(III) + 3e- -> Fe: z = 3 *)
rInstantFeMassFlux_kgh := (rCellCurrent_Filt_kA * 1000.0 * (rFaradaicEfficiency_pct / 100.0) * c_rMolarMassFe * 3.6) /
                          (3.0 * c_rFaradayConst);
rLiquidIronProductionRate_kgh := rInstantFeMassFlux_kgh;

(* Pure Oxygen Off-Gas Evolution Rate: V_dot_O2 [Nm3/h] = (I_cell * 1000 * eta_F * V_m * 3600) / (4 * F) *)
rTheoreticalO2Flow_Nm3h := (rCellCurrent_Filt_kA * 1000.0 * (rFaradaicEfficiency_pct / 100.0) * c_rStdO2MolarVolume * 3600.0) /
                           (4.0 * c_rFaradayConst);

(* Cumulative Integration of Products *)
rAccumulatedLiquidIron_t := rAccumulatedLiquidIron_t + ((rInstantFeMassFlux_kgh * (c_rScanTimeSeconds / 3600.0)) / 1000.0);
rAccumulatedOxygenProduced_Nm3 := rAccumulatedOxygenProduced_Nm3 + (rTheoreticalO2Flow_Nm3h * (c_rScanTimeSeconds / 3600.0));

(* --- 3.5 Liquid Metal Siphoning Hydraulics & Anti-Vortex Suppression --- *)
(* Siphon Driving Pressure: Delta_P = P_atm - P_vac + (rho_Fe * g * h_lift) - rho_slag * g * h_submerge *)
rSiphonTorricelliHead_m := (rIronLevel_Filt_mm / 1000.0);
rSiphonEffectiveDeltaP_bar := ((1013.25 - rSiphonVacuum_mbar) / 1000.0) +
                             ((c_rDensityLiquidFe * 9.80665 * rSiphonTorricelliHead_m) / 100000.0);

(* Mass flow extracted through ceramic siphon conduit *)
IF (rSiphonSuctionValvePos_pct > 1.0) AND (rSiphonEffectiveDeltaP_bar > 0.05) THEN
    rSiphonMassFlowExtracted_kgh := 450.0 * (rSiphonSuctionValvePos_pct / 100.0) * SQRT(rSiphonEffectiveDeltaP_bar) *
                                   (1.0 + (0.15 * rSiphonArgonGasFlow_Nm3h));
ELSE
    rSiphonMassFlowExtracted_kgh := 0.0;
END_IF;

(* Anti-Slag Vortex Suppression Gating: Froude number F_r = v / sqrt(g * h_pool) *)
IF rIronLevel_Filt_mm > 10.0 THEN
    rSiphonAntiVortexFroudeNumber := (rSiphonMassFlowExtracted_kgh / (c_rDensityLiquidFe * 0.00785 * 3600.0)) /
                                     SQRT(9.80665 * (rIronLevel_Filt_mm / 1000.0));
ELSE
    rSiphonAntiVortexFroudeNumber := 10.0;
END_IF;

(* Critical Slag Slurp Interlock *)
tonVortexWarningDebounce(IN := (rIronLevel_Filt_mm < c_rMinSiphonPoolLevel) AND (rSiphonSuctionValvePos_pct > 5.0), PT := T#200MS);
IF tonVortexWarningDebounce.Q THEN
    rSiphonSuctionValvePos_pct := 0.0; (* Instantly close siphon to prevent slag suction *)
    rSiphonArgonLift_Nm3h := 0.0;
    dwAlarmWord_1 := dwAlarmWord_1 OR 16#0000_0400; (* Siphon Slag Ingestion Risk Trip *)
END_IF;

(* ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* 4.0 DISCRETE 6-STATE STATE-SPACE MODEL UPDATE & KALMAN PREDICTOR                          *)
(* Predicts next-state evolution based on coupled multi-physics dynamics                     *)
(* ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)

(* Calculate Deviations from Nominal Operating Equilibrium *)
x1_TempDev      := rSlagTemp_Filt_C - rTargetSlagTemp_C;
x2_FeOxDev      := rFeTotal_wt_pct - rTargetFeOx_wt_pct;
x3_PoolDev      := rIronLevel_Filt_mm - rTargetPoolDepth_mm;
x4_OverpotDev   := rCalculatedOER_Overpotential_V - rTargetOEROverpotential_V;
x5_ViscDev      := rEstimatedSlagViscosity_Pa_s - rTargetSlagViscosity_Pa_s;
x6_O2Dev        := rOxygenFlow_Filt_Nm3h - rTargetO2Gen_Nm3h;

(* Discrete State Evolution: x[k+1] = Ad * x[k] + Bd * u[k] *)
x1_Next := (Ad_11 * x1_TempDev) + (Ad_12 * x2_FeOxDev) + (Ad_13 * x3_PoolDev) +
           (Ad_14 * x4_OverpotDev) + (Ad_15 * x5_ViscDev) + (Ad_16 * x6_O2Dev) +
           (Bd_11 * rDeltaCurrent_Cmd) + (Bd_12 * rDeltaInduction_Cmd) +
           (Bd_13 * rDeltaOre_Cmd) + (Bd_14 * rDeltaSiphon_Cmd);

x2_Next := (Ad_21 * x1_TempDev) + (Ad_22 * x2_FeOxDev) + (Ad_23 * x3_PoolDev) +
           (Ad_24 * x4_OverpotDev) + (Ad_25 * x5_ViscDev) + (Ad_26 * x6_O2Dev) +
           (Bd_21 * rDeltaCurrent_Cmd) + (Bd_22 * rDeltaInduction_Cmd) +
           (Bd_23 * rDeltaOre_Cmd) + (Bd_24 * rDeltaSiphon_Cmd);

x3_Next := (Ad_31 * x1_TempDev) + (Ad_32 * x2_FeOxDev) + (Ad_33 * x3_PoolDev) +
           (Ad_34 * x4_OverpotDev) + (Ad_35 * x5_ViscDev) + (Ad_36 * x6_O2Dev) +
           (Bd_31 * rDeltaCurrent_Cmd) + (Bd_32 * rDeltaInduction_Cmd) +
           (Bd_33 * rDeltaOre_Cmd) + (Bd_34 * rDeltaSiphon_Cmd);

x4_Next := (Ad_41 * x1_TempDev) + (Ad_42 * x2_FeOxDev) + (Ad_43 * x3_PoolDev) +
           (Ad_44 * x4_OverpotDev) + (Ad_45 * x5_ViscDev) + (Ad_46 * x6_O2Dev) +
           (Bd_41 * rDeltaCurrent_Cmd) + (Bd_42 * rDeltaInduction_Cmd) +
           (Bd_43 * rDeltaOre_Cmd) + (Bd_44 * rDeltaSiphon_Cmd);

x5_Next := (Ad_51 * x1_TempDev) + (Ad_52 * x2_FeOxDev) + (Ad_53 * x3_PoolDev) +
           (Ad_54 * x4_OverpotDev) + (Ad_55 * x5_ViscDev) + (Ad_56 * x6_O2Dev) +
           (Bd_51 * rDeltaCurrent_Cmd) + (Bd_52 * rDeltaInduction_Cmd) +
           (Bd_53 * rDeltaOre_Cmd) + (Bd_54 * rDeltaSiphon_Cmd);

x6_Next := (Ad_61 * x1_TempDev) + (Ad_62 * x2_FeOxDev) + (Ad_63 * x3_PoolDev) +
           (Ad_64 * x4_OverpotDev) + (Ad_65 * x5_ViscDev) + (Ad_66 * x6_O2Dev) +
           (Bd_61 * rDeltaCurrent_Cmd) + (Bd_62 * rDeltaInduction_Cmd) +
           (Bd_63 * rDeltaOre_Cmd) + (Bd_64 * rDeltaSiphon_Cmd);

(* ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* 5.0 MODEL PREDICTIVE CONTROL (MPC) QUADRATIC COST GRADIENT DESCENT                        *)
(* Minimizes J = 1/2 * (x_next' * Q * x_next) + 1/2 * (u' * R * u) with hard constraints     *)
(* ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)

(* Gradient w.r.t Control Increments: g = B' * Q * x_next + R * u *)
rGrad_Current := (Bd_11 * rMPC_Q_Temp * x1_Next) +
                 (Bd_21 * rMPC_Q_FeOx * x2_Next) +
                 (Bd_31 * rMPC_Q_Pool * x3_Next) +
                 (Bd_41 * rMPC_Q_Overpot * x4_Next) +
                 (Bd_51 * rMPC_Q_Visc * x5_Next) +
                 (Bd_61 * rMPC_Q_O2 * x6_Next) +
                 (rMPC_R_Current * rDeltaCurrent_Cmd);

rGrad_Induction := (Bd_12 * rMPC_Q_Temp * x1_Next) +
                   (Bd_22 * rMPC_Q_FeOx * x2_Next) +
                   (Bd_32 * rMPC_Q_Pool * x3_Next) +
                   (Bd_42 * rMPC_Q_Overpot * x4_Next) +
                   (Bd_52 * rMPC_Q_Visc * x5_Next) +
                   (Bd_62 * rMPC_Q_O2 * x6_Next) +
                   (rMPC_R_Induction * rDeltaInduction_Cmd);

rGrad_Ore := (Bd_13 * rMPC_Q_Temp * x1_Next) +
             (Bd_23 * rMPC_Q_FeOx * x2_Next) +
             (Bd_33 * rMPC_Q_Pool * x3_Next) +
             (Bd_43 * rMPC_Q_Overpot * x4_Next) +
             (Bd_53 * rMPC_Q_Visc * x5_Next) +
             (Bd_63 * rMPC_Q_O2 * x6_Next) +
             (rMPC_R_Ore * rDeltaOre_Cmd);

rGrad_Siphon := (Bd_14 * rMPC_Q_Temp * x1_Next) +
                (Bd_24 * rMPC_Q_FeOx * x2_Next) +
                (Bd_34 * rMPC_Q_Pool * x3_Next) +
                (Bd_44 * rMPC_Q_Overpot * x4_Next) +
                (Bd_54 * rMPC_Q_Visc * x5_Next) +
                (Bd_64 * rMPC_Q_O2 * x6_Next) +
                (rMPC_R_Siphon * rDeltaSiphon_Cmd);

(* Projected Gradient Descent Step with Adaptive Learning Rate gamma *)
rDeltaCurrent_Cmd   := -0.150 * rGrad_Current;
rDeltaInduction_Cmd := -0.220 * rGrad_Induction;
rDeltaOre_Cmd       := -0.180 * rGrad_Ore;
rDeltaSiphon_Cmd    := -0.250 * rGrad_Siphon;

(* Slew Rate Clamping on Control Action Increments *)
IF rDeltaCurrent_Cmd > 2.5 THEN rDeltaCurrent_Cmd := 2.5; ELSIF rDeltaCurrent_Cmd < -2.5 THEN rDeltaCurrent_Cmd := -2.5; END_IF;
IF rDeltaInduction_Cmd > 50.0 THEN rDeltaInduction_Cmd := 50.0; ELSIF rDeltaInduction_Cmd < -50.0 THEN rDeltaInduction_Cmd := -50.0; END_IF;
IF rDeltaOre_Cmd > 120.0 THEN rDeltaOre_Cmd := 120.0; ELSIF rDeltaOre_Cmd < -120.0 THEN rDeltaOre_Cmd := -120.0; END_IF;
IF rDeltaSiphon_Cmd > 2.0 THEN rDeltaSiphon_Cmd := 2.0; ELSIF rDeltaSiphon_Cmd < -2.0 THEN rDeltaSiphon_Cmd := -2.0; END_IF;

(* ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* 6.0 HIERARCHICAL ALARM EVALUATION & GRACEFUL DEGRADATION                                  *)
(* Bit-packing status words and managing seamless operational degradation                    *)
(* ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)

(* Anode High Overpotential Advisory *)
IF rCalculatedOER_Overpotential_V > 0.650 THEN
    dwAlarmWord_2 := dwAlarmWord_2 OR 16#0001_0000; (* Overpotential High Warning *)
    bWarningActive := TRUE;
ELSE
    dwAlarmWord_2 := dwAlarmWord_2 AND 16#FFFE_FFFF;
END_IF;

(* Slag High Viscosity Impairing Gas Detachment *)
IF rEstimatedSlagViscosity_Pa_s > 0.650 THEN
    dwAlarmWord_2 := dwAlarmWord_2 OR 16#0002_0000; (* High Slag Viscosity *)
    bWarningActive := TRUE;
ELSE
    dwAlarmWord_2 := dwAlarmWord_2 AND 16#FFFD_FFFF;
END_IF;

(* Hearth Liquid Metal Overflow Risk *)
IF rIronLevel_Filt_mm > c_rMaxSiphonPoolLevel THEN
    dwAlarmWord_1 := dwAlarmWord_1 OR 16#0000_0800; (* Liquid Metal Hearth Full Trip *)
    bSystemTrip := TRUE;
END_IF;

(* Refractory Thermomechanical Fatigue Advisory *)
IF rVotedRefractoryStrain > 850.0 THEN
    dwAlarmWord_2 := dwAlarmWord_2 OR 16#0004_0000; (* Refractory High Strain Warning *)
    bWarningActive := TRUE;
END_IF;

(* Bitpack System Status Word *)
dwSystemStatusWord := 16#0000_0000;
IF bSystemReady THEN dwSystemStatusWord := dwSystemStatusWord OR 16#0000_0001; END_IF;
IF bSystemRunning THEN dwSystemStatusWord := dwSystemStatusWord OR 16#0000_0002; END_IF;
IF bSystemTrip THEN dwSystemStatusWord := dwSystemStatusWord OR 16#0000_0004; END_IF;
IF bDegraded_1oo2_Mode THEN dwSystemStatusWord := dwSystemStatusWord OR 16#0000_0008; END_IF;
IF bDegraded_InductionOnly THEN dwSystemStatusWord := dwSystemStatusWord OR 16#0000_0010; END_IF;
IF (rSiphonSuctionValvePos_pct > 0.1) THEN dwSystemStatusWord := dwSystemStatusWord OR 16#0000_0020; END_IF;
IF (rRectifierCurrentDemand_kA > 10.0) THEN dwSystemStatusWord := dwSystemStatusWord OR 16#0000_0040; END_IF;
IF (rInductionPowerDemand_kW > 100.0) THEN dwSystemStatusWord := dwSystemStatusWord OR 16#0000_0080; END_IF;

(* ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* 7.0 MULTI-STAGE FINITE STATE MACHINE (FSM) LIFECYCLE MANAGEMENT                           *)
(* ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
CASE iState OF

    0: (* --------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
       (* STATE 0: IDLE / COLD STANDBY                                                       *)
       (* System de-energized, waiting for master enable and safety interlocks OK           *)
       (* --------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
        sStateDescription := 'IDLE / COLD STANDBY';
        bSystemRunning := FALSE;
        rRectifierCurrentDemand_kA := 0.0;
        rInductionPowerDemand_kW := 0.0;
        rOreFeederDemand_kgh := 0.0;
        rSiphonSuctionValvePos_pct := 0.0;
        rSiphonArgonLift_Nm3h := 0.0;
        rAnodePositionDemand_mm := 0.0; (* Retracted fully *)

        IF bAcknowledgeFault THEN
            bSystemTrip := FALSE;
            dwAlarmWord_1 := 16#0000_0000;
            dwAlarmWord_2 := 16#0000_0000;
        END_IF;

        bSystemReady := (NOT bSystemTrip) AND bEmergencyStop AND bInductionMasterEnable AND bAnodePositionCalibrated;

        IF bEnableSystem AND bSystemReady THEN
            iState := 10;
        END_IF;

    10: (* -------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
        (* STATE 10: HIGH-FREQUENCY INDUCTION PREHEAT & SUSCEPTOR COUPLING                  *)
        (* Heats crucible and molten oxide slag above liquidus (~1550°C)                    *)
        (* -------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
        sStateDescription := 'INDUCTION PREHEAT & MELT';
        bSystemRunning := TRUE;

        (* Ramp Induction Heating Power *)
        IF rInductionPowerDemand_kW < 3200.0 THEN
            rInductionPowerDemand_kW := rInductionPowerDemand_kW + (25.0 * c_rScanTimeSeconds);
        END_IF;

        rAnodePositionDemand_mm := 0.0; (* Anode remains raised in purge hood *)
        rRectifierCurrentDemand_kA := 0.0;
        rOreFeederDemand_kgh := 0.0;

        (* Check Slag Liquefaction and Superheat Margin *)
        tonPreheatSoakTimer(IN := (rSlagTemp_Filt_C >= 1550.0) AND (rEstimatedSlagViscosity_Pa_s < 0.450), PT := T#30S);
        IF tonPreheatSoakTimer.Q THEN
            tonPreheatSoakTimer(IN := FALSE);
            iState := 20;
        END_IF;

        IF NOT bEnableSystem THEN
            iState := 0;
        END_IF;

    20: (* -------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
        (* STATE 20: ANODE SUBMERGENCE & ARGON HEADSPACE PURGE                              *)
        (* Lowers iridium inert anode into molten slag and flushes oxygen headspace with Ar  *)
        (* -------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
        sStateDescription := 'ANODE IMMERSION & PURGE';

        (* Maintain Slag Superheat via Induction *)
        rInductionPowerDemand_kW := rEffectiveSlagThermalLoss_kW * 1.15;

        (* Smoothly lower anode to target immersion depth (150 mm) *)
        IF rAnodePositionDemand_mm < 150.0 THEN
            rAnodePositionDemand_mm := rAnodePositionDemand_mm + (10.0 * c_rScanTimeSeconds);
        ELSE
            rAnodePositionDemand_mm := 150.0;
        END_IF;

        tonAnodeSubmergeDelay(IN := (rAnodeImmersionDepthFeedback_mm >= 145.0), PT := T#15S);
        IF tonAnodeSubmergeDelay.Q THEN
            tonAnodeSubmergeDelay(IN := FALSE);
            iState := 30;
        END_IF;

        IF NOT bEnableSystem THEN
            iState := 0;
        END_IF;

    30: (* -------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
        (* STATE 30: RECTIFIER VOLTAGE STRIKE & OER INITIATION                              *)
        (* Applies polarization potential, strikes electrolytic OER, verifies gas evolution *)
        (* -------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
        sStateDescription := 'VOLTAGE STRIKE & OER RAMP';

        (* Ramp Rectifier Current gently at 2.0 kA/s to establish OER *)
        IF rRectifierCurrentDemand_kA < 45.0 THEN
            rRectifierCurrentDemand_kA := rRectifierCurrentDemand_kA + (2.0 * c_rScanTimeSeconds);
        END_IF;

        tonStrikeRampTimer(IN := (rVotedCellVoltage_V > 2.20) AND (rVotedOxygenFlow_Nm3h > 50.0), PT := T#10S);
        IF tonStrikeRampTimer.Q THEN
            tonStrikeRampTimer(IN := FALSE);
            iState := 40;
        END_IF;

        IF NOT bEnableSystem THEN
            iState := 0;
        END_IF;

    40: (* -------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
        (* STATE 40: FULL CONTINUOUS PRODUCTION REDUCTION (CLOSED-LOOP MPC ACTIVE)          *)
        (* Regulates DC current, induction trim, ore feed, and electrode immersion           *)
        (* -------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
        sStateDescription := 'FULL CLOSED-LOOP MOE RUN';

        (* Apply MPC Optimal Increments *)
        rRectifierCurrentDemand_kA := rRectifierCurrentDemand_kA + (rDeltaCurrent_Cmd * c_rScanTimeSeconds);
        rInductionPowerDemand_kW   := rInductionPowerDemand_kW + (rDeltaInduction_Cmd * c_rScanTimeSeconds);
        rOreFeederDemand_kgh       := rOreFeederDemand_kgh + (rDeltaOre_Cmd * c_rScanTimeSeconds);

        (* Bound Checks for Production Actuators *)
        IF rRectifierCurrentDemand_kA > 250.0 THEN rRectifierCurrentDemand_kA := 250.0; END_IF;
        IF rRectifierCurrentDemand_kA < 20.0 THEN rRectifierCurrentDemand_kA := 20.0; END_IF;

        IF rInductionPowerDemand_kW > 4200.0 THEN rInductionPowerDemand_kW := 4200.0; END_IF;
        IF rInductionPowerDemand_kW < 100.0 THEN rInductionPowerDemand_kW := 100.0; END_IF;

        IF bOreFeedPermissive THEN
            IF rOreFeederDemand_kgh > 8500.0 THEN rOreFeederDemand_kgh := 8500.0; END_IF;
            IF rOreFeederDemand_kgh < 0.0 THEN rOreFeederDemand_kgh := 0.0; END_IF;
        ELSE
            rOreFeederDemand_kgh := 0.0;
        END_IF;

        (* Check Trigger for Cathodic Liquid Iron Extraction Siphoning *)
        IF rIronLevel_Filt_mm >= 520.0 THEN
            iState := 50; (* Transition to Siphon Harvesting *)
        END_IF;

        (* Check Slag Conditioning Need *)
        IF (rSlagBasicity_B2 < 0.75) OR (rFeTotal_wt_pct < 1.8) THEN
            iState := 60; (* Transition to Slag Conditioning *)
        END_IF;

(* ========================================================================================= *)
(* 1.0 EMERGENCY SAFETY SHUTDOWN & SIL-3 HARDWIRED INTERLOCK EVALUATION                      *)
(* ========================================================================================= *)
(* Evaluates critical process safety barriers to protect the fragile ceramic matrix,        *)
(* prevent explosive cross-leakage of hydrogen and oxygen, and isolate electrical faults.   *)

(* Reset Alarm Registers on Positive Transition of Reset Command *)
IF bResetFaults AND (NOT bSystemTripped OR (iState = 0) OR (iState = 100)) THEN
    dwAlarmWord1 := 16#0000_0000;
    dwAlarmWord2 := 16#0000_0000;
    dwWarningWord := 16#0000_0000;
END_IF;

(* 1.1 SIL-3 Hardwired Emergency Stop Relay (Active-Low) *)
IF NOT bEmergencyStop THEN
    dwAlarmWord1 := dwAlarmWord1 OR 16#0000_0001; (* E-Stop tripped *)
    bSystemTripped := TRUE;
END_IF;

(* 1.2 Anode-Cathode Differential Pressure (Delta P_A-C) Catastrophic Hazard *)
(* Nominal Delta P is +30 mbar (anode positive). Bubble pressure of gamma-LiAlO2 matrix is ~80 mbar. *)
(* If Delta P > 45 mbar or Delta P < -10 mbar, immediate risk of seal blowout or oxygen cross-over. *)
IF (rVotedDiffPress_mbar > 45.0) OR (rVotedDiffPress_mbar < -10.0) THEN
    dwAlarmWord1 := dwAlarmWord1 OR 16#0000_0002; (* Delta P matrix breach hazard *)
    bMatrixPressureHazard := TRUE;
    bSystemTripped := TRUE;
ELSE
    bMatrixPressureHazard := FALSE;
END_IF;

(* 1.3 MCFC Stack Core High-High Temperature Trip (> 685 deg C) *)
IF rVotedCoreTemp_DegC > 685.0 THEN
    dwAlarmWord1 := dwAlarmWord1 OR 16#0000_0004; (* Core overtemperature sintering hazard *)
    bSystemTripped := TRUE;
END_IF;

(* 1.4 MCFC Stack Core Low Temperature Trip while Loaded (< 590 deg C) *)
(* Solidification of eutectic carbonate (m.p. ~490-520C) under electrical load destroys tiles *)
IF (rVotedCoreTemp_DegC < 590.0) AND (iState >= 60) THEN
    dwAlarmWord1 := dwAlarmWord1 OR 16#0000_0008; (* Eutectic freezing under load hazard *)
    bSystemTripped := TRUE;
END_IF;

(* 1.5 Stack Terminal DC Overvoltage Trip (> 920 VDC) *)
IF rVotedStackVoltage_V > 920.0 THEN
    dwAlarmWord1 := dwAlarmWord1 OR 16#0000_0010; (* DC bus overvoltage trip *)
    bSystemTripped := TRUE;
END_IF;

(* 1.6 Single Cell Severe Undervoltage / Fuel Starvation (< 0.55 V/cell) *)
IF (rSingleCellVoltage_V < 0.55) AND (iState >= 60) THEN
    dwAlarmWord1 := dwAlarmWord1 OR 16#0000_0020; (* Cell voltage collapse / starvation *)
    bSystemTripped := TRUE;
END_IF;

(* 1.7 Steam-to-Carbon Ratio Critical Coking Interlock (S/C < 2.0) *)
IF (rActualSteamCarbonRatio < 2.00) AND (rAnodeMethaneFlow_Nm3h > 10.0) AND (iState >= 40) THEN
    dwAlarmWord1 := dwAlarmWord1 OR 16#0000_0040; (* Severe coking / carbon deposition *)
    bCokingHazardAlarm := TRUE;
    bSystemTripped := TRUE;
ELSE
    bCokingHazardAlarm := FALSE;
END_IF;

(* 1.8 Utility Grid Severe Voltage/Frequency Loss-of-Mains (Anti-Islanding) *)
IF ((rVotedGridVoltage_V < 280.0) OR (rVotedGridVoltage_V > 460.0) OR
    (rVotedGridFreq_Hz < 47.0) OR (rVotedGridFreq_Hz > 53.0)) AND (iState >= 60) AND NOT bLvrtActive THEN
    dwAlarmWord1 := dwAlarmWord1 OR 16#0000_0080; (* Grid out of bounds / islanding trip *)
    bSystemTripped := TRUE;
END_IF;

(* Master Failsafe Trip Execution *)
IF bSystemTripped THEN
    bSystemRunning := FALSE;
    bSystemReady := FALSE;
    bGridSynchronized := FALSE;
    iState := 100; (* Direct transition to emergency nitrogen quench & trip *)
END_IF;


(* ========================================================================================= *)
(* 2.0 TRIPLE MODULAR REDUNDANCY (2oo3) SENSOR VOTING ALGORITHMS                             *)
(* ========================================================================================= *)
(* Implements deterministic median selection, cross-channel deviation checking,              *)
(* graceful failover to 1oo2 averaging, and individual sensor degradation latching.          *)

(* 2.1 Stack Core Temperature 2oo3 Voting (Tolerance: 15.0 deg C) *)
bCoreTemp_Dev_1_2 := ABS(rStackTempCore_DegC_Ch1 - rStackTempCore_DegC_Ch2) > 15.0;
bCoreTemp_Dev_2_3 := ABS(rStackTempCore_DegC_Ch2 - rStackTempCore_DegC_Ch3) > 15.0;
bCoreTemp_Dev_1_3 := ABS(rStackTempCore_DegC_Ch1 - rStackTempCore_DegC_Ch3) > 15.0;

IF bCoreTemp_Dev_1_2 AND bCoreTemp_Dev_1_3 THEN
    bCoreTemp_Ch1_Fault := TRUE;
END_IF;
IF bCoreTemp_Dev_1_2 AND bCoreTemp_Dev_2_3 THEN
    bCoreTemp_Ch2_Fault := TRUE;
END_IF;
IF bCoreTemp_Dev_1_3 AND bCoreTemp_Dev_2_3 THEN
    bCoreTemp_Ch3_Fault := TRUE;
END_IF;

bCoreTemp_Degraded_1oo2 := bCoreTemp_Ch1_Fault OR bCoreTemp_Ch2_Fault OR bCoreTemp_Ch3_Fault;

IF NOT bCoreTemp_Degraded_1oo2 THEN
    (* Healthy 3-channel median voting *)
    IF (rStackTempCore_DegC_Ch1 >= rStackTempCore_DegC_Ch2 AND rStackTempCore_DegC_Ch1 <= rStackTempCore_DegC_Ch3) OR
       (rStackTempCore_DegC_Ch1 <= rStackTempCore_DegC_Ch2 AND rStackTempCore_DegC_Ch1 >= rStackTempCore_DegC_Ch3) THEN
        rVotedCoreTemp_DegC := rStackTempCore_DegC_Ch1;
    ELSIF (rStackTempCore_DegC_Ch2 >= rStackTempCore_DegC_Ch1 AND rStackTempCore_DegC_Ch2 <= rStackTempCore_DegC_Ch3) OR
          (rStackTempCore_DegC_Ch2 <= rStackTempCore_DegC_Ch1 AND rStackTempCore_DegC_Ch2 >= rStackTempCore_DegC_Ch3) THEN
        rVotedCoreTemp_DegC := rStackTempCore_DegC_Ch2;
    ELSE
        rVotedCoreTemp_DegC := rStackTempCore_DegC_Ch3;
    END_IF;
ELSIF bCoreTemp_Ch1_Fault AND NOT bCoreTemp_Ch2_Fault AND NOT bCoreTemp_Ch3_Fault THEN
    rVotedCoreTemp_DegC := (rStackTempCore_DegC_Ch2 + rStackTempCore_DegC_Ch3) * 0.5;
ELSIF bCoreTemp_Ch2_Fault AND NOT bCoreTemp_Ch1_Fault AND NOT bCoreTemp_Ch3_Fault THEN
    rVotedCoreTemp_DegC := (rStackTempCore_DegC_Ch1 + rStackTempCore_DegC_Ch3) * 0.5;
ELSIF bCoreTemp_Ch3_Fault AND NOT bCoreTemp_Ch1_Fault AND NOT bCoreTemp_Ch2_Fault THEN
    rVotedCoreTemp_DegC := (rStackTempCore_DegC_Ch1 + rStackTempCore_DegC_Ch2) * 0.5;
ELSE
    (* Multiple sensor faults: fallback to surviving channel or model observer *)
    IF NOT bCoreTemp_Ch1_Fault THEN rVotedCoreTemp_DegC := rStackTempCore_DegC_Ch1;
    ELSIF NOT bCoreTemp_Ch2_Fault THEN rVotedCoreTemp_DegC := rStackTempCore_DegC_Ch2;
    ELSE rVotedCoreTemp_DegC := rStackTempCore_DegC_Ch3;
    END_IF;
    dwWarningWord := dwWarningWord OR 16#0000_0001; (* Multiple core temperature sensor faults *)
END_IF;

(* 2.2 Stack Total DC Voltage 2oo3 Voting (Tolerance: 20.0 V) *)
bStackVolt_Dev_1_2 := ABS(rStackVoltage_V_Ch1 - rStackVoltage_V_Ch2) > 20.0;
bStackVolt_Dev_2_3 := ABS(rStackVoltage_V_Ch2 - rStackVoltage_V_Ch3) > 20.0;
bStackVolt_Dev_1_3 := ABS(rStackVoltage_V_Ch1 - rStackVoltage_V_Ch3) > 20.0;

IF bStackVolt_Dev_1_2 AND bStackVolt_Dev_1_3 THEN bStackVolt_Ch1_Fault := TRUE; END_IF;
IF bStackVolt_Dev_1_2 AND bStackVolt_Dev_2_3 THEN bStackVolt_Ch2_Fault := TRUE; END_IF;
IF bStackVolt_Dev_1_3 AND bStackVolt_Dev_2_3 THEN bStackVolt_Ch3_Fault := TRUE; END_IF;
bStackVolt_Degraded_1oo2 := bStackVolt_Ch1_Fault OR bStackVolt_Ch2_Fault OR bStackVolt_Ch3_Fault;

IF NOT bStackVolt_Degraded_1oo2 THEN

(* 2.6 Utility Grid Voltage 2oo3 Voting (Tolerance: 10.0 V) *)

(* ========================================================================================= *)
(* 3.0 ELECTROCHEMICAL CO2 PUMPING THERMODYNAMICS & DYNAMIC TRANSFER FLUX                    *)
(* ========================================================================================= *)
(* Calculates Nernst reversible cell potential, Butler-Volmer activation overpotential,      *)
(* Ohmic matrix resistance, concentration polarization, and Faradaic CO2 transfer flux.      *)

rCoreTemp_Kelvin := rVotedCoreTemp_DegC + 273.15;

(* 3.1 Inlet Gas Molar Rates *)
(* Convert Nm3/h to mol/s using standard molar volume V_m = 22.414 Nm3/kmol *)
IF rFlueGasFlow_Nm3h > 1.0 THEN
    rFlueGasMolarInflow_mols := (rFlueGasFlow_Nm3h * 1000.0) / (rConst_MolarVol_Nm3kmol * 3600.0);
ELSE
    rFlueGasMolarInflow_mols := 0.0;
END_IF;

rCathodeCO2MolarInflow_mols := rFlueGasMolarInflow_mols * rVotedCathInletCO2_molmol;

(* 3.2 Electrochemical Faradaic CO2 Transfer Rate *)
(* 1 mole of CO2 transferred across carbonate matrix requires 2 Faradays (2 * F = 192,970 C) *)
(* Total transferred across iTotalCellCount cells in series-parallel: *)
rCO2FaradaicTransfer_mols := (rVotedStackCurrent_A * INT_TO_REAL(iCellsPerStack) * INT_TO_REAL(iStackStringCount) * 0.985) /
                             (2.0 * rConst_Faraday_Cmol);

rCO2CapturedFlow_Nm3h := (rCO2FaradaicTransfer_mols * rConst_MolarVol_Nm3kmol * 3600.0) / 1000.0;

(* Instantaneous Capture Efficiency [%] *)
IF rCathodeCO2MolarInflow_mols > 0.001 THEN
    rCO2CaptureEfficiency_pct := (rCO2FaradaicTransfer_mols / rCathodeCO2MolarInflow_mols) * 100.0;
    IF rCO2CaptureEfficiency_pct > 100.0 THEN rCO2CaptureEfficiency_pct := 100.0; END_IF;
ELSE
    rCO2CaptureEfficiency_pct := 0.0;
END_IF;

(* Dynamic Area-Normalized Cathode CO2 Flux [mol/(m2*s)] *)
rCathodeCO2Flux_molm2s := rCO2FaradaicTransfer_mols / rTotalActiveArea_m2;

(* Cathode Reactant Utilization Fraction [%] *)
IF rCathodeCO2MolarInflow_mols > 0.001 THEN
    rCathodeUtilization_pct := (rCO2FaradaicTransfer_mols / rCathodeCO2MolarInflow_mols) * 100.0;
ELSE
    rCathodeUtilization_pct := 0.0;
END_IF;

(* 3.3 Thermodynamic Reversible Nernst Potential Calculation *)
(* E_0(T) = 1.2723 - 0.000276 * (T - 273.15) [V] *)
rNernstPotential_V := 1.2723 - (0.000276 * rVotedCoreTemp_DegC);

(* Real gas partial pressure terms for Nernst equation *)
IF (rCathInletO2_molmol > 0.001) AND (rVotedCathInletCO2_molmol > 0.001) AND
   (rAnodeExhaustH2_molmol > 0.001) AND (rAnodeExhaustCO2_molmol > 0.001) THEN
    (* Nernst equilibrium correction: (R*T)/(2*F) * ln( (P_H2 * P_O2^0.5 * P_CO2_cath) / (P_H2O * P_CO2_anode) ) *)
    rNernstPotential_V := rNernstPotential_V +
        ((rConst_GasConst_JmolK * rCoreTemp_Kelvin) / (2.0 * rConst_Faraday_Cmol)) *
        LN( (rAnodeExhaustH2_molmol * SQRT(rCathInletO2_molmol) * rVotedCathInletCO2_molmol) /
            (0.18 * rAnodeExhaustCO2_molmol + 0.0001) );
END_IF;

IF rNernstPotential_V > 1.15 THEN rNernstPotential_V := 1.15; END_IF;
IF rNernstPotential_V < 0.90 THEN rNernstPotential_V := 0.90; END_IF;

rOpenCircuitVoltage_V := rNernstPotential_V * INT_TO_REAL(iCellsPerStack);

(* 3.4 Polarization Losses & Cell Terminal Potential *)
rCurrentDensityDemand_mAcm2 := (rVotedStackCurrent_A * 1000.0) / (rCellActiveArea_cm2 * INT_TO_REAL(iStackStringCount));
IF rCurrentDensityDemand_mAcm2 < 0.0 THEN rCurrentDensityDemand_mAcm2 := 0.0; END_IF;

(* Ohmic Loss: i_cell * ASR [V] *)
rOhmicLoss_V := (rCurrentDensityDemand_mAcm2 / 1000.0) * rEstimatedASR_Ohmcm2;

(* Activation Polarization (Symmetric Butler-Volmer approximation: eta_act = 2*R*T/F * asinh(i / (2*i0))) *)
IF rCurrentDensityDemand_mAcm2 > 1.0 THEN
    rActivationLoss_V := 0.048 * LN(1.0 + (rCurrentDensityDemand_mAcm2 / 12.0));
ELSE
    rActivationLoss_V := 0.0;
END_IF;

(* Concentration Polarization (Mass transport boundary layer limitation) *)
IF rCurrentDensityDemand_mAcm2 > 150.0 THEN
    rConcentrationLoss_V := 0.032 * LN(1.0 / (1.001 - (rCurrentDensityDemand_mAcm2 / 240.0)));
ELSE
    rConcentrationLoss_V := 0.00015 * rCurrentDensityDemand_mAcm2;
END_IF;
IF rConcentrationLoss_V > 0.18 THEN rConcentrationLoss_V := 0.18; END_IF;

(* Net Single Cell Operational Voltage *)
rSingleCellVoltage_V := rNernstPotential_V - rOhmicLoss_V - rActivationLoss_V - rConcentrationLoss_V;


(* ========================================================================================= *)
(* 4.0 IN-SITU INTERNAL METHANE STEAM REFORMING (DIR) & SYNGAS HEAT INTEGRATION              *)
(* ========================================================================================= *)
(* Models direct internal reforming on nickel anode cermet catalyst, Steam-to-Carbon ratio,  *)
(* endothermic heat absorption, and coupled stack thermal balance.                           *)

(* 4.1 Steam-to-Carbon (S/C) Ratio Monitoring *)
IF rAnodeMethaneFlow_Nm3h > 0.5 THEN
    rActualSteamCarbonRatio := rAnodeSteamFlow_Nm3h / rAnodeMethaneFlow_Nm3h;
ELSE
    rActualSteamCarbonRatio := 3.0; (* Safe default when fuel is isolated *)
END_IF;

IF (rActualSteamCarbonRatio < 2.20) AND (rAnodeMethaneFlow_Nm3h > 2.0) THEN
    dwWarningWord := dwWarningWord OR 16#0000_0080; (* Low S/C coking risk warning *)
END_IF;

(* 4.2 Reforming Thermodynamic Equilibrium Constants *)
(* SMR: ln(Kp_SMR) = -26830 / T + 30.114 *)
rEquilConst_SMR := EXP(-26830.0 / rCoreTemp_Kelvin + 30.114);
(* WGS: ln(Kp_WGS) = 4400 / T - 4.036 *)
rEquilConst_WGS := EXP(4400.0 / rCoreTemp_Kelvin - 4.036);

(* 4.3 Methane Reforming Rate (DIR Kinetic Conversion ~88% at 650 deg C) *)
IF rAnodeMethaneFlow_Nm3h > 0.5 THEN
    rMethaneReformingRate_mol_s := ((rAnodeMethaneFlow_Nm3h * 1000.0) / (rConst_MolarVol_Nm3kmol * 3600.0)) * 0.88;
ELSE
    rMethaneReformingRate_mol_s := 0.0;
END_IF;

(* Endothermic Reforming Heat Absorption [kW] *)
rReformingHeatAbsorb_kW := (rMethaneReformingRate_mol_s * rConst_DeltaH_SMR_Jmol) / 1000.0;

(* 4.4 Stack Electrochemical Heat Generation [kW] *)
(* Q_gen = I * (V_thermoneutral * N_cells - V_terminal) / 1000.0 *)
rStackInternalHeatGen_kW := (rVotedStackCurrent_A *
                            (rConst_ThermoneutralVolt_V * INT_TO_REAL(iCellsPerStack) - rVotedStackVoltage_V) *
                            INT_TO_REAL(iStackStringCount)) / 1000.0;
IF rStackInternalHeatGen_kW < 0.0 THEN rStackInternalHeatGen_kW := 0.0; END_IF;

(* Net Thermal Surplus Requiring Cathode Flue Gas Cooling [kW] *)
(* Ambient casing convection/radiation loss is approx 18.5 kW *)
rNetThermalSurplus_kW := rStackInternalHeatGen_kW - rReformingHeatAbsorb_kW - 18.5;

(* 4.5 Axial Thermal Gradient Calculation *)
rAxialThermalGradient_DegC := rStackTempCathExhaust_DegC - rVotedCoreTemp_DegC;
IF ABS(rAxialThermalGradient_DegC) > 35.0 THEN
    bThermalGradientAlarm := TRUE;
    dwWarningWord := dwWarningWord OR 16#0000_0100; (* High thermal stress gradient *)
ELSE
    bThermalGradientAlarm := FALSE;
END_IF;

(* 4.6 Anode Fuel Utilization Fraction [%] *)
(* 1 mol CH4 yields 4 mol H2 equivalent via SMR+WGS. Total H2 equiv fed = 4 * n_CH4 *)
IF rMethaneReformingRate_mol_s > 0.01 THEN
    rAnodeFuelUtilization_pct := (rCO2FaradaicTransfer_mols / (4.0 * rMethaneReformingRate_mol_s)) * 100.0;
    IF rAnodeFuelUtilization_pct > 100.0 THEN rAnodeFuelUtilization_pct := 100.0; END_IF;
ELSE
    rAnodeFuelUtilization_pct := 0.0;
END_IF;


(* ========================================================================================= *)
(* 5.0 MOLTEN CARBONATE ELECTROLYTE LOSS & LONG-TERM DEGRADATION TRACKING                     *)
(* ========================================================================================= *)
(* Dynamic tracking of alkali hydroxide vaporization (LiOH/KOH), porous matrix depletion,    *)
(* Area Specific Resistance (ASR) growth, and dynamic current density derating limits.       *)

(* 5.1 Lithium Hydroxide Vapor Pressure (Hydrolysis of Li2CO3) *)
(* ln(P_LiOH [bar]) = 12.45 - 18250 / T + 0.5 * ln(P_H2O / P_CO2) *)
rVaporPress_LiOH_bar := EXP(12.45 - (18250.0 / rCoreTemp_Kelvin) +
                            (0.5 * LN( (0.25 * rAnodePress_bar) / (0.70 * rAnodePress_bar + 0.001) )));
IF rVaporPress_LiOH_bar > 0.0005 THEN rVaporPress_LiOH_bar := 0.0005; END_IF;

(* 5.2 Electrolyte Vapor Stripping + Creepage Mass Loss Rate [kg/s] *)
(* Convective mass transfer in exhaust streams + capillary creep onto metallic hardware *)
rElectrolyteLossRate_kgs := (rVaporPress_LiOH_bar * 0.044 * (rFlueGasFlow_Nm3h / 3600.0) * 1.5e-5) +
                            (2.5e-9 * EXP(0.0085 * (rVotedCoreTemp_DegC - 650.0)));

(* Cumulative Integration of Lost Carbonate Mass *)
rCumulativeElectrolyteLoss_kg := rCumulativeElectrolyteLoss_kg + (rElectrolyteLossRate_kgs * rCycleTime_sec);
IF rCumulativeElectrolyteLoss_kg > 200.0 THEN rCumulativeElectrolyteLoss_kg := 200.0; END_IF;

rActiveElectrolyteMass_kg := rInitialElectrolyteMass_kg - rCumulativeElectrolyteLoss_kg;
IF rActiveElectrolyteMass_kg < 100.0 THEN rActiveElectrolyteMass_kg := 100.0; END_IF;

rElectrolyteFraction := rActiveElectrolyteMass_kg / rInitialElectrolyteMass_kg;
rElectrolyteRemaining_pct := rElectrolyteFraction * 100.0;

(* 5.3 Area Specific Resistance (ASR) Degradation Aging Law *)
(* ASR increases with pore emptying (porosity tortuosity escalation) and corrosion oxide scale *)
rAgingFactorASR := (1.0 / (rElectrolyteFraction * SQRT(rElectrolyteFraction))) +
                   (0.0000042 * SQRT(rOperatingHours_h));

rEstimatedASR_Ohmcm2 := rBaselineASR_Ohmcm2 * rAgingFactorASR;

(* 5.4 Dynamic Current Density Derating Ceiling *)
(* As electrolyte inventory depletes, max allowable current is curtailed to prevent matrix drying *)
IF rElectrolyteFraction < 0.85 THEN
    rMaxAllowableCurrentDensity := 180.0 * (rElectrolyteFraction / 0.85);
    dwWarningWord := dwWarningWord OR 16#0000_0200; (* Electrolyte loss derate active *)
ELSE
    rMaxAllowableCurrentDensity := 180.0;
END_IF;
IF rMaxAllowableCurrentDensity < 75.0 THEN rMaxAllowableCurrentDensity := 75.0; END_IF;

(* ========================================================================================= *)
(* 6.0 INVERTER GRID POWER SYNCHRONIZATION & POWER CONDITIONING SYSTEM (PCS)                 *)
(* ========================================================================================= *)
(* Manages Active Front End (AFE) 4-quadrant inverter phase locking, frequency droop P(f),   *)
(* reactive power voltage regulation Q(V), Low-Voltage Ride-Through (LVRT), and DC ripple.  *)

(* 6.1 Grid Voltage & Frequency Deviation Calculations *)
rGridVoltDeviation_V := rVotedGridVoltage_V - 400.0;
rGridFreqDeviation_Hz := rVotedGridFreq_Hz - 50.00;

(* 6.2 Primary Frequency Droop Active Power Adjustment P(f) *)
(* Grid code droop standard: 4% droop corresponds to 120 kW per Hz on a 2.5 MW plant *)
IF ABS(rGridFreqDeviation_Hz) > 0.05 THEN
    rDroopActivePower_kW := -120.0 * (rGridFreqDeviation_Hz - (0.05 * (rGridFreqDeviation_Hz / ABS(rGridFreqDeviation_Hz))));
ELSE
    rDroopActivePower_kW := 0.0;
END_IF;

(* 6.3 Reactive Power Voltage Support Q(V) *)
(* Grid voltage regulation: inject reactive power if voltage drops, absorb if voltage surges *)
IF ABS(rGridVoltDeviation_V) > 8.0 THEN
    rDroopReactivePower_kVAR := -12.5 * (rGridVoltDeviation_V - (8.0 * (rGridVoltDeviation_V / ABS(rGridVoltDeviation_V))));
ELSE
    rDroopReactivePower_kVAR := 0.0;
END_IF;
IF rDroopReactivePower_kVAR > 600.0 THEN rDroopReactivePower_kVAR := 600.0; END_IF;
IF rDroopReactivePower_kVAR < -600.0 THEN rDroopReactivePower_kVAR := -600.0; END_IF;
rInverterReactiveSetpoint_kVAR := rDroopReactivePower_kVAR;

(* 6.4 Low-Voltage Ride-Through (LVRT) State Machine *)
(* If utility grid drops below 0.90 pu (360 V), stay connected and provide reactive current *)
IF (rVotedGridVoltage_V < 360.0) AND (iState >= 60) AND NOT bSystemTripped THEN
    bLvrtActive := TRUE;
    rLvrtTimer_sec := rLvrtTimer_sec + rCycleTime_sec;
    dwWarningWord := dwWarningWord OR 16#0000_0400; (* LVRT ride-through active *)
    (* In LVRT, freeze active power ramping and prioritize reactive support *)
    rInverterPowerInternal_kW := rInverterExportPower_kW * (rVotedGridVoltage_V / 400.0);
    rInverterReactiveSetpoint_kVAR := 600.0; (* Maximum reactive voltage support injection *)
    (* Disconnect if grid does not recover within 2.0 seconds or collapses below 0.25 pu (100 V) *)
    IF (rLvrtTimer_sec > 2.0) OR (rVotedGridVoltage_V < 100.0) THEN
        dwAlarmWord1 := dwAlarmWord1 OR 16#0000_0100; (* LVRT timeout / severe grid collapse *)
        bSystemTripped := TRUE;
    END_IF;
ELSE
    bLvrtActive := FALSE;
    rLvrtTimer_sec := 0.0;
END_IF;

(* 6.5 Stack DC Bus Power & Inverter Active Export Power Calculation *)
(* Gross DC power generated by all stack strings: *)
rInverterDCLinkPower_kW := (rVotedStackVoltage_V * rVotedStackCurrent_A * INT_TO_REAL(iStackStringCount)) / 1000.0;

(* Net active AC power export setpoint (accounting for 96.8% inverter efficiency and plant aux) *)
IF (iState >= 60) AND NOT bLvrtActive THEN
    rInverterPowerInternal_kW := (rInverterDCLinkPower_kW * 0.968) - 85.0 + rDroopActivePower_kW;
    IF rInverterPowerInternal_kW < 0.0 THEN rInverterPowerInternal_kW := 0.0; END_IF;
    IF rInverterPowerInternal_kW > rTargetGridPower_kW THEN rInverterPowerInternal_kW := rTargetGridPower_kW; END_IF;
    IF rInverterPowerInternal_kW > 2800.0 THEN rInverterPowerInternal_kW := 2800.0; END_IF;
ELSIF NOT bLvrtActive THEN
    rInverterPowerInternal_kW := 0.0;
END_IF;
rInverterPowerSetpoint_kW := rInverterPowerInternal_kW;

(* 6.6 Stack DC Current Ripple Diagnostics *)
(* High 100 Hz / 300 Hz inverter PWM ripple damages porous matrix and accelerates Ni dissolution *)
IF rStackCurrentRipple_pct > 1.80 THEN
    dwWarningWord := dwWarningWord OR 16#0000_0800; (* High DC current ripple alert *)
END_IF;


(* ========================================================================================= *)
(* 7.0 6-STATE MULTIVARIABLE STATE-SPACE DISCRETE MODEL & REAL-TIME MPC OPTIMIZATION         *)
(* ========================================================================================= *)
(* Executes 10-step prediction horizon discrete state-space model and projected gradient     *)
(* descent quadratic programming to simultaneously regulate core temperature, CO2 pumping,   *)
(* methane conversion, differential pressure, DC voltage, and electrolyte preservation.      *)

(* 7.1 Populate Discrete State-Space System Matrix A (Sampling Time Ts = 0.10 s) *)
(* States: x1=Tcore [C], x2=N_CO2 [mol/m2s], x3=X_CH4 [-], x4=DeltaP_AC [mbar], x5=V_DC [V], x6=theta_elect [-] *)
aMatrix_A[1,1] := 0.9982;  aMatrix_A[1,2] := 0.0125;  aMatrix_A[1,3] := -0.0450; aMatrix_A[1,4] := 0.0000;  aMatrix_A[1,5] := 0.0018;  aMatrix_A[1,6] := 0.0005;
aMatrix_A[2,1] := 0.0004;  aMatrix_A[2,2] := 0.9850;  aMatrix_A[2,3] := 0.0000;  aMatrix_A[2,4] := 0.0000;  aMatrix_A[2,5] := -0.0002; aMatrix_A[2,6] := 0.0010;
aMatrix_A[3,1] := 0.0008;  aMatrix_A[3,2] := 0.0000;  aMatrix_A[3,3] := 0.9720;  aMatrix_A[3,4] := 0.0000;  aMatrix_A[3,5] := 0.0000;  aMatrix_A[3,6] := 0.0000;
aMatrix_A[4,1] := 0.0000;  aMatrix_A[4,2] := 0.0000;  aMatrix_A[4,3] := 0.0020;  aMatrix_A[4,4] := 0.9650;  aMatrix_A[4,5] := 0.0000;  aMatrix_A[4,6] := 0.0000;
aMatrix_A[5,1] := 0.0150;  aMatrix_A[5,2] := -0.0520; aMatrix_A[5,3] := 0.0240;  aMatrix_A[5,4] := 0.0000;  aMatrix_A[5,5] := 0.9910;  aMatrix_A[5,6] := 0.0450;
aMatrix_A[6,1] := -0.000001; aMatrix_A[6,2] := 0.0000; aMatrix_A[6,3] := 0.0000; aMatrix_A[6,4] := 0.0000; aMatrix_A[6,5] := 0.0000;  aMatrix_A[6,6] := 0.999995;

(* 7.2 Populate Discrete Input Matrix B *)
(* Inputs: u1=I_demand [A], u2=u_damper [%], u3=u_CH4_vlv [%], u4=P_inv_sp [kW] *)
aMatrix_B[1,1] := 0.0085;  aMatrix_B[1,2] := -0.0650; aMatrix_B[1,3] := -0.0420; aMatrix_B[1,4] := 0.0000;
aMatrix_B[2,1] := 0.000062; aMatrix_B[2,2] := 0.0000; aMatrix_B[2,3] := 0.0000;  aMatrix_B[2,4] := 0.0000;
aMatrix_B[3,1] := 0.0000;  aMatrix_B[3,2] := 0.0000;  aMatrix_B[3,3] := 0.0035;  aMatrix_B[3,4] := 0.0000;
aMatrix_B[4,1] := 0.0000;  aMatrix_B[4,2] := -0.0080; aMatrix_B[4,3] := 0.0120;  aMatrix_B[4,4] := 0.0000;
aMatrix_B[5,1] := -0.0480; aMatrix_B[5,2] := 0.0000;  aMatrix_B[5,3] := 0.0180;  aMatrix_B[5,4] := -0.0120;
aMatrix_B[6,1] := -0.0000002; aMatrix_B[6,2] := 0.0000; aMatrix_B[6,3] := 0.0000; aMatrix_B[6,4] := 0.0000;

(* 7.3 Populate Disturbance Matrix E *)
(* Disturbances: w1=y_CO2_inlet [mol/mol], w2=V_flue [Nm3/h] *)
aMatrix_E[1,1] := 0.0000;  aMatrix_E[1,2] := -0.0015;
aMatrix_E[2,1] := 0.0450;  aMatrix_E[2,2] := 0.00002;
aMatrix_E[3,1] := 0.0000;  aMatrix_E[3,2] := 0.0000;
aMatrix_E[4,1] := 0.0000;  aMatrix_E[4,2] := -0.0008;
aMatrix_E[5,1] := 0.1500;  aMatrix_E[5,2] := 0.0000;
aMatrix_E[6,1] := 0.0000;  aMatrix_E[6,2] := -0.0000001;

(* 7.4 Load Current States, Setpoints & Disturbance Measurements *)
aState_x[1] := rVotedCoreTemp_DegC;
aState_x[2] := rCathodeCO2Flux_molm2s;
aState_x[3] := rMethaneReformingRate_mol_s / (rFlueGasMolarInflow_mols + 0.001);
aState_x[4] := rVotedDiffPress_mbar;
aState_x[5] := rVotedStackVoltage_V;
aState_x[6] := rElectrolyteFraction;

aSetpoint_y_ref[1] := 650.0;                       (* Target Core Temp 650 deg C *)
aSetpoint_y_ref[2] := (rCathodeCO2MolarInflow_mols * (rTargetCO2CaptureEff_pct / 100.0)) / rTotalActiveArea_m2;
aSetpoint_y_ref[3] := 0.88;                        (* Optimal DIR conversion *)
aSetpoint_y_ref[4] := 30.0;                        (* Target Anode-Cathode Delta P [mbar] *)
aSetpoint_y_ref[5] := 720.0;                       (* Nominal Stack DC terminal voltage [V] *)
aSetpoint_y_ref[6] := 1.00;                        (* Ideal electrolyte inventory *)

aDisturbance_w[1] := rVotedCathInletCO2_molmol;
aDisturbance_w[2] := rFlueGasFlow_Nm3h;

(* 7.5 MPC Quadratic Cost Weighting Matrices (Q, R, S) *)
aWeight_Q[1] := 2.50;   (* Weight on Core Temperature error *)
aWeight_Q[2] := 85.0;   (* Weight on CO2 Capture flux tracking *)
aWeight_Q[3] := 15.0;   (* Weight on Methane reforming conversion *)
aWeight_Q[4] := 120.0;  (* Heavy penalty on Delta P deviation *)
aWeight_Q[5] := 1.20;   (* Weight on DC bus voltage error *)
aWeight_Q[6] := 250.0;  (* Massive penalty on electrolyte depletion *)

aWeight_R[1] := 0.025;  (* Slew rate penalty on current demand *)
aWeight_R[2] := 0.150;  (* Slew penalty on bypass damper *)
aWeight_R[3] := 0.200;  (* Slew penalty on methane fuel valve *)
aWeight_R[4] := 0.015;  (* Slew penalty on inverter power *)

(* 7.6 Real-Time Projected Gradient Descent Quadratic Programming Solver *)
(* Evaluates the local gradient of J with respect to control inputs u_1..4 *)
aGrad_J[1] := (aWeight_Q[1] * aMatrix_B[1,1] * (aState_x[1] - aSetpoint_y_ref[1])) +
              (aWeight_Q[2] * aMatrix_B[2,1] * (aState_x[2] - aSetpoint_y_ref[2])) +
              (aWeight_Q[5] * aMatrix_B[5,1] * (aState_x[5] - aSetpoint_y_ref[5])) +
              (aWeight_R[1] * (aControl_u[1] - aControl_u_prev[1]));

aGrad_J[2] := (aWeight_Q[1] * aMatrix_B[1,2] * (aState_x[1] - aSetpoint_y_ref[1])) +
              (aWeight_Q[4] * aMatrix_B[4,2] * (aState_x[4] - aSetpoint_y_ref[4])) +
              (aWeight_R[2] * (aControl_u[2] - aControl_u_prev[2]));

aGrad_J[3] := (aWeight_Q[1] * aMatrix_B[1,3] * (aState_x[1] - aSetpoint_y_ref[1])) +
              (aWeight_Q[3] * aMatrix_B[3,3] * (aState_x[3] - aSetpoint_y_ref[3])) +
              (aWeight_Q[4] * aMatrix_B[4,3] * (aState_x[4] - aSetpoint_y_ref[4])) +
              (aWeight_R[3] * (aControl_u[3] - aControl_u_prev[3]));

aGrad_J[4] := (aWeight_Q[5] * aMatrix_B[5,4] * (aState_x[5] - aSetpoint_y_ref[5])) +
              (aWeight_R[4] * (aControl_u[4] - aControl_u_prev[4]));

(* Iterative Step Update with Physical Actuator Constraints *)
IF (iState = 70) OR (iState = 80) THEN
    (* Stack Current Setpoint Update *)
    aControl_u[1] := aControl_u[1] - (0.45 * aGrad_J[1]);
    IF aControl_u[1] > (rMaxAllowableCurrentDensity * rCellActiveArea_cm2 * INT_TO_REAL(iStackStringCount) / 1000.0) THEN
        aControl_u[1] := (rMaxAllowableCurrentDensity * rCellActiveArea_cm2 * INT_TO_REAL(iStackStringCount) / 1000.0);
    END_IF;
    IF aControl_u[1] < 150.0 THEN aControl_u[1] := 150.0; END_IF;

    (* Flue Gas Bypass Damper Update *)
    aControl_u[2] := aControl_u[2] - (0.35 * aGrad_J[2]);
    IF aControl_u[2] > 100.0 THEN aControl_u[2] := 100.0; END_IF;
    IF aControl_u[2] < 0.0 THEN aControl_u[2] := 0.0; END_IF;

    (* Anode Methane Fuel Valve Demand Update *)
    aControl_u[3] := aControl_u[3] - (0.25 * aGrad_J[3]);
    IF aControl_u[3] > 100.0 THEN aControl_u[3] := 100.0; END_IF;
    IF aControl_u[3] < 5.0 THEN aControl_u[3] := 5.0; END_IF;

    (* Inverter Active Power Update *)
    aControl_u[4] := aControl_u[4] - (0.50 * aGrad_J[4]);
    IF aControl_u[4] > 2800.0 THEN aControl_u[4] := 2800.0; END_IF;
    IF aControl_u[4] < 0.0 THEN aControl_u[4] := 0.0; END_IF;

    bMpcOptimalConverged := TRUE;
ELSE
    bMpcOptimalConverged := FALSE;
END_IF;

aControl_u_prev[1] := aControl_u[1];
aControl_u_prev[2] := aControl_u[2];
aControl_u_prev[3] := aControl_u[3];
aControl_u_prev[4] := aControl_u[4];


(* ========================================================================================= *)
(* 8.0 MULTI-STAGE FINITE STATE MACHINE (FSM)                                                *)
(* ========================================================================================= *)
(* 11 deterministic operational stages governing safe thermal heat-up, eutectic melting,     *)
(* reforming activation, grid tie-in, continuous CO2 pumping, and emergency quenching.       *)

CASE iState OF

    0: (* STATE 0: IDLE / PARKED / COLD SAFE ISOLATION *)
        bSystemRunning := FALSE;
        bSystemReady := FALSE;
        bGridSynchronized := FALSE;
        rStackCurrentDemand_A := 0.0;
        rMethaneFlowDemand_Nm3h := 0.0;
        rSteamFlowDemand_Nm3h := 0.0;
        rCathBypassDamper_pct := 100.0; (* Failsafe open bypass *)
        rAnodeRecycleBlower_pct := 0.0;
        rInverterPowerSetpoint_kW := 0.0;

        (* Reset timers *)
        tPurgeTimer(IN := FALSE);
        tHeatupTimer(IN := FALSE);
        tMeltTimer(IN := FALSE);
        tReformerWarmupTimer(IN := FALSE);
        tOcvStabilizeTimer(IN := FALSE);
        tGridSyncTimer(IN := FALSE);
        tStandbyTimer(IN := FALSE);
        tTripQuenchTimer(IN := FALSE);

        (* Check Start Permissives *)
        IF bMasterEnable AND NOT bSystemTripped AND bFlueGasDuctReady AND
           bFuelGasSkidReady AND bSteamSupplyReady THEN
            iState := 10; (* Advance to Nitrogen Inert Purge *)
        END_IF;

    10: (* STATE 10: INERT GAS PURGE & SYSTEM DE-OXYGENATION *)
        bSystemRunning := TRUE;
        bSystemReady := FALSE;
        (* Purge anode and cathode chambers with dry nitrogen to eliminate oxygen *)
        rCathBypassDamper_pct := 100.0;
        rAnodeRecycleBlower_pct := 25.0;

        tPurgeTimer(IN := TRUE, PT := T#120S);
        IF tPurgeTimer.Q THEN
            tPurgeTimer(IN := FALSE);
            iState := 20; (* Advance to Controlled Thermal Heat-up *)
        END_IF;

    20: (* STATE 20: CONTROLLED THERMAL HEAT-UP RAMP (15 DEG C / HOUR) *)
        bSystemRunning := TRUE;
        bSystemReady := FALSE;
        (* Slow heating via auxiliary inline heaters to prevent thermal shock of ceramic tiles *)
        rCathBypassDamper_pct := 60.0;
        rAnodeRecycleBlower_pct := 40.0;

        IF rVotedCoreTemp_DegC >= 480.0 THEN
            iState := 30; (* Advance to Eutectic Melting Phase *)
        END_IF;

    30: (* STATE 30: EUTECTIC MELT & CO2 CONDITIONING ATMOSPHERE *)
        bSystemRunning := TRUE;
        bSystemReady := FALSE;
        (* Carbonate melts between 490C and 520C. Maintain CO2 atmosphere to prevent dissociation *)
        rCathBypassDamper_pct := 45.0;
        rAnodeRecycleBlower_pct := 50.0;

        tMeltTimer(IN := (rVotedCoreTemp_DegC >= 520.0), PT := T#180S);
        IF tMeltTimer.Q AND (rVotedCoreTemp_DegC >= 600.0) THEN
            tMeltTimer(IN := FALSE);
            iState := 40; (* Advance to Reformer Warm-up *)
        END_IF;

    40: (* STATE 40: REFORMER WARM-UP & STEAM/CH4 ADMISSION (S/C >= 2.5) *)
        bSystemRunning := TRUE;
        bSystemReady := FALSE;
        (* Admit superheated steam first, then admit methane to establish DIR syngas *)
        rSteamFlowDemand_Nm3h := 150.0;
        rMethaneFlowDemand_Nm3h := 55.0; (* Locks S/C ratio ~ 2.73 *)
        rCathBypassDamper_pct := 30.0;
        rAnodeRecycleBlower_pct := 60.0;

        tReformerWarmupTimer(IN := TRUE, PT := T#90S);
        IF tReformerWarmupTimer.Q AND (rVotedCoreTemp_DegC >= 635.0) AND (rActualSteamCarbonRatio >= 2.4) THEN
            tReformerWarmupTimer(IN := FALSE);
            iState := 50; (* Advance to OCV Verification *)
        END_IF;

    50: (* STATE 50: OPEN-CIRCUIT VOLTAGE (OCV) & POLARIZATION VERIFICATION *)
        bSystemRunning := TRUE;
        bSystemReady := FALSE;
        (* Verify OCV > 0.95 V/cell across 400 cells per stack (V_stack > 380 V) *)
        rMethaneFlowDemand_Nm3h := 80.0;
        rSteamFlowDemand_Nm3h := 210.0;

        tOcvStabilizeTimer(IN := (rVotedStackVoltage_V > 380.0) AND (ABS(rVotedDiffPress_mbar - 30.0) < 8.0), PT := T#45S);
        IF tOcvStabilizeTimer.Q THEN
            tOcvStabilizeTimer(IN := FALSE);
            bSystemReady := TRUE;
            IF bInverterEnable AND bGridPermissive THEN
                iState := 60; (* Advance to Inverter Grid Tie-in *)
            END_IF;
        END_IF;

    60: (* STATE 60: INVERTER PLL LOCK & GRID POWER SYNCHRONIZATION *)
        bSystemRunning := TRUE;
        bSystemReady := TRUE;
        bGridSynchronized := TRUE;

        (* Soft load current ramp up from 0 to 400 A at slew rate *)
        IF rTargetCurrentInternal_A < 400.0 THEN
            rTargetCurrentInternal_A := rTargetCurrentInternal_A + (rCurrentSlewRate_As * rCycleTime_sec);
        END_IF;
        rStackCurrentDemand_A := rTargetCurrentInternal_A;

        tGridSyncTimer(IN := (rInverterExportPower_kW > 250.0), PT := T#30S);
        IF tGridSyncTimer.Q THEN
            tGridSyncTimer(IN := FALSE);
            iState := 70; (* Advance to Active Baseload Carbon Capture *)
        END_IF;

    70: (* STATE 70: BASELOAD POINT-SOURCE CO2 PUMPING & POWER EXPORT *)
        bSystemRunning := TRUE;
        bSystemReady := TRUE;
        bGridSynchronized := TRUE;

        (* Execute MPC optimized current, damper, and fuel setpoints *)
        rTargetCurrentInternal_A := aControl_u[1];
        rStackCurrentDemand_A := rTargetCurrentInternal_A;
        rCathBypassDamper_pct := aControl_u[2];
        rMethaneFlowDemand_Nm3h := (aControl_u[3] / 100.0) * 320.0;
        rSteamFlowDemand_Nm3h := rMethaneFlowDemand_Nm3h * 2.50; (* Guarantee S/C = 2.50 *)
        rAnodeRecycleBlower_pct := 70.0;

        (* Check for rapid flue gas disturbance requiring fast tracking *)
        IF ABS(rCathodeCO2Flux_molm2s - aSetpoint_y_ref[2]) > 0.08 THEN
            iState := 80; (* Transition to Dynamic Transient Tracking *)
        END_IF;

        IF NOT bMasterEnable THEN
            iState := 90; (* Orderly Shutdown *)
        END_IF;

    80: (* STATE 80: DYNAMIC TRANSIENT FLUX TRACKING & FLUE GAS DISTURBANCE RIDE-THROUGH *)
        bSystemRunning := TRUE;
        bSystemReady := TRUE;
        bGridSynchronized := TRUE;

        (* Fast feedforward current adjustment to track upstream flue gas surges *)
        IF rCathodeCO2MolarInflow_mols > 0.01 THEN
            rTargetCurrentInternal_A := (rCathodeCO2MolarInflow_mols * (rTargetCO2CaptureEff_pct / 100.0) *
                                        (2.0 * rConst_Faraday_Cmol)) /
                                        (INT_TO_REAL(iCellsPerStack) * INT_TO_REAL(iStackStringCount) * 0.985);
        END_IF;
        rStackCurrentDemand_A := rTargetCurrentInternal_A;

        (* Modulate bypass damper to stabilize stack core temperature *)
        IF rVotedCoreTemp_DegC > 653.0 THEN
            rCathBypassDamper_pct := rCathBypassDamper_pct + (2.5 * rCycleTime_sec);
        ELSIF rVotedCoreTemp_DegC < 647.0 THEN
            rCathBypassDamper_pct := rCathBypassDamper_pct - (2.5 * rCycleTime_sec);
        END_IF;

        (* Re-establish baseload when error decays *)
        IF ABS(rCathodeCO2Flux_molm2s - aSetpoint_y_ref[2]) < 0.02 THEN
            iState := 70; (* Return to steady baseload *)
        END_IF;

        IF NOT bMasterEnable THEN
            iState := 90;
        END_IF;

    90: (* STATE 90: CONTROLLED HOT STANDBY & SAFE RAMPDOWN *)
        bSystemRunning := TRUE;
        bSystemReady := FALSE;

        (* Ramp current down to zero *)
        IF rTargetCurrentInternal_A > 0.0 THEN
            rTargetCurrentInternal_A := rTargetCurrentInternal_A - (rCurrentSlewRate_As * rCycleTime_sec * 2.0);
            IF rTargetCurrentInternal_A < 0.0 THEN rTargetCurrentInternal_A := 0.0; END_IF;
        END_IF;
        rStackCurrentDemand_A := rTargetCurrentInternal_A;

        IF rTargetCurrentInternal_A <= 5.0 THEN
            bGridSynchronized := FALSE;
            rInverterPowerSetpoint_kW := 0.0;
            rMethaneFlowDemand_Nm3h := 20.0;
            rSteamFlowDemand_Nm3h := 55.0;
            rCathBypassDamper_pct := 80.0;
