(* ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* 1.0 SIL-3 HARDWIRED EMERGENCY STOP & MASTER SAFETY INTERLOCKS                                     *)
(* Dual-channel hardware loop open forces immediate, deterministic failsafe shutdown to safe state. *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
IF NOT bEmergencyStop THEN
    bSystemRunning := FALSE;
    bSystemReady := FALSE;
    bSystemTrip := TRUE;
    bTubeGateValveOpenDemand := FALSE;
    rRootsBlowerSpeedDemand := 0.0;
    rTurbomolecularSpeedDemand := 0.0;
    rEqualizationValveDemand := 0.0;
    rAcousticBaffleLinearStroke := 0.0;
    (* Maintain seal pressure in emergency to prevent massive tube venting *)
    IF rVotedSealPress_Internal < c_rSealMinSeatingPressure THEN
        rSealPressureSetpoint := c_rSealTargetNominalPressure;
    END_IF;
    dwAlarmWord_1 := dwAlarmWord_1 OR 16#0000_0001; (* Bit 0: Hardware E-Stop Loop Tripped *)
    iCurrentState := 90; (* Force Transition to Failsafe Emergency Abort State *)
    iState := 90;
    RETURN;
END_IF;

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* 2.0 TRIPLE MODULAR REDUNDANCY (2oo3) SENSOR VOTING & HEALTH DIAGNOSTICS                            *)
(* Median Value Selection (MVS) algorithm with channel drift deviation detection and 1oo2 fallback.  *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)

(* --- 2.1 Airlock Chamber Static Pressure 2oo3 Voting --- *)
bAirlock_A_Valid := (rAirlockPressure_A >= 0.1) AND (rAirlockPressure_A <= 125000.0);
bAirlock_B_Valid := (rAirlockPressure_B >= 0.1) AND (rAirlockPressure_B <= 125000.0);
bAirlock_C_Valid := (rAirlockPressure_C >= 0.1) AND (rAirlockPressure_C <= 125000.0);

IF bAirlock_A_Valid AND bAirlock_B_Valid AND bAirlock_C_Valid THEN
    (* All 3 channels within physical limits: compute median *)
    IF (rAirlockPressure_A >= rAirlockPressure_B AND rAirlockPressure_A <= rAirlockPressure_C) OR
       (rAirlockPressure_A >= rAirlockPressure_C AND rAirlockPressure_A <= rAirlockPressure_B) THEN
        rVotedAirlockPress_Internal := rAirlockPressure_A;
    ELSIF (rAirlockPressure_B >= rAirlockPressure_A AND rAirlockPressure_B <= rAirlockPressure_C) OR
          (rAirlockPressure_B >= rAirlockPressure_C AND rAirlockPressure_B <= rAirlockPressure_A) THEN
        rVotedAirlockPress_Internal := rAirlockPressure_B;
    ELSE
        rVotedAirlockPress_Internal := rAirlockPressure_C;
    END_IF;
    bAirlock_Degraded_1oo2 := FALSE;

    (* Check for sensor calibration drift between healthy channels *)
    IF (ABS(rAirlockPressure_A - rAirlockPressure_B) > c_rAirlockPressDevLimit) OR
       (ABS(rAirlockPressure_B - rAirlockPressure_C) > c_rAirlockPressDevLimit) OR
       (ABS(rAirlockPressure_C - rAirlockPressure_A) > c_rAirlockPressDevLimit) THEN
        dwAlarmWord_2 := dwAlarmWord_2 OR 16#0000_0001; (* Airlock Pressure Sensor Drift Warning *)
    END_IF;
ELSIF bAirlock_A_Valid AND bAirlock_B_Valid THEN
    rVotedAirlockPress_Internal := (rAirlockPressure_A + rAirlockPressure_B) * 0.5;
    bAirlock_Degraded_1oo2 := TRUE;
    dwAlarmWord_2 := dwAlarmWord_2 OR 16#0000_0002; (* Channel C Airlock Pressure Fault *)
ELSIF bAirlock_B_Valid AND bAirlock_C_Valid THEN
    rVotedAirlockPress_Internal := (rAirlockPressure_B + rAirlockPressure_C) * 0.5;
    bAirlock_Degraded_1oo2 := TRUE;
    dwAlarmWord_2 := dwAlarmWord_2 OR 16#0000_0004; (* Channel A Airlock Pressure Fault *)
ELSIF bAirlock_A_Valid AND bAirlock_C_Valid THEN
    rVotedAirlockPress_Internal := (rAirlockPressure_A + rAirlockPressure_C) * 0.5;
    bAirlock_Degraded_1oo2 := TRUE;
    dwAlarmWord_2 := dwAlarmWord_2 OR 16#0000_0008; (* Channel B Airlock Pressure Fault *)
ELSE
    (* Multiple sensor failure: Catastrophic loss of chamber pressure telemetry *)
    bSystemTrip := TRUE;
    dwAlarmWord_1 := dwAlarmWord_1 OR 16#0000_0002; (* Critical Airlock Pressure TMR Breakdown *)
END_IF;
rVotedAirlockPressure := rVotedAirlockPress_Internal;

(* --- 2.2 Guideway Tube Static Pressure 2oo3 Voting --- *)
bTube_A_Valid := (rTubeStaticPressure_A >= 0.1) AND (rTubeStaticPressure_A <= 1500.0);
bTube_B_Valid := (rTubeStaticPressure_B >= 0.1) AND (rTubeStaticPressure_B <= 1500.0);
bTube_C_Valid := (rTubeStaticPressure_C >= 0.1) AND (rTubeStaticPressure_C <= 1500.0);

IF bTube_A_Valid AND bTube_B_Valid AND bTube_C_Valid THEN
    IF (rTubeStaticPressure_A >= rTubeStaticPressure_B AND rTubeStaticPressure_A <= rTubeStaticPressure_C) OR
       (rTubeStaticPressure_A >= rTubeStaticPressure_C AND rTubeStaticPressure_A <= rTubeStaticPressure_B) THEN
        rVotedTubePress_Internal := rTubeStaticPressure_A;
    ELSIF (rTubeStaticPressure_B >= rTubeStaticPressure_A AND rTubeStaticPressure_B <= rTubeStaticPressure_C) OR
          (rTubeStaticPressure_B >= rTubeStaticPressure_C AND rTubeStaticPressure_B <= rTubeStaticPressure_A) THEN
        rVotedTubePress_Internal := rTubeStaticPressure_B;
    ELSE
        rVotedTubePress_Internal := rTubeStaticPressure_C;
    END_IF;
    bTube_Degraded_1oo2 := FALSE;
    IF (ABS(rTubeStaticPressure_A - rTubeStaticPressure_B) > c_rTubePressDevLimit) OR
       (ABS(rTubeStaticPressure_B - rTubeStaticPressure_C) > c_rTubePressDevLimit) OR
       (ABS(rTubeStaticPressure_C - rTubeStaticPressure_A) > c_rTubePressDevLimit) THEN
        dwAlarmWord_2 := dwAlarmWord_2 OR 16#0000_0010; (* Tube Pressure Sensor Drift Warning *)
    END_IF;
ELSIF bTube_A_Valid AND bTube_B_Valid THEN
    rVotedTubePress_Internal := (rTubeStaticPressure_A + rTubeStaticPressure_B) * 0.5;
    bTube_Degraded_1oo2 := TRUE;
    dwAlarmWord_2 := dwAlarmWord_2 OR 16#0000_0020;
ELSIF bTube_B_Valid AND bTube_C_Valid THEN
    rVotedTubePress_Internal := (rTubeStaticPressure_B + rTubeStaticPressure_C) * 0.5;
    bTube_Degraded_1oo2 := TRUE;
    dwAlarmWord_2 := dwAlarmWord_2 OR 16#0000_0040;
ELSIF bTube_A_Valid AND bTube_C_Valid THEN
    rVotedTubePress_Internal := (rTubeStaticPressure_A + rTubeStaticPressure_C) * 0.5;
    bTube_Degraded_1oo2 := TRUE;
    dwAlarmWord_2 := dwAlarmWord_2 OR 16#0000_0080;
ELSE
    bSystemTrip := TRUE;
    dwAlarmWord_1 := dwAlarmWord_1 OR 16#0000_0004; (* Critical Tube Pressure TMR Breakdown *)
END_IF;
rVotedTubePressure := rVotedTubePress_Internal;

(* --- 2.3 Seal Pneumatic Inflation Pressure 2oo3 Voting --- *)
bSealP_A_Valid := (rSealInflationPressure_A >= -0.5) AND (rSealInflationPressure_A <= 12.0);
bSealP_B_Valid := (rSealInflationPressure_B >= -0.5) AND (rSealInflationPressure_B <= 12.0);
bSealP_C_Valid := (rSealInflationPressure_C >= -0.5) AND (rSealInflationPressure_C <= 12.0);

IF bSealP_A_Valid AND bSealP_B_Valid AND bSealP_C_Valid THEN
    IF (rSealInflationPressure_A >= rSealInflationPressure_B AND rSealInflationPressure_A <= rSealInflationPressure_C) OR
       (rSealInflationPressure_A >= rSealInflationPressure_C AND rSealInflationPressure_A <= rSealInflationPressure_B) THEN
        rVotedSealPress_Internal := rSealInflationPressure_A;
    ELSIF (rSealInflationPressure_B >= rSealInflationPressure_A AND rSealInflationPressure_B <= rSealInflationPressure_C) OR
          (rSealInflationPressure_B >= rSealInflationPressure_C AND rSealInflationPressure_B <= rSealInflationPressure_A) THEN
        rVotedSealPress_Internal := rSealInflationPressure_B;
    ELSE
        rVotedSealPress_Internal := rSealInflationPressure_C;
    END_IF;
    bSealP_Degraded_1oo2 := FALSE;
    IF (ABS(rSealInflationPressure_A - rSealInflationPressure_B) > c_rSealPressDevLimit) OR
       (ABS(rSealInflationPressure_B - rSealInflationPressure_C) > c_rSealPressDevLimit) OR
       (ABS(rSealInflationPressure_C - rSealInflationPressure_A) > c_rSealPressDevLimit) THEN
        dwAlarmWord_2 := dwAlarmWord_2 OR 16#0000_0100; (* Seal Pressure Drift *)
    END_IF;
ELSIF bSealP_A_Valid AND bSealP_B_Valid THEN
    rVotedSealPress_Internal := (rSealInflationPressure_A + rSealInflationPressure_B) * 0.5;
    bSealP_Degraded_1oo2 := TRUE;
    dwAlarmWord_2 := dwAlarmWord_2 OR 16#0000_0200;
ELSIF bSealP_B_Valid AND bSealP_C_Valid THEN
    rVotedSealPress_Internal := (rSealInflationPressure_B + rSealInflationPressure_C) * 0.5;
    bSealP_Degraded_1oo2 := TRUE;
    dwAlarmWord_2 := dwAlarmWord_2 OR 16#0000_0400;
ELSIF bSealP_A_Valid AND bSealP_C_Valid THEN
    rVotedSealPress_Internal := (rSealInflationPressure_A + rSealInflationPressure_C) * 0.5;
    bSealP_Degraded_1oo2 := TRUE;
    dwAlarmWord_2 := dwAlarmWord_2 OR 16#0000_0800;
ELSE
    bSystemTrip := TRUE;
    dwAlarmWord_1 := dwAlarmWord_1 OR 16#0000_0008; (* Critical Seal Pressure TMR Failure *)
END_IF;

(* --- 2.4 Seal Flange Gap Displacement 2oo3 Voting --- *)
bSealG_A_Valid := (rSealCompressionGap_A >= 0.0) AND (rSealCompressionGap_A <= 40.0);
bSealG_B_Valid := (rSealCompressionGap_B >= 0.0) AND (rSealCompressionGap_B <= 40.0);
bSealG_C_Valid := (rSealCompressionGap_C >= 0.0) AND (rSealCompressionGap_C <= 40.0);

IF bSealG_A_Valid AND bSealG_B_Valid AND bSealG_C_Valid THEN
    IF (rSealCompressionGap_A >= rSealCompressionGap_B AND rSealCompressionGap_A <= rSealCompressionGap_C) OR
       (rSealCompressionGap_A >= rSealCompressionGap_C AND rSealCompressionGap_A <= rSealCompressionGap_B) THEN
        rVotedSealGap_Internal := rSealCompressionGap_A;
    ELSIF (rSealCompressionGap_B >= rSealCompressionGap_A AND rSealCompressionGap_B <= rSealCompressionGap_C) OR
          (rSealCompressionGap_B >= rSealCompressionGap_C AND rSealCompressionGap_B <= rSealCompressionGap_A) THEN
        rVotedSealGap_Internal := rSealCompressionGap_B;
    ELSE
        rVotedSealGap_Internal := rSealCompressionGap_C;
    END_IF;
    bSealG_Degraded_1oo2 := FALSE;
ELSIF bSealG_A_Valid AND bSealG_B_Valid THEN
    rVotedSealGap_Internal := (rSealCompressionGap_A + rSealCompressionGap_B) * 0.5;
    bSealG_Degraded_1oo2 := TRUE;
    dwAlarmWord_2 := dwAlarmWord_2 OR 16#0000_1000;
ELSIF bSealG_B_Valid AND bSealG_C_Valid THEN
    rVotedSealGap_Internal := (rSealCompressionGap_B + rSealCompressionGap_C) * 0.5;
    bSealG_Degraded_1oo2 := TRUE;
    dwAlarmWord_2 := dwAlarmWord_2 OR 16#0000_2000;
ELSIF bSealG_A_Valid AND bSealG_C_Valid THEN
    rVotedSealGap_Internal := (rSealCompressionGap_A + rSealCompressionGap_C) * 0.5;
    bSealG_Degraded_1oo2 := TRUE;
    dwAlarmWord_2 := dwAlarmWord_2 OR 16#0000_4000;
ELSE
    bSystemTrip := TRUE;
    dwAlarmWord_1 := dwAlarmWord_1 OR 16#0000_0010; (* Critical Seal Gap LVDT TMR Failure *)
END_IF;

bDegradedControlMode := bAirlock_Degraded_1oo2 OR bTube_Degraded_1oo2 OR bSealP_Degraded_1oo2 OR bSealG_Degraded_1oo2;

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* 3.0 NON-LINEAR VISCOELASTIC INFLATABLE ELASTOMER SEAL CONTACT MECHANICS                           *)
(* Mooney-Rivlin hyperelastic stress formulation, dynamic anti-blowout margin, and leak estimation.   *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* Compute Seal Uniaxial Stretch Ratio lambda = 1.0 - (delta_gap / h_nominal) *)
IF c_rSealWidth > 0.001 THEN
    rSealNominalCompressionRatio := 1.0 - ((25.0 - rVotedSealGap_Internal) / (c_rSealWidth * 1000.0));
ELSE
    rSealNominalCompressionRatio := 1.0;
END_IF;
IF rSealNominalCompressionRatio < 0.65 THEN
    rSealNominalCompressionRatio := 0.65; (* Maximum structural strain boundary *)
ELSIF rSealNominalCompressionRatio > 1.05 THEN
    rSealNominalCompressionRatio := 1.05;
END_IF;

(* Mooney-Rivlin Hyperelastic Contact Stress: sigma = 2*C10*(lambda - lambda^-2) + 2*C01*(1 - lambda^-3) *)
rTempA := rSealNominalCompressionRatio;
IF rTempA > 0.1 THEN
    rTempB := (rTempA - (1.0 / (rTempA * rTempA)));
    rTempC := (1.0 - (1.0 / (rTempA * rTempA * rTempA)));
    (* Net Contact Stress in MPa = Hyperelastic Base Stress + Pneumatic Actuation Pressure (bar/10) *)
    rSealContactStressMpa := (2.0 * c_rSealMooneyRivlin_C10 * rTempB) +
                             (2.0 * c_rSealMooneyRivlin_C01 * rTempC) +
                             (rVotedSealPress_Internal * 0.10);
ELSE
    rSealContactStressMpa := 0.0;
END_IF;
IF rSealContactStressMpa < 0.0 THEN
    rSealContactStressMpa := 0.0;
END_IF;

(* Viscoelastic Maxwell Relaxation Creep: d(sigma_creep)/dt = E_visco * d_eps/dt - sigma_creep / tau *)
rSealViscoelasticCreep := rSealViscoelasticCreep * 0.9985 + (rSealContactStressMpa * 0.0015);

(* Differential Pressure Anti-Blowout Margin: Ratio of Seal Friction Restoring Force to Pressure Force *)
(* F_friction = mu * sigma_contact * A_contact; F_pressure = Delta_P * A_transverse *)
rChamberDifferentialForce := ABS(rVotedAirlockPress_Internal - rVotedTubePress_Internal) * c_rAirlockInternalArea;
rSealStaticFrictionForce := (rSealContactStressMpa * 1000000.0) * (c_rSealCircumferenceLength * c_rSealWidth) * c_rSealFrictionCoefficient;

IF rChamberDifferentialForce > 100.0 THEN
    rSealBlowoutSafetyMargin := rSealStaticFrictionForce / rChamberDifferentialForce;
ELSE
    rSealBlowoutSafetyMargin := 99.9; (* Infinitely safe when differential pressure is negligible *)
END_IF;

IF (rSealBlowoutSafetyMargin < 1.35) AND (iState >= 30) AND (iState <= 75) THEN
    dwAlarmWord_1 := dwAlarmWord_1 OR 16#0000_0020; (* Critical Seal Blowout Hazard Alarm *)
    bSystemTrip := TRUE;
END_IF;

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* 4.0 RAREFIED GAS DYNAMICS & MULTI-STAGE VACUUM PUMPING CASCADE REGIME MODEL                       *)
(* Calculates mean free path, Knudsen number, flow regime, effective pumping speeds, and leak-back.  *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* Gas Mean Free Path lambda = (k_B * T) / (sqrt(2) * pi * sigma^2 * P) *)
rTempA := 1.41421356 * 3.14159265 * (c_rEffectiveMoleculeDiam * c_rEffectiveMoleculeDiam) * rVotedAirlockPress_Internal;
IF rTempA > 1.0E-25 THEN
    rMeanFreePathLambda := (c_rBoltzmannConstant * rChamberGasTemperature) / rTempA;
ELSE
    rMeanFreePathLambda := 1.0;
END_IF;

(* Dimensionless Knudsen Number Kn = lambda / D_hydraulic *)
IF c_rAirlockHydraulicDiameter > 0.01 THEN
    rKnudsenNumber := rMeanFreePathLambda / c_rAirlockHydraulicDiameter;
ELSE
    rKnudsenNumber := 0.001;
END_IF;

(* Dynamic Gas Viscosity via Sutherland Law for Dry Air: mu(T) = mu0 * (T/T0)^(3/2) * (T0 + S)/(T + S) *)
rTempB := rChamberGasTemperature / 291.15;
rDynamicAirViscosity := 0.00001827 * (rTempB * SQRT(rTempB)) * ((291.15 + 120.0) / (rChamberGasTemperature + 120.0));

(* Mean Maxwellian Molecular Thermal Velocity: v_th = sqrt(8 * R_spec * T / pi) *)
rMolecularThermalSpeed := SQRT((8.0 * c_rSpecificGasConstantAir * rChamberGasTemperature) / 3.14159265);

(* Multi-Stage Pumping Cascade Dispatch & Pumping Speed Characteristic *)
(* Stage 1: Roots Vacuum Blower Effective Speed S_roots = S0 * (1 - 1 / K_compression) *)
IF rRootsBlowerSpeedFeedback > 100.0 THEN
    rRootsCompressionRatio := 1.0 + (12.5 * (rRootsBlowerSpeedFeedback / c_rRootsMaxNominalSpeed) *
                                   (1.0 / (1.0 + (rVotedAirlockPress_Internal / 2000.0))));
    IF rRootsCompressionRatio > 1.05 THEN
        rRootsEffectiveSpeed := c_rRootsMaxDisplacement * (rRootsBlowerSpeedFeedback / c_rRootsMaxNominalSpeed) *
                                (1.0 - (1.0 / rRootsCompressionRatio));
    ELSE
        rRootsEffectiveSpeed := 0.1;
    END_IF;
ELSE
    rRootsEffectiveSpeed := 0.0;
END_IF;

(* Stage 2: Mag-Lev Turbomolecular Pump Speed S_tmp(Kn, omega) in Molecular / Transitional Flow *)
IF (rTurbomolecularSpeedFeedback > 5000.0) AND (rVotedAirlockPress_Internal < c_rForelineMaxSafePressure) THEN
    (* Molecular pumping efficiency increases as Knudsen number exceeds transitional threshold (Kn > 0.01) *)
    IF rKnudsenNumber >= 0.10 THEN
        rTempC := 1.0; (* Full molecular pumping capability *)
    ELSIF rKnudsenNumber <= 0.005 THEN
        rTempC := 0.08; (* Severe aerodynamic stalling & gas friction *)
    ELSE
        rTempC := 0.08 + (0.92 * ((rKnudsenNumber - 0.005) / 0.095));
    END_IF;
    rTMPEffectiveSpeed := c_rTMPRatedPumpingSpeed * (rTurbomolecularSpeedFeedback / c_rTMPRatedSpeed) * rTempC;
ELSE
    rTMPEffectiveSpeed := 0.0;
END_IF;

(* Combined Pumping Speed *)
rTotalPumpingSpeed := rRootsEffectiveSpeed + rTMPEffectiveSpeed;

(* Stainless Steel Outgassing Load Decay: Q_outgas(t) = q0 * A_surface / (1 + t/t0)^alpha *)
rTempD := 1.0 + (rEvacuationTimeElapsed / 18.0);
IF rTempD > 0.1 THEN
    rOutgassingRatePerArea := 0.00018 / SQRT(rTempD); (* Alpha ~ 0.5 initial surface water desorption *)
ELSE
    rOutgassingRatePerArea := 0.00018;
END_IF;
rIntegratedOutgassingLoad := rOutgassingRatePerArea * c_rChamberWettedSurfaceArea;

(* Real-Time Chamber Differential Rate of Pressure Change dP/dt [Pa/s] *)
rCalculatedRateOfPressChange := (rVotedAirlockPress_Internal - rPreviousAirlockPressure) / c_rScanTimeSeconds;
rPreviousAirlockPressure := rVotedAirlockPress_Internal;

(* Net Specific Airlock Leak Rate Q_leak = V * dP/dt + S*P - Q_outgas *)
IF (iState = 25) OR ((rTotalPumpingSpeed < 0.05) AND (rVotedAirlockPress_Internal < 50000.0)) THEN
    (* Isolated leak-rate evaluation *)
    rEstimatedLeakBackLoad := (c_rAirlockInternalVolume * rCalculatedRateOfPressChange) - rIntegratedOutgassingLoad;
    IF rEstimatedLeakBackLoad < 0.0 THEN
        rEstimatedLeakBackLoad := 0.0;
    END_IF;
    rCalculatedLeakRate := rEstimatedLeakBackLoad;
END_IF;

(* Model-Based Prediction of Remaining Evacuation Time to Crossover [s] *)
IF (rVotedAirlockPress_Internal > c_rRootsCrossoverPressure) AND (rTotalPumpingSpeed > 0.5) THEN
    rEstimatedEvacuationTimeRemaining := (c_rAirlockInternalVolume / rTotalPumpingSpeed) *
                                         LN(rVotedAirlockPress_Internal / c_rRootsCrossoverPressure);
ELSIF (rVotedAirlockPress_Internal <= c_rRootsCrossoverPressure) AND (rTMPEffectiveSpeed > 2.0) THEN
    rEstimatedEvacuationTimeRemaining := (c_rAirlockInternalVolume / rTMPEffectiveSpeed) *
                                         LN(rVotedAirlockPress_Internal / c_rTargetChamberPressure);
ELSE
    rEstimatedEvacuationTimeRemaining := 0.0;
END_IF;
IF rEstimatedEvacuationTimeRemaining < 0.0 THEN
    rEstimatedEvacuationTimeRemaining := 0.0;
END_IF;

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* 5.0 RESIDUAL SHOCK WAVE REFLECTION SUPPRESSION & RANKINE-HUGONIOT DAMPING                         *)
(* Computes normal shock jump across opening boundary and tunes acoustic Helmholtz impedance.       *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* Pressure Ratio P_airlock / P_tube across isolating knife gate *)
IF rVotedTubePress_Internal > 0.5 THEN
    rChamberTubePressureRatio := rVotedAirlockPress_Internal / rVotedTubePress_Internal;
ELSE
    rChamberTubePressureRatio := 1.0;
END_IF;

(* Rankine-Hugoniot Incident Shock Mach Number: Ms = sqrt( ((gamma+1)/(2*gamma))*(P_ratio - 1) + 1 ) *)
IF rChamberTubePressureRatio > 1.005 THEN
    rTempA := ((c_rSpecificHeatRatioGamma + 1.0) / (2.0 * c_rSpecificHeatRatioGamma)) *
              (rChamberTubePressureRatio - 1.0) + 1.0;
    IF rTempA > 1.0 THEN
        rShockMachNumber := SQRT(rTempA);
    ELSE
        rShockMachNumber := 1.0;
    END_IF;
ELSE
    rShockMachNumber := 1.0;
END_IF;

(* Rankine-Hugoniot Incident Static Overpressure Jump Delta P = P_tube * (2*gamma/(gamma+1))*(Ms^2 - 1) *)
rShockOverpressureJump := rVotedTubePress_Internal *
                          ((2.0 * c_rSpecificHeatRatioGamma) / (c_rSpecificHeatRatioGamma + 1.0)) *
                          ((rShockMachNumber * rShockMachNumber) - 1.0);
rPredictedShockOverpressure := rShockOverpressureJump;

(* Predicted Acoustic Sound Pressure Level SPL = 20 * log10(Delta P_rms / 20 uPa) *)
IF rShockOverpressureJump > 0.01 THEN
    rTempB := (rShockOverpressureJump * 0.70710678) / 0.000020;
    IF rTempB > 1.0 THEN
        rPredictedIncidentSPL := 20.0 * (LN(rTempB) / 2.30258509);
    ELSE
        rPredictedIncidentSPL := 0.0;
    END_IF;
ELSE
    rPredictedIncidentSPL := 0.0;
END_IF;

(* Acoustic Wave Reflection Damper Helmholtz Tuning: f_res = (c / 2*pi) * sqrt( A_neck / (V_cavity * L_eff) ) *)
(* Speed of sound c = sqrt(gamma * R_spec * T) *)
rShockWavePropagationSpeed := SQRT(c_rSpecificHeatRatioGamma * c_rSpecificGasConstantAir * rChamberGasTemperature);

(* Variable Baffle Linear Stroke Position [0 to 450 mm] to match Quarter-Wave Standing Modes *)
IF rShockWavePropagationSpeed > 50.0 AND c_rAirlockInternalLength > 1.0 THEN
    (* Fundamental acoustic tube quarter-wave resonance mode f1 = c / (4 * L) *)
    rHelmholtzResonantFreq := rShockWavePropagationSpeed / (4.0 * c_rAirlockInternalLength);
    (* Dynamic Baffle Actuator Stroke modulation proportional to acoustic SPL error *)
    rTempC := (rPredictedIncidentSPL - 65.0) / (c_rShockMaxAllowableSPL - 65.0);
    IF rTempC < 0.0 THEN rTempC := 0.0; ELSIF rTempC > 1.0 THEN rTempC := 1.0; END_IF;
    rAcousticBaffleLinearStroke := rTempC * c_rBaffleStrokeMax;
ELSE
    rAcousticBaffleLinearStroke := 0.0;
END_IF;

(* Micro-Bleed Equalization Choked Flow Limiter: m_dot_choked = A_throat * P_up * sqrt(gamma/RT) * (2/(gamma+1))^((gamma+1)/(2*(gamma-1))) *)
IF rVotedAirlockPress_Internal > (rVotedTubePress_Internal * 1.8929) THEN
    (* Choked sonic flow regime through equalization bypass orifice *)
    rTempD := SQRT(c_rSpecificHeatRatioGamma / (c_rSpecificGasConstantAir * rChamberGasTemperature)) * 0.5787;
    rChokedMassFlowMax := 0.0125 * rVotedAirlockPress_Internal * rTempD; (* A_orifice = 0.0125 m2 *)
ELSE
    (* Subsonic pressure equalization *)
    rChokedMassFlowMax := 0.0125 * SQRT(2.0 * rVotedAirlockPress_Internal *
                                        (rVotedAirlockPress_Internal - rVotedTubePress_Internal) /
                                        (c_rSpecificGasConstantAir * rChamberGasTemperature));
END_IF;

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* 6.0 COMPLETE STATE-SPACE MODEL & MODEL PREDICTIVE CONTROL (MPC) OPTIMIZATION                      *)
(* Evaluates discrete-time dynamic state vector, cost function gradients, and actuator increments.   *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* Compute Deviation States relative to Linearization Trajectory Target *)
x1_PressDev     := rVotedAirlockPress_Internal - rTargetChamberPressure;
x2_ForelineDev  := (rVotedAirlockPress_Internal * 0.12) - (c_rRootsCrossoverPressure * 0.5);
x3_SealPressDev := rVotedSealPress_Internal - rTargetSealPressure;
x4_TMPSpeedDev  := rTurbomolecularSpeedFeedback - rTargetTMPSpeed;
x5_ShockAmpDev  := rShockOverpressureJump - rTargetShockAmplitude;
x6_ShockRateDev := rCalculatedRateOfPressChange;

(* 1-Step Ahead State Space Prediction: x_next = Ad * x + Bd * u *)
x1_Next := (Ad_11 * x1_PressDev) + (Ad_12 * x2_ForelineDev) + (Ad_13 * x3_SealPressDev) +
           (Ad_14 * x4_TMPSpeedDev) + (Ad_15 * x5_ShockAmpDev) + (Ad_16 * x6_ShockRateDev) +
           (Bd_11 * rOpt_Delta_RootsSpeed) + (Bd_12 * rOpt_Delta_EqualValve);

x2_Next := (Ad_21 * x1_PressDev) + (Ad_22 * x2_ForelineDev) + (Ad_23 * x3_SealPressDev) +
           (Ad_24 * x4_TMPSpeedDev) + (Ad_25 * x5_ShockAmpDev) + (Ad_26 * x6_ShockRateDev) +
           (Bd_21 * rOpt_Delta_RootsSpeed) + (Bd_22 * rOpt_Delta_EqualValve);

x3_Next := (Ad_31 * x1_PressDev) + (Ad_32 * x2_ForelineDev) + (Ad_33 * x3_SealPressDev) +
           (Ad_34 * x4_TMPSpeedDev) + (Ad_35 * x5_ShockAmpDev) + (Ad_36 * x6_ShockRateDev) +
           (Bd_33 * rOpt_Delta_SealPress);

x4_Next := (Ad_41 * x1_PressDev) + (Ad_42 * x2_ForelineDev) + (Ad_43 * x3_SealPressDev) +
           (Ad_44 * x4_TMPSpeedDev) + (Ad_45 * x5_ShockAmpDev) + (Ad_46 * x6_ShockRateDev);

x5_Next := (Ad_51 * x1_PressDev) + (Ad_52 * x2_ForelineDev) + (Ad_53 * x3_SealPressDev) +
           (Ad_54 * x4_TMPSpeedDev) + (Ad_55 * x5_ShockAmpDev) + (Ad_56 * x6_ShockRateDev) +
           (Bd_52 * rOpt_Delta_EqualValve) + (Bd_54 * rOpt_Delta_BaffleStroke);

x6_Next := (Ad_61 * x1_PressDev) + (Ad_62 * x2_ForelineDev) + (Ad_63 * x3_SealPressDev) +
           (Ad_64 * x4_TMPSpeedDev) + (Ad_65 * x5_ShockAmpDev) + (Ad_66 * x6_ShockRateDev) +
           (Bd_62 * rOpt_Delta_EqualValve) + (Bd_64 * rOpt_Delta_BaffleStroke);

(* Analytical Quadratic Cost Minimization: J = x^T * Q * x + u^T * R * u *)
(* Gradient evaluation: grad_u(J) = Bd^T * Q * (Ad * x) + R * u *)
rGrad1 := (Bd_11 * rMPC_Weight_PressureTrack * (Ad_11 * x1_PressDev + Ad_12 * x2_ForelineDev)) +
          (rMPC_Weight_dRootsSpeed * rOpt_Delta_RootsSpeed);

rGrad2 := (Bd_12 * rMPC_Weight_PressureTrack * (Ad_11 * x1_PressDev + Ad_12 * x2_ForelineDev)) +
          (Bd_52 * rMPC_Weight_ShockSuppression * (Ad_55 * x5_ShockAmpDev + Ad_56 * x6_ShockRateDev)) +
          (rMPC_Weight_dValvePos * rOpt_Delta_EqualValve);

rGrad3 := (Bd_33 * rMPC_Weight_SealIntegrity * (Ad_33 * x3_SealPressDev)) +
          (rMPC_Weight_dSealRegulator * rOpt_Delta_SealPress);

rGrad4 := (Bd_54 * rMPC_Weight_ShockSuppression * (Ad_55 * x5_ShockAmpDev + Ad_56 * x6_ShockRateDev)) +
          (rMPC_Weight_dBaffleStroke * rOpt_Delta_BaffleStroke);

(* Diagonal Hessian Approximation: Hess_ii = Bd_i^T * Q * Bd_i + R_ii *)
rHess1 := (Bd_11 * Bd_11 * rMPC_Weight_PressureTrack) + rMPC_Weight_dRootsSpeed;
rHess2 := (Bd_12 * Bd_12 * rMPC_Weight_PressureTrack) + (Bd_52 * Bd_52 * rMPC_Weight_ShockSuppression) + rMPC_Weight_dValvePos;
rHess3 := (Bd_33 * Bd_33 * rMPC_Weight_SealIntegrity) + rMPC_Weight_dSealRegulator;
rHess4 := (Bd_54 * Bd_54 * rMPC_Weight_ShockSuppression) + rMPC_Weight_dBaffleStroke;

(* Newton-Raphson Gradient Descent Step with Actuator Saturation & Slew Limiting *)
IF rHess1 > 0.001 THEN rOpt_Delta_RootsSpeed  := rOpt_Delta_RootsSpeed  - (0.65 * rGrad1 / rHess1); END_IF;
IF rHess2 > 0.001 THEN rOpt_Delta_EqualValve  := rOpt_Delta_EqualValve  - (0.65 * rGrad2 / rHess2); END_IF;
IF rHess3 > 0.001 THEN rOpt_Delta_SealPress   := rOpt_Delta_SealPress   - (0.65 * rGrad3 / rHess3); END_IF;
IF rHess4 > 0.001 THEN rOpt_Delta_BaffleStroke := rOpt_Delta_BaffleStroke - (0.65 * rGrad4 / rHess4); END_IF;

(* Actuator Slew Rate Clamping *)
IF rOpt_Delta_RootsSpeed > 150.0 THEN rOpt_Delta_RootsSpeed := 150.0; ELSIF rOpt_Delta_RootsSpeed < -150.0 THEN rOpt_Delta_RootsSpeed := -150.0; END_IF;
IF rOpt_Delta_EqualValve > 5.0 THEN rOpt_Delta_EqualValve := 5.0; ELSIF rOpt_Delta_EqualValve < -5.0 THEN rOpt_Delta_EqualValve := -5.0; END_IF;
IF rOpt_Delta_SealPress > 0.15 THEN rOpt_Delta_SealPress := 0.15; ELSIF rOpt_Delta_SealPress < -0.15 THEN rOpt_Delta_SealPress := -0.15; END_IF;
IF rOpt_Delta_BaffleStroke > 12.0 THEN rOpt_Delta_BaffleStroke := 12.0; ELSIF rOpt_Delta_BaffleStroke < -12.0 THEN rOpt_Delta_BaffleStroke := -12.0; END_IF;

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* 7.0 MULTI-STAGE SUPERVISORY FINITE STATE MACHINE (CASE iState OF ... END_CASE;)                   *)
(* Deterministic sequence orchestration from Atmospheric Standby through Deep Vacuum to Pod Transit. *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
CASE iState OF
    0: (* STATE 0: STANDBY_ATMOSPHERIC - Station Ingress/Egress Door Open, Seals Deflated *)
        bSystemReady := TRUE;
        bSystemRunning := FALSE;
        bSealsInflatedAndLocked := FALSE;
        bChamberEvacuatedToTarget := FALSE;
        bTubeGateValveOpenDemand := FALSE;
        bAcousticShockSuppressed := FALSE;
        rRootsBlowerSpeedDemand := 0.0;
        rTurbomolecularSpeedDemand := 0.0;
        rSealPressureSetpoint := 0.0;
        rEqualizationValveDemand := 0.0;
        rAcousticBaffleLinearStroke := 0.0;
        rEvacuationTimeElapsed := 0.0;
        rStateTimerAccumulator := 0.0;

        (* Transition to Stage 10 upon Operator Request and Docking Latch Confirmation *)
        IF bMasterEnableCycle AND bPodDockingLatched AND bStationGateClosedInterlock THEN
            bSystemReady := FALSE;
            bSystemRunning := TRUE;
            iState := 10;
        END_IF;

    10: (* STATE 10: STATION_ISOLATION_VERIFICATION - Verify Barrier Closure & Pre-Seat Clearance *)
        rStateTimerAccumulator := rStateTimerAccumulator + c_rScanTimeSeconds;
        IF bStationGateClosedInterlock AND (rVotedSealGap_Internal <= 30.0) THEN
            IF rStateTimerAccumulator >= 0.50 THEN
                rStateTimerAccumulator := 0.0;
                iState := 20; (* Advance to Seal Inflation *)
            END_IF;
        ELSE
            IF rStateTimerAccumulator > 5.0 THEN
                dwAlarmWord_1 := dwAlarmWord_1 OR 16#0000_0040; (* Station Gate Latch Failure *)
                bSystemTrip := TRUE;
                iState := 90;
            END_IF;
        END_IF;

    20: (* STATE 20: SEAL_RAPID_INFLATION - Multi-Segment S-Curve Viscoelastic Inflation Profile *)
        rStateTimerAccumulator := rStateTimerAccumulator + c_rScanTimeSeconds;
        (* Phase 1: Rapid Gap Takeup (0.0 to 2.0 bar) *)
        IF rVotedSealPress_Internal < 2.0 THEN
            rSealPressureSetpoint := rSealPressureSetpoint + (c_rSealMaxSlewRate * c_rScanTimeSeconds);
        (* Phase 2: Controlled Seating against Pod Hull (2.0 to 5.2 bar) *)
        ELSE
            rSealPressureSetpoint := rSealPressureSetpoint + (0.45 * c_rSealMaxSlewRate * c_rScanTimeSeconds);
        END_IF;

        IF rSealPressureSetpoint > c_rSealTargetNominalPressure THEN
            rSealPressureSetpoint := c_rSealTargetNominalPressure;
        END_IF;

        (* Check Seating Completion Permissive *)
        IF (rVotedSealPress_Internal >= (c_rSealTargetNominalPressure - 0.15)) AND
           (rSealContactStressMpa >= 1.85) AND
           (rVotedSealGap_Internal <= 8.5) THEN
            rStateTimerAccumulator := 0.0;
            iState := 25; (* Advance to In-situ Leak Test *)
        ELSIF rStateTimerAccumulator > 12.0 THEN
            dwAlarmWord_1 := dwAlarmWord_1 OR 16#0000_0080; (* Seal Inflation Timeout / Rupture *)
            bSystemTrip := TRUE;
            iState := 90;
        END_IF;

    25: (* STATE 25: SEAL_PRESSURE_HOLD_TEST - Isolated Leak-Back Evaluation Prior to Evacuation *)
        rStateTimerAccumulator := rStateTimerAccumulator + c_rScanTimeSeconds;
        tonSealLeakHoldTest(IN := TRUE, PT := T#2S);
        IF tonSealLeakHoldTest.Q THEN
            tonSealLeakHoldTest(IN := FALSE);
            (* Verify pressure drop rate is within allowable hermetic threshold *)
            IF ABS(rCalculatedRateOfPressChange) < 15.0 THEN
                bSealsInflatedAndLocked := TRUE;
                rStateTimerAccumulator := 0.0;
                iState := 30; (* Advance to Roughing Stage 1 *)
            ELSE
                dwAlarmWord_1 := dwAlarmWord_1 OR 16#0000_0100; (* Seal Gross Inleakage Detected *)
                bSystemTrip := TRUE;
                iState := 90;
            END_IF;
        END_IF;

    30: (* STATE 30: STAGE1_ROOTS_RAPID_ROUGHING - High-Volume Atmospheric Evacuation to 250 Pa *)
        rStateTimerAccumulator := rStateTimerAccumulator + c_rScanTimeSeconds;
        rEvacuationTimeElapsed := rEvacuationTimeElapsed + c_rScanTimeSeconds;

        (* Ramp Roots Blower to Maximum Speed under Frequency Inverter S-Curve *)
        IF rRootsBlowerSpeedDemand < c_rRootsMaxNominalSpeed THEN
            rRootsBlowerSpeedDemand := rRootsBlowerSpeedDemand + (600.0 * c_rScanTimeSeconds);
        ELSE
            rRootsBlowerSpeedDemand := c_rRootsMaxNominalSpeed;
        END_IF;

        (* Monitor for Crossover Pressure Boundary *)
        IF rVotedAirlockPress_Internal <= c_rRootsCrossoverPressure THEN
            rStateTimerAccumulator := 0.0;
            iState := 40; (* Advance to Foreline Crossover *)
        ELSIF rStateTimerAccumulator > 180.0 THEN
            dwAlarmWord_1 := dwAlarmWord_1 OR 16#0000_0200; (* Roughing Evacuation Timeout *)
            bSystemTrip := TRUE;
            iState := 90;
        END_IF;

    40: (* STATE 40: CROSSOVER_FORELINE_STABILIZE - Fore-vacuum Matching & TMP Spool-Up Permissive *)
        rStateTimerAccumulator := rStateTimerAccumulator + c_rScanTimeSeconds;
        rEvacuationTimeElapsed := rEvacuationTimeElapsed + c_rScanTimeSeconds;

        (* Maintain Roots at Intermediate Speed as Foreline Backing Pump *)
        rRootsBlowerSpeedDemand := 2200.0;

        (* Spin Up Mag-Lev Turbomolecular Pump Battery *)
        IF rTurbomolecularSpeedDemand < c_rTMPRatedSpeed THEN

(* ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* 1.0 SIL-3 HARDWIRED EMERGENCY STOP & MASTER INTERLOCK EVALUATION                          *)
(* Active-High Fail-Safe Dual-Channel Relay Monitored Directly. Immediate Trip Execution.    *)
(* ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
IF NOT bEmergencyStop THEN
    bSystemRunning                  := FALSE;
    bSystemReady                    := FALSE;
    bSystemTrip                     := TRUE;
    rFeedPumpSpeedDemand_rpm        := 0.0;
    rBackpressureChokeDemand_pct    := 12.0; (* Safe Controlled Venting Position to Avoid Overpressure *)
    rSaltBlowdownValveDemand_pct    := 0.0;
    rHERT_SpeedDemand_rpm           := 0.0;
    rLetdownStage2Demand_pct        := 25.0; (* Controlled Depressurization to Intermediate Vessel *)
    rReactorBurnerDutyDemand_kW     := 0.0;
    rQuenchInjectionValveDemand_pct := 100.0; (* Open Emergency Quench to Stop Runaway Exotherms *)
    rSaltWashWaterPumpDemand_pct    := 0.0;
    
    (* Assert Critical Trip Alarm Bits in dwAlarmWord_1 *)
    dwAlarmWord_1 := dwAlarmWord_1 OR 16#0000_0001; (* Bit 0: SIL-3 Hardware E-Stop Circuit Open *)
    dwSystemStatusWord := dwSystemStatusWord OR 16#8000_0000; (* Bit 31: System Trip Latched *)
    dwSystemStatusWord := dwSystemStatusWord AND 16#FFFF_FFFE; (* Clear Bit 0: System Running = 0 *)
    
    iActiveState := 90; (* Jump to STATE_90_EMERGENCY_BLOWDOWN_TRIP *)
    iState := 90;
    RETURN;
END_IF;

(* ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* 2.0 TRIPLE MODULAR REDUNDANCY (2oo3) SENSOR VOTING & HEALTH EVALUATION                    *)
(* Evaluates Discrepancy Limits, Median Selection, and Graceful 1oo2 Degraded Fallback.      *)
(* ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* --- 2.1 Reactor Backpressure 2oo3 Voting --- *)
bPress_A_OK := (rFeedPumpDischPress_A >= 10.0) AND (rFeedPumpDischPress_A <= 280.0);
bPress_B_OK := (rFeedPumpDischPress_B >= 10.0) AND (rFeedPumpDischPress_B <= 280.0);
bPress_C_OK := (rFeedPumpDischPress_C >= 10.0) AND (rFeedPumpDischPress_C <= 280.0);

IF bPress_A_OK AND bPress_B_OK AND bPress_C_OK THEN
    (* Check Pairwise Deviations *)
    IF (ABS(rFeedPumpDischPress_A - rFeedPumpDischPress_B) <= c_rPressDiscrepancyLimit_bar) AND
       (ABS(rFeedPumpDischPress_B - rFeedPumpDischPress_C) <= c_rPressDiscrepancyLimit_bar) AND
       (ABS(rFeedPumpDischPress_A - rFeedPumpDischPress_C) <= c_rPressDiscrepancyLimit_bar) THEN
        (* All Three Transmitters Fully Consistent: Compute Median *)
        IF (rFeedPumpDischPress_A >= rFeedPumpDischPress_B AND rFeedPumpDischPress_A <= rFeedPumpDischPress_C) OR
           (rFeedPumpDischPress_A >= rFeedPumpDischPress_C AND rFeedPumpDischPress_A <= rFeedPumpDischPress_B) THEN
            rVotedReactorPress := rFeedPumpDischPress_A;
        ELSIF (rFeedPumpDischPress_B >= rFeedPumpDischPress_A AND rFeedPumpDischPress_B <= rFeedPumpDischPress_C) OR
              (rFeedPumpDischPress_B >= rFeedPumpDischPress_C AND rFeedPumpDischPress_B <= rFeedPumpDischPress_A) THEN
            rVotedReactorPress := rFeedPumpDischPress_B;
        ELSE
            rVotedReactorPress := rFeedPumpDischPress_C;
        END_IF;
        bPress_Degraded_1oo2 := FALSE;
    ELSE
        (* Sensor Discrepancy Detected: Identify Outlier Channel and Fallback to 1oo2 Mean of Closest Pair *)
        IF ABS(rFeedPumpDischPress_A - rFeedPumpDischPress_B) <= c_rPressDiscrepancyLimit_bar THEN
            rVotedReactorPress := (rFeedPumpDischPress_A + rFeedPumpDischPress_B) * 0.5;
            dwWarningWord := dwWarningWord OR 16#0000_0004; (* Channel C Pressure Discrepant *)
        ELSIF ABS(rFeedPumpDischPress_A - rFeedPumpDischPress_C) <= c_rPressDiscrepancyLimit_bar THEN
            rVotedReactorPress := (rFeedPumpDischPress_A + rFeedPumpDischPress_C) * 0.5;
            dwWarningWord := dwWarningWord OR 16#0000_0002; (* Channel B Pressure Discrepant *)
        ELSE
            rVotedReactorPress := (rFeedPumpDischPress_B + rFeedPumpDischPress_C) * 0.5;
            dwWarningWord := dwWarningWord OR 16#0000_0001; (* Channel A Pressure Discrepant *)
        END_IF;
        bPress_Degraded_1oo2 := TRUE;
    END_IF;
ELSIF bPress_A_OK AND bPress_B_OK THEN
    rVotedReactorPress := (rFeedPumpDischPress_A + rFeedPumpDischPress_B) * 0.5;
    bPress_Degraded_1oo2 := TRUE;
    dwWarningWord := dwWarningWord OR 16#0000_0008; (* Pressure Sensor C Hard Failure *)
ELSIF bPress_A_OK AND bPress_C_OK THEN
    rVotedReactorPress := (rFeedPumpDischPress_A + rFeedPumpDischPress_C) * 0.5;
    bPress_Degraded_1oo2 := TRUE;
    dwWarningWord := dwWarningWord OR 16#0000_0010; (* Pressure Sensor B Hard Failure *)
ELSIF bPress_B_OK AND bPress_C_OK THEN
    rVotedReactorPress := (rFeedPumpDischPress_B + rFeedPumpDischPress_C) * 0.5;
    bPress_Degraded_1oo2 := TRUE;
    dwWarningWord := dwWarningWord OR 16#0000_0020; (* Pressure Sensor A Hard Failure *)
ELSE
    (* Catastrophic 2oo3 Loss: Less Than 2 Transmitters Healthy -> Mandatory SIS Trip *)
    bSystemTrip := TRUE;
    dwAlarmWord_1 := dwAlarmWord_1 OR 16#0000_0002; (* Bit 1: Dual/Triple Pressure Sensor Loss *)
    iActiveState := 90;
    iState := 90;
    RETURN;
END_IF;

(* --- 2.2 Reactor Core Temperature 2oo3 Voting --- *)
bTemp_A_OK := (rReactorCoreTemp_A >= 15.0) AND (rReactorCoreTemp_A <= 450.0);
bTemp_B_OK := (rReactorCoreTemp_B >= 15.0) AND (rReactorCoreTemp_B <= 450.0);
bTemp_C_OK := (rReactorCoreTemp_C >= 15.0) AND (rReactorCoreTemp_C <= 450.0);

IF bTemp_A_OK AND bTemp_B_OK AND bTemp_C_OK THEN
    IF (ABS(rReactorCoreTemp_A - rReactorCoreTemp_B) <= c_rTempDiscrepancyLimit_degC) AND
       (ABS(rReactorCoreTemp_B - rReactorCoreTemp_C) <= c_rTempDiscrepancyLimit_degC) AND
       (ABS(rReactorCoreTemp_A - rReactorCoreTemp_C) <= c_rTempDiscrepancyLimit_degC) THEN
        (* All Three Temperature Thermocouples Consistent: Compute Median *)
        IF (rReactorCoreTemp_A >= rReactorCoreTemp_B AND rReactorCoreTemp_A <= rReactorCoreTemp_C) OR
           (rReactorCoreTemp_A >= rReactorCoreTemp_C AND rReactorCoreTemp_A <= rReactorCoreTemp_B) THEN
            rVotedReactorTemp := rReactorCoreTemp_A;
        ELSIF (rReactorCoreTemp_B >= rReactorCoreTemp_A AND rReactorCoreTemp_B <= rReactorCoreTemp_C) OR
              (rReactorCoreTemp_B >= rReactorCoreTemp_C AND rReactorCoreTemp_B <= rReactorCoreTemp_A) THEN
            rVotedReactorTemp := rReactorCoreTemp_B;
        ELSE
            rVotedReactorTemp := rReactorCoreTemp_C;
        END_IF;
        bTemp_Degraded_1oo2 := FALSE;
    ELSE
        (* Sensor Drift Detected in Thermocouples *)
        IF ABS(rReactorCoreTemp_A - rReactorCoreTemp_B) <= c_rTempDiscrepancyLimit_degC THEN
            rVotedReactorTemp := (rReactorCoreTemp_A + rReactorCoreTemp_B) * 0.5;
            dwWarningWord := dwWarningWord OR 16#0000_0080; (* Thermocouple C Drift *)
        ELSIF ABS(rReactorCoreTemp_A - rReactorCoreTemp_C) <= c_rTempDiscrepancyLimit_degC THEN
            rVotedReactorTemp := (rReactorCoreTemp_A + rReactorCoreTemp_C) * 0.5;
            dwWarningWord := dwWarningWord OR 16#0000_0040; (* Thermocouple B Drift *)
        ELSE
            rVotedReactorTemp := (rReactorCoreTemp_B + rReactorCoreTemp_C) * 0.5;
            dwWarningWord := dwWarningWord OR 16#0000_0100; (* Thermocouple A Drift *)
        END_IF;
        bTemp_Degraded_1oo2 := TRUE;
    END_IF;
ELSIF bTemp_A_OK AND bTemp_B_OK THEN
    rVotedReactorTemp := (rReactorCoreTemp_A + rReactorCoreTemp_B) * 0.5;
    bTemp_Degraded_1oo2 := TRUE;
ELSIF bTemp_A_OK AND bTemp_C_OK THEN
    rVotedReactorTemp := (rReactorCoreTemp_A + rReactorCoreTemp_C) * 0.5;
    bTemp_Degraded_1oo2 := TRUE;
ELSIF bTemp_B_OK AND bTemp_C_OK THEN
    rVotedReactorTemp := (rReactorCoreTemp_B + rReactorCoreTemp_C) * 0.5;
    bTemp_Degraded_1oo2 := TRUE;
ELSE
    bSystemTrip := TRUE;
    dwAlarmWord_1 := dwAlarmWord_1 OR 16#0000_0004; (* Dual/Triple Temperature Sensor Loss *)
    iActiveState := 90;
    iState := 90;
    RETURN;
END_IF;

bDegradedMode := bPress_Degraded_1oo2 OR bTemp_Degraded_1oo2;

(* --- 2.3 Cyclone Differential Pressure Filtering --- *)
rVotedCycloneDiffP := rCycloneDiffPress_bar;

(* ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* 3.0 DIGITAL BIQUAD NOTCH FILTER: PUMP DISCHARGE PULSATION ATTENUATION                     *)
(* Rejects 10 Hz quintuplex positive displacement pulsation ripples from backpressure signal*)
(* ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
rFilteredPulsationPress :=
    c_rNotch_b0 * rVotedReactorPress +
    c_rNotch_b1 * rNotch_x1 +
    c_rNotch_b2 * rNotch_x2 -
    c_rNotch_a1 * rNotch_y1 -
    c_rNotch_a2 * rNotch_y2;

(* Advance Delay Lines *)
rNotch_x2 := rNotch_x1;
rNotch_x1 := rVotedReactorPress;
rNotch_y2 := rNotch_y1;
rNotch_y1 := rFilteredPulsationPress;

rInstantaneousPulsationAmpl := ABS(rVotedReactorPress - rFilteredPulsationPress);
IF rInstantaneousPulsationAmpl > 14.5 THEN
    dwWarningWord := dwWarningWord OR 16#0000_0200; (* Severe Pump Pulsation: Damper Bladder Failure *)
END_IF;

(* ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* 4.0 SLURRY NON-NEWTONIAN RHEOLOGY & PLUG-FLOW HYDRAULIC ENGINE                            *)
(* Computes Herschel-Bulkley wall shear stress, apparent viscosity, and line friction drop. *)
(* ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* Compute Core Temperature in Kelvin *)
rCoreTempKelvin := rVotedReactorTemp + 273.15;

(* Slurry Superficial Flow Velocity inside Reactor Tube: v = Q_mass / (rho * A_pipe * 3600) *)
rSlurryFlowVelocity_ms := rSlurryMassFlowRate / (rSlurryFeedDensity * 0.00456037 * 3600.0);
IF rSlurryFlowVelocity_ms < 0.01 THEN
    rSlurryFlowVelocity_ms := 0.01; (* Clamp to prevent numerical division by zero *)
END_IF;

(* Pipe Wall Superficial Shear Rate: gamma_dot = (8 * v / D) * ((3n + 1) / (4n)) *)
rSlurryShearRate_gamma := (8.0 * rSlurryFlowVelocity_ms / c_rReactorTubeDiameter_m) *
    ((3.0 * c_rFlowBehaviorIndex_n + 1.0) / (4.0 * c_rFlowBehaviorIndex_n));

(* In-situ Bingham/Herschel-Bulkley Yield Stress Scaling with Total Dry Solids % *)
rTmpDelta := c_rBaseYieldStress_tau0 * EXP(c_rSolidsYieldStressSlope * (rFeedSlurryDrySolids_pct - 15.0));

(* Pipe Wall Shear Stress: tau_w = tau_0 + K * (gamma_dot)^n *)
rHerschelBulkleyTau_w := rTmpDelta + c_rBaseConsistencyIndex_K * EXPT(rSlurryShearRate_gamma, c_rFlowBehaviorIndex_n);

(* Apparent Dynamic Viscosity: mu_app = tau_w / gamma_dot in [Pa*s], convert to [cP] *)
rRheologicalApparentViscosity_cP := (rHerschelBulkleyTau_w / rSlurryShearRate_gamma) * 1000.0;

(* Generalized Non-Newtonian Reynolds Number Re_HB *)
rReynoldsNumber_HB := (rSlurryFeedDensity * EXPT(rSlurryFlowVelocity_ms, 2.0 - c_rFlowBehaviorIndex_n) *
    EXPT(c_rReactorTubeDiameter_m, c_rFlowBehaviorIndex_n)) /
    (c_rBaseConsistencyIndex_K * EXPT((3.0 * c_rFlowBehaviorIndex_n + 1.0) / (4.0 * c_rFlowBehaviorIndex_n), c_rFlowBehaviorIndex_n) *
     EXPT(8.0, c_rFlowBehaviorIndex_n - 1.0));

(* Friction Factor Calculation *)
IF rReynoldsNumber_HB < 2100.0 THEN
    (* Laminar Non-Newtonian Flow: f = 64 / Re_HB *)
    rPipeFrictionFactor_f := 64.0 / rReynoldsNumber_HB;
ELSE
    (* Turbulent Swamee-Aggarwal Approximation *)
    rPipeFrictionFactor_f := 0.3164 / EXPT(rReynoldsNumber_HB, 0.25);
END_IF;

(* Slurry Hydraulic Line Pressure Drop across 120m Reactor Tube [bar] *)
rTmpB := (rPipeFrictionFactor_f * (c_rReactorLength_m / c_rReactorTubeDiameter_m) *
    (rSlurryFeedDensity * rSlurryFlowVelocity_ms * rSlurryFlowVelocity_ms * 0.5)) / 100000.0;

(* ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* 5.0 SUPERCRITICAL WATER DIELECTRIC COLLAPSE & INORGANIC SALT PRECIPITATION KINETICS       *)
(* Evaluates Dielectric Permittivity epsilon_r, Mineral Precipitation Rate & Cyclone Vortex. *)
(* ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* Water Relative Permittivity (Dielectric Constant epsilon_r) Approximation at 220 bar *)
IF rVotedReactorTemp <= 100.0 THEN
    rWaterDielectricConstantEst := 78.5 - 0.35 * (rVotedReactorTemp - 20.0);
ELSIF rVotedReactorTemp <= 300.0 THEN
    rWaterDielectricConstantEst := 50.5 - 0.17 * (rVotedReactorTemp - 100.0);
ELSIF rVotedReactorTemp <= 373.9 THEN
    (* Steep Dielectric Collapse near Subcritical Transition: epsilon drops to ~ 14.8 at 350 deg C *)
    rWaterDielectricConstantEst := 16.5 - 0.085 * (rVotedReactorTemp - 300.0);
    IF rWaterDielectricConstantEst < 5.0 THEN
        rWaterDielectricConstantEst := 5.0;
    END_IF;
ELSE
    (* Supercritical Region: Non-polar behaviour like hexane, epsilon_r ~ 2.0 to 4.5 *)
    rWaterDielectricConstantEst := 3.2;
END_IF;

(* Inorganic Salt Solubility Cutoff: Drops exponentially as dielectric constant falls below 20 *)
IF rWaterDielectricConstantEst < 20.0 THEN
    rSaltSolubilityCutoff := 0.045 * (rWaterDielectricConstantEst / 20.0); (* Near-complete desolvation [g/L] *)
ELSE
    rSaltSolubilityCutoff := 35.0; (* Soluble *)
END_IF;

(* Cyclone Centrifugal Separation Efficiency for Precipitated Mineral Ash (Apatite, Struvite, SiO2) *)
(* Inlet velocity to cyclone: v_in = Q_vol / A_in *)
rTmpA := (rSlurryMassFlowRate / (rSlurryFeedDensity * 3600.0)) / c_rCycloneInletArea_m2;
IF rTmpA > 8.0 THEN
    rCycloneSeparationEfficiency_pct := 98.7;
ELSIF rTmpA > 4.0 THEN
    rCycloneSeparationEfficiency_pct := 95.2;
ELSE
    rCycloneSeparationEfficiency_pct := 82.0;
END_IF;

(* Real-Time Ash Precipitation Mass Flow [kg/s]: Ash% * DrySolids% * MassRate *)
rInstantaneousAshRate_kgs := (rSlurryMassFlowRate / 3600.0) * (rFeedSlurryDrySolids_pct / 100.0) *
    (rSlurryAshContent_pct / 100.0) * (rCycloneSeparationEfficiency_pct / 100.0);

(* Integrate Accumulated Precipitated Salt Mass into Lock-Hopper Dipleg *)
IF iActiveState = 40 (* STEADY_STATE_CO_LIQUEFACTION *) THEN
    rInternalAccumSaltMass := rInternalAccumSaltMass + (rInstantaneousAshRate_kgs * c_rScanTimeSec);
END_IF;
rEstimatedSaltBedMass_kg := rInternalAccumSaltMass;

(* Check Cyclone Plugging / Fouling: Delta P across cyclone > 3.8 bar indicates dipleg choke *)
IF rVotedCycloneDiffP > 3.8 THEN
    dwAlarmWord_2 := dwAlarmWord_2 OR 16#0000_0001; (* Bit 0: Cyclone Dipleg Severe Choke *)
ELSIF rVotedCycloneDiffP > 2.6 THEN
    dwWarningWord := dwWarningWord OR 16#0000_0400; (* Bit 10: High Cyclone Differential Pressure *)
END_IF;

(* Cyclone Wall Temperature Differential: Coking / Fouling Detection *)
IF ABS(rCycloneSkinTemp - rVotedReactorTemp) > 25.0 THEN
    dwWarningWord := dwWarningWord OR 16#0000_0800; (* Bit 11: Cyclone Thermal Insulation Fouling Layer *)
END_IF;

(* ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* 6.0 THERMOCHEMICAL DEPOLYMERIZATION REACTION KINETICS & YIELD OBSERVER                    *)
(* Evaluates Arrhenius rate k, Mean Residence Time tau_res, and Phase Yield Splits.          *)
(* ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* Arrhenius Reaction Rate Constant: k_htl = k0 * exp(-Ea / (R * T)) *)
rReactionKineticsRate_k := c_rArrheniusPreExp_k0 * EXP(-c_rActivationEnergy_Ea / (c_rUniversalGasConst * rCoreTempKelvin));

(* Hydraulic Residence Time: tau_res = ReactorVolume / VolumetricFlow [s] *)
rReactorResidenceTime_s := (c_rReactorVolume_m3 * rSlurryFeedDensity * 3600.0) / rSlurryMassFlowRate;
IF rReactorResidenceTime_s < 10.0 THEN
    rReactorResidenceTime_s := 10.0;
END_IF;

(* Biomass Organic Conversion Efficiency fraction: eta = 1.0 - exp(-k * tau) *)
rOrganicConversionEff := 1.0 - EXP(-rReactionKineticsRate_k * rReactorResidenceTime_s);
IF rOrganicConversionEff > 0.96 THEN
    rOrganicConversionEff := 0.96;
ELSIF rOrganicConversionEff < 0.10 THEN
    rOrganicConversionEff := 0.10;
END_IF;

(* Estimated Real-Time Phase Mass Yields [kg/h] *)
(* Biocrude Heavy Hydrocarbon Phase (~36% of dry organic matter) *)
rBiocrudeYieldEst_kgh := rSlurryMassFlowRate * (rFeedSlurryDrySolids_pct / 100.0) *
    (1.0 - (rSlurryAshContent_pct / 100.0)) * rOrganicConversionEff * 0.382;

(* Carbonaceous Hydrochar Phase (~18% of dry organic matter) *)
rHydrocharYieldEst_kgh := rSlurryMassFlowRate * (rFeedSlurryDrySolids_pct / 100.0) *
    (1.0 - (rSlurryAshContent_pct / 100.0)) * (1.0 - rOrganicConversionEff) * 0.35;

(* Aqueous Dissolved Organics Phase (VFAs, amino acids, glycerol, ammonium salts) *)
rAqueousOrganicsYield_kgh := rSlurryMassFlowRate * (rFeedSlurryDrySolids_pct / 100.0) *
    (1.0 - (rSlurryAshContent_pct / 100.0)) * rOrganicConversionEff * 0.420;

(* Net Reactor Thermal Duty [kW]: Sensible Enthalpy + Endothermic Cracking Duty *)
rReactorThermalDuty_kW := ((rSlurryMassFlowRate / 3600.0) * 4.184 * (rVotedReactorTemp - rReactorInletSlurryTemp)) +
    ((rBiocrudeYieldEst_kgh / 3600.0) * 320.0);

(* ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* 7.0 MULTI-STAGE PRESSURE LETDOWN & HYDRAULIC ENERGY RECOVERY TURBINE (HERT) DYNAMICS     *)
(* Letdown Stage 1: 220 bar -> 25 bar. Stage 2: 25 bar -> 1.8 bar. Cavitation Prevention.    *)
(* ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* High-Pressure Stage-1 Differential Across Backpressure Choke and HERT *)
rDeltaP_LetdownStage1 := rVotedReactorPress - rIntermediateFlashPress_bar;
IF rDeltaP_LetdownStage1 < 5.0 THEN
    rDeltaP_LetdownStage1 := 5.0;
END_IF;

(* Antoine Water Saturation Vapor Pressure at Letdown Trim Temperature [bar] *)
rWaterSatVaporPress_bar := EXP(11.6834 - (3816.44 / (rChokeTrimBodyTemp_degC + 227.02)));

(* Choke Incipient Cavitation Parameter: sigma = (P_down - P_vap) / (P_up - P_down) *)
rCavitationIndexSigma := (rIntermediateFlashPress_bar - rWaterSatVaporPress_bar) / rDeltaP_LetdownStage1;

(* Cavitation Mitigation & Severe Vibration Protection *)
IF rChokeTrimVibration_mm_s > 7.5 THEN
    dwAlarmWord_2 := dwAlarmWord_2 OR 16#0000_0002; (* Bit 1: Ceramic Choke Severe Flashing Vibration *)
    (* Emergency Choke Trimming: Open Choke 4% to shift pressure drop downstream *)
    rBackpressureChokeDemand_pct := rBackpressureChokeDemand_pct + 4.0;
ELSIF rCavitationIndexSigma < 0.12 THEN
    dwWarningWord := dwWarningWord OR 16#0000_1000; (* Bit 12: Incipient Supercritical Flashing Cavitation *)
END_IF;

(* Hydraulic Energy Recovery Turbine (HERT) Performance Formulation *)
IF (NOT bInhibitHERT) AND (iActiveState = 40 (* PRODUCTION *)) THEN
    bHERT_Online := TRUE;
    (* Net Hydraulic Head [m]: H = DeltaP * 10^5 / (rho * g) *)
    rHERT_HydraulicHead_m := (rDeltaP_LetdownStage1 * 100000.0) / (rSlurryFeedDensity * c_rGravityAcc);
    
    (* Theoretical Hydraulic Power Exergy [kW]: P_hyd = Q * DeltaP / 36000 *)
    rHERT_IdealHydPower_kW := ((rSlurryMassFlowRate / rSlurryFeedDensity) * rDeltaP_LetdownStage1) / 36.0;
    
    (* Turbine Efficiency Curve: Peak 72% at 2950 rpm *)
    rTmpDelta := (rHERT_ShaftSpeed_rpm / 2950.0) - 1.0;
    rHERT_EfficiencyCoeff := 0.725 * (1.0 - (1.8 * rTmpDelta * rTmpDelta));
    IF rHERT_EfficiencyCoeff < 0.20 THEN
        rHERT_EfficiencyCoeff := 0.20;
    END_IF;
    
    (* Net Electrical Power Generated and Exported to Plant DC Bus [kW] *)
    rSpecificEnergyRecovery_kW := rHERT_IdealHydPower_kW * rHERT_EfficiencyCoeff * 0.94; (* Generator eff 94% *)
    rHERT_SpeedDemand_rpm := 2950.0;
ELSE
    bHERT_Online := FALSE;
    rSpecificEnergyRecovery_kW := 0.0;
    rHERT_SpeedDemand_rpm := 0.0;
END_IF;

(* Secondary Stage Aqueous Phase Flash Letdown Control (25 bar -> 1.8 bar) *)
(* Regulates Intermediate Flash Level around 48% and Pressure at 25 bar *)
rLetdownStage2Demand_pct := 32.5 + (1.2 * (rFlashLiquidLevel_pct - 48.0)) + (0.8 * (rIntermediateFlashPress_bar - 25.0));
IF rLetdownStage2Demand_pct > 90.0 THEN
    rLetdownStage2Demand_pct := 90.0;
ELSIF rLetdownStage2Demand_pct < 10.0 THEN
    rLetdownStage2Demand_pct := 10.0;
END_IF;

(* ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* 8.0 6-STATE CONSTRAINED MODEL PREDICTIVE CONTROL (MPC) OPTIMIZATION ENGINE                *)
(* Computes state deviations, one-step ahead prediction, analytical QP Hessian & gradient,   *)
(* and optimal constrained control increments for dynamic backpressure and feed drive.       *)
(* ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* Calculate State Deviation Vector x from Nominal Equilibrium Operating Point *)
x1_PressDev      := rVotedReactorPress - c_rNominalReactorPressure_bar;
x2_FlowDev       := rSlurryMassFlowRate - c_rNominalSlurryRate_kgh;
x3_TempDev       := rVotedReactorTemp - c_rNominalReactorTemp_degC;
x4_CycDiffDev    := rVotedCycloneDiffP - 1.85;
x5_FlashPressDev := rIntermediateFlashPress_bar - c_rNominalFlash1Pressure_bar;
x6_HertTorqueDev := (rHERT_RecoveredPower_kW * 3.14159 / (rHERT_ShaftSpeed_rpm * 0.10472)) - 145.0;

(* State Prediction: x_pred = Ad * x *)
x1_Pred := Ad_11*x1_PressDev + Ad_12*x2_FlowDev + Ad_13*x3_TempDev + Ad_14*x4_CycDiffDev + Ad_15*x5_FlashPressDev + Ad_16*x6_HertTorqueDev;
x2_Pred := Ad_21*x1_PressDev + Ad_22*x2_FlowDev + Ad_23*x3_TempDev + Ad_24*x4_CycDiffDev + Ad_25*x5_FlashPressDev + Ad_26*x6_HertTorqueDev;
x3_Pred := Ad_31*x1_PressDev + Ad_32*x2_FlowDev + Ad_33*x3_TempDev + Ad_34*x4_CycDiffDev + Ad_35*x5_FlashPressDev + Ad_36*x6_HertTorqueDev;
x4_Pred := Ad_41*x1_PressDev + Ad_42*x2_FlowDev + Ad_43*x3_TempDev + Ad_44*x4_CycDiffDev + Ad_45*x5_FlashPressDev + Ad_46*x6_HertTorqueDev;
x5_Pred := Ad_51*x1_PressDev + Ad_52*x2_FlowDev + Ad_53*x3_TempDev + Ad_54*x4_CycDiffDev + Ad_55*x5_FlashPressDev + Ad_56*x6_HertTorqueDev;
x6_Pred := Ad_61*x1_PressDev + Ad_62*x2_FlowDev + Ad_63*x3_TempDev + Ad_64*x4_CycDiffDev + Ad_65*x5_FlashPressDev + Ad_66*x6_HertTorqueDev;

(* Analytical Quadratic Hessian Matrix: H = 2 * (B^T * Q * B + R) *)
rHessian_11 := 2.0 * (
    (Bd_11*Bd_11*rMPC_Q_Press) +
    (Bd_21*Bd_21*rMPC_Q_Flow) +
    (Bd_31*Bd_31*rMPC_Q_Temp) +
    (Bd_41*Bd_41*rMPC_Q_CycP) +
    (Bd_51*Bd_51*rMPC_Q_FlashP) +
    (Bd_61*Bd_61*rMPC_Q_HertTorque) +
    rMPC_R_dChoke);

rHessian_12 := 2.0 * (
    (Bd_11*Bd_12*rMPC_Q_Press) +
    (Bd_21*Bd_22*rMPC_Q_Flow) +
    (Bd_31*Bd_32*rMPC_Q_Temp) +
    (Bd_41*Bd_42*rMPC_Q_CycP) +
    (Bd_51*Bd_52*rMPC_Q_FlashP) +
    (Bd_61*Bd_62*rMPC_Q_HertTorque));

rHessian_22 := 2.0 * (
    (Bd_12*Bd_12*rMPC_Q_Press) +
    (Bd_22*Bd_22*rMPC_Q_Flow) +
    (Bd_32*Bd_32*rMPC_Q_Temp) +
    (Bd_42*Bd_42*rMPC_Q_CycP) +
    (Bd_52*Bd_52*rMPC_Q_FlashP) +
    (Bd_62*Bd_62*rMPC_Q_HertTorque) +
    rMPC_R_dPumpSpeed);

(* Hessian Determinant *)
rDetHessian := (rHessian_11 * rHessian_22) - (rHessian_12 * rHessian_12);
IF rDetHessian < 0.001 THEN
    rDetHessian := 0.001; (* Regularization to prevent singularity *)
END_IF;

(* Analytical Cost Function Gradient Vector: g = 2 * B^T * Q * x_pred *)
rGrad_1 := 2.0 * (
    (Bd_11 * rMPC_Q_Press * x1_Pred) +
    (Bd_21 * rMPC_Q_Flow * x2_Pred) +
    (Bd_31 * rMPC_Q_Temp * x3_Pred) +
    (Bd_41 * rMPC_Q_CycP * x4_Pred) +
    (Bd_51 * rMPC_Q_FlashP * x5_Pred) +
    (Bd_61 * rMPC_Q_HertTorque * x6_Pred));

rGrad_2 := 2.0 * (
    (Bd_12 * rMPC_Q_Press * x1_Pred) +
    (Bd_22 * rMPC_Q_Flow * x2_Pred) +
    (Bd_32 * rMPC_Q_Temp * x3_Pred) +
    (Bd_42 * rMPC_Q_CycP * x4_Pred) +
    (Bd_52 * rMPC_Q_FlashP * x5_Pred) +
    (Bd_62 * rMPC_Q_HertTorque * x6_Pred));

(* Unconstrained Quadratic Step: Delta_u = - H^-1 * g *)
rOptDeltaChoke     := -(( rHessian_22 * rGrad_1) - (rHessian_12 * rGrad_2)) / rDetHessian;
rOptDeltaPumpSpeed := -((-rHessian_12 * rGrad_1) + (rHessian_11 * rGrad_2)) / rDetHessian;

(* Enforce Slew Rate Constraints per Execution Scan *)
IF rOptDeltaChoke > c_rMaxDeltaChokePct THEN
    rOptDeltaChoke := c_rMaxDeltaChokePct;
ELSIF rOptDeltaChoke < -c_rMaxDeltaChokePct THEN
    rOptDeltaChoke := -c_rMaxDeltaChokePct;
END_IF;

IF rOptDeltaPumpSpeed > c_rMaxDeltaPumpSpeedRpm THEN
    rOptDeltaPumpSpeed := c_rMaxDeltaPumpSpeedRpm;
ELSIF rOptDeltaPumpSpeed < -c_rMaxDeltaPumpSpeedRpm THEN
    rOptDeltaPumpSpeed := -c_rMaxDeltaPumpSpeedRpm;
END_IF;

(* ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* 9.0 MULTI-STAGE FINITE STATE MACHINE (SEQUENTIAL CONTROL LOGIC)                           *)
(* Manages Cold Idle, Preheat, Supercritical Transition, Slurry Feed, Steady-State, Salt     *)
(* Blowdown, Hot Water Flush, Controlled Cooldown, and Emergency SIS Trip.                   *)
(* ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
CASE iState OF
    0: (* ========================================================================= *)
       (* STATE 0: COLD INACTIVE IDLE / NITROGEN PURGED STANDBY                     *)
       (* ========================================================================= *)
        bSystemRunning                  := FALSE;
        bSystemReady                    := bEmergencyStop AND (NOT bSystemTrip);
        rFeedPumpSpeedDemand_rpm        := 0.0;
        rBackpressureChokeDemand_pct    := 0.0;
        rSaltBlowdownValveDemand_pct    := 0.0;
        rHERT_SpeedDemand_rpm           := 0.0;
        rLetdownStage2Demand_pct        := 0.0;
        rReactorBurnerDutyDemand_kW     := 0.0;
        rQuenchInjectionValveDemand_pct := 0.0;
        rSaltWashWaterPumpDemand_pct    := 0.0;
        rStateTimerAccumSec             := 0.0;
        
        dwSystemStatusWord := dwSystemStatusWord AND 16#FFFF_0000;
        dwSystemStatusWord := dwSystemStatusWord OR 16#0000_0001; (* State 0 Active *)
        
        IF bEnableSystem AND bSystemReady THEN
            iState := 10; (* Transition to Water Preheat & Pressurization *)
        END_IF;

    10: (* ======================================================================== *)
        (* STATE 10: AUXILIARY DI WATER PREHEAT & HYDRAULIC PRESSURIZATION          *)
        (* Carrier: Demineralized Water. Pressurizing to 180 bar, Heating to 280 deg C*)
        (* ======================================================================== *)
        bSystemRunning      := TRUE;
        rStateTimerAccumSec := rStateTimerAccumSec + c_rScanTimeSec;
        
        dwSystemStatusWord := (dwSystemStatusWord AND 16#FFFF_0000) OR 16#0000_0002;
        
        (* Slowly Ramp Water Feed Pump to Build Initial Backpressure *)
        IF rFeedPumpSpeedDemand_rpm < 45.0 THEN
            rFeedPumpSpeedDemand_rpm := rFeedPumpSpeedDemand_rpm + 0.15;
        END_IF;
        
        (* Modulate Dynamic Backpressure Valve to Target 180 bar on Carrier Water *)
        IF rVotedReactorPress < 175.0 THEN
            rBackpressureChokeDemand_pct := 14.0; (* Restricted to pack lines *)
        ELSE
            rBackpressureChokeDemand_pct := 22.0 + (0.35 * (rVotedReactorPress - 180.0));
        END_IF;
        
        (* Fire Shell-and-Tube Heater to 280 deg C *)
        rReactorBurnerDutyDemand_kW := 380.0;
        
        (* Transition Criteria: Pressure >= 175 bar AND Core Temp >= 275 deg C *)
        IF (rVotedReactorPress >= 175.0) AND (rVotedReactorTemp >= 275.0) THEN
            iState := 20; (* Transition to Subcritical Transition *)
            rStateTimerAccumSec := 0.0;
        END_IF;
        
        IF NOT bEnableSystem THEN
            iState := 80; (* Abort to Controlled Depressurization *)
        END_IF;

    20: (* ======================================================================== *)
        (* STATE 20: SUBCRITICAL TARGET TRANSITION (220 BAR, 350 DEG C ON WATER)   *)
        (* Brings Carrier Water to Supercritical Interface. Dielectric drops ~ 15.  *)
        (* ======================================================================== *)
        rStateTimerAccumSec := rStateTimerAccumSec + c_rScanTimeSec;
        dwSystemStatusWord := (dwSystemStatusWord AND 16#FFFF_0000) OR 16#0000_0004;
        
        (* Engage MPC Algorithm on Carrier Water *)
        rBackpressureChokeDemand_pct := rBackpressureChokeDemand_pct + (0.5 * rOptDeltaChoke);
        rFeedPumpSpeedDemand_rpm     := rFeedPumpSpeedDemand_rpm + (0.5 * rOptDeltaPumpSpeed);
        
        (* Clamp Actuators within Operational Range *)
        IF rBackpressureChokeDemand_pct > c_rMaxChokeOpeningPct THEN rBackpressureChokeDemand_pct := c_rMaxChokeOpeningPct; END_IF;
        IF rBackpressureChokeDemand_pct < c_rMinChokeOpeningPct THEN rBackpressureChokeDemand_pct := c_rMinChokeOpeningPct; END_IF;
        IF rFeedPumpSpeedDemand_rpm > 120.0 THEN rFeedPumpSpeedDemand_rpm := 120.0; END_IF;
        IF rFeedPumpSpeedDemand_rpm < 30.0  THEN rFeedPumpSpeedDemand_rpm := 30.0;  END_IF;
        
        (* Ramp Burner Thermal Duty to reach 350 deg C *)
        rReactorBurnerDutyDemand_kW := 450.0 + (5.5 * (350.0 - rVotedReactorTemp));
        IF rReactorBurnerDutyDemand_kW > 650.0 THEN rReactorBurnerDutyDemand_kW := 650.0; END_IF;
        
        (* Transition Permissive: Core at 220 bar (+/- 4 bar) and 350 deg C (+/- 3 deg C) *)
        IF (ABS(rVotedReactorPress - 220.0) <= 4.0) AND (ABS(rVotedReactorTemp - 350.0) <= 3.5) THEN
            IF bStartSlurryFeed THEN
                iState := 30; (* Operator approved switchover to biosolids *)
                rStateTimerAccumSec := 0.0;
            END_IF;
        END_IF;
        
        IF NOT bEnableSystem THEN
            iState := 70; (* Flush and shutdown *)
        END_IF;

    30: (* ======================================================================== *)
        (* STATE 30: BIOSOLIDS SLURRY FEED SWITCHOVER & RHEOLOGY ADAPTATION          *)
        (* Progressively diverts DI water to high-solids municipal biosolids feed.  *)
        (* Herschel-Bulkley yield stress increases from 0 to 45 Pa.                 *)
        (* ======================================================================== *)
        rStateTimerAccumSec := rStateTimerAccumSec + c_rScanTimeSec;
        dwSystemStatusWord := (dwSystemStatusWord AND 16#FFFF_0000) OR 16#0000_0008;
        
        (* Apply Dynamic Feed Forward Compensation for Slurry Viscosity Spike *)
        rBackpressureChokeDemand_pct := rBackpressureChokeDemand_pct + rOptDeltaChoke + (0.015 * rFeedSlurryDrySolids_pct);
