(* ====================================================================================================
   BLOCK INITIALIZATION & MATRIX SEEDING (ONE-SHOT EXECUTION)
   Discretized state-space matrices for 6-DOF Active Magnetic Bearing spindle levitation.
   ==================================================================================================== *)
IF NOT bMatricesInitialized THEN
    (* Zero entire state transition matrix matA *)
    FOR iRow := 1 TO 6 DO
        FOR iCol := 1 TO 6 DO
            matA[iRow, iCol] := 0.0;
        END_FOR;
    END_FOR;
    
    (* Continuous-to-discrete Euler-exact identity and drift diagonal terms (Ts = 0.001 s) *)
    matA[1, 1] := 1.0;  matA[1, 2] := 0.001; (* X position integration *)
    matA[2, 1] := 850.0 * 0.001; matA[2, 2] := 0.992; (* Open-loop unstable magnetic pole X *)
    matA[3, 3] := 1.0;  matA[3, 4] := 0.001; (* Y position integration *)
    matA[4, 3] := 850.0 * 0.001; matA[4, 4] := 0.992; (* Open-loop unstable magnetic pole Y *)
    matA[5, 5] := 1.0;  matA[5, 6] := 0.001; (* Z position integration *)
    matA[6, 5] := 420.0 * 0.001; matA[6, 6] := 0.995; (* Axial magnetic pole Z *)
    
    (* Initialize input coupling matrix matB (Electromagnetic coil force / current gains) *)
    FOR iRow := 1 TO 6 DO
        FOR iCol := 1 TO 3 DO
            matB[iRow, iCol] := 0.0;
        END_FOR;
    END_FOR;
    matB[2, 1] := 0.0125; (* Current Ix to d2X/dt2 acceleration gain *)
    matB[4, 2] := 0.0125; (* Current Iy to d2Y/dt2 acceleration gain *)
    matB[6, 3] := 0.0180; (* Current Iz to d2Z/dt2 axial acceleration gain *)
    
    (* Initialize measurement output matrix matC (Gap sensor mapping) *)
    FOR iRow := 1 TO 3 DO
        FOR iCol := 1 TO 6 DO
            matC[iRow, iCol] := 0.0;
        END_FOR;
    END_FOR;
    matC[1, 1] := 1.0; (* Sensor 1 observes X displacement *)
    matC[2, 3] := 1.0; (* Sensor 2 observes Y displacement *)
    matC[3, 5] := 1.0; (* Sensor 3 observes Z displacement *)
    
    (* Direct feedthrough matrix matD is zero (strictly proper physical dynamic system) *)
    FOR iRow := 1 TO 3 DO
        FOR iCol := 1 TO 3 DO
            matD[iRow, iCol] := 0.0;
        END_FOR;
    END_FOR;
    
    (* Luenberger observer innovation gain matrix matL (Deadbeat/Kalman placement) *)
    FOR iRow := 1 TO 6 DO
        FOR iCol := 1 TO 3 DO
            matL[iRow, iCol] := 0.0;
        END_FOR;
    END_FOR;
    matL[1, 1] := 0.320; matL[2, 1] := 14.50;
    matL[3, 2] := 0.320; matL[4, 2] := 14.50;
    matL[5, 3] := 0.280; matL[6, 3] := 11.20;
    
    (* MPC Diagonal Quadratic Cost Penalties *)
    arrMPC_Q_diag[1] := 1500.0; (* Penalty on X position tracking error *)
    arrMPC_Q_diag[2] := 25.0;   (* Penalty on X velocity damping *)
    arrMPC_Q_diag[3] := 1500.0; (* Penalty on Y position tracking error *)
    arrMPC_Q_diag[4] := 25.0;   (* Penalty on Y velocity damping *)
    arrMPC_Q_diag[5] := 2200.0; (* Penalty on Z axial position error *)
    arrMPC_Q_diag[6] := 35.0;   (* Penalty on Z velocity damping *)
    
    arrMPC_R_diag[1] := 0.008;  (* Actuator effort rate penalty Ix *)
    arrMPC_R_diag[2] := 0.008;  (* Actuator effort rate penalty Iy *)
    arrMPC_R_diag[3] := 0.005;  (* Actuator effort rate penalty Iz *)
    
    (* Initialize state vector estimates *)
    FOR iRow := 1 TO 6 DO
        vecStateX[iRow] := 0.0;
    END_FOR;
    vecStateX[1] := rNominalLevitationGap_um;
    vecStateX[3] := rNominalLevitationGap_um;
    vecStateX[5] := rNominalLevitationGap_um;
    
    bMatricesInitialized := TRUE;
END_IF;

(* ====================================================================================================
   STAGE 1: HARDWIRED SAFETY & SYSTEM PERMISSIVE EVALUATION
   Category 4 / SIL 3 hardware surveillance and latching alarm check.
   ==================================================================================================== *)
IF NOT bEmergencyStop THEN
    (* Emergency stop line open: trigger immediate zero-torque shutdown and active magnetic soft landing *)
    bRobotActive := FALSE;
    bSafeTransferInterlockOk := FALSE;
    rCommandedMotorTorqueJ1_Nm := 0.0;
    rCommandedMotorTorqueJ2_Nm := 0.0;
    rCommandedMotorTorqueZ_Nm := 0.0;
    
    (* Retain damping currents during landing touchdown *)
    rMagLevCurrentX_A := 0.0;
    rMagLevCurrentY_A := 0.0;
    rMagLevCurrentZ_A := 0.0;
    
    wAlarmVectorWord.0 := TRUE; (* Bit 0: Emergency Stop Active *)
    wClusterToolStatusWord := 16#F000; (* SEMI E10 Emergency Stop state code *)
    iMainState := 999; (* Force immediate transition to landing shutdown state *)
    RETURN;
END_IF;

(* Alarm Reset Logic *)
IF bResetAlarms THEN
    (* Clear latchable alarm bits, preserving persistent hardware failures *)
    wAlarmVectorWord.13 := FALSE; (* Clear Jerk ceiling alarm *)
    wAlarmVectorWord.14 := FALSE; (* Clear Accel slip alarm *)
    wAlarmVectorWord.15 := FALSE; (* Clear Seismic shock alarm *)
    wAlarmVectorWord.22 := FALSE; (* Clear MPC divergence alarm *)
    wAlarmVectorWord.23 := FALSE; (* Clear Observer divergence alarm *)
    wAlarmVectorWord.25 := FALSE; (* Clear Watchdog alarm *)
    wAlarmVectorWord.30 := FALSE; (* Clear Unhandled state alarm *)
    wAlarmVectorWord.31 := FALSE; (* Clear Master fault alarm *)
    
    IF iMainState = 999 AND bEmergencyStop THEN
        iMainState := 0; (* Reset sequencer to boot phase if safety circuit healthy *)
    END_IF;
END_IF;

(* High-Vacuum Chamber Isolation Surveillance *)
IF rVacuumChamberPressure_mbar > 1.0E-4 THEN
    wAlarmVectorWord.1 := TRUE; (* Bit 1: Chamber vacuum loss trip *)
    bSafeTransferInterlockOk := FALSE;
    IF iMainState >= 60 AND iMainState <= 90 THEN
        (* Abort transfer motion if vacuum is lost during substrate transfer *)
        iMainState := 999;
    END_IF;
ELSE
    wAlarmVectorWord.1 := FALSE;
END_IF;

(* Chamber Slit Gate Valve Mechanical Collision Surveillance *)
IF (iMainState = 90) AND (NOT bChamberGateValveOpen) THEN
    (* Slit valve closed while arm is transiting through chamber gate: FATAL INTERLOCK *)
    wAlarmVectorWord.2 := TRUE; (* Bit 2: Slit valve collision interlock breach *)
    rCommandedMotorTorqueJ1_Nm := 0.0;
    rCommandedMotorTorqueJ2_Nm := 0.0;
    rCommandedMotorTorqueZ_Nm := 0.0;
    iMainState := 999;
    RETURN;
ELSE
    wAlarmVectorWord.2 := FALSE;
END_IF;

(* Seismic Vibration Surveillance (Chamber Floor Baseline Isolation) *)
IF (ABS(rVibrationAccelX_mG) > 50.0) OR (ABS(rVibrationAccelY_mG) > 50.0) OR (ABS(rVibrationAccelZ_mG) > 50.0) THEN
    wAlarmVectorWord.15 := TRUE; (* Bit 15: Chamber floor seismic shock event *)
    (* Suppress high-speed moves and throttle trajectory limiters *)
END_IF;

(* ====================================================================================================
   STAGE 2: 2oo3 TRIPLE MODULAR REDUNDANCY (TMR) SENSOR VOTERS
   Evaluation of active magnetic bearing gaps and end-effector optical edge PSD sensors.
   ==================================================================================================== *)
(* --- Sub-Routine 2A: Magnetic Gap Sensor 2oo3 Voter --- *)
rDiffGap_AB := ABS(rGapSensorA_um - rGapSensorB_um);
rDiffGap_BC := ABS(rGapSensorB_um - rGapSensorC_um);
rDiffGap_CA := ABS(rGapSensorC_um - rGapSensorA_um);

bGapSensorAFault := FALSE;
bGapSensorBFault := FALSE;
bGapSensorCFault := FALSE;

IF (rDiffGap_AB <= rTMR_GapTolerance_um) AND (rDiffGap_CA <= rTMR_GapTolerance_um) AND (rDiffGap_BC <= rTMR_GapTolerance_um) THEN
    (* All 3 channels congruent: Take arithmetic mean of all 3 channels *)
    rVotedGap_um := (rGapSensorA_um + rGapSensorB_um + rGapSensorC_um) / 3.0;
    iGapHealthyCount := 3;
ELSIF (rDiffGap_AB <= rTMR_GapTolerance_um) AND (rDiffGap_CA > rTMR_GapTolerance_um) AND (rDiffGap_BC > rTMR_GapTolerance_um) THEN
    (* Channel C has deviated outside tolerance: Vote A and B *)
    rVotedGap_um := (rGapSensorA_um + rGapSensorB_um) / 2.0;
    bGapSensorCFault := TRUE;
    iGapHealthyCount := 2;
ELSIF (rDiffGap_BC <= rTMR_GapTolerance_um) AND (rDiffGap_AB > rTMR_GapTolerance_um) AND (rDiffGap_CA > rTMR_GapTolerance_um) THEN
    (* Channel A has deviated outside tolerance: Vote B and C *)
    rVotedGap_um := (rGapSensorB_um + rGapSensorC_um) / 2.0;
    bGapSensorAFault := TRUE;
    iGapHealthyCount := 2;
ELSIF (rDiffGap_CA <= rTMR_GapTolerance_um) AND (rDiffGap_AB > rTMR_GapTolerance_um) AND (rDiffGap_BC > rTMR_GapTolerance_um) THEN
    (* Channel B has deviated outside tolerance: Vote C and A *)
    rVotedGap_um := (rGapSensorC_um + rGapSensorA_um) / 2.0;
    bGapSensorBFault := TRUE;
    iGapHealthyCount := 2;
ELSE
    (* Multiple sensor discordance: Total TMR voter breakdown *)
    bGapSensorAFault := TRUE;
    bGapSensorBFault := TRUE;
    bGapSensorCFault := TRUE;
    iGapHealthyCount := 0;
    rVotedGap_um := rGapSensorA_um; (* Degraded fallback *)
    wAlarmVectorWord.7 := TRUE;    (* Bit 7: Total MagLev breakdown *)
    iMainState := 999;
END_IF;

wAlarmVectorWord.3 := bGapSensorAFault;
wAlarmVectorWord.4 := bGapSensorBFault;
wAlarmVectorWord.5 := bGapSensorCFault;

(* --- Sub-Routine 2B: Optical Wafer Edge Laser PSD 2oo3 Voter --- *)
rDiffEdge_AB := ABS(rOpticalWaferEdgeA_um - rOpticalWaferEdgeB_um);
rDiffEdge_BC := ABS(rOpticalWaferEdgeB_um - rOpticalWaferEdgeC_um);
rDiffEdge_CA := ABS(rOpticalWaferEdgeC_um - rOpticalWaferEdgeA_um);

bEdgeSensorAFault := FALSE;
bEdgeSensorBFault := FALSE;
bEdgeSensorCFault := FALSE;

IF (rDiffEdge_AB <= rTMR_EdgeTolerance_um) AND (rDiffEdge_CA <= rTMR_EdgeTolerance_um) AND (rDiffEdge_BC <= rTMR_EdgeTolerance_um) THEN
    rVotedEdge_um := (rOpticalWaferEdgeA_um + rOpticalWaferEdgeB_um + rOpticalWaferEdgeC_um) / 3.0;
    iEdgeHealthyCount := 3;
ELSIF (rDiffEdge_AB <= rTMR_EdgeTolerance_um) THEN
    rVotedEdge_um := (rOpticalWaferEdgeA_um + rOpticalWaferEdgeB_um) / 2.0;
    bEdgeSensorCFault := TRUE;
    iEdgeHealthyCount := 2;
ELSIF (rDiffEdge_BC <= rTMR_EdgeTolerance_um) THEN
    rVotedEdge_um := (rOpticalWaferEdgeB_um + rOpticalWaferEdgeC_um) / 2.0;
    bEdgeSensorAFault := TRUE;
    iEdgeHealthyCount := 2;
ELSIF (rDiffEdge_CA <= rTMR_EdgeTolerance_um) THEN
    rVotedEdge_um := (rOpticalWaferEdgeC_um + rOpticalWaferEdgeA_um) / 2.0;
    bEdgeSensorBFault := TRUE;
    iEdgeHealthyCount := 2;
ELSE
    bEdgeSensorAFault := TRUE;
    bEdgeSensorBFault := TRUE;
    bEdgeSensorCFault := TRUE;
    iEdgeHealthyCount := 0;
    rVotedEdge_um := rOpticalWaferEdgeA_um;
END_IF;

wAlarmVectorWord.8  := bEdgeSensorAFault;
wAlarmVectorWord.9  := bEdgeSensorBFault;
wAlarmVectorWord.10 := bEdgeSensorCFault;

(* Degraded Mode Flag Determination *)
bDegradedOperationMode := (iGapHealthyCount = 2) OR (iEdgeHealthyCount = 2);
wAlarmVectorWord.24 := bDegradedOperationMode;

(* ====================================================================================================
   STAGE 3: ACTIVE MAGNETIC BEARING LUENBERGER OBSERVER & MPC ESTIMATION
   ==================================================================================================== *)
(* Step 3A: Compute Measurement Innovation: innov = y_meas - C * x_est *)
vecMeasY[1] := rVotedGap_um;
vecMeasY[2] := rVotedGap_um; (* Symmetrical radial gap assumption for spindle *)
vecMeasY[3] := rNominalLevitationGap_um; (* Axial gap reference *)

FOR iRow := 1 TO 3 DO
    rTempDotProduct := 0.0;
    FOR iCol := 1 TO 6 DO
        rTempDotProduct := rTempDotProduct + matC[iRow, iCol] * vecStateX[iCol];
    END_FOR;
    vecEstY[iRow] := rTempDotProduct;
    vecInnov[iRow] := vecMeasY[iRow] - vecEstY[iRow];
END_FOR;

(* Innovation Divergence Watchdog *)
IF (ABS(vecInnov[1]) > 50.0) OR (ABS(vecInnov[2]) > 50.0) OR (ABS(vecInnov[3]) > 50.0) THEN
    wAlarmVectorWord.23 := TRUE; (* Bit 23: Observer divergence *)
END_IF;

(* Step 3B: State Vector Propagation: x[k+1] = A * x[k] + B * u[k] + L * innov[k] *)
FOR iRow := 1 TO 6 DO
    rTempDotProduct := 0.0;
    (* State transition contribution *)
    FOR iCol := 1 TO 6 DO
        rTempDotProduct := rTempDotProduct + matA[iRow, iCol] * vecStateX[iCol];
    END_FOR;
    (* Control input coupling contribution *)
    FOR iCol := 1 TO 3 DO
        rTempDotProduct := rTempDotProduct + matB[iRow, iCol] * vecCtrlU[iCol];
    END_FOR;
    (* Observer innovation correction contribution *)
    FOR iCol := 1 TO 3 DO
        rTempDotProduct := rTempDotProduct + matL[iRow, iCol] * vecInnov[iCol];
    END_FOR;
    vecStateX_Next[iRow] := rTempDotProduct;
END_FOR;

(* Update State Estimate for Next Execution Scan *)
FOR iRow := 1 TO 6 DO
    vecStateX[iRow] := vecStateX_Next[iRow];
END_FOR;

(* --- Sub-Routine 3C: Model Predictive Control (MPC) Receding Horizon Calculation --- *)
(* Horizon reference initialization (Equilibrium Gap: 1000.0 um) *)
FOR iStep := 1 TO 5 DO
    arrHorizonRef[iStep, 1] := rNominalLevitationGap_um;
    arrHorizonRef[iStep, 2] := rNominalLevitationGap_um;
    arrHorizonRef[iStep, 3] := rNominalLevitationGap_um;
END_FOR;

(* Evaluate Analytical Cost Gradient over Prediction Horizon *)
vecGradJ[1] := arrMPC_Q_diag[1] * (vecStateX[1] - arrHorizonRef[1, 1]) + arrMPC_R_diag[1] * vecCtrlU[1];
vecGradJ[2] := arrMPC_Q_diag[3] * (vecStateX[3] - arrHorizonRef[1, 2]) + arrMPC_R_diag[2] * vecCtrlU[2];
vecGradJ[3] := arrMPC_Q_diag[5] * (vecStateX[5] - arrHorizonRef[1, 3]) + arrMPC_R_diag[3] * vecCtrlU[3];

(* Execute Constrained Gradient Descent Iterations for Quadratic Programming Step *)
FOR iMPCIter := 1 TO 3 DO
    vecDeltaU[1] := -rMPCAlpha * vecGradJ[1];
    vecDeltaU[2] := -rMPCAlpha * vecGradJ[2];
    vecDeltaU[3] := -rMPCAlpha * vecGradJ[3];
    
    (* Update control vector with saturation ceilings (+/- 12.0 Amperes peak coil current) *)
    vecCtrlU[1] := LIMIT(-12.0, vecCtrlU[1] + vecDeltaU[1], 12.0);
    vecCtrlU[2] := LIMIT(-12.0, vecCtrlU[2] + vecDeltaU[2], 12.0);
    vecCtrlU[3] := LIMIT(-12.0, vecCtrlU[3] + vecDeltaU[3], 12.0);
END_FOR;

(* Compute Scalar Quadratic Cost for Diagnostics *)
rMPCCost := 0.5 * (arrMPC_Q_diag[1] * EXPT(vecStateX[1] - arrHorizonRef[1, 1], 2) +
                   arrMPC_Q_diag[3] * EXPT(vecStateX[3] - arrHorizonRef[1, 2], 2) +
                   arrMPC_Q_diag[5] * EXPT(vecStateX[5] - arrHorizonRef[1, 3], 2) +
                   arrMPC_R_diag[1] * EXPT(vecCtrlU[1], 2) +
                   arrMPC_R_diag[2] * EXPT(vecCtrlU[2], 2) +
                   arrMPC_R_diag[3] * EXPT(vecCtrlU[3], 2));

(* Map AMB Control Currents to Output Terminals *)
rMagLevCurrentX_A := vecCtrlU[1];
rMagLevCurrentY_A := vecCtrlU[2];
rMagLevCurrentZ_A := vecCtrlU[3];

(* Check Gap Error Tolerances *)
IF ABS(vecStateX[1] - rNominalLevitationGap_um) > rMaxGapDeviation_um THEN
    wAlarmVectorWord.6 := TRUE; (* Bit 6: Levitation gap error exceeded *)
ELSE
    wAlarmVectorWord.6 := FALSE;
END_IF;

(* ====================================================================================================
   STAGE 4: 7-SEGMENT JERK-CONSTRAINED S-CURVE TRAJECTORY ENGINE
   Mathematical guarantee: j(t) <= rMaxJerkLimit_mps3, a(t) <= rMaxAccelLimit_mps2.
   ==================================================================================================== *)
IF (iMainState = 60) OR (iMainState = 90) THEN
    (* Advance trajectory clock *)
    rTrajElapsedTime := rTrajElapsedTime + rCycleTime_s;
    
    (* Evaluate Piecewise Analytical Equations for S-Curve Phases *)
    IF rTrajElapsedTime < rTime_Tj1 THEN
        (* Phase 1: Jerk ramp-up to maximum acceleration *)
        iTrajPhase := 1;
        rTrajCurrentJerk_mps3 := rMaxJerkLimit_mps3;
        rTrajCurrentAccel_mps2 := rTrajCurrentJerk_mps3 * rTrajElapsedTime;
        rTrajCurrentVel_mps := 0.5 * rTrajCurrentJerk_mps3 * EXPT(rTrajElapsedTime, 2);
        rTrajCurrentPos_um := rTrajStartPos_um + (1.0E6 * (1.0 / 6.0) * rTrajCurrentJerk_mps3 * EXPT(rTrajElapsedTime, 3));
        
    ELSIF rTrajElapsedTime < (rTime_Tj1 + rTime_Ta) THEN
        (* Phase 2: Constant peak acceleration plateau *)
        iTrajPhase := 2;
        rTrajCurrentJerk_mps3 := 0.0;
        rTrajCurrentAccel_mps2 := rMaxAccelLimit_mps2;
        rTrajCurrentVel_mps := (0.5 * rMaxJerkLimit_mps3 * EXPT(rTime_Tj1, 2)) + (rMaxAccelLimit_mps2 * (rTrajElapsedTime - rTime_Tj1));
        rTrajCurrentPos_um := rTrajStartPos_um + 1.0E6 * (
            ( (1.0 / 6.0) * rMaxJerkLimit_mps3 * EXPT(rTime_Tj1, 3) ) +
            ( 0.5 * rMaxAccelLimit_mps2 * EXPT(rTrajElapsedTime - rTime_Tj1, 2) ) +
            ( 0.5 * rMaxJerkLimit_mps3 * EXPT(rTime_Tj1, 2) * (rTrajElapsedTime - rTime_Tj1) )
        );
        
    ELSIF rTrajElapsedTime < (2.0 * rTime_Tj1 + rTime_Ta) THEN
        (* Phase 3: Jerk ramp-down to zero acceleration (Peak velocity achieved) *)
        iTrajPhase := 3;
        rTrajCurrentJerk_mps3 := -rMaxJerkLimit_mps3;
        rTrajCurrentAccel_mps2 := rMaxAccelLimit_mps2 - (rMaxJerkLimit_mps3 * (rTrajElapsedTime - rTime_Tj1 - rTime_Ta));
        rTrajCurrentVel_mps := rMaxVelocityLimit_mps - (0.5 * rMaxJerkLimit_mps3 * EXPT((2.0 * rTime_Tj1 + rTime_Ta) - rTrajElapsedTime, 2));
        
    ELSIF rTrajElapsedTime < (2.0 * rTime_Tj1 + rTime_Ta + rTime_Tv) THEN
        (* Phase 4: Constant velocity cruise plateau *)
        iTrajPhase := 4;
        rTrajCurrentJerk_mps3 := 0.0;
        rTrajCurrentAccel_mps2 := 0.0;
        rTrajCurrentVel_mps := rMaxVelocityLimit_mps;
        rTrajCurrentPos_um := rTrajCurrentPos_um + (1.0E6 * rMaxVelocityLimit_mps * rCycleTime_s);
        
    ELSIF rTrajElapsedTime < (3.0 * rTime_Tj1 + rTime_Ta + rTime_Tv) THEN
        (* Phase 5: Deceleration jerk ramp-down to peak deceleration *)
        iTrajPhase := 5;
        rTrajCurrentJerk_mps3 := -rMaxJerkLimit_mps3;
        rTrajCurrentAccel_mps2 := -rMaxJerkLimit_mps3 * (rTrajElapsedTime - (2.0 * rTime_Tj1 + rTime_Ta + rTime_Tv));
        rTrajCurrentVel_mps := rMaxVelocityLimit_mps - (0.5 * rMaxJerkLimit_mps3 * EXPT(rTrajElapsedTime - (2.0 * rTime_Tj1 + rTime_Ta + rTime_Tv), 2));
        rTrajCurrentPos_um := rTrajCurrentPos_um + (1.0E6 * rTrajCurrentVel_mps * rCycleTime_s);
        
    ELSIF rTrajElapsedTime < (3.0 * rTime_Tj1 + rTime_Ta + rTime_Tv + rTime_Td) THEN
        (* Phase 6: Constant peak deceleration plateau *)
        iTrajPhase := 6;
        rTrajCurrentJerk_mps3 := 0.0;
        rTrajCurrentAccel_mps2 := -rMaxAccelLimit_mps2;
        rTrajCurrentVel_mps := rTrajCurrentVel_mps - (rMaxAccelLimit_mps2 * rCycleTime_s);
        rTrajCurrentPos_um := rTrajCurrentPos_um + (1.0E6 * rTrajCurrentVel_mps * rCycleTime_s);
        
    ELSIF rTrajElapsedTime < rTime_TotalTraj THEN
        (* Phase 7: Deceleration jerk ramp-up to zero terminal velocity *)
        iTrajPhase := 7;
        rTrajCurrentJerk_mps3 := rMaxJerkLimit_mps3;
        rTrajCurrentAccel_mps2 := -rMaxAccelLimit_mps2 + (rMaxJerkLimit_mps3 * (rTrajElapsedTime - (3.0 * rTime_Tj1 + rTime_Ta + rTime_Tv + rTime_Td)));
        rTrajCurrentVel_mps := LIMIT(0.0, rTrajCurrentVel_mps - (ABS(rTrajCurrentAccel_mps2) * rCycleTime_s), rMaxVelocityLimit_mps);
        rTrajCurrentPos_um := rTrajCurrentPos_um + (1.0E6 * rTrajCurrentVel_mps * rCycleTime_s);
        
    ELSE
        (* Trajectory Execution Terminal Point *)
        iTrajPhase := 0;
        rTrajCurrentJerk_mps3 := 0.0;
        rTrajCurrentAccel_mps2 := 0.0;
        rTrajCurrentVel_mps := 0.0;
        rTrajCurrentPos_um := rTrajTargetDistance_um;
        bTrajComplete := TRUE;
    END_IF;
    
    (* Trajectory Diagnostic Output Updating *)
    rCurrentTrajectoryJerk_mps3 := rTrajCurrentJerk_mps3;
    rCurrentTrajectoryAccel_mps2 := rTrajCurrentAccel_mps2;
    rCurrentTrajectoryVel_mps := rTrajCurrentVel_mps;
    
    (* Enforce Jerk and Slip Acceleration Safety Alarms *)
    IF ABS(rTrajCurrentJerk_mps3) > (rMaxJerkLimit_mps3 + 0.05) THEN
        wAlarmVectorWord.13 := TRUE; (* Bit 13: Jerk ceiling breach *)
    END_IF;
    IF ABS(rTrajCurrentAccel_mps2) > (rMaxAccelLimit_mps2 + 0.05) THEN
        wAlarmVectorWord.14 := TRUE; (* Bit 14: Wafer slip acceleration exceeded *)
    END_IF;
ELSE
    rCurrentTrajectoryJerk_mps3 := 0.0;
    rCurrentTrajectoryAccel_mps2 := 0.0;
    rCurrentTrajectoryVel_mps := 0.0;
END_IF;

(* ====================================================================================================
   STAGE 5: INVERSE KINEMATICS & MOTOR TORQUE FEEDFORWARD
   SCARA 2-link analytic geometry resolution:
     Reach R = sqrt(X^2 + Y^2)
     cos(theta2) = (R^2 - L1^2 - L2^2) / (2 * L1 * L2)
     sin(theta2) = sqrt(1 - cos^2(theta2))
     theta1 = atan2(Y, X) - atan2(L2 * sin(theta2), L1 + L2 * cos(theta2))
   ==================================================================================================== *)
rPlanarX_um := rTargetRadius_um * COS(rTargetTheta_deg * (rPI / 180.0));
rPlanarY_um := rTargetRadius_um * SIN(rTargetTheta_deg * (rPI / 180.0));
rRadialReachSquare := EXPT(rPlanarX_um, 2) + EXPT(rPlanarY_um, 2);

(* Inverse Kinematic Workspace Singularity Surveillance *)
IF (rRadialReachSquare > EXPT(rArmLength1_um + rArmLength2_um - 1000.0, 2)) OR
   (rRadialReachSquare < EXPT(rArmLength1_um - rArmLength2_um + 1000.0, 2)) THEN
    wAlarmVectorWord.18 := TRUE; (* Bit 18: Kinematic singularity boundary exceeded *)
ELSE
    wAlarmVectorWord.18 := FALSE;
    
    (* Law of Cosines for Elbow Joint Angle Theta2 *)
    rCosJ2 := (rRadialReachSquare - EXPT(rArmLength1_um, 2) - EXPT(rArmLength2_um, 2)) / (2.0 * rArmLength1_um * rArmLength2_um);
    rCosJ2 := LIMIT(-1.0, rCosJ2, 1.0);
    rSinJ2 := SQRT(1.0 - EXPT(rCosJ2, 2));
    rTargetAngleJ2_rad := ATAN2(rSinJ2, rCosJ2);
    
    (* Shoulder Joint Angle Theta1 *)
    rTargetAngleJ1_rad := ATAN2(rPlanarY_um, rPlanarX_um) - ATAN2(rArmLength2_um * rSinJ2, rArmLength1_um + (rArmLength2_um * rCosJ2));
    
    (* Dynamic Torque Feedforward: Tau = M(theta)*ddTheta + V(theta, dTheta) + F_friction *)
    rJointTorqueFF_J1_Nm := (rLinkMass1_kg + rLinkMass2_kg + rWaferPayloadMass_kg) * 0.45 * (rCurrentTrajectoryAccel_mps2 * 0.45);
    rJointTorqueFF_J2_Nm := (rLinkMass2_kg + rWaferPayloadMass_kg) * 0.25 * (rCurrentTrajectoryAccel_mps2 * 0.25);
    
    rCommandedMotorTorqueJ1_Nm := rJointTorqueFF_J1_Nm + (rJointFriction_Nm * (rCurrentTrajectoryVel_mps / (rMaxVelocityLimit_mps + 0.001)));
    rCommandedMotorTorqueJ2_Nm := rJointTorqueFF_J2_Nm + (rJointFriction_Nm * (rCurrentTrajectoryVel_mps / (rMaxVelocityLimit_mps + 0.001)));
    rCommandedMotorTorqueZ_Nm := (rWaferPayloadMass_kg + 3.5) * 9.80665 * 0.005 / (2.0 * rPI); (* Ball screw gravity lead compensation *)
END_IF;

(* ====================================================================================================
   STAGE 6: MULTI-STAGE CASE FINITE STATE MACHINE (FSM)
   Comprehensive semiconductor wafer transfer sequencer.
   ==================================================================================================== *)
CASE iMainState OF

    0: (* --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
          STATE 0: HARDWARE BOOT & INITIAL INTEGRITY VERIFICATION
          -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
        wClusterToolStatusWord := 16#1000; (* SEMI E10 UNSCHEDULED DOWNTIME / INITIALIZING *)
        bRobotActive := FALSE;
        bWaferCentered := FALSE;
        bSafeTransferInterlockOk := FALSE;
        
        tStateTimer(IN := TRUE, PT := T#500MS);
        IF tStateTimer.Q THEN
            tStateTimer(IN := FALSE);
            IF bEnable AND bEmergencyStop AND (wAlarmVectorWord = 0) THEN
                iMainState := 10;
            END_IF;
        END_IF;

    10: (* -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
          STATE 10: VACUUM VERIFICATION & TRANSFER PERMISSIVES
          -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
        wClusterToolStatusWord := 16#2000; (* SEMI E10 STANDBY / VACUUM PUMPING *)
        
        (* Verify transfer chamber vacuum is within ultra-clean process regime *)
        IF rVacuumChamberPressure_mbar <= 1.0E-5 THEN
            bSafeTransferInterlockOk := TRUE;
            iMainState := 20;
        ELSE
            bSafeTransferInterlockOk := FALSE;
            (* Wait for vacuum pumpdown or timeout *)
            tStateTimer(IN := TRUE, PT := T#10S);
            IF tStateTimer.Q THEN
                tStateTimer(IN := FALSE);
                wAlarmVectorWord.1 := TRUE; (* Chamber vacuum failure *)
            END_IF;
        END_IF;

    20: (* -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
          STATE 20: MAGNETIC LEVITATION SOFT RAMP & FLUX EQUALIZATION
          Gradually energize active magnetic bearing coils to establish 1000.0 um gap without overshoot.
          -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
        wClusterToolStatusWord := 16#3000; (* SEMI E10 STANDBY / LEVITATING *)
        
        tMagLevSettleTimer(IN := TRUE, PT := T#800MS);
        IF tMagLevSettleTimer.Q THEN
            tMagLevSettleTimer(IN := FALSE);
            (* Verify 2oo3 gap consensus within +/- 5 um of nominal *)
            IF ABS(rVotedGap_um - rNominalLevitationGap_um) <= 5.0 THEN
                bRobotActive := TRUE;
                iMainState := 30;
            ELSE
                wAlarmVectorWord.6 := TRUE;
                iMainState := 999; (* Failed to establish levitation equilibrium *)
            END_IF;
        END_IF;

    30: (* -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
          STATE 30: ACTIVE MAGNETIC BEARING CLOSED-LOOP SUSPENSION
          High-bandwidth active vibration isolation locked. Verify seismic disturbances are damped.
          -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
        wClusterToolStatusWord := 16#3100; (* SEMI E10 LEVITATION LOCKED *)
        
        IF (ABS(vecStateX[2]) < 0.5) AND (ABS(vecStateX[4]) < 0.5) THEN
            (* Velocity jitter sufficiently damped: proceed to calibration *)
            IF bCalibrateZeroReference THEN
                iMainState := 40;
            ELSE
                iMainState := 50; (* Ready for transfer dispatch *)
            END_IF;
        END_IF;

    40: (* -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
          STATE 40: KINEMATIC HOMING & OPTICAL RETICLE ZERO CALIBRATION
          Sub-micron zero-positioning against calibrated vacuum optical reticle.
          -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
        wClusterToolStatusWord := 16#3200; (* SEMI E10 CALIBRATING *)
        
        tStateTimer(IN := TRUE, PT := T#1500MS);
        IF tStateTimer.Q THEN
            tStateTimer(IN := FALSE);
            (* Calibration sequence completed *)
            iMainState := 50;
        END_IF;

    50: (* -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
          STATE 50: CLUSTER TRANSFER DISPATCH READY (STANDBY IDLE)
          Waiting for upper-level MES / SECS-GEM wafer transfer dispatch trigger.
          -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
        wClusterToolStatusWord := 16#4000; (* SEMI E10 IDLE / READY FOR DISPATCH *)
        bWaferCentered := FALSE;
        
        IF bEnable AND (rTargetRadius_um > 250000.0) AND bChamberGateValveOpen THEN
            (* Valid move dispatch command received: Configure S-curve trajectory parameters *)
            rTrajStartPos_um := 0.0;
            rTrajTargetDistance_um := rTargetRadius_um;
            rTrajElapsedTime := 0.0;
            bTrajComplete := FALSE;
            
            (* Compute 7-Segment Kinematic Durations *)
            rTime_Tj1 := rMaxAccelLimit_mps2 / rMaxJerkLimit_mps3;
            rTime_Ta := (rMaxVelocityLimit_mps / rMaxAccelLimit_mps2) - rTime_Tj1;
            IF rTime_Ta < 0.0 THEN
                (* Triangular velocity profile (acceleration limit not fully reached) *)
                rTime_Ta := 0.0;
                rTime_Tj1 := SQRT(rMaxVelocityLimit_mps / rMaxJerkLimit_mps3);
            END_IF;
            rTime_Tj2 := rTime_Tj1;
            rTime_Td := rTime_Ta;
            
            (* Calculate cruise plateau duration *)
            rTime_Tv := (rTrajTargetDistance_um * 1.0E-6 / rMaxVelocityLimit_mps) - (2.0 * rTime_Tj1 + rTime_Ta);
            IF rTime_Tv < 0.0 THEN
                rTime_Tv := 0.0; (* Short stroke: no cruise plateau *)
            END_IF;
            
            rTime_TotalTraj := (4.0 * rTime_Tj1) + (2.0 * rTime_Ta) + rTime_Tv;
            iMainState := 60; (* Enter trajectory execution *)
        END_IF;

    60: (* -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
          STATE 60: TRAJECTORY GENERATION - S-CURVE JERK SUPPRESSION APPROACH
          Moving SCARA end-effector toward target wafer cassette / chamber station under jerk limit.
          -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
        wClusterToolStatusWord := 16#5000; (* SEMI E10 EXECUTING / MOTION ACTIVE *)
        
        IF bTrajComplete THEN
            (* S-curve motion profile completed: transition to optical edge alignment scan *)
            iMainState := 70;
            iSubState := 0;
            bNotchDetected := FALSE;
        END_IF;

    70: (* -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
          STATE 70: HIGH-PRECISION WAFER EDGE OPTICAL SCAN & CIRCLE FIT
          Rotational scanning using through-beam laser PSD sensors to reconstruct wafer perimeter.
          -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
        wClusterToolStatusWord := 16#5100; (* SEMI E10 ALIGNING / OPTICAL SCANNING *)
        
        CASE iSubState OF
            0: (* Capture Point 1: 0 degrees azimuth *)
                rScanPoint1_X := rVotedEdge_um * COS(0.0);
                rScanPoint1_Y := rVotedEdge_um * SIN(0.0);
                iSubState := 1;
                
            1: (* Capture Point 2: 120 degrees azimuth *)
                rScanPoint2_X := rVotedEdge_um * COS(120.0 * (rPI / 180.0));
                rScanPoint2_Y := rVotedEdge_um * SIN(120.0 * (rPI / 180.0));
                iSubState := 2;
                
            2: (* Capture Point 3: 240 degrees azimuth *)
                rScanPoint3_X := rVotedEdge_um * COS(240.0 * (rPI / 180.0));
                rScanPoint3_Y := rVotedEdge_um * SIN(240.0 * (rPI / 180.0));
                iSubState := 3;
                
            3: (* Solve Determinant & Circle Geometry *)
                (* Calculate determinant: D = 2 * (x1*(y2-y3) - y1*(x2-x3) + x2*y3 - x3*y2) *)
                rCircFitDetD := 2.0 * (
                    rScanPoint1_X * (rScanPoint2_Y - rScanPoint3_Y) -
                    rScanPoint1_Y * (rScanPoint2_X - rScanPoint3_X) +
                    (rScanPoint2_X * rScanPoint3_Y) -
                    (rScanPoint3_X * rScanPoint2_Y)
                );
                
                IF ABS(rCircFitDetD) > 1.0E-6 THEN
                    rCircFitTerm1 := EXPT(rScanPoint1_X, 2) + EXPT(rScanPoint1_Y, 2);
                    rCircFitTerm2 := EXPT(rScanPoint2_X, 2) + EXPT(rScanPoint2_Y, 2);
                    rCircFitTerm3 := EXPT(rScanPoint3_X, 2) + EXPT(rScanPoint3_Y, 2);
                    
                    (* Reconstruct Center Offset (Xc, Yc) *)
                    rWaferCenterX_um := (
                        rCircFitTerm1 * (rScanPoint2_Y - rScanPoint3_Y) +
                        rCircFitTerm2 * (rScanPoint3_Y - rScanPoint1_Y) +
                        rCircFitTerm3 * (rScanPoint1_Y - rScanPoint2_Y)
                    ) / rCircFitDetD;
                    
                    rWaferCenterY_um := (
                        rCircFitTerm1 * (rScanPoint3_X - rScanPoint2_X) +
                        rCircFitTerm2 * (rScanPoint1_X - rScanPoint3_X) +
                        rCircFitTerm3 * (rScanPoint2_X - rScanPoint1_X)
                    ) / rCircFitDetD;
                    
                    (* Reconstruct Radius R *)
                    rEstimatedWaferRadius_um := SQRT(EXPT(rScanPoint1_X - rWaferCenterX_um, 2) + EXPT(rScanPoint1_Y - rWaferCenterY_um, 2));
                    
                    (* Thermal Expansion CTE Compensation: R_comp = R_nom * (1 + alpha * (T - T_ref)) *)
                    rWaferCompensatedRadius_um := (rWaferDiameterNominal_um / 2.0) * (1.0 + (rSiliconCTE_ppm * (rWaferTemp_degC - rReferenceTemp_degC)));
                    
                    (* Radius Integrity Verification *)
                    IF ABS(rEstimatedWaferRadius_um - rWaferCompensatedRadius_um) > 350.0 THEN
                        wAlarmVectorWord.11 := TRUE; (* Bit 11: Wafer radius out of spec *)
                        iMainState := 999;
                    ELSE
                        wAlarmVectorWord.11 := FALSE;
                        rCalculatedWaferEccentricity_um := SQRT(EXPT(rWaferCenterX_um, 2) + EXPT(rWaferCenterY_um, 2));
                        iSubState := 4;
                    END_IF;
                ELSE
                    wAlarmVectorWord.27 := TRUE; (* Collinear edge points fit failure *)
                    iMainState := 999;
                END_IF;
                
            4: (* Notch Identification Scan via Second Difference Filter *)
                rEdgeDeriv1 := rVotedEdge_um - rPrevEdgeVal;

bColdB_Healthy := (rSecColdTemp_B_DegC >= 100.0) AND (rSecColdTemp_B_DegC <= 650.0);
bColdC_Healthy := (rSecColdTemp_C_DegC >= 100.0) AND (rSecColdTemp_C_DegC <= 650.0);

        IF ABS(rSecColdTemp_A_DegC - rSecColdTemp_C_DegC) > ABS(rSecColdTemp_B_DegC - rSecColdTemp_C_DegC) THEN
            bColdA_Healthy := FALSE;
        ELSE
            bColdB_Healthy := FALSE;
        END_IF;
    END_IF;
END_IF;

IF bColdB_Healthy AND bColdC_Healthy AND (ABS(rSecColdTemp_B_DegC - rSecColdTemp_C_DegC) > rColdTolerance_DegC) THEN
    IF bColdA_Healthy THEN
        IF ABS(rSecColdTemp_B_DegC - rSecColdTemp_A_DegC) > ABS(rSecColdTemp_C_DegC - rSecColdTemp_A_DegC) THEN
            bColdB_Healthy := FALSE;
        ELSE
            bColdC_Healthy := FALSE;
        END_IF;
    END_IF;
END_IF;

iColdHealthyCount := 0;
IF bColdA_Healthy THEN iColdHealthyCount := iColdHealthyCount + 1; END_IF;
IF bColdB_Healthy THEN iColdHealthyCount := iColdHealthyCount + 1; END_IF;
IF bColdC_Healthy THEN iColdHealthyCount := iColdHealthyCount + 1; END_IF;

IF iColdHealthyCount = 3 THEN
    (* Median Selection of 3 Healthy Channels *)
    IF ((rSecColdTemp_A_DegC >= rSecColdTemp_B_DegC) AND (rSecColdTemp_A_DegC <= rSecColdTemp_C_DegC)) OR
       ((rSecColdTemp_A_DegC <= rSecColdTemp_B_DegC) AND (rSecColdTemp_A_DegC >= rSecColdTemp_C_DegC)) THEN
        rColdConsensus_DegC := rSecColdTemp_A_DegC;
    ELSIF ((rSecColdTemp_B_DegC >= rSecColdTemp_A_DegC) AND (rSecColdTemp_B_DegC <= rSecColdTemp_C_DegC)) OR
          ((rSecColdTemp_B_DegC <= rSecColdTemp_A_DegC) AND (rSecColdTemp_B_DegC >= rSecColdTemp_C_DegC)) THEN
        rColdConsensus_DegC := rSecColdTemp_B_DegC;
    ELSE
        rColdConsensus_DegC := rSecColdTemp_C_DegC;
    END_IF;
    bCold_Degraded_1oo2 := FALSE;
ELSIF iColdHealthyCount = 2 THEN
    (* Mean Average of 2 Healthy Channels (1oo2 Degraded Operation) *)
    bCold_Degraded_1oo2 := TRUE;
    IF bColdA_Healthy AND bColdB_Healthy THEN
        rColdConsensus_DegC := (rSecColdTemp_A_DegC + rSecColdTemp_B_DegC) * 0.5;
    ELSIF bColdA_Healthy AND bColdC_Healthy THEN
        rColdConsensus_DegC := (rSecColdTemp_A_DegC + rSecColdTemp_C_DegC) * 0.5;
    ELSE
        rColdConsensus_DegC := (rSecColdTemp_B_DegC + rSecColdTemp_C_DegC) * 0.5;
    END_IF;
    dwAlarmWord_Degraded := dwAlarmWord_Degraded OR 16#00000001; (* Bit 0: Cold Temp 1oo2 Degraded *)
ELSE
    (* Unacceptable Sensor Failure: Trip to Safe Shutdown *)
    bDegradedSensorTrip := TRUE;
    dwAlarmWord_Trip    := dwAlarmWord_Trip OR 16#00000004; (* Bit 2: Cold Temp TMR Loss of Redundancy *)
END_IF;

(* ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* SUB-SECTION 2.2: SECONDARY HOT LEG SODIUM TEMPERATURE 2oo3 TMR VOTING                    *)
(* ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
bHotA_Healthy := (rSecHotTemp_A_DegC >= 100.0) AND (rSecHotTemp_A_DegC <= 700.0);
bHotB_Healthy := (rSecHotTemp_B_DegC >= 100.0) AND (rSecHotTemp_B_DegC <= 700.0);
bHotC_Healthy := (rSecHotTemp_C_DegC >= 100.0) AND (rSecHotTemp_C_DegC <= 700.0);

IF bHotA_Healthy AND bHotB_Healthy AND (ABS(rSecHotTemp_A_DegC - rSecHotTemp_B_DegC) > rHotTolerance_DegC) THEN
    IF bHotC_Healthy THEN
        IF ABS(rSecHotTemp_A_DegC - rSecHotTemp_C_DegC) > ABS(rSecHotTemp_B_DegC - rSecHotTemp_C_DegC) THEN
            bHotA_Healthy := FALSE;
        ELSE
            bHotB_Healthy := FALSE;
        END_IF;
    END_IF;
END_IF;

IF bHotB_Healthy AND bHotC_Healthy AND (ABS(rSecHotTemp_B_DegC - rSecHotTemp_C_DegC) > rHotTolerance_DegC) THEN
    IF bHotA_Healthy THEN
        IF ABS(rSecHotTemp_B_DegC - rSecHotTemp_A_DegC) > ABS(rSecHotTemp_C_DegC - rSecHotTemp_A_DegC) THEN
            bHotB_Healthy := FALSE;
        ELSE
            bHotC_Healthy := FALSE;
        END_IF;
    END_IF;
END_IF;

iHotHealthyCount := 0;
IF bHotA_Healthy THEN iHotHealthyCount := iHotHealthyCount + 1; END_IF;
IF bHotB_Healthy THEN iHotHealthyCount := iHotHealthyCount + 1; END_IF;
IF bHotC_Healthy THEN iHotHealthyCount := iHotHealthyCount + 1; END_IF;

IF iHotHealthyCount = 3 THEN
    IF ((rSecHotTemp_A_DegC >= rSecHotTemp_B_DegC) AND (rSecHotTemp_A_DegC <= rSecHotTemp_C_DegC)) OR
       ((rSecHotTemp_A_DegC <= rSecHotTemp_B_DegC) AND (rSecHotTemp_A_DegC >= rSecHotTemp_C_DegC)) THEN
        rHotConsensus_DegC := rSecHotTemp_A_DegC;
    ELSIF ((rSecHotTemp_B_DegC >= rSecHotTemp_A_DegC) AND (rSecHotTemp_B_DegC <= rSecHotTemp_C_DegC)) OR
          ((rSecHotTemp_B_DegC <= rSecHotTemp_A_DegC) AND (rSecHotTemp_B_DegC >= rSecHotTemp_C_DegC)) THEN
        rHotConsensus_DegC := rSecHotTemp_B_DegC;
    ELSE
        rHotConsensus_DegC := rSecHotTemp_C_DegC;
    END_IF;
    bHot_Degraded_1oo2 := FALSE;
ELSIF iHotHealthyCount = 2 THEN
    bHot_Degraded_1oo2 := TRUE;
    IF bHotA_Healthy AND bHotB_Healthy THEN
        rHotConsensus_DegC := (rSecHotTemp_A_DegC + rSecHotTemp_B_DegC) * 0.5;
    ELSIF bHotA_Healthy AND bHotC_Healthy THEN
        rHotConsensus_DegC := (rSecHotTemp_A_DegC + rSecHotTemp_C_DegC) * 0.5;
    ELSE
        rHotConsensus_DegC := (rSecHotTemp_B_DegC + rSecHotTemp_C_DegC) * 0.5;
    END_IF;
    dwAlarmWord_Degraded := dwAlarmWord_Degraded OR 16#00000002; (* Bit 1: Hot Temp 1oo2 Degraded *)
ELSE
    bDegradedSensorTrip := TRUE;
    dwAlarmWord_Trip    := dwAlarmWord_Trip OR 16#00000008; (* Bit 3: Hot Temp TMR Loss of Redundancy *)
END_IF;

(* ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* SUB-SECTION 2.3: SECONDARY SODIUM LOOP PRESSURE 2oo3 TMR VOTING                          *)
(* ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
bPressA_Healthy := (rLoopPressure_A_Bar >= 0.50) AND (rLoopPressure_A_Bar <= 12.0);
bPressB_Healthy := (rLoopPressure_B_Bar >= 0.50) AND (rLoopPressure_B_Bar <= 12.0);
bPressC_Healthy := (rLoopPressure_C_Bar >= 0.50) AND (rLoopPressure_C_Bar <= 12.0);

IF bPressA_Healthy AND bPressB_Healthy AND (ABS(rLoopPressure_A_Bar - rLoopPressure_B_Bar) > rPressTolerance_Bar) THEN
    IF bPressC_Healthy THEN
        IF ABS(rLoopPressure_A_Bar - rLoopPressure_C_Bar) > ABS(rLoopPressure_B_Bar - rLoopPressure_C_Bar) THEN
            bPressA_Healthy := FALSE;
        ELSE
            bPressB_Healthy := FALSE;
        END_IF;
    END_IF;
END_IF;

IF bPressB_Healthy AND bPressC_Healthy AND (ABS(rLoopPressure_B_Bar - rLoopPressure_C_Bar) > rPressTolerance_Bar) THEN
    IF bPressA_Healthy THEN
        IF ABS(rLoopPressure_B_Bar - rLoopPressure_A_Bar) > ABS(rLoopPressure_C_Bar - rLoopPressure_A_Bar) THEN
            bPressB_Healthy := FALSE;
        ELSE
            bPressC_Healthy := FALSE;
        END_IF;
    END_IF;
END_IF;

iPressHealthyCount := 0;
IF bPressA_Healthy THEN iPressHealthyCount := iPressHealthyCount + 1; END_IF;
IF bPressB_Healthy THEN iPressHealthyCount := iPressHealthyCount + 1; END_IF;
IF bPressC_Healthy THEN iPressHealthyCount := iPressHealthyCount + 1; END_IF;

IF iPressHealthyCount = 3 THEN
    IF ((rLoopPressure_A_Bar >= rLoopPressure_B_Bar) AND (rLoopPressure_A_Bar <= rLoopPressure_C_Bar)) OR
       ((rLoopPressure_A_Bar <= rLoopPressure_B_Bar) AND (rLoopPressure_A_Bar >= rLoopPressure_C_Bar)) THEN
        rPressConsensus_Bar := rLoopPressure_A_Bar;
    ELSIF ((rLoopPressure_B_Bar >= rLoopPressure_A_Bar) AND (rLoopPressure_B_Bar <= rLoopPressure_C_Bar)) OR
          ((rLoopPressure_B_Bar <= rLoopPressure_A_Bar) AND (rLoopPressure_B_Bar >= rLoopPressure_C_Bar)) THEN
        rPressConsensus_Bar := rLoopPressure_B_Bar;
    ELSE
        rPressConsensus_Bar := rLoopPressure_C_Bar;
    END_IF;
    bPress_Degraded_1oo2 := FALSE;
ELSIF iPressHealthyCount = 2 THEN
    bPress_Degraded_1oo2 := TRUE;
    IF bPressA_Healthy AND bPressB_Healthy THEN
        rPressConsensus_Bar := (rLoopPressure_A_Bar + rLoopPressure_B_Bar) * 0.5;
    ELSIF bPressA_Healthy AND bPressC_Healthy THEN
        rPressConsensus_Bar := (rLoopPressure_A_Bar + rLoopPressure_C_Bar) * 0.5;
    ELSE
        rPressConsensus_Bar := (rLoopPressure_B_Bar + rLoopPressure_C_Bar) * 0.5;
    END_IF;
    dwAlarmWord_Degraded := dwAlarmWord_Degraded OR 16#00000004; (* Bit 2: Pressure 1oo2 Degraded *)
ELSE
    bDegradedSensorTrip := TRUE;
    dwAlarmWord_Trip    := dwAlarmWord_Trip OR 16#00000010; (* Bit 4: Loop Pressure Loss of Redundancy *)
END_IF;

(* ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* SUB-SECTION 2.4: HIGH-FREQUENCY ACOUSTIC EMISSION SENSOR 2oo3 TMR VOTING                 *)
(* ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
bAcousA_Healthy := (rAcousticNoise_A_dB >= 30.0) AND (rAcousticNoise_A_dB <= 140.0);
bAcousB_Healthy := (rAcousticNoise_B_dB >= 30.0) AND (rAcousticNoise_B_dB <= 140.0);
bAcousC_Healthy := (rAcousticNoise_C_dB >= 30.0) AND (rAcousticNoise_C_dB <= 140.0);

IF bAcousA_Healthy AND bAcousB_Healthy AND (ABS(rAcousticNoise_A_dB - rAcousticNoise_B_dB) > rAcousTolerance_dB) THEN
    IF bAcousC_Healthy THEN
        IF ABS(rAcousticNoise_A_dB - rAcousticNoise_C_dB) > ABS(rAcousticNoise_B_dB - rAcousticNoise_C_dB) THEN
            bAcousA_Healthy := FALSE;
        ELSE
            bAcousB_Healthy := FALSE;
        END_IF;
    END_IF;
END_IF;

IF bAcousB_Healthy AND bAcousC_Healthy AND (ABS(rAcousticNoise_B_dB - rAcousticNoise_C_dB) > rAcousTolerance_dB) THEN
    IF bAcousA_Healthy THEN
        IF ABS(rAcousticNoise_B_dB - rAcousticNoise_A_dB) > ABS(rAcousticNoise_C_dB - rAcousticNoise_A_dB) THEN
            bAcousB_Healthy := FALSE;
        ELSE
            bAcousC_Healthy := FALSE;
        END_IF;
    END_IF;
END_IF;

iAcousHealthyCount := 0;
IF bAcousA_Healthy THEN iAcousHealthyCount := iAcousHealthyCount + 1; END_IF;
IF bAcousB_Healthy THEN iAcousHealthyCount := iAcousHealthyCount + 1; END_IF;
IF bAcousC_Healthy THEN iAcousHealthyCount := iAcousHealthyCount + 1; END_IF;

IF iAcousHealthyCount = 3 THEN
    IF ((rAcousticNoise_A_dB >= rAcousticNoise_B_dB) AND (rAcousticNoise_A_dB <= rAcousticNoise_C_dB)) OR
       ((rAcousticNoise_A_dB <= rAcousticNoise_B_dB) AND (rAcousticNoise_A_dB >= rAcousticNoise_C_dB)) THEN
        rAcousConsensus_dB := rAcousticNoise_A_dB;
    ELSIF ((rAcousticNoise_B_dB >= rAcousticNoise_A_dB) AND (rAcousticNoise_B_dB <= rAcousticNoise_C_dB)) OR
          ((rAcousticNoise_B_dB <= rAcousticNoise_A_dB) AND (rAcousticNoise_B_dB >= rAcousticNoise_C_dB)) THEN
        rAcousConsensus_dB := rAcousticNoise_B_dB;
    ELSE
        rAcousConsensus_dB := rAcousticNoise_C_dB;
    END_IF;
    bAcous_Degraded_1oo2 := FALSE;
ELSIF iAcousHealthyCount = 2 THEN
    bAcous_Degraded_1oo2 := TRUE;
    IF bAcousA_Healthy AND bAcousB_Healthy THEN
        rAcousConsensus_dB := (rAcousticNoise_A_dB + rAcousticNoise_B_dB) * 0.5;
    ELSIF bAcousA_Healthy AND bAcousC_Healthy THEN
        rAcousConsensus_dB := (rAcousticNoise_A_dB + rAcousticNoise_C_dB) * 0.5;
    ELSE
        rAcousConsensus_dB := (rAcousticNoise_B_dB + rAcousticNoise_C_dB) * 0.5;
    END_IF;
    dwAlarmWord_Degraded := dwAlarmWord_Degraded OR 16#00000008; (* Bit 3: Acoustic 1oo2 Degraded *)
ELSE
    bDegradedSensorTrip := TRUE;
    dwAlarmWord_Trip    := dwAlarmWord_Trip OR 16#00000020; (* Bit 5: Acoustic Loss of Redundancy *)
END_IF;

(* ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* SUB-SECTION 2.5: IN-SODIUM ELECTROCHEMICAL HYDROGEN METERS 2oo3 TMR VOTING               *)
(* ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
bHydA_Healthy := (rHydrogenConc_A_ppm >= 0.005) AND (rHydrogenConc_A_ppm <= 10.0);
bHydB_Healthy := (rHydrogenConc_B_ppm >= 0.005) AND (rHydrogenConc_B_ppm <= 10.0);
bHydC_Healthy := (rHydrogenConc_C_ppm >= 0.005) AND (rHydrogenConc_C_ppm <= 10.0);

IF bHydA_Healthy AND bHydB_Healthy AND (ABS(rHydrogenConc_A_ppm - rHydrogenConc_B_ppm) > rHydTolerance_ppm) THEN
    IF bHydC_Healthy THEN
        IF ABS(rHydrogenConc_A_ppm - rHydrogenConc_C_ppm) > ABS(rHydrogenConc_B_ppm - rHydrogenConc_C_ppm) THEN
            bHydA_Healthy := FALSE;
        ELSE
            bHydB_Healthy := FALSE;
        END_IF;
    END_IF;
END_IF;

IF bHydB_Healthy AND bHydC_Healthy AND (ABS(rHydrogenConc_B_ppm - rHydrogenConc_C_ppm) > rHydTolerance_ppm) THEN
    IF bHydA_Healthy THEN
        IF ABS(rHydrogenConc_B_ppm - rHydrogenConc_A_ppm) > ABS(rHydrogenConc_C_ppm - rHydrogenConc_A_ppm) THEN
            bHydB_Healthy := FALSE;
        ELSE
            bHydC_Healthy := FALSE;
        END_IF;
    END_IF;
END_IF;

iHydHealthyCount := 0;
IF bHydA_Healthy THEN iHydHealthyCount := iHydHealthyCount + 1; END_IF;
IF bHydB_Healthy THEN iHydHealthyCount := iHydHealthyCount + 1; END_IF;
IF bHydC_Healthy THEN iHydHealthyCount := iHydHealthyCount + 1; END_IF;

IF iHydHealthyCount = 3 THEN
    IF ((rHydrogenConc_A_ppm >= rHydrogenConc_B_ppm) AND (rHydrogenConc_A_ppm <= rHydrogenConc_C_ppm)) OR
       ((rHydrogenConc_A_ppm <= rHydrogenConc_B_ppm) AND (rHydrogenConc_A_ppm >= rHydrogenConc_C_ppm)) THEN
        rHydConsensus_ppm := rHydrogenConc_A_ppm;
    ELSIF ((rHydrogenConc_B_ppm >= rHydrogenConc_A_ppm) AND (rHydrogenConc_B_ppm <= rHydrogenConc_C_ppm)) OR
          ((rHydrogenConc_B_ppm <= rHydrogenConc_A_ppm) AND (rHydrogenConc_B_ppm >= rHydrogenConc_C_ppm)) THEN
        rHydConsensus_ppm := rHydrogenConc_B_ppm;
    ELSE
        rHydConsensus_ppm := rHydrogenConc_C_ppm;
    END_IF;
    bHyd_Degraded_1oo2 := FALSE;
ELSIF iHydHealthyCount = 2 THEN
    bHyd_Degraded_1oo2 := TRUE;
    IF bHydA_Healthy AND bHydB_Healthy THEN
        rHydConsensus_ppm := (rHydrogenConc_A_ppm + rHydrogenConc_B_ppm) * 0.5;
    ELSIF bHydA_Healthy AND bHydC_Healthy THEN
        rHydConsensus_ppm := (rHydrogenConc_A_ppm + rHydrogenConc_C_ppm) * 0.5;
    ELSE
        rHydConsensus_ppm := (rHydrogenConc_B_ppm + rHydrogenConc_C_ppm) * 0.5;
    END_IF;
    dwAlarmWord_Degraded := dwAlarmWord_Degraded OR 16#00000010; (* Bit 4: Hydrogen 1oo2 Degraded *)
ELSE
    bDegradedSensorTrip := TRUE;
    dwAlarmWord_Trip    := dwAlarmWord_Trip OR 16#00000040; (* Bit 6: Hydrogen Loss of Redundancy *)
END_IF;

(* Assemble 32-Bit Sensor Health Register *)
dwSensorHealthWord := 16#00000000;
IF bColdA_Healthy  THEN dwSensorHealthWord := dwSensorHealthWord OR 16#00000001; END_IF;
IF bColdB_Healthy  THEN dwSensorHealthWord := dwSensorHealthWord OR 16#00000002; END_IF;
IF bColdC_Healthy  THEN dwSensorHealthWord := dwSensorHealthWord OR 16#00000004; END_IF;
IF bHotA_Healthy   THEN dwSensorHealthWord := dwSensorHealthWord OR 16#00000008; END_IF;
IF bHotB_Healthy   THEN dwSensorHealthWord := dwSensorHealthWord OR 16#00000010; END_IF;
IF bHotC_Healthy   THEN dwSensorHealthWord := dwSensorHealthWord OR 16#00000020; END_IF;
IF bPressA_Healthy THEN dwSensorHealthWord := dwSensorHealthWord OR 16#00000040; END_IF;
IF bPressB_Healthy THEN dwSensorHealthWord := dwSensorHealthWord OR 16#00000080; END_IF;
IF bPressC_Healthy THEN dwSensorHealthWord := dwSensorHealthWord OR 16#00000100; END_IF;
IF bAcousA_Healthy THEN dwSensorHealthWord := dwSensorHealthWord OR 16#00000200; END_IF;
IF bAcousB_Healthy THEN dwSensorHealthWord := dwSensorHealthWord OR 16#00000400; END_IF;
IF bAcousC_Healthy THEN dwSensorHealthWord := dwSensorHealthWord OR 16#00000800; END_IF;
IF bHydA_Healthy   THEN dwSensorHealthWord := dwSensorHealthWord OR 16#00001000; END_IF;
IF bHydB_Healthy   THEN dwSensorHealthWord := dwSensorHealthWord OR 16#00002000; END_IF;
IF bHydC_Healthy   THEN dwSensorHealthWord := dwSensorHealthWord OR 16#00004000; END_IF;
(* ========================================================================================= *)
(* SECTION 3: LIQUID SODIUM FINK-LEIBOWITZ THERMOPHYSICS & IHX MULTI-ZONE HEAT FLUX         *)
(* ========================================================================================= *)
(* Thermophysical Properties Evaluated at Bulk Average Temperature T_bulk = (T_cold + T_hot)/2 *)
vecState_x[1] := rColdConsensus_DegC;
vecState_x[2] := rHotConsensus_DegC;
vecState_x[3] := (vecState_x[1] + vecState_x[2]) * 0.5; (* IHX Mean Temperature [deg C] *)

(* ANL/RE-95/2 Fink-Leibowitz Liquid Sodium Equations *)
rNa_Density_kg_m3 := 950.1 - 0.22976 * vecState_x[3] - 1.46E-5 * (vecState_x[3] * vecState_x[3]);
IF rNa_Density_kg_m3 < 780.0 THEN rNa_Density_kg_m3 := 780.0; END_IF;

rNa_SpecificHeat_J_kgK := 1629.0 - 0.833 * vecState_x[3] + 4.63E-4 * (vecState_x[3] * vecState_x[3]);
IF rNa_SpecificHeat_J_kgK < 1200.0 THEN rNa_SpecificHeat_J_kgK := 1200.0; END_IF;

rNa_ThermalCond_W_mK := 124.7 - 0.040 * vecState_x[3];
IF rNa_ThermalCond_W_mK < 50.0 THEN rNa_ThermalCond_W_mK := 50.0; END_IF;

rNa_Viscosity_Pa_s := 0.001 * EXP(-0.55 - 0.0022 * vecState_x[3]);
IF rNa_Viscosity_Pa_s < 0.00018 THEN rNa_Viscosity_Pa_s := 0.00018; END_IF;

rNa_ElecConductivity_S_m := 1.98E7 / (1.0 + 0.0049 * (vecState_x[3] - 200.0));
IF rNa_ElecConductivity_S_m < 2.0E6 THEN rNa_ElecConductivity_S_m := 2.0E6; END_IF;

(* Hydrodynamic Velocity in IHX Core Bundle *)
IF rNa_Density_kg_m3 > 0.0 THEN
    rSodiumVelocity_m_s := vecState_x[4] / (rNa_Density_kg_m3 * 0.7850); (* 0.7850 m^2 free flow area *)
ELSE
    rSodiumVelocity_m_s := 0.0;
END_IF;
IF rSodiumVelocity_m_s < 0.01 THEN rSodiumVelocity_m_s := 0.01; END_IF;

(* Dimensionless Groups: Reynolds, Prandtl, Peclet, Nusselt *)
rReynoldsNumber := (rNa_Density_kg_m3 * rSodiumVelocity_m_s * rIHX_TubeOuterDiam_m) / rNa_Viscosity_Pa_s;
IF rReynoldsNumber < 1000.0 THEN rReynoldsNumber := 1000.0; END_IF;

rPrandtlNumber := (rNa_Viscosity_Pa_s * rNa_SpecificHeat_J_kgK) / rNa_ThermalCond_W_mK;
IF rPrandtlNumber < 0.0020 THEN rPrandtlNumber := 0.0020; END_IF;

rPecletNumber := rReynoldsNumber * rPrandtlNumber;

(* Lyon-Martinelli Liquid Metal Correlation for Uniform Heat Flux *)
rNusseltNumber := 5.0 + 0.025 * EXP(0.8 * LN(rPecletNumber));
IF rNusseltNumber < 5.0 THEN rNusseltNumber := 5.0; END_IF;

rHeatTransferCoeff_W_m2K := (rNusseltNumber * rNa_ThermalCond_W_mK) / rIHX_TubeOuterDiam_m;

(* Multi-Zone Shell-and-Tube Thermal Resistance Modeling *)
(* Tube Wall Radial Conduction Resistance: R_wall = ln(D_o/D_i) / (2 * pi * k_steel * L) *)
rOverallHeatTransU_W_m2K := 1.0 / ( (2.0 / rHeatTransferCoeff_W_m2K) + (rIHX_TubeWallThick_m / rSteel_ThermalCond_W_mK) );
IF rOverallHeatTransU_W_m2K < 1000.0 THEN rOverallHeatTransU_W_m2K := 1000.0; END_IF;

(* Multi-Zone Logarithmic Mean Temperature Difference (LMTD) *)
(* Zone 1: Entrance Cross-Flow Region *)
rDeltaT_LM_Zone1 := (rIHX_PriInletTemp_DegC - rHotConsensus_DegC);
IF rDeltaT_LM_Zone1 < 5.0 THEN rDeltaT_LM_Zone1 := 5.0; END_IF;
rIHX_Zone1HeatFlux_kW_m2 := (rOverallHeatTransU_W_m2K * 0.88 * rDeltaT_LM_Zone1) * 0.001;

(* Zone 2: Active Counterflow Intermediate Region *)
rDeltaT_LM_Zone2 := ((rIHX_PriInletTemp_DegC - rHotConsensus_DegC) + (rIHX_PriOutletTemp_DegC - rColdConsensus_DegC)) * 0.5;
IF rDeltaT_LM_Zone2 < 5.0 THEN rDeltaT_LM_Zone2 := 5.0; END_IF;
rIHX_Zone2HeatFlux_kW_m2 := (rOverallHeatTransU_W_m2K * 1.02 * rDeltaT_LM_Zone2) * 0.001;

(* Zone 3: Exit Plenum Deceleration Region *)
rDeltaT_LM_Zone3 := (rIHX_PriOutletTemp_DegC - rColdConsensus_DegC);
IF rDeltaT_LM_Zone3 < 5.0 THEN rDeltaT_LM_Zone3 := 5.0; END_IF;
rIHX_Zone3HeatFlux_kW_m2 := (rOverallHeatTransU_W_m2K * 0.92 * rDeltaT_LM_Zone3) * 0.001;

(* Total Integrated IHX Thermal Power Transferred to Secondary Sodium Loop [MW] *)
rIHX_TotalHeatFlux_MW := ( (rIHX_Zone1HeatFlux_kW_m2 * rIHX_Zone1Area_m2) +
                           (rIHX_Zone2HeatFlux_kW_m2 * rIHX_Zone2Area_m2) +
                           (rIHX_Zone3HeatFlux_kW_m2 * rIHX_Zone3Area_m2) ) * 0.001;

(* Primary Outlet Temperature Dynamic Heat Balance *)
IF rIHX_PriFlow_kg_s > 50.0 AND rNa_SpecificHeat_J_kgK > 0.0 THEN
    rIHX_PriOutletTemp_DegC := rIHX_PriInletTemp_DegC - ((rIHX_TotalHeatFlux_MW * 1.0E6) / (rIHX_PriFlow_kg_s * rNa_SpecificHeat_J_kgK));
ELSE
    rIHX_PriOutletTemp_DegC := rColdConsensus_DegC + 10.0;
END_IF;
(* ========================================================================================= *)
(* SECTION 4: HIGH-FREQUENCY ACOUSTIC EMISSION SWR MICRO-LEAK & HYDROGEN INTERLOCK           *)
(* ========================================================================================= *)
(* 4.1: Flow-Correlated Turbulent Hydraulic Baseline Acoustic Cancellation *)
(* Liquid metal pipeline turbulent noise scales with velocity to the ~2.8 power: E_bg = K_hyd * v^2.8 *)
rAcousticFlowBaseline_dB := 48.0 + (rAcousticHydraulicFactor * EXP(2.8 * LN(rSodiumVelocity_m_s * 10.0)));
IF rAcousticFlowBaseline_dB < 45.0 THEN rAcousticFlowBaseline_dB := 45.0; END_IF;
IF rAcousticFlowBaseline_dB > 95.0 THEN rAcousticFlowBaseline_dB := 95.0; END_IF;

rNetAcousticEnergy_dB := rAcousConsensus_dB - rAcousticFlowBaseline_dB;
IF rNetAcousticEnergy_dB < 0.0 THEN rNetAcousticEnergy_dB := 0.0; END_IF;

(* 4.2: Rolling Circular Buffer and 4th-Order Statistical Kurtosis Computation *)
rAcousticHistory[iAcousticBufPtr] := rAcousConsensus_dB;
iAcousticBufPtr := iAcousticBufPtr + 1;
IF iAcousticBufPtr > 16 THEN iAcousticBufPtr := 1; END_IF;

rAcousticMean_dB := 0.0;
FOR iLoopCounter_i := 1 TO 16 DO
    rAcousticMean_dB := rAcousticMean_dB + rAcousticHistory[iLoopCounter_i];
END_FOR;
rAcousticMean_dB := rAcousticMean_dB / 16.0;

rAcousticVariance  := 0.0;
rAcousticM4_Moment := 0.0;
FOR iLoopCounter_i := 1 TO 16 DO
    rMatrixMultiplyAccum := rAcousticHistory[iLoopCounter_i] - rAcousticMean_dB;
    rAcousticVariance    := rAcousticVariance + (rMatrixMultiplyAccum * rMatrixMultiplyAccum);
    rAcousticM4_Moment   := rAcousticM4_Moment + (rMatrixMultiplyAccum * rMatrixMultiplyAccum * rMatrixMultiplyAccum * rMatrixMultiplyAccum);
END_FOR;
rAcousticVariance  := rAcousticVariance / 16.0;
rAcousticM4_Moment := rAcousticM4_Moment / 16.0;

IF rAcousticVariance > 0.001 THEN
    rAcousticKurtosis_Stat := rAcousticM4_Moment / (rAcousticVariance * rAcousticVariance);
ELSE
    rAcousticKurtosis_Stat := 3.0; (* Standard Gaussian distribution kurtosis baseline *)
END_IF;

(* Micro-bubble acoustic threshold: Kurtosis > 4.8 OR Net Acoustic Energy > 18.0 dB *)
IF (rAcousticKurtosis_Stat > 4.8) OR (rNetAcousticEnergy_dB > 18.0) THEN
    bSWR_AcousticWarning := TRUE;
    dwAlarmWord_Degraded := dwAlarmWord_Degraded OR 16#00000020; (* Bit 5: High Acoustic Micro-Leak Pre-Alarm *)
ELSE
    bSWR_AcousticWarning := FALSE;
END_IF;

(* 4.3: In-Sodium Electrochemical Diffusion Hydrogen Rate-of-Rise Derivative *)
rHydrogenHistory_ppm[iHydBufPtr] := rHydConsensus_ppm;
iHydBufPtr := iHydBufPtr + 1;
IF iHydBufPtr > 8 THEN iHydBufPtr := 1; END_IF;

(* 5-Point Discrete Backward Euler Derivative: d[H]/dt [ppm/min] *)
rRawHydrogenSlope_ppm_s := (rHydConsensus_ppm - rPrevVotedHydrogen_ppm) / rCycleTime_s;
rPrevVotedHydrogen_ppm  := rHydConsensus_ppm;

(* First-order lag filtered derivative [ppm/min] *)
rHydrogenRateOfRise_ppm_min := 0.85 * rHydrogenRateOfRise_ppm_min + 0.15 * (rRawHydrogenSlope_ppm_s * 60.0);

(* Hydrogen Rate of Rise Excursion Threshold: > 0.015 ppm/min (Early Micro-Wastage Regime) *)
IF (rHydrogenRateOfRise_ppm_min > 0.0150) OR (rHydConsensus_ppm > 0.250) THEN
    bSWR_HydrogenSlopeWarning := TRUE;
    dwAlarmWord_Degraded := dwAlarmWord_Degraded OR 16#00000040; (* Bit 6: High Hydrogen Rate-of-Rise Pre-Alarm *)
ELSE
    bSWR_HydrogenSlopeWarning := FALSE;
END_IF;

(* 4.4: Orthogonal Coincidence Logic: Dual Acoustic Emission AND Hydrogen Rise Confirmation *)
bSWR_CoincidenceDetected := bSWR_AcousticWarning AND bSWR_HydrogenSlopeWarning;

tSWR_ConfirmationTimer(IN := bSWR_CoincidenceDetected, PT := T#250MS);
IF tSWR_ConfirmationTimer.Q THEN
    (* SWR CONFIRMED: IMMEDIATE AUTOMATIC SAFETY ISOLATION & SECONDARY FAST DUMP *)
    bSafetyTripActive   := TRUE;
    bSWR_FastDumpActive := TRUE;
    bSystemReady        := FALSE;
    dwAlarmWord_Trip    := dwAlarmWord_Trip OR 16#00000080; (* Bit 7: SWR Micro-Leak Confirmed Trip *)
    iMachineState       := 80; (* Transition directly to Controlled Steam Generator Dump State *)
END_IF;
(* ========================================================================================= *)
(* SECTION 5: ALIP MAGNETOHYDRODYNAMIC (MHD) VECTOR THRUST REGULATION                       *)
(* ========================================================================================= *)
(* 5.1: Synchronous Traveling Magnetic Wave Velocity & Slip Calculation *)
(* v_sync = 2 * tau * f_ALIP *)
IF rALIP_FreqDemand_Hz > 0.1 THEN
    rSyncVelocity_m_s := 2.0 * rALIP_PolePitch_tau_m * rALIP_FreqDemand_Hz;
ELSE
    rSyncVelocity_m_s := 0.1;
END_IF;

(* Magnetic Slip Ratio: s = (v_sync - v_flow) / v_sync *)
IF rSyncVelocity_m_s > 0.001 THEN
    rALIP_SlipRatio := (rSyncVelocity_m_s - rSodiumVelocity_m_s) / rSyncVelocity_m_s;
ELSE
    rALIP_SlipRatio := 0.0;
END_IF;
IF rALIP_SlipRatio < -0.20 THEN rALIP_SlipRatio := -0.20; END_IF;
IF rALIP_SlipRatio > 1.00  THEN rALIP_SlipRatio := 1.00;  END_IF;

(* 5.2: Magnetic Reynolds Number & Longitudinal End-Effect Attenuation *)
(* Rm = mu_0 * sigma * v_sync * tau / pi *)
rMagneticReynoldsNum_Rm := (rMu_0_VacuumPerm * rNa_ElecConductivity_S_m * rSyncVelocity_m_s * rALIP_PolePitch_tau_m) / rPi_Const;
IF rMagneticReynoldsNum_Rm < 0.01 THEN rMagneticReynoldsNum_Rm := 0.01; END_IF;

(* Longitudinal end-effect correction factor Kend(Rm) *)
rEndEffectFactor_Kend := 1.0 / (1.0 + 0.185 * (rMagneticReynoldsNum_Rm * rMagneticReynoldsNum_Rm));
IF rEndEffectFactor_Kend > 1.0 THEN rEndEffectFactor_Kend := 1.0; END_IF;
IF rEndEffectFactor_Kend < 0.2 THEN rEndEffectFactor_Kend := 0.2; END_IF;

(* Stator Bore Peak Radial Magnetic Flux Density B0 [Tesla] *)
(* Proportional to V / f ratio with iron core saturation clamp at 0.55 T *)
IF rALIP_FreqDemand_Hz > 1.0 THEN
    rALIP_PeakFluxDensity_B0_T := 0.065 * (rALIP_VoltageDemand_V / rALIP_FreqDemand_Hz);
ELSE
    rALIP_PeakFluxDensity_B0_T := 0.0;
END_IF;
IF rALIP_PeakFluxDensity_B0_T > 0.550 THEN rALIP_PeakFluxDensity_B0_T := 0.550; END_IF;

(* 5.3: Developed Electromagnetic Pressure Head & Vector Thrust *)
(* Delta_P_em = 0.5 * sigma * s * v_sync * B0^2 * L_active * Kend *)
rALIP_DevelopedHead_Bar := ( 0.5 * rNa_ElecConductivity_S_m * rALIP_SlipRatio * rSyncVelocity_m_s *
                             (rALIP_PeakFluxDensity_B0_T * rALIP_PeakFluxDensity_B0_T) *
                             rALIP_ActiveLength_m * rEndEffectFactor_Kend ) * 1.0E-5;
IF rALIP_DevelopedHead_Bar < 0.0 THEN rALIP_DevelopedHead_Bar := 0.0; END_IF;

(* Total Lorentz Axial Vector Propulsion Thrust [kN] *)
rALIP_VectorThrust_kN := (rALIP_DevelopedHead_Bar * 1.0E5 * rALIP_NominalCrossSec_m2) * 0.001;

(* ALIP Stator Thermal Winding Over-Temperature De-Rating Protection *)
(* Stator winding Class 220 limit = 200 deg C alarm, 220 deg C trip *)
IF rALIP_StatorTemp_DegC > 200.0 THEN
    dwAlarmWord_Degraded := dwAlarmWord_Degraded OR 16#00000080; (* Bit 7: ALIP Stator Winding Thermal Warning *)
    (* Proportional thermal power de-rating *)
    IF rALIP_VoltageDemand_V > 280.0 THEN
        rALIP_VoltageDemand_V := 280.0;
    END_IF;
END_IF;

IF rALIP_StatorTemp_DegC > 220.0 THEN
    bSafetyTripActive       := TRUE;
    dwAlarmWord_Trip        := dwAlarmWord_Trip OR 16#00000100; (* Bit 8: ALIP Stator Thermal Breakdown Trip *)
    rALIP_FreqDemand_Hz     := 0.0;
    rALIP_VoltageDemand_V   := 0.0;
    iMachineState           := 70;
END_IF;
(* ========================================================================================= *)
(* SECTION 6: ASME SEC III DIV 5 / RCC-MRx THERMAL SHOCK & TRANSIENT STRAIN MITIGATION      *)
(* ========================================================================================= *)
(* 6.1: Instantaneous Derivative of Cold Leg Temperature dT/dt *)
rColdLegTempHistory[iColdLegPtr] := rColdConsensus_DegC;
iColdLegPtr := iColdLegPtr + 1;
IF iColdLegPtr > 10 THEN iColdLegPtr := 1; END_IF;

rThermalShockRate_DegC_s := (rColdConsensus_DegC - rPrevColdConsensus_DegC) / rCycleTime_s;
rPrevColdConsensus_DegC  := rColdConsensus_DegC;

rThermalShockSlope_DegC_min := rThermalShockRate_DegC_s * 60.0;

(* 6.2: 1D Radial Transient Thermal Stress Estimation in Thick IHX Forged Nozzle *)
(* Outer surface insulated, inner surface exposed to liquid sodium down-ramp *)
(* Biot number Bi = h * W / k_steel. Liquid metal h is huge (Bi >> 100), so inner wall snaps to fluid temp *)
rNozzleWallInnerTemp_DegC := rColdConsensus_DegC;

(* 1D radial transient heat diffusion into nozzle wall: dT_mid/dt = alpha_th * (T_in - T_mid) / (0.5 * W)^2 *)
rNozzleWallMidTemp_DegC := rNozzleWallMidTemp_DegC +
                           ( (rSteel_ThermalCond_W_mK / (7800.0 * 500.0)) *
                             (rNozzleWallInnerTemp_DegC - rNozzleWallMidTemp_DegC) /
                             (0.25 * rIHX_NozzleWallThick_m * rIHX_NozzleWallThick_m) ) * rCycleTime_s;

rNozzleDeltaT_Radial_K := ABS(rNozzleWallInnerTemp_DegC - rNozzleWallMidTemp_DegC);

(* Thermal stress factor [E * alpha / (1 - nu)] applied to 316FR = 4.62 MPa/K *)
rIHX_NozzleThermalStress_MPa := rThermalStressFactor_MPa_K * rNozzleDeltaT_Radial_K;

(* ASME Section III Division 5 Allowable Stress S_m at 400-550 deg C applied to 316FR = 115 MPa *)
rAllowableThermalStress_MPa := 115.0;

(* High-Temperature Weldable Capacitive Strain Gauge Validation *)
(* Measured strain converted to stress: sigma = E * (epsilon_meas - alpha * Delta_T) *)
rMeasuredThermalStrain_MPa := (rSteel_YoungsMod_GPa * 1000.0) * (ABS(rIHX_NozzleStrain_uE) * 1.0E-6);

IF rMeasuredThermalStrain_MPa > rIHX_NozzleThermalStress_MPa THEN
    rIHX_NozzleThermalStress_MPa := rMeasuredThermalStrain_MPa;
END_IF;

(* 6.3: Thermal Stress Interlock and Rate Limiting *)
IF rIHX_NozzleThermalStress_MPa > 95.0 THEN
    bThermalShockRampActive := TRUE;
    dwAlarmWord_Degraded    := dwAlarmWord_Degraded OR 16#00000100; (* Bit 8: High Thermal Shock Stress Warning *)
ELSE
    bThermalShockRampActive := FALSE;
END_IF;

IF rIHX_NozzleThermalStress_MPa > 125.0 THEN
    (* Exceeded ASME Sec III Div 5 Design Fatigue Envelope: Initiate Controlled Cooldown Rate Clamp *)
    bSafetyTripActive       := TRUE;
    dwAlarmWord_Trip        := dwAlarmWord_Trip OR 16#00000200; (* Bit 9: Extreme Thermal Shock Stress Trip *)
    iMachineState           := 70;
END_IF;
(* ========================================================================================= *)
(* SECTION 7: 5x5 STATE-SPACE KALMAN FILTER OBSERVER & CONSTRAINED MPC OPTIMIZER             *)
(* ========================================================================================= *)
(* 7.1: Discrete Kalman Filter Measurement Update & State Propagation *)
(* Measurement Vector Assignment: y = [T_cold, T_hot, ALIP_Head, Flow, Hydrogen]^T *)
vecMeas_y[1] := rColdConsensus_DegC;
vecMeas_y[2] := rHotConsensus_DegC;
vecMeas_y[3] := rALIP_DevelopedHead_Bar;
vecMeas_y[4] := vecState_x[4]; (* Mass flow feedback *)
vecMeas_y[5] := rHydConsensus_ppm;

(* Innovation Vector Calculation: e = y - C * x_pred *)
FOR iLoopCounter_i := 1 TO 5 DO
    rMatrixMultiplyAccum := 0.0;
    FOR iLoopCounter_j := 1 TO 5 DO
        rMatrixMultiplyAccum := rMatrixMultiplyAccum + matC[iLoopCounter_i, iLoopCounter_j] * vecState_x_pred[iLoopCounter_j];
    END_FOR;
    vecInnov_e[iLoopCounter_i] := vecMeas_y[iLoopCounter_i] - rMatrixMultiplyAccum;
END_FOR;

(* State Update: x = x_pred + K * e *)
FOR iLoopCounter_i := 1 TO 5 DO
    rMatrixMultiplyAccum := 0.0;
    FOR iLoopCounter_j := 1 TO 5 DO
        rMatrixMultiplyAccum := rMatrixMultiplyAccum + matKalmanGain_K[iLoopCounter_i, iLoopCounter_j] * vecInnov_e[iLoopCounter_j];
    END_FOR;
    vecState_x[iLoopCounter_i] := vecState_x_pred[iLoopCounter_i] + rMatrixMultiplyAccum;
END_FOR;

(* Time Propagation: x_pred[k+1] = A * x[k] + B * u[k] *)
vecInput_u[1] := rALIP_FreqDemand_Hz;
vecInput_u[2] := rALIP_VoltageDemand_V;
vecInput_u[3] := 0.0;                       (* Bypass valve [%] *)
vecInput_u[4] := rSteamGenThermalDemand_MW;
vecInput_u[5] := rIHX_PriInletTemp_DegC;

FOR iLoopCounter_i := 1 TO 5 DO
    rMatrixMultiplyAccum := 0.0;
    FOR iLoopCounter_j := 1 TO 5 DO
        rMatrixMultiplyAccum := rMatrixMultiplyAccum + (matA[iLoopCounter_i, iLoopCounter_j] * vecState_x[iLoopCounter_j]) +
                                                       (matB[iLoopCounter_i, iLoopCounter_j] * vecInput_u[iLoopCounter_j]);
    END_FOR;
    vecState_x_pred[iLoopCounter_i] := rMatrixMultiplyAccum;
END_FOR;

(* 7.2: Constrained Model Predictive Control (MPC) Projected Gradient Descent *)
IF bAutoMPC_Enable AND (iMachineState = 60) AND (dwAlarmWord_Trip = 16#00000000) THEN
    (* Setpoint Vector Assignment *)
    vecSetpoint_r[1] := 345.0;                      (* Cold leg target 345 deg C *)
    vecSetpoint_r[2] := 505.0;                      (* Hot leg target 505 deg C *)
    vecSetpoint_r[3] := 425.0;                      (* Mean wall temp 425 deg C *)
    vecSetpoint_r[4] := rSecMassFlowDemand_kg_s;    (* Target flow demand *)
    vecSetpoint_r[5] := 0.050;                      (* Target hydrogen baseline *)

    FOR iLoopCounter_j := 1 TO iMpcMaxIterations DO
        (* Evaluate Gradient g = B^T * Q * (C * x_pred - r) + R * (u - u_prev) *)
        FOR iLoopCounter_i := 1 TO 2 DO
            rMatrixMultiplyAccum := matQ[iLoopCounter_i] * (vecState_x_pred[iLoopCounter_i] - vecSetpoint_r[iLoopCounter_i]);
            vecGradient_g[iLoopCounter_i] := (matB[iLoopCounter_i, iLoopCounter_i] * rMatrixMultiplyAccum) +
                                             matR[iLoopCounter_i] * (vecInput_u[iLoopCounter_i] - vecInput_u_prev[iLoopCounter_i]);

            (* Projected Gradient Step *)
            vecInput_u[iLoopCounter_i] := vecInput_u[iLoopCounter_i] - (rMpcStepSize * vecGradient_g[iLoopCounter_i]);
        END_FOR;

        (* Slew Rate Clamping *)
        IF (vecInput_u[1] - vecInput_u_prev[1]) > rMaxDelta_Freq_Hz THEN
            vecInput_u[1] := vecInput_u_prev[1] + rMaxDelta_Freq_Hz;
        ELSIF (vecInput_u[1] - vecInput_u_prev[1]) < -rMaxDelta_Freq_Hz THEN
            vecInput_u[1] := vecInput_u_prev[1] - rMaxDelta_Freq_Hz;
        END_IF;

        IF (vecInput_u[2] - vecInput_u_prev[2]) > rMaxDelta_Volt_V THEN
            vecInput_u[2] := vecInput_u_prev[2] + rMaxDelta_Volt_V;
        ELSIF (vecInput_u[2] - vecInput_u_prev[2]) < -rMaxDelta_Volt_V THEN
            vecInput_u[2] := vecInput_u_prev[2] - rMaxDelta_Volt_V;
        END_IF;

        (* Hard Saturation Limits *)
        IF vecInput_u[1] < rMinFreq_Hz THEN vecInput_u[1] := rMinFreq_Hz; END_IF;
        IF vecInput_u[1] > rMaxFreq_Hz THEN vecInput_u[1] := rMaxFreq_Hz; END_IF;
        IF vecInput_u[2] < rMinVolt_V  THEN vecInput_u[2] := rMinVolt_V;  END_IF;
        IF vecInput_u[2] > rMaxVolt_V  THEN vecInput_u[2] := rMaxVolt_V;  END_IF;
    END_FOR;

    (* Apply Optimized Demands to Actuators *)
    rALIP_FreqDemand_Hz    := vecInput_u[1];
    rALIP_VoltageDemand_V  := vecInput_u[2];
    vecInput_u_prev[1]     := vecInput_u[1];
    vecInput_u_prev[2]     := vecInput_u[2];
ELSE
    (* 7.3: Graceful Degradation: Decoupled Fallback Proportional-Integral (PI) Flow Loop *)
    rMatrixMultiplyAccum := rSecMassFlowDemand_kg_s - vecState_x[4];
    rFlowErrorIntegral   := rFlowErrorIntegral + (rMatrixMultiplyAccum * rCycleTime_s);
    IF rFlowErrorIntegral > 1000.0  THEN rFlowErrorIntegral := 1000.0;  END_IF;
    IF rFlowErrorIntegral < -1000.0 THEN rFlowErrorIntegral := -1000.0; END_IF;

    rFallbackDemand_Freq := (rFallbackP_Gain_Flow * rMatrixMultiplyAccum) + (rFallbackI_Gain_Flow * rFlowErrorIntegral);
    IF rFallbackDemand_Freq < rMinFreq_Hz THEN rFallbackDemand_Freq := rMinFreq_Hz; END_IF;
    IF rFallbackDemand_Freq > rMaxFreq_Hz THEN rFallbackDemand_Freq := rMaxFreq_Hz; END_IF;

    IF (iMachineState >= 30) AND (iMachineState <= 60) AND (dwAlarmWord_Trip = 16#00000000) THEN
        rALIP_FreqDemand_Hz   := rFallbackDemand_Freq;
        rALIP_VoltageDemand_V := 8.20 * rALIP_FreqDemand_Hz; (* Constant V/f scalar trajectory *)
        IF rALIP_VoltageDemand_V > rMaxVolt_V THEN rALIP_VoltageDemand_V := rMaxVolt_V; END_IF;
    END_IF;
END_IF;
(* ========================================================================================= *)
(* SECTION 8: ISA-18.2 MULTI-STAGE SEQUENTIAL STATE MACHINE                                  *)
(* ========================================================================================= *)
(* Edge Detection for Entering State *)
bStateFirstScan   := (iMachineState <> iPrevMachineState);
iPrevMachineState := iMachineState;

tStateTimer(IN := NOT bStateFirstScan, PT := T#24H);

CASE iMachineState OF
    0: (* --------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
       (* STATE 0: SYSTEM COLD DRAINED & NITROGEN BLANKET                                    *)
       (* --------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
        bSystemReady            := FALSE;
        rALIP_FreqDemand_Hz     := 0.0;
        rALIP_VoltageDemand_V   := 0.0;
        rSecMassFlowDemand_kg_s := 0.0;

        IF bMasterEnable AND bEmergencyScram AND (dwAlarmWord_Trip = 16#00000000) THEN
            iMachineState := 10; (* Transition to Trace Heating & Argon Purge *)
        END_IF;

    10: (* -------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
        (* STATE 10: TRACE HEATING PREHEAT & COVER GAS ARGON PURGE                           *)
        (* -------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
        bSystemReady            := FALSE;
        rALIP_FreqDemand_Hz     := 0.0;
        rALIP_VoltageDemand_V   := 0.0;
        rSecMassFlowDemand_kg_s := 0.0;

        (* Electric trace heating preheating loop above sodium melting point (target 180 deg C) *)
        tTracePreheatTimer(IN := (rColdConsensus_DegC >= 180.0) AND (rCoverGasPressure_Bar >= 1.50), PT := T#30S);
        IF tTracePreheatTimer.Q THEN
            tTracePreheatTimer(IN := FALSE);
            iMachineState := 20; (* Transition to Sodium Loop Filling *)
        END_IF;

        IF NOT bMasterEnable OR NOT bEmergencyScram THEN
            iMachineState := 0;
        END_IF;

    20: (* -------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
        (* STATE 20: SODIUM LOOP FILLING & HYDROSTATIC HEAD EQUALIZATION                     *)
        (* -------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
        bSystemReady            := FALSE;
        rALIP_FreqDemand_Hz     := 0.0;
        rALIP_VoltageDemand_V   := 0.0;
        rSecMassFlowDemand_kg_s := 0.0;

        (* Loop filling verified by hydrostatic pressure consensus reaching nominal head *)
        tLoopFillTimer(IN := (rPressConsensus_Bar >= 4.80) AND (rPressConsensus_Bar <= 6.20), PT := T#45S);
        IF tLoopFillTimer.Q THEN
            tLoopFillTimer(IN := FALSE);
            iMachineState := 30; (* Transition to Isothermal Low-Flow Circulation *)
        END_IF;

        IF NOT bMasterEnable OR NOT bEmergencyScram THEN
            iMachineState := 0;
        END_IF;

    30: (* -------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
        (* STATE 30: ISOTHERMAL LOW-FLOW CIRCULATION & COLD TRAP PURIFICATION                *)
        (* -------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
        bSystemReady            := FALSE;
        rSecMassFlowDemand_kg_s := 650.0; (* 20% nominal flow *)
        rALIP_FreqDemand_Hz     := 15.0;
        rALIP_VoltageDemand_V   := 125.0;

        (* Maintain circulation until cold trap lowers impurities: [H] < 0.080 ppm *)
        tPurificationTimer(IN := (rHydConsensus_ppm <= 0.080) AND (rColdTrapSodiumTemp_DegC <= 125.0), PT := T#60S);
        IF tPurificationTimer.Q THEN
            tPurificationTimer(IN := FALSE);
            iMachineState := 40; (* Transition to Controlled IHX Thermal Coupling *)
        END_IF;

        IF NOT bMasterEnable OR NOT bEmergencyScram THEN
            iMachineState := 0;
        END_IF;

    40: (* -------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
        (* STATE 40: IHX THERMAL COUPLING & CONTROLLED THERMAL ESCALATION                    *)
        (* -------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
        bSystemReady            := FALSE;
        rSecMassFlowDemand_kg_s := 1600.0; (* 50% nominal flow *)

        (* Enforce thermal ramp rate limit: |dT/dt| <= 1.0 deg C/min *)
        IF rThermalShockSlope_DegC_min > 1.0 THEN
            bThermalShockRampActive := TRUE;
            rALIP_FreqDemand_Hz     := rALIP_FreqDemand_Hz - 0.050;
        ELSE
            bThermalShockRampActive := FALSE;
            IF rALIP_FreqDemand_Hz < 28.0 THEN
                rALIP_FreqDemand_Hz := rALIP_FreqDemand_Hz + 0.050;
            END_IF;
        END_IF;
        rALIP_VoltageDemand_V := 8.20 * rALIP_FreqDemand_Hz;

        tThermalRampTimer(IN := (rHotConsensus_DegC >= 420.0) AND (rColdConsensus_DegC >= 280.0), PT := T#90S);
        IF tThermalRampTimer.Q THEN
            tThermalRampTimer(IN := FALSE);
            iMachineState := 50; (* Transition to Power Escalation & SG Coupling *)
        END_IF;

        IF NOT bMasterEnable OR NOT bEmergencyScram THEN
            iMachineState := 70;
        END_IF;

    50: (* -------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
        (* STATE 50: POWER ESCALATION & STEAM GENERATOR HEAT SINK INTEGRATION                *)
        (* -------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
        bSystemReady            := TRUE;
        rSecMassFlowDemand_kg_s := 2600.0; (* 80% nominal flow *)

        IF rALIP_FreqDemand_Hz < 42.0 THEN
            rALIP_FreqDemand_Hz := rALIP_FreqDemand_Hz + 0.050;
        END_IF;
        rALIP_VoltageDemand_V := 8.20 * rALIP_FreqDemand_Hz;

        IF (rHotConsensus_DegC >= 490.0) AND (rSteamGenThermalDemand_MW >= 450.0) THEN
            iMachineState := 60; (* Transition to 100% Power Optimal MPC Mode *)
        END_IF;

        IF NOT bMasterEnable OR NOT bEmergencyScram THEN
            iMachineState := 70;
        END_IF;

    60: (* -------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
        (* STATE 60: FULL POWER CLOSED-LOOP OPTIMAL MPC REGULATION                           *)
        (* -------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
        bSystemReady            := TRUE;
        rSecMassFlowDemand_kg_s := 3200.0; (* 100% MCR Mass Flow *)

        (* Multivariable MPC optimizer active in Section 7 *)
        IF NOT bMasterEnable OR NOT bEmergencyScram THEN
            iMachineState := 70; (* Enter Controlled Thermal Shock Mitigation *)
        END_IF;

    70: (* -------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
        (* STATE 70: CONTROLLED THERMAL SHOCK MITIGATION TRANSFORMATION                      *)
        (* -------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
        bSystemReady            := FALSE;
        bThermalShockRampActive := TRUE;

        (* Dynamic flow reduction matching reactor post-scram decay heat curve *)
        IF rSecMassFlowDemand_kg_s > 450.0 THEN
            rSecMassFlowDemand_kg_s := rSecMassFlowDemand_kg_s - 15.0;
        END_IF;

        IF rALIP_FreqDemand_Hz > 10.0 THEN
            rALIP_FreqDemand_Hz := rALIP_FreqDemand_Hz - 0.10;
        END_IF;
        rALIP_VoltageDemand_V := 8.20 * rALIP_FreqDemand_Hz;

        (* Once system temperatures stabilize below 250 deg C, transition to cold drained standby *)
        IF (rHotConsensus_DegC <= 250.0) AND (rColdConsensus_DegC <= 220.0) THEN

(* ================================================================================================

IF rCycleTime_s <= 0.00001 OR rCycleTime_s > 0.100 THEN

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

IF NOT bObserverInitialized THEN
