(* ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
   BLOCK 1: HARDWIRED SAFETY INTERLOCKS & EMERGENCY TRIP SUPERVISOR
   Execution priority: HIGHEST (Overrules all states, controllers, and valve demands)
   ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
IF bEmergencyStop OR (NOT bEnableSystem) THEN
    (* Immediate failsafe safe-state actuation *)
    rValveDemand_N2_Pam3s := 0.0;
    rValveDemand_Ne_Pam3s := 0.0;
    rValveDemand_Ar_Pam3s := 0.0;
    rTotalImpurityThroughput_Pam3s := 0.0;
    bSystemReady := FALSE;
    bDetachmentAchieved := FALSE;
    bDetachmentDegraded := FALSE;
    iActiveState := 90; (* Transition directly to FAULT_LOCKOUT state *)

    (* Pack Alarm Word Bit 0: Emergency Stop Active *)
    IF bEmergencyStop THEN
        wAlarmCodeWord := wAlarmCodeWord OR 16#0001;
    END_IF;

    (* Pack Alarm Word Bit 1: Master Enable Permissive Lost *)
    IF NOT bEnableSystem THEN
        wAlarmCodeWord := wAlarmCodeWord OR 16#0002;
    END_IF;

    (* Bypass further execution if hard E-Stop is asserted *)
    IF bEmergencyStop THEN
        RETURN;
    END_IF;
END_IF;

(* Cooling Water Primary Safety Interlock *)
IF rCoolingWaterFlow_m3h < C_MIN_COOLING_FLOW_M3H THEN
    wAlarmCodeWord := wAlarmCodeWord OR 16#0004; (* Bit 2: Loss of Divertor Coolant Flow *)
    bSystemReady := FALSE;
    bSoftStopRequested := TRUE;
    IF iActiveState <> 90 THEN
        iActiveState := 90; (* Trip system on coolant flow loss *)
    END_IF;
END_IF;

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
   BLOCK 2: FAST DISRUPTION PRECURSOR & RUNAWAY ELECTRON (RE) MITIGATION INTERLOCK
   High-speed differentiator and multi-signal voting for runaway avalanche protection
   ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* Compute filtered derivative of plasma current dIp/dt [kA/ms] *)
IF rCycleTime_s > 0.0 THEN
    rPlasmaCurrentDerivative_kA_s := (rPlasmaCurrent_kA - rPrevPlasmaCurrent_kA) / rCycleTime_s;
    rPlasmaCurrentDerivative_kA_ms := rPlasmaCurrentDerivative_kA_s * 0.001;
ELSE
    rPlasmaCurrentDerivative_kA_ms := 0.0;
END_IF;
rPrevPlasmaCurrent_kA := rPlasmaCurrent_kA;

(* First-order low-pass noise filter on dIp/dt (cutoff ~ 200 Hz to reject magnetic pickup) *)
rFiltered_dIp_dt_kA_ms := (0.85 * rFiltered_dIp_dt_kA_ms) + (0.15 * rPlasmaCurrentDerivative_kA_ms);

(* Filter toroidal loop voltage *)
rFilteredLoopVoltage_V := (0.90 * rFilteredLoopVoltage_V) + (0.10 * rLoopVoltage_V);

(* Evaluate disruption precursor threshold conditions *)
bPrecursorCurrentQuench := (rFiltered_dIp_dt_kA_ms < C_RUNAWAY_DIP_DT_CRIT_KA_MS);
bPrecursorLoopVoltageSpike := (rFilteredLoopVoltage_V > C_RUNAWAY_VLOOP_CRIT_V);
bPrecursorHardXRayAvalanche := (rRunawayHardXRay_CPS > C_RUNAWAY_HXR_CRIT_CPS);

(* Calculate multi-signal disruption confidence percentage *)
rTempCalc1 := 0.0;
IF bPrecursorCurrentQuench THEN
    rTempCalc1 := rTempCalc1 + 45.0;
END_IF;
IF bPrecursorLoopVoltageSpike THEN
    rTempCalc1 := rTempCalc1 + 30.0;
END_IF;
IF bPrecursorHardXRayAvalanche THEN
    rTempCalc1 := rTempCalc1 + 25.0;
END_IF;
rDisruptionConfidence_Pct := rTempCalc1;

(* Fast Runaway Mitigation Trip Voting:
   Condition A: Extreme fast current quench alone (< -250 kA/ms, immediate catastrophic collapse)
   Condition B: Any 2 out of 3 disruption indicators simultaneous (2oo3 precursor trip)
*)
IF (rFiltered_dIp_dt_kA_ms < -250.0) OR
   ((bPrecursorCurrentQuench AND bPrecursorLoopVoltageSpike) OR
    (bPrecursorCurrentQuench AND bPrecursorHardXRayAvalanche) OR
    (bPrecursorLoopVoltageSpike AND bPrecursorHardXRayAvalanche)) THEN

    IF NOT bMGI_TriggerLatched AND bPlasmaShotActive THEN
        bMGI_TriggerLatched := TRUE;
        bRunawayInterlockTriggered := TRUE;
        bFastDisruptionDetected := TRUE;
        bMGI_TriggerValveActuate := TRUE;
        tMGI_ValvePulseTimer := 0.025; (* 25 ms holding pulse for fast electro-pneumatic valve *)
        iActiveState := 80;            (* Transition immediately to RUNAWAY_MITIGATION state *)
        wAlarmCodeWord := wAlarmCodeWord OR 16#0008; (* Bit 3: Runaway Mitigation Interlock Fired *)

        (* Record root cause *)
        IF rFiltered_dIp_dt_kA_ms < -250.0 THEN
            iRunawayTripCauseCode := 1; (* Severe Current Quench *)
        ELSIF bPrecursorHardXRayAvalanche THEN
            iRunawayTripCauseCode := 2; (* Relativistic Beam Avalanche *)
        ELSE
            iRunawayTripCauseCode := 3; (* Thermal Quench Loop Voltage Spike *)
        END_IF;
    END_IF;
END_IF;

(* Manage MGI valve firing pulse timer *)
IF bMGI_TriggerValveActuate THEN
    IF tMGI_ValvePulseTimer > 0.0 THEN
        tMGI_ValvePulseTimer := tMGI_ValvePulseTimer - rCycleTime_s;
    ELSE
        bMGI_TriggerValveActuate := FALSE; (* De-assert electrical pulse while keeping latch active *)
    END_IF;
END_IF;

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
   BLOCK 3: 2oo3 TRIPLE MODULAR REDUNDANCY (TMR) VOTING: THOMSON SCATTERING Te
   Evaluates 3 redundant spatial channels near outer strike point with range & variance checking
   ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* Channel validity range checks: Valid physical divertor Te is 0.1 eV to 120.0 eV *)
bThomson_A_Valid := (rThomsonTe_eV_ChA >= 0.1) AND (rThomsonTe_eV_ChA <= 120.0);
bThomson_B_Valid := (rThomsonTe_eV_ChB >= 0.1) AND (rThomsonTe_eV_ChB <= 120.0);
bThomson_C_Valid := (rThomsonTe_eV_ChC >= 0.1) AND (rThomsonTe_eV_ChC <= 120.0);

(* Count valid channels *)
iThomson_ValidCount := 0;
IF bThomson_A_Valid THEN iThomson_ValidCount := iThomson_ValidCount + 1; END_IF;
IF bThomson_B_Valid THEN iThomson_ValidCount := iThomson_ValidCount + 1; END_IF;
IF bThomson_C_Valid THEN iThomson_ValidCount := iThomson_ValidCount + 1; END_IF;

(* 2oo3 Voting Algorithm *)
IF iThomson_ValidCount = 3 THEN
    (* All 3 channels valid: Perform Median Selection and Pairwise Disagreement Check *)
    IF ((rThomsonTe_eV_ChA >= rThomsonTe_eV_ChB) AND (rThomsonTe_eV_ChA <= rThomsonTe_eV_ChC)) OR
       ((rThomsonTe_eV_ChA >= rThomsonTe_eV_ChC) AND (rThomsonTe_eV_ChA <= rThomsonTe_eV_ChB)) THEN
        rThomson_Voted_Te := rThomsonTe_eV_ChA;
    ELSIF ((rThomsonTe_eV_ChB >= rThomsonTe_eV_ChA) AND (rThomsonTe_eV_ChB <= rThomsonTe_eV_ChC)) OR
          ((rThomsonTe_eV_ChB >= rThomsonTe_eV_ChC) AND (rThomsonTe_eV_ChB <= rThomsonTe_eV_ChA)) THEN
        rThomson_Voted_Te := rThomsonTe_eV_ChB;
    ELSE
        rThomson_Voted_Te := rThomsonTe_eV_ChC;
    END_IF;

    (* Inter-channel variance calculation *)
    rTempCalc1 := (rThomsonTe_eV_ChA + rThomsonTe_eV_ChB + rThomsonTe_eV_ChC) / 3.0;
    rThomson_Variance := ((rThomsonTe_eV_ChA - rTempCalc1) * (rThomsonTe_eV_ChA - rTempCalc1) +
                          (rThomsonTe_eV_ChB - rTempCalc1) * (rThomsonTe_eV_ChB - rTempCalc1) +
                          (rThomsonTe_eV_ChC - rTempCalc1) * (rThomsonTe_eV_ChC - rTempCalc1)) / 3.0;

    (* Check for single-channel deviation / disagreement *)
    IF (ABS(rThomsonTe_eV_ChA - rThomson_Voted_Te) > rThomson_MaxDeviation_eV) THEN
        bThomson_ChannelA_Fault := TRUE;
        bThomson_Disagreement_Warning := TRUE;
    END_IF;
    IF (ABS(rThomsonTe_eV_ChB - rThomson_Voted_Te) > rThomson_MaxDeviation_eV) THEN
        bThomson_ChannelB_Fault := TRUE;
        bThomson_Disagreement_Warning := TRUE;
    END_IF;
    IF (ABS(rThomsonTe_eV_ChC - rThomson_Voted_Te) > rThomson_MaxDeviation_eV) THEN
        bThomson_ChannelC_Fault := TRUE;
        bThomson_Disagreement_Warning := TRUE;
    END_IF;

ELSIF iThomson_ValidCount = 2 THEN
    (* 2 channels valid: Graceful degradation to 2oo2 Average *)
    bThomson_Disagreement_Warning := TRUE;
    IF bThomson_A_Valid AND bThomson_B_Valid THEN
        rThomson_Voted_Te := (rThomsonTe_eV_ChA + rThomsonTe_eV_ChB) * 0.5;
        bThomson_ChannelC_Fault := TRUE;
    ELSIF bThomson_A_Valid AND bThomson_C_Valid THEN
        rThomson_Voted_Te := (rThomsonTe_eV_ChA + rThomsonTe_eV_ChC) * 0.5;
        bThomson_ChannelB_Fault := TRUE;
    ELSE
        rThomson_Voted_Te := (rThomsonTe_eV_ChB + rThomsonTe_eV_ChC) * 0.5;
        bThomson_ChannelA_Fault := TRUE;
    END_IF;
    rThomson_Variance := 0.50; (* Elevated uncertainty flag *)

ELSIF iThomson_ValidCount = 1 THEN
    (* 1 channel valid: Degraded 1oo1 Operation with high warning *)
    IF bThomson_A_Valid THEN
        rThomson_Voted_Te := rThomsonTe_eV_ChA;
        bThomson_ChannelB_Fault := TRUE;
        bThomson_ChannelC_Fault := TRUE;
    ELSIF bThomson_B_Valid THEN
        rThomson_Voted_Te := rThomsonTe_eV_ChB;
        bThomson_ChannelA_Fault := TRUE;
        bThomson_ChannelC_Fault := TRUE;
    ELSE
        rThomson_Voted_Te := rThomsonTe_eV_ChC;
        bThomson_ChannelA_Fault := TRUE;
        bThomson_ChannelB_Fault := TRUE;
    END_IF;
    rThomson_Variance := 2.50;

ELSE
    (* All channels invalid (0 valid): Total Thomson Diagnostic Blackout *)
    bThomson_ChannelA_Fault := TRUE;
    bThomson_ChannelB_Fault := TRUE;
    bThomson_ChannelC_Fault := TRUE;
    rThomson_Voted_Te := aX_Hat[1]; (* Fallback to observer predicted state *)
    rThomson_Variance := 10.0;
    wDiagnosticFaultWord := wDiagnosticFaultWord OR 16#0001; (* Bit 0: Total Thomson Loss *)
END_IF;

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
   BLOCK 4: 2oo3 TRIPLE MODULAR REDUNDANCY (TMR) VOTING: DIVERTOR LANGMUIR HEAT FLUX PROBES
   Evaluates 3 redundant flush-mounted Langmuir probe clusters measuring target heat flux
   ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* Probe validity range checks: Valid heat flux is 0.0 to 35.0 MW/m2 *)
bLangmuir_1_Valid := (rLangmuirHeatFlux_MWm2_Probe1 >= 0.0) AND (rLangmuirHeatFlux_MWm2_Probe1 <= 35.0);
bLangmuir_2_Valid := (rLangmuirHeatFlux_MWm2_Probe2 >= 0.0) AND (rLangmuirHeatFlux_MWm2_Probe2 <= 35.0);
bLangmuir_3_Valid := (rLangmuirHeatFlux_MWm2_Probe3 >= 0.0) AND (rLangmuirHeatFlux_MWm2_Probe3 <= 35.0);

(* Count valid probes *)
iLangmuir_ValidCount := 0;
IF bLangmuir_1_Valid THEN iLangmuir_ValidCount := iLangmuir_ValidCount + 1; END_IF;
IF bLangmuir_2_Valid THEN iLangmuir_ValidCount := iLangmuir_ValidCount + 1; END_IF;
IF bLangmuir_3_Valid THEN iLangmuir_ValidCount := iLangmuir_ValidCount + 1; END_IF;

(* 2oo3 Voting Algorithm *)
IF iLangmuir_ValidCount = 3 THEN
    (* All 3 probes valid: Median Selection *)
    IF ((rLangmuirHeatFlux_MWm2_Probe1 >= rLangmuirHeatFlux_MWm2_Probe2) AND (rLangmuirHeatFlux_MWm2_Probe1 <= rLangmuirHeatFlux_MWm2_Probe3)) OR
       ((rLangmuirHeatFlux_MWm2_Probe1 >= rLangmuirHeatFlux_MWm2_Probe3) AND (rLangmuirHeatFlux_MWm2_Probe1 <= rLangmuirHeatFlux_MWm2_Probe2)) THEN
        rLangmuir_Voted_HeatFlux := rLangmuirHeatFlux_MWm2_Probe1;
    ELSIF ((rLangmuirHeatFlux_MWm2_Probe2 >= rLangmuirHeatFlux_MWm2_Probe1) AND (rLangmuirHeatFlux_MWm2_Probe2 <= rLangmuirHeatFlux_MWm2_Probe3)) OR
          ((rLangmuirHeatFlux_MWm2_Probe2 >= rLangmuirHeatFlux_MWm2_Probe3) AND (rLangmuirHeatFlux_MWm2_Probe2 <= rLangmuirHeatFlux_MWm2_Probe1)) THEN
        rLangmuir_Voted_HeatFlux := rLangmuirHeatFlux_MWm2_Probe2;
    ELSE
        rLangmuir_Voted_HeatFlux := rLangmuirHeatFlux_MWm2_Probe3;
    END_IF;

    (* Variance calculation *)
    rTempCalc1 := (rLangmuirHeatFlux_MWm2_Probe1 + rLangmuirHeatFlux_MWm2_Probe2 + rLangmuirHeatFlux_MWm2_Probe3) / 3.0;
    rLangmuir_Variance := ((rLangmuirHeatFlux_MWm2_Probe1 - rTempCalc1) * (rLangmuirHeatFlux_MWm2_Probe1 - rTempCalc1) +
                           (rLangmuirHeatFlux_MWm2_Probe2 - rTempCalc1) * (rLangmuirHeatFlux_MWm2_Probe2 - rTempCalc1) +
                           (rLangmuirHeatFlux_MWm2_Probe3 - rTempCalc1) * (rLangmuirHeatFlux_MWm2_Probe3 - rTempCalc1)) / 3.0;

    (* Check for single-probe deviation *)
    IF (ABS(rLangmuirHeatFlux_MWm2_Probe1 - rLangmuir_Voted_HeatFlux) > rLangmuir_MaxDeviation_MWm2) THEN
        bLangmuir_Probe1_Fault := TRUE;
        bLangmuir_Disagreement_Warning := TRUE;
    END_IF;
    IF (ABS(rLangmuirHeatFlux_MWm2_Probe2 - rLangmuir_Voted_HeatFlux) > rLangmuir_MaxDeviation_MWm2) THEN
        bLangmuir_Probe2_Fault := TRUE;
        bLangmuir_Disagreement_Warning := TRUE;
    END_IF;
    IF (ABS(rLangmuirHeatFlux_MWm2_Probe3 - rLangmuir_Voted_HeatFlux) > rLangmuir_MaxDeviation_MWm2) THEN
        bLangmuir_Probe3_Fault := TRUE;
        bLangmuir_Disagreement_Warning := TRUE;
    END_IF;

ELSIF iLangmuir_ValidCount = 2 THEN
    (* 2 probes valid: 2oo2 Average *)
    bLangmuir_Disagreement_Warning := TRUE;
    IF bLangmuir_1_Valid AND bLangmuir_2_Valid THEN
        rLangmuir_Voted_HeatFlux := (rLangmuirHeatFlux_MWm2_Probe1 + rLangmuirHeatFlux_MWm2_Probe2) * 0.5;
        bLangmuir_Probe3_Fault := TRUE;
    ELSIF bLangmuir_1_Valid AND bLangmuir_3_Valid THEN
        rLangmuir_Voted_HeatFlux := (rLangmuirHeatFlux_MWm2_Probe1 + rLangmuirHeatFlux_MWm2_Probe3) * 0.5;
        bLangmuir_Probe2_Fault := TRUE;
    ELSE
        rLangmuir_Voted_HeatFlux := (rLangmuirHeatFlux_MWm2_Probe2 + rLangmuirHeatFlux_MWm2_Probe3) * 0.5;
        bLangmuir_Probe1_Fault := TRUE;
    END_IF;
    rLangmuir_Variance := 1.0;

ELSIF iLangmuir_ValidCount = 1 THEN
    (* 1 probe valid: Degraded 1oo1 *)
    IF bLangmuir_1_Valid THEN
        rLangmuir_Voted_HeatFlux := rLangmuirHeatFlux_MWm2_Probe1;
        bLangmuir_Probe2_Fault := TRUE;
        bLangmuir_Probe3_Fault := TRUE;
    ELSIF bLangmuir_2_Valid THEN
        rLangmuir_Voted_HeatFlux := rLangmuirHeatFlux_MWm2_Probe2;
        bLangmuir_Probe1_Fault := TRUE;
        bLangmuir_Probe3_Fault := TRUE;
    ELSE
        rLangmuir_Voted_HeatFlux := rLangmuirHeatFlux_MWm2_Probe3;
        bLangmuir_Probe1_Fault := TRUE;
        bLangmuir_Probe2_Fault := TRUE;
    END_IF;
    rLangmuir_Variance := 4.0;

ELSE
    (* All probes invalid (0 valid): Langmuir Diagnostic Blackout *)
    bLangmuir_Probe1_Fault := TRUE;
    bLangmuir_Probe2_Fault := TRUE;
    bLangmuir_Probe3_Fault := TRUE;
    rLangmuir_Voted_HeatFlux := aX_Hat[2]; (* Fallback to observer state *)
    rLangmuir_Variance := 15.0;
    wDiagnosticFaultWord := wDiagnosticFaultWord OR 16#0002; (* Bit 1: Total Langmuir Loss *)
END_IF;

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
   BLOCK 5: SECONDARY DIAGNOSTIC FUSION: IR CAMERA & BOLOMETRY RECONCILIATION
   Cross-verifies voted Langmuir heat flux against optical surface thermography
   ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* Plausibility check on IR thermography camera reading *)
IF (rIRCameraSurfaceTemp_DegC >= 20.0) AND (rIRCameraSurfaceTemp_DegC <= 2500.0) THEN
    (* Reconcile surface temperature using 1D semi-infinite slab thermal model:
       T_surf ~ T_bulk + q_target * (thickness / k_tungsten)
       With thickness = 0.010 m (10 mm armor) and k_tungsten ~ 140 W/(m*K)
       DeltaT = q [W/m2] * (0.01 / 140) = q [MW/m2] * 1e6 * 7.1428e-5 = q [MW/m2] * 71.43 deg C
    *)
    rCalculatedSurfaceTemp_DegC := rDivertorTileTemp_DegC + (rLangmuir_Voted_HeatFlux * 71.43);

    (* If Langmuir probe indicates detachment (low heat flux) but IR camera detects scorching surface (>800 deg C),
       detect sheath breakdown / Langmuir probe short circuit and raise warning *)
    IF (rLangmuir_Voted_HeatFlux < 3.0) AND (rIRCameraSurfaceTemp_DegC > 750.0) THEN
        wDiagnosticFaultWord := wDiagnosticFaultWord OR 16#0004; (* Bit 2: Probe Sheath Breakdown / False Detachment *)
        (* Override voted heat flux with IR thermal inversion value *)
        rLangmuir_Voted_HeatFlux := (rIRCameraSurfaceTemp_DegC - rDivertorTileTemp_DegC) / 71.43;
        IF rLangmuir_Voted_HeatFlux < 0.0 THEN rLangmuir_Voted_HeatFlux := 0.0; END_IF;
    END_IF;
ELSE
    wDiagnosticFaultWord := wDiagnosticFaultWord OR 16#0008; (* Bit 3: IR Camera Blind / Window Coated *)
END_IF;

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
   BLOCK 6: PLASMA POWER BALANCE & DIVERTOR EXHAUST METRICS
   Computes radiative fraction f_rad and total power across separatrix P_sep
   ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* Total heating power = Auxiliary (NBI+ECRH+ICRH) + Ohmic heating (Ip * V_loop) *)
rTempCalc1 := (rPlasmaCurrent_kA * 1000.0) * rLoopVoltage_V * 1.0E-6; (* Ohmic power [MW] *)
IF rTempCalc1 < 0.0 THEN rTempCalc1 := 0.0; END_IF;
rTempCalc2 := rTotalAuxiliaryPower_MW + rTempCalc1; (* Total heating power P_tot [MW] *)

(* Power across separatrix: P_sep = P_tot - P_rad,core *)
IF rTempCalc2 > rBolometerPradCore_MW THEN
    rTempCalc3 := rTempCalc2 - rBolometerPradCore_MW;
ELSE
    rTempCalc3 := 0.50; (* Minimum residual loss power *)
END_IF;

(* Radiative fraction: f_rad = (P_rad,core + P_rad,div) / P_tot *)
IF rTempCalc2 > 1.0 THEN
    rRadiativeFraction := (rBolometerPradCore_MW + rBolometerPradDivertor_MW) / rTempCalc2;
ELSE
    rRadiativeFraction := 0.0;
END_IF;

(* Bound radiative fraction *)
IF rRadiativeFraction > 1.20 THEN
    rRadiativeFraction := 1.20;
    wAlarmCodeWord := wAlarmCodeWord OR 16#0010; (* Bit 4: Radiation Collapse / MARFE Risk *)
END_IF;

(* Divertor thermal margin relative to 10.0 MW/m2 steady-state limit *)
IF rLangmuir_Voted_HeatFlux < C_MAX_STEADY_HEAT_FLUX_MWM2 THEN
    rDivertorThermalMargin_Pct := ((C_MAX_STEADY_HEAT_FLUX_MWM2 - rLangmuir_Voted_HeatFlux) / C_MAX_STEADY_HEAT_FLUX_MWM2) * 100.0;
ELSE
    rDivertorThermalMargin_Pct := 0.0;
END_IF;

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
   BLOCK 7: 5th-ORDER DISCRETE-TIME STATE-SPACE OBSERVER (KALMAN/LUENBERGER)
   Reconciles physical dynamics with noisy / degraded sensor measurements
   Step 1: Measurement vector update
   Step 2: Predicted state: x_pred = A * x_hat + B * u
   Step 3: Predicted output: y_hat = C * x_pred + D * u
   Step 4: Innovation: y_innov = y_meas - y_hat
   Step 5: Corrected state: x_hat = x_pred + L * y_innov
   ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* Reconciled measurement vector *)
aY_Meas[1] := rThomson_Voted_Te;
aY_Meas[2] := rLangmuir_Voted_HeatFlux;
aY_Meas[3] := rDivertorTileTemp_DegC;

(* Current control vector [N2, Ne, Ar] *)
aU_Control[1] := rActualFlow_N2_Pam3s;
aU_Control[2] := rActualFlow_Ne_Pam3s;
aU_Control[3] := rActualFlow_Ar_Pam3s;

(* Step 2: x_pred = A * x_hat + B * u *)
FOR iIdx := 1 TO 5 DO
    rTempDotProduct := 0.0;
    FOR jIdx := 1 TO 5 DO
        rTempDotProduct := rTempDotProduct + (aA_Matrix[iIdx, jIdx] * aX_Hat[jIdx]);
    END_FOR;
    FOR kIdx := 1 TO 3 DO
        rTempDotProduct := rTempDotProduct + (aB_Matrix[iIdx, kIdx] * aU_Control[kIdx]);
    END_FOR;
    aX_Pred[iIdx] := rTempDotProduct;
END_FOR;

(* Step 3: y_hat = C * x_pred + D * u *)
FOR iIdx := 1 TO 3 DO
    rTempDotProduct := 0.0;
    FOR jIdx := 1 TO 5 DO
        rTempDotProduct := rTempDotProduct + (aC_Matrix[iIdx, jIdx] * aX_Pred[jIdx]);
    END_FOR;
    FOR kIdx := 1 TO 3 DO
        rTempDotProduct := rTempDotProduct + (aD_Matrix[iIdx, kIdx] * aU_Control[kIdx]);
    END_FOR;
    aY_Hat[iIdx] := rTempDotProduct;
END_FOR;

(* Step 4: Innovation y_innov = y_meas - y_hat with sensor fault masking *)
FOR iIdx := 1 TO 3 DO
    (* If specific diagnostic is in total failure, suppress innovation to avoid corrupting observer *)
    IF (iIdx = 1) AND (iThomson_ValidCount = 0) THEN
        aY_Innov[1] := 0.0; (* Zero innovation on Thomson total failure *)
    ELSIF (iIdx = 2) AND (iLangmuir_ValidCount = 0) THEN
        aY_Innov[2] := 0.0; (* Zero innovation on Langmuir total failure *)
    ELSE
        aY_Innov[iIdx] := aY_Meas[iIdx] - aY_Hat[iIdx];
    END_IF;
END_FOR;

(* Step 5: x_hat = x_pred + L * y_innov *)
FOR iIdx := 1 TO 5 DO
    rTempDotProduct := 0.0;
    FOR jIdx := 1 TO 3 DO
        rTempDotProduct := rTempDotProduct + (aL_Matrix[iIdx, jIdx] * aY_Innov[jIdx]);
    END_FOR;
    aX_Hat[iIdx] := aX_Pred[iIdx] + rTempDotProduct;
END_FOR;

(* Apply physical realism saturation bounds to estimated states *)
IF aX_Hat[1] < 0.20 THEN aX_Hat[1] := 0.20; END_IF;      (* Te_div cannot be below 0.2 eV *)
IF aX_Hat[1] > 150.0 THEN aX_Hat[1] := 150.0; END_IF;
IF aX_Hat[2] < 0.00 THEN aX_Hat[2] := 0.00; END_IF;      (* q_div cannot be negative *)
IF aX_Hat[2] > 60.0 THEN aX_Hat[2] := 60.0; END_IF;
IF aX_Hat[3] < 0.001 THEN aX_Hat[3] := 0.001; END_IF;   (* Neutral pressure lower limit *)
IF aX_Hat[4] < 0.00 THEN aX_Hat[4] := 0.00; END_IF;      (* Prad_div cannot be negative *)
IF aX_Hat[5] < 20.0 THEN aX_Hat[5] := 20.0; END_IF;      (* T_monoblock minimum room temperature *)

(* Transfer observer states to output variables *)
rEstimatedTe_eV := aX_Hat[1];
rEstimatedHeatFlux_MWm2 := aX_Hat[2];
rEstimatedNeutralPressure_Pa := aX_Hat[3];
rEstimatedPradDivertor_MW := aX_Hat[4];
rEstimatedMonoblockTemp_DegC := aX_Hat[5];

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
   BLOCK 8: GRACEFUL DEGRADATION HIERARCHY & SENSOR ISOLATION
   Determines system capability level based on remaining diagnostic redundancy
   ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
IF (iThomson_ValidCount = 3) AND (iLangmuir_ValidCount = 3) THEN
    iDegradedModeLevel := 0; (* Tier 0: Full nominal 2oo3 redundancy across all diagnostics *)
    bDetachmentDegraded := FALSE;
ELSIF (iThomson_ValidCount >= 2) AND (iLangmuir_ValidCount >= 2) THEN
    iDegradedModeLevel := 1; (* Tier 1: Single channel fault; operating in 2oo2 degraded voting *)
    bDetachmentDegraded := FALSE;
ELSIF (iThomson_ValidCount = 0) AND (iLangmuir_ValidCount >= 2) THEN
    iDegradedModeLevel := 2; (* Tier 2: Thomson lost completely; Langmuir primary + IR camera cross-check *)
    bDetachmentDegraded := TRUE;
    wDiagnosticFaultWord := wDiagnosticFaultWord OR 16#0020; (* Bit 5: Degraded Mode 2 Active *)
ELSIF (iThomson_ValidCount >= 2) AND (iLangmuir_ValidCount = 0) THEN
    iDegradedModeLevel := 3; (* Tier 3: Langmuir lost completely; Thomson primary + Observer state reconstruction *)
    bDetachmentDegraded := TRUE;
    wDiagnosticFaultWord := wDiagnosticFaultWord OR 16#0040; (* Bit 6: Degraded Mode 3 Active *)
ELSE
    iDegradedModeLevel := 4; (* Tier 4: Multiple severe failures; Safe conservative feedforward puffing & soft stop *)
    bDetachmentDegraded := TRUE;
    wDiagnosticFaultWord := wDiagnosticFaultWord OR 16#0080; (* Bit 7: Critical Degradation Mode 4 Active *)
    bSoftStopRequested := TRUE;
END_IF;

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
   BLOCK 9: MODEL PREDICTIVE CONTROL (MPC) REFINED QUADRATIC OPTIMIZATION
   Solves constrained quadratic cost function:
       min J = 1/2 * DeltaU^T * H * DeltaU + g^T * DeltaU
   Tracking: rTargetHeatFlux_MWm2, rTargetTe_eV, and maintaining radiative fraction
   ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* Construct 3x3 Hessian Matrix H:
   Diagonal dominance guaranteed by actuator slew-rate regularization weights.
   Cross-coupling terms reflect physical impurity radiation overlap.
*)
aHessian[1,1] := (rWeight_Q * 0.0156) + (rWeight_Te * 0.0072) + rWeight_Rate_N2;
aHessian[1,2] := (rWeight_Q * 0.0122) + (rWeight_Te * 0.0035);
aHessian[1,3] := (rWeight_Q * 0.0181) + (rWeight_Te * 0.0015);

aHessian[2,1] := aHessian[1,2];
aHessian[2,2] := (rWeight_Q * 0.0096) + (rWeight_Te * 0.0018) + rWeight_Rate_Ne;
aHessian[2,3] := (rWeight_Q * 0.0142) + (rWeight_Te * 0.0008);

aHessian[3,1] := aHessian[1,3];
aHessian[3,2] := aHessian[2,3];
aHessian[3,3] := (rWeight_Q * 0.0210) + (rWeight_Te * 0.0003) + rWeight_Rate_Ar;

(* Construct 3x1 Cost Gradient Vector g:
   Calculates error between observer states and setpoints:
   e_q = rEstimatedHeatFlux_MWm2 - rTargetHeatFlux_MWm2
   e_te = rEstimatedTe_eV - rTargetTe_eV
*)
rTempCalc1 := rEstimatedHeatFlux_MWm2 - rTargetHeatFlux_MWm2;
rTempCalc2 := rEstimatedTe_eV - rTargetTe_eV;

aGradient[1] := (rWeight_Q * rTempCalc1 * (-0.125)) + (rWeight_Te * rTempCalc2 * (-0.085));
aGradient[2] := (rWeight_Q * rTempCalc1 * (-0.098)) + (rWeight_Te * rTempCalc2 * (-0.042));
aGradient[3] := (rWeight_Q * rTempCalc1 * (-0.145)) + (rWeight_Te * rTempCalc2 * (-0.018));

(* Penalize Argon usage if core radiation is approaching safety limit *)
IF rBolometerPradCore_MW > 0.45 * rTempCalc2 THEN
    aGradient[3] := aGradient[3] + 15.0; (* Heavily disincentivize additional Argon puffing *)
END_IF;

(* Boost N2 gradient during ELM burst event *)
IF bELM_EventTrigger THEN
    aGradient[1] := aGradient[1] - 8.5; (* Demand rapid Nitrogen surge *)
END_IF;

(* Active-Set Projected Gradient Solver (8 deterministic iterations per scan cycle) *)
aDeltaU[1] := 0.0;
aDeltaU[2] := 0.0;
aDeltaU[3] := 0.0;

FOR iQPIteration := 1 TO 8 DO
    (* Compute gradient of cost: grad_J = H * DeltaU + g *)
    FOR iIdx := 1 TO 3 DO
        rTempDotProduct := 0.0;
        FOR jIdx := 1 TO 3 DO
            rTempDotProduct := rTempDotProduct + (aHessian[iIdx, jIdx] * aDeltaU[jIdx]);
        END_FOR;
        rTempDotProduct := rTempDotProduct + aGradient[iIdx];

        (* Projected gradient step *)
        aDeltaU_Trial[iIdx] := aDeltaU[iIdx] - (rStepSize_Alpha * rTempDotProduct);

        (* Slew-rate constraint: -DeltaU_max <= DeltaU <= DeltaU_max *)
        rUpperBound := C_MAX_SLEW_RATE_PAM3S2 * rCycleTime_s;
        rLowerBound := -rUpperBound;

        IF aDeltaU_Trial[iIdx] > rUpperBound THEN
            aDeltaU_Trial[iIdx] := rUpperBound;
        ELSIF aDeltaU_Trial[iIdx] < rLowerBound THEN
            aDeltaU_Trial[iIdx] := rLowerBound;
        END_IF;

        (* Absolute actuator saturation projection: 0 <= U_prev + DeltaU <= U_max *)
        IF iIdx = 1 THEN
            rUpperBound := C_MAX_VALVE_N2_PAM3S - aU_Prev[1];
            rLowerBound := 0.0 - aU_Prev[1];
        ELSIF iIdx = 2 THEN
            rUpperBound := C_MAX_VALVE_NE_PAM3S - aU_Prev[2];
            rLowerBound := 0.0 - aU_Prev[2];
        ELSE
            rUpperBound := C_MAX_VALVE_AR_PAM3S - aU_Prev[3];
            rLowerBound := 0.0 - aU_Prev[3];
        END_IF;

        IF aDeltaU_Trial[iIdx] > rUpperBound THEN
            aDeltaU_Trial[iIdx] := rUpperBound;
        ELSIF aDeltaU_Trial[iIdx] < rLowerBound THEN
            aDeltaU_Trial[iIdx] := rLowerBound;
        END_IF;

        aDeltaU[iIdx] := aDeltaU_Trial[iIdx];
    END_FOR;
END_FOR;

(* Calculate unconstrained target flows *)
rTargetFlow_N2_Pam3s := aU_Prev[1] + aDeltaU[1];
rTargetFlow_Ne_Pam3s := aU_Prev[2] + aDeltaU[2];
rTargetFlow_Ar_Pam3s := aU_Prev[3] + aDeltaU[3];

(* Clamp to non-negative physical bounds *)
IF rTargetFlow_N2_Pam3s < 0.0 THEN rTargetFlow_N2_Pam3s := 0.0; END_IF;
IF rTargetFlow_Ne_Pam3s < 0.0 THEN rTargetFlow_Ne_Pam3s := 0.0; END_IF;
IF rTargetFlow_Ar_Pam3s < 0.0 THEN rTargetFlow_Ar_Pam3s := 0.0; END_IF;

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
   BLOCK 10: SUPERSONIC ACTUATOR DYNAMICS & CHOKED NOZZLE PRESSURE COMPENSATION
   Applies sonic choked flow formula: Q_max = C_conductance * P_manifold
   Filters demand through piezoelectric and solenoid lag time constants
   ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* Manifold pressure sanity check (minimum 2.0 bar required for supersonic jet formation) *)
IF rGasManifoldPressure_N2_bar < 2.0 THEN
    wDiagnosticFaultWord := wDiagnosticFaultWord OR 16#0100; (* Bit 8: Low N2 Plenum Pressure *)
    rTempCalc1 := rGasManifoldPressure_N2_bar * rChokedConductance_N2;
    IF rTargetFlow_N2_Pam3s > rTempCalc1 THEN rTargetFlow_N2_Pam3s := rTempCalc1; END_IF;
END_IF;

IF rGasManifoldPressure_Ne_bar < 2.0 THEN
    wDiagnosticFaultWord := wDiagnosticFaultWord OR 16#0200; (* Bit 9: Low Ne Plenum Pressure *)
    rTempCalc2 := rGasManifoldPressure_Ne_bar * rChokedConductance_Ne;
    IF rTargetFlow_Ne_Pam3s > rTempCalc2 THEN rTargetFlow_Ne_Pam3s := rTempCalc2; END_IF;
END_IF;

IF rGasManifoldPressure_Ar_bar < 2.0 THEN
    wDiagnosticFaultWord := wDiagnosticFaultWord OR 16#0400; (* Bit 10: Low Ar Plenum Pressure *)
    rTempCalc3 := rGasManifoldPressure_Ar_bar * rChokedConductance_Ar;
    IF rTargetFlow_Ar_Pam3s > rTempCalc3 THEN rTargetFlow_Ar_Pam3s := rTempCalc3; END_IF;
END_IF;

(* Dynamic lag simulation / filter representing valve electro-mechanical response *)
IF rPiezoTimeConstant_s > 0.0 THEN
    rTempCalc1 := rCycleTime_s / (rPiezoTimeConstant_s + rCycleTime_s);
    rActualFlow_N2_Pam3s := rActualFlow_N2_Pam3s + rTempCalc1 * (rTargetFlow_N2_Pam3s - rActualFlow_N2_Pam3s);
    rActualFlow_Ne_Pam3s := rActualFlow_Ne_Pam3s + rTempCalc1 * (rTargetFlow_Ne_Pam3s - rActualFlow_Ne_Pam3s);
ELSE
    rActualFlow_N2_Pam3s := rTargetFlow_N2_Pam3s;
    rActualFlow_Ne_Pam3s := rTargetFlow_Ne_Pam3s;
END_IF;

IF rSolenoidTimeConstant_s > 0.0 THEN
    rTempCalc2 := rCycleTime_s / (rSolenoidTimeConstant_s + rCycleTime_s);
    rActualFlow_Ar_Pam3s := rActualFlow_Ar_Pam3s + rTempCalc2 * (rTargetFlow_Ar_Pam3s - rActualFlow_Ar_Pam3s);
ELSE
    rActualFlow_Ar_Pam3s := rTargetFlow_Ar_Pam3s;
END_IF;

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

     Conversely, complete drainage loss causes high-pressure compressed air blowby into the atmospheric condensate

  3. STATE-SPACE DISCRETE PLANT REPRESENTATION & MODEL PREDICTIVE CONTROL (MPC):
     The coupled thermal-hydraulic subsystem is modeled as a 4th-order discrete state-space plant with sampling
     period Ts = 100 ms (0.10 s):
         x[k+1] = A * x[k] + B * u[k] + E * d[k]
         y[k]   = C * x[k] + D * u[k]
     where:
       State Vector x = [x1, x2, x3, x4]^T:
         x1: Intercooler air exit temperature deviation (Delta T_air_out = T_air_out - 38.0 deg C) [K]
         x2: Knockout drum liquid level deviation (Delta h_drum = Level_voted - 50.0%) [%]
         x3: Core differential pressure drop deviation (Delta DP_core = DP_measured - DP_nominal) [mbar]
         x4: Cooling fluid return temperature deviation (Delta T_cool_out = T_return - T_return_target) [K]
       Manipulated Input Vector u = [u1, u2]^T:
         u1: Cooling water / HTF flow control valve position (0.0 .. 100.0%) [%]
         u2: Knockout drum continuous condensate drain valve position (0.0 .. 100.0%) [%]
       Disturbance Vector d = [d1, d2, d3]^T:
         d1: Air mass flow rate variation (Delta m_dot_air) [kg/s]
         d2: Stage 1 discharge air temperature variation (Delta T_stage1_out) [K]
         d3: Compressor train rotational shaft speed variation (Delta N_rpm) [rpm]

     Continuous-time physics Jacobian matrices linearized around nominal operating point (Air: 180 kg/s, 3.8 bar,
     Cooling flow: 650 m3/h, Drum level: 50.0%):
         A_c = [ -0.1250    0.0000    0.0000    0.0450 ]
               [  0.0380   -0.0420    0.0000    0.0000 ]
               [  0.0000    0.0000   -0.2100    0.0000 ]
               [  0.0550    0.0000    0.0000   -0.0950 ]
     Discretized over Ts = 0.1s via matrix exponential Phi = exp(A_c * Ts):
         A = [ 0.8825    0.0000    0.0000    0.0423 ]
             [ 0.0036    0.9589    0.0000    0.0000 ]
             [ 0.0000    0.0000    0.7945    0.0000 ]
             [ 0.0518    0.0000    0.0000    0.9094 ]
         B = [ -0.2850    0.0000 ]
             [  0.0082   -0.1945 ]
             [  0.0015    0.0000 ]
             [  0.1462    0.0000 ]
         E = [  0.1240    0.2180    0.0008 ]
             [  0.0415    0.0000    0.0002 ]
             [  0.0182    0.0000    0.0012 ]
             [  0.0645    0.0842    0.0004 ]
         C = Eye(4),   D = Zero(4,2)

     MPC Optimization Criterion:
     Minimizes the finite-horizon quadratic objective function:
         J(k) = Sum_{j=1..Np} [ (y(k+j) - r(k+j))^T * Q * (y(k+j) - r(k+j)) ] +
                Sum_{j=0..Nu-1} [ Delta_u(k+j)^T * R * Delta_u(k+j) ]
     where Q = diag(12.0, 18.0, 2.5, 4.0) and R = diag(1.5, 2.0).
     The unconstrained analytical Riccati gain matrix K_mpc and feedforward disturbance rejection matrix K_ff
     are pre-computed and evaluated cyclically with strict actuator slew rate and saturation limiters.

  4. TRIPLE MODULAR REDUNDANCY (2oo3 TMR) SENSOR VOTING ALGORITHM:
     Three independent, physically separated level sensors monitor the knockout drum:
         - LT1: High-frequency Guided Wave Radar (GWR) probe (flange-mounted top chamber)
         - LT2: Differential Pressure (DP) transmitter with capillary remote seals
         - LT3: Magnetostrictive continuous displacer sensor (external bypass bridle)
     The 2oo3 voting engine computes pairwise absolute residuals:
         e12 = |LT1 - LT2|,  e23 = |LT2 - LT3|,  e31 = |LT3 - LT1|
     If any channel deviates beyond the tolerance limit (delta > 5.0%) for longer than debounce time (300 ms),
     or suffers out-of-range hardware fault (NAMUR NE43 breakdown < 3.8 mA or > 20.5 mA), the faulty transmitter
     is isolated and the voting engine degrades gracefully:
         2oo3 Healthy (Median Vote) -> 2oo2 Averaging (Single Fault) -> 1oo1 Last Healthy (Dual Fault) -> Failsafe Trip.

  5. COMPREHENSIVE ISA-18.2 / ISA-84 DEFENSE-IN-DEPTH ALARM HIERARCHY:
     Incorporates multi-tier trip latches, first-out indication, demister pad differential pressure surge margin
     biasing, and emergency high-capacity drain dump control.
========================================================================================================================
*)

VAR_INPUT
    (* --- Safety Permissives and Master Commands --- *)
    bMasterEnable                   : BOOL;     (* Main CAES compression train master enable [TRUE=Permitted] *)
    bEmergencyStopOk                : BOOL;     (* Hardwired SIL-3 emergency stop circuit [TRUE=Healthy, FALSE=Tripped] *)
    bAutoModeSelect                 : BOOL;     (* Control mode selection: TRUE = Automatic MPC, FALSE = Safe Coordinated Manual *)
    bManualReset                    : BOOL;     (* Operator manual reset pushbutton for latched critical trips *)

    (* --- Turbomachinery Dynamic Operation Measurements --- *)
    rCompressorSpeed_RPM            : REAL;     (* Multi-stage centrifugal compressor shaft speed [rpm] (0.0 .. 18000.0) *)
    rAirMassFlow_kgs                : REAL;     (* Primary air inlet mass flow rate [kg/s] (0.0 .. 250.0) *)
    rStage1DischargePress_bar       : REAL;     (* Stage 1 discharge air pressure upstream of intercooler [bar] (1.0 .. 35.0) *)
    rStage1DischargeTemp_DegC       : REAL;     (* Stage 1 discharge air temperature upstream of intercooler [deg C] (20.0 .. 250.0) *)

    (* --- Intercooler Aerodynamic and Thermal Measurements --- *)
    rInterstageAirPress_bar         : REAL;     (* Intercooler outlet air pressure entering knockout drum [bar] (1.0 .. 35.0) *)
    rInterstageAirTemp_DegC         : REAL;     (* Intercooler outlet air temperature entering knockout drum [deg C] (5.0 .. 100.0) *)
    rIntercoolerDiffPress_mbar      : REAL;     (* Core air-side differential pressure drop across heat exchanger [mbar] (0.0 .. 800.0) *)
    rCoolingWaterSupplyTemp_DegC    : REAL;     (* Cooling medium / thermal energy storage supply temperature [deg C] (10.0 .. 50.0) *)
    rCoolingWaterReturnTemp_DegC    : REAL;     (* Cooling medium return temperature downstream of intercooler [deg C] (15.0 .. 95.0) *)
    rCoolingWaterFlow_m3h           : REAL;     (* Cooling water circulation volumetric flow rate [m3/h] (0.0 .. 1500.0) *)

    (* --- Knockout Drum Redundant Instrumentation (2oo3 TMR) --- *)
    rDrumLevel_Sensor1_Pct          : REAL;     (* Knockout drum level transmitter 1: Guided Wave Radar [%] (0.0 .. 100.0) *)
    rDrumLevel_Sensor2_Pct          : REAL;     (* Knockout drum level transmitter 2: Differential Pressure [%] (0.0 .. 100.0) *)
    rDrumLevel_Sensor3_Pct          : REAL;     (* Knockout drum level transmitter 3: Magnetostrictive Displacer [%] (0.0 .. 100.0) *)
    rDemisterDiffPress_mbar         : REAL;     (* Knockout drum wire-mesh demister pad differential pressure [mbar] (0.0 .. 250.0) *)
    bHighHighLiquidLevelSwitch      : BOOL;     (* Hardwired SIL-3 discrete float switch LSHH for carryover trip [FALSE=Trip] *)

    (* --- Ambient Atmospheric Psychrometric Conditions --- *)
    rAmbientAirTemp_DegC            : REAL;     (* Ambient weather station dry-bulb temperature [deg C] (-25.0 .. 50.0) *)
    rAmbientHumidity_Pct            : REAL;     (* Ambient weather station relative humidity [%] (5.0 .. 100.0) *)
END_VAR

VAR_OUTPUT
    (* --- Primary Process Safety and Status Indicators --- *)
    bSystemReady                    : BOOL;     (* Subsystem operational readiness status indicator *)
    bCompressorTripInterlock        : BOOL;     (* Hardwired emergency trip signal to compressor ESD [TRUE = Trip Train] *)
    bDegradedModeActive             : BOOL;     (* Operating under degraded sensor redundancy (2oo2 or 1oo1) *)

    (* --- Modulated Final Control Elements (Actuation Signals) --- *)
    rCoolingWaterValve_Pct          : REAL;     (* Modulated cooling water flow control valve command [%] (0.0 .. 100.0) *)
    rCondensateDrainValve_Pct       : REAL;     (* Modulated continuous condensate drain valve command [%] (0.0 .. 100.0) *)
    rEmergencyDrainDump_Pct         : REAL;     (* High-capacity rapid blowdown emergency drain valve command [%] (0.0 .. 100.0) *)
    rAntiSurgeRecycleBias_Pct       : REAL;     (* Feedforward dynamic opening bias added to Stage 1 anti-surge valve [%] (0.0 .. 50.0) *)

    (* --- Packed Diagnostic and Alarm Words --- *)
    wAlarmWord                      : WORD;     (* ISA-18.2 packed alarm annunciator word (Bit0=Trip, Bit1=LAHH, etc.) *)
    wSystemStatusWord               : WORD;     (* Subsystem operational state and mode packed word *)

    (* --- Validated Process and Thermodynamic Analytics --- *)
    rVotedDrumLevel_Pct             : REAL;     (* 2oo3 TMR resolved and validated knockout drum liquid level [%] *)
    rCalculatedCondensationRate_kgh : REAL;     (* Real-time theoretical water condensation mass rate [kg/h] *)
    rThermalDutyRecovered_kW        : REAL;     (* Real-time thermal exergy transferred to cooling fluid / TES [kW] *)
    rIntercoolerThermalEff_Pct      : REAL;     (* Real-time heat exchanger thermal effectiveness [%] *)
END_VAR

VAR
    (* --- State Machine Registers (ISA-88 Architecture) --- *)
    iState                          : INT := 0; (* Active operational state index *)
    iPreviousState                  : INT := 0; (* State transition audit index *)
    bStateInitialized               : BOOL := FALSE;

    (* --- Triple Modular Redundancy (2oo3 TMR) Voting Registers --- *)
    bSensor1_Valid                  : BOOL := TRUE;
    bSensor2_Valid                  : BOOL := TRUE;
    bSensor3_Valid                  : BOOL := TRUE;
    iHealthySensorCount             : INT := 3;
    rDelta12                        : REAL := 0.0;
    rDelta23                        : REAL := 0.0;
    rDelta31                        : REAL := 0.0;
    rTmrToleranceLimit_Pct          : REAL := 5.0;  (* Maximum allowed deviation between channels [%] *)
    tonSensor1FaultTimer            : TON;
    tonSensor2FaultTimer            : TON;
    tonSensor3FaultTimer            : TON;
    bSensor1FaultLatched            : BOOL := FALSE;
    bSensor2FaultLatched            : BOOL := FALSE;
    bSensor3FaultLatched            : BOOL := FALSE;

    (* --- Discrete State-Space Model Representation (Ts = 0.1s) --- *)
    rState_x1_TempErr               : REAL := 0.0; (* Delta T_air_out [K] *)
    rState_x2_LevelErr              : REAL := 0.0; (* Delta h_drum [%] *)
    rState_x3_PressLoss             : REAL := 0.0; (* Delta DP_core [mbar] *)
    rState_x4_ReturnTempErr         : REAL := 0.0; (* Delta T_cool_out [K] *)

    (* State Transition Matrix A (4x4) *)
    rA11 : REAL := 0.8825; rA12 : REAL := 0.0000; rA13 : REAL := 0.0000; rA14 : REAL := 0.0423;
    rA21 : REAL := 0.0036; rA22 : REAL := 0.9589; rA23 : REAL := 0.0000; rA24 : REAL := 0.0000;
    rA31 : REAL := 0.0000; rA32 : REAL := 0.0000; rA33 : REAL := 0.7945; rA34 : REAL := 0.0000;
    rA41 : REAL := 0.0518; rA42 : REAL := 0.0000; rA43 : REAL := 0.0000; rA44 : REAL := 0.9094;

    (* Input Coupling Matrix B (4x2) *)
    rB11 : REAL := -0.2850; rB12 : REAL :=  0.0000;
    rB21 : REAL :=  0.0082; rB22 : REAL := -0.1945;
    rB31 : REAL :=  0.0015; rB32 : REAL :=  0.0000;
    rB41 : REAL :=  0.1462; rB42 : REAL :=  0.0000;

    (* Disturbance Coupling Matrix E (4x3) *)
    rE11 : REAL := 0.1240;  rE12 : REAL := 0.2180;  rE13 : REAL := 0.0008;
    rE21 : REAL := 0.0415;  rE22 : REAL := 0.0000;  rE23 : REAL := 0.0002;
    rE31 : REAL := 0.0182;  rE32 : REAL := 0.0000;  rE33 : REAL := 0.0012;
    rE41 : REAL := 0.0645;  rE42 : REAL := 0.0842;  rE43 : REAL := 0.0004;

    (* Disturbance State Vector *)
    rDist_d1_FlowErr                : REAL := 0.0;
    rDist_d2_InletTempErr           : REAL := 0.0;
    rDist_d3_SpeedErr               : REAL := 0.0;

    (* Model Predictive Control (MPC) Feedback Gain Matrix K_mpc (2x4) *)
    (* Derived from Discrete Algebraic Riccati Equation with Q and R weightings *)
    rK_mpc_11 : REAL := -0.7420; rK_mpc_12 : REAL :=  0.0150; rK_mpc_13 : REAL := -0.0050; rK_mpc_14 : REAL :=  0.1850;
    rK_mpc_21 : REAL :=  0.0450; rK_mpc_22 : REAL := -0.8920; rK_mpc_23 : REAL :=  0.0000; rK_mpc_24 : REAL :=  0.0000;

    (* Model Predictive Control Feedforward Disturbance Rejection Gain Matrix K_ff (2x3) *)
    rK_ff_11 : REAL := 0.3250;  rK_ff_12 : REAL := 0.5120;  rK_ff_13 : REAL := 0.0018;
    rK_ff_21 : REAL := 0.1180;  rK_ff_22 : REAL := 0.0240;  rK_ff_23 : REAL := 0.0005;

    (* Control Target Setpoints *)
    rAirTempTarget_DegC             : REAL := 38.0; (* Optimum interstage air temperature [deg C] *)
    rDrumLevelTarget_Pct            : REAL := 50.0; (* Optimum knockout drum liquid level setpoint [%] *)
    rNominalAirMassFlow_kgs         : REAL := 180.0;(* Plant baseline mass flow rating [kg/s] *)
    rNominalStage1Temp_DegC         : REAL := 185.0;(* Plant baseline stage 1 discharge temp [deg C] *)
    rNominalSpeed_RPM               : REAL := 14800.0; (* Plant rated operating speed [rpm] *)

    (* Actuator Command Accumulators & Slewing Limits *)
    rCoolingValve_Accum             : REAL := 35.0;
    rDrainValve_Accum               : REAL := 25.0;
    rMaxValveSlew_PctPerSec         : REAL := 15.0; (* Maximum valve rate-of-change [%/s] *)
    rSampleTime_s                   : REAL := 0.10; (* Controller execution cycle time [s] *)

    (* Signal Conditioning and First-Order Filter Accumulators *)
    rAirFlow_Filt                   : REAL := 0.0;
    rInterstageTemp_Filt            : REAL := 38.0;
    rDrumLevel_Filt                 : REAL := 50.0;
    rCoolingFlow_Filt               : REAL := 0.0;
    rDemisterDP_Filt                : REAL := 0.0;
    rFilterAlpha                    : REAL := 0.20; (* First-order PT1 smoothing filter coefficient *)

    (* Thermodynamic Condensation Calculation Variables *)
    rSatPress_Inlet_mbar            : REAL := 0.0;
    rSatPress_Outlet_mbar           : REAL := 0.0;
    rHumRatio_Inlet_kgkg            : REAL := 0.0;
    rHumRatio_Outlet_kgkg           : REAL := 0.0;
    rVaporPress_Ambient_mbar        : REAL := 0.0;
    rSpecHeatAir_kJkgK              : REAL := 1.006; (* Isobaric specific heat of dry air [kJ/(kg*K)] *)
    rSpecHeatWater_kJkgK            : REAL := 4.186; (* Specific heat of liquid water [kJ/(kg*K)] *)
    rLatentHeatVap_kJkg             : REAL := 2260.0;(* Latent heat of vaporization at condensation temp [kJ/kg] *)

    (* System Watchdogs, Timers and Pulse Generators *)
    tonStartupPermissiveDelay       : TON;
    tonPrechargeTimer               : TON;
    tonShutdownCooldownTimer        : TON;
    tonHighLevelPersistenceTimer    : TON;
    tonHighTempPersistenceTimer     : TON;
    tonDemisterDPPersistence        : TON;
    tonResetDebounce                : TON;
    tonEmergencyDumpTimer           : TON;

    (* Diagnostic Counters and Statistical Trackers *)
    udiExecutionCycles              : UDINT := 0;
    udiEmergencyTripCount           : UDINT := 0;
    udiDegradedOperationSeconds     : UDINT := 0;
    rCumulativeDrainVolume_m3       : REAL := 0.0;
    bFirstScan                      : BOOL := TRUE;
    bTripLatch                      : BOOL := FALSE;
END_VAR

(*
========================================================================================================================
  CYCLIC EXECUTION ROUTINE (Ts = 100 ms)
========================================================================================================================
*)

udiExecutionCycles := udiExecutionCycles + 1;

(* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
   LAYER 0: FIRST SCAN INITIALIZATION AND SIGNAL CONDITIONING (PT1 EXPONENTIAL FILTERING)
   --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
IF bFirstScan THEN
    rAirFlow_Filt        := rAirMassFlow_kgs;
    rInterstageTemp_Filt := rInterstageAirTemp_DegC;
    rDrumLevel_Filt      := (rDrumLevel_Sensor1_Pct + rDrumLevel_Sensor2_Pct + rDrumLevel_Sensor3_Pct) / 3.0;
    rCoolingFlow_Filt    := rCoolingWaterFlow_m3h;
    rDemisterDP_Filt     := rDemisterDiffPress_mbar;
    bFirstScan           := FALSE;
ELSE
    rAirFlow_Filt        := rAirFlow_Filt        + rFilterAlpha * (rAirMassFlow_kgs - rAirFlow_Filt);
    rInterstageTemp_Filt := rInterstageTemp_Filt + rFilterAlpha * (rInterstageAirTemp_DegC - rInterstageTemp_Filt);
    rCoolingFlow_Filt    := rCoolingFlow_Filt    + rFilterAlpha * (rCoolingWaterFlow_m3h - rCoolingFlow_Filt);
    rDemisterDP_Filt     := rDemisterDP_Filt     + rFilterAlpha * (rDemisterDiffPress_mbar - rDemisterDP_Filt);
END_IF;

(* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
   LAYER 1: TRIPLE MODULAR REDUNDANCY (2oo3 TMR) LEVEL SENSOR VOTING AND HEALTH VALIDATION
   --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* Step 1.1: Physical boundary range check conforming to NAMUR NE43 standard *)
IF (rDrumLevel_Sensor1_Pct < -2.0) OR (rDrumLevel_Sensor1_Pct > 105.0) THEN
    bSensor1_Valid := FALSE;
ELSE
    bSensor1_Valid := TRUE;
END_IF;

IF (rDrumLevel_Sensor2_Pct < -2.0) OR (rDrumLevel_Sensor2_Pct > 105.0) THEN
    bSensor2_Valid := FALSE;
ELSE
    bSensor2_Valid := TRUE;
END_IF;

IF (rDrumLevel_Sensor3_Pct < -2.0) OR (rDrumLevel_Sensor3_Pct > 105.0) THEN
    bSensor3_Valid := FALSE;
ELSE
    bSensor3_Valid := TRUE;
END_IF;

(* Step 1.2: Compute pairwise absolute residuals between transmitters *)
rDelta12 := ABS(rDrumLevel_Sensor1_Pct - rDrumLevel_Sensor2_Pct);
rDelta23 := ABS(rDrumLevel_Sensor2_Pct - rDrumLevel_Sensor3_Pct);
rDelta31 := ABS(rDrumLevel_Sensor3_Pct - rDrumLevel_Sensor1_Pct);

(* Step 1.3: Fault isolation and persistence debouncing (300 ms delay) *)
tonSensor1FaultTimer(IN := ((rDelta12 > rTmrToleranceLimit_Pct) AND (rDelta31 > rTmrToleranceLimit_Pct)) OR NOT bSensor1_Valid,
                     PT := T#300MS);
IF tonSensor1FaultTimer.Q THEN
    bSensor1FaultLatched := TRUE;
END_IF;

tonSensor2FaultTimer(IN := ((rDelta12 > rTmrToleranceLimit_Pct) AND (rDelta23 > rTmrToleranceLimit_Pct)) OR NOT bSensor2_Valid,
                     PT := T#300MS);
IF tonSensor2FaultTimer.Q THEN
    bSensor2FaultLatched := TRUE;
END_IF;

tonSensor3FaultTimer(IN := ((rDelta23 > rTmrToleranceLimit_Pct) AND (rDelta31 > rTmrToleranceLimit_Pct)) OR NOT bSensor3_Valid,
                     PT := T#300MS);
IF tonSensor3FaultTimer.Q THEN
    bSensor3FaultLatched := TRUE;
END_IF;

(* Step 1.4: Count active healthy channels and resolve voted process value *)
iHealthySensorCount := 0;
IF NOT bSensor1FaultLatched THEN iHealthySensorCount := iHealthySensorCount + 1; END_IF;
IF NOT bSensor2FaultLatched THEN iHealthySensorCount := iHealthySensorCount + 1; END_IF;
IF NOT bSensor3FaultLatched THEN iHealthySensorCount := iHealthySensorCount + 1; END_IF;

IF iHealthySensorCount = 3 THEN
    (* 2oo3 Normal Operation: True Median Selection Algorithm *)
    IF ((rDrumLevel_Sensor1_Pct >= rDrumLevel_Sensor2_Pct) AND (rDrumLevel_Sensor1_Pct <= rDrumLevel_Sensor3_Pct)) OR
       ((rDrumLevel_Sensor1_Pct <= rDrumLevel_Sensor2_Pct) AND (rDrumLevel_Sensor1_Pct >= rDrumLevel_Sensor3_Pct)) THEN
        rVotedDrumLevel_Pct := rDrumLevel_Sensor1_Pct;
    ELSIF ((rDrumLevel_Sensor2_Pct >= rDrumLevel_Sensor1_Pct) AND (rDrumLevel_Sensor2_Pct <= rDrumLevel_Sensor3_Pct)) OR
          ((rDrumLevel_Sensor2_Pct <= rDrumLevel_Sensor1_Pct) AND (rDrumLevel_Sensor2_Pct >= rDrumLevel_Sensor3_Pct)) THEN
        rVotedDrumLevel_Pct := rDrumLevel_Sensor2_Pct;
    ELSE
        rVotedDrumLevel_Pct := rDrumLevel_Sensor3_Pct;
    END_IF;
    bDegradedModeActive := FALSE;

ELSIF iHealthySensorCount = 2 THEN
    (* Degraded 2oo2 Averaging Mode *)
    IF NOT bSensor1FaultLatched AND NOT bSensor2FaultLatched THEN
        rVotedDrumLevel_Pct := (rDrumLevel_Sensor1_Pct + rDrumLevel_Sensor2_Pct) * 0.5;
    ELSIF NOT bSensor2FaultLatched AND NOT bSensor3FaultLatched THEN
        rVotedDrumLevel_Pct := (rDrumLevel_Sensor2_Pct + rDrumLevel_Sensor3_Pct) * 0.5;
    ELSE
        rVotedDrumLevel_Pct := (rDrumLevel_Sensor3_Pct + rDrumLevel_Sensor1_Pct) * 0.5;
    END_IF;
    bDegradedModeActive := TRUE;
    udiDegradedOperationSeconds := udiDegradedOperationSeconds + 1;

ELSIF iHealthySensorCount = 1 THEN
    (* Degraded 1oo1 Single-Channel Mode *)
    IF NOT bSensor1FaultLatched THEN
        rVotedDrumLevel_Pct := rDrumLevel_Sensor1_Pct;
    ELSIF NOT bSensor2FaultLatched THEN
        rVotedDrumLevel_Pct := rDrumLevel_Sensor2_Pct;
    ELSE
        rVotedDrumLevel_Pct := rDrumLevel_Sensor3_Pct;
    END_IF;
    bDegradedModeActive := TRUE;
    udiDegradedOperationSeconds := udiDegradedOperationSeconds + 1;

ELSE
    (* Total Sensor Redundancy Breakdown: Failsafe Default to 85% to Force Emergency Drainage *)
    rVotedDrumLevel_Pct := 85.0;
    bDegradedModeActive := TRUE;
END_IF;

(* Smooth the resolved voted level through low-pass filter *)
rDrumLevel_Filt := rDrumLevel_Filt + rFilterAlpha * (rVotedDrumLevel_Pct - rDrumLevel_Filt);

(* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
   LAYER 2: CRITICAL PROCESS SAFETY INTERLOCKS AND FIRST-OUT ESD TRIP LATCHING (SIL-3)
   --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* Condition A: External Emergency Stop Loop Interruption *)
IF NOT bEmergencyStopOk THEN
    bTripLatch := TRUE;
    wAlarmWord.0 := TRUE; (* Master ESD trip active *)
END_IF;

(* Condition B: Knockout Drum High-High Liquid Level Carryover Threat (LAHH) *)
(* Dual-path protection: Hardwired float switch OR Voted level > 82.0% for 500 ms *)
tonHighLevelPersistenceTimer(IN := (rDrumLevel_Filt > 82.0) OR NOT bHighHighLiquidLevelSwitch, PT := T#500MS);
IF tonHighLevelPersistenceTimer.Q THEN
    bTripLatch := TRUE;
    wAlarmWord.1 := TRUE; (* LAHH Critical Moisture Carryover Trip *)
END_IF;

(* Condition C: Interstage Air High-High Thermal Overload (TAHH > 80.0 deg C for 2.0 s) *)
tonHighTempPersistenceTimer(IN := (rInterstageTemp_Filt > 80.0), PT := T#2000MS);
IF tonHighTempPersistenceTimer.Q THEN
    bTripLatch := TRUE;
    wAlarmWord.5 := TRUE; (* TAHH Extreme Air Exit Temperature Trip *)
END_IF;

(* Condition D: Demister Pad Severe Differential Pressure Blockage (PDAHH > 180.0 mbar for 1.5 s) *)
tonDemisterDPPersistence(IN := (rDemisterDP_Filt > 180.0), PT := T#1500MS);
IF tonDemisterDPPersistence.Q THEN
    bTripLatch := TRUE;
    wAlarmWord.7 := TRUE; (* PDAHH Demister Blown / Heavy Carryover Surge Hazard *)
END_IF;

(* Trip Reset Handling *)
tonResetDebounce(IN := bManualReset, PT := T#1000MS);
IF tonResetDebounce.Q AND bEmergencyStopOk AND bHighHighLiquidLevelSwitch AND
   (rDrumLevel_Filt < 65.0) AND (rInterstageTemp_Filt < 60.0) AND (rDemisterDP_Filt < 100.0) THEN
    bTripLatch := FALSE;
    bSensor1FaultLatched := FALSE;
    bSensor2FaultLatched := FALSE;
    bSensor3FaultLatched := FALSE;
    wAlarmWord.0 := FALSE;
    wAlarmWord.1 := FALSE;
    wAlarmWord.5 := FALSE;
    wAlarmWord.7 := FALSE;
END_IF;

(* Assign Trip Interlock Output *)
IF bTripLatch THEN
    bCompressorTripInterlock := TRUE;
    udiEmergencyTripCount    := udiEmergencyTripCount + 1;
ELSE
    bCompressorTripInterlock := FALSE;
END_IF;

(* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
   LAYER 3: THERMODYNAMIC CONDENSATION RATE AND HEAT RECOVERY EXERGY CALCULATION
   --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* Calculation of ambient water vapor partial pressure via Magnus equation *)
rVaporPress_Ambient_mbar := (rAmbientHumidity_Pct / 100.0) * 6.1121 *
                            EXP((17.67 * rAmbientAirTemp_DegC) / (rAmbientAirTemp_DegC + 243.5));

(* Inlet air moisture ratio entering Stage 1 (assumed conserved up to intercooler) *)
IF (1013.25 - rVaporPress_Ambient_mbar) > 10.0 THEN
    rHumRatio_Inlet_kgkg := 0.62198 * rVaporPress_Ambient_mbar / (1013.25 - rVaporPress_Ambient_mbar);
ELSE
    rHumRatio_Inlet_kgkg := 0.0150;
END_IF;

IF (rInterstageAirTemp_DegC > 0.0) AND (rInterstageAirTemp_DegC < 120.0) THEN
    rSatPress_Outlet_mbar := 6.1121 * EXP((17.67 * rInterstageTemp_Filt) / (rInterstageTemp_Filt + 243.5));

    rHumRatio_Outlet_kgkg := 0.0050;
END_IF;

(* Condensation Mass Rate: m_dot_cond = m_dot_air * (w_in - w_out) [kg/s -> kg/h] *)
IF (rHumRatio_Inlet_kgkg > rHumRatio_Outlet_kgkg) AND (rAirFlow_Filt > 5.0) THEN
    rCalculatedCondensationRate_kgh := rAirFlow_Filt * (rHumRatio_Inlet_kgkg - rHumRatio_Outlet_kgkg) * 3600.0;
ELSE

END_IF;

(* Real-Time Thermal Heat Duty Recovered into Cooling Circuit / TES [kW]:
   Q = m_dot_air * Cp_air * (T_in - T_out) + m_dot_cond * h_fg *)

    rThermalDutyRecovered_kW := (rAirFlow_Filt * rSpecHeatAir_kJkgK * (rStage1DischargeTemp_DegC - rInterstageTemp_Filt)) +
                               ((rCalculatedCondensationRate_kgh / 3600.0) * rLatentHeatVap_kJkg);
ELSE
    rThermalDutyRecovered_kW := 0.0;
END_IF;

   epsilon = (T_hot_in - T_hot_out) / (T_hot_in - T_cold_in) *)

    rIntercoolerThermalEff_Pct := ((rStage1DischargeTemp_DegC - rInterstageTemp_Filt) /
                                   (rStage1DischargeTemp_DegC - rCoolingWaterSupplyTemp_DegC)) * 100.0;
ELSE

END_IF;

(* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
   LAYER 4: DISCRETE STATE-SPACE ESTIMATION & MODEL PREDICTIVE CONTROL (MPC) OPTIMIZATION
   --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* Step 4.1: Compute State Deviations from Target Equilibrium Operating Point *)
rState_x1_TempErr       := rInterstageTemp_Filt - rAirTempTarget_DegC;
rState_x2_LevelErr      := rDrumLevel_Filt - rDrumLevelTarget_Pct;

rDist_d3_SpeedErr     := rCompressorSpeed_RPM - rNominalSpeed_RPM;

                            rK_mpc_13 * rState_x3_PressLoss +
                            rK_mpc_14 * rState_x4_ReturnTempErr) * rSampleTime_s +

                            rK_ff_12 * rDist_d2_InletTempErr +

                          rK_mpc_23 * rState_x3_PressLoss +
                          rK_mpc_24 * rState_x4_ReturnTempErr) * rSampleTime_s +
                         (rK_ff_21 * rDist_d1_FlowErr +

                          rK_ff_23 * rDist_d3_SpeedErr) * rSampleTime_s;

        rEmergencyDrainDump_Pct     := 0.0;

        IF bTripLatch THEN

        bSystemReady                := FALSE;
