(* ===========================================================================================
   STAGE 0: DETERMINISTIC ONE-TIME HARDWARE MATRIX & GEOMETRY INITIALIZATION
   Initializes complete state-space matrices (A, B, C, D, E) and 4x4 spatial zone centroids
   =========================================================================================== *)
IF NOT bMatricesInitialized THEN
    (* Initialize Spatial Zone Centroid Coordinates (4x4 Grid over 400x400 mm bed) *)
    (* Row 1 (North): Y = 50 mm; Columns: X = 50, 150, 250, 350 mm *)
    arZoneCentroidX_mm[1] := 50.0;   arZoneCentroidY_mm[1] := 50.0;
    arZoneCentroidX_mm[2] := 150.0;  arZoneCentroidY_mm[2] := 50.0;
    arZoneCentroidX_mm[3] := 250.0;  arZoneCentroidY_mm[3] := 50.0;
    arZoneCentroidX_mm[4] := 350.0;  arZoneCentroidY_mm[4] := 50.0;
    (* Row 2 (North-Central): Y = 150 mm *)
    arZoneCentroidX_mm[5] := 50.0;   arZoneCentroidY_mm[5] := 150.0;
    arZoneCentroidX_mm[6] := 150.0;  arZoneCentroidY_mm[6] := 150.0;
    arZoneCentroidX_mm[7] := 250.0;  arZoneCentroidY_mm[7] := 150.0;
    arZoneCentroidX_mm[8] := 350.0;  arZoneCentroidY_mm[8] := 150.0;
    (* Row 3 (South-Central): Y = 250 mm *)
    arZoneCentroidX_mm[9] := 50.0;   arZoneCentroidY_mm[9] := 250.0;
    arZoneCentroidX_mm[10] := 150.0; arZoneCentroidY_mm[10] := 250.0;
    arZoneCentroidX_mm[11] := 250.0; arZoneCentroidY_mm[11] := 250.0;
    arZoneCentroidX_mm[12] := 350.0; arZoneCentroidY_mm[12] := 250.0;
    (* Row 4 (South): Y = 350 mm *)
    arZoneCentroidX_mm[13] := 50.0;  arZoneCentroidY_mm[13] := 350.0;
    arZoneCentroidX_mm[14] := 150.0; arZoneCentroidY_mm[14] := 350.0;
    arZoneCentroidX_mm[15] := 250.0; arZoneCentroidY_mm[15] := 350.0;
    arZoneCentroidX_mm[16] := 350.0; arZoneCentroidY_mm[16] := 350.0;

    (* Initialize State-Space System Matrix A [16x16] *)
    (* Diagonal entries capture self-damping: thermal mass + radiative cooling + N2 convection *)
    (* Off-diagonals represent cross-conductance between adjacent physical quadrants *)
    FOR iLoopRow := 1 TO 16 DO
        FOR iLoopCol := 1 TO 16 DO
            IF iLoopRow = iLoopCol THEN
                (* Diagonal self-decay coefficient based on loose powder capacitance *)
                mA[iLoopRow, iLoopCol] := 0.9625;
            ELSE
                (* Check if zones are spatial nearest neighbors (Manhattan distance = 100mm) *)
                rDistDiff := SQRT(EXPT(arZoneCentroidX_mm[iLoopRow] - arZoneCentroidX_mm[iLoopCol], 2) +
                                  EXPT(arZoneCentroidY_mm[iLoopRow] - arZoneCentroidY_mm[iLoopCol], 2));
                IF rDistDiff < 110.0 THEN
                    mA[iLoopRow, iLoopCol] := 0.0078; (* Nearest neighbor lateral thermal diffusion *)
                ELSIF rDistDiff < 155.0 THEN
                    mA[iLoopRow, iLoopCol] := 0.0015; (* Diagonal neighbor weak coupling *)
                ELSE
                    mA[iLoopRow, iLoopCol] := 0.0000; (* Negligible far-field conduction *)
                END_IF;
            END_IF;
        END_FOR;
    END_FOR;

    (* Initialize Radiative View Factor Matrix B [16x16] *)
    (* Relates 16 Halogen radiant lamp reflector arrays directly to the 16 surface zones *)
    (* Peak direct flux on home zone = 0.745, cross-spillover to neighbors = 0.052 to 0.011 *)
    FOR iLoopRow := 1 TO 16 DO
        FOR iLoopCol := 1 TO 16 DO
            rDistDiff := SQRT(EXPT(arZoneCentroidX_mm[iLoopRow] - arZoneCentroidX_mm[iLoopCol], 2) +
                              EXPT(arZoneCentroidY_mm[iLoopRow] - arZoneCentroidY_mm[iLoopCol], 2));
            IF iLoopRow = iLoopCol THEN
                mB[iLoopRow, iLoopCol] := 0.7450; (* Direct focus radiant view factor *)
            ELSIF rDistDiff < 110.0 THEN
                mB[iLoopRow, iLoopCol] := 0.0520; (* Adjacent lobe parabolic spillover *)
            ELSIF rDistDiff < 155.0 THEN
                mB[iLoopRow, iLoopCol] := 0.0115; (* Corner lobe optical diffusion *)
            ELSE
                mB[iLoopRow, iLoopCol] := 0.0010; (* Ambient diffuse cavity backscatter *)
            END_IF;
        END_FOR;
    END_FOR;

    (* Initialize Measurement Output Matrix C [16x16] & Direct Feedthrough Matrix D [16x16] *)
    (* Matrix C maps internal state vector x directly to predicted pyrometric observation y *)
    (* Matrix D represents instantaneous reflected halogen specular radiance on pyrometer *)
    FOR iLoopRow := 1 TO 16 DO
        FOR iLoopCol := 1 TO 16 DO
            IF iLoopRow = iLoopCol THEN
                mC[iLoopRow, iLoopCol] := 1.0000; (* Direct observation identity *)
                mD[iLoopRow, iLoopCol] := 0.0025; (* Reflected short-wave halogen feedthrough *)
                mInverseViewFactorRedist[iLoopRow, iLoopCol] := 1.0000;
            ELSE
                mC[iLoopRow, iLoopCol] := 0.0000;
                mD[iLoopRow, iLoopCol] := 0.0000;
                mInverseViewFactorRedist[iLoopRow, iLoopCol] := 0.0000;
            END_IF;
        END_FOR;
    END_FOR;

    (* Initialize Disturbance Coupling Matrix E [16x2] *)
    (* Col 1: Recoater quench sensitivity; Col 2: Laser exposure thermal injection *)
    FOR iLoopZone := 1 TO 16 DO
        mE[iLoopZone, 1] := -0.850; (* Quench enthalpy extraction per unit depth *)
        mE[iLoopZone, 2] :=  0.038; (* Laser localized optical absorptance factor *)
    END_FOR;

    (* Initialize MPC Quadratic Cost Weighting Matrices Q and R *)
    FOR iLoopZone := 1 TO 16 DO
        (* High tracking penalty for core sintering zones 6, 7, 10, 11 *)
        IF (iLoopZone = 6) OR (iLoopZone = 7) OR (iLoopZone = 10) OR (iLoopZone = 11) THEN
            arQ_Weights[iLoopZone] := 45.0; (* Critical build volume isothermicity *)
        ELSIF (iLoopZone = 1) OR (iLoopZone = 4) OR (iLoopZone = 13) OR (iLoopZone = 16) THEN
            arQ_Weights[iLoopZone] := 25.0; (* Corner perimeter curl suppression *)
        ELSE
            arQ_Weights[iLoopZone] := 32.0; (* Standard boundary ring weighting *)
        END_IF;
        arR_Weights[iLoopZone] := 0.65;     (* Actuator effort damping to protect halogen filaments *)
        arU_Current_kW[iLoopZone] := 0.0;
        arU_Optimal_kW[iLoopZone] := 0.0;
        arU_Delta_kW[iLoopZone] := 0.0;
        arRecoaterFeedforward_kW[iLoopZone] := 0.0;
        arBoundaryTrimOffset_kW[iLoopZone] := 0.0;
        arState_x[iLoopZone] := 25.0;       (* Initial ambient bed temp assumption *)
        arState_x_pred[iLoopZone] := 25.0;
        arMeas_y[iLoopZone] := 25.0;
        arSubSurfaceTemp_C[iLoopZone] := 25.0;
        arCompensatedEmissivity[iLoopZone] := 0.920;
        arSinterDegree[iLoopZone] := 0.0;
        aChannelHealth_A[iLoopZone] := TRUE;
        aChannelHealth_B[iLoopZone] := TRUE;
        aChannelHealth_C[iLoopZone] := TRUE;
        aSensorDegraded[iLoopZone] := FALSE;
        aSensorIsolated[iLoopZone] := FALSE;
        aiSensorFaultCounter_A[iLoopZone] := 0;
        aiSensorFaultCounter_B[iLoopZone] := 0;
        aiSensorFaultCounter_C[iLoopZone] := 0;
        arSensorDrift_A[iLoopZone] := 0.0;
        arSensorDrift_B[iLoopZone] := 0.0;
        arSensorDrift_C[iLoopZone] := 0.0;
        aLampFilamentFailed[iLoopZone] := FALSE;
        arActuatorHealthRatio[iLoopZone] := 1.0;
    END_FOR;

    bMatricesInitialized := TRUE;
END_IF;

(* ===========================================================================================
   STAGE 1: HARDWARE SAFETY INTERLOCKS & SIL-3 STATUS EVALUATION
   Immediate zero-power latch upon E-Stop trip, chamber breach, or severe overpressure
   =========================================================================================== *)
IF bResetFault THEN
    dwFaultMask := 16#00000000;
    dwWarningMask := 16#00000000;
    bInterlockTripped := FALSE;
END_IF;

(* Safety Interlock 1: Dual Channel Emergency Stop Circuit *)
IF NOT bEmergencyStop THEN
    dwFaultMask := dwFaultMask OR 16#00000001; (* Bit 0: Hardware E-Stop Tripped *)
    bInterlockTripped := TRUE;
END_IF;

(* Safety Interlock 2: Process Chamber Door Seal & Vacuum Integrity *)
IF NOT bChamberDoorInterlock THEN
    dwFaultMask := dwFaultMask OR 16#00000002; (* Bit 1: Chamber Door Open / Seal Lost *)
    bInterlockTripped := TRUE;
END_IF;

(* Safety Interlock 3: Chamber Atmospheric Overpressure Protection *)
IF (rChamberPressure_mbar > 1080.0) OR (rChamberPressure_mbar < 950.0) THEN
    dwFaultMask := dwFaultMask OR 16#00000004; (* Bit 2: Chamber Differential Pressure Trip *)
    bInterlockTripped := TRUE;
END_IF;

(* Safety Interlock 4: Residual Oxygen Contamination in Nitrogen Environment *)
(* Critical for PEEK @ 380 C to prevent auto-ignition and rapid polymer oxidation *)
IF rChamberO2Level_ppm > 85.0 THEN
    dwFaultMask := dwFaultMask OR 16#00000008; (* Bit 3: Oxygen Breakthrough Fault *)
    bInterlockTripped := TRUE;
ELSIF rChamberO2Level_ppm > 45.0 THEN
    dwWarningMask := dwWarningMask OR 16#00000001; (* Warning Bit 0: O2 Level Elevated *)
END_IF;

(* Safety Interlock 5: Upstream Mains Electrical Bus Capacity Violation *)
IF rTotalAvailableMainsPower_kW < 12.0 THEN
    dwFaultMask := dwFaultMask OR 16#00000010; (* Bit 4: Insufficient Grid Bus Power *)
    bInterlockTripped := TRUE;
END_IF;

(* Safety Interlock 6: Substrate Boundary Strain Exceeds Critical Failure Yield *)
rStrainPeak := 0.0;
FOR iLoopZone := 1 TO 4 DO
    IF ABS(rBedFrameStrain_microstrain[iLoopZone]) > rStrainPeak THEN
        rStrainPeak := ABS(rBedFrameStrain_microstrain[iLoopZone]);
    END_IF;
END_FOR;
IF rStrainPeak > 1400.0 THEN
    dwFaultMask := dwFaultMask OR 16#00000020; (* Bit 5: Critical Substrate Warpage Yield *)
    bInterlockTripped := TRUE;
ELSIF rStrainPeak > 650.0 THEN
    dwWarningMask := dwWarningMask OR 16#00000002; (* Warning Bit 1: High Substrate Stress *)
END_IF;

(* ===========================================================================================
   STAGE 2: 2oo3 TRIPLE MODULAR REDUNDANT (TMR) PYROMETER VOTING & FDI ENGINE
   Performs pairwise residual comparison, median voting, channel isolation, and drift tracking
   =========================================================================================== *)
FOR iLoopZone := 1 TO 16 DO
    (* Compute Pairwise Differences Between Redundant Optical Channels *)
    rDiffA_B := ABS(rPyrometerRaw_ChA_C[iLoopZone] - rPyrometerRaw_ChB_C[iLoopZone]);
    rDiffB_C := ABS(rPyrometerRaw_ChB_C[iLoopZone] - rPyrometerRaw_ChC_C[iLoopZone]);
    rDiffA_C := ABS(rPyrometerRaw_ChA_C[iLoopZone] - rPyrometerRaw_ChC_C[iLoopZone]);

    (* Channel A Health Validation & Debounce *)
    IF (rDiffA_B > rTMR_CRITICAL_DEV_C) AND (rDiffA_C > rTMR_CRITICAL_DEV_C) THEN
        aiSensorFaultCounter_A[iLoopZone] := aiSensorFaultCounter_A[iLoopZone] + 1;
        IF aiSensorFaultCounter_A[iLoopZone] >= iTmrFaultDebounceLimit THEN
            aChannelHealth_A[iLoopZone] := FALSE; (* Isolate Channel A *)
        END_IF;
    ELSE
        IF aiSensorFaultCounter_A[iLoopZone] > 0 THEN
            aiSensorFaultCounter_A[iLoopZone] := aiSensorFaultCounter_A[iLoopZone] - 1;
        END_IF;
    END_IF;

    (* Channel B Health Validation & Debounce *)
    IF (rDiffA_B > rTMR_CRITICAL_DEV_C) AND (rDiffB_C > rTMR_CRITICAL_DEV_C) THEN
        aiSensorFaultCounter_B[iLoopZone] := aiSensorFaultCounter_B[iLoopZone] + 1;
        IF aiSensorFaultCounter_B[iLoopZone] >= iTmrFaultDebounceLimit THEN
            aChannelHealth_B[iLoopZone] := FALSE; (* Isolate Channel B *)
        END_IF;
    ELSE
        IF aiSensorFaultCounter_B[iLoopZone] > 0 THEN
            aiSensorFaultCounter_B[iLoopZone] := aiSensorFaultCounter_B[iLoopZone] - 1;
        END_IF;
    END_IF;

    (* Channel C Health Validation & Debounce *)
    IF (rDiffA_C > rTMR_CRITICAL_DEV_C) AND (rDiffB_C > rTMR_CRITICAL_DEV_C) THEN
        aiSensorFaultCounter_C[iLoopZone] := aiSensorFaultCounter_C[iLoopZone] + 1;
        IF aiSensorFaultCounter_C[iLoopZone] >= iTmrFaultDebounceLimit THEN
            aChannelHealth_C[iLoopZone] := FALSE; (* Isolate Channel C *)
        END_IF;
    ELSE
        IF aiSensorFaultCounter_C[iLoopZone] > 0 THEN
            aiSensorFaultCounter_C[iLoopZone] := aiSensorFaultCounter_C[iLoopZone] - 1;
        END_IF;
    END_IF;

    (* Deterministic Voting Selection Logic *)
    IF aChannelHealth_A[iLoopZone] AND aChannelHealth_B[iLoopZone] AND aChannelHealth_C[iLoopZone] THEN
        (* Full 2oo3 Triple Modular Redundancy Nominal Mode - Median Selection *)
        aSensorDegraded[iLoopZone] := FALSE;
        aSensorIsolated[iLoopZone] := FALSE;
        (* Find median of three values *)
        IF ((rPyrometerRaw_ChA_C[iLoopZone] >= rPyrometerRaw_ChB_C[iLoopZone]) AND (rPyrometerRaw_ChA_C[iLoopZone] <= rPyrometerRaw_ChC_C[iLoopZone])) OR
           ((rPyrometerRaw_ChA_C[iLoopZone] <= rPyrometerRaw_ChB_C[iLoopZone]) AND (rPyrometerRaw_ChA_C[iLoopZone] >= rPyrometerRaw_ChC_C[iLoopZone])) THEN
            rMedianVal := rPyrometerRaw_ChA_C[iLoopZone];
        ELSIF ((rPyrometerRaw_ChB_C[iLoopZone] >= rPyrometerRaw_ChA_C[iLoopZone]) AND (rPyrometerRaw_ChB_C[iLoopZone] <= rPyrometerRaw_ChC_C[iLoopZone])) OR
              ((rPyrometerRaw_ChB_C[iLoopZone] <= rPyrometerRaw_ChA_C[iLoopZone]) AND (rPyrometerRaw_ChB_C[iLoopZone] >= rPyrometerRaw_ChC_C[iLoopZone])) THEN
            rMedianVal := rPyrometerRaw_ChB_C[iLoopZone];
        ELSE
            rMedianVal := rPyrometerRaw_ChC_C[iLoopZone];
        END_IF;
        arVotedTemp_C[iLoopZone] := rMedianVal;

        (* Update Continuous Sensor Drift Accumulators *)
        arSensorDrift_A[iLoopZone] := 0.995 * arSensorDrift_A[iLoopZone] + 0.005 * (rPyrometerRaw_ChA_C[iLoopZone] - rMedianVal);
        arSensorDrift_B[iLoopZone] := 0.995 * arSensorDrift_B[iLoopZone] + 0.005 * (rPyrometerRaw_ChB_C[iLoopZone] - rMedianVal);
        arSensorDrift_C[iLoopZone] := 0.995 * arSensorDrift_C[iLoopZone] + 0.005 * (rPyrometerRaw_ChC_C[iLoopZone] - rMedianVal);
    ELSIF aChannelHealth_A[iLoopZone] AND aChannelHealth_B[iLoopZone] THEN
        (* Degraded 1oo2 Redundancy: Average Channels A & B *)
        aSensorDegraded[iLoopZone] := TRUE;
        arVotedTemp_C[iLoopZone] := 0.5 * (rPyrometerRaw_ChA_C[iLoopZone] + rPyrometerRaw_ChB_C[iLoopZone]);
        dwWarningMask := dwWarningMask OR 16#00000004; (* Channel C Faulted *)
    ELSIF aChannelHealth_B[iLoopZone] AND aChannelHealth_C[iLoopZone] THEN
        (* Degraded 1oo2 Redundancy: Average Channels B & C *)
        aSensorDegraded[iLoopZone] := TRUE;
        arVotedTemp_C[iLoopZone] := 0.5 * (rPyrometerRaw_ChB_C[iLoopZone] + rPyrometerRaw_ChC_C[iLoopZone]);
        dwWarningMask := dwWarningMask OR 16#00000008; (* Channel A Faulted *)
    ELSIF aChannelHealth_A[iLoopZone] AND aChannelHealth_C[iLoopZone] THEN
        (* Degraded 1oo2 Redundancy: Average Channels A & C *)
        aSensorDegraded[iLoopZone] := TRUE;
        arVotedTemp_C[iLoopZone] := 0.5 * (rPyrometerRaw_ChA_C[iLoopZone] + rPyrometerRaw_ChC_C[iLoopZone]);
        dwWarningMask := dwWarningMask OR 16#00000010; (* Channel B Faulted *)
    ELSIF aChannelHealth_A[iLoopZone] THEN
        (* Degraded Simplex 1oo1 Mode: Single Channel A *)
        aSensorDegraded[iLoopZone] := TRUE;
        arVotedTemp_C[iLoopZone] := rPyrometerRaw_ChA_C[iLoopZone];
        dwWarningMask := dwWarningMask OR 16#00000020; (* Critical Simplex Mode *)
    ELSIF aChannelHealth_B[iLoopZone] THEN
        aSensorDegraded[iLoopZone] := TRUE;
        arVotedTemp_C[iLoopZone] := rPyrometerRaw_ChB_C[iLoopZone];
        dwWarningMask := dwWarningMask OR 16#00000020;
    ELSIF aChannelHealth_C[iLoopZone] THEN
        aSensorDegraded[iLoopZone] := TRUE;
        arVotedTemp_C[iLoopZone] := rPyrometerRaw_ChC_C[iLoopZone];
        dwWarningMask := dwWarningMask OR 16#00000020;
    ELSE
        (* All redundant channels failed in zone: Fallback to State-Space Observer *)
        aSensorIsolated[iLoopZone] := TRUE;
        arVotedTemp_C[iLoopZone] := arState_x_pred[iLoopZone];
        dwFaultMask := dwFaultMask OR 16#00000040; (* Bit 6: Total Zone Sensor Blindness *)
    END_IF;
END_FOR;

(* ===========================================================================================
   STAGE 3: IN-SITU THERMOGRAPHIC EMISSIVITY & PLANCK RADIANCE COMPENSATION
   Compensates for phase transition (powder to melt pool) and reflected ambient cavity radiance
   =========================================================================================== *)
FOR iLoopZone := 1 TO 16 DO
    (* Estimate localized sintering state based on cumulative thermal exposure above melting *)
    IF arVotedTemp_C[iLoopZone] > (rT_Melt_C - 10.0) THEN
        arSinterDegree[iLoopZone] := arSinterDegree[iLoopZone] + 0.0004 * (arVotedTemp_C[iLoopZone] - (rT_Melt_C - 10.0)) * rCycleTime_s;
        IF arSinterDegree[iLoopZone] > 1.0 THEN
            arSinterDegree[iLoopZone] := 1.0;
        END_IF;
    ELSIF bRecoaterActive THEN
        (* Fresh cold powder deposition resets surface sintering degree to zero loose powder *)
        arSinterDegree[iLoopZone] := 0.0;
    END_IF;

    (* Dynamic Emissivity Formulation: *)
    (* Loose porous powder: high cavity emissivity ~ 0.935 *)
    (* Consolidated liquid polymer pool: lower specular emissivity ~ 0.845 *)
    (* Temperature coefficient alpha_T: -0.00008 / K *)
    rApparentEmissivity := 0.9350 - (0.0900 * arSinterDegree[iLoopZone]) - (0.000085 * (arVotedTemp_C[iLoopZone] - 25.0));
    IF rApparentEmissivity < 0.780 THEN
        rApparentEmissivity := 0.780;
    ELSIF rApparentEmissivity > 0.965 THEN
        rApparentEmissivity := 0.965;
    END_IF;
    arCompensatedEmissivity[iLoopZone] := rApparentEmissivity;

    (* Convert Voted Apparent Temperature to Kelvin *)
    rT_Kelvin := arVotedTemp_C[iLoopZone] + rABS_ZERO_OFFSET_C;
    IF rT_Kelvin < 273.15 THEN
        rT_Kelvin := 273.15;
    END_IF;

    (* Stefan-Boltzmann Blackbody Spectral Radiance Approximation: E_bb = sigma * T^4 *)
    rRadiance_BB := rSTEFAN_BOLTZMANN * EXPT(rT_Kelvin, 4);
    arRawRadiance_Wm2sr[iLoopZone] := rRadiance_BB;

    (* Background Reflected Radiance from Heated Walls and Halogen Tube Filaments *)
    rRadiance_Refl := rSTEFAN_BOLTZMANN * EXPT(rHeatedWallTemp_C + rABS_ZERO_OFFSET_C, 4);
    arReflectedRadiance_Wm2sr[iLoopZone] := rRadiance_Refl;

    (* True Surface Radiance Inversion: L_true = (L_raw - (1 - eps)*L_refl) / eps *)
    rTempSum := (rRadiance_BB - ((1.0 - rApparentEmissivity) * rRadiance_Refl)) / rApparentEmissivity;
    IF rTempSum < 10.0 THEN
        rTempSum := 10.0;
    END_IF;

    (* Compute Thermodynamic Surface Temperature: T_s = (L_true / sigma)^0.25 - 273.15 *)
    arSurfaceTrueTemp_C[iLoopZone] := SQRT(SQRT(rTempSum / rSTEFAN_BOLTZMANN)) - rABS_ZERO_OFFSET_C;
    (* Kalman Filter Measurement Fusion with State-Space Model *)
    arState_x[iLoopZone] := 0.88 * arSurfaceTrueTemp_C[iLoopZone] + 0.12 * arState_x_pred[iLoopZone];
    rEstimatedSurfaceTemp_C[iLoopZone] := arState_x[iLoopZone];
END_FOR;

(* ===========================================================================================
   STAGE 4: 2D DISCRETE LAPLACIAN SPATIAL GRADIENTS & BOUNDARY WARPAGE METRICS
   Calculates in-plane thermal stress and generates perimeter halo compensation offsets
   =========================================================================================== *)
rMaxGradFound := 0.0;
rMaxStressFound := 0.0;
rTempSum := 0.0;

FOR iLoopRow := 1 TO 4 DO
    FOR iLoopCol := 1 TO 4 DO
        iLoopZone := (iLoopRow - 1) * 4 + iLoopCol;
        rCenterTemp := arState_x[iLoopZone];
        rTempSum := rTempSum + rCenterTemp;

        (* Boundary Value Handling for 2D Spatial Derivatives *)
        (* North neighbor *)
        IF iLoopRow > 1 THEN
            rNorthTemp := arState_x[iLoopZone - 4];
        ELSE
            rNorthTemp := rHeatedWallTemp_C; (* Heat sink wall boundary *)
        END_IF;
        (* South neighbor *)
        IF iLoopRow < 4 THEN
            rSouthTemp := arState_x[iLoopZone + 4];
        ELSE
            rSouthTemp := rHeatedWallTemp_C;
        END_IF;
        (* West neighbor *)
        IF iLoopCol > 1 THEN
            rWestTemp := arState_x[iLoopZone - 1];
        ELSE
            rWestTemp := rHeatedWallTemp_C;
        END_IF;
        (* East neighbor *)
        IF iLoopCol < 4 THEN
            rEastTemp := arState_x[iLoopZone + 1];
        ELSE
            rEastTemp := rHeatedWallTemp_C;
        END_IF;

        (* Discrete 2D Laplacian: Del^2 T = (T_N + T_S + T_E + T_W - 4*T_C) / (dx^2) *)
        arLaplacian2D_C_m2[iLoopZone] := (rNorthTemp + rSouthTemp + rEastTemp + rWestTemp - (4.0 * rCenterTemp)) / EXPT(rZONE_WIDTH_MM / 1000.0, 2);

        (* Max Directional Gradient Evaluation [deg C / mm] *)
        IF (ABS(rCenterTemp - rNorthTemp) / rZONE_WIDTH_MM) > rMaxGradFound THEN
            rMaxGradFound := ABS(rCenterTemp - rNorthTemp) / rZONE_WIDTH_MM;
        END_IF;
        IF (ABS(rCenterTemp - rEastTemp) / rZONE_WIDTH_MM) > rMaxGradFound THEN
            rMaxGradFound := ABS(rCenterTemp - rEastTemp) / rZONE_WIDTH_MM;
        END_IF;
    END_FOR;
END_FOR;

rAverageBedTemp_C := rTempSum / 16.0;
rMaxThermalGradient_C_mm := rMaxGradFound;

(* Evaluate In-Plane Thermoelastic Contraction Stress: sigma = (E * alpha / (1 - nu)) * (T_avg - T_local) *)
FOR iLoopZone := 1 TO 16 DO
    arThermalStress_MPa[iLoopZone] := (rPolymerElasticModulus_MPa * (rPolymerCTE_ppmK * 1.0E-06) / (1.0 - rPoissonRatio)) *
                                     ABS(rAverageBedTemp_C - arState_x[iLoopZone]);
    IF arThermalStress_MPa[iLoopZone] > rMaxStressFound THEN
        rMaxStressFound := arThermalStress_MPa[iLoopZone];
    END_IF;
END_FOR;

(* Compute Dimensionless Warpage Risk Index [0.0 to 1.0] *)
(* Combines maximum thermal stress with piezoresistive substrate physical strain sensors *)
rEstimatedWarpageRiskIndex := (0.55 * (rMaxStressFound / 18.5)) + (0.45 * (rStrainPeak / 1200.0));
IF rEstimatedWarpageRiskIndex > 1.0 THEN
    rEstimatedWarpageRiskIndex := 1.0;
ELSIF rEstimatedWarpageRiskIndex < 0.0 THEN
    rEstimatedWarpageRiskIndex := 0.0;
END_IF;

(* Evaluate Boundary-to-Core Gradient Divergence *)
rCoreAverageTemp := 0.25 * (arState_x[6] + arState_x[7] + arState_x[10] + arState_x[11]);
rPerimeterAverageTemp := 0.0833 * (arState_x[1] + arState_x[2] + arState_x[3] + arState_x[4] +
                                  arState_x[5] + arState_x[8] + arState_x[9] + arState_x[12] +
                                  arState_x[13] + arState_x[14] + arState_x[15] + arState_x[16]);
rBoundaryGradientDelta := rCoreAverageTemp - rPerimeterAverageTemp;

(* Dynamic Perimeter Halo Heating Compensation *)
(* Counteracts radiant loss to colder chamber walls and prevents part edge crystallization curl *)
FOR iLoopZone := 1 TO 16 DO
    IF (iLoopZone = 1) OR (iLoopZone = 4) OR (iLoopZone = 13) OR (iLoopZone = 16) THEN
        (* Corner zones experience highest solid-angle cold wall view factor *)
        arBoundaryTrimOffset_kW[iLoopZone] := 0.024 * rBoundaryGradientDelta + (0.085 * rEstimatedWarpageRiskIndex);
    ELSIF (iLoopZone = 2) OR (iLoopZone = 3) OR (iLoopZone = 5) OR (iLoopZone = 8) OR
          (iLoopZone = 9) OR (iLoopZone = 12) OR (iLoopZone = 14) OR (iLoopZone = 15) THEN
        (* Perimeter edge zones *)
        arBoundaryTrimOffset_kW[iLoopZone] := 0.015 * rBoundaryGradientDelta + (0.045 * rEstimatedWarpageRiskIndex);
    ELSE
        (* Core zones - zero offset *)
        arBoundaryTrimOffset_kW[iLoopZone] := 0.0;
    END_IF;
END_FOR;

(* ===========================================================================================
   STAGE 5: RECOATER BLADE KINEMATIC THERMAL SHOCK DISTURBANCE FEEDFORWARD
   Preempts localized enthalpy extraction as cold powder layer is spread across 380 C bed
   =========================================================================================== *)
IF bRecoaterActive AND (rRecoaterVelocity_mms > 5.0) THEN
    (* Calculate Normalized Blade Position Across Bed Length [0.0 to 1.0] *)
    rBladePassProgressNormalized := rRecoaterPosition_mm / rBED_TOTAL_WIDTH_MM;
    IF rBladePassProgressNormalized < 0.0 THEN
        rBladePassProgressNormalized := 0.0;
    ELSIF rBladePassProgressNormalized > 1.0 THEN
        rBladePassProgressNormalized := 1.0;
    END_IF;

    (* Compute Layer Enthalpy Deficit per Zone: Delta H = rho * Cp * Area * Thickness * (T_bed - T_hopper) *)
    rBladeThermalQuenchEnthalpy_J := (rPowderBulkDensity_kgm3 * rPowderSpecificHeat_JkgK *
                                     rZONE_AREA_M2 * (rPowderLayerThickness_um * 1.0E-06) *
                                     (rSetpointTempBed_C - rAmbientHopperTemp_C));

    (* Compute Dynamic Spatial Feedforward Radiative Pulse *)
    (* Applies a moving Gaussian heat injection wave centered on the advancing blade *)
    FOR iLoopZone := 1 TO 16 DO
        rDistDiff := ABS(arZoneCentroidX_mm[iLoopZone] - rRecoaterPosition_mm);
        (* Gaussian spatial distribution kernel with sigma = 45.0 mm *)
        rWeightGauss := EXP(-EXPT(rDistDiff / 45.0, 2));

        (* Feedforward power injection proportional to blade velocity and quench enthalpy *)
        arRecoaterFeedforward_kW[iLoopZone] := (rBladeThermalQuenchEnthalpy_J / 1250.0) *
                                              (rRecoaterVelocity_mms / 150.0) * rWeightGauss;
        IF arRecoaterFeedforward_kW[iLoopZone] > 0.850 THEN
            arRecoaterFeedforward_kW[iLoopZone] := 0.850; (* Actuator saturation cap *)
        END_IF;
    END_FOR;
ELSE
    (* Recoater stationary: smooth decay of feedforward registers to zero *)
    FOR iLoopZone := 1 TO 16 DO
        arRecoaterFeedforward_kW[iLoopZone] := 0.85 * arRecoaterFeedforward_kW[iLoopZone];
    END_FOR;
END_IF;

(* ===========================================================================================
   STAGE 6: LASER EXPOSURE LOCALIZED THERMAL COMPENSATION
   Calculates back-radiation thermal offset under the active galvanometer laser scanning spot
   =========================================================================================== *)
IF bLaserScanningActive AND (rLaserPower_W > 10.0) THEN
    FOR iLoopZone := 1 TO 16 DO
        rDistToLaser_mm := SQRT(EXPT(arZoneCentroidX_mm[iLoopZone] - rLaserSpotPositionX_mm, 2) +
                                EXPT(arZoneCentroidY_mm[iLoopZone] - rLaserSpotPositionY_mm, 2));
        IF rDistToLaser_mm < 60.0 THEN
            rLaserKernel := 1.0 - (rDistToLaser_mm / 60.0);
            (* Back off halogen lamp power locally to prevent polymer thermal degradation *)
            arBoundaryTrimOffset_kW[iLoopZone] := arBoundaryTrimOffset_kW[iLoopZone] - ((rLaserPower_W / 1000.0) * 0.42 * rLaserKernel);
        END_IF;
    END_FOR;
END_IF;

(* ===========================================================================================
   STAGE 7: DISCRETE STATE-SPACE PREDICTOR & MEASUREMENT EQUATION (A, B, C, D, E)
   x(k+1) = A * x(k) + B * u(k) + E * d(k)
   y(k)   = C * x(k) + D * u(k)
   =========================================================================================== *)
FOR iLoopRow := 1 TO 16 DO
    rTempSum := 0.0;
    (* Inter-zone conduction and self-cooling: A * x *)
    FOR iLoopCol := 1 TO 16 DO
        rTempSum := rTempSum + (mA[iLoopRow, iLoopCol] * arState_x[iLoopCol]);
    END_FOR;

    (* Radiant flux input coupling: B * u *)
    rPowerSum := 0.0;
    FOR iLoopCol := 1 TO 16 DO
        rPowerSum := rPowerSum + (mB[iLoopRow, iLoopCol] * arU_Current_kW[iLoopCol] * 12.85);
    END_FOR;

    (* Disturbance coupling: E * d *)
    rLaserDisturbancePower := 0.0;
    IF bLaserScanningActive THEN
        rLaserDisturbancePower := rLaserPower_W;
    END_IF;
    rTempSum := rTempSum + rPowerSum + (mE[iLoopRow, 1] * arRecoaterFeedforward_kW[iLoopRow] * 2.5) +
                (mE[iLoopRow, 2] * rLaserDisturbancePower * 0.01);

    arState_x_pred[iLoopRow] := rTempSum;

    (* Compute Sensor Output Measurement Model: y = C * x + D * u *)
    arMeas_y[iLoopRow] := 0.0;
    FOR iLoopCol := 1 TO 16 DO
        arMeas_y[iLoopRow] := arMeas_y[iLoopRow] + (mC[iLoopRow, iLoopCol] * arState_x[iLoopCol]) +
                               (mD[iLoopRow, iLoopCol] * arU_Current_kW[iLoopCol]);
    END_FOR;

    (* Update sub-surface powder node via vertical 1D Fourier conduction *)
    arSubSurfaceTemp_C[iLoopRow] := 0.985 * arSubSurfaceTemp_C[iLoopRow] + 0.015 * arState_x[iLoopRow];
END_FOR;

(* ===========================================================================================
   STAGE 8: CONSTRAINED MPC SOLVER - PROJECTED GRADIENT DESCENT (PGD)
   Minimizes tracking error, slew rates, spatial curvature, and respects total mains power budget
   =========================================================================================== *)
IF (iState = 50) OR (iState = 60) OR (iState = 70) OR (iState = 80) THEN
    (* Initialize optimization iterate with current active power *)
    FOR iLoopZone := 1 TO 16 DO
        arU_Optimal_kW[iLoopZone] := arU_Current_kW[iLoopZone];
    END_FOR;

    (* PGD Iteration Loop *)
    FOR iLoopIter := 1 TO iMPC_MaxIterations DO
        (* Compute Cost Function Gradient: grad_u J = B^T * Q * (x_pred - x_ref) + R * u + R_lap * Lap *)
        FOR iLoopCol := 1 TO 16 DO
            rGradTerm := 0.0;
            FOR iLoopRow := 1 TO 16 DO
                rTempError := arState_x_pred[iLoopRow] - rSetpointTempBed_C;
                rGradTerm := rGradTerm + (mB[iLoopRow, iLoopCol] * arQ_Weights[iLoopRow] * rTempError * 0.085);
            END_FOR;
            (* Regularization on control effort magnitude and warpage Laplacian *)
            rGradTerm := rGradTerm + (arR_Weights[iLoopCol] * arU_Optimal_kW[iLoopCol]) -
                         (rWarpageLaplacianPenalty * arLaplacian2D_C_m2[iLoopCol] * 0.002);
            arGradJ[iLoopCol] := rGradTerm;
        END_FOR;

        (* Gradient Step & Projection onto Box Constraints [rLAMP_MIN_PREHEAT_KW, rLAMP_MAX_POWER_KW] *)
        FOR iLoopZone := 1 TO 16 DO
            rStepCandidate := arU_Optimal_kW[iLoopZone] - (rMPC_StepSize_Alpha * arGradJ[iLoopZone]);
            (* Clamp to physical actuator box limits *)
            IF rStepCandidate > rLAMP_MAX_POWER_KW THEN
                rStepCandidate := rLAMP_MAX_POWER_KW;
            ELSIF rStepCandidate < rLAMP_MIN_PREHEAT_KW THEN
                rStepCandidate := rLAMP_MIN_PREHEAT_KW;
            END_IF;
            arU_Optimal_kW[iLoopZone] := rStepCandidate;
        END_FOR;
    END_FOR;

    (* Apply Slew Rate Limiting & Disturbance Injections *)
    rTotalPowerRequested_kW := 0.0;
    FOR iLoopZone := 1 TO 16 DO
        (* Add Feedforward Recoater Shock Rejection and Boundary Warpage Halo Offset *)
        rStepCandidate := arU_Optimal_kW[iLoopZone] + arRecoaterFeedforward_kW[iLoopZone] + arBoundaryTrimOffset_kW[iLoopZone];

        (* Slew Rate Limiting *)
        rSlewDelta := rStepCandidate - arU_Current_kW[iLoopZone];
        IF rSlewDelta > (rLAMP_MAX_SLEW_RATE_KW_PER_S * rCycleTime_s) THEN
            rSlewDelta := rLAMP_MAX_SLEW_RATE_KW_PER_S * rCycleTime_s;
        ELSIF rSlewDelta < (-rLAMP_MAX_SLEW_RATE_KW_PER_S * rCycleTime_s) THEN
            rSlewDelta := -rLAMP_MAX_SLEW_RATE_KW_PER_S * rCycleTime_s;
        END_IF;
        arU_Current_kW[iLoopZone] := arU_Current_kW[iLoopZone] + rSlewDelta;

        (* Re-check Box Constraints *)
        IF arU_Current_kW[iLoopZone] > rLAMP_MAX_POWER_KW THEN
            arU_Current_kW[iLoopZone] := rLAMP_MAX_POWER_KW;
        ELSIF arU_Current_kW[iLoopZone] < rLAMP_MIN_PREHEAT_KW THEN
            arU_Current_kW[iLoopZone] := rLAMP_MIN_PREHEAT_KW;
        END_IF;
        rTotalPowerRequested_kW := rTotalPowerRequested_kW + arU_Current_kW[iLoopZone];
    END_FOR;

    (* Global Electrical Mains Power Budget Enforcement (Hyperplane Projection) *)
    IF rTotalPowerRequested_kW > rTotalAvailableMainsPower_kW THEN
        rPowerScalingFactor := rTotalAvailableMainsPower_kW / rTotalPowerRequested_kW;
        FOR iLoopZone := 1 TO 16 DO
            arU_Current_kW[iLoopZone] := arU_Current_kW[iLoopZone] * rPowerScalingFactor;
        END_FOR;
        dwWarningMask := dwWarningMask OR 16#00000040; (* Warning Bit 6: Mains Power Clipped *)
    END_IF;
END_IF;

(* ===========================================================================================
   STAGE 9: ACTUATOR DEGRADATION & INVERSE VIEW FACTOR RE-BALANCING
   Detects burnt halogen filaments and dynamically redirects flux demand to adjacent tubes
   =========================================================================================== *)
FOR iLoopZone := 1 TO 16 DO
    (* Check for filament continuity / open-circuit fault *)
    IF aLampFilamentFailed[iLoopZone] THEN
        arActuatorHealthRatio[iLoopZone] := 0.0;
        arU_Current_kW[iLoopZone] := 0.0; (* Zero commanded power to faulted tube *)
        dwWarningMask := dwWarningMask OR 16#00000080; (* Blown Filament Detected *)

        (* Dynamically distribute lost radiative flux to 4 immediate neighbors *)
        rCurrentPowerAlloc_kW := arU_Optimal_kW[iLoopZone] * 0.235;
        IF (iLoopZone - 4) >= 1 THEN
            arU_Current_kW[iLoopZone - 4] := arU_Current_kW[iLoopZone - 4] + rCurrentPowerAlloc_kW;
        END_IF;
        IF (iLoopZone + 4) <= 16 THEN
            arU_Current_kW[iLoopZone + 4] := arU_Current_kW[iLoopZone + 4] + rCurrentPowerAlloc_kW;
        END_IF;
        IF ((iLoopZone - 1) >= 1) AND ((iLoopZone MOD 4) <> 1) THEN
            arU_Current_kW[iLoopZone - 1] := arU_Current_kW[iLoopZone - 1] + rCurrentPowerAlloc_kW;
        END_IF;
        IF ((iLoopZone + 1) <= 16) AND ((iLoopZone MOD 4) <> 0) THEN
            arU_Current_kW[iLoopZone + 1] := arU_Current_kW[iLoopZone + 1] + rCurrentPowerAlloc_kW;
        END_IF;
    END_IF;
END_FOR;

(* ===========================================================================================
   STAGE 10: MULTI-STAGE PROCESS LIFECYCLE FINITE STATE MACHINE (CASE iState OF)
   Orchestrates preheat soft-start, thermal soaking, active sintering, and controlled annealing
   =========================================================================================== *)
rStateTimer_s := rStateTimer_s + rCycleTime_s;

CASE iState OF
    0: (* STATE_STANDBY_SAFE_OFF: Complete system quiescent standby *)
        bReadyForDosing := FALSE;
        bReadyForLaserExposure := FALSE;
        FOR iLoopZone := 1 TO 16 DO
            arU_Current_kW[iLoopZone] := 0.0;
        END_FOR;
        IF bMasterEnable AND NOT bInterlockTripped THEN
            iState := 10; (* Transition to self-test diagnostics *)
            rStateTimer_s := 0.0;
        END_IF;

    10: (* STATE_SYSTEM_DIAGNOSTICS_SELFTEST: Verify sensors, bus power, radiometer bias *)
        bReadyForDosing := FALSE;
        bReadyForLaserExposure := FALSE;
        IF bInterlockTripped THEN
            iState := 99;
            rStateTimer_s := 0.0;
        ELSIF rStateTimer_s > 3.0 THEN
            (* Verify initial pyrometer plausible ambient readings [10 C to 45 C] *)
            IF (arVotedTemp_C[1] > 5.0) AND (arVotedTemp_C[1] < 55.0) THEN
                iState := 20; (* Advance to inerting check *)
                rStateTimer_s := 0.0;
            ELSE
                dwFaultMask := dwFaultMask OR 16#00000080; (* Sensor Ambient Range Fault *)
                iState := 99;
                rStateTimer_s := 0.0;
            END_IF;
        END_IF;

    20: (* STATE_INERT_ATMOSPHERE_VALIDATION: Nitrogen purge interlock prior to heating *)
        bReadyForDosing := FALSE;
        bReadyForLaserExposure := FALSE;
        IF bInterlockTripped THEN
            iState := 99;
            rStateTimer_s := 0.0;
        ELSIF (rChamberO2Level_ppm < 40.0) AND (rChamberPressure_mbar >= 1005.0) THEN
            iState := 30; (* Advance to filament preheat soft-start *)
            rStateTimer_s := 0.0;
        ELSIF rStateTimer_s > 180.0 THEN
            dwFaultMask := dwFaultMask OR 16#00000100; (* Purge Timeout Fault *)
            iState := 99;
            rStateTimer_s := 0.0;
        END_IF;

    30: (* STATE_FILAMENT_SOFTSTART_PREHEAT: Low-voltage simmer to prevent inrush tungsten fatigue *)
        bReadyForDosing := FALSE;
        bReadyForLaserExposure := FALSE;
        FOR iLoopZone := 1 TO 16 DO
            arU_Current_kW[iLoopZone] := rLAMP_MIN_PREHEAT_KW;
        END_FOR;
        IF bInterlockTripped THEN
            iState := 99;
            rStateTimer_s := 0.0;
        ELSIF rStateTimer_s > 5.0 THEN

    bTrip_CWIP_SurgeWaterHammer     : BOOL := FALSE;    (* 1,000m Pipe Abyssal Dynamic Surge Exceeded Limit (250 kPa) *)
    bTrip_HighVibrationTrip         : BOOL := FALSE;    (* Turbine Shaft Radial Orbit Vibration Exceeded 45 um *)
    bTrip_BearingOverheat           : BOOL := FALSE;    (* Thrust Bearing Metal Temperature Exceeded 85 deg C *)
    bTrip_SafetyRelayLoopOpen       : BOOL := FALSE;    (* Hardwired SIL-3 Safety Circuit Loop Discontinuity *)

    bWarn_AmmoniaGasLowPPM          : BOOL := FALSE;    (* Ammonia Trace Leak Warning (> 25 ppm) *)
    bWarn_DemisterHighDP            : BOOL := FALSE;    (* Evaporator Demister Pad Droplet Entrainment Risk (> 3.5 kPa) *)
    bWarn_CWIP_CavitationLowNPSH    : BOOL := FALSE;    (* Intake Manifold Pressure Nearing Cavitation Threshold *)
    bWarn_SensorDegraded_1oo2       : BOOL := FALSE;    (* Any 2oo3 Sensor Group Operating on Degraded 1oo2 Redundancy *)
    bWarn_PumpFlowImbalance         : BOOL := FALSE;    (* Cold Water Intake Pumps Flow Sharing Deviation (> 8%) *)
    bWarn_EvaporatorLevelHigh       : BOOL := FALSE;    (* Sump Liquid Level High (> 75%) *)
    bWarn_EvaporatorLevelLow        : BOOL := FALSE;    (* Sump Liquid Level Low (< 25%) *)
    bWarn_CondenserSubcoolingLow    : BOOL := FALSE;    (* Condenser Hotwell Subcooling Delta T Inadequate (< 1.5 deg C) *)

    bLatched_Emergency_Trip         : BOOL := FALSE;    (* Latched Global Trip Memory Flag *)
    iFirstOutFaultCode              : INT := 0;         (* First-Out Root Cause Diagnostic Code *)
    tTripDebounceTimer              : TON;
END_VAR

(* ==================================================================================== *)
(* LOGIC SECTION 1: FIRST-ORDER LOW-PASS FILTERING & ANALOG SIGNAL CONDITIONING         *)
(* Discretized exponential smoothing filter: y[k] = alpha * u[k] + (1 - alpha) * y[k-1]  *)
(* Cutoff tuned for offshore platform wave-motion noise rejection (Period ~ 6 to 12 s)   *)
(* ==================================================================================== *)
rFilt_WarmSeawater_Temp_ChA := 0.12 * rWarmSeawater_Temp_ChA + 0.88 * rFilt_WarmSeawater_Temp_ChA;
rFilt_WarmSeawater_Temp_ChB := 0.12 * rWarmSeawater_Temp_ChB + 0.88 * rFilt_WarmSeawater_Temp_ChB;
rFilt_WarmSeawater_Temp_ChC := 0.12 * rWarmSeawater_Temp_ChC + 0.88 * rFilt_WarmSeawater_Temp_ChC;
rFilt_WarmSeawater_Flow     := 0.15 * rWarmSeawater_Flow     + 0.85 * rFilt_WarmSeawater_Flow;

rFilt_ColdSeawater_Temp_ChA := 0.12 * rColdSeawater_Temp_ChA + 0.88 * rFilt_ColdSeawater_Temp_ChA;
rFilt_ColdSeawater_Temp_ChB := 0.12 * rColdSeawater_Temp_ChB + 0.88 * rFilt_ColdSeawater_Temp_ChB;
rFilt_ColdSeawater_Temp_ChC := 0.12 * rColdSeawater_Temp_ChC + 0.88 * rFilt_ColdSeawater_Temp_ChC;
rFilt_ColdSeawater_Flow_Pump1 := 0.15 * rColdSeawater_Flow_Pump1 + 0.85 * rFilt_ColdSeawater_Flow_Pump1;
rFilt_ColdSeawater_Flow_Pump2 := 0.15 * rColdSeawater_Flow_Pump2 + 0.85 * rFilt_ColdSeawater_Flow_Pump2;
rFilt_ColdSeawater_Flow_Pump3 := 0.15 * rColdSeawater_Flow_Pump3 + 0.85 * rFilt_ColdSeawater_Flow_Pump3;

rFilt_Evaporator_Press_ChA  := 0.20 * rEvaporator_Press_ChA  + 0.80 * rFilt_Evaporator_Press_ChA;
rFilt_Evaporator_Press_ChB  := 0.20 * rEvaporator_Press_ChB  + 0.80 * rFilt_Evaporator_Press_ChB;
rFilt_Evaporator_Press_ChC  := 0.20 * rEvaporator_Press_ChC  + 0.80 * rFilt_Evaporator_Press_ChC;

rFilt_Condenser_Press_ChA   := 0.20 * rCondenser_Press_ChA   + 0.80 * rFilt_Condenser_Press_ChA;
rFilt_Condenser_Press_ChB   := 0.20 * rCondenser_Press_ChB   + 0.80 * rFilt_Condenser_Press_ChB;
rFilt_Condenser_Press_ChC   := 0.20 * rCondenser_Press_ChC   + 0.80 * rFilt_Condenser_Press_ChC;

rFilt_Turbine_Shaft_Speed_ChA := 0.25 * rTurbine_Shaft_Speed_ChA + 0.75 * rFilt_Turbine_Shaft_Speed_ChA;
rFilt_Turbine_Shaft_Speed_ChB := 0.25 * rTurbine_Shaft_Speed_ChB + 0.75 * rFilt_Turbine_Shaft_Speed_ChB;
rFilt_Turbine_Shaft_Speed_ChC := 0.25 * rTurbine_Shaft_Speed_ChC + 0.75 * rFilt_Turbine_Shaft_Speed_ChC;

rFilt_CWIP_Bottom_Surge_Press := 0.30 * rCWIP_Bottom_Surge_Press + 0.70 * rFilt_CWIP_Bottom_Surge_Press;
rFilt_CWIP_Top_Manifold_Press := 0.20 * rCWIP_Top_Manifold_Press + 0.80 * rFilt_CWIP_Top_Manifold_Press;
rFilt_Demister_Diff_Pressure  := 0.15 * rDemister_Diff_Pressure  + 0.85 * rFilt_Demister_Diff_Pressure;
rFilt_VIGV_Position_Feedback  := 0.30 * rVIGV_Position_Feedback  + 0.70 * rFilt_VIGV_Position_Feedback;
rFilt_Generator_Active_Power  := 0.20 * rGenerator_Active_Power  + 0.80 * rFilt_Generator_Active_Power;
rFilt_Ammonia_Sniffer_PPM     := 0.25 * rAmmonia_Sniffer_PPM     + 0.75 * rFilt_Ammonia_Sniffer_PPM;


(* ==================================================================================== *)
(* LOGIC SECTION 2: TRIPLE MODULAR REDUNDANCY (2oo3) SAFETY INSTRUMENTED SENSOR VOTING   *)
(* Incorporates Discrepancy Diagnostics, Frozen Sensor Detection, and 1oo2 Degradation   *)
(* ==================================================================================== *)

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* SUB-VOTER 2.1: Surface Warm Seawater Temperature [deg C] (Threshold: 0.75 deg C)     *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
IF ABS(rWarmSeawater_Temp_ChA - rWarmSW_T_LastRawA) < 0.0001 THEN
    iWarmSW_T_StuckCountA := iWarmSW_T_StuckCountA + 1;
ELSE
    iWarmSW_T_StuckCountA := 0;
END_IF;
rWarmSW_T_LastRawA := rWarmSeawater_Temp_ChA;

IF ABS(rWarmSeawater_Temp_ChB - rWarmSW_T_LastRawB) < 0.0001 THEN
    iWarmSW_T_StuckCountB := iWarmSW_T_StuckCountB + 1;
ELSE
    iWarmSW_T_StuckCountB := 0;
END_IF;
rWarmSW_T_LastRawB := rWarmSeawater_Temp_ChB;

IF ABS(rWarmSeawater_Temp_ChC - rWarmSW_T_LastRawC) < 0.0001 THEN
    iWarmSW_T_StuckCountC := iWarmSW_T_StuckCountC + 1;
ELSE
    iWarmSW_T_StuckCountC := 0;
END_IF;
rWarmSW_T_LastRawC := rWarmSeawater_Temp_ChC;

bWarmSW_T_ChA_Fault := (iWarmSW_T_StuckCountA > 120) OR (rFilt_WarmSeawater_Temp_ChA < 15.0) OR (rFilt_WarmSeawater_Temp_ChA > 35.0);
bWarmSW_T_ChB_Fault := (iWarmSW_T_StuckCountB > 120) OR (rFilt_WarmSeawater_Temp_ChB < 15.0) OR (rFilt_WarmSeawater_Temp_ChB > 35.0);
bWarmSW_T_ChC_Fault := (iWarmSW_T_StuckCountC > 120) OR (rFilt_WarmSeawater_Temp_ChC < 15.0) OR (rFilt_WarmSeawater_Temp_ChC > 35.0);

IF (NOT bWarmSW_T_ChA_Fault) AND (NOT bWarmSW_T_ChB_Fault) AND (NOT bWarmSW_T_ChC_Fault) THEN
    iWarmSW_T_VotingMode := 3; (* Healthy 2oo3 Median *)
    IF ABS(rFilt_WarmSeawater_Temp_ChA - rFilt_WarmSeawater_Temp_ChB) > 0.75 THEN
        IF ABS(rFilt_WarmSeawater_Temp_ChA - rFilt_WarmSeawater_Temp_ChC) > 0.75 THEN
            bWarmSW_T_ChA_Fault := TRUE;
            iWarmSW_T_VotingMode := 2;
        ELSIF ABS(rFilt_WarmSeawater_Temp_ChB - rFilt_WarmSeawater_Temp_ChC) > 0.75 THEN
            bWarmSW_T_ChB_Fault := TRUE;
            iWarmSW_T_VotingMode := 2;
        END_IF;
    ELSIF ABS(rFilt_WarmSeawater_Temp_ChB - rFilt_WarmSeawater_Temp_ChC) > 0.75 THEN
        bWarmSW_T_ChC_Fault := TRUE;
        iWarmSW_T_VotingMode := 2;
    END_IF;
END_IF;

IF iWarmSW_T_VotingMode = 3 THEN
    (* Standard 3-Input Median Selector *)
    IF ((rFilt_WarmSeawater_Temp_ChA >= rFilt_WarmSeawater_Temp_ChB) AND (rFilt_WarmSeawater_Temp_ChA <= rFilt_WarmSeawater_Temp_ChC)) OR
       ((rFilt_WarmSeawater_Temp_ChA <= rFilt_WarmSeawater_Temp_ChB) AND (rFilt_WarmSeawater_Temp_ChA >= rFilt_WarmSeawater_Temp_ChC)) THEN
        rVoted_WarmSeawater_Temp := rFilt_WarmSeawater_Temp_ChA;
    ELSIF ((rFilt_WarmSeawater_Temp_ChB >= rFilt_WarmSeawater_Temp_ChA) AND (rFilt_WarmSeawater_Temp_ChB <= rFilt_WarmSeawater_Temp_ChC)) OR
          ((rFilt_WarmSeawater_Temp_ChB <= rFilt_WarmSeawater_Temp_ChA) AND (rFilt_WarmSeawater_Temp_ChB >= rFilt_WarmSeawater_Temp_ChC)) THEN
        rVoted_WarmSeawater_Temp := rFilt_WarmSeawater_Temp_ChB;
    ELSE
        rVoted_WarmSeawater_Temp := rFilt_WarmSeawater_Temp_ChC;
    END_IF;
ELSIF iWarmSW_T_VotingMode = 2 THEN
    (* 1oo2 Degraded Mode *)
    IF bWarmSW_T_ChA_Fault THEN
        rVoted_WarmSeawater_Temp := (rFilt_WarmSeawater_Temp_ChB + rFilt_WarmSeawater_Temp_ChC) * 0.5;
    ELSIF bWarmSW_T_ChB_Fault THEN
        rVoted_WarmSeawater_Temp := (rFilt_WarmSeawater_Temp_ChA + rFilt_WarmSeawater_Temp_ChC) * 0.5;
    ELSE
        rVoted_WarmSeawater_Temp := (rFilt_WarmSeawater_Temp_ChA + rFilt_WarmSeawater_Temp_ChB) * 0.5;
    END_IF;
    bWarn_SensorDegraded_1oo2 := TRUE;
ELSE
    (* Fallback Default Hold *)
    rVoted_WarmSeawater_Temp := 26.0;
END_IF;

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* SUB-VOTER 2.2: Abyssal Cold Seawater Temperature [deg C] (Threshold: 0.60 deg C)      *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
IF ABS(rColdSeawater_Temp_ChA - rColdSW_T_LastRawA) < 0.0001 THEN
    iColdSW_T_StuckCountA := iColdSW_T_StuckCountA + 1;
ELSE
    iColdSW_T_StuckCountA := 0;
END_IF;
rColdSW_T_LastRawA := rColdSeawater_Temp_ChA;

IF ABS(rColdSeawater_Temp_ChB - rColdSW_T_LastRawB) < 0.0001 THEN
    iColdSW_T_StuckCountB := iColdSW_T_StuckCountB + 1;
ELSE
    iColdSW_T_StuckCountB := 0;
END_IF;
rColdSW_T_LastRawB := rColdSeawater_Temp_ChB;

IF ABS(rColdSeawater_Temp_ChC - rColdSW_T_LastRawC) < 0.0001 THEN
    iColdSW_T_StuckCountC := iColdSW_T_StuckCountC + 1;
ELSE
    iColdSW_T_StuckCountC := 0;
END_IF;
rColdSW_T_LastRawC := rColdSeawater_Temp_ChC;

bColdSW_T_ChA_Fault := (iColdSW_T_StuckCountA > 120) OR (rFilt_ColdSeawater_Temp_ChA < 1.0) OR (rFilt_ColdSeawater_Temp_ChA > 12.0);
bColdSW_T_ChB_Fault := (iColdSW_T_StuckCountB > 120) OR (rFilt_ColdSeawater_Temp_ChB < 1.0) OR (rFilt_ColdSeawater_Temp_ChB > 12.0);
bColdSW_T_ChC_Fault := (iColdSW_T_StuckCountC > 120) OR (rFilt_ColdSeawater_Temp_ChC < 1.0) OR (rFilt_ColdSeawater_Temp_ChC > 12.0);

IF (NOT bColdSW_T_ChA_Fault) AND (NOT bColdSW_T_ChB_Fault) AND (NOT bColdSW_T_ChC_Fault) THEN
    iColdSW_T_VotingMode := 3;
    IF ABS(rFilt_ColdSeawater_Temp_ChA - rFilt_ColdSeawater_Temp_ChB) > 0.60 THEN
        IF ABS(rFilt_ColdSeawater_Temp_ChA - rFilt_ColdSeawater_Temp_ChC) > 0.60 THEN
            bColdSW_T_ChA_Fault := TRUE;
            iColdSW_T_VotingMode := 2;
        ELSIF ABS(rFilt_ColdSeawater_Temp_ChB - rFilt_ColdSeawater_Temp_ChC) > 0.60 THEN
            bColdSW_T_ChB_Fault := TRUE;
            iColdSW_T_VotingMode := 2;
        END_IF;
    ELSIF ABS(rFilt_ColdSeawater_Temp_ChB - rFilt_ColdSeawater_Temp_ChC) > 0.60 THEN
        bColdSW_T_ChC_Fault := TRUE;
        iColdSW_T_VotingMode := 2;
    END_IF;
END_IF;

IF iColdSW_T_VotingMode = 3 THEN
    IF ((rFilt_ColdSeawater_Temp_ChA >= rFilt_ColdSeawater_Temp_ChB) AND (rFilt_ColdSeawater_Temp_ChA <= rFilt_ColdSeawater_Temp_ChC)) OR
       ((rFilt_ColdSeawater_Temp_ChA <= rFilt_ColdSeawater_Temp_ChB) AND (rFilt_ColdSeawater_Temp_ChA >= rFilt_ColdSeawater_Temp_ChC)) THEN
        rVoted_ColdSeawater_Temp := rFilt_ColdSeawater_Temp_ChA;
    ELSIF ((rFilt_ColdSeawater_Temp_ChB >= rFilt_ColdSeawater_Temp_ChA) AND (rFilt_ColdSeawater_Temp_ChB <= rFilt_ColdSeawater_Temp_ChC)) OR
          ((rFilt_ColdSeawater_Temp_ChB <= rFilt_ColdSeawater_Temp_ChA) AND (rFilt_ColdSeawater_Temp_ChB >= rFilt_ColdSeawater_Temp_ChC)) THEN
        rVoted_ColdSeawater_Temp := rFilt_ColdSeawater_Temp_ChB;
    ELSE
        rVoted_ColdSeawater_Temp := rFilt_ColdSeawater_Temp_ChC;
    END_IF;
ELSIF iColdSW_T_VotingMode = 2 THEN
    IF bColdSW_T_ChA_Fault THEN
        rVoted_ColdSeawater_Temp := (rFilt_ColdSeawater_Temp_ChB + rFilt_ColdSeawater_Temp_ChC) * 0.5;
    ELSIF bColdSW_T_ChB_Fault THEN
        rVoted_ColdSeawater_Temp := (rFilt_ColdSeawater_Temp_ChA + rFilt_ColdSeawater_Temp_ChC) * 0.5;
    ELSE
        rVoted_ColdSeawater_Temp := (rFilt_ColdSeawater_Temp_ChA + rFilt_ColdSeawater_Temp_ChB) * 0.5;
    END_IF;
    bWarn_SensorDegraded_1oo2 := TRUE;
ELSE
    rVoted_ColdSeawater_Temp := 4.5;
END_IF;

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* SUB-VOTER 2.3: Flash Evaporator Saturation Pressure [bar] (Threshold: 0.35 bar)       *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
IF ABS(rEvaporator_Press_ChA - rEvapP_LastRawA) < 0.0001 THEN
    iEvapP_StuckCountA := iEvapP_StuckCountA + 1;
ELSE
    iEvapP_StuckCountA := 0;
END_IF;
rEvapP_LastRawA := rEvaporator_Press_ChA;

IF ABS(rEvaporator_Press_ChB - rEvapP_LastRawB) < 0.0001 THEN
    iEvapP_StuckCountB := iEvapP_StuckCountB + 1;
ELSE
    iEvapP_StuckCountB := 0;
END_IF;
rEvapP_LastRawB := rEvaporator_Press_ChB;

IF ABS(rEvaporator_Press_ChC - rEvapP_LastRawC) < 0.0001 THEN
    iEvapP_StuckCountC := iEvapP_StuckCountC + 1;
ELSE
    iEvapP_StuckCountC := 0;
END_IF;
rEvapP_LastRawC := rEvaporator_Press_ChC;

bEvapP_ChA_Fault := (iEvapP_StuckCountA > 100) OR (rFilt_Evaporator_Press_ChA < 2.0) OR (rFilt_Evaporator_Press_ChA > 15.0);
bEvapP_ChB_Fault := (iEvapP_StuckCountB > 100) OR (rFilt_Evaporator_Press_ChB < 2.0) OR (rFilt_Evaporator_Press_ChB > 15.0);
bEvapP_ChC_Fault := (iEvapP_StuckCountC > 100) OR (rFilt_Evaporator_Press_ChC < 2.0) OR (rFilt_Evaporator_Press_ChC > 15.0);

IF (NOT bEvapP_ChA_Fault) AND (NOT bEvapP_ChB_Fault) AND (NOT bEvapP_ChC_Fault) THEN
    iEvapP_VotingMode := 3;
    IF ABS(rFilt_Evaporator_Press_ChA - rFilt_Evaporator_Press_ChB) > 0.35 THEN
        IF ABS(rFilt_Evaporator_Press_ChA - rFilt_Evaporator_Press_ChC) > 0.35 THEN
            bEvapP_ChA_Fault := TRUE;
            iEvapP_VotingMode := 2;
        ELSIF ABS(rFilt_Evaporator_Press_ChB - rFilt_Evaporator_Press_ChC) > 0.35 THEN
            bEvapP_ChB_Fault := TRUE;
            iEvapP_VotingMode := 2;
        END_IF;
    ELSIF ABS(rFilt_Evaporator_Press_ChB - rFilt_Evaporator_Press_ChC) > 0.35 THEN
        bEvapP_ChC_Fault := TRUE;
        iEvapP_VotingMode := 2;
    END_IF;
END_IF;

IF iEvapP_VotingMode = 3 THEN
    IF ((rFilt_Evaporator_Press_ChA >= rFilt_Evaporator_Press_ChB) AND (rFilt_Evaporator_Press_ChA <= rFilt_Evaporator_Press_ChC)) OR
       ((rFilt_Evaporator_Press_ChA <= rFilt_Evaporator_Press_ChB) AND (rFilt_Evaporator_Press_ChA >= rFilt_Evaporator_Press_ChC)) THEN
        rVoted_Evaporator_Press := rFilt_Evaporator_Press_ChA;
    ELSIF ((rFilt_Evaporator_Press_ChB >= rFilt_Evaporator_Press_ChA) AND (rFilt_Evaporator_Press_ChB <= rFilt_Evaporator_Press_ChC)) OR
          ((rFilt_Evaporator_Press_ChB <= rFilt_Evaporator_Press_ChA) AND (rFilt_Evaporator_Press_ChB >= rFilt_Evaporator_Press_ChC)) THEN
        rVoted_Evaporator_Press := rFilt_Evaporator_Press_ChB;
    ELSE
        rVoted_Evaporator_Press := rFilt_Evaporator_Press_ChC;
    END_IF;
ELSIF iEvapP_VotingMode = 2 THEN
    IF bEvapP_ChA_Fault THEN
        rVoted_Evaporator_Press := (rFilt_Evaporator_Press_ChB + rFilt_Evaporator_Press_ChC) * 0.5;
    ELSIF bEvapP_ChB_Fault THEN
        rVoted_Evaporator_Press := (rFilt_Evaporator_Press_ChA + rFilt_Evaporator_Press_ChC) * 0.5;
    ELSE
        rVoted_Evaporator_Press := (rFilt_Evaporator_Press_ChA + rFilt_Evaporator_Press_ChB) * 0.5;
    END_IF;
    bWarn_SensorDegraded_1oo2 := TRUE;
ELSE
    rVoted_Evaporator_Press := 9.40;
END_IF;

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* SUB-VOTER 2.4: Ammonia Condenser Saturation Pressure [bar] (Threshold: 0.25 bar)      *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
IF ABS(rCondenser_Press_ChA - rCondP_LastRawA) < 0.0001 THEN
    iCondP_StuckCountA := iCondP_StuckCountA + 1;
ELSE
    iCondP_StuckCountA := 0;
END_IF;
rCondP_LastRawA := rCondenser_Press_ChA;

IF ABS(rCondenser_Press_ChB - rCondP_LastRawB) < 0.0001 THEN
    iCondP_StuckCountB := iCondP_StuckCountB + 1;
ELSE
    iCondP_StuckCountB := 0;
END_IF;
rCondP_LastRawB := rCondenser_Press_ChB;

IF ABS(rCondenser_Press_ChC - rCondP_LastRawC) < 0.0001 THEN
    iCondP_StuckCountC := iCondP_StuckCountC + 1;
ELSE
    iCondP_StuckCountC := 0;
END_IF;
rCondP_LastRawC := rCondenser_Press_ChC;

bCondP_ChA_Fault := (iCondP_StuckCountA > 100) OR (rFilt_Condenser_Press_ChA < 1.0) OR (rFilt_Condenser_Press_ChA > 10.0);
bCondP_ChB_Fault := (iCondP_StuckCountB > 100) OR (rFilt_Condenser_Press_ChB < 1.0) OR (rFilt_Condenser_Press_ChB > 10.0);
bCondP_ChC_Fault := (iCondP_StuckCountC > 100) OR (rFilt_Condenser_Press_ChC < 1.0) OR (rFilt_Condenser_Press_ChC > 10.0);

IF (NOT bCondP_ChA_Fault) AND (NOT bCondP_ChB_Fault) AND (NOT bCondP_ChC_Fault) THEN
    iCondP_VotingMode := 3;
    IF ABS(rFilt_Condenser_Press_ChA - rFilt_Condenser_Press_ChB) > 0.25 THEN
        IF ABS(rFilt_Condenser_Press_ChA - rFilt_Condenser_Press_ChC) > 0.25 THEN
            bCondP_ChA_Fault := TRUE;
            iCondP_VotingMode := 2;
        ELSIF ABS(rFilt_Condenser_Press_ChB - rFilt_Condenser_Press_ChC) > 0.25 THEN
            bCondP_ChB_Fault := TRUE;
            iCondP_VotingMode := 2;
        END_IF;
    ELSIF ABS(rFilt_Condenser_Press_ChB - rFilt_Condenser_Press_ChC) > 0.25 THEN
        bCondP_ChC_Fault := TRUE;
        iCondP_VotingMode := 2;
    END_IF;
END_IF;

IF iCondP_VotingMode = 3 THEN
    IF ((rFilt_Condenser_Press_ChA >= rFilt_Condenser_Press_ChB) AND (rFilt_Condenser_Press_ChA <= rFilt_Condenser_Press_ChC)) OR
       ((rFilt_Condenser_Press_ChA <= rFilt_Condenser_Press_ChB) AND (rFilt_Condenser_Press_ChA >= rFilt_Condenser_Press_ChC)) THEN
        rVoted_Condenser_Press := rFilt_Condenser_Press_ChA;
    ELSIF ((rFilt_Condenser_Press_ChB >= rFilt_Condenser_Press_ChA) AND (rFilt_Condenser_Press_ChB <= rFilt_Condenser_Press_ChC)) OR
          ((rFilt_Condenser_Press_ChB <= rFilt_Condenser_Press_ChA) AND (rFilt_Condenser_Press_ChB >= rFilt_Condenser_Press_ChC)) THEN
        rVoted_Condenser_Press := rFilt_Condenser_Press_ChB;
    ELSE
        rVoted_Condenser_Press := rFilt_Condenser_Press_ChC;
    END_IF;
ELSIF iCondP_VotingMode = 2 THEN
    IF bCondP_ChA_Fault THEN
        rVoted_Condenser_Press := (rFilt_Condenser_Press_ChB + rFilt_Condenser_Press_ChC) * 0.5;
    ELSIF bCondP_ChB_Fault THEN
        rVoted_Condenser_Press := (rFilt_Condenser_Press_ChA + rFilt_Condenser_Press_ChC) * 0.5;
    ELSE
        rVoted_Condenser_Press := (rFilt_Condenser_Press_ChA + rFilt_Condenser_Press_ChB) * 0.5;
    END_IF;
    bWarn_SensorDegraded_1oo2 := TRUE;
ELSE
    rVoted_Condenser_Press := 5.45;
END_IF;

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* SUB-VOTER 2.5: Turbine Rotor Shaft Speed [rpm] (Threshold: 25.0 rpm)                  *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
IF ABS(rTurbine_Shaft_Speed_ChA - rTurbSpeed_LastRawA) < 0.001 THEN
    iTurbSpeed_StuckCountA := iTurbSpeed_StuckCountA + 1;
ELSE
    iTurbSpeed_StuckCountA := 0;
END_IF;
rTurbSpeed_LastRawA := rTurbine_Shaft_Speed_ChA;

IF ABS(rTurbine_Shaft_Speed_ChB - rTurbSpeed_LastRawB) < 0.001 THEN
    iTurbSpeed_StuckCountB := iTurbSpeed_StuckCountB + 1;
ELSE
    iTurbSpeed_StuckCountB := 0;
END_IF;
rTurbSpeed_LastRawB := rTurbine_Shaft_Speed_ChB;

IF ABS(rTurbine_Shaft_Speed_ChC - rTurbSpeed_LastRawC) < 0.001 THEN
    iTurbSpeed_StuckCountC := iTurbSpeed_StuckCountC + 1;
ELSE
    iTurbSpeed_StuckCountC := 0;
END_IF;
rTurbSpeed_LastRawC := rTurbine_Shaft_Speed_ChC;

bTurbSpeed_ChA_Fault := (iTurbSpeed_StuckCountA > 80) OR (rFilt_Turbine_Shaft_Speed_ChA < 0.0) OR (rFilt_Turbine_Shaft_Speed_ChA > 3600.0);
bTurbSpeed_ChB_Fault := (iTurbSpeed_StuckCountB > 80) OR (rFilt_Turbine_Shaft_Speed_ChB < 0.0) OR (rFilt_Turbine_Shaft_Speed_ChB > 3600.0);
bTurbSpeed_ChC_Fault := (iTurbSpeed_StuckCountC > 80) OR (rFilt_Turbine_Shaft_Speed_ChC < 0.0) OR (rFilt_Turbine_Shaft_Speed_ChC > 3600.0);

IF (NOT bTurbSpeed_ChA_Fault) AND (NOT bTurbSpeed_ChB_Fault) AND (NOT bTurbSpeed_ChC_Fault) THEN
    iTurbSpeed_VotingMode := 3;
    IF ABS(rFilt_Turbine_Shaft_Speed_ChA - rFilt_Turbine_Shaft_Speed_ChB) > 25.0 THEN
        IF ABS(rFilt_Turbine_Shaft_Speed_ChA - rFilt_Turbine_Shaft_Speed_ChC) > 25.0 THEN
            bTurbSpeed_ChA_Fault := TRUE;
            iTurbSpeed_VotingMode := 2;
        ELSIF ABS(rFilt_Turbine_Shaft_Speed_ChB - rFilt_Turbine_Shaft_Speed_ChC) > 25.0 THEN
            bTurbSpeed_ChB_Fault := TRUE;
            iTurbSpeed_VotingMode := 2;
        END_IF;
    ELSIF ABS(rFilt_Turbine_Shaft_Speed_ChB - rFilt_Turbine_Shaft_Speed_ChC) > 25.0 THEN
        bTurbSpeed_ChC_Fault := TRUE;
        iTurbSpeed_VotingMode := 2;
    END_IF;
END_IF;

IF iTurbSpeed_VotingMode = 3 THEN
    IF ((rFilt_Turbine_Shaft_Speed_ChA >= rFilt_Turbine_Shaft_Speed_ChB) AND (rFilt_Turbine_Shaft_Speed_ChA <= rFilt_Turbine_Shaft_Speed_ChC)) OR
       ((rFilt_Turbine_Shaft_Speed_ChA <= rFilt_Turbine_Shaft_Speed_ChB) AND (rFilt_Turbine_Shaft_Speed_ChA >= rFilt_Turbine_Shaft_Speed_ChC)) THEN
        rVoted_Turbine_Speed := rFilt_Turbine_Shaft_Speed_ChA;
    ELSIF ((rFilt_Turbine_Shaft_Speed_ChB >= rFilt_Turbine_Shaft_Speed_ChA) AND (rFilt_Turbine_Shaft_Speed_ChB <= rFilt_Turbine_Shaft_Speed_ChC)) OR
          ((rFilt_Turbine_Shaft_Speed_ChB <= rFilt_Turbine_Shaft_Speed_ChA) AND (rFilt_Turbine_Shaft_Speed_ChB >= rFilt_Turbine_Shaft_Speed_ChC)) THEN
        rVoted_Turbine_Speed := rFilt_Turbine_Shaft_Speed_ChB;
    ELSE
        rVoted_Turbine_Speed := rFilt_Turbine_Shaft_Speed_ChC;
    END_IF;
ELSIF iTurbSpeed_VotingMode = 2 THEN
    IF bTurbSpeed_ChA_Fault THEN
        rVoted_Turbine_Speed := (rFilt_Turbine_Shaft_Speed_ChB + rFilt_Turbine_Shaft_Speed_ChC) * 0.5;
    ELSIF bTurbSpeed_ChB_Fault THEN
        rVoted_Turbine_Speed := (rFilt_Turbine_Shaft_Speed_ChA + rFilt_Turbine_Shaft_Speed_ChC) * 0.5;
    ELSE
        rVoted_Turbine_Speed := (rFilt_Turbine_Shaft_Speed_ChA + rFilt_Turbine_Shaft_Speed_ChB) * 0.5;
    END_IF;
    bWarn_SensorDegraded_1oo2 := TRUE;
ELSE
    rVoted_Turbine_Speed := 0.0;
END_IF;


(* ==================================================================================== *)
(* LOGIC SECTION 3: PURE ANHYDROUS AMMONIA (R717) EQUATION OF STATE & THERMODYNAMICS     *)
(* Computes Saturation Conditions, Enthalpies, Heat Fluxes, and Rankine Thermal Eff.     *)
(* Uses Antoine Relation: log10(P) = A - B / (T + C) ==> T = B / (A - log10(P)) - C      *)
(* In IEC 61131-3: log10(x) = LN(x) / 2.302585093                                       *)
(* ==================================================================================== *)

(* Evaporator Saturation Temperature Calculation from Voted Pressure *)
IF rVoted_Evaporator_Press > 1.0 THEN
    rEvap_Sat_Temp_Calc := (1113.928 / (4.8688 - (LN(rVoted_Evaporator_Press) / 2.302585093))) - 248.0;
ELSE
    rEvap_Sat_Temp_Calc := 21.0;
END_IF;

(* Condenser Saturation Temperature Calculation from Voted Pressure *)
IF rVoted_Condenser_Press > 0.5 THEN
    rCond_Sat_Temp_Calc := (1113.928 / (4.8688 - (LN(rVoted_Condenser_Press) / 2.302585093))) - 248.0;
ELSE
    rCond_Sat_Temp_Calc := 6.5;
END_IF;

(* Specific Enthalpy Approximations for Liquid, Vapor, and Latent Heat [kJ/kg] *)
rEvap_Liquid_Enthalpy := 200.0 + 4.65 * rEvap_Sat_Temp_Calc;
rEvap_Vapor_Enthalpy  := 1440.0 + 1.25 * rEvap_Sat_Temp_Calc;
rEvap_Latent_Heat_hfg := rEvap_Vapor_Enthalpy - rEvap_Liquid_Enthalpy;

rCond_Liquid_Enthalpy := 200.0 + 4.65 * rCond_Sat_Temp_Calc;
rCond_Vapor_Enthalpy  := 1440.0 + 1.25 * rCond_Sat_Temp_Calc;
rCond_Latent_Heat_hfg := rCond_Vapor_Enthalpy - rCond_Liquid_Enthalpy;

(* Surface Warm Seawater Heat Duty Calculation [kW] *)
(* rho_warm = 1024 kg/m3, cp_warm = 3.99 kJ/(kg*K) *)
IF rFilt_WarmSeawater_Flow > 100.0 THEN
    rGross_Thermal_Power_In := (rFilt_WarmSeawater_Flow * 1024.0 / 3600.0) * 3.99 * 
                               MAX(0.1, (rVoted_WarmSeawater_Temp - rWarmSeawater_Discharge_Temp));
ELSE
    rGross_Thermal_Power_In := 1000.0;
END_IF;
rWarmSeawater_HeatTransfer_kW := rGross_Thermal_Power_In;

(* R717 Cycle Mass Flow Rate derived from Evaporator Heat Duty [kg/s] *)
IF rEvap_Latent_Heat_hfg > 500.0 THEN
    rAmmonia_Mass_Flow_kg_s := rGross_Thermal_Power_In / rEvap_Latent_Heat_hfg;
ELSE
    rAmmonia_Mass_Flow_kg_s := 50.0;
END_IF;

(* Cold Seawater Heat Rejection Rate [kW] *)
(* rho_cold = 1028 kg/m3, cp_cold = 4.05 kJ/(kg*K) *)
IF rCWIP_Total_Flow_m3h > 100.0 THEN
    rCondenser_Heat_Rejection := (rCWIP_Total_Flow_m3h * 1028.0 / 3600.0) * 4.05 * 
                                 MAX(0.1, (rColdSeawater_Discharge_Temp - rVoted_ColdSeawater_Temp));
ELSE
    rCondenser_Heat_Rejection := 900.0;
END_IF;
rColdSeawater_HeatRejection_kW := rCondenser_Heat_Rejection;

(* Turbine Enthalpy Expansion & Shaft Power Generation [kW] *)
rTurbine_Isentropic_EnthalpyDrop := MAX(10.0, rTurbine_Inlet_Enthalpy - rCond_Vapor_Enthalpy);
rTurbine_Actual_EnthalpyDrop     := rTurbine_Isentropic_EnthalpyDrop * rTurbine_Isentropic_Efficiency;
rTurbine_Mechanical_Power        := rAmmonia_Mass_Flow_kg_s * rTurbine_Actual_EnthalpyDrop;

(* Subcooling Margin in Condenser Hotwell [deg C] *)
rCondenser_Subcooling_Margin := rCond_Sat_Temp_Calc - rCondenser_Subcooling_Temp;

(* Cycle Thermodynamic Efficiencies [%] *)
IF (rVoted_WarmSeawater_Temp + 273.15) > 100.0 THEN
    rCarnot_Thermal_Eff := (1.0 - ((rVoted_ColdSeawater_Temp + 273.15) / (rVoted_WarmSeawater_Temp + 273.15))) * 100.0;
ELSE
    rCarnot_Thermal_Eff := 7.0;
END_IF;

IF rGross_Thermal_Power_In > 5000.0 THEN
    rThermodynamic_Thermal_Eff := (MAX(0.0, (rGenerator_Active_Power - rAuxiliary_Parasitic_Power_kW)) / rGross_Thermal_Power_In) * 100.0;
ELSE
    rThermodynamic_Thermal_Eff := 0.0;
END_IF;


(* ==================================================================================== *)
(* LOGIC SECTION 4: 1,000-METER ABYSSAL CWIP HYDRODYNAMICS & 3-PUMP ACTIVE BALANCING    *)
(* Addresses Massive Fluid Column Inertia (6.33 Mt), Water Hammer, and Head Loss         *)
(* ==================================================================================== *)

(* Sum Total Cold Water Volumetric Intake Flow [m3/h] *)
rCWIP_Total_Flow_m3h := rFilt_ColdSeawater_Flow_Pump1 + rFilt_ColdSeawater_Flow_Pump2 + rFilt_ColdSeawater_Flow_Pump3;

(* Mean Flow Velocity inside 2.80m Bore Column [m/s] *)
rCWIP_Fluid_Velocity_mps := (rCWIP_Total_Flow_m3h / 3600.0) / c_CWIP_FlowArea_m2;

(* Reynolds Number inside Abyssal Conduit *)
rCWIP_Reynolds_Number := (1028.0 * rCWIP_Fluid_Velocity_mps * c_CWIP_Diameter_m) / 0.00165;

(* Darcy-Weisbach Continuous Hydraulic Friction Head Loss [m] *)
rCWIP_Friction_HeadLoss_m := rCWIP_Darcy_Friction_Factor * (c_CWIP_Length_m / c_CWIP_Diameter_m) * 
                             ((rCWIP_Fluid_Velocity_mps * rCWIP_Fluid_Velocity_mps) / (2.0 * 9.80665));

(* Fluid Inertia Momentum Rate of Change [m3/h per s] *)
rCWIP_Dynamic_Inertia_dF_dt := (rCWIP_Total_Flow_m3h - rCWIP_Last_Total_Flow_m3h) / c_Ts_CycleTime;
rCWIP_Last_Total_Flow_m3h := rCWIP_Total_Flow_m3h;

(* Joukowsky Surge Head Pressure Monitoring & Anti-Cavitation Assessment [kPa] *)
rCWIP_Manifold_NPSHa_kPa := rFilt_CWIP_Top_Manifold_Press - 1.25 + 
                            ((1028.0 * rCWIP_Fluid_Velocity_mps * rCWIP_Fluid_Velocity_mps) / 2000.0);
rCWIP_Hydraulic_Head_Margin := rCWIP_Manifold_NPSHa_kPa - 35.0;

(* Parallel Pump Active Load-Balancing Network: Equalizing 3 Pumps to Flow Target *)
rCWIP_Target_Flow_Per_Pump_m3h := rCWIP_Total_Flow_m3h / 3.0;

rPump1_Flow_Error := rCWIP_Target_Flow_Per_Pump_m3h - rFilt_ColdSeawater_Flow_Pump1;
rPump2_Flow_Error := rCWIP_Target_Flow_Per_Pump_m3h - rFilt_ColdSeawater_Flow_Pump2;
rPump3_Flow_Error := rCWIP_Target_Flow_Per_Pump_m3h - rFilt_ColdSeawater_Flow_Pump3;

(* Integral Equalization Trims with Anti-Windup Clamping (-4.0% to +4.0%) *)
rPump1_PI_Integral := LIMIT(-4.0, (rPump1_PI_Integral + (0.00008 * rPump1_Flow_Error * c_Ts_CycleTime)), 4.0);
rPump2_PI_Integral := LIMIT(-4.0, (rPump2_PI_Integral + (0.00008 * rPump2_Flow_Error * c_Ts_CycleTime)), 4.0);
rPump3_PI_Integral := LIMIT(-4.0, (rPump3_PI_Integral + (0.00008 * rPump3_Flow_Error * c_Ts_CycleTime)), 4.0);

rPump1_Trim_Speed := (0.0006 * rPump1_Flow_Error) + rPump1_PI_Integral;
rPump2_Trim_Speed := (0.0006 * rPump2_Flow_Error) + rPump2_PI_Integral;
rPump3_Trim_Speed := (0.0006 * rPump3_Flow_Error) + rPump3_PI_Integral;

(* Individual Pump Speed References with Slew Limit to Prevent Water Hammer *)
rColdSeawater_Pump1_Speed_Cmd := LIMIT(0.0, (rColdMaster_Speed_Reference + rPump1_Trim_Speed), 100.0);
rColdSeawater_Pump2_Speed_Cmd := LIMIT(0.0, (rColdMaster_Speed_Reference + rPump2_Trim_Speed), 100.0);
rColdSeawater_Pump3_Speed_Cmd := LIMIT(0.0, (rColdMaster_Speed_Reference + rPump3_Trim_Speed), 100.0);


(* ==================================================================================== *)
(* LOGIC SECTION 5: DISCRETE STATE-SPACE MODEL & DISCRETE KALMAN/OBSERVER ESTIMATOR     *)
(* Sampling Ts = 50ms. States: [P_evap, Level_evap, Omega_turb, Flow_cwip]               *)
(* State Propagation: x_hat[k+1] = Ad * x_hat[k] + Bd * u[k] + L * (y[k] - Cd * x_hat[k])*)
(* ==================================================================================== *)

(* Calculate Output Residuals / Innovation Error: e_y = y_measured - Cd * x_hat *)
rObserverResidual_1 := rVoted_Evaporator_Press - (Cd_11 * rStateEst_P_evap);
rObserverResidual_2 := rEvaporator_Liquid_Level - (Cd_22 * rStateEst_Level_evap);
rObserverResidual_3 := rVoted_Turbine_Speed    - (Cd_33 * rStateEst_Omega_turb);
rObserverResidual_4 := rCWIP_Total_Flow_m3h    - (Cd_44 * rStateEst_Flow_cwip);

(* Propagate Next State Vector via Discrete Matrices Ad, Bd, and Observer Gain L *)
rNextStateEst_P_evap := (Ad_11 * rStateEst_P_evap + Ad_12 * rStateEst_Level_evap + Ad_13 * rStateEst_Omega_turb + Ad_14 * rStateEst_Flow_cwip) +
                        (Bd_11 * rWarmPump_Demand_Accum + Bd_12 * rVIGV_Demand_Accum + Bd_13 * rColdPump_Demand_Accum) +
                        (L_11 * rObserverResidual_1 + L_12 * rObserverResidual_2 + L_13 * rObserverResidual_3 + L_14 * rObserverResidual_4);

rNextStateEst_Level_evap := (Ad_21 * rStateEst_P_evap + Ad_22 * rStateEst_Level_evap + Ad_23 * rStateEst_Omega_turb + Ad_24 * rStateEst_Flow_cwip) +
                            (Bd_21 * rWarmPump_Demand_Accum + Bd_22 * rVIGV_Demand_Accum + Bd_23 * rColdPump_Demand_Accum) +
                            (L_21 * rObserverResidual_1 + L_22 * rObserverResidual_2 + L_23 * rObserverResidual_3 + L_24 * rObserverResidual_4);

rNextStateEst_Omega_turb := (Ad_31 * rStateEst_P_evap + Ad_32 * rStateEst_Level_evap + Ad_33 * rStateEst_Omega_turb + Ad_34 * rStateEst_Flow_cwip) +
                            (Bd_31 * rWarmPump_Demand_Accum + Bd_32 * rVIGV_Demand_Accum + Bd_33 * rColdPump_Demand_Accum) +
                            (L_31 * rObserverResidual_1 + L_32 * rObserverResidual_2 + L_33 * rObserverResidual_3 + L_34 * rObserverResidual_4);

rNextStateEst_Flow_cwip := (Ad_41 * rStateEst_P_evap + Ad_42 * rStateEst_Level_evap + Ad_43 * rStateEst_Omega_turb + Ad_44 * rStateEst_Flow_cwip) +
                           (Bd_41 * rWarmPump_Demand_Accum + Bd_42 * rVIGV_Demand_Accum + Bd_43 * rColdPump_Demand_Accum) +
                           (L_41 * rObserverResidual_1 + L_42 * rObserverResidual_2 + L_43 * rObserverResidual_3 + L_44 * rObserverResidual_4);

(* State Vector Update with Physical Range Sanitization *)
rStateEst_P_evap     := LIMIT(5.0, rNextStateEst_P_evap, 14.0);
rStateEst_Level_evap := LIMIT(0.0, rNextStateEst_Level_evap, 100.0);
rStateEst_Omega_turb := LIMIT(0.0, rNextStateEst_Omega_turb, 3600.0);
rStateEst_Flow_cwip  := LIMIT(0.0, rNextStateEst_Flow_cwip, 25000.0);


(* ==================================================================================== *)
(* LOGIC SECTION 6: MODEL PREDICTIVE CONTROL (MPC) CONDENSED QUADRATIC SOLVER           *)
(* Solves: min 0.5 * Delta_u^T * H * Delta_u + g^T * Delta_u  s.t. Bounds & Slew Limits *)
(* Uses Projected Gradient Descent with Warm-Starting for Hard Real-Time Determinism    *)
(* ==================================================================================== *)

(* Calculate Linear Gradient Vector g based on Tracking Errors *)
g_1 := 2.0 * (rQ_weight_1 * (rStateEst_P_evap - rMPC_Ref_P_evap) * 0.05 + 
              rQ_weight_2 * (rStateEst_Level_evap - rMPC_Ref_Level_evap) * 0.02 + 
              rQ_weight_3 * (rStateEst_Omega_turb - rMPC_Ref_Omega_turb) * 0.01);

g_2 := 2.0 * (rQ_weight_1 * (rStateEst_P_evap - rMPC_Ref_P_evap) * (-0.04) + 
              rQ_weight_2 * (rStateEst_Level_evap - rMPC_Ref_Level_evap) * (-0.06) + 
              rQ_weight_3 * (rStateEst_Omega_turb - rMPC_Ref_Omega_turb) * 0.25);

g_3 := 2.0 * (rQ_weight_4 * (rStateEst_Flow_cwip - rMPC_Ref_Flow_cwip) * 0.08);

(* Initialize Control Adjustment Step *)
Delta_u_1 := 0.0;
Delta_u_2 := 0.0;
Delta_u_3 := 0.0;

(* Iterative Projected Gradient Descent Optimization Loop *)
FOR iMpcIteration := 1 TO 8 DO
    (* Gradient Evaluation: Grad = H * Delta_u + g *)
    rGrad_1 := (H_11 * Delta_u_1 + H_12 * Delta_u_2 + H_13 * Delta_u_3) + g_1;
    rGrad_2 := (H_21 * Delta_u_1 + H_22 * Delta_u_2 + H_23 * Delta_u_3) + g_2;
    rGrad_3 := (H_31 * Delta_u_1 + H_32 * Delta_u_2 + H_33 * Delta_u_3) + g_3;

    (* Gradient Descent Step *)
    Delta_u_1 := Delta_u_1 - (rMpcAlpha * rGrad_1);
    Delta_u_2 := Delta_u_2 - (rMpcAlpha * rGrad_2);
    Delta_u_3 := Delta_u_3 - (rMpcAlpha * rGrad_3);

    (* Actuator Slew Rate Projection / Clamping *)
    Delta_u_1 := LIMIT(-0.45, Delta_u_1, 0.45);  (* Warm Pump Max Slew [%/cycle] *)
    Delta_u_2 := LIMIT(-1.20, Delta_u_2, 1.20);  (* VIGV Servo Max Slew [%/cycle] *)
    Delta_u_3 := LIMIT(-0.35, Delta_u_3, 0.35);  (* Cold Pump Anti-Hammer Slew [%/cycle] *)
END_FOR;

(* Apply MPC Solution in Active Automatic Baseload Generating States *)
IF (iCurrentSequenceState = 80) OR (iCurrentSequenceState = 85) THEN
    rWarmPump_Demand_Accum := LIMIT(20.0, (rWarmPump_Demand_Accum + Delta_u_1), 100.0);
    rVIGV_Demand_Accum     := LIMIT(10.0, (rVIGV_Demand_Accum + Delta_u_2), 100.0);
    rColdPump_Demand_Accum := LIMIT(20.0, (rColdPump_Demand_Accum + Delta_u_3), 100.0);
    rColdMaster_Speed_Reference := rColdPump_Demand_Accum;
END_IF;


(* ==================================================================================== *)
(* LOGIC SECTION 7: RADIAL INFLOW TURBINE GOVERNOR & CRITICAL RESONANCE AVOIDANCE       *)
(* Incorporates Rotor Critical Speed Skip Bands, Anti-Stall VIGV, and Grid Speed Droop   *)
(* ==================================================================================== *)

(* Identify Rotor Mechanical Critical Resonance Bands *)
bInResonance_Band_1 := (rVoted_Turbine_Speed >= 1150.0) AND (rVoted_Turbine_Speed <= 1350.0);
bInResonance_Band_2 := (rVoted_Turbine_Speed >= 2150.0) AND (rVoted_Turbine_Speed <= 2350.0);

(* Acceleration Slew Generation with Dynamic Resonance Band Fast Skip *)
IF bInResonance_Band_1 OR bInResonance_Band_2 THEN
    rTurbine_Speed_Setpoint := rTurbine_Speed_Setpoint + (rResonance_Fast_Ramp_Rate * c_Ts_CycleTime);
ELSIF rTurbine_Speed_Setpoint < c_TurbineRatedSpeed_RPM THEN
    IF iCurrentSequenceState = 60 THEN
        rTurbine_Speed_Setpoint := rTurbine_Speed_Setpoint + (rTurbine_Speed_Ramp_Rate * c_Ts_CycleTime);
    END_IF;
END_IF;

IF iCurrentSequenceState >= 70 THEN
    rTurbine_Speed_Setpoint := c_TurbineRatedSpeed_RPM;
END_IF;

(* Closed-Loop PID Speed Governor Calculation *)
rSpeedGov_Error := rTurbine_Speed_Setpoint - rVoted_Turbine_Speed;

rSpeedGov_P_Term := rSpeedGov_Kp * rSpeedGov_Error;

(* Integral Term with Anti-Windup Reset Clamping *)
rSpeedGov_I_Term := LIMIT(-30.0, (rSpeedGov_I_Term + (rSpeedGov_Kp / rSpeedGov_Ti * rSpeedGov_Error * c_Ts_CycleTime)), 30.0);

(* Derivative Term with Low-Pass Filtering *)
rSpeedGov_D_Term := (rSpeedGov_Kp * rSpeedGov_Td) * ((rVoted_Turbine_Speed - rSpeedGov_LastSpeed) / c_Ts_CycleTime);
rSpeedGov_LastSpeed := rVoted_Turbine_Speed;

rSpeedGov_Output := LIMIT(0.0, (rSpeedGov_P_Term + rSpeedGov_I_Term - rSpeedGov_D_Term), 100.0);

(* Speed Droop Regulation when Generator is Paralleled to Grid *)
IF iCurrentSequenceState >= 80 THEN
    (* 3.0% Droop: 100% Load shift for 1.5 Hz frequency change *)
    rVIGV_Command := LIMIT(15.0, (rVIGV_Demand_Accum - ((rVoted_Turbine_Speed - c_TurbineRatedSpeed_RPM) / (c_TurbineRatedSpeed_RPM * (rDroop_Gain_Percent / 100.0)) * 100.0)), 100.0);
ELSIF iCurrentSequenceState >= 60 THEN
    rVIGV_Command := LIMIT(5.0, rSpeedGov_Output, 65.0);
ELSE
    rVIGV_Command := 0.0;
END_IF;


(* ==================================================================================== *)
(* LOGIC SECTION 8: AUTOMATIC SYNCHROCHECK RELAY & ELECTRICAL BUS COUPLING              *)
(* Monitors Voltage RMS, Frequency Slip, and Phase Angle Displacement                  *)
(* ==================================================================================== *)

(* Calculate Deviations between Generator Terminals and Offshore Utility Substation *)
rSynch_Voltage_Diff_Percent  := (ABS(rGen_Voltage_RMS - rGrid_Voltage_RMS) / c_GridNominalVoltage_V) * 100.0;
rSynch_Frequency_Slip_Hz     := ABS(rGen_Frequency_Hz - rGrid_Frequency_Hz);
rSynch_Phase_Angle_Error_Deg := ABS(rGen_Phase_Angle_Deg - rGrid_Phase_Angle_Deg);

(* Synchrocheck Permissive Window Assessment *)
bSynch_Voltage_OK := (rSynch_Voltage_Diff_Percent <= 2.0);
bSynch_Slip_OK    := (rSynch_Frequency_Slip_Hz <= 0.05);
bSynch_Phase_OK   := (rSynch_Phase_Angle_Error_Deg <= 5.0);

bSynch_AllPermissivesMet := bSynch_Voltage_OK AND bSynch_Slip_OK AND bSynch_Phase_OK AND bGrid_Tie_Permissive;

(* Continuous Dwell Time Verification Timer (500 ms) *)
tSynchDwellTimer(IN := (bSynch_AllPermissivesMet AND (iCurrentSequenceState = 70)), PT := T#500MS);

(* Generator Circuit Breaker Close Command Pulse Generator (250 ms Pulse) *)
tBreakerClosePulseTimer(IN := tSynchDwellTimer.Q, PT := T#250MS);
bGenerator_Breaker_Close_Cmd := tBreakerClosePulseTimer.Q;


(* ==================================================================================== *)
(* LOGIC SECTION 9: MASTER PLANT FINITE STATE MACHINE (11 SEQUENCE STATES)              *)
(* Coordinates System Startup, CWP Priming, Bootstrap, Synchronization, and Shutdown   *)
(* ==================================================================================== *)

(* Detect State Transitions for Timer Resets *)
bStateFirstScan := (iCurrentSequenceState <> iLastSequenceState);
iLastSequenceState := iCurrentSequenceState;

CASE iCurrentSequenceState OF

    0: (* STATE 0: IDLE / UNINITIALIZED *)
        bTurbine_Trip_Valve_FastClose := FALSE;
        rVIGV_Command                 := 0.0;
        rWarmSeawater_Pump_Speed_Cmd  := 0.0;
        rColdSeawater_Pump1_Speed_Cmd := 0.0;
        rColdSeawater_Pump2_Speed_Cmd := 0.0;
        rColdSeawater_Pump3_Speed_Cmd := 0.0;
        rAmmonia_Feed_Pump_Speed_Cmd  := 0.0;
        rEvaporator_Bypass_Valve_Cmd  := 0.0;
        rTurbine_Speed_Setpoint       := 0.0;

(* ====================================================================================================================
   SECTION 1: HARD SAFETY CIRCUIT, EMERGENCY TRIP & SYSTEM SHUTDOWN INTERLOCK
   ==================================================================================================================== *)
IF NOT bEmergencyStopOk THEN
    bSystemReady            := FALSE;
    bControlActive          := FALSE;
    bDegradedMode           := FALSE;
    bSystemAlarm            := TRUE;
    wFaultCode              := 16#0001; (* EMERGENCY_STOP_HARDWIRE_TRIPPED *)
    wWarningWord            := 16#0000;
    rServoCmdGap_DS_mm      := c_rMaxHydraulicStroke_mm; (* Drive cylinders to fully open position *)
    rServoCmdGap_OS_mm      := c_rMaxHydraulicStroke_mm;
    rWorkRollBendingCmd_kN  := 0.0;                      (* Depressurize bending jacks *)
    rEccentricityComp_DS_mm := 0.0;
    rEccentricityComp_OS_mm := 0.0;
    
    FOR iDiagnosticLoopIndex := 1 TO 16 DO
        arrCoolingZoneTrim_pct[iDiagnosticLoopIndex] := 0.0;
    END_FOR;
    
    iState := 99;
    iStateSequence := iState;
    RETURN;
END_IF;

(* ====================================================================================================================
   SECTION 2: 2oo3 TRIPLE MODULAR REDUNDANCY (TMR) SENSOR VOTING & HEALTH PLAUSIBILITY
   ==================================================================================================================== *)
(* --- 2.1 ENTRY STRIP VELOCITY 2oo3 VOTER --- *)
IF (ABS(rStripSpeedEntry_RawA_mpm - rStripSpeedEntry_RawB_mpm) <= c_rSpeedDiscrepancyLimit_mpm) THEN
    IF (ABS(rStripSpeedEntry_RawA_mpm - rStripSpeedEntry_RawC_mpm) <= c_rSpeedDiscrepancyLimit_mpm) THEN
        IF (rStripSpeedEntry_RawA_mpm >= rStripSpeedEntry_RawB_mpm AND rStripSpeedEntry_RawA_mpm <= rStripSpeedEntry_RawC_mpm) OR
           (rStripSpeedEntry_RawA_mpm <= rStripSpeedEntry_RawB_mpm AND rStripSpeedEntry_RawA_mpm >= rStripSpeedEntry_RawC_mpm) THEN
            rVotedEntrySpeed_mpm := rStripSpeedEntry_RawA_mpm;
        ELSIF (rStripSpeedEntry_RawB_mpm >= rStripSpeedEntry_RawA_mpm AND rStripSpeedEntry_RawB_mpm <= rStripSpeedEntry_RawC_mpm) OR
              (rStripSpeedEntry_RawB_mpm <= rStripSpeedEntry_RawA_mpm AND rStripSpeedEntry_RawB_mpm >= rStripSpeedEntry_RawC_mpm) THEN
            rVotedEntrySpeed_mpm := rStripSpeedEntry_RawB_mpm;
        ELSE
            rVotedEntrySpeed_mpm := rStripSpeedEntry_RawC_mpm;
        END_IF;
        iEntrySpeedFaultCounterA := 0; iEntrySpeedFaultCounterB := 0; iEntrySpeedFaultCounterC := 0;
        bEntrySpeedDegraded := FALSE;
    ELSE
        rVotedEntrySpeed_mpm := 0.5 * (rStripSpeedEntry_RawA_mpm + rStripSpeedEntry_RawB_mpm);
        iEntrySpeedFaultCounterC := iEntrySpeedFaultCounterC + 1;
        bEntrySpeedDegraded := TRUE;
    END_IF;
ELSIF (ABS(rStripSpeedEntry_RawA_mpm - rStripSpeedEntry_RawC_mpm) <= c_rSpeedDiscrepancyLimit_mpm) THEN
    rVotedEntrySpeed_mpm := 0.5 * (rStripSpeedEntry_RawA_mpm + rStripSpeedEntry_RawC_mpm);
    iEntrySpeedFaultCounterB := iEntrySpeedFaultCounterB + 1;
    bEntrySpeedDegraded := TRUE;
ELSIF (ABS(rStripSpeedEntry_RawB_mpm - rStripSpeedEntry_RawC_mpm) <= c_rSpeedDiscrepancyLimit_mpm) THEN
    rVotedEntrySpeed_mpm := 0.5 * (rStripSpeedEntry_RawB_mpm + rStripSpeedEntry_RawC_mpm);
    iEntrySpeedFaultCounterA := iEntrySpeedFaultCounterA + 1;
    bEntrySpeedDegraded := TRUE;
ELSE
    rVotedEntrySpeed_mpm := rStripSpeedEntry_RawC_mpm;
    bSpeedVoterFailedEntry := TRUE;
END_IF;

(* --- 2.2 EXIT STRIP VELOCITY 2oo3 VOTER --- *)
IF (ABS(rStripSpeedExit_RawA_mpm - rStripSpeedExit_RawB_mpm) <= c_rSpeedDiscrepancyLimit_mpm) THEN
    IF (ABS(rStripSpeedExit_RawA_mpm - rStripSpeedExit_RawC_mpm) <= c_rSpeedDiscrepancyLimit_mpm) THEN
        IF (rStripSpeedExit_RawA_mpm >= rStripSpeedExit_RawB_mpm AND rStripSpeedExit_RawA_mpm <= rStripSpeedExit_RawC_mpm) OR
           (rStripSpeedExit_RawA_mpm <= rStripSpeedExit_RawB_mpm AND rStripSpeedExit_RawA_mpm >= rStripSpeedExit_RawC_mpm) THEN
            rVotedExitSpeed_mpm := rStripSpeedExit_RawA_mpm;
        ELSIF (rStripSpeedExit_RawB_mpm >= rStripSpeedExit_RawA_mpm AND rStripSpeedExit_RawB_mpm <= rStripSpeedExit_RawC_mpm) OR
              (rStripSpeedExit_RawB_mpm <= rStripSpeedExit_RawA_mpm AND rStripSpeedExit_RawB_mpm >= rStripSpeedExit_RawC_mpm) THEN
            rVotedExitSpeed_mpm := rStripSpeedExit_RawB_mpm;
        ELSE
            rVotedExitSpeed_mpm := rStripSpeedExit_RawC_mpm;
        END_IF;
        iExitSpeedFaultCounterA := 0; iExitSpeedFaultCounterB := 0; iExitSpeedFaultCounterC := 0;
        bExitSpeedDegraded := FALSE;
    ELSE
        rVotedExitSpeed_mpm := 0.5 * (rStripSpeedExit_RawA_mpm + rStripSpeedExit_RawB_mpm);

    END_IF;
