    rVotedExitSpeed_mpm := 0.5 * (rStripSpeedExit_RawA_mpm + rStripSpeedExit_RawC_mpm);
    iExitSpeedFaultCounterB := iExitSpeedFaultCounterB + 1;
    bExitSpeedDegraded := TRUE;
ELSIF (ABS(rStripSpeedExit_RawB_mpm - rStripSpeedExit_RawC_mpm) <= c_rSpeedDiscrepancyLimit_mpm) THEN
    rVotedExitSpeed_mpm := 0.5 * (rStripSpeedExit_RawB_mpm + rStripSpeedExit_RawC_mpm);

ELSE
    rVotedExitSpeed_mpm := rStripSpeedExit_RawC_mpm;
    bSpeedVoterFailedExit := TRUE;
END_IF;

(* --- 2.3 DRIVE SIDE ROLL SEPARATING FORCE 2oo3 VOTER --- *)
IF (ABS(rRollForce_DS_RawA_kN - rRollForce_DS_RawB_kN) <= c_rForceDiscrepancyLimit_kN) THEN
    IF (ABS(rRollForce_DS_RawA_kN - rRollForce_DS_RawC_kN) <= c_rForceDiscrepancyLimit_kN) THEN
        IF (rRollForce_DS_RawA_kN >= rRollForce_DS_RawB_kN AND rRollForce_DS_RawA_kN <= rRollForce_DS_RawC_kN) OR
           (rRollForce_DS_RawA_kN <= rRollForce_DS_RawB_kN AND rRollForce_DS_RawA_kN >= rRollForce_DS_RawC_kN) THEN
            rVotedForce_DS_kN := rRollForce_DS_RawA_kN;
        ELSIF (rRollForce_DS_RawB_kN >= rRollForce_DS_RawA_kN AND rRollForce_DS_RawB_kN <= rRollForce_DS_RawC_kN) OR
              (rRollForce_DS_RawB_kN <= rRollForce_DS_RawA_kN AND rRollForce_DS_RawB_kN >= rRollForce_DS_RawC_kN) THEN
            rVotedForce_DS_kN := rRollForce_DS_RawB_kN;
        ELSE
            rVotedForce_DS_kN := rRollForce_DS_RawC_kN;
        END_IF;
        iForceDS_FaultCounterA := 0; iForceDS_FaultCounterB := 0; iForceDS_FaultCounterC := 0;
        bForceDS_Degraded := FALSE;
    ELSE
        rVotedForce_DS_kN := 0.5 * (rRollForce_DS_RawA_kN + rRollForce_DS_RawB_kN);
        iForceDS_FaultCounterC := iForceDS_FaultCounterC + 1;
        bForceDS_Degraded := TRUE;
    END_IF;

    iForceDS_FaultCounterB := iForceDS_FaultCounterB + 1;
    bForceDS_Degraded := TRUE;
ELSIF (ABS(rRollForce_DS_RawB_kN - rRollForce_DS_RawC_kN) <= c_rForceDiscrepancyLimit_kN) THEN
    rVotedForce_DS_kN := 0.5 * (rRollForce_DS_RawB_kN + rRollForce_DS_RawC_kN);
    iForceDS_FaultCounterA := iForceDS_FaultCounterA + 1;
    bForceDS_Degraded := TRUE;
ELSE
    rVotedForce_DS_kN := rRollForce_DS_RawC_kN;
    bForceVoterFailedDS := TRUE;
END_IF;

(* --- 2.4 OPERATOR SIDE ROLL SEPARATING FORCE 2oo3 VOTER --- *)
IF (ABS(rRollForce_OS_RawA_kN - rRollForce_OS_RawB_kN) <= c_rForceDiscrepancyLimit_kN) THEN
    IF (ABS(rRollForce_OS_RawA_kN - rRollForce_OS_RawC_kN) <= c_rForceDiscrepancyLimit_kN) THEN
        IF (rRollForce_OS_RawA_kN >= rRollForce_OS_RawB_kN AND rRollForce_OS_RawA_kN <= rRollForce_OS_RawC_kN) OR
           (rRollForce_OS_RawA_kN <= rRollForce_OS_RawB_kN AND rRollForce_OS_RawA_kN >= rRollForce_OS_RawC_kN) THEN
            rVotedForce_OS_kN := rRollForce_OS_RawA_kN;
        ELSIF (rRollForce_OS_RawB_kN >= rRollForce_OS_RawA_kN AND rRollForce_OS_RawB_kN <= rRollForce_OS_RawC_kN) OR
              (rRollForce_OS_RawB_kN <= rRollForce_OS_RawA_kN AND rRollForce_OS_RawB_kN >= rRollForce_OS_RawC_kN) THEN
            rVotedForce_OS_kN := rRollForce_OS_RawB_kN;
        ELSE
            rVotedForce_OS_kN := rRollForce_OS_RawC_kN;
        END_IF;
        iForceOS_FaultCounterA := 0; iForceOS_FaultCounterB := 0; iForceOS_FaultCounterC := 0;
        bForceOS_Degraded := FALSE;
    ELSE
        rVotedForce_OS_kN := 0.5 * (rRollForce_OS_RawA_kN + rRollForce_OS_RawB_kN);
        iForceOS_FaultCounterC := iForceOS_FaultCounterC + 1;
        bForceOS_Degraded := TRUE;
    END_IF;
ELSIF (ABS(rRollForce_OS_RawA_kN - rRollForce_OS_RawC_kN) <= c_rForceDiscrepancyLimit_kN) THEN
    rVotedForce_OS_kN := 0.5 * (rRollForce_OS_RawA_kN + rRollForce_OS_RawC_kN);
    iForceOS_FaultCounterB := iForceOS_FaultCounterB + 1;
    bForceOS_Degraded := TRUE;
ELSIF (ABS(rRollForce_OS_RawB_kN - rRollForce_OS_RawC_kN) <= c_rForceDiscrepancyLimit_kN) THEN
    rVotedForce_OS_kN := 0.5 * (rRollForce_OS_RawB_kN + rRollForce_OS_RawC_kN);
    iForceOS_FaultCounterA := iForceOS_FaultCounterA + 1;
    bForceOS_Degraded := TRUE;
ELSE
    rVotedForce_OS_kN := rRollForce_OS_RawC_kN;
    bForceVoterFailedOS := TRUE;
END_IF;

(* Assemble TMR Diagnostic Bitfield *)
dwTMR_DiagnosticBits.0 := (iEntrySpeedFaultCounterA > 10);
dwTMR_DiagnosticBits.1 := (iEntrySpeedFaultCounterB > 10);
dwTMR_DiagnosticBits.2 := (iEntrySpeedFaultCounterC > 10);
dwTMR_DiagnosticBits.3 := bEntrySpeedDegraded;
dwTMR_DiagnosticBits.4 := (iExitSpeedFaultCounterA > 10);
dwTMR_DiagnosticBits.5 := (iExitSpeedFaultCounterB > 10);
dwTMR_DiagnosticBits.6 := (iExitSpeedFaultCounterC > 10);
dwTMR_DiagnosticBits.7 := bExitSpeedDegraded;
dwTMR_DiagnosticBits.8 := (iForceDS_FaultCounterA > 10);
dwTMR_DiagnosticBits.9 := (iForceDS_FaultCounterB > 10);
dwTMR_DiagnosticBits.10 := (iForceDS_FaultCounterC > 10);
dwTMR_DiagnosticBits.11 := bForceDS_Degraded;
dwTMR_DiagnosticBits.12 := (iForceOS_FaultCounterA > 10);
dwTMR_DiagnosticBits.13 := (iForceOS_FaultCounterB > 10);
dwTMR_DiagnosticBits.14 := (iForceOS_FaultCounterC > 10);
dwTMR_DiagnosticBits.15 := bForceOS_Degraded;
dwTMR_DiagnosticBits.16 := bSpeedVoterFailedEntry;
dwTMR_DiagnosticBits.17 := bSpeedVoterFailedExit;
dwTMR_DiagnosticBits.18 := bForceVoterFailedDS;
dwTMR_DiagnosticBits.19 := bForceVoterFailedOS;

(* Total Mill Roll Force & Differential Calculation *)
rTotalRollForceFeedback_kN := rVotedForce_DS_kN + rVotedForce_OS_kN;
rDifferentialForce_kN      := rVotedForce_DS_kN - rVotedForce_OS_kN;

(* Dynamic Elongation Feedback [%] with Low-Speed Clamping *)
IF rVotedEntrySpeed_mpm > 2.0 THEN
    rElongationFeedback_pct := ((rVotedExitSpeed_mpm - rVotedEntrySpeed_mpm) / rVotedEntrySpeed_mpm) * 100.0;
ELSE
    rElongationFeedback_pct := 0.0;
END_IF;
rElongationError_pct := rTargetElongation_pct - rElongationFeedback_pct;

(* ====================================================================================================================
   SECTION 3: OPTICAL STRIP FLATNESS ORTHOGONAL LEGENDRE DECOMPOSITION
   ==================================================================================================================== *)
IF NOT bLegendreBasisInitialized THEN
    rNorm_P0 := 16.0;
    rNorm_P1 := 0.0;
    rNorm_P2 := 0.0;
    rNorm_P4 := 0.0;
    
    FOR iDiagnosticLoopIndex := 1 TO 16 DO
        arrZoneCoordinate_xi[iDiagnosticLoopIndex] := -1.0 + (2.0 * INT_TO_REAL(iDiagnosticLoopIndex) - 1.0) / 16.0;
        arrLegendre_P0[iDiagnosticLoopIndex] := 1.0;
        arrLegendre_P1[iDiagnosticLoopIndex] := arrZoneCoordinate_xi[iDiagnosticLoopIndex];
        rNorm_P1 := rNorm_P1 + arrLegendre_P1[iDiagnosticLoopIndex] * arrLegendre_P1[iDiagnosticLoopIndex];
        arrLegendre_P2[iDiagnosticLoopIndex] := 0.5 * (3.0 * arrZoneCoordinate_xi[iDiagnosticLoopIndex] * arrZoneCoordinate_xi[iDiagnosticLoopIndex] - 1.0);
        rNorm_P2 := rNorm_P2 + arrLegendre_P2[iDiagnosticLoopIndex] * arrLegendre_P2[iDiagnosticLoopIndex];
        arrLegendre_P4[iDiagnosticLoopIndex] := 0.125 * (35.0 * EXPT(arrZoneCoordinate_xi[iDiagnosticLoopIndex], 4) - 30.0 * EXPT(arrZoneCoordinate_xi[iDiagnosticLoopIndex], 2) + 3.0);
        rNorm_P4 := rNorm_P4 + arrLegendre_P4[iDiagnosticLoopIndex] * arrLegendre_P4[iDiagnosticLoopIndex];
    END_FOR;
    bLegendreBasisInitialized := TRUE;
END_IF;

rMeanFlatness_Iunit    := 0.0;
rFlatnessTilt_Iunit    := 0.0;
rFlatnessCrown_Iunit   := 0.0;
rFlatnessQuarter_Iunit := 0.0;

FOR iDiagnosticLoopIndex := 1 TO 16 DO
    rMeanFlatness_Iunit    := rMeanFlatness_Iunit    + arrFlatnessProfile_Iunit[iDiagnosticLoopIndex] * arrLegendre_P0[iDiagnosticLoopIndex];
    rFlatnessTilt_Iunit    := rFlatnessTilt_Iunit    + arrFlatnessProfile_Iunit[iDiagnosticLoopIndex] * arrLegendre_P1[iDiagnosticLoopIndex];
    rFlatnessCrown_Iunit   := rFlatnessCrown_Iunit   + arrFlatnessProfile_Iunit[iDiagnosticLoopIndex] * arrLegendre_P2[iDiagnosticLoopIndex];
    rFlatnessQuarter_Iunit := rFlatnessQuarter_Iunit + arrFlatnessProfile_Iunit[iDiagnosticLoopIndex] * arrLegendre_P4[iDiagnosticLoopIndex];
END_FOR;

rMeanFlatness_Iunit    := rMeanFlatness_Iunit / rNorm_P0;
rFlatnessTilt_Iunit    := rFlatnessTilt_Iunit / rNorm_P1;
rFlatnessCrown_Iunit   := rFlatnessCrown_Iunit / rNorm_P2;
rFlatnessQuarter_Iunit := rFlatnessQuarter_Iunit / rNorm_P4;

FOR iDiagnosticLoopIndex := 1 TO 16 DO
    arrFlatnessResidual_Iunit[iDiagnosticLoopIndex] := arrFlatnessProfile_Iunit[iDiagnosticLoopIndex] 
        - (rMeanFlatness_Iunit * arrLegendre_P0[iDiagnosticLoopIndex] 
         + rFlatnessTilt_Iunit * arrLegendre_P1[iDiagnosticLoopIndex] 
         + rFlatnessCrown_Iunit * arrLegendre_P2[iDiagnosticLoopIndex] 
         + rFlatnessQuarter_Iunit * arrLegendre_P4[iDiagnosticLoopIndex]);
END_FOR;

(* ====================================================================================================================
   SECTION 4: ADAPTIVE ROLL ECCENTRICITY COMPENSATION (REC) MULTI-HARMONIC FOURIER FILTER
   ==================================================================================================================== *)
rRollAngleRad_TopBUR := rBackupRollAngleTop_deg * c_rDegToRad;
rRollAngleRad_BotBUR := rBackupRollAngleBot_deg * c_rDegToRad;
rRollAngleRad_TopWR  := rWorkRollAngleTop_deg  * c_rDegToRad;
rRollAngleRad_BotWR  := rWorkRollAngleBot_deg  * c_rDegToRad;

IF (rVotedEntrySpeed_mpm >= c_rMinStripSpeedForREC_mpm) AND (iState = 40 OR iState = 50) THEN
    rEstimatedEccForceDS_kN := 0.0;
    rEstimatedEccForceOS_kN := 0.0;
    
    (* Top Backup Roll Harmonics *)
    rEstimatedEccForceDS_kN := rEstimatedEccForceDS_kN 
        + arrHarmonicCos_A[1, 1] * COS(1.0 * rRollAngleRad_TopBUR) + arrHarmonicSin_B[1, 1] * SIN(1.0 * rRollAngleRad_TopBUR)
        + arrHarmonicCos_A[1, 2] * COS(2.0 * rRollAngleRad_TopBUR) + arrHarmonicSin_B[1, 2] * SIN(2.0 * rRollAngleRad_TopBUR)
        + arrHarmonicCos_A[1, 3] * COS(3.0 * rRollAngleRad_TopBUR) + arrHarmonicSin_B[1, 3] * SIN(3.0 * rRollAngleRad_TopBUR)
        + arrHarmonicCos_A[1, 4] * COS(4.0 * rRollAngleRad_TopBUR) + arrHarmonicSin_B[1, 4] * SIN(4.0 * rRollAngleRad_TopBUR);

    (* Bottom Backup Roll Harmonics *)
    rEstimatedEccForceDS_kN := rEstimatedEccForceDS_kN 
        + arrHarmonicCos_A[2, 1] * COS(1.0 * rRollAngleRad_BotBUR) + arrHarmonicSin_B[2, 1] * SIN(1.0 * rRollAngleRad_BotBUR)
        + arrHarmonicCos_A[2, 2] * COS(2.0 * rRollAngleRad_BotBUR) + arrHarmonicSin_B[2, 2] * SIN(2.0 * rRollAngleRad_BotBUR)
        + arrHarmonicCos_A[2, 3] * COS(3.0 * rRollAngleRad_BotBUR) + arrHarmonicSin_B[2, 3] * SIN(3.0 * rRollAngleRad_BotBUR)
        + arrHarmonicCos_A[2, 4] * COS(4.0 * rRollAngleRad_BotBUR) + arrHarmonicSin_B[2, 4] * SIN(4.0 * rRollAngleRad_BotBUR);

    (* Top Work Roll Harmonics *)
    rEstimatedEccForceDS_kN := rEstimatedEccForceDS_kN 
        + arrHarmonicCos_A[3, 1] * COS(1.0 * rRollAngleRad_TopWR)  + arrHarmonicSin_B[3, 1] * SIN(1.0 * rRollAngleRad_TopWR)
        + arrHarmonicCos_A[3, 2] * COS(2.0 * rRollAngleRad_TopWR)  + arrHarmonicSin_B[3, 2] * SIN(2.0 * rRollAngleRad_TopWR);

    (* Bottom Work Roll Harmonics *)
    rEstimatedEccForceDS_kN := rEstimatedEccForceDS_kN 
        + arrHarmonicCos_A[4, 1] * COS(1.0 * rRollAngleRad_BotWR)  + arrHarmonicSin_B[4, 1] * SIN(1.0 * rRollAngleRad_BotWR)
        + arrHarmonicCos_A[4, 2] * COS(2.0 * rRollAngleRad_BotWR)  + arrHarmonicSin_B[4, 2] * SIN(2.0 * rRollAngleRad_BotWR);

    rEstimatedEccForceOS_kN := rEstimatedEccForceDS_kN * 0.985;

    IF iState = 50 THEN
        arrHarmonicCos_A[1, 1] := arrHarmonicCos_A[1, 1] + rRLS_LearningGain * (rVotedForce_DS_kN - rEstimatedEccForceDS_kN) * COS(1.0 * rRollAngleRad_TopBUR);
        arrHarmonicSin_B[1, 1] := arrHarmonicSin_B[1, 1] + rRLS_LearningGain * (rVotedForce_DS_kN - rEstimatedEccForceDS_kN) * SIN(1.0 * rRollAngleRad_TopBUR);
        arrHarmonicCos_A[1, 2] := arrHarmonicCos_A[1, 2] + rRLS_LearningGain * (rVotedForce_DS_kN - rEstimatedEccForceDS_kN) * COS(2.0 * rRollAngleRad_TopBUR);
        arrHarmonicSin_B[1, 2] := arrHarmonicSin_B[1, 2] + rRLS_LearningGain * (rVotedForce_DS_kN - rEstimatedEccForceDS_kN) * SIN(2.0 * rRollAngleRad_TopBUR);

        arrHarmonicCos_A[2, 1] := arrHarmonicCos_A[2, 1] + rRLS_LearningGain * (rVotedForce_DS_kN - rEstimatedEccForceDS_kN) * COS(1.0 * rRollAngleRad_BotBUR);
        arrHarmonicSin_B[2, 1] := arrHarmonicSin_B[2, 1] + rRLS_LearningGain * (rVotedForce_DS_kN - rEstimatedEccForceDS_kN) * SIN(1.0 * rRollAngleRad_BotBUR);
        arrHarmonicCos_A[2, 2] := arrHarmonicCos_A[2, 2] + rRLS_LearningGain * (rVotedForce_DS_kN - rEstimatedEccForceDS_kN) * COS(2.0 * rRollAngleRad_BotBUR);
        arrHarmonicSin_B[2, 2] := arrHarmonicSin_B[2, 2] + rRLS_LearningGain * (rVotedForce_DS_kN - rEstimatedEccForceDS_kN) * SIN(2.0 * rRollAngleRad_BotBUR);
    END_IF;

    rEccentricityComp_DS_mm := -1.0 * (rEstimatedEccForceDS_kN / c_rMillModulus_kN_per_mm) * rEccentricityCompGain;
    rEccentricityComp_OS_mm := -1.0 * (rEstimatedEccForceOS_kN / c_rMillModulus_kN_per_mm) * rEccentricityCompGain;

    IF rEccentricityComp_DS_mm > 0.35 THEN rEccentricityComp_DS_mm := 0.35; END_IF;
    IF rEccentricityComp_DS_mm < -0.35 THEN rEccentricityComp_DS_mm := -0.35; END_IF;
    IF rEccentricityComp_OS_mm > 0.35 THEN rEccentricityComp_OS_mm := 0.35; END_IF;
    IF rEccentricityComp_OS_mm < -0.35 THEN rEccentricityComp_OS_mm := -0.35; END_IF;
ELSE
    rEccentricityComp_DS_mm := 0.0;
    rEccentricityComp_OS_mm := 0.0;
END_IF;

(* ====================================================================================================================
   SECTION 5: MODEL PREDICTIVE CONTROL (MPC) STATE-SPACE ENGINE & PROJECTED GRADIENT SOLVER
   ==================================================================================================================== *)
IF NOT bMPC_MatricesInitialized THEN
    matA[1,1] := 0.965;  matA[1,2] := 0.000;  matA[1,3] := 0.000;  matA[1,4] := 0.00012; matA[1,5] := 0.000;   matA[1,6] := 0.000;
    matA[2,1] := 0.000;  matA[2,2] := 0.940;  matA[2,3] := 0.000;  matA[2,4] := 0.000;   matA[2,5] := 0.00185; matA[2,6] := 0.000;
    matA[3,1] := 0.000;  matA[3,2] := 0.000;  matA[3,3] := 0.925;  matA[3,4] := 0.000;   matA[3,5] := 0.000;   matA[3,6] := 0.0042;
    matA[4,1] := -15.2;  matA[4,2] := 0.000;  matA[4,3] := 0.000;  matA[4,4] := 0.880;   matA[4,5] := 0.000;   matA[4,6] := 0.000;
    matA[5,1] := 0.000;  matA[5,2] := -2.40;  matA[5,3] := 0.000;  matA[5,4] := 0.000;   matA[5,5] := 0.850;   matA[5,6] := 0.000;
    matA[6,1] := 0.000;  matA[6,2] := 0.000;  matA[6,3] := -1.15;  matA[6,4] := 0.000;   matA[6,5] := 0.000;   matA[6,6] := 0.910;

    matB[1,1] := -1.850; matB[1,2] := 0.000;  matB[1,3] := 0.0000; matB[1,4] := 0.0450;
    matB[2,1] := 0.000;  matB[2,2] := -4.250; matB[2,3] := 0.0000; matB[2,4] := 0.0000;
    matB[3,1] := 0.000;  matB[3,2] := 0.000;  matB[3,3] := 0.0820; matB[3,4] := 0.0000;
    matB[4,1] := 4250.0; matB[4,2] := 0.000;  matB[4,3] := 0.0000; matB[4,4] := -12.50;
    matB[5,1] := 0.000;  matB[5,2] := 2150.0; matB[5,3] := 0.0000; matB[5,4] := 0.0000;
    matB[6,1] := 0.000;  matB[6,2] := 0.000;  matB[6,3] := 0.8500; matB[6,4] := 0.0000;

    matC[1,1] := 1.0; matC[1,2] := 0.0; matC[1,3] := 0.0; matC[1,4] := 0.0; matC[1,5] := 0.0; matC[1,6] := 0.0;
    matC[2,1] := 0.0; matC[2,2] := 1.0; matC[2,3] := 0.0; matC[2,4] := 0.0; matC[2,5] := 0.0; matC[2,6] := 0.0;
    matC[3,1] := 0.0; matC[3,2] := 0.0; matC[3,3] := 1.0; matC[3,4] := 0.0; matC[3,5] := 0.0; matC[3,6] := 0.0;
    matC[4,1] := 0.0; matC[4,2] := 0.0; matC[4,3] := 0.0; matC[4,4] := 1.0; matC[4,5] := 0.0; matC[4,6] := 0.0;

    FOR iDiagnosticLoopIndex := 1 TO 4 DO
        matD[iDiagnosticLoopIndex, 1] := 0.0;
        matD[iDiagnosticLoopIndex, 2] := 0.0;
        matD[iDiagnosticLoopIndex, 3] := 0.0;
        matD[iDiagnosticLoopIndex, 4] := 0.0;
    END_FOR;

    vecCostWeight_Q[1] := 1250.0;
    vecCostWeight_Q[2] := 85.0;
    vecCostWeight_Q[3] := 120.0;
    vecCostWeight_Q[4] := 0.005;
    vecCostWeight_Q[5] := 0.020;
    vecCostWeight_Q[6] := 0.010;

    vecCostWeight_R[1] := 25.0;
    vecCostWeight_R[2] := 35.0;
    vecCostWeight_R[3] := 0.05;
    vecCostWeight_R[4] := 0.15;

    vecCostWeight_S[1] := 80.0;
    vecCostWeight_S[2] := 100.0;
    vecCostWeight_S[3] := 1.5;
    vecCostWeight_S[4] := 2.0;

    vecControlMin_u[1] := -0.80; vecControlMax_u[1] := 0.80;
    vecControlMin_u[2] := -0.40; vecControlMax_u[2] := 0.40;
    vecControlMin_u[3] := c_rMaxBendingForceNegative_kN; vecControlMax_u[3] := c_rMaxBendingForcePositive_kN;
    vecControlMin_u[4] := -25.0; vecControlMax_u[4] := 25.0;

    vecDeltaMax_du[1]  := 0.015;
    vecDeltaMax_du[2]  := 0.010;
    vecDeltaMax_du[3]  := 8.0;
    vecDeltaMax_du[4]  := 0.5;

    bMPC_MatricesInitialized := TRUE;
END_IF;

vecState_x[1] := rElongationError_pct;
vecState_x[2] := 0.0 - rFlatnessTilt_Iunit;
vecState_x[3] := 0.0 - rFlatnessCrown_Iunit;
vecState_x[4] := rTotalRollForceFeedback_kN - c_rKissPassCalibrationForce_kN * 5.0;
vecState_x[5] := rDifferentialForce_kN;
vecState_x[6] := rWorkRollBendingCmd_kN - rTargetBendingForce_kN;

IF (iState = 50 OR iState = 60) AND bEnable THEN
    FOR iDiagnosticLoopIndex := 1 TO iMPC_MaxIterations DO
        vecStateNext_x[1] := matA[1,1]*vecState_x[1] + matA[1,4]*vecState_x[4] + matB[1,1]*vecControl_u[1] + matB[1,4]*vecControl_u[4];
        vecStateNext_x[2] := matA[2,2]*vecState_x[2] + matA[2,5]*vecState_x[5] + matB[2,2]*vecControl_u[2];
        vecStateNext_x[3] := matA[3,3]*vecState_x[3] + matA[3,6]*vecState_x[6] + matB[3,3]*vecControl_u[3];
        vecStateNext_x[4] := matA[4,1]*vecState_x[1] + matA[4,4]*vecState_x[4] + matB[4,1]*vecControl_u[1] + matB[4,4]*vecControl_u[4];
        vecStateNext_x[5] := matA[5,2]*vecState_x[2] + matA[5,5]*vecState_x[5] + matB[5,2]*vecControl_u[2];
        vecStateNext_x[6] := matA[6,3]*vecState_x[3] + matA[6,6]*vecState_x[6] + matB[6,3]*vecControl_u[3];

        vecGradient_g[1] := matB[1,1] * vecCostWeight_Q[1] * vecStateNext_x[1] 
                          + matB[4,1] * vecCostWeight_Q[4] * vecStateNext_x[4] 
                          + vecCostWeight_R[1] * vecControl_u[1] 
                          + vecCostWeight_S[1] * (vecControl_u[1] - vecControlPrev_u[1]);

        vecGradient_g[2] := matB[2,2] * vecCostWeight_Q[2] * vecStateNext_x[2] 
                          + matB[5,2] * vecCostWeight_Q[5] * vecStateNext_x[5] 
                          + vecCostWeight_R[2] * vecControl_u[2] 
                          + vecCostWeight_S[2] * (vecControl_u[2] - vecControlPrev_u[2]);

        vecGradient_g[3] := matB[3,3] * vecCostWeight_Q[3] * vecStateNext_x[3] 
                          + matB[6,3] * vecCostWeight_Q[6] * vecStateNext_x[6] 
                          + vecCostWeight_R[3] * vecControl_u[3] 
                          + vecCostWeight_S[3] * (vecControl_u[3] - vecControlPrev_u[3]);

        vecGradient_g[4] := matB[1,4] * vecCostWeight_Q[1] * vecStateNext_x[1] 
                          + matB[4,4] * vecCostWeight_Q[4] * vecStateNext_x[4] 
                          + vecCostWeight_R[4] * vecControl_u[4] 
                          + vecCostWeight_S[4] * (vecControl_u[4] - vecControlPrev_u[4]);

        vecControl_u[1] := vecControl_u[1] - rMPC_StepSizeAlpha * vecGradient_g[1];
        vecControl_u[2] := vecControl_u[2] - rMPC_StepSizeAlpha * vecGradient_g[2];
        vecControl_u[3] := vecControl_u[3] - rMPC_StepSizeAlpha * vecGradient_g[3];
        vecControl_u[4] := vecControl_u[4] - rMPC_StepSizeAlpha * vecGradient_g[4];

        vecDeltaControl_du[1] := vecControl_u[1] - vecControlPrev_u[1];
        IF vecDeltaControl_du[1] > vecDeltaMax_du[1] THEN vecControl_u[1] := vecControlPrev_u[1] + vecDeltaMax_du[1]; END_IF;
        IF vecDeltaControl_du[1] < -vecDeltaMax_du[1] THEN vecControl_u[1] := vecControlPrev_u[1] - vecDeltaMax_du[1]; END_IF;

        vecDeltaControl_du[2] := vecControl_u[2] - vecControlPrev_u[2];
        IF vecDeltaControl_du[2] > vecDeltaMax_du[2] THEN vecControl_u[2] := vecControlPrev_u[2] + vecDeltaMax_du[2]; END_IF;
        IF vecDeltaControl_du[2] < -vecDeltaMax_du[2] THEN vecControl_u[2] := vecControlPrev_u[2] - vecDeltaMax_du[2]; END_IF;

        vecDeltaControl_du[3] := vecControl_u[3] - vecControlPrev_u[3];
        IF vecDeltaControl_du[3] > vecDeltaMax_du[3] THEN vecControl_u[3] := vecControlPrev_u[3] + vecDeltaMax_du[3]; END_IF;
        IF vecDeltaControl_du[3] < -vecDeltaMax_du[3] THEN vecControl_u[3] := vecControlPrev_u[3] - vecDeltaMax_du[3]; END_IF;

        IF vecControl_u[1] < vecControlMin_u[1] THEN vecControl_u[1] := vecControlMin_u[1]; END_IF;
        IF vecControl_u[1] > vecControlMax_u[1] THEN vecControl_u[1] := vecControlMax_u[1]; END_IF;

        IF vecControl_u[2] < vecControlMin_u[2] THEN vecControl_u[2] := vecControlMin_u[2]; END_IF;
        IF vecControl_u[2] > vecControlMax_u[2] THEN vecControl_u[2] := vecControlMax_u[2]; END_IF;

        IF vecControl_u[3] < vecControlMin_u[3] THEN vecControl_u[3] := vecControlMin_u[3]; END_IF;
        IF vecControl_u[3] > vecControlMax_u[3] THEN vecControl_u[3] := vecControlMax_u[3]; END_IF;
    END_FOR;
    
    vecControlPrev_u[1] := vecControl_u[1];
    vecControlPrev_u[2] := vecControl_u[2];
    vecControlPrev_u[3] := vecControl_u[3];
    vecControlPrev_u[4] := vecControl_u[4];
ELSE
    vecControl_u[1] := 0.0;
    vecControl_u[2] := 0.0;
    vecControl_u[3] := 0.0;
    vecControl_u[4] := 0.0;
    vecControlPrev_u[1] := 0.0;
    vecControlPrev_u[2] := 0.0;
    vecControlPrev_u[3] := 0.0;
    vecControlPrev_u[4] := 0.0;
END_IF;

(* ====================================================================================================================
   SECTION 6: MULTI-STAGE FINITE STATE MACHINE (CASE iState OF)
   ==================================================================================================================== *)
CASE iState OF
    0: (* ---------------- STATE 0: STANDBY & SYSTEM INITIALIZATION ---------------- *)
        bSystemReady            := FALSE;
        bControlActive          := FALSE;
        bDegradedMode           := FALSE;
        bSystemAlarm            := FALSE;
        wFaultCode              := 16#0000;
        rServoCmdGap_DS_mm      := rBaseGapPosition_DS_mm;
        rServoCmdGap_OS_mm      := rBaseGapPosition_OS_mm;

(*
========================================================================================================================
SECTION 1: HARDWIRED SAFETY INTERLOCKS & PRIMARY STATUS PRE-PROCESSING
========================================================================================================================
The Cryostat Safety Matrix coordinates SIL-3 hardwired cryogenic dump valves, vacuum rupture discs,
and superconducting magnet/cavity fast energy extraction systems.
*)
IF NOT bEmergencyStop OR NOT bSystemEnable THEN
    // Immediate de-energization to intrinsically safe shutdown configuration
    rJTOpeningPercent                   := 0.0;
    rVacuumPumpingSpeedCmd_rpm          := 0.0;
    rFountainPumpHeaterPwr_W            := 0.0;
    bSuperfluidRegimeActive             := FALSE;
    bLambdaTransitionComplete           := FALSE;
    bThermalRunawayQuenchRisk           := FALSE;
    bCryostatSafetyInterlockTripped     := TRUE;
    
    // Set status word to Safety Trip State (Bit 0)
    wCryostatStatusWord                 := 16#0001;
    wAlarmVectorHigh                    := wAlarmVectorHigh OR 16#00000001; // Bit 0: Emergency Stop Tripped
    
    iOperatingState                     := 99; // Transition directly to Cryogenic Quench / Safe Shutdown
    RETURN;
ELSE
    bCryostatSafetyInterlockTripped     := FALSE;
    wAlarmVectorHigh                    := wAlarmVectorHigh AND NOT 16#00000001;
END_IF;

// Manual alarm acknowledgment and latch reset handling
IF bResetAlarms THEN
    wAlarmVectorHigh                    := 16#00000000;
    wAlarmVectorLow                     := 16#00000000;
END_IF;

(*
========================================================================================================================
SECTION 2: TRIPLE MODULAR REDUNDANCY (2oo3) VOTING FOR TEMPERATURE & PRESSURE
========================================================================================================================
Dynamic Excitation Joule Self-Heating Correction:
  At sub-lambda temperatures (T < 2.1768 K), even microwatt electrical power dissipated in the Cernox RTD
  generates a thermal gradient across the Kapitza boundary resistance R_K:
    Delta_T_self_heating = (V_exc^2 / R_sensor) / (h_Kapitza * A_contact)
  Here calibrated: R_sensor ~ 3500 Ohm at 1.8 K, effective conductance alpha ~ 0.015 W/K.
*)
IF rSensorExcitationVolt_V > 0.0001 THEN
    rSelfHeatingCorr_T_A_K := (rSensorExcitationVolt_V * rSensorExcitationVolt_V / 3500.0) / 0.015;
    rSelfHeatingCorr_T_B_K := (rSensorExcitationVolt_V * rSensorExcitationVolt_V / 3500.0) / 0.015;
    rSelfHeatingCorr_T_C_K := (rSensorExcitationVolt_V * rSensorExcitationVolt_V / 3500.0) / 0.015;
ELSE
    rSelfHeatingCorr_T_A_K := 0.0;
    rSelfHeatingCorr_T_B_K := 0.0;
    rSelfHeatingCorr_T_C_K := 0.0;
END_IF;

// Physical Bounds and Plausibility Validation for Cernox RTDs [1.0 K to 320.0 K]
bSensorValid_T_A := (rTempCernox_A_K >= 1.0) AND (rTempCernox_A_K <= 320.0);
bSensorValid_T_B := (rTempCernox_B_K >= 1.0) AND (rTempCernox_B_K <= 320.0);
bSensorValid_T_C := (rTempCernox_C_K >= 1.0) AND (rTempCernox_C_K <= 320.0);

// Physical Bounds and Plausibility Validation for Baratrons [0.01 mbar to 1200.0 mbar]
bSensorValid_P_A := (rPressureBaratron_A_mbar >= 0.01) AND (rPressureBaratron_A_mbar <= 1200.0);
bSensorValid_P_B := (rPressureBaratron_B_mbar >= 0.01) AND (rPressureBaratron_B_mbar <= 1200.0);
bSensorValid_P_C := (rPressureBaratron_C_mbar >= 0.01) AND (rPressureBaratron_C_mbar <= 1200.0);

// Pairwise Difference Evaluation for Discrepancy Diagnostics
rDelta_T_AB := ABS((rTempCernox_A_K - rSelfHeatingCorr_T_A_K) - (rTempCernox_B_K - rSelfHeatingCorr_T_B_K));
rDelta_T_BC := ABS((rTempCernox_B_K - rSelfHeatingCorr_T_B_K) - (rTempCernox_C_K - rSelfHeatingCorr_T_C_K));
rDelta_T_CA := ABS((rTempCernox_C_K - rSelfHeatingCorr_T_C_K) - (rTempCernox_A_K - rSelfHeatingCorr_T_A_K));

rDelta_P_AB := ABS(rPressureBaratron_A_mbar - rPressureBaratron_B_mbar);
rDelta_P_BC := ABS(rPressureBaratron_B_mbar - rPressureBaratron_C_mbar);
rDelta_P_CA := ABS(rPressureBaratron_C_mbar - rPressureBaratron_A_mbar);

// Temperature 2oo3 TMR Voting Algorithm & Graceful Degradation Logic
IF bSensorValid_T_A AND bSensorValid_T_B AND bSensorValid_T_C THEN
    iTMRMode_Temp := 3; // Fully Redundant 2oo3 Operation
    
    // Check if channel A drifted outside allowable envelope
    IF (rDelta_T_AB > rMaxAllowedDev_T_K) AND (rDelta_T_CA > rMaxAllowedDev_T_K) THEN
        rVotedBathTemp_K := ((rTempCernox_B_K - rSelfHeatingCorr_T_B_K) + (rTempCernox_C_K - rSelfHeatingCorr_T_C_K)) * 0.5;
        wAlarmVectorLow := wAlarmVectorLow OR 16#00000002; // Bit 1: Cernox Channel A Deviation
        IF iHealthCount_T_A > 0 THEN iHealthCount_T_A := iHealthCount_T_A - 1; END_IF;
    ELSIF (rDelta_T_AB > rMaxAllowedDev_T_K) AND (rDelta_T_BC > rMaxAllowedDev_T_K) THEN
        rVotedBathTemp_K := ((rTempCernox_A_K - rSelfHeatingCorr_T_A_K) + (rTempCernox_C_K - rSelfHeatingCorr_T_C_K)) * 0.5;
        wAlarmVectorLow := wAlarmVectorLow OR 16#00000004; // Bit 2: Cernox Channel B Deviation
        IF iHealthCount_T_B > 0 THEN iHealthCount_T_B := iHealthCount_T_B - 1; END_IF;
    ELSIF (rDelta_T_BC > rMaxAllowedDev_T_K) AND (rDelta_T_CA > rMaxAllowedDev_T_K) THEN
        rVotedBathTemp_K := ((rTempCernox_A_K - rSelfHeatingCorr_T_A_K) + (rTempCernox_B_K - rSelfHeatingCorr_T_B_K)) * 0.5;
        wAlarmVectorLow := wAlarmVectorLow OR 16#00000008; // Bit 3: Cernox Channel C Deviation
        IF iHealthCount_T_C > 0 THEN iHealthCount_T_C := iHealthCount_T_C - 1; END_IF;
    ELSE
        // Healthy 2oo3 Triplet: Select Median Sensor
        IF ((rTempCernox_A_K >= rTempCernox_B_K) AND (rTempCernox_A_K <= rTempCernox_C_K)) OR 
           ((rTempCernox_A_K <= rTempCernox_B_K) AND (rTempCernox_A_K >= rTempCernox_C_K)) THEN
            rVotedBathTemp_K := rTempCernox_A_K - rSelfHeatingCorr_T_A_K;
        ELSIF ((rTempCernox_B_K >= rTempCernox_A_K) AND (rTempCernox_B_K <= rTempCernox_C_K)) OR 
              ((rTempCernox_B_K <= rTempCernox_A_K) AND (rTempCernox_B_K >= rTempCernox_C_K)) THEN
            rVotedBathTemp_K := rTempCernox_B_K - rSelfHeatingCorr_T_B_K;
        ELSE
            rVotedBathTemp_K := rTempCernox_C_K - rSelfHeatingCorr_T_C_K;
        END_IF;
    END_IF;

ELSIF bSensorValid_T_A AND bSensorValid_T_B THEN
    iTMRMode_Temp := 2; // Degraded 1oo2 Mode (A + B)
    rVotedBathTemp_K := ((rTempCernox_A_K - rSelfHeatingCorr_T_A_K) + (rTempCernox_B_K - rSelfHeatingCorr_T_B_K)) * 0.5;
    wAlarmVectorLow := wAlarmVectorLow OR 16#00000010; // Bit 4: Temp TMR Degraded to 1oo2
ELSIF bSensorValid_T_B AND bSensorValid_T_C THEN
    iTMRMode_Temp := 2; // Degraded 1oo2 Mode (B + C)
    rVotedBathTemp_K := ((rTempCernox_B_K - rSelfHeatingCorr_T_B_K) + (rTempCernox_C_K - rSelfHeatingCorr_T_C_K)) * 0.5;
    wAlarmVectorLow := wAlarmVectorLow OR 16#00000010;
ELSIF bSensorValid_T_A AND bSensorValid_T_C THEN
    iTMRMode_Temp := 2; // Degraded 1oo2 Mode (A + C)
    rVotedBathTemp_K := ((rTempCernox_A_K - rSelfHeatingCorr_T_A_K) + (rTempCernox_C_K - rSelfHeatingCorr_T_C_K)) * 0.5;
    wAlarmVectorLow := wAlarmVectorLow OR 16#00000010;
ELSIF bSensorValid_T_A THEN
    iTMRMode_Temp := 1; // Simplex Fallback Mode (Channel A Only)
    rVotedBathTemp_K := rTempCernox_A_K - rSelfHeatingCorr_T_A_K;
    wAlarmVectorHigh := wAlarmVectorHigh OR 16#00000020; // Bit 5: Critical Temp Redundancy Lost
ELSIF bSensorValid_T_B THEN
    iTMRMode_Temp := 1; // Simplex Fallback Mode (Channel B Only)
    rVotedBathTemp_K := rTempCernox_B_K - rSelfHeatingCorr_T_B_K;
    wAlarmVectorHigh := wAlarmVectorHigh OR 16#00000020;
ELSIF bSensorValid_T_C THEN
    iTMRMode_Temp := 1; // Simplex Fallback Mode (Channel C Only)
    rVotedBathTemp_K := rTempCernox_C_K - rSelfHeatingCorr_T_C_K;
    wAlarmVectorHigh := wAlarmVectorHigh OR 16#00000020;
ELSE
    iTMRMode_Temp := 0; // Total Sensor Failure
    rVotedBathTemp_K := 4.200; // Fail-Safe Conservative Substitution
    wAlarmVectorHigh := wAlarmVectorHigh OR 16#00000040; // Bit 6: Total Temp Sensor Failure
END_IF;

// Pressure 2oo3 TMR Voting Algorithm & Graceful Degradation Logic
IF bSensorValid_P_A AND bSensorValid_P_B AND bSensorValid_P_C THEN
    iTMRMode_Press := 3; // Fully Redundant 2oo3 Operation
    
    IF (rDelta_P_AB > rMaxAllowedDev_P_mbar) AND (rDelta_P_CA > rMaxAllowedDev_P_mbar) THEN
        rVotedHeadPressure_mbar := (rPressureBaratron_B_mbar + rPressureBaratron_C_mbar) * 0.5;
        wAlarmVectorLow := wAlarmVectorLow OR 16#00000100; // Bit 8: Baratron Channel A Fault
        IF iHealthCount_P_A > 0 THEN iHealthCount_P_A := iHealthCount_P_A - 1; END_IF;
    ELSIF (rDelta_P_AB > rMaxAllowedDev_P_mbar) AND (rDelta_P_BC > rMaxAllowedDev_P_mbar) THEN
        rVotedHeadPressure_mbar := (rPressureBaratron_A_mbar + rPressureBaratron_C_mbar) * 0.5;
        wAlarmVectorLow := wAlarmVectorLow OR 16#00000200; // Bit 9: Baratron Channel B Fault
        IF iHealthCount_P_B > 0 THEN iHealthCount_P_B := iHealthCount_P_B - 1; END_IF;
    ELSIF (rDelta_P_BC > rMaxAllowedDev_P_mbar) AND (rDelta_P_CA > rMaxAllowedDev_P_mbar) THEN
        rVotedHeadPressure_mbar := (rPressureBaratron_A_mbar + rPressureBaratron_B_mbar) * 0.5;
        wAlarmVectorLow := wAlarmVectorLow OR 16#00000400; // Bit 10: Baratron Channel C Fault
        IF iHealthCount_P_C > 0 THEN iHealthCount_P_C := iHealthCount_P_C - 1; END_IF;
    ELSE
        // Healthy Median Selection
        IF ((rPressureBaratron_A_mbar >= rPressureBaratron_B_mbar) AND (rPressureBaratron_A_mbar <= rPressureBaratron_C_mbar)) OR 
           ((rPressureBaratron_A_mbar <= rPressureBaratron_B_mbar) AND (rPressureBaratron_A_mbar >= rPressureBaratron_C_mbar)) THEN
            rVotedHeadPressure_mbar := rPressureBaratron_A_mbar;
        ELSIF ((rPressureBaratron_B_mbar >= rPressureBaratron_A_mbar) AND (rPressureBaratron_B_mbar <= rPressureBaratron_C_mbar)) OR 
              ((rPressureBaratron_B_mbar <= rPressureBaratron_A_mbar) AND (rPressureBaratron_B_mbar >= rPressureBaratron_C_mbar)) THEN
            rVotedHeadPressure_mbar := rPressureBaratron_B_mbar;
        ELSE
            rVotedHeadPressure_mbar := rPressureBaratron_C_mbar;
        END_IF;
    END_IF;

ELSIF bSensorValid_P_A AND bSensorValid_P_B THEN
    iTMRMode_Press := 2; // Degraded 1oo2 Mode (A + B)
    rVotedHeadPressure_mbar := (rPressureBaratron_A_mbar + rPressureBaratron_B_mbar) * 0.5;
    wAlarmVectorLow := wAlarmVectorLow OR 16#00000800; // Bit 11: Pressure TMR Degraded
ELSIF bSensorValid_P_B AND bSensorValid_P_C THEN
    iTMRMode_Press := 2; // Degraded 1oo2 Mode (B + C)
    rVotedHeadPressure_mbar := (rPressureBaratron_B_mbar + rPressureBaratron_C_mbar) * 0.5;
    wAlarmVectorLow := wAlarmVectorLow OR 16#00000800;
ELSIF bSensorValid_P_A AND bSensorValid_P_C THEN
    iTMRMode_Press := 2; // Degraded 1oo2 Mode (A + C)
    rVotedHeadPressure_mbar := (rPressureBaratron_A_mbar + rPressureBaratron_C_mbar) * 0.5;
    wAlarmVectorLow := wAlarmVectorLow OR 16#00000800;
ELSIF bSensorValid_P_A THEN
    iTMRMode_Press := 1; // Simplex Fallback Mode (Channel A Only)
    rVotedHeadPressure_mbar := rPressureBaratron_A_mbar;
    wAlarmVectorHigh := wAlarmVectorHigh OR 16#00001000; // Bit 12: Critical Pressure Redundancy Lost
ELSIF bSensorValid_P_B THEN
    iTMRMode_Press := 1; // Simplex Fallback Mode (Channel B Only)
    rVotedHeadPressure_mbar := rPressureBaratron_B_mbar;
    wAlarmVectorHigh := wAlarmVectorHigh OR 16#00001000;
ELSIF bSensorValid_P_C THEN
    iTMRMode_Press := 1; // Simplex Fallback Mode (Channel C Only)
    rVotedHeadPressure_mbar := rPressureBaratron_C_mbar;
    wAlarmVectorHigh := wAlarmVectorHigh OR 16#00001000;
ELSE
    iTMRMode_Press := 0; // Total Pressure Sensor Failure
    rVotedHeadPressure_mbar := 1013.25; // Atmospheric Conservative Default
    wAlarmVectorHigh := wAlarmVectorHigh OR 16#00002000; // Bit 13: Total Pressure Sensor Failure
END_IF;

// Primary Signal Conditioning: Exponential Moving Average Filters & Numerical Derivatives
rFiltTemp_K := (rFilterAlpha_Fast * rVotedBathTemp_K) + ((1.0 - rFilterAlpha_Fast) * rFiltTemp_K);
rFiltPressure_mbar := (rFilterAlpha_Fast * rVotedHeadPressure_mbar) + ((1.0 - rFilterAlpha_Fast) * rFiltPressure_mbar);
rFiltMassFlow_gps := (rFilterAlpha_Slow * rMassFlowPumpingLine_gps) + ((1.0 - rFilterAlpha_Slow) * rFiltMassFlow_gps);
rFiltLevel_mm := (rFilterAlpha_Slow * rHeliumLiquidLevel_mm) + ((1.0 - rFilterAlpha_Slow) * rFiltLevel_mm);

rDerivativeTemp_K_s := (rFiltTemp_K - rPrevTemp_K) / c_SampleTime_s;
rDerivativePressure_mbar_s := (rFiltPressure_mbar - rPrevPressure_mbar) / c_SampleTime_s;

rPrevTemp_K := rFiltTemp_K;
rPrevPressure_mbar := rFiltPressure_mbar;

// Taconis Thermo-Acoustic Oscillation Detection in Cryogenic Sensing Taps
// Circular buffer statistical variance evaluation across last 16 cycles (0.80 s window)
aPressBuffer[iPressBufIdx] := rVotedHeadPressure_mbar;
iPressBufIdx := iPressBufIdx + 1;
IF iPressBufIdx > 16 THEN iPressBufIdx := 1; END_IF;

rPressAcousticMean := 0.0;
FOR iNode := 1 TO 16 DO
    rPressAcousticMean := rPressAcousticMean + aPressBuffer[iNode];
END_FOR;
rPressAcousticMean := rPressAcousticMean * 0.0625; // Divide by 16

rPressAcousticVariance := 0.0;
FOR iNode := 1 TO 16 DO
    rPressAcousticVariance := rPressAcousticVariance + ((aPressBuffer[iNode] - rPressAcousticMean) * (aPressBuffer[iNode] - rPressAcousticMean));
END_FOR;
rPressAcousticRMS := SQRT(rPressAcousticVariance * 0.0625);

IF rPressAcousticRMS > rTaconisAcousticThreshold_mbar THEN
    bTaconisOscillationDetected := TRUE;
    wAlarmVectorLow := wAlarmVectorLow OR 16#00040000; // Bit 18: Taconis Oscillation Detected
ELSE
    bTaconisOscillationDetected := FALSE;
    wAlarmVectorLow := wAlarmVectorLow AND NOT 16#00040000;
END_IF;

(*
========================================================================================================================
SECTION 3: THERMODYNAMIC He-4 PROPERTY ENGINE & SUPERFLUID QUANTUM HYDRODYNAMICS
========================================================================================================================
ITS-90 He-4 Saturated Vapor Pressure Equation & Landau Two-Fluid Partitioning:
  Below T_lambda = 2.1768 K, normal fluid density decreases precipitously as T^5.6, leaving nearly 100% superfluid
  at T = 1.0 K.
*)
VAR_TEMP
    rTheoryP_sat            : REAL;
    rTempRatio              : REAL;
    rTempRatio5_6           : REAL;
    rDeltaT_node            : REAL;
    rNodeT                  : REAL;
    rNodeRatio              : REAL;
    rNodeRatio5_6           : REAL;
    rNodeEntropy            : REAL;
    rNodeDensity            : REAL;
END_VAR

IF rFiltTemp_K > 0.5 THEN
    // Sub-lambda saturation pressure calculation (ITS-90 polynomial fit)
    // Range 1.25 K <= T <= 2.1768 K:
    IF rFiltTemp_K <= c_T_lambda THEN
        // He-II cubic Taylor expansion around T = 1.800 K (P_sat = 16.380 mbar)
        rTheoryP_sat := 16.380 * (1.0 + 3.120 * (rFiltTemp_K - 1.800) + 
                                  3.850 * (rFiltTemp_K - 1.800) * (rFiltTemp_K - 1.800) + 
                                  2.100 * (rFiltTemp_K - 1.800) * (rFiltTemp_K - 1.800) * (rFiltTemp_K - 1.800));
    ELSE
        // Normal fluid He-I region expansion around T_lambda = 2.1768 K (P_sat = 50.418 mbar)
        rTheoryP_sat := 50.418 * (1.0 + 2.850 * (rFiltTemp_K - c_T_lambda) + 
                                  1.950 * (rFiltTemp_K - c_T_lambda) * (rFiltTemp_K - c_T_lambda) + 
                                  0.420 * (rFiltTemp_K - c_T_lambda) * (rFiltTemp_K - c_T_lambda) * (rFiltTemp_K - c_T_lambda));
    END_IF;
    
    rSatPressureEquilibriumErr_mbar := rFiltPressure_mbar - rTheoryP_sat;
ELSE
    rTheoryP_sat := 16.380;
    rSatPressureEquilibriumErr_mbar := 0.0;
END_IF;

// Tisza-Landau Two-Fluid Hydrodynamic Model Calculations (for T < T_lambda)
IF rFiltTemp_K < c_T_lambda THEN
    bSuperfluidRegimeActive := TRUE;
    rTempRatio := rFiltTemp_K / c_T_lambda;
    
    // (T / T_lambda)^5.6 evaluation via power decomposition: x^5.6 = x^5 * (0.4 + 0.6 * x)
    rTempRatio5_6 := (rTempRatio * rTempRatio * rTempRatio * rTempRatio * rTempRatio) * (0.4 + 0.6 * rTempRatio);
    IF rTempRatio5_6 > 1.0 THEN
        rTempRatio5_6 := 1.0;
    END_IF;
    
    // Superfluid and Normal fluid fractions and densities
    rHeII_SuperfluidFraction_pct := (1.0 - rTempRatio5_6) * 100.0;
    rSuperfluidDensity_g_cm3     := c_Density_HeII * (1.0 - rTempRatio5_6);
    rNormalFluidDensity_g_cm3    := c_Density_HeII * rTempRatio5_6;
    
    // Helium-II Specific Entropy: s(T) ~ s_lambda * (T/T_lambda)^5.6 [J/(g*K)]
    rEntropy_s_J_gK := 1.55 * rTempRatio5_6;
    
    // London Thermomechanical Fountain Pressure Integral:
    // Delta_P_F = Integral_{T_target}^{T_actual} [ rho * s(T) ] dT
    // Evaluated via 5-Point Composite Simpson Numerical Quadrature:
    rFountainTempDifference_K := rFiltTemp_K - rTargetTempSetpoint_K;
    rDeltaT_node := rFountainTempDifference_K * 0.25;
    
    FOR iNode := 1 TO 5 DO
        rNodeT := rTargetTempSetpoint_K + (INT_TO_REAL(iNode - 1) * rDeltaT_node);
        IF rNodeT < 0.5 THEN rNodeT := 0.5; ELSIF rNodeT > c_T_lambda THEN rNodeT := c_T_lambda; END_IF;
        
        rNodeRatio := rNodeT / c_T_lambda;
        rNodeRatio5_6 := (rNodeRatio * rNodeRatio * rNodeRatio * rNodeRatio * rNodeRatio) * (0.4 + 0.6 * rNodeRatio);
        IF rNodeRatio5_6 > 1.0 THEN rNodeRatio5_6 := 1.0; END_IF;
        
        aQuadNodeEntropy[iNode] := 1.55 * rNodeRatio5_6; // [J/(g*K)]
        aQuadNodeDensity[iNode] := c_Density_HeII * 1000.0; // [kg/m3]
    END_FOR;
    
    // Composite Simpson's 1/3 Rule: Integral = (h/3) * (f0 + 4*f1 + 2*f2 + 4*f3 + f4)
    // Unit conversion: 1 Pa = 0.01 mbar; rho [kg/m3] * s [J/(kg*K)] = [Pa/K]
    rQuadIntegralAcc := (rDeltaT_node / 3.0) * (
        (aQuadNodeDensity[1] * aQuadNodeEntropy[1] * 1000.0) + 
        (4.0 * aQuadNodeDensity[2] * aQuadNodeEntropy[2] * 1000.0) + 
        (2.0 * aQuadNodeDensity[3] * aQuadNodeEntropy[3] * 1000.0) + 
        (4.0 * aQuadNodeDensity[4] * aQuadNodeEntropy[4] * 1000.0) + 
        (aQuadNodeDensity[5] * aQuadNodeEntropy[5] * 1000.0)
    );
    rFountainPressureDiff_mbar := rQuadIntegralAcc * 0.01; // Convert Pa to mbar
    
    // Superfluid mass flow induced through porous superleak by fountain pressure (Darcy flow):
    // m_dot = rho_s * K_perm * A / L * Delta_P
    rLondonFountainMassFlow_gps := (rSuperfluidDensity_g_cm3 * c_SuperleakFlowArea_cm2 / c_SuperleakLength_cm) * 
                                  (rFountainPressureDiff_mbar * 0.125);

    // Gorter-Mellink Mutual Friction Thermal Transport Function:
    // f(T)^-1 = (rho_s^3 * s^4 * T^3) / (A_GM * rho_n)
    IF rNormalFluidDensity_g_cm3 > 0.0005 THEN
        rGorterMellink_f_inv := ((rSuperfluidDensity_g_cm3 * rSuperfluidDensity_g_cm3 * rSuperfluidDensity_g_cm3) * 
                                 (rEntropy_s_J_gK * rEntropy_s_J_gK * rEntropy_s_J_gK * rEntropy_s_J_gK) * 
                                 (rFiltTemp_K * rFiltTemp_K * rFiltTemp_K)) / 
                                (c_A_GM_FrictionConst * rNormalFluidDensity_g_cm3 * 1.0E-3);
    ELSE
        rGorterMellink_f_inv := 1.0E6; // Near zero normal fluid -> infinite Gorter-Mellink conductance
    END_IF;
    
    // Instantaneous Effective Thermal Conductance [W/K] for cryostat cooling duct:
    rGorterMellinkHeatConductance_W_K := (c_SuperleakFlowArea_cm2 / c_SuperleakLength_cm) * (rGorterMellink_f_inv * 0.085);
    
    // Bulk Apparent Thermal Conductivity [W/(m*K)]
    rObservedThermalConductivity_W_mK := rGorterMellinkHeatConductance_W_K * (c_SuperleakLength_cm * 0.01) / (c_SuperleakFlowArea_cm2 * 0.0001);
    
    // Feynman Quantum Vortex Tangle Line Density Estimation:
    // L_0 = gamma(T)^2 * (v_n - v_s - v_0)^2; here counterflow velocity is proportional to heat flux q:
    // v_counter = q / (rho_s * s * T)
    IF (rSuperfluidDensity_g_cm3 > 0.001) AND (rEntropy_s_J_gK > 0.001) THEN
        rCounterflowVelocity_cm_s := (rHeatFluxDensitySRF_W_cm2) / (rSuperfluidDensity_g_cm3 * rEntropy_s_J_gK * rFiltTemp_K);
        // Critical Feynman velocity for vortex creation: v_c = (kappa / (4*pi*d)) * ln(d / a0)
        rVortexCirculationThreshold := (c_QuantumCirculation_kappa / (4.0 * 3.14159 * c_SuperleakPoreDiameter_nm * 1.0E-9)) * 4.62;
        IF rCounterflowVelocity_cm_s > (rVortexCirculationThreshold * 100.0) THEN
            rVortexLineDensity_m2 := 1.45E8 * (rCounterflowVelocity_cm_s - (rVortexCirculationThreshold * 100.0)) * 
                                              (rCounterflowVelocity_cm_s - (rVortexCirculationThreshold * 100.0));
        ELSE
            rVortexLineDensity_m2 := 0.0;
        END_IF;
    ELSE
        rVortexLineDensity_m2 := 0.0;
    END_IF;

    // Equilibrium Latent Heat Evaporation Rate [g/s]
    rEvaporationBoiloffRate_gps := ((rHeatFluxDensitySRF_W_cm2 * 50.0) + (rFountainPumpHeaterPwr_W)) / c_LatentHeat_1K8;
    
    // Critical Heat Flux Margin Monitoring (Onset of Film Boiling at Nb Cavity Wall)
    IF c_CriticalHeatFlux_1K8_W_cm2 > 0.001 THEN
        rCriticalHeatFluxMargin_pct := (1.0 - (rHeatFluxDensitySRF_W_cm2 / c_CriticalHeatFlux_1K8_W_cm2)) * 100.0;
        IF rCriticalHeatFluxMargin_pct < 15.0 THEN
            bThermalRunawayQuenchRisk := TRUE;
            wAlarmVectorHigh := wAlarmVectorHigh OR 16#00010000; // Bit 16: SRF Thermal Quench Warning
        ELSE
            bThermalRunawayQuenchRisk := FALSE;
            wAlarmVectorHigh := wAlarmVectorHigh AND NOT 16#00010000;
        END_IF;
    END_IF;

ELSE
    // Normal Fluid He-I Regime (T >= T_lambda)
    bSuperfluidRegimeActive             := FALSE;
    rHeII_SuperfluidFraction_pct        := 0.0;
    rSuperfluidDensity_g_cm3            := 0.0;
    rNormalFluidDensity_g_cm3           := c_Density_HeI;
    rEntropy_s_J_gK                     := 1.65 + 1.20 * (rFiltTemp_K - c_T_lambda);
    rFountainPressureDiff_mbar          := 0.0; // Fountain effect nonexistent in He-I
    rLondonFountainMassFlow_gps         := 0.0;
    rGorterMellinkHeatConductance_W_K   := 0.15; // Low conventional thermal conduction
    rObservedThermalConductivity_W_mK   := 0.025; // Standard liquid helium-I conductivity
    rVortexLineDensity_m2               := 0.0;
    rEvaporationBoiloffRate_gps         := ((rHeatFluxDensitySRF_W_cm2 * 50.0) + 1.5) / c_LatentHeat_4K2;
    rCriticalHeatFluxMargin_pct         := 100.0;
    bThermalRunawayQuenchRisk           := FALSE;
END_IF;

// Lambda Transition Complete Verification Flag
bLambdaTransitionComplete := (rFiltTemp_K < (c_T_lambda - 0.015)) AND (rFiltPressure_mbar < (c_P_lambda - 1.50));

(*
========================================================================================================================
SECTION 4: 4x4 DISCRETE STATE-SPACE MODEL PREDICTOR & OBSERVER UPDATE
========================================================================================================================
Linearized State-Space System Matrices:
  x(k+1) = A * x(k) + B * u(k) + E * w(k)
  y(k)   = C * x(k) + D * u(k)
States:
  x[1] = delta_T_bath      (rFiltTemp_K - rTargetTempSetpoint_K)           [K]
  x[2] = delta_P_vapor     (rFiltPressure_mbar - c_P_nominal_superfluid)   [mbar]
  x[3] = delta_Level       (rFiltLevel_mm - rTargetBathLevel_mm)           [mm]
  x[4] = delta_MassFlow    (rFiltMassFlow_gps - rTargetMassFlow_gps)       [g/s]
Controls:
  u[1] = delta_JT_opening  (rJTOpeningPercent - 25.0)                      [%]
  u[2] = delta_Blower_rpm  (rVacuumPumpingSpeedCmd_rpm - 3600.0)           [rpm]
  u[3] = delta_FountainPwr (rFountainPumpHeaterPwr_W - 5.0)                [W]
Disturbances:
  w[1] = rHeatFluxDensitySRF_W_cm2 * 25.0                                  [W]
  w[2] = 1.25 (Cryostat static radiation and conduction heat leak)        [W]
*)
aState_x[1] := rFiltTemp_K - rTargetTempSetpoint_K;
aState_x[2] := rFiltPressure_mbar - c_P_nominal_superfluid;
aState_x[3] := rFiltLevel_mm - rTargetBathLevel_mm;
aState_x[4] := rFiltMassFlow_gps - rTargetMassFlow_gps;

aState_x_ref[1] := 0.0;
aState_x_ref[2] := 0.0;
aState_x_ref[3] := 0.0;
aState_x_ref[4] := 0.0;

aDisturbance_w[1] := rHeatFluxDensitySRF_W_cm2 * 25.0;
aDisturbance_w[2] := 1.25;

aControl_u[1] := rJTOpeningPercent - 25.0;
aControl_u[2] := rVacuumPumpingSpeedCmd_rpm - 3600.0;
aControl_u[3] := rFountainPumpHeaterPwr_W - 5.0;

// One-Step-Ahead State Prediction: x_pred = A * x + B * u + E * w
FOR iRow := 1 TO 4 DO
    aState_x_pred[iRow] := 0.0;
    
    FOR iCol := 1 TO 4 DO
        aState_x_pred[iRow] := aState_x_pred[iRow] + (aMatrix_A[iRow, iCol] * aState_x[iCol]);
    END_FOR;
    
    FOR iCol := 1 TO 3 DO
        aState_x_pred[iRow] := aState_x_pred[iRow] + (aMatrix_B[iRow, iCol] * aControl_u[iCol]);
    END_FOR;
    
    FOR iCol := 1 TO 2 DO
        aState_x_pred[iRow] := aState_x_pred[iRow] + (aMatrix_E[iRow, iCol] * aDisturbance_w[iCol]);
    END_FOR;
END_FOR;

// Compute Tracking Error Vector
FOR iRow := 1 TO 4 DO
    aState_error[iRow] := aState_x[iRow] - aState_x_ref[iRow];
END_FOR;

(*
========================================================================================================================
SECTION 5: CONSTRAINED MPC QUADRATIC PROGRAMMING OPTIMIZER (EXPLICIT 3x3 HESSIAN INVERSION)
========================================================================================================================
Cost Function:
  J(u) = (x_pred - x_ref)^T * Q * (x_pred - x_ref) + delta_u^T * R * delta_u + (u - u_nominal)^T * R_rate * (u - u_nominal)

Analytical 3x3 Hessian Matrix Construction:
  H = 2.0 * [ B^T * Q * B + diag(R) + diag(R_rate) ]
*)
VAR_TEMP
    rDeltaJTMax         : REAL;
    rDeltaBlowerMax     : REAL;
    rDeltaHeaterMax     : REAL;
    rH11                : REAL;
    rH12                : REAL;
    rH13                : REAL;
    rH21                : REAL;
    rH22                : REAL;
    rH23                : REAL;
    rH31                : REAL;
    rH32                : REAL;
    rH33                : REAL;
END_VAR

// Assemble Full 3x3 Symmetric Hessian Matrix
FOR iRow := 1 TO 3 DO
    FOR iCol := 1 TO 3 DO
        aHessian_H[iRow, iCol] := 2.0 * (
            (aMatrix_B[1, iRow] * aMatrix_B[1, iCol] * aWeight_Q[1]) + 
            (aMatrix_B[2, iRow] * aMatrix_B[2, iCol] * aWeight_Q[2]) + 
            (aMatrix_B[3, iRow] * aMatrix_B[3, iCol] * aWeight_Q[3]) + 
            (aMatrix_B[4, iRow] * aMatrix_B[4, iCol] * aWeight_Q[4])
        );
        IF iRow = iCol THEN
            aHessian_H[iRow, iCol] := aHessian_H[iRow, iCol] + (2.0 * (aWeight_R[iRow] + aWeight_R_rate[iRow]));
        END_IF;
    END_FOR;
END_FOR;

// Compute Gradient Vector g = 2.0 * B^T * Q * error + 2.0 * diag(R) * u
FOR iCol := 1 TO 3 DO
    aGradient_g[iCol] := 0.0;
    FOR iRow := 1 TO 4 DO
        aGradient_g[iCol] := aGradient_g[iCol] + (2.0 * aMatrix_B[iRow, iCol] * aWeight_Q[iRow] * aState_error[iRow]);
    END_FOR;
    aGradient_g[iCol] := aGradient_g[iCol] + (2.0 * aWeight_R[iCol] * aControl_u[iCol]);
END_FOR;

// Exact Analytical Determinant of 3x3 Hessian Matrix
rH11 := aHessian_H[1, 1]; rH12 := aHessian_H[1, 2]; rH13 := aHessian_H[1, 3];
rH21 := aHessian_H[2, 1]; rH22 := aHessian_H[2, 2]; rH23 := aHessian_H[2, 3];
rH31 := aHessian_H[3, 1]; rH32 := aHessian_H[3, 2]; rH33 := aHessian_H[3, 3];

rDetHessian := (rH11 * (rH22 * rH33 - rH23 * rH32)) - 
               (rH12 * (rH21 * rH33 - rH23 * rH31)) + 
               (rH13 * (rH21 * rH32 - rH22 * rH31));

// Compute Inverse Hessian Matrix using Classical Adjugate Method
IF ABS(rDetHessian) > 1.0E-9 THEN
    aHessian_inv[1, 1] :=  (rH22 * rH33 - rH23 * rH32) / rDetHessian;
    aHessian_inv[1, 2] := -(rH12 * rH33 - rH13 * rH32) / rDetHessian;
    aHessian_inv[1, 3] :=  (rH12 * rH23 - rH13 * rH22) / rDetHessian;

    aHessian_inv[2, 1] := -(rH21 * rH33 - rH23 * rH31) / rDetHessian;
    aHessian_inv[2, 2] :=  (rH11 * rH33 - rH13 * rH31) / rDetHessian;
    aHessian_inv[2, 3] := -(rH11 * rH23 - rH13 * rH21) / rDetHessian;

    aHessian_inv[3, 1] :=  (rH21 * rH32 - rH22 * rH31) / rDetHessian;
    aHessian_inv[3, 2] := -(rH11 * rH32 - rH12 * rH31) / rDetHessian;
    aHessian_inv[3, 3] :=  (rH11 * rH22 - rH12 * rH21) / rDetHessian;

    // Unconstrained Optimal Newton Step: delta_u_opt = - H^-1 * g
    FOR iRow := 1 TO 3 DO
        aDelta_u_unconstrained[iRow] := -(
            (aHessian_inv[iRow, 1] * aGradient_g[1]) + 
            (aHessian_inv[iRow, 2] * aGradient_g[2]) + 
            (aHessian_inv[iRow, 3] * aGradient_g[3])
        );
    END_FOR;
ELSE
    // Determinant singularity fallback: Simple diagonal decoupled descent
    aDelta_u_unconstrained[1] := -aGradient_g[1] / (rH11 + 0.1);
    aDelta_u_unconstrained[2] := -aGradient_g[2] / (rH22 + 0.001);
    aDelta_u_unconstrained[3] := -aGradient_g[3] / (rH33 + 0.1);
END_IF;

// Active Set Projection onto Physical Actuator Rate Limits
rDeltaJTMax := rSlewLimit_JT_pct_s * c_SampleTime_s;
rDeltaBlowerMax := rSlewLimit_Blower_rpm_s * c_SampleTime_s;
rDeltaHeaterMax := rSlewLimit_Heater_W_s * c_SampleTime_s;

// Input 1 Clamping (Joule-Thomson Valve Throttling)
IF aDelta_u_unconstrained[1] > rDeltaJTMax THEN
    aDelta_u_opt[1] := rDeltaJTMax;
ELSIF aDelta_u_unconstrained[1] < -rDeltaJTMax THEN
    aDelta_u_opt[1] := -rDeltaJTMax;
ELSE
    aDelta_u_opt[1] := aDelta_u_unconstrained[1];
END_IF;

// Input 2 Clamping (Cold Vacuum Roots Blower VFD Speed)
IF aDelta_u_unconstrained[2] > rDeltaBlowerMax THEN
    aDelta_u_opt[2] := rDeltaBlowerMax;
ELSIF aDelta_u_unconstrained[2] < -rDeltaBlowerMax THEN
    aDelta_u_opt[2] := -rDeltaBlowerMax;
ELSE
    aDelta_u_opt[2] := aDelta_u_unconstrained[2];
END_IF;

// Input 3 Clamping (London Thermomechanical Fountain Heater Power)
IF aDelta_u_unconstrained[3] > rDeltaHeaterMax THEN
    aDelta_u_opt[3] := rDeltaHeaterMax;
ELSIF aDelta_u_unconstrained[3] < -rDeltaHeaterMax THEN
    aDelta_u_opt[3] := -rDeltaHeaterMax;
ELSE
    aDelta_u_opt[3] := aDelta_u_unconstrained[3];
END_IF;

(*
========================================================================================================================
SECTION 6: SUPERVISORY FINITE STATE MACHINE (SFSM) - 11 THERMODYNAMIC STAGES
========================================================================================================================
Cryostat Operating Sequence:
   0: COLD_IDLE_SELFTEST_STANDBY
  10: LHE4_SUPERCRITICAL_FILL_AND_PURGE (300 K -> 4.2 K)
  20: EQUILIBRATION_4K2_BATH_SVP_REFERENCE
  30: VACUUM_ROOSTER_PUMP_CASCADE_CHILLDOWN
  40: CONTROLLED_SUB_MILLIBAR_PUMPDOWN_APPROACH (4.2 K -> 2.30 K)
  50: PRE_LAMBDA_EXPANSION_CRITICAL_DECELERATION (2.30 K -> 2.18 K)
  60: LAMBDA_TRANSITION_CROSSING_SINGULARITY_WINDOW (2.18 K -> 2.16 K)
  70: SUPERFLUID_HE_II_1K8_STEADY_STATE_REGIME (1.800 K +/- 0.5 mK)
  80: SUPERCONDUCTING_RF_CAVITY_HEAT_LOAD_FEEDFORWARD
  90: CONTROLLED_THERMAL_RECUPERATION_AND_WARMUP
  99: CRYOGENIC_QUENCH_RELIEF_EMERGENCY_DEGRADATION
*)
// Maintain state dwell timer
tStateTimer(IN := (iOperatingState = iPreviousState), PT := T#86400S);
IF iOperatingState <> iPreviousState THEN
    iPreviousState := iOperatingState;
    bStateFirstScan := TRUE;
    rStateTimeSeconds := 0.0;
ELSE
    bStateFirstScan := FALSE;
    rStateTimeSeconds := TIME_TO_REAL(tStateTimer.ET) * 0.001;
END_IF;

CASE iOperatingState OF

    (* -------------------------------------------------------------------------
       STATE 0: COLD IDLE SELF TEST & SYSTEM STANDBY
       ------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
    0:
        wCryostatStatusWord := 16#0000;
        rJTOpeningPercent := 0.0;
        rVacuumPumpingSpeedCmd_rpm := 0.0;
        rFountainPumpHeaterPwr_W := 0.0;
        
        // Permissive self-test evaluation: sensor bridge health check
        IF bSystemEnable AND (iTMRMode_Temp >= 2) AND (iTMRMode_Press >= 2) THEN
            IF rFiltTemp_K > 77.0 THEN
                iOperatingState := 10; // Warm cryostat: Precool and transfer fill required
            ELSIF rFiltTemp_K <= 4.5 THEN
                iOperatingState := 20; // Cold bath already full: Proceed to equilibration
            ELSE
                iOperatingState := 10;
            END_IF;
        END_IF;

    (* -------------------------------------------------------------------------
       STATE 10: LIQUID HELIUM-4 TRANSFER & CAVITY PRECOOL (4.2 K, 1013 mbar)
       ------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
    10:
        wCryostatStatusWord := 16#0010;
        // Thermal stress mitigation: regulate cooldown rate < 15 K/hour on high-purity SRF Niobium
        IF rDerivativeTemp_K_s < -0.00416 THEN // Exceeds 15 K/hr limit
            rJTOpeningPercent := rJTOpeningPercent - (0.5 * c_SampleTime_s);
        ELSE

    rArmCurrent_Lower_kA            : REAL;     (* Instantaneous phase lower arm current measurement [kA] (-5.0 .. 5.0) *)

    (* --- Submodule Capacitor Voltage Statistics from Fast VCU Bus --- *)
    rSubmoduleCapVolt_Nom_V         : REAL;     (* Nominal submodule capacitor target voltage [V] (e.g. 2500.0) *)
    rSubmoduleCapVolt_Mean_V        : REAL;     (* Real-time mean capacitor voltage across active submodules [V] (1800 .. 3200) *)
    rSubmoduleCapVolt_Max_V         : REAL;     (* Maximum measured capacitor voltage in phase arm submodules [V] *)
    rSubmoduleCapVolt_Min_V         : REAL;     (* Minimum measured capacitor voltage in phase arm submodules [V] *)

    (* --- Submodule Hardware Health & Valve Hall Status --- *)
    iActiveSubmoduleCount_Upper     : INT;      (* Active online non-bypassed submodules in upper arm (nominal 200 .. 216) *)
    iActiveSubmoduleCount_Lower     : INT;      (* Active online non-bypassed submodules in lower arm (nominal 200 .. 216) *)
    rAmbientValveHallTemp_DegC      : REAL;     (* Valve hall ambient HVAC / cooling liquid inlet temperature [deg C] *)
    bValveHallGroundFaultTripped    : BOOL;     (* Valve hall ground fault detection relay status [TRUE=Fault] *)
END_VAR

VAR_OUTPUT
    (* --- Converter Arm Control Readiness & Operational Status --- *)
    bSystemReady                    : BOOL;     (* Overall MMC valve arm controller operational readiness status *)
    bDegradedRedundancyActive       : BOOL;     (* Operating in degraded redundancy mode due to bypassed submodules *)
    bCircSuppressionActive          : BOOL;     (* Circulating current suppression controller actively driving differential ref *)

    (* --- Voltage Reference Commands to Firing Generator / NLC Modulator --- *)
    rVdiff_CircRef_Upper_kV         : REAL;     (* Synthesized upper arm differential compensating voltage reference [kV] *)
    rVdiff_CircRef_Lower_kV         : REAL;     (* Synthesized lower arm differential compensating voltage reference [kV] *)
    rVarm_Upper_Command_kV          : REAL;     (* Total synthesized upper arm voltage reference [kV] (0.0 .. Vdc) *)
    rVarm_Lower_Command_kV          : REAL;     (* Total synthesized lower arm voltage reference [kV] (0.0 .. Vdc) *)

    (* --- Real-Time Performance & Balancing Telemetry --- *)
    rCirculatingCurrent_kA          : REAL;     (* Filtered 2nd-harmonic circulating current magnitude [kA] *)
    rCapacitorVoltageSpread_V       : REAL;     (* Submodule capacitor voltage spread (Vmax - Vmin) [V] *)
    rMpcOptimizationCost            : REAL;     (* Real-time evaluated MPC quadratic cost function value J [dimensionless] *)
    rPowerDeratingFactor            : REAL;     (* Dynamic converter active power dispatch rating factor [0.0 .. 1.0] *)

    (* --- Submodule Insertion Count Commands --- *)
    iNumSubmodulesToInsert_Upper    : INT;      (* Number of submodules to be inserted in upper arm (0 .. N_active) *)
    iNumSubmodulesToInsert_Lower    : INT;      (* Number of submodules to be inserted in lower arm (0 .. N_active) *)

    (* --- Validated Process Values & Diagnostic Registers --- *)
    rVdc_Voted_kV                   : REAL;     (* Validated 2oo3 TMR resolved DC link pole-to-pole voltage [kV] *)
    wAlarmWord                      : WORD;     (* ISA-18.2 packed alarm register (Bit0=Trip, Bit1=OverV, Bit2=TMR, etc.) *)
    wSystemStatusWord               : WORD;     (* Diagnostic and state machine status indicator word *)
END_VAR

VAR
    (* --- State Machine Registers --- *)
    iState                          : INT := 0; (* Active MMC operational state index *)
    iPreviousState                  : INT := 0; (* Historical state tracker *)

    (* --- 2oo3 Triple Modular Redundancy (TMR) Validation Registers --- *)
    bVdcCh1_Valid                   : BOOL := TRUE;
    bVdcCh2_Valid                   : BOOL := TRUE;
    bVdcCh3_Valid                   : BOOL := TRUE;
    iHealthyVdcSensorCount          : INT  := 3;
    rVdcDelta12                     : REAL := 0.0;
    rVdcDelta23                     : REAL := 0.0;
    rVdcDelta31                     : REAL := 0.0;
    rVdcTmrToleranceLimit_kV        : REAL := 15.0; (* Maximum allowable cross-channel DC voltage divergence [kV] *)

    (* --- Electrical Parameter Constants --- *)
    rL_arm_H                        : REAL := 0.050;    (* Equivalent phase arm reactor inductance [H] *)
    rR_arm_Ohm                      : REAL := 0.850;    (* Equivalent phase arm parasitic resistance [Ohm] *)
    rSamplingTime_s                 : REAL := 0.0005;   (* Control execution loop sampling period Ts = 500 us [s] *)
    rPi                             : REAL := 3.14159265;
    rTwoPi                          : REAL := 6.28318531;

    (* --- Discrete State-Space Plant Matrices (Ts = 0.0005 s, L_arm = 50 mH, R_arm = 0.85 Ohm) --- *)
    (* Discretized System Matrix A_d: 2x2 matrix *)
    rA_d_11                         : REAL :=  0.942468;
    rA_d_12                         : REAL := -0.309062;
    rA_d_21                         : REAL :=  0.309062;
    rA_d_22                         : REAL :=  0.942468;

    (* Discretized Input Matrix B_d: 2x2 matrix *)
    rB_d_11                         : REAL :=  0.009712;
    rB_d_12                         : REAL := -0.001552;
    rB_d_21                         : REAL :=  0.001552;
    rB_d_22                         : REAL :=  0.009712;

    (* Output Matrix C_d and Direct Transmission Matrix D_d *)
    rC_d_11                         : REAL := 1.0;
    rC_d_22                         : REAL := 1.0;
    rD_d_11                         : REAL := 0.0;
    rD_d_22                         : REAL := 0.0;

    (* --- MPC Weighting Matrices & Analytical Feedback Gains --- *)
    rQ_weight_11                    : REAL := 1200.0;   (* Penalty on circulating current d-axis error *)
    rQ_weight_22                    : REAL := 1200.0;   (* Penalty on circulating current q-axis error *)
    rR_weight_11                    : REAL := 0.045;    (* Penalty on d-axis differential voltage control effort *)
    rR_weight_22                    : REAL := 0.045;    (* Penalty on q-axis differential voltage control effort *)
    rLambdaSpread                   : REAL := 0.015;    (* Penalty factor on capacitor voltage spread *)

    (* Precalculated MPC Gain Matrix K_mpc = (B_d^T * Q * B_d + R)^(-1) * B_d^T * Q * A_d *)
    rK_mpc_11                       : REAL :=  61.428;
    rK_mpc_12                       : REAL := -20.155;
    rK_mpc_21                       : REAL :=  20.155;
    rK_mpc_22                       : REAL :=  61.428;

    (* --- Orthogonal Transformation & Rotating Frame Variables --- *)
    rOmegaGrid                      : REAL := 314.159265;   (* Fundamental grid angular velocity [rad/s] *)
    rThetaGrid                      : REAL := 0.0;          (* Fundamental grid electrical angle from PLL [rad] *)
    rThetaDouble                    : REAL := 0.0;          (* Double-frequency rotating angle (2*theta) [rad] *)
    rSin2Theta                      : REAL := 0.0;          (* Sine of double-frequency angle *)
    rCos2Theta                      : REAL := 0.0;          (* Cosine of double-frequency angle *)

    (* Circulating Current Components *)
    rIdiff_Raw_kA                   : REAL := 0.0;          (* Instantaneous total differential current [kA] *)
    rIdc_Estimated_kA               : REAL := 0.0;          (* Extracted direct-current component [kA] *)
    rIcirc_Instantaneous_kA         : REAL := 0.0;          (* Raw instantaneous AC circulating current [kA] *)
    rIcirc_alpha_kA                 : REAL := 0.0;          (* Stationary alpha-axis circulating current [kA] *)
    rIcirc_beta_kA                  : REAL := 0.0;          (* Stationary beta-axis circulating current [kA] *)
    rIcirc_d_kA                     : REAL := 0.0;          (* Rotating d-axis circulating current component [kA] *)
    rIcirc_q_kA                     : REAL := 0.0;          (* Rotating q-axis circulating current component [kA] *)
    rIcirc_d_Filt_kA                : REAL := 0.0;          (* Low-pass conditioned d-axis circulating current [kA] *)
    rIcirc_q_Filt_kA                : REAL := 0.0;          (* Low-pass conditioned q-axis circulating current [kA] *)

    (* MPC Optimal Differential Voltage Vectors *)
    rU_opt_d_kV                     : REAL := 0.0;          (* Optimal d-axis differential voltage reference [kV] *)
    rU_opt_q_kV                     : REAL := 0.0;          (* Optimal q-axis differential voltage reference [kV] *)
    rU_opt_alpha_kV                 : REAL := 0.0;          (* Reverse Park alpha differential voltage [kV] *)
    rU_opt_beta_kV                  : REAL := 0.0;          (* Reverse Park beta differential voltage [kV] *)
    rVdiff_CircComp_kV              : REAL := 0.0;          (* Final circulating current compensating voltage [kV] *)

    (* Dynamic Submodule Balancing & Nearest Level Control Accumulators *)
    rTargetSubmoduleVolt_V          : REAL := 2500.0;       (* Dynamic baseline voltage target per SM [V] *)
    rVu_Continuous_kV               : REAL := 0.0;          (* Unclamped continuous upper arm voltage reference [kV] *)
    rVl_Continuous_kV               : REAL := 0.0;          (* Unclamped continuous lower arm voltage reference [kV] *)
    rNu_Real                        : REAL := 0.0;          (* Ideal continuous upper arm insertion index *)
    rNl_Real                        : REAL := 0.0;          (* Ideal continuous lower arm insertion index *)
    iNu_Calculated                  : INT  := 0;            (* Quantized upper insertion count *)
    iNl_Calculated                  : INT  := 0;            (* Quantized lower insertion count *)

    (* Timers & Watchdogs *)
    tonPrechargeTimer               : TON;                  (* DC link pre-charge duration monitor *)
    tonBalancingWatchdog            : TON;                  (* Submodule voltage spread divergence timer *)
    tonDegradedPersistence          : TON;                  (* Redundancy degradation debounce timer *)
    tonTripLatchClearTimer          : TON;                  (* Reset and latch clearance timer *)

    (* Execution & Statistical Counters *)
    udiCycleCounter                 : UDINT := 0;           (* Total PLC deterministic scan cycles executed *)
    udiBypassedSubmodulesTotal      : UDINT := 0;           (* Cumulative submodules permanently bypassed *)
    rHistoricalMaxSpread_V          : REAL  := 0.0;         (* Peak recorded capacitor imbalance spread [V] *)
END_VAR

(*
========================================================================================================================
  CYCLIC EXECUTION ROUTINE (DETERMINISTIC 500 us SCAN CYCLE)
========================================================================================================================
*)

udiCycleCounter := udiCycleCounter + 1;

(* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
   LAYER 1: CRITICAL HARDWIRED SAFETY INTERLOCKS & SIL-3 EMERGENCY FIRST-OUT TRIP
   --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
IF (NOT bSafetyEStopOk) OR bValveHallGroundFaultTripped THEN
    (* Immediate Deterministic Failsafe Safe-State Actions *)
    bSystemReady                    := FALSE;
    bDegradedRedundancyActive       := FALSE;
    bCircSuppressionActive          := FALSE;
    rVdiff_CircRef_Upper_kV         := 0.0;
    rVdiff_CircRef_Lower_kV         := 0.0;
    rVarm_Upper_Command_kV          := 0.0;
    rVarm_Lower_Command_kV          := 0.0;
    iNumSubmodulesToInsert_Upper    := 0;     (* Block all IGBT gate firing signals *)
    iNumSubmodulesToInsert_Lower    := 0;     (* Block all IGBT gate firing signals *)
    rPowerDeratingFactor            := 0.0;   (* Inhibit all power transfer *)
    rMpcOptimizationCost            := 9999.9;

    (* ISA-18.2 Latch Critical Alarm Register *)
    wAlarmWord.0                    := TRUE;  (* SIL-3 Master Emergency Trip Latch *)
    IF bValveHallGroundFaultTripped THEN
        wAlarmWord.1                := TRUE;  (* Valve Hall Insulation Ground Fault *)
    END_IF;

    wSystemStatusWord               := 16#F000;
    iState                          := 99;    (* Force direct transition to Emergency State *)
    RETURN;
END_IF;

wAlarmWord.0 := FALSE;

(* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
   LAYER 2: TRIPLE MODULAR REDUNDANCY (2oo3 TMR) DC VOLTAGE SENSOR VOTING ALGORITHM
   --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* Step 2.1: Verify Individual Physical Sensor Plausibility Bounds [50.0 kV to 700.0 kV] *)
bVdcCh1_Valid := (rVdc_Bus_Ch1_kV >= 50.0) AND (rVdc_Bus_Ch1_kV <= 700.0);
bVdcCh2_Valid := (rVdc_Bus_Ch2_kV >= 50.0) AND (rVdc_Bus_Ch2_kV <= 700.0);
bVdcCh3_Valid := (rVdc_Bus_Ch3_kV >= 50.0) AND (rVdc_Bus_Ch3_kV <= 700.0);

(* Step 2.2: Compute Cross-Channel Differential Residuals *)
rVdcDelta12 := ABS(rVdc_Bus_Ch1_kV - rVdc_Bus_Ch2_kV);
rVdcDelta23 := ABS(rVdc_Bus_Ch2_kV - rVdc_Bus_Ch3_kV);
rVdcDelta31 := ABS(rVdc_Bus_Ch3_kV - rVdc_Bus_Ch1_kV);

(* Step 2.3: 2oo3 Voting Core & Faulted Channel Rejection *)
IF bVdcCh1_Valid AND bVdcCh2_Valid AND bVdcCh3_Valid THEN
    IF (rVdcDelta12 <= rVdcTmrToleranceLimit_kV) AND (rVdcDelta23 <= rVdcTmrToleranceLimit_kV) AND (rVdcDelta31 <= rVdcTmrToleranceLimit_kV) THEN
        (* All three transducers in tight consensus: Triplicated Mean Output *)
        rVdc_Voted_kV          := (rVdc_Bus_Ch1_kV + rVdc_Bus_Ch2_kV + rVdc_Bus_Ch3_kV) / 3.0;
        iHealthyVdcSensorCount := 3;
        wAlarmWord.2           := FALSE; (* Clear TMR drift alarm *)
        wAlarmWord.3           := FALSE;
    ELSIF (rVdcDelta12 <= rVdcTmrToleranceLimit_kV) AND (rVdcDelta23 > rVdcTmrToleranceLimit_kV) AND (rVdcDelta31 > rVdcTmrToleranceLimit_kV) THEN
        (* Channel 3 drifting out of tolerance: Isolate Ch3, vote Ch1 & Ch2 *)
        rVdc_Voted_kV          := (rVdc_Bus_Ch1_kV + rVdc_Bus_Ch2_kV) / 2.0;
        bVdcCh3_Valid          := FALSE;
        iHealthyVdcSensorCount := 2;
        wAlarmWord.2           := TRUE;  (* Sensor Channel 3 Discrepancy Warning *)
    ELSIF (rVdcDelta23 <= rVdcTmrToleranceLimit_kV) AND (rVdcDelta12 > rVdcTmrToleranceLimit_kV) AND (rVdcDelta31 > rVdcTmrToleranceLimit_kV) THEN
        (* Channel 1 drifting out of tolerance: Isolate Ch1, vote Ch2 & Ch3 *)
        rVdc_Voted_kV          := (rVdc_Bus_Ch2_kV + rVdc_Bus_Ch3_kV) / 2.0;
        bVdcCh1_Valid          := FALSE;
        iHealthyVdcSensorCount := 2;
        wAlarmWord.2           := TRUE;  (* Sensor Channel 1 Discrepancy Warning *)
    ELSIF (rVdcDelta31 <= rVdcTmrToleranceLimit_kV) AND (rVdcDelta12 > rVdcTmrToleranceLimit_kV) AND (rVdcDelta23 > rVdcTmrToleranceLimit_kV) THEN
        (* Channel 2 drifting out of tolerance: Isolate Ch2, vote Ch1 & Ch3 *)
        rVdc_Voted_kV          := (rVdc_Bus_Ch1_kV + rVdc_Bus_Ch3_kV) / 2.0;
        bVdcCh2_Valid          := FALSE;
        iHealthyVdcSensorCount := 2;
        wAlarmWord.2           := TRUE;  (* Sensor Channel 2 Discrepancy Warning *)
    ELSE
        (* Total TMR Incoherence: Divergence across all channels *)
        rVdc_Voted_kV          := (rVdc_Bus_Ch1_kV + rVdc_Bus_Ch2_kV + rVdc_Bus_Ch3_kV) / 3.0;
        iHealthyVdcSensorCount := 1;
        wAlarmWord.2           := TRUE;
        wAlarmWord.3           := TRUE;  (* Critical TMR Incoherence Fault *)
    END_IF;
ELSIF bVdcCh1_Valid AND bVdcCh2_Valid THEN
    rVdc_Voted_kV          := (rVdc_Bus_Ch1_kV + rVdc_Bus_Ch2_kV) / 2.0;
    iHealthyVdcSensorCount := 2;
    wAlarmWord.2           := TRUE;
ELSIF bVdcCh2_Valid AND bVdcCh3_Valid THEN
    rVdc_Voted_kV          := (rVdc_Bus_Ch2_kV + rVdc_Bus_Ch3_kV) / 2.0;
    iHealthyVdcSensorCount := 2;
    wAlarmWord.2           := TRUE;
ELSIF bVdcCh1_Valid AND bVdcCh3_Valid THEN
    rVdc_Voted_kV          := (rVdc_Bus_Ch1_kV + rVdc_Bus_Ch3_kV) / 2.0;
    iHealthyVdcSensorCount := 2;
    wAlarmWord.2           := TRUE;
ELSIF bVdcCh1_Valid THEN
    rVdc_Voted_kV          := rVdc_Bus_Ch1_kV;
    iHealthyVdcSensorCount := 1;
    wAlarmWord.3           := TRUE;  (* Severe: Single Sensor Channel Fallback *)
ELSIF bVdcCh2_Valid THEN
    rVdc_Voted_kV          := rVdc_Bus_Ch2_kV;
    iHealthyVdcSensorCount := 1;
    wAlarmWord.3           := TRUE;
ELSIF bVdcCh3_Valid THEN
    rVdc_Voted_kV          := rVdc_Bus_Ch3_kV;
    iHealthyVdcSensorCount := 1;
    wAlarmWord.3           := TRUE;
ELSE
    (* Total Sensor Blackout: Safe Default Fallback & Trip Initiation *)
    rVdc_Voted_kV          := 500.0;
    iHealthyVdcSensorCount := 0;
    wAlarmWord.3           := TRUE;
    iState                 := 99;    (* Force shutdown due to complete feedback loss *)
    RETURN;
END_IF;

(* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
   LAYER 3: SIGNAL PROCESSING, ORTHOGONAL PARK ROTATION & CIRCULATING CURRENT EXTRACTION
   --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* Step 3.1: Fundamental Angular Frequency & Double-Frequency Tracking *)
IF (rGridFrequency_Hz >= 45.0) AND (rGridFrequency_Hz <= 65.0) THEN
    rOmegaGrid := rTwoPi * rGridFrequency_Hz;
ELSE
    rOmegaGrid := rTwoPi * 50.0; (* Failsafe nominal 50 Hz fallback *)
END_IF;

(* Continuous Integrator for Electrical Angle with Wrapping [0 .. 2*PI] *)
rThetaGrid := rThetaGrid + (rOmegaGrid * rSamplingTime_s);
IF rThetaGrid >= rTwoPi THEN
    rThetaGrid := rThetaGrid - rTwoPi;
ELSIF rThetaGrid < 0.0 THEN
    rThetaGrid := rThetaGrid + rTwoPi;
END_IF;

(* Double-Frequency Rotating Reference Frame Angle (Negative-Sequence 2*omega_0) *)
rThetaDouble := 2.0 * rThetaGrid;
IF rThetaDouble >= rTwoPi THEN
    rThetaDouble := rThetaDouble - rTwoPi;
END_IF;

rSin2Theta := SIN(rThetaDouble);
rCos2Theta := COS(rThetaDouble);

(* Step 3.2: Differential Current Decomposition *)
rIdiff_Raw_kA := 0.5 * (rArmCurrent_Upper_kA + rArmCurrent_Lower_kA);

(* High-pass / bandpass extraction: DC bias tracking via low-pass accumulator *)
rIdc_Estimated_kA := (rIdc_Estimated_kA * 0.995) + (rIdiff_Raw_kA * 0.005);
rIcirc_Instantaneous_kA := rIdiff_Raw_kA - rIdc_Estimated_kA;

(* Synthetic Orthogonal SGI (Second-Order Generalized Integrator) Stationary Vector *)
rIcirc_alpha_kA := rIcirc_Instantaneous_kA;
rIcirc_beta_kA  := -(rIcirc_Instantaneous_kA * rSin2Theta) / (rCos2Theta + 0.0001);

(* Step 3.3: Park Coordinate Transformation to Negative-Sequence dq^2w Frame *)
rIcirc_d_kA :=  (rIcirc_alpha_kA * rCos2Theta) + (rIcirc_beta_kA * rSin2Theta);
rIcirc_q_kA := -(rIcirc_alpha_kA * rSin2Theta) + (rIcirc_beta_kA * rCos2Theta);

(* Digital Low-Pass Conditioning of Rotating dq Current States *)
rIcirc_d_Filt_kA := (rIcirc_d_Filt_kA * 0.85) + (rIcirc_d_kA * 0.15);
rIcirc_q_Filt_kA := (rIcirc_q_Filt_kA * 0.85) + (rIcirc_q_kA * 0.15);

(* Overall Magnitude of 2nd Harmonic Circulating Current *)
rCirculatingCurrent_kA := SQRT((rIcirc_d_Filt_kA * rIcirc_d_Filt_kA) + (rIcirc_q_Filt_kA * rIcirc_q_Filt_kA));

(* Step 3.4: Submodule Capacitor Statistics & Health Evaluation *)
rCapacitorVoltageSpread_V := rSubmoduleCapVolt_Max_V - rSubmoduleCapVolt_Min_V;
IF rCapacitorVoltageSpread_V > rHistoricalMaxSpread_V THEN
    rHistoricalMaxSpread_V := rCapacitorVoltageSpread_V;
END_IF;

(* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
   LAYER 4: MODEL PREDICTIVE CONTROL (MPC) & VOLTAGE BALANCING ALGORITHM
   --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
IF bCircCurrentSuppressionEnable AND (iState = 30 OR iState = 40 OR iState = 50) THEN
    (* Step 4.1: Optimal dq Differential Voltage Control Authority via Precomputed Quadratic Minimizer *)
    rU_opt_d_kV := -( (rK_mpc_11 * rIcirc_d_Filt_kA) + (rK_mpc_12 * rIcirc_q_Filt_kA) );
    rU_opt_q_kV := -( (rK_mpc_21 * rIcirc_d_Filt_kA) + (rK_mpc_22 * rIcirc_q_Filt_kA) );

    (* Physical Actuator Saturation Clamping on Differential Voltage (+/- 15% of Nominal Pole Voltage) *)
    IF rU_opt_d_kV > 45.0 THEN
        rU_opt_d_kV := 45.0;
    ELSIF rU_opt_d_kV < -45.0 THEN
        rU_opt_d_kV := -45.0;
    END_IF;

    IF rU_opt_q_kV > 45.0 THEN
        rU_opt_q_kV := 45.0;
    ELSIF rU_opt_q_kV < -45.0 THEN
        rU_opt_q_kV := -45.0;
    END_IF;

    (* Step 4.2: Reverse Park Transformation from dq^2w to Stationary Reference Frame *)
    rU_opt_alpha_kV := (rU_opt_d_kV * rCos2Theta) - (rU_opt_q_kV * rSin2Theta);
    rU_opt_beta_kV  := (rU_opt_d_kV * rSin2Theta) + (rU_opt_q_kV * rCos2Theta);

    (* Resolving Compensating Differential Voltage *)
    rVdiff_CircComp_kV := rU_opt_alpha_kV;
    bCircSuppressionActive := TRUE;

    (* Step 4.3: Real-Time Evaluation of Quadratic Cost Function J *)
    rMpcOptimizationCost := (rQ_weight_11 * rIcirc_d_Filt_kA * rIcirc_d_Filt_kA)
                          + (rQ_weight_22 * rIcirc_q_Filt_kA * rIcirc_q_Filt_kA)
                          + (rR_weight_11 * rU_opt_d_kV * rU_opt_d_kV)
                          + (rR_weight_22 * rU_opt_q_kV * rU_opt_q_kV)
                          + (rLambdaSpread * rCapacitorVoltageSpread_V * 0.001 * rCapacitorVoltageSpread_V * 0.001);
ELSE
    rU_opt_d_kV             := 0.0;
    rU_opt_q_kV             := 0.0;
    rVdiff_CircComp_kV      := 0.0;
    bCircSuppressionActive  := FALSE;
    rMpcOptimizationCost    := 0.0;
END_IF;

(* Differential Arm Compensating Output Distribution *)
rVdiff_CircRef_Upper_kV :=  rVdiff_CircComp_kV;
rVdiff_CircRef_Lower_kV := -rVdiff_CircComp_kV;

(* Step 4.4: Dynamic Target Voltage Calculation per Active Submodule *)
IF iActiveSubmoduleCount_Upper > 0 THEN
    rTargetSubmoduleVolt_V := (rVdc_Voted_kV * 1000.0) / INT_TO_REAL(iActiveSubmoduleCount_Upper);
ELSE
    rTargetSubmoduleVolt_V := rSubmoduleCapVolt_Nom_V;
END_IF;

(* Step 4.5: Unclamped Continuous Arm Reference Voltages *)
rVu_Continuous_kV := (0.5 * rVdc_Voted_kV) - rPhaseAcVoltageRef_kV - rVdiff_CircRef_Upper_kV;
rVl_Continuous_kV := (0.5 * rVdc_Voted_kV) + rPhaseAcVoltageRef_kV - rVdiff_CircRef_Lower_kV;

(* Anti-Windup Clamping to Physical Voltage Boundaries [0.0 .. Vdc] *)
IF rVu_Continuous_kV < 0.0 THEN
    rVarm_Upper_Command_kV := 0.0;
ELSIF rVu_Continuous_kV > rVdc_Voted_kV THEN
    rVarm_Upper_Command_kV := rVdc_Voted_kV;
ELSE
    rVarm_Upper_Command_kV := rVu_Continuous_kV;
END_IF;

IF rVl_Continuous_kV < 0.0 THEN
    rVarm_Lower_Command_kV := 0.0;
ELSIF rVl_Continuous_kV > rVdc_Voted_kV THEN
    rVarm_Lower_Command_kV := rVdc_Voted_kV;
ELSE
    rVarm_Lower_Command_kV := rVl_Continuous_kV;
END_IF;

(* Step 4.6: Nearest Level Control (NLC) Quantization & Insertion Count *)
IF rSubmoduleCapVolt_Mean_V > 500.0 THEN
    rNu_Real := (rVarm_Upper_Command_kV * 1000.0) / rSubmoduleCapVolt_Mean_V;
    rNl_Real := (rVarm_Lower_Command_kV * 1000.0) / rSubmoduleCapVolt_Mean_V;
ELSE
    rNu_Real := (rVarm_Upper_Command_kV * 1000.0) / rTargetSubmoduleVolt_V;
    rNl_Real := (rVarm_Lower_Command_kV * 1000.0) / rTargetSubmoduleVolt_V;
END_IF;

iNu_Calculated := REAL_TO_INT(rNu_Real + 0.5);
iNl_Calculated := REAL_TO_INT(rNl_Real + 0.5);

(* Structural Boundary Protection on Insertion Counts *)
IF iNu_Calculated < 0 THEN
    iNumSubmodulesToInsert_Upper := 0;
ELSIF iNu_Calculated > iActiveSubmoduleCount_Upper THEN
    iNumSubmodulesToInsert_Upper := iActiveSubmoduleCount_Upper;
ELSE
    iNumSubmodulesToInsert_Upper := iNu_Calculated;
END_IF;

IF iNl_Calculated < 0 THEN

   ==================================================================================================== *)
(* Sanitize Raw Solar Irradiance Channels (0 to 1600 W/m2) *)
IF rSolarIrradiance_ChA_Wm2 < 0.0 THEN rClampedSolar_Wm2 := 0.0; ELSIF rSolarIrradiance_ChA_Wm2 > 1600.0 THEN rClampedSolar_Wm2 := 1600.0; ELSE rClampedSolar_Wm2 := rSolarIrradiance_ChA_Wm2; END_IF;

(* --- 2.1 TMR Voting: Solar Irradiance Pyranometers --- *)

    IF ((rSolarIrradiance_ChA_Wm2 >= rSolarIrradiance_ChB_Wm2) AND (rSolarIrradiance_ChA_Wm2 <= rSolarIrradiance_ChC_Wm2)) OR ((rSolarIrradiance_ChA_Wm2 <= rSolarIrradiance_ChB_Wm2) AND (rSolarIrradiance_ChA_Wm2 >= rSolarIrradiance_ChC_Wm2)) THEN

    ELSE

    END_IF;
ELSIF (rSolar_DevAB <= c_rTmrSolarIrradianceTolerance_Wm2) AND (rSolar_DevBC > c_rTmrSolarIrradianceTolerance_Wm2) AND (rSolar_DevCA > c_rTmrSolarIrradianceTolerance_Wm2) THEN

(* ====================================================================================================
