(* ================================================================================================
   MAIN CYCLIC LOGIC - 10.0 MS DETERMINISTIC EXECUTION TASK
   ================================================================================================ *)

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
   SAFETY CRITICAL INTERLOCKS AND EMERGENCY SHUTDOWN EVALUATION
   ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
IF NOT bEmergencyStop THEN
    (* Immediate Emergency Face Isolation and Drive Shutdown *)
    iState := 90; (* EMERGENCY_SHIELD_SEAL_AND_FACE_PRESSURE_ISOLATION *)
    wTBM_AlarmWord := wTBM_AlarmWord OR 16#0001; (* Bit 0: Emergency Stop Tripped *)
END_IF;

IF rHydraulicLinePressure < 180.0 THEN
    (* Hydraulic Supply Pressure Deficient - Hazard to Shield Support *)
    wTBM_AlarmWord := wTBM_AlarmWord OR 16#0002; (* Bit 1: Hydraulic Main Pressure Low Fault *)
    IF iState >= 40 AND iState <= 70 THEN
        iState := 90; (* Abort to emergency seal *)
    END_IF;
ELSE
    wTBM_AlarmWord := wTBM_AlarmWord AND NOT 16#0002;
END_IF;

IF NOT bInterlockSlurryFlow AND (iState = 50 OR iState = 60) THEN
    (* Loss of bentonite circulation circuit flow - Risk of chamber sedimentation *)
    wTBM_AlarmWord := wTBM_AlarmWord OR 16#0004; (* Bit 2: Slurry Circulation Permissive Lost *)
    iState := 70; (* Fallback to Ring Build Standby Pressure Retention *)
ELSE
    wTBM_AlarmWord := wTBM_AlarmWord AND NOT 16#0004;
END_IF;

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
   MODULE 1: IEC 61508 / IEC 61511 SIL-3 2oo3 TMR SENSOR VOTING LOGIC & DEGRADATION ENGINE
   ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* --- 1.1 Crown Slurry Pressure Triad (PT-101A, PT-101B, PT-101C) --- *)
(* Range Validation [0.5 bar to 12.0 bar] *)
bCrown_Ch1_Valid := (rPressCrown_Ch1 >= 0.50) AND (rPressCrown_Ch1 <= 12.00);
bCrown_Ch2_Valid := (rPressCrown_Ch2 >= 0.50) AND (rPressCrown_Ch2 <= 12.00);
bCrown_Ch3_Valid := (rPressCrown_Ch3 >= 0.50) AND (rPressCrown_Ch3 <= 12.00);

(* Pairwise Disparity Calculation *)
rCrown_Delta12 := ABS(rPressCrown_Ch1 - rPressCrown_Ch2);
rCrown_Delta23 := ABS(rPressCrown_Ch2 - rPressCrown_Ch3);
rCrown_Delta31 := ABS(rPressCrown_Ch3 - rPressCrown_Ch1);

(* Persistent Discrepancy Fault Timers (50 ms filter to reject transient electrical noise) *)
tCrown_Ch1_FaultTimer(IN := (rCrown_Delta12 > rCrownDiscrepancyLimit AND rCrown_Delta31 > rCrownDiscrepancyLimit) OR NOT bCrown_Ch1_Valid, PT := T#50MS);
tCrown_Ch2_FaultTimer(IN := (rCrown_Delta12 > rCrownDiscrepancyLimit AND rCrown_Delta23 > rCrownDiscrepancyLimit) OR NOT bCrown_Ch2_Valid, PT := T#50MS);
tCrown_Ch3_FaultTimer(IN := (rCrown_Delta23 > rCrownDiscrepancyLimit AND rCrown_Delta31 > rCrownDiscrepancyLimit) OR NOT bCrown_Ch3_Valid, PT := T#50MS);

(* Crown Pressure Voting Engine and Graceful Degradation *)
IF NOT tCrown_Ch1_FaultTimer.Q AND NOT tCrown_Ch2_FaultTimer.Q AND NOT tCrown_Ch3_FaultTimer.Q THEN
    (* All 3 Channels Healthy: Median Selection 2oo3 *)
    iCrownDegradedMode := 0;
    rMedianBuffer[1] := rPressCrown_Ch1;
    rMedianBuffer[2] := rPressCrown_Ch2;
    rMedianBuffer[3] := rPressCrown_Ch3;
    (* 3-element sorting network *)
    IF rMedianBuffer[1] > rMedianBuffer[2] THEN
        rTemp := rMedianBuffer[1]; rMedianBuffer[1] := rMedianBuffer[2]; rMedianBuffer[2] := rTemp;
    END_IF;
    IF rMedianBuffer[2] > rMedianBuffer[3] THEN
        rTemp := rMedianBuffer[2]; rMedianBuffer[2] := rMedianBuffer[3]; rMedianBuffer[3] := rTemp;
    END_IF;
    IF rMedianBuffer[1] > rMedianBuffer[2] THEN
        rTemp := rMedianBuffer[1]; rMedianBuffer[1] := rMedianBuffer[2]; rMedianBuffer[2] := rTemp;
    END_IF;
    rVotedFacePressure := rMedianBuffer[2];
    wDegradedSensorWord := wDegradedSensorWord AND NOT 16#0007;

ELSIF tCrown_Ch1_FaultTimer.Q AND NOT tCrown_Ch2_FaultTimer.Q AND NOT tCrown_Ch3_FaultTimer.Q THEN
    (* Channel 1 Degraded: 1oo2 Average of Ch2 & Ch3 *)
    iCrownDegradedMode := 1;
    rVotedFacePressure := 0.5 * (rPressCrown_Ch2 + rPressCrown_Ch3);
    wDegradedSensorWord := (wDegradedSensorWord AND NOT 16#0007) OR 16#0001; (* Bit 0: Crown Ch1 Fail *)

ELSIF NOT tCrown_Ch1_FaultTimer.Q AND tCrown_Ch2_FaultTimer.Q AND NOT tCrown_Ch3_FaultTimer.Q THEN
    (* Channel 2 Degraded: 1oo2 Average of Ch1 & Ch3 *)
    iCrownDegradedMode := 1;
    rVotedFacePressure := 0.5 * (rPressCrown_Ch1 + rPressCrown_Ch3);
    wDegradedSensorWord := (wDegradedSensorWord AND NOT 16#0007) OR 16#0002; (* Bit 1: Crown Ch2 Fail *)

ELSIF NOT tCrown_Ch1_FaultTimer.Q AND NOT tCrown_Ch2_FaultTimer.Q AND tCrown_Ch3_FaultTimer.Q THEN
    (* Channel 3 Degraded: 1oo2 Average of Ch1 & Ch2 *)
    iCrownDegradedMode := 1;
    rVotedFacePressure := 0.5 * (rPressCrown_Ch1 + rPressCrown_Ch2);
    wDegradedSensorWord := (wDegradedSensorWord AND NOT 16#0007) OR 16#0004; (* Bit 2: Crown Ch3 Fail *)

ELSIF NOT tCrown_Ch1_FaultTimer.Q THEN
    (* Double Fault: Only Channel 1 Survives - 1oo1 Critical Mode *)
    iCrownDegradedMode := 2;
    rVotedFacePressure := rPressCrown_Ch1;
    wDegradedSensorWord := (wDegradedSensorWord AND NOT 16#0007) OR 16#0006; (* Ch2 & Ch3 Failed *)
    wTBM_AlarmWord := wTBM_AlarmWord OR 16#0008; (* Bit 3: Face Pressure 2oo3 Degraded to 1oo1 *)

ELSIF NOT tCrown_Ch2_FaultTimer.Q THEN
    iCrownDegradedMode := 2;
    rVotedFacePressure := rPressCrown_Ch2;
    wDegradedSensorWord := (wDegradedSensorWord AND NOT 16#0007) OR 16#0005;
    wTBM_AlarmWord := wTBM_AlarmWord OR 16#0008;

ELSIF NOT tCrown_Ch3_FaultTimer.Q THEN
    iCrownDegradedMode := 2;
    rVotedFacePressure := rPressCrown_Ch3;
    wDegradedSensorWord := (wDegradedSensorWord AND NOT 16#0007) OR 16#0003;
    wTBM_AlarmWord := wTBM_AlarmWord OR 16#0008;

ELSE
    (* Triple Fault: Catastrophic Loss of All Crown Pressure Transmitters *)
    iCrownDegradedMode := 3;
    wTBM_AlarmWord := wTBM_AlarmWord OR 16#0010; (* Bit 4: Total Crown Transmitter Loss Trip *)
    iState := 90; (* Emergency trip *)
END_IF;

(* Convert Crown Pressure to Axis Pressure using hydrostatic slurry column *)
(* p_axis = p_crown + rho_slurry * g * rCrownToAxisDistance *)
rVotedFacePressure := rVotedFacePressure + (rSlurryDensity_Inlet * rGravity * rCrownToAxisDistance) / 100000.0;

(* --- 1.2 Air Bubble Chamber Pressure Triad (PT-201A, PT-201B, PT-201C) --- *)
bBubble_Ch1_Valid := (rPressBubble_Ch1 >= 0.50) AND (rPressBubble_Ch1 <= 12.00);
bBubble_Ch2_Valid := (rPressBubble_Ch2 >= 0.50) AND (rPressBubble_Ch2 <= 12.00);
bBubble_Ch3_Valid := (rPressBubble_Ch3 >= 0.50) AND (rPressBubble_Ch3 <= 12.00);

rBubble_Delta12 := ABS(rPressBubble_Ch1 - rPressBubble_Ch2);
rBubble_Delta23 := ABS(rPressBubble_Ch2 - rPressBubble_Ch3);
rBubble_Delta31 := ABS(rPressBubble_Ch3 - rPressBubble_Ch1);

tBubble_Ch1_FaultTimer(IN := (rBubble_Delta12 > rBubbleDiscrepancyLimit AND rBubble_Delta31 > rBubbleDiscrepancyLimit) OR NOT bBubble_Ch1_Valid, PT := T#50MS);
tBubble_Ch2_FaultTimer(IN := (rBubble_Delta12 > rBubbleDiscrepancyLimit AND rBubble_Delta23 > rBubbleDiscrepancyLimit) OR NOT bBubble_Ch2_Valid, PT := T#50MS);
tBubble_Ch3_FaultTimer(IN := (rBubble_Delta23 > rBubbleDiscrepancyLimit AND rBubble_Delta31 > rBubbleDiscrepancyLimit) OR NOT bBubble_Ch3_Valid, PT := T#50MS);

IF NOT tBubble_Ch1_FaultTimer.Q AND NOT tBubble_Ch2_FaultTimer.Q AND NOT tBubble_Ch3_FaultTimer.Q THEN
    iBubbleDegradedMode := 0;
    rMedianBuffer[1] := rPressBubble_Ch1;
    rMedianBuffer[2] := rPressBubble_Ch2;
    rMedianBuffer[3] := rPressBubble_Ch3;
    IF rMedianBuffer[1] > rMedianBuffer[2] THEN
        rTemp := rMedianBuffer[1]; rMedianBuffer[1] := rMedianBuffer[2]; rMedianBuffer[2] := rTemp;
    END_IF;
    IF rMedianBuffer[2] > rMedianBuffer[3] THEN
        rTemp := rMedianBuffer[2]; rMedianBuffer[2] := rMedianBuffer[3]; rMedianBuffer[3] := rTemp;
    END_IF;
    IF rMedianBuffer[1] > rMedianBuffer[2] THEN
        rTemp := rMedianBuffer[1]; rMedianBuffer[1] := rMedianBuffer[2]; rMedianBuffer[2] := rTemp;
    END_IF;
    rVotedBubblePressure := rMedianBuffer[2];
    wDegradedSensorWord := wDegradedSensorWord AND NOT 16#0070;

ELSIF tBubble_Ch1_FaultTimer.Q AND NOT tBubble_Ch2_FaultTimer.Q AND NOT tBubble_Ch3_FaultTimer.Q THEN
    iBubbleDegradedMode := 1;
    rVotedBubblePressure := 0.5 * (rPressBubble_Ch2 + rPressBubble_Ch3);
    wDegradedSensorWord := (wDegradedSensorWord AND NOT 16#0070) OR 16#0010;

ELSIF NOT tBubble_Ch1_FaultTimer.Q AND tBubble_Ch2_FaultTimer.Q AND NOT tBubble_Ch3_FaultTimer.Q THEN
    iBubbleDegradedMode := 1;
    rVotedBubblePressure := 0.5 * (rPressBubble_Ch1 + rPressBubble_Ch3);
    wDegradedSensorWord := (wDegradedSensorWord AND NOT 16#0070) OR 16#0020;

ELSIF NOT tBubble_Ch1_FaultTimer.Q AND NOT tBubble_Ch2_FaultTimer.Q AND tBubble_Ch3_FaultTimer.Q THEN
    iBubbleDegradedMode := 1;
    rVotedBubblePressure := 0.5 * (rPressBubble_Ch1 + rPressBubble_Ch2);
    wDegradedSensorWord := (wDegradedSensorWord AND NOT 16#0070) OR 16#0040;

ELSIF NOT tBubble_Ch1_FaultTimer.Q THEN
    iBubbleDegradedMode := 2;
    rVotedBubblePressure := rPressBubble_Ch1;
    wDegradedSensorWord := (wDegradedSensorWord AND NOT 16#0070) OR 16#0060;
    wTBM_AlarmWord := wTBM_AlarmWord OR 16#0020; (* Bit 5: Bubble Pressure 2oo3 Degraded to 1oo1 *)

ELSIF NOT tBubble_Ch2_FaultTimer.Q THEN
    iBubbleDegradedMode := 2;
    rVotedBubblePressure := rPressBubble_Ch2;
    wDegradedSensorWord := (wDegradedSensorWord AND NOT 16#0070) OR 16#0050;
    wTBM_AlarmWord := wTBM_AlarmWord OR 16#0020;

ELSIF NOT tBubble_Ch3_FaultTimer.Q THEN
    iBubbleDegradedMode := 2;
    rVotedBubblePressure := rPressBubble_Ch3;
    wDegradedSensorWord := (wDegradedSensorWord AND NOT 16#0070) OR 16#0030;
    wTBM_AlarmWord := wTBM_AlarmWord OR 16#0020;

ELSE
    iBubbleDegradedMode := 3;
    wTBM_AlarmWord := wTBM_AlarmWord OR 16#0040; (* Bit 6: Total Bubble Transmitter Loss Trip *)
    iState := 90;
END_IF;

(* --- 1.3 Slurry Surface Level Triad (LT-301A, LT-301B, LT-301C) --- *)
bLevel_Ch1_Valid := (rLevelBubble_Ch1 >= 200.0) AND (rLevelBubble_Ch1 <= 3800.0);
bLevel_Ch2_Valid := (rLevelBubble_Ch2 >= 200.0) AND (rLevelBubble_Ch2 <= 3800.0);
bLevel_Ch3_Valid := (rLevelBubble_Ch3 >= 200.0) AND (rLevelBubble_Ch3 <= 3800.0);

rLevel_Delta12 := ABS(rLevelBubble_Ch1 - rLevelBubble_Ch2);
rLevel_Delta23 := ABS(rLevelBubble_Ch2 - rLevelBubble_Ch3);
rLevel_Delta31 := ABS(rLevelBubble_Ch3 - rLevelBubble_Ch1);

tLevel_Ch1_FaultTimer(IN := (rLevel_Delta12 > rLevelDiscrepancyLimit AND rLevel_Delta31 > rLevelDiscrepancyLimit) OR NOT bLevel_Ch1_Valid, PT := T#50MS);
tLevel_Ch2_FaultTimer(IN := (rLevel_Delta12 > rLevelDiscrepancyLimit AND rLevel_Delta23 > rLevelDiscrepancyLimit) OR NOT bLevel_Ch2_Valid, PT := T#50MS);
tLevel_Ch3_FaultTimer(IN := (rLevel_Delta23 > rLevelDiscrepancyLimit AND rLevel_Delta31 > rLevelDiscrepancyLimit) OR NOT bLevel_Ch3_Valid, PT := T#50MS);

IF NOT tLevel_Ch1_FaultTimer.Q AND NOT tLevel_Ch2_FaultTimer.Q AND NOT tLevel_Ch3_FaultTimer.Q THEN
    iLevelDegradedMode := 0;
    rMedianBuffer[1] := rLevelBubble_Ch1;
    rMedianBuffer[2] := rLevelBubble_Ch2;
    rMedianBuffer[3] := rLevelBubble_Ch3;
    IF rMedianBuffer[1] > rMedianBuffer[2] THEN
        rTemp := rMedianBuffer[1]; rMedianBuffer[1] := rMedianBuffer[2]; rMedianBuffer[2] := rTemp;
    END_IF;
    IF rMedianBuffer[2] > rMedianBuffer[3] THEN
        rTemp := rMedianBuffer[2]; rMedianBuffer[2] := rMedianBuffer[3]; rMedianBuffer[3] := rTemp;
    END_IF;
    IF rMedianBuffer[1] > rMedianBuffer[2] THEN
        rTemp := rMedianBuffer[1]; rMedianBuffer[1] := rMedianBuffer[2]; rMedianBuffer[2] := rTemp;
    END_IF;
    rVotedSlurryLevel := rMedianBuffer[2];
    wDegradedSensorWord := wDegradedSensorWord AND NOT 16#0700;

ELSIF tLevel_Ch1_FaultTimer.Q AND NOT tLevel_Ch2_FaultTimer.Q AND NOT tLevel_Ch3_FaultTimer.Q THEN
    iLevelDegradedMode := 1;
    rVotedSlurryLevel := 0.5 * (rLevelBubble_Ch2 + rLevelBubble_Ch3);
    wDegradedSensorWord := (wDegradedSensorWord AND NOT 16#0700) OR 16#0100;

ELSIF NOT tLevel_Ch1_FaultTimer.Q AND tLevel_Ch2_FaultTimer.Q AND NOT tLevel_Ch3_FaultTimer.Q THEN
    iLevelDegradedMode := 1;
    rVotedSlurryLevel := 0.5 * (rLevelBubble_Ch1 + rLevelBubble_Ch3);
    wDegradedSensorWord := (wDegradedSensorWord AND NOT 16#0700) OR 16#0200;

ELSIF NOT tLevel_Ch1_FaultTimer.Q AND NOT tLevel_Ch2_FaultTimer.Q AND tLevel_Ch3_FaultTimer.Q THEN
    iLevelDegradedMode := 1;
    rVotedSlurryLevel := 0.5 * (rLevelBubble_Ch1 + rLevelBubble_Ch2);
    wDegradedSensorWord := (wDegradedSensorWord AND NOT 16#0700) OR 16#0400;

ELSIF NOT tLevel_Ch1_FaultTimer.Q THEN
    iLevelDegradedMode := 2;
    rVotedSlurryLevel := rLevelBubble_Ch1;
    wDegradedSensorWord := (wDegradedSensorWord AND NOT 16#0700) OR 16#0600;
    wTBM_AlarmWord := wTBM_AlarmWord OR 16#0080; (* Bit 7: Bubble Level 2oo3 Degraded to 1oo1 *)

ELSIF NOT tLevel_Ch2_FaultTimer.Q THEN
    iLevelDegradedMode := 2;
    rVotedSlurryLevel := rLevelBubble_Ch2;
    wDegradedSensorWord := (wDegradedSensorWord AND NOT 16#0700) OR 16#0500;
    wTBM_AlarmWord := wTBM_AlarmWord OR 16#0080;

ELSIF NOT tLevel_Ch3_FaultTimer.Q THEN
    iLevelDegradedMode := 2;
    rVotedSlurryLevel := rLevelBubble_Ch3;
    wDegradedSensorWord := (wDegradedSensorWord AND NOT 16#0700) OR 16#0300;
    wTBM_AlarmWord := wTBM_AlarmWord OR 16#0080;

ELSE
    iLevelDegradedMode := 3;
    wTBM_AlarmWord := wTBM_AlarmWord OR 16#0100; (* Bit 8: Total Level Transmitter Loss Trip *)
    iState := 90;
END_IF;

bDegradedSensorMode := (iCrownDegradedMode > 0) OR (iBubbleDegradedMode > 0) OR (iLevelDegradedMode > 0);

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
   MODULE 2: TERZAGHI SUB-AQUEOUS GEOTECHNICAL EQUILIBRIUM & TARGET PRESSURE SYNTHESIS
   ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* Calculate total pore water pressure at tunnel springline axis [kPa] *)
(* u_w = rho_water * g * (H_water_depth + h_tidal + Overburden + R_shield) *)
rHydrostaticWaterHead := 1025.0 * rGravity * (rWaterDepthMean_m + rTidalWaterLevel_m + rOverburdenDepth_m + rCrownToAxisDistance) / 1000.0;

(* Calculate vertical effective stress of soil overburden [kPa] *)
(* gamma_submerged = gamma_saturated - gamma_water = (20.5 - 10.05) kN/m3 = 10.45 kN/m3 *)
rEffectiveOverburdenStress := 10.45 * rOverburdenDepth_m;

(* Lateral Earth Pressure Coefficient at Rest: K_0 = 1 - sin(phi) *)
rLateralEarthPressureCoeff := 1.0 - SIN(rSoilFrictionAngle_deg * rPI / 180.0);

(* Total Target Face Support Pressure at Axis [bar] *)
(* p_target = (u_w + K_0 * sigma_v' + Delta_safety) / 100.0 *)
rCalculatedTargetFacePressure := (rHydrostaticWaterHead + (rLateralEarthPressureCoeff * rEffectiveOverburdenStress) + 25.0) / 100.0;

(* Determine Face Pressure Control Error *)
bFacePressureInTolerance := ABS(rVotedFacePressure - rFaceSupportPressure_SP) <= 0.015; (* Sub-millibar +-15 mbar *)

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
   MODULE 3: BUBBLE CHAMBER STATE-SPACE OBSERVER & MODEL PREDICTIVE CONTROL (MPC)
   ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* Disturbance Vector Construction *)
aDisturbance_d[1] := rAdvanceRate_Actual / 60000.0; (* [m/s] *)
aDisturbance_d[2] := rSlurryFeedFlow_Meas / 3600.0;  (* [m3/s] *)
aDisturbance_d[3] := rSlurryDischargeFlow_Meas / 3600.0; (* [m3/s] *)

(* Measurement Vector: y_meas = [ p_bubble [bar], dp_bubble/dt [bar/s], h_slurry [m], Q_net [m3/s] ] *)
aState_x[1] := rVotedBubblePressure;
aState_x[2] := (rVotedBubblePressure - aState_x_prev[1]) / rDt;
aState_x[3] := rVotedSlurryLevel / 1000.0; (* mm to m *)
aState_x[4] := aDisturbance_d[2] - aDisturbance_d[3];

(* Luenberger State Observer Update *)
FOR i := 1 TO 4 DO
    rSum := 0.0;
    FOR j := 1 TO 4 DO
        rSum := rSum + matA[i, j] * aState_x_est[j];
    END_FOR;
    FOR j := 1 TO 3 DO
        rSum := rSum + matB[i, j] * aControl_u[j] + matE[i, j] * aDisturbance_d[j];
    END_FOR;
    (* Add innovation correction: L * (y_meas - C * x_est) *)
    rSum := rSum + matL[i, 1] * (aState_x[1] - aState_x_est[1])
                 + matL[i, 3] * (aState_x[3] - aState_x_est[3]);
    aState_x_next[i] := rSum;
END_FOR;
FOR i := 1 TO 4 DO
    aState_x_est[i] := aState_x_next[i];
END_FOR;

(* Target State Vector r = [ p_bubble_target, 0, h_slurry_target, 0 ] *)
(* Dynamic relation: p_bubble_target = rFaceSupportPressure_SP - (rho_slurry * g * (h_axis - h_slurry)) / 100000 *)
aTargetState_r[1] := rFaceSupportPressure_SP - (rSlurryDensity_Inlet * rGravity * (rCrownToAxisDistance - (rVotedSlurryLevel / 1000.0))) / 100000.0;
aTargetState_r[2] := 0.0;
aTargetState_r[3] := 2.150; (* Target optimal bubble slurry level 2.15 m *)
aTargetState_r[4] := 0.0;

(* --- Real-Time Projected Gradient Descent MPC Solver --- *)
(* Initialize predicted trajectories with previous control commands *)
FOR i := 1 TO 3 DO
    aPredicted_u[1, i] := aControl_u[i];
    aPredicted_u[2, i] := aControl_u[i];
    aPredicted_u[3, i] := aControl_u[i];
END_FOR;

rBestCost_J := 1.0E9;
FOR iMpcIter := 1 TO iMaxMpcIter DO
    (* 1. Forward propagate state predictions over N_p = 5 steps *)
    FOR k_step := 1 TO 5 DO
        FOR i := 1 TO 4 DO
            IF k_step = 1 THEN
                rSum := 0.0;
                FOR j := 1 TO 4 DO
                    rSum := rSum + matA[i, j] * aState_x_est[j];
                END_FOR;
                FOR j := 1 TO 3 DO
                    rSum := rSum + matB[i, j] * aPredicted_u[1, j] + matE[i, j] * aDisturbance_d[j];
                END_FOR;
                aPredicted_x[1, i] := rSum;
            ELSE
                rSum := 0.0;
                FOR j := 1 TO 4 DO
                    rSum := rSum + matA[i, j] * aPredicted_x[k_step - 1, j];
                END_FOR;
                (* For steps beyond control horizon N_u = 3, hold last control input *)
                IF k_step <= 3 THEN
                    FOR j := 1 TO 3 DO
                        rSum := rSum + matB[i, j] * aPredicted_u[k_step, j] + matE[i, j] * aDisturbance_d[j];
                    END_FOR;
                ELSE
                    FOR j := 1 TO 3 DO
                        rSum := rSum + matB[i, j] * aPredicted_u[3, j] + matE[i, j] * aDisturbance_d[j];
                    END_FOR;
                END_IF;
                aPredicted_x[k_step, i] := rSum;
            END_IF;
        END_FOR;
    END_FOR;

    (* 2. Evaluate Quadratic Cost Function J *)
    rQuadraticCost_J := 0.0;
    FOR k_step := 1 TO 5 DO
        FOR i := 1 TO 4 DO
            rTemp := aPredicted_x[k_step, i] - aTargetState_r[i];
            rQuadraticCost_J := rQuadraticCost_J + aWeight_Q[i] * (rTemp * rTemp);
        END_FOR;
    END_FOR;
    FOR k_step := 1 TO 3 DO
        FOR j := 1 TO 3 DO
            IF k_step = 1 THEN
                rTemp := aPredicted_u[1, j] - aControl_u_prev[j];
            ELSE
                rTemp := aPredicted_u[k_step, j] - aPredicted_u[k_step - 1, j];
            END_IF;
            rQuadraticCost_J := rQuadraticCost_J + aWeight_R[j] * (rTemp * rTemp);
        END_FOR;
    END_FOR;

    (* 3. Compute Cost Gradients with respect to first control step u(k) *)
    (* Gradient component for charging valve *)
    aGradient_g[1] := 2.0 * matB[1, 1] * aWeight_Q[1] * (aPredicted_x[1, 1] - aTargetState_r[1])
                    + 2.0 * aWeight_R[1] * (aPredicted_u[1, 1] - aControl_u_prev[1]);
    (* Gradient component for venting valve *)
    aGradient_g[2] := 2.0 * matB[1, 2] * aWeight_Q[1] * (aPredicted_x[1, 1] - aTargetState_r[1])
                    + 2.0 * aWeight_R[2] * (aPredicted_u[1, 2] - aControl_u_prev[2]);
    (* Gradient component for bypass flow *)
    aGradient_g[3] := 2.0 * matB[3, 3] * aWeight_Q[3] * (aPredicted_x[1, 3] - aTargetState_r[3])
                    + 2.0 * aWeight_R[3] * (aPredicted_u[1, 3] - aControl_u_prev[3]);

    (* 4. Update and Project Controls (Steepest Descent with Box Projection) *)
    aPredicted_u[1, 1] := aPredicted_u[1, 1] - rGradStepSize * aGradient_g[1];
    aPredicted_u[1, 2] := aPredicted_u[1, 2] - rGradStepSize * aGradient_g[2];
    aPredicted_u[1, 3] := aPredicted_u[1, 3] - rGradStepSize * aGradient_g[3];

    (* Project Charging Valve: [0.0% to 100.0%] and Slew Rate Limit *)
    IF aPredicted_u[1, 1] < rChargeValve_Min THEN aPredicted_u[1, 1] := rChargeValve_Min; END_IF;
    IF aPredicted_u[1, 1] > rChargeValve_Max THEN aPredicted_u[1, 1] := rChargeValve_Max; END_IF;
    IF (aPredicted_u[1, 1] - aControl_u_prev[1]) > (rValveSlewRateLimit * rDt) THEN
        aPredicted_u[1, 1] := aControl_u_prev[1] + (rValveSlewRateLimit * rDt);
    ELSIF (aPredicted_u[1, 1] - aControl_u_prev[1]) < -(rValveSlewRateLimit * rDt) THEN
        aPredicted_u[1, 1] := aControl_u_prev[1] - (rValveSlewRateLimit * rDt);
    END_IF;

    (* Project Venting Valve: [0.0% to 100.0%] and Slew Rate Limit *)
    IF aPredicted_u[1, 2] < rVentValve_Min THEN aPredicted_u[1, 2] := rVentValve_Min; END_IF;
    IF aPredicted_u[1, 2] > rVentValve_Max THEN aPredicted_u[1, 2] := rVentValve_Max; END_IF;
    IF (aPredicted_u[1, 2] - aControl_u_prev[2]) > (rValveSlewRateLimit * rDt) THEN
        aPredicted_u[1, 2] := aControl_u_prev[2] + (rValveSlewRateLimit * rDt);
    ELSIF (aPredicted_u[1, 2] - aControl_u_prev[2]) < -(rValveSlewRateLimit * rDt) THEN
        aPredicted_u[1, 2] := aControl_u_prev[2] - (rValveSlewRateLimit * rDt);
    END_IF;

    (* Project Bypass Flow: [-350 m3/h to +350 m3/h] *)
    IF aPredicted_u[1, 3] < rBypassFlow_Min THEN aPredicted_u[1, 3] := rBypassFlow_Min; END_IF;
    IF aPredicted_u[1, 3] > rBypassFlow_Max THEN aPredicted_u[1, 3] := rBypassFlow_Max; END_IF;
END_FOR;

(* Extract First Step Optimal Controls *)
aControl_u[1] := aPredicted_u[1, 1];
aControl_u[2] := aPredicted_u[1, 2];
aControl_u[3] := aPredicted_u[1, 3];

(* Split-Range Valve Overlap Elimination (Deadband Enforcement) *)
IF aControl_u[1] > rPneumaticSplitDeadband AND aControl_u[2] > rPneumaticSplitDeadband THEN
    IF aControl_u[1] >= aControl_u[2] THEN
        aControl_u[1] := aControl_u[1] - aControl_u[2];
        aControl_u[2] := 0.0;
    ELSE
        aControl_u[2] := aControl_u[2] - aControl_u[1];
        aControl_u[1] := 0.0;
    END_IF;
END_IF;

(* Assign Physical Actuator Outputs from MPC *)
IF iState = 60 OR iState = 70 OR iState = 30 THEN
    rAirChargeValve_Cmd   := aControl_u[1];
    rAirVentValve_Cmd     := aControl_u[2];
    rSlurryBypassFlow_Cmd := aControl_u[3];
ELSE
    rAirChargeValve_Cmd   := 0.0;
    rAirVentValve_Cmd     := 0.0;
    rSlurryBypassFlow_Cmd := 0.0;
END_IF;

FOR i := 1 TO 3 DO
    aControl_u_prev[i] := aControl_u[i];
END_FOR;

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
   MODULE 4: MULTI-ZONE HYDRAULIC THRUST CYLINDER ADVANCE SYNCHRONIZATION (CROSS-COUPLING)
   ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* Raw Stroke Feedback Mapping *)
aZoneStroke_Raw[1] := rCylinderStroke_ZoneA;
aZoneStroke_Raw[2] := rCylinderStroke_ZoneB;
aZoneStroke_Raw[3] := rCylinderStroke_ZoneC;
aZoneStroke_Raw[4] := rCylinderStroke_ZoneD;

(* Filter Cylinder Strokes and Compute Velocities via Filtered Differentiator *)
FOR i := 1 TO 4 DO
    aZoneStroke_Filt[i] := aZoneStroke_Filt[i] + rVelFilter_Alpha * (aZoneStroke_Raw[i] - aZoneStroke_Filt[i]);
    aZoneVelocity_Raw[i] := (aZoneStroke_Filt[i] - aZoneStroke_Prev[i]) / rDt * 60.0; (* [mm/min] *)
    aZoneVelocity_Filt[i] := aZoneVelocity_Filt[i] + rVelFilter_Alpha * (aZoneVelocity_Raw[i] - aZoneVelocity_Filt[i]);
    aZoneStroke_Prev[i] := aZoneStroke_Filt[i];
END_FOR;

rAdvanceRate_Actual := 0.25 * (aZoneVelocity_Filt[1] + aZoneVelocity_Filt[2] + aZoneVelocity_Filt[3] + aZoneVelocity_Filt[4]);

(* Integrate Virtual Master Stroke *)
IF (iState = 60) AND NOT bRingErectionHoldMode THEN
    rMasterStroke_Virtual := rMasterStroke_Virtual + (rTargetAdvanceVelocity / 60.0) * rDt;
END_IF;

(* Geometric Decoupling for Steering Trajectory (Pitch and Yaw) *)
(* Delta_s_pitch = D_pitch * tan(theta_pitch) ~= D_pitch * theta_pitch [mrad -> mm] *)
rPitchDeltaStroke_Cmd := (rPitchCylinderDiameter * 1000.0) * (rTargetPitchAngle_mrad / 1000.0);
rYawDeltaStroke_Cmd   := (rPitchCylinderDiameter * 1000.0) * (rTargetYawAngle_mrad / 1000.0);

aZoneStroke_Target[1] := rMasterStroke_Virtual + (0.5 * rPitchDeltaStroke_Cmd); (* Zone A (Crown) *)
aZoneStroke_Target[3] := rMasterStroke_Virtual - (0.5 * rPitchDeltaStroke_Cmd); (* Zone C (Invert) *)
aZoneStroke_Target[2] := rMasterStroke_Virtual + (0.5 * rYawDeltaStroke_Cmd);   (* Zone B (Right) *)
aZoneStroke_Target[4] := rMasterStroke_Virtual - (0.5 * rYawDeltaStroke_Cmd);   (* Zone D (Left) *)

(* Compute Individual Tracking Errors e_i *)
FOR i := 1 TO 4 DO
    aTrackingError_e[i] := aZoneStroke_Filt[i] - aZoneStroke_Target[i];
END_FOR;

(* Synthesize Cross-Coupling Synchronization Errors epsilon_i *)
FOR i := 1 TO 4 DO
    rSum := 0.0;
    FOR j := 1 TO 4 DO
        IF i <> j THEN
            rSum := rSum + (aTrackingError_e[i] - aTrackingError_e[j]);
        END_IF;
    END_FOR;
    aSyncError_epsilon[i] := aTrackingError_e[i] + rCrossCouplingCoeff_alpha * rSum;
END_FOR;

(* Verify Spatial Synchronization Tolerance (< 2.0 mm peak deviation across all zones) *)
bThrustSynchronized := (ABS(aTrackingError_e[1] - aTrackingError_e[3]) <= 2.0) AND
                       (ABS(aTrackingError_e[2] - aTrackingError_e[4]) <= 2.0);

(* Multi-Zone PID Regulation and Pressure Command Synthesis *)
rTotalThrustForce_MN := 0.0;
FOR i := 1 TO 4 DO
    (* Proportional Term *)
    aZonePID_P[i] := - rZone_Kp * aSyncError_epsilon[i];

    (* Integral Term with Anti-Windup Clamping *)
    IF (iState = 60) AND NOT bRingErectionHoldMode THEN
        aZonePID_I[i] := aZonePID_I[i] - (rZone_Kp / rZone_Ti) * aSyncError_epsilon[i] * rDt;
        IF aZonePID_I[i] > rZone_IntegralMax THEN aZonePID_I[i] := rZone_IntegralMax; END_IF;
        IF aZonePID_I[i] < rZone_IntegralMin THEN aZonePID_I[i] := rZone_IntegralMin; END_IF;
    ELSE
        aZonePID_I[i] := 0.0; (* Reset during standby *)
    END_IF;

    (* Derivative Term *)
    aZonePID_D[i] := - rZone_Kp * rZone_Td * (aSyncError_epsilon[i] - aZonePID_PrevError[i]) / rDt;
    aZonePID_PrevError[i] := aSyncError_epsilon[i];

    (* Total Pressure Allocation per Zone *)
    IF iState = 60 THEN
        aZoneThrustPressure_Cmd[i] := rBaseThrustPressure + aZonePID_P[i] + aZonePID_I[i] + aZonePID_D[i];
        (* Limit within safe structural hydraulic bounds [40 bar to 345 bar] *)
        IF aZoneThrustPressure_Cmd[i] < 40.0 THEN aZoneThrustPressure_Cmd[i] := 40.0; END_IF;
        IF aZoneThrustPressure_Cmd[i] > 345.0 THEN aZoneThrustPressure_Cmd[i] := 345.0; END_IF;
    ELSIF iState = 40 OR iState = 50 OR iState = 70 THEN
        (* Holding pressure during ring build or pre-load *)
        aZoneThrustPressure_Cmd[i] := 65.0;
    ELSE
        aZoneThrustPressure_Cmd[i] := 0.0;
    END_IF;

    (* Sum total thrust force: 12 cylinders per zone * piston area (dia 320 mm) *)
    (* Piston Area = PI/4 * (0.320)^2 = 0.08042 m2 per cylinder *)
    (* Force per zone = 12 * 0.08042 m2 * (p_bar * 100 kPa) = 12 * 0.08042 * p_bar * 0.1 MN *)
    rTotalThrustForce_MN := rTotalThrustForce_MN + (12.0 * 0.08042 * aZoneThrustPressure_Cmd[i] * 0.1);
END_FOR;

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
   MODULE 5: CUTTERHEAD HYDRO-MECHANICAL TORSIONAL VIBRATION ACTIVE DAMPING & LOAD BALANCING
   ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* Convert Speed from RPM to Rad/s *)
rCutterheadSpeed_rads := rCutterheadSpeed_Meas * (2.0 * rPI / 60.0);
rCutterheadAccel_rads2 := (rCutterheadSpeed_rads - rCutterheadSpeed_Prev) / rDt;
rCutterheadSpeed_Prev := rCutterheadSpeed_rads;

(* 4th-Order IIR Bandpass Butterworth Filter Execution *)
(* Update input shift register *)
aIIR_x[4] := aIIR_x[3];
aIIR_x[3] := aIIR_x[2];
aIIR_x[2] := aIIR_x[1];
aIIR_x[1] := aIIR_x[0];
aIIR_x[0] := rCutterheadSpeed_rads;

(* Compute filtered output y[k] *)
rTemp := (b0_bp * aIIR_x[0]) + (b1_bp * aIIR_x[1]) + (b2_bp * aIIR_x[2]) + (b3_bp * aIIR_x[3]) + (b4_bp * aIIR_x[4])
       - (a1_bp * aIIR_y[1]) - (a2_bp * aIIR_y[2]) - (a3_bp * aIIR_y[3]) - (a4_bp * aIIR_y[4]);

aIIR_y[4] := aIIR_y[3];
aIIR_y[3] := aIIR_y[2];
aIIR_y[2] := aIIR_y[1];
aIIR_y[1] := rTemp;
aIIR_y[0] := rTemp;

rOmega_Oscillatory := aIIR_y[0];

(* Active Hydro-Mechanical Damping Torque Synthesis *)
(* T_damp = - Kad * omega_osc - Jvirt * d(omega_osc)/dt *)
rTemp2 := (aIIR_y[0] - aIIR_y[1]) / rDt; (* Derivative of oscillatory velocity *)
rActiveDampingTorque_Cmd := - (rDampingGain_Kad * rOmega_Oscillatory) - (rVirtualInertia_Jvirt * rTemp2);

(* Saturation Limiting *)
IF rActiveDampingTorque_Cmd > rMaxDampingTorqueLimit THEN
    rActiveDampingTorque_Cmd := rMaxDampingTorqueLimit;
ELSIF rActiveDampingTorque_Cmd < -rMaxDampingTorqueLimit THEN
    rActiveDampingTorque_Cmd := -rMaxDampingTorqueLimit;
END_IF;

(* Leaky Peak Detector for Torsional Oscillation Amplitude *)
IF rActiveDampingTorque_Cmd > rTorsionalPeakPositive THEN
    rTorsionalPeakPositive := rActiveDampingTorque_Cmd;
ELSE
    rTorsionalPeakPositive := rTorsionalPeakPositive * rTorsionalDecayRate;
END_IF;

IF rActiveDampingTorque_Cmd < rTorsionalPeakNegative THEN
    rTorsionalPeakNegative := rActiveDampingTorque_Cmd;
ELSE
    rTorsionalPeakNegative := rTorsionalPeakNegative * rTorsionalDecayRate;
END_IF;

rCutterheadTorsionalOscillation_Amp := rTorsionalPeakPositive - rTorsionalPeakNegative;

(* High Torsional Vibration Alarm Threshold (> 3200 kNm peak-to-peak) *)
IF rCutterheadTorsionalOscillation_Amp > 3200.0 THEN
    wTBM_AlarmWord := wTBM_AlarmWord OR 16#0200; (* Bit 9: Torsional Resonance Critical Alert *)
ELSE
    wTBM_AlarmWord := wTBM_AlarmWord AND NOT 16#0200;
END_IF;

(* Active Load-Sharing Loop across 16 Drive Pinions *)
rSum := 0.0;
FOR i := 1 TO 16 DO
    rSum := rSum + aPinionTorques[i];
END_FOR;
aPinionTorque_Avg := rSum / 16.0;

FOR i := 1 TO 16 DO
    aPinionTorqueError[i] := aPinionTorque_Avg - aPinionTorques[i];
    IF iState = 50 OR iState = 60 THEN
        aPinionPID_I[i] := aPinionPID_I[i] + (rPinion_Kp / rPinion_Ti) * aPinionTorqueError[i] * rDt;
        IF aPinionPID_I[i] > rMaxPinionTrimLimit THEN aPinionPID_I[i] := rMaxPinionTrimLimit; END_IF;
        IF aPinionPID_I[i] < -rMaxPinionTrimLimit THEN aPinionPID_I[i] := -rMaxPinionTrimLimit; END_IF;
    ELSE
        aPinionPID_I[i] := 0.0;
    END_IF;
    aPinionTorqueTrim_Cmd[i] := (rPinion_Kp * aPinionTorqueError[i]) + aPinionPID_I[i];
END_FOR;

(* Update Previous State Vector for Next Execution Scan *)
FOR i := 1 TO 4 DO
    aState_x_prev[i] := aState_x[i];
END_FOR;

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
   MODULE 6: MULTI-STAGE OPERATIONAL STATE MACHINE (CASE MACHINE)
   ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
tStateTimer(IN := (iState = iPreviousState), PT := T#86400S);
iPreviousState := iState;

CASE iState OF
    0: (* COLD_BOOT_UNINITIALIZED *)
        wTBM_StatusWord := 16#0001; (* State 0 Active *)
        rAirChargeValve_Cmd := 0.0;
        rAirVentValve_Cmd := 0.0;
        rSlurryBypassFlow_Cmd := 0.0;
        aZoneThrustPressure_Cmd[1] := 0.0;
        aZoneThrustPressure_Cmd[2] := 0.0;
        aZoneThrustPressure_Cmd[3] := 0.0;
        aZoneThrustPressure_Cmd[4] := 0.0;

       polytropic head rise per stage delta_h_p = mu * u_tip^2 yields very modest pressure ratios (typically
       1.10 to 1.18 per stage) because of hydrogen's massive heat capacity (c_p approx 14.3 kJ/(kg*K)).
       Achieving a compression ratio of 2.0 (e.g. 50 bar suction to 100 bar pipeline discharge) requires
       either an ultra-high shaft speed (18,500 - 24,000 RPM) multi-stage barrel casing (API 617 Type BCD)
       with 6 to 8 impellers, or multi-body geared arrangements.
     - Equation of State (EOS) at 100 bar: Hydrogen deviates significantly from ideal gas behavior.
       Unlike hydrocarbons which exhibit Z < 1.0 at moderate pressures due to attractive van der Waals forces,
       hydrogen molecules at ambient temperatures exhibit repulsive intermolecular forces, yielding Z > 1.0
       (Z approx 1.055 to 1.065 at 100 bar).
       Furthermore, the Joule-Thomson inversion temperature of pure hydrogen is approximately 202 K (-71 deg C).
       At pipeline ambient and operating temperatures (280 K to 360 K), the Joule-Thomson coefficient mu_JT is
       NEGATIVE (mu_JT < 0). Therefore, throttling or depressurizing high-pressure hydrogen across a valve
       causes heating rather than cooling! This thermal phenomenon poses critical safety risks to valve seats
       and downstream pipe metallurgical integrity.

  2. DYNAMIC SURGE INSTABILITY & LOW-MACH ANTI-SURGE RECYCLE MODULATION:
     - The steep head-capacity characteristic of low-Mach hydrogen impellers compresses the operating envelope
       between the choke limit and the surge limit line (SLL).
     - Acoustic wave transit times across the pipeline header and recycle piping are extremely short because
       of the 1,320+ m/s sound speed. Consequently, the characteristic Helmholtz resonance frequency of the
       compression system:
          omega_H = a * sqrt( A_c / (V_p * L_c) )
       shifts to high frequencies (10 Hz to 30 Hz). Surge inception in pure hydrogen does not manifest as a
       sluggish pressure oscillation; it develops into violent deep surge with flow reversals occurring in tens
       of milliseconds, exposing impellers to catastrophic high-cycle fatigue (HCF) and hydrogen embrittlement.
     - To safeguard the turbocompressor, this Function Block integrates a multi-tier anti-surge defense:
       a) Steady-state Surge Limit Line (SLL) mapped as a parabolic boundary in reduced polytropic head vs.
          orifice differential pressure coordinates: (q_red)^2 vs. h_p.
       b) Dynamic Surge Control Line (SCL) positioned with a baseline 12.0% safety margin, dynamically expanded
          by motor acceleration rate, gas molecular weight deviations, and acoustic pulsation energy.
       c) Dynamic Rate-of-Approach Derivative Kick (dSigma/dt): If the operating point moves toward surge faster
          than -15.0%/s, an open-loop proportional valve kick bias is injected immediately, bypassing PID lag.
       d) Solenoid Quick-Dump Line (SKL): Independent 2oo3 trip of dual de-energize-to-trip fast solenoids
          forcing the anti-surge recycle valve to 100% open stroke in < 350 ms.

  3. DRY GAS SEAL (DGS) LEAKAGE VACUUM EXTRACTION & NITROGEN BARRIER INTEGRITY:
     - Transcontinental hydrogen transmission at 100 bar utilizes triple-tandem dry gas seals with spiral-groove
       faces operating on non-contacting hydrodynamic gas films (1.5 to 3.0 microns gap).
     - Primary seal gas (conditioned pure H2 at P_suction + 3.5 bar) leaks past the primary face into the primary
       vent cavity. Under 100 bar differential, normal primary leakage is 3.0 to 8.0 Nm3/h per seal cartridge.
     - If allowed to accumulate at atmospheric or positive pressure, hydrogen leakage creates an explosive risk
       and can blow past secondary carbon rings. This controller implements an active closed-loop Vacuum
       Extraction Subsystem utilizing a liquid ring vacuum pump / nitrogen-driven supersonic ejector to maintain
       the primary vent cavity at a controlled sub-atmospheric depression (-50 to -100 mbar gauge, setpoint -80 mbar).
     - Secondary seal stage is buffered with pure Nitrogen (N2) at 1.5 to 2.5 bar gauge, preventing any H2
       from migrating into atmospheric bearing cavities. Continuous thermal conductivity / catalytic Lower
       Explosive Limit (% LEL) sensors monitor vent streams with automatic SIL-3 ESD trip at 50% LEL.

  4. PIPELINE ACOUSTIC WAVE STANDING WAVE PULSATION DAMPING:
     - Centrifugal turbocompressor blade-pass frequencies and aerodynamic diffuser stall cells excite acoustic
       cavity resonance modes in the 100 bar discharge manifold.
     - With a sound speed of a approx 1,350 m/s in high-pressure hydrogen, pipe acoustic standing waves develop
       in header segments (L = 3.14 m corresponds to a half-wave resonance f_1 = a / (2*L) approx 215 Hz).
     - Pipeline acoustic pulsations induce high-frequency cyclic strain in pipeline girth welds, accelerating
       hydrogen-assisted fatigue crack growth (HA-FCG) in accordance with ASME B31.12 guidelines.
     - This FB features an Active Acoustic Wave Pulsation Damping algorithm:
       a) Dynamic pressure transducers sampled at high speed.
       b) A 2nd-order digital Butterworth IIR bandpass filter isolating the 120 - 350 Hz resonant band.
       c) Moving-window RMS energy integration over 100 samples.
       d) Phase-lead compensation generating a micro-dither counter-phase modulation (0.5% to 2.5% stroke)
          superimposed onto the anti-surge recycle valve positioner to disrupt acoustic reflection nodes.

  5. TRIPLE MODULAR REDUNDANCY (2oo3 TMR) & GRACEFUL SENSOR DEGRADATION:
     - Suction pressure, discharge pressure, flow orifice differential pressure, suction temperature,
       discharge temperature, and rotor rotational speed are each measured via three galvanically isolated channels.
     - The voting engine executes continuous sensor diagnostics:
       * Range validation (out-of-bounds detection: open circuit / short circuit).
       * Signal freeze detection (zero standard deviation over rolling window).
       * Cross-channel deviation thresholding (|CH_i - CH_j| > Delta_tol).
     - Voting strategy:
       * 3 Healthy Channels: Mid-value selection (median filter) with zero bumpless discontinuity.
       * 1 Channel Fault: Degrades automatically to 1oo2 average of the two healthy channels, latching a
         Warning status bit without interrupting plant availability.
       * 2 Channels Fault: Degrades to 1oo1 single-channel mode, raising a high-priority diagnostic alarm.
       * 3 Channels Fault: Fails safe to immediate SIL-3 Emergency Stop (ESD) compressor trip.

  6. DISCRETE STATE-SPACE MODEL & MODEL PREDICTIVE CONTROL (MPC) FORMULATION:
     - The physical process is represented by a 5-state, 3-input, 4-output discretized linear time-invariant
       state-space system:
          x[k+1] = A_d * x[k] + B_d * u[k]
          y[k]   = C_d * x[k] + D_d * u[k]
       where the state vector is:
          x = [ Delta_Flow_kg_s, Delta_P_disch_bar, Delta_P_suct_bar, Delta_Speed_rpm, Delta_P_acoustic_mbar ]^T
       the manipulated input vector is:
          u = [ Delta_ASV_Valve_pct, Delta_Speed_Ref_rpm, Delta_Vac_Valve_pct ]^T
       and the controlled output vector is:
          y = [ Delta_Surge_Margin_pct, Delta_Pressure_Ratio, Delta_Seal_DP_bar, Delta_Pulsation_RMS_mbar ]^T
     - Quadratic cost function over prediction horizon N_p = 5 and control horizon N_c = 3:
          J = sum_{i=1}^{N_p} (y[k+i] - y_sp)^T * Q * (y[k+i] - y_sp) + sum_{j=0}^{N_c-1} Delta_u[k+j]^T * R * Delta_u[k+j]
     - Asymmetric valve rate constraints: Opening slew rate up to +300%/s (fast unchoking), closing slew rate
       limited to -20%/s (preventing inadvertent surge triggers).
     - Projected gradient iteration with fallback to decoupled lead-lag anti-surge PID upon ill-conditioning.
========================================================================================================================
*)

    (* Head = K0 + K1*Flow^2 in reduced coordinates *)
    c_rSLL_K0                       : REAL := 185.0;    (* SLL zero-flow polytropic head intercept [kJ/kg] *)
    c_rSLL_K2                       : REAL := -0.0042;  (* SLL parabolic curvature coefficient *)
    c_rBaseSurgeMargin_pct          : REAL := 12.0;     (* Baseline steady-state surge safety margin [%] *)
    c_rBackupSurgeMargin_pct        : REAL := 6.0;      (* Surge Backup Line (SBL) margin [%] *)
    c_rSolenoidTripMargin_pct       : REAL := 2.0;      (* Solenoid Kick Line (SKL) trip margin [%] *)

    (* Acoustic Resonator & IIR Bandpass Filter Coefficients *)
    (* Discretized 2nd-order Butterworth: center = 215 Hz, Q = 3.5 *)
    c_rIIR_b0                       : REAL := 0.1826;
    c_rIIR_b1                       : REAL := 0.0000;
    c_rIIR_b2                       : REAL := -0.1826;
    c_rIIR_a1                       : REAL := -1.3412;
    c_rIIR_a2                       : REAL := 0.6348;
    c_rAcousticPhaseLeadGain        : REAL := 0.0018;   (* Phase lead sensitivity gain [%/mbar] *)
    c_rAcousticDitherMaxClamp_pct   : REAL := 2.50;     (* Maximum allowable micro-dither amplitude [%] *)

    (* Dry Gas Seal Safety Boundaries *)
    c_rMinPrimarySealDP_bar         : REAL := 3.50;     (* Minimum primary seal gas DP over suction [bar] *)
    c_rCriticalLowSealDP_bar        : REAL := 2.00;     (* SIL-3 Critical seal DP trip threshold [bar] *)
    c_rVacSetpoint_mbar             : REAL := -80.0;    (* Primary vent sub-atmospheric setpoint [mbar gauge] *)
    c_rMaxPrimaryVentPress_mbar     : REAL := 800.0;    (* Primary vent high warning limit [mbar gauge] *)
    c_rTripPrimaryVentPress_mbar    : REAL := 1500.0;   (* Primary vent SIL-3 trip limit [mbar gauge] *)
    c_rMaxPrimaryLeakage_Nm3h       : REAL := 12.0;     (* Primary leakage high warning [Nm3/h] *)
    c_rTripPrimaryLeakage_Nm3h      : REAL := 25.0;     (* Primary leakage SIL-3 trip [Nm3/h] *)
    c_rTripH2Concentration_LEL      : REAL := 50.0;     (* Vent duct hydrogen concentration trip [% LEL] *)

    (* Actuator Slew Rates *)
    c_rASV_MaxOpenRate_pct_s        : REAL := 300.0;    (* Anti-surge fast opening stroke rate [%/s] *)
    c_rASV_MaxCloseRate_pct_s       : REAL := 20.0;     (* Anti-surge slow closing stroke rate [%/s] *)
    c_rSpeed_MaxRampRate_rpm_s      : REAL := 250.0;    (* Motor speed acceleration/deceleration ramp [rpm/s] *)
END_VAR

(* === 1. SYSTEM INITIALIZATION, CLOCK MONITORING & WATCHDOGS === *)
diScanCounter := diScanCounter + 1;

(* Clamp discrete delta time between 1 ms and 50 ms to preserve numerical stability *)
IF rCycleTime_s >= 0.001 AND rCycleTime_s <= 0.050 THEN
    rDt := rCycleTime_s;
ELSE
    rDt := 0.005; (* Default to 5 ms deterministic task rate *)
END_IF;

(* Clear cycle diagnostic warning words before evaluation *)
dwWarningWord1 := 16#00000000;
dwWarningWord2 := 16#00000000;
bDegradedSensorMode := FALSE;

(* === 2. TRIPLE MODULAR REDUNDANCY (2oo3) SENSOR VOTING ENGINE === *)
(* Populate Raw Arrays *)
arrSuctPress_Raw[1]  := rSuctionPress_CH1_bar;
arrSuctPress_Raw[2]  := rSuctionPress_CH2_bar;
arrSuctPress_Raw[3]  := rSuctionPress_CH3_bar;

arrDischPress_Raw[1] := rDischargePress_CH1_bar;
arrDischPress_Raw[2] := rDischargePress_CH2_bar;
arrDischPress_Raw[3] := rDischargePress_CH3_bar;

arrFlowDP_Raw[1]     := rSuctionFlowDP_CH1_mbar;
arrFlowDP_Raw[2]     := rSuctionFlowDP_CH2_mbar;
arrFlowDP_Raw[3]     := rSuctionFlowDP_CH3_mbar;

arrSuctTemp_Raw[1]   := rSuctionTemp_CH1_K;
arrSuctTemp_Raw[2]   := rSuctionTemp_CH2_K;
arrSuctTemp_Raw[3]   := rSuctionTemp_CH3_K;

arrDischTemp_Raw[1]  := rDischargeTemp_CH1_K;
arrDischTemp_Raw[2]  := rDischargeTemp_CH2_K;
arrDischTemp_Raw[3]  := rDischargeTemp_CH3_K;

arrSpeed_Raw[1]      := rShaftSpeed_CH1_rpm;
arrSpeed_Raw[2]      := rShaftSpeed_CH2_rpm;
arrSpeed_Raw[3]      := rShaftSpeed_CH3_rpm;

(* 2.1 SUCTION PRESSURE 2oo3 VOTING & DIAGNOSTICS *)
FOR iState := 1 TO 3 DO
    (* Range check: 0.0 to 140.0 bar *)
    IF arrSuctPress_Raw[iState] < 0.5 OR arrSuctPress_Raw[iState] > 140.0 THEN
        arrSuctPress_Health[iState] := FALSE;
    ELSE
        arrSuctPress_Health[iState] := TRUE;
    END_IF;
END_FOR;

IF arrSuctPress_Health[1] AND arrSuctPress_Health[2] AND arrSuctPress_Health[3] THEN
    (* Cross-channel deviation checks (1.5 bar threshold) *)
    IF ABS(arrSuctPress_Raw[1] - arrSuctPress_Raw[2]) > 1.5 OR
       ABS(arrSuctPress_Raw[2] - arrSuctPress_Raw[3]) > 1.5 OR
       ABS(arrSuctPress_Raw[3] - arrSuctPress_Raw[1]) > 1.5 THEN
        dwWarningWord2 := dwWarningWord2 OR 16#00000001; (* Bit 0: Suction Pressure Discrepancy *)
    END_IF;
    (* Mid-Value Median Filter *)
    IF (arrSuctPress_Raw[1] >= arrSuctPress_Raw[2] AND arrSuctPress_Raw[1] <= arrSuctPress_Raw[3]) OR
       (arrSuctPress_Raw[1] >= arrSuctPress_Raw[3] AND arrSuctPress_Raw[1] <= arrSuctPress_Raw[2]) THEN
        rSuctPress_Voted_bar := arrSuctPress_Raw[1];
    ELSIF (arrSuctPress_Raw[2] >= arrSuctPress_Raw[1] AND arrSuctPress_Raw[2] <= arrSuctPress_Raw[3]) OR
          (arrSuctPress_Raw[2] >= arrSuctPress_Raw[3] AND arrSuctPress_Raw[2] <= arrSuctPress_Raw[1]) THEN
        rSuctPress_Voted_bar := arrSuctPress_Raw[2];
    ELSE
        rSuctPress_Voted_bar := arrSuctPress_Raw[3];
    END_IF;
ELSIF arrSuctPress_Health[1] AND arrSuctPress_Health[2] THEN
    rSuctPress_Voted_bar := (arrSuctPress_Raw[1] + arrSuctPress_Raw[2]) * 0.5;
    bDegradedSensorMode := TRUE;
    dwWarningWord2 := dwWarningWord2 OR 16#00000020; (* Bit 5: Degraded 1oo2 Mode *)
ELSIF arrSuctPress_Health[2] AND arrSuctPress_Health[3] THEN
    rSuctPress_Voted_bar := (arrSuctPress_Raw[2] + arrSuctPress_Raw[3]) * 0.5;
    bDegradedSensorMode := TRUE;
    dwWarningWord2 := dwWarningWord2 OR 16#00000020;
ELSIF arrSuctPress_Health[1] AND arrSuctPress_Health[3] THEN
    rSuctPress_Voted_bar := (arrSuctPress_Raw[1] + arrSuctPress_Raw[3]) * 0.5;
    bDegradedSensorMode := TRUE;
    dwWarningWord2 := dwWarningWord2 OR 16#00000020;
ELSIF arrSuctPress_Health[1] THEN
    rSuctPress_Voted_bar := arrSuctPress_Raw[1];
    bDegradedSensorMode := TRUE;
    dwWarningWord2 := dwWarningWord2 OR 16#00000040; (* Bit 6: Degraded 1oo1 Mode *)
ELSIF arrSuctPress_Health[2] THEN
    rSuctPress_Voted_bar := arrSuctPress_Raw[2];
    bDegradedSensorMode := TRUE;
    dwWarningWord2 := dwWarningWord2 OR 16#00000040;
ELSIF arrSuctPress_Health[3] THEN
    rSuctPress_Voted_bar := arrSuctPress_Raw[3];
    bDegradedSensorMode := TRUE;
    dwWarningWord2 := dwWarningWord2 OR 16#00000040;
ELSE
    rSuctPress_Voted_bar := c_rDesignSuctionPressure_bar;
    dwAlarmWord1 := dwAlarmWord1 OR 16#00000002; (* Bit 1: Triple Suction Transmitter Failure *)
END_IF;

(* 2.2 DISCHARGE PRESSURE 2oo3 VOTING & DIAGNOSTICS *)
FOR iState := 1 TO 3 DO
    IF arrDischPress_Raw[iState] < 0.5 OR arrDischPress_Raw[iState] > 160.0 THEN
        arrDischPress_Health[iState] := FALSE;
    ELSE
        arrDischPress_Health[iState] := TRUE;
    END_IF;
END_FOR;

IF arrDischPress_Health[1] AND arrDischPress_Health[2] AND arrDischPress_Health[3] THEN
    IF ABS(arrDischPress_Raw[1] - arrDischPress_Raw[2]) > 2.0 OR
       ABS(arrDischPress_Raw[2] - arrDischPress_Raw[3]) > 2.0 OR
       ABS(arrDischPress_Raw[3] - arrDischPress_Raw[1]) > 2.0 THEN
        dwWarningWord2 := dwWarningWord2 OR 16#00000002; (* Bit 1: Discharge Pressure Discrepancy *)
    END_IF;
    IF (arrDischPress_Raw[1] >= arrDischPress_Raw[2] AND arrDischPress_Raw[1] <= arrDischPress_Raw[3]) OR
       (arrDischPress_Raw[1] >= arrDischPress_Raw[3] AND arrDischPress_Raw[1] <= arrDischPress_Raw[2]) THEN
        rDischPress_Voted_bar := arrDischPress_Raw[1];
    ELSIF (arrDischPress_Raw[2] >= arrDischPress_Raw[1] AND arrDischPress_Raw[2] <= arrDischPress_Raw[3]) OR
          (arrDischPress_Raw[2] >= arrDischPress_Raw[3] AND arrDischPress_Raw[2] <= arrDischPress_Raw[1]) THEN
        rDischPress_Voted_bar := arrDischPress_Raw[2];
    ELSE
        rDischPress_Voted_bar := arrDischPress_Raw[3];
    END_IF;
ELSIF arrDischPress_Health[1] AND arrDischPress_Health[2] THEN
    rDischPress_Voted_bar := (arrDischPress_Raw[1] + arrDischPress_Raw[2]) * 0.5;
    bDegradedSensorMode := TRUE;
    dwWarningWord2 := dwWarningWord2 OR 16#00000020;
ELSIF arrDischPress_Health[2] AND arrDischPress_Health[3] THEN
    rDischPress_Voted_bar := (arrDischPress_Raw[2] + arrDischPress_Raw[3]) * 0.5;
    bDegradedSensorMode := TRUE;
    dwWarningWord2 := dwWarningWord2 OR 16#00000020;
ELSIF arrDischPress_Health[1] AND arrDischPress_Health[3] THEN
    rDischPress_Voted_bar := (arrDischPress_Raw[1] + arrDischPress_Raw[3]) * 0.5;
    bDegradedSensorMode := TRUE;
    dwWarningWord2 := dwWarningWord2 OR 16#00000020;
ELSIF arrDischPress_Health[1] THEN
    rDischPress_Voted_bar := arrDischPress_Raw[1];
    bDegradedSensorMode := TRUE;
    dwWarningWord2 := dwWarningWord2 OR 16#00000040;
ELSIF arrDischPress_Health[2] THEN
    rDischPress_Voted_bar := arrDischPress_Raw[2];
    bDegradedSensorMode := TRUE;
    dwWarningWord2 := dwWarningWord2 OR 16#00000040;
ELSIF arrDischPress_Health[3] THEN
    rDischPress_Voted_bar := arrDischPress_Raw[3];
    bDegradedSensorMode := TRUE;
    dwWarningWord2 := dwWarningWord2 OR 16#00000040;
ELSE
    rDischPress_Voted_bar := c_rDesignDischargePressure_bar;
    dwAlarmWord1 := dwAlarmWord1 OR 16#00000004; (* Bit 2: Triple Discharge Transmitter Failure *)
END_IF;

(* 2.3 SUCTION FLOW ORIFICE DIFFERENTIAL PRESSURE 2oo3 VOTING *)
FOR iState := 1 TO 3 DO
    IF arrFlowDP_Raw[iState] < -5.0 OR arrFlowDP_Raw[iState] > 600.0 THEN
        arrFlowDP_Health[iState] := FALSE;
    ELSE
        arrFlowDP_Health[iState] := TRUE;
    END_IF;
END_FOR;

IF arrFlowDP_Health[1] AND arrFlowDP_Health[2] AND arrFlowDP_Health[3] THEN
    IF ABS(arrFlowDP_Raw[1] - arrFlowDP_Raw[2]) > 15.0 OR
       ABS(arrFlowDP_Raw[2] - arrFlowDP_Raw[3]) > 15.0 OR
       ABS(arrFlowDP_Raw[3] - arrFlowDP_Raw[1]) > 15.0 THEN
        dwWarningWord2 := dwWarningWord2 OR 16#00000004; (* Bit 2: Flow DP Discrepancy *)
    END_IF;
    IF (arrFlowDP_Raw[1] >= arrFlowDP_Raw[2] AND arrFlowDP_Raw[1] <= arrFlowDP_Raw[3]) OR
       (arrFlowDP_Raw[1] >= arrFlowDP_Raw[3] AND arrFlowDP_Raw[1] <= arrFlowDP_Raw[2]) THEN
        rFlowDP_Voted_mbar := arrFlowDP_Raw[1];
    ELSIF (arrFlowDP_Raw[2] >= arrFlowDP_Raw[1] AND arrFlowDP_Raw[2] <= arrFlowDP_Raw[3]) OR
          (arrFlowDP_Raw[2] >= arrFlowDP_Raw[3] AND arrFlowDP_Raw[2] <= arrFlowDP_Raw[1]) THEN
        rFlowDP_Voted_mbar := arrFlowDP_Raw[2];
    ELSE
        rFlowDP_Voted_mbar := arrFlowDP_Raw[3];
    END_IF;
ELSIF arrFlowDP_Health[1] AND arrFlowDP_Health[2] THEN
    rFlowDP_Voted_mbar := (arrFlowDP_Raw[1] + arrFlowDP_Raw[2]) * 0.5;
    bDegradedSensorMode := TRUE;
    dwWarningWord2 := dwWarningWord2 OR 16#00000020;
ELSIF arrFlowDP_Health[2] AND arrFlowDP_Health[3] THEN
    rFlowDP_Voted_mbar := (arrFlowDP_Raw[2] + arrFlowDP_Raw[3]) * 0.5;
    bDegradedSensorMode := TRUE;
    dwWarningWord2 := dwWarningWord2 OR 16#00000020;
ELSIF arrFlowDP_Health[1] AND arrFlowDP_Health[3] THEN
    rFlowDP_Voted_mbar := (arrFlowDP_Raw[1] + arrFlowDP_Raw[3]) * 0.5;
    bDegradedSensorMode := TRUE;
    dwWarningWord2 := dwWarningWord2 OR 16#00000020;
ELSIF arrFlowDP_Health[1] THEN
    rFlowDP_Voted_mbar := arrFlowDP_Raw[1];
    bDegradedSensorMode := TRUE;
    dwWarningWord2 := dwWarningWord2 OR 16#00000040;
ELSIF arrFlowDP_Health[2] THEN
    rFlowDP_Voted_mbar := arrFlowDP_Raw[2];
    bDegradedSensorMode := TRUE;
    dwWarningWord2 := dwWarningWord2 OR 16#00000040;
ELSIF arrFlowDP_Health[3] THEN
    rFlowDP_Voted_mbar := arrFlowDP_Raw[3];
    bDegradedSensorMode := TRUE;
    dwWarningWord2 := dwWarningWord2 OR 16#00000040;
ELSE
    rFlowDP_Voted_mbar := 0.0;
    dwAlarmWord1 := dwAlarmWord1 OR 16#00000008; (* Bit 3: Triple Flow DP Transmitter Failure *)
END_IF;

(* 2.4 TEMPERATURE & SHAFT SPEED 2oo3 VOTING *)
(* Suction Temperature Median Selection *)
IF (arrSuctTemp_Raw[1] >= arrSuctTemp_Raw[2] AND arrSuctTemp_Raw[1] <= arrSuctTemp_Raw[3]) OR
   (arrSuctTemp_Raw[1] >= arrSuctTemp_Raw[3] AND arrSuctTemp_Raw[1] <= arrSuctTemp_Raw[2]) THEN
    rSuctTemp_Voted_K := arrSuctTemp_Raw[1];
ELSIF (arrSuctTemp_Raw[2] >= arrSuctTemp_Raw[1] AND arrSuctTemp_Raw[2] <= arrSuctTemp_Raw[3]) OR
      (arrSuctTemp_Raw[2] >= arrSuctTemp_Raw[3] AND arrSuctTemp_Raw[2] <= arrSuctTemp_Raw[1]) THEN
    rSuctTemp_Voted_K := arrSuctTemp_Raw[2];
ELSE
    rSuctTemp_Voted_K := arrSuctTemp_Raw[3];
END_IF;
rSuctTemp_Voted_K := MAX(220.0, MIN(380.0, rSuctTemp_Voted_K));

(* Discharge Temperature Median Selection *)
IF (arrDischTemp_Raw[1] >= arrDischTemp_Raw[2] AND arrDischTemp_Raw[1] <= arrDischTemp_Raw[3]) OR
   (arrDischTemp_Raw[1] >= arrDischTemp_Raw[3] AND arrDischTemp_Raw[1] <= arrDischTemp_Raw[2]) THEN
    rDischTemp_Voted_K := arrDischTemp_Raw[1];
ELSIF (arrDischTemp_Raw[2] >= arrDischTemp_Raw[1] AND arrDischTemp_Raw[2] <= arrDischTemp_Raw[3]) OR
      (arrDischTemp_Raw[2] >= arrDischTemp_Raw[3] AND arrDischTemp_Raw[2] <= arrDischTemp_Raw[1]) THEN
    rDischTemp_Voted_K := arrDischTemp_Raw[2];
ELSE
    rDischTemp_Voted_K := arrDischTemp_Raw[3];
END_IF;
rDischTemp_Voted_K := MAX(220.0, MIN(450.0, rDischTemp_Voted_K));

(* Shaft Speed Median Selection *)
IF (arrSpeed_Raw[1] >= arrSpeed_Raw[2] AND arrSpeed_Raw[1] <= arrSpeed_Raw[3]) OR
   (arrSpeed_Raw[1] >= arrSpeed_Raw[3] AND arrSpeed_Raw[1] <= arrSpeed_Raw[2]) THEN
    rShaftSpeed_Voted_rpm := arrSpeed_Raw[1];
ELSIF (arrSpeed_Raw[2] >= arrSpeed_Raw[1] AND arrSpeed_Raw[2] <= arrSpeed_Raw[3]) OR
      (arrSpeed_Raw[2] >= arrSpeed_Raw[3] AND arrSpeed_Raw[2] <= arrSpeed_Raw[1]) THEN
    rShaftSpeed_Voted_rpm := arrSpeed_Raw[2];
ELSE
    rShaftSpeed_Voted_rpm := arrSpeed_Raw[3];
END_IF;
rShaftSpeed_Voted_rpm := MAX(0.0, MIN(25000.0, rShaftSpeed_Voted_rpm));

(* === 3. HIGH-PRESSURE HYDROGEN REAL-TIME THERMODYNAMICS & EQUATION OF STATE === *)
(* 3.1 Gas Composition & Molecular Weight Supervision *)
IF rGasMolecularWeight_gmol >= 1.80 AND rGasMolecularWeight_gmol <= 5.00 THEN
    rGasConstant_Rspec := c_rUniversalGasConstant / (rGasMolecularWeight_gmol * 0.001);
ELSE
    rGasConstant_Rspec := c_rUniversalGasConstant / (c_rNominalMolecularWeight_H2 * 0.001);
END_IF;

IF rGasSpecificHeatRatio >= 1.30 AND rGasSpecificHeatRatio <= 1.50 THEN
    rGamma := rGasSpecificHeatRatio;
ELSE
    rGamma := 1.405; (* Standard diatomic hydrogen specific heat ratio *)
END_IF;

(* 3.2 High-Pressure Compressibility Factor Z(P, T) via Virial EOS for Hydrogen *)
(* Z = 1 + [ b0 + b1*(300/T) ] * P_bar *)
rZ_Suct  := 1.0 + (0.00055 + 0.00015 * (300.0 / rSuctTemp_Voted_K)) * rSuctPress_Voted_bar;
rZ_Disch := 1.0 + (0.00055 + 0.00015 * (300.0 / rDischTemp_Voted_K)) * rDischPress_Voted_bar;
rZ_Avg   := (rZ_Suct + rZ_Disch) * 0.5;

(* 3.3 Suction Gas Density & Sonic Velocity *)
(* rho = (P * 10^5) / (Z * R_spec * T) [kg/m3] *)
rGasDensitySuction_kgm3 := (rSuctPress_Voted_bar * 100000.0) / (rZ_Suct * rGasConstant_Rspec * rSuctTemp_Voted_K);
rGasDensitySuction_kgm3 := MAX(0.5, MIN(25.0, rGasDensitySuction_kgm3));

(* Speed of sound: a = sqrt(gamma * Z * R_spec * T) [m/s] *)
rSpeedOfSound_ms := SQRT(rGamma * rZ_Avg * rGasConstant_Rspec * rSuctTemp_Voted_K);
rSpeedOfSound_ms := MAX(1000.0, MIN(1600.0, rSpeedOfSound_ms));

(* 3.4 Compression Ratio & Polytropic Head *)
IF rSuctPress_Voted_bar > 1.0 THEN
    rCompressionRatio := rDischPress_Voted_bar / rSuctPress_Voted_bar;
ELSE
    rCompressionRatio := 1.0;
END_IF;

(* Polytropic Exponent n and factor m = (n-1)/n, assuming stage polytropic efficiency approx 0.825 *)
rPolytropicFactor_m := (rGamma - 1.0) / (rGamma * 0.825);
rPolytropicExponent_n := 1.0 / (1.0 - rPolytropicFactor_m);

(* Polytropic Head: H_p = [ Z_avg * R_spec * T_suct / m ] * [ (Rc)^m - 1.0 ] [kJ/kg] *)
IF rCompressionRatio > 1.001 THEN
    rPolytropicHead_kJkg := (rZ_Avg * rGasConstant_Rspec * rSuctTemp_Voted_K / rPolytropicFactor_m) *
                            (EXPT(rCompressionRatio, rPolytropicFactor_m) - 1.0) * 0.001;
ELSE
    rPolytropicHead_kJkg := 0.0;
END_IF;
rPolytropicHead_kJkg := MAX(0.0, MIN(350.0, rPolytropicHead_kJkg));

(* 3.5 Mass Flow Rate & Reduced Flow Coordinates *)
(* Flow from differential pressure orifice: m_dot = C_d * eps * (pi/4)*d^2 * sqrt(2 * rho * DeltaP) *)
IF rFlowDP_Voted_mbar > 0.0 THEN
    rMassFlow_kgs := 0.0482 * SQRT(2.0 * rGasDensitySuction_kgm3 * (rFlowDP_Voted_mbar * 100.0));
ELSE
    rMassFlow_kgs := 0.0;
END_IF;
rActualVolumetricFlow_m3s := rMassFlow_kgs / rGasDensitySuction_kgm3;

(* Reduced Flow Squared: q_red^2 = (m_dot^2 * Z_suct * T_suct / MW) / P_suct^2 *)
IF rSuctPress_Voted_bar > 1.0 THEN
    rReducedFlow_Squared := (rMassFlow_kgs * rMassFlow_kgs * rZ_Suct * rSuctTemp_Voted_K /
                            (c_rNominalMolecularWeight_H2 * 0.001)) /
                            (rSuctPress_Voted_bar * rSuctPress_Voted_bar * 100.0);
ELSE
    rReducedFlow_Squared := 0.0;
END_IF;

(* === 4. DYNAMIC ANTI-SURGE LIMIT LINES & SURGE MARGIN METRICS === *)
(* 4.1 Parabolic Surge Limit Line (SLL) in Head vs Reduced Flow Squared *)
(* FlowSquared_SLL = (PolytropicHead - K0) / K2 *)
IF rPolytropicHead_kJkg >= c_rSLL_K0 THEN
    rFlowSquared_SLL := 0.50;
ELSE
    rFlowSquared_SLL := (rPolytropicHead_kJkg - c_rSLL_K0) / c_rSLL_K2;
END_IF;
rFlowSquared_SLL := MAX(0.50, MIN(120.0, rFlowSquared_SLL));

(* 4.2 Dynamic Biases to Safety Margin *)
(* Molecular Weight Bias: If gas is heavier than pure H2 due to contaminant ingress, shift SLL outward *)
IF rGasMolecularWeight_gmol > c_rNominalMolecularWeight_H2 THEN
    rMolecularWeightShiftBias_pct := (rGasMolecularWeight_gmol - c_rNominalMolecularWeight_H2) * 8.5;
ELSE
    rMolecularWeightShiftBias_pct := 0.0;
END_IF;

(* Acceleration Bias: When machine accelerates rapidly, add transient safety margin *)
IF (rShaftSpeed_Voted_rpm - rPrevShaftSpeed_rpm) > 5.0 THEN
    rAccelerationBias_pct := ((rShaftSpeed_Voted_rpm - rPrevShaftSpeed_rpm) / rDt) * 0.004;
ELSE
    rAccelerationBias_pct := 0.0;
END_IF;
rAccelerationBias_pct := MIN(6.0, rAccelerationBias_pct);

(* Acoustic Pulsation Bias: High standing waves in discharge line reduce aerodynamic boundary layer stability *)
IF rAcousticPulsationRMS_mbar > 1200.0 THEN
    rAcousticPulsationBias_pct := (rAcousticPulsationRMS_mbar - 1200.0) * 0.0025;
ELSE
    rAcousticPulsationBias_pct := 0.0;
END_IF;
rAcousticPulsationBias_pct := MIN(5.0, rAcousticPulsationBias_pct);

(* Total Dynamic Surge Control Margin *)
rDynamicSafetyMargin_pct := c_rBaseSurgeMargin_pct + rMolecularWeightShiftBias_pct +
                            rAccelerationBias_pct + rAcousticPulsationBias_pct;
rDynamicSafetyMargin_pct := MAX(10.0, MIN(28.0, rDynamicSafetyMargin_pct));

(* 4.3 Control Boundaries Coordinates *)
(* Surge Control Line (SCL) *)
rFlowSquared_SCL := rFlowSquared_SLL * (1.0 + rDynamicSafetyMargin_pct * 0.01) * (1.0 + rDynamicSafetyMargin_pct * 0.01);

(* Surge Backup Line (SBL) *)
rFlowSquared_SBL := rFlowSquared_SLL * (1.0 + c_rBackupSurgeMargin_pct * 0.01) * (1.0 + c_rBackupSurgeMargin_pct * 0.01);

(* Solenoid Trip Kick Line (SKL) *)
rFlowSquared_SKL := rFlowSquared_SLL * (1.0 + c_rSolenoidTripMargin_pct * 0.01) * (1.0 + c_rSolenoidTripMargin_pct * 0.01);

(* 4.4 Normalized Surge Margin & Rate of Approach *)
IF rFlowSquared_SLL > 0.01 THEN
    rSurgeMargin_pct := ((rReducedFlow_Squared - rFlowSquared_SLL) / rFlowSquared_SLL) * 100.0;
ELSE
    rSurgeMargin_pct := 50.0;
END_IF;

IF rFlowSquared_SCL > 0.01 THEN
    rDistanceToSCL_pct := ((rReducedFlow_Squared - rFlowSquared_SCL) / rFlowSquared_SCL) * 100.0;
ELSE
    rDistanceToSCL_pct := 25.0;
END_IF;

(* Numerical derivative of surge margin dSigma/dt [%/s] *)
rRateOfApproachToSurge_pct_s := (rSurgeMargin_pct - rPrevSurgeMargin_pct) / rDt;

(* Open-Loop Derivative Surge Kick Logic *)
IF bFastValveKickEnable AND (rRateOfApproachToSurge_pct_s < -15.0) AND (rDistanceToSCL_pct < 8.0) THEN
    bFastValveKickActive := TRUE;
    (* Calculate instantaneous valve kick magnitude proportional to approach velocity *)
    rRateOfApproachBias_pct := ABS(rRateOfApproachToSurge_pct_s + 15.0) * 1.25;
    rRateOfApproachBias_pct := MIN(50.0, rRateOfApproachBias_pct);
    IF rRateOfApproachBias_pct > rValveKickBias_pct THEN
        rValveKickBias_pct := rRateOfApproachBias_pct;
    END_IF;
    dwWarningWord1 := dwWarningWord1 OR 16#00000008; (* Bit 3: Fast Valve Kick Active *)
ELSE
    bFastValveKickActive := FALSE;
    (* Smooth exponential decay of open-loop kick bias *)
    rValveKickBias_pct := rValveKickBias_pct * rValveKickDecay;
    IF rValveKickBias_pct < 0.20 THEN
        rValveKickBias_pct := 0.0;
    END_IF;
END_IF;

(* === 5. DISCRETE 5x5 STATE-SPACE DYNAMIC MODEL SIMULATION === *)
(* State Vector:
   x[1]: Delta_Flow (kg/s)
   x[2]: Delta_P_disch (bar)
   x[3]: Delta_P_suct (bar)
   x[4]: Delta_Speed (rpm)
   x[5]: Delta_P_acoustic (mbar)
*)
(* Populate Discretized Dynamic Matrix A_d (5x5) *)
arrMatA[1,1] := 0.8850; arrMatA[1,2] := -0.0450; arrMatA[1,3] := 0.0650; arrMatA[1,4] := 0.0012; arrMatA[1,5] := -0.0008;
arrMatA[2,1] := 0.0350; arrMatA[2,2] := 0.9420;  arrMatA[2,3] := 0.0150; arrMatA[2,4] := 0.0022; arrMatA[2,5] := 0.0011;
arrMatA[3,1] := -0.0280;arrMatA[3,2] := 0.0080;  arrMatA[3,3] := 0.9510; arrMatA[3,4] := -0.0004;arrMatA[3,5] := 0.0002;
arrMatA[4,1] := -0.0150;arrMatA[4,2] := -0.0080; arrMatA[4,3] := 0.0050; arrMatA[4,4] := 0.9850; arrMatA[4,5] := 0.0000;
arrMatA[5,1] := 0.0520; arrMatA[5,2] := 0.0780;  arrMatA[5,3] := -0.0210;arrMatA[5,4] := 0.0014; arrMatA[5,5] := 0.7200;

(* Populate Input Coupling Matrix B_d (5x3)
   u[1]: Delta_ASV_Position_pct
   u[2]: Delta_Speed_Ref_rpm
   u[3]: Delta_Vac_Valve_pct
*)
arrMatB[1,1] := 0.3200; arrMatB[1,2] := -0.0002; arrMatB[1,3] := 0.0000;
arrMatB[2,1] := -0.2800;arrMatB[2,2] := 0.0042;  arrMatB[2,3] := 0.0000;
arrMatB[3,1] := 0.1900; arrMatB[3,2] := -0.0008; arrMatB[3,3] := 0.0000;
arrMatB[4,1] := 0.0250; arrMatB[4,2] := 0.0850;  arrMatB[4,3] := 0.0000;
arrMatB[5,1] := -0.1500;arrMatB[5,2] := 0.0005;  arrMatB[5,3] := 0.0000;

(* Populate Output Observation Matrix C_d (4x5)
   y[1]: Surge Margin Deviation (%)
   y[2]: Compression Ratio Deviation (-)
   y[3]: Seal Differential Pressure Deviation (bar)
   y[4]: Acoustic Dynamic Pressure RMS (mbar)
*)
arrMatC[1,1] := 1.450; arrMatC[1,2] := -0.320; arrMatC[1,3] := 0.280; arrMatC[1,4] := 0.015; arrMatC[1,5] := -0.050;
arrMatC[2,1] := -0.012;arrMatC[2,2] := 0.020;  arrMatC[2,3] := -0.020;arrMatC[2,4] := 0.0001;arrMatC[2,5] := 0.0000;
arrMatC[3,1] := 0.000; arrMatC[3,2] := 0.000;  arrMatC[3,3] := -0.010;arrMatC[3,4] := 0.0000;arrMatC[3,5] := 0.0000;
arrMatC[4,1] := 0.000; arrMatC[4,2] := 0.000;  arrMatC[4,3] := 0.000; arrMatC[4,4] := 0.0000;arrMatC[4,5] := 1.0000;

(* Populate Feedthrough Matrix D_d (4x3) *)
arrMatD[1,1] := 0.420; arrMatD[1,2] := 0.000; arrMatD[1,3] := 0.000;
arrMatD[2,1] := -0.005;arrMatD[2,2] := 0.0001;arrMatD[2,3] := 0.000;
arrMatD[3,1] := 0.000; arrMatD[3,2] := 0.000; arrMatD[3,3] := 0.000;
arrMatD[4,1] := -0.120;arrMatD[4,2] := 0.000; arrMatD[4,3] := 0.000;

(* Plant Observation Feedback into State Vector *)
arrStateX[1] := rMassFlow_kgs - 3.25;
arrStateX[2] := rDischPress_Voted_bar - 100.0;
arrStateX[3] := rSuctPress_Voted_bar - 50.0;
arrStateX[4] := rShaftSpeed_Voted_rpm - 18500.0;
arrStateX[5] := rAcousticDynamicPress_CH2_bar * 1000.0;

(* Input Vector *)
arrInputU[1] := rAntiSurgeValveActual_pct - 20.0;
arrInputU[2] := rSpeedRefActual_rpm - 18500.0;
arrInputU[3] := rVacValveActual_pct - 35.0;

(* Compute x[k+1] = A_d * x[k] + B_d * u[k] *)
FOR iState := 1 TO 5 DO
    arrNextStateX[iState] := arrMatA[iState,1] * arrStateX[1] +
                             arrMatA[iState,2] * arrStateX[2] +
                             arrMatA[iState,3] * arrStateX[3] +
                             arrMatA[iState,4] * arrStateX[4] +
                             arrMatA[iState,5] * arrStateX[5] +
                             arrMatB[iState,1] * arrInputU[1] +
                             arrMatB[iState,2] * arrInputU[2] +
                             arrMatB[iState,3] * arrInputU[3];
END_FOR;

(* Compute y[k] = C_d * x[k] + D_d * u[k] *)
FOR iState := 1 TO 4 DO
    arrOutputY[iState] := arrMatC[iState,1] * arrStateX[1] +
                          arrMatC[iState,2] * arrStateX[2] +
                          arrMatC[iState,3] * arrStateX[3] +
                          arrMatC[iState,4] * arrStateX[4] +
                          arrMatC[iState,5] * arrStateX[5] +
                          arrMatD[iState,1] * arrInputU[1] +
                          arrMatD[iState,2] * arrInputU[2] +
                          arrMatD[iState,3] * arrInputU[3];
END_FOR;

(* === 6. MODEL PREDICTIVE CONTROL (MPC) QUADRATIC COST OPTIMIZATION === *)
IF bMPCControlEnable AND NOT bCompressorTrip THEN
    (* Evaluate Gradient: g = H * Delta_u + F * x0 *)
    (* Target: maintain surge margin at setpoint (arrOutputSP[1] = 15%), minimize acoustic energy *)
    arrGradientG[1] := arrWeightQ[1] * (arrOutputY[1] - arrOutputSP[1]) * arrMatD[1,1] +
                       arrWeightQ[4] * (arrOutputY[4] - arrOutputSP[4]) * arrMatD[4,1] +
                       arrWeightR[1] * arrDeltaU_Opt[1];

    arrGradientG[2] := arrWeightQ[2] * (arrOutputY[2] - arrOutputSP[2]) * arrMatD[2,2] +
                       arrWeightR[2] * arrDeltaU_Opt[2];

    arrGradientG[3] := arrWeightQ[3] * (arrOutputY[3] - arrOutputSP[3]) * 0.10 +
                       arrWeightR[3] * arrDeltaU_Opt[3];

    (* Numerical conditioning check *)
    IF ABS(arrGradientG[1]) > 5000.0 OR ABS(arrGradientG[2]) > 5000.0 THEN
        bMpcIllConditioned := TRUE;
        dwWarningWord2 := dwWarningWord2 OR 16#00000080; (* Bit 7: MPC Ill-conditioned *)
    ELSE
        bMpcIllConditioned := FALSE;
    END_IF;

    IF NOT bMpcIllConditioned THEN
        (* Projected gradient descent move *)
        arrDeltaU_Opt[1] := -rMpcStepAlpha * arrGradientG[1];
        arrDeltaU_Opt[2] := -rMpcStepAlpha * arrGradientG[2];
        arrDeltaU_Opt[3] := -rMpcStepAlpha * arrGradientG[3];

        (* Clamp optimal control rate to asymmetric actuator limits *)
        arrDeltaU_Opt[1] := MAX(-c_rASV_MaxCloseRate_pct_s * rDt,
                            MIN(c_rASV_MaxOpenRate_pct_s * rDt, arrDeltaU_Opt[1]));

        (* If distance to SCL is negative (inside control margin), prioritize fast opening *)
        IF rDistanceToSCL_pct < 0.0 THEN
            arrDeltaU_Opt[1] := arrDeltaU_Opt[1] + ABS(rDistanceToSCL_pct) * 0.45;
        END_IF;

        bMPCActive := TRUE;
    ELSE
        bMPCActive := FALSE;
    END_IF;
ELSE
    bMPCActive := FALSE;
    arrDeltaU_Opt[1] := 0.0;
    arrDeltaU_Opt[2] := 0.0;
    arrDeltaU_Opt[3] := 0.0;
END_IF;

(* 6.1 Decoupled PID Anti-Surge Fallback (Active if MPC is inactive or ill-conditioned) *)
IF NOT bMPCActive AND NOT bCompressorTrip THEN
    (* Error defined as distance to Surge Control Line: e = SCL - Operating_Point *)
    rASV_PID_Derivative := ((rFlowSquared_SCL - rReducedFlow_Squared) - rASV_PID_PrevError) / rDt;
    rASV_PID_PrevError  := (rFlowSquared_SCL - rReducedFlow_Squared);

    IF rDistanceToSCL_pct < 0.0 THEN
        (* Operating point is inside SCL: aggressive opening proportional action *)
        rASV_PID_Integral := rASV_PID_Integral + 2.5 * ABS(rDistanceToSCL_pct) * rDt;
        rASV_PID_Output := 15.0 + 3.2 * ABS(rDistanceToSCL_pct) + rASV_PID_Integral + 0.15 * rASV_PID_Derivative;
    ELSE
        (* Safe operating region: slowly ramp integral closed *)
        rASV_PID_Integral := rASV_PID_Integral - 0.45 * rDt;
        rASV_PID_Output := rASV_PID_Integral;
    END_IF;
    rASV_PID_Integral := MAX(0.0, MIN(100.0, rASV_PID_Integral));
    rASV_PID_Output   := MAX(0.0, MIN(100.0, rASV_PID_Output));
END_IF;

(* === 7. PIPELINE ACOUSTIC WAVE STANDING WAVE PULSATION ACTIVE DAMPING === *)
(* 7.1 Dynamic Pressure Input from Piezo Transducer [bar -> mbar] *)
rAcousticInput_mbar := rAcousticDynamicPress_CH2_bar * 1000.0;

(* 7.2 2nd-Order Butterworth Digital Bandpass Filter (120 - 350 Hz) *)
(* Difference equation: Y0 = b0*X0 + b1*X1 + b2*X2 - a1*Y1 - a2*Y2 *)
rAcousticFilt_X0 := rAcousticInput_mbar;
rAcousticFilt_Y0 := c_rIIR_b0 * rAcousticFilt_X0 +
                    c_rIIR_b1 * rAcousticFilt_X1 +
                    c_rIIR_b2 * rAcousticFilt_X2 -
                    c_rIIR_a1 * rAcousticFilt_Y1 -
                    c_rIIR_a2 * rAcousticFilt_Y2;

(* Update delay registers *)
rAcousticFilt_X2 := rAcousticFilt_X1;
rAcousticFilt_X1 := rAcousticFilt_X0;
rAcousticFilt_Y2 := rAcousticFilt_Y1;
rAcousticFilt_Y1 := rAcousticFilt_Y0;

(* 7.3 Rolling Window RMS Calculation (100 samples) *)
rAcousticSumSquares := rAcousticSumSquares -
                       (arrAcousticHistory[iAcousticHistIndex] * arrAcousticHistory[iAcousticHistIndex]);
arrAcousticHistory[iAcousticHistIndex] := rAcousticFilt_Y0;
rAcousticSumSquares := rAcousticSumSquares + (rAcousticFilt_Y0 * rAcousticFilt_Y0);
iAcousticHistIndex := iAcousticHistIndex + 1;
IF iAcousticHistIndex > 100 THEN
    iAcousticHistIndex := 1;
END_IF;
IF rAcousticSumSquares > 0.0 THEN
    rAcousticPulsationRMS_mbar := SQRT(rAcousticSumSquares * 0.01);
ELSE
    rAcousticPulsationRMS_mbar := 0.0;
END_IF;

(* 7.4 Phase-Lead Dynamic Anti-Pulsation Modulation *)
IF bAcousticDampingEnable AND (rAcousticPulsationRMS_mbar > 450.0) AND NOT bCompressorTrip THEN
    (* Phase lead transfer function: G_lead = K * (Y0 + tau * dY/dt) *)
    rAcousticPhaseLeadOutput := -c_rAcousticPhaseLeadGain *
                                (rAcousticFilt_Y0 + 0.0022 * ((rAcousticFilt_Y0 - rAcousticFilt_Y1) / rDt));

    (* Micro-dither command clamped between -c_rAcousticDitherMaxClamp_pct and +c_rAcousticDitherMaxClamp_pct *)
    rAcousticDitherModulation := MAX(-c_rAcousticDitherMaxClamp_pct,
                                 MIN(c_rAcousticDitherMaxClamp_pct, rAcousticPhaseLeadOutput));
    bAcousticDampingEngaged := TRUE;
ELSE
    rAcousticDitherModulation := 0.0;
    bAcousticDampingEngaged := FALSE;
END_IF;

(* === 8. DRY GAS SEAL LEAKAGE VACUUM EXTRACTION SUBSYSTEM === *)
(* 8.1 Primary Seal Gas Differential Pressure Supervision *)
rPrimarySealDP_bar := rSealGasSupplyPress_bar - rSuctPress_Voted_bar;

IF rPrimarySealDP_bar < c_rCriticalLowSealDP_bar THEN
    dwAlarmWord1 := dwAlarmWord1 OR 16#00000200; (* Bit 9: Primary Seal Gas DP Low-Low *)
ELSIF rPrimarySealDP_bar < c_rMinPrimarySealDP_bar THEN
    dwWarningWord1 := dwWarningWord1 OR 16#00000400; (* Bit 10: Seal DP Low Warning *)
END_IF;

(* 8.2 Primary Vent Cavity Pressure Regulation (-80.0 mbar gauge setpoint) *)
rVac_PID_Error := rPrimaryVentPress_mbar - c_rVacSetpoint_mbar;

(* Anti-windup PID formulation for vacuum extraction modulating valve *)
rVac_PID_Derivative := (rVac_PID_Error - rVac_PID_PrevError) / rDt;
rVac_PID_PrevError  := rVac_PID_Error;

rVac_PID_Integral := rVac_PID_Integral + (0.015 * rVac_PID_Error * rDt);
rVac_PID_Integral := MAX(0.0, MIN(100.0, rVac_PID_Integral));

rVacExtractionValveRaw_pct := 35.0 + (0.28 * rVac_PID_Error) + rVac_PID_Integral + (0.05 * rVac_PID_Derivative);
rVacExtractionValveRaw_pct := MAX(0.0, MIN(100.0, rVacExtractionValveRaw_pct));

IF rPrimaryVentPress_mbar >= -120.0 AND rPrimaryVentPress_mbar <= 200.0 THEN
    bSealVacuumHealthy := TRUE;
ELSE
    bSealVacuumHealthy := FALSE;
END_IF;

(* 8.3 Secondary Buffer Nitrogen Gas & LEL Protection *)
IF rBufferN2SupplyPress_bar < 1.50 THEN
    dwAlarmWord3 := dwAlarmWord3 OR 16#00000001; (* Bit 0: N2 Buffer Supply Low-Low *)
END_IF;

IF rSealVentH2Concentration_LEL >= c_rTripH2Concentration_LEL THEN
    dwAlarmWord1 := dwAlarmWord1 OR 16#00001000; (* Bit 12: Vent Duct H2 LEL High-High Trip *)
ELSIF rSealVentH2Concentration_LEL >= 25.0 THEN
    dwWarningWord2 := dwWarningWord2 OR 16#00000800; (* Bit 11: Vent Duct H2 LEL High Warning *)
END_IF;

IF rPrimarySealLeakage_Nm3h >= c_rTripPrimaryLeakage_Nm3h THEN
    dwAlarmWord1 := dwAlarmWord1 OR 16#00000800; (* Bit 11: Primary Seal Leakage High-High Trip *)
ELSIF rPrimarySealLeakage_Nm3h >= c_rMaxPrimaryLeakage_Nm3h THEN
    dwWarningWord2 := dwWarningWord2 OR 16#00000400; (* Bit 10: Primary Seal Leakage High Warning *)
END_IF;

(* === 9. COMPREHENSIVE SIL-3 SAFETY ALARM TREE & TRIP LATCHING === *)
(* 9.1 Evaluation of Critical Process Trips into dwAlarmWord1 *)
IF NOT bEStopTripped THEN
    dwAlarmWord1 := dwAlarmWord1 OR 16#00000001; (* Bit 0: Emergency Stop Tripped *)
END_IF;

IF rVibrationRadialDE_X_mms >= 18.0 OR rVibrationRadialDE_Y_mms >= 18.0 THEN
    dwAlarmWord1 := dwAlarmWord1 OR 16#00000040; (* Bit 6: DE Radial Vibration High-High Trip *)
ELSIF rVibrationRadialDE_X_mms >= 9.0 OR rVibrationRadialDE_Y_mms >= 9.0 THEN
    dwWarningWord1 := dwWarningWord1 OR 16#00000080; (* Bit 7: DE Radial Vibration Warning *)
END_IF;

IF rVibrationRadialNDE_X_mms >= 18.0 OR rVibrationRadialNDE_Y_mms >= 18.0 THEN
    dwAlarmWord1 := dwAlarmWord1 OR 16#00000080; (* Bit 7: NDE Radial Vibration High-High Trip *)
ELSIF rVibrationRadialNDE_X_mms >= 9.0 OR rVibrationRadialNDE_Y_mms >= 9.0 THEN
    dwWarningWord1 := dwWarningWord1 OR 16#00000100; (* Bit 8: NDE Radial Vibration Warning *)
END_IF;

IF ABS(rShaftAxialThrust_um) >= 120.0 THEN
    dwAlarmWord1 := dwAlarmWord1 OR 16#00000100; (* Bit 8: Axial Thrust High-High Trip *)
ELSIF ABS(rShaftAxialThrust_um) >= 75.0 THEN
    dwWarningWord1 := dwWarningWord1 OR 16#00000200; (* Bit 9: Axial Thrust Warning *)
END_IF;

IF rDischTemp_Voted_K >= 430.0 THEN
    dwAlarmWord1 := dwAlarmWord1 OR 16#00004000; (* Bit 14: Discharge Gas Temp High-High Trip *)
ELSIF rDischTemp_Voted_K >= 405.0 THEN
    dwWarningWord1 := dwWarningWord1 OR 16#00000040; (* Bit 6: Discharge Gas Temp Warning *)
END_IF;

IF rAcousticPulsationRMS_mbar >= 4500.0 THEN
    dwAlarmWord1 := dwAlarmWord1 OR 16#00002000; (* Bit 13: Pipeline Acoustic Pulsation High-High Trip *)
ELSIF rAcousticPulsationRMS_mbar >= 2200.0 THEN
    dwWarningWord1 := dwWarningWord1 OR 16#00000010; (* Bit 4: Acoustic Pulsation High Warning *)
END_IF;

(* 9.2 Evaluation of Operating Boundary Trips into dwAlarmWord2 *)
IF rDischPress_Voted_bar >= c_rMaxDischargePressure_bar THEN
    dwAlarmWord2 := dwAlarmWord2 OR 16#00000001; (* Bit 0: Discharge Pressure MAOP High-High *)
END_IF;

IF rSuctPress_Voted_bar <= c_rMinSuctionPressure_bar THEN
    dwAlarmWord2 := dwAlarmWord2 OR 16#00000002; (* Bit 1: Suction Pressure Low-Low *)
END_IF;

IF rDriverPower_kW >= 26500.0 THEN
    dwAlarmWord2 := dwAlarmWord2 OR 16#00000004; (* Bit 2: Drive Motor Overpower Trip *)
END_IF;

IF rGasPurityH2_pct <= 95.0 AND rGasPurityH2_pct > 0.0 THEN
    dwAlarmWord2 := dwAlarmWord2 OR 16#00000010; (* Bit 4: Gas Purity Contamination Trip *)
END_IF;

IF ABS(rGasMolecularWeight_gmol - c_rNominalMolecularWeight_H2) >= c_rMaxAllowableMW_Deviation THEN
    dwAlarmWord2 := dwAlarmWord2 OR 16#00000020; (* Bit 5: Gas Molecular Weight Shift Trip *)
END_IF;

IF bEmergencyDepressurizeReq THEN
    dwAlarmWord2 := dwAlarmWord2 OR 16#00000200; (* Bit 9: Pipeline ESD Depressurization Request *)
END_IF;

(* 9.3 Deep Surge Cycle Accumulator within 60s Sliding Window *)
IF (rDistanceToSCL_pct < -8.0) AND (rFlowDP_Voted_mbar < 10.0) AND NOT bSurgeCycleLatched THEN
    bSurgeCycleLatched := TRUE;
    uiSurgeCycleCount := uiSurgeCycleCount + 1;
    dwWarningWord1 := dwWarningWord1 OR 16#00000020; (* Bit 5: Single Surge Cycle Detected *)
ELSIF rDistanceToSCL_pct > 5.0 THEN
    bSurgeCycleLatched := FALSE;
END_IF;

tSurgeCycleTimer(IN := (uiSurgeCycleCount > 0), PT := T#60S);
IF tSurgeCycleTimer.Q THEN
    tSurgeCycleTimer(IN := FALSE);
    uiSurgeCycleCount := 0; (* Reset window counter if 60s expires without lock *)
END_IF;

IF uiSurgeCycleCount >= 3 THEN
    dwAlarmWord1 := dwAlarmWord1 OR 16#00000020; (* Bit 5: Deep Surge Cycle Lockout Trip *)
END_IF;

(* 9.4 Master Trip Determination *)
IF (dwAlarmWord1 <> 16#00000000) OR (dwAlarmWord2 <> 16#00000000) OR (dwAlarmWord3 <> 16#00000000) THEN
    bCompressorTrip := TRUE;
    bSystemReady := FALSE;
    iState := 99; (* Force transition to Emergency Shutdown *)
ELSE
    bCompressorTrip := FALSE;
END_IF;

(* Alarm Reset Logic *)
IF bResetAlarms AND NOT bCompressorTrip THEN
    dwAlarmWord1 := 16#00000000;
    dwAlarmWord2 := 16#00000000;
    dwAlarmWord3 := 16#00000000;
    uiSurgeCycleCount := 0;
END_IF;

(* System Ready Permissive Evaluation *)
IF (dwAlarmWord1 = 16#00000000) AND (dwAlarmWord2 = 16#00000000) AND (dwAlarmWord3 = 16#00000000) AND
   bEStopTripped AND (rSuctPress_Voted_bar >= 40.0) AND bSealVacuumHealthy THEN
    bSystemReady := TRUE;
ELSE
    bSystemReady := FALSE;
END_IF;

(* === 10. MULTI-STAGE OPERATIONAL FINITE STATE MACHINE (FSM) === *)
CASE iState OF
    0: (* FSM_IDLE_STANDBY: Plant Safe Depressurized Standby *)
        bAntiSurgeValveFullOpen  := TRUE;
        rAntiSurgeValveActual_pct:= 100.0;
        rSpeedRefActual_rpm      := 0.0;
        rBlowdownValveCmd_pct    := 0.0;
        bMPCActive               := FALSE;
        bAcousticDampingEngaged  := FALSE;
        rASV_PID_Integral        := 100.0;

        IF bEnableSystem AND bSystemReady AND bAutoModeRequest THEN
            iState := 10; (* Transition to Inert Purge *)
        END_IF;

    10: (* FSM_N2_INERT_PURGE: Nitrogen Displacement Purge *)
        bAntiSurgeValveFullOpen  := TRUE;
        rAntiSurgeValveActual_pct:= 100.0;
        rSpeedRefActual_rpm      := 0.0;

        tPurgeTimer(IN := TRUE, PT := T#30S);
        IF tPurgeTimer.Q THEN
            tPurgeTimer(IN := FALSE);
            iState := 20; (* Transition to H2 Pressurization & Vacuum Extraction *)
        END_IF;

    20: (* FSM_H2_PRESSURIZATION_AND_SEAL_VACUUM: Introduce H2, Engage Vacuum Loop *)
        bAntiSurgeValveFullOpen  := TRUE;
        rAntiSurgeValveActual_pct:= 100.0;
        rSpeedRefActual_rpm      := 0.0;

        (* Engage vacuum extraction control valve *)
        rVacValveActual_pct := rVacExtractionValveRaw_pct;

        IF bSealVacuumHealthy AND (rPrimarySealDP_bar >= c_rMinPrimarySealDP_bar) AND (rSuctPress_Voted_bar >= 45.0) THEN
            iState := 30; (* Transition to Magnetic Bearing Permissive *)
        END_IF;

    30: (* FSM_BEARING_LEVITATION_AND_LUBE_PERMISSIVE: Active Magnetic Bearing Verification *)
        bAntiSurgeValveFullOpen  := TRUE;
        rAntiSurgeValveActual_pct:= 100.0;
        rSpeedRefActual_rpm      := 0.0;

        IF ABS(rShaftAxialThrust_um) < 25.0 AND (rBearingMetalTempMax_K < 340.0) THEN
            iState := 40; (* Transition to Slow Roll Warmup *)
        END_IF;

    40: (* FSM_SLOW_ROLL_WARMUP: Rotor Unbowing at 1,200 rpm *)
        bAntiSurgeValveFullOpen  := TRUE;
        rAntiSurgeValveActual_pct:= 100.0;
        rSpeedRefActual_rpm      := 1200.0;

        tWarmupTimer(IN := TRUE, PT := T#45S);
        IF tWarmupTimer.Q AND (rVibrationRadialDE_X_mms < 4.0) THEN
            tWarmupTimer(IN := FALSE);
            iState := 50; (* Transition to Critical Speed Acceleration *)
        END_IF;

    50: (* FSM_ACCELERATION_THROUGH_CRITICALS: Rapid Ramp Through 3,500 - 8,200 rpm *)
        bAntiSurgeValveFullOpen  := TRUE;
        rAntiSurgeValveActual_pct:= 100.0;
        rSpeedRefActual_rpm      := 12500.0; (* Accelerate directly to minimum governor speed *)

        IF rShaftSpeed_Voted_rpm >= 12400.0 THEN
            iState := 60; (* Transition to Pipeline Packing & Recycle *)
        END_IF;

    60: (* FSM_PIPELINE_PACKING_AND_RECYCLE: Modulate ASV to Build Pressure *)
        rSpeedRefActual_rpm := 12500.0;
        (* Slowly close ASV from 100% towards 35% *)
        IF rAntiSurgeValveActual_pct > 35.0 THEN
            rAntiSurgeValveActual_pct := rAntiSurgeValveActual_pct - (1.5 * rDt);
        END_IF;

        IF (rDischPress_Voted_bar >= (rDischargeHeaderPress_bar - 2.0)) AND (rSurgeMargin_pct >= 18.0) THEN
            iState := 70; (* Transition to Online Closed-Loop MPC Mode *)
        END_IF;
