(* 2.0 TRIPLE MODULAR REDUNDANCY (2oo3 TMR) SENSOR VOTING ALGORITHMS                         *)
(* Performs median voting, pairwise Euclidean discrepancy tracking, and 1oo2 fallback.       *)
(* ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)

(* --- 2.1 In-Situ Pyroelectric Energy Density Fluence Voting --- *)
bPyro_A_OK := (rPyroFluence_ChA_mJcm2 >= 400.0) AND (rPyroFluence_ChA_mJcm2 <= 1400.0);
bPyro_B_OK := (rPyroFluence_ChB_mJcm2 >= 400.0) AND (rPyroFluence_ChB_mJcm2 <= 1400.0);
bPyro_C_OK := (rPyroFluence_ChC_mJcm2 >= 400.0) AND (rPyroFluence_ChC_mJcm2 <= 1400.0);

IF bPyro_A_OK AND bPyro_B_OK AND bPyro_C_OK THEN
    (* 3 Channels Healthy: Compute Median *)
    IF (rPyroFluence_ChA_mJcm2 >= rPyroFluence_ChB_mJcm2 AND rPyroFluence_ChA_mJcm2 <= rPyroFluence_ChC_mJcm2) OR
       (rPyroFluence_ChA_mJcm2 >= rPyroFluence_ChC_mJcm2 AND rPyroFluence_ChA_mJcm2 <= rPyroFluence_ChB_mJcm2) THEN
        rVotedFluence_mJcm2 := rPyroFluence_ChA_mJcm2;
    ELSIF (rPyroFluence_ChB_mJcm2 >= rPyroFluence_ChA_mJcm2 AND rPyroFluence_ChB_mJcm2 <= rPyroFluence_ChC_mJcm2) OR
          (rPyroFluence_ChB_mJcm2 >= rPyroFluence_ChC_mJcm2 AND rPyroFluence_ChB_mJcm2 <= rPyroFluence_ChA_mJcm2) THEN
        rVotedFluence_mJcm2 := rPyroFluence_ChB_mJcm2;
    ELSE
        rVotedFluence_mJcm2 := rPyroFluence_ChC_mJcm2;
    END_IF;
    bPyro_Degraded_1oo2 := FALSE;

    (* Detect Pairwise Channel Drift Beyond Process Tolerance *)
    IF ABS(rPyroFluence_ChA_mJcm2 - rPyroFluence_ChB_mJcm2) > c_rFluenceDiscrepancyTol OR
       ABS(rPyroFluence_ChB_mJcm2 - rPyroFluence_ChC_mJcm2) > c_rFluenceDiscrepancyTol OR
       ABS(rPyroFluence_ChC_mJcm2 - rPyroFluence_ChA_mJcm2) > c_rFluenceDiscrepancyTol THEN
        dwAlarmWord_2 := dwAlarmWord_2 OR 16#0000_0001; (* Pyroelectric Sensor Drift Warning *)
    END_IF;
ELSIF bPyro_A_OK AND bPyro_B_OK THEN
    rVotedFluence_mJcm2 := (rPyroFluence_ChA_mJcm2 + rPyroFluence_ChB_mJcm2) * 0.5;
    bPyro_Degraded_1oo2 := TRUE;
    dwAlarmWord_2 := dwAlarmWord_2 OR 16#0000_0002; (* Pyro Channel C Fault - Operating 1oo2 *)
ELSIF bPyro_B_OK AND bPyro_C_OK THEN
    rVotedFluence_mJcm2 := (rPyroFluence_ChB_mJcm2 + rPyroFluence_ChC_mJcm2) * 0.5;
    bPyro_Degraded_1oo2 := TRUE;
    dwAlarmWord_2 := dwAlarmWord_2 OR 16#0000_0004; (* Pyro Channel A Fault - Operating 1oo2 *)
ELSIF bPyro_A_OK AND bPyro_C_OK THEN
    rVotedFluence_mJcm2 := (rPyroFluence_ChA_mJcm2 + rPyroFluence_ChC_mJcm2) * 0.5;
    bPyro_Degraded_1oo2 := TRUE;
    dwAlarmWord_2 := dwAlarmWord_2 OR 16#0000_0008; (* Pyro Channel B Fault - Operating 1oo2 *)
ELSE
    bSystemTrip := TRUE;
    dwAlarmWord_1 := dwAlarmWord_1 OR 16#0000_0004; (* Catastrophic Loss of Pyroelectric Telemetry *)
END_IF;
rEffectiveDosage_mJcm2 := rVotedFluence_mJcm2;

(* --- 2.2 Sub-Micron Flying Focus Optical Distance Voting --- *)
bFocus_A_OK := (rWaferFocus_ChA_um >= -50.0) AND (rWaferFocus_ChA_um <= 50.0);
bFocus_B_OK := (rWaferFocus_ChB_um >= -50.0) AND (rWaferFocus_ChB_um <= 50.0);
bFocus_C_OK := (rWaferFocus_ChC_um >= -50.0) AND (rWaferFocus_ChC_um <= 50.0);

IF bFocus_A_OK AND bFocus_B_OK AND bFocus_C_OK THEN
    IF (rWaferFocus_ChA_um >= rWaferFocus_ChB_um AND rWaferFocus_ChA_um <= rWaferFocus_ChC_um) OR
       (rWaferFocus_ChA_um >= rWaferFocus_ChC_um AND rWaferFocus_ChA_um <= rWaferFocus_ChB_um) THEN
        rVotedFocus_um := rWaferFocus_ChA_um;
    ELSIF (rWaferFocus_ChB_um >= rWaferFocus_ChA_um AND rWaferFocus_ChB_um <= rWaferFocus_ChC_um) OR
          (rWaferFocus_ChB_um >= rWaferFocus_ChC_um AND rWaferFocus_ChB_um <= rWaferFocus_ChA_um) THEN
        rVotedFocus_um := rWaferFocus_ChB_um;
    ELSE
        rVotedFocus_um := rWaferFocus_ChC_um;
    END_IF;
    bFocus_Degraded_1oo2 := FALSE;

    IF ABS(rWaferFocus_ChA_um - rWaferFocus_ChB_um) > c_rFocusDiscrepancyTol OR
       ABS(rWaferFocus_ChB_um - rWaferFocus_ChC_um) > c_rFocusDiscrepancyTol OR
       ABS(rWaferFocus_ChC_um - rWaferFocus_ChA_um) > c_rFocusDiscrepancyTol THEN
        dwAlarmWord_2 := dwAlarmWord_2 OR 16#0000_0010; (* Focus Distance Drift Warning *)
    END_IF;
ELSIF bFocus_A_OK AND bFocus_B_OK THEN
    rVotedFocus_um := (rWaferFocus_ChA_um + rWaferFocus_ChB_um) * 0.5;
    bFocus_Degraded_1oo2 := TRUE;
    dwAlarmWord_2 := dwAlarmWord_2 OR 16#0000_0020;
ELSIF bFocus_B_OK AND bFocus_C_OK THEN
    rVotedFocus_um := (rWaferFocus_ChB_um + rWaferFocus_ChC_um) * 0.5;
    bFocus_Degraded_1oo2 := TRUE;
    dwAlarmWord_2 := dwAlarmWord_2 OR 16#0000_0040;
ELSIF bFocus_A_OK AND bFocus_C_OK THEN
    rVotedFocus_um := (rWaferFocus_ChA_um + rWaferFocus_ChC_um) * 0.5;
    bFocus_Degraded_1oo2 := TRUE;
    dwAlarmWord_2 := dwAlarmWord_2 OR 16#0000_0080;
ELSE
    bSystemTrip := TRUE;
    dwAlarmWord_1 := dwAlarmWord_1 OR 16#0000_0008; (* Focus Distance TMR Complete Failure *)
END_IF;

(* --- 2.3 Vacuum Chuck Holding Pressure Voting --- *)
bVac_A_OK := (rChuckVacuum_ChA_mbar >= 0.0001) AND (rChuckVacuum_ChA_mbar <= 1013.25);
bVac_B_OK := (rChuckVacuum_ChB_mbar >= 0.0001) AND (rChuckVacuum_ChB_mbar <= 1013.25);
bVac_C_OK := (rChuckVacuum_ChC_mbar >= 0.0001) AND (rChuckVacuum_ChC_mbar <= 1013.25);

IF bVac_A_OK AND bVac_B_OK AND bVac_C_OK THEN
    IF (rChuckVacuum_ChA_mbar >= rChuckVacuum_ChB_mbar AND rChuckVacuum_ChA_mbar <= rChuckVacuum_ChC_mbar) OR
       (rChuckVacuum_ChA_mbar >= rChuckVacuum_ChC_mbar AND rChuckVacuum_ChA_mbar <= rChuckVacuum_ChB_mbar) THEN
        rVotedVacuum_mbar := rChuckVacuum_ChA_mbar;
    ELSIF (rChuckVacuum_ChB_mbar >= rChuckVacuum_ChA_mbar AND rChuckVacuum_ChB_mbar <= rChuckVacuum_ChC_mbar) OR
          (rChuckVacuum_ChB_mbar >= rChuckVacuum_ChC_mbar AND rChuckVacuum_ChB_mbar <= rChuckVacuum_ChA_mbar) THEN
        rVotedVacuum_mbar := rChuckVacuum_ChB_mbar;
    ELSE
        rVotedVacuum_mbar := rChuckVacuum_ChC_mbar;
    END_IF;
    bVac_Degraded_1oo2 := FALSE;
ELSIF bVac_A_OK AND bVac_B_OK THEN
    rVotedVacuum_mbar := (rChuckVacuum_ChA_mbar + rChuckVacuum_ChB_mbar) * 0.5;
    bVac_Degraded_1oo2 := TRUE;
    dwAlarmWord_2 := dwAlarmWord_2 OR 16#0000_0100;
ELSIF bVac_B_OK AND bVac_C_OK THEN
    rVotedVacuum_mbar := (rChuckVacuum_ChB_mbar + rChuckVacuum_ChC_mbar) * 0.5;
    bVac_Degraded_1oo2 := TRUE;
    dwAlarmWord_2 := dwAlarmWord_2 OR 16#0000_0200;
ELSIF bVac_A_OK AND bVac_C_OK THEN
    rVotedVacuum_mbar := (rChuckVacuum_ChA_mbar + rChuckVacuum_ChC_mbar) * 0.5;
    bVac_Degraded_1oo2 := TRUE;
    dwAlarmWord_2 := dwAlarmWord_2 OR 16#0000_0400;
ELSE
    bSystemTrip := TRUE;
    dwAlarmWord_1 := dwAlarmWord_1 OR 16#0000_0010; (* Vacuum Sensor TMR Failure *)
END_IF;

(* --- 2.4 Pyroelectric Pre-Amp Peak Voltage Voting --- *)
bVolt_A_OK := (rPyroRaw_ChA_mV >= 0.0) AND (rPyroRaw_ChA_mV <= 500.0);
bVolt_B_OK := (rPyroRaw_ChB_mV >= 0.0) AND (rPyroRaw_ChB_mV <= 500.0);
bVolt_C_OK := (rPyroRaw_ChC_mV >= 0.0) AND (rPyroRaw_ChC_mV <= 500.0);

IF bVolt_A_OK AND bVolt_B_OK AND bVolt_C_OK THEN
    IF (rPyroRaw_ChA_mV >= rPyroRaw_ChB_mV AND rPyroRaw_ChA_mV <= rPyroRaw_ChC_mV) OR
       (rPyroRaw_ChA_mV >= rPyroRaw_ChC_mV AND rPyroRaw_ChA_mV <= rPyroRaw_ChB_mV) THEN
        rVotedRawVolt_mV := rPyroRaw_ChA_mV;
    ELSIF (rPyroRaw_ChB_mV >= rPyroRaw_ChA_mV AND rPyroRaw_ChB_mV <= rPyroRaw_ChC_mV) OR
          (rPyroRaw_ChB_mV >= rPyroRaw_ChC_mV AND rPyroRaw_ChB_mV <= rPyroRaw_ChA_mV) THEN
        rVotedRawVolt_mV := rPyroRaw_ChB_mV;
    ELSE
        rVotedRawVolt_mV := rPyroRaw_ChC_mV;
    END_IF;
    bVolt_Degraded_1oo2 := FALSE;
ELSIF bVolt_A_OK AND bVolt_B_OK THEN
    rVotedRawVolt_mV := (rPyroRaw_ChA_mV + rPyroRaw_ChB_mV) * 0.5;
    bVolt_Degraded_1oo2 := TRUE;
ELSIF bVolt_B_OK AND bVolt_C_OK THEN
    rVotedRawVolt_mV := (rPyroRaw_ChB_mV + rPyroRaw_ChC_mV) * 0.5;
    bVolt_Degraded_1oo2 := TRUE;
ELSIF bVolt_A_OK AND bVolt_C_OK THEN
    rVotedRawVolt_mV := (rPyroRaw_ChA_mV + rPyroRaw_ChC_mV) * 0.5;
    bVolt_Degraded_1oo2 := TRUE;
ELSE
    rVotedRawVolt_mV := rPyroChannel_mV;
END_IF;

(* ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* 3.0 SAPPHIRE-GaN INTERFACE THERMODYNAMICS & THERMAL SHOCK DECOMPOSITION WAVE PROFILING    *)
(* Evaluates transient non-equilibrium heat diffusion, Arrhenius dissociation, gas pressure  *)
(* and thermoelastic acoustic compressive/tensile stress generation at the hetero-boundary.  *)
(* ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)

(* 3.1 Net Optical Energy Coupled Across Transparent Sapphire Backside *)
(* Incident beam passes through sapphire with 1.2% bulk absorption and 2.65% interface reflection *)
rAbsorbedOpticalFluence_mJcm2 := rVotedFluence_mJcm2 * (1.0 - c_rFresnelInterfaceReflect) * 0.988;

(* 3.2 1D Transient Thermal Diffusion Length: l_th = 2 * sqrt(D * tau_p) *)
(* For GaN with D = 4.314E-5 m2/s and tau_p = 30 ns, l_th ~ 72.0 nm *)
rHeatDiffusionLength_nm := 2.0 * SQRT(c_rGaNThermalDiffusivity_m2s * (c_rLaserPulseDuration_ns * 1.0E-9)) * 1.0E9;
IF rHeatDiffusionLength_nm < 10.0 THEN
    rHeatDiffusionLength_nm := 10.0;
END_IF;

(* 3.3 Peak Transient Interfacial Temperature Rise via Non-Equilibrium Energy Deposition *)
(* Volumetric enthalpy density: Delta_H = Phi_abs / (delta_opt + l_th) *)
rTmpA := (c_rOpticalSkinDepth_nm + rHeatDiffusionLength_nm) * 1.0E-7; (* Convert nm to cm *)
IF rTmpA > 0.0 THEN
    rVolumetricHeatSource_Jcm3 := (rAbsorbedOpticalFluence_mJcm2 * 1.0E-3) / rTmpA;
ELSE
    rVolumetricHeatSource_Jcm3 := 1000.0;
END_IF;

(* Delta_T = Delta_H / (rho * Cp) where rho = 6.15 g/cm3, Cp = 0.490 J/(g*K) -> rho*Cp = 3.0135 J/(cm3*K) *)
rTmpB := rVolumetricHeatSource_Jcm3 / 3.0135;
rGaNInterfacePeakTemp_degC := rChuckPlateTemp_degC + rTmpB;
rCalculatedPeakTemp_degC := rGaNInterfacePeakTemp_degC;

(* Interfacial Thermal Gradient Spike Alert *)
IF rGaNInterfacePeakTemp_degC > 1350.0 THEN
    bThermalShockAlert := TRUE;
    dwAlarmWord_1 := dwAlarmWord_1 OR 16#0000_0020; (* Interface Over-Temperature Trip Hazard *)
ELSIF rGaNInterfacePeakTemp_degC > 1200.0 THEN
    bThermalShockAlert := TRUE;
    dwAlarmWord_2 := dwAlarmWord_2 OR 16#0000_0800; (* High Thermal Gradient Warning *)
ELSE
    bThermalShockAlert := FALSE;
END_IF;

(* 3.4 GaN Interfacial Thermal Decomposition Kinetics (Arrhenius Dissociation) *)
(* 2 GaN (solid) -> 2 Ga (liquid) + N2 (gas); Activation Energy Ea ~ 3.10 eV = 4.966E-19 J *)
IF rGaNInterfacePeakTemp_degC >= 850.0 THEN
    (* Effective decomposition reaction velocity v_decomp [m/s] *)
    rTmpC := (rGaNInterfacePeakTemp_degC - 850.0) / 450.0;
    IF rTmpC > 1.5 THEN rTmpC := 1.5; END_IF;
    rArrheniusReactionRate := 0.850 * (rTmpC * rTmpC); (* Empirical decomposition velocity [m/s] *)
    rActiveDecompositionDepth_nm := rArrheniusReactionRate * (c_rLaserPulseDuration_ns * 1.0E-9) * 1.0E9 + 18.0;
ELSE
    rArrheniusReactionRate := 0.0;
    rActiveDecompositionDepth_nm := 0.0;
END_IF;
rDecompositionDepth_nm := rActiveDecompositionDepth_nm;

(* 3.5 Interfacial Nitrogen (N2) Gas Pressure Accumulation *)
(* Confined volume model: moles of N2 per unit area = 0.5 * (rho_GaN * d_decomp / M_GaN) *)
IF rActiveDecompositionDepth_nm > 0.1 THEN
    rEvolvedN2GasMoles_molcm2 := 0.5 * (6.150 * (rActiveDecompositionDepth_nm * 1.0E-7) / 83.73);
    (* Assume confined micro-void thickness h_void ~ 12.0 nm at interface *)
    (* P_N2 = n * R * T / V [bar] *)
    rCalculatedN2Pressure_bar := (rEvolvedN2GasMoles_molcm2 * c_rUniversalGasConst_JmolK *
                                 (rGaNInterfacePeakTemp_degC + 273.15)) / (12.0E-7 * 1.0E5);
ELSE
    rCalculatedN2Pressure_bar := 0.0;
END_IF;
rDecompositionPressure_bar := rCalculatedN2Pressure_bar;

(* 3.6 Thermoelastic Acoustic Shock Wave Stress Amplitude *)
(* Sigma_acoustic = Gamma * alpha * Phi_absorbed / 2 [MPa] *)
rPeakAcousticShockStress_MPa := (c_rGruneisenParamGaN * (c_rGaNAbsorptionCoeff_cm) *
                                 (rAbsorbedOpticalFluence_mJcm2 * 1.0E-3 * 1.0E-4) * 0.5) / 1.0E6;
rAcousticStressPeak_MPa := rPeakAcousticShockStress_MPa;

(* 3.7 Spallation / Micro-LED Mesa Delamination Verification *)
(* Separation occurs when acoustic recoil and gas expansion overcome GaN adhesion (~85.0 MPa) *)
IF (rCalculatedN2Pressure_bar >= 45.0) AND (rActiveDecompositionDepth_nm >= 12.0) THEN
    bDecompositionVerified := TRUE;
    rGaNSpallationRatio := 1.0;
ELSE
    bDecompositionVerified := FALSE;
    rGaNSpallationRatio := rActiveDecompositionDepth_nm / 12.0;
END_IF;

(* ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* 4.0 OPTICAL HOMOGENIZER FLAT-TOP SPATIAL PROFILING & RAYLEIGH RANGE COMPUTATION           *)
(* Evaluates multi-zone plateau uniformity, edge steepness, and short-axis Rayleigh focus.   *)
(* ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)

(* 4.1 Flat-Top Plateau Uniformity Calculation across Left, Center, Right Zones *)
rPlateMax := rBeamPlateau_Left_mJcm2;
IF rBeamPlateau_Center_mJcm2 > rPlateMax THEN rPlateMax := rBeamPlateau_Center_mJcm2; END_IF;
IF rBeamPlateau_Right_mJcm2 > rPlateMax THEN rPlateMax := rBeamPlateau_Right_mJcm2; END_IF;
rPlateauMaxFluence_mJcm2 := rPlateMax;

rPlateMin := rBeamPlateau_Left_mJcm2;
IF rBeamPlateau_Center_mJcm2 < rPlateMin THEN rPlateMin := rBeamPlateau_Center_mJcm2; END_IF;
IF rBeamPlateau_Right_mJcm2 < rPlateMin THEN rPlateMin := rBeamPlateau_Right_mJcm2; END_IF;
rPlateauMinFluence_mJcm2 := rPlateMin;

rPlateauFluenceSpread_mJcm2 := rPlateauMaxFluence_mJcm2 - rPlateauMinFluence_mJcm2;

IF (rPlateauMaxFluence_mJcm2 + rPlateauMinFluence_mJcm2) > 1.0 THEN
    rBeamHomogeneityUniformity := (1.0 - (rPlateauFluenceSpread_mJcm2 /
                                         (rPlateauMaxFluence_mJcm2 + rPlateauMinFluence_mJcm2))) * 100.0;
ELSE
    rBeamHomogeneityUniformity := 0.0;
END_IF;
rBeamFlatTopUniformity_pct := rBeamHomogeneityUniformity;

(* 4.2 Rayleigh Range & Short-Axis Beam Expansion under Defocus *)
(* z_R = pi * w0^2 / (lambda * M^2) ~ 18.5 um *)
rActualRayleighRange_um := c_rNominalRayleighRange_um;
rRayleighDepthOfFocus_um := rActualRayleighRange_um;

(* Beam waist broadening: w(z) = w0 * sqrt(1 + (z / z_R)^2) *)
rLocalFocusDeviation_um := rVotedFocus_um;
rTmpD := rLocalFocusDeviation_um / rActualRayleighRange_um;
rBeamWaistExpansionFactor := SQRT(1.0 + (rTmpD * rTmpD));

(* Defocus Warning Interlock *)
IF ABS(rLocalFocusDeviation_um) > 2.50 THEN
    dwAlarmWord_1 := dwAlarmWord_1 OR 16#0000_0040; (* Severe Focal Excursion Trip Hazard *)
ELSIF ABS(rLocalFocusDeviation_um) > 1.20 THEN
    dwAlarmWord_2 := dwAlarmWord_2 OR 16#0000_1000; (* Defocus Warning *)
END_IF;

(* ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* 5.0 PIEZOELECTRIC SUB-MICRON STAGE ANTI-RESONANCE BIQUAD DIGITAL NOTCH FILTER             *)
(* Filters out 2.40 kHz mechanical structural eigenmode to prevent stage oscillation.        *)
(* ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)

(* Numerical derivative of piezo stage feedback to track vertical velocity [um/s] *)
rPiezoStageVelocity_ums := (rPiezoPositionFeedback_um - rPrevPiezoFeedback_um) / c_rScanTimeSeconds;
rPrevPiezoFeedback_um := rPiezoPositionFeedback_um;

(* Biquad Notch Difference Equation: y[k] = b0*x[k] + b1*x[k-1] + b2*x[k-2] - a1*y[k-1] - a2*y[k-2] *)
rTmpE := (rNotch_b0 * rLocalFocusDeviation_um) + (rNotch_b1 * rNotch_x1) + (rNotch_b2 * rNotch_x2) -
         (rNotch_a1 * rNotch_y1) - (rNotch_a2 * rNotch_y2);

(* Update Biquad Internal Delay Line *)
rNotch_x2 := rNotch_x1;
rNotch_x1 := rLocalFocusDeviation_um;
rNotch_y2 := rNotch_y1;
rNotch_y1 := rTmpE;
rFilteredPiezoDemand_um := rTmpE;

(* ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* 6.0 COMPLETE 6-STATE DISCRETE-TIME STATE-SPACE MODEL & MPC QUADRATIC OPTIMIZATION         *)
(* Discretized plant: x[k+1] = Ad*x[k] + Bd*u[k]; y[k] = Cd*x[k] + Dd*u[k]                  *)
(* Solves real-time quadratic cost gradient: J = x'*Q*x + u'*R*u via Cramer's Rule.          *)
(* ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)

(* 6.1 Assemble Current State Deviation Vector x *)
x1_FluenceDev  := rVotedFluence_mJcm2 - rTargetFluence_mJcm2;
x2_FocusDev    := rVotedFocus_um - rTargetFocus_um;
x3_TempDev     := rGaNInterfacePeakTemp_degC - rTargetInterfaceTemp_degC;
x4_DecompDev   := rActiveDecompositionDepth_nm - rTargetDecompDepth_nm;
x5_HomogDev    := rBeamHomogeneityUniformity - rTargetUniformity_pct;
x6_FocusVelDev := rPiezoStageVelocity_ums;

(* 6.2 1-Step Ahead State Prediction Vector: x_next = Ad * x + Bd * u *)
x1_Next := (Ad_11 * x1_FluenceDev) + (Ad_12 * x2_FocusDev) + (Ad_13 * x3_TempDev) +
           (Ad_14 * x4_DecompDev) + (Ad_15 * x5_HomogDev) + (Ad_16 * x6_FocusVelDev) +
           (Bd_11 * rDeltaAttenuator_Cmd) + (Bd_12 * rDeltaPiezo_Cmd);

x2_Next := (Ad_21 * x1_FluenceDev) + (Ad_22 * x2_FocusDev) + (Ad_23 * x3_TempDev) +
           (Ad_24 * x4_DecompDev) + (Ad_25 * x5_HomogDev) + (Ad_26 * x6_FocusVelDev) +
           (Bd_21 * rDeltaAttenuator_Cmd) + (Bd_22 * rDeltaPiezo_Cmd);

x3_Next := (Ad_31 * x1_FluenceDev) + (Ad_32 * x2_FocusDev) + (Ad_33 * x3_TempDev) +
           (Ad_34 * x4_DecompDev) + (Ad_35 * x5_HomogDev) + (Ad_36 * x6_FocusVelDev) +
           (Bd_31 * rDeltaAttenuator_Cmd) + (Bd_32 * rDeltaPiezo_Cmd);

x4_Next := (Ad_41 * x1_FluenceDev) + (Ad_42 * x2_FocusDev) + (Ad_43 * x3_TempDev) +
           (Ad_44 * x4_DecompDev) + (Ad_45 * x5_HomogDev) + (Ad_46 * x6_FocusVelDev) +
           (Bd_41 * rDeltaAttenuator_Cmd) + (Bd_42 * rDeltaPiezo_Cmd);

x5_Next := (Ad_51 * x1_FluenceDev) + (Ad_52 * x2_FocusDev) + (Ad_53 * x3_TempDev) +
           (Ad_54 * x4_DecompDev) + (Ad_55 * x5_HomogDev) + (Ad_56 * x6_FocusVelDev) +
           (Bd_51 * rDeltaAttenuator_Cmd) + (Bd_52 * rDeltaPiezo_Cmd);

x6_Next := (Ad_61 * x1_FluenceDev) + (Ad_62 * x2_FocusDev) + (Ad_63 * x3_TempDev) +
           (Ad_64 * x4_DecompDev) + (Ad_65 * x5_HomogDev) + (Ad_66 * x6_FocusVelDev) +
           (Bd_61 * rDeltaAttenuator_Cmd) + (Bd_62 * rDeltaPiezo_Cmd);

(* 6.3 Predicted Observable Process Outputs *)
rMPCPredictedFluence  := (Cd_11 * x1_Next) + (Cd_12 * x2_Next) + (Cd_13 * x3_Next) +
                         (Cd_14 * x4_Next) + (Cd_15 * x5_Next) + (Cd_16 * x6_Next) + rTargetFluence_mJcm2;
rMPCPredictedFocusErr := (Cd_21 * x1_Next) + (Cd_22 * x2_Next) + (Cd_23 * x3_Next) +
                         (Cd_24 * x4_Next) + (Cd_25 * x5_Next) + (Cd_26 * x6_Next) + rTargetFocus_um;

(* 6.4 Analytical Gradient Vector: g = B' * Q * x *)
rGrad1 := (Bd_11 * rMPC_Weight_Fluence * x1_FluenceDev) +
          (Bd_21 * rMPC_Weight_Focus * x2_FocusDev) +
          (Bd_31 * rMPC_Weight_Temp * x3_TempDev) +
          (Bd_41 * rMPC_Weight_Decomp * x4_DecompDev) +
          (Bd_51 * rMPC_Weight_Homog * x5_HomogDev) +
          (Bd_61 * rMPC_Weight_FocusVel * x6_FocusVelDev);

rGrad2 := (Bd_12 * rMPC_Weight_Fluence * x1_FluenceDev) +
          (Bd_22 * rMPC_Weight_Focus * x2_FocusDev) +
          (Bd_32 * rMPC_Weight_Temp * x3_TempDev) +
          (Bd_42 * rMPC_Weight_Decomp * x4_DecompDev) +
          (Bd_52 * rMPC_Weight_Homog * x5_HomogDev) +
          (Bd_62 * rMPC_Weight_FocusVel * x6_FocusVelDev);

(* 6.5 Projected 2x2 Hessian Matrix: H = B' * Q * B + R *)
rHess11 := (Bd_11 * Bd_11 * rMPC_Weight_Fluence) +
           (Bd_21 * Bd_21 * rMPC_Weight_Focus) +
           (Bd_31 * Bd_31 * rMPC_Weight_Temp) +
           (Bd_41 * Bd_41 * rMPC_Weight_Decomp) +
           (Bd_51 * Bd_51 * rMPC_Weight_Homog) +
           (Bd_61 * Bd_61 * rMPC_Weight_FocusVel) + rMPC_Weight_dAttenuator;

rHess22 := (Bd_12 * Bd_12 * rMPC_Weight_Fluence) +
           (Bd_22 * Bd_22 * rMPC_Weight_Focus) +
           (Bd_32 * Bd_32 * rMPC_Weight_Temp) +
           (Bd_42 * Bd_42 * rMPC_Weight_Decomp) +
           (Bd_52 * Bd_52 * rMPC_Weight_Homog) +
           (Bd_62 * Bd_62 * rMPC_Weight_FocusVel) + rMPC_Weight_dPiezo;

rHess12 := (Bd_11 * Bd_12 * rMPC_Weight_Fluence) +
           (Bd_21 * Bd_22 * rMPC_Weight_Focus) +
           (Bd_31 * Bd_32 * rMPC_Weight_Temp) +
           (Bd_41 * Bd_42 * rMPC_Weight_Decomp) +
           (Bd_51 * Bd_52 * rMPC_Weight_Homog) +
           (Bd_61 * Bd_62 * rMPC_Weight_FocusVel);

(* 6.6 Invert 2x2 Projected System via Cramer's Rule: Delta_u* = - H^-1 * g *)
rDetHess := (rHess11 * rHess22) - (rHess12 * rHess12);

IF rDetHess > 1.0E-5 THEN
    rUnconstrained_u1 := - ((rHess22 * rGrad1) - (rHess12 * rGrad2)) / rDetHess;
    rUnconstrained_u2 := - ((rHess11 * rGrad2) - (rHess12 * rGrad1)) / rDetHess;
    bDegradedControlMode := FALSE;
ELSE
    (* Ill-conditioned Hessian Fallback to Decoupled Gradient Descent *)
    rUnconstrained_u1 := - 0.045 * rGrad1;
    rUnconstrained_u2 := - 0.020 * rGrad2;
    bDegradedControlMode := TRUE;
    dwAlarmWord_2 := dwAlarmWord_2 OR 16#0000_2000; (* MPC Ill-Conditioned Hessian Warning *)
END_IF;

(* 6.7 Enforce Hard Slew-Rate Limits and Actuator Authority Bounds *)
(* Attenuator slew limit: +/- 0.85 deg per ms *)
IF rUnconstrained_u1 > 0.85 THEN
    rDeltaAttenuator_Cmd := 0.85;
ELSIF rUnconstrained_u1 < -0.85 THEN
    rDeltaAttenuator_Cmd := -0.85;
ELSE
    rDeltaAttenuator_Cmd := rUnconstrained_u1;
END_IF;

(* Piezo stage slew limit: +/- 0.15 um per ms *)
IF rUnconstrained_u2 > 0.15 THEN
    rDeltaPiezo_Cmd := 0.15;
ELSIF rUnconstrained_u2 < -0.15 THEN
    rDeltaPiezo_Cmd := -0.15;
ELSE
    rDeltaPiezo_Cmd := rUnconstrained_u2;
END_IF;

(* ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* 7.0 FINITE STATE MACHINE (FSM) - MULTI-STAGE STEP-AND-SCAN EXPOSURE CORE                  *)
(* ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
CASE iState OF
    0: (* STATE 0: UNINITIALIZED / POWER-ON SELF TEST (POST) *)
        bSystemRunning := FALSE;
        bSystemReady := FALSE;
        bLaserFirePermissive := FALSE;
        bBeamShutterOpenCmd := FALSE;
        rPiezoFocusZ_Cmd_um := -25.0; (* Objective safe parked *)
        rAttenuatorAngle_Cmd_deg := 45.0; (* Full extinction *)
        rLaserRepRate_Cmd_Hz := 0.0;
        rN2PurgeFlow_Cmd_sccm := 500.0;
        rVacuumValvePosition_pct := 0.0;
        rStateTimerAccum := rStateTimerAccum + c_rScanTimeSeconds;

(* Section 1: Scan Cycle Timing & Heartbeat Accumulation *)
iCycleCounter := iCycleCounter + 1;
rStateTimeElapsed_Sec := rStateTimeElapsed_Sec + rCycleTime_Sec;
IF (iMachineState <> iPreviousState) THEN
    rStateTimeElapsed_Sec := 0.000;
    iPreviousState := iMachineState;
END_IF;

(* Section 2: 2oo3 Triple Modular Redundancy (TMR) Sensor Voting Algorithms *)
(* 2.1 Tank Ullage Pressure Voting (PT101A, PT101B, PT101C) *)
IF (ABS(rPress_TankUllage_PT101A - rPress_TankUllage_PT101B) > rTMR_Tol_Press_Bar) THEN
    IF (ABS(rPress_TankUllage_PT101A - rPress_TankUllage_PT101C) > rTMR_Tol_Press_Bar) THEN
        iDiscrep_Timer_PT_A := iDiscrep_Timer_PT_A + 1;
    ELSE
        iDiscrep_Timer_PT_B := iDiscrep_Timer_PT_B + 1;
    END_IF;
ELSIF (ABS(rPress_TankUllage_PT101B - rPress_TankUllage_PT101C) > rTMR_Tol_Press_Bar) THEN
    iDiscrep_Timer_PT_C := iDiscrep_Timer_PT_C + 1;
ELSE
    IF (iDiscrep_Timer_PT_A > 0) THEN iDiscrep_Timer_PT_A := iDiscrep_Timer_PT_A - 1; END_IF;
    IF (iDiscrep_Timer_PT_B > 0) THEN iDiscrep_Timer_PT_B := iDiscrep_Timer_PT_B - 1; END_IF;
    IF (iDiscrep_Timer_PT_C > 0) THEN iDiscrep_Timer_PT_C := iDiscrep_Timer_PT_C - 1; END_IF;
END_IF;

(* Persistent Discrepancy Debounce Filter (10 scans = 200 ms) *)
IF (iDiscrep_Timer_PT_A > 10) THEN bHealthy_PT_A := FALSE; END_IF;
IF (iDiscrep_Timer_PT_B > 10) THEN bHealthy_PT_B := FALSE; END_IF;
IF (iDiscrep_Timer_PT_C > 10) THEN bHealthy_PT_C := FALSE; END_IF;

(* Voting Logic with Dynamic Channel Degradation *)
IF (bHealthy_PT_A AND bHealthy_PT_B AND bHealthy_PT_C) THEN
    (* True 2oo3 Median Selection *)
    IF ((rPress_TankUllage_PT101A >= rPress_TankUllage_PT101B) AND (rPress_TankUllage_PT101A <= rPress_TankUllage_PT101C)) OR
       ((rPress_TankUllage_PT101A <= rPress_TankUllage_PT101B) AND (rPress_TankUllage_PT101A >= rPress_TankUllage_PT101C)) THEN
        rVoted_TankPress_bar := rPress_TankUllage_PT101A;
    ELSIF ((rPress_TankUllage_PT101B >= rPress_TankUllage_PT101A) AND (rPress_TankUllage_PT101B <= rPress_TankUllage_PT101C)) OR
          ((rPress_TankUllage_PT101B <= rPress_TankUllage_PT101A) AND (rPress_TankUllage_PT101B >= rPress_TankUllage_PT101C)) THEN
        rVoted_TankPress_bar := rPress_TankUllage_PT101B;
    ELSE
        rVoted_TankPress_bar := rPress_TankUllage_PT101C;
    END_IF;
ELSIF (bHealthy_PT_A AND bHealthy_PT_B) THEN
    rVoted_TankPress_bar := (rPress_TankUllage_PT101A + rPress_TankUllage_PT101B) * 0.50;
ELSIF (bHealthy_PT_B AND bHealthy_PT_C) THEN
    rVoted_TankPress_bar := (rPress_TankUllage_PT101B + rPress_TankUllage_PT101C) * 0.50;
ELSIF (bHealthy_PT_A AND bHealthy_PT_C) THEN
    rVoted_TankPress_bar := (rPress_TankUllage_PT101A + rPress_TankUllage_PT101C) * 0.50;
ELSE
    (* Dual Channel Failure - Force Emergency Trip *)
    dwAlarmsInternal := dwAlarmsInternal OR 16#00000001; (* Bit 0: PT101 TMR Failure *)
END_IF;

(* 2.2 Submerged Tank Liquid Temperature Voting (TT101A, TT101B, TT101C) *)
IF (ABS(rTemp_TankLiquid_TT101A - rTemp_TankLiquid_TT101B) > rTMR_Tol_Temp_K) THEN
    IF (ABS(rTemp_TankLiquid_TT101A - rTemp_TankLiquid_TT101C) > rTMR_Tol_Temp_K) THEN
        iDiscrep_Timer_TT_A := iDiscrep_Timer_TT_A + 1;
    ELSE
        iDiscrep_Timer_TT_B := iDiscrep_Timer_TT_B + 1;
    END_IF;
ELSIF (ABS(rTemp_TankLiquid_TT101B - rTemp_TankLiquid_TT101C) > rTMR_Tol_Temp_K) THEN
    iDiscrep_Timer_TT_C := iDiscrep_Timer_TT_C + 1;
ELSE
    IF (iDiscrep_Timer_TT_A > 0) THEN iDiscrep_Timer_TT_A := iDiscrep_Timer_TT_A - 1; END_IF;
    IF (iDiscrep_Timer_TT_B > 0) THEN iDiscrep_Timer_TT_B := iDiscrep_Timer_TT_B - 1; END_IF;
    IF (iDiscrep_Timer_TT_C > 0) THEN iDiscrep_Timer_TT_C := iDiscrep_Timer_TT_C - 1; END_IF;
END_IF;
IF (iDiscrep_Timer_TT_A > 10) THEN bHealthy_TT_A := FALSE; END_IF;
IF (iDiscrep_Timer_TT_B > 10) THEN bHealthy_TT_B := FALSE; END_IF;
IF (iDiscrep_Timer_TT_C > 10) THEN bHealthy_TT_C := FALSE; END_IF;

IF (bHealthy_TT_A AND bHealthy_TT_B AND bHealthy_TT_C) THEN
    IF ((rTemp_TankLiquid_TT101A >= rTemp_TankLiquid_TT101B) AND (rTemp_TankLiquid_TT101A <= rTemp_TankLiquid_TT101C)) OR
       ((rTemp_TankLiquid_TT101A <= rTemp_TankLiquid_TT101B) AND (rTemp_TankLiquid_TT101A >= rTemp_TankLiquid_TT101C)) THEN
        rVoted_TankTemp_K := rTemp_TankLiquid_TT101A;
    ELSIF ((rTemp_TankLiquid_TT101B >= rTemp_TankLiquid_TT101A) AND (rTemp_TankLiquid_TT101B <= rTemp_TankLiquid_TT101C)) OR
          ((rTemp_TankLiquid_TT101B <= rTemp_TankLiquid_TT101A) AND (rTemp_TankLiquid_TT101B >= rTemp_TankLiquid_TT101C)) THEN
        rVoted_TankTemp_K := rTemp_TankLiquid_TT101B;
    ELSE
        rVoted_TankTemp_K := rTemp_TankLiquid_TT101C;
    END_IF;
ELSIF (bHealthy_TT_A AND bHealthy_TT_B) THEN
    rVoted_TankTemp_K := (rTemp_TankLiquid_TT101A + rTemp_TankLiquid_TT101B) * 0.50;
ELSIF (bHealthy_TT_B AND bHealthy_TT_C) THEN
    rVoted_TankTemp_K := (rTemp_TankLiquid_TT101B + rTemp_TankLiquid_TT101C) * 0.50;
ELSIF (bHealthy_TT_A AND bHealthy_TT_C) THEN
    rVoted_TankTemp_K := (rTemp_TankLiquid_TT101A + rTemp_TankLiquid_TT101C) * 0.50;
ELSE
    dwAlarmsInternal := dwAlarmsInternal OR 16#00000002; (* Bit 1: TT101 TMR Failure *)
END_IF;

(* 2.3 Cathode Compressor Air Mass Flow Voting (FT301A, FT301B, FT301C) *)
IF (ABS(rFlow_CathodeAir_FT301A - rFlow_CathodeAir_FT301B) > rTMR_Tol_Flow_kg_h) THEN
    IF (ABS(rFlow_CathodeAir_FT301A - rFlow_CathodeAir_FT301C) > rTMR_Tol_Flow_kg_h) THEN
        iDiscrep_Timer_FT_A := iDiscrep_Timer_FT_A + 1;
    ELSE
        iDiscrep_Timer_FT_B := iDiscrep_Timer_FT_B + 1;
    END_IF;
ELSIF (ABS(rFlow_CathodeAir_FT301B - rFlow_CathodeAir_FT301C) > rTMR_Tol_Flow_kg_h) THEN
    iDiscrep_Timer_FT_C := iDiscrep_Timer_FT_C + 1;
ELSE
    IF (iDiscrep_Timer_FT_A > 0) THEN iDiscrep_Timer_FT_A := iDiscrep_Timer_FT_A - 1; END_IF;
    IF (iDiscrep_Timer_FT_B > 0) THEN iDiscrep_Timer_FT_B := iDiscrep_Timer_FT_B - 1; END_IF;
    IF (iDiscrep_Timer_FT_C > 0) THEN iDiscrep_Timer_FT_C := iDiscrep_Timer_FT_C - 1; END_IF;
END_IF;
IF (iDiscrep_Timer_FT_A > 10) THEN bHealthy_FT_A := FALSE; END_IF;
IF (iDiscrep_Timer_FT_B > 10) THEN bHealthy_FT_B := FALSE; END_IF;
IF (iDiscrep_Timer_FT_C > 10) THEN bHealthy_FT_C := FALSE; END_IF;

IF (bHealthy_FT_A AND bHealthy_FT_B AND bHealthy_FT_C) THEN
    IF ((rFlow_CathodeAir_FT301A >= rFlow_CathodeAir_FT301B) AND (rFlow_CathodeAir_FT301A <= rFlow_CathodeAir_FT301C)) OR
       ((rFlow_CathodeAir_FT301A <= rFlow_CathodeAir_FT301B) AND (rFlow_CathodeAir_FT301A >= rFlow_CathodeAir_FT301C)) THEN
        rVoted_AirFlow_kg_h := rFlow_CathodeAir_FT301A;
    ELSIF ((rFlow_CathodeAir_FT301B >= rFlow_CathodeAir_FT301A) AND (rFlow_CathodeAir_FT301B <= rFlow_CathodeAir_FT301C)) OR
          ((rFlow_CathodeAir_FT301B <= rFlow_CathodeAir_FT301A) AND (rFlow_CathodeAir_FT301B >= rFlow_CathodeAir_FT301C)) THEN
        rVoted_AirFlow_kg_h := rFlow_CathodeAir_FT301B;
    ELSE
        rVoted_AirFlow_kg_h := rFlow_CathodeAir_FT301C;
    END_IF;
ELSIF (bHealthy_FT_A AND bHealthy_FT_B) THEN
    rVoted_AirFlow_kg_h := (rFlow_CathodeAir_FT301A + rFlow_CathodeAir_FT301B) * 0.50;
ELSIF (bHealthy_FT_B AND bHealthy_FT_C) THEN
    rVoted_AirFlow_kg_h := (rFlow_CathodeAir_FT301B + rFlow_CathodeAir_FT301C) * 0.50;
ELSIF (bHealthy_FT_A AND bHealthy_FT_C) THEN
    rVoted_AirFlow_kg_h := (rFlow_CathodeAir_FT301A + rFlow_CathodeAir_FT301C) * 0.50;
ELSE
    dwAlarmsInternal := dwAlarmsInternal OR 16#00000004; (* Bit 2: FT301 TMR Failure *)
END_IF;

(* 2.4 High-Voltage Stack DC Current Voting (CT201A, CT201B, CT201C) *)
IF (ABS(rCurrent_HVDC_Stack_CT201A - rCurrent_HVDC_Stack_CT201B) > rTMR_Tol_Current_A) THEN
    IF (ABS(rCurrent_HVDC_Stack_CT201A - rCurrent_HVDC_Stack_CT201C) > rTMR_Tol_Current_A) THEN
        iDiscrep_Timer_CT_A := iDiscrep_Timer_CT_A + 1;
    ELSE
        iDiscrep_Timer_CT_B := iDiscrep_Timer_CT_B + 1;
    END_IF;
ELSIF (ABS(rCurrent_HVDC_Stack_CT201B - rCurrent_HVDC_Stack_CT201C) > rTMR_Tol_Current_A) THEN
    iDiscrep_Timer_CT_C := iDiscrep_Timer_CT_C + 1;
ELSE
    IF (iDiscrep_Timer_CT_A > 0) THEN iDiscrep_Timer_CT_A := iDiscrep_Timer_CT_A - 1; END_IF;
    IF (iDiscrep_Timer_CT_B > 0) THEN iDiscrep_Timer_CT_B := iDiscrep_Timer_CT_B - 1; END_IF;
    IF (iDiscrep_Timer_CT_C > 0) THEN iDiscrep_Timer_CT_C := iDiscrep_Timer_CT_C - 1; END_IF;
END_IF;
IF (iDiscrep_Timer_CT_A > 10) THEN bHealthy_CT_A := FALSE; END_IF;
IF (iDiscrep_Timer_CT_B > 10) THEN bHealthy_CT_B := FALSE; END_IF;
IF (iDiscrep_Timer_CT_C > 10) THEN bHealthy_CT_C := FALSE; END_IF;

IF (bHealthy_CT_A AND bHealthy_CT_B AND bHealthy_CT_C) THEN
    IF ((rCurrent_HVDC_Stack_CT201A >= rCurrent_HVDC_Stack_CT201B) AND (rCurrent_HVDC_Stack_CT201A <= rCurrent_HVDC_Stack_CT201C)) OR
       ((rCurrent_HVDC_Stack_CT201A <= rCurrent_HVDC_Stack_CT201B) AND (rCurrent_HVDC_Stack_CT201A >= rCurrent_HVDC_Stack_CT201C)) THEN
        rVoted_StackCurrent_A := rCurrent_HVDC_Stack_CT201A;
    ELSIF ((rCurrent_HVDC_Stack_CT201B >= rCurrent_HVDC_Stack_CT201A) AND (rCurrent_HVDC_Stack_CT201B <= rCurrent_HVDC_Stack_CT201C)) OR
          ((rCurrent_HVDC_Stack_CT201B <= rCurrent_HVDC_Stack_CT201A) AND (rCurrent_HVDC_Stack_CT201B >= rCurrent_HVDC_Stack_CT201C)) THEN
        rVoted_StackCurrent_A := rCurrent_HVDC_Stack_CT201B;
    ELSE
        rVoted_StackCurrent_A := rCurrent_HVDC_Stack_CT201C;
    END_IF;
ELSIF (bHealthy_CT_A AND bHealthy_CT_B) THEN
    rVoted_StackCurrent_A := (rCurrent_HVDC_Stack_CT201A + rCurrent_HVDC_Stack_CT201B) * 0.50;
ELSIF (bHealthy_CT_B AND bHealthy_CT_C) THEN
    rVoted_StackCurrent_A := (rCurrent_HVDC_Stack_CT201B + rCurrent_HVDC_Stack_CT201C) * 0.50;
ELSIF (bHealthy_CT_A AND bHealthy_CT_C) THEN
    rVoted_StackCurrent_A := (rCurrent_HVDC_Stack_CT201A + rCurrent_HVDC_Stack_CT201C) * 0.50;
ELSE
    dwAlarmsInternal := dwAlarmsInternal OR 16#00000008; (* Bit 3: CT201 TMR Failure *)
END_IF;

(* Degraded 1oo2 Status Evaluation *)
IF (NOT bHealthy_PT_A OR NOT bHealthy_PT_B OR NOT bHealthy_PT_C OR
    NOT bHealthy_TT_A OR NOT bHealthy_TT_B OR NOT bHealthy_TT_C OR
    NOT bHealthy_FT_A OR NOT bHealthy_FT_B OR NOT bHealthy_FT_C OR
    NOT bHealthy_CT_A OR NOT bHealthy_CT_B OR NOT bHealthy_CT_C) THEN
    bDegradedModeActive := TRUE;
    rDegraded_RunTime_Sec := rDegraded_RunTime_Sec + rCycleTime_Sec;
    dwWarningsInternal := dwWarningsInternal OR 16#00000001; (* Warning Bit 0: TMR Degraded Mode *)
ELSE
    bDegradedModeActive := FALSE;
END_IF;

(* Section 3: Physical Thermodynamics & Fluid Property Estimation *)
(* 3.1 Saturated Para-Hydrogen Vapor Pressure P_vap(T) Approximation [bar] *)
(* Antoine/NIST Polynomial approximation around 20K to 24K *)
rPress_Vapor_LH2 := 1.013 * EXP( (445.60 * rConst_MolarMass_H2 / 0.008314) * ( (1.0 / 20.28) - (1.0 / MAX(18.0, rVoted_TankTemp_K)) ) );
IF (rPress_Vapor_LH2 < 0.50) THEN rPress_Vapor_LH2 := 0.50; END_IF;
IF (rPress_Vapor_LH2 > 4.50) THEN rPress_Vapor_LH2 := 4.50; END_IF;

(* 3.2 Submerged Cryo-Pump NPSHa Calculation *)
(* Head = (P_ullage - P_vap) / (rho * g) + StaticHead - SuctionLineLoss *)
rNPSH_Available := ((rVoted_TankPress_bar - rPress_Vapor_LH2) * 1.0E5) / (rConst_Density_LH2 * rConst_Gravity_Acc) + 0.450;
rAct_NPSHa_CryoPump_Calc := rNPSH_Available;

(* Dynamic NPSH Required based on actual pump speed (quadratic affinity scaling) *)
rNPSH_Required := 1.20 + 2.50 * (rSpeed_SubmergedPump_ST101 / 25000.0) * (rSpeed_SubmergedPump_ST101 / 25000.0);

(* Cavitation Risk Monitoring *)
IF (rNPSH_Available < (rNPSH_Required + 0.250)) AND (rSpeed_SubmergedPump_ST101 > 4500.0) THEN
    rCavitation_Duration_Sec := rCavitation_Duration_Sec + rCycleTime_Sec;
    dwWarningsInternal := dwWarningsInternal OR 16#00000002; (* Warning Bit 1: Low NPSHa Cavitation Hazard *)
    IF (rCavitation_Duration_Sec > 1.50) THEN
        dwAlarmsInternal := dwAlarmsInternal OR 16#00000010; (* Alarm Bit 4: Cryo-Pump Severe Cavitation Trip *)
    END_IF;
ELSE
    IF (rCavitation_Duration_Sec > 0.0) THEN
        rCavitation_Duration_Sec := rCavitation_Duration_Sec - (rCycleTime_Sec * 0.50);
    END_IF;
END_IF;

(* 3.3 Supercritical Hydrogen Enthalpy Estimation at MCHX Exit [kJ/kg] *)
(* Near 15 bar, H2 warms from 20K (h ~ -250 kJ/kg ref) to 285K (h ~ 3950 kJ/kg) *)
rAct_SupercriticalH2_Enthalpy := 14.30 * (rTemp_MCHX_H2_Out_TT103 - 20.0) + (0.0045 * (rTemp_MCHX_H2_Out_TT103 * rTemp_MCHX_H2_Out_TT103));

(* Thermal Power Exchanged across MCHX core [kW] *)
(* Q = W_glycol * Cp_glycol * Delta_T_glycol *)
rGlycol_Temp_Delta := rTemp_Glycol_Supply_TT201 - rTemp_Glycol_Return_TT202;
rAct_MCHX_HeatExchanged_kW := (rFlow_GlycolCoolant_FT201 / 3600.0) * rConst_SpecificHeat_Glycol * MAX(0.0, rGlycol_Temp_Delta);

(* Boundary Wall Freezing Guard Evaluation *)
(* Harmonic boundary temperature estimation between warm glycol bulk and cold H2 *)
rWall_Temp_Boundary_Est := (0.65 * rTemp_Glycol_Return_TT202) + (0.35 * (rTemp_MCHX_H2_Out_TT103 - 273.15));
IF (rWall_Temp_Boundary_Est < -22.0) THEN
    rFreezeProtect_Duration_Sec := rFreezeProtect_Duration_Sec + rCycleTime_Sec;
    dwWarningsInternal := dwWarningsInternal OR 16#00000004; (* Warning Bit 2: MCHX Glycol Freeze Risk *)
    IF (rFreezeProtect_Duration_Sec > 2.00) THEN
        dwAlarmsInternal := dwAlarmsInternal OR 16#00000020; (* Alarm Bit 5: MCHX Glycol Freeze Protection Trip *)
    END_IF;
ELSE
    IF (rFreezeProtect_Duration_Sec > 0.0) THEN
        rFreezeProtect_Duration_Sec := rFreezeProtect_Duration_Sec - rCycleTime_Sec;
    END_IF;
END_IF;

(* 3.4 Cathode Compressor Pressure Ratio & Aerodynamic Surge Margin *)
rCompressor_PressureRatio := MAX(1.0, rPress_CathodeInlet_PT301) / MAX(0.20, rAmbient_Air_Press_PT001);
(* Surge mass flow characteristic line: W_surge = a * PR^2 + b * PR + c *)
rCompressor_SurgeLine_kg_h := 120.0 + 85.0 * (rCompressor_PressureRatio - 1.0) * (rCompressor_PressureRatio - 1.0);
IF (rCompressor_SurgeLine_kg_h > 10.0) THEN
    rAct_CompressorSurgeMargin_Pct := ((rVoted_AirFlow_kg_h - rCompressor_SurgeLine_kg_h) / rCompressor_SurgeLine_kg_h) * 100.0;
ELSE
    rAct_CompressorSurgeMargin_Pct := 100.0;
END_IF;

(* 3.5 Anode-to-Cathode Transmembrane Pressure Differential *)
rAct_TransmembraneDeltaP_bar := rPress_AnodeRegulated_PT102 - rPress_CathodeInlet_PT301;
IF (ABS(rAct_TransmembraneDeltaP_bar) > 0.40) AND (iMachineState >= 70) THEN
    rTransmembrane_Duration_Sec := rTransmembrane_Duration_Sec + rCycleTime_Sec;
    dwWarningsInternal := dwWarningsInternal OR 16#00000020; (* Warning Bit 5: Transmembrane Delta-P High *)
    IF (rTransmembrane_Duration_Sec > 0.80) THEN
        dwAlarmsInternal := dwAlarmsInternal OR 16#00010000; (* Alarm Bit 16: Transmembrane Rupture Risk Trip *)
    END_IF;
ELSE
    IF (rTransmembrane_Duration_Sec > 0.0) THEN
        rTransmembrane_Duration_Sec := rTransmembrane_Duration_Sec - rCycleTime_Sec;
    END_IF;
END_IF;

(* Section 4: Submerged Cryo-Boost Pump & BOG Pressure Modulation Logic *)
rBOG_Pressure_Error := rVoted_TankPress_bar - 2.300; (* Target ullage pressure = 2.30 bar *)
rBOG_Pressure_Integral := rBOG_Pressure_Integral + (rBOG_Pressure_Error * rCycleTime_Sec * 0.40);
IF (rBOG_Pressure_Integral > 100.0) THEN rBOG_Pressure_Integral := 100.0; END_IF;
IF (rBOG_Pressure_Integral < 0.0) THEN rBOG_Pressure_Integral := 0.0; END_IF;

(* Proportional-Integral Modulating Relief Valve CV101 *)
rBOG_Relief_Cmd := (rBOG_Pressure_Error * 65.0) + rBOG_Pressure_Integral;
IF (rBOG_Relief_Cmd > 100.0) THEN rBOG_Relief_Cmd := 100.0; END_IF;
IF (rBOG_Relief_Cmd < 0.0) THEN rBOG_Relief_Cmd := 0.0; END_IF;
rCmd_BOG_ReliefValve_CV101 := rBOG_Relief_Cmd;

(* Emergency Discrete Solenoid Vent Valve Command for Rapid De-pressurization *)
IF (rVoted_TankPress_bar > 3.400) THEN
    bBOG_VentValve_Open := TRUE;
    rOverpressure_Duration_Sec := rOverpressure_Duration_Sec + rCycleTime_Sec;
    IF (rOverpressure_Duration_Sec > 3.00) THEN
        dwAlarmsInternal := dwAlarmsInternal OR 16#00000040; (* Alarm Bit 6: Tank Ullage Extreme Overpressure *)
    END_IF;
ELSIF (rVoted_TankPress_bar < 2.900) THEN
    bBOG_VentValve_Open := FALSE;
    rOverpressure_Duration_Sec := 0.000;
END_IF;

(* Recompression Buffer Compressor ST102 Modulation *)
IF (rVoted_TankPress_bar > 2.400) AND (iMachineState >= 70) THEN
    rCmd_BOG_BufferCompSpeed_SP := 8000.0 + (rVoted_TankPress_bar - 2.400) * 12000.0;
    IF (rCmd_BOG_BufferCompSpeed_SP > 20000.0) THEN rCmd_BOG_BufferCompSpeed_SP := 20000.0; END_IF;
ELSE
    rCmd_BOG_BufferCompSpeed_SP := 0.0;
END_IF;

(* Submerged Cryo-Pump Speed Demand governed by Fuel Cell Current *)
(* Flow demand: W_H2 = (I_fc * N_cells / (2*F)) * M_H2 * 3600 [kg/h] *)
rCryoPump_Speed_Cmd := 4500.0 + (rVoted_StackCurrent_A / 1875.0) * 19500.0;
(* Anti-Cavitation Speed Truncation: clamp pump speed if NPSHa is degraded *)
IF (rNPSH_Available < (rNPSH_Required + 0.40)) THEN
    IF (rCryoPump_Speed_Cmd > 14000.0) THEN rCryoPump_Speed_Cmd := 14000.0; END_IF;
END_IF;
rCmd_CryoPumpSpeed_SP := rCryoPump_Speed_Cmd;

(* Section 5: Supercritical MCHX Glycol Thermal Rebalance & Anti-Freeze Logic *)
(* Closed-loop regulation of MCHX H2 exit temperature to 285 K *)
IF (rTemp_MCHX_H2_Out_TT103 < 275.0) OR (rWall_Temp_Boundary_Est < -10.0) THEN
    (* Close bypass valve to force maximum warm glycol flow through cryogenic core *)
    rGlycol_Bypass_Cmd := rGlycol_Bypass_Cmd - (rCycleTime_Sec * 25.0);
ELSIF (rTemp_MCHX_H2_Out_TT103 > 295.0) AND (rWall_Temp_Boundary_Est > 25.0) THEN
    (* Open bypass valve to prevent overheating and conserve thermal bus exergy *)
    rGlycol_Bypass_Cmd := rGlycol_Bypass_Cmd + (rCycleTime_Sec * 15.0);
END_IF;
IF (rGlycol_Bypass_Cmd > 85.0) THEN rGlycol_Bypass_Cmd := 85.0; END_IF;
IF (rGlycol_Bypass_Cmd < 0.0)  THEN rGlycol_Bypass_Cmd := 0.0;  END_IF;
rCmd_GlycolBypassValve_CV201 := rGlycol_Bypass_Cmd;
rCmd_GlycolCoolantPump_SP := 1800.0 + (rAct_FC_GrossPower_Calc / 1500.0) * 2200.0;

(* Section 6: 1.5 MW PEMFC Dynamic Cathode Air Stoichiometry *)
(* Faraday Electrochemical Consumption: W_O2 [kg/h] = (N_cells * I_fc / (4*F)) * M_O2 * 3600 *)
rO2_MassConsumption_kg_h := (INT_TO_REAL(iConst_Total_PEM_Cells) * rVoted_StackCurrent_A / (4.0 * rConst_Faraday)) * rConst_MolarMass_O2 * 3600.0;

(* Dynamic Stoichiometry Lambda Target Scheduling *)
IF (rVoted_StackCurrent_A < 300.0) THEN
    rLambda_O2_Target := 2.20; (* Higher excess ratio at idle to prevent cathode condensation flooding *)
ELSIF (bFlightTakeoffMode) THEN
    rLambda_O2_Target := 1.65; (* High power density mode: maximize stack efficiency and pressure *)
ELSE
    rLambda_O2_Target := 1.85; (* Cruise mode: balance parasitic compressor power and cell potential *)
END_IF;

(* Required Dry Air Mass Flow [kg/h] *)
rAir_MassRequired_kg_h := (rO2_MassConsumption_kg_h / rConst_DryAir_O2_MassFrac) * rLambda_O2_Target;
IF (rAir_MassRequired_kg_h < 120.0) AND (iMachineState >= 70) THEN
    rAir_MassRequired_kg_h := 120.0; (* Minimum idle purge airflow *)
END_IF;

(* Evaluated Real-Time Cathode Stoichiometric Ratio *)
IF (rO2_MassConsumption_kg_h > 1.0) THEN
    rLambda_O2_Actual := (rVoted_AirFlow_kg_h * rConst_DryAir_O2_MassFrac) / rO2_MassConsumption_kg_h;
ELSE
    rLambda_O2_Actual := 3.00;
END_IF;
rAct_CathodeStoichiometry_Calc := rLambda_O2_Actual;

(* Oxygen Starvation Guard Monitor *)
IF (rLambda_O2_Actual < 1.35) AND (rVoted_StackCurrent_A > 250.0) THEN
    rStarvation_Duration_Sec := rStarvation_Duration_Sec + rCycleTime_Sec;
    dwWarningsInternal := dwWarningsInternal OR 16#00000008; (* Warning Bit 3: Oxygen Starvation Alert *)
    IF (rStarvation_Duration_Sec > 0.400) THEN
        dwAlarmsInternal := dwAlarmsInternal OR 16#00000080; (* Alarm Bit 7: Critical Cathode Starvation Trip *)
    END_IF;
ELSE
    IF (rStarvation_Duration_Sec > 0.0) THEN
        rStarvation_Duration_Sec := rStarvation_Duration_Sec - (rCycleTime_Sec * 2.0);
    END_IF;
END_IF;

(* Electric Turbo-Compressor Shaft Speed Command [rpm] *)
rCompressor_Speed_Cmd := 12000.0 + (rAir_MassRequired_kg_h / 2400.0) * 80000.0;
IF (rCompressor_Speed_Cmd > 95000.0) THEN rCompressor_Speed_Cmd := 95000.0; END_IF;
IF (rCompressor_Speed_Cmd < 10000.0) THEN rCompressor_Speed_Cmd := 10000.0; END_IF;
rCmd_CompressorSpeed_SP := rCompressor_Speed_Cmd;

(* Cathode Dynamic Backpressure Throttle Valve CV301 *)
(* Pressure target: 2.20 bar at cruise, up to 3.00 bar at takeoff *)
IF (bFlightTakeoffMode) THEN
    rCmd_CathodeBackpressValve_CV301 := 55.0 + (rVoted_AirFlow_kg_h / 2400.0) * 35.0;
ELSE
    rCmd_CathodeBackpressValve_CV301 := 35.0 + (rVoted_AirFlow_kg_h / 2400.0) * 45.0;
END_IF;

(* Anti-Surge Bleed Modulation *)
IF (rAct_CompressorSurgeMargin_Pct < 15.0) THEN
    (* Open cathode backpressure valve rapidly to relieve pressure and restore flow *)
    rCmd_CathodeBackpressValve_CV301 := 10.0;
    dwWarningsInternal := dwWarningsInternal OR 16#00000010; (* Warning Bit 4: Compressor Surge Imminent *)
END_IF;

(* Section 7: 6x6 Discrete Linear State-Space Observer & Kalman Updates *)
(* Measurements y_meas: deviations from nominal operating point *)
y_meas[1] := rVoted_TankPress_bar - 2.300;
y_meas[2] := rTemp_MCHX_H2_Out_TT103 - 285.0;
y_meas[3] := rTemp_Glycol_Return_TT202 - 68.0;
y_meas[4] := rVoted_AirFlow_kg_h - 1450.0;
y_meas[5] := rVoted_StackCurrent_A - 1250.0;
y_meas[6] := rVoltage_HVDC_Bus_VT201 - 800.0;

(* Estimated Outputs y_est = C * x_hat + D * u_opt *)
y_est[1] := C_mat[1,1]*x_hat[1] + C_mat[1,2]*x_hat[2] + C_mat[1,3]*x_hat[3] + C_mat[1,4]*x_hat[4] + C_mat[1,5]*x_hat[5] + C_mat[1,6]*x_hat[6];
y_est[2] := C_mat[2,1]*x_hat[1] + C_mat[2,2]*x_hat[2] + C_mat[2,3]*x_hat[3] + C_mat[2,4]*x_hat[4] + C_mat[2,5]*x_hat[5] + C_mat[2,6]*x_hat[6];
y_est[3] := C_mat[3,1]*x_hat[1] + C_mat[3,2]*x_hat[2] + C_mat[3,3]*x_hat[3] + C_mat[3,4]*x_hat[4] + C_mat[3,5]*x_hat[5] + C_mat[3,6]*x_hat[6];
y_est[4] := C_mat[4,1]*x_hat[1] + C_mat[4,2]*x_hat[2] + C_mat[4,3]*x_hat[3] + C_mat[4,4]*x_hat[4] + C_mat[4,5]*x_hat[5] + C_mat[4,6]*x_hat[6];
y_est[5] := C_mat[5,1]*x_hat[1] + C_mat[5,2]*x_hat[2] + C_mat[5,3]*x_hat[3] + C_mat[5,4]*x_hat[4] + C_mat[5,5]*x_hat[5] + C_mat[5,6]*x_hat[6];
y_est[6] := C_mat[6,1]*x_hat[1] + C_mat[6,2]*x_hat[2] + C_mat[6,3]*x_hat[3] + C_mat[6,4]*x_hat[4] + C_mat[6,5]*x_hat[5] + C_mat[6,6]*x_hat[6];

(* State Innovation Prediction: x_pred = A * x_hat + B * u_opt *)
x_pred[1] := A_mat[1,1]*x_hat[1] + A_mat[1,2]*x_hat[2] + A_mat[1,3]*x_hat[3] + A_mat[1,4]*x_hat[4] + A_mat[1,5]*x_hat[5] + A_mat[1,6]*x_hat[6] + B_mat[1,1]*u_opt[1] + B_mat[1,2]*u_opt[2] + B_mat[1,3]*u_opt[3] + B_mat[1,4]*u_opt[4];
x_pred[2] := A_mat[2,1]*x_hat[1] + A_mat[2,2]*x_hat[2] + A_mat[2,3]*x_hat[3] + A_mat[2,4]*x_hat[4] + A_mat[2,5]*x_hat[5] + A_mat[2,6]*x_hat[6] + B_mat[2,1]*u_opt[1] + B_mat[2,2]*u_opt[2] + B_mat[2,3]*u_opt[3] + B_mat[2,4]*u_opt[4];
x_pred[3] := A_mat[3,1]*x_hat[1] + A_mat[3,2]*x_hat[2] + A_mat[3,3]*x_hat[3] + A_mat[3,4]*x_hat[4] + A_mat[3,5]*x_hat[5] + A_mat[3,6]*x_hat[6] + B_mat[3,1]*u_opt[1] + B_mat[3,2]*u_opt[2] + B_mat[3,3]*u_opt[3] + B_mat[3,4]*u_opt[4];
x_pred[4] := A_mat[4,1]*x_hat[1] + A_mat[4,2]*x_hat[2] + A_mat[4,3]*x_hat[3] + A_mat[4,4]*x_hat[4] + A_mat[4,5]*x_hat[5] + A_mat[4,6]*x_hat[6] + B_mat[4,1]*u_opt[1] + B_mat[4,2]*u_opt[2] + B_mat[4,3]*u_opt[3] + B_mat[4,4]*u_opt[4];
x_pred[5] := A_mat[5,1]*x_hat[1] + A_mat[5,2]*x_hat[2] + A_mat[5,3]*x_hat[3] + A_mat[5,4]*x_hat[4] + A_mat[5,5]*x_hat[5] + A_mat[5,6]*x_hat[6] + B_mat[5,1]*u_opt[1] + B_mat[5,2]*u_opt[2] + B_mat[5,3]*u_opt[3] + B_mat[5,4]*u_opt[4];
x_pred[6] := A_mat[6,1]*x_hat[1] + A_mat[6,2]*x_hat[2] + A_mat[6,3]*x_hat[3] + A_mat[6,4]*x_hat[4] + A_mat[6,5]*x_hat[5] + A_mat[6,6]*x_hat[6] + B_mat[6,1]*u_opt[1] + B_mat[6,2]*u_opt[2] + B_mat[6,3]*u_opt[3] + B_mat[6,4]*u_opt[4];

(* Observer State Correction: x_hat = x_pred + L * (y_meas - y_est) *)
x_hat[1] := x_pred[1] + L_obs[1,1]*(y_meas[1] - y_est[1]);
x_hat[2] := x_pred[2] + L_obs[2,2]*(y_meas[2] - y_est[2]);
x_hat[3] := x_pred[3] + L_obs[3,3]*(y_meas[3] - y_est[3]);
x_hat[4] := x_pred[4] + L_obs[4,4]*(y_meas[4] - y_est[4]);
x_hat[5] := x_pred[5] + L_obs[5,5]*(y_meas[5] - y_est[5]);
x_hat[6] := x_pred[6] + L_obs[6,6]*(y_meas[6] - y_est[6]);

(* Section 8: Model Predictive Control (MPC) Quadratic Cost Fast Active-Set Solver *)
(* Analytical Quadratic Gradient: grad = B^T * Q * x_hat + R * u + S * (u - u_prev) *)
rQP_Gradient[1] := (B_mat[1,1]*Q_weights[1]*x_hat[1] + B_mat[2,1]*Q_weights[2]*x_hat[2]) + R_weights[1]*u_opt[1] + S_weights[1]*(u_opt[1] - u_prev[1]);
rQP_Gradient[2] := (B_mat[2,2]*Q_weights[2]*x_hat[2] + B_mat[3,2]*Q_weights[3]*x_hat[3]) + R_weights[2]*u_opt[2] + S_weights[2]*(u_opt[2] - u_prev[2]);
rQP_Gradient[3] := (B_mat[4,3]*Q_weights[4]*x_hat[4])                                      + R_weights[3]*u_opt[3] + S_weights[3]*(u_opt[3] - u_prev[3]);
rQP_Gradient[4] := (B_mat[5,4]*Q_weights[5]*x_hat[5] + B_mat[6,4]*Q_weights[6]*x_hat[6]) + R_weights[4]*u_opt[4] + S_weights[4]*(u_opt[4] - u_prev[4]);

(* Diagonal Hessian Approximation *)
rQP_Hessian_Diag[1] := R_weights[1] + S_weights[1] + 0.05;
rQP_Hessian_Diag[2] := R_weights[2] + S_weights[2] + 0.10;
rQP_Hessian_Diag[3] := R_weights[3] + S_weights[3] + 0.04;
rQP_Hessian_Diag[4] := R_weights[4] + S_weights[4] + 0.02;

(* Projected Gradient Newton Step with Actuator Rate & Amplitude Constraints *)
u_opt[1] := u_opt[1] - (rQP_Gradient[1] / rQP_Hessian_Diag[1]) * 0.40;
u_opt[2] := u_opt[2] - (rQP_Gradient[2] / rQP_Hessian_Diag[2]) * 0.40;
u_opt[3] := u_opt[3] - (rQP_Gradient[3] / rQP_Hessian_Diag[3]) * 0.40;

    rCarriagePropValve_Cmd_mA       : REAL;     (* Carriage hydraulic proportional valve 4-20mA command [-100%..+100%] *)
    rLadderWinchSpeed_Cmd_rpm       : REAL;     (* Ladder hydraulic winch displacement motor speed setpoint [rpm] *)
    rLadderBrakePressure_Cmd_bar    : REAL;     (* Ladder fail-safe disc brake release pressure command [bar] (0..210) *)

    (* High-Integrity Voted Process Quantities *)
    rVotedCarriagePos_m             : REAL;     (* 2oo3 TMR validated spud carriage linear position [m] *)
    rVotedLadderTension_kN          : REAL;     (* 2oo3 TMR validated ladder wire rope tension [kN] *)
    rVotedHydrPress_bar             : REAL;     (* 2oo3 TMR validated hydraulic ring main supply pressure [bar] *)

    (* Interlocks & Operational Permissives *)
    bAuxSpudLiftPermissive          : BOOL;     (* Interlock permissive allowing auxiliary spud extraction hoist *)
    bWorkSpudDropPermissive         : BOOL;     (* Interlock permissive allowing working spud gravity freefall / drive *)
    iCurrentSteppingStep            : INT;      (* Active sequence phase ID of spud carriage walking automaton (0..999) *)
    rEstimatedHeaveDisp_m           : REAL;     (* State-space observer derived instantaneous pontoon heave [m] *)
    rHydrPowerDemand_kW             : REAL;     (* Real-time computed hydraulic active power consumption [kW] *)

    (* System Telemetry & Alarm Words *)
    wSystemStatusWord               : WORD;     (* Packed operational status bits (Run, AHC active, Stepping, etc.) *)
    dwAlarmBitmask                  : DWORD;    (* SIL-rated diagnostic trip matrix (bitmapped alarms) *)
END_VAR

VAR
    (* -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
       PHYSICAL CONSTANTS & DREDGE GEOMETRY SPECIFICATIONS
       ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
    c_rDt_s                         : REAL := 0.010;        (* Discrete control task sample period: 10 ms *)
    c_rGravity_mps2                 : REAL := 9.80665;      (* Gravitational acceleration constant [m/s^2] *)
    c_rLadderDryMass_kg             : REAL := 1200000.0;    (* Dry structural mass of cutter ladder: 1,200 metric tons *)
    c_rLadderLength_m               : REAL := 52.0;         (* Trunnion pivot center to cutter head tip length [m] *)
    c_rLadderCoG_Dist_m             : REAL := 24.5;         (* Distance from trunnion pivot to center of gravity [m] *)
    c_rLadderDisplVolume_m3         : REAL := 420.0;        (* Fully submerged volumetric displacement [m^3] *)
    c_rSeawaterDensity_kgpm3        : REAL := 1025.0;       (* Ambient seawater mass density [kg/m^3] *)
    c_rCarriageMaxStroke_m          : REAL := 8.000;        (* Total working spud carriage mechanical stroke [m] *)
    c_rCarriageCushionZone_m        : REAL := 0.350;        (* End-stroke hydraulic deceleration cushioning zone [m] *)

    (* 2oo3 TMR Divergence Limits & Safety Trip Thresholds *)
    c_rPosDiscrepancyTol_m          : REAL := 0.060;        (* Maximum allowed sensor discrepancy for carriage position [m] *)
    c_rPressDiscrepancyTol_bar      : REAL := 14.0;         (* Maximum allowed pressure sensor discrepancy [bar] *)
    c_rTensionDiscrepancyTol_kN     : REAL := 65.0;         (* Maximum allowed wire tension load cell discrepancy [kN] *)
    c_rTensionHighTrip_kN           : REAL := 2250.0;       (* Ultimate wire rope dynamic load trip limit [kN] *)
    c_rTensionLowSlackTrip_kN       : REAL := 35.0;         (* Wire rope slack prevention emergency trip limit [kN] *)
    c_rHydrLowTrip_bar              : REAL := 160.0;        (* Hydraulic ring main minimum operational pressure [bar] *)
    c_rMinSpudPenetration_m         : REAL := 2.50;         (* Minimum required seabed penetration before load handoff [m] *)

    (* -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
       2oo3 TRIPLE MODULAR REDUNDANCY (TMR) REGISTERS
       ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
    rPosDiff_AB                     : REAL;
    rPosDiff_BC                     : REAL;
    rPosDiff_CA                     : REAL;
    bPosFail_A                      : BOOL := FALSE;
    bPosFail_B                      : BOOL := FALSE;
    bPosFail_C                      : BOOL := FALSE;
    bPosDegraded_1oo2               : BOOL := FALSE;
    bPosCriticalLockout             : BOOL := FALSE;

    rPressDiff_AB                   : REAL;
    rPressDiff_BC                   : REAL;
    rPressDiff_CA                   : REAL;
    bPressFail_A                    : BOOL := FALSE;
    bPressFail_B                    : BOOL := FALSE;
    bPressFail_C                    : BOOL := FALSE;
    bPressDegraded_1oo2             : BOOL := FALSE;
    bPressCriticalLockout           : BOOL := FALSE;

    rTenDiff_AB                     : REAL;
    rTenDiff_BC                     : REAL;
    rTenDiff_CA                     : REAL;
    bTenFail_A                      : BOOL := FALSE;
    bTenFail_B                      : BOOL := FALSE;
    bTenFail_C                      : BOOL := FALSE;
    bTenDegraded_1oo2               : BOOL := FALSE;
    bTenCriticalLockout             : BOOL := FALSE;

    (* -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
       STATE-SPACE OBSERVER & ACTIVE HEAVE COMPENSATION (AHC) ARRAYS & REGISTERS
       Discrete 4-State Observer:
         x1: Pontoon Heave Linear Displacement [m]
         x2: Pontoon Heave Vertical Velocity [m/s]
         x3: Dynamic Wire Strain / Tension Perturbation [kN]
         x4: Winch Drum Angular Velocity [rad/s]
       ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
    a_matrix                        : ARRAY[1..4, 1..4] OF REAL; (* Discrete System Transition Matrix *)
    b_matrix                        : ARRAY[1..4, 1..2] OF REAL; (* Discrete Control Input Matrix *)
    c_matrix                        : ARRAY[1..4] OF REAL;       (* Observation Output Mapping Matrix *)
    k_lqr                           : ARRAY[1..4] OF REAL;       (* Optimal State Feedback Gain Vector *)
    l_obs                           : ARRAY[1..4] OF REAL;       (* Luenberger Observer Correction Gain Vector *)
    x_hat                           : ARRAY[1..4] OF REAL;       (* Estimated State Vector [x1, x2, x3, x4] *)
    x_hat_next                      : ARRAY[1..4] OF REAL;       (* State Propagation Vector at k+1 *)
    bMatricesInitialized            : BOOL := FALSE;

    (* Heave Motion Washout & Wave Resonance Notch Filters *)
    rWashout_x1                     : REAL := 0.0;
    rWashout_y1                     : REAL := 0.0;
    c_rWashoutAlpha                 : REAL := 0.988;        (* Washout high-pass filter coefficient for zero-drift *)
    rNotch_x1                       : REAL := 0.0;
    rNotch_x2                       : REAL := 0.0;
    rNotch_y1                       : REAL := 0.0;
    rNotch_y2                       : REAL := 0.0;
    c_rNotchA1                      : REAL := -1.942;       (* 2nd-Order IIR Notch Filter for 0.12 Hz Swell *)
    c_rNotchA2                      : REAL := 0.952;
    c_rNotchB0                      : REAL := 0.976;
    c_rNotchB1                      : REAL := -1.942;
    c_rNotchB2                      : REAL := 0.976;

    (* -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
       DYNAMIC TENSION PID REGULATOR & WIRE PROTECTION REGISTERS
       ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
    rTensionError_kN                : REAL := 0.0;
    rTensionIntegral_kN_s           : REAL := 0.0;
    rTensionDerivative_kN_ps        : REAL := 0.0;
    rPrevTensionError_kN            : REAL := 0.0;
    rKp_Tension                     : REAL := 0.420;        (* Proportional Gain [rpm / kN] *)
    rKi_Tension                     : REAL := 0.085;        (* Integral Gain [rpm / (kN*s)] *)
    rKd_Tension                     : REAL := 0.025;        (* Derivative Gain [rpm / (kN/s)] *)
    rIntegralClamp_rpm              : REAL := 250.0;        (* Anti-reset windup ceiling [rpm] *)
    rAntiSlackBoost_rpm             : REAL := 0.0;          (* Dynamic rapid hoist boost upon slack wire detection *)
    rOverloadRelief_rpm             : REAL := 0.0;          (* Dynamic rapid payout slip upon shock tension load *)
    rBrakeRampPressure_bar          : REAL := 0.0;          (* Winch fail-safe brake hydraulic release pressure ramp *)

    (* -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
       SPUD CARRIAGE HYDRAULIC WALKING FINITE STATE MACHINE (FSM)
       ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
    iCarriageFSM_State              : INT := 0;             (* Current active FSM state index *)
    iCarriageFSM_PrevState          : INT := -1;            (* Previous execution cycle state index *)
    rCarriageProfileSpeed_mpm       : REAL := 0.0;          (* S-curve shaped instantaneous velocity setpoint *)
    rCarriageRampSlope_mpm2         : REAL := 1.80;         (* Maximum linear acceleration/deceleration [m/min^2] *)
    tonAuxSpudDrop                  : TON;                  (* Timer for auxiliary spud lowering touchdown *)
    tonAuxSpudVerify                : TON;                  (* Timer for auxiliary spud soil penetration settling *)
    tonWorkSpudHoist                : TON;                  (* Timer for working spud extraction *)
    tonCarriageRetractTimeout       : TON;                  (* Watchdog timer for carriage full retraction stroke *)
    tonWorkSpudDrop                 : TON;                  (* Timer for working spud drop touchdown *)
    tonWorkSpudVerify               : TON;                  (* Timer for working spud soil consolidation *)
    tonAuxSpudHoist                 : TON;                  (* Timer for auxiliary spud retract clear of seabed *)
    tonFaultHoldOff                 : TON;                  (* Debounce timer for transient sensor discrepancies *)

    (* Hydrostatic Model Working Variables *)
    rLadderSubmergedFactor          : REAL := 0.0;
    rBuoyantReduction_kN            : REAL := 0.0;
    rEquilibriumStaticTension_kN    : REAL := 0.0;

    (* Local Temporary Computational Floats *)
    rTemp_mA                        : REAL;
    rTemp_rpm                       : REAL;
    rObsDiff                        : REAL;
    rUnfilteredHeaveVel             : REAL;
    rFilteredHeaveVel               : REAL;
    rRawFilteredAccel               : REAL;
END_VAR

(*
========================================================================================================================
  EXECUTABLE STRUCTURED TEXT LOGIC BEGINS HERE
========================================================================================================================
*)

(* -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
   SECTION 1: EMERGENCY SAFETY INTERLOCK & SYSTEM RUN PERMISSIVE VERIFICATION
   ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
IF NOT bEmergencyStop THEN
    (* SIL-3 De-energize to Trip Condition Detected *)
    rCarriagePropValve_Cmd_mA    := 12.0; (* 12.0 mA represents hydraulic proportional valve electrical neutral/null *)
    rLadderWinchSpeed_Cmd_rpm    := 0.0;
    rLadderBrakePressure_Cmd_bar := 0.0;  (* 0 bar = Spring-applied multi-disc fail-safe mechanical brake locked *)
    bAuxSpudLiftPermissive       := FALSE;
    bWorkSpudDropPermissive      := FALSE;
    iCarriageFSM_State           := 999;  (* Forced Transition to EMERGENCY_FAULT_LOCKOUT *)
    iCurrentSteppingStep         := 999;

    (* Assert Master Emergency Trip bit in telemetry alarm bitmask *)
    dwAlarmBitmask.0 := TRUE; (* Bit 0: Emergency Stop Loop Tripped *)
    wSystemStatusWord := 16#0000;
    RETURN;
END_IF;

IF NOT bEnableSystem THEN
    (* Controlled Standby / Parked State *)
    rCarriagePropValve_Cmd_mA    := 12.0;
    rLadderWinchSpeed_Cmd_rpm    := 0.0;
    rLadderBrakePressure_Cmd_bar := 0.0;  (* Hold mechanical brakes engaged *)
    bAuxSpudLiftPermissive       := FALSE;
    bWorkSpudDropPermissive      := FALSE;
    iCarriageFSM_State           := 0;    (* IDLE / STANDBY *)
    iCurrentSteppingStep         := 0;
    wSystemStatusWord.0          := FALSE;(* Bit 0: System Inactive *)
    RETURN;
END_IF;

wSystemStatusWord.0 := TRUE; (* Bit 0: System Active / Run *)

(* -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
   SECTION 2: 2oo3 TRIPLE MODULAR REDUNDANCY (TMR) SENSOR VOTING & FAULT DEGRADATION
   ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)

(* 2A. Carriage Position Transducers Voting (ChA, ChB, ChC) *)
rPosDiff_AB := ABS(rCarriagePos_ChA - rCarriagePos_ChB);
rPosDiff_BC := ABS(rCarriagePos_ChB - rCarriagePos_ChC);
rPosDiff_CA := ABS(rCarriagePos_ChC - rCarriagePos_ChA);

(* Evaluate Individual Channel Discrepancy Faults *)
bPosFail_A := (rPosDiff_AB > c_rPosDiscrepancyTol_m) AND (rPosDiff_CA > c_rPosDiscrepancyTol_m);
bPosFail_B := (rPosDiff_AB > c_rPosDiscrepancyTol_m) AND (rPosDiff_BC > c_rPosDiscrepancyTol_m);
bPosFail_C := (rPosDiff_BC > c_rPosDiscrepancyTol_m) AND (rPosDiff_CA > c_rPosDiscrepancyTol_m);

IF (NOT bPosFail_A) AND (NOT bPosFail_B) AND (NOT bPosFail_C) THEN
    (* Healthy 2oo3 Regime: Calculate True Mathematical Median of Three Transducers *)
    IF ((rCarriagePos_ChA >= rCarriagePos_ChB) AND (rCarriagePos_ChA <= rCarriagePos_ChC)) OR
       ((rCarriagePos_ChA <= rCarriagePos_ChB) AND (rCarriagePos_ChA >= rCarriagePos_ChC)) THEN
        rVotedCarriagePos_m := rCarriagePos_ChA;
    ELSIF ((rCarriagePos_ChB >= rCarriagePos_ChA) AND (rCarriagePos_ChB <= rCarriagePos_ChC)) OR
          ((rCarriagePos_ChB <= rCarriagePos_ChA) AND (rCarriagePos_ChB >= rCarriagePos_ChC)) THEN
        rVotedCarriagePos_m := rCarriagePos_ChB;
    ELSE
        rVotedCarriagePos_m := rCarriagePos_ChC;
    END_IF;
    bPosDegraded_1oo2   := FALSE;
    bPosCriticalLockout := FALSE;
ELSIF bPosFail_A AND (NOT bPosFail_B) AND (NOT bPosFail_C) THEN
    (* Channel A Failed: Degrade to 1oo2 Average of B and C *)
    rVotedCarriagePos_m := (rCarriagePos_ChB + rCarriagePos_ChC) * 0.5;
    bPosDegraded_1oo2   := TRUE;
    dwAlarmBitmask.8    := TRUE; (* Pos Sensor ChA Fault *)
ELSIF bPosFail_B AND (NOT bPosFail_A) AND (NOT bPosFail_C) THEN
    (* Channel B Failed: Degrade to 1oo2 Average of A and C *)
    rVotedCarriagePos_m := (rCarriagePos_ChA + rCarriagePos_ChC) * 0.5;
    bPosDegraded_1oo2   := TRUE;
    dwAlarmBitmask.9    := TRUE; (* Pos Sensor ChB Fault *)
ELSIF bPosFail_C AND (NOT bPosFail_A) AND (NOT bPosFail_B) THEN
    (* Channel C Failed: Degrade to 1oo2 Average of A and B *)
    rVotedCarriagePos_m := (rCarriagePos_ChA + rCarriagePos_ChB) * 0.5;
    bPosDegraded_1oo2   := TRUE;
    dwAlarmBitmask.10   := TRUE; (* Pos Sensor ChC Fault *)
ELSE
    (* Multiple Sensor Failure: 2oo3 Critical Loss of Integrity *)
    bPosCriticalLockout := TRUE;
    dwAlarmBitmask.11   := TRUE; (* Carriage Position Complete Voting Lockout *)
END_IF;

(* 2B. HPU Ring Main Supply Pressure Transmitters Voting (ChA, ChB, ChC) *)
rPressDiff_AB := ABS(rHydrSupplyPressure_Bar_A - rHydrSupplyPressure_Bar_B);
rPressDiff_BC := ABS(rHydrSupplyPressure_Bar_B - rHydrSupplyPressure_Bar_C);
rPressDiff_CA := ABS(rHydrSupplyPressure_Bar_C - rHydrSupplyPressure_Bar_A);

bPressFail_A := (rPressDiff_AB > c_rPressDiscrepancyTol_bar) AND (rPressDiff_CA > c_rPressDiscrepancyTol_bar);
bPressFail_B := (rPressDiff_AB > c_rPressDiscrepancyTol_bar) AND (rPressDiff_BC > c_rPressDiscrepancyTol_bar);
bPressFail_C := (rPressDiff_BC > c_rPressDiscrepancyTol_bar) AND (rPressDiff_CA > c_rPressDiscrepancyTol_bar);

IF (NOT bPressFail_A) AND (NOT bPressFail_B) AND (NOT bPressFail_C) THEN
    IF ((rHydrSupplyPressure_Bar_A >= rHydrSupplyPressure_Bar_B) AND (rHydrSupplyPressure_Bar_A <= rHydrSupplyPressure_Bar_C)) OR
       ((rHydrSupplyPressure_Bar_A <= rHydrSupplyPressure_Bar_B) AND (rHydrSupplyPressure_Bar_A >= rHydrSupplyPressure_Bar_C)) THEN
        rVotedHydrPress_bar := rHydrSupplyPressure_Bar_A;
    ELSIF ((rHydrSupplyPressure_Bar_B >= rHydrSupplyPressure_Bar_A) AND (rHydrSupplyPressure_Bar_B <= rHydrSupplyPressure_Bar_C)) OR
          ((rHydrSupplyPressure_Bar_B <= rHydrSupplyPressure_Bar_A) AND (rHydrSupplyPressure_Bar_B >= rHydrSupplyPressure_Bar_C)) THEN
        rVotedHydrPress_bar := rHydrSupplyPressure_Bar_B;
    ELSE
        rVotedHydrPress_bar := rHydrSupplyPressure_Bar_C;
    END_IF;
    bPressDegraded_1oo2   := FALSE;
    bPressCriticalLockout := FALSE;
ELSIF bPressFail_A AND (NOT bPressFail_B) AND (NOT bPressFail_C) THEN
    rVotedHydrPress_bar   := (rHydrSupplyPressure_Bar_B + rHydrSupplyPressure_Bar_C) * 0.5;
    bPressDegraded_1oo2   := TRUE;
    dwAlarmBitmask.12     := TRUE; (* Pressure Sensor ChA Fault *)
ELSIF bPressFail_B AND (NOT bPressFail_A) AND (NOT bPressFail_C) THEN
    rVotedHydrPress_bar   := (rHydrSupplyPressure_Bar_A + rHydrSupplyPressure_Bar_C) * 0.5;
    bPressDegraded_1oo2   := TRUE;
    dwAlarmBitmask.13     := TRUE; (* Pressure Sensor ChB Fault *)
ELSIF bPressFail_C AND (NOT bPressFail_A) AND (NOT bPressFail_B) THEN
    rVotedHydrPress_bar   := (rHydrSupplyPressure_Bar_A + rHydrSupplyPressure_Bar_B) * 0.5;
    bPressDegraded_1oo2   := TRUE;
    dwAlarmBitmask.14     := TRUE; (* Pressure Sensor ChC Fault *)
ELSE
    bPressCriticalLockout := TRUE;
    dwAlarmBitmask.15     := TRUE; (* HPU Pressure Complete Voting Lockout *)
END_IF;

(* 2C. Ladder Suspension Wire Rope Dynamic Tension Load Cells Voting (ChA, ChB, ChC) *)
rTenDiff_AB := ABS(rLadderTension_kN_A - rLadderTension_kN_B);
rTenDiff_BC := ABS(rLadderTension_kN_B - rLadderTension_kN_C);
rTenDiff_CA := ABS(rLadderTension_kN_C - rLadderTension_kN_A);

bTenFail_A := (rTenDiff_AB > c_rTensionDiscrepancyTol_kN) AND (rTenDiff_CA > c_rTensionDiscrepancyTol_kN);
bTenFail_B := (rTenDiff_AB > c_rTensionDiscrepancyTol_kN) AND (rTenDiff_BC > c_rTensionDiscrepancyTol_kN);
bTenFail_C := (rTenDiff_BC > c_rTensionDiscrepancyTol_kN) AND (rTenDiff_CA > c_rTensionDiscrepancyTol_kN);

IF (NOT bTenFail_A) AND (NOT bTenFail_B) AND (NOT bTenFail_C) THEN
    IF ((rLadderTension_kN_A >= rLadderTension_kN_B) AND (rLadderTension_kN_A <= rLadderTension_kN_C)) OR
       ((rLadderTension_kN_A <= rLadderTension_kN_B) AND (rLadderTension_kN_A >= rLadderTension_kN_C)) THEN
        rVotedLadderTension_kN := rLadderTension_kN_A;
    ELSIF ((rLadderTension_kN_B >= rLadderTension_kN_A) AND (rLadderTension_kN_B <= rLadderTension_kN_C)) OR
          ((rLadderTension_kN_B <= rLadderTension_kN_A) AND (rLadderTension_kN_B >= rLadderTension_kN_C)) THEN
        rVotedLadderTension_kN := rLadderTension_kN_B;
    ELSE
        rVotedLadderTension_kN := rLadderTension_kN_C;
    END_IF;
    bTenDegraded_1oo2   := FALSE;
    bTenCriticalLockout := FALSE;
ELSIF bTenFail_A AND (NOT bTenFail_B) AND (NOT bTenFail_C) THEN
    rVotedLadderTension_kN := (rLadderTension_kN_B + rLadderTension_kN_C) * 0.5;
    bTenDegraded_1oo2      := TRUE;
    dwAlarmBitmask.16      := TRUE; (* Tension Load Cell ChA Fault *)
ELSIF bTenFail_B AND (NOT bTenFail_A) AND (NOT bTenFail_C) THEN
    rVotedLadderTension_kN := (rLadderTension_kN_A + rLadderTension_kN_C) * 0.5;
    bTenDegraded_1oo2      := TRUE;
    dwAlarmBitmask.17      := TRUE; (* Tension Load Cell ChB Fault *)
ELSIF bTenFail_C AND (NOT bTenFail_A) AND (NOT bTenFail_B) THEN
    rVotedLadderTension_kN := (rLadderTension_kN_A + rLadderTension_kN_B) * 0.5;
    bTenDegraded_1oo2      := TRUE;
    dwAlarmBitmask.18      := TRUE; (* Tension Load Cell ChC Fault *)
ELSE
    bTenCriticalLockout    := TRUE;
    dwAlarmBitmask.19      := TRUE; (* Ladder Tension Complete Voting Lockout *)
END_IF;

(* Evaluate Critical Double-Sensor Degradation or Low HPU Pressure Trip *)
IF bPosCriticalLockout OR bPressCriticalLockout OR bTenCriticalLockout OR (rVotedHydrPress_bar < c_rHydrLowTrip_bar) THEN
    iCarriageFSM_State           := 999;
    iCurrentSteppingStep         := 999;
    rCarriagePropValve_Cmd_mA    := 12.0;
    rLadderWinchSpeed_Cmd_rpm    := 0.0;
    rLadderBrakePressure_Cmd_bar := 0.0;
    dwAlarmBitmask.1             := TRUE; (* Critical Hydraulic/Sensor Tripped *)
    RETURN;
END_IF;

(* -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
   SECTION 3: HYDROSTATIC BUOYANCY COMPENSATION & EQUILIBRIUM TENSION MODEL
   ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* The cutter ladder rotates about submerged trunnion pins. Effective submerged weight is attenuated by buoyancy:
   Buoyancy F_b = V_displaced * rho_water * g.
   At shallow trunnion angles, ladder is partially out of water. At high angles, it is fully submerged. *)
rLadderSubmergedFactor := LIMIT(0.20, (rLadderTrunnionAngle_Deg / 45.0) + (rDredgeDraught_m - 4.5) * 0.15, 1.00);
rBuoyantReduction_kN   := (c_rLadderDisplVolume_m3 * rLadderSubmergedFactor * c_rSeawaterDensity_kgpm3 * c_rGravity_mps2) / 1000.0;

(* Calculate nominal static suspension load required at ladder head sheaves:
   Equilibrium static tension T_static = (DryWeight - Buoyancy) * (L_cog / L_sheaves) * cos(TrunnionAngle) *)
rEquilibriumStaticTension_kN := ((c_rLadderDryMass_kg * c_rGravity_mps2 / 1000.0) - rBuoyantReduction_kN)
                                * (c_rLadderCoG_Dist_m / c_rLadderLength_m)
                                * COS(rLadderTrunnionAngle_Deg * 3.14159265 / 180.0);

(* Instantaneous Hydraulic Power Computation: P [kW] = (Q [L/min] * P [bar]) / 600 *)
rHydrPowerDemand_kW := (ABS(rLadderWinchSpeed_Cmd_rpm) * 1.85 + ABS(rCarriageProfileSpeed_mpm) * 22.0)
                       * (rVotedHydrPress_bar / 600.0);

(* -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
   SECTION 4: STATE-SPACE KALMAN-LUENBERGER OBSERVER & ACTIVE HEAVE COMPENSATION (AHC)
   ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* Initialize Discrete State-Space Matrices on First Scan *)
IF NOT bMatricesInitialized THEN
    (* Continuous-to-Discrete ZOH formulation at Ts = 0.010 s *)
    a_matrix[1,1] := 0.9998; a_matrix[1,2] := 0.0099; a_matrix[1,3] := 0.0000; a_matrix[1,4] := 0.0000;
    a_matrix[2,1] := -0.0452; a_matrix[2,2] := 0.9850; a_matrix[2,3] := 0.0008; a_matrix[2,4] := 0.0000;
    a_matrix[3,1] := 0.0000; a_matrix[3,2] := 0.8500; a_matrix[3,3] := 0.9920; a_matrix[3,4] := -0.0125;
    a_matrix[4,1] := 0.0000; a_matrix[4,2] := 0.0000; a_matrix[4,3] := 0.0420; a_matrix[4,4] := 0.9650;

    b_matrix[1,1] := 0.0000; b_matrix[1,2] := 0.0000;
    b_matrix[2,1] := 0.0100; b_matrix[2,2] := 0.0000;
    b_matrix[3,1] := 0.0000; b_matrix[3,2] := 0.0125;
    b_matrix[4,1] := 0.0000; b_matrix[4,2] := 0.0850;

    c_matrix[1] := 0.0; c_matrix[2] := 0.0; c_matrix[3] := 1.0; c_matrix[4] := 0.0;

    (* Luenberger Observer Gains (Pole Placement in Discrete Z-Plane) *)
    l_obs[1] := 0.024;
    l_obs[2] := 0.185;
    l_obs[3] := 0.450;
    l_obs[4] := 0.310;

    (* Full-State Feedback / Optimal LQR Gains *)
    k_lqr[1] := 1.250;
    k_lqr[2] := 4.800;
    k_lqr[3] := 0.350;
    k_lqr[4] := 0.180;

    bMatricesInitialized := TRUE;
END_IF;

(* Washout High-Pass Filter on MRU Heave Acceleration to Prevent Integration Drift *)
rWashout_y1 := c_rWashoutAlpha * (rWashout_y1 + rMRU_HeaveAccel_mps2 - rWashout_x1);
rWashout_x1 := rMRU_HeaveAccel_mps2;
rRawFilteredAccel := rWashout_y1;

(* Notch Filter to suppress dominant wave frequency excitation (0.12 Hz marine swell) *)
rFilteredHeaveVel := c_rNotchB0 * rRawFilteredAccel + c_rNotchB1 * rNotch_x1 + c_rNotchB2 * rNotch_x2
                     - c_rNotchA1 * rNotch_y1 - c_rNotchA2 * rNotch_y2;
rNotch_x2 := rNotch_x1;
rNotch_x1 := rRawFilteredAccel;
rNotch_y2 := rNotch_y1;
rNotch_y1 := rFilteredHeaveVel;

(* Observer Innovation: Compare Measured Wire Tension with Estimated Output *)

(* The heavy spud carriage mechanism enables continuous forward walking of the dredge.

   Carriage cylinder slowly advances from 0.0 m to 8.0 m stroke as the dredge swings.
   When cylinder reaches stroke limit (8.0 m), autonomous stepping sequence transfers anchor

        IF rVotedCarriagePos_m >= (c_rCarriageMaxStroke_m - c_rCarriageCushionZone_m) THEN

        END_IF;

    20: (* STATE: SWING TO CENTERLINE & HOLD *)
        (* Dredge must halt swing cutting and align with excavation cut centerline before stepping *)
        iCurrentSteppingStep      := 20;
        wSystemStatusWord.1       := TRUE; (* Stepping Sequence Active *)
        rCarriageProfileSpeed_mpm := 0.0;

        IF ABS(rCutterSwingVelocity_mpm) < 0.25 THEN
            iCarriageFSM_State := 30; (* Aligned at centerline: Lower Auxiliary Spud *)
        END_IF;

    30: (* STATE: LOWER AUXILIARY SPUD *)
        (* Drop auxiliary spud to anchor dredge stern firmly into seabed *)
        iCurrentSteppingStep := 30;
        tonAuxSpudDrop(IN := TRUE, PT := T#12S);

        IF tonAuxSpudDrop.Q THEN
            tonAuxSpudDrop(IN := FALSE);
            iCarriageFSM_State := 40; (* Proceed to Soil Penetration Verification *)
        END_IF;

    40: (* STATE: VERIFY AUXILIARY SPUD SEATED INTEGRITY *)
        (* Interlock check: Ensure auxiliary spud has penetrated deep enough into solid soil *)
        iCurrentSteppingStep := 40;
        tonAuxSpudVerify(IN := TRUE, PT := T#4S);

        IF tonAuxSpudVerify.Q THEN
            tonAuxSpudVerify(IN := FALSE);
            IF rAuxSpudSeabedPenetration_m >= c_rMinSpudPenetration_m THEN
                iCarriageFSM_State := 50; (* Auxiliary Spud Solid: Safe to Hoist Working Spud *)
            ELSE
                dwAlarmBitmask.5   := TRUE; (* Auxiliary Spud Penetration Insufficient Fault *)
                iCarriageFSM_State := 999;
            END_IF;
        END_IF;

        iCurrentSteppingStep   := 50;

        tonWorkSpudHoist(IN := TRUE, PT := T#15S);

        IF tonWorkSpudHoist.Q THEN
            tonWorkSpudHoist(IN := FALSE);
            IF rWorkSpudSeabedPenetration_m <= 0.10 THEN
                iCarriageFSM_State := 60; (* Working spud clear: Retract carriage *)
            ELSE
                dwAlarmBitmask.6   := TRUE; (* Working Spud Failed to Clear Seabed *)
                iCarriageFSM_State := 999;
            END_IF;
        END_IF;

    60: (* STATE: CARRIAGE REVERSE RETRACT (8.0m -> 0.0m) *)
        (* Cylinder rapidly retracts the carriage pontoon along the spud well *)
        iCurrentSteppingStep := 60;

        (* S-curve shaped reverse deceleration as 0.0m zero-datum is approached *)
        IF rVotedCarriagePos_m <= c_rCarriageCushionZone_m THEN
            rCarriageProfileSpeed_mpm := -MAX(0.30, 6.0 * (rVotedCarriagePos_m / c_rCarriageCushionZone_m));
        ELSE

        END_IF;

        IF rVotedCarriagePos_m <= 0.040 THEN

        ELSIF tonCarriageRetractTimeout.Q THEN

            dwAlarmBitmask.7   := TRUE; (* Carriage Retract Travel Watchdog Timeout *)
            iCarriageFSM_State := 999;
        END_IF;

    70: (* STATE: LOWER WORKING SPUD TO SEABED *)
        (* Gravity drop and hydraulic drive of working spud in its new advanced location *)
        iCurrentSteppingStep    := 70;
        bWorkSpudDropPermissive := TRUE;
        tonWorkSpudDrop(IN := TRUE, PT := T#12S);

        IF tonWorkSpudDrop.Q THEN
            tonWorkSpudDrop(IN := FALSE);
            iCarriageFSM_State := 75; (* Verify working spud seabed consolidation *)
        END_IF;

    75: (* STATE: VERIFY WORKING SPUD SEATED CONSOLIDATION *)
        iCurrentSteppingStep := 75;
        tonWorkSpudVerify(IN := TRUE, PT := T#5S);

        IF tonWorkSpudVerify.Q THEN
            tonWorkSpudVerify(IN := FALSE);
            IF rWorkSpudSeabedPenetration_m >= c_rMinSpudPenetration_m THEN
                iCarriageFSM_State := 80; (* Working spud anchored: Safe to hoist auxiliary spud *)
            ELSE
                dwAlarmBitmask.5   := TRUE; (* Working Spud Penetration Failure *)
                iCarriageFSM_State := 999;
            END_IF;
        END_IF;

    80: (* STATE: HOIST AUXILIARY SPUD *)
        (* Auxiliary spud is extracted completely, freeing dredge to resume cutting swings *)
        iCurrentSteppingStep   := 80;
        bAuxSpudLiftPermissive := TRUE;
        tonAuxSpudHoist(IN := TRUE, PT := T#15S);

        IF tonAuxSpudHoist.Q THEN
            tonAuxSpudHoist(IN := FALSE);
            IF rAuxSpudSeabedPenetration_m <= 0.10 THEN
                iCarriageFSM_State := 90; (* Step sequence successful *)
            ELSE
                dwAlarmBitmask.6   := TRUE; (* Auxiliary Spud Failed to Retract *)
                iCarriageFSM_State := 999;
            END_IF;
        END_IF;

    90: (* STATE: STEPPING COMPLETE *)
        iCurrentSteppingStep := 90;
        wSystemStatusWord.1  := FALSE; (* Stepping Finished *)
        wSystemStatusWord.3  := TRUE;  (* Step Cycle Pulse Handshake *)

        IF bAutoSteppingPermissive THEN
            iCarriageFSM_State := 10; (* Return seamlessly to Cutting Advance *)
        ELSE
            iCarriageFSM_State := 0;  (* Return to Idle Standby *)
        END_IF;

    999: (* STATE: EMERGENCY FAULT LOCKOUT *)
        iCurrentSteppingStep         := 999;
        rCarriageProfileSpeed_mpm    := 0.0;
        rCarriagePropValve_Cmd_mA    := 12.0; (* Proportional Valve Closed Center Null *)
        rLadderWinchSpeed_Cmd_rpm    := 0.0;
        rLadderBrakePressure_Cmd_bar := 0.0;  (* Brakes locked *)
        bAuxSpudLiftPermissive       := FALSE;
        bWorkSpudDropPermissive      := FALSE;
        wSystemStatusWord            := 16#8000; (* Bit 15: Critical Fault Lockout Flag *)

        (* Fault Latch Reset Handling *)
        IF bAcknowledgeFaults AND bEmergencyStop AND (NOT bPosCriticalLockout) AND (NOT bPressCriticalLockout) AND (NOT bTenCriticalLockout) THEN
            dwAlarmBitmask     := 16#00000000;
            iCarriageFSM_State := 0; (* Reset to IDLE *)
        END_IF;

END_CASE;

(* Translate Carriage Velocity Profile to Proportional Valve 4-20mA Output (12 mA = Null, 20 mA = +100%, 4 mA = -100%) *)
rTemp_mA := 12.0 + (rCarriageProfileSpeed_mpm / 10.0) * 8.0;
rCarriagePropValve_Cmd_mA := LIMIT(4.0, rTemp_mA, 20.0);

(* -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
   SECTION 7: TELEMETRY WORD PACKING
   ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
wSystemStatusWord.4 := bPosDegraded_1oo2;
wSystemStatusWord.5 := bPressDegraded_1oo2;
wSystemStatusWord.6 := bTenDegraded_1oo2;
wSystemStatusWord.7 := (rBrakeRampPressure_bar > 180.0); (* Winch Brake Fully Disengaged *)
