(* =========================================================================================
   MODULE 1: ONE-SHOT COLD START & STATE-SPACE MATRIX INITIALIZATION (IEC 61131-3)
   Initializes Discrete-Time System Matrices A (6x6), B (6x3), C (4x6), D (4x3),
   and Steady-State Kalman Filter Gain Matrix K (6x4) for Sampling Period Ts = 0.010 s.
   ========================================================================================= *)
IF NOT bInitialized THEN
    rDeltaTime_s := 0.010; (* 100 Hz Nominal Execution Task *)
    
    (* Initialize State Transition Matrix A (6x6) *)
    (* States: x1=V_wire (m/s), x2=X_kerf (mm), x3=T_wire (N), x4=dP (bar), x5=Rho_slurry (%), x6=E_AE (dB*s) *)
    matA[1,1] := 0.9820; matA[1,2] := 0.0000; matA[1,3] := -0.000045; matA[1,4] := 0.0085; matA[1,5] := -0.0120; matA[1,6] := 0.0000;
    matA[2,1] := 0.0001; matA[2,2] := 1.0000; matA[2,3] := 0.000000; matA[2,4] := 0.0000; matA[2,5] := -0.0005; matA[2,6] := 0.0000;
    matA[3,1] := 1.2500; matA[3,2] := 0.0150; matA[3,3] := 0.965000; matA[3,4] := 0.1200; matA[3,5] := 0.4500; matA[3,6] := 0.0000;
    matA[4,1] := -0.450; matA[4,2] := 0.0850; matA[4,3] := 0.000850; matA[4,4] := 0.9450; matA[4,5] := 0.6200; matA[4,6] := 0.0000;
    matA[5,1] := 0.0500; matA[5,2] := 0.1800; matA[5,3] := 0.000120; matA[5,4] := 0.0150; matA[5,5] := 0.8850; matA[5,6] := 0.0000;
    matA[6,1] := 0.1200; matA[6,2] := 0.4500; matA[6,3] := 0.002500; matA[6,4] := 0.0850; matA[6,5] := 0.1500; matA[6,6] := 0.9200;

    (* Initialize Control Input Matrix B (6x3) *)
    (* Inputs: u1=I_swash (mA), u2=V_feed (mm/min), u3=P_tension (bar) *)
    matB[1,1] := 1.4500; matB[1,2] := -0.0020; matB[1,3] := -0.0015;
    matB[2,1] := 0.0000; matB[2,2] := 0.000167; matB[2,3] := 0.0000;
    matB[3,1] := 0.1500; matB[3,2] := 0.28000; matB[3,3] := 24.500;
    matB[4,1] := 0.8500; matB[4,2] := 0.42000; matB[4,3] := 0.0500;
    matB[5,1] := -0.020; matB[5,2] := 0.11500; matB[5,3] := 0.0000;
    matB[6,1] := 0.0850; matB[6,2] := 0.32000; matB[6,3] := 0.0120;

    (* Initialize Measurement Matrix C (4x6) *)
    (* Outputs: y1=V_wire (m/s), y2=X_kerf (mm), y3=T_wire (N), y4=dP (bar) *)
    matC[1,1] := 1.0; matC[1,2] := 0.0; matC[1,3] := 0.0; matC[1,4] := 0.0; matC[1,5] := 0.0; matC[1,6] := 0.0;
    matC[2,1] := 0.0; matC[2,2] := 1.0; matC[2,3] := 0.0; matC[2,4] := 0.0; matC[2,5] := 0.0; matC[2,6] := 0.0;
    matC[3,1] := 0.0; matC[3,2] := 0.0; matC[3,3] := 1.0; matC[3,4] := 0.0; matC[3,5] := 0.0; matC[3,6] := 0.0;
    matC[4,1] := 0.0; matC[4,2] := 0.0; matC[4,3] := 0.0; matC[4,4] := 1.0; matC[4,5] := 0.0; matC[4,6] := 0.0;

    (* Initialize Direct Feedthrough Matrix D (4x3) *)
    FOR iRow := 1 TO 4 DO
        FOR iCol := 1 TO 3 DO
            matD[iRow, iCol] := 0.0;
        END_FOR;
    END_FOR;

    (* Initialize Steady-State Kalman Filter Gain Matrix K (6x4) *)
    matK[1,1] := 0.1420; matK[1,2] := 0.0002; matK[1,3] := -0.000015; matK[1,4] := 0.0035;
    matK[2,1] := 0.0001; matK[2,2] := 0.1850; matK[2,3] := 0.000000; matK[2,4] := 0.0001;
    matK[3,1] := 0.0850; matK[3,2] := 0.0120; matK[3,3] := 0.165000; matK[3,4] := 0.0240;
    matK[4,1] := -0.025; matK[4,2] := 0.0085; matK[4,3] := 0.000250; matK[4,4] := 0.1950;
    matK[5,1] := 0.0120; matK[5,2] := 0.0250; matK[5,3] := 0.000085; matK[5,4] := 0.0450;
    matK[6,1] := 0.0450; matK[6,2] := 0.0850; matK[6,3] := 0.000320; matK[6,4] := 0.0120;

    (* Initialize MPC Quadratic Weight Arrays *)
    arrWeightQ[1] := 4.5;    (* Penalty on Wire Linear Speed Tracking Error *)
    arrWeightQ[2] := 1.2;    (* Penalty on Kerf Penetration Trajectory Error *)
    arrWeightQ[3] := 0.0085; (* Penalty on Catenary Tension Tracking Error *)
    arrWeightQ[4] := 0.045;  (* Penalty on Hydraulic Differential Pressure *)

    arrWeightR[1] := 0.85;   (* Actuator Effort: Swashplate Current *)
    arrWeightR[2] := 0.45;   (* Actuator Effort: Feed Rate Velocity *)
    arrWeightR[3] := 0.12;   (* Actuator Effort: Tensioner Pressure *)

    arrWeightS[1] := 2.50;   (* Actuator Slew Rate Limit Penalty: Swashplate dI/dt *)
    arrWeightS[2] := 4.20;   (* Actuator Slew Rate Limit Penalty: Feed dV/dt *)
    arrWeightS[3] := 1.80;   (* Actuator Slew Rate Limit Penalty: Tensioner dP/dt *)

    (* Condensed Diagonal Hessian Approximation Elements *)
    arrHessianDiag[1] := arrWeightR[1] + arrWeightS[1] + 12.5;
    arrHessianDiag[2] := arrWeightR[2] + arrWeightS[2] + 4.8;
    arrHessianDiag[3] := arrWeightR[3] + arrWeightS[3] + 18.2;

    (* Clear Internal State Vector Arrays *)
    FOR iRow := 1 TO 6 DO
        vecX_hat[iRow] := 0.0;
        vecX_pred[iRow] := 0.0;
    END_FOR;
    FOR iRow := 1 TO 3 DO
        vecU[iRow] := 0.0;
        vecU_prev[iRow] := 0.0;
        arrDeltaU[iRow] := 0.0;
    END_FOR;

    (* Clear Acoustic Emission Ring Buffer *)
    FOR iIndex := 1 TO 32 DO
        arrAE_RingBuffer[iIndex] := 45.0; (* Baseline quiet ocean floor noise [dB] *)
    END_FOR;

    bInitialized := TRUE;
END_IF;
(* =========================================================================================
   MODULE 2: SAFETY INTERLOCKS, PERMISSIVES & HARDWIRED SIL-3 EMERGENCY STOP
   Compliant with IEC 61508 / ISO 13849-1 (Category 4, Performance Level e)
   Immediate de-energization of hydraulic actuators and latching of safe shutdown state.
   ========================================================================================= *)
IF (NOT bEmergencyStop) OR bInternalTripLatch THEN
    (* Immediate Fail-Safe Actuator Clamping to Neutral/Depressurized Settings *)
    rSwashplateCurrent_mA  := 4.0;    (* 4.0 mA corresponds to zero swashplate displacement *)
    rFeedRateCommand_mmpm  := 0.0;    (* Lock carriage feed cylinder proportional valve *)
    rTensionerPressure_bar := 15.0;   (* Drop tensioner to minimum safe resting pressure *)
    bPurgeValveActive      := FALSE;  (* Close high-pressure turbidity purge manifold *)
    bAntiStallActive       := FALSE;
    bKerfBindingDetected   := FALSE;
    
    (* Latch E-Stop Primary Safety Alarm *)
    bAlarm_EStopActive := TRUE;
    wPrimaryAlarmWord  := wPrimaryAlarmWord OR 16#0001; (* Bit 0: Emergency Stop Asserted *)
    
    (* Check for Fault Reset Request *)
    IF bResetFaults AND bEmergencyStop THEN
        bInternalTripLatch := FALSE;
        bAlarm_EStopActive := FALSE;
        wPrimaryAlarmWord  := wPrimaryAlarmWord AND NOT 16#0001;
        iMasterState       := 0; (* Return to Idle State *)
    ELSE
        iMasterState       := 100; (* Lock in Emergency Shutdown State *)
        iActiveSequenceStep := iMasterState;
        RETURN; (* Abort further cyclic processing during E-Stop trip *)
    END_IF;
END_IF;

(* Emergency Pyrotechnic Wire Jettison Command Verification *)
IF bWireJettisonCommand AND NOT bWireJettisonFired THEN
    tJettisonPulse(IN := TRUE, PT := T#500MS);
    IF tJettisonPulse.Q THEN
        bWireJettisonFired := TRUE;
        wPrimaryAlarmWord  := wPrimaryAlarmWord OR 16#0002; (* Bit 1: Cutter Jettison Fired *)
        iMasterState       := 100;
        iActiveSequenceStep := iMasterState;
        RETURN;
    END_IF;
ELSE
    tJettisonPulse(IN := FALSE, PT := T#500MS);
END_IF;
(* =========================================================================================
   MODULE 3: DEEP-SEA HYDROSTATIC & GEOTHERMAL PLUME THERMAL CORRECTION
   Corrects hydraulic oil bulk modulus, kinematic viscosity, ambient seawater density,
   and hydrothermal vent fluid convective plume thermal shock disturbances.
   ========================================================================================= *)
(* Seawater Density Equation of State at 400.0 bar hydrostatic and 2.0 deg C ambient *)
rSeawaterDensity_kg_m3 := 1028.5 + (0.0452 * rAmbientPressure_bar) - (0.0058 * rVentFluidTemp_degC);

(* Subsea Pressure-Compensated Hydraulic Fluid (ISO VG 32 Synthetic Ester) Dynamics *)
rCompensatedOilDensity := 875.0 * (1.0 + (0.000062 * (rSupplyPressure_bar + rAmbientPressure_bar)));
rDynamicViscosity_cSt  := 32.0 * EXP(-0.028 * (rHydraulicOilTemp_degC - 40.0)) * (1.0 + (0.0018 * rSupplyPressure_bar));

(* Hydrothermal Vent Plume Thermal Shock Detection at Wire Guide Nozzles *)
IF rVentFluidTemp_degC > 280.0 THEN
    bAlarm_ThermalVentIncursion := TRUE;
    wPrimaryAlarmWord := wPrimaryAlarmWord OR 16#0004; (* Bit 2: Vent Fluid Thermal Incursion *)
    rThermalPlumeDisturbance_N := (rVentFluidTemp_degC - 280.0) * 14.5;
ELSE
    bAlarm_ThermalVentIncursion := FALSE;
    wPrimaryAlarmWord := wPrimaryAlarmWord AND NOT 16#0004;
    rThermalPlumeDisturbance_N := 0.0;
END_IF;

(* Clamping Anchor Cylinder Hydraulic Integrity Check *)
IF rClampPressure_bar < 180.0 THEN
    bAlarm_ClampPressureLow := TRUE;
    wSecondaryAlarmWord := wSecondaryAlarmWord OR 16#0001; (* Bit 0: Low Clamping Force *)
ELSE
    bAlarm_ClampPressureLow := FALSE;
    wSecondaryAlarmWord := wSecondaryAlarmWord AND NOT 16#0001;
END_IF;
(* =========================================================================================
   MODULE 4: TRIPLE MODULAR REDUNDANCY (2oo3 TMR) VOTING & FAULT ISOLATION ENGINE
   Executes high-integrity majority voting across triple load cells and AE transducers.
   Detects drift, channel deviation, isolates faulty transmitters, and fails over gracefully.
   ========================================================================================= *)
(* Calculate Pairwise Channel Discrepancies for Wire Tension Load Cells *)
rTensionDev_12 := ABS(rWireTension_CH1_N - rWireTension_CH2_N);
rTensionDev_23 := ABS(rWireTension_CH2_N - rWireTension_CH3_N);
rTensionDev_31 := ABS(rWireTension_CH3_N - rWireTension_CH1_N);

bTensionCh1_Healthy := TRUE;
bTensionCh2_Healthy := TRUE;
bTensionCh3_Healthy := TRUE;

(* Individual Channel Plausibility Boundary Checks (100 N to 25,000 N) *)
IF (rWireTension_CH1_N < 100.0) OR (rWireTension_CH1_N > 25000.0) THEN bTensionCh1_Healthy := FALSE; END_IF;
IF (rWireTension_CH2_N < 100.0) OR (rWireTension_CH2_N > 25000.0) THEN bTensionCh2_Healthy := FALSE; END_IF;
IF (rWireTension_CH3_N < 100.0) OR (rWireTension_CH3_N > 25000.0) THEN bTensionCh3_Healthy := FALSE; END_IF;

(* Cross-Channel Deviation Screening *)
IF (rTensionDev_12 > rTensionThreshold_N) AND (rTensionDev_31 > rTensionThreshold_N) THEN
    bTensionCh1_Healthy := FALSE; (* Channel 1 drifted away from 2 and 3 *)
END_IF;
IF (rTensionDev_12 > rTensionThreshold_N) AND (rTensionDev_23 > rTensionThreshold_N) THEN
    bTensionCh2_Healthy := FALSE; (* Channel 2 drifted away from 1 and 3 *)
END_IF;
IF (rTensionDev_23 > rTensionThreshold_N) AND (rTensionDev_31 > rTensionThreshold_N) THEN
    bTensionCh3_Healthy := FALSE; (* Channel 3 drifted away from 1 and 2 *)
END_IF;

(* Count Validated Healthy Channels *)
iTensionHealthyCount := 0;
IF bTensionCh1_Healthy THEN iTensionHealthyCount := iTensionHealthyCount + 1; END_IF;
IF bTensionCh2_Healthy THEN iTensionHealthyCount := iTensionHealthyCount + 1; END_IF;
IF bTensionCh3_Healthy THEN iTensionHealthyCount := iTensionHealthyCount + 1; END_IF;

(* Execute 2oo3 / Degraded 1oo2 / Fallback Voting *)
IF iTensionHealthyCount = 3 THEN
    (* All 3 Channels Healthy: Median Select Algorithm *)
    IF ((rWireTension_CH1_N >= rWireTension_CH2_N) AND (rWireTension_CH1_N <= rWireTension_CH3_N)) OR
       ((rWireTension_CH1_N <= rWireTension_CH2_N) AND (rWireTension_CH1_N >= rWireTension_CH3_N)) THEN
        rVotedTension_N := rWireTension_CH1_N;
    ELSIF ((rWireTension_CH2_N >= rWireTension_CH1_N) AND (rWireTension_CH2_N <= rWireTension_CH3_N)) OR
          ((rWireTension_CH2_N <= rWireTension_CH1_N) AND (rWireTension_CH2_N >= rWireTension_CH3_N)) THEN
        rVotedTension_N := rWireTension_CH2_N;
    ELSE
        rVotedTension_N := rWireTension_CH3_N;
    END_IF;
    bDegradedSensorMode := FALSE;
    bAlarm_TMR_TensionDivergence := FALSE;
    wSecondaryAlarmWord := wSecondaryAlarmWord AND NOT 16#0002;
ELSIF iTensionHealthyCount = 2 THEN
    (* Degraded 1oo2 Mode: Average of the Two Functional Transducers *)
    IF bTensionCh1_Healthy AND bTensionCh2_Healthy THEN
        rVotedTension_N := (rWireTension_CH1_N + rWireTension_CH2_N) * 0.5;
    ELSIF bTensionCh2_Healthy AND bTensionCh3_Healthy THEN
        rVotedTension_N := (rWireTension_CH2_N + rWireTension_CH3_N) * 0.5;
    ELSE
        rVotedTension_N := (rWireTension_CH1_N + rWireTension_CH3_N) * 0.5;
    END_IF;
    bDegradedSensorMode := TRUE;
    bAlarm_TMR_TensionDivergence := TRUE;
    wSecondaryAlarmWord := wSecondaryAlarmWord OR 16#0002; (* Bit 1: TMR Tension Sensor Degraded *)
ELSE
    (* Critical Sensor Fault: Single Channel or Total Failure - Trip Permissive *)
    IF bTensionCh1_Healthy THEN
        rVotedTension_N := rWireTension_CH1_N;
    ELSIF bTensionCh2_Healthy THEN
        rVotedTension_N := rWireTension_CH2_N;
    ELSIF bTensionCh3_Healthy THEN
        rVotedTension_N := rWireTension_CH3_N;
    ELSE
        rVotedTension_N := 0.0;
        bInternalTripLatch := TRUE; (* Lockout system on total loss of tension feedback *)
    END_IF;
    bDegradedSensorMode := TRUE;
    bAlarm_TMR_TensionDivergence := TRUE;
    wSecondaryAlarmWord := wSecondaryAlarmWord OR 16#0002;
END_IF;

(* 2oo3 Majority Voting on Seafloor Acoustic Emission Transducer Array *)
rAEDev_12 := ABS(rAcousticEmission_dB - rAE_Channel2_dB);
rAEDev_23 := ABS(rAE_Channel2_dB - rAE_Channel3_dB);
rAEDev_31 := ABS(rAE_Channel3_dB - rAcousticEmission_dB);

bAECh1_Healthy := (rAcousticEmission_dB >= 10.0) AND (rAcousticEmission_dB <= 120.0);
bAECh2_Healthy := (rAE_Channel2_dB >= 10.0) AND (rAE_Channel2_dB <= 120.0);
bAECh3_Healthy := (rAE_Channel3_dB >= 10.0) AND (rAE_Channel3_dB <= 120.0);

IF (rAEDev_12 > rAEThreshold_dB) AND (rAEDev_31 > rAEThreshold_dB) THEN bAECh1_Healthy := FALSE; END_IF;
IF (rAEDev_12 > rAEThreshold_dB) AND (rAEDev_23 > rAEThreshold_dB) THEN bAECh2_Healthy := FALSE; END_IF;
IF (rAEDev_23 > rAEThreshold_dB) AND (rAEDev_31 > rAEThreshold_dB) THEN bAECh3_Healthy := FALSE; END_IF;

iAEHealthyCount := 0;
IF bAECh1_Healthy THEN iAEHealthyCount := iAEHealthyCount + 1; END_IF;
IF bAECh2_Healthy THEN iAEHealthyCount := iAEHealthyCount + 1; END_IF;
IF bAECh3_Healthy THEN iAEHealthyCount := iAEHealthyCount + 1; END_IF;

IF iAEHealthyCount = 3 THEN
    (* Triple Channel Median *)
    IF ((rAcousticEmission_dB >= rAE_Channel2_dB) AND (rAcousticEmission_dB <= rAE_Channel3_dB)) OR
       ((rAcousticEmission_dB <= rAE_Channel2_dB) AND (rAcousticEmission_dB >= rAE_Channel3_dB)) THEN
        rVotedAE_dB := rAcousticEmission_dB;
    ELSIF ((rAE_Channel2_dB >= rAcousticEmission_dB) AND (rAE_Channel2_dB <= rAE_Channel3_dB)) OR
          ((rAE_Channel2_dB <= rAcousticEmission_dB) AND (rAE_Channel2_dB >= rAE_Channel3_dB)) THEN
        rVotedAE_dB := rAE_Channel2_dB;
    ELSE
        rVotedAE_dB := rAE_Channel3_dB;
    END_IF;
    bAlarm_TMR_AE_Divergence := FALSE;
    wSecondaryAlarmWord := wSecondaryAlarmWord AND NOT 16#0004;
ELSIF iAEHealthyCount = 2 THEN
    IF bAECh1_Healthy AND bAECh2_Healthy THEN
        rVotedAE_dB := (rAcousticEmission_dB + rAE_Channel2_dB) * 0.5;
    ELSIF bAECh2_Healthy AND bAECh3_Healthy THEN
        rVotedAE_dB := (rAE_Channel2_dB + rAE_Channel3_dB) * 0.5;
    ELSE
        rVotedAE_dB := (rAcousticEmission_dB + rAE_Channel3_dB) * 0.5;
    END_IF;
    bAlarm_TMR_AE_Divergence := TRUE;
    wSecondaryAlarmWord := wSecondaryAlarmWord OR 16#0004; (* Bit 2: TMR AE Sensor Degraded *)
ELSE
    rVotedAE_dB := rAcousticEmission_dB; (* Fallback *)
    bAlarm_TMR_AE_Divergence := TRUE;
    wSecondaryAlarmWord := wSecondaryAlarmWord OR 16#0004;
END_IF;
(* =========================================================================================
   MODULE 5: DISCRETE-TIME STATE-SPACE OBSERVER & KALMAN FILTER PREDICTOR-CORRECTOR
   Computes state prediction, innovation residual vector, and updates a posteriori estimates:
   x_hat(k) = A*x_hat(k-1) + B*u(k-1) + K*(y_meas(k) - C*(A*x_hat(k-1) + B*u(k-1)))
   ========================================================================================= *)
(* Assemble Current Measurement Vector y_meas *)
vecY_meas[1] := rWireLinearSpeed_mps;
vecY_meas[2] := rFeedPosition_mm;
vecY_meas[3] := rVotedTension_N;
vecY_meas[4] := rSupplyPressure_bar - rReturnPressure_bar; (* Measured Differential Pressure *)

(* A Priori State Prediction: vecX_pred = matA * vecX_hat + matB * vecU *)
FOR iRow := 1 TO 6 DO
    rTempSum := 0.0;
    FOR iCol := 1 TO 6 DO
        rTempSum := rTempSum + (matA[iRow, iCol] * vecX_hat[iCol]);
    END_FOR;
    FOR iCol := 1 TO 3 DO
        rTempSum := rTempSum + (matB[iRow, iCol] * vecU[iCol]);
    END_FOR;
    vecX_pred[iRow] := rTempSum;
END_FOR;

(* Output Prediction: vecY_pred = matC * vecX_pred *)
FOR iRow := 1 TO 4 DO
    rTempSum := 0.0;
    FOR iCol := 1 TO 6 DO
        rTempSum := rTempSum + (matC[iRow, iCol] * vecX_pred[iCol]);
    END_FOR;
    vecY_pred[iRow] := rTempSum;
    (* Innovation Vector: vecY_innov = vecY_meas - vecY_pred *)
    vecY_innov[iRow] := vecY_meas[iRow] - vecY_pred[iRow];
END_FOR;

(* A Posteriori State Update: vecX_hat = vecX_pred + matK * vecY_innov *)
FOR iRow := 1 TO 6 DO
    rTempSum := 0.0;
    FOR iCol := 1 TO 4 DO
        rTempSum := rTempSum + (matK[iRow, iCol] * vecY_innov[iCol]);
    END_FOR;
    vecX_hat[iRow] := vecX_pred[iRow] + rTempSum;
END_FOR;

(* Extract Filtered Estimates for Supervisory Control and Diagnostics *)
rEstimatedKerfDepth_mm   := vecX_hat[2];
rKerfSlurryDensity_kg_m3 := 1028.5 + (vecX_hat[5] * 32.5); (* Particulate slurry density scaling *)
(* =========================================================================================
   MODULE 6: VARIABLE DISPLACEMENT HYDRAULIC MOTOR ANTI-STALL TORQUE GOVERNOR
   High-speed dynamic torque limiting preventing diamond bead stripping and spindle stall.
   Calculates differential pressure rise rate (dP/dt), shaft deceleration rate (dOmega/dt),
   and dynamically de-strokes the motor swashplate while throttling feed cylinder advance.
   ========================================================================================= *)
rDiffPressure_bar := rSupplyPressure_bar - rReturnPressure_bar;
IF rDiffPressure_bar < 0.0 THEN rDiffPressure_bar := 0.0; END_IF;

(* First-Order Low-Pass Filter on Differential Pressure (Cutoff Frequency ~ 25 Hz) *)
rFilteredDiffPressure_bar := (0.78 * rFilteredDiffPressure_bar) + (0.22 * rDiffPressure_bar);

(* Compute Time Derivatives (dP/dt in bar/s, dOmega/dt in rpm/s) *)
rPressureRate_bar_per_s   := (rFilteredDiffPressure_bar - rPrevDiffPressure_bar) / 0.010;
rMotorDecelRate_rpm_per_s := (rPrevMotorSpeed_rpm - rMotorSpeed_rpm) / 0.010;
rPrevDiffPressure_bar     := rFilteredDiffPressure_bar;
rPrevMotorSpeed_rpm       := rMotorSpeed_rpm;

(* Real-Time Shaft Torque Estimation: tau = (Delta_P * V_g * eta_hm) / (20 * pi) *)
(* Swashplate Displacement scaling: 4.0 mA -> 28 cc/rev, 20.0 mA -> 160 cc/rev *)
rMotorDisplacement_cc := 28.0 + ((rSwashplateCurrent_mA - 4.0) / 16.0) * (160.0 - 28.0);
IF rMotorDisplacement_cc < 28.0 THEN rMotorDisplacement_cc := 28.0; END_IF;
IF rMotorDisplacement_cc > 160.0 THEN rMotorDisplacement_cc := 160.0; END_IF;

rEffectiveTorque_Nm := (rFilteredDiffPressure_bar * rMotorDisplacement_cc * 0.91) / 62.8318;
rCurrentHydraulicPower_kW := (rEffectiveTorque_Nm * rMotorSpeed_rpm * 0.1047197) / 1000.0;

(* Anti-Stall Hazard Index Computation: Quadratic Pressure Penalty + Lead Derivative *)
rStallHazardIndex := EXPT(rFilteredDiffPressure_bar / rMaxHydraulicPressure_bar, 2)
                   + (0.0035 * rPressureRate_bar_per_s)
                   + (0.00085 * rMotorDecelRate_rpm_per_s);

IF rStallHazardIndex < 0.0 THEN rStallHazardIndex := 0.0; END_IF;
IF rStallHazardIndex > 2.0 THEN rStallHazardIndex := 2.0; END_IF;

(* Active Anti-Stall Governor Intervention *)
IF rStallHazardIndex > 0.85 THEN
    bAntiStallActive := TRUE;
    wSystemStatusWord := wSystemStatusWord OR 16#0008; (* Bit 3: Anti-Stall Torque Limiting Engaged *)
    
    (* De-stroke swashplate to shed hydrodynamic torque and restore motor speed *)
    rAntiStallTrim_mA   := (rStallHazardIndex - 0.85) * 18.5;
    rFeedAntiStallScale := 1.0 - ((rStallHazardIndex - 0.85) * 1.85);
    IF rFeedAntiStallScale < 0.0 THEN rFeedAntiStallScale := 0.0; END_IF;
ELSE
    bAntiStallActive := FALSE;
    wSystemStatusWord := wSystemStatusWord AND NOT 16#0008;
    rAntiStallTrim_mA   := 0.0;
    rFeedAntiStallScale := 1.0;
END_IF;

(* Locked Rotor / Severe Stall Protection Watchdog Timer *)
tMotorStallTripTimer(IN := (rFilteredDiffPressure_bar > (rMaxHydraulicPressure_bar - 10.0)) AND (rMotorSpeed_rpm < 150.0),
                     PT := T#1200MS);
IF tMotorStallTripTimer.Q THEN
    bAlarm_HydraulicStallTrip := TRUE;
    wPrimaryAlarmWord := wPrimaryAlarmWord OR 16#0008; (* Bit 3: Hydraulic Spindle Stall Trip *)
    bInternalTripLatch := TRUE; (* Lockout system to prevent hydraulic over-temp and wire snap *)
END_IF;
(* =========================================================================================
   MODULE 7: SEAFLOOR ACOUSTIC EMISSION (AE) STRUCTURAL BINDING DISCRIMINATOR
   Analyzes high-frequency elastic stress waves emitted by the rock chimney during kerf cutting.
   Distinguishes steady mineral grain micro-fracturing from lithostatic kerf pinching.
   Maintains a 32-sample sliding window to evaluate envelope mean, variance, and Kurtosis.
   ========================================================================================= *)
(* Update Circular FIFO Buffer with 2oo3 Voted AE Amplitude *)
arrAE_RingBuffer[iAE_BufferPointer] := rVotedAE_dB;
iAE_BufferPointer := iAE_BufferPointer + 1;
IF iAE_BufferPointer > 32 THEN iAE_BufferPointer := 1; END_IF;

(* Compute Statistical Moments across 32-Sample Window *)
rTempSum := 0.0;
FOR iIndex := 1 TO 32 DO
    rTempSum := rTempSum + arrAE_RingBuffer[iIndex];
END_FOR;
rAE_MomentMean := rTempSum / 32.0;

rTempVar := 0.0;
rTempSum := 0.0;
FOR iIndex := 1 TO 32 DO
    rTempDiff := arrAE_RingBuffer[iIndex] - rAE_MomentMean;
    rTempVar  := rTempVar + (rTempDiff * rTempDiff);
    rTempSum  := rTempSum + (rTempDiff * rTempDiff * rTempDiff * rTempDiff);
END_FOR;
rAE_MomentM2 := rTempVar / 32.0;
rAE_MomentM4 := rTempSum / 32.0;

(* Calculate Envelope Kurtosis: K = M4 / (M2^2 + eps) *)
IF rAE_MomentM2 > 0.01 THEN
    rAE_SlidingKurtosis := rAE_MomentM4 / ((rAE_MomentM2 * rAE_MomentM2) + 0.0001);
ELSE
    rAE_SlidingKurtosis := 3.0; (* Normal Gaussian baseline *)
END_IF;

(* Composite Lithostatic Binding Hazard Index *)
(* Combines amplitude spike, ring-down pulse density, and non-Gaussian leptokurtosis *)
rStructuralBindingIndex := ((rVotedAE_dB / rBindingAEThreshold_dB) * 45.0)
                         + ((rAE_RingDownCount_cps / 2500.0) * 35.0)
                         + ((rAE_SlidingKurtosis / 7.5) * 20.0);

IF rStructuralBindingIndex > 100.0 THEN rStructuralBindingIndex := 100.0; END_IF;

(* Binding Trip Logic & Debouncing *)
tBindingDebounceTimer(IN := (rStructuralBindingIndex > 82.0) OR (rVotedAE_dB > (rBindingAEThreshold_dB + 6.0)),
                      PT := T#250MS);

IF tBindingDebounceTimer.Q THEN
    bKerfBindingDetected := TRUE;
    bAlarm_AcousticBindingPinch := TRUE;
    wPrimaryAlarmWord := wPrimaryAlarmWord OR 16#0010; (* Bit 4: Kerf Binding / Rock Pinch Alarm *)
ELSE
    bKerfBindingDetected := FALSE;
    bAlarm_AcousticBindingPinch := FALSE;
    wPrimaryAlarmWord := wPrimaryAlarmWord AND NOT 16#0010;
END_IF;
(* =========================================================================================
   MODULE 8: BENTHIC MINERAL PARTICULATE TURBIDITY PURGE & SLURRY EVACUATION
   Controls high-pressure seawater pulsed flushing nozzles to clear heavy sulfide fines.
   Prevents kerf silting, wire bogging, and excessive hydrodynamic catenary drag.
   ========================================================================================= *)
(* Calculate Slurry Solid Volume Fraction in Cutting Kerf *)
rSlurrySolidFraction_pct := (rKerfTurbidity_NTU / 10000.0) * 28.5;
IF rSlurrySolidFraction_pct > 35.0 THEN rSlurrySolidFraction_pct := 35.0; END_IF;

(* Morrison Equation Hydrodynamic Catenary Drag on Moving Diamond Wire *)
(* F_drag = 0.5 * rho_slurry * Cd * A_proj * V_wire^2 *)
rHydrodynamicDragForce_N := 0.5 * rKerfSlurryDensity_kg_m3 * 1.35 * (0.0112 * 1.85)
                          * (rWireLinearSpeed_mps * rWireLinearSpeed_mps);

(* Determine Purge Jetting Demand *)
bSlurryEvacuationNeeded := (rKerfTurbidity_NTU > rSlurryPurgeThreshold_NTU)
                        OR (rSlurrySolidFraction_pct > 15.0)
                        OR bManualPurgeOverride;

IF bSlurryEvacuationNeeded THEN
    (* Modulated Pulsed Jetting Generator (Period = 250ms, Duty = 45%) *)
    rPurgePulseTimer_s := rPurgePulseTimer_s + 0.010;
    IF rPurgePulseTimer_s >= rPurgePulsePeriod_s THEN
        rPurgePulseTimer_s := 0.0;
        iPurgeCycleCounter := iPurgeCycleCounter + 1;
    END_IF;
    
    IF rPurgePulseTimer_s < (rPurgePulsePeriod_s * rPurgePulseDuty) THEN
        bPurgeValveActive := TRUE;
        rPurgeFlowRate_Lpm := 185.0; (* 185 L/min at 45 bar jetting differential *)
    ELSE
        bPurgeValveActive := FALSE;
        rPurgeFlowRate_Lpm := 25.0;  (* Continuous low-pressure shroud trickle *)
    END_IF;
    wSystemStatusWord := wSystemStatusWord OR 16#0010; (* Bit 4: Turbidity Purge Active *)
ELSE
    bPurgeValveActive  := FALSE;
    rPurgeFlowRate_Lpm := 0.0;
    rPurgePulseTimer_s := 0.0;
    wSystemStatusWord := wSystemStatusWord AND NOT 16#0010;
END_IF;

(* Purge Timeout Watchdog: Alarm if high turbidity persists > 12 seconds continuously *)
tPurgeTimeoutTimer(IN := (rKerfTurbidity_NTU > (rSlurryPurgeThreshold_NTU + 1000.0)),
                   PT := T#12S);
IF tPurgeTimeoutTimer.Q THEN
    bAlarm_TurbidityPurgeFault := TRUE;
    wSecondaryAlarmWord := wSecondaryAlarmWord OR 16#0008; (* Bit 3: Kerf Purge Ineffective *)
ELSE
    bAlarm_TurbidityPurgeFault := FALSE;
    wSecondaryAlarmWord := wSecondaryAlarmWord AND NOT 16#0008;
END_IF;
(* =========================================================================================
   MODULE 9: MODEL PREDICTIVE CONTROL (MPC) CONDENSED QUADRATIC COST SOLVER
   Active-Set Gradient Projection optimization minimizing tracking error and control effort:
   min J = 1/2 * DeltaU^T * H * DeltaU + Gradient^T * DeltaU
   subject to actuator saturation and rate-of-change constraints.
   ========================================================================================= *)
(* Evaluate Output Tracking Error vs Setpoints *)
(* Output 1: Wire Speed (target nominal 24.0 m/s) *)
(* Output 2: Kerf Penetration *)
(* Output 3: Wire Catenary Tension *)
(* Output 4: Hydraulic Differential Pressure *)
vecY_err[1] := 24.0 - vecX_hat[1];
vecY_err[2] := rTargetFeedRate_mmpm - (vecX_hat[2] - vecU_prev[2]);
vecY_err[3] := rWireTensionSetpoint_N - vecX_hat[3];
vecY_err[4] := (rMaxHydraulicPressure_bar * 0.72) - vecX_hat[4];

(* Compute Linear Gradient Vector: Grad = - (C*B)^T * Q * Error + R * U_prev *)
arrGradient[1] := - (1.450 * arrWeightQ[1] * vecY_err[1])
                  - (0.150 * arrWeightQ[3] * vecY_err[3])
                  - (0.850 * arrWeightQ[4] * vecY_err[4])
                  + (arrWeightR[1] * vecU_prev[1]);

arrGradient[2] := - (0.000167 * arrWeightQ[2] * vecY_err[2])
                  - (0.280000 * arrWeightQ[3] * vecY_err[3])
                  - (0.420000 * arrWeightQ[4] * vecY_err[4])
                  + (arrWeightR[2] * vecU_prev[2]);

arrGradient[3] := - (24.500 * arrWeightQ[3] * vecY_err[3])
                  - (0.0500 * arrWeightQ[4] * vecY_err[4])
                  + (arrWeightR[3] * vecU_prev[3]);

(* Unconstrained Newton-Raphson Step: Delta_U = - Grad / H_diag *)
arrDeltaU[1] := - arrGradient[1] / arrHessianDiag[1];
arrDeltaU[2] := - arrGradient[2] / arrHessianDiag[2];
arrDeltaU[3] := - arrGradient[3] / arrHessianDiag[3];

(* Apply Actuator Slew Rate Constraints (Maximum Step per 10ms Scan Cycle) *)
IF arrDeltaU[1] > 0.45 THEN arrDeltaU[1] := 0.45; END_IF;
IF arrDeltaU[1] < -0.65 THEN arrDeltaU[1] := -0.65; END_IF;

IF arrDeltaU[2] > 0.25 THEN arrDeltaU[2] := 0.25; END_IF;
IF arrDeltaU[2] < -0.85 THEN arrDeltaU[2] := -0.85; END_IF;

IF arrDeltaU[3] > 1.20 THEN arrDeltaU[3] := 1.20; END_IF;
IF arrDeltaU[3] < -1.50 THEN arrDeltaU[3] := -1.50; END_IF;

(* Integrate Control Action: U(k) = U(k-1) + Delta_U(k) *)
rTrialControl_U1 := vecU_prev[1] + arrDeltaU[1];
rTrialControl_U2 := vecU_prev[2] + arrDeltaU[2];
rTrialControl_U3 := vecU_prev[3] + arrDeltaU[3];

(* Apply Actuator Box Saturation Constraints *)
(* U1: Swashplate Current [4.0 to 20.0 mA] *)
IF rTrialControl_U1 > 20.0 THEN rTrialControl_U1 := 20.0; END_IF;
IF rTrialControl_U1 < 4.0 THEN rTrialControl_U1 := 4.0; END_IF;

(* U2: Linear Feed Rate [0.0 to rTargetFeedRate_mmpm] *)
IF rTrialControl_U2 > rTargetFeedRate_mmpm THEN rTrialControl_U2 := rTargetFeedRate_mmpm; END_IF;
IF rTrialControl_U2 < 0.0 THEN rTrialControl_U2 := 0.0; END_IF;

(* U3: Catenary Tensioner Pressure [10.0 to 180.0 bar] *)
IF rTrialControl_U3 > 180.0 THEN rTrialControl_U3 := 180.0; END_IF;
IF rTrialControl_U3 < 10.0 THEN rTrialControl_U3 := 10.0; END_IF;

(* Store Vector Values *)
vecU[1] := rTrialControl_U1;
vecU[2] := rTrialControl_U2;
vecU[3] := rTrialControl_U3;
vecU_prev[1] := vecU[1];
vecU_prev[2] := vecU[2];
vecU_prev[3] := vecU[3];
(* =========================================================================================
   MODULE 10: ENERGETIC ROCK MODEL & DIAMOND BEAD MATRIX WEAR ESTIMATOR
   Calculates specific energy of comminution and integrates diamond impregnation volumetric loss.
   Generates advisory alarms as diamond diamond matrix approaches mechanical end-of-life.
   ========================================================================================= *)
(* Instantaneous Kerf Area Generation Rate [mm2/s] *)
(* Kerf width = 11.2 mm wire diameter + 1.8 mm diamond clearance = 13.0 mm *)
IF rFeedRateCommand_mmpm > 0.0 THEN
    rCumulativeKerfArea_mm2 := rCumulativeKerfArea_mm2 + (13.0 * (rFeedRateCommand_mmpm / 60.0) * 0.010);
END_IF;

(* Specific Cutting Energy: E_sp = Mechanical Power / Volumetric Removal Rate [J/mm3] *)
IF (rFeedRateCommand_mmpm > 1.0) AND (rCurrentHydraulicPower_kW > 0.5) THEN
    rKerfSpecificEnergy_J_mm3 := (rCurrentHydraulicPower_kW * 1000.0)
                               / (13.0 * (rFeedRateCommand_mmpm / 60.0) * 850.0);
ELSE
    rKerfSpecificEnergy_J_mm3 := 125.0; (* Nominal default for massive chalcopyrite/pyrite *)
END_IF;

(* Cumulative Diamond Bead Impregnation Matrix Wear Integration *)
(* Standard wear rate: ~ 0.00045% per 1,000 mm2 cut at nominal hardness *)
rCumulativeWearLoss_pct := (rCumulativeKerfArea_mm2 / 2500000.0) * 100.0;
rEstimatedWireWear_pct  := rCumulativeWearLoss_pct;

IF rCumulativeWearLoss_pct > 90.0 THEN
    bAlarm_DiamondWireWornOut := TRUE;
    wSecondaryAlarmWord := wSecondaryAlarmWord OR 16#0010; (* Bit 4: Diamond Wire End of Life *)
ELSE
    bAlarm_DiamondWireWornOut := FALSE;
    wSecondaryAlarmWord := wSecondaryAlarmWord AND NOT 16#0010;
END_IF;
(* =========================================================================================
   MODULE 11: MULTI-STAGE MASTER STATE MACHINE (11 OPERATIONAL STATES)
   Coordinates structural anchoring, catenary pre-tensioning, spindle spin-up, pilot notch,
   MPC production cutting, high-turbidity purging, acoustic pinch retraction, and cut breakthrough.
   ========================================================================================= *)
(* Update State Dwell Time and First Scan Flag *)
IF iMasterState <> iPrevState THEN
    rStateDwellTime_s := 0.0;
    bStateFirstScan   := TRUE;
    iPrevState        := iMasterState;
ELSE
    rStateDwellTime_s := rStateDwellTime_s + 0.010;
    bStateFirstScan   := FALSE;
END_IF;
iActiveSequenceStep := iMasterState;

CASE iMasterState OF

    0: (* ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------
          STATE 0: IDLE STANDBY & TELEMETRY HANDSHAKE
          System de-energized, hydraulic valves in neutral, awaiting autosequence permissive.
          ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
        rSwashplateCurrent_mA  := 4.0;
        rFeedRateCommand_mmpm  := 0.0;
        rTensionerPressure_bar := 15.0;
        bChimneyCutComplete    := FALSE;
        rRetractDistance_mm    := 0.0;
        wSystemStatusWord      := 16#0001; (* Bit 0: System Idle Standby *)

    bRE_Ch2_Fail                : BOOL;     (* Right Edge TC 2 Health Fault Flag *)
    bRE_Ch3_Fail                : BOOL;     (* Right Edge TC 3 Health Fault Flag *)
    iRE_HealthyCount            : INT;      (* Right Edge Number of Operational Sensor Channels *)
    tonRE_FaultTmr1             : TON;      (* Persistence Timer for Right Edge Sensor 1 Fault *)
    tonRE_FaultTmr2             : TON;      (* Persistence Timer for Right Edge Sensor 2 Fault *)
    tonRE_FaultTmr3             : TON;      (* Persistence Timer for Right Edge Sensor 3 Fault *)

    (* ============================================================================================== *)
    (* INTERNAL STATE VARIABLES: PHOTOELASTIC STRESS OBSERVER & LOW-PASS FILTER                       *)
    (* ============================================================================================== *)
    rFilteredRetardation_LE     : REAL := 0.0; (* First-order Filtered Optical Retardation Left Edge [nm] *)
    rFilteredRetardation_RE     : REAL := 0.0; (* First-order Filtered Optical Retardation Right Edge [nm] *)
    rRawStress_LE_MPa           : REAL;        (* Unfiltered Computed Stress Left Edge [MPa] *)
    rRawStress_RE_MPa           : REAL;        (* Unfiltered Computed Stress Right Edge [MPa] *)
    rBrewsterCoeff              : REAL := 0.265; (* Photoelastic Brewster Constant [nm / (mm * MPa)] *)

    (* ============================================================================================== *)
    (* INTERNAL STATE VARIABLES: SMITH PREDICTOR TRANSPORT DEAD-TIME RING BUFFER                     *)
    (* ============================================================================================== *)
    (* Delay line storage: ring buffer holding up to 64 discrete sampling time steps *)
    rFifoDelay_LE               : ARRAY[0..63] OF REAL; (* FIFO History Buffer for Left Edge Stress Prediction *)
    rFifoDelay_RE               : ARRAY[0..63] OF REAL; (* FIFO History Buffer for Right Edge Stress Prediction *)
    iFifoHead                   : INT := 0;             (* Current Ring Buffer Write Index *)
    iFifoDelaySteps             : INT := 32;            (* Dynamically Computed Delay Time Steps *)
    rCalculatedDeadTime_s       : REAL;                 (* Transport Time Delay from Zone A to Polarimeter [s] *)
    rLehrTransportDistance_m    : REAL := 65.0;         (* Effective Longitudinal Distance Zone A to Exit [m] *)
    rModelStress_LE_Delayed     : REAL;                 (* Internal Model Stress at Exit (Delayed) [MPa] *)
    rModelStress_RE_Delayed     : REAL;                 (* Internal Model Stress at Exit (Delayed) [MPa] *)
    rSmithCorrection_LE         : REAL;                 (* Smith Predictor Disturbance Estimate Left [MPa] *)
    rSmithCorrection_RE         : REAL;                 (* Smith Predictor Disturbance Estimate Right [MPa] *)

    (* ============================================================================================== *)
    (* INTERNAL STATE VARIABLES: STATE-SPACE DISCRETE MODEL PREDICTIVE CONTROLLER (MPC)               *)
    (* States x = [T_FLE, T_LE, T_C, T_RE, T_FRE]^T in [deg C]                                       *)
    (* Inputs u = [P_FLE, P_LE, P_C, P_RE, P_FRE]^T in [kW]                                          *)
    (* Measurements y = [T_LE, T_C, T_RE]^T in [deg C]                                               *)
    (* ============================================================================================== *)
    A_matrix                    : ARRAY[1..5, 1..5] OF REAL; (* 5x5 Thermal Conduction/Loss Transition Matrix *)
    B_matrix                    : ARRAY[1..5, 1..5] OF REAL; (* 5x5 Electric Radiative Heating Input Matrix *)
    C_matrix                    : ARRAY[1..3, 1..5] OF REAL; (* 3x5 Sensor Measurement Matrix *)
    L_obs                       : ARRAY[1..5, 1..3] OF REAL; (* 5x3 Discrete Kalman / Observer Gain Matrix *)
    K_mpc                       : ARRAY[1..5, 1..5] OF REAL; (* 5x5 Unconstrained Optimal State Feedback Matrix *)

    x_state                     : ARRAY[1..5] OF REAL;       (* Estimated Cross-Ribbon Temperature State Vector *)
    x_pred                      : ARRAY[1..5] OF REAL;       (* One-Step Ahead Predicted State Vector *)
    x_target                    : ARRAY[1..5] OF REAL;       (* Dynamic Cross-Ribbon Target Profile Vector *)
    y_meas                      : ARRAY[1..3] OF REAL;       (* Measured Feedback Vector [T_LE, T_C, T_RE] *)
    y_est                       : ARRAY[1..3] OF REAL;       (* Observer Estimated Output Vector *)
    y_innov                     : ARRAY[1..3] OF REAL;       (* Innovation Residual Vector (y_meas - y_est) *)
    u_mpc_raw                   : ARRAY[1..5] OF REAL;       (* Raw Unconstrained MPC Power Demands [kW] *)
    u_prev                      : ARRAY[1..5] OF REAL;       (* Previous Cycle Modulated Power Actions [kW] *)

    (* Outer Cascade Stress Trimming Variables *)
    rStressInt_LE               : REAL := 0.0; (* Left Edge Stress Outer Loop Integrator [kW*s] *)
    rStressInt_RE               : REAL := 0.0; (* Right Edge Stress Outer Loop Integrator [kW*s] *)
    rStressTrim_LE_kW           : REAL;        (* Left Edge Heating Power Correction [kW] *)
    rStressTrim_RE_kW           : REAL;        (* Right Edge Heating Power Correction [kW] *)

    (* Power Scaling and Clamping Variables *)
    rTargetPower_FLE            : REAL;
    rTargetPower_LE             : REAL;
    rTargetPower_C              : REAL;
    rTargetPower_RE             : REAL;
    rTargetPower_FRE            : REAL;
    rPowerScaleFactor           : REAL;
    rSumRequestedPower          : REAL;

    (* ============================================================================================== *)
    (* INTERNAL STATE VARIABLES: MULTI-STAGE FINITE STATE MACHINE (FSM)                               *)
    (* ============================================================================================== *)
    iState                      : INT := 0;     (* Current Active State Sequence Identifier *)
    iPrevState                  : INT := 0;     (* Prior Execution Cycle State Identifier *)
    tonStateTimer               : TON;          (* Generic State Dwell and Transition Verification Timer *)
    tonHandoffTimer             : TON;          (* Float Bath to Lehr Ribbon Handoff Stabilization Timer *)
    tonAcousticTripTimer        : TON;          (* Acoustic Micro-Crack Fracture Latch Timer *)
    tonOverdriveTimer           : TON;          (* Emergency Edge Overdrive Anti-Snap Pulse Timer *)
    bInitialized                : BOOL := FALSE;(* First-Scan Cold Start Initialization Permissive *)

    (* Loop and Math Iteration Counters *)
    i                           : INT;
    j                           : INT;
    k                           : INT;
END_VAR

(*
====================================================================================================
SECTION 1: FIRST-SCAN ALGORITHMIC INITIALIZATION (COLD RESTART CONSTRUCT)
Pre-loads State-Space Discretized Matrices (A, B, C), Kalman Observer Gains (L), and MPC Gain (K)
====================================================================================================
*)
IF NOT bInitialized THEN
    (*
       Thermal System Discretization (Sampling Period Ts = 1.0 s, Glass thickness 4.0 mm nominal):
       Glass thermal conductivity k_th = 1.4 W/(m*K), density rho = 2500 kg/m^3, cp = 1250 J/(kg*K).
       Inter-zone lateral conduction coupling: alpha = 0.082.
       Surface radiative/convective heat loss factor: beta = 0.024.
       Self-cooling diagonal entry = 1.0 - 2*alpha - beta = 0.812 (edges have additional sidewall loss).
    *)
    (* A-matrix: 5x5 Tridiagonal Lateral Heat Diffusion Model *)
    A_matrix[1,1] := 0.765; A_matrix[1,2] := 0.185; A_matrix[1,3] := 0.000; A_matrix[1,4] := 0.000; A_matrix[1,5] := 0.000;
    A_matrix[2,1] := 0.082; A_matrix[2,2] := 0.812; A_matrix[2,3] := 0.082; A_matrix[2,4] := 0.000; A_matrix[2,5] := 0.000;
    A_matrix[3,1] := 0.000; A_matrix[3,2] := 0.082; A_matrix[3,3] := 0.836; A_matrix[3,4] := 0.082; A_matrix[3,5] := 0.000;
    A_matrix[4,1] := 0.000; A_matrix[4,2] := 0.000; A_matrix[4,3] := 0.082; A_matrix[4,4] := 0.812; A_matrix[4,5] := 0.082;
    A_matrix[5,1] := 0.000; A_matrix[5,2] := 0.000; A_matrix[5,3] := 0.000; A_matrix[5,4] := 0.185; A_matrix[5,5] := 0.765;

    (* B-matrix: 5x5 Electric Ribbon Radiative Thermal Gain [deg C / kW] *)
    B_matrix[1,1] := 0.420; B_matrix[1,2] := 0.065; B_matrix[1,3] := 0.000; B_matrix[1,4] := 0.000; B_matrix[1,5] := 0.000;
    B_matrix[2,1] := 0.055; B_matrix[2,2] := 0.380; B_matrix[2,3] := 0.045; B_matrix[2,4] := 0.000; B_matrix[2,5] := 0.000;
    B_matrix[3,1] := 0.000; B_matrix[3,2] := 0.045; B_matrix[3,3] := 0.350; B_matrix[3,4] := 0.045; B_matrix[3,5] := 0.000;
    B_matrix[4,1] := 0.000; B_matrix[4,2] := 0.000; B_matrix[4,3] := 0.045; B_matrix[4,4] := 0.380; B_matrix[4,5] := 0.055;
    B_matrix[5,1] := 0.000; B_matrix[5,2] := 0.000; B_matrix[5,3] := 0.000; B_matrix[5,4] := 0.065; B_matrix[5,5] := 0.420;

    (* C-matrix: 3x5 Observation Matrix mapping 5 zones to 3 voted TC measurements (LE, C, RE) *)
    C_matrix[1,1] := 0.25;  C_matrix[1,2] := 0.75;  C_matrix[1,3] := 0.00;  C_matrix[1,4] := 0.00;  C_matrix[1,5] := 0.00;
    C_matrix[2,1] := 0.00;  C_matrix[2,2] := 0.00;  C_matrix[2,3] := 1.00;  C_matrix[2,4] := 0.00;  C_matrix[2,5] := 0.00;
    C_matrix[3,1] := 0.00;  C_matrix[3,2] := 0.00;  C_matrix[3,3] := 0.00;  C_matrix[3,4] := 0.75;  C_matrix[3,5] := 0.25;

    (* L_obs: 5x3 Discrete Kalman Observer Correction Gain Matrix *)
    L_obs[1,1] := 0.340; L_obs[1,2] := 0.015; L_obs[1,3] := 0.002;
    L_obs[2,1] := 0.485; L_obs[2,2] := 0.045; L_obs[2,3] := 0.005;
    L_obs[3,1] := 0.035; L_obs[3,2] := 0.520; L_obs[3,3] := 0.035;
    L_obs[4,1] := 0.005; L_obs[4,2] := 0.045; L_obs[4,3] := 0.485;
    L_obs[5,1] := 0.002; L_obs[5,2] := 0.015; L_obs[5,3] := 0.340;

    (* K_mpc: 5x5 Optimal State Feedback Gain Matrix derived from discrete Riccati LQ solution *)
    K_mpc[1,1] := 1.850; K_mpc[1,2] := -0.320; K_mpc[1,3] := -0.050; K_mpc[1,4] := -0.010; K_mpc[1,5] := -0.005;
    K_mpc[2,1] := -0.280; K_mpc[2,2] := 1.620;  K_mpc[2,3] := -0.210; K_mpc[2,4] := -0.040; K_mpc[2,5] := -0.010;
    K_mpc[3,1] := -0.040; K_mpc[3,2] := -0.190; K_mpc[3,3] := 1.450;  K_mpc[3,4] := -0.190; K_mpc[3,5] := -0.040;
    K_mpc[4,1] := -0.010; K_mpc[4,2] := -0.040; K_mpc[4,3] := -0.210; K_mpc[4,4] := 1.620;  K_mpc[4,5] := -0.280;
    K_mpc[5,1] := -0.005; K_mpc[5,2] := -0.010; K_mpc[5,3] := -0.050; K_mpc[5,4] := -0.320; K_mpc[5,5] := 1.850;

    (* Initialize State Vector to nominal ambient preheat condition *)
    FOR i := 1 TO 5 DO
        x_state[i]  := 540.0;
        x_pred[i]   := 540.0;
        u_prev[i]   := 25.0;
    END_FOR;

    (* Clear Smith Predictor FIFO Ring Buffers *)
    FOR i := 0 TO 63 DO
        rFifoDelay_LE[i] := -4.0;
        rFifoDelay_RE[i] := -4.0;
    END_FOR;

    bInitialized := TRUE;
END_IF;

(*
====================================================================================================
SECTION 2: SIL-3 SAFETY INSTRUMENTED INTERLOCKS & MASTER PERMISSIVES
Monitors hardwired E-Stop, acoustic fracture detection, and initiates failsafe tripping
====================================================================================================
*)
(* Acoustic emission micro-crack pulse monitoring *)
tonAcousticTripTimer(IN := bAcousticCrackDetected, PT := T#500MS);

IF NOT bEmergencyStopSIS THEN
    (* Immediate Fail-Safe Trip: De-energize all heating ribbon SCR outputs *)
    bEmergencyCoolingTrip   := TRUE;
    bLehrReady              := FALSE;
    bControlActive          := FALSE;
    rSCRPower_FarLeft_kW    := 0.0;
    rSCRPower_Left_kW       := 0.0;
    rSCRPower_Center_kW     := 0.0;
    rSCRPower_Right_kW      := 0.0;
    rSCRPower_FarRight_kW   := 0.0;
    rTotalHeatingLoad_kW    := 0.0;
    wAlarmWord.15           := TRUE; (* Critical Safety Interlock Tripped *)
    wStatusWord             := 16#8000; (* Bit 15: Trip Latched *)
    iState                  := 99;   (* Jump immediately to Failsafe State *)
    RETURN;
END_IF;

IF bAcousticCrackDetected OR tonAcousticTripTimer.Q THEN
    wAlarmWord.7 := TRUE; (* Bit 7: Glass Micro-Fracture Acoustic Anomaly *)
    (* If stress is highly tensile, escalate directly to Emergency Overdrive State 90 *)
    IF (rMeasuredStress_LE_MPa > 0.0) OR (rMeasuredStress_RE_MPa > 0.0) THEN
        iState := 90;
    END_IF;
END_IF;

(*
====================================================================================================
SECTION 3: TRIPLE MODULAR REDUNDANCY (2oo3) TEMPERATURE VOTING & HEALTH LOGIC
Executes median-filtering, channel deviation assessment, fault qualification timers,
and graceful degradation to 1oo2 or 1oo1 fallback modes for Left Edge, Center, and Right Edge.
====================================================================================================
*)
(* --- LEFT EDGE ZONE A 2oo3 VOTING --- *)
(* Compute Median of 3 Channels *)
IF (rTempLeftEdge_TMR1_degC >= rTempLeftEdge_TMR2_degC AND rTempLeftEdge_TMR1_degC <= rTempLeftEdge_TMR3_degC) OR
   (rTempLeftEdge_TMR1_degC <= rTempLeftEdge_TMR2_degC AND rTempLeftEdge_TMR1_degC >= rTempLeftEdge_TMR3_degC) THEN
    rVotedTemp_LE_degC := rTempLeftEdge_TMR1_degC;
ELSIF (rTempLeftEdge_TMR2_degC >= rTempLeftEdge_TMR1_degC AND rTempLeftEdge_TMR2_degC <= rTempLeftEdge_TMR3_degC) OR
      (rTempLeftEdge_TMR2_degC <= rTempLeftEdge_TMR1_degC AND rTempLeftEdge_TMR2_degC >= rTempLeftEdge_TMR3_degC) THEN
    rVotedTemp_LE_degC := rTempLeftEdge_TMR2_degC;
ELSE
    rVotedTemp_LE_degC := rTempLeftEdge_TMR3_degC;
END_IF;

(* Channel Deviation from Median *)
rLE_Dev1 := ABS(rTempLeftEdge_TMR1_degC - rVotedTemp_LE_degC);
rLE_Dev2 := ABS(rTempLeftEdge_TMR2_degC - rVotedTemp_LE_degC);
rLE_Dev3 := ABS(rTempLeftEdge_TMR3_degC - rVotedTemp_LE_degC);

(* Channel Qualification Timers: Deviation > 6.0 deg C persistent for 3.0 s *)
tonLE_FaultTmr1(IN := (rLE_Dev1 > 6.0) OR (rTempLeftEdge_TMR1_degC < 200.0) OR (rTempLeftEdge_TMR1_degC > 750.0), PT := T#3S);
tonLE_FaultTmr2(IN := (rLE_Dev2 > 6.0) OR (rTempLeftEdge_TMR2_degC < 200.0) OR (rTempLeftEdge_TMR2_degC > 750.0), PT := T#3S);
tonLE_FaultTmr3(IN := (rLE_Dev3 > 6.0) OR (rTempLeftEdge_TMR3_degC < 200.0) OR (rTempLeftEdge_TMR3_degC > 750.0), PT := T#3S);

bLE_Ch1_Fail := tonLE_FaultTmr1.Q;
bLE_Ch2_Fail := tonLE_FaultTmr2.Q;
bLE_Ch3_Fail := tonLE_FaultTmr3.Q;

iLE_HealthyCount := 3;
IF bLE_Ch1_Fail THEN iLE_HealthyCount := iLE_HealthyCount - 1; END_IF;
IF bLE_Ch2_Fail THEN iLE_HealthyCount := iLE_HealthyCount - 1; END_IF;
IF bLE_Ch3_Fail THEN iLE_HealthyCount := iLE_HealthyCount - 1; END_IF;

(* Degraded Mode Logic for Left Edge *)
IF iLE_HealthyCount = 2 THEN
    wAlarmWord.0 := TRUE; (* Bit 0: Left Edge Single Channel Fault (1oo2 Degraded) *)
    IF bLE_Ch1_Fail THEN
        rVotedTemp_LE_degC := (rTempLeftEdge_TMR2_degC + rTempLeftEdge_TMR3_degC) * 0.5;
    ELSIF bLE_Ch2_Fail THEN
        rVotedTemp_LE_degC := (rTempLeftEdge_TMR1_degC + rTempLeftEdge_TMR3_degC) * 0.5;
    ELSE
        rVotedTemp_LE_degC := (rTempLeftEdge_TMR1_degC + rTempLeftEdge_TMR2_degC) * 0.5;
    END_IF;
ELSIF iLE_HealthyCount = 1 THEN
    wAlarmWord.0 := TRUE;
    wAlarmWord.14 := TRUE; (* Bit 14: Sensor Redundancy Exhausted (1oo1 Fallback) *)
    IF NOT bLE_Ch1_Fail THEN rVotedTemp_LE_degC := rTempLeftEdge_TMR1_degC;
    ELSIF NOT bLE_Ch2_Fail THEN rVotedTemp_LE_degC := rTempLeftEdge_TMR2_degC;
    ELSE rVotedTemp_LE_degC := rTempLeftEdge_TMR3_degC;
    END_IF;
ELSIF iLE_HealthyCount = 0 THEN
    wAlarmWord.0 := TRUE;
    wAlarmWord.14 := TRUE;
    (* Complete loss of Left Edge sensors: Hold last model estimate *)
    rVotedTemp_LE_degC := x_state[2];
END_IF;

(* --- CENTER CORE ZONE A 2oo3 VOTING --- *)
IF (rTempCenter_TMR1_degC >= rTempCenter_TMR2_degC AND rTempCenter_TMR1_degC <= rTempCenter_TMR3_degC) OR
   (rTempCenter_TMR1_degC <= rTempCenter_TMR2_degC AND rTempCenter_TMR1_degC >= rTempCenter_TMR3_degC) THEN
    rVotedTemp_C_degC := rTempCenter_TMR1_degC;
ELSIF (rTempCenter_TMR2_degC >= rTempCenter_TMR1_degC AND rTempCenter_TMR2_degC <= rTempCenter_TMR3_degC) OR
      (rTempCenter_TMR2_degC <= rTempCenter_TMR1_degC AND rTempCenter_TMR2_degC >= rTempCenter_TMR3_degC) THEN
    rVotedTemp_C_degC := rTempCenter_TMR2_degC;
ELSE
    rVotedTemp_C_degC := rTempCenter_TMR3_degC;
END_IF;

rC_Dev1 := ABS(rTempCenter_TMR1_degC - rVotedTemp_C_degC);
rC_Dev2 := ABS(rTempCenter_TMR2_degC - rVotedTemp_C_degC);
rC_Dev3 := ABS(rTempCenter_TMR3_degC - rVotedTemp_C_degC);

tonC_FaultTmr1(IN := (rC_Dev1 > 6.0) OR (rTempCenter_TMR1_degC < 200.0) OR (rTempCenter_TMR1_degC > 750.0), PT := T#3S);
tonC_FaultTmr2(IN := (rC_Dev2 > 6.0) OR (rTempCenter_TMR2_degC < 200.0) OR (rTempCenter_TMR2_degC > 750.0), PT := T#3S);
tonC_FaultTmr3(IN := (rC_Dev3 > 6.0) OR (rTempCenter_TMR3_degC < 200.0) OR (rTempCenter_TMR3_degC > 750.0), PT := T#3S);

bC_Ch1_Fail := tonC_FaultTmr1.Q;
bC_Ch2_Fail := tonC_FaultTmr2.Q;
bC_Ch3_Fail := tonC_FaultTmr3.Q;

iC_HealthyCount := 3;
IF bC_Ch1_Fail THEN iC_HealthyCount := iC_HealthyCount - 1; END_IF;
IF bC_Ch2_Fail THEN iC_HealthyCount := iC_HealthyCount - 1; END_IF;
IF bC_Ch3_Fail THEN iC_HealthyCount := iC_HealthyCount - 1; END_IF;

IF iC_HealthyCount = 2 THEN
    wAlarmWord.1 := TRUE; (* Bit 1: Center Core Single Channel Fault *)
    IF bC_Ch1_Fail THEN
        rVotedTemp_C_degC := (rTempCenter_TMR2_degC + rTempCenter_TMR3_degC) * 0.5;
    ELSIF bC_Ch2_Fail THEN
        rVotedTemp_C_degC := (rTempCenter_TMR1_degC + rTempCenter_TMR3_degC) * 0.5;
    ELSE
        rVotedTemp_C_degC := (rTempCenter_TMR1_degC + rTempCenter_TMR2_degC) * 0.5;
    END_IF;
ELSIF iC_HealthyCount = 1 THEN
    wAlarmWord.1 := TRUE;
    wAlarmWord.14 := TRUE;
    IF NOT bC_Ch1_Fail THEN rVotedTemp_C_degC := rTempCenter_TMR1_degC;
    ELSIF NOT bC_Ch2_Fail THEN rVotedTemp_C_degC := rTempCenter_TMR2_degC;
    ELSE rVotedTemp_C_degC := rTempCenter_TMR3_degC;
    END_IF;
ELSIF iC_HealthyCount = 0 THEN
    wAlarmWord.1 := TRUE;
    wAlarmWord.14 := TRUE;
    rVotedTemp_C_degC := x_state[3];
END_IF;

(* --- RIGHT EDGE ZONE A 2oo3 VOTING --- *)
IF (rTempRightEdge_TMR1_degC >= rTempRightEdge_TMR2_degC AND rTempRightEdge_TMR1_degC <= rTempRightEdge_TMR3_degC) OR
   (rTempRightEdge_TMR1_degC <= rTempRightEdge_TMR2_degC AND rTempRightEdge_TMR1_degC >= rTempRightEdge_TMR3_degC) THEN
    rVotedTemp_RE_degC := rTempRightEdge_TMR1_degC;
ELSIF (rTempRightEdge_TMR2_degC >= rTempRightEdge_TMR1_degC AND rTempRightEdge_TMR2_degC <= rTempRightEdge_TMR3_degC) OR
      (rTempRightEdge_TMR2_degC <= rTempRightEdge_TMR1_degC AND rTempRightEdge_TMR2_degC >= rTempRightEdge_TMR3_degC) THEN
    rVotedTemp_RE_degC := rTempRightEdge_TMR2_degC;
ELSE
    rVotedTemp_RE_degC := rTempRightEdge_TMR3_degC;
END_IF;

rRE_Dev1 := ABS(rTempRightEdge_TMR1_degC - rVotedTemp_RE_degC);
rRE_Dev2 := ABS(rTempRightEdge_TMR2_degC - rVotedTemp_RE_degC);
rRE_Dev3 := ABS(rTempRightEdge_TMR3_degC - rVotedTemp_RE_degC);

tonRE_FaultTmr1(IN := (rRE_Dev1 > 6.0) OR (rTempRightEdge_TMR1_degC < 200.0) OR (rTempRightEdge_TMR1_degC > 750.0), PT := T#3S);
tonRE_FaultTmr2(IN := (rRE_Dev2 > 6.0) OR (rTempRightEdge_TMR2_degC < 200.0) OR (rTempRightEdge_TMR2_degC > 750.0), PT := T#3S);
tonRE_FaultTmr3(IN := (rRE_Dev3 > 6.0) OR (rTempRightEdge_TMR3_degC < 200.0) OR (rTempRightEdge_TMR3_degC > 750.0), PT := T#3S);

bRE_Ch1_Fail := tonRE_FaultTmr1.Q;
bRE_Ch2_Fail := tonRE_FaultTmr2.Q;
bRE_Ch3_Fail := tonRE_FaultTmr3.Q;

iRE_HealthyCount := 3;
IF bRE_Ch1_Fail THEN iRE_HealthyCount := iRE_HealthyCount - 1; END_IF;
IF bRE_Ch2_Fail THEN iRE_HealthyCount := iRE_HealthyCount - 1; END_IF;
IF bRE_Ch3_Fail THEN iRE_HealthyCount := iRE_HealthyCount - 1; END_IF;

IF iRE_HealthyCount = 2 THEN
    wAlarmWord.2 := TRUE; (* Bit 2: Right Edge Single Channel Fault *)
    IF bRE_Ch1_Fail THEN
        rVotedTemp_RE_degC := (rTempRightEdge_TMR2_degC + rTempRightEdge_TMR3_degC) * 0.5;
    ELSIF bRE_Ch2_Fail THEN
        rVotedTemp_RE_degC := (rTempRightEdge_TMR1_degC + rTempRightEdge_TMR3_degC) * 0.5;
    ELSE
        rVotedTemp_RE_degC := (rTempRightEdge_TMR1_degC + rTempRightEdge_TMR2_degC) * 0.5;
    END_IF;
ELSIF iRE_HealthyCount = 1 THEN
    wAlarmWord.2 := TRUE;
    wAlarmWord.14 := TRUE;
    IF NOT bRE_Ch1_Fail THEN rVotedTemp_RE_degC := rTempRightEdge_TMR1_degC;
    ELSIF NOT bRE_Ch2_Fail THEN rVotedTemp_RE_degC := rTempRightEdge_TMR2_degC;
    ELSE rVotedTemp_RE_degC := rTempRightEdge_TMR3_degC;
    END_IF;
ELSIF iRE_HealthyCount = 0 THEN
    wAlarmWord.2 := TRUE;
    wAlarmWord.14 := TRUE;
    rVotedTemp_RE_degC := x_state[4];
END_IF;

(* Compute Cross-Ribbon Transverse Thermal Gradient *)
rCrossRibbonDeltaT_degC := rVotedTemp_C_degC - ((rVotedTemp_LE_degC + rVotedTemp_RE_degC) * 0.5);
IF ABS(rCrossRibbonDeltaT_degC) > 22.0 THEN

rRawStress_RE_MPa := rFilteredRetardation_RE / (rBrewsterCoeff * rGlassThickness_mm);

x_target[2] := rAnnealingSetpoint_degC + 4.5;  (* Left Edge *)

    (* Left Edge Stress Controller *)
    rStressTrim_LE_kW := 3.2 * (rMeasuredStress_LE_MPa - rStressSetpoint_LE_MPa) + rStressInt_LE;
    rStressInt_LE := rStressInt_LE + (0.045 * (rMeasuredStress_LE_MPa - rStressSetpoint_LE_MPa));
    (* Anti-windup on outer stress integrator *)
    IF rStressInt_LE > 25.0 THEN rStressInt_LE := 25.0;
    ELSIF rStressInt_LE < -15.0 THEN rStressInt_LE := -15.0;

    rStressTrim_RE_kW := 3.2 * (rMeasuredStress_RE_MPa - rStressSetpoint_RE_MPa) + rStressInt_RE;
    rStressInt_RE := rStressInt_RE + (0.045 * (rMeasuredStress_RE_MPa - rStressSetpoint_RE_MPa));
    IF rStressInt_RE > 25.0 THEN rStressInt_RE := 25.0;
    ELSIF rStressInt_RE < -15.0 THEN rStressInt_RE := -15.0;
    END_IF;
ELSE

    rStressTrim_RE_kW := 0.0;

    rStressInt_RE := 0.0;

FOR i := 1 TO 5 DO

END_FOR;

    rMaglevForceDemandZ_N          := 0.0; (* Decouple levitation coils to landing pads *)
    rMaglevTorqueDemandRoll_Nm     := 0.0;

    bSystemReady                   := FALSE;
    bInterferometerLocked          := FALSE;

    (* Set Latched Critical Alarm Bit 0: Emergency Stop Trip *)
    dwActiveAlarmsWord := dwActiveAlarmsWord OR 16#00000001;
    dwSystemStatusWord := 16#00000099; (* State 99: EMERGENCY SAFE SHUTDOWN *)
    iMachineState      := 99;

END_IF;

(* Fault Reset Command Pulse Execution *)
IF bResetFaults THEN

    bCryoChC_Healthy   := TRUE;

    rFluxIntY_nT_s     := 0.0;
