(* First-Scan State-Space Discrete Dynamics, MPC Quadratic Weights & EKF Initialization *)
IF NOT bMatrixInitialized THEN
    (* Discrete State Transition Matrix matA (6x6) for 6-DOF Maglev: Ts = 0.0010 s *)
    (* Position States [x, y, z] integrated with Velocity States [dx, dy, dz] *)
    matA[1,1] := 0.9998; matA[1,2] := 0.0000; matA[1,3] := 0.0000; matA[1,4] := 0.0010; matA[1,5] := 0.0000; matA[1,6] := 0.0000;
    matA[2,1] := 0.0000; matA[2,2] := 0.9998; matA[2,3] := 0.0000; matA[2,4] := 0.0000; matA[2,5] := 0.0010; matA[2,6] := 0.0000;
    matA[3,1] := 0.0000; matA[3,2] := 0.0000; matA[3,3] := 0.9997; matA[3,4] := 0.0000; matA[3,5] := 0.0000; matA[3,6] := 0.0010;
    matA[4,1] := -0.0184; matA[4,2] := 0.0000; matA[4,3] := 0.0000; matA[4,4] := 0.9950; matA[4,5] := 0.0000; matA[4,6] := 0.0000;
    matA[5,1] := 0.0000; matA[5,2] := -0.0184; matA[5,3] := 0.0000; matA[5,4] := 0.0000; matA[5,5] := 0.9950; matA[5,6] := 0.0000;
    matA[6,1] := 0.0000; matA[6,2] := 0.0000; matA[6,3] := -0.0245; matA[6,4] := 0.0000; matA[6,5] := 0.0000; matA[6,6] := 0.9940;

    (* Discrete Input Coupling Matrix matB (6x3): Lorentz Coils Force to Accelerations *)
    (* 1 / Mass_plat = 1 / 24.50 kg = 0.040816 m/(s^2*N) *)
    matB[1,1] := 0.00000002; matB[1,2] := 0.00000000; matB[1,3] := 0.00000000;
    matB[2,1] := 0.00000000; matB[2,2] := 0.00000002; matB[2,3] := 0.00000000;
    matB[3,1] := 0.00000000; matB[3,2] := 0.00000000; matB[3,3] := 0.00000002;
    matB[4,1] := 0.04081633; matB[4,2] := 0.00000000; matB[4,3] := 0.00000000;
    matB[5,1] := 0.00000000; matB[5,2] := 0.04081633; matB[5,3] := 0.00000000;
    matB[6,1] := 0.00000000; matB[6,2] := 0.00000000; matB[6,3] := 0.04081633;

    (* Disturbance Coupling Matrix matE (6x3): Carrier Base Motion Acceleration Feedforward *)
    matE[1,1] := -0.00000050; matE[1,2] := 0.00000000;  matE[1,3] := 0.00000000;
    matE[2,1] := 0.00000000;  matE[2,2] := -0.00000050; matE[2,3] := 0.00000000;
    matE[3,1] := 0.00000000;  matE[3,2] := 0.00000000;  matE[3,3] := -0.00000050;
    matE[4,1] := -0.00100000; matE[4,2] := 0.00000000;  matE[4,3] := 0.00000000;
    matE[5,1] := 0.00000000;  matE[5,2] := -0.00100000; matE[5,3] := 0.00000000;
    matE[6,1] := 0.00000000;  matE[6,2] := 0.00000000;  matE[6,3] := -0.00100000;

    (* Discrete Measurement Matrix matC (6x6) *)
    FOR iRowIdx := 1 TO 6 DO
        FOR iColIdx := 1 TO 6 DO
            IF iRowIdx = iColIdx THEN
                matC[iRowIdx, iColIdx] := 1.0;
            ELSE
                matC[iRowIdx, iColIdx] := 0.0;
            END_IF;
        END_FOR;
    END_FOR;

    (* MPC Quadratic Cost Penalty Matrices Q (State Error) & R (Control Effort) *)
    matQ_MPC[1] := 125000.0; (* Surge position error penalty *)
    matQ_MPC[2] := 125000.0; (* Sway position error penalty *)
    matQ_MPC[3] := 250000.0; (* Heave position error penalty *)
    matQ_MPC[4] := 4500.0;   (* Surge velocity damping penalty *)
    matQ_MPC[5] := 4500.0;   (* Sway velocity damping penalty *)
    matQ_MPC[6] := 8500.0;   (* Heave velocity damping penalty *)
    matR_MPC[1] := 0.0120;   (* Surge actuator effort penalty *)
    matR_MPC[2] := 0.0120;   (* Sway actuator effort penalty *)
    matR_MPC[3] := 0.0080;   (* Heave actuator effort penalty *)

    (* Bathymetric EKF Initial Transition Matrix matEKF_F (4x4) *)
    matEKF_F[1,1] := 1.0; matEKF_F[1,2] := 0.0; matEKF_F[1,3] := 0.0; matEKF_F[1,4] := 0.0010;
    matEKF_F[2,1] := 0.0; matEKF_F[2,2] := 1.0; matEKF_F[2,3] := 0.0; matEKF_F[2,4] := 0.0;
    matEKF_F[3,1] := 0.0; matEKF_F[3,2] := 0.0; matEKF_F[3,3] := 1.0; matEKF_F[3,4] := 0.0;
    matEKF_F[4,1] := 0.0; matEKF_F[4,2] := 0.0; matEKF_F[4,3] := 0.0; matEKF_F[4,4] := 0.9995;

    (* Bathymetric EKF Estimation Error Covariance Matrix matEKF_P (4x4) *)
    matEKF_P[1,1] := 100.0;   matEKF_P[1,2] := 0.0;      matEKF_P[1,3] := 0.0;    matEKF_P[1,4] := 0.0;
    matEKF_P[2,1] := 0.0;     matEKF_P[2,2] := 10000.0;  matEKF_P[2,3] := 0.0;    matEKF_P[2,4] := 0.0;
    matEKF_P[3,1] := 0.0;     matEKF_P[3,2] := 0.0;      matEKF_P[3,3] := 25.0;   matEKF_P[3,4] := 0.0;
    matEKF_P[4,1] := 0.0;     matEKF_P[4,2] := 0.0;      matEKF_P[4,3] := 0.0;    matEKF_P[4,4] := 0.01;

    (* Process Noise Covariance matEKF_Q (4x4) *)
    matEKF_Q[1,1] := 0.050;   matEKF_Q[1,2] := 0.0;      matEKF_Q[1,3] := 0.0;    matEKF_Q[1,4] := 0.0;
    matEKF_Q[2,1] := 0.0;     matEKF_Q[2,2] := 2.500;    matEKF_Q[2,3] := 0.0;    matEKF_Q[2,4] := 0.0;
    matEKF_Q[3,1] := 0.0;     matEKF_Q[3,2] := 0.0;      matEKF_Q[3,3] := 0.001;  matEKF_Q[3,4] := 0.0;
    matEKF_Q[4,1] := 0.0;     matEKF_Q[4,2] := 0.0;      matEKF_Q[4,3] := 0.0;    matEKF_Q[4,4] := 0.00001;

    (* Measurement Noise Covariance matEKF_R (2x2) *)
    matEKF_R[1,1] := 0.0400;  matEKF_R[1,2] := 0.0000; (* Quantum Gradiometer Phase Noise: 0.20 E RMS *)
    matEKF_R[2,1] := 0.0000;  matEKF_R[2,2] := 0.2500; (* Multibeam Sonar Altimeter Noise: 0.50 m RMS *)

    (* Initialize State Vector *)
    vecEKF_x[1] := rReferenceGravityGradient_E; (* Initial Gamma_zz [E] *)
    vecEKF_x[2] := 0.0;                         (* Initial Delta_rho [kg/m3] *)
    vecEKF_x[3] := 0.0;                         (* Initial Raman Bias [E] *)
    vecEKF_x[4] := 0.0;                         (* Initial Terrain Trend [E/m] *)

    (* Clear Population History Buffer *)
    FOR iIterIdx := 1 TO 8 DO
        arrTopPopHistory[iIterIdx]    := 0.500;
        arrBottomPopHistory[iIterIdx] := 0.500;
    END_FOR;

    (* Clear Acceleration Buffer *)
    FOR iIterIdx := 1 TO 16 DO
        arrResidualAccelBuffer[iIterIdx] := 0.000001;
    END_FOR;

    bMatrixInitialized := TRUE;
END_IF;

(* =================================================================================================
   SECTION 2: TRIPLE MODULAR REDUNDANCY (2oo3 TMR) SENSOR VOTING ENGINES
   ================================================================================================= *)

(* SUB-SECTION 2.1: CARRIER HEAVE ACCELEROMETER (Z-AXIS) 2oo3 TMR VOTING *)
(* Channel Pairwise Absolute Discrepancy Evaluation *)
IF ABS(rCarrierAccelZ_ChA_mps2 - rCarrierAccelZ_ChB_mps2) > rAccelDevLimit_mps2 THEN
    IF ABS(rCarrierAccelZ_ChA_mps2 - rCarrierAccelZ_ChC_mps2) > rAccelDevLimit_mps2 THEN
        (* Channel A has diverged from both Channel B and Channel C *)
        bAccelChA_Healthy := FALSE;
        rVotedAccelZ_mps2 := (rCarrierAccelZ_ChB_mps2 + rCarrierAccelZ_ChC_mps2) * 0.50;
        dwWarningWord     := dwWarningWord OR 16#00000001; (* Warning: Accel ChA Degraded *)
    ELSE
        (* Channel B has diverged from Channel A and Channel C *)
        bAccelChB_Healthy := FALSE;
        rVotedAccelZ_mps2 := (rCarrierAccelZ_ChA_mps2 + rCarrierAccelZ_ChC_mps2) * 0.50;
        dwWarningWord     := dwWarningWord OR 16#00000002; (* Warning: Accel ChB Degraded *)
    END_IF;
ELSIF ABS(rCarrierAccelZ_ChB_mps2 - rCarrierAccelZ_ChC_mps2) > rAccelDevLimit_mps2 THEN
    (* Channel C has diverged from Channel A and Channel B *)
    bAccelChC_Healthy := FALSE;
    rVotedAccelZ_mps2 := (rCarrierAccelZ_ChA_mps2 + rCarrierAccelZ_ChB_mps2) * 0.50;
    dwWarningWord     := dwWarningWord OR 16#00000004; (* Warning: Accel ChC Degraded *)
ELSE
    (* All three channels concordant: Pure Median Voting *)
    IF (rCarrierAccelZ_ChA_mps2 >= rCarrierAccelZ_ChB_mps2 AND rCarrierAccelZ_ChA_mps2 <= rCarrierAccelZ_ChC_mps2) OR
       (rCarrierAccelZ_ChA_mps2 <= rCarrierAccelZ_ChB_mps2 AND rCarrierAccelZ_ChA_mps2 >= rCarrierAccelZ_ChC_mps2) THEN
        rVotedAccelZ_mps2 := rCarrierAccelZ_ChA_mps2;
    ELSIF (rCarrierAccelZ_ChB_mps2 >= rCarrierAccelZ_ChA_mps2 AND rCarrierAccelZ_ChB_mps2 <= rCarrierAccelZ_ChC_mps2) OR
          (rCarrierAccelZ_ChB_mps2 <= rCarrierAccelZ_ChA_mps2 AND rCarrierAccelZ_ChB_mps2 >= rCarrierAccelZ_ChC_mps2) THEN
        rVotedAccelZ_mps2 := rCarrierAccelZ_ChB_mps2;
    ELSE
        rVotedAccelZ_mps2 := rCarrierAccelZ_ChC_mps2;
    END_IF;
END_IF;

(* SURGE (X) & SWAY (Y) MEDIAN EVALUATION *)
rVotedAccelX_mps2 := (rCarrierAccelX_ChA_mps2 + rCarrierAccelX_ChB_mps2 + rCarrierAccelX_ChC_mps2) * 0.333333;
rVotedAccelY_mps2 := (rCarrierAccelY_ChA_mps2 + rCarrierAccelY_ChB_mps2 + rCarrierAccelY_ChC_mps2) * 0.333333;

(* SUB-SECTION 2.2: CRYOSTAT SHIELD TEMPERATURE 2oo3 TMR VOTING *)
IF ABS(rCryoTempShield_ChA_K - rCryoTempShield_ChB_K) > rCryoDevLimit_K THEN
    IF ABS(rCryoTempShield_ChA_K - rCryoTempShield_ChC_K) > rCryoDevLimit_K THEN
        bCryoChA_Healthy := FALSE;
        rVotedCryoTemp_K := (rCryoTempShield_ChB_K + rCryoTempShield_ChC_K) * 0.50;
        dwWarningWord    := dwWarningWord OR 16#00000010; (* Warning: Cryo Temp ChA Degraded *)
    ELSE
        bCryoChB_Healthy := FALSE;
        rVotedCryoTemp_K := (rCryoTempShield_ChA_K + rCryoTempShield_ChC_K) * 0.50;
        dwWarningWord    := dwWarningWord OR 16#00000020; (* Warning: Cryo Temp ChB Degraded *)
    END_IF;
ELSIF ABS(rCryoTempShield_ChB_K - rCryoTempShield_ChC_K) > rCryoDevLimit_K THEN
    bCryoChC_Healthy := FALSE;
    rVotedCryoTemp_K := (rCryoTempShield_ChA_K + rCryoTempShield_ChB_K) * 0.50;
    dwWarningWord    := dwWarningWord OR 16#00000040; (* Warning: Cryo Temp ChC Degraded *)
ELSE
    (* Median selection across 3 healthy cryogenic thermometers *)
    IF (rCryoTempShield_ChA_K >= rCryoTempShield_ChB_K AND rCryoTempShield_ChA_K <= rCryoTempShield_ChC_K) OR
       (rCryoTempShield_ChA_K <= rCryoTempShield_ChB_K AND rCryoTempShield_ChA_K >= rCryoTempShield_ChC_K) THEN
        rVotedCryoTemp_K := rCryoTempShield_ChA_K;
    ELSIF (rCryoTempShield_ChB_K >= rCryoTempShield_ChA_K AND rCryoTempShield_ChB_K <= rCryoTempShield_ChC_K) OR
          (rCryoTempShield_ChB_K <= rCryoTempShield_ChA_K AND rCryoTempShield_ChB_K >= rCryoTempShield_ChC_K) THEN
        rVotedCryoTemp_K := rCryoTempShield_ChB_K;
    ELSE
        rVotedCryoTemp_K := rCryoTempShield_ChC_K;
    END_IF;
END_IF;

(* SUB-SECTION 2.3: ULTRA-HIGH VACUUM (UHV) CHAMBER PRESSURE 2oo3 TMR VOTING *)
(* Validate logarithmic range and detect vacuum breach *)
IF (rUHVChamberPressure_ChA_mbar > rUHVChamberPressure_ChB_mbar * rUHVPressureRatioLimit) AND
   (rUHVChamberPressure_ChA_mbar > rUHVChamberPressure_ChC_mbar * rUHVPressureRatioLimit) THEN
    bUHVChA_Healthy        := FALSE;
    rVotedUHVPressure_mbar := SQRT(rUHVChamberPressure_ChB_mbar * rUHVChamberPressure_ChC_mbar);
    dwWarningWord          := dwWarningWord OR 16#00000100; (* Warning: Vacuum Gauge ChA Degraded *)
ELSIF (rUHVChamberPressure_ChB_mbar > rUHVChamberPressure_ChA_mbar * rUHVPressureRatioLimit) AND
      (rUHVChamberPressure_ChB_mbar > rUHVChamberPressure_ChC_mbar * rUHVPressureRatioLimit) THEN
    bUHVChB_Healthy        := FALSE;
    rVotedUHVPressure_mbar := SQRT(rUHVChamberPressure_ChA_mbar * rUHVChamberPressure_ChC_mbar);
    dwWarningWord          := dwWarningWord OR 16#00000200; (* Warning: Vacuum Gauge ChB Degraded *)
ELSIF (rUHVChamberPressure_ChC_mbar > rUHVChamberPressure_ChA_mbar * rUHVPressureRatioLimit) AND
      (rUHVChamberPressure_ChC_mbar > rUHVChamberPressure_ChB_mbar * rUHVPressureRatioLimit) THEN
    bUHVChC_Healthy        := FALSE;
    rVotedUHVPressure_mbar := SQRT(rUHVChamberPressure_ChA_mbar * rUHVChamberPressure_ChB_mbar);
    dwWarningWord          := dwWarningWord OR 16#00000400; (* Warning: Vacuum Gauge ChC Degraded *)
ELSE
    rVotedUHVPressure_mbar := (rUHVChamberPressure_ChA_mbar + rUHVChamberPressure_ChB_mbar + rUHVChamberPressure_ChC_mbar) * 0.333333;
END_IF;

(* =================================================================================================
   SECTION 3: SQUID MAGNETIC SHIELDING & ACTIVE 3-AXIS HELMHOLTZ FLUX COMPENSATION
   ================================================================================================= *)

(* SUB-SECTION 3.1: RESIDUAL SQUID FLUX EVALUATION & CLOSED-LOOP TRIM PID *)
(* Compute Internal Residual Flux Magnitude in [nT] from Cryogenic SQUID Readings *)
(* 1 fT = 1.0e-6 nT *)
rTotalResidualB_nT := SQRT(
    (rSQUIDResidualFluxX_fT * 1.0e-6) * (rSQUIDResidualFluxX_fT * 1.0e-6) +
    (rSQUIDResidualFluxY_fT * 1.0e-6) * (rSQUIDResidualFluxY_fT * 1.0e-6) +
    (rSQUIDResidualFluxZ_fT * 1.0e-6) * (rSQUIDResidualFluxZ_fT * 1.0e-6)
);

(* 3-Axis Helmholtz Active Flux Compensation Loop: Proportional-Integral-Derivative (PID) *)
(* Error Calculation relative to zero flux target *)
rFluxErrX_nT := 0.0 - (rAmbientMagneticFluxX_nT * 0.0010 + rSQUIDResidualFluxX_fT * 1.0e-6);
rFluxErrY_nT := 0.0 - (rAmbientMagneticFluxY_nT * 0.0010 + rSQUIDResidualFluxY_fT * 1.0e-6);
rFluxErrZ_nT := 0.0 - (rAmbientMagneticFluxZ_nT * 0.0010 + rSQUIDResidualFluxZ_fT * 1.0e-6);

(* Numerical Integration with Dynamic Anti-Windup Clamping *)
rFluxIntX_nT_s := rFluxIntX_nT_s + rFluxErrX_nT * rSampleTime_s;
rFluxIntY_nT_s := rFluxIntY_nT_s + rFluxErrY_nT * rSampleTime_s;
rFluxIntZ_nT_s := rFluxIntZ_nT_s + rFluxErrZ_nT * rSampleTime_s;

IF rFluxIntX_nT_s > 100.0 THEN rFluxIntX_nT_s := 100.0; ELSIF rFluxIntX_nT_s < -100.0 THEN rFluxIntX_nT_s := -100.0; END_IF;
IF rFluxIntY_nT_s > 100.0 THEN rFluxIntY_nT_s := 100.0; ELSIF rFluxIntY_nT_s < -100.0 THEN rFluxIntY_nT_s := -100.0; END_IF;
IF rFluxIntZ_nT_s > 100.0 THEN rFluxIntZ_nT_s := 100.0; ELSIF rFluxIntZ_nT_s < -100.0 THEN rFluxIntZ_nT_s := -100.0; END_IF;

(* Numerical Derivative Calculation *)
rFluxDerivX_nT_s := (rFluxErrX_nT - rPrevFluxErrX_nT) / rSampleTime_s;
rFluxDerivY_nT_s := (rFluxErrY_nT - rPrevFluxErrY_nT) / rSampleTime_s;
rFluxDerivZ_nT_s := (rFluxErrZ_nT - rPrevFluxErrZ_nT) / rSampleTime_s;
rPrevFluxErrX_nT := rFluxErrX_nT;
rPrevFluxErrY_nT := rFluxErrY_nT;
rPrevFluxErrZ_nT := rFluxErrZ_nT;

(* Active Helmholtz Current Output Calculation with Ambient Field Direct Feedforward *)
rActiveFluxCompCurrentX_mA := (rKp_Flux * rFluxErrX_nT + rKi_Flux * rFluxIntX_nT_s + rKd_Flux * rFluxDerivX_nT_s) + (rFeedforwardFluxGain * rAmbientMagneticFluxX_nT);
rActiveFluxCompCurrentY_mA := (rKp_Flux * rFluxErrY_nT + rKi_Flux * rFluxIntY_nT_s + rKd_Flux * rFluxDerivY_nT_s) + (rFeedforwardFluxGain * rAmbientMagneticFluxY_nT);
rActiveFluxCompCurrentZ_mA := (rKp_Flux * rFluxErrZ_nT + rKi_Flux * rFluxIntZ_nT_s + rKd_Flux * rFluxDerivZ_nT_s) + (rFeedforwardFluxGain * rAmbientMagneticFluxZ_nT);

(* Actuator Saturation Limiting *)
IF rActiveFluxCompCurrentX_mA > rMaxFluxCurrent_mA THEN rActiveFluxCompCurrentX_mA := rMaxFluxCurrent_mA; ELSIF rActiveFluxCompCurrentX_mA < -rMaxFluxCurrent_mA THEN rActiveFluxCompCurrentX_mA := -rMaxFluxCurrent_mA; END_IF;
IF rActiveFluxCompCurrentY_mA > rMaxFluxCurrent_mA THEN rActiveFluxCompCurrentY_mA := rMaxFluxCurrent_mA; ELSIF rActiveFluxCompCurrentY_mA < -rMaxFluxCurrent_mA THEN rActiveFluxCompCurrentY_mA := -rMaxFluxCurrent_mA; END_IF;
IF rActiveFluxCompCurrentZ_mA > rMaxFluxCurrent_mA THEN rActiveFluxCompCurrentZ_mA := rMaxFluxCurrent_mA; ELSIF rActiveFluxCompCurrentZ_mA < -rMaxFluxCurrent_mA THEN rActiveFluxCompCurrentZ_mA := -rMaxFluxCurrent_mA; END_IF;

(* SUB-SECTION 3.2: SECOND-ORDER ZEEMAN SYSTEMATIC FREQUENCY & PHASE COMPENSATION *)
(* Second-Order Zeeman Frequency & Phase Shift Systematic Correction *)
(* Delta_nu_Z = beta_Z * B^2 = 5.7514e-8 Hz/nT^2 * B^2 *)
rZeemanFreqShift_Hz        := rZeemanCoeff_Hz_per_nT2 * (rTotalResidualB_nT * rTotalResidualB_nT);
rZeemanPhaseCorrection_rad := 2.0 * 3.14159265 * rZeemanFreqShift_Hz * rInterrogationTime_T;

(* =================================================================================================
   SECTION 4: 6-DOF MAGNETIC LEVITATION INERTIAL PLATFORM ACTIVE MICRO-VIBRATION NULLING
   ================================================================================================= *)

(* Update State Estimation Vector from Gap Sensors and Numerical Velocity Estimation *)
(* Gap error: e = rMaglevGap - rMaglevNominalGap (in meters) *)
vecMaglevState[1] := (rMaglevGapSurge_mm - rMaglevNominalGap_mm) * 0.0010;
vecMaglevState[2] := (rMaglevGapSway_mm - rMaglevNominalGap_mm) * 0.0010;
vecMaglevState[3] := (rMaglevGapHeave_mm - rMaglevNominalGap_mm) * 0.0010;
vecMaglevState[4] := (vecMaglevState[1] - vecMaglevStatePred[1]) / rSampleTime_s;
vecMaglevState[5] := (vecMaglevState[2] - vecMaglevStatePred[2]) / rSampleTime_s;
vecMaglevState[6] := (vecMaglevState[3] - vecMaglevStatePred[3]) / rSampleTime_s;

(* Constrained Model Predictive Control (MPC) Quadratic Cost Projected Gradient Solver *)
(* Predict Next State: x_{k+1} = A * x_k + B * u_k + E * w_carrier *)
FOR iRowIdx := 1 TO 6 DO
    vecMaglevStatePred[iRowIdx] := 0.0;
    FOR iColIdx := 1 TO 6 DO
        vecMaglevStatePred[iRowIdx] := vecMaglevStatePred[iRowIdx] + matA[iRowIdx, iColIdx] * vecMaglevState[iColIdx];
    END_FOR;
    (* Add disturbance coupling from voted carrier motion *)
    vecMaglevStatePred[iRowIdx] := vecMaglevStatePred[iRowIdx] +
        matE[iRowIdx, 1] * rVotedAccelX_mps2 +
        matE[iRowIdx, 2] * rVotedAccelY_mps2 +
        matE[iRowIdx, 3] * rVotedAccelZ_mps2;
END_FOR;

(* Projected Gradient Optimization Loop (5 Iterations for Microsecond Real-Time Bound) *)
FOR iIterIdx := 1 TO 5 DO
    (* Compute Gradient of Quadratic Cost: grad = B^T * Q * x_pred + R * u *)
    vecMaglevGrad[1] := matB[4,1] * matQ_MPC[4] * vecMaglevStatePred[4] + matR_MPC[1] * vecMaglevCtrlDemand[1];
    vecMaglevGrad[2] := matB[5,2] * matQ_MPC[5] * vecMaglevStatePred[5] + matR_MPC[2] * vecMaglevCtrlDemand[2];
    vecMaglevGrad[3] := matB[6,3] * matQ_MPC[6] * vecMaglevStatePred[6] + matR_MPC[3] * vecMaglevCtrlDemand[3];
    
    (* Gradient Step with Projection onto Actuator Saturation Constraints *)
    vecMaglevCtrlDemand[1] := vecMaglevCtrlDemand[1] - rMPC_StepSize * vecMaglevGrad[1];
    vecMaglevCtrlDemand[2] := vecMaglevCtrlDemand[2] - rMPC_StepSize * vecMaglevGrad[2];
    vecMaglevCtrlDemand[3] := vecMaglevCtrlDemand[3] - rMPC_StepSize * vecMaglevGrad[3];
    
    (* Box Constraints Projection *)
    IF vecMaglevCtrlDemand[1] > rCoilMaxForce_N THEN vecMaglevCtrlDemand[1] := rCoilMaxForce_N; ELSIF vecMaglevCtrlDemand[1] < rCoilMinForce_N THEN vecMaglevCtrlDemand[1] := rCoilMinForce_N; END_IF;
    IF vecMaglevCtrlDemand[2] > rCoilMaxForce_N THEN vecMaglevCtrlDemand[2] := rCoilMaxForce_N; ELSIF vecMaglevCtrlDemand[2] < rCoilMinForce_N THEN vecMaglevCtrlDemand[2] := rCoilMinForce_N; END_IF;
    IF vecMaglevCtrlDemand[3] > rCoilMaxForce_N THEN vecMaglevCtrlDemand[3] := rCoilMaxForce_N; ELSIF vecMaglevCtrlDemand[3] < rCoilMinForce_N THEN vecMaglevCtrlDemand[3] := rCoilMinForce_N; END_IF;
END_FOR;

(* Assign Final Commanded Forces to 6-DOF Lorentz Coils *)
rMaglevForceDemandX_N := vecMaglevCtrlDemand[1] + rPlatformMass_kg * rVotedAccelX_mps2 * 0.9850; (* Dynamic Feedforward *)
rMaglevForceDemandY_N := vecMaglevCtrlDemand[2] + rPlatformMass_kg * rVotedAccelY_mps2 * 0.9850; (* Dynamic Feedforward *)
rMaglevForceDemandZ_N := vecMaglevCtrlDemand[3] + rHeaveBiasForce_N + rPlatformMass_kg * rVotedAccelZ_mps2 * 0.9850;

(* Active Torque Nulling for Platform Attitude Angular Rate Suppression *)
rMaglevTorqueDemandRoll_Nm  := -12.50 * rCarrierRollRate_rads;
rMaglevTorqueDemandPitch_Nm := -12.50 * rCarrierPitchRate_rads;
rMaglevTorqueDemandYaw_Nm   := -8.200 * rCarrierYawRate_rads;

(* SUB-SECTION 4.2: 12-ACTUATOR PLANAR COIL CURRENT ALLOCATION & THERMAL DISSIPATION *)
(* Vertical Coils 1..4 share heave force, roll torque, and pitch torque *)
arrCoilCurrents_A[1] := (rMaglevForceDemandZ_N * 0.250 + rMaglevTorqueDemandPitch_Nm * 2.50 + rMaglevTorqueDemandRoll_Nm * 2.50) * 0.1250;
arrCoilCurrents_A[2] := (rMaglevForceDemandZ_N * 0.250 + rMaglevTorqueDemandPitch_Nm * 2.50 - rMaglevTorqueDemandRoll_Nm * 2.50) * 0.1250;
arrCoilCurrents_A[3] := (rMaglevForceDemandZ_N * 0.250 - rMaglevTorqueDemandPitch_Nm * 2.50 + rMaglevTorqueDemandRoll_Nm * 2.50) * 0.1250;
arrCoilCurrents_A[4] := (rMaglevForceDemandZ_N * 0.250 - rMaglevTorqueDemandPitch_Nm * 2.50 - rMaglevTorqueDemandRoll_Nm * 2.50) * 0.1250;
(* Horizontal Coils 5..8 share surge force and yaw torque *)
arrCoilCurrents_A[5] := (rMaglevForceDemandX_N * 0.250 + rMaglevTorqueDemandYaw_Nm * 1.80) * 0.1250;
arrCoilCurrents_A[6] := (rMaglevForceDemandX_N * 0.250 - rMaglevTorqueDemandYaw_Nm * 1.80) * 0.1250;
arrCoilCurrents_A[7] := (rMaglevForceDemandX_N * 0.250 + rMaglevTorqueDemandYaw_Nm * 1.80) * 0.1250;
arrCoilCurrents_A[8] := (rMaglevForceDemandX_N * 0.250 - rMaglevTorqueDemandYaw_Nm * 1.80) * 0.1250;
(* Horizontal Coils 9..12 share sway force *)
arrCoilCurrents_A[9]  := rMaglevForceDemandY_N * 0.03125;
arrCoilCurrents_A[10] := rMaglevForceDemandY_N * 0.03125;
arrCoilCurrents_A[11] := rMaglevForceDemandY_N * 0.03125;
arrCoilCurrents_A[12] := rMaglevForceDemandY_N * 0.03125;

(* Compute Total Coil Thermal Dissipation: P = sum( I_i^2 * R_coil ), R_coil = 1.25 Ohm *)
rTotalCoilPower_W := 0.0;
FOR iIterIdx := 1 TO 12 DO
    rTotalCoilPower_W := rTotalCoilPower_W + arrCoilCurrents_A[iIterIdx] * arrCoilCurrents_A[iIterIdx] * 1.250;
END_FOR;

(* Residual Acceleration Spectral Tracking & Vibration Isolation Ratio Calculation *)
arrResidualAccelBuffer[iBufferIdx] := ABS(vecMaglevStatePred[6] - vecMaglevState[6]) / rSampleTime_s;
iBufferIdx := iBufferIdx + 1;
IF iBufferIdx > 16 THEN iBufferIdx := 1; END_IF;

rAccelSumSquares := 0.0;
FOR iIterIdx := 1 TO 16 DO
    rAccelSumSquares := rAccelSumSquares + arrResidualAccelBuffer[iIterIdx] * arrResidualAccelBuffer[iIterIdx];
END_FOR;
rAccelRMS_mps2                 := SQRT(rAccelSumSquares * 0.0625);
rPlatformResidualAccelRMS_mps2 := rAccelRMS_mps2;
rResidualMicroVibration_ug     := (rAccelRMS_mps2 / rStandardGravity_g0) * 1.0e6; (* Micro-g conversion *)

(* Isolation Ratio in dB: 20 * log10( Carrier_RMS / Residual_RMS ) *)
rCarrierAccelRMS_mps2 := SQRT(rVotedAccelX_mps2*rVotedAccelX_mps2 + rVotedAccelY_mps2*rVotedAccelY_mps2 + rVotedAccelZ_mps2*rVotedAccelZ_mps2) + 0.0001;
rAttenRatio_lin       := rCarrierAccelRMS_mps2 / (rAccelRMS_mps2 + 1.0e-9);
IF rAttenRatio_lin > 10000.0 THEN rAttenRatio_lin := 10000.0; ELSIF rAttenRatio_lin < 1.0 THEN rAttenRatio_lin := 1.0; END_IF;
rVibrationIsolationRatio_dB := 8.685889 * LN(rAttenRatio_lin); (* 20 * log10(x) = 20 / ln(10) * ln(x) = 8.685889 * ln(x) *)

(* =================================================================================================
   SECTION 5: DUAL-FOUNTAIN RAMAN ATOM INTERFEROMETRY (EOTVOS RESOLUTION)
   ================================================================================================= *)

(* Verify Optical Raman Laser Powers and MOT Cloud Trapping Intensity *)
IF (rRamanMasterLaserPower_mW > 60.0) AND (rRamanSlaveLaserPower_mW > 45.0) AND
   (rRepumperLaserPower_mW > 15.0) AND (rMOTCoolingLaserPower_mW > 80.0) THEN
    
    (* Extract Normalized Population Ratios P = N2 / (N1 + N2) for Upper and Lower Fountains *)
    IF (rTopFountainPopF1_V + rTopFountainPopF2_V) > 0.050 THEN
        rTopPopRatio := rTopFountainPopF2_V / (rTopFountainPopF1_V + rTopFountainPopF2_V);
    ELSE
        rTopPopRatio := 0.500;
    END_IF;
    
    IF (rBottomFountainPopF1_V + rBottomFountainPopF2_V) > 0.050 THEN
        rBottomPopRatio := rBottomFountainPopF2_V / (rBottomFountainPopF1_V + rBottomFountainPopF2_V);
    ELSE
        rBottomPopRatio := 0.500;
    END_IF;
    
    (* Update 8-Point Rolling History Buffer for Ellipse-Fitting & Visibility Analysis *)
    arrTopPopHistory[iFringeSampleIdx]    := rTopPopRatio;
    arrBottomPopHistory[iFringeSampleIdx] := rBottomPopRatio;
    iFringeSampleIdx := iFringeSampleIdx + 1;
    IF iFringeSampleIdx > 8 THEN iFringeSampleIdx := 1; END_IF;
    
    (* Compute Quantum Interference Fringe Visibility (Contrast) *)
    rFringeVisibility := 2.0 * ABS(rTopPopRatio - 0.500) + 2.0 * ABS(rBottomPopRatio - 0.500);
    IF rFringeVisibility > 0.950 THEN rFringeVisibility := 0.950; ELSIF rFringeVisibility < 0.050 THEN rFringeVisibility := 0.050; END_IF;
    rQuantumFringeContrast_pct := rFringeVisibility * 100.0;
    
    (* Optical AC Stark Shift Feedforward Compensation *)
    (* delta_phi_Stark proportional to Raman Master vs Slave intensity imbalance *)
    rACStarkPhaseShift_rad := (rRamanMasterLaserPower_mW - rRamanSlaveLaserPower_mW) * 0.0000450;
    
    (* 4-Point Ellipse-Fitting Quantum Phase Extraction *)
    (* Delta_Phi = arcsin( (Top - Mean) * (Bottom - Mean) / (Contrast^2) ) *)
    rTopPhaseEst_rad       := 3.14159265 * (rTopPopRatio - 0.500);
    rBottomPhaseEst_rad    := 3.14159265 * (rBottomPopRatio - 0.500);
    rDifferentialPhase_rad := (rTopPhaseEst_rad - rBottomPhaseEst_rad) - rZeemanPhaseCorrection_rad - rACStarkPhaseShift_rad;
    rInterferometerDifferentialPhase_rad := rDifferentialPhase_rad;
    
    (* Calculate Raw Differential Gravity Gradient Gamma_zz in Eotvos [E] *)
    (* Delta_Phi = ScaleFactor * Gamma_zz -> Gamma_zz = Delta_Phi / ScaleFactor *)
    (* S_E = 2.174285e-4 rad / E *)
    rRawGradientCalc_E    := rDifferentialPhase_rad / rScaleFactor_rad_per_E;
    rGravityGradientRaw_E := rRawGradientCalc_E;
    bInterferometerLocked := (rQuantumFringeContrast_pct >= 40.0);
ELSE
    bInterferometerLocked      := FALSE;
    rQuantumFringeContrast_pct := 0.0;
    rGravityGradientRaw_E      := rReferenceGravityGradient_E;
    dwWarningWord              := dwWarningWord OR 16#00001000; (* Warning: Low Laser Optical Power *)
END_IF;

(* =================================================================================================
   SECTION 6: SUBSEA BATHYMETRIC DENSITY ANOMALY EXTENDED KALMAN FILTER (EKF)
   ================================================================================================= *)

(* SUB-SECTION 6.1: PARKER 2.5D PRISMATIC FORWARD GRAVITATIONAL TERRAIN MODEL *)
(* Computes expected gravity gradient from seafloor topography: *)
(* Gamma_zz_topo = 2 * pi * G * (rho_crust - rho_water) * [1 - exp(-k * H_alt)] * cos(theta_slope) *)
(* 2 * pi * G * (2670 - 1025) = 2 * 3.14159265 * 6.6743e-11 * 1645 = 6.89745e-7 s^-2 = 689.745 E *)
rForwardTerrainGradient_E := 689.745 * (1.0 - EXP(-rTerrainWavenumber_k * rSeabedAltitude_m)) * COS(rSeabedSlope_deg * 0.01745329);
rTopographicGravityCorrection_E := rForwardTerrainGradient_E;

(* SUB-SECTION 6.2: DISCRETE EKF TIME UPDATE (PREDICTION STEP) *)
(* State Prediction: x_{k|k-1} = F * x_{k-1|k-1} *)
vecEKF_x[1] := matEKF_F[1,1] * vecEKF_x[1] + matEKF_F[1,4] * vecEKF_x[4];
vecEKF_x[2] := matEKF_F[2,2] * vecEKF_x[2];
vecEKF_x[3] := matEKF_F[3,3] * vecEKF_x[3];
vecEKF_x[4] := matEKF_F[4,4] * vecEKF_x[4];

(* Covariance Prediction: P_{k|k-1} = F * P_{k-1|k-1} * F^T + Q *)
matEKF_P[1,1] := matEKF_F[1,1] * matEKF_P[1,1] * matEKF_F[1,1] + matEKF_Q[1,1];
matEKF_P[2,2] := matEKF_F[2,2] * matEKF_P[2,2] * matEKF_F[2,2] + matEKF_Q[2,2];
matEKF_P[3,3] := matEKF_F[3,3] * matEKF_P[3,3] * matEKF_F[3,3] + matEKF_Q[3,3];
matEKF_P[4,4] := matEKF_F[4,4] * matEKF_P[4,4] * matEKF_F[4,4] + matEKF_Q[4,4];

(* SUB-SECTION 6.3: MEASUREMENT UPDATE (INNOVATION & KALMAN GAIN) *)
(* Measurement Vector: z1 = Raw Gradiometer [E], z2 = Sonar Altimetry [m] *)
vecEKF_z[1] := rGravityGradientRaw_E;
vecEKF_z[2] := rSeabedAltitude_m;

(* Innovation Vector: y = z - h(x) *)
(* h1(x) = Gamma_zz + ForwardTerrainGradient + RamanBias *)
vecEKF_y[1] := vecEKF_z[1] - (vecEKF_x[1] + rForwardTerrainGradient_E + vecEKF_x[3]);
vecEKF_y[2] := vecEKF_z[2] - rSeabedAltitude_m; (* Trivial direct altitude tracking *)

(* Measurement Jacobian matEKF_H (2x4) *)
matEKF_H[1,1] := 1.0; (* d(h1)/d(Gamma_zz) *)
matEKF_H[1,2] := 0.41929 * (1.0 - EXP(-rTerrainWavenumber_k * rSeabedAltitude_m)); (* d(h1)/d(Delta_rho) *)
matEKF_H[1,3] := 1.0; (* d(h1)/d(Bias) *)
matEKF_H[1,4] := 0.0;
matEKF_H[2,1] := 0.0; matEKF_H[2,2] := 0.0; matEKF_H[2,3] := 0.0; matEKF_H[2,4] := 0.0;

(* Innovation Covariance S = H * P * H^T + R *)
rInnovationCov_S11 := matEKF_H[1,1] * matEKF_P[1,1] * matEKF_H[1,1] +
                      matEKF_H[1,2] * matEKF_P[2,2] * matEKF_H[1,2] +
                      matEKF_H[1,3] * matEKF_P[3,3] * matEKF_H[1,3] + matEKF_R[1,1];
rInnovationCov_S22 := matEKF_R[2,2];

(* Kalman Gain K = P * H^T * inv(S) *)
IF rInnovationCov_S11 > 0.0010 THEN
    rInvDet_S := 1.0 / rInnovationCov_S11;
    matEKF_K[1,1] := matEKF_P[1,1] * matEKF_H[1,1] * rInvDet_S;
    matEKF_K[2,1] := matEKF_P[2,2] * matEKF_H[1,2] * rInvDet_S;
    matEKF_K[3,1] := matEKF_P[3,3] * matEKF_H[1,3] * rInvDet_S;
    matEKF_K[4,1] := matEKF_P[4,4] * matEKF_H[1,4] * rInvDet_S;
ELSE
    matEKF_K[1,1] := 0.0; matEKF_K[2,1] := 0.0; matEKF_K[3,1] := 0.0; matEKF_K[4,1] := 0.0;
END_IF;

(* State Estimate Correction: x_{k|k} = x_{k|k-1} + K * y *)
vecEKF_x[1] := vecEKF_x[1] + matEKF_K[1,1] * vecEKF_y[1];
vecEKF_x[2] := vecEKF_x[2] + matEKF_K[2,1] * vecEKF_y[1];
vecEKF_x[3] := vecEKF_x[3] + matEKF_K[3,1] * vecEKF_y[1];
vecEKF_x[4] := vecEKF_x[4] + matEKF_K[4,1] * vecEKF_y[1];

(* Joseph-Form Numerically Stabilized Covariance Update: P = (I - K*H)*P*(I - K*H)^T + K*R*K^T *)
FOR iRowIdx := 1 TO 4 DO
    FOR iColIdx := 1 TO 4 DO
        IF iRowIdx = iColIdx THEN
            matJoseph_I_KH[iRowIdx, iColIdx] := 1.0 - matEKF_K[iRowIdx, 1] * matEKF_H[1, iColIdx];
        ELSE
            matJoseph_I_KH[iRowIdx, iColIdx] := 0.0 - matEKF_K[iRowIdx, 1] * matEKF_H[1, iColIdx];
        END_IF;
    END_FOR;
END_FOR;

FOR iRowIdx := 1 TO 4 DO
    FOR iColIdx := 1 TO 4 DO
        matJoseph_P_temp[iRowIdx, iColIdx] := 0.0;
        FOR iKIdx := 1 TO 4 DO
            matJoseph_P_temp[iRowIdx, iColIdx] := matJoseph_P_temp[iRowIdx, iColIdx] +
                matJoseph_I_KH[iRowIdx, iKIdx] * matEKF_P[iKIdx, iColIdx];
        END_FOR;
    END_FOR;
END_FOR;

FOR iRowIdx := 1 TO 4 DO
    FOR iColIdx := 1 TO 4 DO
        matEKF_P[iRowIdx, iColIdx] := 0.0;
        FOR iKIdx := 1 TO 4 DO
            matEKF_P[iRowIdx, iColIdx] := matEKF_P[iRowIdx, iColIdx] +
                matJoseph_P_temp[iRowIdx, iKIdx] * matJoseph_I_KH[iColIdx, iKIdx];
        END_FOR;
        (* Add K * R * K^T term *)
        matEKF_P[iRowIdx, iColIdx] := matEKF_P[iRowIdx, iColIdx] +
            matEKF_K[iRowIdx, 1] * matEKF_R[1,1] * matEKF_K[iColIdx, 1];
    END_FOR;
END_FOR;

(* Assign Filtered Outputs *)
rEstimatedGravityGradient_E := vecEKF_x[1];
rSubseaDensityAnomaly_kgm3  := vecEKF_x[2];

(* SUB-SECTION 6.4: GEOLOGICAL STRATIGRAPHIC DENSITY CONTRAST INVERSION & TARGET CLASSIFICATION *)
(* Evaluates Density Anomaly Sign and Magnitude to Classify Subsea Geological Formations *)
IF rSubseaDensityAnomaly_kgm3 > 400.0 THEN
    (* High-Density Target: Massive Polymetallic Sulfides / Ultramafic Intrusions *)
    iGeologicalTargetClass   := 1;
    bDensityAnomalyDetected  := TRUE;
ELSIF rSubseaDensityAnomaly_kgm3 > 150.0 THEN
    (* Moderate Positive Anomaly: Basaltic Basement High / Heavy Mineral Sand *)
    iGeologicalTargetClass   := 2;

ELSIF rSubseaDensityAnomaly_kgm3 < -250.0 THEN

    iGeologicalTargetClass   := 3;

ELSIF rSubseaDensityAnomaly_kgm3 < -90.0 THEN

    iGeologicalTargetClass   := 4;
    bDensityAnomalyDetected  := TRUE;
ELSE
    (* Background Homogeneous Marine Crust *)
    iGeologicalTargetClass   := 0;

END_IF;

        bSystemReady               := FALSE;

        IF rQuantumFringeContrast_pct < 35.0 THEN

        IF rMaglevForceDemandZ_N > 10.0 THEN

    Cd_41 : REAL := 0.00000; Cd_42 : REAL := 0.00000; Cd_43 : REAL := 0.00000; Cd_44 : REAL := 1.00000; Cd_45 : REAL := 0.00000; Cd_46 : REAL := 0.00000;

    Dd_11 : REAL := 0.00000;
    Dd_21 : REAL := 0.00000;
    Dd_31 : REAL := 0.00000;

    (* Kalman / Luenberger Observer Innovation Gains L (6x2) *)
    L_11 : REAL := 0.00142; L_12 : REAL := 0.8520;
    L_21 : REAL := 0.03850; L_22 : REAL := 42.150;
    L_31 : REAL := 0.45200; L_32 : REAL := 1.2500;
    L_41 : REAL := 1.85000; L_42 : REAL := 2.4500;
    L_51 : REAL := 0.28500; L_52 : REAL := 0.0000;

    (* State Vector Internal Registers *)
    x1_Angle_mrad       : REAL := 0.0;  (* Galvo tilt position [mrad] *)
    x2_Vel_mrad_s       : REAL := 0.0;  (* Galvo angular rate [mrad/s] *)
    x3_Pos_um           : REAL := 0.0;  (* Beam position on PSD [um] *)
    x4_Vel_um_s         : REAL := 0.0;  (* Beam transverse rate [um/s] *)
    x5_Disturb_um       : REAL := 0.0;  (* Mechanical chatter disturbance [um] *)
    x6_Integ_um_s       : REAL := 0.0;  (* Cumulative tracking error integrator [um*s] *)
    x1_Pred : REAL := 0.0; x2_Pred : REAL := 0.0; x3_Pred : REAL := 0.0;
    x4_Pred : REAL := 0.0; x5_Pred : REAL := 0.0; x6_Pred : REAL := 0.0;

    (* Model Predictive Control (MPC) Quadratic Cost Function Weights *)
    rMPC_Weight_Pos     : REAL := 85.0;     (* Penalty weight on optical beam position tracking error *)
    rMPC_Weight_Vel     : REAL := 14.5;     (* Penalty weight on beam transverse velocity *)
    rMPC_Weight_Angle   : REAL := 4.20;     (* Penalty weight on galvo mirror tilt excursion *)
    rMPC_Weight_Integ   : REAL := 22.0;     (* Penalty weight on steady-state integrator state *)
    rMPC_Weight_Drive   : REAL := 0.045;    (* Control effort penalty on drive demand *)

    rMaxGalvoDrive_mV   : REAL := 10000.0;  (* Saturation ceiling on piezo-galvo coil drive [mV] *)
    rMaxSlewRate_mV_s   : REAL := 3000000.0;(* Slew rate limit on piezo drive [mV/s] (1500 mV/cycle) *)
    rPrevGalvoDrive_mV  : REAL := 0.0;      (* Historical drive voltage for rate clamping *)

    (* ===================================================================================== *)
    (* 4.0 TDLAS VOIGT PROFILE DECONVOLUTION ENGINE & SPECTRAL ARRAYS                        *)
    (* 32-Point Equidistant Wavelength Modulation Spectral Scan across 760.8nm Oxygen line   *)
    (* ===================================================================================== *)
    arrSpectralSweep_mV         : ARRAY[1..32] OF REAL; (* Digitized 2f WMS raw photodiode absorption [mV] *)
    arrWavelengthDetune_GHz     : ARRAY[1..32] OF REAL; (* Frequency offset grid relative to line center [GHz] *)
    arrBaselineCorrected_mV     : ARRAY[1..32] OF REAL; (* 2f profile with polynomial baseline subtracted [mV] *)
    arrFittedVoigt_mV           : ARRAY[1..32] OF REAL; (* Synthesized Voigt profile from non-linear solver [mV] *)
    arrResidualError_mV         : ARRAY[1..32] OF REAL; (* Residual deviation between raw 2f and fitted Voigt [mV] *)

    (* Spectroscopic Voigt Parameters *)
    rDopplerFWHM_GHz            : REAL := 0.842;    (* Thermal Gaussian Doppler broadening linewidth [GHz] *)
    rLorentzFWHM_GHz            : REAL := 0.290;    (* Collisional Lorentzian pressure broadening linewidth [GHz] *)
    rVoigtFWHM_GHz              : REAL := 0.985;    (* Total deconvolved Voigt profile FWHM [GHz] *)
    rPseudoVoigtEta             : REAL := 0.285;    (* Pseudo-Voigt Lorentzian/Gaussian partition factor eta [-] *)
    rCalculatedOptPathLength_mm : REAL := 19.8;     (* Effective internal optical chord length through vial [mm] *)
    rPeakAbsorption2f_mV        : REAL := 0.0;      (* Peak amplitude of 2f absorption feature [mV] *)
    rBaselineSlope              : REAL := 0.0;      (* Linear tilt parameter of baseline polynomial [mV/GHz] *)
    rBaselineOffset             : REAL := 0.0;      (* Constant pedestal parameter of baseline polynomial [mV] *)
    rO2_AbsorptionCrossSect     : REAL := 1.85E-21; (* Optical absorption cross-section per molecule [cm^2] *)
    rWaterVaporCrossTalkCoeff   : REAL := 0.0145;   (* Residual H2O absorption cross-sensitivity factor at 760.8nm *)

    (* ===================================================================================== *)
    (* 5.0 DUAL STARWHEEL REJECT CAMMING & CIRCULAR SHIFT REGISTERS                          *)
    (* 64 Pockets on Main Rotary Turret Dial; Starwheel 1 at Pocket 18, Starwheel 2 at 34   *)
    (* ===================================================================================== *)
    arrPocketOccupied           : ARRAY[1..64] OF BOOL; (* Pocket vial presence flag *)
    arrPocketInspectionDone     : ARRAY[1..64] OF BOOL; (* Optical spectroscopy acquisition completed flag *)
    arrPocketRejectCode         : ARRAY[1..64] OF INT;  (* 0=Pass, 1=Reject1 (Gross/O2), 2=Reject2 (Vac/H2O) *)
    arrPocketO2_Val             : ARRAY[1..64] OF REAL; (* Measured headspace oxygen [%] *)
    arrPocketPress_Val          : ARRAY[1..64] OF REAL; (* Measured total vacuum pressure [mbar] *)
    arrPocketLatchAngle_deg     : ARRAY[1..64] OF REAL; (* Encoder absolute angle when pocket arrived [deg] *)

    c_iPocketOffset_Reject1     : INT := 18;        (* Pocket distance from inspection to Starwheel 1 blow-off *)
    c_iPocketOffset_Reject2     : INT := 34;        (* Pocket distance from inspection to Starwheel 2 blow-off *)
    c_rPneumaticValveLatency_ms : REAL := 4.5;      (* Solenoid valve electrical & pilot pneumatic firing delay [ms] *)
    c_rRejectPulseDuration_ms   : REAL := 16.0;     (* Commanded pneumatic blow-off nozzle open duration [ms] *)
    rReject1_TimerAccum_s       : REAL := 0.0;      (* Starwheel 1 valve open duration accumulator [s] *)
    rReject2_TimerAccum_s       : REAL := 0.0;      (* Starwheel 2 valve open duration accumulator [s] *)
    rReject1_Watchdog_s         : REAL := 0.0;      (* Starwheel 1 verification sensor timeout timer [s] *)
    rReject2_Watchdog_s         : REAL := 0.0;      (* Starwheel 2 verification sensor timeout timer [s] *)
    bReject1_AwaitingConfirm    : BOOL := FALSE;    (* Starwheel 1 active rejection confirmation tracking flag *)
    bReject2_AwaitingConfirm    : BOOL := FALSE;    (* Starwheel 2 active rejection confirmation tracking flag *)
    iCurrentPocketIndex         : INT := 1;         (* Currently active inspection station pocket pointer [1..64] *)
    rPrevMasterEncoderAngle_deg : REAL := 0.0;      (* Historical encoder angle for pocket pitch indexing *)

    (* ===================================================================================== *)
    (* 6.0 DYNAMIC STATISTICAL PROCESS CONTROL (SPC) & RECURSIVE WELFORD ANALYTICS           *)
    (* Real-time rolling sample capability estimation across 64-vial moving batch window     *)
    (* ===================================================================================== *)
    arrSPC_O2_Buffer            : ARRAY[1..64] OF REAL; (* Circular FIFO buffer for valid O2 measurements *)
    arrSPC_Press_Buffer         : ARRAY[1..64] OF REAL; (* Circular FIFO buffer for valid pressure measurements *)
    iSPC_Index                  : INT := 1;         (* Circular buffer insertion pointer [1..64] *)
    iSPC_Count                  : INT := 0;         (* Validated samples accumulated in SPC buffer *)
    rWelford_Mean_O2            : REAL := 0.0;      (* Recursive online sample mean O2 [%] *)
    rWelford_M2_O2              : REAL := 0.0;      (* Recursive online second central moment M2 for O2 *)
    rWelford_Mean_Press         : REAL := 100.0;    (* Recursive online sample mean pressure [mbar] *)
    rWelford_M2_Press           : REAL := 0.0;      (* Recursive online second central moment M2 for pressure *)
    rCalculatedVariance_O2      : REAL := 0.0;      (* Sample variance s^2 for O2 *)
    rCalculatedVariance_Press   : REAL := 0.0;      (* Sample variance s^2 for pressure *)
    rCp_O2                      : REAL := 1.67;     (* Process potential capability Cp for O2 *)
    rCpk_Upper_O2               : REAL := 1.67;     (* Upper capability limit CpkU for O2 *)
    rCpk_Lower_O2               : REAL := 1.67;     (* Lower capability limit CpkL for O2 *)
    rCp_Press                   : REAL := 1.67;     (* Process potential capability Cp for pressure *)
    rCpk_Upper_Press            : REAL := 1.67;     (* Upper capability limit CpkU for pressure *)
    rCpk_Lower_Press            : REAL := 1.67;     (* Lower capability limit CpkL for pressure *)
    iNelsonRule2_RunCount_O2    : INT := 0;         (* Consecutive points on same side of mean (Rule 2) *)
    iNelsonRule3_TrendCount_O2  : INT := 0;         (* Consecutive points steadily increasing/decreasing (Rule 3) *)
    rPrevSample_O2              : REAL := 0.0;      (* Preceding sample for trend tracking *)

    (* ===================================================================================== *)
    (* 7.0 TIMERS, DEBOUNCERS, EDGE DETECTORS & SCRATCH REGISTERS                            *)
    (* ===================================================================================== *)
    tonLaserWarmup              : TON;              (* DFB laser source startup ignition timer *)
    tonTEC_Stabilize            : TON;              (* Thermoelectric temperature stabilization debounce *)
    tonGateWatchdog             : TON;              (* Maximum optical transit inspection window timer *)
    tonPneumaticPressDebounce   : TON;              (* Reject air supply pressure drop debounce timer *)
    r_trig_VialDetect           : R_TRIG;           (* Vial presence rising edge trigger *)
    r_trig_PocketAdvance        : R_TRIG;           (* Main turret pitch index pulse *)
    r_trig_Acknowledge          : R_TRIG;           (* Fault reset pulse *)

    (* State Machine Transition Variables *)
    iState                      : INT := 0;         (* Active finite state machine index *)
    iPrevState                  : INT := 0;         (* Historical state machine index *)
    rStateTimerAccum_s          : REAL := 0.0;      (* Elapsed residence time in active state [s] *)
    iSpectralPointIndex         : INT := 1;         (* Sweep digitization sample counter [1..32] *)

    (* Non-Linear Least Squares Gauss-Newton Working Registers *)
    rGN_Jacobian_11 : REAL; rGN_Jacobian_12 : REAL; (* Approximated partial derivatives *)
    rGN_Hessian_11  : REAL; rGN_Hessian_12  : REAL; rGN_Hessian_22 : REAL;
    rGN_Grad_1      : REAL; rGN_Grad_2      : REAL;
    rGN_Delta_Amp   : REAL; rGN_Delta_Width : REAL;
    rGN_Det         : REAL;
    rFittedLorentzVal : REAL; rFittedGaussVal : REAL; rFrequencyOffsetVal : REAL;
    rResidualSquareSum : REAL;

    (* General Math Scratch Registers *)
    rTmpA : REAL; rTmpB : REAL; rTmpC : REAL; rTmpDiff : REAL;
    rGrad1 : REAL; rHess11 : REAL; rUnconstrainedDrive : REAL;
    iIdx : INT; jIdx : INT; kIdx : INT;
END_VAR

(* ========================================================================================= *)
(* 1.0 EMERGENCY SAFETY SHUTDOWN & SIL-3 HARDWIRED INTERLOCK EVALUATION                      *)
(* Hard real-time safety gating evaluated unconditionally at start of every 500 us task      *)
(* ========================================================================================= *)
IF NOT bEmergencyStop THEN
    bSystemRunning := FALSE;
    bSystemReady := FALSE;
    bSystemTrip := TRUE;
    bRejectGate1_Actuate := FALSE;
    bRejectGate2_Actuate := FALSE;
    rPiezoGalvoDriveDemand := 0.0;
    dwAlarmWord_1 := dwAlarmWord_1 OR 16#0000_0001; (* Bit 0: SIL-3 Hardwired E-Stop Relay Tripped *)
    dwSystemStatusWord := (dwSystemStatusWord AND 16#FFFF_FFF0) OR 16#0000_0009; (* Status: E-Stop Decoupled *)
    iCurrentState := 100; (* Direct jump to fail-safe containment state *)
    iState := 100;
    RETURN;
END_IF;

(* Class 1 Optical Enclosure Laser Safety Interlock Check *)
IF NOT bLaserSafetyInterlock THEN
    bSystemRunning := FALSE;
    bSystemReady := FALSE;
    bSystemTrip := TRUE;
    rPiezoGalvoDriveDemand := 0.0;
    dwAlarmWord_1 := dwAlarmWord_1 OR 16#0000_0002; (* Bit 1: Class 1 Laser Safety Enclosure Interlock Open *)
    iCurrentState := 100;
    iState := 100;
    RETURN;
END_IF;

(* Pneumatic Reject Air Supply Header Pressure Supervision *)
tonPneumaticPressDebounce(IN := (rRejectAirSupply_bar < 4.8), PT := T#100MS);
IF tonPneumaticPressDebounce.Q THEN
    bSystemTrip := TRUE;
    dwAlarmWord_1 := dwAlarmWord_1 OR 16#0000_0004; (* Bit 2: Pneumatic Blow-Off Header Pressure Exhausted (< 4.8 bar) *)
    iCurrentState := 100;
    iState := 100;
    RETURN;
END_IF;

(* ========================================================================================= *)
(* 2.0 TRIPLE MODULAR REDUNDANCY (2oo3) SENSOR VOTING ALGORITHMS                             *)
(* Evaluates pair-wise Euclidean deviations, detects sensor drift, and flags degraded 1oo2.  *)
(* ========================================================================================= *)
(* 2.1 Optical Absorption Photodiode Transimpedance Receiver 2oo3 Voting *)
bDet_A_OK := (rPhotodiodeRaw_A_mV >= 50.0) AND (rPhotodiodeRaw_A_mV <= 4950.0);
bDet_B_OK := (rPhotodiodeRaw_B_mV >= 50.0) AND (rPhotodiodeRaw_B_mV <= 4950.0);
bDet_C_OK := (rPhotodiodeRaw_C_mV >= 50.0) AND (rPhotodiodeRaw_C_mV <= 4950.0);

IF bDet_A_OK AND bDet_B_OK AND bDet_C_OK THEN
    (* All 3 channels operational: compute median value *)
    IF (rPhotodiodeRaw_A_mV >= rPhotodiodeRaw_B_mV AND rPhotodiodeRaw_A_mV <= rPhotodiodeRaw_C_mV) OR
       (rPhotodiodeRaw_A_mV >= rPhotodiodeRaw_C_mV AND rPhotodiodeRaw_A_mV <= rPhotodiodeRaw_B_mV) THEN
        rVotedPhotodiode_mV := rPhotodiodeRaw_A_mV;
    ELSIF (rPhotodiodeRaw_B_mV >= rPhotodiodeRaw_A_mV AND rPhotodiodeRaw_B_mV <= rPhotodiodeRaw_C_mV) OR
          (rPhotodiodeRaw_B_mV >= rPhotodiodeRaw_C_mV AND rPhotodiodeRaw_B_mV <= rPhotodiodeRaw_A_mV) THEN
        rVotedPhotodiode_mV := rPhotodiodeRaw_B_mV;
    ELSE
        rVotedPhotodiode_mV := rPhotodiodeRaw_C_mV;
    END_IF;
    bDet_Degraded_1oo2 := FALSE;
    (* Check for channel calibration drift beyond tolerance *)
    IF (ABS(rPhotodiodeRaw_A_mV - rPhotodiodeRaw_B_mV) > c_rPhotodiodeTol_mV) OR
       (ABS(rPhotodiodeRaw_B_mV - rPhotodiodeRaw_C_mV) > c_rPhotodiodeTol_mV) OR
       (ABS(rPhotodiodeRaw_C_mV - rPhotodiodeRaw_A_mV) > c_rPhotodiodeTol_mV) THEN
        dwAlarmWord_2 := dwAlarmWord_2 OR 16#0000_0001; (* Bit 0: Photodiode TMR Channel Discrepancy Drift *)
    END_IF;
ELSIF bDet_A_OK AND bDet_B_OK THEN
    rVotedPhotodiode_mV := (rPhotodiodeRaw_A_mV + rPhotodiodeRaw_B_mV) * 0.5;
    bDet_Degraded_1oo2 := TRUE;
    dwAlarmWord_2 := dwAlarmWord_2 OR 16#0000_0002; (* Bit 1: Photodiode Channel C Failure (Degraded 1oo2 Mode) *)
ELSIF bDet_B_OK AND bDet_C_OK THEN
    rVotedPhotodiode_mV := (rPhotodiodeRaw_B_mV + rPhotodiodeRaw_C_mV) * 0.5;
    bDet_Degraded_1oo2 := TRUE;
    dwAlarmWord_2 := dwAlarmWord_2 OR 16#0000_0004; (* Bit 2: Photodiode Channel A Failure (Degraded 1oo2 Mode) *)
ELSIF bDet_A_OK AND bDet_C_OK THEN
    rVotedPhotodiode_mV := (rPhotodiodeRaw_A_mV + rPhotodiodeRaw_C_mV) * 0.5;
    bDet_Degraded_1oo2 := TRUE;
    dwAlarmWord_2 := dwAlarmWord_2 OR 16#0000_0008; (* Bit 3: Photodiode Channel B Failure (Degraded 1oo2 Mode) *)
ELSE
    (* 2 or more photodiode channels failed: Optical acquisition loss *)
    bSystemTrip := TRUE;
    dwAlarmWord_1 := dwAlarmWord_1 OR 16#0000_0008; (* Bit 3: Photodiode TMR Multiple Channel Catastrophic Failure *)
END_IF;
bTMR_Degraded_1oo2 := bDet_Degraded_1oo2 OR bTrig_Degraded_1oo2;

(* 2.2 Pocket Presence Proximity Trigger 2oo3 Voting *)
IF (bVialTrigger_A AND bVialTrigger_B) OR (bVialTrigger_B AND bVialTrigger_C) OR (bVialTrigger_A AND bVialTrigger_C) THEN
    bVotedVialTrigger := TRUE;
ELSE
    bVotedVialTrigger := FALSE;
END_IF;
r_trig_VialDetect(CLK := bVotedVialTrigger);

(* 2.3 Laser Substrate Temperature (TEC) Permissive Check *)
bLaserThermalStabilized := (ABS(rLaserDiodeTemp_DegC - 25.0) <= 0.015);
IF NOT bLaserThermalStabilized AND bEnableSystem THEN
    dwAlarmWord_2 := dwAlarmWord_2 OR 16#0000_0010; (* Bit 4: Laser DFB Substrate Temperature Outside Operating Window *)
END_IF;

(* ========================================================================================= *)
(* 3.0 PIEZO-GALVANOMETER OPTICAL JITTER NULLING & STATE-SPACE MPC OBSERVER                   *)
(* Maintains laser beam centroid centered on the moving vial optical chord during transit    *)
(* ========================================================================================= *)
(* Innovation calculation from Position Sensitive Detector (PSD) measurement *)
rTrackingTrackingError_um := rBeamDeflection_PSD_um - x3_Pos_um;

(* Observer State Correction Step: x = x_pred + L * innovation *)
x1_Angle_mrad := x1_Pred + (L_11 * rTrackingTrackingError_um) + (L_12 * (rGalvoMirrorAngleFeedback_urad / 1000.0 - x1_Pred));
x2_Vel_mrad_s := x2_Pred + (L_21 * rTrackingTrackingError_um);
x3_Pos_um     := x3_Pred + (L_31 * rTrackingTrackingError_um);
x4_Vel_um_s   := x4_Pred + (L_41 * rTrackingTrackingError_um);
x5_Disturb_um := x5_Pred + (L_51 * rTrackingTrackingError_um);
x6_Integ_um_s := x6_Pred + (rTrackingTrackingError_um * c_rCycleTimeSeconds);

(* Constrained Quadratic Programming MPC Drive Computation *)
(* Analytical unconstrained gradient step J = 1/2 u'*H*u + g'*u *)
rHess11 := (Bd_31 * rMPC_Weight_Pos * Bd_31) + (Bd_41 * rMPC_Weight_Vel * Bd_41) +
           (Bd_11 * rMPC_Weight_Angle * Bd_11) + (Bd_61 * rMPC_Weight_Integ * Bd_61) +
           rMPC_Weight_Drive + (rMPC_Weight_Rate / (c_rCycleTimeSeconds * c_rCycleTimeSeconds));

rGrad1  := (Bd_31 * rMPC_Weight_Pos * (x3_Pos_um + x5_Disturb_um)) +
           (Bd_41 * rMPC_Weight_Vel * x4_Vel_um_s) +
           (Bd_11 * rMPC_Weight_Angle * x1_Angle_mrad) +
           (Bd_61 * rMPC_Weight_Integ * x6_Integ_um_s) -
           ((rMPC_Weight_Rate / (c_rCycleTimeSeconds * c_rCycleTimeSeconds)) * rPrevGalvoDrive_mV);

IF rHess11 > 0.0001 THEN
    rUnconstrainedDrive := - (rGrad1 / rHess11);
ELSE
    rUnconstrainedDrive := 0.0;
END_IF;

(* Slew Rate Limiter Clamping (3,000,000 mV/s = 1500 mV per 500 us scan) *)
rTmpDiff := rUnconstrainedDrive - rPrevGalvoDrive_mV;
IF rTmpDiff > 1500.0 THEN
    rPiezoGalvoDriveDemand := rPrevGalvoDrive_mV + 1500.0;
ELSIF rTmpDiff < -1500.0 THEN
    rPiezoGalvoDriveDemand := rPrevGalvoDrive_mV - 1500.0;
ELSE
    rPiezoGalvoDriveDemand := rUnconstrainedDrive;
END_IF;

(* Absolute Drive Voltage Saturation Limiter (+/- 10,000 mV) *)
IF rPiezoGalvoDriveDemand > rMaxGalvoDrive_mV THEN
    rPiezoGalvoDriveDemand := rMaxGalvoDrive_mV;
    dwAlarmWord_2 := dwAlarmWord_2 OR 16#0000_0020; (* Bit 5: Piezo-Galvo Drive Command Saturated High *)
ELSIF rPiezoGalvoDriveDemand < -rMaxGalvoDrive_mV THEN
    rPiezoGalvoDriveDemand := -rMaxGalvoDrive_mV;
    dwAlarmWord_2 := dwAlarmWord_2 OR 16#0000_0020;
END_IF;
rPrevGalvoDrive_mV := rPiezoGalvoDriveDemand;

(* Optical Alignment Lock Verification *)
bOpticalAlignmentLocked := (ABS(rTrackingTrackingError_um) <= 12.0) AND (rBeamIntensity_PSD_mV > 1500.0);

(* Discrete State-Space Propagation Step: x_pred = Ad * x + Bd * u *)
x1_Pred := (Ad_11 * x1_Angle_mrad) + (Ad_12 * x2_Vel_mrad_s) + (Bd_11 * rPiezoGalvoDriveDemand);
x2_Pred := (Ad_21 * x1_Angle_mrad) + (Ad_22 * x2_Vel_mrad_s) + (Bd_21 * rPiezoGalvoDriveDemand);
x3_Pred := (Ad_31 * x1_Angle_mrad) + (Ad_32 * x2_Vel_mrad_s) + (Ad_33 * x3_Pos_um) + (Ad_34 * x4_Vel_um_s) + (Ad_35 * x5_Disturb_um) + (Bd_31 * rPiezoGalvoDriveDemand);
x4_Pred := (Ad_41 * x1_Angle_mrad) + (Ad_42 * x2_Vel_mrad_s) + (Ad_43 * x3_Pos_um) + (Ad_44 * x4_Vel_um_s) + (Ad_45 * x5_Disturb_um) + (Bd_41 * rPiezoGalvoDriveDemand);
x5_Pred := (Ad_55 * x5_Disturb_um);
x6_Pred := (Ad_61 * x1_Angle_mrad) + (Ad_63 * x3_Pos_um) + (Ad_66 * x6_Integ_um_s) + (Bd_61 * rPiezoGalvoDriveDemand);

(* ========================================================================================= *)
(* 4.0 MULTI-STAGE FINITE STATE MACHINE (CASE iState OF)                                     *)
(* Hard real-time orchestration across 10 deterministic supervisory & spectroscopic states   *)
(* ========================================================================================= *)
CASE iState OF
    0: (* STATE_SYSTEM_INIT_AND_DIAGNOSTICS *)
        bSystemRunning := FALSE;
        bSystemReady := FALSE;
        bRejectGate1_Actuate := FALSE;
        bRejectGate2_Actuate := FALSE;
        rPiezoGalvoDriveDemand := 0.0;
        x1_Pred := 0.0; x2_Pred := 0.0; x3_Pred := 0.0; x4_Pred := 0.0; x5_Pred := 0.0; x6_Pred := 0.0;
        (* Reset Pocket Circular Shift Registers *)
        FOR iIdx := 1 TO 64 DO
            arrPocketOccupied[iIdx] := FALSE;
            arrPocketInspectionDone[iIdx] := FALSE;
            arrPocketRejectCode[iIdx] := 0;
            arrPocketO2_Val[iIdx] := 0.0;
            arrPocketPress_Val[iIdx] := 0.0;
            arrPocketLatchAngle_deg[iIdx] := 0.0;
        END_FOR;
        (* Reset Spectral Scan Arrays *)
        FOR jIdx := 1 TO 32 DO
            arrSpectralSweep_mV[jIdx] := 0.0;
            arrWavelengthDetune_GHz[jIdx] := -3.10 + (DINT_TO_REAL(jIdx - 1) * 0.20); (* -3.1 to +3.1 GHz grid *)
            arrBaselineCorrected_mV[jIdx] := 0.0;
            arrFittedVoigt_mV[jIdx] := 0.0;
            arrResidualError_mV[jIdx] := 0.0;
        END_FOR;
        IF bEmergencyStop AND bLaserSafetyInterlock THEN
            iState := 10;
        END_IF;

    10: (* STATE_LASER_TEC_WARMUP_STABILIZATION *)
        tonLaserWarmup(IN := TRUE, PT := T#5S);
        tonTEC_Stabilize(IN := bLaserThermalStabilized, PT := T#2S);
        IF tonLaserWarmup.Q AND tonTEC_Stabilize.Q THEN
            tonLaserWarmup(IN := FALSE);
            tonTEC_Stabilize(IN := FALSE);
            iState := 20;
        END_IF;

    20: (* STATE_REFERENCE_GAS_CELL_AUTO_CALIBRATION *)
        (* Verify sealed 21.0% O2 standard cell and pure N2 zero cell absorption ratio *)
        IF (rRefCellO2_Signal_mV >= 1500.0) AND (rRefCellZero_Signal_mV <= 250.0) THEN
            iState := 30;
        ELSE
            dwAlarmWord_2 := dwAlarmWord_2 OR 16#0000_0040; (* Bit 6: Optical Reference Cell Calibration Span Error *)
            iState := 30; (* Proceed to Standby with advisory flag *)
        END_IF;

    30: (* STATE_STANDBY_WAIT_INSPECTION_ENABLE *)
        bSystemReady := bLaserThermalStabilized AND bStarwheelSyncPermissive AND (rRejectAirSupply_bar >= 5.2);
        bSystemRunning := FALSE;
        rPiezoGalvoDriveDemand := 0.0;
        IF bEnableSystem AND bSystemReady THEN
            bSystemRunning := TRUE;
            iState := 40;
        END_IF;

    40: (* STATE_VIAL_POCKET_ACQUISITION_AND_TRACKING *)
        (* Detect vial presence entering optical transit gate *)
        IF r_trig_VialDetect.Q OR bManualInspectionGateForce THEN
            arrPocketOccupied[iCurrentPocketIndex] := TRUE;
            arrPocketInspectionDone[iCurrentPocketIndex] := FALSE;
            arrPocketRejectCode[iCurrentPocketIndex] := 0;
            arrPocketLatchAngle_deg[iCurrentPocketIndex] := rMasterEncoderAngle_deg;
            iSpectralPointIndex := 1;
            rStateTimerAccum_s := 0.0;
            iState := 50;
        END_IF;

    50: (* STATE_FAST_TDLAS_BURST_AND_PIEZO_MPC *)
        (* High-speed burst sampling: Acquire 32-point 2f absorption profile while tracking *)
