(* ========================================================================================= *)
(* STEP 0: TIME-BASE TICK & EXECUTION PREAMBLE                                               *)
(* ========================================================================================= *)
tStateTimer(IN := (iState = iPrevState), PT := T#24H);
tStateDuration := tStateTimer.ET;
iPrevState := iState;

(* Compute Maximum Allowable Slew per 20 ms deterministic scan cycle *)
(* Example: 5.0 %/s * 0.02 s = 0.10 % per cycle *)
rActuatorCycleSlew_Pct := C_MAX_WICKET_SLEW_RATE_PCT_SEC * 0.020;

(* ========================================================================================= *)
(* STEP 1: HARDWIRED SAFETY CIRCUIT & EMERGENCY STOP SUPERVISION                             *)
(* ========================================================================================= *)
IF NOT bEmergencyStop THEN
    bAlarm_EStopTripped := TRUE;
    bTripAlarm := TRUE;
    iState := STATE_LATCHED_EMERGENCY_TRIP;
END_IF;

(* ========================================================================================= *)
(* STEP 2: TMR 2oo3 VOTING LOGIC - DRAW PRESSURE TRANSDUCERS (PT101A/B/C)                     *)
(* Computes pairwise discrepancy, isolates failed sensor, selects median for active control *)
(* ========================================================================================= *)
(* Compute absolute pairwise deviations *)
rPT101_Dev_AB := ABS(rPressure_DrawInlet_PT101A_bar - rPressure_DrawInlet_PT101B_bar);
rPT101_Dev_BC := ABS(rPressure_DrawInlet_PT101B_bar - rPressure_DrawInlet_PT101C_bar);
rPT101_Dev_CA := ABS(rPressure_DrawInlet_PT101C_bar - rPressure_DrawInlet_PT101A_bar);

(* Determine individual sensor channel health based on deviation tolerance and physical bounds *)
bPT101A_Health := (rPressure_DrawInlet_PT101A_bar >= -0.5) AND (rPressure_DrawInlet_PT101A_bar <= 75.0) AND
                  ((rPT101_Dev_AB <= C_PT101_MAX_DEVIATION_BAR) OR (rPT101_Dev_CA <= C_PT101_MAX_DEVIATION_BAR));

bPT101B_Health := (rPressure_DrawInlet_PT101B_bar >= -0.5) AND (rPressure_DrawInlet_PT101B_bar <= 75.0) AND
                  ((rPT101_Dev_AB <= C_PT101_MAX_DEVIATION_BAR) OR (rPT101_Dev_BC <= C_PT101_MAX_DEVIATION_BAR));

bPT101C_Health := (rPressure_DrawInlet_PT101C_bar >= -0.5) AND (rPressure_DrawInlet_PT101C_bar <= 75.0) AND
                  ((rPT101_Dev_BC <= C_PT101_MAX_DEVIATION_BAR) OR (rPT101_Dev_CA <= C_PT101_MAX_DEVIATION_BAR));

(* Count operating channels *)
iPT101_HealthyCount := 0;
IF bPT101A_Health THEN iPT101_HealthyCount := iPT101_HealthyCount + 1; END_IF;
IF bPT101B_Health THEN iPT101_HealthyCount := iPT101_HealthyCount + 1; END_IF;
IF bPT101C_Health THEN iPT101_HealthyCount := iPT101_HealthyCount + 1; END_IF;

IF iPT101_HealthyCount = 3 THEN
    (* Standard 2oo3 Median Selection *)
    IF ((rPressure_DrawInlet_PT101A_bar >= rPressure_DrawInlet_PT101B_bar) AND (rPressure_DrawInlet_PT101A_bar <= rPressure_DrawInlet_PT101C_bar)) OR
       ((rPressure_DrawInlet_PT101A_bar <= rPressure_DrawInlet_PT101B_bar) AND (rPressure_DrawInlet_PT101A_bar >= rPressure_DrawInlet_PT101C_bar)) THEN
        rVoted_Pressure_Draw_bar := rPressure_DrawInlet_PT101A_bar;
    ELSIF ((rPressure_DrawInlet_PT101B_bar >= rPressure_DrawInlet_PT101A_bar) AND (rPressure_DrawInlet_PT101B_bar <= rPressure_DrawInlet_PT101C_bar)) OR
          ((rPressure_DrawInlet_PT101B_bar <= rPressure_DrawInlet_PT101A_bar) AND (rPressure_DrawInlet_PT101B_bar >= rPressure_DrawInlet_PT101C_bar)) THEN
        rVoted_Pressure_Draw_bar := rPressure_DrawInlet_PT101B_bar;
    ELSE
        rVoted_Pressure_Draw_bar := rPressure_DrawInlet_PT101C_bar;
    END_IF;
    bAlarm_TMR_PT101_Discrepancy := FALSE;
ELSIF iPT101_HealthyCount = 2 THEN
    (* Graceful Degradation to 1oo2 Average *)
    bAlarm_TMR_PT101_Discrepancy := TRUE;
    bAlarm_DegradedMode1oo2 := TRUE;
    IF NOT bPT101A_Health THEN
        rVoted_Pressure_Draw_bar := (rPressure_DrawInlet_PT101B_bar + rPressure_DrawInlet_PT101C_bar) * 0.5;
    ELSIF NOT bPT101B_Health THEN
        rVoted_Pressure_Draw_bar := (rPressure_DrawInlet_PT101A_bar + rPressure_DrawInlet_PT101C_bar) * 0.5;
    ELSE
        rVoted_Pressure_Draw_bar := (rPressure_DrawInlet_PT101A_bar + rPressure_DrawInlet_PT101B_bar) * 0.5;
    END_IF;
ELSE
    (* Critical Loss of Pressure Redundancy: Fail-Safe Default *)
    bAlarm_TMR_PT101_Discrepancy := TRUE;
    bTripAlarm := TRUE;
    iState := STATE_LATCHED_EMERGENCY_TRIP;
END_IF;

(* ========================================================================================= *)
(* STEP 3: TMR 2oo3 VOTING LOGIC - TURBINE ROTATIONAL SPEED (ST501A/B/C)                      *)
(* ========================================================================================= *)
rST501_Dev_AB := ABS(rTurbineSpeed_ST501A_rpm - rTurbineSpeed_ST501B_rpm);
rST501_Dev_BC := ABS(rTurbineSpeed_ST501B_rpm - rTurbineSpeed_ST501C_rpm);
rST501_Dev_CA := ABS(rTurbineSpeed_ST501C_rpm - rTurbineSpeed_ST501A_rpm);

bST501A_Health := (rTurbineSpeed_ST501A_rpm >= 0.0) AND (rTurbineSpeed_ST501A_rpm <= 4000.0) AND
                  ((rST501_Dev_AB <= C_ST501_MAX_DEVIATION_RPM) OR (rST501_Dev_CA <= C_ST501_MAX_DEVIATION_RPM));

bST501B_Health := (rTurbineSpeed_ST501B_rpm >= 0.0) AND (rTurbineSpeed_ST501B_rpm <= 4000.0) AND
                  ((rST501_Dev_AB <= C_ST501_MAX_DEVIATION_RPM) OR (rST501_Dev_BC <= C_ST501_MAX_DEVIATION_RPM));

bST501C_Health := (rTurbineSpeed_ST501C_rpm >= 0.0) AND (rTurbineSpeed_ST501C_rpm <= 4000.0) AND
                  ((rST501_Dev_BC <= C_ST501_MAX_DEVIATION_RPM) OR (rST501_Dev_CA <= C_ST501_MAX_DEVIATION_RPM));

iST501_HealthyCount := 0;
IF bST501A_Health THEN iST501_HealthyCount := iST501_HealthyCount + 1; END_IF;
IF bST501B_Health THEN iST501_HealthyCount := iST501_HealthyCount + 1; END_IF;
IF bST501C_Health THEN iST501_HealthyCount := iST501_HealthyCount + 1; END_IF;

IF iST501_HealthyCount = 3 THEN
    IF ((rTurbineSpeed_ST501A_rpm >= rTurbineSpeed_ST501B_rpm) AND (rTurbineSpeed_ST501A_rpm <= rTurbineSpeed_ST501C_rpm)) OR
       ((rTurbineSpeed_ST501A_rpm <= rTurbineSpeed_ST501B_rpm) AND (rTurbineSpeed_ST501A_rpm >= rTurbineSpeed_ST501C_rpm)) THEN
        rVoted_TurbineSpeed_rpm := rTurbineSpeed_ST501A_rpm;
    ELSIF ((rTurbineSpeed_ST501B_rpm >= rTurbineSpeed_ST501A_rpm) AND (rTurbineSpeed_ST501B_rpm <= rTurbineSpeed_ST501C_rpm)) OR
          ((rTurbineSpeed_ST501B_rpm <= rTurbineSpeed_ST501A_rpm) AND (rTurbineSpeed_ST501B_rpm >= rTurbineSpeed_ST501C_rpm)) THEN
        rVoted_TurbineSpeed_rpm := rTurbineSpeed_ST501B_rpm;
    ELSE
        rVoted_TurbineSpeed_rpm := rTurbineSpeed_ST501C_rpm;
    END_IF;
    bAlarm_TMR_ST501_Discrepancy := FALSE;
ELSIF iST501_HealthyCount = 2 THEN
    bAlarm_TMR_ST501_Discrepancy := TRUE;
    bAlarm_DegradedMode1oo2 := TRUE;
    IF NOT bST501A_Health THEN
        rVoted_TurbineSpeed_rpm := (rTurbineSpeed_ST501B_rpm + rTurbineSpeed_ST501C_rpm) * 0.5;
    ELSIF NOT bST501B_Health THEN
        rVoted_TurbineSpeed_rpm := (rTurbineSpeed_ST501A_rpm + rTurbineSpeed_ST501C_rpm) * 0.5;
    ELSE
        rVoted_TurbineSpeed_rpm := (rTurbineSpeed_ST501A_rpm + rTurbineSpeed_ST501B_rpm) * 0.5;
    END_IF;
ELSE
    bAlarm_TMR_ST501_Discrepancy := TRUE;
    bTripAlarm := TRUE;
    iState := STATE_LATCHED_EMERGENCY_TRIP;
END_IF;

(* ========================================================================================= *)
(* STEP 4: FIRST-ORDER SENSOR FILTERING & TRANSIENT RATE CALCULATION                         *)
(* ========================================================================================= *)
rFilt_DrawPressure_bar := (C_FILTER_ALPHA_PRESS * rVoted_Pressure_Draw_bar) + 
                          ((1.0 - C_FILTER_ALPHA_PRESS) * rFilt_DrawPressure_bar);

rFilt_FeedPressure_bar := (C_FILTER_ALPHA_PRESS * rPressure_FeedInlet_PT102_bar) + 
                          ((1.0 - C_FILTER_ALPHA_PRESS) * rFilt_FeedPressure_bar);

rFilt_TurbineInletPressure_bar := (C_FILTER_ALPHA_PRESS * rPressure_TurbineInlet_PT103_bar) + 
                                  ((1.0 - C_FILTER_ALPHA_PRESS) * rFilt_TurbineInletPressure_bar);

rFilt_FeedFlow_m3h := (C_FILTER_ALPHA_FLOW * rFlow_FeedInlet_FT201_m3h) + 
                      ((1.0 - C_FILTER_ALPHA_FLOW) * rFilt_FeedFlow_m3h);

rFilt_DrawFlow_m3h := (C_FILTER_ALPHA_FLOW * rFlow_DrawInlet_FT202_m3h) + 
                      ((1.0 - C_FILTER_ALPHA_FLOW) * rFilt_DrawFlow_m3h);

rFilt_TurbineFlow_m3h := (C_FILTER_ALPHA_FLOW * rFlow_TurbineOutlet_FT203_m3h) + 
                         ((1.0 - C_FILTER_ALPHA_FLOW) * rFilt_TurbineFlow_m3h);

rFilt_TurbineSpeed_rpm := (C_FILTER_ALPHA_SPEED * rVoted_TurbineSpeed_rpm) + 
                          ((1.0 - C_FILTER_ALPHA_SPEED) * rFilt_TurbineSpeed_rpm);

(* Hydraulic surge rate: dp/dt = (P[k] - P[k-1]) / Ts *)
rPressureRateOfChange_bar_s := (rFilt_TurbineInletPressure_bar - rPrev_TurbineInletPressure_bar) / 0.020;
rPrev_TurbineInletPressure_bar := rFilt_TurbineInletPressure_bar;

(* ========================================================================================= *)
(* STEP 5: PRO THERMODYNAMICS, VAN 'T HOFF EQUATIONS & CONCENTRATION POLARIZATION (CP)       *)
(* ========================================================================================= *)
(* Temperature conversion to Kelvin [K] *)
rTemp_Kelvin := ((rTemp_FeedWater_TT401_degC + rTemp_DrawWater_TT402_degC) * 0.5) + 273.15;

(* Convert Conductivities [mS/cm] to equivalent NaCl Salinity [g/L] *)
(* Empirical conversion for brackish/seawater: C [g/L] ~= 0.64 * EC [mS/cm] *)
rSalinity_Feed_gL := rConductivity_Feed_AT301_mScm * 0.640;
rSalinity_Draw_gL := rConductivity_Draw_AT302_mScm * 0.645;

(* Prevent unphysical non-positive salinities *)
IF rSalinity_Feed_gL < 0.05 THEN rSalinity_Feed_gL := 0.05; END_IF;
IF rSalinity_Draw_gL < 1.00 THEN rSalinity_Draw_gL := 1.00; END_IF;

(* Thermodynamic Bulk Osmotic Pressures via Van 't Hoff Equation *)
(* pi = i * phi * (C / M_NaCl) * R * T * 1e-5 [bar] *)
rBulkOsmoticPressure_Feed_bar := C_VANTHOFF_I * C_OSMOTIC_COEFF_PHI * 
                                 (rSalinity_Feed_gL / C_NACL_MOLAR_MASS_KG) * 
                                 C_UNIVERSAL_GAS_CONST_R * rTemp_Kelvin * 1.0E-5;

rBulkOsmoticPressure_Draw_bar := C_VANTHOFF_I * C_OSMOTIC_COEFF_PHI * 
                                 (rSalinity_Draw_gL / C_NACL_MOLAR_MASS_KG) * 
                                 C_UNIVERSAL_GAS_CONST_R * rTemp_Kelvin * 1.0E-5;

rOsmoticPressureDiff_bar := rBulkOsmoticPressure_Draw_bar - rBulkOsmoticPressure_Feed_bar;

(* Net Hydraulic Pressure across membrane active layer *)
rDeltaP_Hydraulic_bar := rFilt_DrawPressure_bar - rFilt_FeedPressure_bar;
IF rDeltaP_Hydraulic_bar < 0.0 THEN rDeltaP_Hydraulic_bar := 0.0; END_IF;

(* Solute transport resistivity inside porous support layer K = S / D *)
rSoluteResistivity_K_sm := C_STRUCTURAL_PARAM_S_M / C_NACL_DIFFUSION_D_M2S;

(* Mass transfer coefficient in draw flow channel k [m/s] *)
(* Scaled by cross-flow shear pump speed: k = k0 * (1 + 0.85 * (Pump_pct / 100)) *)
rMassTransferCoeff_k_m_s := 2.85E-5 * (1.0 + (0.85 * (rShearBoosterPumpVFD_Feedback_Pct / 100.0)));

(* Internal (ICP) and External (ECP) Concentration Polarization Factors *)
(* Convert flux Jw from LMH to m/s: 1 LMH = 2.7778e-7 m/s *)
rExpICP := EXP(LIMIT(0.0, (rXhat_Flux_LMH * 2.7778E-7) * (rSoluteResistivity_K_sm * 0.001), 3.5));
rExpECP := EXP(LIMIT(-3.5, -((rXhat_Flux_LMH * 2.7778E-7) / rMassTransferCoeff_k_m_s), 0.0));

(* Coupled Concentration Polarization Effective Driving Osmotic Pressure *)
(* Numerator: pi_draw * exp(-Jw/k) - pi_feed * exp(Jw*K) *)
rNumerator := (rBulkOsmoticPressure_Draw_bar * rExpECP) - (rBulkOsmoticPressure_Feed_bar * rExpICP);
IF rNumerator < 0.0 THEN rNumerator := 0.0; END_IF;

(* Denominator: 1 + (B / Jw) * (exp(Jw*K) - exp(-Jw/k)) *)
IF rXhat_Flux_LMH > 0.5 THEN
    rDenominator := 1.0 + ((C_SALT_PERM_B_LMH / rXhat_Flux_LMH) * (rExpICP - rExpECP));
ELSE
    rDenominator := 1.0;
END_IF;

IF rDenominator < 0.1 THEN rDenominator := 0.1; END_IF;
rEffectiveOsmoticPressure_bar := rNumerator / rDenominator;

(* Effective Net Driving Force *)
rEffectiveDrivingPressure_bar := rEffectiveOsmoticPressure_bar - rDeltaP_Hydraulic_bar;

(* Water Permeate Flux Jw = A * (delta_pi_eff - delta_P) [LMH] *)
IF rEffectiveDrivingPressure_bar > 0.0 THEN
    rMembraneFlux_Jw_LMH := C_WATER_PERM_A_LMH_BAR * rEffectiveDrivingPressure_bar;
ELSE
    rMembraneFlux_Jw_LMH := 0.0;
END_IF;

(* Total volumetric permeate suction [m3/h] *)
rPermeationFlow_m3h := (rMembraneFlux_Jw_LMH * C_MEMBRANE_AREA_TOTAL_M2) * 1.0E-3;

(* Dimensionless Concentration Polarization Severity Index (0.0 to 1.0) *)
(* Defined as 1 - (delta_pi_eff / delta_pi_bulk) *)
IF rOsmoticPressureDiff_bar > 1.0 THEN
    rConcentrationPolarizationIndex := 1.0 - (rEffectiveOsmoticPressure_bar / rOsmoticPressureDiff_bar);
    rConcentrationPolarizationIndex := LIMIT(0.0, rConcentrationPolarizationIndex, 1.0);
ELSE
    rConcentrationPolarizationIndex := 0.0;
END_IF;

(* Maximum Power Point Tracking (MPPT) optimal transmembrane pressure: DeltaP* = 0.5 * DeltaPi_eff *)
rOptimalOperatingPressure_bar := 0.50 * rEffectiveOsmoticPressure_bar;
IF rOptimalOperatingPressure_bar > 60.0 THEN
    rOptimalOperatingPressure_bar := 60.0; (* Mechanical limit of membrane module *)
END_IF;

(* Available Hydro-Mechanical Power at Turbine Shaft *)
(* P_hyd = (Q_m3h * DeltaP_bar) / 36 * eta [kW] *)
rNetHydroPower_kW := ((rFilt_TurbineFlow_m3h * (rFilt_TurbineInletPressure_bar - rPressure_TurbineOutlet_PT104_bar)) / 36.0) * rTurbineEfficiency;
IF rNetHydroPower_kW < 0.0 THEN rNetHydroPower_kW := 0.0; END_IF;

(* ========================================================================================= *)
(* STEP 6: DISCRETE KALMAN OBSERVER STATE UPDATE                                             *)
(* x_hat[k+1] = A_d * x_hat[k] + B_d * u[k] + L * (y[k] - C * x_hat[k])                      *)
(* ========================================================================================= *)
(* Compute Innovations (Measurement Residuals) *)
rResid_DeltaP := rDeltaP_Hydraulic_bar - rXhat_DeltaP_bar;
rResid_Flux   := rMembraneFlux_Jw_LMH  - rXhat_Flux_LMH;
rResid_CP     := rConcentrationPolarizationIndex - rXhat_CP_Index;
rResid_Speed  := rFilt_TurbineSpeed_rpm - rXhat_Speed_rpm;

(* Update State Estimate Vector *)
rXhat_DeltaP_bar := (A_11 * rXhat_DeltaP_bar) + (A_12 * rXhat_Flux_LMH) + (A_13 * rXhat_CP_Index) + (A_14 * rXhat_Speed_rpm) +
                    (B_11 * (rWicketGate_Internal_Pct / 100.0)) + (B_12 * (rShearPump_Internal_Pct / 100.0)) + (B_13 * (rBypassValve_Internal_Pct / 100.0)) +
                    (L_11 * rResid_DeltaP) + (L_12 * rResid_Flux) + (L_13 * rResid_CP) + (L_14 * rResid_Speed);

rXhat_Flux_LMH := (A_21 * rXhat_DeltaP_bar) + (A_22 * rXhat_Flux_LMH) + (A_23 * rXhat_CP_Index) + (A_24 * rXhat_Speed_rpm) +
                  (B_21 * (rWicketGate_Internal_Pct / 100.0)) + (B_22 * (rShearPump_Internal_Pct / 100.0)) + (B_23 * (rBypassValve_Internal_Pct / 100.0)) +
                  (L_21 * rResid_DeltaP) + (L_22 * rResid_Flux) + (L_23 * rResid_CP) + (L_24 * rResid_Speed);

rXhat_CP_Index := (A_31 * rXhat_DeltaP_bar) + (A_32 * rXhat_Flux_LMH) + (A_33 * rXhat_CP_Index) + (A_34 * rXhat_Speed_rpm) +
                  (B_31 * (rWicketGate_Internal_Pct / 100.0)) + (B_32 * (rShearPump_Internal_Pct / 100.0)) + (B_33 * (rBypassValve_Internal_Pct / 100.0)) +
                  (L_31 * rResid_DeltaP) + (L_32 * rResid_Flux) + (L_33 * rResid_CP) + (L_34 * rResid_Speed);

rXhat_Speed_rpm := (A_41 * rXhat_DeltaP_bar) + (A_42 * rXhat_Flux_LMH) + (A_43 * rXhat_CP_Index) + (A_44 * rXhat_Speed_rpm) +
                   (B_41 * (rWicketGate_Internal_Pct / 100.0)) + (B_42 * (rShearPump_Internal_Pct / 100.0)) + (B_43 * (rBypassValve_Internal_Pct / 100.0)) +
                   (L_41 * rResid_DeltaP) + (L_42 * rResid_Flux) + (L_43 * rResid_CP) + (L_44 * rResid_Speed);

(* Bound State Observer variables within physical limits *)
rXhat_DeltaP_bar := LIMIT(0.0, rXhat_DeltaP_bar, 75.0);
rXhat_Flux_LMH   := LIMIT(0.0, rXhat_Flux_LMH, 50.0);
rXhat_CP_Index   := LIMIT(0.0, rXhat_CP_Index, 1.0);
rXhat_Speed_rpm  := LIMIT(0.0, rXhat_Speed_rpm, 4500.0);

(* ========================================================================================= *)
(* STEP 7: DYNAMIC CONCENTRATION POLARIZATION SUPPRESSION (SHEAR PULSER)                     *)
(* Periodic turbulent flush or event-triggered flush when CP index > threshold              *)
(* ========================================================================================= *)
tShearCycleTimer(IN := NOT bShearPulseTriggerCondition AND (iState = STATE_STEADY_STATE_MPC_RUN), PT := C_SHEAR_CYCLE_PERIOD);

IF tShearCycleTimer.Q OR (rXhat_CP_Index >= rCP_Threshold_Severe) THEN
    bShearPulseTriggerCondition := TRUE;
END_IF;

tShearBurstDurationTimer(IN := bShearPulseTriggerCondition, PT := C_SHEAR_BURST_TIME);
IF tShearBurstDurationTimer.Q THEN
    bShearPulseTriggerCondition := FALSE;
END_IF;

bShearPulseActive := bShearPulseTriggerCondition;

(* ========================================================================================= *)
(* STEP 8: MODEL PREDICTIVE CONTROL (MPC) RECURSIVE OPTIMIZER                                *)
(* Evaluates optimal actuator vector minimizing multi-objective quadratic cost               *)
(* ========================================================================================= *)
IF (iState = STATE_STEADY_STATE_MPC_RUN) OR (iState = STATE_DEGRADED_FAILSOFT_RUN) THEN
    (* 1. Hydro-Turbine Speed & Pressure Error Formulation *)
    rTempCalc := 3000.0 - rFilt_TurbineSpeed_rpm; (* 3000 rpm grid synchronization reference *)
    
    (* Wicket gate command synthesized from speed error and optimal pressure tracking *)
    rMPC_WicketGate_Target_Pct := 50.0 + (0.045 * rTempCalc) + 
                                  (1.25 * (rFilt_DrawPressure_bar - rOptimalOperatingPressure_bar));
    
    (* If degraded mode active, cap wicket gate demand to 75% *)
    IF bAlarm_DegradedMode1oo2 THEN
        rMPC_WicketGate_Target_Pct := LIMIT(15.0, rMPC_WicketGate_Target_Pct, 75.0);
    ELSE
        rMPC_WicketGate_Target_Pct := LIMIT(10.0, rMPC_WicketGate_Target_Pct, 95.0);
    END_IF;

    (* 2. Concentration Polarization Suppression Shear Booster Pump *)
    IF bShearPulseActive THEN
        (* Maximum turbulence burst to scrub boundary layer *)
        rMPC_ShearPump_Target_Pct := 100.0;
    ELSE
        (* Proportional-Integral baseline tracking of CP index *)
        rMPC_ShearPump_Target_Pct := 40.0 + (C_MPC_Q_CP * (rXhat_CP_Index - rCP_Threshold_Nominal) * 100.0);
        rMPC_ShearPump_Target_Pct := LIMIT(30.0, rMPC_ShearPump_Target_Pct, 85.0);
    END_IF;

    (* 3. High-Pressure Bypass Relief Valve *)
    (* Normally closed; opens dynamically to bleed pressure if overpressure or overspeed threatens *)
    IF rFilt_DrawPressure_bar > 58.0 THEN
        rMPC_Bypass_Target_Pct := (rFilt_DrawPressure_bar - 58.0) * 12.5; (* Fast linear relief *)
    ELSIF rFilt_TurbineSpeed_rpm > 3150.0 THEN
        rMPC_Bypass_Target_Pct := (rFilt_TurbineSpeed_rpm - 3150.0) * 0.15;
    ELSE
        rMPC_Bypass_Target_Pct := 0.0;
    END_IF;
    rMPC_Bypass_Target_Pct := LIMIT(0.0, rMPC_Bypass_Target_Pct, 100.0);
END_IF;

(* ========================================================================================= *)
(* STEP 9: MULTI-STAGE FINITE STATE MACHINE (ISA-88 HIERARCHY)                               *)
(* ========================================================================================= *)
CASE iState OF

    STATE_IDLE_SAFE_ISOLATION: (* State 0: Safe De-energized Standby *)
        bSystemReady := FALSE;
        bSystemRunning := FALSE;
        rWicketGate_Internal_Pct := 0.0;
        rBypassValve_Internal_Pct := 0.0;
        rShearPump_Internal_Pct := 0.0;
        rFeedBoosterPump_Flow_Cmd_m3h := 0.0;
        wTurbineStateWord := 16#0001;

        IF bEnable AND NOT bTripAlarm AND (iPT101_HealthyCount >= 2) AND (iST501_HealthyCount >= 2) THEN
            iState := STATE_PREFLIGHT_DIAGNOSTICS;
        END_IF;

    STATE_PREFLIGHT_DIAGNOSTICS: (* State 10: TMR Sensor Validation & Baseline Water Quality *)
        bSystemReady := FALSE;
        bSystemRunning := FALSE;
        wTurbineStateWord := 16#0002;

        (* Check adequate salinity gradient between feed and draw streams *)
        IF (rConductivity_Draw_AT302_mScm >= 35.0) AND (rConductivity_Feed_AT301_mScm <= 6.0) AND
           (tStateDuration >= T#3S) THEN
            iState := STATE_MEMBRANE_SLOW_PRIMING;
        ELSIF tStateDuration > T#10S THEN
            (* Diagnostic Timeout - Abort *)
            bAlarm_LowDrawSalinity := (rConductivity_Draw_AT302_mScm < 35.0);
            bAlarm_HighFeedSalinity := (rConductivity_Feed_AT301_mScm > 6.0);
            iState := STATE_IDLE_SAFE_ISOLATION;
        END_IF;

    STATE_MEMBRANE_SLOW_PRIMING: (* State 20: Gentle feed flooding and air de-aeration *)
        bSystemReady := FALSE;
        bSystemRunning := FALSE;
        wTurbineStateWord := 16#0004;

        (* Ramp feed pump flow gently to displace air bubbles *)
        rFeedBoosterPump_Flow_Cmd_m3h := 35.0;
        rShearPump_Internal_Pct := 25.0;
        rBypassValve_Internal_Pct := 100.0; (* Full open bypass to avoid premature pressure spike *)
        rWicketGate_Internal_Pct := 0.0;

        IF (rFilt_FeedFlow_m3h >= 30.0) AND (rFilt_FeedPressure_bar >= 1.2) AND (tStateDuration >= T#15S) THEN
            iState := STATE_DRAW_PRESSURIZATION;
        END_IF;

    STATE_DRAW_PRESSURIZATION: (* State 30: Permeation buildup & Isobaric Pressurization *)
        bSystemReady := TRUE;
        bSystemRunning := FALSE;
        wTurbineStateWord := 16#0008;

        rFeedBoosterPump_Flow_Cmd_m3h := 60.0;
        rShearPump_Internal_Pct := 45.0;

        (* Gently ramp bypass valve down to build manifold pressure *)
        IF rBypassValve_Internal_Pct > 20.0 THEN
            rBypassValve_Internal_Pct := rBypassValve_Internal_Pct - (rActuatorCycleSlew_Pct * 2.0);
        END_IF;

        IF (rFilt_DrawPressure_bar >= 25.0) AND (rMembraneFlux_Jw_LMH >= 8.0) AND (tStateDuration >= T#20S) THEN
            iState := STATE_TURBINE_RUNUP_SYNCH;
        END_IF;

    STATE_TURBINE_RUNUP_SYNCH: (* State 40: Turbine Acceleration to Grid Synchronous Speed *)
        bSystemReady := TRUE;
        bSystemRunning := TRUE;
        wTurbineStateWord := 16#0010;

        (* Gradually crack open wicket gate to spin up turbine *)
        IF rWicketGate_Internal_Pct < 35.0 THEN
            rWicketGate_Internal_Pct := rWicketGate_Internal_Pct + rActuatorCycleSlew_Pct;
        END_IF;

        (* Modulate bypass to maintain constant backpressure while accelerating *)
        IF rFilt_TurbineSpeed_rpm < 2850.0 THEN
            rBypassValve_Internal_Pct := LIMIT(5.0, 50.0 - (rFilt_TurbineSpeed_rpm * 0.015), 50.0);
        ELSE
            rBypassValve_Internal_Pct := 0.0;
        END_IF;

        (* Check for grid intertie synchronization breaker *)
        IF bGridSynchronized AND (rFilt_TurbineSpeed_rpm >= 2950.0) AND (rFilt_TurbineSpeed_rpm <= 3050.0) THEN
            iState := STATE_STEADY_STATE_MPC_RUN;
        END_IF;

    STATE_STEADY_STATE_MPC_RUN: (* State 50: Closed-Loop Model Predictive Power Extraction *)
        bSystemReady := TRUE;
        bSystemRunning := TRUE;
        wTurbineStateWord := 16#0020;

        rFeedBoosterPump_Flow_Cmd_m3h := 110.0;

        (* Smooth rate-of-change governed actuator transfer from MPC targets *)
        IF rWicketGate_Internal_Pct < rMPC_WicketGate_Target_Pct THEN
            rWicketGate_Internal_Pct := MIN(rMPC_WicketGate_Target_Pct, rWicketGate_Internal_Pct + rActuatorCycleSlew_Pct);
        ELSE
            rWicketGate_Internal_Pct := MAX(rMPC_WicketGate_Target_Pct, rWicketGate_Internal_Pct - rActuatorCycleSlew_Pct);
        END_IF;

        IF rBypassValve_Internal_Pct < rMPC_Bypass_Target_Pct THEN
            rBypassValve_Internal_Pct := MIN(rMPC_Bypass_Target_Pct, rBypassValve_Internal_Pct + (rActuatorCycleSlew_Pct * 3.0));
        ELSE
            rBypassValve_Internal_Pct := MAX(rMPC_Bypass_Target_Pct, rBypassValve_Internal_Pct - rActuatorCycleSlew_Pct);
        END_IF;

        rShearPump_Internal_Pct := rMPC_ShearPump_Target_Pct;

        (* Intertie trip supervisor *)
        IF NOT bGridSynchronized THEN
            bAlarm_GridLossOnLoad := TRUE;
            iState := STATE_HYDRAULIC_SURGE_DUMP;
        ELSIF bAlarm_DegradedMode1oo2 THEN
            iState := STATE_DEGRADED_FAILSOFT_RUN;
        ELSIF NOT bEnable THEN
            iState := STATE_CONTROLLED_COASTDOWN;
        END_IF;

    STATE_DEGRADED_FAILSOFT_RUN: (* State 70: Fault-Tolerant Single Channel Fallback *)
        bSystemReady := TRUE;
        bSystemRunning := TRUE;
        bDegradedOperation := TRUE;
        wTurbineStateWord := 16#0040;

        (* Plant operating with single sensor channel; run with derated power limits *)
        rFeedBoosterPump_Flow_Cmd_m3h := 85.0;
        
        IF rWicketGate_Internal_Pct > 65.0 THEN
            rWicketGate_Internal_Pct := rWicketGate_Internal_Pct - rActuatorCycleSlew_Pct;
        ELSE
            rWicketGate_Internal_Pct := LIMIT(15.0, rMPC_WicketGate_Target_Pct, 65.0);
        END_IF;

        rBypassValve_Internal_Pct := rMPC_Bypass_Target_Pct;
        rShearPump_Internal_Pct := rMPC_ShearPump_Target_Pct;

        IF NOT bEnable THEN
            iState := STATE_CONTROLLED_COASTDOWN;
        ELSIF NOT bGridSynchronized THEN
            iState := STATE_HYDRAULIC_SURGE_DUMP;
        END_IF;

    STATE_HYDRAULIC_SURGE_DUMP: (* State 80: Emergency Water Hammer Relief on Generator Trip *)
        bSystemReady := FALSE;
        bSystemRunning := FALSE;
        wTurbineStateWord := 16#0080;

        (* Anti-Surge Fast Open on Bypass Valve (absorbs water column momentum) *)
        rBypassValve_Internal_Pct := 100.0;

        (* Controlled Fast Close on Wicket Gate to avoid runaway overspeed *)
        IF rWicketGate_Internal_Pct > 0.0 THEN
            rWicketGate_Internal_Pct := MAX(0.0, rWicketGate_Internal_Pct - (C_EMERGENCY_WICKET_CLOSE_RATE * 0.020));
        END_IF;

        rShearPump_Internal_Pct := 20.0;
        rFeedBoosterPump_Flow_Cmd_m3h := 20.0;

        IF (rWicketGate_Internal_Pct <= 0.0) AND (rFilt_TurbineSpeed_rpm < 300.0) THEN
            iState := STATE_IDLE_SAFE_ISOLATION;
        END_IF;

    STATE_CONTROLLED_COASTDOWN: (* State 90: Orderly Plant Shutdown *)
        bSystemReady := FALSE;
        bSystemRunning := FALSE;
        wTurbineStateWord := 16#0100;

        (* Gently bleed pressure by cracking bypass, closing wicket gate *)
        IF rBypassValve_Internal_Pct < 50.0 THEN
            rBypassValve_Internal_Pct := rBypassValve_Internal_Pct + rActuatorCycleSlew_Pct;
        END_IF;

        IF rWicketGate_Internal_Pct > 0.0 THEN
            rWicketGate_Internal_Pct := MAX(0.0, rWicketGate_Internal_Pct - rActuatorCycleSlew_Pct);
        END_IF;

        IF rShearPump_Internal_Pct > 0.0 THEN
            rShearPump_Internal_Pct := MAX(0.0, rShearPump_Internal_Pct - (rActuatorCycleSlew_Pct * 2.0));
        END_IF;

        IF rFeedBoosterPump_Flow_Cmd_m3h > 0.0 THEN
            rFeedBoosterPump_Flow_Cmd_m3h := MAX(0.0, rFeedBoosterPump_Flow_Cmd_m3h - 1.0);
        END_IF;

        IF (rWicketGate_Internal_Pct <= 0.0) AND (rFilt_TurbineSpeed_rpm <= 100.0) AND (rFilt_DrawPressure_bar <= 2.0) THEN
            iState := STATE_IDLE_SAFE_ISOLATION;
        END_IF;

    STATE_LATCHED_EMERGENCY_TRIP: (* State 99: Master Hardware Lockout *)
        bSystemReady := FALSE;
        bSystemRunning := FALSE;
        wTurbineStateWord := 16#8000;

        (* Immediate Fail-Safe Actuator Positions *)
        rWicketGate_Internal_Pct := 0.0;      (* Direct spring return shut *)
        rBypassValve_Internal_Pct := 100.0;   (* Full open depressurization *)
        rShearPump_Internal_Pct := 0.0;       (* De-energize VFD *)
        rFeedBoosterPump_Flow_Cmd_m3h := 0.0; (* Trip feed pump *)

        IF bResetAlarms AND bEmergencyStop AND (rFilt_TurbineSpeed_rpm < 50.0) THEN
            bTripAlarm := FALSE;
            bAlarm_EStopTripped := FALSE;
            bAlarm_MembraneOverpressure_HH := FALSE;
            bAlarm_TurbineOverspeed_HH := FALSE;
            bAlarm_LowFeedFlow_LL := FALSE;
            bAlarm_BearingTemp_HH := FALSE;
            bAlarm_TurbineVibration_HH := FALSE;
            bAlarm_WaterHammerShock := FALSE;
            bAlarm_GridLossOnLoad := FALSE;
            iState := STATE_IDLE_SAFE_ISOLATION;
        END_IF;

END_CASE;

(* ========================================================================================= *)
(* STEP 10: ALARM TRIP SUPERVISION & TIME-QUALIFIED INTERLOCK EVALUATION                     *)
(* ========================================================================================= *)
(* Membrane Overpressure High-High: 65.0 bar *)
tOverpressureTripTimer(IN := (rFilt_DrawPressure_bar >= 65.0), PT := T#200MS);
IF tOverpressureTripTimer.Q THEN
    bAlarm_MembraneOverpressure_HH := TRUE;
    bTripAlarm := TRUE;
    iState := STATE_LATCHED_EMERGENCY_TRIP;
END_IF;

(* ============================================================================================= *)
(* 1.0 EMERGENCY SAFETY SHUTDOWN & SIL-3 HARDWIRED INTERLOCK EVALUATION                          *)
(* ============================================================================================= *)
(* Reset trip latch registers *)
bInterlockShutdown := FALSE;
dwAlarmWord1 := 16#0000_0000;
rHydraulicDumpValve_FastOpen := FALSE;

(* Interlock 1.1: Active-low Emergency Shutdown Relay (SIL-3 Hardwired Circuit) *)
IF NOT bEmergencyStop THEN
    dwAlarmWord1 := dwAlarmWord1 OR 16#0000_0001; (* Bit 0: E-Stop Activated *)
    bInterlockShutdown := TRUE;
END_IF;

(* Interlock 1.2: System Enable Master Permissive Lost *)
IF NOT bEnable THEN
    dwAlarmWord1 := dwAlarmWord1 OR 16#0000_0002; (* Bit 1: Master Enable Permissive Dropped *)
    bInterlockShutdown := TRUE;
END_IF;

(* Interlock 1.3: Catastrophic Mechanical Roll Collision Guard (Gap < 25.0 um under high force) *)
IF ((rNipGapSensor_OS_A_um < c_MinPermissibleNipGap_um) OR 
    (rNipGapSensor_DS_A_um < c_MinPermissibleNipGap_um)) AND 
   ((rCylinderForce_OS_kN + rCylinderForce_DS_kN) > 500.0) THEN
    dwAlarmWord1 := dwAlarmWord1 OR 16#0000_0004; (* Bit 2: Critical Mechanical Nip Collision Imminent *)
    bInterlockShutdown := TRUE;
END_IF;

(* Interlock 1.4: Extreme Separating Force Overload (Load > 3600.0 kN - Frame Yield Hazard) *)
IF (rCylinderForce_OS_kN + rCylinderForce_DS_kN) > c_MaxLineSeparatingForce_kN THEN
    dwAlarmWord1 := dwAlarmWord1 OR 16#0000_0008; (* Bit 3: Extreme Mill Structural Separating Overload *)
    bInterlockShutdown := TRUE;
END_IF;

(* Interlock 1.5: Hydraulic Main Header Depressurization (< 160.0 bar while in high-load nip) *)
IF (rHydraulicSupplyPress_bar < 160.0) AND (iState >= 60) THEN
    dwAlarmWord1 := dwAlarmWord1 OR 16#0000_0010; (* Bit 4: Main Hydraulic Supply Collapse *)
    bInterlockShutdown := TRUE;
END_IF;

(* Interlock 1.6: Induction Roll Surface Thermal Runaway (> 205.0 deg C - PTFE Degradation Hazard) *)
IF (rRollSurfaceTemp_Center_DegC > 205.0) OR 
   (rRollSurfaceTemp_OS_Edge_DegC > 205.0) OR 
   (rRollSurfaceTemp_DS_Edge_DegC > 205.0) THEN
    dwAlarmWord1 := dwAlarmWord1 OR 16#0000_0020; (* Bit 5: Induction Roll Extreme Thermal Runaway *)
    bInterlockShutdown := TRUE;
END_IF;

(* Interlock 1.7: Roll Chock Bearing Overtemperature (> 85.0 deg C - Bearing Seizure Hazard) *)
IF (rChockBearingTemp_OS_DegC > 85.0) OR (rChockBearingTemp_DS_DegC > 85.0) THEN
    dwAlarmWord1 := dwAlarmWord1 OR 16#0000_0040; (* Bit 6: Roll Chock Journal Bearing Overheat *)
    bInterlockShutdown := TRUE;
END_IF;

(* Interlock 1.8: Excessive Lateral Wedge Taper Deviation (|OS Gap - DS Gap| > 25.0 um under nip) *)
IF (ABS(rNipGapSensor_OS_A_um - rNipGapSensor_DS_A_um) > 25.0) AND (iState >= 60) THEN
    dwAlarmWord1 := dwAlarmWord1 OR 16#0000_0080; (* Bit 7: Excessive Nip Wedge Taper Jamming Hazard *)
    bInterlockShutdown := TRUE;
END_IF;

(* Interlock 1.9: Web Snap / Rupture Under Tension (Tension < 15.0 N while running > 5 m/min) *)
IF (rWebTension_Infeed_N < 15.0) AND (rWebSpeed_mpm > 5.0) AND (iState >= 60) THEN
    dwAlarmWord1 := dwAlarmWord1 OR 16#0000_0100; (* Bit 8: Infeed Electrode Web Snap Detected *)
    bInterlockShutdown := TRUE;
END_IF;

(* Interlock 1.10: Extreme Roll Bending Circuit Overpressure (> 320.0 bar) *)
IF (rBendingPressure_Pos_bar > 320.0) OR (rBendingPressure_Neg_bar > 320.0) THEN
    dwAlarmWord1 := dwAlarmWord1 OR 16#0000_0200; (* Bit 9: Roll Bending Hydraulic Overpressure *)
    bInterlockShutdown := TRUE;
END_IF;

(* Execute immediate emergency de-energization if any SIL-3 interlock condition tripped *)
IF bInterlockShutdown THEN
    bMajorFault := TRUE;
    bSystemReady := FALSE;
    bCalenderInNip := FALSE;
    rHydraulicDumpValve_FastOpen := TRUE;   (* Energize dump cartridge to instantaneously open rolls *)
    rServoValve_OS_pct := -100.0;           (* Retract OS cylinder at maximum slew rate *)
    rServoValve_DS_pct := -100.0;           (* Retract DS cylinder at maximum slew rate *)
    rRollBendingValve_pct := 0.0;           (* Depressurize roll bending jacks *)
    rInductionPowerZone1_pct := 0.0;        (* Cut induction generator zone 1 *)
    rInductionPowerZone2_pct := 0.0;        (* Cut induction generator zone 2 *)
    rInductionPowerZone3_pct := 0.0;        (* Cut induction generator zone 3 *)
    rWebTensionDrivesTrim_rpm := 0.0;
    iState := 100;                          (* Force transition directly to FAULT_RETRACT state *)
END_IF;
(* ============================================================================================= *)
(* 2.0 TRIPLE MODULAR REDUNDANCY (2oo3) SENSOR VOTING ALGORITHMS                                 *)
(* ============================================================================================= *)
(* Diagnostic warning register clear *)
dwAlarmWord2 := 16#0000_0000;
bWarningActive := FALSE;

(* --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* 2.1 Operator Side (OS) Nip Gap Sensor Voting Bank (Sensors OS_A, OS_B, OS_C)                  *)
(* --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
rGap_OS_Dev_AB_um := ABS(rNipGapSensor_OS_A_um - rNipGapSensor_OS_B_um);
rGap_OS_Dev_BC_um := ABS(rNipGapSensor_OS_B_um - rNipGapSensor_OS_C_um);
rGap_OS_Dev_CA_um := ABS(rNipGapSensor_OS_C_um - rNipGapSensor_OS_A_um);

bGap_OS_SensorFault_A := (rNipGapSensor_OS_A_um < 5.0) OR (rNipGapSensor_OS_A_um > 500.0) OR 
                         ((rGap_OS_Dev_AB_um > 2.5) AND (rGap_OS_Dev_CA_um > 2.5));
bGap_OS_SensorFault_B := (rNipGapSensor_OS_B_um < 5.0) OR (rNipGapSensor_OS_B_um > 500.0) OR 
                         ((rGap_OS_Dev_AB_um > 2.5) AND (rGap_OS_Dev_BC_um > 2.5));
bGap_OS_SensorFault_C := (rNipGapSensor_OS_C_um < 5.0) OR (rNipGapSensor_OS_C_um > 500.0) OR 
                         ((rGap_OS_Dev_BC_um > 2.5) AND (rGap_OS_Dev_CA_um > 2.5));

iGap_OS_HealthyCount := 3;
IF bGap_OS_SensorFault_A THEN iGap_OS_HealthyCount := iGap_OS_HealthyCount - 1; END_IF;
IF bGap_OS_SensorFault_B THEN iGap_OS_HealthyCount := iGap_OS_HealthyCount - 1; END_IF;
IF bGap_OS_SensorFault_C THEN iGap_OS_HealthyCount := iGap_OS_HealthyCount - 1; END_IF;

IF iGap_OS_HealthyCount = 3 THEN
    (* Standard 2oo3 Median Selection Algorithm *)
    IF ((rNipGapSensor_OS_A_um >= rNipGapSensor_OS_B_um) AND (rNipGapSensor_OS_A_um <= rNipGapSensor_OS_C_um)) OR 
       ((rNipGapSensor_OS_A_um >= rNipGapSensor_OS_C_um) AND (rNipGapSensor_OS_A_um <= rNipGapSensor_OS_B_um)) THEN
        rVotedGap_OS_um := rNipGapSensor_OS_A_um;
    ELSIF ((rNipGapSensor_OS_B_um >= rNipGapSensor_OS_A_um) AND (rNipGapSensor_OS_B_um <= rNipGapSensor_OS_C_um)) OR 
          ((rNipGapSensor_OS_B_um >= rNipGapSensor_OS_C_um) AND (rNipGapSensor_OS_B_um <= rNipGapSensor_OS_A_um)) THEN
        rVotedGap_OS_um := rNipGapSensor_OS_B_um;
    ELSE
        rVotedGap_OS_um := rNipGapSensor_OS_C_um;
    END_IF;
    bGracefulDegradeGapOS := FALSE;
ELSIF iGap_OS_HealthyCount = 2 THEN
    (* Degraded 1oo2 Average of the two surviving healthy channels *)
    IF NOT bGap_OS_SensorFault_A AND NOT bGap_OS_SensorFault_B THEN
        rVotedGap_OS_um := (rNipGapSensor_OS_A_um + rNipGapSensor_OS_B_um) * 0.50;
    ELSIF NOT bGap_OS_SensorFault_B AND NOT bGap_OS_SensorFault_C THEN
        rVotedGap_OS_um := (rNipGapSensor_OS_B_um + rNipGapSensor_OS_C_um) * 0.50;
    ELSE
        rVotedGap_OS_um := (rNipGapSensor_OS_A_um + rNipGapSensor_OS_C_um) * 0.50;
    END_IF;
    bGracefulDegradeGapOS := TRUE;
    dwAlarmWord2 := dwAlarmWord2 OR 16#0000_0001; (* Warning: OS Gap Sensor Degraded to 1oo2 *)
    bWarningActive := TRUE;
ELSIF iGap_OS_HealthyCount = 1 THEN
    (* Single surviving channel fallback *)
    IF NOT bGap_OS_SensorFault_A THEN rVotedGap_OS_um := rNipGapSensor_OS_A_um;
    ELSIF NOT bGap_OS_SensorFault_B THEN rVotedGap_OS_um := rNipGapSensor_OS_B_um;
    ELSE rVotedGap_OS_um := rNipGapSensor_OS_C_um;
    END_IF;
    bGracefulDegradeGapOS := TRUE;
    dwAlarmWord2 := dwAlarmWord2 OR 16#0000_0002; (* Warning: OS Gap Sensor Degraded to Single Channel *)
    bWarningActive := TRUE;
ELSE
    (* Total voting bank failure: Trip immediately *)
    dwAlarmWord1 := dwAlarmWord1 OR 16#0000_0400; (* Trip: All OS Gap Sensors Failed *)
    bMajorFault := TRUE;
    iState := 100;
END_IF;

(* --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* 2.2 Drive Side (DS) Nip Gap Sensor Voting Bank (Sensors DS_A, DS_B, DS_C)                     *)
(* --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
rGap_DS_Dev_AB_um := ABS(rNipGapSensor_DS_A_um - rNipGapSensor_DS_B_um);
rGap_DS_Dev_BC_um := ABS(rNipGapSensor_DS_B_um - rNipGapSensor_DS_C_um);
rGap_DS_Dev_CA_um := ABS(rNipGapSensor_DS_C_um - rNipGapSensor_DS_A_um);

bGap_DS_SensorFault_A := (rNipGapSensor_DS_A_um < 5.0) OR (rNipGapSensor_DS_A_um > 500.0) OR 
                         ((rGap_DS_Dev_AB_um > 2.5) AND (rGap_DS_Dev_CA_um > 2.5));
bGap_DS_SensorFault_B := (rNipGapSensor_DS_B_um < 5.0) OR (rNipGapSensor_DS_B_um > 500.0) OR 
                         ((rGap_DS_Dev_AB_um > 2.5) AND (rGap_DS_Dev_BC_um > 2.5));
bGap_DS_SensorFault_C := (rNipGapSensor_DS_C_um < 5.0) OR (rNipGapSensor_DS_C_um > 500.0) OR 
                         ((rGap_DS_Dev_BC_um > 2.5) AND (rGap_DS_Dev_CA_um > 2.5));

iGap_DS_HealthyCount := 3;
IF bGap_DS_SensorFault_A THEN iGap_DS_HealthyCount := iGap_DS_HealthyCount - 1; END_IF;
IF bGap_DS_SensorFault_B THEN iGap_DS_HealthyCount := iGap_DS_HealthyCount - 1; END_IF;
IF bGap_DS_SensorFault_C THEN iGap_DS_HealthyCount := iGap_DS_HealthyCount - 1; END_IF;

IF iGap_DS_HealthyCount = 3 THEN
    IF ((rNipGapSensor_DS_A_um >= rNipGapSensor_DS_B_um) AND (rNipGapSensor_DS_A_um <= rNipGapSensor_DS_C_um)) OR 
       ((rNipGapSensor_DS_A_um >= rNipGapSensor_DS_C_um) AND (rNipGapSensor_DS_A_um <= rNipGapSensor_DS_B_um)) THEN
        rVotedGap_DS_um := rNipGapSensor_DS_A_um;
    ELSIF ((rNipGapSensor_DS_B_um >= rNipGapSensor_DS_A_um) AND (rNipGapSensor_DS_B_um <= rNipGapSensor_DS_C_um)) OR 
          ((rNipGapSensor_DS_B_um >= rNipGapSensor_DS_C_um) AND (rNipGapSensor_DS_B_um <= rNipGapSensor_DS_A_um)) THEN
        rVotedGap_DS_um := rNipGapSensor_DS_B_um;
    ELSE
        rVotedGap_DS_um := rNipGapSensor_DS_C_um;
    END_IF;
    bGracefulDegradeGapDS := FALSE;
ELSIF iGap_DS_HealthyCount = 2 THEN
    IF NOT bGap_DS_SensorFault_A AND NOT bGap_DS_SensorFault_B THEN
        rVotedGap_DS_um := (rNipGapSensor_DS_A_um + rNipGapSensor_DS_B_um) * 0.50;
    ELSIF NOT bGap_DS_SensorFault_B AND NOT bGap_DS_SensorFault_C THEN
        rVotedGap_DS_um := (rNipGapSensor_DS_B_um + rNipGapSensor_DS_C_um) * 0.50;
    ELSE
        rVotedGap_DS_um := (rNipGapSensor_DS_A_um + rNipGapSensor_DS_C_um) * 0.50;
    END_IF;
    bGracefulDegradeGapDS := TRUE;
    dwAlarmWord2 := dwAlarmWord2 OR 16#0000_0004; (* Warning: DS Gap Sensor Degraded to 1oo2 *)
    bWarningActive := TRUE;
ELSIF iGap_DS_HealthyCount = 1 THEN
    IF NOT bGap_DS_SensorFault_A THEN rVotedGap_DS_um := rNipGapSensor_DS_A_um;
    ELSIF NOT bGap_DS_SensorFault_B THEN rVotedGap_DS_um := rNipGapSensor_DS_B_um;
    ELSE rVotedGap_DS_um := rNipGapSensor_DS_C_um;
    END_IF;
    bGracefulDegradeGapDS := TRUE;
    dwAlarmWord2 := dwAlarmWord2 OR 16#0000_0008; (* Warning: DS Gap Sensor Degraded to Single Channel *)
    bWarningActive := TRUE;
ELSE
    dwAlarmWord1 := dwAlarmWord1 OR 16#0000_0800; (* Trip: All DS Gap Sensors Failed *)
    bMajorFault := TRUE;
    iState := 100;
END_IF;

(* --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* 2.3 Hydraulic Main Cylinder Pressure Transducers Plausibility Evaluation                      *)
(* --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
IF ABS(rMainCylinderPress_OS_A_bar - rMainCylinderPress_OS_B_bar) > 12.0 THEN
    bPress_OS_Discrepancy := TRUE;
    rVotedMainPress_OS_bar := MAX(rMainCylinderPress_OS_A_bar, rMainCylinderPress_OS_B_bar); (* Failsafe high *)
    dwAlarmWord2 := dwAlarmWord2 OR 16#0000_0010; (* Warning: OS Cylinder Pressure Discrepancy *)
    bWarningActive := TRUE;
ELSE
    bPress_OS_Discrepancy := FALSE;
    rVotedMainPress_OS_bar := (rMainCylinderPress_OS_A_bar + rMainCylinderPress_OS_B_bar) * 0.50;
END_IF;

IF ABS(rMainCylinderPress_DS_A_bar - rMainCylinderPress_DS_B_bar) > 12.0 THEN
    bPress_DS_Discrepancy := TRUE;
    rVotedMainPress_DS_bar := MAX(rMainCylinderPress_DS_A_bar, rMainCylinderPress_DS_B_bar); (* Failsafe high *)
    dwAlarmWord2 := dwAlarmWord2 OR 16#0000_0020; (* Warning: DS Cylinder Pressure Discrepancy *)
    bWarningActive := TRUE;
ELSE
    bPress_DS_Discrepancy := FALSE;
    rVotedMainPress_DS_bar := (rMainCylinderPress_DS_A_bar + rMainCylinderPress_DS_B_bar) * 0.50;
END_IF;
(* ============================================================================================= *)
(* 3.0 INDUCTION ROLL THERMAL EXPANSION CROWN ESTIMATION & TIMOSHENKO BEAM BENDING               *)
(* ============================================================================================= *)
(* --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* 3.1 Digital Low-Pass Filtering of Induction Pyrometer Array                                   *)
(* --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
rFilteredTempCenter_DegC := rFilteredTempCenter_DegC + 
    rThermalFilterAlpha * (rRollSurfaceTemp_Center_DegC - rFilteredTempCenter_DegC);
rFilteredTempOS_DegC := rFilteredTempOS_DegC + 
    rThermalFilterAlpha * (rRollSurfaceTemp_OS_Edge_DegC - rFilteredTempOS_DegC);
rFilteredTempDS_DegC := rFilteredTempDS_DegC + 
    rThermalFilterAlpha * (rRollSurfaceTemp_DS_Edge_DegC - rFilteredTempDS_DegC);

(* Calculate axial differential temperature gradient (center crown vs edge heat sink) *)
rAxialThermalGradient_DegC := rFilteredTempCenter_DegC - ((rFilteredTempOS_DegC + rFilteredTempDS_DegC) * 0.50);

(* --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* 3.2 Dynamic 2D Thermo-Elastic Expansion Model                                                 *)
(* Radial expansion at any axial coordinate z: delta_R(z) = R_0 * alpha * (T(z) - T_ambient)     *)
(* Center-to-edge differential thermal crown: Delta_Crown_therm = delta_R(0) - delta_R(L/2)      *)
(* --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
rThermalCenterRadiusGrowth_um := c_RollRadius_um * c_RollSteelThermalExp_perK * 
                                 (rFilteredTempCenter_DegC - rAmbientTemp_DegC);
rThermalEdgeRadiusGrowth_um   := c_RollRadius_um * c_RollSteelThermalExp_perK * 
                                 (((rFilteredTempOS_DegC + rFilteredTempDS_DegC) * 0.50) - rAmbientTemp_DegC);

(* Net differential thermal crown expanding into the nip gap at roll center [um] *)
rThermalExpansionCrownModel_um := rThermalCenterRadiusGrowth_um - rThermalEdgeRadiusGrowth_um;
rThermalExpansionCrown_um      := rThermalExpansionCrownModel_um;

(* --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* 3.3 Elastic Beam Deflection Mechanics (Timoshenko Fourth-Order Equation)                      *)
(* Roll barrel behaves as an elastic cylindrical beam under line load q [N/mm]                   *)
(* Line load q = TotalForce / StripWidth                                                         *)
(* Sag deflection at roll centerline: w_sag = (5 * q * L^4) / (384 * E * I)                      *)
(* --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
rTotalSeparatingForce_kN := rCylinderForce_OS_kN + rCylinderForce_DS_kN;

IF rStripWidth_mm > 100.0 THEN
    rDynamicLineLoad_Nmm := (rTotalSeparatingForce_kN * 1000.0) / rStripWidth_mm;
ELSE
    rDynamicLineLoad_Nmm := 0.0;
END_IF;

(* Pure mechanical beam bending center sag [um] calculated from line load and steel inertia *)
(* Empirical conversion factor tuned for 750 mm dia x 1100 mm barrel roll: 0.0142 um / (N/mm) *)
rCalculatedElasticDeflect_um := rDynamicLineLoad_Nmm * 0.01425;

(* Net required crown correction: Elastic beam bending tends to open center;                     *)
(* Thermal crown tends to pinch center. The hydraulic roll-bending system must supply the net!   *)
rNetRequiredCrownCorrection_um := rCalculatedElasticDeflect_um - (2.0 * rThermalExpansionCrown_um);
rActualRollBendingCrown_um     := (rBendingPressure_Pos_bar - rBendingPressure_Neg_bar) * 0.1250; (* [um/bar] *)

(* Target hydraulic roll bending pressure required to enforce uniform flat nip profile *)
rTargetBendingPressure_bar := 120.0 + (rNetRequiredCrownCorrection_um * 4.80);
rTargetBendingPressure_bar := LIMIT(20.0, rTargetBendingPressure_bar, 280.0);

(* Closed-loop Roll Bending PI Regulator *)
rBendingHydraulicError_bar := rTargetBendingPressure_bar - rBendingPressure_Pos_bar;
rBending_PID_Integ := rBending_PID_Integ + (rBendingHydraulicError_bar * 0.150 * c_CycleTime_s);
rBending_PID_Integ := LIMIT(-25.0, rBending_PID_Integ, 25.0);

rRollBendingValve_pct := (rBendingHydraulicError_bar * 1.85) + rBending_PID_Integ + (rTargetBendingPressure_bar * 0.22);
rRollBendingValve_pct := LIMIT(-100.0, rRollBendingValve_pct, 100.0);
(* ============================================================================================= *)
(* 4.0 WEB TENSION MICRO-OSCILLATION DECOUPLING & HARMONIC REJECTION                             *)
(* ============================================================================================= *)
(* --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* 4.1 Roll Rotational Frequency Calculation & Adaptive Resonant Tracking                        *)
(* Roll angular frequency: omega = v_web / R_roll; f_0 = v_web / (pi * D_roll)                  *)
(* For Dia 750 mm (circumference 2.356 m), at 60 m/min, f_0 = 0.424 Hz                           *)
(* --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
IF rWebSpeed_mpm > 0.50 THEN
    rRollRotationalFreq_Hz := (rWebSpeed_mpm / 60.0) / (3.14159265 * (c_RollDiameter_mm * 0.001));
ELSE
    rRollRotationalFreq_Hz := 0.01;
END_IF;

(* --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* 4.2 Second-Order Active Band-Stop Notch Filter on Infeed Web Tension Feedback                 *)
(* Eliminates periodic tension oscillations induced by roll eccentricity (TIR runout)            *)
(* State-space direct form II realization of resonant bandstop filter                            *)
(* --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
rTensionTrackingError_N := rTargetWebTension_N - rWebTension_Infeed_N;

(* Discrete resonant filter integrator updates *)
rTensionNotchState1 := rTensionNotchState1 + 
    c_CycleTime_s * (rTensionTrackingError_N - (6.28318 * rNotchFilterBandwidth_Hz * rTensionNotchState1) - 
    (39.4784 * rRollRotationalFreq_Hz * rRollRotationalFreq_Hz * rTensionNotchState2));
rTensionNotchState2 := rTensionNotchState2 + c_CycleTime_s * rTensionNotchState1;

rFilteredWebTension_N := rWebTension_Infeed_N + (rTensionNotchState1 * 0.350);

(* --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* 4.3 Web Tension PI Closed-Loop Regulator with Fast Feedforward Speed Decoupling               *)
(* --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
rTensionPid_Integral := rTensionPid_Integral + ((rTargetWebTension_N - rFilteredWebTension_N) * 0.080 * c_CycleTime_s);
rTensionPid_Integral := LIMIT(-15.0, rTensionPid_Integral, 15.0);

rTensionDecouplingSpeedTrim_rpm := ((rTargetWebTension_N - rFilteredWebTension_N) * 0.280) + 
                                   rTensionPid_Integral;
rTensionDecouplingSpeedTrim_rpm := LIMIT(-25.0, rTensionDecouplingSpeedTrim_rpm, 25.0);
rWebTensionDrivesTrim_rpm       := rTensionDecouplingSpeedTrim_rpm;
(* ============================================================================================= *)
(* 5.0 INLINE X-RAY AREAL DENSITY FEEDBACK & SMITH PREDICTOR (200 - 450 g/m2)                    *)
(* ============================================================================================= *)
(* --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* 5.1 Dynamic Transport Delay Calculation                                                       *)
(* transit_time tau_d = Distance / LineSpeed; dynamic ring buffer index = tau_d / CycleTime      *)
(* Distance = 3.850 m. At 30 m/min (0.5 m/s), tau_d = 7.7 s. Downsampled by factor of 100 ms.   *)
(* --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
IF rWebSpeed_mpm > 2.0 THEN
    rTempCalc1 := c_XRaySensorDistance_m / (rWebSpeed_mpm / 60.0); (* Transit delay in seconds *)
    iDynamicDelaySteps := REAL_TO_INT(rTempCalc1 * 10.0);          (* Delay buffer sampled at 100 ms *)
    iDynamicDelaySteps := LIMIT(2, iDynamicDelaySteps, 125);
ELSE
    iDynamicDelaySteps := 125;
END_IF;

(* --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* 5.2 Circular Ring Buffer FIFO Management for Smith Delay Compensation                         *)
(* --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
iDelayBufferWriteIndex := (iDelayBufferWriteIndex + 1) MOD 128;
rXRayDelayBuffer[iDelayBufferWriteIndex] := (rVotedGap_OS_um + rVotedGap_DS_um) * 0.50;

(* Retrieve delayed model gap estimate corresponding to the exact web slice at X-ray head *)
rTempCalc2 := INT_TO_REAL((iDelayBufferWriteIndex - iDynamicDelaySteps + 128) MOD 128);
rSmithDelayedNipGap_um := rXRayDelayBuffer[REAL_TO_INT(rTempCalc2)];
rSmithModelNipGap_um   := (rVotedGap_OS_um + rVotedGap_DS_um) * 0.50;

(* --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* 5.3 Dry Electrode Calendering Compacted Density & Bulk Porosity Estimation                    *)
(* Compacted Density rho_c [g/cm3] = ArealDensity [g/m2] / NipGap [um]                           *)
(* Bulk Porosity eps [%] = (1.0 - (rho_c / rho_theoretical)) * 100.0 %                          *)
(* --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
rActualMeanNipGap_um := ((rVotedGap_OS_um - rTareOffset_OS_um) + 
                         (rVotedGap_DS_um - rTareOffset_DS_um)) * 0.50;
rActualNipTaper_um   := (rVotedGap_OS_um - rTareOffset_OS_um) - 
                         (rVotedGap_DS_um - rTareOffset_DS_um);

IF rActualMeanNipGap_um > 10.0 THEN
    rCompactedArealDensity_Est_gm2 := rTargetArealDensity_gm2; (* Nominal base *)
    rTempCalc3 := (rXRayArealDensity_Scan_gm2 / rActualMeanNipGap_um); (* [g/cm3 equivalent] *)
    IF rTheoreticalSolidDensity_gcm3 > 0.10 THEN
        rEstimatedPorosity_pct := (1.0 - (rTempCalc3 / rTheoreticalSolidDensity_gcm3)) * 100.0;
        rEstimatedPorosity_pct := LIMIT(5.0, rEstimatedPorosity_pct, 60.0);
    END_IF;
END_IF;

(* --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* 5.4 Smith Predictor Outer-Loop Areal Density Trim Regulator                                   *)
(* --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
IF bXRayDataValid AND (iState = 70) THEN
    bGracefulDegradeXRay := FALSE;
    rArealDensityError_gm2 := rTargetArealDensity_gm2 - rXRayArealDensity_Scan_gm2;
    
    (* Integrating trim regulator with anti-windup *)
    rArealDensityTrim_Integ := rArealDensityTrim_Integ + 
                               (rArealDensityError_gm2 * 0.0045 * c_CycleTime_s);
    rArealDensityTrim_Integ := LIMIT(-8.0, rArealDensityTrim_Integ, 8.0);
    
    (* Sensitivity of dry electrode: ~3.8 g/m2 density shift per 1.0 um gap adjustment *)
    rDensityTrimGapOffset_um := (rArealDensityError_gm2 * 0.263) + rArealDensityTrim_Integ;
    rDensityTrimGapOffset_um := LIMIT(-12.0, rDensityTrimGapOffset_um, 12.0);
ELSE
    (* Fallback to open-loop feedforward when X-ray data invalid or scanning off-sheet *)
    bGracefulDegradeXRay := TRUE;
    rDensityTrimGapOffset_um := 0.0;
    dwAlarmWord2 := dwAlarmWord2 OR 16#0000_0040; (* Warning: Inline X-Ray Feedback Suspended *)
    bWarningActive := TRUE;
END_IF;
(* ============================================================================================= *)
(* 6.0 6-STATE MULTIVARIABLE STATE-SPACE (A,B,C,D) & REAL-TIME MPC OPTIMIZATION                  *)
(* ============================================================================================= *)
(* --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* 6.1 Initialize Discrete State-Space Model Matrices (Sampled at Ts = 1.0 ms)                   *)
(* --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
IF NOT bMatricesInitialized THEN
    (* Diagonal state self-decay and coupling *)
    A_mat[1,1] := 0.9850; A_mat[1,2] := 0.0085; A_mat[1,3] :=-0.0120; A_mat[1,4] := 0.0210; A_mat[1,5] := 0.0015; A_mat[1,6] := 0.0;
    A_mat[2,1] := 0.0085; A_mat[2,2] := 0.9850; A_mat[2,3] := 0.0120; A_mat[2,4] := 0.0210; A_mat[2,5] :=-0.0015; A_mat[2,6] := 0.0;
    A_mat[3,1] :=-0.0150; A_mat[3,2] := 0.0150; A_mat[3,3] := 0.9620; A_mat[3,4] :=-0.0350; A_mat[3,5] := 0.0000; A_mat[3,6] := 0.0;
    A_mat[4,1] := 0.0000; A_mat[4,2] := 0.0000; A_mat[4,3] := 0.0000; A_mat[4,4] := 0.9992; A_mat[4,5] := 0.0000; A_mat[4,6] := 0.0;
    A_mat[5,1] := 0.0450; A_mat[5,2] := 0.0450; A_mat[5,3] := 0.0000; A_mat[5,4] := 0.0000; A_mat[5,5] := 0.9450; A_mat[5,6] := 0.0;
    A_mat[6,1] := 0.0820; A_mat[6,2] := 0.0820; A_mat[6,3] := 0.0150; A_mat[6,4] := 0.0000; A_mat[6,5] := 0.0020; A_mat[6,6] := 0.9910;

    (* Input control matrix B (6 states x 4 inputs) *)
    B_mat[1,1] := 0.0420; B_mat[1,2] := 0.0015; B_mat[1,3] :=-0.0045; B_mat[1,4] := 0.0005;
    B_mat[2,1] := 0.0015; B_mat[2,2] := 0.0420; B_mat[2,3] := 0.0045; B_mat[2,4] := 0.0005;
    B_mat[3,1] :=-0.0080; B_mat[3,2] := 0.0080; B_mat[3,3] := 0.0580; B_mat[3,4] :=-0.0020;
    B_mat[4,1] := 0.0000; B_mat[4,2] := 0.0000; B_mat[4,3] := 0.0000; B_mat[4,4] := 0.0085;
    B_mat[5,1] := 0.0180; B_mat[5,2] := 0.0180; B_mat[5,3] := 0.0000; B_mat[5,4] := 0.0000;
    B_mat[6,1] := 0.0250; B_mat[6,2] := 0.0250; B_mat[6,3] := 0.0035; B_mat[6,4] := 0.0000;

    (* Output matrix C (Identity 6x6) *)
    FOR iRow := 1 TO 6 DO
        FOR iCol := 1 TO 6 DO
            IF iRow = iCol THEN C_mat[iRow, iCol] := 1.0; ELSE C_mat[iRow, iCol] := 0.0; END_IF;
        END_FOR;
    END_FOR;

    (* Feedthrough matrix D (Zero 6x4) *)
    FOR iRow := 1 TO 6 DO
        FOR iCol := 1 TO 4 DO D_mat[iRow, iCol] := 0.0; END_FOR;
    END_FOR;

    (* Quadratic cost functional weights: Q (State tracking) and R (Input rates) *)
    Q_diag[1] := 15.0;  (* OS Gap Error Priority *)
    Q_diag[2] := 15.0;  (* DS Gap Error Priority *)
    Q_diag[3] := 8.50;  (* Roll Bending Camber Priority *)
    Q_diag[4] := 5.20;  (* Thermal Crown Stability *)
    Q_diag[5] := 3.40;  (* Web Tension Micro-damping *)
    Q_diag[6] := 12.0;  (* Inline Areal Density Compaction *)

    R_diag[1] := 0.85;  (* OS Servo Valve Energy *)
    R_diag[2] := 0.85;  (* DS Servo Valve Energy *)
    R_diag[3] := 0.65;  (* Roll-Bending Valve Slew *)
    R_diag[4] := 0.45;  (* Induction Power Smoothness *)

    (* Diagonal approximation of Hessian matrix H = 2 * (B' * Q * B + R) *)
    H_diag[1] := 2.0 * ((B_mat[1,1]*B_mat[1,1]*Q_diag[1]) + (B_mat[2,1]*B_mat[2,1]*Q_diag[2]) + 
                        (B_mat[3,1]*B_mat[3,1]*Q_diag[3]) + (B_mat[5,1]*B_mat[5,1]*Q_diag[5]) + 
                        (B_mat[6,1]*B_mat[6,1]*Q_diag[6]) + R_diag[1]);
    H_diag[2] := 2.0 * ((B_mat[1,2]*B_mat[1,2]*Q_diag[1]) + (B_mat[2,2]*B_mat[2,2]*Q_diag[2]) + 
                        (B_mat[3,2]*B_mat[3,2]*Q_diag[3]) + (B_mat[5,2]*B_mat[5,2]*Q_diag[5]) + 
                        (B_mat[6,2]*B_mat[6,2]*Q_diag[6]) + R_diag[2]);
    H_diag[3] := 2.0 * ((B_mat[1,3]*B_mat[1,3]*Q_diag[1]) + (B_mat[2,3]*B_mat[2,3]*Q_diag[2]) + 
                        (B_mat[3,3]*B_mat[3,3]*Q_diag[3]) + (B_mat[6,3]*B_mat[6,3]*Q_diag[6]) + R_diag[3]);
    H_diag[4] := 2.0 * ((B_mat[4,4]*B_mat[4,4]*Q_diag[4]) + R_diag[4]);

    bMatricesInitialized := TRUE;
END_IF;

(* --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* 6.2 Populate State and Reference Vectors                                                      *)
(* --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
x_state[1] := rVotedGap_OS_um - rTareOffset_OS_um;
x_state[2] := rVotedGap_DS_um - rTareOffset_DS_um;
x_state[3] := rActualRollBendingCrown_um;
x_state[4] := rThermalExpansionCrownModel_um;
x_state[5] := rFilteredWebTension_N;
x_state[6] := rXRayArealDensity_Scan_gm2;

rSafeNipSetpoint_um := LIMIT(c_MinPermissibleNipGap_um, 
                             rNipGapSetpoint_um + rDensityTrimGapOffset_um, 
                             c_MaxPermissibleNipGap_um);

x_ref[1] := rSafeNipSetpoint_um;
x_ref[2] := rSafeNipSetpoint_um;
x_ref[3] := rNetRequiredCrownCorrection_um;
x_ref[4] := 22.0; (* Baseline equilibrium thermal expansion crown *)
x_ref[5] := rTargetWebTension_N;
x_ref[6] := rTargetArealDensity_gm2;

FOR iRow := 1 TO 6 DO
    x_err[iRow] := x_state[iRow] - x_ref[iRow];
END_FOR;

(* --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* 6.3 State One-Step Ahead Forward Prediction: x_pred = A * x + B * u                           *)
(* --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
FOR iRow := 1 TO 6 DO
    rTempCalc1 := 0.0;
    FOR iCol := 1 TO 6 DO
        rTempCalc1 := rTempCalc1 + (A_mat[iRow, iCol] * x_state[iCol]);
    END_FOR;
    FOR iCol := 1 TO 4 DO
        rTempCalc1 := rTempCalc1 + (B_mat[iRow, iCol] * u_prev[iCol]);
    END_FOR;
    x_pred[iRow] := rTempCalc1;
END_FOR;

(* --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* 6.4 Real-Time Quadratic Cost Function Gradient Computation & Projected Descent Iteration      *)
(* Cost: J = sum(x_err' * Q * x_err) + sum(u' * R * u)                                           *)
(* Gradient: grad_J = 2 * B' * Q * (x_pred - x_ref) + 2 * R * u                                 *)
(* --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
rMpcObjectiveCost := 0.0;
FOR iRow := 1 TO 6 DO
    rMpcObjectiveCost := rMpcObjectiveCost + (x_err[iRow] * x_err[iRow] * Q_diag[iRow]);
END_FOR;
FOR iRow := 1 TO 4 DO
    rMpcObjectiveCost := rMpcObjectiveCost + (u_prev[iRow] * u_prev[iRow] * R_diag[iRow]);
END_FOR;

(* Calculate Gradient vector for each of the 4 control inputs *)
FOR iCol := 1 TO 4 DO
    rTempCalc2 := 0.0;
    FOR iRow := 1 TO 6 DO
        rTempCalc2 := rTempCalc2 + (B_mat[iRow, iCol] * Q_diag[iRow] * (x_pred[iRow] - x_ref[iRow]));
    END_FOR;
    grad_J[iCol] := (2.0 * rTempCalc2) + (2.0 * R_diag[iCol] * u_prev[iCol]);
END_FOR;

(* Perform 3 Fast Newton-Raphson / Projected Gradient Descent Optimization Steps *)
FOR iIter := 1 TO 3 DO
    FOR iCol := 1 TO 4 DO
        IF H_diag[iCol] > 0.001 THEN
            rGradStep := grad_J[iCol] / H_diag[iCol];
        ELSE
            rGradStep := grad_J[iCol] * 0.010;
        END_IF;
        u_delta[iCol] := -1.0 * rGradStep;
        u_mpc[iCol]   := u_prev[iCol] + u_delta[iCol];
    END_FOR;

    (* Apply Box Constraints and Actuator Saturation Limits *)
    u_mpc[1] := LIMIT(-100.0, u_mpc[1], 100.0); (* OS Servo Valve % *)
    u_mpc[2] := LIMIT(-100.0, u_mpc[2], 100.0); (* DS Servo Valve % *)
    u_mpc[3] := LIMIT(-100.0, u_mpc[3], 100.0); (* Roll Bending Valve % *)
    u_mpc[4] := LIMIT(-30.0,  u_mpc[4], 30.0);  (* Center Zone Induction Trim % *)

    (* Refresh previous vector for subsequent step *)
    FOR iCol := 1 TO 4 DO
        u_prev[iCol] := u_mpc[iCol];
    END_FOR;
END_FOR;
(* ============================================================================================= *)
(* 7.0 SERVO VALVE NON-LINEARITIES & ASYMMETRIC HYDRAULIC COMPENSATION                          *)
(* ============================================================================================= *)
