    rYawRate_GyroC_degps        : REAL;     (* MEMS Gyroscope Channel C chassis yaw rate [deg/s] *)

    (* --- Redundant Triple Modular Redundancy (2oo3) Lateral Guideway Displacement Sensors --- *)
    rGuidewayDispl_SensA_m      : REAL;     (* Optical/Laser Track Centerline Lateral Offset Channel A [m] *)
    rGuidewayDispl_SensB_m      : REAL;     (* Magnetic Inductive Guideway Sensor Channel B [m] *)
    rGuidewayDispl_SensC_m      : REAL;     (* Time-of-Flight Radar Guideway Sensor Channel C [m] *)

    (* --- LSM Electrical Feedback & Bogie Feedback --- *)
    rPortActualCurrent_A        : REAL;     (* Port (Left) Linear Motor inverter q-axis torque current [A] *)
    rStbdActualCurrent_A        : REAL;     (* Starboard (Right) Linear Motor inverter q-axis torque current [A] *)
    rBogieSteerAngleFb_rad      : REAL;     (* Rotary absolute encoder bogie articulation angle feedback [rad] *)
END_VAR

VAR_OUTPUT
    (* --- Primary Actuator Thrust & Angle Commands --- *)
    bSystemReady                : BOOL;     (* Steering & yaw control loop operational and in closed-loop state *)
    rPortThrustCmd_kN           : REAL;     (* Port stator linear synchronous motor thrust command [kN] *)
    rStbdThrustCmd_kN           : REAL;     (* Starboard stator linear synchronous motor thrust command [kN] *)
    rDifferentialForce_kN       : REAL;     (* Differential yaw torque control force Delta_Fx = F_stbd - F_port [kN] *)
    rBogieSteerAngleCmd_rad     : REAL;     (* Electro-hydraulic/electric bogie steering actuator angle setpoint [rad] *)

    (* --- State Estimation & Observation Outputs --- *)
    rVotedLateralDispl_m        : REAL;     (* 2oo3 validated guideway lateral displacement [m] *)
    rVotedYawRate_radps         : REAL;     (* 2oo3 validated vehicle yaw rate [rad/s] *)
    rEstimatedYawAngle_rad      : REAL;     (* Discrete observer estimated chassis yaw angle relative to guideway [rad] *)
    rEstimatedLateralVel_mps    : REAL;     (* Discrete observer estimated lateral drift velocity [m/s] *)

    (* --- Diagnostics, Status Words & Safety Flags --- *)
    wOperatingState             : WORD;     (* Current internal finite state machine operational code *)
    wDiagnosticWord             : WORD;     (* Real-time fault bitmask register for SCADA telemetry *)
    bDegradedMode               : BOOL;     (* True if operating under single sensor fallback (2oo2 / 1oo1) *)
    bFlangeContactWarning       : BOOL;     (* Flange clearance below critical threshold (< 6.0 mm) *)
    bEmergencyBrakingActive     : BOOL;     (* Emergency dynamic and friction brake override triggered *)
END_VAR

VAR
    (* --- Internal State Machine Variables --- *)
    iState                      : INT := 0; (* Primary sequencer state index *)
    iPreviousState              : INT := 0; (* Previous state for edge transition detection *)
    tonStateTimer               : TON;      (* State residence duration timer *)
    tonSensorMismatchTimer      : TON;      (* Persistent sensor discrepancy debounce timer *)

    (* --- Physical & Geometric Parameters (Port Shuttle Model 65t) --- *)
    rMassTare_kg                : REAL := 18500.0;  (* Chassis tare empty mass [kg] *)
    rTotalMass_kg               : REAL := 18500.0;  (* Total vehicle plus payload operational mass [kg] *)
    rBogieTrackHalfWidth_b_m    : REAL := 1.250;    (* Half-track distance from centerline to LSM stator centerline [m] *)
    rWheelbase_L_m              : REAL := 9.800;    (* Longitudinal distance between front and rear bogie pivots [m] *)
    rYawInertia_Jz_kgm2         : REAL := 220000.0; (* Chassis yaw moment of inertia [kg*m^2] *)
    rMaxLSMThrust_kN            : REAL := 85.0;     (* Peak individual LSM thrust limit [kN] *)
    rMaxDifferentialThrust_kN   : REAL := 60.0;     (* Maximum allowable differential thrust [kN] *)
    rMaxSteeringAngle_rad       : REAL := 0.1745;   (* Maximum mechanical bogie steering angle (+/- 10.0 deg) [rad] *)
    rSamplingPeriod_Ts_s        : REAL := 0.005;    (* 5 ms sample time [s] *)
    rDegToRad                   : REAL := 0.017453292519943; (* Conversion constant [deg -> rad] *)
    rRadToDeg                   : REAL := 57.29577951308232; (* Conversion constant [rad -> deg] *)

    (* --- 2oo3 TMR Voting Variables & Sensor Health Status --- *)
    rYawRateA_radps             : REAL;     (* Converted Ch A yaw rate [rad/s] *)
    rYawRateB_radps             : REAL;     (* Converted Ch B yaw rate [rad/s] *)
    rYawRateC_radps             : REAL;     (* Converted Ch C yaw rate [rad/s] *)
    bGyroA_Valid                : BOOL;     (* Gyro A health validation flag *)
    bGyroB_Valid                : BOOL;     (* Gyro B health validation flag *)
    bGyroC_Valid                : BOOL;     (* Gyro C health validation flag *)
    rDiffGyro_AB                : REAL;     (* Absolute discrepancy |A - B| [rad/s] *)
    rDiffGyro_BC                : REAL;     (* Absolute discrepancy |B - C| [rad/s] *)
    rDiffGyro_CA                : REAL;     (* Absolute discrepancy |C - A| [rad/s] *)
    rGyroTolerance_radps        : REAL := 0.035; (* 2.0 deg/s allowable discrepancy threshold *)

    bDisplA_Valid               : BOOL;     (* Lateral displacement Sensor A health flag *)
    bDisplB_Valid               : BOOL;     (* Lateral displacement Sensor B health flag *)
    bDisplC_Valid               : BOOL;     (* Lateral displacement Sensor C health flag *)
    rDiffDispl_AB               : REAL;     (* Absolute discrepancy |A - B| [m] *)
    rDiffDispl_BC               : REAL;     (* Absolute discrepancy |B - C| [m] *)
    rDiffDispl_CA               : REAL;     (* Absolute discrepancy |C - A| [m] *)
    rDisplTolerance_m           : REAL := 0.008; (* 8.0 mm allowable sensor discrepancy threshold *)

    (* --- 4-State Discrete Luenberger Observer / Estimator --- *)
    (* States: x[0] = y (lateral pos [m]), x[1] = y_dot (lateral vel [m/s]), *)
    (*         x[2] = psi (yaw error [rad]), x[3] = psi_dot (yaw rate [rad/s]) *)
    x_hat_0                     : REAL := 0.0; (* Lateral position estimate [m] *)
    x_hat_1                     : REAL := 0.0; (* Lateral velocity estimate [m/s] *)
    x_hat_2                     : REAL := 0.0; (* Yaw error angle estimate [rad] *)
    x_hat_3                     : REAL := 0.0; (* Yaw rate estimate [rad/s] *)

    (* Discrete Observer Prediction Pre-Calculated Matrices (Taylor Series 2nd Order discretised at Ts=5ms) *)
    (* Ad = I + Ac*Ts + 0.5*(Ac*Ts)^2 *)
    ad_00 : REAL := 1.0000;  ad_01 : REAL := 0.0050;  ad_02 : REAL := 0.0000;  ad_03 : REAL := 0.0000;
    ad_10 : REAL := -0.0450; ad_11 : REAL := 0.9850;  ad_12 : REAL := 0.1200;  ad_13 : REAL := 0.0025;
    ad_20 : REAL := 0.0000;  ad_21 : REAL := 0.0000;  ad_22 : REAL := 1.0000;  ad_23 : REAL := 0.0050;
    ad_30 : REAL := -0.0120; ad_31 : REAL := -0.0050; ad_32 : REAL := -0.0850; ad_33 : REAL := 0.9780;

    (* Input matrix Bd for u = [Delta_Fx (kN), BogieAngle (rad)] *)
    bd_00 : REAL := 0.00000;  bd_01 : REAL := 0.00010;
    bd_10 : REAL := 0.00012;  bd_11 : REAL := 0.01850;
    bd_20 : REAL := 0.00000;  bd_21 : REAL := 0.00025;
    bd_30 : REAL := 0.00065;  bd_31 : REAL := 0.04200;

    (* Observer Innovation Correction Gains L (Dual output y_meas, psi_dot_meas) *)
    l_00 : REAL := 0.1850;  l_01 : REAL := 0.0005;
    l_10 : REAL := 0.4200;  l_11 : REAL := 0.0150;
    l_20 : REAL := 0.0080;  l_21 : REAL := 0.1250;
    l_30 : REAL := 0.0250;  l_31 : REAL := 0.4800;

    (* --- State Feedback & Model Predictive Controller Gains --- *)
    (* Optimal Linear Quadratic Regulator Gains K for [y, y_dot, psi, psi_dot] *)
    k_diff_y                    : REAL := 145.0;    (* Differential thrust per meter lateral displacement [kN/m] *)
    k_diff_ydot                 : REAL := 32.0;     (* Differential thrust per m/s lateral velocity [kN/(m/s)] *)
    k_diff_psi                  : REAL := 285.0;    (* Differential thrust per radian yaw angle [kN/rad] *)
    k_diff_psidot               : REAL := 48.0;     (* Differential thrust per rad/s yaw rate [kN/(rad/s)] *)

    k_steer_y                   : REAL := 0.380;    (* Bogie steer angle per meter lateral displacement [rad/m] *)
    k_steer_ydot                : REAL := 0.085;    (* Bogie steer angle per m/s lateral velocity [rad/(m/s)] *)
    k_steer_psi                 : REAL := 0.920;    (* Bogie steer angle per radian yaw error [rad/rad] *)
    k_steer_psidot              : REAL := 0.140;    (* Bogie steer angle per rad/s yaw rate [rad/(rad/s)] *)

    (* --- Feedforward Calculation Registers --- *)
    rFeedforwardDifferential_kN : REAL := 0.0;     (* Curvature and wind feedforward differential thrust *)
    rFeedforwardSteer_rad       : REAL := 0.0;     (* Curvature kinematic Ackerman bogie feedforward *)
    rWindCompThrust_kN          : REAL := 0.0;     (* Crosswind aerodynamic counter-torque thrust *)

    (* --- Integrator Accumulator for Steady-State Offset Rejection --- *)
    rDisplacementIntegral_m_s   : REAL := 0.0;     (* Integral of lateral guideway displacement [m*s] *)
    k_integral_y                : REAL := 18.0;     (* Integrator gain for differential thrust [kN/(m*s)] *)
    rIntegralLimit_m_s          : REAL := 0.250;    (* Anti-windup clamping envelope on integral accumulator *)

    (* --- Rate Limiter Variables --- *)
    rPrevPortThrust_kN          : REAL := 0.0;
    rPrevStbdThrust_kN          : REAL := 0.0;
    rMaxThrustSlewRate_kNps     : REAL := 250.0;    (* Maximum allowable slew rate 250 kN/sec *)
    rMaxSlewPerCycle_kN         : REAL := 1.25;     (* 250 * 0.005s = 1.25 kN per 5ms execution cycle *)

    (* --- Constant Status & Alarm Bitmask Definitions --- *)
    ESTOP_ACTIVE_BIT            : WORD := 16#0001;  (* Bit 0: Hardware E-Stop open *)
    GYRO_A_FAULT_BIT            : WORD := 16#0002;  (* Bit 1: Gyro A discrepancy isolated *)
    GYRO_B_FAULT_BIT            : WORD := 16#0004;  (* Bit 2: Gyro B discrepancy isolated *)
    GYRO_C_FAULT_BIT            : WORD := 16#0008;  (* Bit 3: Gyro C discrepancy isolated *)
    DISPL_A_FAULT_BIT           : WORD := 16#0010;  (* Bit 4: Lateral sensor A discrepancy isolated *)
    DISPL_B_FAULT_BIT           : WORD := 16#0020;  (* Bit 5: Lateral sensor B discrepancy isolated *)
    DISPL_C_FAULT_BIT           : WORD := 16#0040;  (* Bit 6: Lateral sensor C discrepancy isolated *)
    TMR_SENSOR_COLLAPSE_BIT     : WORD := 16#0080;  (* Bit 7: Dual sensor disagreement - TMR loss *)
    LATERAL_LIMIT_EXCEEDED_BIT  : WORD := 16#0100;  (* Bit 8: Guideway lateral offset exceeded limit (> 40mm) *)
    YAW_RATE_EXCEEDED_BIT       : WORD := 16#0200;  (* Bit 9: Vehicle yaw angular velocity exceeded limit *)
    CURRENT_ASYMMETRY_WARN_BIT  : WORD := 16#0400;  (* Bit 10: LSM phase currents severe imbalance *)
    CROSSWIND_SEVERE_BIT        : WORD := 16#0800;  (* Bit 11: Severe lateral gale gust compensation active *)
    ACTUATOR_SLEW_CLAMP_BIT     : WORD := 16#1000;  (* Bit 12: Bogie or LSM rate limiter operating at ceiling *)
    OBSERVER_RESIDUAL_HIGH_BIT  : WORD := 16#2000;  (* Bit 13: Kalman/Observer innovation residual divergence *)
    DEGRADED_OPERATION_BIT      : WORD := 16#4000;  (* Bit 14: Degraded sub-optimal performance active *)
    SAFETY_LOCKOUT_BIT          : WORD := 16#8000;  (* Bit 15: Critical safety fault lockout latched *)
END_VAR

(* ========================================================================================= *)
(* 1.0 HARDWARE SAFETY INTERLOCK AND EMERGENCY OVERRIDE EVALUATION                           *)
(* ========================================================================================= *)
IF NOT bEStopOk THEN
    (* Immediate de-energization of bilateral thrust and fail-safe mechanical brake drop *)
    rPortThrustCmd_kN           := 0.0;
    rStbdThrustCmd_kN           := 0.0;
    rDifferentialForce_kN       := 0.0;
    rBogieSteerAngleCmd_rad     := 0.0;
    bSystemReady                := FALSE;
    bEmergencyBrakingActive     := TRUE;
    wOperatingState             := 16#0090; (* STATE 90: EMERGENCY_BRAKE *)
    wDiagnosticWord             := wDiagnosticWord OR ESTOP_ACTIVE_BIT OR SAFETY_LOCKOUT_BIT;
    iState                      := 90;
    RETURN;
END_IF;

(* Clear E-Stop bit if loop is healthy *)
wDiagnosticWord := wDiagnosticWord AND NOT ESTOP_ACTIVE_BIT;

(* Fault reset acknowledgement on rising edge *)
IF bResetFault THEN
    IF (wDiagnosticWord AND SAFETY_LOCKOUT_BIT) = 0 THEN
        wDiagnosticWord := 16#0000;
        bFlangeContactWarning := FALSE;
        rDisplacementIntegral_m_s := 0.0;
    END_IF;
END_IF;

(* Total operational mass calculation accounting for payload dynamics *)
rTotalMass_kg := rMassTare_kg + (LIMIT(0.0, rPayloadMass_ton, 45.0) * 1000.0);
(* Scale yaw moment of inertia dynamically with container payload mass *)
rYawInertia_Jz_kgm2 := 120000.0 + (rTotalMass_kg * 4.25);

(* ========================================================================================= *)
(* 2.0 TRIPLE MODULAR REDUNDANCY (2oo3) VOTING AND FAULT DETECTION LOGIC                      *)
(* ========================================================================================= *)
(* Convert incoming Gyro measurements from deg/s to rad/s *)
rYawRateA_radps := rYawRate_GyroA_degps * rDegToRad;
rYawRateB_radps := rYawRate_GyroB_degps * rDegToRad;
rYawRateC_radps := rYawRate_GyroC_degps * rDegToRad;

(* Pairwise difference computation for Gyro channels *)
rDiffGyro_AB := ABS(rYawRateA_radps - rYawRateB_radps);
rDiffGyro_BC := ABS(rYawRateB_radps - rYawRateC_radps);
rDiffGyro_CA := ABS(rYawRateC_radps - rYawRateA_radps);

bGyroA_Valid := TRUE;
bGyroB_Valid := TRUE;
bGyroC_Valid := TRUE;

(* Tri-channel voting arbitration for Yaw Rate *)
IF (rDiffGyro_AB <= rGyroTolerance_radps) AND (rDiffGyro_BC <= rGyroTolerance_radps) AND (rDiffGyro_CA <= rGyroTolerance_radps) THEN
    (* All three sensors concordant: Standard median / middle-value selection *)
    IF (rYawRateA_radps >= rYawRateB_radps AND rYawRateA_radps <= rYawRateC_radps) OR (rYawRateA_radps <= rYawRateB_radps AND rYawRateA_radps >= rYawRateC_radps) THEN
        rVotedYawRate_radps := rYawRateA_radps;
    ELSIF (rYawRateB_radps >= rYawRateA_radps AND rYawRateB_radps <= rYawRateC_radps) OR (rYawRateB_radps <= rYawRateA_radps AND rYawRateB_radps >= rYawRateC_radps) THEN
        rVotedYawRate_radps := rYawRateB_radps;
    ELSE
        rVotedYawRate_radps := rYawRateC_radps;
    END_IF;
    wDiagnosticWord := wDiagnosticWord AND NOT (GYRO_A_FAULT_BIT OR GYRO_B_FAULT_BIT OR GYRO_C_FAULT_BIT);
ELSIF (rDiffGyro_AB <= rGyroTolerance_radps) AND (rDiffGyro_CA > rGyroTolerance_radps) AND (rDiffGyro_BC > rGyroTolerance_radps) THEN
    (* Channel C drifted / failed: Isolate C, average A and B *)
    bGyroC_Valid := FALSE;
    rVotedYawRate_radps := (rYawRateA_radps + rYawRateB_radps) * 0.5;
    wDiagnosticWord := (wDiagnosticWord OR GYRO_C_FAULT_BIT) AND NOT (GYRO_A_FAULT_BIT OR GYRO_B_FAULT_BIT);
ELSIF (rDiffGyro_BC <= rGyroTolerance_radps) AND (rDiffGyro_AB > rGyroTolerance_radps) AND (rDiffGyro_CA > rGyroTolerance_radps) THEN
    (* Channel A drifted / failed: Isolate A, average B and C *)
    bGyroA_Valid := FALSE;
    rVotedYawRate_radps := (rYawRateB_radps + rYawRateC_radps) * 0.5;
    wDiagnosticWord := (wDiagnosticWord OR GYRO_A_FAULT_BIT) AND NOT (GYRO_B_FAULT_BIT OR GYRO_C_FAULT_BIT);
ELSIF (rDiffGyro_CA <= rGyroTolerance_radps) AND (rDiffGyro_AB > rGyroTolerance_radps) AND (rDiffGyro_BC > rGyroTolerance_radps) THEN
    (* Channel B drifted / failed: Isolate B, average C and A *)
    bGyroB_Valid := FALSE;
    rVotedYawRate_radps := (rYawRateC_radps + rYawRateA_radps) * 0.5;
    wDiagnosticWord := (wDiagnosticWord OR GYRO_B_FAULT_BIT) AND NOT (GYRO_A_FAULT_BIT OR GYRO_C_FAULT_BIT);
ELSE
    (* Total TMR disagreement: More than 1 sensor diverged *)
    bGyroA_Valid := FALSE;
    bGyroB_Valid := FALSE;
    bGyroC_Valid := FALSE;
    rVotedYawRate_radps := (rYawRateA_radps + rYawRateB_radps + rYawRateC_radps) / 3.0;
    wDiagnosticWord := wDiagnosticWord OR TMR_SENSOR_COLLAPSE_BIT;
END_IF;

(* Pairwise difference computation for Guideway Displacement sensors *)
rDiffDispl_AB := ABS(rGuidewayDispl_SensA_m - rGuidewayDispl_SensB_m);
rDiffDispl_BC := ABS(rGuidewayDispl_SensB_m - rGuidewayDispl_SensC_m);
rDiffDispl_CA := ABS(rGuidewayDispl_SensC_m - rGuidewayDispl_SensA_m);

bDisplA_Valid := TRUE;
bDisplB_Valid := TRUE;
bDisplC_Valid := TRUE;

(* Tri-channel voting arbitration for Lateral Guideway Position *)
IF (rDiffDispl_AB <= rDisplTolerance_m) AND (rDiffDispl_BC <= rDisplTolerance_m) AND (rDiffDispl_CA <= rDisplTolerance_m) THEN
    (* All sensors healthy: Median voter *)
    IF (rGuidewayDispl_SensA_m >= rGuidewayDispl_SensB_m AND rGuidewayDispl_SensA_m <= rGuidewayDispl_SensC_m) OR (rGuidewayDispl_SensA_m <= rGuidewayDispl_SensB_m AND rGuidewayDispl_SensA_m >= rGuidewayDispl_SensC_m) THEN
        rVotedLateralDispl_m := rGuidewayDispl_SensA_m;
    ELSIF (rGuidewayDispl_SensB_m >= rGuidewayDispl_SensA_m AND rGuidewayDispl_SensB_m <= rGuidewayDispl_SensC_m) OR (rGuidewayDispl_SensB_m <= rGuidewayDispl_SensA_m AND rGuidewayDispl_SensB_m >= rGuidewayDispl_SensC_m) THEN
        rVotedLateralDispl_m := rGuidewayDispl_SensB_m;
    ELSE
        rVotedLateralDispl_m := rGuidewayDispl_SensC_m;
    END_IF;
    wDiagnosticWord := wDiagnosticWord AND NOT (DISPL_A_FAULT_BIT OR DISPL_B_FAULT_BIT OR DISPL_C_FAULT_BIT);
ELSIF (rDiffDispl_AB <= rDisplTolerance_m) AND (rDiffDispl_CA > rDisplTolerance_m) AND (rDiffDispl_BC > rDisplTolerance_m) THEN
    (* Displ C failed *)
    bDisplC_Valid := FALSE;
    rVotedLateralDispl_m := (rGuidewayDispl_SensA_m + rGuidewayDispl_SensB_m) * 0.5;
    wDiagnosticWord := (wDiagnosticWord OR DISPL_C_FAULT_BIT) AND NOT (DISPL_A_FAULT_BIT OR DISPL_B_FAULT_BIT);
ELSIF (rDiffDispl_BC <= rDisplTolerance_m) AND (rDiffDispl_AB > rDisplTolerance_m) AND (rDiffDispl_CA > rDisplTolerance_m) THEN
    (* Displ A failed *)
    bDisplA_Valid := FALSE;
    rVotedLateralDispl_m := (rGuidewayDispl_SensB_m + rGuidewayDispl_SensC_m) * 0.5;
    wDiagnosticWord := (wDiagnosticWord OR DISPL_A_FAULT_BIT) AND NOT (DISPL_B_FAULT_BIT OR DISPL_C_FAULT_BIT);
ELSIF (rDiffDispl_CA <= rDisplTolerance_m) AND (rDiffDispl_AB > rDisplTolerance_m) AND (rDiffDispl_BC > rDisplTolerance_m) THEN
    (* Displ B failed *)
    bDisplB_Valid := FALSE;
    rVotedLateralDispl_m := (rGuidewayDispl_SensC_m + rGuidewayDispl_SensA_m) * 0.5;
    wDiagnosticWord := (wDiagnosticWord OR DISPL_B_FAULT_BIT) AND NOT (DISPL_A_FAULT_BIT OR DISPL_C_FAULT_BIT);
ELSE
    (* Total TMR disagreement on Displacement *)
    bDisplA_Valid := FALSE;
    bDisplB_Valid := FALSE;
    bDisplC_Valid := FALSE;
    rVotedLateralDispl_m := (rGuidewayDispl_SensA_m + rGuidewayDispl_SensB_m + rGuidewayDispl_SensC_m) / 3.0;
    wDiagnosticWord := wDiagnosticWord OR TMR_SENSOR_COLLAPSE_BIT;
END_IF;

(* Determine Degraded Mode Flag *)
bDegradedMode := NOT (bGyroA_Valid AND bGyroB_Valid AND bGyroC_Valid AND bDisplA_Valid AND bDisplB_Valid AND bDisplC_Valid);
IF bDegradedMode THEN
    wDiagnosticWord := wDiagnosticWord OR DEGRADED_OPERATION_BIT;
ELSE
    wDiagnosticWord := wDiagnosticWord AND NOT DEGRADED_OPERATION_BIT;
END_IF;

(* Flange contact avoidance warning if offset exceeds +/- 28 mm *)
bFlangeContactWarning := (ABS(rVotedLateralDispl_m) > 0.028);
IF ABS(rVotedLateralDispl_m) > 0.040 THEN
    wDiagnosticWord := wDiagnosticWord OR LATERAL_LIMIT_EXCEEDED_BIT;
ELSE
    wDiagnosticWord := wDiagnosticWord AND NOT LATERAL_LIMIT_EXCEEDED_BIT;
END_IF;

(* ========================================================================================= *)
(* 3.0 FOUR-STATE DISCRETE LUENBERGER OBSERVER UPDATE                                        *)
(* ========================================================================================= *)
(* Prediction Phase: x_pred = Ad * x_hat + Bd * u *)
VAR_TEMP
    x_pred_0    : REAL;
    x_pred_1    : REAL;
    x_pred_2    : REAL;
    x_pred_3    : REAL;
    rInnov_0    : REAL;
    rInnov_1    : REAL;
    rDiffForce_u: REAL;
    rSteer_u    : REAL;
    rLsmTotalThrust_kN : REAL;
    rRawPortThrust_kN  : REAL;
    rRawStbdThrust_kN  : REAL;
    rSlewClampedPort_kN: REAL;
    rSlewClampedStbd_kN: REAL;
END_VAR

rDiffForce_u := rDifferentialForce_kN;
rSteer_u     := rBogieSteerAngleFb_rad;

(* State propagation equations *)
x_pred_0 := (ad_00 * x_hat_0) + (ad_01 * x_hat_1) + (ad_02 * x_hat_2) + (ad_03 * x_hat_3) + (bd_00 * rDiffForce_u) + (bd_01 * rSteer_u);
x_pred_1 := (ad_10 * x_hat_0) + (ad_11 * x_hat_1) + (ad_12 * x_hat_2) + (ad_13 * x_hat_3) + (bd_10 * rDiffForce_u) + (bd_11 * rSteer_u);
x_pred_2 := (ad_20 * x_hat_0) + (ad_21 * x_hat_1) + (ad_22 * x_hat_2) + (ad_23 * x_hat_3) + (bd_20 * rDiffForce_u) + (bd_21 * rSteer_u);
x_pred_3 := (ad_30 * x_hat_0) + (ad_31 * x_hat_1) + (ad_32 * x_hat_2) + (ad_33 * x_hat_3) + (bd_30 * rDiffForce_u) + (bd_31 * rSteer_u);

(* Innovation Residual: Measured minus Predicted Output *)
rInnov_0 := rVotedLateralDispl_m - x_pred_0;
rInnov_1 := rVotedYawRate_radps  - x_pred_3;

(* Check for observer divergence *)
IF (ABS(rInnov_0) > 0.050) OR (ABS(rInnov_1) > 0.25) THEN
    wDiagnosticWord := wDiagnosticWord OR OBSERVER_RESIDUAL_HIGH_BIT;
ELSE
    wDiagnosticWord := wDiagnosticWord AND NOT OBSERVER_RESIDUAL_HIGH_BIT;
END_IF;

(* Correction Phase: x_hat = x_pred + L * Innovation *)
x_hat_0 := x_pred_0 + (l_00 * rInnov_0) + (l_01 * rInnov_1);
x_hat_1 := x_pred_1 + (l_10 * rInnov_0) + (l_11 * rInnov_1);
x_hat_2 := x_pred_2 + (l_20 * rInnov_0) + (l_21 * rInnov_1);
x_hat_3 := x_pred_3 + (l_30 * rInnov_0) + (l_31 * rInnov_1);

(* Export filtered observer states to functional block outputs *)
rEstimatedLateralVel_mps := x_hat_1;
rEstimatedYawAngle_rad   := x_hat_2;

(* Integral accumulation with anti-windup *)
IF bEnable AND (iState = 20 OR iState = 30 OR iState = 40) THEN
    rDisplacementIntegral_m_s := LIMIT(-rIntegralLimit_m_s, rDisplacementIntegral_m_s + (x_hat_0 * rSamplingPeriod_Ts_s), rIntegralLimit_m_s);
ELSE
    rDisplacementIntegral_m_s := 0.0;
END_IF;

(* ========================================================================================= *)
(* 4.0 FINITE STATE MACHINE: SUPERVISORY CONTROL AND GRACEFUL DEGRADATION                    *)
(* ========================================================================================= *)
tonStateTimer(IN := (iState = iPreviousState), PT := T#24H);
iPreviousState := iState;

        wOperatingState := 16#0014;

            iState := 80;
        ELSIF tonSensorMismatchTimer.Q THEN

        ELSIF bDegradedMode THEN

        ELSIF ABS(rTrackCurvature_radpm) > 0.002 THEN

    (* Aerodynamic crosswind counter-torque feedforward: M_wind = F_wind * L_wind_arm *)

    (* 5.2 Feedback Terms *)
    (* State feedback differential force for yaw stability and centerline keeping *)
    rDifferentialForce_kN := -( (k_diff_y * x_hat_0)
                              + (k_diff_ydot * x_hat_1)
                              + (k_diff_psi * x_hat_2)
                              + (k_diff_psidot * x_hat_3)
                              + (k_integral_y * rDisplacementIntegral_m_s) )
                              + rFeedforwardDifferential_kN
                              + rWindCompThrust_kN;

    rDifferentialForce_kN := LIMIT(-rMaxDifferentialThrust_kN, rDifferentialForce_kN, rMaxDifferentialThrust_kN);

    rBogieSteerAngleCmd_rad := -( (k_steer_y * x_hat_0)
                                + (k_steer_ydot * x_hat_1)
                                + (k_steer_psi * x_hat_2)
                                + (k_steer_psidot * x_hat_3) )
                                + rFeedforwardSteer_rad;

    rBogieSteerAngleCmd_rad := LIMIT(-rMaxSteeringAngle_rad, rBogieSteerAngleCmd_rad, rMaxSteeringAngle_rad);

    (* 5.3 Force Allocation to Port and Starboard Linear Synchronous Motors *)
    (* Total longitudinal thrust request *)
    rLsmTotalThrust_kN := LIMIT(0.0, rTargetThrust_kN, rMaxLSMThrust_kN * 1.80);

    (* Bilateral thrust allocation: F_port = 0.5*(F_tot - Delta_F), F_stbd = 0.5*(F_tot + Delta_F) *)
    rRawPortThrust_kN := (rLsmTotalThrust_kN * 0.5) - (rDifferentialForce_kN * 0.5);
    rRawStbdThrust_kN := (rLsmTotalThrust_kN * 0.5) + (rDifferentialForce_kN * 0.5);

    (* Anti-saturation priority logic: Maintain differential steering moment under high traction demand *)
    IF rRawPortThrust_kN > rMaxLSMThrust_kN THEN
        rRawStbdThrust_kN := rRawStbdThrust_kN - (rRawPortThrust_kN - rMaxLSMThrust_kN);
        rRawPortThrust_kN := rMaxLSMThrust_kN;
    ELSIF rRawStbdThrust_kN > rMaxLSMThrust_kN THEN
        rRawPortThrust_kN := rRawPortThrust_kN - (rRawStbdThrust_kN - rMaxLSMThrust_kN);
        rRawStbdThrust_kN := rMaxLSMThrust_kN;
    END_IF;

    (* Prevent reverse thrust during high-speed forward cruising unless braking commanded *)
    IF rTargetThrust_kN >= 0.0 THEN
        rRawPortThrust_kN := MAX(0.0, rRawPortThrust_kN);
        rRawStbdThrust_kN := MAX(0.0, rRawStbdThrust_kN);
    END_IF;

    (* 5.4 Slew Rate Limiting on Inverter Output Thrust (dF/dt <= 250 kN/s) *)
    rSlewClampedPort_kN := LIMIT(rPrevPortThrust_kN - rMaxSlewPerCycle_kN, rRawPortThrust_kN, rPrevPortThrust_kN + rMaxSlewPerCycle_kN);
    rSlewClampedStbd_kN := LIMIT(rPrevStbdThrust_kN - rMaxSlewPerCycle_kN, rRawStbdThrust_kN, rPrevStbdThrust_kN + rMaxSlewPerCycle_kN);

    IF (rSlewClampedPort_kN <> rRawPortThrust_kN) OR (rSlewClampedStbd_kN <> rRawStbdThrust_kN) THEN

    ELSE
        wDiagnosticWord := wDiagnosticWord AND NOT ACTUATOR_SLEW_CLAMP_BIT;
    END_IF;

    rPortThrustCmd_kN  := rSlewClampedPort_kN;
    rStbdThrustCmd_kN  := rSlewClampedStbd_kN;
    rPrevPortThrust_kN := rPortThrustCmd_kN;
    rPrevStbdThrust_kN := rStbdThrustCmd_kN;

    rPortThrustCmd_kN := LIMIT(0.0, rPrevPortThrust_kN - rMaxSlewPerCycle_kN, rMaxLSMThrust_kN);

    rPrevPortThrust_kN := rPortThrustCmd_kN;
    rPrevStbdThrust_kN := rStbdThrustCmd_kN;
END_IF;

IF tTempDiscrepTimer_AB.Q OR tTempDiscrepTimer_BC.Q OR tTempDiscrepTimer_CA.Q THEN

IF NOT bTempFault_B THEN iTempHealthyCount := iTempHealthyCount + 1; END_IF;

(*
====================================================================================================
MODULE 1: HIGH-VISCOSITY NON-NEWTONIAN SLURRY RHEOLOGY & TRIPLEX PUMP DYNAMICS
====================================================================================================
Fluid Mechanics & Kinematics:
- Herschel-Bulkley non-Newtonian apparent viscosity calculation with Rabinowitsch-Mooney correction.
- Generalized Metzner-Reed Reynolds number and Fanning friction factor estimation.
- Triplex pump volumetric displacement, slip factor compensation, and cavitation monitoring.
- Hydropneumatic pulsation dampener bladder nitrogen charge pressure supervision.
*)

(* Pipeline Velocity Calculation *)
IF rSlurryFeedFlow_FT101 > 0.05 THEN
    (* Convert flow from m3/h to m3/s: Q_m3s = Q_m3h / 3600.0 *)
    rSlurryVelocity := (rSlurryFeedFlow_FT101 / 3600.0) / rPipeCrossSectionArea;
ELSE
    rSlurryVelocity := 0.001;
END_IF;

(* Nominal Newtonian Wall Shear Rate: gamma_dot_0 = 8 * v / D *)
rShearRateNominal := (8.0 * rSlurryVelocity) / rPipeDiameter_D;

(* Rabinowitsch-Mooney Correction for Pseudoplastic Power-Law Behavior: (3n + 1) / (4n) *)
IF rSlurryFlowBehavior_n > 0.15 AND rSlurryFlowBehavior_n < 1.50 THEN
    rRabinowitschMooneyCorrection := (3.0 * rSlurryFlowBehavior_n + 1.0) / (4.0 * rSlurryFlowBehavior_n);
ELSE
    rRabinowitschMooneyCorrection := 1.0;
END_IF;

(* True Non-Newtonian Wall Shear Rate *)
rWallShearRate := rShearRateNominal * rRabinowitschMooneyCorrection;

(* Herschel-Bulkley Apparent Dynamic Viscosity [cP]: eta = (tau_0 / gamma_dot) + K * (gamma_dot)^(n-1) *)
(* Note: 1 Pa.s = 1000 cP *)
IF rWallShearRate > 0.01 THEN
    rTempCalc1 := (rSlurryYieldStress_Tau0 / rWallShearRate); (* Yield stress component in Pa.s *)
    rTempCalc2 := rSlurryConsistency_K * EXPT(rWallShearRate, (rSlurryFlowBehavior_n - 1.0)); (* Consistency component *)
    rApparentViscosity_Calculated := (rTempCalc1 + rTempCalc2) * 1000.0; (* Convert to cP *)
ELSE
    rApparentViscosity_Calculated := 4500.0; (* Upper boundary at zero-shear gelation *)
END_IF;

(* Bound Apparent Viscosity to Prevent Extreme Numerical Instabilities *)
IF rApparentViscosity_Calculated < 15.0 THEN
    rApparentViscosity_Calculated := 15.0;
ELSIF rApparentViscosity_Calculated > 10000.0 THEN
    rApparentViscosity_Calculated := 10000.0;
    dwAlarmWord1 := dwAlarmWord1 OR 16#00020000; (* Set Bit 17: Slurry Gelation Risk *)
END_IF;

(* Generalized Metzner-Reed Reynolds Number *)
IF rSlurryDensity_DT101 > 800.0 AND rSlurryVelocity > 0.005 THEN
    rTempCalc1 := rSlurryDensity_DT101 * EXPT(rPipeDiameter_D, rSlurryFlowBehavior_n) * EXPT(rSlurryVelocity, (2.0 - rSlurryFlowBehavior_n));
    rTempCalc2 := EXPT(8.0, (rSlurryFlowBehavior_n - 1.0)) * rSlurryConsistency_K * EXPT(rRabinowitschMooneyCorrection, rSlurryFlowBehavior_n);
    IF rTempCalc2 > 0.0001 THEN
        rGeneralizedReynoldsNumber := rTempCalc1 / rTempCalc2;
    ELSE
        rGeneralizedReynoldsNumber := 10.0;
    END_IF;
ELSE
    rGeneralizedReynoldsNumber := 1.0;
END_IF;

(* Fanning Friction Factor Evaluation *)
IF rGeneralizedReynoldsNumber < 2100.0 THEN
    (* Laminar Non-Newtonian Flow *)
    rFanningFrictionFactor := 16.0 / MAX(1.0, rGeneralizedReynoldsNumber);
ELSE
    (* Turbulent Slurry Flow: Blasius / Dodge-Metzner Approximation *)
    rFanningFrictionFactor := 0.0791 / EXPT(rGeneralizedReynoldsNumber, 0.25);
END_IF;

(* Pipeline Frictional Head Loss Across Reaction Core [bar] *)
(* Delta_P = (2 * f * L * rho * v^2) / (D) in Pascals; 1 bar = 100,000 Pa *)
rPipeFrictionalHeadLoss := (2.0 * rFanningFrictionFactor * rPipeLength_L * rSlurryDensity_DT101 * EXPT(rSlurryVelocity, 2.0)) / (rPipeDiameter_D * 100000.0);

(* Triplex Plunger Pump Kinematic Model *)
rPumpCrankSpeed_RPM := rSlurryPumpSpeedRef;
(* Plunger Swept Volume per Revolution: V_rev = 3 * (pi * D_plunger^2 / 4) * L_stroke *)
rTempCalc1 := 3.0 * (3.14159265 * EXPT(rPumpPistonDiameter, 2.0) / 4.0) * rPumpStrokeLength;
(* Theoretical Volumetric Capacity [m3/h] *)
rPumpTheoreticalDisplacement := rTempCalc1 * (rPumpCrankSpeed_RPM * 60.0);

(* High-Pressure Slip and Volumetric Efficiency Calculation *)
rTempCalc2 := rReactorPressure_Voted - rPumpSuctionPressure_PT100;
IF rTempCalc2 > 0.0 AND rApparentViscosity_Calculated > 1.0 THEN
    rPumpVolumetricEfficiency := 0.95 - (rPumpSlipCoefficient * SQRT(rTempCalc2 / (rApparentViscosity_Calculated / 1000.0)));
ELSE
    rPumpVolumetricEfficiency := 0.95;
END_IF;

IF rPumpVolumetricEfficiency < 0.70 THEN
    rPumpVolumetricEfficiency := 0.70;
END_IF;

(* Triplex Suction Net Positive Suction Head Margin (NPSH) Supervision *)
(* NPSH_available = (P_suction - P_vapor) / (rho * g) * 10^5 [m] or in [bar]: P_suct - P_vap *)
rPumpCavitationMargin_NPSH := rPumpSuctionPressure_PT100 - rVaporPressureAtSuctionTemp;

IF rPumpCavitationMargin_NPSH < rNPSH_Required THEN
    dwAlarmWord1 := dwAlarmWord1 OR 16#00000400; (* Set Bit 10: Slurry Pump Cavitation Risk *)
    bWarningActive := TRUE;
    (* Throttle pump speed to prevent destructive cavitation pitting *)
    IF rSlurryPumpSpeedRef > 300.0 THEN
        rSlurryPumpSpeedRef := rSlurryPumpSpeedRef - 5.0;
    END_IF;
END_IF;

(* Pulsation Dampener Hydropneumatic Bladder Charge Supervision *)
(* Nominal Nitrogen charge should be maintained at 65% - 80% of operating discharge pressure *)
IF rReactorPressure_Voted > 15.0 THEN
    rDamperGasPrechargeNominal := 0.72 * rReactorPressure_Voted;
    IF (rPumpDamperBladderPress_PT103 < (0.55 * rReactorPressure_Voted)) OR
       (rPumpDamperBladderPress_PT103 > (0.90 * rReactorPressure_Voted)) THEN
        dwAlarmWord1 := dwAlarmWord1 OR 16#00000800; (* Set Bit 11: Damper Nitrogen Drift *)
        bWarningActive := TRUE;
    END_IF;
END_IF;
(*
====================================================================================================
MODULE 2: REGENERATIVE COUNTER-CURRENT HEAT EXCHANGER FOULING THERMAL RESISTANCE OBSERVER
====================================================================================================
Thermodynamic Principles:
- Counter-current slurry-to-slurry heat recovery economizer.
- Strict LMTD calculation with singularity protection (L'Hopital limit for equal delta-Ts).
- Online heat duty Q_hx, observed overall heat transfer coefficient U_obs, and asymptotic fouling
  resistance R_f observer with first-order exponential smoothing.
- Cleanliness Index and automated predictive trigger for online hydro-cavitation CIP backpulse.
*)

(* Terminal Temperature Difference Evaluation *)
rDeltaT1_HX := rHotHydrocharTemp_Out_TT104 - rPreheatedSlurryTemp_TT103;
rDeltaT2_HX := rCooledHydrocharTemp_TT105 - rRawSlurryTemp_In_TT102;

(* LMTD Calculation with Safeguards *)
IF rDeltaT1_HX > 0.5 AND rDeltaT2_HX > 0.5 THEN
    IF ABS(rDeltaT1_HX - rDeltaT2_HX) < 0.20 THEN
        (* Arithmetic Mean Approximation near singularity *)
        rLMTD_Calculated := 0.5 * (rDeltaT1_HX + rDeltaT2_HX);
    ELSE
        rLMTD_Calculated := (rDeltaT1_HX - rDeltaT2_HX) / LN(rDeltaT1_HX / rDeltaT2_HX);
    END_IF;
ELSE
    rLMTD_Calculated := 15.0; (* Fallback baseline *)
END_IF;

(* Exchanger Thermal Recovery Duty [Watts]: Q = m_dot * Cp * Delta_T_cold *)
(* Mass flow rate: m_dot [kg/s] = (Q_vol [m3/h] * rho [kg/m3]) / 3600.0 *)
IF rSlurryFeedFlow_FT101 > 0.1 AND rSlurryDensity_DT101 > 800.0 THEN
    rTempCalc1 := (rSlurryFeedFlow_FT101 * rSlurryDensity_DT101) / 3600.0;
    rThermalDuty_Q_HX := rTempCalc1 * rSpecificHeatSlurry_Cp * MAX(0.0, (rPreheatedSlurryTemp_TT103 - rRawSlurryTemp_In_TT102));
ELSE
    rThermalDuty_Q_HX := 0.0;
END_IF;

(* Exchanger Counter-Current Thermal Effectiveness Ratio *)
IF (rHotHydrocharTemp_Out_TT104 - rRawSlurryTemp_In_TT102) > 5.0 THEN
    rHeatExchangerEffectiveness := ((rPreheatedSlurryTemp_TT103 - rRawSlurryTemp_In_TT102) /
                                    (rHotHydrocharTemp_Out_TT104 - rRawSlurryTemp_In_TT102)) * 100.0;
ELSE
    rHeatExchangerEffectiveness := 0.0;
END_IF;

(* Observed Overall Heat Transfer Coefficient U [W/m2.K]: U = Q / (A * LMTD) *)
IF (rHeatExchangerSurfaceArea_A > 1.0) AND (rLMTD_Calculated > 1.0) AND (rThermalDuty_Q_HX > 1000.0) THEN
    rInstantaneous_U := rThermalDuty_Q_HX / (rHeatExchangerSurfaceArea_A * rLMTD_Calculated);
ELSE
    rInstantaneous_U := rCleanOverallU_Baseline;
END_IF;

(* Bound U within Physical Thermodynamic Limits *)
IF rInstantaneous_U < 25.0 THEN
    rInstantaneous_U := 25.0;
ELSIF rInstantaneous_U > 1200.0 THEN
    rInstantaneous_U := 1200.0;
END_IF;
rOverallHeatTransferCoeff := rInstantaneous_U;

(* Exchanger Cleanliness Index [%] *)
rExchangerCleanlinessIndex := (rInstantaneous_U / rCleanOverallU_Baseline) * 100.0;

(* Online Asymptotic Thermal Fouling Resistance: R_f = (1 / U_obs) - (1 / U_clean) [m2.K/W] *)
rFoulingResistance_Raw := (1.0 / rInstantaneous_U) - (1.0 / rCleanOverallU_Baseline);
IF rFoulingResistance_Raw < 0.0 THEN
    rFoulingResistance_Raw := 0.0; (* Zero-bound clean surface *)
END_IF;

(* First-Order Discrete Exponential Low-Pass Filter: R_f_filt[k] = alpha*R_raw + (1-alpha)*R_filt[k-1] *)
rFoulingResistance_Filt := (rFoulingFilterConstant_Alpha * rFoulingResistance_Raw) +
                          ((1.0 - rFoulingFilterConstant_Alpha) * rFoulingResistance_Filt);
rFoulingResistanceObserver := rFoulingResistance_Filt;

(* Periodic Historical Array Storage for Trend Rate (dR_f / dt) Estimation *)
tFoulingObservationTimer(IN := TRUE, PT := T#10S);
IF tFoulingObservationTimer.Q THEN
    tFoulingObservationTimer(IN := FALSE);
    
    (* Store into circular buffer *)
    rHistoricalFoulingArray[iFoulingHistoryPointer] := rFoulingResistance_Filt;
    iFoulingHistoryPointer := iFoulingHistoryPointer + 1;
    IF iFoulingHistoryPointer > 10 THEN
        iFoulingHistoryPointer := 1;
    END_IF;
    
    (* Calculate hourly rate of fouling growth: delta_R / (10 steps * 10s = 100s) * 3600 *)
    rTempCalc1 := rHistoricalFoulingArray[10] - rHistoricalFoulingArray[1];
    rFoulingGrowthRate := (rTempCalc1 / 100.0) * 3600.0; (* m2.K/W per hour *)
    
    (* Estimated time remaining before reaching critical fouling threshold *)
    IF rFoulingGrowthRate > 0.000001 THEN
        rEstimatedCIP_TimeRemaining := MAX(0.0, (rFoulingCriticalThreshold - rFoulingResistance_Filt) / rFoulingGrowthRate * 60.0);
    ELSE
        rEstimatedCIP_TimeRemaining := 999.0;
    END_IF;
END_IF;

(* Exchanger Fouling Critical Interlocks & Warnings *)
IF (rFoulingResistance_Filt > rFoulingCriticalThreshold) OR (rEconomizerDiffPressure_PDT201 > 6.80) THEN
    dwAlarmWord1 := dwAlarmWord1 OR 16#00000200; (* Set Bit 09: Fouling Resistance Exceeded *)
    IF rEconomizerDiffPressure_PDT201 > 7.00 THEN
        dwAlarmWord1 := dwAlarmWord1 OR 16#00000100; (* Set Bit 08: Exchanger Tube dP High-High *)
    END_IF;
    bWarningActive := TRUE;
    
    (* Trigger Automated CIP Request if system is in steady state *)
    IF (iState = 50 OR iState = 55) AND NOT bCIP_CycleActive THEN
        iNextState := 60; (* Queue CIP Backpulse Transition *)
    END_IF;
END_IF;
(*
====================================================================================================
MODULE 3: CONTINUOUS HTC REACTOR KINETICS & AUTOTHERMAL ENERGY BALANCE
====================================================================================================
Chemical Engineering Fundamentals:
- Hydrothermal Carbonization depolymerization kinetics via Arrhenius relationship.
- Exothermic reaction enthalpy generation estimation: Delta_H_rxn = -1.42 MJ/kg dry solids.
- Subcritical liquid phase verification via Wagner/Antoine vapor pressure formulation.
- Overpressure margin verification: Delta_P = P_core - P_sat(T) >= 4.0 bar.
*)

(* Subcritical Saturation Vapor Pressure Calculation for Water (Antoine / Wagner Simplified) *)
(* T in deg C; P_sat in bar *)
IF rReactorTemp_Voted > 10.0 AND rReactorTemp_Voted < 280.0 THEN
    rTempCalc1 := 11.6834 - (3816.44 / (rReactorTemp_Voted + 227.02));
    rTempCalc2 := EXP(rTempCalc1); (* P_sat in bar *)
ELSE
    rTempCalc2 := 1.0;
END_IF;

(* Subcooling Overpressure Margin *)
rSubcoolingMargin_Voted := rReactorPressure_Voted - rTempCalc2;

(* Critical Subcooling Margin Supervision: Prevent Bulk Flashing Inside Reactor Core *)
IF rSubcoolingMargin_Voted < 2.50 THEN
    dwAlarmWord1 := dwAlarmWord1 OR 16#00000008; (* Set Bit 03: Subcooling Margin Low-Low *)
    bWarningActive := TRUE;
    (* Immediate Safety Action: Interlock Auxiliary Trim Steam and Throttle Flash Valve *)
    rTrimSteamValveCmd := 0.0;
    IF rFlashStage1ValveCmd > 5.0 THEN
        rFlashStage1ValveCmd := rFlashStage1ValveCmd - 3.0;
    END_IF;
END_IF;

(* Arrhenius Reaction Kinetic Constant Calculation: k = A0 * exp(-Ea / (R * T_K)) *)
rTempCalc1 := rReactorTemp_Voted + 273.15; (* Absolute temperature in Kelvin *)
IF rTempCalc1 > 350.0 THEN
    rTempCalc2 := -rHTC_ActivationEnergy_Ea / (rUniversalGasConstant_R * rTempCalc1);
    IF rTempCalc2 > -40.0 THEN
        rKineticRateConstant_k := rHTC_Arrhenius_PreExp_A0 * EXP(rTempCalc2);
    ELSE
        rKineticRateConstant_k := 0.0;
    END_IF;
ELSE
    rKineticRateConstant_k := 0.0;
END_IF;

(* Volatile Solids Carbonization Reaction Extent: alpha = 1 - exp(-k * tau) *)
IF rSlurryFeedFlow_FT101 > 0.1 THEN
    (* Hydrodynamic liquid residence time: tau = V_core / Q_vol *)
    rSlurryResidenceTime_tau := (3.85 / (rSlurryFeedFlow_FT101 / 3600.0)); (* approx 3.85 m3 core volume *)
ELSE
    rSlurryResidenceTime_tau := 1800.0;
END_IF;

rTempCalc3 := -rKineticRateConstant_k * rSlurryResidenceTime_tau;
IF rTempCalc3 > -25.0 THEN
    rBiomassConversionFraction := 1.0 - EXP(rTempCalc3);
ELSE
    rBiomassConversionFraction := 1.0;
END_IF;
rCarbonizationDegree := rBiomassConversionFraction * 100.0;

(* Real-Time Exothermic Reaction Power Release: Q_rxn [kW] = m_dot_dry * Delta_H * alpha *)
(* Dry solids mass fraction estimated at 15.0% dry solids w/w *)
IF rSlurryFeedFlow_FT101 > 0.1 AND rSlurryDensity_DT101 > 800.0 THEN
    rTempCalc1 := (rSlurryFeedFlow_FT101 * rSlurryDensity_DT101 / 3600.0) * 0.15; (* kg dry solids / s *)
    rReactionHeatReleaseEst := (rTempCalc1 * (rHTC_EnthalpyExothermic_DeltaH / 1000.0) * rBiomassConversionFraction);
ELSE
    rReactionHeatReleaseEst := 0.0;
END_IF;

(* Autothermal Index: Ratio of Exothermic Heat Release to Reactor Sensible Heating Demand *)
(* Heat Demand: Q_req = m_dot * Cp * (T_core - T_preheat) + Q_loss *)
IF rSlurryFeedFlow_FT101 > 0.1 THEN
    rTempCalc1 := (rSlurryFeedFlow_FT101 * rSlurryDensity_DT101 / 3600.0); (* Total slurry kg/s *)
    rTempCalc2 := (rTempCalc1 * (rSpecificHeatSlurry_Cp / 1000.0) * MAX(0.0, (rReactorTemp_Voted - rPreheatedSlurryTemp_TT103))) + rAmbientThermalLossRate;
    IF rTempCalc2 > 1.0 THEN
        rAutothermalIndex := rReactionHeatReleaseEst / rTempCalc2;
    ELSE
        rAutothermalIndex := 1.0;
    END_IF;
ELSE
    rAutothermalIndex := 0.0;
END_IF;
(*
====================================================================================================
MODULE 4: STATE-SPACE MODEL PREDICTIVE CONTROL (MPC) RECEDING HORIZON SOLVER
====================================================================================================
Optimization & Control Theory:
- Discrete-time Linear Time-Varying (LTV) State-Space model:
    x[k+1] = A_d * x[k] + B_d * u[k]
    y[k]   = C_d * x[k] + D_d * u[k]
- Multivariable Quadratic Cost Function:
    J = (x - x_ref)^T * Q * (x - x_ref) + Delta_u^T * R * Delta_u
- Active Projected Gradient Descent with hard actuator saturation bounds and rate-of-change limits.
*)

(* Populate Current Deviation States from Process Measurements *)
x_StateVector[1] := rReactorTemp_Voted - rSetpointTemp;        (* Delta T_core [K] *)
x_StateVector[2] := rReactorPressure_Voted - rSetpointPressure;(* Delta P_core [bar] *)
x_StateVector[3] := rInfluentLiquidCOD_AT301 * (1.0 - (rTargetCOD_Reduction / 100.0)); (* Soluble COD Target Deviation *)
x_StateVector[4] := rPreheatedSlurryTemp_TT103 - 175.0;        (* Delta T_preheat [K] *)
x_StateVector[5] := (rFoulingResistance_Filt - 0.00015) * 10000.0; (* Scaled Delta R_fouling *)
x_StateVector[6] := rPumpDischargePressure_PT102 - rReactorPressure_Voted; (* Slurry Pump Head Deviation *)

(* State Prediction via Discrete Matrix Multiplication: x_pred = A_d * x + B_d * u_prev *)
FOR iLoopIndex1 := 1 TO 6 DO
    rTempCalc1 := 0.0;
    FOR iLoopIndex2 := 1 TO 6 DO
        rTempCalc1 := rTempCalc1 + (A_Matrix[iLoopIndex1, iLoopIndex2] * x_StateVector[iLoopIndex2]);
    END_FOR;
    FOR iLoopIndex3 := 1 TO 4 DO
        rTempCalc1 := rTempCalc1 + (B_Matrix[iLoopIndex1, iLoopIndex3] * u_PreviousControl[iLoopIndex3]);
    END_FOR;
    x_PredictedState[iLoopIndex1] := rTempCalc1;
END_FOR;

(* Evaluate Objective Quadratic Cost Function J *)
rMPC_ObjectiveCost := 0.0;
FOR iLoopIndex1 := 1 TO 6 DO
    rTempCalc1 := x_PredictedState[iLoopIndex1] - x_StateReference[iLoopIndex1];
    rMPC_ObjectiveCost := rMPC_ObjectiveCost + (rTempCalc1 * Q_WeightDiag[iLoopIndex1] * rTempCalc1);
END_FOR;
FOR iLoopIndex3 := 1 TO 4 DO
    rTempCalc2 := u_ControlVector[iLoopIndex3] - u_PreviousControl[iLoopIndex3];
    rMPC_ObjectiveCost := rMPC_ObjectiveCost + (rTempCalc2 * R_WeightDiag[iLoopIndex3] * rTempCalc2);
END_FOR;

(* Optimization: Iterative Projected Gradient Descent Solver *)
IF (iState = 50 OR iState = 55) AND NOT bEmergencyTripped THEN
    FOR iMPC_IterationCounter := 1 TO 5 DO
        (* Calculate Gradient Vector: grad = B^T * Q * (x_pred - x_ref) + R * Delta_u *)
        FOR iLoopIndex3 := 1 TO 4 DO
            rTempCalc1 := 0.0;
            FOR iLoopIndex1 := 1 TO 6 DO
                rTempCalc2 := x_PredictedState[iLoopIndex1] - x_StateReference[iLoopIndex1];
                rTempCalc1 := rTempCalc1 + (B_Matrix[iLoopIndex1, iLoopIndex3] * Q_WeightDiag[iLoopIndex1] * rTempCalc2);
            END_FOR;
            rTempCalc3 := u_ControlVector[iLoopIndex3] - u_PreviousControl[iLoopIndex3];
            u_ControlGradient[iLoopIndex3] := rTempCalc1 + (R_WeightDiag[iLoopIndex3] * rTempCalc3);
            
            (* Projected Gradient Step *)
            u_ControlVector[iLoopIndex3] := u_ControlVector[iLoopIndex3] - (rMPC_GradientStepSize * u_ControlGradient[iLoopIndex3]);
        END_FOR;
    END_FOR;
END_IF;

(* Actuator 1: Slurry Pump Speed Slew & Saturation Mapping *)
u_DeltaControl[1] := u_ControlVector[1] - u_PreviousControl[1];
IF u_DeltaControl[1] > rPumpSpeed_MaxSlew THEN
    u_ControlVector[1] := u_PreviousControl[1] + rPumpSpeed_MaxSlew;
ELSIF u_DeltaControl[1] < -rPumpSpeed_MaxSlew THEN
    u_ControlVector[1] := u_PreviousControl[1] - rPumpSpeed_MaxSlew;
END_IF;

IF (iState = 50 OR iState = 55) THEN
    (* Map control output to pump speed reference *)
    rSlurryPumpSpeedRef := 650.0 + u_ControlVector[1];
    IF rSlurryPumpSpeedRef < rPumpSpeed_Min THEN
        rSlurryPumpSpeedRef := rPumpSpeed_Min;
    ELSIF rSlurryPumpSpeedRef > rPumpSpeed_Max THEN
        rSlurryPumpSpeedRef := rPumpSpeed_Max;
    END_IF;
    rSlurryPumpStrokeCmd := 100.0; (* Full mechanical displacement *)
END_IF;

(* Actuator 2: Utility Trim Steam Valve Slew & Saturation Mapping *)
u_DeltaControl[2] := u_ControlVector[2] - u_PreviousControl[2];
IF u_DeltaControl[2] > rSteamValve_MaxSlew THEN
    u_ControlVector[2] := u_PreviousControl[2] + rSteamValve_MaxSlew;
ELSIF u_DeltaControl[2] < -rSteamValve_MaxSlew THEN
    u_ControlVector[2] := u_PreviousControl[2] - rSteamValve_MaxSlew;
END_IF;

IF (iState = 50 OR iState = 55) THEN
    (* Base steam position modulates down if reaction is self-sustaining autothermal *)
    IF rAutothermalIndex >= 1.05 THEN
        rTrimSteamValveCmd := 4.0 + (0.35 * u_ControlVector[2]); (* Low trim pilot mode *)
    ELSE
        rTrimSteamValveCmd := 28.0 + u_ControlVector[2];
    END_IF;
    
    IF rTrimSteamValveCmd < rSteamValve_Min THEN
        rTrimSteamValveCmd := rSteamValve_Min;
    ELSIF rTrimSteamValveCmd > rSteamValve_Max THEN
        rTrimSteamValveCmd := rSteamValve_Max;
    END_IF;
END_IF;

(* Actuator 3: Flash Stage 1 Choke Valve Slew & Saturation Mapping *)
u_DeltaControl[3] := u_ControlVector[3] - u_PreviousControl[3];
IF u_DeltaControl[3] > rFlashValve_MaxSlew THEN
    u_ControlVector[3] := u_PreviousControl[3] + rFlashValve_MaxSlew;
ELSIF u_DeltaControl[3] < -rFlashValve_MaxSlew THEN
    u_ControlVector[3] := u_PreviousControl[3] - rFlashValve_MaxSlew;
END_IF;

IF (iState = 50 OR iState = 55) THEN
    rFlashStage1ValveCmd := 42.0 + u_ControlVector[3];
    IF rFlashStage1ValveCmd < rFlashValve_Min THEN
        rFlashStage1ValveCmd := rFlashValve_Min;
    ELSIF rFlashStage1ValveCmd > rFlashValve_Max THEN
        rFlashStage1ValveCmd := rFlashValve_Max;
    END_IF;
END_IF;

(* Actuator 4: WAO Sparging Air Valve Slew & Saturation Mapping *)
u_DeltaControl[4] := u_ControlVector[4] - u_PreviousControl[4];
IF u_DeltaControl[4] > rAirValve_MaxSlew THEN
    u_ControlVector[4] := u_PreviousControl[4] + rAirValve_MaxSlew;
ELSIF u_DeltaControl[4] < -rAirValve_MaxSlew THEN
    u_ControlVector[4] := u_PreviousControl[4] - rAirValve_MaxSlew;
END_IF;

IF (iState = 55) THEN
    rWAO_AirSpargingValveCmd := 35.0 + u_ControlVector[4];
    IF rWAO_AirSpargingValveCmd < rAirValve_Min THEN
        rWAO_AirSpargingValveCmd := rAirValve_Min;
    ELSIF rWAO_AirSpargingValveCmd > rAirValve_Max THEN
        rWAO_AirSpargingValveCmd := rAirValve_Max;
    END_IF;
ELSE
    rWAO_AirSpargingValveCmd := 0.0;
END_IF;

(* Store Control History for Next Discrete Cycle *)
FOR iLoopIndex3 := 1 TO 4 DO
    u_PreviousControl[iLoopIndex3] := u_ControlVector[iLoopIndex3];
END_FOR;
(*
====================================================================================================
MODULE 5: STEAM-ASSISTED HYDROCHAR FLASH DEPRESSURIZATION & MULTI-STAGE CHOKE
====================================================================================================
Process Mechanics:
- Controlled pressure letdown from 30.0 bar reactor core down to 8.0 bar (Stage 1 Knock-Out Drum)
  and 1.5 bar (Stage 2 Hydrochar Receiver).
- Flashing vapor fraction x_flash and superficial vapor disengagement velocity estimation.
- Souders-Brown critical entrainment velocity limits and ceramic choke trim cavitation index sigma.
- Cyclic anti-coking steam pulse injection to prevent valve throat plugging.
*)

(* Flashing Vapor Mass Fraction in Stage 1 Depressurization: x_v1 = (h_L,in - h_L,out) / h_LV *)
IF (rFlashStage1EnthalpyVaporOut - rFlashStage1EnthalpyLiquidOut) > 10.0 THEN
    rFlashStage1SteamFraction := (rFlashStage1EnthalpyLiquidIn - rFlashStage1EnthalpyLiquidOut) /
                                 (rFlashStage1EnthalpyVaporOut - rFlashStage1EnthalpyLiquidOut);
ELSE
    rFlashStage1SteamFraction := 0.125;
END_IF;

(* Bound Calculated Flash Vapor Fraction (nominal ~11.0% to 14.5%) *)
IF rFlashStage1SteamFraction < 0.05 THEN
    rFlashStage1SteamFraction := 0.05;
ELSIF rFlashStage1SteamFraction > 0.22 THEN
    rFlashStage1SteamFraction := 0.22;
END_IF;

(* Souders-Brown Maximum Allowable Vapor Disengagement Velocity: v_max = K_SB * sqrt((rho_L - rho_V) / rho_V) *)
IF rFlashStage1VaporDensity > 0.1 THEN
    rMaxAllowableVaporVelocity := rSoudersBrownCoefficient_KSB *
                                  SQRT((rFlashStage1LiquidDensity - rFlashStage1VaporDensity) / rFlashStage1VaporDensity);
ELSE
    rMaxAllowableVaporVelocity := 0.65;
END_IF;

(* Actual Superficial Vapor Velocity in Knock-Out Drum *)
(* Drum Cross-Sectional Area: A_drum = pi * D^2 / 4 *)
rTempCalc1 := 3.14159265 * EXPT(rFlashVesselVesselDiameter, 2.0) / 4.0;
IF rTempCalc1 > 0.1 AND rFlashStage1VaporDensity > 0.1 AND rSlurryFeedFlow_FT101 > 0.1 THEN
    (* Mass flow of flashing steam: m_dot_steam = m_dot_slurry * x_flash *)
    rTempCalc2 := ((rSlurryFeedFlow_FT101 * rSlurryDensity_DT101) / 3600.0) * rFlashStage1SteamFraction;
    rActualVaporVelocity := rTempCalc2 / (rFlashStage1VaporDensity * rTempCalc1);
ELSE
    rActualVaporVelocity := 0.0;
END_IF;

(* Entrainment Velocity Supervision *)
IF rActualVaporVelocity > (0.85 * rMaxAllowableVaporVelocity) THEN
    dwAlarmWord1 := dwAlarmWord1 OR 16#00002000; (* Set Bit 13: Flash Entrainment Velocity Exceeded *)
    bWarningActive := TRUE;
    (* Throttle Stage 1 Valve to suppress foaming / slurry carryover into steam exhaust *)
    IF rFlashStage1ValveCmd > 10.0 THEN
        rFlashStage1ValveCmd := rFlashStage1ValveCmd - 2.5;
    END_IF;
END_IF;

(* Severe-Service Ceramic Valve Cavitation Vulnerability Index: sigma = (P_up - P_vap) / (P_up - P_down) *)
rTempCalc1 := rReactorPressure_Voted - rFlashStage1Pressure_PT501;
IF rTempCalc1 > 0.5 THEN
    rCavitationIndex_Sigma := (rReactorPressure_Voted - rTempCalc2) / rTempCalc1;
ELSE
    rCavitationIndex_Sigma := 2.5;
END_IF;

IF rCavitationIndex_Sigma < 1.15 THEN
    dwAlarmWord1 := dwAlarmWord1 OR 16#00001000; (* Set Bit 12: Valve Cavitation Choke Risk *)
    bWarningActive := TRUE;
END_IF;

(* Secondary Flash Letdown Control (Stage 2: 8.0 bar -> 1.5 bar) *)
(* Modulate CV-202 to maintain intermediate Stage 1 drum pressure at 8.0 bar *)
IF rFlashStage1Pressure_PT501 > 8.20 THEN
    rFlashStage2ValveCmd := rFlashStage2ValveCmd + 1.2;
ELSIF rFlashStage1Pressure_PT501 < 7.80 THEN
    rFlashStage2ValveCmd := rFlashStage2ValveCmd - 1.2;
END_IF;

IF rFlashStage2ValveCmd < 0.0 THEN
    rFlashStage2ValveCmd := 0.0;
ELSIF rFlashStage2ValveCmd > 100.0 THEN
    rFlashStage2ValveCmd := 100.0;
END_IF;

(* Periodic Anti-Coking Steam Purge Pulse Cycle: High-Pressure Steam Burst to Clear Nozzle *)
tSteamPurgePulseTimer(IN := NOT bSteamPurgePulseActive, PT := T#120S);
IF tSteamPurgePulseTimer.Q THEN
    bSteamPurgePulseActive := TRUE;
END_IF;

IF bSteamPurgePulseActive THEN
    (* Active steam purge sequence for 3.0 seconds *)
    tSubTimer(IN := TRUE, PT := T#3S);
    IF tSubTimer.Q THEN
        tSubTimer(IN := FALSE);
        bSteamPurgePulseActive := FALSE;
    END_IF;
END_IF;
(*
====================================================================================================
MODULE 6: WET AIR OXIDATION (WAO) & SOLUBLE COD DECOUPLING CONTROLLER
====================================================================================================
Reaction Engineering & Multivariable Decoupling:
- Wet Air Oxidation converts soluble refractory organic carbon (VFAs, phenols, aldehydes)
  into carbon dioxide and low molecular weight organic acids.
- Arrhenius oxidation kinetics and Henry's law dissolved oxygen mass transfer.
- Multivariable Decoupling Feedforward Compensator: Eliminates strong thermal cross-coupling
  between exothermic COD oxidation heat release and reactor core temperature.
- Headspace Off-Gas Safety Interlock: Combustible Lower Explosive Limit (LEL) and O2 monitoring.
*)

(* Oxygen Solubility via Henry's Law at 220 deg C: C*_O2 = H * P_O2 *)
(* Air comprises approx. 21.0% O2 by volume: P_O2 = 0.21 * P_compressed_air *)
IF rCompressedAirPressure_PT401 > 1.0 THEN
    rPartialPressure_O2 := 0.21 * rCompressedAirPressure_PT401;
    rDissolvedOxygenEquilibrium := rHenryLawConstant_O2 * rPartialPressure_O2 * 32000.0; (* in mg/L *)
ELSE
    rDissolvedOxygenEquilibrium := 0.5;
END_IF;

(* Temperature-Dependent WAO Oxidation Kinetic Rate: k_WAO = A0 * exp(-Ea / (R * T)) *)
rTempCalc1 := rReactorTemp_Voted + 273.15;
IF rTempCalc1 > 350.0 THEN
    rTempCalc2 := -rWAO_ActivationEnergy / (rUniversalGasConstant_R * rTempCalc1);
    IF rTempCalc2 > -35.0 THEN
        rTempCalc3 := rWAO_Arrhenius_A0 * EXP(rTempCalc2);
    ELSE
        rTempCalc3 := 0.0;
    END_IF;
ELSE
    rTempCalc3 := 0.0;
END_IF;

(* Observer Estimate of Effluent Soluble COD [mg/L] *)
IF rInfluentLiquidCOD_AT301 > 100.0 AND rSlurryResidenceTime_tau > 10.0 THEN
    (* First-order oxidation conversion with DO availability constraint *)
    rTempCalc4 := 1.0 + (rTempCalc3 * rSlurryResidenceTime_tau * MIN(1.0, (rDissolvedOxygen_DO401 / 5.0)));
    rEffluentCOD_Estimate := rInfluentLiquidCOD_AT301 / rTempCalc4;
ELSE
    rEffluentCOD_Estimate := rInfluentLiquidCOD_AT301;
END_IF;

(* Soluble COD Destruction Efficiency Rate [%] *)
IF rInfluentLiquidCOD_AT301 > 50.0 THEN
    rCOD_DestructionRate := ((rInfluentLiquidCOD_AT301 - rEffluentCOD_Estimate) / rInfluentLiquidCOD_AT301) * 100.0;
ELSE
    rCOD_DestructionRate := 0.0;
END_IF;

(* Multivariable Decoupling Feedforward Compensator *)
(* Oxidation of COD releases ~13.8 MJ/kg COD destroyed, creating thermal heat in the core *)
(* Decoupler cancels thermal interaction by trimming steam valve inversely to air flow *)
IF rSteamThermalDirectGain > 0.01 THEN
    rDecouplingCompensatorGain := -(rWAO_ThermalCrossCouplingGain / rSteamThermalDirectGain);
ELSE
    rDecouplingCompensatorGain := -0.65;
END_IF;

IF (iState = 55) THEN
    (* Apply feedforward trim to steam valve *)
    rTrimSteamValveCmd := rTrimSteamValveCmd + (rDecouplingCompensatorGain * (rWAO_AirSpargingValveCmd - 35.0));
    IF rTrimSteamValveCmd < 0.0 THEN
        rTrimSteamValveCmd := 0.0;
    ELSIF rTrimSteamValveCmd > 100.0 THEN
        rTrimSteamValveCmd := 100.0;
    END_IF;
END_IF;

(* Off-Gas Headspace Safety Interlocks (ISA-84 / IEC 61511 Safety Instrument) *)
IF rReactorHeadspaceLEL_AT403 > 25.0 THEN
    dwAlarmWord1 := dwAlarmWord1 OR 16#00004000; (* Set Bit 14: Headspace LEL High Warning *)
    bWarningActive := TRUE;
    (* Throttle technical air flow immediately *)
    rWAO_AirSpargingValveCmd := 0.0;
    rNitrogenInertingValveCmd := 50.0; (* Inject Nitrogen to dilute headspace *)
END_IF;

IF rReactorHeadspaceO2_AT402 > 4.50 THEN
    dwAlarmWord1 := dwAlarmWord1 OR 16#00008000; (* Set Bit 15: Headspace Oxygen High-High Trip *)
    bEmergencyTripped := TRUE;
    (* Immediate trip of compressed air supply *)
    rWAO_AirSpargingValveCmd := 0.0;
    rNitrogenInertingValveCmd := 100.0;
    iState := 90;
    RETURN;
END_IF;
(*
====================================================================================================
MODULE 7: HIERARCHICAL INDUSTRIAL FINITE STATE MACHINE
====================================================================================================
State Architecture:
- State 0:  STATE_COLD_IDLE (Cold uncommissioned standby)
- State 10: STATE_NITROGEN_INERTING_PURGE (Displace air with N2 until O2 < 0.5%)

        (* Verify headspace oxygen concentration falls below 0.5% vol *)
        IF rReactorHeadspaceO2_AT402 < 0.50 THEN
            tSubTimer(IN := TRUE, PT := T#15S); (* Dwell to ensure complete displacement *)
            IF tSubTimer.Q THEN
                tSubTimer(IN := FALSE);
                tStateTimer(IN := FALSE);
                rNitrogenInertingValveCmd := 5.0; (* Low nitrogen blanket bias *)
                rFlashStage1ValveCmd := 0.0;
                rFlashStage2ValveCmd := 0.0;
                wStatusWord := wStatusWord OR 16#0004; (* Set Bit 02: Inerting Complete *)
                iState := 20; (* Proceed to Hydraulic Pressure Test *)
            END_IF;

        (* ================================================================= *)

        rSlurryPumpSpeedRef := 250.0; (* Low pump speed on water feed *)
        rSlurryPumpStrokeCmd := 100.0;
        rFlashStage1ValveCmd := 0.0;  (* Closed to build hydraulic pressure *)
        rFlashStage2ValveCmd := 0.0;

        IF rTargetCOD_Reduction < 5.0 THEN

        rTrimSteamValveCmd := 0.0;

        IF tPurgeDisplacementTimer.Q OR (rSlurryDensity_DT101 < 1010.0) THEN

        END_IF;

        (* ================================================================= *)

            rFlashStage2ValveCmd := 0.0;

(* =================================================================================================

    bInterlockActive    := TRUE;

    rPump2FlowCmd_mLmin := 0.0;             (* Immediately stop secondary cavity delivery pump *)
    rGasKnifeVelocityCmd_ms := 0.0;         (* Shut down quenching nitrogen blower jet *)
    rWebTensionTrim_N   := 0.0;             (* Release active tension synchronization trim *)
    dwActiveAlarms      := dwActiveAlarms OR 16#00000001; (* Bit 0: Hardware E-Stop or Enable Lost *)
    iMachineState       := 120;             (* Jump directly to EMERGENCY_RETRACT_SAFE_TRIP state *)
END_IF;

(* First Scan Initialization of Hard Real-Time State-Space & Covariance Matrices *)
IF NOT bFirstScanDone THEN
    (* Discrete System Dynamics Matrix A (Ts = 10 ms) *)
    matA[1, 1] := 0.9450; matA[1, 2] := -0.0120; matA[1, 3] := -0.0450; matA[1, 4] :=  0.0080; matA[1, 5] :=  0.0650;

    matA[3, 1] := 0.0210; matA[3, 2] := -0.0350; matA[3, 3] :=  0.9120; matA[3, 4] :=  0.0150; matA[3, 5] :=  0.0820;
    matA[4, 1] := 0.0000; matA[4, 2] :=  0.0000; matA[4, 3] :=  0.0000; matA[4, 4] :=  0.9250; matA[4, 5] :=  0.0000;

    matB[1, 1] := 0.0850; matB[1, 2] :=  0.0050; matB[1, 3] := -0.0220; matB[1, 4] := -0.0450; matB[1, 5] :=  0.0380;
    matB[2, 1] := 0.0000; matB[2, 2] :=  0.1450; matB[2, 3] :=  0.0000; matB[2, 4] :=  0.0000; matB[2, 5] := -0.0920;
    matB[3, 1] := 0.0150; matB[3, 2] := -0.0180; matB[3, 3] :=  0.1650; matB[3, 4] :=  0.0780; matB[3, 5] :=  0.0250;
    matB[4, 1] := 0.0000; matB[4, 2] :=  0.0000; matB[4, 3] :=  0.0000; matB[4, 4] :=  0.1850; matB[4, 5] :=  0.0000;
    matB[5, 1] := 0.0000; matB[5, 2] :=  0.0000; matB[5, 3] :=  0.0000; matB[5, 4] :=  0.0000; matB[5, 5] :=  0.1500;

    (* Measurement Sensitivity Matrix C *)
    matC[1, 1] := 1.0000; matC[1, 2] := 0.0000; matC[1, 3] := 0.0000; matC[1, 4] := 0.0000; matC[1, 5] := 0.0000;
    matC[2, 1] := 0.0000; matC[2, 2] := 1.0000; matC[2, 3] := 0.0000; matC[2, 4] := 0.0000; matC[2, 5] := 0.0000;
    matC[3, 1] := 0.0000; matC[3, 2] := 0.0000; matC[3, 3] := 1.0000; matC[3, 4] := 0.0000; matC[3, 5] := 0.0000;
    matC[4, 1] := 0.0000; matC[4, 2] := 0.0000; matC[4, 3] := 0.0000; matC[4, 4] := 1.0000; matC[4, 5] := 0.0000;

    (* Discrete Kalman Filter Innovation Gain Matrix K *)
    matK_Kalman[1, 1] := 0.3250; matK_Kalman[1, 2] := 0.0120; matK_Kalman[1, 3] := 0.0450; matK_Kalman[1, 4] := 0.0020; matK_Kalman[1, 5] := 0.0180;

    vecWeight_R[4] := 1.80;     (* Backing roll velocity trim slew penalty *)
    vecWeight_R[5] := 2.20;     (* Piezo nano-stage position slew penalty *)

    vecU_Min[1] := 0.05;        vecU_Max[1] := 25.0;        vecDeltaU_Max[1] := 0.75;   (* Flow rate [mL/min] *)
