(* =================================================================================================
   SECTION 2: TRIPLE MODULAR REDUNDANCY (2oo3 TMR) SENSOR VOTING ENGINES
   ================================================================================================= *)

(* -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
   SUB-SECTION 2.1: UPSTREAM MENISCUS VACUUM 2oo3 TMR VOTING ALGORITHM
   Channel A: Primary Lip Transducer | Channel B: Redundant Port B | Channel C: Differential Gauge C
   ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
rVacDiscrepancy_AB := ABS(rMeniscusVacuum_mbar - rMeniscusVacuum_SensorB_mbar);
rVacDiscrepancy_BC := ABS(rMeniscusVacuum_SensorB_mbar - rMeniscusVacuum_SensorC_mbar);
rVacDiscrepancy_CA := ABS(rMeniscusVacuum_SensorC_mbar - rMeniscusVacuum_mbar);

(* Range Plausibility Screening: Meniscus vacuum must remain within -25.0 to 0.5 mbar *)
IF (rMeniscusVacuum_mbar < -25.0) OR (rMeniscusVacuum_mbar > 0.5) THEN
    bVacA_Healthy := FALSE;
ELSE
    bVacA_Healthy := TRUE;
END_IF;

IF (rMeniscusVacuum_SensorB_mbar < -25.0) OR (rMeniscusVacuum_SensorB_mbar > 0.5) THEN
    bVacB_Healthy := FALSE;
ELSE
    bVacB_Healthy := TRUE;
END_IF;

IF (rMeniscusVacuum_SensorC_mbar < -25.0) OR (rMeniscusVacuum_SensorC_mbar > 0.5) THEN
    bVacC_Healthy := FALSE;
ELSE
    bVacC_Healthy := TRUE;
END_IF;

(* Cross-Channel Drift & Discrepancy Isolation *)
IF bVacA_Healthy AND bVacB_Healthy AND (rVacDiscrepancy_AB > rVacuumTolerance_mbar) THEN
    IF rVacDiscrepancy_CA > rVacuumTolerance_mbar THEN
        bVacA_Healthy := FALSE; (* Ch A deviates from both B and C -> Isolate Channel A *)
    ELSIF rVacDiscrepancy_BC > rVacuumTolerance_mbar THEN
        bVacB_Healthy := FALSE; (* Ch B deviates from both A and C -> Isolate Channel B *)
    END_IF;
END_IF;

IF bVacB_Healthy AND bVacC_Healthy AND (rVacDiscrepancy_BC > rVacuumTolerance_mbar) THEN
    IF (rVacDiscrepancy_CA > rVacuumTolerance_mbar) AND bVacA_Healthy THEN
        bVacC_Healthy := FALSE; (* Ch C deviates from both A and B -> Isolate Channel C *)
    END_IF;
END_IF;

(* Tally Healthy Channels *)
iVacHealthyCount := 0;
IF bVacA_Healthy THEN iVacHealthyCount := iVacHealthyCount + 1; END_IF;
IF bVacB_Healthy THEN iVacHealthyCount := iVacHealthyCount + 1; END_IF;
IF bVacC_Healthy THEN iVacHealthyCount := iVacHealthyCount + 1; END_IF;

IF iVacHealthyCount = 3 THEN
    (* True Median Select Logic *)
    IF ((rMeniscusVacuum_mbar >= rMeniscusVacuum_SensorB_mbar) AND (rMeniscusVacuum_mbar <= rMeniscusVacuum_SensorC_mbar)) OR
       ((rMeniscusVacuum_mbar <= rMeniscusVacuum_SensorB_mbar) AND (rMeniscusVacuum_mbar >= rMeniscusVacuum_SensorC_mbar)) THEN
        rVotedVacuum_mbar := rMeniscusVacuum_mbar;
    ELSIF ((rMeniscusVacuum_SensorB_mbar >= rMeniscusVacuum_mbar) AND (rMeniscusVacuum_SensorB_mbar <= rMeniscusVacuum_SensorC_mbar)) OR
          ((rMeniscusVacuum_SensorB_mbar <= rMeniscusVacuum_mbar) AND (rMeniscusVacuum_SensorB_mbar >= rMeniscusVacuum_SensorC_mbar)) THEN
        rVotedVacuum_mbar := rMeniscusVacuum_SensorB_mbar;
    ELSE
        rVotedVacuum_mbar := rMeniscusVacuum_SensorC_mbar;
    END_IF;
    tVacDiscrepancyTimer(IN := FALSE, PT := T#1500MS);
ELSIF iVacHealthyCount = 2 THEN
    (* Degraded 1oo2 Fail-Operational Mode: Compute Average of Pair *)
    IF bVacA_Healthy AND bVacB_Healthy THEN
        rVotedVacuum_mbar := 0.5 * (rMeniscusVacuum_mbar + rMeniscusVacuum_SensorB_mbar);
        rDiffAbs := ABS(rMeniscusVacuum_mbar - rMeniscusVacuum_SensorB_mbar);
    ELSIF bVacB_Healthy AND bVacC_Healthy THEN
        rVotedVacuum_mbar := 0.5 * (rMeniscusVacuum_SensorB_mbar + rMeniscusVacuum_SensorC_mbar);
        rDiffAbs := ABS(rMeniscusVacuum_SensorB_mbar - rMeniscusVacuum_SensorC_mbar);
    ELSE
        rVotedVacuum_mbar := 0.5 * (rMeniscusVacuum_mbar + rMeniscusVacuum_SensorC_mbar);
        rDiffAbs := ABS(rMeniscusVacuum_mbar - rMeniscusVacuum_SensorC_mbar);
    END_IF;
    dwProcessWarnings := dwProcessWarnings OR 16#00000002; (* Bit 1: Vacuum Transducer Degraded 1oo2 *)
    tVacDiscrepancyTimer(IN := (rDiffAbs > (rVacuumTolerance_mbar * 1.5)), PT := T#1500MS);
    IF tVacDiscrepancyTimer.Q THEN
        dwActiveAlarms := dwActiveAlarms OR 16#00002000; (* Bit 13: 2oo3 Vacuum Dual Divergence Trip *)
        iMachineState  := 120;
    END_IF;
ELSE
    (* Critical Multi-Channel Failure *)
    dwActiveAlarms := dwActiveAlarms OR 16#00002000;
    iMachineState  := 120;
END_IF;

(* -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
   SUB-SECTION 2.2: SUB-NEWTON WEB TENSION 2oo3 TMR VOTING ALGORITHM
   Channel A: Drive Side Load Cell | Channel B: Operator Side Load Cell | Channel C: Dancer Pivot Sensor
   ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
rTensionDiscrepancy_AB := ABS(rWebTension_N - rWebTension_SensorB_N);
rTensionDiscrepancy_BC := ABS(rWebTension_SensorB_N - rWebTension_SensorC_N);
rTensionDiscrepancy_CA := ABS(rWebTension_SensorC_N - rWebTension_N);

(* Plausibility Screening: Sub-Newton web tension must be between 0.10 N and 12.00 N *)
IF (rWebTension_N < 0.10) OR (rWebTension_N > 12.0) THEN
    bTensionA_Healthy := FALSE;
ELSE
    bTensionA_Healthy := TRUE;
END_IF;

IF (rWebTension_SensorB_N < 0.10) OR (rWebTension_SensorB_N > 12.0) THEN
    bTensionB_Healthy := FALSE;
ELSE
    bTensionB_Healthy := TRUE;
END_IF;

IF (rWebTension_SensorC_N < 0.10) OR (rWebTension_SensorC_N > 12.0) THEN
    bTensionC_Healthy := FALSE;
ELSE
    bTensionC_Healthy := TRUE;
END_IF;

(* Cross-Channel Drift & Discrepancy Isolation *)
IF bTensionA_Healthy AND bTensionB_Healthy AND (rTensionDiscrepancy_AB > rTensionTolerance_N) THEN
    IF rTensionDiscrepancy_CA > rTensionTolerance_N THEN
        bTensionA_Healthy := FALSE;
    ELSIF rTensionDiscrepancy_BC > rTensionTolerance_N THEN
        bTensionB_Healthy := FALSE;
    END_IF;
END_IF;

IF bTensionB_Healthy AND bTensionC_Healthy AND (rTensionDiscrepancy_BC > rTensionTolerance_N) THEN
    IF (rTensionDiscrepancy_CA > rTensionTolerance_N) AND bTensionA_Healthy THEN
        bTensionC_Healthy := FALSE;
    END_IF;
END_IF;

iTensionHealthyCount := 0;
IF bTensionA_Healthy THEN iTensionHealthyCount := iTensionHealthyCount + 1; END_IF;
IF bTensionB_Healthy THEN iTensionHealthyCount := iTensionHealthyCount + 1; END_IF;
IF bTensionC_Healthy THEN iTensionHealthyCount := iTensionHealthyCount + 1; END_IF;

IF iTensionHealthyCount = 3 THEN
    IF ((rWebTension_N >= rWebTension_SensorB_N) AND (rWebTension_N <= rWebTension_SensorC_N)) OR
       ((rWebTension_N <= rWebTension_SensorB_N) AND (rWebTension_N >= rWebTension_SensorC_N)) THEN
        rVotedTension_N := rWebTension_N;
    ELSIF ((rWebTension_SensorB_N >= rWebTension_N) AND (rWebTension_SensorB_N <= rWebTension_SensorC_N)) OR
          ((rWebTension_SensorB_N <= rWebTension_N) AND (rWebTension_SensorB_N >= rWebTension_SensorC_N)) THEN
        rVotedTension_N := rWebTension_SensorB_N;
    ELSE
        rVotedTension_N := rWebTension_SensorC_N;
    END_IF;
    tTensionDiscrepancyTimer(IN := FALSE, PT := T#1000MS);
ELSIF iTensionHealthyCount = 2 THEN
    IF bTensionA_Healthy AND bTensionB_Healthy THEN
        rVotedTension_N := 0.5 * (rWebTension_N + rWebTension_SensorB_N);
        rDiffAbs := ABS(rWebTension_N - rWebTension_SensorB_N);
    ELSIF bTensionB_Healthy AND bTensionC_Healthy THEN
        rVotedTension_N := 0.5 * (rWebTension_SensorB_N + rWebTension_SensorC_N);
        rDiffAbs := ABS(rWebTension_SensorB_N - rWebTension_SensorC_N);
    ELSE
        rVotedTension_N := 0.5 * (rWebTension_N + rWebTension_SensorC_N);
        rDiffAbs := ABS(rWebTension_N - rWebTension_SensorC_N);
    END_IF;
    dwProcessWarnings := dwProcessWarnings OR 16#00000004; (* Bit 2: Tension Load Cell Degraded 1oo2 *)
    tTensionDiscrepancyTimer(IN := (rDiffAbs > (rTensionTolerance_N * 2.0)), PT := T#1000MS);
    IF tTensionDiscrepancyTimer.Q THEN
        dwActiveAlarms := dwActiveAlarms OR 16#00004000; (* Bit 14: 2oo3 Tension Dual Divergence Trip *)
        iMachineState  := 120;
    END_IF;
ELSE
    dwActiveAlarms := dwActiveAlarms OR 16#00004000;
    iMachineState  := 120;
END_IF;

(* -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
   SUB-SECTION 2.3: BACKING ROLL SURFACE TEMPERATURE 2oo3 TMR VOTING ALGORITHM
   Channel A: Embedded Drive-End RTD | Channel B: Center RTD | Channel C: Operator-End RTD
   ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
rTempDiscrepancy_AB := ABS(rBackingRollTemp_degC - rBackingRollTemp_SensorB_degC);
rTempDiscrepancy_BC := ABS(rBackingRollTemp_SensorB_degC - rBackingRollTemp_SensorC_degC);
rTempDiscrepancy_CA := ABS(rBackingRollTemp_SensorC_degC - rBackingRollTemp_degC);

IF (rBackingRollTemp_degC < 10.0) OR (rBackingRollTemp_degC > 110.0) THEN
    bTempA_Healthy := FALSE;
ELSE
    bTempA_Healthy := TRUE;
END_IF;

IF (rBackingRollTemp_SensorB_degC < 10.0) OR (rBackingRollTemp_SensorB_degC > 110.0) THEN
    bTempB_Healthy := FALSE;
ELSE
    bTempB_Healthy := TRUE;
END_IF;

IF (rBackingRollTemp_SensorC_degC < 10.0) OR (rBackingRollTemp_SensorC_degC > 110.0) THEN
    bTempC_Healthy := FALSE;
ELSE
    bTempC_Healthy := TRUE;
END_IF;

IF bTempA_Healthy AND bTempB_Healthy AND (rTempDiscrepancy_AB > rTempTolerance_degC) THEN
    IF rTempDiscrepancy_CA > rTempTolerance_degC THEN
        bTempA_Healthy := FALSE;
    ELSIF rTempDiscrepancy_BC > rTempTolerance_degC THEN
        bTempB_Healthy := FALSE;
    END_IF;
END_IF;

IF bTempB_Healthy AND bTempC_Healthy AND (rTempDiscrepancy_BC > rTempTolerance_degC) THEN
    IF (rTempDiscrepancy_CA > rTempTolerance_degC) AND bTempA_Healthy THEN
        bTempC_Healthy := FALSE;
    END_IF;
END_IF;

iTempHealthyCount := 0;
IF bTempA_Healthy THEN iTempHealthyCount := iTempHealthyCount + 1; END_IF;
IF bTempB_Healthy THEN iTempHealthyCount := iTempHealthyCount + 1; END_IF;
IF bTempC_Healthy THEN iTempHealthyCount := iTempHealthyCount + 1; END_IF;

IF iTempHealthyCount = 3 THEN
    IF ((rBackingRollTemp_degC >= rBackingRollTemp_SensorB_degC) AND (rBackingRollTemp_degC <= rBackingRollTemp_SensorC_degC)) OR
       ((rBackingRollTemp_degC <= rBackingRollTemp_SensorB_degC) AND (rBackingRollTemp_degC >= rBackingRollTemp_SensorC_degC)) THEN
        rVotedBackingTemp_degC := rBackingRollTemp_degC;
    ELSIF ((rBackingRollTemp_SensorB_degC >= rBackingRollTemp_degC) AND (rBackingRollTemp_SensorB_degC <= rBackingRollTemp_SensorC_degC)) OR
          ((rBackingRollTemp_SensorB_degC <= rBackingRollTemp_degC) AND (rBackingRollTemp_SensorB_degC >= rBackingRollTemp_SensorC_degC)) THEN
        rVotedBackingTemp_degC := rBackingRollTemp_SensorB_degC;
    ELSE
        rVotedBackingTemp_degC := rBackingRollTemp_SensorC_degC;
    END_IF;
    tTempDiscrepancyTimer(IN := FALSE, PT := T#2000MS);
ELSIF iTempHealthyCount = 2 THEN
    IF bTempA_Healthy AND bTempB_Healthy THEN
        rVotedBackingTemp_degC := 0.5 * (rBackingRollTemp_degC + rBackingRollTemp_SensorB_degC);
        rDiffAbs := ABS(rBackingRollTemp_degC - rBackingRollTemp_SensorB_degC);
    ELSIF bTempB_Healthy AND bTempC_Healthy THEN
        rVotedBackingTemp_degC := 0.5 * (rBackingRollTemp_SensorB_degC + rBackingRollTemp_SensorC_degC);
        rDiffAbs := ABS(rBackingRollTemp_SensorB_degC - rBackingRollTemp_SensorC_degC);
    ELSE
        rVotedBackingTemp_degC := 0.5 * (rBackingRollTemp_degC + rBackingRollTemp_SensorC_degC);
        rDiffAbs := ABS(rBackingRollTemp_degC - rBackingRollTemp_SensorC_degC);
    END_IF;
    dwProcessWarnings := dwProcessWarnings OR 16#00000008; (* Bit 3: Backing Roll RTD Degraded 1oo2 *)
    tTempDiscrepancyTimer(IN := (rDiffAbs > (rTempTolerance_degC * 2.0)), PT := T#2000MS);
    IF tTempDiscrepancyTimer.Q THEN
        dwActiveAlarms := dwActiveAlarms OR 16#00008000; (* Bit 15: 2oo3 Temperature Dual Divergence Trip *)
        iMachineState  := 120;
    END_IF;
ELSE
    dwActiveAlarms := dwActiveAlarms OR 16#00008000;
    iMachineState  := 120;
END_IF;

(* =================================================================================================
   SECTION 3: MENISCUS HYDRODYNAMICS, QUENCHING KINETICS & LASER METROLOGY
   ================================================================================================= *)

(* -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
   SUB-SECTION 3.1: DUAL-CAVITY SLOT-DIE DYNAMIC MENISCUS HYDRODYNAMICS & CAPILLARY STABILITY
   ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* Convert Physical Parameters to SI Units *)
rWebSpeed_ms            := (rWebSpeed_mmin / 60.0);
rDynamicViscosity_Pas   := (rInkViscosity_cP * 0.001);
rSurfaceTension_Nm      := (rInkSurfaceTension_mNm * 0.001);
rDieGap_m               := (rDieLipMicroGap_um * 0.000001);
rWetFilmThickness_m     := (rConfocalFilmThickness_nm * 0.000000001) /
                           MAX(0.01, (rPrecursorSolidFraction * (rSolventDensity_kgm3 / MAX(1.0, rPerovskiteDensity_kgm3))));

(* Capillary Number: Ca = (mu * U_web) / sigma *)
IF rSurfaceTension_Nm > 0.001 THEN
    rCapillaryNumber := (rDynamicViscosity_Pas * rWebSpeed_ms) / rSurfaceTension_Nm;
ELSE
    rCapillaryNumber := 0.001;
END_IF;
rCapillaryNumberOut := rCapillaryNumber;

(* Bead Reynolds Number: Re = (rho * U_web * H_G) / mu *)
IF rDynamicViscosity_Pas > 0.0001 THEN
    rReynoldsNumber := (rSolventDensity_kgm3 * rWebSpeed_ms * rDieGap_m) / rDynamicViscosity_Pas;
ELSE
    rReynoldsNumber := 0.0;
END_IF;
rReynoldsNumberOut := rReynoldsNumber;

(* Weber Number: We = (rho * U_web^2 * H_G) / sigma *)
IF rSurfaceTension_Nm > 0.001 THEN
    rWeberNumber := (rSolventDensity_kgm3 * (rWebSpeed_ms * rWebSpeed_ms) * rDieGap_m) / rSurfaceTension_Nm;
ELSE
    rWeberNumber := 0.0;
END_IF;

(* Ruschak-Higgins Viscous-Capillary Dynamic Meniscus Pressure Balance *)
(* Delta_P = (sigma/H_G) * [ 1.34 * Ca^(2/3) * (1 - t_wet/H_G)^(-1.5) - (H_G / R_curv) ] *)
IF (rDieGap_m > 0.000005) AND (rWetFilmThickness_m < (rDieGap_m * 0.85)) THEN
    rTempFloat := 1.0 - (rWetFilmThickness_m / rDieGap_m);
    IF rTempFloat < 0.15 THEN rTempFloat := 0.15; END_IF;
    (* Approximate Ca^(2/3) via Taylor series / exponential approximation *)
    rRuschakPressureDrop_mbar := ((rSurfaceTension_Nm / rDieGap_m) *
                                 (1.34 * EXPT(MAX(0.00001, rCapillaryNumber), 0.66667) *
                                  EXPT(rTempFloat, -1.5) - (rDieGap_m / MAX(0.000005, rMeniscusCurvatureRadius_m)))) * 0.01;
ELSE
    rRuschakPressureDrop_mbar := -4.50;
END_IF;
rMeniscusPressureDrop_mbar := rRuschakPressureDrop_mbar;

(* Dynamic Coating Window Boundaries *)
rCoatingWindowMinVac_mbar := rRuschakPressureDrop_mbar - 3.50; (* Air entrainment boundary *)
rCoatingWindowMaxVac_mbar := rRuschakPressureDrop_mbar + 4.20; (* Cavity weeping boundary *)

(* Verify Meniscus Stability Envelope *)
IF (rVotedVacuum_mbar >= rCoatingWindowMinVac_mbar) AND (rVotedVacuum_mbar <= rCoatingWindowMaxVac_mbar) AND
   (rDieLipMicroGap_um >= 15.0) AND (rDieLipMicroGap_um <= 100.0) THEN
    bCoatingBeadStable := TRUE;
ELSE
    bCoatingBeadStable := FALSE;
    IF (iMachineState = 80) THEN
        dwProcessWarnings := dwProcessWarnings OR 16#00000020; (* Bit 5: Meniscus Operating Outside Optimal Window *)
    END_IF;
END_IF;

(* -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
   SUB-SECTION 3.2: IN-SITU GAS-KNIFE QUENCHING & CRYSTALLIZATION FRONT DETECTION
   ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* Gas Jet Reynolds Number: Re_jet = (rho_gas * v_gas * d_standoff) / mu_gas *)
IF rGasKinematicVisc_m2s > 0.000001 THEN
    rJetReynolds := (rGasKnifeVelocity_ms * (rGasKnifeStandoff_mm * 0.001)) / rGasKinematicVisc_m2s;
ELSE
    rJetReynolds := 1000.0;
END_IF;

(* Sherwood Number for Convective Mass Transfer: Sh = 0.023 * Re^0.8 * Sc^0.4 *)
rSherwoodNumber := 0.023 * EXPT(MAX(10.0, rJetReynolds), 0.8) * EXPT(rSchmidtNumber, 0.4);
rMassTransferCoeff_k := (rSherwoodNumber * 0.0000085) / MAX(0.001, (rGasKnifeStandoff_mm * 0.001));

(* Solvent Evaporation Flux [kg / (m^2 * s)] *)
rSolventEvapRate_kgm2s := rMassTransferCoeff_k * (rSatVaporPress_Pa / (8.314 * (rVotedBackingTemp_degC + 273.15)));

(* Supersaturation Ratio and Theoretical Crystallization Front Model *)
rSupersaturationRatio := 1.0 + (rSolventEvapRate_kgm2s * 125.0) / MAX(0.01, rWebSpeed_ms);
rCrystFrontModel_mm := 8.5 + (rWebSpeed_mmin * 1.85) / MAX(2.0, (rGasKnifeVelocity_ms * 0.12));

(* First-Order Exponential Filtering of Line-Scan Optical Crystallization Front *)
rFilteredCrystFront_mm := (rCrystFrontAlphaFilter * rCrystFrontObservedPos_mm) +
                          ((1.0 - rCrystFrontAlphaFilter) * rFilteredCrystFront_mm);
rCrystFrontPosition_mm := rFilteredCrystFront_mm;

(* Verify Crystallization Front Locking *)
IF (ABS(rFilteredCrystFront_mm - rTargetCrystFront_mm) <= 1.50) AND (rCrystFrontObservedPos_mm > 2.0) THEN
    bCrystFrontLocked := TRUE;
ELSE
    bCrystFrontLocked := FALSE;
END_IF;

(* -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
   SUB-SECTION 3.3: DUAL-WAVELENGTH LASER CONFOCAL THIN-FILM METROLOGY
   ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* Verify Optical Window Obscuration *)
IF rOpticalObscuration_pct > 75.0 THEN
    dwActiveAlarms := dwActiveAlarms OR 16#00000020; (* Bit 5: Laser Confocal Obscuration Critical *)
ELSIF rOpticalObscuration_pct > 40.0 THEN
    dwProcessWarnings := dwProcessWarnings OR 16#00000040; (* Bit 6: Optical Window Contamination Warning *)
END_IF;

(* Synthetic Vernier Wavelength Phase Disambiguation *)
(* Lambda_syn = (Lambda_1 * Lambda_2) / |Lambda_1 - Lambda_2| = 1117.17 nm *)
rPhaseDiff_rad := ATAN2(rLaser405nmIntensity_V, MAX(0.001, rLaser635nmIntensity_V));
IF rPhaseDiff_rad < 0.0 THEN
    rPhaseDiff_rad := rPhaseDiff_rad + 6.2831853;
END_IF;

(* Wet Film Thickness Reconstructed from Vernier Phase Angle *)
rConfocalWetThickness_nm := (rPhaseDiff_rad / 6.2831853) * (rSyntheticWavelength_nm / (2.0 * rEffectiveRefractiveIndex));

(* Dry Film Active Layer Thickness Reconstructed via Precursor Solid Volume Fraction *)
(* t_dry = t_wet * [ w_solid * (rho_sol / rho_perov) ] *)
rReconstructedDryThickness_nm := rConfocalFilmThickness_nm;
IF rReconstructedDryThickness_nm < 50.0 THEN
    rReconstructedDryThickness_nm := rConfocalWetThickness_nm *
                                    (rPrecursorSolidFraction * (rSolventDensity_kgm3 / MAX(1.0, rPerovskiteDensity_kgm3)));
END_IF;

rEstimatedDryThickness_nm := (rLaserThicknessAlphaFilter * rReconstructedDryThickness_nm) +
                             ((1.0 - rLaserThicknessAlphaFilter) * rEstimatedDryThickness_nm);
rFilmThicknessError_nm := rEstimatedDryThickness_nm - rTargetFilmThickness_nm;

(* =================================================================================================
   SECTION 4: 5x5 STATE-SPACE KALMAN FILTER OBSERVER & MULTIVARIABLE PROJECTED GRADIENT MPC
   ================================================================================================= *)

(* Pack Continuous Measurement Vector y[k] *)
vecMeas_y[1] := rEstimatedDryThickness_nm;      (* State 1 Meas: Dry film thickness [nm] *)
vecMeas_y[2] := rVotedVacuum_mbar;             (* State 2 Meas: Upstream meniscus vacuum [mbar] *)
vecMeas_y[3] := rFilteredCrystFront_mm;        (* State 3 Meas: Crystallization front pos [mm] *)
vecMeas_y[4] := rVotedTension_N;               (* State 4 Meas: Web tension [N] *)
vecMeas_y[5] := rDieLipMicroGap_um;            (* State 5 Meas: Lip coating gap [um] *)

(* Pack Target State Vector x_sp *)
vecTarget_x[1] := rTargetFilmThickness_nm;
vecTarget_x[2] := rTargetMeniscusVacuum_mbar;
vecTarget_x[3] := rTargetCrystFront_mm;
vecTarget_x[4] := rTargetWebTension_N;
vecTarget_x[5] := rTargetDieGap_um;

(* -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
   SUB-SECTION 4.1: DISCRETE KALMAN FILTER MEASUREMENT UPDATE & TIME PROPAGATION
   1. Compute Innovation Residual: e[k] = y[k] - C * x_pred[k]
   2. State Correction Update:     x[k|k] = x_pred[k] + K * e[k]
   3. Time Propagation:            x_pred[k+1] = A * x[k|k] + B * u[k]
   ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
FOR iRow := 1 TO 5 DO
    rTempSum := 0.0;
    FOR iCol := 1 TO 5 DO
        rTempSum := rTempSum + (matC[iRow, iCol] * vecState_x_pred[iCol]);
    END_FOR;
    vecResidual_y[iRow] := vecMeas_y[iRow] - rTempSum;
END_FOR;

(* Kalman State Correction *)
FOR iRow := 1 TO 5 DO
    rTempSum := 0.0;
    FOR iCol := 1 TO 5 DO
        rTempSum := rTempSum + (matK_Kalman[iRow, iCol] * vecResidual_y[iCol]);
    END_FOR;
    vecState_x[iRow] := vecState_x_pred[iRow] + rTempSum;
END_FOR;

(* Kalman Innovation Plausibility Boundary Check *)
IF (ABS(vecResidual_y[1]) > 80.0) OR (ABS(vecResidual_y[2]) > 4.0) THEN
    dwProcessWarnings := dwProcessWarnings OR 16#00000080; (* Bit 7: Kalman Innovation Divergence Warning *)
END_IF;

(* -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
   SUB-SECTION 4.2: CONSTRAINED MULTIVARIABLE MODEL PREDICTIVE CONTROL (MPC) OPTIMIZER
   Objective: Minimize J = (x - x_sp)^T * Q * (x - x_sp) + Delta_u^T * R * Delta_u
   Algorithm: Projected Gradient Descent with hard boundary clipping and slew limiting
   ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
IF bAutoMPC_Enable AND (iMachineState = 80) AND (dwActiveAlarms = 16#00000000) THEN
    (* Initialize Input Candidate from Previous Cycle *)
    FOR iCol := 1 TO 5 DO
        vecInput_u[iCol] := vecInput_u_prev[iCol];
    END_FOR;

    (* Projected Gradient Descent Iteration Loop *)
    FOR iIter := 1 TO iMpcMaxIterations DO
        FOR iCol := 1 TO 5 DO
            rTempSum := 0.0;
            FOR iRow := 1 TO 5 DO
                rTempSum := rTempSum + (matB[iRow, iCol] * vecWeight_Q[iRow] * (vecState_x[iRow] - vecTarget_x[iRow]));
            END_FOR;
            rTempSum := rTempSum + (vecWeight_R[iCol] * (vecInput_u[iCol] - vecInput_u_prev[iCol]));
            vecGradient_g[iCol] := rTempSum;
        END_FOR;

        (* Gradient Descent Step: u = u - alpha * g *)
        FOR iCol := 1 TO 5 DO
            vecInput_u[iCol] := vecInput_u[iCol] - (rMpcStepSize * vecGradient_g[iCol]);
            (* Slew Rate Clamping *)
            IF (vecInput_u[iCol] - vecInput_u_prev[iCol]) > vecDeltaU_Max[iCol] THEN
                vecInput_u[iCol] := vecInput_u_prev[iCol] + vecDeltaU_Max[iCol];
            ELSIF (vecInput_u[iCol] - vecInput_u_prev[iCol]) < -vecDeltaU_Max[iCol] THEN
                vecInput_u[iCol] := vecInput_u_prev[iCol] - vecDeltaU_Max[iCol];
            END_IF;
            (* Hard Actuator Saturation Clamping *)
            IF vecInput_u[iCol] > vecU_Max[iCol] THEN
                vecInput_u[iCol] := vecU_Max[iCol];
            ELSIF vecInput_u[iCol] < vecU_Min[iCol] THEN
                vecInput_u[iCol] := vecU_Min[iCol];
            END_IF;
        END_FOR;
    END_FOR;

    (* Save Solution for Slew Regularization in Next Cycle *)
    FOR iCol := 1 TO 5 DO
        vecInput_u_prev[iCol] := vecInput_u[iCol];
    END_FOR;
END_IF;

(* Time Propagation for Next Scan: x_pred[k+1] = A * x[k|k] + B * u[k] *)
FOR iRow := 1 TO 5 DO
    rTempSum := 0.0;
    FOR iCol := 1 TO 5 DO
        rTempSum := rTempSum + (matA[iRow, iCol] * vecState_x[iCol]) + (matB[iRow, iCol] * vecInput_u[iCol]);
    END_FOR;
    vecState_x_pred[iRow] := rTempSum;
END_FOR;

(* =================================================================================================
   SECTION 5: SUB-NEWTON HIGH-SPEED WEB TENSION SYNCHRONIZATION & ACTIVE COMPLIANCE
   ================================================================================================= *)
(* Sub-Newton Tension Deviation & PI Controller with Anti-Windup *)
rTensionError_N := rTargetWebTension_N - rVotedTension_N;

IF (iMachineState >= 20) AND (iMachineState <= 100) THEN
    rTensionIntegral_N := rTensionIntegral_N + (rTensionKi * rTensionError_N * rCycleTime_s);
    (* Integral Anti-Windup Clamping *)
    IF rTensionIntegral_N > 0.40 THEN
        rTensionIntegral_N := 0.40;
    ELSIF rTensionIntegral_N < -0.40 THEN
        rTensionIntegral_N := -0.40;
    END_IF;
    rBackingRollVelocityTrim_mmin := (rTensionKp * rTensionError_N) + rTensionIntegral_N;
ELSE
    rTensionIntegral_N            := 0.0;
    rBackingRollVelocityTrim_mmin := 0.0;
END_IF;

(* Sub-Newton Web Tension Precision Status Evaluation (+/- 0.05 N) *)
IF ABS(rTensionError_N) <= 0.05 THEN
    bWebTensionInSpec := TRUE;
ELSE
    bWebTensionInSpec := FALSE;
    IF (iMachineState = 80) THEN
        dwProcessWarnings := dwProcessWarnings OR 16#00000100; (* Bit 8: Web Tension Drift Warning *)
    END_IF;
END_IF;

(* Apply Velocity Synchronization Trim to Backing Roll Output *)
rWebTensionTrim_N := rBackingRollVelocityTrim_mmin;

    aInputMatrix_B                  : ARRAY [1..6, 1..6] OF REAL; (* Discrete voltage input matrix *)

(* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* SECTION 1: HARDWIRED SAFETY INTERLOCKS & SIL-3 EMERGENCY TRIP EVALUATION                             *)
(* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
IF (NOT bEmergencyStop) OR (rVacuumVesselPressure_Pa > 0.05) OR (bFastDischargeManualCommand) THEN
    (* Immediate Fail-Safe Trip Execution *)
    bSystemReady            := FALSE;
    bBreakerTripCommand     := TRUE;
    bCounterPulseTrigger    := TRUE;
    bFastDischargeActive    := TRUE;
    rControlVoltageDemand_V := 0.0;
    iActiveStateNumber      := 999; (* Lockout / Emergency Trip State *)

    (* Pack Primary Emergency Alarms *)
    IF NOT bEmergencyStop THEN
        dwAlarmWord1 := dwAlarmWord1 OR 16#0000_0001; (* Bit 0: Hardwired Safety Bus Emergency Stop Tripped *)
    END_IF;
    IF rVacuumVesselPressure_Pa > 0.05 THEN
        dwAlarmWord1 := dwAlarmWord1 OR 16#0000_0002; (* Bit 1: Cryostat Vacuum Insulation Rupture (> 0.05 Pa) *)
    END_IF;
    IF bFastDischargeManualCommand THEN
        dwAlarmWord1 := dwAlarmWord1 OR 16#0000_0004; (* Bit 2: Manual Fast Discharge Dump Command Actuated *)
    END_IF;

    (* Execute Fast Resistor Commutation directly *)
    rDumpResistorCurrent_kA := rVoterCurrent_kA;
    iState := 200; (* Jump directly to Fast Discharge Stage 1 *)
END_IF;

(* Delta Cycle Time Guard *)
IF rCycleTime_s <= 0.0001 THEN
    rCycleTime_s := 0.001; (* Default fallback to 1.0 ms scan cycle *)
END_IF;

(* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* SECTION 2: 2oo3 TRIPLE MODULAR REDUNDANCY (TMR) SENSOR VOTING & DISCREPANCY ARBITRATION             *)
(* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)

(* === 2.1 MAGNET CURRENT VOTING (ChA: Hall, ChB: DCCT, ChC: Faraday) === *)
bCurrent_ChA_Healthy := (rCS_Current_kA_ChA >= -50.0) AND (rCS_Current_kA_ChA <= 50.0);
bCurrent_ChB_Healthy := (rCS_Current_kA_ChB >= -50.0) AND (rCS_Current_kA_ChB <= 50.0);
bCurrent_ChC_Healthy := (rCS_Current_kA_ChC >= -50.0) AND (rCS_Current_kA_ChC <= 50.0);

(* Discrepancy checks: Tolerance +/- 0.8 kA (800 A) *)
IF ABS(rCS_Current_kA_ChA - rCS_Current_kA_ChB) > 0.80 THEN
    IF ABS(rCS_Current_kA_ChA - rCS_Current_kA_ChC) > 0.80 THEN
        bCurrent_ChA_Healthy := FALSE; (* ChA diverges from both ChB and ChC *)
    ELSE
        bCurrent_ChB_Healthy := FALSE; (* ChB diverges from both ChA and ChC *)
    END_IF;
ELSIF ABS(rCS_Current_kA_ChA - rCS_Current_kA_ChC) > 0.80 THEN
    bCurrent_ChC_Healthy := FALSE; (* ChC diverges from ChA and ChB *)
END_IF;

(* TMR 2oo3 Median Selection with Graceful Degradation *)
IF bCurrent_ChA_Healthy AND bCurrent_ChB_Healthy AND bCurrent_ChC_Healthy THEN
    (* 3 Channels Healthy: Standard Median Voter *)
    IF ((rCS_Current_kA_ChA >= rCS_Current_kA_ChB) AND (rCS_Current_kA_ChA <= rCS_Current_kA_ChC)) OR
       ((rCS_Current_kA_ChA <= rCS_Current_kA_ChB) AND (rCS_Current_kA_ChA >= rCS_Current_kA_ChC)) THEN
        rVoterCurrent_kA := rCS_Current_kA_ChA;
    ELSIF ((rCS_Current_kA_ChB >= rCS_Current_kA_ChA) AND (rCS_Current_kA_ChB <= rCS_Current_kA_ChC)) OR
          ((rCS_Current_kA_ChB <= rCS_Current_kA_ChA) AND (rCS_Current_kA_ChB >= rCS_Current_kA_ChC)) THEN
        rVoterCurrent_kA := rCS_Current_kA_ChB;
    ELSE
        rVoterCurrent_kA := rCS_Current_kA_ChC;
    END_IF;
    bCurrent_Degraded_1oo2 := FALSE;
    rCurrent_DiscrepancyTimer_s := 0.0;
ELSIF bCurrent_ChA_Healthy AND bCurrent_ChB_Healthy THEN
    rVoterCurrent_kA := (rCS_Current_kA_ChA + rCS_Current_kA_ChB) * 0.5;
    bCurrent_Degraded_1oo2 := TRUE;
ELSIF bCurrent_ChA_Healthy AND bCurrent_ChC_Healthy THEN
    rVoterCurrent_kA := (rCS_Current_kA_ChA + rCS_Current_kA_ChC) * 0.5;
    bCurrent_Degraded_1oo2 := TRUE;
ELSIF bCurrent_ChB_Healthy AND bCurrent_ChC_Healthy THEN
    rVoterCurrent_kA := (rCS_Current_kA_ChB + rCS_Current_kA_ChC) * 0.5;
    bCurrent_Degraded_1oo2 := TRUE;
ELSE
    (* Only 1 or 0 channels healthy -> Complete sensor failure, fail-safe fast dump *)
    rVoterCurrent_kA := rCS_Current_kA_ChA;
    dwAlarmWord2 := dwAlarmWord2 OR 16#0000_0001; (* Bit 0: Total Magnet Current Sensor Failure *)
    bBreakerTripCommand := TRUE;
    bFastDischargeActive := TRUE;
END_IF;

IF bCurrent_Degraded_1oo2 THEN
    rCurrent_DiscrepancyTimer_s := rCurrent_DiscrepancyTimer_s + rCycleTime_s;
    dwAlarmWord2 := dwAlarmWord2 OR 16#0000_0002; (* Bit 1: Magnet Current Transducer 1oo2 Degraded Mode *)
    IF rCurrent_DiscrepancyTimer_s > 5.0 THEN
        dwAlarmWord2 := dwAlarmWord2 OR 16#0000_0004; (* Bit 2: Magnet Current Discrepancy Timeout Expired *)
    END_IF;
END_IF;

(* === 2.2 COIL VOLTAGE TAP BRIDGE VOTING (ChA, ChB, ChC) [mV] === *)
bVoltage_ChA_Healthy := (rCoilVoltage_mV_ChA >= -5000.0) AND (rCoilVoltage_mV_ChA <= 5000.0);
bVoltage_ChB_Healthy := (rCoilVoltage_mV_ChB >= -5000.0) AND (rCoilVoltage_mV_ChB <= 5000.0);
bVoltage_ChC_Healthy := (rCoilVoltage_mV_ChC >= -5000.0) AND (rCoilVoltage_mV_ChC <= 5000.0);

IF ABS(rCoilVoltage_mV_ChA - rCoilVoltage_mV_ChB) > 25.0 THEN
    IF ABS(rCoilVoltage_mV_ChA - rCoilVoltage_mV_ChC) > 25.0 THEN
        bVoltage_ChA_Healthy := FALSE;
    ELSE
        bVoltage_ChB_Healthy := FALSE;
    END_IF;
ELSIF ABS(rCoilVoltage_mV_ChA - rCoilVoltage_mV_ChC) > 25.0 THEN
    bVoltage_ChC_Healthy := FALSE;
END_IF;

IF bVoltage_ChA_Healthy AND bVoltage_ChB_Healthy AND bVoltage_ChC_Healthy THEN
    IF ((rCoilVoltage_mV_ChA >= rCoilVoltage_mV_ChB) AND (rCoilVoltage_mV_ChA <= rCoilVoltage_mV_ChC)) OR
       ((rCoilVoltage_mV_ChA <= rCoilVoltage_mV_ChB) AND (rCoilVoltage_mV_ChA >= rCoilVoltage_mV_ChC)) THEN
        rVoterCoilVoltage_mV := rCoilVoltage_mV_ChA;
    ELSIF ((rCoilVoltage_mV_ChB >= rCoilVoltage_mV_ChA) AND (rCoilVoltage_mV_ChB <= rCoilVoltage_mV_ChC)) OR
          ((rCoilVoltage_mV_ChB <= rCoilVoltage_mV_ChA) AND (rCoilVoltage_mV_ChB >= rCoilVoltage_mV_ChC)) THEN
        rVoterCoilVoltage_mV := rCoilVoltage_mV_ChB;
    ELSE
        rVoterCoilVoltage_mV := rCoilVoltage_mV_ChC;
    END_IF;
    bVoltage_Degraded_1oo2 := FALSE;
    rVoltage_DiscrepancyTimer_s := 0.0;
ELSIF bVoltage_ChA_Healthy AND bVoltage_ChB_Healthy THEN
    rVoterCoilVoltage_mV := (rCoilVoltage_mV_ChA + rCoilVoltage_mV_ChB) * 0.5;
    bVoltage_Degraded_1oo2 := TRUE;
ELSIF bVoltage_ChA_Healthy AND bVoltage_ChC_Healthy THEN
    rVoterCoilVoltage_mV := (rCoilVoltage_mV_ChA + rCoilVoltage_mV_ChC) * 0.5;
    bVoltage_Degraded_1oo2 := TRUE;
ELSIF bVoltage_ChB_Healthy AND bVoltage_ChC_Healthy THEN
    rVoterCoilVoltage_mV := (rCoilVoltage_mV_ChB + rCoilVoltage_mV_ChC) * 0.5;
    bVoltage_Degraded_1oo2 := TRUE;
ELSE
    rVoterCoilVoltage_mV := rCoilVoltage_mV_ChA;
    dwAlarmWord2 := dwAlarmWord2 OR 16#0000_0008; (* Bit 3: Coil Voltage Tap Bridge Complete Sensor Failure *)
END_IF;

IF bVoltage_Degraded_1oo2 THEN
    rVoltage_DiscrepancyTimer_s := rVoltage_DiscrepancyTimer_s + rCycleTime_s;
    dwAlarmWord2 := dwAlarmWord2 OR 16#0000_0010; (* Bit 4: Coil Voltage Tap 1oo2 Degraded Mode *)
END_IF;

(* === 2.3 SUPERCRITICAL HELIUM OUTLET TEMPERATURE VOTING (ChA: Cernox, ChB: RhFe, ChC: TVO) [K] === *)
bTemp_ChA_Healthy := (rCryoTemp_SHe_Outlet_K_ChA >= 3.0) AND (rCryoTemp_SHe_Outlet_K_ChA <= 30.0);
bTemp_ChB_Healthy := (rCryoTemp_SHe_Outlet_K_ChB >= 3.0) AND (rCryoTemp_SHe_Outlet_K_ChB <= 30.0);
bTemp_ChC_Healthy := (rCryoTemp_SHe_Outlet_K_ChC >= 3.0) AND (rCryoTemp_SHe_Outlet_K_ChC <= 30.0);

IF ABS(rCryoTemp_SHe_Outlet_K_ChA - rCryoTemp_SHe_Outlet_K_ChB) > 0.35 THEN
    IF ABS(rCryoTemp_SHe_Outlet_K_ChA - rCryoTemp_SHe_Outlet_K_ChC) > 0.35 THEN
        bTemp_ChA_Healthy := FALSE;
    ELSE
        bTemp_ChB_Healthy := FALSE;
    END_IF;
ELSIF ABS(rCryoTemp_SHe_Outlet_K_ChA - rCryoTemp_SHe_Outlet_K_ChC) > 0.35 THEN
    bTemp_ChC_Healthy := FALSE;
END_IF;

IF bTemp_ChA_Healthy AND bTemp_ChB_Healthy AND bTemp_ChC_Healthy THEN
    IF ((rCryoTemp_SHe_Outlet_K_ChA >= rCryoTemp_SHe_Outlet_K_ChB) AND (rCryoTemp_SHe_Outlet_K_ChA <= rCryoTemp_SHe_Outlet_K_ChC)) OR
       ((rCryoTemp_SHe_Outlet_K_ChA <= rCryoTemp_SHe_Outlet_K_ChB) AND (rCryoTemp_SHe_Outlet_K_ChA >= rCryoTemp_SHe_Outlet_K_ChC)) THEN
        rVoterTemp_K := rCryoTemp_SHe_Outlet_K_ChA;
    ELSIF ((rCryoTemp_SHe_Outlet_K_ChB >= rCryoTemp_SHe_Outlet_K_ChA) AND (rCryoTemp_SHe_Outlet_K_ChB <= rCryoTemp_SHe_Outlet_K_ChC)) OR
          ((rCryoTemp_SHe_Outlet_K_ChB <= rCryoTemp_SHe_Outlet_K_ChA) AND (rCryoTemp_SHe_Outlet_K_ChB >= rCryoTemp_SHe_Outlet_K_ChC)) THEN
        rVoterTemp_K := rCryoTemp_SHe_Outlet_K_ChB;
    ELSE
        rVoterTemp_K := rCryoTemp_SHe_Outlet_K_ChC;
    END_IF;
    bTemp_Degraded_1oo2 := FALSE;
    rTemp_DiscrepancyTimer_s := 0.0;
ELSIF bTemp_ChA_Healthy AND bTemp_ChB_Healthy THEN
    rVoterTemp_K := (rCryoTemp_SHe_Outlet_K_ChA + rCryoTemp_SHe_Outlet_K_ChB) * 0.5;
    bTemp_Degraded_1oo2 := TRUE;
ELSIF bTemp_ChA_Healthy AND bTemp_ChC_Healthy THEN
    rVoterTemp_K := (rCryoTemp_SHe_Outlet_K_ChA + rCryoTemp_SHe_Outlet_K_ChC) * 0.5;
    bTemp_Degraded_1oo2 := TRUE;
ELSIF bTemp_ChB_Healthy AND bTemp_ChC_Healthy THEN
    rVoterTemp_K := (rCryoTemp_SHe_Outlet_K_ChB + rCryoTemp_SHe_Outlet_K_ChC) * 0.5;
    bTemp_Degraded_1oo2 := TRUE;
ELSE
    rVoterTemp_K := rCryoTemp_SHe_Outlet_K_ChA;
    dwAlarmWord2 := dwAlarmWord2 OR 16#0000_0020; (* Bit 5: SHe Cryogenic Temperature Sensor Loss *)
END_IF;

IF bTemp_Degraded_1oo2 THEN
    rTemp_DiscrepancyTimer_s := rTemp_DiscrepancyTimer_s + rCycleTime_s;
    dwAlarmWord2 := dwAlarmWord2 OR 16#0000_0040; (* Bit 6: SHe Cryo Temperature 1oo2 Degraded *)
END_IF;

(* === 2.4 SUPERCRITICAL HELIUM CONDUIT PRESSURE VOTING (ChA, ChB, ChC) [bar] === *)
bPress_ChA_Healthy := (rCryoPressure_SHe_bar_ChA >= 1.0) AND (rCryoPressure_SHe_bar_ChA <= 35.0);
bPress_ChB_Healthy := (rCryoPressure_SHe_bar_ChB >= 1.0) AND (rCryoPressure_SHe_bar_ChB <= 35.0);
bPress_ChC_Healthy := (rCryoPressure_SHe_bar_ChC >= 1.0) AND (rCryoPressure_SHe_bar_ChC <= 35.0);

IF ABS(rCryoPressure_SHe_bar_ChA - rCryoPressure_SHe_bar_ChB) > 0.50 THEN
    IF ABS(rCryoPressure_SHe_bar_ChA - rCryoPressure_SHe_bar_ChC) > 0.50 THEN
        bPress_ChA_Healthy := FALSE;
    ELSE
        bPress_ChB_Healthy := FALSE;
    END_IF;
ELSIF ABS(rCryoPressure_SHe_bar_ChA - rCryoPressure_SHe_bar_ChC) > 0.50 THEN
    bPress_ChC_Healthy := FALSE;
END_IF;

IF bPress_ChA_Healthy AND bPress_ChB_Healthy AND bPress_ChC_Healthy THEN
    IF ((rCryoPressure_SHe_bar_ChA >= rCryoPressure_SHe_bar_ChB) AND (rCryoPressure_SHe_bar_ChA <= rCryoPressure_SHe_bar_ChC)) OR
       ((rCryoPressure_SHe_bar_ChA <= rCryoPressure_SHe_bar_ChB) AND (rCryoPressure_SHe_bar_ChA >= rCryoPressure_SHe_bar_ChC)) THEN
        rVoterPressure_bar := rCryoPressure_SHe_bar_ChA;
    ELSIF ((rCryoPressure_SHe_bar_ChB >= rCryoPressure_SHe_bar_ChA) AND (rCryoPressure_SHe_bar_ChB <= rCryoPressure_SHe_bar_ChC)) OR
          ((rCryoPressure_SHe_bar_ChB <= rCryoPressure_SHe_bar_ChA) AND (rCryoPressure_SHe_bar_ChB >= rCryoPressure_SHe_bar_ChC)) THEN
        rVoterPressure_bar := rCryoPressure_SHe_bar_ChB;
    ELSE
        rVoterPressure_bar := rCryoPressure_SHe_bar_ChC;
    END_IF;
    bPress_Degraded_1oo2 := FALSE;
    rPress_DiscrepancyTimer_s := 0.0;
ELSIF bPress_ChA_Healthy AND bPress_ChB_Healthy THEN
    rVoterPressure_bar := (rCryoPressure_SHe_bar_ChA + rCryoPressure_SHe_bar_ChB) * 0.5;
    bPress_Degraded_1oo2 := TRUE;
ELSIF bPress_ChA_Healthy AND bPress_ChC_Healthy THEN
    rVoterPressure_bar := (rCryoPressure_SHe_bar_ChA + rCryoPressure_SHe_bar_ChC) * 0.5;
    bPress_Degraded_1oo2 := TRUE;
ELSIF bPress_ChB_Healthy AND bPress_ChC_Healthy THEN
    rVoterPressure_bar := (rCryoPressure_SHe_bar_ChB + rCryoPressure_SHe_bar_ChC) * 0.5;
    bPress_Degraded_1oo2 := TRUE;
ELSE
    rVoterPressure_bar := rCryoPressure_SHe_bar_ChA;
    dwAlarmWord2 := dwAlarmWord2 OR 16#0000_0080; (* Bit 7: SHe Cryogenic Pressure Sensor Loss *)
END_IF;

IF bPress_Degraded_1oo2 THEN
    rPress_DiscrepancyTimer_s := rPress_DiscrepancyTimer_s + rCycleTime_s;
    dwAlarmWord2 := dwAlarmWord2 OR 16#0000_0100; (* Bit 8: SHe Cryo Pressure 1oo2 Degraded Mode *)
END_IF;


(* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* SECTION 3: INDUCTIVE COMPENSATION & RESISTIVE QUENCH VOLTAGE CALCULATION                            *)
(* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* The terminal voltage across a superconducting magnet contains both resistive and inductive parts:    *)
(*   V_terminal = V_resistive + L * (dI/dt) + sum(M_ij * dI_j/dt) + M_plasma * (dI_plasma/dt)         *)
(* During current ramp-up, L*(dI/dt) can reach hundreds of Volts, whereas a quench starts at 100 mV.    *)
(* Precise real-time numerical differentiation and inductive subtraction are mathematically mandatory. *)

(* 3.1 Two-Stage 2nd-Order Low-Pass Filtered Derivative for Magnet Current *)
rRawDerivative_kA_s := (rVoterCurrent_kA - rCurrent_PrevScan_kA) / rCycleTime_s;
rCurrent_PrevScan_kA := rVoterCurrent_kA;

(* 2nd-Order Filter: damping ratio zeta = 0.707, cutoff frequency omega_n = 150 rad/s (~24 Hz) *)
rDerivFilterState_1 := rDerivFilterState_1 + (rRawDerivative_kA_s - rDerivFilterState_1) * (150.0 * rCycleTime_s);
rDerivFilterState_2 := rDerivFilterState_2 + (rDerivFilterState_1 - rDerivFilterState_2) * (150.0 * rCycleTime_s);
rCurrentDerivative_kA_s := rDerivFilterState_2;

(* 3.2 Plasma Current Coupling Derivative (dI_p/dt) *)
rPlasmaDeriv_MA_s := (rPlasmaCurrent_MA - rPlasmaCurrent_Prev_MA) / rCycleTime_s;
rPlasmaCurrent_Prev_MA := rPlasmaCurrent_MA;

(* 3.3 Inductive Compensation Potential [mV] *)
(* V_ind = [L_eff (uH) * dI/dt (kA/s) + M_p (uH) * dIp/dt (MA/s * 1000)] -> Result in Volts * 1000 = mV *)
rInductiveVoltageComp_mV := (rMutualInductanceEquivalent_uH * rCurrentDerivative_kA_s) + 
                            (rPlasmaMutualInductance_uH * (rPlasmaDeriv_MA_s * 1000.0));

(* 3.4 Pure Resistive Quench Potential [mV] *)
rResistiveVoltage_mV := rVoterCoilVoltage_mV - rInductiveVoltageComp_mV;

(* Offset baseline compensation when current is stationary *)
IF ABS(rCurrentDerivative_kA_s) < 0.05 THEN
    IF ABS(rResistiveVoltage_mV) < 5.0 THEN
        rResistiveVoltage_mV := 0.0; (* Zero-deadband noise filter *)
    END_IF;
END_IF;


(* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* SECTION 4: SUPERCONDUCTING QUENCH DETECTION CRITERIA ENGINE                                         *)
(* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* Multi-physics quench criteria evaluated in parallel:                                                *)
(* 1. Electrical criterion: V_res > 100 mV sustained for > 15 ms (or > 300 mV for > 3 ms).             *)
(* 2. Thermal criterion: Temperature margin Delta T_m = T_cs(B, I) - T_out < 0.50 K.                  *)
(* 3. Hydraulic criterion: Supercritical Helium shockwave dP/dt > 1.50 bar/s.                          *)
(* 4. Acoustic burst criterion: High-frequency emissions > 92 dB correlated with V_res > 40 mV.         *)

(* 4.1 Magnetic Field and Nb3Sn Current Sharing Temperature (T_cs) Evaluation *)
(* Empirical parameterization for ITER Central Solenoid Nb3Sn CICC: B_peak = 0.288 T/kA * I_CS *)
rPeakMagneticField_T := ABS(rVoterCurrent_kA) * 0.2888;
IF rPeakMagneticField_T > 13.5 THEN
    rPeakMagneticField_T := 13.5;
END_IF;

(* Critical temperature reduction under high magnetic field and transport current: *)
(* T_cs = T_c0 * (1 - B/B_c20)^0.59 * (1 - I/I_c0)^0.5 *)
(* For CS Nb3Sn: T_c0 = 18.0 K, B_c20 = 28.0 T. At 13 T, 40 kA: T_cs ~ 6.2 K - 6.8 K *)
rCurrentSharingTemp_Tcs_K := 18.0 * SQRT(MAX(0.01, 1.0 - (rPeakMagneticField_T / 28.0))) * 
                             SQRT(MAX(0.01, 1.0 - (ABS(rVoterCurrent_kA) / 65.0)));
IF rCurrentSharingTemp_Tcs_K < 4.80 THEN
    rCurrentSharingTemp_Tcs_K := 4.80; (* Lower physical floor *)
END_IF;

(* Temperature Margin [K] *)
rTempMargin_K := rCurrentSharingTemp_Tcs_K - rVoterTemp_K;

(* 4.2 Supercritical Helium Pressure and Temperature Transient Rates *)
rPressureRate_bar_s := (rVoterPressure_bar - rPressure_PrevScan_bar) / rCycleTime_s;
rPressure_PrevScan_bar := rVoterPressure_bar;
rPressureDerivFilter_1 := rPressureDerivFilter_1 + (rPressureRate_bar_s - rPressureDerivFilter_1) * (80.0 * rCycleTime_s);
rPressureRate_bar_s := rPressureDerivFilter_1;

rTemperatureRate_K_s := (rVoterTemp_K - rTemperature_PrevScan_K) / rCycleTime_s;
rTemperature_PrevScan_K := rVoterTemp_K;

(* 4.3 Multi-Criteria Quench Discrimination Logic *)
(* Criterion A: Standard Resistive Voltage Sustained Integration *)
IF ABS(rResistiveVoltage_mV) >= 100.0 THEN
    rQuenchValidationTimer_s := rQuenchValidationTimer_s + rCycleTime_s;
    IF rQuenchValidationTimer_s >= 0.015 THEN (* 15 ms sustained threshold *)
        bVoltageQuenchLatched := TRUE;
    END_IF;
ELSIF ABS(rResistiveVoltage_mV) >= 300.0 THEN
    (* Fast-track extreme overvoltage threshold: 3 ms response *)
    rQuenchValidationTimer_s := rQuenchValidationTimer_s + (rCycleTime_s * 5.0);
    IF rQuenchValidationTimer_s >= 0.015 THEN
        bVoltageQuenchLatched := TRUE;
    END_IF;
ELSE
    (* Rapid leaky integration reset *)
    rQuenchValidationTimer_s := MAX(0.0, rQuenchValidationTimer_s - (rCycleTime_s * 2.0));
END_IF;

(* Criterion B: Cryogenic Thermohydraulic Heat Flux Quench *)
IF (rTempMargin_K <= 0.40) OR (rPressureRate_bar_s >= 1.60) THEN
    bCryoQuenchLatched := TRUE;
    dwAlarmWord1 := dwAlarmWord1 OR 16#0000_0010; (* Bit 4: Cryogenic Supercritical Helium Heat Flux Quench *)
END_IF;

(* Criterion C: Acoustic Micro-Fracture Burst Quench *)
IF (rAcousticEmission_dB >= 92.0) AND (ABS(rResistiveVoltage_mV) >= 45.0) THEN
    bAcousticQuenchLatched := TRUE;
    dwAlarmWord1 := dwAlarmWord1 OR 16#0000_0020; (* Bit 5: Acoustic Burst Quench Tripped *)
END_IF;

(* Master Quench Latch *)
IF bVoltageQuenchLatched OR bCryoQuenchLatched OR bAcousticQuenchLatched THEN
    bQuenchDetected := TRUE;
    dwAlarmWord1 := dwAlarmWord1 OR 16#0000_0040; (* Bit 6: Master Quench Protection Tripped *)
    bFastDischargeActive := TRUE;
    bBreakerTripCommand := TRUE;
    iState := 200; (* Immediate transition to Fast Discharge State *)
END_IF;


(* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* SECTION 5: COMPLETE 6x6 STATE-SPACE MATRICES & MULTI-MODULE ELECTROMAGNETICS                        *)
(* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* The Central Solenoid consists of 6 stacked modules:                                                 *)
(* Index 1: CS3U (Top Outer Module)                                                                    *)
(* Index 2: CS2U (Upper Middle Module)                                                                 *)
(* Index 3: CS1U (Upper Central Module)                                                                *)
(* Index 4: CS1L (Lower Central Module)                                                                *)
(* Index 5: CS2L (Lower Middle Module)                                                                 *)
(* Index 6: CS3L (Bottom Outer Module)                                                                 *)
(* Dynamics: d(I)/dt = M^-1 * (V - R*I)                                                                *)

(* Discrete State Matrix A (6x6): A_discrete ~ I_6 - (M^-1 * R) * dt                                  *)
(* Because Nb3Sn is superconducting in normal operation, R ~ 1.0E-9 Ohm, A is near Identity.          *)
aStateMatrix_A[1,1] := 0.99998; aStateMatrix_A[1,2] := 0.00001; aStateMatrix_A[1,3] := 0.00000; aStateMatrix_A[1,4] := 0.00000; aStateMatrix_A[1,5] := 0.00000; aStateMatrix_A[1,6] := 0.00000;
aStateMatrix_A[2,1] := 0.00001; aStateMatrix_A[2,2] := 0.99997; aStateMatrix_A[2,3] := 0.00001; aStateMatrix_A[2,4] := 0.00000; aStateMatrix_A[2,5] := 0.00000; aStateMatrix_A[2,6] := 0.00000;
aStateMatrix_A[3,1] := 0.00000; aStateMatrix_A[3,2] := 0.00001; aStateMatrix_A[3,3] := 0.99996; aStateMatrix_A[3,4] := 0.00002; aStateMatrix_A[3,5] := 0.00000; aStateMatrix_A[3,6] := 0.00000;
aStateMatrix_A[4,1] := 0.00000; aStateMatrix_A[4,2] := 0.00000; aStateMatrix_A[4,3] := 0.00002; aStateMatrix_A[4,4] := 0.99996; aStateMatrix_A[4,5] := 0.00001; aStateMatrix_A[4,6] := 0.00000;
aStateMatrix_A[5,1] := 0.00000; aStateMatrix_A[5,2] := 0.00000; aStateMatrix_A[5,3] := 0.00000; aStateMatrix_A[5,4] := 0.00001; aStateMatrix_A[5,5] := 0.99997; aStateMatrix_A[5,6] := 0.00001;
aStateMatrix_A[6,1] := 0.00000; aStateMatrix_A[6,2] := 0.00000; aStateMatrix_A[6,3] := 0.00000; aStateMatrix_A[6,4] := 0.00000; aStateMatrix_A[6,5] := 0.00001; aStateMatrix_A[6,6] := 0.99998;

(* Discrete Input Coupling Matrix B (6x6): B_discrete = M^-1 * dt (Units: kA / Volt)                  *)
aInputMatrix_B[1,1] := 0.000452; aInputMatrix_B[1,2] :=-0.000084; aInputMatrix_B[1,3] :=-0.000021; aInputMatrix_B[1,4] :=-0.000008; aInputMatrix_B[1,5] :=-0.000003; aInputMatrix_B[1,6] :=-0.000001;
aInputMatrix_B[2,1] :=-0.000084; aInputMatrix_B[2,2] := 0.000488; aInputMatrix_B[2,3] :=-0.000092; aInputMatrix_B[2,4] :=-0.000024; aInputMatrix_B[2,5] :=-0.000009; aInputMatrix_B[2,6] :=-0.000003;
aInputMatrix_B[3,1] :=-0.000021; aInputMatrix_B[3,2] :=-0.000092; aInputMatrix_B[3,3] := 0.000512; aInputMatrix_B[3,4] :=-0.000105; aInputMatrix_B[3,5] :=-0.000024; aInputMatrix_B[3,6] :=-0.000008;
aInputMatrix_B[4,1] :=-0.000008; aInputMatrix_B[4,2] :=-0.000024; aInputMatrix_B[4,3] :=-0.000105; aInputMatrix_B[4,4] := 0.000512; aInputMatrix_B[4,5] :=-0.000092; aInputMatrix_B[4,6] :=-0.000021;
aInputMatrix_B[5,1] :=-0.000003; aInputMatrix_B[5,2] :=-0.000009; aInputMatrix_B[5,3] :=-0.000024; aInputMatrix_B[5,4] :=-0.000092; aInputMatrix_B[5,5] := 0.000488; aInputMatrix_B[5,6] :=-0.000084;
aInputMatrix_B[6,1] :=-0.000001; aInputMatrix_B[6,2] :=-0.000003; aInputMatrix_B[6,3] :=-0.000008; aInputMatrix_B[6,4] :=-0.000021; aInputMatrix_B[6,5] :=-0.000084; aInputMatrix_B[6,6] := 0.000452;

(* Mutual Inductance Matrix M [Henrys] (Symmetric Pos-Definite) *)
aMutualInductance_M[1,1] := 0.00285; aMutualInductance_M[1,2] := 0.00062; aMutualInductance_M[1,3] := 0.00018; aMutualInductance_M[1,4] := 0.00007; aMutualInductance_M[1,5] := 0.00003; aMutualInductance_M[1,6] := 0.00001;
aMutualInductance_M[2,1] := 0.00062; aMutualInductance_M[2,2] := 0.00282; aMutualInductance_M[2,3] := 0.00065; aMutualInductance_M[2,4] := 0.00019; aMutualInductance_M[2,5] := 0.00007; aMutualInductance_M[2,6] := 0.00003;
aMutualInductance_M[3,1] := 0.00018; aMutualInductance_M[3,2] := 0.00065; aMutualInductance_M[3,3] := 0.00280; aMutualInductance_M[3,4] := 0.00072; aMutualInductance_M[3,5] := 0.00019; aMutualInductance_M[3,6] := 0.00007;
aMutualInductance_M[4,1] := 0.00007; aMutualInductance_M[4,2] := 0.00019; aMutualInductance_M[4,3] := 0.00072; aMutualInductance_M[4,4] := 0.00280; aMutualInductance_M[4,5] := 0.00065; aMutualInductance_M[4,6] := 0.00018;
aMutualInductance_M[5,1] := 0.00003; aMutualInductance_M[5,2] := 0.00007; aMutualInductance_M[5,3] := 0.00019; aMutualInductance_M[5,4] := 0.00065; aMutualInductance_M[5,5] := 0.00282; aMutualInductance_M[5,6] := 0.00062;
aMutualInductance_M[6,1] := 0.00001; aMutualInductance_M[6,2] := 0.00003; aMutualInductance_M[6,3] := 0.00007; aMutualInductance_M[6,4] := 0.00018; aMutualInductance_M[6,5] := 0.00062; aMutualInductance_M[6,6] := 0.00285;

(* Synchronize module currents with voted magnet current *)
FOR iIndex := 1 TO 6 DO
    aModuleCurrents_kA[iIndex] := rVoterCurrent_kA;
END_FOR;

(* Calculate Inter-Module Vertical Separating Forces and Peak Tresca Stress *)
(* F_vert = sum(I_i * I_j * dM_ij/dz) *)
rVerticalForce_MN := (rVoterCurrent_kA * rVoterCurrent_kA) * 0.000182; (* Empirically ~ 290 MN at 40 kA *)
rTrescaStressMax_MPa := (rVoterCurrent_kA * rVoterCurrent_kA) * 0.000285; (* ~ 456 MPa peak at 40 kA *)

IF rTrescaStressMax_MPa > 650.0 THEN
    dwAlarmWord1 := dwAlarmWord1 OR 16#0000_0080; (* Bit 7: Central Solenoid Structural Tresca Stress Exceeded *)
    bBreakerTripCommand := TRUE;
    bFastDischargeActive := TRUE;
    iState := 200;
END_IF;


(* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* SECTION 6: MODEL PREDICTIVE CONTROL (MPC) QUADRATIC COST OPTIMIZER                                  *)
(* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* Quadratic Cost Function: J = sum( (x_i - x_ref_i)^2 * Q_i ) + sum( u_i^2 * R_i )                    *)
(* Solved via deterministic Projected Gradient Descent with box constraints on power converter:         *)
(* V_min = -1500 V <= u <= +1500 V = V_max                                                             *)

(* 6.1 State Penalty Weights and Reference Allocation *)
FOR iIndex := 1 TO 6 DO
    aWeight_Q[iIndex] := 250.0; (* High tracking priority *)
    aWeight_R[iIndex] := 0.025; (* Low voltage effort penalty *)
    aTrackingError_kA[iIndex] := aModuleCurrents_kA[iIndex] - aStateReference_kA[iIndex];
END_FOR;

(* 6.2 Compute Gradient Vector: g = 2 * (B^T * Q * error + R * u) *)
FOR iIndex := 1 TO 6 DO
    aGradient_g[iIndex] := 0.0;
    FOR jIndex := 1 TO 6 DO
        aGradient_g[iIndex] := aGradient_g[iIndex] + (aInputMatrix_B[jIndex, iIndex] * aWeight_Q[jIndex] * aTrackingError_kA[jIndex]);
    END_FOR;
    aGradient_g[iIndex] := (2.0 * aGradient_g[iIndex]) + (2.0 * aWeight_R[iIndex] * aModuleVoltages_V[iIndex]);
    
    (* Hessian Diagonal Approximation: H_ii = 2 * (sum_j( B_ji^2 * Q_j ) + R_i) *)
    aHessianDiag_H[iIndex] := 2.0 * aWeight_R[iIndex];
    FOR jIndex := 1 TO 6 DO
        aHessianDiag_H[iIndex] := aHessianDiag_H[iIndex] + (2.0 * aInputMatrix_B[jIndex, iIndex] * aInputMatrix_B[jIndex, iIndex] * aWeight_Q[jIndex]);
    END_FOR;
END_FOR;

(* 6.3 Projected Gradient Descent Optimization (Deterministic 6 Iterations) *)
FOR kIter := 1 TO 6 DO
    FOR iIndex := 1 TO 6 DO
        IF aHessianDiag_H[iIndex] > 0.0001 THEN
            aDeltaU_V[iIndex] := - (aGradient_g[iIndex] / aHessianDiag_H[iIndex]);
        ELSE
            aDeltaU_V[iIndex] := 0.0;
        END_IF;
        
        (* Apply step and saturate to converter physical envelope [-1500 V, +1500 V] *)
        aModuleVoltages_V[iIndex] := aModuleVoltages_V[iIndex] + (0.45 * aDeltaU_V[iIndex]);
        IF aModuleVoltages_V[iIndex] > 1500.0 THEN
            aModuleVoltages_V[iIndex] := 1500.0;
        ELSIF aModuleVoltages_V[iIndex] < -1500.0 THEN
            aModuleVoltages_V[iIndex] := -1500.0;
        END_IF;
    END_FOR;
END_FOR;

(* Output single representative voltage demand setpoint *)
rControlVoltageDemand_V := aModuleVoltages_V[3]; (* CS1U central module voltage *)


(* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* SECTION 7: ADIABATIC HOTSPOT TEMPERATURE & MIITs ENERGY ACCUMULATION                                *)
(* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* The adiabatic hot-spot temperature of the Nb3Sn strand and copper stabilizer matrix is governed     *)
(* by the thermal equation: integral(I^2 dt) = A_cu * A_total * integral( C_p(T) / rho(T) dT )        *)
(* Expressed in Mega-Amperes-squared-seconds (MIITs = 10^6 A^2 * s = 1.0E12 A^2 * s):                  *)

IF ABS(rVoterCurrent_kA) > 0.1 THEN
    (* Accumulate real-time MIITs: I(kA)^2 * dt(s) * 1.0E-6 = MA^2 * s *)
    rMIITsAccumulated_MA2s := rMIITsAccumulated_MA2s + ((rVoterCurrent_kA * rVoterCurrent_kA * 0.000001) * rCycleTime_s);
END_IF;

(* 5th-Order Polynomial Approximation of Hotspot Temperature from MIITs *)
rCoilHotspotTemp_K := rHotspotPolynomial_a0 + 
                      (rHotspotPolynomial_a1 * rMIITsAccumulated_MA2s) + 
                      (rHotspotPolynomial_a2 * (rMIITsAccumulated_MA2s * rMIITsAccumulated_MA2s)) + 
                      (rHotspotPolynomial_a3 * (rMIITsAccumulated_MA2s * rMIITsAccumulated_MA2s * rMIITsAccumulated_MA2s)) + 
                      (rHotspotPolynomial_a4 * (rMIITsAccumulated_MA2s * rMIITsAccumulated_MA2s * rMIITsAccumulated_MA2s * rMIITsAccumulated_MA2s)) + 
                      (rHotspotPolynomial_a5 * (rMIITsAccumulated_MA2s * rMIITsAccumulated_MA2s * rMIITsAccumulated_MA2s * rMIITsAccumulated_MA2s * rMIITsAccumulated_MA2s));

(* Hard Safety Limits: ITER Magnet Safety Design Criteria enforces T_hotspot <= 150 K *)
IF rCoilHotspotTemp_K > 150.0 THEN
    dwAlarmWord1 := dwAlarmWord1 OR 16#0000_0100; (* Bit 8: Adiabatic Hotspot Temperature Exceeded (> 150 K) *)
    bBreakerTripCommand := TRUE;
    bFastDischargeActive := TRUE;
    iState := 200;
ELSIF rCoilHotspotTemp_K > 80.0 THEN
    dwAlarmWord1 := dwAlarmWord1 OR 16#0000_0200; (* Bit 9: Hotspot Thermal Warning (> 80 K) *)
END_IF;


(* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* SECTION 8: FAST DISCHARGE UNIT (FDU) & PYRO-SWITCH COMMUTATION SEQUENCER                            *)
(* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* Sequence of Fast Discharge Commutation:                                                             *)
(* 1. Send fast trip command to vacuum DC circuit breaker.                                              *)
(* 2. Simultaneously fire counter-pulse capacitor bank to force zero-crossing in breaker contacts.     *)
(* 3. Monitor auxiliary contact and current commutation into dump resistor.                           *)
(* 4. If current is NOT commutated into dump resistor within 8.0 ms, fire dual pyrotechnic cutters.    *)

IF bFastDischargeActive THEN
    rFastDischargeTimer_s := rFastDischargeTimer_s + rCycleTime_s;
    bBreakerTripCommand := TRUE;
    bCounterPulseTrigger := TRUE;

    (* Check if vacuum breaker opened successfully *)
    IF NOT bDCBreakerClosedFeedback THEN
        (* Breaker open confirmed: Current commutated into dump resistor *)
        rDumpResistorCurrent_kA := rVoterCurrent_kA * EXP(- rFastDischargeTimer_s / 7.20); (* tau = L/R = 12.56 mH / 0.225 Ohm ~ 7.2s *)
    ELSE
        (* Breaker auxiliary contact still reports CLOSED: Arc sustained or mechanism jammed *)
        rBreakerArcClearanceTimer_s := rBreakerArcClearanceTimer_s + rCycleTime_s;
        
        (* If breaker fails to open within 8.0 ms (0.008 s), actuate explosive pyro-switches *)
        IF (rBreakerArcClearanceTimer_s >= 0.008) AND bPyroSquibArmed THEN
            bPyroTriggerPulse := TRUE;
            bPyroFired := TRUE;
            bPyroTriggerLatched := TRUE;
            dwAlarmWord1 := dwAlarmWord1 OR 16#0000_0400; (* Bit 10: Pyrotechnic Squib Cutting Switch Fired *)
            
            (* Force current into dump resistor via pyrotechnic cutting *)
            rDumpResistorCurrent_kA := rVoterCurrent_kA * EXP(- (rFastDischargeTimer_s - 0.008) / 7.20);
        END_IF;

        IF rBreakerArcClearanceTimer_s >= 0.025 THEN
            bBreakerFailedToOpen := TRUE;
            dwAlarmWord1 := dwAlarmWord1 OR 16#0000_0800; (* Bit 11: DC Vacuum Breaker Failed to Clear Arc *)
        END_IF;
    END_IF;

    (* Resistor Thermal Dissipation Accumulation *)
    rDumpResistorTemp_K := 293.15 + (rDumpResistorEnergy_MJ / rDumpResistorThermalMass_MJ_K);
    IF rDumpResistorTemp_K > 550.0 THEN
        dwAlarmWord1 := dwAlarmWord1 OR 16#0000_1000; (* Bit 12: Dump Resistor Overtemperature (> 550 K) *)
    END_IF;
ELSE
    rFastDischargeTimer_s := 0.0;
    rBreakerArcClearanceTimer_s := 0.0;
    rDumpResistorCurrent_kA := 0.0;
END_IF;


(* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* SECTION 9: MULTI-STAGE CENTRAL SOLENOID FINITE STATE MACHINE (CASE iState OF ...)                    *)
(* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
IF iState <> iStatePrevious THEN
    tStateTimer := 0.0;
    bStateFirstScan := TRUE;
    iStatePrevious := iState;
ELSE
    tStateTimer := tStateTimer + rCycleTime_s;
    bStateFirstScan := FALSE;
END_IF;

iActiveStateNumber := iState;

CASE iState OF

    (* ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
    (* STATE 0: POWER-ON SELF-TEST & INSTRUMENTATION INTEGRITY AUDIT                                    *)
    (* ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
    0:
        bSystemReady := FALSE;
        bBreakerTripCommand := FALSE;
        bFastDischargeActive := FALSE;
        bPyroTriggerPulse := FALSE;
        rControlVoltageDemand_V := 0.0;

        (* Audit Pyro-switch squib continuity loops *)
        IF (NOT bPyroBridgeIntegrityCh1) OR (NOT bPyroBridgeIntegrityCh2) THEN
            dwAlarmWord2 := dwAlarmWord2 OR 16#0000_0200; (* Bit 9: Pyro Squib Detonator Bridge Open *)
        END_IF;

        (* Verification of Cryogenic Base Conditions *)
        IF (rCryoTemp_SHe_Inlet_K < 5.20) AND (rVoterTemp_K < 5.50) AND 
           (rVoterPressure_bar >= 4.50) AND (rCryoMassFlow_kg_s >= 0.20) AND
           bDCBreakerClosedFeedback AND bPyroBridgeIntegrityCh1 AND bPyroBridgeIntegrityCh2 THEN
            IF tStateTimer >= 1.0 THEN
                iState := 10; (* Transition to Cryogenic Stabilization *)
            END_IF;
        END_IF;

    (* ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
    (* STATE 10: CRYOGENIC SUPERCRITICAL HELIUM 4.5 K STABILIZATION                                    *)
    (* ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
    10:
        bSystemReady := FALSE;
        rControlVoltageDemand_V := 0.0;

        (* Verify steady-state SHe cooling with temperature margin > 1.8 K *)
        IF (rVoterTemp_K <= 4.60) AND (rTempMargin_K >= 1.80) AND (ABS(rPressureRate_bar_s) < 0.10) THEN
            IF tStateTimer >= 2.0 THEN
                iState := 20; (* Transition to Insulation and Squib Arming *)
            END_IF;
        END_IF;

        IF NOT bEnable THEN
            iState := 0;
        END_IF;

    (* ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
    (* STATE 20: INSULATION VERIFICATION & PYRO-SQUIB CAPACITOR ARMING                                 *)
    (* ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
    20:
        bSystemReady := FALSE;
        
        (* Verify Counter-pulse capacitor bank is charged to > 1800 V *)
        IF (rCounterPulseCapVoltage_V >= 1800.0) AND bPyroSquibArmed THEN
            IF tStateTimer >= 1.0 THEN
                iState := 30; (* Transition to Power Supply DC Standby *)
            END_IF;
        END_IF;

        IF NOT bEnable THEN
            iState := 0;
        END_IF;

    (* ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
    (* STATE 30: POWER CONVERTER DC STANDBY & READY-TO-RAMP PERMISSIVE                                 *)
    (* ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
    30:
        bSystemReady := TRUE;
        rControlVoltageDemand_V := 0.0;

        (* Await external run command / PCS handshake *)
        IF bEnable AND (NOT bQuenchDetected) THEN
            IF tStateTimer >= 0.5 THEN
                iState := 40; (* Transition to Pre-magnetization Ramp *)
            END_IF;
        END_IF;

    (* ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
    (* STATE 40: CS PRE-MAGNETIZATION CURRENT RAMP-UP (+40 kA FLUX INJECTION)                          *)
    (* ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
    40:
        bSystemReady := TRUE;

        (* Ramp current at controlled rate: +350 A/s to reach 40.0 kA in ~ 114 seconds *)
        FOR iIndex := 1 TO 6 DO
            aStateReference_kA[iIndex] := MIN(40.0, aStateReference_kA[iIndex] + (0.350 * rCycleTime_s));
        END_FOR;

        (* Update Poloidal Flux accumulated: Phi = L * I = 0.00285 H * 40000 A ~ 114 Wb *)
        rFluxAccumulated_Wb := rVoterCurrent_kA * 0.00285;
        rRemainingFlux_Wb := rTotalFluxCapacity_Wb - rFluxAccumulated_Wb;

        (* Target 40 kA reached with steady-state confirmation *)
        IF (rVoterCurrent_kA >= 39.80) THEN
            IF tStateTimer >= 1.0 THEN
                iState := 50; (* Transition to Flux Loaded Breakdown Armed *)
            END_IF;
        END_IF;

        IF NOT bEnable THEN
            iState := 90; (* Normal Controlled Ramp-Down *)
        END_IF;

    (* ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
    (* STATE 50: FLUX-LOADED READY FOR PLASMA BREAKDOWN TRIGGER                                         *)
    (* ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
    50:
        bSystemReady := TRUE;
        (* Hold flat current at 40 kA awaiting PCS fast breakdown trigger *)
        FOR iIndex := 1 TO 6 DO
            aStateReference_kA[iIndex] := 40.0;
        END_FOR;

        IF bPlasmaInitiationTrigger THEN
            iState := 60; (* Transition to Fast Commutation Breakdown Initiation *)
        END_IF;

        IF NOT bEnable THEN
            iState := 90; (* Normal Controlled Ramp-Down *)
        END_IF;

    (* ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
    (* STATE 60: FAST INDUCTIVE ENERGY TRANSFER & PLASMA BREAKDOWN IONIZATION                           *)
    (* ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
