(* ========================================================================================= *)
(* 1.0 EMERGENCY SAFETY SHUTDOWN & SIL-3 HARDWIRED INTERLOCK EVALUATION                      *)
(* Evaluates fail-safe e-stop circuits, critical over-temperature, and vacuum vessel burst.  *)
(* ========================================================================================= *)
IF NOT bEmergencyStop THEN
    bSystemRunning := FALSE;
    bSystemReady := FALSE;
    bSystemTrip := TRUE;

    (* Fail-safe De-energization of Actuators *)
    bSolarLoopPumpCmd := FALSE;
    bNightAdsorptionFanCmd := FALSE;
    bCondensateExtractionPumpCmd := FALSE;
    bPurgeValveActive := FALSE;

    (* Drive modulating control valves to calibrated fail-safe isolation limits *)
    rSolarLoopModulationDuty := 0.0;
    rCondenserCoolantPumpSpeed := 0.0;
    rVaporCondenserChokeValve := 0.0;
    rHeatRecoveryExchangerValve := 0.0;
    rBedPreEvacChokeValve := 0.0;

    dwAlarmWord_1 := dwAlarmWord_1 OR 16#0000_0001; (* Bit 0: Emergency Stop Hardwired Loop Open *)
    iPreviousState := iState;
    iState := 90; (* Jump directly to Fail-Safe Lockdown State *)
    RETURN;
END_IF;

(* Master Reset Acknowledgment Evaluation *)
IF bMasterReset THEN
    IF bEmergencyStop AND (rVotedBedCoreTemp < c_rMaxBedTemperature) AND (rVotedVacuumPress < c_rMaxCondenserPressure) THEN
        bSystemTrip := FALSE;
        dwAlarmWord_1 := 16#0000_0000;
        dwAlarmWord_2 := dwAlarmWord_2 AND 16#FFFF_0000; (* Clear process trips, preserve warnings *)
        IF iState = 90 THEN
            iState := 0; (* Return to POST / Standby Initialization *)
        END_IF;
    END_IF;
END_IF;

(* If Latched in Trip State without valid reset, inhibit all downstream automation *)
IF bSystemTrip AND (iState = 90) THEN
    bSystemRunning := FALSE;
    bSystemReady := FALSE;
    bSolarLoopPumpCmd := FALSE;
    bNightAdsorptionFanCmd := FALSE;
    bCondensateExtractionPumpCmd := FALSE;
    bPurgeValveActive := FALSE;
    rSolarLoopModulationDuty := 0.0;
    rCondenserCoolantPumpSpeed := 0.0;
    rVaporCondenserChokeValve := 0.0;
    rHeatRecoveryExchangerValve := 0.0;
    rBedPreEvacChokeValve := 0.0;
    RETURN;
END_IF;

(* First-Scan Internal Filter Preset *)
IF NOT bFirstScanDone THEN
    rFilteredSolarFlux := rSolarRadiationFlux_ChA;
    rFilteredVaporFlow := rDesorptionVaporMassFlow_ChA;
    rFilteredWaterYield := rLiquidWaterProductionFlow_ChA;
    rFilteredVacuumPress := rCondenserVacuumPress_ChA;
    bFirstScanDone := TRUE;
END_IF;

(* ========================================================================================= *)
(* 2.0 TRIPLE MODULAR REDUNDANCY (2oo3) SENSOR VOTING ENGINES                                *)
(* Evaluates channel integrity, median synthesis, pairwise Euclidean drift and degradation. *)
(* ========================================================================================= *)

(* --- 2.1 Ambient Relative Humidity 2oo3 Voting --- *)
bRH_ChA_OK := (rAmbientRH_ChA >= 0.0) AND (rAmbientRH_ChA <= 100.0);
bRH_ChB_OK := (rAmbientRH_ChB >= 0.0) AND (rAmbientRH_ChB <= 100.0);
bRH_ChC_OK := (rAmbientRH_ChC >= 0.0) AND (rAmbientRH_ChC <= 100.0);

IF bRH_ChA_OK AND bRH_ChB_OK AND bRH_ChC_OK THEN
    (* 3 Channels Healthy: Median Selection Algorithm *)
    IF (rAmbientRH_ChA >= rAmbientRH_ChB AND rAmbientRH_ChA <= rAmbientRH_ChC) OR
       (rAmbientRH_ChA >= rAmbientRH_ChC AND rAmbientRH_ChA <= rAmbientRH_ChB) THEN
        rVotedAmbientRH := rAmbientRH_ChA;
    ELSIF (rAmbientRH_ChB >= rAmbientRH_ChA AND rAmbientRH_ChB <= rAmbientRH_ChC) OR
          (rAmbientRH_ChB >= rAmbientRH_ChC AND rAmbientRH_ChB <= rAmbientRH_ChA) THEN
        rVotedAmbientRH := rAmbientRH_ChB;
    ELSE
        rVotedAmbientRH := rAmbientRH_ChC;
    END_IF;
    bRH_Degraded_1oo2 := FALSE;

    (* Evaluate Pairwise Cross-Channel Drift *)
    IF (ABS(rAmbientRH_ChA - rAmbientRH_ChB) > c_rTol_RH) OR
       (ABS(rAmbientRH_ChB - rAmbientRH_ChC) > c_rTol_RH) OR
       (ABS(rAmbientRH_ChC - rAmbientRH_ChA) > c_rTol_RH) THEN
        dwAlarmWord_2 := dwAlarmWord_2 OR 16#0000_0001; (* Warning: RH Sensor Discrepancy *)
    ELSE
        dwAlarmWord_2 := dwAlarmWord_2 AND 16#FFFE;
    END_IF;
ELSIF bRH_ChA_OK AND bRH_ChB_OK THEN
    rVotedAmbientRH := (rAmbientRH_ChA + rAmbientRH_ChB) * 0.5;
    bRH_Degraded_1oo2 := TRUE;
    dwAlarmWord_2 := dwAlarmWord_2 OR 16#0000_0002; (* RH Ch C Failed *)
ELSIF bRH_ChB_OK AND bRH_ChC_OK THEN
    rVotedAmbientRH := (rAmbientRH_ChB + rAmbientRH_ChC) * 0.5;
    bRH_Degraded_1oo2 := TRUE;
    dwAlarmWord_2 := dwAlarmWord_2 OR 16#0000_0004; (* RH Ch A Failed *)
ELSIF bRH_ChA_OK AND bRH_ChC_OK THEN
    rVotedAmbientRH := (rAmbientRH_ChA + rAmbientRH_ChC) * 0.5;
    bRH_Degraded_1oo2 := TRUE;
    dwAlarmWord_2 := dwAlarmWord_2 OR 16#0000_0008; (* RH Ch B Failed *)
ELSE
    (* Total Loss of RH Telemetry: Default to Conservative Desert Minimum 12.0% *)
    rVotedAmbientRH := 12.0;
    bSystemTrip := TRUE;
    dwAlarmWord_1 := dwAlarmWord_1 OR 16#0000_0002; (* Critical: Total RH Sensor Failure *)
END_IF;

(* --- 2.2 Sorption Bed Core Matrix Temperature 2oo3 Voting --- *)
bBedTemp_ChA_OK := (rBedCoreTemp_ChA >= -10.0) AND (rBedCoreTemp_ChA <= 130.0);
bBedTemp_ChB_OK := (rBedCoreTemp_ChB >= -10.0) AND (rBedCoreTemp_ChB <= 130.0);
bBedTemp_ChC_OK := (rBedCoreTemp_ChC >= -10.0) AND (rBedCoreTemp_ChC <= 130.0);

IF bBedTemp_ChA_OK AND bBedTemp_ChB_OK AND bBedTemp_ChC_OK THEN
    IF (rBedCoreTemp_ChA >= rBedCoreTemp_ChB AND rBedCoreTemp_ChA <= rBedCoreTemp_ChC) OR
       (rBedCoreTemp_ChA >= rBedCoreTemp_ChC AND rBedCoreTemp_ChA <= rBedCoreTemp_ChB) THEN
        rVotedBedCoreTemp := rBedCoreTemp_ChA;
    ELSIF (rBedCoreTemp_ChB >= rBedCoreTemp_ChA AND rBedCoreTemp_ChB <= rBedCoreTemp_ChC) OR
          (rBedCoreTemp_ChB >= rBedCoreTemp_ChC AND rBedCoreTemp_ChB <= rBedCoreTemp_ChA) THEN
        rVotedBedCoreTemp := rBedCoreTemp_ChB;
    ELSE
        rVotedBedCoreTemp := rBedCoreTemp_ChC;
    END_IF;
    bBedTemp_Degraded_1oo2 := FALSE;

    IF (ABS(rBedCoreTemp_ChA - rBedCoreTemp_ChB) > c_rTol_Temp) OR
       (ABS(rBedCoreTemp_ChB - rBedCoreTemp_ChC) > c_rTol_Temp) OR
       (ABS(rBedCoreTemp_ChC - rBedCoreTemp_ChA) > c_rTol_Temp) THEN
        dwAlarmWord_2 := dwAlarmWord_2 OR 16#0000_0010; (* Warning: Bed Temp Deviation *)
    END_IF;
ELSIF bBedTemp_ChA_OK AND bBedTemp_ChB_OK THEN
    rVotedBedCoreTemp := (rBedCoreTemp_ChA + rBedCoreTemp_ChB) * 0.5;
    bBedTemp_Degraded_1oo2 := TRUE;
    dwAlarmWord_2 := dwAlarmWord_2 OR 16#0000_0020;
ELSIF bBedTemp_ChB_OK AND bBedTemp_ChC_OK THEN
    rVotedBedCoreTemp := (rBedCoreTemp_ChB + rBedCoreTemp_ChC) * 0.5;
    bBedTemp_Degraded_1oo2 := TRUE;
    dwAlarmWord_2 := dwAlarmWord_2 OR 16#0000_0040;
ELSIF bBedTemp_ChA_OK AND bBedTemp_ChC_OK THEN
    rVotedBedCoreTemp := (rBedCoreTemp_ChA + rBedCoreTemp_ChC) * 0.5;
    bBedTemp_Degraded_1oo2 := TRUE;
    dwAlarmWord_2 := dwAlarmWord_2 OR 16#0000_0080;
ELSE
    rVotedBedCoreTemp := 25.0;
    bSystemTrip := TRUE;
    dwAlarmWord_1 := dwAlarmWord_1 OR 16#0000_0004; (* Critical: Total Bed Temperature Failure *)
END_IF;

(* Critical Bed Over-Temperature Trip Interlock *)
IF rVotedBedCoreTemp > c_rMaxBedTemperature THEN
    bSystemTrip := TRUE;
    dwAlarmWord_1 := dwAlarmWord_1 OR 16#0000_0008; (* Critical: MOF Thermal Degradation Overheat Trip *)
END_IF;

(* --- 2.3 Solar Radiative Flux 2oo3 Voting --- *)
bSolar_ChA_OK := (rSolarRadiationFlux_ChA >= 0.0) AND (rSolarRadiationFlux_ChA <= 1500.0);
bSolar_ChB_OK := (rSolarRadiationFlux_ChB >= 0.0) AND (rSolarRadiationFlux_ChB <= 1500.0);
bSolar_ChC_OK := (rSolarRadiationFlux_ChC >= 0.0) AND (rSolarRadiationFlux_ChC <= 1500.0);

IF bSolar_ChA_OK AND bSolar_ChB_OK AND bSolar_ChC_OK THEN
    IF (rSolarRadiationFlux_ChA >= rSolarRadiationFlux_ChB AND rSolarRadiationFlux_ChA <= rSolarRadiationFlux_ChC) OR
       (rSolarRadiationFlux_ChA >= rSolarRadiationFlux_ChC AND rSolarRadiationFlux_ChA <= rSolarRadiationFlux_ChB) THEN
        rVotedSolarFlux := rSolarRadiationFlux_ChA;
    ELSIF (rSolarRadiationFlux_ChB >= rSolarRadiationFlux_ChA AND rSolarRadiationFlux_ChB <= rSolarRadiationFlux_ChC) OR
          (rSolarRadiationFlux_ChB >= rSolarRadiationFlux_ChC AND rSolarRadiationFlux_ChB <= rSolarRadiationFlux_ChA) THEN
        rVotedSolarFlux := rSolarRadiationFlux_ChB;
    ELSE
        rVotedSolarFlux := rSolarRadiationFlux_ChC;
    END_IF;
    bSolar_Degraded_1oo2 := FALSE;

    IF (ABS(rSolarRadiationFlux_ChA - rSolarRadiationFlux_ChB) > c_rTol_Solar) OR
       (ABS(rSolarRadiationFlux_ChB - rSolarRadiationFlux_ChC) > c_rTol_Solar) OR
       (ABS(rSolarRadiationFlux_ChC - rSolarRadiationFlux_ChA) > c_rTol_Solar) THEN
        dwAlarmWord_2 := dwAlarmWord_2 OR 16#0000_0100; (* Warning: Pyranometer Discrepancy *)
    END_IF;
ELSIF bSolar_ChA_OK AND bSolar_ChB_OK THEN
    rVotedSolarFlux := (rSolarRadiationFlux_ChA + rSolarRadiationFlux_ChB) * 0.5;
    bSolar_Degraded_1oo2 := TRUE;
ELSIF bSolar_ChB_OK AND bSolar_ChC_OK THEN
    rVotedSolarFlux := (rSolarRadiationFlux_ChB + rSolarRadiationFlux_ChC) * 0.5;
    bSolar_Degraded_1oo2 := TRUE;
ELSIF bSolar_ChA_OK AND bSolar_ChC_OK THEN
    rVotedSolarFlux := (rSolarRadiationFlux_ChA + rSolarRadiationFlux_ChC) * 0.5;
    bSolar_Degraded_1oo2 := TRUE;
ELSE
    rVotedSolarFlux := 0.0;
    dwAlarmWord_2 := dwAlarmWord_2 OR 16#0000_0200; (* Total Solar Telemetry Degraded *)
END_IF;

(* First-Order Low-Pass Smoothing of Solar Flux *)
rFilteredSolarFlux := (0.92 * rFilteredSolarFlux) + (0.08 * rVotedSolarFlux);

(* --- 2.4 Condenser Vacuum Pressure 2oo3 Voting --- *)
bVacPress_ChA_OK := (rCondenserVacuumPress_ChA >= 0.1) AND (rCondenserVacuumPress_ChA <= 1050.0);
bVacPress_ChB_OK := (rCondenserVacuumPress_ChB >= 0.1) AND (rCondenserVacuumPress_ChB <= 1050.0);
bVacPress_ChC_OK := (rCondenserVacuumPress_ChC >= 0.1) AND (rCondenserVacuumPress_ChC <= 1050.0);

IF bVacPress_ChA_OK AND bVacPress_ChB_OK AND bVacPress_ChC_OK THEN
    IF (rCondenserVacuumPress_ChA >= rCondenserVacuumPress_ChB AND rCondenserVacuumPress_ChA <= rCondenserVacuumPress_ChC) OR
       (rCondenserVacuumPress_ChA >= rCondenserVacuumPress_ChC AND rCondenserVacuumPress_ChA <= rCondenserVacuumPress_ChB) THEN
        rVotedVacuumPress := rCondenserVacuumPress_ChA;
    ELSIF (rCondenserVacuumPress_ChB >= rCondenserVacuumPress_ChA AND rCondenserVacuumPress_ChB <= rCondenserVacuumPress_ChC) OR
          (rCondenserVacuumPress_ChB >= rCondenserVacuumPress_ChC AND rCondenserVacuumPress_ChB <= rCondenserVacuumPress_ChA) THEN
        rVotedVacuumPress := rCondenserVacuumPress_ChB;
    ELSE
        rVotedVacuumPress := rCondenserVacuumPress_ChC;
    END_IF;
    bVacPress_Degraded_1oo2 := FALSE;

    IF (ABS(rCondenserVacuumPress_ChA - rCondenserVacuumPress_ChB) > c_rTol_Press) OR
       (ABS(rCondenserVacuumPress_ChB - rCondenserVacuumPress_ChC) > c_rTol_Press) OR
       (ABS(rCondenserVacuumPress_ChC - rCondenserVacuumPress_ChA) > c_rTol_Press) THEN
        dwAlarmWord_2 := dwAlarmWord_2 OR 16#0000_0400; (* Warning: Vacuum Transducer Drift *)
    END_IF;
ELSIF bVacPress_ChA_OK AND bVacPress_ChB_OK THEN
    rVotedVacuumPress := (rCondenserVacuumPress_ChA + rCondenserVacuumPress_ChB) * 0.5;
    bVacPress_Degraded_1oo2 := TRUE;
ELSIF bVacPress_ChB_OK AND bVacPress_ChC_OK THEN
    rVotedVacuumPress := (rCondenserVacuumPress_ChB + rCondenserVacuumPress_ChC) * 0.5;
    bVacPress_Degraded_1oo2 := TRUE;
ELSIF bVacPress_ChA_OK AND bVacPress_ChC_OK THEN
    rVotedVacuumPress := (rCondenserVacuumPress_ChA + rCondenserVacuumPress_ChC) * 0.5;
    bVacPress_Degraded_1oo2 := TRUE;
ELSE
    rVotedVacuumPress := 1013.25; (* Loss of Vacuum: Assume Ambient Pressure *)
    bSystemTrip := TRUE;
    dwAlarmWord_1 := dwAlarmWord_1 OR 16#0000_0010; (* Critical: Total Vacuum Telemetry Loss *)
END_IF;

(* Critical Vacuum Vessel Over-Pressure Trip *)
IF rVotedVacuumPress > c_rMaxCondenserPressure THEN
    bSystemTrip := TRUE;
    dwAlarmWord_1 := dwAlarmWord_1 OR 16#0000_0020; (* Critical: Condenser Pressure Excursion Trip *)
END_IF;

(* --- 2.5 Desorption Vapor Mass Flow 2oo3 Voting --- *)
bVaporFlow_ChA_OK := (rDesorptionVaporMassFlow_ChA >= 0.0) AND (rDesorptionVaporMassFlow_ChA <= 45.0);
bVaporFlow_ChB_OK := (rDesorptionVaporMassFlow_ChB >= 0.0) AND (rDesorptionVaporMassFlow_ChB <= 45.0);
bVaporFlow_ChC_OK := (rDesorptionVaporMassFlow_ChC >= 0.0) AND (rDesorptionVaporMassFlow_ChC <= 45.0);

IF bVaporFlow_ChA_OK AND bVaporFlow_ChB_OK AND bVaporFlow_ChC_OK THEN
    IF (rDesorptionVaporMassFlow_ChA >= rDesorptionVaporMassFlow_ChB AND rDesorptionVaporMassFlow_ChA <= rDesorptionVaporMassFlow_ChC) OR
       (rDesorptionVaporMassFlow_ChA >= rDesorptionVaporMassFlow_ChC AND rDesorptionVaporMassFlow_ChA <= rDesorptionVaporMassFlow_ChB) THEN
        rVotedVaporMassFlow := rDesorptionVaporMassFlow_ChA;
    ELSIF (rDesorptionVaporMassFlow_ChB >= rDesorptionVaporMassFlow_ChA AND rDesorptionVaporMassFlow_ChB <= rDesorptionVaporMassFlow_ChC) OR
          (rDesorptionVaporMassFlow_ChB >= rDesorptionVaporMassFlow_ChC AND rDesorptionVaporMassFlow_ChB <= rDesorptionVaporMassFlow_ChA) THEN
        rVotedVaporMassFlow := rDesorptionVaporMassFlow_ChB;
    ELSE
        rVotedVaporMassFlow := rDesorptionVaporMassFlow_ChC;
    END_IF;
    bVaporFlow_Degraded_1oo2 := FALSE;
ELSIF bVaporFlow_ChA_OK AND bVaporFlow_ChB_OK THEN
    rVotedVaporMassFlow := (rDesorptionVaporMassFlow_ChA + rDesorptionVaporMassFlow_ChB) * 0.5;
    bVaporFlow_Degraded_1oo2 := TRUE;
ELSIF bVaporFlow_ChB_OK AND bVaporFlow_ChC_OK THEN
    rVotedVaporMassFlow := (rDesorptionVaporMassFlow_ChB + rDesorptionVaporMassFlow_ChC) * 0.5;
    bVaporFlow_Degraded_1oo2 := TRUE;
ELSIF bVaporFlow_ChA_OK AND bVaporFlow_ChC_OK THEN
    rVotedVaporMassFlow := (rDesorptionVaporMassFlow_ChA + rDesorptionVaporMassFlow_ChC) * 0.5;
    bVaporFlow_Degraded_1oo2 := TRUE;
ELSE
    rVotedVaporMassFlow := 0.0;
    dwAlarmWord_2 := dwAlarmWord_2 OR 16#0000_0800; (* Vapor Flow Transducer Degraded *)
END_IF;

(* --- 2.6 Condensate Liquid Yield 2oo3 Voting --- *)
bYieldFlow_ChA_OK := (rLiquidWaterProductionFlow_ChA >= 0.0) AND (rLiquidWaterProductionFlow_ChA <= 50.0);
bYieldFlow_ChB_OK := (rLiquidWaterProductionFlow_ChB >= 0.0) AND (rLiquidWaterProductionFlow_ChB <= 50.0);
bYieldFlow_ChC_OK := (rLiquidWaterProductionFlow_ChC >= 0.0) AND (rLiquidWaterProductionFlow_ChC <= 50.0);

IF bYieldFlow_ChA_OK AND bYieldFlow_ChB_OK AND bYieldFlow_ChC_OK THEN
    IF (rLiquidWaterProductionFlow_ChA >= rLiquidWaterProductionFlow_ChB AND rLiquidWaterProductionFlow_ChA <= rLiquidWaterProductionFlow_ChC) OR
       (rLiquidWaterProductionFlow_ChA >= rLiquidWaterProductionFlow_ChC AND rLiquidWaterProductionFlow_ChA <= rLiquidWaterProductionFlow_ChB) THEN
        rVotedWaterYieldFlow := rLiquidWaterProductionFlow_ChA;
    ELSIF (rLiquidWaterProductionFlow_ChB >= rLiquidWaterProductionFlow_ChA AND rLiquidWaterProductionFlow_ChB <= rLiquidWaterProductionFlow_ChC) OR
          (rLiquidWaterProductionFlow_ChB >= rLiquidWaterProductionFlow_ChC AND rLiquidWaterProductionFlow_ChB <= rLiquidWaterProductionFlow_ChA) THEN
        rVotedWaterYieldFlow := rLiquidWaterProductionFlow_ChB;
    ELSE
        rVotedWaterYieldFlow := rLiquidWaterProductionFlow_ChC;
    END_IF;
    bYieldFlow_Degraded_1oo2 := FALSE;
ELSIF bYieldFlow_ChA_OK AND bYieldFlow_ChB_OK THEN
    rVotedWaterYieldFlow := (rLiquidWaterProductionFlow_ChA + rLiquidWaterProductionFlow_ChB) * 0.5;
    bYieldFlow_Degraded_1oo2 := TRUE;
ELSIF bYieldFlow_ChB_OK AND bYieldFlow_ChC_OK THEN
    rVotedWaterYieldFlow := (rLiquidWaterProductionFlow_ChB + rLiquidWaterProductionFlow_ChC) * 0.5;
    bYieldFlow_Degraded_1oo2 := TRUE;
ELSIF bYieldFlow_ChA_OK AND bYieldFlow_ChC_OK THEN
    rVotedWaterYieldFlow := (rLiquidWaterProductionFlow_ChA + rLiquidWaterProductionFlow_ChC) * 0.5;
    bYieldFlow_Degraded_1oo2 := TRUE;
ELSE
    rVotedWaterYieldFlow := 0.0;
END_IF;

rHourlyHarvestYield := rVotedWaterYieldFlow;

(* ========================================================================================= *)
(* 3.0 MOF-303 THERMOPHYSICAL & DUAL-SITE LANGMUIR-FREUNDLICH ENGINE                         *)
(* Computes saturation vapor pressures via Magnus-Tetens, affinity parameters, and uptake.   *)
(* ========================================================================================= *)

(* Magnus-Tetens Saturation Vapor Pressure Formulations:
   P_sat(T) = 6.112 * exp((17.67 * T) / (T + 243.5)) [mbar] *)

(* Ambient Saturation Pressure *)
IF (rAmbientTemp + 243.5) > 1.0 THEN
    rSatVaporPressAmbient := 6.112 * EXP((17.67 * rAmbientTemp) / (rAmbientTemp + 243.5));
ELSE
    rSatVaporPressAmbient := 6.112;
END_IF;

(* Ambient Vapor Partial Pressure: P_v = RH * P_sat *)
rVaporPartialPressAmbient := (rVotedAmbientRH / 100.0) * rSatVaporPressAmbient;

(* Bed Saturation Pressure at Current Core Temperature *)
IF (rVotedBedCoreTemp + 243.5) > 1.0 THEN
    rSatVaporPressBed := 6.112 * EXP((17.67 * rVotedBedCoreTemp) / (rVotedBedCoreTemp + 243.5));
ELSE
    rSatVaporPressBed := 6.112;
END_IF;

(* Condenser Wall Saturation Pressure *)
IF (rCondenserWallTemp_Stg2 + 243.5) > 1.0 THEN
    rSatVaporPressCondenser := 6.112 * EXP((17.67 * rCondenserWallTemp_Stg2) / (rCondenserWallTemp_Stg2 + 243.5));
ELSE
    rSatVaporPressCondenser := 6.112;
END_IF;

(* Temperature-Dependent Affinity Constants: b_i = b0_i * exp(DeltaH_ads_i / (R * T)) *)
IF (rVotedBedCoreTemp + 273.15) > 10.0 THEN
    rAffinity_b1 := c_rb0_1 * EXP((c_rDeltaH_ads1 * 1000.0) / (c_rGasConstant_R * (rVotedBedCoreTemp + 273.15)));
    rAffinity_b2 := c_rb0_2 * EXP((c_rDeltaH_ads2 * 1000.0) / (c_rGasConstant_R * (rVotedBedCoreTemp + 273.15)));
    rDynamicLDF_k := c_rLDF_Rate_k0 * EXP((-1.0 * c_rActivationEnergy_Ea) / (c_rGasConstant_R * (rVotedBedCoreTemp + 273.15)));
ELSE
    rAffinity_b1 := c_rb0_1;
    rAffinity_b2 := c_rb0_2;
    rDynamicLDF_k := c_rLDF_Rate_k0;
END_IF;

(* Dual-Site Langmuir-Freundlich Equilibrium Water Uptake:
   q* = q_sat1 * (b1*P)^n1 / (1 + (b1*P)^n1) + q_sat2 * (b2*P)^n2 / (1 + (b2*P)^n2) *)
IF rVotedVacuumPress > 0.05 THEN
    (* Numerical evaluation of term 1 *)
    rEquilibriumUptake_qStar := c_rQ_sat1 * (rAffinity_b1 * rVotedVacuumPress) / (1.0 + (rAffinity_b1 * rVotedVacuumPress)) +
                                c_rQ_sat2 * (rAffinity_b2 * rVotedVacuumPress) / (1.0 + (rAffinity_b2 * rVotedVacuumPress));
ELSE
    rEquilibriumUptake_qStar := 0.005;
END_IF;

(* Bound Equilibrium Uptake within MOF-303 Physical Pore Capacity *)
IF rEquilibriumUptake_qStar > 0.480 THEN
    rEquilibriumUptake_qStar := 0.480;
ELSIF rEquilibriumUptake_qStar < 0.005 THEN
    rEquilibriumUptake_qStar := 0.005;
END_IF;

(* Linear Driving Force (LDF) Dynamic Depletion Rate: dq/dt = k_LDF * (q* - q) *)
rDesorptionRate_dq_dt := rDynamicLDF_k * (rEquilibriumUptake_qStar - rInstantUptake_q);

(* Numerical Integration of Sorbent Water Loading (dt = 0.1s for 100ms task) *)
IF (iState = 30) OR (iState = 40) THEN
    (* Active Desorption: Water loading depletes *)
    rInstantUptake_q := rInstantUptake_q + (rDesorptionRate_dq_dt * 0.1);
ELSIF (iState = 70) THEN
    (* Nocturnal Adsorption: Mass uptake increases from ambient vapor *)
    rInstantUptake_q := rInstantUptake_q + (0.0035 * (0.450 - rInstantUptake_q) * 0.1);
END_IF;

(* Clamp instantaneous uptake to valid physical limits *)
IF rInstantUptake_q > 0.480 THEN
    rInstantUptake_q := 0.480;
ELSIF rInstantUptake_q < 0.020 THEN
    rInstantUptake_q := 0.020;
END_IF;

rCurrentWaterUptake := rInstantUptake_q;

(* Normalized Desorption Progress (0% to 100%) *)
rBedDesorptionProgress := ((0.440 - rInstantUptake_q) / (0.440 - 0.080)) * 100.0;
IF rBedDesorptionProgress > 100.0 THEN
    rBedDesorptionProgress := 100.0;
ELSIF rBedDesorptionProgress < 0.0 THEN
    rBedDesorptionProgress := 0.0;
END_IF;

(* Isosteric Heat of Adsorption Formulation: q_st = DeltaH + RT *)
rIsostericHeat_qst := ((c_rDeltaH_ads1 * 1000.0) / c_rMolarMassWater_M) / 1000.0; (* ~2914 kJ/kg *)

(* ========================================================================================= *)
(* 4.0 MULTI-STAGE CONDENSER & LATENT HEAT RECOVERY HEAT EXCHANGER DYNAMICS                  *)
(* Stage 1: Desuperheating & Latent Preheating | Stage 2: Main Condenser | Stage 3: Trim     *)
(* ========================================================================================= *)

(* Calculate Log-Mean Temperature Difference (LMTD) across Condenser *)
IF (rCondenserWallTemp_Stg1 > rCondenserWallTemp_Stg2) AND ((rVotedBedCoreTemp - rCondenserWallTemp_Stg2) > 1.0) THEN
    rCondenserLMTD := ((rVotedBedCoreTemp - rCondenserWallTemp_Stg1) + (rCondenserWallTemp_Stg1 - rCondenserWallTemp_Stg2)) * 0.5;
ELSE
    rCondenserLMTD := 15.0;
END_IF;

(* Multi-Stage Condenser Thermal Efficiency:
   eta_cond = Q_recovered / (dot_m_vapor * h_fg) *)
IF (rVotedVaporMassFlow > 0.2) AND (rLatentHeatCondensation > 1500.0) THEN
    rCondenserThermalEfficiency := (rLatentHeatRecoveryPower / ((rVotedVaporMassFlow / 3600.0) * rLatentHeatCondensation)) * 100.0;
ELSE
    rCondenserThermalEfficiency := 82.5; (* Nominal steady state estimate *)
END_IF;

IF rCondenserThermalEfficiency > 98.0 THEN
    rCondenserThermalEfficiency := 98.0;
ELSIF rCondenserThermalEfficiency < 10.0 THEN
    rCondenserThermalEfficiency := 10.0;
END_IF;

(* ========================================================================================= *)
(* 5.0 NON-CONDENSABLE GAS (NCG) PURGE & VACUUM SYNCHRONIZATION ENGINE                       *)
(* Evaluates Colburn-Hougen vapor boundary layer diffusion and Dalton partial pressures.    *)
(* ========================================================================================= *)

(* Dalton's Law: P_total = P_sat_water(T_condenser) + P_NCG
   P_NCG = P_voted_vacuum - P_sat(T_condenser_wall) *)
IF rVotedVacuumPress > rSatVaporPressCondenser THEN
    rNCG_PartialPressure := rVotedVacuumPress - rSatVaporPressCondenser;
ELSE
    rNCG_PartialPressure := 0.05; (* Negligible trace gas *)
END_IF;

(* Non-Condensable Gas Molar / Volume Ratio in Condenser [%] *)
IF rVotedVacuumPress > 0.1 THEN
    rNonCondensableGasRatio := (rNCG_PartialPressure / rVotedVacuumPress) * 100.0;
ELSE
    rNonCondensableGasRatio := 0.0;
END_IF;

IF rNonCondensableGasRatio > 100.0 THEN
    rNonCondensableGasRatio := 100.0;
END_IF;

(* Colburn-Hougen Diffusion Resistance Factor:
   Gas boundary layer resistance scales nonlinearly with NCG molar fraction:
   Theta_diff = 1.0 / (1.0 + 0.18 * (rNonCondensableGasRatio)^1.2) *)
rDiffusionResistanceFactor := 1.0 / (1.0 + (0.18 * rNonCondensableGasRatio));
IF rDiffusionResistanceFactor > 1.0 THEN
    rDiffusionResistanceFactor := 1.0;
ELSIF rDiffusionResistanceFactor < 0.05 THEN
    rDiffusionResistanceFactor := 0.05;
END_IF;

(* Degradation of Overall Condensation Heat Transfer Coefficient *)
rOverallHeatTransferCoeff_U := 2800.0 * rDiffusionResistanceFactor;

(* Vacuum Sync Purge Automation Logic *)
(* Interlock: Only permit purge if purge header vacuum is deeper than condenser chamber *)
bPurgePermitInterlock := (rPurgeLinePressure < (rVotedVacuumPress * 0.75)) OR (rPurgeLinePressure < 25.0);

(* Evaluate Purge Trigger Conditions *)
IF (rNonCondensableGasRatio >= c_rNCG_PurgeTriggerRatio) OR bManualPurgeReq THEN
    IF bPurgePermitInterlock AND NOT tPurgeCooldownTimer.IN THEN
        bPurgeActiveLatched := TRUE;
    END_IF;
END_IF;

(* Timed Pulse Purge Execution (Open purge solenoid for precisely calibrated 3.5 seconds) *)
tPurgeTimer(IN := bPurgeActiveLatched, PT := T#3500MS);
IF tPurgeTimer.Q OR (rNonCondensableGasRatio <= c_rNCG_PurgeClearRatio) THEN
    bPurgeActiveLatched := FALSE;
    tPurgeTimer(IN := FALSE);
    (* Start 15-second inter-purge vacuum stabilization cooldown *)
    tPurgeCooldownTimer(IN := TRUE, PT := T#15000MS);
END_IF;

IF tPurgeCooldownTimer.Q THEN
    tPurgeCooldownTimer(IN := FALSE);
END_IF;

bPurgeValveActive := bPurgeActiveLatched;

(* ========================================================================================= *)
(* 6.0 6-STATE DISCRETE STATE-SPACE MODEL & MODEL PREDICTIVE CONTROL (MPC) OPTIMIZATION      *)
(* Evaluates discrete state deviation, 1-step prediction, cost gradient and Hessian solver.  *)
(* ========================================================================================= *)

(* Calculate Normalized State Deviation Vector:
   x_dev = [Delta_q, Delta_Tbed, Delta_Pvac, Delta_Tcond, Delta_Pncg, Delta_Qrec]' *)
x1_Dev_q     := rCurrentWaterUptake - rTarget_q;
x2_Dev_Tbed  := rVotedBedCoreTemp - rTarget_Tbed;
x3_Dev_Pvac  := rVotedVacuumPress - rTarget_Pvac;
x4_Dev_Tcond := rCondenserWallTemp_Stg2 - rTarget_Tcond;
x5_Dev_Pncg  := rNCG_PartialPressure - rTarget_Pncg;
x6_Dev_Qrec  := rLatentHeatRecoveryPower - rTarget_Qrec;

(* Evaluate 1-Step Ahead State Prediction: x_next = Ad * x_dev + Bd * u_prev *)
x1_Next := (Ad_11 * x1_Dev_q) + (Ad_12 * x2_Dev_Tbed) + (Ad_13 * x3_Dev_Pvac) + (Ad_14 * x4_Dev_Tcond) + (Ad_15 * x5_Dev_Pncg) + (Ad_16 * x6_Dev_Qrec) + (Bd_11 * rDeltaSolar_Cmd) + (Bd_12 * rDeltaCoolant_Cmd);
x2_Next := (Ad_21 * x1_Dev_q) + (Ad_22 * x2_Dev_Tbed) + (Ad_23 * x3_Dev_Pvac) + (Ad_24 * x4_Dev_Tcond) + (Ad_25 * x5_Dev_Pncg) + (Ad_26 * x6_Dev_Qrec) + (Bd_21 * rDeltaSolar_Cmd) + (Bd_22 * rDeltaCoolant_Cmd);
x3_Next := (Ad_31 * x1_Dev_q) + (Ad_32 * x2_Dev_Tbed) + (Ad_33 * x3_Dev_Pvac) + (Ad_34 * x4_Dev_Tcond) + (Ad_35 * x5_Dev_Pncg) + (Ad_36 * x6_Dev_Qrec) + (Bd_31 * rDeltaSolar_Cmd) + (Bd_32 * rDeltaCoolant_Cmd);
x4_Next := (Ad_41 * x1_Dev_q) + (Ad_42 * x2_Dev_Tbed) + (Ad_43 * x3_Dev_Pvac) + (Ad_44 * x4_Dev_Tcond) + (Ad_45 * x5_Dev_Pncg) + (Ad_46 * x6_Dev_Qrec) + (Bd_41 * rDeltaSolar_Cmd) + (Bd_42 * rDeltaCoolant_Cmd);
x5_Next := (Ad_51 * x1_Dev_q) + (Ad_52 * x2_Dev_Tbed) + (Ad_53 * x3_Dev_Pvac) + (Ad_54 * x4_Dev_Tcond) + (Ad_55 * x5_Dev_Pncg) + (Ad_56 * x6_Dev_Qrec) + (Bd_51 * rDeltaSolar_Cmd) + (Bd_52 * rDeltaCoolant_Cmd);
x6_Next := (Ad_61 * x1_Dev_q) + (Ad_62 * x2_Dev_Tbed) + (Ad_63 * x3_Dev_Pvac) + (Ad_64 * x4_Dev_Tcond) + (Ad_65 * x5_Dev_Pncg) + (Ad_66 * x6_Dev_Qrec) + (Bd_61 * rDeltaSolar_Cmd) + (Bd_62 * rDeltaCoolant_Cmd);

(* Evaluate Analytical Gradient of Quadratic Cost: g = B' * Q * x_dev *)
(* Control Input 1: Solar Loop Modulation Valve Increment *)
rGrad_u1 := (Bd_11 * rMPC_Weight_qDev    * x1_Dev_q) +
            (Bd_21 * rMPC_Weight_TbedDev * x2_Dev_Tbed) +
            (Bd_31 * rMPC_Weight_PvacDev * x3_Dev_Pvac) +
            (Bd_41 * rMPC_Weight_TcondDev * x4_Dev_Tcond) +
            (Bd_51 * rMPC_Weight_PncgDev * x5_Dev_Pncg) +
            (Bd_61 * rMPC_Weight_QrecDev * x6_Dev_Qrec);

(* Control Input 2: Condenser Coolant Modulation Valve Increment *)
rGrad_u2 := (Bd_12 * rMPC_Weight_qDev    * x1_Dev_q) +
            (Bd_22 * rMPC_Weight_TbedDev * x2_Dev_Tbed) +
            (Bd_32 * rMPC_Weight_PvacDev * x3_Dev_Pvac) +
            (Bd_42 * rMPC_Weight_TcondDev * x4_Dev_Tcond) +
            (Bd_52 * rMPC_Weight_PncgDev * x5_Dev_Pncg) +
            (Bd_62 * rMPC_Weight_QrecDev * x6_Dev_Qrec);

(* Construct 2x2 Projected Hessian Matrix: H = B' * Q * B + R *)
rHess_11 := (Bd_11 * Bd_11 * rMPC_Weight_qDev) +
            (Bd_21 * Bd_21 * rMPC_Weight_TbedDev) +
            (Bd_31 * Bd_31 * rMPC_Weight_PvacDev) +
            (Bd_41 * Bd_41 * rMPC_Weight_TcondDev) +
            (Bd_51 * Bd_51 * rMPC_Weight_PncgDev) +
            (Bd_61 * Bd_61 * rMPC_Weight_QrecDev) +
            rMPC_Weight_dSolar;

rHess_22 := (Bd_12 * Bd_12 * rMPC_Weight_qDev) +
            (Bd_22 * Bd_22 * rMPC_Weight_TbedDev) +
            (Bd_32 * Bd_32 * rMPC_Weight_PvacDev) +
            (Bd_42 * Bd_42 * rMPC_Weight_TcondDev) +
            (Bd_52 * Bd_52 * rMPC_Weight_PncgDev) +
            (Bd_62 * Bd_62 * rMPC_Weight_QrecDev) +
            rMPC_Weight_dCoolant;

rHess_12 := (Bd_11 * Bd_12 * rMPC_Weight_qDev) +
            (Bd_21 * Bd_22 * rMPC_Weight_TbedDev) +
            (Bd_31 * Bd_32 * rMPC_Weight_PvacDev) +
            (Bd_41 * Bd_42 * rMPC_Weight_TcondDev) +
            (Bd_51 * Bd_52 * rMPC_Weight_PncgDev) +
            (Bd_61 * Bd_62 * rMPC_Weight_QrecDev);

(* Determinant of 2x2 Hessian Matrix *)
rDetHess := (rHess_11 * rHess_22) - (rHess_12 * rHess_12);

(* Invert Hessian via Cramer's Rule: Delta_u* = - H^-1 * g *)
IF rDetHess > 0.0001 THEN
    rDelta_u1_Optimal := - ((rHess_22 * rGrad_u1) - (rHess_12 * rGrad_u2)) / rDetHess;
    rDelta_u2_Optimal := - ((rHess_11 * rGrad_u2) - (rHess_12 * rGrad_u1)) / rDetHess;
    bMPC_DegradedFallback := FALSE;
ELSE
    (* Fallback: Direct Gradient Descent with Stabilizing Damping *)
    rDelta_u1_Optimal := - 0.08 * rGrad_u1;
    rDelta_u2_Optimal := - 0.08 * rGrad_u2;
    bMPC_DegradedFallback := TRUE;
    dwDiagnosticWord := dwDiagnosticWord OR 16#0000_0001; (* Diagnostic: Ill-Conditioned Hessian *)
END_IF;

(* Actuator Slew Rate Limiting & Envelope Clamping *)
(* Solar loop valve: Max +/- 2.5% per 100ms scan (~ 25%/s) *)
IF rDelta_u1_Optimal > 2.5 THEN
    rDeltaSolar_Cmd := 2.5;
ELSIF rDelta_u1_Optimal < -2.5 THEN
    rDeltaSolar_Cmd := -2.5;
ELSE
    rDeltaSolar_Cmd := rDelta_u1_Optimal;
END_IF;

(* Condenser coolant pump: Max +/- 3.0% per 100ms scan *)
IF rDelta_u2_Optimal > 3.0 THEN
    rDeltaCoolant_Cmd := 3.0;
ELSIF rDelta_u2_Optimal < -3.0 THEN
    rDeltaCoolant_Cmd := -3.0;
ELSE
    rDeltaCoolant_Cmd := rDelta_u2_Optimal;
END_IF;

(* ========================================================================================= *)

        rCondenserCoolantPumpSpeed := 15.0;

        rHeatRecoveryExchangerValve := 0.0;
        rBedPreEvacChokeValve := 0.0;

(* ============================================================================================= *)
(*                                    MAIN EXECUTION LOGIC                                       *)
(* ============================================================================================= *)

(* ============================================================================================= *)
(* SECTION 1: HARDWIRED SAFETY INTERLOCK VERIFICATION & SIL-3 EMERGENCY TRIP                     *)
(* ============================================================================================= *)
(* Fail-safe active-low emergency stop circuit verification *)
IF NOT bEmergencyStop THEN
    bEmergencyTripActive := TRUE;
    bTrip_Hardwire_Latched := TRUE;
    iStateStep := 90; (* Jump directly to STATE_EMERGENCY_RETRACT_BLOWDOWN_TRIP *)
END_IF;

(* Continuous Critical Boundary Fault Supervision *)
IF (iStateStep >= 30) AND (iStateStep <= 50) THEN
    (* 1. Wafer Slippage / Fly-Out Hazard: Loss of Vacuum or Severe Pocket Pressure Drop *)
    IF (rCarrierVacuum_kPa > 85.0) AND (rPolishingElapsed_Sec > 3.0) THEN
        bTrip_WaferSlip_Latched := TRUE;
        bEmergencyTripActive := TRUE;
        iStateStep := 90;
    END_IF;

    (* 2. Pad Surface Thermal Runaway: Exceeding 62.0 deg C damages polyurethane foam matrix *)
    IF rPadTemperature_degC > 62.0 THEN
        bTrip_PadOverheat_Latched := TRUE;
        bEmergencyTripActive := TRUE;
        iStateStep := 90;
    END_IF;

    (* 3. Slurry Starvation Hydroplaning Collapse: Dry friction generates catastrophic wafer fracture *)
    IF (rSlurryFlow_Filt_mLmin < 45.0) AND (rPolishingElapsed_Sec > 4.0) THEN
        bTrip_SlurryStarve_Latched := TRUE;
        bEmergencyTripActive := TRUE;
        iStateStep := 90;
    END_IF;

    (* 4. Spindle Reaction Torque Spike: Wafer shudder or pad delamination *)
    IF rCarrierTorque_Filt_Nm > 42.0 THEN
        bTrip_TorqueSpike_Latched := TRUE;
        bEmergencyTripActive := TRUE;
        iStateStep := 90;
    END_IF;

    (* 5. Membrane Pneumatic Rupture: Large discrepancy between commanded and actual chamber pressure *)
    IF (ABS(rPressureCmd_Zone1_kPa - rPressureFbk_Zone1_kPa) > 18.0) OR
       (ABS(rPressureCmd_Zone6_kPa - rPressureFbk_Zone6_kPa) > 18.0) OR
       (ABS(rPressureCmd_Zone7_kPa - rPressureFbk_Zone7_kPa) > 18.0) THEN
        bTrip_MembraneRupture_Latched := TRUE;
        bEmergencyTripActive := TRUE;
        iStateStep := 90;
    END_IF;
END_IF;

(* Operator Diagnostic Reset & Latch Clear Handler *)
IF bAcknowledgeFaults THEN
    IF bEmergencyStop THEN
        bTrip_Hardwire_Latched := FALSE;
    END_IF;
    IF rCarrierVacuum_kPa <= 30.0 THEN
        bTrip_WaferSlip_Latched := FALSE;
    END_IF;
    IF rPadTemperature_degC < 48.0 THEN
        bTrip_PadOverheat_Latched := FALSE;
    END_IF;
    IF rSlurryFlow_Filt_mLmin > 120.0 THEN
        bTrip_SlurryStarve_Latched := FALSE;
    END_IF;
    IF rCarrierTorque_Filt_Nm < 20.0 THEN
        bTrip_TorqueSpike_Latched := FALSE;
    END_IF;
    bTrip_MembraneRupture_Latched := FALSE;
    bTrip_OverpolishPunch_Latched := FALSE;
    bTrip_TotalSpectroLoss_Latched := FALSE;
    IF (NOT bTrip_Hardwire_Latched) AND (NOT bTrip_WaferSlip_Latched) AND
       (NOT bTrip_PadOverheat_Latched) AND (NOT bTrip_SlurryStarve_Latched) AND
       (NOT bTrip_TorqueSpike_Latched) THEN
        bEmergencyTripActive := FALSE;
        wTripAlarmBitmask := 16#0000;
    END_IF;
END_IF;

(* ============================================================================================= *)
(* SECTION 2: 2-OUT-OF-3 (2oo3) TRIPLE MODULAR REDUNDANCY VOTING ENGINE                         *)
(* ============================================================================================= *)
(* --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* SUB-SECTION 2.1: Center Spectrometric Thickness Transmitters 2oo3 Voting                      *)
(* --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
IF bHealth_Thick_ChA AND bHealth_Thick_ChB AND bHealth_Thick_ChC THEN
    (* All 3 channels online: Median Selection Algorithm *)
    IF (rThickness_Spectro_nm_ChA >= rThickness_Spectro_nm_ChB) THEN
        IF (rThickness_Spectro_nm_ChB >= rThickness_Spectro_nm_ChC) THEN
            rThickness_Voted_nm := rThickness_Spectro_nm_ChB;
        ELSIF (rThickness_Spectro_nm_ChA >= rThickness_Spectro_nm_ChC) THEN
            rThickness_Voted_nm := rThickness_Spectro_nm_ChC;
        ELSE
            rThickness_Voted_nm := rThickness_Spectro_nm_ChA;
        END_IF;
    ELSE
        IF (rThickness_Spectro_nm_ChA >= rThickness_Spectro_nm_ChC) THEN
            rThickness_Voted_nm := rThickness_Spectro_nm_ChA;
        ELSIF (rThickness_Spectro_nm_ChB >= rThickness_Spectro_nm_ChC) THEN
            rThickness_Voted_nm := rThickness_Spectro_nm_ChC;
        ELSE
            rThickness_Voted_nm := rThickness_Spectro_nm_ChB;
        END_IF;
    END_IF;

    (* Monitor inter-channel deviation thresholds *)
    IF (ABS(rThickness_Spectro_nm_ChA - rThickness_Spectro_nm_ChB) > rTOL_Thick_nm) OR
       (ABS(rThickness_Spectro_nm_ChB - rThickness_Spectro_nm_ChC) > rTOL_Thick_nm) OR
       (ABS(rThickness_Spectro_nm_ChA - rThickness_Spectro_nm_ChC) > rTOL_Thick_nm) THEN
        rTimer_Thick_Discrepancy := rTimer_Thick_Discrepancy + tScanDeltaTime_Sec;
        IF rTimer_Thick_Discrepancy >= rMAX_DISCREPANCY_TIME_Sec THEN
            (* Identify rogue spectrometer and isolate *)
            IF ABS(rThickness_Spectro_nm_ChA - rThickness_Voted_nm) > rTOL_Thick_nm THEN
                bHealth_Thick_ChA := FALSE;
            ELSIF ABS(rThickness_Spectro_nm_ChB - rThickness_Voted_nm) > rTOL_Thick_nm THEN
                bHealth_Thick_ChB := FALSE;
            ELSE
                bHealth_Thick_ChC := FALSE;
            END_IF;
        END_IF;
    ELSE
        rTimer_Thick_Discrepancy := 0.0;
    END_IF;
ELSIF (bHealth_Thick_ChA AND bHealth_Thick_ChB) THEN
    rThickness_Voted_nm := 0.5 * (rThickness_Spectro_nm_ChA + rThickness_Spectro_nm_ChB);
    bDegradedSensorMode := TRUE;
ELSIF (bHealth_Thick_ChA AND bHealth_Thick_ChC) THEN
    rThickness_Voted_nm := 0.5 * (rThickness_Spectro_nm_ChA + rThickness_Spectro_nm_ChC);
    bDegradedSensorMode := TRUE;
ELSIF (bHealth_Thick_ChB AND bHealth_Thick_ChC) THEN
    rThickness_Voted_nm := 0.5 * (rThickness_Spectro_nm_ChB + rThickness_Spectro_nm_ChC);
    bDegradedSensorMode := TRUE;
ELSE
    (* Degraded 1oo1 fallback mode *)
    IF bHealth_Thick_ChA THEN
        rThickness_Voted_nm := rThickness_Spectro_nm_ChA;
    ELSIF bHealth_Thick_ChB THEN
        rThickness_Voted_nm := rThickness_Spectro_nm_ChB;
    ELSIF bHealth_Thick_ChC THEN
        rThickness_Voted_nm := rThickness_Spectro_nm_ChC;
    ELSE
        (* Total instrument loss: trip *)
        bTrip_TotalSpectroLoss_Latched := TRUE;
        bEmergencyTripActive := TRUE;
        iStateStep := 90;
    END_IF;
    bDegradedSensorMode := TRUE;
END_IF;

(* --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* SUB-SECTION 2.2: CMP Platen Table Rotational Speed 2oo3 Voting                                *)
(* --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
IF bHealth_Platen_ChA AND bHealth_Platen_ChB AND bHealth_Platen_ChC THEN
    IF (rPlatenSpeed_rpm_ChA >= rPlatenSpeed_rpm_ChB) THEN
        IF (rPlatenSpeed_rpm_ChB >= rPlatenSpeed_rpm_ChC) THEN
            rPlatenSpeed_Voted_rpm := rPlatenSpeed_rpm_ChB;
        ELSIF (rPlatenSpeed_rpm_ChA >= rPlatenSpeed_rpm_ChC) THEN
            rPlatenSpeed_Voted_rpm := rPlatenSpeed_rpm_ChC;
        ELSE
            rPlatenSpeed_Voted_rpm := rPlatenSpeed_rpm_ChA;
        END_IF;
    ELSE
        IF (rPlatenSpeed_rpm_ChA >= rPlatenSpeed_rpm_ChC) THEN
            rPlatenSpeed_Voted_rpm := rPlatenSpeed_rpm_ChA;
        ELSIF (rPlatenSpeed_rpm_ChB >= rPlatenSpeed_rpm_ChC) THEN
            rPlatenSpeed_Voted_rpm := rPlatenSpeed_rpm_ChC;
        ELSE
            rPlatenSpeed_Voted_rpm := rPlatenSpeed_rpm_ChB;

    IF (ABS(rPlatenSpeed_rpm_ChA - rPlatenSpeed_rpm_ChB) > rTOL_Platen_rpm) OR
       (ABS(rPlatenSpeed_rpm_ChB - rPlatenSpeed_rpm_ChC) > rTOL_Platen_rpm) OR
       (ABS(rPlatenSpeed_rpm_ChA - rPlatenSpeed_rpm_ChC) > rTOL_Platen_rpm) THEN
        rTimer_Platen_Discrepancy := rTimer_Platen_Discrepancy + tScanDeltaTime_Sec;
        IF rTimer_Platen_Discrepancy >= rMAX_DISCREPANCY_TIME_Sec THEN
            IF ABS(rPlatenSpeed_rpm_ChA - rPlatenSpeed_Voted_rpm) > rTOL_Platen_rpm THEN
                bHealth_Platen_ChA := FALSE;
            ELSIF ABS(rPlatenSpeed_rpm_ChB - rPlatenSpeed_Voted_rpm) > rTOL_Platen_rpm THEN
                bHealth_Platen_ChB := FALSE;
            ELSE
                bHealth_Platen_ChC := FALSE;
            END_IF;
        END_IF;
    ELSE
        rTimer_Platen_Discrepancy := 0.0;
    END_IF;
ELSIF (bHealth_Platen_ChA AND bHealth_Platen_ChB) THEN
    rPlatenSpeed_Voted_rpm := 0.5 * (rPlatenSpeed_rpm_ChA + rPlatenSpeed_rpm_ChB);
    bDegradedSensorMode := TRUE;
ELSIF (bHealth_Platen_ChA AND bHealth_Platen_ChC) THEN
    rPlatenSpeed_Voted_rpm := 0.5 * (rPlatenSpeed_rpm_ChA + rPlatenSpeed_rpm_ChC);
    bDegradedSensorMode := TRUE;
ELSIF (bHealth_Platen_ChB AND bHealth_Platen_ChC) THEN
    rPlatenSpeed_Voted_rpm := 0.5 * (rPlatenSpeed_rpm_ChB + rPlatenSpeed_rpm_ChC);
    bDegradedSensorMode := TRUE;
ELSE
    IF bHealth_Platen_ChA THEN
        rPlatenSpeed_Voted_rpm := rPlatenSpeed_rpm_ChA;
    ELSIF bHealth_Platen_ChB THEN
        rPlatenSpeed_Voted_rpm := rPlatenSpeed_rpm_ChB;
    ELSIF bHealth_Platen_ChC THEN
        rPlatenSpeed_Voted_rpm := rPlatenSpeed_rpm_ChC;
    ELSE
        rPlatenSpeed_Voted_rpm := 0.0;
        bEmergencyTripActive := TRUE;
        iStateStep := 90;
    END_IF;
    bDegradedSensorMode := TRUE;
END_IF;

(* --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* SUB-SECTION 2.3: Slurry Chemical Dispense Flow Transmitters 2oo3 Voting                       *)
(* --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
IF bHealth_Slurry_ChA AND bHealth_Slurry_ChB AND bHealth_Slurry_ChC THEN
    IF (rSlurryFlow_mLmin_ChA >= rSlurryFlow_mLmin_ChB) THEN
        IF (rSlurryFlow_mLmin_ChB >= rSlurryFlow_mLmin_ChC) THEN
            rSlurryFlow_Voted_mLmin := rSlurryFlow_mLmin_ChB;
        ELSIF (rSlurryFlow_mLmin_ChA >= rSlurryFlow_mLmin_ChC) THEN
            rSlurryFlow_Voted_mLmin := rSlurryFlow_mLmin_ChC;
        ELSE
            rSlurryFlow_Voted_mLmin := rSlurryFlow_mLmin_ChA;
        END_IF;
    ELSE
        IF (rSlurryFlow_mLmin_ChA >= rSlurryFlow_mLmin_ChC) THEN
            rSlurryFlow_Voted_mLmin := rSlurryFlow_mLmin_ChA;
        ELSIF (rSlurryFlow_mLmin_ChB >= rSlurryFlow_mLmin_ChC) THEN
            rSlurryFlow_Voted_mLmin := rSlurryFlow_mLmin_ChC;
        ELSE
            rSlurryFlow_Voted_mLmin := rSlurryFlow_mLmin_ChB;
        END_IF;
    END_IF;

    IF (ABS(rSlurryFlow_mLmin_ChA - rSlurryFlow_mLmin_ChB) > rTOL_Slurry_mLmin) OR
       (ABS(rSlurryFlow_mLmin_ChB - rSlurryFlow_mLmin_ChC) > rTOL_Slurry_mLmin) OR
       (ABS(rSlurryFlow_mLmin_ChA - rSlurryFlow_mLmin_ChC) > rTOL_Slurry_mLmin) THEN
        rTimer_Slurry_Discrepancy := rTimer_Slurry_Discrepancy + tScanDeltaTime_Sec;
        IF rTimer_Slurry_Discrepancy >= rMAX_DISCREPANCY_TIME_Sec THEN
            IF ABS(rSlurryFlow_mLmin_ChA - rSlurryFlow_Voted_mLmin) > rTOL_Slurry_mLmin THEN
                bHealth_Slurry_ChA := FALSE;
            ELSIF ABS(rSlurryFlow_mLmin_ChB - rSlurryFlow_Voted_mLmin) > rTOL_Slurry_mLmin THEN
                bHealth_Slurry_ChB := FALSE;
            ELSE
                bHealth_Slurry_ChC := FALSE;
            END_IF;
        END_IF;
    ELSE
        rTimer_Slurry_Discrepancy := 0.0;
    END_IF;
ELSIF (bHealth_Slurry_ChA AND bHealth_Slurry_ChB) THEN
    rSlurryFlow_Voted_mLmin := 0.5 * (rSlurryFlow_mLmin_ChA + rSlurryFlow_mLmin_ChB);
    bDegradedSensorMode := TRUE;
ELSIF (bHealth_Slurry_ChA AND bHealth_Slurry_ChC) THEN
    rSlurryFlow_Voted_mLmin := 0.5 * (rSlurryFlow_mLmin_ChA + rSlurryFlow_mLmin_ChC);
    bDegradedSensorMode := TRUE;
ELSIF (bHealth_Slurry_ChB AND bHealth_Slurry_ChC) THEN
    rSlurryFlow_Voted_mLmin := 0.5 * (rSlurryFlow_mLmin_ChB + rSlurryFlow_mLmin_ChC);
    bDegradedSensorMode := TRUE;
ELSE
    IF bHealth_Slurry_ChA THEN
        rSlurryFlow_Voted_mLmin := rSlurryFlow_mLmin_ChA;
    ELSIF bHealth_Slurry_ChB THEN
        rSlurryFlow_Voted_mLmin := rSlurryFlow_mLmin_ChB;
    ELSIF bHealth_Slurry_ChC THEN
        rSlurryFlow_Voted_mLmin := rSlurryFlow_mLmin_ChC;
    ELSE
        rSlurryFlow_Voted_mLmin := 0.0;
        bEmergencyTripActive := TRUE;
        iStateStep := 90;
    END_IF;
    bDegradedSensorMode := TRUE;
END_IF;

(* --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* SUB-SECTION 2.4: Carrier Spindle Motor Drive Torque 2oo3 Voting                               *)
(* --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
IF bHealth_Torque_ChA AND bHealth_Torque_ChB AND bHealth_Torque_ChC THEN
    IF (rCarrierTorque_Nm_ChA >= rCarrierTorque_Nm_ChB) THEN
        IF (rCarrierTorque_Nm_ChB >= rCarrierTorque_Nm_ChC) THEN
            rCarrierTorque_Voted_Nm := rCarrierTorque_Nm_ChB;
        ELSIF (rCarrierTorque_Nm_ChA >= rCarrierTorque_Nm_ChC) THEN
            rCarrierTorque_Voted_Nm := rCarrierTorque_Nm_ChC;
        ELSE
            rCarrierTorque_Voted_Nm := rCarrierTorque_Nm_ChA;
        END_IF;
    ELSE
        IF (rCarrierTorque_Nm_ChA >= rCarrierTorque_Nm_ChC) THEN
            rCarrierTorque_Voted_Nm := rCarrierTorque_Nm_ChA;
        ELSIF (rCarrierTorque_Nm_ChB >= rCarrierTorque_Nm_ChC) THEN
            rCarrierTorque_Voted_Nm := rCarrierTorque_Nm_ChC;
        ELSE
            rCarrierTorque_Voted_Nm := rCarrierTorque_Nm_ChB;
        END_IF;
    END_IF;

    IF (ABS(rCarrierTorque_Nm_ChA - rCarrierTorque_Nm_ChB) > rTOL_Torque_Nm) OR
       (ABS(rCarrierTorque_Nm_ChB - rCarrierTorque_Nm_ChC) > rTOL_Torque_Nm) OR
       (ABS(rCarrierTorque_Nm_ChA - rCarrierTorque_Nm_ChC) > rTOL_Torque_Nm) THEN
        rTimer_Torque_Discrepancy := rTimer_Torque_Discrepancy + tScanDeltaTime_Sec;
        IF rTimer_Torque_Discrepancy >= rMAX_DISCREPANCY_TIME_Sec THEN
            IF ABS(rCarrierTorque_Nm_ChA - rCarrierTorque_Voted_Nm) > rTOL_Torque_Nm THEN
                bHealth_Torque_ChA := FALSE;
            ELSIF ABS(rCarrierTorque_Nm_ChB - rCarrierTorque_Voted_Nm) > rTOL_Torque_Nm THEN
                bHealth_Torque_ChB := FALSE;
            ELSE
                bHealth_Torque_ChC := FALSE;
            END_IF;
        END_IF;
    ELSE
        rTimer_Torque_Discrepancy := 0.0;
    END_IF;
ELSIF (bHealth_Torque_ChA AND bHealth_Torque_ChB) THEN
    rCarrierTorque_Voted_Nm := 0.5 * (rCarrierTorque_Nm_ChA + rCarrierTorque_Nm_ChB);
    bDegradedSensorMode := TRUE;
ELSIF (bHealth_Torque_ChA AND bHealth_Torque_ChC) THEN
    rCarrierTorque_Voted_Nm := 0.5 * (rCarrierTorque_Nm_ChA + rCarrierTorque_Nm_ChC);
    bDegradedSensorMode := TRUE;
ELSIF (bHealth_Torque_ChB AND bHealth_Torque_ChC) THEN
    rCarrierTorque_Voted_Nm := 0.5 * (rCarrierTorque_Nm_ChB + rCarrierTorque_Nm_ChC);

    ELSIF bHealth_Torque_ChB THEN
        rCarrierTorque_Voted_Nm := rCarrierTorque_Nm_ChB;
    ELSIF bHealth_Torque_ChC THEN
        rCarrierTorque_Voted_Nm := rCarrierTorque_Nm_ChC;
    ELSE
        rCarrierTorque_Voted_Nm := 0.0;
        bEmergencyTripActive := TRUE;
        iStateStep := 90;
    END_IF;
    bDegradedSensorMode := TRUE;
END_IF;

(* Digital Low-Pass Smoothing Filters *)
rThickness_Filt_nm     := (rFilterWeight * rThickness_Voted_nm)     + ((1.0 - rFilterWeight) * rThickness_Filt_nm);
rPlatenSpeed_Filt_rpm  := (rFilterWeight * rPlatenSpeed_Voted_rpm)  + ((1.0 - rFilterWeight) * rPlatenSpeed_Filt_rpm);
rSlurryFlow_Filt_mLmin := (rFilterWeight * rSlurryFlow_Voted_mLmin) + ((1.0 - rFilterWeight) * rSlurryFlow_Filt_mLmin);
rCarrierTorque_Filt_Nm := (rFilterWeight * rCarrierTorque_Voted_Nm) + ((1.0 - rFilterWeight) * rCarrierTorque_Filt_Nm);

(* Map Array of Multi-Zone Process Thicknesses *)
rZoneThicknessArray[1] := rThickness_Filt_nm;
rZoneThicknessArray[2] := rThickness_Zone2_nm;
rZoneThicknessArray[3] := rThickness_Zone3_nm;
rZoneThicknessArray[4] := rThickness_Zone4_nm;
rZoneThicknessArray[5] := rThickness_Zone5_nm;
rZoneThicknessArray[6] := rThickness_Zone6_nm;
rZoneThicknessArray[7] := rThickness_Zone7_nm;
rFilmThicknessResidual_nm := rThickness_Filt_nm;

(* ============================================================================================= *)
(* SECTION 3: SLURRY NANO-ABRASIVE SHEAR RATE TRIBOLOGY & CONTACT MECHANICS                     *)
(* ============================================================================================= *)
(* Kinematic Relative Velocities Across 7 Concentric Carrier Membrane Zones:                     *)
(* V_rel(r) = sqrt( (omega_platen * R_offset)^2 + (omega_platen - omega_carrier)^2 * r^2 )        *)
rRelVelocityCenter_m_s := (rPlatenSpeed_Filt_rpm * 0.104719755) * rCarrierOffsetDistance_m;

rZoneVelocity_m_s[1] := SQRT(EXPT(rRelVelocityCenter_m_s, 2.0) + EXPT(((rPlatenSpeed_Filt_rpm - rCarrierSpeed_rpm) * 0.104719755) * rRadius_Zone1_m, 2.0));
rZoneVelocity_m_s[2] := SQRT(EXPT(rRelVelocityCenter_m_s, 2.0) + EXPT(((rPlatenSpeed_Filt_rpm - rCarrierSpeed_rpm) * 0.104719755) * rRadius_Zone2_m, 2.0));
rZoneVelocity_m_s[3] := SQRT(EXPT(rRelVelocityCenter_m_s, 2.0) + EXPT(((rPlatenSpeed_Filt_rpm - rCarrierSpeed_rpm) * 0.104719755) * rRadius_Zone3_m, 2.0));
rZoneVelocity_m_s[4] := SQRT(EXPT(rRelVelocityCenter_m_s, 2.0) + EXPT(((rPlatenSpeed_Filt_rpm - rCarrierSpeed_rpm) * 0.104719755) * rRadius_Zone4_m, 2.0));
rZoneVelocity_m_s[5] := SQRT(EXPT(rRelVelocityCenter_m_s, 2.0) + EXPT(((rPlatenSpeed_Filt_rpm - rCarrierSpeed_rpm) * 0.104719755) * rRadius_Zone5_m, 2.0));
rZoneVelocity_m_s[6] := SQRT(EXPT(rRelVelocityCenter_m_s, 2.0) + EXPT(((rPlatenSpeed_Filt_rpm - rCarrierSpeed_rpm) * 0.104719755) * rRadius_Zone6_m, 2.0));
rZoneVelocity_m_s[7] := SQRT(EXPT(rRelVelocityCenter_m_s, 2.0) + EXPT(((rPlatenSpeed_Filt_rpm - rCarrierSpeed_rpm) * 0.104719755) * rRadius_Zone7_m, 2.0));

(* Mean Hydrodynamic Slurry Shear Rate: gamma_dot = V_rel / h_lub [1/s] *)
IF rSlurryFilmThickness_m > 1.0E-6 THEN
    rSlurryShearRate_Local := rZoneVelocity_m_s[4] / rSlurryFilmThickness_m;
ELSE
    rSlurryShearRate_Local := 45000.0;
END_IF;
rShearRate_SecInv := rSlurryShearRate_Local;

(* Non-Newtonian Carreau-Yasuda Rheology Model:                                                  *)
(* mu(gamma_dot) = mu_inf + (mu_0 - mu_inf) * [ 1 + (lambda * gamma_dot)^2 ]^((n - 1) / 2)       *)
rApparentViscosity_PaS := rMu_InfShear_PaS + ((rMu_ZeroShear_PaS - rMu_InfShear_PaS) *
    EXPT((1.0 + EXPT(rCarreau_Lambda_Sec * rSlurryShearRate_Local, 2.0)), ((rCarreau_PowerIndex_n - 1.0) / 2.0)));
rSlurryDynamicViscosity_mPaS := rApparentViscosity_PaS * 1000.0;

(* Stribeck Lubrication Parameter: S = (mu * V_rel) / P_avg *)
IF rPressureFbk_Zone4_kPa > 1.0 THEN
    rStribeckNumber := (rApparentViscosity_PaS * rZoneVelocity_m_s[4]) / (rPressureFbk_Zone4_kPa * 1000.0);
ELSE
    rStribeckNumber := 0.0001;
END_IF;

(* Total Downward Normal Force & Friction Coefficient Mu:                                        *)
(* F_N = Sum( P_i * Area_i ) + P_RR * Area_RR                                                   *)
rTotalVerticalDownforce_N :=
    (rPressureFbk_Zone1_kPa * 0.001963) +
    (rPressureFbk_Zone2_kPa * 0.007540) +
    (rPressureFbk_Zone3_kPa * 0.012252) +
    (rPressureFbk_Zone4_kPa * 0.016022) +
    (rPressureFbk_Zone5_kPa * 0.015243) +
    (rPressureFbk_Zone6_kPa * 0.008126) +
    (rPressureFbk_Zone7_kPa * 0.001407) +
    (rPressureFbk_RetRing_kPa * 0.031102);
rTotalVerticalDownforce_N := rTotalVerticalDownforce_N * 1000.0; (* Convert kPa*m^2 to N *)

(* Friction Force F_f = Torque / R_offset *)
IF rCarrierOffsetDistance_m > 0.05 THEN
    rFrictionForce_N := rCarrierTorque_Filt_Nm / rCarrierOffsetDistance_m;
ELSE
    rFrictionForce_N := 0.0;
END_IF;

(* Instantaneous Friction Coefficient Mu = F_friction / F_normal *)
IF rTotalVerticalDownforce_N > 50.0 THEN
    rCurrentFrictionCoeff_Mu := rFrictionForce_N / rTotalVerticalDownforce_N;
    IF rCurrentFrictionCoeff_Mu > 0.85 THEN
        rCurrentFrictionCoeff_Mu := 0.85;
    ELSIF rCurrentFrictionCoeff_Mu < 0.05 THEN
        rCurrentFrictionCoeff_Mu := 0.05;
    END_IF;
ELSE
    rCurrentFrictionCoeff_Mu := 0.35;
END_IF;

(* Dynamic Pad Micro-Asperity Glaze Saturation Index Tracking *)
IF (iStateStep >= 40) AND (iStateStep <= 50) THEN
    rPadGlazingIndex_Pct := rPadGlazingIndex_Pct +
        (rPadGlazeRateCoeff * rCurrentFrictionCoeff_Mu * rZoneVelocity_m_s[4] * tScanDeltaTime_Sec) -
        (rConditionerCutoffCoeff * (rConditionerDownforce_N / 45.0) * (rConditionerSweepFreq_Hz / 0.35) * tScanDeltaTime_Sec);
    IF rPadGlazingIndex_Pct > 100.0 THEN
        rPadGlazingIndex_Pct := 100.0;
    ELSIF rPadGlazingIndex_Pct < 0.0 THEN
        rPadGlazingIndex_Pct := 0.0;
    END_IF;
END_IF;

(* ============================================================================================= *)
(* SECTION 4: IN-SITU SPECTROSCOPIC THICKNESS PROFILING & MULTI-ZONE ENDPOINT DETECTION (EPD)   *)
(* ============================================================================================= *)
(* Shift 5-Point Thickness History Buffer for Savitzky-Golay Linear Regression Slope *)
rThicknessBuffer_Center[5] := rThicknessBuffer_Center[4];
rThicknessBuffer_Center[4] := rThicknessBuffer_Center[3];
rThicknessBuffer_Center[3] := rThicknessBuffer_Center[2];
rThicknessBuffer_Center[2] := rThicknessBuffer_Center[1];
rThicknessBuffer_Center[1] := rThickness_Filt_nm;

(* Least-Squares 1st Derivative: slope = [ 2*(y1 - y5) + (y2 - y4) ] / (10 * dt) [nm/s] *)
IF tScanDeltaTime_Sec > 0.001 THEN
    rSlope_Derivative_nm_s :=
        (2.0 * (rThicknessBuffer_Center[1] - rThicknessBuffer_Center[5]) +
         1.0 * (rThicknessBuffer_Center[2] - rThicknessBuffer_Center[4])) / (10.0 * tScanDeltaTime_Sec);
    (* Convert nm/s to Angstrom/min: RR = -slope * 10 [Angstrom/nm] * 60 [s/min] *)
    rEstimatedRemovalRate_AngstromMin := -1.0 * rSlope_Derivative_nm_s * 600.0;
    IF rEstimatedRemovalRate_AngstromMin < 0.0 THEN
        rEstimatedRemovalRate_AngstromMin := 0.0;
    END_IF;
ELSE
    rEstimatedRemovalRate_AngstromMin := 2800.0;
END_IF;

(* 2nd Derivative Curvature: inflection point indicates barrier breakthrough *)
rCurvature_2ndDeriv := (rThicknessBuffer_Center[1] - (2.0 * rThicknessBuffer_Center[3]) + rThicknessBuffer_Center[5]) /
    EXPT(2.0 * tScanDeltaTime_Sec, 2.0);

(* Within-Wafer Non-Uniformity (WIWNU) Across 7 Concentric Radial Zones *)
rSum := 0.0;
FOR iIdx := 1 TO 7 DO
    rSum := rSum + rZoneThicknessArray[iIdx];
END_FOR;
rMeanThick := rSum / 7.0;

rVariance := 0.0;
FOR iIdx := 1 TO 7 DO
    rVariance := rVariance + EXPT(rZoneThicknessArray[iIdx] - rMeanThick, 2.0);
END_FOR;
rStdDev := SQRT(rVariance / 7.0);

IF rMeanThick > 0.1 THEN
    rWaferNonUniformity_WIWNU_Pct := (rStdDev / rMeanThick) * 100.0;
ELSE
    rWaferNonUniformity_WIWNU_Pct := 0.0;
END_IF;

(* Spectroscopic EPD Trigger Detection *)
rEndpointThreshold_nm := rTargetFinalThickness_nm + rAllowedOverpolish_nm;
IF (rThickness_Filt_nm <= rEndpointThreshold_nm) AND (iStateStep == 40) THEN
    bEndpointDetected := TRUE;
    rEndpointConfidence_Pct := 98.4;
    iStateStep := 50; (* Transition to SELECTIVE_BUFF_OVERPOLISH *)
END_IF;

(* ============================================================================================= *)
(* SECTION 5: DISCRETE-TIME STATE-SPACE KALMAN STATE OBSERVER UPDATE                            *)
(* ============================================================================================= *)
(* 1. Innovation Error: y_meas - C_d * x_pred *)
FOR iRow := 1 TO 7 DO
    (* Nominal target thickness trajectory difference in Angstroms: 1 nm = 10 Angstroms *)
    rInnovation[iRow] := ((rZoneThicknessArray[iRow] - rTargetFinalThickness_nm) * 10.0) - xState_Pred[iRow];
END_FOR;

(* 2. Measurement State Correction: x_est = x_pred + L * Innovation *)
FOR iRow := 1 TO 8 DO
    rSum := 0.0;
    FOR iCol := 1 TO 7 DO
        rSum := rSum + (mL_Gain[iRow, iCol] * rInnovation[iCol]);
    END_FOR;
    xState_Est[iRow] := xState_Pred[iRow] + rSum;
    xState[iRow] := xState_Est[iRow];
END_FOR;

(* 3. Disturbance Vector Extraction *)
dDisturbance[1] := rPlatenSpeed_Filt_rpm - 90.0;
dDisturbance[2] := rSlurryFlow_Filt_mLmin - 250.0;
dDisturbance[3] := rConditionerDownforce_N - 45.0;

(* ============================================================================================= *)
(* SECTION 6: MULTIVARIABLE MODEL PREDICTIVE CONTROL (MPC) 7-ZONE PRESSURE OPTIMIZER           *)
(* ============================================================================================= *)
(* Solve Projected Gradient Quadratic Programming Step deterministically *)
IF (iStateStep == 40) OR (iStateStep == 50) THEN
    (* Target trajectory: drive thickness error to zero *)
    FOR iIdx := 1 TO 7 DO
        xState_Ref[iIdx] := 0.0;
    END_FOR;
    xState_Ref[8] := 0.0; (* Regulate pad temp to nominal 38 deg C *)

    (* Projected Gradient Descent Iteration Loop *)
    FOR iQPIter := 1 TO iMaxQPIter DO
        (* One-step forward prediction: x_pred = A_d * x_est + B_d * u + E_d * d *)
        FOR iRow := 1 TO 8 DO
            rSum := 0.0;
            FOR iCol := 1 TO 8 DO
                rSum := rSum + (mA_d[iRow, iCol] * xState_Est[iCol]);
            END_FOR;
            FOR iCol := 1 TO 7 DO
                rSum := rSum + (mB_d[iRow, iCol] * uControl[iCol]);
            END_FOR;
            FOR iCol := 1 TO 3 DO
                rSum := rSum + (mE_d[iRow, iCol] * dDisturbance[iCol]);
            END_FOR;
            xState_Pred[iRow] := rSum;
        END_FOR;

        (* Compute Gradient: Grad_u = B_d^T * Q * (x_pred - x_ref) + R * u + S * (u - u_prev) *)
        FOR iCol := 1 TO 7 DO
            rSum := 0.0;
            FOR iRow := 1 TO 8 DO
                rSum := rSum + (mB_d[iRow, iCol] * vQ_Diag[iRow] * (xState_Pred[iRow] - xState_Ref[iRow]));
            END_FOR;
            rSum := rSum + (vR_Diag[iCol] * uControl[iCol]) + (vS_Diag[iCol] * (uControl[iCol] - uControl_Prev[iCol]));

            (* Edge Roll-Off Barrier Penalty: Penalize excessive pressure differential between Zone 6 and 7 *)
            IF iCol == 7 THEN
                rEdgeShearDeltaP_kPa := uControl[7] - uControl[6];
                IF ABS(rEdgeShearDeltaP_kPa) > 4.5 THEN
                    rSum := rSum + (rRhoEdgePenalty * (rEdgeShearDeltaP_kPa - 4.5));
                END_IF;
            END_IF;
            rGradJ[iCol] := rSum;
        END_FOR;

        (* Gradient Descent Update with Projection into Feasible Pressure Bounds *)
        FOR iCol := 1 TO 7 DO
            uControl[iCol] := uControl[iCol] - (rAlphaStep * rGradJ[iCol]);
            (* Enforce Actuator Slew Rate Constraints *)
            IF (uControl[iCol] - uControl_Prev[iCol]) > rMaxDeltaP_PerScan THEN
                uControl[iCol] := uControl_Prev[iCol] + rMaxDeltaP_PerScan;
            ELSIF (uControl[iCol] - uControl_Prev[iCol]) < -rMaxDeltaP_PerScan THEN
                uControl[iCol] := uControl_Prev[iCol] - rMaxDeltaP_PerScan;
            END_IF;
            (* Enforce Absolute Pressure Bounds [rPressureMin_kPa - 20.0, rPressureMax_kPa - 20.0] *)
            IF uControl[iCol] > (rPressureMax_kPa - 20.0) THEN
                uControl[iCol] := rPressureMax_kPa - 20.0;
            ELSIF uControl[iCol] < (rPressureMin_kPa - 20.0) THEN
                uControl[iCol] := rPressureMin_kPa - 20.0;
            END_IF;
        END_FOR;
    END_FOR;

    (* Store Previous Control Setpoint for Slew Penalty *)
    FOR iCol := 1 TO 7 DO
        uControl_Prev[iCol] := uControl[iCol];
    END_FOR;

    (* Decouple Pneumatic Cross-Talk: P_valves = M_decouple * (P_baseline + uControl) *)
    FOR iRow := 1 TO 7 DO
        rSum := 0.0;
        FOR iCol := 1 TO 7 DO
            rTargetZoneP_kPa := 20.0 + uControl[iCol];
            rSum := rSum + (mMembraneDecouple[iRow, iCol] * rTargetZoneP_kPa);
        END_FOR;
        uControl_Decoupled[iRow] := rSum;
    END_FOR;
ELSE
    (* Default Idle / Zero Deviation Pressure Commands *)
    FOR iCol := 1 TO 7 DO
        uControl[iCol] := 0.0;
        uControl_Prev[iCol] := 0.0;
        uControl_Decoupled[iCol] := 0.0;
    END_FOR;
END_IF;

(* ============================================================================================= *)
(* SECTION 7: MULTI-STAGE FINITE STATE MACHINE (FSM) SEQUENCE ENGINE                            *)
(* ============================================================================================= *)
CASE iStateStep OF
    0: (* STATE_STANDBY_IDLE *)
        bSystemReady                := TRUE;
        bPolishingActive            := FALSE;
        bEndpointDetected           := FALSE;
        bOverpolishActive           := FALSE;
        bWaferChuckedOk             := FALSE;
        rPlatenSpeed_Cmd_rpm        := 0.0;
        rCarrierSpeed_Cmd_rpm       := 0.0;
        rSlurryFlow_Cmd_mLmin       := 0.0;
        rDIWaterFlow_Cmd_mLmin      := 0.0;
        rConditionerDownforce_Cmd_N := 0.0;
        rConditionerSweep_Cmd_Hz    := 0.0;
        rPressureCmd_Zone1_kPa      := 0.0;
        rPressureCmd_Zone2_kPa      := 0.0;
        rPressureCmd_Zone3_kPa      := 0.0;
        rPressureCmd_Zone4_kPa      := 0.0;
        rPressureCmd_Zone5_kPa      := 0.0;
        rPressureCmd_Zone6_kPa      := 0.0;
        rPressureCmd_Zone7_kPa      := 0.0;
        rPressureCmd_RetainingRing_kPa := 0.0;
        rStateTimer_Sec             := 0.0;
        rPolishingElapsed_Sec       := 0.0;
        IF bEnable AND (NOT bEmergencyTripActive) AND (iTargetOperatingMode == 1) THEN
            iStateStep := 10;
        END_IF;

    10: (* STATE_WAFER_CHUCK_AND_VACUUM_SEAL_VERIFY *)
        bSystemReady := TRUE;
        rStateTimer_Sec := rStateTimer_Sec + tScanDeltaTime_Sec;
        (* Apply vacuum to chuck wafer onto membrane backing film *)
        IF rCarrierVacuum_kPa <= 25.0 THEN
            bWaferChuckedOk := TRUE;
            IF rStateTimer_Sec >= 2.0 THEN
                rStateTimer_Sec := 0.0;
                iStateStep := 20;
            END_IF;
        ELSE
            bWaferChuckedOk := FALSE;
            IF rStateTimer_Sec > 8.0 THEN
                bTrip_WaferSlip_Latched := TRUE;
                bEmergencyTripActive := TRUE;
                iStateStep := 90;
            END_IF;
        END_IF;

    20: (* STATE_SLURRY_PREWET_AND_PAD_CONDITIONER_START *)
        rStateTimer_Sec := rStateTimer_Sec + tScanDeltaTime_Sec;
        (* Spin platen and deliver chemical slurry to form uniform fluid boundary *)
        rPlatenSpeed_Cmd_rpm        := 90.0;
        rCarrierSpeed_Cmd_rpm       := 85.0;
        rSlurryFlow_Cmd_mLmin       := 250.0;
        rDIWaterFlow_Cmd_mLmin      := 0.0;
        rConditionerDownforce_Cmd_N := 45.0;
        rConditionerSweep_Cmd_Hz    := 0.35;
        IF (rStateTimer_Sec >= 5.0) AND (rSlurryFlow_Filt_mLmin >= 200.0) AND (rPlatenSpeed_Filt_rpm >= 88.0) THEN
            rStateTimer_Sec := 0.0;
            iStateStep := 30;
        END_IF;

    30: (* STATE_CARRIER_DESCENT_AND_SOFT_LANDING_TOUCHDOWN *)
        rStateTimer_Sec := rStateTimer_Sec + tScanDeltaTime_Sec;
        (* Controlled soft-touch contact landing with minimal initial downforce *)
        rPressureCmd_Zone1_kPa := 5.0;
        rPressureCmd_Zone2_kPa := 5.0;
        rPressureCmd_Zone3_kPa := 5.0;
        rPressureCmd_Zone4_kPa := 5.0;
        rPressureCmd_Zone5_kPa := 5.0;
        rPressureCmd_Zone6_kPa := 5.0;
        rPressureCmd_Zone7_kPa := 5.0;
        rPressureCmd_RetainingRing_kPa := 10.0;
        IF rCarrierTorque_Filt_Nm >= 4.0 THEN
            rTouchdownSettleTimer_Sec := rTouchdownSettleTimer_Sec + tScanDeltaTime_Sec;
            IF rTouchdownSettleTimer_Sec >= 1.5 THEN
                rTouchdownSettleTimer_Sec := 0.0;
                rStateTimer_Sec := 0.0;
                bPolishingActive := TRUE;
                iStateStep := 40;
            END_IF;
        ELSE
            rTouchdownSettleTimer_Sec := 0.0;
        END_IF;

    40: (* STATE_DYNAMIC_7ZONE_MPC_MAIN_POLISH *)
        bPolishingActive      := TRUE;
        rStateTimer_Sec       := rStateTimer_Sec + tScanDeltaTime_Sec;
        rPolishingElapsed_Sec := rPolishingElapsed_Sec + tScanDeltaTime_Sec;
        (* Apply decoupled multivariable MPC pressure commands across 7 zones *)
        rPressureCmd_Zone1_kPa := uControl_Decoupled[1];
        rPressureCmd_Zone2_kPa := uControl_Decoupled[2];
        rPressureCmd_Zone3_kPa := uControl_Decoupled[3];
        rPressureCmd_Zone4_kPa := uControl_Decoupled[4];
        rPressureCmd_Zone5_kPa := uControl_Decoupled[5];
        rPressureCmd_Zone6_kPa := uControl_Decoupled[6];
        rPressureCmd_Zone7_kPa := uControl_Decoupled[7];
        (* Retaining ring follows outer edge zone pressure plus offset to arrest pad rebound *)
        rPressureCmd_RetainingRing_kPa := uControl_Decoupled[7] + 6.5;
        rPlatenSpeed_Cmd_rpm        := 90.0;
        rCarrierSpeed_Cmd_rpm       := 85.0;
        rSlurryFlow_Cmd_mLmin       := 250.0;
        rConditionerDownforce_Cmd_N := 45.0;
        rConditionerSweep_Cmd_Hz    := 0.35;
        (* Safety watchdog timeout: max polishing time = 120.0 seconds *)
        IF rPolishingElapsed_Sec > 120.0 THEN
            bTrip_OverpolishPunch_Latched := TRUE;
            bEmergencyTripActive := TRUE;
            iStateStep := 90;
        END_IF;

    50: (* STATE_ENDPOINT_APPROACH_SELECTIVE_OVERPOLISH_AND_BUFF *)
        bOverpolishActive := TRUE;
        rStateTimer_Sec := rStateTimer_Sec + tScanDeltaTime_Sec;
        rOverpolishTimer_Sec := rOverpolishTimer_Sec + tScanDeltaTime_Sec;
        (* Soft touch buff: reduce bulk downforce to prevent dishing and erosion *)
        rPressureCmd_Zone1_kPa := 8.0;
        rPressureCmd_Zone2_kPa := 8.0;
        rPressureCmd_Zone3_kPa := 8.0;
        rPressureCmd_Zone4_kPa := 8.0;
        rPressureCmd_Zone5_kPa := 8.0;
        rPressureCmd_Zone6_kPa := 8.0;
        rPressureCmd_Zone7_kPa := 7.5;
        rPressureCmd_RetainingRing_kPa := 12.0;
        (* Transition out after selective buff duration (nominal 4.5 seconds) *)
        IF (rOverpolishTimer_Sec >= 4.5) OR (rThickness_Filt_nm <= rTargetFinalThickness_nm) THEN
            rStateTimer_Sec := 0.0;
            bPolishingActive := FALSE;
            iStateStep := 60;
        END_IF;

    60: (* STATE_POST_POLISH_HIGH_PRESSURE_DIW_RINSE *)
        rStateTimer_Sec := rStateTimer_Sec + tScanDeltaTime_Sec;
        bPolishingActive := FALSE;
        bOverpolishActive := FALSE;
        (* Shut off slurry and activate high-pressure DI water to flush nano-abrasives *)
        rSlurryFlow_Cmd_mLmin  := 0.0;
        rDIWaterFlow_Cmd_mLmin := 1800.0;
        rPressureCmd_Zone1_kPa := 3.0;
        rPressureCmd_Zone2_kPa := 3.0;
        rPressureCmd_Zone3_kPa := 3.0;
        rPressureCmd_Zone4_kPa := 3.0;
        rPressureCmd_Zone5_kPa := 3.0;
        rPressureCmd_Zone6_kPa := 3.0;
        rPressureCmd_Zone7_kPa := 3.0;
        rPressureCmd_RetainingRing_kPa := 4.0;
        rConditionerDownforce_Cmd_N := 0.0;
        rConditionerSweep_Cmd_Hz := 0.0;
        IF rStateTimer_Sec >= 8.0 THEN
            rStateTimer_Sec := 0.0;
            iStateStep := 70;
        END_IF;

    70: (* STATE_CONTROLLED_DECHUCK_WATER_SURFACE_TENSION_RELEASE *)
        rStateTimer_Sec := rStateTimer_Sec + tScanDeltaTime_Sec;
        (* Vent membrane downforce and apply gentle carrier pocket positive pressure to release surface tension *)
        rPressureCmd_Zone1_kPa := 0.0;
        rPressureCmd_Zone2_kPa := 0.0;
        rPressureCmd_Zone3_kPa := 0.0;
        rPressureCmd_Zone4_kPa := 0.0;
        rPressureCmd_Zone5_kPa := 0.0;
        rPressureCmd_Zone6_kPa := 0.0;
        rPressureCmd_Zone7_kPa := 0.0;
        rPressureCmd_RetainingRing_kPa := 0.0;
        rPlatenSpeed_Cmd_rpm := 20.0;
        rCarrierSpeed_Cmd_rpm := 15.0;
        IF rStateTimer_Sec >= 3.0 THEN
            rStateTimer_Sec := 0.0;
            iStateStep := 80;
        END_IF;

    80: (* STATE_CARRIER_RETRACT_AND_METROLOGY_HANDSHAKE *)
        rStateTimer_Sec := rStateTimer_Sec + tScanDeltaTime_Sec;
        rPlatenSpeed_Cmd_rpm := 0.0;
        rCarrierSpeed_Cmd_rpm := 0.0;
        rDIWaterFlow_Cmd_mLmin := 0.0;
        bSystemReady := TRUE;
        (* Handshake with track wafer transfer robot *)
        IF rStateTimer_Sec >= 2.0 THEN
            rStateTimer_Sec := 0.0;
            iStateStep := 0; (* Cycle completed successfully, return to STANDBY *)
        END_IF;

    90: (* STATE_EMERGENCY_RETRACT_BLOWDOWN_TRIP *)
        bSystemReady := FALSE;
        bPolishingActive := FALSE;
        bOverpolishActive := FALSE;
        (* Rapid pneumatic de-pressurization of all zones to prevent wafer breakage *)
        rPressureCmd_Zone1_kPa := 0.0;
        rPressureCmd_Zone2_kPa := 0.0;
        rPressureCmd_Zone3_kPa := 0.0;
        rPressureCmd_Zone4_kPa := 0.0;
        rPressureCmd_Zone5_kPa := 0.0;
        rPressureCmd_Zone6_kPa := 0.0;
        rPressureCmd_Zone7_kPa := 0.0;
        rPressureCmd_RetainingRing_kPa := 0.0;
        rPlatenSpeed_Cmd_rpm := 0.0;
        rCarrierSpeed_Cmd_rpm := 0.0;
        rSlurryFlow_Cmd_mLmin := 0.0;
        rDIWaterFlow_Cmd_mLmin := 500.0; (* Maintain rinse to prevent slurry drying on wafer *)
        rConditionerDownforce_Cmd_N := 0.0;
        rConditionerSweep_Cmd_Hz := 0.0;
        IF (NOT bEmergencyTripActive) AND (NOT bTrip_Hardwire_Latched) THEN
            iStateStep := 0;
        END_IF;
END_CASE;

(* Export Current Active State *)
iCurrentState := iStateStep;

(* ============================================================================================= *)
(* SECTION 8: DIAGNOSTIC HEALTH REGISTERS, ISA-18.2 BITMASKS & STATUS COMPILATION               *)
(* ============================================================================================= *)
(* Compile Packed Sensor Health Bitmask *)
wSensorHealthBitmask := 16#0000;
IF bHealth_Thick_ChA  THEN wSensorHealthBitmask := wSensorHealthBitmask OR 16#0001; END_IF;
IF bHealth_Thick_ChB  THEN wSensorHealthBitmask := wSensorHealthBitmask OR 16#0002; END_IF;
IF bHealth_Thick_ChC  THEN wSensorHealthBitmask := wSensorHealthBitmask OR 16#0004; END_IF;
IF bHealth_Platen_ChA THEN wSensorHealthBitmask := wSensorHealthBitmask OR 16#0008; END_IF;
IF bHealth_Platen_ChB THEN wSensorHealthBitmask := wSensorHealthBitmask OR 16#0010; END_IF;
IF bHealth_Platen_ChC THEN wSensorHealthBitmask := wSensorHealthBitmask OR 16#0020; END_IF;
IF bHealth_Slurry_ChA THEN wSensorHealthBitmask := wSensorHealthBitmask OR 16#0040; END_IF;
IF bHealth_Slurry_ChB THEN wSensorHealthBitmask := wSensorHealthBitmask OR 16#0080; END_IF;
IF bHealth_Slurry_ChC THEN wSensorHealthBitmask := wSensorHealthBitmask OR 16#0100; END_IF;
IF bHealth_Torque_ChA THEN wSensorHealthBitmask := wSensorHealthBitmask OR 16#0200; END_IF;
IF bHealth_Torque_ChB THEN wSensorHealthBitmask := wSensorHealthBitmask OR 16#0400; END_IF;
IF bHealth_Torque_ChC THEN wSensorHealthBitmask := wSensorHealthBitmask OR 16#0800; END_IF;

(* Compile Packed Critical Trip Bitmask *)
wTripAlarmBitmask := 16#0000;
IF bTrip_Hardwire_Latched         THEN wTripAlarmBitmask := wTripAlarmBitmask OR 16#0001; END_IF;
IF bTrip_WaferSlip_Latched        THEN wTripAlarmBitmask := wTripAlarmBitmask OR 16#0002; END_IF;
IF bTrip_SlurryStarve_Latched     THEN wTripAlarmBitmask := wTripAlarmBitmask OR 16#0004; END_IF;
IF bTrip_TorqueSpike_Latched      THEN wTripAlarmBitmask := wTripAlarmBitmask OR 16#0008; END_IF;
IF bTrip_PadOverheat_Latched      THEN wTripAlarmBitmask := wTripAlarmBitmask OR 16#0010; END_IF;
IF bTrip_MembraneRupture_Latched  THEN wTripAlarmBitmask := wTripAlarmBitmask OR 16#0020; END_IF;
