(* ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* 1.0 EMERGENCY STOP & MASTER SAFETY INTERLOCK EVALUATION                                   *)
(* Hardwired dual-channel SIL-3 safety circuit check. Active high permissive.               *)
(* ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
IF NOT bEmergencyStop THEN
    bSystemTrip := TRUE;
    bTripLatched := TRUE;
    dwTripWord := dwTripWord OR 16#0000_0001; (* E-Stop Relay Dropped Out *)
    iState := 120; (* Force Emergency Trip Shutdown State *)
END_IF;

IF bAcknowledgeFault AND NOT bEmergencyStop THEN
    (* Cannot reset while safety string is physically open *)
    dwAlarmWord1 := dwAlarmWord1 OR 16#0000_0001;
ELSIF bAcknowledgeFault AND bEmergencyStop THEN
    bTripLatched := FALSE;
    bSystemTrip := FALSE;
    dwTripWord := 16#0000_0000;
    dwAlarmWord1 := dwAlarmWord1 AND NOT 16#0000_0001;
END_IF;

(* ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* 2.0 TRIPLE MODULAR REDUNDANCY (2oo3) SENSOR VOTING & DEGRADATION ARBITRATION             *)
(* Executes median voting across 3 channels; degrades to 1oo2 average if 1 channel drifts.   *)
(* ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
bDegradedSensorMode := FALSE;

(* 2.1 Brine Supply Temperature Voting *)
rDiffAB := ABS(rBrineInletTemp_A - rBrineInletTemp_B);
rDiffBC := ABS(rBrineInletTemp_B - rBrineInletTemp_C);
rDiffCA := ABS(rBrineInletTemp_C - rBrineInletTemp_A);
bHealthyA := (rDiffAB <= rBrineTempTol) OR (rDiffCA <= rBrineTempTol);
bHealthyB := (rDiffAB <= rBrineTempTol) OR (rDiffBC <= rBrineTempTol);
bHealthyC := (rDiffBC <= rBrineTempTol) OR (rDiffCA <= rBrineTempTol);

IF bHealthyA AND bHealthyB AND bHealthyC THEN
    (* Complete 3-Channel Healthy: Select True Median *)
    IF (rBrineInletTemp_A >= rBrineInletTemp_B AND rBrineInletTemp_A <= rBrineInletTemp_C) OR
       (rBrineInletTemp_A <= rBrineInletTemp_B AND rBrineInletTemp_A >= rBrineInletTemp_C) THEN
        rVotedBrineInletTemp := rBrineInletTemp_A;
    ELSIF (rBrineInletTemp_B >= rBrineInletTemp_A AND rBrineInletTemp_B <= rBrineInletTemp_C) OR
          (rBrineInletTemp_B <= rBrineInletTemp_A AND rBrineInletTemp_B >= rBrineInletTemp_C) THEN
        rVotedBrineInletTemp := rBrineInletTemp_B;
    ELSE
        rVotedBrineInletTemp := rBrineInletTemp_C;
    END_IF;
    bBrineInletTemp_Degraded := FALSE;
    bBrineInletTemp_Fault := FALSE;
ELSIF bHealthyA AND bHealthyB THEN
    rVotedBrineInletTemp := (rBrineInletTemp_A + rBrineInletTemp_B) * 0.5;
    bBrineInletTemp_Degraded := TRUE;
    bDegradedSensorMode := TRUE;
    dwAlarmWord2 := dwAlarmWord2 OR 16#0000_0001; (* Brine Temp Channel C Fault *)
ELSIF bHealthyB AND bHealthyC THEN
    rVotedBrineInletTemp := (rBrineInletTemp_B + rBrineInletTemp_C) * 0.5;
    bBrineInletTemp_Degraded := TRUE;
    bDegradedSensorMode := TRUE;
    dwAlarmWord2 := dwAlarmWord2 OR 16#0000_0002; (* Brine Temp Channel A Fault *)
ELSIF bHealthyA AND bHealthyC THEN
    rVotedBrineInletTemp := (rBrineInletTemp_A + rBrineInletTemp_C) * 0.5;
    bBrineInletTemp_Degraded := TRUE;
    bDegradedSensorMode := TRUE;
    dwAlarmWord2 := dwAlarmWord2 OR 16#0000_0004; (* Brine Temp Channel B Fault *)
ELSE
    bBrineInletTemp_Fault := TRUE;
    bSystemTrip := TRUE;
    dwTripWord := dwTripWord OR 16#0000_0002; (* 2oo3 Loss of Brine Temperature Measurement *)
END_IF;

(* 2.2 Brine Mass Flowrate Voting *)
rDiffAB := ABS(rBrineMassFlow_A - rBrineMassFlow_B);
rDiffBC := ABS(rBrineMassFlow_B - rBrineMassFlow_C);
rDiffCA := ABS(rBrineMassFlow_C - rBrineMassFlow_A);
bHealthyA := (rDiffAB <= rBrineFlowTol) OR (rDiffCA <= rBrineFlowTol);
bHealthyB := (rDiffAB <= rBrineFlowTol) OR (rDiffBC <= rBrineFlowTol);
bHealthyC := (rDiffBC <= rBrineFlowTol) OR (rDiffCA <= rBrineFlowTol);

IF bHealthyA AND bHealthyB AND bHealthyC THEN
    IF (rBrineMassFlow_A >= rBrineMassFlow_B AND rBrineMassFlow_A <= rBrineMassFlow_C) OR
       (rBrineMassFlow_A <= rBrineMassFlow_B AND rBrineMassFlow_A >= rBrineMassFlow_C) THEN
        rVotedBrineMassFlow := rBrineMassFlow_A;
    ELSIF (rBrineMassFlow_B >= rBrineMassFlow_A AND rBrineMassFlow_B <= rBrineMassFlow_C) OR
          (rBrineMassFlow_B <= rBrineMassFlow_A AND rBrineMassFlow_B >= rBrineMassFlow_C) THEN
        rVotedBrineMassFlow := rBrineMassFlow_B;
    ELSE
        rVotedBrineMassFlow := rBrineMassFlow_C;
    END_IF;
    bBrineMassFlow_Degraded := FALSE;
    bBrineMassFlow_Fault := FALSE;
ELSIF bHealthyA AND bHealthyB THEN
    rVotedBrineMassFlow := (rBrineMassFlow_A + rBrineMassFlow_B) * 0.5;
    bBrineMassFlow_Degraded := TRUE;
    bDegradedSensorMode := TRUE;
ELSIF bHealthyB AND bHealthyC THEN
    rVotedBrineMassFlow := (rBrineMassFlow_B + rBrineMassFlow_C) * 0.5;
    bBrineMassFlow_Degraded := TRUE;
    bDegradedSensorMode := TRUE;
ELSIF bHealthyA AND bHealthyC THEN
    rVotedBrineMassFlow := (rBrineMassFlow_A + rBrineMassFlow_C) * 0.5;
    bBrineMassFlow_Degraded := TRUE;
    bDegradedSensorMode := TRUE;
ELSE
    bBrineMassFlow_Fault := TRUE;
    bSystemTrip := TRUE;
    dwTripWord := dwTripWord OR 16#0000_0004; (* 2oo3 Loss of Brine Flow Measurement *)
END_IF;

(* 2.3 Separator Drum Pressure Voting *)
rDiffAB := ABS(rSeparatorPress_A - rSeparatorPress_B);
rDiffBC := ABS(rSeparatorPress_B - rSeparatorPress_C);
rDiffCA := ABS(rSeparatorPress_C - rSeparatorPress_A);
bHealthyA := (rDiffAB <= rSeparatorPressTol) OR (rDiffCA <= rSeparatorPressTol);
bHealthyB := (rDiffAB <= rSeparatorPressTol) OR (rDiffBC <= rSeparatorPressTol);
bHealthyC := (rDiffBC <= rSeparatorPressTol) OR (rDiffCA <= rSeparatorPressTol);

IF bHealthyA AND bHealthyB AND bHealthyC THEN
    IF (rSeparatorPress_A >= rSeparatorPress_B AND rSeparatorPress_A <= rSeparatorPress_C) OR
       (rSeparatorPress_A <= rSeparatorPress_B AND rSeparatorPress_A >= rSeparatorPress_C) THEN
        rVotedSeparatorPress := rSeparatorPress_A;
    ELSIF (rSeparatorPress_B >= rSeparatorPress_A AND rSeparatorPress_B <= rSeparatorPress_C) OR
          (rSeparatorPress_B <= rSeparatorPress_A AND rSeparatorPress_B >= rSeparatorPress_C) THEN
        rVotedSeparatorPress := rSeparatorPress_B;
    ELSE
        rVotedSeparatorPress := rSeparatorPress_C;
    END_IF;
    bSeparatorPress_Degraded := FALSE;
    bSeparatorPress_Fault := FALSE;
ELSIF bHealthyA AND bHealthyB THEN
    rVotedSeparatorPress := (rSeparatorPress_A + rSeparatorPress_B) * 0.5;
    bSeparatorPress_Degraded := TRUE;
    bDegradedSensorMode := TRUE;
ELSIF bHealthyB AND bHealthyC THEN
    rVotedSeparatorPress := (rSeparatorPress_B + rSeparatorPress_C) * 0.5;
    bSeparatorPress_Degraded := TRUE;
    bDegradedSensorMode := TRUE;
ELSIF bHealthyA AND bHealthyC THEN
    rVotedSeparatorPress := (rSeparatorPress_A + rSeparatorPress_C) * 0.5;
    bSeparatorPress_Degraded := TRUE;
    bDegradedSensorMode := TRUE;
ELSE
    bSeparatorPress_Fault := TRUE;
    bSystemTrip := TRUE;
    dwTripWord := dwTripWord OR 16#0000_0008; (* 2oo3 Loss of Separator Pressure Measurement *)
END_IF;

(* 2.4 Separator Overhead Rich Vapor Ammonia Concentration Voting *)
rDiffAB := ABS(rVaporAmmoniaConc_A - rVaporAmmoniaConc_B);
rDiffBC := ABS(rVaporAmmoniaConc_B - rVaporAmmoniaConc_C);
rDiffCA := ABS(rVaporAmmoniaConc_C - rVaporAmmoniaConc_A);
bHealthyA := (rDiffAB <= rVaporAmmoniaTol) OR (rDiffCA <= rVaporAmmoniaTol);
bHealthyB := (rDiffAB <= rVaporAmmoniaTol) OR (rDiffBC <= rVaporAmmoniaTol);
bHealthyC := (rDiffBC <= rVaporAmmoniaTol) OR (rDiffCA <= rVaporAmmoniaTol);

IF bHealthyA AND bHealthyB AND bHealthyC THEN
    IF (rVaporAmmoniaConc_A >= rVaporAmmoniaConc_B AND rVaporAmmoniaConc_A <= rVaporAmmoniaConc_C) OR
       (rVaporAmmoniaConc_A <= rVaporAmmoniaConc_B AND rVaporAmmoniaConc_A >= rVaporAmmoniaConc_C) THEN
        rVotedVaporAmmoniaConc := rVaporAmmoniaConc_A;
    ELSIF (rVaporAmmoniaConc_B >= rVaporAmmoniaConc_A AND rVaporAmmoniaConc_B <= rVaporAmmoniaConc_C) OR
          (rVaporAmmoniaConc_B <= rVaporAmmoniaConc_A AND rVaporAmmoniaConc_B >= rVaporAmmoniaConc_C) THEN
        rVotedVaporAmmoniaConc := rVaporAmmoniaConc_B;
    ELSE
        rVotedVaporAmmoniaConc := rVaporAmmoniaConc_C;
    END_IF;
    bVaporAmmoniaConc_Degraded := FALSE;
ELSIF bHealthyA AND bHealthyB THEN
    rVotedVaporAmmoniaConc := (rVaporAmmoniaConc_A + rVaporAmmoniaConc_B) * 0.5;
    bVaporAmmoniaConc_Degraded := TRUE;
    bDegradedSensorMode := TRUE;
ELSIF bHealthyB AND bHealthyC THEN
    rVotedVaporAmmoniaConc := (rVaporAmmoniaConc_B + rVaporAmmoniaConc_C) * 0.5;
    bVaporAmmoniaConc_Degraded := TRUE;
    bDegradedSensorMode := TRUE;
ELSIF bHealthyA AND bHealthyC THEN
    rVotedVaporAmmoniaConc := (rVaporAmmoniaConc_A + rVaporAmmoniaConc_C) * 0.5;
    bVaporAmmoniaConc_Degraded := TRUE;
    bDegradedSensorMode := TRUE;
ELSE
    bVaporAmmoniaConc_Fault := TRUE;
    bSystemWarning := TRUE;
    dwAlarmWord1 := dwAlarmWord1 OR 16#0000_0002; (* Vapor Concentration Sensor Failure *)
END_IF;

(* 2.5 Turbine Expander Shaft Speed Voting *)
rDiffAB := ABS(rTurbineSpeed_A - rTurbineSpeed_B);
rDiffBC := ABS(rTurbineSpeed_B - rTurbineSpeed_C);
rDiffCA := ABS(rTurbineSpeed_C - rTurbineSpeed_A);
bHealthyA := (rDiffAB <= rTurbineSpeedTol) OR (rDiffCA <= rTurbineSpeedTol);
bHealthyB := (rDiffAB <= rTurbineSpeedTol) OR (rDiffBC <= rTurbineSpeedTol);
bHealthyC := (rDiffBC <= rTurbineSpeedTol) OR (rDiffCA <= rTurbineSpeedTol);

IF bHealthyA AND bHealthyB AND bHealthyC THEN
    IF (rTurbineSpeed_A >= rTurbineSpeed_B AND rTurbineSpeed_A <= rTurbineSpeed_C) OR
       (rTurbineSpeed_A <= rTurbineSpeed_B AND rTurbineSpeed_A >= rTurbineSpeed_C) THEN
        rVotedTurbineSpeed := rTurbineSpeed_A;
    ELSIF (rTurbineSpeed_B >= rTurbineSpeed_A AND rTurbineSpeed_B <= rTurbineSpeed_C) OR
          (rTurbineSpeed_B <= rTurbineSpeed_A AND rTurbineSpeed_B >= rTurbineSpeed_C) THEN
        rVotedTurbineSpeed := rTurbineSpeed_B;
    ELSE
        rVotedTurbineSpeed := rTurbineSpeed_C;
    END_IF;
    bTurbineSpeed_Degraded := FALSE;
    bTurbineSpeed_Fault := FALSE;
ELSIF bHealthyA AND bHealthyB THEN
    rVotedTurbineSpeed := (rTurbineSpeed_A + rTurbineSpeed_B) * 0.5;
    bTurbineSpeed_Degraded := TRUE;
    bDegradedSensorMode := TRUE;
ELSIF bHealthyB AND bHealthyC THEN
    rVotedTurbineSpeed := (rTurbineSpeed_B + rTurbineSpeed_C) * 0.5;
    bTurbineSpeed_Degraded := TRUE;
    bDegradedSensorMode := TRUE;
ELSIF bHealthyA AND bHealthyC THEN
    rVotedTurbineSpeed := (rTurbineSpeed_A + rTurbineSpeed_C) * 0.5;
    bTurbineSpeed_Degraded := TRUE;
    bDegradedSensorMode := TRUE;
ELSE
    bTurbineSpeed_Fault := TRUE;
    bSystemTrip := TRUE;
    dwTripWord := dwTripWord OR 16#0000_0010; (* 2oo3 Loss of Turbine Speed Feedback *)
END_IF;

(* 2.6 Condenser / Absorber Low-Pressure Shell Pressure Voting *)
rDiffAB := ABS(rCondenserPressure_A - rCondenserPressure_B);
rDiffBC := ABS(rCondenserPressure_B - rCondenserPressure_C);
rDiffCA := ABS(rCondenserPressure_C - rCondenserPressure_A);
bHealthyA := (rDiffAB <= rCondenserPressTol) OR (rDiffCA <= rCondenserPressTol);
bHealthyB := (rDiffAB <= rCondenserPressTol) OR (rDiffBC <= rCondenserPressTol);
bHealthyC := (rDiffBC <= rCondenserPressTol) OR (rDiffCA <= rCondenserPressTol);

IF bHealthyA AND bHealthyB AND bHealthyC THEN
    IF (rCondenserPressure_A >= rCondenserPressure_B AND rCondenserPressure_A <= rCondenserPressure_C) OR
       (rCondenserPressure_A <= rCondenserPressure_B AND rCondenserPressure_A >= rCondenserPressure_C) THEN
        rVotedCondenserPressure := rCondenserPressure_A;
    ELSIF (rCondenserPressure_B >= rCondenserPressure_A AND rCondenserPressure_B <= rCondenserPressure_C) OR
          (rCondenserPressure_B <= rCondenserPressure_A AND rCondenserPressure_B >= rCondenserPressure_C) THEN
        rVotedCondenserPressure := rCondenserPressure_B;
    ELSE
        rVotedCondenserPressure := rCondenserPressure_C;
    END_IF;
    bCondenserPressure_Degraded := FALSE;
ELSIF bHealthyA AND bHealthyB THEN
    rVotedCondenserPressure := (rCondenserPressure_A + rCondenserPressure_B) * 0.5;
    bCondenserPressure_Degraded := TRUE;
    bDegradedSensorMode := TRUE;
ELSIF bHealthyB AND bHealthyC THEN
    rVotedCondenserPressure := (rCondenserPressure_B + rCondenserPressure_C) * 0.5;
    bCondenserPressure_Degraded := TRUE;
    bDegradedSensorMode := TRUE;
ELSIF bHealthyA AND bHealthyC THEN
    rVotedCondenserPressure := (rCondenserPressure_A + rCondenserPressure_C) * 0.5;
    bCondenserPressure_Degraded := TRUE;
    bDegradedSensorMode := TRUE;
ELSE
    bCondenserPressure_Fault := TRUE;
    bSystemTrip := TRUE;
    dwTripWord := dwTripWord OR 16#0000_0020; (* 2oo3 Loss of Condenser Vacuum Measurement *)
END_IF;

(* 2.7 Liquid Float Level Voting (Separator, Hotwell, HTR, LTR, Preheater) *)
rVotedSeparatorFloatLevel := (rSeparatorFloatLevel_A + rSeparatorFloatLevel_B + rSeparatorFloatLevel_C) / 3.0;
rVotedHotwellFloatLevel   := (rHotwellFloatLevel_A + rHotwellFloatLevel_B + rHotwellFloatLevel_C) / 3.0;
rVotedHTR_FloatLevel      := (rHTR_FloatLevel_A + rHTR_FloatLevel_B + rHTR_FloatLevel_C) / 3.0;
rVotedLTR_FloatLevel      := (rLTR_FloatLevel_A + rLTR_FloatLevel_B + rLTR_FloatLevel_C) / 3.0;
rVotedPreheaterFloatLevel := (rPreheaterFloatLevel_A + rPreheaterFloatLevel_B + rPreheaterFloatLevel_C) / 3.0;
rVotedFeedFlow            := (rWorkingFluidFeedFlow_A + rWorkingFluidFeedFlow_B + rWorkingFluidFeedFlow_C) / 3.0;
rVotedGeneratorRealPower  := (rGeneratorRealPower_A + rGeneratorRealPower_B + rGeneratorRealPower_C) / 3.0;
rVotedTurbineInletPress   := (rTurbineInletPress_A + rTurbineInletPress_B + rTurbineInletPress_C) / 3.0;
rVotedTurbineExhaustPress := (rTurbineExhaustPress_A + rTurbineExhaustPress_B + rTurbineExhaustPress_C) / 3.0;
rVotedNCGLockPressure     := (rNCGLockPressure_A + rNCGLockPressure_B) * 0.5;

(* ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* 3.0 THERMODYNAMIC PROPERTY ESTIMATION & VLE CALCULATIONS                                  *)
(* Estimates zeotropic ammonia-water equilibrium, superheat clearance, and silica saturation *)
(* ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* 3.1 Bubble-Point Temperature of Basic Mixture at High Pressure *)
(* Polynomial approximation: T_bub = f(P_sep, x_b) *)
rCalcBubblePointTemp := 45.2 + (2.15 * rVotedSeparatorPress) - (0.015 * rVotedSeparatorPress * rVotedSeparatorPress)
                        - (48.0 * rVotedBasicAmmoniaConc) + (18.5 * rVotedBasicAmmoniaConc * rVotedBasicAmmoniaConc)
                        + (0.35 * rVotedSeparatorPress * (1.0 - rVotedBasicAmmoniaConc));

(* 3.2 Dew-Point Temperature of Separator Overhead Vapor Stream *)
(* T_dew = f(P_sep, x_v) *)
rCalcDewPointTemp := 78.4 + (2.65 * rVotedSeparatorPress) - (0.018 * rVotedSeparatorPress * rVotedSeparatorPress)
                     - (32.0 * rVotedVaporAmmoniaConc) + (12.0 * rVotedVaporAmmoniaConc * rVotedVaporAmmoniaConc);

(* 3.3 Vapor Superheat Margin Clearance *)
rSeparatorVaporSuperheat := rSeparatorVaporTemp_A - rCalcDewPointTemp;
rDewPointMargin_degC := rSeparatorVaporSuperheat;

(* If superheat margin is deficient, risk of liquid droplets eroding turbine blading *)
IF (rDewPointMargin_degC < c_rMinVaporSuperheatMargin) AND (iState >= 70) THEN
    dwAlarmWord1 := dwAlarmWord1 OR 16#0000_0004; (* Inadequate Vapor Superheat Margin *)
ELSE
    dwAlarmWord1 := dwAlarmWord1 AND NOT 16#0000_0004;
END_IF;

(* 3.4 Geothermal Brine Reinjection Silica Solubility Margin *)
(* Fournier & Rowe empirical equilibrium equation for amorphous silica solubility: *)
(* log10(C_SiO2_sat [mg/kg]) = 4.52 - 731.0 / (T_K) *)
IF rVotedBrineOutletTemp > 10.0 THEN
    rSilicaEquilibriumSolubility := EXPT(10.0, (4.52 - (731.0 / (rVotedBrineOutletTemp + 273.15))));
ELSE
    rSilicaEquilibriumSolubility := 120.0;
END_IF;

IF rSilicaEquilibriumSolubility > 1.0 THEN
    rSilicaSaturationIndex := rMeasuredSilicaConcentration / rSilicaEquilibriumSolubility;
ELSE
    rSilicaSaturationIndex := 1.5;
END_IF;

(* Silica Precipitation Prevention Interlock *)
IF (rVotedBrineOutletTemp < c_rMinBrineReinjectTemp) OR (rSilicaSaturationIndex > 1.05) THEN
    dwAlarmWord1 := dwAlarmWord1 OR 16#0000_0008; (* Silica Scaling Excursion on Reinjection *)
    tSilicaExcursionTimer := tSilicaExcursionTimer + c_rScanTime_Ts;
    IF tSilicaExcursionTimer > 30.0 THEN
        bSystemTrip := TRUE;
        dwTripWord := dwTripWord OR 16#0000_0040; (* Silica Scaling Emergency Lockout Trip *)
    END_IF;
ELSE
    tSilicaExcursionTimer := 0.0;
    dwAlarmWord1 := dwAlarmWord1 AND NOT 16#0000_0008;
END_IF;

(* 3.5 Cycle Thermal Duties and First/Second Law Efficiencies *)
(* Brine Heat Transfer Rate = m_brine * c_p_brine * (T_in - T_out) where c_p ~ 4.18 kJ/(kg*K) *)
rBrineHeatExtraction_kW := rVotedBrineMassFlow * 4.184 * (rVotedBrineInletTemp - rVotedBrineOutletTemp);
rTotalThermalDuty_kW := rBrineHeatExtraction_kW * 0.965; (* 3.5% thermal shell losses *)

IF rTotalThermalDuty_kW > 100.0 THEN
    rKalinaThermalEfficiency := (rVotedGeneratorRealPower / rTotalThermalDuty_kW) * 100.0;
    (* Exergy of 165°C brine against ambient wet-bulb reference: *)
    rSecondLawExergyEfficiency := (rVotedGeneratorRealPower / (rTotalThermalDuty_kW * (1.0 - ((rAmbientWetBulbTemp + 273.15) / (rVotedBrineInletTemp + 273.15))))) * 100.0;
ELSE
    rKalinaThermalEfficiency := 0.0;
    rSecondLawExergyEfficiency := 0.0;
END_IF;

(* ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* 4.0 VARIABLE WORKING FLUID CONCENTRATION DYNAMIC TRIMMING                                 *)
(* Shifts basic ammonia-water concentration based on ambient wet-bulb temperature.          *)
(* ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
IF bAutoConcentrationShiftEnable THEN
    (* Higher ambient sink temperature -> Lower basic concentration needed to maintain condensation pressure *)
    (* Lower ambient sink temperature (e.g. night) -> Higher concentration to maximize turbine expansion *)
    rTargetBasicAmmoniaConc := 0.865 - (0.0042 * rAmbientWetBulbTemp);
    IF rTargetBasicAmmoniaConc > 0.840 THEN
        rTargetBasicAmmoniaConc := 0.840;
    ELSIF rTargetBasicAmmoniaConc < 0.720 THEN
        rTargetBasicAmmoniaConc := 0.720;
    END_IF;
ELSE
    rTargetBasicAmmoniaConc := 0.780; (* Manual Default Baseline *)
END_IF;

(* ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* 5.0 DYNAMIC FRACTIONATION DISTILLATION & SEPARATOR LEVEL FLOAT BALANCE                    *)
(* Regulates overhead vapor purity (x_v > 0.94) and bottoms lean liquid drain to HTR.        *)
(* ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* 5.1 Distillation Overhead Reflux Control *)
(* If vapor concentration falls below target, increase reflux flow to enrich column top *)
IF rVotedVaporAmmoniaConc < rTargetVaporConc THEN
    rDistillationReflux_Cmd := rDistillationReflux_Cmd + ((rTargetVaporConc - rVotedVaporAmmoniaConc) * 15.0 * c_rScanTime_Ts);
ELSE
    rDistillationReflux_Cmd := rDistillationReflux_Cmd - ((rVotedVaporAmmoniaConc - rTargetVaporConc) * 8.0 * c_rScanTime_Ts);
END_IF;

IF rDistillationReflux_Cmd > 85.0 THEN
    rDistillationReflux_Cmd := 85.0;
ELSIF rDistillationReflux_Cmd < 5.0 THEN
    rDistillationReflux_Cmd := 5.0;
END_IF;

(* 5.2 Separator Bottoms Lean Liquid Float Level Control *)
rSepLevelError := rVotedSeparatorFloatLevel - rTargetSeparatorLevel;
rSepLevelIntegral := rSepLevelIntegral + (rSepLevelError * c_rScanTime_Ts);
IF rSepLevelIntegral > 250.0 THEN rSepLevelIntegral := 250.0; ELSIF rSepLevelIntegral < -250.0 THEN rSepLevelIntegral := -250.0; END_IF;

rSepFloatValveDemand := (rSepLevelKp * rSepLevelError) + (rSepLevelKi * rSepLevelIntegral) + 45.0;

(* Anti-Vapor Blow-Through Interlock: If liquid level is dangerously low, throttle drain *)
IF rVotedSeparatorFloatLevel < 18.0 THEN
    bAntiVaporBlowThrough_Active := TRUE;
    rLeanLiquidDrainValve_Cmd := 0.0; (* Hard Close Drain *)
    dwAlarmWord1 := dwAlarmWord1 OR 16#0000_0010; (* Separator Low-Low Level Blow-Through Trip *)
ELSIF rVotedSeparatorFloatLevel > 82.0 THEN
    bAntiLiquidCarryOver_Active := TRUE;
    rLeanLiquidDrainValve_Cmd := 100.0; (* Force 100% Drain Open *)
    dwAlarmWord1 := dwAlarmWord1 OR 16#0000_0020; (* Separator High-High Level Carry-Over Alarm *)
ELSE
    bAntiVaporBlowThrough_Active := FALSE;
    bAntiLiquidCarryOver_Active := FALSE;
    dwAlarmWord1 := dwAlarmWord1 AND NOT 16#0000_0030;
    IF rSepFloatValveDemand > 100.0 THEN
        rLeanLiquidDrainValve_Cmd := 100.0;
    ELSIF rSepFloatValveDemand < 0.0 THEN
        rLeanLiquidDrainValve_Cmd := 0.0;
    ELSE
        rLeanLiquidDrainValve_Cmd := rSepFloatValveDemand;
    END_IF;
END_IF;

(* ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* 6.0 VARIABLE-GEOMETRY RADIAL INFLOW TURBINE (VGRIT) GOVERNOR TUNING & VGV MODULATION     *)
(* Coordinates nozzle guide vanes and throttle governor for synchronous grid generation.    *)
(* ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* 6.1 Aerodynamic Tip-to-Spouting Velocity Ratio (u / c0) Calculation *)
(* Isentropic Enthalpy Drop across Expander: *)
IF rVotedTurbineExhaustPress > 0.5 THEN
    rAerodynamicPressureRatio := rVotedTurbineInletPress / rVotedTurbineExhaustPress;
ELSE
    rAerodynamicPressureRatio := 6.5;
END_IF;

IF rAerodynamicPressureRatio > 1.2 THEN
    (* Ideal enthalpy drop approximation for zeotropic ammonia-water mixture: *)
    rIsentropicExhaustEnthalpy := rVaporEnthalpy_kJ_kg * (1.0 - (0.245 * (1.0 - (1.0 / EXPT(rAerodynamicPressureRatio, 0.285)))));
    rSpoutingVelocity_c0 := SQRT(2.0 * ABS(rVaporEnthalpy_kJ_kg - rIsentropicExhaustEnthalpy) * 1000.0);
ELSE
    rSpoutingVelocity_c0 := 300.0;
END_IF;

(* Impeller Tip Speed: u = pi * D_rotor * N / 60 *)
rRotorBladeTipSpeed_u := (3.14159265 * c_rTurbineRotorDiameter * rVotedTurbineSpeed) / 60.0;

IF rSpoutingVelocity_c0 > 10.0 THEN
    rTurbineVelocityRatio_u_c0 := rRotorBladeTipSpeed_u / rSpoutingVelocity_c0;
ELSE
    rTurbineVelocityRatio_u_c0 := 0.70;
END_IF;

(* Real-Time Isentropic Efficiency Estimation *)
IF (rVaporEnthalpy_kJ_kg - rIsentropicExhaustEnthalpy) > 1.0 THEN
    rTurbineIsentropicEff := ((rVaporEnthalpy_kJ_kg - rTurbineExhaustEnthalpy_kJ_kg) /
                             (rVaporEnthalpy_kJ_kg - rIsentropicExhaustEnthalpy)) * 100.0;
    IF rTurbineIsentropicEff > 91.5 THEN rTurbineIsentropicEff := 91.5; END_IF;
    IF rTurbineIsentropicEff < 40.0 THEN rTurbineIsentropicEff := 40.0; END_IF;
ELSE
    rTurbineIsentropicEff := 75.0;
END_IF;

(* 6.2 Aerodynamic Optimal Variable Guide Vane (VGV) Feedforward Schedule *)
(* Target velocity ratio is 0.705. VGV position adjusts throat area to maintain design u/c0 *)
rScheduledVanePosition := 42.0 + (3.8 * rAerodynamicPressureRatio) + (18.0 * (rTurbineVelocityRatio_u_c0 - rOptimalNozzleVelocityRatio));
IF rScheduledVanePosition > 100.0 THEN rScheduledVanePosition := 100.0; ELSIF rScheduledVanePosition < 15.0 THEN rScheduledVanePosition := 15.0; END_IF;

(* 6.3 Synchronous Speed Governor with 4.0% Grid Frequency Droop *)
IF bBypassGovernorDroop OR NOT bGridBreakerClosed THEN
    rDroopSpeedOffset_rpm := 0.0; (* Isochronous speed regulation prior to grid synchronization *)
ELSE
    (* Standard Droop: Delta_N = - Droop * (f_grid - f_nom) / f_nom * N_rated *)
    rDroopSpeedOffset_rpm := - (rDroopRegulationFactor * ((rGridFrequency_Hz - 50.0) / 50.0) * c_rRatedTurbineSpeed);
    IF rDroopSpeedOffset_rpm > 350.0 THEN rDroopSpeedOffset_rpm := 350.0; ELSIF rDroopSpeedOffset_rpm < -350.0 THEN rDroopSpeedOffset_rpm := -350.0; END_IF;
END_IF;

(* Compute Composite Speed Reference with Active Droop *)
IF iState = 70 THEN
    (* Accelerating from turning gear to rated synchronous speed *)
    IF rGovernorSpeedRef_rpm < c_rRatedTurbineSpeed THEN
        rGovernorSpeedRef_rpm := rGovernorSpeedRef_rpm + (25.0 * c_rScanTime_Ts * 20.0); (* 500 rpm/min ramp *)
    ELSE
        rGovernorSpeedRef_rpm := c_rRatedTurbineSpeed;
    END_IF;
ELSIF iState >= 80 THEN
    rGovernorSpeedRef_rpm := c_rRatedTurbineSpeed + rDroopSpeedOffset_rpm;
ELSE
    rGovernorSpeedRef_rpm := 0.0;
END_IF;

(* PID Error Calculation *)
rGovernorSpeedError_rpm := rGovernorSpeedRef_rpm - rVotedTurbineSpeed;

(* Derivative with 1st-Order Low-Pass Filter *)
rGovernorDerivativeFiltered := (0.80 * rGovernorDerivativeFiltered) +
                               (0.20 * ((rGovernorSpeedError_rpm - rGovernorDerivativePrevError) / c_rScanTime_Ts));
rGovernorDerivativePrevError := rGovernorSpeedError_rpm;

(* Integral with Anti-Windup Clamping *)
IF NOT bGovernorAntiWindupActive THEN
    rGovernorIntegralAccum := rGovernorIntegralAccum + (rGovernorSpeedError_rpm * c_rScanTime_Ts);
    IF rGovernorIntegralAccum > 3000.0 THEN rGovernorIntegralAccum := 3000.0; ELSIF rGovernorIntegralAccum < -3000.0 THEN rGovernorIntegralAccum := -3000.0; END_IF;
END_IF;

(* Unclamped PID Output *)
rGovernorPID_Out := (rGovernorKp * rGovernorSpeedError_rpm) +
                    (rGovernorKi * rGovernorIntegralAccum) +
                    (rGovernorKd * rGovernorDerivativeFiltered);

(* Check Anti-Windup Condition *)
IF (rGovernorPID_Out > 100.0 AND rGovernorSpeedError_rpm > 0.0) OR
   (rGovernorPID_Out < 0.0 AND rGovernorSpeedError_rpm < 0.0) THEN
    bGovernorAntiWindupActive := TRUE;
ELSE
    bGovernorAntiWindupActive := FALSE;
END_IF;

(* Apply Throttle Governor Output and Decouple Fast Bypass *)
IF iState >= 70 AND NOT bSystemTrip THEN
    IF rGovernorPID_Out > 100.0 THEN
        rTurbineThrottleValve_Cmd := 100.0;
    ELSIF rGovernorPID_Out < 0.0 THEN
        rTurbineThrottleValve_Cmd := 0.0;
    ELSE
        rTurbineThrottleValve_Cmd := rGovernorPID_Out;
    END_IF;
    (* Fast Bypass Closes Inversely as Throttle Opens to Protect Evaporator Pressure *)
    rTurbineBypassValve_Cmd := 100.0 - rTurbineThrottleValve_Cmd;
    bEmergencyStopValve_Trip := TRUE; (* Solenoid Energized / Valve Open *)
ELSE
    rTurbineThrottleValve_Cmd := 0.0;
    rTurbineBypassValve_Cmd := 100.0;
    bEmergencyStopValve_Trip := FALSE; (* Trip Solenoid De-Energized *)
END_IF;

(* Guide Vane Command Synthesis *)
IF bMPC_Active AND (iState = 90) THEN
    (* Guide Vane Commanded by MPC with Scheduled Feedforward *)
    rVanePitchAngle_Cmd := rScheduledVanePosition + rDelta_u1_Vane;
ELSIF iState >= 70 THEN
    rVanePitchAngle_Cmd := rScheduledVanePosition;
ELSE
    rVanePitchAngle_Cmd := 15.0; (* Minimum Opening for Purge/Warmup *)
END_IF;

IF rVanePitchAngle_Cmd > 100.0 THEN rVanePitchAngle_Cmd := 100.0; ELSIF rVanePitchAngle_Cmd < 15.0 THEN rVanePitchAngle_Cmd := 15.0; END_IF;

(* Governor Synchronized Flag Evaluation *)
IF (ABS(rVotedTurbineSpeed - c_rRatedTurbineSpeed) < 30.0) AND (iState >= 80) THEN
    bGovernorSynchronized := TRUE;
ELSE
    bGovernorSynchronized := FALSE;
END_IF;

(* ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* 7.0 RECUPERATOR & PREHEATER CONDENSATION FLOAT BALANCE CONTROL                            *)
(* Multi-element float balance to prevent vapor blow-through and liquid carry-over.          *)
(* ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* 7.1 High-Temperature Recuperator (HTR) Float Control *)
rHTR_LevelError := rVotedHTR_FloatLevel - 50.0;
rHTR_LevelIntegral := rHTR_LevelIntegral + (rHTR_LevelError * c_rScanTime_Ts);
IF rHTR_LevelIntegral > 200.0 THEN rHTR_LevelIntegral := 200.0; ELSIF rHTR_LevelIntegral < -200.0 THEN rHTR_LevelIntegral := -200.0; END_IF;

rHTR_DrainValveDemand := (rHTR_LevelKp * rHTR_LevelError) + (rHTR_LevelKi * rHTR_LevelIntegral) + 50.0;
IF rVotedHTR_FloatLevel < 15.0 THEN
    rHTR_DrainFloatValve_Cmd := 0.0; (* Anti-Vapor Blowthrough Cutoff *)
    dwAlarmWord1 := dwAlarmWord1 OR 16#0000_0040; (* HTR Low-Low Level Alarm *)
ELSIF rVotedHTR_FloatLevel > 85.0 THEN
    rHTR_DrainFloatValve_Cmd := 100.0; (* High Level Flood Dump *)
    dwAlarmWord1 := dwAlarmWord1 OR 16#0000_0080; (* HTR High-High Level Alarm *)
ELSE
    dwAlarmWord1 := dwAlarmWord1 AND NOT 16#0000_00C0;
    IF rHTR_DrainValveDemand > 100.0 THEN rHTR_DrainFloatValve_Cmd := 100.0;
    ELSIF rHTR_DrainValveDemand < 0.0 THEN rHTR_DrainFloatValve_Cmd := 0.0;
    ELSE rHTR_DrainFloatValve_Cmd := rHTR_DrainValveDemand; END_IF;
END_IF;

(* 7.2 Low-Temperature Recuperator (LTR) Float Control *)
rLTR_LevelError := rVotedLTR_FloatLevel - 50.0;
rLTR_LevelIntegral := rLTR_LevelIntegral + (rLTR_LevelError * c_rScanTime_Ts);
IF rLTR_LevelIntegral > 200.0 THEN rLTR_LevelIntegral := 200.0; ELSIF rLTR_LevelIntegral < -200.0 THEN rLTR_LevelIntegral := -200.0; END_IF;

rLTR_DrainValveDemand := (rLTR_LevelKp * rLTR_LevelError) + (rLTR_LevelKi * rLTR_LevelIntegral) + 50.0;
IF rVotedLTR_FloatLevel < 15.0 THEN
    rLTR_DrainFloatValve_Cmd := 0.0;
    dwAlarmWord1 := dwAlarmWord1 OR 16#0000_0100; (* LTR Low-Low Level Alarm *)
ELSIF rVotedLTR_FloatLevel > 85.0 THEN
    rLTR_DrainFloatValve_Cmd := 100.0;
    dwAlarmWord1 := dwAlarmWord1 OR 16#0000_0200; (* LTR High-High Level Alarm *)
ELSE
    dwAlarmWord1 := dwAlarmWord1 AND NOT 16#0000_0300;
    IF rLTR_DrainValveDemand > 100.0 THEN rLTR_DrainFloatValve_Cmd := 100.0;
    ELSIF rLTR_DrainValveDemand < 0.0 THEN rLTR_DrainFloatValve_Cmd := 0.0;
    ELSE rLTR_DrainFloatValve_Cmd := rLTR_DrainValveDemand; END_IF;
END_IF;

(* 7.3 Evaporator Preheater Condensate Float Control *)
rPreheaterLevelError := rVotedPreheaterFloatLevel - 50.0;
rPreheaterLevelIntegral := rPreheaterLevelIntegral + (rPreheaterLevelError * c_rScanTime_Ts);
IF rPreheaterLevelIntegral > 200.0 THEN rPreheaterLevelIntegral := 200.0; ELSIF rPreheaterLevelIntegral < -200.0 THEN rPreheaterLevelIntegral := -200.0; END_IF;

rPreheaterDrainValveDemand := (rPreheaterLevelKp * rPreheaterLevelError) + (rPreheaterLevelKi * rPreheaterLevelIntegral) + 50.0;
IF rVotedPreheaterFloatLevel < 15.0 THEN
    rPreheaterDrainValve_Cmd := 0.0;
    dwAlarmWord1 := dwAlarmWord1 OR 16#0000_0400; (* Preheater Low-Low Level Alarm *)
ELSIF rVotedPreheaterFloatLevel > 85.0 THEN
    rPreheaterDrainValve_Cmd := 100.0;
    dwAlarmWord1 := dwAlarmWord1 OR 16#0000_0800; (* Preheater High-High Level Alarm *)
ELSE
    dwAlarmWord1 := dwAlarmWord1 AND NOT 16#0000_0C00;
    IF rPreheaterDrainValveDemand > 100.0 THEN rPreheaterDrainValve_Cmd := 100.0;
    ELSIF rPreheaterDrainValveDemand < 0.0 THEN rPreheaterDrainValve_Cmd := 0.0;
    ELSE rPreheaterDrainValve_Cmd := rPreheaterDrainValveDemand; END_IF;
END_IF;

(* 7.4 Condenser Hotwell Condensate Float Control & Pump Speed Demand *)
rHotwellLevelError := rVotedHotwellFloatLevel - rTargetHotwellLevel;
rHotwellLevelIntegral := rHotwellLevelIntegral + (rHotwellLevelError * c_rScanTime_Ts);
IF rHotwellLevelIntegral > 300.0 THEN rHotwellLevelIntegral := 300.0; ELSIF rHotwellLevelIntegral < -300.0 THEN rHotwellLevelIntegral := -300.0; END_IF;

rHotwellPumpDemand := (rHotwellLevelKp * rHotwellLevelError) + (rHotwellLevelKi * rHotwellLevelIntegral) + 55.0;

IF bMPC_Active AND (iState = 90) THEN
    rCondensatePumpSpeed_Cmd := rHotwellPumpDemand + rDelta_u4_CondPump;
ELSE
    rCondensatePumpSpeed_Cmd := rHotwellPumpDemand;
END_IF;

IF rCondensatePumpSpeed_Cmd > 100.0 THEN rCondensatePumpSpeed_Cmd := 100.0;
ELSIF rCondensatePumpSpeed_Cmd < 20.0 THEN rCondensatePumpSpeed_Cmd := 20.0; END_IF;

(* ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* 8.0 NON-CONDENSABLE GAS (NCG) PURGE VACUUM LOCK SEQUENCE CONTROLLER                       *)
(* Differential-pressure lock-hopper sub-state machine to evacuate incondensable gases.      *)
(* ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* Calculate NCG Partial Pressure Fraction in Condenser Shell: *)
(* Saturation pressure of ammonia-water at condenser return temperature: *)
rCondenserSatTemp := rCoolingWaterReturnTemp + 4.5;
rAmmoniaPartialPressureEst := 125.0 + (10.5 * rCondenserSatTemp) + (0.28 * rCondenserSatTemp * rCondenserSatTemp);
rNCGPartialPressureDiff := rVotedCondenserPressure - rAmmoniaPartialPressureEst;

IF rVotedCondenserPressure > 10.0 THEN
    rNCGAccumulationIndex := (ABS(rNCGPartialPressureDiff) / rVotedCondenserPressure) * 100.0;
ELSE
    rNCGAccumulationIndex := 0.0;
END_IF;

(* Auto-Trigger NCG Purge when Incondensable Overpressure exceeds 35 kPa or Manual Command *)
IF (rNCGPartialPressureDiff > 35.0 OR bManualNCGPurgeTrigger) AND NOT bNCGPurgeCycleActive AND NOT bSystemTrip THEN
    bNCGPurgeCycleActive := TRUE;
    iNCG_State := 10; (* Start Isolation *)
    tNCG_Timer := 0.0;
END_IF;

CASE iNCG_State OF
    0: (* IDLE MONITORING *)
        rNCGLockInletValve_Cmd := 0.0;
        rNCGLockVentValve_Cmd := 0.0;
        bNCGVacuumPump_Run := FALSE;
        bNCGScrubberPump_Run := FALSE;
        tNCG_Timer := 0.0;

    10: (* ISOLATE LOCK CHAMBER *)
        (* Ensure inlet and vent valves are tightly sealed *)
        rNCGLockInletValve_Cmd := 0.0;
        rNCGLockVentValve_Cmd := 0.0;
        bNCGVacuumPump_Run := FALSE;
        bNCGScrubberPump_Run := TRUE; (* Start scrubber water recirculation spray *)
        tNCG_Timer := tNCG_Timer + c_rScanTime_Ts;
        IF tNCG_Timer >= 5.0 THEN
            iNCG_State := 20; (* Proceed to Chamber Evacuation *)
            tNCG_Timer := 0.0;
        END_IF;

    20: (* EVACUATE LOCK CHAMBER *)
        (* Run liquid-ring vacuum pump to pull chamber down below 8 kPa *)
        bNCGVacuumPump_Run := TRUE;
        tNCG_Timer := tNCG_Timer + c_rScanTime_Ts;
        IF (rVotedNCGLockPressure <= rLockChamberTargetVacuum) OR (tNCG_Timer >= 30.0) THEN
            bNCGVacuumPump_Run := FALSE;
            iNCG_State := 30; (* Open Condenser Vapor Pocket Intake *)
            tNCG_Timer := 0.0;
        END_IF;

    30: (* DRAW NCG POCKET INTO LOCK CHAMBER *)
        (* Open modulating intake valve to allow gas pocket to equalize into vacuum lock *)
        rNCGLockInletValve_Cmd := 100.0;
        tNCG_Timer := tNCG_Timer + c_rScanTime_Ts;
        IF (rVotedNCGLockPressure >= (rVotedCondenserPressure - 15.0)) OR (tNCG_Timer >= 20.0) THEN
            rNCGLockInletValve_Cmd := 0.0; (* Re-isolate Lock Intake *)
            iNCG_State := 40; (* Scrub Residual Ammonia *)
            tNCG_Timer := 0.0;
        END_IF;

    40: (* SCRUB RESIDUAL AMMONIA WITH COLD WATER SPRAY *)
        (* Intense water washing to dissolve and absorb any co-extracted NH3 vapor *)
        bNCGScrubberPump_Run := TRUE;
        tNCG_Timer := tNCG_Timer + c_rScanTime_Ts;
        IF (rNCGAmmoniaVaporPPM < c_rMaxAllowableAmmoniaPPM) AND (tNCG_Timer >= 15.0) THEN
            iNCG_State := 50; (* Safe to Vent Purified NCG *)
            tNCG_Timer := 0.0;
        ELSIF tNCG_Timer >= 45.0 THEN
            (* Scrubbing timeout: NH3 still above OSHA limit *)
            bNCGScrubberHighAmmoniaTrip := TRUE;
            dwAlarmWord2 := dwAlarmWord2 OR 16#0000_0008; (* Scrubber NH3 Breakthrough *)
            iNCG_State := 60; (* Abort Vent and Recycle *)
            tNCG_Timer := 0.0;
        END_IF;

    50: (* VENT PURIFIED NCG TO ATMOSPHERE *)
        rNCGLockVentValve_Cmd := 65.0;
        tNCG_Timer := tNCG_Timer + c_rScanTime_Ts;
        IF (rVotedNCGLockPressure <= 105.0) OR (tNCG_Timer >= 15.0) THEN
            rNCGLockVentValve_Cmd := 0.0;
            iNCG_State := 60; (* Purge Cycle Complete *)
            tNCG_Timer := 0.0;
        END_IF;

    60: (* RESET & DWELL *)
        rNCGLockInletValve_Cmd := 0.0;
        rNCGLockVentValve_Cmd := 0.0;
        bNCGVacuumPump_Run := FALSE;
        bNCGScrubberPump_Run := FALSE;
        iPurgeCycleCount := iPurgeCycleCount + 1;
        bNCGPurgeCycleActive := FALSE;
        iNCG_State := 0; (* Return to Idle Monitoring *)
        tNCG_Timer := 0.0;

END_CASE;

(* ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* 9.0 DISCRETE STATE-SPACE MODEL & MODEL PREDICTIVE CONTROL (MPC) OPTIMIZATION              *)
(* Solves 6-state, 4-control quadratic cost optimization via projected gradient descent.     *)
(* ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* 9.1 Normalized State Deviation Vector Computation *)
x1_ConcDev         := rVotedVaporAmmoniaConc - rTargetVaporConc;
x2_PressDev        := rVotedSeparatorPress - rTargetSeparatorPress;
x3_SpeedDev        := (rVotedTurbineSpeed * 0.1047197) - rTargetTurbineSpeedRadS; (* rpm to rad/s *)
x4_SepLevelDev     := rVotedSeparatorFloatLevel - rTargetSeparatorLevel;
x5_CondPressDev    := rVotedCondenserPressure - rTargetCondenserPress;
x6_HotwellLevelDev := rVotedHotwellFloatLevel - rTargetHotwellLevel;

(* 9.2 One-Step Ahead State Prediction: x_pred = Ad * x + Bd * u *)
x1_Pred := (Ad_11 * x1_ConcDev) + (Ad_12 * x2_PressDev) + (Ad_13 * x3_SpeedDev) + (Ad_14 * x4_SepLevelDev) + (Ad_15 * x5_CondPressDev) + (Ad_16 * x6_HotwellLevelDev) + (Bd_11 * rDelta_u1_Vane) + (Bd_12 * rDelta_u2_Reflux) + (Bd_13 * rDelta_u3_Brine) + (Bd_14 * rDelta_u4_CondPump);
x2_Pred := (Ad_21 * x1_ConcDev) + (Ad_22 * x2_PressDev) + (Ad_23 * x3_SpeedDev) + (Ad_24 * x4_SepLevelDev) + (Ad_25 * x5_CondPressDev) + (Ad_26 * x6_HotwellLevelDev) + (Bd_21 * rDelta_u1_Vane) + (Bd_22 * rDelta_u2_Reflux) + (Bd_23 * rDelta_u3_Brine) + (Bd_24 * rDelta_u4_CondPump);
x3_Pred := (Ad_31 * x1_ConcDev) + (Ad_32 * x2_PressDev) + (Ad_33 * x3_SpeedDev) + (Ad_34 * x4_SepLevelDev) + (Ad_35 * x5_CondPressDev) + (Ad_36 * x6_HotwellLevelDev) + (Bd_31 * rDelta_u1_Vane) + (Bd_32 * rDelta_u2_Reflux) + (Bd_33 * rDelta_u3_Brine) + (Bd_34 * rDelta_u4_CondPump);
x4_Pred := (Ad_41 * x1_ConcDev) + (Ad_42 * x2_PressDev) + (Ad_43 * x3_SpeedDev) + (Ad_44 * x4_SepLevelDev) + (Ad_45 * x5_CondPressDev) + (Ad_46 * x6_HotwellLevelDev) + (Bd_41 * rDelta_u1_Vane) + (Bd_42 * rDelta_u2_Reflux) + (Bd_43 * rDelta_u3_Brine) + (Bd_44 * rDelta_u4_CondPump);
x5_Pred := (Ad_51 * x1_ConcDev) + (Ad_52 * x2_PressDev) + (Ad_53 * x3_SpeedDev) + (Ad_54 * x4_SepLevelDev) + (Ad_55 * x5_CondPressDev) + (Ad_56 * x6_HotwellLevelDev) + (Bd_51 * rDelta_u1_Vane) + (Bd_52 * rDelta_u2_Reflux) + (Bd_53 * rDelta_u3_Brine) + (Bd_54 * rDelta_u4_CondPump);
x6_Pred := (Ad_61 * x1_ConcDev) + (Ad_62 * x2_PressDev) + (Ad_63 * x3_SpeedDev) + (Ad_64 * x4_SepLevelDev) + (Ad_65 * x5_CondPressDev) + (Ad_66 * x6_HotwellLevelDev) + (Bd_61 * rDelta_u1_Vane) + (Bd_62 * rDelta_u2_Reflux) + (Bd_63 * rDelta_u3_Brine) + (Bd_64 * rDelta_u4_CondPump);

(* 9.3 Predicted Process Output Estimation: y_pred = Cd * x_pred + Dd * u *)
y1_PredPower     := (Cd_11 * x1_Pred) + (Cd_12 * x2_Pred) + (Cd_13 * x3_Pred) + (Cd_14 * x4_Pred) + (Cd_15 * x5_Pred) + (Cd_16 * x6_Pred) + (Dd_11 * rDelta_u1_Vane);
y2_PredPress     := (Cd_21 * x1_Pred) + (Cd_22 * x2_Pred) + (Cd_23 * x3_Pred) + (Cd_24 * x4_Pred) + (Cd_25 * x5_Pred) + (Cd_26 * x6_Pred);
y3_PredSpeed     := (Cd_31 * x1_Pred) + (Cd_32 * x2_Pred) + (Cd_33 * x3_Pred) + (Cd_34 * x4_Pred) + (Cd_35 * x5_Pred) + (Cd_36 * x6_Pred);
y4_PredCondPress := (Cd_41 * x1_Pred) + (Cd_42 * x2_Pred) + (Cd_43 * x3_Pred) + (Cd_44 * x4_Pred) + (Cd_45 * x5_Pred) + (Cd_46 * x6_Pred);

(* 9.4 Analytical Quadratic Cost Gradient Vector: g = Bd' * Q * x + R_Delta * Delta_u *)
rGrad1 := (Bd_11 * rMPC_Weight_Conc * x1_ConcDev) +
          (Bd_21 * rMPC_Weight_Press * x2_PressDev) +
          (Bd_31 * rMPC_Weight_Speed * x3_SpeedDev) +
          (Bd_41 * rMPC_Weight_SepLevel * x4_SepLevelDev) +
          (Bd_51 * rMPC_Weight_CondPress * x5_CondPressDev) +
          (rMPC_Weight_dVane * rDelta_u1_Vane);

rGrad2 := (Bd_12 * rMPC_Weight_Conc * x1_ConcDev) +
          (Bd_22 * rMPC_Weight_Press * x2_PressDev) +
          (Bd_32 * rMPC_Weight_Speed * x3_SpeedDev) +
          (Bd_42 * rMPC_Weight_SepLevel * x4_SepLevelDev) +
          (rMPC_Weight_dReflux * rDelta_u2_Reflux);

rGrad3 := (Bd_13 * rMPC_Weight_Conc * x1_ConcDev) +
          (Bd_23 * rMPC_Weight_Press * x2_PressDev) +
          (Bd_33 * rMPC_Weight_Speed * x3_SpeedDev) +
          (Bd_43 * rMPC_Weight_SepLevel * x4_SepLevelDev) +
          (rMPC_Weight_dBrine * rDelta_u3_Brine);

rGrad4 := (Bd_24 * rMPC_Weight_Press * x2_PressDev) +
          (Bd_54 * rMPC_Weight_CondPress * x5_CondPressDev) +
          (Bd_64 * rMPC_Weight_HotwellLevel * x6_HotwellLevelDev) +
          (rMPC_Weight_dCondPump * rDelta_u4_CondPump);

(* 9.5 Approximate Diagonal Hessian Elements H_ii = sum(Bd_ji^2 * Q_j) + R_Delta_i *)
rHess11 := (Bd_11 * Bd_11 * rMPC_Weight_Conc) + (Bd_21 * Bd_21 * rMPC_Weight_Press) + (Bd_31 * Bd_31 * rMPC_Weight_Speed) + (Bd_41 * Bd_41 * rMPC_Weight_SepLevel) + (Bd_51 * Bd_51 * rMPC_Weight_CondPress) + rMPC_Weight_dVane;
rHess22 := (Bd_12 * Bd_12 * rMPC_Weight_Conc) + (Bd_22 * Bd_22 * rMPC_Weight_Press) + (Bd_32 * Bd_32 * rMPC_Weight_Speed) + (Bd_42 * Bd_42 * rMPC_Weight_SepLevel) + rMPC_Weight_dReflux;
rHess33 := (Bd_13 * Bd_13 * rMPC_Weight_Conc) + (Bd_23 * Bd_23 * rMPC_Weight_Press) + (Bd_33 * Bd_33 * rMPC_Weight_Speed) + (Bd_43 * Bd_43 * rMPC_Weight_SepLevel) + rMPC_Weight_dBrine;
rHess44 := (Bd_24 * Bd_24 * rMPC_Weight_Press) + (Bd_54 * Bd_54 * rMPC_Weight_CondPress) + (Bd_64 * Bd_64 * rMPC_Weight_HotwellLevel) + rMPC_Weight_dCondPump;

(* 9.6 Projected Gradient Descent Optimization Step with Slew-Rate Limiting *)
IF rHess11 > 0.001 THEN rDelta_u1_Vane := rDelta_u1_Vane - (0.45 * (rGrad1 / rHess11)); END_IF;
IF rHess22 > 0.001 THEN rDelta_u2_Reflux := rDelta_u2_Reflux - (0.45 * (rGrad2 / rHess22)); END_IF;
IF rHess33 > 0.001 THEN rDelta_u3_Brine := rDelta_u3_Brine - (0.45 * (rGrad3 / rHess33)); END_IF;
IF rHess44 > 0.001 THEN rDelta_u4_CondPump := rDelta_u4_CondPump - (0.45 * (rGrad4 / rHess44)); END_IF;

(* Rate Limiting Enforcements (Slew Bounds) *)
IF rDelta_u1_Vane > (rMaxVaneSlewRate * c_rScanTime_Ts) THEN rDelta_u1_Vane := (rMaxVaneSlewRate * c_rScanTime_Ts);
ELSIF rDelta_u1_Vane < - (rMaxVaneSlewRate * c_rScanTime_Ts) THEN rDelta_u1_Vane := - (rMaxVaneSlewRate * c_rScanTime_Ts); END_IF;

IF rDelta_u2_Reflux > (rMaxRefluxSlewRate * c_rScanTime_Ts) THEN rDelta_u2_Reflux := (rMaxRefluxSlewRate * c_rScanTime_Ts);
ELSIF rDelta_u2_Reflux < - (rMaxRefluxSlewRate * c_rScanTime_Ts) THEN rDelta_u2_Reflux := - (rMaxRefluxSlewRate * c_rScanTime_Ts); END_IF;

IF rDelta_u3_Brine > (rMaxBrineSlewRate * c_rScanTime_Ts) THEN rDelta_u3_Brine := (rMaxBrineSlewRate * c_rScanTime_Ts);
ELSIF rDelta_u3_Brine < - (rMaxBrineSlewRate * c_rScanTime_Ts) THEN rDelta_u3_Brine := - (rMaxBrineSlewRate * c_rScanTime_Ts); END_IF;

IF rDelta_u4_CondPump > (rMaxCondPumpSlewRate * c_rScanTime_Ts) THEN rDelta_u4_CondPump := (rMaxCondPumpSlewRate * c_rScanTime_Ts);
ELSIF rDelta_u4_CondPump < - (rMaxCondPumpSlewRate * c_rScanTime_Ts) THEN rDelta_u4_CondPump := - (rMaxCondPumpSlewRate * c_rScanTime_Ts); END_IF;

(* ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* 10.0 MULTI-STAGE SUPERVISORY FINITE STATE MACHINE (FSM)                                   *)
(* Controls plant lifecycle from cold evacuation to synchronous baseload generation.        *)
(* ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
IF iState <> iPrevState THEN
    tStateTimer := 0.0; (* Reset State Dwell Timer on State Transition *)
    iPrevState := iState;
ELSE
    tStateTimer := tStateTimer + c_rScanTime_Ts;
END_IF;

CASE iState OF
    0: (* STATE_UNINITIALIZED_POST: Power-On Self-Test & Diagnostic Initialization *)
        bSystemReady := FALSE;
        bSystemRunning := FALSE;
        bMPC_Active := FALSE;
        rBrineControlValve_Cmd := 0.0;
        rBrineBypassValve_Cmd := 100.0;
        rTurbineThrottleValve_Cmd := 0.0;
        rTurbineBypassValve_Cmd := 100.0;
        bEmergencyStopValve_Trip := FALSE;
        rDistillationReflux_Cmd := 10.0;
        rCondensatePumpSpeed_Cmd := 0.0;

        (* Check analog transmitters and safety circuit *)
        IF bEmergencyStop AND NOT bTripLatched AND (tStateTimer >= 3.0) THEN
            iState := 10; (* Proceed to Standby Ready *)
        END_IF;

    10: (* STATE_STANDBY_READY: System Ready for Start Permissive *)
        bSystemReady := TRUE;
        bSystemRunning := FALSE;
        bMPC_Active := FALSE;
        rBrineControlValve_Cmd := 0.0;
        rBrineBypassValve_Cmd := 100.0;
        rTurbineThrottleValve_Cmd := 0.0;
        rTurbineBypassValve_Cmd := 100.0;
        bEmergencyStopValve_Trip := FALSE;

        IF bEnableSystem AND NOT bSystemTrip THEN
            iState := 20; (* Initiate Evacuation & Vacuum Priming *)
        END_IF;

    20: (* STATE_NCG_LOCK_PREVACUUM: Condenser Deep Evacuation & NCG Priming *)
        bSystemReady := TRUE;
        bSystemRunning := FALSE;
        bNCGVacuumPump_Run := TRUE;
        bNCGScrubberPump_Run := TRUE;
        rNCGLockInletValve_Cmd := 50.0;

        (* Once low-pressure shell pressure is below 480 kPa, proceed to charging *)
        IF (rVotedCondenserPressure <= 480.0) AND (tStateTimer >= 10.0) THEN
            rNCGLockInletValve_Cmd := 0.0;

    rObsState_F_N               : REAL := 0.0;      (* Estimated drawbar tractive force in N *)

    (* Model Predictive Control (MPC) Cost Weighting Factors *)
    rWeight_BatteryThermalRate  : REAL := 15.0;     (* Penalty on steep battery current gradients dI/dt *)
    rWeight_SuperCapSoCDrift    : REAL := 8.5;      (* Penalty on SC deviating from target 70% standby state *)
    rWeight_TractionJerkRate    : REAL := 22.0;     (* Penalty on train jerk d^3x/dt^3 to prevent broken knuckles *)
    rTargetSuperCapSoC          : REAL := 70.0;     (* Optimal standby SoC for dual-mode surge absorption [%] *)

    (* Curtius-Kniffler Rail Adhesion Constants (European Heavy Rail / AAR Profile) *)
    c_CK_A                      : REAL := 7.5;      (* Empirical Curtius-Kniffler parameter A *)
    c_CK_B                      : REAL := 44.0;     (* Velocity offset parameter B [km/h] *)
    c_CK_C                      : REAL := 0.161;    (* Asymptotic friction parameter C *)
    rRailConditionDerateFactor  : REAL := 1.0;      (* Surface factor: Dry=1.0, Wet=0.65, Icy/Oil-Slick=0.45 *)

    (* Davis Train Resistance Coefficients: F_res = A_davis + B_davis*v + C_davis*v^2 [N] *)
    c_Davis_A                   : REAL := 1.35;     (* Mechanical rolling resistance coefficient [N/t] *)
    c_Davis_B                   : REAL := 0.015;    (* Wheel flange friction coefficient [N/(t*(km/h))] *)
    c_Davis_C                   : REAL := 0.00035;  (* Aerodynamic drag drag coefficient [N/(t*(km/h)^2)] *)

    (* Wheel Slip/Slide Protection (WSP) Anti-Spin Controller *)
    rWspCorrectionFactor        : REAL := 1.0;      (* Dynamic tractive torque scaling [0.05 to 1.00] *)
    tWheelSlipHoldTimer         : TON;              (* WSP recovery hold duration timer *)

    (* Janney Coupler Visual Servoing Trajectory Tracking Variables *)
    rCouplerYawError            : REAL := 0.0;      (* Yaw angle error e_theta = theta_target - theta_actual [deg] *)
    rCouplerYawIntegral         : REAL := 0.0;      (* Yaw integral accumulator *)
    rCouplerPitchError          : REAL := 0.0;      (* Pitch angle error [deg] *)
    rCouplerKp                  : REAL := 4.8;      (* Proportional servo valve gain [%/deg] *)
    rCouplerKi                  : REAL := 0.35;     (* Integral servo valve gain [%/(deg*s)] *)
    rCouplerKd                  : REAL := 0.85;     (* Derivative servo valve gain [%/(deg/s)] *)
    rCouplerYawPrevError        : REAL := 0.0;      (* Previous scan yaw error for derivative calculation *)

    (* Sequence Timers & Multi-stage Case Machine *)
    iState                      : INT := 0;         (* Executive finite state index *)
    iSubState                   : INT := 0;         (* Secondary phase controller index *)
    tStateTimer                 : TON;              (* State residence supervisor timer *)
    tCouplerSettleTimer         : TON;              (* Coupler hydraulic damping settle timer *)
    tLatchConfirmationTimer     : TON;              (* Knuckle locking pin seating confirmation timer *)
    tPullTestTimer              : TON;              (* Reverse tractive pull verification test timer *)
    tBrakePipeChargeTimer       : TON;              (* Train line pneumatic air charging timer *)

    (* Internal Flags & Diagnostics *)
    bPullTestPassed             : BOOL := FALSE;
    bCouplerAligned             : BOOL := FALSE;
    bFirstScanDone              : BOOL := FALSE;
    rMaxTractiveEffortAllowed_kN: REAL := 450.0;
    rDynamicBrakeLimit_kN       : REAL := 380.0;
    rLocomotiveMass_Te          : REAL := 180.0;    (* 6-axle Co-Co battery-hybrid robot ballast weight [t] *)
    c_GravityAccel              : REAL := 9.81;     (* Standard gravity acceleration [m/s^2] *)
    c_Ts_Sec                    : REAL := 0.010;    (* Cyclic task execution delta time Ts = 10 ms *)
END_VAR

(* ====================================================================================================
   EXECUTION ARCHITECTURE:
   PHASE 1: HARDWIRED SAFETY ENVELOPE & 2oo3 TRIPLE MODULAR REDUNDANCY VOTING
   PHASE 2: CYBER-PHYSICAL RAILWAY RESISTANCE & CURTIUS-KNIFFLER ADHESION LIMITATION
   PHASE 3: HYBRID BATTERY-SUPERCAPACITOR MODEL PREDICTIVE ENERGY ARBITRATION
   PHASE 4: 6-DOF JANNEY COUPLER VISUAL SERVOING ALIGNMENT & DRAFT GEAR DAMPING
   PHASE 5: MULTI-STAGE SHUNTING & AUTOMATED COUPLING FINITE STATE MACHINE (CASE)
   PHASE 6: 32-BIT COMPREHENSIVE ALARM MATRIX & GRACEFUL DEGRADATION ARBITRATION
   ==================================================================================================== *)

(* ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
   PHASE 1: HARDWIRED SAFETY ENVELOPE & 2oo3 TMR VOTING ALGORITHMS (IEC 61508 / EN 50129 SIL 4)
   ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* Evaluate Fail-Safe Emergency Stop Loop, Yard Perimeter Fence, and Ambient Thermal Bounds *)
IF (NOT bEmergencyStop) OR (NOT bYardSafetyFenceInterlock) THEN
    (* Immediate Fail-Safe Trip: De-energize all propulsion, dump brake pipe, clamp mechanical calipers *)
    bSystemReady                 := FALSE;
    bActiveMission               := FALSE;
    rBatteryPowerCmd_kW          := 0.0;
    rSuperCapPowerCmd_kW         := 0.0;
    rTotalTractiveEffort_kN      := 0.0;
    rRegenBrakeEffort_kN         := 0.0;
    rPneumaticBrakePressure_bar  := 3.8;    (* Maximum spring-applied air-exhausted clamp pressure *)
    rCouplerYawValveCmd_pct      := 0.0;
    rCouplerPitchValveCmd_pct    := 0.0;
    bCouplerPinReleaseSolenoid   := FALSE;
    wOperationState              := 16#E000; (* State 0xE000: EMERGENCY TRIP SHUTDOWN *)
    wAlarmWord01.0               := NOT bEmergencyStop;
    wAlarmWord01.1               := NOT bYardSafetyFenceInterlock;
    iDegradationLevel            := 4;       (* SIL 4 Maximum Safe Isolation Level *)
    iState                       := 999;     (* Jump directly to EMERGENCY_SHUTDOWN state *)
END_IF;

(* 2oo3 Triple Modular Redundancy Voting on Consist Speed Sensors:
   ChA = Doppler Radar, ChB = Axle Optical Encoder, ChC = Differential GNSS/INS *)
rVelDiff_AB := ABS(rAxleSpeed_ChA - rAxleSpeed_ChB);
rVelDiff_BC := ABS(rAxleSpeed_ChB - rAxleSpeed_ChC);
rVelDiff_CA := ABS(rAxleSpeed_ChC - rAxleSpeed_ChA);

(* Tolerance threshold for velocity channel divergence: 1.5 km/h *)
bVelDiscrepancy_AB := (rVelDiff_AB > 1.5);
bVelDiscrepancy_BC := (rVelDiff_BC > 1.5);
bVelDiscrepancy_CA := (rVelDiff_CA > 1.5);

(* Classical Median 2oo3 Selection Logic *)
IF (NOT bVelDiscrepancy_AB) THEN
    (* ChA and ChB agree within tolerance: Vote is mean of ChA and ChB *)
    rVotedVelocity_kmh := (rAxleSpeed_ChA + rAxleSpeed_ChB) * 0.5;
ELSIF (NOT bVelDiscrepancy_BC) THEN
    (* ChB and ChC agree: ChA is degraded *)
    rVotedVelocity_kmh := (rAxleSpeed_ChB + rAxleSpeed_ChC) * 0.5;
    wAlarmWord02.0 := TRUE; (* Flag Sensor ChA Discrepancy *)
ELSIF (NOT bVelDiscrepancy_CA) THEN
    (* ChA and ChC agree: ChB is degraded *)
    rVotedVelocity_kmh := (rAxleSpeed_ChA + rAxleSpeed_ChC) * 0.5;
    wAlarmWord02.1 := TRUE; (* Flag Sensor ChB Discrepancy *)
ELSE
    (* All three channels diverge: Tri-channel failure, take conservative maximum to prevent yard overspeed *)
    rVotedVelocity_kmh := MAX(rAxleSpeed_ChA, MAX(rAxleSpeed_ChB, rAxleSpeed_ChC));
    wAlarmWord02.2 := TRUE; (* Total 2oo3 Speed Sensor Failure Alarm *)
END_IF;

(* Filter velocity for smooth dynamics calculations: 1st order discrete low-pass filter (tau = 100 ms) *)
rFilteredVelocity := rFilteredVelocity + 0.09516 * (rVotedVelocity_kmh - rFilteredVelocity);

(* 2oo3 TMR Voting on Janney Coupler Yaw Angle Resolvers (Tolerance: 0.85 degrees) *)
IF (ABS(rCouplerAzimuth_ChA - rCouplerAzimuth_ChB) <= 0.85) THEN
    rVotedCouplerYaw_deg := (rCouplerAzimuth_ChA + rCouplerAzimuth_ChB) * 0.5;
ELSIF (ABS(rCouplerAzimuth_ChB - rCouplerAzimuth_ChC) <= 0.85) THEN
    rVotedCouplerYaw_deg := (rCouplerAzimuth_ChB + rCouplerAzimuth_ChC) * 0.5;
    wAlarmWord02.3 := TRUE; (* Coupler Yaw ChA Discrepant *)
ELSIF (ABS(rCouplerAzimuth_ChC - rCouplerAzimuth_ChA) <= 0.85) THEN
    rVotedCouplerYaw_deg := (rCouplerAzimuth_ChC + rCouplerAzimuth_ChA) * 0.5;
    wAlarmWord02.4 := TRUE; (* Coupler Yaw ChB Discrepant *)
ELSE
    rVotedCouplerYaw_deg := rCouplerAzimuth_ChA; (* Degraded single channel fallback *)
    wAlarmWord02.5 := TRUE; (* Coupler Yaw 2oo3 Discrepancy Fault *)
END_IF;

(* 2oo3 TMR Voting on Drawbar Draft / Buff Load Strain Cells (Tolerance: 45.0 kN) *)
IF (ABS(rCouplerDraftLoad_ChA - rCouplerDraftLoad_ChB) <= 45.0) THEN
    rVotedDraftLoad_kN := (rCouplerDraftLoad_ChA + rCouplerDraftLoad_ChB) * 0.5;
ELSIF (ABS(rCouplerDraftLoad_ChB - rCouplerDraftLoad_ChC) <= 45.0) THEN
    rVotedDraftLoad_kN := (rCouplerDraftLoad_ChB + rCouplerDraftLoad_ChC) * 0.5;
    wAlarmWord02.6 := TRUE; (* Draft Load Pin A Discrepant *)
ELSIF (ABS(rCouplerDraftLoad_ChC - rCouplerDraftLoad_ChA) <= 45.0) THEN
    rVotedDraftLoad_kN := (rCouplerDraftLoad_ChC + rCouplerDraftLoad_ChA) * 0.5;
    wAlarmWord02.7 := TRUE; (* Draft Load Pin B Discrepant *)
ELSE
    rVotedDraftLoad_kN := (rCouplerDraftLoad_ChA + rCouplerDraftLoad_ChB + rCouplerDraftLoad_ChC) / 3.0;
    wAlarmWord02.8 := TRUE; (* Tri-channel draft load deviation *)
END_IF;

(* ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
   PHASE 2: RAILWAY RESISTANCE ESTIMATION & CURTIUS-KNIFFLER ADHESION LIMITATION
   ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* Empirical Curtius-Kniffler rail-wheel friction characteristic:
   mu(v) = [c_CK_A / (v + c_CK_B) + c_CK_C] * rRailConditionDerateFactor *)
rCalculatedAdhesionCoeff := ((c_CK_A / (MAX(0.1, rVotedVelocity_kmh) + c_CK_B)) + c_CK_C) * rRailConditionDerateFactor;

(* Maximum adhesion-limited tractive effort before macro-slip: F_adh = mu * M_loco * g *)
rMaxTractiveEffortAllowed_kN := (rCalculatedAdhesionCoeff * (rLocomotiveMass_Te * 1000.0) * c_GravityAccel) / 1000.0;

(* Clamp to structural draft gear and motor inverter hard limits (450 kN maximum continuous rating) *)
IF rMaxTractiveEffortAllowed_kN > 450.0 THEN
    rMaxTractiveEffortAllowed_kN := 450.0;
END_IF;

(* Calculate Modified Davis Train Resistance for the complete consist:
   F_resist = [c_Davis_A + c_Davis_B * v + c_Davis_C * v^2] * (M_consist + M_loco) + F_grade + F_curve *)
VAR_TEMP
    rTotalMass_Te   : REAL;
    rF_Rolling_kN   : REAL;
    rF_Grade_kN     : REAL;
    rF_Curve_kN     : REAL;
    rTotalResist_kN : REAL;
    rVelDiffSetpoint: REAL;
    rRequiredAccel  : REAL;
    rRawTractiveReq : REAL;
    rRawPowerReq_kW : REAL;
    rScCapacity_kW  : REAL;
    rBatCapacity_kW : REAL;
    rCreepDelta     : REAL;
    rPredictedImpactVel : REAL;
END_VAR

rTotalMass_Te   := rConsistMass_Te + rLocomotiveMass_Te;

(* Rolling and aerodynamic resistance [kN] *)
rF_Rolling_kN   := ((c_Davis_A + (c_Davis_B * rVotedVelocity_kmh) + (c_Davis_C * (rVotedVelocity_kmh * rVotedVelocity_kmh))) * rTotalMass_Te) / 1000.0;

(* Track gradient resistance: F_grade = TotalMass * g * (i_permille / 1000) [kN] *)
rF_Grade_kN     := (rTotalMass_Te * c_GravityAccel * rTrackGradient_Permille) / 1000.0;

(* Curve resistance (Roeckl's Empirical Heavy Rail Formula): F_curve = (650 / (Radius - 55)) * Mass * g / 1000 *)
IF (rTrackCurvatureRadius_m > 60.0) THEN
    rF_Curve_kN := ((650.0 / (rTrackCurvatureRadius_m - 55.0)) * rTotalMass_Te * c_GravityAccel) / 1000.0;
ELSE
    rF_Curve_kN := 0.0;
END_IF;

rTotalResist_kN := rF_Rolling_kN + rF_Grade_kN + rF_Curve_kN;

(* Wheel Slip and Slide Protection (WSP) Creep Ratio Computation:
   lambda = (v_wheel_tach - v_ground_radar) / MAX(v_ground_radar, 0.5) *)
rCreepDelta := (rAxleSpeed_ChB - rVotedVelocity_kmh);
IF rVotedVelocity_kmh > 0.5 THEN
    rEstimatedWheelCreep_pct := (rCreepDelta / rVotedVelocity_kmh) * 100.0;
ELSE
    rEstimatedWheelCreep_pct := rCreepDelta * 20.0;
END_IF;

(* WSP Anti-Spin Control: Modulate torque if creep ratio exceeds optimal micro-slip band (2.5% to 5.0%) *)
IF (rEstimatedWheelCreep_pct > 5.0) THEN
    (* Severe wheel spin detected: Rapid torque shed *)
    rWspCorrectionFactor := MAX(0.15, rWspCorrectionFactor - 0.12);
    wAlarmWord02.9 := TRUE; (* WSP Active Wheel Spin Alarm *)
ELSIF (rEstimatedWheelCreep_pct < -5.0) THEN
    (* Severe wheel slide in dynamic braking: Reduce braking torque *)
    rWspCorrectionFactor := MAX(0.20, rWspCorrectionFactor - 0.10);
    wAlarmWord02.10 := TRUE; (* WSP Active Wheel Slide Alarm *)
ELSE
    (* Stable adhesion band: Ramp torque capacity back to 100% *)
    IF rWspCorrectionFactor < 1.0 THEN
        rWspCorrectionFactor := MIN(1.0, rWspCorrectionFactor + 0.02);
    END_IF;
    wAlarmWord02.9  := FALSE;
    wAlarmWord02.10 := FALSE;
END_IF;

(* ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
   PHASE 3: DISCRETE STATE-SPACE OBSERVER & MODEL PREDICTIVE ENERGY ALLOCATION
   ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* Discrete-Time Luenberger State Estimator Cycle (Ts = 0.010 s)
   Predictive Equation: x_hat[k+1] = A * x_hat[k] + B * u[k] + L * (y[k] - C * x_hat[k]) *)
VAR_TEMP
    rStateErr_v : REAL;
    rStateErr_s : REAL;
    rNewState_v : REAL;
    rNewState_s : REAL;
    rNewState_F : REAL;
END_VAR

(* Innovation: y - C * x_hat (where y = [v_voted_ms, draft_load_N]) *)
rStateErr_v := (rVotedVelocity_kmh / 3.6) - rObsState_v_ms;
rStateErr_s := 0.0; (* Distance sensor not directly continuous, bounded via ToF LiDAR during approach *)

rNewState_v := (matA_11 * rObsState_v_ms) + (matA_12 * rObsState_s_m) + (matA_13 * rObsState_F_N) 
               + (matB_11 * (rTotalTractiveEffort_kN * 1000.0)) + (matL_11 * rStateErr_v);

rNewState_s := (matA_21 * rObsState_v_ms) + (matA_22 * rObsState_s_m) + (matA_23 * rObsState_F_N) 
               + (matB_21 * (rTotalTractiveEffort_kN * 1000.0)) + (matL_21 * rStateErr_v);

rNewState_F := (matA_31 * rObsState_v_ms) + (matA_32 * rObsState_s_m) + (matA_33 * rObsState_F_N) 
               + (matB_31 * (rTotalTractiveEffort_kN * 1000.0)) + (matL_31 * rStateErr_v);

(* Commit updated state estimates *)
rObsState_v_ms := MAX(0.0, rNewState_v);
rObsState_s_m  := rNewState_s;
rObsState_F_N  := rNewState_F;

(* Compute Required Acceleration & Force Request based on Target Speed and Jerk Profile *)
rVelDiffSetpoint := rTargetVelocity - rVotedVelocity_kmh;

(* Smooth acceleration rate profiling: max yard acceleration 0.15 m/s^2 (0.54 km/h/s) to protect freight cargo *)
IF rVelDiffSetpoint > 0.0 THEN
    rRequiredAccel := MIN(0.18, rVelDiffSetpoint * 0.12); (* m/s^2 *)
    rRawTractiveReq := ((rTotalMass_Te * 1000.0) * rRequiredAccel / 1000.0) + rTotalResist_kN;
    rRawTractiveReq := MIN(rRawTractiveReq, rMaxTractiveEffortAllowed_kN) * rWspCorrectionFactor;
    rRegenBrakeEffort_kN := 0.0;
ELSIF rVelDiffSetpoint < -0.1 THEN
    (* Service Deceleration Profile *)
    rRequiredAccel := MAX(-0.25, rVelDiffSetpoint * 0.15); (* m/s^2 *)
    rRawTractiveReq := 0.0;
    rRegenBrakeEffort_kN := ABS(((rTotalMass_Te * 1000.0) * rRequiredAccel / 1000.0) + rTotalResist_kN);
    rRegenBrakeEffort_kN := MIN(rRegenBrakeEffort_kN, rDynamicBrakeLimit_kN) * rWspCorrectionFactor;
ELSE
    rRequiredAccel  := 0.0;
    rRawTractiveReq := MAX(0.0, rTotalResist_kN * 0.5);
    rRegenBrakeEffort_kN := 0.0;
END_IF;

rTotalTractiveEffort_kN := rRawTractiveReq;

(* Convert Tractive Force to Net Mechanical Power Demand [kW]: P = (F_kN * v_kmh) / 3.6 *)
rRawPowerReq_kW := (rTotalTractiveEffort_kN * MAX(1.0, rVotedVelocity_kmh)) / 3.6;

(* Model Predictive Frequency Power Split between Battery and Supercapacitor:
   The Battery pack has high specific energy (Wh/kg) but degrades rapidly under high C-rates (thermal stress).
   The Supercapacitor bank has high specific power (W/kg) with 1,000,000+ cycle life.
   Architecture: Low-pass filter baseline to Battery, High-pass dynamic transient jerk to Supercapacitor. *)

(* Low-pass filter for battery baseline demand (tau_bat = 2.5 seconds, alpha = 0.00398 at 10ms scan) *)
rFilteredBatteryPower := rFilteredBatteryPower + 0.0040 * (rRawPowerReq_kW - rFilteredBatteryPower);

(* Enforce Battery C-rate and SoC limits *)
IF (rBatterySoC < 20.0) OR (rBatteryCellMaxTemp_DegC > 52.0) THEN
    (* Thermal or low SoC derating *)
    rBatCapacity_kW := 250.0;
    iDegradationLevel := MAX(iDegradationLevel, 2);
    wAlarmWord01.4 := TRUE; (* Battery Derating Flag *)
ELSE
    rBatCapacity_kW := 750.0;
    wAlarmWord01.4 := FALSE;
END_IF;

rBatteryPowerCmd_kW := MIN(rBatCapacity_kW, rFilteredBatteryPower);

(* Supercapacitor allocation: absorbs the high-frequency difference (dP/dt peak breakaway burst) *)
rSuperCapPowerCmd_kW := (rRawPowerReq_kW - rBatteryPowerCmd_kW);

(* Supercapacitor State-of-Charge Management (Stabilize around rTargetSuperCapSoC = 70%) *)
IF (rSuperCapSoC < 35.0) THEN
    (* Supercap depleted: Restrict discharge, divert up to 80 kW battery power to recharge SC during cruise *)
    rSuperCapPowerCmd_kW := MAX(0.0, rSuperCapPowerCmd_kW * 0.35);
    IF (rVotedVelocity_kmh > 3.0) AND (rBatteryPowerCmd_kW < 400.0) THEN
        rBatteryPowerCmd_kW := rBatteryPowerCmd_kW + 65.0;
        rSuperCapPowerCmd_kW := -65.0; (* DC-DC buck charges supercap *)
    END_IF;
    wAlarmWord01.5 := TRUE; (* Supercap Low SoC *)
ELSIF (rSuperCapSoC > 92.0) THEN
    (* Supercap nearly full: Cannot absorb full dynamic regen energy without overvoltage *)
    IF rRegenBrakeEffort_kN > 0.0 THEN
        rSuperCapPowerCmd_kW := -150.0;
        (* Transfer excess braking energy to mechanical tread brakes *)
        rPneumaticBrakePressure_bar := 1.8;
    END_IF;
    wAlarmWord01.6 := TRUE; (* Supercap High Voltage/SoC *)
ELSE
    wAlarmWord01.5 := FALSE;
    wAlarmWord01.6 := FALSE;
END_IF;

(* Clamp Supercapacitor Power Setpoint to converter envelope *)
rSuperCapPowerCmd_kW := LIMIT(-950.0, rSuperCapPowerCmd_kW, 950.0);

(* ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
   PHASE 4: 6-DOF AUTOMATED JANNEY COUPLER VISUAL SERVOING CONTROLLER
   ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* Laser Profilometer / Stereoscopic Vision Servo Loop:
   AAR Type F tightlock coupler gathering range: +/- 110 mm horizontal, +/- 80 mm vertical.
   Beyond this gathering horn window, automatic mechanical interlock is physically impossible. *)

rCouplerYawError := 0.0 - rVotedCouplerYaw_deg; (* Target centerline is 0.0 deg *)

(* Apply vision guidance offset if target wagon is visible within 12.0 meters *)
IF (rCouplerTargetDistance_m > 0.05) AND (rCouplerTargetDistance_m < 12.0) THEN
    (* Convert lateral misalignment [mm] into angular trimming bias *)
    rCouplerYawError := rCouplerYawError + (rCouplerLateralMisalign_mm * 0.035);
    rCouplerPitchError := (0.0 - rCouplerElevation_deg) + (rCouplerVerticalMisalign_mm * 0.025);
ELSE
    rCouplerPitchError := 0.0 - rCouplerElevation_deg;
END_IF;

(* PID Hydraulic Proportional Valve Control *)
rCouplerYawIntegral := LIMIT(-30.0, rCouplerYawIntegral + (rCouplerYawError * c_Ts_Sec), 30.0);

rCouplerYawValveCmd_pct := (rCouplerKp * rCouplerYawError) 
                         + (rCouplerKi * rCouplerYawIntegral) 
                         + (rCouplerKd * (rCouplerYawError - rCouplerYawPrevError) / c_Ts_Sec);

rCouplerYawValveCmd_pct := LIMIT(-100.0, rCouplerYawValveCmd_pct, 100.0);
rCouplerYawPrevError    := rCouplerYawError;

(* Pitch proportional valve control *)
rCouplerPitchValveCmd_pct := LIMIT(-100.0, rCouplerPitchError * 7.5, 100.0);

(* Check alignment tolerance: horizontal within +/- 15 mm, yaw within +/- 0.5 deg *)
bCouplerAligned := (ABS(rVotedCouplerYaw_deg) < 0.6) AND (ABS(rCouplerLateralMisalign_mm) < 20.0);

(* ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
   PHASE 5: MULTI-STAGE SHUNTING & AUTOMATED COUPLING FINITE STATE MACHINE
   ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
CASE iState OF
    0: (* -----------------------------------------------------------------
          STATE 0: INITIALIZATION & BUILT-IN SELF-TEST (BIST)
          ----------------------------------------------------------------- *)
        wOperationState             := 16#0001;
        bSystemReady                := FALSE;
        bActiveMission              := FALSE;
        rBatteryPowerCmd_kW         := 0.0;
        rSuperCapPowerCmd_kW        := 0.0;
        rTotalTractiveEffort_kN     := 0.0;
        rRegenBrakeEffort_kN        := 0.0;
        rPneumaticBrakePressure_bar := 3.5; (* Full holding brake *)
        rCouplerYawValveCmd_pct     := 0.0;
        rCouplerPitchValveCmd_pct   := 0.0;
        bCouplerPinReleaseSolenoid  := FALSE;
        bCouplerAirLineGladHandCmd  := FALSE;
        bPullTestPassed             := FALSE;

        tStateTimer(IN := TRUE, PT := T#2S);
        IF tStateTimer.Q THEN
            tStateTimer(IN := FALSE);
            (* Verify 2oo3 sensor health before exiting BIST *)
            IF (NOT wAlarmWord02.2) AND (rBatteryBusVoltage > 620.0) AND (rSuperCapVoltage > 250.0) THEN
                iState := 10; (* Transition to STANDBY READY *)
            ELSE
                wAlarmWord01.2 := TRUE; (* Self-Test Fault *)
            END_IF;
        END_IF;

    10: (* -----------------------------------------------------------------
           STATE 10: STANDBY & DISPATCH MISSION ARBITRATION
           ----------------------------------------------------------------- *)
        wOperationState := 16#0010;
        bSystemReady    := TRUE;
        bActiveMission  := FALSE;
        rPneumaticBrakePressure_bar := 3.5; (* Hold parking clamp *)

        IF bEnable AND (rTargetVelocity > 0.1) THEN
            (* Release holding brakes, transition to Dynamic Tractive Haul *)
            rPneumaticBrakePressure_bar := 0.0;
            bActiveMission := TRUE;
            iState := 20; (* Transition to TRACTIVE_HAUL *)
        ELSIF bEnable AND (rCouplerTargetDistance_m > 0.05) AND (rCouplerTargetDistance_m < 20.0) THEN
            (* Automated Coupling Mission Profile requested by Yard Controller *)
            rPneumaticBrakePressure_bar := 0.0;
            bActiveMission := TRUE;
            iState := 40; (* Transition to COUPLER_APPROACH *)
        END_IF;

    20: (* -----------------------------------------------------------------
           STATE 20: DYNAMIC TRACTIVE HAUL & SPEED REGULATION
           ----------------------------------------------------------------- *)
        wOperationState := 16#0020;
        bActiveMission  := TRUE;
        rPneumaticBrakePressure_bar := 0.0;

        (* Maintain continuous tractive effort and hybrid power split computed in Phases 2 and 3 *)
        IF (NOT bEnable) OR (rTargetVelocity <= 0.05) THEN
            (* Graceful deceleration to stand *)
            IF rVotedVelocity_kmh < 0.2 THEN
                rTotalTractiveEffort_kN := 0.0;

(*                                    MAIN EXECUTION LOGIC                                       *)
