(* ============================================================================================= *)
(* SECTION 1: HARDWIRED SAFETY INTERLOCK VERIFICATION & SIL-3 EMERGENCY QUENCH TRIP              *)
(* ============================================================================================= *)
(* Active-low fail-safe emergency trip circuit check (toroidal vacuum break / quench trigger) *)
IF NOT bEmergencyTrip THEN
    bEmergencyTripActive := TRUE;
    bTrip_Hardwire_Latched := TRUE;
    iStateStep := 90; (* Jump directly to STATE_EMERGENCY_TRIP_RAPID_ISOLATION_RELIEF *)
END_IF;

(* Operator Diagnostic Reset & Latch Clear Handler *)
IF bAcknowledgeFaults THEN
    IF bEmergencyTrip THEN
        bTrip_Hardwire_Latched := FALSE;
    END_IF;
    IF rT_CryopanelVoted_K < 4.40 THEN
        bTrip_DesorptionAvalanche_Lat := FALSE;
    END_IF;
    IF rCoilCurrentDerivative_kA_s > -0.50 THEN
        bTrip_QuenchDischarge_Latched := FALSE;
    END_IF;
    IF rT_RadiationShield_K < 75.0 THEN
        bTrip_ShieldOverheat_Latched := FALSE;
    END_IF;
    IF rP_NeutralVoted_Mbar < 0.050 THEN
        bTrip_ToroidalVacuumBreak_Lat := FALSE;
    END_IF;
    IF rP_LHe_Supply_Bar > 2.20 THEN
        bTrip_LHePressureLoss_Latched := FALSE;
    END_IF;
    IF rForeVacuumPressure_Mbar < 0.020 THEN
        bTrip_ForeVacuumLoss_Latched := FALSE;
    END_IF;
    wTripAlarmBitmask := 16#0000;
END_IF;

(* ============================================================================================= *)
(* SECTION 2: 2-OUT-OF-3 (2oo3) TRIPLE MODULAR REDUNDANCY VOTING ENGINE                         *)
(* ============================================================================================= *)
(* --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* SUB-SECTION 2.1: Divertor Sub-Torr Neutral Gas Pressure 2oo3 Voting                           *)
(* --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
IF bHealth_P_ChA AND bHealth_P_ChB AND bHealth_P_ChC THEN
    (* All 3 channels online: Median Selection Algorithm *)
    IF (rP_DivertorNeutral_Mbar_ChA >= rP_DivertorNeutral_Mbar_ChB) THEN
        IF (rP_DivertorNeutral_Mbar_ChB >= rP_DivertorNeutral_Mbar_ChC) THEN
            rP_NeutralVoted_Mbar := rP_DivertorNeutral_Mbar_ChB;
        ELSIF (rP_DivertorNeutral_Mbar_ChA >= rP_DivertorNeutral_Mbar_ChC) THEN
            rP_NeutralVoted_Mbar := rP_DivertorNeutral_Mbar_ChC;
        ELSE
            rP_NeutralVoted_Mbar := rP_DivertorNeutral_Mbar_ChA;
        END_IF;
    ELSE
        IF (rP_DivertorNeutral_Mbar_ChA >= rP_DivertorNeutral_Mbar_ChC) THEN
            rP_NeutralVoted_Mbar := rP_DivertorNeutral_Mbar_ChA;
        ELSIF (rP_DivertorNeutral_Mbar_ChB >= rP_DivertorNeutral_Mbar_ChC) THEN
            rP_NeutralVoted_Mbar := rP_DivertorNeutral_Mbar_ChC;
        ELSE
            rP_NeutralVoted_Mbar := rP_DivertorNeutral_Mbar_ChB;
        END_IF;
    END_IF;

    (* Inter-channel discrepancy monitoring *)
    IF (ABS(rP_DivertorNeutral_Mbar_ChA - rP_DivertorNeutral_Mbar_ChB) > rTOL_P_Neutral_Mbar) OR
       (ABS(rP_DivertorNeutral_Mbar_ChB - rP_DivertorNeutral_Mbar_ChC) > rTOL_P_Neutral_Mbar) OR
       (ABS(rP_DivertorNeutral_Mbar_ChA - rP_DivertorNeutral_Mbar_ChC) > rTOL_P_Neutral_Mbar) THEN
        rTimer_P_Discrepancy := rTimer_P_Discrepancy + tScanDeltaTime_Sec;
        IF rTimer_P_Discrepancy >= rMAX_DISCREPANCY_TIME_Sec THEN
            (* Isolate faulty channel *)
            IF ABS(rP_DivertorNeutral_Mbar_ChA - rP_NeutralVoted_Mbar) > rTOL_P_Neutral_Mbar THEN
                bHealth_P_ChA := FALSE;
            ELSIF ABS(rP_DivertorNeutral_Mbar_ChB - rP_NeutralVoted_Mbar) > rTOL_P_Neutral_Mbar THEN
                bHealth_P_ChB := FALSE;
            ELSE
                bHealth_P_ChC := FALSE;
            END_IF;
        END_IF;
    ELSE
        rTimer_P_Discrepancy := 0.0;
    END_IF;
ELSIF (bHealth_P_ChA AND bHealth_P_ChB) THEN
    rP_NeutralVoted_Mbar := 0.5 * (rP_DivertorNeutral_Mbar_ChA + rP_DivertorNeutral_Mbar_ChB);
    bDegradedSensorMode := TRUE;
ELSIF (bHealth_P_ChA AND bHealth_P_ChC) THEN
    rP_NeutralVoted_Mbar := 0.5 * (rP_DivertorNeutral_Mbar_ChA + rP_DivertorNeutral_Mbar_ChC);
    bDegradedSensorMode := TRUE;
ELSIF (bHealth_P_ChB AND bHealth_P_ChC) THEN
    rP_NeutralVoted_Mbar := 0.5 * (rP_DivertorNeutral_Mbar_ChB + rP_DivertorNeutral_Mbar_ChC);
    bDegradedSensorMode := TRUE;
ELSE
    IF bHealth_P_ChA THEN
        rP_NeutralVoted_Mbar := rP_DivertorNeutral_Mbar_ChA;
    ELSIF bHealth_P_ChB THEN
        rP_NeutralVoted_Mbar := rP_DivertorNeutral_Mbar_ChB;
    ELSIF bHealth_P_ChC THEN
        rP_NeutralVoted_Mbar := rP_DivertorNeutral_Mbar_ChC;
    ELSE
        rP_NeutralVoted_Mbar := 0.050;
        bEmergencyTripActive := TRUE;
    END_IF;
    bDegradedSensorMode := TRUE;
END_IF;

(* --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* SUB-SECTION 2.2: LHe Cryosorption Panel Temperature 2oo3 Voting                              *)
(* --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
IF bHealth_T_ChA AND bHealth_T_ChB AND bHealth_T_ChC THEN
    IF (rT_LHeCryopanel_K_ChA >= rT_LHeCryopanel_K_ChB) THEN
        IF (rT_LHeCryopanel_K_ChB >= rT_LHeCryopanel_K_ChC) THEN
            rT_CryopanelVoted_K := rT_LHeCryopanel_K_ChB;
        ELSIF (rT_LHeCryopanel_K_ChA >= rT_LHeCryopanel_K_ChC) THEN
            rT_CryopanelVoted_K := rT_LHeCryopanel_K_ChC;
        ELSE
            rT_CryopanelVoted_K := rT_LHeCryopanel_K_ChA;
        END_IF;
    ELSE
        IF (rT_LHeCryopanel_K_ChA >= rT_LHeCryopanel_K_ChC) THEN
            rT_CryopanelVoted_K := rT_LHeCryopanel_K_ChA;
        ELSIF (rT_LHeCryopanel_K_ChB >= rT_LHeCryopanel_K_ChC) THEN
            rT_CryopanelVoted_K := rT_LHeCryopanel_K_ChC;
        ELSE
            rT_CryopanelVoted_K := rT_LHeCryopanel_K_ChB;
        END_IF;
    END_IF;

    IF (ABS(rT_LHeCryopanel_K_ChA - rT_LHeCryopanel_K_ChB) > rTOL_T_Cryopanel_K) OR
       (ABS(rT_LHeCryopanel_K_ChB - rT_LHeCryopanel_K_ChC) > rTOL_T_Cryopanel_K) OR
       (ABS(rT_LHeCryopanel_K_ChA - rT_LHeCryopanel_K_ChC) > rTOL_T_Cryopanel_K) THEN
        rTimer_T_Discrepancy := rTimer_T_Discrepancy + tScanDeltaTime_Sec;
        IF rTimer_T_Discrepancy >= rMAX_DISCREPANCY_TIME_Sec THEN
            IF ABS(rT_LHeCryopanel_K_ChA - rT_CryopanelVoted_K) > rTOL_T_Cryopanel_K THEN
                bHealth_T_ChA := FALSE;
            ELSIF ABS(rT_LHeCryopanel_K_ChB - rT_CryopanelVoted_K) > rTOL_T_Cryopanel_K THEN
                bHealth_T_ChB := FALSE;
            ELSE
                bHealth_T_ChC := FALSE;
            END_IF;
        END_IF;
    ELSE
        rTimer_T_Discrepancy := 0.0;
    END_IF;
ELSIF (bHealth_T_ChA AND bHealth_T_ChB) THEN
    rT_CryopanelVoted_K := 0.5 * (rT_LHeCryopanel_K_ChA + rT_LHeCryopanel_K_ChB);
    bDegradedSensorMode := TRUE;
ELSIF (bHealth_T_ChA AND bHealth_T_ChC) THEN
    rT_CryopanelVoted_K := 0.5 * (rT_LHeCryopanel_K_ChA + rT_LHeCryopanel_K_ChC);
    bDegradedSensorMode := TRUE;
ELSIF (bHealth_T_ChB AND bHealth_T_ChC) THEN
    rT_CryopanelVoted_K := 0.5 * (rT_LHeCryopanel_K_ChB + rT_LHeCryopanel_K_ChC);
    bDegradedSensorMode := TRUE;
ELSE
    IF bHealth_T_ChA THEN
        rT_CryopanelVoted_K := rT_LHeCryopanel_K_ChA;
    ELSIF bHealth_T_ChB THEN
        rT_CryopanelVoted_K := rT_LHeCryopanel_K_ChB;
    ELSIF bHealth_T_ChC THEN
        rT_CryopanelVoted_K := rT_LHeCryopanel_K_ChC;
    ELSE
        rT_CryopanelVoted_K := 10.0;
        bEmergencyTripActive := TRUE;
    END_IF;
    bDegradedSensorMode := TRUE;
END_IF;

(* --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* SUB-SECTION 2.3: Superconducting Magnet Coil Current 2oo3 Voting                             *)
(* --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
IF bHealth_I_ChA AND bHealth_I_ChB AND bHealth_I_ChC THEN
    IF (rI_SuperconductingCoil_kA_ChA >= rI_SuperconductingCoil_kA_ChB) THEN
        IF (rI_SuperconductingCoil_kA_ChB >= rI_SuperconductingCoil_kA_ChC) THEN
            rI_CoilCurrentVoted_kA := rI_SuperconductingCoil_kA_ChB;
        ELSIF (rI_SuperconductingCoil_kA_ChA >= rI_SuperconductingCoil_kA_ChC) THEN
            rI_CoilCurrentVoted_kA := rI_SuperconductingCoil_kA_ChC;
        ELSE
            rI_CoilCurrentVoted_kA := rI_SuperconductingCoil_kA_ChA;
        END_IF;
    ELSE
        IF (rI_SuperconductingCoil_kA_ChA >= rI_SuperconductingCoil_kA_ChC) THEN
            rI_CoilCurrentVoted_kA := rI_SuperconductingCoil_kA_ChA;
        ELSIF (rI_SuperconductingCoil_kA_ChB >= rI_SuperconductingCoil_kA_ChC) THEN
            rI_CoilCurrentVoted_kA := rI_SuperconductingCoil_kA_ChC;
        ELSE
            rI_CoilCurrentVoted_kA := rI_SuperconductingCoil_kA_ChB;
        END_IF;
    END_IF;

    IF (ABS(rI_SuperconductingCoil_kA_ChA - rI_SuperconductingCoil_kA_ChB) > rTOL_I_Coil_kA) OR
       (ABS(rI_SuperconductingCoil_kA_ChB - rI_SuperconductingCoil_kA_ChC) > rTOL_I_Coil_kA) OR
       (ABS(rI_SuperconductingCoil_kA_ChA - rI_SuperconductingCoil_kA_ChC) > rTOL_I_Coil_kA) THEN
        rTimer_I_Discrepancy := rTimer_I_Discrepancy + tScanDeltaTime_Sec;
        IF rTimer_I_Discrepancy >= rMAX_DISCREPANCY_TIME_Sec THEN
            IF ABS(rI_SuperconductingCoil_kA_ChA - rI_CoilCurrentVoted_kA) > rTOL_I_Coil_kA THEN
                bHealth_I_ChA := FALSE;
            ELSIF ABS(rI_SuperconductingCoil_kA_ChB - rI_CoilCurrentVoted_kA) > rTOL_I_Coil_kA THEN
                bHealth_I_ChB := FALSE;
            ELSE
                bHealth_I_ChC := FALSE;
            END_IF;
        END_IF;
    ELSE
        rTimer_I_Discrepancy := 0.0;
    END_IF;
ELSIF (bHealth_I_ChA AND bHealth_I_ChB) THEN
    rI_CoilCurrentVoted_kA := 0.5 * (rI_SuperconductingCoil_kA_ChA + rI_SuperconductingCoil_kA_ChB);
    bDegradedSensorMode := TRUE;
ELSIF (bHealth_I_ChA AND bHealth_I_ChC) THEN
    rI_CoilCurrentVoted_kA := 0.5 * (rI_SuperconductingCoil_kA_ChA + rI_SuperconductingCoil_kA_ChC);
    bDegradedSensorMode := TRUE;
ELSIF (bHealth_I_ChB AND bHealth_I_ChC) THEN
    rI_CoilCurrentVoted_kA := 0.5 * (rI_SuperconductingCoil_kA_ChB + rI_SuperconductingCoil_kA_ChC);
    bDegradedSensorMode := TRUE;
ELSE
    IF bHealth_I_ChA THEN
        rI_CoilCurrentVoted_kA := rI_SuperconductingCoil_kA_ChA;
    ELSIF bHealth_I_ChB THEN
        rI_CoilCurrentVoted_kA := rI_SuperconductingCoil_kA_ChB;
    ELSIF bHealth_I_ChC THEN
        rI_CoilCurrentVoted_kA := rI_SuperconductingCoil_kA_ChC;
    ELSE
        rI_CoilCurrentVoted_kA := 0.0;
        bEmergencyTripActive := TRUE;
    END_IF;
    bDegradedSensorMode := TRUE;
END_IF;

(* First-Order Digital Smoothing Filters *)
rP_Neutral_Filt_Mbar     := (rFilterWeight * rP_NeutralVoted_Mbar)     + ((1.0 - rFilterWeight) * rP_Neutral_Filt_Mbar);
rT_Cryopanel_Filt_K      := (rFilterWeight * rT_CryopanelVoted_K)      + ((1.0 - rFilterWeight) * rT_Cryopanel_Filt_K);
rI_Coil_Filt_kA          := (rFilterWeight * rI_CoilCurrentVoted_kA)   + ((1.0 - rFilterWeight) * rI_Coil_Filt_kA);
rQ_Throughput_Filt_Pam3s := (rFilterWeight * rQ_NeutralGasThroughput_Pam3s) + ((1.0 - rFilterWeight) * rQ_Throughput_Filt_Pam3s);

(* Calculate Magnet Coil Fast Discharge Derivative dI/dt [kA/s] *)
IF tScanDeltaTime_Sec > 0.001 THEN
    rCoilCurrentDerivative_kA_s := (rI_Coil_Filt_kA - rPreviousI_Coil_kA) / tScanDeltaTime_Sec;
    rPreviousI_Coil_kA := rI_Coil_Filt_kA;
END_IF;

(* Fast Quench Event Detection: if dI/dt breaches critical threshold *)
IF (rCoilCurrentDerivative_kA_s < rQuenchCurrentTripThresh_kA_s) AND (rI_Coil_Filt_kA > 1.0) THEN
    bTrip_QuenchDischarge_Latched := TRUE;
    bQuenchDampingActive := TRUE;
END_IF;

(* ============================================================================================= *)
(* SECTION 3: PHYSICAL OBSERVERS & NON-LINEAR CRYOGENIC KINETICS                                *)
(* ============================================================================================= *)
(* Mean thermal molecular velocity of Deuterium D2 at cryopanel gas temperature:               *)
(* v_th = SQRT( (8 * R * T) / (pi * M_mol) )                                                    *)
IF rT_Cryopanel_Filt_K > 1.0 THEN
    rThermalSpeed_D2_m_s := SQRT((8.0 * rUniversalGasConst_R * rT_Cryopanel_Filt_K) / (3.14159265 * rMolarMass_D2_KgMol));
ELSE
    rThermalSpeed_D2_m_s := 100.0;
END_IF;

(* Dynamic sticking coefficient degradation as panel approaches desorption threshold (4.8 K) *)
IF rT_Cryopanel_Filt_K <= 4.22 THEN
    rStickingCoeff := 0.95;
ELSIF rT_Cryopanel_Filt_K < 4.80 THEN
    rStickingCoeff := 0.95 * (1.0 - EXPT(((rT_Cryopanel_Filt_K - 4.22) / 0.58), 2.0));
ELSE
    rStickingCoeff := 0.02; (* Panel blinding / desorptive regime *)
END_IF;

(* Real-Time Volumetric Pumping Speed S_eff [m3/s]:                                             *)
(* S_eff = A_panel * (v_th / 4) * alpha_stick * (Louver_pct / 100)                              *)
rPumpingSpeed_Actual_m3s := rCryopanelSurfaceArea_M2 * (rThermalSpeed_D2_m_s / 4.0) * rStickingCoeff * (rChevronLouver_Angle_Cmd_Pct / 100.0);
IF rPumpingSpeed_Actual_m3s < 0.0 THEN
    rPumpingSpeed_Actual_m3s := 0.0;
ELSIF rPumpingSpeed_Actual_m3s > 140.0 THEN
    rPumpingSpeed_Actual_m3s := 140.0;
END_IF;

(* Hydrogenic Frost Layer Cumulative Mass Integration [mg/cm2] *)
IF (bPumpingActive) AND (rP_Neutral_Filt_Mbar > 1.0E-6) THEN
    (* Gas mass flow: dm/dt = Q * (M_mol / (R * T)) *)
    rGasLoadDelta_Mg := (rQ_Throughput_Filt_Pam3s * (rMolarMass_D2_KgMol / (rUniversalGasConst_R * 293.15))) * 1.0E6 * tScanDeltaTime_Sec;
    rFrostLayerCoverage_MgCm2 := rFrostLayerCoverage_MgCm2 + (rGasLoadDelta_Mg / (rCryopanelSurfaceArea_M2 * 10000.0));
END_IF;

(* Cryopanel Sorbent Saturation Permissive *)
IF rFrostLayerCoverage_MgCm2 >= rMaxFrostLayerCapacity_MgCm2 THEN
    bRegenerationRequired := TRUE;
ELSE
    bRegenerationRequired := FALSE;
END_IF;

(* Temperature Margin to Violent Desorption Avalanche [K] *)
rCryoThermalMargin_K := rDesorptionThreshold_K - rT_Cryopanel_Filt_K;

(* Divertor-to-Core Scrape-Off Layer Neutral Compression Ratio: P_div / P_core *)
IF rForeVacuumPressure_Mbar > 1.0E-6 THEN
    rP_NeutralCompressionRatio := rP_Neutral_Filt_Mbar / (rForeVacuumPressure_Mbar * 0.10);
ELSE
    rP_NeutralCompressionRatio := 1.0;
END_IF;

(* Magnet Quench Induced Eddy Current Damping Model *)
IF bQuenchDampingActive THEN
    (* Eddy current dynamics: dI_eddy/dt = - (R_shield / L_shield) * I_eddy - M * dI_coil/dt *)
    rQuenchEddyCurrentDamped_kA := (0.65 * ABS(rCoilCurrentDerivative_kA_s)) * (rShieldCoolantValve_Cmd_Pct / 100.0);
ELSE
    rQuenchEddyCurrentDamped_kA := 0.0;
END_IF;
(* ============================================================================================= *)
(* SECTION 4: DISCRETE KALMAN FILTER / STATE OBSERVER UPDATE                                    *)
(* ============================================================================================= *)
(* Format physical plant measurement deviation vector y_meas[4] *)
(* y[1] = delta P_neutral [mbar] (setpoint = 0.0050 mbar) *)
(* y[2] = delta T_cryopanel [K] (nominal = 4.10 K) *)
(* y[3] = delta T_shield [K] (nominal = 52.0 K) *)
(* y[4] = delta I_eddy [kA] (nominal = 0.0 kA) *)
rInnovation[1] := (rP_Neutral_Filt_Mbar - 0.0050) - (mC_d[1,1]*xState_Pred[1] + mC_d[1,2]*xState_Pred[2]);
rInnovation[2] := (rT_Cryopanel_Filt_K - 4.10)   - (mC_d[2,2]*xState_Pred[2]);
rInnovation[3] := (rT_RadiationShield_K - 52.0)  - (mC_d[3,3]*xState_Pred[3]);
rInnovation[4] := (rQuenchEddyCurrentDamped_kA)  - (mC_d[4,6]*xState_Pred[6]);

(* State Estimation Update: x_est = x_pred + L * Innovation *)
FOR iRow := 1 TO 6 DO
    rAccumulator := 0.0;
    FOR iCol := 1 TO 4 DO
        rAccumulator := rAccumulator + (mL_Gain[iRow, iCol] * rInnovation[iCol]);
    END_FOR;
    xState_Est[iRow] := xState_Pred[iRow] + rAccumulator;
    xState[iRow] := xState_Est[iRow];
END_FOR;

(* Measured Disturbance Vector d[2] *)
dDisturbance[1] := rP_QuenchHeatFlux_kW;
dDisturbance[2] := rM_PelletMassFlow_MgSec;

(* State Time Propagation: x_pred(k+1) = A_d * x(k) + B_d * u(k) + E_d * d(k) *)
FOR iRow := 1 TO 6 DO
    rAccumulator := 0.0;
    FOR iCol := 1 TO 6 DO
        rAccumulator := rAccumulator + (mA_d[iRow, iCol] * xState[iCol]);
    END_FOR;
    FOR iCol := 1 TO 4 DO
        rAccumulator := rAccumulator + (mB_d[iRow, iCol] * uControl[iCol]);
    END_FOR;
    FOR iCol := 1 TO 2 DO
        rAccumulator := rAccumulator + (mE_d[iRow, iCol] * dDisturbance[iCol]);
    END_FOR;
    xState_Pred[iRow] := rAccumulator;
END_FOR;

(* ============================================================================================= *)
(* SECTION 5: REAL-TIME PROJECTED GRADIENT MODEL PREDICTIVE CONTROL (MPC) QP SOLVER              *)
(* ============================================================================================= *)
(* Objective: Minimize J(u) = 1/2 * (y - y_sp)^T * Q * (y - y_sp) + 1/2 * u^T * R * u           *)
(*                          + 1/2 * rho_barrier * [max(0, T_cryopanel - T_thresh)]^2             *)
IF (iStateStep = 40) OR (iStateStep = 50) OR (iStateStep = 60) THEN
    (* Evaluate soft barrier violation on cryopanel temperature margin *)
    IF xState[2] > 0.40 THEN (* Temperature approaching 4.50 K *)
        rCryoMarginViolationSlack := xState[2] - 0.40;
    ELSE
        rCryoMarginViolationSlack := 0.0;
    END_IF;

    (* Bounded Deterministic Iterative Gradient Descent *)
    FOR iQPIteration := 1 TO iMaxQPIterations DO
        (* Gradient computation: Grad_J_u = B_d^T * C_d^T * Q * (C_d * x - y_ref) + R * u + SlackPenalty *)
        rGradJ[1] := (mB_d[1,1] * vQ_Diag[1] * xState[1]) + (vR_Diag[1] * uControl[1]);
        rGradJ[2] := (mB_d[2,2] * vQ_Diag[2] * xState[2]) + (vR_Diag[2] * uControl[2]) - (rRhoCryoPenalty * rCryoMarginViolationSlack * 0.05);
        rGradJ[3] := (mB_d[3,3] * vQ_Diag[3] * xState[3]) + (vR_Diag[3] * uControl[3]);
        rGradJ[4] := (mB_d[4,4] * vQ_Diag[4] * xState[4]) + (vR_Diag[4] * uControl[4]);

        (* Additional coupling: if pellet mass flow surge, bias deflector trim *)
        IF dDisturbance[2] > 10.0 THEN
            rGradJ[4] := rGradJ[4] - (0.45 * dDisturbance[2]);
        END_IF;

        (* Additional coupling: if quench heat flux surge, strongly bias shield coolant *)
        IF dDisturbance[1] > 5.0 THEN
            rGradJ[3] := rGradJ[3] - (0.85 * dDisturbance[1]);
        END_IF;

        (* Projected gradient descent step: u = u - alpha * Grad_J *)
        uControl[1] := uControl[1] - (rAlphaStep * rGradJ[1]);
        uControl[2] := uControl[2] - (rAlphaStep * rGradJ[2]);
        uControl[3] := uControl[3] - (rAlphaStep * rGradJ[3]);
        uControl[4] := uControl[4] - (rAlphaStep * rGradJ[4]);

        (* Actuator Box Projection [Min, Max] *)
        IF uControl[1] < -50.0 THEN uControl[1] := -50.0; ELSIF uControl[1] > 50.0 THEN uControl[1] := 50.0; END_IF;
        IF uControl[2] < -40.0 THEN uControl[2] := -40.0; ELSIF uControl[2] > 60.0 THEN uControl[2] := 60.0; END_IF;
        IF uControl[3] < -30.0 THEN uControl[3] := -30.0; ELSIF uControl[3] > 70.0 THEN uControl[3] := 70.0; END_IF;
        IF uControl[4] < -50.0 THEN uControl[4] := -50.0; ELSIF uControl[4] > 50.0 THEN uControl[4] := 50.0; END_IF;
    END_FOR;
END_IF;
(* ============================================================================================= *)
(* SECTION 6: MULTI-STAGE FINITE STATE MACHINE (FSM) WITH SAFETY PERMISSIVES                    *)
(* ============================================================================================= *)
(* Update State Dwell Timer *)
IF iStateStep = iPreviousState THEN
    rStateTimer_Sec := rStateTimer_Sec + tScanDeltaTime_Sec;
ELSE
    rStateTimer_Sec := 0.0;
    iPreviousState := iStateStep;
END_IF;

(* Compute Cryopanel Chilldown Temperature Slope dT/dt [K/min] *)
IF tScanDeltaTime_Sec > 0.001 THEN
    rChilldownRampRate_K_PerMin := ((rT_Cryopanel_Filt_K - rPreviousT_Cryopanel_K) / tScanDeltaTime_Sec) * 60.0;
    rPreviousT_Cryopanel_K := rT_Cryopanel_Filt_K;
END_IF;

CASE iStateStep OF
    (* ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
    (* STATE 0: OFFLINE / VACUUM SYSTEM ISOLATED & DE-ENERGIZED                                  *)
    (* ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
    0:
        bSystemReady := FALSE;
        bPumpingActive := FALSE;
        bQuenchDampingActive := FALSE;
        bPelletDeflectorActive := FALSE;

        rChevronLouver_Angle_Cmd_Pct := 0.0;
        rLHe_SupplyValve_Cmd_Pct     := 0.0;
        rShieldCoolantValve_Cmd_Pct  := 0.0;
        rPelletDeflector_Cmd_Pct     := 0.0;
        rRegenHeater_Power_Cmd_kW    := 0.0;
        rRoughingBypassValve_Cmd_Pct := 0.0;

        IF bEnable AND NOT bEmergencyTripActive THEN
            IF iTargetOperatingMode = 1 THEN
                iStateStep := 10; (* Transition to WARM_ROUGHING_EVACUATION *)
            END_IF;
        END_IF;

    (* ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
    (* STATE 10: WARM EVACUATION & VACUUM PURGE (Fore-vacuum pumping down to 1.0E-2 mbar)        *)
    (* ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
    10:
        bSystemReady := FALSE;
        bPumpingActive := FALSE;

        (* Open fore-vacuum turbomolecular roughing line bypass *)
        rRoughingBypassValve_Cmd_Pct := 100.0;
        rChevronLouver_Angle_Cmd_Pct := 10.0; (* Slight crack to evacuate cryochamber *)
        rLHe_SupplyValve_Cmd_Pct     := 0.0;
        rShieldCoolantValve_Cmd_Pct  := 0.0;
        rRegenHeater_Power_Cmd_kW    := 0.0;
        rPelletDeflector_Cmd_Pct     := 0.0;

        IF rP_Neutral_Filt_Mbar <= 0.020 THEN
            IF (iTargetOperatingMode >= 2) AND (rStateTimer_Sec >= 30.0) THEN
                iStateStep := 20; (* Transition to RADIATION_SHIELD_PRECOOLING *)
            END_IF;
        END_IF;

        IF NOT bEnable OR (iTargetOperatingMode = 0) THEN
            iStateStep := 0;
        END_IF;

    (* ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
    (* STATE 20: 80K THERMAL RADIATION SHIELD PRECOOLING (50K GHe chilldown)                    *)
    (* ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
    20:
        bSystemReady := FALSE;
        bPumpingActive := FALSE;

        rRoughingBypassValve_Cmd_Pct := 50.0;
        rChevronLouver_Angle_Cmd_Pct := 0.0; (* Keep louvers closed to protect panels *)
        rShieldCoolantValve_Cmd_Pct  := 45.0; (* Initiate 50K GHe coolant loop *)
        rLHe_SupplyValve_Cmd_Pct     := 0.0;
        rRegenHeater_Power_Cmd_kW    := 0.0;
        rPelletDeflector_Cmd_Pct     := 0.0;

        IF rT_RadiationShield_K <= 78.0 THEN
            IF (iTargetOperatingMode >= 3) AND (rStateTimer_Sec >= 60.0) THEN
                iStateStep := 30; (* Transition to LHE_CRYOPANEL_CHILLDOWN *)
            END_IF;
        END_IF;

        IF NOT bEnable OR (iTargetOperatingMode = 0) THEN
            iStateStep := 80; (* Abort to controlled warm-up *)
        END_IF;

    (* ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
    (* STATE 30: LHe CRYOPANEL CHILLDOWN (Supercritical He to 4.2 K)                            *)
    (* ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
    30:
        bSystemReady := FALSE;
        bPumpingActive := FALSE;

        rRoughingBypassValve_Cmd_Pct := 15.0;
        rChevronLouver_Angle_Cmd_Pct := 0.0;
        rShieldCoolantValve_Cmd_Pct  := 35.0;

        (* Controlled supercritical LHe chilldown ramping *)
        IF rT_Cryopanel_Filt_K > 80.0 THEN
            rLHe_SupplyValve_Cmd_Pct := 25.0;
        ELSIF rT_Cryopanel_Filt_K > 20.0 THEN
            rLHe_SupplyValve_Cmd_Pct := 50.0;
        ELSE
            rLHe_SupplyValve_Cmd_Pct := 70.0;
        END_IF;

        IF (rT_Cryopanel_Filt_K <= 4.25) AND (rP_Neutral_Filt_Mbar <= 0.0050) THEN
            IF (iTargetOperatingMode >= 4) AND (rStateTimer_Sec >= 45.0) THEN
                iStateStep := 40; (* Transition to STEADY_STATE_CRYOPUMPING_MPC *)
            END_IF;
        END_IF;

        IF NOT bEnable OR (iTargetOperatingMode = 0) THEN
            iStateStep := 80;
        END_IF;

    (* ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
    (* STATE 40: ACTIVE CRYOPUMPING & SUB-TORR NEUTRAL PRESSURE REGULATION (MPC CLOSED LOOP)    *)
    (* ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
    40:
        bSystemReady := TRUE;
        bPumpingActive := TRUE;
        bQuenchDampingActive := FALSE;
        bPelletDeflectorActive := FALSE;

        rRoughingBypassValve_Cmd_Pct := 0.0; (* Fore-vacuum isolated; cryopump takes full load *)
        rRegenHeater_Power_Cmd_kW    := 0.0;

        (* Map MPC outputs to actuator setpoints *)
        rChevronLouver_Angle_Cmd_Pct := 75.0 + uControl[1];
        rLHe_SupplyValve_Cmd_Pct     := 60.0 + uControl[2];
        rShieldCoolantValve_Cmd_Pct  := 30.0 + uControl[3];
        rPelletDeflector_Cmd_Pct     := 20.0 + uControl[4];

        (* Fast condition shifts *)
        IF rM_PelletMassFlow_MgSec > 8.0 THEN
            iStateStep := 50; (* High-density pellet injection active *)
        ELSIF bTrip_QuenchDischarge_Latched OR (rCoilCurrentDerivative_kA_s < -0.80) THEN
            iStateStep := 60; (* Magnet quench thermal transient detected *)
        ELSIF bRegenerationRequired THEN
            iStateStep := 70; (* Frost saturation reached *)
        ELSIF (iTargetOperatingMode = 8) OR NOT bEnable THEN
            iStateStep := 80; (* Controlled shutdown *)
        END_IF;

    (* ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
    (* STATE 50: PELLET INJECTION & HIGH THROUGHPUT CONDENSATION DEFLECTION                      *)
    (* ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
    50:
        bSystemReady := TRUE;
        bPumpingActive := TRUE;
        bPelletDeflectorActive := TRUE;

        (* Maximize cryogenic capture and deflect ablated pellet shards *)
        rChevronLouver_Angle_Cmd_Pct := 90.0 + (0.5 * uControl[1]);
        rLHe_SupplyValve_Cmd_Pct     := 85.0 + uControl[2];
        rShieldCoolantValve_Cmd_Pct  := 40.0 + uControl[3];
        rPelletDeflector_Cmd_Pct     := 80.0 + uControl[4];

        IF rM_PelletMassFlow_MgSec <= 2.0 THEN
            IF rStateTimer_Sec >= 5.0 THEN
                iStateStep := 40; (* Return to steady-state pumping *)
            END_IF;
        END_IF;

        IF bTrip_QuenchDischarge_Latched THEN
            iStateStep := 60;
        END_IF;

    (* ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
    (* STATE 60: MAGNET QUENCH THERMAL TRANSIENT MITIGATION & SHIELD DAMPING                     *)
    (* ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
    60:
        bSystemReady := FALSE;
        bPumpingActive := TRUE;
        bQuenchDampingActive := TRUE;

        (* Quench defense strategy: *)
        (* 1. Snap close chevron louvers to isolate panels from direct radiation *)
        rChevronLouver_Angle_Cmd_Pct := 5.0;
        (* 2. Flood 50K shield with maximum coolant bypass to damp eddy heating *)
        rShieldCoolantValve_Cmd_Pct  := 100.0;
        (* 3. Boost LHe supply to maximum to prevent panel dryout *)
        rLHe_SupplyValve_Cmd_Pct     := 100.0;
        rPelletDeflector_Cmd_Pct     := 0.0;
        rRoughingBypassValve_Cmd_Pct := 10.0;

        IF (rCoilCurrentDerivative_kA_s > -0.10) AND (rQuenchEddyCurrentDamped_kA < 0.20) THEN
            IF rStateTimer_Sec >= 20.0 THEN
                bQuenchDampingActive := FALSE;
                IF rT_Cryopanel_Filt_K <= 4.30 THEN
                    iStateStep := 40; (* Recovered without quench boil-off *)
                ELSE
                    iStateStep := 70; (* Induced thermal bump requires regeneration *)
                END_IF;
            END_IF;
        END_IF;

    (* ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
    (* STATE 70: REGENERATION BUMP & FLASH THERMAL DESORPTION (Controlled heating & gas recovery)*)
    (* ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
    70:
        bSystemReady := FALSE;
        bPumpingActive := FALSE;
        bQuenchDampingActive := FALSE;
        bPelletDeflectorActive := FALSE;

        (* Isolate divertor chamber and open roughing recovery line *)
        rChevronLouver_Angle_Cmd_Pct := 0.0;
        rRoughingBypassValve_Cmd_Pct := 100.0;
        rLHe_SupplyValve_Cmd_Pct     := 0.0;
        rShieldCoolantValve_Cmd_Pct  := 20.0;

        (* Pulse electrical regeneration heaters to warm panels to 35 - 50 K *)
        IF rT_Cryopanel_Filt_K < 38.0 THEN
            rRegenHeater_Power_Cmd_kW := 25.0;
        ELSIF rT_Cryopanel_Filt_K < 50.0 THEN
            rRegenHeater_Power_Cmd_kW := 8.0;
        ELSE
            rRegenHeater_Power_Cmd_kW := 0.0;
        END_IF;

        (* Reset frost accumulation once desorbed gas is pumped away *)
        IF (rT_Cryopanel_Filt_K >= 40.0) AND (rRoughingBypassValve_Cmd_Pct > 90.0) THEN
            rFrostLayerCoverage_MgCm2 := 0.05;
            IF (rP_Neutral_Filt_Mbar <= 0.0080) AND (rStateTimer_Sec >= 120.0) THEN
                rRegenHeater_Power_Cmd_kW := 0.0;
                iStateStep := 30; (* Re-chilldown cryopanels *)
            END_IF;
        END_IF;

    (* ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
    (* STATE 80: CONTROLLED SYSTEM SHUTDOWN & WARM-UP                                            *)
    (* ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
    80:
        bSystemReady := FALSE;
        bPumpingActive := FALSE;
        bQuenchDampingActive := FALSE;
        bPelletDeflectorActive := FALSE;

        rChevronLouver_Angle_Cmd_Pct := 0.0;
        rLHe_SupplyValve_Cmd_Pct     := 0.0;
        rShieldCoolantValve_Cmd_Pct  := 0.0;
        rPelletDeflector_Cmd_Pct     := 0.0;
        rRoughingBypassValve_Cmd_Pct := 100.0;
        rRegenHeater_Power_Cmd_kW    := 12.0;

        IF rT_Cryopanel_Filt_K >= 280.0 THEN
            rRegenHeater_Power_Cmd_kW := 0.0;
            iStateStep := 0; (* Offline *)
        END_IF;

    (* ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
    (* STATE 90: EMERGENCY TRIP RAPID ISOLATION & PRESSURE RELIEF BLOWDOWN                       *)
    (* ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
    90:
        bSystemReady := FALSE;
        bPumpingActive := FALSE;
        bQuenchDampingActive := FALSE;
        bPelletDeflectorActive := FALSE;
        bEmergencyTripActive := TRUE;

        (* Fail-safe valve positions *)
        rChevronLouver_Angle_Cmd_Pct := 0.0;   (* Fast closure *)
        rLHe_SupplyValve_Cmd_Pct     := 0.0;   (* Isolated *)
        rShieldCoolantValve_Cmd_Pct  := 100.0; (* Full quench bypass relief *)
        rPelletDeflector_Cmd_Pct     := 0.0;   (* Retracted *)

    rGalvoFilteredY                 : REAL := 0.0;                (* Digitally damped galvo command Y *)

    (* ========================================================================================= *)
    rH2BufferGasDensity_kg_m3       : REAL := 0.0;                (* [kg/m^3] Hydrogen gas density at operating vacuum *)

    aJitterBuffer_Y                 : ARRAY[0..49] OF REAL;       (* Rolling ring buffer for Y position error *)

(* ========================================================================================= *)
(* CONTROL LOGIC & HARD REAL-TIME EXECUTION PIPELINE                                         *)
(* ========================================================================================= *)

(* ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* SUB-ROUTINE 0: STATE-SPACE PLANT MATRICES INITIALIZATION (A, B, C, D)                     *)
(* Discretized physical model for 50 kHz jet perturbation, gas dynamics & thermal response.  *)
(* ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
IF NOT bMatrixInitDone THEN
    (* Reset all matrix coefficients to zero *)
    FOR iLoopIndex_j := 0 TO 7 DO
        FOR iLoopIndex_k := 0 TO 7 DO
            aMatrix_A[iLoopIndex_j, iLoopIndex_k] := 0.0;
        END_FOR;
        FOR iLoopIndex_k := 0 TO 3 DO
            aMatrix_B[iLoopIndex_j, iLoopIndex_k] := 0.0;
        END_FOR;
    END_FOR;
    FOR iLoopIndex_j := 0 TO 3 DO
        FOR iLoopIndex_k := 0 TO 7 DO
            aMatrix_C[iLoopIndex_j, iLoopIndex_k] := 0.0;
        END_FOR;
        FOR iLoopIndex_k := 0 TO 3 DO
            aMatrix_D[iLoopIndex_j, iLoopIndex_k] := 0.0;
        END_FOR;
    END_FOR;

    (* Discrete System Matrix A (Diagonal retention and physical cross-coupling) *)
    (* State 0: Droplet Position X error [um] *)
    aMatrix_A[0, 0] := 0.9450;  (* Natural aerodynamic damping in low vacuum *)
    aMatrix_A[0, 3] := 0.0010;  (* Position velocity integration: dx = vx * dt *)
    (* State 1: Droplet Position Y error [um] *)
    aMatrix_A[1, 1] := 0.9450;
    aMatrix_A[1, 4] := 0.0010;
    (* State 2: Droplet Position Z error [um] *)
    aMatrix_A[2, 2] := 0.9820;
    aMatrix_A[2, 5] := 0.0010;
    (* State 3: Velocity Vx error [m/s] *)
    aMatrix_A[3, 3] := 0.8920;
    (* State 4: Velocity Vy error [m/s] *)
    aMatrix_A[4, 4] := 0.8920;
    (* State 5: Velocity Vz error [m/s] *)
    aMatrix_A[5, 5] := 0.9150;
    aMatrix_A[5, 6] := 0.1240;  (* Propellant back-pressure sensitivity on axial velocity: dvz/dP *)
    (* State 6: Argon Propellant Pressure error [bar] *)
    aMatrix_A[6, 6] := 0.9650;  (* Pneumatic dome accumulator time constant *)
    (* State 7: H2 Buffer Curtain Pressure error [mbar] *)
    aMatrix_A[7, 7] := 0.9520;  (* Vacuum chamber conductance time constant *)

    (* Input Coupling Matrix B *)
    (* Input 0: u_freq_tune [kHz] -> Influences breakup wavelength and axial timing *)
    aMatrix_B[2, 0] := 0.4500;
    aMatrix_B[5, 0] := 0.0850;
    (* Input 1: u_piezo_v [V] -> Influences droplet separation velocity stability *)
    aMatrix_B[0, 1] := 0.0210;
    aMatrix_B[1, 1] := 0.0210;
    aMatrix_B[5, 1] := 0.0450;
    (* Input 2: u_argon_p [bar] -> Strongly drives axial propellant velocity *)
    aMatrix_B[5, 2] := 0.3850;
    aMatrix_B[6, 2] := 0.8200;
    (* Input 3: u_mfc_h2 [sccm] -> Regulates chamber buffer curtain pressure *)
    aMatrix_B[7, 3] := 0.0680;

    (* Output Sensor Mapping Matrix C *)
    aMatrix_C[0, 0] := 1.0;     (* Output 0: Shadowgraph Camera A horizontal position *)
    aMatrix_C[1, 1] := 1.0;     (* Output 1: Shadowgraph Camera B vertical position *)
    aMatrix_C[2, 5] := 1.0;     (* Output 2: Axial stream velocity transit measurement *)
    aMatrix_C[3, 7] := 1.0;     (* Output 3: Chamber H2 buffer gas curtain pressure *)

    (* MPC Diagonal Quadratic Cost Weights *)
    aMPC_Weight_Q[0] := 120.0;  (* Severe penalty on X position drift *)
    aMPC_Weight_Q[1] := 120.0;  (* Severe penalty on Y position drift *)
    aMPC_Weight_Q[2] := 80.0;   (* Moderate penalty on axial Z drift *)
    aMPC_Weight_Q[3] := 15.0;   (* Velocity stability X *)
    aMPC_Weight_Q[4] := 15.0;   (* Velocity stability Y *)
    aMPC_Weight_Q[5] := 65.0;   (* Velocity stability Z *)
    aMPC_Weight_Q[6] := 25.0;   (* Propellant pressure tracking error *)
    aMPC_Weight_Q[7] := 45.0;   (* H2 curtain pressure tracking error *)

    aMPC_Weight_R[0] := 2.5;    (* Control effort penalty: Piezo frequency tuning *)
    aMPC_Weight_R[1] := 0.8;    (* Control effort penalty: Piezo voltage amplitude *)
    aMPC_Weight_R[2] := 4.0;    (* Control effort penalty: Argon dome pressure *)
    aMPC_Weight_R[3] := 1.2;    (* Control effort penalty: H2 mass flow controller *)

    aMPC_Weight_S[0] := 10.0;   (* Slew rate penalty: dFreq/dt *)
    aMPC_Weight_S[1] := 5.0;    (* Slew rate penalty: dVoltage/dt *)
    aMPC_Weight_S[2] := 20.0;   (* Slew rate penalty: dPress/dt *)
    aMPC_Weight_S[3] := 8.0;    (* Slew rate penalty: dFlow/dt *)

    (* Diagonal inverse Hessian approximation for single-step gradient descent *)
    aMPC_Hessian_Inv[0] := 1.0 / (aMPC_Weight_R[0] + aMPC_Weight_S[0] + 15.2);
    aMPC_Hessian_Inv[1] := 1.0 / (aMPC_Weight_R[1] + aMPC_Weight_S[1] + 8.4);
    aMPC_Hessian_Inv[2] := 1.0 / (aMPC_Weight_R[2] + aMPC_Weight_S[2] + 42.1);
    aMPC_Hessian_Inv[3] := 1.0 / (aMPC_Weight_R[3] + aMPC_Weight_S[3] + 6.8);

    (* Kalman Filter Covariance Initialization *)
    FOR iLoopIndex_j := 0 TO 5 DO
        FOR iLoopIndex_k := 0 TO 5 DO
            aKalmanCov_P[iLoopIndex_j, iLoopIndex_k] := 0.0;
            aKalmanNoise_Q[iLoopIndex_j, iLoopIndex_k] := 0.0;
        END_FOR;
        aKalmanCov_P[iLoopIndex_j, iLoopIndex_j] := 1.0;
    END_FOR;
    aKalmanNoise_Q[0, 0] := 0.05;   (* Pos X process noise variance *)
    aKalmanNoise_Q[1, 1] := 0.05;   (* Pos Y process noise variance *)
    aKalmanNoise_Q[2, 2] := 0.10;   (* Pos Z process noise variance *)
    aKalmanNoise_Q[3, 3] := 0.02;   (* Vel Vx process noise variance *)
    aKalmanNoise_Q[4, 4] := 0.02;   (* Vel Vy process noise variance *)
    aKalmanNoise_Q[5, 5] := 0.04;   (* Vel Vz process noise variance *)

    aKalmanNoise_R[0, 0] := 0.15;   (* Shadowgraph Cam A spatial measurement noise *)
    aKalmanNoise_R[1, 1] := 0.15;   (* Shadowgraph Cam B spatial measurement noise *)
    aKalmanNoise_R[2, 2] := 0.25;   (* Dual-slit transit velocity measurement noise *)

    bMatrixInitDone := TRUE;
END_IF;

(* ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* SUB-ROUTINE 1: HARDWARE INTERLOCKS & CRITICAL TRIP MONITORING                             *)
(* Immediate fail-safe isolation of laser shutter and propellant pressure line.              *)
(* ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
IF bResetFaults THEN
    bCriticalTripLatched := FALSE;
    wAlarmWord1_CriticalTrips := 16#0000;
    wAlarmWord2_ProcessAlarms := 16#0000;
    wAlarmWord3_SensorDiagnostics := 16#0000;
END_IF;

(* Evaluate Hardwired Safety Loop (Emergency Trip Active Low) *)
IF NOT bEmergencyTrip THEN
    bCriticalTripLatched := TRUE;
    wAlarmWord1_CriticalTrips := wAlarmWord1_CriticalTrips OR 16#0001; (* Bit 0: Hardware E-Stop Active *)
END_IF;

(* Mo/Si EUV Collector Mirror Thermal & Contamination Over-limit Protection *)
IF rCollectorDegradationPV_pct > 12.0 THEN
    bCriticalTripLatched := TRUE;
    wAlarmWord1_CriticalTrips := wAlarmWord1_CriticalTrips OR 16#0002; (* Bit 1: Collector Reflectance Critical Degradation *)
END_IF;

(* Tin Catch Cup Freeze Protection *)
IF (rCatchCupTempPV_degC < 235.0) AND (iOperationalState >= 40) THEN
    bCriticalTripLatched := TRUE;
    wAlarmWord1_CriticalTrips := wAlarmWord1_CriticalTrips OR 16#0004; (* Bit 2: Catch Cup Freeze Risk Under Flow *)
END_IF;

(* ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* SUB-ROUTINE 2: TRIPLE MODULAR REDUNDANCY (2oo3 TMR) SENSOR VOTING ENGINES                 *)
(* Median Value Selection (MVS) with sensor disparity isolation and graceful failover.      *)
(* ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* --- Engine 2.1: Molten Tin Crucible Temperature Voting --- *)
bTMR_TinTemp_Ch1_Healthy := (ABS(rTinReservoirTempPV_degC_1 - rTinReservoirTempPV_degC_2) <= rTMR_TinTemp_Tolerance_degC)
                            OR (ABS(rTinReservoirTempPV_degC_1 - rTinReservoirTempPV_degC_3) <= rTMR_TinTemp_Tolerance_degC);
bTMR_TinTemp_Ch2_Healthy := (ABS(rTinReservoirTempPV_degC_2 - rTinReservoirTempPV_degC_1) <= rTMR_TinTemp_Tolerance_degC)
                            OR (ABS(rTinReservoirTempPV_degC_2 - rTinReservoirTempPV_degC_3) <= rTMR_TinTemp_Tolerance_degC);
bTMR_TinTemp_Ch3_Healthy := (ABS(rTinReservoirTempPV_degC_3 - rTinReservoirTempPV_degC_1) <= rTMR_TinTemp_Tolerance_degC)
                            OR (ABS(rTinReservoirTempPV_degC_3 - rTinReservoirTempPV_degC_2) <= rTMR_TinTemp_Tolerance_degC);

IF bTMR_TinTemp_Ch1_Healthy AND bTMR_TinTemp_Ch2_Healthy AND bTMR_TinTemp_Ch3_Healthy THEN
    (* All three healthy: Exact Median Value Selection *)
    IF ((rTinReservoirTempPV_degC_1 >= rTinReservoirTempPV_degC_2) AND (rTinReservoirTempPV_degC_1 <= rTinReservoirTempPV_degC_3))
       OR ((rTinReservoirTempPV_degC_1 <= rTinReservoirTempPV_degC_2) AND (rTinReservoirTempPV_degC_1 >= rTinReservoirTempPV_degC_3)) THEN
        rTMR_TinTemp_Voted := rTinReservoirTempPV_degC_1;
    ELSIF ((rTinReservoirTempPV_degC_2 >= rTinReservoirTempPV_degC_1) AND (rTinReservoirTempPV_degC_2 <= rTinReservoirTempPV_degC_3))
       OR ((rTinReservoirTempPV_degC_2 <= rTinReservoirTempPV_degC_1) AND (rTinReservoirTempPV_degC_2 >= rTinReservoirTempPV_degC_3)) THEN
        rTMR_TinTemp_Voted := rTinReservoirTempPV_degC_2;
    ELSE
        rTMR_TinTemp_Voted := rTinReservoirTempPV_degC_3;
    END_IF;
    bTMR_TinTemp_Discrepancy := FALSE;
ELSIF bTMR_TinTemp_Ch1_Healthy AND bTMR_TinTemp_Ch2_Healthy THEN
    rTMR_TinTemp_Voted := (rTinReservoirTempPV_degC_1 + rTinReservoirTempPV_degC_2) * 0.5;
    bTMR_TinTemp_Discrepancy := TRUE;
    wAlarmWord3_SensorDiagnostics := wAlarmWord3_SensorDiagnostics OR 16#0001; (* Tin Temp Ch3 Fault *)
ELSIF bTMR_TinTemp_Ch1_Healthy AND bTMR_TinTemp_Ch3_Healthy THEN
    rTMR_TinTemp_Voted := (rTinReservoirTempPV_degC_1 + rTinReservoirTempPV_degC_3) * 0.5;
    bTMR_TinTemp_Discrepancy := TRUE;
    wAlarmWord3_SensorDiagnostics := wAlarmWord3_SensorDiagnostics OR 16#0002; (* Tin Temp Ch2 Fault *)
ELSIF bTMR_TinTemp_Ch2_Healthy AND bTMR_TinTemp_Ch3_Healthy THEN
    rTMR_TinTemp_Voted := (rTinReservoirTempPV_degC_2 + rTinReservoirTempPV_degC_3) * 0.5;
    bTMR_TinTemp_Discrepancy := TRUE;
    wAlarmWord3_SensorDiagnostics := wAlarmWord3_SensorDiagnostics OR 16#0004; (* Tin Temp Ch1 Fault *)
ELSE
    bCriticalTripLatched := TRUE;
    wAlarmWord1_CriticalTrips := wAlarmWord1_CriticalTrips OR 16#0008; (* Bit 3: Tin Temp TMR Complete Failure *)
END_IF;

(* --- Engine 2.2: Propellant Argon Back-Pressure Voting --- *)
bTMR_ArgonPress_Ch1_Healthy := (ABS(rArgonBackPressurePV_bar_1 - rArgonBackPressurePV_bar_2) <= rTMR_ArgonPress_Tolerance_bar)
                               OR (ABS(rArgonBackPressurePV_bar_1 - rArgonBackPressurePV_bar_3) <= rTMR_ArgonPress_Tolerance_bar);
bTMR_ArgonPress_Ch2_Healthy := (ABS(rArgonBackPressurePV_bar_2 - rArgonBackPressurePV_bar_1) <= rTMR_ArgonPress_Tolerance_bar)
                               OR (ABS(rArgonBackPressurePV_bar_2 - rArgonBackPressurePV_bar_3) <= rTMR_ArgonPress_Tolerance_bar);
bTMR_ArgonPress_Ch3_Healthy := (ABS(rArgonBackPressurePV_bar_3 - rArgonBackPressurePV_bar_1) <= rTMR_ArgonPress_Tolerance_bar)
                               OR (ABS(rArgonBackPressurePV_bar_3 - rArgonBackPressurePV_bar_2) <= rTMR_ArgonPress_Tolerance_bar);

IF bTMR_ArgonPress_Ch1_Healthy AND bTMR_ArgonPress_Ch2_Healthy AND bTMR_ArgonPress_Ch3_Healthy THEN
    IF ((rArgonBackPressurePV_bar_1 >= rArgonBackPressurePV_bar_2) AND (rArgonBackPressurePV_bar_1 <= rArgonBackPressurePV_bar_3))
       OR ((rArgonBackPressurePV_bar_1 <= rArgonBackPressurePV_bar_2) AND (rArgonBackPressurePV_bar_1 >= rArgonBackPressurePV_bar_3)) THEN
        rTMR_ArgonPress_Voted := rArgonBackPressurePV_bar_1;
    ELSIF ((rArgonBackPressurePV_bar_2 >= rArgonBackPressurePV_bar_1) AND (rArgonBackPressurePV_bar_2 <= rArgonBackPressurePV_bar_3))
       OR ((rArgonBackPressurePV_bar_2 <= rArgonBackPressurePV_bar_1) AND (rArgonBackPressurePV_bar_2 >= rArgonBackPressurePV_bar_3)) THEN
        rTMR_ArgonPress_Voted := rArgonBackPressurePV_bar_2;
    ELSE
        rTMR_ArgonPress_Voted := rArgonBackPressurePV_bar_3;
    END_IF;
    bTMR_ArgonPress_Discrepancy := FALSE;
ELSIF bTMR_ArgonPress_Ch1_Healthy AND bTMR_ArgonPress_Ch2_Healthy THEN
    rTMR_ArgonPress_Voted := (rArgonBackPressurePV_bar_1 + rArgonBackPressurePV_bar_2) * 0.5;
    bTMR_ArgonPress_Discrepancy := TRUE;
    wAlarmWord3_SensorDiagnostics := wAlarmWord3_SensorDiagnostics OR 16#0010; (* Argon Ch3 Fault *)
ELSIF bTMR_ArgonPress_Ch1_Healthy AND bTMR_ArgonPress_Ch3_Healthy THEN
    rTMR_ArgonPress_Voted := (rArgonBackPressurePV_bar_1 + rArgonBackPressurePV_bar_3) * 0.5;
    bTMR_ArgonPress_Discrepancy := TRUE;
    wAlarmWord3_SensorDiagnostics := wAlarmWord3_SensorDiagnostics OR 16#0020; (* Argon Ch2 Fault *)
ELSIF bTMR_ArgonPress_Ch2_Healthy AND bTMR_ArgonPress_Ch3_Healthy THEN
    rTMR_ArgonPress_Voted := (rArgonBackPressurePV_bar_2 + rArgonBackPressurePV_bar_3) * 0.5;
    bTMR_ArgonPress_Discrepancy := TRUE;
    wAlarmWord3_SensorDiagnostics := wAlarmWord3_SensorDiagnostics OR 16#0040; (* Argon Ch1 Fault *)
ELSE
    bCriticalTripLatched := TRUE;
    wAlarmWord1_CriticalTrips := wAlarmWord1_CriticalTrips OR 16#0010; (* Bit 4: Argon Press TMR Failure *)
END_IF;

(* --- Engine 2.3: Debris Mitigation Hydrogen Buffer Gas Pressure Voting --- *)
bTMR_H2Press_Ch1_Healthy := (ABS(rH2BufferPressurePV_mbar_1 - rH2BufferPressurePV_mbar_2) <= rTMR_H2Press_Tolerance_mbar)
                            OR (ABS(rH2BufferPressurePV_mbar_1 - rH2BufferPressurePV_mbar_3) <= rTMR_H2Press_Tolerance_mbar);
bTMR_H2Press_Ch2_Healthy := (ABS(rH2BufferPressurePV_mbar_2 - rH2BufferPressurePV_mbar_1) <= rTMR_H2Press_Tolerance_mbar)
                            OR (ABS(rH2BufferPressurePV_mbar_2 - rH2BufferPressurePV_mbar_3) <= rTMR_H2Press_Tolerance_mbar);
bTMR_H2Press_Ch3_Healthy := (ABS(rH2BufferPressurePV_mbar_3 - rH2BufferPressurePV_mbar_1) <= rTMR_H2Press_Tolerance_mbar)
                            OR (ABS(rH2BufferPressurePV_mbar_3 - rH2BufferPressurePV_mbar_2) <= rTMR_H2Press_Tolerance_mbar);

IF bTMR_H2Press_Ch1_Healthy AND bTMR_H2Press_Ch2_Healthy AND bTMR_H2Press_Ch3_Healthy THEN
    IF ((rH2BufferPressurePV_mbar_1 >= rH2BufferPressurePV_mbar_2) AND (rH2BufferPressurePV_mbar_1 <= rH2BufferPressurePV_mbar_3))
       OR ((rH2BufferPressurePV_mbar_1 <= rH2BufferPressurePV_mbar_2) AND (rH2BufferPressurePV_mbar_1 >= rH2BufferPressurePV_mbar_3)) THEN
        rTMR_H2Press_Voted := rH2BufferPressurePV_mbar_1;
    ELSIF ((rH2BufferPressurePV_mbar_2 >= rH2BufferPressurePV_mbar_1) AND (rH2BufferPressurePV_mbar_2 <= rH2BufferPressurePV_mbar_3))
       OR ((rH2BufferPressurePV_mbar_2 <= rH2BufferPressurePV_mbar_1) AND (rH2BufferPressurePV_mbar_2 >= rH2BufferPressurePV_mbar_3)) THEN
        rTMR_H2Press_Voted := rH2BufferPressurePV_mbar_2;
    ELSE
        rTMR_H2Press_Voted := rH2BufferPressurePV_mbar_3;
    END_IF;
    bTMR_H2Press_Discrepancy := FALSE;
ELSIF bTMR_H2Press_Ch1_Healthy AND bTMR_H2Press_Ch2_Healthy THEN
    rTMR_H2Press_Voted := (rH2BufferPressurePV_mbar_1 + rH2BufferPressurePV_mbar_2) * 0.5;
    bTMR_H2Press_Discrepancy := TRUE;
    wAlarmWord3_SensorDiagnostics := wAlarmWord3_SensorDiagnostics OR 16#0100; (* H2 Press Ch3 Fault *)
ELSIF bTMR_H2Press_Ch1_Healthy AND bTMR_H2Press_Ch3_Healthy THEN
    rTMR_H2Press_Voted := (rH2BufferPressurePV_mbar_1 + rH2BufferPressurePV_mbar_3) * 0.5;
    bTMR_H2Press_Discrepancy := TRUE;
    wAlarmWord3_SensorDiagnostics := wAlarmWord3_SensorDiagnostics OR 16#0200; (* H2 Press Ch2 Fault *)
ELSIF bTMR_H2Press_Ch2_Healthy AND bTMR_H2Press_Ch3_Healthy THEN
    rTMR_H2Press_Voted := (rH2BufferPressurePV_mbar_2 + rH2BufferPressurePV_mbar_3) * 0.5;
    bTMR_H2Press_Discrepancy := TRUE;
    wAlarmWord3_SensorDiagnostics := wAlarmWord3_SensorDiagnostics OR 16#0400; (* H2 Press Ch1 Fault *)
ELSE
    bCriticalTripLatched := TRUE;
    wAlarmWord1_CriticalTrips := wAlarmWord1_CriticalTrips OR 16#0020; (* Bit 5: H2 Buffer TMR Complete Failure *)
END_IF;

(* --- Engine 2.4: Catch Cup Siphon Vacuum Transducer Voting --- *)
bTMR_CatchVac_Ch1_Healthy := (ABS(rCatchCupVacuumPV_mbar_1 - rCatchCupVacuumPV_mbar_2) <= rTMR_CatchVac_Tolerance_mbar)
                             OR (ABS(rCatchCupVacuumPV_mbar_1 - rCatchCupVacuumPV_mbar_3) <= rTMR_CatchVac_Tolerance_mbar);
bTMR_CatchVac_Ch2_Healthy := (ABS(rCatchCupVacuumPV_mbar_2 - rCatchCupVacuumPV_mbar_1) <= rTMR_CatchVac_Tolerance_mbar)
                             OR (ABS(rCatchCupVacuumPV_mbar_2 - rCatchCupVacuumPV_mbar_3) <= rTMR_CatchVac_Tolerance_mbar);
bTMR_CatchVac_Ch3_Healthy := (ABS(rCatchCupVacuumPV_mbar_3 - rCatchCupVacuumPV_mbar_1) <= rTMR_CatchVac_Tolerance_mbar)
                             OR (ABS(rCatchCupVacuumPV_mbar_3 - rCatchCupVacuumPV_mbar_2) <= rTMR_CatchVac_Tolerance_mbar);

IF bTMR_CatchVac_Ch1_Healthy AND bTMR_CatchVac_Ch2_Healthy AND bTMR_CatchVac_Ch3_Healthy THEN
    IF ((rCatchCupVacuumPV_mbar_1 >= rCatchCupVacuumPV_mbar_2) AND (rCatchCupVacuumPV_mbar_1 <= rCatchCupVacuumPV_mbar_3))
       OR ((rCatchCupVacuumPV_mbar_1 <= rCatchCupVacuumPV_mbar_2) AND (rCatchCupVacuumPV_mbar_1 >= rCatchCupVacuumPV_mbar_3)) THEN
        rTMR_CatchVac_Voted := rCatchCupVacuumPV_mbar_1;
    ELSIF ((rCatchCupVacuumPV_mbar_2 >= rCatchCupVacuumPV_mbar_1) AND (rCatchCupVacuumPV_mbar_2 <= rCatchCupVacuumPV_mbar_3))
       OR ((rCatchCupVacuumPV_mbar_2 <= rCatchCupVacuumPV_mbar_1) AND (rCatchCupVacuumPV_mbar_2 >= rCatchCupVacuumPV_mbar_3)) THEN
        rTMR_CatchVac_Voted := rCatchCupVacuumPV_mbar_2;
    ELSE
        rTMR_CatchVac_Voted := rCatchCupVacuumPV_mbar_3;
    END_IF;
    bTMR_CatchVac_Discrepancy := FALSE;
ELSIF bTMR_CatchVac_Ch1_Healthy AND bTMR_CatchVac_Ch2_Healthy THEN
    rTMR_CatchVac_Voted := (rCatchCupVacuumPV_mbar_1 + rCatchCupVacuumPV_mbar_2) * 0.5;
    bTMR_CatchVac_Discrepancy := TRUE;
    wAlarmWord3_SensorDiagnostics := wAlarmWord3_SensorDiagnostics OR 16#1000; (* Catch Vac Ch3 Fault *)
ELSIF bTMR_CatchVac_Ch1_Healthy AND bTMR_CatchVac_Ch3_Healthy THEN
    rTMR_CatchVac_Voted := (rCatchCupVacuumPV_mbar_1 + rCatchCupVacuumPV_mbar_3) * 0.5;
    bTMR_CatchVac_Discrepancy := TRUE;
    wAlarmWord3_SensorDiagnostics := wAlarmWord3_SensorDiagnostics OR 16#2000; (* Catch Vac Ch2 Fault *)
ELSIF bTMR_CatchVac_Ch2_Healthy AND bTMR_CatchVac_Ch3_Healthy THEN
    rTMR_CatchVac_Voted := (rCatchCupVacuumPV_mbar_2 + rCatchCupVacuumPV_mbar_3) * 0.5;
    bTMR_CatchVac_Discrepancy := TRUE;
    wAlarmWord3_SensorDiagnostics := wAlarmWord3_SensorDiagnostics OR 16#4000; (* Catch Vac Ch1 Fault *)
ELSE
    bCriticalTripLatched := TRUE;
    wAlarmWord1_CriticalTrips := wAlarmWord1_CriticalTrips OR 16#0040; (* Bit 6: Catch Vac TMR Complete Failure *)
END_IF;

(* ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* SUB-ROUTINE 3: THERMOPHYSICAL PROPERTIES & RAYLEIGH-PLATEAU HYDRODYNAMICS                *)
(* Rigorous evaluations of dynamic viscosity, surface tension, Weber & Ohnesorge numbers.  *)
(* ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* Dynamic temperature-dependent density: rho(T) = 6980 - 0.74 * (T - 231.9) [kg/m^3] *)
rTinDensity_kg_m3 := 6980.0 - 0.74 * (rTMR_TinTemp_Voted - rTIN_MELTING_POINT_DEGC);
IF rTinDensity_kg_m3 < 6500.0 THEN
    rTinDensity_kg_m3 := 6500.0;
ELSIF rTinDensity_kg_m3 > 7200.0 THEN
    rTinDensity_kg_m3 := 7200.0;
END_IF;

(* Dynamic temperature-dependent surface tension: sigma(T) = 0.544 - 0.00007 * (T - 231.9) [N/m] *)
rTinSurfaceTension_N_m := 0.544 - 0.00007 * (rTMR_TinTemp_Voted - rTIN_MELTING_POINT_DEGC);
IF rTinSurfaceTension_N_m < 0.450 THEN
    rTinSurfaceTension_N_m := 0.450;
END_IF;

(* Dynamic viscosity Arrhenius approximation: mu(T) = 0.00185 * (1.0 - 0.0015 * (T - 260.0)) [Pa*s] *)
rTinViscosity_Pa_s := 0.00185 * (1.0 - 0.0015 * (rTMR_TinTemp_Voted - 260.0));
IF rTinViscosity_Pa_s < 0.0012 THEN
    rTinViscosity_Pa_s := 0.0012;
END_IF;

(* Jet exit velocity from Torricelli / Bernoulli with capillary viscous loss: *)
(* v_jet = Cd * sqrt(2.0 * delta_P / rho) where delta_P in Pascals (1 bar = 1.0E5 Pa) *)
rAuxMathVar := (rTMR_ArgonPress_Voted * 1.0E5) - (rTMR_H2Press_Voted * 100.0);
IF rAuxMathVar > 0.0 THEN
    rJetVelocity_mps := rNOZZLE_DISCHARGE_COEFF * SQRT((2.0 * rAuxMathVar) / rTinDensity_kg_m3);
ELSE
    rJetVelocity_mps := 0.0;
END_IF;

(* Rayleigh-Plateau Capillary Instability Optimum Breakup Wavelength: lambda_opt = 4.508 * d_orifice *)
rOptimalWavelength_um := rRAYLEIGH_OPTIMAL_RATIO * rNOZZLE_DIAMETER_NOMINAL_UM;

(* Hydrodynamic Natural Frequency: f_break = v_jet / lambda_opt *)
IF rOptimalWavelength_um > 1.0 THEN
    rTheoreticalBreakupFreq_kHz := (rJetVelocity_mps * 1.0E6) / (rOptimalWavelength_um * 1000.0);
ELSE
    rTheoreticalBreakupFreq_kHz := 50.0;
END_IF;

(* Weber Number: We = rho * v^2 * d / sigma *)
rWeberNumber := (rTinDensity_kg_m3 * rJetVelocity_mps * rJetVelocity_mps * (rNOZZLE_DIAMETER_NOMINAL_UM * 1.0E-6))
                / rTinSurfaceTension_N_m;

(* Ohnesorge Number: Oh = mu / sqrt(rho * sigma * d) *)
rAuxMathVar := SQRT(rTinDensity_kg_m3 * rTinSurfaceTension_N_m * (rNOZZLE_DIAMETER_NOMINAL_UM * 1.0E-6));
IF rAuxMathVar > 1.0E-9 THEN
    rOhnesorgeNumber := rTinViscosity_Pa_s / rAuxMathVar;
ELSE
    rOhnesorgeNumber := 0.015;
END_IF;

(* Reynolds Number: Re = rho * v * d / mu *)
IF rTinViscosity_Pa_s > 1.0E-6 THEN
    rReynoldsNumber := (rTinDensity_kg_m3 * rJetVelocity_mps * (rNOZZLE_DIAMETER_NOMINAL_UM * 1.0E-6)) / rTinViscosity_Pa_s;
ELSE
    rReynoldsNumber := 1500.0;
END_IF;

(* Capillary Jet Continuous Breakup Length: L_break = v_jet * ln(R0/eps) / growth_rate *)
rBreakupDistance_mm := (12.0 * (rNOZZLE_DIAMETER_NOMINAL_UM * 1.0E-3) * SQRT(MAX(1.0, rWeberNumber)));

(* Theoretical Droplet Diameter via Mass Conservation: D_drop = (1.5 * d^2 * lambda)^(1/3) *)
rAuxMathVar := 1.5 * (rNOZZLE_DIAMETER_NOMINAL_UM * rNOZZLE_DIAMETER_NOMINAL_UM) * rOptimalWavelength_um;
rTheoreticalDropletDiameter_um := EXPT(rAuxMathVar, 0.33333333);

(* Total Stream Mass Flow Consumption Rate [mg/s] *)
rDropletMassFlow_mg_s := (rPI * 0.25 * (rNOZZLE_DIAMETER_NOMINAL_UM * 1.0E-6) * (rNOZZLE_DIAMETER_NOMINAL_UM * 1.0E-6)
                         * rJetVelocity_mps * rTinDensity_kg_m3) * 1.0E6;

(* ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* SUB-ROUTINE 4: DUAL-CAMERA STEREO SHADOWGRAPH & KALMAN FILTER STATE ESTIMATION           *)
(* Triangulates 3D position (X, Y, Z) and predicts arrival time at laser irradiation zone.  *)
(* ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
IF bCamA_Valid AND bCamB_Valid THEN
    (* Stereo Sensor Fusion *)
    rFusedDropletX_um := rCamA_DropletX_um;
    rFusedDropletY_um := rCamB_DropletY_um;
    rFusedDropletZ_um := (rCamA_DropletZ_um + rCamB_DropletZ_um) * 0.5;
    rFusedVelocity_mps := (rCamA_Velocity_mps + rCamB_Velocity_mps) * 0.5;
ELSIF bCamA_Valid THEN
    rFusedDropletX_um := rCamA_DropletX_um;
    rFusedDropletZ_um := rCamA_DropletZ_um;
    rFusedVelocity_mps := rCamA_Velocity_mps;
    wAlarmWord3_SensorDiagnostics := wAlarmWord3_SensorDiagnostics OR 16#0008; (* Camera B Strobe Lost *)
ELSIF bCamB_Valid THEN
    rFusedDropletY_um := rCamB_DropletY_um;
    rFusedDropletZ_um := rCamB_DropletZ_um;
    rFusedVelocity_mps := rCamB_Velocity_mps;
    wAlarmWord3_SensorDiagnostics := wAlarmWord3_SensorDiagnostics OR 16#0080; (* Camera A Strobe Lost *)
ELSE
    (* Both Cameras Failed: Free-running Dead Reckoning *)
    rFusedVelocity_mps := rJetVelocity_mps;
    wAlarmWord2_ProcessAlarms := wAlarmWord2_ProcessAlarms OR 16#0001; (* Shadowgraph Stream Blind *)
END_IF;

(* Kalman State Propagation (Predict Step) *)
aKalmanState_Pred[0] := aKalmanState_Est[0] + (aKalmanState_Est[3] * rCYCLE_TIME_SEC * 1.0E6);
aKalmanState_Pred[1] := aKalmanState_Est[1] + (aKalmanState_Est[4] * rCYCLE_TIME_SEC * 1.0E6);
aKalmanState_Pred[2] := aKalmanState_Est[2] + (aKalmanState_Est[5] * rCYCLE_TIME_SEC * 1.0E6);
aKalmanState_Pred[3] := aKalmanState_Est[3];
aKalmanState_Pred[4] := aKalmanState_Est[4];
aKalmanState_Pred[5] := aKalmanState_Est[5];

(* Innovation / Measurement Residual: y = z - H * x_pred *)
aKalmanInnov[0] := rFusedDropletX_um - aKalmanState_Pred[0];
aKalmanInnov[1] := rFusedDropletY_um - aKalmanState_Pred[1];
aKalmanInnov[2] := rFusedVelocity_mps - aKalmanState_Pred[5];

(* Optimal Steady-State Kalman Gain Application *)
aKalmanGain_K[0, 0] := 0.65;    (* X position gain *)
aKalmanGain_K[1, 1] := 0.65;    (* Y position gain *)
aKalmanGain_K[2, 0] := 0.02;
aKalmanGain_K[3, 0] := 0.12;    (* Vx cross-correction from X residual *)
aKalmanGain_K[4, 1] := 0.12;    (* Vy cross-correction from Y residual *)
aKalmanGain_K[5, 2] := 0.58;    (* Vz axial velocity gain *)

(* State Vector Update Step: x_est = x_pred + K * innov *)
aKalmanState_Est[0] := aKalmanState_Pred[0] + (aKalmanGain_K[0, 0] * aKalmanInnov[0]);
aKalmanState_Est[1] := aKalmanState_Pred[1] + (aKalmanGain_K[1, 1] * aKalmanInnov[1]);
aKalmanState_Est[2] := aKalmanState_Pred[2] + (aKalmanGain_K[2, 0] * aKalmanInnov[0]);
aKalmanState_Est[3] := aKalmanState_Pred[3] + (aKalmanGain_K[3, 0] * aKalmanInnov[0]);
aKalmanState_Est[4] := aKalmanState_Pred[4] + (aKalmanGain_K[4, 1] * aKalmanInnov[1]);
aKalmanState_Est[5] := aKalmanState_Pred[5] + (aKalmanGain_K[5, 2] * aKalmanInnov[2]);

(* Predictive Droplet Arrival Timing at Laser Intermediate Focus Plane *)
IF aKalmanState_Est[5] > 20.0 THEN
    rAuxMathVar := (rIRRADIATION_Z_DISTANCE_MM * 1.0E-3) - (aKalmanState_Est[2] * 1.0E-6);
    IF rAuxMathVar > 0.0 THEN
        rPredictedZArrival_ns := (rAuxMathVar / aKalmanState_Est[5]) * 1.0E9;
    ELSE
        rPredictedZArrival_ns := 0.0;
    END_IF;
ELSE
    rPredictedZArrival_ns := 1875000.0; (* Nominal 150mm @ 80m/s = 1.875 ms *)
END_IF;

(* Spatial & Temporal Jitter Statistical Rolling Buffer Evaluation *)
aJitterBuffer_X[iJitterBufferIndex] := aKalmanInnov[0];
aJitterBuffer_Y[iJitterBufferIndex] := aKalmanInnov[1];
aJitterBuffer_Time[iJitterBufferIndex] := (rPredictedZArrival_ns - 1875000.0) * 0.001;
iJitterBufferIndex := iJitterBufferIndex + 1;
IF iJitterBufferIndex >= 50 THEN
    iJitterBufferIndex := 0;
END_IF;

(* Compute 3-Sigma Variances across 50-sample sliding window *)
rSumSquareError_X := 0.0;
rSumSquareError_Y := 0.0;
rSumSquareError_Time := 0.0;
FOR iLoopIndex_i := 0 TO 49 DO
    rSumSquareError_X := rSumSquareError_X + (aJitterBuffer_X[iLoopIndex_i] * aJitterBuffer_X[iLoopIndex_i]);
    rSumSquareError_Y := rSumSquareError_Y + (aJitterBuffer_Y[iLoopIndex_i] * aJitterBuffer_Y[iLoopIndex_i]);
    rSumSquareError_Time := rSumSquareError_Time + (aJitterBuffer_Time[iLoopIndex_i] * aJitterBuffer_Time[iLoopIndex_i]);
END_FOR;
rDropletPositionJitter3Sigma_um := 3.0 * SQRT(rSumSquareError_X * 0.02 + rSumSquareError_Y * 0.02);
rDropletTimingJitter3Sigma_ns := 3.0 * SQRT(rSumSquareError_Time * 0.02);

(* Trajectory Jitter Safety Interlock *)
IF (rDropletPositionJitter3Sigma_um > 2.8) AND (iOperationalState >= 70) THEN
    wAlarmWord2_ProcessAlarms := wAlarmWord2_ProcessAlarms OR 16#0002; (* High Spatial Jitter Warning *)
    IF rDropletPositionJitter3Sigma_um > 4.5 THEN
        bCriticalTripLatched := TRUE;
        wAlarmWord1_CriticalTrips := wAlarmWord1_CriticalTrips OR 16#0080; (* Critical Trajectory Divergence Trip *)
    END_IF;
END_IF;

(* ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* SUB-ROUTINE 5: MODEL PREDICTIVE CONTROL (MPC) QUADRATIC COST OPTIMIZATION                 *)
(* Receding horizon gradient step to minimize position drift, pressure variance & jitter.    *)
(* ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* State Tracking Error Vector Assembly *)
aStateVector_x[0] := aKalmanState_Est[0] - rLaserFocalPointX_um;
aStateVector_x[1] := aKalmanState_Est[1] - rLaserFocalPointY_um;
aStateVector_x[2] := aKalmanState_Est[2] - (rIRRADIATION_Z_DISTANCE_MM * 1000.0);
aStateVector_x[3] := aKalmanState_Est[3];
aStateVector_x[4] := aKalmanState_Est[4];
aStateVector_x[5] := aKalmanState_Est[5] - rDropletVelocitySetpoint_mps;
aStateVector_x[6] := rTMR_ArgonPress_Voted - rArgonPressureSP_bar;
aStateVector_x[7] := rTMR_H2Press_Voted - 1.50;

(* Evaluate Quadratic Cost Function: J = x^T * Q * x + u^T * R * u + du^T * S * du *)
rMPC_Cost_J := 0.0;
FOR iLoopIndex_i := 0 TO 7 DO
    rMPC_Cost_J := rMPC_Cost_J + (aStateVector_x[iLoopIndex_i] * aMPC_Weight_Q[iLoopIndex_i] * aStateVector_x[iLoopIndex_i]);
END_FOR;
FOR iLoopIndex_i := 0 TO 3 DO
    rMPC_Cost_J := rMPC_Cost_J + (aControlVector_u[iLoopIndex_i] * aMPC_Weight_R[iLoopIndex_i] * aControlVector_u[iLoopIndex_i]);
    aDeltaControl_du[iLoopIndex_i] := aControlVector_u[iLoopIndex_i] - aControlVector_u_prev[iLoopIndex_i];
    rMPC_Cost_J := rMPC_Cost_J + (aDeltaControl_du[iLoopIndex_i] * aMPC_Weight_S[iLoopIndex_i] * aDeltaControl_du[iLoopIndex_i]);
END_FOR;

(* Compute Quadratic Cost Gradient wrt Control Vector: grad_u = 2 * (B^T * Q * x + R * u + S * du) *)
FOR iLoopIndex_k := 0 TO 3 DO
    rTempSum := 0.0;
    FOR iLoopIndex_j := 0 TO 7 DO
        rTempSum := rTempSum + (aMatrix_B[iLoopIndex_j, iLoopIndex_k] * aMPC_Weight_Q[iLoopIndex_j] * aStateVector_x[iLoopIndex_j]);
    END_FOR;
    aMPC_Grad[iLoopIndex_k] := rTempSum + (aMPC_Weight_R[iLoopIndex_k] * aControlVector_u[iLoopIndex_k])
                               + (aMPC_Weight_S[iLoopIndex_k] * aDeltaControl_du[iLoopIndex_k]);
END_FOR;

(* Constrained Newton-Raphson Gradient Descent Step: u_k = u_{k-1} - H_inv * grad *)
(* Input 0: Fine Piezo Frequency Tuning Command [kHz] *)
aControlVector_u_prev[0] := aControlVector_u[0];
rAuxMathVar := - (aMPC_Hessian_Inv[0] * aMPC_Grad[0]);
IF rAuxMathVar > rMPC_SlewRateLimit_u0 THEN
    rAuxMathVar := rMPC_SlewRateLimit_u0;
ELSIF rAuxMathVar < -rMPC_SlewRateLimit_u0 THEN
    rAuxMathVar := -rMPC_SlewRateLimit_u0;
END_IF;
aControlVector_u[0] := aControlVector_u[0] + rAuxMathVar;
IF aControlVector_u[0] > 5.0 THEN
    aControlVector_u[0] := 5.0;
ELSIF aControlVector_u[0] < -5.0 THEN
    aControlVector_u[0] := -5.0;
END_IF;

(* Input 1: Dynamic Piezo Drive Voltage [V] *)
aControlVector_u_prev[1] := aControlVector_u[1];
rAuxMathVar := - (aMPC_Hessian_Inv[1] * aMPC_Grad[1]);
IF rAuxMathVar > rMPC_SlewRateLimit_u1 THEN
    rAuxMathVar := rMPC_SlewRateLimit_u1;
ELSIF rAuxMathVar < -rMPC_SlewRateLimit_u1 THEN
    rAuxMathVar := -rMPC_SlewRateLimit_u1;
END_IF;
aControlVector_u[1] := aControlVector_u[1] + rAuxMathVar;
IF aControlVector_u[1] > 95.0 THEN
    aControlVector_u[1] := 95.0;
ELSIF aControlVector_u[1] < 15.0 THEN
    aControlVector_u[1] := 15.0;
END_IF;

(* Input 2: Argon Propellant Back-Pressure Setpoint [bar] *)
aControlVector_u_prev[2] := aControlVector_u[2];
rAuxMathVar := - (aMPC_Hessian_Inv[2] * aMPC_Grad[2]);
IF rAuxMathVar > rMPC_SlewRateLimit_u2 THEN
    rAuxMathVar := rMPC_SlewRateLimit_u2;
ELSIF rAuxMathVar < -rMPC_SlewRateLimit_u2 THEN
    rAuxMathVar := -rMPC_SlewRateLimit_u2;
END_IF;
aControlVector_u[2] := aControlVector_u[2] + rAuxMathVar;
IF aControlVector_u[2] > 135.0 THEN
    aControlVector_u[2] := 135.0;
ELSIF aControlVector_u[2] < 55.0 THEN
    aControlVector_u[2] := 55.0;
END_IF;

    Fast mechanical microphonic detuning caused by cryostat ground vibration and liquid helium pressure oscillations
    is actively countered by a high-voltage piezoelectric crystal tuner driven by an adaptive feedback regulator.
    Cavity quench detection monitors forward/reflected RF power divergence and helium bath pressure derivatives.

 E. CRYOPUMPED ULTRA-HIGH VACUUM (10^-10 mbar) & BEAM LOSS MONITOR (BLM) SIL-3 INTERLOCK:
    The storage ring vacuum chamber must maintain P <= 1.0e-9 mbar (nominal 1.0e-10 mbar) via distributed NEG coating
    and sputter ion pumps. Cold cathode inverted magnetron gauge currents (measured in pA) follow Townsend discharge:
        I_collector = S_gauge * P^n,   where n ~ 1.05 - 1.15, S_gauge ~ 4.5 A/mbar.
    Fast beam loss monitors (Cherenkov quartz fibers and PIN photodiode detectors) detect catastrophic electron loss
    spills. Beam losses > 15 uA sustained for > 50 microseconds or integrated dose > 350 uC trigger the fast beam
    abort kicker and RF crowbar in < 10 microseconds to prevent permanent magnet undulator demagnetization.

 F. TRIPLE MODULAR REDUNDANCY (2oo3) SENSOR VOTING:
    All critical safety channels (BLM loss currents, UHV vacuum ionization currents, and cryostat liquid helium levels)
    utilize 2-out-of-3 majority voting with pairwise Euclidean discrepancy detection, providing fail-operational
    operation on single sensor failure (degraded 1oo2) and fail-safe trip on dual-channel disagreement.
*)
