    tInjectionBlankTimer        : TON;                  (* Injection blanking window duration timer (5.0 ms)            *)
    tQuenchHoldoffTimer         : TON;                  (* Cavity startup quench detection holdoff timer                *)
    tAutoResetDebounceTimer     : TON;                  (* Interlock reset command debounce timer                       *)

    (* ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
    (* FAULT BITFIELD MASKS & STATE REGISTERS                                                                            *)
    (* ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
    bHardwareTripLatched        : BOOL := FALSE;        (* SIL-3 master hardware trip lockout latch                     *)
    bDegradedModeActive         : BOOL := FALSE;        (* Machine operating in degraded slow orbit correction mode     *)
    iFaultSeverityLevel         : INT := 0;             (* 0=Nominal, 1=Warning, 2=Degraded, 3=Critical Trip            *)
END_VAR

(* ================================================================================================================= *)
(* EXECUTION LOGIC - CYCLE START (100 us / 10 kHz DETERMINISTIC HARD REAL-TIME INTERRUPT)                           *)
(* ================================================================================================================= *)

(* ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* 1.0 SIL-3 HARDWIRED EMERGENCY STOP & MACHINE PROTECTION SYSTEM (MPS) EVALUATION                                   *)
(* ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
IF NOT bEmergencyStop THEN
    bSystemReady := FALSE;
    bFastOrbitActive := FALSE;
    bHardwareTripLatched := TRUE;
    bBeamLossTrip := TRUE;
    bFastAbortKickerTrigger := TRUE;        (* Fire storage ring fast extraction kicker to dump beam immediately *)
    bRFCrowbarTrigger := TRUE;              (* Fire high-speed thyristor crowbar to collapse RF field in < 2 us *)
    bFastGateValveCloseDemand := TRUE;      (* Close fast sector gate valves to protect UHV beamline chambers   *)
    rFastCorrectorDemand_A := 0.0;          (* De-energize fast steering dipole corrector coils                 *)
    rPiezoTunerVoltage_V := 0.0;            (* Discharge high-voltage piezoelectric crystal tuner               *)
    rLLRF_AmpSetpoint_kV := 0.0;            (* Set RF cavity voltage demand to zero                             *)

    (* Bit 0: SIL-3 Master Emergency Stop Interlock Loop Open *)
    dwAlarmWord_1 := dwAlarmWord_1 OR 16#0000_0001;
    dwSystemStatusWord := (dwSystemStatusWord AND 16#FFFF_FF00) OR 16#0000_005A; (* Force FSM State 90: TRIP *)
    iState := 90;
    RETURN;
END_IF;

(* ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* 1.1 OPERATOR MANUAL FAULT RESET & ALARM CLEARING LOGIC                                                            *)
(* ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
tAutoResetDebounceTimer(IN := bResetAlarms, PT := T#50MS);
IF tAutoResetDebounceTimer.Q AND (iState = 0 OR iState = 90) THEN
    bHardwareTripLatched := FALSE;
    bBeamLossTrip := FALSE;
    bVacuumInterlockTrip := FALSE;
    bSRF_QuenchDetected := FALSE;
    bFastAbortKickerTrigger := FALSE;
    bRFCrowbarTrigger := FALSE;
    bFastGateValveCloseDemand := FALSE;
    rIntegratedLossDose_uC := 0.0;
    dwAlarmWord_1 := 16#0000_0000;
    dwAlarmWord_2 := 16#0000_0000;
END_IF;

(* ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* 2.0 TRIPLE MODULAR REDUNDANCY (2oo3) SENSOR VOTING ALGORITHMS                                                     *)
(* Evaluates pair-wise Euclidean deviations, detects sensor drift, and flags degraded 1oo2.                          *)
(* ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)

(* --- 2.1 Beam Loss Monitor (BLM) 2oo3 Voting --- *)
bBLM_ChA_Valid := (rBLM_LossCurrent_ChA_uA >= 0.0) AND (rBLM_LossCurrent_ChA_uA <= 100.0);
bBLM_ChB_Valid := (rBLM_LossCurrent_ChB_uA >= 0.0) AND (rBLM_LossCurrent_ChB_uA <= 100.0);
bBLM_ChC_Valid := (rBLM_LossCurrent_ChC_uA >= 0.0) AND (rBLM_LossCurrent_ChC_uA <= 100.0);

IF bBLM_ChA_Valid AND bBLM_ChB_Valid AND bBLM_ChC_Valid THEN
    (* All 3 channels healthy: compute true median *)
    IF (rBLM_LossCurrent_ChA_uA >= rBLM_LossCurrent_ChB_uA AND rBLM_LossCurrent_ChA_uA <= rBLM_LossCurrent_ChC_uA) OR
       (rBLM_LossCurrent_ChA_uA >= rBLM_LossCurrent_ChC_uA AND rBLM_LossCurrent_ChA_uA <= rBLM_LossCurrent_ChB_uA) THEN
        rVoted_BLM_uA := rBLM_LossCurrent_ChA_uA;
    ELSIF (rBLM_LossCurrent_ChB_uA >= rBLM_LossCurrent_ChA_uA AND rBLM_LossCurrent_ChB_uA <= rBLM_LossCurrent_ChC_uA) OR
          (rBLM_LossCurrent_ChB_uA >= rBLM_LossCurrent_ChC_uA AND rBLM_LossCurrent_ChB_uA <= rBLM_LossCurrent_ChA_uA) THEN
        rVoted_BLM_uA := rBLM_LossCurrent_ChB_uA;
    ELSE
        rVoted_BLM_uA := rBLM_LossCurrent_ChC_uA;
    END_IF;
    bBLM_Degraded_1oo2 := FALSE;

    (* Inter-channel drift and discrepancy diagnosis *)
    IF (ABS(rBLM_LossCurrent_ChA_uA - rBLM_LossCurrent_ChB_uA) > c_rBLM_DiscrepancyTol_uA) OR
       (ABS(rBLM_LossCurrent_ChB_uA - rBLM_LossCurrent_ChC_uA) > c_rBLM_DiscrepancyTol_uA) OR
       (ABS(rBLM_LossCurrent_ChC_uA - rBLM_LossCurrent_ChA_uA) > c_rBLM_DiscrepancyTol_uA) THEN
        bBLM_Discrepancy_Warning := TRUE;
        dwAlarmWord_2 := dwAlarmWord_2 OR 16#0000_0001; (* Bit 0: BLM Channel Discrepancy Warning *)
    ELSE
        bBLM_Discrepancy_Warning := FALSE;
    END_IF;
ELSIF bBLM_ChA_Valid AND bBLM_ChB_Valid THEN
    (* Channel C failed: Degraded 1oo2 mode taking maximum for radiation safety *)
    IF rBLM_LossCurrent_ChA_uA >= rBLM_LossCurrent_ChB_uA THEN
        rVoted_BLM_uA := rBLM_LossCurrent_ChA_uA;
    ELSE
        rVoted_BLM_uA := rBLM_LossCurrent_ChB_uA;
    END_IF;
    bBLM_Degraded_1oo2 := TRUE;
    dwAlarmWord_2 := dwAlarmWord_2 OR 16#0000_0002; (* Bit 1: BLM Channel C Hardware Failure *)
ELSIF bBLM_ChB_Valid AND bBLM_ChC_Valid THEN
    (* Channel A failed: Degraded 1oo2 mode *)
    IF rBLM_LossCurrent_ChB_uA >= rBLM_LossCurrent_ChC_uA THEN
        rVoted_BLM_uA := rBLM_LossCurrent_ChB_uA;
    ELSE
        rVoted_BLM_uA := rBLM_LossCurrent_ChC_uA;
    END_IF;
    bBLM_Degraded_1oo2 := TRUE;
    dwAlarmWord_2 := dwAlarmWord_2 OR 16#0000_0004; (* Bit 2: BLM Channel A Hardware Failure *)
ELSIF bBLM_ChA_Valid AND bBLM_ChC_Valid THEN
    (* Channel B failed: Degraded 1oo2 mode *)
    IF rBLM_LossCurrent_ChA_uA >= rBLM_LossCurrent_ChC_uA THEN
        rVoted_BLM_uA := rBLM_LossCurrent_ChA_uA;
    ELSE
        rVoted_BLM_uA := rBLM_LossCurrent_ChC_uA;
    END_IF;
    bBLM_Degraded_1oo2 := TRUE;
    dwAlarmWord_2 := dwAlarmWord_2 OR 16#0000_0008; (* Bit 3: BLM Channel B Hardware Failure *)
ELSE
    (* Dual or triple sensor failure: Total loss of BLM telemetry -> Fail-Safe Trip *)
    bBeamLossTrip := TRUE;
    bFastAbortKickerTrigger := TRUE;
    dwAlarmWord_1 := dwAlarmWord_1 OR 16#0000_0002; (* Bit 1: Catastrophic BLM 2oo3 Sensor Loss *)
    iState := 90;
    RETURN;
END_IF;

(* Overwrite voted BLM with primary input if hardware overrides are unassigned *)
IF (rBLM_LossCurrent_uA > 0.0) AND (rVoted_BLM_uA <= 0.001) THEN
    rVoted_BLM_uA := rBLM_LossCurrent_uA;
END_IF;

(* --- 2.2 Cold Cathode Ultra-High Vacuum (UHV) 2oo3 Voting --- *)
bVac_ChA_Valid := (rVac_GaugeCurrent_ChA_pA >= 0.0) AND (rVac_GaugeCurrent_ChA_pA <= 5000.0);
bVac_ChB_Valid := (rVac_GaugeCurrent_ChB_pA >= 0.0) AND (rVac_GaugeCurrent_ChB_pA <= 5000.0);
bVac_ChC_Valid := (rVac_GaugeCurrent_ChC_pA >= 0.0) AND (rVac_GaugeCurrent_ChC_pA <= 5000.0);

IF bVac_ChA_Valid AND bVac_ChB_Valid AND bVac_ChC_Valid THEN
    (* All 3 healthy: compute median *)
    IF (rVac_GaugeCurrent_ChA_pA >= rVac_GaugeCurrent_ChB_pA AND rVac_GaugeCurrent_ChA_pA <= rVac_GaugeCurrent_ChC_pA) OR
       (rVac_GaugeCurrent_ChA_pA >= rVac_GaugeCurrent_ChC_pA AND rVac_GaugeCurrent_ChA_pA <= rVac_GaugeCurrent_ChB_pA) THEN
        rVoted_Vac_pA := rVac_GaugeCurrent_ChA_pA;
    ELSIF (rVac_GaugeCurrent_ChB_pA >= rVac_GaugeCurrent_ChA_pA AND rVac_GaugeCurrent_ChB_pA <= rVac_GaugeCurrent_ChC_pA) OR
          (rVac_GaugeCurrent_ChB_pA >= rVac_GaugeCurrent_ChC_pA AND rVac_GaugeCurrent_ChB_pA <= rVac_GaugeCurrent_ChA_pA) THEN
        rVoted_Vac_pA := rVac_GaugeCurrent_ChB_pA;
    ELSE
        rVoted_Vac_pA := rVac_GaugeCurrent_ChC_pA;
    END_IF;
    bVac_Degraded_1oo2 := FALSE;

    IF (ABS(rVac_GaugeCurrent_ChA_pA - rVac_GaugeCurrent_ChB_pA) > c_rVac_DiscrepancyTol_pA) OR
       (ABS(rVac_GaugeCurrent_ChB_pA - rVac_GaugeCurrent_ChC_pA) > c_rVac_DiscrepancyTol_pA) OR
       (ABS(rVac_GaugeCurrent_ChC_pA - rVac_GaugeCurrent_ChA_pA) > c_rVac_DiscrepancyTol_pA) THEN
        bVac_Discrepancy_Warning := TRUE;
        dwAlarmWord_2 := dwAlarmWord_2 OR 16#0000_0010; (* Bit 4: UHV Gauge Discrepancy Warning *)
    ELSE
        bVac_Discrepancy_Warning := FALSE;
    END_IF;
ELSIF bVac_ChA_Valid AND bVac_ChB_Valid THEN
    IF rVac_GaugeCurrent_ChA_pA >= rVac_GaugeCurrent_ChB_pA THEN
        rVoted_Vac_pA := rVac_GaugeCurrent_ChA_pA;
    ELSE
        rVoted_Vac_pA := rVac_GaugeCurrent_ChB_pA;
    END_IF;
    bVac_Degraded_1oo2 := TRUE;
    dwAlarmWord_2 := dwAlarmWord_2 OR 16#0000_0020; (* Bit 5: UHV Gauge Channel C Failure *)
ELSIF bVac_ChB_Valid AND bVac_ChC_Valid THEN
    IF rVac_GaugeCurrent_ChB_pA >= rVac_GaugeCurrent_ChC_pA THEN
        rVoted_Vac_pA := rVac_GaugeCurrent_ChB_pA;
    ELSE
        rVoted_Vac_pA := rVac_GaugeCurrent_ChC_pA;
    END_IF;
    bVac_Degraded_1oo2 := TRUE;
    dwAlarmWord_2 := dwAlarmWord_2 OR 16#0000_0040; (* Bit 6: UHV Gauge Channel A Failure *)
ELSIF bVac_ChA_Valid AND bVac_ChC_Valid THEN
    IF rVac_GaugeCurrent_ChA_pA >= rVac_GaugeCurrent_ChC_pA THEN
        rVoted_Vac_pA := rVac_GaugeCurrent_ChA_pA;
    ELSE
        rVoted_Vac_pA := rVac_GaugeCurrent_ChC_pA;
    END_IF;
    bVac_Degraded_1oo2 := TRUE;
    dwAlarmWord_2 := dwAlarmWord_2 OR 16#0000_0080; (* Bit 7: UHV Gauge Channel B Failure *)
ELSE
    bVacuumInterlockTrip := TRUE;
    bFastAbortKickerTrigger := TRUE;
    bFastGateValveCloseDemand := TRUE;
    dwAlarmWord_1 := dwAlarmWord_1 OR 16#0000_0004; (* Bit 2: Catastrophic UHV 2oo3 Sensor Loss *)
    iState := 90;
    RETURN;
END_IF;

IF (rVacuumPressure_pA > 0.0) AND (rVoted_Vac_pA <= 0.001) THEN
    rVoted_Vac_pA := rVacuumPressure_pA;
END_IF;

(* --- 2.3 Cryomodule Liquid Helium Level 2oo3 Voting --- *)
bCryo_ChA_Valid := (rCryo_Level_ChA_pct >= 0.0) AND (rCryo_Level_ChA_pct <= 100.0);
bCryo_ChB_Valid := (rCryo_Level_ChB_pct >= 0.0) AND (rCryo_Level_ChB_pct <= 100.0);
bCryo_ChC_Valid := (rCryo_Level_ChC_pct >= 0.0) AND (rCryo_Level_ChC_pct <= 100.0);

IF bCryo_ChA_Valid AND bCryo_ChB_Valid AND bCryo_ChC_Valid THEN
    IF (rCryo_Level_ChA_pct >= rCryo_Level_ChB_pct AND rCryo_Level_ChA_pct <= rCryo_Level_ChC_pct) OR
       (rCryo_Level_ChA_pct >= rCryo_Level_ChC_pct AND rCryo_Level_ChA_pct <= rCryo_Level_ChB_pct) THEN
        rVoted_Cryo_pct := rCryo_Level_ChA_pct;
    ELSIF (rCryo_Level_ChB_pct >= rCryo_Level_ChA_pct AND rCryo_Level_ChB_pct <= rCryo_Level_ChC_pct) OR
          (rCryo_Level_ChB_pct >= rCryo_Level_ChC_pct AND rCryo_Level_ChB_pct <= rCryo_Level_ChA_pct) THEN
        rVoted_Cryo_pct := rCryo_Level_ChB_pct;
    ELSE
        rVoted_Cryo_pct := rCryo_Level_ChC_pct;
    END_IF;
    bCryo_Degraded_1oo2 := FALSE;

    IF (ABS(rCryo_Level_ChA_pct - rCryo_Level_ChB_pct) > c_rCryo_DiscrepancyTol_pct) OR
       (ABS(rCryo_Level_ChB_pct - rCryo_Level_ChC_pct) > c_rCryo_DiscrepancyTol_pct) OR
       (ABS(rCryo_Level_ChC_pct - rCryo_Level_ChA_pct) > c_rCryo_DiscrepancyTol_pct) THEN
        bCryo_Discrepancy_Warning := TRUE;
        dwAlarmWord_2 := dwAlarmWord_2 OR 16#0000_0100; (* Bit 8: Cryo Level Discrepancy Warning *)
    ELSE
        bCryo_Discrepancy_Warning := FALSE;
    END_IF;
ELSIF bCryo_ChA_Valid AND bCryo_ChB_Valid THEN
    (* In degraded cryo mode, take minimum liquid level for cryostat protection *)
    IF rCryo_Level_ChA_pct <= rCryo_Level_ChB_pct THEN
        rVoted_Cryo_pct := rCryo_Level_ChA_pct;
    ELSE
        rVoted_Cryo_pct := rCryo_Level_ChB_pct;
    END_IF;
    bCryo_Degraded_1oo2 := TRUE;
    dwAlarmWord_2 := dwAlarmWord_2 OR 16#0000_0200; (* Bit 9: Cryo Level Channel C Failure *)
ELSIF bCryo_ChB_Valid AND bCryo_ChC_Valid THEN
    IF rCryo_Level_ChB_pct <= rCryo_Level_ChC_pct THEN
        rVoted_Cryo_pct := rCryo_Level_ChB_pct;
    ELSE
        rVoted_Cryo_pct := rCryo_Level_ChC_pct;
    END_IF;
    bCryo_Degraded_1oo2 := TRUE;
    dwAlarmWord_2 := dwAlarmWord_2 OR 16#0000_0400; (* Bit 10: Cryo Level Channel A Failure *)
ELSIF bCryo_ChA_Valid AND bCryo_ChC_Valid THEN
    IF rCryo_Level_ChA_pct <= rCryo_Level_ChC_pct THEN
        rVoted_Cryo_pct := rCryo_Level_ChA_pct;
    ELSE
        rVoted_Cryo_pct := rCryo_Level_ChC_pct;
    END_IF;
    bCryo_Degraded_1oo2 := TRUE;
    dwAlarmWord_2 := dwAlarmWord_2 OR 16#0000_0800; (* Bit 11: Cryo Level Channel B Failure *)
ELSE
    bSRF_QuenchDetected := TRUE;
    bRFCrowbarTrigger := TRUE;
    dwAlarmWord_1 := dwAlarmWord_1 OR 16#0000_0008; (* Bit 3: Catastrophic Cryo Level 2oo3 Loss *)
    iState := 90;
    RETURN;
END_IF;

IF (rCryoHeliumLevel_pct > 0.0) AND (rVoted_Cryo_pct <= 0.001) THEN
    rVoted_Cryo_pct := rCryoHeliumLevel_pct;
END_IF;

(* ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* 3.0 10 kHz FAST ORBIT FEEDBACK (FOFB) DIGITAL SIGNAL PROCESSING & JITTER ANALYSIS                                 *)
(* ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)

(* --- 3.1 Digital Biquad Notch Filtering for Orbit Perturbation Rejection --- *)
(* Filter Stage 1: 50.0 Hz AC Mains Magnetic Leakage Notch *)
rN1_y1 := c_rN1_b0 * rBPM_Pos_X_nm + c_rN1_b1 * rN1_x1 + c_rN1_b2 * rN1_x2 - c_rN1_a1 * rN1_y1 - c_rN1_a2 * rN1_y2;
rN1_x2 := rN1_x1;
rN1_x1 := rBPM_Pos_X_nm;
rN1_y2 := rN1_y1;

(* Filter Stage 2: 300.0 Hz Power Converter Switching Harmonic Notch *)
rN2_y1 := c_rN2_b0 * rN1_y1 + c_rN2_b1 * rN2_x1 + c_rN2_b2 * rN2_x2 - c_rN2_a1 * rN2_y1 - c_rN2_a2 * rN2_y2;
rN2_x2 := rN2_x1;
rN2_x1 := rN1_y1;
rN2_y2 := rN2_y1;

(* Filter Stage 3: 43.5 Hz Girder Mechanical Vibration Resonance Notch *)
rN3_y1 := c_rN3_b0 * rN2_y1 + c_rN3_b1 * rN3_x1 + c_rN3_b2 * rN3_x2 - c_rN3_a1 * rN3_y1 - c_rN3_a2 * rN3_y2;
rN3_x2 := rN3_x1;
rN3_x1 := rN2_y1;
rN3_y2 := rN3_y1;

(* --- 3.2 Transverse Orbit Root-Mean-Square (RMS) Jitter Accumulator --- *)
(* Implements a 64-sample running circular buffer window (6.4 ms history at 10 kHz) *)
rOrbitSum_X := rOrbitSum_X - arrOrbitBuffer_X[iBufferIndex] + rN3_y1;
rOrbitSumSq_X := rOrbitSumSq_X - (arrOrbitBuffer_X[iBufferIndex] * arrOrbitBuffer_X[iBufferIndex]) + (rN3_y1 * rN3_y1);
arrOrbitBuffer_X[iBufferIndex] := rN3_y1;

iBufferIndex := iBufferIndex + 1;
IF iBufferIndex >= 64 THEN
    iBufferIndex := 0;
END_IF;

rOrbitMean_X := rOrbitSum_X / 64.0;
rOrbitVariance_X := (rOrbitSumSq_X / 64.0) - (rOrbitMean_X * rOrbitMean_X);
IF rOrbitVariance_X > 0.0 THEN
    rBeamOrbitRMS_nm := SQRT(rOrbitVariance_X);
ELSE
    rBeamOrbitRMS_nm := 0.0;
END_IF;

IF rBeamOrbitRMS_nm > c_rOrbitTargetJitter_nm THEN
    dwAlarmWord_2 := dwAlarmWord_2 OR 16#0000_1000; (* Bit 12: Beam Orbit RMS Jitter Exceeds 100 nm Specification *)
END_IF;

(* --- 3.3 SVD Modal Decomposition & Tikhonov Regularized ORM Inversion --- *)
(* Calculate regularized singular value inverse weights: s_i / (s_i^2 + lambda^2) *)
rReg_Gain_1 := c_rSVD_SingularValue_1 / ((c_rSVD_SingularValue_1 * c_rSVD_SingularValue_1) + (c_rSVD_Tikhonov_Lambda * c_rSVD_Tikhonov_Lambda));
rReg_Gain_2 := c_rSVD_SingularValue_2 / ((c_rSVD_SingularValue_2 * c_rSVD_SingularValue_2) + (c_rSVD_Tikhonov_Lambda * c_rSVD_Tikhonov_Lambda));
rReg_Gain_3 := c_rSVD_SingularValue_3 / ((c_rSVD_SingularValue_3 * c_rSVD_SingularValue_3) + (c_rSVD_Tikhonov_Lambda * c_rSVD_Tikhonov_Lambda));
rReg_Gain_4 := c_rSVD_SingularValue_4 / ((c_rSVD_SingularValue_4 * c_rSVD_SingularValue_4) + (c_rSVD_Tikhonov_Lambda * c_rSVD_Tikhonov_Lambda));

(* Project notched orbit measurement onto spatial eigenmodes *)
rModal_Coeff_1 := rN3_y1 * 0.707106;
rModal_Coeff_2 := rN3_y1 * 0.500000;
rModal_Coeff_3 := rN3_y1 * 0.353553;
rModal_Coeff_4 := rN3_y1 * 0.141421;

(* Synthesize regularized modal correction demand *)
rX_State_1 := (rModal_Coeff_1 * rReg_Gain_1 * 452.8) +
              (rModal_Coeff_2 * rReg_Gain_2 * 284.1) +
              (rModal_Coeff_3 * rReg_Gain_3 * 115.6) +
              (rModal_Coeff_4 * rReg_Gain_4 * 22.4);

(* --- 3.4 Vacuum Chamber Eddy Current Lead-Lag Dynamic Compensation --- *)
(* Compensates for the 350 us eddy shielding attenuation of the stainless-steel beam pipe *)
rX_State_2 := (rX_State_1 - rEddyLead_x1) / c_rTs_s; (* Estimated orbit velocity dx/dt [nm/s] *)
rEddyLead_x1 := rX_State_1;

(* ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* 4.0 DISCRETE 4TH-ORDER STATE-SPACE MODEL & MODEL PREDICTIVE CONTROL (MPC) OPTIMIZATION                           *)
(* ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)

(* Current State Vector: *)
(* x[k] = [ rX_State_1 (Orbit Error [nm]), rX_State_2 (Velocity [nm/s]), rX_State_3 (I_corr [A]), rX_State_4 (B_eddy [T]) ] *)
rX_State_3 := rCorrectorCurrent_A;

(* --- 4.1 One-Step Forward State Prediction: x[k+1] = A_d * x[k] + B_d * u[k] --- *)
rX_Pred_1 := (c_rAd_11 * rX_State_1) + (c_rAd_12 * rX_State_2) + (c_rAd_13 * rX_State_3) + (c_rAd_14 * rX_State_4) + (c_rBd_1 * rFastCorrectorDemand_A);
rX_Pred_2 := (c_rAd_21 * rX_State_1) + (c_rAd_22 * rX_State_2) + (c_rAd_23 * rX_State_3) + (c_rAd_24 * rX_State_4) + (c_rBd_2 * rFastCorrectorDemand_A);
rX_Pred_3 := (c_rAd_31 * rX_State_1) + (c_rAd_32 * rX_State_2) + (c_rAd_33 * rX_State_3) + (c_rAd_34 * rX_State_4) + (c_rBd_3 * rFastCorrectorDemand_A);
rX_Pred_4 := (c_rAd_41 * rX_State_1) + (c_rAd_42 * rX_State_2) + (c_rAd_43 * rX_State_3) + (c_rAd_44 * rX_State_4) + (c_rBd_4 * rFastCorrectorDemand_A);

(* Update Eddy Current internal state register *)
rX_State_4 := rX_Pred_4;

(* --- 4.2 Quadratic Cost Gradient Formulation --- *)
(* Objective: minimize J = 1/2 * (y_pred - y_ref)^T * Q * (y_pred - y_ref) + 1/2 * Delta_u^T * R * Delta_u + 1/2 * u^T * S * u *)
(* Gradient w.r.t control increment Delta_u: g = B_d[1] * Q * (rX_Pred_1 - 0.0) + S * rFastCorrectorDemand_A *)
rMPC_Gradient := (c_rBd_1 * c_rQ_Weight * rX_Pred_1) + (c_rS_Weight * rFastCorrectorDemand_A);

(* Approximate Scalar Projected Hessian: H = B_d[1]^2 * Q + R + S *)
rMPC_Hessian := (c_rBd_1 * c_rBd_1 * c_rQ_Weight) + c_rR_Weight + c_rS_Weight;

(* Solve 1D Unconstrained Step via Newton-Raphson: Delta_u* = - g / H *)
IF ABS(rMPC_Hessian) > 1.0E-06 THEN
    rMPC_DeltaU_Opt := - (rMPC_Gradient / rMPC_Hessian);
ELSE
    rMPC_DeltaU_Opt := - (rMPC_Gradient * 0.05); (* Fallback gradient descent *)
END_IF;

(* --- 4.3 Slew Rate Limiting & Actuator Envelope Bounding --- *)
(* Maximum slew per 100 us scan = c_rCorrectorMaxSlew_ApS * c_rTs_s = 5000 A/s * 0.0001 s = 0.50 A *)

    rMPC_DeltaU_Clamped := 0.50;
ELSIF rMPC_DeltaU_Opt < -0.50 THEN
    rMPC_DeltaU_Clamped := -0.50;

    rFastCorrectorDemand_A := rFastCorrectorDemand_A + rMPC_DeltaU_Clamped;

    IF rFastCorrectorDemand_A > c_rCorrectorMaxCurrent_A THEN
        rFastCorrectorDemand_A := c_rCorrectorMaxCurrent_A;
        dwAlarmWord_2 := dwAlarmWord_2 OR 16#0000_2000; (* Bit 13: Fast Corrector Amplifier Positive Saturation *)
    ELSIF rFastCorrectorDemand_A < -c_rCorrectorMaxCurrent_A THEN
        rFastCorrectorDemand_A := -c_rCorrectorMaxCurrent_A;
        dwAlarmWord_2 := dwAlarmWord_2 OR 16#0000_4000; (* Bit 14: Fast Corrector Amplifier Negative Saturation *)
    END_IF;

    (* Closed-loop inactive: decay corrector current gradually to zero *)
    rFastCorrectorDemand_A := rFastCorrectorDemand_A * 0.995;

(* ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* 5.0 SUPERCONDUCTING RF (SRF) CAVITY PHASE-LOCKED FIELD VECTOR CONTROL & MICROPHONICS                               *)
(* ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)

(* --- 5.1 In-Phase (I) and Quadrature (Q) Vector Demodulation --- *)
(* V_cavity = rSRF_CavityVoltage_kV, Phase = rSRF_PhaseError_deg *)
rSRF_I_Measurement := rSRF_CavityVoltage_kV * COS(rSRF_PhaseError_deg * 3.14159265 / 180.0);
rSRF_Q_Measurement := rSRF_CavityVoltage_kV * SIN(rSRF_PhaseError_deg * 3.14159265 / 180.0);

rSRF_I_Setpoint := c_rNominalCavityVoltage_kV;
rSRF_Q_Setpoint := 0.0;

rSRF_I_Error := rSRF_I_Setpoint - rSRF_I_Measurement;
rSRF_Q_Error := rSRF_Q_Setpoint - rSRF_Q_Measurement;

(* --- 5.2 LLRF Vector PI Regulators with Anti-Windup Clamping --- *)
rLLRF_Amp_Integrator := rLLRF_Amp_Integrator + (c_rLLRF_Ki_Amp * rSRF_I_Error * c_rTs_s);
IF rLLRF_Amp_Integrator > 1800.0 THEN
    rLLRF_Amp_Integrator := 1800.0;
ELSIF rLLRF_Amp_Integrator < 0.0 THEN
    rLLRF_Amp_Integrator := 0.0;
END_IF;

rLLRF_AmpSetpoint_kV := (c_rLLRF_Kp_Amp * rSRF_I_Error) + rLLRF_Amp_Integrator;
IF rLLRF_AmpSetpoint_kV > 1850.0 THEN
    rLLRF_AmpSetpoint_kV := 1850.0;
ELSIF rLLRF_AmpSetpoint_kV < 0.0 THEN
    rLLRF_AmpSetpoint_kV := 0.0;
END_IF;

rLLRF_Phase_Integrator := rLLRF_Phase_Integrator + (c_rLLRF_Ki_Phase * rSRF_Q_Error * c_rTs_s);
IF rLLRF_Phase_Integrator > 45.0 THEN
    rLLRF_Phase_Integrator := 45.0;
ELSIF rLLRF_Phase_Integrator < -45.0 THEN
    rLLRF_Phase_Integrator := -45.0;
END_IF;

rLLRF_PhaseSetpoint_deg := (c_rLLRF_Kp_Phase * rSRF_Q_Error) + rLLRF_Phase_Integrator;

(* --- 5.3 Heavy Beam Loading & Robinson Detuning Calculation --- *)
(* Optimal Robinson detuning: Delta_f = - (f0 * R_shunt * I_beam * sin(phi_s)) / (2 * Q_L * V_cavity) *)
IF rSRF_CavityVoltage_kV > 100.0 THEN
    rRobinsonDetuning_Hz := - ((c_rNominalRFFreq_MHz * 1.0E+06) * (c_rCavityShuntImpedance_MOhm * 1.0E+06) *
                                (rBeamCurrent_mA * 1.0E-03) * SIN(c_rSynchPhase_deg * 3.14159265 / 180.0)) /
                                (2.0 * c_rCavityLoaded_QL * (rSRF_CavityVoltage_kV * 1.0E+03));
ELSE
    rRobinsonDetuning_Hz := 0.0;
END_IF;

(* Compute total microphonic and beam loading resonance detuning *)
rCavityDetuning_Hz := (rSRF_PhaseError_deg * (c_rNominalRFFreq_MHz * 1.0E+06) / (2.0 * c_rCavityLoaded_QL)) + rRobinsonDetuning_Hz;

(* --- 5.4 High-Voltage Piezoelectric Crystal Fast Mechanical Tuner --- *)
(* Active microphonics damping against ground vibration and cryo boiling pressure ripples *)
rPiezo_Integrator := rPiezo_Integrator + (c_rPiezo_Ki * rCavityDetuning_Hz * c_rTs_s);
IF rPiezo_Integrator > c_rPiezoMaxVoltage_V THEN
    rPiezo_Integrator := c_rPiezoMaxVoltage_V;
ELSIF rPiezo_Integrator < c_rPiezoMinVoltage_V THEN
    rPiezo_Integrator := c_rPiezoMinVoltage_V;
END_IF;

rPiezo_Command_Raw := (c_rPiezo_Kp * rCavityDetuning_Hz) + rPiezo_Integrator;
IF rPiezo_Command_Raw > c_rPiezoMaxVoltage_V THEN
    rPiezoTunerVoltage_V := c_rPiezoMaxVoltage_V;
    dwAlarmWord_2 := dwAlarmWord_2 OR 16#0000_8000; (* Bit 15: Piezo Tuner Positive Rail Saturation *)
ELSIF rPiezo_Command_Raw < c_rPiezoMinVoltage_V THEN
    rPiezoTunerVoltage_V := c_rPiezoMinVoltage_V;
    dwAlarmWord_2 := dwAlarmWord_2 OR 16#0001_0000; (* Bit 16: Piezo Tuner Negative Rail Saturation *)
ELSE
    rPiezoTunerVoltage_V := rPiezo_Command_Raw;
END_IF;

(* --- 5.5 Superconducting Cavity Thermal Quench Detection Interlock --- *)
(* Stored RF energy in cavity: U = (V_c^2) / (omega_0 * (R/Q)) ~ 0.5 * C * V^2 *)
rStoredCavityEnergy_J := ((rSRF_CavityVoltage_kV * 1.0E+03) * (rSRF_CavityVoltage_kV * 1.0E+03)) /
                          (2.0 * 3.14159265 * (c_rNominalRFFreq_MHz * 1.0E+06) * 120.0);

(* Power balance: P_forward - P_reverse should match cavity dissipation + beam power *)
rExpectedPowerDiss_kW := (rSRF_CavityVoltage_kV * rSRF_CavityVoltage_kV) / (c_rCavityShuntImpedance_MOhm * 1000.0) +
                         (rSRF_CavityVoltage_kV * (rBeamCurrent_mA * 0.001) * COS(c_rSynchPhase_deg * 3.14159265 / 180.0));
rPowerImbalance_kW := ABS(rSRF_ForwardPower_kW - rSRF_ReversePower_kW - rExpectedPowerDiss_kW);

rHeliumPressureDerivative := (rCryo_HePressure_mbar - rPrevHeliumPressure_mbar) / c_rTs_s;

        iState := 90;
        RETURN;
    END_IF;
ELSE
    IF iQuenchDebounceCounter > 0 THEN
        iQuenchDebounceCounter := iQuenchDebounceCounter - 1;
    END_IF;
END_IF;

(* 6.0 CRYOPUMPED ULTRA-HIGH VACUUM & BEAM LOSS MONITOR PROTECTION MATRIX                                            *)
(* ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)

    (* Integrate ionizing radiation dose charge on undulator magnets: Q = int(I_blm dt) *)
    rIntegratedLossDose_uC := rIntegratedLossDose_uC + (rVoted_BLM_uA * c_rTs_s);

    (* Instantaneous peak loss trip *)
    IF rVoted_BLM_uA > c_rBLM_TripCurrent_uA THEN

        bFastAbortKickerTrigger := TRUE;
        dwAlarmWord_1 := dwAlarmWord_1 OR 16#0000_0040; (* Bit 6: Instantaneous Beam Loss Peak Spill Trip *)
        iState := 90;
        RETURN;
    END_IF;

    (* Cumulative radiation dose trip to prevent permanent magnet demagnetization *)
    IF rIntegratedLossDose_uC > c_rBLM_MaxIntegratedDose_uC THEN

        iState := 90;

END_IF;

(* --- 6.3 Cryomodule Liquid Helium Boil-Off Rate Estimator --- *)
(* Boil-off rate: derivative of liquid level multiplied by cryostat bath geometry factor *)
rCryoBoilOffRate_Lph := ABS((100.0 - rVoted_Cryo_pct) * 2.45);

    bSRF_QuenchDetected := TRUE;
    bRFCrowbarTrigger := TRUE;

(* ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* 7.0 MULTI-STAGE FINITE STATE MACHINE (FSM) CONTROL MACHINE                                                        *)

        bSystemReady := FALSE;

        IF (rCalculatedVacuum_mbar < 5.0E-09) AND (rVoted_Cryo_pct >= 80.0) AND (rCryo_HePressure_mbar <= 25.0) THEN

        END_IF;

    90: (* --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)

        (* --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)

        bFastOrbitActive := FALSE;

            bRFCrowbarTrigger := FALSE;
            bFastGateValveCloseDemand := FALSE;
            iState := 0; (* Transition to Cold Standby *)

    rChokeSlewRate_mms              : REAL := 0.0;     (* Instantaneous choke motion velocity [mm/s] *)
    rPrevChokeCmd_mm                : REAL := 0.0;     (* Previous cycle choke command for slew rate limiting *)

    (* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
       3. MICRO-SEISMIC SLIP ACOUSTIC EMISSION RATE QUENCHING FILTER & DAMPING
       --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
    rAERawPrev_dB                   : REAL := 0.0;
    rAEFiltered_dB                  : REAL := 0.0;     (* 2nd-order low-pass filtered acoustic emission energy *)
    rAEFilterVel_dB                 : REAL := 0.0;
    rMicroSeismicRatePrev_epm       : REAL := 0.0;
    rMicroSeismicRateFiltered_epm   : REAL := 0.0;     (* Filtered event frequency [events/min] *)
    rEventRateDerivative_epm_s      : REAL := 0.0;     (* Acceleration of seismic event frequency *)
    rSeismicQuenchOffset_mm         : REAL := 0.0;     (* Negative feedback stroke trim for seismic suppression *)
    rSeismicStressIndex             : REAL := 0.0;     (* Dimensionless reservoir geomechanical instability index *)
    tSeismicQuenchDwellTimer        : TON;             (* Minimum quench duration hold timer *)
    bSeismicAlarmActive             : BOOL := FALSE;
    bSeismicTripLatch               : BOOL := FALSE;

    (* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
       4. SUPERCRITICAL THERMODYNAMICS & HIGH-ENTHALPY FLASH CALCULATOR
       --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
    rReducedDensity_delta           : REAL := 1.0;
    rReducedTemp_tau                : REAL := 1.0;
    rSatLiquidEnthalpy_kJkg         : REAL := 1050.0;  (* Saturated brine enthalpy at flash pressure [kJ/kg] *)
    rSatVaporEnthalpy_kJkg          : REAL := 2800.0;  (* Saturated steam enthalpy at flash pressure [kJ/kg] *)
    rFlashVaporQuality_x            : REAL := 0.35;    (* Dry steam mass fraction *)
    rCalculatedSteamFlow_kgs        : REAL := 0.0;     (* Generated steam mass flow [kg/s] *)
    rBrineDrainFlow_kgs             : REAL := 0.0;     (* Concentrated brine discharge flow [kg/s] *)

    (* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
       5. STATE-SPACE MODEL PREDICTIVE CONTROL (MPC) KERNEL MATRICES
       Plant Dimensions: 5 States (x), 3 Inputs (u), 5 Outputs (y)
       --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
    aStateVector                    : ARRAY[1..5] OF REAL; (* x = [DeltaP_dh, Deltax_gap, x_ae, DeltaP_fl, DeltaN] *)
    aReferenceVector                : ARRAY[1..5] OF REAL; (* Target reference setpoint trajectory *)
    aStateError                     : ARRAY[1..5] OF REAL; (* Error e(k) = x(k) - r(k) *)
    aControlInputVector             : ARRAY[1..3] OF REAL; (* u = [u_choke, u_bypass, u_gov] *)
    aDeltaControlInput              : ARRAY[1..3] OF REAL; (* Delta u(k) = u(k) - u(k-1) *)
    aPrevControlInput               : ARRAY[1..3] OF REAL; (* u(k-1) *)

    (* Discrete System Transition Matrix A_d (5x5) for Ts = 100 ms *)
    aMatrix_A : ARRAY[1..5, 1..5] OF REAL := [
        [0.9420, -0.1250,  0.0150,  0.0480,  0.0000],   (* Row 1: Delta P_dh dynamics *)
        [0.0025,  0.9650,  0.0000,  0.0000,  0.0000],   (* Row 2: Delta x_gap thermal clearance *)
        [0.1850,  0.0420,  0.8850,  0.0000,  0.0000],   (* Row 3: Acoustic emission index x_ae *)
        [0.0820,  0.0000,  0.0000,  0.9120, -0.0650],   (* Row 4: Delta P_flash dynamics *)
        [0.0000,  0.0000,  0.0000,  0.1450,  0.9380]    (* Row 5: Turbine shaft speed Delta N *)
    ];

    (* Discrete Control Input Matrix B_d (5x3) *)
    aMatrix_B : ARRAY[1..5, 1..3] OF REAL := [
        [ 0.3850,  0.0000,  0.0000],                    (* Choke stroke impacts downhole pressure *)
        [-0.0450,  0.0000,  0.0000],                    (* Choke movement alters flow cooling on gap *)
        [ 0.2200,  0.0000,  0.0000],                    (* Choke opening increases fault slip stress *)
        [ 0.1500, -0.2850, -0.3150],                    (* Inflow from well, bypass dump, governor draw *)
        [ 0.0000,  0.0000,  0.4200]                     (* Governor admission accelerates turbine shaft *)
    ];

    (* MPC State Weighting Matrix Q (5x5 Diagonal) *)
    aWeight_Q : ARRAY[1..5] OF REAL := [0.850, 1.450, 2.200, 1.100, 1.800];

    (* MPC Actuator Slew Weighting Matrix R (3x3 Diagonal) *)
    aWeight_R : ARRAY[1..3] OF REAL := [0.450, 0.250, 0.300];

    (* MPC Internal Optimizer State Vectors *)
    aPredictedState                 : ARRAY[1..5] OF REAL;
    aMpcGradient                    : ARRAY[1..3] OF REAL;
    aOptimizedInput                 : ARRAY[1..3] OF REAL;
    iMpcIter                        : INT := 0;

    (* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
       6. HIGH-ENTHALPY STEAM TURBINE GOVERNING & GRID SYNCHRONIZATION
       --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
    rSpeedError_rpm                 : REAL := 0.0;
    rSpeedIntegral_rpm              : REAL := 0.0;
    rSpeedDerivative_rpms           : REAL := 0.0;
    rPrevSpeed_rpm                  : REAL := 0.0;
    rGovernorPidOutput_pct          : REAL := 0.0;
    rDroopCompensation_pct          : REAL := 0.0;
    rFreqDiff_Hz                    : REAL := 0.0;
    rVoltDiff_pct                   : REAL := 0.0;
    rPhaseDiff_deg                  : REAL := 0.0;
    bSynchroWindowHealthy           : BOOL := FALSE;
    tSynchroDwellTimer              : TON;
    tTurbineWarmupTimer             : TON;
    tGridBreakerCloseTimer          : TON;

    (* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
       7. SEQUENTIAL STATE MACHINE INTERNAL REGISTERS & PROCESS TIMERS
       --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
    iState                          : INT  := 0;
    iPreviousState                  : INT  := 0;
    tStateWatchdogTimer             : TON;
    tStateStepTimer                 : TON;
    tPressureStabilizeTimer         : TON;
    tThermalExpansionCalibTimer     : TON;
    tQuenchRecoveryTimer            : TON;
    tDepressurizeTimer              : TON;
    rRampTargetChoke_mm             : REAL := 0.0;
    rCurrentChokeRampRate_mms       : REAL := 0.05;
    rRampTargetFlashBypass_pct      : REAL := 100.0;
    rRampTargetGov_pct              : REAL := 0.0;

    (* Iteration & Matrix Arithmetic Index Variables *)
    i                               : INT  := 1;
    j                               : INT  := 1;
    k_idx                           : INT  := 1;

    (* Physical, Material & Metallurgical Constants *)
    c_rAlphaCeramic_perK            : REAL := 3.2E-6;   (* Si3N4 Silicon Nitride ceramic linear CTE [1/K] *)
    c_rAlphaStem_perK               : REAL := 13.8E-6;  (* Inconel 718 actuator drive spindle CTE [1/K] *)
    c_rAlphaCage_perK               : REAL := 12.8E-6;  (* Hastelloy C-276 containment cage CTE [1/K] *)
    c_rL0_Stem_mm                   : REAL := 2400.0;   (* Nominal spindle stem length at reference temp [mm] *)
    c_rL0_Cage_mm                   : REAL := 2350.0;   (* Nominal outer structural cage length [mm] *)
    c_rL0_Ceramic_mm                : REAL := 250.0;    (* Nominal ceramic needle & seat assembly length [mm] *)
    c_rRefTemp_degC                 : REAL := 20.0;     (* Ambient reference calibration temperature [deg C] *)
    c_rMaxChokeStroke_mm            : REAL := 100.0;    (* Full physical travel of downhole choke actuator [mm] *)
    c_rMinChokeStroke_mm            : REAL := 0.0;      (* Fully seated choke position [mm] *)
    c_rCycleDt_s                    : REAL := 0.100;    (* Discrete PLC cyclic task execution interval (100 ms) [s] *)
    c_rTMR_MaxPresDev_bar           : REAL := 8.5;      (* Permissible inter-channel downhole pressure drift [bar] *)
    c_rTMR_MaxTempDev_degC          : REAL := 15.0;     (* Permissible inter-channel downhole temperature drift [deg C] *)
    c_rCritMaxPres_bar              : REAL := 340.0;    (* SIL-3 high-pressure casing structural safety trip [bar] *)
    c_rCritMaxTemp_degC             : REAL := 480.0;    (* SIL-3 high-temperature downhole metallurgical trip [deg C] *)
    c_rCritMaxAE_dB                 : REAL := 75.0;     (* Catastrophic fault slip acoustic emission trip [dB] *)
    c_rCritTurbineOverspeed_rpm     : REAL := 3960.0;   (* 110% turbine mechanical overspeed emergency trip [rpm] *)
    c_rMaxChokeSlew_mms             : REAL := 2.50;     (* Anti-water hammer choke velocity ceiling [mm/s] *)
    c_rMaxGovernorSlew_pcts         : REAL := 15.0;     (* Turbine governor electro-hydraulic valve max rate [%/s] *)
    c_rGasConstant_kJkgK            : REAL := 0.461526; (* Specific gas constant for pure steam H2O [kJ/(kg*K)] *)
    c_rCriticalTemp_degC            : REAL := 373.946;  (* Thermodynamic critical point temperature of H2O [deg C] *)
    c_rCriticalPres_bar             : REAL := 220.64;   (* Thermodynamic critical point pressure of H2O [bar] *)
END_VAR

(*
========================================================================================================================
  CYCLIC LOGIC EXECUTION ARCHITECTURE (SAMPLE PERIOD Ts = 100 ms)
========================================================================================================================
*)

(* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
   LAYER 1: SIL-3 HARDWIRED SAFETY INTERLOCKS & IMMEDIATE TRIP HIERARCHY
   --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
IF NOT bEStopOk THEN
    (* Immediate deterministic de-energization and safe-state commanding *)
    rCmdChokePosition_mm        := 0.0;   (* Close downhole ceramic choke immediately *)
    rCmdSurfaceFlashBypass_pct  := 100.0; (* Full open surface bypass to dissipate steam pressure *)
    rCmdTurbineGovernor_pct     := 0.0;   (* Trip turbine admission governor valve instantly *)
    rCmdEmergencyDump_pct       := 100.0; (* Open emergency atmospheric quench desuperheater *)
    rCmdBrineReinjection_pct    := 100.0; (* Divert full brine discharge to reinjection well *)
    bEmergencyDumpActive        := TRUE;
    bTurbineSynchronized        := FALSE;
    bSystemReady                := FALSE;
    wFaultWord.0                := TRUE;  (* Bit 0: Hardware E-Stop Tripped *)
    wSystemStatusWord           := 16#F001;
    iState                      := 999;   (* Jump immediately to Failsafe Emergency Depressurization *)
    iActiveState                := 999;
    RETURN;
END_IF;

(* Critical Turbine Overspeed Hardware Protection (110% = 3960 rpm) *)
IF (rTurbineSpeed_rpm >= c_rCritTurbineOverspeed_rpm) OR bTurbineTripInterlock THEN
    rCmdTurbineGovernor_pct     := 0.0;   (* Immediate mechanical trip *)
    rCmdSurfaceFlashBypass_pct  := 100.0; (* Fast-acting bypass dump accepts entire steam flow *)
    bTurbineSynchronized        := FALSE;
    wFaultWord.1                := TRUE;  (* Bit 1: Turbine Overspeed / Protection Trip *)
    IF iState = 80 THEN
        iState := 60; (* Revert to Surface Flash Equilibration / Island Mode *)
    END_IF;
END_IF;

(* Critical Downhole Overpressure Interlock (P > 340 bar) *)
IF (rWellheadPress_bar > c_rCritMaxPres_bar) OR
   (bPresA_Valid AND (rDownholePressA_bar > c_rCritMaxPres_bar)) OR
   (bPresB_Valid AND (rDownholePressB_bar > c_rCritMaxPres_bar)) OR
   (bPresC_Valid AND (rDownholePressC_bar > c_rCritMaxPres_bar)) THEN
    rCmdChokePosition_mm        := 0.0;
    rCmdSurfaceFlashBypass_pct  := 100.0;
    rCmdEmergencyDump_pct       := 100.0;
    bEmergencyDumpActive        := TRUE;
    wFaultWord.2                := TRUE;  (* Bit 2: Critical Overpressure Trip *)
    iState                      := 999;
END_IF;

(* Critical Downhole Over-Temperature Interlock (T > 480 deg C) *)
IF (bTempA_Valid AND (rDownholeTempA_degC > c_rCritMaxTemp_degC)) OR
   (bTempB_Valid AND (rDownholeTempB_degC > c_rCritMaxTemp_degC)) OR
   (bTempC_Valid AND (rDownholeTempC_degC > c_rCritMaxTemp_degC)) THEN
    wFaultWord.3                := TRUE;  (* Bit 3: Critical Over-Temperature Trip *)
    iState                      := 999;
END_IF;

(* Catastrophic Fault Slip Acoustic Emission Shock Burst (AE > 75 dB) *)
IF (rAcousticEmissionLevel_dB > c_rCritMaxAE_dB) THEN
    bSeismicTripLatch           := TRUE;
    wFaultWord.4                := TRUE;  (* Bit 4: Unstable Fault Slip Trip *)
    iState                      := 999;
END_IF;

(* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
   LAYER 2: TRIPLE MODULAR REDUNDANCY (2oo3 TMR) SENSOR VOTING ENGINES
   --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* --- Subsystem 2.1: Downhole Pressure Transducers (2oo3 Voting) --- *)
(* Sensor Physical Plausibility Range Verification (0.0 .. 400.0 bar) *)
bPresA_Valid := (rDownholePressA_bar >= 0.0) AND (rDownholePressA_bar <= 400.0);
bPresB_Valid := (rDownholePressB_bar >= 0.0) AND (rDownholePressB_bar <= 400.0);
bPresC_Valid := (rDownholePressC_bar >= 0.0) AND (rDownholePressC_bar <= 400.0);

rDiffPres_AB := ABS(rDownholePressA_bar - rDownholePressB_bar);
rDiffPres_BC := ABS(rDownholePressB_bar - rDownholePressC_bar);
rDiffPres_CA := ABS(rDownholePressC_bar - rDownholePressA_bar);

IF bPresA_Valid AND bPresB_Valid AND bPresC_Valid THEN
    IF (rDiffPres_AB <= c_rTMR_MaxPresDev_bar) AND (rDiffPres_BC <= c_rTMR_MaxPresDev_bar) AND (rDiffPres_CA <= c_rTMR_MaxPresDev_bar) THEN
        (* Case 2.1.1: Complete 3-Channel Consensus -> Classic Median Value Voting *)
        rVotedDownholePress_bar := rDownholePressA_bar + rDownholePressB_bar + rDownholePressC_bar
                                   - MIN(rDownholePressA_bar, MIN(rDownholePressB_bar, rDownholePressC_bar))
                                   - MAX(rDownholePressA_bar, MAX(rDownholePressB_bar, rDownholePressC_bar));
        iHealthyPresCount       := 3;
        wDegradedModeWord.0     := FALSE; (* Channel A Healthy *)
        wDegradedModeWord.1     := FALSE; (* Channel B Healthy *)
        wDegradedModeWord.2     := FALSE; (* Channel C Healthy *)
        wFaultWord.5            := FALSE; (* No Pressure TMR Fault *)
    ELSIF (rDiffPres_BC <= c_rTMR_MaxPresDev_bar) AND (rDiffPres_AB > c_rTMR_MaxPresDev_bar) THEN
        (* Case 2.1.2: Channel A Drifted -> Quarantine Channel A, Degrade to 1oo2 of (B, C) *)
        rVotedDownholePress_bar := (rDownholePressB_bar + rDownholePressC_bar) * 0.5;
        iHealthyPresCount       := 2;
        wDegradedModeWord.0     := TRUE;  (* Quarantine Ch A *)
        wFaultWord.5            := TRUE;  (* Pressure TMR Degraded Alarm *)
    ELSIF (rDiffPres_CA <= c_rTMR_MaxPresDev_bar) AND (rDiffPres_AB > c_rTMR_MaxPresDev_bar) THEN
        (* Case 2.1.3: Channel B Drifted -> Quarantine Channel B, Degrade to 1oo2 of (A, C) *)
        rVotedDownholePress_bar := (rDownholePressA_bar + rDownholePressC_bar) * 0.5;
        iHealthyPresCount       := 2;
        wDegradedModeWord.1     := TRUE;  (* Quarantine Ch B *)
        wFaultWord.5            := TRUE;
    ELSIF (rDiffPres_AB <= c_rTMR_MaxPresDev_bar) AND (rDiffPres_BC > c_rTMR_MaxPresDev_bar) THEN
        (* Case 2.1.4: Channel C Drifted -> Quarantine Channel C, Degrade to 1oo2 of (A, B) *)
        rVotedDownholePress_bar := (rDownholePressA_bar + rDownholePressB_bar) * 0.5;
        iHealthyPresCount       := 2;
        wDegradedModeWord.2     := TRUE;  (* Quarantine Ch C *)
        wFaultWord.5            := TRUE;
    ELSE
        (* Case 2.1.5: Total Loss of Pressure Consensus -> Failsafe to Wellhead Pressure + Hydrostatic Gradient *)
        rVotedDownholePress_bar := rWellheadPress_bar + 185.0; (* Hydrostatic head approx for 4,800 m supercritical column *)
        iHealthyPresCount       := 0;
        wFaultWord.5            := TRUE;
        wFaultWord.6            := TRUE;  (* Total Downhole Sensor Bank Discrepancy *)
    END_IF;
ELSIF bPresB_Valid AND bPresC_Valid THEN
    rVotedDownholePress_bar := (rDownholePressB_bar + rDownholePressC_bar) * 0.5;
    iHealthyPresCount       := 2;
    wDegradedModeWord.0     := TRUE;
    wFaultWord.5            := TRUE;
ELSIF bPresA_Valid AND bPresC_Valid THEN
    rVotedDownholePress_bar := (rDownholePressA_bar + rDownholePressC_bar) * 0.5;
    iHealthyPresCount       := 2;
    wDegradedModeWord.1     := TRUE;
    wFaultWord.5            := TRUE;
ELSIF bPresA_Valid AND bPresB_Valid THEN
    rVotedDownholePress_bar := (rDownholePressA_bar + rDownholePressB_bar) * 0.5;
    iHealthyPresCount       := 2;
    wDegradedModeWord.2     := TRUE;
    wFaultWord.5            := TRUE;
ELSE
    (* Complete sensor failure *)
    rVotedDownholePress_bar := rWellheadPress_bar + 185.0;
    iHealthyPresCount       := 0;
    wFaultWord.6            := TRUE;
    iState                  := 999;
END_IF;

(* --- Subsystem 2.2: Downhole Temperature Thermocouples (2oo3 Voting) --- *)
bTempA_Valid := (rDownholeTempA_degC >= 0.0) AND (rDownholeTempA_degC <= 550.0);
bTempB_Valid := (rDownholeTempB_degC >= 0.0) AND (rDownholeTempB_degC <= 550.0);
bTempC_Valid := (rDownholeTempC_degC >= 0.0) AND (rDownholeTempC_degC <= 550.0);

rDiffTemp_AB := ABS(rDownholeTempA_degC - rDownholeTempB_degC);
rDiffTemp_BC := ABS(rDownholeTempB_degC - rDownholeTempC_degC);
rDiffTemp_CA := ABS(rDownholeTempC_degC - rDownholeTempA_degC);

IF bTempA_Valid AND bTempB_Valid AND bTempC_Valid THEN
    IF (rDiffTemp_AB <= c_rTMR_MaxTempDev_degC) AND (rDiffTemp_BC <= c_rTMR_MaxTempDev_degC) AND (rDiffTemp_CA <= c_rTMR_MaxTempDev_degC) THEN
        rVotedDownholeTemp_degC := rDownholeTempA_degC + rDownholeTempB_degC + rDownholeTempC_degC
                                   - MIN(rDownholeTempA_degC, MIN(rDownholeTempB_degC, rDownholeTempC_degC))
                                   - MAX(rDownholeTempA_degC, MAX(rDownholeTempB_degC, rDownholeTempC_degC));
        iHealthyTempCount       := 3;
        wDegradedModeWord.3     := FALSE;
        wDegradedModeWord.4     := FALSE;
        wDegradedModeWord.5     := FALSE;
        wFaultWord.7            := FALSE;
    ELSIF (rDiffTemp_BC <= c_rTMR_MaxTempDev_degC) AND (rDiffTemp_AB > c_rTMR_MaxTempDev_degC) THEN
        rVotedDownholeTemp_degC := (rDownholeTempB_degC + rDownholeTempC_degC) * 0.5;
        iHealthyTempCount       := 2;
        wDegradedModeWord.3     := TRUE;  (* Quarantine Temp Ch A *)
        wFaultWord.7            := TRUE;
    ELSIF (rDiffTemp_CA <= c_rTMR_MaxTempDev_degC) AND (rDiffTemp_AB > c_rTMR_MaxTempDev_degC) THEN
        rVotedDownholeTemp_degC := (rDownholeTempA_degC + rDownholeTempC_degC) * 0.5;
        iHealthyTempCount       := 2;
        wDegradedModeWord.4     := TRUE;  (* Quarantine Temp Ch B *)
        wFaultWord.7            := TRUE;
    ELSIF (rDiffTemp_AB <= c_rTMR_MaxTempDev_degC) AND (rDiffTemp_BC > c_rTMR_MaxTempDev_degC) THEN
        rVotedDownholeTemp_degC := (rDownholeTempA_degC + rDownholeTempB_degC) * 0.5;
        iHealthyTempCount       := 2;
        wDegradedModeWord.5     := TRUE;  (* Quarantine Temp Ch C *)
        wFaultWord.7            := TRUE;
    ELSE
        rVotedDownholeTemp_degC := (rDownholeTempA_degC + rDownholeTempB_degC + rDownholeTempC_degC) / 3.0;
        iHealthyTempCount       := 0;
        wFaultWord.7            := TRUE;
        wFaultWord.8            := TRUE;  (* Total Downhole Temperature Consensus Lost *)
    END_IF;
ELSIF bTempB_Valid AND bTempC_Valid THEN
    rVotedDownholeTemp_degC := (rDownholeTempB_degC + rDownholeTempC_degC) * 0.5;
    iHealthyTempCount       := 2;
    wDegradedModeWord.3     := TRUE;
    wFaultWord.7            := TRUE;
ELSIF bTempA_Valid AND bTempC_Valid THEN
    rVotedDownholeTemp_degC := (rDownholeTempA_degC + rDownholeTempC_degC) * 0.5;
    iHealthyTempCount       := 2;
    wDegradedModeWord.4     := TRUE;
    wFaultWord.7            := TRUE;
ELSIF bTempA_Valid AND bTempB_Valid THEN
    rVotedDownholeTemp_degC := (rDownholeTempA_degC + rDownholeTempB_degC) * 0.5;
    iHealthyTempCount       := 2;
    wDegradedModeWord.5     := TRUE;
    wFaultWord.7            := TRUE;
ELSE
    rVotedDownholeTemp_degC := 450.0; (* Safe fallback assumption *)
    iHealthyTempCount       := 0;
    wFaultWord.8            := TRUE;
    iState                  := 999;
END_IF;

bDegradedTMRActive := (iHealthyPresCount < 3) OR (iHealthyTempCount < 3);

(* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
   LAYER 3: DYNAMIC CERAMIC CHOKE ACTUATOR THERMAL EXPANSION NULLING KINETICS
   --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* Discrete 3-Node Thermal Capacitance & Conduction ODE Integration (Euler Forward, dt = 0.1s) *)
(* Node 1: Si3N4 Ceramic Trim exposed directly to supercritical fluid convective heat transfer *)
rTempNodeCeramic_degC := rTempNodeCeramic_degC + (c_rCycleDt_s * 0.1850 * (rVotedDownholeTemp_degC - rTempNodeCeramic_degC))
                                               - (c_rCycleDt_s * 0.0420 * (rTempNodeCeramic_degC - rTempNodeStem_degC));

(* Node 2: Inconel 718 Drive Spindle Stem heated by ceramic trim and cooled by casing conduction *)
rTempNodeStem_degC    := rTempNodeStem_degC    + (c_rCycleDt_s * 0.0420 * (rTempNodeCeramic_degC - rTempNodeStem_degC))
                                               - (c_rCycleDt_s * 0.0180 * (rTempNodeStem_degC - rTempNodeCage_degC));

(* Node 3: Hastelloy C-276 Outer Structural Cage immersed in wellbore annulus fluid *)
rTempNodeCage_degC    := rTempNodeCage_degC    + (c_rCycleDt_s * 0.1250 * (rVotedDownholeTemp_degC - rTempNodeCage_degC))
                                               - (c_rCycleDt_s * 0.0220 * (rTempNodeCage_degC - (rVotedDownholeTemp_degC * 0.88)));

(* Compute Component Thermal Elongations: Delta L = L0 * alpha * Delta T [mm] *)
rStemElongation_mm    := c_rL0_Stem_mm    * c_rAlphaStem_perK    * (rTempNodeStem_degC    - c_rRefTemp_degC);
rCageElongation_mm    := c_rL0_Cage_mm    * c_rAlphaCage_perK    * (rTempNodeCage_degC    - c_rRefTemp_degC);
rCeramicElongation_mm := c_rL0_Ceramic_mm * c_rAlphaCeramic_perK * (rTempNodeCeramic_degC - c_rRefTemp_degC);

(* Net Differential Axial Expansion Mismatch: Stem expands forward, Cage expands body backward, Ceramic trims tip *)
rNetDifferentialExpansion_mm := rStemElongation_mm - rCageElongation_mm - rCeramicElongation_mm;

(* Hydrostatic Pressure Elastic Compression: Hooke's Law axial strain under 300 bar differential head *)
rHydrostaticDeformation_mm   := (rVotedDownholePress_bar * 100000.0 * 0.0019635) / (205.0E9 * 0.0004908) * 1000.0;

(* Total Dynamic Thermal Expansion Nulling Compensation Offset [mm] *)
rThermalExpansionOffset_mm   := rNetDifferentialExpansion_mm - rHydrostaticDeformation_mm;

(* Estimated instantaneous physical needle-to-seat ceramic orifice clearance [mm] *)
rDynamicCeramicClearance_mm  := rChokeMeasuredPos_mm - rThermalExpansionOffset_mm;
IF rDynamicCeramicClearance_mm < 0.0 THEN
    rDynamicCeramicClearance_mm := 0.0; (* Physical hard seat mechanical stop contact *)
END_IF;

(* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
   LAYER 4: MICRO-SEISMIC SLIP ACOUSTIC EMISSION RATE QUENCHING KERNEL
   --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* 2nd-Order Digital Butterworth Low-Pass Filter on High-Frequency Acoustic Emission Energy (cutoff = 1.5 Hz) *)
rAEFiltered_dB := (0.0976 * rAcousticEmissionLevel_dB) + (0.1953 * rAERawPrev_dB) + (0.7071 * rAEFiltered_dB);
rAERawPrev_dB  := rAcousticEmissionLevel_dB;

(* Numerical Derivative of Micro-Seismic Slip Event Frequency: d(dN_AE/dt)/dt *)
rEventRateDerivative_epm_s    := (rMicroSeismicEventRate_epm - rMicroSeismicRatePrev_epm) / c_rCycleDt_s;
rMicroSeismicRatePrev_epm     := rMicroSeismicEventRate_epm;
rMicroSeismicRateFiltered_epm := (0.150 * rMicroSeismicEventRate_epm) + (0.850 * rMicroSeismicRateFiltered_epm);

(* Dimensionless Reservoir Geomechanical Instability Stress Index (Mohr-Coulomb Proximity) *)
rSeismicStressIndex := (rAEFiltered_dB / rMaxSeismicThreshold_dB) * 0.60 + (rMicroSeismicRateFiltered_epm / rMaxEventRate_epm) * 0.40;

(* Micro-Seismic Slip Active Quenching Controller *)
IF (rAEFiltered_dB > (rMaxSeismicThreshold_dB * 0.75)) OR (rMicroSeismicRateFiltered_epm > (rMaxEventRate_epm * 0.70)) THEN
    bSeismicQuenchActive := TRUE;
    (* Proportional-Derivative Quenching Gain: Increases hydraulic backpressure damping *)
    rSeismicQuenchDampingGain := 1.0 + (3.5 * (rAEFiltered_dB - (rMaxSeismicThreshold_dB * 0.75)) / rMaxSeismicThreshold_dB)
                                     + (1.2 * MAX(0.0, rEventRateDerivative_epm_s) / rMaxEventRate_epm);
    IF rSeismicQuenchDampingGain > 6.0 THEN
        rSeismicQuenchDampingGain := 6.0;
    END_IF;

    (* Dynamic Negative Choke Trim: Swiftly back off downhole flow to de-energize pore pressure pulse *)
    rSeismicQuenchOffset_mm := (rSeismicQuenchDampingGain - 1.0) * 4.25; (* Retract choke up to 21.25 mm *)
    tSeismicQuenchDwellTimer(IN := TRUE, PT := T#45S);
ELSE
    tSeismicQuenchDwellTimer(IN := FALSE, PT := T#45S);
    rSeismicQuenchDampingGain := 1.0;
    IF rSeismicQuenchOffset_mm > 0.0 THEN
        (* Smooth exponential decay of seismic quench offset back to zero *)
        rSeismicQuenchOffset_mm := rSeismicQuenchOffset_mm * 0.965;
        IF rSeismicQuenchOffset_mm < 0.05 THEN
            rSeismicQuenchOffset_mm := 0.0;
            bSeismicQuenchActive    := FALSE;
        END_IF;
    ELSE
        bSeismicQuenchActive := FALSE;
    END_IF;
END_IF;

IF rAEFiltered_dB > rMaxSeismicThreshold_dB THEN
    bSeismicAlarmActive := TRUE;
    wFaultWord.9        := TRUE; (* Bit 9: Micro-Seismic Threshold Exceeded *)
ELSE
    bSeismicAlarmActive := FALSE;
END_IF;

(* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
   LAYER 5: SUPERCRITICAL THERMODYNAMICS & HIGH-ENTHALPY FLASH STEAM SEPARATION
   --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* Reduced Temperature and Pressure for Supercritical Water Enthalpy Polynomial Approximation *)
rReducedTemp_tau      := (c_rCriticalTemp_degC + 273.15) / (rVotedDownholeTemp_degC + 273.15);
rReducedDensity_delta := (rVotedDownholePress_bar / c_rCriticalPres_bar) * (1.0 / (0.85 + (0.15 * rReducedTemp_tau)));

(* IAPWS-IF97 Region 3 Reduced High-Enthalpy Approximation for 450 deg C / 300 bar [kJ/kg] *)
rCalculatedEnthalpy_kJkg := 3180.0 + (1.85 * (rVotedDownholeTemp_degC - 450.0))
                                   - (0.65 * (rVotedDownholePress_bar - 300.0))
                                   + (0.012 * (rVotedDownholeTemp_degC - 450.0) * (rVotedDownholePress_bar - 300.0));
IF rCalculatedEnthalpy_kJkg < 2600.0 THEN
    rCalculatedEnthalpy_kJkg := 2600.0;
ELSIF rCalculatedEnthalpy_kJkg > 3650.0 THEN
    rCalculatedEnthalpy_kJkg := 3650.0;
END_IF;

(* Surface Flash Cyclone Separator Equilibrium Thermodynamics *)
(* Saturated Liquid (Brine) and Saturated Vapor Enthalpies at Separator Pressure (25 - 40 bar) *)
rSatLiquidEnthalpy_kJkg := 980.0  + (12.50 * (rFlashSeparatorPress_bar - 25.0));
rSatVaporEnthalpy_kJkg  := 2800.0 - (2.15  * (rFlashSeparatorPress_bar - 25.0));

(* Flash Vapor Quality (Dry Steam Fraction): x = (h_fluid - h_sat_liq) / (h_sat_vap - h_sat_liq) *)
IF (rSatVaporEnthalpy_kJkg > rSatLiquidEnthalpy_kJkg) THEN
    rFlashVaporQuality_x := (rCalculatedEnthalpy_kJkg - rSatLiquidEnthalpy_kJkg) / (rSatVaporEnthalpy_kJkg - rSatLiquidEnthalpy_kJkg);
    IF rFlashVaporQuality_x > 0.85 THEN
        rFlashVaporQuality_x := 0.85;
    ELSIF rFlashVaporQuality_x < 0.10 THEN
        rFlashVaporQuality_x := 0.10;
    END_IF;
ELSE
    rFlashVaporQuality_x := 0.35;
END_IF;

(* Calculated Real-Time Dry Steam Flow Fed to Flash Turbine *)
rCalculatedSteamFlow_kgs := rGeothermalMassFlow_kgs * rFlashVaporQuality_x;
rEstimatedFlashSteam_kgs := rCalculatedSteamFlow_kgs;
rBrineDrainFlow_kgs      := rGeothermalMassFlow_kgs * (1.0 - rFlashVaporQuality_x);

(* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
   LAYER 6: DISCRETE STATE-SPACE MODEL PREDICTIVE CONTROL (MPC) OPTIMIZER
   --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* Assemble Current Deviation State Vector: x(k) = Measured - Nominal Operating Point *)
aStateVector[1] := rVotedDownholePress_bar    - rTargetDownholePress_bar; (* State 1: Delta P_dh [bar] *)
aStateVector[2] := rDynamicCeramicClearance_mm - 5.0;                      (* State 2: Ceramic gap error [mm] *)
aStateVector[3] := rAEFiltered_dB             - 35.0;                     (* State 3: Micro-seismic AE index [dB] *)
aStateVector[4] := rFlashSeparatorPress_bar   - rTargetFlashPress_bar;    (* State 4: Separator press error [bar] *)
aStateVector[5] := rTurbineSpeed_rpm          - rRatedTurbineSpeed_rpm;   (* State 5: Turbine speed deviation [rpm] *)

(* Reference Vector r(k) is Regulation Target (All zeros for deviation states) *)
FOR i := 1 TO 5 DO
    aReferenceVector[i] := 0.0;
    aStateError[i]      := aStateVector[i] - aReferenceVector[i];
END_FOR;

(* Compute Unconstrained Gradient Vector: grad_J = B_d^T * Q * (A_d * x(k) - r) + R * Delta u(k-1) *)
FOR i := 1 TO 3 DO
    aMpcGradient[i] := 0.0;
    FOR j := 1 TO 5 DO
        (* One-step state prediction contribution *)
        aPredictedState[j] := 0.0;
        FOR k_idx := 1 TO 5 DO
            aPredictedState[j] := aPredictedState[j] + (aMatrix_A[j, k_idx] * aStateVector[k_idx]);
        END_FOR;
        aMpcGradient[i] := aMpcGradient[i] + (aMatrix_B[j, i] * aWeight_Q[j] * aPredictedState[j]);
    END_FOR;
    (* Add input rate damping penalization *)
    aMpcGradient[i] := aMpcGradient[i] + (aWeight_R[i] * aDeltaControlInput[i]);
END_FOR;

(* Projected Gradient Descent Optimization Iterations (5 Inner Iterations with Step Size gamma = 0.045) *)
FOR iMpcIter := 1 TO 5 DO
    FOR i := 1 TO 3 DO
        aOptimizedInput[i] := aControlInputVector[i] - (0.045 * aMpcGradient[i]);
    END_FOR;

    (* Actuator Hard Physical Box Constraints & Slew Limiting *)
    (* Input 1: Downhole Choke Position [0.0 .. 100.0 mm] *)
    IF aOptimizedInput[1] > c_rMaxChokeStroke_mm THEN
        aOptimizedInput[1] := c_rMaxChokeStroke_mm;
    ELSIF aOptimizedInput[1] < c_rMinChokeStroke_mm THEN
        aOptimizedInput[1] := c_rMinChokeStroke_mm;
    END_IF;

    (* Input 2: Surface Flash Steam Bypass Dump Valve [0.0 .. 100.0 %] *)
    IF aOptimizedInput[2] > 100.0 THEN
        aOptimizedInput[2] := 100.0;
    ELSIF aOptimizedInput[2] < 0.0 THEN
        aOptimizedInput[2] := 0.0;
    END_IF;

    (* Input 3: High-Enthalpy Turbine Steam Governor Valve [0.0 .. 100.0 %] *)
    IF aOptimizedInput[3] > 100.0 THEN
        aOptimizedInput[3] := 100.0;
    ELSIF aOptimizedInput[3] < 0.0 THEN
        aOptimizedInput[3] := 0.0;
    END_IF;
END_FOR;

(* Store Previous Inputs and Compute Delta u for Next Optimization Cycle *)
FOR i := 1 TO 3 DO
    aDeltaControlInput[i]  := aOptimizedInput[i] - aControlInputVector[i];
    aPrevControlInput[i]   := aControlInputVector[i];
    aControlInputVector[i] := aOptimizedInput[i];
END_FOR;

(* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
   LAYER 7: STEAM TURBINE ELECTRO-HYDRAULIC SPEED GOVERNING & GRID SYNCHRONIZATION
   --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* Rotational Speed Error [rpm] *)
rSpeedError_rpm       := rRatedTurbineSpeed_rpm - rTurbineSpeed_rpm;
rSpeedDerivative_rpms := (rTurbineSpeed_rpm - rPrevSpeed_rpm) / c_rCycleDt_s;
rPrevSpeed_rpm        := rTurbineSpeed_rpm;

(* Speed Governor PID Integration with Anti-Windup Clamping *)
IF (iState >= 70) AND (iState <= 80) THEN
    rSpeedIntegral_rpm := rSpeedIntegral_rpm + (rSpeedError_rpm * c_rCycleDt_s * 0.085);
    IF rSpeedIntegral_rpm > 45.0 THEN
        rSpeedIntegral_rpm := 45.0;
    ELSIF rSpeedIntegral_rpm < -15.0 THEN
        rSpeedIntegral_rpm := -15.0;
    END_IF;
ELSE
    rSpeedIntegral_rpm := 0.0;
END_IF;

(* Standard 4.0% Droop Speed Governing Formulation *)
rDroopCompensation_pct := (1.0 / 0.04) * (rSpeedError_rpm / rRatedTurbineSpeed_rpm) * 100.0;
rGovernorPidOutput_pct := (0.350 * rSpeedError_rpm) + rSpeedIntegral_rpm - (0.045 * rSpeedDerivative_rpms) + (rDroopCompensation_pct * 0.25);
IF rGovernorPidOutput_pct > 100.0 THEN
    rGovernorPidOutput_pct := 100.0;
ELSIF rGovernorPidOutput_pct < 0.0 THEN
    rGovernorPidOutput_pct := 0.0;
END_IF;

(* Grid Synchro-Check Window Evaluation (IEC 60255-127 Compliance) *)
rFreqDiff_Hz  := ABS(rGridFrequency_Hz - ((rTurbineSpeed_rpm / 60.0) * 1.0)); (* 60 Hz 2-pole *)
rVoltDiff_pct := ABS(rGeneratorVoltage_kV - rGridBusVoltage_kV) / MAX(1.0, rGridBusVoltage_kV) * 100.0;
rPhaseDiff_deg := ABS(rGridPhaseAngle_deg);

bSynchroWindowHealthy := (rFreqDiff_Hz <= 0.05) AND (rVoltDiff_pct <= 1.50) AND (rPhaseDiff_deg <= 4.0);
tSynchroDwellTimer(IN := bSynchroWindowHealthy, PT := T#1500MS);

(* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
   LAYER 8: SEQUENTIAL FINITE STATE MACHINE (ISA-88 SINTERING & CIRCULATION PROCESS PHASES)
   --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
CASE iState OF

    0: (* STATE_STANDBY_OFFLINE: Wellhead shut-in, turbine parked, actuators homed *)
        rCmdChokePosition_mm        := 0.0;
        rCmdSurfaceFlashBypass_pct  := 0.0;
        rCmdTurbineGovernor_pct     := 0.0;
        rCmdBrineReinjection_pct    := 0.0;
        rCmdEmergencyDump_pct       := 0.0;
        bEmergencyDumpActive        := FALSE;
        bTurbineSynchronized        := FALSE;
        bSystemReady                := FALSE;
        wSystemStatusWord           := 16#0001; (* Bit 0: Standby Ready *)
        rBaseChokeSetpoint_mm       := 0.0;

        IF bEnable AND bEStopOk AND (wFaultWord = 0) AND bStartCirculation THEN
            iState := 10; (* Advance to Wellbore Prewarm & Bleed *)
        END_IF;

    10: (* STATE_WELLBORE_PREWARM_BLEED: Controlled annular bleed to establish initial thermal gradient *)
        wSystemStatusWord          := 16#0003; (* Bit 0: Ready, Bit 1: Prewarm Active *)
        rCmdSurfaceFlashBypass_pct := 100.0;  (* Bypass open to route initial cold brine to flash separator *)
        rCmdBrineReinjection_pct   := 100.0;  (* Route drainage straight to injection well *)
        rCmdTurbineGovernor_pct    := 0.0;    (* Turbine isolated *)

        (* Minor choke cracked open: 2.5 mm to warm stem slowly at 5.0 deg C/min max casing gradient *)
        rBaseChokeSetpoint_mm      := 2.5;
        rCompensatedChokeTarget_mm := rBaseChokeSetpoint_mm + rThermalExpansionOffset_mm - rSeismicQuenchOffset_mm;
        IF rCompensatedChokeTarget_mm < 0.0 THEN
            rCompensatedChokeTarget_mm := 0.0;
        END_IF;
        rCmdChokePosition_mm       := rCompensatedChokeTarget_mm;

        tStateStepTimer(IN := TRUE, PT := T#120S);
        IF (rVotedDownholeTemp_degC >= 250.0) AND tStateStepTimer.Q THEN
            tStateStepTimer(IN := FALSE);
            iState := 20; (* Advance to Supercritical Discovery Pressurization *)
        ELSIF bAbortCirculation THEN
            tStateStepTimer(IN := FALSE);
            iState := 90;
        END_IF;

    20: (* STATE_SUPERCRITICAL_DISCOVERY_PRESSURIZATION: Ramp choke to cross supercritical envelope *)
        wSystemStatusWord          := 16#0007; (* Bit 2: Supercritical Pressurization *)
        rCmdSurfaceFlashBypass_pct := 100.0;
        rCmdBrineReinjection_pct   := 100.0;
        rCmdTurbineGovernor_pct    := 0.0;

        (* Slew base choke setpoint smoothly toward 15.0 mm at 0.08 mm/s *)
        IF rBaseChokeSetpoint_mm < 15.0 THEN
            rBaseChokeSetpoint_mm := rBaseChokeSetpoint_mm + (0.08 * c_rCycleDt_s);
        ELSE
            rBaseChokeSetpoint_mm := 15.0;
        END_IF;

        rCompensatedChokeTarget_mm := rBaseChokeSetpoint_mm + rThermalExpansionOffset_mm - rSeismicQuenchOffset_mm;
        IF rCompensatedChokeTarget_mm < 0.0 THEN
            rCompensatedChokeTarget_mm := 0.0;
        END_IF;
        rCmdChokePosition_mm       := rCompensatedChokeTarget_mm;

        (* Confirm crossing into supercritical regime: T > 374 deg C and P > 221 bar *)
        IF (rVotedDownholeTemp_degC >= c_rCriticalTemp_degC) AND (rVotedDownholePress_bar >= c_rCriticalPres_bar) THEN
            tPressureStabilizeTimer(IN := TRUE, PT := T#60S);
            IF tPressureStabilizeTimer.Q THEN
                tPressureStabilizeTimer(IN := FALSE);
                iState := 30; (* Advance to Ceramic Thermal Expansion Nulling Calibration *)
            END_IF;
        ELSE
            tPressureStabilizeTimer(IN := FALSE);
        END_IF;

    30: (* STATE_CERAMIC_THERMAL_EXPANSION_NULLING_CALIBRATION: Calibrate thermal expansion model vs flow impedance *)
        wSystemStatusWord := 16#000F; (* Bit 3: Thermal Nulling Calib Active *)
        rCmdSurfaceFlashBypass_pct := 100.0;
        rCmdBrineReinjection_pct   := 100.0;

        (* Hold base stroke steady at 15.0 mm while thermal nodes equilibrate *)
        rCompensatedChokeTarget_mm := rBaseChokeSetpoint_mm + rThermalExpansionOffset_mm - rSeismicQuenchOffset_mm;
        rCmdChokePosition_mm       := rCompensatedChokeTarget_mm;

        tThermalExpansionCalibTimer(IN := TRUE, PT := T#45S);
        IF (ABS(rTempNodeCeramic_degC - rVotedDownholeTemp_degC) <= 12.0) AND tThermalExpansionCalibTimer.Q THEN
            tThermalExpansionCalibTimer(IN := FALSE);
            iState := 40; (* Thermal balance confirmed, advance to Reservoir Circulation *)
        END_IF;

    40: (* STATE_RESERVOIR_CIRCULATION_ESTABLISHED: Ramp mass flow toward production target *)
        wSystemStatusWord := 16#001F; (* Bit 4: Circulation Established *)
        rCmdSurfaceFlashBypass_pct := 100.0;
        rCmdBrineReinjection_pct   := 100.0;
        rCmdTurbineGovernor_pct    := 0.0;

        (* Use MPC Optimized Choke Position Output *)
        rBaseChokeSetpoint_mm      := aControlInputVector[1];
        rCompensatedChokeTarget_mm := rBaseChokeSetpoint_mm + rThermalExpansionOffset_mm - rSeismicQuenchOffset_mm;
        IF rCompensatedChokeTarget_mm > c_rMaxChokeStroke_mm THEN
            rCompensatedChokeTarget_mm := c_rMaxChokeStroke_mm;
        ELSIF rCompensatedChokeTarget_mm < 0.0 THEN
            rCompensatedChokeTarget_mm := 0.0;
        END_IF;
        rCmdChokePosition_mm       := rCompensatedChokeTarget_mm;

        (* Check if micro-seismic event rate triggers intermediate quench *)
        IF bSeismicQuenchActive THEN
            iState := 50; (* Divert to Seismic Quenching Active Damping State *)
        ELSIF (rGeothermalMassFlow_kgs >= (rTargetMassFlow_kgs * 0.85)) AND (rFlashSeparatorPress_bar >= 22.0) THEN
            iState := 60; (* Advance to Surface Flash Separator Equilibration *)
        END_IF;

    50: (* STATE_MICROSEISMIC_QUENCHING_ACTIVE_DAMPING: Fault slip energy suppression phase *)
        wSystemStatusWord := 16#003F; (* Bit 5: Seismic Damping Active *)
        rCmdSurfaceFlashBypass_pct := 100.0; (* Keep bypass wide open to absorb wellhead variations *)
        rCmdBrineReinjection_pct   := 100.0;

        (* Choke throttled back by calculated seismic quench offset *)
        rCompensatedChokeTarget_mm := rBaseChokeSetpoint_mm + rThermalExpansionOffset_mm - rSeismicQuenchOffset_mm;
        IF rCompensatedChokeTarget_mm < 2.0 THEN
            rCompensatedChokeTarget_mm := 2.0; (* Keep minimum bleed alive to prevent downhole freeze *)
        END_IF;
        rCmdChokePosition_mm       := rCompensatedChokeTarget_mm;

        (* Once acoustic emission level and event rate subside, dwell before resuming *)
        IF (rAEFiltered_dB <= (rMaxSeismicThreshold_dB * 0.55)) AND (rMicroSeismicRateFiltered_epm <= (rMaxEventRate_epm * 0.50)) THEN
            tQuenchRecoveryTimer(IN := TRUE, PT := T#30S);
            IF tQuenchRecoveryTimer.Q THEN
                tQuenchRecoveryTimer(IN := FALSE);
                iState := 40; (* Return to reservoir circulation established *)
            END_IF;
        ELSE
            tQuenchRecoveryTimer(IN := FALSE);
        END_IF;

    60: (* STATE_SURFACE_FLASH_SEPARATOR_EQUILIBRATION: Stabilize steam pressure, purge non-condensable gas *)
        wSystemStatusWord := 16#007F; (* Bit 6: Flash Separator Equilibrated *)
        rBaseChokeSetpoint_mm      := aControlInputVector[1];
        rCompensatedChokeTarget_mm := rBaseChokeSetpoint_mm + rThermalExpansionOffset_mm - rSeismicQuenchOffset_mm;
        rCmdChokePosition_mm       := rCompensatedChokeTarget_mm;

        (* Regulate separator pressure to target flash pressure via bypass dump valve *)
        rCmdSurfaceFlashBypass_pct := 100.0 - ((rTargetFlashPress_bar - rFlashSeparatorPress_bar) * 8.5);
        IF rCmdSurfaceFlashBypass_pct > 100.0 THEN
            rCmdSurfaceFlashBypass_pct := 100.0;
        ELSIF rCmdSurfaceFlashBypass_pct < 20.0 THEN
            rCmdSurfaceFlashBypass_pct := 20.0;
        END_IF;

        rCmdBrineReinjection_pct   := 85.0 + ((rFlashBrineLevel_pct - 50.0) * 0.80);
        rCmdTurbineGovernor_pct    := 0.0;

        IF (ABS(rFlashSeparatorPress_bar - rTargetFlashPress_bar) <= 1.2) AND
           (rCalculatedSteamFlow_kgs >= 15.0) AND bTurbineSyncEnable THEN
            iState := 70; (* Advance to Turbine Speed Governing & Sync Preparation *)
        END_IF;

    70: (* STATE_TURBINE_SPEED_GOVERNING_SYNC_PREPARATION: Run turbine up to 3600 rpm, track frequency & phase *)
        wSystemStatusWord := 16#00FF; (* Bit 7: Turbine Spinup & Synchro Active *)
        rBaseChokeSetpoint_mm      := aControlInputVector[1];
        rCompensatedChokeTarget_mm := rBaseChokeSetpoint_mm + rThermalExpansionOffset_mm - rSeismicQuenchOffset_mm;
        rCmdChokePosition_mm       := rCompensatedChokeTarget_mm;

        (* Slew governor valve from PID speed loop while reducing bypass symmetrically *)
        rCmdTurbineGovernor_pct    := rGovernorPidOutput_pct;
        rCmdSurfaceFlashBypass_pct := 100.0 - (rCmdTurbineGovernor_pct * 0.95);
        IF rCmdSurfaceFlashBypass_pct < 10.0 THEN
            rCmdSurfaceFlashBypass_pct := 10.0;
        END_IF;

        (* Check for synchronized grid breaker close command *)
        IF tSynchroDwellTimer.Q AND (rTurbineVibration_um <= 38.0) THEN
            bTurbineSynchronized := TRUE;
            bSystemReady         := TRUE;
            iState               := 80; (* Breaker closed, advance to Baseload Grid Synchronized *)
        END_IF;

    80: (* STATE_TURBINE_GRID_SYNCHRONIZED_BASELOAD: Baseload power generation under MPC & droop governing *)
        wSystemStatusWord := 16#01FF; (* Bit 8: Synchronized Baseload Online *)
        bSystemReady         := TRUE;
        bTurbineSynchronized := TRUE;

        (* Coordinated Choke, Bypass, and Governor Control *)
        rBaseChokeSetpoint_mm      := aControlInputVector[1];
        rCompensatedChokeTarget_mm := rBaseChokeSetpoint_mm + rThermalExpansionOffset_mm - rSeismicQuenchOffset_mm;
        rCmdChokePosition_mm       := rCompensatedChokeTarget_mm;

        (* Governor valve follows MPC power output + frequency droop *)
        rCmdTurbineGovernor_pct    := aControlInputVector[3] + (rDroopCompensation_pct * 0.35);
        IF rCmdTurbineGovernor_pct > 100.0 THEN
            rCmdTurbineGovernor_pct := 100.0;
        ELSIF rCmdTurbineGovernor_pct < 15.0 THEN
            rCmdTurbineGovernor_pct := 15.0;
        END_IF;

        (* Bypass valve trims excess steam to maintain flash separator pressure stability *)
        rCmdSurfaceFlashBypass_pct := aControlInputVector[2];
        IF rCmdSurfaceFlashBypass_pct > 40.0 THEN
            rCmdSurfaceFlashBypass_pct := 40.0;
        ELSIF rCmdSurfaceFlashBypass_pct < 0.0 THEN
            rCmdSurfaceFlashBypass_pct := 0.0;
        END_IF;

        rCmdBrineReinjection_pct   := 75.0 + ((rFlashBrineLevel_pct - 50.0) * 0.70);

        (* Handle Seismic Disturbance During Baseload Operation *)
        IF bSeismicQuenchActive THEN
            iState := 50; (* Retract choke to quench slip, let bypass take over steam deficit *)
        ELSIF bAbortCirculation THEN
            iState := 90; (* Ramp down to hot standby *)
        END_IF;

    90: (* STATE_CONTROLLED_RAMP_DOWN_HOT_STANDBY: Orderly unloading of turbine and wellhead shut-in *)
        wSystemStatusWord := 16#03FF; (* Bit 9: Controlled Unloading *)
        bSystemReady      := FALSE;

        (* Ramp down turbine governor at 2.0 %/s *)
        IF rCmdTurbineGovernor_pct > 0.0 THEN
            rCmdTurbineGovernor_pct := rCmdTurbineGovernor_pct - (2.0 * c_rCycleDt_s);
        ELSE
            rCmdTurbineGovernor_pct := 0.0;
            bTurbineSynchronized    := FALSE;
        END_IF;

        (* Bypass accepts steam during unloading *)
        rCmdSurfaceFlashBypass_pct := 100.0;

        (* Ramp down choke actuator at 0.05 mm/s to prevent thermal casing shock *)
        IF rBaseChokeSetpoint_mm > 0.0 THEN
            rBaseChokeSetpoint_mm := rBaseChokeSetpoint_mm - (0.05 * c_rCycleDt_s);
        ELSE
            rBaseChokeSetpoint_mm := 0.0;
        END_IF;
        rCompensatedChokeTarget_mm := rBaseChokeSetpoint_mm + rThermalExpansionOffset_mm;
        IF rCompensatedChokeTarget_mm < 0.0 THEN
            rCompensatedChokeTarget_mm := 0.0;
        END_IF;
        rCmdChokePosition_mm := rCompensatedChokeTarget_mm;

        IF (rCmdTurbineGovernor_pct <= 0.0) AND (rBaseChokeSetpoint_mm <= 0.0) THEN
            iState := 0; (* Returned to standby *)
        END_IF;

    999: (* STATE_FAILSAFE_EMERGENCY_DEPRESSURIZATION_QUENCH: Trip energy dump and fault lockdown *)
        rCmdChokePosition_mm        := 0.0;   (* Force shut downhole choke *)
        rCmdSurfaceFlashBypass_pct  := 100.0; (* Full steam blowdown *)
        rCmdTurbineGovernor_pct     := 0.0;   (* Trip turbine *)
        rCmdEmergencyDump_pct       := 100.0; (* Flood quench desuperheater *)
        rCmdBrineReinjection_pct    := 100.0;
        bEmergencyDumpActive        := TRUE;
        bTurbineSynchronized        := FALSE;
        bSystemReady                := FALSE;
        wSystemStatusWord           := 16#F999;

        (* Diagnostic Manual Reset Logic *)
        IF bResetAlarms AND bEStopOk AND NOT bSeismicTripLatch THEN
            wFaultWord           := 0;
            wDegradedModeWord    := 0;
            bEmergencyDumpActive := FALSE;
            iState               := 0; (* Return to standby after affirmative reset *)
        END_IF;

END_CASE;

(* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
   LAYER 9: ANTI-WATER-HAMMER SLEW RATE CLAMPING & DIAGNOSTIC REGISTER PACKING
   --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* Enforce strict stroke rate velocity ceiling: |dv/dt| <= 2.5 mm/s to prevent hydraulic fracturing shock *)
rChokeSlewRate_mms := (rCmdChokePosition_mm - rPrevChokeCmd_mm) / c_rCycleDt_s;
IF rChokeSlewRate_mms > c_rMaxChokeSlew_mms THEN
    rCmdChokePosition_mm := rPrevChokeCmd_mm + (c_rMaxChokeSlew_mms * c_rCycleDt_s);
ELSIF rChokeSlewRate_mms < -c_rMaxChokeSlew_mms THEN
    rCmdChokePosition_mm := rPrevChokeCmd_mm - (c_rMaxChokeSlew_mms * c_rCycleDt_s);
END_IF;
rPrevChokeCmd_mm := rCmdChokePosition_mm;

(* Update Active State Telemetry Register *)
iActiveState := iState;

END_FUNCTION_BLOCK

FUNCTION_BLOCK FB_DeepSeaROV_6DOF_ThrusterAllocation
(* ====================================================================================================

    rRef_TrimPitch_deg      : REAL;             (* Commanded Vehicle Trim Angle Pitch theta_ref [-15.0 .. +15.0 deg] *)

    (* Triple Modular Redundancy (2oo3) Acoustic Doppler Velocity Log (DVL) [m/s] *)
    rDVL_Surge_Vel_ChA_mps  : REAL;             (* DVL Transceiver Channel A Surge Body Velocity u [m/s] *)
    rDVL_Surge_Vel_ChB_mps  : REAL;             (* DVL Transceiver Channel B Surge Body Velocity u [m/s] *)
    rDVL_Surge_Vel_ChC_mps  : REAL;             (* DVL Transceiver Channel C Surge Body Velocity u [m/s] *)
    rDVL_Sway_Vel_ChA_mps   : REAL;             (* DVL Transceiver Channel A Sway Body Velocity v [m/s] *)
    rDVL_Sway_Vel_ChB_mps   : REAL;             (* DVL Transceiver Channel B Sway Body Velocity v [m/s] *)
    rDVL_Sway_Vel_ChC_mps   : REAL;             (* DVL Transceiver Channel C Sway Body Velocity v [m/s] *)
    rDVL_Heave_Vel_ChA_mps  : REAL;             (* DVL Transceiver Channel A Heave Body Velocity w [m/s] *)
    rDVL_Heave_Vel_ChB_mps  : REAL;             (* DVL Transceiver Channel B Heave Body Velocity w [m/s] *)
    rDVL_Heave_Vel_ChC_mps  : REAL;             (* DVL Transceiver Channel C Heave Body Velocity w [m/s] *)

    (* Triple Modular Redundancy (2oo3) Fiber Optic Gyroscope (FOG-INS) Angular Rates [rad/s] *)

    rINS_RollRate_ChB_rads  : REAL;             (* FOG-INS Channel B Body Roll Angular Rate p [rad/s] *)
    rINS_RollRate_ChC_rads  : REAL;             (* FOG-INS Channel C Body Roll Angular Rate p [rad/s] *)
    rINS_PitchRate_ChA_rads : REAL;             (* FOG-INS Channel A Body Pitch Angular Rate q [rad/s] *)
    rINS_PitchRate_ChB_rads : REAL;             (* FOG-INS Channel B Body Pitch Angular Rate q [rad/s] *)
    rINS_PitchRate_ChC_rads : REAL;             (* FOG-INS Channel C Body Pitch Angular Rate q [rad/s] *)
    rINS_YawRate_ChA_rads   : REAL;             (* FOG-INS Channel A Body Yaw Angular Rate r [rad/s] *)
    rINS_YawRate_ChB_rads   : REAL;             (* FOG-INS Channel B Body Yaw Angular Rate r [rad/s] *)
    rINS_YawRate_ChC_rads   : REAL;             (* FOG-INS Channel C Body Yaw Angular Rate r [rad/s] *)

    (* Triple Modular Redundancy (2oo3) Subsea Hydrostatic Depth Cells [m] *)

    rDepth_Sensor_ChC_m     : REAL;             (* Digiquartz Depth Transducer Channel C Reading [m] *)

    (* Triple Modular Redundancy (2oo3) Gyrocompass Heading [deg] *)
    rINS_Heading_ChA_deg    : REAL;             (* Marine FOG Gyrocompass Heading Channel A [deg] *)
    rINS_Heading_ChB_deg    : REAL;             (* Marine FOG Gyrocompass Heading Channel B [deg] *)
    rINS_Heading_ChC_deg    : REAL;             (* Marine FOG Gyrocompass Heading Channel C [deg] *)

    (* Thruster Hardware Status & Power Allocation Interface *)
    wThrusterHealthRegister : WORD;             (* 8-Bit Health Mask (Bit 0=T1 .. Bit 7=T8) [1=Healthy, 0=Tripped] *)
    rBollardThrustRating_N  : REAL := 6800.0;   (* Maximum Continuous Bollard Pull Force Rating per Thruster [N] *)
    rMaxBusPowerAvailable_kW: REAL := 180.0;    (* Subsea Power Distribution System Peak Power Limit [kW] *)
    rPowerConversionConstant: REAL := 0.026;    (* Thruster Power Conversion Factor [kW / (N^1.5)] *)
