VAR_OUTPUT
    (* Primary System Status Words and Annunciators *)
    bSystemOperational      : BOOL;             (* DP-3 Station-Keeping Loop Fully Active and Within Deadband *)
    bDegradedOperation      : BOOL;             (* System Operating with Redundancy Loss (Thruster or Sensor Fail) *)
    bSafetyTripActive       : BOOL;             (* Critical Safety Trip or Total Loss of Station-Keeping *)
    wMasterStatusWord       : WORD;             (* Comprehensive System Diagnostic Status Bitfield *)
    wSensorHealthMatrix     : WORD;             (* 2oo3 Sensor Fault & Discrepancy Bitfield *)

    (* Demanded 6-DOF Generalized Control Wrench [N], [Nm] *)
    rDemandedWrench_X_N     : REAL;             (* Commanded Net Force in Surge Axis tau_X [N] *)
    rDemandedWrench_Y_N     : REAL;             (* Commanded Net Force in Sway Axis tau_Y [N] *)
    rDemandedWrench_Z_N     : REAL;             (* Commanded Net Force in Heave Axis tau_Z [N] *)
    rDemandedTorque_K_Nm    : REAL;             (* Commanded Net Torque in Roll Axis tau_K [Nm] *)
    rDemandedTorque_M_Nm    : REAL;             (* Commanded Net Torque in Pitch Axis tau_M [Nm] *)
    rDemandedTorque_N_Nm    : REAL;             (* Commanded Net Torque in Yaw Axis tau_N [Nm] *)

    (* Nonlinear Disturbance Observer (NDOB) Current & Hydrodynamic Disturbance Estimates *)
    rEstDisturbance_Surge_N : REAL;             (* Observed Ocean Current Environmental Force in Surge [N] *)
    rEstDisturbance_Sway_N  : REAL;             (* Observed Ocean Current Environmental Force in Sway [N] *)
    rEstDisturbance_Heave_N : REAL;             (* Observed Ocean Upwelling / Tether Umbilical Pull in Heave [N] *)
    rEstDisturbance_Yaw_Nm  : REAL;             (* Observed Ocean Current Induced Hydrodynamic Yaw Torque [Nm] *)
    rEstOceanCurrentVel_mps : REAL;             (* Inferred Ambient Deep-Sea Current Velocity Magnitude [m/s] *)

    (* Individual 8-Thruster Setpoint Command Outputs [N] *)
    rThrusterCmd_T1_FwdStbdH: REAL;             (* T1: Forward-Starboard Horizontal Thruster (45 deg) [N] *)
    rThrusterCmd_T2_FwdPortH: REAL;             (* T2: Forward-Port Horizontal Thruster (135 deg) [N] *)
    rThrusterCmd_T3_AftPortH: REAL;             (* T3: Aft-Port Horizontal Thruster (225 deg) [N] *)
    rThrusterCmd_T4_AftStbdH: REAL;             (* T4: Aft-Starboard Horizontal Thruster (315 deg) [N] *)
    rThrusterCmd_T5_FwdStbdV: REAL;             (* T5: Forward-Starboard Vertical Thruster (Canted 15 deg) [N] *)
    rThrusterCmd_T6_FwdPortV: REAL;             (* T6: Forward-Port Vertical Thruster (Canted 15 deg) [N] *)
    rThrusterCmd_T7_AftPortV: REAL;             (* T7: Aft-Port Vertical Thruster (Canted 15 deg) [N] *)
    rThrusterCmd_T8_AftStbdV: REAL;             (* T8: Aft-Starboard Vertical Thruster (Canted 15 deg) [N] *)

    (* Subsea Power & Actuator Envelope Diagnostics *)
    rAggregatedPower_kW     : REAL;             (* Total Electrical/Hydraulic Grid Load Estimate [kW] *)
    rPowerAttenuationRatio  : REAL;             (* Active Grid Load-Shedding Attenuation Factor [0.0 .. 1.0] *)
    bThrustSaturationActive : BOOL;             (* Hardware Saturation Flag (At Least One Thruster at Rating) *)
END_VAR

VAR
    (* Supervisory Finite State Machine State Pointer *)
    iOperatingMode          : INT := 0;         (* Operating State: 0=ColdInit, 10=Standby, 20=DP3_Full, 30=Degraded, 99=Failsafe *)
    iActiveSubPhase         : INT := 0;         (* Multi-Stage Sequential Phase Indicator *)

    (* Hydrodynamic Model State Space Parameters (WROV Rigid Body + Added Mass) *)
    rMassTotal_kg           : REAL := 3780.0;   (* Total In-Water ROV Mass [kg] *)
    rAddedMass_X_kg         : REAL := 1980.0;   (* Surge Added Mass Tensor Component X_udot [kg] *)
    rAddedMass_Y_kg         : REAL := 2520.0;   (* Sway Added Mass Tensor Component Y_vdot [kg] *)
    rAddedMass_Z_kg         : REAL := 3250.0;   (* Heave Added Mass Tensor Component Z_wdot [kg] *)
    rInertia_Z_kgm2         : REAL := 4450.0;   (* Yaw Mass Moment of Inertia I_zz + N_rdot [kg*m^2] *)

    (* Hydrodynamic Damping Parameters (Linear Skin Friction + Quadratic Crossflow Form Drag) *)
    rDampLin_Surge          : REAL := 240.0;    (* Surge Linear Damping [N*s/m] *)
    rDampQuad_Surge         : REAL := 510.0;    (* Surge Quadratic Damping [N*s^2/m^2] *)
    rDampLin_Sway           : REAL := 360.0;    (* Sway Linear Damping [N*s/m] *)
    rDampQuad_Sway          : REAL := 680.0;    (* Sway Quadratic Damping [N*s^2/m^2] *)
    rDampLin_Heave          : REAL := 440.0;    (* Heave Linear Damping [N*s/m] *)
    rDampQuad_Heave         : REAL := 820.0;    (* Heave Quadratic Damping [N*s^2/m^2] *)
    rDampLin_Yaw            : REAL := 720.0;    (* Yaw Linear Damping [Nm*s/rad] *)
    rDampQuad_Yaw           : REAL := 1380.0;   (* Yaw Quadratic Damping [Nm*s^2/rad^2] *)

    (* Nonlinear Disturbance Observer (NDOB) Internal Continuous-Discrete Registers *)
    rDOB_State_z_Surge      : REAL := 0.0;      (* Filter State Variable z_Surge [N] *)
    rDOB_State_z_Sway       : REAL := 0.0;      (* Filter State Variable z_Sway [N] *)
    rDOB_State_z_Heave      : REAL := 0.0;      (* Filter State Variable z_Heave [N] *)
    rDOB_State_z_Yaw        : REAL := 0.0;      (* Filter State Variable z_Yaw [Nm] *)
    rDOB_Gain_Surge         : REAL := 2.10;     (* Observer Bandwidth Convergence Gain L_surge [rad/s] *)
    rDOB_Gain_Sway          : REAL := 2.10;     (* Observer Bandwidth Convergence Gain L_sway [rad/s] *)
    rDOB_Gain_Heave         : REAL := 1.65;     (* Observer Bandwidth Convergence Gain L_heave [rad/s] *)
    rDOB_Gain_Yaw           : REAL := 2.45;     (* Observer Bandwidth Convergence Gain L_yaw [rad/s] *)

    (* 2oo3 TMR Validated Navigation Telemetry Registers *)
    rVoted_Surge_Vel_mps    : REAL := 0.0;      (* Triply-Voted Body Surge Velocity u [m/s] *)
    rVoted_Sway_Vel_mps     : REAL := 0.0;      (* Triply-Voted Body Sway Velocity v [m/s] *)
    rVoted_Heave_Vel_mps    : REAL := 0.0;      (* Triply-Voted Body Heave Velocity w [m/s] *)
    rVoted_RollRate_rads    : REAL := 0.0;      (* Triply-Voted Body Roll Rate p [rad/s] *)
    rVoted_PitchRate_rads   : REAL := 0.0;      (* Triply-Voted Body Pitch Rate q [rad/s] *)
    rVoted_YawRate_rads     : REAL := 0.0;      (* Triply-Voted Body Yaw Rate r [rad/s] *)
    rVoted_Depth_m          : REAL := 0.0;      (* Triply-Voted Hydrostatic Depth [m] *)
    rVoted_Heading_deg      : REAL := 0.0;      (* Triply-Voted Gyro Heading [deg] *)

    (* Dead-Reckoning Position Accumulators [m] *)
    rEstimatedPos_Surge_m   : REAL := 0.0;      (* Integrated Dead-Reckoning Surge Coordinate [m] *)
    rEstimatedPos_Sway_m    : REAL := 0.0;      (* Integrated Dead-Reckoning Sway Coordinate [m] *)

    (* Closed-Loop Tracking Errors *)
    rErr_Surge_m            : REAL := 0.0;      (* Position Error in Surge Axis [m] *)
    rErr_Sway_m             : REAL := 0.0;      (* Position Error in Sway Axis [m] *)
    rErr_Depth_m            : REAL := 0.0;      (* Position Error in Heave Axis [m] *)
    rErr_Heading_deg        : REAL := 0.0;      (* Angular Heading Tracking Error [-180.0 .. +180.0 deg] *)

    (* PID Control Integral Accumulators with Anti-Windup Clamping *)
    rInteg_Surge_Ns         : REAL := 0.0;      (* Surge Axis Integrator Accumulator [N*s] *)
    rInteg_Sway_Ns          : REAL := 0.0;      (* Sway Axis Integrator Accumulator [N*s] *)
    rInteg_Depth_Ns         : REAL := 0.0;      (* Heave Axis Integrator Accumulator [N*s] *)
    rInteg_Yaw_Nms          : REAL := 0.0;      (* Yaw Axis Integrator Accumulator [Nm*s] *)

    (* PID Gain Parameter Tuning Constants *)
    rKp_Surge               : REAL := 4800.0;   (* Proportional Gain Surge [N/m] *)
    rKi_Surge               : REAL := 310.0;    (* Integral Gain Surge [N/(m*s)] *)
    rKd_Surge               : REAL := 7600.0;   (* Derivative Damping Gain Surge [N*s/m] *)

    rKp_Sway                : REAL := 4500.0;   (* Proportional Gain Sway [N/m] *)
    rKi_Sway                : REAL := 280.0;    (* Integral Gain Sway [N/(m*s)] *)
    rKd_Sway                : REAL := 7100.0;   (* Derivative Damping Gain Sway [N*s/m] *)

    rKp_Depth               : REAL := 5900.0;   (* Proportional Gain Heave [N/m] *)
    rKi_Depth               : REAL := 420.0;    (* Integral Gain Heave [N/(m*s)] *)
    rKd_Depth               : REAL := 8900.0;   (* Derivative Damping Gain Heave [N*s/m] *)

    rKp_Yaw                 : REAL := 6600.0;   (* Proportional Gain Yaw [Nm/rad] *)
    rKi_Yaw                 : REAL := 350.0;    (* Integral Gain Yaw [Nm/(rad*s)] *)
    rKd_Yaw                 : REAL := 9800.0;   (* Derivative Damping Gain Yaw [Nm*s/rad] *)

    (* Thruster Dynamic Force Arrays *)
    arrUnboundedThrust_N    : ARRAY[1..8] OF REAL; (* Unconstrained Force Allocation Vector u_raw [N] *)
    arrConditionedThrust_N  : ARRAY[1..8] OF REAL; (* Allocated Thrust After Power and Slew Conditioning [N] *)
    arrPreviousThrustCmd_N  : ARRAY[1..8] OF REAL; (* Historical Output Array for Slew Rate Limiting [N] *)

    (* Physical Configuration Geometry Constants *)
    rInvSqrt2               : REAL := 0.70710678; (* 1 / SQRT(2) = sin(45 deg) = cos(45 deg) *)
    rCantedCos15            : REAL := 0.96592583; (* cos(15 deg) vertical thruster inclination factor *)
    rCantedSin15            : REAL := 0.25881905; (* sin(15 deg) lateral thruster cross-coupling factor *)
    rMomentArm_X_m          : REAL := 1.05;       (* Longitudinal Distance to Thruster Centerlines [m] *)
    rMomentArm_Y_m          : REAL := 0.88;       (* Transverse Distance to Thruster Centerlines [m] *)

    (* Timers and Safety Enunciators *)
    tonWatchdogHeartbeat    : TON;              (* Supervisory Communication Loss Watchdog *)
    tonDegradedDebounce     : TON;              (* Degraded Mode State Confirmation Filter *)
    tonTripHold             : TON;              (* Safety Trip Acknowledgment Lockout Timer *)

    (* Internal Computation Auxiliaries *)
    rCycleTime_s            : REAL;             (* Cyclic Task Delta Time [s] *)
    rInternalHydroForce     : REAL;             (* Instantaneous Model Hydrodynamic Force [N] *)
    rCurrentPowerSum_kW     : REAL;             (* Instantaneous Aggregated Thruster Power [kW] *)
    iIdx                    : INT;              (* General Loop Iterator *)
    iVertLoop               : INT;              (* Vertical Redundancy Loop Index *)
    rDiff_AB                : REAL;             (* 2oo3 Sensor Channel Comparison AB *)
    rDiff_BC                : REAL;             (* 2oo3 Sensor Channel Comparison BC *)
    rDiff_CA                : REAL;             (* 2oo3 Sensor Channel Comparison CA *)
    rSlewLimit_Nps          : REAL := 2800.0;   (* Maximum Actuator Slew Rate [N/s] *)
    iHealthyCount           : INT := 8;         (* Count of Currently Available Thrusters *)
END_VAR

(* ====================================================================================================
   CONTROL EXECUTION ENGINE
   ==================================================================================================== *)

(* --- SAFETY INTERLOCK STAGE 0: HARDWIRED EMERGENCY STOP & ELECTRICAL TRIP --- *)
IF NOT bEmergencyStopCircuit THEN
    (* Immediate De-energization of All Eight Thrusters *)
    FOR iIdx := 1 TO 8 DO
        arrConditionedThrust_N[iIdx] := 0.0;
        arrPreviousThrustCmd_N[iIdx] := 0.0;
    END_FOR;

    rThrusterCmd_T1_FwdStbdH := 0.0;
    rThrusterCmd_T2_FwdPortH := 0.0;
    rThrusterCmd_T3_AftPortH := 0.0;
    rThrusterCmd_T4_AftStbdH := 0.0;
    rThrusterCmd_T5_FwdStbdV := 0.0;
    rThrusterCmd_T6_FwdPortV := 0.0;
    rThrusterCmd_T7_AftPortV := 0.0;
    rThrusterCmd_T8_AftStbdV := 0.0;

    rDemandedWrench_X_N  := 0.0;
    rDemandedWrench_Y_N  := 0.0;
    rDemandedWrench_Z_N  := 0.0;
    rDemandedTorque_K_Nm := 0.0;
    rDemandedTorque_M_Nm := 0.0;
    rDemandedTorque_N_Nm := 0.0;

    bSystemOperational    := FALSE;
    bSafetyTripActive     := TRUE;
    wMasterStatusWord     := 16#F001; (* Status Flag: Emergency Circuit Open *)
    iOperatingMode        := 99;      (* Shift FSM to Failsafe State *)
    RETURN;
END_IF;

(* Convert System Task Interval to Seconds for Integration *)
rCycleTime_s := TIME_TO_REAL(tDiscreteScanCycle) / 1000.0;
IF rCycleTime_s < 0.002 THEN
    rCycleTime_s := 0.020; (* Clamp to Standard 20ms Task Cycle *)
END_IF;

(* ====================================================================================================
   MULTI-STAGE FINITE STATE MACHINE (CASE iOperatingMode OF)
   ==================================================================================================== *)
CASE iOperatingMode OF

    0: (* =========================================================================
          STATE 0: INITIALIZATION & SENSOR SELF-TEST
          ========================================================================= *)
        bSystemOperational      := FALSE;
        bDegradedOperation      := FALSE;
        bSafetyTripActive       := FALSE;
        bThrustSaturationActive := FALSE;
        wMasterStatusWord       := 16#0001; (* Initialization Active *)
        wSensorHealthMatrix     := 16#0000;

        (* Reset Integral Terms *)
        rInteg_Surge_Ns := 0.0;
        rInteg_Sway_Ns  := 0.0;
        rInteg_Depth_Ns := 0.0;
        rInteg_Yaw_Nms  := 0.0;

        (* Initialize NDOB State Registers *)
        rDOB_State_z_Surge := 0.0;
        rDOB_State_z_Sway  := 0.0;
        rDOB_State_z_Heave := 0.0;
        rDOB_State_z_Yaw   := 0.0;

        FOR iIdx := 1 TO 8 DO
            arrUnboundedThrust_N[iIdx]   := 0.0;
            arrConditionedThrust_N[iIdx] := 0.0;
            arrPreviousThrustCmd_N[iIdx] := 0.0;
        END_FOR;

        IF bEnableMasterDP THEN
            iOperatingMode := 20; (* Transition directly into DP-3 Active Mode *)
        ELSE
            iOperatingMode := 10; (* Transition to Standby Ready *)
        END_IF;

    10: (* =========================================================================
           STATE 10: STANDBY READY (SYSTEM ENERGIZED BUT THRUSTERS AT NEUTRAL)
           ========================================================================= *)
        bSystemOperational := FALSE;
        bSafetyTripActive  := FALSE;
        wMasterStatusWord  := 16#0010; (* Standby Mode *)

        FOR iIdx := 1 TO 8 DO
            arrConditionedThrust_N[iIdx] := 0.0;
            arrPreviousThrustCmd_N[iIdx] := 0.0;
        END_FOR;

        rThrusterCmd_T1_FwdStbdH := 0.0;

                    (rKamal_A2 * EXP(-rKamal_E2_K / rResinTemp_Kelvin) * EXPT(MAX(0.0001, rCurrentResinAlpha), rKamal_m)) ) 
                  * EXPT(MAX(0.001, 1.0 - rCurrentResinAlpha), rKamal_n);

    rNipDwellTime_s := rNipFootprintWidth_m / (rWebSpeed_Filt / 60.0);

ay_innov[1] := (rMeanNipPressure_Npm - rNominalNipBase_Npm) 
               - (aC_mat[1,1] * ax_pred[1] + aC_mat[1,2] * ax_pred[2] + aC_mat[1,3] * ax_pred[3]);

ay_innov[2] := (rVotedRollTemp_degC - rNominalTempBase_degC) 
               - (aC_mat[2,1] * ax_pred[1] + aC_mat[2,2] * ax_pred[2] + aC_mat[2,3] * ax_pred[3]);

ay_innov[3] := (rComputedResinViscosity_Pas - rNominalViscBase_Pas) 
               - (aC_mat[3,1] * ax_pred[1] + aC_mat[3,2] * ax_pred[2] + aC_mat[3,3] * ax_pred[3]);

    ax_est[i] := ax_pred[i] + (aL_gain[i,1] * ay_innov[1] + aL_gain[i,2] * ay_innov[2] + aL_gain[i,3] * ay_innov[3]);
END_FOR;

au_ctl[1] := - (aK_mpc[1,1] * ax_est[1] + aK_mpc[1,2] * ax_est[2] + aK_mpc[1,3] * ax_est[3])
             + (aKr_ff[1,1] * (rActiveNipSetpoint_Npm - rNominalNipBase_Npm));

au_ctl[2] := - (aK_mpc[2,1] * ax_est[1] + aK_mpc[2,2] * ax_est[2] + aK_mpc[2,3] * ax_est[3])
             + (aKr_ff[2,2] * (rActiveTempSetpoint_degC - rNominalTempBase_degC));

au_ctl[3] := - (aK_mpc[3,1] * ax_est[1] + aK_mpc[3,2] * ax_est[2] + aK_mpc[3,3] * ax_est[3])
             + (aKr_ff[3,3] * (rActiveViscSetpoint_Pas - rNominalViscBase_Pas));

FOR i := 1 TO 3 DO
    ax_pred[i] := (aA_mat[i,1] * ax_est[1] + aA_mat[i,2] * ax_est[2] + aA_mat[i,3] * ax_est[3])
                + (aB_mat[i,1] * au_ctl[1] + aB_mat[i,2] * au_ctl[2] + aB_mat[i,3] * au_ctl[3]);

    (* Luenberger State Observer Innovation Matrix L (6x4) *)
    aMatrix_L[1,1] := 0.2850; aMatrix_L[1,2] := 0.0120; aMatrix_L[1,3] := 0.0015; aMatrix_L[1,4] := 0.0000;
    aMatrix_L[2,1] := 0.0150; aMatrix_L[2,2] := 0.3200; aMatrix_L[2,3] := 0.0000; aMatrix_L[2,4] := 0.0000;
    aMatrix_L[3,1] := 0.0001; aMatrix_L[3,2] := 0.0000; aMatrix_L[3,3] := 0.0150; aMatrix_L[3,4] := 0.0025;
    aMatrix_L[4,1] := 0.0040; aMatrix_L[4,2] := 0.0000; aMatrix_L[4,3] := 0.3800; aMatrix_L[4,4] := 0.0010;
    aMatrix_L[5,1] := 0.0010; aMatrix_L[5,2] := 0.0000; aMatrix_L[5,3] := 0.0085; aMatrix_L[5,4] := 0.2950;
    aMatrix_L[6,1] := 0.0080; aMatrix_L[6,2] := 0.0045; aMatrix_L[6,3] := 0.0000; aMatrix_L[6,4] := 0.0000;

    bInitializationComplete := TRUE;
END_IF;

(* ========================================================================================================= *)
(* 1. SIL-3 HARDWARE INTERLOCK EVALUATION & SAFETY WORD ENCODING                              *)
(* ========================================================================================================= *)
wSafetyInterlockWord.0  := bEmergencyStop;                  (* Bit 0: Hardware E-Stop Circuit OK *)
wSafetyInterlockWord.1  := bContainmentInertN2;             (* Bit 1: Secondary Containment N2 Blanket OK *)
wSafetyInterlockWord.2  := bVentilationAirflowOK;           (* Bit 2: ATEX Enclosure Ventilation Dilution OK *)
wSafetyInterlockWord.3  := (rCoolantFlowRate_Lmin >= 12.0);  (* Bit 3: Minimum Coolant Hydraulic Circulation OK *)
wSafetyInterlockWord.4  := (rH2SupplyPressure_bar < 48.0);  (* Bit 4: H2 Supply Header Within Maximum Proof Pressure *)
wSafetyInterlockWord.5  := NOT bStressInterlockLatched;     (* Bit 5: Vessel Dilatometry Stress Permissive *)
wSafetyInterlockWord.6  := NOT bThermalRunawayLatched;      (* Bit 6: Metal Hydride Core Thermal Exotherm Safe *)
wSafetyInterlockWord.7  := NOT bHydrogenLeakDetected;       (* Bit 7: Enclosure Lower Flammability Limit (<10% LFL) *)
wSafetyInterlockWord.8  := NOT bDualChannelFailure;         (* Bit 8: Redundancy Channel Integrity Sustained *)
wSafetyInterlockWord.9  := bFuelCellRunPermit;              (* Bit 9: Fuel Cell Interface Handshake Active *)
wSafetyInterlockWord.10 := (rCoolantReturnTemp_DegC < 75.0); (* Bit 10: Plate Heat Exchanger Fluid Overheat Safe *)
wSafetyInterlockWord.11 := (rBedPressure_bar_ChA < 45.0);   (* Bit 11: Chamber Absolute Pressure Below Rupture Disk *)
wSafetyInterlockWord.12 := TRUE;                            (* Bit 12: Reserved Interlock Bus A *)
wSafetyInterlockWord.13 := TRUE;                            (* Bit 13: Reserved Interlock Bus B *)
wSafetyInterlockWord.14 := TRUE;                            (* Bit 14: Reserved Interlock Bus C *)
wSafetyInterlockWord.15 := bInitializationComplete;         (* Bit 15: Algorithm Engine Initialized *)

(* Master Readiness Logic: Essential Safety Bits (0..8) must be TRUE *)
bSystemReady := ((wSafetyInterlockWord AND 16#01FF) = 16#01FF) AND bMasterEnable;

(* Fail-Safe Emergency Shutdown Relay Actuation *)
IF NOT bEmergencyStop OR bThermalRunawayLatched OR bHydrogenLeakDetected THEN
    bH2SafetyShutoffValve_Cmd  := FALSE; (* De-energize to trip *)
    bAlarmCriticalTrip         := TRUE;
    iOperatingState            := 99;    (* Immediate Jump to Emergency Lockout *)
END_IF;

(* ========================================================================================================= *)
(* 2. 2oo3 TRIPLE MODULAR REDUNDANCY (TMR) SENSOR VOTING ALGORITHMS                          *)
(* ========================================================================================================= *)
(* --- A. Hydrogen Bed Pressure 2oo3 Voting --- *)
rPress_Dev_AB := ABS(rBedPressure_bar_ChA - rBedPressure_bar_ChB);
rPress_Dev_BC := ABS(rBedPressure_bar_ChB - rBedPressure_bar_ChC);
rPress_Dev_CA := ABS(rBedPressure_bar_ChC - rBedPressure_bar_ChA);

bPress_ChA_Healthy := (rBedPressure_bar_ChA >= 0.0) AND (rBedPressure_bar_ChA <= 55.0);
bPress_ChB_Healthy := (rBedPressure_bar_ChB >= 0.0) AND (rBedPressure_bar_ChB <= 55.0);
bPress_ChC_Healthy := (rBedPressure_bar_ChC >= 0.0) AND (rBedPressure_bar_ChC <= 55.0);

(* Cross-channel discrepancy checks *)
IF (rPress_Dev_AB > rPressMaxDiscrepancy_bar) AND (rPress_Dev_CA > rPressMaxDiscrepancy_bar) THEN
    bPress_ChA_Healthy := FALSE; (* Channel A isolated as outlier *)
ELSIF (rPress_Dev_AB > rPressMaxDiscrepancy_bar) AND (rPress_Dev_BC > rPressMaxDiscrepancy_bar) THEN
    bPress_ChB_Healthy := FALSE; (* Channel B isolated as outlier *)
ELSIF (rPress_Dev_BC > rPressMaxDiscrepancy_bar) AND (rPress_Dev_CA > rPressMaxDiscrepancy_bar) THEN
    bPress_ChC_Healthy := FALSE; (* Channel C isolated as outlier *)
END_IF;

(* Full 2oo3 Median-of-Three or Degraded 2oo2 / 1oo1 Selection *)
IF bPress_ChA_Healthy AND bPress_ChB_Healthy AND bPress_ChC_Healthy THEN
    (* Pristine 2oo3: Exact Median Value *)
    rVotedBedPressure_bar := MAX(
        MIN(rBedPressure_bar_ChA, rBedPressure_bar_ChB),
        MIN(MAX(rBedPressure_bar_ChA, rBedPressure_bar_ChB), rBedPressure_bar_ChC)
    );
ELSIF bPress_ChA_Healthy AND bPress_ChB_Healthy THEN
    rVotedBedPressure_bar := (rBedPressure_bar_ChA + rBedPressure_bar_ChB) * 0.5;
    bSingleChannelFailure := TRUE;
ELSIF bPress_ChB_Healthy AND bPress_ChC_Healthy THEN
    rVotedBedPressure_bar := (rBedPressure_bar_ChB + rBedPressure_bar_ChC) * 0.5;
    bSingleChannelFailure := TRUE;
ELSIF bPress_ChA_Healthy AND bPress_ChC_Healthy THEN
    rVotedBedPressure_bar := (rBedPressure_bar_ChA + rBedPressure_bar_ChC) * 0.5;
    bSingleChannelFailure := TRUE;
ELSIF bPress_ChA_Healthy THEN
    rVotedBedPressure_bar := rBedPressure_bar_ChA;
    bDualChannelFailure   := TRUE;
ELSIF bPress_ChB_Healthy THEN
    rVotedBedPressure_bar := rBedPressure_bar_ChB;
    bDualChannelFailure   := TRUE;
ELSIF bPress_ChC_Healthy THEN
    rVotedBedPressure_bar := rBedPressure_bar_ChC;
    bDualChannelFailure   := TRUE;
ELSE
    rVotedBedPressure_bar := 50.0; (* Fail-safe trip overpressure *)
    bAlarmCriticalTrip    := TRUE;
END_IF;

(* --- B. Hydride Bed Core Temperature 2oo3 Voting --- *)
rTemp_Dev_AB := ABS(rBedTemp_DegC_ChA - rBedTemp_DegC_ChB);
rTemp_Dev_BC := ABS(rBedTemp_DegC_ChB - rBedTemp_DegC_ChC);
rTemp_Dev_CA := ABS(rBedTemp_DegC_ChC - rBedTemp_DegC_ChA);

bTemp_ChA_Healthy := (rBedTemp_DegC_ChA >= -30.0) AND (rBedTemp_DegC_ChA <= 120.0);
bTemp_ChB_Healthy := (rBedTemp_DegC_ChB >= -30.0) AND (rBedTemp_DegC_ChB <= 120.0);
bTemp_ChC_Healthy := (rBedTemp_DegC_ChC >= -30.0) AND (rBedTemp_DegC_ChC <= 120.0);

IF (rTemp_Dev_AB > rTempMaxDiscrepancy_DegC) AND (rTemp_Dev_CA > rTempMaxDiscrepancy_DegC) THEN
    bTemp_ChA_Healthy := FALSE;
ELSIF (rTemp_Dev_AB > rTempMaxDiscrepancy_DegC) AND (rTemp_Dev_BC > rTempMaxDiscrepancy_DegC) THEN
    bTemp_ChB_Healthy := FALSE;
ELSIF (rTemp_Dev_BC > rTempMaxDiscrepancy_DegC) AND (rTemp_Dev_CA > rTempMaxDiscrepancy_DegC) THEN
    bTemp_ChC_Healthy := FALSE;
END_IF;

IF bTemp_ChA_Healthy AND bTemp_ChB_Healthy AND bTemp_ChC_Healthy THEN
    rVotedBedTemp_DegC := MAX(
        MIN(rBedTemp_DegC_ChA, rBedTemp_DegC_ChB),
        MIN(MAX(rBedTemp_DegC_ChA, rBedTemp_DegC_ChB), rBedTemp_DegC_ChC)
    );
ELSIF bTemp_ChA_Healthy AND bTemp_ChB_Healthy THEN
    rVotedBedTemp_DegC := (rBedTemp_DegC_ChA + rBedTemp_DegC_ChB) * 0.5;
    bSingleChannelFailure := TRUE;
ELSIF bTemp_ChB_Healthy AND bTemp_ChC_Healthy THEN
    rVotedBedTemp_DegC := (rBedTemp_DegC_ChB + rBedTemp_DegC_ChC) * 0.5;
    bSingleChannelFailure := TRUE;
ELSIF bTemp_ChA_Healthy AND bTemp_ChC_Healthy THEN
    rVotedBedTemp_DegC := (rBedTemp_DegC_ChA + rBedTemp_DegC_ChC) * 0.5;
    bSingleChannelFailure := TRUE;
ELSIF bTemp_ChA_Healthy THEN
    rVotedBedTemp_DegC := rBedTemp_DegC_ChA;
    bDualChannelFailure   := TRUE;
ELSIF bTemp_ChB_Healthy THEN
    rVotedBedTemp_DegC := rBedTemp_DegC_ChB;
    bDualChannelFailure   := TRUE;
ELSIF bTemp_ChC_Healthy THEN
    rVotedBedTemp_DegC := rBedTemp_DegC_ChC;
    bDualChannelFailure   := TRUE;
ELSE
    rVotedBedTemp_DegC := 95.0; (* Overheat fail-safe fallback *)
    bAlarmCriticalTrip := TRUE;
END_IF;

(* --- C. Structural Dilatometry Hoop Stress 2oo3 Voting --- *)
rStress_Dev_AB := ABS(rWallStress_MPa_ChA - rWallStress_MPa_ChB);
rStress_Dev_BC := ABS(rWallStress_MPa_ChB - rWallStress_MPa_ChC);
rStress_Dev_CA := ABS(rWallStress_MPa_ChC - rWallStress_MPa_ChA);

bStress_ChA_Healthy := (rWallStress_MPa_ChA >= -10.0) AND (rWallStress_MPa_ChA <= 250.0);
bStress_ChB_Healthy := (rWallStress_MPa_ChB >= -10.0) AND (rWallStress_MPa_ChB <= 250.0);
bStress_ChC_Healthy := (rWallStress_MPa_ChC >= -10.0) AND (rWallStress_MPa_ChC <= 250.0);

IF (rStress_Dev_AB > rStressMaxDiscrepancy_MPa) AND (rStress_Dev_CA > rStressMaxDiscrepancy_MPa) THEN
    bStress_ChA_Healthy := FALSE;
ELSIF (rStress_Dev_AB > rStressMaxDiscrepancy_MPa) AND (rStress_Dev_BC > rStressMaxDiscrepancy_MPa) THEN
    bStress_ChB_Healthy := FALSE;
ELSIF (rStress_Dev_BC > rStressMaxDiscrepancy_MPa) AND (rStress_Dev_CA > rStressMaxDiscrepancy_MPa) THEN
    bStress_ChC_Healthy := FALSE;
END_IF;

IF bStress_ChA_Healthy AND bStress_ChB_Healthy AND bStress_ChC_Healthy THEN
    rVotedWallStress_MPa := MAX(
        MIN(rWallStress_MPa_ChA, rWallStress_MPa_ChB),
        MIN(MAX(rWallStress_MPa_ChA, rWallStress_MPa_ChB), rWallStress_MPa_ChC)
    );
ELSIF bStress_ChA_Healthy AND bStress_ChB_Healthy THEN
    rVotedWallStress_MPa := (rWallStress_MPa_ChA + rWallStress_MPa_ChB) * 0.5;
    bSingleChannelFailure := TRUE;
ELSIF bStress_ChB_Healthy AND bStress_ChC_Healthy THEN
    rVotedWallStress_MPa := (rWallStress_MPa_ChB + rWallStress_MPa_ChC) * 0.5;
    bSingleChannelFailure := TRUE;
ELSIF bStress_ChA_Healthy AND bStress_ChC_Healthy THEN
    rVotedWallStress_MPa := (rWallStress_MPa_ChA + rWallStress_MPa_ChC) * 0.5;
    bSingleChannelFailure := TRUE;
ELSIF bStress_ChA_Healthy THEN
    rVotedWallStress_MPa := rWallStress_MPa_ChA;
    bDualChannelFailure   := TRUE;
ELSIF bStress_ChB_Healthy THEN
    rVotedWallStress_MPa := rWallStress_MPa_ChB;
    bDualChannelFailure   := TRUE;
ELSIF bStress_ChC_Healthy THEN
    rVotedWallStress_MPa := rWallStress_MPa_ChC;
    bDualChannelFailure   := TRUE;
ELSE
    rVotedWallStress_MPa := 220.0; (* Overstress fail-safe fallback *)
    bAlarmCriticalTrip   := TRUE;
END_IF;

(* TMR Health Telemetry Word Construction *)
wTmrDiagnosticWord.0 := bPress_ChA_Healthy;
wTmrDiagnosticWord.1 := bPress_ChB_Healthy;
wTmrDiagnosticWord.2 := bPress_ChC_Healthy;
wTmrDiagnosticWord.3 := bTemp_ChA_Healthy;
wTmrDiagnosticWord.4 := bTemp_ChB_Healthy;
wTmrDiagnosticWord.5 := bTemp_ChC_Healthy;
wTmrDiagnosticWord.6 := bStress_ChA_Healthy;
wTmrDiagnosticWord.7 := bStress_ChB_Healthy;
wTmrDiagnosticWord.8 := bStress_ChC_Healthy;
wTmrDiagnosticWord.9 := NOT bSingleChannelFailure;
wTmrDiagnosticWord.10 := NOT bDualChannelFailure;
bDegradedModeActive := bSingleChannelFailure AND NOT bDualChannelFailure;

(* ========================================================================================================= *)
(* 3. DYNAMIC VAN 'T HOFF EQUILIBRIUM & REACTION KINETIC OBSERVER                            *)
(* ========================================================================================================= *)
rBedTemp_Kelvin := rVotedBedTemp_DegC + 273.15;
IF rBedTemp_Kelvin < 240.0 THEN
    rBedTemp_Kelvin := 240.0; (* Prevent division by cryogenic singularity *)
END_IF;

(* Distinguish Absorption vs Desorption Thermodynamics via Net Mass Flow *)
IF rH2MassFlow_Nm3h > 0.05 THEN
    (* Absorption Exothermic Mode *)
    rReactionDirectionSign := 1.0;
    (* Van 't Hoff Equation: ln(Peq/P0) = (dH_abs / (R * T)) - (dS_abs / R) + HysteresisOffset *)
    rVanTHoffExpTerm := (rEnthalpyAbsorption_J_mol / (rGasConstant_R * rBedTemp_Kelvin)) - (rEntropyAbsorption_J_molK / rGasConstant_R) + (rHysteresisFactor * 0.5);
ELSIF rFuelCellDemandFlow_Nm3h > 0.05 THEN
    (* Desorption Endothermic Mode *)
    rReactionDirectionSign := -1.0;
    (* Van 't Hoff Equation: ln(Peq/P0) = (dH_des / (R * T)) - (dS_des / R) - HysteresisOffset *)
    rVanTHoffExpTerm := (-rEnthalpyDesorption_J_mol / (rGasConstant_R * rBedTemp_Kelvin)) + (rEntropyDesorption_J_molK / rGasConstant_R) - (rHysteresisFactor * 0.5);
ELSE
    (* Static Isothermal Idle Equilibrium *)
    rReactionDirectionSign := 0.0;
    rVanTHoffExpTerm := (rEnthalpyAbsorption_J_mol / (rGasConstant_R * rBedTemp_Kelvin)) - (rEntropyAbsorption_J_molK / rGasConstant_R);
END_IF;

(* Non-ideal PCI Plateau Slope Correction Polynomial: phi(SoC) *)
(* Real metal hydride isotherms exhibit a non-zero slope and inflection at two-phase limits *)
rPlateauSlopeCorrection := 0.240 * (aStateEstimate_xHat[3] - 0.50);
IF aStateEstimate_xHat[3] > 0.85 THEN
    (* Alpha + Beta -> Beta phase saturation steep pressure rise *)
    rPlateauSlopeCorrection := rPlateauSlopeCorrection + (1.85 * (aStateEstimate_xHat[3] - 0.85));
ELSIF aStateEstimate_xHat[3] < 0.15 THEN
    (* Alpha solid-solution region depression *)
    rPlateauSlopeCorrection := rPlateauSlopeCorrection - (1.45 * (0.15 - aStateEstimate_xHat[3]));
END_IF;

(* Calculate Equilibrium Plateau Pressure via Exponentiation *)
rEquilibriumPlateauPress_bar := rStandardPressure_bar * EXP(LIMIT(-4.0, rVanTHoffExpTerm + rPlateauSlopeCorrection, 5.0));
rPlateauOverpressure_bar := rVotedBedPressure_bar - rEquilibriumPlateauPress_bar;

(* Real-time Sized Sorption Enthalpy Generation / Absorption Heat Flux [kW] *)
(* 1 Nm3 H2 = 44.64 mol H2 -> Enthalpy Rate = Flow * 44.64 * abs(dH) / 3600 *)
rReactionEnthalpyFlow_kW := (ABS(rH2MassFlow_Nm3h) * 44.643 * ABS(rEnthalpyAbsorption_J_mol)) / 3600000.0;

(* ========================================================================================================= *)
(* 4. DILATOMETRY EXPANSION INTERLOCK & POWDER COMPACTION OBSERVER                           *)
(* ========================================================================================================= *)
(* Dynamic Strain Rate Differentiator dSigma/dt [MPa/s] *)
IF rScanCycleTime_Sec > 0.001 THEN
    rRawStressDerivative := (rVotedWallStress_MPa - rPrevVotedStress_MPa) / rScanCycleTime_Sec;
    rFilteredStressRate_MPa_s := (rStrainRateFilterAlpha * rRawStressDerivative) + ((1.0 - rStrainRateFilterAlpha) * rFilteredStressRate_MPa_s);
    rPrevVotedStress_MPa := rVotedWallStress_MPa;
    (* Convert Hoop Stress Rate to Microstrain Rate: deps/dt = dsigma/dt / E * 1e6 *)
    rDilatometryStrainRate_ue_s := (rFilteredStressRate_MPa_s / rYoungsModulus_Vessel_MPa) * 1000000.0;
END_IF;

(* Estimated Metal Hydride Lattice Volumetric Expansion (%) *)
rLatticeVolExpansion_Pct := aStateEstimate_xHat[3] * rCompactionLatticeExpansionRate * 100.0;

(* Multi-Tier Dilatometry Protection Interlocks *)
IF rVotedWallStress_MPa >= rStressCriticalTrip_MPa THEN
    (* SIL-3 Critical Trip: Hard plastic deformation prevention *)
    bStressInterlockLatched := TRUE;
    nHighStressEventsCounter := nHighStressEventsCounter + 1;
    rH2ChargeControlValve_Pct := 0.0; (* Immediate isolate hydriding *)
    iOperatingState := 90;            (* Jump to Stress Mitigation Backoff *)
ELSIF (rVotedWallStress_MPa >= rStressWarningLimit_MPa) OR (rDilatometryStrainRate_ue_s > 45.0) THEN
    (* Pre-trip warning: Dynamic hydriding flow derating *)
    wAlarmAggregatedWord.5 := TRUE;   (* Set High Vessel Dilatometry Stress Warning *)
ELSE
    wAlarmAggregatedWord.5 := FALSE;
END_IF;

(* ========================================================================================================= *)
(* 5. FULL STATE-SPACE OBSERVER & MODEL PREDICTIVE CONTROL OPTIMIZER                         *)
(* ========================================================================================================= *)
(* Assemble Observation Vector y[1..4] from 2oo3 Validated Sensors *)
aSensorMeasurement_y[1] := rVotedBedTemp_DegC;
aSensorMeasurement_y[2] := rCoolantReturnTemp_DegC;
aSensorMeasurement_y[3] := rVotedBedPressure_bar;
aSensorMeasurement_y[4] := rVotedWallStress_MPa;

(* A. Luenberger Observer Innovation Residual: e_y = y - C * x_hat *)
FOR iLoopIndexI := 1 TO 4 DO
    rTempSum := 0.0;
    FOR iLoopIndexJ := 1 TO 6 DO
        rTempSum := rTempSum + (aMatrix_C[iLoopIndexI, iLoopIndexJ] * aStateEstimate_xHat[iLoopIndexJ]);
    END_FOR;
    aObserverResidual_eY[iLoopIndexI] := aSensorMeasurement_y[iLoopIndexI] - rTempSum;
END_FOR;

(* B. State Vector Prediction & Correction Update: x_hat[k+1] = A * x_hat + B * u + L * e_y *)
FOR iLoopIndexI := 1 TO 6 DO
    rTempSum := 0.0;
    FOR iLoopIndexJ := 1 TO 6 DO
        rTempSum := rTempSum + (aMatrix_A[iLoopIndexI, iLoopIndexJ] * aStateEstimate_xHat[iLoopIndexJ]);
    END_FOR;
    (* Add input coupling B * u *)
    FOR iLoopIndexK := 1 TO 3 DO
        rTempSum := rTempSum + (aMatrix_B[iLoopIndexI, iLoopIndexK] * aControl_u[iLoopIndexK]);
    END_FOR;
    (* Add observer correction L * e_y *)
    FOR iLoopIndexK := 1 TO 4 DO
        rTempSum := rTempSum + (aMatrix_L[iLoopIndexI, iLoopIndexK] * aObserverResidual_eY[iLoopIndexK]);
    END_FOR;
    aStateEstimate_xHat[iLoopIndexI] := rTempSum;
END_FOR;

(* Saturate Physical Limits on Estimated States *)
aStateEstimate_xHat[3] := LIMIT(0.0, aStateEstimate_xHat[3], 1.0);  (* State of Charge [%] *)
aStateEstimate_xHat[6] := LIMIT(0.0, aStateEstimate_xHat[6], 1.0);  (* PCM Molten Fraction [%] *)
rCurrentStateOfCharge_Pct := aStateEstimate_xHat[3] * 100.0;
rPCMLiquidFraction_Pct   := aStateEstimate_xHat[6] * 100.0;
rNetStoredH2Mass_kg       := aStateEstimate_xHat[3] * rMaxStorageCapacity_kg;

(* C. Update Target Reference Trajectories & Error Vector *)
aStateTarget_xRef[3] := LIMIT(0.05, rTargetSoC_Pct / 100.0, 0.98);
IF iOperatingState = 40 THEN
    (* Hydriding Absorption Target Operating Window *)
    aStateTarget_xRef[1] := 32.0; (* Optimal reaction plateau temperature [deg C] *)
    aStateTarget_xRef[4] := rEquilibriumPlateauPress_bar + 4.5; (* 4.5 bar driving overpressure *)
    aStateTarget_xRef[5] := 115.0; (* Controlled safe dilatometry stress *)
ELSIF iOperatingState = 70 THEN
    (* Dehydriding Desorption Target Operating Window *)
    aStateTarget_xRef[1] := 55.0; (* Elevated temperature to boost desorption plateau *)
    aStateTarget_xRef[4] := MAX(rMinFuelCellDeliveryPress_bar + 1.2, 5.0);
    aStateTarget_xRef[5] := 45.0; (* Relaxed stress state during discharge *)
ELSE
    aStateTarget_xRef[1] := 22.0;
    aStateTarget_xRef[4] := 10.0;
    aStateTarget_xRef[5] := 25.0;
END_IF;

FOR iLoopIndexI := 1 TO 6 DO
    aStateTrackingError[iLoopIndexI] := aStateEstimate_xHat[iLoopIndexI] - aStateTarget_xRef[iLoopIndexI];
END_FOR;

(* D. Real-Time Model Predictive Control (Active-Set Projected Gradient Descent) *)
(* Quadratic Cost: J = 0.5 * eX^T * Q * eX + 0.5 * u^T * R * u + 0.5 * du^T * S * du *)
FOR iMpcIter := 1 TO 12 DO
    (* 1. Forward 1-Step Prediction under Current Control Estimate *)
    FOR iLoopIndexI := 1 TO 6 DO
        rTempSum := 0.0;
        FOR iLoopIndexJ := 1 TO 6 DO
            rTempSum := rTempSum + (aMatrix_A[iLoopIndexI, iLoopIndexJ] * aStateEstimate_xHat[iLoopIndexJ]);
        END_FOR;
        FOR iLoopIndexK := 1 TO 3 DO
            rTempSum := rTempSum + (aMatrix_B[iLoopIndexI, iLoopIndexK] * aControl_u[iLoopIndexK]);
        END_FOR;
        aStatePredict_xPred[iLoopIndexI] := rTempSum;
    END_FOR;

    (* 2. Analytical Gradient Computation: grad_J = B^T * Q * (x_pred - x_ref) + R * u + S * (u - u_prev) *)
    FOR iLoopIndexK := 1 TO 3 DO
        rTempSum := 0.0;
        FOR iLoopIndexI := 1 TO 6 DO
            rTempSum := rTempSum + (aMatrix_B[iLoopIndexI, iLoopIndexK] * aWeights_Q[iLoopIndexI] * (aStatePredict_xPred[iLoopIndexI] - aStateTarget_xRef[iLoopIndexI]));
        END_FOR;
        rTempSum := rTempSum + (aWeights_R[iLoopIndexK] * aControl_u[iLoopIndexK]);
        rTempSum := rTempSum + (aWeights_S[iLoopIndexK] * (aControl_u[iLoopIndexK] - aControl_uPrev[iLoopIndexK]));
        aMpcGradient[iLoopIndexK] := rTempSum;
    END_FOR;

    (* 3. Projected Gradient Descent Update with Dilatometry Wall Stress Back-off *)
    FOR iLoopIndexK := 1 TO 3 DO
        rMpcTempControlVal := aControl_u[iLoopIndexK] - (rMpcStepSize * aMpcGradient[iLoopIndexK]);
        (* Enforce Hard Actuator Polyhedral Box Saturation *)
        IF iLoopIndexK = 1 THEN
            (* Hydrogen Flow Throttle Valve [0..100 %] *)
            IF rVotedWallStress_MPa > rStressWarningLimit_MPa THEN
                (* Dynamic Dilatometry Clamping to Relieve Compaction Stress *)
                rMpcTempControlVal := MIN(rMpcTempControlVal, 35.0);
            END_IF;
            aControl_u[1] := LIMIT(0.0, rMpcTempControlVal, 100.0);
        ELSIF iLoopIndexK = 2 THEN
            (* Coolant Circulation Pump [15..100 %] *)
            aControl_u[2] := LIMIT(15.0, rMpcTempControlVal, 100.0);
        ELSE
            (* Thermal Sync 3-Way Valve [0=Chiller, 100=Heater] *)
            aControl_u[3] := LIMIT(0.0, rMpcTempControlVal, 100.0);
        END_IF;
    END_FOR;
END_FOR;

(* Record Control Slew Rate & Update Historic Memory *)
FOR iLoopIndexK := 1 TO 3 DO
    aControl_Delta_u[iLoopIndexK] := aControl_u[iLoopIndexK] - aControl_uPrev[iLoopIndexK];
    aControl_uPrev[iLoopIndexK]   := aControl_u[iLoopIndexK];
END_FOR;

(* ========================================================================================================= *)
(* 6. FINITE STATE MACHINE PROCESS SEQUENCER (CASE 0 TO 99)                                  *)
(* ========================================================================================================= *)

        rH2DischargeControlValve_Pct    := 0.0;

        rCoolant3WayValve_Pct           := 50.0;
        rAuxHeatingDemand_kW            := 0.0;

        IF tEquilibrationSoakTimer.Q THEN

        END_IF;

    70: (* ---------------- DEHYDRIDING ENDOTHERMIC DISCHARGE TO FUEL CELL ---------------- *)
        bH2SafetyShutoffValve_Cmd       := TRUE;
        rH2ChargeControlValve_Pct       := 0.0;
        
        (* Throttle Discharge Valve to Match Fuel Cell Flow Request while Guarding Backpressure *)
        IF rVotedBedPressure_bar < (rMinFuelCellDeliveryPress_bar + 0.5) THEN
            (* Fuel Cell Starvation Risk: Choke discharge valve to protect bed plateau *)
            rH2DischargeControlValve_Pct := LIMIT(5.0, (rVotedBedPressure_bar / rMinFuelCellDeliveryPress_bar) * 45.0, 60.0);

        bH2SafetyShutoffValve_Cmd       := TRUE;

        rAuxHeatingDemand_kW            := 25.0;
        
        IF (rCurrentStateOfCharge_Pct <= 3.0) OR (rVotedBedPressure_bar < rMinFuelCellDeliveryPress_bar) THEN
            rH2DischargeControlValve_Pct := 0.0;

        rH2DischargeControlValve_Pct    := 0.0;
        bInertGasPurgeValve_Cmd         := TRUE;

        rCoolantPumpDemand_Pct          := 50.0;

        END_IF;

    90: (* ---------------- DILATOMETRY STRESS MITIGATION & BACK-OFF ---------------- *)
        (* Active stress relief: stop hydriding, boost chilling to shrink bed, open micro-relief *)
        rH2ChargeControlValve_Pct       := 0.0;
        bH2SafetyShutoffValve_Cmd       := FALSE;
        rCoolant3WayValve_Pct           := 0.0;   (* Maximum chilling *)
        rCoolantPumpDemand_Pct          := 100.0; (* Maximum thermal dissipation *)
        rAuxHeatingDemand_kW            := 0.0;
        
        (* Soak timer for dilatometry stress relaxation *)
        tStressRelaxationTimer(IN := (rVotedWallStress_MPa < rStressWarningLimit_MPa), PT := T#5M);
        
        IF tStressRelaxationTimer.Q THEN
            tStressRelaxationTimer(IN := FALSE);

            iOperatingState         := 50; (* Resume Standby *)
        END_IF;

    95: (* ---------------- DEGRADED GRACEFUL OPERATION (DERATED PROFILE) ---------------- *)
        (* Permitted operation with 2oo2 sensor configuration under reduced boundaries *)
        bDegradedModeActive             := TRUE;
        rH2ChargeControlValve_Pct       := LIMIT(0.0, aControl_u[1] * 0.60, 40.0);
        rH2DischargeControlValve_Pct    := LIMIT(0.0, aControl_u[1] * 0.70, 50.0);
        rCoolantPumpDemand_Pct          := 75.0;

        END_IF;

        rH2DischargeControlValve_Pct    := 0.0;
        bEmergencyDepressValve_Cmd      := TRUE; (* Route hydrogen to atmospheric vent / flare *)
        rCoolantPumpDemand_Pct          := 100.0;
        bInertGasPurgeValve_Cmd         := TRUE; (* Nitrogen blanket displacement *)
        
        IF rVotedBedPressure_bar <= 1.2 THEN
            bEmergencyDepressValve_Cmd := FALSE;
            iOperatingState            := 99;
        END_IF;

    99: (* ---------------- CRITICAL EMERGENCY LOCKOUT TRIP ---------------- *)
        bH2SafetyShutoffValve_Cmd       := FALSE; (* Positive spring-return mechanical closure *)
        rH2ChargeControlValve_Pct       := 0.0;
        rH2DischargeControlValve_Pct    := 0.0;
        rCoolantPumpDemand_Pct          := 100.0; (* Continuous emergency heat removal *)
        rCoolant3WayValve_Pct           := 0.0;   (* Direct to emergency chiller *)
        rAuxHeatingDemand_kW            := 0.0;

        bInertGasPurgeValve_Cmd         := FALSE;
        bAlarmCriticalTrip              := TRUE;

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* 1. HARDWARE SAFETY INTERLOCK WATCHDOG & EMERGENCY DE-ENERGIZATION                                 *)
(* Strict compliance with IEC 61508 / IEC 61511 Functional Safety SIL-2 Interlocking                  *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
IF NOT bEStop THEN
    bAlarmTrip := TRUE;
    bSystemReady := FALSE;
    bRegenActive := FALSE;
    rSteamControlValve_pct := 0.0;         (* Spring-return fail-safe shut on superheated steam *)
    rVacuumPumpSpeed_pct := 0.0;           (* Decelerate vacuum extraction blower *)
    rSorbentBedSpeed_rpm := 0.0;           (* Mechanical brake on moving bed rotary valves *)
    rThermoclineValve_pct := 0.0;          (* Isolate thermal storage fluid matrix *)
    rCondenserDuty_pct := 100.0;           (* 100% cooling water quench to arrest desorber vapors *)
    wAlarmWord1 := wAlarmWord1 OR 16#0001; (* Bit 0: Emergency Stop Safety Loop Open *)
    iState := 99;                          (* Trap in CRITICAL_TRIP_SAFE_PARK *)
    RETURN;
END_IF;

(* Manual Fault Reset & Alarm Acknowledgment Engine *)
IF bAckFault THEN
    wAlarmWord1 := 16#0000;
    wAlarmWord2 := 16#0000;
    wAlarmWord3 := 16#0000;
    bAlarmTrip := FALSE;
    IF iState = 99 THEN
        iState := 0;                       (* Return to BOOT_INITIALIZE after safety clearance *)
    END_IF;
END_IF;

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* 2. 2oo3 TRIPLE MODULAR REDUNDANCY (TMR) SENSOR VOTING & DISCREPANCY ISOLATION                    *)
(* Median selection, inter-channel deviation tracking, persistent drift accumulation, & degradation  *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* --- Sub-System A: Vacuum Pressure 2oo3 (PT_01A, PT_01B, PT_01C) [mbar] --- *)
bVacDiscrepancy_AB := ABS(rVacuumPress_A_mbar - rVacuumPress_B_mbar) > rVacDiscrepancyTol_mbar;
bVacDiscrepancy_BC := ABS(rVacuumPress_B_mbar - rVacuumPress_C_mbar) > rVacDiscrepancyTol_mbar;
bVacDiscrepancy_CA := ABS(rVacuumPress_C_mbar - rVacuumPress_A_mbar) > rVacDiscrepancyTol_mbar;

IF (NOT bVacDiscrepancy_AB) AND (NOT bVacDiscrepancy_BC) AND (NOT bVacDiscrepancy_CA) THEN
    (* Healthy Triplet: compute arithmetic mean / median *)
    rVoted_VacPress_mbar := (rVacuumPress_A_mbar + rVacuumPress_B_mbar + rVacuumPress_C_mbar) / 3.0;
    iVacHealthySensorCount := 3;
    bVacSensorFail_A := FALSE;
    bVacSensorFail_B := FALSE;
    bVacSensorFail_C := FALSE;
ELSIF (NOT bVacDiscrepancy_AB) AND (bVacDiscrepancy_BC AND bVacDiscrepancy_CA) THEN
    (* Channel C Diverged: degrade to 1oo2 on A and B *)
    rVoted_VacPress_mbar := (rVacuumPress_A_mbar + rVacuumPress_B_mbar) * 0.5;
    iVacHealthySensorCount := 2;
    bVacSensorFail_C := TRUE;
    wAlarmWord2 := wAlarmWord2 OR 16#0001; (* Bit 0: PT_01C Discrepancy Failure *)
ELSIF (NOT bVacDiscrepancy_BC) AND (bVacDiscrepancy_AB AND bVacDiscrepancy_CA) THEN
    (* Channel A Diverged: degrade to 1oo2 on B and C *)
    rVoted_VacPress_mbar := (rVacuumPress_B_mbar + rVacuumPress_C_mbar) * 0.5;
    iVacHealthySensorCount := 2;
    bVacSensorFail_A := TRUE;
    wAlarmWord2 := wAlarmWord2 OR 16#0002; (* Bit 1: PT_01A Discrepancy Failure *)
ELSIF (NOT bVacDiscrepancy_CA) AND (bVacDiscrepancy_AB AND bVacDiscrepancy_BC) THEN
    (* Channel B Diverged: degrade to 1oo2 on C and A *)
    rVoted_VacPress_mbar := (rVacuumPress_C_mbar + rVacuumPress_A_mbar) * 0.5;
    iVacHealthySensorCount := 2;
    bVacSensorFail_B := TRUE;
    wAlarmWord2 := wAlarmWord2 OR 16#0004; (* Bit 2: PT_01B Discrepancy Failure *)
ELSE
    (* Complete 2oo3 Voting Collapse: All three channels disagree beyond tolerance *)
    iVacHealthySensorCount := 0;
    wAlarmWord1 := wAlarmWord1 OR 16#0002; (* Bit 1: 2oo3 Vacuum Instrumentation Trip *)
    rVoted_VacPress_mbar := 1013.25;        (* Default to atmospheric failsafe *)
    bAlarmTrip := TRUE;
END_IF;

(* --- Sub-System B: Desorption Bed Temperature 2oo3 (TT_01A, TT_01B, TT_01C) [deg C] --- *)
bBedDiscrepancy_AB := ABS(rBedTemp_A_degC - rBedTemp_B_degC) > rBedDiscrepancyTol_degC;
bBedDiscrepancy_BC := ABS(rBedTemp_B_degC - rBedTemp_C_degC) > rBedDiscrepancyTol_degC;
bBedDiscrepancy_CA := ABS(rBedTemp_C_degC - rBedTemp_A_degC) > rBedDiscrepancyTol_degC;

IF (NOT bBedDiscrepancy_AB) AND (NOT bBedDiscrepancy_BC) AND (NOT bBedDiscrepancy_CA) THEN
    rVoted_BedTemp_degC := (rBedTemp_A_degC + rBedTemp_B_degC + rBedTemp_C_degC) / 3.0;
    iBedHealthySensorCount := 3;
    bBedSensorFail_A := FALSE;
    bBedSensorFail_B := FALSE;
    bBedSensorFail_C := FALSE;
ELSIF (NOT bBedDiscrepancy_AB) AND (bBedDiscrepancy_BC AND bBedDiscrepancy_CA) THEN
    rVoted_BedTemp_degC := (rBedTemp_A_degC + rBedTemp_B_degC) * 0.5;
    iBedHealthySensorCount := 2;
    bBedSensorFail_C := TRUE;
    wAlarmWord2 := wAlarmWord2 OR 16#0008; (* Bit 3: TT_01C Discrepancy Failure *)
ELSIF (NOT bBedDiscrepancy_BC) AND (bBedDiscrepancy_AB AND bBedDiscrepancy_CA) THEN
    rVoted_BedTemp_degC := (rBedTemp_B_degC + rBedTemp_C_degC) * 0.5;
    iBedHealthySensorCount := 2;
    bBedSensorFail_A := TRUE;
    wAlarmWord2 := wAlarmWord2 OR 16#0010; (* Bit 4: TT_01A Discrepancy Failure *)
ELSIF (NOT bBedDiscrepancy_CA) AND (bBedDiscrepancy_AB AND bBedDiscrepancy_BC) THEN
    rVoted_BedTemp_degC := (rBedTemp_C_degC + rBedTemp_A_degC) * 0.5;
    iBedHealthySensorCount := 2;
    bBedSensorFail_B := TRUE;
    wAlarmWord2 := wAlarmWord2 OR 16#0020; (* Bit 5: TT_01B Discrepancy Failure *)
ELSE
    iBedHealthySensorCount := 0;
    wAlarmWord1 := wAlarmWord1 OR 16#0004; (* Bit 2: 2oo3 Temperature Instrumentation Trip *)
    rVoted_BedTemp_degC := 140.0;           (* Safe high assumption to trip heaters *)
    bAlarmTrip := TRUE;
END_IF;

(* --- Sub-System C: Effluent Slip CO2 GC / NDIR 2oo3 (AT_01A, AT_01B, AT_01C) [ppm] --- *)
bSlipDiscrepancy_AB := ABS(rSlipCO2_A_ppm - rSlipCO2_B_ppm) > rSlipDiscrepancyTol_ppm;
bSlipDiscrepancy_BC := ABS(rSlipCO2_B_ppm - rSlipCO2_C_ppm) > rSlipDiscrepancyTol_ppm;
bSlipDiscrepancy_CA := ABS(rSlipCO2_C_ppm - rSlipCO2_A_ppm) > rSlipDiscrepancyTol_ppm;

IF (NOT bSlipDiscrepancy_AB) AND (NOT bSlipDiscrepancy_BC) AND (NOT bSlipDiscrepancy_CA) THEN
    rVoted_SlipCO2_ppm := (rSlipCO2_A_ppm + rSlipCO2_B_ppm + rSlipCO2_C_ppm) / 3.0;
    iSlipHealthySensorCount := 3;
    bSlipSensorFail_A := FALSE;
    bSlipSensorFail_B := FALSE;
    bSlipSensorFail_C := FALSE;
ELSIF (NOT bSlipDiscrepancy_AB) AND (bSlipDiscrepancy_BC AND bSlipDiscrepancy_CA) THEN
    rVoted_SlipCO2_ppm := (rSlipCO2_A_ppm + rSlipCO2_B_ppm) * 0.5;
    iSlipHealthySensorCount := 2;
    bSlipSensorFail_C := TRUE;
    wAlarmWord2 := wAlarmWord2 OR 16#0040; (* Bit 6: AT_01C Analyzer Divergence *)
ELSIF (NOT bSlipDiscrepancy_BC) AND (bSlipDiscrepancy_AB AND bSlipDiscrepancy_CA) THEN
    rVoted_SlipCO2_ppm := (rSlipCO2_B_ppm + rSlipCO2_C_ppm) * 0.5;
    iSlipHealthySensorCount := 2;
    bSlipSensorFail_A := TRUE;
    wAlarmWord2 := wAlarmWord2 OR 16#0080; (* Bit 7: AT_01A Analyzer Divergence *)
ELSIF (NOT bSlipDiscrepancy_CA) AND (bSlipDiscrepancy_AB AND bSlipDiscrepancy_BC) THEN
    rVoted_SlipCO2_ppm := (rSlipCO2_C_ppm + rSlipCO2_A_ppm) * 0.5;
    iSlipHealthySensorCount := 2;
    bSlipSensorFail_B := TRUE;
    wAlarmWord2 := wAlarmWord2 OR 16#0100; (* Bit 8: AT_01B Analyzer Divergence *)
ELSE
    iSlipHealthySensorCount := 0;
    wAlarmWord2 := wAlarmWord2 OR 16#0200; (* Bit 9: 2oo3 Slip Analyzer Complete Degradation *)
    (* Graceful median fallback *)
    IF (rSlipCO2_A_ppm >= rSlipCO2_B_ppm AND rSlipCO2_A_ppm <= rSlipCO2_C_ppm) OR
       (rSlipCO2_A_ppm >= rSlipCO2_C_ppm AND rSlipCO2_A_ppm <= rSlipCO2_B_ppm) THEN
        rVoted_SlipCO2_ppm := rSlipCO2_A_ppm;
    ELSIF (rSlipCO2_B_ppm >= rSlipCO2_A_ppm AND rSlipCO2_B_ppm <= rSlipCO2_C_ppm) OR
          (rSlipCO2_B_ppm >= rSlipCO2_C_ppm AND rSlipCO2_B_ppm <= rSlipCO2_A_ppm) THEN
        rVoted_SlipCO2_ppm := rSlipCO2_B_ppm;
    ELSE
        rVoted_SlipCO2_ppm := rSlipCO2_C_ppm;
    END_IF;
END_IF;

(* Map voted slip signal to primary telemetry output *)
rSlipRate_ppm := rVoted_SlipCO2_ppm;

(* Evaluate Graceful Degradation flag *)
bDegradedMode := (iVacHealthySensorCount < 3) OR (iBedHealthySensorCount < 3) OR (iSlipHealthySensorCount < 3);

(* Sorbent Chemical Safety: Thermal Degradation Critical Trip *)
IF rVoted_BedTemp_degC >= rAMINE_MAX_TEMP_LIMIT THEN
    wAlarmWord1 := wAlarmWord1 OR 16#0008; (* Bit 3: Sorbent Amine Thermal Breakdown Trip *)
    bAlarmTrip := TRUE;
END_IF;

(* Environmental Slip Breakthrough Critical Trip *)
IF rVoted_SlipCO2_ppm >= rSLIP_BREAKTHRU_TRIP_PPM THEN
    wAlarmWord1 := wAlarmWord1 OR 16#0010; (* Bit 4: Contactor CO2 Breakthrough Trip *)
    bAlarmTrip := TRUE;
END_IF;

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* 3. SOLID-SORBENT ISOTHERM KINETICS & AMINE THERMAL AGING ACCUMULATOR                             *)
(* Non-linear dual-site Langmuir-Freundlich equilibrium loading and Arrhenius degradation rate       *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* Atmospheric CO2 Partial Pressure [bar] *)
rPartialPressCO2_bar := (rBarometricPress_mbar * 100.0) * (420.0 * 1.0E-6) / 100000.0;

(* Moisture Enhancement Factor: Bicarbonate reaction pathway under ambient humidity *)
rMoistureEnhanceFactor := 1.0 + (0.0035 * rAirRelHumidity_pct);
IF rMoistureEnhanceFactor > 1.35 THEN
    rMoistureEnhanceFactor := 1.35;
END_IF;

(* Dual-Site Langmuir-Freundlich Equilibrium Loading Calculation *)
rLangmuirTerm1 := rSite1_Capacity_molkg * (rAffinityConst1 * rPartialPressCO2_bar) / (1.0 + (rAffinityConst1 * rPartialPressCO2_bar));
rLangmuirTerm2 := rSite2_Capacity_molkg * (rAffinityConst2 * rPartialPressCO2_bar) / (1.0 + (rAffinityConst2 * rPartialPressCO2_bar));
rIsothermLoading_molkg := (rLangmuirTerm1 + rLangmuirTerm2) * rMoistureEnhanceFactor;

(* Arrhenius Thermal Degradation Rate of Supported Solid Amine: k_deg = A * exp(-Ea / (R * T)) *)
IF rVoted_BedTemp_degC > 85.0 THEN
    rDegradationRate_per_hr := rARRHENIUS_FREQ_FACTOR * EXP(- (rARRHENIUS_ACTIVATION_EA * 1000.0) / (rR_GAS_CONST * 1000.0 * (rVoted_BedTemp_degC + 273.15)));
    rCumulativeHoursAtTemp := rCumulativeHoursAtTemp + (rTS_CYCLE_SEC / 3600.0);
    rSorbentCapacityLoss_pct := rSorbentCapacityLoss_pct + (rDegradationRate_per_hr * (rTS_CYCLE_SEC / 3600.0) * 100.0);
    IF rSorbentCapacityLoss_pct > 25.0 THEN
        wAlarmWord3 := wAlarmWord3 OR 16#0001; (* Bit 0: Sorbent Lifetime Exceeded Warning *)
    END_IF;
END_IF;

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* 4. FIRST-PRINCIPLES MASS & ENERGY BALANCE AND RECOVERY KPIS                                       *)
(* Real-time estimation of capture mass, specific energy, and condensation heat recovery             *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* Air Density from Ideal Gas Law based on real barometric pressure and ambient temperature *)
rInletAirDensity_kgm3 := ((rBarometricPress_mbar * 100.0) * (rMOL_WEIGHT_AIR / 1000.0)) / (rR_GAS_CONST * 1000.0 * (rAirTemp_degC + 273.15));
rInletAirMassFlow_kgh := rAirFlowRate_m3h * rInletAirDensity_kgm3;

(* Inlet Carbon Dioxide Mass Flux *)
rInletCO2MassFlow_kgh := rInletAirMassFlow_kgh * (420.0 * 1.0E-6) * (rMOL_WEIGHT_CO2 / rMOL_WEIGHT_AIR);

(* Effluent Carbon Dioxide Slip Mass Flux *)
rEffluentCO2MassFlow_kgh := rInletAirMassFlow_kgh * (rVoted_SlipCO2_ppm * 1.0E-6) * (rMOL_WEIGHT_CO2 / rMOL_WEIGHT_AIR);

(* Net Real-Time CO2 Adsorption / Desorption Production Yield *)
rNetCaptureRate_kgh := rInletCO2MassFlow_kgh - rEffluentCO2MassFlow_kgh;
IF rNetCaptureRate_kgh < 0.0 THEN
    rNetCaptureRate_kgh := 0.0;
END_IF;
rCO2Production_kgh := rNetCaptureRate_kgh;

(* Instantaneous Contactor Capture Efficiency *)
IF rInletCO2MassFlow_kgh > 0.01 THEN
    rCaptureEfficiency_pct := (rNetCaptureRate_kgh / rInletCO2MassFlow_kgh) * 100.0;
ELSE
    rCaptureEfficiency_pct := 0.0;
END_IF;

(* Thermal & Electrical Energy Integration *)
rSteamSpecificThermal_kW := (rSteamFlow_kgh / 3600.0) * (rSteamEnthalpy_kJkg - (4.184 * rCondensateTemp_degC));
rTotalPower_kW := rSteamSpecificThermal_kW + (rVacuumPumpSpeed_pct * 0.52); (* Plus vacuum electrical work *)

IF rCO2Production_kgh > 0.05 THEN
    rSpecificEnergy_kJkgCO2 := (rTotalPower_kW * 3600.0) / rCO2Production_kgh;
ELSE
    rSpecificEnergy_kJkgCO2 := 9999.0;
END_IF;

(* Cumulative Integration *)
rTotalCO2Captured_kg := rTotalCO2Captured_kg + (rCO2Production_kgh * (rTS_CYCLE_SEC / 3600.0));
rTotalSteamConsumed_kg := rTotalSteamConsumed_kg + (rSteamFlow_kgh * (rTS_CYCLE_SEC / 3600.0));
rTotalThermalEnergy_kJ := rTotalThermalEnergy_kJ + (rSteamSpecificThermal_kW * rTS_CYCLE_SEC);
rTotalElectricEnergy_kJ := rTotalElectricEnergy_kJ + ((rVacuumPumpSpeed_pct * 0.52) * rTS_CYCLE_SEC);

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* 5. WASTE HEAT RECUPERATION THERMOCLINE NUMERICAL MODEL (8-NODE AXIAL PDE)                         *)
(* Finite-difference conduction-advection discretization tracking sensible thermocline front         *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* Thermal Front Migration Velocity v_th [m/s] *)
rThermoclineFrontVel := (rSorbentFeedRate_kgh / 3600.0) / (650.0 * rBedCrossSection_m2 * 0.58);

(* Boundary Condition: Top Node 1 in contact with hot regenerated sorbent discharge *)
rThermoclineNodes[1] := rThermoclineNodes[1] + ((rThermoclineInletTemp_degC - rThermoclineNodes[1]) * 0.12);

(* Interior Finite Difference PDE Discretization for Nodes 2 to 7 *)
FOR i := 2 TO 7 DO
    (* Axial thermal conduction component *)
    rNodeConduction := (rThermalDiffusivity_m2s / (rBedNodeHeight_m * rBedNodeHeight_m)) * 
                       (rThermoclineNodes[i - 1] - (2.0 * rThermoclineNodes[i]) + rThermoclineNodes[i + 1]);
    (* Axial convective advection component *)
    rNodeAdvection := - (rThermoclineFrontVel / rBedNodeHeight_m) * (rThermoclineNodes[i] - rThermoclineNodes[i - 1]);
    
    rThermoclineNodes[i] := rThermoclineNodes[i] + ((rNodeConduction + rNodeAdvection) * rTS_CYCLE_SEC * 12.0);
END_FOR;

(* Boundary Condition: Bottom Node 8 in contact with cold saturated incoming sorbent *)
rThermoclineNodes[8] := rThermoclineNodes[8] + ((rAirTemp_degC - rThermoclineNodes[8]) * 0.08);

(* Instantaneous Recuperated Sensible Heat Power [kW] *)
rRecupDuty_kW := (rSorbentFeedRate_kgh / 3600.0) * rCP_SORBENT * (rThermoclineNodes[1] - rThermoclineNodes[8]);
IF rRecupDuty_kW < 0.0 THEN
    rRecupDuty_kW := 0.0;
END_IF;

(* Exergy Efficiency of Thermal Stratification *)
IF (rThermoclineNodes[1] + 273.15) > 0.0 AND (rAirTemp_degC + 273.15) > 0.0 THEN
    rExergyEfficiency_pct := (1.0 - ((rAirTemp_degC + 273.15) / (rThermoclineNodes[1] + 273.15))) * 100.0;
ELSE
    rExergyEfficiency_pct := 0.0;
END_IF;

(* Peclet Number Diagnostic: checks advection dominance vs destratification conduction *)
IF rThermalDiffusivity_m2s > 1.0E-8 THEN
    rPecletNumber := (rThermoclineFrontVel * rBedNodeHeight_m) / rThermalDiffusivity_m2s;
END_IF;

(* Inversion Hazard Detection: Cold upper layer / hot lower layer destratification *)
IF (rThermoclineNodes[1] < rThermoclineNodes[4]) OR (rThermoclineNodes[2] < rThermoclineNodes[6]) THEN
    wAlarmWord2 := wAlarmWord2 OR 16#0400; (* Bit 10: Thermocline Thermal Stratification Inversion *)
END_IF;

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* 6. DISCRETE 4x4 STATE-SPACE CYBER-PHYSICAL OBSERVER (LUENBERGER ESTIMATION)                       *)
(* x(k+1) = Ad * x(k) + Bd * u(k) + Ld * (y_meas(k) - Cd * x(k))                                    *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* Map Physical Sensor Variables to Normalized Deviation Coordinates *)
rY_meas[1] := rVoted_BedTemp_degC - 100.0;         (* Deviation around 100 deg C operating point *)
rY_meas[2] := rVoted_VacPress_mbar - 220.0;        (* Deviation around 220 mbar deep vacuum *)
rY_meas[3] := rVoted_SlipCO2_ppm - 15.0;           (* Deviation around 15 ppm slip baseline *)
rY_meas[4] := rThermoclineNodes[3] - 80.0;         (* Deviation around 80 deg C thermocline core *)

(* Compute A Priori State Prediction: x_pred = Ad * x_hat + Bd * u_prev *)
FOR i := 1 TO 4 DO
    rTempSum := 0.0;
    FOR j := 1 TO 4 DO
        rTempSum := rTempSum + (Ad[i, j] * rX_hat[j]) + (Bd[i, j] * (rU_prev[j] * 0.01));
    END_FOR;
    rX_pred[i] := rTempSum;
END_FOR;

(* Compute Output Prediction: y_pred = Cd * x_pred *)
FOR i := 1 TO 4 DO
    rTempSum := 0.0;
    FOR j := 1 TO 4 DO
        rTempSum := rTempSum + (Cd[i, j] * rX_pred[j]);
    END_FOR;
    rY_pred[i] := rTempSum;
    rY_resid[i] := rY_meas[i] - rY_pred[i];         (* Innovation residual vector *)
END_FOR;

(* Correct State Estimate via Observer Gain: x_hat = x_pred + Ld * y_resid *)
FOR i := 1 TO 4 DO
    rTempSum := 0.0;
    FOR j := 1 TO 4 DO
        rTempSum := rTempSum + (Ld[i, j] * rY_resid[j]);
    END_FOR;
    rX_hat[i] := rX_pred[i] + rTempSum;
END_FOR;

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* 7. MODEL PREDICTIVE CONTROL (MPC) FINITE HORIZON QUADRATIC OPTIMIZATION ENGINE                    *)
(* Projected Gradient Descent with Diagonal Preconditioning & Actuator Slew Rate Constraints         *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* Update Multi-Step State Horizon Rollout (Np = 3) *)
FOR h := 1 TO 3 DO
    FOR i := 1 TO 4 DO
        rTempSum := 0.0;
        FOR j := 1 TO 4 DO
            IF h = 1 THEN
                rTempSum := rTempSum + (Ad[i, j] * rX_hat[j]) + (Bd[i, j] * (rU_opt[j] * 0.01));
            ELSE
                rTempSum := rTempSum + (Ad[i, j] * rX_horizon[h - 1, j]) + (Bd[i, j] * (rU_opt[j] * 0.01));
            END_IF;
        END_FOR;
        rX_horizon[h, i] := rTempSum;
    END_FOR;
END_FOR;

(* Calculate Diagonal Preconditioned Hessian Approximations *)
FOR i := 1 TO 4 DO
    rHessianDiag[i] := (rQ_diag[i] * 0.185) + rR_diag[i];
    IF rHessianDiag[i] < 0.02 THEN
        rHessianDiag[i] := 0.02;
    END_IF;
END_FOR;

(* Projected Gradient Descent Optimization Loops (3-Step Real-Time Iterations) *)
FOR iMpcIter := 1 TO 3 DO
    (* Compute Analytical Gradients Grad_J = Q * (x_horizon[3] - rSetpoints) * B_col + R * (u - u_prev) *)
    rGradJ[1] := (rQ_diag[1] * (rX_horizon[3, 1] - rSetpoints[1]) * 0.1850) + (rR_diag[1] * (rU_opt[1] - rU_prev[1]));
    rGradJ[2] := (rQ_diag[2] * (rX_horizon[3, 2] - rSetpoints[2]) * (-0.2450)) + (rR_diag[2] * (rU_opt[2] - rU_prev[2]));
    rGradJ[3] := (rQ_diag[3] * (rX_horizon[3, 3] - rSetpoints[3]) * (-0.1950)) + (rR_diag[3] * (rU_opt[3] - rU_prev[3]));
    rGradJ[4] := (rQ_diag[4] * (rX_horizon[3, 4] - rSetpoints[4]) * 0.1680) + (rR_diag[4] * (rU_opt[4] - rU_prev[4]));
    
    (* Preconditioned Update & Box Constraint Projection *)
    FOR i := 1 TO 4 DO
        rU_opt[i] := rU_opt[i] - (rStepAlpha * (rGradJ[i] / rHessianDiag[i]));
        
        (* Projection onto Physical Actuator Saturation Limits [u_min, u_max] *)
        IF rU_opt[i] < rU_min[i] THEN
            rU_opt[i] := rU_min[i];
        ELSIF rU_opt[i] > rU_max[i] THEN
            rU_opt[i] := rU_max[i];
        END_IF;
    END_FOR;
END_FOR;

(* Enforcement of Actuator Slew Rate Clamping *)
FOR i := 1 TO 4 DO
    rActuatorDelta := rU_opt[i] - rU_prev[i];
    IF rActuatorDelta > rDeltaU_max[i] THEN
        rU_opt[i] := rU_prev[i] + rDeltaU_max[i];
    ELSIF rActuatorDelta < -rDeltaU_max[i] THEN
        rU_opt[i] := rU_prev[i] - rDeltaU_max[i];
    END_IF;
    rU_prev[i] := rU_opt[i];
END_FOR;

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* 8. GAS CHROMATOGRAPHY CO2 SLIP SMITH PREDICTOR & RING BUFFER DEAD-TIME COMPENSATION               *)
(* Preempts breakthrough by driving sorbent bed advance ahead of delayed chromatographic analysis    *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* Push into 30-step Ring Buffer (15 seconds total dead-time coverage at 0.5s Ts) *)
rSlipFifoBuffer[iFifoIndex] := rVoted_SlipCO2_ppm;
iFifoIndex := iFifoIndex + 1;
IF iFifoIndex > 29 THEN
    iFifoIndex := 0;
END_IF;

(* Low-Pass Filter on Slip Measurement *)
rSlipFiltered_ppm := rSlipFiltered_ppm + ((rVoted_SlipCO2_ppm - rSlipFiltered_ppm) * 0.12);

(* Compute Instantaneous Slip Rate of Change [ppm/s] across delayed horizon *)
rSlipRateOfChange_ppms := (rVoted_SlipCO2_ppm - rSlipFifoBuffer[iFifoIndex]) / (30.0 * rTS_CYCLE_SEC);

(* Dynamic Bed Velocity Trim Calculation *)
IF rSlipFiltered_ppm > rSLIP_TARGET_MAX_PPM THEN
    rSlipPredictorCorrection := ((rSlipFiltered_ppm - rSLIP_TARGET_MAX_PPM) * 0.95) + (rSlipRateOfChange_ppms * 3.4);
    IF rSlipPredictorCorrection > 15.0 THEN
        rSlipPredictorCorrection := 15.0;     (* Cap maximum feedforward velocity bump *)
    END_IF;
ELSE
    rSlipPredictorCorrection := 0.0;
END_IF;

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* 9. SEQUENTIAL MULTI-STAGE FINITE STATE MACHINE (CASE iState OF ... END_CASE;)                     *)
(* Full TVSA Cycle: Idle -> Adsorb -> Evacuate -> Desorb -> Extract -> Recuperate -> Cool -> Transfer*)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* Update Master Sequence Dwell Timer *)
tStateTimer(IN := (iState = iPrevState), PT := T#7200S);
iPrevState := iState;

CASE iState OF
    0: (* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
       (* STATE 0: BOOT INITIALIZATION & SAFETY SELF-TEST VERIFICATION                              *)
       (* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
        bSystemReady := FALSE;
        bRegenActive := FALSE;
        rSteamControlValve_pct := 0.0;
        rVacuumPumpSpeed_pct := 0.0;
        rSorbentBedSpeed_rpm := 0.0;
        rThermoclineValve_pct := 0.0;
        rCondenserDuty_pct := 0.0;
        
        (* Confirm triple sensor health and absence of trip conditions *)
        IF (iVacHealthySensorCount >= 2) AND (iBedHealthySensorCount >= 2) AND 
           (iSlipHealthySensorCount >= 2) AND (NOT bAlarmTrip) THEN
            bSystemReady := TRUE;
            IF bEnable THEN
                iState := 10;                  (* Move to WARM STANDBY IDLE *)
            END_IF;
        END_IF;
        
    10: (* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
        (* STATE 10: WARM STANDBY & READY-TO-CYCLE                                                  *)
        (* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
        bSystemReady := TRUE;
        bRegenActive := FALSE;
        rSteamControlValve_pct := 0.0;
        rVacuumPumpSpeed_pct := 0.0;
        rSorbentBedSpeed_rpm := 1.5;           (* Anti-compaction trickle rotation *)
        rThermoclineValve_pct := 5.0;          (* Low bypass standby flow *)
        rCondenserDuty_pct := 10.0;
        
        IF bEnable THEN
            iState := 20;                      (* Advance to ADSORPTION MASS EXCHANGE RUN *)
        END_IF;
        
    20: (* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
        (* STATE 20: ADSORPTION MASS EXCHANGE RUN (Moving-Bed Continuous Contactor)                 *)
        (* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
        bSystemReady := TRUE;
        bRegenActive := FALSE;
        
        (* Rotary Feeder Speed modulated by MPC u3 + GC Smith Predictor Feedforward *)
        rSorbentBedSpeed_rpm := rU_opt[3] + rSlipPredictorCorrection;
        IF rSorbentBedSpeed_rpm > 55.0 THEN
            rSorbentBedSpeed_rpm := 55.0;
        ELSIF rSorbentBedSpeed_rpm < 4.0 THEN
            rSorbentBedSpeed_rpm := 4.0;
        END_IF;
        
        rSteamControlValve_pct := 0.0;
        rVacuumPumpSpeed_pct := 0.0;
        rThermoclineValve_pct := 20.0;
        rCondenserDuty_pct := 0.0;
        
        (* Trigger regeneration when sorbent loading reaches threshold or dwell expires *)
        IF (rSorbentMoisture_pct >= 10.0) AND (tStateTimer.ET >= T#90S) THEN
            iState := 30;                      (* Transition to LOCK-HOPPER EVACUATION *)
        END_IF;
        
    30: (* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
        (* STATE 30: LOCK-HOPPER ISOLATION & PRE-EVACUATION                                         *)
        (* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
        bSystemReady := TRUE;
        bRegenActive := TRUE;
        
        (* Evacuate atmospheric air and inert gas to prevent N2 dilution of product CO2 *)
        rVacuumPumpSpeed_pct := 85.0;
        rSteamControlValve_pct := 0.0;
        rSorbentBedSpeed_rpm := 0.0;           (* Stationary bed during lock-hopper depressurization *)
        rThermoclineValve_pct := 10.0;
        rCondenserDuty_pct := 35.0;
        
        tPumpDownTimer(IN := TRUE, PT := T#40S);
        IF (rVoted_VacPress_mbar <= 280.0) OR tPumpDownTimer.Q THEN
            tPumpDownTimer(IN := FALSE);
            iState := 40;                      (* Advance to SUPERHEATED STEAM DESORPTION *)
        END_IF;
        
    40: (* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
        (* STATE 40: SUPERHEATED STEAM INJECTION DESORPTION (TVSA Core)                              *)
        (* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
        bSystemReady := TRUE;
        bRegenActive := TRUE;
        
        (* MPC Closed-Loop Modulation of Steam and Vacuum *)
        rSteamControlValve_pct := rU_opt[1];
        rVacuumPumpSpeed_pct := rU_opt[2];
        rSorbentBedSpeed_rpm := 12.0;           (* Steady desorption moving-bed feed rate *)
        rThermoclineValve_pct := rU_opt[4];
        rCondenserDuty_pct := 80.0;            (* Heavy cooling to condense steam sweep *)
        
        tDesorpTimer(IN := TRUE, PT := T#150S);
        IF (rVoted_BedTemp_degC >= 102.0) AND (rVoted_VacPress_mbar <= rVAC_TARGET_DESORP_MBAR + 25.0) AND tDesorpTimer.Q THEN
            tDesorpTimer(IN := FALSE);
            iState := 50;                      (* Transition to CO2 PUMP-OUT & CONDENSATION *)
        END_IF;
        
    50: (* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
        (* STATE 50: HIGH-VACUUM CO2 EXTRACTION & CONDENSATION                                       *)
        (* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
        bSystemReady := TRUE;
        bRegenActive := TRUE;
        
        rSteamControlValve_pct := rSteamControlValve_pct * 0.40; (* Throttled trailing steam *)
        rVacuumPumpSpeed_pct := 95.0;          (* Maximum vacuum pull to exhaust pure CO2 gas *)
        rCondenserDuty_pct := 100.0;           (* 100% Condenser quench *)
        rSorbentBedSpeed_rpm := 10.0;
        
        IF tStateTimer.ET >= T#50S THEN
            iState := 60;                      (* Advance to THERMOCLINE RECUPERATION *)
        END_IF;
        
    60: (* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
        (* STATE 60: THERMOCLINE SENSIBLE HEAT RECUPERATION                                         *)
        (* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
        bSystemReady := TRUE;
        bRegenActive := TRUE;
        
        rSteamControlValve_pct := 0.0;         (* Steam shut *)
        rVacuumPumpSpeed_pct := 25.0;
        rCondenserDuty_pct := 25.0;
        rThermoclineValve_pct := 95.0;         (* Maximum sensible heat extraction into storage *)
        rSorbentBedSpeed_rpm := 16.0;
        
        IF (rThermoclineNodes[1] >= 85.0) OR (tStateTimer.ET >= T#60S) THEN
            iState := 70;                      (* Advance to SORBENT REHYDRATION & COOLING *)
        END_IF;
        
    70: (* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
        (* STATE 70: SORBENT RECONDITIONING, COOL-DOWN & RE-HYDRATION                               *)
        (* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
        bSystemReady := TRUE;
        bRegenActive := FALSE;
        
        rSteamControlValve_pct := 0.0;
        rVacuumPumpSpeed_pct := 0.0;
        rThermoclineValve_pct := 15.0;
        rCondenserDuty_pct := 10.0;
        rSorbentBedSpeed_rpm := 22.0;          (* High turnover through cooling contactor *)
        
        tCoolDownTimer(IN := TRUE, PT := T#45S);
        IF (rVoted_BedTemp_degC <= 42.0) OR tCoolDownTimer.Q THEN
            tCoolDownTimer(IN := FALSE);
            iState := 80;                      (* Transition to SORBENT RETURN TRANSFER *)
        END_IF;
        
    80: (* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
        (* STATE 80: SORBENT RETURN TRANSFER & CYCLE COMPLETION                                     *)
        (* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
        bSystemReady := TRUE;
        bRegenActive := FALSE;
        rSteamControlValve_pct := 0.0;
        rVacuumPumpSpeed_pct := 0.0;
        rSorbentBedSpeed_rpm := 12.0;
        rThermoclineValve_pct := 0.0;
        
        IF NOT bEnable THEN
            iState := 10;                      (* Return to WARM STANDBY *)
        ELSE
            iState := 20;                      (* Loop back to continuous ADSORPTION RUN *)
        END_IF;
        
    90: (* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
        (* STATE 90: GRACEFUL DEGRADATION / LIMP-HOME RUN                                           *)
        (* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
        bSystemReady := TRUE;
        bRegenActive := FALSE;
        bDegradedMode := TRUE;
        
        (* Conservative, de-rated operational envelope safeguarding amine inventory *)
        rSteamControlValve_pct := 20.0;
        rVacuumPumpSpeed_pct := 45.0;
        rSorbentBedSpeed_rpm := 10.0;
        rThermoclineValve_pct := 30.0;
        rCondenserDuty_pct := 55.0;
        
        IF (iVacHealthySensorCount >= 2) AND (iBedHealthySensorCount >= 2) AND 
           (iSlipHealthySensorCount >= 2) AND (NOT bAlarmTrip) THEN
            iState := 10;                      (* Automatically recover when sensor health restored *)

END_IF;
