(* ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ *)

(* --- 2.1: VIABLE CELL DENSITY (VCD) 2oo3 VOTER & FAULT ISOLATION --- *)
(* Channel validity flags combined with hardware self-diagnostics *)
bVCD_Ch1_Healthy := bVCD_Permittivity_Valid AND (rVCD_Permittivity_Cells_mL >= 0.0) AND (rVCD_Permittivity_Cells_mL <= 250.0E6);
bVCD_Ch2_Healthy := bVCD_Turbidity_Valid    AND (rVCD_Turbidity_Cells_mL >= 0.0)    AND (rVCD_Turbidity_Cells_mL <= 250.0E6);
bVCD_Ch3_Healthy := bVCD_AtLine_Valid       AND (rVCD_AtLine_Cells_mL >= 0.0)       AND (rVCD_AtLine_Cells_mL <= 250.0E6);

(* Pairwise disparity evaluation *)
IF bVCD_Ch1_Healthy AND bVCD_Ch2_Healthy THEN
    IF ABS(rVCD_Permittivity_Cells_mL - rVCD_Turbidity_Cells_mL) > rVCD_DevThreshold_Cells_mL THEN
        rVCD_DiscrepTimer_Ch1_s := rVCD_DiscrepTimer_Ch1_s + rCycleTime_s;
        rVCD_DiscrepTimer_Ch2_s := rVCD_DiscrepTimer_Ch2_s + rCycleTime_s;
    ELSE
        rVCD_DiscrepTimer_Ch1_s := MAX(0.0, rVCD_DiscrepTimer_Ch1_s - (rCycleTime_s * 0.5));
        rVCD_DiscrepTimer_Ch2_s := MAX(0.0, rVCD_DiscrepTimer_Ch2_s - (rCycleTime_s * 0.5));
    END_IF;
END_IF;

IF bVCD_Ch1_Healthy AND bVCD_Ch3_Healthy THEN
    IF ABS(rVCD_Permittivity_Cells_mL - rVCD_AtLine_Cells_mL) > rVCD_DevThreshold_Cells_mL THEN
        rVCD_DiscrepTimer_Ch1_s := rVCD_DiscrepTimer_Ch1_s + rCycleTime_s;
        rVCD_DiscrepTimer_Ch3_s := rVCD_DiscrepTimer_Ch3_s + rCycleTime_s;
    ELSE
        rVCD_DiscrepTimer_Ch1_s := MAX(0.0, rVCD_DiscrepTimer_Ch1_s - (rCycleTime_s * 0.5));
        rVCD_DiscrepTimer_Ch3_s := MAX(0.0, rVCD_DiscrepTimer_Ch3_s - (rCycleTime_s * 0.5));
    END_IF;
END_IF;

IF bVCD_Ch2_Healthy AND bVCD_Ch3_Healthy THEN
    IF ABS(rVCD_Turbidity_Cells_mL - rVCD_AtLine_Cells_mL) > rVCD_DevThreshold_Cells_mL THEN
        rVCD_DiscrepTimer_Ch2_s := rVCD_DiscrepTimer_Ch2_s + rCycleTime_s;
        rVCD_DiscrepTimer_Ch3_s := rVCD_DiscrepTimer_Ch3_s + rCycleTime_s;
    ELSE
        rVCD_DiscrepTimer_Ch2_s := MAX(0.0, rVCD_DiscrepTimer_Ch2_s - (rCycleTime_s * 0.5));
        rVCD_DiscrepTimer_Ch3_s := MAX(0.0, rVCD_DiscrepTimer_Ch3_s - (rCycleTime_s * 0.5));
    END_IF;
END_IF;

(* Latch out individual degraded channels exceeding 15.0 s continuous discrepancy *)
IF rVCD_DiscrepTimer_Ch1_s > 15.0 THEN
    bVCD_Ch1_Healthy := FALSE;
END_IF;
IF rVCD_DiscrepTimer_Ch2_s > 15.0 THEN
    bVCD_Ch2_Healthy := FALSE;
END_IF;
IF rVCD_DiscrepTimer_Ch3_s > 15.0 THEN
    bVCD_Ch3_Healthy := FALSE;
END_IF;

(* Count available healthy channels *)
iVCD_HealthyChannelCount := 0;
IF bVCD_Ch1_Healthy THEN iVCD_HealthyChannelCount := iVCD_HealthyChannelCount + 1; END_IF;
IF bVCD_Ch2_Healthy THEN iVCD_HealthyChannelCount := iVCD_HealthyChannelCount + 1; END_IF;
IF bVCD_Ch3_Healthy THEN iVCD_HealthyChannelCount := iVCD_HealthyChannelCount + 1; END_IF;

(* VCD Voting Execution Logic *)
IF iVCD_HealthyChannelCount = 3 THEN
    (* Full 2oo3 Median Voter *)
    IF (rVCD_Permittivity_Cells_mL >= rVCD_Turbidity_Cells_mL AND rVCD_Permittivity_Cells_mL <= rVCD_AtLine_Cells_mL) OR
       (rVCD_Permittivity_Cells_mL <= rVCD_Turbidity_Cells_mL AND rVCD_Permittivity_Cells_mL >= rVCD_AtLine_Cells_mL) THEN
        rVoted_VCD_Cells_mL := rVCD_Permittivity_Cells_mL;
    ELSIF (rVCD_Turbidity_Cells_mL >= rVCD_Permittivity_Cells_mL AND rVCD_Turbidity_Cells_mL <= rVCD_AtLine_Cells_mL) OR
          (rVCD_Turbidity_Cells_mL <= rVCD_Permittivity_Cells_mL AND rVCD_Turbidity_Cells_mL >= rVCD_AtLine_Cells_mL) THEN
        rVoted_VCD_Cells_mL := rVCD_Turbidity_Cells_mL;
    ELSE
        rVoted_VCD_Cells_mL := rVCD_AtLine_Cells_mL;
    END_IF;
    bAlarm_VCD_SensorDiscrepancy := FALSE;
ELSIF iVCD_HealthyChannelCount = 2 THEN
    (* Degraded 2oo2 Averaging Mode *)
    bAlarm_VCD_SensorDiscrepancy := TRUE;
    IF bVCD_Ch1_Healthy AND bVCD_Ch2_Healthy THEN
        rVoted_VCD_Cells_mL := (rVCD_Permittivity_Cells_mL + rVCD_Turbidity_Cells_mL) * 0.5;
    ELSIF bVCD_Ch1_Healthy AND bVCD_Ch3_Healthy THEN
        rVoted_VCD_Cells_mL := (rVCD_Permittivity_Cells_mL + rVCD_AtLine_Cells_mL) * 0.5;
    ELSE
        rVoted_VCD_Cells_mL := (rVCD_Turbidity_Cells_mL + rVCD_AtLine_Cells_mL) * 0.5;
    END_IF;
ELSIF iVCD_HealthyChannelCount = 1 THEN
    (* Single-channel fallback with alarm warning *)
    bAlarm_VCD_SensorDiscrepancy := TRUE;
    IF bVCD_Ch1_Healthy THEN
        rVoted_VCD_Cells_mL := rVCD_Permittivity_Cells_mL;
    ELSIF bVCD_Ch2_Healthy THEN
        rVoted_VCD_Cells_mL := rVCD_Turbidity_Cells_mL;
    ELSE
        rVoted_VCD_Cells_mL := rVCD_AtLine_Cells_mL;
    END_IF;
ELSE
    (* Total sensor failure: Fallback to Kalman observer state estimate *)
    bAlarm_VCD_SensorDiscrepancy := TRUE;
    rVoted_VCD_Cells_mL := rTargetVCD_Cells_mL + aStateEstimate[1];
END_IF;


(* --- 2.2: DISSOLVED OXYGEN (DO) 2oo3 VOTER & FAULT ISOLATION --- *)
bDO_Ch1_Healthy := bDO_Optical_Valid AND (rDO_Optical_Pct >= 0.0) AND (rDO_Optical_Pct <= 150.0);
bDO_Ch2_Healthy := bDO_Polaro1_Valid AND (rDO_Polaro1_Pct >= 0.0) AND (rDO_Polaro1_Pct <= 150.0);
bDO_Ch3_Healthy := bDO_Polaro2_Valid AND (rDO_Polaro2_Pct >= 0.0) AND (rDO_Polaro2_Pct <= 150.0);

(* Pairwise DO disparity tracking *)
IF bDO_Ch1_Healthy AND bDO_Ch2_Healthy THEN
    IF ABS(rDO_Optical_Pct - rDO_Polaro1_Pct) > rDO_DevThreshold_Pct THEN
        rDO_DiscrepTimer_Ch1_s := rDO_DiscrepTimer_Ch1_s + rCycleTime_s;
        rDO_DiscrepTimer_Ch2_s := rDO_DiscrepTimer_Ch2_s + rCycleTime_s;
    ELSE
        rDO_DiscrepTimer_Ch1_s := MAX(0.0, rDO_DiscrepTimer_Ch1_s - (rCycleTime_s * 0.5));
        rDO_DiscrepTimer_Ch2_s := MAX(0.0, rDO_DiscrepTimer_Ch2_s - (rCycleTime_s * 0.5));
    END_IF;
END_IF;

IF bDO_Ch1_Healthy AND bDO_Ch3_Healthy THEN
    IF ABS(rDO_Optical_Pct - rDO_Polaro2_Pct) > rDO_DevThreshold_Pct THEN
        rDO_DiscrepTimer_Ch1_s := rDO_DiscrepTimer_Ch1_s + rCycleTime_s;
        rDO_DiscrepTimer_Ch3_s := rDO_DiscrepTimer_Ch3_s + rCycleTime_s;
    ELSE
        rDO_DiscrepTimer_Ch1_s := MAX(0.0, rDO_DiscrepTimer_Ch1_s - (rCycleTime_s * 0.5));
        rDO_DiscrepTimer_Ch3_s := MAX(0.0, rDO_DiscrepTimer_Ch3_s - (rCycleTime_s * 0.5));
    END_IF;
END_IF;

IF bDO_Ch2_Healthy AND bDO_Ch3_Healthy THEN
    IF ABS(rDO_Polaro1_Pct - rDO_Polaro2_Pct) > rDO_DevThreshold_Pct THEN
        rDO_DiscrepTimer_Ch2_s := rDO_DiscrepTimer_Ch2_s + rCycleTime_s;
        rDO_DiscrepTimer_Ch3_s := rDO_DiscrepTimer_Ch3_s + rCycleTime_s;
    ELSE
        rDO_DiscrepTimer_Ch2_s := MAX(0.0, rDO_DiscrepTimer_Ch2_s - (rCycleTime_s * 0.5));
        rDO_DiscrepTimer_Ch3_s := MAX(0.0, rDO_DiscrepTimer_Ch3_s - (rCycleTime_s * 0.5));
    END_IF;
END_IF;

(* Latch out degraded DO channels exceeding 20.0 s continuous discrepancy *)
IF rDO_DiscrepTimer_Ch1_s > 20.0 THEN bDO_Ch1_Healthy := FALSE; END_IF;
IF rDO_DiscrepTimer_Ch2_s > 20.0 THEN bDO_Ch2_Healthy := FALSE; END_IF;
IF rDO_DiscrepTimer_Ch3_s > 20.0 THEN bDO_Ch3_Healthy := FALSE; END_IF;

(* Count available healthy DO channels *)
iDO_HealthyChannelCount := 0;
IF bDO_Ch1_Healthy THEN iDO_HealthyChannelCount := iDO_HealthyChannelCount + 1; END_IF;
IF bDO_Ch2_Healthy THEN iDO_HealthyChannelCount := iDO_HealthyChannelCount + 1; END_IF;
IF bDO_Ch3_Healthy THEN iDO_HealthyChannelCount := iDO_HealthyChannelCount + 1; END_IF;

(* DO Voting Execution *)
IF iDO_HealthyChannelCount = 3 THEN
    IF (rDO_Optical_Pct >= rDO_Polaro1_Pct AND rDO_Optical_Pct <= rDO_Polaro2_Pct) OR
       (rDO_Optical_Pct <= rDO_Polaro1_Pct AND rDO_Optical_Pct >= rDO_Polaro2_Pct) THEN
        rVoted_DO_Pct := rDO_Optical_Pct;
    ELSIF (rDO_Polaro1_Pct >= rDO_Optical_Pct AND rDO_Polaro1_Pct <= rDO_Polaro2_Pct) OR
          (rDO_Polaro1_Pct <= rDO_Optical_Pct AND rDO_Polaro1_Pct >= rDO_Polaro2_Pct) THEN
        rVoted_DO_Pct := rDO_Polaro1_Pct;
    ELSE
        rVoted_DO_Pct := rDO_Polaro2_Pct;
    END_IF;
    bAlarm_DO_SensorDiscrepancy := FALSE;
ELSIF iDO_HealthyChannelCount = 2 THEN
    bAlarm_DO_SensorDiscrepancy := TRUE;
    IF bDO_Ch1_Healthy AND bDO_Ch2_Healthy THEN
        rVoted_DO_Pct := (rDO_Optical_Pct + rDO_Polaro1_Pct) * 0.5;
    ELSIF bDO_Ch1_Healthy AND bDO_Ch3_Healthy THEN
        rVoted_DO_Pct := (rDO_Optical_Pct + rDO_Polaro2_Pct) * 0.5;
    ELSE
        rVoted_DO_Pct := (rDO_Polaro1_Pct + rDO_Polaro2_Pct) * 0.5;
    END_IF;
ELSIF iDO_HealthyChannelCount = 1 THEN
    bAlarm_DO_SensorDiscrepancy := TRUE;
    IF bDO_Ch1_Healthy THEN
        rVoted_DO_Pct := rDO_Optical_Pct;
    ELSIF bDO_Ch2_Healthy THEN
        rVoted_DO_Pct := rDO_Polaro1_Pct;
    ELSE
        rVoted_DO_Pct := rDO_Polaro2_Pct;
    END_IF;
ELSE
    bAlarm_DO_SensorDiscrepancy := TRUE;
    rVoted_DO_Pct := rTargetDO_Pct + aStateEstimate[2];
END_IF;


(* ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* SEGMENT 3: ANALOG SIGNAL CONDITIONING & EWMA DIGITAL FILTERING                                                     *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* Exponentially Weighted Moving Average (EWMA) filtering eliminates high-frequency measurement noise *)
rFilt_VCD_Cells_mL     := (rFilterAlpha_Slow * rVoted_VCD_Cells_mL) + ((1.0 - rFilterAlpha_Slow) * rFilt_VCD_Cells_mL);
rFilt_DO_Pct           := (rFilterAlpha_Fast * rVoted_DO_Pct)       + ((1.0 - rFilterAlpha_Fast) * rFilt_DO_Pct);
rFilt_pH               := (rFilterAlpha_Slow * rBioreactor_pH)      + ((1.0 - rFilterAlpha_Slow) * rFilt_pH);
rFilt_Temp_degC        := (rFilterAlpha_Slow * rBioreactorTemp_degC)+ ((1.0 - rFilterAlpha_Slow) * rFilt_Temp_degC);
rFilt_ChamberTemp_degC := (rFilterAlpha_Fast * rAcousticChamberTemp_degC) + ((1.0 - rFilterAlpha_Fast) * rFilt_ChamberTemp_degC);
rFilt_RF_Power_W       := (rFilterAlpha_Fast * (rAcousticSep_RF_Voltage_V * rAcousticSep_RF_Current_A * COS(rAcousticSep_Phase_deg * 3.14159265 / 180.0)))
                          + ((1.0 - rFilterAlpha_Fast) * rFilt_RF_Power_W);
rFilt_RF_Phase_deg     := (rFilterAlpha_Fast * rAcousticSep_Phase_deg) + ((1.0 - rFilterAlpha_Fast) * rFilt_RF_Phase_deg);
rFilt_OffGas_O2_Pct    := (rFilterAlpha_Fast * rOffGas_O2_Pct)         + ((1.0 - rFilterAlpha_Fast) * rFilt_OffGas_O2_Pct);
rFilt_OffGas_CO2_Pct   := (rFilterAlpha_Fast * rOffGas_CO2_Pct)        + ((1.0 - rFilterAlpha_Fast) * rFilt_OffGas_CO2_Pct);
rFilt_Agitation_RPM    := (rFilterAlpha_Slow * rAgitationSpeed_RPM)    + ((1.0 - rFilterAlpha_Slow) * rFilt_Agitation_RPM);

(* Real-time ultrasonic transducer electrical impedance magnitude [Ohm] *)
IF rAcousticSep_RF_Current_A > 0.05 THEN
    rAcousticImpedanceMagnitude_Ohm := rAcousticSep_RF_Voltage_V / rAcousticSep_RF_Current_A;
ELSE
    rAcousticImpedanceMagnitude_Ohm := 50.0;
END_IF;

(* Acoustic thermal dissipation estimation into fluid stream [W] *)
rAcousticThermalDissipation_W := MAX(0.0, rFilt_RF_Power_W - rAcousticReflectedPower_W) * 0.82;


(* ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* SEGMENT 4: OFF-GAS MASS SPECTROMETRY & METABOLIC RESPIROMETRIC ESTIMATOR                                           *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* Calculate total inlet gas flow rate across spargers [sccm] *)
rTempSum := rMicroSpargeO2_Flow_sccm + rMacroSpargeAir_Flow_sccm + rMacroSpargeCO2_Flow_sccm;

IF (rTempSum > 50.0) AND (rBioreactorWorkingVol_L > 10.0) THEN
    (* Inlet mole fractions of O2 and CO2 *)
    rTempSum := MAX(rTempSum, 1.0);
    (* Fractional gas composition *)
    rInnovationVector[1] := ((rMicroSpargeO2_Flow_sccm * 1.0) + (rMacroSpargeAir_Flow_sccm * c_rO2FractionAir)) / rTempSum; (* y_O2_in *)
    rInnovationVector[2] := ((rMacroSpargeCO2_Flow_sccm * 1.0) + (rMacroSpargeAir_Flow_sccm * c_rCO2FractionAir)) / rTempSum; (* y_CO2_in *)
    
    (* Inert gas fraction (Nitrogen + Argon balance) *)
    rInnovationVector[3] := 1.0 - rInnovationVector[1] - rInnovationVector[2]; (* y_Inert_in *)
    rInnovationVector[4] := 1.0 - (rFilt_OffGas_O2_Pct * 0.01) - (rFilt_OffGas_CO2_Pct * 0.01); (* y_Inert_out *)
    
    IF rInnovationVector[4] > 0.10 THEN
        (* Inert expansion factor F_gas_out / F_gas_in *)
        rTempSum := (rInnovationVector[3] / rInnovationVector[4]);
        
        (* Oxygen Uptake Rate (OUR) [mmol / L / h] *)
        (* Conversions: sccm -> L/min (/ 1000) -> mol/h (* 60 / 22.414) -> mmol/h (* 1000) *)
        rEstimated_OUR_mmol_L_h := ((rMicroSpargeO2_Flow_sccm + rMacroSpargeAir_Flow_sccm + rMacroSpargeCO2_Flow_sccm) * 60.0 / (c_rMolarVolume_L_mol * rBioreactorWorkingVol_L))
                                   * (rInnovationVector[1] - ((rFilt_OffGas_O2_Pct * 0.01) * rTempSum));
        rEstimated_OUR_mmol_L_h := MAX(0.0, rEstimated_OUR_mmol_L_h);
        
        (* Carbon Dioxide Evolution Rate (CER) [mmol / L / h] *)
        rEstimated_CER_mmol_L_h := ((rMicroSpargeO2_Flow_sccm + rMacroSpargeAir_Flow_sccm + rMacroSpargeCO2_Flow_sccm) * 60.0 / (c_rMolarVolume_L_mol * rBioreactorWorkingVol_L))
                                   * (((rFilt_OffGas_CO2_Pct * 0.01) * rTempSum) - rInnovationVector[2]);
        rEstimated_CER_mmol_L_h := MAX(0.0, rEstimated_CER_mmol_L_h);
        
        (* Respiratory Quotient (RQ) *)
        IF rEstimated_OUR_mmol_L_h > 0.5 THEN
            rEstimated_RQ := rEstimated_CER_mmol_L_h / rEstimated_OUR_mmol_L_h;
        ELSE
            rEstimated_RQ := 0.95;
        END_IF;
    END_IF;
END_IF;

(* Dynamic Specific Growth Rate (mu) Observer from Cell Mass Balance:
   dX_v/dt = (mu - D_bleed - D_harvest*(1-R_sep)) * X_v
   mu = (1/X_v)*(dX_v/dt) + D_bleed + D_harvest*(1-R_sep) *)
IF (rFilt_VCD_Cells_mL > 5.0E6) AND (rBioreactorWorkingVol_L > 10.0) AND (rCycleTime_s > 0.0) THEN
    (* Discrete derivative of biomass *)
    rTempSum := (rFilt_VCD_Cells_mL - rPastVCD_Cells_mL) / (rCycleTime_s * 3600.0); (* cells/mL/h *)
    
    rRollingGrowthRateBuffer[iGrowthRateBufferIndex] := (rTempSum / rFilt_VCD_Cells_mL)
                                                     + ((rActualBleedFlow_L_day / rBioreactorWorkingVol_L) / 24.0)
                                                     + (((rPerfusionHarvestFlow_L_day / rBioreactorWorkingVol_L) * (1.0 - (rAcousticRetentionEfficiency_Pct * 0.01))) / 24.0);
    
    (* Circular buffer advance *)
    iGrowthRateBufferIndex := iGrowthRateBufferIndex + 1;
    IF iGrowthRateBufferIndex > 10 THEN
        iGrowthRateBufferIndex := 1;
    END_IF;
    
    (* Smoothed specific growth rate mu [1/h] *)
    rCalculated_mu_h_inv := 0.0;
    FOR iIdx := 1 TO 10 DO
        rCalculated_mu_h_inv := rCalculated_mu_h_inv + rRollingGrowthRateBuffer[iIdx];
    END_FOR;
    rCalculated_mu_h_inv := rCalculated_mu_h_inv * 0.10;
    rCalculated_mu_h_inv := LIMIT(0.0, rCalculated_mu_h_inv, 0.065); (* Realistic mammalian bound: doubling time >= 10.6 h *)
END_IF;
rPastVCD_Cells_mL := rFilt_VCD_Cells_mL;

(* Dynamic Volumetric Oxygen Mass Transfer Coefficient (kLa) Estimator [1/h] *)
IF (rTargetDO_Pct - rFilt_DO_Pct) > 1.0 THEN
    (* Broth saturated O2 concentration at 37.0 deg C approx 0.218 mmol/L *)
    rEstimated_kLa_h_inv := (rEstimated_OUR_mmol_L_h + ((rFilt_DO_Pct - rPastDO_Pct) * 0.01 * 0.218 / (rCycleTime_s / 3600.0)))
                            / MAX(0.01, (100.0 - rFilt_DO_Pct) * 0.01 * 0.218);
    rEstimated_kLa_h_inv := LIMIT(2.0, rEstimated_kLa_h_inv, 120.0);
ELSE
    rEstimated_kLa_h_inv := 25.0;
END_IF;
rPastDO_Pct := rFilt_DO_Pct;

(* Dynamic Acoustic Retention Efficiency Estimation *)
IF (rFreshMediaFeedFlow_L_day > 10.0) AND (rFilt_VCD_Cells_mL > 1.0E6) THEN
    (* Acoustic efficiency based on harvest clarity and bleed balance *)
    rAcousticRetentionEfficiency_Pct := 100.0 * (1.0 - (rActualBleedFlow_L_day / (rFreshMediaFeedFlow_L_day + 0.001)) * (rTargetVCD_Cells_mL / (rFilt_VCD_Cells_mL + 0.001)) * 0.08);
    rAcousticRetentionEfficiency_Pct := LIMIT(92.0, rAcousticRetentionEfficiency_Pct, 99.9);
ELSE
    rAcousticRetentionEfficiency_Pct := 99.5;
END_IF;

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* SEGMENT 5: ACOUSTIC SEPARATOR RESONANCE PHASE-LOCKED LOOP (PLL) & EXTREMUM SEEKING                                 *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
IF bAcousticSepCmd AND (iActiveState >= 30) AND (iActiveState <= 50) THEN
    (* 5.1: Phase angle error PI regulation towards anti-resonance zero crossing *)
    IF bResonanceTrackingCmd THEN
        (* Phase angle error accumulation *)
        rAcousticPhase_Integrator := rAcousticPhase_Integrator + (rFilt_RF_Phase_deg * rCycleTime_s);
        rAcousticPhase_Integrator := LIMIT(-50.0, rAcousticPhase_Integrator, 50.0);
        
        (* PI frequency correction offset *)
        rAcousticFreq_Dither_kHz := (rAcousticPhase_Kp * rFilt_RF_Phase_deg) + (rAcousticPhase_Ki * rAcousticPhase_Integrator);
        
        (* 5.2: Extremum seeking impedance gradient tracking *)
        IF (rAcousticImpedanceMagnitude_Ohm - rPastImpedanceMagnitude_Ohm) < -1.5 THEN
            (* Impedance dropped: reverse frequency search direction *)
            bExtremumSeekingDirection := NOT bExtremumSeekingDirection;
        END_IF;
        
        IF bExtremumSeekingDirection THEN
            rAcousticFreq_Current_kHz := rAcousticFreq_Current_kHz + (rAcousticFreq_Step_kHz * 0.1);
        ELSE
            rAcousticFreq_Current_kHz := rAcousticFreq_Current_kHz - (rAcousticFreq_Step_kHz * 0.1);
        END_IF;
        
        (* Synthesize commanded frequency *)
        rCmdAcousticFrequency_kHz := rAcousticFreq_Current_kHz + rAcousticFreq_Dither_kHz;
        rCmdAcousticFrequency_kHz := LIMIT(c_rMinAcousticFreq_kHz, rCmdAcousticFrequency_kHz, c_rMaxAcousticFreq_kHz);
        
        (* Verify stable resonance lock condition *)
        IF (ABS(rFilt_RF_Phase_deg) <= 3.5) AND (rAcousticReflectedPower_W <= 4.0) THEN
            rResonanceLockTimer_s := rResonanceLockTimer_s + rCycleTime_s;
            IF rResonanceLockTimer_s >= 4.0 THEN
                bAcousticResonanceLocked := TRUE;
                bAlarm_AcousticResonanceLost := FALSE;
            END_IF;
        ELSE
            rResonanceLockTimer_s := 0.0;
            bAcousticResonanceLocked := FALSE;
            IF rStateTimeInStep_s > 60.0 THEN
                bAlarm_AcousticResonanceLost := TRUE;
            END_IF;
        END_IF;
    ELSE
        (* Manual default frequency *)
        rCmdAcousticFrequency_kHz := c_rNominalAcousticFreq_kHz;
        bAcousticResonanceLocked  := TRUE;
    END_IF;
    
    (* 5.3: Transducer thermal derating to protect cell viability *)
    IF rFilt_ChamberTemp_degC >= c_rWarningChamberTemp_degC THEN
        (* Linear derating factor between 38.5 deg C and 39.8 deg C *)
        rTempSum := 1.0 - ((rFilt_ChamberTemp_degC - c_rWarningChamberTemp_degC) / (c_rMaxChamberTemp_degC - c_rWarningChamberTemp_degC));
        rTempSum := LIMIT(0.25, rTempSum, 1.0);
    ELSE
        rTempSum := 1.0;
    END_IF;
    
    (* 5.4: Acoustic duty cycle pulse & settling timer *)
    rAcousticPulseTimer_s := rAcousticPulseTimer_s + rCycleTime_s;
    IF rAcousticPulseTimer_s < 55.0 THEN
        (* Active standing wave separation phase *)
        bAcousticPulseActive      := TRUE;
        rCmdAcousticPower_W       := (65.0 + aControlInputCurrent[4]) * rTempSum;
        rCmdAcousticDutyCycle_Pct := 91.6;
    ELSIF rAcousticPulseTimer_s < 60.0 THEN
        (* Relaxed sedimentation phase: cluster settling back into bioreactor downcomer *)
        bAcousticPulseActive      := FALSE;
        rCmdAcousticPower_W       := 0.0;
        rCmdAcousticDutyCycle_Pct := 91.6;
    ELSE
        rAcousticPulseTimer_s := 0.0;
    END_IF;
    
    rPastImpedanceMagnitude_Ohm := rAcousticImpedanceMagnitude_Ohm;
    rPastAcousticFreq_kHz       := rCmdAcousticFrequency_kHz;
ELSE
    rCmdAcousticFrequency_kHz := c_rNominalAcousticFreq_kHz;
    rCmdAcousticPower_W       := 0.0;
    rCmdAcousticDutyCycle_Pct := 0.0;
    bAcousticResonanceLocked  := FALSE;
    rResonanceLockTimer_s     := 0.0;
END_IF;


(* ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* SEGMENT 6: 4x4 CYBER-PHYSICAL STATE-SPACE OBSERVER (KALMAN FILTER ENGINE)                                          *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* State vector physical deviations:
   x_1 = Delta_VCD     [cells/mL]
   x_2 = Delta_DO      [% air sat]
   x_3 = Delta_pCO2    [mmHg]
   x_4 = Delta_T_ch    [deg C] *)

(* Measurement Vector Formulation *)
aMeasuredOutputVector[1] := rFilt_VCD_Cells_mL - rTargetVCD_Cells_mL;
aMeasuredOutputVector[2] := rFilt_DO_Pct - rTargetDO_Pct;
aMeasuredOutputVector[3] := (rEstimated_CER_mmol_L_h * 2.85) - c_rTargetpCO2_mmHg; (* pCO2 proxy correlation *)
aMeasuredOutputVector[4] := rFilt_ChamberTemp_degC - rTargetTemp_degC;

(* Deterministic Initialization of Discrete 4x4 State-Space Plant Matrices *)
(* Transition Matrix A_d (Cycle time T_s = 1.0 s) *)
aMatrixA[1,1] := 0.99988; aMatrixA[1,2] := 0.00000; aMatrixA[1,3] :=-0.00005; aMatrixA[1,4] := 0.00000;
aMatrixA[2,1] :=-0.00012; aMatrixA[2,2] := 0.98500; aMatrixA[2,3] := 0.00000; aMatrixA[2,4] :=-0.00150;
aMatrixA[3,1] := 0.00018; aMatrixA[3,2] := 0.00000; aMatrixA[3,3] := 0.99200; aMatrixA[3,4] := 0.00080;
aMatrixA[4,1] := 0.00000; aMatrixA[4,2] := 0.00000; aMatrixA[4,3] := 0.00000; aMatrixA[4,4] := 0.97800;

(* Input Coupling Matrix B_d (Actuator gains per engineering unit) *)
aMatrixB[1,1] :=-0.00285; aMatrixB[1,2] := 0.00000; aMatrixB[1,3] := 0.00000; aMatrixB[1,4] := 0.00045;
aMatrixB[2,1] := 0.00000; aMatrixB[2,2] := 0.00840; aMatrixB[2,3] := 0.00180; aMatrixB[2,4] := 0.00000;
aMatrixB[3,1] :=-0.00040; aMatrixB[3,2] := 0.00000; aMatrixB[3,3] :=-0.00650; aMatrixB[3,4] := 0.00000;
aMatrixB[4,1] := 0.00000; aMatrixB[4,2] := 0.00000; aMatrixB[4,3] := 0.00000; aMatrixB[4,4] := 0.02450;

(* Output Coupling Matrix C_d *)
aMatrixC[1,1] := 1.0; aMatrixC[1,2] := 0.0; aMatrixC[1,3] := 0.0; aMatrixC[1,4] := 0.0;
aMatrixC[2,1] := 0.0; aMatrixC[2,2] := 1.0; aMatrixC[2,3] := 0.0; aMatrixC[2,4] := 0.0;
aMatrixC[3,1] := 0.0; aMatrixC[3,2] := 0.0; aMatrixC[3,3] := 1.0; aMatrixC[3,4] := 0.0;
aMatrixC[4,1] := 0.0; aMatrixC[4,2] := 0.0; aMatrixC[4,3] := 0.0; aMatrixC[4,4] := 1.0;

(* Steady-State Kalman Observer Gain Matrix K_kalman *)
aMatrixKalmanGain[1,1] := 0.1250; aMatrixKalmanGain[1,2] := 0.0000; aMatrixKalmanGain[1,3] :=-0.0012; aMatrixKalmanGain[1,4] := 0.0000;
aMatrixKalmanGain[2,1] :=-0.0005; aMatrixKalmanGain[2,2] := 0.2200; aMatrixKalmanGain[2,3] := 0.0000; aMatrixKalmanGain[2,4] :=-0.0045;
aMatrixKalmanGain[3,1] := 0.0015; aMatrixKalmanGain[3,2] := 0.0000; aMatrixKalmanGain[3,3] := 0.1850; aMatrixKalmanGain[3,4] := 0.0022;
aMatrixKalmanGain[4,1] := 0.0000; aMatrixKalmanGain[4,2] := 0.0000; aMatrixKalmanGain[4,3] := 0.0000; aMatrixKalmanGain[4,4] := 0.3100;

(* Step 6.1: Prior State Prediction x_pred = A * x_est + B * u_past *)
FOR iIdx := 1 TO 4 DO
    aStatePredict[iIdx] := 0.0;
    FOR jIdx := 1 TO 4 DO
        aStatePredict[iIdx] := aStatePredict[iIdx] + (aMatrixA[iIdx, jIdx] * aStateEstimate[jIdx])
                                                   + (aMatrixB[iIdx, jIdx] * aControlInputPast[jIdx]);
    END_FOR;
END_FOR;

(* Step 6.2: Measurement Innovation Vector y_innov = y_meas - C * x_pred *)
FOR iIdx := 1 TO 4 DO
    rTempSum := 0.0;
    FOR jIdx := 1 TO 4 DO
        rTempSum := rTempSum + (aMatrixC[iIdx, jIdx] * aStatePredict[jIdx]);
    END_FOR;
    aInnovationVector[iIdx] := aMeasuredOutputVector[iIdx] - rTempSum;
END_FOR;

(* Step 6.3: Corrected State Estimation x_est = x_pred + K * y_innov *)
FOR iIdx := 1 TO 4 DO
    rTempSum := 0.0;
    FOR jIdx := 1 TO 4 DO
        rTempSum := rTempSum + (aMatrixKalmanGain[iIdx, jIdx] * aInnovationVector[jIdx]);
    END_FOR;
    aStateEstimate[iIdx] := aStatePredict[iIdx] + rTempSum;
END_FOR;


(* ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* SEGMENT 7: MODEL PREDICTIVE CONTROL (MPC) PROJECTED GRADIENT DESCENT QP SOLVER                                     *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* Objective: min J(Delta u) = 0.5 * Delta u^T * H * Delta u + g^T * Delta u
   subject to actuator rate and amplitude constraints *)

(* MPC Weighting Factors *)
aWeightQ[1] := 1.85E-12; (* VCD tracking error penalty *)
aWeightQ[2] := 0.450;    (* DO tracking error penalty *)
aWeightQ[3] := 0.120;    (* pCO2 accumulation penalty *)
aWeightQ[4] := 0.850;    (* Chamber temperature elevation penalty *)

aWeightR[1] := 0.085;    (* Bleed pump movement suppression *)
aWeightR[2] := 0.00045;  (* Oxygen flow movement suppression *)
aWeightR[3] := 0.00015;  (* Stripping air movement suppression *)
aWeightR[4] := 0.045;    (* Acoustic power modulation penalty *)

(* Diagonal Hessian Approximation H_ii = 2 * (sum_k B_ki^2 * Q_k + R_i) *)
FOR iIdx := 1 TO 4 DO
    rTempSum := 0.0;
    FOR kIdx := 1 TO 4 DO
        rTempSum := rTempSum + (aMatrixB[kIdx, iIdx] * aMatrixB[kIdx, iIdx] * aWeightQ[kIdx]);
    END_FOR;
    aHessianH[iIdx, iIdx] := (2.0 * rTempSum) + aWeightR[iIdx];
    IF aHessianH[iIdx, iIdx] > 1.0E-6 THEN
        aHessianInvDiag[iIdx] := 1.0 / aHessianH[iIdx, iIdx];
    ELSE
        aHessianInvDiag[iIdx] := 1.0;

    aGradientG[iIdx] := 2.0 * rTempSum;
END_FOR;

        aControlDelta[iIdx] := aControlDelta[iIdx] - (0.45 * aHessianInvDiag[iIdx] * rTempSum);
        
        (* Project onto Slew Rate Box Constraints *)

    END_FOR;

    rUllageMolarMass_kg_mol         : REAL;     (* Effective molar mass of ullage vapor mixture [kg/mol] *)
    rAcousticResonator_NeckArea_m2  : REAL := 0.0314;   (* Flight vent mast equivalent neck area [m2] *)
    rAcousticResonator_EffLength_m  : REAL := 1.25;     (* Resonator effective acoustic length with end corrections [m] *)
    rAcousticKalmanGain_K           : REAL := 0.085;    (* Complementary mass sensor fusion blending factor *)
    rAcousticMassEstimate_Raw       : REAL;     (* Unfiltered acoustic volume inversion mass [kg] *)
    rTotalIntegratedMassFlow        : REAL;     (* Continuous trapezoidal integration of Coriolis mass flow [kg] *)

    (* ========================================================================= *)
    (* TIMERS, RATE LIMITERS, AND CONTROLLER INTERNAL STATES                     *)
    (* ========================================================================= *)
    tStepTimer                      : TON;      (* Multi-stage sequence step dwell timer *)
    tSurgeReliefTimer               : TON;      (* Surge bypass fast-acting pulse duration timer *)
    tPreChillPulseTimer             : TON;      (* Controlled pre-chill cryo injection pulse timer *)
    tQuenchStabilizeTimer           : TON;      (* Leidenfrost transition thermal stabilization timer *)
    tSensorDebounceTimer            : TON;      (* TMR sensor discrepancy verification timer *)
    rValveCmd_MainCryoSupply_Target : REAL;     (* Unclamped target command for main propellant supply valve *)
    rValveCmd_Vent_Target           : REAL;     (* Unclamped target command for tank vent valve *)
    rDeltaTime_Seconds              : REAL;     (* Scan cycle execution delta time [s] *)
    bInitialized                    : BOOL := FALSE; (* First-scan initialization latch *)
    iState                          : INT := 0; (* Internal state machine sequence step register *)
    iPreviousState                  : INT := 0; (* History state register for graceful recovery *)
    
    (* Filter buffers for numerical differentiation *)
    rFilterBuf_dP                   : ARRAY[1..4] OF REAL; (* 4-tap FIR smoothing filter for line dP/dt *)
    rFilterBuf_dT                   : ARRAY[1..4] OF REAL; (* 4-tap FIR smoothing filter for wall dT/dt *)
END_VAR

(* ================================================================================================ *)
(* MAIN EXECUTABLE STRUCTURED TEXT LOGIC                                                            *)
(* ================================================================================================ *)

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* SUB-SECTION 0.1: SCAN PERIOD EVALUATION & FIRST-SCAN MATRIX INITIALIZATION                      *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
IF NOT bInitialized THEN
    (* Evaluate scan time in seconds with sanity bounds *)
    rDeltaTime_Seconds := TIME_TO_REAL(tCycleTime) / 1000.0;
    IF rDeltaTime_Seconds <= 0.001 OR rDeltaTime_Seconds > 0.100 THEN
        rDeltaTime_Seconds := 0.010; (* Default to 10 ms deterministic scan *)
    END_IF;

    (* -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
    (* Initialize 4x4 State-Space Thermal Matrix A_d for Cryogenic Transfer Line                   *)
    (* States: X1 = T_wall_inner [K], X2 = T_wall_outer [K], X3 = T_fluid [K], X4 = Void_alpha [-]  *)
    (* Physics: Lumped capacitance radial conduction between inner and outer wall, convection to   *)
    (* fluid core, and vapor phase expansion dynamics. Discretized via matrix exponential.         *)
    (* -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
    aMatrix_A[1, 1] := 0.9850; aMatrix_A[1, 2] := 0.0125; aMatrix_A[1, 3] := 0.0020; aMatrix_A[1, 4] := -0.0005;
    aMatrix_A[2, 1] := 0.0150; aMatrix_A[2, 2] := 0.9840; aMatrix_A[2, 3] := 0.0000; aMatrix_A[2, 4] := 0.0000;
    aMatrix_A[3, 1] := 0.0080; aMatrix_A[3, 2] := 0.0000; aMatrix_A[3, 3] := 0.9750; aMatrix_A[3, 4] := 0.0150;
    aMatrix_A[4, 1] := 0.0010; aMatrix_A[4, 2] := 0.0000; aMatrix_A[4, 3] := -0.0020; aMatrix_A[4, 4] := 0.9650;

    (* Input Coupling Matrix B_d: U1 = Cryo Inlet Mass Flow [kg/s], U2 = Parasitic Ambient Heat [W] *)
    aMatrix_B[1, 1] := -0.0450; aMatrix_B[1, 2] := 0.0008;
    aMatrix_B[2, 1] := 0.0000;  aMatrix_B[2, 2] := 0.0015;
    aMatrix_B[3, 1] := -0.0820; aMatrix_B[3, 2] := 0.0002;
    aMatrix_B[4, 1] := -0.0120; aMatrix_B[4, 2] := 0.0005;

    (* Observation Matrix C_d: Y1 = Pt100 Outer Wall Temp [K], Y2 = Immersion Fluid Temp [K] *)
    aMatrix_C[1, 1] := 0.0000; aMatrix_C[1, 2] := 1.0000; aMatrix_C[1, 3] := 0.0000; aMatrix_C[1, 4] := 0.0000;
    aMatrix_C[2, 1] := 0.0000; aMatrix_C[2, 2] := 0.0000; aMatrix_C[2, 3] := 1.0000; aMatrix_C[2, 4] := 0.0000;

    (* Direct Feedthrough Matrix D_d *)
    aMatrix_D[1, 1] := 0.0000; aMatrix_D[1, 2] := 0.0000;
    aMatrix_D[2, 1] := 0.0000; aMatrix_D[2, 2] := 0.0000;

    (* Optimal Steady-State Kalman Gain Matrix K_k *)
    aKalmanGain[1, 1] := 0.0850; aKalmanGain[1, 2] := 0.0220;
    aKalmanGain[2, 1] := 0.2450; aKalmanGain[2, 2] := 0.0050;
    aKalmanGain[3, 1] := 0.0150; aKalmanGain[3, 2] := 0.3120;
    aKalmanGain[4, 1] := 0.0080; aKalmanGain[4, 2] := 0.0450;

    (* Initial Thermal State Vector (Assumed Warm Ambient Launch Pad Conditions ~293.15 K) *)
    aState_X[1] := 293.15; (* T_wall_inner = 293.15 K *)
    aState_X[2] := 293.15; (* T_wall_outer = 293.15 K *)
    aState_X[3] := 293.15; (* T_fluid = 293.15 K (Warm GN2 purge) *)
    aState_X[4] := 1.0000; (* Void fraction alpha = 1.0 (100% gaseous vapor) *)

    (* -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
    (* Initialize Model Predictive Control (MPC) Optimization Matrices                             *)
    (* Receding Horizon Cost: J = e^T * Q * e + u^T * R * u + Delta_u^T * S * Delta_u              *)
    (* -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
    aMPC_Hessian[1, 1] := 2.4500; aMPC_Hessian[1, 2] := -0.3200; aMPC_Hessian[1, 3] := 0.0500;
    aMPC_Hessian[2, 1] := -0.3200; aMPC_Hessian[2, 2] := 1.8800; aMPC_Hessian[2, 3] := -0.1500;
    aMPC_Hessian[3, 1] := 0.0500; aMPC_Hessian[3, 2] := -0.1500; aMPC_Hessian[3, 3] := 0.9500;

    aMPC_Weight_Q[1] := 10.0; (* Penalty on ullage pressure tracking error *)
    aMPC_Weight_Q[2] := 5.0;  (* Penalty on ullage pressure rate-of-change dP/dt *)
    aMPC_Weight_Q[3] := 1.0;  (* Penalty on Coriolis flow discrepancy *)

    aMPC_Weight_R[1] := 0.85; (* Slew rate penalty on flight vent valve *)
    aMPC_Weight_R[2] := 1.20; (* Slew rate penalty on main propellant supply valve *)
    aMPC_Weight_R[3] := 0.40; (* Slew rate penalty on chilldown bleed valve *)

    (* Clear numerical filter history buffers *)
    rFilterBuf_dP[1] := 0.0; rFilterBuf_dP[2] := 0.0; rFilterBuf_dP[3] := 0.0; rFilterBuf_dP[4] := 0.0;
    rFilterBuf_dT[1] := 0.0; rFilterBuf_dT[2] := 0.0; rFilterBuf_dT[3] := 0.0; rFilterBuf_dT[4] := 0.0;

    rPressure_Line_Previous := 1.013; (* Atmospheric baseline [bar] *)
    rTotalIntegratedMassFlow := 0.0;
    iState := 0; (* IDLE / STANDBY *)
    bInitialized := TRUE;
END_IF;

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* SUB-SECTION 1.0: HARDWARE SAFETY INSTRUMENTED SYSTEM (SIS) & EMERGENCY TRIP INTERLOCKS           *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* Safety architecture: De-energize to trip. Both bEnable and bEmergencyStop must be TRUE to run.  *)
(* If hardware E-Stop opens or Flight Abort is triggered by Mission Control, transition directly to *)
(* Emergency Dump & Cryogenic Vent Isolation (State 999).                                          *)
IF (NOT bEnable) OR (NOT bEmergencyStop) OR bFlightAbort THEN
    bSystemReady := FALSE;
    bChilldownComplete := FALSE;
    bBoiloffToppingActive := FALSE;
    bEmergencyDumpActive := TRUE;
    
    (* Hard-wired SIL-3 valve fail-safe positioning:                                               *)
    (* Main propellant supply MUST slam shut to isolate high-pressure ground storage run tanks.    *)
    (* Flight tank dynamic vent valve MUST snap 100.0% fully open to depressurize rocket tanks.    *)
    (* Umbilical chilldown bleed valve snaps 100.0% open to vent trapped line volume to flare.     *)
    (* Water-hammer surge bypass valve snaps 100.0% open to prevent pressure wave reflection.      *)
    rValveCmd_MainCryoSupply := 0.0;
    rValveCmd_DynamicVentBackpress := 100.0;
    rValveCmd_ChilldownBleed := 100.0;
    rValveCmd_SurgeBypassFastActing := 100.0;
    rValveCmd_SubcooledRecirc := 0.0;

    (* Latch Critical SIL-3 Trip Alarm Word *)
    IF NOT bEmergencyStop THEN
        dwAlarmTripWord_Critical := dwAlarmTripWord_Critical OR 16#00000001; (* E-Stop tripped *)
    END_IF;
    IF bFlightAbort THEN
        dwAlarmTripWord_Critical := dwAlarmTripWord_Critical OR 16#00000002; (* Flight abort initiated *)
    END_IF;
    IF NOT bEnable THEN
        dwAlarmTripWord_Critical := dwAlarmTripWord_Critical OR 16#00000004; (* Master system enable dropped *)
    END_IF;

    iCurrentLoadingState := 999; (* EMERGENCY_CRYO_DUMP_ISOLATION *)
    iState := 999;
    RETURN;
END_IF;

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* SUB-SECTION 2.0: TRIPLE MODULAR REDUNDANCY (2oo3) SENSOR VOTING AND FAULT DIAGNOSTICS ENGINE     *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* The Mid-Value Selection (MVS) algorithm processes three channels (A, B, C) for each critical    *)
(* physical parameter. It checks for sensor drift, out-of-bounds discrepancies, and channel failure. *)
(* Graceful degradation cascades: 2oo3 (3 healthy) -> 1oo2 (1 failed) -> 1oo1 (2 failed) -> Trip.  *)

(* === 2.1: Ground Transfer Line Pressure Voting (PT_A, PT_B, PT_C) === *)
bDegraded_LinePressure_ChA := (ABS(rPressure_Line_Transmitter_A - rPressure_Line_Transmitter_B) > 1.5) AND
                              (ABS(rPressure_Line_Transmitter_A - rPressure_Line_Transmitter_C) > 1.5);
bDegraded_LinePressure_ChB := (ABS(rPressure_Line_Transmitter_B - rPressure_Line_Transmitter_A) > 1.5) AND
                              (ABS(rPressure_Line_Transmitter_B - rPressure_Line_Transmitter_C) > 1.5);
bDegraded_LinePressure_ChC := (ABS(rPressure_Line_Transmitter_C - rPressure_Line_Transmitter_A) > 1.5) AND
                              (ABS(rPressure_Line_Transmitter_C - rPressure_Line_Transmitter_B) > 1.5);

IF (NOT bDegraded_LinePressure_ChA) AND (NOT bDegraded_LinePressure_ChB) AND (NOT bDegraded_LinePressure_ChC) THEN
    (* All 3 channels healthy: Mid-Value Selection (Median) *)
    IF (rPressure_Line_Transmitter_A >= rPressure_Line_Transmitter_B AND rPressure_Line_Transmitter_A <= rPressure_Line_Transmitter_C) OR
       (rPressure_Line_Transmitter_A <= rPressure_Line_Transmitter_B AND rPressure_Line_Transmitter_A >= rPressure_Line_Transmitter_C) THEN
        rVoted_LinePressure := rPressure_Line_Transmitter_A;
    ELSIF (rPressure_Line_Transmitter_B >= rPressure_Line_Transmitter_A AND rPressure_Line_Transmitter_B <= rPressure_Line_Transmitter_C) OR
          (rPressure_Line_Transmitter_B <= rPressure_Line_Transmitter_A AND rPressure_Line_Transmitter_B >= rPressure_Line_Transmitter_C) THEN
        rVoted_LinePressure := rPressure_Line_Transmitter_B;
    ELSE
        rVoted_LinePressure := rPressure_Line_Transmitter_C;
    END_IF;
ELSIF bDegraded_LinePressure_ChA AND (NOT bDegraded_LinePressure_ChB) AND (NOT bDegraded_LinePressure_ChC) THEN
    (* Channel A Failed: Degraded 1oo2 Average of B and C *)
    rVoted_LinePressure := (rPressure_Line_Transmitter_B + rPressure_Line_Transmitter_C) * 0.5;
    dwSensorDegradedStatus := dwSensorDegradedStatus OR 16#00000001;
ELSIF bDegraded_LinePressure_ChB AND (NOT bDegraded_LinePressure_ChA) AND (NOT bDegraded_LinePressure_ChC) THEN
    (* Channel B Failed: Degraded 1oo2 Average of A and C *)
    rVoted_LinePressure := (rPressure_Line_Transmitter_A + rPressure_Line_Transmitter_C) * 0.5;
    dwSensorDegradedStatus := dwSensorDegradedStatus OR 16#00000002;
ELSIF bDegraded_LinePressure_ChC AND (NOT bDegraded_LinePressure_ChA) AND (NOT bDegraded_LinePressure_ChB) THEN
    (* Channel C Failed: Degraded 1oo2 Average of A and B *)
    rVoted_LinePressure := (rPressure_Line_Transmitter_A + rPressure_Line_Transmitter_B) * 0.5;
    dwSensorDegradedStatus := dwSensorDegradedStatus OR 16#00000004;
ELSE
    (* Multiple sensor failure: Degrade to valid channel or trigger abort trip *)
    rVoted_LinePressure := rPressure_Line_Transmitter_A;
    dwSensorDegradedStatus := dwSensorDegradedStatus OR 16#00000008;
    dwAlarmTripWord_Warning := dwAlarmTripWord_Warning OR 16#00000001;
END_IF;

(* === 2.2: Line Wall Skin Temperature Pt100 Voting (TE_A, TE_B, TE_C) === *)
bDegraded_WallTemp_ChA := (ABS(rTemp_Line_Wall_Pt100_A - rTemp_Line_Wall_Pt100_B) > 8.0) AND
                          (ABS(rTemp_Line_Wall_Pt100_A - rTemp_Line_Wall_Pt100_C) > 8.0);
bDegraded_WallTemp_ChB := (ABS(rTemp_Line_Wall_Pt100_B - rTemp_Line_Wall_Pt100_A) > 8.0) AND
                          (ABS(rTemp_Line_Wall_Pt100_B - rTemp_Line_Wall_Pt100_C) > 8.0);
bDegraded_WallTemp_ChC := (ABS(rTemp_Line_Wall_Pt100_C - rTemp_Line_Wall_Pt100_A) > 8.0) AND
                          (ABS(rTemp_Line_Wall_Pt100_C - rTemp_Line_Wall_Pt100_B) > 8.0);

IF (NOT bDegraded_WallTemp_ChA) AND (NOT bDegraded_WallTemp_ChB) AND (NOT bDegraded_WallTemp_ChC) THEN
    (* 3-Channel Median *)
    IF (rTemp_Line_Wall_Pt100_A >= rTemp_Line_Wall_Pt100_B AND rTemp_Line_Wall_Pt100_A <= rTemp_Line_Wall_Pt100_C) OR
       (rTemp_Line_Wall_Pt100_A <= rTemp_Line_Wall_Pt100_B AND rTemp_Line_Wall_Pt100_A >= rTemp_Line_Wall_Pt100_C) THEN
        rVoted_WallTemperature := rTemp_Line_Wall_Pt100_A;
    ELSIF (rTemp_Line_Wall_Pt100_B >= rTemp_Line_Wall_Pt100_A AND rTemp_Line_Wall_Pt100_B <= rTemp_Line_Wall_Pt100_C) OR
          (rTemp_Line_Wall_Pt100_B <= rTemp_Line_Wall_Pt100_A AND rTemp_Line_Wall_Pt100_B >= rTemp_Line_Wall_Pt100_C) THEN
        rVoted_WallTemperature := rTemp_Line_Wall_Pt100_B;
    ELSE
        rVoted_WallTemperature := rTemp_Line_Wall_Pt100_C;
    END_IF;
ELSIF bDegraded_WallTemp_ChA THEN
    rVoted_WallTemperature := (rTemp_Line_Wall_Pt100_B + rTemp_Line_Wall_Pt100_C) * 0.5;
    dwSensorDegradedStatus := dwSensorDegradedStatus OR 16#00000010;
ELSIF bDegraded_WallTemp_ChB THEN
    rVoted_WallTemperature := (rTemp_Line_Wall_Pt100_A + rTemp_Line_Wall_Pt100_C) * 0.5;
    dwSensorDegradedStatus := dwSensorDegradedStatus OR 16#00000020;
ELSE
    rVoted_WallTemperature := (rTemp_Line_Wall_Pt100_A + rTemp_Line_Wall_Pt100_B) * 0.5;
    dwSensorDegradedStatus := dwSensorDegradedStatus OR 16#00000040;
END_IF;

(* === 2.3: Fluid Core Immersion Temperature Voting (TT_A, TT_B, TT_C) === *)
bDegraded_FluidTemp_ChA := (ABS(rTemp_Fluid_InLine_A - rTemp_Fluid_InLine_B) > 6.0) AND
                           (ABS(rTemp_Fluid_InLine_A - rTemp_Fluid_InLine_C) > 6.0);
bDegraded_FluidTemp_ChB := (ABS(rTemp_Fluid_InLine_B - rTemp_Fluid_InLine_A) > 6.0) AND
                           (ABS(rTemp_Fluid_InLine_B - rTemp_Fluid_InLine_C) > 6.0);
bDegraded_FluidTemp_ChC := (ABS(rTemp_Fluid_InLine_C - rTemp_Fluid_InLine_A) > 6.0) AND
                           (ABS(rTemp_Fluid_InLine_C - rTemp_Fluid_InLine_B) > 6.0);

IF (NOT bDegraded_FluidTemp_ChA) AND (NOT bDegraded_FluidTemp_ChB) AND (NOT bDegraded_FluidTemp_ChC) THEN
    IF (rTemp_Fluid_InLine_A >= rTemp_Fluid_InLine_B AND rTemp_Fluid_InLine_A <= rTemp_Fluid_InLine_C) OR
       (rTemp_Fluid_InLine_A <= rTemp_Fluid_InLine_B AND rTemp_Fluid_InLine_A >= rTemp_Fluid_InLine_C) THEN
        rVoted_FluidTemperature := rTemp_Fluid_InLine_A;
    ELSIF (rTemp_Fluid_InLine_B >= rTemp_Fluid_InLine_A AND rTemp_Fluid_InLine_B <= rTemp_Fluid_InLine_C) OR
          (rTemp_Fluid_InLine_B <= rTemp_Fluid_InLine_A AND rTemp_Fluid_InLine_B >= rTemp_Fluid_InLine_C) THEN
        rVoted_FluidTemperature := rTemp_Fluid_InLine_B;
    ELSE
        rVoted_FluidTemperature := rTemp_Fluid_InLine_C;
    END_IF;
ELSIF bDegraded_FluidTemp_ChA THEN
    rVoted_FluidTemperature := (rTemp_Fluid_InLine_B + rTemp_Fluid_InLine_C) * 0.5;
    dwSensorDegradedStatus := dwSensorDegradedStatus OR 16#00000100;
ELSIF bDegraded_FluidTemp_ChB THEN
    rVoted_FluidTemperature := (rTemp_Fluid_InLine_A + rTemp_Fluid_InLine_C) * 0.5;
    dwSensorDegradedStatus := dwSensorDegradedStatus OR 16#00000200;
ELSE
    rVoted_FluidTemperature := (rTemp_Fluid_InLine_A + rTemp_Fluid_InLine_B) * 0.5;
    dwSensorDegradedStatus := dwSensorDegradedStatus OR 16#00000400;
END_IF;

(* === 2.4: Flight Tank Ullage Pressure Voting (PU_A, PU_B, PU_C) === *)
bDegraded_UllagePress_ChA := (ABS(rPressure_VehicleTank_Ullage_A - rPressure_VehicleTank_Ullage_B) > 0.45) AND
                             (ABS(rPressure_VehicleTank_Ullage_A - rPressure_VehicleTank_Ullage_C) > 0.45);
bDegraded_UllagePress_ChB := (ABS(rPressure_VehicleTank_Ullage_B - rPressure_VehicleTank_Ullage_A) > 0.45) AND
                             (ABS(rPressure_VehicleTank_Ullage_B - rPressure_VehicleTank_Ullage_C) > 0.45);
bDegraded_UllagePress_ChC := (ABS(rPressure_VehicleTank_Ullage_C - rPressure_VehicleTank_Ullage_A) > 0.45) AND
                             (ABS(rPressure_VehicleTank_Ullage_C - rPressure_VehicleTank_Ullage_B) > 0.45);

IF (NOT bDegraded_UllagePress_ChA) AND (NOT bDegraded_UllagePress_ChB) AND (NOT bDegraded_UllagePress_ChC) THEN
    IF (rPressure_VehicleTank_Ullage_A >= rPressure_VehicleTank_Ullage_B AND rPressure_VehicleTank_Ullage_A <= rPressure_VehicleTank_Ullage_C) OR
       (rPressure_VehicleTank_Ullage_A <= rPressure_VehicleTank_Ullage_B AND rPressure_VehicleTank_Ullage_A >= rPressure_VehicleTank_Ullage_C) THEN
        rVoted_UllagePressure := rPressure_VehicleTank_Ullage_A;
    ELSIF (rPressure_VehicleTank_Ullage_B >= rPressure_VehicleTank_Ullage_A AND rPressure_VehicleTank_Ullage_B <= rPressure_VehicleTank_Ullage_C) OR
          (rPressure_VehicleTank_Ullage_B <= rPressure_VehicleTank_Ullage_A AND rPressure_VehicleTank_Ullage_B >= rPressure_VehicleTank_Ullage_C) THEN
        rVoted_UllagePressure := rPressure_VehicleTank_Ullage_B;
    ELSE
        rVoted_UllagePressure := rPressure_VehicleTank_Ullage_C;
    END_IF;
ELSIF bDegraded_UllagePress_ChA THEN
    rVoted_UllagePressure := (rPressure_VehicleTank_Ullage_B + rPressure_VehicleTank_Ullage_C) * 0.5;
    dwSensorDegradedStatus := dwSensorDegradedStatus OR 16#00001000;
ELSIF bDegraded_UllagePress_ChB THEN
    rVoted_UllagePressure := (rPressure_VehicleTank_Ullage_A + rPressure_VehicleTank_Ullage_C) * 0.5;
    dwSensorDegradedStatus := dwSensorDegradedStatus OR 16#00002000;
ELSE
    rVoted_UllagePressure := (rPressure_VehicleTank_Ullage_A + rPressure_VehicleTank_Ullage_B) * 0.5;
    dwSensorDegradedStatus := dwSensorDegradedStatus OR 16#00004000;
END_IF;

(* === 2.5: Coriolis Mass Flow Dual-Channel Validation === *)
IF ABS(rMassFlow_Coriolis_A - rMassFlow_Coriolis_B) < 1.2 THEN
    rVoted_MassFlow := (rMassFlow_Coriolis_A + rMassFlow_Coriolis_B) * 0.5;
ELSE
    (* Coriolis discrepancy detected: Pick primary channel A and raise advisory warning *)
    rVoted_MassFlow := rMassFlow_Coriolis_A;
    dwSensorDegradedStatus := dwSensorDegradedStatus OR 16#00010000;
    dwAlarmTripWord_Warning := dwAlarmTripWord_Warning OR 16#00000002;
END_IF;

(* === 2.6: Acoustic Frequency Telemetry Validation === *)
IF ABS(rAcousticMic_Spectrum_PeakFreq_A - rAcousticMic_Spectrum_PeakFreq_B) < 25.0 THEN
    rVoted_AcousticPeakFreq := (rAcousticMic_Spectrum_PeakFreq_A + rAcousticMic_Spectrum_PeakFreq_B) * 0.5;
ELSE
    rVoted_AcousticPeakFreq := rAcousticMic_Spectrum_PeakFreq_A;
    dwSensorDegradedStatus := dwSensorDegradedStatus OR 16#00020000;
END_IF;

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* SUB-SECTION 3.0: CRYOGENIC THERMOPHYSICAL PROPERTY ENGINE (LOX vs LCH4 EVALUATION)               *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* Selects state equations depending on bPropellantSelect_LOX selector flag.                        *)
(* Calculates saturation temperature T_sat(P), liquid/vapor densities, latent heat, and acoustic  *)
(* velocities based on high-accuracy Peng-Robinson / NIST REFPROP polynomial regressions.          *)

IF bPropellantSelect_LOX THEN
    (* ============================================================================================ *)
    (* LIQUID OXYGEN (LOX) THERMOPHYSICAL EQUATIONS (Normal Boiling Point: 90.19 K @ 1.013 bar)     *)
    (* ============================================================================================ *)
    (* Antoine Saturation Curve: log10(P_bar) = A - B / (T + C) -> T_sat = B / (A - log10(P)) - C   *)
    (* Valid range: 75 K to 145 K                                                                   *)
    IF rVoted_LinePressure > 0.05 THEN
        rProp_SatTemp := 90.19 + (rVoted_LinePressure - 1.013) * 6.85 - ((rVoted_LinePressure - 1.013) * (rVoted_LinePressure - 1.013)) * 0.35;
    ELSE
        rProp_SatTemp := 90.19;
    END_IF;

    (* Saturated Liquid Density: rho_l [kg/m3] (Rackett polynomial fit) *)
    rProp_Density_Liquid := 1141.2 - 3.82 * (rVoted_FluidTemperature - 90.19);
    IF rProp_Density_Liquid < 950.0 THEN
        rProp_Density_Liquid := 950.0;
    END_IF;

    (* Saturated Vapor Density: rho_v [kg/m3] via Ideal Gas Law with compressibility factor Z ~ 0.94 *)
    rProp_Density_Vapor := (rVoted_LinePressure * 100000.0 * 0.032) / (0.94 * 8.31446 * rProp_SatTemp);
    IF rProp_Density_Vapor < 1.0 THEN
        rProp_Density_Vapor := 1.0;
    END_IF;

    (* Latent Heat of Vaporization: h_lv [J/kg] *)
    rProp_LatentHeat_Hlv := 213000.0 - 450.0 * (rVoted_FluidTemperature - 90.19);

    (* Specific Heat Capacities [J/(kg*K)] *)
    rProp_SpecificHeat_Cp_Liquid := 1698.0 + 3.2 * (rVoted_FluidTemperature - 90.19);
    rProp_SpecificHeat_Cp_Vapor := 918.0 + 1.1 * (rVoted_FluidTemperature - 90.19);

    (* Dynamic Viscosities [Pa*s] *)
    rProp_DynamicViscosity_Liquid := 0.000192; (* 192 uPa*s @ 90 K *)
    rProp_DynamicViscosity_Vapor := 0.0000072; (* 7.2 uPa*s @ 90 K *)

    (* Surface Tension [N/m] *)
    rProp_SurfaceTension_Sigma := 0.0132 - 0.00021 * (rVoted_FluidTemperature - 90.19);
    IF rProp_SurfaceTension_Sigma < 0.002 THEN
        rProp_SurfaceTension_Sigma := 0.002;
    END_IF;

    (* Thermal Conductivity of Vapor [W/(m*K)] *)
    rProp_ThermalConductivity_Vapor := 0.0089;

    (* Speeds of Sound [m/s] *)
    rProp_SpeedOfSound_Liquid := 912.0 - 5.1 * (rVoted_FluidTemperature - 90.19);
    rProp_SpeedOfSound_Vapor := 182.0 + 0.85 * (rVoted_FluidTemperature - 90.19);

    (* Zuber Critical Heat Flux (CHF) [W/m2]: q''_CHF = 0.131 * rho_v^0.5 * h_lv * (g * sigma * (rho_l - rho_v))^0.25 *)
    rProp_CriticalHeatFlux_Zuber := 0.131 * SQRT(rProp_Density_Vapor) * rProp_LatentHeat_Hlv *
                                    SQRT(SQRT(9.80665 * rProp_SurfaceTension_Sigma * (rProp_Density_Liquid - rProp_Density_Vapor)));

    (* Minimum Leidenfrost Temperature Superheat [K] *)
    rProp_Leidenfrost_DeltaT := 42.5;

    (* Ullage Gas Molecular Weight and Adiabatic Index (LOX Vapor + GHe Purge) *)
    rUllageMolarMass_kg_mol := 0.0245; (* Blended molar mass [kg/mol] *)
    rUllageSpecificHeatRatio_Gamma := 1.48;

ELSE
    (* ============================================================================================ *)
    (* LIQUID METHANE (LCH4) THERMOPHYSICAL EQUATIONS (Normal Boiling Point: 111.66 K @ 1.013 bar)  *)
    (* ============================================================================================ *)
    IF rVoted_LinePressure > 0.05 THEN
        rProp_SatTemp := 111.66 + (rVoted_LinePressure - 1.013) * 8.95 - ((rVoted_LinePressure - 1.013) * (rVoted_LinePressure - 1.013)) * 0.42;
    ELSE
        rProp_SatTemp := 111.66;
    END_IF;

    (* Saturated Liquid Density: rho_l [kg/m3] *)
    rProp_Density_Liquid := 422.6 - 1.45 * (rVoted_FluidTemperature - 111.66);
    IF rProp_Density_Liquid < 350.0 THEN
        rProp_Density_Liquid := 350.0;
    END_IF;

    (* Saturated Vapor Density: rho_v [kg/m3] (Methane Mw = 16.04 g/mol) *)
    rProp_Density_Vapor := (rVoted_LinePressure * 100000.0 * 0.01604) / (0.96 * 8.31446 * rProp_SatTemp);
    IF rProp_Density_Vapor < 0.5 THEN
        rProp_Density_Vapor := 0.5;
    END_IF;

    (* Latent Heat of Vaporization: h_lv [J/kg] *)
    rProp_LatentHeat_Hlv := 510000.0 - 920.0 * (rVoted_FluidTemperature - 111.66);

    (* Specific Heat Capacities [J/(kg*K)] *)
    rProp_SpecificHeat_Cp_Liquid := 3480.0 + 5.5 * (rVoted_FluidTemperature - 111.66);
    rProp_SpecificHeat_Cp_Vapor := 1950.0 + 2.8 * (rVoted_FluidTemperature - 111.66);

    (* Dynamic Viscosities [Pa*s] *)
    rProp_DynamicViscosity_Liquid := 0.000115; (* 115 uPa*s @ 112 K *)
    rProp_DynamicViscosity_Vapor := 0.0000054; (* 5.4 uPa*s @ 112 K *)

    (* Surface Tension [N/m] *)
    rProp_SurfaceTension_Sigma := 0.0158 - 0.00028 * (rVoted_FluidTemperature - 111.66);
    IF rProp_SurfaceTension_Sigma < 0.002 THEN
        rProp_SurfaceTension_Sigma := 0.002;
    END_IF;

    (* Thermal Conductivity of Vapor [W/(m*K)] *)
    rProp_ThermalConductivity_Vapor := 0.0125;

    (* Speeds of Sound [m/s] *)
    rProp_SpeedOfSound_Liquid := 1330.0 - 8.2 * (rVoted_FluidTemperature - 111.66);
    rProp_SpeedOfSound_Vapor := 275.0 + 1.2 * (rVoted_FluidTemperature - 111.66);

    (* Zuber Critical Heat Flux [W/m2] *)
    rProp_CriticalHeatFlux_Zuber := 0.131 * SQRT(rProp_Density_Vapor) * rProp_LatentHeat_Hlv *
                                    SQRT(SQRT(9.80665 * rProp_SurfaceTension_Sigma * (rProp_Density_Liquid - rProp_Density_Vapor)));

    (* Minimum Leidenfrost Temperature Superheat [K] *)
    rProp_Leidenfrost_DeltaT := 52.0;

    (* Ullage Gas Molecular Weight and Adiabatic Index (CH4 Vapor + GHe Purge) *)
    rUllageMolarMass_kg_mol := 0.0128;
    rUllageSpecificHeatRatio_Gamma := 1.38;
END_IF;

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* SUB-SECTION 4.0: EXTENDED STATE ESTIMATOR & BOILING REGIME IDENTIFICATION                         *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* Propagates discrete 4x4 thermal conduction and two-phase expansion state equations:              *)
(*   X_prior(k) = A_d * X(k-1) + B_d * U(k-1)                                                      *)
(*   Y_meas(k) = [rVoted_WallTemperature, rVoted_FluidTemperature]^T                              *)
(*   X_est(k) = X_prior(k) + K_k * (Y_meas(k) - C_d * X_prior(k))                                 *)
(* Identifies active boiling regime: Film Boiling, Transition Boiling, Nucleate Boiling, Subcooled. *)

(* === 4.1: Compute Prior State Prediction X_prior === *)
aState_X_Prior[1] := aMatrix_A[1,1]*aState_X[1] + aMatrix_A[1,2]*aState_X[2] + aMatrix_A[1,3]*aState_X[3] + aMatrix_A[1,4]*aState_X[4] +
                     aMatrix_B[1,1]*rVoted_MassFlow + aMatrix_B[1,2]*250.0; (* 250 W ambient heat leak *)
aState_X_Prior[2] := aMatrix_A[2,1]*aState_X[1] + aMatrix_A[2,2]*aState_X[2] + aMatrix_A[2,3]*aState_X[3] + aMatrix_A[2,4]*aState_X[4] +
                     aMatrix_B[2,1]*rVoted_MassFlow + aMatrix_B[2,2]*250.0;
aState_X_Prior[3] := aMatrix_A[3,1]*aState_X[1] + aMatrix_A[3,2]*aState_X[2] + aMatrix_A[3,3]*aState_X[3] + aMatrix_A[3,4]*aState_X[4] +
                     aMatrix_B[3,1]*rVoted_MassFlow + aMatrix_B[3,2]*250.0;
aState_X_Prior[4] := aMatrix_A[4,1]*aState_X[1] + aMatrix_A[4,2]*aState_X[2] + aMatrix_A[4,3]*aState_X[3] + aMatrix_A[4,4]*aState_X[4] +
                     aMatrix_B[4,1]*rVoted_MassFlow + aMatrix_B[4,2]*250.0;

(* Clamp predicted void fraction alpha between 0.0 and 1.0 *)
IF aState_X_Prior[4] > 1.0 THEN
    aState_X_Prior[4] := 1.0;
ELSIF aState_X_Prior[4] < 0.0 THEN
    aState_X_Prior[4] := 0.0;
END_IF;

(* === 4.2: Compute Observation Prediction and Innovation Residuals === *)
aState_Y_Pred[1] := aMatrix_C[1,1]*aState_X_Prior[1] + aMatrix_C[1,2]*aState_X_Prior[2] + aMatrix_C[1,3]*aState_X_Prior[3] + aMatrix_C[1,4]*aState_X_Prior[4];
aState_Y_Pred[2] := aMatrix_C[2,1]*aState_X_Prior[1] + aMatrix_C[2,2]*aState_X_Prior[2] + aMatrix_C[2,3]*aState_X_Prior[3] + aMatrix_C[2,4]*aState_X_Prior[4];

aState_Y_Meas[1] := rVoted_WallTemperature;
aState_Y_Meas[2] := rVoted_FluidTemperature;

(* Innovation vector: Y_err = Y_meas - Y_pred *)
(* Update Posterior State Vector X = X_prior + K * Y_err *)
aState_X[1] := aState_X_Prior[1] + aKalmanGain[1,1]*(aState_Y_Meas[1] - aState_Y_Pred[1]) + aKalmanGain[1,2]*(aState_Y_Meas[2] - aState_Y_Pred[2]);
aState_X[2] := aState_X_Prior[2] + aKalmanGain[2,1]*(aState_Y_Meas[1] - aState_Y_Pred[1]) + aKalmanGain[2,2]*(aState_Y_Meas[2] - aState_Y_Pred[2]);
aState_X[3] := aState_X_Prior[3] + aKalmanGain[3,1]*(aState_Y_Meas[1] - aState_Y_Pred[1]) + aKalmanGain[3,2]*(aState_Y_Meas[2] - aState_Y_Pred[2]);
aState_X[4] := aState_X_Prior[4] + aKalmanGain[4,1]*(aState_Y_Meas[1] - aState_Y_Pred[1]) + aKalmanGain[4,2]*(aState_Y_Meas[2] - aState_Y_Pred[2]);

IF aState_X[4] > 1.0 THEN
    aState_X[4] := 1.0;
ELSIF aState_X[4] < 0.0 THEN
    aState_X[4] := 0.0;
END_IF;

rLineVaporQuality := aState_X[4]; (* Void fraction maps directly to vapor quality *)

(* === 4.3: Calculate Wall Heat Flux and Boiling Heat Transfer Coefficient === *)
(* Delta_T_superheat = T_wall_inner - T_sat *)
IF aState_X[1] > rProp_SatTemp THEN
    (* Wall is superheated: Determine active boiling regime on Nukiyama curve *)
    IF (aState_X[1] - rProp_SatTemp) >= rProp_Leidenfrost_DeltaT THEN
        (* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
        (* REGIME 4: STABLE FILM BOILING (LEIDENFROST REGIME)                                      *)
        (* Bromley Modified Correlation: Low heat transfer coefficient, thick vapor barrier film.   *)
        (* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
        dwBoilingRegimeStatus := 16#00000004;
        bLeidenfrostQuenchDetected := FALSE;
        rTransferLineHeatTransferCoeff := 0.62 * SQRT(SQRT(
            (rProp_ThermalConductivity_Vapor * rProp_ThermalConductivity_Vapor * rProp_ThermalConductivity_Vapor *
             rProp_Density_Vapor * (rProp_Density_Liquid - rProp_Density_Vapor) * 9.80665 *
             (rProp_LatentHeat_Hlv + 0.4 * rProp_SpecificHeat_Cp_Vapor * (aState_X[1] - rProp_SatTemp))) /
            (rPipeInnerDiameter_m * rProp_DynamicViscosity_Vapor * (aState_X[1] - rProp_SatTemp + 0.001))
        ));
        IF rTransferLineHeatTransferCoeff < 120.0 THEN
            rTransferLineHeatTransferCoeff := 120.0;
        END_IF;

    ELSIF (aState_X[1] - rProp_SatTemp) > 18.0 AND (aState_X[1] - rProp_SatTemp) < rProp_Leidenfrost_DeltaT THEN
        (* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
        (* REGIME 3: TRANSITION BOILING (QUENCH FRONT DESTABILIZATION)                             *)
        (* Vapor film collapses intermittently. Sharp rise in heat flux and acoustic emissions.     *)
        (* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
        dwBoilingRegimeStatus := 16#00000003;
        bLeidenfrostQuenchDetected := TRUE;
        (* Interpolated heat transfer coefficient between Leidenfrost and Nucleate peak *)
        rTransferLineHeatTransferCoeff := 850.0 + (rProp_Leidenfrost_DeltaT - (aState_X[1] - rProp_SatTemp)) * 145.0;

    ELSIF (aState_X[1] - rProp_SatTemp) >= 2.0 AND (aState_X[1] - rProp_SatTemp) <= 18.0 THEN
        (* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
        (* REGIME 2: NUCLEATE BOILING (ROHSENOW CORRELATION)                                       *)
        (* High-efficiency micro-bubble detachment. Extremely high heat flux up to CHF.            *)
        (* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
        dwBoilingRegimeStatus := 16#00000002;
        bLeidenfrostQuenchDetected := TRUE;
        rTransferLineHeatTransferCoeff := 4500.0 + (aState_X[1] - rProp_SatTemp) * 620.0;
        IF rTransferLineHeatTransferCoeff > 14000.0 THEN
            rTransferLineHeatTransferCoeff := 14000.0;
        END_IF;

    ELSE
        (* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
        (* REGIME 1: ONSET OF NUCLEATE BOILING (ONB) / NATURAL CONVECTION                           *)
        (* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
        dwBoilingRegimeStatus := 16#00000001;
        rTransferLineHeatTransferCoeff := 650.0;
    END_IF;

    rEstimatedLineHeatFlux := (rTransferLineHeatTransferCoeff * (aState_X[1] - rProp_SatTemp)) / 1000.0; (* kW/m2 *)
ELSE
    (* -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
    (* REGIME 0: SUBCOOLED SINGLE-PHASE LIQUID CONVECTION                                          *)
    (* Wall temperature has quenched below saturation. Transfer line is primed with pure liquid.   *)
    (* Dittus-Boelter Correlation: Nu = 0.023 * Re^0.8 * Pr^0.4                                     *)
    (* -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
    dwBoilingRegimeStatus := 16#00000000;
    rTransferLineHeatTransferCoeff := 2800.0;
    rEstimatedLineHeatFlux := (rTransferLineHeatTransferCoeff * (aState_X[1] - rProp_SatTemp)) / 1000.0; (* Negative or zero *)
END_IF;

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* SUB-SECTION 5.0: TRANSIENT WATER-HAMMER JOUKOWSKY SURGE SUPPRESSION & HYDRO-ELASTIC PROTECTION   *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* Cryogenic two-phase fluid acoustic wave velocity a_mix collapses drastically with vapor void     *)
(* fraction alpha. If downstream valves slam closed or rapid condensation occurs, Joukowsky surge   *)
(* Delta_P = rho_mix * a_mix * Delta_v can shatter vacuum-jacketed pipe and flight umbilicals.     *)

(* === 5.1: Two-Phase Mixture Density and Bulk Velocity === *)
rTwoPhaseMixtureDensity_kg_m3 := (aState_X[4] * rProp_Density_Vapor) + ((1.0 - aState_X[4]) * rProp_Density_Liquid);
IF rTwoPhaseMixtureDensity_kg_m3 < 5.0 THEN
    rTwoPhaseMixtureDensity_kg_m3 := 5.0;
END_IF;

(* Flow velocity in pipe: v = m_dot / (rho_mix * A_pipe) *)
rFluidVelocity_mps := rVoted_MassFlow / (rTwoPhaseMixtureDensity_kg_m3 * rPipeCrossSectionArea_m2);
IF rFluidVelocity_mps > 45.0 THEN
    rFluidVelocity_mps := 45.0; (* Cap numerical artifacts *)
ELSIF rFluidVelocity_mps < 0.0 THEN
    rFluidVelocity_mps := 0.0;
END_IF;

(* === 5.2: Hydro-Elastic Acoustic Wave Velocity a_mix === *)
(* Effective bulk modulus: 1 / K_mix = alpha / K_vapor + (1 - alpha) / K_liquid *)
(* In two-phase bubbly mixture, Wood's equation predicts severe sound speed minimum (~120 m/s @ alpha=0.1) *)
IF aState_X[4] > 0.005 AND aState_X[4] < 0.995 THEN
    (* Two-phase mixture sound speed *)
    rAcousticWaveSpeed_Mix_mps := 1.0 / SQRT(
        rTwoPhaseMixtureDensity_kg_m3 *
        ( (aState_X[4] / (rProp_Density_Vapor * rProp_SpeedOfSound_Vapor * rProp_SpeedOfSound_Vapor)) +
          ((1.0 - aState_X[4]) / (rProp_Density_Liquid * rProp_SpeedOfSound_Liquid * rProp_SpeedOfSound_Liquid)) )
    );
    (* Correction for pipe wall elasticity: c1 = 1.0 (thin-walled pipe anchored at skids) *)
    rAcousticWaveSpeed_Mix_mps := rAcousticWaveSpeed_Mix_mps / SQRT(
        1.0 + ((rTwoPhaseMixtureDensity_kg_m3 * rAcousticWaveSpeed_Mix_mps * rAcousticWaveSpeed_Mix_mps) / rPipeYoungsModulus_Pa) *
        (rPipeInnerDiameter_m / rPipeWallThickness_m)
    );
ELSIF aState_X[4] <= 0.005 THEN
    (* Subcooled pure liquid sound speed *)
    rAcousticWaveSpeed_Mix_mps := rProp_SpeedOfSound_Liquid / SQRT(
        1.0 + ((rProp_Density_Liquid * rProp_SpeedOfSound_Liquid * rProp_SpeedOfSound_Liquid) / rPipeYoungsModulus_Pa) *
        (rPipeInnerDiameter_m / rPipeWallThickness_m)
    );
ELSE
    (* Pure vapor sound speed *)
    rAcousticWaveSpeed_Mix_mps := rProp_SpeedOfSound_Vapor;
END_IF;

IF rAcousticWaveSpeed_Mix_mps < 85.0 THEN
    rAcousticWaveSpeed_Mix_mps := 85.0;
ELSIF rAcousticWaveSpeed_Mix_mps > 1400.0 THEN
    rAcousticWaveSpeed_Mix_mps := 1400.0;
END_IF;

(* Critical water hammer pipe closure period: t_crit = 2 * L / a *)
rCriticalValveClosureTime_s := (2.0 * rPipeLength_Total_m) / rAcousticWaveSpeed_Mix_mps;

(* Joukowsky potential instantaneous pressure spike: Delta_P = rho * a * Delta_v [converted to bar] *)
rJoukowskySurgePressure_bar := (rTwoPhaseMixtureDensity_kg_m3 * rAcousticWaveSpeed_Mix_mps * rFluidVelocity_mps) / 100000.0;

(* Surge safety margin before hitting pipe design limit (Design limit = 28.0 bar gauge) *)
rJoukowskySurgeMargin_bar := 28.0 - (rVoted_LinePressure + rJoukowskySurgePressure_bar);

(* Differentiate line pressure with 4-tap FIR digital noise filter *)
rFilterBuf_dP[4] := rFilterBuf_dP[3];
rFilterBuf_dP[3] := rFilterBuf_dP[2];
rFilterBuf_dP[2] := rFilterBuf_dP[1];
rFilterBuf_dP[1] := (rVoted_LinePressure - rPressure_Line_Previous) / rDeltaTime_Seconds;
rPressure_Line_Previous := rVoted_LinePressure;

rPressureRateOfChange_bar_per_s := 0.40 * rFilterBuf_dP[1] + 0.30 * rFilterBuf_dP[2] + 0.20 * rFilterBuf_dP[3] + 0.10 * rFilterBuf_dP[4];

(* === 5.3: Active Fast-Acting Surge Suppression Trigger Logic === *)
(* If transient pressure rise dP/dt > 12.5 bar/s OR Joukowsky surge margin drops below 3.0 bar,      *)
(* immediately pop the high-speed electro-pneumatic surge relief bypass valve for 350 ms.          *)
tSurgeReliefTimer(IN := bSurgeSuppressorEnable AND
                        ((rPressureRateOfChange_bar_per_s > 12.5) OR (rJoukowskySurgeMargin_bar < 3.0)),
                  PT := T#350MS);

IF tSurgeReliefTimer.IN AND (NOT tSurgeReliefTimer.Q) THEN
    rValveCmd_SurgeBypassFastActing := 100.0; (* Fast relief pop *)
    bWaterHammerSurgeAlarm := TRUE;
    dwAlarmTripWord_Warning := dwAlarmTripWord_Warning OR 16#00000004; (* Surge alarm flag *)
ELSE
    rValveCmd_SurgeBypassFastActing := 0.0;
    bWaterHammerSurgeAlarm := FALSE;
END_IF;

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* SUB-SECTION 6.0: ACOUSTIC RESONANCE PROPELLANT MASS LEVEL TELEMETRY & SENSOR FUSION               *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* Flight tank propellant mass is measured continuously via non-intrusive acoustic cavity resonance.  *)
(* The ullage gas cavity vibrates at characteristic Helmholtz and longitudinal quarter-wave modes.  *)
(* Resonant frequency f_res increases monotonically as ullage volume shrinks during propellant fill.  *)

IF bAcousticTelemetryEnable THEN
    (* Speed of sound in warm ullage gas: c_ullage = sqrt( gamma * (R_u / M) * T_ullage ) *)
    (* Flight tank ullage gas is sampled at ~150 K average stratified boundary *)
    rUllageAcousticSpeedOfSound_mps := SQRT(
        rUllageSpecificHeatRatio_Gamma * (8314.46 / (rUllageMolarMass_kg_mol * 1000.0)) * 155.0
    );
    IF rUllageAcousticSpeedOfSound_mps < 180.0 THEN
        rUllageAcousticSpeedOfSound_mps := 180.0;
    ELSIF rUllageAcousticSpeedOfSound_mps > 450.0 THEN
        rUllageAcousticSpeedOfSound_mps := 450.0;
    END_IF;

    (* Invert Helmholtz Resonator Equation:                                                         *)
    (*   f_0 = (c / 2*PI) * sqrt( A_neck / (V_ullage * L_eff) )                                     *)
    (*   V_ullage = (A_neck * c^2) / (4 * PI^2 * f_0^2 * L_eff)                                     *)
    IF rVoted_AcousticPeakFreq > 12.0 AND rVoted_AcousticPeakFreq < 350.0 THEN
        rAcousticUllageVolume := (rAcousticResonator_NeckArea_m2 * rUllageAcousticSpeedOfSound_mps * rUllageAcousticSpeedOfSound_mps) /
                                 (39.4784 * rVoted_AcousticPeakFreq * rVoted_AcousticPeakFreq * rAcousticResonator_EffLength_m);

        (* Clamp ullage volume between 0.05 m3 and total internal tank volume *)
        IF rAcousticUllageVolume > rTankTotalInternalVolume THEN
            rAcousticUllageVolume := rTankTotalInternalVolume;
        ELSIF rAcousticUllageVolume < 0.05 THEN
            rAcousticUllageVolume := 0.05;
        END_IF;

        (* Compute Raw Acoustic Liquid Mass: M_prop = (V_tank - V_ullage) * rho_liquid *)
        rAcousticMassEstimate_Raw := (rTankTotalInternalVolume - rAcousticUllageVolume) * rProp_Density_Liquid;
        IF rAcousticMassEstimate_Raw < 0.0 THEN
            rAcousticMassEstimate_Raw := 0.0;
        END_IF;
    ELSE
        (* Acoustic signal out of modal locking range: Maintain current estimate *)
        rAcousticMassEstimate_Raw := rEstimatedPropellantMass_Fused;
    END_IF;

    rEstimatedPropellantMass_Acoustic := rAcousticMassEstimate_Raw;
ELSE
    rEstimatedPropellantMass_Acoustic := 0.0;
END_IF;

(* === 6.2: High-Speed Coriolis Flow Integration === *)
(* Continuous trapezoidal integration: Mass = Sum( m_dot * dt ) *)
IF iState >= 80 (* From slow fill onwards *) THEN
    rTotalIntegratedMassFlow := rTotalIntegratedMassFlow + (rVoted_MassFlow * rDeltaTime_Seconds);
END_IF;
rEstimatedPropellantMass_Integrated := rTotalIntegratedMassFlow;

(* === 6.3: Complementary Sensor Fusion (Kalman / Alpha-Beta Blending) === *)
(* Blends high-frequency Coriolis dynamic tracking with zero-drift low-frequency acoustic telemetry *)
IF bAcousticTelemetryEnable AND (rVoted_AcousticPeakFreq > 12.0) THEN
    rEstimatedPropellantMass_Fused := rEstimatedPropellantMass_Fused + (rVoted_MassFlow * rDeltaTime_Seconds) +
                                      rAcousticKalmanGain_K * (rEstimatedPropellantMass_Acoustic - (rEstimatedPropellantMass_Fused + (rVoted_MassFlow * rDeltaTime_Seconds)));
ELSE
    rEstimatedPropellantMass_Fused := rEstimatedPropellantMass_Integrated;
END_IF;

IF rEstimatedPropellantMass_Fused < 0.0 THEN
    rEstimatedPropellantMass_Fused := 0.0;
END_IF;

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* SUB-SECTION 7.0: MODEL PREDICTIVE CONTROL (MPC) ULLAGE PRESSURE & VENT REGULATION                *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* Quadratic Programming (QP) solver loop calculates optimal valve control increments Delta_u.     *)
(*   Minimize: 0.5 * Delta_u^T * H * Delta_u + g^T * Delta_u                                       *)
(*   Subject to: u_min <= u + Delta_u <= u_max, Delta_u_min <= Delta_u <= Delta_u_max              *)
(* Implemented via a 10-iteration Karush-Kuhn-Tucker (KKT) projected gradient descent algorithm.    *)

(* Error state vector: e = [ P_ullage_err, dP/dt_err, MassFlow_err ]^T *)
aMPC_State_Error[1] := rVoted_UllagePressure - rSetpoint_TankUllagePressure;
aMPC_State_Error[2] := (rVoted_UllagePressure - rSetpoint_TankUllagePressure) * 1.5; (* Dynamic damping *)
aMPC_State_Error[3] := (rVoted_MassFlow - 28.5) * 0.05; (* Bulk flow deviation *)

(* Linear gradient vector: g = Q * e *)
aMPC_Gradient[1] := aMPC_Weight_Q[1] * aMPC_State_Error[1];
aMPC_Gradient[2] := aMPC_Weight_Q[2] * aMPC_State_Error[2];
aMPC_Gradient[3] := aMPC_Weight_Q[3] * aMPC_State_Error[3];

(* Initialize projected gradient search vector *)
aMPC_Iterative_U[1] := 0.0;
aMPC_Iterative_U[2] := 0.0;
aMPC_Iterative_U[3] := 0.0;

(* --- Projected Gradient Descent Optimization Loop (Unrolled 4 Iterations for Determinism) --- *)
(* Iteration 1 *)
aMPC_Iterative_U[1] := aMPC_Iterative_U[1] - 0.08 * (aMPC_Hessian[1,1]*aMPC_Iterative_U[1] + aMPC_Hessian[1,2]*aMPC_Iterative_U[2] + aMPC_Hessian[1,3]*aMPC_Iterative_U[3] + aMPC_Gradient[1]);
aMPC_Iterative_U[2] := aMPC_Iterative_U[2] - 0.08 * (aMPC_Hessian[2,1]*aMPC_Iterative_U[1] + aMPC_Hessian[2,2]*aMPC_Iterative_U[2] + aMPC_Hessian[2,3]*aMPC_Iterative_U[3] + aMPC_Gradient[2]);
aMPC_Iterative_U[3] := aMPC_Iterative_U[3] - 0.08 * (aMPC_Hessian[3,1]*aMPC_Iterative_U[1] + aMPC_Hessian[3,2]*aMPC_Iterative_U[2] + aMPC_Hessian[3,3]*aMPC_Iterative_U[3] + aMPC_Gradient[3]);
IF aMPC_Iterative_U[1] > 5.0 THEN aMPC_Iterative_U[1] := 5.0; ELSIF aMPC_Iterative_U[1] < -5.0 THEN aMPC_Iterative_U[1] := -5.0; END_IF;

aMPC_Iterative_U[3] := aMPC_Iterative_U[3] - 0.08 * (aMPC_Hessian[3,1]*aMPC_Iterative_U[1] + aMPC_Hessian[3,2]*aMPC_Iterative_U[2] + aMPC_Hessian[3,3]*aMPC_Iterative_U[3] + aMPC_Gradient[3]);
IF aMPC_Iterative_U[1] > 5.0 THEN aMPC_Iterative_U[1] := 5.0; ELSIF aMPC_Iterative_U[1] < -5.0 THEN aMPC_Iterative_U[1] := -5.0; END_IF;
IF aMPC_Iterative_U[2] > 3.0 THEN aMPC_Iterative_U[2] := 3.0; ELSIF aMPC_Iterative_U[2] < -3.0 THEN aMPC_Iterative_U[2] := -3.0; END_IF;
IF aMPC_Iterative_U[3] > 4.0 THEN aMPC_Iterative_U[3] := 4.0; ELSIF aMPC_Iterative_U[3] < -4.0 THEN aMPC_Iterative_U[3] := -4.0; END_IF;

aMPC_Iterative_U[1] := aMPC_Iterative_U[1] - 0.08 * (aMPC_Hessian[1,1]*aMPC_Iterative_U[1] + aMPC_Hessian[1,2]*aMPC_Iterative_U[2] + aMPC_Hessian[1,3]*aMPC_Iterative_U[3] + aMPC_Gradient[1]);
aMPC_Iterative_U[2] := aMPC_Iterative_U[2] - 0.08 * (aMPC_Hessian[2,1]*aMPC_Iterative_U[1] + aMPC_Hessian[2,2]*aMPC_Iterative_U[2] + aMPC_Hessian[2,3]*aMPC_Iterative_U[3] + aMPC_Gradient[2]);
aMPC_Iterative_U[3] := aMPC_Iterative_U[3] - 0.08 * (aMPC_Hessian[3,1]*aMPC_Iterative_U[1] + aMPC_Hessian[3,2]*aMPC_Iterative_U[2] + aMPC_Hessian[3,3]*aMPC_Iterative_U[3] + aMPC_Gradient[3]);
IF aMPC_Iterative_U[1] > 5.0 THEN aMPC_Iterative_U[1] := 5.0; ELSIF aMPC_Iterative_U[1] < -5.0 THEN aMPC_Iterative_U[1] := -5.0; END_IF;
IF aMPC_Iterative_U[2] > 3.0 THEN aMPC_Iterative_U[2] := 3.0; ELSIF aMPC_Iterative_U[2] < -3.0 THEN aMPC_Iterative_U[2] := -3.0; END_IF;
IF aMPC_Iterative_U[3] > 4.0 THEN aMPC_Iterative_U[3] := 4.0; ELSIF aMPC_Iterative_U[3] < -4.0 THEN aMPC_Iterative_U[3] := -4.0; END_IF;

(* Iteration 4 *)
aMPC_Iterative_U[1] := aMPC_Iterative_U[1] - 0.08 * (aMPC_Hessian[1,1]*aMPC_Iterative_U[1] + aMPC_Hessian[1,2]*aMPC_Iterative_U[2] + aMPC_Hessian[1,3]*aMPC_Iterative_U[3] + aMPC_Gradient[1]);
aMPC_Iterative_U[2] := aMPC_Iterative_U[2] - 0.08 * (aMPC_Hessian[2,1]*aMPC_Iterative_U[1] + aMPC_Hessian[2,2]*aMPC_Iterative_U[2] + aMPC_Hessian[2,3]*aMPC_Iterative_U[3] + aMPC_Gradient[2]);
aMPC_Iterative_U[3] := aMPC_Iterative_U[3] - 0.08 * (aMPC_Hessian[3,1]*aMPC_Iterative_U[1] + aMPC_Hessian[3,2]*aMPC_Iterative_U[2] + aMPC_Hessian[3,3]*aMPC_Iterative_U[3] + aMPC_Gradient[3]);
IF aMPC_Iterative_U[1] > 5.0 THEN aMPC_Iterative_U[1] := 5.0; ELSIF aMPC_Iterative_U[1] < -5.0 THEN aMPC_Iterative_U[1] := -5.0; END_IF;
IF aMPC_Iterative_U[2] > 3.0 THEN aMPC_Iterative_U[2] := 3.0; ELSIF aMPC_Iterative_U[2] < -3.0 THEN aMPC_Iterative_U[2] := -3.0; END_IF;

aMPC_ControlHorizon_U[1] := aMPC_Iterative_U[1];
aMPC_ControlHorizon_U[2] := aMPC_Iterative_U[2];

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* SUB-SECTION 8.0: MULTI-STAGE MAIN SEQUENCE STATE MACHINE                                          *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* Manages the complete autonomous sequence from inert purge to chilldown, bulk fill, and topping.   *)
(* Handled via standard IEC 61131-3 CASE iState OF ... END_CASE;                                    *)

CASE iState OF

    0: (* ========================================================================================= *)
       (* STATE 0: IDLE & GROUND STANDBY                                                           *)
       (* All cryo supply valves closed, vent open, waiting for operator launch sequence enable.   *)
       (* ========================================================================================= *)
        bSystemReady := TRUE;
        bChilldownComplete := FALSE;
        bLoadingComplete := FALSE;
        bBoiloffToppingActive := FALSE;
        bEmergencyDumpActive := FALSE;

        rValveCmd_MainCryoSupply_Target := 0.0;
        rValveCmd_Vent_Target := 10.0; (* Slight crack to prevent air ingress *)
        rValveCmd_ChilldownBleed := 0.0;
        rValveCmd_SubcooledRecirc := 0.0;

        IF bStartChilldown THEN
            iPreviousState := 0;
            iState := 10; (* Proceed to Gaseous Inert Purge *)
        END_IF;

    10: (* ======================================================================================== *)
        (* STATE 10: INERT GASEOUS PURGE & VACUUM JACKET VERIFICATION                             *)
        (* Blow dry GN2 / GHe through transfer line to purge atmospheric moisture and oxygen.       *)
        (* ======================================================================================== *)
        bSystemReady := TRUE;
        rValveCmd_MainCryoSupply_Target := 0.0;
        rValveCmd_Vent_Target := 100.0; (* Fully open flight vent stack *)
        rValveCmd_ChilldownBleed := 85.0; (* Vent skid bleed *)

        (* Dwell for 15 seconds to establish verified inert atmosphere *)
        tStepTimer(IN := TRUE, PT := T#15S);
        IF tStepTimer.Q THEN
            tStepTimer(IN := FALSE);
            iPreviousState := 10;
            iState := 20; (* Proceed to 2oo3 Sensor Calibration Check *)
        END_IF;

    20: (* ======================================================================================== *)
        (* STATE 20: TMR SENSOR VALIDATION & NOISE FLOOR HEALTH CHECK                              *)
        (* Verify all 3 channels of line pressure, temperature, and ullage sensors are aligned.    *)
        (* ======================================================================================== *)
        tStepTimer(IN := TRUE, PT := T#5S);
        
        (* Verify line pressure is near atmospheric and wall sensors are warm (>270 K) *)
        IF (rVoted_LinePressure < 2.5) AND (rVoted_WallTemperature > 270.0) AND tStepTimer.Q THEN
            tStepTimer(IN := FALSE);
            iPreviousState := 20;
            iState := 30; (* Proceed to Pulsed Pre-Chill *)
        ELSIF tStepTimer.Q AND (rVoted_LinePressure >= 2.5) THEN
            (* Line blocked or over-pressured: Abort *)
            tStepTimer(IN := FALSE);
            dwAlarmTripWord_Critical := dwAlarmTripWord_Critical OR 16#00000010;
            iState := 900; (* Graceful abort *)
        END_IF;

    30: (* ======================================================================================== *)
        (* STATE 30: TRIPLE-POINT PULSED PRE-CHILL & THERMAL STRESS MITIGATION                      *)
        (* Inject controlled low-flow cryogen pulses (5% valve for 2s every 6s) to cool thick      *)
        (* flange forgings and eliminate violent thermal shock cracking in 316L pipework.           *)
        (* ======================================================================================== *)
        tPreChillPulseTimer(IN := NOT tPreChillPulseTimer.Q, PT := T#6S);
        
        IF tPreChillPulseTimer.ET < T#2S THEN
            rValveCmd_MainCryoSupply_Target := 6.5; (* Cryo pulse injection *)
            rValveCmd_ChilldownBleed := 100.0;
        ELSE
            rValveCmd_MainCryoSupply_Target := 0.0; (* Soak period *)
            rValveCmd_ChilldownBleed := 40.0;
        END_IF;

        rValveCmd_Vent_Target := 75.0;

        (* Check if pipe outer wall skin has cooled below 230 K *)
        IF rVoted_WallTemperature < 230.0 THEN
            tPreChillPulseTimer(IN := FALSE);
            iPreviousState := 30;
            iState := 40; (* Transition to Continuous Film Boiling Chilldown *)
        END_IF;

    40: (* ======================================================================================== *)
        (* STATE 40: CONTINUOUS FILM BOILING CHILLDOWN (VAPOR BLANKET REGIME)                       *)
        (* Ramp main supply valve to 18%. Massive vapor generation in pipe. Dynamic vent regulates *)
        (* line backpressure to prevent vapor lock and acoustic two-phase choking.                 *)
        (* ======================================================================================== *)
        rValveCmd_MainCryoSupply_Target := 18.0;
        rValveCmd_ChilldownBleed := 100.0;
        
        (* Regulate dynamic vent using MPC backpressure guidance *)
        rValveCmd_Vent_Target := 60.0 + aMPC_ControlHorizon_U[1];
        IF rValveCmd_Vent_Target > 100.0 THEN rValveCmd_Vent_Target := 100.0; END_IF;
        IF rValveCmd_Vent_Target < 20.0 THEN rValveCmd_Vent_Target := 20.0; END_IF;

        (* Check for Leidenfrost point collapse: Wall temperature approaching Leidenfrost delta *)
        IF (rVoted_WallTemperature - rProp_SatTemp) <= (rProp_Leidenfrost_DeltaT + 5.0) THEN
            iPreviousState := 40;
            iState := 50; (* Proceed to Quench Front Transition *)
        END_IF;

        (* ======================================================================================== *)
        rValveCmd_MainCryoSupply_Target := 14.0; (* Throttle back to prevent pressure spike *)
        rValveCmd_ChilldownBleed := 100.0;
        rValveCmd_Vent_Target := 85.0;

        IF tQuenchStabilizeTimer.Q AND (rVoted_WallTemperature < (rProp_SatTemp + 18.0)) THEN

            iPreviousState := 50;
            iState := 60; (* Transition to Nucleate Boiling *)
        END_IF;
