        (* High-efficiency nucleate boiling. Pipe wall rapidly cools to liquid saturation temp.     *)
        (* ======================================================================================== *)
        rValveCmd_MainCryoSupply_Target := 25.0;
        rValveCmd_ChilldownBleed := 50.0;
        rValveCmd_Vent_Target := 50.0 + aMPC_ControlHorizon_U[1];

        IF (rVoted_WallTemperature - rProp_SatTemp) < 3.5 THEN

        END_IF;

    70: (* ======================================================================================== *)

        (* ======================================================================================== *)
        bChilldownComplete := TRUE;
        rValveCmd_MainCryoSupply_Target := 10.0; (* Low idle flow *)
        rValveCmd_ChilldownBleed := 0.0;         (* Close bleed to flare *)
        rValveCmd_SubcooledRecirc := 80.0;       (* Open recirculation to ground subcooler *)
        rValveCmd_Vent_Target := 25.0;

        (* ======================================================================================== *)
        rValveCmd_SubcooledRecirc := 10.0;
        rValveCmd_MainCryoSupply_Target := 22.0; (* 8.5 kg/s fill *)
        rValveCmd_Vent_Target := 35.0 + aMPC_ControlHorizon_U[1];

        IF rEstimatedPropellantMass_Fused >= (rSetpoint_TargetPropellantMass * 0.05) THEN
            iPreviousState := 80;
            iState := 90; (* Proceed to High-Flow Bulk Fast Fill *)
        END_IF;

    90: (* ======================================================================================== *)
        (* STATE 90: HIGH-FLOW BULK PROPULSION LOADING UNDER RECEDING HORIZON MPC                   *)
        (* Maximum mass flow transfer (up to 45.0 kg/s). Dynamic vent valve actively throttled by  *)

        (* ======================================================================================== *)
        rValveCmd_MainCryoSupply_Target := 92.5; (* Full bore propellant transfer *)
        rValveCmd_SubcooledRecirc := 0.0;

        rValveCmd_Vent_Target := 45.0 + aMPC_ControlHorizon_U[1] * 2.5;

        END_IF;

         (* ======================================================================================= *)
        bBoiloffToppingActive := TRUE;

         (* ======================================================================================= *)
        bSystemReady := FALSE;
        bChilldownComplete := FALSE;
        bBoiloffToppingActive := FALSE;

        rValveCmd_Vent_Target := 100.0;

    rValveCmd_DynamicVentBackpress := rValveCmd_DynamicVentBackpress + 4.5;
ELSIF (rValveCmd_DynamicVentBackpress - rValveCmd_Vent_Target) > 4.5 THEN
    rValveCmd_DynamicVentBackpress := rValveCmd_DynamicVentBackpress - 4.5;

dwSafetyInterlockStatus := 0;

IF bEmergencyStop THEN dwSafetyInterlockStatus := dwSafetyInterlockStatus OR 16#00000002; END_IF;

    c_rCycleDeltaT_s                : REAL := 0.10;     (* Periodic scan cycle duration (100 ms) [s] *)

    (* Temporary Loop Counters and Calculations *)
    iIdx                            : INT;
    jIdx                            : INT;
    rTempTerm                       : REAL;
    rAntoineLogP                    : REAL;
    rDeltaCurrent                   : REAL;
    rDeltaVacSpeed                  : REAL;
    rDeltaPumpSpeed                 : REAL;
    rNetGrossPower_kW               : REAL;
END_VAR

(*
========================================================================================================================
  CYCLIC LOGIC EXECUTION ROUTINE (SAMPLE TIME Ts = 100 ms)
========================================================================================================================
*)

(* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
   LAYER 1: HARDWIRED SAFETY INTERLOCKS & CRITICAL TRIP HIERARCHY (SIL-3 LEVEL)
   --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* Reset internal alarm latches if requested and safe *)
IF bResetFaults THEN
    wAlarmWord1 := 16#0000;
    wAlarmWord2 := 16#0000;
    bSystemAlarm := FALSE;
    bSystemWarning := FALSE;
END_IF;

(* SIL-3 Master Emergency Stop Interlock: Deterministic Immediate System De-Energization *)
IF NOT bEStopOk THEN
    rCmdBMEDCurrentDensity_Am2  := 0.0;
    rCmdVacuumPumpSpeed_pct     := 0.0;
    rCmdVacuumBleedValve_pct    := 100.0;   (* Fully open bleed valve to vent chamber *)
    rCmdBottomsPumpSpeed_pct    := 0.0;
    rCmdAlkalineDosingRatio     := 0.0;
    bSeawaterFeedPumpCmd        := FALSE;
    bElectrodeRinsePumpCmd      := FALSE;
    bVacuumPumpTrainCmd         := FALSE;
    bCondenserChillerCmd        := FALSE;
    bVacuumBreakValveCmd        := TRUE;    (* Fast nitrogen / atmospheric vacuum break *)
    bEffluentDischargeDivertCmd := TRUE;    (* Divert discharge away from ocean *)

    wAlarmWord1.0               := TRUE;    (* E-Stop Trip Active *)
    bSystemAlarm                := TRUE;
    wSystemStatusWord           := 16#F000;
    iState                      := 999;     (* Jump immediately to failsafe emergency state *)
    iSequenceStep               := 999;
    RETURN;
END_IF;

(* Hydrogen Flammability Interlock in Electrode Rinse Off-Gas *)
IF (rBMED_H2Concentration_pctLEL >= c_rCriticalH2_pctLEL) THEN
    rCmdBMEDCurrentDensity_Am2  := 0.0;
    bElectrodeRinsePumpCmd      := TRUE;    (* Keep circulating rinse to purge gas *)
    wAlarmWord1.1               := TRUE;    (* Critical H2 LEL trip *)
    bSystemAlarm                := TRUE;
    iState                      := 999;
ELSIF (rBMED_H2Concentration_pctLEL >= c_rWarningH2_pctLEL) THEN
    wAlarmWord2.0               := TRUE;    (* H2 LEL warning advisory *)
    bSystemWarning              := TRUE;
END_IF;

(* BMED Membrane Stack Bulk Thermal Runaway Protection *)
IF (rBMED_StackTemp_degC >= c_rMaxStackTemp_degC) THEN
    rCmdBMEDCurrentDensity_Am2  := 0.0;
    wAlarmWord1.2               := TRUE;    (* Membrane stack overtemperature trip *)
    bSystemAlarm                := TRUE;
    iState                      := 999;
END_IF;

(* BMED DC Stack Overvoltage / Membrane Delamination Arc Prevention *)
IF (rBMED_StackVoltage_V >= c_rMaxStackVoltage_V) THEN
    rCmdBMEDCurrentDensity_Am2  := 0.0;
    wAlarmWord1.3               := TRUE;    (* Stack overvoltage trip *)
    bSystemAlarm                := TRUE;
    iState                      := 999;
END_IF;

(* Flash Stripper Sump Low-Low Level Cavitation Protection *)
IF (iState >= 40) AND (rFlashStripperLiquidLevel_m <= 0.18) THEN
    rCmdBottomsPumpSpeed_pct    := 0.0;     (* Inhibit bottoms pump to prevent dry run cavitation *)
    wAlarmWord1.5               := TRUE;    (* Sump low-low level trip *)
    bSystemAlarm                := TRUE;
    iState                      := 900;     (* Divert to safe recirculation mode *)
END_IF;

(* Flash Stripper Sump High-High Level Condenser Flood Prevention *)
IF (rFlashStripperLiquidLevel_m >= 1.35) THEN
    rCmdBottomsPumpSpeed_pct    := 100.0;   (* Maximize evacuation speed *)
    wAlarmWord1.6               := TRUE;    (* Sump high-high level alarm *)
    bSystemAlarm                := TRUE;
    iState                      := 900;
END_IF;

(* Marine Effluent Neutralization Discharge Violation Interlock *)
IF (iState >= 50) AND ((rDischargeEffluentPH_pH < 6.50) OR (rDischargeEffluentPH_pH > 8.50)) THEN
    bEffluentDischargeDivertCmd := TRUE;    (* Divert to environmental holding pond *)
    wAlarmWord1.7               := TRUE;    (* Ocean permit pH excursion *)
    bSystemAlarm                := TRUE;
ELSE
    bEffluentDischargeDivertCmd := FALSE;
END_IF;

(* Electrode Rinse Loop Flow Loss Protection *)
IF (bElectrodeRinsePumpCmd) AND (rBMED_ElectrodeRinseFlow_m3h < 1.50) AND (iState >= 20) THEN
    rCmdBMEDCurrentDensity_Am2  := 0.0;
    wAlarmWord1.8               := TRUE;    (* Electrode rinse flow lost *)
    bSystemAlarm                := TRUE;
    iState                      := 999;
END_IF;

(* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
   LAYER 2: TRIPLE MODULAR REDUNDANCY (2oo3 TMR) SENSOR VOTING ENGINES
   --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)

(* --- ENGINE 1: FLASH STRIPPER VACUUM PRESSURE (PT-101A, PT-101B, PT-101C) --- *)
(* Physical Boundary Validation [5.0 .. 1100.0 mbar abs] *)
bPT_ChanA_Valid := (rFlashStripperPress_TMR_A_mbar >= 5.0) AND (rFlashStripperPress_TMR_A_mbar <= 1100.0);
bPT_ChanB_Valid := (rFlashStripperPress_TMR_B_mbar >= 5.0) AND (rFlashStripperPress_TMR_B_mbar <= 1100.0);
bPT_ChanC_Valid := (rFlashStripperPress_TMR_C_mbar >= 5.0) AND (rFlashStripperPress_TMR_C_mbar <= 1100.0);

(* Pairwise Discrepancy Computation *)
rDiff_PT_AB := ABS(rFlashStripperPress_TMR_A_mbar - rFlashStripperPress_TMR_B_mbar);
rDiff_PT_BC := ABS(rFlashStripperPress_TMR_B_mbar - rFlashStripperPress_TMR_C_mbar);
rDiff_PT_CA := ABS(rFlashStripperPress_TMR_C_mbar - rFlashStripperPress_TMR_A_mbar);

(* Discrepancy Timers for Sensor Drift Identification (2.0 s persistence threshold) *)
tPT_DevTimer_A(IN := (rDiff_PT_AB > c_rPT_MaxDeviation_mbar) AND (rDiff_PT_CA > c_rPT_MaxDeviation_mbar), PT := T#2S);
tPT_DevTimer_B(IN := (rDiff_PT_AB > c_rPT_MaxDeviation_mbar) AND (rDiff_PT_BC > c_rPT_MaxDeviation_mbar), PT := T#2S);
tPT_DevTimer_C(IN := (rDiff_PT_BC > c_rPT_MaxDeviation_mbar) AND (rDiff_PT_CA > c_rPT_MaxDeviation_mbar), PT := T#2S);

IF tPT_DevTimer_A.Q THEN bPT_ChanA_Valid := FALSE; wAlarmWord2.2 := TRUE; END_IF;
IF tPT_DevTimer_B.Q THEN bPT_ChanB_Valid := FALSE; wAlarmWord2.3 := TRUE; END_IF;
IF tPT_DevTimer_C.Q THEN bPT_ChanC_Valid := FALSE; wAlarmWord2.4 := TRUE; END_IF;

(* Sensor Health Counting *)
iHealthyPTCount := 0;
IF bPT_ChanA_Valid THEN iHealthyPTCount := iHealthyPTCount + 1; END_IF;
IF bPT_ChanB_Valid THEN iHealthyPTCount := iHealthyPTCount + 1; END_IF;
IF bPT_ChanC_Valid THEN iHealthyPTCount := iHealthyPTCount + 1; END_IF;

(* 2oo3 / 1oo2 Voting Resolution *)
IF (iHealthyPTCount = 3) THEN
    (* All channels healthy: Select True Median *)
    IF ((rFlashStripperPress_TMR_A_mbar >= rFlashStripperPress_TMR_B_mbar) AND (rFlashStripperPress_TMR_A_mbar <= rFlashStripperPress_TMR_C_mbar)) OR
       ((rFlashStripperPress_TMR_A_mbar <= rFlashStripperPress_TMR_B_mbar) AND (rFlashStripperPress_TMR_A_mbar >= rFlashStripperPress_TMR_C_mbar)) THEN
        rVotedFlashPress_mbar := rFlashStripperPress_TMR_A_mbar;
    ELSIF ((rFlashStripperPress_TMR_B_mbar >= rFlashStripperPress_TMR_A_mbar) AND (rFlashStripperPress_TMR_B_mbar <= rFlashStripperPress_TMR_C_mbar)) OR
          ((rFlashStripperPress_TMR_B_mbar <= rFlashStripperPress_TMR_A_mbar) AND (rFlashStripperPress_TMR_B_mbar >= rFlashStripperPress_TMR_C_mbar)) THEN
        rVotedFlashPress_mbar := rFlashStripperPress_TMR_B_mbar;
    ELSE
        rVotedFlashPress_mbar := rFlashStripperPress_TMR_C_mbar;
    END_IF;
    bDegradedModeActive := FALSE;
ELSIF (iHealthyPTCount = 2) THEN
    (* Degraded 1oo2 operation: Arithmetic average of remaining healthy channels *)
    bDegradedModeActive := TRUE;
    IF bPT_ChanA_Valid AND bPT_ChanB_Valid THEN
        rVotedFlashPress_mbar := 0.5 * (rFlashStripperPress_TMR_A_mbar + rFlashStripperPress_TMR_B_mbar);
    ELSIF bPT_ChanB_Valid AND bPT_ChanC_Valid THEN
        rVotedFlashPress_mbar := 0.5 * (rFlashStripperPress_TMR_B_mbar + rFlashStripperPress_TMR_C_mbar);
    ELSE
        rVotedFlashPress_mbar := 0.5 * (rFlashStripperPress_TMR_A_mbar + rFlashStripperPress_TMR_C_mbar);
    END_IF;
ELSIF (iHealthyPTCount = 1) THEN
    (* Critical degraded fallback: Use sole surviving channel and trigger high-priority warning *)
    bDegradedModeActive := TRUE;
    wAlarmWord2.9 := TRUE;
    IF bPT_ChanA_Valid THEN rVotedFlashPress_mbar := rFlashStripperPress_TMR_A_mbar;
    ELSIF bPT_ChanB_Valid THEN rVotedFlashPress_mbar := rFlashStripperPress_TMR_B_mbar;
    ELSE rVotedFlashPress_mbar := rFlashStripperPress_TMR_C_mbar;
    END_IF;
ELSE
    (* Total sensor divergence/failure: Immediate fail-safe abort *)
    wAlarmWord1.9 := TRUE;
    bSystemAlarm  := TRUE;
    iState        := 999;
END_IF;


(* --- ENGINE 2: ACIDIFIED SEAWATER PH (AT-201A, AT-201B, AT-201C) --- *)
(* Physical Boundary Validation [1.0 .. 13.0 pH] *)
bPH_ChanA_Valid := (rAcidPH_TMR_A_pH >= 1.0) AND (rAcidPH_TMR_A_pH <= 13.0);
bPH_ChanB_Valid := (rAcidPH_TMR_B_pH >= 1.0) AND (rAcidPH_TMR_B_pH <= 13.0);
bPH_ChanC_Valid := (rAcidPH_TMR_C_pH >= 1.0) AND (rAcidPH_TMR_C_pH <= 13.0);

(* Pairwise Discrepancy Computation *)
rDiff_PH_AB := ABS(rAcidPH_TMR_A_pH - rAcidPH_TMR_B_pH);
rDiff_PH_BC := ABS(rAcidPH_TMR_B_pH - rAcidPH_TMR_C_pH);
rDiff_PH_CA := ABS(rAcidPH_TMR_C_pH - rAcidPH_TMR_A_pH);

tPH_DevTimer_A(IN := (rDiff_PH_AB > c_rPH_MaxDeviation_pH) AND (rDiff_PH_CA > c_rPH_MaxDeviation_pH), PT := T#2S);
tPH_DevTimer_B(IN := (rDiff_PH_AB > c_rPH_MaxDeviation_pH) AND (rDiff_PH_BC > c_rPH_MaxDeviation_pH), PT := T#2S);
tPH_DevTimer_C(IN := (rDiff_PH_BC > c_rPH_MaxDeviation_pH) AND (rDiff_PH_CA > c_rPH_MaxDeviation_pH), PT := T#2S);

IF tPH_DevTimer_A.Q THEN bPH_ChanA_Valid := FALSE; wAlarmWord2.5 := TRUE; END_IF;
IF tPH_DevTimer_B.Q THEN bPH_ChanB_Valid := FALSE; wAlarmWord2.6 := TRUE; END_IF;
IF tPH_DevTimer_C.Q THEN bPH_ChanC_Valid := FALSE; wAlarmWord2.7 := TRUE; END_IF;

iHealthyPHCount := 0;
IF bPH_ChanA_Valid THEN iHealthyPHCount := iHealthyPHCount + 1; END_IF;
IF bPH_ChanB_Valid THEN iHealthyPHCount := iHealthyPHCount + 1; END_IF;
IF bPH_ChanC_Valid THEN iHealthyPHCount := iHealthyPHCount + 1; END_IF;

IF (iHealthyPHCount = 3) THEN
    IF ((rAcidPH_TMR_A_pH >= rAcidPH_TMR_B_pH) AND (rAcidPH_TMR_A_pH <= rAcidPH_TMR_C_pH)) OR
       ((rAcidPH_TMR_A_pH <= rAcidPH_TMR_B_pH) AND (rAcidPH_TMR_A_pH >= rAcidPH_TMR_C_pH)) THEN
        rVotedAcidPH_pH := rAcidPH_TMR_A_pH;
    ELSIF ((rAcidPH_TMR_B_pH >= rAcidPH_TMR_A_pH) AND (rAcidPH_TMR_B_pH <= rAcidPH_TMR_C_pH)) OR
          ((rAcidPH_TMR_B_pH <= rAcidPH_TMR_A_pH) AND (rAcidPH_TMR_B_pH >= rAcidPH_TMR_C_pH)) THEN
        rVotedAcidPH_pH := rAcidPH_TMR_B_pH;
    ELSE
        rVotedAcidPH_pH := rAcidPH_TMR_C_pH;
    END_IF;
ELSIF (iHealthyPHCount = 2) THEN
    bDegradedModeActive := TRUE;
    IF bPH_ChanA_Valid AND bPH_ChanB_Valid THEN
        rVotedAcidPH_pH := 0.5 * (rAcidPH_TMR_A_pH + rAcidPH_TMR_B_pH);
    ELSIF bPH_ChanB_Valid AND bPH_ChanC_Valid THEN
        rVotedAcidPH_pH := 0.5 * (rAcidPH_TMR_B_pH + rAcidPH_TMR_C_pH);
    ELSE
        rVotedAcidPH_pH := 0.5 * (rAcidPH_TMR_A_pH + rAcidPH_TMR_C_pH);
    END_IF;
ELSIF (iHealthyPHCount = 1) THEN
    bDegradedModeActive := TRUE;
    IF bPH_ChanA_Valid THEN rVotedAcidPH_pH := rAcidPH_TMR_A_pH;
    ELSIF bPH_ChanB_Valid THEN rVotedAcidPH_pH := rAcidPH_TMR_B_pH;
    ELSE rVotedAcidPH_pH := rAcidPH_TMR_C_pH;
    END_IF;
ELSE
    wAlarmWord1.10 := TRUE;
    bSystemAlarm   := TRUE;
    iState         := 999;
END_IF;

(* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
   LAYER 3: THERMODYNAMIC, CHEMICAL SPECIATION & MEMBRANE RESISTANCE ANALYTICS
   --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* Real-time Antoine Saturated Vapor Pressure of Seawater: log10(P_sat [mmHg]) = 8.07131 - 1730.63 / (T + 233.426) *)
rTempTerm := rSeawaterIntakeTemp_degC + 233.426;
IF (rTempTerm > 50.0) THEN
    rAntoineLogP := 8.07131 - (1730.63 / rTempTerm);
    (* Convert mmHg to mbar (1 mmHg = 1.33322 mbar) and correct for seawater salinity osmotic depression *)
    rWaterVaporSaturationPress_mbar := EXPT(10.0, rAntoineLogP) * 1.33322 * (1.0 - 0.000537 * rSeawaterIntakeSalinity_PSU);
ELSE
    rWaterVaporSaturationPress_mbar := 23.4;
END_IF;

(* Dynamic Vacuum Low-Limit Floor to Prevent Catastrophic Steam Flash Runaway *)
rMinPermissibleFlashPress_mbar := rWaterVaporSaturationPress_mbar + c_rChokingMargin_mbar;

(* Interlock: Trip vacuum train if operating chamber pressure breaches boiling runaway threshold *)
IF (iState >= 40) AND (rVotedFlashPress_mbar <= (rWaterVaporSaturationPress_mbar + 5.0)) THEN
    rCmdVacuumPumpSpeed_pct  := 0.0;
    rCmdVacuumBleedValve_pct := 100.0;  (* Immediate pressure relief *)
    wAlarmWord1.4            := TRUE;   (* Water boiling flashover trip *)
    bSystemAlarm             := TRUE;
    iState                   := 900;    (* Divert to safe recirculation mode *)
END_IF;

(* Temperature and Salinity Dependent Henry Solubility Coefficient H_CO2(T, S) [mol/kg/bar] *)
rHenrysConstant_mol_kg_bar := 0.0345 * EXP(-0.024 * (rSeawaterIntakeTemp_degC - 20.0)) * (1.0 - 0.0035 * (rSeawaterIntakeSalinity_PSU - 35.0));

(* Carbonic Acid Bjerrum Speciation Fraction: alpha_CO2 = [CO2*] / DIC = 1 / (1 + 10^(pH - pK1) + 10^(2pH - pK1 - pK2)) *)
IF (rVotedAcidPH_pH <= 4.0) THEN
    rCarbonicDissociationRatio := 0.985;
ELSIF (rVotedAcidPH_pH <= 5.0) THEN
    rCarbonicDissociationRatio := 0.920;
ELSIF (rVotedAcidPH_pH <= 6.0) THEN
    rCarbonicDissociationRatio := 0.650;
ELSE
    rCarbonicDissociationRatio := 0.150;
END_IF;

(* BMED Stack Apparent Resistance & Area-Specific Resistance (ASR) Tracking *)
IF (rBMED_StackCurrent_A > 5.0) THEN
    rBMED_ApparentResistance_Ohm    := rBMED_StackVoltage_V / rBMED_StackCurrent_A;
    rBMED_AreaSpecificResist_Ohm_m2 := (rBMED_ApparentResistance_Ohm * (c_rStackActiveCellPairs * c_rMembraneActiveArea_m2)) / c_rStackActiveCellPairs;

    (* Mineral Scaling Detection: Brucite Mg(OH)2 or Aragonite CaCO3 Precipitation *)
    IF (rBMED_AreaSpecificResist_Ohm_m2 >= (rBaselineASR_Ohm_m2 * 1.35)) THEN
        bMembraneScaleDetected := TRUE;
        wAlarmWord2.1          := TRUE;    (* Membrane scaling warning *)
        bSystemWarning         := TRUE;
    ELSE
        bMembraneScaleDetected := FALSE;
    END_IF;
ELSE
    rBMED_ApparentResistance_Ohm    := 0.0;
    rBMED_AreaSpecificResist_Ohm_m2 := rBaselineASR_Ohm_m2;
END_IF;

(* Real-Time CO2 Gas Harvesting Mass Rate Calculation [kg/h] *)
rEstimatedCO2CaptureRate_kgh := rGaseousCO2Flow_Nm3h * (rGaseousCO2Purity_pct / 100.0) * (c_rCO2MolarMass_g_mol / 22.414);

(* Real-Time Net Specific Energy Consumption [kWh / tCO2] *)
IF (rEstimatedCO2CaptureRate_kgh > 5.0) THEN
    rNetGrossPower_kW := ((rBMED_StackVoltage_V * rBMED_StackCurrent_A) / 1000.0) + (rCmdVacuumPumpSpeed_pct * 0.45) + (rCmdBottomsPumpSpeed_pct * 0.15);
    rSpecificEnergy_kWh_tCO2 := (rNetGrossPower_kW / (rEstimatedCO2CaptureRate_kgh / 1000.0));
    IF (rSpecificEnergy_kWh_tCO2 > 350.0) THEN
        wAlarmWord2.10 := TRUE; (* Specific energy consumption high advisory *)
    END_IF;
ELSE
    rSpecificEnergy_kWh_tCO2 := 0.0;
END_IF;

(* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
   LAYER 4: STATE-SPACE PREDICTIVE CONTROLLER & FEEDFORWARD DECOUPLING (MPC KERNEL)
   --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* Measurable External Disturbance Vector: d = [Delta Q_sw, Delta T_sw]^T *)
rDisturbance_DeltaQ_m3h  := rSeawaterInflowRate_m3h - c_rNominalInflow_m3h;
rDisturbance_DeltaT_degC := rSeawaterIntakeTemp_degC - c_rNominalTemp_degC;

(* System State Error Deviation Vector: e(k) = x_ref - x_actual *)
aStateDeviation[1] := rTargetAcidPH_pH - rVotedAcidPH_pH;
aStateDeviation[2] := rTargetFlashPress_mbar - rVotedFlashPress_mbar;
aStateDeviation[3] := rTargetSumpLevel_m - rFlashStripperLiquidLevel_m;
aStateDeviation[4] := (rSeawaterInflowRate_m3h * 2.15 * 0.04401 * 0.90) - rEstimatedCO2CaptureRate_kgh;

(* 1-Step Ahead State Prediction: x_pred(k+1) = A_d * x(k) + B_d_mat * u(k) + B_dist * d(k) *)
FOR iIdx := 1 TO 4 DO
    aStatePrediction[iIdx] := 0.0;
    FOR jIdx := 1 TO 4 DO
        aStatePrediction[iIdx] := aStatePrediction[iIdx] + aMatrix_A_d[iIdx, jIdx] * aStateDeviation[jIdx];
    END_FOR;
    (* Add input coupling *)
    aStatePrediction[iIdx] := aStatePrediction[iIdx] + aMatrix_B_d[iIdx, 1] * aControlIncrement[1]
                                                    + aMatrix_B_d[iIdx, 2] * aControlIncrement[2]
                                                    + aMatrix_B_d[iIdx, 3] * aControlIncrement[3];
    (* Add external disturbance coupling *)
    aStatePrediction[iIdx] := aStatePrediction[iIdx] + aMatrix_B_dist[iIdx, 1] * rDisturbance_DeltaQ_m3h
                                                    + aMatrix_B_dist[iIdx, 2] * rDisturbance_DeltaT_degC;
END_FOR;

(* MPC Deadbeat/Horizon Optimal Control Increment Computation: Delta u = K_mpc * e(k) + K_ff * d(k) *)
FOR iIdx := 1 TO 3 DO
    aControlIncrement[iIdx] := 0.0;
    FOR jIdx := 1 TO 4 DO
        aControlIncrement[iIdx] := aControlIncrement[iIdx] + aMatrix_K_mpc[iIdx, jIdx] * aStateDeviation[jIdx];
    END_FOR;
    aControlIncrement[iIdx] := aControlIncrement[iIdx] + aMatrix_K_ff[iIdx, 1] * rDisturbance_DeltaQ_m3h
                                                    + aMatrix_K_ff[iIdx, 2] * rDisturbance_DeltaT_degC;
END_FOR;

(* Closed-Loop Actuator Integration with Slew-Rate Limiting & Anti-Windup Boundary Projections *)
IF (iState = 50) OR (iState = 90) THEN
    (* 1. BMED Rectifier Current Density Demand *)
    rTargetCurrentDensity_Am2 := rPrevCurrentDensity_Am2 + aControlIncrement[1];

    (* Graceful degradation derating: Clamp current to 65% if membrane scaling detected *)
    IF bMembraneScaleDetected OR (iState = 90) THEN
        IF (rTargetCurrentDensity_Am2 > (c_rMaxCurrentDensity_Am2 * 0.65)) THEN
            rTargetCurrentDensity_Am2 := c_rMaxCurrentDensity_Am2 * 0.65;
        END_IF;
    ELSE
        IF (rTargetCurrentDensity_Am2 > c_rMaxCurrentDensity_Am2) THEN
            rTargetCurrentDensity_Am2 := c_rMaxCurrentDensity_Am2;
        ELSIF (rTargetCurrentDensity_Am2 < c_rMinCurrentDensity_Am2) THEN
            rTargetCurrentDensity_Am2 := c_rMinCurrentDensity_Am2;
        END_IF;
    END_IF;

    (* Apply Slew Rate Limiter on Current Density (max 25.0 A/m2/s) *)
    rDeltaCurrent := rTargetCurrentDensity_Am2 - rPrevCurrentDensity_Am2;
    IF (rDeltaCurrent > (c_rMaxSlewCurrent_Am2_s * c_rCycleDeltaT_s)) THEN
        rDeltaCurrent := c_rMaxSlewCurrent_Am2_s * c_rCycleDeltaT_s;
    ELSIF (rDeltaCurrent < (-c_rMaxSlewCurrent_Am2_s * c_rCycleDeltaT_s)) THEN
        rDeltaCurrent := -c_rMaxSlewCurrent_Am2_s * c_rCycleDeltaT_s;
    END_IF;
    rCmdBMEDCurrentDensity_Am2 := rPrevCurrentDensity_Am2 + rDeltaCurrent;
    rPrevCurrentDensity_Am2    := rCmdBMEDCurrentDensity_Am2;

    (* 2. Vacuum Extraction Train VFD Speed Demand *)
    rTargetVacuumSpeed_pct := rPrevVacuumSpeed_pct + aControlIncrement[2];

    (* Restrict vacuum speed if flash pressure approaches boiling margin *)
    IF (rVotedFlashPress_mbar <= rMinPermissibleFlashPress_mbar) THEN
        rTargetVacuumSpeed_pct := rPrevVacuumSpeed_pct - 2.5; (* Back off vacuum speed *)
        rCmdVacuumBleedValve_pct := 15.0;                      (* Modulate bleed valve *)
    ELSE
        rCmdVacuumBleedValve_pct := 0.0;
    END_IF;

    IF (rTargetVacuumSpeed_pct > 100.0) THEN rTargetVacuumSpeed_pct := 100.0;
    ELSIF (rTargetVacuumSpeed_pct < 15.0) THEN rTargetVacuumSpeed_pct := 15.0;
    END_IF;

    rDeltaVacSpeed := rTargetVacuumSpeed_pct - rPrevVacuumSpeed_pct;
    IF (rDeltaVacSpeed > (c_rMaxSlewVacuum_pct_s * c_rCycleDeltaT_s)) THEN
        rDeltaVacSpeed := c_rMaxSlewVacuum_pct_s * c_rCycleDeltaT_s;
    ELSIF (rDeltaVacSpeed < (-c_rMaxSlewVacuum_pct_s * c_rCycleDeltaT_s)) THEN
        rDeltaVacSpeed := -c_rMaxSlewVacuum_pct_s * c_rCycleDeltaT_s;
    END_IF;
    rCmdVacuumPumpSpeed_pct := rPrevVacuumSpeed_pct + rDeltaVacSpeed;
    rPrevVacuumSpeed_pct    := rCmdVacuumPumpSpeed_pct;

    (* 3. Flash Stripper Bottoms Extraction Pump VFD Speed Demand *)
    rTargetBottomsSpeed_pct := rPrevBottomsSpeed_pct + aControlIncrement[3];
    IF (rTargetBottomsSpeed_pct > 100.0) THEN rTargetBottomsSpeed_pct := 100.0;
    ELSIF (rTargetBottomsSpeed_pct < 10.0) THEN rTargetBottomsSpeed_pct := 10.0;
    END_IF;

    rDeltaPumpSpeed := rTargetBottomsSpeed_pct - rPrevBottomsSpeed_pct;
    IF (rDeltaPumpSpeed > (c_rMaxSlewPump_pct_s * c_rCycleDeltaT_s)) THEN
        rDeltaPumpSpeed := c_rMaxSlewPump_pct_s * c_rCycleDeltaT_s;
    ELSIF (rDeltaPumpSpeed < (-c_rMaxSlewPump_pct_s * c_rCycleDeltaT_s)) THEN
        rDeltaPumpSpeed := -c_rMaxSlewPump_pct_s * c_rCycleDeltaT_s;
    END_IF;
    rCmdBottomsPumpSpeed_pct := rPrevBottomsSpeed_pct + rDeltaPumpSpeed;
    rPrevBottomsSpeed_pct    := rCmdBottomsPumpSpeed_pct;

    rCmdAlkalineDosingRatio := 0.85 + (0.05 * (7.80 - rDischargeEffluentPH_pH));
    IF (rCmdAlkalineDosingRatio > 1.20) THEN rCmdAlkalineDosingRatio := 1.20;
    ELSIF (rCmdAlkalineDosingRatio < 0.60) THEN rCmdAlkalineDosingRatio := 0.60;
    END_IF;
END_IF;

(* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
   LAYER 5: ISA-88 CONTINUOUS MULTI-STAGE PHASE STATE MACHINE
   --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
tStateStepTimer(IN := (iState = iPreviousState), PT := T#24H);
iPreviousState := iState;

CASE iState OF
    0: (* PHASE: IDLE / SYSTEM STANDBY *)
        rCmdBMEDCurrentDensity_Am2  := 0.0;
        rCmdVacuumPumpSpeed_pct     := 0.0;

        rCmdBottomsPumpSpeed_pct    := 0.0;
        rCmdAlkalineDosingRatio     := 0.0;

        bCondenserChillerCmd        := FALSE;

            iState := 10;
        END_IF;

    10: (* PHASE: SEAWATER INTAKE & SYSTEM HYDRAULIC PRIMING *)
        bSeawaterFeedPumpCmd        := TRUE;
        bElectrodeRinsePumpCmd      := TRUE;

        IF (rSeawaterInflowRate_m3h >= 80.0) AND (rBMED_ElectrodeRinseFlow_m3h >= 2.0) AND (rFlashStripperLiquidLevel_m >= 0.40) THEN

            rCmdBottomsPumpSpeed_pct := 35.0;
            rPrevBottomsSpeed_pct    := 35.0;
            wSystemStatusWord        := 16#0003; (* Primed *)
            iState                   := 20;
        ELSIF tStateStepTimer.ET > T#120S THEN
            wAlarmWord2.9 := TRUE;              (* Priming timeout warning *)
        END_IF;

    20: (* PHASE: ELECTRODE RINSE DEGAS & LOW-CURRENT MEMBRANE POLARIZATION *)
        bSeawaterFeedPumpCmd       := TRUE;
        bElectrodeRinsePumpCmd     := TRUE;
        bCondenserChillerCmd       := TRUE;
        rCmdBMEDCurrentDensity_Am2 := c_rMinCurrentDensity_Am2; (* Apply 10 A/m2 trickle current *)
        rPrevCurrentDensity_Am2    := c_rMinCurrentDensity_Am2;

        tPolarizationTimer(IN := TRUE, PT := T#30S);
        IF tPolarizationTimer.Q AND (rBMED_H2Concentration_pctLEL < c_rWarningH2_pctLEL) THEN

            wSystemStatusWord := 16#0007;       (* Polarized *)
            iState := 30;
        END_IF;

        bSeawaterFeedPumpCmd       := TRUE;
        bElectrodeRinsePumpCmd     := TRUE;

        IF (rCmdBMEDCurrentDensity_Am2 < 280.0) THEN
            rCmdBMEDCurrentDensity_Am2 := rCmdBMEDCurrentDensity_Am2 + (c_rMaxSlewCurrent_Am2_s * c_rCycleDeltaT_s);
            rPrevCurrentDensity_Am2    := rCmdBMEDCurrentDensity_Am2;
        END_IF;

        rCmdBottomsPumpSpeed_pct := 35.0 + 30.0 * (rFlashStripperLiquidLevel_m - rTargetSumpLevel_m);

            wSystemStatusWord := 16#000F;       (* Acidification Established *)

        ELSIF tStateStepTimer.ET > T#180S THEN
            wAlarmWord2.9 := TRUE;              (* Acidification rate slow *)
        END_IF;

        bSeawaterFeedPumpCmd       := TRUE;
        bElectrodeRinsePumpCmd     := TRUE;
        bCondenserChillerCmd       := TRUE;

        IF (rVotedFlashPress_mbar <= 95.0) THEN
            wSystemStatusWord := 16#001F;       (* Vacuum Established *)
            iState := 50;                       (* Enter Equilibrated MPC Harvesting Mode *)
        ELSIF tStateStepTimer.ET > T#240S THEN
            wAlarmWord2.9 := TRUE;              (* Vacuum pull-down sluggish *)
        END_IF;

    50: (* PHASE: EQUILIBRATED CO2 EXTRACTION & HARVESTING (FULL MPC CLOSED LOOP) *)

        bElectrodeRinsePumpCmd := TRUE;
        bVacuumPumpTrainCmd    := TRUE;
        bCondenserChillerCmd   := TRUE;
        wSystemStatusWord      := 16#003F;      (* Full Active Harvesting *)

        tGasAnalyzerStabilizeTimer(IN := (rGaseousCO2Purity_pct < 90.0), PT := T#45S);

            iState := 60;                       (* Enter Anti-Scale Descaling Phase *)
        END_IF;

        IF bStopCapture THEN

        END_IF;

        rCmdBMEDCurrentDensity_Am2 := 30.0;
        rPrevCurrentDensity_Am2    := 30.0;
        rCmdVacuumPumpSpeed_pct    := 40.0;
        rPrevVacuumSpeed_pct       := 40.0;
        wSystemStatusWord          := 16#002F;  (* Descaling Maintenance Mode *)

        IF tStateStepTimer.ET > T#180S THEN
            bMembraneScaleDetected := FALSE;
            wAlarmWord2.1          := FALSE;
            iState := 50;                       (* Return to Steady Harvesting *)
        END_IF;

    70: (* PHASE: CONTROLLED SYSTEM RAMP-DOWN & RECOMBINATION PURGE *)
        (* Ramp down current density smoothly *)
        IF (rCmdBMEDCurrentDensity_Am2 > 10.0) THEN
            rCmdBMEDCurrentDensity_Am2 := rCmdBMEDCurrentDensity_Am2 - (c_rMaxSlewCurrent_Am2_s * c_rCycleDeltaT_s);
            rPrevCurrentDensity_Am2    := rCmdBMEDCurrentDensity_Am2;
        ELSE
            rCmdBMEDCurrentDensity_Am2 := 0.0;
        END_IF;

        (* Ramp down vacuum train and bleed chamber to atmospheric pressure *)
        IF (rCmdVacuumPumpSpeed_pct > 10.0) THEN
            rCmdVacuumPumpSpeed_pct := rCmdVacuumPumpSpeed_pct - (c_rMaxSlewVacuum_pct_s * c_rCycleDeltaT_s);
            rPrevVacuumSpeed_pct    := rCmdVacuumPumpSpeed_pct;
        ELSE
            rCmdVacuumPumpSpeed_pct := 0.0;
            bVacuumPumpTrainCmd     := FALSE;
            rCmdVacuumBleedValve_pct := 100.0;  (* Bleed column *)
        END_IF;

        (* Recombine remaining acid with excess base stream to neutralize column before stopping *)
        rCmdAlkalineDosingRatio := 1.15;

        IF (rCmdBMEDCurrentDensity_Am2 = 0.0) AND (rCmdVacuumPumpSpeed_pct = 0.0) AND (rVotedFlashPress_mbar >= 950.0) THEN
            iState := 80;                       (* Proceed to Dewatering & Standby *)
        END_IF;

    80: (* PHASE: POST-STRIP DEWATERING & SYSTEM PURGE *)
        rCmdBMEDCurrentDensity_Am2 := 0.0;
        bVacuumPumpTrainCmd        := FALSE;
        rCmdVacuumBleedValve_pct   := 100.0;

        (* Evacuate column liquid sump *)
        IF (rFlashStripperLiquidLevel_m > 0.15) THEN
            rCmdBottomsPumpSpeed_pct := 30.0;
        ELSE
            rCmdBottomsPumpSpeed_pct := 0.0;
            bSeawaterFeedPumpCmd     := FALSE;
            bElectrodeRinsePumpCmd   := FALSE;
            bCondenserChillerCmd     := FALSE;
            wSystemStatusWord        := 16#0000;
            iState                   := 0;      (* Return to Standby IDLE *)
        END_IF;

    90: (* PHASE: GRACEFUL DEGRADATION RUN (1oo2 SENSORS OR CURRENT THROTTLED) *)
        bSeawaterFeedPumpCmd   := TRUE;
        bElectrodeRinsePumpCmd := TRUE;
        bVacuumPumpTrainCmd    := TRUE;
        bCondenserChillerCmd   := TRUE;
        bDegradedModeActive    := TRUE;
        wSystemStatusWord      := 16#007F;      (* Degraded Harvesting Mode *)

        (* In degraded mode, MPC remains active but current ceiling is clamped to 65% *)
        IF bStopCapture THEN
            iState := 70;
        END_IF;

    900: (* PHASE: FAULT HOLD / SAFE RECIRCULATION *)
        (* Hold process safe: de-energize stack, stop vacuum stripping, keep seawater loop circulating *)
        rCmdBMEDCurrentDensity_Am2  := 0.0;
        rCmdVacuumPumpSpeed_pct     := 0.0;
        rCmdVacuumBleedValve_pct    := 100.0;
        bVacuumPumpTrainCmd         := FALSE;
        bEffluentDischargeDivertCmd := TRUE;    (* Divert discharge *)
        wSystemStatusWord           := 16#0F00;

        (* Sump level regulation on recirculating flow *)
        IF (rFlashStripperLiquidLevel_m > 0.85) THEN
            rCmdBottomsPumpSpeed_pct := 50.0;
        ELSIF (rFlashStripperLiquidLevel_m < 0.30) THEN
            rCmdBottomsPumpSpeed_pct := 0.0;
        END_IF;

        IF bResetFaults AND NOT bSystemAlarm THEN
            iState := 0;                        (* Return to Idle upon manual acknowledge *)
        END_IF;

    999: (* PHASE: SIL-3 EMERGENCY SAFETY TRIP & RAPID NITROGEN VACUUM BREAK *)
        rCmdBMEDCurrentDensity_Am2  := 0.0;
        rCmdVacuumPumpSpeed_pct     := 0.0;
        rCmdVacuumBleedValve_pct    := 100.0;
        rCmdBottomsPumpSpeed_pct    := 0.0;
        rCmdAlkalineDosingRatio     := 0.0;
        bSeawaterFeedPumpCmd        := FALSE;
        bElectrodeRinsePumpCmd      := FALSE;
        bVacuumPumpTrainCmd         := FALSE;
        bCondenserChillerCmd        := FALSE;
        bVacuumBreakValveCmd        := TRUE;    (* Fast nitrogen vacuum purge valve OPEN *)
        bEffluentDischargeDivertCmd := TRUE;    (* Isolate ocean discharge *)
        wSystemStatusWord           := 16#FFFF; (* Critical Trip Status *)

        IF bResetFaults AND bEStopOk THEN
            bVacuumBreakValveCmd := FALSE;
            wAlarmWord1          := 16#0000;
            bSystemAlarm         := FALSE;
            iState               := 0;          (* Acknowledge trip and return to Idle *)
        END_IF;

END_CASE;

(* Update Output Sequence Step for SCADA / DCS Supervisory Tracking *)
iSequenceStep := iState;

END_FUNCTION_BLOCK

    rDumpValve_AP               : REAL;     (* Aft-Port seawater overboard expulsion valve [%] *)
    rDumpValve_AS               : REAL;     (* Aft-Starboard seawater overboard expulsion valve [%] *)
    
    (* 4-Quadrant Tank Atmospheric Exhaust Vent Valves (0.0 to 100.0 %) *)
    rVentValve_FP               : REAL;     (* Forward-Port atmospheric vent de-pressurization valve [%] *)
    rVentValve_FS               : REAL;     (* Forward-Starboard atmospheric vent de-pressurization valve [%] *)
    rVentValve_AP               : REAL;     (* Aft-Port atmospheric vent de-pressurization valve [%] *)
    rVentValve_AS               : REAL;     (* Aft-Starboard atmospheric vent de-pressurization valve [%] *)
    
    (* Hydrostatic Stability & State Diagnostics *)
    rComputedGM_Transverse      : REAL;     (* Dynamically calculated transverse metacentric height GM_T [m] *)
    rComputedGM_Longitudinal    : REAL;     (* Dynamically calculated longitudinal metacentric height GM_L [m] *)
    rCurrentPlatformDisplacement: REAL;     (* Real-time platform total displacement mass [t] *)
    rFreeSurfaceCorrection_GG1  : REAL;     (* Aggregate virtual rise of center of gravity from slack tanks [m] *)
    rVotedRollAngle             : REAL;     (* 2oo3 TMR consolidated platform roll angle [deg] *)
    rVotedPitchAngle            : REAL;     (* 2oo3 TMR consolidated platform pitch angle [deg] *)
    rTotalAirConsumptionRate    : REAL;     (* Total instantaneous compressed air consumption [m3/h] *)
END_VAR

VAR
    (* Finite State Machine Operational States *)
    iState                      : INT := 0; (* Master state index: 0=INIT, 10=STANDBY, 20=MPC_TRIM, 30=TRANSFER, 40=EMERGENCY, 50=DEGRADED, 99=TRIP *)
    iSubState                   : INT := 0; (* Auxiliary sub-sequence execution counter *)
    
    (* 2oo3 TMR Sensor Health & Deviation Trackers *)
    bMRU1_Fault                 : BOOL;     (* MRU 1 discrepancy fault latch *)
    bMRU2_Fault                 : BOOL;     (* MRU 2 discrepancy fault latch *)
    bMRU3_Fault                 : BOOL;     (* MRU 3 discrepancy fault latch *)
    iMRU_FaultCount             : INT;      (* Total number of failed MRU sensors (0, 1, 2, or 3) *)
    rRollDiff12                 : REAL;     (* Absolute disparity |MRU1 - MRU2| [deg] *)
    rRollDiff23                 : REAL;     (* Absolute disparity |MRU2 - MRU3| [deg] *)
    rRollDiff31                 : REAL;     (* Absolute disparity |MRU3 - MRU1| [deg] *)
    rPitchDiff12                : REAL;     (* Absolute disparity |MRU1 - MRU2| [deg] *)
    rPitchDiff23                : REAL;     (* Absolute disparity |MRU2 - MRU3| [deg] *)
    rPitchDiff31                : REAL;     (* Absolute disparity |MRU3 - MRU1| [deg] *)
    rVotedRollRate              : REAL;     (* 2oo3 Voted roll angular velocity [deg/s] *)
    rVotedPitchRate             : REAL;     (* 2oo3 Voted pitch angular velocity [deg/s] *)
    
    (* Semi-Submersible Hydrodynamic & Structural Geometric Constants *)
    rLightshipWeight            : REAL := 22500.0;  (* Platform bare lightship displacement mass [t] *)
    rLightshipKG                : REAL := 18.25;    (* Lightship vertical center of gravity above keel [m] *)
    rColumnWidth_X              : REAL := 12.5;     (* Square column length dimension [m] *)
    rColumnWidth_Y              : REAL := 12.5;     (* Square column breadth dimension [m] *)
    rColumnCenterDistance_X     : REAL := 68.0;     (* Longitudinal distance between column centers [m] *)
    rColumnCenterDistance_Y     : REAL := 68.0;     (* Transverse distance between column centers [m] *)
    rColumnSectionArea          : REAL := 156.25;   (* Cross-sectional area per column [m2] *)
    rTotalWaterplaneArea        : REAL := 625.0;    (* 4 Columns total waterplane area at operating draft [m2] *)
    rPontoonDisplacementKeel    : REAL := 28500.0;  (* Twin submerged pontoons volumetric displacement mass [t] *)
    rPontoonKB                  : REAL := 4.85;     (* Center of buoyancy of submerged pontoons [m] *)
    rTankMaxHeight              : REAL := 16.0;     (* Internal vertical height of corner ballast tanks [m] *)
    rTankBaseKG                 : REAL := 7.50;     (* Vertical height of ballast tank keel base [m] *)
    rTankCrossSectionArea       : REAL := 85.0;     (* Effective cross-sectional horizontal area per tank [m2] *)
    rTankMaxVolume              : REAL := 1360.0;   (* Maximum storage capacity per ballast column tank [m3] *)
    
    (* Hydrostatic Real-Time Variables *)
    rDisplacedVolume            : REAL;     (* Platform total underwater submerged volume [m3] *)
    rKB_Current                 : REAL;     (* Center of buoyancy above baseline keel [m] *)
    rKG_Current                 : REAL;     (* Vertical center of gravity of loaded vessel [m] *)
    rBM_Transverse              : REAL;     (* Transverse metacentric radius BM_T [m] *)
    rBM_Longitudinal            : REAL;     (* Longitudinal metacentric radius BM_L [m] *)
    rWaterplaneInertia_T        : REAL;     (* Transverse waterplane moment of inertia I_T [m4] *)
    rWaterplaneInertia_L        : REAL;     (* Longitudinal waterplane moment of inertia I_L [m4] *)
    rTankMass_FP                : REAL;     (* Seawater ballast mass in Forward-Port tank [t] *)
    rTankMass_FS                : REAL;     (* Seawater ballast mass in Forward-Starboard tank [t] *)
    rTankMass_AP                : REAL;     (* Seawater ballast mass in Aft-Port tank [t] *)
    rTankMass_AS                : REAL;     (* Seawater ballast mass in Aft-Starboard tank [t] *)
    rTotalBallastMass           : REAL;     (* Aggregate ballast liquid mass on platform [t] *)
    rTotalStaticMoment_Z        : REAL;     (* Cumulative vertical mass moment [t*m] *)
    rFSE_Inertia_FP             : REAL;     (* Slack liquid second moment of free surface FP [m4] *)
    rFSE_Inertia_FS             : REAL;     (* Slack liquid second moment of free surface FS [m4] *)
    rFSE_Inertia_AP             : REAL;     (* Slack liquid second moment of free surface AP [m4] *)
    rFSE_Inertia_AS             : REAL;     (* Slack liquid second moment of free surface AS [m4] *)
    
    (* Dynamic State-Space Vector x = [x1, x2, x3, x4, x5, x6]^T *)
    arrStateVector              : ARRAY[1..6] OF REAL; (* x1=e_phi[rad], x2=dphi[rad/s], x3=e_theta[rad], x4=dtheta[rad/s], x5=e_z[m], x6=e_gm[m] *)
    arrStateVectorPrev          : ARRAY[1..6] OF REAL; (* Previous cycle state vector for digital derivative filtering *)
    
    (* Discrete State-Space Model Matrices Ad (6x6) and Bd (6x4) *)
    arrAd                       : ARRAY[1..6, 1..6] OF REAL; (* Discretized hydrodynamic plant transition matrix *)
    arrBd                       : ARRAY[1..6, 1..4] OF REAL; (* Discretized actuator pneumatic effectiveness matrix *)
    arrCd                       : ARRAY[1..4, 1..6] OF REAL; (* State measurement transformation matrix *)
    arrDd                       : ARRAY[1..4, 1..4] OF REAL; (* Direct transmission matrix *)
    
    (* Model Predictive Control (MPC) Gain Matrix K_mpc (4x6) *)
    arrK_mpc                    : ARRAY[1..4, 1..6] OF REAL; (* Precomputed unconstrained LQR/MPC gain derived from Q & R *)
    arrControlDemands           : ARRAY[1..4] OF REAL;      (* Raw computed pneumatic flow rate commands u [m3/s] *)
    
    (* Valve Control Accumulators & Rate Limiters *)
    rFilteredRoll               : REAL;     (* 1st-order low-pass filtered roll angle [deg] *)
    rFilteredPitch              : REAL;     (* 1st-order low-pass filtered pitch angle [deg] *)
    rRollAlphaFilter            : REAL := 0.15;     (* Digital smoothing constant for MRU signals *)
    rAirHeaderMinPressure       : REAL := 18.0;     (* Lower critical trip limit for compressed air blowing [bar] *)
    rAirHeaderNominalPressure   : REAL := 30.0;     (* Design nominal supply manifold pressure [bar] *)
    rMaxAllowableRoll           : REAL := 3.5;      (* Operational alarm threshold for transverse heel [deg] *)
    rMaxAllowablePitch          : REAL := 3.0;      (* Operational alarm threshold for longitudinal trim [deg] *)
    rCriticalTripAngle          : REAL := 6.0;      (* Emergency shutdown limit for trim/heel [deg] *)
    
    (* Timers & Diagnostic Execution Blocks *)
    tonAirSupplyStabilize       : TON;      (* Settling timer for compressed air manifold charging *)
    tonMRUDiscrepancyTimer      : TON;      (* Persistence timer for MRU voting fault confirmation *)
    tonEmergencyBlowingTimer    : TON;      (* Max duration watchdog for continuous emergency air discharge *)
    tonDegradedBlinkTimer       : TON;      (* Diagnostic flasher for degraded operational state *)
    tonWatchdogHeartbeat        : TON;      (* Controller internal execution cycle watchdog *)
    
    (* Loop Indices & Scratchpad Memory *)
    iRow                        : INT;
    iCol                        : INT;
    iK                          : INT;
    rTempSum                    : REAL;
    rTempVar                    : REAL;
    rSafeCycleTime              : REAL;
END_VAR

(* === MAIN LOGIC IMPLEMENTATION === *)

(* -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
   01. SAFETY CYCLE TIME VALIDATION & INTERNAL WATCHDOG RE-TRIGGER
   ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
IF rCycleTime_s < 0.005 OR rCycleTime_s > 0.250 THEN
    rSafeCycleTime := 0.050; (* Fallback to 50ms nominal task timebase if out of bounds *)
ELSE
    rSafeCycleTime := rCycleTime_s;
END_IF;

tonWatchdogHeartbeat(IN := NOT tonWatchdogHeartbeat.Q, PT := T#500MS);

(* -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
   02. 2oo3 TRIPLE MODULAR REDUNDANCY (TMR) MRU SENSOR FUSION & DISCREPANCY VOTING
   ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* Compute absolute discrepancies between all 3 redundant MRUs *)
rRollDiff12 := ABS(rRollAngle_MRU1 - rRollAngle_MRU2);
rRollDiff23 := ABS(rRollAngle_MRU2 - rRollAngle_MRU3);
rRollDiff31 := ABS(rRollAngle_MRU3 - rRollAngle_MRU1);

rPitchDiff12 := ABS(rPitchAngle_MRU1 - rPitchAngle_MRU2);
rPitchDiff23 := ABS(rPitchAngle_MRU2 - rPitchAngle_MRU3);
rPitchDiff31 := ABS(rPitchAngle_MRU3 - rPitchAngle_MRU1);

(* Check for discrepancy threshold exceedances (0.65 deg persistence) *)
tonMRUDiscrepancyTimer(
    IN := (rRollDiff12 > 0.65) OR (rRollDiff23 > 0.65) OR (rRollDiff31 > 0.65) OR
          (rPitchDiff12 > 0.65) OR (rPitchDiff23 > 0.65) OR (rPitchDiff31 > 0.65),
    PT := T#250MS
);

(* Channel Disparity Fault Isolation via 2oo3 Parity Evaluation *)
IF tonMRUDiscrepancyTimer.Q THEN
    bMRU1_Fault := (rRollDiff12 > 0.65) AND (rRollDiff31 > 0.65);
    bMRU2_Fault := (rRollDiff12 > 0.65) AND (rRollDiff23 > 0.65);
    bMRU3_Fault := (rRollDiff23 > 0.65) AND (rRollDiff31 > 0.65);
ELSE
    IF bResetFaults THEN
        bMRU1_Fault := FALSE;
        bMRU2_Fault := FALSE;
        bMRU3_Fault := FALSE;
    END_IF;
END_IF;

iMRU_FaultCount := 0;
IF bMRU1_Fault THEN iMRU_FaultCount := iMRU_FaultCount + 1; END_IF;
IF bMRU2_Fault THEN iMRU_FaultCount := iMRU_FaultCount + 1; END_IF;
IF bMRU3_Fault THEN iMRU_FaultCount := iMRU_FaultCount + 1; END_IF;

(* Median Selection Voting for Roll, Pitch, and Rates *)
IF (NOT bMRU1_Fault) AND (NOT bMRU2_Fault) AND (NOT bMRU3_Fault) THEN
    (* Healthy 2oo3 Condition: Classic Median Filter Algorithm *)
    IF ((rRollAngle_MRU1 >= rRollAngle_MRU2) AND (rRollAngle_MRU1 <= rRollAngle_MRU3)) OR 
       ((rRollAngle_MRU1 <= rRollAngle_MRU2) AND (rRollAngle_MRU1 >= rRollAngle_MRU3)) THEN
        rVotedRollAngle := rRollAngle_MRU1;
        rVotedRollRate := rRollRate_MRU1;
    ELSIF ((rRollAngle_MRU2 >= rRollAngle_MRU1) AND (rRollAngle_MRU2 <= rRollAngle_MRU3)) OR 
          ((rRollAngle_MRU2 <= rRollAngle_MRU1) AND (rRollAngle_MRU2 >= rRollAngle_MRU3)) THEN
        rVotedRollAngle := rRollAngle_MRU2;
        rVotedRollRate := rRollRate_MRU2;
    ELSE
        rVotedRollAngle := rRollAngle_MRU3;
        rVotedRollRate := rRollRate_MRU3;
    END_IF;

    IF ((rPitchAngle_MRU1 >= rPitchAngle_MRU2) AND (rPitchAngle_MRU1 <= rPitchAngle_MRU3)) OR 
       ((rPitchAngle_MRU1 <= rPitchAngle_MRU2) AND (rPitchAngle_MRU1 >= rPitchAngle_MRU3)) THEN
        rVotedPitchAngle := rPitchAngle_MRU1;
        rVotedPitchRate := rPitchRate_MRU1;
    ELSIF ((rPitchAngle_MRU2 >= rPitchAngle_MRU1) AND (rPitchAngle_MRU2 <= rPitchAngle_MRU3)) OR 
          ((rPitchAngle_MRU2 <= rPitchAngle_MRU1) AND (rPitchAngle_MRU2 >= rPitchAngle_MRU3)) THEN
        rVotedPitchAngle := rPitchAngle_MRU2;
        rVotedPitchRate := rPitchRate_MRU2;
    ELSE
        rVotedPitchAngle := rPitchAngle_MRU3;
        rVotedPitchRate := rPitchRate_MRU3;
    END_IF;
ELSIF bMRU1_Fault AND (NOT bMRU2_Fault) AND (NOT bMRU3_Fault) THEN
    (* Channel 1 Degraded: Average MRU2 and MRU3 *)
    rVotedRollAngle := (rRollAngle_MRU2 + rRollAngle_MRU3) * 0.5;
    rVotedPitchAngle := (rPitchAngle_MRU2 + rPitchAngle_MRU3) * 0.5;
    rVotedRollRate := (rRollRate_MRU2 + rRollRate_MRU3) * 0.5;
    rVotedPitchRate := (rPitchRate_MRU2 + rPitchRate_MRU3) * 0.5;
ELSIF bMRU2_Fault AND (NOT bMRU1_Fault) AND (NOT bMRU3_Fault) THEN
    (* Channel 2 Degraded: Average MRU1 and MRU3 *)
    rVotedRollAngle := (rRollAngle_MRU1 + rRollAngle_MRU3) * 0.5;
    rVotedPitchAngle := (rPitchAngle_MRU1 + rPitchAngle_MRU3) * 0.5;
    rVotedRollRate := (rRollRate_MRU1 + rRollRate_MRU3) * 0.5;
    rVotedPitchRate := (rPitchRate_MRU1 + rPitchRate_MRU3) * 0.5;
ELSIF bMRU3_Fault AND (NOT bMRU1_Fault) AND (NOT bMRU2_Fault) THEN
    (* Channel 3 Degraded: Average MRU1 and MRU2 *)
    rVotedRollAngle := (rRollAngle_MRU1 + rRollAngle_MRU2) * 0.5;
    rVotedPitchAngle := (rPitchAngle_MRU1 + rPitchAngle_MRU2) * 0.5;
    rVotedRollRate := (rRollRate_MRU1 + rRollRate_MRU2) * 0.5;
    rVotedPitchRate := (rPitchRate_MRU1 + rPitchRate_MRU2) * 0.5;
ELSE
    (* Multiple MRU Failure: Hold last filtered values and trip alarm *)
    rVotedRollAngle := rFilteredRoll;
    rVotedPitchAngle := rFilteredPitch;
    rVotedRollRate := 0.0;
    rVotedPitchRate := 0.0;
END_IF;

(* 1st-Order Low-Pass Filter on Attitude Signals *)
rFilteredRoll := (rRollAlphaFilter * rVotedRollAngle) + ((1.0 - rRollAlphaFilter) * rFilteredRoll);
rFilteredPitch := (rRollAlphaFilter * rVotedPitchAngle) + ((1.0 - rRollAlphaFilter) * rFilteredPitch);

(* -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
   03. RIGOROUS REAL-TIME HYDROSTATIC STABILITY & METACENTRIC HEIGHT (GM) CALCULATIONS
   ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* Liquid ballast masses in metric tons (rho_sw * Area * level) *)
rTankMass_FP := rTankLevel_FP * rTankCrossSectionArea * rSeawaterSpecificGravity;
rTankMass_FS := rTankLevel_FS * rTankCrossSectionArea * rSeawaterSpecificGravity;
rTankMass_AP := rTankLevel_AP * rTankCrossSectionArea * rSeawaterSpecificGravity;
rTankMass_AS := rTankLevel_AS * rTankCrossSectionArea * rSeawaterSpecificGravity;
rTotalBallastMass := rTankMass_FP + rTankMass_FS + rTankMass_AP + rTankMass_AS;

(* Cumulative Platform Displacement Mass and Underwater Volume *)
rCurrentPlatformDisplacement := rLightshipWeight + rTotalBallastMass;
IF rSeawaterSpecificGravity > 0.5 THEN
    rDisplacedVolume := rCurrentPlatformDisplacement / rSeawaterSpecificGravity;
ELSE
    rDisplacedVolume := rCurrentPlatformDisplacement / 1.025;
END_IF;

(* Vertical Center of Gravity (KG) Cumulative Moments *)
rTotalStaticMoment_Z := (rLightshipWeight * rLightshipKG) +
                        (rTankMass_FP * (rTankBaseKG + (rTankLevel_FP * 0.5))) +
                        (rTankMass_FS * (rTankBaseKG + (rTankLevel_FS * 0.5))) +
                        (rTankMass_AP * (rTankBaseKG + (rTankLevel_AP * 0.5))) +
                        (rTankMass_AS * (rTankBaseKG + (rTankLevel_AS * 0.5)));

IF rCurrentPlatformDisplacement > 1000.0 THEN
    rKG_Current := rTotalStaticMoment_Z / rCurrentPlatformDisplacement;
ELSE
    rKG_Current := rLightshipKG;
END_IF;

(* Height of Center of Buoyancy (KB) as Function of Operating Draft *)
IF rPlatformDraft > 6.0 THEN
    (* Platform pontoons are completely submerged; columns penetrate water surface *)
    rKB_Current := ((rPontoonDisplacementKeel * rPontoonKB) + 
                   (rTotalWaterplaneArea * (rPlatformDraft - 6.0) * rSeawaterSpecificGravity * (6.0 + ((rPlatformDraft - 6.0) * 0.5)))) / 
                   rCurrentPlatformDisplacement;
ELSE
    rKB_Current := rPontoonKB * (rPlatformDraft / 6.0);
END_IF;

(* Waterplane Moments of Inertia at Column Waterline (Parallel Axis Theorem) *)
(* I_T = 4 * [ (L * B^3 / 12) + A_col * y_c^2 ], where y_c = 34.0 m *)
rWaterplaneInertia_T := 4.0 * ((rColumnWidth_X * rColumnWidth_Y * rColumnWidth_Y * rColumnWidth_Y / 12.0) + 
                               (rColumnSectionArea * (rColumnCenterDistance_Y * 0.5) * (rColumnCenterDistance_Y * 0.5)));

(* I_L = 4 * [ (B * L^3 / 12) + A_col * x_c^2 ], where x_c = 34.0 m *)
rWaterplaneInertia_L := 4.0 * ((rColumnWidth_Y * rColumnWidth_X * rColumnWidth_X * rColumnWidth_X / 12.0) + 
                               (rColumnSectionArea * (rColumnCenterDistance_X * 0.5) * (rColumnCenterDistance_X * 0.5)));

(* Metacentric Radii: BM = I / Displaced_Volume *)
IF rDisplacedVolume > 100.0 THEN
    rBM_Transverse := rWaterplaneInertia_T / rDisplacedVolume;
    rBM_Longitudinal := rWaterplaneInertia_L / rDisplacedVolume;
ELSE
    rBM_Transverse := 0.0;
    rBM_Longitudinal := 0.0;
END_IF;

(* Free Surface Moment of Slack Ballast Tanks (FSE virtual rise of G) *)
(* Tank breadth b = 9.22m, length l = 9.22m (approx sqrt(85m2)) -> i_tank = 9.22^4 / 12 = 602.0 m4 *)
IF (rTankLevel_FP > 0.4) AND (rTankLevel_FP < (rTankMaxHeight - 0.4)) THEN
    rFSE_Inertia_FP := 602.0;
ELSE
    rFSE_Inertia_FP := 0.0;
END_IF;

IF (rTankLevel_FS > 0.4) AND (rTankLevel_FS < (rTankMaxHeight - 0.4)) THEN
    rFSE_Inertia_FS := 602.0;
ELSE
    rFSE_Inertia_FS := 0.0;
END_IF;

IF (rTankLevel_AP > 0.4) AND (rTankLevel_AP < (rTankMaxHeight - 0.4)) THEN
    rFSE_Inertia_AP := 602.0;
ELSE
    rFSE_Inertia_AP := 0.0;
END_IF;

IF (rTankLevel_AS > 0.4) AND (rTankLevel_AS < (rTankMaxHeight - 0.4)) THEN
    rFSE_Inertia_AS := 602.0;
ELSE
    rFSE_Inertia_AS := 0.0;
END_IF;

IF rCurrentPlatformDisplacement > 1000.0 THEN
    rFreeSurfaceCorrection_GG1 := (rSeawaterSpecificGravity * (rFSE_Inertia_FP + rFSE_Inertia_FS + rFSE_Inertia_AP + rFSE_Inertia_AS)) / 
                                   rCurrentPlatformDisplacement;
ELSE
    rFreeSurfaceCorrection_GG1 := 0.0;
END_IF;

(* True Dynamic Metacentric Heights (GM_T and GM_L) *)
rComputedGM_Transverse := rKB_Current + rBM_Transverse - rKG_Current - rFreeSurfaceCorrection_GG1;
rComputedGM_Longitudinal := rKB_Current + rBM_Longitudinal - rKG_Current - (rFreeSurfaceCorrection_GG1 * 0.95);

(* Total Instantaneous Blowing Air Mass Flow Rate Summation *)
rTotalAirConsumptionRate := rAirBlowingFlow_FP + rAirBlowingFlow_FS + rAirBlowingFlow_AP + rAirBlowingFlow_AS;

(* -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
   04. STATE-SPACE DYNAMICS & MODEL PREDICTIVE CONTROL GAIN CALCULATION
   ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* State Vector Definition (Error coordinates relative to trim targets):
   x1: Transverse heel error e_phi [rad] = (rFilteredRoll - rTargetRoll) * PI / 180.0
   x2: Transverse roll rate dphi_dt [rad/s] = rVotedRollRate * PI / 180.0
   x3: Longitudinal trim error e_theta [rad] = (rFilteredPitch - rTargetPitch) * PI / 180.0
   x4: Longitudinal pitch rate dtheta_dt [rad/s] = rVotedPitchRate * PI / 180.0
   x5: Draft displacement error e_z [m] = rPlatformDraft - rTargetDraft
   x6: Dynamic Metacentric Height deficit [m] = rMinMetacentricHeight_GM - rComputedGM_Transverse
*)
arrStateVector[1] := (rFilteredRoll - rTargetRoll) * 0.01745329;
arrStateVector[2] := rVotedRollRate * 0.01745329;
arrStateVector[3] := (rFilteredPitch - rTargetPitch) * 0.01745329;
arrStateVector[4] := rVotedPitchRate * 0.01745329;
arrStateVector[5] := rPlatformDraft - rTargetDraft;
arrStateVector[6] := rMinMetacentricHeight_GM - rComputedGM_Transverse;

(* Hydrodynamic State-Space Transition Matrix Ad = I + Ac * dt (Pre-linearized around operating draft 21m) *)
(* Row 1: Roll Angle integration *)
arrAd[1, 1] := 1.0;
arrAd[1, 2] := rSafeCycleTime;
arrAd[1, 3] := 0.0;
arrAd[1, 4] := 0.0;
arrAd[1, 5] := 0.0;
arrAd[1, 6] := 0.0;

(* Row 2: Roll Angular Acceleration (Damped Pendulum: w_n^2 = g*GM/r_xx^2, damping b_roll = 0.08) *)
arrAd[2, 1] := -1.85 * rSafeCycleTime * (rComputedGM_Transverse / 2.5);
arrAd[2, 2] := 1.0 - (0.085 * rSafeCycleTime);
arrAd[2, 3] := 0.0;
arrAd[2, 4] := 0.0;
arrAd[2, 5] := 0.0;
arrAd[2, 6] := 0.0;

(* Row 3: Pitch Angle integration *)
arrAd[3, 1] := 0.0;
arrAd[3, 2] := 0.0;
arrAd[3, 3] := 1.0;
arrAd[3, 4] := rSafeCycleTime;
arrAd[3, 5] := 0.0;
arrAd[3, 6] := 0.0;

(* Row 4: Pitch Angular Acceleration (w_n^2 = g*GM_L/r_yy^2, damping b_pitch = 0.09) *)
arrAd[4, 1] := 0.0;
arrAd[4, 2] := 0.0;
arrAd[4, 3] := -1.65 * rSafeCycleTime * (rComputedGM_Longitudinal / 3.0);
arrAd[4, 4] := 1.0 - (0.092 * rSafeCycleTime);
arrAd[4, 5] := 0.0;
arrAd[4, 6] := 0.0;

(* Row 5: Heave/Draft Restoring Response (Restoring stiffness = rho*g*Awp / M) *)
arrAd[5, 1] := 0.0;
arrAd[5, 2] := 0.0;
arrAd[5, 3] := 0.0;
arrAd[5, 4] := 0.0;
arrAd[5, 5] := 1.0 - (0.125 * rSafeCycleTime);
arrAd[5, 6] := 0.0;

(* Row 6: Metacentric Height variation dynamics *)
arrAd[6, 1] := 0.0;
arrAd[6, 2] := 0.0;
arrAd[6, 3] := 0.0;
arrAd[6, 4] := 0.0;
arrAd[6, 5] := 0.052 * rSafeCycleTime;
arrAd[6, 6] := 1.0 - (0.050 * rSafeCycleTime);

(* Actuator Input Coupling Matrix Bd (6x4) for 4 corner column ballast tanks:
   u1 = FP blowing flow [m3/s], u2 = FS blowing flow [m3/s], 
   u3 = AP blowing flow [m3/s], u4 = AS blowing flow [m3/s]
   Moment arms: x_arm = 34.0 m, y_arm = 34.0 m
   Blowing causes de-ballasting (loss of mass -> upward buoyant lift at quadrant)
   FP lift -> induces +roll (starboard list) and -pitch (aft trim)
   FS lift -> induces -roll (port list) and -pitch (aft trim)
   AP lift -> induces +roll (starboard list) and +pitch (forward trim)
   AS lift -> induces -roll (port list) and +pitch (forward trim)
*)
(* Row 1: Roll influence (dt * 0.0) *)
arrBd[1, 1] := 0.0;   arrBd[1, 2] := 0.0;   arrBd[1, 3] := 0.0;   arrBd[1, 4] := 0.0;

(* Row 2: Roll Angular Velocity Acceleration Bd[2, :] *)
arrBd[2, 1] := 0.0034 * rSafeCycleTime;   (* FP blowing causes +roll *)
arrBd[2, 2] := -0.0034 * rSafeCycleTime;  (* FS blowing causes -roll *)

    bDiscrepancyTemp_BC         : BOOL;     (* Tundish Temp Discrepancy Channel B vs C *)
    bDiscrepancyTemp_CA         : BOOL;     (* Tundish Temp Discrepancy Channel C vs A *)

    bTempSensorC_Fail           : BOOL;     (* Tundish Temp Sensor Channel C Discredited *)
    iHealthyTempSensors         : INT;      (* Count of Fully Operational Temperature Transducers [0..3] *)
    rVotedTundishTemp           : REAL;     (* 2oo3 Validated Median Tundish Temperature [deg C] *)

    bDiscrepancyPress_AB        : BOOL;     (* Hydraulic Pressure Discrepancy Channel A vs B *)
    bDiscrepancyPress_BC        : BOOL;     (* Hydraulic Pressure Discrepancy Channel B vs C *)
    bDiscrepancyPress_CA        : BOOL;     (* Hydraulic Pressure Discrepancy Channel C vs A *)
    bPressSensorA_Fail          : BOOL;     (* Pressure Sensor Channel A Discredited *)
    bPressSensorB_Fail          : BOOL;     (* Pressure Sensor Channel B Discredited *)
    bPressSensorC_Fail          : BOOL;     (* Pressure Sensor Channel C Discredited *)
    iHealthyPressSensors        : INT;      (* Count of Fully Operational Pressure Transducers [0..3] *)
    rVotedHydraulicPress        : REAL;     (* 2oo3 Validated Median Cylinder Pressure [bar] *)

    (* --- MULTIVARIABLE STATE-SPACE METALLURGICAL OBSERVER (LUENBERGER FILTER) --- *)

    (*   X[2] = Bloom Centerline Temperature Deviation Delta_T_center [deg C]       *)

    rMatrix_A                   : ARRAY[0..3, 0..3] OF REAL := [

    rMatrix_L                   : ARRAY[0..3, 0..1] OF REAL := [

    (* --- MODEL PREDICTIVE ROLL GAP CONTROLLER (MPC) SYNTHESIS --- *)
    rU_Demand                   : ARRAY[0..2] OF REAL;  (* Raw Unconstrained Demands: 0=GapTrim, 1=Taper, 2=Water *)
    rU_Filtered                 : ARRAY[0..2] OF REAL;  (* Slew-Rate Limited Control Setpoints *)
    rU_Previous                 : ARRAY[0..2] OF REAL;  (* Storage of Preceding Task Actuator Demands *)

    rLiquidCoreCaliberAtEntry   : REAL;     (* Remaining Unsolidified Liquid/Mushy Core Thickness [mm] *)
    rHydrostaticFerrostaticBar  : REAL;     (* Molten Steel Ferrostatic Internal Pressure at MSR [bar] *)

(*
 * ==================================================================================================
 * SECTION 0: SAFETY EMBARGO & HARDWIRED SIL-3 SAFETY INTERLOCK EVALUATION
 * ==================================================================================================
 *)
IF NOT bEmergencyStop THEN
    (* Hardwired SIL-3 Safety Chain Interrupted (Active-Low Emergency Interlock) *)
    rCV_HydraulicGapSetpoint   := rBloomNominalThickness + 10.0; (* Fail-Safe: Full Open Gap to Prevent Roll Binding *)
    rCV_DynamicTaperSlope      := 0.0;
    rCV_HydraulicPressureLimit := 25.0; (* De-energize Main High-Pressure Circuit *)
    rSeparatingForceCalc       := 0.0;
    bSystemReady               := FALSE;
    bMSR_Engaged               := FALSE;
    bOverloadRetractActive     := TRUE;
    wSystemStatusWord          := 16#E5D0; (* Emergency Shutdown State *)
    wAlarmWord                 := wAlarmWord OR 16#8000; (* Bit 15: Critical Emergency Safety Trip *)
    iState                     := 99; (* Lockout State *)
    RETURN;
END_IF;

(* Protect against zero or anomalous periodic execution interval *)
IF rCycleTimeSec <= 0.001 OR rCycleTimeSec > 2.0 THEN
    rCycleTimeSec := 0.100; (* 100ms Standard Industrial PLC Task Fallback *)
END_IF;

(* Initialize Physical MSR Segment Geography *)
IF rMSR_SegmentExitPos <= rMSR_SegmentEntryPos THEN
    rMSR_SegmentEntryPos := 18.5; (* Standard Bloom Machine Segment 5 Entry [m] *)
    rMSR_SegmentExitPos  := 23.5; (* Standard Bloom Machine Segment 6 Exit [m] *)
END_IF;
rMSR_ActiveZoneLength := rMSR_SegmentExitPos - rMSR_SegmentEntryPos;

IF rBloomNominalThickness <= 100.0 THEN
    rBloomNominalThickness := 280.0; (* Standard 280mm x 380mm Rectangular Bloom Caliber *)
END_IF;

(*
 * ==================================================================================================
 * SECTION 1: 2oo3 TRIPLE MODULAR REDUNDANCY (TMR) SENSOR VOTING & INTEGRITY CHECKING
 * ==================================================================================================
 *)
(* --- SUB-SECTION 1.1: STRAND WITHDRAWAL SPEED TMR VOTING --- *)
bSpeedSensorA_Fail := (rVc_CastingSpeed_A < 0.0) OR (rVc_CastingSpeed_A > rSPEED_MAX_CASTING_M_MIN);
bSpeedSensorB_Fail := (rVc_CastingSpeed_B < 0.0) OR (rVc_CastingSpeed_B > rSPEED_MAX_CASTING_M_MIN);
bSpeedSensorC_Fail := (rVc_CastingSpeed_C < 0.0) OR (rVc_CastingSpeed_C > rSPEED_MAX_CASTING_M_MIN);

bDiscrepancyVc_AB := ABS(rVc_CastingSpeed_A - rVc_CastingSpeed_B) > rVC_DISCREPANCY_MAX;
bDiscrepancyVc_BC := ABS(rVc_CastingSpeed_B - rVc_CastingSpeed_C) > rVC_DISCREPANCY_MAX;
bDiscrepancyVc_CA := ABS(rVc_CastingSpeed_C - rVc_CastingSpeed_A) > rVC_DISCREPANCY_MAX;

IF bDiscrepancyVc_AB AND bDiscrepancyVc_CA THEN bSpeedSensorA_Fail := TRUE; END_IF;
IF bDiscrepancyVc_AB AND bDiscrepancyVc_BC THEN bSpeedSensorB_Fail := TRUE; END_IF;
IF bDiscrepancyVc_BC AND bDiscrepancyVc_CA THEN bSpeedSensorC_Fail := TRUE; END_IF;

iHealthySpeedSensors := 3;
IF bSpeedSensorA_Fail THEN iHealthySpeedSensors := iHealthySpeedSensors - 1; END_IF;
IF bSpeedSensorB_Fail THEN iHealthySpeedSensors := iHealthySpeedSensors - 1; END_IF;
IF bSpeedSensorC_Fail THEN iHealthySpeedSensors := iHealthySpeedSensors - 1; END_IF;

IF iHealthySpeedSensors = 3 THEN
    (* Full 2oo3 Median Selection *)
    IF (rVc_CastingSpeed_A >= rVc_CastingSpeed_B AND rVc_CastingSpeed_A <= rVc_CastingSpeed_C) OR
       (rVc_CastingSpeed_A <= rVc_CastingSpeed_B AND rVc_CastingSpeed_A >= rVc_CastingSpeed_C) THEN
        rVotedCastingSpeed := rVc_CastingSpeed_A;
    ELSIF (rVc_CastingSpeed_B >= rVc_CastingSpeed_A AND rVc_CastingSpeed_B <= rVc_CastingSpeed_C) OR
          (rVc_CastingSpeed_B <= rVc_CastingSpeed_A AND rVc_CastingSpeed_B >= rVc_CastingSpeed_C) THEN
        rVotedCastingSpeed := rVc_CastingSpeed_B;
    ELSE
        rVotedCastingSpeed := rVc_CastingSpeed_C;
    END_IF;
ELSIF iHealthySpeedSensors = 2 THEN
    (* Degraded 1oo2 Dual Redundancy Mode *)
    IF NOT bSpeedSensorA_Fail AND NOT bSpeedSensorB_Fail THEN
        rVotedCastingSpeed := 0.5 * (rVc_CastingSpeed_A + rVc_CastingSpeed_B);
    ELSIF NOT bSpeedSensorB_Fail AND NOT bSpeedSensorC_Fail THEN
        rVotedCastingSpeed := 0.5 * (rVc_CastingSpeed_B + rVc_CastingSpeed_C);
    ELSE
        rVotedCastingSpeed := 0.5 * (rVc_CastingSpeed_A + rVc_CastingSpeed_C);
    END_IF;
    wAlarmWord := wAlarmWord OR 16#0400; (* Bit 10: 1oo2 Degraded Mode *)
ELSIF iHealthySpeedSensors = 1 THEN
    (* Critical Single Sensor Surviving (1oo1) *)
    IF NOT bSpeedSensorA_Fail THEN
        rVotedCastingSpeed := rVc_CastingSpeed_A;
    ELSIF NOT bSpeedSensorB_Fail THEN
        rVotedCastingSpeed := rVc_CastingSpeed_B;
    ELSE
        rVotedCastingSpeed := rVc_CastingSpeed_C;
    END_IF;
    wAlarmWord := wAlarmWord OR 16#0800; (* Bit 11: 1oo1 Degraded Mode Critical *)
ELSE
    (* Total Speed Transducer Blackout *)
    rVotedCastingSpeed := 0.0;
    wAlarmWord := wAlarmWord OR 16#1000; (* Bit 12: Total Sensor Blackout Trip *)
    bOverloadRetractActive := TRUE;
    iState := 50;
END_IF;

(* --- SUB-SECTION 1.2: TUNDISH TEMPERATURE TMR VOTING --- *)
bTempSensorA_Fail := (rTT_TundishTemp_A < 1450.0) OR (rTT_TundishTemp_A > 1650.0);
bTempSensorB_Fail := (rTT_TundishTemp_B < 1450.0) OR (rTT_TundishTemp_B > 1650.0);
bTempSensorC_Fail := (rTT_TundishTemp_C < 1450.0) OR (rTT_TundishTemp_C > 1650.0);

bDiscrepancyTemp_AB := ABS(rTT_TundishTemp_A - rTT_TundishTemp_B) > rTT_DISCREPANCY_MAX;
bDiscrepancyTemp_BC := ABS(rTT_TundishTemp_B - rTT_TundishTemp_C) > rTT_DISCREPANCY_MAX;
bDiscrepancyTemp_CA := ABS(rTT_TundishTemp_C - rTT_TundishTemp_A) > rTT_DISCREPANCY_MAX;

IF bDiscrepancyTemp_AB AND bDiscrepancyTemp_CA THEN bTempSensorA_Fail := TRUE; END_IF;
IF bDiscrepancyTemp_AB AND bDiscrepancyTemp_BC THEN bTempSensorB_Fail := TRUE; END_IF;
IF bDiscrepancyTemp_BC AND bDiscrepancyTemp_CA THEN bTempSensorC_Fail := TRUE; END_IF;

iHealthyTempSensors := 3;
IF bTempSensorA_Fail THEN iHealthyTempSensors := iHealthyTempSensors - 1; END_IF;
IF bTempSensorB_Fail THEN iHealthyTempSensors := iHealthyTempSensors - 1; END_IF;
IF bTempSensorC_Fail THEN iHealthyTempSensors := iHealthyTempSensors - 1; END_IF;

IF iHealthyTempSensors = 3 THEN
    IF (rTT_TundishTemp_A >= rTT_TundishTemp_B AND rTT_TundishTemp_A <= rTT_TundishTemp_C) OR
       (rTT_TundishTemp_A <= rTT_TundishTemp_B AND rTT_TundishTemp_A >= rTT_TundishTemp_C) THEN
        rVotedTundishTemp := rTT_TundishTemp_A;
    ELSIF (rTT_TundishTemp_B >= rTT_TundishTemp_A AND rTT_TundishTemp_B <= rTT_TundishTemp_C) OR
          (rTT_TundishTemp_B <= rTT_TundishTemp_A AND rTT_TundishTemp_B >= rTT_TundishTemp_C) THEN
        rVotedTundishTemp := rTT_TundishTemp_B;
    ELSE
        rVotedTundishTemp := rTT_TundishTemp_C;
    END_IF;
ELSIF iHealthyTempSensors = 2 THEN
    IF NOT bTempSensorA_Fail AND NOT bTempSensorB_Fail THEN
        rVotedTundishTemp := 0.5 * (rTT_TundishTemp_A + rTT_TundishTemp_B);
    ELSIF NOT bTempSensorB_Fail AND NOT bTempSensorC_Fail THEN
        rVotedTundishTemp := 0.5 * (rTT_TundishTemp_B + rTT_TundishTemp_C);
    ELSE
        rVotedTundishTemp := 0.5 * (rTT_TundishTemp_A + rTT_TundishTemp_C);
    END_IF;
ELSIF iHealthyTempSensors = 1 THEN
    IF NOT bTempSensorA_Fail THEN
        rVotedTundishTemp := rTT_TundishTemp_A;
    ELSIF NOT bTempSensorB_Fail THEN
        rVotedTundishTemp := rTT_TundishTemp_B;
    ELSE
        rVotedTundishTemp := rTT_TundishTemp_C;
    END_IF;
ELSE
    (* Fallback Default: Liquidus + 25 deg C superheat assumed *)
    rVotedTundishTemp := rGrade_LiquidusTemp + 25.0;
END_IF;

(* Calculate Actual Superheat *)
rSuperheatActual := rVotedTundishTemp - rGrade_LiquidusTemp;

(* --- SUB-SECTION 1.3: HYDRAULIC REDUCTION CYLINDER PRESSURE TMR VOTING --- *)
bPressSensorA_Fail := (rPT_MSR_CylinderPress_A < 0.0) OR (rPT_MSR_CylinderPress_A > 320.0);
bPressSensorB_Fail := (rPT_MSR_CylinderPress_B < 0.0) OR (rPT_MSR_CylinderPress_B > 320.0);
bPressSensorC_Fail := (rPT_MSR_CylinderPress_C < 0.0) OR (rPT_MSR_CylinderPress_C > 320.0);

bDiscrepancyPress_AB := ABS(rPT_MSR_CylinderPress_A - rPT_MSR_CylinderPress_B) > rPT_DISCREPANCY_MAX;
bDiscrepancyPress_BC := ABS(rPT_MSR_CylinderPress_B - rPT_MSR_CylinderPress_C) > rPT_DISCREPANCY_MAX;
bDiscrepancyPress_CA := ABS(rPT_MSR_CylinderPress_C - rPT_MSR_CylinderPress_A) > rPT_DISCREPANCY_MAX;

IF bDiscrepancyPress_AB AND bDiscrepancyPress_CA THEN bPressSensorA_Fail := TRUE; END_IF;
IF bDiscrepancyPress_AB AND bDiscrepancyPress_BC THEN bPressSensorB_Fail := TRUE; END_IF;
IF bDiscrepancyPress_BC AND bDiscrepancyPress_CA THEN bPressSensorC_Fail := TRUE; END_IF;

iHealthyPressSensors := 3;
IF bPressSensorA_Fail THEN iHealthyPressSensors := iHealthyPressSensors - 1; END_IF;
IF bPressSensorB_Fail THEN iHealthyPressSensors := iHealthyPressSensors - 1; END_IF;
IF bPressSensorC_Fail THEN iHealthyPressSensors := iHealthyPressSensors - 1; END_IF;

IF iHealthyPressSensors = 3 THEN
    IF (rPT_MSR_CylinderPress_A >= rPT_MSR_CylinderPress_B AND rPT_MSR_CylinderPress_A <= rPT_MSR_CylinderPress_C) OR
       (rPT_MSR_CylinderPress_A <= rPT_MSR_CylinderPress_B AND rPT_MSR_CylinderPress_A >= rPT_MSR_CylinderPress_C) THEN
        rVotedHydraulicPress := rPT_MSR_CylinderPress_A;

    SQRT(MAX(0.50, 1.0 + (0.22 * (rSprayWaterFiltered - 350.0) / 350.0) - (0.15 * (rSuperheatActual - 25.0) / 25.0)));
