(* ============================================================================================= *)
(* SECTION 1: HARDWIRED SAFETY INTERLOCK VERIFICATION & IMMEDIATE HARDWARE TRIP                 *)
(* ============================================================================================= *)
(* SIL-3 Active-High Safety Loop Integrity Check *)
IF NOT bSafetyInterlockCircuit THEN
    bTrip_Hardwire_Latched := TRUE;
    bCrowbarDumpTrigger := TRUE;
    bBeamAbortInterlock := TRUE;
    bQuenchDetected := TRUE;
    iStateStep := 90; (* Jump directly to STATE_QUENCH_TRIP_FAST_CROWBAR_DUMP *)
END_IF;

(* Operator Diagnostic Reset & Latch Clear Handler *)
IF bAcknowledgeQuenchTrip THEN
    IF bSafetyInterlockCircuit THEN
        bTrip_Hardwire_Latched := FALSE;
    END_IF;
    IF (rV_Res_Voted_mV < 15.0) AND (rQuenchPersistenceTimer_Sec <= 0.0) THEN
        bTrip_QuenchResistive_Latched := FALSE;
        bTrip_FastDVDT_Latched := FALSE;
    END_IF;
    IF rMIITs_Cumulative_MA2s < 0.10 THEN
        bTrip_MIITsLimit_Latched := FALSE;
    END_IF;
    IF rHotSpot_T_Calc_K < 20.0 THEN
        bTrip_HotspotHigh_Latched := FALSE;
    END_IF;
    IF rP_Bath_Voted_Mbar < 1450.0 THEN
        bTrip_BathOverpressure_Latched := FALSE;
    END_IF;
    IF rP_CryostatVacuum_Mbar < 1.0E-4 THEN
        bTrip_VacuumBreakdown_Latched := FALSE;
    END_IF;
    IF rF_LeadCoolingGas_Lh > 15.0 THEN
        bTrip_LeadCoolingLoss_Latched := FALSE;
    END_IF;
    IF (rT_Bath_Voted_K < 4.80) AND (rT_Shield_Voted_K < 85.0) THEN
        bTrip_CryoSevereThermal_Latched := FALSE;
    END_IF;
    
    (* Clear trip word if all latches acknowledged *)
    IF (NOT bTrip_Hardwire_Latched) AND (NOT bTrip_QuenchResistive_Latched) AND
       (NOT bTrip_FastDVDT_Latched) AND (NOT bTrip_MIITsLimit_Latched) AND
       (NOT bTrip_HotspotHigh_Latched) AND (NOT bTrip_BathOverpressure_Latched) AND
       (NOT bTrip_VacuumBreakdown_Latched) AND (NOT bTrip_LeadCoolingLoss_Latched) AND
       (NOT bTrip_CryoSevereThermal_Latched) THEN
        wTripAlarmBitmask := 16#0000;
        bQuenchDetected := FALSE;
        bCrowbarDumpTrigger := FALSE;
        bBeamAbortInterlock := FALSE;
    END_IF;
END_IF;

(* ============================================================================================= *)
(* SECTION 2: 2-OUT-OF-3 (2oo3) TRIPLE MODULAR REDUNDANCY VOTING ENGINES                        *)
(* ============================================================================================= *)
(* --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* SUB-SECTION 2.1: 4.2K Helium Bath Cryogenic RTD 2oo3 Voting Engine                            *)
(* --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
IF bHealth_TBath_ChA AND bHealth_TBath_ChB AND bHealth_TBath_ChC THEN
    (* All 3 channels online: Median Selection Algorithm *)
    IF (rT_Bath_K_ChA >= rT_Bath_K_ChB) THEN
        IF (rT_Bath_K_ChB >= rT_Bath_K_ChC) THEN
            rT_Bath_Voted_K := rT_Bath_K_ChB;
        ELSIF (rT_Bath_K_ChA >= rT_Bath_K_ChC) THEN
            rT_Bath_Voted_K := rT_Bath_K_ChC;
        ELSE
            rT_Bath_Voted_K := rT_Bath_K_ChA;
        END_IF;
    ELSE
        IF (rT_Bath_K_ChA >= rT_Bath_K_ChC) THEN
            rT_Bath_Voted_K := rT_Bath_K_ChA;
        ELSIF (rT_Bath_K_ChB >= rT_Bath_K_ChC) THEN
            rT_Bath_Voted_K := rT_Bath_K_ChC;
        ELSE
            rT_Bath_Voted_K := rT_Bath_K_ChB;
        END_IF;
    END_IF;

    (* Monitor inter-channel deviation thresholds *)
    IF (ABS(rT_Bath_K_ChA - rT_Bath_K_ChB) > rTOL_TBath_K) OR
       (ABS(rT_Bath_K_ChB - rT_Bath_K_ChC) > rTOL_TBath_K) OR
       (ABS(rT_Bath_K_ChA - rT_Bath_K_ChC) > rTOL_TBath_K) THEN
        rTimer_TBath_Discrepancy := rTimer_TBath_Discrepancy + tScanDeltaTime_Sec;
        IF rTimer_TBath_Discrepancy >= rMAX_DISCREPANCY_TIME_Sec THEN
            (* Identify diverging transmitter and isolate *)
            IF ABS(rT_Bath_K_ChA - rT_Bath_Voted_K) > rTOL_TBath_K THEN
                bHealth_TBath_ChA := FALSE;
            ELSIF ABS(rT_Bath_K_ChB - rT_Bath_Voted_K) > rTOL_TBath_K THEN
                bHealth_TBath_ChB := FALSE;
            ELSE
                bHealth_TBath_ChC := FALSE;
            END_IF;
        END_IF;
    ELSE
        rTimer_TBath_Discrepancy := 0.0;
    END_IF;
ELSIF (bHealth_TBath_ChA AND bHealth_TBath_ChB) THEN
    (* Degraded 1oo2 fail-operational mode *)
    rT_Bath_Voted_K := 0.5 * (rT_Bath_K_ChA + rT_Bath_K_ChB);
    bDegradedSensorMode := TRUE;
ELSIF (bHealth_TBath_ChA AND bHealth_TBath_ChC) THEN
    rT_Bath_Voted_K := 0.5 * (rT_Bath_K_ChA + rT_Bath_K_ChC);
    bDegradedSensorMode := TRUE;
ELSIF (bHealth_TBath_ChB AND bHealth_TBath_ChC) THEN
    rT_Bath_Voted_K := 0.5 * (rT_Bath_K_ChB + rT_Bath_K_ChC);
    bDegradedSensorMode := TRUE;
ELSE
    (* Degraded 1oo1 fallback mode *)
    IF bHealth_TBath_ChA THEN
        rT_Bath_Voted_K := rT_Bath_K_ChA;
    ELSIF bHealth_TBath_ChB THEN
        rT_Bath_Voted_K := rT_Bath_K_ChB;
    ELSIF bHealth_TBath_ChC THEN
        rT_Bath_Voted_K := rT_Bath_K_ChC;
    ELSE
        (* Total instrumentation failure: initiate trip *)
        rT_Bath_Voted_K := 300.0;
        bTrip_CryoSevereThermal_Latched := TRUE;
    END_IF;
    bDegradedSensorMode := TRUE;
END_IF;

(* --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* SUB-SECTION 2.2: Liquid Helium Bath Pressure 2oo3 Voting Engine                               *)
(* --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
IF bHealth_PBath_ChA AND bHealth_PBath_ChB AND bHealth_PBath_ChC THEN
    IF (rP_Bath_Mbar_ChA >= rP_Bath_Mbar_ChB) THEN
        IF (rP_Bath_Mbar_ChB >= rP_Bath_Mbar_ChC) THEN
            rP_Bath_Voted_Mbar := rP_Bath_Mbar_ChB;
        ELSIF (rP_Bath_Mbar_ChA >= rP_Bath_Mbar_ChC) THEN
            rP_Bath_Voted_Mbar := rP_Bath_Mbar_ChC;
        ELSE
            rP_Bath_Voted_Mbar := rP_Bath_Mbar_ChA;
        END_IF;
    ELSE
        IF (rP_Bath_Mbar_ChA >= rP_Bath_Mbar_ChC) THEN
            rP_Bath_Voted_Mbar := rP_Bath_Mbar_ChA;
        ELSIF (rP_Bath_Mbar_ChB >= rP_Bath_Mbar_ChC) THEN
            rP_Bath_Voted_Mbar := rP_Bath_Mbar_ChC;
        ELSE
            rP_Bath_Voted_Mbar := rP_Bath_Mbar_ChB;
        END_IF;
    END_IF;

    IF (ABS(rP_Bath_Mbar_ChA - rP_Bath_Mbar_ChB) > rTOL_PBath_Mbar) OR
       (ABS(rP_Bath_Mbar_ChB - rP_Bath_Mbar_ChC) > rTOL_PBath_Mbar) OR
       (ABS(rP_Bath_Mbar_ChA - rP_Bath_Mbar_ChC) > rTOL_PBath_Mbar) THEN
        rTimer_PBath_Discrepancy := rTimer_PBath_Discrepancy + tScanDeltaTime_Sec;
        IF rTimer_PBath_Discrepancy >= rMAX_DISCREPANCY_TIME_Sec THEN
            IF ABS(rP_Bath_Mbar_ChA - rP_Bath_Voted_Mbar) > rTOL_PBath_Mbar THEN
                bHealth_PBath_ChA := FALSE;
            ELSIF ABS(rP_Bath_Mbar_ChB - rP_Bath_Voted_Mbar) > rTOL_PBath_Mbar THEN
                bHealth_PBath_ChB := FALSE;
            ELSE
                bHealth_PBath_ChC := FALSE;
            END_IF;
        END_IF;
    ELSE
        rTimer_PBath_Discrepancy := 0.0;
    END_IF;
ELSIF (bHealth_PBath_ChA AND bHealth_PBath_ChB) THEN
    rP_Bath_Voted_Mbar := 0.5 * (rP_Bath_Mbar_ChA + rP_Bath_Mbar_ChB);
    bDegradedSensorMode := TRUE;
ELSIF (bHealth_PBath_ChA AND bHealth_PBath_ChC) THEN
    rP_Bath_Voted_Mbar := 0.5 * (rP_Bath_Mbar_ChA + rP_Bath_Mbar_ChC);
    bDegradedSensorMode := TRUE;
ELSIF (bHealth_PBath_ChB AND bHealth_PBath_ChC) THEN
    rP_Bath_Voted_Mbar := 0.5 * (rP_Bath_Mbar_ChB + rP_Bath_Mbar_ChC);
    bDegradedSensorMode := TRUE;
ELSE
    IF bHealth_PBath_ChA THEN
        rP_Bath_Voted_Mbar := rP_Bath_Mbar_ChA;
    ELSIF bHealth_PBath_ChB THEN
        rP_Bath_Voted_Mbar := rP_Bath_Mbar_ChB;
    ELSIF bHealth_PBath_ChC THEN
        rP_Bath_Voted_Mbar := rP_Bath_Mbar_ChC;
    ELSE
        rP_Bath_Voted_Mbar := 16000.0; (* Failsafe overpressure trip *)
        bTrip_BathOverpressure_Latched := TRUE;
    END_IF;
    bDegradedSensorMode := TRUE;
END_IF;

(* --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* SUB-SECTION 2.3: 50K Thermal Radiation Shield Temperature 2oo3 Voting Engine                  *)
(* --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
IF bHealth_TShield_ChA AND bHealth_TShield_ChB AND bHealth_TShield_ChC THEN
    IF (rT_Shield_K_ChA >= rT_Shield_K_ChB) THEN
        IF (rT_Shield_K_ChB >= rT_Shield_K_ChC) THEN
            rT_Shield_Voted_K := rT_Shield_K_ChB;
        ELSIF (rT_Shield_K_ChA >= rT_Shield_K_ChC) THEN
            rT_Shield_Voted_K := rT_Shield_K_ChC;
        ELSE
            rT_Shield_Voted_K := rT_Shield_K_ChA;
        END_IF;
    ELSE
        IF (rT_Shield_K_ChA >= rT_Shield_K_ChC) THEN
            rT_Shield_Voted_K := rT_Shield_K_ChA;
        ELSIF (rT_Shield_K_ChB >= rT_Shield_K_ChC) THEN
            rT_Shield_Voted_K := rT_Shield_K_ChC;
        ELSE
            rT_Shield_Voted_K := rT_Shield_K_ChB;
        END_IF;
    END_IF;

    IF (ABS(rT_Shield_K_ChA - rT_Shield_K_ChB) > rTOL_TShield_K) OR
       (ABS(rT_Shield_K_ChB - rT_Shield_K_ChC) > rTOL_TShield_K) OR
       (ABS(rT_Shield_K_ChA - rT_Shield_K_ChC) > rTOL_TShield_K) THEN
        rTimer_TShield_Discrepancy := rTimer_TShield_Discrepancy + tScanDeltaTime_Sec;
        IF rTimer_TShield_Discrepancy >= rMAX_DISCREPANCY_TIME_Sec THEN
            IF ABS(rT_Shield_K_ChA - rT_Shield_Voted_K) > rTOL_TShield_K THEN
                bHealth_TShield_ChA := FALSE;
            ELSIF ABS(rT_Shield_K_ChB - rT_Shield_Voted_K) > rTOL_TShield_K THEN
                bHealth_TShield_ChB := FALSE;
            ELSE
                bHealth_TShield_ChC := FALSE;
            END_IF;
        END_IF;
    ELSE
        rTimer_TShield_Discrepancy := 0.0;
    END_IF;
ELSIF (bHealth_TShield_ChA AND bHealth_TShield_ChB) THEN
    rT_Shield_Voted_K := 0.5 * (rT_Shield_K_ChA + rT_Shield_K_ChB);
    bDegradedSensorMode := TRUE;
ELSIF (bHealth_TShield_ChA AND bHealth_TShield_ChC) THEN
    rT_Shield_Voted_K := 0.5 * (rT_Shield_K_ChA + rT_Shield_K_ChC);
    bDegradedSensorMode := TRUE;
ELSIF (bHealth_TShield_ChB AND bHealth_TShield_ChC) THEN
    rT_Shield_Voted_K := 0.5 * (rT_Shield_K_ChB + rT_Shield_K_ChC);
    bDegradedSensorMode := TRUE;
ELSE
    IF bHealth_TShield_ChA THEN
        rT_Shield_Voted_K := rT_Shield_K_ChA;
    ELSIF bHealth_TShield_ChB THEN
        rT_Shield_Voted_K := rT_Shield_K_ChB;
    ELSIF bHealth_TShield_ChC THEN
        rT_Shield_Voted_K := rT_Shield_K_ChC;
    ELSE
        rT_Shield_Voted_K := 120.0;
    END_IF;
    bDegradedSensorMode := TRUE;
END_IF;

(* --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* SUB-SECTION 2.4: Dipole DCCT Current Transducers 2oo3 Voting Engine                           *)
(* --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
IF bHealth_Current_ChA AND bHealth_Current_ChB AND bHealth_Current_ChC THEN
    IF (rI_MagnetCurrent_A_ChA >= rI_MagnetCurrent_A_ChB) THEN
        IF (rI_MagnetCurrent_A_ChB >= rI_MagnetCurrent_A_ChC) THEN
            rI_MagnetCurrent_Voted_A := rI_MagnetCurrent_A_ChB;
        ELSIF (rI_MagnetCurrent_A_ChA >= rI_MagnetCurrent_A_ChC) THEN
            rI_MagnetCurrent_Voted_A := rI_MagnetCurrent_A_ChC;
        ELSE
            rI_MagnetCurrent_Voted_A := rI_MagnetCurrent_A_ChA;
        END_IF;
    ELSE
        IF (rI_MagnetCurrent_A_ChA >= rI_MagnetCurrent_A_ChC) THEN
            rI_MagnetCurrent_Voted_A := rI_MagnetCurrent_A_ChA;
        ELSIF (rI_MagnetCurrent_A_ChB >= rI_MagnetCurrent_A_ChC) THEN
            rI_MagnetCurrent_Voted_A := rI_MagnetCurrent_A_ChC;
        ELSE
            rI_MagnetCurrent_Voted_A := rI_MagnetCurrent_A_ChB;
        END_IF;
    END_IF;

    IF (ABS(rI_MagnetCurrent_A_ChA - rI_MagnetCurrent_A_ChB) > rTOL_Current_A) OR
       (ABS(rI_MagnetCurrent_A_ChB - rI_MagnetCurrent_A_ChC) > rTOL_Current_A) OR
       (ABS(rI_MagnetCurrent_A_ChA - rI_MagnetCurrent_A_ChC) > rTOL_Current_A) THEN
        rTimer_Current_Discrepancy := rTimer_Current_Discrepancy + tScanDeltaTime_Sec;
        IF rTimer_Current_Discrepancy >= rMAX_DISCREPANCY_TIME_Sec THEN
            IF ABS(rI_MagnetCurrent_A_ChA - rI_MagnetCurrent_Voted_A) > rTOL_Current_A THEN
                bHealth_Current_ChA := FALSE;
            ELSIF ABS(rI_MagnetCurrent_A_ChB - rI_MagnetCurrent_Voted_A) > rTOL_Current_A THEN
                bHealth_Current_ChB := FALSE;
            ELSE
                bHealth_Current_ChC := FALSE;
            END_IF;
        END_IF;
    ELSE
        rTimer_Current_Discrepancy := 0.0;
    END_IF;
ELSIF (bHealth_Current_ChA AND bHealth_Current_ChB) THEN
    rI_MagnetCurrent_Voted_A := 0.5 * (rI_MagnetCurrent_A_ChA + rI_MagnetCurrent_A_ChB);
    bDegradedSensorMode := TRUE;
ELSIF (bHealth_Current_ChA AND bHealth_Current_ChC) THEN
    rI_MagnetCurrent_Voted_A := 0.5 * (rI_MagnetCurrent_A_ChA + rI_MagnetCurrent_A_ChC);
    bDegradedSensorMode := TRUE;
ELSIF (bHealth_Current_ChB AND bHealth_Current_ChC) THEN
    rI_MagnetCurrent_Voted_A := 0.5 * (rI_MagnetCurrent_A_ChB + rI_MagnetCurrent_A_ChC);
    bDegradedSensorMode := TRUE;
ELSE
    IF bHealth_Current_ChA THEN
        rI_MagnetCurrent_Voted_A := rI_MagnetCurrent_A_ChA;
    ELSIF bHealth_Current_ChB THEN
        rI_MagnetCurrent_Voted_A := rI_MagnetCurrent_A_ChB;
    ELSIF bHealth_Current_ChC THEN
        rI_MagnetCurrent_Voted_A := rI_MagnetCurrent_A_ChC;
    ELSE
        rI_MagnetCurrent_Voted_A := 0.0;
    END_IF;
    bDegradedSensorMode := TRUE;
END_IF;

(* First-Order Digital Smoothing Filters for Auxiliary Signals *)
rT_Bath_Filt_K    := (rFilterAlpha_Standard * rT_Bath_Voted_K)    + ((1.0 - rFilterAlpha_Standard) * rT_Bath_Filt_K);
rP_Bath_Filt_Mbar := (rFilterAlpha_Standard * rP_Bath_Voted_Mbar) + ((1.0 - rFilterAlpha_Standard) * rP_Bath_Filt_Mbar);
rT_Shield_Filt_K  := (rFilterAlpha_Standard * rT_Shield_Voted_K)  + ((1.0 - rFilterAlpha_Standard) * rT_Shield_Filt_K);
rI_Current_Filt_A  := (rFilterAlpha_Standard * rI_MagnetCurrent_Voted_A) + ((1.0 - rFilterAlpha_Standard) * rI_Current_Filt_A);

(* Magnet Energization Interlock Flag *)
bMagnetEnergized := (rI_Current_Filt_A > 60.0);

(* ============================================================================================= *)
(* SECTION 3: INDUCTIVE COMPENSATION & QUENCH DETECTION BRIDGE BALANCE                           *)
(* ============================================================================================= *)
(* 1. Compute moving derivative dI/dt [A/s] *)
IF tScanDeltaTime_Sec > 0.001 THEN
    rRawDIDT_As := (rI_MagnetCurrent_Voted_A - rI_Previous_A) / tScanDeltaTime_Sec;
ELSE
    rRawDIDT_As := 0.0;
END_IF;
rI_Previous_A := rI_MagnetCurrent_Voted_A;
rDIDT_Filtered_As := (rDIDT_FilterAlpha * rRawDIDT_As) + ((1.0 - rDIDT_FilterAlpha) * rDIDT_Filtered_As);

(* 2. Estimate common-mode inductive voltage across each half-winding: V_ind = L_half * dI/dt *)
(* mV = (Henry * A/s) * 1000.0 *)
rV_Inductive_Estimated_mV := (rSelfInductance_Half1_H - rSelfInductance_Half2_H + rMutualInductance_H) * rDIDT_Filtered_As * 1000.0;

(* 3. Compute net resistive voltage for each 2oo3 bridge channel: *)
(* V_res = (V_half1 - V_half2) - V_ind_offset *)
rV_Res_ChA_Raw_mV := (rV_CoilHalf1_mV_ChA - rV_CoilHalf2_mV_ChA) - rV_Inductive_Estimated_mV;
rV_Res_ChB_Raw_mV := (rV_CoilHalf1_mV_ChB - rV_CoilHalf2_mV_ChB) - rV_Inductive_Estimated_mV;
rV_Res_ChC_Raw_mV := (rV_CoilHalf1_mV_ChC - rV_CoilHalf2_mV_ChC) - rV_Inductive_Estimated_mV;

(* 4. 2oo3 Median Voting on Resistive Voltage Signals *)
IF bHealth_VoltTap_ChA AND bHealth_VoltTap_ChB AND bHealth_VoltTap_ChC THEN
    IF (rV_Res_ChA_Raw_mV >= rV_Res_ChB_Raw_mV) THEN
        IF (rV_Res_ChB_Raw_mV >= rV_Res_ChC_Raw_mV) THEN
            rV_Res_Voted_mV := rV_Res_ChB_Raw_mV;
        ELSIF (rV_Res_ChA_Raw_mV >= rV_Res_ChC_Raw_mV) THEN
            rV_Res_Voted_mV := rV_Res_ChC_Raw_mV;
        ELSE
            rV_Res_Voted_mV := rV_Res_ChA_Raw_mV;
        END_IF;
    ELSE
        IF (rV_Res_ChA_Raw_mV >= rV_Res_ChC_Raw_mV) THEN
            rV_Res_Voted_mV := rV_Res_ChA_Raw_mV;
        ELSIF (rV_Res_ChB_Raw_mV >= rV_Res_ChC_Raw_mV) THEN
            rV_Res_Voted_mV := rV_Res_ChC_Raw_mV;
        ELSE
            rV_Res_Voted_mV := rV_Res_ChB_Raw_mV;
        END_IF;
    END_IF;

    (* Channel discrepancy verification *)
    IF (ABS(rV_Res_ChA_Raw_mV - rV_Res_ChB_Raw_mV) > rTOL_VoltTap_mV) OR
       (ABS(rV_Res_ChB_Raw_mV - rV_Res_ChC_Raw_mV) > rTOL_VoltTap_mV) OR
       (ABS(rV_Res_ChA_Raw_mV - rV_Res_ChC_Raw_mV) > rTOL_VoltTap_mV) THEN
        rTimer_VoltTap_Discrepancy := rTimer_VoltTap_Discrepancy + tScanDeltaTime_Sec;
        IF rTimer_VoltTap_Discrepancy >= rMAX_DISCREPANCY_TIME_Sec THEN
            IF ABS(rV_Res_ChA_Raw_mV - rV_Res_Voted_mV) > rTOL_VoltTap_mV THEN
                bHealth_VoltTap_ChA := FALSE;
            ELSIF ABS(rV_Res_ChB_Raw_mV - rV_Res_Voted_mV) > rTOL_VoltTap_mV THEN
                bHealth_VoltTap_ChB := FALSE;
            ELSE
                bHealth_VoltTap_ChC := FALSE;
            END_IF;
        END_IF;
    ELSE
        rTimer_VoltTap_Discrepancy := 0.0;
    END_IF;
ELSIF (bHealth_VoltTap_ChA AND bHealth_VoltTap_ChB) THEN
    rV_Res_Voted_mV := 0.5 * (rV_Res_ChA_Raw_mV + rV_Res_ChB_Raw_mV);
    bDegradedSensorMode := TRUE;
ELSIF (bHealth_VoltTap_ChA AND bHealth_VoltTap_ChC) THEN
    rV_Res_Voted_mV := 0.5 * (rV_Res_ChA_Raw_mV + rV_Res_ChC_Raw_mV);
    bDegradedSensorMode := TRUE;
ELSIF (bHealth_VoltTap_ChB AND bHealth_VoltTap_ChC) THEN
    rV_Res_Voted_mV := 0.5 * (rV_Res_ChB_Raw_mV + rV_Res_ChC_Raw_mV);
    bDegradedSensorMode := TRUE;
ELSE
    IF bHealth_VoltTap_ChA THEN
        rV_Res_Voted_mV := rV_Res_ChA_Raw_mV;
    ELSIF bHealth_VoltTap_ChB THEN
        rV_Res_Voted_mV := rV_Res_ChB_Raw_mV;
    ELSIF bHealth_VoltTap_ChC THEN
        rV_Res_Voted_mV := rV_Res_ChC_Raw_mV;
    ELSE
        rV_Res_Voted_mV := 500.0; (* Failsafe trip *)
        bTrip_QuenchResistive_Latched := TRUE;
    END_IF;
    bDegradedSensorMode := TRUE;
END_IF;

rQuenchResistiveVoltage_mV := rV_Res_Voted_mV;

(* 5. Compute resistive voltage rate of change dV_res/dt [mV/ms] *)
IF tScanDeltaTime_Sec > 0.001 THEN
    rDVDT_Estimated_mV_PerMs := (ABS(rV_Res_Voted_mV) - ABS(rV_Res_Previous_mV)) / (tScanDeltaTime_Sec * 1000.0);
ELSE
    rDVDT_Estimated_mV_PerMs := 0.0;
END_IF;
rV_Res_Previous_mV := rV_Res_Voted_mV;

(* 6. Dual-Criteria Quench Discrimination Engine *)
IF bMagnetEnergized THEN
    (* Criterion A: Sustained resistive threshold exceedance (V_res >= 100 mV for >= 8 ms) *)
    IF ABS(rV_Res_Voted_mV) >= rQuenchVoltThreshold_mV THEN
        rQuenchPersistenceTimer_Sec := rQuenchPersistenceTimer_Sec + tScanDeltaTime_Sec;
        IF rQuenchPersistenceTimer_Sec >= rQuenchValidationTime_Sec THEN
            bTrip_QuenchResistive_Latched := TRUE;
        END_IF;
    ELSE
        (* Symmetrical decay of validation accumulator to avoid noise pumping *)
        IF rQuenchPersistenceTimer_Sec > 0.0 THEN
            rQuenchPersistenceTimer_Sec := rQuenchPersistenceTimer_Sec - (1.5 * tScanDeltaTime_Sec);
            IF rQuenchPersistenceTimer_Sec < 0.0 THEN rQuenchPersistenceTimer_Sec := 0.0; END_IF;
        END_IF;
    END_IF;

    (* Criterion B: Catastrophic fast quench propagation rate-of-rise (dV/dt >= 25 mV/ms) *)
    IF (rDVDT_Estimated_mV_PerMs >= rFastQuenchDVDT_Threshold) AND (ABS(rV_Res_Voted_mV) >= 40.0) THEN
        bTrip_FastDVDT_Latched := TRUE;
    END_IF;
ELSE
    rQuenchPersistenceTimer_Sec := 0.0;
END_IF;

(* ============================================================================================= *)
(* SECTION 4: ACTION INTEGRAL (MIITs) & ADIABATIC NORMAL-ZONE HOTSPOT MODEL                      *)
(* ============================================================================================= *)
(* Action Integral MIITs = integral(I^2 * dt) in MA^2 * s *)
IF (bTrip_QuenchResistive_Latched OR bTrip_FastDVDT_Latched OR (iStateStep >= 80)) THEN
    (* Current is decaying through dump resistor or localized arc *)
    rMIITs_Cumulative_MA2s := rMIITs_Cumulative_MA2s + (EXPT((rI_Current_Filt_A / 1000000.0), 2.0) * tScanDeltaTime_Sec);
ELSIF (NOT bMagnetEnergized) THEN
    (* Decay accumulator slowly when magnet is completely de-energized *)
    IF rMIITs_Cumulative_MA2s > 0.0 THEN
        rMIITs_Cumulative_MA2s := rMIITs_Cumulative_MA2s - (0.05 * tScanDeltaTime_Sec);
        IF rMIITs_Cumulative_MA2s < 0.0 THEN rMIITs_Cumulative_MA2s := 0.0; END_IF;
    END_IF;
END_IF;
rMIITsAccumulated_MA2s := rMIITs_Cumulative_MA2s;

(* Adiabatic Hot-spot Inversion Model for Nb-Ti/Cu matrix *)
rHotSpot_T_Calc_K := rT_Bath_Filt_K + (rCoeff_Hotspot_k1 * rMIITs_Cumulative_MA2s) +
                     (rCoeff_Hotspot_k2 * EXPT(rMIITs_Cumulative_MA2s, 2.0)) +
                     (rCoeff_Hotspot_k3 * EXPT(rMIITs_Cumulative_MA2s, 3.0));
rHotSpotEstimatedTemp_K := rHotSpot_T_Calc_K;

(* Interlock checks on thermal limits *)
IF rMIITs_Cumulative_MA2s >= rMAX_PERMISSIBLE_MIITS THEN
    bTrip_MIITsLimit_Latched := TRUE;
END_IF;
IF rHotSpot_T_Calc_K >= rMAX_ALLOWABLE_HOTSPOT_K THEN
    bTrip_HotspotHigh_Latched := TRUE;
END_IF;

(* ============================================================================================= *)
(* SECTION 5: SUPERCONDUCTOR Nb-Ti CRITICAL SURFACE & STABILITY MARGIN                          *)
(* ============================================================================================= *)
(* Lubell parameterization: B_c2(T) = B_c20 * [1 - (T/T_c0)^1.7] *)
IF rT_Bath_Filt_K < rTc0_ZeroField_K THEN
    rCriticalField_Bc2_T := rBc20_ZeroTemp_T * (1.0 - EXPT((rT_Bath_Filt_K / rTc0_ZeroField_K), 1.7));
    IF rCriticalField_Bc2_T < 0.10 THEN rCriticalField_Bc2_T := 0.10; END_IF;
ELSE
    rCriticalField_Bc2_T := 0.10;
END_IF;

(* Current sharing temperature: T_cs(B, I) = T_c0 * (1 - B/B_c20)^0.59 * (1 - I/I_c0) *)
IF (rB_DipoleField_T < rBc20_ZeroTemp_T) AND (rI_Current_Filt_A < rIc0_Nominal_A) THEN
    rCurrentSharingTemp_Tcs_K := rTc0_ZeroField_K * EXPT((1.0 - (rB_DipoleField_T / rBc20_ZeroTemp_T)), 0.59) *
                                 (1.0 - (rI_Current_Filt_A / rIc0_Nominal_A));
    IF rCurrentSharingTemp_Tcs_K < rT_Bath_Filt_K THEN
        rCurrentSharingTemp_Tcs_K := rT_Bath_Filt_K;
    END_IF;
ELSE
    rCurrentSharingTemp_Tcs_K := rT_Bath_Filt_K;
END_IF;

(* Instantaneous coil critical temperature margin *)
rCoilMarginToCritical_K := rCurrentSharingTemp_Tcs_K - rT_Bath_Filt_K;

(* Liquid Helium Boil-Off Rate Estimation: Q_dot / L_v *)
(* L_v of LHe ~ 20.8 kJ/kg ~ 2.6 J/cm^3 *)
rAccumulator := (rHeaterColdMass_Cmd_W + (0.00015 * EXPT(rI_Current_Filt_A, 1.8))) * 2.85; (* L/h equivalent *)
rHeliumBoiloffRate_Lh := rAccumulator;

(* ============================================================================================= *)
(* SECTION 6: THERMO-ACOUSTIC TACONIS OSCILLATION RESONATOR & SPECTRAL DETECTOR                  *)
(* ============================================================================================= *)
(* Feed raw thermal shield temperature into 6.0 Hz 2nd-order resonant bandpass digital filter *)
rTAO_Input_Current := rT_Shield_Voted_K;
rTAO_Filtered_Current := (2.0 * rResonator_r * rResonator_CosTheta * rTAO_Filtered_Prev1) -
                         (EXPT(rResonator_r, 2.0) * rTAO_Filtered_Prev2) +
                         ((1.0 - rResonator_r) * (rTAO_Input_Current - rTAO_Input_Prev2));

(* Update filter delay lines *)
rTAO_Input_Prev2      := rTAO_Input_Prev1;
rTAO_Input_Prev1      := rTAO_Input_Current;
rTAO_Filtered_Prev2   := rTAO_Filtered_Prev1;
rTAO_Filtered_Prev1   := rTAO_Filtered_Current;

(* Peak envelope tracking via leaky peak follower *)
rTempDelta := ABS(rTAO_Filtered_Current);
IF rTempDelta > rTAO_Envelope_Amplitude_K THEN
    rTAO_Envelope_Amplitude_K := (0.35 * rTempDelta) + (0.65 * rTAO_Envelope_Amplitude_K);
ELSE

            matC[iIdx, jIdx] := 0.0;
            matKalmanGain[iIdx, jIdx] := 0.0;
        END_FOR;
        matA[iIdx, iIdx] := 1.0; (* Diagonal identity baseline *)
        matC[iIdx, iIdx] := 1.0; (* Direct state observation *)
        matKalmanGain[iIdx, iIdx] := 0.15; (* Default filter observer baseline *)
    END_FOR;

    (* Ullage pressure integrating dynamics with pneumatic venting leakage *)
    matA[1, 1] := 0.9982;    matA[1, 2] := 0.0985;    matA[1, 5] := -0.000125;
    matA[2, 1] := -0.0150;   matA[2, 2] := 0.8850;    matA[2, 5] := -0.002400;
    (* BAHX cold end temperature response to Nelium refrigerant and mass flow *)
    matA[3, 3] := 0.9450;    matA[3, 5] := 0.00085;   matA[3, 7] := 0.052000;
    (* Ortho-to-para conversion residual decay over catalyst bed *)
    matA[4, 3] := 0.0120;    matA[4, 4] := 0.8200;    matA[4, 5] := 0.000450;
    (* Condensation mass flow dynamic inertia *)
    matA[5, 1] := 1.2500;    matA[5, 3] := -0.4500;   matA[5, 5] := 0.910000;
    (* Nelium high-pressure cycle loop inventory response *)
    matA[6, 6] := 0.9650;    matA[6, 7] := -0.0150;
    (* Expander exhaust cryogenic temperature dynamics *)
    matA[7, 6] := 0.0350;    matA[7, 7] := 0.8950;

    (* Fine-tune Kalman Observer Gain Matrix L (7x7) *)
    matKalmanGain[1, 1] := 0.350;  matKalmanGain[1, 2] := 0.045;
    matKalmanGain[2, 1] := 0.120;  matKalmanGain[2, 2] := 0.420;
    matKalmanGain[3, 3] := 0.280;  matKalmanGain[3, 7] := 0.015;
    matKalmanGain[4, 4] := 0.220;
    matKalmanGain[5, 5] := 0.310;  matKalmanGain[5, 1] := 0.055;
    matKalmanGain[6, 6] := 0.250;
    matKalmanGain[7, 7] := 0.290;  matKalmanGain[7, 6] := 0.018;

    (* Initialize Discrete Input Coupling Matrix B (7x5) *)
    FOR iIdx := 1 TO 7 DO
        FOR jIdx := 1 TO 5 DO
            matB[iIdx, jIdx] := 0.0;
            matD[iIdx, jIdx] := 0.0;
        END_FOR;
    END_FOR;
    (* u[1]=CompSpeed, u[2]=ExpIGV, u[3]=JTValve, u[4]=Bypass, u[5]=GCUSendout *)
    matB[1, 1] := -0.000015; matB[1, 4] := 0.000350;  matB[1, 5] := -0.000850;
    matB[2, 1] := -0.000280; matB[2, 4] := 0.005500;  matB[2, 5] := -0.014200;
    matB[3, 1] := -0.000450; matB[3, 2] := -0.08500;  matB[3, 3] := -0.045000;
    matB[4, 2] := -0.015000; matB[4, 3] := -0.02200;  matB[4, 4] := 0.005000;
    matB[5, 1] := 0.085000;  matB[5, 2] := 1.250000;  matB[5, 4] := -2.150000; matB[5, 5] := -3.500000;
    matB[6, 1] := 0.000950;  matB[6, 2] := -0.04200;
    matB[7, 1] := -0.000120; matB[7, 2] := -0.11500;  matB[7, 3] := 0.008000;

    (* Initialize Disturbance Coupling Matrix E (7x3) *)
    (* d[1]=ShipSloshInertia, d[2]=AtmBaroChange, d[3]=InsulationHeatLeak *)
    FOR iIdx := 1 TO 7 DO
        FOR jIdx := 1 TO 3 DO
            matE_dist[iIdx, jIdx] := 0.0;
        END_FOR;
    END_FOR;
    matE_dist[1, 1] := 0.0180;  matE_dist[1, 2] := -0.0010; matE_dist[1, 3] := 0.00008;
    matE_dist[2, 1] := 0.3500;  matE_dist[2, 2] := -0.0200; matE_dist[2, 3] := 0.00150;
    matE_dist[3, 3] := 0.0250;
    matE_dist[5, 1] := 1.8500;  matE_dist[5, 3] := 0.4200;

    (* Initialize MPC Quadratic Weighting Penalties *)
    vec_Q_diag[1] := 500.0;     (* Heavy penalty on ullage pressure deviation *)
    vec_Q_diag[2] := 80.0;      (* Penalty on pressure rate-of-change (damping) *)
    vec_Q_diag[3] := 150.0;     (* Penalty on BAHX cold-end temperature drift *)
    vec_Q_diag[4] := 250.0;     (* Severe penalty on unconverted ortho-hydrogen *)
    vec_Q_diag[5] := 15.0;      (* Mass flow rate tracking penalty *)
    vec_Q_diag[6] := 10.0;      (* Refrigerant high-pressure loop stability *)
    vec_Q_diag[7] := 45.0;      (* Expander exhaust temperature stability *)

    vec_R_diag[1] := 0.0025;    (* Compressor motor speed change energy penalty *)
    vec_R_diag[2] := 0.8500;    (* Expander IGV mechanical wear suppression *)
    vec_R_diag[3] := 1.2000;    (* Cryogenic JT valve cycle suppression *)
    vec_R_diag[4] := 0.4500;    (* Hot-gas bypass valve hunting suppression *)
    vec_R_diag[5] := 5.0000;    (* High penalty on flaring hydrogen to GCU *)

    (* Actuator Hard Saturation Bounds *)
    vec_u_lower_bound[1] := 15000.0;  vec_u_upper_bound[1] := 36000.0; (* Compressor [rpm] *)
    vec_u_lower_bound[2] := 10.0;     vec_u_upper_bound[2] := 100.0;   (* Expander IGV [%] *)
    vec_u_lower_bound[3] := 0.0;      vec_u_upper_bound[3] := 100.0;   (* JT Valve [%] *)
    vec_u_lower_bound[4] := 0.0;      vec_u_upper_bound[4] := 100.0;   (* Bypass Valve [%] *)
    vec_u_lower_bound[5] := 0.0;      vec_u_upper_bound[5] := 100.0;   (* GCU Sendout [%] *)

    (* Actuator Slew Rate Bounds per 100ms scan *)
    vec_delta_u_max[1] := 250.0; (* Max 2500 rpm/sec *)
    vec_delta_u_max[2] := 2.5;   (* Max 25%/sec *)
    vec_delta_u_max[3] := 1.5;   (* Max 15%/sec *)
    vec_delta_u_max[4] := 10.0;  (* Fast bypass response 100%/sec *)
    vec_delta_u_max[5] := 5.0;   (* GCU valve ramp 50%/sec *)

    (* Initialize Approximate Hessian Diagonal elements: H_ii = sum(B_ji^2 * Q_j) + R_i *)
    FOR jIdx := 1 TO 5 DO
        rTempSum := 0.0;
        FOR iIdx := 1 TO 7 DO
            rTempSum := rTempSum + (matB[iIdx, jIdx] * matB[iIdx, jIdx] * vec_Q_diag[iIdx]);
        END_FOR;
        mat_Hessian_diag[jIdx] := rTempSum + vec_R_diag[jIdx];
    END_FOR;

    (* Initialize BAHX 10-Node Structural Thermal Characteristics *)
    FOR iIdx := 1 TO 10 DO
        (* Temperature profile gradient from 295 K warm end down to 20.28 K cold end *)
        rNodeTemp_NeliumHP[iIdx]     := 300.0 - (INT_TO_REAL(iIdx - 1) * 31.0);
        rNodeTemp_NeliumLP[iIdx]     := 292.0 - (INT_TO_REAL(iIdx - 1) * 31.0);
        rNodeTemp_Hydrogen[iIdx]     := 295.0 - (INT_TO_REAL(iIdx - 1) * 30.5);
        rNodeUA_Rating[iIdx]         := 12.5 + (INT_TO_REAL(iIdx) * 1.8); (* Enhanced cold-end fins *)
        (* Catalyst activity profile: concentrated in lower temperature stages (nodes 6 to 10) *)
        IF iIdx <= 5 THEN
            rCatalystBedActivity[iIdx] := 0.20;
        ELSE
            rCatalystBedActivity[iIdx] := 1.00; (* Full hydrous ferric oxide packing *)
        END_IF;
    END_FOR;
END_IF;

(* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* SECTION 2: 2oo3 TRIPLE MODULAR REDUNDANCY (TMR) SENSING & FAILURE DIAGNOSTICS                       *)
(* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
rPressArray[1] := rCargoTankUllagePress_A;
rPressArray[2] := rCargoTankUllagePress_B;
rPressArray[3] := rCargoTankUllagePress_C;

rTempArray[1] := rBOG_SuctionTemp_A;
rTempArray[2] := rBOG_SuctionTemp_B;
rTempArray[3] := rBOG_SuctionTemp_C;

(* Update Sensor History Ring Buffer for Frozen Sensor Detection *)
iHistoryIndex := (iHistoryIndex MOD 5) + 1;
FOR iIdx := 1 TO 3 DO
    rPressHistoryRing[iIdx, iHistoryIndex] := rPressArray[iIdx];
    rTempHistoryRing[iIdx, iHistoryIndex]  := rTempArray[iIdx];
END_FOR;

(* Channel Sanity Checks: Out of Range [0.8 to 2.5 bar], Freeze, and Slew-Rate Verification *)
FOR iIdx := 1 TO 3 DO
    (* Out of range physical checks *)
    IF (rPressArray[iIdx] < 0.800) OR (rPressArray[iIdx] > 2.500) THEN
        bPressChanFault[iIdx] := TRUE;
    END_IF;

    (* Sensor Freeze Detection: exactly zero variation over 5 scans while vessel is moving *)
    IF (rPressHistoryRing[iIdx, 1] = rPressHistoryRing[iIdx, 2]) AND
       (rPressHistoryRing[iIdx, 2] = rPressHistoryRing[iIdx, 3]) AND
       (rPressHistoryRing[iIdx, 3] = rPressHistoryRing[iIdx, 4]) AND
       (rPressHistoryRing[iIdx, 4] = rPressHistoryRing[iIdx, 5]) AND
       ((ABS(rShipRollAngle_deg) > 0.4) OR (ABS(rShipPitchAngle_deg) > 0.2)) THEN
        (* Cargo is actively sloshing, ullage MUST vary dynamically. Constant value indicates stuck ADC *)
        bPressChanFault[iIdx] := TRUE;
    END_IF;

    (* Temperature range checks [15K to 320K] *)
    IF (rTempArray[iIdx] < 15.0) OR (rTempArray[iIdx] > 320.0) THEN
        bTempChanFault[iIdx] := TRUE;
    END_IF;
END_FOR;

(* Inter-Channel Deviation Checks (Discrepancy Drift Detection > 0.040 bar for > 2.5 seconds) *)
IF NOT bPressChanFault[1] AND NOT bPressChanFault[2] THEN
    IF ABS(rPressArray[1] - rPressArray[2]) > 0.040 THEN
        rPressDiscrepancyTimer_s[1] := rPressDiscrepancyTimer_s[1] + rCONST_SAMPLE_TIME_S;
    ELSE
        rPressDiscrepancyTimer_s[1] := MAX(0.0, rPressDiscrepancyTimer_s[1] - rCONST_SAMPLE_TIME_S);
    END_IF;
END_IF;

IF NOT bPressChanFault[2] AND NOT bPressChanFault[3] THEN
    IF ABS(rPressArray[2] - rPressArray[3]) > 0.040 THEN
        rPressDiscrepancyTimer_s[2] := rPressDiscrepancyTimer_s[2] + rCONST_SAMPLE_TIME_S;
    ELSE
        rPressDiscrepancyTimer_s[2] := MAX(0.0, rPressDiscrepancyTimer_s[2] - rCONST_SAMPLE_TIME_S);
    END_IF;
END_IF;

IF NOT bPressChanFault[3] AND NOT bPressChanFault[1] THEN
    IF ABS(rPressArray[3] - rPressArray[1]) > 0.040 THEN
        rPressDiscrepancyTimer_s[3] := rPressDiscrepancyTimer_s[3] + rCONST_SAMPLE_TIME_S;
    ELSE
        rPressDiscrepancyTimer_s[3] := MAX(0.0, rPressDiscrepancyTimer_s[3] - rCONST_SAMPLE_TIME_S);
    END_IF;
END_IF;

(* Isolate Drifting Channels exceeding 2.5s persistence *)
FOR iIdx := 1 TO 3 DO
    IF rPressDiscrepancyTimer_s[iIdx] > 2.50 THEN
        bPressChanFault[iIdx] := TRUE; (* Flag isolated channel *)
    END_IF;
END_FOR;

(* Count Healthy Channels *)
iHealthyPressChans := 0;
FOR iIdx := 1 TO 3 DO
    IF NOT bPressChanFault[iIdx] THEN
        iHealthyPressChans := iHealthyPressChans + 1;
    END_IF;
END_FOR;

iHealthyTempChans := 0;
FOR iIdx := 1 TO 3 DO
    IF NOT bTempChanFault[iIdx] THEN
        iHealthyTempChans := iHealthyTempChans + 1;
    END_IF;
END_FOR;

(* Voting Logic with Graceful Degradation: 2oo3 -> 1oo2 -> 1oo1 -> Fail-Safe Trip *)
IF iHealthyPressChans = 3 THEN
    (* Full 2oo3 Median Selection: copy to buffer and sort *)
    rSortBuffer[1] := rPressArray[1];
    rSortBuffer[2] := rPressArray[2];
    rSortBuffer[3] := rPressArray[3];
    (* 3-element bubble sort *)
    IF rSortBuffer[1] > rSortBuffer[2] THEN
        rTempSwap := rSortBuffer[1]; rSortBuffer[1] := rSortBuffer[2]; rSortBuffer[2] := rTempSwap;
    END_IF;
    IF rSortBuffer[2] > rSortBuffer[3] THEN
        rTempSwap := rSortBuffer[2]; rSortBuffer[2] := rSortBuffer[3]; rSortBuffer[3] := rTempSwap;
    END_IF;
    IF rSortBuffer[1] > rSortBuffer[2] THEN
        rTempSwap := rSortBuffer[1]; rSortBuffer[1] := rSortBuffer[2]; rSortBuffer[2] := rTempSwap;
    END_IF;
    rVotedUllagePressure_bar := rSortBuffer[2]; (* True median *)
    bDegradedSensorMode := FALSE;
ELSIF iHealthyPressChans = 2 THEN
    (* Degraded 1oo2 Voting: Select Maximum for Overpressure Protection Conservatism *)
    rTempMaxPress := -999.0;
    FOR iIdx := 1 TO 3 DO
        IF NOT bPressChanFault[iIdx] THEN
            IF rPressArray[iIdx] > rTempMaxPress THEN
                rTempMaxPress := rPressArray[iIdx];
            END_IF;
        END_IF;
    END_FOR;
    rVotedUllagePressure_bar := rTempMaxPress;
    bDegradedSensorMode := TRUE;
ELSIF iHealthyPressChans = 1 THEN
    (* Severely Degraded 1oo1 Operation: Direct single channel with advisory *)
    FOR iIdx := 1 TO 3 DO
        IF NOT bPressChanFault[iIdx] THEN
            rVotedUllagePressure_bar := rPressArray[iIdx];
        END_IF;
    END_FOR;
    bDegradedSensorMode := TRUE;
ELSE
    (* Total Sensor Loss (0 healthy channels): Force safe default and initiate ESD trip *)
    rVotedUllagePressure_bar := 1.300; (* Force conservative high pressure reading *)
    bDegradedSensorMode := TRUE;
END_IF;

(* Temperature Sensor Voting (Median or Valid Average) *)
IF iHealthyTempChans >= 2 THEN
    rTempSum := 0.0;
    FOR iIdx := 1 TO 3 DO
        IF NOT bTempChanFault[iIdx] THEN
            rTempSum := rTempSum + rTempArray[iIdx];
        END_IF;
    END_FOR;
    rVotedBOG_Temp_K := rTempSum / INT_TO_REAL(iHealthyTempChans);
ELSIF iHealthyTempChans = 1 THEN
    FOR iIdx := 1 TO 3 DO
        IF NOT bTempChanFault[iIdx] THEN
            rVotedBOG_Temp_K := rTempArray[iIdx];
        END_IF;
    END_FOR;
ELSE
    rVotedBOG_Temp_K := 25.0; (* Default cryogenic vapor temperature *)
END_IF;

(* Filtered Pressure Derivative dP/dt [bar/s] *)
rRawPressDerivative := (rVotedUllagePressure_bar - rPrevVotedPress_bar) / rCONST_SAMPLE_TIME_S;
rUllagePressureRate_bar_s := (0.85 * rUllagePressureRate_bar_s) + (0.15 * rRawPressDerivative);
rPrevVotedPress_bar := rVotedUllagePressure_bar;

(* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* SECTION 3: MARINE SLOSHING INERTIAL WAVE NOTCH FILTER & ULLAGE FLOAT ESTIMATOR                      *)
(* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* In 160,000 m3 membrane / prismatic tanks, vessel roll and pitch excite standing wave sloshing       *)
(* with primary resonance at ~0.12 Hz (omega_0 = 0.754 rad/s). The resulting hydrostatic dynamic wave  *)
(* pressure oscillates at the dome transmitters, falsely tricking pressure controllers.                *)
(* We implement an active 2nd-order notch filter to strip hydraulic slosh and reveal pure gas ullage. *)

rFilterRollInput := rShipRollAngle_deg * 0.0174533;   (* Convert to radians *)
rFilterPitchInput := rShipPitchAngle_deg * 0.0174533;

(* Discrete Direct-Form II Notch Filter at 0.12 Hz with damping zeta=0.15 *)
(* b0 = 0.952, b1 = -1.890, b2 = 0.952, a1 = -1.890, a2 = 0.904 *)
rFilterRoll_x1 := (0.952 * rFilterRollInput) - (-1.890 * rFilterRoll_x1) - (0.904 * rFilterRoll_x2);
rFilterRoll_x2 := rFilterRoll_x1;

rFilterPitch_x1 := (0.952 * rFilterPitchInput) - (-1.890 * rFilterPitch_x1) - (0.904 * rFilterPitch_x2);
rFilterPitch_x2 := rFilterPitch_x1;

(* Calculate Dynamic Hydrostatic Wave Head: rho_LH2 = 70.85 kg/m3, tank semi-width = 18.5 m *)
rSloshPressureHeadCorrection := (rCONST_LH2_DENSITY_KG_M3 * (9.81 + rShipHeaveAcc_m_s2) *
    (rCONST_TANK_SEMI_WIDTH_M * SIN(rFilterRoll_x1) + (rCONST_TANK_LENGTH_M * 0.5) * SIN(rFilterPitch_x1))) / 100000.0; (* bar *)
rCompensatedUllagePress_bar := rVotedUllagePressure_bar - (0.35 * rSloshPressureHeadCorrection);

(* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* SECTION 4: MULTI-STREAM BAHX 10-NODE THERMAL INTEGRATION & ORTHO-PARA KINETICS                      *)
(* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* Ortho-to-Para Conversion Thermodynamics:                                                             *)
(* Boltzmann Rotational Partition Function approximation for Para fraction at temperature T:           *)
(* x_p_eq(T) = 1.0 / (1.0 + 3.0 * EXP(-175.0 / T) + 7.0 * EXP(-1050.0 / T))                            *)
(* Heat of conversion: 527.1 kJ/kg released continuously into refrigerant cooling stream               *)

rPinchSearchMin := 999.0;
rTotalColdDuty_kW := 0.0;
FOR iIdx := 1 TO 10 DO
    (* Calculate Local Hydrogen Temperature Profile along the 10 nodes *)
    IF iIdx = 1 THEN
        rNodeTemp_Hydrogen[1] := rBAHX_WarmEndTemp_K;
        rNodeParaFraction[1] := rOrthoParaInletRatio_Pct;
        rNodeEnthalpy_Hydrogen[1] := (rCONST_H2_CP_GAS_KJ_KG_K * (rBAHX_WarmEndTemp_K - 20.28)) + rCONST_H2_LATENT_HEAT_KJ_KG;
    ELSE
        (* Progressive cooling step *)
        rNodeTemp_Hydrogen[iIdx] := rNodeTemp_Hydrogen[iIdx - 1] - ((rNodeTemp_Hydrogen[1] - rBAHX_ColdEndTemp_K) / 9.0);
    END_IF;

    (* Evaluate Theoretical Equilibrium Para-Hydrogen Fraction at local node temperature *)
    IF rNodeTemp_Hydrogen[iIdx] > 100.0 THEN
        rParaEquilibrium := 25.0 + (50.0 * (100.0 / rNodeTemp_Hydrogen[iIdx]));
    ELSIF rNodeTemp_Hydrogen[iIdx] > 30.0 THEN
        rParaEquilibrium := 75.0 + (24.0 * ((100.0 - rNodeTemp_Hydrogen[iIdx]) / 70.0));
    ELSE
        (* Cryogenic plateau nearing 20.28 K *)
        rParaEquilibrium := rCONST_PARA_EQUILIBRIUM_20K - (0.015 * (rNodeTemp_Hydrogen[iIdx] - 20.28));
    END_IF;
    rParaEquilibrium := MIN(100.0, MAX(25.0, rParaEquilibrium));

    (* Catalytic Reaction Kinetics: d(x_p)/dt = k_cat * (x_p_eq - x_p)^1.8 *)
    rReactionDrivingForce := MAX(0.0, rParaEquilibrium - rNodeParaFraction[iIdx]);
    rConversionRate := 0.185 * rCatalystBedActivity[iIdx] * EXPT(rReactionDrivingForce, 1.8);

    (* Update Para Fraction at Next Node *)
    IF iIdx < 10 THEN
        rNodeParaFraction[iIdx + 1] := MIN(rParaEquilibrium, rNodeParaFraction[iIdx] + (rConversionRate * 0.05));
    END_IF;

    (* Calculate Exothermic Heat Generation in Node [kW] *)
    rExothermicHeat_kW := (rBOG_MassFlow_kg_h / 3600.0) * (rConversionRate / 100.0) * rCONST_OP_CONV_HEAT_KJ_KG;

    (* Counter-Current Nelium Refrigerant Temperatures *)
    rNodeTemp_NeliumHP[iIdx] := rNodeTemp_Hydrogen[iIdx] - 4.5 - (INT_TO_REAL(iIdx) * 0.25);
    rNodeTemp_NeliumLP[iIdx] := rNodeTemp_NeliumHP[iIdx] - 2.8;

    (* Local Temperature Approach / Pinch Delta T between hot hydrogen and cold Nelium *)
    rNodeDeltaT_Pinch[iIdx] := rNodeTemp_Hydrogen[iIdx] - rNodeTemp_NeliumLP[iIdx];
    IF rNodeDeltaT_Pinch[iIdx] < rPinchSearchMin THEN
        rPinchSearchMin := rNodeDeltaT_Pinch[iIdx];
    END_IF;

    (* Compute local nodal heat flux exchanged [kW] *)
    rNodeHeatExchanged_kW[iIdx] := rNodeUA_Rating[iIdx] * rNodeDeltaT_Pinch[iIdx];
    rTotalColdDuty_kW := rTotalColdDuty_kW + rNodeHeatExchanged_kW[iIdx];
END_FOR;
rBAHX_MinimumPinchObserved_K := rPinchSearchMin;
rCalculatedOrthoParaPurity_Pct := rNodeParaFraction[10];

(* Total Cryogenic Refrigeration Load: Sensible Cool (300K->20K) + Latent Heat (445.8 kJ/kg) + Ortho-Para Conversion (527 kJ/kg) *)
rTotalCoolingDemand_kW := (rBOG_MassFlow_kg_h / 3600.0) * (
    (rCONST_H2_CP_GAS_KJ_KG_K * MAX(0.0, rBAHX_WarmEndTemp_K - 20.28)) +
    rCONST_H2_LATENT_HEAT_KJ_KG +
    (((rCalculatedOrthoParaPurity_Pct - rOrthoParaInletRatio_Pct) / 100.0) * rCONST_OP_CONV_HEAT_KJ_KG)
);

(* Actual Brayton Refrigeration Capacity from Turbo-Expander *)
rBraytonRefrigCapacity_kW := (rRefrigCompPower_kW * 0.72) * (MAX(10.0, rExpanderInletTemp_K - rExpanderExhaustTemp_K) / 280.0);
IF rRefrigCompPower_kW > 1.0 THEN
    rCryogenicEfficiency_COP := rBraytonRefrigCapacity_kW / rRefrigCompPower_kW;
ELSE
    rCryogenicEfficiency_COP := 0.0;
END_IF;

(* Condensation Yield Rate *)
IF rTotalCoolingDemand_kW > 0.0 THEN
    rBOG_ReliquefiedRate_kg_h := rBOG_MassFlow_kg_h * MIN(1.0, rBraytonRefrigCapacity_kW / rTotalCoolingDemand_kW);
ELSE
    rBOG_ReliquefiedRate_kg_h := 0.0;
END_IF;

(* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* SECTION 5: DISCRETE KALMAN OBSERVER STATE ESTIMATION                                                 *)
(* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* Assemble Measurement Vector y_meas *)
vec_y_meas[1] := rCompensatedUllagePress_bar - rTargetUllagePress_bar;
vec_y_meas[2] := rUllagePressureRate_bar_s;
vec_y_meas[3] := rBAHX_ColdEndTemp_K - 20.28;
vec_y_meas[4] := rCONST_PARA_EQUILIBRIUM_20K - rCalculatedOrthoParaPurity_Pct;
vec_y_meas[5] := rBOG_MassFlow_kg_h - rBOG_ReliquefiedRate_kg_h;
vec_y_meas[6] := rRefrigCycleHighPress_bar - 18.50;
vec_y_meas[7] := rExpanderExhaustTemp_K - 16.50;

(* Observer Innovation: y_meas - C*x_hat *)
FOR iIdx := 1 TO 7 DO
    rTempSum := 0.0;
    FOR jIdx := 1 TO 7 DO
        rTempSum := rTempSum + (matC[iIdx, jIdx] * vec_x_hat[jIdx]);
    END_FOR;
    vec_x_innov[iIdx] := vec_y_meas[iIdx] - rTempSum;
END_FOR;

(* State Correction: x_corrected = x_hat + L * innovation *)
FOR iIdx := 1 TO 7 DO
    rTempSum := 0.0;
    FOR jIdx := 1 TO 7 DO
        rTempSum := rTempSum + (matKalmanGain[iIdx, jIdx] * vec_x_innov[jIdx]);
    END_FOR;
    vec_x[iIdx] := vec_x_hat[iIdx] + rTempSum;
END_FOR;

(* External Disturbance Estimation *)
vec_dist[1] := rFilterRoll_x1 + rFilterPitch_x1;                  (* Hydrodynamic slosh surge *)
vec_dist[2] := rAtmosphericPressure_kPa - 101.325;                 (* Barometric offset *)
vec_dist[3] := (rTotalLiquidVolume_m3 * 0.0015 * rCONST_LH2_DENSITY_KG_M3 * rCONST_H2_LATENT_HEAT_KJ_KG) / 86400.0; (* Heat leak kW *)

(* One-Step Ahead Observer Time Update: x_hat(k+1) = A*x(k) + B*u(k) + E*dist(k) *)
FOR iIdx := 1 TO 7 DO
    rTempSum := 0.0;
    FOR jIdx := 1 TO 7 DO
        rTempSum := rTempSum + (matA[iIdx, jIdx] * vec_x[jIdx]);
    END_FOR;
    FOR jIdx := 1 TO 5 DO
        rTempSum := rTempSum + (matB[iIdx, jIdx] * vec_u[jIdx]);
    END_FOR;
    FOR jIdx := 1 TO 3 DO
        rTempSum := rTempSum + (matE_dist[iIdx, jIdx] * vec_dist[jIdx]);
    END_FOR;
    vec_x_hat[iIdx] := rTempSum;
END_FOR;

(* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)

END_VAR

VAR_OUTPUT
    bSystemReady            : BOOL;     (* ATL consolidation cell healthy and ready for active trajectory *)
    bLaserPermissive        : BOOL;     (* SIL-3 laser safety shutter open and emission permit interlock *)
    bCompactionEngaged      : BOOL;     (* Compaction shoe extended and exerting validated consolidation force *)
    bTapeFeedPermit         : BOOL;     (* Spool feed and backing film take-up synchronous permit *)
    wStatusWord             : WORD;     (* Subsystem operational status and mode flags [16-bit bitfield] *)
    dwDiagnosticAlarms      : DWORD;    (* Diagnostic alarms, sensor health, and trip flags [32-bit bitfield] *)
    rLaserPowerCmd_kW       : REAL;     (* Closed-loop direct-diode laser optical power setpoint command [kW] *)
    rCompactionForceCmd_N   : REAL;     (* Closed-loop electro-pneumatic/servo shoe normal force command [N] *)
    rCompactionPressure_bar : REAL;     (* Calculated instantaneous consolidation contact pressure [bar] *)
    rVotedFlashTemp_DegC    : REAL;     (* 2oo3 TMR consolidated flash zone nip-point temperature [deg C] *)
    rVotedNormalForce_N     : REAL;     (* 2oo3 TMR consolidated compaction shoe normal force [N] *)
    rIntimateContactRatio   : REAL;     (* Instantaneous Lee-Springer degree of intimate contact D_ic [0.0-1.0] *)
    rResinViscosity_Pa_s    : REAL;     (* Real-time Arrhenius dynamic resin matrix melt viscosity [Pa*s] *)
    rThermalGradient_C_mm   : REAL;     (* Calculated through-thickness thermal gradient [deg C / mm] *)
    bDegradedModeActive     : BOOL;     (* Operational under TMR single-channel degraded fallback mode *)
END_VAR

VAR
    (* --- 2oo3 TRIPLE MODULAR REDUNDANCY (TMR): PYROMETRY --- *)
    bPyro1_Healthy          : BOOL;     (* Channel 1 optical sensor plausibility flag *)
    bPyro2_Healthy          : BOOL;     (* Channel 2 optical sensor plausibility flag *)
    bPyro3_Healthy          : BOOL;     (* Channel 3 optical sensor plausibility flag *)
    iPyroHealthyCount       : INT;      (* Total healthy optical pyrometer sensors *)
    rPyroDiff_12            : REAL;     (* Discrepancy between Pyrometer 1 and 2 [deg C] *)
    rPyroDiff_23            : REAL;     (* Discrepancy between Pyrometer 2 and 3 [deg C] *)
    rPyroDiff_31            : REAL;     (* Discrepancy between Pyrometer 3 and 1 [deg C] *)
    bPyro_TMR_Degraded      : BOOL;     (* Single pyrometer failure flag *)

    (* --- 2oo3 TRIPLE MODULAR REDUNDANCY (TMR): LOAD CELLS --- *)
    bLoad1_Healthy          : BOOL;     (* Load cell 1 transducer plausibility flag *)
    bLoad2_Healthy          : BOOL;     (* Load cell 2 transducer plausibility flag *)
    bLoad3_Healthy          : BOOL;     (* Load cell 3 transducer plausibility flag *)
    iLoadHealthyCount       : INT;      (* Total healthy normal force transducers *)
    rLoadDiff_12            : REAL;     (* Discrepancy between Load Cell 1 and 2 [N] *)
    rLoadDiff_23            : REAL;     (* Discrepancy between Load Cell 2 and 3 [N] *)
    rLoadDiff_31            : REAL;     (* Discrepancy between Load Cell 3 and 1 [N] *)
    bLoad_TMR_Degraded      : BOOL;     (* Single load cell failure flag *)

    (* --- THERMAL PROCESS TARGETS & BOUNDS (THERMOPLASTIC PEEK / AS4) --- *)
    rTemp_GlassTrans_DegC   : REAL := 143.0;    (* PEEK glass transition temperature T_g [deg C] *)
    rTemp_Melting_DegC      : REAL := 343.0;    (* PEEK thermodynamic crystal melting point T_m [deg C] *)
    rTemp_TargetFlash_DegC  : REAL := 395.0;    (* Optimum consolidation nip-point flash setpoint [deg C] *)
    rTemp_MaxSafeFlash_DegC : REAL := 430.0;    (* Upper thermal degradation / outgassing trip threshold [deg C] *)
    rTemp_MinConsol_DegC    : REAL := 365.0;    (* Lower limit for complete void collapse & healing [deg C] *)
    rLaserSpotWidth_mm      : REAL := 50.0;     (* Nominal tape width / laser beam footprint width [mm] *)
    rLaserSpotLength_mm     : REAL := 18.0;     (* Instantaneous irradiated beam focal zone length [mm] *)
    rLaserOpticEfficiency   : REAL := 0.88;     (* Optical train transmissive & absorptive efficiency *)

    (* --- COMPACTION NORMAL FORCE TARGETS & SQUEEZE-FLOW --- *)
    rForce_TargetNominal_N  : REAL := 850.0;    (* Target baseline compaction shoe normal force [N] *)
    rForce_MinConsol_N      : REAL := 400.0;    (* Minimum contact force to prevent de-ply delamination [N] *)
    rForce_MaxSafe_N        : REAL := 1600.0;   (* Maximum structural shoe force to prevent fiber wash [N] *)
    rShoeContactArea_mm2    : REAL := 1250.0;   (* Effective contact area of articulated shoe segment [mm2] *)
    rTapeThicknessNom_mm    : REAL := 0.145;    (* Nominal single-ply consolidated tape thickness [mm] *)

    (* --- DISCRETE STATE-SPACE MATRIX REPRESENTATION (4x4 THERMAL DIFFUSION) --- *)
    (* State Vector x_th = [T_nip (flash), T_surface, T_interply, T_shoe]^T in [deg C] *)
    (* Input Vector u_th = [P_laser (kW), v_gantry (m/s)]^T *)
    a_thermal               : ARRAY [1..4, 1..4] OF REAL; (* Discrete state transition matrix A_th *)
    b_thermal               : ARRAY [1..4, 1..2] OF REAL; (* Discrete input coupling matrix B_th *)
    x_thermal_est           : ARRAY [1..4] OF REAL;       (* Kalman/Luenberger state estimates *)
    x_thermal_pred          : ARRAY [1..4] OF REAL;       (* Receding horizon 1-step prediction *)
    l_observer_gain         : ARRAY [1..4] OF REAL;       (* State observer innovation feedback gains *)

    (* --- DISCRETE STATE-SPACE MATRIX (2x2 SHOE ELASTODYNAMICS) --- *)
    (* State Vector x_shoe = [z_shoe (deflection mm), v_shoe (velocity mm/s)]^T *)
    a_shoe                  : ARRAY [1..2, 1..2] OF REAL; (* Shoe structural stiffness/damping matrix *)
    b_shoe                  : ARRAY [1..2] OF REAL;       (* Shoe actuator electro-pneumatic force matrix *)
    x_shoe_est              : ARRAY [1..2] OF REAL;       (* Estimated shoe structural state *)

    (* --- ARRHENIUS RHEOLOGY & LEE-SPRINGER CONSOLIDATION KINETICS --- *)
    rVisc_Prefactor_A       : REAL := 0.082;    (* Arrhenius pre-exponential viscosity coefficient [Pa*s] *)
    rActivationEnergy_R     : REAL := 4250.0;   (* Ratio of activation energy to universal gas constant [K] *)
    rIntimateContactIntegral: REAL := 0.0;      (* Numerical time integral of (P / mu) for void collapse *)
    rMaxIntimateContactTime : REAL := 0.045;    (* Dwell time under compaction shoe at current velocity [s] *)

    (* --- MODEL PREDICTIVE CONTROLLER (MPC) ACCUMULATORS & GAINS --- *)
    rMPC_Temp_Gain_P        : REAL := 0.0385;   (* Proportional laser thermal gain [kW / deg C] *)
    rMPC_Temp_Gain_I        : REAL := 0.0120;   (* Predictive thermal disturbance integral gain [kW / (deg C * s)] *)
    rMPC_Temp_Gain_D        : REAL := 0.0042;   (* Rate of flash zone heating predictive damping [kW / (deg C / s)] *)
    rMPC_Feedforward_Speed  : REAL := 7.6500;   (* Specific enthalpy feedforward gain [kW / (m/s)] *)
    rMPC_Feedforward_Accel  : REAL := 0.8500;   (* Acceleration thermal inertia feedforward gain [kW / (m/s2)] *)
    rTempErrorIntegral      : REAL := 0.0;      (* Anti-windup bounded temperature error accumulator *)
    rPrevVotedTemp          : REAL := 0.0;      (* Prior scan temperature for numeric derivative *)

    rMPC_Force_Gain_P       : REAL := 1.8500;   (* Proportional force stiffness regulation gain [N / N] *)
    rMPC_Force_Gain_I       : REAL := 0.4200;   (* Steady-state shoe pressure integral gain [N / (N * s)] *)
    rMPC_Force_Gain_D       : REAL := 0.0850;   (* Viscous squeeze-flow damping gain [N / (N / s)] *)
    rCurvatureComp_Gain     : REAL := 125.0;    (* Tooling convex/concave curvature force correction [N * mm] *)
    rForceErrorIntegral     : REAL := 0.0;      (* Anti-windup bounded force error accumulator *)
    rPrevVotedForce         : REAL := 0.0;      (* Prior scan force for derivative computation *)

    (* --- MULTI-STAGE FINITE STATE MACHINE SEQUENCING --- *)
    iSequencerState         : INT := 0;         (* Active operational state index *)
    iPreviousState          : INT := -1;        (* State transition memory register *)
    tStateDwellTimer        : TON;              (* Dwell timer within current machine state *)
    tInertingTimer          : TON;              (* Nitrogen inerting gas purge duration timer *)
    tTouchdownTimer         : TON;              (* Compaction shoe landing force stabilization timer *)
    bColdBootInitialized    : BOOL := FALSE;    (* Cold boot dynamic matrix allocation flag *)

    (* --- WORKING VARIABLES & NUMERIC ACCUMULATORS --- *)
    rDt                     : REAL;             (* Sanitized task execution scan interval [s] *)
    iRow                    : INT;              (* Matrix row iterator *)
    iCol                    : INT;              (* Matrix column iterator *)
    rMatrixSum              : REAL;             (* Matrix multiplication inner accumulator *)
    rTempObsError           : REAL;             (* Observer residual flash temperature error [deg C] *)
    rTempError              : REAL;             (* Error between setpoint and voted flash temp [deg C] *)
    rTempDerivative         : REAL;             (* Rate of change of flash zone temperature [deg C / s] *)
    rForceError             : REAL;             (* Error between setpoint and voted shoe force [N] *)
    rForceDerivative        : REAL;             (* Rate of change of shoe normal force [N / s] *)
    rAbsCurvature           : REAL;             (* Sanitized absolute radius of surface curvature [mm] *)
    rCurvatureOffset_N      : REAL;             (* Dynamic force offset for surface curvature [N] *)
    rLaserPowerUnsat_kW     : REAL;             (* Raw unconstrained laser power command [kW] *)
    rForceUnsat_N           : REAL;             (* Raw unconstrained shoe force command [N] *)
END_VAR

(* === STEP 0: COLD BOOT MATRIX INITIALIZATION & DISCRETIZATION === *)
IF NOT bColdBootInitialized THEN
    (* 4x4 Thermal State-Space Matrix Discretization (Euler-Tustin Taylor expansion, Ts = 0.001 s)
       Coupled state diffusion: [T_nip, T_surf, T_interply, T_shoe] *)
    a_thermal[1, 1] := 0.9850; a_thermal[1, 2] := 0.0125; a_thermal[1, 3] := 0.0000; a_thermal[1, 4] := 0.0015;
    a_thermal[2, 1] := 0.0180; a_thermal[2, 2] := 0.9760; a_thermal[2, 3] := 0.0050; a_thermal[2, 4] := 0.0000;
    a_thermal[3, 1] := 0.0000; a_thermal[3, 2] := 0.0085; a_thermal[3, 3] := 0.9905; a_thermal[3, 4] := 0.0000;
    a_thermal[4, 1] := 0.0020; a_thermal[4, 2] := 0.0000; a_thermal[4, 3] := 0.0000; a_thermal[4, 4] := 0.9960;

    b_thermal[1, 1] := 0.4500; b_thermal[1, 2] := -18.500;
    b_thermal[2, 1] := 0.1200; b_thermal[2, 2] := -8.2000;
    b_thermal[3, 1] := 0.0150; b_thermal[3, 2] := -2.1000;
    b_thermal[4, 1] := 0.0050; b_thermal[4, 2] := 0.05000;

    (* Luenberger observer innovation feedback vector *)
    l_observer_gain[1] := 0.1450;
    l_observer_gain[2] := 0.0650;
    l_observer_gain[3] := 0.0120;
    l_observer_gain[4] := 0.0025;

    (* 2x2 Shoe Mechanical Compliance Matrix: [Deflection, Velocity] *)
    a_shoe[1, 1] := 0.9995; a_shoe[1, 2] := 0.00098;
    a_shoe[2, 1] := -1.4500; a_shoe[2, 2] := 0.97500;
    b_shoe[1]    := 0.000045;
    b_shoe[2]    := 0.088000;

    (* Initialize state vector with baseline ambient preheat *)
    x_thermal_est[1] := rSubstratePreheat_Temp;
    x_thermal_est[2] := rSubstratePreheat_Temp;
    x_thermal_est[3] := rSubstratePreheat_Temp;
    x_thermal_est[4] := rCoolingWaterTemp_In;

    x_shoe_est[1] := 0.0;
    x_shoe_est[2] := 0.0;

    bColdBootInitialized := TRUE;
END_IF;

(* === STEP 1: REAL-TIME SCAN INTERVAL SANITIZATION === *)
IF rCycleTime_Sec <= 0.00001 OR rCycleTime_Sec > 0.050 THEN
    rDt := 0.001; (* Enforce 1 millisecond deterministic baseline scan *)
ELSE
    rDt := rCycleTime_Sec;
END_IF;

(* === STEP 2: 2oo3 TRIPLE MODULAR REDUNDANCY (TMR) - PYROMETER VOTING === *)
(* Optical Channel Plausibility Boundary Checks (0 to 600 deg C) *)
bPyro1_Healthy := (rLaserTemp_Pyrometer1 >= 15.0) AND (rLaserTemp_Pyrometer1 <= 550.0);
bPyro2_Healthy := (rLaserTemp_Pyrometer2 >= 15.0) AND (rLaserTemp_Pyrometer2 <= 550.0);
bPyro3_Healthy := (rLaserTemp_Pyrometer3 >= 15.0) AND (rLaserTemp_Pyrometer3 <= 550.0);

(* Inter-Channel Discrepancy Cross-Validation (Discrepancy Limit = 22.0 deg C) *)
rPyroDiff_12 := ABS(rLaserTemp_Pyrometer1 - rLaserTemp_Pyrometer2);
rPyroDiff_23 := ABS(rLaserTemp_Pyrometer2 - rLaserTemp_Pyrometer3);
rPyroDiff_31 := ABS(rLaserTemp_Pyrometer3 - rLaserTemp_Pyrometer1);

IF (rPyroDiff_12 > 22.0) AND (rPyroDiff_31 > 22.0) AND bPyro1_Healthy THEN
    bPyro1_Healthy := FALSE; (* Pyrometer 1 has diverged from optical consensus *)
END_IF;
IF (rPyroDiff_12 > 22.0) AND (rPyroDiff_23 > 22.0) AND bPyro2_Healthy THEN
    bPyro2_Healthy := FALSE; (* Pyrometer 2 has diverged from optical consensus *)
END_IF;
IF (rPyroDiff_23 > 22.0) AND (rPyroDiff_31 > 22.0) AND bPyro3_Healthy THEN
    bPyro3_Healthy := FALSE; (* Pyrometer 3 has diverged from optical consensus *)
END_IF;

(* Evaluate healthy channel count *)
iPyroHealthyCount := 0;
IF bPyro1_Healthy THEN iPyroHealthyCount := iPyroHealthyCount + 1; END_IF;
IF bPyro2_Healthy THEN iPyroHealthyCount := iPyroHealthyCount + 1; END_IF;
IF bPyro3_Healthy THEN iPyroHealthyCount := iPyroHealthyCount + 1; END_IF;

(* 2oo3 Median Voter & Graceful Degradation Engine *)
IF iPyroHealthyCount = 3 THEN
    bPyro_TMR_Degraded := FALSE;
    (* Complete 3-Channel Consensus Median Selection *)
    IF (rLaserTemp_Pyrometer1 >= rLaserTemp_Pyrometer2 AND rLaserTemp_Pyrometer1 <= rLaserTemp_Pyrometer3) OR
       (rLaserTemp_Pyrometer1 <= rLaserTemp_Pyrometer2 AND rLaserTemp_Pyrometer1 >= rLaserTemp_Pyrometer3) THEN
        rVotedFlashTemp_DegC := rLaserTemp_Pyrometer1;
    ELSIF (rLaserTemp_Pyrometer2 >= rLaserTemp_Pyrometer1 AND rLaserTemp_Pyrometer2 <= rLaserTemp_Pyrometer3) OR
          (rLaserTemp_Pyrometer2 <= rLaserTemp_Pyrometer1 AND rLaserTemp_Pyrometer2 >= rLaserTemp_Pyrometer3) THEN
        rVotedFlashTemp_DegC := rLaserTemp_Pyrometer2;
    ELSE
        rVotedFlashTemp_DegC := rLaserTemp_Pyrometer3;
    END_IF;
ELSIF iPyroHealthyCount = 2 THEN
    bPyro_TMR_Degraded := TRUE; (* Fallback to 1oo2 Mean Average Mode *)
    IF bPyro1_Healthy AND bPyro2_Healthy THEN
        rVotedFlashTemp_DegC := (rLaserTemp_Pyrometer1 + rLaserTemp_Pyrometer2) * 0.5;
    ELSIF bPyro2_Healthy AND bPyro3_Healthy THEN
        rVotedFlashTemp_DegC := (rLaserTemp_Pyrometer2 + rLaserTemp_Pyrometer3) * 0.5;
    ELSE
        rVotedFlashTemp_DegC := (rLaserTemp_Pyrometer1 + rLaserTemp_Pyrometer3) * 0.5;
    END_IF;
ELSIF iPyroHealthyCount = 1 THEN
    bPyro_TMR_Degraded := TRUE; (* Single-channel Degraded Emergency Run *)
    IF bPyro1_Healthy THEN rVotedFlashTemp_DegC := rLaserTemp_Pyrometer1;
    ELSIF bPyro2_Healthy THEN rVotedFlashTemp_DegC := rLaserTemp_Pyrometer2;
    ELSE rVotedFlashTemp_DegC := rLaserTemp_Pyrometer3;
    END_IF;
ELSE
    (* Total Pyrometric Sensor Failure: Synthesize state estimate and trip safety *)
    rVotedFlashTemp_DegC := x_thermal_est[1];
    bPyro_TMR_Degraded := TRUE;
END_IF;

(* === STEP 3: 2oo3 TRIPLE MODULAR REDUNDANCY (TMR) - LOAD CELL FORCE VOTING === *)
(* Load Cell Transducer Plausibility Check (0 to 2500 N) *)
bLoad1_Healthy := (rShoeForce_LoadCell1 >= -20.0) AND (rShoeForce_LoadCell1 <= 2400.0);
bLoad2_Healthy := (rShoeForce_LoadCell2 >= -20.0) AND (rShoeForce_LoadCell2 <= 2400.0);
bLoad3_Healthy := (rShoeForce_LoadCell3 >= -20.0) AND (rShoeForce_LoadCell3 <= 2400.0);

(* Inter-Channel Discrepancy Cross-Validation (Discrepancy Limit = 65.0 N) *)
rLoadDiff_12 := ABS(rShoeForce_LoadCell1 - rShoeForce_LoadCell2);
rLoadDiff_23 := ABS(rShoeForce_LoadCell2 - rShoeForce_LoadCell3);
rLoadDiff_31 := ABS(rShoeForce_LoadCell3 - rShoeForce_LoadCell1);

IF (rLoadDiff_12 > 65.0) AND (rLoadDiff_31 > 65.0) AND bLoad1_Healthy THEN
    bLoad1_Healthy := FALSE; (* Load cell 1 divergence *)
END_IF;
IF (rLoadDiff_12 > 65.0) AND (rLoadDiff_23 > 65.0) AND bLoad2_Healthy THEN
    bLoad2_Healthy := FALSE; (* Load cell 2 divergence *)
END_IF;
IF (rLoadDiff_23 > 65.0) AND (rLoadDiff_31 > 65.0) AND bLoad3_Healthy THEN
    bLoad3_Healthy := FALSE; (* Load cell 3 divergence *)
END_IF;

(* Evaluate healthy load transducer count *)
iLoadHealthyCount := 0;
IF bLoad1_Healthy THEN iLoadHealthyCount := iLoadHealthyCount + 1; END_IF;
IF bLoad2_Healthy THEN iLoadHealthyCount := iLoadHealthyCount + 1; END_IF;
IF bLoad3_Healthy THEN iLoadHealthyCount := iLoadHealthyCount + 1; END_IF;

(* 2oo3 Load Cell Median Voter *)
IF iLoadHealthyCount = 3 THEN
    bLoad_TMR_Degraded := FALSE;
    IF (rShoeForce_LoadCell1 >= rShoeForce_LoadCell2 AND rShoeForce_LoadCell1 <= rShoeForce_LoadCell3) OR
       (rShoeForce_LoadCell1 <= rShoeForce_LoadCell2 AND rShoeForce_LoadCell1 >= rShoeForce_LoadCell3) THEN
        rVotedNormalForce_N := rShoeForce_LoadCell1;
    ELSIF (rShoeForce_LoadCell2 >= rShoeForce_LoadCell1 AND rShoeForce_LoadCell2 <= rShoeForce_LoadCell3) OR
          (rShoeForce_LoadCell2 <= rShoeForce_LoadCell1 AND rShoeForce_LoadCell2 >= rShoeForce_LoadCell3) THEN
        rVotedNormalForce_N := rShoeForce_LoadCell2;
    ELSE
        rVotedNormalForce_N := rShoeForce_LoadCell3;
    END_IF;
ELSIF iLoadHealthyCount = 2 THEN
    bLoad_TMR_Degraded := TRUE;
    IF bLoad1_Healthy AND bLoad2_Healthy THEN
        rVotedNormalForce_N := (rShoeForce_LoadCell1 + rShoeForce_LoadCell2) * 0.5;
    ELSIF bLoad2_Healthy AND bLoad3_Healthy THEN
        rVotedNormalForce_N := (rShoeForce_LoadCell2 + rShoeForce_LoadCell3) * 0.5;
    ELSE
        rVotedNormalForce_N := (rShoeForce_LoadCell1 + rShoeForce_LoadCell3) * 0.5;
    END_IF;
ELSIF iLoadHealthyCount = 1 THEN
    bLoad_TMR_Degraded := TRUE;
    IF bLoad1_Healthy THEN rVotedNormalForce_N := rShoeForce_LoadCell1;
    ELSIF bLoad2_Healthy THEN rVotedNormalForce_N := rShoeForce_LoadCell2;
    ELSE rVotedNormalForce_N := rShoeForce_LoadCell3;
    END_IF;
ELSE
    rVotedNormalForce_N := 0.0;
    bLoad_TMR_Degraded := TRUE;
END_IF;

bDegradedModeActive := bPyro_TMR_Degraded OR bLoad_TMR_Degraded;

(* === STEP 4: ARRHENIUS RESIN VISCOSITY & LEE-SPRINGER INTIMATE CONTACT === *)
(* Calculate Contact Pressure [bar]: P = (F [N] / A [mm2]) * 10.0 [bar / (N/mm2)] *)
rCompactionPressure_bar := (rVotedNormalForce_N / rShoeContactArea_mm2) * 10.0;

(* Temperature-dependent PEEK melt viscosity: mu(T) = A * exp(E_a / (R * T_K)) *)
IF rVotedFlashTemp_DegC > rTemp_GlassTrans_DegC THEN
    rResinViscosity_Pa_s := rVisc_Prefactor_A * EXP(rActivationEnergy_R / (rVotedFlashTemp_DegC + 273.15));
    IF rResinViscosity_Pa_s < 120.0 THEN
        rResinViscosity_Pa_s := 120.0; (* Viscosity asymptote *)
    ELSIF rResinViscosity_Pa_s > 85000.0 THEN
        rResinViscosity_Pa_s := 85000.0;
    END_IF;
ELSE
    rResinViscosity_Pa_s := 100000.0; (* Solid state glassy matrix *)
END_IF;

(* Dwell time under compaction shoe footprint: t_dwell = L_shoe / v_gantry *)
IF rGantryVelocity_Act > 0.015 THEN
    rMaxIntimateContactTime := (rLaserSpotLength_mm * 0.001) / rGantryVelocity_Act;
ELSE
    rMaxIntimateContactTime := 0.250;
END_IF;

(* Lee-Springer intimate contact accumulation: D_ic = C * (P / mu * t)^0.2 *)
IF (rVotedFlashTemp_DegC >= rTemp_Melting_DegC) AND (rVotedNormalForce_N >= rForce_MinConsol_N) THEN
    rIntimateContactIntegral := rIntimateContactIntegral + ((rCompactionPressure_bar * 100000.0) / rResinViscosity_Pa_s) * rDt;
    rIntimateContactRatio := 0.28 * EXP(0.20 * LN(1.0 + (5.0 * rIntimateContactIntegral)));
    IF rIntimateContactRatio > 1.0 THEN rIntimateContactRatio := 1.0; END_IF;
ELSE
    rIntimateContactIntegral := rIntimateContactIntegral * 0.985; (* Relaxation / cool down *)
    rIntimateContactRatio := rIntimateContactRatio * 0.990;
END_IF;

(* Through-thickness thermal gradient: (T_flash - T_substrate) / t_ply *)
rThermalGradient_C_mm := (rVotedFlashTemp_DegC - rSubstratePreheat_Temp) / rTapeThicknessNom_mm;

(* === STEP 5: STATE OBSERVER & MODEL PREDICTIVE LASER THERMAL REGULATION === *)
(* Innovation Residual for Luenberger Observer *)
rTempObsError := rVotedFlashTemp_DegC - x_thermal_est[1];

(* Update Observer State Estimates: x(k) = A*x + B*u + L*(y - y_hat) *)
FOR iRow := 1 TO 4 DO
    rMatrixSum := 0.0;
    FOR iCol := 1 TO 4 DO
        rMatrixSum := rMatrixSum + a_thermal[iRow, iCol] * x_thermal_est[iCol];
    END_FOR;
    x_thermal_est[iRow] := rMatrixSum
                           + b_thermal[iRow, 1] * rLaserPower_Feedback
                           + b_thermal[iRow, 2] * rGantryVelocity_Act
                           + l_observer_gain[iRow] * rTempObsError;
END_FOR;

(* 1-Step Receding Horizon Predictive State Estimation *)
FOR iRow := 1 TO 4 DO
    rMatrixSum := 0.0;
    FOR iCol := 1 TO 4 DO
        rMatrixSum := rMatrixSum + a_thermal[iRow, iCol] * x_thermal_est[iCol];
    END_FOR;
    x_thermal_pred[iRow] := rMatrixSum
                            + b_thermal[iRow, 1] * rLaserPowerCmd_kW
                            + b_thermal[iRow, 2] * rGantryVelocity_Act;
END_FOR;

(* MPC Error Dynamics with Derivative Damping and Anti-Windup *)
rTempError := rTemp_TargetFlash_DegC - x_thermal_pred[1];
rTempDerivative := (rVotedFlashTemp_DegC - rPrevVotedTemp) / rDt;
rPrevVotedTemp := rVotedFlashTemp_DegC;

IF (iSequencerState = 50 OR iSequencerState = 60 OR iSequencerState = 80) THEN
    IF ABS(rTempError) < 45.0 THEN
        rTempErrorIntegral := rTempErrorIntegral + rTempError * rDt;
        IF rTempErrorIntegral > 150.0 THEN rTempErrorIntegral := 150.0;
        ELSIF rTempErrorIntegral < -150.0 THEN rTempErrorIntegral := -150.0;
        END_IF;
    ELSE
        rTempErrorIntegral := rTempErrorIntegral * 0.995;
    END_IF;
ELSE
    rTempErrorIntegral := 0.0;
END_IF;

(* Multi-Variable Laser Control Law: Feedforward (Velocity + Acceleration) + MPC Feedback *)
rLaserPowerUnsat_kW := (rGantryVelocity_Act * rMPC_Feedforward_Speed)
                       + (rGantryAccel_Act * rMPC_Feedforward_Accel)
                       + (rMPC_Temp_Gain_P * rTempError)
                       + (rMPC_Temp_Gain_I * rTempErrorIntegral)
                       - (rMPC_Temp_Gain_D * rTempDerivative);

(* Saturation within Physical Diode Limits (0.0 to 12.0 kW) *)
IF (iSequencerState = 50 OR iSequencerState = 60 OR iSequencerState = 80) THEN
    IF rLaserPowerUnsat_kW > 12.0 THEN
        rLaserPowerCmd_kW := 12.0;
    ELSIF rLaserPowerUnsat_kW < 0.25 THEN
        rLaserPowerCmd_kW := 0.25; (* Keep simmer current *)
    ELSE
        rLaserPowerCmd_kW := rLaserPowerUnsat_kW;
    END_IF;
