(* 2.0 TRIPLE MODULAR REDUNDANCY (2oo3 TMR) SENSOR VOTING ENGINES                             *)
(* High-reliability median selection with single-channel deviation detection & 1oo2 failover *)
(* ========================================================================================= *)
(* 2.1 BOND FORCE TRANSDUCERS (2oo3) *)
IF bForce_ChA_Healthy AND bForce_ChB_Healthy AND bForce_ChC_Healthy THEN
    (* Pure 3-Channel Median Calculation: V_med = max(min(A,B), min(max(A,B),C)) *)
    IF rBondForce_N_A > rBondForce_N_B THEN
        IF rBondForce_N_B > rBondForce_N_C THEN
            rVotedBondForce_N := rBondForce_N_B;
        ELSIF rBondForce_N_A > rBondForce_N_C THEN
            rVotedBondForce_N := rBondForce_N_C;
        ELSE
            rVotedBondForce_N := rBondForce_N_A;
        END_IF;
    ELSE
        IF rBondForce_N_A > rBondForce_N_C THEN
            rVotedBondForce_N := rBondForce_N_A;
        ELSIF rBondForce_N_B > rBondForce_N_C THEN
            rVotedBondForce_N := rBondForce_N_C;
        ELSE
            rVotedBondForce_N := rBondForce_N_B;
        END_IF;
    END_IF;

    (* Channel Deviation Analysis against Median *)
    IF ABS(rBondForce_N_A - rVotedBondForce_N) > rForce_Dev_Threshold_N THEN
        bForce_ChA_Healthy := FALSE;
        bForce_Degraded_1oo2 := TRUE;
        dwWarningWord := dwWarningWord OR 16#0000_0004; (* Bit 2: Force ChA Discrepancy Fault *)
    ELSIF ABS(rBondForce_N_B - rVotedBondForce_N) > rForce_Dev_Threshold_N THEN
        bForce_ChB_Healthy := FALSE;
        bForce_Degraded_1oo2 := TRUE;
        dwWarningWord := dwWarningWord OR 16#0000_0008; (* Bit 3: Force ChB Discrepancy Fault *)
    ELSIF ABS(rBondForce_N_C - rVotedBondForce_N) > rForce_Dev_Threshold_N THEN
        bForce_ChC_Healthy := FALSE;
        bForce_Degraded_1oo2 := TRUE;
        dwWarningWord := dwWarningWord OR 16#0000_0010; (* Bit 4: Force ChC Discrepancy Fault *)
    END_IF;
ELSIF bForce_Degraded_1oo2 THEN
    (* Degraded 1oo2 Dual-Channel Averaging *)
    IF bForce_ChA_Healthy AND bForce_ChB_Healthy THEN
        rVotedBondForce_N := (rBondForce_N_A + rBondForce_N_B) * 0.5;
        IF ABS(rBondForce_N_A - rBondForce_N_B) > (rForce_Dev_Threshold_N * 1.5) THEN
            bSystemTrip := TRUE; (* Complete Force Sensor Bank Failure *)
            dwAlarmWord_1 := dwAlarmWord_1 OR 16#0000_0010; (* Bit 4: 2oo3 Force Complete Loss *)
        END_IF;
    ELSIF bForce_ChB_Healthy AND bForce_ChC_Healthy THEN
        rVotedBondForce_N := (rBondForce_N_B + rBondForce_N_C) * 0.5;
        IF ABS(rBondForce_N_B - rBondForce_N_C) > (rForce_Dev_Threshold_N * 1.5) THEN
            bSystemTrip := TRUE;
            dwAlarmWord_1 := dwAlarmWord_1 OR 16#0000_0010;
        END_IF;
    ELSIF bForce_ChA_Healthy AND bForce_ChC_Healthy THEN
        rVotedBondForce_N := (rBondForce_N_A + rBondForce_N_C) * 0.5;
        IF ABS(rBondForce_N_A - rBondForce_N_C) > (rForce_Dev_Threshold_N * 1.5) THEN
            bSystemTrip := TRUE;
            dwAlarmWord_1 := dwAlarmWord_1 OR 16#0000_0010;
        END_IF;
    ELSE
        bSystemTrip := TRUE;
        dwAlarmWord_1 := dwAlarmWord_1 OR 16#0000_0010;
    END_IF;
END_IF;

(* 2.2 HIGH-SPEED INFRARED PYROMETERS (2oo3) *)
IF bTemp_ChA_Healthy AND bTemp_ChB_Healthy AND bTemp_ChC_Healthy THEN
    IF rJointTemp_DegC_A > rJointTemp_DegC_B THEN
        IF rJointTemp_DegC_B > rJointTemp_DegC_C THEN
            rVotedJointTemp_DegC := rJointTemp_DegC_B;
        ELSIF rJointTemp_DegC_A > rJointTemp_DegC_C THEN
            rVotedJointTemp_DegC := rJointTemp_DegC_C;
        ELSE
            rVotedJointTemp_DegC := rJointTemp_DegC_A;
        END_IF;
    ELSE
        IF rJointTemp_DegC_A > rJointTemp_DegC_C THEN
            rVotedJointTemp_DegC := rJointTemp_DegC_A;
        ELSIF rJointTemp_DegC_B > rJointTemp_DegC_C THEN
            rVotedJointTemp_DegC := rJointTemp_DegC_C;
        ELSE
            rVotedJointTemp_DegC := rJointTemp_DegC_B;
        END_IF;
    END_IF;

    IF ABS(rJointTemp_DegC_A - rVotedJointTemp_DegC) > rTemp_Dev_Threshold_DegC THEN
        bTemp_ChA_Healthy := FALSE;
        bTemp_Degraded_1oo2 := TRUE;
        dwWarningWord := dwWarningWord OR 16#0000_0020; (* Bit 5: Pyrometer ChA Fault *)
    ELSIF ABS(rJointTemp_DegC_B - rVotedJointTemp_DegC) > rTemp_Dev_Threshold_DegC THEN
        bTemp_ChB_Healthy := FALSE;
        bTemp_Degraded_1oo2 := TRUE;
        dwWarningWord := dwWarningWord OR 16#0000_0040; (* Bit 6: Pyrometer ChB Fault *)
    ELSIF ABS(rJointTemp_DegC_C - rVotedJointTemp_DegC) > rTemp_Dev_Threshold_DegC THEN
        bTemp_ChC_Healthy := FALSE;
        bTemp_Degraded_1oo2 := TRUE;
        dwWarningWord := dwWarningWord OR 16#0000_0080; (* Bit 7: Pyrometer ChC Fault *)
    END_IF;
ELSIF bTemp_Degraded_1oo2 THEN
    IF bTemp_ChA_Healthy AND bTemp_ChB_Healthy THEN
        rVotedJointTemp_DegC := (rJointTemp_DegC_A + rJointTemp_DegC_B) * 0.5;
    ELSIF bTemp_ChB_Healthy AND bTemp_ChC_Healthy THEN
        rVotedJointTemp_DegC := (rJointTemp_DegC_B + rJointTemp_DegC_C) * 0.5;
    ELSIF bTemp_ChA_Healthy AND bTemp_ChC_Healthy THEN
        rVotedJointTemp_DegC := (rJointTemp_DegC_A + rJointTemp_DegC_C) * 0.5;
    ELSE
        bSystemTrip := TRUE;
        dwAlarmWord_1 := dwAlarmWord_1 OR 16#0000_0020; (* Bit 5: 2oo3 Pyrometer Complete Failure *)
    END_IF;
END_IF;

(* 2.3 LASER INTERFEROMETER POSITION TRANSDUCERS (2oo3) *)
IF bPos_ChA_Healthy AND bPos_ChB_Healthy AND bPos_ChC_Healthy THEN
    IF rZPositionInterferometer_nm_A > rZPositionInterferometer_nm_B THEN
        IF rZPositionInterferometer_nm_B > rZPositionInterferometer_nm_C THEN
            rVotedZPosition_nm := rZPositionInterferometer_nm_B;
        ELSIF rZPositionInterferometer_nm_A > rZPositionInterferometer_nm_C THEN
            rVotedZPosition_nm := rZPositionInterferometer_nm_C;
        ELSE
            rVotedZPosition_nm := rZPositionInterferometer_nm_A;
        END_IF;
    ELSE
        IF rZPositionInterferometer_nm_A > rZPositionInterferometer_nm_C THEN
            rVotedZPosition_nm := rZPositionInterferometer_nm_A;
        ELSIF rZPositionInterferometer_nm_B > rZPositionInterferometer_nm_C THEN
            rVotedZPosition_nm := rZPositionInterferometer_nm_C;
        ELSE
            rVotedZPosition_nm := rZPositionInterferometer_nm_B;
        END_IF;
    END_IF;

    IF ABS(rZPositionInterferometer_nm_A - rVotedZPosition_nm) > rPos_Dev_Threshold_nm THEN
        bPos_ChA_Healthy := FALSE;
        bPos_Degraded_1oo2 := TRUE;
        dwWarningWord := dwWarningWord OR 16#0000_0100; (* Bit 8: Interferometer ChA Fault *)
    ELSIF ABS(rZPositionInterferometer_nm_B - rVotedZPosition_nm) > rPos_Dev_Threshold_nm THEN
        bPos_ChB_Healthy := FALSE;
        bPos_Degraded_1oo2 := TRUE;
        dwWarningWord := dwWarningWord OR 16#0000_0200; (* Bit 9: Interferometer ChB Fault *)
    ELSIF ABS(rZPositionInterferometer_nm_C - rVotedZPosition_nm) > rPos_Dev_Threshold_nm THEN
        bPos_ChC_Healthy := FALSE;
        bPos_Degraded_1oo2 := TRUE;
        dwWarningWord := dwWarningWord OR 16#0000_0400; (* Bit 10: Interferometer ChC Fault *)
    END_IF;
ELSIF bPos_Degraded_1oo2 THEN
    IF bPos_ChA_Healthy AND bPos_ChB_Healthy THEN
        rVotedZPosition_nm := (rZPositionInterferometer_nm_A + rZPositionInterferometer_nm_B) * 0.5;
    ELSIF bPos_ChB_Healthy AND bPos_ChC_Healthy THEN
        rVotedZPosition_nm := (rZPositionInterferometer_nm_B + rZPositionInterferometer_nm_C) * 0.5;
    ELSIF bPos_ChA_Healthy AND bPos_ChC_Healthy THEN
        rVotedZPosition_nm := (rZPositionInterferometer_nm_A + rZPositionInterferometer_nm_C) * 0.5;
    ELSE
        bSystemTrip := TRUE;
        dwAlarmWord_1 := dwAlarmWord_1 OR 16#0000_0040; (* Bit 6: 2oo3 Interferometer Complete Failure *)
    END_IF;
END_IF;

(* 2.4 MICRO-GAP CHAMBER VACUUM SENSORS (2oo3) *)
IF bVac_ChA_Healthy AND bVac_ChB_Healthy AND bVac_ChC_Healthy THEN
    IF rChamberVacuum_mbar_A > rChamberVacuum_mbar_B THEN
        IF rChamberVacuum_mbar_B > rChamberVacuum_mbar_C THEN
            rVotedChamberVacuum_mbar := rChamberVacuum_mbar_B;
        ELSIF rChamberVacuum_mbar_A > rChamberVacuum_mbar_C THEN
            rVotedChamberVacuum_mbar := rChamberVacuum_mbar_C;
        ELSE
            rVotedChamberVacuum_mbar := rChamberVacuum_mbar_A;
        END_IF;
    ELSE
        IF rChamberVacuum_mbar_A > rChamberVacuum_mbar_C THEN
            rVotedChamberVacuum_mbar := rChamberVacuum_mbar_A;
        ELSIF rChamberVacuum_mbar_B > rChamberVacuum_mbar_C THEN
            rVotedChamberVacuum_mbar := rChamberVacuum_mbar_C;
        ELSE
            rVotedChamberVacuum_mbar := rChamberVacuum_mbar_B;
        END_IF;
    END_IF;
ELSE
    rVotedChamberVacuum_mbar := rChamberVacuum_mbar_A;
END_IF;

(* 2.5 ULTRASONIC ACOUSTIC PICKUPS (2oo3) *)
IF bAcoustic_ChA_Healthy AND bAcoustic_ChB_Healthy AND bAcoustic_ChC_Healthy THEN
    IF rUltrasonicAcoustic_mV_A > rUltrasonicAcoustic_mV_B THEN
        IF rUltrasonicAcoustic_mV_B > rUltrasonicAcoustic_mV_C THEN
            rVotedUltrasonicAmplitude_mV := rUltrasonicAcoustic_mV_B;
        ELSIF rUltrasonicAcoustic_mV_A > rUltrasonicAcoustic_mV_C THEN
            rVotedUltrasonicAmplitude_mV := rUltrasonicAcoustic_mV_C;
        ELSE
            rVotedUltrasonicAmplitude_mV := rUltrasonicAcoustic_mV_A;
        END_IF;
    ELSE
        IF rUltrasonicAcoustic_mV_A > rUltrasonicAcoustic_mV_C THEN
            rVotedUltrasonicAmplitude_mV := rUltrasonicAcoustic_mV_A;
        ELSIF rUltrasonicAcoustic_mV_B > rUltrasonicAcoustic_mV_C THEN
            rVotedUltrasonicAmplitude_mV := rUltrasonicAcoustic_mV_C;
        ELSE
            rVotedUltrasonicAmplitude_mV := rUltrasonicAcoustic_mV_B;
        END_IF;
    END_IF;
ELSE
    rVotedUltrasonicAmplitude_mV := rUltrasonicAcoustic_mV_A;
END_IF;

bDegradedControlMode := bForce_Degraded_1oo2 OR bTemp_Degraded_1oo2 OR bPos_Degraded_1oo2;

(* ========================================================================================= *)
(* 3.0 DERIVATIVES, DYNAMIC EMISSIVITY & GOERTZEL ULTRASONIC RESONANCE FILTER               *)
(* ========================================================================================= *)
(* Instantaneous heating rate dT/dt [deg C/s] *)
rDynamicHeatingRampRate_DegC_s := (rVotedJointTemp_DegC - rPrevVotedTemp_DegC) / c_rScanTimeSeconds;
rPrevVotedTemp_DegC := rVotedJointTemp_DegC;

(* Instantaneous collapse rate dz/dt [nm/s] *)
rDynamicSolderCollapseRate_nm_s := (rVotedZPosition_nm - rPrevVotedPos_nm) / c_rScanTimeSeconds;
rPrevVotedPos_nm := rVotedZPosition_nm;

(* Dynamic Pyrometer Emissivity Compensation: Solder phase changes reflectance *)
IF rVotedJointTemp_DegC > c_rSAC305MeltingPoint_DegC THEN
    (* Molten solder mirror-like wetting increases reflectance to ~68% *)
    rApparentReflectance_Pct := 68.0;
    rEmissivityCorrectionFactor := 0.72; (* Effective emissivity drops *)
ELSE
    (* Solid rough micro-bump top surface reflectance ~32% *)
    rApparentReflectance_Pct := 32.0;
    rEmissivityCorrectionFactor := 0.92;
END_IF;

(* GOERTZEL DISCRETE FOURIER TRANSFORM AT 68.5 kHz RESONANT FREQUENCY *)
(* Difference equation: s[n] = x[n] + coeff * s[n-1] - s[n-2] *)
rGoertzel_s0 := rVotedUltrasonicAmplitude_mV + (c_rGoertzelCoeff * rGoertzel_s1) - rGoertzel_s2;
rGoertzel_s2 := rGoertzel_s1;
rGoertzel_s1 := rGoertzel_s0;
iGoertzel_SampleCount := iGoertzel_SampleCount + 1;

(* Compute block power every 10 samples (1.0 ms window at 10 kHz sub-frame) *)
IF iGoertzel_SampleCount >= 10 THEN
    rGoertzel_Real := rGoertzel_s1 - (rGoertzel_s2 * COS(c_rGoertzelOmega));
    rGoertzel_Imag := rGoertzel_s2 * SIN(c_rGoertzelOmega);
    rGoertzel_Mag := SQRT((rGoertzel_Real * rGoertzel_Real) + (rGoertzel_Imag * rGoertzel_Imag)) * 0.10;
    
    (* Dynamic acoustic impedance estimate: Z = V_acoustic / I_piezo *)
    IF rUltrasonicPowerCmd_Percent > 1.0 THEN
        rUltrasonicAcousticImpedance_Ohms := (rGoertzel_Mag * 10.0) / (rUltrasonicPowerCmd_Percent * 0.15);
    ELSE
        rUltrasonicAcousticImpedance_Ohms := 450.0; (* Nominal quiescent impedance *)
    END_IF;
    
    (* Acoustic Damping Loss Factor: ratio of active attenuation vs solid baseline *)
    IF rBaselineAcousticMag > 10.0 THEN
        rAcousticDampingLossFactor := (rBaselineAcousticMag - rGoertzel_Mag) / rBaselineAcousticMag;
        IF rAcousticDampingLossFactor < 0.0 THEN rAcousticDampingLossFactor := 0.0; END_IF;
    END_IF;
    
    (* Detect Solder Liquefaction & Wetting Drop *)
    IF (rVotedJointTemp_DegC >= (c_rSAC305MeltingPoint_DegC - 2.0)) AND (rAcousticDampingLossFactor > 0.45) THEN
        bSolderLiquefactionTriggered := TRUE;
    END_IF;
    
    (* Reset Goertzel delay buffers *)
    rGoertzel_s0 := 0.0;
    rGoertzel_s1 := 0.0;
    rGoertzel_s2 := 0.0;
    iGoertzel_SampleCount := 0;
END_IF;

(* ========================================================================================= *)
(* 4.0 INTERMETALLIC COMPOUND (IMC) ARRHENIUS KINETICS & QUALITY INDEX FUSION                *)
(* Reaction: Cu + Sn -> Cu6Sn5 (eta-phase) and Cu3Sn (epsilon-phase)                        *)
(* Growth equation: d(delta^2)/dt = 2 * K0 * exp(-Q/(R*T)) * (1 + chi * P_us)             *)
(* ========================================================================================= *)
IF rVotedJointTemp_DegC > 180.0 THEN
    (* Absolute thermodynamic temperature in Kelvin *)
    rTmpA := rVotedJointTemp_DegC + 273.15;
    
    (* Arrhenius exponential factor exp(-Q / (R * T)) *)
    rTmpB := EXP(-1.0 * c_rArrheniusActivationEnergy / (c_rGasConstant_R * rTmpA));
    
    (* Ultrasonic non-thermal acoustic cavitation & streaming enhancement multiplier *)
    IF bUltrasonicEmissionActive THEN
        rUltrasonicKineticEnhancement := 1.0 + (0.015 * rUltrasonicPowerCmd_Percent);
    ELSE
        rUltrasonicKineticEnhancement := 1.0;
    END_IF;
    
    (* Instantaneous rate in nm^2 / second (1 m^2/s = 1E18 nm^2/s) *)
    rInstantaneousIMCRate_nm2_s := 2.0 * (c_rArrheniusPreFactor * 1.0E18) * rTmpB * rUltrasonicKineticEnhancement;
    
    (* Discrete trapezoidal Euler integration *)
    rAccumulatedIMCSquared_nm2 := rAccumulatedIMCSquared_nm2 + (rInstantaneousIMCRate_nm2_s * c_rScanTimeSeconds);
    rEstimatedIMCGrowth_nm := SQRT(rAccumulatedIMCSquared_nm2);
END_IF;

(* Online Bondline Thickness BLT Measurement from Touchdown Datum *)
IF bTouchDownDetected THEN
    rMeasuredBondlineThickness_nm := rTargetBondlineThickness_nm - (rVotedZPosition_nm - rTouchDownPosLatch_nm);
    IF rMeasuredBondlineThickness_nm < 100.0 THEN
        rMeasuredBondlineThickness_nm := 100.0; (* Physical silicon contact hardstop *)
    END_IF;
ELSE
    rMeasuredBondlineThickness_nm := rTargetBondlineThickness_nm;
END_IF;

(* In-Situ Multi-Physics Bond Quality Index (BQI) Fusion *)
(* Parameters: 1) IMC thickness in 350-850 nm window; 2) BLT within +/- 1500 nm; 3) Tilt < 15 urad *)
rCalculatedBQI_Accumulator := 0.0;
IF (rEstimatedIMCGrowth_nm >= 350.0) AND (rEstimatedIMCGrowth_nm <= 850.0) THEN
    rCalculatedBQI_Accumulator := rCalculatedBQI_Accumulator + 0.40; (* IMC optimal weight 40% *)
ELSIF (rEstimatedIMCGrowth_nm >= 200.0) AND (rEstimatedIMCGrowth_nm <= 1200.0) THEN
    rCalculatedBQI_Accumulator := rCalculatedBQI_Accumulator + 0.25;
ELSE
    rCalculatedBQI_Accumulator := rCalculatedBQI_Accumulator + 0.05;
END_IF;

IF ABS(rMeasuredBondlineThickness_nm - rTargetBondlineThickness_nm) <= 1000.0 THEN
    rCalculatedBQI_Accumulator := rCalculatedBQI_Accumulator + 0.35; (* BLT precision weight 35% *)
ELSIF ABS(rMeasuredBondlineThickness_nm - rTargetBondlineThickness_nm) <= 2500.0 THEN
    rCalculatedBQI_Accumulator := rCalculatedBQI_Accumulator + 0.20;
ELSE
    rCalculatedBQI_Accumulator := rCalculatedBQI_Accumulator + 0.05;
END_IF;

IF (ABS(rCoPlanarityTiltX_urad) <= 15.0) AND (ABS(rCoPlanarityTiltY_urad) <= 15.0) THEN
    rCalculatedBQI_Accumulator := rCalculatedBQI_Accumulator + 0.25; (* Tilt co-planarity weight 25% *)
ELSIF (ABS(rCoPlanarityTiltX_urad) <= 35.0) AND (ABS(rCoPlanarityTiltY_urad) <= 35.0) THEN
    rCalculatedBQI_Accumulator := rCalculatedBQI_Accumulator + 0.15;
END_IF;
rBondQualityIndex := rCalculatedBQI_Accumulator;

(* ========================================================================================= *)
(* 5.0 CYBER-PHYSICAL STATE-SPACE OBSERVER (LUENBERGER ESTIMATOR)                            *)
(* Equation: x_hat[k] = A * x_hat[k-1] + B * u[k-1] + L * (y[k] - y_hat[k])                  *)
(* ========================================================================================= *)
(* 5.1 Measurement vector y_meas assembly *)
vecY_Meas[1] := rVotedBondForce_N;
vecY_Meas[2] := rMeasuredBondlineThickness_nm;
vecY_Meas[3] := rVotedJointTemp_DegC;
vecY_Meas[4] := rUltrasonicAcousticImpedance_Ohms;

(* 5.2 Prior state prediction: x_pred = A * x_hat + B * u *)
FOR iLoopI := 1 TO 6 DO
    rTmpA := 0.0;
    FOR iLoopJ := 1 TO 6 DO
        rTmpA := rTmpA + (matA[iLoopI, iLoopJ] * vecX_Hat[iLoopJ]);
    END_FOR;
    FOR iLoopK := 1 TO 3 DO
        rTmpA := rTmpA + (matB[iLoopI, iLoopK] * vecU_Prev[iLoopK]);
    END_FOR;
    vecX_Pred[iLoopI] := rTmpA;
END_FOR;

(* 5.3 Predicted output: y_hat = C * x_pred + D * u *)
FOR iLoopI := 1 TO 4 DO
    rTmpA := 0.0;
    FOR iLoopJ := 1 TO 6 DO
        rTmpA := rTmpA + (matC[iLoopI, iLoopJ] * vecX_Pred[iLoopJ]);
    END_FOR;
    FOR iLoopK := 1 TO 3 DO
        rTmpA := rTmpA + (matD[iLoopI, iLoopK] * vecU_Prev[iLoopK]);
    END_FOR;
    vecY_Hat[iLoopI] := rTmpA;
    vecY_Err[iLoopI] := vecY_Meas[iLoopI] - vecY_Hat[iLoopI];
END_FOR;

(* 5.4 Posterior state correction: x_hat = x_pred + L * e *)
FOR iLoopI := 1 TO 6 DO
    rTmpA := vecX_Pred[iLoopI];
    FOR iLoopJ := 1 TO 4 DO
        rTmpA := rTmpA + (matL[iLoopI, iLoopJ] * vecY_Err[iLoopJ]);
    END_FOR;
    vecX_Hat[iLoopI] := rTmpA;
END_FOR;

(* ========================================================================================= *)
(* 6.0 CONSTRAINED MODEL PREDICTIVE CONTROL (MPC) FAST PROJECTED GRADIENT SOLVER             *)
(* Quadratic cost functional: J = sum(||y - r||^2_Q + ||delta_u||^2_R)                      *)
(* ========================================================================================= *)
(* 6.1 Populate reference preview horizon vectors (Np = 5) *)
FOR iLoopI := 1 TO 5 DO
    vecRefTrajectory_Force[iLoopI] := rTraj_TargetForce_N;
    vecRefTrajectory_BLT[iLoopI] := rTargetBondlineThickness_nm;
    vecRefTrajectory_Temp[iLoopI] := rTraj_TargetTemp_DegC;
END_FOR;

(* 6.2 Iterative Projected Gradient Descent on delta_u *)
(* Gradient calculation for control vector u = [VoiceCoilCurrent, LaserPower, UltrasonicPower] *)
FOR iLoopI := 1 TO iMPC_MaxIterations DO
    (* Output errors evaluated at current step *)
    rTmpA := (vecX_Hat[3] - vecRefTrajectory_Force[1]); (* Force error *)
    rTmpB := (vecX_Hat[6] - vecRefTrajectory_BLT[1]);   (* BLT error *)
    rTmpC := (vecX_Hat[5] - vecRefTrajectory_Temp[1]);  (* Temp error *)
    
    (* Analytical gradient w.r.t control inputs *)
    rGrad1 := (matQ_Weight[1] * rTmpA * matB[3,1]) + (matQ_Weight[2] * rTmpB * matB[6,1]) + (matR_Weight[1] * vecDeltaU[1]);
    rGrad2 := (matQ_Weight[3] * rTmpC * matB[5,2]) + (matQ_Weight[2] * rTmpB * matB[6,2]) + (matR_Weight[2] * vecDeltaU[2]);
    rGrad3 := (matQ_Weight[1] * rTmpA * matB[3,3]) + (matQ_Weight[3] * rTmpC * matB[5,3]) + (matR_Weight[3] * vecDeltaU[3]);
    
    (* Gradient step *)
    vecDeltaU[1] := vecDeltaU[1] - (rMPC_StepSize_Alpha * rGrad1);
    vecDeltaU[2] := vecDeltaU[2] - (rMPC_StepSize_Alpha * rGrad2);
    vecDeltaU[3] := vecDeltaU[3] - (rMPC_StepSize_Alpha * rGrad3);
    
    (* Slew rate bounding projection *)
    IF vecDeltaU[1] > 2.50 THEN vecDeltaU[1] := 2.50; ELSIF vecDeltaU[1] <-2.50 THEN vecDeltaU[1] :=-2.50; END_IF;
    IF vecDeltaU[2] > 25.0 THEN vecDeltaU[2] := 25.0; ELSIF vecDeltaU[2] <-25.0 THEN vecDeltaU[2] :=-25.0; END_IF;
    IF vecDeltaU[3] > 5.00 THEN vecDeltaU[3] := 5.00; ELSIF vecDeltaU[3] <-5.00 THEN vecDeltaU[3] :=-5.00; END_IF;
END_FOR;

(* 6.3 Integrate control increments: u[k] = u[k-1] + delta_u[k] *)
vecU_Cmd[1] := vecU_Prev[1] + vecDeltaU[1];
vecU_Cmd[2] := vecU_Prev[2] + vecDeltaU[2];
vecU_Cmd[3] := vecU_Prev[3] + vecDeltaU[3];

(* Enforce hard physical plant saturation boundaries *)
IF vecU_Cmd[1] > c_rMaxVoiceCoilCurrent_A THEN
    vecU_Cmd[1] := c_rMaxVoiceCoilCurrent_A;
ELSIF vecU_Cmd[1] <-c_rMaxVoiceCoilCurrent_A THEN
    vecU_Cmd[1] :=-c_rMaxVoiceCoilCurrent_A;
END_IF;

IF vecU_Cmd[2] > c_rMaxAllowableLaserPower_Watts THEN
    vecU_Cmd[2] := c_rMaxAllowableLaserPower_Watts;
ELSIF vecU_Cmd[2] < 0.0 THEN
    vecU_Cmd[2] := 0.0;
END_IF;

IF vecU_Cmd[3] > 100.0 THEN
    vecU_Cmd[3] := 100.0;
ELSIF vecU_Cmd[3] < 0.0 THEN
    vecU_Cmd[3] := 0.0;
END_IF;

(* Store historical commands for next cycle *)
vecU_Prev[1] := vecU_Cmd[1];
vecU_Prev[2] := vecU_Cmd[2];
vecU_Prev[3] := vecU_Cmd[3];

(* ========================================================================================= *)
(* 7.0 SUB-MICRORADIAN MULTI-AXIS PIEZOELECTRIC CO-PLANARITY LEVELING LOOP                   *)
(* Dual-axis PI regulator driving Theta-X and Theta-Y leveling actuators to 0.0 urad        *)
(* ========================================================================================= *)
IF (iState >= 50) AND (iState <= 100) THEN
    (* Axis X tilt error and integration *)
    rTmpA := 0.0 - rCoPlanarityTiltX_urad;
    rPiezoTiltX_Integral := rPiezoTiltX_Integral + (rTmpA * c_rScanTimeSeconds * 12.5);
    IF rPiezoTiltX_Integral > 250.0 THEN rPiezoTiltX_Integral := 250.0; ELSIF rPiezoTiltX_Integral <-250.0 THEN rPiezoTiltX_Integral :=-250.0; END_IF;
    rPiezoTiltXCmd_urad := (rTmpA * 1.85) + rPiezoTiltX_Integral;
    
    (* Axis Y tilt error and integration *)
    rTmpB := 0.0 - rCoPlanarityTiltY_urad;
    rPiezoTiltY_Integral := rPiezoTiltY_Integral + (rTmpB * c_rScanTimeSeconds * 12.5);
    IF rPiezoTiltY_Integral > 250.0 THEN rPiezoTiltY_Integral := 250.0; ELSIF rPiezoTiltY_Integral <-250.0 THEN rPiezoTiltY_Integral :=-250.0; END_IF;
    rPiezoTiltYCmd_urad := (rTmpB * 1.85) + rPiezoTiltY_Integral;
ELSE
    rPiezoTiltX_Integral := 0.0;
    rPiezoTiltY_Integral := 0.0;
    rPiezoTiltXCmd_urad := 0.0;
    rPiezoTiltYCmd_urad := 0.0;
END_IF;

(* ========================================================================================= *)
(* 8.0 MULTI-STAGE THERMO-COMPRESSION BONDING FINITE STATE MACHINE (FSM)                     *)
(* ========================================================================================= *)
IF iState <> iPreviousState THEN
    rStateTimerAccum_Sec := 0.0; (* Reset dwell time upon state entry *)
    iPreviousState := iState;
ELSE
    rStateTimerAccum_Sec := rStateTimerAccum_Sec + c_rScanTimeSeconds;
END_IF;

CASE iState OF
    0: (* STATE 0: POWER-ON SELF TEST & HARDWARE VALIDATION (POST) *)
        bSystemReady := FALSE;
        bBondCycleInProgress := FALSE;
        bBondCycleComplete := FALSE;
        bTouchDownDetected := FALSE;
        bLaserEmissionActive := FALSE;
        bUltrasonicEmissionActive := FALSE;
        bSolderLiquefactionTriggered := FALSE;
        rVoiceCoilCurrentCmd_A := 0.0;
        rLaserOpticalPowerCmd_Watts := 0.0;
        rUltrasonicPowerCmd_Percent := 0.0;
        rQuenchGasFlowCmd_Percent := 0.0;
        rFormingGasPurgeCmd_sccm := 0.0;
        rAccumulatedIMCSquared_nm2 := 0.0;

    Sauerbrey Equation with dynamic Lu-Lewis Acoustic Impedance (Z-Match) and 4th-order thermal drift polynomial:
       Delta_f_thermal = c1 * (T - T0) + c2 * (T - T0)^2 + c3 * (T - T0)^3 + c4 * (T - T0)^4
       Delta_f_corrected = (f_measured - f_nominal) - Delta_f_thermal
       Delta_m = - (N_at * rho_q / (pi * Z_ratio * f_measured)) * ATAN( Z_ratio * TAN(pi * Delta_f_corrected / f_nominal) )
       Thickness_Al2O3 = Delta_m / (rho_film * A_active)
       Growth_Per_Cycle (GPC) = Thickness_Al2O3 / N_cycles_elapsed [Angstrom / cycle]
    Crystal motional resistance R_damping monitors viscoelastic viscous loading and warns of crystal acoustic saturation.

 5. 8-STATE MIMO DISCRETE STATE-SPACE MODEL & HILDRETH DUAL QP MPC:
    State vector x in R^8:
       x_1: Micro-gap clearance error [um]
       x_2: Micro-gap rate of change [um/s]
       x_3: Precursor-curtain differential pressure Delta_P_TMA [mbar]
       x_4: Precursor-curtain differential pressure Delta_P_H2O [mbar]
       x_5: Web lateral wander position [mm]
       x_6: Web lateral velocity [mm/s]
       x_7: QCM accumulated barrier film thickness [nm]
       x_8: Platen thermal equilibration offset [deg C]
    Control vector u in R^4:
       u_1: Aerodynamic bleed servo valve command [%]
       u_2: Dynamic N2 purge curtain MFC setpoint [sccm]
       u_3: Precursor injector dosing valve trim [%]
       u_4: Web steering guide servo stroke command [mm]
    Model Predictive Control minimizes quadratic objective over prediction horizon Np=5, control horizon Nc=3:
       min J = sum_{k=1..Np} (y(k)-y_sp)'*Q*(y(k)-y_sp) + sum_{k=0..Nc-1} (u(k)'*R*u(k) + Delta_u(k)'*S*Delta_u(k))
    Subject to polyhedral inequality constraints: E * Delta_U <= b_vec
    Solved in real-time PLC scan using the iterative Hildreth dual quadratic programming method.
====================================================================================================
*)

(*
====================================================================================================
 SECTION 1: MASTER SAFETY CIRCUIT, HARDWARE INTERLOCKS & FAULT RESET SUPERVISION
====================================================================================================
*)
fbTrigReset(CLK := bResetFault);
fbToneEStopDebounce(IN := NOT bEmergencyStopOk, PT := T#20MS);

(* Operator Manual Reset Evaluation *)
IF fbTrigReset.Q THEN
    dwFaultLatched_Critical := 16#00000000;
    dwFaultActive_Warning := 16#00000000;
    bAlarmActive := FALSE;
    IF iState = 130 THEN
        iState := 0; (* Return from Emergency Abort to Cold Safe State *)
        bStateFirstScan := TRUE;
    END_IF;
END_IF;

(* Category 4 / SIL 3 Emergency Stop Trip Interlock *)
IF fbToneEStopDebounce.Q THEN
    dwFaultLatched_Critical := dwFaultLatched_Critical OR 16#00000001; (* Bit 0: Emergency Stop Asserted *)
    bEmergencyVentActive := TRUE;
    bDepositionActive := FALSE;
    bSystemReady := FALSE;
    rTMA_DosingValve_pct := 0.0;
    rH2O_DosingValve_pct := 0.0;
    rBearingBleedValve_pct := 0.0; (* Close bleed to maintain maximum levitation cushion *)
    iState := 130; (* Force Transition to State 130: Emergency Shutdown & Blanket Scrub *)
END_IF;

(* Glovebox / Enclosure Perimeter Door Seal Interlock *)
IF NOT bSafetyDoorInterlock THEN
    dwFaultLatched_Critical := dwFaultLatched_Critical OR 16#00000002; (* Bit 1: Safety Enclosure Breach *)
    IF iState >= 40 THEN
        iState := 130;
    END_IF;
END_IF;

(* Precursor Exhaust Scrubber / Thermal Oxidizer Vacuum Draft Interlock *)
IF NOT bPrecursorExhaustDraftOk THEN
    dwFaultLatched_Critical := dwFaultLatched_Critical OR 16#00000004; (* Bit 2: Exhaust Draft Vacuum Failure *)
    IF iState >= 80 THEN
        iState := 130;
    END_IF;
END_IF;

(* Pyrophoric TMA Toxic Gas Leak Detection Interlock *)
IF NOT bTMA_GasLeakDetectorOk THEN
    dwFaultLatched_Critical := dwFaultLatched_Critical OR 16#00000008; (* Bit 3: TMA Ambient Gas Leak Detected *)
    bEmergencyVentActive := TRUE;
    iState := 130;
END_IF;

(* High-Purity Nitrogen Bulk Supply Pressure Interlock *)
IF NOT bN2_BulkSupplyPressureOk THEN
    dwFaultLatched_Critical := dwFaultLatched_Critical OR 16#00000010; (* Bit 4: Bulk N2 Supply Depleted *)
    iState := 130;
END_IF;

(*
====================================================================================================
 SECTION 2: 2oo3 TRIPLE MODULAR REDUNDANCY (TMR) SENSOR VOTING & FAULT TOLERANCE
====================================================================================================
*)
(* --- 2.1 Micro-Gap Sensor Triplet Slew-Rate and Boundary Plausibility Checks --- *)
IF (rGapSensor1_um < 5.0) OR (rGapSensor1_um > 95.0) OR (ABS(rGapSensor1_um - rGap_Prev_S1) > (rGap_SlewRateLimit_um_s * rTs)) THEN
    bGap_S1_Valid := FALSE;
    dwDegradedStateRegister := dwDegradedStateRegister OR 16#00000001; (* Bit 0: Gap Sensor 1 Unhealthy *)
ELSE
    bGap_S1_Valid := TRUE;
    dwDegradedStateRegister := dwDegradedStateRegister AND 16#FFFFFFFE;
END_IF;
rGap_Prev_S1 := rGapSensor1_um;

IF (rGapSensor2_um < 5.0) OR (rGapSensor2_um > 95.0) OR (ABS(rGapSensor2_um - rGap_Prev_S2) > (rGap_SlewRateLimit_um_s * rTs)) THEN
    bGap_S2_Valid := FALSE;
    dwDegradedStateRegister := dwDegradedStateRegister OR 16#00000002; (* Bit 1: Gap Sensor 2 Unhealthy *)
ELSE
    bGap_S2_Valid := TRUE;
    dwDegradedStateRegister := dwDegradedStateRegister AND 16#FFFFFFFD;
END_IF;
rGap_Prev_S2 := rGapSensor2_um;

IF (rGapSensor3_um < 5.0) OR (rGapSensor3_um > 95.0) OR (ABS(rGapSensor3_um - rGap_Prev_S3) > (rGap_SlewRateLimit_um_s * rTs)) THEN
    bGap_S3_Valid := FALSE;
    dwDegradedStateRegister := dwDegradedStateRegister OR 16#00000004; (* Bit 2: Gap Sensor 3 Unhealthy *)
ELSE
    bGap_S3_Valid := TRUE;
    dwDegradedStateRegister := dwDegradedStateRegister AND 16#FFFFFFFB;
END_IF;
rGap_Prev_S3 := rGapSensor3_um;

(* --- 2.2 Discrepancy Matrix Evaluation Across Triplet --- *)
rGap_Discrepancy_12 := ABS(rGapSensor1_um - rGapSensor2_um);
rGap_Discrepancy_23 := ABS(rGapSensor2_um - rGapSensor3_um);
rGap_Discrepancy_13 := ABS(rGapSensor1_um - rGapSensor3_um);

fbToneDiscrepancyGap(IN := ((rGap_Discrepancy_12 > rGap_DiscrepancyTol_um) AND (rGap_Discrepancy_23 > rGap_DiscrepancyTol_um) AND (rGap_Discrepancy_13 > rGap_DiscrepancyTol_um)), PT := T#250MS);
IF fbToneDiscrepancyGap.Q THEN
    dwFaultActive_Warning := dwFaultActive_Warning OR 16#00000001; (* Warning Bit 0: Persistent Gap Triplet Discrepancy *)
END_IF;

(* --- 2.3 2oo3 Voting & Graceful Degradation Logic --- *)
IF bGap_S1_Valid AND bGap_S2_Valid AND bGap_S3_Valid THEN
    (* Full 2oo3 Mode: Median Selection Algorithm *)
    iGap_FailoverMode := 3;
    bDegradedModeActive := FALSE;
    IF ((rGapSensor1_um >= rGapSensor2_um) AND (rGapSensor1_um <= rGapSensor3_um)) OR ((rGapSensor1_um >= rGapSensor3_um) AND (rGapSensor1_um <= rGapSensor2_um)) THEN
        rGapVoted_um := rGapSensor1_um;
    ELSIF ((rGapSensor2_um >= rGapSensor1_um) AND (rGapSensor2_um <= rGapSensor3_um)) OR ((rGapSensor2_um >= rGapSensor3_um) AND (rGapSensor2_um <= rGapSensor1_um)) THEN
        rGapVoted_um := rGapSensor2_um;
    ELSE
        rGapVoted_um := rGapSensor3_um;
    END_IF;
ELSIF bGap_S1_Valid AND bGap_S2_Valid AND (NOT bGap_S3_Valid) THEN
    (* Single Channel S3 Failure: 1oo2 Degraded Mode Averaging *)
    iGap_FailoverMode := 2;
    bDegradedModeActive := TRUE;
    rGapVoted_um := 0.5 * (rGapSensor1_um + rGapSensor2_um);
ELSIF bGap_S1_Valid AND (NOT bGap_S2_Valid) AND bGap_S3_Valid THEN
    (* Single Channel S2 Failure: 1oo2 Degraded Mode Averaging *)
    iGap_FailoverMode := 2;
    bDegradedModeActive := TRUE;
    rGapVoted_um := 0.5 * (rGapSensor1_um + rGapSensor3_um);
ELSIF (NOT bGap_S1_Valid) AND bGap_S2_Valid AND bGap_S3_Valid THEN
    (* Single Channel S1 Failure: 1oo2 Degraded Mode Averaging *)
    iGap_FailoverMode := 2;
    bDegradedModeActive := TRUE;
    rGapVoted_um := 0.5 * (rGapSensor2_um + rGapSensor3_um);
ELSE
    (* Multiple Sensor Failure (Double or Triple Fault): Fail-Safe Trip *)
    iGap_FailoverMode := 1;
    bDegradedModeActive := TRUE;
    dwFaultLatched_Critical := dwFaultLatched_Critical OR 16#00000020; (* Bit 5: Dual Gap Sensor Failure *)
    rGapVoted_um := 0.0; (* Force zero to indicate collapse hazard *)
    IF iState >= 40 THEN
        iState := 130;
    END_IF;
END_IF;
rEstimatedMicroGap_um := rGapVoted_um;

(* Catastrophic Gap Crash Hazard Interlock *)
IF (rEstimatedMicroGap_um < 14.0) AND (iState >= 40) THEN
    dwFaultLatched_Critical := dwFaultLatched_Critical OR 16#00000040; (* Bit 6: Micro-Gap Collapse Hazard (< 14 um) *)
    iState := 130;
END_IF;

(*
====================================================================================================
 SECTION 3: KNUDSEN SLIP CORRECTION, PÉCLET PURGE DYNAMICS & IN-SITU QCM MASS RECKONER
====================================================================================================
*)
(* --- 3.1 Gas Bearing Viscosity & Knudsen Number Calculation --- *)
rTempAbs_K := rReactorTemperature_degC + 273.15;
(* Sutherland equation for dynamic viscosity of nitrogen gas *)
rN2_DynamicViscosity := rViscosity_N2_Base * ((rTempAbs_K / 273.15)**1.5) * ((273.15 + rSutherland_S) / (rTempAbs_K + rSutherland_S));

(* Mean free path calculation: lambda = (k_B * T) / (sqrt(2) * pi * d^2 * p) *)
rMeanFreePath_m := (rBoltzmann_kB * rTempAbs_K) / (1.41421356 * rPI * (rMoleculeDiameter_N2 * rMoleculeDiameter_N2) * (rExhaustPressure_mbar * 100.0));
IF rEstimatedMicroGap_um > 1.0 THEN
    rKnudsenNumber := (rMeanFreePath_m * 1.0E6) / rEstimatedMicroGap_um;
ELSE
    rKnudsenNumber := 0.005;
END_IF;
rKnudsenSlipCorrection := 1.0 + (6.0 * rKnudsenNumber);

(* --- 3.2 Dynamic Inter-Slit N2 Purge Curtain Péclet Number Reckoner --- *)
(* Convert flow from sccm to m^3/s at operating conditions *)
rGasFlow_m3_s := (rN2PurgeFlow_sccm * 1.66667E-8) * (rTempAbs_K / 273.15) * (1013.25 / MAX(rExhaustPressure_mbar, 100.0));
rGasVelocity_m_s := rGasFlow_m3_s / (rPurgeSlitArea_mm2 * 1.0E-6);
rDiffCoeff_Actual := rDiffCoeff_TMA_N2_Ref * ((rTempAbs_K / 393.15)**1.75) * (1013.25 / MAX(rExhaustPressure_mbar, 100.0));
rCurrentPecletNumber := (rGasVelocity_m_s * (rBarrierLandWidth_mm * 1.0E-3)) / MAX(rDiffCoeff_Actual, 1.0E-9);

(* Péclet Number Isolation Warning *)
IF (rCurrentPecletNumber < 95.0) AND (iState >= 80) THEN
    dwFaultActive_Warning := dwFaultActive_Warning OR 16#00000002; (* Warning Bit 1: Purge Péclet Number Deficient (< 95) *)
END_IF;

(* Precursor Differential Pressure Cross-Contamination Trip *)
IF ((ABS(rDeltaP_TMA_mbar) > 0.12) OR (ABS(rDeltaP_H2O_mbar) > 0.12)) AND (iState >= 90) THEN
    dwFaultLatched_Critical := dwFaultLatched_Critical OR 16#00000080; (* Bit 7: Precursor Differential Overpressure (> 0.12 mbar) *)
    iState := 130;
END_IF;

(* --- 3.3 In-Situ Quartz Crystal Microbalance (QCM) Mass & Growth Reckoner --- *)
(* Update QCM 16-element ring buffer for noise suppression *)
aQCM_FreqBuffer[iQCM_BufferIdx] := rQCM_RawFrequency_Hz;
iQCM_BufferIdx := (iQCM_BufferIdx + 1) MOD 16;
rSumTemp := 0.0;
FOR iIdx := 0 TO 15 DO
    rSumTemp := rSumTemp + aQCM_FreqBuffer[iIdx];
END_FOR;
rQCM_FreqFiltered := rSumTemp / 16.0;

(* 4th-order polynomial thermal drift compensation for AT-cut quartz *)
rSumTemp := rQCM_CrystalTemp_degC - rQCM_ReferenceTemp;
rDeltaLambda := (rQCM_PolyCoeff_c1 * rSumTemp) + (rQCM_PolyCoeff_c2 * (rSumTemp**2)) + (rQCM_PolyCoeff_c3 * (rSumTemp**3)) + (rQCM_PolyCoeff_c4 * (rSumTemp**4));
rSumTemp := (rQCM_BaselineFreq - rQCM_FreqFiltered) - rDeltaLambda; (* Temperature-corrected frequency delta [Hz] *)

(* Sauerbrey mass reckoning with Lu-Lewis acoustic Z-match correction *)
IF rSumTemp > 0.0 THEN
    (* Dimensionless acoustic impedance ratio Z_factor = Z_quartz / Z_Al2O3 *)
    rMaxLambdaDiff := rQCM_AcousticImpedance_Quartz / rQCM_AcousticImpedance_Al2O3;
    rDeltaLambda := (rPI * rSumTemp) / rQCM_FreqNominal;
    rQCM_AccumulatedMass_ug_cm2 := (rQCM_AcousticImpedance_Quartz / (rPI * rMaxLambdaDiff)) * ATAN(rMaxLambdaDiff * TAN(rDeltaLambda)) * 1.0E6;
    rAccumulatedFilmThickness_nm := (rQCM_AccumulatedMass_ug_cm2 * 1.0E-2) / rDensity_Al2O3;
ELSE
    rQCM_AccumulatedMass_ug_cm2 := 0.0;
    rAccumulatedFilmThickness_nm := 0.0;
END_IF;

(* Dynamic Growth-Per-Cycle (GPC) Estimation *)
IF (rWebVelocity_m_min > 0.5) AND (iState = 100) THEN
    (* Calculate active spatial deposition cycle frequency: f_cycle = v_web / L_module *)
    rQCM_CyclesCount := rQCM_CyclesCount + ((rWebVelocity_m_min / 60.0) / 0.50) * rTs; (* 0.50 m per module length *)
    IF rQCM_CyclesCount >= 1.0 THEN
        rThicknessDelta_nm := rAccumulatedFilmThickness_nm - rQCM_LastCycleThickness_nm;
        IF rThicknessDelta_nm > 0.0 THEN
            rGrowthRate_A_per_cycle := (rThicknessDelta_nm * 10.0) / rQCM_CyclesCount; (* 1 nm = 10 Angstrom *)
        END_IF;
        rQCM_LastCycleThickness_nm := rAccumulatedFilmThickness_nm;
        rQCM_CyclesCount := 0.0;
    END_IF;
END_IF;

(* QCM Crystal Health & Motional Damping Impedance Check *)
IF rQCM_DampingResistance_Ohm < rQCM_MotionalResistMax THEN
    rQCM_CrystalHealth_pct := 100.0 * (1.0 - (rQCM_DampingResistance_Ohm / rQCM_MotionalResistMax));
ELSE
    rQCM_CrystalHealth_pct := 0.0;
    dwFaultActive_Warning := dwFaultActive_Warning OR 16#00000004; (* Warning Bit 2: QCM Crystal Saturated / Damping Critical *)
END_IF;

(*
====================================================================================================
 SECTION 4: WEB LATERAL WANDER OPTICAL SERVO & SHELTON BEAM MECHANICS
====================================================================================================
*)
(* --- 4.1 Euler-Eytelwein Tension Decoupling Filter --- *)
rFilteredWebTension := (0.92 * rFilteredWebTension) + (0.08 * rWebTension_N);
rCalculatedWebTension_N := rFilteredWebTension;

(* --- 4.2 Lateral Tracking Error Residual & Deadband Handling --- *)
rLateralWebTrackingError_mm := rWebEdgePos_mm - rWebEdgeSetpoint_mm;
IF ABS(rLateralWebTrackingError_mm) < rSteer_Deadband_mm THEN
    rSumTemp := 0.0; (* Inside sensor noise deadband *)
ELSE
    rSumTemp := rLateralWebTrackingError_mm;
END_IF;

(* --- 4.3 Digital Lead-Lag Compensator with Anti-Windup Integration --- *)
IF (iState >= 70) AND (iState <= 110) THEN
    (* Trapezoidal integration with conditional clamping *)
    rSteer_IntegralSum := rSteer_IntegralSum + ((rSteer_Kp / rSteer_Ti) * rSumTemp * rTs);
    IF rSteer_IntegralSum > 8.0 THEN
        rSteer_IntegralSum := 8.0;
    ELSIF rSteer_IntegralSum < -8.0 THEN
        rSteer_IntegralSum := -8.0;
    END_IF;

    (* Derivative lead calculation on error *)
    rDeltaLambda := (rSumTemp - rSteer_LeadLag_State1) / rTs;
    rSteer_LeadLag_State1 := rSumTemp;

    (* Total raw steering command: PID + Tension feedforward *)
    rMaxLambdaDiff := (rSteer_Kp * rSumTemp) + rSteer_IntegralSum + (rSteer_Td * rDeltaLambda) + (rTension_Feedforward_Gain * (rTargetWebTension_N - rFilteredWebTension));

    (* Slew rate limiter: |dr/dt| <= rSteer_SlewMax_mm_s *)
    rDeltaLambda := rMaxLambdaDiff - rEdgeGuideServo_mm;
    IF rDeltaLambda > (rSteer_SlewMax_mm_s * rTs) THEN
        rEdgeGuideServo_mm := rEdgeGuideServo_mm + (rSteer_SlewMax_mm_s * rTs);
    ELSIF rDeltaLambda < -(rSteer_SlewMax_mm_s * rTs) THEN
        rEdgeGuideServo_mm := rEdgeGuideServo_mm - (rSteer_SlewMax_mm_s * rTs);
    ELSE
        rEdgeGuideServo_mm := rMaxLambdaDiff;
    END_IF;

    (* Hardware stroke limits *)
    IF rEdgeGuideServo_mm > rSteer_MaxStroke_mm THEN
        rEdgeGuideServo_mm := rSteer_MaxStroke_mm;
        dwFaultActive_Warning := dwFaultActive_Warning OR 16#00000008; (* Warning Bit 3: Steering Guide Near Positive Stroke Limit *)
    ELSIF rEdgeGuideServo_mm < -rSteer_MaxStroke_mm THEN
        rEdgeGuideServo_mm := -rSteer_MaxStroke_mm;
        dwFaultActive_Warning := dwFaultActive_Warning OR 16#00000010; (* Warning Bit 4: Steering Guide Near Negative Stroke Limit *)
    END_IF;
ELSE
    (* Servo disengaged: Return to neutral mechanical zero *)
    rEdgeGuideServo_mm := 0.0;
    rSteer_IntegralSum := 0.0;
END_IF;

(*
====================================================================================================
 SECTION 5: MIMO STATE-SPACE MODEL & REAL-TIME HILDRETH DUAL QP MPC ENGINE
====================================================================================================
*)
(* --- 5.1 System Matrices Population (Executed Once on Startup or Auto-Tune) --- *)
fbTrigAutoTune(CLK := bAutoTuneRequest);
IF (NOT bMatricesInitialized) OR fbTrigAutoTune.Q THEN
    (* Clear A_Sys, B_Sys, C_Sys, D_Sys *)
    FOR iIdx := 1 TO 8 DO
        FOR jIdx := 1 TO 8 DO
            A_Sys[iIdx, jIdx] := 0.0;
        END_FOR;
        FOR jIdx := 1 TO 4 DO
            B_Sys[iIdx, jIdx] := 0.0;
        END_FOR;
    END_FOR;
    FOR iIdx := 1 TO 4 DO
        FOR jIdx := 1 TO 8 DO
            C_Sys[iIdx, jIdx] := 0.0;
        END_FOR;
        FOR jIdx := 1 TO 4 DO
            D_Sys[iIdx, jIdx] := 0.0;
        END_FOR;
    END_FOR;

    (* Discrete Matrix A_Sys (8x8) at Ts = 0.005s *)
    A_Sys[1, 1] := 0.965;  A_Sys[1, 2] := 0.0048; A_Sys[1, 3] := -0.012; A_Sys[1, 4] := -0.011;
    A_Sys[2, 1] := -1.25;  A_Sys[2, 2] := 0.880;  A_Sys[2, 3] := -0.450; A_Sys[2, 4] := -0.420;
    A_Sys[3, 3] := 0.910;  A_Sys[3, 4] := 0.025;
    A_Sys[4, 3] := 0.022;  A_Sys[4, 4] := 0.915;
    A_Sys[5, 5] := 0.985;  A_Sys[5, 6] := 0.0049;
    A_Sys[6, 5] := -0.85;  A_Sys[6, 6] := 0.920;
    A_Sys[7, 7] := 1.000;  (* Pure integrator for accumulated film thickness *)
    A_Sys[8, 8] := 0.992;  (* Thermal platen slow dynamic decay *)

    (* Discrete Matrix B_Sys (8x4) *)
    B_Sys[1, 1] := -0.085; B_Sys[1, 2] := 0.0012; B_Sys[1, 3] := 0.0005; B_Sys[1, 4] := 0.0;
    B_Sys[2, 1] := -3.450; B_Sys[2, 2] := 0.0450; B_Sys[2, 3] := 0.0150; B_Sys[2, 4] := 0.0;
    B_Sys[3, 1] := 0.015;  B_Sys[3, 2] := 0.0035; B_Sys[3, 3] := -0.008; B_Sys[3, 4] := 0.0;
    B_Sys[4, 1] := 0.014;  B_Sys[4, 2] := 0.0036; B_Sys[4, 3] := 0.0005; B_Sys[4, 4] := -0.007;
    B_Sys[5, 1] := 0.0;    B_Sys[5, 2] := 0.0;    B_Sys[5, 3] := 0.0;    B_Sys[5, 4] := 0.052;
    B_Sys[6, 1] := 0.0;    B_Sys[6, 2] := 0.0;    B_Sys[6, 3] := 0.0;    B_Sys[6, 4] := 2.150;
    B_Sys[7, 1] := 0.0;    B_Sys[7, 2] := 0.0;    B_Sys[7, 3] := 0.0022; B_Sys[7, 4] := 0.0;
    B_Sys[8, 1] := 0.001;  B_Sys[8, 2] := -0.0008;B_Sys[8, 3] := 0.0;    B_Sys[8, 4] := 0.0;

    (* Output Matrix C_Sys (4x8) *)
    C_Sys[1, 1] := 1.0; (* y1: Micro-gap clearance error [um] *)
    C_Sys[2, 3] := 1.0; (* y2: Precursor TMA differential pressure [mbar] *)
    C_Sys[3, 4] := 1.0; (* y3: Precursor H2O differential pressure [mbar] *)
    C_Sys[4, 5] := 1.0; (* y4: Web lateral wander error [mm] *)

    (* MPC Tuning Penalty Matrices *)
    Weight_Q[1] := 15.0;  (* High penalty on micro-gap clearance tracking *)
    Weight_Q[2] := 45.0;  (* Extreme penalty on TMA isolation balance *)
    Weight_Q[3] := 45.0;  (* Extreme penalty on H2O isolation balance *)
    Weight_Q[4] := 8.0;   (* Moderate penalty on web lateral tracking *)

    Weight_R[1] := 0.05;  (* Bleed valve effort penalty *)
    Weight_R[2] := 0.002; (* N2 purge flow effort penalty *)
    Weight_R[3] := 0.10;  (* Precursor dosing effort penalty *)
    Weight_R[4] := 0.08;  (* Steering servo effort penalty *)

    Weight_S[1] := 0.50;  (* Bleed valve rate penalty *)
    Weight_S[2] := 0.05;  (* Purge flow rate penalty *)
    Weight_S[3] := 1.20;  (* Precursor valve pulse slew penalty *)
    Weight_S[4] := 0.80;  (* Steering servo jerk penalty *)

    (* Initialize Condensed Prediction Matrices (Phi_Mat, Gamma_Mat, Hessian_H) *)
    FOR iIdx := 1 TO 20 DO
        FOR jIdx := 1 TO 8 DO
            Phi_Mat[iIdx, jIdx] := 0.0;
        END_FOR;
        FOR jIdx := 1 TO 12 DO
            Gamma_Mat[iIdx, jIdx] := 0.0;
        END_FOR;
    END_FOR;

    (* Populate Phi_Mat (20x8) and Gamma_Mat (20x12) for Np=5, Nc=3 *)
    FOR iIdx := 1 TO 5 DO
        FOR jIdx := 1 TO 4 DO
            mIdx := ((iIdx - 1) * 4) + jIdx;
            FOR kIdx := 1 TO 8 DO
                Phi_Mat[mIdx, kIdx] := C_Sys[jIdx, kIdx] * (A_Sys[kIdx, kIdx]**iIdx);
            END_FOR;
            FOR nIdx := 1 TO 3 DO
                IF iIdx >= nIdx THEN
                    FOR kIdx := 1 TO 4 DO
                        Gamma_Mat[mIdx, ((nIdx - 1) * 4) + kIdx] := C_Sys[jIdx, jIdx] * B_Sys[jIdx, kIdx] * (A_Sys[jIdx, jIdx]**(iIdx - nIdx));
                    END_FOR;
                END_IF;
            END_FOR;
        END_FOR;
    END_FOR;

    (* Construct Condensed Hessian Matrix H = 2 * (Gamma' * Q * Gamma + R + S) *)
    FOR iIdx := 1 TO 12 DO
        FOR jIdx := 1 TO 12 DO
            rSumTemp := 0.0;
            FOR kIdx := 1 TO 20 DO
                mIdx := ((kIdx - 1) MOD 4) + 1;
                rSumTemp := rSumTemp + (Gamma_Mat[kIdx, iIdx] * Weight_Q[mIdx] * Gamma_Mat[kIdx, jIdx]);
            END_FOR;
            Hessian_H[iIdx, jIdx] := 2.0 * rSumTemp;
            IF iIdx = jIdx THEN
                mIdx := ((iIdx - 1) MOD 4) + 1;
                Hessian_H[iIdx, jIdx] := Hessian_H[iIdx, jIdx] + (2.0 * (Weight_R[mIdx] + Weight_S[mIdx]));
            END_IF;
        END_FOR;
    END_FOR;

    (* Invert Hessian via Diagonal Tikhonov Regularization Approximation *)
    FOR iIdx := 1 TO 12 DO
        FOR jIdx := 1 TO 12 DO
            IF iIdx = jIdx THEN
                InvHessian[iIdx, jIdx] := 1.0 / MAX(Hessian_H[iIdx, jIdx], 0.001);
            ELSE
                InvHessian[iIdx, jIdx] := -0.05 * Hessian_H[iIdx, jIdx] / (MAX(Hessian_H[iIdx, iIdx], 0.001) * MAX(Hessian_H[jIdx, jIdx], 0.001));
            END_IF;
        END_FOR;
    END_FOR;

    (* Precompute Dual Hessian Matrix P = E * InvH * E' for 24 box constraints *)
    FOR iIdx := 1 TO 24 DO
        FOR jIdx := 1 TO 24 DO
            QP_P_Mat[iIdx, jIdx] := 0.0;
            IF iIdx = jIdx THEN
                mIdx := ((iIdx - 1) MOD 12) + 1;
                QP_P_Mat[iIdx, jIdx] := InvHessian[mIdx, mIdx];
            END_IF;
        END_FOR;
    END_FOR;
    bMatricesInitialized := TRUE;
END_IF;

(* --- 5.2 Plant Output Residual & State Observer Propagation --- *)
y_Meas[1] := rEstimatedMicroGap_um - rTargetMicroGap_um;
y_Meas[2] := rDeltaP_TMA_mbar;
y_Meas[3] := rDeltaP_H2O_mbar;
y_Meas[4] := rLateralWebTrackingError_mm;

(* Luenberger observer state update: x_hat = A*x_hat + B*u + L*(y - C*x_hat) *)
FOR iIdx := 1 TO 4 DO
    rSumTemp := 0.0;
    FOR jIdx := 1 TO 8 DO
        rSumTemp := rSumTemp + (C_Sys[iIdx, jIdx] * x_Hat[jIdx]);
    END_FOR;
    y_Residual[iIdx] := y_Meas[iIdx] - rSumTemp;
END_FOR;

FOR iIdx := 1 TO 8 DO
    rSumTemp := 0.0;
    FOR jIdx := 1 TO 8 DO
        rSumTemp := rSumTemp + (A_Sys[iIdx, jIdx] * x_Hat[jIdx]);
    END_FOR;
    FOR jIdx := 1 TO 4 DO
        rSumTemp := rSumTemp + (B_Sys[iIdx, jIdx] * u_Ctrl[jIdx]);
    END_FOR;
    (* Observer injection gain: L_diag = 0.25 *)
    IF iIdx <= 4 THEN
        rSumTemp := rSumTemp + (0.25 * y_Residual[iIdx]);
    END_IF;
    x_Hat[iIdx] := rSumTemp;
END_FOR;

(* --- 5.3 MPC Gradient Computation f = 2 * Gamma' * Q * (Phi * x - Y_ref) --- *)
FOR iIdx := 1 TO 20 DO
    rSumTemp := 0.0;
    FOR jIdx := 1 TO 8 DO
        rSumTemp := rSumTemp + (Phi_Mat[iIdx, jIdx] * x_Hat[jIdx]);
    END_FOR;
    y_Predicted[iIdx] := rSumTemp; (* Setpoint Y_ref is regulation to 0 *)
END_FOR;

FOR iIdx := 1 TO 12 DO
    rSumTemp := 0.0;
    FOR jIdx := 1 TO 20 DO
        mIdx := ((jIdx - 1) MOD 4) + 1;
        rSumTemp := rSumTemp + (Gamma_Mat[jIdx, iIdx] * Weight_Q[mIdx] * y_Predicted[jIdx]);
    END_FOR;
    QP_f_Grad[iIdx] := 2.0 * rSumTemp;
END_FOR;

(* --- 5.4 Hildreth Dual Active-Set Quadratic Programming Solver --- *)
(* Formulate constraint vector d = b + E * InvH * f *)
(* Lower and Upper bounds on Delta_u: [-2.0, +2.0] for bleed, [-500, +500] for N2, [-2.5, +2.5] for TMA, [-1.5, +1.5] for steer *)
FOR iIdx := 1 TO 12 DO
    mIdx := ((iIdx - 1) MOD 4) + 1;
    CASE mIdx OF
        1: rSumTemp := 2.0;   (* Bleed valve delta clamp [%] *)
        2: rSumTemp := 450.0; (* N2 purge flow delta clamp [sccm] *)
        3: rSumTemp := 2.5;   (* Precursor pulse delta clamp [%] *)

  The lunar gravitational acceleration is parameterized as g_Moon = 1.625 m/s^2, acting strictly along
  the local vertical axis (zenith-nadir). Due to the absence of a lunar atmosphere, all deceleration,
  attitude stabilization, and trajectory diversion must be achieved exclusively through rocket propulsion.
  The total spacecraft wet mass at powered descent initiation (PDI) is approximately 14,500.0 kg,
  depleting to a dry touchdown mass of approximately 3,200.0 kg after burning cryogenic propellants.
  The required hovering thrust at touchdown mass is: F_hover_dry = 3200 kg * 1.625 m/s^2 = 5,200 N (5.20 kN).
  The maximum deceleration thrust at PDI is: F_max = 65.0 kN. This necessitates an ultra-wide continuous
  deep-throttling capability of 10:1 (65.0 kN down to 6.50 kN) to avoid premature engine shutoff and enable
  a stable, controllable terminal hover and gentle touchdown (v_z <= 1.0 m/s).

  2. VARIABLE-AREA PINTLE INJECTOR FLUID DYNAMICS & 10:1 THROTTLING:
  Deep throttling of cryogenic liquid oxygen (LOX, T_boil = 90.2 K) and liquid methane (LCH4, T_boil = 111.6 K)
  presents severe hydrodynamic and combustion instability challenges. In conventional fixed-geometry injectors,
  throttling flow by a factor of 10 reduces manifold pressure drop (dP_inj ~ m_dot^2) by a factor of 100,
  causing catastrophic loss of injection acoustic stiffness, severe chugging (10-50 Hz), and geysering.
  This system overcomes throttling collapse via a high-precision electro-mechanically driven variable-area
  coaxial pintle sleeve. By linearly translating the pintle sleeve over an axial stroke x_p in [1.85, 18.50] mm,
  both the annular fuel (LCH4) gap area A_fuel(x_p) and the radial oxidizer (LOX) slot area A_ox(x_p) are
  simultaneously adjusted in direct proportion to mass flow rate. Consequently, injection fluid velocity and
  manifold differential pressure ratio (dP_inj / P_c >= 0.18) remain strictly constant across the entire 10:1
  dynamic operating envelope, eliminating acoustic resonance, droplet atomization collapse, and combustion chug.

  3. SUB-KELVIN THERMODYNAMIC VENT SYSTEM (TVS) CRYOGENIC RECOVERY:
  Deep-space vacuum solar radiation, internal electronics conduction, and lunar surface infrared albedo
  induce continuous thermal heat leaks into the vacuum-jacketed MLI cryogenic tanks. Under low-g and terminal
  braking deceleration, thermal stratification rapidly develops: warm buoyant fluid collects near the liquid-vapor
  interface, driving up ullage pressure and inducing cavitation in turbo-pumps or flowmeter valves.
  The active Thermodynamic Vent System (TVS) operates in two synergistic thermodynamic modes:
    a. Active Propellant Destratification: Submerged brushless cryogenic mixer pumps continuously circulate bulk
       liquid through high-velocity spray bars, destroying thermal boundary layers and homogenizing tank temperature.
    b. Joule-Thomson Overboard Thermodynamic Cooling: A micro-bleed liquid stream is extracted, passed through an
       active Joule-Thomson throttling expansion valve where isenthalpic pressure drop flashes the fluid into a
       sub-Kelvin two-phase mixture (dT_JT ~ -4.5 K). This subcooled fluid circulates through a internal regenerative
       heat exchanger coiled inside the tank and along the vapor-cooled shield (VCS), subcooling the bulk liquid
       by 0.85 K below saturation without dumping high-density liquid overboard, venting only dry superheated vapor.

  4. GUIDANCE, NAVIGATION & CONTROL: DISCRETE-TIME STATE-SPACE MPC:
  The lunar descent trajectory is governed by a 6-DOF discrete-time state-space Model Predictive Controller (MPC).
  State vector x = [p_z, v_z, p_x, v_x, p_y, v_y]^T comprises vertical and horizontal topocentric coordinates.
  Input vector u = [a_z, a_x, a_y]^T comprises net commanded acceleration components.
  Continuous-time kinematics:
    dp_z/dt = v_z,   dv_z/dt = a_z - g_Moon
    dp_x/dt = v_x,   dv_x/dt = a_x
    dp_y/dt = v_y,   dv_y/dt = a_y
  Discretized with sample period dt = 0.010 s using exact matrix exponential integration:
    x(k+1) = A * x(k) + B * u(k) + d(k)
    y(k)   = C * x(k) + D * u(k)
  An online quadratic programming (QP) solver executes over a receding prediction horizon (N_p = 5), minimizing
  trajectory tracking error and control action jerk while strictly enforcing thrust magnitude constraints
  (6.50 kN <= F <= 65.00 kN) and dual-axis gimbal angle limits (max +/- 8.0 deg, slew rate <= 20.0 deg/s).

  5. 2oo3 TRIPLE MODULAR REDUNDANT (TMR) SENSORY ARCHITECTURE & HAZARD AVOIDANCE:
  Flight-critical telemetry is monitored via triple-modular redundant (2oo3) sensor buses:
    - Triplicate Radar Altimeters (Ch A, Ch B, Ch C) for terrain distance [m]
    - Triplicate Doppler Velocity Radars (Ch A, Ch B, Ch C) for vertical velocity [m/s]
    - Triplicate Cryogenic LOX Tank Pressure Transducers [bar]
    - Triplicate Cryogenic LOX Tank Temperature RTDs [K]
    - Triplicate Cryogenic LCH4 Tank Pressure Transducers [bar]
    - Triplicate Cryogenic LCH4 Tank Temperature RTDs [K]
  Each channel undergoes rigorous range verification and inter-channel cross-discrepancy monitoring.
  Median voting is executed during healthy 3oo3 states, with automated bumpless degradation to 1oo2 averaging,
  1oo1 singular fallback, or autonomous emergency abort upon multi-channel failure.
  During terminal approach (altitude 250 m down to 30 m), an active Flash LIDAR digital elevation model (DEM)
  detects crater rims, boulders, and steep slopes (> 7 deg). If a hazard is detected, the flight computer
  computes a 5th-order minimum-jerk divert polynomial, seamlessly injecting lateral retargeting offsets into the MPC.
====================================================================================================
*)
