    rSloshFilter_Pitch_Y1           : REAL := 0.0; (* Biquad Notch Filter delay memory Y1 *)
    rSloshFilter_Pitch_Y2           : REAL := 0.0; (* Biquad Notch Filter delay memory Y2 *)
    rSloshFilter_Yaw_X1             : REAL := 0.0;
    rSloshFilter_Yaw_X2             : REAL := 0.0;
    rSloshFilter_Yaw_Y1             : REAL := 0.0;
    rSloshFilter_Yaw_Y2             : REAL := 0.0;
    (* Discrete Biquad Notch Filter Coefficients (f_notch = 1.45 Hz, Q = 4.0 at fs = 100 Hz) *)
    c_b0_notch                      : REAL :=  0.9572;
    c_b1_notch                      : REAL := -1.8967;
    c_b2_notch                      : REAL :=  0.9572;
    c_a1_notch                      : REAL := -1.8967;
    c_a2_notch                      : REAL :=  0.9144;
    rPrevGimbalPitchCmd_deg         : REAL := 0.0;
    rPrevGimbalYawCmd_deg           : REAL := 0.0;

    (* ========================================================================================= *)
    (* 8. TEMPORARY CALCULATION ACCUMULATORS & LOOP INDICES                                     *)
    (* ========================================================================================= *)
    iLoopI                          : INT := 1;
    iLoopJ                          : INT := 1;
    iLoopK                          : INT := 1;
    rTempSum                        : REAL := 0.0;
    rNormAccel                      : REAL := 0.0;
    rTotalThrustForce_N             : REAL := 0.0;
    rPitchAngleRad                  : REAL := 0.0;
    rYawAngleRad                    : REAL := 0.0;
    rTauDivert                      : REAL := 0.0;
    rTauSquared                     : REAL := 0.0;
    rTauCubed                       : REAL := 0.0;
    rPolyScale                      : REAL := 0.0;
END_VAR

(* ============================================================================================= *)
(* SECTION 1: EXECUTION TASK CLOCK, TIMER TICK & INITIALIZATION ACCUMULATORS                     *)
(* ============================================================================================= *)
rStateTimer_Sec := rStateTimer_Sec + c_rCycleDeltaT_s;

(* Failsafe Master Reset Permissive Check *)
IF bResetFaults THEN
    wFaultWord_Critical := 16#0000;
    wFaultWord_Degraded := 16#0000;
    wDiagnosticSubKelvin_LOX := 16#0000;
    wDiagnosticSubKelvin_LCH4 := 16#0000;
    bTouchdownConfirmed := FALSE;
    rTouchdownLatchTimer_Sec := 0.0;
END_IF;

(* ============================================================================================= *)
(* SECTION 2: 2oo3 TRIPLE MODULAR REDUNDANT (TMR) SENSORY VOTING & DEGRADATION ENGINE            *)
(* ============================================================================================= *)
(* --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* 2.1 Radar Altimeter 2oo3 Validation & Median Voting Logic                                     *)
(* --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* Range sanity check: Radar Altimeter valid envelope [0.0 m to 8000.0 m] *)
bHealth_Alt_ChA := (rRadarAlt_ChA_m >= 0.0) AND (rRadarAlt_ChA_m <= 8000.0);
bHealth_Alt_ChB := (rRadarAlt_ChB_m >= 0.0) AND (rRadarAlt_ChB_m <= 8000.0);
bHealth_Alt_ChC := (rRadarAlt_ChC_m >= 0.0) AND (rRadarAlt_ChC_m <= 8000.0);

IF bHealth_Alt_ChA AND bHealth_Alt_ChB AND bHealth_Alt_ChC THEN
    (* All 3 channels online: check cross-channel discrepancies *)
    IF (ABS(rRadarAlt_ChA_m - rRadarAlt_ChB_m) > c_rAltTol_m) OR
       (ABS(rRadarAlt_ChB_m - rRadarAlt_ChC_m) > c_rAltTol_m) OR
       (ABS(rRadarAlt_ChA_m - rRadarAlt_ChC_m) > c_rAltTol_m) THEN
        rTimer_Alt_Discrepancy := rTimer_Alt_Discrepancy + c_rCycleDeltaT_s;
        IF rTimer_Alt_Discrepancy >= 0.150 THEN
            wFaultWord_Degraded.0 := TRUE; (* Altimeter discrepancy latch *)
        END_IF;
    ELSE
        rTimer_Alt_Discrepancy := 0.0;
    END_IF;
    (* True Median Voting 3oo3 Algorithm *)
    IF ((rRadarAlt_ChA_m <= rRadarAlt_ChB_m) AND (rRadarAlt_ChB_m <= rRadarAlt_ChC_m)) OR
       ((rRadarAlt_ChC_m <= rRadarAlt_ChB_m) AND (rRadarAlt_ChB_m <= rRadarAlt_ChA_m)) THEN
        rVoted_Alt_m := rRadarAlt_ChB_m;
    ELSIF ((rRadarAlt_ChB_m <= rRadarAlt_ChA_m) AND (rRadarAlt_ChA_m <= rRadarAlt_ChC_m)) OR
          ((rRadarAlt_ChC_m <= rRadarAlt_ChA_m) AND (rRadarAlt_ChA_m <= rRadarAlt_ChB_m)) THEN
        rVoted_Alt_m := rRadarAlt_ChA_m;
    ELSE
        rVoted_Alt_m := rRadarAlt_ChC_m;
    END_IF;
    iDegradeMode_Alt := 0; (* Nominal 3oo3 *)
ELSIF bHealth_Alt_ChA AND bHealth_Alt_ChB THEN
    (* Channel C failed: Degrade to 1oo2 averaging between A and B *)
    rVoted_Alt_m := (rRadarAlt_ChA_m + rRadarAlt_ChB_m) * 0.50;
    iDegradeMode_Alt := 1; (* Degraded 1oo2 *)
    wFaultWord_Degraded.1 := TRUE;
ELSIF bHealth_Alt_ChB AND bHealth_Alt_ChC THEN
    rVoted_Alt_m := (rRadarAlt_ChB_m + rRadarAlt_ChC_m) * 0.50;
    iDegradeMode_Alt := 1;
    wFaultWord_Degraded.1 := TRUE;
ELSIF bHealth_Alt_ChA AND bHealth_Alt_ChC THEN
    rVoted_Alt_m := (rRadarAlt_ChA_m + rRadarAlt_ChC_m) * 0.50;
    iDegradeMode_Alt := 1;
    wFaultWord_Degraded.1 := TRUE;
ELSIF bHealth_Alt_ChA THEN
    rVoted_Alt_m := rRadarAlt_ChA_m;
    iDegradeMode_Alt := 2; (* Degraded 1oo1 single string *)
    wFaultWord_Degraded.2 := TRUE;
ELSIF bHealth_Alt_ChB THEN
    rVoted_Alt_m := rRadarAlt_ChB_m;
    iDegradeMode_Alt := 2;
    wFaultWord_Degraded.2 := TRUE;
ELSIF bHealth_Alt_ChC THEN
    rVoted_Alt_m := rRadarAlt_ChC_m;
    iDegradeMode_Alt := 2;
    wFaultWord_Degraded.2 := TRUE;
ELSE
    (* All 3 Radar Altimeters Failed: Critical Bus Fault *)
    iDegradeMode_Alt := 3;
    wFaultWord_Critical.0 := TRUE; (* Altimeter loss triggers abort *)
END_IF;

(* --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* 2.2 Doppler Velocity Radar 2oo3 Validation & Median Voting Logic                              *)
(* --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
bHealth_VelZ_ChA := (rDopplerVel_Z_ChA_mps >= -250.0) AND (rDopplerVel_Z_ChA_mps <= 50.0);
bHealth_VelZ_ChB := (rDopplerVel_Z_ChB_mps >= -250.0) AND (rDopplerVel_Z_ChB_mps <= 50.0);
bHealth_VelZ_ChC := (rDopplerVel_Z_ChC_mps >= -250.0) AND (rDopplerVel_Z_ChC_mps <= 50.0);

IF bHealth_VelZ_ChA AND bHealth_VelZ_ChB AND bHealth_VelZ_ChC THEN
    IF (ABS(rDopplerVel_Z_ChA_mps - rDopplerVel_Z_ChB_mps) > c_rVelZTol_mps) OR
       (ABS(rDopplerVel_Z_ChB_mps - rDopplerVel_Z_ChC_mps) > c_rVelZTol_mps) OR
       (ABS(rDopplerVel_Z_ChA_mps - rDopplerVel_Z_ChC_mps) > c_rVelZTol_mps) THEN
        rTimer_VelZ_Discrepancy := rTimer_VelZ_Discrepancy + c_rCycleDeltaT_s;
        IF rTimer_VelZ_Discrepancy >= 0.150 THEN
            wFaultWord_Degraded.3 := TRUE;
        END_IF;
    ELSE
        rTimer_VelZ_Discrepancy := 0.0;
    END_IF;
    (* Median Selection for Velocity *)
    IF ((rDopplerVel_Z_ChA_mps <= rDopplerVel_Z_ChB_mps) AND (rDopplerVel_Z_ChB_mps <= rDopplerVel_Z_ChC_mps)) OR
       ((rDopplerVel_Z_ChC_mps <= rDopplerVel_Z_ChB_mps) AND (rDopplerVel_Z_ChB_mps <= rDopplerVel_Z_ChA_mps)) THEN
        rVoted_VelZ_mps := rDopplerVel_Z_ChB_mps;
    ELSIF ((rDopplerVel_Z_ChB_mps <= rDopplerVel_Z_ChA_mps) AND (rDopplerVel_Z_ChA_mps <= rDopplerVel_Z_ChC_mps)) OR
          ((rDopplerVel_Z_ChC_mps <= rDopplerVel_Z_ChA_mps) AND (rDopplerVel_Z_ChA_mps <= rDopplerVel_Z_ChB_mps)) THEN
        rVoted_VelZ_mps := rDopplerVel_Z_ChA_mps;
    ELSE
        rVoted_VelZ_mps := rDopplerVel_Z_ChC_mps;
    END_IF;
    iDegradeMode_VelZ := 0;
ELSIF bHealth_VelZ_ChA AND bHealth_VelZ_ChB THEN
    rVoted_VelZ_mps := (rDopplerVel_Z_ChA_mps + rDopplerVel_Z_ChB_mps) * 0.50;
    iDegradeMode_VelZ := 1;
    wFaultWord_Degraded.4 := TRUE;
ELSIF bHealth_VelZ_ChB AND bHealth_VelZ_ChC THEN
    rVoted_VelZ_mps := (rDopplerVel_Z_ChB_mps + rDopplerVel_Z_ChC_mps) * 0.50;
    iDegradeMode_VelZ := 1;
    wFaultWord_Degraded.4 := TRUE;
ELSIF bHealth_VelZ_ChA AND bHealth_VelZ_ChC THEN
    rVoted_VelZ_mps := (rDopplerVel_Z_ChA_mps + rDopplerVel_Z_ChC_mps) * 0.50;
    iDegradeMode_VelZ := 1;
    wFaultWord_Degraded.4 := TRUE;
ELSIF bHealth_VelZ_ChA THEN
    rVoted_VelZ_mps := rDopplerVel_Z_ChA_mps;
    iDegradeMode_VelZ := 2;
    wFaultWord_Degraded.5 := TRUE;
ELSIF bHealth_VelZ_ChB THEN
    rVoted_VelZ_mps := rDopplerVel_Z_ChB_mps;
    iDegradeMode_VelZ := 2;
    wFaultWord_Degraded.5 := TRUE;
ELSIF bHealth_VelZ_ChC THEN
    rVoted_VelZ_mps := rDopplerVel_Z_ChC_mps;
    iDegradeMode_VelZ := 2;
    wFaultWord_Degraded.5 := TRUE;
ELSE
    iDegradeMode_VelZ := 3;
    wFaultWord_Critical.1 := TRUE; (* Doppler failure *)
END_IF;

(* --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* 2.3 LOX Propellant Tank Pressure & Temperature 2oo3 Voting Logic                              *)
(* --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
bHealth_PressLOX_ChA := (rTankPress_LOX_ChA_bar >= 0.50) AND (rTankPress_LOX_ChA_bar <= 6.00);
bHealth_PressLOX_ChB := (rTankPress_LOX_ChB_bar >= 0.50) AND (rTankPress_LOX_ChB_bar <= 6.00);
bHealth_PressLOX_ChC := (rTankPress_LOX_ChC_bar >= 0.50) AND (rTankPress_LOX_ChC_bar <= 6.00);

IF bHealth_PressLOX_ChA AND bHealth_PressLOX_ChB AND bHealth_PressLOX_ChC THEN
    IF ((rTankPress_LOX_ChA_bar <= rTankPress_LOX_ChB_bar) AND (rTankPress_LOX_ChB_bar <= rTankPress_LOX_ChC_bar)) OR
       ((rTankPress_LOX_ChC_bar <= rTankPress_LOX_ChB_bar) AND (rTankPress_LOX_ChB_bar <= rTankPress_LOX_ChA_bar)) THEN
        rVoted_TankPress_LOX_bar := rTankPress_LOX_ChB_bar;
    ELSIF ((rTankPress_LOX_ChB_bar <= rTankPress_LOX_ChA_bar) AND (rTankPress_LOX_ChA_bar <= rTankPress_LOX_ChC_bar)) OR
          ((rTankPress_LOX_ChC_bar <= rTankPress_LOX_ChA_bar) AND (rTankPress_LOX_ChA_bar <= rTankPress_LOX_ChB_bar)) THEN
        rVoted_TankPress_LOX_bar := rTankPress_LOX_ChA_bar;
    ELSE
        rVoted_TankPress_LOX_bar := rTankPress_LOX_ChC_bar;
    END_IF;
    iDegradeMode_PressLOX := 0;
ELSIF bHealth_PressLOX_ChA AND bHealth_PressLOX_ChB THEN
    rVoted_TankPress_LOX_bar := (rTankPress_LOX_ChA_bar + rTankPress_LOX_ChB_bar) * 0.50;
    iDegradeMode_PressLOX := 1;
ELSIF bHealth_PressLOX_ChB AND bHealth_PressLOX_ChC THEN
    rVoted_TankPress_LOX_bar := (rTankPress_LOX_ChB_bar + rTankPress_LOX_ChC_bar) * 0.50;
    iDegradeMode_PressLOX := 1;
ELSIF bHealth_PressLOX_ChA AND bHealth_PressLOX_ChC THEN
    rVoted_TankPress_LOX_bar := (rTankPress_LOX_ChA_bar + rTankPress_LOX_ChC_bar) * 0.50;
    iDegradeMode_PressLOX := 1;
ELSE
    rVoted_TankPress_LOX_bar := 2.20; (* Default safe hold *)
    iDegradeMode_PressLOX := 3;
    wFaultWord_Critical.2 := TRUE;
END_IF;

(* LOX Temperature 2oo3 Voting *)
bHealth_TempLOX_ChA := (rTankTemp_LOX_ChA_K >= 70.0) AND (rTankTemp_LOX_ChA_K <= 110.0);
bHealth_TempLOX_ChB := (rTankTemp_LOX_ChB_K >= 70.0) AND (rTankTemp_LOX_ChB_K <= 110.0);
bHealth_TempLOX_ChC := (rTankTemp_LOX_ChC_K >= 70.0) AND (rTankTemp_LOX_ChC_K <= 110.0);

IF bHealth_TempLOX_ChA AND bHealth_TempLOX_ChB AND bHealth_TempLOX_ChC THEN
    IF ((rTankTemp_LOX_ChA_K <= rTankTemp_LOX_ChB_K) AND (rTankTemp_LOX_ChB_K <= rTankTemp_LOX_ChC_K)) OR
       ((rTankTemp_LOX_ChC_K <= rTankTemp_LOX_ChB_K) AND (rTankTemp_LOX_ChB_K <= rTankTemp_LOX_ChA_K)) THEN
        rVoted_TankTemp_LOX_K := rTankTemp_LOX_ChB_K;
    ELSIF ((rTankTemp_LOX_ChB_K <= rTankTemp_LOX_ChA_K) AND (rTankTemp_LOX_ChA_K <= rTankTemp_LOX_ChC_K)) OR
          ((rTankTemp_LOX_ChC_K <= rTankTemp_LOX_ChA_K) AND (rTankTemp_LOX_ChA_K <= rTankTemp_LOX_ChB_K)) THEN
        rVoted_TankTemp_LOX_K := rTankTemp_LOX_ChA_K;
    ELSE
        rVoted_TankTemp_LOX_K := rTankTemp_LOX_ChC_K;
    END_IF;
ELSE
    rVoted_TankTemp_LOX_K := 90.00;
END_IF;

(* --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* 2.4 LCH4 Propellant Tank Pressure & Temperature 2oo3 Voting Logic                             *)
(* --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
bHealth_PressLCH4_ChA := (rTankPress_LCH4_ChA_bar >= 0.50) AND (rTankPress_LCH4_ChA_bar <= 6.00);
bHealth_PressLCH4_ChB := (rTankPress_LCH4_ChB_bar >= 0.50) AND (rTankPress_LCH4_ChB_bar <= 6.00);
bHealth_PressLCH4_ChC := (rTankPress_LCH4_ChC_bar >= 0.50) AND (rTankPress_LCH4_ChC_bar <= 6.00);

IF bHealth_PressLCH4_ChA AND bHealth_PressLCH4_ChB AND bHealth_PressLCH4_ChC THEN
    IF ((rTankPress_LCH4_ChA_bar <= rTankPress_LCH4_ChB_bar) AND (rTankPress_LCH4_ChB_bar <= rTankPress_LCH4_ChC_bar)) OR
       ((rTankPress_LCH4_ChC_bar <= rTankPress_LCH4_ChB_bar) AND (rTankPress_LCH4_ChB_bar <= rTankPress_LCH4_ChA_bar)) THEN
        rVoted_TankPress_LCH4_bar := rTankPress_LCH4_ChB_bar;
    ELSIF ((rTankPress_LCH4_ChB_bar <= rTankPress_LCH4_ChA_bar) AND (rTankPress_LCH4_ChA_bar <= rTankPress_LCH4_ChC_bar)) OR
          ((rTankPress_LCH4_ChC_bar <= rTankPress_LCH4_ChA_bar) AND (rTankPress_LCH4_ChA_bar <= rTankPress_LCH4_ChB_bar)) THEN
        rVoted_TankPress_LCH4_bar := rTankPress_LCH4_ChA_bar;
    ELSE
        rVoted_TankPress_LCH4_bar := rTankPress_LCH4_ChC_bar;
    END_IF;
    iDegradeMode_PressLCH4 := 0;
ELSIF bHealth_PressLCH4_ChA AND bHealth_PressLCH4_ChB THEN
    rVoted_TankPress_LCH4_bar := (rTankPress_LCH4_ChA_bar + rTankPress_LCH4_ChB_bar) * 0.50;
    iDegradeMode_PressLCH4 := 1;
ELSIF bHealth_PressLCH4_ChB AND bHealth_PressLCH4_ChC THEN
    rVoted_TankPress_LCH4_bar := (rTankPress_LCH4_ChB_bar + rTankPress_LCH4_ChC_bar) * 0.50;
    iDegradeMode_PressLCH4 := 1;
ELSIF bHealth_PressLCH4_ChA AND bHealth_PressLCH4_ChC THEN
    rVoted_TankPress_LCH4_bar := (rTankPress_LCH4_ChA_bar + rTankPress_LCH4_ChC_bar) * 0.50;
    iDegradeMode_PressLCH4 := 1;
ELSE
    rVoted_TankPress_LCH4_bar := 2.20;
    iDegradeMode_PressLCH4 := 3;
    wFaultWord_Critical.3 := TRUE;
END_IF;

(* LCH4 Temperature 2oo3 Voting *)
bHealth_TempLCH4_ChA := (rTankTemp_LCH4_ChA_K >= 90.0) AND (rTankTemp_LCH4_ChA_K <= 130.0);
bHealth_TempLCH4_ChB := (rTankTemp_LCH4_ChB_K >= 90.0) AND (rTankTemp_LCH4_ChB_K <= 130.0);
bHealth_TempLCH4_ChC := (rTankTemp_LCH4_ChC_K >= 90.0) AND (rTankTemp_LCH4_ChC_K <= 130.0);

IF bHealth_TempLCH4_ChA AND bHealth_TempLCH4_ChB AND bHealth_TempLCH4_ChC THEN
    IF ((rTankTemp_LCH4_ChA_K <= rTankTemp_LCH4_ChB_K) AND (rTankTemp_LCH4_ChB_K <= rTankTemp_LCH4_ChC_K)) OR
       ((rTankTemp_LCH4_ChC_K <= rTankTemp_LCH4_ChB_K) AND (rTankTemp_LCH4_ChB_K <= rTankTemp_LCH4_ChA_K)) THEN
        rVoted_TankTemp_LCH4_K := rTankTemp_LCH4_ChB_K;
    ELSIF ((rTankTemp_LCH4_ChB_K <= rTankTemp_LCH4_ChA_K) AND (rTankTemp_LCH4_ChA_K <= rTankTemp_LCH4_ChC_K)) OR
          ((rTankTemp_LCH4_ChC_K <= rTankTemp_LCH4_ChA_K) AND (rTankTemp_LCH4_ChA_K <= rTankTemp_LCH4_ChB_K)) THEN
        rVoted_TankTemp_LCH4_K := rTankTemp_LCH4_ChA_K;
    ELSE
        rVoted_TankTemp_LCH4_K := rTankTemp_LCH4_ChC_K;
    END_IF;
ELSE
    rVoted_TankTemp_LCH4_K := 111.00;
END_IF;

(* ============================================================================================= *)
(* SECTION 3: SUB-KELVIN THERMODYNAMIC VENT SYSTEM (TVS) PROPELLANT BOIL-OFF CONTROL           *)
(* ============================================================================================= *)
(* --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* 3.1 Thermodynamic Saturation Pressure/Temperature Polynomial Approximation                   *)
(* Clapeyron-Antoine Curve Fit: LOX Saturation: T_sat = 68.15 + 10.35*P - 0.72*P^2 [K]         *)
(* --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
rLOX_SatTemp_Calculated_K := 68.15 + (10.35 * rVoted_TankPress_LOX_bar) - (0.72 * rVoted_TankPress_LOX_bar * rVoted_TankPress_LOX_bar);
rLOX_SubcoolingMargin_K := rLOX_SatTemp_Calculated_K - rVoted_TankTemp_LOX_K;

(* LCH4 Saturation: T_sat = 88.50 + 11.20*P - 0.81*P^2 [K] *)
rLCH4_SatTemp_Calculated_K := 88.50 + (11.20 * rVoted_TankPress_LCH4_bar) - (0.81 * rVoted_TankPress_LCH4_bar * rVoted_TankPress_LCH4_bar);
rLCH4_SubcoolingMargin_K := rLCH4_SatTemp_Calculated_K - rVoted_TankTemp_LCH4_K;

(* Status Bitmask Diagnostic Logging *)
wDiagnosticSubKelvin_LOX.0 := (rLOX_SubcoolingMargin_K < 0.85); (* Sub-Kelvin threshold warning *)
wDiagnosticSubKelvin_LOX.1 := (rVoted_TankPress_LOX_bar > 2.80); (* Ullage overpressure *)
wDiagnosticSubKelvin_LCH4.0 := (rLCH4_SubcoolingMargin_K < 0.85);
wDiagnosticSubKelvin_LCH4.1 := (rVoted_TankPress_LCH4_bar > 2.80);

(* --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* 3.2 LOX TVS Joule-Thomson Vent Valve Modulating Closed-Loop Controller                       *)
(* Target Ullage Pressure: 2.15 bar. If subcooling margin drops < 0.85 K, JT valve cracks open  *)
(* --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
IF (rVoted_TankPress_LOX_bar > 2.15) OR (rLOX_SubcoolingMargin_K < 0.85) THEN
    (* Closed-loop proportional-integral expansion throttling *)
    rTempSum := (rVoted_TankPress_LOX_bar - 2.15) * 45.0 + (0.85 - rLOX_SubcoolingMargin_K) * 20.0;
    rLOX_TVS_PID_Integral := rLOX_TVS_PID_Integral + (rTempSum * c_rCycleDeltaT_s * 0.10);
    IF rLOX_TVS_PID_Integral > 40.0 THEN
        rLOX_TVS_PID_Integral := 40.0;
    ELSIF rLOX_TVS_PID_Integral < 0.0 THEN
        rLOX_TVS_PID_Integral := 0.0;
    END_IF;
    rVentValve_LOX_Cmd_Pct := rTempSum + rLOX_TVS_PID_Integral;
    (* Activate submerged destratification mixer pump *)
    bTVS_MixerPump_LOX_Cmd := TRUE;
    rMixerPumpRunTimer_LOX_Sec := rMixerPumpRunTimer_LOX_Sec + c_rCycleDeltaT_s;
ELSE
    rLOX_TVS_PID_Integral := rLOX_TVS_PID_Integral - (c_rCycleDeltaT_s * 2.0);
    IF rLOX_TVS_PID_Integral < 0.0 THEN rLOX_TVS_PID_Integral := 0.0; END_IF;
    rVentValve_LOX_Cmd_Pct := 0.0;
    bTVS_MixerPump_LOX_Cmd := FALSE;
    rMixerPumpRunTimer_LOX_Sec := 0.0;
END_IF;

(* Clamp LOX JT Valve [0.0% to 100.0%] *)
IF rVentValve_LOX_Cmd_Pct > 100.0 THEN
    rVentValve_LOX_Cmd_Pct := 100.0;
ELSIF rVentValve_LOX_Cmd_Pct < 0.0 THEN
    rVentValve_LOX_Cmd_Pct := 0.0;
END_IF;

(* --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* 3.3 LCH4 TVS Joule-Thomson Vent Valve Modulating Closed-Loop Controller                      *)
(* --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
IF (rVoted_TankPress_LCH4_bar > 2.15) OR (rLCH4_SubcoolingMargin_K < 0.85) THEN
    rTempSum := (rVoted_TankPress_LCH4_bar - 2.15) * 45.0 + (0.85 - rLCH4_SubcoolingMargin_K) * 20.0;
    rLCH4_TVS_PID_Integral := rLCH4_TVS_PID_Integral + (rTempSum * c_rCycleDeltaT_s * 0.10);
    IF rLCH4_TVS_PID_Integral > 40.0 THEN
        rLCH4_TVS_PID_Integral := 40.0;
    ELSIF rLCH4_TVS_PID_Integral < 0.0 THEN
        rLCH4_TVS_PID_Integral := 0.0;
    END_IF;
    rVentValve_LCH4_Cmd_Pct := rTempSum + rLCH4_TVS_PID_Integral;
    bTVS_MixERPump_LCH4_Cmd := TRUE;
    rMixerPumpRunTimer_LCH4_Sec := rMixerPumpRunTimer_LCH4_Sec + c_rCycleDeltaT_s;
ELSE
    rLCH4_TVS_PID_Integral := rLCH4_TVS_PID_Integral - (c_rCycleDeltaT_s * 2.0);
    IF rLCH4_TVS_PID_Integral < 0.0 THEN rLCH4_TVS_PID_Integral := 0.0; END_IF;
    rVentValve_LCH4_Cmd_Pct := 0.0;
    bTVS_MixerPump_LCH4_Cmd := FALSE;
    rMixerPumpRunTimer_LCH4_Sec := 0.0;
END_IF;

IF rVentValve_LCH4_Cmd_Pct > 100.0 THEN
    rVentValve_LCH4_Cmd_Pct := 100.0;
ELSIF rVentValve_LCH4_Cmd_Pct < 0.0 THEN
    rVentValve_LCH4_Cmd_Pct := 0.0;
END_IF;

(* ============================================================================================= *)
(* SECTION 4: FLASH LIDAR TERRAIN HAZARD EVALUATION & RETARGETING DIVERT PLANNER                *)
(* ============================================================================================= *)
(* Trigger Criteria: Active between 250 m and 30 m altitude, hazard score > 0.45 or slope > 7.0 deg *)
IF (rVoted_Alt_m <= 250.0) AND (rVoted_Alt_m >= 30.0) AND (NOT bDivertInitiated) THEN
    IF (rLidarHazardScore_Norm >= 0.45) OR (rLidarSlope_deg >= 7.0) THEN
        (* Initialize Autonomous Hazard Divert Maneuver *)
        bDivertInitiated := TRUE;
        bHazardAvoidanceActive := TRUE;
        rDivertTimer_Sec := 0.0;
        rDivertOrigin_X_m := rNavPosition_X_m;
        rDivertOrigin_Y_m := rNavPosition_Y_m;
        (* Clamp maximum autonomous lateral translation to 65.0 meters *)
        rDivertTarget_X_m := rNavPosition_X_m + rLidarTargetOffset_X_m;
        rDivertTarget_Y_m := rNavPosition_Y_m + rLidarTargetOffset_Y_m;
        IF (rDivertTarget_X_m - rDivertOrigin_X_m) > 65.0 THEN
            rDivertTarget_X_m := rDivertOrigin_X_m + 65.0;
        ELSIF (rDivertTarget_X_m - rDivertOrigin_X_m) < -65.0 THEN
            rDivertTarget_X_m := rDivertOrigin_X_m - 65.0;
        END_IF;
        IF (rDivertTarget_Y_m - rDivertOrigin_Y_m) > 65.0 THEN
            rDivertTarget_Y_m := rDivertOrigin_Y_m + 65.0;
        ELSIF (rDivertTarget_Y_m - rDivertOrigin_Y_m) < -65.0 THEN
            rDivertTarget_Y_m := rDivertOrigin_Y_m - 65.0;
        END_IF;
    END_IF;
END_IF;

(* Quintic Minimum-Jerk Polynomial Divert Trajectory Profile Generation *)
IF bDivertInitiated THEN
    rDivertTimer_Sec := rDivertTimer_Sec + c_rCycleDeltaT_s;
    IF rDivertTimer_Sec < rDivertDuration_Sec THEN
        (* Normalized tau in [0.0, 1.0] *)
        rTauDivert := rDivertTimer_Sec / rDivertDuration_Sec;
        rTauSquared := rTauDivert * rTauDivert;
        rTauCubed   := rTauSquared * rTauDivert;
        (* Quintic smooth step: s(tau) = 10*tau^3 - 15*tau^4 + 6*tau^5 *)
        rPolyScale := (10.0 * rTauCubed) - (15.0 * rTauSquared * rTauDivert) + (6.0 * rTauCubed * rTauSquared);
        rDivertCmd_PosX_m := rDivertOrigin_X_m + ((rDivertTarget_X_m - rDivertOrigin_X_m) * rPolyScale);
        rDivertCmd_PosY_m := rDivertOrigin_Y_m + ((rDivertTarget_Y_m - rDivertOrigin_Y_m) * rPolyScale);
        (* Velocity derivative: ds/dtau = 30*tau^2 - 60*tau^3 + 30*tau^4 *)
        rPolyScale := ((30.0 * rTauSquared) - (60.0 * rTauCubed) + (30.0 * rTauCubed * rTauDivert)) / rDivertDuration_Sec;
        rDivertCmd_VelX_mps := (rDivertTarget_X_m - rDivertOrigin_X_m) * rPolyScale;
        rDivertCmd_VelY_mps := (rDivertTarget_Y_m - rDivertOrigin_Y_m) * rPolyScale;
    ELSE
        rDivertCmd_PosX_m := rDivertTarget_X_m;
        rDivertCmd_PosY_m := rDivertTarget_Y_m;
        rDivertCmd_VelX_mps := 0.0;
        rDivertCmd_VelY_mps := 0.0;
        bHazardAvoidanceActive := FALSE; (* Divert complete *)
    END_IF;
ELSE
    rDivertCmd_PosX_m := 0.0;
    rDivertCmd_PosY_m := 0.0;
    rDivertCmd_VelX_mps := 0.0;
    rDivertCmd_VelY_mps := 0.0;
END_IF;

(* ============================================================================================= *)
(* SECTION 5: MODEL PREDICTIVE CONTROL (MPC) 6-DOF DESCENT TRAJECTORY OPTIMIZER                 *)
(* ============================================================================================= *)
(* --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* 5.1 Assemble State Vector x = [pz, vz, px, vx, py, vy]^T and Target Vector                    *)
(* --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
aX_Current[1] := rVoted_Alt_m;
aX_Current[2] := rVoted_VelZ_mps;
aX_Current[3] := rNavPosition_X_m;
aX_Current[4] := rNavVelocity_X_mps;
aX_Current[5] := rNavPosition_Y_m;
aX_Current[6] := rNavVelocity_Y_mps;

(* Set dynamic tracking targets depending on mission phase *)
IF bDivertInitiated THEN
    aX_Target[3] := rDivertCmd_PosX_m;
    aX_Target[4] := rDivertCmd_VelX_mps;
    aX_Target[5] := rDivertCmd_PosY_m;
    aX_Target[6] := rDivertCmd_VelY_mps;
ELSE
    aX_Target[3] := 0.0;
    aX_Target[4] := 0.0;
    aX_Target[5] := 0.0;
    aX_Target[6] := 0.0;
END_IF;

(* --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* 5.2 Discrete Horizon Forward Rollout Prediction (Np = 5 steps)                                *)
(* --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
FOR iLoopI := 1 TO 6 DO
    aX_Pred[1, iLoopI] := aX_Current[iLoopI];
END_FOR;

FOR iLoopK := 1 TO 4 DO
    FOR iLoopI := 1 TO 6 DO
        rTempSum := 0.0;
        FOR iLoopJ := 1 TO 6 DO
            rTempSum := rTempSum + (aA_Matrix[iLoopI, iLoopJ] * aX_Pred[iLoopK, iLoopJ]);
        END_FOR;
        FOR iLoopJ := 1 TO 3 DO
            rTempSum := rTempSum + (aB_Matrix[iLoopI, iLoopJ] * aU_Current[iLoopJ]);
        END_FOR;
        (* Compensate for lunar gravity in vertical velocity channel *)
        IF iLoopI = 2 THEN
            rTempSum := rTempSum - (c_rMoonGravity_mps2 * c_rCycleDeltaT_s);
        END_IF;
        aX_Pred[iLoopK + 1, iLoopI] := rTempSum;
    END_FOR;
END_FOR;

(* --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* 5.3 Quadratic Cost Function Gradient Evaluation: grad_J = B^T * Q * (x_pred - x_target) + R*u *)
(* --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
FOR iLoopJ := 1 TO 3 DO
    rTempSum := 0.0;
    FOR iLoopI := 1 TO 6 DO
        rTempSum := rTempSum + aB_Matrix[iLoopI, iLoopJ] * aQ_Weight[iLoopI] * (aX_Pred[5, iLoopI] - aX_Target[iLoopI]);
    END_FOR;
    rTempSum := rTempSum + (aR_Weight[iLoopJ] * aU_Current[iLoopJ]);
    rTempSum := rTempSum + (aS_Weight[iLoopJ] * (aU_Current[iLoopJ] - aU_Prev[iLoopJ]));
    aGrad_J[iLoopJ] := rTempSum;
END_FOR;

(* Projected Gradient Descent Update Step *)
FOR iLoopJ := 1 TO 3 DO
    aU_Prev[iLoopJ] := aU_Current[iLoopJ];
    aU_Current[iLoopJ] := aU_Current[iLoopJ] - (rStepAlpha * aGrad_J[iLoopJ]);
END_FOR;

(* Box Constraints on Commanded Accelerations [m/s^2] *)
IF aU_Current[1] < 0.20 THEN
    aU_Current[1] := 0.20; (* Lower vertical accel limit to avoid free-fall *)
ELSIF aU_Current[1] > 6.20 THEN
    aU_Current[1] := 6.20; (* Upper vertical accel clamp *)
END_IF;

IF aU_Current[2] < -1.80 THEN
    aU_Current[2] := -1.80;
ELSIF aU_Current[2] > 1.80 THEN
    aU_Current[2] := 1.80;
END_IF;

IF aU_Current[3] < -1.80 THEN
    aU_Current[3] := -1.80;
ELSIF aU_Current[3] > 1.80 THEN
    aU_Current[3] := 1.80;
END_IF;

(* --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* 5.4 Transform Commanded Accelerations to Total Thrust Vector & Gimbal Attitude Angles        *)
(* Total Net Acceleration: a_total = sqrt((a_z + g_Moon)^2 + a_x^2 + a_y^2)                    *)
(* --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
rNormAccel := SQRT(((aU_Current[1] + c_rMoonGravity_mps2) * (aU_Current[1] + c_rMoonGravity_mps2)) +
                   (aU_Current[2] * aU_Current[2]) + (aU_Current[3] * aU_Current[3]));

(* Convert to commanded Newtons and kilonewtons *)
rTotalThrustForce_N := rEstimatedMass_kg * rNormAccel;
rDesiredThrust_kN := rTotalThrustForce_N * 0.0010;

(* Gimbal Angle Spherical Projections [rad to deg] *)
IF (aU_Current[1] + c_rMoonGravity_mps2) > 0.05 THEN
    rPitchAngleRad := aU_Current[2] / (aU_Current[1] + c_rMoonGravity_mps2);
    rYawAngleRad   := aU_Current[3] / (aU_Current[1] + c_rMoonGravity_mps2);
    rGimbalPitch_Unfiltered_deg := rPitchAngleRad * 57.29578;
    rGimbalYaw_Unfiltered_deg   := rYawAngleRad   * 57.29578;
ELSE
    rGimbalPitch_Unfiltered_deg := 0.0;
    rGimbalYaw_Unfiltered_deg   := 0.0;
END_IF;

(* ============================================================================================= *)
(* SECTION 6: VARIABLE-AREA PINTLE INJECTOR 10:1 DEEP THROTTLING & MIXTURE CONTROL              *)
(* ============================================================================================= *)
(* First-order lag thrust demand filtering to prevent acoustic shockwave *)
rFilteredThrust_kN := rFilteredThrust_kN + (c_rCycleDeltaT_s * 15.0 * (rDesiredThrust_kN - rFilteredThrust_kN));

(* Deep Throttling Dynamic Saturation: Strict 10:1 envelope [6.50 kN to 65.00 kN] *)
IF rFilteredThrust_kN > c_rMaxThrust_kN THEN
    rFilteredThrust_kN := c_rMaxThrust_kN;
ELSIF rFilteredThrust_kN < c_rMinThrust_kN THEN
    rFilteredThrust_kN := c_rMinThrust_kN;
END_IF;
rThrustCmd_kN := rFilteredThrust_kN;

(* --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* 6.1 Non-Linear Pintle Sleeve Stroke Characteristic Mapping                                   *)
(* Cubic Spline Interpolation: x_p = 0.285*F - 0.0014*F^2 + 0.000008*F^3                        *)
(* --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
rPintleFeedforward_mm := (0.2850 * rThrustCmd_kN) -
                        (0.00140 * rThrustCmd_kN * rThrustCmd_kN) +
                        (0.0000080 * rThrustCmd_kN * rThrustCmd_kN * rThrustCmd_kN);

(* Closed-Loop Chamber Pressure Feedback Trim *)
rChamberPress_Target_bar := (rThrustCmd_kN / c_rMaxThrust_kN) * 70.0; (* 7.0 bar to 70.0 bar *)
rChamberPress_Error_bar  := rChamberPress_Target_bar - rChamberPress_Pc_bar;
rChamberPress_Integrator := rChamberPress_Integrator + (rChamberPress_Error_bar * c_rCycleDeltaT_s * 0.45);
IF rChamberPress_Integrator > 1.25 THEN
    rChamberPress_Integrator := 1.25;
ELSIF rChamberPress_Integrator < -1.25 THEN
    rChamberPress_Integrator := -1.25;
END_IF;

rPintleSleeveCmd_Unclamped_mm := rPintleFeedforward_mm + (rChamberPress_Error_bar * 0.085) + rChamberPress_Integrator;

(* Pintle Sleeve Stroke Mechanical Clamping [1.85 mm to 18.50 mm] *)
IF rPintleSleeveCmd_Unclamped_mm > c_rMaxPintleStroke_mm THEN
    rPintleStrokeCmd_mm := c_rMaxPintleStroke_mm;
ELSIF rPintleSleeveCmd_Unclamped_mm < c_rMinPintleStroke_mm THEN
    rPintleStrokeCmd_mm := c_rMinPintleStroke_mm;
ELSE
    rPintleStrokeCmd_mm := rPintleSleeveCmd_Unclamped_mm;
END_IF;

(* Pintle Actuator Dynamic Slew Rate Limiter (max 50.0 mm/s) *)
rPintleSlewRate_mmps := (rPintleStrokeCmd_mm - rPrevPintleCmd_mm) / c_rCycleDeltaT_s;
IF rPintleSlewRate_mmps > 50.0 THEN
    rPintleStrokeCmd_mm := rPrevPintleCmd_mm + (50.0 * c_rCycleDeltaT_s);
ELSIF rPintleSlewRate_mmps < -50.0 THEN
    rPintleStrokeCmd_mm := rPrevPintleCmd_mm - (50.0 * c_rCycleDeltaT_s);
END_IF;
rPrevPintleCmd_mm := rPintleStrokeCmd_mm;

(* Pintle Acoustic Stability Check: Injection Differential Ratio *)
IF rChamberPress_Pc_bar > 2.0 THEN
    rCavitationAcousticMargin := (rVoted_TankPress_LOX_bar - rChamberPress_Pc_bar) / rChamberPress_Pc_bar;
    IF rCavitationAcousticMargin < 0.18 THEN
        wFaultWord_Degraded.6 := TRUE; (* Impending acoustic chugging detected *)
    END_IF;
END_IF;

(* Mixture Ratio Monitoring *)
IF rMassFlow_LCH4_kgps > 0.05 THEN
    rActiveMixtureRatio := rMassFlow_LOX_kgps / rMassFlow_LCH4_kgps;
ELSE
    rActiveMixtureRatio := c_rNominalMixtureRatio;
END_IF;

(* ============================================================================================= *)
(* SECTION 7: DUAL-AXIS ELECTROMECHANICAL GIMBAL & ANTI-SLOSH NOTCH FILTERING                   *)
(* ============================================================================================= *)
(* --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* 7.1 Pitch Gimbal Discrete Biquad Notch Filter (Removes Propellant Slosh Mode at 1.45 Hz)     *)
(* Difference equation: y[k] = b0*x[k] + b1*x[k-1] + b2*x[k-2] - a1*y[k-1] - a2*y[k-2]          *)
(* --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
rTempSum := (c_b0_notch * rGimbalPitch_Unfiltered_deg) +
            (c_b1_notch * rSloshFilter_Pitch_X1) +
            (c_b2_notch * rSloshFilter_Pitch_X2) -
            (c_a1_notch * rSloshFilter_Pitch_Y1) -
            (c_a2_notch * rSloshFilter_Pitch_Y2);

rSloshFilter_Pitch_X2 := rSloshFilter_Pitch_X1;
rSloshFilter_Pitch_X1 := rGimbalPitch_Unfiltered_deg;
rSloshFilter_Pitch_Y2 := rSloshFilter_Pitch_Y1;
rSloshFilter_Pitch_Y1 := rTempSum;
rGimbalPitchCmd_deg   := rTempSum;

(* --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* 7.2 Yaw Gimbal Discrete Biquad Notch Filter                                                  *)
(* --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
rTempSum := (c_b0_notch * rGimbalYaw_Unfiltered_deg) +
            (c_b1_notch * rSloshFilter_Yaw_X1) +
            (c_b2_notch * rSloshFilter_Yaw_X2) -
            (c_a1_notch * rSloshFilter_Yaw_Y1) -
            (c_a2_notch * rSloshFilter_Yaw_Y2);

rSloshFilter_Yaw_X2 := rSloshFilter_Yaw_X1;
rSloshFilter_Yaw_X1 := rGimbalYaw_Unfiltered_deg;
rSloshFilter_Yaw_Y2 := rSloshFilter_Yaw_Y1;
rSloshFilter_Yaw_Y1 := rTempSum;
rGimbalYawCmd_deg   := rTempSum;

(* Mechanical Slew Rate Clamping: 20.0 deg/s *)
IF (rGimbalPitchCmd_deg - rPrevGimbalPitchCmd_deg) > (c_rMaxGimbalSlewRate_degps * c_rCycleDeltaT_s) THEN
    rGimbalPitchCmd_deg := rPrevGimbalPitchCmd_deg + (c_rMaxGimbalSlewRate_degps * c_rCycleDeltaT_s);
ELSIF (rGimbalPitchCmd_deg - rPrevGimbalPitchCmd_deg) < (-c_rMaxGimbalSlewRate_degps * c_rCycleDeltaT_s) THEN
    rGimbalPitchCmd_deg := rPrevGimbalPitchCmd_deg - (c_rMaxGimbalSlewRate_degps * c_rCycleDeltaT_s);
END_IF;
rPrevGimbalPitchCmd_deg := rGimbalPitchCmd_deg;

IF (rGimbalYawCmd_deg - rPrevGimbalYawCmd_deg) > (c_rMaxGimbalSlewRate_degps * c_rCycleDeltaT_s) THEN
    rGimbalYawCmd_deg := rPrevGimbalYawCmd_deg + (c_rMaxGimbalSlewRate_degps * c_rCycleDeltaT_s);
ELSIF (rGimbalYawCmd_deg - rPrevGimbalYawCmd_deg) < (-c_rMaxGimbalSlewRate_degps * c_rCycleDeltaT_s) THEN
    rGimbalYawCmd_deg := rPrevGimbalYawCmd_deg - (c_rMaxGimbalSlewRate_degps * c_rCycleDeltaT_s);
END_IF;
rPrevGimbalYawCmd_deg := rGimbalYawCmd_deg;

(* Gimbal Angle Bounds Check: +/- 8.00 deg *)
IF rGimbalPitchCmd_deg > c_rMaxGimbalAngle_deg THEN
    rGimbalPitchCmd_deg := c_rMaxGimbalAngle_deg;
ELSIF rGimbalPitchCmd_deg < -c_rMaxGimbalAngle_deg THEN
    rGimbalPitchCmd_deg := -c_rMaxGimbalAngle_deg;
END_IF;

IF rGimbalYawCmd_deg > c_rMaxGimbalAngle_deg THEN
    rGimbalYawCmd_deg := c_rMaxGimbalAngle_deg;
ELSIF rGimbalYawCmd_deg < -c_rMaxGimbalAngle_deg THEN
    rGimbalYawCmd_deg := -c_rMaxGimbalAngle_deg;
END_IF;

(* ============================================================================================= *)
(* SECTION 8: MULTI-STAGE AUTONOMOUS DESCENT FLIGHT STATE MACHINE                               *)
(* ============================================================================================= *)
(* Master Abort Override Logic *)
IF bEmergencyAbortCmd OR (wFaultWord_Critical <> 16#0000) THEN
    IF (iStateStep <> 70) AND (iStateStep <> 80) AND (iStateStep <> 99) THEN
        iStateStep := 90; (* Transition immediately to Emergency Abort Ascent *)
    END_IF;
END_IF;

CASE iStateStep OF
    0: (* STATE_STANDBY_PRE_DESCENT: Orbit verification and sub-Kelvin TVS priming *)
        bEngineMainValvesCmd  := FALSE;
        bEngineMainIgniterCmd := FALSE;
        rThrustCmd_kN         := 0.0;
        rPintleStrokeCmd_mm   := c_rMinPintleStroke_mm;
        rGimbalPitchCmd_deg   := 0.0;
        rGimbalYawCmd_deg     := 0.0;
        bHazardAvoidanceActive:= FALSE;
        bTouchdownConfirmed   := FALSE;
        rDescentPhaseProgress_Pct := 0.0;
        wFlightStateWord      := 16#0001;

        IF bMissionEnable AND (wFaultWord_Critical = 16#0000) THEN
            iStateStep := 10;
            rStateTimer_Sec := 0.0;
        END_IF;

    10: (* STATE_CHILLDOWN_AND_TVS_CONDITIONING: Line conditioning, subcooling verification *)
        bEngineMainValvesCmd  := FALSE;
        bEngineMainIgniterCmd := FALSE;
        rThrustCmd_kN         := 0.0;
        wFlightStateWord      := 16#0003;
        rDescentPhaseProgress_Pct := 5.0;

        (* Verify propellant subcooling margins > 0.80 K and tank pressures conditioned *)
        IF (rLOX_SubcoolingMargin_K >= 0.80) AND (rLCH4_SubcoolingMargin_K >= 0.80) AND (rStateTimer_Sec >= 3.0) THEN
            iStateStep := 20;
            rStateTimer_Sec := 0.0;
        END_IF;

    20: (* STATE_ULLAGE_AND_IGNITION: Torch igniter excitation and pintle pre-positioning *)
        bEngineMainIgniterCmd := TRUE;
        rPintleStrokeCmd_mm   := 3.20; (* Initial ignition pintle crack *)
        wFlightStateWord      := 16#0007;
        rDescentPhaseProgress_Pct := 10.0;

        IF rStateTimer_Sec >= 0.350 THEN
            bEngineMainValvesCmd := TRUE; (* Open main propellant cryogenic valves *)
        END_IF;

        (* Confirm chamber pressure rise Pc >= 12.0 bar to verify flame establishment *)
        IF (rChamberPress_Pc_bar >= 12.0) AND (rStateTimer_Sec >= 0.850) THEN
            iStateStep := 30; (* Main engine lit, enter powered braking phase *)
            rStateTimer_Sec := 0.0;
        END_IF;

    30: (* STATE_POWERED_BRAKING_BURN: High thrust decel from orbital velocity (100% to 70%) *)
        bEngineMainValvesCmd  := TRUE;
        bEngineMainIgniterCmd := FALSE; (* De-energize torch spark once combustion steady *)
        wFlightStateWord      := 16#000F;
        rDescentPhaseProgress_Pct := 20.0 + ((2500.0 - rVoted_Alt_m) / 2500.0 * 40.0);

        (* Trajectory state-space reference targets for high-altitude braking *)
        aX_Target[1] := 450.0; (* Approach gate altitude *)
        aX_Target[2] := -15.0; (* Vertical velocity gate [m/s] *)

        (* Transition gate: Altitude <= 450 m and vertical speed reduced below -18 m/s *)
        IF (rVoted_Alt_m <= 450.0) AND (rVoted_VelZ_mps >= -18.0) THEN
            iStateStep := 40; (* Enter pitch-over approach *)
            rStateTimer_Sec := 0.0;
        END_IF;

    40: (* STATE_PITCH_OVER_APPROACH: Throttle to 50%-35%, orient lander vertical for sensors *)
        bEngineMainValvesCmd  := TRUE;
        wFlightStateWord      := 16#001F;
        rDescentPhaseProgress_Pct := 60.0 + ((450.0 - rVoted_Alt_m) / 450.0 * 20.0);

        aX_Target[1] := 60.0;  (* Terminal gate altitude *)
        aX_Target[2] := -4.0;  (* Approach vertical speed *)

        (* If hazard detected by Flash LIDAR, transition to divert phase *)
        IF bDivertInitiated THEN
            iStateStep := 50;
            rStateTimer_Sec := 0.0;
        ELSIF (rVoted_Alt_m <= 60.0) AND (rVoted_VelZ_mps >= -5.0) THEN
            iStateStep := 60; (* Clear terrain, transition directly to terminal descent *)
            rStateTimer_Sec := 0.0;
        END_IF;

    50: (* STATE_HAZARD_AVOIDANCE_REPLAN: Active lateral divert maneuver via 5th order poly *)
        bEngineMainValvesCmd  := TRUE;
        wFlightStateWord      := 16#003F;
        rDescentPhaseProgress_Pct := 80.0;

        (* Hold altitude rate stable while performing lateral translation *)
        aX_Target[1] := 45.0;
        aX_Target[2] := -2.0;

        (* Divert completed or altitude drops below 35 m *)
        IF (NOT bHazardAvoidanceActive) OR (rVoted_Alt_m <= 35.0) THEN
            iStateStep := 60; (* Proceed to terminal touchdown descent *)
            rStateTimer_Sec := 0.0;
        END_IF;

    60: (* STATE_TERMINAL_VERTICAL_DESCENT: Deep-throttle (15%-10%) constant velocity soft descent *)
        bEngineMainValvesCmd  := TRUE;
        wFlightStateWord      := 16#007F;
        rDescentPhaseProgress_Pct := 90.0 + ((35.0 - rVoted_Alt_m) / 35.0 * 9.0);

        (* Target exact -1.0 m/s vertical touchdown velocity and zero lateral drift *)
        aX_Target[1] := 0.0;
        aX_Target[2] := -1.00; (* 1.0 m/s gentle touchdown *)
        aX_Target[3] := 0.0;
        aX_Target[4] := 0.0;
        aX_Target[5] := 0.0;
        aX_Target[6] := 0.0;

        (* Touchdown detection criteria: probe contact or ultra-low radar altitude *)
        IF bTouchdownProbesTripped OR (rVoted_Alt_m <= 0.40) THEN
            rTouchdownLatchTimer_Sec := rTouchdownLatchTimer_Sec + c_rCycleDeltaT_s;
            IF rTouchdownLatchTimer_Sec >= 0.030 THEN (* 30 ms debounced contact *)
                iStateStep := 70; (* Instant Engine Cutoff *)
                rStateTimer_Sec := 0.0;
            END_IF;
        ELSE
            rTouchdownLatchTimer_Sec := 0.0;
        END_IF;

    70: (* STATE_TOUCHDOWN_DETECTION_AND_CUTOFF: Immediate shutdown to prevent soil erosion *)
        bEngineMainValvesCmd  := FALSE; (* Slam propellant shutoff valves closed *)
        bEngineMainIgniterCmd := FALSE;
        rThrustCmd_kN         := 0.0;
        rPintleStrokeCmd_mm   := c_rMinPintleStroke_mm;
        rGimbalPitchCmd_deg   := 0.0;
        rGimbalYawCmd_deg     := 0.0;
        bTouchdownConfirmed   := TRUE;
        rDescentPhaseProgress_Pct := 100.0;
        wFlightStateWord      := 16#00FF; (* Touchdown achieved *)

        IF rStateTimer_Sec >= 5.0 THEN
            iStateStep := 80; (* Proceed to propellant passivation *)
            rStateTimer_Sec := 0.0;
        END_IF;

    80: (* STATE_POST_LANDING_PASSIVATION: Blowdown cryo lines, depressurize tanks *)
        bEngineMainValvesCmd  := FALSE;
        rThrustCmd_kN         := 0.0;
        (* Open TVS vent valves 100% to vent residual ullage and passivate lander *)
        rVentValve_LOX_Cmd_Pct  := 100.0;
        rVentValve_LCH4_Cmd_Pct := 100.0;

(* ==================================================================================================================== *)
(* Immediate fail-safe verification before any algorithmic calculations are performed                                   *)
IF NOT bSafetyInterlockLoop THEN
    bAlarmLatch_EStop := TRUE;
    bEmergencyTripActive := TRUE;
    bSystemHealthy := FALSE;
    iFSM_CurrentState := 90; (* Jump directly to EMERGENCY_DEPRESSURIZATION_LOCKOUT *)
END_IF;

IF bEmergencyWaterSlamShutCmd THEN
    bAlarmLatch_PeltonOverpress := TRUE;
    bEmergencyTripActive := TRUE;
    bSystemHealthy := FALSE;
    iFSM_CurrentState := 90;
END_IF;

(* Manual master fault acknowledge and alarm reset pulse handling *)
IF bResetFaults THEN
    IF bSafetyInterlockLoop AND NOT bWaterHammerLatch AND NOT bEmergencyWaterSlamShutCmd THEN
        bAlarmLatch_EStop := FALSE;
        bEmergencyTripActive := FALSE;
        bAlarmLatch_HighCO := FALSE;
        bAlarmLatch_HighNO2 := FALSE;
        bAlarmLatch_HighCH4 := FALSE;
        bAlarmLatch_PeltonOverpress := FALSE;
        bAlarmLatch_BarrierBreach := FALSE;
        bAlarmLatch_ThermalRunaway := FALSE;
        bAlarmLatch_TMR_Failure := FALSE;
        bToxicGasTripActive := FALSE;
    END_IF;
    IF bSafetyInterlockLoop AND (rPressureSlewRate_bar_s < 10.0) THEN
        bWaterHammerLatch := FALSE;
    END_IF;
END_IF;

(* ==================================================================================================================== *)
(* EXECUTION SECTION 3: 2oo3 TRIPLE MODULAR REDUNDANCY (TMR) SENSOR VOTING ENGINES                                     *)
(* ==================================================================================================================== *)
(* SIL-3 compliant triple voting with discrepancy debounce, degradation tracking, and fallback                          *)
iTmrFaultAccumulator := 0;

(* --- GROUP 1: CHILLED WATER HIGH-PRESSURE SENSORS (A, B, C) [bar] --- *)
rPressDev_AB := ABS(rChilledWaterSupplyPress_A - rChilledWaterSupplyPress_B);
rPressDev_BC := ABS(rChilledWaterSupplyPress_B - rChilledWaterSupplyPress_C);
rPressDev_AC := ABS(rChilledWaterSupplyPress_A - rChilledWaterSupplyPress_C);
tPressDiscTimer(IN := ((rPressDev_AB > 18.0) OR (rPressDev_BC > 18.0) OR (rPressDev_AC > 18.0)), PT := T#1200MS);

IF tPressDiscTimer.Q THEN
    (* Isolate faulty channel based on highest paired divergence *)
    IF (rPressDev_AB > 18.0) AND (rPressDev_AC > 18.0) THEN
        bPressChanFault_A := TRUE;
    ELSIF (rPressDev_AB > 18.0) AND (rPressDev_BC > 18.0) THEN
        bPressChanFault_B := TRUE;
    ELSIF (rPressDev_AC > 18.0) AND (rPressDev_BC > 18.0) THEN
        bPressChanFault_C := TRUE;
    END_IF;
END_IF;

(* Voting execution for Chilled Water Pressure *)
IF NOT bPressChanFault_A AND NOT bPressChanFault_B AND NOT bPressChanFault_C THEN
    (* Full 2oo3 Median Selection: Voted = Sum - Max - Min *)
    rSumA := rChilledWaterSupplyPress_A + rChilledWaterSupplyPress_B + rChilledWaterSupplyPress_C;
    rTempSort := MAX(rChilledWaterSupplyPress_A, MAX(rChilledWaterSupplyPress_B, rChilledWaterSupplyPress_C));
    rDeltaVal := MIN(rChilledWaterSupplyPress_A, MIN(rChilledWaterSupplyPress_B, rChilledWaterSupplyPress_C));
    rVotedWaterPress_bar := rSumA - rTempSort - rDeltaVal;
ELSIF bPressChanFault_A AND NOT bPressChanFault_B AND NOT bPressChanFault_C THEN
    (* Degraded 1oo2: Average Channels B & C *)
    rVotedWaterPress_bar := (rChilledWaterSupplyPress_B + rChilledWaterSupplyPress_C) * 0.5;
    iTmrFaultAccumulator := iTmrFaultAccumulator + 1;
ELSIF bPressChanFault_B AND NOT bPressChanFault_A AND NOT bPressChanFault_C THEN
    (* Degraded 1oo2: Average Channels A & C *)
    rVotedWaterPress_bar := (rChilledWaterSupplyPress_A + rChilledWaterSupplyPress_C) * 0.5;
    iTmrFaultAccumulator := iTmrFaultAccumulator + 1;
ELSIF bPressChanFault_C AND NOT bPressChanFault_A AND NOT bPressChanFault_B THEN
    (* Degraded 1oo2: Average Channels A & B *)
    rVotedWaterPress_bar := (rChilledWaterSupplyPress_A + rChilledWaterSupplyPress_B) * 0.5;
    iTmrFaultAccumulator := iTmrFaultAccumulator + 1;
ELSE
    (* Severe Degradation: 1oo1 or Fail-Safe clamp *)
    IF NOT bPressChanFault_A THEN
        rVotedWaterPress_bar := rChilledWaterSupplyPress_A;
    ELSIF NOT bPressChanFault_B THEN
        rVotedWaterPress_bar := rChilledWaterSupplyPress_B;
    ELSIF NOT bPressChanFault_C THEN
        rVotedWaterPress_bar := rChilledWaterSupplyPress_C;
    ELSE
        rVotedWaterPress_bar := 380.0; (* Fail-safe nominal assumption *)
        bAlarmLatch_TMR_Failure := TRUE;
    END_IF;
    iTmrFaultAccumulator := iTmrFaultAccumulator + 2;
END_IF;

(* --- GROUP 2: STOPE AMBIENT DRY-BULB TEMPERATURE SENSORS (A, B, C) [deg C] --- *)
rTempDev_AB := ABS(rStopeDryBulbTemp_A - rStopeDryBulbTemp_B);
rTempDev_BC := ABS(rStopeDryBulbTemp_B - rStopeDryBulbTemp_C);
rTempDev_AC := ABS(rStopeDryBulbTemp_A - rStopeDryBulbTemp_C);
tTempDiscTimer(IN := ((rTempDev_AB > 3.5) OR (rTempDev_BC > 3.5) OR (rTempDev_AC > 3.5)), PT := T#1500MS);

IF tTempDiscTimer.Q THEN
    IF (rTempDev_AB > 3.5) AND (rTempDev_AC > 3.5) THEN
        bTempChanFault_A := TRUE;
    ELSIF (rTempDev_AB > 3.5) AND (rTempDev_BC > 3.5) THEN
        bTempChanFault_B := TRUE;
    ELSIF (rTempDev_AC > 3.5) AND (rTempDev_BC > 3.5) THEN
        bTempChanFault_C := TRUE;
    END_IF;
END_IF;

IF NOT bTempChanFault_A AND NOT bTempChanFault_B AND NOT bTempChanFault_C THEN
    rSumA := rStopeDryBulbTemp_A + rStopeDryBulbTemp_B + rStopeDryBulbTemp_C;
    rTempSort := MAX(rStopeDryBulbTemp_A, MAX(rStopeDryBulbTemp_B, rStopeDryBulbTemp_C));
    rDeltaVal := MIN(rStopeDryBulbTemp_A, MIN(rStopeDryBulbTemp_B, rStopeDryBulbTemp_C));
    rVotedStopeDryBulb_degC := rSumA - rTempSort - rDeltaVal;
ELSIF bTempChanFault_A AND NOT bTempChanFault_B AND NOT bTempChanFault_C THEN
    rVotedStopeDryBulb_degC := (rStopeDryBulbTemp_B + rStopeDryBulbTemp_C) * 0.5;
    iTmrFaultAccumulator := iTmrFaultAccumulator + 1;
ELSIF bTempChanFault_B AND NOT bTempChanFault_A AND NOT bTempChanFault_C THEN
    rVotedStopeDryBulb_degC := (rStopeDryBulbTemp_A + rStopeDryBulbTemp_C) * 0.5;
    iTmrFaultAccumulator := iTmrFaultAccumulator + 1;
ELSIF bTempChanFault_C AND NOT bTempChanFault_A AND NOT bTempChanFault_B THEN
    rVotedStopeDryBulb_degC := (rStopeDryBulbTemp_A + rStopeDryBulbTemp_B) * 0.5;
    iTmrFaultAccumulator := iTmrFaultAccumulator + 1;
ELSE
    IF NOT bTempChanFault_A THEN
        rVotedStopeDryBulb_degC := rStopeDryBulbTemp_A;
    ELSIF NOT bTempChanFault_B THEN
        rVotedStopeDryBulb_degC := rStopeDryBulbTemp_B;
    ELSIF NOT bTempChanFault_C THEN
        rVotedStopeDryBulb_degC := rStopeDryBulbTemp_C;
    ELSE
        rVotedStopeDryBulb_degC := 42.0; (* Fail-safe elevated thermal default *)
        bAlarmLatch_TMR_Failure := TRUE;
    END_IF;
    iTmrFaultAccumulator := iTmrFaultAccumulator + 2;
END_IF;

(* --- GROUP 3: BARRIER DIFFERENTIAL OVERPRESSURE SENSORS (A, B, C) [mbar] --- *)
rDiffPDev_AB := ABS(rBarrierDifferentialPress_A - rBarrierDifferentialPress_B);
rDiffPDev_BC := ABS(rBarrierDifferentialPress_B - rBarrierDifferentialPress_C);
rDiffPDev_AC := ABS(rBarrierDifferentialPress_A - rBarrierDifferentialPress_C);
tDiffPDiscTimer(IN := ((rDiffPDev_AB > 6.0) OR (rDiffPDev_BC > 6.0) OR (rDiffPDev_AC > 6.0)), PT := T#1000MS);

IF tDiffPDiscTimer.Q THEN
    IF (rDiffPDev_AB > 6.0) AND (rDiffPDev_AC > 6.0) THEN
        bDiffPChanFault_A := TRUE;
    ELSIF (rDiffPDev_AB > 6.0) AND (rDiffPDev_BC > 6.0) THEN
        bDiffPChanFault_B := TRUE;
    ELSIF (rDiffPDev_AC > 6.0) AND (rDiffPDev_BC > 6.0) THEN
        bDiffPChanFault_C := TRUE;
    END_IF;
END_IF;

IF NOT bDiffPChanFault_A AND NOT bDiffPChanFault_B AND NOT bDiffPChanFault_C THEN
    rSumA := rBarrierDifferentialPress_A + rBarrierDifferentialPress_B + rBarrierDifferentialPress_C;
    rTempSort := MAX(rBarrierDifferentialPress_A, MAX(rBarrierDifferentialPress_B, rBarrierDifferentialPress_C));
    rDeltaVal := MIN(rBarrierDifferentialPress_A, MIN(rBarrierDifferentialPress_B, rBarrierDifferentialPress_C));
    rVotedBarrierDiffPress_mbar := rSumA - rTempSort - rDeltaVal;
ELSIF bDiffPChanFault_A AND NOT bDiffPChanFault_B AND NOT bDiffPChanFault_C THEN
    rVotedBarrierDiffPress_mbar := (rBarrierDifferentialPress_B + rBarrierDifferentialPress_C) * 0.5;
    iTmrFaultAccumulator := iTmrFaultAccumulator + 1;
ELSIF bDiffPChanFault_B AND NOT bDiffPChanFault_A AND NOT bDiffPChanFault_C THEN
    rVotedBarrierDiffPress_mbar := (rBarrierDifferentialPress_A + rBarrierDifferentialPress_C) * 0.5;
    iTmrFaultAccumulator := iTmrFaultAccumulator + 1;
ELSIF bDiffPChanFault_C AND NOT bDiffPChanFault_A AND NOT bDiffPChanFault_B THEN
    rVotedBarrierDiffPress_mbar := (rBarrierDifferentialPress_A + rBarrierDifferentialPress_B) * 0.5;
    iTmrFaultAccumulator := iTmrFaultAccumulator + 1;
ELSE
    IF NOT bDiffPChanFault_A THEN
        rVotedBarrierDiffPress_mbar := rBarrierDifferentialPress_A;
    ELSIF NOT bDiffPChanFault_B THEN
        rVotedBarrierDiffPress_mbar := rBarrierDifferentialPress_B;
    ELSIF NOT bDiffPChanFault_C THEN
        rVotedBarrierDiffPress_mbar := rBarrierDifferentialPress_C;
    ELSE
        rVotedBarrierDiffPress_mbar := 10.0; (* Low boundary trip trigger *)
        bAlarmLatch_TMR_Failure := TRUE;
    END_IF;
    iTmrFaultAccumulator := iTmrFaultAccumulator + 2;
END_IF;

(* --- GROUP 4: CARBON MONOXIDE TOXIC BLAST FUME SENSORS (A, B, C) [ppm] --- *)
rCODev_AB := ABS(rToxicGas_CO_ppm_A - rToxicGas_CO_ppm_B);
rCODev_BC := ABS(rToxicGas_CO_ppm_B - rToxicGas_CO_ppm_C);
rCODev_AC := ABS(rToxicGas_CO_ppm_A - rToxicGas_CO_ppm_C);
tCODiscTimer(IN := ((rCODev_AB > 25.0) OR (rCODev_BC > 25.0) OR (rCODev_AC > 25.0)), PT := T#800MS);

IF tCODiscTimer.Q THEN
    IF (rCODev_AB > 25.0) AND (rCODev_AC > 25.0) THEN
        bCOChanFault_A := TRUE;
    ELSIF (rCODev_AB > 25.0) AND (rCODev_BC > 25.0) THEN
        bCOChanFault_B := TRUE;
    ELSIF (rCODev_AC > 25.0) AND (rCODev_BC > 25.0) THEN
        bCOChanFault_C := TRUE;
    END_IF;
END_IF;

IF NOT bCOChanFault_A AND NOT bCOChanFault_B AND NOT bCOChanFault_C THEN
    rSumA := rToxicGas_CO_ppm_A + rToxicGas_CO_ppm_B + rToxicGas_CO_ppm_C;
    rTempSort := MAX(rToxicGas_CO_ppm_A, MAX(rToxicGas_CO_ppm_B, rToxicGas_CO_ppm_C));
    rDeltaVal := MIN(rToxicGas_CO_ppm_A, MIN(rToxicGas_CO_ppm_B, rToxicGas_CO_ppm_C));
    rVotedCO_Concentration_ppm := rSumA - rTempSort - rDeltaVal;
ELSIF bCOChanFault_A AND NOT bCOChanFault_B AND NOT bCOChanFault_C THEN
    rVotedCO_Concentration_ppm := MAX(rToxicGas_CO_ppm_B, rToxicGas_CO_ppm_C); (* Conservative high-select *)
    iTmrFaultAccumulator := iTmrFaultAccumulator + 1;
ELSIF bCOChanFault_B AND NOT bCOChanFault_A AND NOT bCOChanFault_C THEN
    rVotedCO_Concentration_ppm := MAX(rToxicGas_CO_ppm_A, rToxicGas_CO_ppm_C);
    iTmrFaultAccumulator := iTmrFaultAccumulator + 1;
ELSIF bCOChanFault_C AND NOT bCOChanFault_A AND NOT bCOChanFault_B THEN
    rVotedCO_Concentration_ppm := MAX(rToxicGas_CO_ppm_A, rToxicGas_CO_ppm_B);
    iTmrFaultAccumulator := iTmrFaultAccumulator + 1;
ELSE
    rVotedCO_Concentration_ppm := MAX(rToxicGas_CO_ppm_A, MAX(rToxicGas_CO_ppm_B, rToxicGas_CO_ppm_C));
    bAlarmLatch_TMR_Failure := TRUE;
    iTmrFaultAccumulator := iTmrFaultAccumulator + 2;
END_IF;

(* --- GROUP 5: NITROGEN DIOXIDE TOXIC BLAST FUME SENSORS (A, B, C) [ppm] --- *)
rNO2Dev_AB := ABS(rToxicGas_NO2_ppm_A - rToxicGas_NO2_ppm_B);
rNO2Dev_BC := ABS(rToxicGas_NO2_ppm_B - rToxicGas_NO2_ppm_C);
rNO2Dev_AC := ABS(rToxicGas_NO2_ppm_A - rToxicGas_NO2_ppm_C);
tNO2DiscTimer(IN := ((rNO2Dev_AB > 2.5) OR (rNO2Dev_BC > 2.5) OR (rNO2Dev_AC > 2.5)), PT := T#800MS);

IF tNO2DiscTimer.Q THEN
    IF (rNO2Dev_AB > 2.5) AND (rNO2Dev_AC > 2.5) THEN
        bNO2ChanFault_A := TRUE;
    ELSIF (rNO2Dev_AB > 2.5) AND (rNO2Dev_BC > 2.5) THEN
        bNO2ChanFault_B := TRUE;
    ELSIF (rNO2Dev_AC > 2.5) AND (rNO2Dev_BC > 2.5) THEN
        bNO2ChanFault_C := TRUE;
    END_IF;
END_IF;

IF NOT bNO2ChanFault_A AND NOT bNO2ChanFault_B AND NOT bNO2ChanFault_C THEN
    rSumA := rToxicGas_NO2_ppm_A + rToxicGas_NO2_ppm_B + rToxicGas_NO2_ppm_C;
    rTempSort := MAX(rToxicGas_NO2_ppm_A, MAX(rToxicGas_NO2_ppm_B, rToxicGas_NO2_ppm_C));
    rDeltaVal := MIN(rToxicGas_NO2_ppm_A, MIN(rToxicGas_NO2_ppm_B, rToxicGas_NO2_ppm_C));
    rVotedNO2_Concentration_ppm := rSumA - rTempSort - rDeltaVal;
ELSIF bNO2ChanFault_A AND NOT bNO2ChanFault_B AND NOT bNO2ChanFault_C THEN
    rVotedNO2_Concentration_ppm := MAX(rToxicGas_NO2_ppm_B, rToxicGas_NO2_ppm_C);
    iTmrFaultAccumulator := iTmrFaultAccumulator + 1;
ELSIF bNO2ChanFault_B AND NOT bNO2ChanFault_A AND NOT bNO2ChanFault_C THEN
    rVotedNO2_Concentration_ppm := MAX(rToxicGas_NO2_ppm_A, rToxicGas_NO2_ppm_C);
    iTmrFaultAccumulator := iTmrFaultAccumulator + 1;
ELSIF bNO2ChanFault_C AND NOT bNO2ChanFault_A AND NOT bNO2ChanFault_B THEN
    rVotedNO2_Concentration_ppm := MAX(rToxicGas_NO2_ppm_A, rToxicGas_NO2_ppm_B);
    iTmrFaultAccumulator := iTmrFaultAccumulator + 1;
ELSE
    rVotedNO2_Concentration_ppm := MAX(rToxicGas_NO2_ppm_A, MAX(rToxicGas_NO2_ppm_B, rToxicGas_NO2_ppm_C));
    bAlarmLatch_TMR_Failure := TRUE;
    iTmrFaultAccumulator := iTmrFaultAccumulator + 2;
END_IF;

(* Flag degraded mode if any instrument channel has failed *)
bDegradedSensorMode := (iTmrFaultAccumulator > 0);

(* Toxic Gas Evacuation & Trip Interlocks *)
IF (rVotedCO_Concentration_ppm > 50.0) THEN
    bAlarmLatch_HighCO := TRUE;
    bToxicGasTripActive := TRUE;
END_IF;
IF (rVotedNO2_Concentration_ppm > 3.0) THEN
    bAlarmLatch_HighNO2 := TRUE;
    bToxicGasTripActive := TRUE;
END_IF;
IF (rToxicGas_CH4_LEL_pct > 20.0) THEN
    bAlarmLatch_HighCH4 := TRUE;
    bToxicGasTripActive := TRUE;
END_IF;

(* ==================================================================================================================== *)
(* EXECUTION SECTION 4: PSYCHROMETRIC ENTHALPY & DETERMINISTIC WET-BULB SOLVER                                          *)
(* ==================================================================================================================== *)
(* Modified Tetens equation with barometric autocompression scaling for deep mine shafts                                *)
(* Calculate saturation vapor pressure at dry-bulb temperature *)
rSatVaporPress_kPa := 0.61078 * EXP((17.27 * rVotedStopeDryBulb_degC) / (rVotedStopeDryBulb_degC + 237.3));
rActualVaporPress_kPa := (rStopeRelativeHumidity / 100.0) * rSatVaporPress_kPa;

(* Humidity ratio: w = 0.62198 * Pv / (P_baro - Pv) *)
IF (rBarometricPressure_kPa - rActualVaporPress_kPa) > 10.0 THEN
    rHumidityRatio_kg_kg := 0.62198 * rActualVaporPress_kPa / (rBarometricPressure_kPa - rActualVaporPress_kPa);
ELSE
    rHumidityRatio_kg_kg := 0.035; (* Safe physical upper bound saturation limit *)
END_IF;

(* Specific air enthalpy: h = 1.006 * T_db + w * (2501.0 + 1.86 * T_db) [kJ/kg dry air] *)
rCalculatedAirEnthalpy_kJkg := (1.006 * rVotedStopeDryBulb_degC) + (rHumidityRatio_kg_kg * (2501.0 + (1.86 * rVotedStopeDryBulb_degC)));

(* Deterministic 6-step Newton-Raphson thermodynamic solver for Wet-Bulb Temperature *)
(* Avoids unbounded while loops to guarantee hard real-time cycle determinism *)
rWetBulbEstimate := rVotedStopeDryBulb_degC - ((100.0 - rStopeRelativeHumidity) / 100.0) * ((rVotedStopeDryBulb_degC - 10.0) * 0.35);
FOR iNewtonIter := 1 TO 6 DO
    rSatVaporPress_Twb := 0.61078 * EXP((17.27 * rWetBulbEstimate) / (rWetBulbEstimate + 237.3));
    rPsychroResidual := rSatVaporPress_Twb - rActualVaporPress_kPa - (rBarometricPressure_kPa * rPsychroConstant * (rVotedStopeDryBulb_degC - rWetBulbEstimate));
    rPsychroDerivative := (rSatVaporPress_Twb * (4098.0 / ((rWetBulbEstimate + 237.3) * (rWetBulbEstimate + 237.3)))) + (rBarometricPressure_kPa * rPsychroConstant);
    IF ABS(rPsychroDerivative) > 0.001 THEN
        rWetBulbEstimate := rWetBulbEstimate - (rPsychroResidual / rPsychroDerivative);
    END_IF;
END_FOR;
rCalculatedStopeWetBulb_degC := rWetBulbEstimate;

(* Geothermal refrigeration duty absorbed by chilled water cascade *)
(* Q_absorbed = m_dot * Cp * (T_return - T_supply) -> rho = 1000 kg/m3, Cp = 4.184 kJ/kg.K *)
rCalculatedRefrigerationEffect_kW := rChilledWaterFlowRate * 1000.0 * 4.184 * (rChilledWaterReturnTemp - rChilledWaterSupplyTemp);

(* Thermal Runaway Trip Check: Wet-Bulb exceeding regulatory legal limit 32.5 deg C *)
IF (rCalculatedStopeWetBulb_degC > 32.5) THEN
    bAlarmLatch_ThermalRunaway := TRUE;
END_IF;

(* ==================================================================================================================== *)
(* EXECUTION SECTION 5: JOUKOWSKY ACOUSTIC SURGE & WATER HAMMER MITIGATION                                              *)
(* ==================================================================================================================== *)
(* Pressure derivative dP/dt computed over scan interval Ts = 100ms                                                     *)
rPressureSlewRate_bar_s := (ABS(rVotedWaterPress_bar - rPrevScanPress)) / 0.100;
rPrevScanPress := rVotedWaterPress_bar;

(* Push into circular buffer for moving peak history *)
aPressHistory[iPressHistoryIdx] := rVotedWaterPress_bar;
iPressHistoryIdx := (iPressHistoryIdx + 1) MOD 10;

(* Detect catastrophic hydraulic water hammer surge (> 35.0 bar/s or > 420.0 bar) *)
tWaterHammerSustain(IN := (rPressureSlewRate_bar_s > 35.0) OR (rVotedWaterPress_bar > 420.0), PT := T#200MS);
IF tWaterHammerSustain.Q THEN
    bWaterHammerLatch := TRUE;
    bWaterHammerWarning := TRUE;
    bAlarmLatch_WaterHammer := TRUE;
    bEmergencyTripActive := TRUE;
    iFSM_CurrentState := 90; (* Force emergency lockout *)
END_IF;

(* Pelton overpressure threshold trip *)
IF (rVotedWaterPress_bar > 435.0) THEN
    bAlarmLatch_PeltonOverpress := TRUE;
    bEmergencyTripActive := TRUE;
    iFSM_CurrentState := 90;
END_IF;

(* ==================================================================================================================== *)
(* EXECUTION SECTION 6: COANDA PLANAR AIR CURTAIN FLUID DYNAMICS & VECTORING                                             *)
(* ==================================================================================================================== *)
(* Dynamic vectoring adjusts vane pitch and yaw to counter thermal buoyancy and cross-drafts                            *)
(* Archimedes Number: Ar = g * beta * (T_stope - T_supply) * b0 / u0^2 *)
IF rAirCurtainSupplyVelocity > 2.0 THEN
    rCurtainArchimedesNumber := (9.81 * rThermalExpansionBeta * (rVotedStopeDryBulb_degC - rChilledWaterSupplyTemp) * rSlotNozzleWidth_m) / (rAirCurtainSupplyVelocity * rAirCurtainSupplyVelocity);
    rCurtainMomentumFlux := rAirDensity_kgm3 * rSlotNozzleWidth_m * rAirCurtainSupplyVelocity * rAirCurtainSupplyVelocity;
ELSE
    rCurtainArchimedesNumber := 1.5; (* High buoyancy stall risk *)
    rCurtainMomentumFlux := 0.0;
    bAirCurtainStallAlarm := TRUE;
END_IF;

(* Aerodynamic Pitch Elevation Vane Angle Calculation (counters buoyancy up-draft) *)
(* Pitch correction: Theta_pitch = K_buoy * Ar - K_cross * (v_cross / u_jet) *)
rRawPitchAngle := (18.5 * rCurtainArchimedesNumber) - (7.2 * (rCrossDraftAirVelocity / (rAirCurtainSupplyVelocity + 0.1)));
IF rRawPitchAngle > 30.0 THEN
    rAirCurtainPitchAngle_deg := 30.0;
ELSIF rRawPitchAngle < -30.0 THEN
    rAirCurtainPitchAngle_deg := -30.0;
ELSE
    rAirCurtainPitchAngle_deg := rRawPitchAngle;
END_IF;

(* Aerodynamic Yaw Angle Calculation (counters transverse drift) *)
rRawYawAngle := (rTransverseAirVelocity / (rAirCurtainSupplyVelocity + 0.1)) * 57.2958; (* Rad to deg *)
IF rRawYawAngle > 25.0 THEN
    rAirCurtainYawAngle_deg := 25.0;
ELSIF rRawYawAngle < -25.0 THEN
    rAirCurtainYawAngle_deg := -25.0;
ELSE
    rAirCurtainYawAngle_deg := rRawYawAngle;
END_IF;

(* ==================================================================================================================== *)
(* EXECUTION SECTION 7: MODEL PREDICTIVE CONTROL (MPC) QUADRATIC OPTIMIZATION                                            *)
(* ==================================================================================================================== *)
(* Receding horizon state error calculation *)
vX[0] := rVotedStopeDryBulb_degC - rTargetDryBulbTemp_degC;     (* e_Tdb: Dry-bulb deviation *)
vX[1] := rCalculatedStopeWetBulb_degC - rTargetWetBulbTemp_degC; (* e_Twb: Wet-bulb deviation *)
vX[2] := rAirCurtainSupplyVelocity - rTargetCurtainVelocity_ms; (* e_Ujet: Velocity error *)
vX[3] := rVotedBarrierDiffPress_mbar - rTargetBarrierPress_mbar; (* e_dP: Barrier pressure error *)

(* Analytical gradient computation of quadratic cost: Grad = B^T * Q * x + R * (u - u_prev) *)
FOR idx_j := 0 TO 3 DO
    rSumA := 0.0;
    FOR idx_i := 0 TO 3 DO
        rSumA := rSumA + (mB[idx_i, idx_j] * mQ[idx_i, idx_i] * vX[idx_i]);
    END_FOR;
    vGrad[idx_j] := rSumA + (mR[idx_j, idx_j] * (vU_optimal[idx_j] - vU_previous[idx_j]));
END_FOR;

(* Projected Gradient Descent Iteration Loop (Hard Real-Time Bound) *)
FOR iMpcIter := 1 TO iMpcMaxIter DO
    FOR idx_j := 0 TO 3 DO
        (* Gradient descent step *)
        vU_optimal[idx_j] := vU_optimal[idx_j] - (rMpcStepSize * vGrad[idx_j]);
        
        (* Actuator Slew Rate Clamping *)
        rDeltaVal := vU_optimal[idx_j] - vU_previous[idx_j];
        IF rDeltaVal > vDeltaU_clamp[idx_j] THEN
            vU_optimal[idx_j] := vU_previous[idx_j] + vDeltaU_clamp[idx_j];
        ELSIF rDeltaVal < -vDeltaU_clamp[idx_j] THEN
            vU_optimal[idx_j] := vU_previous[idx_j] - vDeltaU_clamp[idx_j];
        END_IF;
        
        (* Actuator Absolute Physical Box Constraint Projection *)
        IF vU_optimal[idx_j] > vU_max[idx_j] THEN
            vU_optimal[idx_j] := vU_max[idx_j];
        ELSIF vU_optimal[idx_j] < vU_min[idx_j] THEN
            vU_optimal[idx_j] := vU_min[idx_j];
        END_IF;
    END_FOR;
END_FOR;

(* Save optimal commands for slew tracking in subsequent scan *)
FOR idx_j := 0 TO 3 DO
    vU_previous[idx_j] := vU_optimal[idx_j];
END_FOR;

(* ==================================================================================================================== *)
(* EXECUTION SECTION 8: 10-STAGE CYBER-PHYSICAL FINITE STATE MACHINE (CASE)                                              *)
(* ==================================================================================================================== *)
(* Detect state transitions to generate one-shot pulse *)
IF iFSM_CurrentState <> iFSM_PreviousState THEN
    bFSM_FirstScan := TRUE;
    iFSM_PreviousState := iFSM_CurrentState;
ELSE
    bFSM_FirstScan := FALSE;
END_IF;

tStateDwellTimer(IN := NOT bFSM_FirstScan, PT := T#24H);

CASE iFSM_CurrentState OF
    0: (* STATE_COLD_INIT: Hardware check, memory conditioning, self-test *)
        wSystemStateCode := 16#0000;
        rCascadeChilledWaterValve_pct := 0.0;
        rPeltonTurbineBypass_pct := 100.0; (* Full bypass during cold start *)
        rAirCurtainFanSpeed_RPM := 0.0;
        rBarrierScupperDamper_pct := 0.0;
        bSystemHealthy := FALSE;
        
        IF bEnableSystem AND bSafetyInterlockLoop AND NOT bEmergencyTripActive THEN
            iFSM_CurrentState := 10; (* Advance to Hydraulic Prime *)
        END_IF;
    
    10: (* STATE_STANDBY_HYDRAULIC_PRIME: Slowly prime chilled water line, check pressure *)
        wSystemStateCode := 16#000A;
        rCascadeChilledWaterValve_pct := 2.5; (* Minimal priming bleed *)
        rPeltonTurbineBypass_pct := 100.0;
        rAirCurtainFanSpeed_RPM := 0.0;
        rBarrierScupperDamper_pct := 10.0;
        bSystemHealthy := TRUE;
        
        IF (rVotedWaterPress_bar > 250.0) AND (tStateDwellTimer.ET > T#5S) THEN
            iFSM_CurrentState := 20; (* Advance to Cascade Ramp *)
        ELSIF NOT bEnableSystem THEN
            iFSM_CurrentState := 0;
        END_IF;
    
    20: (* STATE_PELTON_CHILL_CASCADE_RAMP: Modulate Pelton spear needle, pre-cool BAC *)
        wSystemStateCode := 16#0014;
        rPeltonTurbineBypass_pct := 70.0;
        rCascadeChilledWaterValve_pct := 25.0;
        rAirCurtainFanSpeed_RPM := 800.0; (* Low speed purge *)
        rBarrierScupperDamper_pct := 20.0;
        
        IF (rChilledWaterSupplyTemp < 5.0) AND (tStateDwellTimer.ET > T#10S) THEN
            iFSM_CurrentState := 30; (* Advance to Establish Curtain *)
        ELSIF NOT bEnableSystem THEN
            iFSM_CurrentState := 0;
        END_IF;
    
    30: (* STATE_COANDA_AIR_CURTAIN_ESTABLISH: Ramp fan, establish boundary attachment *)
        wSystemStateCode := 16#001E;
        rCascadeChilledWaterValve_pct := 50.0;
        rPeltonTurbineBypass_pct := 40.0;
        rAirCurtainFanSpeed_RPM := 2200.0;
        rBarrierScupperDamper_pct := 25.0;
        
        IF (rAirCurtainSupplyVelocity > 18.0) AND (rVotedBarrierDiffPress_mbar > 15.0) THEN
            bAirCurtainStallAlarm := FALSE;
            iFSM_CurrentState := 40; (* Advance to Dynamic MPC Regulation *)
        END_IF;
    
    40: (* STATE_MPC_DYNAMIC_EQUILIBRIUM: Continuous multi-variable optimal regulation *)
        wSystemStateCode := 16#0028;
        (* Apply optimal commands computed by MPC engine *)
        rCascadeChilledWaterValve_pct := vU_optimal[0];
        rAirCurtainFanSpeed_RPM := vU_optimal[1];
        rBarrierScupperDamper_pct := vU_optimal[3];
        rPeltonTurbineBypass_pct := 100.0 - rCascadeChilledWaterValve_pct; (* Coordinated Pelton split *)
        
        (* State Transition Supervisory Triggers *)
        IF bBlastSequenceActive THEN
            iFSM_CurrentState := 50; (* Blast clearance *)
        ELSIF (rThermalRefrigerationLoad > 18000.0) OR (rCalculatedStopeWetBulb_degC > 29.5) THEN
            iFSM_CurrentState := 60; (* Thermal overload *)
