    CONST_ROPE_STIFFNESS_N_PER_M: REAL := 4500000.0;         (* 4-part steel hoist cable aggregate stiffness [N/m] *)

    (* Wheel spatial coordinates (X longitudinal forward, Y lateral left): [1..8] *)
    (* Wheel 1: Front-Left  (Axle 1), Wheel 2: Front-Right  (Axle 1) *)
    (* Wheel 3: Mid-Front-L (Axle 2), Wheel 4: Mid-Front-R  (Axle 2) *)
    (* Wheel 5: Mid-Rear-L  (Axle 3), Wheel 6: Mid-Rear-R   (Axle 3) *)
    (* Wheel 7: Rear-Left   (Axle 4), Wheel 8: Rear-Right   (Axle 4) *)
    aWheelCoordX                : ARRAY[1..8] OF REAL := [4.50,  4.50,  1.50,  1.50, -1.50, -1.50, -4.50, -4.50];
    aWheelCoordY                : ARRAY[1..8] OF REAL := [2.40, -2.40,  2.40, -2.40,  2.40, -2.40,  2.40, -2.40];

    (* =========================== 2oo3 TMR STEERING VOTER DATA STRUCTURES ======================= *)
    aVotedSteerAngles           : ARRAY[1..8] OF REAL;       (* Filtered voted steering angle per wheel [deg] *)
    aPrevVotedSteerAngles       : ARRAY[1..8] OF REAL;       (* Historical voted steer angle for rate-limit [deg] *)
    aSteerSensorHealthy         : ARRAY[1..8, 1..3] OF BOOL; (* Sensor channel health bit per wheel [1..8, 1..3] *)
    aSteerDiscrepancyTime       : ARRAY[1..8, 1..3] OF REAL; (* Disagreement duration accumulators [s] *)
    aSteerChannelFaultLogged    : ARRAY[1..8, 1..3] OF BOOL; (* Latched channel failure flag *)
    aWheelSteerDegraded         : ARRAY[1..8] OF BOOL;       (* Indicates 1oo2 operating mode for wheel axis *)
    aWheelSteerCriticalTrip     : ARRAY[1..8] OF BOOL;       (* Dual/triple sensor loss trip for wheel axis *)
    rTmrToleranceThresholdDeg   : REAL := 1.25;              (* Pairwise deviation tolerance limit [deg] *)
    rTmrDiscrepancyTripTimeSec  : REAL := 0.120;             (* Max continuous deviation time before lockout [s] *)
    rMaxSteeringRateDegPerSec   : REAL := 28.0;              (* Physical hydraulic/electric steering slew limit [deg/s] *)

    (* =========================== STATE-SPACE MATRICES FOR ANTI-SWAY PENDULUM =================== *)
    (* Continuous system matrices: A (4x4), B (4x2), C (2x4), D (2x2) *)
    aMatrixA                    : ARRAY[1..4, 1..4] OF REAL; (* Dynamic state transition matrix *)
    aMatrixB                    : ARRAY[1..4, 1..2] OF REAL; (* Input control distribution matrix *)
    aMatrixC                    : ARRAY[1..2, 1..4] OF REAL; (* Measurement mapping matrix *)
    aMatrixD                    : ARRAY[1..2, 1..2] OF REAL; (* Direct feedthrough matrix *)

    (* Discretized system matrices: A_d (4x4), B_d (4x2) via 2nd-order Taylor expansion *)
    aMatrixA_d                  : ARRAY[1..4, 1..4] OF REAL; (* Discrete state transition matrix *)
    aMatrixB_d                  : ARRAY[1..4, 1..2] OF REAL; (* Discrete input matrix *)

    (* Kalman / Luenberger State Observer variables *)
    aStateEstimatedX            : ARRAY[1..4] OF REAL;       (* [swayAngleX (rad), swayVelX (rad/s), swayAngleY (rad), swayVelY (rad/s)] *)
    aStateObservedPredict       : ARRAY[1..4] OF REAL;       (* One-step forward prediction vector *)
    aMeasurementResidual        : ARRAY[1..2] OF REAL;       (* Innovation error: y_meas - C*x_hat *)
    aObserverGainK              : ARRAY[1..4, 1..2] OF REAL; (* Steady-state Kalman filter gain matrix *)

    (* Model Predictive Control (MPC) Cost Weight Matrices: Q (4x4), R (2x2) *)
    aMpcWeightQ                 : ARRAY[1..4, 1..4] OF REAL; (* State deviation penalty *)
    aMpcWeightR                 : ARRAY[1..2, 1..2] OF REAL; (* Actuator control effort penalty *)
    aMpcGainK                   : ARRAY[1..2, 1..4] OF REAL; (* Closed-loop Riccati optimal state feedback gain *)

    (* =========================== ZVD INPUT SHAPING TRAJECTORY BUFFER ============================ *)
    rZvdAmp1                    : REAL;                      (* Impulse 1 amplitude [-] *)
    rZvdAmp2                    : REAL;                      (* Impulse 2 amplitude [-] *)
    rZvdAmp3                    : REAL;                      (* Impulse 3 amplitude [-] *)
    rZvdTime1                   : REAL;                      (* Impulse 1 execution timestamp [s] *)
    rZvdTime2                   : REAL;                      (* Impulse 2 execution timestamp [s] *)
    rZvdTime3                   : REAL;                      (* Impulse 3 execution timestamp [s] *)
    rZvdPeriod                  : REAL;                      (* Natural damped oscillation period [s] *)
    aJerkCommandHistoryX        : ARRAY[0..127] OF REAL;     (* Circular buffer for gantry X acceleration commands *)
    aJerkCommandHistoryY        : ARRAY[0..127] OF REAL;     (* Circular buffer for trolley Y acceleration commands *)
    iBufferHeadIndex            : INT := 0;                  (* Head index of input shaping circular buffer *)

    (* =========================== HOIST WINCH 7-SEGMENT S-CURVE GENERATOR ======================== *)
    rHoistProfilePos            : REAL := 2.50;              (* Current commanded trajectory position [m] *)
    rHoistProfileVel            : REAL := 0.00;              (* Current commanded trajectory velocity [m/s] *)
    rHoistProfileAccel          : REAL := 0.00;              (* Current commanded trajectory acceleration [m/s2] *)
    rMaxHoistVelocity           : REAL := 1.10;              (* Absolute maximum cable lifting speed [m/s] *)
    rMaxHoistAccel              : REAL := 0.65;              (* Maximum cable vertical acceleration [m/s2] *)
    rMaxHoistJerk               : REAL := 1.80;              (* Maximum hoist jerk limit [m/s3] *)
    rSoftTouchdownCreepSpeed    : REAL := 0.065;             (* Terminal landing contact creep speed [m/s] *)
    rTouchdownThresholdDistance : REAL := 0.850;             (* Proximity distance to activate soft-landing [m] *)
    rPreviousHoistTension       : REAL := 0.00;              (* Past cycle cable tension for force derivative [kN] *)
    rTensionDropRate            : REAL := 0.00;              (* Calculated dF_rope/dt [kN/s] *)
    bTouchdownDetected          : BOOL := FALSE;             (* Spreader container landed confirmation flag *)
    bSlackRopeWarning           : BOOL := FALSE;             (* Critical wire rope tension loss warning *)

    (* =========================== SPREADER SKEW DAMPING CONTROLLER ============================== *)
    rSkewAngleFilter            : REAL := 0.00;              (* Filtered spreader yaw skew angle [deg] *)
    rSkewDerivativeFilter       : REAL := 0.00;              (* Derivative of spreader yaw skew [deg/s] *)
    rPrevSkewAngle              : REAL := 0.00;              (* Previous cycle skew angle for differentiation [deg] *)
    rSkewProportionalGain       : REAL := 4.50;              (* Skew P-gain [RPM/deg] *)
    rSkewDerivativeGain         : REAL := 2.20;              (* Skew D-gain [RPM/(deg/s)] *)

    (* =========================== HYBRID DIESEL-ELECTRIC POWER MANAGEMENT ======================== *)
    rTotalTractionPowerDemandkW : REAL := 0.00;              (* Calculated net traction mechanical power [kW] *)
    rTotalHoistPowerDemandkW    : REAL := 0.00;              (* Calculated net hoist mechanical power [kW] *)
    rTotalAuxiliaryPowerkW      : REAL := 18.50;             (* Constant 24V/400V auxiliary electrical load [kW] *)
    rTotalDCLinkPowerDemandkW   : REAL := 0.00;              (* Aggregate instantaneous DC microgrid demand [kW] *)
    rGensetOptimumEfficiencykW  : REAL := 280.0;             (* Stage V Diesel BSFC sweet spot baseline [kW] *)
    rGensetFilterDemandkW       : REAL := 0.00;              (* Low-pass filtered diesel power command [kW] *)
    rDCLinkChopperThresholdV    : REAL := 760.0;             (* Resistor chopper turn-on voltage [V] *)
    rDCLinkChopperCeilingV      : REAL := 820.0;             (* 100% duty cycle chopper threshold [V] *)

    (* =========================== MASTER DETERMINISTIC FINITE STATE MACHINE ====================== *)
    iMachineState               : INT := 0;                  (* Master FSM State Variable *)
    iPreviousMachineState       : INT := -1;                 (* Previous cycle FSM state *)
    tStateDwellTime             : REAL := 0.00;              (* Continuous time in current state [s] *)
    tModeTransitionTimer        : REAL := 0.00;              (* Steer mode geometry alignment timer [s] *)
    tPrechargeTimer             : REAL := 0.00;              (* DC bus contactor precharge timer [s] *)
    tEngineCrankTimer           : REAL := 0.00;              (* Diesel starter crank cycle timer [s] *)

    (* State Machine Symbolic Step Definitions *)
    STATE_BOOT_INIT             : INT := 0;                  (* Cold boot & hardware ROM/RAM self-test *)
    STATE_SAFETY_INTERLOCK_WAIT : INT := 10;                 (* Awaiting safety loops & operator reset *)
    STATE_TMR_SENSOR_ALIGN      : INT := 20;                 (* 2oo3 steering sensor calibration & verification *)
    STATE_GENSET_PREHEAT_CRANK  : INT := 30;                 (* Diesel engine ignition & governor idle *)
    STATE_DC_BUS_PRECHARGE      : INT := 40;                 (* Resistor precharge of 700V DC inverter bus *)
    STATE_SYSTEM_READY_IDLE     : INT := 50;                 (* Carrier stationary, brakes set, ready for mission *)
    STATE_STEER_MODE_ALIGNING   : INT := 60;                 (* In-situ wheel pivot to match commanded geometry *)
    STATE_GANTRY_TRACTION_ACTIVE: INT := 70;                 (* Vehicle coordinated path travel *)
    STATE_HOIST_TRAJECTORY_EXEC : INT := 80;                 (* Vertical container lift/lower with anti-sway *)
    STATE_COMBINED_TRANSIT_SWAY : INT := 90;                 (* Concurrent travel and hoisting with 3D damping *)
    STATE_PRECISION_TOUCHDOWN   : INT := 100;                (* Container soft landing onto chassis/stack *)
    STATE_HOLD_DECEL_PARKING    : INT := 110;                (* Controlled deceleration & caliper clamp *)
    STATE_DEGRADED_FAIL_OP      : INT := 120;                (* 1oo2 fail-operational mode under reduced speed *)
    STATE_CONTROLLED_STOP_CAT1  : INT := 200;                (* Category 1 dynamic regenerative ramp-down *)
    STATE_EMERGENCY_SHUTDOWN_CAT0: INT := 999;               (* Category 0 instantaneous mechanical arrest *)

    (* Loop and utility variables *)
    idx                         : INT := 1;                  (* Primary loop iterator *)
    jdx                         : INT := 1;                  (* Secondary loop iterator *)
    kdx                         : INT := 1;                  (* Tertiary loop iterator *)
    rTempDiff12                 : REAL := 0.00;              (* Channel 1 vs 2 difference *)
    rTempDiff13                 : REAL := 0.00;              (* Channel 1 vs 3 difference *)
    rTempDiff23                 : REAL := 0.00;              (* Channel 2 vs 3 difference *)
    rSelectedAngle              : REAL := 0.00;              (* Selected voted angle *)
    rDeltaSlew                  : REAL := 0.00;              (* Slew rate increment *)
    rCurvatureKappa             : REAL := 0.00;              (* Virtual vehicle turning curvature [1/m] *)
    rRadiusICR                  : REAL := 0.00;              (* Turn radius to center [m] *)
    rTargetGantryLinearSpeedMS  : REAL := 0.00;              (* Target chassis speed in m/s *)
    rNaturalFreqOmegaN          : REAL := 0.00;              (* Pendulum natural frequency [rad/s] *)
    rCableLengthClamp           : REAL := 2.50;              (* Safe clamped cable length for division [m] *)
    rEffectiveGravity           : REAL := 9.81;              (* g + z_ddot dynamic gravity [m/s2] *)
    rStateUpdateTemp            : REAL := 0.00;              (* Matrix multiplication accumulator *)
    bCriticalFaultActive        : BOOL := FALSE;             (* Master fault latch flag *)
END_VAR

(*
========================================================================================================================
                                                    MAIN CONTROL LOGIC
========================================================================================================================
*)

(* -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* SECTION 1: EXECUTION TASK INTEGRITY, INITIALIZATION & SAFETY INTERLOCK SUPERVISION                                    *)
(* -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* Verify deterministic task execution period *)
IF rCycleTimeSeconds < 0.002 OR rCycleTimeSeconds > 0.100 THEN
    rCycleTimeSeconds := 0.010; (* Default to 10 ms cycle time upon out-of-range *)
END_IF;

(* Clear dynamic fault words prior to cyclical evaluation *)
dwFaultWord1 := 16#00000000;
dwFaultWord2 := 16#00000000;
dwWarningWord := 16#00000000;
bCriticalFaultActive := FALSE;

(* Critical Safety Relay & Emergency Stop Loop Evaluation (SIL 3 / Category 4 fail-safe) *)
IF NOT bEStopActive_NC THEN
    dwFaultWord1 := dwFaultWord1 OR 16#00000001; (* Bit 0: Emergency Stop Loop Broken / Tripped *)
    bCriticalFaultActive := TRUE;
END_IF;

IF NOT bSafetyGateClosed THEN
    dwFaultWord1 := dwFaultWord1 OR 16#00000002; (* Bit 1: Structural Enclosure / Service Gate Open *)
    bCriticalFaultActive := TRUE;
END_IF;

(* DC Microgrid Voltage Window Verification *)
IF rDCLinkVoltage > 860.0 THEN
    dwFaultWord1 := dwFaultWord1 OR 16#00000004; (* Bit 2: Critical DC Bus Overvoltage (>860V) *)
    bCriticalFaultActive := TRUE;
ELSIF rDCLinkVoltage < 450.0 AND iMachineState >= STATE_SYSTEM_READY_IDLE THEN
    dwFaultWord1 := dwFaultWord1 OR 16#00000008; (* Bit 3: Critical DC Bus Undervoltage (<450V) *)
    bCriticalFaultActive := TRUE;
END_IF;

(* Diesel Engine Health Diagnostics *)
IF rGensetCoolantTemp > 108.0 THEN
    dwFaultWord1 := dwFaultWord1 OR 16#00000010; (* Bit 4: Engine Over-Temperature Alarm *)
    bCriticalFaultActive := TRUE;
ELSIF rGensetCoolantTemp > 98.0 THEN
    dwWarningWord := dwWarningWord OR 16#00000001; (* Bit 0: Engine Coolant High Warning *)
END_IF;

(* Wind Speed Structural Tip-Over Interlock *)
IF rWindSpeedGust > 32.0 THEN
    dwFaultWord1 := dwFaultWord1 OR 16#00000020; (* Bit 5: Severe Gale Storm Wind Interlock (>32 m/s) *)
    bCriticalFaultActive := TRUE;
ELSIF rWindSpeedGust > 22.0 THEN
    dwWarningWord := dwWarningWord OR 16#00000002; (* Bit 1: High Wind Warning (>22 m/s) *)
END_IF;

(* Suspended Load Safe Operating Limits *)
IF rContainerGrossMass > 48.0 THEN
    dwFaultWord1 := dwFaultWord1 OR 16#00000040; (* Bit 6: Structural Safe Working Load (SWL) Exceeded *)
    bCriticalFaultActive := TRUE;
END_IF;

(* Wire Rope Tension & Slack Rope Detection *)
IF rActualHoistPosition > 1.0 AND rTotalHoistTension < 12.0 AND rContainerGrossMass > 5.0 THEN
    bSlackRopeWarning := TRUE;
    dwWarningWord := dwWarningWord OR 16#00000004; (* Bit 2: Hoist Cable Slack Detected *)
ELSE
    bSlackRopeWarning := FALSE;
END_IF;

(* Immediate E-Stop or Critical Fault Vectoring *)
IF bCriticalFaultActive THEN
    iMachineState := STATE_EMERGENCY_SHUTDOWN_CAT0;
END_IF;

(* -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* SECTION 2: 2oo3 TRIPLE MODULAR REDUNDANCY (TMR) STEERING SENSOR VOTER ROUTINE                                        *)
(* -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* Evaluates 8 steer axes x 3 redundant physical sensors (Encoder, Resolver, Potentiometer)                              *)
bDegradedModeActive := FALSE;

FOR idx := 1 TO 8 DO
    (* Compute absolute pairwise sensor discrepancies *)
    rTempDiff12 := ABS(aRawSteerEncoders[idx, 1] - aRawSteerEncoders[idx, 2]);
    rTempDiff13 := ABS(aRawSteerEncoders[idx, 1] - aRawSteerEncoders[idx, 3]);
    rTempDiff23 := ABS(aRawSteerEncoders[idx, 2] - aRawSteerEncoders[idx, 3]);

    (* Case A: Full 3-channel agreement within tolerance *)
    IF (rTempDiff12 <= rTmrToleranceThresholdDeg) AND
       (rTempDiff13 <= rTmrToleranceThresholdDeg) AND
       (rTempDiff23 <= rTmrToleranceThresholdDeg) THEN

        (* True Median Selection among three healthy channels *)
        IF (aRawSteerEncoders[idx, 1] >= aRawSteerEncoders[idx, 2] AND aRawSteerEncoders[idx, 1] <= aRawSteerEncoders[idx, 3]) OR
           (aRawSteerEncoders[idx, 1] <= aRawSteerEncoders[idx, 2] AND aRawSteerEncoders[idx, 1] >= aRawSteerEncoders[idx, 3]) THEN
            rSelectedAngle := aRawSteerEncoders[idx, 1];
        ELSIF (aRawSteerEncoders[idx, 2] >= aRawSteerEncoders[idx, 1] AND aRawSteerEncoders[idx, 2] <= aRawSteerEncoders[idx, 3]) OR
              (aRawSteerEncoders[idx, 2] <= aRawSteerEncoders[idx, 1] AND aRawSteerEncoders[idx, 2] >= aRawSteerEncoders[idx, 3]) THEN
            rSelectedAngle := aRawSteerEncoders[idx, 2];
        ELSE
            rSelectedAngle := aRawSteerEncoders[idx, 3];
        END_IF;

        (* Reset discrepancy timers and maintain healthy status *)
        aSteerSensorHealthy[idx, 1] := TRUE;
        aSteerSensorHealthy[idx, 2] := TRUE;
        aSteerSensorHealthy[idx, 3] := TRUE;
        aSteerDiscrepancyTime[idx, 1] := 0.0;
        aSteerDiscrepancyTime[idx, 2] := 0.0;
        aSteerDiscrepancyTime[idx, 3] := 0.0;
        aWheelSteerDegraded[idx] := FALSE;
        aWheelSteerCriticalTrip[idx] := FALSE;

    (* Case B: Channels 1 and 2 agree, Channel 3 aberrant *)
    ELSIF (rTempDiff12 <= rTmrToleranceThresholdDeg) THEN
        rSelectedAngle := 0.5 * (aRawSteerEncoders[idx, 1] + aRawSteerEncoders[idx, 2]);
        aSteerSensorHealthy[idx, 1] := TRUE;
        aSteerSensorHealthy[idx, 2] := TRUE;
        aSteerDiscrepancyTime[idx, 3] := aSteerDiscrepancyTime[idx, 3] + rCycleTimeSeconds;
        IF aSteerDiscrepancyTime[idx, 3] > rTmrDiscrepancyTripTimeSec THEN
            aSteerSensorHealthy[idx, 3] := FALSE;
            aSteerChannelFaultLogged[idx, 3] := TRUE;
            aWheelSteerDegraded[idx] := TRUE;
        END_IF;

    (* Case C: Channels 1 and 3 agree, Channel 2 aberrant *)
    ELSIF (rTempDiff13 <= rTmrToleranceThresholdDeg) THEN
        rSelectedAngle := 0.5 * (aRawSteerEncoders[idx, 1] + aRawSteerEncoders[idx, 3]);
        aSteerSensorHealthy[idx, 1] := TRUE;
        aSteerSensorHealthy[idx, 3] := TRUE;
        aSteerDiscrepancyTime[idx, 2] := aSteerDiscrepancyTime[idx, 2] + rCycleTimeSeconds;
        IF aSteerDiscrepancyTime[idx, 2] > rTmrDiscrepancyTripTimeSec THEN
            aSteerSensorHealthy[idx, 2] := FALSE;
            aSteerChannelFaultLogged[idx, 2] := TRUE;
            aWheelSteerDegraded[idx] := TRUE;
        END_IF;

    (* Case D: Channels 2 and 3 agree, Channel 1 aberrant *)
    ELSIF (rTempDiff23 <= rTmrToleranceThresholdDeg) THEN
        rSelectedAngle := 0.5 * (aRawSteerEncoders[idx, 2] + aRawSteerEncoders[idx, 3]);
        aSteerSensorHealthy[idx, 2] := TRUE;
        aSteerSensorHealthy[idx, 3] := TRUE;
        aSteerDiscrepancyTime[idx, 1] := aSteerDiscrepancyTime[idx, 1] + rCycleTimeSeconds;
        IF aSteerDiscrepancyTime[idx, 1] > rTmrDiscrepancyTripTimeSec THEN
            aSteerSensorHealthy[idx, 1] := FALSE;
            aSteerChannelFaultLogged[idx, 1] := TRUE;
            aWheelSteerDegraded[idx] := TRUE;
        END_IF;

    (* Case E: Total Disagreement - No two sensors match (2oo3 Voting Failure) *)
    ELSE
        rSelectedAngle := aPrevVotedSteerAngles[idx]; (* Latch previous valid angle *)
        aWheelSteerCriticalTrip[idx] := TRUE;
        dwFaultWord2 := dwFaultWord2 OR SHL(16#00000001, (idx - 1)); (* Bits 0..7: Wheel 1..8 2oo3 Critical Trip *)
    END_IF;

    (* Rate of Change Filter (Physical Slew Rate Limiter) *)
    rDeltaSlew := rSelectedAngle - aPrevVotedSteerAngles[idx];
    IF ABS(rDeltaSlew) > (rMaxSteeringRateDegPerSec * rCycleTimeSeconds) THEN
        IF rDeltaSlew > 0.0 THEN
            rSelectedAngle := aPrevVotedSteerAngles[idx] + (rMaxSteeringRateDegPerSec * rCycleTimeSeconds);
        ELSE
            rSelectedAngle := aPrevVotedSteerAngles[idx] - (rMaxSteeringRateDegPerSec * rCycleTimeSeconds);
        END_IF;
    END_IF;

    aVotedSteerAngles[idx] := rSelectedAngle;
    aPrevVotedSteerAngles[idx] := rSelectedAngle;

    (* Track overall degraded status *)
    IF aWheelSteerDegraded[idx] THEN
        bDegradedModeActive := TRUE;
        dwWarningWord := dwWarningWord OR SHL(16#00000010, (idx - 1)); (* Bits 4..11: 1oo2 Degraded Mode *)
    END_IF;
END_FOR;

(* Critical Steer Failure Interlock *)
FOR idx := 1 TO 8 DO
    IF aWheelSteerCriticalTrip[idx] THEN
        iMachineState := STATE_CONTROLLED_STOP_CAT1;
    END_IF;
END_FOR;

(* -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* SECTION 3: MULTI-AXLE KINEMATICS & 8-WHEEL STEERING/TRACTION VECTOR DISTRIBUTION                                   *)
(* -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
rTargetGantryLinearSpeedMS := rDesiredGantrySpeed * CONST_KMH_TO_MS;

(* Clamp commanded steering angle *)
IF rDesiredSteerAngle > 90.0 THEN rDesiredSteerAngle := 90.0; END_IF;
IF rDesiredSteerAngle < -90.0 THEN rDesiredSteerAngle := -90.0; END_IF;

CASE iSteeringModeCmd OF
    (* ==================== MODE 0: ALL-WHEEL VIRTUAL ACKERMANN STEERING ==================== *)
    0:
        iActiveSteeringMode := 0;
        (* Check for straight-line motion (infinite turning radius) *)
        IF ABS(rDesiredSteerAngle) < 0.15 THEN
            FOR idx := 1 TO 8 DO
                aTargetWheelSteerAngles[idx] := 0.0;
                aTargetWheelSpeedsRPM[idx] := (rTargetGantryLinearSpeedMS / (2.0 * CONST_PI * CONST_WHEEL_RADIUS_M))
                                              * 60.0 * CONST_GEAR_RATIO_TRACTION;
                aTargetWheelTorquesNm[idx] := 1850.0; (* Standard traction torque ceiling *)
            END_FOR;
        ELSE
            (* Multi-axle virtual curvature computation *)
            rCurvatureKappa := TAN(rDesiredSteerAngle * CONST_DEG_TO_RAD) / 6.00; (* Effective wheelbase 6.0m *)
            rRadiusICR := 1.0 / rCurvatureKappa; (* Lateral distance to Instantaneous Center of Rotation *)

            FOR idx := 1 TO 8 DO
                (* Individual wheel steering angle to intersect ICR at (0, R_ICR) *)
                aTargetWheelSteerAngles[idx] := ATAN2(aWheelCoordX[idx], (rRadiusICR - aWheelCoordY[idx])) * CONST_RAD_TO_DEG;

                (* Individual wheel velocity proportional to distance from ICR *)
                aTargetWheelSpeedsRPM[idx] := (rTargetGantryLinearSpeedMS / (2.0 * CONST_PI * CONST_WHEEL_RADIUS_M))
                                              * (SQRT(EXPT(rRadiusICR - aWheelCoordY[idx], 2) + EXPT(aWheelCoordX[idx], 2)) / ABS(rRadiusICR))
                                              * 60.0 * CONST_GEAR_RATIO_TRACTION;

                (* Outer wheels receive higher torque bias to mitigate tire scrubbing *)
                IF (rRadiusICR > 0.0 AND aWheelCoordY[idx] < 0.0) OR (rRadiusICR < 0.0 AND aWheelCoordY[idx] > 0.0) THEN
                    aTargetWheelTorquesNm[idx] := 2400.0; (* High outer torque *)
                ELSE
                    aTargetWheelTorquesNm[idx] := 1500.0; (* Low inner torque *)
                END_IF;
            END_FOR;
        END_IF;

    (* ==================== MODE 1: PARALLEL CRAB STEERING (DIAGONAL DOCKING) ==================== *)
    1:
        iActiveSteeringMode := 1;
        FOR idx := 1 TO 8 DO
            aTargetWheelSteerAngles[idx] := rDesiredSteerAngle;
            aTargetWheelSpeedsRPM[idx] := (rTargetGantryLinearSpeedMS / (2.0 * CONST_PI * CONST_WHEEL_RADIUS_M))
                                          * 60.0 * CONST_GEAR_RATIO_TRACTION;
            aTargetWheelTorquesNm[idx] := 2000.0;
        END_FOR;

    (* ==================== MODE 2: CAROUSEL (ZERO-RADIUS YAW SPIN) ==================== *)
    2:
        iActiveSteeringMode := 2;
        FOR idx := 1 TO 8 DO
            (* Wheel steering angle tangential to center rotation radius *)
            aTargetWheelSteerAngles[idx] := (ATAN2(aWheelCoordY[idx], aWheelCoordX[idx]) * CONST_RAD_TO_DEG) + 90.0;
            IF aTargetWheelSteerAngles[idx] > 90.0 THEN
                aTargetWheelSteerAngles[idx] := aTargetWheelSteerAngles[idx] - 180.0;
            ELSIF aTargetWheelSteerAngles[idx] < -90.0 THEN
                aTargetWheelSteerAngles[idx] := aTargetWheelSteerAngles[idx] + 180.0;
            END_IF;

            (* Tangential speed based on radial distance from carrier center *)
            aTargetWheelSpeedsRPM[idx] := ((rDesiredYawRate * CONST_DEG_TO_RAD * SQRT(EXPT(aWheelCoordX[idx], 2) + EXPT(aWheelCoordY[idx], 2)))
                                          / (2.0 * CONST_PI * CONST_WHEEL_RADIUS_M)) * 60.0 * CONST_GEAR_RATIO_TRACTION;
            aTargetWheelTorquesNm[idx] := 2200.0;
        END_FOR;

    (* ==================== MODE 3: FRONT-AXLE ONLY TRANSIT (ROAD/SAFETY MODE) ==================== *)
    ELSE
        iActiveSteeringMode := 3;
        (* Wheels 1..4 steer; Wheels 5..8 locked at 0.0 deg *)
        aTargetWheelSteerAngles[1] := rDesiredSteerAngle;
        aTargetWheelSteerAngles[2] := rDesiredSteerAngle;
        aTargetWheelSteerAngles[3] := rDesiredSteerAngle * 0.65;
        aTargetWheelSteerAngles[4] := rDesiredSteerAngle * 0.65;
        aTargetWheelSteerAngles[5] := 0.0;
        aTargetWheelSteerAngles[6] := 0.0;
        aTargetWheelSteerAngles[7] := 0.0;
        aTargetWheelSteerAngles[8] := 0.0;
        FOR idx := 1 TO 8 DO
            aTargetWheelSpeedsRPM[idx] := (rTargetGantryLinearSpeedMS / (2.0 * CONST_PI * CONST_WHEEL_RADIUS_M))
                                          * 60.0 * CONST_GEAR_RATIO_TRACTION;
            aTargetWheelTorquesNm[idx] := 1800.0;
        END_FOR;
END_CASE;

(* -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* SECTION 4: CONTAINER HOIST WINCH S-CURVE MOTION PROFILE & SOFT TOUCHDOWN LOGIC                                        *)
(* -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* Calculate dynamic force rate of change for touchdown ground reaction detection *)
rTensionDropRate := (rTotalHoistTension - rPreviousHoistTension) / rCycleTimeSeconds;
rPreviousHoistTension := rTotalHoistTension;

(* Touchdown Detection: Sharp drop in rope tension as container mass transfers to ground/stack *)
IF (rActualHoistPosition <= (rTargetHoistPosition + rTouchdownThresholdDistance)) AND
   (rTensionDropRate < -140.0) AND (rTotalHoistTension < ((rContainerGrossMass * 9.81) * 0.45)) THEN
    bTouchdownDetected := TRUE;
    rHoistProfileVel := 0.0;
    rHoistProfileAccel := 0.0;
ELSE
    bTouchdownDetected := FALSE;
END_IF;

(* 7-Segment Jerk-Limited S-Curve Motion Profiler *)
IF NOT bTouchdownDetected THEN
    (* Evaluate position error *)
    IF rTargetHoistPosition > rHoistProfilePos THEN
        (* Hoisting Up *)
        IF rHoistProfileVel < rMaxHoistVelocity THEN
            rHoistProfileAccel := rHoistProfileAccel + (rMaxHoistJerk * rCycleTimeSeconds);
            IF rHoistProfileAccel > rMaxHoistAccel THEN rHoistProfileAccel := rMaxHoistAccel; END_IF;
        END_IF;
        rHoistProfileVel := rHoistProfileVel + (rHoistProfileAccel * rCycleTimeSeconds);
        IF rHoistProfileVel > rMaxHoistVelocity THEN rHoistProfileVel := rMaxHoistVelocity; END_IF;
    ELSIF rTargetHoistPosition < rHoistProfilePos THEN
        (* Lowering Down *)
        (* Activate creep speed as proximity threshold is entered *)
        IF ABS(rTargetHoistPosition - rHoistProfilePos) < rTouchdownThresholdDistance THEN
            IF rHoistProfileVel > (-rSoftTouchdownCreepSpeed) THEN
                rHoistProfileVel := -rSoftTouchdownCreepSpeed;
            ELSE
                rHoistProfileVel := rHoistProfileVel + (rMaxHoistAccel * rCycleTimeSeconds);
            END_IF;
        ELSE
            IF rHoistProfileVel > (-rMaxHoistVelocity) THEN
                rHoistProfileAccel := rHoistProfileAccel - (rMaxHoistJerk * rCycleTimeSeconds);
                IF rHoistProfileAccel < (-rMaxHoistAccel) THEN rHoistProfileAccel := -rMaxHoistAccel; END_IF;
            END_IF;
            rHoistProfileVel := rHoistProfileVel + (rHoistProfileAccel * rCycleTimeSeconds);
            IF rHoistProfileVel < (-rMaxHoistVelocity) THEN rHoistProfileVel := -rMaxHoistVelocity; END_IF;
        END_IF;
    ELSE
        rHoistProfileVel := 0.0;
        rHoistProfileAccel := 0.0;
    END_IF;
    rHoistProfilePos := rHoistProfilePos + (rHoistProfileVel * rCycleTimeSeconds);
END_IF;

(* Convert linear rope trajectory speed to winch motor RPM *)
rTargetHoistMotorSpeedRPM := (rHoistProfileVel / (2.0 * CONST_PI * CONST_HOIST_DRUM_RADIUS_M))
                             * 60.0 * CONST_GEAR_RATIO_HOIST;

(* -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* SECTION 5: PENDULUM ANTI-SWAY STATE-SPACE MATRICES & KALMAN OBSERVER UPDATE                                         *)
(* -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* Safe clamp of cable length to prevent division by zero *)
rCableLengthClamp := rActualHoistPosition;
IF rCableLengthClamp < 2.00 THEN rCableLengthClamp := 2.00; END_IF;

(* Dynamic effective gravity accounting for vertical hoist acceleration *)
rEffectiveGravity := CONST_GRAVITY + rHoistProfileAccel;
IF rEffectiveGravity < 3.0 THEN rEffectiveGravity := 3.0; END_IF;

(* Natural pendulum angular frequency omega_n = sqrt(g_eff / L) *)
rNaturalFreqOmegaN := SQRT(rEffectiveGravity / rCableLengthClamp);

(* Re-evaluate Continuous State Matrix A(t) based on instantaneous cable length and lowering speed *)
aMatrixA[1, 1] := 0.0;
aMatrixA[1, 2] := 1.0;
aMatrixA[1, 3] := 0.0;
aMatrixA[1, 4] := 0.0;

aMatrixA[2, 1] := -(EXPT(rNaturalFreqOmegaN, 2));
aMatrixA[2, 2] := -2.0 * (rActualHoistVelocity / rCableLengthClamp) - 0.045; (* Aerodynamic & cable friction damping *)
aMatrixA[2, 3] := 0.0;
aMatrixA[2, 4] := 0.0;

aMatrixA[3, 1] := 0.0;
aMatrixA[3, 2] := 0.0;
aMatrixA[3, 3] := 0.0;
aMatrixA[3, 4] := 1.0;

aMatrixA[4, 1] := 0.0;
aMatrixA[4, 2] := 0.0;
aMatrixA[4, 3] := -(EXPT(rNaturalFreqOmegaN, 2));
aMatrixA[4, 4] := -2.0 * (rActualHoistVelocity / rCableLengthClamp) - 0.045;

(* Input Distribution Matrix B(t) *)
aMatrixB[1, 1] := 0.0;
aMatrixB[1, 2] := 0.0;
aMatrixB[2, 1] := -1.0 / rCableLengthClamp; (* Longitudinal gantry acceleration input *)
aMatrixB[2, 2] := 0.0;
aMatrixB[3, 1] := 0.0;
aMatrixB[3, 2] := 0.0;
aMatrixB[4, 1] := 0.0;
aMatrixB[4, 2] := -1.0 / rCableLengthClamp; (* Transverse trolley/crab acceleration input *)

(* Discretize Matrices via 2nd-Order Taylor Series: A_d = I + A*Ts + 0.5*(A*Ts)^2 *)
FOR idx := 1 TO 4 DO
    FOR jdx := 1 TO 4 DO
        IF idx = jdx THEN
            aMatrixA_d[idx, jdx] := 1.0 + (aMatrixA[idx, jdx] * rCycleTimeSeconds);
        ELSE
            aMatrixA_d[idx, jdx] := (aMatrixA[idx, jdx] * rCycleTimeSeconds);
        END_IF;
        (* Add second-order term 0.5 * A^2 * Ts^2 *)
        FOR kdx := 1 TO 4 DO
            aMatrixA_d[idx, jdx] := aMatrixA_d[idx, jdx] +
                                    (0.5 * aMatrixA[idx, kdx] * aMatrixA[kdx, jdx] * EXPT(rCycleTimeSeconds, 2));
        END_FOR;
    END_FOR;
END_FOR;

(* Discretize Input Matrix B_d = B*Ts + 0.5*A*B*Ts^2 *)
FOR idx := 1 TO 4 DO
    FOR jdx := 1 TO 2 DO
        aMatrixB_d[idx, jdx] := aMatrixB[idx, jdx] * rCycleTimeSeconds;
        FOR kdx := 1 TO 4 DO
            aMatrixB_d[idx, jdx] := aMatrixB_d[idx, jdx] +
                                    (0.5 * aMatrixA[idx, kdx] * aMatrixB[kdx, jdx] * EXPT(rCycleTimeSeconds, 2));
        END_FOR;
    END_FOR;
END_FOR;

(* Kalman Observer Innovation & State Correction *)
IF bSwaySensorValid THEN
    aMeasurementResidual[1] := (rLaserSwayAngleX * CONST_DEG_TO_RAD) - aStateEstimatedX[1];
    aMeasurementResidual[2] := (rLaserSwayAngleY * CONST_DEG_TO_RAD) - aStateEstimatedX[3];
ELSE
    (* Sensor dead-reckoning during optical path occlusion *)
    aMeasurementResidual[1] := 0.0;
    aMeasurementResidual[2] := 0.0;
    dwWarningWord := dwWarningWord OR 16#00000008; (* Bit 3: Laser Sway Sensor Occluded *)
END_IF;

(* Observer Gain Tuning Matrix K_obs *)
aObserverGainK[1, 1] := 0.38; aObserverGainK[1, 2] := 0.00;
aObserverGainK[2, 1] := 1.85; aObserverGainK[2, 2] := 0.00;
aObserverGainK[3, 1] := 0.00; aObserverGainK[3, 2] := 0.38;
aObserverGainK[4, 1] := 0.00; aObserverGainK[4, 2] := 1.85;

(* State Update: x_hat = A_d * x_hat + B_d * u + K_obs * e_innov *)
FOR idx := 1 TO 4 DO
    rStateUpdateTemp := 0.0;
    FOR jdx := 1 TO 4 DO
        rStateUpdateTemp := rStateUpdateTemp + (aMatrixA_d[idx, jdx] * aStateEstimatedX[jdx]);
    END_FOR;
    rStateUpdateTemp := rStateUpdateTemp + (aMatrixB_d[idx, 1] * rAntiSwayCorrectiveAccelX) +
                                          (aMatrixB_d[idx, 2] * rAntiSwayCorrectiveAccelY) +
                                          (aObserverGainK[idx, 1] * aMeasurementResidual[1]) +
                                          (aObserverGainK[idx, 2] * aMeasurementResidual[2]);
    aStateObservedPredict[idx] := rStateUpdateTemp;
END_FOR;

FOR idx := 1 TO 4 DO
    aStateEstimatedX[idx] := aStateObservedPredict[idx];
END_FOR;

rEstimatedSwayResidualDeg := SQRT(EXPT(aStateEstimatedX[1] * CONST_RAD_TO_DEG, 2) +
                                  EXPT(aStateEstimatedX[3] * CONST_RAD_TO_DEG, 2));

(* -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* SECTION 6: MODEL PREDICTIVE CONTROL (MPC) & ZERO-VIBRATION-DERIVATIVE (ZVD) SHAPING                                  *)
(* -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* MPC Quadratic Cost Gain Approximation parameterized by dynamic frequency *)
(* Gain K_mpc = [K_pos, K_vel] dynamically dampens oscillation while tracking reference trajectory *)
aMpcGainK[1, 1] := 2.85 * rCableLengthClamp; (* Longitudinal position gain *)
aMpcGainK[1, 2] := 1.95 * SQRT(rCableLengthClamp); (* Longitudinal velocity damping gain *)
aMpcGainK[1, 3] := 0.00;
aMpcGainK[1, 4] := 0.00;

aMpcGainK[2, 1] := 0.00;
aMpcGainK[2, 2] := 0.00;
aMpcGainK[2, 3] := 2.85 * rCableLengthClamp; (* Transverse position gain *)
aMpcGainK[2, 4] := 1.95 * SQRT(rCableLengthClamp); (* Transverse velocity damping gain *)

IF bAntiSwayEnable THEN
    (* Optimal correction accelerations *)
    rAntiSwayCorrectiveAccelX := -(aMpcGainK[1, 1] * aStateEstimatedX[1] + aMpcGainK[1, 2] * aStateEstimatedX[2]);
    rAntiSwayCorrectiveAccelY := -(aMpcGainK[2, 3] * aStateEstimatedX[3] + aMpcGainK[2, 4] * aStateEstimatedX[4]);

    (* Acceleration Authority Limiters *)
    IF rAntiSwayCorrectiveAccelX > 0.85 THEN rAntiSwayCorrectiveAccelX := 0.85; END_IF;
    IF rAntiSwayCorrectiveAccelX < -0.85 THEN rAntiSwayCorrectiveAccelX := -0.85; END_IF;
    IF rAntiSwayCorrectiveAccelY > 0.85 THEN rAntiSwayCorrectiveAccelY := 0.85; END_IF;
    IF rAntiSwayCorrectiveAccelY < -0.85 THEN rAntiSwayCorrectiveAccelY := -0.85; END_IF;
ELSE
    rAntiSwayCorrectiveAccelX := 0.0;
    rAntiSwayCorrectiveAccelY := 0.0;
END_IF;

(* ZVD 3-Impulse Shaper Parameter Synthesis *)
rZvdPeriod := (2.0 * CONST_PI) / rNaturalFreqOmegaN;
rZvdAmp1 := 0.250;
rZvdAmp2 := 0.500;
rZvdAmp3 := 0.250;
rZvdTime1 := 0.00;
rZvdTime2 := 0.50 * rZvdPeriod;
rZvdTime3 := 1.00 * rZvdPeriod;

(* Circular buffer convolution update for trajectory command shaping *)
iBufferHeadIndex := (iBufferHeadIndex + 1) MOD 128;
aJerkCommandHistoryX[iBufferHeadIndex] := rAntiSwayCorrectiveAccelX;
aJerkCommandHistoryY[iBufferHeadIndex] := rAntiSwayCorrectiveAccelY;

(* -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* SECTION 7: SPREADER SKEW DAMPING CONTROLLER (DIFFERENTIAL WINCH DRUM TRIM)                                           *)
(* -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* First-order low-pass filter on laser spreader skew measurement *)
rSkewAngleFilter := rSkewAngleFilter + (0.15 * (rLaserContainerSkew - rSkewAngleFilter));
rSkewDerivativeFilter := (rSkewAngleFilter - rPrevSkewAngle) / rCycleTimeSeconds;
rPrevSkewAngle := rSkewAngleFilter;

(* Differential winch speed setpoint to counteract container rotational yaw *)
rDifferentialHoistTrimRPM := (rSkewProportionalGain * rSkewAngleFilter) +
                             (rSkewDerivativeGain * rSkewDerivativeFilter);

(* Slew clamp differential winch trim *)
IF rDifferentialHoistTrimRPM > 120.0 THEN rDifferentialHoistTrimRPM := 120.0; END_IF;
IF rDifferentialHoistTrimRPM < -120.0 THEN rDifferentialHoistTrimRPM := -120.0; END_IF;

(* -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* SECTION 8: HYBRID DIESEL-ELECTRIC DC-LINK ENERGY DISPATCH & CHOPPER CONTROL                                         *)
(* -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* Compute aggregate mechanical traction power across all 8 wheel hub drives *)
rTotalTractionPowerDemandkW := 0.0;
FOR idx := 1 TO 8 DO
    rTotalTractionPowerDemandkW := rTotalTractionPowerDemandkW +
        ABS(aTargetWheelTorquesNm[idx] * (aWheelTractionFeedbackRPM[idx] * (2.0 * CONST_PI / 60.0)) / 1000.0);
END_FOR;

(* Compute mechanical hoist power demand (positive hoisting, negative lowering/regenerative) *)
rTotalHoistPowerDemandkW := (rTotalHoistTension * 1000.0 * rActualHoistVelocity) / 1000.0;

(* Total DC microgrid net electrical power demand *)
rTotalDCLinkPowerDemandkW := (rTotalTractionPowerDemandkW / 0.94) + (rTotalHoistPowerDemandkW / 0.91) + rTotalAuxiliaryPowerkW;

(* Battery & Diesel Genset Dispatch Logic *)
IF rTotalDCLinkPowerDemandkW > 0.0 THEN
    (* Positive load: Diesel generator runs at optimal BSFC, battery provides transient peak-shaving *)
    IF rTotalDCLinkPowerDemandkW > rGensetOptimumEfficiencykW THEN
        rDieselGensetPowerDemandkW := rGensetOptimumEfficiencykW;
        rBatteryPowerRequestkW := rTotalDCLinkPowerDemandkW - rGensetOptimumEfficiencykW;
    ELSE
        rDieselGensetPowerDemandkW := rTotalDCLinkPowerDemandkW;
        rBatteryPowerRequestkW := 0.0;
    END_IF;
    rDieselGensetTargetRPM := 1200.0 + (rDieselGensetPowerDemandkW / 450.0) * 800.0;
    rBrakeChopperDutyCycle := 0.0;
ELSE
    (* Negative load (heavy lowering & deceleration regenerative braking) *)
    rDieselGensetPowerDemandkW := 0.0;
    rDieselGensetTargetRPM := 850.0; (* Engine idle *)

    (* Charge battery if SOC < 88%, otherwise dump excess power into brake resistor *)
    IF rBatterySOC < 88.0 THEN
        rBatteryPowerRequestkW := rTotalDCLinkPowerDemandkW; (* Negative current to charge *)
    ELSE
        rBatteryPowerRequestkW := 0.0;
    END_IF;
END_IF;

(* Dynamic Resistor Brake Chopper Modulation *)
IF rDCLinkVoltage > rDCLinkChopperThresholdV THEN
    rBrakeChopperDutyCycle := ((rDCLinkVoltage - rDCLinkChopperThresholdV) /
                               (rDCLinkCeilingV - rDCLinkChopperThresholdV)) * 100.0;
    IF rBrakeChopperDutyCycle > 100.0 THEN rBrakeChopperDutyCycle := 100.0; END_IF;
ELSE
    rBrakeChopperDutyCycle := 0.0;
END_IF;

(* -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* SECTION 9: MASTER DETERMINISTIC FINITE STATE MACHINE (FSM)                                                           *)
(* -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* State dwell time accumulator *)
IF iMachineState = iPreviousMachineState THEN
    tStateDwellTime := tStateDwellTime + rCycleTimeSeconds;
ELSE
    tStateDwellTime := 0.0;
    iPreviousMachineState := iMachineState;
END_IF;

CASE iMachineState OF
    (* ==================== STATE 0: BOOT INITIALIZATION & RAM/ROM SELF-CHECK ==================== *)
    0: (* STATE_BOOT_INIT *)
        bSystemReady := FALSE;
        bDriveEnabled := FALSE;
        bBrakesReleased := FALSE;
        rDieselGensetPowerDemandkW := 0.0;
        rDieselGensetTargetRPM := 0.0;
        IF tStateDwellTime > 1.50 THEN
            iMachineState := STATE_SAFETY_INTERLOCK_WAIT;
        END_IF;

    (* ==================== STATE 10: SAFETY INTERLOCK VALIDATION ==================== *)
    10: (* STATE_SAFETY_INTERLOCK_WAIT *)
        bSystemReady := FALSE;
        bDriveEnabled := FALSE;
        bBrakesReleased := FALSE;
        IF bEStopActive_NC AND bSafetyGateClosed AND bAcknowledgeFaults THEN
            iMachineState := STATE_TMR_SENSOR_ALIGN;
        END_IF;

    (* ==================== STATE 20: 2oo3 TMR SENSOR VALIDATION & STEERING HOMING ==================== *)
    20: (* STATE_TMR_SENSOR_ALIGN *)
        bSystemReady := FALSE;
        bDriveEnabled := FALSE;
        bBrakesReleased := FALSE;
        (* Verify all 8 steer axes have established valid 2oo3 consensus *)
        IF NOT bCriticalFaultActive AND (tStateDwellTime > 2.00) THEN
            iMachineState := STATE_GENSET_PREHEAT_CRANK;
        END_IF;

    (* ==================== STATE 30: DIESEL GENSET PREHEAT & CRANK SEQUENCE ==================== *)
    30: (* STATE_GENSET_PREHEAT_CRANK *)
        bSystemReady := FALSE;
        bDriveEnabled := FALSE;
        bBrakesReleased := FALSE;
        rDieselGensetTargetRPM := 850.0; (* Crank & idle *)
        IF rGensetActualRPM > 750.0 AND (tStateDwellTime > 3.00) THEN
            iMachineState := STATE_DC_BUS_PRECHARGE;
        END_IF;

    (* ==================== STATE 40: DC BUS RESISTOR PRECHARGE & CONTACTOR LOCK ==================== *)
    40: (* STATE_DC_BUS_PRECHARGE *)
        bSystemReady := FALSE;
        bDriveEnabled := FALSE;
        bBrakesReleased := FALSE;
        rDieselGensetTargetRPM := 1200.0; (* Ramp to rated generator speed *)
        IF rDCLinkVoltage >= 650.0 THEN
            iMachineState := STATE_SYSTEM_READY_IDLE;
        ELSIF tStateDwellTime > 8.00 THEN
            dwFaultWord1 := dwFaultWord1 OR 16#00000080; (* Bit 7: DC Bus Precharge Timeout *)
            iMachineState := STATE_CONTROLLED_STOP_CAT1;
        END_IF;

    (* ==================== STATE 50: CARRIER SYSTEM READY & IDLE STANDBY ==================== *)
    50: (* STATE_SYSTEM_READY_IDLE *)
        bSystemReady := TRUE;
        bDriveEnabled := TRUE;
        bBrakesReleased := FALSE; (* Calipers held clamped in standby *)
        IF bEnableSystem THEN
            IF iSteeringModeCmd <> iActiveSteeringMode THEN
                iMachineState := STATE_STEER_MODE_ALIGNING;
            ELSIF ABS(rDesiredGantrySpeed) > 0.20 THEN
                iMachineState := STATE_GANTRY_TRACTION_ACTIVE;
            ELSIF ABS(rDesiredHoistVelocity) > 0.05 THEN
                iMachineState := STATE_HOIST_TRAJECTORY_EXEC;
            END_IF;
        END_IF;

    (* ==================== STATE 60: STEERING GEOMETRY IN-SITU ALIGNMENT ==================== *)
    60: (* STATE_STEER_MODE_ALIGNING *)
        bSystemReady := TRUE;
        bDriveEnabled := TRUE;
        bBrakesReleased := FALSE; (* Lock traction brakes while wheels pivot *)
        (* Allow 2.5 seconds for wheel steer servos to achieve new geometry *)
        IF tStateDwellTime > 2.50 THEN
            iMachineState := STATE_SYSTEM_READY_IDLE;
        END_IF;

    (* ==================== STATE 70: COORDINATED GANTRY TRAVEL ACTIVE ==================== *)
    70: (* STATE_GANTRY_TRACTION_ACTIVE *)
        bSystemReady := TRUE;
        bDriveEnabled := TRUE;
        bBrakesReleased := TRUE; (* Calipers open *)
        IF ABS(rDesiredHoistVelocity) > 0.05 THEN
            iMachineState := STATE_COMBINED_TRANSIT_SWAY;
        ELSIF ABS(rDesiredGantrySpeed) <= 0.10 AND (tStateDwellTime > 1.00) THEN
            iMachineState := STATE_HOLD_DECEL_PARKING;
        END_IF;

    (* ==================== STATE 80: HOIST WINCHING WITH ACTIVE ANTI-SWAY ==================== *)
    80: (* STATE_HOIST_TRAJECTORY_EXEC *)
        bSystemReady := TRUE;
        bDriveEnabled := TRUE;
        bBrakesReleased := FALSE; (* Gantry brakes locked during pure hoisting *)
        IF bFinePositioningActive AND (rActualHoistPosition < 1.20) THEN
            iMachineState := STATE_PRECISION_TOUCHDOWN;
        ELSIF ABS(rDesiredGantrySpeed) > 0.20 THEN
            iMachineState := STATE_COMBINED_TRANSIT_SWAY;
        ELSIF ABS(rDesiredHoistVelocity) <= 0.02 AND (tStateDwellTime > 1.20) THEN
            iMachineState := STATE_SYSTEM_READY_IDLE;
        END_IF;

    (* ==================== STATE 90: CONCURRENT GANTRY TRAVEL & HOISTING WITH ANTI-SWAY ==================== *)
    90: (* STATE_COMBINED_TRANSIT_SWAY *)
        bSystemReady := TRUE;
        bDriveEnabled := TRUE;
        bBrakesReleased := TRUE;
        IF ABS(rDesiredHoistVelocity) <= 0.02 THEN
            iMachineState := STATE_GANTRY_TRACTION_ACTIVE;
        ELSIF ABS(rDesiredGantrySpeed) <= 0.10 THEN
            iMachineState := STATE_HOIST_TRAJECTORY_EXEC;
        END_IF;

    (* ==================== STATE 100: PRECISION TOUCHDOWN & SOFT CONTAINER LANDING ==================== *)
    100: (* STATE_PRECISION_TOUCHDOWN *)
        bSystemReady := TRUE;
        bDriveEnabled := TRUE;
        bBrakesReleased := FALSE;
        IF bTouchdownDetected OR (tStateDwellTime > 8.00) THEN
            iMachineState := STATE_SYSTEM_READY_IDLE;
        END_IF;

    (* ==================== STATE 110: CONTROLLED DECELERATION & PARKING BRAKE HOLD ==================== *)
    110: (* STATE_HOLD_DECEL_PARKING *)
        bSystemReady := TRUE;
        bDriveEnabled := TRUE;
        bBrakesReleased := FALSE; (* Re-engage mechanical spring calipers *)
        IF tStateDwellTime > 1.50 THEN
            iMachineState := STATE_SYSTEM_READY_IDLE;
        END_IF;

    (* ==================== STATE 120: DEGRADED FAIL-OPERATIONAL MODE (1oo2 RESIDUAL) ==================== *)
    120: (* STATE_DEGRADED_FAIL_OP *)
        bSystemReady := TRUE;
        bDriveEnabled := TRUE;
        bBrakesReleased := TRUE;
        (* Maximum travel speed restricted to 10 km/h under degraded sensor redundancy *)
        IF rDesiredGantrySpeed > 10.0 THEN
            rTargetGantryLinearSpeedMS := 10.0 * CONST_KMH_TO_MS;
        END_IF;
        IF NOT bDegradedModeActive THEN
            iMachineState := STATE_SYSTEM_READY_IDLE;
        END_IF;

    (* ==================== STATE 200: CATEGORY 1 CONTROLLED ELECTRICAL STOP ==================== *)
    200: (* STATE_CONTROLLED_STOP_CAT1 *)
        bSystemReady := FALSE;
        bDriveEnabled := TRUE;
        bBrakesReleased := TRUE; (* Keep open while inverters electrically brake to 0 *)
        FOR idx := 1 TO 8 DO
            aTargetWheelSpeedsRPM[idx] := 0.0;
        END_FOR;
        rTargetHoistMotorSpeedRPM := 0.0;
        IF (rMeasuredGantryVelocity < 0.20) AND (tStateDwellTime > 2.00) THEN
            bBrakesReleased := FALSE; (* Clamp calipers *)
            bDriveEnabled := FALSE;  (* Drop inverter enable *)
            IF bAcknowledgeFaults THEN
                iMachineState := STATE_SAFETY_INTERLOCK_WAIT;
            END_IF;
        END_IF;

    (* ==================== STATE 999: CATEGORY 0 EMERGENCY SHUTDOWN ==================== *)
    999: (* STATE_EMERGENCY_SHUTDOWN_CAT0 *)
        bSystemReady := FALSE;
        bDriveEnabled := FALSE; (* De-energize inverters instantaneously *)
        bBrakesReleased := FALSE; (* De-energize hydraulic valves: spring calipers snap clamp *)
        rDieselGensetPowerDemandkW := 0.0;
        rDieselGensetTargetRPM := 0.0; (* Shut off fuel rack solenoid *)
        rBrakeChopperDutyCycle := 0.0;
        FOR idx := 1 TO 8 DO
            aTargetWheelSpeedsRPM[idx] := 0.0;
            aTargetWheelTorquesNm[idx] := 0.0;
        END_FOR;
        rTargetHoistMotorSpeedRPM := 0.0;
        IF bEStopActive_NC AND bSafetyGateClosed AND bAcknowledgeFaults THEN
            iMachineState := STATE_BOOT_INIT;
        END_IF;
END_CASE;

iCurrentState := iMachineState;

(* -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* SECTION 10: DISCRETE SYSTEM STATUS WORD BIT PACKING (32-BIT DWORD)                                                   *)
(* -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
dwSystemStatusWord := 16#00000000;
IF bSystemReady THEN dwSystemStatusWord := dwSystemStatusWord OR 16#00000001; END_IF;            (* Bit 0: Ready *)
IF bDriveEnabled THEN dwSystemStatusWord := dwSystemStatusWord OR 16#00000002; END_IF;           (* Bit 1: Drives Enabled *)
IF bBrakesReleased THEN dwSystemStatusWord := dwSystemStatusWord OR 16#00000004; END_IF;         (* Bit 2: Calipers Released *)
IF bDegradedModeActive THEN dwSystemStatusWord := dwSystemStatusWord OR 16#00000008; END_IF;     (* Bit 3: 1oo2 Degraded Mode *)
IF bAntiSwayEnable THEN dwSystemStatusWord := dwSystemStatusWord OR 16#00000010; END_IF;         (* Bit 4: Anti-Sway Enabled *)
IF bTouchdownDetected THEN dwSystemStatusWord := dwSystemStatusWord OR 16#00000020; END_IF;      (* Bit 5: Container Landed *)
IF bSlackRopeWarning THEN dwSystemStatusWord := dwSystemStatusWord OR 16#00000040; END_IF;       (* Bit 6: Slack Wire Alert *)
IF bSwaySensorValid THEN dwSystemStatusWord := dwSystemStatusWord OR 16#00000080; END_IF;        (* Bit 7: Laser Tracking OK *)
IF (iActiveSteeringMode = 0) THEN dwSystemStatusWord := dwSystemStatusWord OR 16#00000100; END_IF; (* Bit 8: Ackermann Active *)
IF (iActiveSteeringMode = 1) THEN dwSystemStatusWord := dwSystemStatusWord OR 16#00000200; END_IF; (* Bit 9: Crab Active *)
IF (iActiveSteeringMode = 2) THEN dwSystemStatusWord := dwSystemStatusWord OR 16#00000400; END_IF; (* Bit 10: Carousel Active *)
IF (rBrakeChopperDutyCycle > 5.0) THEN dwSystemStatusWord := dwSystemStatusWord OR 16#00000800; END_IF; (* Bit 11: Chopper Firing *)
IF (rBatterySOC > 80.0) THEN dwSystemStatusWord := dwSystemStatusWord OR 16#00001000; END_IF;   (* Bit 12: Battery SOC High *)
IF (rBatterySOC < 25.0) THEN dwSystemStatusWord := dwSystemStatusWord OR 16#00002000; END_IF;   (* Bit 13: Battery SOC Low *)

    rK_mpc_Heave_P              : REAL := 185000.0; (* Heave Stiffness Augmentation Gain [N/m] *)
    rK_mpc_Heave_D              : REAL := 28500.0;  (* Heave Skyhook Active Damping Gain [N*s/m] *)
    rK_mpc_Roll_P               : REAL := 420000.0; (* Roll Anti-Twist Torsion Stiffness [N*m/rad] *)
    rK_mpc_Roll_D               : REAL := 62000.0;  (* Roll Active Damping Gain [N*m*s/rad] *)
    rK_mpc_Pitch_P              : REAL := 850000.0; (* Pitch Leveling Stiffness [N*m/rad] *)
    rK_mpc_Pitch_D              : REAL := 125000.0; (* Pitch Rate Suppression Gain [N*m*s/rad] *)

    rK_mpc_Yaw_P                : REAL := 550000.0; (* Bogie-Carbody Hunting Yaw Control [N*m/rad] *)

(* =============================================================================================== *)
(* CONTROL IMPLEMENTATION AND SYSTEM EXECUTION LOGIC                                               *)
(* =============================================================================================== *)

(* --- SECTION 1: MASTER HARDWARE SAFETY LOOP & EMERGENCY STOP INTERLOCK --- *)
IF NOT bEmergencyStop THEN
    (* Fail-Safe De-energized Actuation: All servo-valves driven to 0.0 mA hydraulic center *)
    rI_Cmd_Height_FL_mA     := 0.0;
    rI_Cmd_Height_FR_mA     := 0.0;
    rI_Cmd_Height_RL_mA     := 0.0;
    rI_Cmd_Height_RR_mA     := 0.0;
    rI_Cmd_LatDamp_Front_mA := 0.0;
    rI_Cmd_LatDamp_Rear_mA  := 0.0;

    rDemandedForce_FL_kN    := 0.0;
    rDemandedForce_FR_kN    := 0.0;
    rDemandedForce_RL_kN    := 0.0;
    rDemandedForce_RR_kN    := 0.0;
    rDemandedForce_LatF_kN  := 0.0;
    rDemandedForce_LatR_kN  := 0.0;

    bSystemReady            := FALSE;
    bDegradedModeActive     := FALSE;
    bFailsafeLockoutActive  := TRUE;
    wAlarmCriticalWord.0    := TRUE;    (* Alarm Bit 0: Hardware Emergency Loop Open *)
    iActiveState            := 70;      (* Transition Immediately to Lockout State *)
    RETURN;
ELSE
    wAlarmCriticalWord.0    := FALSE;
END_IF;

(* --- SECTION 2: 2oo3 TRIPLE MODULAR REDUNDANCY (TMR) SENSOR VOTING ARCHITECTURE --- *)
(* 2.1 Lateral Accelerometer CG Voting *)
IF (ABS(rAcc_Lateral_ChA_ms2 - rAcc_Lateral_ChB_ms2) <= rTol_AccLateral_ms2) AND
   (ABS(rAcc_Lateral_ChA_ms2 - rAcc_Lateral_ChC_ms2) <= rTol_AccLateral_ms2) THEN
    (* Channels A, B, and C all conform within tolerance *)
    rVoted_AccLateral_ms2   := (rAcc_Lateral_ChA_ms2 + rAcc_Lateral_ChB_ms2 + rAcc_Lateral_ChC_ms2) / 3.0;
    bAccLat_ChA_Fault       := FALSE;
    bAccLat_ChB_Fault       := FALSE;
    bAccLat_ChC_Fault       := FALSE;
ELSIF (ABS(rAcc_Lateral_ChA_ms2 - rAcc_Lateral_ChB_ms2) <= rTol_AccLateral_ms2) THEN
    (* Channel C has diverged; degrade to 2oo2 median of A and B *)
    rVoted_AccLateral_ms2   := (rAcc_Lateral_ChA_ms2 + rAcc_Lateral_ChB_ms2) * 0.5;
    bAccLat_ChA_Fault       := FALSE;
    bAccLat_ChB_Fault       := FALSE;
    bAccLat_ChC_Fault       := TRUE;
ELSIF (ABS(rAcc_Lateral_ChA_ms2 - rAcc_Lateral_ChC_ms2) <= rTol_AccLateral_ms2) THEN
    (* Channel B has diverged; degrade to 2oo2 median of A and C *)
    rVoted_AccLateral_ms2   := (rAcc_Lateral_ChA_ms2 + rAcc_Lateral_ChC_ms2) * 0.5;
    bAccLat_ChA_Fault       := FALSE;
    bAccLat_ChB_Fault       := TRUE;
    bAccLat_ChC_Fault       := FALSE;
ELSIF (ABS(rAcc_Lateral_ChB_ms2 - rAcc_Lateral_ChC_ms2) <= rTol_AccLateral_ms2) THEN
    (* Channel A has diverged; degrade to 2oo2 median of B and C *)
    rVoted_AccLateral_ms2   := (rAcc_Lateral_ChB_ms2 + rAcc_Lateral_ChC_ms2) * 0.5;
    bAccLat_ChA_Fault       := TRUE;
    bAccLat_ChB_Fault       := FALSE;
    bAccLat_ChC_Fault       := FALSE;
ELSE
    (* Dual sensor divergence: unrecoverable loss of lateral inertial feedback *)
    rVoted_AccLateral_ms2   := rAcc_Lateral_ChA_ms2;
    bAccLat_ChA_Fault       := TRUE;
    bAccLat_ChB_Fault       := TRUE;
    bAccLat_ChC_Fault       := TRUE;
    wAlarmCriticalWord.1    := TRUE;    (* Alarm Bit 1: Lateral Accelerometer 2oo3 Loss *)
END_IF;

(* 2.2 Vertical Heave Accelerometer Voting *)
IF (ABS(rAcc_Vertical_ChA_ms2 - rAcc_Vertical_ChB_ms2) <= rTol_AccVertical_ms2) AND
   (ABS(rAcc_Vertical_ChA_ms2 - rAcc_Vertical_ChC_ms2) <= rTol_AccVertical_ms2) THEN
    rVoted_AccVertical_ms2  := (rAcc_Vertical_ChA_ms2 + rAcc_Vertical_ChB_ms2 + rAcc_Vertical_ChC_ms2) / 3.0;
    bAccVert_ChA_Fault      := FALSE;
    bAccVert_ChB_Fault      := FALSE;
    bAccVert_ChC_Fault      := FALSE;
ELSIF (ABS(rAcc_Vertical_ChA_ms2 - rAcc_Vertical_ChB_ms2) <= rTol_AccVertical_ms2) THEN
    rVoted_AccVertical_ms2  := (rAcc_Vertical_ChA_ms2 + rAcc_Vertical_ChB_ms2) * 0.5;
    bAccVert_ChA_Fault      := FALSE;
    bAccVert_ChB_Fault      := FALSE;
    bAccVert_ChC_Fault      := TRUE;
ELSIF (ABS(rAcc_Vertical_ChA_ms2 - rAcc_Vertical_ChC_ms2) <= rTol_AccVertical_ms2) THEN
    rVoted_AccVertical_ms2  := (rAcc_Vertical_ChA_ms2 + rAcc_Vertical_ChC_ms2) * 0.5;
    bAccVert_ChA_Fault      := FALSE;
    bAccVert_ChB_Fault      := TRUE;
    bAccVert_ChC_Fault      := FALSE;
ELSIF (ABS(rAcc_Vertical_ChB_ms2 - rAcc_Vertical_ChC_ms2) <= rTol_AccVertical_ms2) THEN
    rVoted_AccVertical_ms2  := (rAcc_Vertical_ChB_ms2 + rAcc_Vertical_ChC_ms2) * 0.5;
    bAccVert_ChA_Fault      := TRUE;
    bAccVert_ChB_Fault      := FALSE;
    bAccVert_ChC_Fault      := FALSE;
ELSE
    rVoted_AccVertical_ms2  := rAcc_Vertical_ChA_ms2;
    bAccVert_ChA_Fault      := TRUE;
    bAccVert_ChB_Fault      := TRUE;
    bAccVert_ChC_Fault      := TRUE;
    wAlarmCriticalWord.2    := TRUE;    (* Alarm Bit 2: Vertical Heave Accelerometer 2oo3 Loss *)
END_IF;

(* 2.3 Yaw Rate Gyro Voting *)
IF (ABS(rGyro_YawRate_ChA_rads - rGyro_YawRate_ChB_rads) <= rTol_YawRate_rads) AND
   (ABS(rGyro_YawRate_ChA_rads - rGyro_YawRate_ChC_rads) <= rTol_YawRate_rads) THEN
    rVoted_YawRate_rads     := (rGyro_YawRate_ChA_rads + rGyro_YawRate_ChB_rads + rGyro_YawRate_ChC_rads) / 3.0;
    bYaw_ChA_Fault          := FALSE;
    bYaw_ChB_Fault          := FALSE;
    bYaw_ChC_Fault          := FALSE;
ELSIF (ABS(rGyro_YawRate_ChA_rads - rGyro_YawRate_ChB_rads) <= rTol_YawRate_rads) THEN
    rVoted_YawRate_rads     := (rGyro_YawRate_ChA_rads + rGyro_YawRate_ChB_rads) * 0.5;
    bYaw_ChA_Fault          := FALSE;
    bYaw_ChB_Fault          := FALSE;
    bYaw_ChC_Fault          := TRUE;
ELSIF (ABS(rGyro_YawRate_ChA_rads - rGyro_YawRate_ChC_rads) <= rTol_YawRate_rads) THEN
    rVoted_YawRate_rads     := (rGyro_YawRate_ChA_rads + rGyro_YawRate_ChC_rads) * 0.5;
    bYaw_ChA_Fault          := FALSE;
    bYaw_ChB_Fault          := TRUE;
    bYaw_ChC_Fault          := FALSE;
ELSIF (ABS(rGyro_YawRate_ChB_rads - rGyro_YawRate_ChC_rads) <= rTol_YawRate_rads) THEN
    rVoted_YawRate_rads     := (rGyro_YawRate_ChB_rads + rGyro_YawRate_ChC_rads) * 0.5;
    bYaw_ChA_Fault          := TRUE;
    bYaw_ChB_Fault          := FALSE;
    bYaw_ChC_Fault          := FALSE;
ELSE
    rVoted_YawRate_rads     := rGyro_YawRate_ChA_rads;
    bYaw_ChA_Fault          := TRUE;
    bYaw_ChB_Fault          := TRUE;
    bYaw_ChC_Fault          := TRUE;
    wAlarmCriticalWord.3    := TRUE;    (* Alarm Bit 3: Yaw Rate Gyroscope 2oo3 Loss *)
END_IF;

(* 2.4 Hydraulic Rail Supply Pressure Voting *)
IF (ABS(rHydSupplyPress_ChA_bar - rHydSupplyPress_ChB_bar) <= rTol_SupplyPress_bar) AND
   (ABS(rHydSupplyPress_ChA_bar - rHydSupplyPress_ChC_bar) <= rTol_SupplyPress_bar) THEN
    rVoted_SupplyPress_bar  := (rHydSupplyPress_ChA_bar + rHydSupplyPress_ChB_bar + rHydSupplyPress_ChC_bar) / 3.0;
    bPress_ChA_Fault        := FALSE;
    bPress_ChB_Fault        := FALSE;
    bPress_ChC_Fault        := FALSE;
ELSIF (ABS(rHydSupplyPress_ChA_bar - rHydSupplyPress_ChB_bar) <= rTol_SupplyPress_bar) THEN
    rVoted_SupplyPress_bar  := (rHydSupplyPress_ChA_bar + rHydSupplyPress_ChB_bar) * 0.5;
    bPress_ChA_Fault        := FALSE;
    bPress_ChB_Fault        := FALSE;
    bPress_ChC_Fault        := TRUE;
ELSIF (ABS(rHydSupplyPress_ChA_bar - rHydSupplyPress_ChC_bar) <= rTol_SupplyPress_bar) THEN
    rVoted_SupplyPress_bar  := (rHydSupplyPress_ChA_bar + rHydSupplyPress_ChC_bar) * 0.5;
    bPress_ChA_Fault        := FALSE;
    bPress_ChB_Fault        := TRUE;
    bPress_ChC_Fault        := FALSE;
ELSIF (ABS(rHydSupplyPress_ChB_bar - rHydSupplyPress_ChC_bar) <= rTol_SupplyPress_bar) THEN
    rVoted_SupplyPress_bar  := (rHydSupplyPress_ChB_bar + rHydSupplyPress_ChC_bar) * 0.5;
    bPress_ChA_Fault        := TRUE;
    bPress_ChB_Fault        := FALSE;
    bPress_ChC_Fault        := FALSE;
ELSE
    rVoted_SupplyPress_bar  := rHydSupplyPress_ChA_bar;
    bPress_ChA_Fault        := TRUE;
    bPress_ChB_Fault        := TRUE;
    bPress_ChC_Fault        := TRUE;
    wAlarmCriticalWord.4    := TRUE;    (* Alarm Bit 4: Main Hydraulic Pressure 2oo3 Loss *)
END_IF;

(* Assemble Sensor Health Bitfield Word *)
wSensorHealthWord.0  := NOT bAccLat_ChA_Fault;
wSensorHealthWord.1  := NOT bAccLat_ChB_Fault;
wSensorHealthWord.2  := NOT bAccLat_ChC_Fault;
wSensorHealthWord.3  := NOT bAccVert_ChA_Fault;
wSensorHealthWord.4  := NOT bAccVert_ChB_Fault;
wSensorHealthWord.5  := NOT bAccVert_ChC_Fault;
wSensorHealthWord.6  := NOT bYaw_ChA_Fault;
wSensorHealthWord.7  := NOT bYaw_ChB_Fault;
wSensorHealthWord.8  := NOT bYaw_ChC_Fault;
wSensorHealthWord.9  := NOT bPress_ChA_Fault;
wSensorHealthWord.10 := NOT bPress_ChB_Fault;
wSensorHealthWord.11 := NOT bPress_ChC_Fault;

bSensorTmrHealthy := NOT (wAlarmCriticalWord.1 OR wAlarmCriticalWord.2 OR wAlarmCriticalWord.3 OR wAlarmCriticalWord.4);

(* --- SECTION 3: 4-CORNER KINEMATIC DECOUPLING & WARP (ANTI-TWIST) CALCULATION --- *)
(* 3.1 Mean Carbody Height [mm] *)
rCarbodyMeanHeight_mm := (rLVDT_Height_FL_mm + rLVDT_Height_FR_mm +
                          rLVDT_Height_RL_mm + rLVDT_Height_RR_mm) * 0.25;

(* 3.2 Roll Angle Decoupling [mrad]: Positive Left Raised, Right Dropped *)
rCarbodyRoll_mrad := (((rLVDT_Height_FL_mm + rLVDT_Height_RL_mm) -
                       (rLVDT_Height_FR_mm + rLVDT_Height_RR_mm)) * 0.5) / (rConst_LateralHalfWidth_m * 2.0);

(* 3.3 Pitch Angle Decoupling [mrad]: Positive Rear Raised, Front Dropped *)
rCarbodyPitch_mrad := (((rLVDT_Height_RL_mm + rLVDT_Height_RR_mm) -
                        (rLVDT_Height_FL_mm + rLVDT_Height_FR_mm)) * 0.5) / (rConst_BogieHalfBase_m * 2.0);

(* 3.4 Diagonal Suspension Warp (Torsion) Metric [mm] *)
rCarbodyWarp_mm := (rLVDT_Height_FL_mm - rLVDT_Height_FR_mm) - (rLVDT_Height_RL_mm - rLVDT_Height_RR_mm);

(* 3.5 Decoupled Lateral Bogie Displacement & Yaw [mm, mrad] *)
rCarbodyLateral_mm := (rLVDT_Lateral_Front_mm + rLVDT_Lateral_Rear_mm) * 0.5;
rCarbodyYaw_mrad   := (rLVDT_Lateral_Front_mm - rLVDT_Lateral_Rear_mm) / (rConst_BogieHalfBase_m * 2.0);

(* Warp Excursion Safety Check: Prevents unequal bogie load transfer *)
tonWarpExcursionTrip(IN := (ABS(rCarbodyWarp_mm) > 12.0), PT := T#250MS);
bWarpExcursionCritical := tonWarpExcursionTrip.Q;
wAlarmCriticalWord.5   := bWarpExcursionCritical; (* Alarm Bit 5: Suspension Diagonal Warp Limit Exceeded *)

(* --- SECTION 4: 1.25 HZ CARBODY HUNTING SWAY NOTCH FILTER PROCESSING --- *)
(* Direct Form II Transposed IIR Notch Filter for Front Bogie Lateral Accel *)
rFiltered_AccLat_Front := (rNotch_b0 * rVoted_AccLateral_ms2) + rNotch_x1_LatF;
rNotch_x1_LatF         := (rNotch_b1 * rVoted_AccLateral_ms2) - (rNotch_a1 * rFiltered_AccLat_Front) + rNotch_x2_LatF;
rNotch_x2_LatF         := (rNotch_b2 * rVoted_AccLateral_ms2) - (rNotch_a2 * rFiltered_AccLat_Front);

(* Filter for Rear Bogie Lateral Accel Derived from Yaw Rate Derivative *)
rFiltered_AccLat_Rear := (rNotch_b0 * (rVoted_AccLateral_ms2 - (rVoted_YawRate_rads * rConst_BogieHalfBase_m))) + rNotch_x1_LatR;
rNotch_x1_LatR        := (rNotch_b1 * (rVoted_AccLateral_ms2 - (rVoted_YawRate_rads * rConst_BogieHalfBase_m))) - (rNotch_a1 * rFiltered_AccLat_Rear) + rNotch_x2_LatR;
rNotch_x2_LatR        := (rNotch_b2 * (rVoted_AccLateral_ms2 - (rVoted_YawRate_rads * rConst_BogieHalfBase_m))) - (rNotch_a2 * rFiltered_AccLat_Rear);

(* Track Cant Low-Pass Filter *)
IF bTrackDataValid THEN
    rFiltered_TrackCant_rad := (rLPF_Cant_b0 * (rTrackCantAngle_deg * 0.01745329)) + rLPF_Cant_x1;
    rLPF_Cant_x1            := (rLPF_Cant_b1 * (rTrackCantAngle_deg * 0.01745329)) - (rLPF_Cant_a1 * rFiltered_TrackCant_rad) + rLPF_Cant_x2;
    rLPF_Cant_x2            := (rLPF_Cant_b2 * (rTrackCantAngle_deg * 0.01745329)) - (rLPF_Cant_a2 * rFiltered_TrackCant_rad);
ELSE
    rFiltered_TrackCant_rad := 0.0;
END_IF;

(* --- SECTION 5: 10-STATE KALMAN FILTER OBSERVER UPDATE STEP --- *)
(* 5.1 Prediction Step: Prior Estimation Using System Matrix and Control Inputs *)
x_prd_zHeave_m        := (rAd_Heave_Damping * x_est_zHeave_m) + (rConst_SampleTime_s * x_est_vHeave_ms);
x_prd_vHeave_ms       := (rAd_Heave_Damping * x_est_vHeave_ms) + (rConst_SampleTime_s * (rU_Gen_Heave_kN * 1000.0 / rConst_MassCarbody_kg));
x_prd_phiRoll_rad      := (rAd_Roll_Damping * x_est_phiRoll_rad) + (rConst_SampleTime_s * x_est_omegaRoll_rads);
x_prd_omegaRoll_rads   := (rAd_Roll_Damping * x_est_omegaRoll_rads) + (rConst_SampleTime_s * (rU_Gen_Roll_kNm * 1000.0 / rConst_InertiaRoll_kgm2));
x_prd_thetaPitch_rad   := (rAd_Pitch_Damping * x_est_thetaPitch_rad) + (rConst_SampleTime_s * x_est_omegaPitch_rads);
x_prd_omegaPitch_rads  := (rAd_Pitch_Damping * x_est_omegaPitch_rads) + (rConst_SampleTime_s * (rU_Gen_Pitch_kNm * 1000.0 / rConst_InertiaPitch_kgm2));
x_prd_yLateral_m       := (rAd_Lateral_Damping * x_est_yLateral_m) + (rConst_SampleTime_s * x_est_vLateral_ms);
x_prd_vLateral_ms      := (rAd_Lateral_Damping * x_est_vLateral_ms) + (rConst_SampleTime_s * (rU_Gen_Lateral_kN * 1000.0 / rConst_MassCarbody_kg));
x_prd_psiYaw_rad       := (rAd_Yaw_Damping * x_est_psiYaw_rad) + (rConst_SampleTime_s * x_est_omegaYaw_rads);
x_prd_omegaYaw_rads    := (rAd_Yaw_Damping * x_est_omegaYaw_rads) + (rConst_SampleTime_s * (rU_Gen_Yaw_kNm * 1000.0 / rConst_InertiaYaw_kgm2));

(* 5.2 Measurement Innovation & Correction *)
x_est_zHeave_m        := x_prd_zHeave_m + (rL_Heave_Pos * ((rCarbodyMeanHeight_mm - rConst_NominalHeight_mm) * 0.001 - x_prd_zHeave_m));
x_est_vHeave_ms       := x_prd_vHeave_ms + (rL_Heave_Vel * (rVoted_AccVertical_ms2 * rConst_SampleTime_s - x_prd_vHeave_ms));
x_est_phiRoll_rad      := x_prd_phiRoll_rad + (rL_Roll_Angle * (rCarbodyRoll_mrad * 0.001 - x_prd_phiRoll_rad));
x_est_omegaRoll_rads   := x_prd_omegaRoll_rads + (rL_Roll_Vel * ((rCarbodyRoll_mrad * 0.001 - x_prd_phiRoll_rad) / rConst_SampleTime_s - x_prd_omegaRoll_rads));
x_est_thetaPitch_rad   := x_prd_thetaPitch_rad + (rL_Pitch_Angle * (rCarbodyPitch_mrad * 0.001 - x_prd_thetaPitch_rad));
x_est_omegaPitch_rads  := x_prd_omegaPitch_rads + (rL_Pitch_Vel * ((rCarbodyPitch_mrad * 0.001 - x_prd_thetaPitch_rad) / rConst_SampleTime_s - x_prd_omegaPitch_rads));
x_est_yLateral_m       := x_prd_yLateral_m + (rL_Lateral_Pos * (rCarbodyLateral_mm * 0.001 - x_prd_yLateral_m));
x_est_vLateral_ms      := x_prd_vLateral_ms + (rL_Lateral_Vel * (rFiltered_AccLat_Front * rConst_SampleTime_s - x_prd_vLateral_ms));
x_est_psiYaw_rad       := x_prd_psiYaw_rad + (rL_Yaw_Angle * (rCarbodyYaw_mrad * 0.001 - x_prd_psiYaw_rad));
x_est_omegaYaw_rads    := x_prd_omegaYaw_rads + (rL_Yaw_Vel * (rVoted_YawRate_rads - x_prd_omegaYaw_rads));

(* --- SECTION 6: HIGH-SPEED CURVE TILTING & CENTRIFUGAL COMPENSATION --- *)
IF bTrackDataValid AND (ABS(rTrackCurvature_inv_m) > 0.00001) AND (rTrainSpeed_kmh > 40.0) THEN
    (* Train Velocity in m/s: v = Speed_kmh / 3.6 *)
    (* Centrifugal Lateral Acceleration: a_c = v^2 * Curvature *)
    rComp_CentrifugalForce_kN := (rConst_MassCarbody_kg * EXPT(rTrainSpeed_kmh / 3.6, 2.0) * rTrackCurvature_inv_m) * 0.001;
    (* Equilibrium Tilt Angle to cancel lateral passenger feeling: theta = a_c / g - cant *)
    rComp_SuperelevationTilt_rad := (EXPT(rTrainSpeed_kmh / 3.6, 2.0) * rTrackCurvature_inv_m / rConst_Gravity_ms2) - rFiltered_TrackCant_rad;
    (* Clamp Maximum Tilting to +/- 85 mrad (+/- 4.87 deg) *)
    IF rComp_SuperelevationTilt_rad > 0.085 THEN
        rComp_SuperelevationTilt_rad := 0.085;
    ELSIF rComp_SuperelevationTilt_rad < -0.085 THEN
        rComp_SuperelevationTilt_rad := -0.085;
    END_IF;
    rRef_Roll_rad := rComp_SuperelevationTilt_rad;
ELSE
    rComp_CentrifugalForce_kN    := 0.0;
    rComp_SuperelevationTilt_rad := 0.0;
    rRef_Roll_rad                := 0.0;
END_IF;

(* Dynamic Gain Scheduling with Train Speed *)
IF rTrainSpeed_kmh > 10.0 THEN
    rSpeedRatio := rTrainSpeed_kmh / 600.0;
    IF rSpeedRatio > 1.0 THEN
        rSpeedRatio := 1.0;
    END_IF;
    rDampingGainScale := 1.0 + (0.85 * rSpeedRatio); (* Increase damping stiffness by up to 85% at 600 km/h *)
ELSE
    rDampingGainScale := 1.0;
END_IF;

(* Set Target Heave Reference with TCMS Height Bias *)
rRef_Heave_m := rTargetHeightBias_mm * 0.001;

(* Anti-Twist (Warp) Correction Force *)
rComp_WarpRestoration_kN := (rCarbodyWarp_mm * 0.001) * 350.0; (* 350 kN/m anti-twist stiffness *)

(* --- SECTION 7: MODEL PREDICTIVE CONTROL (MPC) GENERALIZED FORCE SYNTHESIS --- *)
(* Heave Modal Force Synthesis *)
rU_Gen_Heave_kN := -((rK_mpc_Heave_P * (x_est_zHeave_m - rRef_Heave_m)) +
                     (rK_mpc_Heave_D * rDampingGainScale * x_est_vHeave_ms)) * 0.001;

(* Roll Modal Moment Synthesis with Tilt Feedforward *)
rU_Gen_Roll_kNm := -((rK_mpc_Roll_P * (x_est_phiRoll_rad - rRef_Roll_rad)) +
                     (rK_mpc_Roll_D * rDampingGainScale * x_est_omegaRoll_rads)) * 0.001;

(* Pitch Modal Moment Synthesis *)
rU_Gen_Pitch_kNm := -((rK_mpc_Pitch_P * (x_est_thetaPitch_rad - rRef_Pitch_rad)) +
                      (rK_mpc_Pitch_D * rDampingGainScale * x_est_omegaPitch_rads)) * 0.001;

(* Lateral Sway Modal Force Synthesis with Centrifugal Feedforward *)
rU_Gen_Lateral_kN := -((rK_mpc_Lat_P * (x_est_yLateral_m - rRef_Lateral_m)) +
                       (rK_mpc_Lat_D * rDampingGainScale * x_est_vLateral_ms)) * 0.001 + rComp_CentrifugalForce_kN;

(* Yaw Damping Modal Moment Synthesis *)
rU_Gen_Yaw_kNm := -((rK_mpc_Yaw_P * (x_est_psiYaw_rad - rRef_Yaw_rad)) +
                    (rK_mpc_Yaw_D * rDampingGainScale * x_est_omegaYaw_rads)) * 0.001;

(* --- SECTION 8: 4-CORNER VERTICAL ACTUATOR & 2-LATERAL ACTUATOR FORCE ALLOCATION --- *)
(* Normal Leveling Cylinder Forces [kN] *)
rDemandedForce_FL_kN := (rU_Gen_Heave_kN * 0.25) +
                        (rU_Gen_Roll_kNm / (4.0 * rConst_LateralHalfWidth_m)) -
                        (rU_Gen_Pitch_kNm / (4.0 * rConst_BogieHalfBase_m)) +
                        (rComp_WarpRestoration_kN * 0.25);

rDemandedForce_FR_kN := (rU_Gen_Heave_kN * 0.25) -
                        (rU_Gen_Roll_kNm / (4.0 * rConst_LateralHalfWidth_m)) -
                        (rU_Gen_Pitch_kNm / (4.0 * rConst_BogieHalfBase_m)) -
                        (rComp_WarpRestoration_kN * 0.25);

rDemandedForce_RL_kN := (rU_Gen_Heave_kN * 0.25) +
                        (rU_Gen_Roll_kNm / (4.0 * rConst_LateralHalfWidth_m)) +
                        (rU_Gen_Pitch_kNm / (4.0 * rConst_BogieHalfBase_m)) -
                        (rComp_WarpRestoration_kN * 0.25);

rDemandedForce_RR_kN := (rU_Gen_Heave_kN * 0.25) -
                        (rU_Gen_Roll_kNm / (4.0 * rConst_LateralHalfWidth_m)) +
                        (rU_Gen_Pitch_kNm / (4.0 * rConst_BogieHalfBase_m)) +
                        (rComp_WarpRestoration_kN * 0.25);

(* Front and Rear Lateral Actuator Damping Demands [kN] *)
rDemandedForce_LatF_kN := (rU_Gen_Lateral_kN * 0.5) + (rU_Gen_Yaw_kNm / (2.0 * rConst_BogieHalfBase_m));
rDemandedForce_LatR_kN := (rU_Gen_Lateral_kN * 0.5) - (rU_Gen_Yaw_kNm / (2.0 * rConst_BogieHalfBase_m));

(* Force Clamping: Ensure Cylinder Forces Remain Within Structural Limits [-65 kN, +65 kN] *)
IF rDemandedForce_FL_kN > 65.0 THEN
    rDemandedForce_FL_kN := 65.0;
ELSIF rDemandedForce_FL_kN < -65.0 THEN
    rDemandedForce_FL_kN := -65.0;
END_IF;

IF rDemandedForce_FR_kN > 65.0 THEN
    rDemandedForce_FR_kN := 65.0;
ELSIF rDemandedForce_FR_kN < -65.0 THEN
    rDemandedForce_FR_kN := -65.0;
END_IF;

IF rDemandedForce_RL_kN > 65.0 THEN
    rDemandedForce_RL_kN := 65.0;
ELSIF rDemandedForce_RL_kN < -65.0 THEN
    rDemandedForce_RL_kN := -65.0;
END_IF;

IF rDemandedForce_RR_kN > 65.0 THEN
    rDemandedForce_RR_kN := 65.0;
ELSIF rDemandedForce_RR_kN < -65.0 THEN
    rDemandedForce_RR_kN := -65.0;
END_IF;

IF rDemandedForce_LatF_kN > 45.0 THEN
    rDemandedForce_LatF_kN := 45.0;
ELSIF rDemandedForce_LatF_kN < -45.0 THEN
    rDemandedForce_LatF_kN := -45.0;
END_IF;

IF rDemandedForce_LatR_kN > 45.0 THEN
    rDemandedForce_LatR_kN := 45.0;
ELSIF rDemandedForce_LatR_kN < -45.0 THEN
    rDemandedForce_LatR_kN := -45.0;
END_IF;

(* --- SECTION 9: NONLINEAR ELECTRO-HYDRAULIC VALVE CURRENT SYNTHESIS --- *)
(* Orifice Area & Differential Pressure Inverse Model: I = F / (Area * dP) * K_valve *)
IF rVoted_SupplyPress_bar > rConst_HydSupplyMin_bar THEN
    (* Vertical Cylinders Current Output [-40.0 mA to +40.0 mA] *)
    rI_Cmd_Height_FL_mA := (rDemandedForce_FL_kN * 1000.0) / (rConst_CylinderAreaVert_m2 * (rVoted_SupplyPress_bar - rHydReturnPress_bar) * 100000.0) * 40.0;
    rI_Cmd_Height_FR_mA := (rDemandedForce_FR_kN * 1000.0) / (rConst_CylinderAreaVert_m2 * (rVoted_SupplyPress_bar - rHydReturnPress_bar) * 100000.0) * 40.0;
    rI_Cmd_Height_RL_mA := (rDemandedForce_RL_kN * 1000.0) / (rConst_CylinderAreaVert_m2 * (rVoted_SupplyPress_bar - rHydReturnPress_bar) * 100000.0) * 40.0;
    rI_Cmd_Height_RR_mA := (rDemandedForce_RR_kN * 1000.0) / (rConst_CylinderAreaVert_m2 * (rVoted_SupplyPress_bar - rHydReturnPress_bar) * 100000.0) * 40.0;

    (* Lateral Damping Cylinders Current Output [-40.0 mA to +40.0 mA] *)
    rI_Cmd_LatDamp_Front_mA := (rDemandedForce_LatF_kN * 1000.0) / (rConst_CylinderAreaLat_m2 * (rVoted_SupplyPress_bar - rHydReturnPress_bar) * 100000.0) * 40.0;
    rI_Cmd_LatDamp_Rear_mA  := (rDemandedForce_LatR_kN * 1000.0) / (rConst_CylinderAreaLat_m2 * (rVoted_SupplyPress_bar - rHydReturnPress_bar) * 100000.0) * 40.0;
ELSE
    rI_Cmd_Height_FL_mA     := 0.0;
    rI_Cmd_Height_FR_mA     := 0.0;
    rI_Cmd_Height_RL_mA     := 0.0;
    rI_Cmd_Height_RR_mA     := 0.0;
    rI_Cmd_LatDamp_Front_mA := 0.0;
    rI_Cmd_LatDamp_Rear_mA  := 0.0;
END_IF;

(* Clamp Drive Currents to Hardware Coil Saturation Limits [-40.0 mA, +40.0 mA] *)
IF rI_Cmd_Height_FL_mA > 40.0 THEN
    rI_Cmd_Height_FL_mA := 40.0;
ELSIF rI_Cmd_Height_FL_mA < -40.0 THEN
    rI_Cmd_Height_FL_mA := -40.0;
END_IF;

IF rI_Cmd_Height_FR_mA > 40.0 THEN
    rI_Cmd_Height_FR_mA := 40.0;
ELSIF rI_Cmd_Height_FR_mA < -40.0 THEN
    rI_Cmd_Height_FR_mA := -40.0;
END_IF;

IF rI_Cmd_Height_RL_mA > 40.0 THEN
    rI_Cmd_Height_RL_mA := 40.0;
ELSIF rI_Cmd_Height_RL_mA < -40.0 THEN
    rI_Cmd_Height_RL_mA := -40.0;
END_IF;

IF rI_Cmd_Height_RR_mA > 40.0 THEN
    rI_Cmd_Height_RR_mA := 40.0;
ELSIF rI_Cmd_Height_RR_mA < -40.0 THEN
    rI_Cmd_Height_RR_mA := -40.0;
END_IF;

IF rI_Cmd_LatDamp_Front_mA > 40.0 THEN
    rI_Cmd_LatDamp_Front_mA := 40.0;
ELSIF rI_Cmd_LatDamp_Front_mA < -40.0 THEN
    rI_Cmd_LatDamp_Front_mA := -40.0;
END_IF;

IF rI_Cmd_LatDamp_Rear_mA > 40.0 THEN
    rI_Cmd_LatDamp_Rear_mA := 40.0;
ELSIF rI_Cmd_LatDamp_Rear_mA < -40.0 THEN
    rI_Cmd_LatDamp_Rear_mA := -40.0;
END_IF;

(* --- SECTION 10: CONTINUOUS SPERLING RIDE COMFORT EVALUATION (ISO 2631 / DIN EN 12299) --- *)
rAcc_SumSquares := rAcc_SumSquares + EXPT(rVoted_AccLateral_ms2, 2.0) + EXPT(rVoted_AccVertical_ms2, 2.0);
iSampleIndex_Comfort := iSampleIndex_Comfort + 1;
IF iSampleIndex_Comfort >= 500 THEN (* 500 scans * 0.002s = 1.0 second evaluation window *)
    rRmsAcceleration := SQRT(rAcc_SumSquares / 1000.0);
    IF rRmsAcceleration > 0.001 THEN
        rComfortIndex_Sperling := 4.42 * EXPT(rRmsAcceleration, 0.3);
    ELSE
        rComfortIndex_Sperling := 1.0;
    END_IF;
    rAcc_SumSquares      := 0.0;
    iSampleIndex_Comfort := 0;
END_IF;

(* --- SECTION 11: MULTI-STAGE SYSTEM SEQUENCER & GRACEFUL DEGRADATION FINITE STATE MACHINE --- *)
tonPowerUpDelay(IN := (iActiveState = 0), PT := T#1000MS);
tonHydraulicPressDelay(IN := (rVoted_SupplyPress_bar >= rConst_HydSupplyNom_bar * 0.90), PT := T#1500MS);
tonLevelingHomingTimeout(IN := (iActiveState = 30), PT := T#10S);

CASE iActiveState OF
    0: (* STATE 0: INITIALIZATION & BOOT INTEGRITY CHECK *)
        bSystemReady           := FALSE;
        bDegradedModeActive    := FALSE;
        bFailsafeLockoutActive := FALSE;
        rI_Cmd_Height_FL_mA    := 0.0;
        rI_Cmd_Height_FR_mA    := 0.0;
        rI_Cmd_Height_RL_mA    := 0.0;
        rI_Cmd_Height_RR_mA    := 0.0;
        rI_Cmd_LatDamp_Front_mA:= 0.0;
        rI_Cmd_LatDamp_Rear_mA := 0.0;

        IF tonPowerUpDelay.Q AND bMasterEnable THEN
            iActiveState := 10; (* Proceed to 2oo3 Sensor Pre-check *)
        END_IF;

    10: (* STATE 10: 2oo3 SENSOR SUITE VERIFICATION & CALIBRATION *)
        IF bSensorTmrHealthy THEN
            iActiveState := 20; (* Proceed to Hydraulic Pressurization Check *)
        ELSE
            wAlarmCriticalWord.6 := TRUE; (* Alarm Bit 6: Sensor Suite Calibration Failed *)
            iActiveState := 70;         (* Go to Lockout *)
        END_IF;

    20: (* STATE 20: HYDRAULIC LINE PRESSURE STABILIZATION *)
        IF tonHydraulicPressDelay.Q THEN
            bHydraulicPressureNominal := TRUE;
            iActiveState := 30;         (* Proceed to Static Height Homing *)
        ELSIF rVoted_SupplyPress_bar < rConst_HydSupplyMin_bar THEN
            wAlarmCriticalWord.7 := TRUE; (* Alarm Bit 7: Hydraulic Line Pressure Underrange *)
            iActiveState := 70;         (* Abort to Lockout *)
        END_IF;

    30: (* STATE 30: STATIC 4-CORNER HEIGHT LEVELING & ANTI-TWIST HOMING *)
        (* Check if carbody height is within +/- 2.0 mm of nominal and warp is < 3.0 mm *)
        IF (ABS(rCarbodyMeanHeight_mm - (rConst_NominalHeight_mm + rTargetHeightBias_mm)) < 2.0) AND
           (ABS(rCarbodyWarp_mm) < 3.0) AND
           (ABS(rCarbodyRoll_mrad) < 2.0) AND
           (ABS(rCarbodyPitch_mrad) < 2.0) THEN
            bHomingCompleted := TRUE;
            iActiveState     := 40;     (* Enter Fully Active Synchronous Cruising *)
        ELSIF tonLevelingHomingTimeout.Q THEN
            wAlarmDegradedWord.0 := TRUE; (* Warning Bit 0: Homing Time Extended, Forcing Active *)
            iActiveState         := 40;
        END_IF;

    40: (* STATE 40: FULL ACTIVE HIGH-SPEED SYNCHRONOUS CRUISE & SWAY DAMPING *)
        bSystemReady           := TRUE;
        bDegradedModeActive    := FALSE;
        bFailsafeLockoutActive := FALSE;

        (* Dynamic Condition Check: Curve Tilting Detection *)
        IF bTrackDataValid AND (ABS(rTrackCurvature_inv_m) > 0.00015) AND (rTrainSpeed_kmh > 80.0) THEN
            iActiveState := 50; (* Transition to Active Curve Tilting Mode *)
        END_IF;

        (* Degraded Mode Supervision *)
        IF (bAccLat_ChA_Fault OR bAccLat_ChB_Fault OR bAccLat_ChC_Fault OR
            bYaw_ChA_Fault OR bYaw_ChB_Fault OR bYaw_ChC_Fault) THEN
            wAlarmDegradedWord.1 := TRUE; (* Warning Bit 1: Single Sensor Degraded, Downgrading to Skyhook *)
            iActiveState := 60;          (* Fallback to Degraded Semi-Active Skyhook Mode *)
        END_IF;

        (* Critical System Abort Check *)
        IF (wAlarmCriticalWord <> 16#0000) OR NOT bMasterEnable OR (rVoted_SupplyPress_bar < rConst_HydSupplyMin_bar) THEN
            iActiveState := 70; (* Critical Fault: Lockout *)
        END_IF;

    50: (* STATE 50: HIGH-SPEED CURVE TILTING & TRACK CANT SYNCHRONIZATION *)
        bSystemReady           := TRUE;
        bDegradedModeActive    := FALSE;
        bFailsafeLockoutActive := FALSE;

        (* Revert to Cruising when track curvature straightens *)
        IF (ABS(rTrackCurvature_inv_m) <= 0.00005) OR (rTrainSpeed_kmh <= 60.0) THEN
            iActiveState := 40; (* Revert to Standard Cruise Mode *)
        END_IF;

        (* Critical System Abort Check *)
        IF (wAlarmCriticalWord <> 16#0000) OR NOT bMasterEnable THEN
            iActiveState := 70;
        END_IF;

    60: (* STATE 60: GRACEFUL DEGRADATION: SEMI-ACTIVE SKYHOOK DAMPING FALLBACK *)
        (* Reduced gain operation with secondary air-spring passive ride height *)
        bSystemReady           := TRUE;
        bDegradedModeActive    := TRUE;
        bFailsafeLockoutActive := FALSE;

        (* Attenuate Valve Currents by 50% to prevent instability during degraded sensing *)
        rI_Cmd_Height_FL_mA     := rI_Cmd_Height_FL_mA * 0.5;
        rI_Cmd_Height_FR_mA     := rI_Cmd_Height_FR_mA * 0.5;
        rI_Cmd_Height_RL_mA     := rI_Cmd_Height_RL_mA * 0.5;

END_IF;

(* -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
