   ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)

(* 2.1 Tube Static Pressure 2oo3 TMR Engine (Range 0.01 mbar to 25.0 mbar, Max Delta = 0.35 mbar) *)
bTubePressure_CH1_Valid := (rTubeStaticPressure_CH1_mbar >= 0.01) AND (rTubeStaticPressure_CH1_mbar <= 25.0);
bTubePressure_CH2_Valid := (rTubeStaticPressure_CH2_mbar >= 0.01) AND (rTubeStaticPressure_CH2_mbar <= 25.0);
bTubePressure_CH3_Valid := (rTubeStaticPressure_CH3_mbar >= 0.01) AND (rTubeStaticPressure_CH3_mbar <= 25.0);

rTubePressure_Delta12 := ABS(rTubeStaticPressure_CH1_mbar - rTubeStaticPressure_CH2_mbar);
rTubePressure_Delta23 := ABS(rTubeStaticPressure_CH2_mbar - rTubeStaticPressure_CH3_mbar);
rTubePressure_Delta31 := ABS(rTubeStaticPressure_CH3_mbar - rTubeStaticPressure_CH1_mbar);

tTubePressSkewTimer(IN := ((rTubePressure_Delta12 > 0.35) OR (rTubePressure_Delta23 > 0.35) OR (rTubePressure_Delta31 > 0.35)), PT := T#150MS);
IF tTubePressSkewTimer.Q THEN
    wFaultWord1.0 := TRUE; (* Tube Pressure Sensor Skew Warning *)
END_IF;

IF bTubePressure_CH1_Valid AND bTubePressure_CH2_Valid AND bTubePressure_CH3_Valid THEN
    iTubePressure_HealthyChannels := 3;
    IF ((rTubeStaticPressure_CH1_mbar >= rTubeStaticPressure_CH2_mbar) AND (rTubeStaticPressure_CH1_mbar <= rTubeStaticPressure_CH3_mbar)) OR
       ((rTubeStaticPressure_CH1_mbar <= rTubeStaticPressure_CH2_mbar) AND (rTubeStaticPressure_CH1_mbar >= rTubeStaticPressure_CH3_mbar)) THEN
        rVotedTubePressure_mbar := rTubeStaticPressure_CH1_mbar;
    ELSIF ((rTubeStaticPressure_CH2_mbar >= rTubeStaticPressure_CH1_mbar) AND (rTubeStaticPressure_CH2_mbar <= rTubeStaticPressure_CH3_mbar)) OR
          ((rTubeStaticPressure_CH2_mbar <= rTubeStaticPressure_CH1_mbar) AND (rTubeStaticPressure_CH2_mbar >= rTubeStaticPressure_CH3_mbar)) THEN
        rVotedTubePressure_mbar := rTubeStaticPressure_CH2_mbar;
    ELSE
        rVotedTubePressure_mbar := rTubeStaticPressure_CH3_mbar;
    END_IF;
ELSIF bTubePressure_CH1_Valid AND bTubePressure_CH2_Valid THEN
    iTubePressure_HealthyChannels := 2;
    rVotedTubePressure_mbar := (rTubeStaticPressure_CH1_mbar + rTubeStaticPressure_CH2_mbar) * 0.5;
    wFaultWord1.1 := TRUE;
ELSIF bTubePressure_CH2_Valid AND bTubePressure_CH3_Valid THEN
    iTubePressure_HealthyChannels := 2;
    rVotedTubePressure_mbar := (rTubeStaticPressure_CH2_mbar + rTubeStaticPressure_CH3_mbar) * 0.5;

        rVotedGap_FL_mm := rLevitationAirGap_FL_CH2_mm;

        rVotedGap_FL_mm := rLevitationAirGap_FL_CH3_mm;

ELSIF bGap_FL_CH1_Valid AND bGap_FL_CH2_Valid THEN

ELSIF bGap_FL_CH2_Valid AND bGap_FL_CH3_Valid THEN

    rVotedGap_FL_mm := (rLevitationAirGap_FL_CH2_mm + rLevitationAirGap_FL_CH3_mm) * 0.5;
ELSIF bGap_FL_CH3_Valid AND bGap_FL_CH1_Valid THEN

    rVotedGap_FL_mm := rLevitationAirGap_FL_CH2_mm;

ELSE

    rVotedGap_FL_mm := 15.0;
    wFaultWord2.1 := TRUE;
END_IF;

(* 2.3 Quadrant 2 (Fore-Starboard) Levitation Gap TMR Engine *)
bGap_FR_CH1_Valid := (rLevitationAirGap_FR_CH1_mm >= 3.0) AND (rLevitationAirGap_FR_CH1_mm <= 35.0);
bGap_FR_CH2_Valid := (rLevitationAirGap_FR_CH2_mm >= 3.0) AND (rLevitationAirGap_FR_CH2_mm <= 35.0);
bGap_FR_CH3_Valid := (rLevitationAirGap_FR_CH3_mm >= 3.0) AND (rLevitationAirGap_FR_CH3_mm <= 35.0);

tGapFRSkewTimer(IN := (ABS(rLevitationAirGap_FR_CH1_mm - rLevitationAirGap_FR_CH2_mm) > 1.8) OR
                      (ABS(rLevitationAirGap_FR_CH2_mm - rLevitationAirGap_FR_CH3_mm) > 1.8) OR
                      (ABS(rLevitationAirGap_FR_CH3_mm - rLevitationAirGap_FR_CH1_mm) > 1.8), PT := T#80MS);

IF bGap_FR_CH1_Valid AND bGap_FR_CH2_Valid AND bGap_FR_CH3_Valid THEN
    iGap_FR_HealthyChannels := 3;
    IF ((rLevitationAirGap_FR_CH1_mm >= rLevitationAirGap_FR_CH2_mm) AND (rLevitationAirGap_FR_CH1_mm <= rLevitationAirGap_FR_CH3_mm)) OR
       ((rLevitationAirGap_FR_CH1_mm <= rLevitationAirGap_FR_CH2_mm) AND (rLevitationAirGap_FR_CH1_mm >= rLevitationAirGap_FR_CH3_mm)) THEN
        rVotedGap_FR_mm := rLevitationAirGap_FR_CH1_mm;
    ELSIF ((rLevitationAirGap_FR_CH2_mm >= rLevitationAirGap_FR_CH1_mm) AND (rLevitationAirGap_FR_CH2_mm <= rLevitationAirGap_FR_CH3_mm)) OR
          ((rLevitationAirGap_FR_CH2_mm <= rLevitationAirGap_FR_CH1_mm) AND (rLevitationAirGap_FR_CH2_mm >= rLevitationAirGap_FR_CH3_mm)) THEN

ELSIF bGap_FR_CH1_Valid AND bGap_FR_CH2_Valid THEN
    iGap_FR_HealthyChannels := 2;
    rVotedGap_FR_mm := (rLevitationAirGap_FR_CH1_mm + rLevitationAirGap_FR_CH2_mm) * 0.5;
ELSIF bGap_FR_CH2_Valid AND bGap_FR_CH3_Valid THEN
    iGap_FR_HealthyChannels := 2;
    rVotedGap_FR_mm := (rLevitationAirGap_FR_CH2_mm + rLevitationAirGap_FR_CH3_mm) * 0.5;

    rVotedGap_FR_mm := (rLevitationAirGap_FR_CH3_mm + rLevitationAirGap_FR_CH1_mm) * 0.5;

    rVotedGap_FR_mm := rLevitationAirGap_FR_CH2_mm;

    rVotedGap_FR_mm := rLevitationAirGap_FR_CH3_mm;

    rVotedGap_FR_mm := 15.0;
    wFaultWord2.3 := TRUE;
END_IF;

(* 2.4 Quadrant 3 (Aft-Port) Levitation Gap TMR Engine *)
bGap_RL_CH1_Valid := (rLevitationAirGap_RL_CH1_mm >= 3.0) AND (rLevitationAirGap_RL_CH1_mm <= 35.0);
bGap_RL_CH2_Valid := (rLevitationAirGap_RL_CH2_mm >= 3.0) AND (rLevitationAirGap_RL_CH2_mm <= 35.0);
bGap_RL_CH3_Valid := (rLevitationAirGap_RL_CH3_mm >= 3.0) AND (rLevitationAirGap_RL_CH3_mm <= 35.0);

tGapRLSkewTimer(IN := (ABS(rLevitationAirGap_RL_CH1_mm - rLevitationAirGap_RL_CH2_mm) > 1.8) OR
                      (ABS(rLevitationAirGap_RL_CH2_mm - rLevitationAirGap_RL_CH3_mm) > 1.8) OR
                      (ABS(rLevitationAirGap_RL_CH3_mm - rLevitationAirGap_RL_CH1_mm) > 1.8), PT := T#80MS);
IF tGapRLSkewTimer.Q THEN wFaultWord2.4 := TRUE; END_IF;

IF bGap_RL_CH1_Valid AND bGap_RL_CH2_Valid AND bGap_RL_CH3_Valid THEN
    iGap_RL_HealthyChannels := 3;
    IF ((rLevitationAirGap_RL_CH1_mm >= rLevitationAirGap_RL_CH2_mm) AND (rLevitationAirGap_RL_CH1_mm <= rLevitationAirGap_RL_CH3_mm)) OR
       ((rLevitationAirGap_RL_CH1_mm <= rLevitationAirGap_RL_CH2_mm) AND (rLevitationAirGap_RL_CH1_mm >= rLevitationAirGap_RL_CH3_mm)) THEN
        rVotedGap_RL_mm := rLevitationAirGap_RL_CH1_mm;
    ELSIF ((rLevitationAirGap_RL_CH2_mm >= rLevitationAirGap_RL_CH1_mm) AND (rLevitationAirGap_RL_CH2_mm <= rLevitationAirGap_RL_CH3_mm)) OR
          ((rLevitationAirGap_RL_CH2_mm <= rLevitationAirGap_RL_CH1_mm) AND (rLevitationAirGap_RL_CH2_mm >= rLevitationAirGap_RL_CH3_mm)) THEN
        rVotedGap_RL_mm := rLevitationAirGap_RL_CH2_mm;
    ELSE
        rVotedGap_RL_mm := rLevitationAirGap_RL_CH3_mm;
    END_IF;
ELSIF bGap_RL_CH1_Valid AND bGap_RL_CH2_Valid THEN
    iGap_RL_HealthyChannels := 2;
    rVotedGap_RL_mm := (rLevitationAirGap_RL_CH1_mm + rLevitationAirGap_RL_CH2_mm) * 0.5;
ELSIF bGap_RL_CH2_Valid AND bGap_RL_CH3_Valid THEN
    iGap_RL_HealthyChannels := 2;
    rVotedGap_RL_mm := (rLevitationAirGap_RL_CH2_mm + rLevitationAirGap_RL_CH3_mm) * 0.5;
ELSIF bGap_RL_CH3_Valid AND bGap_RL_CH1_Valid THEN
    iGap_RL_HealthyChannels := 2;
    rVotedGap_RL_mm := (rLevitationAirGap_RL_CH3_mm + rLevitationAirGap_RL_CH1_mm) * 0.5;

    rVotedGap_RL_mm := rLevitationAirGap_RL_CH1_mm;
ELSIF bGap_RL_CH2_Valid THEN
    iGap_RL_HealthyChannels := 1;
    rVotedGap_RL_mm := rLevitationAirGap_RL_CH2_mm;
ELSIF bGap_RL_CH3_Valid THEN
    iGap_RL_HealthyChannels := 1;
    rVotedGap_RL_mm := rLevitationAirGap_RL_CH3_mm;
ELSE
    iGap_RL_HealthyChannels := 0;
    rVotedGap_RL_mm := 15.0;
    wFaultWord2.5 := TRUE;
END_IF;

(* 2.5 Quadrant 4 (Aft-Starboard) Levitation Gap TMR Engine *)
bGap_RR_CH1_Valid := (rLevitationAirGap_RR_CH1_mm >= 3.0) AND (rLevitationAirGap_RR_CH1_mm <= 35.0);
bGap_RR_CH2_Valid := (rLevitationAirGap_RR_CH2_mm >= 3.0) AND (rLevitationAirGap_RR_CH2_mm <= 35.0);
bGap_RR_CH3_Valid := (rLevitationAirGap_RR_CH3_mm >= 3.0) AND (rLevitationAirGap_RR_CH3_mm <= 35.0);

tGapRRSkewTimer(IN := (ABS(rLevitationAirGap_RR_CH1_mm - rLevitationAirGap_RR_CH2_mm) > 1.8) OR
                      (ABS(rLevitationAirGap_RR_CH2_mm - rLevitationAirGap_RR_CH3_mm) > 1.8) OR
                      (ABS(rLevitationAirGap_RR_CH3_mm - rLevitationAirGap_RR_CH1_mm) > 1.8), PT := T#80MS);
IF tGapRRSkewTimer.Q THEN wFaultWord2.6 := TRUE; END_IF;

IF bGap_RR_CH1_Valid AND bGap_RR_CH2_Valid AND bGap_RR_CH3_Valid THEN
    iGap_RR_HealthyChannels := 3;
    IF ((rLevitationAirGap_RR_CH1_mm >= rLevitationAirGap_RR_CH2_mm) AND (rLevitationAirGap_RR_CH1_mm <= rLevitationAirGap_RR_CH3_mm)) OR
       ((rLevitationAirGap_RR_CH1_mm <= rLevitationAirGap_RR_CH2_mm) AND (rLevitationAirGap_RR_CH1_mm >= rLevitationAirGap_RR_CH3_mm)) THEN

    ELSIF ((rLevitationAirGap_RR_CH2_mm >= rLevitationAirGap_RR_CH1_mm) AND (rLevitationAirGap_RR_CH2_mm <= rLevitationAirGap_RR_CH3_mm)) OR
          ((rLevitationAirGap_RR_CH2_mm <= rLevitationAirGap_RR_CH1_mm) AND (rLevitationAirGap_RR_CH2_mm >= rLevitationAirGap_RR_CH3_mm)) THEN

    rVotedGap_RR_mm := (rLevitationAirGap_RR_CH2_mm + rLevitationAirGap_RR_CH3_mm) * 0.5;

    rVotedGap_RR_mm := (rLevitationAirGap_RR_CH3_mm + rLevitationAirGap_RR_CH1_mm) * 0.5;

    rVotedGap_RR_mm := rLevitationAirGap_RR_CH1_mm;
ELSIF bGap_RR_CH2_Valid THEN

    wFaultWord2.7 := TRUE;

(* Multi-Quadrant Geometry Synthesis: Global Heave, Pitch, and Roll *)
rActiveLevitationHeight_mm := (rVotedGap_FL_mm + rVotedGap_FR_mm + rVotedGap_RL_mm + rVotedGap_RR_mm) * 0.25;
rVehiclePitchAngle_mrad    := (((rVotedGap_FL_mm + rVotedGap_FR_mm) * 0.5) - ((rVotedGap_RL_mm + rVotedGap_RR_mm) * 0.5)) / 12.5;
rVehicleRollAngle_mrad     := (((rVotedGap_FL_mm + rVotedGap_RL_mm) * 0.5) - ((rVotedGap_FR_mm + rVotedGap_RR_mm) * 0.5)) / 2.4;

(* -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
   SECTION 3: DISCRETE EXTENDED KALMAN FILTER (EKF) SENSOR FUSION OBSERVER
   ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
z_measurement[1] := rActiveLevitationHeight_mm * 0.001; (* Gap in m *)
z_measurement[2] := x_hat[2] + (rPodVerticalAcceleration_ms2 * tSampleTime_s);
z_measurement[3] := rVehiclePitchAngle_mrad * 0.001;   (* Pitch in rad *)
z_measurement[4] := rPodPitchRate_rads;

(* 3.1 Time Update: x_pred = A_d * x_hat + B_d * u_control *)
FOR idx := 1 TO 4 DO
    tempSum := 0.0;
    FOR jdx := 1 TO 4 DO
        tempSum := tempSum + (A_d[idx, jdx] * x_hat[jdx]) + (B_d[idx, jdx] * u_control[jdx]);
    END_FOR;

    bTriggerRunoutAutocal       : BOOL;     (* Rising edge trigger to initiate online Fourier harmonic runout autocalibration *)
    bAcknowledgeFault           : BOOL;     (* Operator manual fault trip acknowledge & reset pushbutton *)
END_VAR

VAR_OUTPUT
    bSystemReady                : BOOL;     (* Subsystem operational, pneumatics nominal, FTS in closed-loop regulation *)
    bFTS_Active                 : BOOL;     (* Fast Tool Servo actively engaged in nanometer trajectory compensation *)
    rFTS_Command_nm             : REAL;     (* Total synthesized reference trajectory sent to piezo amplifier [nm] *)
    rPiezoVoltage_V             : REAL;     (* Low-noise analog driver command voltage to high-voltage piezo amplifier [V] *)
    rCompensatedRunout_nm       : REAL;     (* Instantaneous aerostatic spindle dynamic runout estimation vector [nm] *)
    rTrackingError_nm           : REAL;     (* True closed-loop servo tracking deviation (Target + Runout - Actual) [nm] *)
    rEstimatedDisturbance_N     : REAL;     (* Luenberger/Kalman state-space observer estimated dynamic diamond cutting force [N] *)
    wSystemStatusWord           : WORD;     (* Diagnostic status word [Bit 0:Ready, 1:Active, 2:Calibrating, 3:Degraded, 4:Parked] *)
    wAlarmWord                  : WORD;     (* Diagnostic alarm register [Bit 0:Pressure, 1:Thermal, 2:TMR_Fault, 3:Tracking, 4:EStop] *)
    bDegradedMode               : BOOL;     (* Latched flag: System operating under degraded single-probe / relaxed tolerance *)
    bFatalAlarm                 : BOOL;     (* Severe trip: Piezo retracted, diamond disengaged, spindle dynamic brake tripped *)
END_VAR

VAR
    (* --- State Machine Sequencing --- *)
    iState                      : INT := 0; (* Operational finite state machine index *)
    iPrevState                  : INT := 0; (* Historical state tracker for transition auditing *)
    tStateTimer                 : TON;      (* Multi-purpose state dwell and diagnostic timer *)
    
    (* --- Aerostatic Bearing Pneumatic & Thermal Supervision Bounds --- *)
    rNominalPressure_Bar        : REAL := 6.0;   (* Target supply pressure for porous graphite journal bearing [bar] *)
    rMinSafePressure_Bar        : REAL := 5.2;   (* Critical minimum pressure before aerostatic film collapse occurs [bar] *)
    rMaxSafePressure_Bar        : REAL := 7.0;   (* Maximum allowed pneumatic manifold burst rating [bar] *)
    rNominalTemp_DegC           : REAL := 20.0;  (* Metrology cleanroom nominal thermal baseline [deg C] *)
    rMaxAllowableTemp_DegC      : REAL := 23.5;  (* Critical thermal boundary inducing spindle spindle thermal growth [deg C] *)
    
    (* --- 2oo3 Triple Modular Redundancy (TMR) Voting Architecture --- *)
    bProbe1_Valid               : BOOL := TRUE;  (* Sensor Ch1 operational health status *)
    bProbe2_Valid               : BOOL := TRUE;  (* Sensor Ch2 operational health status *)
    bProbe3_Valid               : BOOL := TRUE;  (* Sensor Ch3 operational health status *)
    rDiff_12                    : REAL := 0.0;   (* Discrepancy metric |Probe1 - Probe2| [nm] *)
    rDiff_23                    : REAL := 0.0;   (* Discrepancy metric |Probe2 - Probe3| [nm] *)
    rDiff_31                    : REAL := 0.0;   (* Discrepancy metric |Probe3 - Probe1| [nm] *)
    rTMR_DiscrepancyLimit_nm    : REAL := 45.0;  (* Inter-sensor discordance threshold for defect isolation [nm] *)
    rVoted_RadialRunout_nm      : REAL := 0.0;   (* Synthesized median/average runout from active voting channel [nm] *)
    
    (* --- Online Adaptive Fourier Harmonic Runout Decomposition --- *)
    rHarmonic_1X_Cos            : REAL := 0.0;   (* Fundamental 1X fundamental spindle eccentric runout Cosine [nm] *)
    rHarmonic_1X_Sin            : REAL := 0.0;   (* Fundamental 1X fundamental spindle eccentric runout Sine [nm] *)
    rHarmonic_2X_Cos            : REAL := 0.0;   (* 2X Spindle ellipticity harmonic runout Cosine [nm] *)
    rHarmonic_2X_Sin            : REAL := 0.0;   (* 2X Spindle ellipticity harmonic runout Sine [nm] *)
    rHarmonic_3X_Cos            : REAL := 0.0;   (* 3X Triangular aerostatic lobe lobe runout Cosine [nm] *)
    rHarmonic_3X_Sin            : REAL := 0.0;   (* 3X Triangular aerostatic lobe lobe runout Sine [nm] *)
    rHarmonic_4X_Cos            : REAL := 0.0;   (* 4X Aerostatic bearing orifice pressure pulsation Cosine [nm] *)
    rHarmonic_4X_Sin            : REAL := 0.0;   (* 4X Aerostatic bearing orifice pressure pulsation Sine [nm] *)
    rLearningRate_Gamma         : REAL := 0.0008;(* Recursive gradient descent adaptation learning rate *)
    rIdentifiedRunout_nm        : REAL := 0.0;   (* Real-time synthesized harmonic runout compensation feedforward [nm] *)
    
    (* --- Discrete State-Space Model & Kalman Observer (FTS Flexure Dynamics) --- *)
    (* Plant: 2nd-order resonant flexure mechanics + disturbance + integrated tracking error *)
    (* Sampling period Ts derived from rSamplingFreq_kHz *)
    rTs_sec                     : REAL := 0.00002; (* Default 20 microseconds (50 kHz) *)
    
    (* State Vector: x = [pos_error, velocity, cutting_force, integral_error]^T *)
    rState_x1_Pos_nm            : REAL := 0.0;   (* State 1: Estimated tool displacement [nm] *)
    rState_x2_Vel_nm_s          : REAL := 0.0;   (* State 2: Estimated tool velocity [nm/s] *)
    rState_x3_Force_N           : REAL := 0.0;   (* State 3: Estimated disturbance cutting load [N] *)
    rState_x4_IntError_nm_s     : REAL := 0.0;   (* State 4: Accumulated continuous tracking error [nm*s] *)
    
    (* State Transition Matrix Elements (Continuous parameterized to discrete @ 50kHz) *)
    (* Natural resonance fn = 3.2 kHz, damping zeta = 0.08, moving mass m = 0.085 kg *)
    rA11                        : REAL := 0.9852;
    rA12                        : REAL := 0.0000192;
    rA13                        : REAL := 0.000235;
    rA21                        : REAL := -1524.3;
    rA22                        : REAL := 0.9321;
    rA23                        : REAL := 23.41;
    
    (* Input Matrix Elements: B = [b1, b2]^T *)
    rB1                         : REAL := 0.0148;
    rB2                         : REAL := 1482.5;
    
    (* Observer Correction Gains: L = [L1, L2, L3]^T *)
    rL1_Gain                    : REAL := 0.425;
    rL2_Gain                    : REAL := 12500.0;
    rL3_Gain                    : REAL := 450.0;
    
    (* LQR / State-Feedback Optimal Regulator Gains: K = [K1, K2, K3, K4] *)
    rK1_PosGain                 : REAL := 0.850;
    rK2_VelGain                 : REAL := 0.000145;
    rK3_ForceGain               : REAL := 0.0042;
    rK4_IntGain                 : REAL := 45.0;
    
    (* --- Bouc-Wen Inverse Hysteresis Compensator --- *)
    (* Models and cancels non-linear microscopic polarization hysteresis in PZT ceramic *)
    rPiezo_d33_nm_V             : REAL := 250.0; (* Piezoelectric small-signal stroke coefficient [nm/V] (25 um @ 100V) *)
    rBW_Alpha                   : REAL := 0.45;   (* Bouc-Wen shape scale coefficient *)
    rBW_Beta                    : REAL := 0.055;  (* Bouc-Wen hysteresis loop width parameter *)
    rBW_Gamma                   : REAL := 0.035;  (* Bouc-Wen loop asymmetry parameter *)
    rBW_HysteresisState_w       : REAL := 0.0;   (* Internal nonlinear hysteretic displacement variable [nm] *)
    
    (* --- Piezo Actuator Physical Envelope and Safety Bounds --- *)
    rMaxStroke_nm               : REAL := 25000.0; (* Maximum positive stroke excursion [nm] (25.0 um) *)
    rMinStroke_nm               : REAL := -2000.0; (* Preload mechanical negative boundary [nm] (-2.0 um) *)
    rMaxVoltage_V               : REAL := 120.0;   (* Positive amplifier rail voltage limit [V] *)
    rMinVoltage_V               : REAL := -10.0;   (* Reverse bias polarization breakdown limit [V] *)
    rEmergencyRetractTarget_nm  : REAL := -1500.0; (* Safe diamond tool disengage position [nm] *)
    rRetractSlewRate_nm_per_step: REAL := 500.0;   (* Controlled deceleration slope per 20us sample [nm/step] *)
    
    (* --- Diagnostic Filters and Metrics --- *)
    rMeanTrackingError_nm       : REAL := 0.0;   (* Low-pass filtered residual positioning error [nm] *)
    rMaxObservedError_nm        : REAL := 0.0;   (* Peak tracking deviation envelope [nm] *)
    rErrorToleranceLimit_nm     : REAL := 8.5;   (* Nanometer optical threshold before warning trip [nm] *)
    rFatalErrorLimit_nm         : REAL := 28.0;  (* Unrecoverable diamond collision hazard threshold [nm] *)
    
    (* Edge Detection Trigger *)
    bPrevTriggerRunoutAutocal   : BOOL := FALSE;
    bTriggerAutocalRising       : BOOL := FALSE;
END_VAR

(*
====================================================================================================
  STAGE 0: SYSTEM INITIALIZATION, METROLOGICAL SAFETY CHECKS & 2oo3 TMR DISPLACEMENT ARBITRATION
====================================================================================================
*)

(* Compute instantaneous discrete cycle duration from input frequency *)
IF rSamplingFreq_kHz > 1.0 AND rSamplingFreq_kHz <= 100.0 THEN
    rTs_sec := 0.001 / rSamplingFreq_kHz;
ELSE
    rTs_sec := 0.00002; (* Safe fallback: 50.0 kHz = 20 microseconds *)
END_IF;

(* Edge detection for autocalibration trigger *)
bTriggerAutocalRising := bTriggerRunoutAutocal AND NOT bPrevTriggerRunoutAutocal;
bPrevTriggerRunoutAutocal := bTriggerRunoutAutocal;

(* -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
   CRITICAL HARDWARE INTERLOCK SUPERVISION: DUAL-CHANNEL E-STOP & FLUID FILM INTEGRITY
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
IF NOT bEmergencyStop_DualCh_OK THEN
    wAlarmWord.4 := TRUE;  (* Bit 4: Emergency Stop Circuit Active *)
    bFatalAlarm  := TRUE;
    iState       := 90;    (* Divert unconditionally to Sub-Millisecond Piezo Retract Routine *)
END_IF;

IF (rSupplyPressure_Bar < rMinSafePressure_Bar) OR (rSupplyPressure_Bar > rMaxSafePressure_Bar) THEN
    wAlarmWord.0 := TRUE;  (* Bit 0: Aerostatic Bearing Pneumatic Envelope Violation *)
    bFatalAlarm  := TRUE;
    iState       := 90;    (* Critical: Aerostatic air cushion loss guarantees spindle crash *)
END_IF;

IF rBearingTemp_DegC > rMaxAllowableTemp_DegC THEN
    wAlarmWord.1 := TRUE;  (* Bit 1: Thermal Over-temperature Condition *)
    bDegradedMode := TRUE;
END_IF;

(* -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
   2oo3 TRIPLE MODULAR REDUNDANCY (TMR) CAPACITIVE DISPLACEMENT ARBITRATION
   Evaluates Channel 1, 2, and 3 cross-channel discrepancy metrics.
   Guarantees sub-nanometer radial runout measurement even under single probe hardware breakdown.
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
rDiff_12 := ABS(rCapacitiveProbe_X1_nm - rCapacitiveProbe_X2_nm);
rDiff_23 := ABS(rCapacitiveProbe_X2_nm - rCapacitiveProbe_X3_nm);
rDiff_31 := ABS(rCapacitiveProbe_X3_nm - rCapacitiveProbe_X1_nm);

(* Fault identification on individual capacitive transducer channels *)
IF (rDiff_12 > rTMR_DiscrepancyLimit_nm) AND (rDiff_31 > rTMR_DiscrepancyLimit_nm) THEN
    bProbe1_Valid := FALSE; (* Probe 1 discordant with both 2 and 3 *)
ELSIF (rDiff_12 > rTMR_DiscrepancyLimit_nm) AND (rDiff_23 > rTMR_DiscrepancyLimit_nm) THEN
    bProbe2_Valid := FALSE; (* Probe 2 discordant with both 1 and 3 *)
ELSIF (rDiff_23 > rTMR_DiscrepancyLimit_nm) AND (rDiff_31 > rTMR_DiscrepancyLimit_nm) THEN
    bProbe3_Valid := FALSE; (* Probe 3 discordant with both 1 and 2 *)
END_IF;

(* Synthesize voted radial runout output *)
IF bProbe1_Valid AND bProbe2_Valid AND bProbe3_Valid THEN
    (* All three healthy: Use middle-value median selection to eliminate transient electrical noise *)
    IF (rCapacitiveProbe_X1_nm >= rCapacitiveProbe_X2_nm AND rCapacitiveProbe_X1_nm <= rCapacitiveProbe_X3_nm) OR
       (rCapacitiveProbe_X1_nm <= rCapacitiveProbe_X2_nm AND rCapacitiveProbe_X1_nm >= rCapacitiveProbe_X3_nm) THEN
        rVoted_RadialRunout_nm := rCapacitiveProbe_X1_nm;
    ELSIF (rCapacitiveProbe_X2_nm >= rCapacitiveProbe_X1_nm AND rCapacitiveProbe_X2_nm <= rCapacitiveProbe_X3_nm) OR
          (rCapacitiveProbe_X2_nm <= rCapacitiveProbe_X1_nm AND rCapacitiveProbe_X2_nm >= rCapacitiveProbe_X3_nm) THEN
        rVoted_RadialRunout_nm := rCapacitiveProbe_X2_nm;
    ELSE
        rVoted_RadialRunout_nm := rCapacitiveProbe_X3_nm;
    END_IF;
    wAlarmWord.2 := FALSE;
ELSIF bProbe1_Valid AND bProbe2_Valid THEN
    (* Probe 3 failed: Average Probe 1 and 2 *)
    rVoted_RadialRunout_nm := (rCapacitiveProbe_X1_nm + rCapacitiveProbe_X2_nm) * 0.5;
    bDegradedMode := TRUE;
    wAlarmWord.2 := TRUE;  (* Bit 2: TMR Degradation Warning *)
ELSIF bProbe2_Valid AND bProbe3_Valid THEN
    (* Probe 1 failed: Average Probe 2 and 3 *)
    rVoted_RadialRunout_nm := (rCapacitiveProbe_X2_nm + rCapacitiveProbe_X3_nm) * 0.5;
    bDegradedMode := TRUE;
    wAlarmWord.2 := TRUE;
ELSIF bProbe1_Valid AND bProbe3_Valid THEN
    (* Probe 2 failed: Average Probe 1 and 3 *)
    rVoted_RadialRunout_nm := (rCapacitiveProbe_X1_nm + rCapacitiveProbe_X3_nm) * 0.5;
    bDegradedMode := TRUE;
    wAlarmWord.2 := TRUE;
ELSE
    (* Multiple probe sensor collapse: Cannot guarantee nanometer surface integrity *)
    wAlarmWord.2 := TRUE;
    bFatalAlarm  := TRUE;
    iState       := 90; (* Emergency tool retract *)
END_IF;

(*
====================================================================================================
  STAGE 1: MULTI-STAGE FINITE STATE MACHINE (FSM) CONTROL LOGIC
====================================================================================================
*)

CASE iState OF

    0: (* STATE: BOOT & STANDBY DIAGNOSTICS *)
        bSystemReady    := FALSE;
        bFTS_Active     := FALSE;
        rPiezoVoltage_V := 0.0;
        rFTS_Command_nm := 0.0;
        wSystemStatusWord := 16#0000;
        
        IF bAcknowledgeFault THEN
            wAlarmWord   := 16#0000;
            bFatalAlarm  := FALSE;
            bDegradedMode := FALSE;
            bProbe1_Valid := TRUE;
            bProbe2_Valid := TRUE;
            bProbe3_Valid := TRUE;
        END_IF;
        
        IF bEnable AND bEmergencyStop_DualCh_OK AND (NOT bFatalAlarm) THEN
            IF (rSupplyPressure_Bar >= rNominalPressure_Bar - 0.3) AND (rSupplyPressure_Bar <= rMaxSafePressure_Bar) THEN
                iState := 10; (* Transition to Pneumatic & Thermal Settle *)
            END_IF;
        END_IF;

    10: (* STATE: PNEUMATIC & THERMAL STABILIZATION *)
        (* Ensure aerostatic journal air gap (typ. 12 to 15 um) has completely stabilized *)
        tStateTimer(IN := TRUE, PT := T#500MS);
        wSystemStatusWord := 16#0001; (* Bit 0: Initializing/Readying *)
        
        IF tStateTimer.Q THEN
            tStateTimer(IN := FALSE);
            IF ABS(rBearingTemp_DegC - rNominalTemp_DegC) < 2.0 THEN
                iState := 20; (* Proceed to Sensor Validation & Zero-Calibration *)
            ELSE
                bDegradedMode := TRUE;
                iState := 20; (* Proceed with thermal expansion alert flagged *)
            END_IF;
        END_IF;

    20: (* STATE: SENSOR TMR INTEGRITY & NOISE FLOOR VERIFICATION *)
        (* Check probe noise standard deviation and static zero offset *)
        wSystemStatusWord := 16#0002;
        IF (bProbe1_Valid AND bProbe2_Valid) OR (bProbe2_Valid AND bProbe3_Valid) OR (bProbe1_Valid AND bProbe3_Valid) THEN
            IF rSpindleSpeed_RPM > 100.0 THEN
                iState := 30; (* Spindle rotating: Begin dynamic Fourier runout estimation *)
            ELSE
                (* Spindle static: Direct ready mode for stationary optical micro-structuring *)
                bSystemReady := TRUE;
                IF bEnable THEN
                    iState := 40; (* Jump straight to Closed-Loop Profiling *)
                END_IF;
            END_IF;
        ELSE
            iState := 99; (* Catastrophic sensor loss *)
        END_IF;

    30: (* STATE: ONLINE RECURSIVE FOURIER RUNOUT IDENTIFICATION *)
        (*
           Identifies repeatable aerostatic bearing error motion at 1X, 2X, 3X, 4X spindle harmonics.
           Uses continuous gradient adaptation against high-precision rotary encoder angle theta.
        *)
        wSystemStatusWord := 16#0004; (* Bit 2: Harmonic Autocalibration Active *)
        bSystemReady := TRUE;
        
        (* Residual error between observed radial motion and current harmonic synthesis *)
        rIdentifiedRunout_nm := (rHarmonic_1X_Cos * COS(rSpindleAngle_Rad) + rHarmonic_1X_Sin * SIN(rSpindleAngle_Rad))
                              + (rHarmonic_2X_Cos * COS(2.0 * rSpindleAngle_Rad) + rHarmonic_2X_Sin * SIN(2.0 * rSpindleAngle_Rad))
                              + (rHarmonic_3X_Cos * COS(3.0 * rSpindleAngle_Rad) + rHarmonic_3X_Sin * SIN(3.0 * rSpindleAngle_Rad))
                              + (rHarmonic_4X_Cos * COS(4.0 * rSpindleAngle_Rad) + rHarmonic_4X_Sin * SIN(4.0 * rSpindleAngle_Rad));
                              
        (* Online gradient adaptation update step *)
        rHarmonic_1X_Cos := rHarmonic_1X_Cos + rLearningRate_Gamma * (rVoted_RadialRunout_nm - rIdentifiedRunout_nm) * COS(rSpindleAngle_Rad);
        rHarmonic_1X_Sin := rHarmonic_1X_Sin + rLearningRate_Gamma * (rVoted_RadialRunout_nm - rIdentifiedRunout_nm) * SIN(rSpindleAngle_Rad);
        
        rHarmonic_2X_Cos := rHarmonic_2X_Cos + rLearningRate_Gamma * (rVoted_RadialRunout_nm - rIdentifiedRunout_nm) * COS(2.0 * rSpindleAngle_Rad);
        rHarmonic_2X_Sin := rHarmonic_2X_Sin + rLearningRate_Gamma * (rVoted_RadialRunout_nm - rIdentifiedRunout_nm) * SIN(2.0 * rSpindleAngle_Rad);

        rHarmonic_3X_Cos := rHarmonic_3X_Cos + (rLearningRate_Gamma * 0.5) * (rVoted_RadialRunout_nm - rIdentifiedRunout_nm) * COS(3.0 * rSpindleAngle_Rad);
        rHarmonic_3X_Sin := rHarmonic_3X_Sin + (rLearningRate_Gamma * 0.5) * (rVoted_RadialRunout_nm - rIdentifiedRunout_nm) * SIN(3.0 * rSpindleAngle_Rad);

        rHarmonic_4X_Cos := rHarmonic_4X_Cos + (rLearningRate_Gamma * 0.25) * (rVoted_RadialRunout_nm - rIdentifiedRunout_nm) * COS(4.0 * rSpindleAngle_Rad);
        rHarmonic_4X_Sin := rHarmonic_4X_Sin + (rLearningRate_Gamma * 0.25) * (rVoted_RadialRunout_nm - rIdentifiedRunout_nm) * SIN(4.0 * rSpindleAngle_Rad);

        IF bEnable THEN
            iState := 40; (* Engage Active Nanometer Fast Tool Servo Profiling *)
        END_IF;

    40: (* STATE: ACTIVE CLOSED-LOOP NANOMETER PROFILING WITH MPC & OBSERVER *)
        wSystemStatusWord := 16#0003; (* Bit 0: Ready, Bit 1: FTS Active *)
        bSystemReady      := TRUE;
        bFTS_Active       := TRUE;

        (* 1. Synthesize online dynamic runout feedforward compensation term *)
        rCompensatedRunout_nm := (rHarmonic_1X_Cos * COS(rSpindleAngle_Rad) + rHarmonic_1X_Sin * SIN(rSpindleAngle_Rad))
                               + (rHarmonic_2X_Cos * COS(2.0 * rSpindleAngle_Rad) + rHarmonic_2X_Sin * SIN(2.0 * rSpindleAngle_Rad))
                               + (rHarmonic_3X_Cos * COS(3.0 * rSpindleAngle_Rad) + rHarmonic_3X_Sin * SIN(3.0 * rSpindleAngle_Rad))
                               + (rHarmonic_4X_Cos * COS(4.0 * rSpindleAngle_Rad) + rHarmonic_4X_Sin * SIN(4.0 * rSpindleAngle_Rad));
        
        (* 2. Composite trajectory command = Target Freeform Micro-Structure - Spindle Dynamic Runout *)
        rFTS_Command_nm := rTargetSurfaceProfile_nm - rCompensatedRunout_nm;

        (* 3. Enforce stroke boundary saturations on commanded nanometer position *)
        IF rFTS_Command_nm > rMaxStroke_nm THEN
            rFTS_Command_nm := rMaxStroke_nm;
        ELSIF rFTS_Command_nm < rMinStroke_nm THEN
            rFTS_Command_nm := rMinStroke_nm;
        END_IF;

        (* 4. True tracking deviation computation *)
        rTrackingError_nm := rFTS_Command_nm - rFTS_ActualPos_nm;

        (* 5. Update Luenberger / Kalman Full State Observer:
              x_hat(k+1) = A * x_hat(k) + B * u(k) + L * (y_actual - C * x_hat) *)
        rState_x1_Pos_nm := (rA11 * rState_x1_Pos_nm + rA12 * rState_x2_Vel_nm_s + rA13 * rState_x3_Force_N)
                          + rB1 * rPiezoVoltage_V
                          + rL1_Gain * (rFTS_ActualPos_nm - rState_x1_Pos_nm);

        rState_x2_Vel_nm_s := (rA21 * rState_x1_Pos_nm + rA22 * rState_x2_Vel_nm_s + rA23 * rState_x3_Force_N)
                            + rB2 * rPiezoVoltage_V
                            + rL2_Gain * (rFTS_ActualPos_nm - rState_x1_Pos_nm);

        (* Disturbance estimation: Cutting load force model integration *)
        rState_x3_Force_N := rState_x3_Force_N + rTs_sec * rL3_Gain * (rFTS_ActualPos_nm - rState_x1_Pos_nm);
        rEstimatedDisturbance_N := rState_x3_Force_N;

        (* Error integrator with robust anti-windup clamp *)
        rState_x4_IntError_nm_s := rState_x4_IntError_nm_s + (rTrackingError_nm * rTs_sec);
        IF rState_x4_IntError_nm_s > 500.0 THEN
            rState_x4_IntError_nm_s := 500.0;
        ELSIF rState_x4_IntError_nm_s < -500.0 THEN
            rState_x4_IntError_nm_s := -500.0;
        END_IF;

        (* 6. State-Feedback Optimal LQR / MPC Control Voltage Formulation:
              u_lqr = K1*(Command - Pos) - K2*Vel - K3*Disturbance + K4*IntError *)
        rPiezoVoltage_V := (rK1_PosGain * (rFTS_Command_nm - rState_x1_Pos_nm) / rPiezo_d33_nm_V)
                         - (rK2_VelGain * rState_x2_Vel_nm_s)
                         - (rK3_ForceGain * rState_x3_Force_N)
                         + (rK4_IntGain * rState_x4_IntError_nm_s / rPiezo_d33_nm_V);

        (* 7. Bouc-Wen Inverse Nonlinear Hysteresis Compensation:
              w_dot = alpha * d_u/dt - beta * |d_u/dt| * w - gamma * (d_u/dt) * |w| *)
        rBW_HysteresisState_w := rBW_HysteresisState_w + rTs_sec * (
            rBW_Alpha * (rState_x2_Vel_nm_s / rPiezo_d33_nm_V)
            - rBW_Beta * ABS(rState_x2_Vel_nm_s / rPiezo_d33_nm_V) * rBW_HysteresisState_w
            - rBW_Gamma * (rState_x2_Vel_nm_s / rPiezo_d33_nm_V) * ABS(rBW_HysteresisState_w)
        );
        
        (* Inject inverse hysteresis feedforward correction to cancel ceramic lag *)
        rPiezoVoltage_V := rPiezoVoltage_V - (rBW_HysteresisState_w * 0.08);

        (* 8. Final High-Voltage Amplifier Rail Saturation Clamping *)
        IF rPiezoVoltage_V > rMaxVoltage_V THEN
            rPiezoVoltage_V := rMaxVoltage_V;
        ELSIF rPiezoVoltage_V < rMinVoltage_V THEN
            rPiezoVoltage_V := rMinVoltage_V;
        END_IF;

        (* 9. Real-Time Tracking Error Envelope Supervision *)
        rMeanTrackingError_nm := (rMeanTrackingError_nm * 0.995) + (ABS(rTrackingError_nm) * 0.005);
        IF ABS(rTrackingError_nm) > rMaxObservedError_nm THEN
            rMaxObservedError_nm := ABS(rTrackingError_nm);
        END_IF;

        IF ABS(rTrackingError_nm) > rFatalErrorLimit_nm THEN
            wAlarmWord.3 := TRUE; (* Bit 3: Fatal Nanometer Tracking Boundary Fault *)
            bFatalAlarm  := TRUE;
            iState       := 90;   (* Trigger Emergency Retraction immediately *)
        ELSIF ABS(rTrackingError_nm) > rErrorToleranceLimit_nm THEN
            wAlarmWord.3  := TRUE;
            bDegradedMode := TRUE;
            iState        := 50;   (* Transition to Degraded Low-Speed Profiling *)
        END_IF;

        (* Seamless transition when master enable deactivated *)
        IF NOT bEnable THEN
            iState := 0;
        END_IF;

    50: (* STATE: DEGRADED SUB-OPTIMAL OPERATION (Reduced Feedrate & Thermal Warning) *)
        wSystemStatusWord := 16#0008; (* Bit 3: Degraded Mode Flag *)
        bDegradedMode     := TRUE;
        bFTS_Active       := TRUE;

        (* Execute reduced-gain conservative positioning to prevent surface scuffing *)
        rTrackingError_nm := (rTargetSurfaceProfile_nm - rCompensatedRunout_nm) - rFTS_ActualPos_nm;
        rPiezoVoltage_V   := (rTrackingError_nm * 0.5) / rPiezo_d33_nm_V;
        
        IF rPiezoVoltage_V > 80.0 THEN
            rPiezoVoltage_V := 80.0;
        ELSIF rPiezoVoltage_V < 0.0 THEN
            rPiezoVoltage_V := 0.0;
        END_IF;

    aMPC_Setpoint_r                 : ARRAY[1..4] OF REAL;      (* Target reference: [T1_ref, x_d_ref, T2_ref, h_burr_ref] *)
    aMPC_Grad_g                     : ARRAY[1..4] OF REAL;      (* Objective cost gradient vector *)
    aMPC_DeltaU                     : ARRAY[1..4] OF REAL;      (* Calculated actuator adjustment vector *)
    rMPC_StepSize_alpha             : REAL := 0.042;            (* Gradient descent convergence step parameter *)
    iMPC_Iter                       : INT  := 0;                (* Gradient descent iteration counter *)

    (* =================================================================================================================
       LAYER D: KINEMATICS, SPOOL INERTIA & DANCER DECOUPLING FILTERS
       ================================================================================================================= *)
    rFoilDensity_kg_m3              : REAL := 8960.0;   (* Active foil bulk density [kg/m^3] *)
    rCalculatedArea_m2              : REAL := 2.925E-6; (* Web cross-sectional area w * h [m^2] *)
    rEffectiveStiffness_EA_N        : REAL := 321750.0; (* Longitudinal tension stiffness E * A [N] *)
    rFilteredUnwindRadius_m         : REAL := 0.300;    (* Continuous filtered mother roll radius [m] *)
    rFilteredRewindRadius_m         : REAL := 0.100;    (* Continuous filtered rewind spool radius [m] *)
    rUnwindAngularVel_rad_s         : REAL := 0.0;      (* Unwind shaft angular velocity [rad/s] *)
    rPrevLineSpeed_mpmin            : REAL := 0.0;      (* Velocity storage for acceleration calculation *)
    rWebAcceleration_mps2           : REAL := 0.0;      (* Linear web acceleration d(v)/dt [m/s^2] *)
    rInertiaFeedforwardTorque_Nm    : REAL := 0.0;      (* Dynamic acceleration torque J * alpha / i_gear [Nm] *)
    rTensionTensionTorque_Nm        : REAL := 0.0;      (* Static web tension holding torque T * R / i_gear [Nm] *)

    (* Dancer Second-Order Digital Low-Pass Filter State *)
    rDancerPos_Raw_mm               : REAL := 0.0;      (* Unfiltered dancer encoder displacement [mm] *)
    rDancerPos_Filt_mm              : REAL := 0.0;      (* Filtered dancer position [mm] *)
    rDancerPos_Prev_mm              : REAL := 0.0;      (* Position history for velocity differentiation [mm] *)
    rDancerVel_Calc_m_s             : REAL := 0.0;      (* Numerical velocity dx_d/dt [m/s] *)
    rDancerVel_Filt_m_s             : REAL := 0.0;      (* Low-pass filtered dancer vertical velocity [m/s] *)
    rDancerPneumaticFeedforward_bar : REAL := 3.25;     (* Nominal static pneumatic balancing pressure [bar] *)
    rDancerServoTrimVelocity_mpmin  : REAL := 0.0;      (* Decoupled velocity compensation for unwind servo [m/min] *)

    (* Laser Slitter Process Adaptation Parameters *)
    rFilteredBurrInternal_um        : REAL := 0.85;     (* Internal recursive average burr height [um] *)
    rLaserPulseOverlap_ratio        : REAL := 0.82;     (* Calculated pulse overlap ratio *)
    rLaserAdaptivePowerOffset_W     : REAL := 0.0;      (* Dynamic burr feedback laser power trim [W] *)
    rLaserGasPressureTrim_bar       : REAL := 0.0;      (* Dynamic assist gas trim [bar] *)
    rLaserFocusZ_Trim_um            : REAL := 0.0;      (* Dynamic piezo focus offset [um] *)

    (* ISA-88 State Machine & Supervisory Process Timers *)
    iMachineState                   : INT  := 0;        (* Current execution phase *)
    iTargetState                    : INT  := 0;        (* Target sequence state index *)
    tPhaseTimer                     : TON;              (* Multi-purpose state dwell & stabilization timer *)
    tSpliceWatchdogTimer            : TON;              (* High-speed turret flying splice safety watchdog *)
    tEmergencyBrakeTimer            : TON;              (* Deceleration slip prevention timer *)
    tBurrAlarmIntegrator            : TON;              (* Burr out-of-spec persistent qualification timer *)

    (* Iterators & Scratch Variables *)
    idx_i                           : INT;
    idx_j                           : INT;
    rMatAccumulator                 : REAL;
    rTempCalc                       : REAL;

    (* Constant Physical & Geometric Parameters *)
    c_rSamplingPeriod_s             : REAL := 0.002;    (* Discrete scan cycle period Ts = 2.0 ms [s] *)
    c_rCoreRadius_m                 : REAL := 0.0381;   (* 3.0-inch core radius (76.2 mm diameter / 2) [m] *)
    c_rCoreInertia_kgm2             : REAL := 0.420;    (* Shaft and mandrel mechanical polar inertia [kg*m^2] *)
    c_rGearRatioUnwind              : REAL := 3.250;    (* Unwind servo planetary gearbox reduction ratio *)
    c_rGearRatioRewind              : REAL := 2.850;    (* Rewind servo planetary gearbox reduction ratio *)
    c_rDancerArmMass_kg             : REAL := 2.850;    (* Lumped mass of dancer carriage & roll [kg] *)
    c_rDancerPistonArea_m2          : REAL := 0.001963; (* Dancer pneumatic cylinder effective area (50mm bore) [m^2] *)
    c_rMaxAllowableTension_N        : REAL := 32.0;     (* Absolute upper tension limit before foil necking [N] *)
    c_rMinAllowableTension_N        : REAL := 1.20;     (* Absolute lower tension limit to prevent web slackening [N] *)
    c_rTMR_MaxDiscrepancy_N         : REAL := 0.85;     (* Maximum permissible load cell inter-channel drift [N] *)
    c_rCriticalBurrThreshold_um     : REAL := 1.80;     (* Laser slitting edge burr trip threshold [um] *)
    c_rWarningBurrThreshold_um      : REAL := 1.35;     (* Laser slitting edge burr warning threshold [um] *)
    c_rMaxLaserCollimatorTemp_degC  : REAL := 48.0;     (* Laser optical cutting head overtemperature trip [deg C] *)
    c_rMinAssistGasPressure_bar     : REAL := 4.50;     (* Assist gas minimum pressure interlock limit [bar] *)
    c_rMinChillerFlow_Lmin          : REAL := 12.0;     (* Minimum allowable laser deionized cooling flow [L/min] *)
END_VAR
(*
========================================================================================================================
  LAYER 1: SIL-3 / IEC 61508 CAT 4 PLe HARDWARE SAFETY INTERLOCKS & IMMEDIATE TRIP HIERARCHY
========================================================================================================================
*)
(* Immediate Deterministic De-Energization upon E-Stop Chain Rupture *)
IF NOT bSafetyRelayChainOk THEN
    (* Clamp all servo torque commands to emergency regenerative deceleration limit *)
    rCmdUnwindTorque_Nm         := 0.0;
    rCmdMainCapstanSpeed_mpmin  := 0.0;
    rCmdRewindTorque_Nm         := 0.0;
    rCmdDancerPressure_bar      := 0.0;
    rCmdDancerVoiceCoil_N       := 0.0;
    rCmdEdgeGuideCorrection_mm  := 0.0;

    (* Instantaneously shut off high-power laser beam and close safety shutter *)
    bLaserEmissionPermissive    := FALSE;
    rCmdLaserPower_W            := 0.0;
    rCmdLaserPulseFreq_kHz      := 0.0;
    rCmdLaserDutyCycle_pct      := 0.0;
    rCmdLaserGasFlow_bar        := 0.0;
    rCmdLaserFocusOffset_um     := 0.0;

    (* Assert Trip Diagnostic Bitmasks *)
    wAlarmCodeWord1.0           := TRUE;    (* Bit 0: Hardware E-Stop Tripped *)
    bSystemAlarmSummary         := TRUE;
    wSystemStatusWord           := 16#E000; (* Emergency fault active *)
    bDegradedModeActive         := FALSE;
    iMachineState               := 999;     (* Immediate jump to failsafe state *)
    iActiveMachineState         := 999;
    RETURN;
END_IF;

(* Critical Laser Head Thermal Runaway Interlock *)
IF (rLaserCollimatorTemp_degC > c_rMaxLaserCollimatorTemp_degC) THEN
    bLaserEmissionPermissive    := FALSE;
    rCmdLaserPower_W            := 0.0;
    wAlarmCodeWord2.0           := TRUE;    (* Laser Collimator Overtemperature Trip *)
    bSystemAlarmSummary         := TRUE;
    IF (iMachineState = 40) OR (iMachineState = 30) THEN
        iMachineState           := 70;      (* Initiate controlled deceleration stop *)
    END_IF;
END_IF;

(* Laser Assist Gas Starvation Interlock (prevents foil burning and optical window contamination) *)
IF (rLaserAssistGasPress_bar < c_rMinAssistGasPressure_bar) AND (bLaserEmissionPermissive) THEN
    bLaserEmissionPermissive    := FALSE;
    rCmdLaserPower_W            := 0.0;
    wAlarmCodeWord2.1           := TRUE;    (* Assist Gas Pressure Low Trip *)
    bSystemAlarmSummary         := TRUE;
    IF (iMachineState = 40) THEN
        iMachineState           := 70;
    END_IF;
END_IF;

(* Chiller Coolant Loss Interlock *)
IF (rLaserChillerFlow_Lmin < c_rMinChillerFlow_Lmin) AND (bLaserEmissionPermissive) THEN
    bLaserEmissionPermissive    := FALSE;
    rCmdLaserPower_W            := 0.0;
    wAlarmCodeWord2.2           := TRUE;    (* Laser Chiller Flow Loss *)
    bSystemAlarmSummary         := TRUE;
    IF (iMachineState = 40) THEN
        iMachineState           := 70;
    END_IF;
END_IF;
(*
========================================================================================================================
  LAYER 2: TRIPLE MODULAR REDUNDANCY (2oo3 TMR) PRE-SLITTER WEB TENSION VOTING CORE
========================================================================================================================
*)
(* Plausibility & Physical Boundary Validation (0.0 N to 60.0 N dynamic range) *)
bTMR_ChanA_Valid := (rLoadCellTMR_A_N >= 0.0) AND (rLoadCellTMR_A_N <= 60.0);
bTMR_ChanB_Valid := (rLoadCellTMR_B_N >= 0.0) AND (rLoadCellTMR_B_N <= 60.0);
bTMR_ChanC_Valid := (rLoadCellTMR_C_N >= 0.0) AND (rLoadCellTMR_C_N <= 60.0);

(* Evaluate Pairwise Absolute Deviations *)
rDiff_AB := ABS(rLoadCellTMR_A_N - rLoadCellTMR_B_N);
rDiff_BC := ABS(rLoadCellTMR_B_N - rLoadCellTMR_C_N);
rDiff_CA := ABS(rLoadCellTMR_C_N - rLoadCellTMR_A_N);

(* 2oo3 Voting Decision Engine *)
IF bTMR_ChanA_Valid AND bTMR_ChanB_Valid AND bTMR_ChanC_Valid THEN
    IF (rDiff_AB <= c_rTMR_MaxDiscrepancy_N) AND (rDiff_BC <= c_rTMR_MaxDiscrepancy_N) AND (rDiff_CA <= c_rTMR_MaxDiscrepancy_N) THEN
        (* Case 2.1: Full Three-Channel Consensus - Compute Median without dynamic memory *)
        rVotedWebTension_N  := rLoadCellTMR_A_N + rLoadCellTMR_B_N + rLoadCellTMR_C_N
                               - MIN(rLoadCellTMR_A_N, MIN(rLoadCellTMR_B_N, rLoadCellTMR_C_N))
                               - MAX(rLoadCellTMR_A_N, MAX(rLoadCellTMR_B_N, rLoadCellTMR_C_N));
        iHealthySensorCount := 3;
        bDegradedModeActive := FALSE;
        wAlarmCodeWord1.4   := FALSE;   (* Clear TMR drift alarm *)

    ELSIF (rDiff_BC <= c_rTMR_MaxDiscrepancy_N) AND (rDiff_AB > c_rTMR_MaxDiscrepancy_N) THEN
        (* Case 2.2: Channel A Drift - Quarantine Channel A, Degrade to 1oo2 of (B, C) *)
        rVotedWebTension_N  := (rLoadCellTMR_B_N + rLoadCellTMR_C_N) * 0.5;
        iHealthySensorCount := 2;
        bDegradedModeActive := TRUE;
        wAlarmCodeWord1.4   := TRUE;    (* TMR Sensor Drift: Channel A quarantined *)

    ELSIF (rDiff_CA <= c_rTMR_MaxDiscrepancy_N) AND (rDiff_AB > c_rTMR_MaxDiscrepancy_N) THEN
        (* Case 2.3: Channel B Drift - Quarantine Channel B, Degrade to 1oo2 of (A, C) *)
        rVotedWebTension_N  := (rLoadCellTMR_A_N + rLoadCellTMR_C_N) * 0.5;
        iHealthySensorCount := 2;
        bDegradedModeActive := TRUE;
        wAlarmCodeWord1.4   := TRUE;    (* TMR Sensor Drift: Channel B quarantined *)

    ELSIF (rDiff_AB <= c_rTMR_MaxDiscrepancy_N) AND (rDiff_BC > c_rTMR_MaxDiscrepancy_N) THEN
        (* Case 2.4: Channel C Drift - Quarantine Channel C, Degrade to 1oo2 of (A, B) *)
        rVotedWebTension_N  := (rLoadCellTMR_A_N + rLoadCellTMR_B_N) * 0.5;
        iHealthySensorCount := 2;
        bDegradedModeActive := TRUE;
        wAlarmCodeWord1.4   := TRUE;    (* TMR Sensor Drift: Channel C quarantined *)

    ELSE
        (* Case 2.5: Multi-Channel Divergence - Total Loss of Consensus *)
        rVotedWebTension_N  := (rLoadCellTMR_A_N + rLoadCellTMR_B_N + rLoadCellTMR_C_N) / 3.0;
        iHealthySensorCount := 0;
        wAlarmCodeWord1.5   := TRUE;    (* Critical: Total TMR Consensus Lost *)
        bSystemAlarmSummary := TRUE;
        iMachineState       := 999;     (* Trip immediately to failsafe abort *)
    END_IF;

ELSIF bTMR_ChanB_Valid AND bTMR_ChanC_Valid THEN
    rVotedWebTension_N      := (rLoadCellTMR_B_N + rLoadCellTMR_C_N) * 0.5;
    iHealthySensorCount     := 2;
    bDegradedModeActive     := TRUE;
    wAlarmCodeWord1.4       := TRUE;

ELSIF bTMR_ChanA_Valid AND bTMR_ChanC_Valid THEN
    rVotedWebTension_N      := (rLoadCellTMR_A_N + rLoadCellTMR_C_N) * 0.5;
    iHealthySensorCount     := 2;
    bDegradedModeActive     := TRUE;
    wAlarmCodeWord1.4       := TRUE;

ELSIF bTMR_ChanA_Valid AND bTMR_ChanB_Valid THEN
    rVotedWebTension_N      := (rLoadCellTMR_A_N + rLoadCellTMR_B_N) * 0.5;
    iHealthySensorCount     := 2;
    bDegradedModeActive     := TRUE;
    wAlarmCodeWord1.4       := TRUE;

ELSE
    (* Total Sensor Bank Loss *)
    rVotedWebTension_N      := rWebTensionSetpoint_N;
    iHealthySensorCount     := 0;
    wAlarmCodeWord1.5       := TRUE;
    bSystemAlarmSummary     := TRUE;
    iMachineState           := 999;
END_IF;

(* Instantaneous Web Break & Web Rupture Detection *)
IF (iMachineState >= 30) AND (iMachineState <= 60) THEN
    IF (rVotedWebTension_N < c_rMinAllowableTension_N) AND (rMainCapstanSpeedFb_mpmin > 30.0) THEN
        wAlarmCodeWord1.1   := TRUE;    (* Foil Web Break Detected *)
        bSystemAlarmSummary := TRUE;
        iMachineState       := 999;
    ELSIF (rVotedWebTension_N > c_rMaxAllowableTension_N) THEN
        wAlarmCodeWord1.2   := TRUE;    (* Foil Over-Tension Plastic Necking Trip *)
        bSystemAlarmSummary := TRUE;
        iMachineState       := 999;
    END_IF;
END_IF;
(*
========================================================================================================================
  LAYER 3: FOIL CONTINUUM RHEOLOGY & REAL-TIME SPOOL POLAR INERTIA ESTIMATION
========================================================================================================================
*)
(* Foil Material Physical Configuration *)
IF iFoilMaterialSelect = 0 THEN
    (* Cold-Rolled Ultra-Thin Anode Copper Foil (Cu) *)
    rFoilDensity_kg_m3      := 8960.0;  (* kg/m^3 *)
ELSE
    (* High-Purity Cathode Aluminum Foil (Al) *)
    rFoilDensity_kg_m3      := 2700.0;  (* kg/m^3 *)
END_IF;

(* Cross-Sectional Geometry & Longitudinal Stiffness *)
rCalculatedArea_m2          := (rFoilWidth_mm * 1.0E-3) * (rFoilThickness_um * 1.0E-6);
IF rCalculatedArea_m2 > 1.0E-9 THEN
    rEffectiveStiffness_EA_N    := (rFoilYoungsModulus_GPa * 1.0E9) * rCalculatedArea_m2;
    rFoilStress_MPa             := (rVotedWebTension_N / rCalculatedArea_m2) * 1.0E-6;
    rCalculatedWebStrain_pct    := (rVotedWebTension_N / rEffectiveStiffness_EA_N) * 100.0;
    IF rFoilYieldStrength_MPa > 10.0 THEN
        rYieldSafetyMargin_pct  := (1.0 - (rFoilStress_MPa / rFoilYieldStrength_MPa)) * 100.0;
    ELSE
        rYieldSafetyMargin_pct  := 50.0;
    END_IF;
ELSE
    rCalculatedArea_m2          := 2.925E-6;
    rEffectiveStiffness_EA_N    := 321750.0;
    rFoilStress_MPa             := 0.0;
    rCalculatedWebStrain_pct    := 0.0;
    rYieldSafetyMargin_pct      := 100.0;
END_IF;

(* Online Spool Radius Tracking with First-Order Digital Filtering *)
IF (rUnwindRollDiameter_mm >= 76.2) AND (rUnwindRollDiameter_mm <= 1200.0) THEN
    rFilteredUnwindRadius_m := (0.005 * (rUnwindRollDiameter_mm * 0.5 * 1.0E-3)) + (0.995 * rFilteredUnwindRadius_m);
ELSE
    rFilteredUnwindRadius_m := c_rCoreRadius_m;
END_IF;

IF (rRewindRollDiameter_mm >= 76.2) AND (rRewindRollDiameter_mm <= 1200.0) THEN
    rFilteredRewindRadius_m := (0.005 * (rRewindRollDiameter_mm * 0.5 * 1.0E-3)) + (0.995 * rFilteredRewindRadius_m);
ELSE
    rFilteredRewindRadius_m := c_rCoreRadius_m;
END_IF;

(* Continuous Spool Polar Inertia J(R) Computation *)
rTempCalc := (3.14159265 * 0.5 * rFoilDensity_kg_m3 * (rFoilWidth_mm * 1.0E-3));
rEstimatedUnwindInertia_kgm2 := c_rCoreInertia_kgm2 + (rTempCalc * (EXPT(rFilteredUnwindRadius_m, 4) - EXPT(c_rCoreRadius_m, 4)));
rEstimatedRewindInertia_kgm2 := c_rCoreInertia_kgm2 + (rTempCalc * (EXPT(rFilteredRewindRadius_m, 4) - EXPT(c_rCoreRadius_m, 4)));

(* Numerical Differentiation of Line Acceleration *)
rWebAcceleration_mps2 := ((rMainCapstanSpeedFb_mpmin - rPrevLineSpeed_mpmin) / (60.0 * c_rSamplingPeriod_s));
rPrevLineSpeed_mpmin  := rMainCapstanSpeedFb_mpmin;

(* Feedforward Inertia & Dynamic Back-Tension Torque Synthesis *)
IF rFilteredUnwindRadius_m > 0.030 THEN
    rInertiaFeedforwardTorque_Nm := (rEstimatedUnwindInertia_kgm2 * (rWebAcceleration_mps2 / rFilteredUnwindRadius_m)) / c_rGearRatioUnwind;
    rTensionTensionTorque_Nm     := (rWebTensionSetpoint_N * rFilteredUnwindRadius_m) / c_rGearRatioUnwind;
ELSE
    rInertiaFeedforwardTorque_Nm := 0.0;
    rTensionTensionTorque_Nm     := 0.0;
END_IF;
(*
========================================================================================================================
  LAYER 4: DECOUPLED DANCER SERVO POSITION REGULATION & PNEUMATIC BIAS CONTROL
========================================================================================================================
*)
(* Raw Dancer Displacement Filtering: Low-pass filter to reject structural machine vibration *)
rDancerPos_Raw_mm  := rDancerPosition_mm;
rDancerPos_Filt_mm := (0.15 * rDancerPos_Raw_mm) + (0.85 * rDancerPos_Filt_mm);

(* Dancer Velocity Estimation: dx_d/dt *)
rDancerVel_Calc_m_s := ((rDancerPos_Filt_mm - rDancerPos_Prev_mm) * 1.0E-3) / c_rSamplingPeriod_s;
rDancerPos_Prev_mm  := rDancerPos_Filt_mm;
rDancerVel_Filt_m_s := (0.20 * rDancerVel_Calc_m_s) + (0.80 * rDancerVel_Filt_m_s);

(* Decoupled Web Velocity Feedforward Trim *)
(* When dancer moves downward (+dx_d/dt), web is stored; unwind speed must surge to compensate *)
rDancerServoTrimVelocity_mpmin := (2.0 * rDancerVel_Filt_m_s * 60.0) + (1.25 * rDancerPos_Filt_mm);

(* Dancer Pneumatic Cylinder Force Balancing:
   F_cyl = 2 * T_ref * cos(theta) + m_d * d^2(x_d)/dt^2 + b_d * dx_d/dt *)
IF c_rDancerPistonArea_m2 > 1.0E-6 THEN
    rDancerPneumaticFeedforward_bar := ((2.0 * rWebTensionSetpoint_N) + (c_rDancerArmMass_kg * 9.81)) / (c_rDancerPistonArea_m2 * 1.0E5);
    IF rDancerPneumaticFeedforward_bar > 6.0 THEN
        rDancerPneumaticFeedforward_bar := 6.0;
    ELSIF rDancerPneumaticFeedforward_bar < 0.5 THEN
        rDancerPneumaticFeedforward_bar := 0.5;
    END_IF;
END_IF;

(* Voice-Coil High-Frequency Micro-Trim (suppresses micro-flutter < 50 Hz) *)
rCmdDancerVoiceCoil_N := -(18.5 * rDancerVel_Filt_m_s) - (0.85 * (rVotedWebTension_N - rWebTensionSetpoint_N));
IF rCmdDancerVoiceCoil_N > 25.0 THEN
    rCmdDancerVoiceCoil_N := 25.0;
ELSIF rCmdDancerVoiceCoil_N < -25.0 THEN
    rCmdDancerVoiceCoil_N := -25.0;
END_IF;

(* Dancer Stroke Travel Boundary Limits *)
IF (ABS(rDancerPos_Filt_mm) > 42.0) THEN
    wAlarmCodeWord1.3   := TRUE;    (* Dancer Travel Excursion Warning *)
    IF (ABS(rDancerPos_Filt_mm) > 48.0) AND (iMachineState = 40) THEN
        wAlarmCodeWord1.0   := TRUE;(* Hard Endstop Reached: Initiate Stop *)
        iMachineState       := 70;
    END_IF;
ELSE
    wAlarmCodeWord1.3   := FALSE;
END_IF;
(*
========================================================================================================================
  LAYER 5: DISCRETE-TIME STATE-SPACE OBSERVER & MPC QUADRATIC COST OPTIMIZATION KERNEL
========================================================================================================================
*)
(* Construct Measurement Error State Vector *)
aState_x[1] := rVotedWebTension_N - rWebTensionSetpoint_N;             (* x1: Pre-slitter tension error [N] *)
aState_x[2] := rDancerPos_Filt_mm * 1.0E-3;                            (* x2: Dancer displacement [m] *)
aState_x[3] := rDancerVel_Filt_m_s;                                    (* x3: Dancer velocity [m/s] *)
aState_x[4] := rPostSlitZoneTension_N - rWebTensionSetpoint_N;         (* x4: Post-slitter tension error [N] *)
aState_x[5] := (rMainCapstanSpeedFb_mpmin - rLineSpeedSetpoint_mpmin) / 60.0; (* x5: Capstan speed error [m/s] *)
aState_x[6] := (rLaserSlitterBurr_um - 0.85);                          (* x6: Laser edge burr deviation [um] *)

(* Update Reference Vector *)
aMPC_Setpoint_r[1] := 0.0;  (* Tension error target = 0 N *)
aMPC_Setpoint_r[2] := 0.0;  (* Dancer centered = 0 mm *)
aMPC_Setpoint_r[3] := 0.0;  (* Post-slit error target = 0 N *)
aMPC_Setpoint_r[4] := 0.0;  (* Burr deviation target = 0 um *)

(* State-Space Observer: Propagate x_next = A_d * x + B_d * u *)
FOR idx_i := 1 TO 6 DO
    rMatAccumulator := 0.0;
    FOR idx_j := 1 TO 6 DO
        rMatAccumulator := rMatAccumulator + (aA_mat[idx_i, idx_j] * aState_x[idx_j]);
    END_FOR;
    FOR idx_j := 1 TO 4 DO
        rMatAccumulator := rMatAccumulator + (aB_mat[idx_i, idx_j] * aControl_u[idx_j]);
    END_FOR;
    aState_x_next[idx_i] := rMatAccumulator;
END_FOR;

(* Output Reconstruction: y = C_d * x *)
FOR idx_i := 1 TO 4 DO
    rMatAccumulator := 0.0;
    FOR idx_j := 1 TO 6 DO
        rMatAccumulator := rMatAccumulator + (aC_mat[idx_i, idx_j] * aState_x[idx_j]);
    END_FOR;
    aOutput_y[idx_i] := rMatAccumulator;
END_FOR;

(* Compute Instantaneous Quadratic Tracking Cost J = e^T * Q * e + delta_u^T * R * delta_u *)
rMPC_CostValue := 0.0;
FOR idx_i := 1 TO 4 DO
    rTempCalc := aOutput_y[idx_i] - aMPC_Setpoint_r[idx_i];
    rMPC_CostValue := rMPC_CostValue + (aMPC_Q_diag[idx_i] * rTempCalc * rTempCalc);
    rTempCalc := aControl_u[idx_i] - aControl_u_prev[idx_i];
    rMPC_CostValue := rMPC_CostValue + (aMPC_R_diag[idx_i] * rTempCalc * rTempCalc);
END_FOR;

(* Projected Gradient Descent Solver (8 Iterations in Deterministic Real-Time) *)
FOR iMPC_Iter := 1 TO 8 DO
    (* Gradient Evaluation: g = Q * (y - r) + R * (u - u_prev) *)
    FOR idx_i := 1 TO 4 DO
        aMPC_Grad_g[idx_i] := (aMPC_Q_diag[idx_i] * (aOutput_y[idx_i] - aMPC_Setpoint_r[idx_i]))
                             + (aMPC_R_diag[idx_i] * (aControl_u[idx_i] - aControl_u_prev[idx_i]));
    END_FOR;

    (* Projected Actuator Gradient Descent Step *)
    aControl_u[1] := aControl_u[1] - (rMPC_StepSize_alpha * aMPC_Grad_g[1]);
    aControl_u[2] := aControl_u[2] - (rMPC_StepSize_alpha * aMPC_Grad_g[2]);
    aControl_u[3] := aControl_u[3] - (rMPC_StepSize_alpha * aMPC_Grad_g[3]);
    aControl_u[4] := aControl_u[4] - (rMPC_StepSize_alpha * aMPC_Grad_g[4]);

    (* Hard Box Constraint Saturation *)
    (* u1: Unwind Torque Trim [-45.0 .. +45.0 Nm] *)

         B_ud= | 0.0425   -0.0085    0.0010 |
               | 0.0150   -0.0780   -0.0250 |
               |-0.0280    0.0190    0.0020 |
               | 0.0080    0.0120   -0.0580 |

         B_wd= | 0.0120    0.0045 |
               | 0.0015    0.0082 |
               |-0.0035   -0.0012 |
               | 0.0020    0.0095 |

         C_d = Identity(4x4)
         D_d = Zero(4x3)

  6. MODEL PREDICTIVE CONTROL (MPC) QUADRATIC COST APPROXIMATION:
     Cost Functional: J(Delta u) = 1/2 * Delta u^T * H_mpc * Delta u + g_mpc^T * Delta u
     subject to: Delta u_min <= Delta u <= Delta u_max, and u_min <= u(k-1) + Delta u <= u_max
     Hessian matrix H_mpc is precomputed from condensed prediction matrices:
         H_mpc = | 2.450  -0.320   0.085 |
                 |-0.320   3.120  -0.210 |
                 | 0.085  -0.210   1.950 |
     The online ST kernel solves this quadratic subproblem at each 200 ms scan using projected gradient iterations
     with dynamic step size acceleration and constraint projection.

  7. TRIPLE MODULAR REDUNDANCY (2oo3 TMR) SENSOR ENGINES:
     Implemented for two mission-critical physical feedback loops:
     - TMR Engine 1: MOF Bed Core Thermocouples (Channels A, B, C)
     - TMR Engine 2: Remineralized Potable Water Electrical Conductivity (Channels A, B, C)
     Features dynamic median voting, inter-channel discrepancy detection, automated single-sensor quarantine,
     bumpless fallback to 1oo2 averaging, and fail-safe trip on consensus loss.
========================================================================================================================
*)
