(* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
   LAYER 1: SIL-3 HARDWIRED SAFETY INTERLOCKS & IMMEDIATE TRIP HIERARCHY
   --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* Condition 1.1: E-Stop Circuit Loss *)
IF NOT bEStopOk THEN
    (* Immediate De-Energization of all Thermal and High-Vacuum Drivers *)
    rCmdSolarHTFModValve_pct            := 0.0;
    rCmdAuxHeaterPower_kW               := 0.0;
    rCmdVacuumPumpSpeed_rpm             := 0.0;
    rCmdCondenserCoolantPump_pct        := 0.0;
    rCmdHeatRecoveryDiverter_pct        := 0.0;
    rCmdPeristalticDosingRate_Lh        := 0.0;
    bAdsorptionIntakeDamperCmd          := FALSE;
    bAdsorptionExhaustDamperCmd         := FALSE;
    bDesorptionVacuumIsolationValveCmd  := FALSE;
    bCondensateDrainSolenoidCmd         := FALSE;
    bProductWaterDivertValveCmd         := FALSE; (* Force product diversion to reject *)
    bUVDisinfectionReactorCmd           := FALSE;
    bVacuumChamberVentValveCmd          := TRUE;  (* Safely vent vacuum to atmosphere *)

    wAlarmWord1.0                       := TRUE;  (* E-Stop Trip Bit *)
    bSystemAlarmSummary                 := TRUE;
    wSystemStatusWord                   := 16#F001;
    iState                              := 999;   (* Jump immediately to failsafe emergency shutdown *)
    iActiveStateIndex                   := 999;
    RETURN;
END_IF;

(* Condition 1.2: Solar Thermal HTF Overtemperature Protection *)
IF (rSolarHTFSupplyTemp_degC > c_rMaxHTFSupplyTemp_degC) THEN
    rCmdSolarHTFModValve_pct := 0.0;
    rCmdAuxHeaterPower_kW    := 0.0;
    wAlarmWord1.1            := TRUE; (* Solar HTF Overtemp *)
    bSystemAlarmSummary      := TRUE;
    iState                   := 999;
END_IF;

(* Condition 1.3: MOF-303 Sorbent Matrix Critical Thermal Limit *)
IF (rMOFBedCoreTemp_TMR_A_degC > c_rMaxBedTemperatureSafe_degC) OR
   (rMOFBedCoreTemp_TMR_B_degC > c_rMaxBedTemperatureSafe_degC) OR
   (rMOFBedCoreTemp_TMR_C_degC > c_rMaxBedTemperatureSafe_degC) THEN
    rCmdSolarHTFModValve_pct := 0.0;
    rCmdAuxHeaterPower_kW    := 0.0;
    wAlarmWord1.2            := TRUE; (* MOF Core Over-Temperature *)
    bSystemAlarmSummary      := TRUE;
    iState                   := 999;
END_IF;

(* Condition 1.4: Vacuum Desorption Chamber Overpressure During Desorption *)
IF (iState = 30) AND (rDesorptionChamberPress_mbar > 350.0) THEN
    rCmdAuxHeaterPower_kW := 0.0;
    wAlarmWord1.3         := TRUE; (* Chamber Vacuum Loss / Overpressure *)
    bSystemAlarmSummary   := TRUE;
END_IF;

(* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
   LAYER 2: TRIPLE MODULAR REDUNDANCY (2oo3 TMR) SENSOR CONSENSUS ENGINES
   --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* -------------------------------------------------------------
   TMR ENGINE 1: MOF Bed Core Temperature RTD Bank (Channels A, B, C)
   ------------------------------------------------------------- *)
bTMR1_ChanA_Valid := (rMOFBedCoreTemp_TMR_A_degC >= c_rTMR1_MinRange_degC) AND
                     (rMOFBedCoreTemp_TMR_A_degC <= c_rTMR1_MaxRange_degC);
bTMR1_ChanB_Valid := (rMOFBedCoreTemp_TMR_B_degC >= c_rTMR1_MinRange_degC) AND
                     (rMOFBedCoreTemp_TMR_B_degC <= c_rTMR1_MaxRange_degC);
bTMR1_ChanC_Valid := (rMOFBedCoreTemp_TMR_C_degC >= c_rTMR1_MinRange_degC) AND
                     (rMOFBedCoreTemp_TMR_C_degC <= c_rTMR1_MaxRange_degC);

rTMR1_Diff_AB := ABS(rMOFBedCoreTemp_TMR_A_degC - rMOFBedCoreTemp_TMR_B_degC);
rTMR1_Diff_BC := ABS(rMOFBedCoreTemp_TMR_B_degC - rMOFBedCoreTemp_TMR_C_degC);
rTMR1_Diff_CA := ABS(rMOFBedCoreTemp_TMR_C_degC - rMOFBedCoreTemp_TMR_A_degC);

IF bTMR1_ChanA_Valid AND bTMR1_ChanB_Valid AND bTMR1_ChanC_Valid THEN
    IF (rTMR1_Diff_AB <= c_rTMR1_MaxDeviation_degC) AND
       (rTMR1_Diff_BC <= c_rTMR1_MaxDeviation_degC) AND
       (rTMR1_Diff_CA <= c_rTMR1_MaxDeviation_degC) THEN
        (* Standard Median 2oo3 Voting *)
        rVotedMOFTemp_degC := rMOFBedCoreTemp_TMR_A_degC + rMOFBedCoreTemp_TMR_B_degC + rMOFBedCoreTemp_TMR_C_degC
                              - MIN(rMOFBedCoreTemp_TMR_A_degC, MIN(rMOFBedCoreTemp_TMR_B_degC, rMOFBedCoreTemp_TMR_C_degC))
                              - MAX(rMOFBedCoreTemp_TMR_A_degC, MAX(rMOFBedCoreTemp_TMR_B_degC, rMOFBedCoreTemp_TMR_C_degC));
        iTMR1_HealthyCount  := 3;
        wAlarmWord2.0       := FALSE;

    ELSIF (rTMR1_Diff_BC <= c_rTMR1_MaxDeviation_degC) AND (rTMR1_Diff_AB > c_rTMR1_MaxDeviation_degC) THEN
        (* Channel A drifted: Quarantine A, vote on 1oo2 of (B, C) *)
        rVotedMOFTemp_degC := (rMOFBedCoreTemp_TMR_B_degC + rMOFBedCoreTemp_TMR_C_degC) * 0.5;
        iTMR1_HealthyCount := 2;
        wAlarmWord2.0      := TRUE; (* Sensor A Drifted *)

    ELSIF (rTMR1_Diff_CA <= c_rTMR1_MaxDeviation_degC) AND (rTMR1_Diff_BC > c_rTMR1_MaxDeviation_degC) THEN
        (* Channel B drifted: Quarantine B, vote on 1oo2 of (A, C) *)
        rVotedMOFTemp_degC := (rMOFBedCoreTemp_TMR_A_degC + rMOFBedCoreTemp_TMR_C_degC) * 0.5;
        iTMR1_HealthyCount := 2;
        wAlarmWord2.0      := TRUE; (* Sensor B Drifted *)

    ELSIF (rTMR1_Diff_AB <= c_rTMR1_MaxDeviation_degC) AND (rTMR1_Diff_CA > c_rTMR1_MaxDeviation_degC) THEN
        (* Channel C drifted: Quarantine C, vote on 1oo2 of (A, B) *)
        rVotedMOFTemp_degC := (rMOFBedCoreTemp_TMR_A_degC + rMOFBedCoreTemp_TMR_B_degC) * 0.5;
        iTMR1_HealthyCount := 2;
        wAlarmWord2.0      := TRUE; (* Sensor C Drifted *)

    ELSE
        (* Complete Consensus Loss: Multi-sensor divergence *)
        rVotedMOFTemp_degC  := (rMOFBedCoreTemp_TMR_A_degC + rMOFBedCoreTemp_TMR_B_degC + rMOFBedCoreTemp_TMR_C_degC) / 3.0;
        iTMR1_HealthyCount  := 0;
        wAlarmWord1.4       := TRUE; (* TMR1 Total Consensus Loss *)
        bSystemAlarmSummary := TRUE;
        iState              := 999;
    END_IF;

ELSIF bTMR1_ChanB_Valid AND bTMR1_ChanC_Valid THEN
    rVotedMOFTemp_degC := (rMOFBedCoreTemp_TMR_B_degC + rMOFBedCoreTemp_TMR_C_degC) * 0.5;
    iTMR1_HealthyCount := 2;
    wAlarmWord2.0      := TRUE;
ELSIF bTMR1_ChanA_Valid AND bTMR1_ChanC_Valid THEN
    rVotedMOFTemp_degC := (rMOFBedCoreTemp_TMR_A_degC + rMOFBedCoreTemp_TMR_C_degC) * 0.5;
    iTMR1_HealthyCount := 2;
    wAlarmWord2.0      := TRUE;
ELSIF bTMR1_ChanA_Valid AND bTMR1_ChanB_Valid THEN
    rVotedMOFTemp_degC := (rMOFBedCoreTemp_TMR_A_degC + rMOFBedCoreTemp_TMR_B_degC) * 0.5;
    iTMR1_HealthyCount := 2;
    wAlarmWord2.0      := TRUE;
ELSE
    rVotedMOFTemp_degC  := 25.0;
    iTMR1_HealthyCount  := 0;
    wAlarmWord1.4       := TRUE;
    bSystemAlarmSummary := TRUE;
    iState              := 999;
END_IF;

(* -------------------------------------------------------------
   TMR ENGINE 2: Potable Water Electrical Conductivity (Channels A, B, C)
   ------------------------------------------------------------- *)
bTMR2_ChanA_Valid := (rConductivityPostMineral_TMR_A_uScm >= c_rTMR2_MinRange_uScm) AND
                     (rConductivityPostMineral_TMR_A_uScm <= c_rTMR2_MaxRange_uScm);
bTMR2_ChanB_Valid := (rConductivityPostMineral_TMR_B_uScm >= c_rTMR2_MinRange_uScm) AND
                     (rConductivityPostMineral_TMR_B_uScm <= c_rTMR2_MaxRange_uScm);
bTMR2_ChanC_Valid := (rConductivityPostMineral_TMR_C_uScm >= c_rTMR2_MinRange_uScm) AND
                     (rConductivityPostMineral_TMR_C_uScm <= c_rTMR2_MaxRange_uScm);

rTMR2_Diff_AB := ABS(rConductivityPostMineral_TMR_A_uScm - rConductivityPostMineral_TMR_B_uScm);
rTMR2_Diff_BC := ABS(rConductivityPostMineral_TMR_B_uScm - rConductivityPostMineral_TMR_C_uScm);
rTMR2_Diff_CA := ABS(rConductivityPostMineral_TMR_C_uScm - rConductivityPostMineral_TMR_A_uScm);

IF bTMR2_ChanA_Valid AND bTMR2_ChanB_Valid AND bTMR2_ChanC_Valid THEN
    IF (rTMR2_Diff_AB <= c_rTMR2_MaxDeviation_uScm) AND
       (rTMR2_Diff_BC <= c_rTMR2_MaxDeviation_uScm) AND
       (rTMR2_Diff_CA <= c_rTMR2_MaxDeviation_uScm) THEN
        rVotedMineralConductivity_uScm := rConductivityPostMineral_TMR_A_uScm + rConductivityPostMineral_TMR_B_uScm + rConductivityPostMineral_TMR_C_uScm
                                          - MIN(rConductivityPostMineral_TMR_A_uScm, MIN(rConductivityPostMineral_TMR_B_uScm, rConductivityPostMineral_TMR_C_uScm))
                                          - MAX(rConductivityPostMineral_TMR_A_uScm, MAX(rConductivityPostMineral_TMR_B_uScm, rConductivityPostMineral_TMR_C_uScm));
        iTMR2_HealthyCount := 3;
        wAlarmWord2.1      := FALSE;

    ELSIF (rTMR2_Diff_BC <= c_rTMR2_MaxDeviation_uScm) AND (rTMR2_Diff_AB > c_rTMR2_MaxDeviation_uScm) THEN
        rVotedMineralConductivity_uScm := (rConductivityPostMineral_TMR_B_uScm + rConductivityPostMineral_TMR_C_uScm) * 0.5;
        iTMR2_HealthyCount := 2;
        wAlarmWord2.1      := TRUE;

    ELSIF (rTMR2_Diff_CA <= c_rTMR2_MaxDeviation_uScm) AND (rTMR2_Diff_BC > c_rTMR2_MaxDeviation_uScm) THEN
        rVotedMineralConductivity_uScm := (rConductivityPostMineral_TMR_A_uScm + rConductivityPostMineral_TMR_C_uScm) * 0.5;
        iTMR2_HealthyCount := 2;
        wAlarmWord2.1      := TRUE;

    ELSIF (rTMR2_Diff_AB <= c_rTMR2_MaxDeviation_uScm) AND (rTMR2_Diff_CA > c_rTMR2_MaxDeviation_uScm) THEN
        rVotedMineralConductivity_uScm := (rConductivityPostMineral_TMR_A_uScm + rConductivityPostMineral_TMR_B_uScm) * 0.5;
        iTMR2_HealthyCount := 2;
        wAlarmWord2.1      := TRUE;

    ELSE
        rVotedMineralConductivity_uScm := (rConductivityPostMineral_TMR_A_uScm + rConductivityPostMineral_TMR_B_uScm + rConductivityPostMineral_TMR_C_uScm) / 3.0;
        iTMR2_HealthyCount := 0;
        wAlarmWord2.2      := TRUE; (* TMR2 Consensus Lost: Force divert *)
        bProductWaterDivertValveCmd := FALSE;
    END_IF;
ELSE
    rVotedMineralConductivity_uScm := 10.0;
    iTMR2_HealthyCount := 0;
    wAlarmWord2.2      := TRUE;
    bProductWaterDivertValveCmd := FALSE;
END_IF;

bDegradedSensorMode := (iTMR1_HealthyCount = 2) OR (iTMR2_HealthyCount = 2);

(* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
   LAYER 3: THERMODYNAMIC SIPS ADSORPTION / DESORPTION KINETIC ESTIMATION
   --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
rBedTemp_Kelvin := rVotedMOFTemp_degC + 273.15;

(* Magnus-Tetens saturation water vapor pressure calculation *)
IF rVotedMOFTemp_degC >= 0.0 THEN
    rSaturationPressure_mbar := 6.1078 * EXPT(10.0, (7.5 * rVotedMOFTemp_degC) / (237.3 + rVotedMOFTemp_degC));
ELSE
    rSaturationPressure_mbar := 6.1078 * EXPT(10.0, (9.5 * rVotedMOFTemp_degC) / (265.5 + rVotedMOFTemp_degC));
END_IF;

(* Water vapor pressure in sorption reactor *)
IF (iState = 10) THEN
    (* Adsorption: Open to ambient air *)
    rWaterVaporPressure_mbar := rSaturationPressure_mbar * (rAmbientHumidity_pctRH / 100.0);
ELSE
    (* Desorption under vacuum stripping: Bound by chamber total pressure *)
    rWaterVaporPressure_mbar := MIN(rDesorptionChamberPress_mbar, rSaturationPressure_mbar);
END_IF;

(* Sips Temperature-Dependent Affinity Constant b(T) *)
rSipsAffinity_b := c_rb0_mbar * EXP( (c_rQst_kJkg * c_rMolarMassWater_kgmol * 1000.0) / (c_rRgas_JmolK * rBedTemp_Kelvin) );

(* Dimensionless pressure potential: (b * P_vap)^n *)
rDimensionlessPressureTerm := rSipsAffinity_b * rWaterVaporPressure_mbar;
IF rDimensionlessPressureTerm > 0.001 THEN
    rDimensionlessPressureTerm := EXPT(rDimensionlessPressureTerm, c_rSipsExponent_n);
    rEquilibriumLoading_g_kg   := c_rqmax_gkg * ( rDimensionlessPressureTerm / (1.0 + rDimensionlessPressureTerm) );
ELSE
    rEquilibriumLoading_g_kg   := 5.0;
END_IF;

(* Linear Driving Force (LDF) Dynamic Mass Transfer Rate *)
rMassTransferRate_kgs := 0.0125 * ((rEquilibriumLoading_g_kg - rMOFWaterLoading_g_kg) / 1000.0) * rMOF_Mass_kg;

(* Integrate Moisture Loading across task scan *)
rMOFWaterLoading_g_kg := rMOFWaterLoading_g_kg + ((rMassTransferRate_kgs / rMOF_Mass_kg) * 1000.0 * c_rCyclePeriod_s);
IF rMOFWaterLoading_g_kg > c_rqmax_gkg THEN
    rMOFWaterLoading_g_kg := c_rqmax_gkg;
ELSIF rMOFWaterLoading_g_kg < 0.0 THEN
    rMOFWaterLoading_g_kg := 0.0;
END_IF;

(* Condensate Siphon Volumetric Production Rate *)
rDeltaCondensateLevel_pct := rCondensateCollectorLevel_pct - rPrevCondensateLevel_pct;
rPrevCondensateLevel_pct  := rCondensateCollectorLevel_pct;
IF (rDeltaCondensateLevel_pct > 0.0) AND (rDeltaCondensateLevel_pct < 15.0) THEN
    rInstantaneousProductionRate_Lh := (rDeltaCondensateLevel_pct / 100.0) * rCondensateVolumePerPct_L * (3600.0 / c_rCyclePeriod_s);
    rEstimatedWaterYield_L          := rEstimatedWaterYield_L + ((rDeltaCondensateLevel_pct / 100.0) * rCondensateVolumePerPct_L);
ELSE
    rInstantaneousProductionRate_Lh := 0.0;
END_IF;

(* Latent Heat Recovery Power Calculation: Q_rec = m_dot * c_p * Delta T *)
IF rCondenserCoolantFlow_Lh > 50.0 THEN
    rLatentHeatRecovered_kW := (rCondenserCoolantFlow_Lh / 3600.0) * 3.85 * (* Glycol cp kJ/(kg*K) *)
                               MAX(0.0, (rCondenserCoolantOutletTemp_degC - rCondenserCoolantInletTemp_degC));
ELSE
    rLatentHeatRecovered_kW := 0.0;
END_IF;

(* Germicidal UV-C Dose Calculation: Dose [mJ/cm2] = Intensity [mW/cm2] * Residence_Time [s] *)
IF rTreatedWaterFlow_Lh > 0.5 THEN
    rCalculatedUVDose_mJcm2 := rUVSterilizationIrradiance_mWcm2 * ( (rUVReactorVolume_L / rTreatedWaterFlow_Lh) * 3600.0 );
ELSE
    rCalculatedUVDose_mJcm2 := rUVSterilizationIrradiance_mWcm2 * 120.0;
END_IF;

(* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
   LAYER 4: MODEL PREDICTIVE CONTROL (MPC) QUADRATIC PROGRAMMING KERNEL
   --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* Assemble Deviation State Vector: x = [Delta T_bed, Delta P_desorp, Delta q_loading, Delta T_cond]^T *)
aStateVector_x[1] := rVotedMOFTemp_degC - rRecipeDesorptionTempSP_degC;
aStateVector_x[2] := rDesorptionChamberPress_mbar - rRecipeDesorptionPressSP_mbar;
aStateVector_x[3] := rMOFWaterLoading_g_kg - 250.0;
aStateVector_x[4] := rCondenserSurfaceTemp_degC - rRecipeCondenserTempSP_degC;

(* Assemble Disturbance Vector: w = [Delta Solar_G, Delta T_amb]^T *)
aDisturbance_w[1] := rSolarIrradiance_Wm2 - 800.0;
aDisturbance_w[2] := rAmbientAirTemp_degC - 35.0;

(* Discrete State Predictor: x_hat(k+1) = A_d * x(k) + B_ud * u(k-1) + B_wd * w(k) *)
FOR i := 1 TO 4 DO
    aPredictedState_x[i] := 0.0;
    FOR j := 1 TO 4 DO
        aPredictedState_x[i] := aPredictedState_x[i] + (aMatrix_A_d[i, j] * aStateVector_x[j]);
    END_FOR;
    FOR j := 1 TO 3 DO
        aPredictedState_x[i] := aPredictedState_x[i] + (aMatrix_B_ud[i, j] * aControlInput_u[j]);
    END_FOR;
    FOR j := 1 TO 2 DO
        aPredictedState_x[i] := aPredictedState_x[i] + (aMatrix_B_wd[i, j] * aDisturbance_w[j]);
    END_FOR;
END_FOR;

(* MPC Linear Gradient: g_mpc = B_ud^T * Q * x_hat + R * du_prev *)
(* Diagonal Tracking Weights: Q = diag([1.80, 0.45, 0.20, 1.20]), R = diag([0.50, 0.35, 0.25]) *)
aGradient_g[1] := (aMatrix_B_ud[1, 1] * 1.80 * aPredictedState_x[1]) +
                  (aMatrix_B_ud[2, 1] * 0.45 * aPredictedState_x[2]) +
                  (aMatrix_B_ud[3, 1] * 0.20 * aPredictedState_x[3]) +
                  (aMatrix_B_ud[4, 1] * 1.20 * aPredictedState_x[4]) +
                  (0.50 * aDeltaControl_du[1]);

aGradient_g[2] := (aMatrix_B_ud[1, 2] * 1.80 * aPredictedState_x[1]) +
                  (aMatrix_B_ud[2, 2] * 0.45 * aPredictedState_x[2]) +
                  (aMatrix_B_ud[3, 2] * 0.20 * aPredictedState_x[3]) +
                  (aMatrix_B_ud[4, 2] * 1.20 * aPredictedState_x[4]) +
                  (0.35 * aDeltaControl_du[2]);

aGradient_g[3] := (aMatrix_B_ud[1, 3] * 1.80 * aPredictedState_x[1]) +
                  (aMatrix_B_ud[2, 3] * 0.45 * aPredictedState_x[2]) +
                  (aMatrix_B_ud[3, 3] * 0.20 * aPredictedState_x[3]) +
                  (aMatrix_B_ud[4, 3] * 1.20 * aPredictedState_x[4]) +
                  (0.25 * aDeltaControl_du[3]);

(* Unconstrained Newton Step via Inverse Hessian: Delta u_raw = - H^-1 * g *)
FOR i := 1 TO 3 DO
    aDeltaControl_du[i] := 0.0;
    FOR j := 1 TO 3 DO
        aDeltaControl_du[i] := aDeltaControl_du[i] - (aHessian_Inv[i, j] * aGradient_g[j]);
    END_FOR;
END_FOR;

(* Projected Gradient Iteration Loop for Box Constraints & Actuator Limits *)
FOR k_iter := 1 TO 3 DO
    FOR i := 1 TO 3 DO
        (* Slew Rate Saturation *)
        IF aDeltaControl_du[i] > aDeltaMax[i] THEN
            aDeltaControl_du[i] := aDeltaMax[i];
        ELSIF aDeltaControl_du[i] < aDeltaMin[i] THEN
            aDeltaControl_du[i] := aDeltaMin[i];
        END_IF;

        (* Position Constraint Projection: u_min <= u(k-1) + Delta u <= u_max *)
        rTempCalc1 := aControlInput_u[i] + aDeltaControl_du[i];
        IF rTempCalc1 > aControlMax[i] THEN
            aDeltaControl_du[i] := aControlMax[i] - aControlInput_u[i];
        ELSIF rTempCalc1 < aControlMin[i] THEN
            aDeltaControl_du[i] := aControlMin[i] - aControlInput_u[i];
        END_IF;
    END_FOR;
END_FOR;

(* Compute Quadratic Objective Cost for Telemetry: J = 1/2 * du^T * H * du + g^T * du *)
rMPC_ObjectiveCost := 0.0;
FOR i := 1 TO 3 DO
    rTempCalc2 := 0.0;
    FOR j := 1 TO 3 DO
        rTempCalc2 := rTempCalc2 + (aHessian_H[i, j] * aDeltaControl_du[j]);
    END_FOR;
    rMPC_ObjectiveCost := rMPC_ObjectiveCost + (0.5 * aDeltaControl_du[i] * rTempCalc2) + (aGradient_g[i] * aDeltaControl_du[i]);
END_FOR;

(* Update Actuator Control Positions if in Active Automatic Desorption *)
IF (iState = 30) OR (iState = 40) THEN
    FOR i := 1 TO 3 DO
        aControlInput_u[i] := aControlInput_u[i] + aDeltaControl_du[i];
        IF aControlInput_u[i] > 100.0 THEN
            aControlInput_u[i] := 100.0;
        ELSIF aControlInput_u[i] < 0.0 THEN
            aControlInput_u[i] := 0.0;
        END_IF;
    END_FOR;
ELSE
    (* Control loop managed specifically per state *)
END_IF;

(* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
   LAYER 5: SEQUENTIAL FINITE STATE MACHINE (ISA-88 AWH HARVESTING BATCH PHASES)
   --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
CASE iState OF

    0: (* STATE_STANDBY_IDLE: System quiescent, sensors live, waiting for cycle start *)
        rCmdSolarHTFModValve_pct            := 0.0;
        rCmdAuxHeaterPower_kW               := 0.0;
        rCmdVacuumPumpSpeed_rpm             := 0.0;
        rCmdCondenserCoolantPump_pct        := 0.0;
        rCmdHeatRecoveryDiverter_pct        := 0.0;
        rCmdPeristalticDosingRate_Lh        := 0.0;
        bAdsorptionIntakeDamperCmd          := FALSE;
        bAdsorptionExhaustDamperCmd         := FALSE;
        bDesorptionVacuumIsolationValveCmd  := FALSE;
        bCondensateDrainSolenoidCmd         := FALSE;
        bProductWaterDivertValveCmd         := FALSE;
        bUVDisinfectionReactorCmd           := FALSE;
        bVacuumChamberVentValveCmd          := FALSE;
        bCycleComplete                      := FALSE;
        wSystemStatusWord                   := 16#0001; (* Standby Ready Bit *)

        (* Permissive Check for Automated Diurnal Adsorption Start *)
        IF bEnable AND bEStopOk AND (wAlarmWord1 = 0) AND bStartCycle THEN
            IF rAmbientHumidity_pctRH >= c_rMinAmbientRH_Permissive_pct THEN
                iState := 10; (* Advance to Nocturnal Adsorption Charging *)
            ELSE
                wAlarmWord2.3 := TRUE; (* Ambient RH critically low *)
            END_IF;
        END_IF;

    10: (* STATE_NOCTURNAL_ADSORPTION_CHARGING: Fresh ambient air circulated through MOF bed *)
        rCmdSolarHTFModValve_pct            := 0.0;
        rCmdAuxHeaterPower_kW               := 0.0;
        rCmdVacuumPumpSpeed_rpm             := 0.0;
        rCmdCondenserCoolantPump_pct        := 0.0;
        rCmdHeatRecoveryDiverter_pct        := 0.0;
        rCmdPeristalticDosingRate_Lh        := 0.0;
        bDesorptionVacuumIsolationValveCmd  := FALSE;
        bCondensateDrainSolenoidCmd         := FALSE;
        bProductWaterDivertValveCmd         := FALSE;
        bUVDisinfectionReactorCmd           := FALSE;
        bVacuumChamberVentValveCmd          := TRUE; (* Equalize chamber *)

        (* Open motorized ambient air louvers for low-pressure convective sorption *)
        bAdsorptionIntakeDamperCmd  := TRUE;
        bAdsorptionExhaustDamperCmd := TRUE;
        wSystemStatusWord           := 16#0003; (* Bit 0: Ready, Bit 1: Adsorption Active *)

        (* Sorption Completion Criteria: Loading reaches 85% of theoretical equilibrium or diurnal timer expires *)
        tAdsorptionSoakTimer(IN := TRUE, PT := T#14400S); (* 4-hour max nocturnal soak *)

        IF (rMOFWaterLoading_g_kg >= (rEquilibriumLoading_g_kg * 0.88)) OR
           (rMOFWaterLoading_g_kg >= 280.0) OR
           (rSolarIrradiance_Wm2 > 450.0) (* Diurnal sun rising *) OR
           tAdsorptionSoakTimer.Q THEN

            tAdsorptionSoakTimer(IN := FALSE);
            bAdsorptionIntakeDamperCmd  := FALSE;
            bAdsorptionExhaustDamperCmd := FALSE;
            bVacuumChamberVentValveCmd  := FALSE;
            iState := 20; (* Advance to Chamber Evacuation *)
        END_IF;

    20: (* STATE_PRE_DESORPTION_EVACUATION: Chamber isolation & rough vacuum pumpdown *)
        bAdsorptionIntakeDamperCmd  := FALSE;
        bAdsorptionExhaustDamperCmd := FALSE;
        bVacuumChamberVentValveCmd  := FALSE;
        rCmdSolarHTFModValve_pct    := 0.0;
        rCmdAuxHeaterPower_kW       := 0.0;
        wSystemStatusWord           := 16#0007; (* Bit 2: Evacuation Active *)

        (* Open vacuum line isolation valve and spin up dry scroll pump *)
        bDesorptionVacuumIsolationValveCmd := TRUE;
        rCmdVacuumPumpSpeed_rpm            := 2400.0;

        (* Engage condenser cooling loop in preparation for vapor condensation *)
        rCmdCondenserCoolantPump_pct := 40.0;

        tEvacuationStabilizeTimer(IN := TRUE, PT := T#180S);
        IF (rDesorptionChamberPress_mbar <= (rRecipeDesorptionPressSP_mbar * 1.15)) THEN
            tEvacuationStabilizeTimer(IN := FALSE);
            iState := 30; (* Target vacuum achieved, initiate Solar Thermal Desorption *)
        ELSIF tEvacuationStabilizeTimer.Q THEN
            tEvacuationStabilizeTimer(IN := FALSE);
            wAlarmWord1.5 := TRUE; (* Evacuation Timeout Fault *)
            bSystemAlarmSummary := TRUE;
            iState := 999;
        END_IF;

    30: (* STATE_SOLAR_THERMAL_VACUUM_DESORPTION: Stripping desorption driven by Solar HTF & MPC *)
        bAdsorptionIntakeDamperCmd         := FALSE;
        bAdsorptionExhaustDamperCmd        := FALSE;
        bDesorptionVacuumIsolationValveCmd := TRUE;
        wSystemStatusWord                  := 16#000F; (* Bit 3: Desorption Stripping Active *)

        (* Apply MPC Actuator Outputs *)
        rCmdSolarHTFModValve_pct     := aControlInput_u[1];
        rCmdVacuumPumpSpeed_rpm      := (aControlInput_u[2] / 100.0) * 3600.0;
        rCmdCondenserCoolantPump_pct := aControlInput_u[3];

        (* Auxiliary Electric Trim Heater: Supplements if solar irradiance drops below threshold *)
        IF (rVotedMOFTemp_degC < (rRecipeDesorptionTempSP_degC - 5.0)) AND (rSolarHTFSupplyTemp_degC < 85.0) THEN
            rCmdAuxHeaterPower_kW := 7.5; (* 50% auxiliary thermal boost *)
        ELSIF (rVotedMOFTemp_degC >= rRecipeDesorptionTempSP_degC) THEN
            rCmdAuxHeaterPower_kW := 0.0;
        END_IF;

        (* Condensate Siphon Auto-Transfer to Buffer Reservoir *)
        IF rCondensateCollectorLevel_pct >= 75.0 THEN
            bCondensateDrainSolenoidCmd := TRUE;
        ELSIF rCondensateCollectorLevel_pct <= 15.0 THEN
            bCondensateDrainSolenoidCmd := FALSE;
        END_IF;

        (* Transition Criteria: Sorbent moisture loading depleted (< 35 g/kg) *)
        tDesorptionRunTimer(IN := TRUE, PT := T#7200S); (* 2-hour max desorption plateau *)
        IF (rMOFWaterLoading_g_kg <= 35.0) OR tDesorptionRunTimer.Q THEN
            tDesorptionRunTimer(IN := FALSE);
            rCmdAuxHeaterPower_kW := 0.0;
            iState := 40; (* Advance to Condensation Drain & Latent Recovery Soak *)
        END_IF;

    40: (* STATE_CONDENSATION_LATENT_HEAT_RECOVERY: Final vapor strip & latent heat optimization *)
        wSystemStatusWord                  := 16#001F; (* Bit 4: Condensation Finalizing *)
        rCmdSolarHTFModValve_pct           := 0.0;
        rCmdAuxHeaterPower_kW              := 0.0;
        bDesorptionVacuumIsolationValveCmd := TRUE;

        (* Maintain vacuum stripping pump at idle speed for residual vapor capture *)
        rCmdVacuumPumpSpeed_rpm      := 1200.0;
        rCmdCondenserCoolantPump_pct := 60.0;

        (* Modulate Latent Heat Regenerative Pre-Heat Diverter Valve *)
        IF rLatentHeatRecovered_kW > 1.5 THEN
            rCmdHeatRecoveryDiverter_pct := 85.0;
        ELSE
            rCmdHeatRecoveryDiverter_pct := 20.0;
        END_IF;

        (* Drain remaining condensate to intermediate tank *)
        bCondensateDrainSolenoidCmd := TRUE;

        tStateTimer(IN := TRUE, PT := T#120S);
        IF tStateTimer.Q AND (rCondensateCollectorLevel_pct <= 5.0) THEN
            tStateTimer(IN := FALSE);
            bCondensateDrainSolenoidCmd := FALSE;
            rCmdVacuumPumpSpeed_rpm     := 0.0;
            bDesorptionVacuumIsolationValveCmd := FALSE;
            iState := 50; (* Advance to Bed Regeneration Cooling *)
        END_IF;

    50: (* STATE_POST_DESORPTION_BED_REGENERATION: Vacuum vent & cool-down to reset sorption potential *)
        wSystemStatusWord           := 16#003F; (* Bit 5: Bed Cooling Active *)
        rCmdSolarHTFModValve_pct    := 0.0;
        rCmdAuxHeaterPower_kW       := 0.0;
        rCmdVacuumPumpSpeed_rpm     := 0.0;
        rCmdCondenserCoolantPump_pct:= 0.0;
        rCmdHeatRecoveryDiverter_pct:= 0.0;

        (* Vent vacuum chamber with dry ambient purge *)
        bVacuumChamberVentValveCmd := TRUE;

        tRegenerationCoolTimer(IN := TRUE, PT := T#600S);
        IF (rVotedMOFTemp_degC <= 42.0) OR tRegenerationCoolTimer.Q THEN
            tRegenerationCoolTimer(IN := FALSE);
            bVacuumChamberVentValveCmd := FALSE;
            iState := 60; (* Advance to Potabilization & Remineralization *)
        END_IF;

    60: (* STATE_PERISTALTIC_MINERALIZATION_UV: Inline closed-loop remineralization & UV-C sterilization *)
        wSystemStatusWord := 16#007F; (* Bit 6: Mineralization Active *)

        (* Energize UV-C Germicidal Ballast *)
        bUVDisinfectionReactorCmd := TRUE;

        (* Closed-Loop Digital PI Remineralization Control *)
        rConductivityError_uScm    := rRecipeTargetConductivity_uScm - rVotedMineralConductivity_uScm;
        rConductivityIntegralAccum := rConductivityIntegralAccum + (rConductivityError_uScm * c_rCyclePeriod_s);

        (* Anti-Windup Clamping on PI Integrator *)
        IF rConductivityIntegralAccum > 1200.0 THEN
            rConductivityIntegralAccum := 1200.0;

    (* Spool Mechanical Dimensions & Dynamics Constants *)
    R_SPOOL_CORE_M                  : REAL := 0.040;    (* Spool inner core radius [m] *)
    J_SPOOL_CORE_KG_M2              : REAL := 0.0012;   (* Empty spool core + chuck rotational inertia [kg*m^2] *)

    MIN_TENSION_RUNOUT_N            : REAL := 1.5;      (* Filament break / spool runout trip limit [N] *)

    (* 2oo3 Triple Modular Redundancy Voting Variables *)
    MAX_PYRO_DISCREPANCY_DEGC       : REAL := 18.5;     (* Maximum permissible sensor-to-sensor delta [deg C] *)
    CRITICAL_PYRO_DIVERGE_DEGC      : REAL := 30.0;     (* Catastrophic sensor divergence limit [deg C] *)
    rDev_12                         : REAL := 0.0;      (* Absolute deviation between Pyro 1 and Pyro 2 [deg C] *)
    rDev_23                         : REAL := 0.0;      (* Absolute deviation between Pyro 2 and Pyro 3 [deg C] *)
    rDev_31                         : REAL := 0.0;      (* Absolute deviation between Pyro 3 and Pyro 1 [deg C] *)
    iPyroFaultCounter               : ARRAY[1..3] OF INT := [0, 0, 0]; (* Persistent fault debounce accumulators *)

    rVotedMedianTemp                : REAL := 25.0;     (* Intermediate calculated median temperature [deg C] *)

    (* 1st-Order Low-Pass Filter Accumulators *)
    rRobotFeedRate_Filt             : REAL := 0.0;      (* Filtered robotic TCP velocity [m/min] *)

    A_d                             : ARRAY[1..4, 1..4] OF REAL := [

        [ 0.000000,  0.184500,  0.000000 ],

    x_hat                           : ARRAY[1..4] OF REAL := [0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0]; (* Estimated state vector *)
    x_hat_next                      : ARRAY[1..4] OF REAL := [0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0]; (* Predicted state vector *)
    y_innov                         : ARRAY[1..3] OF REAL := [0.0, 0.0, 0.0];      (* Innovation residual vector *)
    u_plant                         : ARRAY[1..4] OF REAL := [0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0]; (* Plant control vector *)

    H_qp                            : ARRAY[1..3, 1..3] OF REAL := [

    delta_u_opt                     : ARRAY[1..3] OF REAL := [0.0, 0.0, 0.0];      (* Unconstrained QP step *)
    rDeltaLaserPowerCmd             : REAL := 0.0;                                 (* First horizon optimal step [kW] *)
    rLaserPowerFeedback_kW          : REAL := 0.0;                                 (* Feedback component of laser power [kW] *)
    rLaserPowerFeedforward_kW       : REAL := 0.0;                                 (* Dynamic velocity feedforward [kW] *)
    rLaserPowerTarget_kW            : REAL := 0.0;                                 (* Raw combined laser power target [kW] *)

    rSpoolRadius_m                  : ARRAY[1..8] OF REAL; (* Estimated instantaneous spool outer radius [m] *)
    rSpoolInertia_kg_m2             : ARRAY[1..8] OF REAL; (* Estimated spool rotational moment of inertia [kg*m^2] *)

    (* Pneumatic Clamp and Cutter Sequencing Timers *)
    tCutterPulseTimer               : TON;              (* High-speed pneumatic cutter knife pulse timer *)
    bCutterPulseActive              : BOOL := FALSE;    (* Active knife firing pulse flag *)
    tClampDelayTimer                : TON;              (* Clamp engagement settling timer *)
    tShutterSettleTimer             : TON;              (* Laser safety shutter physical travel debounce *)
    tPurgeSettleTimer               : TON;              (* Gas purge pressure accumulation timer *)
    tTowAdvanceTimer                : TON;              (* Tow initial feeding slip lead-in timer *)

    (* Polymer Crystallization & Autohesion Kinetics Accumulators *)
    rNakamuraRateK                  : REAL := 0.0;      (* Nakamura temperature-dependent rate factor [1/s] *)
    rCrystallizationIntegral        : REAL := 0.0;      (* Accumulated crystallization rate integral *)
    rAutohesionIntegral             : REAL := 0.0;      (* Accumulated de Gennes reptation healing integral *)
    rCoolingRate_degC_s             : REAL := 0.0;      (* Instantaneous measured cooling rate [deg C / s] *)
    rPrevNipTemp_degC               : REAL := 25.0;     (* Previous scan nip temperature [deg C] *)

    (* ISA-88 Phase State Machine State Variable *)
    iState                          : INT := 0;         (* Active execution state index *)
    iPreviousState                  : INT := -1;        (* History tracking state index *)
    bSubStateInitialised            : BOOL := FALSE;    (* State entry one-shot initialization flag *)

    (* ISA-18.2 Alarm Registers & Latches *)
    bTripEmergencyStop              : BOOL := FALSE;    (* E-Stop chain ruptured trip latch *)
    bTripLaserInterlock             : BOOL := FALSE;    (* Shutter interlock breached trip latch *)
    bTripPyrometerFailure           : BOOL := FALSE;    (* Dual or triple pyrometer failure trip latch *)
    bTripOpticsOverheat             : BOOL := FALSE;    (* Laser homogenizer overheat trip latch *)
    bTripChillerFault               : BOOL := FALSE;    (* Chilled water flow collapse trip latch *)
    bTripGasPressureLoss            : BOOL := FALSE;    (* Nitrogen shield gas pressure loss trip latch *)
    bTripNipOverheat                : BOOL := FALSE;    (* Nip temperature exceeded PEEK degradation trip latch *)
    bTripTowSnatch                  : BOOL := FALSE;    (* Spool snatch high-tension snag trip latch *)
    bTripTowBreak                   : BOOL := FALSE;    (* Tow filament breakage / spool empty trip latch *)

    (* Iteration & Helper Indices *)
    i                               : INT := 1;         (* Primary loop index *)
    j                               : INT := 1;         (* Secondary matrix index *)
    k_idx                           : INT := 1;         (* Tertiary vector index *)
    iActiveTowCount                 : INT := 0;         (* Real-time count of active engaged tows *)
    rActiveBandwidth_m              : REAL := 0.0508;   (* Total active tow layup bandwidth [m] *)
    rDeltaP                         : REAL := 0.0;      (* Local arithmetic scalar helper *)
END_VAR

(* ==================================================================================================== *)
(*                                    CYCLE INITIALIZATION & TIMING                                     *)
(* ==================================================================================================== *)

(* Calculate real-time robotic linear acceleration from filtered surface feed rate *)
rRobotFeedRate_Filt := (0.940 * rRobotFeedRate_Filt) + (0.060 * rRobotFeedRate_m_min);
IF rRobotFeedRate_Filt < 0.001 THEN
    rRobotFeedRate_Filt := 0.0;
END_IF;

rRobotAccel_m_s2 := ((rRobotFeedRate_Filt * 0.01666667) - rRobotVelocity_Prev_m_s) * ONE_OVER_SAMPLE_TIME;
rRobotVelocity_Prev_m_s := rRobotFeedRate_Filt * 0.01666667;

(* Count active tows and calculate total active composite placement bandwidth *)
iActiveTowCount := 0;
FOR i := 1 TO 8 DO
    IF (dwActiveTowMask AND SHL(DWORD#1, (i - 1))) <> DWORD#0 THEN
        iActiveTowCount := iActiveTowCount + 1;
    END_IF;
END_FOR;
rActiveBandwidth_m := INT_TO_REAL(iActiveTowCount) * TAPE_WIDTH_M;
IF rActiveBandwidth_m < TAPE_WIDTH_M THEN
    rActiveBandwidth_m := TAPE_WIDTH_M;
END_IF;

(* Cumulative energy monitoring [kJ]: Power [kW] * SampleTime [s] = Energy [kJ] *)
IF bLaserEmissionActive THEN
    rTotalEnergyDelivered_kJ := rTotalEnergyDelivered_kJ + (rLaserPowerCmd_kW * SAMPLE_TIME_S);
END_IF;


(* ==================================================================================================== *)
(*                       SENSOR CONDITIONING & LOW-PASS DIGITAL FILTERING                               *)
(* ==================================================================================================== *)

(* 1st-Order Low-Pass Filter on Physical Analog Sensor Transducers (fc ~ 35 Hz) *)
rCompactionForce_Filt := (0.920 * rCompactionForce_Filt) + (0.080 * rCompactionForce_N);
rOpticsTemp_Filt      := (0.995 * rOpticsTemp_Filt) + (0.005 * rOpticsTemp_degC);
rInertGasPress_Filt   := (0.950 * rInertGasPress_Filt) + (0.050 * rInertGasPressure_bar);
rChilledFlow_Filt     := (0.960 * rChilledFlow_Filt) + (0.040 * rChilledWaterFlow_L_min);

FOR i := 1 TO 8 DO
    rTowTension_Filt[i] := (0.900 * rTowTension_Filt[i]) + (0.100 * rTowTensionMeasured_N[i]);
END_FOR;


(* ==================================================================================================== *)
(*                 2oo3 TRIPLE MODULAR REDUNDANCY (TMR) PYROMETER VOTING ENGINE                         *)
(* ==================================================================================================== *)

(* Calculate Pairwise Temperature Discrepancies between Redundant Infrared Pyrometers *)
rDev_12 := ABS(rPyrometerTemp_1_degC - rPyrometerTemp_2_degC);
rDev_23 := ABS(rPyrometerTemp_2_degC - rPyrometerTemp_3_degC);
rDev_31 := ABS(rPyrometerTemp_3_degC - rPyrometerTemp_1_degC);

(* Channel 1 Outlier Analysis & Debounced Fault Quarantine *)
IF (rDev_12 > MAX_PYRO_DISCREPANCY_DEGC) AND (rDev_31 > MAX_PYRO_DISCREPANCY_DEGC) THEN
    iPyroFaultCounter[1] := iPyroFaultCounter[1] + 1;
    IF iPyroFaultCounter[1] > 15 THEN (* > 30 ms continuous discrepancy *)
        bPyroChannelHealthy[1] := FALSE;
        bPyrometerFault[1] := TRUE;
    END_IF;
ELSE
    IF iPyroFaultCounter[1] > 0 THEN
        iPyroFaultCounter[1] := iPyroFaultCounter[1] - 1;
    END_IF;
    IF iPyroFaultCounter[1] = 0 THEN
        bPyroChannelHealthy[1] := TRUE;
        bPyrometerFault[1] := FALSE;
    END_IF;
END_IF;

(* Channel 2 Outlier Analysis & Debounced Fault Quarantine *)
IF (rDev_12 > MAX_PYRO_DISCREPANCY_DEGC) AND (rDev_23 > MAX_PYRO_DISCREPANCY_DEGC) THEN
    iPyroFaultCounter[2] := iPyroFaultCounter[2] + 1;
    IF iPyroFaultCounter[2] > 15 THEN
        bPyroChannelHealthy[2] := FALSE;
        bPyrometerFault[2] := TRUE;
    END_IF;
ELSE
    IF iPyroFaultCounter[2] > 0 THEN
        iPyroFaultCounter[2] := iPyroFaultCounter[2] - 1;
    END_IF;
    IF iPyroFaultCounter[2] = 0 THEN
        bPyroChannelHealthy[2] := TRUE;
        bPyrometerFault[2] := FALSE;
    END_IF;
END_IF;

(* Channel 3 Outlier Analysis & Debounced Fault Quarantine *)
IF (rDev_23 > MAX_PYRO_DISCREPANCY_DEGC) AND (rDev_31 > MAX_PYRO_DISCREPANCY_DEGC) THEN
    iPyroFaultCounter[3] := iPyroFaultCounter[3] + 1;
    IF iPyroFaultCounter[3] > 15 THEN
        bPyroChannelHealthy[3] := FALSE;
        bPyrometerFault[3] := TRUE;
    END_IF;
ELSE
    IF iPyroFaultCounter[3] > 0 THEN
        iPyroFaultCounter[3] := iPyroFaultCounter[3] - 1;
    END_IF;
    IF iPyroFaultCounter[3] = 0 THEN
        bPyroChannelHealthy[3] := TRUE;
        bPyrometerFault[3] := FALSE;
    END_IF;
END_IF;

(* Catastrophic Divergence & Open-Circuit Range Audit *)
IF (rPyrometerTemp_1_degC < -10.0) OR (rPyrometerTemp_1_degC > 550.0) THEN
    bPyroChannelHealthy[1] := FALSE;
    bPyrometerFault[1] := TRUE;
END_IF;
IF (rPyrometerTemp_2_degC < -10.0) OR (rPyrometerTemp_2_degC > 550.0) THEN
    bPyroChannelHealthy[2] := FALSE;
    bPyrometerFault[2] := TRUE;
END_IF;
IF (rPyrometerTemp_3_degC < -10.0) OR (rPyrometerTemp_3_degC > 550.0) THEN
    bPyroChannelHealthy[3] := FALSE;
    bPyrometerFault[3] := TRUE;
END_IF;

(* 2oo3 TMR Voting Logic & Graceful Degradation State Machine *)
IF bPyroChannelHealthy[1] AND bPyroChannelHealthy[2] AND bPyroChannelHealthy[3] THEN
    (* All Three Channels Healthy: Median Selection Algorithm *)
    iSensorHealthStatus := 3;
    IF (rPyrometerTemp_1_degC >= rPyrometerTemp_2_degC) THEN
        IF (rPyrometerTemp_2_degC >= rPyrometerTemp_3_degC) THEN
            rVotedMedianTemp := rPyrometerTemp_2_degC;
        ELSIF (rPyrometerTemp_1_degC <= rPyrometerTemp_3_degC) THEN
            rVotedMedianTemp := rPyrometerTemp_1_degC;
        ELSE
            rVotedMedianTemp := rPyrometerTemp_3_degC;
        END_IF;
    ELSE
        IF (rPyrometerTemp_1_degC >= rPyrometerTemp_3_degC) THEN
            rVotedMedianTemp := rPyrometerTemp_1_degC;
        ELSIF (rPyrometerTemp_2_degC <= rPyrometerTemp_3_degC) THEN
            rVotedMedianTemp := rPyrometerTemp_2_degC;
        ELSE
            rVotedMedianTemp := rPyrometerTemp_3_degC;
        END_IF;
    END_IF;
    rConsolidationTemp_degC := rVotedMedianTemp;

ELSIF bPyroChannelHealthy[1] AND bPyroChannelHealthy[2] THEN
    (* Channel 3 Quarantined: Degraded 1oo2 Averaging of Ch1 and Ch2 *)
    iSensorHealthStatus := 2;
    rConsolidationTemp_degC := 0.5 * (rPyrometerTemp_1_degC + rPyrometerTemp_2_degC);

ELSIF bPyroChannelHealthy[2] AND bPyroChannelHealthy[3] THEN
    (* Channel 1 Quarantined: Degraded 1oo2 Averaging of Ch2 and Ch3 *)
    iSensorHealthStatus := 2;
    rConsolidationTemp_degC := 0.5 * (rPyrometerTemp_2_degC + rPyrometerTemp_3_degC);

ELSIF bPyroChannelHealthy[3] AND bPyroChannelHealthy[1] THEN
    (* Channel 2 Quarantined: Degraded 1oo2 Averaging of Ch3 and Ch1 *)
    iSensorHealthStatus := 2;
    rConsolidationTemp_degC := 0.5 * (rPyrometerTemp_3_degC + rPyrometerTemp_1_degC);

ELSE
    (* Multiple Pyrometer Channel Failure: Immediate Trip Lockout *)
    iSensorHealthStatus := 0;
    bTripPyrometerFailure := TRUE;
    rConsolidationTemp_degC := 0.0;
END_IF;

(* Nip Temperature Processing Window Verification *)
IF (rConsolidationTemp_degC >= T_PROCESS_MIN_DEGC) AND (rConsolidationTemp_degC <= T_PROCESS_MAX_DEGC) THEN
    bProcessInWindow := TRUE;
ELSE
    bProcessInWindow := FALSE;
END_IF;


(* ==================================================================================================== *)
(*                    KALMAN STATE-SPACE OBSERVER ESTIMATION ENGINE                                     *)
(* ==================================================================================================== *)

(* Format Plant Control Input Vector: u_plant = [P_laser, v_robot, F_roller, Q_chiller]^T *)
u_plant[1] := rLaserPowerCmd_Prev_kW;
u_plant[2] := rRobotFeedRate_Filt;
u_plant[3] := rCompactionForce_Filt;
u_plant[4] := rChilledFlow_Filt;

(* Compute Measurement Innovation: y_innov = y_measured - C_d * x_hat *)
y_innov[1] := (rConsolidationTemp_degC - rSubstrateTemp_degC) - x_hat[1];
y_innov[2] := (rOpticsTemp_Filt - 22.0) - x_hat[3];
y_innov[3] := 0.0; (* Roller surface temp virtual observer *)

(* Time-Update (A_d * x_hat + B_d * u_plant) and Measurement-Update (L_obs * y_innov) *)
FOR i := 1 TO 4 DO
    x_hat_next[i] := 0.0;
    (* State transition accumulation: sum(A_d[i, j] * x_hat[j]) *)
    FOR j := 1 TO 4 DO
        x_hat_next[i] := x_hat_next[i] + (A_d[i, j] * x_hat[j]);
    END_FOR;
    (* Input coupling accumulation: sum(B_d[i, j] * u_plant[j]) *)
    FOR j := 1 TO 4 DO
        x_hat_next[i] := x_hat_next[i] + (B_d[i, j] * u_plant[j]);
    END_FOR;
    (* Kalman gain correction accumulation: sum(L_obs[i, k] * y_innov[k]) *)
    FOR k_idx := 1 TO 3 DO
        x_hat_next[i] := x_hat_next[i] + (L_obs[i, k_idx] * y_innov[k_idx]);
    END_FOR;
END_FOR;

(* State Vector Update for Next Cycle *)
FOR i := 1 TO 4 DO
    x_hat[i] := x_hat_next[i];
END_FOR;


(* ==================================================================================================== *)
(*           MODEL PREDICTIVE CONTROL (MPC) & DYNAMIC VELOCITY FEEDFORWARD                              *)
(* ==================================================================================================== *)

(* Calculate Analytical Tape Convection Feedforward Laser Power [kW] *)
(* P_ff = [ rho * Cp * w_band * t_ply * (T_target - T_substrate) / (eta_opt * alpha_opt) ] * v_robot *)
IF (rRobotFeedRate_Filt > 0.05) AND (iState >= 60) THEN
    rLaserPowerFeedforward_kW := (RHO_COMPOSITE_KG_M3 * CP_COMPOSITE_J_KG_K * rActiveBandwidth_m * TAPE_THICKNESS_M
                                 * (rTargetNipTemp_degC - rSubstrateTemp_degC)
                                 / (OPTICAL_EFFICIENCY * OPTICAL_ABSORPTIVITY * 1000.0))
                                 * (rRobotFeedRate_Filt * 0.01666667);
ELSE
    rLaserPowerFeedforward_kW := 0.0;
END_IF;

(* Online Quadratic Cost Gradient Vector Evaluation: g_qp = M_x * x_hat - M_r * (T_target - T_sub) *)
g_qp[1] := (12.450 * (x_hat[1] - (rTargetNipTemp_degC - rSubstrateTemp_degC))) + (0.850 * x_hat[2]);
g_qp[2] := ( 8.220 * (x_hat[1] - (rTargetNipTemp_degC - rSubstrateTemp_degC))) + (0.520 * x_hat[2]);
g_qp[3] := ( 4.150 * (x_hat[1] - (rTargetNipTemp_degC - rSubstrateTemp_degC))) + (0.210 * x_hat[2]);

(* Unconstrained QP Optimal Step Calculation: delta_u_opt = -H_inv * g_qp *)
FOR i := 1 TO 3 DO
    delta_u_opt[i] := 0.0;
    FOR j := 1 TO 3 DO
        delta_u_opt[i] := delta_u_opt[i] - (H_inv[i, j] * g_qp[j]);
    END_FOR;
END_FOR;

(* Extract First Horizon Control Increment [kW] and Enforce Slew Rate Limiter *)
rDeltaLaserPowerCmd := delta_u_opt[1];
IF rDeltaLaserPowerCmd > (MAX_LASER_SLEW_KW_PER_S * SAMPLE_TIME_S) THEN
    rDeltaLaserPowerCmd := (MAX_LASER_SLEW_KW_PER_S * SAMPLE_TIME_S);
ELSIF rDeltaLaserPowerCmd < -(MAX_LASER_SLEW_KW_PER_S * SAMPLE_TIME_S) THEN
    rDeltaLaserPowerCmd := -(MAX_LASER_SLEW_KW_PER_S * SAMPLE_TIME_S);
END_IF;

(* Update MPC Feedback Power Accumulator *)
rLaserPowerFeedback_kW := rLaserPowerFeedback_kW + rDeltaLaserPowerCmd;
IF rLaserPowerFeedback_kW > 2.5 THEN
    rLaserPowerFeedback_kW := 2.5;
ELSIF rLaserPowerFeedback_kW < -2.0 THEN
    rLaserPowerFeedback_kW := -2.0;
END_IF;

(* Synthesize Raw Total Laser Power Command *)
IF (iState = 60) OR (iState = 70) THEN
    rLaserPowerTarget_kW := rLaserPowerFeedforward_kW + rLaserPowerFeedback_kW;
ELSE
    rLaserPowerTarget_kW := 0.0;
    rLaserPowerFeedback_kW := 0.0;
END_IF;

(* Enforce Laser Optical Power Hard Actuator Saturation [0.0 kW to MAX_LASER_POWER_KW] *)
IF rLaserPowerTarget_kW > MAX_LASER_POWER_KW THEN
    rLaserPowerCmd_kW := MAX_LASER_POWER_KW;
ELSIF rLaserPowerTarget_kW < 0.0 THEN
    rLaserPowerCmd_kW := 0.0;
ELSE
    rLaserPowerCmd_kW := rLaserPowerTarget_kW;
END_IF;
rLaserPowerCmd_Prev_kW := rLaserPowerCmd_kW;

(* Laser Irradiance Heat Flux Estimation [W/cm^2] *)
IF (rLaserOpticsZoom_mm > 5.0) AND (rLaserPowerCmd_kW > 0.01) THEN
    rHeatFlux_W_cm2 := (rLaserPowerCmd_kW * 1000.0 * OPTICAL_EFFICIENCY) / (rLaserOpticsZoom_mm * 0.1 * 1.25);
ELSE
    rHeatFlux_W_cm2 := 0.0;
END_IF;


(* ==================================================================================================== *)
(*          8-TOW MULTI-SPOOL MECHANICS, INERTIA COMPENSATION & CLAMP/CUT SUBSYSTEM                     *)
(* ==================================================================================================== *)

bTowAlarmSpoolSnatch := FALSE;
bTowAlarmRunoutBreak := FALSE;

FOR i := 1 TO 8 DO
    (* 1. Real-time Spool Outer Radius Calculation from Residual Prepreg Length *)

        kappa_eff = kappa_bulk * (1 - epsilon_void)^1.5

  1.2 FARADAY'S LAW, MOLAR GAS FLUX & HYDRODYNAMIC BUBBLE DISENGAGEMENT:
  ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  Theoretical molar production rates per Faraday's law:
      dot_n_H2 = (I_stack * N_cells * eta_Faraday) / (2 * F)   [mol/s]
      dot_n_O2 = (I_stack * N_cells * eta_Faraday) / (4 * F)   [mol/s]
  Gas volume generation at standard temperature and pressure (0 deg C, 1.01325 bar STP):
      V_dot_H2_STP = dot_n_H2 * 0.022414 * 3600  [Nm3/h] (~4.18 Nm3/h per kA per cell)
      V_dot_O2_STP = dot_n_O2 * 0.022414 * 3600  [Nm3/h] (~2.09 Nm3/h per kA per cell)
  In-situ volumetric gas flow at operating 30 bar and 80 deg C:
      V_dot_insitu = dot_n * Z(T, P) * R * T / P_operating  [m3/h]
  In the gas-liquid separators, bubbles rise through the liquid froth according to Hadamard-Rybczynski
  drag relations modified for high ionic strength (surfactant-free hindered bubble clustering):
      u_bubble_rise = [g * d_bubble^2 * (rho_lye - rho_gas)] / [18 * mu_lye] * (1 - phi_gas)^2.39

  1.3 DIAPHRAGM CROSS-PERMEATION & FLAMMABILITY SAFETY LIMITS:
  ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  Cross-permeation represents the primary catastrophic explosion hazard in pressurized AWE.
  Gases dissolve into the electrolyte at the electrode surfaces per Henry's Law:
      C_sol,H2 = k_H,H2(T) * P_H2;   C_sol,O2 = k_H,O2(T) * P_O2
  Mass transfer across the Zirfon composite separator proceeds by coupled diffusion and convection:
      J_total = J_diffusion + J_convection
      J_diffusion  = -D_eff * [C_sol / delta_x_membrane]                 (Fick's 1st Law)
      J_convection = -[k_perm / mu_lye] * [dP / delta_x_membrane] * C_sol (Darcy's Law)
  Where:
      - Effective diffusivity: D_eff = D_molecular * (epsilon_porosity / tau_tortuosity)
      - Diaphragm thickness: delta_x = 500 um; Permeability: k_perm ~ 1.2e-15 m2
  The fraction of H2 impurity in the O2 stream (HTO) and O2 in H2 (OTH) are given by:
      C_H2_in_O2 = [dot_n_cross,H2] / [dot_n_produced,O2 + dot_n_cross,H2]
  CRITICAL SAFETY IMPLICATION: Because dot_n_produced,O2 is directly proportional to I_stack,
  while J_diffusion is driven by the 30 bar partial pressure and is completely independent of current,
  as current I_stack drops, C_H2_in_O2 rises hyperbolically as (1 / I_stack)!
  Flammability Boundaries (ISO 22734 / IEC 61010-1 / EN 60079):
    - Lower Flammability Limit (LFL) of H2 in O2: 4.0 vol% (40,000 ppm)
    - SIL-3 Emergency Shutdown Trip Threshold:    1.8 vol% (18,000 ppm) [45% LFL]
    - Warning Alarm & Fast Power Derate:          1.0 vol% (10,000 ppm) [25% LFL]

  1.4 ANODE-CATHODE DIFFERENTIAL PRESSURE NULLING & COMMUNICATING VESSELS:
  ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  The liquid electrolyte return circuits from the Anode and Cathode separators join at the common
  suction header of the recirculation pumps. This creates a giant U-tube hydraulic manometer:
      Delta_P_hydrostatic = rho_lye * g * (h_Cathode - h_Anode)
  With 30 wt% KOH (rho = 1285 kg/m3), a differential pressure of just 10.0 mbar induces an
  equilibrium level shift of:
      Delta_h = 1000 Pa / (1285 kg/m3 * 9.80665 m/s2) = 0.0793 m = 7.93 cm!
  If dP reaches 50 mbar, liquid shifts by 40 cm, causing total gas blow-through into the pump suction
  or liquid flooding of the gas demister pads. Dynamic cross-permeation nulling eliminates dP
  using high-speed dome-loaded electronic pilot backpressure valves (PCV-H2, PCV-O2) and an
  inter-separator balancing transfer valve (LV-Bal).

  1.5 CATALYTIC DE-OXO PURIFICATION THERMAL RUNAWAY SYNC:
  ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  Crude H2 contains 0.1 to 1.5 vol% O2. A fixed-bed catalytic De-Oxo reactor (0.5 wt% Pd on theta-Al2O3)
  combusts the trace oxygen:
      2 H2 + O2 --> 2 H2O(g)   [Delta_H_rxn = -241.8 kJ/mol O2 consumed]
  Adiabatic temperature rise:
      Delta_T_ad = [y_O2 * (-Delta_H_rxn)] / [C_p,gas_mix] ~ 162 deg C per 1.0 vol% O2!
  Catalyst thermal constraints:
    - Minimum light-off temperature:  65 deg C (below which reaction extinguishes and O2 slips)
    - Maximum operating temperature:  380 deg C
    - Irreversible sintering threshold: 450 deg C (palladium crystallite agglomeration and alumina phase shift)
  The block executes feedforward thermal balancing: modulating SCR preheater duty, interstage cooling
  gas bypass, and emergency quench isolation.

  1.6 FAST RENEWABLE POWER RAMP RATE LIMITING:
  ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  To integrate with intermittent solar PV and wind turbines, the electrolyzer must accommodate
  extreme power gradients. However, rapid current ramp-up (di/dt > 10% / sec) causes violent gas void
  fraction expansion ('liquid swell') in the cell frames, triggering massive hydraulic dP pulses.
  Rapid current ramp-down drops Faradaic O2 production instantly while gas cross-diffusion continues,
  causing a sudden spike in H2-in-O2 concentration. The block dynamically modulates maximum allowable
  di/dt based on stack temperature, cell voltage dispersion, and instantaneous gas purity margins.

  1.7 MULTIVARIABLE STATE-SPACE (A, B, C, D) & REAL-TIME MPC OPTIMIZER:
  ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  State vector (n=6):
      x = [ dP (mbar), dLevel (%), T_DeOxo (deg C), T_Stack (deg C), C_H2_in_O2 (ppm/1000), C_O2_in_H2 (ppm/1000) ]^T
  Actuator vector (m=4):
      u = [ u_PCV_H2 (%), u_LV_Bal (%), u_HTR_DeOxo (%), I_Rectifier_Demand (kA) ]^T
  The block solves an embedded Quadratic Program (QP) using Barzilai-Borwein projected gradient
  descent with explicit box constraints and actuator slew rate limits.
 ==========================================================================================
*)

    rEmergencyDepressValve_pct := 25.0;
    dwAlarmWord2_Safety := dwAlarmWord2_Safety OR 16#0000_0001; (* Bit 0: Hardwired E-Stop Trip *)
    iState := 100; (* SAFETY_FAULT_LOCKOUT *)
    RETURN;
END_IF;

IF NOT bEnableSystem THEN
    bSystemRunning := FALSE;
    bProductionReady := FALSE;
    rRectifierCurrentDemand_kA := 0.0;
    rDeOxoPreheaterDuty_pct := 0.0;
    IF (iState <> 0) AND (iState <> 100) THEN
        iState := 0; (* Return to Standby *)
    END_IF;
END_IF;

(* Master alarm acknowledgement and fault reset *)
IF bResetFaults THEN
    bTripActive := FALSE;
    bAlarmActive := FALSE;
    dwAlarmWord1_Process := 16#0000_0000;
    dwAlarmWord2_Safety := 16#0000_0000;
    dwSubsystemDiagnostics := dwSubsystemDiagnostics AND 16#0000_FFFF;
    IF (iState = 100) AND bEnableSystem THEN
        iState := 0; (* Clear lockout to Standby *)
    END_IF;
END_IF;

(* ========================================================================================= *)
(* 2.0 TRIPLE MODULAR REDUNDANCY (2oo3) SENSOR VOTING ALGORITHMS                             *)
(* ========================================================================================= *)
(* Robust median selection across redundant transmitters with discrepancy anomaly rejection, *)
(* out-of-range sensor health flagging, and graceful degradation from 2oo3 -> 1oo2 -> Fail. *)

(* --- 2.1 CATHODE (H2) PRESSURE TRANSMITTERS PT-201A/B/C [bar] --- *)
bCathodePress_A_Healthy := (rCathodePressure_A_bar >= 0.0) AND (rCathodePressure_A_bar <= 45.0);
bCathodePress_B_Healthy := (rCathodePressure_B_bar >= 0.0) AND (rCathodePressure_B_bar <= 45.0);
bCathodePress_C_Healthy := (rCathodePressure_C_bar >= 0.0) AND (rCathodePressure_C_bar <= 45.0);

IF bCathodePress_A_Healthy AND bCathodePress_B_Healthy AND bCathodePress_C_Healthy THEN
    (* 3 Healthy: Exact Median Calculation *)
    IF (rCathodePressure_A_bar >= rCathodePressure_B_bar) THEN
        IF (rCathodePressure_B_bar >= rCathodePressure_C_bar) THEN
            rVotedCathodePressure_bar := rCathodePressure_B_bar;
        ELSIF (rCathodePressure_A_bar >= rCathodePressure_C_bar) THEN
            rVotedCathodePressure_bar := rCathodePressure_C_bar;
        ELSE
            rVotedCathodePressure_bar := rCathodePressure_A_bar;
        END_IF;
    ELSE
        IF (rCathodePressure_A_bar >= rCathodePressure_C_bar) THEN
            rVotedCathodePressure_bar := rCathodePressure_A_bar;
        ELSIF (rCathodePressure_B_bar >= rCathodePressure_C_bar) THEN
            rVotedCathodePressure_bar := rCathodePressure_C_bar;
        ELSE
            rVotedCathodePressure_bar := rCathodePressure_B_bar;
        END_IF;
    END_IF;
ELSIF bCathodePress_A_Healthy AND bCathodePress_B_Healthy THEN
    rVotedCathodePressure_bar := (rCathodePressure_A_bar + rCathodePressure_B_bar) * 0.5;
    dwSubsystemDiagnostics := dwSubsystemDiagnostics OR 16#0000_0001; (* Cathode PT-C Failed *)
ELSIF bCathodePress_A_Healthy AND bCathodePress_C_Healthy THEN
    rVotedCathodePressure_bar := (rCathodePressure_A_bar + rCathodePressure_C_bar) * 0.5;
    dwSubsystemDiagnostics := dwSubsystemDiagnostics OR 16#0000_0002; (* Cathode PT-B Failed *)
ELSIF bCathodePress_B_Healthy AND bCathodePress_C_Healthy THEN
    rVotedCathodePressure_bar := (rCathodePressure_B_bar + rCathodePressure_C_bar) * 0.5;
    dwSubsystemDiagnostics := dwSubsystemDiagnostics OR 16#0000_0004; (* Cathode PT-A Failed *)
ELSIF bCathodePress_A_Healthy THEN
    rVotedCathodePressure_bar := rCathodePressure_A_bar;
    bDegradedMode := TRUE;
ELSIF bCathodePress_B_Healthy THEN
    rVotedCathodePressure_bar := rCathodePressure_B_bar;
    bDegradedMode := TRUE;
ELSIF bCathodePress_C_Healthy THEN
    rVotedCathodePressure_bar := rCathodePressure_C_bar;
    bDegradedMode := TRUE;
ELSE
    bTripActive := TRUE;
    dwAlarmWord2_Safety := dwAlarmWord2_Safety OR 16#0000_0002; (* Complete Cathode PT Loss *)
END_IF;

(* --- 2.2 ANODE (O2) PRESSURE TRANSMITTERS PT-301A/B/C [bar] --- *)
