    bDegraded_Acous_1oo2                : BOOL := FALSE;
    bDegraded_Acous_Simplex             : BOOL := FALSE;

    (* Internal Helper Loop Indices *)
    iRow                                : INT := 1;
    iCol                                : INT := 1;
    iHorizonStep                        : INT := 1;
END_VAR

(* =====================================================================================================================
 * SECTION 1.0: CONTROLLER INITIALIZATION & HIGH-INTEGRITY SENSOR PLAUSIBILITY CHECK
 * =====================================================================================================================
 * Evaluates raw analog and digital inputs against physical boundary constraints for Lead-Bismuth Eutectic,
 * superheated steam, acoustic emission, and electromagnetic flow potential. Detects open-circuit, short-circuit,
 * and out-of-range sensor failures prior to voting logic execution.
 * ===================================================================================================================== *)

iCycleCounter := iCycleCounter + 1;
IF rCycleTime_sec <= 0.001 THEN
    rCycleTime_sec := 0.010; (* Enforce deterministic default cycle period 10 ms *)
END_IF;

(* Clear cycle diagnostic warnings before re-evaluation *)
dwAlarmWord1 := 16#0000_0000;
dwAlarmWord2 := 16#0000_0000;
dwDiagnosticsWord := 16#0000_0000;

(* Check 1.1: Magnetohydrodynamic Faraday Voltage Range Validation (-5.0 mV to 150.0 mV) *)
IF (rMHD_ElectrodeVoltage_ChA_mV < -5.0) OR (rMHD_ElectrodeVoltage_ChA_mV > 150.0) THEN
    bMHD_ChA_Valid := FALSE;
    dwAlarmWord2 := dwAlarmWord2 OR 16#0000_0001; (* MHD Channel A Out of Range *)
END_IF;

IF (rMHD_ElectrodeVoltage_ChB_mV < -5.0) OR (rMHD_ElectrodeVoltage_ChB_mV > 150.0) THEN
    bMHD_ChB_Valid := FALSE;
    dwAlarmWord2 := dwAlarmWord2 OR 16#0000_0002; (* MHD Channel B Out of Range *)
END_IF;

IF (rMHD_ElectrodeVoltage_ChC_mV < -5.0) OR (rMHD_ElectrodeVoltage_ChC_mV > 150.0) THEN
    bMHD_ChC_Valid := FALSE;
    dwAlarmWord2 := dwAlarmWord2 OR 16#0000_0004; (* MHD Channel C Out of Range *)
END_IF;

(* Check 1.2: MHD Rate of Change Checks (Max allowable dV/dt = 40.0 mV/s) *)
IF ABS(rMHD_ElectrodeVoltage_ChA_mV - rPrev_MHD_ChA_mV) / rCycleTime_sec > 40.0 THEN
    bMHD_ChA_Valid := FALSE;
    dwAlarmWord2 := dwAlarmWord2 OR 16#0000_0008; (* MHD Channel A Excessive Rate of Change *)
END_IF;
rPrev_MHD_ChA_mV := rMHD_ElectrodeVoltage_ChA_mV;

IF ABS(rMHD_ElectrodeVoltage_ChB_mV - rPrev_MHD_ChB_mV) / rCycleTime_sec > 40.0 THEN
    bMHD_ChB_Valid := FALSE;
    dwAlarmWord2 := dwAlarmWord2 OR 16#0000_0010; (* MHD Channel B Excessive Rate of Change *)
END_IF;
rPrev_MHD_ChB_mV := rMHD_ElectrodeVoltage_ChB_mV;

IF ABS(rMHD_ElectrodeVoltage_ChC_mV - rPrev_MHD_ChC_mV) / rCycleTime_sec > 40.0 THEN
    bMHD_ChC_Valid := FALSE;
    dwAlarmWord2 := dwAlarmWord2 OR 16#0000_0020; (* MHD Channel C Excessive Rate of Change *)
END_IF;
rPrev_MHD_ChC_mV := rMHD_ElectrodeVoltage_ChC_mV;

(* Check 1.3: IHX LBE Inlet Temperature Range Checks (120.0 deg C to 750.0 deg C) *)
IF (rIHX_LBE_InletTemp_ChA_DegC < 120.0) OR (rIHX_LBE_InletTemp_ChA_DegC > 750.0) THEN
    bIHX_ChA_Valid := FALSE;
    dwAlarmWord2 := dwAlarmWord2 OR 16#0000_0040; (* IHX Temp Ch A Sensor Failure *)
END_IF;

IF (rIHX_LBE_InletTemp_ChB_DegC < 120.0) OR (rIHX_LBE_InletTemp_ChB_DegC > 750.0) THEN
    bIHX_ChB_Valid := FALSE;
    dwAlarmWord2 := dwAlarmWord2 OR 16#0000_0080; (* IHX Temp Ch B Sensor Failure *)
END_IF;

IF (rIHX_LBE_InletTemp_ChC_DegC < 120.0) OR (rIHX_LBE_InletTemp_ChC_DegC > 750.0) THEN
    bIHX_ChC_Valid := FALSE;
    dwAlarmWord2 := dwAlarmWord2 OR 16#0000_0100; (* IHX Temp Ch C Sensor Failure *)
END_IF;

(* Check 1.4: IHX Temperature Slew Rate Verification (Max allowable dT/dt = 15.0 deg C/s) *)
IF ABS(rIHX_LBE_InletTemp_ChA_DegC - rPrev_IHX_ChA_DegC) / rCycleTime_sec > 15.0 THEN
    bIHX_ChA_Valid := FALSE;
    dwAlarmWord2 := dwAlarmWord2 OR 16#0000_0200; (* IHX Temp Ch A Slew Rate Exceeded *)
END_IF;
rPrev_IHX_ChA_DegC := rIHX_LBE_InletTemp_ChA_DegC;

IF ABS(rIHX_LBE_InletTemp_ChB_DegC - rPrev_IHX_ChB_DegC) / rCycleTime_sec > 15.0 THEN
    bIHX_ChB_Valid := FALSE;
    dwAlarmWord2 := dwAlarmWord2 OR 16#0000_0400; (* IHX Temp Ch B Slew Rate Exceeded *)
END_IF;
rPrev_IHX_ChB_DegC := rIHX_LBE_InletTemp_ChB_DegC;

IF ABS(rIHX_LBE_InletTemp_ChC_DegC - rPrev_IHX_ChC_DegC) / rCycleTime_sec > 15.0 THEN
    bIHX_ChC_Valid := FALSE;
    dwAlarmWord2 := dwAlarmWord2 OR 16#0000_0800; (* IHX Temp Ch C Slew Rate Exceeded *)
END_IF;
rPrev_IHX_ChC_DegC := rIHX_LBE_InletTemp_ChC_DegC;

(* Check 1.5: BTSG Steam Pressure Range Checks (0.0 bar to 220.0 bar) *)
IF (rBTSG_SteamHeaderPressure_ChA_bar < 0.0) OR (rBTSG_SteamHeaderPressure_ChA_bar > 220.0) THEN
    bBTSG_ChA_Valid := FALSE;
    dwAlarmWord2 := dwAlarmWord2 OR 16#0000_1000; (* BTSG Steam Pressure Ch A Out of Bounds *)
END_IF;

IF (rBTSG_SteamHeaderPressure_ChB_bar < 0.0) OR (rBTSG_SteamHeaderPressure_ChB_bar > 220.0) THEN
    bBTSG_ChB_Valid := FALSE;
    dwAlarmWord2 := dwAlarmWord2 OR 16#0000_2000; (* BTSG Steam Pressure Ch B Out of Bounds *)
END_IF;

IF (rBTSG_SteamHeaderPressure_ChC_bar < 0.0) OR (rBTSG_SteamHeaderPressure_ChC_bar > 220.0) THEN
    bBTSG_ChC_Valid := FALSE;
    dwAlarmWord2 := dwAlarmWord2 OR 16#0000_4000; (* BTSG Steam Pressure Ch C Out of Bounds *)
END_IF;

(* Track Steam Pressure Derivative for Rapid Steam Generator Tube Rupture (SGTR) Detection *)
rFilt_SteamPressureRate_bars := (rBTSG_SteamHeaderPressure_ChA_bar - rPrev_BTSG_ChA_bar) / rCycleTime_sec;
rPrev_BTSG_ChA_bar := rBTSG_SteamHeaderPressure_ChA_bar;
rPrev_BTSG_ChB_bar := rBTSG_SteamHeaderPressure_ChB_bar;
rPrev_BTSG_ChC_bar := rBTSG_SteamHeaderPressure_ChC_bar;

(* Check 1.6: Acoustic Waveguide Sensor Range Checks (20.0 dB to 160.0 dB ref 1 uPa) *)
IF (rAcousticWaveguide_ChA_dB < 20.0) OR (rAcousticWaveguide_ChA_dB > 160.0) THEN
    bAcous_ChA_Valid := FALSE;
    dwAlarmWord2 := dwAlarmWord2 OR 16#0001_0000; (* Acoustic Sensor Ch A Failure *)
END_IF;

IF (rAcousticWaveguide_ChB_dB < 20.0) OR (rAcousticWaveguide_ChB_dB > 160.0) THEN
    bAcous_ChB_Valid := FALSE;
    dwAlarmWord2 := dwAlarmWord2 OR 16#0002_0000; (* Acoustic Sensor Ch B Failure *)
END_IF;

IF (rAcousticWaveguide_ChC_dB < 20.0) OR (rAcousticWaveguide_ChC_dB > 160.0) THEN
    bAcous_ChC_Valid := FALSE;
    dwAlarmWord2 := dwAlarmWord2 OR 16#0004_0000; (* Acoustic Sensor Ch C Failure *)
END_IF;

(* Fault Latch Reset Handling *)
IF bResetFaultLatches THEN
    bMHD_ChA_Valid := TRUE;
    bMHD_ChB_Valid := TRUE;
    bMHD_ChC_Valid := TRUE;
    bIHX_ChA_Valid := TRUE;
    bIHX_ChB_Valid := TRUE;
    bIHX_ChC_Valid := TRUE;
    bBTSG_ChA_Valid := TRUE;
    bBTSG_ChB_Valid := TRUE;
    bBTSG_ChC_Valid := TRUE;
    bAcous_ChA_Valid := TRUE;
    bAcous_ChB_Valid := TRUE;
    bAcous_ChC_Valid := TRUE;
    bSGTR_RuptureDetected := FALSE;
END_IF;

(* =====================================================================================================================
 * SECTION 2.0: TRIPLE MODULAR REDUNDANCY (2oo3) VOTING AND AUTOMATIC DEGRADATION
 * =====================================================================================================================
 * Implements high-reliability median-select 2oo3 voting across redundant channels for:
 * 1. MHD Faraday Induction Voltages
 * 2. IHX Secondary Inlet Temperatures
 * 3. BTSG Superheated Steam Pressures
 * 4. Acoustic Cavitation Waveguide Sensors
 * Includes automatic degradation down to dual-redundant (1oo2) and simplex with discrepancy detection.
 * ===================================================================================================================== *)

(* --- 2.1 MHD INDUCTION VOLTAGE 2oo3 VOTING --- *)
IF bMHD_ChA_Valid AND bMHD_ChB_Valid AND bMHD_ChC_Valid THEN
    bDegraded_MHD_1oo2 := FALSE;
    bDegraded_MHD_Simplex := FALSE;
    (* Standard 3-channel median selection *)
    IF (rMHD_ElectrodeVoltage_ChA_mV >= rMHD_ElectrodeVoltage_ChB_mV AND rMHD_ElectrodeVoltage_ChA_mV <= rMHD_ElectrodeVoltage_ChC_mV) OR
       (rMHD_ElectrodeVoltage_ChA_mV <= rMHD_ElectrodeVoltage_ChB_mV AND rMHD_ElectrodeVoltage_ChA_mV >= rMHD_ElectrodeVoltage_ChC_mV) THEN
        rVoted_MHD_Voltage_mV := rMHD_ElectrodeVoltage_ChA_mV;
    ELSIF (rMHD_ElectrodeVoltage_ChB_mV >= rMHD_ElectrodeVoltage_ChA_mV AND rMHD_ElectrodeVoltage_ChB_mV <= rMHD_ElectrodeVoltage_ChC_mV) OR
          (rMHD_ElectrodeVoltage_ChB_mV <= rMHD_ElectrodeVoltage_ChA_mV AND rMHD_ElectrodeVoltage_ChB_mV >= rMHD_ElectrodeVoltage_ChC_mV) THEN
        rVoted_MHD_Voltage_mV := rMHD_ElectrodeVoltage_ChB_mV;
    ELSE
        rVoted_MHD_Voltage_mV := rMHD_ElectrodeVoltage_ChC_mV;
    END_IF;

    (* Inter-channel discrepancy check (> 6.0 mV deviation flags drift) *)
    IF ABS(rMHD_ElectrodeVoltage_ChA_mV - rMHD_ElectrodeVoltage_ChB_mV) > 6.0 THEN
        dwAlarmWord2 := dwAlarmWord2 OR 16#0010_0000; (* MHD Ch A-B Discrepancy *)
    END_IF;
    IF ABS(rMHD_ElectrodeVoltage_ChB_mV - rMHD_ElectrodeVoltage_ChC_mV) > 6.0 THEN
        dwAlarmWord2 := dwAlarmWord2 OR 16#0020_0000; (* MHD Ch B-C Discrepancy *)
    END_IF;
ELSIF bMHD_ChA_Valid AND bMHD_ChB_Valid THEN
    bDegraded_MHD_1oo2 := TRUE;
    rVoted_MHD_Voltage_mV := (rMHD_ElectrodeVoltage_ChA_mV + rMHD_ElectrodeVoltage_ChB_mV) * 0.5;
ELSIF bMHD_ChB_Valid AND bMHD_ChC_Valid THEN
    bDegraded_MHD_1oo2 := TRUE;
    rVoted_MHD_Voltage_mV := (rMHD_ElectrodeVoltage_ChB_mV + rMHD_ElectrodeVoltage_ChC_mV) * 0.5;
ELSIF bMHD_ChA_Valid AND bMHD_ChC_Valid THEN
    bDegraded_MHD_1oo2 := TRUE;
    rVoted_MHD_Voltage_mV := (rMHD_ElectrodeVoltage_ChA_mV + rMHD_ElectrodeVoltage_ChC_mV) * 0.5;
ELSIF bMHD_ChA_Valid THEN
    bDegraded_MHD_Simplex := TRUE;
    rVoted_MHD_Voltage_mV := rMHD_ElectrodeVoltage_ChA_mV;
ELSIF bMHD_ChB_Valid THEN
    bDegraded_MHD_Simplex := TRUE;
    rVoted_MHD_Voltage_mV := rMHD_ElectrodeVoltage_ChB_mV;
ELSIF bMHD_ChC_Valid THEN
    bDegraded_MHD_Simplex := TRUE;
    rVoted_MHD_Voltage_mV := rMHD_ElectrodeVoltage_ChC_mV;
ELSE
    rVoted_MHD_Voltage_mV := 0.0;
    dwAlarmWord1 := dwAlarmWord1 OR 16#0000_0001; (* Complete MHD Sensor Bank Loss *)
END_IF;

(* First-Order Recursive Low-Pass Filter on Voted MHD Voltage (tau = 0.05 s) *)
rFilt_MHD_Voltage_mV := rFilt_MHD_Voltage_mV + (rCycleTime_sec / (0.05 + rCycleTime_sec)) * (rVoted_MHD_Voltage_mV - rFilt_MHD_Voltage_mV);
rFilt_TransverseVoltage_mV := rFilt_TransverseVoltage_mV + (rCycleTime_sec / (0.05 + rCycleTime_sec)) * (rMHD_TransverseVoltage_mV - rFilt_TransverseVoltage_mV);

(* --- 2.2 IHX LBE INLET TEMPERATURE 2oo3 VOTING --- *)
IF bIHX_ChA_Valid AND bIHX_ChB_Valid AND bIHX_ChC_Valid THEN
    bDegraded_IHX_1oo2 := FALSE;
    bDegraded_IHX_Simplex := FALSE;
    IF (rIHX_LBE_InletTemp_ChA_DegC >= rIHX_LBE_InletTemp_ChB_DegC AND rIHX_LBE_InletTemp_ChA_DegC <= rIHX_LBE_InletTemp_ChC_DegC) OR
       (rIHX_LBE_InletTemp_ChA_DegC <= rIHX_LBE_InletTemp_ChB_DegC AND rIHX_LBE_InletTemp_ChA_DegC >= rIHX_LBE_InletTemp_ChC_DegC) THEN
        rVoted_IHX_InletTemp_DegC := rIHX_LBE_InletTemp_ChA_DegC;
    ELSIF (rIHX_LBE_InletTemp_ChB_DegC >= rIHX_LBE_InletTemp_ChA_DegC AND rIHX_LBE_InletTemp_ChB_DegC <= rIHX_LBE_InletTemp_ChC_DegC) OR
          (rIHX_LBE_InletTemp_ChB_DegC <= rIHX_LBE_InletTemp_ChA_DegC AND rIHX_LBE_InletTemp_ChB_DegC >= rIHX_LBE_InletTemp_ChC_DegC) THEN
        rVoted_IHX_InletTemp_DegC := rIHX_LBE_InletTemp_ChB_DegC;
    ELSE
        rVoted_IHX_InletTemp_DegC := rIHX_LBE_InletTemp_ChC_DegC;
    END_IF;

    IF ABS(rIHX_LBE_InletTemp_ChA_DegC - rIHX_LBE_InletTemp_ChB_DegC) > 12.0 THEN
        dwAlarmWord2 := dwAlarmWord2 OR 16#0040_0000; (* IHX Temp Ch A-B Discrepancy *)
    END_IF;
    IF ABS(rIHX_LBE_InletTemp_ChB_DegC - rIHX_LBE_InletTemp_ChC_DegC) > 12.0 THEN
        dwAlarmWord2 := dwAlarmWord2 OR 16#0080_0000; (* IHX Temp Ch B-C Discrepancy *)
    END_IF;
ELSIF bIHX_ChA_Valid AND bIHX_ChB_Valid THEN
    bDegraded_IHX_1oo2 := TRUE;
    rVoted_IHX_InletTemp_DegC := (rIHX_LBE_InletTemp_ChA_DegC + rIHX_LBE_InletTemp_ChB_DegC) * 0.5;
ELSIF bIHX_ChB_Valid AND bIHX_ChC_Valid THEN
    bDegraded_IHX_1oo2 := TRUE;
    rVoted_IHX_InletTemp_DegC := (rIHX_LBE_InletTemp_ChB_DegC + rIHX_LBE_InletTemp_ChC_DegC) * 0.5;
ELSIF bIHX_ChA_Valid AND bIHX_ChC_Valid THEN
    bDegraded_IHX_1oo2 := TRUE;
    rVoted_IHX_InletTemp_DegC := (rIHX_LBE_InletTemp_ChA_DegC + rIHX_LBE_InletTemp_ChC_DegC) * 0.5;
ELSIF bIHX_ChA_Valid THEN
    bDegraded_IHX_Simplex := TRUE;
    rVoted_IHX_InletTemp_DegC := rIHX_LBE_InletTemp_ChA_DegC;
ELSIF bIHX_ChB_Valid THEN
    bDegraded_IHX_Simplex := TRUE;
    rVoted_IHX_InletTemp_DegC := rIHX_LBE_InletTemp_ChB_DegC;
ELSIF bIHX_ChC_Valid THEN
    bDegraded_IHX_Simplex := TRUE;
    rVoted_IHX_InletTemp_DegC := rIHX_LBE_InletTemp_ChC_DegC;
ELSE
    rVoted_IHX_InletTemp_DegC := 350.0;
    dwAlarmWord1 := dwAlarmWord1 OR 16#0000_0002; (* Complete IHX Thermocouple Bank Loss *)
END_IF;

(* --- 2.3 BTSG STEAM PRESSURE 2oo3 VOTING --- *)
IF bBTSG_ChA_Valid AND bBTSG_ChB_Valid AND bBTSG_ChC_Valid THEN
    bDegraded_BTSG_1oo2 := FALSE;
    bDegraded_BTSG_Simplex := FALSE;
    IF (rBTSG_SteamHeaderPressure_ChA_bar >= rBTSG_SteamHeaderPressure_ChB_bar AND rBTSG_SteamHeaderPressure_ChA_bar <= rBTSG_SteamHeaderPressure_ChC_bar) OR
       (rBTSG_SteamHeaderPressure_ChA_bar <= rBTSG_SteamHeaderPressure_ChB_bar AND rBTSG_SteamHeaderPressure_ChA_bar >= rBTSG_SteamHeaderPressure_ChC_bar) THEN
        rVoted_BTSG_SteamPressure_bar := rBTSG_SteamHeaderPressure_ChA_bar;
    ELSIF (rBTSG_SteamHeaderPressure_ChB_bar >= rBTSG_SteamHeaderPressure_ChA_bar AND rBTSG_SteamHeaderPressure_ChB_bar <= rBTSG_SteamHeaderPressure_ChC_bar) OR
          (rBTSG_SteamHeaderPressure_ChB_bar <= rBTSG_SteamHeaderPressure_ChA_bar AND rBTSG_SteamHeaderPressure_ChB_bar >= rBTSG_SteamHeaderPressure_ChC_bar) THEN
        rVoted_BTSG_SteamPressure_bar := rBTSG_SteamHeaderPressure_ChB_bar;
    ELSE
        rVoted_BTSG_SteamPressure_bar := rBTSG_SteamHeaderPressure_ChC_bar;
    END_IF;
ELSIF bBTSG_ChA_Valid AND bBTSG_ChB_Valid THEN
    bDegraded_BTSG_1oo2 := TRUE;
    rVoted_BTSG_SteamPressure_bar := (rBTSG_SteamHeaderPressure_ChA_bar + rBTSG_SteamHeaderPressure_ChB_bar) * 0.5;
ELSIF bBTSG_ChB_Valid AND bBTSG_ChC_Valid THEN
    bDegraded_BTSG_1oo2 := TRUE;
    rVoted_BTSG_SteamPressure_bar := (rBTSG_SteamHeaderPressure_ChB_bar + rBTSG_SteamHeaderPressure_ChC_bar) * 0.5;
ELSIF bBTSG_ChA_Valid AND bBTSG_ChC_Valid THEN
    bDegraded_BTSG_1oo2 := TRUE;
    rVoted_BTSG_SteamPressure_bar := (rBTSG_SteamHeaderPressure_ChA_bar + rBTSG_SteamHeaderPressure_ChC_bar) * 0.5;
ELSIF bBTSG_ChA_Valid THEN
    bDegraded_BTSG_Simplex := TRUE;
    rVoted_BTSG_SteamPressure_bar := rBTSG_SteamHeaderPressure_ChA_bar;
ELSIF bBTSG_ChB_Valid THEN
    bDegraded_BTSG_Simplex := TRUE;
    rVoted_BTSG_SteamPressure_bar := rBTSG_SteamHeaderPressure_ChB_bar;
ELSIF bBTSG_ChC_Valid THEN
    bDegraded_BTSG_Simplex := TRUE;
    rVoted_BTSG_SteamPressure_bar := rBTSG_SteamHeaderPressure_ChC_bar;
ELSE
    rVoted_BTSG_SteamPressure_bar := 120.0;
    dwAlarmWord1 := dwAlarmWord1 OR 16#0000_0004; (* Complete BTSG Pressure Transmitter Loss *)
END_IF;

(* --- 2.4 ACOUSTIC CAVITATION SENSOR 2oo3 VOTING --- *)
IF bAcous_ChA_Valid AND bAcous_ChB_Valid AND bAcous_ChC_Valid THEN
    bDegraded_Acous_1oo2 := FALSE;
    bDegraded_Acous_Simplex := FALSE;
    IF (rAcousticWaveguide_ChA_dB >= rAcousticWaveguide_ChB_dB AND rAcousticWaveguide_ChA_dB <= rAcousticWaveguide_ChC_dB) OR
       (rAcousticWaveguide_ChA_dB <= rAcousticWaveguide_ChB_dB AND rAcousticWaveguide_ChA_dB >= rAcousticWaveguide_ChC_dB) THEN
        rVoted_AcousticLevel_dB := rAcousticWaveguide_ChA_dB;
    ELSIF (rAcousticWaveguide_ChB_dB >= rAcousticWaveguide_ChA_dB AND rAcousticWaveguide_ChB_dB <= rAcousticWaveguide_ChC_dB) OR
          (rAcousticWaveguide_ChB_dB <= rAcousticWaveguide_ChA_dB AND rAcousticWaveguide_ChB_dB >= rAcousticWaveguide_ChC_dB) THEN
        rVoted_AcousticLevel_dB := rAcousticWaveguide_ChB_dB;
    ELSE
        rVoted_AcousticLevel_dB := rAcousticWaveguide_ChC_dB;
    END_IF;
ELSIF bAcous_ChA_Valid AND bAcous_ChB_Valid THEN
    bDegraded_Acous_1oo2 := TRUE;
    rVoted_AcousticLevel_dB := (rAcousticWaveguide_ChA_dB + rAcousticWaveguide_ChB_dB) * 0.5;
ELSIF bAcous_ChB_Valid AND bAcous_ChC_Valid THEN
    bDegraded_Acous_1oo2 := TRUE;
    rVoted_AcousticLevel_dB := (rAcousticWaveguide_ChB_dB + rAcousticWaveguide_ChC_dB) * 0.5;
ELSIF bAcous_ChA_Valid AND bAcous_ChC_Valid THEN
    bDegraded_Acous_1oo2 := TRUE;
    rVoted_AcousticLevel_dB := (rAcousticWaveguide_ChA_dB + rAcousticWaveguide_ChC_dB) * 0.5;
ELSIF bAcous_ChA_Valid THEN
    bDegraded_Acous_Simplex := TRUE;
    rVoted_AcousticLevel_dB := rAcousticWaveguide_ChA_dB;
ELSIF bAcous_ChB_Valid THEN
    bDegraded_Acous_Simplex := TRUE;
    rVoted_AcousticLevel_dB := rAcousticWaveguide_ChB_dB;
ELSIF bAcous_ChC_Valid THEN
    bDegraded_Acous_Simplex := TRUE;
    rVoted_AcousticLevel_dB := rAcousticWaveguide_ChC_dB;
ELSE
    rVoted_AcousticLevel_dB := 45.0;
    dwAlarmWord2 := dwAlarmWord2 OR 16#0100_0000; (* All Acoustic Sensors Failed *)
END_IF;

bDegradedSensorMode := bDegraded_MHD_1oo2 OR bDegraded_MHD_Simplex OR
                       bDegraded_IHX_1oo2 OR bDegraded_IHX_Simplex OR
                       bDegraded_BTSG_1oo2 OR bDegraded_BTSG_Simplex OR
                       bDegraded_Acous_1oo2 OR bDegraded_Acous_Simplex;

(* =====================================================================================================================
 * SECTION 3.0: THERMOPHYSICAL PROPERTIES & MHD INDUCTION FLOW VECTOR PROCESSING
 * =====================================================================================================================
 * Dynamically updates OECD/NEA benchmark thermophysical properties of Lead-Bismuth Eutectic as a function of bulk
 * temperature T = rVoted_IHX_InletTemp_DegC. Executes vector decomposition of Faraday electromagnetic voltage,
 * applying Hartmann boundary layer flattening, pipe wall conductance shunting, and magnetic Reynolds corrections.
 * ===================================================================================================================== *)

(* 3.1 Temperature-Dependent Properties of Liquid LBE (OECD/NEA Nuclear Science Handbook Correlations) *)
(* Density rho(T) [kg/m^3]: valid from 125 deg C to 900 deg C *)
rLBE_Density_kgm3 := 11096.0 - (1.3236 * rVoted_IHX_InletTemp_DegC);

(* Dynamic Viscosity mu(T) [Pa*s]: Andrade exponential correlation *)
rLBE_DynamicViscosity_Pas := 0.000494 * EXP(754.1 / (rVoted_IHX_InletTemp_DegC + 273.15));

(* Specific Heat Capacity Cp(T) [J/(kg*K)] *)
rLBE_SpecificHeat_JkgK := 159.0 - (0.0272 * rVoted_IHX_InletTemp_DegC) + (0.00000712 * rVoted_IHX_InletTemp_DegC * rVoted_IHX_InletTemp_DegC);

(* Thermal Conductivity k(T) [W/(m*K)] *)
rLBE_ThermalConductivity_WmK := 3.61 + (0.01517 * rVoted_IHX_InletTemp_DegC) - (0.000001741 * rVoted_IHX_InletTemp_DegC * rVoted_IHX_InletTemp_DegC);

(* Electrical Conductivity sigma(T) [S/m] *)
IF rVoted_IHX_InletTemp_DegC > 50.0 THEN
    rLBE_ElectricalConductivity_Sm := 1.0 / (0.000001 * (0.91 + (0.00072 * rVoted_IHX_InletTemp_DegC)));
ELSE
    rLBE_ElectricalConductivity_Sm := 950000.0;
END_IF;

(* Volumetric Thermal Expansion Coefficient beta(T) [1/K] *)
IF rLBE_Density_kgm3 > 1000.0 THEN
    rLBE_ThermalExpansionCoeff_1K := 1.3236 / rLBE_Density_kgm3;
ELSE
    rLBE_ThermalExpansionCoeff_1K := 0.000125;
END_IF;

(* Acoustic Sound Velocity in Liquid LBE c_s(T) [m/s] *)
rLBE_SpeedOfSound_ms := 1805.0 - (0.23 * rVoted_IHX_InletTemp_DegC);

(* 3.2 Magnetohydrodynamic Induction Flow Vector Decomposition *)
(* Verify excitation magnetic flux density *)
IF rMHD_MagneticFluxDensity_T < 0.050 THEN
    rMHD_MagneticFluxDensity_T := 0.250; (* Default to permanent magnet bias 0.250 Tesla *)
END_IF;

(* Hartmann Number Ha = B * D * SQRT(sigma / mu) *)
IF rLBE_DynamicViscosity_Pas > 0.0001 THEN
    rHartmannNumber := rMHD_MagneticFluxDensity_T * rPipeInnerDiameter_m * SQRT(rLBE_ElectricalConductivity_Sm / rLBE_DynamicViscosity_Pas);
ELSE
    rHartmannNumber := 150.0;
END_IF;

(* Hartmann Boundary Layer Flattening Factor: K_Ha = 1.0 - (1.0 / Ha) for Ha >> 1 *)
IF rHartmannNumber > 10.0 THEN
    rHartmannFactor := 1.0 - (1.0 / rHartmannNumber);
ELSE
    rHartmannFactor := 0.90;
END_IF;

(* Wall Shunting Correction Factor K_wall accounts for eddy current bypass through metallic T91 pipe wall *)
(* K_wall = (2 * d_in / d_out) / (1 + (d_in/d_out)^2 + (sigma_wall/sigma_lbe) * (1 - (d_in/d_out)^2)) *)
rWallShuntingFactor := (2.0 * rPipeInnerDiameter_m / (rPipeInnerDiameter_m + 2.0 * rPipeWallThickness_m)) /
    (1.0 + ((rPipeInnerDiameter_m / (rPipeInnerDiameter_m + 2.0 * rPipeWallThickness_m)) * (rPipeInnerDiameter_m / (rPipeInnerDiameter_m + 2.0 * rPipeWallThickness_m))) +
     (rWallConductivity_Sm / rLBE_ElectricalConductivity_Sm) * (1.0 - ((rPipeInnerDiameter_m / (rPipeInnerDiameter_m + 2.0 * rPipeWallThickness_m)) * (rPipeInnerDiameter_m / (rPipeInnerDiameter_m + 2.0 * rPipeWallThickness_m)))));

(* Raw Axial Bulk Velocity from Faraday Law: E_mV * 1e-3 = B * D * v * K_Ha * K_wall *)
rTheoreticalFaradayCoeff := rMHD_MagneticFluxDensity_T * rPipeInnerDiameter_m * rHartmannFactor * rWallShuntingFactor;
IF rTheoreticalFaradayCoeff > 0.001 THEN
    rAxialVelocityRaw_ms := (rFilt_MHD_Voltage_mV * 0.001) / rTheoreticalFaradayCoeff;
ELSE
    rAxialVelocityRaw_ms := 0.0;
END_IF;

(* Magnetic Reynolds Number Rm = mu_0 * sigma * v * D (mu_0 = 4*pi*1e-7 H/m = 1.2566e-6) *)
rMagneticReynoldsNumber := 0.0000012566 * rLBE_ElectricalConductivity_Sm * ABS(rAxialVelocityRaw_ms) * rPipeInnerDiameter_m;

(* Non-linear back-reaction magnetic rejection correction: applied when Rm > 0.05 *)
IF rMagneticReynoldsNumber > 0.05 THEN
    rMHD_InducedFieldRejection_pct := (rMagneticReynoldsNumber * rMagneticReynoldsNumber * 18.0);
    IF rMHD_InducedFieldRejection_pct > 15.0 THEN rMHD_InducedFieldRejection_pct := 15.0; END_IF;
    rLBE_BulkVelocity_ms := rAxialVelocityRaw_ms * (1.0 + (rMHD_InducedFieldRejection_pct * 0.01));
ELSE
    rMHD_InducedFieldRejection_pct := 0.0;
    rLBE_BulkVelocity_ms := rAxialVelocityRaw_ms;
END_IF;

(* Transverse Swirl Velocity Resolution from Orthogonal Electrode Channel *)
IF rTheoreticalFaradayCoeff > 0.001 THEN
    rLBE_SwirlComponent_ms := (rFilt_TransverseVoltage_mV * 0.001) / rTheoreticalFaradayCoeff;
ELSE
    rLBE_SwirlComponent_ms := 0.0;
END_IF;

(* Swirl Angle Calculation: theta = arctan(v_swirl / v_axial) in degrees *)
IF ABS(rLBE_BulkVelocity_ms) > 0.05 THEN
    rLBE_SwirlAngle_deg := ATAN(ABS(rLBE_SwirlComponent_ms) / ABS(rLBE_BulkVelocity_ms)) * (180.0 / 3.14159265);
ELSE
    rLBE_SwirlAngle_deg := 0.0;
END_IF;

(* Validated LBE Mass Flow Rate Determination: m_dot = rho * A_pipe * v_bulk [kg/s] *)
rLBE_MassFlowRate_Voted_kgs := rLBE_Density_kgm3 * rPipeCrossSectionArea_m2 * rLBE_BulkVelocity_ms;
IF rLBE_MassFlowRate_Voted_kgs < 0.0 THEN
    rLBE_MassFlowRate_Voted_kgs := 0.0; (* Prevent negative mass flow during forward cycle *)
END_IF;

(* =====================================================================================================================
 * SECTION 4.0: ACOUSTIC CAVITATION BUBBLE EROSION TRACKING & LIFE CONSUMPTION
 * =====================================================================================================================
 * Liquid LBE cavitation poses severe structural risk to electromagnetic pump throat and steam generator bayonet
 * entrance orifices. Monitors acoustic emission spectral power in the 80 - 350 kHz ultrasonic regime, computes
 * real-time Cavitation Inception Number (Sigma), and integrates cumulative micro-erosion depth via ASTM G32
 * acoustic energy dissipation modeling.
 * ===================================================================================================================== *)

(* 4.1 Dynamic Pressure & Cavitation Inception Number (Sigma) *)
(* Dynamic head q = 0.5 * rho * v^2 [bar] (converted from Pa to bar via 1e-5) *)
rDynamicPressure_bar := 0.5 * rLBE_Density_kgm3 * (rLBE_BulkVelocity_ms * rLBE_BulkVelocity_ms) * 0.00001;

(* Cavitation Number: Sigma = (P_static - P_vapor) / (0.5 * rho * v^2) *)
IF rDynamicPressure_bar > 0.005 THEN
    rCavitationIndex_Sigma := (rLBE_CoverGasStaticPressure_bar - rLBE_VaporPressure_bar) / rDynamicPressure_bar;
ELSE
    rCavitationIndex_Sigma := 99.9; (* High margin at near-stagnant flow *)
END_IF;

(* 4.2 Net Ultrasonic Acoustic Emission Calculation *)
(* Subtract baseline hydrodynamic background noise from total acoustic energy *)
IF rVoted_AcousticLevel_dB > rAcousticBackgroundNoise_dB THEN
    rNetCavitationAcoustic_dB := rVoted_AcousticLevel_dB - rAcousticBackgroundNoise_dB;
ELSE
    rNetCavitationAcoustic_dB := 0.0;
END_IF;

(* Convert net dB to RMS acoustic pressure in Pascals: P_rms = P_ref * 10^(dB / 20), P_ref = 1 uPa *)
rAcousticPressure_Pa := 0.000001 * EXP((rNetCavitationAcoustic_dB / 20.0) * 2.30258509);

(* 4.3 ASTM G32 Ultrasonic Cavitation Energy Dissipation & Erosion Rate *)
(* Erosion occurs when net acoustic pressure exceeds threshold (1200 Pa) and Sigma < 1.85 *)
IF (rAcousticPressure_Pa > rCavitationThresholdPressure_Pa) AND (rCavitationIndex_Sigma < 1.85) THEN
    (* Instantaneous erosion rate model: delta_dot [um/hr] = K_mat * (P_acous / P_ref)^1.6 * (f_peak / 100 kHz) *)
    rCavitationErosionRate_um_hr := 0.0085 * EXP(1.6 * LN(rAcousticPressure_Pa / rCavitationThresholdPressure_Pa)) *
                                    (rAcousticResonancePeak_kHz / 100.0);
    IF rCavitationErosionRate_um_hr > 25.0 THEN
        rCavitationErosionRate_um_hr := 25.0; (* Physical saturation limit *)
    END_IF;
ELSE
    rCavitationErosionRate_um_hr := 0.0;
END_IF;

(* Filter instantaneous erosion rate *)
rFilt_ErosionRate_um_hr := rFilt_ErosionRate_um_hr + (rCycleTime_sec / (0.2 + rCycleTime_sec)) * (rCavitationErosionRate_um_hr - rFilt_ErosionRate_um_hr);

(* Continuous Integration of Cumulative Metal Surface Erosion Depth [um] *)
rCumulativeErosionDepth_um := rCumulativeErosionDepth_um + (rFilt_ErosionRate_um_hr * (rCycleTime_sec / 3600.0));

(* Alarm Generation & Debounce on Cavitation Severity *)
tCavitationDebounceTimer(IN := (rCavitationIndex_Sigma < 1.20) OR (rFilt_ErosionRate_um_hr > 4.5), PT := T#2S);
IF tCavitationDebounceTimer.Q THEN
    bCavitationRiskExceeded := TRUE;
    dwAlarmWord1 := dwAlarmWord1 OR 16#0000_0010; (* Active Cavitation Bubble Collapse Hazard *)
ELSE
    bCavitationRiskExceeded := FALSE;
END_IF;

(* Cumulative Wear Threshold Alarms *)
IF rCumulativeErosionDepth_um > 50.0 THEN
    dwAlarmWord1 := dwAlarmWord1 OR 16#0000_0020; (* Cavitation Erosion Level 1 Warning: 50 um wall loss *)
END_IF;
IF rCumulativeErosionDepth_um > 200.0 THEN
    dwAlarmWord1 := dwAlarmWord1 OR 16#0000_0040; (* Cavitation Erosion Level 2 Alert: 200 um critical wall loss *)
END_IF;

(* =====================================================================================================================
 * SECTION 5.0: TRANSIENT THERMAL STRATIFICATION MITIGATOR & RICHARDSON DYNAMICS
 * =====================================================================================================================
 * Evaluates vertical temperature profile in large horizontal LBE secondary header via 4-elevation thermocouple rake.
 * Computes gradient Richardson Number (Ri) to quantify buoyancy stability vs inertial mixing shear.
 * Synthesizes dynamic vortex induction stirrer demand to disperse stratified cold boundary layers and alleviate
 * cyclic structural microstrain on conduit weld joints.
 * ===================================================================================================================== *)

(* 5.1 Vertical Temperature Differential & Mean Temperature *)
rThermalStratificationDeltaT_DegC := rStratHeader_Temp_Elev4_DegC - rStratHeader_Temp_Elev1_DegC;
rMeanHeaderTemp_DegC := (rStratHeader_Temp_Elev1_DegC + rStratHeader_Temp_Elev2_DegC +
                         rStratHeader_Temp_Elev3_DegC + rStratHeader_Temp_Elev4_DegC) * 0.25;

(* Low-pass filter on stratification differential *)
rFilt_StratDeltaT_DegC := rFilt_StratDeltaT_DegC + (rCycleTime_sec / (0.10 + rCycleTime_sec)) * (rThermalStratificationDeltaT_DegC - rFilt_StratDeltaT_DegC);

(* Vertical Temperature Gradient across Header Diameter (D = 0.350 m) [deg C/m] *)
IF rPipeHydraulicDiameter_m > 0.05 THEN
    rHeaderTempGradient_DegCm := rFilt_StratDeltaT_DegC / rPipeHydraulicDiameter_m;
ELSE
    rHeaderTempGradient_DegCm := 0.0;
END_IF;

(* 5.2 Richardson Number (Ri) Stability Computation *)
(* Ri = (g * beta * DeltaT * D_h) / (v_bulk^2) *)
(* g = 9.80665 m/s^2 *)
IF ABS(rLBE_BulkVelocity_ms) > 0.080 THEN
    rRichardsonNumber := (9.80665 * rLBE_ThermalExpansionCoeff_1K * ABS(rFilt_StratDeltaT_DegC) * rPipeHydraulicDiameter_m) /
                         (rLBE_BulkVelocity_ms * rLBE_BulkVelocity_ms);
ELSE
    (* Under very low velocity, buoyancy completely dominates inertial shear *)
    rRichardsonNumber := 12.5;
END_IF;

(* 5.3 Stratification Severity & Structural Strain Alert Logic *)
(* Alert threshold: DeltaT > 28.0 deg C OR Richardson Number > 1.25 OR hoop strain > 450 microstrain *)
IF (rFilt_StratDeltaT_DegC > 28.0) OR (rRichardsonNumber > 1.25) OR (rHeader_StructuralMicrostrain_ue > 450.0) THEN
    bStratificationAlert := TRUE;
    dwAlarmWord1 := dwAlarmWord1 OR 16#0000_0080; (* Thermal Stratification Warning *)
ELSE
    bStratificationAlert := FALSE;
END_IF;

(* 5.4 Mitigator Vortex Induction Drive Synthesis *)
(* Proportional-derivative mitigation demand to break stratification boundary layer *)
IF bStratificationAlert OR bForceStratificationMitigation THEN
    rCurrentVortexCommand_pct := 35.0 + (rFilt_StratDeltaT_DegC * 1.8) + (rRichardsonNumber * 4.2);
    IF rCurrentVortexCommand_pct > 100.0 THEN
        rCurrentVortexCommand_pct := 100.0;
    END_IF;
ELSE
    (* Baseline gentle swirl to maintain uniform temperature distribution *)
    IF rFilt_StratDeltaT_DegC > 10.0 THEN
        rCurrentVortexCommand_pct := 15.0 + (rFilt_StratDeltaT_DegC * 0.8);
    ELSE
        rCurrentVortexCommand_pct := 5.0; (* Minimum idle circulation swirl *)
    END_IF;
END_IF;

(* Enforce Slew Rate Limiter on Mitigator Vortex Command (max 10.0 %/s) *)
IF rCurrentVortexCommand_pct > rStratificationMitigator_Drive_pct THEN
    rStratificationMitigator_Drive_pct := rStratificationMitigator_Drive_pct + (rVortexSlewLimit_pcts * rCycleTime_sec);
    IF rStratificationMitigator_Drive_pct > rCurrentVortexCommand_pct THEN
        rStratificationMitigator_Drive_pct := rCurrentVortexCommand_pct;
    END_IF;
ELSIF rCurrentVortexCommand_pct < rStratificationMitigator_Drive_pct THEN
    rStratificationMitigator_Drive_pct := rStratificationMitigator_Drive_pct - (rVortexSlewLimit_pcts * rCycleTime_sec);
    IF rStratificationMitigator_Drive_pct < rCurrentVortexCommand_pct THEN
        rStratificationMitigator_Drive_pct := rCurrentVortexCommand_pct;
    END_IF;
END_IF;

(* =====================================================================================================================
 * SECTION 6.0: BAYONET-TUBE STEAM GENERATOR FREEZE-PLUG ISOLATION & SGTR PROTECTION
 * =====================================================================================================================
 * Bayonet-Tube Steam Generator (BTSG) operates with high-pressure supercritical/subcritical water inside bayonets
 * immersed in low-pressure liquid LBE. In the event of bayonet tube failure (SGTR):
 * 1. Steam flashes into LBE causing acute pressure surge (dP/dt > 4.5 bar/s or P_steam drop).
 * 2. Rapid freeze-plug protection executes: trips electrical heating to 0 kW, actuates cryogenic jacket cooling.
 * 3. 1D Stefan phase-change solidification propagates radially, freezing LBE solid (< 123.5 deg C) in < 8.0 s.
 * ===================================================================================================================== *)

(* 6.1 Steam Generator Tube Rupture (SGTR) Detection Logic *)
(* Trigger conditions:
   a) Steam pressure drop rate exceeds 4.5 bar/s while LBE cover gas pressure spikes > 7.0 bar
   b) Disproportionate acoustic noise rise > 35 dB coincident with pressure disturbance
   c) Manual operator freeze command *)
IF (rFilt_SteamPressureRate_bars < -4.5 AND rLBE_CoverGasStaticPressure_bar > 6.5) OR
   (rAcousticWaveguide_ChA_dB > 115.0 AND rLBE_CoverGasStaticPressure_bar > 7.5) OR
   bForceFreezePlugSolidification THEN
    tSGTR_TripDebounceTimer(IN := TRUE, PT := T#150MS);
    IF tSGTR_TripDebounceTimer.Q THEN
        bSGTR_RuptureDetected := TRUE;
        dwAlarmWord1 := dwAlarmWord1 OR 16#0000_0100; (* Confirmed Steam Generator Tube Rupture (SGTR) *)
    END_IF;
ELSE
    tSGTR_TripDebounceTimer(IN := FALSE);
END_IF;

(* 6.2 Freeze-Plug Phase-Change State Evaluation *)
IF rFreezePlug_CoreCenterTemp_DegC <= rFreezePlug_MeltingPoint_DegC THEN
    bFreezePlugIsSolidSealed := TRUE;
    bFreezePlugIsOpenLiquid := FALSE;
    dwDiagnosticsWord := dwDiagnosticsWord OR 16#0000_0001; (* Freeze Plug Hermetically Solid *)
ELSIF rFreezePlug_CoreCenterTemp_DegC >= 210.0 THEN
    bFreezePlugIsSolidSealed := FALSE;
    bFreezePlugIsOpenLiquid := TRUE;
    dwDiagnosticsWord := dwDiagnosticsWord OR 16#0000_0002; (* Freeze Plug Fully Liquid Open *)
ELSE
    bFreezePlugIsSolidSealed := FALSE;
    bFreezePlugIsOpenLiquid := FALSE;
    dwDiagnosticsWord := dwDiagnosticsWord OR 16#0000_0004; (* Freeze Plug In Phase Transition *)
END_IF;

(* 6.3 Freeze-Plug Solidification / Melt Control Engine *)
IF bSGTR_RuptureDetected OR bEmergencyTripManual OR bReactorScramActive THEN
    (* EMERGENCY ISOLATION ACTIVATION *)
    (* Trip electrical heating instantly *)
    rFreezePlug_HeatingPowerDemand_kW := 0.0;
    (* Actuate cryogenic cooling jacket at 100% capacity *)
    rFreezePlug_CryoCoolingDemand_pct := 100.0;

    (* 1D Stefan Moving Boundary Solidification Front Estimation *)
    (* ds/dt = [k_sol*(T_melt - T_jacket) - k_liq*(T_core - T_melt)] / (rho * DeltaH_fus) *)
    IF rFreezePlugConduitRadius_m > 0.001 THEN
        rFreezeQuenchCoolingRate_DegCs := (rFreezePlug_MeltingPoint_DegC - rFreezePlug_AnnularJacketTemp_DegC) * 3.8;
    END_IF;
    dwAlarmWord1 := dwAlarmWord1 OR 16#0000_0200; (* Freeze Plug Fast Quench Active *)
ELSIF (iState = 0) OR (iState = 10) THEN
    (* COLD STANDBY / CONTROLLED THAWING MODE *)
    IF rFreezePlug_CoreCenterTemp_DegC < 250.0 THEN
        rFreezePlug_HeatingPowerDemand_kW := 18.0; (* Maximum trace heating for controlled melt *)
        rFreezePlug_CryoCoolingDemand_pct := 0.0;
    ELSE
        rFreezePlug_HeatingPowerDemand_kW := 8.5;  (* Maintenance trace heating *)
        rFreezePlug_CryoCoolingDemand_pct := 0.0;
    END_IF;
ELSE
    (* NORMAL POWER OPERATION - EQUILIBRIUM ACTIVE BARRIER *)
    (* Modulate heater and cooling jacket to maintain plug core stably at 265 deg C *)
    IF rFreezePlug_CoreCenterTemp_DegC < 260.0 THEN
        rFreezePlug_HeatingPowerDemand_kW := 10.5;
        rFreezePlug_CryoCoolingDemand_pct := 0.0;
    ELSIF rFreezePlug_CoreCenterTemp_DegC > 280.0 THEN
        rFreezePlug_HeatingPowerDemand_kW := 2.0;
        rFreezePlug_CryoCoolingDemand_pct := 15.0; (* Light trim cooling *)
    ELSE
        rFreezePlug_HeatingPowerDemand_kW := 6.0;  (* Steady balance *)
        rFreezePlug_CryoCoolingDemand_pct := 0.0;
    END_IF;
END_IF;

(* =====================================================================================================================
 * SECTION 7.0: DISCRETE STATE-SPACE OBSERVER & MODEL PREDICTIVE CONTROL (MPC)
 * =====================================================================================================================
 * Implements a 4th-order MIMO state-space dynamic model of the intermediate LBE loop coupled to the BTSG.
 * Model States:
 *   x1: LBE Hot Leg Temperature T_hot [deg C]
 *   x2: LBE Cold Leg Temperature T_cold [deg C]
 *   x3: Bayonet-Tube Heat Transfer Wall Temperature T_wall [deg C]
 *   x4: Header Thermal Stratification Differential DeltaT_strat [deg C]
 * Control Inputs:
 *   u1: LBE MHD Pump Flow Demand [%]
 *   u2: Stratification Mitigator Vortex Drive [%]
 * Solves discrete Luenberger observer: x_hat[k+1] = A*x_hat[k] + B*u[k] + L*(y[k] - C*x_hat[k])
 * Executes receding horizon quadratic cost optimization with input rate and saturation constraints.
 * ===================================================================================================================== *)

(* 7.1 Populate Discretized System Dynamic Matrices (A, B, C, D) *)
(* Discretization of continuous physics: dx/dt = Ac*x + Bc*u at Ts = 0.010 s *)
(* Matrix A: System State Transition *)
aMatrixA[1,1] := 0.9945;  aMatrixA[1,2] := 0.0032;  aMatrixA[1,3] := 0.0018;  aMatrixA[1,4] := -0.0008;
aMatrixA[2,1] := 0.0021;  aMatrixA[2,2] := 0.9915;  aMatrixA[2,3] := 0.0045;  aMatrixA[2,4] := 0.0005;
aMatrixA[3,1] := 0.0042;  aMatrixA[3,2] := 0.0058;  aMatrixA[3,3] := 0.9880;  aMatrixA[3,4] := -0.0012;
aMatrixA[4,1] := 0.0015;  aMatrixA[4,2] := -0.0022; aMatrixA[4,3] := -0.0009; aMatrixA[4,4] := 0.9820;

(* Matrix B: Control Input Coupling *)
aMatrixB[1,1] := 0.0145;  aMatrixB[1,2] := -0.0012;
aMatrixB[2,1] := -0.0185; aMatrixB[2,2] := 0.0008;
aMatrixB[3,1] := -0.0092; aMatrixB[3,2] := -0.0025;
aMatrixB[4,1] := -0.0320; aMatrixB[4,2] := -0.0450;

(* Matrix C: Measurement Output Observation Matrix *)
aMatrixC[1,1] := 1.0; aMatrixC[1,2] := 0.0; aMatrixC[1,3] := 0.0; aMatrixC[1,4] := 0.0;
aMatrixC[2,1] := 0.0; aMatrixC[2,2] := 1.0; aMatrixC[2,3] := 0.0; aMatrixC[2,4] := 0.0;
aMatrixC[3,1] := 0.0; aMatrixC[3,2] := 0.0; aMatrixC[3,3] := 1.0; aMatrixC[3,4] := 0.0;
aMatrixC[4,1] := 0.0; aMatrixC[4,2] := 0.0; aMatrixC[4,3] := 0.0; aMatrixC[4,4] := 1.0;

(* Observer Gain Matrix L (Kalman/Luenberger pole placement) *)
aObserverGainL[1,1] := 0.185; aObserverGainL[1,2] := 0.012; aObserverGainL[1,3] := 0.005; aObserverGainL[1,4] := 0.001;
aObserverGainL[2,1] := 0.010; aObserverGainL[2,2] := 0.192; aObserverGainL[2,3] := 0.008; aObserverGainL[2,4] := 0.002;
aObserverGainL[3,1] := 0.006; aObserverGainL[3,2] := 0.011; aObserverGainL[3,3] := 0.178; aObserverGainL[3,4] := 0.003;
aObserverGainL[4,1] := 0.002; aObserverGainL[4,2] := 0.004; aObserverGainL[4,3] := 0.005; aObserverGainL[4,4] := 0.210;

(* 7.2 Assemble Process Measurements into Vector y *)
aOutputMeasurement_y[1] := rIHX_LBE_OutletTemp_DegC;
aOutputMeasurement_y[2] := rVoted_IHX_InletTemp_DegC;
aOutputMeasurement_y[3] := (rIHX_LBE_OutletTemp_DegC + rVoted_IHX_InletTemp_DegC) * 0.5;
aOutputMeasurement_y[4] := rFilt_StratDeltaT_DegC;

(* 7.3 Observer State Correction Step: e = y - C*x_hat *)
FOR iRow := 1 TO 4 DO
    aObserverResidual_e[iRow] := aOutputMeasurement_y[iRow] - aStateEstimate_x[iRow];
END_FOR;

(* State Update: x_hat[k+1] = A*x_hat[k] + B*u[k] + L*e[k] *)
FOR iRow := 1 TO 4 DO
    aStatePredicted_x[iRow] := 0.0;
    FOR iCol := 1 TO 4 DO
        aStatePredicted_x[iRow] := aStatePredicted_x[iRow] + (aMatrixA[iRow, iCol] * aStateEstimate_x[iCol]);
    END_FOR;
    aStatePredicted_x[iRow] := aStatePredicted_x[iRow] + (aMatrixB[iRow, 1] * aControlInput_u[1]) + (aMatrixB[iRow, 2] * aControlInput_u[2]);
    FOR iCol := 1 TO 4 DO
        aStatePredicted_x[iRow] := aStatePredicted_x[iRow] + (aObserverGainL[iRow, iCol] * aObserverResidual_e[iCol]);
    END_FOR;
END_FOR;

(* Transfer predicted states to estimate registers *)
FOR iRow := 1 TO 4 DO
    aStateEstimate_x[iRow] := aStatePredicted_x[iRow];
END_FOR;

(* 7.4 Model Predictive Control (MPC) Quadratic Cost Optimization *)
(* MPC Cost Formulation: J = sum((x_hat - r)^T * Q * (x_hat - r)) + u^T * R * u + delta_u^T * S * delta_u *)
(* State Reference Trajectories *)
aStateSetpoint_r[1] := 550.0; (* Target Hot Leg Temperature [deg C] *)
aStateSetpoint_r[2] := 380.0; (* Target Cold Leg Temperature [deg C] *)
aStateSetpoint_r[3] := 440.0; (* Target Bayonet Wall Temperature [deg C] *)
aStateSetpoint_r[4] := 0.0;   (* Target Stratification Differential [deg C] *)

(* Weighting Factors *)
aWeightMatrixQ[1] := 1.50;  (* Hot leg error penalty *)
aWeightMatrixQ[2] := 1.80;  (* Cold leg error penalty *)
aWeightMatrixQ[3] := 0.80;  (* Wall thermal gradient penalty *)
aWeightMatrixQ[4] := 4.50;  (* Thermal stratification penalty *)
aWeightMatrixR[1] := 0.08;  (* Pump control effort penalty *)
aWeightMatrixR[2] := 0.05;  (* Vortex mixer effort penalty *)
aWeightMatrixS[1] := 0.25;  (* Pump slew penalty *)
aWeightMatrixS[2] := 0.15;  (* Vortex slew penalty *)

(* Calculate Quadratic Cost and Numerical Gradient *)
rMPC_PredictedCost := 0.0;
FOR iRow := 1 TO 4 DO
    rMPC_PredictedCost := rMPC_PredictedCost + (aWeightMatrixQ[iRow] * (aStateEstimate_x[iRow] - aStateSetpoint_r[iRow]) * (aStateEstimate_x[iRow] - aStateSetpoint_r[iRow]));
END_FOR;
rMPC_PredictedCost := rMPC_PredictedCost + (aWeightMatrixR[1] * aControlInput_u[1] * aControlInput_u[1]) +
                                          (aWeightMatrixR[2] * aControlInput_u[2] * aControlInput_u[2]);

(* Analytical Gradient Approximations for Feedback Slew *)
rGradientPump := (2.0 * aWeightMatrixQ[4] * (aStateEstimate_x[4] - aStateSetpoint_r[4]) * aMatrixB[4,1]) +
                 (2.0 * aWeightMatrixR[1] * aControlInput_u[1]) +
                 (2.0 * aWeightMatrixS[1] * (aControlInput_u[1] - aControlInputPrev_u[1]));

rGradientVortex := (2.0 * aWeightMatrixQ[4] * (aStateEstimate_x[4] - aStateSetpoint_r[4]) * aMatrixB[4,2]) +
                   (2.0 * aWeightMatrixR[2] * aControlInput_u[2]) +

  1.5 OPTICAL CONTACT ARC EXTINCTION VIA HIGH-SPEED DYNAMIC RE-ENGAGEMENT:
      When dynamic contact force drops to zero (Fc <= 0), contact separation occurs under high current
      (up to 1,500 A RMS at 25 kV AC). The resulting plasma arc exceeds 12,000 K, evaporating contact
      wire copper and cratering the carbon collector strips.
      An optical ultraviolet phototube sensor (spectral sensitivity 240 - 320 nm, blind to solar rays)
      detects arc ignition within 0.5 ms. The controller immediately overrides normal regulation,
      injecting an instantaneous aerodynamic pitch-up kick (+6.5 deg) and pneumatic pulse (+0.45 bar)
      to force physical re-engagement and quench the plasma arc within 8.0 ms, enforcing EN 50367
      contact loss arcing percentage NQ < 0.10%.

  1.6 TRIPLE MODULAR REDUNDANCY (2oo3 TMR) SENSOR INTEGRITY MANAGEMENT:
      Three physically segregated force transducers monitor contact force:
        - Sensor Channel A: Left panhead strain-gauge load bridge.
        - Sensor Channel B: Right panhead strain-gauge load bridge.
        - Sensor Channel C: Central high-bandwidth piezoelectric quartz load link.
      A cross-channel disparity evaluation algorithm tracks inter-sensor deviations. Any transducer
      exceeding a 28.0 N divergence for longer than 50 ms is isolated, seamlessly transitioning
      the mechatronic controller from 3oo3 Median Value Selection (MVS) to 2oo2 Averaging,
      1oo1 Single-Channel Degraded mode, or Fail-Safe Open-Loop Aerodynamic Velocity Scheduling.

  1.7 DISCRETE KALMAN FILTER (DKF) 6-STATE MECHATRONIC OBSERVER:
      Continuous-time states x = [z1, dz1, z2, dz2, Fc, P_bellows]^T are discretized via zero-order
      hold (ZOH) at Ts = 0.001 s. The state observer eliminates high-frequency aerodynamic noise,
      provides real-time estimates of unmeasured panhead velocity, and estimates true contact force.

  1.8 MODEL PREDICTIVE CONTROL (MPC) REFINED QUADRATIC PROGRAMMING:
      The multi-variable control problem solves an online quadratic program (QP) over a prediction
      horizon Np = 4 and control horizon Nc = 2, penalizing tracking error against the EN 50367
      normative target force Fm = 70 + 0.00097 * v^2 [N] and minimizing actuator slew rates,
      subject to hard constraints on aerodynamic stall angles and pneumatic supply pressures.

  1.9 PNEUMATIC AUTO-DROP DEVICE (ADD) RAPID EVACUATION SYSTEM:
      In accordance with EN 50206-1, the collector carbon strips contain an internal hollow channel
      charged with compressed air at 4.5 bar. If a carbon strip sustains a mechanical fracture or
      catenary hook impact, air vents to atmosphere, causing channel pressure to collapse (< 2.0 bar).
      This immediately triggers the mechanical ADD rapid exhaust valve, forcing the pantograph to drop
      clear of the catenary wire within 350 ms, preventing catenary tear-down.
====================================================================================================
*)

(*
====================================================================================================
  CYCLIC MECHATRONIC LOGIC EXECUTION (1.000 ms SAMPLING PERIOD)
====================================================================================================
*)

(* --- 0. HEARTBEAT PULSE & CYCLIC METRICS --- *)
iHeartbeatDivider := iHeartbeatDivider + 1;
IF iHeartbeatDivider >= 500 THEN
    bBlinkerFlag := NOT bBlinkerFlag;
    iHeartbeatDivider := 0;
END_IF;

(* Convert forward train speed from km/h to m/s *)
rTrainSpeed_mps := rTrainSpeed_kmh * 0.27777778;

(*
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  MODULE 1: SAFETY INTERLOCKS & AUTO-DROP DEVICE (ADD) RAPID RETRACTION
  Meets EN 50206-1 standards for rapid contact strip venting and emergency drop.
  Monitors both external TCMS commands and carbon strip pneumatic chamber pressure.
  If the pressurized carbon strip fractures, pressure drops below 2.2 bar, forcing immediate ADD.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
*)
tAddPneumaticDebounce(IN := (rCarbonStripPressure_bar < c_fAddPressureThreshold_bar) AND (iState >= 30), PT := T#8MS);

IF (bEmergencyLower) OR (tAddPneumaticDebounce.Q) OR (NOT bMasterEnable AND (iState > 10)) THEN
    (* Immediate de-energization and rapid exhaust *)
    bEmergencyDropTriggered := TRUE;
    rPneumaticPressureDemand_bar := 0.0;
    rAeroFlapDemand_deg := c_fFlapAngleMin_deg; (* Maximum aerodynamic down-force pitch *)
    rDynamicDampingTorque_Nm := 0.0;
    bArcSuppressionActive := FALSE;
    iState := 100; (* Transition directly to EMERGENCY_AUTO_DROP *)
END_IF;

(*
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  MODULE 2: THERMODYNAMIC AIR DENSITY & CATENARY WIRE TENSION COMPENSATION
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
*)
(* Real-time ambient air density calculation via ideal gas law *)
IF (rAmbientTemperature_degC > -50.0) AND (rAmbientTemperature_degC < 80.0) THEN
    rAirDensity_kgpm3 := c_fNominalPressure_Pa / (c_fAirGasConstant_JpkgK * (rAmbientTemperature_degC + 273.15));
ELSE
    rAirDensity_kgpm3 := 1.225; (* Fallback nominal density at 15 deg C *)
END_IF;

(* Dynamic contact wire tension calculation incorporating thermal strain *)
rEffectiveWireTension_N := c_fWireNominalTension_N * (1.0 - (c_fWireThermalExpansion * (rAmbientTemperature_degC - 20.0)));
IF rEffectiveWireTension_N < 20000.0 THEN
    rEffectiveWireTension_N := 20000.0; (* Mechanical tension minimum safety floor *)
ELSIF rEffectiveWireTension_N > 45000.0 THEN
    rEffectiveWireTension_N := 45000.0;
END_IF;

(* Transverse wave propagation velocity on the contact wire: c = sqrt(T / mu) *)
IF c_fWireLinearMass_kgpm > 0.05 THEN
    rCatenaryWaveSpeed_mps := SQRT(rEffectiveWireTension_N / c_fWireLinearMass_kgpm);
ELSE
    rCatenaryWaveSpeed_mps := 159.44;
END_IF;

(* Doppler Mach Number: Mc = v_train / c_wave *)
IF rCatenaryWaveSpeed_mps > 10.0 THEN
    rDopplerMachNumber := rTrainSpeed_mps / rCatenaryWaveSpeed_mps;
ELSE
    rDopplerMachNumber := 0.0;
END_IF;
rWaveSpeedRatio_Mach := rDopplerMachNumber;

(* Dynamic pressure calculation for aerodynamic surfaces: q = 0.5 * rho * v^2 *)
rDynamicPressure_Pa := 0.5 * rAirDensity_kgpm3 * rTrainSpeed_mps * rTrainSpeed_mps;

(*
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  MODULE 3: TRIPLE MODULAR REDUNDANCY (2oo3 TMR) SENSOR VOTING & DISCREPANCY ISOLATION
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
*)
(* Cross-channel disparity calculation *)
rDiscrepancy_AB_N := ABS(rContactForce_SensorA_N - rContactForce_SensorB_N);
rDiscrepancy_BC_N := ABS(rContactForce_SensorB_N - rContactForce_SensorC_N);
rDiscrepancy_CA_N := ABS(rContactForce_SensorC_N - rContactForce_SensorA_N);

(* Channel A Health Evaluation *)
IF (rDiscrepancy_AB_N > c_fDiscrepancyLimit_N) AND (rDiscrepancy_CA_N > c_fDiscrepancyLimit_N) THEN
    iDiscrepancyCycles_A := iDiscrepancyCycles_A + 1;
    IF iDiscrepancyCycles_A > c_iMaxDiscrepancyCycles THEN
        bSensorA_Healthy := FALSE;
    END_IF;
ELSE
    IF iDiscrepancyCycles_A > 0 THEN
        iDiscrepancyCycles_A := iDiscrepancyCycles_A - 1;
    END_IF;
    IF iDiscrepancyCycles_A = 0 THEN
        bSensorA_Healthy := TRUE;
    END_IF;
END_IF;

(* Channel B Health Evaluation *)
IF (rDiscrepancy_AB_N > c_fDiscrepancyLimit_N) AND (rDiscrepancy_BC_N > c_fDiscrepancyLimit_N) THEN
    iDiscrepancyCycles_B := iDiscrepancyCycles_B + 1;
    IF iDiscrepancyCycles_B > c_iMaxDiscrepancyCycles THEN
        bSensorB_Healthy := FALSE;
    END_IF;
ELSE
    IF iDiscrepancyCycles_B > 0 THEN
        iDiscrepancyCycles_B := iDiscrepancyCycles_B - 1;
    END_IF;
    IF iDiscrepancyCycles_B = 0 THEN
        bSensorB_Healthy := TRUE;
    END_IF;
END_IF;

(* Channel C Health Evaluation *)
IF (rDiscrepancy_BC_N > c_fDiscrepancyLimit_N) AND (rDiscrepancy_CA_N > c_fDiscrepancyLimit_N) THEN
    iDiscrepancyCycles_C := iDiscrepancyCycles_C + 1;
    IF iDiscrepancyCycles_C > c_iMaxDiscrepancyCycles THEN
        bSensorC_Healthy := FALSE;
    END_IF;
ELSE
    IF iDiscrepancyCycles_C > 0 THEN
        iDiscrepancyCycles_C := iDiscrepancyCycles_C - 1;
    END_IF;
    IF iDiscrepancyCycles_C = 0 THEN
        bSensorC_Healthy := TRUE;
    END_IF;
END_IF;

(* Compute Active Healthy Sensor Count *)
iHealthySensorCount := 0;
IF bSensorA_Healthy THEN
    iHealthySensorCount := iHealthySensorCount + 1;
END_IF;
IF bSensorB_Healthy THEN
    iHealthySensorCount := iHealthySensorCount + 1;
END_IF;
IF bSensorC_Healthy THEN
    iHealthySensorCount := iHealthySensorCount + 1;
END_IF;

(* Graceful Degradation Selection Algorithm *)
IF iHealthySensorCount = 3 THEN
    (* 3oo3 Median Value Selection (MVS) *)
    IF ((rContactForce_SensorA_N >= rContactForce_SensorB_N) AND (rContactForce_SensorA_N <= rContactForce_SensorC_N)) OR
       ((rContactForce_SensorA_N <= rContactForce_SensorB_N) AND (rContactForce_SensorA_N >= rContactForce_SensorC_N)) THEN
        rVotedContactForce_N := rContactForce_SensorA_N;
    ELSIF ((rContactForce_SensorB_N >= rContactForce_SensorA_N) AND (rContactForce_SensorB_N <= rContactForce_SensorC_N)) OR
          ((rContactForce_SensorB_N <= rContactForce_SensorA_N) AND (rContactForce_SensorB_N >= rContactForce_SensorC_N)) THEN
        rVotedContactForce_N := rContactForce_SensorB_N;
    ELSE
        rVotedContactForce_N := rContactForce_SensorC_N;
    END_IF;
ELSIF iHealthySensorCount = 2 THEN
    (* 2oo2 Averaging Mode *)
    IF bSensorA_Healthy AND bSensorB_Healthy THEN
        rVotedContactForce_N := 0.5 * (rContactForce_SensorA_N + rContactForce_SensorB_N);
    ELSIF bSensorB_Healthy AND bSensorC_Healthy THEN
        rVotedContactForce_N := 0.5 * (rContactForce_SensorB_N + rContactForce_SensorC_N);
    ELSE
        rVotedContactForce_N := 0.5 * (rContactForce_SensorA_N + rContactForce_SensorC_N);
    END_IF;
ELSIF iHealthySensorCount = 1 THEN
    (* 1oo1 Single Channel Degraded Mode *)
    IF bSensorA_Healthy THEN
        rVotedContactForce_N := rContactForce_SensorA_N;
    ELSIF bSensorB_Healthy THEN
        rVotedContactForce_N := rContactForce_SensorB_N;
    ELSE
        rVotedContactForce_N := rContactForce_SensorC_N;
    END_IF;
ELSE
    (* Total Sensor Failure: Force Fallback to Open-Loop Aerodynamic Trim *)
    rVotedContactForce_N := rRunningMeanForce_N;
END_IF;

(* Update Sensor Noise Variances via Exponential Smoothing *)
rSensorVarA := (0.98 * rSensorVarA) + (0.02 * (rContactForce_SensorA_N - rVotedContactForce_N) * (rContactForce_SensorA_N - rVotedContactForce_N));
rSensorVarB := (0.98 * rSensorVarB) + (0.02 * (rContactForce_SensorB_N - rVotedContactForce_N) * (rContactForce_SensorB_N - rVotedContactForce_N));
rSensorVarC := (0.98 * rSensorVarC) + (0.02 * (rContactForce_SensorC_N - rVotedContactForce_N) * (rContactForce_SensorC_N - rVotedContactForce_N));

(*
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  MODULE 4: DISCRETE KALMAN FILTER STATE OBSERVER
  Estimates the full 6-dimensional internal state vector from noisy sensor inputs.
  States: x = [z1, dz1, z2, dz2, Fc, P_bellows]^T
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
*)
VAR_TEMP
    rInno_1 : REAL;
    rInno_2 : REAL;
    rStatePred_z1 : REAL;
    rStatePred_dz1 : REAL;
    rStatePred_z2 : REAL;
    rStatePred_dz2 : REAL;
    rStatePred_Fc : REAL;
    rStatePred_Pb : REAL;
END_VAR

(* Step 4.1: Compute Innovations: residual = y - y_pred *)
rInno_1 := rVotedContactForce_N - rStateEst_Fc_N;
rInno_2 := rMainBellowsPressure_bar - rStateEst_Pbellows_bar;

(* Step 4.2: Time Propagation / State Prediction: x_pred = Ad * x + Bd * u *)
rStatePred_z1 := (Ad_11 * rStateEst_z1_m) + (Ad_12 * rStateEst_dz1_mps) + (Ad_13 * rStateEst_z2_m) + (Ad_14 * rStateEst_dz2_mps) + (Ad_15 * rStateEst_Fc_N) + (Ad_16 * rStateEst_Pbellows_bar) + (Bd_11 * rAerodynamicPitchAngle_deg) + (Bd_12 * rPneumaticPressureDemand_bar);
rStatePred_dz1 := (Ad_21 * rStateEst_z1_m) + (Ad_22 * rStateEst_dz1_mps) + (Ad_23 * rStateEst_z2_m) + (Ad_24 * rStateEst_dz2_mps) + (Ad_25 * rStateEst_Fc_N) + (Ad_26 * rStateEst_Pbellows_bar) + (Bd_21 * rAerodynamicPitchAngle_deg) + (Bd_22 * rPneumaticPressureDemand_bar);
rStatePred_z2 := (Ad_31 * rStateEst_z1_m) + (Ad_32 * rStateEst_dz1_mps) + (Ad_33 * rStateEst_z2_m) + (Ad_34 * rStateEst_dz2_mps) + (Ad_35 * rStateEst_Fc_N) + (Ad_36 * rStateEst_Pbellows_bar) + (Bd_31 * rAerodynamicPitchAngle_deg) + (Bd_32 * rPneumaticPressureDemand_bar);
rStatePred_dz2 := (Ad_41 * rStateEst_z1_m) + (Ad_42 * rStateEst_dz1_mps) + (Ad_43 * rStateEst_z2_m) + (Ad_44 * rStateEst_dz2_mps) + (Ad_45 * rStateEst_Fc_N) + (Ad_46 * rStateEst_Pbellows_bar) + (Bd_41 * rAerodynamicPitchAngle_deg) + (Bd_42 * rPneumaticPressureDemand_bar);
rStatePred_Fc := (Ad_51 * rStateEst_z1_m) + (Ad_52 * rStateEst_dz1_mps) + (Ad_53 * rStateEst_z2_m) + (Ad_54 * rStateEst_dz2_mps) + (Ad_55 * rStateEst_Fc_N) + (Ad_56 * rStateEst_Pbellows_bar) + (Bd_51 * rAerodynamicPitchAngle_deg) + (Bd_52 * rPneumaticPressureDemand_bar);
rStatePred_Pb := (Ad_61 * rStateEst_z1_m) + (Ad_62 * rStateEst_dz1_mps) + (Ad_63 * rStateEst_z2_m) + (Ad_64 * rStateEst_dz2_mps) + (Ad_65 * rStateEst_Fc_N) + (Ad_66 * rStateEst_Pbellows_bar) + (Bd_61 * rAerodynamicPitchAngle_deg) + (Bd_62 * rPneumaticPressureDemand_bar);

(* Step 4.3: Measurement Update: x_est = x_pred + Lk * Innovation *)
rStateEst_z1_m := rStatePred_z1 + (Lk_11 * rInno_1) + (Lk_12 * rInno_2);
rStateEst_dz1_mps := rStatePred_dz1 + (Lk_21 * rInno_1) + (Lk_22 * rInno_2);
rStateEst_z2_m := rStatePred_z2 + (Lk_31 * rInno_1) + (Lk_32 * rInno_2);
rStateEst_dz2_mps := rStatePred_dz2 + (Lk_41 * rInno_1) + (Lk_42 * rInno_2);
rStateEst_Fc_N := rStatePred_Fc + (Lk_51 * rInno_1) + (Lk_52 * rInno_2);
rStateEst_Pbellows_bar := rStatePred_Pb + (Lk_61 * rInno_1) + (Lk_62 * rInno_2);

(* Assigned Validated Output *)
rEstimatedContactForce_N := rStateEst_Fc_N;

(*
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  MODULE 5: TARGET UPLIFT FORCE COMPUTATION (EN 50367 / TSI HIGH SPEED REGULATION)
  Normative formula: Fm = 70 + 0.00097 * v^2 [N]
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
*)
rTargetContactForce_N := 70.0 + (0.00097 * rTrainSpeed_kmh * rTrainSpeed_kmh);
IF rTargetContactForce_N > 280.0 THEN
    rTargetContactForce_N := 280.0; (* Upper ceiling for aerodynamic uplift *)
END_IF;

(*
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  MODULE 6: MODEL PREDICTIVE CONTROL (MPC) REFINED QUADRATIC PROGRAMMING
  Solves optimal control increments dU = [d_alpha, d_P] to eliminate contact force tracking error.
  Implements Hildreth's Dual Quadratic Programming algorithm over box constraints.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
*)
VAR_TEMP
    rForceTrackingError_N : REAL;
    rPressureTrackingError_bar : REAL;
    rStaticBellowsTarget_bar : REAL;
    rRawDeltaAlpha : REAL;
    rRawDeltaPneu : REAL;
    iIter : INT;
    rLagrangeStep : REAL;
END_VAR

rForceTrackingError_N := rEstimatedContactForce_N - rTargetContactForce_N;

(* Quasi-static bellows target pressure based on train speed uplift equilibrium *)
rStaticBellowsTarget_bar := 3.20 + (0.000015 * rTrainSpeed_kmh * rTrainSpeed_kmh);
IF rStaticBellowsTarget_bar > 5.50 THEN
    rStaticBellowsTarget_bar := 5.50;
END_IF;
rPressureTrackingError_bar := rStateEst_Pbellows_bar - rStaticBellowsTarget_bar;

(* Compute Linear Gradient Vectors: g = M_err^T * Q * Error *)
rMpcGrad_1 := (1.8542 * rForceTrackingError_N) + (0.1245 * rStateEst_dz1_mps * 100.0);
rMpcGrad_2 := (0.4215 * rForceTrackingError_N) + (24.502 * rPressureTrackingError_bar);
rMpcGrad_3 := 0.6520 * rMpcGrad_1;
rMpcGrad_4 := 0.7015 * rMpcGrad_2;

(* Unconstrained QP Solution: dU_opt = -H_inv * g *)
rRawDeltaAlpha := -((Hinv_11 * rMpcGrad_1) + (Hinv_12 * rMpcGrad_2) + (Hinv_13 * rMpcGrad_3) + (Hinv_14 * rMpcGrad_4));
rRawDeltaPneu  := -((Hinv_21 * rMpcGrad_1) + (Hinv_22 * rMpcGrad_2) + (Hinv_23 * rMpcGrad_3) + (Hinv_24 * rMpcGrad_4));

(* Hildreth Dual Active-Set Projected Iterations for Box Slew Constraints *)
FOR iIter := 1 TO c_iHildrethMaxIterations DO
    (* Multiplier 1: Upper slew bound on flap *)
    rLagrangeStep := rRawDeltaAlpha - (c_fFlapSlewMax_degps * c_fSampleTime_s);
    IF (aLagrangeLambda[1] + (0.0085 * rLagrangeStep)) > 0.0 THEN
        aLagrangeLambda[1] := aLagrangeLambda[1] + (0.0085 * rLagrangeStep);
    ELSE
        aLagrangeLambda[1] := 0.0;
    END_IF;

    (* Multiplier 2: Lower slew bound on flap *)
    rLagrangeStep := -(rRawDeltaAlpha) - (c_fFlapSlewMax_degps * c_fSampleTime_s);
    IF (aLagrangeLambda[2] + (0.0085 * rLagrangeStep)) > 0.0 THEN
        aLagrangeLambda[2] := aLagrangeLambda[2] + (0.0085 * rLagrangeStep);
    ELSE
        aLagrangeLambda[2] := 0.0;
    END_IF;

    (* Multiplier 3: Upper slew bound on pressure *)
    rLagrangeStep := rRawDeltaPneu - (c_fPressureSlewMax_barps * c_fSampleTime_s);
    IF (aLagrangeLambda[3] + (0.0012 * rLagrangeStep)) > 0.0 THEN
        aLagrangeLambda[3] := aLagrangeLambda[3] + (0.0012 * rLagrangeStep);
    ELSE
        aLagrangeLambda[3] := 0.0;
    END_IF;

    (* Multiplier 4: Lower slew bound on pressure *)
    rLagrangeStep := -(rRawDeltaPneu) - (c_fPressureSlewMax_barps * c_fSampleTime_s);
    IF (aLagrangeLambda[4] + (0.0012 * rLagrangeStep)) > 0.0 THEN
        aLagrangeLambda[4] := aLagrangeLambda[4] + (0.0012 * rLagrangeStep);
    ELSE
        aLagrangeLambda[4] := 0.0;
    END_IF;
END_FOR;

(* Projected Gradient Result *)
rDeltaU_Opt_1 := rRawDeltaAlpha - (Hinv_11 * (aLagrangeLambda[1] - aLagrangeLambda[2]));
rDeltaU_Opt_2 := rRawDeltaPneu - (Hinv_22 * (aLagrangeLambda[3] - aLagrangeLambda[4]));

(* Saturated Hard Limit Checks *)
IF rDeltaU_Opt_1 > (c_fFlapSlewMax_degps * c_fSampleTime_s) THEN
    rDeltaU_Opt_1 := c_fFlapSlewMax_degps * c_fSampleTime_s;
ELSIF rDeltaU_Opt_1 < -(c_fFlapSlewMax_degps * c_fSampleTime_s) THEN
    rDeltaU_Opt_1 := -(c_fFlapSlewMax_degps * c_fSampleTime_s);
END_IF;

IF rDeltaU_Opt_2 > (c_fPressureSlewMax_barps * c_fSampleTime_s) THEN
    rDeltaU_Opt_2 := c_fPressureSlewMax_barps * c_fSampleTime_s;
ELSIF rDeltaU_Opt_2 < -(c_fPressureSlewMax_barps * c_fSampleTime_s) THEN
    rDeltaU_Opt_2 := -(c_fPressureSlewMax_barps * c_fSampleTime_s);
END_IF;

(*
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  MODULE 7: CATENARY WAVE SPEED DOPPLER DAMPING (ANTI-RESONANCE BI-QUAD FILTER)
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
*)
(* Compute Dropper Passage Excitation Frequency: f = v / L_dropper *)
IF c_fDropperSpacing_m > 1.0 THEN
    rDropperFrequency_Hz := rTrainSpeed_mps / c_fDropperSpacing_m;
ELSE
    rDropperFrequency_Hz := 0.0;
END_IF;

(* Compute Mast Span Passage Frequency: f_span = v / L_span *)
IF c_fSpanLength_m > 10.0 THEN
    rSpanFrequency_Hz := rTrainSpeed_mps / c_fSpanLength_m;
ELSE
    rSpanFrequency_Hz := 0.0;
END_IF;

(* Dynamic Doppler Amplification Compensation Gain *)
IF rDopplerMachNumber < 0.90 THEN
    rDopplerDampingGain := 1.0 / (1.0 - (0.85 * rDopplerMachNumber));
ELSE
    rDopplerDampingGain := 4.25; (* Clamped ceiling to prevent loop instability near sound speed *)
END_IF;

(* Update Bi-Quad Resonant Filter tuned to Dropper Frequency Harmonic *)
(* Canonical Direct Form II Transposed Structure *)
rBiquad_y := (rBiquad_b0 * rForceTrackingError_N) + rBiquad_x1;
rBiquad_x1 := (rBiquad_b1 * rForceTrackingError_N) - (rBiquad_a1 * rBiquad_y) + rBiquad_x2;
rBiquad_x2 := (rBiquad_b2 * rForceTrackingError_N) - (rBiquad_a2 * rBiquad_y);

(* Anti-Phase Dynamic Torque Generation for Pitch Frame Damping *)
rDynamicDampingTorque_Nm := -1.0 * rDopplerDampingGain * (rBiquad_y * 0.45);
IF rDynamicDampingTorque_Nm > 150.0 THEN
    rDynamicDampingTorque_Nm := 150.0;
ELSIF rDynamicDampingTorque_Nm < -150.0 THEN
    rDynamicDampingTorque_Nm := -150.0;
END_IF;

(* Online Dropper Harmonic Power Tracking via Goertzel Algorithm *)
rGoertzel_s0 := rForceTrackingError_N + (1.854 * rGoertzel_s1) - rGoertzel_s2;
rGoertzel_s2 := rGoertzel_s1;
rGoertzel_s1 := rGoertzel_s0;
iGoertzelSampleCount := iGoertzelSampleCount + 1;
IF iGoertzelSampleCount >= 64 THEN
    rDropperHarmonicPower_W := (rGoertzel_s1 * rGoertzel_s1) + (rGoertzel_s2 * rGoertzel_s2) - (1.854 * rGoertzel_s1 * rGoertzel_s2);
    rGoertzel_s0 := 0.0;
    rGoertzel_s1 := 0.0;
    rGoertzel_s2 := 0.0;
    iGoertzelSampleCount := 0;
END_IF;

(*
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  MODULE 8: OPTICAL CONTACT ARC EXTINCTION VIA HIGH-SPEED DYNAMIC RE-ENGAGEMENT
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
*)
rTotalEvaluationTime_s := rTotalEvaluationTime_s + c_fSampleTime_s;

(* Arc Detection via UV Sensor Voltage Threshold *)
IF (rOpticalArcSensorUV_V >= c_fArcDetectionThreshold_V) AND (rCatenaryVoltage_V > 10000.0) THEN
    rIntegratedArcTime_s := rIntegratedArcTime_s + c_fSampleTime_s;
    iArcIgnitionEventsTotal := iArcIgnitionEventsTotal + 1;
    bArcSuppressionActive := TRUE;
    (* Trigger Instantaneous Aerodynamic Pitch-Up Boost *)
    rArcPulseDecay := c_fArcExtinctionBoost_deg;
ELSE
    (* Exponential Decay of Arc Extinction Pulse (tau ~ 12 ms) *)
    IF rArcPulseDecay > 0.05 THEN
        rArcPulseDecay := rArcPulseDecay * 0.92;
    ELSE
        rArcPulseDecay := 0.0;
        bArcSuppressionActive := FALSE;
    END_IF;
END_IF;

(* Running Contact Loss Percentage NQ (EN 50367 / EN 50318 standard) *)
IF rTotalEvaluationTime_s >= 10.0 THEN
    rContactLossRatio_NQ := (rIntegratedArcTime_s / rTotalEvaluationTime_s) * 100.0;
    (* Reset sliding window periodically *)
    rIntegratedArcTime_s := rIntegratedArcTime_s * 0.5;
    rTotalEvaluationTime_s := rTotalEvaluationTime_s * 0.5;
END_IF;

(*
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  MODULE 9: TUNNEL AERODYNAMIC BOW SHOCK FEEDFORWARD COMPENSATION
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
*)
bTunnelEntryEdge := bTunnelEntryZone AND NOT bTunnelZonePrev;
bTunnelZonePrev := bTunnelEntryZone;

IF bTunnelEntryEdge THEN
    (* Inject forward pitch downfeed to counteract the intense aerodynamic nose shock *)
    rTunnelCompProfile := -3.50 * (rTrainSpeed_kmh / 400.0) * (rTrainSpeed_kmh / 400.0);
    tTunnelDecayTimer(IN := FALSE);
END_IF;

IF rTunnelCompProfile < -0.05 THEN
    tTunnelDecayTimer(IN := TRUE, PT := T#2500MS);
    rTunnelCompProfile := rTunnelCompProfile * 0.995;
    IF tTunnelDecayTimer.Q THEN
        rTunnelCompProfile := 0.0;
    END_IF;
ELSE
    rTunnelCompProfile := 0.0;
    tTunnelDecayTimer(IN := FALSE);
END_IF;

(*
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  MODULE 10: COLLECTOR STRIP THERMAL DYNAMICS & CUMULATIVE WEAR INTEGRATOR
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
*)
(* Frictional and Joule heating dissipation *)
rCumulativeFrictionEnergy_J := rCumulativeFrictionEnergy_J + (rEstimatedContactForce_N * rTrainSpeed_mps * 0.12 * c_fSampleTime_s);
rCarbonStripTempEst_degC := (0.9998 * rCarbonStripTempEst_degC) + (0.0002 * (rAmbientTemperature_degC + (0.0015 * rCumulativeFrictionEnergy_J * 0.001)));

(* Cumulative carbon wear percentage estimation (100% = 25 mm allowable wear depth) *)
rEstimatedStripWear_pct := (rCumulativeFrictionEnergy_J / 450000000.0) * 100.0;
IF rEstimatedStripWear_pct > 100.0 THEN
    rEstimatedStripWear_pct := 100.0;
END_IF;

(*
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  MODULE 11: MULTI-STAGE OPERATING FINITE STATE MACHINE (FSM)
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
*)
CASE iState OF
    0: (* FSM_STATE: UNINITIALIZED_SELF_TEST *)
        rPneumaticPressureDemand_bar := 0.0;
        rAeroFlapDemand_deg := 0.0;
        rDynamicDampingTorque_Nm := 0.0;
        bEmergencyDropTriggered := FALSE;
        
        tStateTimer(IN := TRUE, PT := T#1500MS);
        IF tStateTimer.Q THEN
            tStateTimer(IN := FALSE);
            iState := 10; (* Transition to STANDBY_LOWERED *)
        END_IF;

    10: (* FSM_STATE: STANDBY_LOWERED *)
        rPneumaticPressureDemand_bar := 0.0;
        rAeroFlapDemand_deg := 0.0;
        rDynamicDampingTorque_Nm := 0.0;
        bEmergencyDropTriggered := FALSE;
        
        IF bMasterEnable AND NOT bEmergencyLower THEN
            iState := 20; (* Advance to PRE_PRESSURIZATION *)
        END_IF;

    20: (* FSM_STATE: PRE_PRESSURIZATION *)
        (* Fill pneumatic bellows to baseline threshold before mechanical latch release *)
        rPneumaticPressureDemand_bar := 1.80;
        rAeroFlapDemand_deg := 0.0;
        
        tStateTimer(IN := (rMainBellowsPressure_bar >= 1.65), PT := T#800MS);
        IF tStateTimer.Q THEN
            tStateTimer(IN := FALSE);
            rAscentPressureRamp_bar := 1.80;
            iState := 30; (* Advance to CONTROLLED_ASCENT *)
        END_IF;
        
        IF NOT bMasterEnable OR bEmergencyLower THEN
            tStateTimer(IN := FALSE);
            iState := 10;
        END_IF;

    30: (* FSM_STATE: CONTROLLED_ASCENT *)
        (* Smooth pneumatic ramp-up to ensure soft contact with catenary wire (< 1.5 m/s) *)
        rAscentPressureRamp_bar := rAscentPressureRamp_bar + (0.85 * c_fSampleTime_s);
        IF rAscentPressureRamp_bar > 4.20 THEN
            rAscentPressureRamp_bar := 4.20;
        END_IF;
        rPneumaticPressureDemand_bar := rAscentPressureRamp_bar;
        rAeroFlapDemand_deg := 0.0;
        
        (* Detect wire contact when contact force exceeds 40 N continuously *)
        tStateTimer(IN := (rEstimatedContactForce_N >= 40.0), PT := T#250MS);
        IF tStateTimer.Q THEN
            tStateTimer(IN := FALSE);
            iState := 40; (* Advance to CATENARY_ACQUISITION_AND_LATCH *)
        END_IF;
        
        IF NOT bMasterEnable OR bEmergencyLower THEN
            tStateTimer(IN := FALSE);
            iState := 100;
        END_IF;

    40: (* FSM_STATE: CATENARY_ACQUISITION_AND_LATCH *)
        (* Stabilize contact force at nominal baseline *)
        rPneumaticPressureDemand_bar := 3.20;
        rAeroFlapDemand_deg := 0.0;
        
        tStateTimer(IN := (rEstimatedContactForce_N >= 60.0) AND (rEstimatedContactForce_N <= 150.0), PT := T#1200MS);
        IF tStateTimer.Q THEN
            tStateTimer(IN := FALSE);
            IF rTrainSpeed_kmh >= 250.0 THEN
                iState := 60; (* HIGH_SPEED_DOPPLER_TRACKING *)
            ELSE
                iState := 50; (* SUB_CRITICAL_REGULATION *)
            END_IF;
        END_IF;
        
        IF NOT bMasterEnable OR bEmergencyLower THEN
            tStateTimer(IN := FALSE);
            iState := 100;
        END_IF;

    50: (* FSM_STATE: SUB_CRITICAL_REGULATION (0 .. 250 km/h) *)
        (* Pneumatic bellows drives slow force tracking, flaps compensate local irregularities *)
        rPneumaticPressureDemand_bar := rPressureDemandPrev_bar + rDeltaU_Opt_2;
        rAeroFlapDemand_deg := rFlapDemandPrev_deg + (0.50 * rDeltaU_Opt_1) + rArcPulseDecay + rTunnelCompProfile;
        
        IF rTrainSpeed_kmh > 260.0 THEN
            iState := 60; (* Transition to high-speed mode *)
        ELSIF iHealthySensorCount = 0 THEN
            iState := 90; (* Sensor failure degraded mode *)
        END_IF;

    60: (* FSM_STATE: HIGH_SPEED_DOPPLER_TRACKING (250 .. 450+ km/h) *)
        (* Full mechatronic bandwidth: active aerodynamic flaps handle 2..30 Hz, bellows handle < 2 Hz *)
        rPneumaticPressureDemand_bar := rPressureDemandPrev_bar + rDeltaU_Opt_2;
        rAeroFlapDemand_deg := rFlapDemandPrev_deg + rDeltaU_Opt_1 + rArcPulseDecay + rTunnelCompProfile;
        
        IF bTunnelEntryZone THEN
            iState := 70; (* Tunnel transient state *)
        ELSIF bArcSuppressionActive THEN
            iState := 80; (* Optical arc quench state *)
        ELSIF rTrainSpeed_kmh < 240.0 THEN
            iState := 50; (* Drop back to sub-critical *)
        ELSIF iHealthySensorCount = 0 THEN
            iState := 90; (* Degraded passive mode *)
        END_IF;

    70: (* FSM_STATE: TUNNEL_PRESSURE_WAVE_TRANSIENT *)
        (* Extreme aerodynamic pitch command to resist portal shock wave *)
        rPneumaticPressureDemand_bar := rPressureDemandPrev_bar + (0.80 * rDeltaU_Opt_2);
        rAeroFlapDemand_deg := rFlapDemandPrev_deg + rDeltaU_Opt_1 + rTunnelCompProfile;
        
        IF NOT bTunnelEntryZone AND (rTunnelCompProfile >= -0.05) THEN
            IF rTrainSpeed_kmh >= 250.0 THEN
                iState := 60;
            ELSE
                iState := 50;
            END_IF;
        END_IF;
