(*
========================================================================================================================
  CYCLIC CONTROL LOGIC EXECUTION ROUTINE (SAMPLE PERIOD Ts = 20 ms / 50 Hz)
========================================================================================================================
*)

(* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
   LAYER 0: SIL-3 / SIL-4 HARDWARE SAFETY CHAIN & IMMEDIATE DE-ENERGIZATION TRIPS
   --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* Verify dual-channel hardware safety loop integrity *)
IF NOT bEStopSafetyRelayOk THEN
    (* Immediate failsafe lock: neutral servo spool, isolate accumulators, lock hydraulic circuit *)
    rCmdServoValveSpool_pct         := 0.0;
    rCmdIntensifierBoost_pct        := 0.0;
    bFastDumpSolenoidCmd            := FALSE;
    bWedgeLockEngageCmd             := TRUE;  (* Fail-as-is mechanical wedge dog spring lock *)
    bPackerGelInjectionCmd          := FALSE;
    bAcousticTxEnable               := TRUE;
    dwAcousticTxPayload             := 16#DEADF001; (* Emergency Stop Trip Code *)

    wDiagnosticFaultWord.0          := TRUE;  (* E-Stop Trip Active *)
    wAlarmSeverityWord.0            := TRUE;  (* Severity: Emergency *)
    bSystemAlarm                    := TRUE;
    wSystemStatusWord               := 16#F000;
    iCurrentState                   := 999;   (* Jump immediately to Failsafe Shutdown *)
    iActiveSequenceState            := 999;
    RETURN;
END_IF;

(* Autonomous Deadman / Autoshear Disconnect Trigger (Umbilical parted or LMRP separation) *)
IF bEmergencyAutoshearTrigger AND (iCurrentState < 50) THEN
    (* Riser severance detected: initiate immediate full-power autonomous cut bypass *)
    bAutoshearArmed                 := TRUE;
    wAlarmSeverityWord.0            := TRUE;  (* Emergency Severity *)
    wSystemStatusWord.14            := TRUE;  (* Autoshear Engaged *)
    iCurrentState                   := 950;   (* Jump to Autonomous Deadman Autoshear Routine *)
END_IF;

(* Extreme Wellbore Overpressure Trip: Annular well pressure exceeding rating *)
IF (rBOPWellborePressure_bar > 1034.0) THEN
    wDiagnosticFaultWord.15         := TRUE;  (* Wellbore Extreme Overpressure Alarm *)
    wAlarmSeverityWord.0            := TRUE;
    bSystemAlarm                    := TRUE;
END_IF;

(* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
   LAYER 1: DEEPWATER HYDROSTATIC PRESSURE COMPENSATION, THERMAL PROPERTIES & OCEAN ACOUSTIC PROPAGATION
   --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* Compute dynamic seawater density at depth and abyssal temperature:
   rho_sw(T, S, P) = rho_0(S, T) / (1 - P / K(S, T, P))
   Using simplified high-accuracy industrial polynomial for subsea BOP controls: *)
rCalculatedSeawaterDensity_kgm3 := 1027.0
    + (0.0045 * rSubseaWaterDepth_m)
    - (0.0650 * (rSeawaterTemperature_degC - 4.0))
    + (0.7500 * (c_rSeawaterSalinityRef_PSU - 35.0));

(* Limit seawater density to realistic oceanic envelope (1020 .. 1045 kg/m^3) *)
IF rCalculatedSeawaterDensity_kgm3 < 1020.0 THEN
    rCalculatedSeawaterDensity_kgm3 := 1020.0;
ELSIF rCalculatedSeawaterDensity_kgm3 > 1045.0 THEN
    rCalculatedSeawaterDensity_kgm3 := 1045.0;
END_IF;

(* Theoretical hydrostatic pressure at wellhead datum: P = rho * g * h * 10^-5 bar *)
rTheoreticalHydrostaticPress_bar := (rCalculatedSeawaterDensity_kgm3 * c_rGravityRef_mps2 * rSubseaWaterDepth_m) * 1.0E-5;

(* Verify ambient hydrostatic sensor plausibility against theoretical head *)
IF ABS(rAmbientHydrostaticPress_bar - rTheoreticalHydrostaticPress_bar) > 25.0 THEN
    wDiagnosticFaultWord.1 := TRUE; (* Hydrostatic Transducer Divergence Alarm *)
    wAlarmSeverityWord.1   := TRUE; (* Severity: High *)
    bSystemAlarm           := TRUE;
ELSE
    wDiagnosticFaultWord.1 := FALSE;
END_IF;

(* Hydrostatic Reservoir Return Compensator Evaluation:
   The compensator bladder must maintain +1.50 bar over ambient hydrostatic to prevent seawater intrusion *)
rCompensatorBiasError_bar := rReservoirCompensatorPress_bar - (rAmbientHydrostaticPress_bar + 1.50);

IF (rCompensatorBiasError_bar < -1.00) THEN
    (* Severe risk of seawater ingress into hydraulic fluid *)
    wDiagnosticFaultWord.2 := TRUE; (* Reservoir Under-Pressure Fault *)
    wAlarmSeverityWord.0   := TRUE; (* Severity: Emergency *)
    bSystemAlarm           := TRUE;
    bHydrostaticEquilibrated := FALSE;
ELSIF (rCompensatorBiasError_bar > 12.0) THEN
    (* Excessive backpressure reduces actuator shearing force capability *)
    wDiagnosticFaultWord.3 := TRUE; (* Reservoir Over-Pressure Fault *)
    wAlarmSeverityWord.1   := TRUE; (* Severity: High *)
    bSystemAlarm           := TRUE;
    bHydrostaticEquilibrated := FALSE;
ELSE
    wDiagnosticFaultWord.2 := FALSE;
    wDiagnosticFaultWord.3 := FALSE;
    bHydrostaticEquilibrated := TRUE;
END_IF;

(* Dynamic Hydraulic Fluid Bulk Modulus (Beta_eff) calculation taking pressure and temperature into account:
   Beta_eff(P, T) = Beta_0 + (10.5 * P) - (45.0 * (T - 20.0)) *)
rFluidEffectiveBulkModulus_bar := c_rBaseFluidBulkModulus_bar
    + (10.5 * rAccumulatorSupplyPressure_bar)
    - (45.0 * (rHydraulicFluidTemp_degC - 20.0));

IF rFluidEffectiveBulkModulus_bar < 12000.0 THEN
    rFluidEffectiveBulkModulus_bar := 12000.0;
ELSIF rFluidEffectiveBulkModulus_bar > 25000.0 THEN
    rFluidEffectiveBulkModulus_bar := 25000.0;
END_IF;

(* Hydraulic Fluid Temperature Monitoring *)
IF (rHydraulicFluidTemp_degC > 65.0) THEN
    wDiagnosticFaultWord.12 := TRUE; (* Hydraulic Fluid Overheating Alarm *)
    wAlarmSeverityWord.1   := TRUE;
    bSystemAlarm           := TRUE;
ELSE
    wDiagnosticFaultWord.12 := FALSE;
END_IF;

(* Calculate net effective differential driving pressure available to the cylinder *)
rEffectiveDiffPress_bar := rAccumulatorSupplyPressure_bar - rReservoirCompensatorPress_bar;
rAvailableDifferentialHead_bar := rEffectiveDiffPress_bar;

(* Validate subsea accumulator charge capacity (API Standard 53 minimum) *)
IF (rAccumulatorSupplyPressure_bar < c_rMinAccumulatorCharge_bar) AND (NOT bROVHotStabConnected) THEN
    wDiagnosticFaultWord.4 := TRUE; (* Accumulator Bank Pressure Depleted Alarm *)
    wAlarmSeverityWord.0   := TRUE; (* Severity: Emergency *)
    bSystemAlarm           := TRUE;
ELSE
    wDiagnosticFaultWord.4 := FALSE;
END_IF;

(* Real-Time Hydraulic Volumetric Leakage Estimation:
   Q_leakage = Q_measured - (A_head * v_ram * 60,000 L/min) *)
rTheoreticalPistonFlow_Lmin := c_rPistonAreaHead_m2 * rRamLinearVelocity_mps * 60000.0;
IF (rHydraulicActuationFlow_Lmin > rTheoreticalPistonFlow_Lmin) AND (iCurrentState >= 30) AND (iCurrentState <= 60) THEN
    rVolumetricLeakageRate_Lmin := rHydraulicActuationFlow_Lmin - rTheoreticalPistonFlow_Lmin;
    IF (rVolumetricLeakageRate_Lmin > 180.0) THEN
        wDiagnosticFaultWord.11 := TRUE; (* High Volumetric Leakage Bypass Fault *)
        wAlarmSeverityWord.1   := TRUE;
        bSystemAlarm           := TRUE;
    ELSE
        wDiagnosticFaultWord.11 := FALSE;
    END_IF;
ELSE
    rVolumetricLeakageRate_Lmin := 0.0;
    wDiagnosticFaultWord.11     := FALSE;
END_IF;

(* Mackenzie (1981) 9-Term Oceanographic Sound Speed Formulation in Deepwater:
   c(T, S, D) = 1448.96 + 4.591*T - 5.304E-2*T^2 + 2.374E-4*T^3
              + 1.340*(S - 35) + 1.630E-2*D + 1.675E-7*D^2 - 1.025E-2*T*(S - 35) - 7.139E-13*T*D^3 *)
rDeepwaterSoundSpeed_mps := 1448.96
    + (4.591 * rSeawaterTemperature_degC)
    - (0.05304 * rSeawaterTemperature_degC * rSeawaterTemperature_degC)
    + (0.0002374 * rSeawaterTemperature_degC * rSeawaterTemperature_degC * rSeawaterTemperature_degC)
    + (1.340 * (c_rSeawaterSalinityRef_PSU - 35.0))
    + (0.01630 * rSubseaWaterDepth_m)
    + (1.675E-7 * rSubseaWaterDepth_m * rSubseaWaterDepth_m)
    - (0.01025 * rSeawaterTemperature_degC * (c_rSeawaterSalinityRef_PSU - 35.0))
    - (7.139E-13 * rSeawaterTemperature_degC * rSubseaWaterDepth_m * rSubseaWaterDepth_m * rSubseaWaterDepth_m);

(* Thorpe Empirical Seawater Acoustic Attenuation Coefficient at Carrier Frequency f [kHz]:
   alpha(f) = (0.11 * f^2) / (1 + f^2) + (44 * f^2) / (4100 + f^2) + 2.75E-4 * f^2 + 0.003  [dB/km] *)
IF (rAcousticCarrierFreq_kHz > 1.0) AND (rAcousticCarrierFreq_kHz < 100.0) THEN
    rAcousticThorpeAtten_dB_km := ((0.11 * rAcousticCarrierFreq_kHz * rAcousticCarrierFreq_kHz) / (1.0 + (rAcousticCarrierFreq_kHz * rAcousticCarrierFreq_kHz)))
        + ((44.0 * rAcousticCarrierFreq_kHz * rAcousticCarrierFreq_kHz) / (4100.0 + (rAcousticCarrierFreq_kHz * rAcousticCarrierFreq_kHz)))
        + (0.000275 * rAcousticCarrierFreq_kHz * rAcousticCarrierFreq_kHz)
        + 0.0030;
ELSE
    rAcousticThorpeAtten_dB_km := 1.850; (* Default attenuation at 18.5 kHz in cold seawater *)
END_IF;

(* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
   LAYER 2: ACOUSTIC TELEMETRY TRANSCEIVER TRIPLE MODULAR REDUNDANCY (2oo3 TMR) ENGINE
   --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* Channel Validity Assessment based on hardware CRC, packet lock, SNR threshold (12.0 dB), and Doppler limit *)
bModemA_Trusted := bAcousticPktValid_ModemA AND (rAcousticSNR_ModemA_dB >= 12.0) AND (ABS(rAcousticDopplerShiftA_Hz) <= 18.0);
bModemB_Trusted := bAcousticPktValid_ModemB AND (rAcousticSNR_ModemB_dB >= 12.0) AND (ABS(rAcousticDopplerShiftB_Hz) <= 18.0);
bModemC_Trusted := bAcousticPktValid_ModemC AND (rAcousticSNR_ModemC_dB >= 12.0) AND (ABS(rAcousticDopplerShiftC_Hz) <= 18.0);

(* Count healthy receiving transducers *)
iHealthyModemCount := 0;
IF bModemA_Trusted THEN iHealthyModemCount := iHealthyModemCount + 1; END_IF;
IF bModemB_Trusted THEN iHealthyModemCount := iHealthyModemCount + 1; END_IF;
IF bModemC_Trusted THEN iHealthyModemCount := iHealthyModemCount + 1; END_IF;

(* Dynamic SNR Weighted Beamforming Calculation *)
rSumSNR := 0.0;
IF bModemA_Trusted THEN rSumSNR := rSumSNR + rAcousticSNR_ModemA_dB; END_IF;
IF bModemB_Trusted THEN rSumSNR := rSumSNR + rAcousticSNR_ModemB_dB; END_IF;
IF bModemC_Trusted THEN rSumSNR := rSumSNR + rAcousticSNR_ModemC_dB; END_IF;

IF (rSumSNR > 1.0) THEN
    IF bModemA_Trusted THEN rWeightModemA := rAcousticSNR_ModemA_dB / rSumSNR; ELSE rWeightModemA := 0.0; END_IF;
    IF bModemB_Trusted THEN rWeightModemB := rAcousticSNR_ModemB_dB / rSumSNR; ELSE rWeightModemB := 0.0; END_IF;
    IF bModemC_Trusted THEN rWeightModemC := rAcousticSNR_ModemC_dB / rSumSNR; ELSE rWeightModemC := 0.0; END_IF;
ELSE
    rWeightModemA := 0.3333;
    rWeightModemB := 0.3333;
    rWeightModemC := 0.3333;
END_IF;

(* Bitwise Consensus Voting Logic *)
IF (iHealthyModemCount = 3) THEN
    (* Full 3-Channel Transceiver Consensus Evaluation *)
    IF (dwAcousticPacket_ModemA = dwAcousticPacket_ModemB) AND (dwAcousticPacket_ModemB = dwAcousticPacket_ModemC) THEN
        dwConsensusPacket := dwAcousticPacket_ModemA;
        bVoteQuorumAchieved := TRUE;
        bDegradedTMRActive := FALSE;
        wDiagnosticFaultWord.5 := FALSE; (* Acoustic TMR Discrepancy Clear *)
        rVotedSNR_dB := (rAcousticSNR_ModemA_dB * rWeightModemA)
                      + (rAcousticSNR_ModemB_dB * rWeightModemB)
                      + (rAcousticSNR_ModemC_dB * rWeightModemC);

    ELSIF (dwAcousticPacket_ModemA = dwAcousticPacket_ModemB) THEN
        (* Channel C Discrepant: Quarantine Channel C *)
        dwConsensusPacket := dwAcousticPacket_ModemA;
        bVoteQuorumAchieved := TRUE;
        bDegradedTMRActive := TRUE;
        iModemQuarantineCounterC := iModemQuarantineCounterC + 1;
        wDiagnosticFaultWord.5 := TRUE;
        wAlarmSeverityWord.2   := TRUE; (* Severity: Medium *)
        rVotedSNR_dB := (rAcousticSNR_ModemA_dB + rAcousticSNR_ModemB_dB) * 0.5;

    ELSIF (dwAcousticPacket_ModemB = dwAcousticPacket_ModemC) THEN
        (* Channel A Discrepant: Quarantine Channel A *)
        dwConsensusPacket := dwAcousticPacket_ModemB;
        bVoteQuorumAchieved := TRUE;
        bDegradedTMRActive := TRUE;
        iModemQuarantineCounterA := iModemQuarantineCounterA + 1;
        wDiagnosticFaultWord.5 := TRUE;
        wAlarmSeverityWord.2   := TRUE;
        rVotedSNR_dB := (rAcousticSNR_ModemB_dB + rAcousticSNR_ModemC_dB) * 0.5;

    ELSIF (dwAcousticPacket_ModemA = dwAcousticPacket_ModemC) THEN
        (* Channel B Discrepant: Quarantine Channel B *)
        dwConsensusPacket := dwAcousticPacket_ModemA;
        bVoteQuorumAchieved := TRUE;
        bDegradedTMRActive := TRUE;
        iModemQuarantineCounterB := iModemQuarantineCounterB + 1;
        wDiagnosticFaultWord.5 := TRUE;
        wAlarmSeverityWord.2   := TRUE;
        rVotedSNR_dB := (rAcousticSNR_ModemA_dB + rAcousticSNR_ModemC_dB) * 0.5;

    ELSE
        (* Total TMR Asynchrony / Spurious Plume Noise: No two channels match *)
        dwConsensusPacket := 16#00000000;
        bVoteQuorumAchieved := FALSE;
        bDegradedTMRActive := TRUE;
        wDiagnosticFaultWord.5 := TRUE;
        wAlarmSeverityWord.1   := TRUE; (* Severity: High *)
        rVotedSNR_dB := 0.0;
    END_IF;

ELSIF (iHealthyModemCount = 2) THEN
    (* Degraded 1oo2 Voting Mode *)
    bDegradedTMRActive := TRUE;
    wDiagnosticFaultWord.5 := TRUE;
    wAlarmSeverityWord.2   := TRUE;

    IF bModemA_Trusted AND bModemB_Trusted THEN
        IF (dwAcousticPacket_ModemA = dwAcousticPacket_ModemB) THEN
            dwConsensusPacket := dwAcousticPacket_ModemA;
            bVoteQuorumAchieved := TRUE;
            rVotedSNR_dB := (rAcousticSNR_ModemA_dB + rAcousticSNR_ModemB_dB) * 0.5;
        ELSE
            bVoteQuorumAchieved := FALSE;
            dwConsensusPacket := 16#00000000;
        END_IF;

    ELSIF bModemB_Trusted AND bModemC_Trusted THEN
        IF (dwAcousticPacket_ModemB = dwAcousticPacket_ModemC) THEN
            dwConsensusPacket := dwAcousticPacket_ModemB;
            bVoteQuorumAchieved := TRUE;
            rVotedSNR_dB := (rAcousticSNR_ModemB_dB + rAcousticSNR_ModemC_dB) * 0.5;
        ELSE
            bVoteQuorumAchieved := FALSE;
            dwConsensusPacket := 16#00000000;
        END_IF;

    ELSIF bModemA_Trusted AND bModemC_Trusted THEN
        IF (dwAcousticPacket_ModemA = dwAcousticPacket_ModemC) THEN
            dwConsensusPacket := dwAcousticPacket_ModemA;
            bVoteQuorumAchieved := TRUE;
            rVotedSNR_dB := (rAcousticSNR_ModemA_dB + rAcousticSNR_ModemC_dB) * 0.5;
        ELSE
            bVoteQuorumAchieved := FALSE;
            dwConsensusPacket := 16#00000000;
        END_IF;
    END_IF;

ELSIF (iHealthyModemCount = 1) THEN
    (* Severe Acoustic Degradation: Single surviving modem *)
    bDegradedTMRActive := TRUE;
    wDiagnosticFaultWord.6 := TRUE; (* Severe Acoustic Telemetry Loss *)
    wAlarmSeverityWord.1   := TRUE; (* Severity: High *)
    bVoteQuorumAchieved := FALSE;    (* Single channel cannot command safety-critical shear alone *)
    dwConsensusPacket := 16#00000000;

ELSE
    (* Total Acoustic Link Loss: Multipath plume attenuation / transducer damage *)
    bDegradedTMRActive := FALSE;
    wDiagnosticFaultWord.6 := TRUE;
    wAlarmSeverityWord.0   := TRUE; (* Severity: Emergency *)
    bVoteQuorumAchieved := FALSE;
    dwConsensusPacket := 16#00000000;
    rVotedSNR_dB := 0.0;
END_IF;

(* Acoustic Command Demultiplexing & Decryption *)
IF bVoteQuorumAchieved THEN
    (* Verify 16-bit Security Authentication Key *)
    IF ((dwConsensusPacket AND 16#FFFF0000) = c_dwAuthKeyMask) THEN
        (* Check Subcommands *)
        IF ((dwConsensusPacket AND 16#0000FFFF) = c_dwArmSubcommand) THEN
            bAcousticArmedSignal := TRUE;
            bAcousticCutSignal   := FALSE;
        ELSIF ((dwConsensusPacket AND 16#0000FFFF) = c_dwCutSubcommand) THEN
            bAcousticCutSignal   := TRUE;
        ELSE
            bAcousticArmedSignal := FALSE;
            bAcousticCutSignal   := FALSE;
        END_IF;
    ELSE
        bAcousticArmedSignal := FALSE;
        bAcousticCutSignal   := FALSE;
        wDiagnosticFaultWord.7 := TRUE; (* Invalid Acoustic Security Key *)
        wAlarmSeverityWord.1   := TRUE;
    END_IF;
ELSE
    bAcousticArmedSignal := FALSE;
    bAcousticCutSignal   := FALSE;
END_IF;

(* Acoustic Loss Watchdog Timer *)
tAcousticLossWatchdog(IN := (iHealthyModemCount < 2), PT := T#45S);
IF tAcousticLossWatchdog.Q AND (NOT bROVHotStabConnected) THEN
    wDiagnosticFaultWord.8 := TRUE; (* Acoustic Telemetry Blackout Alarm *)
    wAlarmSeverityWord.0   := TRUE; (* Severity: Emergency *)
    bSystemAlarm := TRUE;
END_IF;

(* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
   LAYER 3: 4TH-ORDER HYDRAULIC OBSERVER & KINEMATICS STATE RECONSTRUCTION
   --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* Update State Vector from Calibrated Transducers *)
aStateVector[1] := rRamPosition_m;
aStateVector[2] := rRamLinearVelocity_mps;
aStateVector[3] := rAccumulatorSupplyPressure_bar;
aStateVector[4] := rReservoirCompensatorPress_bar;

(* State Observer Innovation Correction: x_hat(k) = A*x_hat(k-1) + B*u(k-1) + L*(y(k) - C*x_hat(k-1)) *)
FOR iRow := 1 TO 4 DO
    aStateError[iRow] := aStateVector[iRow] - aStatePredicted[iRow];
END_FOR;

FOR iRow := 1 TO 4 DO
    aStatePredicted[iRow] := 0.0;
    (* State transition multiplication: A * x *)
    FOR iCol := 1 TO 4 DO
        aStatePredicted[iRow] := aStatePredicted[iRow] + (aMatrixA[iRow, iCol] * aStateVector[iCol]);
    END_FOR;
    (* Input coupling multiplication: B * u *)
    aStatePredicted[iRow] := aStatePredicted[iRow]
        + (aMatrixB[iRow, 1] * (rCmdServoValveSpool_pct / 100.0))
        + (aMatrixB[iRow, 2] * (rCmdIntensifierBoost_pct / 100.0));
    (* Observer correction *)
    aStatePredicted[iRow] := aStatePredicted[iRow] + (aStateObserverGain_L[iRow] * aStateError[iRow]);
END_FOR;

(* Dynamic Actuator Thrust Calculation: F = (P_head * A_head - P_rod * A_rod) * 100 kN *)
rVotedRamThrust_kN := ((aStateVector[3] * c_rPistonAreaHead_m2) - (aStateVector[4] * c_rPistonAreaRod_m2)) * 100.0;

(* Force Derivative Calculation for Shear Inflection Detection *)
rIncrementalStroke_m := rRamPosition_m - rPrevRamPosition_m;
rPrevRamPosition_m   := rRamPosition_m;

IF (c_rNominalSamplingTime_s > 0.0) THEN
    rForceDerivative_kNps := (rVotedRamThrust_kN - rPrevThrustForce_kN) / c_rNominalSamplingTime_s;
    rPrevThrustForce_kN   := rVotedRamThrust_kN;
    (* First-order digital low-pass filtering on force derivative (tau = 60 ms) *)
    rFilteredForceDerivative_kNps := (0.25 * rForceDerivative_kNps) + (0.75 * rFilteredForceDerivative_kNps);
END_IF;

(* Real-Time Mechanical Cutting Energy Integration: E = Integral [ F_thrust * dx ] *)
IF (rIncrementalStroke_m > 0.0) AND (iCurrentState >= 40) AND (iCurrentState <= 60) THEN
    rAccumulatedShearEnergy_kJ := rAccumulatedShearEnergy_kJ + (rVotedRamThrust_kN * rIncrementalStroke_m);
    rMechanicalShearWork_kJ    := rAccumulatedShearEnergy_kJ;
END_IF;

(* Instantaneous Estimated Pipe Resistance: R_pipe = F_thrust - M_eff * dv/dt - F_wellbore *)
rCalculatedPipeResistance_kN := rVotedRamThrust_kN - (4.250 * (aStateVector[2] / c_rNominalSamplingTime_s))
                                - (rBOPWellborePressure_bar * 0.0275);
IF rCalculatedPipeResistance_kN < 0.0 THEN
    rCalculatedPipeResistance_kN := 0.0;
END_IF;

(* Track Peak Observed Cutting Force *)
IF (rVotedRamThrust_kN > rShearPeakForceObserved_kN) AND (iCurrentState >= 40) THEN
    rShearPeakForceObserved_kN := rVotedRamThrust_kN;
END_IF;

(* Detect Physical Drill Pipe Engagement & Shear Rupture *)
IF (rRamPosition_m >= c_rWellboreClearanceEnd_m) AND (rFilteredForceDerivative_kNps > 1500.0) THEN
    bPipeContactDetected := TRUE;
END_IF;

(* Shear Rupture occurs when force derivative drops severely after high thrust plateau *)
IF bPipeContactDetected AND (rShearPeakForceObserved_kN > 3500.0) AND (rFilteredForceDerivative_kNps < -4500.0) THEN
    bShearBreakthroughDetected := TRUE;
END_IF;

(* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
   LAYER 4: MODEL PREDICTIVE CONTROL (MPC) QUADRATIC COST OPTIMIZATION KERNEL
   --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* Evaluate State Tracking Errors relative to Active Phase Reference Targets *)
rGradientValve := 0.0;
rGradientBoost := 0.0;

(* Quadratic Performance Index: J = e_x^T * Q * e_x + u^T * R * u + Delta_u^T * S * Delta_u *)
rCostFunctionJ := (aDiagWeightQ[1] * (aStateVector[1] - rTargetTrajectoryPos_m) * (aStateVector[1] - rTargetTrajectoryPos_m))
                + (aDiagWeightQ[2] * (aStateVector[2] - rTargetTrajectoryVel_mps) * (aStateVector[2] - rTargetTrajectoryVel_mps))
                + (aDiagWeightQ[3] * (aStateVector[3] - rTargetHeadPressure_bar) * (aStateVector[3] - rTargetHeadPressure_bar))
                + (aDiagWeightR[1] * (rPrevValveSpoolCmd_pct / 100.0) * (rPrevValveSpoolCmd_pct / 100.0))
                + (aDiagWeightR[2] * (rPrevBoostCmd_pct / 100.0) * (rPrevBoostCmd_pct / 100.0));

(* Compute Analytical Gradients along 5-Step Prediction Horizon *)
FOR iHorizonStep := 1 TO 5 DO
    (* Position error gradient contribution *)
    rGradientValve := rGradientValve + (aDiagWeightQ[1] * (aStatePredicted[1] - rTargetTrajectoryPos_m) * aMatrixB[1, 1]);
    (* Velocity tracking gradient contribution *)
    rGradientValve := rGradientValve + (aDiagWeightQ[2] * (aStatePredicted[2] - rTargetTrajectoryVel_mps) * aMatrixB[2, 1]);
    (* Pressure gradient contribution for booster intensification *)
    rGradientBoost := rGradientBoost + (aDiagWeightQ[3] * (aStatePredicted[3] - rTargetHeadPressure_bar) * aMatrixB[3, 2]);
END_FOR;

(* Regularization and Slew Rate Damping *)
rGradientValve := rGradientValve + (aDiagWeightR[1] * (rPrevValveSpoolCmd_pct / 100.0))
                + (aDiagWeightS[1] * ((rPrevValveSpoolCmd_pct - rCmdServoValveSpool_pct) / 100.0));
rGradientBoost := rGradientBoost + (aDiagWeightR[2] * (rPrevBoostCmd_pct / 100.0))
                + (aDiagWeightS[2] * ((rPrevBoostCmd_pct - rCmdIntensifierBoost_pct) / 100.0));

(* Pre-calculate Diagonal Inverse Hessian Approximation: H_diag = B^T * Q * B + R + S *)
aHessianDiagonalInv[1] := 1.0 / ( (aMatrixB[1, 1] * aMatrixB[1, 1] * aDiagWeightQ[1])
                                + (aMatrixB[2, 1] * aMatrixB[2, 1] * aDiagWeightQ[2])
                                + aDiagWeightR[1] + aDiagWeightS[1] + 0.050 );

aHessianDiagonalInv[2] := 1.0 / ( (aMatrixB[3, 2] * aMatrixB[3, 2] * aDiagWeightQ[3])
                                + aDiagWeightR[2] + aDiagWeightS[2] + 0.050 );

(* Iterative Projected Newton-Gradient Descent Optimization (4 internal iterations per cycle) *)
rOptimalDeltaValve := rPrevValveSpoolCmd_pct;
rOptimalDeltaBoost := rPrevBoostCmd_pct;

FOR iOptStep := 1 TO 4 DO
    rOptimalDeltaValve := rOptimalDeltaValve - (aHessianDiagonalInv[1] * rGradientValve * 12.50);
    rOptimalDeltaBoost := rOptimalDeltaBoost - (aHessianDiagonalInv[2] * rGradientBoost * 10.00);

    (* Enforce Slew Rate Clamping (|Delta_u| <= 25.0% per 20 ms to prevent water hammer) *)
    IF (rOptimalDeltaValve - rPrevValveSpoolCmd_pct) > 25.0 THEN
        rOptimalDeltaValve := rPrevValveSpoolCmd_pct + 25.0;
    ELSIF (rOptimalDeltaValve - rPrevValveSpoolCmd_pct) < -25.0 THEN
        rOptimalDeltaValve := rPrevValveSpoolCmd_pct - 25.0;
    END_IF;

    (* Enforce Actuator Saturation Constraints *)
    IF rOptimalDeltaValve > 100.0 THEN
        rOptimalDeltaValve := 100.0;
    ELSIF rOptimalDeltaValve < -100.0 THEN
        rOptimalDeltaValve := -100.0;
    END_IF;

    IF rOptimalDeltaBoost > 100.0 THEN
        rOptimalDeltaBoost := 100.0;
    ELSIF rOptimalDeltaBoost < 0.0 THEN
        rOptimalDeltaBoost := 0.0;
    END_IF;
END_FOR;

(* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
   LAYER 5: SEQUENTIAL FINITE STATE MACHINE (BOP SHEAR RAM EXECUTION PHASES)
   --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
CASE iCurrentState OF

    0: (* STATE_STANDBY_IDLE_MONITORING: Passive monitoring, hydro balance check, acoustic ping *)
        rCmdServoValveSpool_pct         := 0.0;
        rCmdIntensifierBoost_pct        := 0.0;
        bFastDumpSolenoidCmd            := FALSE;
        bWedgeLockEngageCmd             := FALSE;
        bPackerGelInjectionCmd          := FALSE;
        bRamSealedAndLocked             := FALSE;
        bPipeContactDetected            := FALSE;
        bShearBreakthroughDetected      := FALSE;
        bWedgeLockConfirmed             := FALSE;
        rShearPeakForceObserved_kN      := 0.0;
        rAccumulatedShearEnergy_kJ      := 0.0;
        wSystemStatusWord               := 16#0001; (* Bit 0: System Ready / Idle *)

        (* Acoustic Transceiver Periodic Telemetry Broadcast (Every 5 seconds) *)
        tStatePhaseTimer(IN := TRUE, PT := T#5S);
        IF tStatePhaseTimer.Q THEN
            tStatePhaseTimer(IN := FALSE);
            bAcousticTxEnable := TRUE;
            dwAcousticTxPayload := 16#10010000 OR WORD_TO_DWORD(wSystemStatusWord);
        ELSE
            bAcousticTxEnable := FALSE;
        END_IF;

        (* Advance to Arming Phase upon Valid Acoustic Consensus or Hardwire Command *)
        IF bMasterSystemEnable AND bEStopSafetyRelayOk AND (wDiagnosticFaultWord = 0) THEN
            IF (bArmShearCommand OR bAcousticArmedSignal) AND bHydrostaticEquilibrated THEN
                tStatePhaseTimer(IN := FALSE);
                iCurrentState := 10; (* Advance to Armed State *)
            END_IF;
        END_IF;

    10: (* STATE_ACOUSTIC_ARMING_AND_VOTING: 2oo3 verification, pre-charge accumulators, arm triggers *)
        rCmdServoValveSpool_pct         := 0.0;
        rCmdIntensifierBoost_pct        := 0.0;
        bFastDumpSolenoidCmd            := FALSE;
        bWedgeLockEngageCmd             := FALSE;
        wSystemStatusWord               := 16#0003; (* Bit 0: Ready, Bit 1: Armed *)

        (* Reply via Acoustic Transceiver: Arming Acknowledged *)
        bAcousticTxEnable   := TRUE;
        dwAcousticTxPayload := 16#A0030000 OR WORD_TO_DWORD(wSystemStatusWord);

        (* Supervisory Arming Timeout: 60 seconds to receive Cut trigger, otherwise disarm *)
        tStatePhaseTimer(IN := TRUE, PT := T#60S);
        IF (bExecuteShearCut OR bAcousticCutSignal) AND bVoteQuorumAchieved THEN
            tStatePhaseTimer(IN := FALSE);
            iCurrentState := 20; (* Advance to Hydrostatic Equilibration & Line Prefill *)
        ELSIF tStatePhaseTimer.Q THEN
            tStatePhaseTimer(IN := FALSE);
            iCurrentState := 0;  (* Disarm timeout back to standby *)
        END_IF;

    20: (* STATE_HYDROSTATIC_EQUILIBRATION_PREFILL: Confirm depth compensator, crack pilot valves *)
        wSystemStatusWord               := 16#0007; (* Bit 2: Hydro Pre-fill *)
        rTargetTrajectoryPos_m          := 0.050;
        rTargetTrajectoryVel_mps        := 0.020;
        rTargetHeadPressure_bar         := rAmbientHydrostaticPress_bar + 25.0;

        (* Pilot pre-fill command: 15% valve crack to eliminate hydraulic line deadband *)
        rCmdServoValveSpool_pct         := 15.0;
        rCmdIntensifierBoost_pct        := 0.0;
        bFastDumpSolenoidCmd            := FALSE;
        bWedgeLockEngageCmd             := FALSE;

        tStatePhaseTimer(IN := TRUE, PT := T#2S);
        IF (rRamPosition_m >= 0.035) OR tStatePhaseTimer.Q THEN
            tStatePhaseTimer(IN := FALSE);
            iCurrentState := 30; (* Advance to High-Speed Rapid Traverse *)
        END_IF;

    30: (* STATE_HIGH_SPEED_RAPID_TRAVERSE: Max-speed ram stroke through wellbore clearance *)
        wSystemStatusWord               := 16#000F; (* Bit 3: Rapid Traverse Active *)
        rTargetTrajectoryPos_m          := c_rWellboreClearanceEnd_m;
        rTargetTrajectoryVel_mps        := 0.250; (* High velocity traverse (250 mm/s) *)
        rTargetHeadPressure_bar         := rAccumulatorSupplyPressure_bar * 0.85;

        (* Engage SAM High-Flow Dump Valve for Rapid Hydraulic Discharge *)
        bFastDumpSolenoidCmd            := TRUE;
        rCmdServoValveSpool_pct         := rOptimalDeltaValve;
        IF rCmdServoValveSpool_pct < 85.0 THEN
            rCmdServoValveSpool_pct     := 85.0; (* Force high flow *)
        END_IF;
        rCmdIntensifierBoost_pct        := 0.0;
        bWedgeLockEngageCmd             := FALSE;

        (* Detect approach to drill pipe clearance boundary *)
        IF (rRamPosition_m >= (c_rWellboreClearanceEnd_m - 0.025)) OR bPipeContactDetected THEN
            iCurrentState := 40; (* Prepare for Pipe Impact *)
        END_IF;

    40: (* STATE_PIPE_IMPACT_AND_DECELERATION: Decelerate prior to contact to prevent blade chatter *)
        wSystemStatusWord               := 16#001F; (* Bit 4: Impact Deceleration *)
        rTargetTrajectoryPos_m          := c_rWellboreClearanceEnd_m + 0.040;
        rTargetTrajectoryVel_mps        := 0.050; (* Controlled impact speed (50 mm/s) *)
        rTargetHeadPressure_bar         := rAccumulatorSupplyPressure_bar;

        bFastDumpSolenoidCmd            := TRUE;
        (* Throttle servo spool via MPC optimizer to cushion contact *)
        rCmdServoValveSpool_pct         := rOptimalDeltaValve;
        IF rCmdServoValveSpool_pct > 45.0 THEN
            rCmdServoValveSpool_pct     := 45.0;
        END_IF;
        rCmdIntensifierBoost_pct        := 15.0; (* Pre-arm hydraulic intensifier *)

        (* Detect drill pipe contact via thrust force rise *)
        IF (rVotedRamThrust_kN >= 850.0) OR (rRamPosition_m >= c_rWellboreClearanceEnd_m) THEN
            bPipeContactDetected        := TRUE;
            iCurrentState               := 50; (* Advance to Full-Power Shearing *)
        END_IF;

    50: (* STATE_FULL_POWER_SHEAR_CUTTING_INTENSIFICATION: 10,000 psi intensifier cut of S-135 pipe *)
        wSystemStatusWord               := 16#003F; (* Bit 5: Shearing Intensifier Active *)
        rTargetTrajectoryPos_m          := c_rShearZoneEnd_m;
        rTargetTrajectoryVel_mps        := 0.035;
        rTargetHeadPressure_bar         := c_rMaxSystemPressure_bar; (* Demand 690 bar (10,000 psi) *)

        (* Engage full SAM flow and 100% Intensifier Booster Pump *)
        bFastDumpSolenoidCmd            := TRUE;
        rCmdServoValveSpool_pct         := 100.0;
        rCmdIntensifierBoost_pct        := 100.0;
        bWedgeLockEngageCmd             := FALSE;

        (* Maximum Shearing Duration Watchdog (API 16D allows max 30 seconds for shear) *)
        tSafetyWatchdog(IN := TRUE, PT := T#25S);

        (* Check for pipe severing completion (rupture inflection detected or stroke past shear zone) *)
        IF (bShearBreakthroughDetected OR (rRamPosition_m >= c_rShearZoneEnd_m)) AND (NOT tSafetyWatchdog.Q) THEN
            tSafetyWatchdog(IN := FALSE);
            iCurrentState := 60; (* Severance complete, catch stroke overshoot *)
        ELSIF tSafetyWatchdog.Q THEN
            tSafetyWatchdog(IN := FALSE);
            wDiagnosticFaultWord.9      := TRUE; (* Shear Cut Stall / Timeout Fault *)
            wAlarmSeverityWord.0        := TRUE; (* Severity: Emergency *)
            bSystemAlarm                := TRUE;
            iCurrentState               := 999;  (* Controlled abort *)
        END_IF;

    60: (* STATE_POST_SHEAR_OVERSHOOT_CONTAINMENT: Rapid hydraulic braking to protect BOP casing *)
        wSystemStatusWord               := 16#007F; (* Bit 6: Overshoot Containment *)
        rTargetTrajectoryPos_m          := c_rSealCompactionStart_m;
        rTargetTrajectoryVel_mps        := 0.015;
        rTargetHeadPressure_bar         := 280.0;

        (* De-energize fast dump, throttle spool to backpressure rod end to arrest inertia *)
        bFastDumpSolenoidCmd            := FALSE;
        rCmdServoValveSpool_pct         := 20.0;
        rCmdIntensifierBoost_pct        := 0.0;

        IF (aStateVector[2] <= 0.025) OR (rRamPosition_m >= c_rSealCompactionStart_m) THEN
            iCurrentState := 70; (* Advance to Elastomer Packing Seal Compaction *)
        END_IF;

    70: (* STATE_FINAL_ELASTOMER_SEAL_COMPACTION: Extrude nitrile/viton seals across wellbore *)
        wSystemStatusWord               := 16#00FF; (* Bit 7: Seal Compaction Active *)
        rTargetTrajectoryPos_m          := c_rFullSealLockPosition_m;
        rTargetTrajectoryVel_mps        := 0.008;
        rTargetHeadPressure_bar         := 520.0; (* Intensified packing squeeze *)

        rCmdServoValveSpool_pct         := 45.0;
        rCmdIntensifierBoost_pct        := 75.0;
        bFastDumpSolenoidCmd            := FALSE;

        (* Inject secondary seal energization gel if pressure is extreme *)
        IF (rBOPWellborePressure_bar > 350.0) THEN
            bPackerGelInjectionCmd      := TRUE;
        ELSE
            bPackerGelInjectionCmd      := FALSE;
        END_IF;

        (* Confirm Ram has reached full mechanical travel *)
        IF (rRamPosition_m >= c_rFullSealLockPosition_m) THEN
            tIntensifierDwellTimer(IN := TRUE, PT := T#4S);
            IF tIntensifierDwellTimer.Q THEN
                tIntensifierDwellTimer(IN := FALSE);
                iCurrentState := 80; (* Engage Mechanical Wedge Locks *)
            END_IF;
        ELSE
            tIntensifierDwellTimer(IN := FALSE);
        END_IF;

    80: (* STATE_MECHANICAL_LOCK_ENGAGEMENT: Fire Poslock / wedge locking dogs to hold ram mechanically *)
        wSystemStatusWord               := 16#01FF; (* Bit 8: Locking Dogs Engaged *)
        rCmdServoValveSpool_pct         := 30.0;    (* Maintain forward thrust during lock engagement *)
        rCmdIntensifierBoost_pct        := 50.0;
        bWedgeLockEngageCmd             := TRUE;    (* Energize mechanical wedge-lock dogs *)

        tWedgeLockVerifyTimer(IN := TRUE, PT := T#8S);
        IF tWedgeLockVerifyTimer.Q THEN
            tWedgeLockVerifyTimer(IN := FALSE);
            bWedgeLockConfirmed         := TRUE;
            iCurrentState               := 90; (* Proceed to Wellbore Pressure Integrity Test *)
        END_IF;

    90: (* STATE_HIGH_PRESSURE_WELLBORE_INTEGRITY_TEST: Bleed hydraulics, verify seal holds well pressure *)
        wSystemStatusWord               := 16#03FF; (* Bit 9: Pressure Test Active *)
        (* Bleed hydraulic cylinder pressure to ambient hydrostatic to test pure mechanical containment *)
        rCmdServoValveSpool_pct         := 0.0;
        rCmdIntensifierBoost_pct        := 0.0;
        bFastDumpSolenoidCmd            := FALSE;
        bWedgeLockEngageCmd             := TRUE;  (* Kept mechanically locked *)
        bPackerGelInjectionCmd          := FALSE;

        (* Dwell 10 seconds to monitor wellbore pressure containment below shear ram *)
        tSealIntegrityTestTimer(IN := TRUE, PT := T#10S);
        IF tSealIntegrityTestTimer.Q THEN
            tSealIntegrityTestTimer(IN := FALSE);
            (* Verify ram has not slipped backwards under wellbore pressure *)
            IF (rRamPosition_m >= (c_rFullSealLockPosition_m - 0.010)) THEN
                bRamSealedAndLocked     := TRUE;
                iCurrentState           := 100; (* Wellhead Successfully Secured *)
            ELSE
                wDiagnosticFaultWord.10 := TRUE; (* Seal Slippage Under Well Pressure Alarm *)
                wAlarmSeverityWord.0    := TRUE; (* Severity: Emergency *)
                bSystemAlarm            := TRUE;
                iCurrentState           := 999;
            END_IF;
        END_IF;

    100: (* STATE_SECURED_CONTAINMENT_HOLD: Well sealed, broadcast acoustic confirmation *)
        wSystemStatusWord               := 16#07FF; (* Bit 10: Wellhead Secured & Isolated *)
        rCmdServoValveSpool_pct         := 0.0;
        rCmdIntensifierBoost_pct        := 0.0;
        bFastDumpSolenoidCmd            := FALSE;
        bWedgeLockEngageCmd             := TRUE;
        bPackerGelInjectionCmd          := FALSE;
        bRamSealedAndLocked             := TRUE;

        (* Transmit Continuous Success Acoustic Telemetry Frame (Every 3 seconds) *)
        tStatePhaseTimer(IN := TRUE, PT := T#3S);
        IF tStatePhaseTimer.Q THEN
            tStatePhaseTimer(IN := FALSE);
            bAcousticTxEnable   := TRUE;
            dwAcousticTxPayload := 16#C00D0000 OR WORD_TO_DWORD(wSystemStatusWord);
        ELSE
            bAcousticTxEnable   := FALSE;
        END_IF;

    900: (* STATE_ROV_MANUAL_HOTSTAB_OVERRIDE: Work-Class ROV auxiliary hydraulic intervention *)
        wSystemStatusWord               := 16#5900; (* Bit 12: ROV Intervention Mode *)
        bFastDumpSolenoidCmd            := FALSE;

        IF bROVHotStabConnected AND (rROVSupplyPressure_bar >= 210.0) THEN
            (* Direct ROV hydraulic power to ram head-end for emergency manual close *)
            rCmdServoValveSpool_pct     := 100.0;
            rCmdIntensifierBoost_pct    := 0.0;
            bWedgeLockEngageCmd         := (rRamPosition_m >= c_rFullSealLockPosition_m);
            IF (rRamPosition_m >= c_rFullSealLockPosition_m) THEN
                bRamSealedAndLocked     := TRUE;
            END_IF;
        ELSE
            rCmdServoValveSpool_pct     := 0.0;
        END_IF;

    950: (* STATE_AUTONOMOUS_DEADMAN_AUTOSHEAR: Fast-acting emergency autonomous shear sequence *)
        wSystemStatusWord               := 16#6950; (* Bit 13: Deadman Autoshear Sequence *)
        bAutoshearArmed                 := TRUE;

        (* Fire accumulator fast dump and full intensifier immediately *)
        bFastDumpSolenoidCmd            := TRUE;
        rCmdServoValveSpool_pct         := 100.0;
        rCmdIntensifierBoost_pct        := 100.0;

        (* If ram has crossed lock position, engage locking dogs *)
        IF (rRamPosition_m >= c_rFullSealLockPosition_m) THEN
            bWedgeLockEngageCmd         := TRUE;
            bRamSealedAndLocked         := TRUE;
            iCurrentState               := 100; (* Transition to Secured Containment *)
        END_IF;

    999: (* STATE_FAILSAFE_EMERGENCY_SHUTDOWN: Controlled fault lockup and energy containment *)
        rCmdServoValveSpool_pct         := 0.0;
        rCmdIntensifierBoost_pct        := 0.0;
        bFastDumpSolenoidCmd            := FALSE;
        bWedgeLockEngageCmd             := TRUE;  (* Keep wedge dogs mechanically locked *)
        bPackerGelInjectionCmd          := FALSE;
        wSystemStatusWord               := 16#F999;
        bSystemAlarm                    := TRUE;

        (* Acoustic Telemetry Emergency Beacon Broadcast *)
        bAcousticTxEnable               := TRUE;
        dwAcousticTxPayload             := 16#FA110000 OR WORD_TO_DWORD(wDiagnosticFaultWord);

        (* Reset Procedure: Requires master permissive, reset pulse, healthy safety relay & clear faults *)
        IF bResetAlarms AND bEStopSafetyRelayOk AND bMasterSystemEnable THEN
            IF (rAccumulatorSupplyPressure_bar >= c_rMinAccumulatorCharge_bar) OR bROVHotStabConnected THEN
                wDiagnosticFaultWord    := 0;
                wAlarmSeverityWord      := 0;
                bSystemAlarm            := FALSE;

        bBankValve_Mid_Open     := FALSE;

        rVFD_ChillerSpeed_Pct   := 0.0;

====================================================================================================
Evaluates three independent physical instruments for critical bioprocess channels.
Implements mid-value selection, drift calculation, channel discrepancy exclusion,
and seamless fallback to 1oo2 or fail-safe freeze.
*)

(* -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
   SUB-SECTION 1.1: Mixer Aqueous Inlet Pressure (PT-101A, PT-101B, PT-101C)
   ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
rPT101_Sorted[1] := rPressure_Mixer_PT101A;
rPT101_Sorted[2] := rPressure_Mixer_PT101B;
rPT101_Sorted[3] := rPressure_Mixer_PT101C;

(* In-place 3-element bubble sort to isolate median value *)
IF rPT101_Sorted[1] > rPT101_Sorted[2] THEN
    rPT101_MidValue := rPT101_Sorted[1];
    rPT101_Sorted[1] := rPT101_Sorted[2];
    rPT101_Sorted[2] := rPT101_MidValue;
END_IF;
IF rPT101_Sorted[2] > rPT101_Sorted[3] THEN
    rPT101_MidValue := rPT101_Sorted[2];
    rPT101_Sorted[2] := rPT101_Sorted[3];
    rPT101_Sorted[3] := rPT101_MidValue;
END_IF;
IF rPT101_Sorted[1] > rPT101_Sorted[2] THEN
    rPT101_MidValue := rPT101_Sorted[1];
    rPT101_Sorted[1] := rPT101_Sorted[2];
    rPT101_Sorted[2] := rPT101_MidValue;
END_IF;
rPT101_MidValue := rPT101_Sorted[2]; (* Median selection *)

(* Calculate channel deviations against voted median *)
rPT101_DevA := ABS(rPressure_Mixer_PT101A - rPT101_MidValue);
rPT101_DevB := ABS(rPressure_Mixer_PT101B - rPT101_MidValue);
rPT101_DevC := ABS(rPressure_Mixer_PT101C - rPT101_MidValue);

(* Delta threshold: 0.35 bar maximum allowable divergence in microfluidic feed *)
bPT101_ChA_Fault := (rPT101_DevA > 0.35);
bPT101_ChB_Fault := (rPT101_DevB > 0.35);
bPT101_ChC_Fault := (rPT101_DevC > 0.35);

IF bPT101_ChA_Fault OR bPT101_ChB_Fault OR bPT101_ChC_Fault THEN
    bLatch_2oo3_Discrepancy_Warning := TRUE;
    dwSensorDegradedMask := dwSensorDegradedMask OR 16#00000001;
    (* Determine degraded configuration *)
    IF (bPT101_ChA_Fault AND bPT101_ChB_Fault) OR
       (bPT101_ChA_Fault AND bPT101_ChC_Fault) OR
       (bPT101_ChB_Fault AND bPT101_ChC_Fault) THEN
        bPT101_TotalFailure := TRUE;
        bPT101_Degraded_1oo2 := FALSE;
        rAct_Voted_MixerPressure_bar := rPT101_MidValue;
        dwAlarmVector_ISA18_2 := dwAlarmVector_ISA18_2 OR 16#00000002; (* TMR PT101 Collapse *)
    ELSE
        bPT101_Degraded_1oo2 := TRUE;
        bPT101_TotalFailure := FALSE;
        IF bPT101_ChA_Fault THEN
            rAct_Voted_MixerPressure_bar := (rPressure_Mixer_PT101B + rPressure_Mixer_PT101C) * 0.5;
        ELSIF bPT101_ChB_Fault THEN
            rAct_Voted_MixerPressure_bar := (rPressure_Mixer_PT101A + rPressure_Mixer_PT101C) * 0.5;
        ELSE
            rAct_Voted_MixerPressure_bar := (rPressure_Mixer_PT101A + rPressure_Mixer_PT101B) * 0.5;
        END_IF;
    END_IF;
ELSE
    bPT101_Degraded_1oo2 := FALSE;
    bPT101_TotalFailure := FALSE;
    rAct_Voted_MixerPressure_bar := rPT101_MidValue;
END_IF;

(* -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
   SUB-SECTION 1.2: Mixer Lipid Inlet Pressure (PT-102A, PT-102B, PT-102C)

rPT102_Sorted[1] := rPressure_Lipid_PT102A;
rPT102_Sorted[2] := rPressure_Lipid_PT102B;
rPT102_Sorted[3] := rPressure_Lipid_PT102C;

    rPT102_Sorted[1] := rPT102_Sorted[2];

IF rPT102_Sorted[2] > rPT102_Sorted[3] THEN

    rPT102_Sorted[2] := rPT102_Sorted[3];

rPT102_DevA := ABS(rPressure_Lipid_PT102A - rPT102_MidValue);
rPT102_DevB := ABS(rPressure_Lipid_PT102B - rPT102_MidValue);
rPT102_DevC := ABS(rPressure_Lipid_PT102C - rPT102_MidValue);

bPT102_ChA_Fault := (rPT102_DevA > 0.35);
bPT102_ChB_Fault := (rPT102_DevB > 0.35);
bPT102_ChC_Fault := (rPT102_DevC > 0.35);

IF bPT102_ChA_Fault OR bPT102_ChB_Fault OR bPT102_ChC_Fault THEN

       (bPT102_ChA_Fault AND bPT102_ChC_Fault) OR

(* -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

rAT204_Sorted[1] := rTFF_Conductivity_AT204A;
rAT204_Sorted[2] := rTFF_Conductivity_AT204B;
rAT204_Sorted[3] := rTFF_Conductivity_AT204C;

IF rAT204_Sorted[1] > rAT204_Sorted[2] THEN

    rAT204_Sorted[1] := rAT204_Sorted[2];

rAT204_MidValue := rAT204_Sorted[2];

rAT204_DevA := ABS(rTFF_Conductivity_AT204A - rAT204_MidValue);
rAT204_DevB := ABS(rTFF_Conductivity_AT204B - rAT204_MidValue);
rAT204_DevC := ABS(rTFF_Conductivity_AT204C - rAT204_MidValue);

bAT204_ChA_Fault := (rAT204_DevA > 1.25); (* 1.25 mS/cm divergence trip limit *)
bAT204_ChB_Fault := (rAT204_DevB > 1.25);
bAT204_ChC_Fault := (rAT204_DevC > 1.25);

IF bAT204_ChA_Fault OR bAT204_ChB_Fault OR bAT204_ChC_Fault THEN
    bLatch_2oo3_Discrepancy_Warning := TRUE;
    dwSensorDegradedMask := dwSensorDegradedMask OR 16#00000004;
    IF (bAT204_ChA_Fault AND bAT204_ChB_Fault) OR
       (bAT204_ChA_Fault AND bAT204_ChC_Fault) OR
       (bAT204_ChB_Fault AND bAT204_ChC_Fault) THEN
        bAT204_TotalFailure := TRUE;
        bAT204_Degraded_1oo2 := FALSE;
        rAct_Voted_RetentateCond_mS := rAT204_MidValue;
        dwAlarmVector_ISA18_2 := dwAlarmVector_ISA18_2 OR 16#00000008; (* TMR AT204 Collapse *)
    ELSE
        bAT204_Degraded_1oo2 := TRUE;
        bAT204_TotalFailure := FALSE;
        IF bAT204_ChA_Fault THEN
            rAct_Voted_RetentateCond_mS := (rTFF_Conductivity_AT204B + rTFF_Conductivity_AT204C) * 0.5;
        ELSIF bAT204_ChB_Fault THEN
            rAct_Voted_RetentateCond_mS := (rTFF_Conductivity_AT204A + rTFF_Conductivity_AT204C) * 0.5;
        ELSE
            rAct_Voted_RetentateCond_mS := (rTFF_Conductivity_AT204A + rTFF_Conductivity_AT204B) * 0.5;
        END_IF;
    END_IF;
ELSE

    bAT204_TotalFailure := FALSE;

bDegradedModeActive := bPT101_Degraded_1oo2 OR bPT102_Degraded_1oo2 OR bAT204_Degraded_1oo2;

(*
====================================================================================================
SECTION 2: FLUID DYNAMICS, FLOW CALIBRATION & IN-LINE DLS CUMULANT SPECTROSCOPY
====================================================================================================
*)
(* Resolve dual-redundant Coriolis / thermal mass flow transmitters *)
rAct_CalculatedTFR_mLmin := (rFlowRate_Aqueous_ChA + rFlowRate_Aqueous_ChB) * 0.5 +
                            (rFlowRate_Lipid_ChA + rFlowRate_Lipid_ChB) * 0.5;

IF (rFlowRate_Lipid_ChA + rFlowRate_Lipid_ChB) > 0.05 THEN
    rAct_CalculatedFRR := ((rFlowRate_Aqueous_ChA + rFlowRate_Aqueous_ChB) * 0.5) /
                          ((rFlowRate_Lipid_ChA + rFlowRate_Lipid_ChB) * 0.5);
ELSE
    rAct_CalculatedFRR := 0.0;
END_IF;

(* Solvent Dynamic Viscosity Approximation for Hydro-Alcoholic Phase (Water/Ethanol) *)
(* Polynomial fit around 20.0 deg C: eta(T, C_EtOH) in centipoise [cP] *)
rSolventDynamicViscosity_cP := 1.002 * (1.0 + (0.0245 * rEthanolConcentration_IR) - (0.0195 * (rProcessTemperature_degC - 20.0)));
IF rSolventDynamicViscosity_cP < 0.65 THEN
    rSolventDynamicViscosity_cP := 0.65;
ELSIF rSolventDynamicViscosity_cP > 2.80 THEN
    rSolventDynamicViscosity_cP := 2.80;
END_IF;

(* Stokes-Einstein Hydrodynamic Particle Size Derivation *)
(* D_h = (k_B * T) / (3.0 * pi * eta * D_t) -> Simplified reduced form with Gamma decay *)
IF (rDLS_CorrelationDecayRate_Gamma > 10.0) AND (rDLS_LaserPower_mW > 5.0) THEN
    (* k_B = 1.380649e-23, T_Kelvin = rProcessTemperature_degC + 273.15 *)
    rEstimatedStokesDiameter_nm := (1.380649E-23 * (rProcessTemperature_degC + 273.15) * 1.0E12) /
                                   (3.0 * 3.14159265 * (rSolventDynamicViscosity_cP * 1.0E-3) * (rDLS_CorrelationDecayRate_Gamma * 1.85E-5));

    (* Low-pass filter to reject optical bubble artifacts *)
    rFilteredDLS_Size_nm := (0.88 * rFilteredDLS_Size_nm) + (0.12 * rDLS_HydrodynamicDiameter);
    rDLS_NormalizedPDI   := (0.90 * rDLS_NormalizedPDI) + (0.10 * rDLS_PolydispersityIndex);
ELSE
    (* Fallback to direct spectrometer register *)
    rFilteredDLS_Size_nm := rDLS_HydrodynamicDiameter;
    rDLS_NormalizedPDI   := rDLS_PolydispersityIndex;
END_IF;

(* Transport Lag Buffer for DLS In-Line Measurement (Flow cell distance compensation) *)
rDLS_LagBuffer[iDLS_RingIndex] := rFilteredDLS_Size_nm;
iDLS_RingIndex := iDLS_RingIndex + 1;
IF iDLS_RingIndex > 10 THEN
    iDLS_RingIndex := 1;
END_IF;

(* Empirical Encapsulation Efficiency (EE%) polynomial estimation *)
(* High FRR (e.g., 4:1) with optimal PDI (<0.08) correlates with >92% mRNA entrapment *)
rAct_EstimatedEncapsulation_pct := 98.5 - (18.5 * rDLS_NormalizedPDI) - (0.45 * ABS(rFilteredDLS_Size_nm - rTarget_ParticleSize_nm));
IF rAct_EstimatedEncapsulation_pct > 99.5 THEN
    rAct_EstimatedEncapsulation_pct := 99.5;
ELSIF rAct_EstimatedEncapsulation_pct < 45.0 THEN
    rAct_EstimatedEncapsulation_pct := 45.0;
END_IF;

(*
====================================================================================================
SECTION 3: DISCRETE 6-STATE KALMAN FILTER OBSERVER
====================================================================================================
Predicts internal bioprocess state variables:
x[1] : Nanoparticle Size Tracking Error (Dh - Dh_target) [nm]
x[2] : Polydispersity Deviation (PDI - PDI_target) [PDI]
x[3] : Post-Mixer Residual Ethanol Concentration [%]
x[4] : TFF Transmembrane Pressure Deviation (TMP - TMP_target) [bar]
x[5] : Diafiltration Volume Exchange Remaining (DV_target - DV_act) [DV]
x[6] : Retentate Buffer Conductivity Error (Cond - Cond_target) [mS/cm]
*)

(* Time step dt = 0.010 s (10 ms scan cycle) *)
(* Continuous-to-Discrete State Matrix A Initialization *)
arrA_Matrix[1,1] := 0.985; arrA_Matrix[1,2] := 0.045; arrA_Matrix[1,3] :=-0.120; arrA_Matrix[1,4] := 0.000; arrA_Matrix[1,5] := 0.000; arrA_Matrix[1,6] := 0.000;
arrA_Matrix[2,1] := 0.010; arrA_Matrix[2,2] := 0.940; arrA_Matrix[2,3] := 0.085; arrA_Matrix[2,4] := 0.000; arrA_Matrix[2,5] := 0.000; arrA_Matrix[2,6] := 0.000;
arrA_Matrix[3,1] := 0.000; arrA_Matrix[3,2] := 0.000; arrA_Matrix[3,3] := 0.880; arrA_Matrix[3,4] := 0.000; arrA_Matrix[3,5] := 0.000; arrA_Matrix[3,6] := 0.000;
arrA_Matrix[4,1] := 0.000; arrA_Matrix[4,2] := 0.000; arrA_Matrix[4,3] := 0.000; arrA_Matrix[4,4] := 0.965; arrA_Matrix[4,5] :=-0.015; arrA_Matrix[4,6] := 0.000;
arrA_Matrix[5,1] := 0.000; arrA_Matrix[5,2] := 0.000; arrA_Matrix[5,3] := 0.000; arrA_Matrix[5,4] := 0.000; arrA_Matrix[5,5] := 0.998; arrA_Matrix[5,6] := 0.000;
arrA_Matrix[6,1] := 0.000; arrA_Matrix[6,2] := 0.000; arrA_Matrix[6,3] := 0.000; arrA_Matrix[6,4] := 0.000; arrA_Matrix[6,5] :=-0.085; arrA_Matrix[6,6] := 0.975;

(* Input Coupling Matrix B Initialization *)
(* Inputs: u1: dFRR, u2: dTFR, u3: dQ_quench, u4: dPumpSpeed, u5: dRetValve *)
arrB_Matrix[1,1] :=-3.850; arrB_Matrix[1,2] :=-0.125; arrB_Matrix[1,3] := 0.000; arrB_Matrix[1,4] := 0.000; arrB_Matrix[1,5] := 0.000;
arrB_Matrix[2,1] :=-0.085; arrB_Matrix[2,2] :=-0.015; arrB_Matrix[2,3] := 0.000; arrB_Matrix[2,4] := 0.000; arrB_Matrix[2,5] := 0.000;
arrB_Matrix[3,1] :=-0.450; arrB_Matrix[3,2] := 0.020; arrB_Matrix[3,3] :=-0.850; arrB_Matrix[3,4] := 0.000; arrB_Matrix[3,5] := 0.000;
arrB_Matrix[4,1] := 0.000; arrB_Matrix[4,2] := 0.000; arrB_Matrix[4,3] := 0.000; arrB_Matrix[4,4] := 0.035; arrB_Matrix[4,5] :=-0.042;
arrB_Matrix[5,1] := 0.000; arrB_Matrix[5,2] := 0.000; arrB_Matrix[5,3] := 0.000; arrB_Matrix[5,4] := 0.001; arrB_Matrix[5,5] := 0.000;
arrB_Matrix[6,1] := 0.000; arrB_Matrix[6,2] := 0.000; arrB_Matrix[6,3] := 0.000; arrB_Matrix[6,4] := 0.000; arrB_Matrix[6,5] := 0.000;

(* KALMAN STEP 1: Time Propagation / State Prediction (x_pred = A*x_est + B*u) *)
arrX_Pred[1] := (arrA_Matrix[1,1]*arrX_Est[1] + arrA_Matrix[1,2]*arrX_Est[2] + arrA_Matrix[1,3]*arrX_Est[3]) +
                (arrB_Matrix[1,1]*arrU_Prev[1] + arrB_Matrix[1,2]*arrU_Prev[2]);

arrX_Pred[2] := (arrA_Matrix[2,1]*arrX_Est[1] + arrA_Matrix[2,2]*arrX_Est[2] + arrA_Matrix[2,3]*arrX_Est[3]) +
                (arrB_Matrix[2,1]*arrU_Prev[1] + arrB_Matrix[2,2]*arrU_Prev[2]);

arrX_Pred[3] := (arrA_Matrix[3,3]*arrX_Est[3]) +
                (arrB_Matrix[3,1]*arrU_Prev[1] + arrB_Matrix[3,2]*arrU_Prev[2] + arrB_Matrix[3,3]*arrU_Prev[3]);

arrX_Pred[4] := (arrA_Matrix[4,4]*arrX_Est[4] + arrA_Matrix[4,5]*arrX_Est[5]) +
                (arrB_Matrix[4,4]*arrU_Prev[4] + arrB_Matrix[4,5]*arrU_Prev[5]);

arrX_Pred[5] := (arrA_Matrix[5,5]*arrX_Est[5]) +
                (arrB_Matrix[5,4]*arrU_Prev[4]);

arrX_Pred[6] := (arrA_Matrix[6,5]*arrX_Est[5] + arrA_Matrix[6,6]*arrX_Est[6]);

(* KALMAN STEP 2: Innovation / Measurement Residual Computation *)
arrMeas_Residual[1] := (rFilteredDLS_Size_nm - rTarget_ParticleSize_nm) - arrX_Pred[1];
arrMeas_Residual[2] := (rDLS_NormalizedPDI - rTarget_MaxPDI) - arrX_Pred[2];
arrMeas_Residual[3] := rEthanolConcentration_IR - arrX_Pred[3];
arrMeas_Residual[4] := (rAct_TransmembranePressure_bar - rTarget_RetentateTMP_bar) - arrX_Pred[4];
arrMeas_Residual[5] := (rTarget_DiafiltrationVolumes - rAct_DiafiltrationVolumes_DV) - arrX_Pred[5];
arrMeas_Residual[6] := (rAct_Voted_RetentateCond_mS - rTarget_TargetConductivity_mS) - arrX_Pred[6];

(* Steady-State Kalman Observer Gains (Pre-calculated via algebraic Riccati solution) *)
arrK_KalmanGain[1,1] := 0.245;
arrK_KalmanGain[2,2] := 0.185;
arrK_KalmanGain[3,3] := 0.320;
arrK_KalmanGain[4,4] := 0.280;
arrK_KalmanGain[5,5] := 0.050;
arrK_KalmanGain[6,6] := 0.220;

(* KALMAN STEP 3: State Correction / Measurement Update (x_est = x_pred + K*residual) *)
arrX_Est[1] := arrX_Pred[1] + (arrK_KalmanGain[1,1] * arrMeas_Residual[1]);
arrX_Est[2] := arrX_Pred[2] + (arrK_KalmanGain[2,2] * arrMeas_Residual[2]);
arrX_Est[3] := arrX_Pred[3] + (arrK_KalmanGain[3,3] * arrMeas_Residual[3]);
arrX_Est[4] := arrX_Pred[4] + (arrK_KalmanGain[4,4] * arrMeas_Residual[4]);
arrX_Est[5] := arrX_Pred[5] + (arrK_KalmanGain[5,5] * arrMeas_Residual[5]);
arrX_Est[6] := arrX_Pred[6] + (arrK_KalmanGain[6,6] * arrMeas_Residual[6]);

(*
====================================================================================================
SECTION 4: MODEL PREDICTIVE CONTROL (MPC) REAL-TIME QUADRATIC OPTIMIZATION
====================================================================================================
Minimizes objective:
  J = sum(x^T * Q * x) + sum(u^T * R * u) + sum(delta_u^T * S * delta_u)
Subject to constraints:
  3.00 <= FRR <= 5.00
  10.0 <= TFR <= 120.0 mL/min
  0.0 <= Quench_Pump <= 350.0 mL/min
  0.0 <= TFF_Feed_Pump <= 100.0 %
  0.0 <= Retentate_Valve <= 100.0 %
Executed deterministically via projected gradient descent (max 8 iterations per PLC cycle).
*)

(* Tuning Weights *)
arrQ_Weight[1] := 15.0; (* Penalty on Particle Size Error *)
arrQ_Weight[2] := 45.0; (* Severe Penalty on PDI Violation *)
arrQ_Weight[3] := 12.0; (* Penalty on Unquenched Ethanol *)
arrQ_Weight[4] :=  8.0; (* Penalty on TFF TMP Deviation *)
arrQ_Weight[5] :=  4.0; (* Penalty on Diafiltration Lag *)
arrQ_Weight[6] := 10.0; (* Penalty on Conductivity Offset *)

arrR_Weight[1] := 2.50; (* Cost on Flow Rate Ratio adjustments *)
arrR_Weight[2] := 0.85; (* Cost on Total Flow Rate adjustments *)
arrR_Weight[3] := 0.20; (* Cost on Dilution buffer flow *)
arrR_Weight[4] := 0.50; (* Cost on TFF Pump drive *)
arrR_Weight[5] := 0.65; (* Cost on Retentate valve throttle *)

arrS_Weight[1] := 5.00; (* Slew rate penalty on FRR *)
arrS_Weight[2] := 1.50; (* Slew rate penalty on TFR *)
arrS_Weight[3] := 0.50; (* Slew rate penalty on Quench *)
arrS_Weight[4] := 1.20; (* Slew rate penalty on TFF Pump *)
arrS_Weight[5] := 1.40; (* Slew rate penalty on Retentate valve *)

(* Actuator Physical Hard Limits *)
arrU_Min[1] := 3.00;   arrU_Max[1] := 5.00;   (* FRR (Aqueous:Lipid) *)
arrU_Min[2] := 10.00;  arrU_Max[2] := 120.00; (* TFR [mL/min] *)
arrU_Min[3] := 0.00;   arrU_Max[3] := 350.00; (* Quench Flow [mL/min] *)
arrU_Min[4] := 0.00;   arrU_Max[4] := 100.00; (* TFF Feed Pump [%] *)
arrU_Min[5] := 0.00;   arrU_Max[5] := 100.00; (* Retentate Valve [%] *)

arrDeltaU_Max[1] := 0.050; (* Maximum 0.05 FRR change per 10 ms *)
arrDeltaU_Max[2] := 0.800; (* Maximum 0.80 mL/min TFR change per 10 ms *)
arrDeltaU_Max[3] := 2.500; (* Maximum 2.50 mL/min Quench change per 10 ms *)
arrDeltaU_Max[4] := 0.500; (* Maximum 0.50% pump speed change per 10 ms *)
arrDeltaU_Max[5] := 0.750; (* Maximum 0.75% valve position change per 10 ms *)

(* Initialize Decision Vector from previous cycle if active *)
IF (iState = 50) AND bEnableOnlinePAT THEN
    arrU_Optimal[1] := arrU_Prev[1];
    arrU_Optimal[2] := arrU_Prev[2];
    arrU_Optimal[3] := arrU_Prev[3];
    arrU_Optimal[4] := arrU_Prev[4];
    arrU_Optimal[5] := arrU_Prev[5];

    (* Deterministic Projected Gradient Descent Loop *)
    FOR iMPC_Iteration := 1 TO 6 DO
        (* Calculate Objective Gradient: grad = B^T * Q * x_est + R * u + S * (u - u_prev) *)
        arrGradient[1] := (arrB_Matrix[1,1] * arrQ_Weight[1] * arrX_Est[1]) +
                          (arrB_Matrix[2,1] * arrQ_Weight[2] * arrX_Est[2]) +
                          (arrB_Matrix[3,1] * arrQ_Weight[3] * arrX_Est[3]) +
                          (arrR_Weight[1] * (arrU_Optimal[1] - rTarget_FRR)) +
                          (arrS_Weight[1] * (arrU_Optimal[1] - arrU_Prev[1]));

        arrGradient[2] := (arrB_Matrix[1,2] * arrQ_Weight[1] * arrX_Est[1]) +
                          (arrB_Matrix[2,2] * arrQ_Weight[2] * arrX_Est[2]) +
                          (arrB_Matrix[3,2] * arrQ_Weight[3] * arrX_Est[3]) +
                          (arrR_Weight[2] * (arrU_Optimal[2] - rTarget_TFR_mLmin)) +
                          (arrS_Weight[2] * (arrU_Optimal[2] - arrU_Prev[2]));

        arrGradient[3] := (arrB_Matrix[3,3] * arrQ_Weight[3] * arrX_Est[3]) +
                          (arrR_Weight[3] * arrU_Optimal[3]) +
                          (arrS_Weight[3] * (arrU_Optimal[3] - arrU_Prev[3]));

        arrGradient[4] := (arrB_Matrix[4,4] * arrQ_Weight[4] * arrX_Est[4]) +
                          (arrB_Matrix[5,4] * arrQ_Weight[5] * arrX_Est[5]) +
                          (arrR_Weight[4] * arrU_Optimal[4]) +
                          (arrS_Weight[4] * (arrU_Optimal[4] - arrU_Prev[4]));

        arrGradient[5] := (arrB_Matrix[4,5] * arrQ_Weight[4] * arrX_Est[4]) +
                          (arrR_Weight[5] * arrU_Optimal[5]) +
                          (arrS_Weight[5] * (arrU_Optimal[5] - arrU_Prev[5]));

        (* Descent Update: u = u - step * gradient *)
        arrU_Optimal[1] := arrU_Optimal[1] - (rMPC_StepSize * arrGradient[1]);
        arrU_Optimal[2] := arrU_Optimal[2] - (rMPC_StepSize * arrGradient[2]);
        arrU_Optimal[3] := arrU_Optimal[3] - (rMPC_StepSize * arrGradient[3]);
        arrU_Optimal[4] := arrU_Optimal[4] - (rMPC_StepSize * arrGradient[4]);
        arrU_Optimal[5] := arrU_Optimal[5] - (rMPC_StepSize * arrGradient[5]);

        (* Slew Rate Clamping *)
        IF (arrU_Optimal[1] - arrU_Prev[1]) > arrDeltaU_Max[1] THEN
            arrU_Optimal[1] := arrU_Prev[1] + arrDeltaU_Max[1];
        ELSIF (arrU_Optimal[1] - arrU_Prev[1]) < -arrDeltaU_Max[1] THEN
            arrU_Optimal[1] := arrU_Prev[1] - arrDeltaU_Max[1];
        END_IF;

        IF (arrU_Optimal[2] - arrU_Prev[2]) > arrDeltaU_Max[2] THEN
            arrU_Optimal[2] := arrU_Prev[2] + arrDeltaU_Max[2];
        ELSIF (arrU_Optimal[2] - arrU_Prev[2]) < -arrDeltaU_Max[2] THEN
            arrU_Optimal[2] := arrU_Prev[2] - arrDeltaU_Max[2];
        END_IF;

        IF (arrU_Optimal[3] - arrU_Prev[3]) > arrDeltaU_Max[3] THEN
            arrU_Optimal[3] := arrU_Prev[3] + arrDeltaU_Max[3];
        ELSIF (arrU_Optimal[3] - arrU_Prev[3]) < -arrDeltaU_Max[3] THEN
            arrU_Optimal[3] := arrU_Prev[3] - arrDeltaU_Max[3];
        END_IF;

        IF (arrU_Optimal[4] - arrU_Prev[4]) > arrDeltaU_Max[4] THEN
            arrU_Optimal[4] := arrU_Prev[4] + arrDeltaU_Max[4];
        ELSIF (arrU_Optimal[4] - arrU_Prev[4]) < -arrDeltaU_Max[4] THEN
            arrU_Optimal[4] := arrU_Prev[4] - arrDeltaU_Max[4];
        END_IF;

        IF (arrU_Optimal[5] - arrU_Prev[5]) > arrDeltaU_Max[5] THEN
            arrU_Optimal[5] := arrU_Prev[5] + arrDeltaU_Max[5];
        ELSIF (arrU_Optimal[5] - arrU_Prev[5]) < -arrDeltaU_Max[5] THEN
            arrU_Optimal[5] := arrU_Prev[5] - arrDeltaU_Max[5];
        END_IF;

        (* Box Constraint Projection *)
        IF arrU_Optimal[1] < arrU_Min[1] THEN arrU_Optimal[1] := arrU_Min[1]; END_IF;
        IF arrU_Optimal[1] > arrU_Max[1] THEN arrU_Optimal[1] := arrU_Max[1]; END_IF;

        IF arrU_Optimal[2] < arrU_Min[2] THEN arrU_Optimal[2] := arrU_Min[2]; END_IF;
        IF arrU_Optimal[2] > arrU_Max[2] THEN arrU_Optimal[2] := arrU_Max[2]; END_IF;

        IF arrU_Optimal[3] < arrU_Min[3] THEN arrU_Optimal[3] := arrU_Min[3]; END_IF;
        IF arrU_Optimal[3] > arrU_Max[3] THEN arrU_Optimal[3] := arrU_Max[3]; END_IF;

        IF arrU_Optimal[4] < arrU_Min[4] THEN arrU_Optimal[4] := arrU_Min[4]; END_IF;
        IF arrU_Optimal[4] > arrU_Max[4] THEN arrU_Optimal[4] := arrU_Max[4]; END_IF;

        IF arrU_Optimal[5] < arrU_Min[5] THEN arrU_Optimal[5] := arrU_Min[5]; END_IF;
        IF arrU_Optimal[5] > arrU_Max[5] THEN arrU_Optimal[5] := arrU_Max[5]; END_IF;
    END_FOR;
ELSE
    (* Fallback Deterministic Static Feedforward *)
    arrU_Optimal[1] := rTarget_FRR;
    arrU_Optimal[2] := rTarget_TFR_mLmin;
    arrU_Optimal[3] := rTarget_TFR_mLmin * 2.5; (* 2.5x dilution for quenching *)
    arrU_Optimal[4] := 45.0;                    (* Baseline 45% TFF feed pump *)
    arrU_Optimal[5] := 35.0;                    (* Baseline 35% retentate valve throttle *)
END_IF;

(*
====================================================================================================
SECTION 5: IN-SITU ETHANOL QUENCHING MASS BALANCE DYNAMICS
====================================================================================================
*)
(* Mass Balance Calculation:
   C_post_quench = (Q_lipid * 100%) / (Q_aqueous + Q_lipid + Q_quench)
   Target is strictly < 9.5% v/v to preserve LNP bilayer architecture.
*)
IF (rAct_CalculatedTFR_mLmin + rQuenchBuffer_InletFlowRate) > 1.0 THEN
    rAct_PostQuenchEthanol_pct := (((rFlowRate_Lipid_ChA + rFlowRate_Lipid_ChB) * 0.5) * 100.0) /
                                  (rAct_CalculatedTFR_mLmin + rQuenchBuffer_InletFlowRate);
ELSE
    rAct_PostQuenchEthanol_pct := 0.0;
END_IF;

(* Dynamic Quench Dosing Compensation: Auto-trim quench pump to cap ethanol at 9.0% *)
IF (rAct_PostQuenchEthanol_pct > 9.0) AND (iState = 50) THEN
    arrU_Optimal[3] := arrU_Optimal[3] + 5.0; (* Proactive dilution injection *)
    IF arrU_Optimal[3] > arrU_Max[3] THEN
        arrU_Optimal[3] := arrU_Max[3];
    END_IF;
END_IF;

(*
====================================================================================================
SECTION 6: CONTINUOUS TANGENTIAL FLOW FILTRATION (TFF) & DIAFILTRATION
====================================================================================================
*)
(* Transmembrane Pressure: TMP = ((P_feed + P_retentate) / 2.0) - P_permeate *)
rAct_TransmembranePressure_bar := ((rTFF_FeedPressure_PT201 + rTFF_RetentatePressure_PT202) * 0.5) - rTFF_PermeatePressure_PT203;
IF rAct_TransmembranePressure_bar < 0.0 THEN
    rAct_TransmembranePressure_bar := 0.0;
END_IF;

(* Normalized Permeate Flux: J_p = Q_permeate [L/h] / Area [m2] *)
(* Convert mL/min to L/h: (Q * 60.0) / 1000.0 *)
IF rMembraneArea_m2 > 0.001 THEN
    rAct_PermeateFlux_LMH := ((rTFF_PermeateFlowRate_FT205 * 0.060)) / rMembraneArea_m2;
ELSE
    rAct_PermeateFlux_LMH := 0.0;
END_IF;

(* Diafiltration Volume Integration: DV = Integral(Q_permeate * dt) / V_retentate *)
tPermeateIntegratorTimer(IN := NOT tPermeateIntegratorTimer.Q, PT := T#100MS);
IF tPermeateIntegratorTimer.Q AND (iState = 70) THEN
    (* 100 ms slice in minutes: 0.1 / 60.0 = 0.0016667 min *)
    rCumulativePermeateVolume_mL := rCumulativePermeateVolume_mL + (rTFF_PermeateFlowRate_FT205 * 0.0016667);
    IF rTFF_RetentateHoldVolume_mL > 5.0 THEN
        rAct_DiafiltrationVolumes_DV := rCumulativePermeateVolume_mL / rTFF_RetentateHoldVolume_mL;
    END_IF;
END_IF;

(* Buffer Exchange Completion Ratio based on 2oo3 Voted Conductivity *)
IF (rInitialRetentateConductivity - rTarget_TargetConductivity_mS) > 1.0 THEN
    rBufferExchangeCompletionRatio := (rInitialRetentateConductivity - rAct_Voted_RetentateCond_mS) /
                                      (rInitialRetentateConductivity - rTarget_TargetConductivity_mS);
    IF rBufferExchangeCompletionRatio > 1.0 THEN
        rBufferExchangeCompletionRatio := 1.0;
    ELSIF rBufferExchangeCompletionRatio < 0.0 THEN
        rBufferExchangeCompletionRatio := 0.0;
    END_IF;
ELSE
    rBufferExchangeCompletionRatio := 1.0;
END_IF;

(* TMP Regulation PID Loop (Driving retentate backpressure valve) *)
rTMP_Error := rTarget_RetentateTMP_bar - rAct_TransmembranePressure_bar;
rTMP_IntegralAccumulator := rTMP_IntegralAccumulator + (rTMP_Error * 0.010);
IF rTMP_IntegralAccumulator > 30.0 THEN rTMP_IntegralAccumulator := 30.0; END_IF;
IF rTMP_IntegralAccumulator < -30.0 THEN rTMP_IntegralAccumulator := -30.0; END_IF;

rTMP_DerivativeValue := (rTMP_Error - rTMP_PrevError) / 0.010;
rTMP_PrevError := rTMP_Error;

(*
====================================================================================================
SECTION 7: MULTI-STAGE PROCESS FINITE STATE MACHINE (ISA-88 COMPLIANT)
====================================================================================================
*)
tStateTimer(IN := (iState = iPrevState), PT := T#24H);
tSubStateTimer(IN := TRUE, PT := T#24H);
iPrevState := iState;

CASE iState OF

    0: (* ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
          STATE 0: INITIALIZATION & SELF-DIAGNOSTIC TEST (POWER-ON POST)
          ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
        sCurrentStateString := 'INITIALIZING_DIAGNOSTIC_POST';
        bSystemReady        := FALSE;
        bFormulationActive  := FALSE;
        bQuenchActive       := FALSE;
        bDiafiltrationActive:= FALSE;
        bCycleComplete      := FALSE;

        rCmd_AqueousPump_FlowRate     := 0.0;
        rCmd_LipidPump_FlowRate       := 0.0;
        rCmd_QuenchPump_FlowRate      := 0.0;
        rCmd_TFF_FeedPump_Speed       := 0.0;
        rCmd_TFF_RetentateValve_Pos   := 0.0;
        rCmd_TFF_DiafiltratePump_Flow := 0.0;

        (* Reset accumulators *)
        rCumulativePermeateVolume_mL := 0.0;
        rAct_DiafiltrationVolumes_DV := 0.0;
        rFilteredDLS_Size_nm         := rTarget_ParticleSize_nm;
        rDLS_NormalizedPDI           := 0.05;

        IF bExecute AND (NOT bEmergencyStopActive) AND (NOT bAlarmActive) THEN
            iState := 10; (* Proceed to Standby & Thermal Conditioning *)
        END_IF;

    10: (* -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
          STATE 10: STANDBY & THERMAL JACKET EQUILIBRATION
          ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
        sCurrentStateString := 'STANDBY_THERMAL_EQUILIBRATION';

        (* Closed loop Peltier thermal jacket regulation *)
        rTemp_Error := 20.0 - rProcessTemperature_degC; (* Target 20.0 deg C *)
        rTemp_IntegralAccumulator := rTemp_IntegralAccumulator + (rTemp_Error * 0.010);
        IF rTemp_IntegralAccumulator > 50.0 THEN rTemp_IntegralAccumulator := 50.0; END_IF;
        IF rTemp_IntegralAccumulator < -50.0 THEN rTemp_IntegralAccumulator := -50.0; END_IF;
        rCmd_ThermalJacket_DutyCycle := (rTemp_Kp * rTemp_Error) + (rTemp_Ki * rTemp_IntegralAccumulator);

        IF rCmd_ThermalJacket_DutyCycle > 100.0 THEN rCmd_ThermalJacket_DutyCycle := 100.0; END_IF;
        IF rCmd_ThermalJacket_DutyCycle < 0.0 THEN rCmd_ThermalJacket_DutyCycle := 0.0; END_IF;

        (* Check thermal tolerance (+/- 1.5 deg C) and 2oo3 sensor health *)
        IF (ABS(rProcessTemperature_degC - 20.0) < 1.5) AND
           (NOT bPT101_TotalFailure) AND (NOT bPT102_TotalFailure) AND (NOT bAT204_TotalFailure) THEN
            bSystemReady := TRUE;
            IF bExecute THEN
                iState := 20; (* Advance to Hydraulic Prime *)
                iSubState := 0;
            END_IF;
        ELSE
            bSystemReady := FALSE;
        END_IF;

    20: (* -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
          STATE 20: SOLVENT LINE PRIME, DE-AIRING & LEAK TEST
          ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
        sCurrentStateString := 'LINE_PRIME_AND_DEAIRING';

        CASE iSubState OF
            0: (* Prime Aqueous Manifold with Citrate Buffer *)
                rCmd_AqueousPump_FlowRate := 5.0; (* 5 mL/min flush *)
                rCmd_LipidPump_FlowRate   := 0.0;
                rCmd_QuenchPump_FlowRate  := 15.0;
                IF tStateTimer.ET > T#10S THEN
                    iSubState := 1;
                END_IF;

            1: (* Prime Lipid Line with 100% Pure Ethanol *)
                rCmd_AqueousPump_FlowRate := 5.0;
