    rConst_FrostConductivity_WmK    : REAL := 0.22;     (* [W/(m*K)] Thermal conductivity of frost deposit *)
    rConst_SpoolDuctArea_m2         : REAL := 0.07068;  (* [m2] Inter-chamber vapor transfer spool duct cross-section *)
    rConst_VialBaseArea_m2          : REAL := 0.000314; (* [m2] 2R format vial base surface area (pi * 0.01^2) *)
    rConst_VialCountContinuous      : REAL := 120.0;    (* [-] Instantaneous vials residing in primary drying zone *)
    rConst_MaxAllowableFrost_kg     : REAL := 18.5;     (* [kg] Maximum condenser ice trap holding capacity *)
    rConst_ChamberVolume_m3         : REAL := 0.850;    (* [m3] Free volume of continuous sublimation corridor *)

    (* ===================================================================================== *)
    (* FIRST-PRINCIPLES ESTIMATED VARIABLES                                                  *)
    (* ===================================================================================== *)
    rVaporSaturationPressIce_mbar   : REAL;     (* [mbar] P_ice calculated at sublimation front *)
    rDriedCakeThickness_mm          : REAL;     (* [mm] Current dried cake thickness (L_nom - L_ice) *)
    rVaporDensity_kgm3              : REAL;     (* [kg/m3] Water vapor density at sublimation conditions *)
    rVaporAcousticSpeed_mps         : REAL;     (* [m/s] Speed of sound in low-pressure water vapor *)
    rVaporDuctVelocity_mps          : REAL;     (* [m/s] Linear vapor transfer velocity through spool duct *)
    rVaporMachNumber                : REAL;     (* [-] Spool flow Mach number *)
    rTotalSublimationMassRate_kgh   : REAL;     (* [kg/h] Aggregate vapor generation from all resident vials *)
    rCondenserThermalResistance_KW  : REAL;     (* [K/W] Dynamic conductive resistance of frost layer *)

    (* ===================================================================================== *)
    (* DISCRETE STATE-SPACE MODEL MATRICES & VECTORS (6-STATE, 4-INPUT, 6-OUTPUT)             *)
    (* ===================================================================================== *)
    (* States:                                                                              *)
    (*   x[1] = T_ice       (Sublimation front temperature [deg C])                         *)
    (*   x[2] = L_dry       (Dried cake layer thickness [mm])                               *)
    (*   x[3] = T_shelf     (Platen temperature [deg C])                                    *)
    (*   x[4] = M_frost     (Accumulated condenser frost mass [kg])                         *)
    (*   x[5] = P_chamber   (Chamber absolute pressure [mbar])                              *)
    (*   x[6] = T_cond      (Condenser coil surface temperature [deg C])                    *)
    (* Inputs:                                                                              *)
    (*   u[1] = Q_shelf     (Shelf heating demand [%])                                      *)
    (*   u[2] = V_cryo      (Cryogenic expansion valve demand [%])                          *)
    (*   u[3] = V_n2        (Sterile N2 bleed valve demand [%])                             *)
    (*   u[4] = V_conv      (Continuous conveyor speed [mm/s])                              *)
    aA                              : ARRAY[1..6, 1..6] OF REAL; (* Discrete State Transition Matrix *)
    aB                              : ARRAY[1..6, 1..4] OF REAL; (* Discrete Input Distribution Matrix *)
    aC                              : ARRAY[1..6, 1..6] OF REAL; (* Discrete Output Measurement Matrix *)
    aD                              : ARRAY[1..6, 1..4] OF REAL; (* Direct Feedthrough Matrix *)
    aK_Observer                     : ARRAY[1..6, 1..6] OF REAL; (* Kalman Filter / Observer Gain Matrix *)

    aX_State                        : ARRAY[1..6] OF REAL;       (* Actual Plant State Estimates *)
    aX_Predicted                    : ARRAY[1..6] OF REAL;       (* One-step forward state predictions *)
    aY_Measured                     : ARRAY[1..6] OF REAL;       (* Sensor Feedback Measurement Vector *)
    aY_Residual                     : ARRAY[1..6] OF REAL;       (* Innovation / Measurement Residual Vector *)
    aU_Control                      : ARRAY[1..4] OF REAL;       (* Applied Control Vector *)
    aU_Previous                     : ARRAY[1..4] OF REAL;       (* Previous Cycle Control Vector *)
    aU_Target                       : ARRAY[1..4] OF REAL;       (* Desired Setpoint Demands *)

    (* ===================================================================================== *)
    (* MODEL PREDICTIVE CONTROL (MPC) QUADRATIC COST OPTIMIZATION WEIGHTS & BUFFERS          *)
    (* ===================================================================================== *)
    aQ_StateWeights                 : ARRAY[1..6] OF REAL;       (* State Tracking Error Penalties *)
    aR_InputWeights                 : ARRAY[1..4] OF REAL;       (* Actuator Effort Penalties *)
    aR_DeltaWeights                 : ARRAY[1..4] OF REAL;       (* Slew Rate Penalties *)
    aX_Reference                    : ARRAY[1..6] OF REAL;       (* Reference State Trajectory *)
    
    aMpcGradient                    : ARRAY[1..4] OF REAL;       (* Projected Gradient Vector *)
    aMpcHessianDiag                 : ARRAY[1..4] OF REAL;       (* Diagonalized Quadratic Hessian Matrix *)
    aDeltaU_Mpc                     : ARRAY[1..4] OF REAL;       (* Optimal Step Increment *)
    
    rMpcStepSize                    : REAL := 0.085;             (* Gradient descent step relaxation alpha *)
    rMpcConvergenceTolerance       : REAL := 0.005;             (* QP termination threshold *)
    iMpcMaxIterations               : INT := 12;                 (* Maximum iterations per 10 ms cycle *)
    iMpcActualIterations            : INT := 0;                  (* Actual iterations executed *)
    rMpcCostFunction                : REAL := 0.0;               (* Instantaneous Quadratic Cost J *)

    (* Constraints *)
    rU1_Min                         : REAL := 0.0;               (* Min Shelf Heater Demand [%] *)
    rU1_Max                         : REAL := 100.0;             (* Max Shelf Heater Demand [%] *)
    rU2_Min                         : REAL := 0.0;               (* Min Cryo Valve Demand [%] *)
    rU2_Max                         : REAL := 100.0;             (* Max Cryo Valve Demand [%] *)
    rU3_Min                         : REAL := 0.0;               (* Min N2 Bleed Valve [%] *)
    rU3_Max                         : REAL := 100.0;             (* Max N2 Bleed Valve [%] *)
    rU4_Min                         : REAL := 0.0;               (* Min Conveyor Speed [mm/s] *)
    rU4_Max                         : REAL := 25.0;              (* Max Conveyor Speed [mm/s] *)

    (* Slew Rate Limiters (Max change per second) *)
    rU1_MaxRate_pcts                : REAL := 5.0;               (* Shelf Heater max 5%/s ramp *)
    rU2_MaxRate_pcts                : REAL := 10.0;              (* Cryo Valve max 10%/s ramp *)
    rU3_MaxRate_pcts                : REAL := 15.0;              (* N2 Bleed max 15%/s ramp *)
    rU4_MaxRate_mms2                : REAL := 2.5;               (* Conveyor max 2.5 mm/s^2 accel *)

    (* ===================================================================================== *)
    (* CLEAN-IN-PLACE (CIP) & AIRLOCK CONTROL VARIABLES                                      *)
    (* ===================================================================================== *)
    iCipStep                        : INT := 0;
    rCipWashTime_sec                : REAL := 0.0;
    bCipPrerinseComplete            : BOOL := FALSE;
    bCipDetergentComplete           : BOOL := FALSE;
    bCipFinalRinseComplete          : BOOL := FALSE;
    bCipVacuumDryingComplete        : BOOL := FALSE;
    bAirlockInfeedSealed            : BOOL := TRUE;
    bAirlockOutfeedSealed           : BOOL := TRUE;
    bIsolationGateValveOpen         : BOOL := FALSE;

    (* Loop indexing variables *)
    i                               : INT;
    j                               : INT;
    k                               : INT;
    rTempCalc                       : REAL;
    rTempSum                        : REAL;
    rMaxDev                         : REAL;
END_VAR

(* ========================================================================================= *)
(* ========================================================================================= *)
(* MAIN DETERMINISTIC CONTROL LOGIC EXECUTION                                                *)
(* ========================================================================================= *)
(* ========================================================================================= *)

(* ========================================================================================= *)
(* 1.0 SAFETY INTERLOCK & E-STOP SUPERVISION (SIL-3 / CAT 4 VERIFICATION)                    *)
(* ========================================================================================= *)
(* Fail-safe safety relay monitoring. Loss of E-stop circuit or critical aseptic isolation    *)
(* forces immediate transition to safe hold state, isolating vacuum locks and shutting down   *)
(* high-power shelf heaters.                                                                 *)

IF NOT bEmergencyStop OR NOT bEnableSystem THEN
    bSystemReady                 := FALSE;
    bSystemRunning               := FALSE;
    rShelfHeaterDemand_pct       := 0.0;
    rN2ProportionalBleedValve_pct:= 0.0;
    rConveyorPitchVelocity_mmpers:= 0.0;
    (* Keep condenser cooling active to prevent ice sublimation runaway onto vacuum pumps *)
    rCryoRefrigExpansionValve_pct:= 65.0;
    bAirlockIsolationActive      := TRUE;
    bIsolationGateValveOpen      := FALSE;
    iState                       := 999; (* EMERGENCY SAFE HOLD STATE *)
    dwAlarmStateWord             := dwAlarmStateWord OR 16#0000_0001; (* Bit 0: Emergency Stop Active *)
    bAlarmSummary                := TRUE;
    RETURN;
ELSE
    dwAlarmStateWord             := dwAlarmStateWord AND NOT 16#0000_0001;
END_IF;

IF NOT bSterileBarrierIntact THEN
    dwAlarmStateWord             := dwAlarmStateWord OR 16#0000_0002; (* Bit 1: Sterile Barrier Loss *)
    bAlarmSummary                := TRUE;
    rConveyorPitchVelocity_mmpers:= 0.0;
    bAirlockIsolationActive      := TRUE;
    bIsolationGateValveOpen      := FALSE;
ELSE
    dwAlarmStateWord             := dwAlarmStateWord AND NOT 16#0000_0002;
END_IF;


(* ========================================================================================= *)
(* 2.0 TRIPLE MODULAR REDUNDANCY (2oo3 TMR) SENSOR VOTING & HEALTH ENGINE                    *)
(* ========================================================================================= *)
(* Performs median voting across 3 channels for Capacitance Manometer, Pirani, Shelf Platen  *)
(* Temperature, and Confocal Laser Distance. Validates inter-channel consistency and sets   *)
(* degradation flags if any channel drifts beyond the allowable metrology envelope.          *)

(* ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* 2.1 Capacitance Manometer (Baratron) 2oo3 Voting (Allowable drift: 0.025 mbar)            *)
(* ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
rBaratron_Dev12 := ABS(rChamberPressure_Baratron_mbar - rChamberPressure_Baratron2_mbar);
rBaratron_Dev23 := ABS(rChamberPressure_Baratron2_mbar - rChamberPressure_Baratron3_mbar);
rBaratron_Dev31 := ABS(rChamberPressure_Baratron3_mbar - rChamberPressure_Baratron_mbar);

bBaratronCh1_Healthy := (rBaratron_Dev12 <= 0.025) OR (rBaratron_Dev31 <= 0.025);
bBaratronCh2_Healthy := (rBaratron_Dev12 <= 0.025) OR (rBaratron_Dev23 <= 0.025);
bBaratronCh3_Healthy := (rBaratron_Dev23 <= 0.025) OR (rBaratron_Dev31 <= 0.025);

iBaratronHealthyCount := 0;
IF bBaratronCh1_Healthy THEN iBaratronHealthyCount := iBaratronHealthyCount + 1; END_IF;
IF bBaratronCh2_Healthy THEN iBaratronHealthyCount := iBaratronHealthyCount + 1; END_IF;
IF bBaratronCh3_Healthy THEN iBaratronHealthyCount := iBaratronHealthyCount + 1; END_IF;

IF iBaratronHealthyCount >= 2 THEN
    (* Standard 2oo3 Median Selection *)
    IF (rChamberPressure_Baratron_mbar >= rChamberPressure_Baratron2_mbar AND rChamberPressure_Baratron_mbar <= rChamberPressure_Baratron3_mbar) OR
       (rChamberPressure_Baratron_mbar <= rChamberPressure_Baratron2_mbar AND rChamberPressure_Baratron_mbar >= rChamberPressure_Baratron3_mbar) THEN
        rChamberPressureVoted_mbar := rChamberPressure_Baratron_mbar;
    ELSIF (rChamberPressure_Baratron2_mbar >= rChamberPressure_Baratron_mbar AND rChamberPressure_Baratron2_mbar <= rChamberPressure_Baratron3_mbar) OR
          (rChamberPressure_Baratron2_mbar <= rChamberPressure_Baratron_mbar AND rChamberPressure_Baratron2_mbar >= rChamberPressure_Baratron3_mbar) THEN
        rChamberPressureVoted_mbar := rChamberPressure_Baratron2_mbar;
    ELSE
        rChamberPressureVoted_mbar := rChamberPressure_Baratron3_mbar;
    END_IF;
    dwDiagnosticsWord := dwDiagnosticsWord AND NOT 16#0000_0001;
ELSE
    (* Degraded Mode: Fallback to Mean of surviving channels *)
    rChamberPressureVoted_mbar := (rChamberPressure_Baratron_mbar + rChamberPressure_Baratron2_mbar + rChamberPressure_Baratron3_mbar) / 3.0;
    dwDiagnosticsWord := dwDiagnosticsWord OR 16#0000_0001; (* Bit 0: Baratron TMR degraded *)
    bSensorDiscrepancyAlarm := TRUE;
END_IF;

(* ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* 2.2 Thermal Conductivity Pirani Gauge 2oo3 Voting (Allowable drift: 0.040 mbar)           *)
(* ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
rPirani_Dev12 := ABS(rChamberPressure_Pirani_mbar - rChamberPressure_Pirani2_mbar);
rPirani_Dev23 := ABS(rChamberPressure_Pirani2_mbar - rChamberPressure_Pirani3_mbar);
rPirani_Dev31 := ABS(rChamberPressure_Pirani3_mbar - rChamberPressure_Pirani_mbar);

bPiraniCh1_Healthy := (rPirani_Dev12 <= 0.040) OR (rPirani_Dev31 <= 0.040);
bPiraniCh2_Healthy := (rPirani_Dev12 <= 0.040) OR (rPirani_Dev23 <= 0.040);
bPiraniCh3_Healthy := (rPirani_Dev23 <= 0.040) OR (rPirani_Dev31 <= 0.040);

iPiraniHealthyCount := 0;
IF bPiraniCh1_Healthy THEN iPiraniHealthyCount := iPiraniHealthyCount + 1; END_IF;
IF bPiraniCh2_Healthy THEN iPiraniHealthyCount := iPiraniHealthyCount + 1; END_IF;
IF bPiraniCh3_Healthy THEN iPiraniHealthyCount := iPiraniHealthyCount + 1; END_IF;

IF iPiraniHealthyCount >= 2 THEN
    IF (rChamberPressure_Pirani_mbar >= rChamberPressure_Pirani2_mbar AND rChamberPressure_Pirani_mbar <= rChamberPressure_Pirani3_mbar) OR
       (rChamberPressure_Pirani_mbar <= rChamberPressure_Pirani2_mbar AND rChamberPressure_Pirani_mbar >= rChamberPressure_Pirani3_mbar) THEN
        rFiltPiraniPressure_mbar := rChamberPressure_Pirani_mbar;
    ELSIF (rChamberPressure_Pirani2_mbar >= rChamberPressure_Pirani_mbar AND rChamberPressure_Pirani2_mbar <= rChamberPressure_Pirani3_mbar) OR
          (rChamberPressure_Pirani2_mbar <= rChamberPressure_Pirani_mbar AND rChamberPressure_Pirani2_mbar >= rChamberPressure_Pirani3_mbar) THEN
        rFiltPiraniPressure_mbar := rChamberPressure_Pirani2_mbar;
    ELSE
        rFiltPiraniPressure_mbar := rChamberPressure_Pirani3_mbar;
    END_IF;
    dwDiagnosticsWord := dwDiagnosticsWord AND NOT 16#0000_0002;
ELSE
    rFiltPiraniPressure_mbar := (rChamberPressure_Pirani_mbar + rChamberPressure_Pirani2_mbar + rChamberPressure_Pirani3_mbar) / 3.0;
    dwDiagnosticsWord := dwDiagnosticsWord OR 16#0000_0002; (* Bit 1: Pirani TMR degraded *)
    bSensorDiscrepancyAlarm := TRUE;
END_IF;

(* ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* 2.3 Suspended Shelf Platen Temperature 2oo3 Voting (Allowable drift: 0.75 deg C)          *)
(* ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
rShelfTemp_Dev12 := ABS(rShelfTemperature_degC - rShelfTemperature2_degC);
rShelfTemp_Dev23 := ABS(rShelfTemperature2_degC - rShelfTemperature3_degC);
rShelfTemp_Dev31 := ABS(rShelfTemperature3_degC - rShelfTemperature_degC);

bShelfTempCh1_Healthy := (rShelfTemp_Dev12 <= 0.75) OR (rShelfTemp_Dev31 <= 0.75);
bShelfTempCh2_Healthy := (rShelfTemp_Dev12 <= 0.75) OR (rShelfTemp_Dev23 <= 0.75);
bShelfTempCh3_Healthy := (rShelfTemp_Dev23 <= 0.75) OR (rShelfTemp_Dev31 <= 0.75);

iShelfTempHealthyCount := 0;
IF bShelfTempCh1_Healthy THEN iShelfTempHealthyCount := iShelfTempHealthyCount + 1; END_IF;
IF bShelfTempCh2_Healthy THEN iShelfTempHealthyCount := iShelfTempHealthyCount + 1; END_IF;
IF bShelfTempCh3_Healthy THEN iShelfTempHealthyCount := iShelfTempHealthyCount + 1; END_IF;

IF iShelfTempHealthyCount >= 2 THEN
    IF (rShelfTemperature_degC >= rShelfTemperature2_degC AND rShelfTemperature_degC <= rShelfTemperature3_degC) OR
       (rShelfTemperature_degC <= rShelfTemperature2_degC AND rShelfTemperature_degC >= rShelfTemperature3_degC) THEN
        rShelfTempVoted_degC := rShelfTemperature_degC;
    ELSIF (rShelfTemperature2_degC >= rShelfTemperature_degC AND rShelfTemperature2_degC <= rShelfTemperature3_degC) OR
          (rShelfTemperature2_degC <= rShelfTemperature_degC AND rShelfTemperature2_degC >= rShelfTemperature3_degC) THEN
        rShelfTempVoted_degC := rShelfTemperature2_degC;
    ELSE
        rShelfTempVoted_degC := rShelfTemperature3_degC;
    END_IF;
    dwDiagnosticsWord := dwDiagnosticsWord AND NOT 16#0000_0004;
ELSE
    rShelfTempVoted_degC := (rShelfTemperature_degC + rShelfTemperature2_degC + rShelfTemperature3_degC) / 3.0;
    dwDiagnosticsWord := dwDiagnosticsWord OR 16#0000_0004; (* Bit 2: Shelf Temp TMR degraded *)
    bSensorDiscrepancyAlarm := TRUE;
END_IF;

(* ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* 2.4 Confocal Laser Ice-Front Distance 2oo3 Voting (Allowable drift: 0.15 mm)              *)
(* ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
rLaserPos_Dev12 := ABS(rSublimationIceFrontPos_mm - rSublimationIceFrontPos2_mm);
rLaserPos_Dev23 := ABS(rSublimationIceFrontPos2_mm - rSublimationIceFrontPos3_mm);
rLaserPos_Dev31 := ABS(rSublimationIceFrontPos3_mm - rSublimationIceFrontPos_mm);

bLaserPosCh1_Healthy := (rLaserPos_Dev12 <= 0.15) OR (rLaserPos_Dev31 <= 0.15);
bLaserPosCh2_Healthy := (rLaserPos_Dev12 <= 0.15) OR (rLaserPos_Dev23 <= 0.15);
bLaserPosCh3_Healthy := (rLaserPos_Dev23 <= 0.15) OR (rLaserPos_Dev31 <= 0.15);

iLaserPosHealthyCount := 0;
IF bLaserPosCh1_Healthy THEN iLaserPosHealthyCount := iLaserPosHealthyCount + 1; END_IF;
IF bLaserPosCh2_Healthy THEN iLaserPosHealthyCount := iLaserPosHealthyCount + 1; END_IF;
IF bLaserPosCh3_Healthy THEN iLaserPosHealthyCount := iLaserPosHealthyCount + 1; END_IF;

IF iLaserPosHealthyCount >= 2 THEN
    IF (rSublimationIceFrontPos_mm >= rSublimationIceFrontPos2_mm AND rSublimationIceFrontPos_mm <= rSublimationIceFrontPos3_mm) OR
       (rSublimationIceFrontPos_mm <= rSublimationIceFrontPos2_mm AND rSublimationIceFrontPos_mm >= rSublimationIceFrontPos3_mm) THEN
        rIceFrontPosVoted_mm := rSublimationIceFrontPos_mm;
    ELSIF (rSublimationIceFrontPos2_mm >= rSublimationIceFrontPos_mm AND rSublimationIceFrontPos2_mm <= rSublimationIceFrontPos3_mm) OR
          (rSublimationIceFrontPos2_mm <= rSublimationIceFrontPos_mm AND rSublimationIceFrontPos2_mm >= rSublimationIceFrontPos3_mm) THEN
        rIceFrontPosVoted_mm := rSublimationIceFrontPos2_mm;
    ELSE
        rIceFrontPosVoted_mm := rSublimationIceFrontPos3_mm;
    END_IF;
    dwDiagnosticsWord := dwDiagnosticsWord AND NOT 16#0000_0008;
ELSE
    rIceFrontPosVoted_mm := (rSublimationIceFrontPos_mm + rSublimationIceFrontPos2_mm + rSublimationIceFrontPos3_mm) / 3.0;
    dwDiagnosticsWord := dwDiagnosticsWord OR 16#0000_0008; (* Bit 3: Laser TMR degraded *)
    bSensorDiscrepancyAlarm := TRUE;
END_IF;

(* Master Discrepancy Reset if all 4 sensor suites healthy *)
IF (iBaratronHealthyCount = 3) AND (iPiraniHealthyCount = 3) AND 
   (iShelfTempHealthyCount = 3) AND (iLaserPosHealthyCount = 3) THEN
    bSensorDiscrepancyAlarm := FALSE;
END_IF;


(* ========================================================================================= *)
(* 3.0 DIGITAL SIGNAL FILTERING & DERIVATIVE ESTIMATION                                      *)
(* ========================================================================================= *)
(* Exponential moving average filtering (alpha = 0.08) to attenuate high-frequency acoustic   *)
(* pump flutter and optical scatter while preserving true sublimation dynamics.              *)

rFiltChamberPressure_mbar := (0.92 * rFiltChamberPressure_mbar) + (0.08 * rChamberPressureVoted_mbar);
rFiltShelfTemp_degC       := (0.95 * rFiltShelfTemp_degC)       + (0.05 * rShelfTempVoted_degC);
rFiltCondenserTemp_degC   := (0.97 * rFiltCondenserTemp_degC)   + (0.03 * rCondenserSurfaceTemp_degC);
rFiltMassRate_kgh         := (0.90 * rFiltMassRate_kgh)         + (0.10 * rCondenserFrostMassRate_kgh);

(* Calculate Moving Ice-Front Propagation Velocity [mm/s] with central differencing *)
IF tScanCycleTime_ms > 0.001 THEN
    rRawIceVelocity_mms := (rIceFrontPosVoted_mm - rPrevIceFrontPos_mm) / (tScanCycleTime_ms * 0.001);
ELSE
    rRawIceVelocity_mms := 0.0;
END_IF;
rPrevIceFrontPos_mm := rIceFrontPosVoted_mm;

(* Clamp non-physical negative velocity (ice cannot regenerate during primary sublimation) *)
IF rRawIceVelocity_mms < 0.0 THEN
    rRawIceVelocity_mms := 0.0;
ELSIF rRawIceVelocity_mms > 0.050 THEN
    rRawIceVelocity_mms := 0.050; (* Hard physical upper velocity limit: 50 um/s *)
END_IF;

rFiltIceVelocity_mms := (0.85 * rFiltIceVelocity_mms) + (0.15 * rRawIceVelocity_mms);
rEstimatedIceFrontVelocity_mms := rFiltIceVelocity_mms;


(* ========================================================================================= *)
(* 4.0 FIRST-PRINCIPLES PHYSICAL MODELING & PHENOMENOLOGICAL CALCULUS                        *)
(* ========================================================================================= *)

(* ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* 4.1 Comparative Manometry Gas Composition Ratio                                           *)
(* ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
IF rFiltChamberPressure_mbar > 0.001 THEN
    rPiraniBaratronRatio := rFiltPiraniPressure_mbar / rFiltChamberPressure_mbar;
ELSE
    rPiraniBaratronRatio := 1.0;
END_IF;

(* ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* 4.2 Dried Cake Layer & Sublimation Progress                                               *)
(* ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
IF rNominalCakeHeight_mm > 0.1 THEN
    rDriedCakeThickness_mm := rIceFrontPosVoted_mm;
    IF rDriedCakeThickness_mm > rNominalCakeHeight_mm THEN
        rDriedCakeThickness_mm := rNominalCakeHeight_mm;
    END_IF;
    rSublimationProgress_pct := (rDriedCakeThickness_mm / rNominalCakeHeight_mm) * 100.0;
ELSE
    rDriedCakeThickness_mm := 0.0;
    rSublimationProgress_pct := 0.0;
END_IF;

(* ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* 4.3 Dynamic Cake Resistance Rp(L_dry) Modeling [mbar * s * m2 / kg]                       *)
(* ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* Semi-empirical Pikal formulation for Knudsen porous diffusion resistance *)
rEstimatedCakeResistance_mbarshkg := 1.25E5 + ((3.85E5 * rDriedCakeThickness_mm) / (1.0 + (0.12 * rDriedCakeThickness_mm)));

(* ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* 4.4 Sublimation Interface Equilibrium Vapor Pressure & Interface Temperature              *)
(* ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* Reconstruct interface temperature using energy balance and optical pyrometer feedback *)
rVialBottomInterfaceTemp_degC := rVialProductSurfaceTemp_degC - (rShelfRadiativeHeatFlux_Wm2 * (rDriedCakeThickness_mm * 1.0E-3) / 0.28);

(* Clausius-Clapeyron / Buck equation for saturated ice vapor pressure [mbar] *)
IF rVialBottomInterfaceTemp_degC < 0.0 THEN
    rVaporSaturationPressIce_mbar := 6.1121 * EXP((22.46 * rVialBottomInterfaceTemp_degC) / (272.62 + rVialBottomInterfaceTemp_degC));
ELSE
    rVaporSaturationPressIce_mbar := 6.1121;
END_IF;

(* ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* 4.5 Sublimation Mass Flux & Spool Vapor Dynamics                                          *)
(* ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
IF (rVaporSaturationPressIce_mbar > rFiltChamberPressure_mbar) AND (rEstimatedCakeResistance_mbarshkg > 1000.0) THEN
    rSublimationVaporFlux_kghm2 := ((rVaporSaturationPressIce_mbar - rFiltChamberPressure_mbar) / rEstimatedCakeResistance_mbarshkg) * 3600.0;
ELSE
    rSublimationVaporFlux_kghm2 := 0.0;
END_IF;

(* Aggregate vapor flow from all active vials in sublimation corridor *)
rTotalSublimationMassRate_kgh := rConst_VialCountContinuous * rConst_VialBaseArea_m2 * rSublimationVaporFlux_kghm2;

(* ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* 4.6 Cryogenic Condenser Coil Dynamic Frost Mass Balance & Choking Detection               *)
(* ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* Frost mass accumulation integrated over time *)
rCondenserAccumulatedIce_kg := rCondenserAccumulatedIce_kg + ((rFiltMassRate_kgh / 3600.0) * (tScanCycleTime_ms * 0.001));

(* Frost blanket thickness [mm] across total condenser surface area *)
IF rConst_CondenserArea_m2 > 0.1 AND rConst_FrostDensity_kgm3 > 10.0 THEN
    rCondenserFrostThickness_mm := (rCondenserAccumulatedIce_kg / (rConst_FrostDensity_kgm3 * rConst_CondenserArea_m2)) * 1000.0;
ELSE
    rCondenserFrostThickness_mm := 0.0;
END_IF;

(* Dynamic conductive thermal resistance of frost deposit *)
rCondenserThermalResistance_KW := (rCondenserFrostThickness_mm * 0.001) / (rConst_FrostConductivity_WmK * rConst_CondenserArea_m2);

(* ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* 4.7 Aerodynamic Spool Duct Vapor Velocity & Mach Number Calculation                       *)
(* ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* Gas density via ideal gas law: rho = (P * 100) / (R_specific * T_kelvin) *)
IF (rFiltChamberPressure_mbar > 0.005) AND ((rShelfTempVoted_degC + 273.15) > 100.0) THEN
    rVaporDensity_kgm3 := (rFiltChamberPressure_mbar * 100.0) / (rConst_R_h2o * (rShelfTempVoted_degC + 273.15));
    rVaporAcousticSpeed_mps := SQRT(rConst_Gamma_h2o * rConst_R_h2o * (rShelfTempVoted_degC + 273.15));
    
    (* Linear velocity in transfer spool: v = m_dot / (rho * A_duct) *)
    IF (rVaporDensity_kgm3 > 0.00001) AND (rConst_SpoolDuctArea_m2 > 0.001) THEN
        rVaporDuctVelocity_mps := (rTotalSublimationMassRate_kgh / 3600.0) / (rVaporDensity_kgm3 * rConst_SpoolDuctArea_m2);
        rVaporMachNumber := rVaporDuctVelocity_mps / rVaporAcousticSpeed_mps;
    ELSE
        rVaporDuctVelocity_mps := 0.0;
        rVaporMachNumber := 0.0;
    END_IF;
ELSE
    rVaporDensity_kgm3 := 0.001;
    rVaporAcousticSpeed_mps := 400.0;
    rVaporDuctVelocity_mps := 0.0;
    rVaporMachNumber := 0.0;
END_IF;

(* Condenser Choking Detection *)
tChokingDebounceTimer(IN := (rVaporMachNumber >= 0.28), PT := T#2S);
IF tChokingDebounceTimer.Q THEN
    bCondenserChokeWarning := TRUE;
    dwAlarmStateWord := dwAlarmStateWord OR 16#0000_0004; (* Bit 2: Aerodynamic Choking Warning *)
ELSE
    bCondenserChokeWarning := FALSE;
    dwAlarmStateWord := dwAlarmStateWord AND NOT 16#0000_0004;
END_IF;

(* Critical Collapse Margin Monitoring *)
IF (rVialBottomInterfaceTemp_degC >= (rCriticalCollapseTemp_degC - 1.5)) THEN
    bCollapseWarning := TRUE;
    dwAlarmStateWord := dwAlarmStateWord OR 16#0000_0008; (* Bit 3: Thermal Collapse Risk *)
ELSE
    bCollapseWarning := FALSE;
    dwAlarmStateWord := dwAlarmStateWord AND NOT 16#0000_0008;
END_IF;


(* ========================================================================================= *)
(* 5.0 6-STATE DISCRETE CYBER-PHYSICAL STATE-SPACE OBSERVER                                   *)
(* ========================================================================================= *)
(* State Vector:                                                                             *)
(*   x[1] = T_ice [deg C]                                                                    *)
(*   x[2] = L_dry [mm]                                                                       *)
(*   x[3] = T_shelf [deg C]                                                                  *)
(*   x[4] = M_frost [kg]                                                                     *)
(*   x[5] = P_chamber [mbar]                                                                 *)
(*   x[6] = T_cond [deg C]                                                                   *)

(* Initialize Dynamic Matrices once or on state reset *)
IF (iPrevState <> iState) OR (iState = 0) THEN
    (* Discrete A Matrix (Sampling period Ts = 10 ms) *)
    aA[1,1] := 0.9850; aA[1,2] := -0.0120; aA[1,3] := 0.0180; aA[1,4] := 0.0000; aA[1,5] := 0.0050; aA[1,6] := 0.0000;
    aA[2,1] := 0.0008; aA[2,2] := 0.9995;  aA[2,3] := 0.0012; aA[2,4] := 0.0000; aA[2,5] :=-0.0005; aA[2,6] := 0.0000;
    aA[3,1] := 0.0000; aA[3,2] := 0.0000;  aA[3,3] := 0.9920; aA[3,4] := 0.0000; aA[3,5] := 0.0000; aA[3,6] := 0.0000;
    aA[4,1] := 0.0025; aA[4,2] := 0.0000;  aA[4,3] := 0.0035; aA[4,4] := 1.0000; aA[4,5] := 0.0000; aA[4,6] :=-0.0015;
    aA[5,1] := 0.0015; aA[5,2] :=-0.0008; aA[5,3] := 0.0022; aA[5,4] := 0.0000; aA[5,5] := 0.9650; aA[5,6] := 0.0010;
    aA[6,1] := 0.0000; aA[6,2] := 0.0000;  aA[6,3] := 0.0000; aA[6,4] := 0.0080; aA[6,5] := 0.0000; aA[6,6] := 0.9780;

    (* Discrete B Matrix *)
    aB[1,1] := 0.0240; aB[1,2] := 0.0000; aB[1,3] := 0.0020; aB[1,4] :=-0.0015;
    aB[2,1] := 0.0015; aB[2,2] := 0.0000; aB[2,3] := 0.0000; aB[2,4] := 0.0040;
    aB[3,1] := 0.0850; aB[3,2] := 0.0000; aB[3,3] := 0.0000; aB[3,4] := 0.0000;
    aB[4,1] := 0.0008; aB[4,2] := 0.0012; aB[4,3] := 0.0000; aB[4,4] := 0.0025;
    aB[5,1] := 0.0030; aB[5,2] :=-0.0045; aB[5,3] := 0.0480; aB[5,4] := 0.0010;
    aB[6,1] := 0.0000; aB[6,2] :=-0.0750; aB[6,3] := 0.0000; aB[6,4] := 0.0000;

    (* Output Matrix C (Direct Identity Mapping with Unit Scaling) *)
    FOR i := 1 TO 6 DO
        FOR j := 1 TO 6 DO
            IF i = j THEN
                aC[i,j] := 1.0;
            ELSE
                aC[i,j] := 0.0;
            END_IF;
        END_FOR;
    END_FOR;

    (* Direct Feedthrough D Matrix *)
    FOR i := 1 TO 6 DO
        FOR j := 1 TO 4 DO
            aD[i,j] := 0.0;
        END_FOR;
    END_FOR;

    (* Observer Gain Matrix K_Observer *)
    aK_Observer[1,1] := 0.150; aK_Observer[1,2] := 0.000; aK_Observer[1,3] := 0.025; aK_Observer[1,4] := 0.000; aK_Observer[1,5] := 0.010; aK_Observer[1,6] := 0.000;
    aK_Observer[2,1] := 0.000; aK_Observer[2,2] := 0.220; aK_Observer[2,3] := 0.000; aK_Observer[2,4] := 0.000; aK_Observer[2,5] := 0.000; aK_Observer[2,6] := 0.000;
    aK_Observer[3,1] := 0.010; aK_Observer[3,2] := 0.000; aK_Observer[3,3] := 0.180; aK_Observer[3,4] := 0.000; aK_Observer[3,5] := 0.000; aK_Observer[3,6] := 0.000;
    aK_Observer[4,1] := 0.000; aK_Observer[4,2] := 0.000; aK_Observer[4,3] := 0.000; aK_Observer[4,4] := 0.250; aK_Observer[4,5] := 0.000; aK_Observer[4,6] := 0.000;
    aK_Observer[5,1] := 0.005; aK_Observer[5,2] := 0.000; aK_Observer[5,3] := 0.000; aK_Observer[5,4] := 0.000; aK_Observer[5,5] := 0.190; aK_Observer[5,6] := 0.000;
    aK_Observer[6,1] := 0.000; aK_Observer[6,2] := 0.000; aK_Observer[6,3] := 0.000; aK_Observer[6,4] := 0.015; aK_Observer[6,5] := 0.000; aK_Observer[6,6] := 0.160;

    (* MPC Weight Matrices *)
    aQ_StateWeights[1] := 45.0; (* Heavy penalty on ice interface temperature tracking *)
    aQ_StateWeights[2] := 25.0; (* High penalty on dried cake progression error *)
    aQ_StateWeights[3] := 10.0; (* Shelf platen temperature tracking *)
    aQ_StateWeights[4] :=  5.0; (* Condenser frost mass penalty *)
    aQ_StateWeights[5] := 35.0; (* Chamber vacuum stability penalty *)
    aQ_StateWeights[6] := 15.0; (* Condenser temperature regulation penalty *)

    aR_InputWeights[1] :=  1.2; (* Shelf heater effort penalty *)
    aR_InputWeights[2] :=  1.5; (* Cryo refrigeration valve effort penalty *)
    aR_InputWeights[3] :=  2.0; (* N2 bleed gas consumption penalty *)
    aR_InputWeights[4] :=  0.8; (* Conveyor indexing velocity penalty *)

    aR_DeltaWeights[1] :=  3.5; (* Heater slew rate penalty *)
    aR_DeltaWeights[2] :=  4.0; (* Cryo valve slew rate penalty *)
    aR_DeltaWeights[3] :=  5.0; (* N2 bleed valve slew rate penalty *)
    aR_DeltaWeights[4] :=  2.5; (* Conveyor acceleration penalty *)
END_IF;

(* Construct Measurement Vector y *)
aY_Measured[1] := rVialBottomInterfaceTemp_degC;
aY_Measured[2] := rDriedCakeThickness_mm;
aY_Measured[3] := rShelfTempVoted_degC;
aY_Measured[4] := rCondenserAccumulatedIce_kg;
aY_Measured[5] := rChamberPressureVoted_mbar;
aY_Measured[6] := rFiltCondenserTemp_degC;

(* Map current control vector u *)
aU_Control[1]  := rShelfHeaterDemand_pct;
aU_Control[2]  := rCryoRefrigExpansionValve_pct;
aU_Control[3]  := rN2ProportionalBleedValve_pct;
aU_Control[4]  := rConveyorPitchVelocity_mmpers;

(* Observer Step 1: Predict State x_hat(k+1|k) = A * x(k) + B * u(k) *)
FOR i := 1 TO 6 DO
    rTempSum := 0.0;
    FOR j := 1 TO 6 DO
        rTempSum := rTempSum + (aA[i,j] * aX_State[j]);
    END_FOR;
    FOR k := 1 TO 4 DO
        rTempSum := rTempSum + (aB[i,k] * aU_Control[k]);
    END_FOR;
    aX_Predicted[i] := rTempSum;
END_FOR;

(* Observer Step 2: Compute Residual e = y - C * x_predicted *)
FOR i := 1 TO 6 DO
    rTempSum := 0.0;
    FOR j := 1 TO 6 DO
        rTempSum := rTempSum + (aC[i,j] * aX_Predicted[j]);
    END_FOR;
    aY_Residual[i] := aY_Measured[i] - rTempSum;
END_FOR;

(* Observer Step 3: Measurement Correction x(k+1) = x_predicted + K * e *)
FOR i := 1 TO 6 DO
    rTempSum := 0.0;
    FOR j := 1 TO 6 DO
        rTempSum := rTempSum + (aK_Observer[i,j] * aY_Residual[j]);
    END_FOR;
    aX_State[i] := aX_Predicted[i] + rTempSum;
END_FOR;


(* ========================================================================================= *)
(* 6.0 MULTIVARIABLE MODEL PREDICTIVE CONTROL (MPC) OPTIMIZATION ENGINE                      *)
(* ========================================================================================= *)
(* Formulates a finite-horizon quadratic programming cost objective:                         *)
(*   J(u) = (x - x_ref)^T * Q * (x - x_ref) + u^T * R * u + (u - u_prev)^T * R_delta * (u - u_prev) *)
(* Executes active-set projected gradient descent to obtain optimal control demands subject  *)
(* to actuator saturation and process safety envelopes.                                      *)

(* Update Dynamic Reference Trajectory based on Lyophilization Phase *)
IF (iState = 60) THEN
    (* Primary Sublimation State Target *)
    aX_Reference[1] := rCriticalCollapseTemp_degC - 3.5; (* Safety margin of 3.5 C below collapse *)
    aX_Reference[2] := rNominalCakeHeight_mm;            (* Full cake completion *)
    aX_Reference[3] := -15.0;                            (* Sublimation shelf platen temp setpoint *)
    aX_Reference[4] := rConst_MaxAllowableFrost_kg * 0.75;
    aX_Reference[5] := rTargetChamberPressure_mbar;      (* Target sublimation vacuum *)
    aX_Reference[6] := -85.0;                            (* Condenser cryogenic target *)
ELSIF (iState = 80) THEN
    (* Secondary Desorption Stage Target *)
    aX_Reference[1] := 25.0;
    aX_Reference[2] := rNominalCakeHeight_mm;
    aX_Reference[3] := 35.0;                             (* Platen heated to promote desorption *)
    aX_Reference[4] := rConst_MaxAllowableFrost_kg * 0.85;
    aX_Reference[5] := 0.015;                            (* Deep secondary vacuum *)
    aX_Reference[6] := -88.0;
ELSE
    (* Holding State Reference *)
    aX_Reference[1] := -45.0;
    aX_Reference[2] := 0.0;
    aX_Reference[3] := -45.0;
    aX_Reference[4] := 0.0;
    aX_Reference[5] := 0.100;
    aX_Reference[6] := -85.0;
END_IF;

(* MPC Iterative Gradient Descent Optimization *)
aU_Target[1] := aU_Control[1];
aU_Target[2] := aU_Control[2];
aU_Target[3] := aU_Control[3];
aU_Target[4] := aU_Control[4];

iMpcActualIterations := 0;
FOR k := 1 TO iMpcMaxIterations DO
    iMpcActualIterations := iMpcActualIterations + 1;
    
    (* Calculate Gradient of Quadratic Cost w.r.t. Actuator Inputs:                          *)
    (* Grad_u(J) = 2 * B^T * Q * (x_predicted - x_ref) + 2 * R * u + 2 * R_delta * (u - u_prev)*)
    FOR j := 1 TO 4 DO
        rTempSum := 0.0;
        FOR i := 1 TO 6 DO
            rTempSum := rTempSum + (aB[i,j] * aQ_StateWeights[i] * (aX_Predicted[i] - aX_Reference[i]));
        END_FOR;
        
        aMpcGradient[j] := (2.0 * rTempSum) + 
                           (2.0 * aR_InputWeights[j] * aU_Target[j]) + 
                           (2.0 * aR_DeltaWeights[j] * (aU_Target[j] - aU_Previous[j]));
    END_FOR;

    (* Approximate Diagonal Hessian Element for Fast Newton/Gradient Scaling *)
    FOR j := 1 TO 4 DO
        rTempSum := 0.0;
        FOR i := 1 TO 6 DO
            rTempSum := rTempSum + (aB[i,j] * aB[i,j] * aQ_StateWeights[i]);
        END_FOR;
        aMpcHessianDiag[j] := (2.0 * rTempSum) + (2.0 * aR_InputWeights[j]) + (2.0 * aR_DeltaWeights[j]);
        IF aMpcHessianDiag[j] < 1.0E-4 THEN
            aMpcHessianDiag[j] := 1.0E-4;
        END_IF;
    END_FOR;

    (* Projected Step Update: u = u - alpha * (Grad / Hessian) *)
    rMaxDev := 0.0;
    FOR j := 1 TO 4 DO
        aDeltaU_Mpc[j] := rMpcStepSize * (aMpcGradient[j] / aMpcHessianDiag[j]);
        aU_Target[j] := aU_Target[j] - aDeltaU_Mpc[j];
        
        (* Box Constraints Clamping *)
        IF j = 1 THEN
            IF aU_Target[1] < rU1_Min THEN aU_Target[1] := rU1_Min; END_IF;
            IF aU_Target[1] > rU1_Max THEN aU_Target[1] := rU1_Max; END_IF;
        ELSIF j = 2 THEN
            IF aU_Target[2] < rU2_Min THEN aU_Target[2] := rU2_Min; END_IF;
            IF aU_Target[2] > rU2_Max THEN aU_Target[2] := rU2_Max; END_IF;
        ELSIF j = 3 THEN
            IF aU_Target[3] < rU3_Min THEN aU_Target[3] := rU3_Min; END_IF;
            IF aU_Target[3] > rU3_Max THEN aU_Target[3] := rU3_Max; END_IF;
        ELSIF j = 4 THEN
            IF aU_Target[4] < rU4_Min THEN aU_Target[4] := rU4_Min; END_IF;
            IF aU_Target[4] > rU4_Max THEN aU_Target[4] := rU4_Max; END_IF;
        END_IF;

        IF ABS(aDeltaU_Mpc[j]) > rMaxDev THEN
            rMaxDev := ABS(aDeltaU_Mpc[j]);
        END_IF;
    END_FOR;

    (* Convergence Check *)
    IF rMaxDev < rMpcConvergenceTolerance THEN
        EXIT;
    END_IF;
END_FOR;

(* Calculate Current Instantaneous Cost Function J for Diagnostics *)
rMpcCostFunction := 0.0;
FOR i := 1 TO 6 DO
    rMpcCostFunction := rMpcCostFunction + (aQ_StateWeights[i] * (aX_State[i] - aX_Reference[i]) * (aX_State[i] - aX_Reference[i]));
END_FOR;
FOR j := 1 TO 4 DO
    rMpcCostFunction := rMpcCostFunction + (aR_InputWeights[j] * aU_Target[j] * aU_Target[j]);
END_FOR;

(* Pack MPC Optimization Status *)
dwMpcStatusWord := 16#0000_0000;
IF (iMpcActualIterations < iMpcMaxIterations) THEN
    dwMpcStatusWord := dwMpcStatusWord OR 16#0000_0001; (* Bit 0: QP Solver Converged *)
ELSE
    dwMpcStatusWord := dwMpcStatusWord OR 16#0000_0002; (* Bit 1: QP Max Iterations Reached *)
END_IF;
IF (rMaxDev < 0.05) THEN
    dwMpcStatusWord := dwMpcStatusWord OR 16#0000_0004; (* Bit 2: Residual Norm Nominal *)
END_IF;


(* ========================================================================================= *)
(* 7.0 DETERMINISTIC MULTI-STAGE CONTINUOUS FREEZE-DRYING FINITE STATE MACHINE               *)
(* ========================================================================================= *)
(* Encapsulates all sequence transitions from sterile isolation hold, chamber evacuation,     *)
(* micro-pinch suspended transport, primary sublimation control, PRT endpoint, and CIP wash.  *)

tStateTimer(IN := (iState = iPrevState), PT := T#86400S);

CASE iState OF

    0: (* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
       (* STATE 0: INITIALIZATION & POWER-ON COLD RESET                                      *)
       (* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
        bSystemReady                  := FALSE;
        bSystemRunning                := FALSE;
        bSublimationComplete          := FALSE;
        bAirlockIsolationActive       := TRUE;
        bIsolationGateValveOpen       := FALSE;
        rShelfHeaterDemand_pct        := 0.0;
        rCryoRefrigExpansionValve_pct := 0.0;
        rN2ProportionalBleedValve_pct := 0.0;
        rConveyorPitchVelocity_mmpers := 0.0;
        rCondenserAccumulatedIce_kg   := 0.0;
        
        (* Reset State Observer Vector to Ambient / Chilled Standby Values *)
        aX_State[1] := -45.0;
        aX_State[2] := 0.0;
        aX_State[3] := -40.0;
        aX_State[4] := 0.0;
        aX_State[5] := 1013.25;
        aX_State[6] := -20.0;

        IF bEnableSystem AND bEmergencyStop AND bSterileBarrierIntact THEN
            iState := 10; (* Proceed to Sterile Barrier and Vacuum Hold *)
        END_IF;

    10: (* --------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
        (* STATE 10: STERILE ISOLATION & LOAD LOCK VACUUM VERIFICATION                       *)
        (* --------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
        bSystemReady            := FALSE;
        bSystemRunning          := FALSE;
        bAirlockIsolationActive := TRUE;
        bIsolationGateValveOpen := FALSE;
        
        (* Maintain platens cold to protect system integrity *)
        rShelfHeaterDemand_pct  := 0.0;
        rCryoRefrigExpansionValve_pct := 25.0;

        (* Verify infeed and outfeed airlock seals hold atmospheric barrier *)
        IF (rVacuumLockInfeedPress_bar <= 1.05) AND (rVacuumLockOutfeedPress_bar <= 1.05) THEN
            IF tStateTimer.ET >= T#5S THEN
                iState := 20; (* Proceed to Deep Vacuum Pulldown *)
            END_IF;
        ELSE
            dwAlarmStateWord := dwAlarmStateWord OR 16#0000_0010; (* Bit 4: Airlock Pressure Leak *)
        END_IF;

    20: (* --------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
        (* STATE 20: CHAMBER DEEP VACUUM PULLDOWN & CONDENSER PULLDOWN                       *)
        (* --------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
        bSystemReady            := FALSE;
        bSystemRunning          := FALSE;
        bAirlockIsolationActive := TRUE;
        bIsolationGateValveOpen := FALSE;
        
        (* Drive cryogenic expansion valve to pull coil below -80 deg C *)
        rCryoRefrigExpansionValve_pct := 85.0;
        rShelfHeaterDemand_pct        := 0.0;
        rN2ProportionalBleedValve_pct := 0.0;

        (* Check vacuum and condenser temperature criteria *)
        IF (rChamberPressureVoted_mbar <= 0.150) AND (rFiltCondenserTemp_degC <= -75.0) THEN
            IF tStateTimer.ET >= T#10S THEN
                iState := 30; (* Proceed to Cryogenic Condenser Equilibrium *)
            END_IF;
        END_IF;

    30: (* --------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
        (* STATE 30: CONDENSER EQUILIBRATION & PRE-SUBLIMATION THERMAL BALANCING             *)
        (* --------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
        bSystemReady            := TRUE;
        bSystemRunning          := FALSE;
        bAirlockIsolationActive := TRUE;
        
        (* Modulate refrigeration to maintain -85 deg C baseline *)
        IF rFiltCondenserTemp_degC > -82.0 THEN
            rCryoRefrigExpansionValve_pct := 70.0;
        ELSE
            rCryoRefrigExpansionValve_pct := 40.0;
        END_IF;

        (* Pre-cool suspended micro-pinch platen to -40 deg C *)
        IF rShelfTempVoted_degC > -38.0 THEN
            rShelfHeaterDemand_pct := 0.0;
        ELSE
            rShelfHeaterDemand_pct := 15.0;
        END_IF;

        IF (rShelfTempVoted_degC <= -38.0) AND (rChamberPressureVoted_mbar <= 0.100) THEN
            iState := 40; (* Proceed to Continuous Infeed Transfer *)
        END_IF;

    40: (* --------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
        (* STATE 40: CONTINUOUS INFEED LOAD LOCK TRANSFER & SUSPENDED PINCH GRIP             *)
        (* --------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
        bSystemReady            := TRUE;
        bSystemRunning          := TRUE;
        
        (* Airlock evacuation before opening gate valve *)
        IF (rVacuumLockInfeedPress_bar <= 0.002) AND bAirlockDoorOpenPermissive THEN
            bIsolationGateValveOpen := TRUE;
            bAirlockIsolationActive := FALSE;
            
            (* Start linear indexing conveyor to accept frozen vials *)
            rConveyorPitchVelocity_mmpers := 8.5;
            
            IF tStateTimer.ET >= T#8S THEN
                iState := 50; (* Proceed to Micro-Pinch Alignment *)
            END_IF;
        ELSE
            bIsolationGateValveOpen := FALSE;
            bAirlockIsolationActive := TRUE;
            rConveyorPitchVelocity_mmpers := 0.0;
        END_IF;

    50: (* --------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
        (* STATE 50: MICRO-PINCH SUSPENSION & CONFOCAL LASER ALIGNMENT                       *)
        (* --------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
        bSystemReady            := TRUE;
        bSystemRunning          := TRUE;
        bIsolationGateValveOpen := TRUE;
        
        (* Maintain steady vial transport *)
        rConveyorPitchVelocity_mmpers := 12.0;

        (* Check laser ice-front sensor signal validity *)
        IF (rIceFrontPosVoted_mm >= 0.0) AND (rIceFrontPosVoted_mm <= (rNominalCakeHeight_mm + 2.0)) THEN
            IF tStateTimer.ET >= T#5S THEN
                iState := 60; (* Activate Full MPC Primary Sublimation *)
            END_IF;
        ELSE
            dwAlarmStateWord := dwAlarmStateWord OR 16#0000_0020; (* Bit 5: Laser Misalignment *)
        END_IF;

    60: (* --------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
        (* STATE 60: CONTINUOUS PRIMARY SUBLIMATION - FULL MPC CLOSED-LOOP GOVERNOR          *)
        (* --------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
        bSystemReady            := TRUE;
        bSystemRunning          := TRUE;
        bAirlockIsolationActive := FALSE;
        bIsolationGateValveOpen := TRUE;

        (* Transfer optimal MPC outputs to actuator demands *)
        rShelfHeaterDemand_pct        := aU_Target[1];
        rCryoRefrigExpansionValve_pct := aU_Target[2];
        rN2ProportionalBleedValve_pct := aU_Target[3];
        rConveyorPitchVelocity_mmpers := aU_Target[4];

        (* Primary Sublimation Endpoint Detection via Comparative Manometry:                 *)
        (* During active drying, Pirani / Baratron is ~1.58. When sublimation terminates,    *)
        (* Pirani converges to Baratron (Ratio <= 1.05) and Ice Front reaches nominal cake depth.*)
        IF (rPiraniBaratronRatio <= 1.05) AND (rSublimationProgress_pct >= 96.0) THEN
            IF tStateTimer.ET >= T#30S THEN
                iState := 70; (* Proceed to Pressure Rise Test Verification *)
            END_IF;
        ELSIF bManualPrtTrigger THEN
            iState := 70; (* Operator initiated PRT *)
        END_IF;

    70: (* --------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
        (* STATE 70: PRESSURE RISE TEST (PRT) / MANOMETRIC ENDPOINT VERIFICATION             *)
        (* --------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
        bSystemReady            := TRUE;
        bSystemRunning          := TRUE;
        
        (* Temporarily freeze conveyor indexing during 15-second isolation *)
        rConveyorPitchVelocity_mmpers := 0.0;
        
        IF NOT bPrtActive THEN
            (* Initialize PRT *)
            bPrtActive := TRUE;
            rPrtStartPressure_mbar := rChamberPressureVoted_mbar;
            tPrtDwellTimer(IN := FALSE);
        ELSE
            tPrtDwellTimer(IN := TRUE, PT := T#15S);
            rPrtDeltaPressure_mbar := rChamberPressureVoted_mbar - rPrtStartPressure_mbar;
            
            IF tPrtDwellTimer.Q THEN
                rPrtRateOfRise_mbars := rPrtDeltaPressure_mbar / 15.0;
                bPrtActive := FALSE;

(* ==================================================================================================
   SAFETY INTERLOCK & EMERGENCY ASCENT TRIPPING SECTION (FAIL-SAFE SIL-3 PRE-CHECKS)
   ================================================================================================== *)
IF bEStopEmergencyAscent OR (NOT bMasterEnable AND iCurrentStateID > 0) THEN
    (* Latch Emergency Ascent state *)
    bEmergencyAscentTriggered := TRUE;
    iCurrentStateID := 110; (* Transition directly to emergency buoyant ascent *)
    dwAlarmTreeHighSeverity := dwAlarmTreeHighSeverity OR 16#80000000; (* Bit31: Hard E-Stop / Master Drop *)
END_IF;

(* Heartbeat 1.0s square-wave generator for subsea telemetry ping *)
tHeartbeatBlinker(IN := NOT tHeartbeatBlinker.Q, PT := T#500MS);
IF tHeartbeatBlinker.Q THEN
    bHeartbeatBit := NOT bHeartbeatBit;
END_IF;

(* ==================================================================================================
   STAGE 1: 2oo3 TRIPLE MODULAR REDUNDANT (TMR) VOTING & SENSOR VALIDATION ENGINES
   ================================================================================================== *)
(* --- 1.1 Hydrostatic Depth Pressure 2oo3 Voter (Nominal ~ 400.0 bar at 4000m Depth) --- *)
(* Channel discrepancy tolerances: 6.0 bar allowable spread between independent transmitters *)
bPressTMR_ChA_Healthy := (ABS(rDepthPressure_ChA_bar - rDepthPressure_ChB_bar) <= 6.0) OR (ABS(rDepthPressure_ChA_bar - rDepthPressure_ChC_bar) <= 6.0);
bPressTMR_ChB_Healthy := (ABS(rDepthPressure_ChB_bar - rDepthPressure_ChA_bar) <= 6.0) OR (ABS(rDepthPressure_ChB_bar - rDepthPressure_ChC_bar) <= 6.0);
bPressTMR_ChC_Healthy := (ABS(rDepthPressure_ChC_bar - rDepthPressure_ChA_bar) <= 6.0) OR (ABS(rDepthPressure_ChC_bar - rDepthPressure_ChB_bar) <= 6.0);

IF bPressTMR_ChA_Healthy AND bPressTMR_ChB_Healthy AND bPressTMR_ChC_Healthy THEN
    (* All 3 Channels Healthy: Median Selection Algorithm *)
    IF ((rDepthPressure_ChA_bar >= rDepthPressure_ChB_bar) AND (rDepthPressure_ChA_bar <= rDepthPressure_ChC_bar)) OR
       ((rDepthPressure_ChA_bar >= rDepthPressure_ChC_bar) AND (rDepthPressure_ChA_bar <= rDepthPressure_ChB_bar)) THEN
        rVotedDepthPressure_bar := rDepthPressure_ChA_bar;
    ELSIF ((rDepthPressure_ChB_bar >= rDepthPressure_ChA_bar) AND (rDepthPressure_ChB_bar <= rDepthPressure_ChC_bar)) OR
          ((rDepthPressure_ChB_bar >= rDepthPressure_ChC_bar) AND (rDepthPressure_ChB_bar <= rDepthPressure_ChA_bar)) THEN
        rVotedDepthPressure_bar := rDepthPressure_ChB_bar;
    ELSE
        rVotedDepthPressure_bar := rDepthPressure_ChC_bar;
    END_IF;
    iPressTMR_DegradedState := 0; (* Nominal 2oo3 *)
ELSIF bPressTMR_ChA_Healthy AND bPressTMR_ChB_Healthy THEN
    rVotedDepthPressure_bar := (rDepthPressure_ChA_bar + rDepthPressure_ChB_bar) * 0.5;
    iPressTMR_DegradedState := 1; (* Degraded 2oo2: Channel C Fault *)
    dwAlarmTreeLowSeverity := dwAlarmTreeLowSeverity OR 16#00000001; (* Warning: Pressure Ch C Fault *)
ELSIF bPressTMR_ChA_Healthy AND bPressTMR_ChC_Healthy THEN
    rVotedDepthPressure_bar := (rDepthPressure_ChA_bar + rDepthPressure_ChC_bar) * 0.5;
    iPressTMR_DegradedState := 1; (* Degraded 2oo2: Channel B Fault *)
    dwAlarmTreeLowSeverity := dwAlarmTreeLowSeverity OR 16#00000002; (* Warning: Pressure Ch B Fault *)
ELSIF bPressTMR_ChB_Healthy AND bPressTMR_ChC_Healthy THEN
    rVotedDepthPressure_bar := (rDepthPressure_ChB_bar + rDepthPressure_ChC_bar) * 0.5;
    iPressTMR_DegradedState := 1; (* Degraded 2oo2: Channel A Fault *)
    dwAlarmTreeLowSeverity := dwAlarmTreeLowSeverity OR 16#00000004; (* Warning: Pressure Ch A Fault *)
ELSIF bPressTMR_ChA_Healthy THEN
    rVotedDepthPressure_bar := rDepthPressure_ChA_bar;
    iPressTMR_DegradedState := 2; (* Degraded 1oo1: Only Ch A Remaining *)
    dwAlarmTreeLowSeverity := dwAlarmTreeLowSeverity OR 16#00000008;
ELSE
    (* All Pressure Transmitters Discrepant - Critical TMR Failure *)
    iPressTMR_DegradedState := 3;
    dwAlarmTreeHighSeverity := dwAlarmTreeHighSeverity OR 16#00000001; (* Critical: Total Depth Pressure Loss *)
END_IF;

(* --- 1.2 Umbilical Tension 2oo3 Voter (Nominal Range 10.0..150.0 kN) --- *)
bTensionTMR_ChA_Healthy := (ABS(rUmbilicalTension_ChA_kN - rUmbilicalTension_ChB_kN) <= 15.0) OR (ABS(rUmbilicalTension_ChA_kN - rUmbilicalTension_ChC_kN) <= 15.0);
bTensionTMR_ChB_Healthy := (ABS(rUmbilicalTension_ChB_kN - rUmbilicalTension_ChA_kN) <= 15.0) OR (ABS(rUmbilicalTension_ChB_kN - rUmbilicalTension_ChC_kN) <= 15.0);
bTensionTMR_ChC_Healthy := (ABS(rUmbilicalTension_ChC_kN - rUmbilicalTension_ChA_kN) <= 15.0) OR (ABS(rUmbilicalTension_ChC_kN - rUmbilicalTension_ChB_kN) <= 15.0);

IF bTensionTMR_ChA_Healthy AND bTensionTMR_ChB_Healthy AND bTensionTMR_ChC_Healthy THEN
    IF ((rUmbilicalTension_ChA_kN >= rUmbilicalTension_ChB_kN) AND (rUmbilicalTension_ChA_kN <= rUmbilicalTension_ChC_kN)) OR
       ((rUmbilicalTension_ChA_kN >= rUmbilicalTension_ChC_kN) AND (rUmbilicalTension_ChA_kN <= rUmbilicalTension_ChB_kN)) THEN
        rVotedUmbilicalTension_kN := rUmbilicalTension_ChA_kN;
    ELSIF ((rUmbilicalTension_ChB_kN >= rUmbilicalTension_ChA_kN) AND (rUmbilicalTension_ChB_kN <= rUmbilicalTension_ChC_kN)) OR
          ((rUmbilicalTension_ChB_kN >= rUmbilicalTension_ChC_kN) AND (rUmbilicalTension_ChB_kN <= rUmbilicalTension_ChA_kN)) THEN
        rVotedUmbilicalTension_kN := rUmbilicalTension_ChB_kN;
    ELSE
        rVotedUmbilicalTension_kN := rUmbilicalTension_ChC_kN;
    END_IF;
    iTensionTMR_DegradedState := 0;
ELSIF bTensionTMR_ChA_Healthy AND bTensionTMR_ChB_Healthy THEN
    rVotedUmbilicalTension_kN := (rUmbilicalTension_ChA_kN + rUmbilicalTension_ChB_kN) * 0.5;
    iTensionTMR_DegradedState := 1;
    dwAlarmTreeLowSeverity := dwAlarmTreeLowSeverity OR 16#00000010;
ELSIF bTensionTMR_ChA_Healthy AND bTensionTMR_ChC_Healthy THEN
    rVotedUmbilicalTension_kN := (rUmbilicalTension_ChA_kN + rUmbilicalTension_ChC_kN) * 0.5;
    iTensionTMR_DegradedState := 1;
    dwAlarmTreeLowSeverity := dwAlarmTreeLowSeverity OR 16#00000020;
ELSIF bTensionTMR_ChB_Healthy AND bTensionTMR_ChC_Healthy THEN
    rVotedUmbilicalTension_kN := (rUmbilicalTension_ChB_kN + rUmbilicalTension_ChC_kN) * 0.5;
    iTensionTMR_DegradedState := 1;
    dwAlarmTreeLowSeverity := dwAlarmTreeLowSeverity OR 16#00000040;
ELSE
    rVotedUmbilicalTension_kN := 45.0; (* Default conservative assumption *)
    iTensionTMR_DegradedState := 3;
    dwAlarmTreeHighSeverity := dwAlarmTreeHighSeverity OR 16#00000002; (* Critical: Total Tension Sensor Loss *)
END_IF;

(* --- 1.3 Doppler Velocity Log (DVL) Bottom-Track Surge & Sway 2oo3 Voter --- *)
bDVLTMR_ChA_Healthy := (ABS(rDVL_Velocity_Surge_ChA_mps - rDVL_Velocity_Surge_ChB_mps) <= 0.08) OR (ABS(rDVL_Velocity_Surge_ChA_mps - rDVL_Velocity_Surge_ChC_mps) <= 0.08);
bDVLTMR_ChB_Healthy := (ABS(rDVL_Velocity_Surge_ChB_mps - rDVL_Velocity_Surge_ChA_mps) <= 0.08) OR (ABS(rDVL_Velocity_Surge_ChB_mps - rDVL_Velocity_Surge_ChC_mps) <= 0.08);
bDVLTMR_ChC_Healthy := (ABS(rDVL_Velocity_Surge_ChC_mps - rDVL_Velocity_Surge_ChA_mps) <= 0.08) OR (ABS(rDVL_Velocity_Surge_ChC_mps - rDVL_Velocity_Surge_ChB_mps) <= 0.08);

IF bDVLTMR_ChA_Healthy AND bDVLTMR_ChB_Healthy AND bDVLTMR_ChC_Healthy THEN
    (* Surge Median *)
    IF ((rDVL_Velocity_Surge_ChA_mps >= rDVL_Velocity_Surge_ChB_mps) AND (rDVL_Velocity_Surge_ChA_mps <= rDVL_Velocity_Surge_ChC_mps)) OR
       ((rDVL_Velocity_Surge_ChA_mps >= rDVL_Velocity_Surge_ChC_mps) AND (rDVL_Velocity_Surge_ChA_mps <= rDVL_Velocity_Surge_ChB_mps)) THEN
        rVotedSurgeVel_mps := rDVL_Velocity_Surge_ChA_mps;
    ELSIF ((rDVL_Velocity_Surge_ChB_mps >= rDVL_Velocity_Surge_ChA_mps) AND (rDVL_Velocity_Surge_ChB_mps <= rDVL_Velocity_Surge_ChC_mps)) OR
          ((rDVL_Velocity_Surge_ChB_mps >= rDVL_Velocity_Surge_ChC_mps) AND (rDVL_Velocity_Surge_ChB_mps <= rDVL_Velocity_Surge_ChA_mps)) THEN
        rVotedSurgeVel_mps := rDVL_Velocity_Surge_ChB_mps;
    ELSE
        rVotedSurgeVel_mps := rDVL_Velocity_Surge_ChC_mps;
    END_IF;
    (* Sway Median *)
    IF ((rDVL_Velocity_Sway_ChA_mps >= rDVL_Velocity_Sway_ChB_mps) AND (rDVL_Velocity_Sway_ChA_mps <= rDVL_Velocity_Sway_ChC_mps)) OR
       ((rDVL_Velocity_Sway_ChA_mps >= rDVL_Velocity_Sway_ChC_mps) AND (rDVL_Velocity_Sway_ChA_mps <= rDVL_Velocity_Sway_ChB_mps)) THEN
        rVotedSwayVel_mps := rDVL_Velocity_Sway_ChA_mps;
    ELSIF ((rDVL_Velocity_Sway_ChB_mps >= rDVL_Velocity_Sway_ChA_mps) AND (rDVL_Velocity_Sway_ChB_mps <= rDVL_Velocity_Sway_ChC_mps)) OR
          ((rDVL_Velocity_Sway_ChB_mps >= rDVL_Velocity_Sway_ChC_mps) AND (rDVL_Velocity_Sway_ChB_mps <= rDVL_Velocity_Sway_ChA_mps)) THEN
        rVotedSwayVel_mps := rDVL_Velocity_Sway_ChB_mps;
    ELSE
        rVotedSwayVel_mps := rDVL_Velocity_Sway_ChC_mps;
    END_IF;
    iDVLTMR_DegradedState := 0;
ELSIF bDVLTMR_ChA_Healthy AND bDVLTMR_ChB_Healthy THEN
    rVotedSurgeVel_mps := (rDVL_Velocity_Surge_ChA_mps + rDVL_Velocity_Surge_ChB_mps) * 0.5;
    rVotedSwayVel_mps := (rDVL_Velocity_Sway_ChA_mps + rDVL_Velocity_Sway_ChB_mps) * 0.5;
    iDVLTMR_DegradedState := 1;
    dwAlarmTreeLowSeverity := dwAlarmTreeLowSeverity OR 16#00000100;
ELSE
    (* DVL Acoustic Lock Lost (e.g. dense nepheloid sediment plume) *)
    rVotedSurgeVel_mps := rSurgeVelocityTarget_mps * (1.0 - (rTractionSlipRatio_Port + rTractionSlipRatio_Stbd) * 0.5);
    rVotedSwayVel_mps := 0.0;
    iDVLTMR_DegradedState := 2;
    dwAlarmTreeLowSeverity := dwAlarmTreeLowSeverity OR 16#00000200; (* Warning: DVL Plume Lock Lost *)
END_IF;

(* Determine overall degraded control status *)
bDegradedControlActive := (iPressTMR_DegradedState > 0) OR (iTensionTMR_DegradedState > 0) OR (iDVLTMR_DegradedState > 0) OR bManualDegradedOverride;

(* ==================================================================================================
   STAGE 2: ACOUSTIC RESONANT FLUIDIZED BED DYNAMICS & PHASE-LOCKED LOOP (PLL)
   ================================================================================================== *)
(* Multi-phase Archimedes Number Ar = (d_p^3 * rho_f * (rho_p - rho_f) * g) / mu_f^2 *)
rArchimedesNumber := (EXPT(rNoduleMeanDiameter_m, 3.0) * rSeawaterDensity_kg_m3 * (rNoduleDensity_kg_m3 - rSeawaterDensity_kg_m3) * 9.81) / EXPT(rSeawaterViscosity_Pa_s, 2.0);

(* Ergun Equation quadratic solution for minimum fluidization Reynolds number: *)
(* 1.75 / (eps^3 * phi_s) * Re_mf^2 + 150*(1-eps)/(eps^3 * phi_s^2) * Re_mf - Ar = 0 *)
(* Assuming sphericity phi_s = 0.86 for nodule morphology *)
rReynoldsNumber_mf := (-124.5 + SQRT(15500.25 + 4.0 * 2.36 * rArchimedesNumber)) / (2.0 * 2.36);
IF rReynoldsNumber_mf < 0.1 THEN
    rReynoldsNumber_mf := 0.1;
END_IF;
rMinimumFluidizationVel_mps := (rReynoldsNumber_mf * rSeawaterViscosity_Pa_s) / (rSeawaterDensity_kg_m3 * rNoduleMeanDiameter_m);

(* Resonant Acoustic Radiation Force: F_rad = - grad <U> approx = (V_p * 2 * pi * f / c_0) * I_ac * F_factor *)
rAcousticLevitationPower_kW := (EXPT(rAcousticGeneratorPWM_Duty * 0.01 * 600.0, 2.0) / (rAcousticImpedance_Ohm * 1000.0)) * COS(rAcousticPhase_deg * 0.0174533);
IF rAcousticLevitationPower_kW < 0.0 THEN
    rAcousticLevitationPower_kW := 0.0;
END_IF;
rAcousticRadiationForce_N := (rAcousticLevitationPower_kW * 1000.0 / 1485.0) * 1.85; (* Hydroacoustic coupling *)

(* PLL Phase Locked Loop Tracking Engine *)
rPLL_PhaseError_deg := rAcousticPhase_deg - 0.0; (* Target phase = 0.0 deg for electrical series resonance *)
IF bAcousticFluidizerEnable AND (iCurrentStateID = 50) THEN
    (* Active Phase-Locked Closed Loop *)
    rPLL_Integrator := rPLL_Integrator - (rPLL_PhaseError_deg * rPLL_Ki * rCycleTime_s);
    (* Bound integrator within piezo composite bandwidth: 18.000 to 28.500 kHz *)
    IF rPLL_Integrator > 28.500 THEN
        rPLL_Integrator := 28.500;
    ELSIF rPLL_Integrator < 18.000 THEN
        rPLL_Integrator := 18.000;
    END_IF;
    rAcousticExcitationFreq_kHz := rPLL_Integrator - (rPLL_PhaseError_deg * rPLL_Kp);
    IF rAcousticExcitationFreq_kHz > 28.500 THEN
        rAcousticExcitationFreq_kHz := 28.500;
    ELSIF rAcousticExcitationFreq_kHz < 18.000 THEN
        rAcousticExcitationFreq_kHz := 18.000;
    END_IF;
    bResonancePhaseLocked := (ABS(rPLL_PhaseError_deg) <= 3.5);
ELSE
    bResonancePhaseLocked := FALSE;
END_IF;

(* Nodule Mass Production Extraction Calculation from Slurry Gamma Density *)
IF rNoduleSlurryDensity_kg_m3 > 1045.0 THEN
    (* Volumetric nodule fraction C_v = (rho_slurry - rho_water) / (rho_nodule - rho_water) *)
    rNoduleHarvestRate_tph := rVenturiSuctionFlow_m3ph * ((rNoduleSlurryDensity_kg_m3 - 1045.0) / (rNoduleDensity_kg_m3 - 1045.0)) * (rNoduleDensity_kg_m3 / 1000.0);
ELSE
    rNoduleHarvestRate_tph := 0.0;

(* Estimated normal contact force on seabed from gravity, ballast thrusters, and umbilical tension *)
(* Crawler submerged dry-in-water weight W_sub = 120.0 kN *)
rSeabedContactForce_kN := 120.0 + rThruster_VentralDownforce_Port_kN + rThruster_VentralDownforce_Stbd_kN - (rVotedUmbilicalTension_kN * COS(rPitchAngle_deg * 0.0174533));
IF rSeabedContactForce_kN < 0.0 THEN
    rSeabedContactForce_kN := 0.0;
END_IF;
rCrawlerGroundPressure_kPa := rSeabedContactForce_kN / rTrackAreaTotal_m2;

(* Cohesion c derived directly from in-situ penetrometer undrained shear strength *)
rMaxSoilShearStress_kPa := rSedimentShearStrength_kPa + (rCrawlerGroundPressure_kPa * TAN(rPelagicInternalFriction_deg * 0.0174533));
rTractionLimitForce_kN := rTrackAreaTotal_m2 * rMaxSoilShearStress_kPa;

(* Mobilized track shear stress: tau(j) = tau_max * (1 - exp(-j / K)), where shear displacement j = i * L *)
IF rTractionSlipRatio_Port > 0.001 THEN
    rActualSoilShearStress_Port_kPa := rMaxSoilShearStress_kPa * (1.0 - EXP(-(rTractionSlipRatio_Port * rTrackLength_m) / rShearDeformationModulus_K_m));
ELSE
    rActualSoilShearStress_Port_kPa := 0.0;
END_IF;
IF rTractionSlipRatio_Stbd > 0.001 THEN
    rActualSoilShearStress_Stbd_kPa := rMaxSoilShearStress_kPa * (1.0 - EXP(-(rTractionSlipRatio_Stbd * rTrackLength_m) / rShearDeformationModulus_K_m));
ELSE
    rActualSoilShearStress_Stbd_kPa := 0.0;
END_IF;

(* Detect Slip Exceedance & Sinkage Hazards *)
bTractionSlipAlarm := (rTractionSlipRatio_Port > 0.18) OR (rTractionSlipRatio_Stbd > 0.18);
bSinkageExceededAlarm := (rTrackPenetrationDepth_mm > 180.0);
IF bTractionSlipAlarm THEN
    dwAlarmTreeLowSeverity := dwAlarmTreeLowSeverity OR 16#00001000; (* Warning: Track Slip High *)
END_IF;
IF bSinkageExceededAlarm THEN
    dwAlarmTreeHighSeverity := dwAlarmTreeHighSeverity OR 16#00000004; (* Critical: Sinkage Exceeded *)
END_IF;

(* ==================================================================================================
   STAGE 4: STATE-SPACE KALMAN ESTIMATION & MODEL PREDICTIVE CONTROL (MPC) SOLVER
   ================================================================================================== *)
(* Calculate Heading Error with Modular Wraparound (-180..+180 deg) *)
rHeadingError_deg := rHeadingTarget_deg - rYawHeading_deg;
IF rHeadingError_deg > 180.0 THEN
    rHeadingError_deg := rHeadingError_deg - 360.0;
ELSIF rHeadingError_deg < -180.0 THEN
    rHeadingError_deg := rHeadingError_deg + 360.0;
END_IF;

(* Calculate State Tracking Errors *)
rState_SurgeVelErr_mps := rSurgeVelocityTarget_mps - rVotedSurgeVel_mps;
rState_SwayVelErr_mps := 0.0 - rVotedSwayVel_mps; (* Maintain zero sway drift *)
rState_YawRateErr_radps := (rHeadingError_deg * 0.0174533 * 0.35) - (rYawRate_degps * 0.0174533);
rState_NormalForceErr_kN := rTargetSeabedDownforce_kN - rSeabedContactForce_kN;

(* Compute Quadratic Programming Gradient Vector: g = 2 * (matB^T * Q * error_vector) *)
rQP_Gradient_g1 := -2.0 * (matB_11 * rWeightQ_Surge * rState_SurgeVelErr_mps + matB_31 * rWeightQ_Yaw * rState_YawRateErr_radps);
rQP_Gradient_g2 := -2.0 * (matB_12 * rWeightQ_Surge * rState_SurgeVelErr_mps + matB_22 * rWeightQ_Sway * rState_SwayVelErr_mps + matB_32 * rWeightQ_Yaw * rState_YawRateErr_radps);
rQP_Gradient_g3 := -2.0 * (matB_13 * rWeightQ_Surge * rState_SurgeVelErr_mps + matB_23 * rWeightQ_Sway * rState_SwayVelErr_mps + matB_33 * rWeightQ_Yaw * rState_YawRateErr_radps);
rQP_Gradient_g4 := -2.0 * (matB_44 * rWeightQ_Downforce * rState_NormalForceErr_kN);

(* Hildreth's Dual Active-Set Quadratic Programming Solver for Constrained Thruster/Track Allocation *)
rQP_Lambda1 := 0.0;
rQP_Lambda2 := 0.0;
rQP_Lambda3 := 0.0;
rQP_Lambda4 := 0.0;
FOR iQPIterationCount := 1 TO c_iMaxQPIterations DO
    (* Projected Gauss-Seidel step for Lambda1 (Track Differential Torque) *)
    rQP_Lambda1 := (-(rQP_Gradient_g1 + rQP_Hessian_H12 * rQP_Lambda2 + rQP_Hessian_H13 * rQP_Lambda3 + rQP_Hessian_H14 * rQP_Lambda4)) / rQP_Hessian_H11;
    IF rQP_Lambda1 < -65.0 THEN rQP_Lambda1 := -65.0; ELSIF rQP_Lambda1 > 65.0 THEN rQP_Lambda1 := 65.0; END_IF;

    (* Projected Gauss-Seidel step for Lambda2 (Bow Thruster Allocation) *)
    rQP_Lambda2 := (-(rQP_Gradient_g2 + rQP_Hessian_H21 * rQP_Lambda1 + rQP_Hessian_H23 * rQP_Lambda3 + rQP_Hessian_H24 * rQP_Lambda4)) / rQP_Hessian_H22;
    IF rQP_Lambda2 < -35.0 THEN rQP_Lambda2 := -35.0; ELSIF rQP_Lambda2 > 35.0 THEN rQP_Lambda2 := 35.0; END_IF;

    (* Projected Gauss-Seidel step for Lambda3 (Aft Thruster Allocation) *)
    rQP_Lambda3 := (-(rQP_Gradient_g3 + rQP_Hessian_H31 * rQP_Lambda1 + rQP_Hessian_H32 * rQP_Lambda2 + rQP_Hessian_H34 * rQP_Lambda4)) / rQP_Hessian_H33;
    IF rQP_Lambda3 < -35.0 THEN rQP_Lambda3 := -35.0; ELSIF rQP_Lambda3 > 35.0 THEN rQP_Lambda3 := 35.0; END_IF;

    (* Projected Gauss-Seidel step for Lambda4 (Ventral Downforce Allocation) *)
    rQP_Lambda4 := (-(rQP_Gradient_g4 + rQP_Hessian_H41 * rQP_Lambda1 + rQP_Hessian_H42 * rQP_Lambda2 + rQP_Hessian_H43 * rQP_Lambda3)) / rQP_Hessian_H44;
    IF rQP_Lambda4 < -45.0 THEN rQP_Lambda4 := -45.0; ELSIF rQP_Lambda4 > 45.0 THEN rQP_Lambda4 := 45.0; END_IF;
END_FOR;

(* Dynamic Traction Vectoring: Surge Forward Thrust Split between Track and Thrusters *)
IF bTractionSlipAlarm THEN
    (* Slip Mitigation Mode: Unload tracks, shift surge thrust to horizontal thrusters *)
    rFilteredTrackTorquePort := rQP_Lambda1 * 0.45;
    rFilteredTrackTorqueStbd := -rQP_Lambda1 * 0.45;
    (* Bow and Aft thrusters provide direct surge vectoring to pull crawler out of slip *)
    rThruster_BowPort_kN := rQP_Lambda2 + 18.0; (* Forward surge bias *)
    rThruster_BowStbd_kN := -rQP_Lambda2 + 18.0;
    rThruster_AftPort_kN := rQP_Lambda3 + 18.0;
    rThruster_AftStbd_kN := -rQP_Lambda3 + 18.0;

    rFilteredDownforcePort := rQP_Lambda4 * 0.35;
    rFilteredDownforceStbd := rQP_Lambda4 * 0.35;

    rFilteredTrackTorquePort := 35.0 * rSurgeVelocityTarget_mps + rQP_Lambda1;
    rFilteredTrackTorqueStbd := 35.0 * rSurgeVelocityTarget_mps - rQP_Lambda1;

    rThruster_BowStbd_kN := -rQP_Lambda2;
    rThruster_AftPort_kN := rQP_Lambda3;
    rThruster_AftStbd_kN := -rQP_Lambda3;
    rFilteredDownforcePort := rQP_Lambda4 * 0.5;
    rFilteredDownforceStbd := rQP_Lambda4 * 0.5;
END_IF;

(* Pitch & Roll Slope Stabilization Feedforward *)
IF ABS(rPitchAngle_deg) > 4.0 THEN
    (* Counteract climbing/descending pitch moment on slopes up to 30 deg *)
    rFilteredDownforcePort := rFilteredDownforcePort + (rPitchAngle_deg * 0.65);
    rFilteredDownforceStbd := rFilteredDownforceStbd + (rPitchAngle_deg * 0.65);
END_IF;
IF ABS(rRollAngle_deg) > 3.0 THEN
    (* Counteract lateral roll tipping moment *)
    rFilteredDownforcePort := rFilteredDownforcePort - (rRollAngle_deg * 0.85);
    rFilteredDownforceStbd := rFilteredDownforceStbd + (rRollAngle_deg * 0.85);
END_IF;

(* ==================================================================================================
   STAGE 5: FINITE STATE MACHINE (FSM) SUPERVISORY CONTROL (11 STAGES)
   ================================================================================================== *)
CASE iCurrentStateID OF
    0: (* STATE_COLD_BOOT_TMR_INIT: System Initialization & Sensor Health Validation *)
        rTrackTorqueRef_Port_kNm := 0.0;
        rTrackTorqueRef_Stbd_kNm := 0.0;

        rThruster_BowStbd_kN := 0.0;

        rThruster_VentralDownforce_Stbd_kN := 0.0;

        rVenturiSuctionFlow_m3ph := 0.0;
        bResonancePhaseLocked := FALSE;
        bSweepComplete := FALSE;

        IF bMasterEnable AND (dwAlarmTreeHighSeverity = 16#00000000) THEN
            iCurrentStateID := 10; (* Advance to Hydrostatic Equilibration *)
        END_IF;

    10: (* STATE_HYDROSTATIC_COMPENSATION: 4000m Depth Verification & Barrier Pressure Trim *)
        tEquilibrationTimer(IN := TRUE, PT := T#3S);
        (* Verify hydrostatic pressure is within 360 to 450 bar at 4000m *)
        IF (rVotedDepthPressure_bar >= 360.0) AND (rVotedDepthPressure_bar <= 450.0) THEN

        END_IF;

        (* Apply progressive vertical downforce until contact force reaches 35 kN *)
        rThruster_VentralDownforce_Port_kN := 20.0;

        rThruster_VentralDownforce_Port_kN := rFilteredDownforcePort;
        rThruster_VentralDownforce_Stbd_kN := rFilteredDownforceStbd;

        rVenturiSuctionFlow_m3ph := rTargetSlurryDischarge_m3ph;

        END_IF;

        rThruster_VentralDownforce_Stbd_kN := 35.0;
