(* ========================================================================================= *)
(* 1.0 EMERGENCY SAFETY SHUTDOWN & SIL-3 HARDWIRED INTERLOCK EVALUATION                      *)
(* ========================================================================================= *)
(* Fast deterministic safety loop: evaluates hardware E-stops, passive freeze plug margin,   *)
(* containment boundary, critical redox boundary runaway, and vessel strain integrity.       *)

bHardwareTripCondition       := FALSE;
bThermalFreezeHazard         := FALSE;
bOverTemperatureHazard       := FALSE;
bOxidizingRunawayHazard      := FALSE;
bReducingPrecipitationHazard := FALSE;
bGasVoidReactivityHazard     := FALSE;
bVesselRuptureStrainHazard   := FALSE;
bContainmentBreachHazard     := FALSE;
bCorrosionRateExceededHazard := FALSE;

(* SIL-3 Dual-channel Active-low Emergency Stop Relay Monitoring *)
IF (NOT bEmergencyStop_CH1) OR (NOT bEmergencyStop_CH2) THEN
    bHardwareTripCondition := TRUE;
    dwCriticalAlarmWord := dwCriticalAlarmWord OR 16#0000_0001; (* Bit 0: Hardwired E-Stop Tripped *)
END_IF;

(* Plant Protection System (PPS) Master Scram Permissive *)
IF NOT bReactorScramPermissive THEN
    bHardwareTripCondition := TRUE;
    dwCriticalAlarmWord := dwCriticalAlarmWord OR 16#0000_0002; (* Bit 1: Reactor PPS Core Trip *)
END_IF;

(* Passive Molten Salt Freeze Plug Safety Thermal Margin *)
IF NOT bSafetyFreezePlugHealthy THEN
    bHardwareTripCondition := TRUE;
    dwCriticalAlarmWord := dwCriticalAlarmWord OR 16#0000_0004; (* Bit 2: Passive Freeze Plug Depleted *)
END_IF;

(* Containment Boundary Isolation Breach Interlock *)
IF NOT bContainmentIsolationClosed THEN
    bContainmentBreachHazard := TRUE;
    dwCriticalAlarmWord := dwCriticalAlarmWord OR 16#0000_0008; (* Bit 3: Containment Barrier Open *)
END_IF;

(* Molten Salt Freeze Crystallization Prevention Interlock (< 565°C) *)
IF (rSaltCoreTemp_A_degC < 565.0) AND (rSaltCoreTemp_B_degC < 565.0) THEN
    bThermalFreezeHazard := TRUE;
    dwCriticalAlarmWord := dwCriticalAlarmWord OR 16#0000_0010; (* Bit 4: Fuel Salt Solidification Hazard *)
END_IF;

(* Core Fuel Salt Overtemperature Thermal Stress Interlock (> 725°C) *)
IF (rSaltCoreTemp_A_degC > 725.0) AND (rSaltCoreTemp_B_degC > 725.0) THEN
    bOverTemperatureHazard := TRUE;
    dwCriticalAlarmWord := dwCriticalAlarmWord OR 16#0000_0020; (* Bit 5: Core Extreme Overtemperature *)
END_IF;

(* Catastrophic Fluorine Potential Runaway (U4+/U3+ Ratio > 220 mol/mol) *)
IF (rCalculatedU4U3Ratio > 220.0) THEN
    bOxidizingRunawayHazard := TRUE;
    dwCriticalAlarmWord := dwCriticalAlarmWord OR 16#0000_0040; (* Bit 6: Severe Oxidizing Runaway *)
END_IF;

(* Severe Over-Reduction Actinide Precipitation Hazard (U4+/U3+ Ratio < 5.0 mol/mol) *)
IF (rCalculatedU4U3Ratio < 5.0) AND (rCalculatedU4U3Ratio > 0.01) THEN
    bReducingPrecipitationHazard := TRUE;
    dwCriticalAlarmWord := dwCriticalAlarmWord OR 16#0000_0080; (* Bit 7: Severe Over-Reduction Hazard *)
END_IF;

(* Core Reactivity Void Fraction Carryunder Interlock (> 0.25% void fraction) *)
IF (rSaltVoidFractionSensor_pct > 0.25) THEN
    bGasVoidReactivityHazard := TRUE;
    dwCriticalAlarmWord := dwCriticalAlarmWord OR 16#0000_0100; (* Bit 8: Gas Void Reactivity Exceeded *)
END_IF;

(* Hastelloy-N Vessel Wall Mechanical Hoop Microstrain Failure (> 1850 microstrain) *)
IF (rVesselWallMicrostrain_CH1 > 1850.0) OR (rVesselWallMicrostrain_CH2 > 1850.0) THEN
    bVesselRuptureStrainHazard := TRUE;
    dwCriticalAlarmWord := dwCriticalAlarmWord OR 16#0000_0200; (* Bit 9: Vessel Wall Hoop Overstrain *)
END_IF;

(* Catastrophic Corrosion Rate Boundary (> 60.0 um/year) *)
IF (rCorrosionRate_um_yr > 60.0) THEN
    bCorrosionRateExceededHazard := TRUE;
    dwCriticalAlarmWord := dwCriticalAlarmWord OR 16#0000_0400; (* Bit 10: Extreme Structural Corrosion *)
END_IF;

(* Overall SIL-3 Master Safety Trip Asserted *)
bEmergencyTripActive := bHardwareTripCondition OR
                        bThermalFreezeHazard OR
                        bOverTemperatureHazard OR
                        bOxidizingRunawayHazard OR
                        bReducingPrecipitationHazard OR
                        bGasVoidReactivityHazard OR
                        bVesselRuptureStrainHazard OR
                        bContainmentBreachHazard OR
                        bCorrosionRateExceededHazard;

(* Safety Actuator Clamp on Emergency Trip *)
IF bEmergencyTripActive THEN
    bBeRodFastEjectionActive := TRUE;
    rBeRodPositionCmd_mm     := 0.0;    (* Retract Beryllium rod instantly from molten salt *)
    bH2SupplyIsolated        := TRUE;
    rH2MassFlowCmd_sccm      := 0.0;    (* Slam shut dual-redundant hydrogen isolation valves *)
    rCycloneThrottleCmd_pct  := 100.0;  (* Dump centrifugal separator to maximize gas release *)
    rHeStrippingFlowCmd_sccm := 100.0;  (* Maintain bare minimum blanket purge, stop bubble stripping *)
    bSystemReady             := FALSE;
    iState                   := 100;    (* Force FSM to State 100: EMERGENCY_SCRAM_DRAIN *)
END_IF;


(* ========================================================================================= *)
(* 2.0 TRIPLE MODULAR REDUNDANCY (2oo3) SENSOR VOTING & SENSOR HEALTH DIAGNOSTICS             *)
(* ========================================================================================= *)
(* High-reliability median selection and deviation monitoring for SIL-3 instrumentation:     *)
(* - Electrochemical Potentiometry (rRedoxPotential_A, B, C)                                 *)
(* - Fuel Salt Bulk Temperature (rSaltCoreTemp_A, B, C)                                      *)
(* - Reduction Sparger Manifold Pressure (rSpargerInletPress_A, B)                           *)
(* - Off-Gas Fission Xe-135 Activity (rOffGasXe135Activity_A, B, C)                         *)

(* --- 2.1 Online Potentiometric Sensor 2oo3 Voting --- *)
rPot_Diff_AB := ABS(rRedoxPotential_A_mV - rRedoxPotential_B_mV);
rPot_Diff_BC := ABS(rRedoxPotential_B_mV - rRedoxPotential_C_mV);
rPot_Diff_CA := ABS(rRedoxPotential_C_mV - rRedoxPotential_A_mV);

(* Sensor plausibility bounds: -650 mV to -150 mV vs Ni/NiF2 reference *)
bPot_Healthy_A := (rRedoxPotential_A_mV >= -650.0) AND (rRedoxPotential_A_mV <= -150.0);
bPot_Healthy_B := (rRedoxPotential_B_mV >= -650.0) AND (rRedoxPotential_B_mV <= -150.0);
bPot_Healthy_C := (rRedoxPotential_C_mV >= -650.0) AND (rRedoxPotential_C_mV <= -150.0);

(* Deviation tolerance: 25.0 mV allowable spread between channels *)
IF rPot_Diff_AB > 25.0 THEN
    IF rPot_Diff_BC <= 25.0 THEN
        bPot_Healthy_A := FALSE; (* Channel A drifting *)
    ELSIF rPot_Diff_CA <= 25.0 THEN
        bPot_Healthy_B := FALSE; (* Channel B drifting *)
    ELSE
        bPot_Healthy_C := FALSE; (* Ambiguous multiple drift *)
    END_IF;
END_IF;

IF rPot_Diff_BC > 25.0 THEN
    IF (rPot_Diff_AB <= 25.0) AND bPot_Healthy_A THEN
        bPot_Healthy_C := FALSE; (* Channel C drifting *)
    END_IF;
END_IF;

(* Calculate healthy channel count *)
iPot_Healthy_Count := 0;
IF bPot_Healthy_A THEN iPot_Healthy_Count := iPot_Healthy_Count + 1; END_IF;
IF bPot_Healthy_B THEN iPot_Healthy_Count := iPot_Healthy_Count + 1; END_IF;
IF bPot_Healthy_C THEN iPot_Healthy_Count := iPot_Healthy_Count + 1; END_IF;

(* Median Selection Logic *)
IF iPot_Healthy_Count = 3 THEN
    (* Perfect 2oo3 Median voting among 3 channels *)
    IF (rRedoxPotential_A_mV >= rRedoxPotential_B_mV AND rRedoxPotential_A_mV <= rRedoxPotential_C_mV) OR
       (rRedoxPotential_A_mV <= rRedoxPotential_B_mV AND rRedoxPotential_A_mV >= rRedoxPotential_C_mV) THEN
        rVotedRedoxPotential_mV := rRedoxPotential_A_mV;
    ELSIF (rRedoxPotential_B_mV >= rRedoxPotential_A_mV AND rRedoxPotential_B_mV <= rRedoxPotential_C_mV) OR
          (rRedoxPotential_B_mV <= rRedoxPotential_A_mV AND rRedoxPotential_B_mV >= rRedoxPotential_C_mV) THEN
        rVotedRedoxPotential_mV := rRedoxPotential_B_mV;
    ELSE
        rVotedRedoxPotential_mV := rRedoxPotential_C_mV;
    END_IF;
ELSIF iPot_Healthy_Count = 2 THEN
    (* Degraded 1oo2 average voting *)
    IF bPot_Healthy_A AND bPot_Healthy_B THEN
        rVotedRedoxPotential_mV := (rRedoxPotential_A_mV + rRedoxPotential_B_mV) * 0.50;
    ELSIF bPot_Healthy_B AND bPot_Healthy_C THEN
        rVotedRedoxPotential_mV := (rRedoxPotential_B_mV + rRedoxPotential_C_mV) * 0.50;
    ELSE
        rVotedRedoxPotential_mV := (rRedoxPotential_A_mV + rRedoxPotential_C_mV) * 0.50;
    END_IF;
    dwWarningWord := dwWarningWord OR 16#0000_0001; (* Warning: Potentiometry 1oo2 degraded *)
ELSIF iPot_Healthy_Count = 1 THEN
    (* Severe degradation: single remaining channel *)
    IF bPot_Healthy_A THEN
        rVotedRedoxPotential_mV := rRedoxPotential_A_mV;
    ELSIF bPot_Healthy_B THEN
        rVotedRedoxPotential_mV := rRedoxPotential_B_mV;
    ELSE
        rVotedRedoxPotential_mV := rRedoxPotential_C_mV;
    END_IF;
    dwWarningWord := dwWarningWord OR 16#0000_0002; (* Warning: Potentiometry 1oo1 critical degraded *)
ELSE
    (* Total sensor failure: Fallback to last filtered value *)
    rVotedRedoxPotential_mV := rFiltRedoxPotential_mV;
    dwCriticalAlarmWord := dwCriticalAlarmWord OR 16#0000_2000; (* Alarm: Loss of all potentiometry *)
END_IF;

(* Exponential Smoothing Noise Rejection Filter on Redox Potential *)
rFiltRedoxPotential_mV := (alpha_RedoxFilter * rVotedRedoxPotential_mV) +
                          ((1.0 - alpha_RedoxFilter) * rFiltRedoxPotential_mV);

(* Dynamic Derivative (Rate-of-Change) Evaluation [mV/s] *)
rRedoxRateOfChange_mV_s := (rFiltRedoxPotential_mV - rHistRedox_1) / tSampleTaskInterval_s;
rHistRedox_3 := rHistRedox_2;
rHistRedox_2 := rHistRedox_1;
rHistRedox_1 := rFiltRedoxPotential_mV;

(* --- 2.2 Fuel Salt Bulk Temperature 2oo3 Voting --- *)
rTemp_Diff_AB := ABS(rSaltCoreTemp_A_degC - rSaltCoreTemp_B_degC);
rTemp_Diff_BC := ABS(rSaltCoreTemp_B_degC - rSaltCoreTemp_C_degC);
rTemp_Diff_CA := ABS(rSaltCoreTemp_C_degC - rSaltCoreTemp_A_degC);

bTemp_Healthy_A := (rSaltCoreTemp_A_degC >= 550.0) AND (rSaltCoreTemp_A_degC <= 750.0);
bTemp_Healthy_B := (rSaltCoreTemp_B_degC >= 550.0) AND (rSaltCoreTemp_B_degC <= 750.0);
bTemp_Healthy_C := (rSaltCoreTemp_C_degC >= 550.0) AND (rSaltCoreTemp_C_degC <= 750.0);

IF rTemp_Diff_AB > 20.0 THEN
    IF rTemp_Diff_BC <= 20.0 THEN bTemp_Healthy_A := FALSE;
    ELSIF rTemp_Diff_CA <= 20.0 THEN bTemp_Healthy_B := FALSE;
    ELSE bTemp_Healthy_C := FALSE;
    END_IF;
END_IF;

iTemp_Healthy_Count := 0;
IF bTemp_Healthy_A THEN iTemp_Healthy_Count := iTemp_Healthy_Count + 1; END_IF;
IF bTemp_Healthy_B THEN iTemp_Healthy_Count := iTemp_Healthy_Count + 1; END_IF;
IF bTemp_Healthy_C THEN iTemp_Healthy_Count := iTemp_Healthy_Count + 1; END_IF;

IF iTemp_Healthy_Count = 3 THEN
    IF (rSaltCoreTemp_A_degC >= rSaltCoreTemp_B_degC AND rSaltCoreTemp_A_degC <= rSaltCoreTemp_C_degC) OR
       (rSaltCoreTemp_A_degC <= rSaltCoreTemp_B_degC AND rSaltCoreTemp_A_degC >= rSaltCoreTemp_C_degC) THEN
        rVotedSaltCoreTemp_degC := rSaltCoreTemp_A_degC;
    ELSIF (rSaltCoreTemp_B_degC >= rSaltCoreTemp_A_degC AND rSaltCoreTemp_B_degC <= rSaltCoreTemp_C_degC) OR
          (rSaltCoreTemp_B_degC <= rSaltCoreTemp_A_degC AND rSaltCoreTemp_B_degC >= rSaltCoreTemp_C_degC) THEN
        rVotedSaltCoreTemp_degC := rSaltCoreTemp_B_degC;
    ELSE
        rVotedSaltCoreTemp_degC := rSaltCoreTemp_C_degC;
    END_IF;
ELSIF iTemp_Healthy_Count = 2 THEN
    IF bTemp_Healthy_A AND bTemp_Healthy_B THEN
        rVotedSaltCoreTemp_degC := (rSaltCoreTemp_A_degC + rSaltCoreTemp_B_degC) * 0.50;
    ELSIF bTemp_Healthy_B AND bTemp_Healthy_C THEN
        rVotedSaltCoreTemp_degC := (rSaltCoreTemp_B_degC + rSaltCoreTemp_C_degC) * 0.50;
    ELSE
        rVotedSaltCoreTemp_degC := (rSaltCoreTemp_A_degC + rSaltCoreTemp_C_degC) * 0.50;
    END_IF;
    dwWarningWord := dwWarningWord OR 16#0000_0004; (* Warning: Temp 1oo2 degraded *)
ELSE
    rVotedSaltCoreTemp_degC := rFiltSaltCoreTemp_degC;
END_IF;

rFiltSaltCoreTemp_degC := (alpha_TempFilter * rVotedSaltCoreTemp_degC) +
                          ((1.0 - alpha_TempFilter) * rFiltSaltCoreTemp_degC);

(* --- 2.3 Off-Gas Fission Gas Xe-135 Activity 2oo3 Voting --- *)
rXe_Diff_AB := ABS(rOffGasXe135Activity_A_Bq_m3 - rOffGasXe135Activity_B_Bq_m3);
rXe_Diff_BC := ABS(rOffGasXe135Activity_B_Bq_m3 - rOffGasXe135Activity_C_Bq_m3);
rXe_Diff_CA := ABS(rOffGasXe135Activity_C_Bq_m3 - rOffGasXe135Activity_A_Bq_m3);

bXe_Healthy_A := (rOffGasXe135Activity_A_Bq_m3 >= 0.0);
bXe_Healthy_B := (rOffGasXe135Activity_B_Bq_m3 >= 0.0);
bXe_Healthy_C := (rOffGasXe135Activity_C_Bq_m3 >= 0.0);

iXe_Healthy_Count := 0;
IF bXe_Healthy_A THEN iXe_Healthy_Count := iXe_Healthy_Count + 1; END_IF;
IF bXe_Healthy_B THEN iXe_Healthy_Count := iXe_Healthy_Count + 1; END_IF;
IF bXe_Healthy_C THEN iXe_Healthy_Count := iXe_Healthy_Count + 1; END_IF;

IF iXe_Healthy_Count = 3 THEN
    IF (rOffGasXe135Activity_A_Bq_m3 >= rOffGasXe135Activity_B_Bq_m3 AND rOffGasXe135Activity_A_Bq_m3 <= rOffGasXe135Activity_C_Bq_m3) OR
       (rOffGasXe135Activity_A_Bq_m3 <= rOffGasXe135Activity_B_Bq_m3 AND rOffGasXe135Activity_A_Bq_m3 >= rOffGasXe135Activity_C_Bq_m3) THEN
        rVotedXe135Activity_Bq_m3 := rOffGasXe135Activity_A_Bq_m3;
    ELSIF (rOffGasXe135Activity_B_Bq_m3 >= rOffGasXe135Activity_A_Bq_m3 AND rOffGasXe135Activity_B_Bq_m3 <= rOffGasXe135Activity_C_Bq_m3) OR
          (rOffGasXe135Activity_B_Bq_m3 <= rOffGasXe135Activity_A_Bq_m3 AND rOffGasXe135Activity_B_Bq_m3 >= rOffGasXe135Activity_C_Bq_m3) THEN
        rVotedXe135Activity_Bq_m3 := rOffGasXe135Activity_B_Bq_m3;
    ELSE
        rVotedXe135Activity_Bq_m3 := rOffGasXe135Activity_C_Bq_m3;
    END_IF;
ELSIF iXe_Healthy_Count >= 1 THEN
    IF bXe_Healthy_A THEN rVotedXe135Activity_Bq_m3 := rOffGasXe135Activity_A_Bq_m3;
    ELSIF bXe_Healthy_B THEN rVotedXe135Activity_Bq_m3 := rOffGasXe135Activity_B_Bq_m3;
    ELSE rVotedXe135Activity_Bq_m3 := rOffGasXe135Activity_C_Bq_m3;
    END_IF;
ELSE
    rVotedXe135Activity_Bq_m3 := 0.0;
END_IF;

rFiltOffGasXe_Bq_m3 := (alpha_XeFilter * rVotedXe135Activity_Bq_m3) +
                       ((1.0 - alpha_XeFilter) * rFiltOffGasXe_Bq_m3);


(* ========================================================================================= *)
(* 3.0 THERMODYNAMIC EQUILIBRIUM & NERNSTIAN ELECTROCHEMICAL REDOX REGULATION                *)
(* ========================================================================================= *)
(* Inverts the voted electrochemical cell potential [mV] using temperature-corrected         *)
(* Nernst-Einstein thermodynamics to obtain the online molar ratio [U4+]/[U3+]:              *)
(*   E_cell(T) = E0(T) + (R * T / (n * F)) * ln( (gamma_UF4 / gamma_UF3) * ([U4+]/[U3+]) )   *)

(* Convert voted temperature to thermodynamic Kelvin *)
rT_Kelvin := rFiltSaltCoreTemp_degC + STANDARD_TEMP_K;
IF rT_Kelvin < 800.0 THEN rT_Kelvin := 800.0; END_IF; (* Safeguard against zero division *)

(* Temperature-dependent standard reduction potential E0(T) [V] *)
rE0_T_Volt := E0_REF_POTENTIAL_V + (D_E0_DT_COEFF * (rT_Kelvin - NOMINAL_CORE_TEMP_K));

(* Thermodynamic Nernstian Slope factor: (R_u * T) / (n * F) with n = 1 *)
rNernstSlope_V := (R_GAS_CONST * rT_Kelvin) / FARADAY_CONST;

(* Potential offset in Volts: Convert filtered mV to Volts *)
rDelta_E_Volt := (rFiltRedoxPotential_mV * 0.0010) - rE0_T_Volt;

(* Natural logarithm of molar concentration ratio *)
rLnRatio := (rDelta_E_Volt / rNernstSlope_V) - LN(ACTIVITY_COEFF_RATIO);

(* Anti-saturation bounds on exponent: prevent floating point overflow *)
IF rLnRatio > 7.50 THEN rLnRatio := 7.50; END_IF;       (* Equivalent to ratio approx 1800 *)
IF rLnRatio < 0.50 THEN rLnRatio := 0.50; END_IF;       (* Equivalent to ratio approx 1.65 *)

(* Online calculated U4+/U3+ molar ratio *)
rCalculatedU4U3Ratio := EXP(rLnRatio);

(* Control deviation from setpoint in logarithmic space *)
IF rRedoxRatioTarget_mol_mol < 10.0 THEN rRedoxRatioTarget_mol_mol := 10.0; END_IF;
IF rRedoxRatioTarget_mol_mol > 180.0 THEN rRedoxRatioTarget_mol_mol := 180.0; END_IF;

rRedoxError := LN(rCalculatedU4U3Ratio) - LN(rRedoxRatioTarget_mol_mol);

(* Setpoint Window Diagnostic Supervision *)
IF rCalculatedU4U3Ratio > 140.0 THEN
    dwWarningWord := dwWarningWord OR 16#0000_0010; (* Warning: Fuel salt oxidizing high *)
ELSIF rCalculatedU4U3Ratio < 35.0 THEN
    dwWarningWord := dwWarningWord OR 16#0000_0020; (* Warning: Fuel salt reducing low *)
END_IF;


(* ========================================================================================= *)
(* 4.0 PYROCHEMICAL MASS TRANSFER & MULTI-PHASE SPARGER HYDRODYNAMICS                        *)
(* ========================================================================================= *)
(* Co-regulates coarse reduction via submerged metallic Beryllium (Be) rod convective flux   *)
(* and fine trimming via porous Hydrogen (H2) sparging into the bypass molten salt stream.   *)

(* --- 4.1 Beryllium Rod Dissolution Convective Mass Transfer --- *)
(* Calculate hydrodynamic Reynolds and Schmidt numbers for submerged cylinder cross-flow:   *)
(* Re_rod = (rho_salt * v_bypass * d_rod) / mu_salt                                          *)
(* Salt velocity in bypass duct: v_bypass = rSaltBypassVolFlow_m3_h / (3600.0 * Area_duct)   *)
(* With bypass duct area approx 0.015 m2 (0.138 m inner diameter)                            *)
IF rSaltBypassVolFlow_m3_h > 0.10 THEN
    rWorkVal1 := rSaltBypassVolFlow_m3_h / (3600.0 * 0.0150); (* v_bypass [m/s] *)
ELSE
    rWorkVal1 := 0.050; (* Minimum convective natural circulation [m/s] *)
END_IF;

(* Reynolds number of beryllium cylinder *)
rRe_rod := (4125.0 * rWorkVal1 * BE_ROD_DIAMETER_M) / 0.0062;
IF rRe_rod < 10.0 THEN rRe_rod := 10.0; END_IF;

(* Schmidt number for dissolved Be in fluoride eutectic: Sc = mu / (rho * D_Be) *)
rSc_Be := 0.0062 / (4125.0 * DIFFUSIVITY_BE_SALT_M2_S); (* Sc approx 289.0 *)

(* Sherwood number correlation (Churchill-Bernstein / Whitaker): *)
(* Sh_rod = 0.30 + [ 0.62 * Re^0.5 * Sc^(1/3) ] / [ 1.0 + (0.4 / Sc)^(2/3) ]^0.25 *)
rWorkVal2 := (0.62 * SQRT(rRe_rod) * 6.6115) / 1.0022; (* Sc^(1/3) approx 6.6115 *)
rSh_rod := 0.30 + rWorkVal2;

(* Convective liquid-phase mass transfer coefficient k_L_Be [m/s] *)
rk_L_Be := (rSh_rod * DIFFUSIVITY_BE_SALT_M2_S) / BE_ROD_DIAMETER_M;

(* Beryllium surface dissolution flux [mol/(m2*s)] *)
(* Dependent on fluorine oxidation potential driving force (proportional to redox error) *)
IF rRedoxError > 0.0 THEN
    rMassFlux_Be := rk_L_Be * (rRedoxError * 85.0); (* Scaling flux based on U4+ driving force *)
ELSE
    rMassFlux_Be := 0.0; (* In setpoint equilibrium or slightly reducing *)
END_IF;

(* Cumulative Beryllium mass consumption tracking [grams] *)
(* dM/dt = J_Be * Area_exposed * MW_Be (MW_Be = 9.01218 g/mol) *)
IF rBeRodPositionFeedback_mm > 1.0 THEN
    rWorkVal3 := PI_CONST * BE_ROD_DIAMETER_M * (rBeRodPositionFeedback_mm * 0.0010); (* Area [m2] *)
    rCumulativeBerylliumBurn_grams := rCumulativeBerylliumBurn_grams +
        (rMassFlux_Be * rWorkVal3 * 9.01218 * tSampleTaskInterval_s);
END_IF;

(* --- 4.2 Hydrogen Gas Sparger Two-Film Interfacial Mass Transfer --- *)
(* Gas sparging delivery: 3% H2 in He carrier gas.                                          *)
(* Reaction: 1/2 H2(g) + UF4(salt) <===> UF3(salt) + HF(g)                                  *)
(* Interfacial specific area: a = 6.0 * alpha_sparge / d32                                   *)
IF rH2SpargerFlowFeedback_sccm > 5.0 THEN
    (* Gas volume fraction in sparger mixing zone *)
    rWorkVal4 := (rH2SpargerFlowFeedback_sccm * 1.6667e-8) / (rWorkVal1 * 0.0150);
    IF rWorkVal4 > 0.15 THEN rWorkVal4 := 0.15; END_IF;
    ra_sparge := (6.0 * rWorkVal4) / SAUTER_BUBBLE_DIAM_M;
ELSE
    ra_sparge := 10.0; (* Minimum residual interfacial area *)
END_IF;

(* Mass transfer coefficient for dissolved hydrogen *)
rk_L_H2 := 1.450e-4; (* Characteristic k_L for H2 in molten fluorides at 650°C [m/s] *)
rFlux_H2 := rk_L_H2 * ra_sparge * (rH2SpargerFlowFeedback_sccm / 1200.0);


(* ========================================================================================= *)
(* 5.0 FISSION GAS (Xe/Kr) BUBBLE NUCLEATION, STRIPPING & CYCLONIC EXTRACTION               *)
(* ========================================================================================= *)
(* Models helium microbubble injection into the fuel salt slipstream, mass transfer of       *)
(* insoluble volatile fission products (Xe-135, Kr-88) into the bubbles, and subsequent      *)
(* centrifugal separation in an axial cyclone with strict gas void carryunder limits.        *)

(* Mass transfer coefficient for Xenon stripping: Higbie penetration model *)
(* k_L_Xe = 2.0 * SQRT( (D_Xe * v_bubble_slip) / (pi * d32) )                              *)
(* Characteristic slip velocity of 0.85 mm helium bubble in molten salt: v_slip approx 0.18 m/s *)
rk_L_Xe := 2.0 * SQRT( (DIFFUSIVITY_XE_SALT_M2_S * 0.180) / (PI_CONST * SAUTER_BUBBLE_DIAM_M) );

(* Specific bubble interfacial area for Helium stripping injection *)
IF rHeStrippingFlowFeedback_sccm > 50.0 THEN
    rWorkVal1 := (rHeStrippingFlowFeedback_sccm * 1.6667e-8) / (rWorkVal1 * 0.0150);
    IF rWorkVal1 > 0.12 THEN rWorkVal1 := 0.12; END_IF;
    ra_bubble := (6.0 * rWorkVal1) / SAUTER_BUBBLE_DIAM_M;
ELSE
    ra_bubble := 5.0;
END_IF;

(* Volumetric removal rate of Xenon: dC_Xe/dt = - k_L_Xe * a_bubble * (C_Xe - C_sat) *)
rXeRemovalRate := rk_L_Xe * ra_bubble;

(* Centrifugal Separator G-force and Separation Efficiency *)
(* Tangential velocity inside axial cyclone barrel: v_tangential = (Q_bypass / A_inlet)     *)
(* G = v_tangential^2 / (R_cyclone * 9.81)                                                  *)
IF rSaltBypassVolFlow_m3_h > 0.50 THEN
    rWorkVal2 := (rSaltBypassVolFlow_m3_h / 3600.0) / 0.0028; (* v_tangential [m/s] *)
    rCentrifugalG := (rWorkVal2 * rWorkVal2) / (CYCLONE_RADIUS_M * 9.80665);
    IF rCentrifugalG < 15.0 THEN rCentrifugalG := 15.0; END_IF;
    IF rCentrifugalG > 180.0 THEN rCentrifugalG := 180.0; END_IF;
ELSE
    rCentrifugalG := 15.0;
END_IF;

(* Cyclone bubble separation efficiency modeling *)
rSepEfficiency := 1.0 - EXP( - (rCentrifugalG * 0.0450) );
IF rSepEfficiency > 0.998 THEN rSepEfficiency := 0.998; END_IF;
IF rSepEfficiency < 0.750 THEN rSepEfficiency := 0.750; END_IF;

rXeExtractionEfficiency_pct := rSepEfficiency * 100.0;

(* Carryunder Gas Void Fraction returning to core loop *)
(* Void carryunder = injected gas void * (1.0 - rSepEfficiency) * throttle_factor *)
rWorkVal3 := (1.0 - rSepEfficiency) * (rHeStrippingFlowFeedback_sccm / 5000.0) * 0.85;
IF rCycloneThrottleCmd_pct > 10.0 THEN
    rGasVoidCalculated := rWorkVal3 * (100.0 / rCycloneThrottleCmd_pct);
ELSE
    rGasVoidCalculated := rWorkVal3 * 10.0;
END_IF;

(* Clamp and smooth void fraction *)
IF rGasVoidCalculated < 0.001 THEN rGasVoidCalculated := 0.001; END_IF;
IF rGasVoidCalculated > 0.500 THEN rGasVoidCalculated := 0.500; END_IF;

rFiltVoidFraction_pct := (alpha_VoidFilter * rGasVoidCalculated) +
                         ((1.0 - alpha_VoidFilter) * rFiltVoidFraction_pct);
rCalculatedVoidFraction_pct := rFiltVoidFraction_pct;

(* Void Fraction Alarm Boundaries *)
IF rCalculatedVoidFraction_pct > 0.120 THEN
    dwWarningWord := dwWarningWord OR 16#0000_0040; (* Warning: High gas void fraction *)
END_IF;


(* ========================================================================================= *)
(* 6.0 STRUCTURAL NICKEL ALLOY (HASTELLOY-N) CORROSION IMPEDANCE & MICROSTRAIN KINETICS     *)
(* ========================================================================================= *)
(* High-temperature in-situ Electrochemical Impedance Spectroscopy (EIS) evaluation:         *)
(* Extracts polarization resistance Rp, applies Stern-Geary to obtain corrosion current     *)
(* density i_corr, and computes Faradaic wall thinning rate CR [um/year].                    *)

(* Protect against zero/invalid polarization resistance *)
IF rEIS_PolarizationResist_Ohm > 100.0 THEN
    (* Polarization resistance corrected for solution resistance: Rp_corr = Rp - Rs *)
    rWorkVal1 := rEIS_PolarizationResist_Ohm - rEIS_SolutionResistance_Ohm;
    IF rWorkVal1 < 50.0 THEN rWorkVal1 := 50.0; END_IF;
    
    (* Stern-Geary equation for corrosion current density: i_corr = B / Rp [A/cm2] *)
    rI_corr_A_cm2 := STERN_GEARY_B_VOLT / rWorkVal1;
    rI_corr_uA_cm2 := rI_corr_A_cm2 * 1.0e6; (* Convert to uA/cm2 *)
    
    (* Faradaic corrosion rate: CR [um/year] = (i_corr * EW * 3.1536e7) / (rho * F) * 1.0e4 *)
    (* (EW * 3.1536e7 * 1.0e4) / (rho * F) for Hastelloy-N = (28.52 * 3.1536e11) / (8.86 * 96485.33) = 10515.6 *)
    rCorrosionRate_calc := rI_corr_A_cm2 * 10515.6 * 1.0e4;
ELSE
    (* Fallback estimation based on U4+/U3+ redox ratio and dissolved Cr *)
    rCorrosionRate_calc := 2.50 + (rCalculatedU4U3Ratio * 0.0850) + (rDissolvedChromium_ppm * 0.0350);
END_IF;

(* Bound and filter corrosion rate *)
IF rCorrosionRate_calc < 0.10 THEN rCorrosionRate_calc := 0.10; END_IF;
IF rCorrosionRate_calc > 120.0 THEN rCorrosionRate_calc := 120.0; END_IF;

rFiltCorrosionRate_um_yr := (alpha_CorrosionFilter * rCorrosionRate_calc) +
                            ((1.0 - alpha_CorrosionFilter) * rFiltCorrosionRate_um_yr);
rCorrosionRate_um_yr := rFiltCorrosionRate_um_yr;

(* High Corrosion Rate Warning *)
IF rCorrosionRate_um_yr > 15.0 THEN
    dwWarningWord := dwWarningWord OR 16#0000_0080; (* Warning: Hastelloy corrosion rate high *)
END_IF;

(* Filter and monitor reactor vessel wall hoop microstrain *)
rWorkVal2 := (rVesselWallMicrostrain_CH1 + rVesselWallMicrostrain_CH2) * 0.50;
rFiltVesselMicrostrain := (alpha_StrainFilter * rWorkVal2) +
                          ((1.0 - alpha_StrainFilter) * rFiltVesselMicrostrain);

IF rFiltVesselMicrostrain > 1200.0 THEN
    dwWarningWord := dwWarningWord OR 16#0000_0100; (* Warning: Vessel hoop microstrain elevated *)
END_IF;


(* ========================================================================================= *)
(* 7.0 6-STATE MULTIVARIABLE STATE-SPACE DISCRETE MODEL & REAL-TIME MPC OPTIMIZATION         *)
(* ========================================================================================= *)
(* Multivariable cyber-physical governor:                                                    *)
(*   x[k+1] = A * x[k] + B * u[k]                                                           *)
(*   y[k]   = C * x[k] + D * u[k]                                                           *)
(* Solves an embedded quadratic cost function via projected gradient descent with Hessian    *)
(* preconditioning and actuator saturation constraints:                                      *)
(*   min J = (x_pred - x_ref)^T * Q * (x_pred - x_ref)                                       *)
(*         + (u - u_ref)^T * R * (u - u_ref) + delta_u^T * S * delta_u                       *)

(* First-Scan State-Space Model Matrix Population (T_s = 0.200 s) *)
IF NOT bMatricesInitialized THEN
    (* Discrete Transition Matrix A (6x6) *)
    A_mat[1,1] := 0.9820; A_mat[1,2] := 0.0005; A_mat[1,3] := 0.0000; A_mat[1,4] := 0.0012; A_mat[1,5] := 0.0000;  A_mat[1,6] := 0.0045;
    A_mat[2,1] := 0.0125; A_mat[2,2] := 0.9950; A_mat[2,3] := 0.0000; A_mat[2,4] := 0.0000; A_mat[2,5] := 0.0000;  A_mat[2,6] := 0.0250;
    A_mat[3,1] := 0.0000; A_mat[3,2] := 0.0000; A_mat[3,3] := 0.9200; A_mat[3,4] := 0.0000; A_mat[3,5] := 0.0150;  A_mat[3,6] := 0.0000;
    A_mat[4,1] := 0.0020; A_mat[4,2] := 0.0000; A_mat[4,3] := 0.0000; A_mat[4,4] := 0.9980; A_mat[4,5] := 0.0000;  A_mat[4,6] := 0.0000;
    A_mat[5,1] := 0.0000; A_mat[5,2] := 0.0000; A_mat[5,3] := 0.0000; A_mat[5,4] := 0.0000; A_mat[5,5] := 0.8500;  A_mat[5,6] := 0.0000;
    A_mat[6,1] := 0.0850; A_mat[6,2] := 0.0150; A_mat[6,3] := 0.0000; A_mat[6,4] := 0.0000; A_mat[6,5] := 0.0000;  A_mat[6,6] := 0.9650;

    (* Input Coupling Matrix B (6x4) *)
    (* Inputs: u1=Be rod [mm], u2=H2 flow [sccm], u3=He stripping [sccm], u4=Cyclone throttle [%] *)
    B_mat[1,1] := -0.00420; B_mat[1,2] := -0.00085; B_mat[1,3] := 0.00005;  B_mat[1,4] := 0.00000;
    B_mat[2,1] := -0.00150; B_mat[2,2] := -0.00030; B_mat[2,3] := 0.00000;  B_mat[2,4] := 0.00000;
    B_mat[3,1] := 0.00000;  B_mat[3,2] := 0.00000;  B_mat[3,3] := -0.00065; B_mat[3,4] := -0.00015;
    B_mat[4,1] := 0.00080;  B_mat[4,2] := 0.00000;  B_mat[4,3] := 0.00000;  B_mat[4,4] := 0.00000;
    B_mat[5,1] := 0.00000;  B_mat[5,2] := 0.00002;  B_mat[5,3] := 0.00008;  B_mat[5,4] := -0.00250;
    B_mat[6,1] := -0.00350; B_mat[6,2] := -0.00075; B_mat[6,3] := 0.00000;  B_mat[6,4] := 0.00000;

    (* Output Observation Matrix C (4x6 Identity Selection) *)
    FOR iRow := 1 TO 4 DO
        FOR iCol := 1 TO 6 DO
            IF iRow = iCol THEN
                C_mat[iRow, iCol] := 1.0;
            ELSE
                C_mat[iRow, iCol] := 0.0;
            END_IF;
        END_FOR;
    END_FOR;

    (* Direct Feedthrough Matrix D (4x4 Zero) *)
    FOR iRow := 1 TO 4 DO
        FOR iCol := 1 TO 4 DO
            D_mat[iRow, iCol] := 0.0;
        END_FOR;
    END_FOR;

    (* Diagonal State Penalty Weights Q (6 states) *)
    Q_diag[1] := 120.0;     (* Heavy penalty on Redox Ratio tracking error *)
    Q_diag[2] := 5.0;       (* Penalty on leached chromium accumulation *)
    Q_diag[3] := 45.0;      (* Strong penalty on residual Xe-135 noble gas inventory *)
    Q_diag[4] := 1.5;       (* Minor penalty on Beryllium rod consumption *)
    Q_diag[5] := 250.0;     (* Extreme penalty on core gas void fraction *)
    Q_diag[6] := 80.0;      (* High penalty on structural alloy corrosion current *)

    (* Diagonal Control Action Weights R (4 actuators) *)
    R_diag[1] := 0.025;     (* Beryllium rod movement cost *)
    R_diag[2] := 0.050;     (* Hydrogen sparger gas consumption cost *)
    R_diag[3] := 0.010;     (* Helium stripping flow cost *)
    R_diag[4] := 0.080;     (* Cyclone throttle movement cost *)

    (* Diagonal Slew Rate (Delta-U) Suppression Weights S (4 actuators) *)
    S_diag[1] := 0.850;     (* Suppress aggressive Be rod mechanical oscillations *)
    S_diag[2] := 0.450;     (* Smooth hydrogen flow controller transients *)
    S_diag[3] := 0.150;     (* Smooth helium bubble injection transitions *)
    S_diag[4] := 0.650;     (* Prevent violent cyclone throttle hunting *)

    (* Actuator Hard Saturation Limits *)
    u_min[1] := 0.0;    u_max[1] := BE_ROD_MAX_STROKE_MM;   (* Be rod: 0 to 250 mm *)
    u_min[2] := 0.0;    u_max[2] := 1200.0;                 (* H2 flow: 0 to 1200 sccm *)
    u_min[3] := 200.0;  u_max[3] := 5000.0;                 (* He stripping: 200 to 5000 sccm *)
    u_min[4] := 15.0;   u_max[4] := 95.0;                   (* Cyclone throttle: 15 to 95 % *)

    (* Maximum Permissible Slew Rate per Execution Scan (0.2 s) *)
    delta_u_max[1] := 2.50;     (* Max 12.5 mm/s Be rod drive speed *)
    delta_u_max[2] := 25.0;     (* Max 125 sccm/s H2 MFC ramping *)
    delta_u_max[3] := 100.0;    (* Max 500 sccm/s He MFC ramping *)
    delta_u_max[4] := 5.0;      (* Max 25 %/s cyclone valve stroking *)

    (* Diagonal Hessian Approximations: H_m approx 2 * (sum_n B[n,m]^2 * Q[n] + R[m] + S[m]) *)
    FOR iCol := 1 TO 4 DO
        rTempSum := 0.0;
        FOR iRow := 1 TO 6 DO
            rTempSum := rTempSum + (B_mat[iRow, iCol] * B_mat[iRow, iCol] * Q_diag[iRow]);
        END_FOR;
        rWorkVal1 := 2.0 * (rTempSum + R_diag[iCol] + S_diag[iCol]);
        IF rWorkVal1 > 0.001 THEN
            inv_Hessian_diag[iCol] := 1.0 / rWorkVal1;
        ELSE
            inv_Hessian_diag[iCol] := 1.0;
        END_IF;
    END_FOR;

    bMatricesInitialized := TRUE;
END_IF;

(* Assemble Real-Time Current State Vector x_state *)
x_state[1] := rRedoxError;
x_state[2] := rDissolvedChromium_ppm;
x_state[3] := rFiltOffGasXe_Bq_m3 * 1.0e-10; (* Scaled dimensionless activity *)
x_state[4] := rCumulativeBerylliumBurn_grams * 0.010;
x_state[5] := rCalculatedVoidFraction_pct;
x_state[6] := rI_corr_uA_cm2;

(* Assemble State Setpoint Reference Vector x_ref *)
x_ref[1] := 0.0;        (* Target redox ratio error is zero (ln(ratio) = ln(target)) *)
x_ref[2] := 10.0;       (* Baseline background chromium limit [ppm] *)
x_ref[3] := 0.0;        (* Target residual Xenon activity in salt is zero *)
x_ref[4] := 0.0;        (* Minimize cumulative beryllium consumption *)
x_ref[5] := 0.025;      (* Target optimal bubbly flow void fraction: 0.025% *)
x_ref[6] := 0.250;      (* Target ultra-low corrosion current: 0.25 uA/cm2 *)

(* Actuator Baseline Reference Vector u_ref *)
u_ref[1] := 15.0;       (* Baseline shallow Be rod immersion [mm] *)
u_ref[2] := 150.0;      (* Baseline H2 trimming flow [sccm] *)
u_ref[3] := 1500.0;     (* Nominal He bubble stripping flow [sccm] *)
u_ref[4] := 65.0;       (* Nominal cyclone throttle position [%] *)

(* Forward One-Step State Prediction: x_pred = A * x_state + B * u_ctrl *)
FOR iRow := 1 TO 6 DO
    rTempSum := 0.0;
    FOR iCol := 1 TO 6 DO
        rTempSum := rTempSum + (A_mat[iRow, iCol] * x_state[iCol]);
    END_FOR;
    FOR iCol := 1 TO 4 DO
        rTempSum := rTempSum + (B_mat[iRow, iCol] * u_ctrl[iCol]);
    END_FOR;
    x_pred[iRow] := rTempSum;
    x_error[iRow] := x_pred[iRow] - x_ref[iRow];
END_FOR;

(* Projected Gradient Descent Optimization: 3 Unrolled Iterations per Scan *)
FOR iGradIter := 1 TO 3 DO
    (* Compute Analytical Gradient: grad_J[m] = dJ/du[m] *)
    FOR iCol := 1 TO 4 DO
        rTempSum := 0.0;
        FOR iRow := 1 TO 6 DO
            rTempSum := rTempSum + (2.0 * B_mat[iRow, iCol] * Q_diag[iRow] * x_error[iRow]);
        END_FOR;
        rTempSum := rTempSum + (2.0 * R_diag[iCol] * (u_ctrl[iCol] - u_ref[iCol]));
        rTempSum := rTempSum + (2.0 * S_diag[iCol] * (u_ctrl[iCol] - u_prev[iCol]));
        grad_J[iCol] := rTempSum;
    END_FOR;

    (* Update Control Actions: du = - alpha * inv_H * grad_J *)
    FOR iCol := 1 TO 4 DO
        delta_u[iCol] := - rStepSize * inv_Hessian_diag[iCol] * grad_J[iCol];
        
        (* Apply Slew Rate Bounds *)
        IF delta_u[iCol] > delta_u_max[iCol] THEN
            delta_u[iCol] := delta_u_max[iCol];
        ELSIF delta_u[iCol] < -delta_u_max[iCol] THEN
            delta_u[iCol] := -delta_u_max[iCol];
        END_IF;
        
        (* Integrate Control Action *)
        u_ctrl[iCol] := u_ctrl[iCol] + delta_u[iCol];
        
        (* Enforce Hard Actuator Saturation Constraints *)
        IF u_ctrl[iCol] > u_max[iCol] THEN
            u_ctrl[iCol] := u_max[iCol];
        ELSIF u_ctrl[iCol] < u_min[iCol] THEN
            u_ctrl[iCol] := u_min[iCol];
        END_IF;
    END_FOR;
END_FOR;

(* Store previous control inputs for next scan derivative evaluation *)
FOR iCol := 1 TO 4 DO
    u_prev[iCol] := u_ctrl[iCol];
END_FOR;

(* Assign MPC Computed Targets to Actuator Outputs *)
rBeImmersionTarget_mm := u_ctrl[1];
rH2FlowTarget_sccm    := u_ctrl[2];


(* ========================================================================================= *)
(* 8.0 MULTI-STAGE FINITE STATE MACHINE (FSM) GOVERNOR                                      *)
(* ========================================================================================= *)
(* Deterministic state machine governing sequential warm-up, calibration, sparge purging,    *)
(* coarse beryllium exposure, fine hydrogen trimming, fission gas stripping, and MPC.       *)

(* Detect state transitions *)
IF iState <> iPreviousState THEN
    bStateFirstScan := TRUE;
    iPreviousState := iState;
ELSE
    bStateFirstScan := FALSE;
END_IF;

CASE iState OF
    0: (* FSM_COLD_INHIBIT: System Standby / De-energized Safe Inhibit *)
        bSystemReady             := FALSE;
        rBeRodPositionCmd_mm     := 0.0;
        rH2MassFlowCmd_sccm      := 0.0;
        rHeStrippingFlowCmd_sccm := 0.0;
        rCycloneThrottleCmd_pct  := 0.0;
        rTraceHeatingTarget_kW   := 0.0;
        bBeRodFastEjectionActive := FALSE;
        bH2SupplyIsolated        := TRUE;
        bDegradedModeActive      := FALSE;

        IF bMasterSystemEnable AND (NOT bEmergencyTripActive) THEN
            iState := 10; (* Transition to Preheating *)
        END_IF;

    10: (* FSM_ISOTHERMAL_PREHEAT: Salt Bypass Pre-Warming to 650°C Liquidus Margin *)
        bSystemReady             := FALSE;
        rBeRodPositionCmd_mm     := 0.0;
        rH2MassFlowCmd_sccm      := 0.0;
        rHeStrippingFlowCmd_sccm := 50.0; (* Slight inert helium trickle *)
        rCycloneThrottleCmd_pct  := 15.0;
        rTraceHeatingTarget_kW   := 55.0; (* Engage bypass line trace heaters *)
        bH2SupplyIsolated        := TRUE;

        (* Evaluate isothermal temperature stabilization dwell *)
        tPreheatDwellTimer(IN := (rBypassLoopTemp_degC >= 640.0) AND (rVotedSaltCoreTemp_degC >= 640.0),
                           PT := T#30S);
        
        IF tPreheatDwellTimer.Q THEN
            tPreheatDwellTimer(IN := FALSE);
            iState := 20; (* Transition to Sensor Health Alignment *)
        END_IF;

(* ============================================================================================= *)
(* SECTION 1: HARDWIRED SAFETY INTERLOCK VERIFICATION & REAL-TIME SYSTEM SUPERVISORY             *)
(* ============================================================================================= *)
tScanDeltaTime_s := 0.050; (* Enforce deterministic 50 ms task scan dt *)

(* Dual-Channel Safety Chain Evaluation (IEC 62061 SIL-3 / ISO 13849-1 Cat 4 PLe) *)
IF NOT bEmergencyStopChain THEN
    bSystemReady := FALSE;
    bAutoAdvanceActive := FALSE;
    bPressureBalanced := FALSE;
    bEmergencyRetreatActive := TRUE;
    dwAlarmBitmask_Primary.31 := TRUE; (* Master Hardwired Emergency Stop De-energized *)
    iStateStep := 90; (* Immediate execution vector to EMERGENCY_TRIP_CHAMBER_ISOLATION *)
END_IF;

(* Master Operator Alarm Acknowledge & Fault Reset Vector *)
IF bResetFaults THEN
    dwAlarmBitmask_Primary := 16#00000000;
    dwAlarmBitmask_Secondary := 16#00000000;
    bFaceBlowoutTripActive := FALSE;
    bFaceCollapseTripActive := FALSE;
    bExcessiveTiltTripActive := FALSE;
    bCutterheadThermalOverloadActive := FALSE;
    bSpewingRapidGateAbortActive := FALSE;
    bHydraulicSupplyFailureActive := FALSE;
    bEmergencyRetreatActive := FALSE;
    
    (* If safety chain is healthy and machine is in trip/lockout, recover to safe IDLE *)
    IF bEmergencyStopChain AND ((iStateStep = 90) OR (iStateStep = 99)) THEN
        iStateStep := 0; (* Recover to IDLE_SAFE_DISARMED *)
    END_IF;
END_IF;


(* ============================================================================================= *)
(* SECTION 2: 2-OUT-OF-3 (2oo3) TRIPLE MODULAR REDUNDANCY SENSOR VOTING ENGINE                  *)
(* ============================================================================================= *)
(* --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* SUB-SECTION 2.1: Crown Elevation Bulkhead Earth Pressure Cells 2oo3 Voting                     *)
(* --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
rMedianBuffer[1] := rActualChamberPressure_Crown_A_bar;
rMedianBuffer[2] := rActualChamberPressure_Crown_B_bar;
rMedianBuffer[3] := rActualChamberPressure_Crown_C_bar;

(* Deterministic In-Place Sort for 3 Elements (Median Extraction) *)
IF rMedianBuffer[1] > rMedianBuffer[2] THEN
    rSwapTemp := rMedianBuffer[1];
    rMedianBuffer[1] := rMedianBuffer[2];
    rMedianBuffer[2] := rSwapTemp;
END_IF;
IF rMedianBuffer[2] > rMedianBuffer[3] THEN
    rSwapTemp := rMedianBuffer[2];
    rMedianBuffer[2] := rMedianBuffer[3];
    rMedianBuffer[3] := rSwapTemp;
END_IF;
IF rMedianBuffer[1] > rMedianBuffer[2] THEN
    rSwapTemp := rMedianBuffer[1];
    rMedianBuffer[1] := rMedianBuffer[2];
    rMedianBuffer[2] := rSwapTemp;
END_IF;

(* Analytical Discrepancy Monitoring Across Active Channels *)
rCrownDiscrepancy_bar := ABS(rMedianBuffer[3] - rMedianBuffer[1]);
bCrownSensorA_Healthy := (ABS(rActualChamberPressure_Crown_A_bar - rMedianBuffer[2]) <= rSensorDriftLimit_bar);
bCrownSensorB_Healthy := (ABS(rActualChamberPressure_Crown_B_bar - rMedianBuffer[2]) <= rSensorDriftLimit_bar);
bCrownSensorC_Healthy := (ABS(rActualChamberPressure_Crown_C_bar - rMedianBuffer[2]) <= rSensorDriftLimit_bar);

iCrownHealthyCount := 0;
IF bCrownSensorA_Healthy THEN iCrownHealthyCount := iCrownHealthyCount + 1; END_IF;
IF bCrownSensorB_Healthy THEN iCrownHealthyCount := iCrownHealthyCount + 1; END_IF;
IF bCrownSensorC_Healthy THEN iCrownHealthyCount := iCrownHealthyCount + 1; END_IF;

tSensorFaultDelayCrown(IN := (iCrownHealthyCount < 3), PT := T#250MS);

IF iCrownHealthyCount = 3 THEN
    rEffectiveCrownPressure_bar := rMedianBuffer[2]; (* Fully Validated Median *)
ELSIF iCrownHealthyCount = 2 THEN
    (* Degraded 1oo2 Failover Execution *)
    bDegradedSensorMode := TRUE;
    dwAlarmBitmask_Secondary.0 := TRUE; (* Warning: Crown Pressure Sensor Drift Detected *)
    IF NOT bCrownSensorA_Healthy THEN
        rEffectiveCrownPressure_bar := (rActualChamberPressure_Crown_B_bar + rActualChamberPressure_Crown_C_bar) * 0.50;
    ELSIF NOT bCrownSensorB_Healthy THEN
        rEffectiveCrownPressure_bar := (rActualChamberPressure_Crown_A_bar + rActualChamberPressure_Crown_C_bar) * 0.50;
    ELSE
        rEffectiveCrownPressure_bar := (rActualChamberPressure_Crown_A_bar + rActualChamberPressure_Crown_B_bar) * 0.50;
    END_IF;
ELSE
    (* Critical Loss of Redundancy: 2 or more Crown sensors corrupt *)
    dwAlarmBitmask_Primary.0 := TRUE; (* Trip: Crown Bulkhead Pressure Sensor Quorum Lost *)
    rEffectiveCrownPressure_bar := rMedianBuffer[2]; (* Freeze at last plausible median *)
    IF tSensorFaultDelayCrown.Q THEN
        iStateStep := 90; (* Enforce SIL-3 Safety Shutdown *)
    END_IF;
END_IF;

(* --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* SUB-SECTION 2.2: Center Elevation Bulkhead Earth Pressure Cells 2oo3 Voting                    *)
(* --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
rMedianBuffer[1] := rActualChamberPressure_Center_A_bar;
rMedianBuffer[2] := rActualChamberPressure_Center_B_bar;
rMedianBuffer[3] := rActualChamberPressure_Center_C_bar;

IF rMedianBuffer[1] > rMedianBuffer[2] THEN
    rSwapTemp := rMedianBuffer[1];
    rMedianBuffer[1] := rMedianBuffer[2];
    rMedianBuffer[2] := rSwapTemp;
END_IF;
IF rMedianBuffer[2] > rMedianBuffer[3] THEN
    rSwapTemp := rMedianBuffer[2];
    rMedianBuffer[2] := rMedianBuffer[3];
    rMedianBuffer[3] := rSwapTemp;
END_IF;
IF rMedianBuffer[1] > rMedianBuffer[2] THEN
    rSwapTemp := rMedianBuffer[1];
    rMedianBuffer[1] := rMedianBuffer[2];
    rMedianBuffer[2] := rSwapTemp;
END_IF;

rCenterDiscrepancy_bar := ABS(rMedianBuffer[3] - rMedianBuffer[1]);
bCenterSensorA_Healthy := (ABS(rActualChamberPressure_Center_A_bar - rMedianBuffer[2]) <= rSensorDriftLimit_bar);
bCenterSensorB_Healthy := (ABS(rActualChamberPressure_Center_B_bar - rMedianBuffer[2]) <= rSensorDriftLimit_bar);
bCenterSensorC_Healthy := (ABS(rActualChamberPressure_Center_C_bar - rMedianBuffer[2]) <= rSensorDriftLimit_bar);

iCenterHealthyCount := 0;
IF bCenterSensorA_Healthy THEN iCenterHealthyCount := iCenterHealthyCount + 1; END_IF;
IF bCenterSensorB_Healthy THEN iCenterHealthyCount := iCenterHealthyCount + 1; END_IF;
IF bCenterSensorC_Healthy THEN iCenterHealthyCount := iCenterHealthyCount + 1; END_IF;

tSensorFaultDelayCenter(IN := (iCenterHealthyCount < 3), PT := T#250MS);

IF iCenterHealthyCount = 3 THEN
    rEffectiveCenterPressure_bar := rMedianBuffer[2];
ELSIF iCenterHealthyCount = 2 THEN
    bDegradedSensorMode := TRUE;
    dwAlarmBitmask_Secondary.1 := TRUE; (* Warning: Center Pressure Sensor Drift Detected *)
    IF NOT bCenterSensorA_Healthy THEN
        rEffectiveCenterPressure_bar := (rActualChamberPressure_Center_B_bar + rActualChamberPressure_Center_C_bar) * 0.50;
    ELSIF NOT bCenterSensorB_Healthy THEN
        rEffectiveCenterPressure_bar := (rActualChamberPressure_Center_A_bar + rActualChamberPressure_Center_C_bar) * 0.50;
    ELSE
        rEffectiveCenterPressure_bar := (rActualChamberPressure_Center_A_bar + rActualChamberPressure_Center_B_bar) * 0.50;
    END_IF;
ELSE
    dwAlarmBitmask_Primary.1 := TRUE; (* Trip: Center Bulkhead Pressure Sensor Quorum Lost *)
    rEffectiveCenterPressure_bar := rMedianBuffer[2];
    IF tSensorFaultDelayCenter.Q THEN
        iStateStep := 90;
    END_IF;
END_IF;

(* --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* SUB-SECTION 2.3: Invert Elevation Bulkhead Earth Pressure Cells 2oo3 Voting                    *)
(* --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
rMedianBuffer[1] := rActualChamberPressure_Invert_A_bar;
rMedianBuffer[2] := rActualChamberPressure_Invert_B_bar;
rMedianBuffer[3] := rActualChamberPressure_Invert_C_bar;

IF rMedianBuffer[1] > rMedianBuffer[2] THEN
    rSwapTemp := rMedianBuffer[1];
    rMedianBuffer[1] := rMedianBuffer[2];
    rMedianBuffer[2] := rSwapTemp;
END_IF;
IF rMedianBuffer[2] > rMedianBuffer[3] THEN
    rSwapTemp := rMedianBuffer[2];
    rMedianBuffer[2] := rMedianBuffer[3];
    rMedianBuffer[3] := rSwapTemp;
END_IF;
IF rMedianBuffer[1] > rMedianBuffer[2] THEN
    rSwapTemp := rMedianBuffer[1];
    rMedianBuffer[1] := rMedianBuffer[2];
    rMedianBuffer[2] := rSwapTemp;
END_IF;

rInvertDiscrepancy_bar := ABS(rMedianBuffer[3] - rMedianBuffer[1]);
bInvertSensorA_Healthy := (ABS(rActualChamberPressure_Invert_A_bar - rMedianBuffer[2]) <= rSensorDriftLimit_bar);
bInvertSensorB_Healthy := (ABS(rActualChamberPressure_Invert_B_bar - rMedianBuffer[2]) <= rSensorDriftLimit_bar);
bInvertSensorC_Healthy := (ABS(rActualChamberPressure_Invert_C_bar - rMedianBuffer[2]) <= rSensorDriftLimit_bar);

iInvertHealthyCount := 0;
IF bInvertSensorA_Healthy THEN iInvertHealthyCount := iInvertHealthyCount + 1; END_IF;
IF bInvertSensorB_Healthy THEN iInvertHealthyCount := iInvertHealthyCount + 1; END_IF;
IF bInvertSensorC_Healthy THEN iInvertHealthyCount := iInvertHealthyCount + 1; END_IF;

tSensorFaultDelayInvert(IN := (iInvertHealthyCount < 3), PT := T#250MS);

IF iInvertHealthyCount = 3 THEN
    rEffectiveInvertPressure_bar := rMedianBuffer[2];
ELSIF iInvertHealthyCount = 2 THEN
    bDegradedSensorMode := TRUE;
    dwAlarmBitmask_Secondary.2 := TRUE; (* Warning: Invert Pressure Sensor Drift Detected *)
    IF NOT bInvertSensorA_Healthy THEN
        rEffectiveInvertPressure_bar := (rActualChamberPressure_Invert_B_bar + rActualChamberPressure_Invert_C_bar) * 0.50;
    ELSIF NOT bInvertSensorB_Healthy THEN
        rEffectiveInvertPressure_bar := (rActualChamberPressure_Invert_A_bar + rActualChamberPressure_Invert_C_bar) * 0.50;
    ELSE
        rEffectiveInvertPressure_bar := (rActualChamberPressure_Invert_A_bar + rActualChamberPressure_Invert_B_bar) * 0.50;
    END_IF;
ELSE
    dwAlarmBitmask_Primary.2 := TRUE; (* Trip: Invert Bulkhead Pressure Sensor Quorum Lost *)
    rEffectiveInvertPressure_bar := rMedianBuffer[2];
    IF tSensorFaultDelayInvert.Q THEN
        iStateStep := 90;
    END_IF;
END_IF;

(* First-Order Exponential Low-Pass Dynamic Filters for Noise Attenuation *)
rFiltCrownPressure_bar    := (rFilterCoeff_Pressure * rEffectiveCrownPressure_bar)    + ((1.0 - rFilterCoeff_Pressure) * rFiltCrownPressure_bar);
rFiltCenterPressure_bar   := (rFilterCoeff_Pressure * rEffectiveCenterPressure_bar)   + ((1.0 - rFilterCoeff_Pressure) * rFiltCenterPressure_bar);
rFiltInvertPressure_bar   := (rFilterCoeff_Pressure * rEffectiveInvertPressure_bar)   + ((1.0 - rFilterCoeff_Pressure) * rFiltInvertPressure_bar);
rFiltAdvanceSpeed_mmpm    := (rFilterCoeff_Speed    * rMeasuredAdvanceSpeed_mmpm)     + ((1.0 - rFilterCoeff_Speed)    * rFiltAdvanceSpeed_mmpm);
rFiltCutterheadTorque_kNm := (rFilterCoeff_Torque   * rCutterheadTorque_kNm)          + ((1.0 - rFilterCoeff_Torque)   * rFiltCutterheadTorque_kNm);
rFiltDischargePressure_bar:= (rFilterCoeff_Pressure * rMuckDischargePressure_bar)     + ((1.0 - rFilterCoeff_Pressure) * rFiltDischargePressure_bar);


(* ============================================================================================= *)
(* SECTION 3: GEOTECHNICAL FACE SUPPORT PROFILE & VERTICAL PRESSURE GRADIENT ESTIMATION          *)
(* ============================================================================================= *)
(* Real-Time Vertical Hydrostatic / Earth Pressure Gradient Evaluation [bar/m] *)
IF rVerticalElevationSpan_m > 0.5 THEN
    rEarthPressureGradient_barpm := (rFiltInvertPressure_bar - rFiltCrownPressure_bar) / rVerticalElevationSpan_m;
ELSE
    rEarthPressureGradient_barpm := 0.145; (* Standard cohesive muck gradient default *)
END_IF;

(* Geotechnical Limit State Boundaries (Rankine-Terzaghi Active and Passive Envelopes) *)
rHydrostaticHead_bar := 2.450; (* In-situ groundwater piezometric head relative to crown *)
rOverburdenEffectiveStress_bar := 1.350; (* Vertical effective geostatic stress at crown level *)

(* Active limit: minimum support pressure to prevent plastification and chimney collapse *)
rActiveEarthPressureLimit_bar := rHydrostaticHead_bar + (0.310 * rOverburdenEffectiveStress_bar) - 0.250;

(* Passive limit: maximum support pressure before ground fracturing and surface heave occur *)
rPassiveEarthPressureLimit_bar := rHydrostaticHead_bar + (3.250 * rOverburdenEffectiveStress_bar) + 0.650;

(* Geotechnical Envelope Safety Trip Assertions *)
IF rFiltCrownPressure_bar < rActiveEarthPressureLimit_bar THEN
    bFaceCollapseTripActive := TRUE;
    dwAlarmBitmask_Primary.3 := TRUE; (* Trip: Excavation Face Under-Pressure Collapse Risk *)
ELSE
    bFaceCollapseTripActive := FALSE;
END_IF;

IF rFiltInvertPressure_bar > rPassiveEarthPressureLimit_bar THEN
    bFaceBlowoutTripActive := TRUE;
    dwAlarmBitmask_Primary.4 := TRUE; (* Trip: Excavation Face Over-Pressure Blowout Risk *)
ELSE
    bFaceBlowoutTripActive := FALSE;
END_IF;

(* Operating Chamber Pressure Deviation Tracking *)
rChamberPressureError_bar := ABS(rFiltCenterPressure_bar - rTargetChamberPressure_bar);
bPressureBalanced := (rChamberPressureError_bar <= 0.180);


(* ============================================================================================= *)
(* SECTION 4: EXCAVATION VOLUMETRIC MASS BALANCE & MUCK COMPRESSIBILITY TRACKING                 *)
(* ============================================================================================= *)
(* Theoretical In-Situ Ground Excavation Rate [m^3/min] *)
rTheoreticalExcavationRate_m3pm := rTBM_ExcavationArea_m2 * (rFiltAdvanceSpeed_mmpm / 1000.0);

(* Screw Conveyor Real-Time Volumetric Extraction Rate [m^3/min] *)
rDischargeGateFactor := rScrewDischargeGate_pct / 100.0;
IF rDischargeGateFactor < 0.05 THEN
    rDischargeGateFactor := 0.05; (* Non-zero hydraulic leakage floor *)
END_IF;

rScrewExtractionRate_m3pm := rScrewDisplacementPerRev_m3 * rScrewConveyorSpeed_rpm * rScrewVolumetricEfficiency * rDischargeGateFactor;

(* Discrete Integral Mass Accumulators [kg] across dt *)
rExtractedMassAccumulator_kg   := rExtractedMassAccumulator_kg   + (rScrewExtractionRate_m3pm * (rMuckDensity_tonne_m3 * 1000.0) * (tScanDeltaTime_s / 60.0));
rTheoreticalMassAccumulator_kg := rTheoreticalMassAccumulator_kg + (rTheoreticalExcavationRate_m3pm * (rInSituSoilDensity_tonne_m3 * 1000.0) * (tScanDeltaTime_s / 60.0));

(* Real-Time Dimensionless Mass Balance Extraction Index [-] *)
IF rTheoreticalMassAccumulator_kg > 1000.0 THEN
    rExcavationMassBalanceRatio := rExtractedMassAccumulator_kg / rTheoreticalMassAccumulator_kg;
ELSE
    rExcavationMassBalanceRatio := 1.000;
END_IF;

(* Mass Balance Anomaly Supervision (Over-Excavation / Under-Excavation Risk) *)
IF rExcavationMassBalanceRatio > 1.150 THEN
    dwAlarmBitmask_Secondary.4 := TRUE; (* Warning: Ground Over-Excavation / Subsidence Risk *)
ELSIF (rExcavationMassBalanceRatio < 0.850) AND (rFiltAdvanceSpeed_mmpm > 10.0) THEN
    dwAlarmBitmask_Secondary.5 := TRUE; (* Warning: Chamber Muck Consolidation / Under-Extraction *)
ELSE
    dwAlarmBitmask_Secondary.4 := FALSE;
    dwAlarmBitmask_Secondary.5 := FALSE;
END_IF;


(* ============================================================================================= *)
(* SECTION 5: REAL-TIME CLOSED-LOOP SOIL CONDITIONING OPTIMIZATION & RHEOLOGY CONTROL            *)
(* ============================================================================================= *)
(* Specific Energy of Excavation SE [MJ/m^3] *)
IF rTheoreticalExcavationRate_m3pm > 0.05 THEN
    rSpecificEnergy_MJ_m3 := (2.0 * 3.14159 * (rCutterheadSpeed_rpm / 60.0) * rFiltCutterheadTorque_kNm) / (rTheoreticalExcavationRate_m3pm / 60.0);
ELSE
    rSpecificEnergy_MJ_m3 := 16.5;
END_IF;

(* Soil Conditioning Total Foam Volume Demand [m^3/min] from Target FIR *)
rTotalFoamVolumeDemand_m3pm := rTheoreticalExcavationRate_m3pm * (rSoilConditioning_FIR_Target_pct / 100.0);

(* Surfactant Liquid Mixture Flow Reference [L/min] based on FER *)
IF rFoamExpansionRatio_FER > 1.0 THEN
    rLiquidSurfactantFlow_Lpm := (rTotalFoamVolumeDemand_m3pm / rFoamExpansionRatio_FER) * 1000.0;
ELSE
    rLiquidSurfactantFlow_Lpm := 95.0;
END_IF;

(* Dynamic Cutterhead Drive Torque Feedforward Compensation *)
rTorqueExcess_kNm := rFiltCutterheadTorque_kNm - 18500.0; (* Baseline torque setpoint: 18,500 kNm *)
IF rTorqueExcess_kNm > 0.0 THEN
    (* Boost surfactant liquid flow up to +60% proportional to excessive shear torque *)
    rLiquidSurfactantFlow_Lpm := rLiquidSurfactantFlow_Lpm * (1.0 + (rTorqueExcess_kNm / 30000.0));
END_IF;

(* High-Viscosity Polymer Booster Injection Trigger *)
tConditioningBoostTimer(IN := ((rFiltCutterheadTorque_kNm > 24500.0) OR (rBulkheadMuckTemp_degC > 42.0)), PT := T#60S);

IF tConditioningBoostTimer.IN THEN
    rPolymerFlowRateCmd_Lpm := 40.0 + (rTorqueExcess_kNm * 0.0020);
    dwAlarmBitmask_Secondary.6 := TRUE; (* Status: High-Viscosity Polymer Lubrication Boost Engaged *)
ELSE
    rPolymerFlowRateCmd_Lpm := 6.5; (* Standby seal lubrication flow *)
    dwAlarmBitmask_Secondary.6 := FALSE;
END_IF;

rFoamFlowRateCmd_Lpm := rLiquidSurfactantFlow_Lpm;

(* ============================================================================================= *)
(* SECTION 6: DISCRETE STATE-SPACE OBSERVER & PREDICTOR UPDATES                                  *)
(* ============================================================================================= *)
(* Update kinematic stroke divergence variables *)
rPitchStrokeDiff_mm := rStrokeDisplacement_ZoneC_mm - rStrokeDisplacement_ZoneA_mm;
rYawStrokeDiff_mm   := rStrokeDisplacement_ZoneD_mm - rStrokeDisplacement_ZoneB_mm;

(* Synthesize linearized deviation state vector x in R^6 *)
rState_x[1] := rFiltCrownPressure_bar - rTargetChamberPressure_bar;
rState_x[2] := rFiltInvertPressure_bar - (rTargetChamberPressure_bar + (rEarthPressureGradient_barpm * rVerticalElevationSpan_m));
rState_x[3] := rPitchStrokeDiff_mm;
rState_x[4] := rYawStrokeDiff_mm;
rState_x[5] := rFiltAdvanceSpeed_mmpm - rTargetAdvanceSpeed_mmpm;
rState_x[6] := rFiltDischargePressure_bar;

(* Compute 1-step discrete predictive state vector: x_pred = A_d * x + B_d * Delta_u *)
FOR iIter := 1 TO 6 DO
    rPredictedState[iIter] := 0.0;
    FOR kCol := 1 TO 6 DO
        rPredictedState[iIter] := rPredictedState[iIter] + (rA_d[iIter, kCol] * rState_x[kCol]) + (rB_d[iIter, kCol] * rDelta_u[kCol]);
    END_FOR;
END_FOR;


(* ============================================================================================= *)
(* SECTION 7: CONSTRAINED MODEL PREDICTIVE CONTROL (MPC) PROJECTED GRADIENT DESCENT QP SOLVER   *)
(* ============================================================================================= *)
(* Objective: Minimize Quadratic Performance Index J(Delta_u) = 1/2 Delta_u^T H Delta_u + g^T Delta_u *)

(* Calculate state tracking deviation vector relative to geotechnical target origin *)
FOR iIter := 1 TO 6 DO
    rTrackingError[iIter] := rPredictedState[iIter];
END_FOR;

(* Calculate quadratic cost gradient vector: g = B_d^T * Q * TrackingError + R * Delta_u *)
FOR iIter := 1 TO 6 DO
    rGradient_g[iIter] := 0.0;
    FOR kCol := 1 TO 6 DO
        rGradient_g[iIter] := rGradient_g[iIter] + (rB_d[kCol, iIter] * rWeight_Q[kCol] * rTrackingError[kCol]);
    END_FOR;
    rGradient_g[iIter] := rGradient_g[iIter] + (rWeight_R[iIter] * rDelta_u[iIter]);
END_FOR;

(* Compute Euclidean norm squared of cost gradient for Barzilai-Borwein adaptive step sizing *)
rGradientNorm := 0.0;
FOR iIter := 1 TO 6 DO
    rGradientNorm := rGradientNorm + (rGradient_g[iIter] * rGradient_g[iIter]);
END_FOR;

IF rGradientNorm > 1.0E-6 THEN
    rStepSizeAlpha := 0.042 / (1.0 + SQRT(rGradientNorm) * 0.018);
ELSE
    rStepSizeAlpha := 0.042;
END_IF;

(* Multi-Variable Projected Gradient Descent Iteration with Box Constraints *)
FOR iIter := 1 TO 6 DO
    rDeltaCandidate := rDelta_u[iIter] - (rStepSizeAlpha * rGradient_g[iIter]);
    
    (* Dynamic Actuator Slew Rate Limiting: |Delta_u| <= DeltaU_Max *)
    IF rDeltaCandidate > rDeltaU_Max[iIter] THEN
        rDeltaCandidate := rDeltaU_Max[iIter];
    ELSIF rDeltaCandidate < -rDeltaU_Max[iIter] THEN
        rDeltaCandidate := -rDeltaU_Max[iIter];
    END_IF;
    
    (* Hard Boundary Position Saturation Constraints: U_Min <= u_prev + Delta_u <= U_Max *)
    IF (rControl_u_prev[iIter] + rDeltaCandidate) > rU_Max[iIter] THEN
        rDeltaCandidate := rU_Max[iIter] - rControl_u_prev[iIter];
    ELSIF (rControl_u_prev[iIter] + rDeltaCandidate) < rU_Min[iIter] THEN
        rDeltaCandidate := rU_Min[iIter] - rControl_u_prev[iIter];
    END_IF;
    
    rDelta_u[iIter] := rDeltaCandidate;
    rControl_u[iIter] := rControl_u_prev[iIter] + rDelta_u[iIter];
END_FOR;

(* Update previous control command vector for next discrete execution cycle *)
FOR iIter := 1 TO 6 DO
    rControl_u_prev[iIter] := rControl_u[iIter];
END_FOR;


(* ============================================================================================= *)
(* SECTION 8: MULTI-ZONE HYDRAULIC THRUST SYNCHRONIZATION, STEERING & SEGMENT PROTECTION         *)
(* ============================================================================================= *)
(* Spatial Trajectory Steering Vector Transformation *)
IF bAutoSteeringEngaged THEN
    (* Steering guidance moment demands converted to equivalent differential force [kN] *)
    rPitchDemand_kN := rSteeringPitch_deg * 8800.0; (* 8,800 kN per deg pitch deviation *)
    rYawDemand_kN   := rSteeringYaw_deg   * 8800.0; (* 8,800 kN per deg yaw deviation *)
ELSE
    rPitchDemand_kN := 0.0;
    rYawDemand_kN   := 0.0;
END_IF;

(* Machine Chassis Roll Torsion Reaction Moment Compensation *)
rRollCounterTorque_kNm := -rSteeringRoll_deg * 1250.0;

(* Base Thrust Load Balancing Across 4 Circumferential Quadrants (48 cylinders total) *)
rBaseThrustForcePerZone_kN := rThrustForceTotal_Target_kN / 4.0;

rThrustForce_ZoneA_kN := rBaseThrustForcePerZone_kN - (rPitchDemand_kN * 0.50);
rThrustForce_ZoneC_kN := rBaseThrustForcePerZone_kN + (rPitchDemand_kN * 0.50);
rThrustForce_ZoneB_kN := rBaseThrustForcePerZone_kN - (rYawDemand_kN   * 0.50);
rThrustForce_ZoneD_kN := rBaseThrustForcePerZone_kN + (rYawDemand_kN   * 0.50);

(* Total Hydraulic Cylinder Piston Area per Quadrant Zone (12 cylinder pairs = 2.7216 m^2) *)
rHydraulicPistonAreaTotal_m2 := 2.7216;

(* Convert thrust force demands [kN] to hydraulic proportional relief valve setpoints [bar] *)
(* Formula: P [bar] = F [kN] / (Area [m^2] * 100.0) *)
rThrustPressure_ZoneA_bar := rThrustForce_ZoneA_kN / (rHydraulicPistonAreaTotal_m2 * 100.0);
rThrustPressure_ZoneB_bar := rThrustForce_ZoneB_kN / (rHydraulicPistonAreaTotal_m2 * 100.0);
rThrustPressure_ZoneC_bar := rThrustForce_ZoneC_kN / (rHydraulicPistonAreaTotal_m2 * 100.0);
rThrustPressure_ZoneD_bar := rThrustForce_ZoneD_kN / (rHydraulicPistonAreaTotal_m2 * 100.0);

(* Dispatch Proportional Directional Valve Flow Demands from MPC Controller Outputs u[1..4] *)
rThrustFlow_ZoneA_Lpm := rControl_u[1];
rThrustFlow_ZoneB_Lpm := rControl_u[2];
rThrustFlow_ZoneC_Lpm := rControl_u[3];
rThrustFlow_ZoneD_Lpm := rControl_u[4];

(* Precast Reinforced Concrete Segment Lining Anti-Wedge Structural Protection *)
IF (ABS(rPitchStrokeDiff_mm) > rMaxAllowedTiltDeviation_mm) OR (ABS(rYawStrokeDiff_mm) > rMaxAllowedTiltDeviation_mm) THEN
    bExcessiveTiltTripActive := TRUE;
    dwAlarmBitmask_Primary.5 := TRUE; (* Trip: Segment Lining Angular Tilt Divergence Exceeded *)
    
    (* Cross-Couple Flow Attenuation to Arrest Diverging Quadrant *)
    IF rPitchStrokeDiff_mm > rMaxAllowedTiltDeviation_mm THEN
        rThrustFlow_ZoneC_Lpm := rThrustFlow_ZoneC_Lpm * 0.25;
    ELSIF rPitchStrokeDiff_mm < -rMaxAllowedTiltDeviation_mm THEN
        rThrustFlow_ZoneA_Lpm := rThrustFlow_ZoneA_Lpm * 0.25;
    END_IF;
    
    IF rYawStrokeDiff_mm > rMaxAllowedTiltDeviation_mm THEN
        rThrustFlow_ZoneD_Lpm := rThrustFlow_ZoneD_Lpm * 0.25;
    ELSIF rYawStrokeDiff_mm < -rMaxAllowedTiltDeviation_mm THEN
        rThrustFlow_ZoneB_Lpm := rThrustFlow_ZoneB_Lpm * 0.25;
    END_IF;
ELSE
    bExcessiveTiltTripActive := FALSE;
END_IF;


(* ============================================================================================= *)
(* SECTION 9: ARCHIMEDES SCREW CLOSED-LOOP PRESSURE DISSIPATION & ANTI-SPEWING CONTAINMENT       *)
(* ============================================================================================= *)
(* Evaluate Dynamic Pressure Gradient Along Archimedes Screw Casing *)
rSpewingPressureDrop_bar := rFiltCenterPressure_bar - rFiltDischargePressure_bar;

(* Anti-Spewing Trigger: Collapse of casing pressure drop combined with high discharge pressure *)
tSpewingDebounce(IN := ((rSpewingPressureDrop_bar < 0.650) AND (rFiltDischargePressure_bar > 1.750)), PT := T#150MS);

IF tSpewingDebounce.Q THEN
    bSpewingRiskActive := TRUE;
    dwAlarmBitmask_Primary.6 := TRUE; (* Critical Trip: Severe Soil Plug Failure / Spewing Detected *)
    
    (* High-Speed Hydraulic Guillotine Gate Sealing & Drive Abort *)
    rScrewDischargeGateCmd_pct := 0.0; (* Fast closure within 1.2 s *)
    rScrewConveyorSpeedCmd_rpm := 0.0; (* Immediate VFD frequency cutoff *)
    iStateStep := 80; (* Vector to SPEWING_CONTAINMENT_RAPID_GATE_ABORT *)
ELSE
    bSpewingRiskActive := FALSE;
    (* Regulate screw speed and discharge gate aperture via MPC outputs u[5] and u[6] *)
    rScrewConveyorSpeedCmd_rpm := rControl_u[5];
    rScrewDischargeGateCmd_pct := rControl_u[6];
END_IF;

(* ============================================================================================= *)
(* SECTION 10: DETERMINISTIC MULTI-STAGE FINITE STATE MACHINE (FSM) SEQUENCE ENGINE              *)
(* ============================================================================================= *)
CASE iStateStep OF
    0: (* STATE 0: IDLE_SAFE_DISARMED *)
        bSystemReady := FALSE;
        bAutoAdvanceActive := FALSE;
        bEmergencyRetreatActive := FALSE;
        rThrustPressure_ZoneA_bar := 12.0; (* Standby pre-charge pressure *)
        rThrustPressure_ZoneB_bar := 12.0;
        rThrustPressure_ZoneC_bar := 12.0;
        rThrustPressure_ZoneD_bar := 12.0;
        rThrustFlow_ZoneA_Lpm := 0.0;
        rThrustFlow_ZoneB_Lpm := 0.0;
        rThrustFlow_ZoneC_Lpm := 0.0;
        rThrustFlow_ZoneD_Lpm := 0.0;
        rScrewConveyorSpeedCmd_rpm := 0.0;
        rScrewDischargeGateCmd_pct := 0.0;
        rFoamFlowRateCmd_Lpm := 0.0;
        rPolymerFlowRateCmd_Lpm := 0.0;
        
        IF bEnableMasterControl AND bEmergencyStopChain THEN
            iStateStep := 10; (* Transition to pre-advance self-test *)
        END_IF;

    10: (* STATE 10: PRE_ADVANCE_TMR_INTEGRITY_CHECK *)
        bSystemReady := FALSE;
        bAutoAdvanceActive := FALSE;
        (* Verify sensor triad health and hydraulic pressure *)
        IF (iCrownHealthyCount >= 2) AND (iCenterHealthyCount >= 2) AND (iInvertHealthyCount >= 2) THEN
            IF rHydraulicSupplyPressure_bar >= 240.0 THEN
                iStateStep := 20; (* Proceed to Chamber Pressurization *)
            ELSE
                dwAlarmBitmask_Secondary.7 := TRUE; (* Warning: Hydraulic Main Supply Below 240 bar *)
            END_IF;
        ELSE
            iStateStep := 90; (* Channel quorum loss trip *)
        END_IF;

    20: (* STATE 20: STANDBY_CHAMBER_PRESSURIZATION *)
        bSystemReady := TRUE;
        bAutoAdvanceActive := FALSE;
        rScrewDischargeGateCmd_pct := 0.0; (* Keep gate fully sealed *)
        rScrewConveyorSpeedCmd_rpm := 0.0;
        
        (* Low-flow synchronized pre-thrust to establish ground face contact *)
        rThrustFlow_ZoneA_Lpm := 28.0;
        rThrustFlow_ZoneB_Lpm := 28.0;
        rThrustFlow_ZoneC_Lpm := 28.0;
        rThrustFlow_ZoneD_Lpm := 28.0;
        
        IF bPressureBalanced THEN
            IF NOT bRingBuildModeActive THEN
                iStateStep := 30; (* Engage Synchronized Auto Advance *)
            ELSE
                iStateStep := 60; (* Branch to Ring Build Hold *)
            END_IF;
        END_IF;

    30: (* STATE 30: SYNCHRONIZED_AUTO_ADVANCE_EXCAVATION *)
        bSystemReady := TRUE;
        bAutoAdvanceActive := TRUE;
        
        (* Evaluate State Transitions based on Machine Telemetry *)
        IF bRingBuildModeActive THEN
            iStateStep := 60; (* Branch to Segment Ring Build Mode *)
        ELSIF bSpewingRiskActive THEN
            iStateStep := 80; (* Branch to Spewing Containment Abort *)
        ELSIF bExcessiveTiltTripActive OR bFaceBlowoutTripActive OR bFaceCollapseTripActive THEN
            iStateStep := 90; (* Enforce SIL-3 Emergency Trip *)
        ELSIF rFiltCutterheadTorque_kNm > 25500.0 THEN

rDelta_PT12 := ABS(rAtmospherePress_PT1_mbar - rAtmospherePress_PT2_mbar);

bPT2_Valid := (rDelta_PT12 <= rTMR_Tolerance_mbar) OR (rDelta_PT23 <= rTMR_Tolerance_mbar);
bPT3_Valid := (rDelta_PT13 <= rTMR_Tolerance_mbar) OR (rDelta_PT23 <= rTMR_Tolerance_mbar);

IF bPT1_Valid AND bPT2_Valid AND bPT3_Valid THEN

    IF (rAtmospherePress_PT1_mbar >= rAtmospherePress_PT2_mbar AND rAtmospherePress_PT1_mbar <= rAtmospherePress_PT3_mbar) OR
       (rAtmospherePress_PT1_mbar <= rAtmospherePress_PT2_mbar AND rAtmospherePress_PT1_mbar >= rAtmospherePress_PT3_mbar) THEN
        rVotedBathPressure_mbar := rAtmospherePress_PT1_mbar;
    ELSIF (rAtmospherePress_PT2_mbar >= rAtmospherePress_PT1_mbar AND rAtmospherePress_PT2_mbar <= rAtmospherePress_PT3_mbar) OR

    ELSE
        rVotedBathPressure_mbar := rAtmospherePress_PT3_mbar;
    END_IF;

    (* Sensor 1 isolated: Compute mean of remaining validated channels 2 and 3 *)
    rVotedBathPressure_mbar := (rAtmospherePress_PT2_mbar + rAtmospherePress_PT3_mbar) * 0.5;
    dwDiagnosticFaultCode   := dwDiagnosticFaultCode OR 16#0000_0002;
ELSIF NOT bPT2_Valid AND bPT1_Valid AND bPT3_Valid THEN
    (* Sensor 2 isolated: Compute mean of remaining validated channels 1 and 3 *)
    rVotedBathPressure_mbar := (rAtmospherePress_PT1_mbar + rAtmospherePress_PT3_mbar) * 0.5;
    dwDiagnosticFaultCode   := dwDiagnosticFaultCode OR 16#0000_0004;
ELSIF NOT bPT3_Valid AND bPT1_Valid AND bPT2_Valid THEN
    (* Sensor 3 isolated: Compute mean of remaining validated channels 1 and 2 *)
    rVotedBathPressure_mbar := (rAtmospherePress_PT1_mbar + rAtmospherePress_PT2_mbar) * 0.5;
    dwDiagnosticFaultCode   := dwDiagnosticFaultCode OR 16#0000_0008;
ELSE
    (* Triple Disagreement / Sensor Failure: Take minimum reading for failsafe conservatism *)
    rVotedBathPressure_mbar := MIN(MIN(rAtmospherePress_PT1_mbar, rAtmospherePress_PT2_mbar), rAtmospherePress_PT3_mbar);
    dwDiagnosticFaultCode   := dwDiagnosticFaultCode OR 16#0000_0010;
END_IF;

(* Evaluate safety atmosphere seal threshold: Min 2.2 mbar *)
tDiscrepancyTimer_PT(IN := (rVotedBathPressure_mbar < 2.20), PT := T#2S);
IF tDiscrepancyTimer_PT.Q THEN
    dwDiagnosticFaultCode := dwDiagnosticFaultCode OR 16#0000_0020;
    bFloatLineReady       := FALSE;
ELSE
    dwDiagnosticFaultCode := dwDiagnosticFaultCode AND NOT 16#0000_0020;
END_IF;

(*
 ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  SECTION 3: LINEAR INDUCTION PUMP (LIP) TRAVELING WAVE FLUID DYNAMICS
  Generates traveling sinusoidal magnetic field to sweep molten tin dross away from ribbon edges.
 ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
*)
(* Stator 3-Phase Symmetrical Balance Calculation *)
rPhaseCurrentMean_A := (rLIP_StatorPhaseCurrent_U_A + rLIP_StatorPhaseCurrent_V_A + rLIP_StatorPhaseCurrent_W_A) / 3.0;
rMaxCurrentTemp     := MAX(MAX(rLIP_StatorPhaseCurrent_U_A, rLIP_StatorPhaseCurrent_V_A), rLIP_StatorPhaseCurrent_W_A);
rMinCurrentTemp     := MIN(MIN(rLIP_StatorPhaseCurrent_U_A, rLIP_StatorPhaseCurrent_V_A), rLIP_StatorPhaseCurrent_W_A);

IF rPhaseCurrentMean_A > 2.0 THEN
    rPhaseCurrentUnbalance_pct := ((rMaxCurrentTemp - rMinCurrentTemp) / rPhaseCurrentMean_A) * 100.0;
ELSE
    rPhaseCurrentUnbalance_pct := 0.0;
END_IF;

IF rPhaseCurrentUnbalance_pct > 12.0 THEN
    dwDiagnosticFaultCode := dwDiagnosticFaultCode OR 16#0000_0040;
ELSE
    dwDiagnosticFaultCode := dwDiagnosticFaultCode AND NOT 16#0000_0040;

tStatorThermalWatchdog(IN := (rLIP_StatorWindingTemp_degC > 160.0), PT := T#3S);

    dwDiagnosticFaultCode     := dwDiagnosticFaultCode OR 16#0000_0080;
    rLIP_CurrentSetpointCmd_A := 55.0; (* Derate current command to prevent stator burnout *)
ELSE
    dwDiagnosticFaultCode     := dwDiagnosticFaultCode AND NOT 16#0000_0080;
    (* Current demand scaled linearly with radar-measured dross bed accumulation *)
    rLIP_CurrentSetpointCmd_A := 95.0 + (rDrossCanalBedDepth_mm * 18.5);
    IF rLIP_CurrentSetpointCmd_A > 180.0 THEN
        rLIP_CurrentSetpointCmd_A := 180.0; (* Inverter saturation clamp *)
    END_IF;
END_IF;

IF rSyncWaveVelocity_m_s > 0.05 THEN
    rTinSlipFactor := (rSyncWaveVelocity_m_s - vecStateEstimate[3]) / rSyncWaveVelocity_m_s;
ELSE
    rTinSlipFactor := 1.0;
END_IF;

(* Compute physical molten tin surface velocity and dross removal mass flow rate *)
rTinSurfaceVelocity_m_s      := vecStateEstimate[3];
(* Mass flow = width * depth * density * velocity * packing factor (SnO2 rho ~ 6950 kg/m3) *)
rDrossMassDischargeRate_kg_h := vecStateEstimate[3] * 0.380 * (rDrossCanalBedDepth_mm * 0.001) * 6950.0 * 3600.0 * 0.15;

(*
 ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  SECTION 4: TOP-ROLL KNURLING KINEMATICS & VISCOELASTIC ATTENUATION
  Applies balancing forces to hot glass ribbon against natural equilibrium (6.85 mm).
 ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
*)
IF rEquilibriumGlassThick_mm > 0.1 THEN
    rAttenuationRatio := rTargetNominalThickness_mm / rEquilibriumGlassThick_mm;
ELSE
    rAttenuationRatio := 1.0;
END_IF;

(*
  Kinematic toe angle equation based on viscosity:
  Thin glass (<6.85 mm): Attenuation < 1.0 -> (1 - ratio) > 0 -> Positive toe-out angle (stretches ribbon)
  Thick glass (>6.85 mm): Attenuation > 1.0 -> (1 - ratio) < 0 -> Negative toe-in angle (dams ribbon)
*)
rKinematicNominalToe_deg := (1.0 - rAttenuationRatio) * 15.20 * (rGlassRibbonViscosity_LogP / 5.40);

(* Clamp nominal toe commands to physical gimbal mechanical hardstops *)
IF rKinematicNominalToe_deg > rToeLimitMax_deg THEN
    rKinematicNominalToe_deg := rToeLimitMax_deg;
ELSIF rKinematicNominalToe_deg < rToeLimitMin_deg THEN
    rKinematicNominalToe_deg := rToeLimitMin_deg;
END_IF;

(*
 ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  SECTION 5: DISCRETE-TIME STATE-SPACE OBSERVER & MPC PROFILE REGULATOR
  Cycle time Ts = 100 ms.
  State vector: x = [e_left (mm), e_right (mm), v_tin (m/s)]'
 ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

(* Measurement Pre-processing & Degradation Logic *)
IF bGaugeHealth_Left THEN
    dwDiagnosticFaultCode := dwDiagnosticFaultCode AND NOT 16#0000_0100;
ELSE
    dwDiagnosticFaultCode := dwDiagnosticFaultCode OR 16#0000_0100;
END_IF;

IF bGaugeHealth_Right THEN
    dwDiagnosticFaultCode := dwDiagnosticFaultCode AND NOT 16#0000_0200;
ELSE
    dwDiagnosticFaultCode := dwDiagnosticFaultCode OR 16#0000_0200;
END_IF;

IF bGaugeHealth_Left AND bGaugeHealth_Right THEN
    vecMeasurementResidual[1] := rThicknessSensor_Left_mm - rTargetNominalThickness_mm;
    vecMeasurementResidual[2] := rThicknessSensor_Right_mm - rTargetNominalThickness_mm;
    bDegradedControlMode      := FALSE;
    dwDiagnosticFaultCode     := dwDiagnosticFaultCode AND NOT 16#0000_0400;
ELSIF bGaugeHealth_Center THEN
    (* Fallback mode: Assume symmetrical distribution based on center sensor *)
    vecMeasurementResidual[1] := rThicknessSensor_Center_mm - rTargetNominalThickness_mm;
    vecMeasurementResidual[2] := rThicknessSensor_Center_mm - rTargetNominalThickness_mm;
    bDegradedControlMode      := TRUE;
    dwDiagnosticFaultCode     := dwDiagnosticFaultCode AND NOT 16#0000_0400;
ELSE
    (* Total optical loss: Lock innovations to zero *)
    vecMeasurementResidual[1] := vecStateEstimate[1];
    vecMeasurementResidual[2] := vecStateEstimate[2];
    bDegradedControlMode      := TRUE;
    dwDiagnosticFaultCode     := dwDiagnosticFaultCode OR 16#0000_0400;
END_IF;

(* Luenberger Observer Innovation Update: x_hat = x_hat + L * (y - C * x_hat) *)
vecStateEstimate[1] := vecStateEstimate[1] + (vecL[1] * (vecMeasurementResidual[1] - vecStateEstimate[1]));
vecStateEstimate[2] := vecStateEstimate[2] + (vecL[2] * (vecMeasurementResidual[2] - vecStateEstimate[2]));
vecStateEstimate[3] := vecStateEstimate[3] + (vecL[3] * 0.5 * ((vecMeasurementResidual[1] - vecStateEstimate[1]) + (vecMeasurementResidual[2] - vecStateEstimate[2])));

rProfileThicknessError_mm := (vecStateEstimate[1] + vecStateEstimate[2]) * 0.5;
rProfileAsymmetry_mm      := vecStateEstimate[1] - vecStateEstimate[2];

(* Diagnostics on tolerance exceedance *)
IF ABS(rProfileThicknessError_mm) > 0.85 THEN
    dwDiagnosticFaultCode := dwDiagnosticFaultCode OR 16#0000_1000;
ELSE
    dwDiagnosticFaultCode := dwDiagnosticFaultCode AND NOT 16#0000_1000;
END_IF;

IF ABS(rProfileAsymmetry_mm) > 0.50 THEN
    dwDiagnosticFaultCode := dwDiagnosticFaultCode OR 16#0000_2000;
ELSE
    dwDiagnosticFaultCode := dwDiagnosticFaultCode AND NOT 16#0000_2000;
END_IF;

(* MPC Analytical Unconstrained Quadratic Minimization *)
(* delta_toe_angle penalizes cross-directional thickness difference (wedge) *)
rRawDeltaToe := -(rCostWeight_Asymmetry * rProfileAsymmetry_mm) / (rCostWeight_AngleSlew + 65.0);

(* delta_speed penalizes mean thickness deviation *)
rRawDeltaSpeed := -(rCostWeight_Thickness * rProfileThicknessError_mm) / (rCostWeight_SpeedSlew + 45.0);

(* Apply Rate Slew Limiters to protect molten ribbon boundary from tearing *)
IF rRawDeltaToe > rMaxDeltaAngle_per_cycle THEN
    vecControlIncrement_MPC[1] := rMaxDeltaAngle_per_cycle;
ELSIF rRawDeltaToe < -rMaxDeltaAngle_per_cycle THEN

(* State-Space Time Update: x(k+1) = A * x(k) + B * u(k) *)
FOR idxRow := 1 TO 3 DO

vecStateEstimate[2] := vecPredictedState[2];

        rLIP_InverterFreqCmd_Hz := 20.0 + (rDrossCanalBedDepth_mm * 2.15);

        END_IF;
        
        (* Monitor for sensor degradation *)

        END_IF;

    50: (* STATE_50_DEGRADED_INSTRUMENTATION_HOLD: Failsafe Open-Loop Kinematic Hold *)
        bFloatLineReady        := TRUE;
        bFailsafeRetractActive := FALSE;

        rLeftRoll_ToeAngleCmd_deg  := rKinematicNominalToe_deg;
        rRightRoll_ToeAngleCmd_deg := -rKinematicNominalToe_deg;
        
        rLeftRoll_SurfaceSpeed_m_min  := rLehrDrawSpeed_m_min * rBaseRollOverdrawRatio;
        rRightRoll_SurfaceSpeed_m_min := rLehrDrawSpeed_m_min * rBaseRollOverdrawRatio;

        IF NOT bDegradedControlMode THEN
            iOperationState := 40; (* Return to active MPC closed-loop profiling *)
        END_IF;

    99: (* STATE_99_FAILSAFE_EMERGENCY_RETRACTION: High-Speed Retraction & Inert Gas Flood *)
        bFloatLineReady              := FALSE;
        bFailsafeRetractActive       := TRUE; (* Retract cylinders to prevent hot glass jamming *)
        rLIP_InverterFreqCmd_Hz      := 0.0;
        rLIP_CurrentSetpointCmd_A    := 0.0;
        rLeftRoll_ToeAngleCmd_deg    := 0.0;
        rRightRoll_ToeAngleCmd_deg   := 0.0;
        rLeftRoll_SurfaceSpeed_m_min := 0.0;
        rRightRoll_SurfaceSpeed_m_min:= 0.0;
        dwOperatingStatusWord        := 16#0000_0099;
        
        (* Reset transition allowed only when safety circuit is healthy and enable cycled *)
        IF bSafetyCircuitHealthy AND NOT bSupervisoryEnable THEN
            iOperationState := 0;
        END_IF;

END_CASE;

     Crown Radial Gradient:    Delta_T_rad = (q''_peak * r_o * ln(r_o / r_i)) / k_metal
     Circumferential Gradient: Delta_T_cir = (q''_peak * r_o) / (PI * k_metal) * (k_metal/(h_conv*r_i) + 1.0)
     Axial Thermal Stress:     sigma_ax_th = (E(T)*alpha(T)*Delta_T_rad)/(2*(1-nu)) + (E(T)*alpha(T)*Delta_T_cir)/4.0
     Hoop Thermal Stress:      sigma_hp_th = (E(T)*alpha(T)*Delta_T_rad)/(2*(1-nu))
     Mechanical Pressure Stress: sigma_hp_pr = P_salt * (r_o^2 + r_i^2) / (r_o^2 - r_i^2) * 0.1 [MPa]
     Equivalent von Mises:     sigma_vM = sqrt(0.5*((sigma_ax - sigma_hp)^2 + (sigma_hp - sigma_rad)^2 + (sigma_rad - sigma_ax)^2))

  3. 6TH-ORDER DISCRETE-TIME STATE-SPACE DYNAMICS (T_sample = 50 ms):
     State Vector: x = [Delta_T_out (deg C), Delta_T_crown (deg C), Delta_Q_rec (MW),
                        Delta_m_dot (kg/s), Delta_T_rad (deg C), Delta_epsilon (microstrain)]'
     Control Vector: u = [Delta_m_dot_cmd (kg/s), Delta_eta_flux (shading ratio [-0.5..+0.2])]'
     Observer Equation: x(k+1) = Ad * x(k) + Bd * u(k) + L * (y_meas - Cd * x(k))
     Output Equation:   y(k)   = Cd * x(k) + Dd * u(k)

  4. MODEL PREDICTIVE CONTROL (MPC) CONDENSED QUADRATIC COST OPTIMIZATION:
     min J(Delta_u) = 1/2 * Delta_u' * H_mpc * Delta_u + g_mpc' * Delta_u
     Subject to box constraints:  Delta_u_min <= Delta_u <= Delta_u_max
                                  u_min <= u(k-1) + Delta_u <= u_max
     Solved deterministically via Active-Set Projected Gradient in <= 4 iterations.

  5. TRIPLE MODULAR REDUNDANCY (2oo3 TMR) SENSOR VOTING ARCHITECTURE:
     Validates sensor triplets via pairwise tolerance delta checks:
     Degradation: Healthy 2oo3 -> Degraded 1oo2 (Channel Alert) -> Single 1oo1 -> SIL-3 Hard Trip.

  6. EMERGENCY CLOUD-COVER FAST DEFLECTION SYSTEM (EDS):
     Monitors spatial Direct Normal Irradiance rate of decline d(DNI)/dt:
     If d(DNI)/dt < -250.0 W/m2/s, the controller triggers fast heliostat aim-point deflection,
     steering collective beam centroids to celestial standby corridor above tower within 250 ms.

*)
