(* ========================================================================================= *)
(* SECTION 1: MASTER SIL-3 SAFETY PERMISSIVE INTERLOCKS & HARDWIRED E-STOP CIRCUIT          *)
(* ========================================================================================= *)
IF NOT bEmergencyStop THEN
    bReceiverTripped := TRUE;
    bSystemReady := FALSE;
    bFastDeflectionActive := TRUE;
    rTargetFluxDefocusRatio := 1.0;
    rAimPointShift_X := 0.0;
    rAimPointShift_Y := rStandbyApertureClearance_m;
    dwTripErrorCode := dwTripErrorCode OR cTRIP_ESTOP_ACTIVE;
    dwSystemStatusWord := dwSystemStatusWord OR 16#0000_0001; (* Bit 0: Hardware Trip Latched *)
    iState := 90; (* Forced immediate transition to Safety Latched Trip *)
END_IF;

(* Fault Reset Acknowledgment Edge Evaluation *)
IF bAcknowledgeFault AND bEmergencyStop AND (iState = 90) THEN
    (* Only clear latches if physical parameters have returned below trip thresholds *)
    IF (rVoted_SaltOutletTemp_Int < 575.0) AND (rVoted_TubeCrownTemp < 650.0) AND 
       (rCalculatedVonMisesStress < 195.0) AND NOT bFault_DNI_All AND NOT bFault_Flux_All AND 
       NOT bFault_TIn_All AND NOT bFault_TOut_All AND NOT bFault_TCrown_All AND NOT bFault_Flow_All THEN
        bReceiverTripped := FALSE;
        bFastDeflectionActive := FALSE;
        bFastDeflectLatched := FALSE;
        dwTripErrorCode := 16#0000_0000;
        iState := 0; (* Reset to Cold Standby *)
    END_IF;
END_IF;

(* ========================================================================================= *)
(* SECTION 2: 2oo3 TMR SENSOR VOTING LOGIC WITH PAIRWISE DIAGNOSTICS & GRACEFUL DEGRADATION  *)
(* IEC 61508 SIL-3 Architecture: Mid-value select for 3 channels; fallback to average 1oo2;  *)
(* fallback to single channel 1oo1 with alarm; fail-safe trip on complete loss of triplet.   *)
(* ========================================================================================= *)

(* --- 2.1 Direct Normal Irradiance (DNI) Voting [W/m2] --- *)
bDiscrepancy_DNI_A := (ABS(rDNI_Pyranometer_A - rDNI_Pyranometer_B) > rTol_DNI) AND (ABS(rDNI_Pyranometer_A - rDNI_Pyranometer_C) > rTol_DNI);
bDiscrepancy_DNI_B := (ABS(rDNI_Pyranometer_B - rDNI_Pyranometer_A) > rTol_DNI) AND (ABS(rDNI_Pyranometer_B - rDNI_Pyranometer_C) > rTol_DNI);
bDiscrepancy_DNI_C := (ABS(rDNI_Pyranometer_C - rDNI_Pyranometer_A) > rTol_DNI) AND (ABS(rDNI_Pyranometer_C - rDNI_Pyranometer_B) > rTol_DNI);

IF NOT bDiscrepancy_DNI_A AND NOT bDiscrepancy_DNI_B AND NOT bDiscrepancy_DNI_C THEN
    (* All 3 channels agree: Mid-Value Median Selection *)
    IF ((rDNI_Pyranometer_A >= rDNI_Pyranometer_B) AND (rDNI_Pyranometer_A <= rDNI_Pyranometer_C)) OR
       ((rDNI_Pyranometer_A <= rDNI_Pyranometer_B) AND (rDNI_Pyranometer_A >= rDNI_Pyranometer_C)) THEN
        rVoted_DNI := rDNI_Pyranometer_A;
    ELSIF ((rDNI_Pyranometer_B >= rDNI_Pyranometer_A) AND (rDNI_Pyranometer_B <= rDNI_Pyranometer_C)) OR
          ((rDNI_Pyranometer_B <= rDNI_Pyranometer_A) AND (rDNI_Pyranometer_B >= rDNI_Pyranometer_C)) THEN
        rVoted_DNI := rDNI_Pyranometer_B;
    ELSE
        rVoted_DNI := rDNI_Pyranometer_C;
    END_IF;
    bDegraded_DNI_1oo2 := FALSE;
    bFault_DNI_All := FALSE;
ELSIF bDiscrepancy_DNI_A AND NOT bDiscrepancy_DNI_B AND NOT bDiscrepancy_DNI_C THEN
    (* Channel A faulted: Degrade to 1oo2 Average of B and C *)
    rVoted_DNI := (rDNI_Pyranometer_B + rDNI_Pyranometer_C) * 0.5;
    bDegraded_DNI_1oo2 := TRUE;
    dwSensorDegradedWord := dwSensorDegradedWord OR 16#0000_0001;
ELSIF bDiscrepancy_DNI_B AND NOT bDiscrepancy_DNI_A AND NOT bDiscrepancy_DNI_C THEN
    (* Channel B faulted: Degrade to 1oo2 Average of A and C *)
    rVoted_DNI := (rDNI_Pyranometer_A + rDNI_Pyranometer_C) * 0.5;
    bDegraded_DNI_1oo2 := TRUE;
    dwSensorDegradedWord := dwSensorDegradedWord OR 16#0000_0002;
ELSIF bDiscrepancy_DNI_C AND NOT bDiscrepancy_DNI_A AND NOT bDiscrepancy_DNI_B THEN
    (* Channel C faulted: Degrade to 1oo2 Average of A and B *)
    rVoted_DNI := (rDNI_Pyranometer_A + rDNI_Pyranometer_B) * 0.5;
    bDegraded_DNI_1oo2 := TRUE;
    dwSensorDegradedWord := dwSensorDegradedWord OR 16#0000_0004;
ELSE
    (* Multiple Discrepancies: Complete Triplet Loss *)
    bFault_DNI_All := TRUE;
    dwTripErrorCode := dwTripErrorCode OR cTRIP_SENSOR_TOTAL_FAILURE;
    bReceiverTripped := TRUE;
END_IF;

(* --- 2.2 Peak Absorber Solar Heat Flux Radiometers [W/m2] --- *)
bDiscrepancy_Flux_A := (ABS(rPeakFlux_Radiometer_A - rPeakFlux_Radiometer_B) > rTol_PeakFlux) AND (ABS(rPeakFlux_Radiometer_A - rPeakFlux_Radiometer_C) > rTol_PeakFlux);
bDiscrepancy_Flux_B := (ABS(rPeakFlux_Radiometer_B - rPeakFlux_Radiometer_A) > rTol_PeakFlux) AND (ABS(rPeakFlux_Radiometer_B - rPeakFlux_Radiometer_C) > rTol_PeakFlux);
bDiscrepancy_Flux_C := (ABS(rPeakFlux_Radiometer_C - rPeakFlux_Radiometer_A) > rTol_PeakFlux) AND (ABS(rPeakFlux_Radiometer_C - rPeakFlux_Radiometer_B) > rTol_PeakFlux);

IF NOT bDiscrepancy_Flux_A AND NOT bDiscrepancy_Flux_B AND NOT bDiscrepancy_Flux_C THEN
    IF ((rPeakFlux_Radiometer_A >= rPeakFlux_Radiometer_B) AND (rPeakFlux_Radiometer_A <= rPeakFlux_Radiometer_C)) OR
       ((rPeakFlux_Radiometer_A <= rPeakFlux_Radiometer_B) AND (rPeakFlux_Radiometer_A >= rPeakFlux_Radiometer_C)) THEN
        rVoted_PeakFlux := rPeakFlux_Radiometer_A;
    ELSIF ((rPeakFlux_Radiometer_B >= rPeakFlux_Radiometer_A) AND (rPeakFlux_Radiometer_B <= rPeakFlux_Radiometer_C)) OR
          ((rPeakFlux_Radiometer_B <= rPeakFlux_Radiometer_A) AND (rPeakFlux_Radiometer_B >= rPeakFlux_Radiometer_C)) THEN
        rVoted_PeakFlux := rPeakFlux_Radiometer_B;
    ELSE
        rVoted_PeakFlux := rPeakFlux_Radiometer_C;
    END_IF;
    bDegraded_Flux_1oo2 := FALSE;
    bFault_Flux_All := FALSE;
ELSIF bDiscrepancy_Flux_A AND NOT bDiscrepancy_Flux_B AND NOT bDiscrepancy_Flux_C THEN
    rVoted_PeakFlux := (rPeakFlux_Radiometer_B + rPeakFlux_Radiometer_C) * 0.5;
    bDegraded_Flux_1oo2 := TRUE;

(* ========================================================================================= *)
(* SECTION 3: TERNARY NITRATE MOLTEN SALT THERMODYNAMICS & TRANSPORT PHENOMENA ENGINE       *)
(* Real-time thermodynamic equations evaluated over dynamic bulk temperature T_bulk         *)
(* ========================================================================================= *)
rSaltBulkMeanTemp := (rVoted_SaltInletTemp + rVoted_SaltOutletTemp_Int) * 0.5;

(* Salt Density: rho(T) = 2090.0 - 0.636 * T_bulk [kg/m3] *)
rSaltDensity := 2090.0 - (0.636 * rSaltBulkMeanTemp);
IF rSaltDensity < 1650.0 THEN rSaltDensity := 1650.0; END_IF;

(* Specific Heat Capacity: cp(T) = 1443.0 + 0.172 * T_bulk [J/(kg*K)] *)
rSaltHeatCapacity := 1443.0 + (0.172 * rSaltBulkMeanTemp);

(* Dynamic Viscosity: mu(T) = 0.022714 - 1.20e-4*T + 2.281e-7*T^2 - 1.474e-10*T^3 [Pa*s] *)
rSaltViscosity := 0.022714 - (0.000120 * rSaltBulkMeanTemp) + 
                  (2.281E-7 * rSaltBulkMeanTemp * rSaltBulkMeanTemp) - 
                  (1.474E-10 * rSaltBulkMeanTemp * rSaltBulkMeanTemp * rSaltBulkMeanTemp);
IF rSaltViscosity < 0.0010 THEN rSaltViscosity := 0.0010; END_IF;

(* Thermal Conductivity: k(T) = 0.443 + 1.90e-4 * T_bulk [W/(m*K)] *)
rSaltThermalCond := 0.443 + (0.000190 * rSaltBulkMeanTemp);

(* Prandtl Number: Pr = (cp * mu) / k [-] *)
rSaltPrandtl := (rSaltHeatCapacity * rSaltViscosity) / rSaltThermalCond;

(* Mean Superficial Salt Tube Velocity [m/s] *)
rSaltFlowVelocity := rVoted_SaltMassFlow / (rSaltDensity * rTotalFlowArea);
IF rSaltFlowVelocity < 0.05 THEN rSaltFlowVelocity := 0.05; END_IF;

(* Reynolds Number: Re = (rho * v * d_i) / mu [-] *)
rSaltReynolds := (rSaltDensity * rSaltFlowVelocity * rTubeInnerDia) / rSaltViscosity;

(* Darcy Pipe Friction Factor via Haaland / Filonenko Correlation for Re > 3000 *)
IF rSaltReynolds > 3000.0 THEN
    (* f = (0.790 * ln(Re) - 1.64)^(-2) *)
    rSaltDarcyFriction := 1.0 / ((0.790 * LN(rSaltReynolds) - 1.64) * (0.790 * LN(rSaltReynolds) - 1.64));
ELSE
    rSaltDarcyFriction := 64.0 / rSaltReynolds;
END_IF;

(* Convective Nusselt Number via Gnielinski Correlation: *)
(* Nu = (f/8)*(Re - 1000)*Pr / (1.0 + 12.7*sqrt(f/8)*(Pr^(2/3) - 1.0)) *)
IF rSaltReynolds > 2300.0 THEN
    rSaltNusselt := ((rSaltDarcyFriction / 8.0) * (rSaltReynolds - 1000.0) * rSaltPrandtl) /
                    (1.0 + 12.7 * SQRT(rSaltDarcyFriction / 8.0) * (EXPT(rSaltPrandtl, 0.6667) - 1.0));
ELSE
    rSaltNusselt := 4.36; (* Laminar constant heat flux asymptotic limit *)
END_IF;

(* Internal Tube Convective Heat Transfer Coefficient h [W/(m2*K)] *)
rSaltHeatTransferCoeff := rSaltNusselt * (rSaltThermalCond / rTubeInnerDia);

(* Cavity Absorbed Thermal Enthalpy Power: Q_rec = m_dot * cp * (Tout - Tin) * 1e-6 [MW] *)
rCavityAbsorbedPower_MW := (rVoted_SaltMassFlow * rSaltHeatCapacity * (rVoted_SaltOutletTemp_Int - rVoted_SaltInletTemp)) * 1.0E-6;
rActiveThermalPower_MW := rCavityAbsorbedPower_MW;

(* ========================================================================================= *)
(* SECTION 4: HAYNES 230 TUBE CROWN MULTI-AXIAL THERMAL STRESS & DYNAMIC STRAIN ENGINE       *)
(* Evaluates radial and circumferential thermal gradients, pressure stresses, and von Mises  *)
(* ========================================================================================= *)
(* Temperature-Dependent Haynes 230 Alloy Properties at Peak Tube Crown Temp *)
rHaynes_E := (211000.0 - (65.0 * rVoted_TubeCrownTemp));
rHaynes_Alpha := (1.27E-5 + (4.5E-9 * rVoted_TubeCrownTemp));
rHaynes_Sy := (310.0 - (0.185 * rVoted_TubeCrownTemp));
IF rHaynes_Sy < 120.0 THEN rHaynes_Sy := 120.0; END_IF;
rHaynes_k_metal := 21.5 + (0.0150 * rVoted_TubeCrownTemp);

(* Radial Crown Temperature Gradient Across 2.11mm Superalloy Wall: *)
(* Delta_T_rad = (q''_peak * r_o * ln(r_o / r_i)) / k_metal *)
rDeltaT_RadialCrown := (rVoted_PeakFlux * (rTubeOuterDia * 0.5) * LN(rTubeOuterDia / rTubeInnerDia)) / rHaynes_k_metal;

(* Circumferential Crown-to-Back Gradient: *)
(* Delta_T_cir = (q''_peak * r_o) / (PI * k_metal) * (k_metal / (h_conv * r_i) + 1.0) *)
rDeltaT_Circumferential := ((rVoted_PeakFlux * (rTubeOuterDia * 0.5)) / (3.14159 * rHaynes_k_metal)) * 
                           ((rHaynes_k_metal / (rSaltHeatTransferCoeff * (rTubeInnerDia * 0.5))) + 1.0);

(* Axial Thermal Restraint Stress: *)
(* sigma_ax_th = (E * alpha * Delta_T_rad) / (2 * (1 - nu)) + (E * alpha * Delta_T_cir) / 4.0 *)
rSigma_Th_Axial := ((rHaynes_E * rHaynes_Alpha * rDeltaT_RadialCrown) / (2.0 * (1.0 - rHaynes_Nu))) + 
                   ((rHaynes_E * rHaynes_Alpha * rDeltaT_Circumferential) / 4.0);

(* Circumferential Hoop Thermal Stress: *)
(* sigma_hp_th = (E * alpha * Delta_T_rad) / (2 * (1 - nu)) *)
rSigma_Th_Hoop := (rHaynes_E * rHaynes_Alpha * rDeltaT_RadialCrown) / (2.0 * (1.0 - rHaynes_Nu));

(* Lamé Thick-Walled Cylinder Internal Salt Pressure Hoop Stress: *)
(* sigma_hp_pr = P_salt * (r_o^2 + r_i^2) / (r_o^2 - r_i^2) * 0.1 [MPa] *)
rSigma_Pr_Hoop := (rVoted_SaltDischargePress * 
                  ((rTubeOuterDia * rTubeOuterDia) + (rTubeInnerDia * rTubeInnerDia)) / 
                  ((rTubeOuterDia * rTubeOuterDia) - (rTubeInnerDia * rTubeInnerDia))) * 0.1;

(* Superimposed Total Multi-Axial Normal Stresses [MPa] *)
rSigma_Axial_Total := rSigma_Th_Axial + (rSigma_Pr_Hoop * 0.5);
rSigma_Hoop_Total := rSigma_Th_Hoop + rSigma_Pr_Hoop;
rSigma_Radial_Inner := -(rVoted_SaltDischargePress * 0.1); (* Compressive fluid pressure at inner wall *)

(* Combined Equivalent von Mises Stress: *)
(* sigma_vM = sqrt(0.5 * ((s_ax - s_hp)^2 + (s_hp - s_rad)^2 + (s_rad - s_ax)^2)) *)
rCalculatedVonMisesStress := SQRT(0.5 * (
    ((rSigma_Axial_Total - rSigma_Hoop_Total) * (rSigma_Axial_Total - rSigma_Hoop_Total)) +
    ((rSigma_Hoop_Total - rSigma_Radial_Inner) * (rSigma_Hoop_Total - rSigma_Radial_Inner)) +
    ((rSigma_Radial_Inner - rSigma_Axial_Total) * (rSigma_Radial_Inner - rSigma_Axial_Total))
));
rPeakTubeWallVonMisesStress := rCalculatedVonMisesStress;
rStressYieldRatio := rCalculatedVonMisesStress / rHaynes_Sy;

(* ========================================================================================= *)
(* SECTION 5: 6TH-ORDER DISCRETE STATE-SPACE MODEL (Ad, Bd, Cd, Dd) & KALMAN OBSERVER        *)
(* Discretized state estimation and 1-step prediction at Ts = 50ms                          *)
(* ========================================================================================= *)
(* 1-Step Ahead State Prediction: x_pred = Ad * x + Bd * u *)
x1_Pred := (Ad_11 * x1_SaltTempDev) + (Ad_12 * x2_CrownTempDev) + (Ad_13 * x3_ThermalPwrDev) + 
           (Ad_14 * x4_FlowDev) + (Ad_15 * x5_RadialGradDev) + (Ad_16 * x6_StrainDev) + 
           (Bd_11 * u1_FlowCmd_Prev) + (Bd_12 * u2_DefocusCmd_Prev);

x2_Pred := (Ad_21 * x1_SaltTempDev) + (Ad_22 * x2_CrownTempDev) + (Ad_23 * x3_ThermalPwrDev) + 
           (Ad_24 * x4_FlowDev) + (Ad_25 * x5_RadialGradDev) + (Ad_26 * x6_StrainDev) + 
           (Bd_21 * u1_FlowCmd_Prev) + (Bd_22 * u2_DefocusCmd_Prev);

x3_Pred := (Ad_31 * x1_SaltTempDev) + (Ad_32 * x2_CrownTempDev) + (Ad_33 * x3_ThermalPwrDev) + 
           (Ad_34 * x4_FlowDev) + (Ad_35 * x5_RadialGradDev) + (Ad_36 * x6_StrainDev) + 
           (Bd_31 * u1_FlowCmd_Prev) + (Bd_32 * u2_DefocusCmd_Prev);

x4_Pred := (Ad_41 * x1_SaltTempDev) + (Ad_42 * x2_CrownTempDev) + (Ad_43 * x3_ThermalPwrDev) + 
           (Ad_44 * x4_FlowDev) + (Ad_45 * x5_RadialGradDev) + (Ad_46 * x6_StrainDev) + 
           (Bd_41 * u1_FlowCmd_Prev) + (Bd_42 * u2_DefocusCmd_Prev);

x5_Pred := (Ad_51 * x1_SaltTempDev) + (Ad_52 * x2_CrownTempDev) + (Ad_53 * x3_ThermalPwrDev) + 
           (Ad_54 * x4_FlowDev) + (Ad_55 * x5_RadialGradDev) + (Ad_56 * x6_StrainDev) + 
           (Bd_51 * u1_FlowCmd_Prev) + (Bd_52 * u2_DefocusCmd_Prev);

x6_Pred := (Ad_61 * x1_SaltTempDev) + (Ad_62 * x2_CrownTempDev) + (Ad_63 * x3_ThermalPwrDev) + 
           (Ad_64 * x4_FlowDev) + (Ad_65 * x5_RadialGradDev) + (Ad_66 * x6_StrainDev) + 
           (Bd_61 * u1_FlowCmd_Prev) + (Bd_62 * u2_DefocusCmd_Prev);

(* Measurement Innovations / Residuals: e = y_meas - (Cd * x_pred + Dd * u) *)
e1_Resid := (rVoted_SaltOutletTemp_Int - rSetPoint_SaltTemp) - 
            ((Cd_11 * x1_Pred) + (Cd_12 * x2_Pred) + (Cd_13 * x3_Pred) + (Cd_14 * x4_Pred) + (Cd_15 * x5_Pred) + (Cd_16 * x6_Pred));

e2_Resid := (rVoted_TubeCrownTemp - 610.0) - 
            ((Cd_21 * x1_Pred) + (Cd_22 * x2_Pred) + (Cd_23 * x3_Pred) + (Cd_24 * x4_Pred) + (Cd_25 * x5_Pred) + (Cd_26 * x6_Pred));

e3_Resid := (rCalculatedVonMisesStress - 120.0) - 
            ((Cd_31 * x1_Pred) + (Cd_32 * x2_Pred) + (Cd_33 * x3_Pred) + (Cd_34 * x4_Pred) + (Cd_35 * x5_Pred) + (Cd_36 * x6_Pred));

e4_Resid := (rCavityAbsorbedPower_MW - 600.0) - 
            ((Cd_41 * x1_Pred) + (Cd_42 * x2_Pred) + (Cd_43 * x3_Pred) + (Cd_44 * x4_Pred) + (Cd_45 * x5_Pred) + (Cd_46 * x6_Pred));

(* Observer State Correction Update: x = x_pred + L * e *)
x1_SaltTempDev   := x1_Pred + (L_11 * e1_Resid) + (L_12 * e2_Resid) + (L_13 * e3_Resid) + (L_14 * e4_Resid);
x2_CrownTempDev  := x2_Pred + (L_21 * e1_Resid) + (L_22 * e2_Resid) + (L_23 * e3_Resid) + (L_24 * e4_Resid);
x3_ThermalPwrDev := x3_Pred + (L_31 * e1_Resid) + (L_32 * e2_Resid) + (L_33 * e3_Resid) + (L_34 * e4_Resid);
x4_FlowDev       := x4_Pred + (L_41 * e1_Resid) + (L_42 * e2_Resid) + (L_43 * e3_Resid) + (L_44 * e4_Resid);
x5_RadialGradDev := x5_Pred + (L_51 * e1_Resid) + (L_52 * e2_Resid) + (L_53 * e3_Resid) + (L_54 * e4_Resid);
x6_StrainDev     := x6_Pred + (L_61 * e1_Resid) + (L_62 * e2_Resid) + (L_63 * e3_Resid) + (L_64 * e4_Resid);

(* ========================================================================================= *)
(* SECTION 6: MODEL PREDICTIVE CONTROL (MPC) CONDENSED REAL-TIME QP OPTIMIZATION SOLVER      *)
(* Solves min J(du) = 0.5*du'*H*du + g'*du subject to actuator rate and amplitude bounds     *)
(* ========================================================================================= *)
(* Condensed 2x2 Hessian Matrix Evaluation *)
H_11 := 2.0 * ((Bd_11 * Bd_11 * q1_Weight_SaltTemp) + (Bd_41 * Bd_41 * q4_Weight_Flow)) + r1_Weight_FlowCmd + s1_Weight_FlowRate;
H_12 := 2.0 * ((Bd_11 * Bd_12 * q1_Weight_SaltTemp) + (Bd_21 * Bd_22 * q2_Weight_CrownTemp));
H_21 := H_12;
H_22 := 2.0 * ((Bd_22 * Bd_22 * q2_Weight_CrownTemp) + (Bd_32 * Bd_32 * q3_Weight_ThermalPwr) + (Bd_62 * Bd_62 * q6_Weight_Strain)) + r2_Weight_DefocusCmd + s2_Weight_DefocusRate;

(* Determinant of Positive-Definite Hessian *)
rDet_H := (H_11 * H_22) - (H_12 * H_21);
IF rDet_H < 1.0E-6 THEN rDet_H := 1.0E-6; END_IF;

(* Linear Gradient Vector g (2x1) Accounting for Tracking Errors and Rate Penalties *)
g_1 := 2.0 * ((Bd_11 * q1_Weight_SaltTemp * x1_SaltTempDev) + (Bd_41 * q4_Weight_Flow * x4_FlowDev)) - (s1_Weight_FlowRate * u1_FlowCmd_Prev);
g_2 := 2.0 * ((Bd_22 * q2_Weight_CrownTemp * x2_CrownTempDev) + (Bd_32 * q3_Weight_ThermalPwr * x3_ThermalPwrDev) + (Bd_62 * q6_Weight_Strain * x6_StrainDev)) - (s2_Weight_DefocusRate * u2_DefocusCmd_Prev);

(* Unconstrained Analytical Global Minimum: du_unc = -H^(-1) * g *)
du1_unc := ((-g_1 * H_22) + (g_2 * H_12)) / rDet_H;
du2_unc := ((-g_2 * H_11) + (g_1 * H_21)) / rDet_H;

(* Slew-Rate Box Constraints: Max Delta per 50ms scan *)
IF du1_unc > (rMaxFlowSlewRate_kg_s2 * rCycleTime_s) THEN
    du1_opt := rMaxFlowSlewRate_kg_s2 * rCycleTime_s;
ELSIF du1_unc < -(rMaxFlowSlewRate_kg_s2 * rCycleTime_s) THEN
    du1_opt := -(rMaxFlowSlewRate_kg_s2 * rCycleTime_s);
ELSE
    du1_opt := du1_unc;
END_IF;

IF du2_unc > (rMaxDefocusSlewRate_1_s * rCycleTime_s) THEN
    du2_opt := rMaxDefocusSlewRate_1_s * rCycleTime_s;
ELSIF du2_unc < -(rMaxDefocusSlewRate_1_s * rCycleTime_s) THEN
    du2_opt := -(rMaxDefocusSlewRate_1_s * rCycleTime_s);
ELSE
    du2_opt := du2_unc;
END_IF;

(* Projected Gradient Conditional Adjustment if du1 Hit Constraint *)
IF du1_opt <> du1_unc THEN
    du2_opt := (-g_2 - (H_12 * du1_opt)) / H_22;
    IF du2_opt > (rMaxDefocusSlewRate_1_s * rCycleTime_s) THEN
        du2_opt := rMaxDefocusSlewRate_1_s * rCycleTime_s;
    ELSIF du2_opt < -(rMaxDefocusSlewRate_1_s * rCycleTime_s) THEN
        du2_opt := -(rMaxDefocusSlewRate_1_s * rCycleTime_s);
    END_IF;
END_IF;

(* Integrated Total Actuator Control Move Commands *)
u1_FlowCmd_Prev := u1_FlowCmd_Prev + du1_opt;
u2_DefocusCmd_Prev := u2_DefocusCmd_Prev + du2_opt;

(* Bound Global Control Amplitudes *)
IF (rNominalFlow_kg_s + u1_FlowCmd_Prev) > rMaxPermissibleFlow_kg_s THEN
    u1_FlowCmd_Prev := rMaxPermissibleFlow_kg_s - rNominalFlow_kg_s;
ELSIF (rNominalFlow_kg_s + u1_FlowCmd_Prev) < rMinPermissibleFlow_kg_s THEN
    u1_FlowCmd_Prev := rMinPermissibleFlow_kg_s - rNominalFlow_kg_s;
END_IF;

IF u2_DefocusCmd_Prev > 0.65 THEN
    u2_DefocusCmd_Prev := 0.65;
ELSIF u2_DefocusCmd_Prev < 0.0 THEN
    u2_DefocusCmd_Prev := 0.0;
END_IF;

(* Master Continuous Output Actuator Demands *)
IF (iState = 40) OR (iState = 50) THEN
    rSaltPumpFlowDemand := rNominalFlow_kg_s + u1_FlowCmd_Prev;
    rTargetFluxDefocusRatio := u2_DefocusCmd_Prev;
END_IF;

(* ========================================================================================= *)
(* SECTION 7: EMERGENCY CLOUD-COVER TRANSIENT DETECTION & FAST DEFLECTION (EDS) SYSTEM       *)
(* Executes sub-250ms emergency aim-point divert upon severe cloud-edge DNI rate of collapse *)
(* ========================================================================================= *)
rDNI_RateOfChange := (rVoted_DNI - rPreviousDNI) / rCycleTime_s;
rPreviousDNI := rVoted_DNI;

(* Cloud Edge Transient Detection Trigger *)
bCloudTransientDetected := (rDNI_RateOfChange < rFastDeflectRateThreshold) OR bCloudShadowAnticipationTrigger;

IF bCloudTransientDetected AND NOT bFastDeflectLatched AND ((iState = 40) OR (iState = 50)) THEN
    bFastDeflectLatched := TRUE;
    bFastDeflectionActive := TRUE;
    iState := 60; (* Immediate Jump to Fast Aim-Point Deflection State *)
    dwWarningCode := dwWarningCode OR cWARN_DNI_RAPID_DROP;
END_IF;

(* Fast Deflection Trajectory Generator *)
IF bFastDeflectionActive THEN
    (* Rapidly displace optical centroid vertically above cavity aperture into celestial standby *)
    rAimPointShift_X := 0.0;
    rAimPointShift_Y := rStandbyApertureClearance_m;
    rTargetFluxDefocusRatio := 1.0; (* 100% Beam Shedding Defocus *)
    
    (* Controlled downward salt flow ramp to match residual cavity thermal decay and avoid quenching *)
    IF rSaltPumpFlowDemand > 350.0 THEN
        rSaltPumpFlowDemand := rSaltPumpFlowDemand - (120.0 * rCycleTime_s);
    ELSE
        rSaltPumpFlowDemand := 350.0;
    END_IF;
ELSE
    rAimPointShift_X := 0.0;
    rAimPointShift_Y := 0.0;
END_IF;

(* ========================================================================================= *)
(* SECTION 8: MULTI-HELIOSTAT FIELD DYNAMIC AIM-POINT SHADING & MULTI-PANEL SMOOTHING        *)
(* Coordinates 4 quadrant sectors and 16 serpentine absorber panels to limit peak local flux *)
(* ========================================================================================= *)
(* Sector Attenuation Allocations *)
rSector_NE_Defocus := rTargetFluxDefocusRatio * 1.05;
rSector_NW_Defocus := rTargetFluxDefocusRatio * 1.02;
rSector_SE_Defocus := rTargetFluxDefocusRatio * 0.96;
rSector_SW_Defocus := rTargetFluxDefocusRatio * 0.97;

IF rSector_NE_Defocus > 1.0 THEN rSector_NE_Defocus := 1.0; END_IF;
IF rSector_NW_Defocus > 1.0 THEN rSector_NW_Defocus := 1.0; END_IF;
IF rSector_SE_Defocus > 1.0 THEN rSector_SE_Defocus := 1.0; END_IF;
IF rSector_SW_Defocus > 1.0 THEN rSector_SW_Defocus := 1.0; END_IF;

(* Spatial Gaussian Flux Smoothing Across 16 Serpentine Panels: *)
(* Simulates multi-point aiming spreading across cavity width *)
rPanelPeakFlux_1  := rActivePeakFlux * (1.0 - rSector_NW_Defocus) * 0.52;
rPanelPeakFlux_2  := rActivePeakFlux * (1.0 - rSector_NW_Defocus) * 0.68;
rPanelPeakFlux_3  := rActivePeakFlux * (1.0 - rSector_NW_Defocus) * 0.81;
rPanelPeakFlux_4  := rActivePeakFlux * (1.0 - rSector_NW_Defocus) * 0.91;
rPanelPeakFlux_5  := rActivePeakFlux * (1.0 - rTargetFluxDefocusRatio) * 0.96;
rPanelPeakFlux_6  := rActivePeakFlux * (1.0 - rTargetFluxDefocusRatio) * 0.99;
rPanelPeakFlux_7  := rActivePeakFlux * (1.0 - rTargetFluxDefocusRatio) * 1.00;
rPanelPeakFlux_8  := rActivePeakFlux * (1.0 - rTargetFluxDefocusRatio) * 0.98;
rPanelPeakFlux_9  := rActivePeakFlux * (1.0 - rTargetFluxDefocusRatio) * 0.98;
rPanelPeakFlux_10 := rActivePeakFlux * (1.0 - rTargetFluxDefocusRatio) * 1.00;
rPanelPeakFlux_11 := rActivePeakFlux * (1.0 - rTargetFluxDefocusRatio) * 0.99;
rPanelPeakFlux_12 := rActivePeakFlux * (1.0 - rTargetFluxDefocusRatio) * 0.95;
rPanelPeakFlux_13 := rActivePeakFlux * (1.0 - rSector_NE_Defocus) * 0.90;
rPanelPeakFlux_14 := rActivePeakFlux * (1.0 - rSector_NE_Defocus) * 0.79;
rPanelPeakFlux_15 := rActivePeakFlux * (1.0 - rSector_NE_Defocus) * 0.65;
rPanelPeakFlux_16 := rActivePeakFlux * (1.0 - rSector_NE_Defocus) * 0.49;

(* Automatic Dynamic Flux Shading Engagement When Thresholds Approached *)
IF (rActivePeakFlux > 1050000.0) OR (rVoted_TubeStrain > 1800.0) OR (rCalculatedVonMisesStress > 165.0) THEN
    bFluxShadingEngaged := TRUE;
    rPeakShavingTrimFactor := 0.88;
    IF iState = 40 THEN
        iState := 50; (* Transition from Normal Baseload to Dynamic Shading *)
    END_IF;
ELSE
    bFluxShadingEngaged := FALSE;
    rPeakShavingTrimFactor := 1.00;
END_IF;

(* ========================================================================================= *)
(* SECTION 9: CUMULATIVE HIGH-TEMPERATURE CREEP-FATIGUE LIFE CONSUMPTION ACCUMULATOR         *)
(* Norton-Bailey secondary creep integration and Rainflow strain reversal cycle tracker      *)
(* ========================================================================================= *)
(* High-Temperature Creep Rate: edot_cr = A * sigma^n * exp(-Q/(R*T_kelvin)) [1/h] *)
rInstantaneousCreepRate_1_hr := rNorton_A * EXPT(rCalculatedVonMisesStress, rNorton_n) * 
                               EXP(-rNorton_Q_R / (rVoted_TubeCrownTemp + 273.15));

(* Approximate Larson-Miller Time-to-Rupture [h] *)
IF rCalculatedVonMisesStress > 50.0 THEN
    rTimeToRupture_Hours := EXPT(10.0, (28.5 - 7.5 * (LN(rCalculatedVonMisesStress)/2.302585))) * 
                            (1000.0 / (rVoted_TubeCrownTemp + 273.15));
    IF rTimeToRupture_Hours < 1.0 THEN rTimeToRupture_Hours := 1.0; END_IF;
ELSE
    rTimeToRupture_Hours := 1.0E7;
END_IF;

(* Incremental Creep Damage Fraction Consumed in 50ms Scan Cycle: Delta_D = Delta_t / t_rup *)
rDeltaCreepDamageCycle := (rCycleTime_s / 3600.0) / rTimeToRupture_Hours;
rCumulativeCreepDamage := rCumulativeCreepDamage + rDeltaCreepDamageCycle;

(* Low-Cycle Thermal Fatigue Reversal Counting (Rainflow Half-Cycle Approximation) *)
rDeltaStrainReversal := ABS(rVoted_TubeStrain - rPreviousMicrostrain);
IF rDeltaStrainReversal > 150.0 THEN
    (* Significant thermal strain excursion: Coffin-Manson low-cycle fatigue damage increment *)
    rCyclesToFailure_Nf := 1.5E9 * EXPT(rDeltaStrainReversal, -2.25);
    IF rCyclesToFailure_Nf < 1000.0 THEN rCyclesToFailure_Nf := 1000.0; END_IF;
    rCumulativeFatigueDamage := rCumulativeFatigueDamage + (0.5 / rCyclesToFailure_Nf);
    rPreviousMicrostrain := rVoted_TubeStrain;
END_IF;

(* Cumulative Miner's Rule Linear Damage Sum *)
rTotalCombinedDamageFraction := rCumulativeCreepDamage + rCumulativeFatigueDamage;
rCreepFatigueAccumulation := rTotalCombinedDamageFraction;

(* ========================================================================================= *)
(* SECTION 10: MULTI-STAGE SUPERVISORY FINITE STATE MACHINE (CASE iState OF ... END_CASE)    *)
(* Deterministic cyber-physical execution of receiver startup, MPC control, and trips        *)
(* ========================================================================================= *)
tStateTimer(IN := (iState = iPreviousState), PT := T#24H);
iPreviousState := iState;

CASE iState OF
    0: (* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
       (* STATE 0: COLD DRAINED STANDBY                                                      *)
       (* Receiver cavity cold, trace heating off, salt in subterranean storage sump.        *)
       (* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
        bSystemReady := FALSE;
        bReceiverTripped := FALSE;
        bFastDeflectionActive := FALSE;
        bEmergencyDrainOpen := FALSE;
        bTraceHeatingPermissive := FALSE;
        rSaltPumpFlowDemand := 0.0;
        rTargetFluxDefocusRatio := 1.0;
        rAimPointShift_X := 0.0;
        rAimPointShift_Y := rStandbyApertureClearance_m;

        IF bEnableSystem AND bEmergencyStop AND (dwTripErrorCode = 16#0000_0000) THEN
            iState := 10; (* Advance to Trace Heating & Priming *)
        END_IF;

    10: (* --------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
        (* STATE 10: TRACE HEATING & RECEIVER TUBE PRIMING                                   *)
        (* Electrical trace heating raises dry receiver tubes above 290 deg C before fill.   *)
        (* --------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
        bSystemReady := FALSE;
        bTraceHeatingPermissive := TRUE;
        bEmergencyDrainOpen := FALSE;
        rTargetFluxDefocusRatio := 1.0;
        rAimPointShift_Y := rStandbyApertureClearance_m;
        rSaltPumpFlowDemand := 0.0;

        tIsothermalCircTimer(IN := (rVoted_TubeCrownTemp >= 290.0) AND (rCavityAirTemp >= 260.0), PT := T#120S);
        IF tIsothermalCircTimer.Q THEN
            tIsothermalCircTimer(IN := FALSE);
            iState := 20; (* Tubes thoroughly soaked; advance to salt fill and isothermal flow *)
        END_IF;

        IF NOT bEnableSystem THEN
            iState := 0;
        END_IF;

    20: (* --------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
        (* STATE 20: ISOTHERMAL COLD SALT CIRCULATION                                        *)
        (* Circulate 290 deg C salt through receiver at minimum flow without solar flux.     *)
        (* --------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
        bSystemReady := FALSE;
        bTraceHeatingPermissive := TRUE;
        rSaltPumpFlowDemand := 320.0; (* Minimum priming circulation rate [kg/s] *)
        rTargetFluxDefocusRatio := 1.0;
        rAimPointShift_Y := rStandbyApertureClearance_m;

        IF (rVoted_SaltMassFlow > 300.0) AND (rVoted_SaltInletTemp > 280.0) AND (rVoted_SaltOutletTemp_Int > 280.0) THEN
            bSystemReady := TRUE;
            IF rVoted_DNI > 400.0 THEN
                iState := 30; (* Adequate DNI; advance to modulated solar illumination *)
            END_IF;
        END_IF;

        IF NOT bEnableSystem THEN
            iState := 0;
        END_IF;

    30: (* --------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
        (* STATE 30: CALIBRATED FLUX RAMP-UP & THERMAL EXPANSION SOAK                        *)
        (* Incrementally guide heliostat aim points onto cavity; ramp salt flow.              *)
        (* --------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
        bSystemReady := TRUE;
        bTraceHeatingPermissive := FALSE;
        tStartupRampTimer(IN := TRUE, PT := T#300S);

        (* Smoothly lower aim-point elevation offset and decrease defocus ratio *)
        rAimPointShift_Y := rStandbyApertureClearance_m * (1.0 - (TIME_TO_REAL(tStartupRampTimer.ET) / 300000.0));
        IF rAimPointShift_Y < 0.0 THEN rAimPointShift_Y := 0.0; END_IF;

        rTargetFluxDefocusRatio := 1.0 - (0.85 * (TIME_TO_REAL(tStartupRampTimer.ET) / 300000.0));
        rSaltPumpFlowDemand := 320.0 + (650.0 * (TIME_TO_REAL(tStartupRampTimer.ET) / 300000.0));

        IF tStartupRampTimer.Q OR (rVoted_SaltOutletTemp_Int >= 550.0) THEN
            tStartupRampTimer(IN := FALSE);
            iState := 40; (* Advance to Baseload 565 deg C Closed-Loop MPC Regulation *)
        END_IF;

        IF NOT bEnableSystem THEN
            iState := 70; (* Orderly controlled cooldown *)
        END_IF;

    40: (* --------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
        (* STATE 40: BASELOAD 565 DEG C HIGH-ENTHALPY MPC GENERATION                         *)
        (* Full closed-loop multivariable Model Predictive Control active.                   *)
        (* --------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
        bSystemReady := TRUE;
        bFastDeflectionActive := FALSE;
        bEmergencyDrainOpen := FALSE;
        bTraceHeatingPermissive := FALSE;

        (* Check for peak stress / flux conditions that require dynamic shading *)
        IF (rActivePeakFlux > 1050000.0) OR (rCalculatedVonMisesStress > 165.0) THEN
            iState := 50; (* Transition to Dynamic Shading State *)
        END_IF;

        IF NOT bEnableSystem THEN
            iState := 70; (* Controlled shutdown *)
        END_IF;

    50: (* --------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
        (* STATE 50: TRANSIENT DYNAMIC FLUX SHADING & THERMAL STRESS SUPPRESSION             *)
        (* Actively modulates multi-heliostat focus dispersion to preserve tube crown life.  *)
        (* --------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
        bSystemReady := TRUE;
        bFluxShadingEngaged := TRUE;

(* ============================================================================================= *)
(*                                    MAIN EXECUTION LOGIC                                       *)
(* ============================================================================================= *)

(* ============================================================================================= *)
(* SECTION 1: HARDWIRED SAFETY INTERLOCK VERIFICATION & SIL-3 EMERGENCY TRIP                     *)
(* ============================================================================================= *)
IF NOT bEmergencyTrip THEN
    bEmergencyTripActive := TRUE;
    bTrip_Hardwire_Latched := TRUE;
    iStateStep := 90; (* Jump directly to STATE_EMERGENCY_ISOLATION_BLOWDOWN *)
END_IF;

(* Operator Diagnostic Reset & Latch Clear Handler *)
IF bAcknowledgeFaults THEN
    IF bEmergencyTrip THEN bTrip_Hardwire_Latched := FALSE; END_IF;
    IF rH2_Concentration_EngineBay_Pct < 15.0 THEN bTrip_H2Leak_Latched := FALSE; END_IF;
    IF (rV_DCBus_Voted_V >= 1300.0) AND (rV_DCBus_Voted_V <= 1750.0) THEN
        bTrip_DCBusOvervoltage_Lat := FALSE;
        bTrip_DCBusUndervoltage_Lat := FALSE;
    END_IF;
    IF (rV_MinCell_V_1 > 0.58) AND (rV_MinCell_V_2 > 0.58) AND
       (rV_MinCell_V_3 > 0.58) AND (rV_MinCell_V_4 > 0.58) THEN
        bTrip_StackCellReversal_Lat := FALSE;
    END_IF;
    IF rBESS_MaxCellTemp_DegC < 50.0 THEN bTrip_BESSOvertemp_Lat := FALSE; END_IF;
    IF ABS(rBESS_Current_A) < 1600.0 THEN bTrip_BESSOvercurrent_Lat := FALSE; END_IF;
    IF rH2_Concentration_Exhaust_Pct < 0.80 THEN bTrip_ExhaustH2Flamb_Lat := FALSE; END_IF;
    IF (bHealth_V_ChA OR bHealth_V_ChB OR bHealth_V_ChC) AND
       (bHealth_P_ChA OR bHealth_P_ChB OR bHealth_P_ChC) AND
       (bHealth_Speed_ChA OR bHealth_Speed_ChB OR bHealth_Speed_ChC) THEN
        bTrip_SensorLoss_Lat := FALSE;
    END_IF;
    IF (rT_CoolantOut_DegC_1 < 80.0) AND (rT_CoolantOut_DegC_2 < 80.0) AND
       (rT_CoolantOut_DegC_3 < 80.0) AND (rT_CoolantOut_DegC_4 < 80.0) THEN
        bTrip_CoolantOverheat_Lat := FALSE;
    END_IF;

    IF (wTripAlarmBitmask = 16#0000) AND (iStateStep = 99) THEN
        iStateStep := 0; (* Reset from lockout to idle *)
    END_IF;
END_IF;

(* ============================================================================================= *)
(* SECTION 2: 2-OUT-OF-3 (2oo3) TRIPLE MODULAR REDUNDANCY VOTING ENGINE                         *)
(* ============================================================================================= *)
(* 2.1: High-Voltage DC Link Bus Voltage 2oo3 Voting *)
IF bHealth_V_ChA AND bHealth_V_ChB AND bHealth_V_ChC THEN
    IF (rV_DCBus_ChA >= rV_DCBus_ChB) THEN
        IF (rV_DCBus_ChB >= rV_DCBus_ChC) THEN
            rV_DCBus_Voted_V := rV_DCBus_ChB;
        ELSIF (rV_DCBus_ChA >= rV_DCBus_ChC) THEN
            rV_DCBus_Voted_V := rV_DCBus_ChC;
        ELSE
            rV_DCBus_Voted_V := rV_DCBus_ChA;
        END_IF;
    ELSE
        IF (rV_DCBus_ChA >= rV_DCBus_ChC) THEN
            rV_DCBus_Voted_V := rV_DCBus_ChA;
        ELSIF (rV_DCBus_ChB >= rV_DCBus_ChC) THEN
            rV_DCBus_Voted_V := rV_DCBus_ChC;
        ELSE
            rV_DCBus_Voted_V := rV_DCBus_ChB;
        END_IF;
    END_IF;

    IF (ABS(rV_DCBus_ChA - rV_DCBus_ChB) > rTOL_V_DCBus_V) OR
       (ABS(rV_DCBus_ChB - rV_DCBus_ChC) > rTOL_V_DCBus_V) OR
       (ABS(rV_DCBus_ChA - rV_DCBus_ChC) > rTOL_V_DCBus_V) THEN
        rTimer_V_Discrepancy := rTimer_V_Discrepancy + tScanDeltaTime_Sec;
        IF rTimer_V_Discrepancy >= rMAX_DISCREPANCY_TIME_Sec THEN
            IF ABS(rV_DCBus_ChA - rV_DCBus_Voted_V) > rTOL_V_DCBus_V THEN
                bHealth_V_ChA := FALSE;
            ELSIF ABS(rV_DCBus_ChB - rV_DCBus_Voted_V) > rTOL_V_DCBus_V THEN
                bHealth_V_ChB := FALSE;
            ELSE
                bHealth_V_ChC := FALSE;
            END_IF;
        END_IF;
    ELSE
        rTimer_V_Discrepancy := 0.0;
    END_IF;
ELSIF (bHealth_V_ChA AND bHealth_V_ChB) THEN
    rV_DCBus_Voted_V := 0.5 * (rV_DCBus_ChA + rV_DCBus_ChB);
    bDegradedSensorMode := TRUE;
ELSIF (bHealth_V_ChA AND bHealth_V_ChC) THEN
    rV_DCBus_Voted_V := 0.5 * (rV_DCBus_ChA + rV_DCBus_ChC);
    bDegradedSensorMode := TRUE;
ELSIF (bHealth_V_ChB AND bHealth_V_ChC) THEN
    rV_DCBus_Voted_V := 0.5 * (rV_DCBus_ChB + rV_DCBus_ChC);
    bDegradedSensorMode := TRUE;
ELSE
    IF bHealth_V_ChA THEN
        rV_DCBus_Voted_V := rV_DCBus_ChA;
    ELSIF bHealth_V_ChB THEN
        rV_DCBus_Voted_V := rV_DCBus_ChB;
    ELSIF bHealth_V_ChC THEN
        rV_DCBus_Voted_V := rV_DCBus_ChC;
    ELSE
        rV_DCBus_Voted_V := 0.0;
        bTrip_SensorLoss_Lat := TRUE;
        bEmergencyTripActive := TRUE;
    END_IF;
    bDegradedSensorMode := TRUE;
END_IF;

(* 2.2: Hydrogen Storage Supply Pressure 2oo3 Voting *)
IF bHealth_P_ChA AND bHealth_P_ChB AND bHealth_P_ChC THEN
    IF (rP_H2Supply_Bar_ChA >= rP_H2Supply_Bar_ChB) THEN
        IF (rP_H2Supply_Bar_ChB >= rP_H2Supply_Bar_ChC) THEN
            rP_H2Supply_Voted_Bar := rP_H2Supply_Bar_ChB;
        ELSIF (rP_H2Supply_Bar_ChA >= rP_H2Supply_Bar_ChC) THEN
            rP_H2Supply_Voted_Bar := rP_H2Supply_Bar_ChC;
        ELSE
            rP_H2Supply_Voted_Bar := rP_H2Supply_Bar_ChA;
        END_IF;
    ELSE
        IF (rP_H2Supply_Bar_ChA >= rP_H2Supply_Bar_ChC) THEN
            rP_H2Supply_Voted_Bar := rP_H2Supply_Bar_ChA;
        ELSIF (rP_H2Supply_Bar_ChB >= rP_H2Supply_Bar_ChC) THEN
            rP_H2Supply_Voted_Bar := rP_H2Supply_Bar_ChC;
        ELSE
            rP_H2Supply_Voted_Bar := rP_H2Supply_Bar_ChB;
        END_IF;
    END_IF;

    IF (ABS(rP_H2Supply_Bar_ChA - rP_H2Supply_Bar_ChB) > rTOL_P_H2Supply_Bar) OR
       (ABS(rP_H2Supply_Bar_ChB - rP_H2Supply_Bar_ChC) > rTOL_P_H2Supply_Bar) OR
       (ABS(rP_H2Supply_Bar_ChA - rP_H2Supply_Bar_ChC) > rTOL_P_H2Supply_Bar) THEN
        rTimer_P_Discrepancy := rTimer_P_Discrepancy + tScanDeltaTime_Sec;
        IF rTimer_P_Discrepancy >= rMAX_DISCREPANCY_TIME_Sec THEN
            IF ABS(rP_H2Supply_Bar_ChA - rP_H2Supply_Voted_Bar) > rTOL_P_H2Supply_Bar THEN
                bHealth_P_ChA := FALSE;
            ELSIF ABS(rP_H2Supply_Bar_ChB - rP_H2Supply_Voted_Bar) > rTOL_P_H2Supply_Bar THEN
                bHealth_P_ChB := FALSE;
            ELSE
                bHealth_P_ChC := FALSE;
            END_IF;
        END_IF;
    ELSE
        rTimer_P_Discrepancy := 0.0;
    END_IF;
ELSIF (bHealth_P_ChA AND bHealth_P_ChB) THEN
    rP_H2Supply_Voted_Bar := 0.5 * (rP_H2Supply_Bar_ChA + rP_H2Supply_Bar_ChB);
    bDegradedSensorMode := TRUE;
ELSIF (bHealth_P_ChA AND bHealth_P_ChC) THEN
    rP_H2Supply_Voted_Bar := 0.5 * (rP_H2Supply_Bar_ChA + rP_H2Supply_Bar_ChC);
    bDegradedSensorMode := TRUE;
ELSIF (bHealth_P_ChB AND bHealth_P_ChC) THEN
    rP_H2Supply_Voted_Bar := 0.5 * (rP_H2Supply_Bar_ChB + rP_H2Supply_Bar_ChC);

ELSE

    ELSIF bHealth_P_ChC THEN

    ELSE

        bEmergencyTripActive := TRUE;

END_IF;

(* 2.3: Locomotive Track Speed Pickups 2oo3 Voting *)
IF bHealth_Speed_ChA AND bHealth_Speed_ChB AND bHealth_Speed_ChC THEN
    IF (rV_TrainSpeed_Kmh_ChA >= rV_TrainSpeed_Kmh_ChB) THEN
        IF (rV_TrainSpeed_Kmh_ChB >= rV_TrainSpeed_Kmh_ChC) THEN
            rV_TrainSpeed_Voted_Kmh := rV_TrainSpeed_Kmh_ChB;
        ELSIF (rV_TrainSpeed_Kmh_ChA >= rV_TrainSpeed_Kmh_ChC) THEN
            rV_TrainSpeed_Voted_Kmh := rV_TrainSpeed_Kmh_ChC;
        ELSE
            rV_TrainSpeed_Voted_Kmh := rV_TrainSpeed_Kmh_ChA;

    ELSE
        IF (rV_TrainSpeed_Kmh_ChA >= rV_TrainSpeed_Kmh_ChC) THEN
            rV_TrainSpeed_Voted_Kmh := rV_TrainSpeed_Kmh_ChA;
        ELSIF (rV_TrainSpeed_Kmh_ChB >= rV_TrainSpeed_Kmh_ChC) THEN

ELSIF (bHealth_Speed_ChA AND bHealth_Speed_ChB) THEN

ELSIF (bHealth_Speed_ChA AND bHealth_Speed_ChC) THEN

(* ============================================================================================= *)
(* SECTION 3: SENSOR DIGITAL FILTERING & PRE-PROCESSING                                          *)
(* ============================================================================================= *)
rV_DCBus_Filt_V := ((1.0 - rFilterWeight) * rV_DCBus_Filt_V) + (rFilterWeight * rV_DCBus_Voted_V);
rP_H2Supply_Filt_Bar := ((1.0 - rFilterWeight) * rP_H2Supply_Filt_Bar) + (rFilterWeight * rP_H2Supply_Voted_Bar);
rV_TrainSpeed_Filt_Kmh := ((1.0 - rFilterWeight) * rV_TrainSpeed_Filt_Kmh) + (rFilterWeight * rV_TrainSpeed_Voted_Kmh);
rP_TractionDemand_Filt_kW := ((1.0 - rFilterWeight) * rP_TractionDemand_Filt_kW) + (rFilterWeight * rP_TractionDemand_kW);
rBESS_SOC_Filt_Pct := ((1.0 - rFilterWeight) * rBESS_SOC_Filt_Pct) + (rFilterWeight * rBESS_SOC_Pct);
rBESS_Current_Filt_A := ((1.0 - rFilterWeight) * rBESS_Current_Filt_A) + (rFilterWeight * rBESS_Current_A);

rI_Stack_Filt_1 := ((1.0 - rFilterWeight) * rI_Stack_Filt_1) + (rFilterWeight * rI_Stack_A_1);
rI_Stack_Filt_2 := ((1.0 - rFilterWeight) * rI_Stack_Filt_2) + (rFilterWeight * rI_Stack_A_2);
rI_Stack_Filt_3 := ((1.0 - rFilterWeight) * rI_Stack_Filt_3) + (rFilterWeight * rI_Stack_A_3);
rI_Stack_Filt_4 := ((1.0 - rFilterWeight) * rI_Stack_Filt_4) + (rFilterWeight * rI_Stack_A_4);

rV_Stack_Filt_1 := ((1.0 - rFilterWeight) * rV_Stack_Filt_1) + (rFilterWeight * rV_Stack_V_1);
rV_Stack_Filt_2 := ((1.0 - rFilterWeight) * rV_Stack_Filt_2) + (rFilterWeight * rV_Stack_V_2);
rV_Stack_Filt_3 := ((1.0 - rFilterWeight) * rV_Stack_Filt_3) + (rFilterWeight * rV_Stack_V_3);
rV_Stack_Filt_4 := ((1.0 - rFilterWeight) * rV_Stack_Filt_4) + (rFilterWeight * rV_Stack_V_4);

    rMolarH2_Reacted_1 := (INT_TO_REAL(iCELL_COUNT_PER_STACK) * rI_Stack_Filt_1) / (2.0 * rFARADAY_CONST);
    rMassAirFlow_Kgs_1 := rTARGET_LAMBDA_O2 * rMolarO2_Reacted_1 * (rMOLAR_MASS_AIR / rO2_MOLAR_FRACTION_AIR);
    rAirCompressorSpeed_Rpm_1 := rCompressor_Min_Rpm + (rMassAirFlow_Kgs_1 * rCompressor_Slope);
    IF rAirCompressorSpeed_Rpm_1 > rCompressor_Max_Rpm THEN rAirCompressorSpeed_Rpm_1 := rCompressor_Max_Rpm;
    ELSIF rAirCompressorSpeed_Rpm_1 < rCompressor_Min_Rpm THEN rAirCompressorSpeed_Rpm_1 := rCompressor_Min_Rpm; END_IF;
    rCathodeBackpressure_Pct_1 := rBackpressure_Min_Pct + (rMassAirFlow_Kgs_1 / 0.85) * 60.0;
    IF rCathodeBackpressure_Pct_1 > rBackpressure_Max_Pct THEN rCathodeBackpressure_Pct_1 := rBackpressure_Max_Pct; END_IF;
    rAnodeEjectorPWM_Pct_1 := 15.0 + (rI_Stack_Filt_1 / 750.0) * 80.0;
    IF rAnodeEjectorPWM_Pct_1 > 100.0 THEN rAnodeEjectorPWM_Pct_1 := 100.0; END_IF;
    rMassH2Flow_Kgs_1 := rMolarH2_Reacted_1 * rMOLAR_MASS_H2 * rTARGET_LAMBDA_H2;
    rTotalH2MassFlow_Kgs := rTotalH2MassFlow_Kgs + rMassH2Flow_Kgs_1;
ELSE
    rAirCompressorSpeed_Rpm_1 := 0.0; rCathodeBackpressure_Pct_1 := 0.0; rAnodeEjectorPWM_Pct_1 := 0.0; rMassH2Flow_Kgs_1 := 0.0;

(* Compute Aggregate Net Fuel Cell Electrical Efficiency [%] *)
IF rTotalH2MassFlow_Kgs > 0.0001 THEN
    rAccumulator := ((rV_Stack_Filt_1 * rI_Stack_Filt_1) + (rV_Stack_Filt_2 * rI_Stack_Filt_2) +
                     (rV_Stack_Filt_3 * rI_Stack_Filt_3) + (rV_Stack_Filt_4 * rI_Stack_Filt_4)) / 1000.0;
    rAggregateFCEfficiency_Pct := (rAccumulator / (rTotalH2MassFlow_Kgs * 120000.0)) * 100.0;
    IF rAggregateFCEfficiency_Pct > 68.0 THEN rAggregateFCEfficiency_Pct := 68.0; END_IF;
ELSE
    rAggregateFCEfficiency_Pct := 0.0;
END_IF;

    rMolarN2_Crossover_1 := (rN2_DIFFUSION_PERM_COEFF * rACTIVE_CELL_AREA_M2 * INT_TO_REAL(iCELL_COUNT_PER_STACK) / rMEMBRANE_THICKNESS_M) *
                            ((0.7808 * rP_CathodeIn_Bar_1) - ((rAnode_N2_MoleFraction_1 / 100.0) * rP_AnodeIn_Bar_1));
    IF rMolarN2_Crossover_1 < 0.0 THEN rMolarN2_Crossover_1 := 0.0; END_IF;
    rAnode_N2_MoleFraction_1 := rAnode_N2_MoleFraction_1 + (rMolarN2_Crossover_1 * 0.082 * tScanDeltaTime_Sec);
    IF rAnode_N2_MoleFraction_1 > 18.0 THEN rAnode_N2_MoleFraction_1 := 18.0; END_IF;
    rAccumulated_Ah_1 := rAccumulated_Ah_1 + (rI_Stack_Filt_1 * tScanDeltaTime_Sec / 3600.0);
    rTimer_PurgeInterval_1 := rTimer_PurgeInterval_1 + tScanDeltaTime_Sec;

    IF NOT bPurgeActive_1 THEN
        IF (rAccumulated_Ah_1 >= rAH_PURGE_THRESHOLD) OR
           ((rV_AvgCell_V_1 - rV_MinCell_V_1) >= rCVM_PURGE_DELTA_V_THRESH) OR
           (rTimer_PurgeInterval_1 >= rMAX_PURGE_INTERVAL_SEC) THEN
            IF rH2_Concentration_Exhaust_Pct < rMAX_SAFE_EXHAUST_H2_PCT THEN
                bPurgeActive_1 := TRUE; bAnodePurgeValveCmd_1 := TRUE; rTimer_PurgePulse_1 := 0.0;
            END_IF;
        END_IF;
    ELSE
        rTimer_PurgePulse_1 := rTimer_PurgePulse_1 + tScanDeltaTime_Sec;
        IF rTimer_PurgePulse_1 >= rPURGE_PULSE_DURATION_SEC THEN
            bPurgeActive_1 := FALSE; bAnodePurgeValveCmd_1 := FALSE;
            rAccumulated_Ah_1 := 0.0; rTimer_PurgeInterval_1 := 0.0; rAnode_N2_MoleFraction_1 := 1.5;
        END_IF;
    END_IF;
ELSE
    bPurgeActive_1 := FALSE; bAnodePurgeValveCmd_1 := FALSE;
END_IF;

(* Stack 4 Purge Controller *)
IF NOT bStackIsolated_4 AND (iStateStep >= 40) THEN
    rMolarN2_Crossover_4 := (rN2_DIFFUSION_PERM_COEFF * rACTIVE_CELL_AREA_M2 * INT_TO_REAL(iCELL_COUNT_PER_STACK) / rMEMBRANE_THICKNESS_M) *
                            ((0.7808 * rP_CathodeIn_Bar_4) - ((rAnode_N2_MoleFraction_4 / 100.0) * rP_AnodeIn_Bar_4));
    IF rMolarN2_Crossover_4 < 0.0 THEN rMolarN2_Crossover_4 := 0.0; END_IF;
    rAnode_N2_MoleFraction_4 := rAnode_N2_MoleFraction_4 + (rMolarN2_Crossover_4 * 0.082 * tScanDeltaTime_Sec);
    IF rAnode_N2_MoleFraction_4 > 18.0 THEN rAnode_N2_MoleFraction_4 := 18.0; END_IF;
    rAccumulated_Ah_4 := rAccumulated_Ah_4 + (rI_Stack_Filt_4 * tScanDeltaTime_Sec / 3600.0);
    rTimer_PurgeInterval_4 := rTimer_PurgeInterval_4 + tScanDeltaTime_Sec;

    IF NOT bPurgeActive_4 THEN
        IF (rAccumulated_Ah_4 >= rAH_PURGE_THRESHOLD) OR
           ((rV_AvgCell_V_4 - rV_MinCell_V_4) >= rCVM_PURGE_DELTA_V_THRESH) OR
           (rTimer_PurgeInterval_4 >= rMAX_PURGE_INTERVAL_SEC) THEN
            IF rH2_Concentration_Exhaust_Pct < rMAX_SAFE_EXHAUST_H2_PCT THEN
                bPurgeActive_4 := TRUE; bAnodePurgeValveCmd_4 := TRUE; rTimer_PurgePulse_4 := 0.0;
            END_IF;
        END_IF;
    ELSE
        rTimer_PurgePulse_4 := rTimer_PurgePulse_4 + tScanDeltaTime_Sec;
        IF rTimer_PurgePulse_4 >= rPURGE_PULSE_DURATION_SEC THEN
            bPurgeActive_4 := FALSE; bAnodePurgeValveCmd_4 := FALSE;
            rAccumulated_Ah_4 := 0.0; rTimer_PurgeInterval_4 := 0.0; rAnode_N2_MoleFraction_4 := 1.5;
        END_IF;
    END_IF;
ELSE
    bPurgeActive_4 := FALSE; bAnodePurgeValveCmd_4 := FALSE;
END_IF;

(* ============================================================================================= *)
(* SECTION 6: MULTIPHASE INTERLEAVED DC/DC BOOST CONVERTER ACTIVE RIPPLE DAMPING ENGINE          *)
(* ============================================================================================= *)
IF NOT bStackIsolated_1 THEN
    rI_Ripple_Est_1 := rI_Stack_A_1 - rI_Stack_Filt_1;
    rTempCalc := (rI_Ripple_Est_1 - (rI_Stack_Prev_1 - rI_Stack_Filt_1)) / tScanDeltaTime_Sec;
    rI_Stack_Prev_1 := rI_Stack_A_1;
    rI_RippleDamping_Comp_A_1 := -1.0 * ((rKp_RippleDamping * rI_Ripple_Est_1) + (rKd_RippleDamping * rTempCalc));
    IF rI_RippleDamping_Comp_A_1 > 35.0 THEN rI_RippleDamping_Comp_A_1 := 35.0;
    ELSIF rI_RippleDamping_Comp_A_1 < -35.0 THEN rI_RippleDamping_Comp_A_1 := -35.0; END_IF;
    rDCDC_InterleavePhase_Deg_1 := 0.0;
ELSE
    rI_RippleDamping_Comp_A_1 := 0.0; rDCDC_InterleavePhase_Deg_1 := 0.0;
END_IF;

IF NOT bStackIsolated_2 THEN
    rI_Ripple_Est_2 := rI_Stack_A_2 - rI_Stack_Filt_2;
    rTempCalc := (rI_Ripple_Est_2 - (rI_Stack_Prev_2 - rI_Stack_Filt_2)) / tScanDeltaTime_Sec;
    rI_Stack_Prev_2 := rI_Stack_A_2;
    rI_RippleDamping_Comp_A_2 := -1.0 * ((rKp_RippleDamping * rI_Ripple_Est_2) + (rKd_RippleDamping * rTempCalc));
    IF rI_RippleDamping_Comp_A_2 > 35.0 THEN rI_RippleDamping_Comp_A_2 := 35.0;
    ELSIF rI_RippleDamping_Comp_A_2 < -35.0 THEN rI_RippleDamping_Comp_A_2 := -35.0; END_IF;
    rDCDC_InterleavePhase_Deg_2 := 90.0;
ELSE
    rI_RippleDamping_Comp_A_2 := 0.0; rDCDC_InterleavePhase_Deg_2 := 0.0;
END_IF;

IF NOT bStackIsolated_3 THEN
    rI_Ripple_Est_3 := rI_Stack_A_3 - rI_Stack_Filt_3;
    rTempCalc := (rI_Ripple_Est_3 - (rI_Stack_Prev_3 - rI_Stack_Filt_3)) / tScanDeltaTime_Sec;
    rI_Stack_Prev_3 := rI_Stack_A_3;
    rI_RippleDamping_Comp_A_3 := -1.0 * ((rKp_RippleDamping * rI_Ripple_Est_3) + (rKd_RippleDamping * rTempCalc));
    IF rI_RippleDamping_Comp_A_3 > 35.0 THEN rI_RippleDamping_Comp_A_3 := 35.0;
    ELSIF rI_RippleDamping_Comp_A_3 < -35.0 THEN rI_RippleDamping_Comp_A_3 := -35.0; END_IF;
    rDCDC_InterleavePhase_Deg_3 := 180.0;
ELSE
    rI_RippleDamping_Comp_A_3 := 0.0; rDCDC_InterleavePhase_Deg_3 := 0.0;
END_IF;

IF NOT bStackIsolated_4 THEN
    rI_Ripple_Est_4 := rI_Stack_A_4 - rI_Stack_Filt_4;
    rTempCalc := (rI_Ripple_Est_4 - (rI_Stack_Prev_4 - rI_Stack_Filt_4)) / tScanDeltaTime_Sec;
    rI_Stack_Prev_4 := rI_Stack_A_4;
    rI_RippleDamping_Comp_A_4 := -1.0 * ((rKp_RippleDamping * rI_Ripple_Est_4) + (rKd_RippleDamping * rTempCalc));
    IF rI_RippleDamping_Comp_A_4 > 35.0 THEN rI_RippleDamping_Comp_A_4 := 35.0;
    ELSIF rI_RippleDamping_Comp_A_4 < -35.0 THEN rI_RippleDamping_Comp_A_4 := -35.0; END_IF;
    rDCDC_InterleavePhase_Deg_4 := 270.0;
ELSE
    rI_RippleDamping_Comp_A_4 := 0.0; rDCDC_InterleavePhase_Deg_4 := 0.0;
END_IF;

(* ============================================================================================= *)
(* SECTION 7: DISCRETE KALMAN FILTER / STATE OBSERVER UPDATE                                    *)
(* ============================================================================================= *)
rInnovation[1] := (rV_DCBus_Filt_V - 1500.0) - xState_Pred[1];
rInnovation[2] := (rBESS_SOC_Filt_Pct - 65.0) - xState_Pred[2];
rInnovation[3] := (rTARGET_LAMBDA_O2 - 2.05) - xState_Pred[3];
rInnovation[4] := (0.25 * (ABS(rI_Ripple_Est_1) + ABS(rI_Ripple_Est_2) + ABS(rI_Ripple_Est_3) + ABS(rI_Ripple_Est_4))) - xState_Pred[5];

FOR iRow := 1 TO 6 DO
    rAccumulator := xState_Pred[iRow];
    FOR iCol := 1 TO 4 DO
        rAccumulator := rAccumulator + (mL_Gain[iRow, iCol] * rInnovation[iCol]);
    END_FOR;
    xState_Est[iRow] := rAccumulator;
    xState[iRow] := xState_Est[iRow];
END_FOR;

dDisturbance[1] := rP_TractionDemand_Filt_kW;
dDisturbance[2] := rV_TrainSpeed_Filt_Kmh;

FOR iRow := 1 TO 6 DO
    rAccumulator := 0.0;
    FOR iCol := 1 TO 6 DO
        rAccumulator := rAccumulator + (mA_d[iRow, iCol] * xState_Est[iCol]);
    END_FOR;
    FOR iCol := 1 TO 4 DO
        rAccumulator := rAccumulator + (mB_d[iRow, iCol] * uControl[iCol]);
    END_FOR;
    FOR iCol := 1 TO 2 DO
        rAccumulator := rAccumulator + (mE_d[iRow, iCol] * dDisturbance[iCol]);
    END_FOR;
    xState_Pred[iRow] := rAccumulator;
END_FOR;

(* ============================================================================================= *)
(* SECTION 8: MODEL PREDICTIVE CONTROL (MPC) PROJECTED GRADIENT DESCENT QP SOLVER               *)
(* ============================================================================================= *)
IF (iStateStep = 50) OR (iStateStep = 60) OR (iStateStep = 70) THEN
    IF xState_Pred[3] < -0.35 THEN
        rStarvationSlack := -0.35 - xState_Pred[3];
    ELSE
        rStarvationSlack := 0.0;
    END_IF;

    IF xState_Pred[2] < -35.0 THEN
        rSOCSlack := -35.0 - xState_Pred[2];
    ELSIF xState_Pred[2] > 20.0 THEN
        rSOCSlack := xState_Pred[2] - 20.0;
    ELSE
        rSOCSlack := 0.0;
    END_IF;

    FOR iQPIteration := 1 TO iMaxQPIterations DO
        rGradJ[1] := (mB_d[1, 1] * vQ_Diag[1] * xState_Pred[1]) +
                     (mB_d[2, 1] * vQ_Diag[2] * xState_Pred[2]) +
                     (mB_d[3, 1] * vQ_Diag[3] * (xState_Pred[3] - (rRhoStarvationPenalty * rStarvationSlack))) +
                     (vR_Diag[1] * uControl[1]);

        rGradJ[2] := (mB_d[1, 2] * vQ_Diag[1] * xState_Pred[1]) +
                     (mB_d[2, 2] * vQ_Diag[2] * (xState_Pred[2] + (rRhoSOCPenalty * rSOCSlack))) +
                     (vR_Diag[2] * uControl[2]);

        rGradJ[3] := (mB_d[4, 3] * vQ_Diag[4] * xState_Pred[4]) +
                     (vR_Diag[3] * uControl[3]);

        rGradJ[4] := (mB_d[5, 4] * 25.0 * xState_Pred[5]) +
                     (vR_Diag[4] * uControl[4]);

        FOR iIdx := 1 TO 4 DO
            uControl[iIdx] := uControl[iIdx] - (rAlphaStep * rGradJ[iIdx]);
        END_FOR;

        IF uControl[1] < -1200.0 THEN uControl[1] := -1200.0; ELSIF uControl[1] > 400.0 THEN uControl[1] := 400.0; END_IF;
        IF uControl[2] < -2500.0 THEN uControl[2] := -2500.0; ELSIF uControl[2] > 2500.0 THEN uControl[2] := 2500.0; END_IF;
        IF uControl[3] < 0.0 THEN uControl[3] := 0.0; ELSIF uControl[3] > 100.0 THEN uControl[3] := 100.0; END_IF;
        IF uControl[4] < -35.0 THEN uControl[4] := -35.0; ELSIF uControl[4] > 35.0 THEN uControl[4] := 35.0; END_IF;
    END_FOR;

    rTempCalc := rMAX_FC_RAMP_KW_PER_SEC * tScanDeltaTime_Sec;
    IF (uControl[1] - uControl_Prev[1]) > rTempCalc THEN
        uControl[1] := uControl_Prev[1] + rTempCalc;
    ELSIF (uControl_Prev[1] - uControl[1]) > rTempCalc THEN
        uControl[1] := uControl_Prev[1] - rTempCalc;
    END_IF;
    uControl_Prev[1] := uControl[1];
    uControl_Prev[2] := uControl[2];
    uControl_Prev[3] := uControl[3];
    uControl_Prev[4] := uControl[4];
END_IF;

(* ============================================================================================= *)
(* SECTION 9: HEAVY FREIGHT LOCOMOTIVE DYNAMIC BRAKING & REGENERATIVE POWER SPLIT                *)
(* ============================================================================================= *)
IF iMasterNotchCommand > 0 THEN
    IF iMasterNotchCommand > 8 THEN iMasterNotchCommand := 8; END_IF;
    rEffectiveTractionDemand_kW := rNotchPowerTable[iMasterNotchCommand];
    rDynamicBrakeDemand_kW := 0.0;
    rP_DynamicBrakeResistor_kW := 0.0;
    rDynamicBrakeChopperDuty_Pct := 0.0;

    rAccumulator := 1200.0 + uControl[1];
    rTempCalc := rStackCapacityDerateFactor * rTOTAL_FC_RATED_KW;
    IF rAccumulator > rTempCalc THEN rAccumulator := rTempCalc;
    ELSIF rAccumulator < 80.0 THEN rAccumulator := 80.0; END_IF;
    rP_FC_TotalDemand_kW := rAccumulator;

    rP_BESS_Command_kW := (rEffectiveTractionDemand_kW + rP_AuxiliaryLoads_kW) - rP_FC_TotalDemand_kW;
    IF rP_BESS_Command_kW > rBESS_MaxDischargePwr_kW THEN
        rP_BESS_Command_kW := rBESS_MaxDischargePwr_kW;
    ELSIF rP_BESS_Command_kW < (-1.0 * rBESS_MaxChargePwr_kW) THEN
        rP_BESS_Command_kW := -1.0 * rBESS_MaxChargePwr_kW;
    END_IF;

ELSIF iMasterNotchCommand < 0 THEN
    iIdx := -1 * iMasterNotchCommand;
    IF iIdx > 8 THEN iIdx := 8; END_IF;
    rDynamicBrakeDemand_kW := rNotchDynamicBrakeTable[iIdx];
    rEffectiveTractionDemand_kW := -1.0 * rDynamicBrakeDemand_kW;
    rP_FC_TotalDemand_kW := 20.0 * INT_TO_REAL(iOperationalStackCount);

    IF rDynamicBrakeDemand_kW > rP_AuxiliaryLoads_kW THEN
        rAccumulator := rDynamicBrakeDemand_kW - rP_AuxiliaryLoads_kW;
    ELSE
        rAccumulator := 0.0;
    END_IF;

    IF (rBESS_SOC_Filt_Pct < 85.0) AND (rBESS_MaxCellTemp_DegC < 52.0) THEN
        IF rAccumulator > rBESS_MaxChargePwr_kW THEN
            rBESS_ChargeAllocated_kW := rBESS_MaxChargePwr_kW;
        ELSE
            rBESS_ChargeAllocated_kW := rAccumulator;
        END_IF;
        rP_BESS_Command_kW := -1.0 * rBESS_ChargeAllocated_kW;
        rAccumulator := rAccumulator - rBESS_ChargeAllocated_kW;
    ELSE
        rBESS_ChargeAllocated_kW := 0.0;
        rP_BESS_Command_kW := 0.0;
    END_IF;

    IF rAccumulator > rDYNAMIC_BRAKE_RATING_KW THEN
        rDBR_DissipationAllocated_kW := rDYNAMIC_BRAKE_RATING_KW;
    ELSE
        rDBR_DissipationAllocated_kW := rAccumulator;
    END_IF;
    rP_DynamicBrakeResistor_kW := rDBR_DissipationAllocated_kW;
    rDynamicBrakeChopperDuty_Pct := (rP_DynamicBrakeResistor_kW / rDYNAMIC_BRAKE_RATING_KW) * 100.0;

ELSE
    rEffectiveTractionDemand_kW := 0.0;
    rDynamicBrakeDemand_kW := 0.0;
    rP_DynamicBrakeResistor_kW := 0.0;
    rDynamicBrakeChopperDuty_Pct := 0.0;

    IF rBESS_SOC_Filt_Pct < 60.0 THEN
        rP_FC_TotalDemand_kW := rP_AuxiliaryLoads_kW + 250.0;
        rP_BESS_Command_kW := -250.0;
    ELSE
        rP_FC_TotalDemand_kW := rP_AuxiliaryLoads_kW;
        rP_BESS_Command_kW := 0.0;
    END_IF;
END_IF;

rV_DCBus_Target_V := rNOMINAL_DC_BUS_V;

(* ============================================================================================= *)
(* SECTION 10: MULTI-STACK HEALTH EVALUATION, ISOLATION & FAULT TOLERANCE ENGINE                *)
(* ============================================================================================= *)
rCellVoltageSpread_1 := rV_AvgCell_V_1 - rV_MinCell_V_1;
rCoolantDeltaT_1 := rT_CoolantOut_DegC_1 - rT_CoolantIn_DegC_1;
IF (rCellVoltageSpread_1 > 0.095) OR (rV_MinCell_V_1 < 0.52) OR bCVM_CommFault_1 THEN bStackDegraded_1 := TRUE; ELSE bStackDegraded_1 := FALSE; END_IF;
IF (rCellVoltageSpread_1 > 0.140) OR (rV_MinCell_V_1 < 0.42) OR (rCoolantDeltaT_1 > 18.0) OR (rT_CoolantOut_DegC_1 > 82.0) THEN
    bStackIsolated_1 := TRUE; bStackContactorEnable_1 := FALSE;
END_IF;

rCellVoltageSpread_2 := rV_AvgCell_V_2 - rV_MinCell_V_2;
rCoolantDeltaT_2 := rT_CoolantOut_DegC_2 - rT_CoolantIn_DegC_2;
IF (rCellVoltageSpread_2 > 0.095) OR (rV_MinCell_V_2 < 0.52) OR bCVM_CommFault_2 THEN bStackDegraded_2 := TRUE; ELSE bStackDegraded_2 := FALSE; END_IF;
IF (rCellVoltageSpread_2 > 0.140) OR (rV_MinCell_V_2 < 0.42) OR (rCoolantDeltaT_2 > 18.0) OR (rT_CoolantOut_DegC_2 > 82.0) THEN
    bStackIsolated_2 := TRUE; bStackContactorEnable_2 := FALSE;
END_IF;

rCellVoltageSpread_3 := rV_AvgCell_V_3 - rV_MinCell_V_3;
rCoolantDeltaT_3 := rT_CoolantOut_DegC_3 - rT_CoolantIn_DegC_3;
IF (rCellVoltageSpread_3 > 0.095) OR (rV_MinCell_V_3 < 0.52) OR bCVM_CommFault_3 THEN bStackDegraded_3 := TRUE; ELSE bStackDegraded_3 := FALSE; END_IF;
IF (rCellVoltageSpread_3 > 0.140) OR (rV_MinCell_V_3 < 0.42) OR (rCoolantDeltaT_3 > 18.0) OR (rT_CoolantOut_DegC_3 > 82.0) THEN
    bStackIsolated_3 := TRUE; bStackContactorEnable_3 := FALSE;
END_IF;

rCellVoltageSpread_4 := rV_AvgCell_V_4 - rV_MinCell_V_4;
rCoolantDeltaT_4 := rT_CoolantOut_DegC_4 - rT_CoolantIn_DegC_4;
IF (rCellVoltageSpread_4 > 0.095) OR (rV_MinCell_V_4 < 0.52) OR bCVM_CommFault_4 THEN bStackDegraded_4 := TRUE; ELSE bStackDegraded_4 := FALSE; END_IF;
IF (rCellVoltageSpread_4 > 0.140) OR (rV_MinCell_V_4 < 0.42) OR (rCoolantDeltaT_4 > 18.0) OR (rT_CoolantOut_DegC_4 > 82.0) THEN
    bStackIsolated_4 := TRUE; bStackContactorEnable_4 := FALSE;
END_IF;

iOperationalStackCount := 0;
IF NOT bStackIsolated_1 THEN iOperationalStackCount := iOperationalStackCount + 1; END_IF;
IF NOT bStackIsolated_2 THEN iOperationalStackCount := iOperationalStackCount + 1; END_IF;
IF NOT bStackIsolated_3 THEN iOperationalStackCount := iOperationalStackCount + 1; END_IF;
IF NOT bStackIsolated_4 THEN iOperationalStackCount := iOperationalStackCount + 1; END_IF;

rStackCapacityDerateFactor := INT_TO_REAL(iOperationalStackCount) / 4.0;
bDegradedModeActive := (iOperationalStackCount < 4);

IF iOperationalStackCount > 0 THEN
    rAccumulator := rP_FC_TotalDemand_kW / INT_TO_REAL(iOperationalStackCount);
    IF NOT bStackIsolated_1 THEN rP_StackDemand_kW_1 := rAccumulator; ELSE rP_StackDemand_kW_1 := 0.0; END_IF;
    IF NOT bStackIsolated_2 THEN rP_StackDemand_kW_2 := rAccumulator; ELSE rP_StackDemand_kW_2 := 0.0; END_IF;
    IF NOT bStackIsolated_3 THEN rP_StackDemand_kW_3 := rAccumulator; ELSE rP_StackDemand_kW_3 := 0.0; END_IF;
    IF NOT bStackIsolated_4 THEN rP_StackDemand_kW_4 := rAccumulator; ELSE rP_StackDemand_kW_4 := 0.0; END_IF;
ELSE
    rP_StackDemand_kW_1 := 0.0; rP_StackDemand_kW_2 := 0.0; rP_StackDemand_kW_3 := 0.0; rP_StackDemand_kW_4 := 0.0;
    rP_FC_TotalDemand_kW := 0.0;
END_IF;

(* ============================================================================================= *)
(* SECTION 11: ISA-18.2 ALARM MATRIX & HARDWIRED TRIP SUPERVISION                                 *)
(* ============================================================================================= *)
IF NOT bEmergencyTrip THEN bTrip_Hardwire_Latched := TRUE; END_IF;
IF rH2_Concentration_EngineBay_Pct > 25.0 THEN bTrip_H2Leak_Latched := TRUE; END_IF;
IF rV_DCBus_Voted_V > rMAX_DC_BUS_V THEN bTrip_DCBusOvervoltage_Lat := TRUE; END_IF;
IF (rV_DCBus_Voted_V < rMIN_DC_BUS_V) AND (iStateStep >= 40) THEN bTrip_DCBusUndervoltage_Lat := TRUE; END_IF;
IF (rV_MinCell_V_1 < 0.38) OR (rV_MinCell_V_2 < 0.38) OR (rV_MinCell_V_3 < 0.38) OR (rV_MinCell_V_4 < 0.38) THEN
    bTrip_StackCellReversal_Lat := TRUE;
END_IF;
IF rBESS_MaxCellTemp_DegC > 58.0 THEN bTrip_BESSOvertemp_Lat := TRUE; END_IF;
IF ABS(rBESS_Current_A) > 1800.0 THEN bTrip_BESSOvercurrent_Lat := TRUE; END_IF;
IF rH2_Concentration_Exhaust_Pct > 1.50 THEN bTrip_ExhaustH2Flamb_Lat := TRUE; END_IF;
IF (NOT (bHealth_V_ChA OR bHealth_V_ChB OR bHealth_V_ChC)) OR
   (NOT (bHealth_P_ChA OR bHealth_P_ChB OR bHealth_P_ChC)) OR
   (NOT (bHealth_Speed_ChA OR bHealth_Speed_ChB OR bHealth_Speed_ChC)) THEN
    bTrip_SensorLoss_Lat := TRUE;
END_IF;
IF (rT_CoolantOut_DegC_1 > 84.0) OR (rT_CoolantOut_DegC_2 > 84.0) OR
   (rT_CoolantOut_DegC_3 > 84.0) OR (rT_CoolantOut_DegC_4 > 84.0) THEN
    bTrip_CoolantOverheat_Lat := TRUE;
END_IF;

wTripAlarmBitmask.0 := bTrip_Hardwire_Latched;
wTripAlarmBitmask.1 := bTrip_H2Leak_Latched;
wTripAlarmBitmask.2 := bTrip_DCBusOvervoltage_Lat;
wTripAlarmBitmask.3 := bTrip_DCBusUndervoltage_Lat;
wTripAlarmBitmask.4 := bTrip_StackCellReversal_Lat;
wTripAlarmBitmask.5 := bTrip_BESSOvertemp_Lat;
wTripAlarmBitmask.6 := bTrip_BESSOvercurrent_Lat;
wTripAlarmBitmask.7 := bTrip_ExhaustH2Flamb_Lat;
wTripAlarmBitmask.8 := bTrip_SensorLoss_Lat;
wTripAlarmBitmask.9 := bTrip_CoolantOverheat_Lat;

bWarn_H2SupplyLow := (rP_H2Supply_Voted_Bar < 50.0);
bWarn_HighCellSpread := (rCellVoltageSpread_1 > 0.075) OR (rCellVoltageSpread_2 > 0.075) OR
                        (rCellVoltageSpread_3 > 0.075) OR (rCellVoltageSpread_4 > 0.075);
bWarn_HighN2Accumulation := (rAnode_N2_MoleFraction_1 > 12.0) OR (rAnode_N2_MoleFraction_2 > 12.0) OR
                            (rAnode_N2_MoleFraction_3 > 12.0) OR (rAnode_N2_MoleFraction_4 > 12.0);
bWarn_HighRippleCurrent := (ABS(rI_Ripple_Est_1) > 25.0) OR (ABS(rI_Ripple_Est_2) > 25.0) OR
                           (ABS(rI_Ripple_Est_3) > 25.0) OR (ABS(rI_Ripple_Est_4) > 25.0);
bWarn_LowBESS_SOC := (rBESS_SOC_Filt_Pct < 35.0);
bWarn_HighBESS_SOC := (rBESS_SOC_Filt_Pct > 85.0);
bWarn_AirStoichStarvation := (xState[3] < -0.25);
bWarn_DegradedStackOperation := bDegradedModeActive;

wWarningAlarmBitmask.0 := bWarn_H2SupplyLow;
wWarningAlarmBitmask.1 := bWarn_HighCellSpread;
wWarningAlarmBitmask.2 := bWarn_HighN2Accumulation;
wWarningAlarmBitmask.3 := bWarn_HighRippleCurrent;
wWarningAlarmBitmask.4 := bWarn_LowBESS_SOC;
wWarningAlarmBitmask.5 := bWarn_HighBESS_SOC;
wWarningAlarmBitmask.6 := bWarn_AirStoichStarvation;
wWarningAlarmBitmask.7 := bWarn_DegradedStackOperation;

wSensorHealthBitmask.0 := bHealth_V_ChA;
wSensorHealthBitmask.1 := bHealth_V_ChB;
wSensorHealthBitmask.2 := bHealth_V_ChC;
wSensorHealthBitmask.3 := bHealth_P_ChA;
wSensorHealthBitmask.4 := bHealth_P_ChB;
wSensorHealthBitmask.5 := bHealth_P_ChC;
wSensorHealthBitmask.6 := bHealth_Speed_ChA;
wSensorHealthBitmask.7 := bHealth_Speed_ChB;
wSensorHealthBitmask.8 := bHealth_Speed_ChC;

wStackHealthBitmask.0 := NOT bStackIsolated_1;
wStackHealthBitmask.1 := NOT bStackIsolated_2;
wStackHealthBitmask.2 := NOT bStackIsolated_3;
