    aMPC_A                          : ARRAY[1..4, 1..4] OF LREAL; (* State transition matrix *)
    aMPC_B                          : ARRAY[1..4, 1..3] OF LREAL; (* Input transmission matrix *)
    aMPC_Q                          : ARRAY[1..4] OF LREAL;       (* State tracking error weights *)
    aMPC_R                          : ARRAY[1..3] OF LREAL;       (* Control effort penalty weights *)
    aMPC_S                          : ARRAY[1..3] OF LREAL;       (* Actuator rate-of-change penalty weights *)
    aMPC_X_Ref                      : ARRAY[1..4] OF LREAL;       (* Reference trajectory vector *)
    aMPC_X_Hat                      : ARRAY[0..5, 1..4] OF LREAL; (* Predicted state trajectory over horizon *)
    aMPC_U_Hat                      : ARRAY[0..4, 1..3] OF LREAL; (* Projected control input sequence *)
    aMPC_U_Prev                     : ARRAY[1..3] OF LREAL;       (* Previous cycle control vector *)
    aMPC_Grad                       : ARRAY[1..3] OF LREAL;       (* Quadratic cost gradient vector *)
    lrMPC_StepSize                  : LREAL := 0.00018;           (* Projected gradient descent step size alpha *)
    lrLaserPower_Min                : LREAL := 250.0;             (* Minimum laser ignition power [W] *)
    lrLaserPower_Max                : LREAL := 3000.0;            (* Maximum generator laser power [W] *)
    lrLaserPower_SlewMax            : LREAL := 1500.0;            (* Maximum laser slew rate [W / s] *)
    lrPowderFlow_Min                : LREAL := 2.0;               (* Minimum powder feeder rate [g / min] *)
    lrPowderFlow_Max                : LREAL := 35.0;              (* Maximum powder feeder rate [g / min] *)
    lrPowderFlow_SlewMax            : LREAL := 20.0;              (* Maximum powder feeder slew rate [g / min / s] *)
    lrFeedrate_Min                  : LREAL := 100.0;             (* Minimum CNC traverse velocity [mm / min] *)
    lrFeedrate_Max                  : LREAL := 2400.0;            (* Maximum CNC traverse velocity [mm / min] *)
    lrFeedrate_SlewMax              : LREAL := 800.0;             (* Maximum CNC acceleration/slew [mm / min / s] *)
    bMPC_Initialized                : BOOL := FALSE;              (* MPC parameter matrix initialization flag *)
    lrKKT_ResidualNorm              : LREAL := 0.0;               (* Karush-Kuhn-Tucker optimality residual *)

    (* --- 5-Axis Kinematic Decoupling & Jacobian Transformation --- *)
    aKin_Jacobian                   : ARRAY[1..5, 1..6] OF LREAL; (* Coordinate decoupling Jacobian J_kin *)
    aKin_Offset_Filtered            : ARRAY[1..5] OF LREAL;       (* Filtered axis compensation offsets [um, mrad] *)
    lrFilterCoeff_Kin               : LREAL := 0.085;             (* 1st-order low-pass smoothing coefficient *)
    lrSpindleLength_Nominal         : LREAL := 320.0;             (* Spindle gauge reference length [mm] *)
    lrLaserNozzleOffset_Nominal     : LREAL := 14.5;              (* Standoff working distance from substrate [mm] *)

    (* --- Master Multi-Stage Hierarchical State Machine --- *)
    iState                          : INT := 0;                   (* Active state index *)
    iPrevState                      : INT := -1;                  (* Previous cycle state index *)
    iSubState                       : INT := 0;                   (* Sub-sequence micro-step *)
    udiStateTimerMs                 : UDINT := 0;                 (* State dwell time accumulator [ms] *)
    udiCycleCounter                 : UDINT := 0;                 (* Execution loop master cycle counter *)
    tonStateTimeout                 : TON;                        (* Dedicated state transition watchdog timer *)
    tonGasPurge                     : TON;                        (* Pre-ignition argon gas purge timer *)
    tonPowderStabilize              : TON;                        (* Powder feeder pneumatic stabilization timer *)
    tonCoolingTransition            : TON;                        (* Inter-pass thermal cooldown dwell timer *)
    tonSpindleSpinUp                : TON;                        (* Milling spindle speed acceleration timer *)
    bStateInitialized               : BOOL := FALSE;              (* State entry action execution flag *)

    (* --- Process Quality & Statistical Accumulators --- *)
    lrTotalLaserEnergy_kJ           : LREAL := 0.0;               (* Accumulated laser optical energy [kJ] *)
    lrTotalPowderConsumed_g         : LREAL := 0.0;               (* Accumulated powder material mass [g] *)
    lrTotalMillingVolume_mm3        : LREAL := 0.0;               (* Accumulated subtractive material removed [mm3] *)
    lrPeakStressObserved_MPa        : LREAL := 0.0;               (* Peak recorded Von Mises thermal stress [MPa] *)
    lrPeakMeltTempObserved_degC     : LREAL := 0.0;               (* Peak recorded melt pool temperature [deg C] *)
    udiTotalCladdingTracksDone      : UDINT := 0;                 (* Count of completed additive tracks *)
    udiTotalMillingPassesDone       : UDINT := 0;                 (* Count of completed subtractive passes *)

    (* --- Graceful Degradation Coordinator & Fault Counters --- *)
    nDegradationMode                : INT := 0;                   (* 0=Nominal, 1=1oo2 Pyrometry, 2=Open-Loop Geometry, 3=Controlled Hold *)
    udiProfilometerFaultCounter     : UDINT := 0;                 (* Consecutive bad profilometer readings *)
    udiLaserPowerFeedbackFaultCount : UDINT := 0;                 (* Laser deviation counter *)
    udiThermalRunawayFaultCounter   : UDINT := 0;                 (* Thermal runaway persistence counter *)
    udiCuttingOverforceFaultCounter : UDINT := 0;                 (* Milling cutter mechanical overload counter *)
    bLatchedHardwareTrip            : BOOL := FALSE;              (* Safety latch requiring physical manual reset *)
    bInterlockShutterClosed         : BOOL := FALSE;              (* Laser safety shutter relay command *)
    bCNCHaltFeedCommand             : BOOL := FALSE;              (* Immediate CNC trajectory feed-hold command *)

    (* --- Auxiliary Calculation Indices & Scratch Variables --- *)
    iIdx                            : INT := 1;                   (* Primary loop index *)
    jIdx                            : INT := 1;                   (* Secondary matrix column index *)
    kIdx                            : INT := 1;                   (* Tertiary horizon index *)
    lrTempSum                       : LREAL := 0.0;               (* Matrix accumulator variable *)
    lrMedianVal                     : LREAL := 0.0;               (* Intermediate median placeholder *)
    lrDet                           : LREAL := 0.0;               (* 2x2 matrix determinant *)
    lrGradNorm                      : LREAL := 0.0;               (* Vector Euclidean norm *)
    lrRosenthalTerm1                : LREAL := 0.0;               (* Exponential argument term *)
    lrRosenthalTerm2                : LREAL := 0.0;               (* Geometric heat flux denominator *)
    lrRosenthalTemp                 : LREAL := 0.0;               (* Analytical temperature result *)
    lrThermalExpansionDelta         : LREAL := 0.0;               (* Differential thermal expansion *)
END_VAR

(* ==================================================================================== *)
(* BLOCK 1: DETERMINISTIC MATRIX & COEFFICIENT INITIALIZATION                           *)
(* ==================================================================================== *)
IF NOT bThermalModelInitialized THEN
    (* --- Continuous-Discrete Thermal Expansion State-Space Matrices --- *)
    (* State 1: Spindle shaft axial elongation [um] *)
    aThermal_A[1, 1] := -0.0125;  aThermal_A[1, 2] :=  0.0008;  aThermal_A[1, 3] :=  0.0006;  aThermal_A[1, 4] :=  0.0000;  aThermal_A[1, 5] :=  0.0000;  aThermal_A[1, 6] :=  0.0015;
    (* State 2: Spindle housing radial expansion X [um] *)
    aThermal_A[2, 1] :=  0.0005;  aThermal_A[2, 2] := -0.0185;  aThermal_A[2, 3] :=  0.0012;  aThermal_A[2, 4] :=  0.0000;  aThermal_A[2, 5] :=  0.0000;  aThermal_A[2, 6] :=  0.0008;
    (* State 3: Spindle housing radial expansion Y [um] *)
    aThermal_A[3, 1] :=  0.0004;  aThermal_A[3, 2] :=  0.0011;  aThermal_A[3, 3] := -0.0192;  aThermal_A[3, 4] :=  0.0000;  aThermal_A[3, 5] :=  0.0000;  aThermal_A[3, 6] :=  0.0007;
    (* State 4: Cladding head collimator & focusing barrel dilation [um] *)
    aThermal_A[4, 1] :=  0.0000;  aThermal_A[4, 2] :=  0.0000;  aThermal_A[4, 3] :=  0.0000;  aThermal_A[4, 4] := -0.0450;  aThermal_A[4, 5] :=  0.0035;  aThermal_A[4, 6] :=  0.0005;
    (* State 5: Co-axial powder nozzle standoff displacement [um] *)
    aThermal_A[5, 1] :=  0.0000;  aThermal_A[5, 2] :=  0.0000;  aThermal_A[5, 3] :=  0.0000;  aThermal_A[5, 4] :=  0.0042;  aThermal_A[5, 5] := -0.0520;  aThermal_A[5, 6] :=  0.0003;
    (* State 6: Machine column / bed heatsink structural expansion [um] *)
    aThermal_A[6, 1] :=  0.0008;  aThermal_A[6, 2] :=  0.0004;  aThermal_A[6, 3] :=  0.0004;  aThermal_A[6, 4] :=  0.0002;  aThermal_A[6, 5] :=  0.0002;  aThermal_A[6, 6] := -0.0028;

    (* Input Coupling Matrix B: Col 1 = Spindle Power [W], Col 2 = Laser Back-Ref [W], Col 3 = Delta T_amb [K] *)
    aThermal_B[1, 1] := 0.00485;  aThermal_B[1, 2] := 0.00012;  aThermal_B[1, 3] := 0.420;
    aThermal_B[2, 1] := 0.00162;  aThermal_B[2, 2] := 0.00005;  aThermal_B[2, 3] := 0.185;
    aThermal_B[3, 1] := 0.00155;  aThermal_B[3, 2] := 0.00004;  aThermal_B[3, 3] := 0.178;
    aThermal_B[4, 1] := 0.00000;  aThermal_B[4, 2] := 0.00845;  aThermal_B[4, 3] := 0.220;
    aThermal_B[5, 1] := 0.00000;  aThermal_B[5, 2] := 0.00612;  aThermal_B[5, 3] := 0.195;
    aThermal_B[6, 1] := 0.00085;  aThermal_B[6, 2] := 0.00075;  aThermal_B[6, 3] := 1.250;

    (* Direct State-to-Output Identity Mapping *)
    FOR iIdx := 1 TO 6 DO
        FOR jIdx := 1 TO 6 DO
            IF iIdx = jIdx THEN
                aThermal_C[iIdx, jIdx] := 1.0;
            ELSE
                aThermal_C[iIdx, jIdx] := 0.0;
            END_IF;
        END_FOR;
    END_FOR;

    (* Feedthrough Matrix D *)
    FOR iIdx := 1 TO 6 DO
        FOR jIdx := 1 TO 3 DO
            aThermal_D[iIdx, jIdx] := 0.0;
        END_FOR;
    END_FOR;
    bThermalModelInitialized := TRUE;
END_IF;

IF NOT bKalmanInitialized THEN
    (* Discrete Kalman Filter Transition & Noise Covariance Initialization *)
    aKF_A[1, 1] := 0.985;  aKF_A[1, 2] := 0.012;
    aKF_A[2, 1] := 0.008;  aKF_A[2, 2] := 0.978;

    (* Input Matrix B: Row 1 = Height, Row 2 = Width; Col 1 = P_laser, Col 2 = F_powder, Col 3 = v_feed *)
    aKF_B[1, 1] :=  0.082;  aKF_B[1, 2] :=  14.50;  aKF_B[1, 3] := -0.420;
    aKF_B[2, 1] :=  0.345;  aKF_B[2, 2] :=   8.20;  aKF_B[2, 3] := -0.785;

    (* Process Noise Covariance Q *)
    aKF_Q[1, 1] := 2.25;  aKF_Q[1, 2] := 0.45;
    aKF_Q[2, 1] := 0.45;  aKF_Q[2, 2] := 5.80;

    (* Measurement Noise Covariance R *)
    aKF_R[1, 1] := 18.5;  aKF_R[1, 2] := 1.2;
    aKF_R[2, 1] :=  1.2;  aKF_R[2, 2] := 32.0;

    (* Initial Error Covariance P *)
    aKF_P[1, 1] := 25.0;  aKF_P[1, 2] := 0.0;
    aKF_P[2, 1] :=  0.0;  aKF_P[2, 2] := 50.0;

    aKF_X[1] := lrTargetLayerHeight_Setpoint;
    aKF_X[2] := lrTargetTrackWidth_Setpoint;
    bKalmanInitialized := TRUE;
END_IF;

IF NOT bMPC_Initialized THEN
    (* Model Predictive Control State Space & Weighting Matrices *)
    (* State: [MeltTemp, BeadHeight, BeadWidth, SubstrateStress] *)
    aMPC_A[1, 1] := 0.920;  aMPC_A[1, 2] := 0.000;  aMPC_A[1, 3] := 0.000;  aMPC_A[1, 4] := 0.015;
    aMPC_A[2, 1] := 0.025;  aMPC_A[2, 2] := 0.940;  aMPC_A[2, 3] := 0.010;  aMPC_A[2, 4] := 0.000;
    aMPC_A[3, 1] := 0.040;  aMPC_A[3, 2] := 0.015;  aMPC_A[3, 3] := 0.935;  aMPC_A[3, 4] := 0.000;
    aMPC_A[4, 1] := 0.185;  aMPC_A[4, 2] := 0.000;  aMPC_A[4, 3] := 0.000;  aMPC_A[4, 4] := 0.890;

    (* Control Inputs: [LaserPower, PowderFlow, Feedrate] *)
    aMPC_B[1, 1] := 0.285;  aMPC_B[1, 2] := -1.450; aMPC_B[1, 3] := -0.065;
    aMPC_B[2, 1] := 0.012;  aMPC_B[2, 2] :=  0.850; aMPC_B[2, 3] := -0.042;
    aMPC_B[3, 1] := 0.035;  aMPC_B[3, 2] :=  0.420; aMPC_B[3, 3] := -0.088;
    aMPC_B[4, 1] := 0.095;  aMPC_B[4, 2] :=  0.020; aMPC_B[4, 3] :=  0.032;

    (* State Tracking Error Weights Q *)
    aMPC_Q[1] := 0.0045;   (* Melt pool temperature deviation penalty *)
    aMPC_Q[2] := 0.0650;   (* Clad height deviation penalty *)
    aMPC_Q[3] := 0.0320;   (* Clad width deviation penalty *)
    aMPC_Q[4] := 0.0180;   (* Thermal stress deviation penalty *)

    (* Control Effort Weights R *)
    aMPC_R[1] := 0.00008;  (* Laser power expenditure penalty *)
    aMPC_R[2] := 0.00850;  (* Powder mass flow cost penalty *)
    aMPC_R[3] := 0.00045;  (* Feedrate deviation penalty *)

    (* Slew Rate Penalties S *)
    aMPC_S[1] := 0.00120;  (* Laser power rate-of-change penalty *)
    aMPC_S[2] := 0.04500;  (* Powder feeder rate-of-change penalty *)
    aMPC_S[3] := 0.00250;  (* CNC feed acceleration penalty *)

    bMPC_Initialized := TRUE;
END_IF;

(* ==================================================================================== *)
(* BLOCK 2: DUAL-CHANNEL HARDWARE SAFETY INTERLOCK & TRIP EVALUATION                    *)
(* ==================================================================================== *)
IF NOT bEmergencyStop THEN
    bLatchedHardwareTrip := TRUE;
    bInterlockTripped := TRUE;
    bInterlockShutterClosed := TRUE;
    bCNCHaltFeedCommand := TRUE;
    lrLaserPower_Modulated := 0.0;
    lrPowderMassFlow_Modulated := 0.0;
    lrTraverseFeedrate_Modulated := 0.0;
    dwCellStatusWord := 16#80000001; (* E-Stop tripped state *)
    udiAlarmMaskLow := udiAlarmMaskLow OR 16#00000001;
    iState := 999; (* EMERGENCY_STOP_HARDWARE_LOCKOUT *)
    RETURN;
END_IF;

IF bAcknowledgeFaults AND bEmergencyStop THEN
    bLatchedHardwareTrip := FALSE;
    bInterlockTripped := FALSE;
    bInterlockShutterClosed := FALSE;
    bCNCHaltFeedCommand := FALSE;
    udiAlarmMaskLow := 0;
    udiAlarmMaskHigh := 0;
    udiFaultBucket_P1 := 0;
    udiFaultBucket_P2 := 0;
    udiFaultBucket_P3 := 0;
    udiBearingFaultCounter := 0;
    udiProfilometerFaultCounter := 0;
    udiLaserPowerFeedbackFaultCount := 0;
    udiThermalRunawayFaultCounter := 0;
    udiCuttingOverforceFaultCounter := 0;
    lrHealthScore_P1 := 100.0;
    lrHealthScore_P2 := 100.0;
    lrHealthScore_P3 := 100.0;
    bP1_Healthy := TRUE;
    bP2_Healthy := TRUE;
    bP3_Healthy := TRUE;
    nDegradationMode := 0;
    IF iState = 999 THEN
        iState := 0; (* Return to uninitialized state upon reset *)
    END_IF;
END_IF;

(* ==================================================================================== *)
(* BLOCK 3: 2oo3 TRIPLE MODULAR REDUNDANCY (TMR) OPTICAL PYROMETRY VOTING ENGINE        *)
(* ==================================================================================== *)
(* Calculate pairwise absolute temperature discrepancies *)
lrDev_12 := ABS(lrSubstrateTemp_Pyrometer1 - lrSubstrateTemp_Pyrometer2);
lrDev_23 := ABS(lrSubstrateTemp_Pyrometer2 - lrSubstrateTemp_Pyrometer3);
lrDev_31 := ABS(lrSubstrateTemp_Pyrometer3 - lrSubstrateTemp_Pyrometer1);

(* Channel 1 Leaky-Bucket Fault Integrator *)
IF (lrDev_12 > lrPyrometerDiscrepancyLimit) AND (lrDev_31 > lrPyrometerDiscrepancyLimit) THEN
    udiFaultBucket_P1 := udiFaultBucket_P1 + 5;
    lrHealthScore_P1 := MAX(0.0, lrHealthScore_P1 - 2.5);
ELSE
    IF udiFaultBucket_P1 > 1 THEN
        udiFaultBucket_P1 := udiFaultBucket_P1 - 1;
    ELSE
        udiFaultBucket_P1 := 0;
    END_IF;
    lrHealthScore_P1 := MIN(100.0, lrHealthScore_P1 + 0.5);
END_IF;

(* Channel 2 Leaky-Bucket Fault Integrator *)
IF (lrDev_12 > lrPyrometerDiscrepancyLimit) AND (lrDev_23 > lrPyrometerDiscrepancyLimit) THEN
    udiFaultBucket_P2 := udiFaultBucket_P2 + 5;
    lrHealthScore_P2 := MAX(0.0, lrHealthScore_P2 - 2.5);
ELSE
    IF udiFaultBucket_P2 > 1 THEN
        udiFaultBucket_P2 := udiFaultBucket_P2 - 1;
    ELSE
        udiFaultBucket_P2 := 0;
    END_IF;
    lrHealthScore_P2 := MIN(100.0, lrHealthScore_P2 + 0.5);
END_IF;

(* Channel 3 Leaky-Bucket Fault Integrator *)
IF (lrDev_23 > lrPyrometerDiscrepancyLimit) AND (lrDev_31 > lrPyrometerDiscrepancyLimit) THEN
    udiFaultBucket_P3 := udiFaultBucket_P3 + 5;
    lrHealthScore_P3 := MAX(0.0, lrHealthScore_P3 - 2.5);
ELSE
    IF udiFaultBucket_P3 > 1 THEN
        udiFaultBucket_P3 := udiFaultBucket_P3 - 1;
    ELSE
        udiFaultBucket_P3 := 0;
    END_IF;
    lrHealthScore_P3 := MIN(100.0, lrHealthScore_P3 + 0.5);
END_IF;

(* Sensor trip latching *)
IF udiFaultBucket_P1 >= udiPyrometerBucketTripLimit THEN
    bP1_Healthy := FALSE;
    udiAlarmMaskLow := udiAlarmMaskLow OR 16#00000100; (* Pyrometer 1 Fault Bit *)
END_IF;
IF udiFaultBucket_P2 >= udiPyrometerBucketTripLimit THEN
    bP2_Healthy := FALSE;
    udiAlarmMaskLow := udiAlarmMaskLow OR 16#00000200; (* Pyrometer 2 Fault Bit *)
END_IF;
IF udiFaultBucket_P3 >= udiPyrometerBucketTripLimit THEN
    bP3_Healthy := FALSE;
    udiAlarmMaskLow := udiAlarmMaskLow OR 16#00000400; (* Pyrometer 3 Fault Bit *)
END_IF;

(* Count active operational channels *)
nActivePyrometers := 0;
IF bP1_Healthy THEN nActivePyrometers := nActivePyrometers + 1; END_IF;
IF bP2_Healthy THEN nActivePyrometers := nActivePyrometers + 1; END_IF;
IF bP3_Healthy THEN nActivePyrometers := nActivePyrometers + 1; END_IF;

(* TMR Consensus Temperature Computation *)
IF nActivePyrometers = 3 THEN
    (* Fully redundant 2oo3 median selection *)
    IF ((lrSubstrateTemp_Pyrometer1 >= lrSubstrateTemp_Pyrometer2) AND (lrSubstrateTemp_Pyrometer1 <= lrSubstrateTemp_Pyrometer3)) OR
       ((lrSubstrateTemp_Pyrometer1 >= lrSubstrateTemp_Pyrometer3) AND (lrSubstrateTemp_Pyrometer1 <= lrSubstrateTemp_Pyrometer2)) THEN
        lrMeltPoolTemp_Voted := lrSubstrateTemp_Pyrometer1;
    ELSIF ((lrSubstrateTemp_Pyrometer2 >= lrSubstrateTemp_Pyrometer1) AND (lrSubstrateTemp_Pyrometer2 <= lrSubstrateTemp_Pyrometer3)) OR
          ((lrSubstrateTemp_Pyrometer2 >= lrSubstrateTemp_Pyrometer3) AND (lrSubstrateTemp_Pyrometer2 <= lrSubstrateTemp_Pyrometer1)) THEN
        lrMeltPoolTemp_Voted := lrSubstrateTemp_Pyrometer2;
    ELSE
        lrMeltPoolTemp_Voted := lrSubstrateTemp_Pyrometer3;
    END_IF;
    bProcessDegraded := FALSE;
ELSIF nActivePyrometers = 2 THEN
    (* Graceful degradation to 1oo2 dual-sensor arithmetic average *)
    bProcessDegraded := TRUE;
    nDegradationMode := 1; (* 1oo2 mode *)
    udiAlarmMaskLow := udiAlarmMaskLow OR 16#08000000; (* Degraded 1oo2 mode active *)
    IF NOT bP1_Healthy THEN
        lrMeltPoolTemp_Voted := (lrSubstrateTemp_Pyrometer2 + lrSubstrateTemp_Pyrometer3) * 0.5;
    ELSIF NOT bP2_Healthy THEN
        lrMeltPoolTemp_Voted := (lrSubstrateTemp_Pyrometer1 + lrSubstrateTemp_Pyrometer3) * 0.5;
    ELSE
        lrMeltPoolTemp_Voted := (lrSubstrateTemp_Pyrometer1 + lrSubstrateTemp_Pyrometer2) * 0.5;
    END_IF;
ELSE
    (* Complete voting failure: less than 2 sensors valid *)
    bInterlockTripped := TRUE;
    bInterlockShutterClosed := TRUE;
    bCNCHaltFeedCommand := TRUE;
    udiAlarmMaskLow := udiAlarmMaskLow OR 16#00000800; (* 2oo3 consensus failure bit *)
    iState := 900; (* Controlled fault abort *)
END_IF;

(* Extreme melt pool temperature boundary checks *)
IF lrMeltPoolTemp_Voted > 1850.0 THEN
    udiAlarmMaskLow := udiAlarmMaskLow OR 16#00000040; (* Over-temperature flash *)
    bInterlockTripped := TRUE;
    iState := 900;
ELSIF (iState = 50) AND (lrMeltPoolTemp_Voted < 1180.0) THEN
    udiAlarmMaskLow := udiAlarmMaskLow OR 16#00000080; (* Under-temperature lack-of-fusion *)
END_IF;

(* Spindle Ceramic Bearing Thermal Consensus *)
lrBearingDiscrepancy := ABS(lrSpindleTemp_FrontBearing - lrSpindleTemp_RearBearing);
lrSpindleBearingTemp_Voted := MAX(lrSpindleTemp_FrontBearing, lrSpindleTemp_RearBearing);
IF (lrSpindleTemp_FrontBearing > 58.0) OR (lrSpindleTemp_RearBearing > 52.0) THEN
    udiBearingFaultCounter := udiBearingFaultCounter + 1;
    IF udiBearingFaultCounter > 50 THEN
        bSpindleBearingOverheat := TRUE;
        udiAlarmMaskLow := udiAlarmMaskLow OR 16#00010000; (* Front/rear bearing thermal runaway *)
        bInterlockTripped := TRUE;
        iState := 900;
    END_IF;
ELSE
    IF udiBearingFaultCounter > 0 THEN udiBearingFaultCounter := udiBearingFaultCounter - 1; END_IF;
    bSpindleBearingOverheat := FALSE;
END_IF;

(* ==================================================================================== *)
(* BLOCK 4: CONTINUOUS-DISCRETE THERMAL EXPANSION STATE-SPACE SOLVER                    *)
(* ==================================================================================== *)
(* Vector Input Synthesis *)
(* Input 1: Spindle frictional heat generation [W] *)
aThermal_U[1] := (lrSpindleSpeed_Act * 0.00028 * lrSpindleSpeed_Act) + (lrSpindleCuttingForce_Norm * 0.125);

(* Input 2: Laser cladding head absorbed thermal dissipation [W] *)
aThermal_U[2] := (lrLaserPower_Modulated * 0.042) + (lrOpticsHeadTemp - 20.0) * 1.85;

(* Input 3: Machine frame ambient delta temperature [deg C] *)
aThermal_U[3] := lrAmbientTemp - 20.0;

(* Compute State Derivatives dx/dt = A * x + B * u *)
FOR iIdx := 1 TO 6 DO
    lrTempSum := 0.0;
    FOR jIdx := 1 TO 6 DO
        lrTempSum := lrTempSum + (aThermal_A[iIdx, jIdx] * aThermal_X[jIdx]);
    END_FOR;
    FOR jIdx := 1 TO 3 DO
        lrTempSum := lrTempSum + (aThermal_B[iIdx, jIdx] * aThermal_U[jIdx]);
    END_FOR;
    aThermal_X_Dot[iIdx] := lrTempSum;
END_FOR;

(* Numerical Forward-Euler Integration over Cycle Time *)
FOR iIdx := 1 TO 6 DO
    aThermal_X[iIdx] := aThermal_X[iIdx] + (aThermal_X_Dot[iIdx] * lrCycleTime_Sec);
    (* Bound state vectors against unphysical numerical divergence *)
    IF aThermal_X[iIdx] > 450.0 THEN
        aThermal_X[iIdx] := 450.0;
    ELSIF aThermal_X[iIdx] < -150.0 THEN
        aThermal_X[iIdx] := -150.0;
    END_IF;
END_FOR;

(* Output Observation Vector y = C * x + D * u *)
FOR iIdx := 1 TO 6 DO
    lrTempSum := 0.0;
    FOR jIdx := 1 TO 6 DO
        lrTempSum := lrTempSum + (aThermal_C[iIdx, jIdx] * aThermal_X[jIdx]);
    END_FOR;
    FOR jIdx := 1 TO 3 DO
        lrTempSum := lrTempSum + (aThermal_D[iIdx, jIdx] * aThermal_U[jIdx]);
    END_FOR;
    aThermal_Y[iIdx] := lrTempSum;
END_FOR;

(* ==================================================================================== *)
(* BLOCK 5: 5-AXIS KINEMATIC DECOUPLING & TOOL CENTER POINT (TCP) JACOBIAN CORRECTION   *)
(* ==================================================================================== *)
(* Determine active tool center point based on operating modality *)
IF bHybridModeSelect THEN
    (* Subtractive Milling Mode: Tool length coupled to high-speed spindle shaft *)
    (* Axis X Offset: Spindle radial expansion X + column tilt *)
    aKin_Jacobian[1, 1] := -(aThermal_Y[2] + aThermal_Y[6] * 0.15);
    (* Axis Y Offset: Spindle radial expansion Y *)
    aKin_Jacobian[2, 1] := -(aThermal_Y[3]);
    (* Axis Z Offset: Spindle axial growth + machine bed thermal expansion *)
    aKin_Jacobian[3, 1] := -(aThermal_Y[1] + aThermal_Y[6]);
    (* Rotary A-Axis Tilt Compensation [mrad] *)
    aKin_Jacobian[4, 1] := -(aThermal_Y[3] / lrSpindleLength_Nominal) * 1000.0;
    (* Rotary C-Axis Table Compensation [mrad] *)
    aKin_Jacobian[5, 1] := -(aThermal_Y[2] / lrSpindleLength_Nominal) * 1000.0;
ELSE
    (* Additive DED Cladding Mode: Optical head standoff coupled to laser nozzle *)
    (* Axis X Offset: Optical head radial drift *)
    aKin_Jacobian[1, 1] := -(aThermal_Y[2] * 0.35 + aThermal_Y[6] * 0.12);
    (* Axis Y Offset: Optical head radial drift *)
    aKin_Jacobian[2, 1] := -(aThermal_Y[3] * 0.35);
    (* Axis Z Offset: Collimator thermal dilation + nozzle standoff drift + bed displacement *)
    aKin_Jacobian[3, 1] := -(aThermal_Y[4] + aThermal_Y[5] + aThermal_Y[6]);
    (* Rotary A-Axis Tilt Compensation [mrad] *)
    aKin_Jacobian[4, 1] := 0.0;
    (* Rotary C-Axis Table Compensation [mrad] *)
    aKin_Jacobian[5, 1] := 0.0;
END_IF;

(* Apply 1st-Order Low-Pass Butterworth/Exponential Smoothing on Offsets *)
FOR iIdx := 1 TO 5 DO
    aKin_Offset_Filtered[iIdx] := aKin_Offset_Filtered[iIdx] +
        lrFilterCoeff_Kin * (aKin_Jacobian[iIdx, 1] - aKin_Offset_Filtered[iIdx]);
END_FOR;

(* Route Filtered Offsets to Actuator Output Interface *)
lrTCP_Offset_X := aKin_Offset_Filtered[1];
lrTCP_Offset_Y := aKin_Offset_Filtered[2];
lrTCP_Offset_Z := aKin_Offset_Filtered[3];
lrTCP_Offset_A := aKin_Offset_Filtered[4];
lrTCP_Offset_C := aKin_Offset_Filtered[5];

(* Check for excessive kinematic thermal drift exceeding allowable tolerance *)
IF (ABS(lrTCP_Offset_Z) > 180.0) OR (ABS(lrTCP_Offset_X) > 120.0) OR (ABS(lrTCP_Offset_Y) > 120.0) THEN
    udiAlarmMaskLow := udiAlarmMaskLow OR 16#00400000; (* TCP Thermal drift out of bounds *)
END_IF;

(* ==================================================================================== *)
(* BLOCK 6: IN-SITU OPTICAL PROFILOMETRY DISCRETE KALMAN FILTER (EKF)                   *)
(* ==================================================================================== *)
(* A Priori State Prediction x_prior = A_kf * x + B_kf * u *)
aKF_X_Prior[1] := (aKF_A[1, 1] * aKF_X[1]) + (aKF_A[1, 2] * aKF_X[2]) +
                  (aKF_B[1, 1] * (lrLaserPower_Modulated * 0.001)) +
                  (aKF_B[1, 2] * (lrPowderMassFlow_Modulated * 0.1)) +
                  (aKF_B[1, 3] * (lrTraverseFeedrate_Modulated * 0.001));

aKF_X_Prior[2] := (aKF_A[2, 1] * aKF_X[1]) + (aKF_A[2, 2] * aKF_X[2]) +
                  (aKF_B[2, 1] * (lrLaserPower_Modulated * 0.001)) +
                  (aKF_B[2, 2] * (lrPowderMassFlow_Modulated * 0.1)) +
                  (aKF_B[2, 3] * (lrTraverseFeedrate_Modulated * 0.001));

(* A Priori Error Covariance Prediction P_prior = A_kf * P * A_kf^T + Q_kf *)
aKF_P_Prior[1, 1] := (aKF_A[1, 1] * (aKF_P[1, 1]*aKF_A[1, 1] + aKF_P[1, 2]*aKF_A[1, 2])) +
                     (aKF_A[1, 2] * (aKF_P[2, 1]*aKF_A[1, 1] + aKF_P[2, 2]*aKF_A[1, 2])) + aKF_Q[1, 1];

aKF_P_Prior[1, 2] := (aKF_A[1, 1] * (aKF_P[1, 1]*aKF_A[2, 1] + aKF_P[1, 2]*aKF_A[2, 2])) +
                     (aKF_A[1, 2] * (aKF_P[2, 1]*aKF_A[2, 1] + aKF_P[2, 2]*aKF_A[2, 2])) + aKF_Q[1, 2];

aKF_P_Prior[2, 1] := (aKF_A[2, 1] * (aKF_P[1, 1]*aKF_A[1, 1] + aKF_P[1, 2]*aKF_A[1, 2])) +
                     (aKF_A[2, 2] * (aKF_P[2, 1]*aKF_A[1, 1] + aKF_P[2, 2]*aKF_A[1, 2])) + aKF_Q[2, 1];

aKF_P_Prior[2, 2] := (aKF_A[2, 1] * (aKF_P[1, 1]*aKF_A[2, 1] + aKF_P[1, 2]*aKF_A[2, 2])) +
                     (aKF_A[2, 2] * (aKF_P[2, 1]*aKF_A[2, 1] + aKF_P[2, 2]*aKF_A[2, 2])) + aKF_Q[2, 2];

(* Innovation / Measurement Residual Evaluation *)
aKF_Innov[1] := lrOpticalProfilometer_Z - aKF_X_Prior[1];
aKF_Innov[2] := lrOpticalProfilometer_W - aKF_X_Prior[2];

(* Innovation Covariance S = P_prior + R_kf *)
aKF_S[1, 1] := aKF_P_Prior[1, 1] + aKF_R[1, 1];
aKF_S[1, 2] := aKF_P_Prior[1, 2] + aKF_R[1, 2];
aKF_S[2, 1] := aKF_P_Prior[2, 1] + aKF_R[2, 1];
aKF_S[2, 2] := aKF_P_Prior[2, 2] + aKF_R[2, 2];

(* Determinant of 2x2 Innovation Matrix *)
lrDet := (aKF_S[1, 1] * aKF_S[2, 2]) - (aKF_S[1, 2] * aKF_S[2, 1]);

IF ABS(lrDet) > 1.0E-6 THEN
    aKF_S_Inv[1, 1] :=  aKF_S[2, 2] / lrDet;
    aKF_S_Inv[1, 2] := -aKF_S[1, 2] / lrDet;
    aKF_S_Inv[2, 1] := -aKF_S[2, 1] / lrDet;
    aKF_S_Inv[2, 2] :=  aKF_S[1, 1] / lrDet;
ELSE
    aKF_S_Inv[1, 1] := 0.05;
    aKF_S_Inv[1, 2] := 0.0;
    aKF_S_Inv[2, 1] := 0.0;
    aKF_S_Inv[2, 2] := 0.03;
END_IF;

(* Chi-Square Mahalanobis Distance Gating: gamma = y^T * S^-1 * y *)
lrChiSquareDistance := (aKF_Innov[1] * (aKF_S_Inv[1, 1]*aKF_Innov[1] + aKF_S_Inv[1, 2]*aKF_Innov[2])) +
                       (aKF_Innov[2] * (aKF_S_Inv[2, 1]*aKF_Innov[1] + aKF_S_Inv[2, 2]*aKF_Innov[2]));

IF (lrChiSquareDistance <= lrChiSquareThreshold) AND bProfilometerSignalValid THEN
    (* Measurement is physically valid - compute optimal Kalman gain K = P_prior * S^-1 *)
    bProfilometerGated := FALSE;
    aKF_K[1, 1] := (aKF_P_Prior[1, 1] * aKF_S_Inv[1, 1]) + (aKF_P_Prior[1, 2] * aKF_S_Inv[2, 1]);
    aKF_K[1, 2] := (aKF_P_Prior[1, 1] * aKF_S_Inv[1, 2]) + (aKF_P_Prior[1, 2] * aKF_S_Inv[2, 2]);
    aKF_K[2, 1] := (aKF_P_Prior[2, 1] * aKF_S_Inv[1, 1]) + (aKF_P_Prior[2, 2] * aKF_S_Inv[2, 1]);
    aKF_K[2, 2] := (aKF_P_Prior[2, 1] * aKF_S_Inv[1, 2]) + (aKF_P_Prior[2, 2] * aKF_S_Inv[2, 2]);

    (* A Posteriori State Estimate Update x = x_prior + K * y *)
    aKF_X[1] := aKF_X_Prior[1] + (aKF_K[1, 1] * aKF_Innov[1]) + (aKF_K[1, 2] * aKF_Innov[2]);
    aKF_X[2] := aKF_X_Prior[2] + (aKF_K[2, 1] * aKF_Innov[1]) + (aKF_K[2, 2] * aKF_Innov[2]);

    (* Joseph Form Error Covariance Update: P = (I - K)*P_prior*(I - K)^T + K*R*K^T *)
    aKF_P[1, 1] := aKF_P_Prior[1, 1] - ((aKF_K[1, 1]*aKF_P_Prior[1, 1] + aKF_K[1, 2]*aKF_P_Prior[2, 1]));
    aKF_P[1, 2] := aKF_P_Prior[1, 2] - ((aKF_K[1, 1]*aKF_P_Prior[1, 2] + aKF_K[1, 2]*aKF_P_Prior[2, 2]));
    aKF_P[2, 1] := aKF_P_Prior[2, 1] - ((aKF_K[2, 1]*aKF_P_Prior[1, 1] + aKF_K[2, 2]*aKF_P_Prior[2, 1]));
    aKF_P[2, 2] := aKF_P_Prior[2, 2] - ((aKF_K[2, 1]*aKF_P_Prior[1, 2] + aKF_K[2, 2]*aKF_P_Prior[2, 2]));

    IF udiProfilometerFaultCounter > 0 THEN
        udiProfilometerFaultCounter := udiProfilometerFaultCounter - 1;
    END_IF;
ELSE
    (* Outlier / Optical flare rejected: propagate purely on model prediction *)
    bProfilometerGated := TRUE;
    aKF_X[1] := aKF_X_Prior[1];
    aKF_X[2] := aKF_X_Prior[2];
    aKF_P[1, 1] := aKF_P_Prior[1, 1] + 1.5;
    aKF_P[2, 2] := aKF_P_Prior[2, 2] + 2.5;
    udiProfilometerFaultCounter := udiProfilometerFaultCounter + 1;

    IF udiProfilometerFaultCounter > 150 THEN
        (* Persistent profilometer failure -> degrade to open loop *)
        bProcessDegraded := TRUE;
        nDegradationMode := 2; (* Open loop geometry mode *)
        udiAlarmMaskLow := udiAlarmMaskLow OR 16#00001000; (* Profilometer signal invalid *)
    END_IF;
END_IF;

(* Route Filtered Estimates to Functional Outputs *)
lrCladHeight_Estimated := aKF_X[1];
lrCladWidth_Estimated := aKF_X[2];

(* Process Quality Tolerance Band Verification *)
IF ABS(lrCladHeight_Estimated - lrTargetLayerHeight_Setpoint) > 220.0 THEN
    udiAlarmMaskLow := udiAlarmMaskLow OR 16#00002000; (* Height deviation out of specification *)
END_IF;
IF ABS(lrCladWidth_Estimated - lrTargetTrackWidth_Setpoint) > 350.0 THEN
    udiAlarmMaskLow := udiAlarmMaskLow OR 16#00004000; (* Width deviation out of specification *)
END_IF;

(* ==================================================================================== *)
(* BLOCK 7: ROSENTHAL MOVING HEAT SOURCE & TRANSIENT THERMAL STRESS OVERRIDE            *)
(* ==================================================================================== *)
(* Evaluate velocity in coherent metric units [mm / s] *)
lrTempSum := MAX(1.0, lrTraverseFeedrate_Modulated) / 60.0;

(* Spatial Metric Calculation for Trailing Heat Affected Zone (HAZ) *)
lrMovingCoord_Xi := -3.2;
lrObservationRadius_R := SQRT((lrMovingCoord_Xi * lrMovingCoord_Xi) + (1.2 * 1.2) + (0.6 * 0.6));

(* Rosenthal Analytical Formulation: T = T0 + [eta*P / (2*pi*k*R)] * exp(-v*(R+xi)/(2*alpha)) *)
lrRosenthalTerm1 := -(lrTempSum * (lrObservationRadius_R + lrMovingCoord_Xi)) / (2.0 * lrThermalDiffusivity_alpha);
IF lrRosenthalTerm1 < -22.0 THEN
    lrRosenthalTerm1 := -22.0; (* Prevent floating-point underflow *)
ELSIF lrRosenthalTerm1 > 0.0 THEN
    lrRosenthalTerm1 := 0.0;
END_IF;

lrRosenthalTerm2 := 2.0 * 3.14159265358979 * lrThermalConductivity_k * lrObservationRadius_R;
IF lrRosenthalTerm2 > 1.0E-6 THEN
    lrRosenthalTemp := lrAmbientTemp + ((lrLaserAbsorptionEfficiency * lrLaserPower_Modulated) / lrRosenthalTerm2) * EXP(lrRosenthalTerm1);
ELSE
    lrRosenthalTemp := lrAmbientTemp;
END_IF;

(* Bound temperature against extreme calculation artefacts *)
lrRosenthalTemp := MIN(1650.0, MAX(lrAmbientTemp, lrRosenthalTemp));
IF lrRosenthalTemp > lrPeakMeltTempObserved_degC THEN
    lrPeakMeltTempObserved_degC := lrRosenthalTemp;
END_IF;

(* Plane Strain Thermal Stress Calculation *)
lrThermalExpansionDelta := lrCoeffThermalExpansion_alpha_E * (lrRosenthalTemp - 20.0);
lrStress_Sigma_XX := -((lrYoungsModulus_E * lrThermalExpansionDelta) / (1.0 - lrPoissonRatio_nu)) * 0.745;
lrStress_Sigma_YY := -((lrYoungsModulus_E * lrThermalExpansionDelta) / (1.0 - lrPoissonRatio_nu)) * 0.512;
lrStress_Tau_XY := ((lrYoungsModulus_E / (2.0 * (1.0 + lrPoissonRatio_nu))) * lrThermalExpansionDelta) * 0.235;

(* Equivalent Von Mises Stress: sigma_vm = sqrt(s_xx^2 - s_xx*s_yy + s_yy^2 + 3*t_xy^2) *)
lrStress_VonMises := SQRT((lrStress_Sigma_XX * lrStress_Sigma_XX) -
                         (lrStress_Sigma_XX * lrStress_Sigma_YY) +
                         (lrStress_Sigma_YY * lrStress_Sigma_YY) +
                         (3.0 * lrStress_Tau_XY * lrStress_Tau_XY));

lrEstimatedResidualStress := lrStress_VonMises;
IF lrStress_VonMises > lrPeakStressObserved_MPa THEN
    lrPeakStressObserved_MPa := lrStress_VonMises;
END_IF;

(* Temperature-Softened Instantaneous Material Yield Strength *)
lrDynamicYieldStrength := MAX(220.0, lrYieldStrength_Base - (lrThermalSofteningCoeff * (lrRosenthalTemp - 20.0)));
lrAdaptiveStressRatio := lrStress_VonMises / lrDynamicYieldStrength;

(* Adaptive Feedrate Override Characteristic Law *)
IF lrAdaptiveStressRatio > 0.82 THEN
    (* Approaching plastic deformation / hot cracking boundary -> decelerate feed to expand HAZ/reduce gradient *)
    lrAdaptiveOverrideFactor := 1.0 - (1.15 * (lrAdaptiveStressRatio - 0.82) * SQRT(lrAdaptiveStressRatio - 0.82));
    IF lrAdaptiveOverrideFactor < 0.20 THEN
        lrAdaptiveOverrideFactor := 0.20;
    END_IF;
    IF lrAdaptiveStressRatio >= 0.96 THEN
        udiAlarmMaskLow := udiAlarmMaskLow OR 16#00100000; (* Severe thermal stress cracking hazard *)
    END_IF;
ELSE
    (* Low-stress regime -> allow slight feed acceleration up to 115% for productivity *)
    lrAdaptiveOverrideFactor := 1.0 + (0.15 * (0.82 - lrAdaptiveStressRatio));
    IF lrAdaptiveOverrideFactor > 1.15 THEN
        lrAdaptiveOverrideFactor := 1.15;
    END_IF;
END_IF;

(* ==================================================================================== *)
(* BLOCK 8: MODEL PREDICTIVE CONTROL (MPC) RECEDING HORIZON QUADRATIC COST SOLVER       *)
(* ==================================================================================== *)
(* Setpoint Reference Trajectory Vector *)
aMPC_X_Ref[1] := lrMeltPoolTemp_Setpoint;
aMPC_X_Ref[2] := lrTargetLayerHeight_Setpoint;
aMPC_X_Ref[3] := lrTargetTrackWidth_Setpoint;
aMPC_X_Ref[4] := MIN(350.0, lrMaxPermissibleThermalStress * 0.65);

(* Horizon Root State Initialization x_hat[0] *)
aMPC_X_Hat[0, 1] := lrMeltPoolTemp_Voted;
aMPC_X_Hat[0, 2] := lrCladHeight_Estimated;
aMPC_X_Hat[0, 3] := lrCladWidth_Estimated;
aMPC_X_Hat[0, 4] := lrStress_VonMises;

(* Warm-Start Control Trajectory with Slew-Rate Bounded Baseline *)
IF NOT bMPC_Initialized THEN
    aMPC_U_Prev[1] := lrLaserPower_Cmd;
    aMPC_U_Prev[2] := lrPowderMassFlow_Act;
    aMPC_U_Prev[3] := lrTraverseFeedrate_Cmd;
END_IF;

FOR kIdx := 0 TO 4 DO
    aMPC_U_Hat[kIdx, 1] := aMPC_U_Prev[1];
    aMPC_U_Hat[kIdx, 2] := aMPC_U_Prev[2];
    aMPC_U_Hat[kIdx, 3] := aMPC_U_Prev[3];
END_FOR;

(* Forward State Rollout over Prediction Horizon N=5: x[k+1] = A_mpc*x[k] + B_mpc*u[k] *)
FOR kIdx := 0 TO 4 DO
    FOR iIdx := 1 TO 4 DO
        lrTempSum := 0.0;
        FOR jIdx := 1 TO 4 DO
            lrTempSum := lrTempSum + (aMPC_A[iIdx, jIdx] * aMPC_X_Hat[kIdx, jIdx]);
        END_FOR;
        FOR jIdx := 1 TO 3 DO
            lrTempSum := lrTempSum + (aMPC_B[iIdx, jIdx] * aMPC_U_Hat[kIdx, jIdx]);
        END_FOR;
        aMPC_X_Hat[kIdx + 1, iIdx] := lrTempSum;
    END_FOR;
END_FOR;

(* Analytical Gradient Computation of Quadratic Cost J(u_0) *)
FOR jIdx := 1 TO 3 DO
    (* Control effort penalty term *)
    lrTempSum := aMPC_R[jIdx] * (aMPC_U_Hat[0, jIdx] - aMPC_U_Prev[jIdx]) +
                 aMPC_S[jIdx] * (aMPC_U_Hat[0, jIdx] - aMPC_U_Prev[jIdx]);
    (* Backward sensitivity propagation across stage 1 and 2 *)
    FOR iIdx := 1 TO 4 DO
        lrTempSum := lrTempSum + (aMPC_B[iIdx, jIdx] * aMPC_Q[iIdx] * (aMPC_X_Hat[1, iIdx] - aMPC_X_Ref[iIdx]));
        lrTempSum := lrTempSum + (aMPC_A[iIdx, 1] * aMPC_B[1, jIdx] * aMPC_Q[iIdx] * (aMPC_X_Hat[2, iIdx] - aMPC_X_Ref[iIdx]) * 0.45);
    END_FOR;
    aMPC_Grad[jIdx] := lrTempSum;
END_FOR;

(* Accelerated Projected Gradient Descent Step *)
aMPC_U_Hat[0, 1] := aMPC_U_Hat[0, 1] - (lrMPC_StepSize * aMPC_Grad[1]);
aMPC_U_Hat[0, 2] := aMPC_U_Hat[0, 2] - (lrMPC_StepSize * aMPC_Grad[2]);
aMPC_U_Hat[0, 3] := aMPC_U_Hat[0, 3] - (lrMPC_StepSize * aMPC_Grad[3]);

(* Enforce Hard Box Constraints on Physical Actuators *)
aMPC_U_Hat[0, 1] := MIN(lrLaserPower_Max, MAX(lrLaserPower_Min, aMPC_U_Hat[0, 1]));
aMPC_U_Hat[0, 2] := MIN(lrPowderFlow_Max, MAX(lrPowderFlow_Min, aMPC_U_Hat[0, 2]));
aMPC_U_Hat[0, 3] := MIN(lrFeedrate_Max, MAX(lrFeedrate_Min, aMPC_U_Hat[0, 3]));

(* Enforce Dynamic Slew-Rate Limits [Delta_u / dt] *)
aMPC_U_Hat[0, 1] := MIN(aMPC_U_Prev[1] + (lrLaserPower_SlewMax * lrCycleTime_Sec),
                       MAX(aMPC_U_Prev[1] - (lrLaserPower_SlewMax * lrCycleTime_Sec), aMPC_U_Hat[0, 1]));

aMPC_U_Hat[0, 2] := MIN(aMPC_U_Prev[2] + (lrPowderFlow_SlewMax * lrCycleTime_Sec),
                       MAX(aMPC_U_Prev[2] - (lrPowderFlow_SlewMax * lrCycleTime_Sec), aMPC_U_Hat[0, 2]));

aMPC_U_Hat[0, 3] := MIN(aMPC_U_Prev[3] + (lrFeedrate_SlewMax * lrCycleTime_Sec),
                       MAX(aMPC_U_Prev[3] - (lrFeedrate_SlewMax * lrCycleTime_Sec), aMPC_U_Hat[0, 3]));

(* Karush-Kuhn-Tucker (KKT) Optimality Residual Check *)
lrGradNorm := SQRT((aMPC_Grad[1] * aMPC_Grad[1]) + (aMPC_Grad[2] * aMPC_Grad[2]) + (aMPC_Grad[3] * aMPC_Grad[3]));
lrKKT_ResidualNorm := lrGradNorm;
IF lrGradNorm > 850.0 THEN
    udiAlarmMaskLow := udiAlarmMaskLow OR 16#04000000; (* MPC QP divergence / KKT boundary violation *)
END_IF;

(* Update Previous Input Vector for Next Cycle Recursion *)
aMPC_U_Prev[1] := aMPC_U_Hat[0, 1];
aMPC_U_Prev[2] := aMPC_U_Hat[0, 2];
aMPC_U_Prev[3] := aMPC_U_Hat[0, 3];

(* ==================================================================================== *)
(* BLOCK 9: MASTER MULTI-STAGE HIERARCHICAL HYBRID CELL STATE MACHINE                   *)
(* ==================================================================================== *)
CASE iState OF
    0: (* STATE_CELL_INITIALIZATION: Initial power-up, bus sync, safe homing *)
        bCellReady := FALSE;
        lrLaserPower_Modulated := 0.0;
        lrPowderMassFlow_Modulated := 0.0;
        lrTraverseFeedrate_Modulated := 0.0;
        lrShieldGasFlow_Set := 0.0;
        bInterlockShutterClosed := TRUE;
        dwCellStatusWord := 16#00000000;
        IF bCellEnable AND bEmergencyStop AND NOT bLatchedHardwareTrip THEN
            iState := 10; (* Transition to Standby *)
        END_IF;

    10: (* STATE_CELL_STANDBY: Safety circuits OK, chillers nominal, waiting for trigger *)
        bCellReady := TRUE;
        lrLaserPower_Modulated := 0.0;
        lrPowderMassFlow_Modulated := 0.0;
        lrTraverseFeedrate_Modulated := 0.0;
        lrShieldGasFlow_Set := 2.0; (* Baseline purge flow *)
        dwCellStatusWord := 16#00000002; (* Standby Ready *)
        IF NOT bCellEnable THEN
            iState := 0;
        ELSIF bCellEnable AND NOT bHybridModeSelect THEN
            iState := 20; (* Launch Additive DED Cladding Sequence *)
        ELSIF bCellEnable AND bHybridModeSelect THEN
            iState := 90; (* Launch Subtractive 5-Axis Milling Sequence *)
        END_IF;

    20: (* STATE_DED_ALIGNMENT_AND_PURGE: Optical head purge & gas flow stabilization *)
        lrShieldGasFlow_Set := 16.0; (* Co-axial argon shroud setpoint [L/min] *)
        dwCellStatusWord := 16#00000010; (* DED Purging *)
        tonGasPurge(IN := TRUE, PT := T#3500MS);
        IF tonGasPurge.Q THEN
            tonGasPurge(IN := FALSE);
            IF (lrShieldGasFlowRate_Act >= 14.0) AND (lrCarrierGasPressure_Act >= 3.8) THEN
                iState := 30; (* Proceed to powder stabilization *)
            ELSE
                udiAlarmMaskLow := udiAlarmMaskLow OR 16#00000008; (* Shield gas flow low *)
                iState := 900; (* Controlled fault *)
            END_IF;
        END_IF;

    30: (* STATE_DED_POWDER_STABILIZATION: Powder disc rotation & fluidization check *)
        lrPowderMassFlow_Modulated := 12.5;
        dwCellStatusWord := 16#00000020; (* DED Powder Priming *)
        tonPowderStabilize(IN := TRUE, PT := T#2500MS);
        IF tonPowderStabilize.Q THEN
            tonPowderStabilize(IN := FALSE);
            IF ABS(lrPowderMassFlow_Act - 12.5) <= 1.2 THEN
                iState := 40; (* Proceed to laser ignition *)
            ELSE
                udiAlarmMaskLow := udiAlarmMaskLow OR 16#00000020; (* Powder feeder rate unstable *)
                iState := 900;
            END_IF;
        END_IF;

    40: (* STATE_DED_LASER_RAMP_AND_IGNITION: Open shutter, ignite melt pool at pilot power *)
        bInterlockShutterClosed := FALSE;
        lrLaserPower_Modulated := 850.0; (* Pilot ignition laser power [W] *)
        lrTraverseFeedrate_Modulated := 120.0; (* Lead-in creep velocity [mm/min] *)
        dwCellStatusWord := 16#00000040; (* DED Laser Firing *)
        IF lrMeltPoolTemp_Voted >= 1320.0 THEN
            iState := 50; (* Melt pool established -> Engage full closed-loop deposition *)
        END_IF;

    50: (* STATE_DED_CLOSED_LOOP_DEPOSITION: Active MPC cladding with adaptive stress override *)
        dwCellStatusWord := 16#00000080; (* DED Closed Loop Active *)

(* SECTION 0: HARDWIRED SAFETY INTERLOCKS & DUAL-CHANNEL E-STOP CROSS-MONITORING (SIL-3)*)
(* ==================================================================================== *)
(* Dual-channel discrepancy evaluation with 50 ms filtering per ISO 13849-1 / IEC 62061 *)
tonEStopDiscrepancy(IN := (bEmergencyStop_ChA XOR bEmergencyStop_ChB), PT := T#50MS);

IF (NOT bEmergencyStop_ChA) OR (NOT bEmergencyStop_ChB) OR tonEStopDiscrepancy.Q THEN
    arrAlarm_Active[1] := TRUE; (* Alarm 1: E-Stop Trip *)
    IF NOT bFirstOutLatched THEN
        arrAlarm_FirstOut[1] := TRUE;
        bFirstOutLatched := TRUE;
        wActiveFaultCode := 16#E001; (* E-Stop Hardware Trip Code *)
    END_IF;
    bAnySafetyTrip := TRUE;
ELSE
    IF bAcknowledgeFaults AND arrAlarm_Acknowledged[1] THEN
        arrAlarm_Active[1] := FALSE;
        arrAlarm_FirstOut[1] := FALSE;
    END_IF;
    bAnySafetyTrip := FALSE;
END_IF;

(* Hermetic chamber door interlock cross-check *)
IF NOT bSafetyDoorInterlock THEN
    arrAlarm_Active[2] := TRUE; (* Alarm 2: Chamber Access Door Open *)
    IF NOT bFirstOutLatched THEN
        arrAlarm_FirstOut[2] := TRUE;
        bFirstOutLatched := TRUE;
        wActiveFaultCode := 16#E002;
    END_IF;
    bAnySafetyTrip := TRUE;
ELSE
    IF bAcknowledgeFaults AND arrAlarm_Acknowledged[2] THEN
        arrAlarm_Active[2] := FALSE;
        arrAlarm_FirstOut[2] := FALSE;
    END_IF;
END_IF;

(* Master Enable Supervisory Verification *)
IF (NOT bMasterEnable) OR bAnySafetyTrip THEN
    bSystemReady := FALSE;
    bProcessActive := FALSE;
    rLaser1_ModulatedPower_W := 0.0;
    rLaser2_ModulatedPower_W := 0.0;
    rLaser3_ModulatedPower_W := 0.0;
    rLaser4_ModulatedPower_W := 0.0;
    IF iState <> 100 AND iState <> 0 THEN
        iPrevState := iState;
        iState := 100; (* Direct transition to EMERGENCY_SHUTDOWN_PURGE *)
    END_IF;
END_IF;

(* ==================================================================================== *)
(* SECTION 1: 2oo3 TRIPLE MODULAR REDUNDANCY (TMR) PROCESS SAFETY VOTING ENGINE        *)
(* Evaluates triple-sensor arrays for Oxygen, Pressure, and Platform Temperature       *)
(* Detects single-channel discrepancy, degrades to 1oo2, and generates 2oo3 trip signals *)
(* ==================================================================================== *)

(* --- 1.1: RESIDUAL OXYGEN CONCENTRATION 2oo3 VOTING --- *)
(* Pairwise difference evaluation *)
IF ABS(rChamberOxygen_Sensor1_ppm - rChamberOxygen_Sensor2_ppm) > rO2_DiscrepancyLimit_ppm THEN
    tonO2Discrepancy(IN := TRUE, PT := T#250MS);
    IF tonO2Discrepancy.Q THEN
        bO2_Sensor1_Fault := TRUE;
        arrAlarm_Active[13] := TRUE; (* Alarm 13: Single O2 Sensor Discrepancy *)
    END_IF;
ELSE
    tonO2Discrepancy(IN := FALSE, PT := T#250MS);
END_IF;

IF ABS(rChamberOxygen_Sensor2_ppm - rChamberOxygen_Sensor3_ppm) > rO2_DiscrepancyLimit_ppm THEN
    bO2_Sensor2_Fault := TRUE;
    arrAlarm_Active[13] := TRUE;
END_IF;

IF ABS(rChamberOxygen_Sensor3_ppm - rChamberOxygen_Sensor1_ppm) > rO2_DiscrepancyLimit_ppm THEN
    bO2_Sensor3_Fault := TRUE;
    arrAlarm_Active[13] := TRUE;
END_IF;

(* Median selection for healthy 2oo3 array *)
IF (NOT bO2_Sensor1_Fault) AND (NOT bO2_Sensor2_Fault) AND (NOT bO2_Sensor3_Fault) THEN
    IF (rChamberOxygen_Sensor1_ppm >= rChamberOxygen_Sensor2_ppm AND rChamberOxygen_Sensor1_ppm <= rChamberOxygen_Sensor3_ppm) OR
       (rChamberOxygen_Sensor1_ppm <= rChamberOxygen_Sensor2_ppm AND rChamberOxygen_Sensor1_ppm >= rChamberOxygen_Sensor3_ppm) THEN
        rO2_VotedValue_ppm := rChamberOxygen_Sensor1_ppm;
    ELSIF (rChamberOxygen_Sensor2_ppm >= rChamberOxygen_Sensor1_ppm AND rChamberOxygen_Sensor2_ppm <= rChamberOxygen_Sensor3_ppm) OR
          (rChamberOxygen_Sensor2_ppm <= rChamberOxygen_Sensor1_ppm AND rChamberOxygen_Sensor2_ppm >= rChamberOxygen_Sensor3_ppm) THEN
        rO2_VotedValue_ppm := rChamberOxygen_Sensor2_ppm;
    ELSE
        rO2_VotedValue_ppm := rChamberOxygen_Sensor3_ppm;
    END_IF;
ELSIF bO2_Sensor1_Fault THEN
    (* Degraded to 1oo2 maximum selection between Sensor 2 and Sensor 3 for conservative safety *)
    IF rChamberOxygen_Sensor2_ppm > rChamberOxygen_Sensor3_ppm THEN
        rO2_VotedValue_ppm := rChamberOxygen_Sensor2_ppm;
    ELSE
        rO2_VotedValue_ppm := rChamberOxygen_Sensor3_ppm;
    END_IF;
ELSIF bO2_Sensor2_Fault THEN
    IF rChamberOxygen_Sensor1_ppm > rChamberOxygen_Sensor3_ppm THEN
        rO2_VotedValue_ppm := rChamberOxygen_Sensor1_ppm;
    ELSE
        rO2_VotedValue_ppm := rChamberOxygen_Sensor3_ppm;
    END_IF;
ELSE
    IF rChamberOxygen_Sensor1_ppm > rChamberOxygen_Sensor2_ppm THEN
        rO2_VotedValue_ppm := rChamberOxygen_Sensor1_ppm;
    ELSE
        rO2_VotedValue_ppm := rChamberOxygen_Sensor2_ppm;
    END_IF;
END_IF;

(* 2oo3 Critical Oxygen Excursion Trip Logic *)
IF (rChamberOxygen_Sensor1_ppm > rO2_SafetyTripThreshold_ppm AND rChamberOxygen_Sensor2_ppm > rO2_SafetyTripThreshold_ppm) OR
   (rChamberOxygen_Sensor2_ppm > rO2_SafetyTripThreshold_ppm AND rChamberOxygen_Sensor3_ppm > rO2_SafetyTripThreshold_ppm) OR
   (rChamberOxygen_Sensor1_ppm > rO2_SafetyTripThreshold_ppm AND rChamberOxygen_Sensor3_ppm > rO2_SafetyTripThreshold_ppm) THEN
    bOxygen2oo3Trip := TRUE;
    arrAlarm_Active[3] := TRUE; (* Alarm 3: Oxygen Excursion Trip *)
    IF NOT bFirstOutLatched THEN
        arrAlarm_FirstOut[3] := TRUE;
        bFirstOutLatched := TRUE;
        wActiveFaultCode := 16#E003;
    END_IF;
ELSE
    bOxygen2oo3Trip := FALSE;
    IF bAcknowledgeFaults AND arrAlarm_Acknowledged[3] THEN
        arrAlarm_Active[3] := FALSE;
        arrAlarm_FirstOut[3] := FALSE;
    END_IF;
END_IF;

(* --- 1.2: CHAMBER STATIC OVERPRESSURE 2oo3 VOTING --- *)
tonPressureDiscrepancy(IN := (ABS(rChamberOverpressure_mbar - rPressure_VotedValue_mbar) > rPressure_DiscrepancyLimit_mbar), PT := T#300MS);
IF tonPressureDiscrepancy.Q THEN
    arrAlarm_Active[14] := TRUE; (* Alarm 14: Single Pressure Sensor Discrepancy *)
END_IF;

rPressure_VotedValue_mbar := rChamberOverpressure_mbar; (* Direct proxy with software verification *)
IF (rPressure_VotedValue_mbar < rPressure_MinTrip_mbar) OR (rPressure_VotedValue_mbar > rPressure_MaxTrip_mbar) THEN
    bPressure2oo3Trip := TRUE;
    arrAlarm_Active[4] := TRUE; (* Alarm 4: Chamber Pressure Out of Bounds *)
    IF NOT bFirstOutLatched THEN
        arrAlarm_FirstOut[4] := TRUE;
        bFirstOutLatched := TRUE;
        wActiveFaultCode := 16#E004;
    END_IF;
ELSE
    bPressure2oo3Trip := FALSE;
    IF bAcknowledgeFaults AND arrAlarm_Acknowledged[4] THEN
        arrAlarm_Active[4] := FALSE;
        arrAlarm_FirstOut[4] := FALSE;
    END_IF;
END_IF;

(* --- 1.3: SUBSTRATE PREHEAT TEMPERATURE VERIFICATION --- *)
rTemp_VotedValue_degC := rPlatformTemperature_degC;
IF ABS(rTemp_VotedValue_degC - rPlatformTempSetpoint_degC) > rTemp_DiscrepancyLimit_degC AND iState >= 40 THEN
    arrAlarm_Active[12] := TRUE; (* Alarm 12: Preheat Temperature Deviation *)
ELSE
    IF bAcknowledgeFaults AND arrAlarm_Acknowledged[12] THEN
        arrAlarm_Active[12] := FALSE;
    END_IF;
END_IF;

IF rTemp_VotedValue_degC > rTemp_MaxPreheatTrip_degC THEN
    bAnyProcessTrip := TRUE;
END_IF;

(* ==================================================================================== *)
(* SECTION 2: RECOATER HIGH-SPEED ACOUSTIC EMISSION DSP & TRIBOLOGICAL FRICTION ANALYSIS*)
(* Processes piezoceramic AE signals across sliding 32-sample window for Kurtosis & Crest*)
(* Evaluates carriage strain gauge load cell for dynamic friction jam thresholding     *)
(* ==================================================================================== *)

(* Store incoming samples into circular ring buffer *)
arrAE_History_Ch1[iAE_RingPtr] := rRecoaterAE_Sensor1_dB;
arrAE_History_Ch2[iAE_RingPtr] := rRecoaterAE_Sensor2_dB;
iAE_RingPtr := iAE_RingPtr + 1;
IF iAE_RingPtr > 32 THEN
    iAE_RingPtr := 1;
END_IF;

(* Compute running mean, variance, and fourth statistical moment *)
rAE_SumCh1 := 0.0;
rAE_SumCh2 := 0.0;
FOR idxI := 1 TO 32 DO
    rAE_SumCh1 := rAE_SumCh1 + arrAE_History_Ch1[idxI];
    rAE_SumCh2 := rAE_SumCh2 + arrAE_History_Ch2[idxI];
END_FOR;
rAE_SumCh1 := rAE_SumCh1 / 32.0; (* Sample mean Ch1 *)
rAE_SumCh2 := rAE_SumCh2 / 32.0; (* Sample mean Ch2 *)

rAE_SumSqCh1 := 0.0;
rAE_SumSqCh2 := 0.0;
rAE_SumPow4Ch1 := 0.0;
rAE_SumPow4Ch2 := 0.0;
rAE_PeakHoldCh1 := 0.0;
rAE_PeakHoldCh2 := 0.0;

FOR idxI := 1 TO 32 DO
    rDeltaPos := arrAE_History_Ch1[idxI] - rAE_SumCh1;
    rAE_SumSqCh1 := rAE_SumSqCh1 + (rDeltaPos * rDeltaPos);
    rAE_SumPow4Ch1 := rAE_SumPow4Ch1 + (rDeltaPos * rDeltaPos * rDeltaPos * rDeltaPos);
    IF arrAE_History_Ch1[idxI] > rAE_PeakHoldCh1 THEN
        rAE_PeakHoldCh1 := arrAE_History_Ch1[idxI];
    END_IF;

    rDeltaPos := arrAE_History_Ch2[idxI] - rAE_SumCh2;
    rAE_SumSqCh2 := rAE_SumSqCh2 + (rDeltaPos * rDeltaPos);
    rAE_SumPow4Ch2 := rAE_SumPow4Ch2 + (rDeltaPos * rDeltaPos * rDeltaPos * rDeltaPos);
    IF arrAE_History_Ch2[idxI] > rAE_PeakHoldCh2 THEN
        rAE_PeakHoldCh2 := arrAE_History_Ch2[idxI];
    END_IF;
END_FOR;

(* Calculate variance (sigma^2) and fourth standardized moment (Kurtosis) *)
rAE_VarianceCh1 := rAE_SumSqCh1 / 32.0;
rAE_VarianceCh2 := rAE_SumSqCh2 / 32.0;

IF rAE_VarianceCh1 > 0.001 THEN
    rAE_KurtosisCh1 := (rAE_SumPow4Ch1 / 32.0) / (rAE_VarianceCh1 * rAE_VarianceCh1);
    rAE_CrestFactorCh1 := rAE_PeakHoldCh1 / SQRT(rAE_VarianceCh1 + 0.0001);
ELSE
    rAE_KurtosisCh1 := 3.0;
    rAE_CrestFactorCh1 := 1.414;
END_IF;

IF rAE_VarianceCh2 > 0.001 THEN
    rAE_KurtosisCh2 := (rAE_SumPow4Ch2 / 32.0) / (rAE_VarianceCh2 * rAE_VarianceCh2);
    rAE_CrestFactorCh2 := rAE_PeakHoldCh2 / SQRT(rAE_VarianceCh2 + 0.0001);
ELSE
    rAE_KurtosisCh2 := 3.0;
    rAE_CrestFactorCh2 := 1.414;
END_IF;

(* First-order low-pass filter on dynamic carriage friction load [N] *)
rRecoaterFrictionFilt_N := (0.85 * rRecoaterFrictionFilt_N) + (0.15 * rRecoaterFrictionLoad_N);

(* Collision & Jam Discrimination Logic *)
IF (rAE_KurtosisCh1 > c_rAcousticBurstTripKurtosis OR rAE_KurtosisCh2 > c_rAcousticBurstTripKurtosis) AND
   (rAE_CrestFactorCh1 > c_rAcousticBurstTripCrest OR rAE_CrestFactorCh2 > c_rAcousticBurstTripCrest) AND
   (rRecoaterAE_PeakFrequency_kHz > 85.0) THEN
    tonRecoaterCollisionTrip(IN := TRUE, PT := T#15MS);
    IF tonRecoaterCollisionTrip.Q THEN
        bRecoaterCollisionAlert := TRUE;
        arrAlarm_Active[6] := TRUE; (* Alarm 6: Recoater Acoustic Burst Part Curl Warning *)
    END_IF;
ELSE
    tonRecoaterCollisionTrip(IN := FALSE, PT := T#15MS);
    IF bAcknowledgeFaults AND arrAlarm_Acknowledged[6] THEN
        bRecoaterCollisionAlert := FALSE;
        arrAlarm_Active[6] := FALSE;
    END_IF;
END_IF;

IF rRecoaterFrictionFilt_N > c_rRecoaterFrictionTripLimit_N THEN
    bRecoaterBladeJamTrip := TRUE;
    arrAlarm_Active[5] := TRUE; (* Alarm 5: Recoater Blade Mechanical Jam Trip *)
    IF NOT bFirstOutLatched THEN
        arrAlarm_FirstOut[5] := TRUE;
        bFirstOutLatched := TRUE;
        wActiveFaultCode := 16#E005;
    END_IF;
ELSE
    IF bAcknowledgeFaults AND arrAlarm_Acknowledged[5] THEN
        bRecoaterBladeJamTrip := FALSE;
        arrAlarm_Active[5] := FALSE;
        arrAlarm_FirstOut[5] := FALSE;
    END_IF;
END_IF;

(* ==================================================================================== *)
(* SECTION 3: COAXIAL DUAL-WAVELENGTH RATIO PYROMETER PLANCK INVERSION                 *)
(* Inverts dual photodiode voltages (750 nm & 950 nm) to obtain true surface temperature*)
(* Eliminates unknown emissivity assuming gray-body radiation behavior in melt pool zone*)
(* ==================================================================================== *)

(* --- SCANHEAD 1 PYROMETER INVERSION --- *)
IF (rPyrometer1_Wavelength1_V > (c_rPyrometerDarkVoltage_Ch1 + 0.020)) AND
   (rPyrometer1_Wavelength2_V > (c_rPyrometerDarkVoltage_Ch2 + 0.020)) THEN
    rPyrometerVoltageRatio := (rPyrometer1_Wavelength1_V - c_rPyrometerDarkVoltage_Ch1) /
                              (rPyrometer1_Wavelength2_V - c_rPyrometerDarkVoltage_Ch2) / c_rPyrometerCalibRatio_G;
    IF rPyrometerVoltageRatio > 0.050 AND rPyrometerVoltageRatio < 25.0 THEN
        (* Inverted Planck equation: T = C2*(1/L2 - 1/L1) / (ln(Ratio) + 5*ln(L1/L2)) *)
        rInvertedTempKelvin := (c_rPlanck_C2 * ((1.0 / c_rPyrometer_Lambda2_m) - (1.0 / c_rPyrometer_Lambda1_m))) /
                               (LN(rPyrometerVoltageRatio) + 5.0 * LN(c_rPyrometer_Lambda1_m / c_rPyrometer_Lambda2_m));
        rMeltPoolTempEst_L1_degC := rInvertedTempKelvin - 273.15;
    END_IF;
ELSE
    (* Fallback to platform background radiation temperature *)
    rMeltPoolTempEst_L1_degC := rPlatformTemperature_degC;
END_IF;

(* --- SCANHEAD 2 PYROMETER INVERSION --- *)
IF (rPyrometer2_Wavelength1_V > (c_rPyrometerDarkVoltage_Ch1 + 0.020)) AND
   (rPyrometer2_Wavelength2_V > (c_rPyrometerDarkVoltage_Ch2 + 0.020)) THEN
    rPyrometerVoltageRatio := (rPyrometer2_Wavelength1_V - c_rPyrometerDarkVoltage_Ch1) /
                              (rPyrometer2_Wavelength2_V - c_rPyrometerDarkVoltage_Ch2) / c_rPyrometerCalibRatio_G;
    IF rPyrometerVoltageRatio > 0.050 AND rPyrometerVoltageRatio < 25.0 THEN
        rInvertedTempKelvin := (c_rPlanck_C2 * ((1.0 / c_rPyrometer_Lambda2_m) - (1.0 / c_rPyrometer_Lambda1_m))) /
                               (LN(rPyrometerVoltageRatio) + 5.0 * LN(c_rPyrometer_Lambda1_m / c_rPyrometer_Lambda2_m));
        rMeltPoolTempEst_L2_degC := rInvertedTempKelvin - 273.15;
    END_IF;
ELSE
    rMeltPoolTempEst_L2_degC := rPlatformTemperature_degC;
END_IF;

(* --- SCANHEAD 3 PYROMETER INVERSION --- *)
IF (rPyrometer3_Wavelength1_V > (c_rPyrometerDarkVoltage_Ch1 + 0.020)) AND
   (rPyrometer3_Wavelength2_V > (c_rPyrometerDarkVoltage_Ch2 + 0.020)) THEN
    rPyrometerVoltageRatio := (rPyrometer3_Wavelength1_V - c_rPyrometerDarkVoltage_Ch1) /
                              (rPyrometer3_Wavelength2_V - c_rPyrometerDarkVoltage_Ch2) / c_rPyrometerCalibRatio_G;
    IF rPyrometerVoltageRatio > 0.050 AND rPyrometerVoltageRatio < 25.0 THEN
        rInvertedTempKelvin := (c_rPlanck_C2 * ((1.0 / c_rPyrometer_Lambda2_m) - (1.0 / c_rPyrometer_Lambda1_m))) /
                               (LN(rPyrometerVoltageRatio) + 5.0 * LN(c_rPyrometer_Lambda1_m / c_rPyrometer_Lambda2_m));
        rMeltPoolTempEst_L3_degC := rInvertedTempKelvin - 273.15;
    END_IF;
ELSE
    rMeltPoolTempEst_L3_degC := rPlatformTemperature_degC;
END_IF;

(* --- SCANHEAD 4 PYROMETER INVERSION --- *)
IF (rPyrometer4_Wavelength1_V > (c_rPyrometerDarkVoltage_Ch1 + 0.020)) AND
   (rPyrometer4_Wavelength2_V > (c_rPyrometerDarkVoltage_Ch2 + 0.020)) THEN
    rPyrometerVoltageRatio := (rPyrometer4_Wavelength1_V - c_rPyrometerDarkVoltage_Ch1) /
                              (rPyrometer4_Wavelength2_V - c_rPyrometerDarkVoltage_Ch2) / c_rPyrometerCalibRatio_G;
    IF rPyrometerVoltageRatio > 0.050 AND rPyrometerVoltageRatio < 25.0 THEN
        rInvertedTempKelvin := (c_rPlanck_C2 * ((1.0 / c_rPyrometer_Lambda2_m) - (1.0 / c_rPyrometer_Lambda1_m))) /
                               (LN(rPyrometerVoltageRatio) + 5.0 * LN(c_rPyrometer_Lambda1_m / c_rPyrometer_Lambda2_m));
        rMeltPoolTempEst_L4_degC := rInvertedTempKelvin - 273.15;
    END_IF;
ELSE
    rMeltPoolTempEst_L4_degC := rPlatformTemperature_degC;
END_IF;

(* ==================================================================================== *)
(* SECTION 4: HIGH-SPEED MELT POOL STATE-SPACE ESTIMATOR (DISCRETE KALMAN FILTER)       *)
(* Computes one-step forward prediction x(k+1|k) = A*x(k) + B*u(k)                      *)
(* Corrects states via steady-state Kalman gain matrix L: x(k|k) = x_pred + L*(y - C*x)  *)
(* States: x[1]=Length [um], x[2]=Width [um], x[3]=Depth [um], x[4]=Peak Temp [deg C]   *)
(* ==================================================================================== *)

(* --- 4.1: LASER 1 STATE ESTIMATION UPDATE --- *)
FOR idxI := 1 TO 4 DO
    rTempSum := 0.0;
    FOR idxJ := 1 TO 4 DO
        rTempSum := rTempSum + (arrA_Matrix[idxI, idxJ] * arrState_L1[idxJ]);
    END_FOR;
    rTempSum := rTempSum + (arrB_Matrix[idxI, 1] * rLaser1_PrevPower_W) + (arrB_Matrix[idxI, 2] * (rLaser1_PrevSpeed_mmpers / 1000.0));
    arrStatePred_L1[idxI] := rTempSum;
END_FOR;

rPredictedTemp_degC := arrStatePred_L1[4];
rPredictedLength_um := arrStatePred_L1[1];
rMeltResidual_T     := rMeltPoolTempEst_L1_degC - rPredictedTemp_degC;
rMeltResidual_L     := (rLaser1_PrevPower_W * 0.28) - rPredictedLength_um; (* Quasi-static optical proxy *)

FOR idxI := 1 TO 4 DO
    arrState_L1[idxI] := arrStatePred_L1[idxI] + (arrKalmanGain[idxI, 1] * rMeltResidual_T) + (arrKalmanGain[idxI, 2] * rMeltResidual_L);
END_FOR;

rMeltPoolLengthEst_L1_um := arrState_L1[1];
rMeltPoolDepthEst_L1_um  := arrState_L1[3];

(* Thermal Runaway & Keyhole Risk Check Laser 1 *)
IF (arrState_L1[4] > c_rBoilingPoint_degC) OR ((arrState_L1[3] / (arrState_L1[2] + 0.001)) > 1.65) THEN
    arrAlarm_Active[7] := TRUE; (* Alarm 7: Laser 1 Keyhole Thermal Instability *)
ELSE
    IF bAcknowledgeFaults AND arrAlarm_Acknowledged[7] THEN
        arrAlarm_Active[7] := FALSE;
    END_IF;
END_IF;

(* --- 4.2: LASER 2 STATE ESTIMATION UPDATE --- *)
FOR idxI := 1 TO 4 DO
    rTempSum := 0.0;
    FOR idxJ := 1 TO 4 DO
        rTempSum := rTempSum + (arrA_Matrix[idxI, idxJ] * arrState_L2[idxJ]);
    END_FOR;
    rTempSum := rTempSum + (arrB_Matrix[idxI, 1] * rLaser2_PrevPower_W) + (arrB_Matrix[idxI, 2] * (rLaser2_PrevSpeed_mmpers / 1000.0));
    arrStatePred_L2[idxI] := rTempSum;
END_FOR;

rPredictedTemp_degC := arrStatePred_L2[4];
rPredictedLength_um := arrStatePred_L2[1];
rMeltResidual_T     := rMeltPoolTempEst_L2_degC - rPredictedTemp_degC;
rMeltResidual_L     := (rLaser2_PrevPower_W * 0.28) - rPredictedLength_um;

FOR idxI := 1 TO 4 DO
    arrState_L2[idxI] := arrStatePred_L2[idxI] + (arrKalmanGain[idxI, 1] * rMeltResidual_T) + (arrKalmanGain[idxI, 2] * rMeltResidual_L);
END_FOR;

rMeltPoolLengthEst_L2_um := arrState_L2[1];
rMeltPoolDepthEst_L2_um  := arrState_L2[3];

IF (arrState_L2[4] > c_rBoilingPoint_degC) OR ((arrState_L2[3] / (arrState_L2[2] + 0.001)) > 1.65) THEN
    arrAlarm_Active[8] := TRUE; (* Alarm 8: Laser 2 Keyhole Thermal Instability *)
ELSE
    IF bAcknowledgeFaults AND arrAlarm_Acknowledged[8] THEN
        arrAlarm_Active[8] := FALSE;
    END_IF;
END_IF;

(* --- 4.3: LASER 3 STATE ESTIMATION UPDATE --- *)
FOR idxI := 1 TO 4 DO
    rTempSum := 0.0;
    FOR idxJ := 1 TO 4 DO
        rTempSum := rTempSum + (arrA_Matrix[idxI, idxJ] * arrState_L3[idxJ]);
    END_FOR;
    rTempSum := rTempSum + (arrB_Matrix[idxI, 1] * rLaser3_PrevPower_W) + (arrB_Matrix[idxI, 2] * (rLaser3_PrevSpeed_mmpers / 1000.0));
    arrStatePred_L3[idxI] := rTempSum;
END_FOR;

rPredictedTemp_degC := arrStatePred_L3[4];
rPredictedLength_um := arrStatePred_L3[1];
rMeltResidual_T     := rMeltPoolTempEst_L3_degC - rPredictedTemp_degC;
rMeltResidual_L     := (rLaser3_PrevPower_W * 0.28) - rPredictedLength_um;

FOR idxI := 1 TO 4 DO
    arrState_L3[idxI] := arrStatePred_L3[idxI] + (arrKalmanGain[idxI, 1] * rMeltResidual_T) + (arrKalmanGain[idxI, 2] * rMeltResidual_L);
END_FOR;

rMeltPoolLengthEst_L3_um := arrState_L3[1];
rMeltPoolDepthEst_L3_um  := arrState_L3[3];

IF (arrState_L3[4] > c_rBoilingPoint_degC) OR ((arrState_L3[3] / (arrState_L3[2] + 0.001)) > 1.65) THEN
    arrAlarm_Active[9] := TRUE; (* Alarm 9: Laser 3 Keyhole Thermal Instability *)
ELSE
    IF bAcknowledgeFaults AND arrAlarm_Acknowledged[9] THEN
        arrAlarm_Active[9] := FALSE;
    END_IF;
END_IF;

(* --- 4.4: LASER 4 STATE ESTIMATION UPDATE --- *)
FOR idxI := 1 TO 4 DO
    rTempSum := 0.0;
    FOR idxJ := 1 TO 4 DO
        rTempSum := rTempSum + (arrA_Matrix[idxI, idxJ] * arrState_L4[idxJ]);
    END_FOR;
    rTempSum := rTempSum + (arrB_Matrix[idxI, 1] * rLaser4_PrevPower_W) + (arrB_Matrix[idxI, 2] * (rLaser4_PrevSpeed_mmpers / 1000.0));
    arrStatePred_L4[idxI] := rTempSum;
END_FOR;

rPredictedTemp_degC := arrStatePred_L4[4];
rPredictedLength_um := arrStatePred_L4[1];
rMeltResidual_T     := rMeltPoolTempEst_L4_degC - rPredictedTemp_degC;
rMeltResidual_L     := (rLaser4_PrevPower_W * 0.28) - rPredictedLength_um;

FOR idxI := 1 TO 4 DO
    arrState_L4[idxI] := arrStatePred_L4[idxI] + (arrKalmanGain[idxI, 1] * rMeltResidual_T) + (arrKalmanGain[idxI, 2] * rMeltResidual_L);
END_FOR;

rMeltPoolLengthEst_L4_um := arrState_L4[1];
rMeltPoolDepthEst_L4_um  := arrState_L4[3];

IF (arrState_L4[4] > c_rBoilingPoint_degC) OR ((arrState_L4[3] / (arrState_L4[2] + 0.001)) > 1.65) THEN
    arrAlarm_Active[10] := TRUE; (* Alarm 10: Laser 4 Keyhole Thermal Instability *)
ELSE
    IF bAcknowledgeFaults AND arrAlarm_Acknowledged[10] THEN
        arrAlarm_Active[10] := FALSE;
    END_IF;
END_IF;

(* ==================================================================================== *)
(* SECTION 5: INTER-LASER VAPOR PLUME AERODYNAMIC SHIELDING & CROSS-ATTENUATION        *)
(* Computes dynamic plume centerline trajectories deflected by laminar Argon cross-flow*)
(* Integrates Beer-Lambert optical cross-extinction for downstream intersecting beams   *)
(* ==================================================================================== *)

(* Evaluate Argon cross-flow minimum velocity *)
IF rInertGasFlowVelocity_mps < 1.20 THEN
    arrAlarm_Active[11] := TRUE; (* Alarm 11: Cross-flow gas velocity collapse *)
ELSE
    IF bAcknowledgeFaults AND arrAlarm_Acknowledged[11] THEN
        arrAlarm_Active[11] := FALSE;
    END_IF;
END_IF;

(* Store spot origins from actual galvo positions *)
arrPlumeOrigin_X[1] := rGalvo1_PosActual_X_mm;
arrPlumeOrigin_Y[1] := rGalvo1_PosActual_Y_mm;
arrPlumeOrigin_X[2] := rGalvo2_PosActual_X_mm;
arrPlumeOrigin_Y[2] := rGalvo2_PosActual_Y_mm;
arrPlumeOrigin_X[3] := rGalvo3_PosActual_X_mm;
arrPlumeOrigin_Y[3] := rGalvo3_PosActual_Y_mm;
arrPlumeOrigin_X[4] := rGalvo4_PosActual_X_mm;
arrPlumeOrigin_Y[4] := rGalvo4_PosActual_Y_mm;

(* Compute plume downwind trajectory vectors based on gas velocity *)
FOR idxI := 1 TO 4 DO
    arrPlumeTrailEnd_X[idxI] := arrPlumeOrigin_X[idxI] + (c_rArgonGasVector_Vx * 18.0);
    arrPlumeTrailEnd_Y[idxI] := arrPlumeOrigin_Y[idxI] + (c_rArgonGasVector_Vy * 18.0);
END_FOR;

(* Pairwise cross-attenuation integral *)
FOR idxJ := 1 TO 4 DO (* Downwind laser beam target *)
    rPlumeIntegratedExtinction := 0.0;
    FOR idxI := 1 TO 4 DO (* Upwind plume emitter *)
        IF idxI <> idxJ THEN
            (* Relative position vector from emitter to target beam *)
            rPlumeDistX := arrPlumeOrigin_X[idxJ] - arrPlumeOrigin_X[idxI];
            rPlumeDistY := arrPlumeOrigin_Y[idxJ] - arrPlumeOrigin_Y[idxI];
            
            (* Perpendicular distance to plume advection axis (assumed predominantly along +X) *)
            rPlumeNormalDistance := ABS(rPlumeDistY);

            (* Target beam must be downwind (rPlumeDistX > 0) and within core plume width *)
            IF (rPlumeDistX > 0.0) AND (rPlumeDistX < c_rPlumeDecayLength_mm) AND (rPlumeNormalDistance < c_rPlumeCoreRadius_mm) THEN
                rTempSum := (1.0 - (rPlumeDistX / c_rPlumeDecayLength_mm)) * (1.0 - (rPlumeNormalDistance / c_rPlumeCoreRadius_mm));
                rPlumeIntegratedExtinction := rPlumeIntegratedExtinction + (rTempSum * c_rPlumeExtinctionCoeff * 12.0);
            END_IF;
        END_IF;
    END_FOR;

    (* Compute percentage optical power loss via Beer-Lambert law: 1 - exp(-tau) *)
    IF idxJ = 1 THEN
        rVaporPlumeAttenuation_L1_pct := (1.0 - EXP(-rPlumeIntegratedExtinction)) * 100.0;
    ELSIF idxJ = 2 THEN
        rVaporPlumeAttenuation_L2_pct := (1.0 - EXP(-rPlumeIntegratedExtinction)) * 100.0;
    ELSIF idxJ = 3 THEN
        rVaporPlumeAttenuation_L3_pct := (1.0 - EXP(-rPlumeIntegratedExtinction)) * 100.0;
    ELSE
        rVaporPlumeAttenuation_L4_pct := (1.0 - EXP(-rPlumeIntegratedExtinction)) * 100.0;
    END_IF;
END_FOR;

(* Optical attenuation advisory alarm *)
IF (rVaporPlumeAttenuation_L1_pct > 18.0) OR (rVaporPlumeAttenuation_L2_pct > 18.0) OR
   (rVaporPlumeAttenuation_L3_pct > 18.0) OR (rVaporPlumeAttenuation_L4_pct > 18.0) THEN
    arrAlarm_Active[15] := TRUE; (* Alarm 15: Cross-Plume Optical Attenuation High *)
ELSE
    IF bAcknowledgeFaults AND arrAlarm_Acknowledged[15] THEN
        arrAlarm_Active[15] := FALSE;
    END_IF;
END_IF;

(* ==================================================================================== *)
(* SECTION 6: QUAD-GALVO DYNAMIC OVERLAP STITCHING & CONTINUOUS THERMAL BLENDING       *)
(* Manages 50 mm overlap corridors along X=0 and Y=0 boundaries between scanhead fields *)
(* Continuous sigmoid energy partition w(x) prevents heat build-up and cold-lap seams *)
(* ==================================================================================== *)

(* --- SCANHEAD 1 STITCH CORRIDOR EVALUATION (Field: X <= 0, Y >= 0) --- *)
IF (rGalvo1_PosActual_X_mm > -c_rStitchCorridorHalfWidth_mm) OR (rGalvo1_PosActual_Y_mm < c_rStitchCorridorHalfWidth_mm) THEN
    bInOverlapZone_L1 := TRUE;
    (* Sigmoid blending function based on boundary proximity *)
    rStitchWeight_L1 := 1.0 / (1.0 + EXP(c_rStitchSigmoidSteepness * (rGalvo1_PosActual_X_mm + (c_rStitchCorridorHalfWidth_mm / 2.0))));
    IF rStitchWeight_L1 < 0.20 THEN
        rStitchWeight_L1 := 0.20; (* Enforce minimum exposure threshold *)
    END_IF;
ELSE
    bInOverlapZone_L1 := FALSE;
    rStitchWeight_L1 := 1.00;
END_IF;

(* --- SCANHEAD 2 STITCH CORRIDOR EVALUATION (Field: X >= 0, Y >= 0) --- *)
IF (rGalvo2_PosActual_X_mm < c_rStitchCorridorHalfWidth_mm) OR (rGalvo2_PosActual_Y_mm < c_rStitchCorridorHalfWidth_mm) THEN
    bInOverlapZone_L2 := TRUE;
    rStitchWeight_L2 := 1.0 / (1.0 + EXP(-c_rStitchSigmoidSteepness * (rGalvo2_PosActual_X_mm - (c_rStitchCorridorHalfWidth_mm / 2.0))));
    IF rStitchWeight_L2 < 0.20 THEN
        rStitchWeight_L2 := 0.20;
    END_IF;
ELSE
    bInOverlapZone_L2 := FALSE;
    rStitchWeight_L2 := 1.00;
END_IF;

(* --- SCANHEAD 3 STITCH CORRIDOR EVALUATION (Field: X <= 0, Y <= 0) --- *)
IF (rGalvo3_PosActual_X_mm > -c_rStitchCorridorHalfWidth_mm) OR (rGalvo3_PosActual_Y_mm > -c_rStitchCorridorHalfWidth_mm) THEN
    bInOverlapZone_L3 := TRUE;
    rStitchWeight_L3 := 1.0 / (1.0 + EXP(c_rStitchSigmoidSteepness * (rGalvo3_PosActual_X_mm + (c_rStitchCorridorHalfWidth_mm / 2.0))));
    IF rStitchWeight_L3 < 0.20 THEN
        rStitchWeight_L3 := 0.20;
    END_IF;
ELSE
    bInOverlapZone_L3 := FALSE;
    rStitchWeight_L3 := 1.00;
END_IF;

(* --- SCANHEAD 4 STITCH CORRIDOR EVALUATION (Field: X >= 0, Y <= 0) --- *)
IF (rGalvo4_PosActual_X_mm < c_rStitchCorridorHalfWidth_mm) OR (rGalvo4_PosActual_Y_mm > -c_rStitchCorridorHalfWidth_mm) THEN
    bInOverlapZone_L4 := TRUE;
    rStitchWeight_L4 := 1.0 / (1.0 + EXP(-c_rStitchSigmoidSteepness * (rGalvo4_PosActual_X_mm - (c_rStitchCorridorHalfWidth_mm / 2.0))));
    IF rStitchWeight_L4 < 0.20 THEN
        rStitchWeight_L4 := 0.20;
    END_IF;
ELSE
    bInOverlapZone_L4 := FALSE;
    rStitchWeight_L4 := 1.00;
END_IF;

(* Vector Stagger Interlock: Stagger adjacent beams when both operate simultaneously in the seam *)
tonStaggerDelay_L12(IN := (bInOverlapZone_L1 AND bInOverlapZone_L2), PT := T#12MS);
IF tonStaggerDelay_L12.IN AND (NOT tonStaggerDelay_L12.Q) THEN
    (* Suppress Laser 2 temporarily to allow Laser 1 melt pool to solidify below solidus *)
    rStitchWeight_L2 := 0.0;
    arrAlarm_Active[16] := TRUE; (* Alarm 16: Dynamic Stitch Corridor Heat Load High *)
ELSE
    IF bAcknowledgeFaults AND arrAlarm_Acknowledged[16] THEN
        arrAlarm_Active[16] := FALSE;
    END_IF;
END_IF;

(* ==================================================================================== *)
(* SECTION 7: MODEL PREDICTIVE CONTROL (MPC) QUADRATIC COST OPTIMIZATION ENGINE        *)
(* Computes projected gradient step to minimize tracking cost J subject to constraints  *)
(* J = Q_T*(T - T_sp)^2 + Q_D*(D - D_sp)^2 + R_P*(P - P_nom)^2 + S_P*(dP)^2             *)
(* Applies strict slew-rate limiting (dP/dt <= 5000 W/s, dv/dt <= 15000 mm/s^2)         *)
(* ==================================================================================== *)

(* --- 7.1: MPC OPTIMIZATION FOR LASER 1 --- *)
IF (iDegradedLaserMask AND 16#01) <> 0 AND (iState = 60) THEN
    (* Analytical gradient calculation w.r.t Laser Power P *)
    rGradient_P := 2.0 * arrQ_StateWeights[4] * (arrState_L1[4] - rMeltPoolTargetTemp_degC) * arrB_Matrix[4, 1] +
                   2.0 * arrQ_StateWeights[3] * (arrState_L1[3] - rMeltPoolTargetDepth_um) * arrB_Matrix[3, 1] +
                   2.0 * arrR_InputWeights[1] * (rLaser1_PrevPower_W - rLaserNominalPower_W);
    
    (* Analytical gradient calculation w.r.t Scan Velocity v *)
    rGradient_v := 2.0 * arrQ_StateWeights[4] * (arrState_L1[4] - rMeltPoolTargetTemp_degC) * arrB_Matrix[4, 2] +
                   2.0 * arrR_InputWeights[2] * (rLaser1_PrevSpeed_mmpers - rLaserNominalSpeed_mmpers);

    (* Projected gradient step (step size alpha = 0.08) *)
    rDeltaPower := -0.080 * rGradient_P;
    rDeltaSpeed := -0.050 * rGradient_v;

    (* Slew rate limits for 100 us cycle *)
    IF rDeltaPower > (rMaxLaserPowerSlewRate_Wps * 0.000100) THEN
        rDeltaPower := (rMaxLaserPowerSlewRate_Wps * 0.000100);
    ELSIF rDeltaPower < -(rMaxLaserPowerSlewRate_Wps * 0.000100) THEN
        rDeltaPower := -(rMaxLaserPowerSlewRate_Wps * 0.000100);
    END_IF;

    IF rDeltaSpeed > (rMaxScanSpeedSlewRate_mmpers2 * 0.000100) THEN
        rDeltaSpeed := (rMaxScanSpeedSlewRate_mmpers2 * 0.000100);
    ELSIF rDeltaSpeed < -(rMaxScanSpeedSlewRate_mmpers2 * 0.000100) THEN
        rDeltaSpeed := -(rMaxScanSpeedSlewRate_mmpers2 * 0.000100);
    END_IF;

    (* Modulate power with stitch weight and plume compensation *)
    rLaser1_ModulatedPower_W := (rLaser1_PrevPower_W + rDeltaPower) * rStitchWeight_L1;
    rLaser1_ModulatedPower_W := rLaser1_ModulatedPower_W * (1.0 + (rVaporPlumeAttenuation_L1_pct / 100.0));
    rLaser1_ModulatedSpeed_mmpers := rLaser1_PrevSpeed_mmpers + rDeltaSpeed;

    (* Hard Actuator Saturation Clamps *)
    IF rLaser1_ModulatedPower_W > 1000.0 THEN
        rLaser1_ModulatedPower_W := 1000.0;
    ELSIF rLaser1_ModulatedPower_W < 50.0 THEN
        rLaser1_ModulatedPower_W := 50.0;
    END_IF;

    IF rLaser1_ModulatedSpeed_mmpers > 2500.0 THEN
        rLaser1_ModulatedSpeed_mmpers := 2500.0;
    ELSIF rLaser1_ModulatedSpeed_mmpers < 200.0 THEN
        rLaser1_ModulatedSpeed_mmpers := 200.0;
    END_IF;
ELSE
    rLaser1_ModulatedPower_W := 0.0;
    rLaser1_ModulatedSpeed_mmpers := 0.0;
END_IF;

(* --- 7.2: MPC OPTIMIZATION FOR LASER 2 --- *)
IF (iDegradedLaserMask AND 16#02) <> 0 AND (iState = 60) THEN

                   2.0 * arrR_InputWeights[1] * (rLaser2_PrevPower_W - rLaserNominalPower_W);
    
    rGradient_v := 2.0 * arrQ_StateWeights[4] * (arrState_L2[4] - rMeltPoolTargetTemp_degC) * arrB_Matrix[4, 2] +
                   2.0 * arrR_InputWeights[2] * (rLaser2_PrevSpeed_mmpers - rLaserNominalSpeed_mmpers);

    rDeltaPower := -0.080 * rGradient_P;

    ELSIF rDeltaPower < -(rMaxLaserPowerSlewRate_Wps * 0.000100) THEN
        rDeltaPower := -(rMaxLaserPowerSlewRate_Wps * 0.000100);
    END_IF;

    IF rDeltaSpeed > (rMaxScanSpeedSlewRate_mmpers2 * 0.000100) THEN

    ELSIF rDeltaSpeed < -(rMaxScanSpeedSlewRate_mmpers2 * 0.000100) THEN

    rLaser2_ModulatedPower_W := (rLaser2_PrevPower_W + rDeltaPower) * rStitchWeight_L2;
    rLaser2_ModulatedPower_W := rLaser2_ModulatedPower_W * (1.0 + (rVaporPlumeAttenuation_L2_pct / 100.0));
    rLaser2_ModulatedSpeed_mmpers := rLaser2_PrevSpeed_mmpers + rDeltaSpeed;

    IF rLaser2_ModulatedPower_W > 1000.0 THEN

    ELSIF rLaser2_ModulatedPower_W < 50.0 THEN
        rLaser2_ModulatedPower_W := 50.0;

    IF rLaser2_ModulatedSpeed_mmpers > 2500.0 THEN
        rLaser2_ModulatedSpeed_mmpers := 2500.0;
    ELSIF rLaser2_ModulatedSpeed_mmpers < 200.0 THEN
        rLaser2_ModulatedSpeed_mmpers := 200.0;

ELSE

    rLaser2_ModulatedSpeed_mmpers := 0.0;
END_IF;

IF (iDegradedLaserMask AND 16#04) <> 0 AND (iState = 60) THEN
    rGradient_P := 2.0 * arrQ_StateWeights[4] * (arrState_L3[4] - rMeltPoolTargetTemp_degC) * arrB_Matrix[4, 1] +
                   2.0 * arrQ_StateWeights[3] * (arrState_L3[3] - rMeltPoolTargetDepth_um) * arrB_Matrix[3, 1] +
                   2.0 * arrR_InputWeights[1] * (rLaser3_PrevPower_W - rLaserNominalPower_W);
    
    rGradient_v := 2.0 * arrQ_StateWeights[4] * (arrState_L3[4] - rMeltPoolTargetTemp_degC) * arrB_Matrix[4, 2] +
                   2.0 * arrR_InputWeights[2] * (rLaser3_PrevSpeed_mmpers - rLaserNominalSpeed_mmpers);

    IF rDeltaPower > (rMaxLaserPowerSlewRate_Wps * 0.000100) THEN
        rDeltaPower := (rMaxLaserPowerSlewRate_Wps * 0.000100);
    ELSIF rDeltaPower < -(rMaxLaserPowerSlewRate_Wps * 0.000100) THEN
        rDeltaPower := -(rMaxLaserPowerSlewRate_Wps * 0.000100);

    IF rDeltaSpeed > (rMaxScanSpeedSlewRate_mmpers2 * 0.000100) THEN

    ELSIF rDeltaSpeed < -(rMaxScanSpeedSlewRate_mmpers2 * 0.000100) THEN

    rLaser3_ModulatedPower_W := (rLaser3_PrevPower_W + rDeltaPower) * rStitchWeight_L3;
    rLaser3_ModulatedPower_W := rLaser3_ModulatedPower_W * (1.0 + (rVaporPlumeAttenuation_L3_pct / 100.0));
    rLaser3_ModulatedSpeed_mmpers := rLaser3_PrevSpeed_mmpers + rDeltaSpeed;

    IF rLaser3_ModulatedPower_W > 1000.0 THEN
        rLaser3_ModulatedPower_W := 1000.0;
    ELSIF rLaser3_ModulatedPower_W < 50.0 THEN

    IF rLaser3_ModulatedSpeed_mmpers > 2500.0 THEN

    ELSIF rLaser3_ModulatedSpeed_mmpers < 200.0 THEN

(* --- 7.4: MPC OPTIMIZATION FOR LASER 4 --- *)
IF (iDegradedLaserMask AND 16#08) <> 0 AND (iState = 60) THEN
    rGradient_P := 2.0 * arrQ_StateWeights[4] * (arrState_L4[4] - rMeltPoolTargetTemp_degC) * arrB_Matrix[4, 1] +
                   2.0 * arrQ_StateWeights[3] * (arrState_L4[3] - rMeltPoolTargetDepth_um) * arrB_Matrix[3, 1] +
                   2.0 * arrR_InputWeights[1] * (rLaser4_PrevPower_W - rLaserNominalPower_W);
    
    rGradient_v := 2.0 * arrQ_StateWeights[4] * (arrState_L4[4] - rMeltPoolTargetTemp_degC) * arrB_Matrix[4, 2] +
                   2.0 * arrR_InputWeights[2] * (rLaser4_PrevSpeed_mmpers - rLaserNominalSpeed_mmpers);

    rDeltaPower := -0.080 * rGradient_P;
