rLaser1_PrevPower_W      := rLaser1_ModulatedPower_W;
rLaser2_PrevPower_W      := rLaser2_ModulatedPower_W;
rLaser3_PrevPower_W      := rLaser3_ModulatedPower_W;
rLaser4_PrevPower_W      := rLaser4_ModulatedPower_W;
rLaser1_PrevSpeed_mmpers := rLaser1_ModulatedSpeed_mmpers;
rLaser2_PrevSpeed_mmpers := rLaser2_ModulatedSpeed_mmpers;
rLaser3_PrevSpeed_mmpers := rLaser3_ModulatedSpeed_mmpers;
rLaser4_PrevSpeed_mmpers := rLaser4_ModulatedSpeed_mmpers;

(* ==================================================================================== *)
(* SECTION 8: AUTONOMOUS GRACEFUL DEGRADATION & BEAM REDUNDANCY ENGINE                  *)
(* Monitors hardware health lines; if one source fails, dynamically isolates it via fast *)
(* pneumatic shutter and repartitions its scan vectors to surviving adjacent scanheads   *)
(* ==================================================================================== *)

IF (NOT bLaser1_HealthOK) AND ((iDegradedLaserMask AND 16#01) <> 0) THEN
    iDegradedLaserMask := iDegradedLaserMask AND 16#FE; (* Clear Laser 1 health bit *)
    bGracefulDegradationActive := TRUE;
    iDegradedScanheadAssigned := 2; (* Reassign quadrant 1 to Scanhead 2 *)
END_IF;

IF (NOT bLaser2_HealthOK) AND ((iDegradedLaserMask AND 16#02) <> 0) THEN
    iDegradedLaserMask := iDegradedLaserMask AND 16#FD; (* Clear Laser 2 health bit *)
    bGracefulDegradationActive := TRUE;
    iDegradedScanheadAssigned := 1; (* Reassign quadrant 2 to Scanhead 1 *)
END_IF;

IF (NOT bLaser3_HealthOK) AND ((iDegradedLaserMask AND 16#04) <> 0) THEN
    iDegradedLaserMask := iDegradedLaserMask AND 16#FB; (* Clear Laser 3 health bit *)
    bGracefulDegradationActive := TRUE;
    iDegradedScanheadAssigned := 4; (* Reassign quadrant 3 to Scanhead 4 *)
END_IF;

IF (NOT bLaser4_HealthOK) AND ((iDegradedLaserMask AND 16#08) <> 0) THEN
    iDegradedLaserMask := iDegradedLaserMask AND 16#F7; (* Clear Laser 4 health bit *)
    bGracefulDegradationActive := TRUE;
    iDegradedScanheadAssigned := 3; (* Reassign quadrant 4 to Scanhead 3 *)
END_IF;

(* If more than 2 lasers fail, graceful degradation cannot maintain thermal consistency *)
IF (iDegradedLaserMask = 16#00) OR (iDegradedLaserMask = 16#01) OR (iDegradedLaserMask = 16#02) OR
   (iDegradedLaserMask = 16#04) OR (iDegradedLaserMask = 16#08) THEN
    bAnyProcessTrip := TRUE;
END_IF;

(* ==================================================================================== *)
(* SECTION 9: ISA-18.2 ALARM ENGINE & STATUS WORD ENCODING                              *)
(* Implements alarm state machine (NORMAL, UNACK, ACK, RTN) with priority ranking       *)
(* ==================================================================================== *)

wAlarmSeverityWord := 16#0000;
FOR idxI := 1 TO 16 DO
    IF arrAlarm_Active[idxI] THEN
        IF NOT arrAlarm_Acknowledged[idxI] THEN
            arrAlarm_Unacknowledged[idxI] := TRUE;
        END_IF;
        
        (* Set severity bits based on alarm classification *)
        IF arrAlarm_Severity[idxI] = 4 THEN
            wAlarmSeverityWord := wAlarmSeverityWord OR 16#0008; (* Bit 3: Critical *)
        ELSIF arrAlarm_Severity[idxI] = 3 THEN
            wAlarmSeverityWord := wAlarmSeverityWord OR 16#0004; (* Bit 2: Major *)
        ELSIF arrAlarm_Severity[idxI] = 2 THEN
            wAlarmSeverityWord := wAlarmSeverityWord OR 16#0002; (* Bit 1: Minor *)
        ELSE
            wAlarmSeverityWord := wAlarmSeverityWord OR 16#0001; (* Bit 0: Info *)
        END_IF;
    ELSE
        IF arrAlarm_Acknowledged[idxI] THEN
            arrAlarm_Unacknowledged[idxI] := FALSE;
            arrAlarm_Acknowledged[idxI] := FALSE;
        END_IF;
    END_IF;

    IF bAcknowledgeFaults THEN
        IF arrAlarm_Active[idxI] THEN
            arrAlarm_Acknowledged[idxI] := TRUE;
            arrAlarm_Unacknowledged[idxI] := FALSE;
        END_IF;
    END_IF;
END_FOR;

IF bAcknowledgeFaults AND (NOT arrAlarm_Active[1]) AND (NOT arrAlarm_Active[2]) AND
   (NOT arrAlarm_Active[3]) AND (NOT arrAlarm_Active[4]) AND (NOT arrAlarm_Active[5]) THEN
    bFirstOutLatched := FALSE;
    wActiveFaultCode := 16#0000;
END_IF;

(* ==================================================================================== *)
(* SECTION 10: MULTI-STAGE HIERARCHICAL FINITE STATE MACHINE (FSM)                      *)
(* State 0   : UNINITIALIZED_COLD_BOOT                                                  *)
(* State 10  : SAFETY_CIRCUIT_HEALTH_CHECK                                               *)
(* State 20  : INERT_GAS_PURGE_AND_PRESSURE_SEAL                                        *)
(* State 30  : SUBSTRATE_PREHEAT_HOMING                                                 *)
(* State 40  : POWDER_DOSE_AND_RECOAT_PASS                                               *)
(* State 50  : SCANHEAD_PREFLIGHT_AND_STITCH_MAP                                        *)
(* State 60  : MULTI_BEAM_EXPOSURE_MPC_ACTIVE                                           *)
(* State 70  : INTER_LAYER_THERMAL_EQUILIBRATION                                        *)

(* ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* 1.0 EMERGENCY HARDWARE SAFETY SHUTDOWN & SIL-3 OPTICAL INTERLOCK EVALUATION               *)
(* Evaluates critical safety triggers: hardware E-stop, EDFA thermal runaway (>65C),        *)
(* destructive optical back-reflection (>150mW), and line-of-sight pointing divergence (>5urad)*)
(* ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
IF NOT bEmergencyStop THEN
    bSystemReady            := FALSE;
    bCommLinkActive         := FALSE;
    bOpticalTxShutterOpen   := FALSE;
    bAlarmSummary           := TRUE;
    rFSM_PiezoVolt_Tip_V    := 0.0;
    rFSM_PiezoVolt_Tilt_V   := 0.0;
    rFSM_PiezoVolt_Piston_V := 0.0;
    rLaserLOTuning_Current_mA        := 0.0;
    rCoarseGimbalRateDemand_Az_mrads := 0.0;
    rCoarseGimbalRateDemand_El_mrads := 0.0;
    dwAlarmWord_Critical    := dwAlarmWord_Critical OR 16#0000_0001; (* Bit 0: Emergency Stop Relay Open *)
    iTerminalState          := 999; (* Force immediate shutdown state *)
    iState                  := 999;
    RETURN;
END_IF;

(* Critical Thermal & Optical Interlock Checking *)
IF rEDFA_CaseTemp_degC >= c_rEDFA_MaxTemp_degC THEN
    bOpticalTxShutterOpen   := FALSE;
    bCommLinkActive         := FALSE;
    bAlarmSummary           := TRUE;
    dwAlarmWord_Critical    := dwAlarmWord_Critical OR 16#0000_0002; (* Bit 1: High-Power EDFA Over-Temperature Trip *)
    iTerminalState          := 999;
    iState                  := 999;
    RETURN;
END_IF;

IF rEDFA_BackReflection_mW >= c_rEDFA_MaxBackRefl_mW THEN
    bOpticalTxShutterOpen   := FALSE;
    bCommLinkActive         := FALSE;
    bAlarmSummary           := TRUE;
    dwAlarmWord_Critical    := dwAlarmWord_Critical OR 16#0000_0004; (* Bit 2: Laser Fiber Collimator Damage Back-Reflection *)
    iTerminalState          := 999;
    iState                  := 999;
    RETURN;
END_IF;

(* ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* 2.0 TRIPLE MODULAR REDUNDANCY (2oo3) SENSOR VOTING ALGORITHMS                             *)
(* Executes median selection, pairwise Euclidean discrepancy checking, and sensor drift     *)
(* monitoring for optical bench tri-axial accelerometers and redundant quad-cell preamps.   *)
(* ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* --- 2.1 Accelerometer Axis X 2oo3 Voting --- *)
bAccX_A_OK := (rBusMicroVib_AccelX_A_mps2 >= -50.0) AND (rBusMicroVib_AccelX_A_mps2 <= 50.0);
bAccX_B_OK := (rBusMicroVib_AccelX_B_mps2 >= -50.0) AND (rBusMicroVib_AccelX_B_mps2 <= 50.0);
bAccX_C_OK := (rBusMicroVib_AccelX_C_mps2 >= -50.0) AND (rBusMicroVib_AccelX_C_mps2 <= 50.0);

IF bAccX_A_OK AND bAccX_B_OK AND bAccX_C_OK THEN
    (* All 3 channels healthy: perform robust median selection *)
    IF (rBusMicroVib_AccelX_A_mps2 >= rBusMicroVib_AccelX_B_mps2 AND rBusMicroVib_AccelX_A_mps2 <= rBusMicroVib_AccelX_C_mps2) OR
       (rBusMicroVib_AccelX_A_mps2 >= rBusMicroVib_AccelX_C_mps2 AND rBusMicroVib_AccelX_A_mps2 <= rBusMicroVib_AccelX_B_mps2) THEN
        rVotedAccelX_mps2 := rBusMicroVib_AccelX_A_mps2;
    ELSIF (rBusMicroVib_AccelX_B_mps2 >= rBusMicroVib_AccelX_A_mps2 AND rBusMicroVib_AccelX_B_mps2 <= rBusMicroVib_AccelX_C_mps2) OR
          (rBusMicroVib_AccelX_B_mps2 >= rBusMicroVib_AccelX_C_mps2 AND rBusMicroVib_AccelX_B_mps2 <= rBusMicroVib_AccelX_A_mps2) THEN
        rVotedAccelX_mps2 := rBusMicroVib_AccelX_B_mps2;
    ELSE
        rVotedAccelX_mps2 := rBusMicroVib_AccelX_C_mps2;
    END_IF;
    bAcc_Degraded_1oo2 := FALSE;
    (* Check for subtle sensor drift across channels *)
    IF ABS(rBusMicroVib_AccelX_A_mps2 - rBusMicroVib_AccelX_B_mps2) > c_rAccelDiscrepancyTol_mps2 OR
       ABS(rBusMicroVib_AccelX_B_mps2 - rBusMicroVib_AccelX_C_mps2) > c_rAccelDiscrepancyTol_mps2 OR
       ABS(rBusMicroVib_AccelX_C_mps2 - rBusMicroVib_AccelX_A_mps2) > c_rAccelDiscrepancyTol_mps2 THEN
        dwAlarmWord_Warning := dwAlarmWord_Warning OR 16#0000_0001; (* Accel X Sensor Channel Drift Warning *)
    END_IF;
ELSIF bAccX_A_OK AND bAccX_B_OK THEN
    rVotedAccelX_mps2 := (rBusMicroVib_AccelX_A_mps2 + rBusMicroVib_AccelX_B_mps2) * 0.5;
    bAcc_Degraded_1oo2 := TRUE;
    dwAlarmWord_Warning := dwAlarmWord_Warning OR 16#0000_0002; (* Accel X Channel C Failed: Degraded 1oo2 *)
ELSIF bAccX_B_OK AND bAccX_C_OK THEN
    rVotedAccelX_mps2 := (rBusMicroVib_AccelX_B_mps2 + rBusMicroVib_AccelX_C_mps2) * 0.5;
    bAcc_Degraded_1oo2 := TRUE;
    dwAlarmWord_Warning := dwAlarmWord_Warning OR 16#0000_0004; (* Accel X Channel A Failed: Degraded 1oo2 *)
ELSIF bAccX_A_OK AND bAccX_C_OK THEN
    rVotedAccelX_mps2 := (rBusMicroVib_AccelX_A_mps2 + rBusMicroVib_AccelX_C_mps2) * 0.5;
    bAcc_Degraded_1oo2 := TRUE;
    dwAlarmWord_Warning := dwAlarmWord_Warning OR 16#0000_0008; (* Accel X Channel B Failed: Degraded 1oo2 *)
ELSE
    rVotedAccelX_mps2 := 0.0;
    bAcc_AllFailed_Trip := TRUE;
    dwAlarmWord_Critical := dwAlarmWord_Critical OR 16#0000_0010; (* All Accel X Channels Failed *)
END_IF;

(* --- 2.2 Accelerometer Axis Y 2oo3 Voting --- *)
bAccY_A_OK := (rBusMicroVib_AccelY_A_mps2 >= -50.0) AND (rBusMicroVib_AccelY_A_mps2 <= 50.0);
bAccY_B_OK := (rBusMicroVib_AccelY_B_mps2 >= -50.0) AND (rBusMicroVib_AccelY_B_mps2 <= 50.0);
bAccY_C_OK := (rBusMicroVib_AccelY_C_mps2 >= -50.0) AND (rBusMicroVib_AccelY_C_mps2 <= 50.0);

IF bAccY_A_OK AND bAccY_B_OK AND bAccY_C_OK THEN
    IF (rBusMicroVib_AccelY_A_mps2 >= rBusMicroVib_AccelY_B_mps2 AND rBusMicroVib_AccelY_A_mps2 <= rBusMicroVib_AccelY_C_mps2) OR
       (rBusMicroVib_AccelY_A_mps2 >= rBusMicroVib_AccelY_C_mps2 AND rBusMicroVib_AccelY_A_mps2 <= rBusMicroVib_AccelY_B_mps2) THEN
        rVotedAccelY_mps2 := rBusMicroVib_AccelY_A_mps2;
    ELSIF (rBusMicroVib_AccelY_B_mps2 >= rBusMicroVib_AccelY_A_mps2 AND rBusMicroVib_AccelY_B_mps2 <= rBusMicroVib_AccelY_C_mps2) OR
          (rBusMicroVib_AccelY_B_mps2 >= rBusMicroVib_AccelY_C_mps2 AND rBusMicroVib_AccelY_B_mps2 <= rBusMicroVib_AccelY_A_mps2) THEN
        rVotedAccelY_mps2 := rBusMicroVib_AccelY_B_mps2;
    ELSE
        rVotedAccelY_mps2 := rBusMicroVib_AccelY_C_mps2;
    END_IF;
    IF ABS(rBusMicroVib_AccelY_A_mps2 - rBusMicroVib_AccelY_B_mps2) > c_rAccelDiscrepancyTol_mps2 OR
       ABS(rBusMicroVib_AccelY_B_mps2 - rBusMicroVib_AccelY_C_mps2) > c_rAccelDiscrepancyTol_mps2 OR
       ABS(rBusMicroVib_AccelY_C_mps2 - rBusMicroVib_AccelY_A_mps2) > c_rAccelDiscrepancyTol_mps2 THEN
        dwAlarmWord_Warning := dwAlarmWord_Warning OR 16#0000_0010; (* Accel Y Sensor Channel Drift Warning *)
    END_IF;
ELSIF bAccY_A_OK AND bAccY_B_OK THEN
    rVotedAccelY_mps2 := (rBusMicroVib_AccelY_A_mps2 + rBusMicroVib_AccelY_B_mps2) * 0.5;
    bAcc_Degraded_1oo2 := TRUE;
    dwAlarmWord_Warning := dwAlarmWord_Warning OR 16#0000_0020;
ELSIF bAccY_B_OK AND bAccY_C_OK THEN
    rVotedAccelY_mps2 := (rBusMicroVib_AccelY_B_mps2 + rBusMicroVib_AccelY_C_mps2) * 0.5;
    bAcc_Degraded_1oo2 := TRUE;
    dwAlarmWord_Warning := dwAlarmWord_Warning OR 16#0000_0040;
ELSIF bAccY_A_OK AND bAccY_C_OK THEN
    rVotedAccelY_mps2 := (rBusMicroVib_AccelY_A_mps2 + rBusMicroVib_AccelY_C_mps2) * 0.5;
    bAcc_Degraded_1oo2 := TRUE;
    dwAlarmWord_Warning := dwAlarmWord_Warning OR 16#0000_0080;
ELSE
    rVotedAccelY_mps2 := 0.0;
    bAcc_AllFailed_Trip := TRUE;
    dwAlarmWord_Critical := dwAlarmWord_Critical OR 16#0000_0020; (* All Accel Y Channels Failed *)
END_IF;

(* --- 2.3 Accelerometer Axis Z 2oo3 Voting --- *)
bAccZ_A_OK := (rBusMicroVib_AccelZ_A_mps2 >= -50.0) AND (rBusMicroVib_AccelZ_A_mps2 <= 50.0);
bAccZ_B_OK := (rBusMicroVib_AccelZ_B_mps2 >= -50.0) AND (rBusMicroVib_AccelZ_B_mps2 <= 50.0);
bAccZ_C_OK := (rBusMicroVib_AccelZ_C_mps2 >= -50.0) AND (rBusMicroVib_AccelZ_C_mps2 <= 50.0);

IF bAccZ_A_OK AND bAccZ_B_OK AND bAccZ_C_OK THEN
    IF (rBusMicroVib_AccelZ_A_mps2 >= rBusMicroVib_AccelZ_B_mps2 AND rBusMicroVib_AccelZ_A_mps2 <= rBusMicroVib_AccelZ_C_mps2) OR
       (rBusMicroVib_AccelZ_A_mps2 >= rBusMicroVib_AccelZ_C_mps2 AND rBusMicroVib_AccelZ_A_mps2 <= rBusMicroVib_AccelZ_B_mps2) THEN
        rVotedAccelZ_mps2 := rBusMicroVib_AccelZ_A_mps2;
    ELSIF (rBusMicroVib_AccelZ_B_mps2 >= rBusMicroVib_AccelZ_A_mps2 AND rBusMicroVib_AccelZ_B_mps2 <= rBusMicroVib_AccelZ_C_mps2) OR
          (rBusMicroVib_AccelZ_B_mps2 >= rBusMicroVib_AccelZ_C_mps2 AND rBusMicroVib_AccelZ_B_mps2 <= rBusMicroVib_AccelZ_A_mps2) THEN
        rVotedAccelZ_mps2 := rBusMicroVib_AccelZ_B_mps2;
    ELSE
        rVotedAccelZ_mps2 := rBusMicroVib_AccelZ_C_mps2;
    END_IF;
ELSIF bAccZ_A_OK AND bAccZ_B_OK THEN
    rVotedAccelZ_mps2 := (rBusMicroVib_AccelZ_A_mps2 + rBusMicroVib_AccelZ_B_mps2) * 0.5;
    bAcc_Degraded_1oo2 := TRUE;
ELSIF bAccZ_B_OK AND bAccZ_C_OK THEN
    rVotedAccelZ_mps2 := (rBusMicroVib_AccelZ_B_mps2 + rBusMicroVib_AccelZ_C_mps2) * 0.5;
    bAcc_Degraded_1oo2 := TRUE;
ELSIF bAccZ_A_OK AND bAccZ_C_OK THEN
    rVotedAccelZ_mps2 := (rBusMicroVib_AccelZ_A_mps2 + rBusMicroVib_AccelZ_C_mps2) * 0.5;
    bAcc_Degraded_1oo2 := TRUE;
ELSE
    rVotedAccelZ_mps2 := 0.0;
    bAcc_AllFailed_Trip := TRUE;
    dwAlarmWord_Critical := dwAlarmWord_Critical OR 16#0000_0040; (* All Accel Z Channels Failed *)
END_IF;

(* --- 2.4 Quad-Cell Preamplifier Dual-Redundancy Cross-Validation --- *)
IF ABS(rQuadCell_A_mV - rQuadCell_A_Redundant_mV) > c_rQuadCellDiscrepancyTol_mV OR
   ABS(rQuadCell_B_mV - rQuadCell_B_Redundant_mV) > c_rQuadCellDiscrepancyTol_mV OR
   ABS(rQuadCell_C_mV - rQuadCell_C_Redundant_mV) > c_rQuadCellDiscrepancyTol_mV OR
   ABS(rQuadCell_D_mV - rQuadCell_D_Redundant_mV) > c_rQuadCellDiscrepancyTol_mV THEN
    dwAlarmWord_Warning := dwAlarmWord_Warning OR 16#0000_0100; (* Quad-Cell Preamplifier Redundancy Mismatch *)
    (* Select primary unless primary saturated / open *)
    IF (rQuadCell_A_mV < 0.0 OR rQuadCell_A_mV > 2500.0) THEN
        rVotedQuad_A_mV := rQuadCell_A_Redundant_mV;
        rVotedQuad_B_mV := rQuadCell_B_Redundant_mV;
        rVotedQuad_C_mV := rQuadCell_C_Redundant_mV;
        rVotedQuad_D_mV := rQuadCell_D_Redundant_mV;
        dwAlarmWord_Warning := dwAlarmWord_Warning OR 16#0000_0200; (* Switched to Secondary Quad-Cell *)
    ELSE
        rVotedQuad_A_mV := rQuadCell_A_mV;
        rVotedQuad_B_mV := rQuadCell_B_mV;
        rVotedQuad_C_mV := rQuadCell_C_mV;
        rVotedQuad_D_mV := rQuadCell_D_mV;
    END_IF;
ELSE
    rVotedQuad_A_mV := (rQuadCell_A_mV + rQuadCell_A_Redundant_mV) * 0.5;
    rVotedQuad_B_mV := (rQuadCell_B_mV + rQuadCell_B_Redundant_mV) * 0.5;
    rVotedQuad_C_mV := (rQuadCell_C_mV + rQuadCell_C_Redundant_mV) * 0.5;
    rVotedQuad_D_mV := (rQuadCell_D_mV + rQuadCell_D_Redundant_mV) * 0.5;
END_IF;

(* Thermal Stability Window Checks *)
IF ABS(rOpticsBenchTemp_degC - 20.0) > 3.0 THEN
    dwAlarmWord_Warning := dwAlarmWord_Warning OR 16#0000_0400; (* Optical Bench Temperature Deviation *)
END_IF;
IF ABS(rLaserSeedTemp_degC - c_rLaserSeedNominalTemp_degC) > 1.5 THEN
    dwAlarmWord_Warning := dwAlarmWord_Warning OR 16#0000_0800; (* Laser LO Seed Temperature Thermal Drift *)
END_IF;

(* ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* 3.0 QUAD-CELL PHOTODIODE NUTATION DEMODULATION & BEAM CENTROID DECOUPLING                 *)
(* Computes sum and difference ratios, evaluates 5th-order polynomial distortion              *)
(* linearization, executes synchronous lock-in mixing for conical scan nutation, and decouples*)
(* spacecraft rigid-body angular rate disturbances from optical line-of-sight pointing.      *)
(* ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
rQuadSum_mV := rVotedQuad_A_mV + rVotedQuad_B_mV + rVotedQuad_C_mV + rVotedQuad_D_mV;

IF rQuadSum_mV > 20.0 THEN
    (* Differential quadrant coordinates *)
    rQuadDiffX_mV := (rVotedQuad_A_mV + rVotedQuad_D_mV) - (rVotedQuad_B_mV + rVotedQuad_C_mV);
    rQuadDiffY_mV := (rVotedQuad_A_mV + rVotedQuad_B_mV) - (rVotedQuad_C_mV + rVotedQuad_D_mV);
    
    (* Normalized quadrant ratios *)
    rRawCentroid_X := rQuadDiffX_mV / rQuadSum_mV;
    rRawCentroid_Y := rQuadDiffY_mV / rQuadSum_mV;
    
    (* Saturation limiter on normalized quadrant ratio *)
    IF rRawCentroid_X > 0.95 THEN rRawCentroid_X := 0.95; END_IF;
    IF rRawCentroid_X < -0.95 THEN rRawCentroid_X := -0.95; END_IF;
    IF rRawCentroid_Y > 0.95 THEN rRawCentroid_Y := 0.95; END_IF;
    IF rRawCentroid_Y < -0.95 THEN rRawCentroid_Y := -0.95; END_IF;
    
    (* 5th-Order Polynomial Distortion Linearization for Gaussian Spot on Crosshair Gap *)
    (* Theta = K_lin * Ratio * (1 + K_cub * Ratio^2 + K_quin * Ratio^4) *)
    rLinearizedPos_Az_urad := c_rQuadCell_K_lin * rRawCentroid_X * (1.0 + 
                              c_rQuadCell_K_cub * (rRawCentroid_X * rRawCentroid_X) + 
                              c_rQuadCell_K_quin * (rRawCentroid_X * rRawCentroid_X * rRawCentroid_X * rRawCentroid_X));
                              
    rLinearizedPos_El_urad := c_rQuadCell_K_lin * rRawCentroid_Y * (1.0 + 
                              c_rQuadCell_K_cub * (rRawCentroid_Y * rRawCentroid_Y) + 
                              c_rQuadCell_K_quin * (rRawCentroid_Y * rRawCentroid_Y * rRawCentroid_Y * rRawCentroid_Y));
ELSE
    rRawCentroid_X         := 0.0;
    rRawCentroid_Y         := 0.0;
    rLinearizedPos_Az_urad := 0.0;
    rLinearizedPos_El_urad := 0.0;
END_IF;

(* Conical Scan Nutation Phase Accumulation & Demodulation *)
rNutationPhase := rNutationPhase + (2.0 * c_rPi * c_rNutationFreq_Hz * c_rTs);
IF rNutationPhase >= (2.0 * c_rPi) THEN
    rNutationPhase := rNutationPhase - (2.0 * c_rPi);
END_IF;

(* Synchronous mixing products with in-phase (cos) and quadrature (sin) carriers *)
rDemod_I_Az := (rQuadSum_mV * COS(rNutationPhase)) * 0.002;
rDemod_Q_El := (rQuadSum_mV * SIN(rNutationPhase)) * 0.002;

(* 4th-Order Direct-Form-II Transposed IIR Low-Pass Filter Cascade (f_cutoff = 40 Hz) *)
(* Filters demodulated nutation envelope to isolate steady-state pointing vector *)
rLPF_X_w[0] := rDemod_I_Az - (-1.6475 * rLPF_X_w[1] + 1.1098 * rLPF_X_w[2] - 0.2842 * rLPF_X_w[3]);
rDemod_I_Az := 0.0018 * (rLPF_X_w[0] + 3.0 * rLPF_X_w[1] + 3.0 * rLPF_X_w[2] + rLPF_X_w[3]);
rLPF_X_w[3] := rLPF_X_w[2];
rLPF_X_w[2] := rLPF_X_w[1];
rLPF_X_w[1] := rLPF_X_w[0];

rLPF_Y_w[0] := rDemod_Q_El - (-1.6475 * rLPF_Y_w[1] + 1.1098 * rLPF_Y_w[2] - 0.2842 * rLPF_Y_w[3]);
rDemod_Q_El := 0.0018 * (rLPF_Y_w[0] + 3.0 * rLPF_Y_w[1] + 3.0 * rLPF_Y_w[2] + rLPF_Y_w[3]);
rLPF_Y_w[3] := rLPF_Y_w[2];
rLPF_Y_w[2] := rLPF_Y_w[1];
rLPF_Y_w[1] := rLPF_Y_w[0];

(* Spacecraft Bus Rigid-Body Angular Rate Decoupling Feedforward *)
(* Converts body gyro rates [mrad/s] to Line-of-Sight error compensation [urad] *)
rLinearizedPos_Az_urad := rLinearizedPos_Az_urad - (rSpacecraftBodyRate_Yaw_mrads * 1000.0 * c_rTs);
rLinearizedPos_El_urad := rLinearizedPos_El_urad - (rSpacecraftBodyRate_Pitch_mrads * 1000.0 * c_rTs);

(* ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* 4.0 SPACECRAFT STRUCTURAL MICRO-VIBRATION FEEDFORWARD NULLING (FxLMS)                     *)
(* Adaptive Filtered-X Least Mean Squares FIR Filter nulling Reaction Wheel Assembly (RWA)  *)
(* dynamic unbalance harmonics and cryocooler structural tones measured by 2oo3 accelerometers*)
(* ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* Update input delay lines with newest voted accelerations *)
FOR iLoopCounter := 15 TO 1 BY -1 DO
    x_delay_X[iLoopCounter] := x_delay_X[iLoopCounter - 1];
    x_delay_Y[iLoopCounter] := x_delay_Y[iLoopCounter - 1];
END_FOR;
x_delay_X[0] := rVotedAccelX_mps2;
x_delay_Y[0] := rVotedAccelY_mps2;

(* Convolve reference through 8-tap secondary path filter model S_hat(z) *)
FOR iLoopCounter := 15 TO 1 BY -1 DO
    x_filtered_X[iLoopCounter] := x_filtered_X[iLoopCounter - 1];
    x_filtered_Y[iLoopCounter] := x_filtered_Y[iLoopCounter - 1];
END_FOR;

x_filtered_X[0] := 0.0;
x_filtered_Y[0] := 0.0;
FOR jLoopCounter := 0 TO 7 DO
    IF jLoopCounter <= 15 THEN
        x_filtered_X[0] := x_filtered_X[0] + S_secondary_path[jLoopCounter] * x_delay_X[jLoopCounter];
        x_filtered_Y[0] := x_filtered_Y[0] + S_secondary_path[jLoopCounter] * x_delay_Y[jLoopCounter];
    END_IF;
END_FOR;

(* Calculate Feedforward Cancellation Control Signal: u_ff = W^T * x *)
rFeedforwardCmd_Az_V := 0.0;
rFeedforwardCmd_El_V := 0.0;
FOR iLoopCounter := 0 TO 15 DO
    rFeedforwardCmd_Az_V := rFeedforwardCmd_Az_V + W_feedforward_Az[iLoopCounter] * x_delay_X[iLoopCounter];
    rFeedforwardCmd_El_V := rFeedforwardCmd_El_V + W_feedforward_El[iLoopCounter] * x_delay_Y[iLoopCounter];
END_FOR;

(* Normalized LMS Weight Adaptation with Leakage Factor:                                     *)
(* W[k+1] = (1 - leakage) * W[k] + (mu / (||x_filt||^2 + eps)) * error * x_filt[k]            *)
IF (iState = 70 OR iState = 80 OR iState = 90) THEN
    FOR iLoopCounter := 0 TO 15 DO
        W_feedforward_Az[iLoopCounter] := (1.0 - c_rFxLMS_Leakage) * W_feedforward_Az[iLoopCounter] +
            (c_rFxLMS_Mu / (x_filtered_X[iLoopCounter] * x_filtered_X[iLoopCounter] + c_rFxLMS_Eps)) *
            rTrackingError_Az_urad * x_filtered_X[iLoopCounter];
            
        W_feedforward_El[iLoopCounter] := (1.0 - c_rFxLMS_Leakage) * W_feedforward_El[iLoopCounter] +
            (c_rFxLMS_Mu / (x_filtered_Y[iLoopCounter] * x_filtered_Y[iLoopCounter] + c_rFxLMS_Eps)) *
            rTrackingError_El_urad * x_filtered_Y[iLoopCounter];
    END_FOR;
END_IF;

(* Clamp feedforward voltage output to prevent actuator preemption *)
IF rFeedforwardCmd_Az_V > 25.0 THEN rFeedforwardCmd_Az_V := 25.0; END_IF;
IF rFeedforwardCmd_Az_V < -25.0 THEN rFeedforwardCmd_Az_V := -25.0; END_IF;
IF rFeedforwardCmd_El_V > 25.0 THEN rFeedforwardCmd_El_V := 25.0; END_IF;
IF rFeedforwardCmd_El_V < -25.0 THEN rFeedforwardCmd_El_V := -25.0; END_IF;

(* ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* 5.0 ORBITAL DOPPLER FREQUENCY SYNCHRONIZATION & HETERODYNE LO LOCK                        *)
(* Dual-loop optical frequency tracking: Coarse submount thermal loop (-12.5 GHz/deg C)     *)
(* cascaded with fast direct DFB laser cavity injection current tuning (+/- 2.5 GHz).       *)
(* ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* Measure beat note error relative to coherent 80 MHz intermediate frequency target *)
rMeasuredBeatFreq_MHz       := rHeterodyneIF_BeatFreq_MHz;
rFreqDiscriminatorError_MHz := rMeasuredBeatFreq_MHz - c_rIntermediateFreqTarget_MHz;

(* Ephemeris line-of-sight Doppler feedforward calculation *)
(* Required submount temperature offset: Delta_T = Delta_f_Doppler / Tuning_Sensitivity *)
rLaserLO_TECTemp_Setpoint_degC := c_rLaserSeedNominalTemp_degC + 
                                  (rEstimatedDopplerShift_GHz / c_rLaserThermalTuning_GHz_degC);

(* Slow Thermal Loop PI Integral Regulator with Anti-Windup *)
rDopplerThermalIntegral := rDopplerThermalIntegral + (0.012 * rFreqDiscriminatorError_MHz * 0.001 * c_rTs);
IF rDopplerThermalIntegral > 35.0 THEN rDopplerThermalIntegral := 35.0; END_IF;
IF rDopplerThermalIntegral < 15.0 THEN rDopplerThermalIntegral := 15.0; END_IF;
rLaserLO_TECTemp_Setpoint_degC := rLaserLO_TECTemp_Setpoint_degC + (rDopplerThermalIntegral - 25.0);

(* Fast Injection Current Loop (Bandwidth > 100 kHz): Lead-Lag Filter + PI Controller *)
(* Lead-Lag compensator transfer function: H(s) = (s + 20000) / (s + 120000) *)
rLeadLagState_1 := 0.8825 * rLeadLagState_1 + 0.1175 * rFreqDiscriminatorError_MHz;
rDopplerCurrentIntegral := rDopplerCurrentIntegral + (1.85 * rFreqDiscriminatorError_MHz * c_rTs);
IF rDopplerCurrentIntegral > 4.5 THEN rDopplerCurrentIntegral := 4.5; END_IF;
IF rDopplerCurrentIntegral < -4.5 THEN rDopplerCurrentIntegral := -4.5; END_IF;

rLaserLOTuning_Current_mA := (0.045 * rLeadLagState_1) + rDopplerCurrentIntegral +
                             (rEstimatedDopplerRate_MHzs / (c_rLaserCurrentTuning_GHz_mA * 1000.0) * 0.1);

(* Direct current limits: +/- 5.0 mA *)
IF rLaserLOTuning_Current_mA > 5.0 THEN rLaserLOTuning_Current_mA := 5.0; END_IF;
IF rLaserLOTuning_Current_mA < -5.0 THEN rLaserLOTuning_Current_mA := -5.0; END_IF;

(* Coherent Heterodyne Lock Detector *)
IF ABS(rFreqDiscriminatorError_MHz) <= 2.5 AND (rRxOpticalPower_dBm >= c_rRxPowerLock_dBm) THEN
    bDopplerPhaseLocked := TRUE;
    dwSystemStatusWord := dwSystemStatusWord OR 16#0000_0008; (* Doppler Carrier Frequency Locked *)
ELSE
    bDopplerPhaseLocked := FALSE;
    dwSystemStatusWord := dwSystemStatusWord AND NOT 16#0000_0008;
    IF (iState = 80) THEN
        iCycleSlipCounter := iCycleSlipCounter + 1;
        dwAlarmWord_Warning := dwAlarmWord_Warning OR 16#0000_1000; (* Doppler Frequency Cycle Slip *)
    END_IF;
END_IF;

(* ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* 6.0 6TH-ORDER STATE-SPACE MODEL & MODEL PREDICTIVE CONTROL (MPC) OPTIMIZATION              *)
(* Real-time receding horizon state prediction, innovation correction, unrolled quadratic   *)
(* cost gradient descent, and Bouc-Wen inverse piezoelectric hysteresis compensation.        *)
(* ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* 6.1 State-Space Observer: Prior State Propagation x_pred = A * x_est + B * u_prev *)
FOR iLoopCounter := 0 TO 5 DO
    x_pred[iLoopCounter] := 0.0;
    FOR jLoopCounter := 0 TO 5 DO
        x_pred[iLoopCounter] := x_pred[iLoopCounter] + A_mat[iLoopCounter, jLoopCounter] * x_est[jLoopCounter];
    END_FOR;
    x_pred[iLoopCounter] := x_pred[iLoopCounter] + 
                            B_mat[iLoopCounter, 0] * (u_mpc_accum_Az - 65.0) + 
                            B_mat[iLoopCounter, 1] * (u_mpc_accum_El - 65.0);
END_FOR;

(* Observer Output Prediction: y_est = C * x_pred *)
y_est[0] := C_mat[0, 0] * x_pred[0];
y_est[1] := C_mat[1, 2] * x_pred[2];

(* Compute Measurement Innovation Vector: y_innov = y_meas - y_est *)
y_innov[0] := rLinearizedPos_Az_urad - y_est[0];
y_innov[1] := rLinearizedPos_El_urad - y_est[1];

(* State Correction: x_est = x_pred + L * y_innov *)
FOR iLoopCounter := 0 TO 5 DO
    x_est[iLoopCounter] := x_pred[iLoopCounter] + 
                           L_gain[iLoopCounter, 0] * y_innov[0] + 
                           L_gain[iLoopCounter, 1] * y_innov[1];
END_FOR;

(* Extract Filtered Line-of-Sight Angular Tracking Errors *)
rTrackingError_Az_urad := rTargetAngle_Az_urad - x_est[0];
rTrackingError_El_urad := rTargetAngle_El_urad - x_est[2];

(* 6.2 Model Predictive Control (MPC) Receding Horizon Optimization *)
(* Formulate Gradient Vector g = H * delta_u_0 - F_error *)
g_mpc[0] := -(Q_weight_Az * rTrackingError_Az_urad * 0.00045) + (R_weight_Az * (u_mpc_accum_Az - 65.0) * 0.001);
g_mpc[1] := -(Q_weight_El * rTrackingError_El_urad * 0.00045) + (R_weight_El * (u_mpc_accum_El - 65.0) * 0.001);
g_mpc[2] := -(P_weight_Az * rTrackingError_Az_urad * 0.00025);
g_mpc[3] := -(P_weight_El * rTrackingError_El_urad * 0.00025);

(* Unrolled Quadratic Programming Step via Inverse Hessian: delta_u = -H_inv * g *)
FOR iLoopCounter := 0 TO 3 DO
    delta_u_mpc[iLoopCounter] := 0.0;
    FOR jLoopCounter := 0 TO 3 DO
        delta_u_mpc[iLoopCounter] := delta_u_mpc[iLoopCounter] - H_inv[iLoopCounter, jLoopCounter] * g_mpc[jLoopCounter];
    END_FOR;
END_FOR;

(* Slew Rate Enforcement on Control Increment (|Delta_u| <= 2.5 V/cycle) *)
IF delta_u_mpc[0] > c_rMaxPiezoStep_V THEN delta_u_mpc[0] := c_rMaxPiezoStep_V; END_IF;
IF delta_u_mpc[0] < -c_rMaxPiezoStep_V THEN delta_u_mpc[0] := -c_rMaxPiezoStep_V; END_IF;
IF delta_u_mpc[1] > c_rMaxPiezoStep_V THEN delta_u_mpc[1] := c_rMaxPiezoStep_V; END_IF;
IF delta_u_mpc[1] < -c_rMaxPiezoStep_V THEN delta_u_mpc[1] := -c_rMaxPiezoStep_V; END_IF;

(* Accumulate Control Input with Actuator Saturation [-20.0 V to +150.0 V] *)
IF (iState = 70 OR iState = 80 OR iState = 90) THEN
    u_mpc_accum_Az := u_mpc_accum_Az + delta_u_mpc[0];
    u_mpc_accum_El := u_mpc_accum_El + delta_u_mpc[1];
ELSE
    (* Controlled decay toward 65.0 V electrical center during non-tracking states *)
    u_mpc_accum_Az := u_mpc_accum_Az + 0.05 * (65.0 - u_mpc_accum_Az);
    u_mpc_accum_El := u_mpc_accum_El + 0.05 * (65.0 - u_mpc_accum_El);
END_IF;

IF u_mpc_accum_Az > c_rPiezoVoltsMax THEN u_mpc_accum_Az := c_rPiezoVoltsMax; END_IF;
IF u_mpc_accum_Az < c_rPiezoVoltsMin THEN u_mpc_accum_Az := c_rPiezoVoltsMin; END_IF;
IF u_mpc_accum_El > c_rPiezoVoltsMax THEN u_mpc_accum_El := c_rPiezoVoltsMax; END_IF;
IF u_mpc_accum_El < c_rPiezoVoltsMin THEN u_mpc_accum_El := c_rPiezoVoltsMin; END_IF;

(* 6.3 Inverse Bouc-Wen Piezoelectric Hysteresis Pre-Distortion Compensation *)
(* dh/dt = alpha * du/dt - beta * |du/dt| * h * |h|^(n-1) - gamma * du/dt * |h|^n *)
rHystState_Az := rHystState_Az + (c_rBoucWen_Alpha * delta_u_mpc[0]) - 
                 (c_rBoucWen_Beta * ABS(delta_u_mpc[0]) * rHystState_Az) - 
                 (c_rBoucWen_Gamma * delta_u_mpc[0] * ABS(rHystState_Az));

rHystState_El := rHystState_El + (c_rBoucWen_Alpha * delta_u_mpc[1]) - 
                 (c_rBoucWen_Beta * ABS(delta_u_mpc[1]) * rHystState_El) - 
                 (c_rBoucWen_Gamma * delta_u_mpc[1] * ABS(rHystState_El));

(* Synthesize Final High-Voltage Piezo Output Commands:                                     *)
(* V_piezo = u_mpc + u_feedforward + u_pointahead - Hysteresis_Correction                    *)
rFSM_PiezoVolt_Tip_V := u_mpc_accum_Az + rFeedforwardCmd_Az_V + 
                        (rTargetPointAhead_Az_urad / c_rPiezoD33_um_V) - (0.12 * rHystState_Az);

rFSM_PiezoVolt_Tilt_V := u_mpc_accum_El + rFeedforwardCmd_El_V + 
                         (rTargetPointAhead_El_urad / c_rPiezoD33_um_V) - (0.12 * rHystState_El);

(* Axial Piston Focus Voltage: Compensates optical bench bulk thermal expansion *)
rFSM_PiezoVolt_Piston_V := 60.0 + (rOpticsBenchTemp_degC - 20.0) * 2.85;
IF rFSM_PiezoVolt_Piston_V > 120.0 THEN rFSM_PiezoVolt_Piston_V := 120.0; END_IF;
IF rFSM_PiezoVolt_Piston_V < 0.0 THEN rFSM_PiezoVolt_Piston_V := 0.0; END_IF;

(* Final Saturation Safeguards on Piezo Command Rails *)
IF rFSM_PiezoVolt_Tip_V > c_rPiezoVoltsMax THEN rFSM_PiezoVolt_Tip_V := c_rPiezoVoltsMax; END_IF;
IF rFSM_PiezoVolt_Tip_V < c_rPiezoVoltsMin THEN rFSM_PiezoVolt_Tip_V := c_rPiezoVoltsMin; END_IF;
IF rFSM_PiezoVolt_Tilt_V > c_rPiezoVoltsMax THEN rFSM_PiezoVolt_Tilt_V := c_rPiezoVoltsMax; END_IF;
IF rFSM_PiezoVolt_Tilt_V < c_rPiezoVoltsMin THEN rFSM_PiezoVolt_Tilt_V := c_rPiezoVoltsMin; END_IF;

(* ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* 7.0 COARSE GIMBAL OFF-LOAD & DESATURATION FEEDFORWARD                                     *)
(* Low-pass filters FSM mirror deflection to offload continuous DC line-of-sight offsets     *)
(* onto the Coarse Pointing Assembly (CPA) gimbals, preserving full FSM dynamic range.       *)
(* ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
rFSM_BiasFilter_Az_urad := (0.9985 * rFSM_BiasFilter_Az_urad) + (0.0015 * x_est[0]);
rFSM_BiasFilter_El_urad := (0.9985 * rFSM_BiasFilter_El_urad) + (0.0015 * x_est[2]);

IF ABS(rFSM_BiasFilter_Az_urad) > c_rDesaturationDeadband_urad THEN
    rCoarseGimbalRateDemand_Az_mrads := (rFSM_BiasFilter_Az_urad - 
        (c_rDesaturationDeadband_urad * (rFSM_BiasFilter_Az_urad / ABS(rFSM_BiasFilter_Az_urad)))) * 
        c_rDesaturationGain;
ELSE

END_IF;

IF ABS(rFSM_BiasFilter_El_urad) > c_rDesaturationDeadband_urad THEN
    rCoarseGimbalRateDemand_El_mrads := (rFSM_BiasFilter_El_urad - 
        (c_rDesaturationDeadband_urad * (rFSM_BiasFilter_El_urad / ABS(rFSM_BiasFilter_El_urad)))) * 
        c_rDesaturationGain;
ELSE
    rCoarseGimbalRateDemand_El_mrads := 0.0;
END_IF;

(* Clamp CPA desaturation demand rates to maximum mechanical limits (+/- 15.0 mrad/s) *)
IF rCoarseGimbalRateDemand_Az_mrads > 15.0 THEN rCoarseGimbalRateDemand_Az_mrads := 15.0; END_IF;
IF rCoarseGimbalRateDemand_Az_mrads < -15.0 THEN rCoarseGimbalRateDemand_Az_mrads := -15.0; END_IF;

IF rCoarseGimbalRateDemand_El_mrads < -15.0 THEN rCoarseGimbalRateDemand_El_mrads := -15.0; END_IF;

CASE iState OF

        u_mpc_accum_El          := 65.0;

        bSystemReady            := FALSE;

        bSystemReady            := FALSE;
        bCommLinkActive         := FALSE;
        bOpticalTxShutterOpen   := FALSE;
        (* Generate Archimedean spiral search commands *)
        rSpiralScanAngle_rad   := rSpiralScanAngle_rad + (12.5 * c_rTs);
        rSpiralScanRadius_urad := rSpiralScanRadius_urad + (1.2 * c_rTs);
        rTargetAngle_Az_urad   := rSpiralScanRadius_urad * COS(rSpiralScanAngle_rad);
        rTargetAngle_El_urad   := rSpiralScanRadius_urad * SIN(rSpiralScanAngle_rad);

        IF (rQuadSum_mV >= 85.0) OR bBeaconModulationDetected THEN

        END_IF;
        IF rSpiralScanRadius_urad > 80.0 THEN

        bSystemReady            := FALSE;

        bSystemReady            := TRUE;

        bOpticalTxShutterOpen   := TRUE;
        IF (rTrackingError_RMS_urad > c_rJitterWarning_urad) THEN

        END_IF;

        bCommLinkActive         := FALSE;

        END_IF;
        IF (rTrackingError_RMS_urad > c_rJitterTripThreshold_urad) THEN

        END_IF;

    100: (* POINTING_DEGRADED_JITTER_RECOVERY: Spacecraft thruster or severe RWA transient *)
        bSystemReady            := FALSE;
        bCommLinkActive         := FALSE;
        bOpticalTxShutterOpen   := FALSE; (* Blank laser to prevent uncoordinated illumination *)
        dwAlarmWord_Warning     := dwAlarmWord_Warning OR 16#0000_4000; (* Severe Jitter Degradation *)
        IF (rTrackingError_RMS_urad <= 1.0) AND (rQuadSum_mV >= 50.0) THEN
            iState := 70; (* Recover fine tracking *)
        END_IF;
        IF (rQuadSum_mV < 30.0) THEN iState := 110; END_IF;
        IF NOT bEnable THEN iState := 120; END_IF;

    110: (* LOSS_OF_SIGNAL_FAST_REACQUISITION: Rapid 500ms spiral relock sequence *)
        bSystemReady            := FALSE;
        bCommLinkActive         := FALSE;
        bOpticalTxShutterOpen   := FALSE;
        tRelockGraceTimer(IN := TRUE, PT := T#500MS);
        IF (rQuadSum_mV >= 65.0) THEN

        ELSIF tRelockGraceTimer.Q THEN
            tRelockGraceTimer(IN := FALSE);

        END_IF;

        bSystemReady            := FALSE;
        bCommLinkActive         := FALSE;

        (* Ramp piezos toward 0.0 V *)
        u_mpc_accum_Az := u_mpc_accum_Az - (35.0 * c_rTs);
        u_mpc_accum_El := u_mpc_accum_El - (35.0 * c_rTs);
        IF u_mpc_accum_Az < 0.0 THEN u_mpc_accum_Az := 0.0; END_IF;
        IF u_mpc_accum_El < 0.0 THEN u_mpc_accum_El := 0.0; END_IF;
        IF tPiezoDischargeTimer.Q THEN
            tPiezoDischargeTimer(IN := FALSE);
            iState := 0; (* Park complete: return to cold standby *)
        END_IF;

    999: (* EMERGENCY_SHUTDOWN_OPTICAL_BLANKING: Hardware trip latch *)
        bSystemReady            := FALSE;
        bCommLinkActive         := FALSE;
        bOpticalTxShutterOpen   := FALSE;
        bAlarmSummary           := TRUE;
        rFSM_PiezoVolt_Tip_V    := 0.0;
        rFSM_PiezoVolt_Tilt_V   := 0.0;
        rFSM_PiezoVolt_Piston_V := 0.0;
        rLaserLOTuning_Current_mA        := 0.0;
        rCoarseGimbalRateDemand_Az_mrads := 0.0;
        rCoarseGimbalRateDemand_El_mrads := 0.0;
        IF bAcknowledgeFaults AND bEmergencyStop THEN

(* 9.0 BIT-PACKED STATUS WORDS & RADIAL JITTER RMS TELEMETRY METRICS                         *)
(* Continuously updates 32-sample circular jitter buffer, calculates 2-axis radial RMS,     *)
(* registers peak jitter holds, and packs 32-bit discrete diagnostic words.                 *)
(* ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* Push instantaneous radial pointing error into circular telemetry ring buffer *)
rJitterRingBuffer[iJitterBufferIndex] := (rTrackingError_Az_urad * rTrackingError_Az_urad) + 
                                        (rTrackingError_El_urad * rTrackingError_El_urad);
iJitterBufferIndex := (iJitterBufferIndex + 1) MOD 32;

END_FOR;
rTrackingError_RMS_urad := SQRT(rJitterSumSquared / 32.0);

IF rTrackingError_RMS_urad > rPeakJitterHold_urad THEN
    rPeakJitterHold_urad := rTrackingError_RMS_urad;
ELSE
    rPeakJitterHold_urad := rPeakJitterHold_urad * 0.99995; (* Slow exponential decay *)
END_IF;

(* Assemble 32-Bit System Status Word *)
dwSystemStatusWord := 16#0000_0000;
IF bSystemReady          THEN dwSystemStatusWord := dwSystemStatusWord OR 16#0000_0001; END_IF;
IF bCommLinkActive       THEN dwSystemStatusWord := dwSystemStatusWord OR 16#0000_0002; END_IF;
IF bOpticalTxShutterOpen THEN dwSystemStatusWord := dwSystemStatusWord OR 16#0000_0004; END_IF;
IF bDopplerPhaseLocked   THEN dwSystemStatusWord := dwSystemStatusWord OR 16#0000_0008; END_IF;
IF (rQuadSum_mV >= 50.0) THEN dwSystemStatusWord := dwSystemStatusWord OR 16#0000_0010; END_IF;
IF bAcc_Degraded_1oo2    THEN dwSystemStatusWord := dwSystemStatusWord OR 16#0000_0020; END_IF;

IF (iState = 90)         THEN dwSystemStatusWord := dwSystemStatusWord OR 16#0000_0080; END_IF;
IF (rTrackingError_RMS_urad <= c_rJitterTarget_urad) THEN
    dwSystemStatusWord := dwSystemStatusWord OR 16#0000_0100; (* Sub-Microradian Metric Satisfied *)
END_IF;

(* Update Summary Alarm Indicator *)
bAlarmSummary := (dwAlarmWord_Critical <> 16#0000_0000) OR (dwAlarmWord_Warning <> 16#0000_0000);

END_FUNCTION_BLOCK

  1. DEEPWATER HYDROSTATIC PRESSURE COMPENSATION (SEAWATER EQUATION OF STATE - UNESCO EOS-80):
     At extreme subsea depths (up to h = 3500 m), ambient hydrostatic head exerts massive isotropic compressive
     stresses on hydraulic lines, accumulator bladders, and actuator rod seals. The hydrostatic pressure P_hydro(h)
     is governed by the depth-integrated seawater density:
         P_hydro(h) = Integral_0^h [ rho_sw(z, T_sw, S_sal) * g(phi, z) ] dz * 1.0E-5  [bar]
     where:
         - g(phi, z) is the international gravity formula adjusted for latitude (phi ~ 28.5 deg) and depth:
           g(phi, z) = 9.780327 * (1.0 + 0.0053024 * sin^2(phi) - 0.0000058 * sin^2(2*phi)) + 2.22E-6 * z  [m/s^2]
         - rho_sw(z, T_sw, S_sal) is computed via the simplified polynomial representation of UNESCO EOS-80:
           rho_sw = rho_0 + A_t * T_sw + B_t * T_sw^2 + C_s * S_sal + D_comp * P_hydro
           with standard reference salinity S_sal = 35.0 PSU and abyssal seabed temperature T_sw ~ 2.0 to 4.0 deg C.
     To prevent vacuum collapse of hydraulic reservoirs and ensure deterministic valve pilot operation, a dynamic
     spring-biased diaphragm compensator maintains a positive differential bias:
         P_reservoir_target = P_hydro(h) + DeltaP_spring_bias    (DeltaP_spring_bias = +1.50 bar)
     The net effective differential driving pressure available to the shear ram cylinder is therefore:
         DeltaP_eff = P_accumulator_supply - P_reservoir_compensated  [bar]

  2. 4TH-ORDER HYDROMETRIC SERVO-ACTUATOR STATE-SPACE FORMULATION:
     The blind shear ram tandem hydraulic actuator consists of dual large-bore double-acting cylinders driving
     hardened tool-steel shearing blades across the 18-3/4 inch wellbore. The continuous-time physical state vector is:
         x(t) = [ x_ram(t), v_ram(t), P_head(t), P_rod(t) ]^T
     where:
         - x_ram : Linear ram displacement from retracted home position [m] (Stroke L_max = 0.650 m)
         - v_ram : Linear ram velocity dx_ram/dt [m/s]
         - P_head: Cylinder cap/head-end hydraulic fluid pressure [bar] (Driving chamber, Area A_head = 0.0993 m^2)
         - P_rod : Cylinder rod-end hydraulic fluid pressure [bar] (Retracting chamber, Area A_rod = 0.0811 m^2)
     The non-linear coupled differential equations are:
         dx_ram/dt = v_ram
         dv_ram/dt = (1 / M_eff) * [ (P_head * A_head - P_rod * A_rod) * 1.0E5 - F_fric(v_ram) - F_shear(x_ram)
                                     - P_wellbore * A_wellbore_effective ]
         dP_head/dt = (Beta_eff / V_head(x_ram)) * [ Q_in(u_valve, u_boost, P_head) - A_head * v_ram ]
         dP_rod/dt  = (Beta_eff / V_rod(x_ram))  * [ -Q_out(u_valve, P_rod) + A_rod * v_ram ]
     Here:
         - M_eff = 4250.0 kg (Combined moving mass of ram carrier blocks, shear blades, and entrapped fluid column)
         - Beta_eff = 18500.0 bar (Effective fluid bulk modulus accounting for glycol-water emulsion and pipe elasticity)
         - V_head(x) = V_head_dead + A_head * x_ram
         - V_rod(x)  = V_rod_dead  + A_rod  * (L_max - x_ram)
     Linearization around the nominal cutting trajectory operating point (x0 = 0.325 m, v0 = 0.08 m/s,
     P_h0 = 310.0 bar, P_r0 = 22.0 bar) yields the discrete-time state-space matrices (A, B, C, D) for sample time Ts = 20 ms.

  3. DRILL PIPE MULTI-PHASE SHEAR FORCE DYNAMICS (API 53 S-135 DRILL COLLAR SEVERING):
     Severing an off-center 6-5/8" S-135 high-strength drill pipe (Yield strength Sigma_y >= 931 MPa, UTS >= 1050 MPa)
     under internal wellbore blowout flow follows five distinct mechanical deformation regimes:
         Phase I   (0.000 <= x < 0.280 m): Free Rapid Traverse through wellbore clearance. F_shear ~ 0 kN.
         Phase II  (0.280 <= x < 0.340 m): Pipe Ovalization & Lateral Crushing. Progressive plastic flattening.
         Phase III (0.340 <= x < 0.420 m): Blade Penetration & Strain Hardening. Shear stress reaches peak:
                   F_shear_peak = (1 / sqrt(3)) * Sigma_uts * A_shear_total * C_blade_geometry ~ 6800 to 8200 kN.
         Phase IV  (0.420 <= x < 0.460 m): Ultimate Shear Rupture & Rapid Work Rejection. Sudden load drop (-dF/dt > 400 kN/ms).
         Phase V   (0.460 <= x <= 0.650 m): Centerline Blade Overlap, Elastomeric Packer Seal Squeeze & Wedge Lock.

  4. MODEL PREDICTIVE CONTROL (MPC) QUADRATIC COST FUNCTION APPROXIMATION & LYAPUNOV STABILITY:
     To maximize shearing velocity without hydraulic cavitation while preventing structural ram impact against the BOP
     body upon sudden pipe rupture, a receding horizon quadratic cost minimization is executed:
         min_U J(U, x) = Sum_{k=1}^{Np} [ (x(k) - x_ref(k))^T * Q * (x(k) - x_ref(k)) ]
                       + Sum_{k=0}^{Nc-1} [ u(k)^T * R * u(k) + Delta_u(k)^T * S * Delta_u(k) ]
     Subject to hard kinematic and hydraulic constraints:
         -100.0% <= u_valve <= +100.0%
         0.0% <= u_boost <= 100.0%
         |Delta_u_valve| <= 25.0% per 20 ms (Water hammer mitigation)
         P_rod >= P_hydro + 2.0 bar (Strict anti-cavitation backpressure floor)
     The quadratic optimization is approximated via an active-set projected gradient descent loop over a 5-step horizon
     with analytical diagonal Hessian scaling: Delta_u = - (H_diag)^-1 * grad_J.
     Lyapunov stability is guaranteed via terminal state cost weighting P_lyap satisfying the discrete algebraic
     Riccati equation (DARE): A^T * P_lyap * A - P_lyap - (A^T * P_lyap * B) * (R + B^T * P_lyap * B)^-1 * (B^T * P_lyap * A) + Q = 0.

  5. ACOUSTIC TELEMETRY MODEM TRANSCEIVER TRIPLE MODULAR REDUNDANCY (2oo3 TMR):
     Surface command execution relies on three directional acoustic modems (Transceivers A, B, C) spaced at 120 deg
     around the LMRP framework operating in the medium-frequency acoustic band (16 to 24 kHz, nominal 18.5 kHz).
     Acoustic signals penetrate through multiphase bubble plumes and thermoclines with Thorpe transmission loss:
         TL(r) = 20 * log10(r) + alpha_acoustic * r * 1.0E-3  [dB]
         alpha_acoustic = (0.11 * f^2)/(1 + f^2) + (44 * f^2)/(4100 + f^2) + 2.75E-4 * f^2 + 0.003  [dB/km]
     Each incoming acoustic telegram contains:
         - 8-bit Preamble & Synchronization Word (0xA5)
         - 16-bit Command & Authorization Key (0xAA55)
         - 8-bit Rolling Sequence Counter (Replay attack defense)
         - 16-bit CRC-CCITT Error Detection Checksum (Polynomial 0x1021: x^16 + x^12 + x^5 + 1)
     The 2oo3 TMR voting engine evaluates bitwise majority consensus, signal-to-noise ratio (SNR >= 12.0 dB threshold),
     and Doppler shift (|Delta_f| <= 18.0 Hz). Faulty channels are dynamically quarantined, triggering seamless
     graceful degradation: 2oo3 Normal -> 1oo2 Degraded -> ROV Hot-Stab Override -> Autonomous Deadman Autoshear.

  6. DEEPWATER ACOUSTIC SOUND SPEED IN SEAWATER (MACKENZIE 1981 NINE-TERM FORMULATION):
     Acoustic ranging and multipath echo rejection require continuous estimation of the abyssal sound speed c_sw:
         c_sw(T, S, D) = 1448.96 + 4.591*T - 5.304E-2*T^2 + 2.374E-4*T^3
                       + 1.340*(S - 35.0) + 1.630E-2*D + 1.675E-7*D^2
                       - 1.025E-2*T*(S - 35.0) - 7.139E-13*T*D^3  [m/s]
     where T is temperature [deg C], S is salinity [PSU], and D is bathymetric depth [m].

   --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* Verify dual-channel hardware safety loop integrity *)

    (* Immediate failsafe lock: neutral servo spool, isolate accumulators, lock hydraulic circuit *)

    rCmdIntensifierBoost_pct        := 0.0;
    bFastDumpSolenoidCmd            := FALSE;
    bWedgeLockEngageCmd             := TRUE;  (* Fail-as-is mechanical wedge dog spring lock *)
    bPackerGelInjectionCmd          := FALSE;
    bAcousticTxEnable               := TRUE;
    dwAcousticTxPayload             := 16#DEADF001; (* Emergency Stop Trip Code *)

    wDiagnosticFaultWord.0          := TRUE;  (* E-Stop Trip Active *)
    wAlarmSeverityWord.0            := TRUE;  (* Severity: Emergency *)
    bSystemAlarm                    := TRUE;
    wSystemStatusWord               := 16#F000;
    iCurrentState                   := 999;   (* Jump immediately to Failsafe Shutdown *)
    iActiveSequenceState            := 999;
    RETURN;
END_IF;

(* Autonomous Deadman / Autoshear Disconnect Trigger (Umbilical parted or LMRP separation) *)
IF bEmergencyAutoshearTrigger AND (iCurrentState < 50) THEN
    (* Riser severance detected: initiate immediate full-power autonomous cut bypass *)
    bAutoshearArmed                 := TRUE;
    wAlarmSeverityWord.0            := TRUE;  (* Emergency Severity *)
    wSystemStatusWord.14            := TRUE;  (* Autoshear Engaged *)
    iCurrentState                   := 950;   (* Jump to Autonomous Deadman Autoshear Routine *)
END_IF;

(* Extreme Wellbore Overpressure Trip: Annular well pressure exceeding rating *)
IF (rBOPWellborePressure_bar > 1034.0) THEN
    wDiagnosticFaultWord.15         := TRUE;  (* Wellbore Extreme Overpressure Alarm *)
    wAlarmSeverityWord.0            := TRUE;
    bSystemAlarm                    := TRUE;
END_IF;

(* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
   LAYER 1: DEEPWATER HYDROSTATIC PRESSURE COMPENSATION, THERMAL PROPERTIES & OCEAN ACOUSTIC PROPAGATION
   --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* Compute dynamic seawater density at depth and abyssal temperature:
   rho_sw(T, S, P) = rho_0(S, T) / (1 - P / K(S, T, P))
   Using simplified high-accuracy industrial polynomial for subsea BOP controls: *)
rCalculatedSeawaterDensity_kgm3 := 1027.0
    + (0.0045 * rSubseaWaterDepth_m)
    - (0.0650 * (rSeawaterTemperature_degC - 4.0))
    + (0.7500 * (c_rSeawaterSalinityRef_PSU - 35.0));

(* Limit seawater density to realistic oceanic envelope (1020 .. 1045 kg/m^3) *)
IF rCalculatedSeawaterDensity_kgm3 < 1020.0 THEN
    rCalculatedSeawaterDensity_kgm3 := 1020.0;
ELSIF rCalculatedSeawaterDensity_kgm3 > 1045.0 THEN
    rCalculatedSeawaterDensity_kgm3 := 1045.0;
END_IF;

(* Theoretical hydrostatic pressure at wellhead datum: P = rho * g * h * 10^-5 bar *)
rTheoreticalHydrostaticPress_bar := (rCalculatedSeawaterDensity_kgm3 * c_rGravityRef_mps2 * rSubseaWaterDepth_m) * 1.0E-5;

(* Verify ambient hydrostatic sensor plausibility against theoretical head *)
IF ABS(rAmbientHydrostaticPress_bar - rTheoreticalHydrostaticPress_bar) > 25.0 THEN
    wDiagnosticFaultWord.1 := TRUE; (* Hydrostatic Transducer Divergence Alarm *)
    wAlarmSeverityWord.1   := TRUE; (* Severity: High *)
    bSystemAlarm           := TRUE;
ELSE
    wDiagnosticFaultWord.1 := FALSE;
END_IF;

(* Hydrostatic Reservoir Return Compensator Evaluation:
   The compensator bladder must maintain +1.50 bar over ambient hydrostatic to prevent seawater intrusion *)
rCompensatorBiasError_bar := rReservoirCompensatorPress_bar - (rAmbientHydrostaticPress_bar + 1.50);

IF (rCompensatorBiasError_bar < -1.00) THEN
    (* Severe risk of seawater ingress into hydraulic fluid *)
    wDiagnosticFaultWord.2 := TRUE; (* Reservoir Under-Pressure Fault *)
    wAlarmSeverityWord.0   := TRUE; (* Severity: Emergency *)
    bSystemAlarm           := TRUE;
    bHydrostaticEquilibrated := FALSE;
ELSIF (rCompensatorBiasError_bar > 12.0) THEN
    (* Excessive backpressure reduces actuator shearing force capability *)
    wDiagnosticFaultWord.3 := TRUE; (* Reservoir Over-Pressure Fault *)
    wAlarmSeverityWord.1   := TRUE; (* Severity: High *)
    bSystemAlarm           := TRUE;
    bHydrostaticEquilibrated := FALSE;
ELSE
    wDiagnosticFaultWord.2 := FALSE;
    wDiagnosticFaultWord.3 := FALSE;
    bHydrostaticEquilibrated := TRUE;
END_IF;

(* Dynamic Hydraulic Fluid Bulk Modulus (Beta_eff) calculation taking pressure and temperature into account:
   Beta_eff(P, T) = Beta_0 + (10.5 * P) - (45.0 * (T - 20.0)) *)
rFluidEffectiveBulkModulus_bar := c_rBaseFluidBulkModulus_bar
    + (10.5 * rAccumulatorSupplyPressure_bar)
    - (45.0 * (rHydraulicFluidTemp_degC - 20.0));

IF rFluidEffectiveBulkModulus_bar < 12000.0 THEN
    rFluidEffectiveBulkModulus_bar := 12000.0;
ELSIF rFluidEffectiveBulkModulus_bar > 25000.0 THEN
    rFluidEffectiveBulkModulus_bar := 25000.0;
END_IF;

(* Hydraulic Fluid Temperature Monitoring *)
IF (rHydraulicFluidTemp_degC > 65.0) THEN
    wDiagnosticFaultWord.12 := TRUE; (* Hydraulic Fluid Overheating Alarm *)
    wAlarmSeverityWord.1   := TRUE;
    bSystemAlarm           := TRUE;
ELSE
    wDiagnosticFaultWord.12 := FALSE;
END_IF;

(* Calculate net effective differential driving pressure available to the cylinder *)
rEffectiveDiffPress_bar := rAccumulatorSupplyPressure_bar - rReservoirCompensatorPress_bar;
rAvailableDifferentialHead_bar := rEffectiveDiffPress_bar;

(* Validate subsea accumulator charge capacity (API Standard 53 minimum) *)
IF (rAccumulatorSupplyPressure_bar < c_rMinAccumulatorCharge_bar) AND (NOT bROVHotStabConnected) THEN
    wDiagnosticFaultWord.4 := TRUE; (* Accumulator Bank Pressure Depleted Alarm *)
    wAlarmSeverityWord.0   := TRUE; (* Severity: Emergency *)
    bSystemAlarm           := TRUE;
ELSE
    wDiagnosticFaultWord.4 := FALSE;
END_IF;

(* Real-Time Hydraulic Volumetric Leakage Estimation:
   Q_leakage = Q_measured - (A_head * v_ram * 60,000 L/min) *)
rTheoreticalPistonFlow_Lmin := c_rPistonAreaHead_m2 * rRamLinearVelocity_mps * 60000.0;
IF (rHydraulicActuationFlow_Lmin > rTheoreticalPistonFlow_Lmin) AND (iCurrentState >= 30) AND (iCurrentState <= 60) THEN
    rVolumetricLeakageRate_Lmin := rHydraulicActuationFlow_Lmin - rTheoreticalPistonFlow_Lmin;
    IF (rVolumetricLeakageRate_Lmin > 180.0) THEN
        wDiagnosticFaultWord.11 := TRUE; (* High Volumetric Leakage Bypass Fault *)
        wAlarmSeverityWord.1   := TRUE;
        bSystemAlarm           := TRUE;
    ELSE
        wDiagnosticFaultWord.11 := FALSE;
    END_IF;
ELSE
    rVolumetricLeakageRate_Lmin := 0.0;
    wDiagnosticFaultWord.11     := FALSE;
END_IF;

(* Rod-End Cavitation Floor Assessment: P_rod must exceed hydrostatic pressure + 2.0 bar *)
IF (aStateVector[4] < (rAmbientHydrostaticPress_bar + 2.0)) AND (iCurrentState >= 30) AND (iCurrentState <= 60) THEN
    wDiagnosticFaultWord.13 := TRUE; (* Cavitation Warning on Rod Chamber *)
    wAlarmSeverityWord.2    := TRUE;
ELSE
    wDiagnosticFaultWord.13 := FALSE;
END_IF;

(* Mackenzie (1981) 9-Term Oceanographic Sound Speed Formulation in Deepwater:
   c(T, S, D) = 1448.96 + 4.591*T - 5.304E-2*T^2 + 2.374E-4*T^3
              + 1.340*(S - 35) + 1.630E-2*D + 1.675E-7*D^2 - 1.025E-2*T*(S - 35) - 7.139E-13*T*D^3 *)
rDeepwaterSoundSpeed_mps := 1448.96
    + (4.591 * rSeawaterTemperature_degC)
    - (0.05304 * rSeawaterTemperature_degC * rSeawaterTemperature_degC)
    + (0.0002374 * rSeawaterTemperature_degC * rSeawaterTemperature_degC * rSeawaterTemperature_degC)
    + (1.340 * (c_rSeawaterSalinityRef_PSU - 35.0))
    + (0.01630 * rSubseaWaterDepth_m)
    + (1.675E-7 * rSubseaWaterDepth_m * rSubseaWaterDepth_m)
    - (0.01025 * rSeawaterTemperature_degC * (c_rSeawaterSalinityRef_PSU - 35.0))
    - (7.139E-13 * rSeawaterTemperature_degC * rSubseaWaterDepth_m * rSubseaWaterDepth_m * rSubseaWaterDepth_m);

(* Thorpe Empirical Seawater Acoustic Attenuation Coefficient at Carrier Frequency f [kHz]:
   alpha(f) = (0.11 * f^2) / (1 + f^2) + (44 * f^2) / (4100 + f^2) + 2.75E-4 * f^2 + 0.003  [dB/km] *)
IF (rAcousticCarrierFreq_kHz > 1.0) AND (rAcousticCarrierFreq_kHz < 100.0) THEN
    rAcousticThorpeAtten_dB_km := ((0.11 * rAcousticCarrierFreq_kHz * rAcousticCarrierFreq_kHz) / (1.0 + (rAcousticCarrierFreq_kHz * rAcousticCarrierFreq_kHz)))
        + ((44.0 * rAcousticCarrierFreq_kHz * rAcousticCarrierFreq_kHz) / (4100.0 + (rAcousticCarrierFreq_kHz * rAcousticCarrierFreq_kHz)))
        + (0.000275 * rAcousticCarrierFreq_kHz * rAcousticCarrierFreq_kHz)
        + 0.0030;
ELSE
    rAcousticThorpeAtten_dB_km := 1.850; (* Default attenuation at 18.5 kHz in cold seawater *)
END_IF;

(* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
   LAYER 2: ACOUSTIC TELEMETRY TRANSCEIVER TRIPLE MODULAR REDUNDANCY (2oo3 TMR) ENGINE
   --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* Channel Validity Assessment based on hardware CRC, packet lock, SNR threshold (12.0 dB), and Doppler limit *)
bModemA_Trusted := bAcousticPktValid_ModemA AND (rAcousticSNR_ModemA_dB >= 12.0) AND (ABS(rAcousticDopplerShiftA_Hz) <= 18.0);
bModemB_Trusted := bAcousticPktValid_ModemB AND (rAcousticSNR_ModemB_dB >= 12.0) AND (ABS(rAcousticDopplerShiftB_Hz) <= 18.0);
bModemC_Trusted := bAcousticPktValid_ModemC AND (rAcousticSNR_ModemC_dB >= 12.0) AND (ABS(rAcousticDopplerShiftC_Hz) <= 18.0);

(* Count healthy receiving transducers *)
iHealthyModemCount := 0;
IF bModemA_Trusted THEN iHealthyModemCount := iHealthyModemCount + 1; END_IF;
IF bModemB_Trusted THEN iHealthyModemCount := iHealthyModemCount + 1; END_IF;
IF bModemC_Trusted THEN iHealthyModemCount := iHealthyModemCount + 1; END_IF;

(* Dynamic SNR Weighted Beamforming Calculation *)
rSumSNR := 0.0;
IF bModemA_Trusted THEN rSumSNR := rSumSNR + rAcousticSNR_ModemA_dB; END_IF;
IF bModemB_Trusted THEN rSumSNR := rSumSNR + rAcousticSNR_ModemB_dB; END_IF;
IF bModemC_Trusted THEN rSumSNR := rSumSNR + rAcousticSNR_ModemC_dB; END_IF;

IF (rSumSNR > 1.0) THEN
    IF bModemA_Trusted THEN rWeightModemA := rAcousticSNR_ModemA_dB / rSumSNR; ELSE rWeightModemA := 0.0; END_IF;
    IF bModemB_Trusted THEN rWeightModemB := rAcousticSNR_ModemB_dB / rSumSNR; ELSE rWeightModemB := 0.0; END_IF;
    IF bModemC_Trusted THEN rWeightModemC := rAcousticSNR_ModemC_dB / rSumSNR; ELSE rWeightModemC := 0.0; END_IF;
ELSE
    rWeightModemA := 0.3333;
    rWeightModemB := 0.3333;
    rWeightModemC := 0.3333;
END_IF;

(* Bitwise Consensus Voting Logic *)
IF (iHealthyModemCount = 3) THEN
    (* Full 3-Channel Transceiver Consensus Evaluation *)
    IF (dwAcousticPacket_ModemA = dwAcousticPacket_ModemB) AND (dwAcousticPacket_ModemB = dwAcousticPacket_ModemC) THEN
        dwConsensusPacket := dwAcousticPacket_ModemA;
        bVoteQuorumAchieved := TRUE;
        bDegradedTMRActive := FALSE;
        wDiagnosticFaultWord.5 := FALSE; (* Acoustic TMR Discrepancy Clear *)
        rVotedSNR_dB := (rAcousticSNR_ModemA_dB * rWeightModemA)
                      + (rAcousticSNR_ModemB_dB * rWeightModemB)
                      + (rAcousticSNR_ModemC_dB * rWeightModemC);

    ELSIF (dwAcousticPacket_ModemA = dwAcousticPacket_ModemB) THEN
        (* Channel C Discrepant: Quarantine Channel C *)
        dwConsensusPacket := dwAcousticPacket_ModemA;
        bVoteQuorumAchieved := TRUE;
        bDegradedTMRActive := TRUE;
        iModemQuarantineCounterC := iModemQuarantineCounterC + 1;
        wDiagnosticFaultWord.5 := TRUE;
        wAlarmSeverityWord.2   := TRUE; (* Severity: Medium *)
        rVotedSNR_dB := (rAcousticSNR_ModemA_dB + rAcousticSNR_ModemB_dB) * 0.5;

    ELSIF (dwAcousticPacket_ModemB = dwAcousticPacket_ModemC) THEN
        (* Channel A Discrepant: Quarantine Channel A *)
        dwConsensusPacket := dwAcousticPacket_ModemB;
        bVoteQuorumAchieved := TRUE;
        bDegradedTMRActive := TRUE;
        iModemQuarantineCounterA := iModemQuarantineCounterA + 1;
        wDiagnosticFaultWord.5 := TRUE;
        wAlarmSeverityWord.2   := TRUE;
        rVotedSNR_dB := (rAcousticSNR_ModemB_dB + rAcousticSNR_ModemC_dB) * 0.5;

    ELSIF (dwAcousticPacket_ModemA = dwAcousticPacket_ModemC) THEN
        (* Channel B Discrepant: Quarantine Channel B *)
        dwConsensusPacket := dwAcousticPacket_ModemA;
        bVoteQuorumAchieved := TRUE;
        bDegradedTMRActive := TRUE;
        iModemQuarantineCounterB := iModemQuarantineCounterB + 1;
        wDiagnosticFaultWord.5 := TRUE;
        wAlarmSeverityWord.2   := TRUE;
        rVotedSNR_dB := (rAcousticSNR_ModemA_dB + rAcousticSNR_ModemC_dB) * 0.5;

    ELSE
        (* Total TMR Asynchrony / Spurious Plume Noise: No two channels match *)
        dwConsensusPacket := 16#00000000;
        bVoteQuorumAchieved := FALSE;
        bDegradedTMRActive := TRUE;
        wDiagnosticFaultWord.5 := TRUE;
        wAlarmSeverityWord.1   := TRUE; (* Severity: High *)
        rVotedSNR_dB := 0.0;
    END_IF;

ELSIF (iHealthyModemCount = 2) THEN
    (* Degraded 1oo2 Voting Mode *)
    bDegradedTMRActive := TRUE;
    wDiagnosticFaultWord.5 := TRUE;
    wAlarmSeverityWord.2   := TRUE;

    IF bModemA_Trusted AND bModemB_Trusted THEN
        IF (dwAcousticPacket_ModemA = dwAcousticPacket_ModemB) THEN
            dwConsensusPacket := dwAcousticPacket_ModemA;
            bVoteQuorumAchieved := TRUE;
            rVotedSNR_dB := (rAcousticSNR_ModemA_dB + rAcousticSNR_ModemB_dB) * 0.5;
        ELSE
            bVoteQuorumAchieved := FALSE;
            dwConsensusPacket := 16#00000000;
        END_IF;

    ELSIF bModemB_Trusted AND bModemC_Trusted THEN
        IF (dwAcousticPacket_ModemB = dwAcousticPacket_ModemC) THEN
            dwConsensusPacket := dwAcousticPacket_ModemB;
            bVoteQuorumAchieved := TRUE;
            rVotedSNR_dB := (rAcousticSNR_ModemB_dB + rAcousticSNR_ModemC_dB) * 0.5;
        ELSE
            bVoteQuorumAchieved := FALSE;
            dwConsensusPacket := 16#00000000;
        END_IF;

    ELSIF bModemA_Trusted AND bModemC_Trusted THEN
        IF (dwAcousticPacket_ModemA = dwAcousticPacket_ModemC) THEN
            dwConsensusPacket := dwAcousticPacket_ModemA;
            bVoteQuorumAchieved := TRUE;
            rVotedSNR_dB := (rAcousticSNR_ModemA_dB + rAcousticSNR_ModemC_dB) * 0.5;
        ELSE
            bVoteQuorumAchieved := FALSE;
            dwConsensusPacket := 16#00000000;
        END_IF;
    END_IF;

ELSIF (iHealthyModemCount = 1) THEN
    (* Severe Acoustic Degradation: Single surviving modem *)
    bDegradedTMRActive := TRUE;
    wDiagnosticFaultWord.6 := TRUE; (* Severe Acoustic Telemetry Loss *)
    wAlarmSeverityWord.1   := TRUE; (* Severity: High *)
    bVoteQuorumAchieved := FALSE;    (* Single channel cannot command safety-critical shear alone *)
    dwConsensusPacket := 16#00000000;

ELSE
    (* Total Acoustic Link Loss: Multipath plume attenuation / transducer damage *)
    bDegradedTMRActive := FALSE;
    wDiagnosticFaultWord.6 := TRUE;
    wAlarmSeverityWord.0   := TRUE; (* Severity: Emergency *)
    bVoteQuorumAchieved := FALSE;
    dwConsensusPacket := 16#00000000;
    rVotedSNR_dB := 0.0;
END_IF;

(* Acoustic Command Demultiplexing & Decryption *)
IF bVoteQuorumAchieved THEN
    (* Verify 16-bit Security Authentication Key *)
    IF ((dwConsensusPacket AND 16#FFFF0000) = c_dwAuthKeyMask) THEN
        (* Check Subcommands *)
        IF ((dwConsensusPacket AND 16#0000FFFF) = c_dwArmSubcommand) THEN
            bAcousticArmedSignal := TRUE;
            bAcousticCutSignal   := FALSE;
        ELSIF ((dwConsensusPacket AND 16#0000FFFF) = c_dwCutSubcommand) THEN
            bAcousticCutSignal   := TRUE;
        ELSE
            bAcousticArmedSignal := FALSE;
            bAcousticCutSignal   := FALSE;
        END_IF;
    ELSE
        bAcousticArmedSignal := FALSE;
        bAcousticCutSignal   := FALSE;
        wDiagnosticFaultWord.7 := TRUE; (* Invalid Acoustic Security Key *)
        wAlarmSeverityWord.1   := TRUE;
    END_IF;
ELSE
    bAcousticArmedSignal := FALSE;
    bAcousticCutSignal   := FALSE;
END_IF;

(* Acoustic Loss Watchdog Timer *)
tAcousticLossWatchdog(IN := (iHealthyModemCount < 2), PT := T#45S);
IF tAcousticLossWatchdog.Q AND (NOT bROVHotStabConnected) THEN
    wDiagnosticFaultWord.8 := TRUE; (* Acoustic Telemetry Blackout Alarm *)
    wAlarmSeverityWord.0   := TRUE; (* Severity: Emergency *)
    bSystemAlarm := TRUE;
END_IF;

(* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
   LAYER 3: 4TH-ORDER HYDRAULIC OBSERVER & KINEMATICS STATE RECONSTRUCTION
   --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* Update State Vector from Calibrated Transducers *)
aStateVector[1] := rRamPosition_m;
aStateVector[2] := rRamLinearVelocity_mps;
aStateVector[3] := rAccumulatorSupplyPressure_bar;
aStateVector[4] := rReservoirCompensatorPress_bar;

(* State Observer Innovation Correction: x_hat(k) = A*x_hat(k-1) + B*u(k-1) + L*(y(k) - C*x_hat(k-1)) *)
FOR iRow := 1 TO 4 DO
    aStateError[iRow] := aStateVector[iRow] - aStatePredicted[iRow];
END_FOR;

FOR iRow := 1 TO 4 DO
    aStatePredicted[iRow] := 0.0;
    (* State transition multiplication: A * x *)
    FOR iCol := 1 TO 4 DO
        aStatePredicted[iRow] := aStatePredicted[iRow] + (aMatrixA[iRow, iCol] * aStateVector[iCol]);
    END_FOR;
    (* Input coupling multiplication: B * u *)
    aStatePredicted[iRow] := aStatePredicted[iRow]
        + (aMatrixB[iRow, 1] * (rCmdServoValveSpool_pct / 100.0))
        + (aMatrixB[iRow, 2] * (rCmdIntensifierBoost_pct / 100.0));
    (* Observer correction *)
    aStatePredicted[iRow] := aStatePredicted[iRow] + (aStateObserverGain_L[iRow] * aStateError[iRow]);
END_FOR;

(* Dynamic Actuator Thrust Calculation: F = (P_head * A_head - P_rod * A_rod) * 100 kN *)
rVotedRamThrust_kN := ((aStateVector[3] * c_rPistonAreaHead_m2) - (aStateVector[4] * c_rPistonAreaRod_m2)) * 100.0;

(* Force Derivative Calculation for Shear Inflection Detection *)
rIncrementalStroke_m := rRamPosition_m - rPrevRamPosition_m;
rPrevRamPosition_m   := rRamPosition_m;

IF (c_rNominalSamplingTime_s > 0.0) THEN
    rForceDerivative_kNps := (rVotedRamThrust_kN - rPrevThrustForce_kN) / c_rNominalSamplingTime_s;
    rPrevThrustForce_kN   := rVotedRamThrust_kN;
    (* First-order digital low-pass filtering on force derivative (tau = 60 ms) *)
    rFilteredForceDerivative_kNps := (0.25 * rForceDerivative_kNps) + (0.75 * rFilteredForceDerivative_kNps);
END_IF;

(* Real-Time Mechanical Cutting Energy Integration: E = Integral [ F_thrust * dx ] *)
IF (rIncrementalStroke_m > 0.0) AND (iCurrentState >= 40) AND (iCurrentState <= 60) THEN
    rAccumulatedShearEnergy_kJ := rAccumulatedShearEnergy_kJ + (rVotedRamThrust_kN * rIncrementalStroke_m);
    rMechanicalShearWork_kJ    := rAccumulatedShearEnergy_kJ;
END_IF;

(* Instantaneous Estimated Pipe Resistance: R_pipe = F_thrust - M_eff * dv/dt - F_wellbore *)
rCalculatedPipeResistance_kN := rVotedRamThrust_kN - (4.250 * (aStateVector[2] / c_rNominalSamplingTime_s))
                                - (rBOPWellborePressure_bar * 0.0275);
IF rCalculatedPipeResistance_kN < 0.0 THEN
    rCalculatedPipeResistance_kN := 0.0;
END_IF;

(* Track Peak Observed Cutting Force *)
IF (rVotedRamThrust_kN > rShearPeakForceObserved_kN) AND (iCurrentState >= 40) THEN
    rShearPeakForceObserved_kN := rVotedRamThrust_kN;
END_IF;

(* Detect Physical Drill Pipe Engagement & Shear Rupture *)
IF (rRamPosition_m >= c_rWellboreClearanceEnd_m) AND (rFilteredForceDerivative_kNps > 1500.0) THEN
    bPipeContactDetected := TRUE;
END_IF;

(* Shear Rupture occurs when force derivative drops severely after high thrust plateau *)
IF bPipeContactDetected AND (rShearPeakForceObserved_kN > 3500.0) AND (rFilteredForceDerivative_kNps < -4500.0) THEN
    bShearBreakthroughDetected := TRUE;
END_IF;

(* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
   LAYER 4: MODEL PREDICTIVE CONTROL (MPC) QUADRATIC COST OPTIMIZATION KERNEL
   --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* Evaluate State Tracking Errors relative to Active Phase Reference Targets *)
rGradientValve := 0.0;
rGradientBoost := 0.0;

(* Quadratic Performance Index: J = e_x^T * Q * e_x + u^T * R * u + Delta_u^T * S * Delta_u *)
rCostFunctionJ := (aDiagWeightQ[1] * (aStateVector[1] - rTargetTrajectoryPos_m) * (aStateVector[1] - rTargetTrajectoryPos_m))
                + (aDiagWeightQ[2] * (aStateVector[2] - rTargetTrajectoryVel_mps) * (aStateVector[2] - rTargetTrajectoryVel_mps))
                + (aDiagWeightQ[3] * (aStateVector[3] - rTargetHeadPressure_bar) * (aStateVector[3] - rTargetHeadPressure_bar))
                + (aDiagWeightR[1] * (rPrevValveSpoolCmd_pct / 100.0) * (rPrevValveSpoolCmd_pct / 100.0))
                + (aDiagWeightR[2] * (rPrevBoostCmd_pct / 100.0) * (rPrevBoostCmd_pct / 100.0));

(* Compute Analytical Gradients along 5-Step Prediction Horizon *)
FOR iHorizonStep := 1 TO 5 DO
    (* Position error gradient contribution *)
    rGradientValve := rGradientValve + (aDiagWeightQ[1] * (aStatePredicted[1] - rTargetTrajectoryPos_m) * aMatrixB[1, 1]);
    (* Velocity tracking gradient contribution *)
    rGradientValve := rGradientValve + (aDiagWeightQ[2] * (aStatePredicted[2] - rTargetTrajectoryVel_mps) * aMatrixB[2, 1]);
    (* Pressure gradient contribution for booster intensification *)
    rGradientBoost := rGradientBoost + (aDiagWeightQ[3] * (aStatePredicted[3] - rTargetHeadPressure_bar) * aMatrixB[3, 2]);
END_FOR;

(* Regularization and Slew Rate Damping *)
rGradientValve := rGradientValve + (aDiagWeightR[1] * (rPrevValveSpoolCmd_pct / 100.0))
                + (aDiagWeightS[1] * ((rPrevValveSpoolCmd_pct - rCmdServoValveSpool_pct) / 100.0));
rGradientBoost := rGradientBoost + (aDiagWeightR[2] * (rPrevBoostCmd_pct / 100.0))
                + (aDiagWeightS[2] * ((rPrevBoostCmd_pct - rCmdIntensifierBoost_pct) / 100.0));

(* Pre-calculate Diagonal Inverse Hessian Approximation: H_diag = B^T * Q * B + R + S *)
aHessianDiagonalInv[1] := 1.0 / ( (aMatrixB[1, 1] * aMatrixB[1, 1] * aDiagWeightQ[1])
                                + (aMatrixB[2, 1] * aMatrixB[2, 1] * aDiagWeightQ[2])
                                + aDiagWeightR[1] + aDiagWeightS[1] + 0.050 );

aHessianDiagonalInv[2] := 1.0 / ( (aMatrixB[3, 2] * aMatrixB[3, 2] * aDiagWeightQ[3])
                                + aDiagWeightR[2] + aDiagWeightS[2] + 0.050 );

(* Iterative Projected Newton-Gradient Descent Optimization (4 internal iterations per cycle) *)
rOptimalDeltaValve := rPrevValveSpoolCmd_pct;
rOptimalDeltaBoost := rPrevBoostCmd_pct;

FOR iOptStep := 1 TO 4 DO
    rOptimalDeltaValve := rOptimalDeltaValve - (aHessianDiagonalInv[1] * rGradientValve * 12.50);
    rOptimalDeltaBoost := rOptimalDeltaBoost - (aHessianDiagonalInv[2] * rGradientBoost * 10.00);

    (* Enforce Slew Rate Clamping (|Delta_u| <= 25.0% per 20 ms to prevent water hammer) *)
    IF (rOptimalDeltaValve - rPrevValveSpoolCmd_pct) > 25.0 THEN
        rOptimalDeltaValve := rPrevValveSpoolCmd_pct + 25.0;
    ELSIF (rOptimalDeltaValve - rPrevValveSpoolCmd_pct) < -25.0 THEN
        rOptimalDeltaValve := rPrevValveSpoolCmd_pct - 25.0;
    END_IF;

    (* Enforce Actuator Saturation Constraints *)
    IF rOptimalDeltaValve > 100.0 THEN
        rOptimalDeltaValve := 100.0;
    ELSIF rOptimalDeltaValve < -100.0 THEN
        rOptimalDeltaValve := -100.0;
    END_IF;

    IF rOptimalDeltaBoost > 100.0 THEN
        rOptimalDeltaBoost := 100.0;
    ELSIF rOptimalDeltaBoost < 0.0 THEN
        rOptimalDeltaBoost := 0.0;
    END_IF;
END_FOR;

(* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
   LAYER 5: SEQUENTIAL FINITE STATE MACHINE (BOP SHEAR RAM EXECUTION PHASES)
   --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
CASE iCurrentState OF

    0: (* STATE_STANDBY_IDLE_MONITORING: Passive monitoring, hydro balance check, acoustic ping *)
        rCmdServoValveSpool_pct         := 0.0;
        rCmdIntensifierBoost_pct        := 0.0;
        bFastDumpSolenoidCmd            := FALSE;
        bWedgeLockEngageCmd             := FALSE;
        bPackerGelInjectionCmd          := FALSE;
        bRamSealedAndLocked             := FALSE;
        bPipeContactDetected            := FALSE;
        bShearBreakthroughDetected      := FALSE;
        bWedgeLockConfirmed             := FALSE;
        rShearPeakForceObserved_kN      := 0.0;
        rAccumulatedShearEnergy_kJ      := 0.0;
        wSystemStatusWord               := 16#0001; (* Bit 0: System Ready / Idle *)

        (* Acoustic Transceiver Periodic Telemetry Broadcast (Every 5 seconds) *)
        tStatePhaseTimer(IN := TRUE, PT := T#5S);
        IF tStatePhaseTimer.Q THEN
            tStatePhaseTimer(IN := FALSE);
            bAcousticTxEnable := TRUE;
