    rCmdStillHeaterPower_uW         : REAL;     (* Main Still resistive heater output power [uW] (0.0 - 50000.0 uW) *)
    rCmdStillFilmBurner_uW          : REAL;     (* Rollin superfluid film suppression collar heater [uW] *)
    rCmdJTValvePosition_pct         : REAL;     (* Stepper J-T micro-metering needle valve position [%] (0.0 - 100.0%) *)
    rCmdCondensingBypassValve_pct   : REAL;     (* High-pressure return line proportional bypass throttle [%] *)

    (* Discrete Subsystem Digital Permissives & Contactor Demands *)
    bHe3CompressorRunCmd            : BOOL;     (* Room temperature oil-free 3He circulation compressor enable *)
    bTurbomolecularStillPumpRunCmd  : BOOL;     (* Magnetic-bearing turbomolecular still pumping station run *)
    bDumpTankIsolationValveOpen     : BOOL;     (* 3He/4He isotopic storage dump tank isolation valve open *)
    bCryoTrapRegenHeaterCmd         : BOOL;     (* Liquid nitrogen / charcoal pre-filter trap regenerator *)
    bEmergencyDumpValveOpen         : BOOL;     (* Failsafe high-speed recovery dump valve into expansion volume *)

    (* Supervisory Diagnostic Registers and Status Words *)
    wSystemStatusWord               : WORD;     (* Status: Bit0=Run, Bit1=TMR_Ok, Bit2=PotReady, Bit3=Condensing, Bit4=Separated, Bit5=MCDilution *)
    wFaultWord1                     : WORD;     (* Trip Faults: Bit0=EStop, Bit1=OVC_Vac, Bit2=Overpressure, Bit3=1KDryout, Bit4=StillRunaway *)
    wFaultWord2                     : WORD;     (* Diagnostic Faults: Bit0=StillTMR_Drift, Bit1=PotTMR_Drift, Bit2=FlowStall, Bit3=TrapClogged *)
    bSystemAlarm                    : BOOL;     (* Master summary audible/visual alarm annunciator *)
    bDegradedTMRActive              : BOOL;     (* Sensor operating in 1oo2 degraded configuration *)

    (* Validated Physical & Thermodynamic Telemetry *)
    rVotedStillTemp_mK              : REAL;     (* 2oo3 TMR validated Still temperature [mK] *)
    rVoted1KPotTemp_K               : REAL;     (* 2oo3 TMR validated 1-Kelvin Pot temperature [K] *)
    rEstimatedCoolingPowerMC_uW     : REAL;     (* Calculated instantaneous dilution cooling power at MC [uW] *)
    rStillVaporPurityHe3_pct        : REAL;     (* Real-time Raoult-Dalton estimated 3He vapor phase purity [%] *)
    rCryoTrapImpedanceIndex         : REAL;     (* Normalized flow impedance ratio across cold traps [mbar / (umol/s)] *)
    iSequenceStep                   : INT;      (* Current active cryogenic phase state index *)
END_VAR

VAR
    (* -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
       TRIPLE MODULAR REDUNDANCY (2oo3 TMR) SENSOR INTERNALS
       ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
    bStillChanA_Valid               : BOOL := TRUE;
    bStillChanB_Valid               : BOOL := TRUE;
    bStillChanC_Valid               : BOOL := TRUE;
    rStillDiff_AB                   : REAL := 0.0;
    rStillDiff_BC                   : REAL := 0.0;
    rStillDiff_CA                   : REAL := 0.0;
    iStillHealthyCount              : INT  := 3;

    bPotChanA_Valid                 : BOOL := TRUE;
    bPotChanB_Valid                 : BOOL := TRUE;
    bPotChanC_Valid                 : BOOL := TRUE;
    rPotDiff_AB                     : REAL := 0.0;
    rPotDiff_BC                     : REAL := 0.0;
    rPotDiff_CA                     : REAL := 0.0;
    iPotHealthyCount                : INT  := 3;

    (* -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
       STATE-SPACE MATRICES & MODEL PREDICTIVE CONTROL (MPC) KERNEL
       State vector x = [ Delta T_still [mK], Delta n_dot_3 [umol/s], Delta T_1K [mK], Delta P_cond [mbar] ]^T
       Control vector u = [ Delta Q_still [uW], Delta u_JT [%] ]^T
       ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
    aStateVector                    : ARRAY[1..4] OF REAL; (* x(k) *)
    aStateSetpoint                  : ARRAY[1..4] OF REAL; (* x_ref *)
    aControlVector                  : ARRAY[1..2] OF REAL; (* u(k) *)
    aControlPrev                    : ARRAY[1..2] OF REAL; (* u(k-1) *)
    aControlDelta                   : ARRAY[1..2] OF REAL; (* Delta u(k) *)
    aGradientVector                 : ARRAY[1..2] OF REAL; (* Gradient g = del J / del u *)

    (* Discrete Plant Transition Matrix A_d (4x4) for Ts = 100 ms *)
    aMatrix_A                       : ARRAY[1..4, 1..4] OF REAL := [
        [0.9885, -0.0125,  0.0042,  0.0018],    (* Row 1: d(T_still)/dt dynamics *)
        [0.0450,  0.9620,  0.0010,  0.0820],    (* Row 2: d(n_dot_3)/dt dynamics *)
        [0.0008, -0.0002,  0.9780,  0.0065],    (* Row 3: d(T_1K)/dt dynamics    *)
        [-0.0150, -0.1250, 0.0420,  0.9410]     (* Row 4: d(P_cond)/dt dynamics  *)
    ];

    (* Discrete Control Input Matrix B_d (4x2) for Ts = 100 ms *)
    aMatrix_B                       : ARRAY[1..4, 1..2] OF REAL := [
        [ 0.01450, -0.00320 ],                  (* Input 1: Q_still heater -> T_still, n_dot_3, T_1K, P_cond *)
        [ 0.02850,  0.04800 ],                  (* Input 2: JT valve position -> T_still, n_dot_3, T_1K, P_cond *)
        [ 0.00012,  0.00840 ],
        [-0.00450, -0.18500 ]
    ];

    (* MPC Quadratic Cost Weighting Diagonal Matrices *)
    aWeight_Q                       : ARRAY[1..4] OF REAL := [1.250, 0.850, 2.400, 0.650]; (* State error penalties *)
    aWeight_R                       : ARRAY[1..2] OF REAL := [0.004, 0.012];               (* Actuator effort penalties *)
    aWeight_S                       : ARRAY[1..2] OF REAL := [0.050, 0.150];               (* Actuator slew rate penalties *)

    (* Projected Gradient Descent Solver Parameters *)
    c_iMPC_MaxIter                  : INT  := 8;
    c_rMPC_Alpha                    : REAL := 0.085;    (* Optimization step size *)

    (* -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
       THERMODYNAMIC EQUATIONS & RAOULT-DALTON ESTIMATION REGISTERS
       ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
    rP_sat3_mbar                    : REAL := 0.0;
    rP_sat4_mbar                    : REAL := 0.0;
    rLiquidConcentrationHe3         : REAL := 0.012;    (* 1.2% typical 3He concentration in still liquid *)
    rTempStillKelvin                : REAL := 0.700;
    rRollinFilmCreepRate_umol_s     : REAL := 0.0;
    rStillFilmBurnerTarget_uW       : REAL := 0.0;

    (* -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
       DIGITAL FILTER ACCUMULATORS & SLEW RATE LIMITERS
       ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
    rFilteredMixChamberTemp_mK      : REAL := 20.0;
    rFilteredCirculationFlow_umol_s : REAL := 0.0;
    rFilteredCondensingPress_mbar   : REAL := 0.0;
    rSlewLimitedStillPower_uW       : REAL := 0.0;
    rSlewLimitedJTValve_pct         : REAL := 0.0;

    (* -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
       TIMERS & WATCHDOG REGISTERS
       ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
    tStepWatchdog                   : TON;
    tPrecoolStabilityTimer          : TON;
    tCondensationStabilizeTimer     : TON;
    tPhaseSeparationSearchTimer     : TON;
    tAlarmDelayTimer                : TON;

    (* -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
       INTERNAL FINITE STATE MACHINE (ISA-88 PHASES)
       ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
    iState                          : INT  := 0;
    iPrevState                      : INT  := 0;
    bStateFirstScan                 : BOOL := TRUE;
    rActiveTargetStillTemp_mK       : REAL := 700.0;
    rActiveTarget1KPotTemp_K        : REAL := 1.300;
    rActiveTargetCircFlow_umol_s    : REAL := 300.0;
    rActiveTargetCondPress_mbar     : REAL := 600.0;

    (* -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
       ITERATION INDICES & LOCAL SCRATCHPAD
       ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
    i                               : INT;
    j                               : INT;
    k_iter                          : INT;
    rPredictedState                 : ARRAY[1..4] OF REAL;
    rStateError                     : ARRAY[1..4] OF REAL;
    rCandidateControl               : ARRAY[1..2] OF REAL;

    (* -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
       PHYSICAL & CRYOGENIC PROCESS CONSTANTS
       ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
    c_rStillTMR_MaxDeviation_mK      : REAL := 25.0;     (* Max RuO2 channel discrepancy before quarantine [mK] *)
    c_rPotTMR_MaxDeviation_K        : REAL := 0.080;    (* Max 1K Pot channel discrepancy before quarantine [K] *)
    c_rMaxAllowableCondPress_mbar   : REAL := 1600.0;   (* Compressor discharge relief threshold [mbar] *)
    c_rCritOverpressureTrip_mbar    : REAL := 1850.0;   (* SIL-3 Rupture Disc Protection Trip [mbar] *)
    c_rMaxAllowableOVCVacuum_mbar   : REAL := 5.0E-3;   (* Cryostat thermal isolation vacuum limit [mbar] *)
    c_rMinCirculationFlow_umol_s    : REAL := 25.0;     (* Minimum flow to prevent capillary freezeout [umol/s] *)
    c_rMaxStillHeaterPower_uW       : REAL := 45000.0;  (* Max allowable Still resistive heat load [uW] *)
    c_rMaxFilmBurnerPower_uW        : REAL := 8000.0;   (* Max allowable Rollin film collar heat load [uW] *)
    c_rMaxStillTempRunaway_mK       : REAL := 1150.0;   (* Thermal runaway 4He boiling threshold [mK] *)
    c_rCycleDeltaT_s                : REAL := 0.100;    (* Periodic execution cycle period (100 ms) [s] *)
END_VAR

(*
========================================================================================================================
  CYCLIC CONTROL LOGIC EXECUTION (SAMPLE PERIOD Ts = 100 ms)
========================================================================================================================
*)

(* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
   LAYER 1: SIL-3 HARDWIRED SAFETY CHAIN & IMMEDIATE TRIP HIERARCHY
   Cryogenic containment integrity, isotope conservation, and vacuum thermal boundary protection
   --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
IF NOT bEStopOk OR bEmergencyDumpCmd THEN
    (* Immediate De-Energization of all cryogenic heaters to prevent violent liquid boiloff *)
    rCmdStillHeaterPower_uW         := 0.0;
    rCmdStillFilmBurner_uW          := 0.0;
    rCmdJTValvePosition_pct         := 0.0; (* Lock J-T needle valve *)
    rCmdCondensingBypassValve_pct   := 100.0; (* Relieve high-pressure head *)

    (* Shut down high-vacuum pumps and compressor *)
    bHe3CompressorRunCmd            := FALSE;
    bTurbomolecularStillPumpRunCmd  := FALSE;
    bCryoTrapRegenHeaterCmd         := FALSE;

    (* Isolate storage dump tanks and open emergency expansion recovery valves *)
    bDumpTankIsolationValveOpen     := TRUE;
    bEmergencyDumpValveOpen         := TRUE;

    wFaultWord1.0                   := NOT bEStopOk;
    wFaultWord1.1                   := bEmergencyDumpCmd;
    bSystemAlarm                    := TRUE;
    wSystemStatusWord               := 16#F000;
    iState                          := 999; (* Transition directly to emergency dump state *)
    iSequenceStep                   := 999;
    RETURN;
END_IF;

(* Critical Outer Vacuum Chamber (OVC) Insulation Vacuum Breach Protection *)
IF (rOVCVacuumPressure_mbar > c_rMaxAllowableOVCVacuum_mbar) THEN
    rCmdStillHeaterPower_uW         := 0.0;
    rCmdStillFilmBurner_uW          := 0.0;
    bHe3CompressorRunCmd            := FALSE;
    bTurbomolecularStillPumpRunCmd  := FALSE;
    bEmergencyDumpValveOpen         := TRUE; (* Recover precious 3He gas before thermal conduction warms cold stages *)
    wFaultWord1.2                   := TRUE; (* OVC Vacuum Loss *)
    bSystemAlarm                    := TRUE;
    iState                          := 999;
END_IF;

(* High-Pressure Condensing Return Line Overpressure Trip (Isotope Containment Protection) *)
IF (rCondensingPressure_mbar > c_rCritOverpressureTrip_mbar) THEN
    rCmdStillHeaterPower_uW         := 0.0;
    rCmdStillFilmBurner_uW          := 0.0;
    rCmdCondensingBypassValve_pct   := 100.0; (* Full open bypass to dump tanks *)
    bEmergencyDumpValveOpen         := TRUE;
    wFaultWord1.3                   := TRUE; (* Overpressure trip *)
    bSystemAlarm                    := TRUE;
    iState                          := 999;
END_IF;

(* 1-Kelvin Pot Liquid Dryout Protection under Active Compressor Operation *)
IF (iState >= 40) AND (iState <= 70) AND (r1KPotLiquidLevel_pct < 4.0) AND (r1KPotTempTMR_A_K > 2.20) THEN
    rCmdStillHeaterPower_uW         := 0.0;
    rCmdStillFilmBurner_uW          := 0.0;
    wFaultWord1.4                   := TRUE; (* 1K Pot Dryout Trip *)
    bSystemAlarm                    := TRUE;
    iState                          := 999;
END_IF;

(* Still Thermal Runaway Protection (Excessive 4He Distillation Collapse) *)
IF (rStillTempTMR_A_mK > c_rMaxStillTempRunaway_mK) OR (rStillPressure_mbar > 0.35) THEN
    rCmdStillHeaterPower_uW         := 0.0;
    rCmdStillFilmBurner_uW          := 0.0;
    wFaultWord1.5                   := TRUE; (* Still Runaway Trip *)
    bSystemAlarm                    := TRUE;
    iState                          := 999;
END_IF;

(* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
   LAYER 2: DUAL TRIPLE MODULAR REDUNDANCY (2oo3 TMR) SENSOR VOTING ENGINES
   Provides fault tolerance for Ruthenium Oxide Still bridges and 1K Pot Ge/Cernox thermometers
   --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* --- 2.1: Still RuO2 4-Wire Resistance Bridge 2oo3 Voting --- *)
bStillChanA_Valid := (rStillTempTMR_A_mK >= 100.0) AND (rStillTempTMR_A_mK <= 2500.0);
bStillChanB_Valid := (rStillTempTMR_B_mK >= 100.0) AND (rStillTempTMR_B_mK <= 2500.0);
bStillChanC_Valid := (rStillTempTMR_C_mK >= 100.0) AND (rStillTempTMR_C_mK <= 2500.0);

rStillDiff_AB := ABS(rStillTempTMR_A_mK - rStillTempTMR_B_mK);
rStillDiff_BC := ABS(rStillTempTMR_B_mK - rStillTempTMR_C_mK);
rStillDiff_CA := ABS(rStillTempTMR_C_mK - rStillTempTMR_A_mK);

IF bStillChanA_Valid AND bStillChanB_Valid AND bStillChanC_Valid THEN
    IF (rStillDiff_AB <= c_rStillTMR_MaxDeviation_mK) AND 
       (rStillDiff_BC <= c_rStillTMR_MaxDeviation_mK) AND 
       (rStillDiff_CA <= c_rStillTMR_MaxDeviation_mK) THEN
        (* Case A: Perfect 3-Channel Consensus -> Middle Value Selection (Median Voting) *)
        rVotedStillTemp_mK := rStillTempTMR_A_mK + rStillTempTMR_B_mK + rStillTempTMR_C_mK
                              - MIN(rStillTempTMR_A_mK, MIN(rStillTempTMR_B_mK, rStillTempTMR_C_mK))
                              - MAX(rStillTempTMR_A_mK, MAX(rStillTempTMR_B_mK, rStillTempTMR_C_mK));
        iStillHealthyCount := 3;
        bDegradedTMRActive := FALSE;
        wFaultWord2.0      := FALSE;

    ELSIF (rStillDiff_BC <= c_rStillTMR_MaxDeviation_mK) AND (rStillDiff_AB > c_rStillTMR_MaxDeviation_mK) THEN
        (* Case B: Channel A drifted / noisy -> Quarantine Channel A, Degrade to 1oo2 of (B, C) *)
        rVotedStillTemp_mK := (rStillTempTMR_B_mK + rStillTempTMR_C_mK) * 0.5;
        iStillHealthyCount := 2;
        bDegradedTMRActive := TRUE;
        wFaultWord2.0      := TRUE;

    ELSIF (rStillDiff_CA <= c_rStillTMR_MaxDeviation_mK) AND (rStillDiff_AB > c_rStillTMR_MaxDeviation_mK) THEN
        (* Case C: Channel B drifted / noisy -> Quarantine Channel B, Degrade to 1oo2 of (A, C) *)
        rVotedStillTemp_mK := (rStillTempTMR_A_mK + rStillTempTMR_C_mK) * 0.5;
        iStillHealthyCount := 2;
        bDegradedTMRActive := TRUE;
        wFaultWord2.0      := TRUE;

    ELSIF (rStillDiff_AB <= c_rStillTMR_MaxDeviation_mK) AND (rStillDiff_BC > c_rStillTMR_MaxDeviation_mK) THEN
        (* Case D: Channel C drifted / noisy -> Quarantine Channel C, Degrade to 1oo2 of (A, B) *)
        rVotedStillTemp_mK := (rStillTempTMR_A_mK + rStillTempTMR_B_mK) * 0.5;
        iStillHealthyCount := 2;
        bDegradedTMRActive := TRUE;
        wFaultWord2.0      := TRUE;

    ELSE
        (* Case E: Multi-sensor divergence across Still sensors -> Fallback to conservative average & raise alarm *)
        rVotedStillTemp_mK := (rStillTempTMR_A_mK + rStillTempTMR_B_mK + rStillTempTMR_C_mK) / 3.0;
        iStillHealthyCount := 0;
        bDegradedTMRActive := TRUE;
        wFaultWord2.0      := TRUE;
        bSystemAlarm       := TRUE;
    END_IF;

ELSIF bStillChanB_Valid AND bStillChanC_Valid THEN
    rVotedStillTemp_mK := (rStillTempTMR_B_mK + rStillTempTMR_C_mK) * 0.5;
    iStillHealthyCount := 2;
    bDegradedTMRActive := TRUE;
    wFaultWord2.0      := TRUE;

ELSIF bStillChanA_Valid AND bStillChanC_Valid THEN
    rVotedStillTemp_mK := (rStillTempTMR_A_mK + rStillTempTMR_C_mK) * 0.5;
    iStillHealthyCount := 2;
    bDegradedTMRActive := TRUE;
    wFaultWord2.0      := TRUE;

ELSIF bStillChanA_Valid AND bStillChanB_Valid THEN
    rVotedStillTemp_mK := (rStillTempTMR_A_mK + rStillTempTMR_B_mK) * 0.5;
    iStillHealthyCount := 2;
    bDegradedTMRActive := TRUE;
    wFaultWord2.0      := TRUE;

ELSE
    (* Total Sensor Bank Failure on Still Stage *)
    rVotedStillTemp_mK := 800.0; (* Fallback nominal estimate *)
    iStillHealthyCount := 0;
    bDegradedTMRActive := TRUE;
    wFaultWord2.0      := TRUE;
    bSystemAlarm       := TRUE;
    iState             := 999;
END_IF;

(* --- 2.2: 1-Kelvin Pot Temperature 2oo3 Voting --- *)
bPotChanA_Valid := (r1KPotTempTMR_A_K >= 0.800) AND (r1KPotTempTMR_A_K <= 30.00);
bPotChanB_Valid := (r1KPotTempTMR_B_K >= 0.800) AND (r1KPotTempTMR_B_K <= 30.00);
bPotChanC_Valid := (r1KPotTempTMR_C_K >= 0.800) AND (r1KPotTempTMR_C_K <= 30.00);

rPotDiff_AB := ABS(r1KPotTempTMR_A_K - r1KPotTempTMR_B_K);
rPotDiff_BC := ABS(r1KPotTempTMR_B_K - r1KPotTempTMR_C_K);
rPotDiff_CA := ABS(r1KPotTempTMR_C_K - r1KPotTempTMR_A_K);

IF bPotChanA_Valid AND bPotChanB_Valid AND bPotChanC_Valid THEN
    IF (rPotDiff_AB <= c_rPotTMR_MaxDeviation_K) AND 
       (rPotDiff_BC <= c_rPotTMR_MaxDeviation_K) AND 
       (rPotDiff_CA <= c_rPotTMR_MaxDeviation_K) THEN
        rVoted1KPotTemp_K := r1KPotTempTMR_A_K + r1KPotTempTMR_B_K + r1KPotTempTMR_C_K
                             - MIN(r1KPotTempTMR_A_K, MIN(r1KPotTempTMR_B_K, r1KPotTempTMR_C_K))
                             - MAX(r1KPotTempTMR_A_K, MAX(r1KPotTempTMR_B_K, r1KPotTempTMR_C_K));
        iPotHealthyCount  := 3;
        wFaultWord2.1     := FALSE;

    ELSIF (rPotDiff_BC <= c_rPotTMR_MaxDeviation_K) AND (rPotDiff_AB > c_rPotTMR_MaxDeviation_K) THEN
        rVoted1KPotTemp_K := (r1KPotTempTMR_B_K + r1KPotTempTMR_C_K) * 0.5;
        iPotHealthyCount  := 2;
        wFaultWord2.1     := TRUE;

    ELSIF (rPotDiff_CA <= c_rPotTMR_MaxDeviation_K) AND (rPotDiff_AB > c_rPotTMR_MaxDeviation_K) THEN
        rVoted1KPotTemp_K := (r1KPotTempTMR_A_K + r1KPotTempTMR_C_K) * 0.5;
        iPotHealthyCount  := 2;
        wFaultWord2.1     := TRUE;

    ELSIF (rPotDiff_AB <= c_rPotTMR_MaxDeviation_K) AND (rPotDiff_BC > c_rPotTMR_MaxDeviation_K) THEN
        rVoted1KPotTemp_K := (r1KPotTempTMR_A_K + r1KPotTempTMR_B_K) * 0.5;
        iPotHealthyCount  := 2;
        wFaultWord2.1     := TRUE;

    ELSE
        rVoted1KPotTemp_K := (r1KPotTempTMR_A_K + r1KPotTempTMR_B_K + r1KPotTempTMR_C_K) / 3.0;
        iPotHealthyCount  := 0;
        wFaultWord2.1     := TRUE;
        bSystemAlarm      := TRUE;
    END_IF;

ELSIF bPotChanB_Valid AND bPotChanC_Valid THEN
    rVoted1KPotTemp_K := (r1KPotTempTMR_B_K + r1KPotTempTMR_C_K) * 0.5;
    iPotHealthyCount  := 2;
    wFaultWord2.1     := TRUE;

ELSIF bPotChanA_Valid AND bPotChanC_Valid THEN
    rVoted1KPotTemp_K := (r1KPotTempTMR_A_K + r1KPotTempTMR_C_K) * 0.5;
    iPotHealthyCount  := 2;
    wFaultWord2.1     := TRUE;

ELSIF bPotChanA_Valid AND bPotChanB_Valid THEN
    rVoted1KPotTemp_K := (r1KPotTempTMR_A_K + r1KPotTempTMR_B_K) * 0.5;
    iPotHealthyCount  := 2;
    wFaultWord2.1     := TRUE;

ELSE
    rVoted1KPotTemp_K := 1.40;
    iPotHealthyCount  := 0;
    wFaultWord2.1     := TRUE;
    bSystemAlarm      := TRUE;
END_IF;

(* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
   LAYER 3: THERMODYNAMIC PHYSICAL PROPERTY ESTIMATORS & CRYOGENIC PROCESS KINETICS
   --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* Digital First-Order Low-Pass Filter on Process Telemetry to eliminate AC bridge excitation noise *)
rFilteredMixChamberTemp_mK      := (0.15 * rMixChamberTemp_mK) + (0.85 * rFilteredMixChamberTemp_mK);
rFilteredCirculationFlow_umol_s := (0.20 * rHe3CirculationFlow_umol_s) + (0.80 * rFilteredCirculationFlow_umol_s);
rFilteredCondensingPress_mbar   := (0.25 * rCondensingPressure_mbar) + (0.75 * rFilteredCondensingPress_mbar);

(* Real-Time Isotopic Vapor Pressure Equations (Antoine / Roberts-Sydoriak Parametrization) *)
rTempStillKelvin := rVotedStillTemp_mK * 1.0E-3;
IF rTempStillKelvin > 0.400 THEN
    (* 3He Saturated Vapor Pressure Estimation [mbar] *)
    rP_sat3_mbar := EXP(2.450 - (2.165 / rTempStillKelvin));

    (* 4He Saturated Vapor Pressure Estimation [mbar] *)
    rP_sat4_mbar := EXP(3.120 - (5.320 / rTempStillKelvin));

    (* Dalton-Raoult Vapor Phase Concentration Estimation [%] *)
    IF (rP_sat3_mbar > 0.0) AND ((rP_sat3_mbar + rP_sat4_mbar) > 0.0) THEN
        rStillVaporPurityHe3_pct := ((rP_sat3_mbar * rLiquidConcentrationHe3) / 
                                    ((rP_sat3_mbar * rLiquidConcentrationHe3) + (rP_sat4_mbar * (1.0 - rLiquidConcentrationHe3)))) * 100.0;
        IF rStillVaporPurityHe3_pct > 99.5 THEN
            rStillVaporPurityHe3_pct := 99.5;
        ELSIF rStillVaporPurityHe3_pct < 10.0 THEN
            rStillVaporPurityHe3_pct := 10.0;
        END_IF;
    ELSE
        rStillVaporPurityHe3_pct := 95.0;
    END_IF;
ELSE
    rP_sat3_mbar := 0.001;
    rP_sat4_mbar := 0.00001;
    rStillVaporPurityHe3_pct := 98.0;
END_IF;

(* Theoretical Instantaneous Dilution Cooling Power at Mixing Chamber *)
(* Q_dot_MC = 84.0 * n_dot_3 * T_MC^2 [J/s = W] -> Scaled to micro-Watts [uW] *)
IF rFilteredMixChamberTemp_mK < 800.0 THEN
    rEstimatedCoolingPowerMC_uW := 8.4E-5 * rFilteredCirculationFlow_umol_s * (rFilteredMixChamberTemp_mK * rFilteredMixChamberTemp_mK);
ELSE
    rEstimatedCoolingPowerMC_uW := 0.0;
END_IF;

(* Rollin Superfluid 4He Creeping Film Flow Rate and Required Film Burner Collar Power *)
(* Creeping film is driven up still pumping throat; heater evaporates film back into still base *)
IF (rVotedStillTemp_mK >= 550.0) AND (rVotedStillTemp_mK <= 950.0) THEN
    rRollinFilmCreepRate_umol_s := 45.0 * (1.0 - (rVotedStillTemp_mK / 2170.0)); (* Lambda point 2.17 K *)
    rStillFilmBurnerTarget_uW   := rRollinFilmCreepRate_umol_s * 21.0 * 1.5;     (* 21 J/mol latent heat * safety margin *)
    IF rStillFilmBurnerTarget_uW > c_rMaxFilmBurnerPower_uW THEN
        rStillFilmBurnerTarget_uW := c_rMaxFilmBurnerPower_uW;
    END_IF;
ELSE
    rStillFilmBurnerTarget_uW := 0.0;
END_IF;

(* Cryotrap Normalized Flow Resistance Index: Delta P / flow *)
IF rFilteredCirculationFlow_umol_s > 10.0 THEN
    rCryoTrapImpedanceIndex := rFilteredCondensingPress_mbar / rFilteredCirculationFlow_umol_s;

(* =================================================================================================== *)
(* EXECUTION ENTRY POINT - HIGH-INTEGRITY DETERMINISTIC EXECUTION CYCLE                                 *)
(* =================================================================================================== *)

(* --- SANITY CHECK ON SCAN EXECUTION INTERVAL --- *)
IF rDeltaTime_Scan <= 0.0001 OR rDeltaTime_Scan > 1.0 THEN
    rDeltaTime_Scan := 0.010; (* Default to 10 milliseconds deterministic PLC cycle *)
END_IF;

(* --- ALARM AND STATUS REGISTER CLEARANCE AT START OF CYCLE --- *)
wAlarm_Word_1 := 16#0000;
wAlarm_Word_2 := 16#0000;
wAlarm_Word_3 := 16#0000;

(* =================================================================================================== *)
(* 1. TRIPLE MODULAR REDUNDANT (2oo3) FAST MICRO-THERMOCOUPLE VOTING & FAULT IDENTIFICATION            *)
(* =================================================================================================== *)
(* Calculate cross-channel absolute differentials between the 3 embedded core thermocouples *)
rTMR_Delta12 := ABS(rTemp_Core_TMR1 - rTemp_Core_TMR2);
rTMR_Delta23 := ABS(rTemp_Core_TMR2 - rTemp_Core_TMR3);
rTMR_Delta31 := ABS(rTemp_Core_TMR3 - rTemp_Core_TMR1);

(* Temporal drift rate tracking: rate of change of differential relative to voted value *)
rTMR_DriftRate_Sensor1 := (rTemp_Core_TMR1 - rVoted_CoreTemp_DegC) / 5.0;
rTMR_DriftRate_Sensor2 := (rTemp_Core_TMR2 - rVoted_CoreTemp_DegC) / 5.0;
rTMR_DriftRate_Sensor3 := (rTemp_Core_TMR3 - rVoted_CoreTemp_DegC) / 5.0;

(* Sensor noise variance estimation via recursive exponential smoothing *)
rTMR_Variance_Sensor1 := 0.98 * rTMR_Variance_Sensor1 + 0.02 * (rTemp_Core_TMR1 - rVoted_CoreTemp_DegC) * (rTemp_Core_TMR1 - rVoted_CoreTemp_DegC);
rTMR_Variance_Sensor2 := 0.98 * rTMR_Variance_Sensor2 + 0.02 * (rTemp_Core_TMR2 - rVoted_CoreTemp_DegC) * (rTemp_Core_TMR2 - rVoted_CoreTemp_DegC);
rTMR_Variance_Sensor3 := 0.98 * rTMR_Variance_Sensor3 + 0.02 * (rTemp_Core_TMR3 - rVoted_CoreTemp_DegC) * (rTemp_Core_TMR3 - rVoted_CoreTemp_DegC);

(* Excessive noise variance threshold check (> 0.08 deg C^2 indicates lead degradation or loose terminal) *)
IF rTMR_Variance_Sensor1 > 0.08 THEN
    wAlarm_Word_3 := wAlarm_Word_3 OR 16#0020; (* Sensor 1 high noise variance *)
END_IF;
IF rTMR_Variance_Sensor2 > 0.08 THEN
    wAlarm_Word_3 := wAlarm_Word_3 OR 16#0040; (* Sensor 2 high noise variance *)
END_IF;
IF rTMR_Variance_Sensor3 > 0.08 THEN
    wAlarm_Word_3 := wAlarm_Word_3 OR 16#0080; (* Sensor 3 high noise variance *)
END_IF;

(* Sensor physical bounds sanity checking (-20.0 deg C to +35.0 deg C) *)
IF rTemp_Core_TMR1 < -20.0 OR rTemp_Core_TMR1 > 35.0 THEN
    bTMR_Sensor1_Fault := TRUE;
    wAlarm_Word_3 := wAlarm_Word_3 OR 16#0001; (* Sensor 1 out of physical bounds *)
END_IF;

IF rTemp_Core_TMR2 < -20.0 OR rTemp_Core_TMR2 > 35.0 THEN
    bTMR_Sensor2_Fault := TRUE;
    wAlarm_Word_3 := wAlarm_Word_3 OR 16#0002; (* Sensor 2 out of physical bounds *)
END_IF;

IF rTemp_Core_TMR3 < -20.0 OR rTemp_Core_TMR3 > 35.0 THEN
    bTMR_Sensor3_Fault := TRUE;
    wAlarm_Word_3 := wAlarm_Word_3 OR 16#0004; (* Sensor 3 out of physical bounds *)
END_IF;

(* 2oo3 Discrepancy Debounce Timers (Threshold = 0.85 deg C for > 150 ms) *)
IF rTMR_Delta12 > 0.85 AND rTMR_Delta31 > 0.85 THEN
    rTMR_Discrepancy_Timer1 := rTMR_Discrepancy_Timer1 + rDeltaTime_Scan;
    IF rTMR_Discrepancy_Timer1 > 0.150 THEN
        bTMR_Sensor1_Fault := TRUE;
    END_IF;
ELSE
    rTMR_Discrepancy_Timer1 := 0.0;
END_IF;

IF rTMR_Delta12 > 0.85 AND rTMR_Delta23 > 0.85 THEN
    rTMR_Discrepancy_Timer2 := rTMR_Discrepancy_Timer2 + rDeltaTime_Scan;
    IF rTMR_Discrepancy_Timer2 > 0.150 THEN
        bTMR_Sensor2_Fault := TRUE;
    END_IF;
ELSE
    rTMR_Discrepancy_Timer2 := 0.0;
END_IF;

IF rTMR_Delta23 > 0.85 AND rTMR_Delta31 > 0.85 THEN
    rTMR_Discrepancy_Timer3 := rTMR_Discrepancy_Timer3 + rDeltaTime_Scan;
    IF rTMR_Discrepancy_Timer3 > 0.150 THEN
        bTMR_Sensor3_Fault := TRUE;
    END_IF;
ELSE
    rTMR_Discrepancy_Timer3 := 0.0;
END_IF;

(* Fault Reset Logic *)
IF bAcknowledgeFaults THEN
    IF rTMR_Delta12 <= 0.85 OR rTMR_Delta31 <= 0.85 THEN
        bTMR_Sensor1_Fault := FALSE;
    END_IF;
    IF rTMR_Delta12 <= 0.85 OR rTMR_Delta23 <= 0.85 THEN
        bTMR_Sensor2_Fault := FALSE;
    END_IF;
    IF rTMR_Delta23 <= 0.85 OR rTMR_Delta31 <= 0.85 THEN
        bTMR_Sensor3_Fault := FALSE;
    END_IF;
END_IF;

(* Count surviving healthy channels *)
iTMR_HealthyCount := 3;
IF bTMR_Sensor1_Fault THEN
    iTMR_HealthyCount := iTMR_HealthyCount - 1;
    wAlarm_Word_1 := wAlarm_Word_1 OR 16#0001; (* Bit 0: Core TMR Sensor 1 Fault *)
END_IF;
IF bTMR_Sensor2_Fault THEN
    iTMR_HealthyCount := iTMR_HealthyCount - 1;
    wAlarm_Word_1 := wAlarm_Word_1 OR 16#0002; (* Bit 1: Core TMR Sensor 2 Fault *)
END_IF;
IF bTMR_Sensor3_Fault THEN
    iTMR_HealthyCount := iTMR_HealthyCount - 1;
    wAlarm_Word_1 := wAlarm_Word_1 OR 16#0004; (* Bit 2: Core TMR Sensor 3 Fault *)
END_IF;

(* Synthesize Voted Process Core Temperature with Multi-Tier Degradation *)
IF iTMR_HealthyCount = 3 THEN
    (* Fully nominal 2oo3 Median Selection *)
    IF (rTemp_Core_TMR1 <= rTemp_Core_TMR2 AND rTemp_Core_TMR2 <= rTemp_Core_TMR3) OR
       (rTemp_Core_TMR3 <= rTemp_Core_TMR2 AND rTemp_Core_TMR2 <= rTemp_Core_TMR1) THEN
        rVoted_CoreTemp_DegC := rTemp_Core_TMR2;
    ELSIF (rTemp_Core_TMR2 <= rTemp_Core_TMR1 AND rTemp_Core_TMR1 <= rTemp_Core_TMR3) OR
          (rTemp_Core_TMR3 <= rTemp_Core_TMR1 AND rTemp_Core_TMR1 <= rTemp_Core_TMR2) THEN
        rVoted_CoreTemp_DegC := rTemp_Core_TMR1;
    ELSE
        rVoted_CoreTemp_DegC := rTemp_Core_TMR3;
    END_IF;
    bDegradedMode_Active := FALSE;
ELSIF iTMR_HealthyCount = 2 THEN
    (* Degraded 1oo2 Mean Averaging of Remaining Healthy Pair *)
    bDegradedMode_Active := TRUE;
    IF bTMR_Sensor1_Fault THEN
        rVoted_CoreTemp_DegC := 0.5 * (rTemp_Core_TMR2 + rTemp_Core_TMR3);
    ELSIF bTMR_Sensor2_Fault THEN
        rVoted_CoreTemp_DegC := 0.5 * (rTemp_Core_TMR1 + rTemp_Core_TMR3);
    ELSE
        rVoted_CoreTemp_DegC := 0.5 * (rTemp_Core_TMR1 + rTemp_Core_TMR2);
    END_IF;
ELSIF iTMR_HealthyCount = 1 THEN
    (* Critical 1oo1 Operation: Fallback to Single Surviving Sensor *)
    bDegradedMode_Active := TRUE;
    wAlarm_Word_1 := wAlarm_Word_1 OR 16#0008; (* Bit 3: Critical loss of TMR redundancy *)
    IF NOT bTMR_Sensor1_Fault THEN
        rVoted_CoreTemp_DegC := rTemp_Core_TMR1;
    ELSIF NOT bTMR_Sensor2_Fault THEN
        rVoted_CoreTemp_DegC := rTemp_Core_TMR2;
    ELSE
        rVoted_CoreTemp_DegC := rTemp_Core_TMR3;
    END_IF;
ELSE
    (* Total Sensor Blindness: Immediate Failsafe SIL-3 Trip *)
    wAlarm_Word_1 := wAlarm_Word_1 OR 16#0008;
    bQuenchTriggerLatched := TRUE;
    iFaultHistoryRegister := 101; (* Tripped: All 3 core thermocouples lost *)
    rVoted_CoreTemp_DegC := 25.0; (* Failsafe high forced value *)
END_IF;

(* =================================================================================================== *)
(* 2. IN-LINE ATR-FTIR RESIDUAL DIAZONIUM & SPECTROSCOPIC CONVERSION TRACKING                          *)
(* =================================================================================================== *)
(* Check spectrometer signal-to-noise ratio *)
IF rFTIR_SignalNoiseRatio < 20.0 THEN
    wAlarm_Word_3 := wAlarm_Word_3 OR 16#0010; (* Optical SNR degraded *)
END_IF;

(* Multi-point baseline corrected peak absorbances *)
rFTIR_Peak_Diazonium_Corr := rFTIR_Absorbance_Diazonium - rFTIR_Absorbance_Baseline;
IF rFTIR_Peak_Diazonium_Corr < 0.0 THEN
    rFTIR_Peak_Diazonium_Corr := 0.0;
END_IF;

rFTIR_Peak_Amine_Corr := rFTIR_Absorbance_Amine - rFTIR_Absorbance_Baseline;
IF rFTIR_Peak_Amine_Corr < 0.0 THEN
    rFTIR_Peak_Amine_Corr := 0.0;
END_IF;

rFTIR_Peak_Azo_Corr := rFTIR_Absorbance_AzoCoupling - rFTIR_Absorbance_Baseline;
IF rFTIR_Peak_Azo_Corr < 0.0 THEN
    rFTIR_Peak_Azo_Corr := 0.0;
END_IF;

rFTIR_Peak_Nitrous_Corr := rFTIR_Absorbance_NitrousAcid - rFTIR_Absorbance_Baseline;
IF rFTIR_Peak_Nitrous_Corr < 0.0 THEN
    rFTIR_Peak_Nitrous_Corr := 0.0;
END_IF;

(* Check side-product diazoamino formation (indicates insufficient acid or temperature hot spots) *)
IF rFTIR_Peak_Azo_Corr > 45.0 THEN
    wAlarm_Word_2 := wAlarm_Word_2 OR 16#0020; (* Diazoamino side product accumulation *)
END_IF;

(* Excess nitrous acid accumulation check *)
IF rFTIR_Peak_Nitrous_Corr > 85.0 THEN
    wAlarm_Word_2 := wAlarm_Word_2 OR 16#0100; (* Excess unreacted nitrous acid *)
END_IF;

(* Dynamic fractional chemical conversion of aromatic amine precursor *)
IF rInitial_Amine_Absorbance > 1.0 THEN
    rConversion_Amine_Pct := (1.0 - (rFTIR_Peak_Amine_Corr / rInitial_Amine_Absorbance)) * 100.0;
    IF rConversion_Amine_Pct > 100.0 THEN
        rConversion_Amine_Pct := 100.0;
    ELSIF rConversion_Amine_Pct < 0.0 THEN
        rConversion_Amine_Pct := 0.0;
    END_IF;
ELSE
    rConversion_Amine_Pct := 0.0;
END_IF;

(* Diazonium risk accumulation index: 0.0 (safe nominal) to 1.0 (dangerous accumulation) *)
(* Calibration: 650 mAU corresponds to critical concentration of 1.80 mol/L in flow cell *)
rResidual_Diazonium_Index := rFTIR_Peak_Diazonium_Corr / 650.0;
IF rResidual_Diazonium_Index > 1.0 THEN
    rResidual_Diazonium_Index := 1.0;
    wAlarm_Word_2 := wAlarm_Word_2 OR 16#0004; (* Bit 2: Diazonium accumulation risk high *)
END_IF;

(* Incomplete conversion alarm in steady-state production *)
IF rConversion_Amine_Pct < 91.5 AND iState = 40 THEN
    wAlarm_Word_2 := wAlarm_Word_2 OR 16#0008; (* Bit 3: Conversion efficiency below spec *)
END_IF;

(* =================================================================================================== *)
(* 3. CALORIMETRIC DYNAMIC RUNAWAY HEAT FLUX TRACKING & SEMENOV CRITERION                             *)
(* =================================================================================================== *)
(* First and second numerical derivatives of voted core temperature with Butterworth low-pass filter *)
rdT_dt_Filtered := 0.82 * rdT_dt_Filtered + 0.18 * ((rVoted_CoreTemp_DegC - rPrev_VotedTemp) / rDeltaTime_Scan);
rd2T_dt2_Filtered := 0.82 * rd2T_dt2_Filtered + 0.18 * ((rdT_dt_Filtered - rPrev_dT_dt) / rDeltaTime_Scan);
rPrev_VotedTemp := rVoted_CoreTemp_DegC;
rPrev_dT_dt := rdT_dt_Filtered;

(* Coolant jacket dynamic heat extraction: Q_cool = rho * V_dot * Cp * (T_out - T_in) *)
(* Syltherm XLT density * Cp at -15 deg C = 888 kg/m3 * 1552 J/(kg*K) = 1.378 J/(mL*K) *)
rHeat_CoolantJacket_W := (rFlow_Coolant_Jacket / 60.0) * 1.378 * (rTemp_Coolant_JacketOut - rTemp_Coolant_JacketIn);

(* Reactor thermal capacitance accumulation: Q_accum = C_reactor * dT/dt *)
(* Microreactor Hastelloy C-276 / Silicon block thermal capacitance = 46.2 J/K *)
rHeat_ThermalMass_Accum_W := 46.2 * rdT_dt_Filtered;

(* Total instantaneous chemical reaction heat generation [W] *)
rTotal_Heat_Generated_W := rHeat_CoolantJacket_W + rHeat_ThermalMass_Accum_W - rCalorimetric_Baseline_W;
IF rTotal_Heat_Generated_W < 0.0 THEN
    rTotal_Heat_Generated_W := 0.0;
END_IF;

(* Rolling buffer averaging over 10 scans for heat flux smoothing *)
rHeatFlux_Buffer[iHeatFlux_BufIdx] := rTotal_Heat_Generated_W;
iHeatFlux_BufIdx := iHeatFlux_BufIdx + 1;
IF iHeatFlux_BufIdx > 10 THEN
    iHeatFlux_BufIdx := 1;
END_IF;

rHeatFlux_MovingAvg_W := 0.0;
FOR iIterRow := 1 TO 10 DO
    rHeatFlux_MovingAvg_W := rHeatFlux_MovingAvg_W + rHeatFlux_Buffer[iIterRow];
END_FOR;
rEstimated_HeatFlux_W := rHeatFlux_MovingAvg_W * 0.10;

(* Overall heat transfer conductance UA estimation *)
(* Log-Mean Temperature Difference calculation with series expansion protection *)
rTempSum := (rVoted_CoreTemp_DegC - rTemp_Coolant_JacketIn);
rTempGradVal := (rVoted_CoreTemp_DegC - rTemp_Coolant_JacketOut);
IF rTempSum > 0.1 AND rTempGradVal > 0.1 AND ABS(rTempSum - rTempGradVal) > 0.05 THEN
    rLocalLogArg := rTempSum / rTempGradVal;
    (* First-order logarithmic series approximation: ln(z) ~ 2*(z-1)/(z+1) *)
    rLMTD_DeltaT := (rTempSum - rTempGradVal) / (2.0 * (rLocalLogArg - 1.0) / (rLocalLogArg + 1.0));
ELSE
    rLMTD_DeltaT := 0.5 * (rTempSum + rTempGradVal);
END_IF;
IF rLMTD_DeltaT < 0.5 THEN
    rLMTD_DeltaT := 0.5;
END_IF;
rOverall_HeatTransfer_UA := rHeat_CoolantJacket_W / rLMTD_DeltaT;

(* Dimensionless Semenov Runaway Criterion: Psi = (Ea / (R * T^2)) * (Q_gen / (UA)) *)
rAbsoluteTemp_Kelvin := rVoted_CoreTemp_DegC + 273.15;
IF rOverall_HeatTransfer_UA > 0.1 AND rAbsoluteTemp_Kelvin > 200.0 THEN
    rSemenov_Runaway_Number := (rApparent_Activation_Energy / (rGasConstant_R * rAbsoluteTemp_Kelvin * rAbsoluteTemp_Kelvin)) * (rEstimated_HeatFlux_W / rOverall_HeatTransfer_UA);
ELSE
    rSemenov_Runaway_Number := 0.0;
END_IF;

(* Hydrodynamic Microchannel Transport Calculations *)
rTotalVolumetricFlow_mLmin := rFlow_AmineFeed_Coriolis + rFlow_NitriteAcid_Coriolis;
(* Cross-sectional area = 0.45 mm x 0.45 mm = 2.025E-7 m2 *)
IF rTotalVolumetricFlow_mLmin > 0.05 THEN
    rMicrochannel_Velocity_ms := (rTotalVolumetricFlow_mLmin * 1.0E-6 / 60.0) / 2.025E-7;
    rReynolds_Number_Fluid := (rFluid_Mean_Density * rMicrochannel_Velocity_ms * 0.00045) / rFluid_Dynamic_Viscosity;
    rPrandtl_Number := (rFluid_Dynamic_Viscosity * 3650.0) / rFluid_Thermal_Conductivity;
    rGraetz_Number := (0.00045 / 0.125) * rReynolds_Number_Fluid * rPrandtl_Number;
    (* Sieder-Tate laminar microchannel correlation for square ducts *)
    rNusselt_Number_HeatTransfer := 3.66 + (0.0668 * rGraetz_Number) / (1.0 + 0.04 * (rGraetz_Number * 0.6667));
ELSE
    rMicrochannel_Velocity_ms := 0.0;
    rReynolds_Number_Fluid := 0.0;
    rNusselt_Number_HeatTransfer := 3.66;
END_IF;

(* Microchannel Hydraulic Resistance Monitoring (Detection of Salt Precipitation / Clogging) *)
IF rTotalVolumetricFlow_mLmin > 0.5 THEN
    rMicrochannel_Hydraulic_Res := (0.5 * (rPress_Inlet_Amine + rPress_Inlet_Nitrite) - rPress_Reactor_Outlet) / rTotalVolumetricFlow_mLmin;
    IF rMicrochannel_Hydraulic_Res > (rMicrochannel_Hydraulic_Base * 1.45) AND iState = 40 THEN
        bMicrochannel_Clogging_Alert := TRUE;
        wAlarm_Word_2 := wAlarm_Word_2 OR 16#0200; (* Microchannel hydraulic fouling alert *)
    ELSE
        bMicrochannel_Clogging_Alert := FALSE;
    END_IF;
ELSE
    rMicrochannel_Hydraulic_Res := rMicrochannel_Hydraulic_Base;
    bMicrochannel_Clogging_Alert := FALSE;
END_IF;

(* Exothermic Runaway Detection Criteria *)
IF (rd2T_dt2_Filtered > 1.10 AND rdT_dt_Filtered > 0.40 AND rVoted_CoreTemp_DegC > 1.2) OR (rSemenov_Runaway_Number > 0.36) THEN
    wAlarm_Word_1 := wAlarm_Word_1 OR 16#0040; (* Bit 6: Heat flux runaway acceleration alert *)
    bRunawayMitigation_Engaged := TRUE;
    IF rVoted_CoreTemp_DegC > 3.6 OR rdT_dt_Filtered > 1.25 THEN
        wAlarm_Word_1 := wAlarm_Word_1 OR 16#0080; (* Bit 7: Critical thermal runaway trip *)
        bQuenchTriggerLatched := TRUE;
        iFaultHistoryRegister := 102; (* Critical runaway breach *)
    END_IF;
ELSE
    bRunawayMitigation_Engaged := FALSE;
END_IF;

(* Absolute Core Temperature Envelope Boundaries [-10.0 deg C to +5.0 deg C] *)
IF rVoted_CoreTemp_DegC > 2.5 THEN
    wAlarm_Word_1 := wAlarm_Word_1 OR 16#0010; (* Bit 4: Core temperature high warning *)
END_IF;
IF rVoted_CoreTemp_DegC > 5.0 THEN
    wAlarm_Word_1 := wAlarm_Word_1 OR 16#0020; (* Bit 5: Critical high temp ceiling trip (+5.0 deg C) *)
    bQuenchTriggerLatched := TRUE;
    iFaultHistoryRegister := 103; (* Max core temperature limit breached *)
END_IF;

(* =================================================================================================== *)
(* 4. DUAL CORIOLIS MICRO-PUMP STOICHIOMETRIC MODULATION & LEAD-LAG SYNCHRONIZATION                 *)
(* =================================================================================================== *)
(* Coriolis density degassing verification (detection of N2 micro-bubbles from early decomposition) *)
IF (rDensity_Amine_Coriolis < 0.930 AND rDensity_Amine_Coriolis > 0.100) OR
   (rDensity_Nitrite_Coriolis < 1.075 AND rDensity_Nitrite_Coriolis > 0.100) OR
   (rDriveGain_Amine_Coriolis > 72.0) OR (rDriveGain_Nitrite_Coriolis > 72.0) THEN
    wAlarm_Word_1 := wAlarm_Word_1 OR 16#4000; (* Bit 14: Coriolis degassing / micro-bubbles detected *)
END_IF;

(* Density-based dynamic viscosity compensation factors *)
IF rDensity_Amine_Coriolis > 0.50 THEN
    rAmine_Viscosity_Comp := rAmine_Density_Nominal / rDensity_Amine_Coriolis;
ELSE
    rAmine_Viscosity_Comp := 1.0;
END_IF;

IF rDensity_Nitrite_Coriolis > 0.50 THEN
    rNitrite_Viscosity_Comp := rNitrite_Density_Nominal / rDensity_Nitrite_Coriolis;
ELSE
    rNitrite_Viscosity_Comp := 1.0;
END_IF;

(* Convert Coriolis volumetric flow rates to molar feed rates *)
(* Amine Precursor stock: 1.85 mol/L active amine *)
(* Nitrite/Acid mixture stock: 2.10 mol/L active HNO2 *)
rMolarFlow_Amine := (rFlow_AmineFeed_Coriolis / 1000.0) * 1.85 * rAmine_Viscosity_Comp;     (* mol/min *)
rMolarFlow_Nitrite := (rFlow_NitriteAcid_Coriolis / 1000.0) * 2.10 * rNitrite_Viscosity_Comp; (* mol/min *)

IF rMolarFlow_Amine > 0.0001 THEN
    rCurrent_StoichRatio := rMolarFlow_Nitrite / rMolarFlow_Amine;
ELSE
    rCurrent_StoichRatio := 0.0;
END_IF;

(* Check Stoichiometric Balance (Nominal Range: 1.04 to 1.18 mol/mol) *)
IF (rCurrent_StoichRatio < 1.03 OR rCurrent_StoichRatio > 1.22) AND iState = 40 THEN
    wAlarm_Word_2 := wAlarm_Word_2 OR 16#0001; (* Bit 0: Stoichiometric ratio deviation alert *)
END_IF;

(* First-Order Lead-Lag Dynamic Compensator on Amine Pump Master Demand *)
(* Compensates for the transport delay in the split-and-recombine micro-mixer *)
rLeadLag_State := rLeadLag_State + (rDeltaTime_Scan / 2.20) * (aActuatorU[3] - rLeadLag_State);

(* Stoichiometric Fine-Trim Integrator with Anti-Reset Windup Clamping *)
IF iState = 40 THEN
    rRatio_Integrator := rRatio_Integrator + 0.075 * (rRatio_AcidAmine_Target - rCurrent_StoichRatio) * rDeltaTime_Scan;
    IF rRatio_Integrator > rRatio_Integral_Limit THEN
        rRatio_Integrator := rRatio_Integral_Limit;
    ELSIF rRatio_Integrator < -rRatio_Integral_Limit THEN
        rRatio_Integrator := -rRatio_Integral_Limit;
    END_IF;
ELSE
    rRatio_Integrator := 0.0;
END_IF;

(* =================================================================================================== *)
(* 5. DISCRETE STATE-SPACE LUENBERGER OBSERVER EXECUTION                                              *)
(* =================================================================================================== *)
(* Pack physical measurements into measurement vector y *)
aMeasY[1] := rVoted_CoreTemp_DegC;
aMeasY[2] := rFTIR_Peak_Diazonium_Corr;

(* Innovation Error Vector Calculation: e_y = y - C * x_pred *)
FOR iIterRow := 1 TO 2 DO
    rTempSum := 0.0;
    FOR iIterCol := 1 TO 4 DO
        rTempSum := rTempSum + aMatC[iIterRow, iIterCol] * aStateX_Pred[iIterCol];
    END_FOR;
    aInnovY[iIterRow] := aMeasY[iIterRow] - rTempSum;
END_FOR;

(* Check observer innovation divergence *)
IF ABS(aInnovY[1]) > 4.50 THEN
    wAlarm_Word_3 := wAlarm_Word_3 OR 16#0400; (* State-space observer thermal divergence *)
END_IF;

(* State Estimation Correction Step: x_hat = x_pred + L * e_y *)
FOR iIterRow := 1 TO 4 DO
    rTempSum := 0.0;
    FOR iIterCol := 1 TO 2 DO
        rTempSum := rTempSum + aMatL[iIterRow, iIterCol] * aInnovY[iIterCol];
    END_FOR;
    aStateX_Hat[iIterRow] := aStateX_Pred[iIterRow] + rTempSum;
END_FOR;

(* State Time Propagation / Prediction Step: x_pred(k+1) = A * x_hat + B * u *)
FOR iIterRow := 1 TO 4 DO
    rTempSum := 0.0;
    FOR iIterCol := 1 TO 4 DO
        rTempSum := rTempSum + aMatA[iIterRow, iIterCol] * aStateX_Hat[iIterCol];
    END_FOR;
    FOR iIterCol := 1 TO 3 DO
        rTempSum := rTempSum + aMatB[iIterRow, iIterCol] * (aActuatorU[iIterCol] / 100.0);
    END_FOR;
    aStateX_Pred[iIterRow] := rTempSum;
END_FOR;

(* =================================================================================================== *)
(* 6. MODEL PREDICTIVE CONTROL (MPC) CONDENSED QUADRATIC COST APPROXIMATION                           *)
(* =================================================================================================== *)
(* Linear Gradient Vector: g = G^T * Q * (F * x_hat - TargetRef) *)
aGrad_g[1] := rMPCTrackingWeight_Temp * (aStateX_Hat[1] - rCoreTemp_Setpoint_Target) + rMPCEffortWeight_Move * aDeltaU_Prev[1];
aGrad_g[2] := rMPCTrackingWeight_Conc * (aStateX_Hat[3] - rDiazConcSetpoint) + 1.25 * (aStateX_Hat[1] - rCoreTemp_Setpoint_Target);
aGrad_g[3] := -0.85 * (aStateX_Hat[4] - 0.05) - 0.40 * (aStateX_Hat[1] - rCoreTemp_Setpoint_Target);

(* Projected Gradient Iterations for Optimal Control Move DeltaU *)
FOR iQPIterCount := 1 TO 3 DO
    FOR iIterRow := 1 TO 3 DO
        rTempGradVal := aGrad_g[iIterRow];
        FOR iIterCol := 1 TO 3 DO
            rTempGradVal := rTempGradVal + aHessian_H[iIterRow, iIterCol] * aDeltaU[iIterCol];
        END_FOR;
        aDeltaU[iIterRow] := aDeltaU[iIterRow] - rQP_LearningRate * rTempGradVal;
        (* Enforce slew rate constraints (-2.5% to +2.5% per 10 ms cycle) *)
        IF aDeltaU[iIterRow] > 2.50 THEN
            aDeltaU[iIterRow] := 2.50;
        ELSIF aDeltaU[iIterRow] < -2.50 THEN
            aDeltaU[iIterRow] := -2.50;
        END_IF;
    END_FOR;
END_FOR;

(* Real-time quadratic performance cost metric: J = 0.5 * DeltaU^T * H * DeltaU + g^T * DeltaU *)
rMPC_Cost_Function_J := 0.0;
FOR iIterRow := 1 TO 3 DO
    rMPC_Cost_Function_J := rMPC_Cost_Function_J + aGrad_g[iIterRow] * aDeltaU[iIterRow];
    FOR iIterCol := 1 TO 3 DO
        rMPC_Cost_Function_J := rMPC_Cost_Function_J + 0.5 * aDeltaU[iIterRow] * aHessian_H[iIterRow, iIterCol] * aDeltaU[iIterCol];
    END_FOR;
END_FOR;
aDeltaU_Prev := aDeltaU;

(* =================================================================================================== *)
(* 7. HYDRAULIC PRESSURE INTEGRITY & HARDWIRED SAFETY INTERLOCK SUPERVISION                           *)
(* =================================================================================================== *)
IF NOT bSafetyInterlockOk THEN
    wAlarm_Word_1 := wAlarm_Word_1 OR 16#0800; (* Bit 11: Safety interlock loop broken *)
    bQuenchTriggerLatched := TRUE;
    iFaultHistoryRegister := 104; (* Safety interlock loop open *)
END_IF;

IF bManualQuenchTrigger THEN
    wAlarm_Word_1 := wAlarm_Word_1 OR 16#1000; (* Bit 12: Manual quench push button activated *)
    bQuenchTriggerLatched := TRUE;
    iFaultHistoryRegister := 105; (* Operator manual emergency push button *)
END_IF;

(* Microreactor hydraulic exit pressure monitoring *)
IF rPress_Reactor_Outlet > 14.5 THEN
    wAlarm_Word_1 := wAlarm_Word_1 OR 16#0100; (* Bit 8: Reactor overpressure warning *)
END_IF;
IF rPress_Reactor_Outlet > 18.0 THEN
    wAlarm_Word_1 := wAlarm_Word_1 OR 16#0200; (* Bit 9: Reactor overpressure blowout trip *)
    bQuenchTriggerLatched := TRUE;
    iFaultHistoryRegister := 106; (* Overpressure trip *)
END_IF;

(* Feed stream pressure differential check *)
IF ABS(rPress_Inlet_Amine - rPress_Inlet_Nitrite) > 3.5 THEN
    wAlarm_Word_1 := wAlarm_Word_1 OR 16#0400; (* Bit 10: Inlet port hydraulic pressure mismatch *)
END_IF;

(* Coolant jacket circulation pressure check *)
IF rPress_Coolant_Jacket < 1.20 THEN
    wAlarm_Word_2 := wAlarm_Word_2 OR 16#0040; (* Coolant circulation pressure low *)
END_IF;

(* FIFO Event Recorder Logging of Faults *)
IF iFaultHistoryRegister <> 0 AND iFaultEventLog[iFaultLogPointer] <> iFaultHistoryRegister THEN
    iFaultLogPointer := iFaultLogPointer + 1;
    IF iFaultLogPointer > 8 THEN
        iFaultLogPointer := 1;
    END_IF;
    iFaultEventLog[iFaultLogPointer] := iFaultHistoryRegister;
END_IF;

(* =================================================================================================== *)
(* 8. FINITE STATE MACHINE (FSM) MULTI-STAGE CONTROL SEQUENCE                                         *)
(* =================================================================================================== *)
rStateTimer_Sec := rStateTimer_Sec + rDeltaTime_Scan;

(* Global emergency override: If quench latched, divert immediately to State 90 *)
IF bQuenchTriggerLatched AND iState < 90 THEN
    iState := 90;
    rStateTimer_Sec := 0.0;
END_IF;

CASE iState OF
    0: (* STATE_INITIALIZE: Cold Hardware Readiness and Sensor Pre-Check *)
        bSystemReady := FALSE;
        bCryoN2_QuenchValve_Active := FALSE;
        rPump_Amine_Speed_Cmd := 0.0;
        rPump_Nitrite_Speed_Cmd := 0.0;
        rCoolant_Chiller_Bypass_Cmd := 0.0; (* Maximum cooling circulation *)
        wState_Status_Word := 16#0001;
        
        IF bSystemEnable AND bSafetyInterlockOk AND NOT bQuenchTriggerLatched THEN
            IF iTMR_HealthyCount >= 2 AND rFlow_Coolant_Jacket > 50.0 THEN
                iState := 10; (* Proceed to Pre-Cooling *)
                rStateTimer_Sec := 0.0;
            END_IF;
        END_IF;

    10: (* STATE_CHILLER_PRECOOL: Cool microchannel assembly below -10.0 deg C *)
        bSystemReady := FALSE;
        bCryoN2_QuenchValve_Active := FALSE;
        rPump_Amine_Speed_Cmd := 0.0;
        rPump_Nitrite_Speed_Cmd := 0.0;
        rCoolant_Chiller_Bypass_Cmd := 0.0; (* Full cooling to achieve target *)
        wState_Status_Word := 16#0002;
        
        IF rVoted_CoreTemp_DegC <= -8.5 AND rTemp_Coolant_JacketOut <= -12.0 THEN
            iState := 20; (* Proceed to Solvent Prime *)
            rStateTimer_Sec := 0.0;
        ELSIF rStateTimer_Sec > 300.0 THEN
            wAlarm_Word_2 := wAlarm_Word_2 OR 16#0400; (* State transition timeout *)
            iState := 99; (* Timeout fault lock *)
            rStateTimer_Sec := 0.0;
        END_IF;

    20: (* STATE_SOLVENT_PRIME: Establishing Hydrodynamic Microflow with Inert Solvent *)
        bSystemReady := FALSE;
        bCryoN2_QuenchValve_Active := FALSE;
        (* Prime with dilute acidic carrier solvent at 15% pump rates *)
        rPump_Amine_Speed_Cmd := 15.0;
        rPump_Nitrite_Speed_Cmd := 15.0;
        rCoolant_Chiller_Bypass_Cmd := 20.0;
        wState_Status_Word := 16#0004;
        
        IF rStateTimer_Sec >= 30.0 THEN
            IF rPress_Reactor_Outlet >= 2.0 AND rPress_Reactor_Outlet <= 12.0 THEN
                iState := 30; (* Proceed to Stoichiometric Ramp *)
                rStateTimer_Sec := 0.0;
            ELSE
                wAlarm_Word_2 := wAlarm_Word_2 OR 16#0800; (* Solvent pressure drop out of range *)
                iState := 99;
                rStateTimer_Sec := 0.0;
            END_IF;
        END_IF;

    30: (* STATE_STOICHIOMETRIC_RAMP: Coordinated Precursor Introduction *)
        bSystemReady := FALSE;
        bCryoN2_QuenchValve_Active := FALSE;
        wState_Status_Word := 16#0008;
        
        (* Smoothly ramp pumps towards steady-state operating baseline *)
        rPump_Amine_Speed_Cmd := 15.0 + (35.0 - 15.0) * (rStateTimer_Sec / 45.0);
        rPump_Nitrite_Speed_Cmd := (rPump_Amine_Speed_Cmd * 1.10) + rRatio_Integrator;
        rCoolant_Chiller_Bypass_Cmd := 30.0;
        
        IF rStateTimer_Sec >= 45.0 THEN
            IF rVoted_CoreTemp_DegC >= -5.0 AND rVoted_CoreTemp_DegC <= 1.0 THEN
                iState := 40; (* Enter Autonomous Production Regime *)
                rStateTimer_Sec := 0.0;
            ELSE
                iState := 50; (* Thermal divergence: branch to mitigation *)
                rStateTimer_Sec := 0.0;
            END_IF;
        END_IF;

    40: (* STATE_ACTIVE_MPC_STEADY_STATE: Closed-Loop Production Operating Envelope *)
        bSystemReady := TRUE;
        bCryoN2_QuenchValve_Active := FALSE;
        wState_Status_Word := 16#0010;
        
        (* Apply MPC control increments *)
        aActuatorU[1] := aActuatorU[1] + aDeltaU[1]; (* Chiller bypass *)
        aActuatorU[2] := aActuatorU[2] + aDeltaU[2]; (* Nitrite pump *)
        aActuatorU[3] := aActuatorU[3] + aDeltaU[3]; (* Amine pump *)
        
        (* Enforce physical actuator saturation bounds *)
        IF aActuatorU[1] > 100.0 THEN aActuatorU[1] := 100.0; ELSIF aActuatorU[1] < 0.0 THEN aActuatorU[1] := 0.0; END_IF;
        IF aActuatorU[2] > 90.0 THEN aActuatorU[2] := 90.0; ELSIF aActuatorU[2] < 10.0 THEN aActuatorU[2] := 10.0; END_IF;
        IF aActuatorU[3] > 85.0 THEN aActuatorU[3] := 85.0; ELSIF aActuatorU[3] < 10.0 THEN aActuatorU[3] := 10.0; END_IF;
        
        (* Assign actuator commands with stoichiometric lead-lag ratio coupling *)
        rCoolant_Chiller_Bypass_Cmd := aActuatorU[1];
        rPump_Amine_Speed_Cmd := aActuatorU[3];
        rPump_Nitrite_Speed_Cmd := (rLeadLag_State * rRatio_AcidAmine_Target) + rRatio_Integrator;
        
        (* Clamp nitrite pump command *)
        IF rPump_Nitrite_Speed_Cmd > 95.0 THEN
            rPump_Nitrite_Speed_Cmd := 95.0;
        ELSIF rPump_Nitrite_Speed_Cmd < 5.0 THEN
            rPump_Nitrite_Speed_Cmd := 5.0;
        END_IF;
        
        (* Watchdog on core temperature approaching critical limit *)
        IF rVoted_CoreTemp_DegC > 2.8 THEN
            iState := 50; (* Divert to runaway mitigation *)
            rStateTimer_Sec := 0.0;
        END_IF;

    50: (* STATE_RUNAWAY_MITIGATION_DEGRADATION: Proactive Exotherm Suppression *)
        bSystemReady := FALSE;
        bCryoN2_QuenchValve_Active := FALSE;
        wState_Status_Word := 16#0020;
        
        (* Instantly slash nitrite/acid pump by 65% to starve the exotherm *)
        rPump_Nitrite_Speed_Cmd := rPump_Nitrite_Speed_Cmd * 0.35;
        rPump_Amine_Speed_Cmd := rPump_Amine_Speed_Cmd * 0.80;
        (* Force cooling chiller to 100% full capacity (0% bypass) *)
        rCoolant_Chiller_Bypass_Cmd := 0.0;
        
        IF rVoted_CoreTemp_DegC <= -1.0 AND rdT_dt_Filtered <= 0.0 THEN
            (* Core temperature arrested: return to steady state via ramp *)
            iState := 30;
            rStateTimer_Sec := 0.0;
        ELSIF rVoted_CoreTemp_DegC > 4.5 OR rStateTimer_Sec > 12.0 THEN
            (* Mitigation failed: execute immediate cryogenic N2 dump *)
            bQuenchTriggerLatched := TRUE;
            iFaultHistoryRegister := 107; (* Thermal runaway uncontained in mitigation *)
            iState := 90;
            rStateTimer_Sec := 0.0;
        END_IF;

    90: (* STATE_EMERGENCY_CRYO_QUENCH: SIL-3 Cryogenic N2 Deluge Dump *)
        bSystemReady := FALSE;
        bCryoN2_QuenchValve_Active := TRUE; (* Open high-speed pulse cryogenic valve *)
        rPump_Amine_Speed_Cmd := 0.0;       (* Immediately trip amine feed *)
        rPump_Nitrite_Speed_Cmd := 0.0;     (* Immediately trip nitrite feed *)
        rCoolant_Chiller_Bypass_Cmd := 0.0; (* Lock chiller in maximum cooling *)
        wAlarm_Word_1 := wAlarm_Word_1 OR 16#2000; (* Bit 13: Cryo dump active *)
        wState_Status_Word := 16#0040;
        
        rQuenchDurationTimer := rQuenchDurationTimer + rDeltaTime_Scan;
        (* Keep cryogenic injection open for 15.0 seconds to freeze reaction *)
        IF rQuenchDurationTimer >= 15.0 AND rVoted_CoreTemp_DegC <= -10.0 THEN
            bCryoN2_QuenchValve_Active := FALSE;
            iState := 95; (* Proceed to Post-Quench Cold Purge *)
            rStateTimer_Sec := 0.0;
        END_IF;

    95: (* STATE_POST_QUENCH_PURGE: Inert Flushing of Residual Diazonium Mass *)

    D_mat[4,1] := 0.000000; D_mat[4,2] :=-0.320000; D_mat[4,3] :=-0.450000; D_mat[4,4] := 0.000000;
    D_mat[5,1] := 0.012000; D_mat[5,2] := 0.000000; D_mat[5,3] := 0.000000; D_mat[5,4] :=-0.045000;

    (* Initial Dynamic State Vector *)
    x_state[1] := 0.0; (* delta T_j [K] *)
    x_state[2] := 0.0; (* delta T_fluid [K] *)
    x_state[3] := 0.0; (* delta X_conv [-] *)
    x_state[4] := 0.0; (* delta v_slug [m/s] *)
    x_state[5] := 0.0; (* delta C_prod [mol/L] *)
    x_state[6] := 0.0; (* delta C_imp [mol/L] *)

    (* MPC Weighting Matrices Initialization *)
    Q_weights[1] := 25.0; (* Severe Penalty on API Purity Deviation *)
    Q_weights[2] := 5.0;  (* Moderate Penalty on Product Absorbance Tracking *)
    Q_weights[3] := 8.0;  (* Penalty on Fluid Temperature Deviation *)
    Q_weights[4] := 4.0;  (* Penalty on Residence Time Deviation *)
    Q_weights[5] := 12.0; (* High Penalty on Heat Sink Substrate Temperature *)

    R_weights[1] := 0.15; (* LED Drive Current Slew Rate Weight *)
    R_weights[2] := 1.20; (* Liquid Pump Volumetric Slew Rate Weight *)
    R_weights[3] := 0.80; (* Gas Mass Flow Slew Rate Weight *)
    R_weights[4] := 0.25; (* Peltier TEC Duty Cycle Slew Rate Weight *)

    (* Actuator Hard Saturation Bounds *)
    u_mpc_min[1] := 200.0;  u_mpc_max[1] := 3000.0; (* LED Current: 200 to 3000 mA *)
    u_mpc_min[2] := 0.50;   u_mpc_max[2] := 8.00;   (* Liquid Flow: 0.5 to 8.0 ml/min *)
    u_mpc_min[3] := 1.00;   u_mpc_max[3] := 15.00;  (* Segmenting Gas: 1.0 to 15.0 sccm *)
    u_mpc_min[4] := 0.00;   u_mpc_max[4] := 100.00; (* Peltier PWM Duty: 0 to 100 % *)

    (* Actuator Maximum Allowable Slew Rates per 20ms Scan Cycle *)
    delta_u_max[1] := 50.0; (* 50 mA / cycle = 2500 mA / s ramp limit *)
    delta_u_max[2] := 0.10; (* 0.10 ml/min / cycle = 5.0 ml/min/s *)
    delta_u_max[3] := 0.25; (* 0.25 sccm / cycle = 12.5 sccm/s *)
    delta_u_max[4] := 2.50; (* 2.50 % / cycle = 125 % / s *)

    (* Pre-computed MPC Condensed Hessian Matrix Approximation *)
    H_mpc[1,1] := 1.8420; H_mpc[1,2] :=-0.1250; H_mpc[1,3] := 0.0480; H_mpc[1,4] :=-0.3120;
    H_mpc[2,1] :=-0.1250; H_mpc[2,2] := 4.6500; H_mpc[2,3] := 1.8200; H_mpc[2,4] := 0.0150;
    H_mpc[3,1] := 0.0480; H_mpc[3,2] := 1.8200; H_mpc[3,3] := 3.2400; H_mpc[3,4] := 0.0000;
    H_mpc[4,1] :=-0.3120; H_mpc[4,2] := 0.0150; H_mpc[4,3] := 0.0000; H_mpc[4,4] := 2.1850;

    bInitialScanDone := TRUE;
END_IF;

(* ================================================================================================= *)
(* === SECTION 1: EXECUTIVE SAFETY INTERLOCKS & HARDWARE TRIP VERIFICATION                       === *)
(* ================================================================================================= *)
(* Priority 0 Hardwired Fail-Safe Trip Evaluation *)
IF NOT bEmergencyStop THEN
    (* Immediate De-Energization of all Critical Actuators *)
    bProductHarvestValve := FALSE;     (* Fail-Safe Spring Return to Quench Vessel *)
    bLedPowerEnable := FALSE;          (* Hard Disconnect of High-Voltage LED DC Power *)
    rLedDriveCurrent_mA := 0.0;
    rPumpFlowSetpoint_mlpm := 0.0;
    bQuenchSolventFlushValve := TRUE;  (* Force Open High-Pressure Solvent Wash Line *)
    bSystemReady := FALSE;
    bMajorAlarmActive := TRUE;
    dwAlarmStatusWord := dwAlarmStatusWord OR 16#00000001; (* Bit 0: Emergency Stop Active *)
    iState := 90;                      (* Force State Machine into EMERGENCY_ABORT_AND_SAFE_QUENCH *)
    RETURN;
END_IF;

(* ================================================================================================= *)
(* === SECTION 2: TRIPLE MODULAR REDUNDANCY (2oo3) SENSOR VOTING & HEALTH DIAGNOSTICS            === *)
(* ================================================================================================= *)
(* --- 2.1 Microchannel Operating Pressure 2oo3 TMR Voting --- *)
(* Inter-Channel Discrepancy Monitoring between Channels A, B, and C *)
tDiscrepancyTimer_P_AB(IN := (ABS(rMicroreactorPressure_A_bar - rMicroreactorPressure_B_bar) > rDISCREPANCY_TOL_PRESS_BAR),
                       PT := tDISCREPANCY_DEBOUNCE_TIME);
tDiscrepancyTimer_P_BC(IN := (ABS(rMicroreactorPressure_B_bar - rMicroreactorPressure_C_bar) > rDISCREPANCY_TOL_PRESS_BAR),
                       PT := tDISCREPANCY_DEBOUNCE_TIME);
tDiscrepancyTimer_P_CA(IN := (ABS(rMicroreactorPressure_C_bar - rMicroreactorPressure_A_bar) > rDISCREPANCY_TOL_PRESS_BAR),
                       PT := tDISCREPANCY_DEBOUNCE_TIME);

bPressureFault_A := tDiscrepancyTimer_P_AB.Q AND tDiscrepancyTimer_P_CA.Q;
bPressureFault_B := tDiscrepancyTimer_P_AB.Q AND tDiscrepancyTimer_P_BC.Q;
bPressureFault_C := tDiscrepancyTimer_P_BC.Q AND tDiscrepancyTimer_P_CA.Q;

(* Dynamic 2oo3 -> 1oo2 -> 1oo1 Graceful Degradation State Logic *)
IF NOT bPressureFault_A AND NOT bPressureFault_B AND NOT bPressureFault_C THEN
    (* 2oo3 Normal Healthy Mode: Exact 3-Point Mathematical Median Selection *)
    rPressCandidate_1 := rMicroreactorPressure_A_bar;
    rPressCandidate_2 := rMicroreactorPressure_B_bar;
    rPressCandidate_3 := rMicroreactorPressure_C_bar;
    IF rPressCandidate_1 > rPressCandidate_2 THEN
        rSwapTemp := rPressCandidate_1; rPressCandidate_1 := rPressCandidate_2; rPressCandidate_2 := rSwapTemp;
    END_IF;
    IF rPressCandidate_2 > rPressCandidate_3 THEN
        rSwapTemp := rPressCandidate_2; rPressCandidate_2 := rPressCandidate_3; rPressCandidate_3 := rSwapTemp;
    END_IF;
    IF rPressCandidate_1 > rPressCandidate_2 THEN
        rSwapTemp := rPressCandidate_1; rPressCandidate_1 := rPressCandidate_2; rPressCandidate_2 := rSwapTemp;
    END_IF;
    rVotedReactorPressure_bar := rPressCandidate_2; (* Middle Element is Exact Median *)
    iPressureDegradedMode := 0;
ELSIF bPressureFault_A AND NOT bPressureFault_B AND NOT bPressureFault_C THEN
    (* Channel A Failed: 1oo2 Average Voting between B and C *)
    rVotedReactorPressure_bar := (rMicroreactorPressure_B_bar + rMicroreactorPressure_C_bar) * 0.50;
    iPressureDegradedMode := 1;
    dwAlarmStatusWord := dwAlarmStatusWord OR 16#00000010; (* Bit 4: Pressure Sensor A Failed *)
ELSIF bPressureFault_B AND NOT bPressureFault_A AND NOT bPressureFault_C THEN
    (* Channel B Failed: 1oo2 Average Voting between A and C *)
    rVotedReactorPressure_bar := (rMicroreactorPressure_A_bar + rMicroreactorPressure_C_bar) * 0.50;
    iPressureDegradedMode := 1;
    dwAlarmStatusWord := dwAlarmStatusWord OR 16#00000020; (* Bit 5: Pressure Sensor B Failed *)
ELSIF bPressureFault_C AND NOT bPressureFault_A AND NOT bPressureFault_B THEN
    (* Channel C Failed: 1oo2 Average Voting between A and B *)
    rVotedReactorPressure_bar := (rMicroreactorPressure_A_bar + rMicroreactorPressure_B_bar) * 0.50;
    iPressureDegradedMode := 1;
    dwAlarmStatusWord := dwAlarmStatusWord OR 16#00000040; (* Bit 6: Pressure Sensor C Failed *)
ELSIF NOT bPressureFault_A AND bPressureFault_B AND bPressureFault_C THEN
    (* Dual Failure: 1oo1 Degraded Mode on Surviving Channel A *)
    rVotedReactorPressure_bar := rMicroreactorPressure_A_bar;
    iPressureDegradedMode := 2;
    dwAlarmStatusWord := dwAlarmStatusWord OR 16#00000080; (* Bit 7: Pressure Degraded 1oo1 Mode *)
ELSIF bPressureFault_A AND NOT bPressureFault_B AND bPressureFault_C THEN
    (* Dual Failure: 1oo1 Degraded Mode on Surviving Channel B *)
    rVotedReactorPressure_bar := rMicroreactorPressure_B_bar;
    iPressureDegradedMode := 2;
    dwAlarmStatusWord := dwAlarmStatusWord OR 16#00000080;
ELSIF bPressureFault_A AND bPressureFault_B AND NOT bPressureFault_C THEN
    (* Dual Failure: 1oo1 Degraded Mode on Surviving Channel C *)
    rVotedReactorPressure_bar := rMicroreactorPressure_C_bar;
    iPressureDegradedMode := 2;
    dwAlarmStatusWord := dwAlarmStatusWord OR 16#00000080;
ELSE
    (* Triple Sensor Failure or Unresolvable Discrepancy: Fail-Safe Emergency Trip *)
    iPressureDegradedMode := 3;
    dwAlarmStatusWord := dwAlarmStatusWord OR 16#00000100; (* Bit 8: All Pressure Sensors Faulty *)
    bProductHarvestValve := FALSE;
    bLedPowerEnable := FALSE;
    bMajorAlarmActive := TRUE;
    iState := 90;
    RETURN;
END_IF;

(* Low-Pass Filter on Voted Operating Pressure (Time Constant tau = 100 ms) *)
rFiltPressure_bar := rFiltPressure_bar + 0.1667 * (rVotedReactorPressure_bar - rFiltPressure_bar);

(* --- 2.2 LED Heat Sink Substrate Temperature 2oo3 TMR Voting --- *)
tDiscrepancyTimer_T_AB(IN := (ABS(rLedSubstrateTemp_A_degC - rLedSubstrateTemp_B_degC) > rDISCREPANCY_TOL_TEMP_DEGC),
                       PT := tDISCREPANCY_DEBOUNCE_TIME);
tDiscrepancyTimer_T_BC(IN := (ABS(rLedSubstrateTemp_B_degC - rLedSubstrateTemp_C_degC) > rDISCREPANCY_TOL_TEMP_DEGC),
                       PT := tDISCREPANCY_DEBOUNCE_TIME);
tDiscrepancyTimer_T_CA(IN := (ABS(rLedSubstrateTemp_C_degC - rLedSubstrateTemp_A_degC) > rDISCREPANCY_TOL_TEMP_DEGC),
                       PT := tDISCREPANCY_DEBOUNCE_TIME);

bSubstrateTempFault_A := tDiscrepancyTimer_T_AB.Q AND tDiscrepancyTimer_T_CA.Q;
bSubstrateTempFault_B := tDiscrepancyTimer_T_AB.Q AND tDiscrepancyTimer_T_BC.Q;
bSubstrateTempFault_C := tDiscrepancyTimer_T_BC.Q AND tDiscrepancyTimer_T_CA.Q;

IF NOT bSubstrateTempFault_A AND NOT bSubstrateTempFault_B AND NOT bSubstrateTempFault_C THEN
    rTempCandidate_1 := rLedSubstrateTemp_A_degC;
    rTempCandidate_2 := rLedSubstrateTemp_B_degC;
    rTempCandidate_3 := rLedSubstrateTemp_C_degC;
    IF rTempCandidate_1 > rTempCandidate_2 THEN
        rSwapTemp := rTempCandidate_1; rTempCandidate_1 := rTempCandidate_2; rTempCandidate_2 := rSwapTemp;
    END_IF;
    IF rTempCandidate_2 > rTempCandidate_3 THEN
        rSwapTemp := rTempCandidate_2; rTempCandidate_2 := rTempCandidate_3; rTempCandidate_3 := rSwapTemp;
    END_IF;
    IF rTempCandidate_1 > rTempCandidate_2 THEN
        rSwapTemp := rTempCandidate_1; rTempCandidate_1 := rTempCandidate_2; rTempCandidate_2 := rSwapTemp;
    END_IF;
    rVotedSubstrateTemp_degC := rTempCandidate_2;
    iSubstrateTempDegradedMode := 0;
ELSIF bSubstrateTempFault_A AND NOT bSubstrateTempFault_B AND NOT bSubstrateTempFault_C THEN
    rVotedSubstrateTemp_degC := (rLedSubstrateTemp_B_degC + rLedSubstrateTemp_C_degC) * 0.50;
    iSubstrateTempDegradedMode := 1;
    dwAlarmStatusWord := dwAlarmStatusWord OR 16#00000200; (* Bit 9: Substrate Temp Sensor A Fault *)
ELSIF bSubstrateTempFault_B AND NOT bSubstrateTempFault_A AND NOT bSubstrateTempFault_C THEN
    rVotedSubstrateTemp_degC := (rLedSubstrateTemp_A_degC + rLedSubstrateTemp_C_degC) * 0.50;
    iSubstrateTempDegradedMode := 1;
    dwAlarmStatusWord := dwAlarmStatusWord OR 16#00000400; (* Bit 10: Substrate Temp Sensor B Fault *)
ELSIF bSubstrateTempFault_C AND NOT bSubstrateTempFault_A AND NOT bSubstrateTempFault_B THEN
    rVotedSubstrateTemp_degC := (rLedSubstrateTemp_A_degC + rLedSubstrateTemp_B_degC) * 0.50;
    iSubstrateTempDegradedMode := 1;
    dwAlarmStatusWord := dwAlarmStatusWord OR 16#00000800; (* Bit 11: Substrate Temp Sensor C Fault *)
ELSIF NOT bSubstrateTempFault_A AND bSubstrateTempFault_B AND bSubstrateTempFault_C THEN
    rVotedSubstrateTemp_degC := rLedSubstrateTemp_A_degC;
    iSubstrateTempDegradedMode := 2;
    dwAlarmStatusWord := dwAlarmStatusWord OR 16#00001000; (* Bit 12: Substrate Temp 1oo1 Mode *)
ELSIF bSubstrateTempFault_A AND NOT bSubstrateTempFault_B AND bSubstrateTempFault_C THEN
    rVotedSubstrateTemp_degC := rLedSubstrateTemp_B_degC;
    iSubstrateTempDegradedMode := 2;
    dwAlarmStatusWord := dwAlarmStatusWord OR 16#00001000;
ELSIF bSubstrateTempFault_A AND bSubstrateTempFault_B AND NOT bSubstrateTempFault_C THEN
    rVotedSubstrateTemp_degC := rLedSubstrateTemp_C_degC;
    iSubstrateTempDegradedMode := 2;
    dwAlarmStatusWord := dwAlarmStatusWord OR 16#00001000;
ELSE
    iSubstrateTempDegradedMode := 3;
    dwAlarmStatusWord := dwAlarmStatusWord OR 16#00002000; (* Bit 13: All Temp Sensors Faulty *)
    bProductHarvestValve := FALSE;
    bLedPowerEnable := FALSE;
    bMajorAlarmActive := TRUE;
    iState := 90;
    RETURN;
END_IF;

(* Critical High-High Thermal Runaway Trip Check *)
IF rVotedSubstrateTemp_degC >= rTEMP_RUNAWAY_TRIP_DEGC THEN
    bProductHarvestValve := FALSE;
    bLedPowerEnable := FALSE;
    rLedDriveCurrent_mA := 0.0;
    bMajorAlarmActive := TRUE;
    dwAlarmStatusWord := dwAlarmStatusWord OR 16#00004000; (* Bit 14: Thermal Runaway High-High Trip *)
    iState := 90;
    RETURN;
END_IF;

(* Critical High-High Overpressure Microchannel Rupture Trip Check *)
IF rVotedReactorPressure_bar >= rPRESSURE_BURST_TRIP_BAR THEN
    bProductHarvestValve := FALSE;
    bLedPowerEnable := FALSE;
    rPumpFlowSetpoint_mlpm := 0.0;
    bQuenchSolventFlushValve := TRUE;
    bMajorAlarmActive := TRUE;
    dwAlarmStatusWord := dwAlarmStatusWord OR 16#00008000; (* Bit 15: Pressure Burst High-High Trip *)
    iState := 90;
    RETURN;
END_IF;

(* ================================================================================================= *)
(* === SECTION 3: MULTIPHASE SLUG FLOW HYDRODYNAMICS & OPTICAL RESIDENCE TIME ESTIMATION         === *)
(* ================================================================================================= *)
(* Convert Liquid Volumetric Flow from [ml/min] to SI [m3/s] *)
rLiquidFlow_tot_m3s := (rReagentFlow_A_mlpm + rReagentFlow_B_mlpm) * 1.66667e-8;

(* Actual Volumetric Gas Flow Rate accounting for Operating Pressure & Temperature *)
(* Ideal Gas Equation: Q_gas,act = Q_gas,sccm * (P_std / P_voted) * (T_fluid / T_std) *)
IF rVotedReactorPressure_bar > 0.20 THEN
    rGasFlow_actual_m3s := (rSegmentingGasFlow_sccm * 1.66667e-8) *
                           (rSTD_PRESSURE_BAR / rVotedReactorPressure_bar) *
                           ((rCoolingJacketTemp_degC + 273.15) / rSTD_TEMPERATURE_K);
ELSE
    rGasFlow_actual_m3s := rSegmentingGasFlow_sccm * 1.66667e-8;
END_IF;

(* Total Two-Phase Multiphase Volumetric Flow Rate [m3/s] *)
rTotalMixtureFlow_m3s := rLiquidFlow_tot_m3s + rGasFlow_actual_m3s;

(* Dynamic Volumetric Gas Holdup / Void Fraction epsilon_G *)
IF rTotalMixtureFlow_m3s > 1.0e-12 THEN
    rGasVoidFraction := rGasFlow_actual_m3s / rTotalMixtureFlow_m3s;
    rMixtureVelocity_ms := rTotalMixtureFlow_m3s / rCHANNEL_CROSS_AREA_M2;
ELSE
    rGasVoidFraction := 0.0;
    rMixtureVelocity_ms := 0.0;
END_IF;

(* Capillary Number Ca = mu_L * u_m / gamma *)
rCapillaryNumber := (rSOLVENT_DYNAMIC_VISC_PAS * rMixtureVelocity_ms) / rSOLVENT_SURFACE_TENS_NM;

(* Aussillous-Quere Formulation for Capillary Lubrication Liquid Film Thickness delta *)
(* delta / R = (1.34 * Ca^(2/3)) / (1.0 + 3.35 * Ca^(2/3)) *)
IF rCapillaryNumber > 1.0e-7 THEN
    rTaylorFilmThickness_um := (0.50 * rCHANNEL_DIAMETER_M * 1.0e6) *
                               ((1.34 * EXPT(rCapillaryNumber, 0.666667)) /
                               (1.0 + 3.35 * EXPT(rCapillaryNumber, 0.666667)));
ELSE
    rTaylorFilmThickness_um := 0.50; (* Boundary Minimum Film Thickness [um] *)
END_IF;

(* Taylor Liquid Slug Characteristic Length & Internal Turnover Frequency *)
rSlugLength_m := 3.50 * rCHANNEL_DIAMETER_M; (* Typical Taylor slug aspect ratio L_slug ~ 3.5 * D_ch *)
IF rSlugLength_m > 1.0e-6 THEN
    rSlugFrequency_Hz := rMixtureVelocity_ms / (2.0 * rSlugLength_m);
ELSE
    rSlugFrequency_Hz := 0.0;
END_IF;

(* True Optical Residence Time within the Irradiated Microchannel Volume tau_opt = V_irr / Q_tot *)
IF rTotalMixtureFlow_m3s > 1.0e-12 THEN
    rOpticalResidenceTime_s := rIRRADIATED_VOLUME_M3 / rTotalMixtureFlow_m3s;
ELSE
    rOpticalResidenceTime_s := 9999.0;
END_IF;

(* ================================================================================================= *)
(* === SECTION 4: IN-LINE UV-VIS PHOTOMETRIC PURITY & KINETIC CONVERSION DECONVOLUTION            === *)
(* ================================================================================================= *)
(* Exponential Moving Average (EMA) Digital Filtering of Absorbance Signals (alpha = 0.20) *)
rFiltAbs_Prod_AU := rFiltAbs_Prod_AU + 0.20 * (rUvVisAbsorbance_Prod_AU - rFiltAbs_Prod_AU);
rFiltAbs_Imp_AU  := rFiltAbs_Imp_AU  + 0.20 * (rUvVisAbsorbance_Imp_AU  - rFiltAbs_Imp_AU);
rFiltAbs_Ref_AU  := rFiltAbs_Ref_AU  + 0.20 * (rUvVisAbsorbance_Ref_AU  - rFiltAbs_Ref_AU);

(* Reference Turbidity Baseline Subtraction to Eliminate Gas Slug Bubble Diffraction *)
rAbs_Prod_corr := rFiltAbs_Prod_AU - rFiltAbs_Ref_AU;
IF rAbs_Prod_corr < 0.0 THEN
    rAbs_Prod_corr := 0.0;
END_IF;

rAbs_Imp_corr := rFiltAbs_Imp_AU - rFiltAbs_Ref_AU;
IF rAbs_Imp_corr < 0.0 THEN
    rAbs_Imp_corr := 0.0;
END_IF;

(* Analytical Inversion of 2x2 Beer-Lambert Molar Extinction Matrix *)
(* [ A1_corr ]   [ eps1_prod   eps1_prec ] [ C_prod ]                     *)
(* [ A2_corr ] = [ eps2_prod   eps2_prec ] [ C_prec ] * b_path            *)
rDetExtinction := (rEPSILON_1_PROD * rEPSILON_2_PREC) - (rEPSILON_1_PREC * rEPSILON_2_PROD);

IF ABS(rDetExtinction) > 1.0e-3 THEN
    (* Path length in cm: b_path = rSPECTRO_PATH_LENGTH_M * 100.0 = 0.10 cm *)
    rCalcConc_Prod_M := (1.0 / (0.10 * rDetExtinction)) *
                        (rEPSILON_2_PREC * rAbs_Prod_corr - rEPSILON_1_PREC * rAbs_Imp_corr);
    rCalcConc_Prec_M := (1.0 / (0.10 * rDetExtinction)) *
                        (-rEPSILON_2_PROD * rAbs_Prod_corr + rEPSILON_1_PROD * rAbs_Imp_corr);
ELSE
    rCalcConc_Prod_M := 0.0;
    rCalcConc_Prec_M := rNOMINAL_FEED_CONC_M;
END_IF;

(* Clamping Non-Physical Negative Concentrations *)
IF rCalcConc_Prod_M < 0.0 THEN rCalcConc_Prod_M := 0.0; END_IF;
IF rCalcConc_Prec_M < 0.0 THEN rCalcConc_Prec_M := 0.0; END_IF;

(* Over-Irradiation Degradation Impurity Estimation *)
rCalcConc_Imp_M := rNOMINAL_FEED_CONC_M - (rCalcConc_Prod_M + rCalcConc_Prec_M);
IF rCalcConc_Imp_M < 0.0 THEN rCalcConc_Imp_M := 0.0; END_IF;

(* Total Dissolved Oncology Species *)
rTotalMolarSpecies := rCalcConc_Prod_M + rCalcConc_Prec_M + rCalcConc_Imp_M;

(* Real-Time Chemical Purity [%] *)
IF rTotalMolarSpecies > 1.0e-6 THEN
    rPhotometricPurity_pct := (rCalcConc_Prod_M / rTotalMolarSpecies) * 100.0;
ELSE
    rPhotometricPurity_pct := 0.0;
END_IF;

(* Reagent Conversion Fraction [%] *)
IF rNOMINAL_FEED_CONC_M > 1.0e-6 THEN
    rReactionConversion_pct := ((rNOMINAL_FEED_CONC_M - rCalcConc_Prec_M) / rNOMINAL_FEED_CONC_M) * 100.0;
    rPhotochemicalYield_pct := (rCalcConc_Prod_M / rNOMINAL_FEED_CONC_M) * 100.0;
ELSE
    rReactionConversion_pct := 0.0;
    rPhotochemicalYield_pct := 0.0;
END_IF;

(* In-Situ Photonic Radiant Flux Delivery [umol photons / s = uEin / s] *)
(* q_p,0 = (I_opt * A_irr * lambda) / (h * c * N_A) *)
rPhotonFlux_uEin_s := ((rOpticalIrradiance_Wcm2 * 1.0e4 * rIRRADIATED_APERTURE_M2 * (rWavelength_Target_nm * 1.0e-9)) /
                       (rPLANCK_CONSTANT * rSPEED_OF_LIGHT * rAVOGADRO_CONSTANT)) * 1.0e6;

(* ================================================================================================= *)
(* === SECTION 5: HIGH-POWER MULTI-WAVELENGTH LED HEAT DISSIPATION & PELTIER TEC CONTROL          === *)
(* ================================================================================================= *)
(* Temperature-Compensated Diode Forward Voltage Calculation *)
rForwardVoltage_V := rLED_NOMINAL_VF_V + rLED_TEMP_COEFF_VK * (rVotedSubstrateTemp_degC - 25.0);
IF rForwardVoltage_V < 28.0 THEN rForwardVoltage_V := 28.0; END_IF;

(* Electrical & Thermal Dissipation Rates *)
rP_electrical_W := (rLedDriveCurrent_mA * 1.0e-3) * rForwardVoltage_V;
rP_thermal_W    := rP_electrical_W * (1.0 - rLED_OPTICAL_EFFICIENCY);

(* Real-Time Estimated p-n Junction Temperature Tj = T_sink + P_th * R_th,js *)
rEstimatedJunctionTemp_degC := rVotedSubstrateTemp_degC + (rP_thermal_W * rLED_THERMAL_RESIST_KW);

(* Center Emission Wavelength Thermal Red-Shift *)
rWavelengthDrift_nm := rLED_WAVELENGTH_COEFF_NMK * (rEstimatedJunctionTemp_degC - 25.0);

(* Peltier Thermoelectric Cooler (TEC) Closed-Loop Anti-Windup PID Regulation *)
(* Feedforward Power Rejection based on instantaneous LED thermal dissipation *)
rPeltier_Feedforward := (rP_thermal_W / 120.0) * 45.0; (* 45% duty feedforward at nominal 120W heat *)

(* Feedback Error based on Substrate Temperature vs Target Setpoint *)
rGradValue := rVotedSubstrateTemp_degC - rTargetFluidTemp_degC; (* Temperature error e(t) *)

(* Integral Error Accumulation with Anti-Windup Clamping *)
rPeltier_Integral := rPeltier_Integral + rPeltier_Ki * rGradValue * 0.020;
IF rPeltier_Integral > 35.0 THEN
    rPeltier_Integral := 35.0;
ELSIF rPeltier_Integral < -15.0 THEN
    rPeltier_Integral := -15.0;
END_IF;

(* Total Peltier Actuator Command Calculation *)
rPeltierDriveDuty_pct := (rPeltier_Kp * rGradValue) +
                         rPeltier_Integral +

    5. Bidirectional Thyristor / IGBT DC-DC Chopper Power Conditioning Unit (PCU):
       Two-quadrant / four-quadrant bidirectional H-bridge chopper interfaces the cold REBCO inductor
       to the intermediate 3.3 kV DC bus capacitor bank.
         Freewheeling / Persistent mode: Duty cycle D = 0.5 (or bypass thyristor conduction), V_coil = 0.
         Discharge (Grid Boost): D < 0.5, V_coil = -V_dc * (1 - 2*D) < 0, discharging coil into DC link.
         Charge (Grid Absorption): D > 0.5, V_coil = V_dc * (2*D - 1) > 0, ramping coil current upward.

    6. Quench Detection & Inductive Bridge Compensation:
       REBCO conductors exhibit extremely low Normal Zone Propagation Velocity (NZPV ~ 5-20 mm/s),
       making localized hot-spots dangerous without high global voltage drops. Detection utilizes
       inductive compensation bridges comparing terminal voltage against synthetic L*(dI/dt):
         V_quench = V_terminal - L_coil * (dI_coil / dt) - M * (dI_ext / dt)
       A persistent resistive voltage exceeding 100 mV for > 15 ms triggers an instantaneous SIL-3
       safety trip, opening explosive pyro-breakers and firing dump thyristors into a 0.20 Ohm
       energy extraction resistor to safely dissipate 50 MJ within 8.5 time constants (tau = 20 s).

    7. 8-State Discrete State-Space Model & Real-Time Model Predictive Control (MPC):
       Embedded discrete state-space model running an active-set projected gradient descent
       quadratic programming optimizer to simultaneously regulate coil current, cryostat pressure,
       neon thermal margin, DC bus voltage, grid frequency deviation, active power, reactive power,
       and mechanical hoop strain under strict multi-variable physical constraints.
 ==========================================================================================
*)
