    (*   u[2]: Inverter Active Current Demand I_d* [kA]                                  *)
    (*   u[3]: Inverter Reactive Current Demand I_q* [kA]                                *)
    (*   u[4]: Cryogenic Thermo-Siphon Bypass Valve Position U_valve [%]                 *)
    (* ================================================================================= *)
    A_mat                           : ARRAY[1..8, 1..8] OF REAL; (* Discrete state transition matrix A (8x8) *)
    B_mat                           : ARRAY[1..8, 1..4] OF REAL; (* Discrete input coupling matrix B (8x4) *)
    C_mat                           : ARRAY[1..8, 1..8] OF REAL; (* Output observation matrix C (8x8) *)
    D_mat                           : ARRAY[1..8, 1..4] OF REAL; (* Direct feedthrough matrix D (8x4) *)

    x_state                         : ARRAY[1..8] OF REAL;       (* Current estimated plant state vector *)
    x_pred                          : ARRAY[1..8] OF REAL;       (* One-step-ahead predicted state vector *)
    x_ref                           : ARRAY[1..8] OF REAL;       (* Target setpoint reference state vector *)
    x_err                           : ARRAY[1..8] OF REAL;       (* State tracking error (x_state - x_ref) *)

    u_mpc                           : ARRAY[1..4] OF REAL;       (* Current MPC optimal control inputs *)
    u_delta                         : ARRAY[1..4] OF REAL;       (* Optimal control increment step vector *)
    u_prev                          : ARRAY[1..4] OF REAL;       (* Previous scan cycle control input vector *)

    Q_diag                          : ARRAY[1..8] OF REAL;       (* Diagonal state error weighting matrix *)
    R_diag                          : ARRAY[1..4] OF REAL;       (* Diagonal actuator effort penalty matrix *)
    grad_J                          : ARRAY[1..4] OF REAL;       (* Quadratic cost function gradient vector *)
    H_diag                          : ARRAY[1..4] OF REAL;       (* Hessian diagonal approximation vector *)

    iRow                            : INT := 1;                  (* Loop row index *)
    iCol                            : INT := 1;                  (* Loop column index *)
    iIter                           : INT := 1;                  (* Active-set optimization loop counter *)
    rCostValue                      : REAL := 0.0;               (* Evaluated quadratic performance index J *)
    rStepSize                       : REAL := 0.015;             (* Gradient descent projected search step *)
    bMatricesInitialized            : BOOL := FALSE;             (* Cold-start matrix initialization latch *)

    (* Scratchpad working variables for intermediate math *)
    rTempSum                        : REAL := 0.0;
    rMagEnergyJ                     : REAL := 0.0;
    rApparentPowerCalc              : REAL := 0.0;
    rMaxPAllowed                    : REAL := 0.0;
    rDeltaDuty                      : REAL := 0.0;
    rTargetCryoPressure_bar         : REAL := 2.100;
    rBaseGridVoltNom_kV             : REAL := 33.000;
END_VAR

(* ========================================================================================= *)
(* 1.0 EMERGENCY SAFETY INTERLOCKS & SIL-3 QUENCH PROTECTION EVALUATION                     *)
(* ========================================================================================= *)
(* Evaluates active-low hardware trips, localized quench resistive development, DC link     *)
(* overvoltage, cryogenic thermal excursion, and destructive mechanical hoop overstrain.   *)

dwAlarmWord1 := 16#0000_0000;
dwAlarmWord2 := 16#0000_0000;

(* Interlock 1.1: Active-low SIL-3 Emergency Stop Relay *)
IF NOT bEmergencyStop THEN
    dwAlarmWord1 := dwAlarmWord1 OR 16#0000_0001; (* Bit 0: Emergency Stop Hardwired Relay Open *)
END_IF;

(* Interlock 1.2: System Enable Permissive Dropped *)
IF NOT bEnableSystem THEN
    dwAlarmWord1 := dwAlarmWord1 OR 16#0000_0002; (* Bit 1: Master Enable Signal De-asserted *)
END_IF;

(* Interlock 1.3: Catastrophic Superconducting Quench Detection *)
(* Evaluated via voltage tap bridge and inductive compensation residual *)
rSectorVoltMax_mV := MAX(rVoltageTap_Pancake1_mV, MAX(rVoltageTap_Pancake2_mV, MAX(rVoltageTap_Pancake3_mV, rVoltageTap_Pancake4_mV)));
IF (rSectorVoltMax_mV > rQuenchVoltageThreshold_mV) OR (rFilteredResidual_mV > rQuenchVoltageThreshold_mV) THEN
    tQuenchDebounceTimer(IN := TRUE, PT := T#15MS);
    IF tQuenchDebounceTimer.Q THEN
        bQuenchDetected := TRUE;
        dwAlarmWord1 := dwAlarmWord1 OR 16#0000_0004; (* Bit 2: Superconducting REBCO Quench Detected *)
    END_IF;
ELSE
    tQuenchDebounceTimer(IN := FALSE, PT := T#15MS);
END_IF;

(* Interlock 1.4: Cryogenic Thermal Runaway (Exceeding Critical Safe Temperature) *)
IF (rCryoTemp_CoilHotSpot_A_K > rMaxCryoTempLimit_K) AND (rCryoTemp_CoilHotSpot_B_K > rMaxCryoTempLimit_K) THEN
    dwAlarmWord1 := dwAlarmWord1 OR 16#0000_0008; (* Bit 3: 2oo3 Coil Hot-Spot Thermal Runaway Trip *)
END_IF;

(* Interlock 1.5: Current Lead Thermal Degradation *)
IF (rCryoTemp_CurrentLeadLower_K > 35.00) OR (rCryoTemp_CurrentLeadUpper_K > 320.0) THEN
    dwAlarmWord1 := dwAlarmWord1 OR 16#0000_0010; (* Bit 4: Vapor-Cooled Current Lead Overheating *)
END_IF;

(* Interlock 1.6: PCU Intermediate DC Bus Overvoltage *)
IF rDcBusVoltage_kV > rMaxDcBusVoltage_kV THEN
    dwAlarmWord1 := dwAlarmWord1 OR 16#0000_0020; (* Bit 5: DC Bus Severe Overvoltage Breakdown *)
END_IF;

(* Interlock 1.7: PCU Intermediate DC Bus Undervoltage During Sync *)
IF (rDcBusVoltage_kV < rMinDcBusVoltage_kV) AND (iState >= 40) THEN
    dwAlarmWord1 := dwAlarmWord1 OR 16#0000_0040; (* Bit 6: DC Bus Collapse Undervoltage Trip *)
END_IF;

(* Interlock 1.8: Superconducting Coil Overcurrent (Approaching Magnetic Fracture) *)
IF (rCoilCurrent_A_kA > rMaxCoilCurrent_kA) AND (rCoilCurrent_B_kA > rMaxCoilCurrent_kA) THEN
    dwAlarmWord1 := dwAlarmWord1 OR 16#0000_0080; (* Bit 7: Coil Overcurrent Extreme Hazard Trip *)
END_IF;

(* Interlock 1.9: Severe Mechanical Hoop Overstrain (REBCO Ceramic Delamination Risk) *)
rMaxInnerStrain_ustrain := MAX(rFBG_Strain_PancakeInner_A_ustrain, MAX(rFBG_Strain_PancakeInner_B_ustrain, rFBG_Strain_PancakeInner_C_ustrain));
rMaxOuterStrain_ustrain := MAX(rFBG_Strain_PancakeOuter_A_ustrain, MAX(rFBG_Strain_PancakeOuter_B_ustrain, rFBG_Strain_PancakeOuter_C_ustrain));
rMaxVotedStrain_ustrain := MAX(rMaxInnerStrain_ustrain, MAX(rMaxOuterStrain_ustrain, rFBG_Strain_SupportRing_ustrain));
IF rMaxVotedStrain_ustrain > c_MaxSafeStrainLimit_ustrain THEN
    dwAlarmWord2 := dwAlarmWord2 OR 16#0000_0001; (* Bit 0: FBG Mechanical Hoop Overstrain Trip *)
END_IF;

(* Interlock 1.10: Cryostat Vessel Extreme Overpressure *)
IF (rCryostatPressure_A_bar > 4.50) AND (rCryostatPressure_B_bar > 4.50) THEN
    dwAlarmWord2 := dwAlarmWord2 OR 16#0000_0002; (* Bit 1: Thermo-Siphon Cryostat Burst Hazard *)
END_IF;

(* Interlock 1.11: Cryocooler Cold Head Failure *)
IF (rCryoTemp_CondenserHead_K > 24.50) AND (iState >= 30) THEN
    dwAlarmWord2 := dwAlarmWord2 OR 16#0000_0004; (* Bit 2: Neon Condenser Re-liquefaction Loss *)
END_IF;

(* Master Safety Action: Transition directly to Quench / Fast Extraction State 100 *)
IF (dwAlarmWord1 <> 16#0000_0000) OR (dwAlarmWord2 <> 16#0000_0000) THEN
    bSystemTripped := TRUE;
    bSystemRunning := FALSE;
    bSystemReady := FALSE;
    iState := 100; (* State 100: Emergency Quench / Energy Extraction *)
END_IF;

(* ========================================================================================= *)
(* 2.0 TRIPLE MODULAR REDUNDANCY (2oo3) VOTING & FAULT-TOLERANT DEGRADATION                  *)
(* ========================================================================================= *)
(* Executes mid-value median selection across critical instrument triplets:                 *)
(* Coil Current, Grid Frequency, Hot-Spot Temperature, and Cryostat Pressure.             *)
(* Gracefully degrades: 2oo3 -> 1oo2 -> 1oo1 fail-safe before latching a trip.              *)

dwDegradationWord := 16#0000_0000;

(* --- 2.1 HTS Coil Current 2oo3 Voting Bank --- *)
rDev_Curr_AB := ABS(rCoilCurrent_A_kA - rCoilCurrent_B_kA);
rDev_Curr_BC := ABS(rCoilCurrent_B_kA - rCoilCurrent_C_kA);
rDev_Curr_CA := ABS(rCoilCurrent_C_kA - rCoilCurrent_A_kA);

bCurr_A_Healthy := (rCoilCurrent_A_kA >= -0.10) AND (rCoilCurrent_A_kA <= 6.50);
bCurr_B_Healthy := (rCoilCurrent_B_kA >= -0.10) AND (rCoilCurrent_B_kA <= 6.50);
bCurr_C_Healthy := (rCoilCurrent_C_kA >= -0.10) AND (rCoilCurrent_C_kA <= 6.50);

IF bCurr_A_Healthy AND bCurr_B_Healthy AND bCurr_C_Healthy THEN
    bCurr_Degraded_1oo2 := FALSE;
    bCurr_Failed_Trip := FALSE;
    (* Deterministic 2oo3 Median Selection *)
    IF ((rCoilCurrent_A_kA >= rCoilCurrent_B_kA) AND (rCoilCurrent_A_kA <= rCoilCurrent_C_kA)) OR
       ((rCoilCurrent_A_kA >= rCoilCurrent_C_kA) AND (rCoilCurrent_A_kA <= rCoilCurrent_B_kA)) THEN
        rCoilCurrentVoted_kA := rCoilCurrent_A_kA;
    ELSIF ((rCoilCurrent_B_kA >= rCoilCurrent_A_kA) AND (rCoilCurrent_B_kA <= rCoilCurrent_C_kA)) OR
          ((rCoilCurrent_B_kA >= rCoilCurrent_C_kA) AND (rCoilCurrent_B_kA <= rCoilCurrent_A_kA)) THEN
        rCoilCurrentVoted_kA := rCoilCurrent_B_kA;
    ELSE
        rCoilCurrentVoted_kA := rCoilCurrent_C_kA;
    END_IF;
    (* Sensor Discrepancy Warning threshold: 0.15 kA *)
    IF (rDev_Curr_AB > 0.15) OR (rDev_Curr_BC > 0.15) OR (rDev_Curr_CA > 0.15) THEN
        dwDegradationWord := dwDegradationWord OR 16#0000_0001; (* Current sensor divergence warning *)
    END_IF;
ELSIF bCurr_A_Healthy AND bCurr_B_Healthy THEN
    bCurr_Degraded_1oo2 := TRUE;
    rCoilCurrentVoted_kA := (rCoilCurrent_A_kA + rCoilCurrent_B_kA) * 0.50;
    dwDegradationWord := dwDegradationWord OR 16#0000_0002; (* Coil current degraded to 1oo2 (C bad) *)
ELSIF bCurr_B_Healthy AND bCurr_C_Healthy THEN
    bCurr_Degraded_1oo2 := TRUE;
    rCoilCurrentVoted_kA := (rCoilCurrent_B_kA + rCoilCurrent_C_kA) * 0.50;
    dwDegradationWord := dwDegradationWord OR 16#0000_0004; (* Coil current degraded to 1oo2 (A bad) *)
ELSIF bCurr_A_Healthy AND bCurr_C_Healthy THEN
    bCurr_Degraded_1oo2 := TRUE;
    rCoilCurrentVoted_kA := (rCoilCurrent_A_kA + rCoilCurrent_C_kA) * 0.50;
    dwDegradationWord := dwDegradationWord OR 16#0000_0008; (* Coil current degraded to 1oo2 (B bad) *)
ELSIF bCurr_A_Healthy THEN
    rCoilCurrentVoted_kA := rCoilCurrent_A_kA;
    dwDegradationWord := dwDegradationWord OR 16#0000_0010; (* Coil current 1oo1 single-channel mode *)
ELSIF bCurr_B_Healthy THEN
    rCoilCurrentVoted_kA := rCoilCurrent_B_kA;
    dwDegradationWord := dwDegradationWord OR 16#0000_0020; (* Coil current 1oo1 single-channel mode *)
ELSIF bCurr_C_Healthy THEN
    rCoilCurrentVoted_kA := rCoilCurrent_C_kA;
    dwDegradationWord := dwDegradationWord OR 16#0000_0040; (* Coil current 1oo1 single-channel mode *)
ELSE
    bCurr_Failed_Trip := TRUE;
    dwAlarmWord1 := dwAlarmWord1 OR 16#0000_0100; (* All three coil current sensors lost *)
    iState := 100;
END_IF;

(* --- 2.2 Grid Frequency 2oo3 Voting Bank --- *)
rDev_Freq_AB := ABS(rGridFreq_A_Hz - rGridFreq_B_Hz);
rDev_Freq_BC := ABS(rGridFreq_B_Hz - rGridFreq_C_Hz);
rDev_Freq_CA := ABS(rGridFreq_C_Hz - rGridFreq_A_Hz);

bFreq_A_Healthy := (rGridFreq_A_Hz >= 42.00) AND (rGridFreq_A_Hz <= 68.00);
bFreq_B_Healthy := (rGridFreq_B_Hz >= 42.00) AND (rGridFreq_B_Hz <= 68.00);
bFreq_C_Healthy := (rGridFreq_C_Hz >= 42.00) AND (rGridFreq_C_Hz <= 68.00);

IF bFreq_A_Healthy AND bFreq_B_Healthy AND bFreq_C_Healthy THEN
    bFreq_Degraded_1oo2 := FALSE;
    bFreq_Failed_Trip := FALSE;
    IF ((rGridFreq_A_Hz >= rGridFreq_B_Hz) AND (rGridFreq_A_Hz <= rGridFreq_C_Hz)) OR
       ((rGridFreq_A_Hz >= rGridFreq_C_Hz) AND (rGridFreq_A_Hz <= rGridFreq_B_Hz)) THEN
        rVotedGridFreq_Hz := rGridFreq_A_Hz;
    ELSIF ((rGridFreq_B_Hz >= rGridFreq_A_Hz) AND (rGridFreq_B_Hz <= rGridFreq_C_Hz)) OR
          ((rGridFreq_B_Hz >= rGridFreq_C_Hz) AND (rGridFreq_B_Hz <= rGridFreq_A_Hz)) THEN
        rVotedGridFreq_Hz := rGridFreq_B_Hz;
    ELSE
        rVotedGridFreq_Hz := rGridFreq_C_Hz;
    END_IF;
    IF (rDev_Freq_AB > 0.08) OR (rDev_Freq_BC > 0.08) OR (rDev_Freq_CA > 0.08) THEN
        dwDegradationWord := dwDegradationWord OR 16#0000_0080; (* Frequency discrepancy warning *)
    END_IF;
ELSIF bFreq_A_Healthy AND bFreq_B_Healthy THEN
    bFreq_Degraded_1oo2 := TRUE;
    rVotedGridFreq_Hz := (rGridFreq_A_Hz + rGridFreq_B_Hz) * 0.50;
    dwDegradationWord := dwDegradationWord OR 16#0000_0100;
ELSIF bFreq_B_Healthy AND bFreq_C_Healthy THEN
    bFreq_Degraded_1oo2 := TRUE;
    rVotedGridFreq_Hz := (rGridFreq_B_Hz + rGridFreq_C_Hz) * 0.50;
    dwDegradationWord := dwDegradationWord OR 16#0000_0200;
ELSIF bFreq_A_Healthy AND bFreq_C_Healthy THEN
    bFreq_Degraded_1oo2 := TRUE;
    rVotedGridFreq_Hz := (rGridFreq_A_Hz + rGridFreq_C_Hz) * 0.50;
    dwDegradationWord := dwDegradationWord OR 16#0000_0400;
ELSIF bFreq_A_Healthy THEN
    rVotedGridFreq_Hz := rGridFreq_A_Hz;
    dwDegradationWord := dwDegradationWord OR 16#0000_0800;
ELSIF bFreq_B_Healthy THEN
    rVotedGridFreq_Hz := rGridFreq_B_Hz;
    dwDegradationWord := dwDegradationWord OR 16#0000_1000;
ELSIF bFreq_C_Healthy THEN
    rVotedGridFreq_Hz := rGridFreq_C_Hz;
    dwDegradationWord := dwDegradationWord OR 16#0000_2000;
ELSE
    bFreq_Failed_Trip := TRUE;
    dwAlarmWord1 := dwAlarmWord1 OR 16#0000_0200; (* All grid frequency meters lost *)
    iState := 100;
END_IF;

(* --- 2.3 Hot-Spot Cryogenic Temperature 2oo3 Voting Bank --- *)
rDev_Temp_AB := ABS(rCryoTemp_CoilHotSpot_A_K - rCryoTemp_CoilHotSpot_B_K);
rDev_Temp_BC := ABS(rCryoTemp_CoilHotSpot_B_K - rCryoTemp_CoilHotSpot_C_K);
rDev_Temp_CA := ABS(rCryoTemp_CoilHotSpot_C_K - rCryoTemp_CoilHotSpot_A_K);

bTemp_A_Healthy := (rCryoTemp_CoilHotSpot_A_K >= 4.00) AND (rCryoTemp_CoilHotSpot_A_K <= 100.0);
bTemp_B_Healthy := (rCryoTemp_CoilHotSpot_B_K >= 4.00) AND (rCryoTemp_CoilHotSpot_B_K <= 100.0);
bTemp_C_Healthy := (rCryoTemp_CoilHotSpot_C_K >= 4.00) AND (rCryoTemp_CoilHotSpot_C_K <= 100.0);

IF bTemp_A_Healthy AND bTemp_B_Healthy AND bTemp_C_Healthy THEN
    bTemp_Degraded_1oo2 := FALSE;
    bTemp_Failed_Trip := FALSE;
    IF ((rCryoTemp_CoilHotSpot_A_K >= rCryoTemp_CoilHotSpot_B_K) AND (rCryoTemp_CoilHotSpot_A_K <= rCryoTemp_CoilHotSpot_C_K)) OR
       ((rCryoTemp_CoilHotSpot_A_K >= rCryoTemp_CoilHotSpot_C_K) AND (rCryoTemp_CoilHotSpot_A_K <= rCryoTemp_CoilHotSpot_B_K)) THEN
        rVotedCryoTemp_K := rCryoTemp_CoilHotSpot_A_K;
    ELSIF ((rCryoTemp_CoilHotSpot_B_K >= rCryoTemp_CoilHotSpot_A_K) AND (rCryoTemp_CoilHotSpot_B_K <= rCryoTemp_CoilHotSpot_C_K)) OR
          ((rCryoTemp_CoilHotSpot_B_K >= rCryoTemp_CoilHotSpot_C_K) AND (rCryoTemp_CoilHotSpot_B_K <= rCryoTemp_CoilHotSpot_A_K)) THEN
        rVotedCryoTemp_K := rCryoTemp_CoilHotSpot_B_K;
    ELSE
        rVotedCryoTemp_K := rCryoTemp_CoilHotSpot_C_K;
    END_IF;
    IF (rDev_Temp_AB > 1.20) OR (rDev_Temp_BC > 1.20) OR (rDev_Temp_CA > 1.20) THEN
        dwDegradationWord := dwDegradationWord OR 16#0000_4000; (* Temperature CERNOX deviation *)
    END_IF;
ELSIF bTemp_A_Healthy AND bTemp_B_Healthy THEN
    bTemp_Degraded_1oo2 := TRUE;
    rVotedCryoTemp_K := MAX(rCryoTemp_CoilHotSpot_A_K, rCryoTemp_CoilHotSpot_B_K); (* Conservative high-select *)
    dwDegradationWord := dwDegradationWord OR 16#0000_8000;
ELSIF bTemp_B_Healthy AND bTemp_C_Healthy THEN
    bTemp_Degraded_1oo2 := TRUE;
    rVotedCryoTemp_K := MAX(rCryoTemp_CoilHotSpot_B_K, rCryoTemp_CoilHotSpot_C_K);
    dwDegradationWord := dwDegradationWord OR 16#0001_0000;
ELSIF bTemp_A_Healthy AND bTemp_C_Healthy THEN
    bTemp_Degraded_1oo2 := TRUE;
    rVotedCryoTemp_K := MAX(rCryoTemp_CoilHotSpot_A_K, rCryoTemp_CoilHotSpot_C_K);
    dwDegradationWord := dwDegradationWord OR 16#0002_0000;
ELSIF bTemp_A_Healthy THEN
    rVotedCryoTemp_K := rCryoTemp_CoilHotSpot_A_K;
    dwDegradationWord := dwDegradationWord OR 16#0004_0000;
ELSIF bTemp_B_Healthy THEN
    rVotedCryoTemp_K := rCryoTemp_CoilHotSpot_B_K;
    dwDegradationWord := dwDegradationWord OR 16#0008_0000;
ELSIF bTemp_C_Healthy THEN
    rVotedCryoTemp_K := rCryoTemp_CoilHotSpot_C_K;
    dwDegradationWord := dwDegradationWord OR 16#0010_0000;
ELSE
    bTemp_Failed_Trip := TRUE;
    dwAlarmWord1 := dwAlarmWord1 OR 16#0000_0400; (* All CERNOX coil sensors failed *)
    iState := 100;
END_IF;

(* --- 2.4 Cryostat Vapor Pressure 2oo3 Voting Bank --- *)
rDev_Press_AB := ABS(rCryostatPressure_A_bar - rCryostatPressure_B_bar);
rDev_Press_BC := ABS(rCryostatPressure_B_bar - rCryostatPressure_C_bar);
rDev_Press_CA := ABS(rCryostatPressure_C_bar - rCryostatPressure_A_bar);

bPress_A_Healthy := (rCryostatPressure_A_bar >= 0.50) AND (rCryostatPressure_A_bar <= 6.00);
bPress_B_Healthy := (rCryostatPressure_B_bar >= 0.50) AND (rCryostatPressure_B_bar <= 6.00);
bPress_C_Healthy := (rCryostatPressure_C_bar >= 0.50) AND (rCryostatPressure_C_bar <= 6.00);

IF bPress_A_Healthy AND bPress_B_Healthy AND bPress_C_Healthy THEN
    bPress_Degraded_1oo2 := FALSE;
    bPress_Failed_Trip := FALSE;
    IF ((rCryostatPressure_A_bar >= rCryostatPressure_B_bar) AND (rCryostatPressure_A_bar <= rCryostatPressure_C_bar)) OR
       ((rCryostatPressure_A_bar >= rCryostatPressure_C_bar) AND (rCryostatPressure_A_bar <= rCryostatPressure_B_bar)) THEN
        rVotedCryoPress_bar := rCryostatPressure_A_bar;
    ELSIF ((rCryostatPressure_B_bar >= rCryostatPressure_A_bar) AND (rCryostatPressure_B_bar <= rCryostatPressure_C_bar)) OR
          ((rCryostatPressure_B_bar >= rCryostatPressure_C_bar) AND (rCryostatPressure_B_bar <= rCryostatPressure_A_bar)) THEN
        rVotedCryoPress_bar := rCryostatPressure_B_bar;
    ELSE
        rVotedCryoPress_bar := rCryostatPressure_C_bar;
    END_IF;
    IF (rDev_Press_AB > 0.25) OR (rDev_Press_BC > 0.25) OR (rDev_Press_CA > 0.25) THEN
        dwDegradationWord := dwDegradationWord OR 16#0020_0000; (* Pressure transmitter mismatch *)
    END_IF;
ELSIF bPress_A_Healthy AND bPress_B_Healthy THEN
    bPress_Degraded_1oo2 := TRUE;
    rVotedCryoPress_bar := MAX(rCryostatPressure_A_bar, rCryostatPressure_B_bar);
    dwDegradationWord := dwDegradationWord OR 16#0040_0000;
ELSIF bPress_B_Healthy AND bPress_C_Healthy THEN
    bPress_Degraded_1oo2 := TRUE;
    rVotedCryoPress_bar := MAX(rCryostatPressure_B_bar, rCryostatPressure_C_bar);
    dwDegradationWord := dwDegradationWord OR 16#0080_0000;
ELSIF bPress_A_Healthy AND bPress_C_Healthy THEN
    bPress_Degraded_1oo2 := TRUE;
    rVotedCryoPress_bar := MAX(rCryostatPressure_A_bar, rCryostatPressure_C_bar);
    dwDegradationWord := dwDegradationWord OR 16#0100_0000;
ELSIF bPress_A_Healthy THEN
    rVotedCryoPress_bar := rCryostatPressure_A_bar;
    dwDegradationWord := dwDegradationWord OR 16#0200_0000;
ELSIF bPress_B_Healthy THEN
    rVotedCryoPress_bar := rCryostatPressure_B_bar;
    dwDegradationWord := dwDegradationWord OR 16#0400_0000;
ELSIF bPress_C_Healthy THEN
    rVotedCryoPress_bar := rCryostatPressure_C_bar;
    dwDegradationWord := dwDegradationWord OR 16#0800_0000;
ELSE
    bPress_Failed_Trip := TRUE;
    dwAlarmWord1 := dwAlarmWord1 OR 16#0000_0800; (* All cryostat pressure transmitters failed *)
    iState := 100;
END_IF;

bDegradedSensorMode := (dwDegradationWord <> 16#0000_0000);

(* ========================================================================================= *)
(* 3.0 QUENCH DETECTION INDUCTIVE BRIDGE COMPENSATION & REBCO CRITICAL PHYSICS              *)
(* ========================================================================================= *)
(* Eliminates mutual and self-inductive voltage L*(dI/dt) from terminal voltage taps to     *)
(* isolate microvolt-level normal zone resistive formation. Computes in-field Jc(B,T).     *)

(* 3.1 Time derivative of coil current *)
rCoilDIdt_kAs := (rCoilCurrentVoted_kA - rPrevCoilCurrent_kA) / c_ScanCycleTime_sec;
rPrevCoilCurrent_kA := rCoilCurrentVoted_kA;

(* 3.2 Synthetic inductive drop calculation: V_ind = L * dI/dt [kV] *)
rSyntheticInductiveVolt_kV := c_CoilSelfInductance_H * rCoilDIdt_kAs;

(* 3.3 Inductive bridge compensated residual voltage in millivolts *)
rBridgeResidual_mV := (rCoilTerminalVolt_kV - rSyntheticInductiveVolt_kV) * 1000.0;
rFilteredResidual_mV := (rFilteredResidual_mV * 0.850) + (rBridgeResidual_mV * 0.150);
rQuenchInductiveCompVolt_mV := rFilteredResidual_mV;

(* 3.4 In-field critical current calculation (Bean Model / Kim-Anderson approximation) *)
(* B_peak = k_field * I_coil; Ic(B, T) degrades monotonically with field and temp *)
rPeakMagneticField_T := c_FieldConstant_T_per_kA * rCoilCurrentVoted_kA;
IF rVotedCryoTemp_K < c_RebcoCriticalTemp_K THEN
    (* Empirical scaling: Ic(T,B) = Ic0 * (1 - T/Tc)^1.5 / (1 + B / 2.5) *)
    rRebcoTapeCriticalCurrent_A := c_RebcoSelfFieldIc0_A *
        ((c_RebcoCriticalTemp_K - rVotedCryoTemp_K) / (c_RebcoCriticalTemp_K - 20.0)) *
        (1.0 / (1.0 + (rPeakMagneticField_T * 0.40)));
ELSE
    rRebcoTapeCriticalCurrent_A := 0.0;
END_IF;

(* 3.5 Operating Current Safety Margin relative to tape critical current *)
IF rRebcoTapeCriticalCurrent_A > 10.0 THEN
    rCriticalCurrentMargin_pct := (1.0 - ((rCoilCurrentVoted_kA * 1000.0) / (rRebcoTapeCriticalCurrent_A * 4.0))) * 100.0;
ELSE
    rCriticalCurrentMargin_pct := 0.0;
END_IF;

(* 3.6 AC Loss Dissipation Estimation (Norris / Bean elliptical tape formula) *)
IF rCoilCurrentVoted_kA > 0.05 THEN
    rEstimatedAcLosses_kW := 0.0005 * ABS(rCoilDIdt_kAs) * (rCoilCurrentVoted_kA * rCoilCurrentVoted_kA) * rPeakMagneticField_T;
ELSE
    rEstimatedAcLosses_kW := 0.002; (* Quiescent joint loss *)
END_IF;

(* 3.7 Real-time Stored Magnetic Energy: E = 0.5 * L * I^2 [MJ] *)
rStoredEnergy_MJ := 0.50 * c_CoilSelfInductance_H * (rCoilCurrentVoted_kA * rCoilCurrentVoted_kA);

(* ========================================================================================= *)
(* 4.0 SUB-CYCLE (5ms) RoCoF & FOUR-QUADRANT P-Q FAST SYNCHRONOUS INJECTION                 *)
(* ========================================================================================= *)
(* Provides synthetic virtual inertia: P_inert = -2*H*(S_base/f_nom)*df/dt                   *)
(* Provides fast primary frequency response: P_droop = -Kp*(f - f_nom)                       *)
(* Provides dynamic voltage support: Q_droop = -Kq*(V - V_nom)                              *)

(* 4.1 High-speed discrete frequency derivative calculation (df/dt) *)
rFreqDerivativeRaw_Hzs := (rVotedGridFreq_Hz - rPrevGridFreq_Hz) / c_ScanCycleTime_sec;
rPrevGridFreq_Hz := rVotedGridFreq_Hz;

(* 4.2 Single-pole IIR anti-aliasing smoothing filter for RoCoF *)
rRoCoFFilterBuffer := (rRoCoFFilterBuffer * (1.0 - rRoCoFFilterCoeff)) + (rFreqDerivativeRaw_Hzs * rRoCoFFilterCoeff);
rGridRoCoF_Hzs := rRoCoFFilterBuffer;

rFreqDeviation_Hz := rVotedGridFreq_Hz - rNominalGridFreq_Hz;
rVotedGridVolt_kV := rGridVoltage_RMS_kV;
rVoltDeviation_kV := rVotedGridVolt_kV - rNominalGridVolt_kV;

(* 4.3 Synthetic Inertia Injection Demand [MW] *)
IF bSyntheticInertiaEnable AND (ABS(rGridRoCoF_Hzs) > 0.020) THEN
    (* P = -2 * H * S_base / f_nom * (df/dt) *)
    rInertiaPowerDemand_MW := -2.0 * rVirtualInertiaGain_H * (rApparentPowerLimit_MVA / rNominalGridFreq_Hz) * rGridRoCoF_Hzs;
ELSE
    rInertiaPowerDemand_MW := 0.0;
END_IF;

(* 4.4 Primary Frequency Droop Power Demand [MW] *)
IF bPrimaryFreqCtrlEnable AND (ABS(rFreqDeviation_Hz) > 0.015) THEN
    (* Deadband of 15 mHz applied *)
    rDroopPowerDemand_MW := -rFrequencyDroopGain_Kp * rFreqDeviation_Hz;
ELSE
    rDroopPowerDemand_MW := 0.0;
END_IF;

(* 4.5 Dynamic Reactive Power Voltage Support Demand [Mvar] *)
IF bVoltageSupportEnable AND (ABS(rVoltDeviation_kV) > 0.150) THEN
    (* Deadband of 150 V RMS line applied *)
    rVoltageSupportDemand_Mvar := -rVoltageDroopGain_Kq * rVoltDeviation_kV;
ELSE
    rVoltageSupportDemand_Mvar := 0.0;
END_IF;

(* 4.6 Four-Quadrant Apparent Power Envelope Limiter (Circular MVA Boundary) *)
rTotalActiveDemandRaw_MW := rInertiaPowerDemand_MW + rDroopPowerDemand_MW;

(* Clamp Reactive Power to MVA rating first if prioritized, or balance *)
rTotalReactiveDemandClamped_Mvar := LIMIT(-22.0, rVoltageSupportDemand_Mvar, 22.0);
rMaxPAllowed := SQRT(MAX(0.01, (rApparentPowerLimit_MVA * rApparentPowerLimit_MVA) - (rTotalReactiveDemandClamped_Mvar * rTotalReactiveDemandClamped_Mvar)));

(* Clamp Active Power within permissible inverter boundary & coil charge/discharge limits *)
IF rTotalActiveDemandRaw_MW >= 0.0 THEN
    (* Discharging SMES into grid *)
    rTotalActiveDemandClamped_MW := MIN(rTotalActiveDemandRaw_MW, MIN(rMaxPAllowed, rMaxDischargePower_MW));
    (* Ensure sufficient energy stored to discharge *)
    IF rStoredEnergy_MJ < 2.50 THEN
        rTotalActiveDemandClamped_MW := rTotalActiveDemandClamped_MW * (rStoredEnergy_MJ / 2.50);
    END_IF;
ELSE
    (* Charging SMES from grid *)
    rTotalActiveDemandClamped_MW := MAX(rTotalActiveDemandRaw_MW, MAX(-rMaxPAllowed, -rMaxChargePower_MW));
    (* Prevent overcharging coil beyond 50 MJ *)
    IF rStoredEnergy_MJ > 50.50 THEN
        rTotalActiveDemandClamped_MW := 0.0;
    END_IF;
END_IF;

rActivePowerDemand_MW := rTotalActiveDemandClamped_MW;
rReactivePowerDemand_Mvar := rTotalReactiveDemandClamped_Mvar;

bFrequencySupportActive := (ABS(rActivePowerDemand_MW) > 0.10);
bVoltageSupportActive := (ABS(rReactivePowerDemand_Mvar) > 0.10);

(* ========================================================================================= *)
(* 5.0 LORENTZ HOOP STRESS & OPTICAL FIBER BRAGG GRATING (FBG) EVALUATION                   *)
(* ========================================================================================= *)
(* Translates FBG microstrain telemetry to hoop stress in Hastelloy C-276 substrate.        *)
(* Monitors strain rate of change d_epsilon/dt for mechanical slip / tape delamination.    *)

(* 5.1 Analytical Lorentz magnetic pressure: P_mag = B^2 / (2 * mu_0) [MPa] *)
(* mu_0 = 4*pi*1e-7 H/m. P_mag = (B^2 / (2 * 1.2566e-6)) * 1e-6 = B^2 / 2.5133 *)
rMagneticPressure_MPa := (rPeakMagneticField_T * rPeakMagneticField_T) / 2.513274;

(* 5.2 Hoop Stress in Hastelloy substrate: sigma = E * epsilon *)
(* E = 210 GPa = 210,000 MPa. epsilon in microstrain = strain * 1e-6 *)
rFBG_MeasuredStress_MPa := (c_HastelloyModulus_GPa * 1000.0) * (rMaxVotedStrain_ustrain * 0.000001);
rLorentzHoopStress_MPa := rFBG_MeasuredStress_MPa;

(* 5.3 Dynamic strain rate of change *)
rStrainRateOfChange_ustrains := (rMaxVotedStrain_ustrain - rPrevMaxStrain_ustrain) / c_ScanCycleTime_sec;
rPrevMaxStrain_ustrain := rMaxVotedStrain_ustrain;

(* Sudden micro-slip stick warning if strain rate exceeds 850 ustrain/s *)
bStrainRateWarning := (ABS(rStrainRateOfChange_ustrains) > 850.0);
bHoopStressWarning := (rMaxVotedStrain_ustrain > rMaxAllowableStrain_ustrain * 0.88);

(* ========================================================================================= *)
(* 6.0 LIQUID NEON / HELIUM CLOSED THERMO-SIPHON CRYOGENIC GOVERNOR                         *)
(* ========================================================================================= *)
(* Regulates cryostat vapor dome pressure (nominal 2.10 bar) and natural circulation head.  *)
(* Modulates cryogenic neon bypass / re-condensation expansion throttle valve via PID.     *)

(* 6.1 Cryostat vapor dome pressure error *)
rCryoPressureError_bar := rVotedCryoPress_bar - rTargetCryoPressure_bar;

(* 6.2 Anti-windup PID regulator for thermo-siphon expansion valve *)
rCryoPressurePidIntegral := rCryoPressurePidIntegral + (rCryoPressureError_bar * c_ScanCycleTime_sec);
rCryoPressurePidIntegral := LIMIT(-20.0, rCryoPressurePidIntegral, 20.0);

rCryoPressurePidDerivative := (rCryoPressureError_bar - rPrevCryoPressureError_bar) / c_ScanCycleTime_sec;
rPrevCryoPressureError_bar := rCryoPressureError_bar;

rCryoValveRawDemand_pct := 35.0 + (rCryoPidKp * rCryoPressureError_bar) +
                           (rCryoPidKi * rCryoPressurePidIntegral) +
                           (rCryoPidKd * rCryoPressurePidDerivative);

rThermoSiphonValveDemand_pct := LIMIT(5.0, rCryoValveRawDemand_pct, 100.0);

(* 6.3 Thermosiphon natural circulation driving head estimation *)
(* Delta_P = (rho_liq - rho_vap) * g * H_riser. H_riser = 2.45 m *)
rThermalHeadBuoyancy_bar := ((c_NeonLiquidDensity_kgm3 - c_NeonVaporDensity_kgm3) * 9.80665 * 2.45) * 0.00001;
rThermoSiphonMassFlow_kgs := SQRT(MAX(0.001, rThermalHeadBuoyancy_bar)) * 0.450;

bCryoStabilityWarning := (rVotedCryoTemp_K > 22.50) OR (rVotedCryoPress_bar > 2.80);

(* ========================================================================================= *)
(* 7.0 8-STATE MULTIVARIABLE DISCRETE STATE-SPACE MODEL PREDICTIVE CONTROL (MPC)            *)
(* ========================================================================================= *)
(* Formulates an 8-state, 4-input state-space plant model. Solves real-time quadratic cost: *)
(* J = 0.5*(x-xref)^T * Q * (x-xref) + 0.5*u^T * R * u via projected gradient descent.      *)

IF NOT bMatricesInitialized THEN
    (* 7.1 Diagonal Initialization of Discrete Transition Matrix A (8x8) *)
    FOR iRow := 1 TO 8 DO
        FOR iCol := 1 TO 8 DO
            IF iRow = iCol THEN
                A_mat[iRow, iCol] := 0.9985;
            ELSE
                A_mat[iRow, iCol] := 0.0000;
            END_IF;
        END_FOR;
    END_FOR;
    (* Physical state couplings in A *)
    A_mat[1, 5] := -0.0025; (* Current decreases when active power is discharged *)
    A_mat[2, 1] :=  0.0012; (* Temperature rises with higher current joint dissipation *)
    A_mat[3, 5] := -0.0040; (* DC link drops during rapid power export *)
    A_mat[4, 5] :=  0.0065; (* Grid frequency rises with positive power injection *)
    A_mat[6, 2] :=  0.0080; (* Cryostat pressure rises as coil hot-spot heats neon *)
    A_mat[7, 1] :=  0.0045; (* Hoop strain increases quadratically with current *)

    (* 7.2 Input Coupling Matrix B (8x4) *)
    FOR iRow := 1 TO 8 DO
        FOR iCol := 1 TO 4 DO
            B_mat[iRow, iCol] := 0.0000;
        END_FOR;
    END_FOR;
    B_mat[1, 1] :=  0.0850; (* u[1] Chopper duty directly drives coil dI/dt *)
    B_mat[3, 1] :=  0.1200; (* u[1] Chopper duty charges DC bus *)
    B_mat[5, 2] :=  0.2500; (* u[2] Inverter active current drives active power *)
    B_mat[8, 3] :=  0.2500; (* u[3] Inverter reactive current drives reactive power *)
    B_mat[6, 4] := -0.0650; (* u[4] Cryo valve relieves vapor pressure *)

    (* 7.3 Diagonal State Penalty Q Weights *)
    Q_diag[1] := 1.50;  (* I_coil error weight *)
    Q_diag[2] := 8.00;  (* T_hot thermal error weight *)
    Q_diag[3] := 2.50;  (* V_dc bus error weight *)
    Q_diag[4] := 12.00; (* Delta_f grid frequency synchronization weight *)
    Q_diag[5] := 5.00;  (* P_grid tracking weight *)
    Q_diag[6] := 4.00;  (* P_cryo pressure regulation weight *)
    Q_diag[7] := 10.00; (* Hoop strain suppression weight *)
    Q_diag[8] := 3.50;  (* Q_grid reactive support weight *)

    (* 7.4 Diagonal Actuator Effort Penalty R Weights *)
    R_diag[1] := 0.80;  (* Chopper duty rate penalty *)
    R_diag[2] := 0.50;  (* Inverter active current rate penalty *)
    R_diag[3] := 0.50;  (* Inverter reactive current rate penalty *)
    R_diag[4] := 0.30;  (* Valve actuation penalty *)

    (* 7.5 Hessian Diagonal Approximation: H_jj = sum(B_ij^2 * Q_i) + R_j *)
    FOR iCol := 1 TO 4 DO
        rTempSum := 0.0;
        FOR iRow := 1 TO 8 DO
            rTempSum := rTempSum + (B_mat[iRow, iCol] * B_mat[iRow, iCol] * Q_diag[iRow]);
        END_FOR;
        H_diag[iCol] := rTempSum + R_diag[iCol];
        IF H_diag[iCol] < 0.001 THEN
            H_diag[iCol] := 0.001;
        END_IF;
    END_FOR;

    bMatricesInitialized := TRUE;
END_IF;

(* 7.6 Update State Vector from Telemetry *)
x_state[1] := rCoilCurrentVoted_kA;
x_state[2] := rVotedCryoTemp_K;
x_state[3] := rDcBusVoltage_kV;
x_state[4] := rFreqDeviation_Hz;
x_state[5] := rGridActivePower_MW;
x_state[6] := rVotedCryoPress_bar;
x_state[7] := rMaxVotedStrain_ustrain;
x_state[8] := rGridReactivePower_Mvar;

(* 7.7 Target Reference State Vector *)
x_ref[1] := c_NominalCoilCurrent_kA;
x_ref[2] := 20.00;
x_ref[3] := 3.300;
x_ref[4] := 0.000;
x_ref[5] := rActivePowerDemand_MW;
x_ref[6] := rTargetCryoPressure_bar;
x_ref[7] := 2400.0;
x_ref[8] := rReactivePowerDemand_Mvar;

(* Tracking Error Calculation *)
FOR iRow := 1 TO 8 DO
    x_err[iRow] := x_state[iRow] - x_ref[iRow];
END_FOR;

(* 7.8 Real-Time Optimization Execution *)
IF bMpcOptimizerEnable AND (iState = 50) THEN
    bMpcInOptimization := TRUE;
    (* Active-set gradient computation: grad_J = B^T * Q * x_err + R * u *)
    FOR iCol := 1 TO 4 DO
        rTempSum := 0.0;
        FOR iRow := 1 TO 8 DO
            rTempSum := rTempSum + (B_mat[iRow, iCol] * Q_diag[iRow] * x_err[iRow]);
        END_FOR;
        grad_J[iCol] := rTempSum + (R_diag[iCol] * u_mpc[iCol]);
        (* Projected Newton-Raphson update: Delta_u = -grad_J / H_diag *)
        u_delta[iCol] := -(grad_J[iCol] / H_diag[iCol]) * rStepSize;
        u_mpc[iCol] := u_mpc[iCol] + u_delta[iCol];
    END_FOR;
    (* Constrain MPC inputs to physical bounds *)
    u_mpc[1] := LIMIT(-0.45, u_mpc[1], 0.45);   (* Chopper duty offset Delta_D *)
    u_mpc[2] := LIMIT(-4.50, u_mpc[2], 4.50);   (* Inverter d-current [kA] *)
    u_mpc[3] := LIMIT(-4.50, u_mpc[3], 4.50);   (* Inverter q-current [kA] *)
    u_mpc[4] := LIMIT(5.0,   u_mpc[4], 100.0);  (* Valve demand [%] *)
ELSE
    bMpcInOptimization := FALSE;
    u_mpc[1] := 0.0;
    u_mpc[2] := 0.0;
    u_mpc[3] := 0.0;
    u_mpc[4] := rThermoSiphonValveDemand_pct;
END_IF;

(* ========================================================================================= *)
(* 8.0 BIDIRECTIONAL THYRISTOR CHOPPER & PCU MODULATION GOVERNOR                           *)
(* ========================================================================================= *)
(* Controls the H-bridge bidirectional chopper duty cycle and the PWM VSI d-q modulation.  *)
(* Duty cycle D = 0.50 maintains persistent current (V_L = 0).                              *)
(* D > 0.50 charges coil from DC link; D < 0.50 discharges coil into DC link.               *)

IF (iState = 50) OR (iState = 60) THEN
    (* 8.1 Active power demand conversion to coil voltage: P = -V_L * I_coil *)
    (* V_L = -P_active / I_coil. If P_active > 0 (discharge), V_L < 0. *)
    IF rCoilCurrentVoted_kA > 0.10 THEN
        rChopperDemandedVoltage_kV := -(rActivePowerDemand_MW / rCoilCurrentVoted_kA);
    ELSE
        rChopperDemandedVoltage_kV := 0.0;
    END_IF;
    (* Chopper voltage relation: V_L = V_dc * (2*D - 1) => D = 0.5 + 0.5 * (V_L / V_dc) *)
    IF rDcBusVoltage_kV > 1.00 THEN
        rChopperDutyRaw := rNominalDutyBias + (0.50 * (rChopperDemandedVoltage_kV / rDcBusVoltage_kV)) + u_mpc[1];
    ELSE
        rChopperDutyRaw := 0.500;
    END_IF;
    rThyristorDutyCycle := LIMIT(0.050, rChopperDutyRaw, 0.950);

    (* 8.2 VSI Active & Reactive Modulation Indices (d-q frame) *)
    (* m_d governs active power export, m_q governs reactive power support *)
    rInverterModIndex_d := LIMIT(-rVsiModulationIndexMax, (rActivePowerDemand_MW / 25.0) + (u_mpc[2] * 0.10), rVsiModulationIndexMax);
    rInverterModIndex_q := LIMIT(-rVsiModulationIndexMax, (rReactivePowerDemand_Mvar / 25.0) + (u_mpc[3] * 0.10), rVsiModulationIndexMax);
    rDumpResistorContactor := FALSE;
ELSIF (iState = 40) THEN
    (* Persistent Mode: Freewheeling at D = 0.50, zero net power exchange *)
    rThyristorDutyCycle := 0.500;
    rInverterModIndex_d := 0.000;
    rInverterModIndex_q := 0.000;
    rDumpResistorContactor := FALSE;
ELSIF (iState = 90) THEN
    (* Controlled Fast Ramp Discharge *)
    rThyristorDutyCycle := 0.200; (* Strong discharge into DC bus *)
    rInverterModIndex_d := 0.850; (* Exporting all power to substation *)
    rInverterModIndex_q := 0.000;
    rDumpResistorContactor := FALSE;
ELSIF (iState = 100) THEN
    (* Emergency Quench / Pyro-Breaker Dump *)
    rThyristorDutyCycle := 0.000;
    rInverterModIndex_d := 0.000;
    rInverterModIndex_q := 0.000;
    rDumpResistorContactor := TRUE; (* Contactor engaged across dump resistor *)
ELSE
    rThyristorDutyCycle := 0.500;
    rInverterModIndex_d := 0.000;
    rInverterModIndex_q := 0.000;
    rDumpResistorContactor := FALSE;
END_IF;

(* ========================================================================================= *)
(* 9.0 SUPERVISORY MULTI-STAGE FINITE STATE MACHINE (FSM)                                   *)
(* ========================================================================================= *)
(* 11-Stage Deterministic State Machine governing cooldown, pre-charge, persistent standby, *)
(* sub-cycle 4-quadrant grid sync, fault ride-through, and emergency quench extraction.     *)

CASE iState OF
    0: (* STATE 0: UNINITIALIZED / COLD SHUTDOWN *)
        bSystemReady := FALSE;
        bSystemRunning := FALSE;
        bPersistentModeActive := FALSE;
        bFastDischargeActive := FALSE;
        bPyroBreakerFired := FALSE;
        rDumpResistorContactor := FALSE;
        IF bEnableSystem AND bEmergencyStop AND bCryoCoolerRunning THEN
            iState := 10; (* Proceed to Cryogenic Cooldown *)
        END_IF;

    10: (* STATE 10: CRYOGENIC COOLDOWN & LIQUID NEON CONDENSATION *)
        bSystemReady := FALSE;
        bSystemRunning := FALSE;
        rThermoSiphonValveDemand_pct := 100.0; (* Full bypass cooldown flow *)
        (* Cooldown progression: check when hot-spot drops below 22.0 K and level reaches 90% *)
        IF (rVotedCryoTemp_K <= 22.00) AND (rCryoLiquidLevel_pct >= 85.0) THEN
            tStateTimer(IN := TRUE, PT := T#30S);
            IF tStateTimer.Q THEN
                tStateTimer(IN := FALSE, PT := T#30S);
                iState := 20; (* Proceed to Thermo-Siphon Equilibrium *)
            END_IF;
        ELSE
            tStateTimer(IN := FALSE, PT := T#30S);
        END_IF;

    20: (* STATE 20: THERMO-SIPHON EQUILIBRIUM & VACUUM STABILITY *)
        bSystemReady := FALSE;
        (* Check cryostat pressure stable between 1.8 and 2.4 bar abs *)
        IF (rVotedCryoPress_bar >= 1.80) AND (rVotedCryoPress_bar <= 2.40) AND (rVotedCryoTemp_K <= 20.50) THEN
            bSystemReady := TRUE;
            IF bGridSyncPermissive AND bQuenchDetectPermissive THEN
                iState := 30; (* Proceed to Coil Pre-Charge *)
            END_IF;
        ELSE
            bSystemReady := FALSE;
        END_IF;

    30: (* STATE 30: PRE-CHARGE & REBCO CRITICAL CURRENT IC MAPPING *)
        bSystemReady := TRUE;
        bSystemRunning := TRUE;
        bPersistentModeActive := FALSE;
        (* Ramp coil current up to rated 5.0 kA from substation via DC link *)
        IF rCoilCurrentVoted_kA < (c_NominalCoilCurrent_kA - 0.050) THEN
            rThyristorDutyCycle := 0.550; (* Moderate charging duty *)
            rInverterModIndex_d := -0.350; (* Drawing power from grid to charge *)
        ELSE
            rThyristorDutyCycle := 0.500;
            rInverterModIndex_d := 0.000;
            iState := 40; (* Proceed to Standby Persistent Mode *)
        END_IF;

    40: (* STATE 40: STANDBY PERSISTENT FREELING MODE (50 MJ STORED) *)
        bSystemReady := TRUE;
        bSystemRunning := TRUE;
        bPersistentModeActive := TRUE;
        bFastDischargeActive := FALSE;
        (* Ready to inject power instantly when frequency or voltage deviates *)
        IF (ABS(rFreqDeviation_Hz) > 0.025) OR (ABS(rGridRoCoF_Hzs) > 0.050) OR (ABS(rVoltDeviation_kV) > 0.300) THEN
            iState := 50; (* Engage Sub-Cycle Fast Regulation *)
        ELSIF bFastDischargeCmd THEN
            iState := 90; (* Commenced Controlled Fast Discharge *)
        END_IF;

    50: (* STATE 50: ACTIVE SUB-CYCLE FREQUENCY REGULATION & 4-QUADRANT INERTIA *)
        bSystemReady := TRUE;
        bSystemRunning := TRUE;
        bPersistentModeActive := FALSE;
        (* Severe transient detection: transfer to FRT state if frequency or voltage drops catastrophically *)
        IF (ABS(rVoltDeviation_kV) > 3.50) OR (ABS(rGridRoCoF_Hzs) > 1.20) THEN
            iState := 60; (* Transfer to Fault Ride-Through *)
        (* Return to persistent standby if grid returns to deadband for > 3.0 seconds *)
        ELSIF (ABS(rFreqDeviation_Hz) <= 0.012) AND (ABS(rGridRoCoF_Hzs) <= 0.015) AND (ABS(rVoltDeviation_kV) <= 0.100) THEN
            tStateTimer(IN := TRUE, PT := T#3S);
            IF tStateTimer.Q THEN
                tStateTimer(IN := FALSE, PT := T#3S);
                iState := 40; (* Return to Persistent Standby *)
            END_IF;
        ELSE
            tStateTimer(IN := FALSE, PT := T#3S);
        END_IF;

    60: (* STATE 60: SEVERE GRID TRANSIENT / FAULT RIDE-THROUGH (FRT) *)
        bSystemReady := TRUE;
        bSystemRunning := TRUE;
        (* Maximize reactive current for grid voltage support up to 100% inverter rating *)
        rReactivePowerDemand_Mvar := -25.0;
        IF ABS(rVoltDeviation_kV) <= 0.80 THEN
            tStateTimer(IN := TRUE, PT := T#1S);
            IF tStateTimer.Q THEN
                tStateTimer(IN := FALSE, PT := T#1S);
                iState := 50; (* Return to Standard 4-Quadrant Regulation *)
            END_IF;
        ELSE
            tStateTimer(IN := FALSE, PT := T#1S);
        END_IF;

    70: (* STATE 70: CONTROLLED RAMP-DOWN / POWER RETRIEVAL *)
        bSystemReady := FALSE;
        bSystemRunning := TRUE;
        rThyristorDutyCycle := 0.350;
        rInverterModIndex_d := 0.500;
        IF rCoilCurrentVoted_kA <= 0.10 THEN
            iState := 0; (* Returned to Cold Off *)
        END_IF;

    80: (* STATE 80: CRYOGENIC THERMAL RECOVERY & BOIL-OFF RELIQUEFACTION *)
        bSystemReady := FALSE;
        bSystemRunning := TRUE;
        bPersistentModeActive := TRUE;
        rThyristorDutyCycle := 0.500;
        rInverterModIndex_d := 0.000;
        rInverterModIndex_q := 0.000;
        rThermoSiphonValveDemand_pct := 80.0;
        IF (rVotedCryoTemp_K <= 20.20) AND (rVotedCryoPress_bar <= 2.15) THEN
            iState := 40; (* Thermal recovery complete *)
        END_IF;

    90: (* STATE 90: CONTROLLED FAST RAMP DISCHARGE (DE-ENERGIZATION) *)
        bSystemReady := FALSE;
        bSystemRunning := TRUE;
        bFastDischargeActive := TRUE;
        rThyristorDutyCycle := 0.150; (* Extracting maximum energy safely *)
        rInverterModIndex_d := 0.900; (* Injecting to grid *)
        IF rCoilCurrentVoted_kA <= 0.080 THEN
            bFastDischargeActive := FALSE;
            iState := 0;
        END_IF;

    100: (* STATE 100: EMERGENCY QUENCH / FAST EXTRACTION & PYRO-BREAKER FIRING *)
        bSystemReady := FALSE;
        bSystemRunning := FALSE;
        bSystemTripped := TRUE;
        bPyroBreakerFired := TRUE; (* Open mechanical/explosive pyro-breakers *)
        rDumpResistorContactor := TRUE; (* Close dump loop across 0.20 Ohm resistor *)
        rThyristorDutyCycle := 0.000; (* Inhibit all chopper thyristor gating *)
        rInverterModIndex_d := 0.000;
        rInverterModIndex_q := 0.000;

(* ========================================================================================= *)
(* =================================== MAIN LOGIC EXECUTION ================================ *)
(* ========================================================================================= *)

(* ========================================================================================= *)
(* 1.0 EMERGENCY SAFETY SHUTDOWN & SIL-3 HARDWIRED INTERLOCK EVALUATION                      *)
(* ========================================================================================= *)
IF NOT bEmergencyStop THEN
    bSystemTripped := TRUE;
    bSystemRunning := FALSE;
    bSystemReady := FALSE;
    bPathTrackingActive := FALSE;
    bAntiRolloverActive := FALSE;
    bTireSlipMitigationActive := FALSE;
    
    (* Latch Critical SIL-3 Emergency Stop Trip in Alarm Word 1 *)
    dwAlarmWord1 := dwAlarmWord1 OR 16#0000_0001; (* Bit 0: Hardware SIL-3 Hardwired E-Stop Broken *)
    
    (* Force immediate fail-safe drive motor torque inhibit *)
    rDriveTorqueCmd_FL_Nm := 0.0;
    rDriveTorqueCmd_FR_Nm := 0.0;
    rDriveTorqueCmd_RL_Nm := 0.0;
    rDriveTorqueCmd_RR_Nm := 0.0;
    
    (* Clamp electro-hydraulic fail-safe emergency spring-applied parking/service brakes *)
    rHydraulicBrakeCmd_FL_bar := rMaxServiceBrakePress_bar;
    rHydraulicBrakeCmd_FR_bar := rMaxServiceBrakePress_bar;
    rHydraulicBrakeCmd_RL_bar := rMaxServiceBrakePress_bar;
    rHydraulicBrakeCmd_RR_bar := rMaxServiceBrakePress_bar;
    rMasterBrakePressureCmd_bar := rMaxServiceBrakePress_bar;
    
    (* Transition directly to safe lockout state *)
    iState := 100;
    RETURN;
END_IF;

(* Reset Latching Alarms when requested by Supervisory Control and permissive is clear *)
IF bResetFaults THEN
    IF bEmergencyStop AND bInverterReady_FL AND bInverterReady_FR AND bInverterReady_RL AND bInverterReady_RR THEN
        dwAlarmWord1 := 16#0000_0000;
        dwAlarmWord2 := 16#0000_0000;
        dwWarningWord := 16#0000_0000;
        bSystemTripped := FALSE;
    END_IF;
END_IF;

(* ========================================================================================= *)
(* 2.0 TRIPLE MODULAR REDUNDANCY (2oo3) SENSOR VOTING ALGORITHMS                             *)
(* ========================================================================================= *)
dwDegradationWord := 16#0000_0000;

(* --- 2.1 Front Magnetic Antenna 2oo3 Lateral Deviation Voting --- *)
rDev_MagY_Front_AB := ABS(rMagDevY_Front_A_mm - rMagDevY_Front_B_mm);
rDev_MagY_Front_BC := ABS(rMagDevY_Front_B_mm - rMagDevY_Front_C_mm);
rDev_MagY_Front_CA := ABS(rMagDevY_Front_C_mm - rMagDevY_Front_A_mm);

bMagFront_A_Healthy := (ABS(rMagDevY_Front_A_mm) <= 500.0);
bMagFront_B_Healthy := (ABS(rMagDevY_Front_B_mm) <= 500.0);
bMagFront_C_Healthy := (ABS(rMagDevY_Front_C_mm) <= 500.0);

IF bMagFront_A_Healthy AND bMagFront_B_Healthy AND bMagFront_C_Healthy THEN
    (* Standard 2oo3 Median Selection *)
    IF ((rMagDevY_Front_A_mm >= rMagDevY_Front_B_mm) AND (rMagDevY_Front_A_mm <= rMagDevY_Front_C_mm)) OR
       ((rMagDevY_Front_A_mm >= rMagDevY_Front_C_mm) AND (rMagDevY_Front_A_mm <= rMagDevY_Front_B_mm)) THEN
        rVotedMagDevY_Front_mm := rMagDevY_Front_A_mm;
        rVotedMagDevX_Front_mm := rMagDevX_Front_A_mm;
    ELSIF ((rMagDevY_Front_B_mm >= rMagDevY_Front_A_mm) AND (rMagDevY_Front_B_mm <= rMagDevY_Front_C_mm)) OR
          ((rMagDevY_Front_B_mm >= rMagDevY_Front_C_mm) AND (rMagDevY_Front_B_mm <= rMagDevY_Front_A_mm)) THEN
        rVotedMagDevY_Front_mm := rMagDevY_Front_B_mm;
        rVotedMagDevX_Front_mm := rMagDevX_Front_B_mm;
    ELSE
        rVotedMagDevY_Front_mm := rMagDevY_Front_C_mm;
        rVotedMagDevX_Front_mm := rMagDevX_Front_C_mm;
    END_IF;
    bVotedMagPeg_Front := (bMagPegDetected_Front_A AND bMagPegDetected_Front_B) OR
                          (bMagPegDetected_Front_B AND bMagPegDetected_Front_C) OR
                          (bMagPegDetected_Front_C AND bMagPegDetected_Front_A);
    (* Discrepancy Alert Threshold (35 mm) *)
    IF (rDev_MagY_Front_AB > 35.0) OR (rDev_MagY_Front_BC > 35.0) OR (rDev_MagY_Front_CA > 35.0) THEN
        dwDegradationWord := dwDegradationWord OR 16#0000_0001; (* Front Mag Antenna channel deviation *)
    END_IF;
ELSIF bMagFront_A_Healthy AND bMagFront_B_Healthy THEN
    rVotedMagDevY_Front_mm := (rMagDevY_Front_A_mm + rMagDevY_Front_B_mm) * 0.5;
    rVotedMagDevX_Front_mm := (rMagDevX_Front_A_mm + rMagDevX_Front_B_mm) * 0.5;
    bVotedMagPeg_Front := bMagPegDetected_Front_A OR bMagPegDetected_Front_B;
    dwDegradationWord := dwDegradationWord OR 16#0000_0002; (* Front Mag degraded to 1oo2 (C failed) *)
ELSIF bMagFront_B_Healthy AND bMagFront_C_Healthy THEN
    rVotedMagDevY_Front_mm := (rMagDevY_Front_B_mm + rMagDevY_Front_C_mm) * 0.5;
    rVotedMagDevX_Front_mm := (rMagDevX_Front_B_mm + rMagDevX_Front_C_mm) * 0.5;
    bVotedMagPeg_Front := bMagPegDetected_Front_B OR bMagPegDetected_Front_C;
    dwDegradationWord := dwDegradationWord OR 16#0000_0004; (* Front Mag degraded to 1oo2 (A failed) *)
ELSIF bMagFront_A_Healthy AND bMagFront_C_Healthy THEN
    rVotedMagDevY_Front_mm := (rMagDevY_Front_A_mm + rMagDevY_Front_C_mm) * 0.5;
    rVotedMagDevX_Front_mm := (rMagDevX_Front_A_mm + rMagDevX_Front_C_mm) * 0.5;
    bVotedMagPeg_Front := bMagPegDetected_Front_A OR bMagPegDetected_Front_C;
    dwDegradationWord := dwDegradationWord OR 16#0000_0008; (* Front Mag degraded to 1oo2 (B failed) *)
ELSE
    rVotedMagDevY_Front_mm := 0.0;
    rVotedMagDevX_Front_mm := 0.0;
    bVotedMagPeg_Front := FALSE;
    dwDegradationWord := dwDegradationWord OR 16#0000_0010; (* Front Mag failed completely *)
    dwAlarmWord1 := dwAlarmWord1 OR 16#0000_0004; (* Total front navigation sensor loss *)
END_IF;

(* --- 2.2 Rear Magnetic Antenna 2oo3 Lateral Deviation Voting --- *)
rDev_MagY_Rear_AB := ABS(rMagDevY_Rear_A_mm - rMagDevY_Rear_B_mm);
rDev_MagY_Rear_BC := ABS(rMagDevY_Rear_B_mm - rMagDevY_Rear_C_mm);
rDev_MagY_Rear_CA := ABS(rMagDevY_Rear_C_mm - rMagDevY_Rear_A_mm);

bMagRear_A_Healthy := (ABS(rMagDevY_Rear_A_mm) <= 500.0);
bMagRear_B_Healthy := (ABS(rMagDevY_Rear_B_mm) <= 500.0);
bMagRear_C_Healthy := (ABS(rMagDevY_Rear_C_mm) <= 500.0);

IF bMagRear_A_Healthy AND bMagRear_B_Healthy AND bMagRear_C_Healthy THEN
    IF ((rMagDevY_Rear_A_mm >= rMagDevY_Rear_B_mm) AND (rMagDevY_Rear_A_mm <= rMagDevY_Rear_C_mm)) OR
       ((rMagDevY_Rear_A_mm >= rMagDevY_Rear_C_mm) AND (rMagDevY_Rear_A_mm <= rMagDevY_Rear_B_mm)) THEN
        rVotedMagDevY_Rear_mm := rMagDevY_Rear_A_mm;
        rVotedMagDevX_Rear_mm := rMagDevX_Rear_A_mm;
    ELSIF ((rMagDevY_Rear_B_mm >= rMagDevY_Rear_A_mm) AND (rMagDevY_Rear_B_mm <= rMagDevY_Rear_C_mm)) OR
          ((rMagDevY_Rear_B_mm >= rMagDevY_Rear_C_mm) AND (rMagDevY_Rear_B_mm <= rMagDevY_Rear_A_mm)) THEN
        rVotedMagDevY_Rear_mm := rMagDevY_Rear_B_mm;
        rVotedMagDevX_Rear_mm := rMagDevX_Rear_B_mm;
    ELSE
        rVotedMagDevY_Rear_mm := rMagDevY_Rear_C_mm;
        rVotedMagDevX_Rear_mm := rMagDevX_Rear_C_mm;
    END_IF;
    bVotedMagPeg_Rear := (bMagPegDetected_Rear_A AND bMagPegDetected_Rear_B) OR
                         (bMagPegDetected_Rear_B AND bMagPegDetected_Rear_C) OR
                         (bMagPegDetected_Rear_C AND bMagPegDetected_Rear_A);
    IF (rDev_MagY_Rear_AB > 35.0) OR (rDev_MagY_Rear_BC > 35.0) OR (rDev_MagY_Rear_CA > 35.0) THEN
        dwDegradationWord := dwDegradationWord OR 16#0000_0020; (* Rear Mag Antenna deviation *)
    END_IF;
ELSIF bMagRear_A_Healthy AND bMagRear_B_Healthy THEN
    rVotedMagDevY_Rear_mm := (rMagDevY_Rear_A_mm + rMagDevY_Rear_B_mm) * 0.5;
    rVotedMagDevX_Rear_mm := (rMagDevX_Rear_A_mm + rMagDevX_Rear_B_mm) * 0.5;
    bVotedMagPeg_Rear := bMagPegDetected_Rear_A OR bMagPegDetected_Rear_B;
    dwDegradationWord := dwDegradationWord OR 16#0000_0040;
ELSIF bMagRear_B_Healthy AND bMagRear_C_Healthy THEN
    rVotedMagDevY_Rear_mm := (rMagDevY_Rear_B_mm + rMagDevY_Rear_C_mm) * 0.5;
    rVotedMagDevX_Rear_mm := (rMagDevX_Rear_B_mm + rMagDevX_Rear_C_mm) * 0.5;
    bVotedMagPeg_Rear := bMagPegDetected_Rear_B OR bMagPegDetected_Rear_C;
    dwDegradationWord := dwDegradationWord OR 16#0000_0080;
ELSIF bMagRear_A_Healthy AND bMagRear_C_Healthy THEN
    rVotedMagDevY_Rear_mm := (rMagDevY_Rear_A_mm + rMagDevY_Rear_C_mm) * 0.5;
    rVotedMagDevX_Rear_mm := (rMagDevX_Rear_A_mm + rMagDevX_Rear_C_mm) * 0.5;
    bVotedMagPeg_Rear := bMagPegDetected_Rear_A OR bMagPegDetected_Rear_C;
    dwDegradationWord := dwDegradationWord OR 16#0000_0100;
ELSE
    rVotedMagDevY_Rear_mm := 0.0;
    rVotedMagDevX_Rear_mm := 0.0;
    bVotedMagPeg_Rear := FALSE;
    dwDegradationWord := dwDegradationWord OR 16#0000_0200;
    dwAlarmWord1 := dwAlarmWord1 OR 16#0000_0008; (* Total rear navigation sensor loss *)
END_IF;

(* --- 2.3 IMU Yaw Angular Rate 2oo3 Voting --- *)
rDev_YawRate_AB := ABS(rYawRate_A_degs - rYawRate_B_degs);
rDev_YawRate_BC := ABS(rYawRate_B_degs - rYawRate_C_degs);
rDev_YawRate_CA := ABS(rYawRate_C_degs - rYawRate_A_degs);

bImuYaw_A_Healthy := (ABS(rYawRate_A_degs) <= 90.0);
bImuYaw_B_Healthy := (ABS(rYawRate_B_degs) <= 90.0);
bImuYaw_C_Healthy := (ABS(rYawRate_C_degs) <= 90.0);

IF bImuYaw_A_Healthy AND bImuYaw_B_Healthy AND bImuYaw_C_Healthy THEN
    IF ((rYawRate_A_degs >= rYawRate_B_degs) AND (rYawRate_A_degs <= rYawRate_C_degs)) OR
       ((rYawRate_A_degs >= rYawRate_C_degs) AND (rYawRate_A_degs <= rYawRate_B_degs)) THEN
        rVotedYawRate_degs := rYawRate_A_degs;
    ELSIF ((rYawRate_B_degs >= rYawRate_A_degs) AND (rYawRate_B_degs <= rYawRate_C_degs)) OR
          ((rYawRate_B_degs >= rYawRate_C_degs) AND (rYawRate_B_degs <= rYawRate_A_degs)) THEN
        rVotedYawRate_degs := rYawRate_B_degs;
    ELSE
        rVotedYawRate_degs := rYawRate_C_degs;
    END_IF;
    IF (rDev_YawRate_AB > 4.0) OR (rDev_YawRate_BC > 4.0) OR (rDev_YawRate_CA > 4.0) THEN
        dwDegradationWord := dwDegradationWord OR 16#0000_0400; (* IMU yaw gyro channel deviation *)
    END_IF;
ELSIF bImuYaw_A_Healthy AND bImuYaw_B_Healthy THEN
    rVotedYawRate_degs := (rYawRate_A_degs + rYawRate_B_degs) * 0.5;
    dwDegradationWord := dwDegradationWord OR 16#0000_0800;
ELSIF bImuYaw_B_Healthy AND bImuYaw_C_Healthy THEN
    rVotedYawRate_degs := (rYawRate_B_degs + rYawRate_C_degs) * 0.5;
    dwDegradationWord := dwDegradationWord OR 16#0000_1000;
ELSIF bImuYaw_A_Healthy AND bImuYaw_C_Healthy THEN
    rVotedYawRate_degs := (rYawRate_A_degs + rYawRate_C_degs) * 0.5;
    dwDegradationWord := dwDegradationWord OR 16#0000_2000;
ELSE
    rVotedYawRate_degs := 0.0;
    dwDegradationWord := dwDegradationWord OR 16#0000_4000;
    dwAlarmWord1 := dwAlarmWord1 OR 16#0000_0010; (* IMU Yaw gyro triple failure trip *)
END_IF;

(* --- 2.4 IMU Lateral Acceleration 2oo3 Voting --- *)
rDev_AccelLat_AB := ABS(rAccelLat_A_ms2 - rAccelLat_B_ms2);
rDev_AccelLat_BC := ABS(rAccelLat_B_ms2 - rAccelLat_C_ms2);
rDev_AccelLat_CA := ABS(rAccelLat_C_ms2 - rAccelLat_A_ms2);

bImuLat_A_Healthy := (ABS(rAccelLat_A_ms2) <= 12.0);
bImuLat_B_Healthy := (ABS(rAccelLat_B_ms2) <= 12.0);
bImuLat_C_Healthy := (ABS(rAccelLat_C_ms2) <= 12.0);

IF bImuLat_A_Healthy AND bImuLat_B_Healthy AND bImuLat_C_Healthy THEN
    IF ((rAccelLat_A_ms2 >= rAccelLat_B_ms2) AND (rAccelLat_A_ms2 <= rAccelLat_C_ms2)) OR
       ((rAccelLat_A_ms2 >= rAccelLat_C_ms2) AND (rAccelLat_A_ms2 <= rAccelLat_B_ms2)) THEN
        rVotedAccelLat_ms2 := rAccelLat_A_ms2;
    ELSIF ((rAccelLat_B_ms2 >= rAccelLat_A_ms2) AND (rAccelLat_B_ms2 <= rAccelLat_C_ms2)) OR
          ((rAccelLat_B_ms2 >= rAccelLat_C_ms2) AND (rAccelLat_B_ms2 <= rAccelLat_A_ms2)) THEN
        rVotedAccelLat_ms2 := rAccelLat_B_ms2;
    ELSE
        rVotedAccelLat_ms2 := rAccelLat_C_ms2;
    END_IF;
    IF (rDev_AccelLat_AB > 0.8) OR (rDev_AccelLat_BC > 0.8) OR (rDev_AccelLat_CA > 0.8) THEN
        dwDegradationWord := dwDegradationWord OR 16#0000_8000;
    END_IF;
ELSIF bImuLat_A_Healthy AND bImuLat_B_Healthy THEN
    rVotedAccelLat_ms2 := (rAccelLat_A_ms2 + rAccelLat_B_ms2) * 0.5;
    dwDegradationWord := dwDegradationWord OR 16#0001_0000;
ELSIF bImuLat_B_Healthy AND bImuLat_C_Healthy THEN
    rVotedAccelLat_ms2 := (rAccelLat_B_ms2 + rAccelLat_C_ms2) * 0.5;
    dwDegradationWord := dwDegradationWord OR 16#0002_0000;
ELSIF bImuLat_A_Healthy AND bImuLat_C_Healthy THEN
    rVotedAccelLat_ms2 := (rAccelLat_A_ms2 + rAccelLat_C_ms2) * 0.5;
    dwDegradationWord := dwDegradationWord OR 16#0004_0000;
ELSE
    rVotedAccelLat_ms2 := 0.0;
    dwDegradationWord := dwDegradationWord OR 16#0008_0000;
    dwAlarmWord1 := dwAlarmWord1 OR 16#0000_0020;
END_IF;

(* --- 2.5 IMU Longitudinal Acceleration & Roll Angle Voting --- *)
rVotedAccelLong_ms2 := (rAccelLong_A_ms2 + rAccelLong_B_ms2 + rAccelLong_C_ms2) / 3.0;
rVotedRollAngle_deg := (rRollAngle_A_deg + rRollAngle_B_deg + rRollAngle_C_deg) / 3.0;
rVotedRollRate_degs := (rRollRate_A_degs + rRollRate_B_degs + rRollRate_C_degs) / 3.0;

(* ========================================================================================= *)
(* 3.0 STATIC & DYNAMIC MASS RECONSTRUCTION, 3D COG & LATERAL LOAD TRANSFER (LTR) OBSERVER   *)
(* ========================================================================================= *)
(* Convert corner load cell mass readings from metric tons [t] to kilograms [kg] *)
rMass_FL_kg := MAX(rCornerWeight_FL_t * 1000.0, 1000.0);
rMass_FR_kg := MAX(rCornerWeight_FR_t * 1000.0, 1000.0);
rMass_RL_kg := MAX(rCornerWeight_RL_t * 1000.0, 1000.0);
rMass_RR_kg := MAX(rCornerWeight_RR_t * 1000.0, 1000.0);

rMass_Total_kg := rMass_FL_kg + rMass_FR_kg + rMass_RL_kg + rMass_RR_kg;
rTotalGrossVehicleMass_t := rMass_Total_kg / 1000.0;

(* Sanity check total mass against structural design envelope (tare ~ 31.5t, max ~ 72.0t) *)
IF (rTotalGrossVehicleMass_t > 70.0) THEN
    dwAlarmWord2 := dwAlarmWord2 OR 16#0000_0001; (* AGV gross overload > 70t safety trip *)
ELSIF (rTotalGrossVehicleMass_t < 28.0) THEN
    dwWarningWord := dwWarningWord OR 16#0000_0001; (* Corner load cell underweight anomaly *)
END_IF;

rMass_FrontAxle_kg := rMass_FL_kg + rMass_FR_kg;
rMass_RearAxle_kg  := rMass_RL_kg + rMass_RR_kg;
rMass_LeftTrack_kg := rMass_FL_kg + rMass_RL_kg;
rMass_RightTrack_kg:= rMass_FR_kg + rMass_RR_kg;

(* Longitudinal CoG Position Relative to Front and Rear Axles [m] *)
(* By static moment equilibrium: l_f * m_front = l_r * m_rear, with l_f + l_r = L *)
rCoG_DistRear_m  := (rMass_FrontAxle_kg / rMass_Total_kg) * rWheelbase_L_m;
rCoG_DistFront_m := rWheelbase_L_m - rCoG_DistRear_m;
rEstimatedCoG_OffsetX_mm := (rCoG_DistRear_m - (rWheelbase_L_m * 0.5)) * 1000.0;

(* Transverse CoG Position Offset from Centerline [m] *)
rCoG_LatOffset_m := ((rMass_RightTrack_kg - rMass_LeftTrack_kg) / rMass_Total_kg) * (rTrackWidth_W_m * 0.5);
rEstimatedCoG_OffsetY_mm := rCoG_LatOffset_m * 1000.0;

(* CoG Height Reconstruction: Empirical base chassis height (1.15m) + container payload contribution *)
IF (rContainerGrossWeight_t > 5.0) THEN
    (* High-cube container center of mass is typically 1.45m above chassis bed (bed height ~ 1.75m) *)
    rCoG_HeightEst_m := 1.20 + (rContainerGrossWeight_t / rTotalGrossVehicleMass_t) * 1.65;
ELSE
    rCoG_HeightEst_m := 1.15; (* Tare chassis bare CoG height *)
END_IF;
rEstimatedCoG_Height_m := rCoG_HeightEst_m;

(* Compute Dynamic Lateral Load Transfer Ratio (LTR): *)
(* LTR = (Fz_left - Fz_right) / Fz_total *)
rDynamicLTR := (rMass_LeftTrack_kg - rMass_RightTrack_kg) / rMass_Total_kg;
(* Apply first-order low-pass filter to reject dynamic suspension vibrations (tau = 40 ms) *)
rFilteredLTR := (rFilteredLTR * 0.80) + (rDynamicLTR * 0.20);
rLateralLoadTransferRatio := rFilteredLTR;

(* Check for Severe Lateral Load Imbalance or Container Eccentricity *)
IF (ABS(rCoG_LatOffset_m) > 0.450) THEN
    dwWarningWord := dwWarningWord OR 16#0000_0002; (* Dangerous container eccentric transverse loading *)
END_IF;

(* ========================================================================================= *)
(* 4.0 ACTIVE ANTI-ROLLOVER DYNAMIC LIMIT ENVELOPING & TURNING SPEED GOVERNOR                *)
(* ========================================================================================= *)
(* Theoretical rollover boundary based on steady-state equilibrium:                         *)
(* ay_critical = g * (W / 2) / h_CoG                                                       *)
(* With path curvature kappa [1/m], critical speed v_crit = SQRT(ay_critical / (|kappa| + eps)) *)
IF (ABS(rRefPathCurvature_radm) > 0.0005) THEN
    rCriticalRollOverSpeed_ms := SQRT((rGravitationalConstant * (rTrackWidth_W_m * 0.5)) /
                                     (MAX(rEstimatedCoG_Height_m, 0.8) * ABS(rRefPathCurvature_radm)));
    rCriticalRollOverSpeed_kmh := rCriticalRollOverSpeed_ms * 3.6;
ELSE
    rCriticalRollOverSpeed_kmh := 35.0; (* Straight-line maximum terminal governed limit [km/h] *)
END_IF;

(* Calculate Dynamic Roll Stability Margin *)
rRollStabilityMargin := 1.0 - ABS(rFilteredLTR);

(* Dynamic Rollover Multi-Stage Protection Envelope *)
IF (ABS(rFilteredLTR) >= 0.88) THEN
    (* STAGE 3: CRITICAL IMMINENT ROLLOVER TRIP *)
    dwAlarmWord2 := dwAlarmWord2 OR 16#0000_0002; (* Severe rollover threshold LTR > 0.88 *)
    bAntiRolloverActive := TRUE;
    rAntiRolloverSpeedDerateFactor := 0.0;
    rRolloverTorqueVector_M_z := 0.0;
    (* Rapid controlled straight-ahead counter-action & mechanical braking *)
    iState := 80; (* Enter State 80: Active Anti-Rollover Emergency Recovery *)
ELSIF (ABS(rFilteredLTR) >= 0.65) THEN
    (* STAGE 2: ACTIVE DYNAMIC INTERVENTION *)
    bAntiRolloverActive := TRUE;
    dwWarningWord := dwWarningWord OR 16#0000_0004; (* Active Anti-Rollover Governor intervening *)
    (* Proportional derate factor: scale speed down linearly to 25% *)
    rAntiRolloverSpeedDerateFactor := MAX(0.20, (0.88 - ABS(rFilteredLTR)) / (0.88 - 0.65));
    (* Generate stabilizing counter-yaw moment Mz to unload outside wheels *)
    IF (rFilteredLTR > 0.0) THEN
        (* Left wheels overloaded, vehicle turning right or rolling right: yaw counter-torque *)
        rRolloverTorqueVector_M_z := -15000.0 * (ABS(rFilteredLTR) - 0.65);
    ELSE
        (* Right wheels overloaded, vehicle rolling left: yaw counter-torque *)
        rRolloverTorqueVector_M_z := 15000.0 * (ABS(rFilteredLTR) - 0.65);
    END_IF;
ELSIF (ABS(rFilteredLTR) >= 0.50) THEN
    (* STAGE 1: ADVISORY SPEED DERATING *)
    bAntiRolloverActive := FALSE;
    rAntiRolloverSpeedDerateFactor := 0.80; (* Mild 20% speed derating *)
    rRolloverTorqueVector_M_z := 0.0;
ELSE
    (* STAGE 0: STABLE ENVELOPE *)
    bAntiRolloverActive := FALSE;
    rAntiRolloverSpeedDerateFactor := 1.00; (* 100% nominal speed permitted *)
    rRolloverTorqueVector_M_z := 0.0;
END_IF;

(* Enforce anti-rollover speed limit constraint *)
rMaxSafeTurningSpeed_kmh := MIN(rCriticalRollOverSpeed_kmh * 0.85, 30.0) * rAntiRolloverSpeedDerateFactor;

(* ========================================================================================= *)
(* 5.0 MAGNETIC TRANSPONDER LANDMARK EXTRACTION, NAVIGATION FUSION & EKF CORRECTION         *)
(* ========================================================================================= *)
(* Calculate fused ground speed and chassis kinematics *)
rWheelLinVel_FL_ms := (rWheelSpeed_FL_kmh / 3.6);
rWheelLinVel_FR_ms := (rWheelSpeed_FR_kmh / 3.6);
rWheelLinVel_RL_ms := (rWheelSpeed_RL_kmh / 3.6);
rWheelLinVel_RR_ms := (rWheelSpeed_RR_kmh / 3.6);

rChassisLongVel_ms := (rWheelLinVel_FL_ms + rWheelLinVel_FR_ms + rWheelLinVel_RL_ms + rWheelLinVel_RR_ms) * 0.25;
rVehicleSpeedEst_kmh := rChassisLongVel_ms * 3.6;
rVehicleYawRateEst_degs := rVotedYawRate_degs;

(* Extended Kalman Filter (EKF) Time Propagation Step (Predict) *)
rEkf_Psi_rad := rEkf_Psi_rad + (rVotedYawRate_degs * (3.14159265 / 180.0) * rSampleTime_Ts_s);
rEkf_X_m := rEkf_X_m + (rChassisLongVel_ms * COS(rEkf_Psi_rad) * rSampleTime_Ts_s);
rEkf_Y_m := rEkf_Y_m + (rChassisLongVel_ms * SIN(rEkf_Psi_rad) * rSampleTime_Ts_s);
rEkf_V_ms := rChassisLongVel_ms;

(* Propagate Diagonal Error Covariance P = P + Q *)
rEkf_P11 := rEkf_P11 + rEkf_Q11;
rEkf_P22 := rEkf_P22 + rEkf_Q22;
rEkf_P33 := rEkf_P33 + rEkf_Q33;
rEkf_P44 := rEkf_P44 + rEkf_Q44;

(* Edge detection on magnetic transponder peg detection *)
bTransponderValidPulse := bVotedMagPeg_Front AND NOT bTransponderFrontPrev;
bTransponderFrontPrev := bVotedMagPeg_Front;

IF bTransponderValidPulse AND bMagneticNavEnable THEN
    (* EKF Measurement Update Step: Peg provides absolute millimeter coordinate reference *)
    (* Front antenna is located at x_ant = +L/2 from vehicle center *)
    rLastPegGlobalX_m := rRefPositionX_mm * 0.001;
    rLastPegGlobalY_m := rRefPositionY_mm * 0.001;
    
    (* Measurement Innovation *)
    rInnovX_m := (rLastPegGlobalX_m + (rVotedMagDevX_Front_mm * 0.001)) - rEkf_X_m;
    rInnovY_m := (rLastPegGlobalY_m + (rVotedMagDevY_Front_mm * 0.001)) - rEkf_Y_m;
    
    (* Kalman Gain Calculation *)
    rGainK1 := rEkf_P11 / (rEkf_P11 + rEkf_R_MagX);
    rGainK2 := rEkf_P22 / (rEkf_P22 + rEkf_R_MagY);
    
    (* State Correction *)
    rEkf_X_m := rEkf_X_m + (rGainK1 * rInnovX_m);
    rEkf_Y_m := rEkf_Y_m + (rGainK2 * rInnovY_m);
    
    (* Covariance Matrix Update: P = (1 - K) * P *)
    rEkf_P11 := (1.0 - rGainK1) * rEkf_P11;
    rEkf_P22 := (1.0 - rGainK2) * rEkf_P22;
    
    (* Re-anchor heading error from dual front-rear antenna baseline *)
    IF (bVotedMagPeg_Rear) THEN
        rEkf_Psi_rad := rEkf_Psi_rad + 0.15 * ((rVotedMagDevY_Front_mm - rVotedMagDevY_Rear_mm) / (rWheelbase_L_m * 1000.0));
    END_IF;
END_IF;

(* Populate Global Positioning and Path Tracking Deviation Outputs *)
rGlobalPositionX_mm := rEkf_X_m * 1000.0;
rGlobalPositionY_mm := rEkf_Y_m * 1000.0;
rLateralPathDev_mm  := rVotedMagDevY_Front_mm;
rHeadingAngleDev_deg := (rRefHeadingAngle_deg - (rEkf_Psi_rad * 180.0 / 3.14159265));

(* ========================================================================================= *)
(* 6.0 NON-LINEAR TIRE ROAD-ADHESION DYNAMIC OBSERVER & SLIP SYNCHRONIZATION ENGINE         *)
(* ========================================================================================= *)
(* Convert corner loads to Normal Forces in Newtons: Fz = Mass_kg * 9.80665 *)
rFz_FL_N := rMass_FL_kg * rGravitationalConstant;
rFz_FR_N := rMass_FR_kg * rGravitationalConstant;
rFz_RL_N := rMass_RL_kg * rGravitationalConstant;
rFz_RR_N := rMass_RR_kg * rGravitationalConstant;

(* Dynamic Calculation of Longitudinal Slip Ratio for each corner:                           *)
(* lambda = (omega * R_eff - v_x) / MAX(v_x, omega * R_eff, 0.5)                             *)
IF (rWheelLinVel_FL_ms >= rChassisLongVel_ms) THEN
    (* Driving Mode: Positive Slip *)
    rSlipRatio_FL := (rWheelLinVel_FL_ms - rChassisLongVel_ms) / MAX(rWheelLinVel_FL_ms, 0.5);
ELSE
    (* Braking Mode: Negative Slip *)
    rSlipRatio_FL := (rWheelLinVel_FL_ms - rChassisLongVel_ms) / MAX(rChassisLongVel_ms, 0.5);
END_IF;

IF (rWheelLinVel_FR_ms >= rChassisLongVel_ms) THEN
    rSlipRatio_FR := (rWheelLinVel_FR_ms - rChassisLongVel_ms) / MAX(rWheelLinVel_FR_ms, 0.5);
ELSE
    rSlipRatio_FR := (rWheelLinVel_FR_ms - rChassisLongVel_ms) / MAX(rChassisLongVel_ms, 0.5);
END_IF;

IF (rWheelLinVel_RL_ms >= rChassisLongVel_ms) THEN
    rSlipRatio_RL := (rWheelLinVel_RL_ms - rChassisLongVel_ms) / MAX(rWheelLinVel_RL_ms, 0.5);
ELSE
    rSlipRatio_RL := (rWheelLinVel_RL_ms - rChassisLongVel_ms) / MAX(rChassisLongVel_ms, 0.5);
END_IF;

IF (rWheelLinVel_RR_ms >= rChassisLongVel_ms) THEN
    rSlipRatio_RR := (rWheelLinVel_RR_ms - rChassisLongVel_ms) / MAX(rWheelLinVel_RR_ms, 0.5);
ELSE
    rSlipRatio_RR := (rWheelLinVel_RR_ms - rChassisLongVel_ms) / MAX(rChassisLongVel_ms, 0.5);
END_IF;

(* Clamp Slip Ratios within physical bounds [-1.0, +1.0] and output in percent *)
rTireSlipRatio_FL_pct := LIMIT(-100.0, rSlipRatio_FL * 100.0, 100.0);
rTireSlipRatio_FR_pct := LIMIT(-100.0, rSlipRatio_FR * 100.0, 100.0);
rTireSlipRatio_RL_pct := LIMIT(-100.0, rSlipRatio_RL * 100.0, 100.0);
rTireSlipRatio_RR_pct := LIMIT(-100.0, rSlipRatio_RR * 100.0, 100.0);

(* Recursive Friction Coefficient Observer (Mu Estimation) *)
(* Total tractive force produced by 4 drive motors: F_tract = sum(Torque_i / R_eff) *)
rTractiveEffortTotal_N := (rDriveMotorTorqueFb_FL_Nm + rDriveMotorTorqueFb_FR_Nm +
                           rDriveMotorTorqueFb_RL_Nm + rDriveMotorTorqueFb_RR_Nm) / rTireRollingRadius_m;
rNormalForceTotal_N := rFz_FL_N + rFz_FR_N + rFz_RL_N + rFz_RR_N;

IF (rNormalForceTotal_N > 10000.0) AND (ABS(rChassisLongVel_ms) > 0.5) THEN
    rApparentFrictionDemand := ABS(rTractiveEffortTotal_N) / rNormalForceTotal_N;
    (* If wheel slip is active (>8%), apparent friction approaches peak road-tire adhesion mu *)
    IF (ABS(rSlipRatio_FL) > 0.08) OR (ABS(rSlipRatio_FR) > 0.08) OR
       (ABS(rSlipRatio_RL) > 0.08) OR (ABS(rSlipRatio_RR) > 0.08) THEN
        rEstimatedFrictionMu := (rEstimatedFrictionMu * (1.0 - rFrictionObserverGain)) +
                                (LIMIT(0.15, rApparentFrictionDemand, 0.95) * rFrictionObserverGain);
    END_IF;
END_IF;
rTireAdhesionCoeff_Est := rEstimatedFrictionMu;

(* Dynamic Anti-Slip Regulation (ASR) Traction Cutback Multipliers *)
IF (rSlipRatio_FL > 0.15) THEN
    rTorqueScale_FL := MAX(0.20, 1.0 - (rSlipRatio_FL - 0.15) * 4.0);
    bTireSlipMitigationActive := TRUE;
ELSE
    rTorqueScale_FL := 1.0;
END_IF;

IF (rSlipRatio_FR > 0.15) THEN
    rTorqueScale_FR := MAX(0.20, 1.0 - (rSlipRatio_FR - 0.15) * 4.0);
    bTireSlipMitigationActive := TRUE;
ELSE
    rTorqueScale_FR := 1.0;
END_IF;

IF (rSlipRatio_RL > 0.15) THEN
    rTorqueScale_RL := MAX(0.20, 1.0 - (rSlipRatio_RL - 0.15) * 4.0);
    bTireSlipMitigationActive := TRUE;
ELSE
    rTorqueScale_RL := 1.0;
END_IF;

IF (rSlipRatio_RR > 0.15) THEN
    rTorqueScale_RR := MAX(0.20, 1.0 - (rSlipRatio_RR - 0.15) * 4.0);
    bTireSlipMitigationActive := TRUE;
ELSE
    rTorqueScale_RR := 1.0;
END_IF;

IF (rTorqueScale_FL = 1.0) AND (rTorqueScale_FR = 1.0) AND (rTorqueScale_RL = 1.0) AND (rTorqueScale_RR = 1.0) THEN
    bTireSlipMitigationActive := FALSE;
END_IF;

(* ========================================================================================= *)
(* 7.0 6-STATE MULTIVARIABLE STATE-SPACE MODEL & REAL-TIME MPC OPTIMIZATION                  *)
(* ========================================================================================= *)
(* States:                                                                                  *)
(*   x[1]: Lateral velocity v_y [m/s]                                                       *)
(*   x[2]: Chassis yaw rate r [rad/s]                                                       *)
(*   x[3]: Lateral path error e_y [m]                                                       *)
(*   x[4]: Heading angle error e_psi [rad]                                                  *)
(*   x[5]: Chassis roll angle phi [rad]                                                     *)
(*   x[6]: Chassis roll angular velocity p [rad/s]                                          *)
(* Controls:                                                                                *)
(*   u[1]: Front steering angle command delta_f [rad]                                       *)
(*   u[2]: Rear steering angle command delta_r [rad]                                        *)
(*   u[3]: Active direct yaw moment delta_M_z [Nm]                                          *)
(*   u[4]: Commanded longitudinal acceleration a_x [m/s2]                                   *)

IF NOT bMatricesInitialized THEN
    (* Discrete System Transition Matrix A_mat (6x6) for Ts = 10 ms *)
    A_mat[1,1] := 0.9650; A_mat[1,2] := -0.0450;A_mat[1,3] := 0.0000; A_mat[1,4] := 0.0000; A_mat[1,5] := 0.0120;  A_mat[1,6] := 0.0000;
    A_mat[2,1] := -0.0180;A_mat[2,2] := 0.9480; A_mat[2,3] := 0.0000; A_mat[2,4] := 0.0000; A_mat[2,5] := 0.0000;  A_mat[2,6] := 0.0000;
    A_mat[3,1] := 0.0100; A_mat[3,2] := 0.0000; A_mat[3,3] := 1.0000; A_mat[3,4] := 0.0850; A_mat[3,5] := 0.0000;  A_mat[3,6] := 0.0000;
    A_mat[4,1] := 0.0000; A_mat[4,2] := 0.0100; A_mat[4,3] := 0.0000; A_mat[4,4] := 1.0000; A_mat[4,5] := 0.0000;  A_mat[4,6] := 0.0000;
    A_mat[5,1] := 0.0000; A_mat[5,2] := 0.0000; A_mat[5,3] := 0.0000; A_mat[5,4] := 0.0000; A_mat[5,5] := 0.9850;  A_mat[5,6] := 0.0098;
    A_mat[6,1] := -0.0250;A_mat[6,2] := 0.0000; A_mat[6,3] := 0.0000; A_mat[6,4] := 0.0000; A_mat[6,5] := -0.2850; A_mat[6,6] := 0.9120;

    (* Discrete Input Coupling Matrix B_mat (6x4) *)
    B_mat[1,1] := 0.1850; B_mat[1,2] := 0.1650; B_mat[1,3] := 0.0000;    B_mat[1,4] := 0.0000;
    B_mat[2,1] := 0.1420; B_mat[2,2] := -0.1380;B_mat[2,3] := 0.000015;  B_mat[2,4] := 0.0000;
    B_mat[3,1] := 0.0000; B_mat[3,2] := 0.0000; B_mat[3,3] := 0.0000;    B_mat[3,4] := 0.0000;

    H_diag[4] := 3.20;

x_state[1] := rChassisLatVel_ms;
x_state[2] := rVotedYawRate_degs * (3.14159265 / 180.0);
x_state[3] := rLateralPathDev_mm * 0.001; (* mm to m *)
x_state[4] := rHeadingAngleDev_deg * (3.14159265 / 180.0);
x_state[5] := rVotedRollAngle_deg * (3.14159265 / 180.0);
x_state[6] := rVotedRollRate_degs * (3.14159265 / 180.0);

x_ref[1] := 0.0;
x_ref[2] := (rRefVehicleVelocity_kmh / 3.6) * rRefPathCurvature_radm; (* Steady-state yaw rate *)
x_ref[3] := 0.0; (* Zero lateral error *)
x_ref[4] := 0.0; (* Zero heading orientation error *)
x_ref[5] := 0.0; (* Upright zero roll *)
x_ref[6] := 0.0;

(* Real-Time Quadratic Cost Gradient Descent Optimization *)
IF bMpcTrackingEnable AND (iState = 50 OR iState = 60 OR iState = 70) THEN
    (* Compute Predicted State x_next = A * x + B * u *)
    FOR iRow := 1 TO 6 DO
        x_next[iRow] := 0.0;
        FOR iCol := 1 TO 6 DO
            x_next[iRow] := x_next[iRow] + A_mat[iRow, iCol] * x_state[iCol];
        END_FOR;
        FOR iCol := 1 TO 4 DO
            x_next[iRow] := x_next[iRow] + B_mat[iRow, iCol] * u_mpc[iCol];
        END_FOR;
    END_FOR;

    (* Compute Gradient of Quadratic Cost: grad_J = B^T * Q * (x_next - x_ref) + R * (u - u_prev) *)
    FOR iCol := 1 TO 4 DO
        grad_J[iCol] := 0.0;
        FOR iRow := 1 TO 6 DO
            grad_J[iCol] := grad_J[iCol] + B_mat[iRow, iCol] * Q_diag[iRow] * (x_next[iRow] - x_ref[iRow]);
        END_FOR;

    FOR iCol := 1 TO 4 DO

    FOR iCol := 1 TO 4 DO

    END_FOR;
    bPathTrackingActive := TRUE;
ELSE
    u_mpc[1] := 0.0;
    u_mpc[2] := 0.0;
    u_mpc[3] := 0.0;
    u_mpc[4] := 0.0;

(* ========================================================================================= *)
(* 8.0 4WID-4WIS ACTUATOR ALLOCATION & DYNAMIC TORQUE VECTORING                              *)
(* ========================================================================================= *)
(* Base Ackermann Steering Angles from MPC outputs *)
rTargetAckermannDeltaF_rad := u_mpc[1];
rTargetAckermannDeltaR_rad := u_mpc[2];

(* Check for Crab Steer Mode (pure translation with zero chassis yaw) *)
IF bAllowCrabSteering AND (ABS(rRefHeadingAngle_deg - (rEkf_Psi_rad * 180.0 / 3.14159265)) < 1.0) AND
   (ABS(rLateralPathDev_mm) > 25.0) THEN
    (* Set equal front and rear steer angles for diagonal shift *)
    rTargetCrabAngle_rad := LIMIT(-0.5236, (rLateralPathDev_mm * 0.001) * 0.25, 0.5236);
    rCornerSteer_FL_Raw_deg := rTargetCrabAngle_rad * 180.0 / 3.14159265;
    rCornerSteer_FR_Raw_deg := rCornerSteer_FL_Raw_deg;
    rCornerSteer_RL_Raw_deg := rCornerSteer_FL_Raw_deg;
    rCornerSteer_RR_Raw_deg := rCornerSteer_FL_Raw_deg;
ELSE
    (* Standard Ackermann / Counter-phase steer allocation *)
    rCornerSteer_FL_Raw_deg := rTargetAckermannDeltaF_rad * 180.0 / 3.14159265;
    rCornerSteer_FR_Raw_deg := rTargetAckermannDeltaF_rad * 180.0 / 3.14159265;
    rCornerSteer_RL_Raw_deg := rTargetAckermannDeltaR_rad * 180.0 / 3.14159265;
    rCornerSteer_RR_Raw_deg := rTargetAckermannDeltaR_rad * 180.0 / 3.14159265;
END_IF;

(* Slew Rate Limiter on Steering Actuators (Max 35 deg/s) *)
rSteerAngleCmd_FL_deg := LIMIT(rPrevSteerCmd_FL_deg - (rMaxSteeringRate_degs * rSampleTime_Ts_s),
                               rCornerSteer_FL_Raw_deg,
                               rPrevSteerCmd_FL_deg + (rMaxSteeringRate_degs * rSampleTime_Ts_s));
rSteerAngleCmd_FR_deg := LIMIT(rPrevSteerCmd_FR_deg - (rMaxSteeringRate_degs * rSampleTime_Ts_s),
                               rCornerSteer_FR_Raw_deg,
                               rPrevSteerCmd_FR_deg + (rMaxSteeringRate_degs * rSampleTime_Ts_s));
rSteerAngleCmd_RL_deg := LIMIT(rPrevSteerCmd_RL_deg - (rMaxSteeringRate_degs * rSampleTime_Ts_s),
                               rCornerSteer_RL_Raw_deg,
                               rPrevSteerCmd_RL_deg + (rMaxSteeringRate_degs * rSampleTime_Ts_s));
rSteerAngleCmd_RR_deg := LIMIT(rPrevSteerCmd_RR_deg - (rMaxSteeringRate_degs * rSampleTime_Ts_s),
                               rCornerSteer_RR_Raw_deg,
                               rPrevSteerCmd_RR_deg + (rMaxSteeringRate_degs * rSampleTime_Ts_s));

rPrevSteerCmd_FL_deg := rSteerAngleCmd_FL_deg;
rPrevSteerCmd_FR_deg := rSteerAngleCmd_FR_deg;
rPrevSteerCmd_RL_deg := rSteerAngleCmd_RL_deg;
rPrevSteerCmd_RR_deg := rSteerAngleCmd_RR_deg;

(* Drive Torque Calculation: Base Longitudinal Tractive Demand + Torque Vectoring Yaw Moment *)
IF (u_mpc[4] >= 0.0) THEN
    rBaseDriveTorque_Nm := (u_mpc[4] * rMass_Total_kg * rTireRollingRadius_m * 0.25);
ELSE
    rBaseDriveTorque_Nm := 0.0; (* Negative acceleration handled by service brakes *)
END_IF;

(* Torque Vectoring Moment Allocation across Left and Right Tracks *)
(* delta_Mz = (F_right - F_left) * (W / 2) -> delta_T = delta_Mz * R_eff / W *)
rYawMomentDiffTorque_Nm := (u_mpc[3] + rRolloverTorqueVector_M_z) * rTireRollingRadius_m / rTrackWidth_W_m;

rCornerTorque_FR_Raw_Nm := (rBaseDriveTorque_Nm + (rYawMomentDiffTorque_Nm * 0.5)) * rTorqueScale_FR;
rCornerTorque_RL_Raw_Nm := (rBaseDriveTorque_Nm - (rYawMomentDiffTorque_Nm * 0.5)) * rTorqueScale_RL;

IF bInverterReady_FL AND (iState >= 40) AND (iState < 100) THEN

END_IF;

        bSystemReady := FALSE;
        bSystemRunning := FALSE;
        bSystemTripped := TRUE;
        bPathTrackingActive := FALSE;
        bAntiRolloverActive := FALSE;

        rDriveTorqueCmd_FL_Nm := 0.0;
        rDriveTorqueCmd_FR_Nm := 0.0;
        rDriveTorqueCmd_RL_Nm := 0.0;

        rHydraulicBrakeCmd_FL_bar := rMaxServiceBrakePress_bar;
        rHydraulicBrakeCmd_FR_bar := rMaxServiceBrakePress_bar;
        rHydraulicBrakeCmd_RL_bar := rMaxServiceBrakePress_bar;
