(* 1. Feed Flow Transmitter Voting (rFeedFlow_Nm3h_A, B, C)                                      *)
(* --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* Frozen Sensor Verification *)
IF ABS(rFeedFlow_Nm3h_A - rPrev_FF_A) < 0.001 THEN iStuckCount_FF_A := iStuckCount_FF_A + 1; ELSE iStuckCount_FF_A := 0; END_IF;
IF ABS(rFeedFlow_Nm3h_B - rPrev_FF_B) < 0.001 THEN iStuckCount_FF_B := iStuckCount_FF_B + 1; ELSE iStuckCount_FF_B := 0; END_IF;
IF ABS(rFeedFlow_Nm3h_C - rPrev_FF_C) < 0.001 THEN iStuckCount_FF_C := iStuckCount_FF_C + 1; ELSE iStuckCount_FF_C := 0; END_IF;
rPrev_FF_A := rFeedFlow_Nm3h_A; rPrev_FF_B := rFeedFlow_Nm3h_B; rPrev_FF_C := rFeedFlow_Nm3h_C;
bHealth_FF_A := (rFeedFlow_Nm3h_A >= 100.0) AND (rFeedFlow_Nm3h_A <= 3000.0) AND (iStuckCount_FF_A < 200);
bHealth_FF_B := (rFeedFlow_Nm3h_B >= 100.0) AND (rFeedFlow_Nm3h_B <= 3000.0) AND (iStuckCount_FF_B < 200);
bHealth_FF_C := (rFeedFlow_Nm3h_C >= 100.0) AND (rFeedFlow_Nm3h_C <= 3000.0) AND (iStuckCount_FF_C < 200);

IF bHealth_FF_A AND bHealth_FF_B AND bHealth_FF_C THEN
    bDegraded_FF_1oo2 := FALSE; bDegraded_FF_1oo1 := FALSE;
    (* Median Selection Algorithm for 3 Healthy Sensors *)
    IF ((rFeedFlow_Nm3h_A >= rFeedFlow_Nm3h_B) AND (rFeedFlow_Nm3h_A <= rFeedFlow_Nm3h_C)) OR
       ((rFeedFlow_Nm3h_A >= rFeedFlow_Nm3h_C) AND (rFeedFlow_Nm3h_A <= rFeedFlow_Nm3h_B)) THEN
        rVoted_FeedFlow_Nm3h := rFeedFlow_Nm3h_A;
    ELSIF ((rFeedFlow_Nm3h_B >= rFeedFlow_Nm3h_A) AND (rFeedFlow_Nm3h_B <= rFeedFlow_Nm3h_C)) OR
          ((rFeedFlow_Nm3h_B >= rFeedFlow_Nm3h_C) AND (rFeedFlow_Nm3h_B <= rFeedFlow_Nm3h_A)) THEN
        rVoted_FeedFlow_Nm3h := rFeedFlow_Nm3h_B;
    ELSE
        rVoted_FeedFlow_Nm3h := rFeedFlow_Nm3h_C;
    END_IF;
    (* Check Pairwise Discrepancies *)
    IF (ABS(rFeedFlow_Nm3h_A - rFeedFlow_Nm3h_B) > rTol_FeedFlow_Nm3h) OR
       (ABS(rFeedFlow_Nm3h_B - rFeedFlow_Nm3h_C) > rTol_FeedFlow_Nm3h) OR
       (ABS(rFeedFlow_Nm3h_A - rFeedFlow_Nm3h_C) > rTol_FeedFlow_Nm3h) THEN
        dwTMR_DiagnosticWord := dwTMR_DiagnosticWord OR 16#0000_0001; (* TMR Discrepancy warning *)
    END_IF;
ELSIF bHealth_FF_A AND bHealth_FF_B THEN
    bDegraded_FF_1oo2 := TRUE; rVoted_FeedFlow_Nm3h := (rFeedFlow_Nm3h_A + rFeedFlow_Nm3h_B) * 0.5;
    dwTMR_DiagnosticWord := dwTMR_DiagnosticWord OR 16#0000_0002;
ELSIF bHealth_FF_A AND bHealth_FF_C THEN
    bDegraded_FF_1oo2 := TRUE; rVoted_FeedFlow_Nm3h := (rFeedFlow_Nm3h_A + rFeedFlow_Nm3h_C) * 0.5;
    dwTMR_DiagnosticWord := dwTMR_DiagnosticWord OR 16#0000_0002;
ELSIF bHealth_FF_B AND bHealth_FF_C THEN
    bDegraded_FF_1oo2 := TRUE; rVoted_FeedFlow_Nm3h := (rFeedFlow_Nm3h_B + rFeedFlow_Nm3h_C) * 0.5;
    dwTMR_DiagnosticWord := dwTMR_DiagnosticWord OR 16#0000_0002;
ELSIF bHealth_FF_A THEN
    bDegraded_FF_1oo1 := TRUE; rVoted_FeedFlow_Nm3h := rFeedFlow_Nm3h_A;
    dwTMR_DiagnosticWord := dwTMR_DiagnosticWord OR 16#0000_0004;
ELSIF bHealth_FF_B THEN
    bDegraded_FF_1oo1 := TRUE; rVoted_FeedFlow_Nm3h := rFeedFlow_Nm3h_B;
    dwTMR_DiagnosticWord := dwTMR_DiagnosticWord OR 16#0000_0004;
ELSIF bHealth_FF_C THEN
    bDegraded_FF_1oo1 := TRUE; rVoted_FeedFlow_Nm3h := rFeedFlow_Nm3h_C;
    dwTMR_DiagnosticWord := dwTMR_DiagnosticWord OR 16#0000_0004;
ELSE

(* ============================================================================================= *)
(* SECTION 3: THERMODYNAMIC RAYLEIGH VLE & STRUCTURED PACKING HYDRAULIC ENGINE                   *)
(* ============================================================================================= *)
(* Saturation Vapor Pressures via Antoine Equation: ln(P_sat [bar]) = A - B / (T [K] + C) *)
IF (rVoted_TopTemp_K + rAntoine_C_Ar) > 10.0 THEN
    rSatPress_Ar_bar := EXP(rAntoine_A_Ar - (rAntoine_B_Ar / (rVoted_TopTemp_K + rAntoine_C_Ar)));
ELSE
    rSatPress_Ar_bar := 1.350;
END_IF;

IF (rVoted_TopTemp_K + rAntoine_C_O2) > 10.0 THEN
    rSatPress_O2_bar := EXP(rAntoine_A_O2 - (rAntoine_B_O2 / (rVoted_TopTemp_K + rAntoine_C_O2)));
ELSE
    rSatPress_O2_bar := 0.980;
END_IF;

IF (rVoted_TopTemp_K + rAntoine_C_N2) > 10.0 THEN
    rSatPress_N2_bar := EXP(rAntoine_A_N2 - (rAntoine_B_N2 / (rVoted_TopTemp_K + rAntoine_C_N2)));
ELSE
    rSatPress_N2_bar := 4.150;
END_IF;

(* Relative Volatilities at Column Top Operating Conditions *)
IF rSatPress_O2_bar > 0.01 THEN
    rRelativeVol_ArO2 := rSatPress_Ar_bar / rSatPress_O2_bar;
ELSE
    rRelativeVol_ArO2 := 1.120;
END_IF;

IF rSatPress_Ar_bar > 0.01 THEN
    rRelativeVol_N2Ar := rSatPress_N2_bar / rSatPress_Ar_bar;
ELSE
    rRelativeVol_N2Ar := 3.074;
END_IF;

(* Underwood Minimum Reflux Calculation for Ternary Mixture (Ar, O2, N2) *)
(* Root theta calculation between alpha_ArO2 and 1.0 *)
rUnderwoodTheta := 1.0 + (rRelativeVol_ArO2 - 1.0) * 0.42;
IF (rRelativeVol_ArO2 - rUnderwoodTheta) > 0.005 THEN
    rUnderwoodMinReflux_Rmin := (rRelativeVol_ArO2 * 0.9999) / (rRelativeVol_ArO2 - rUnderwoodTheta) - 1.0;
ELSE
    rUnderwoodMinReflux_Rmin := 28.5;
END_IF;
IF rUnderwoodMinReflux_Rmin < 15.0 THEN rUnderwoodMinReflux_Rmin := 15.0; END_IF;
IF rUnderwoodMinReflux_Rmin > 45.0 THEN rUnderwoodMinReflux_Rmin := 45.0; END_IF;

(* Dynamic Rayleigh Equilibrium Reflux Calculation: R_op = 1.18 * R_min + DeltaR_dynamic *)
rGillilandRefluxRatio := 1.18 * rUnderwoodMinReflux_Rmin + (rVoted_GC_TraceO2_ppm * 4.20) + (rVoted_GC_TraceN2_ppm * 2.80);
rRayleighRefluxRatio := rGillilandRefluxRatio;

(* Structured Packing Hydraulics: MellapakPlus 752.Y *)
(* Superficial Vapor Velocity v_v = V_flow / (A_col * 3600) [m/s] *)
IF rColumnCrossArea_m2 > 0.1 THEN
    rSuperficialVaporVel_ms := (rVoted_FeedFlow_Nm3h * (rVoted_TopTemp_K / 273.15) * (1.01325 / rVoted_ColumnHeadPress_bar)) /
                               (rColumnCrossArea_m2 * 3600.0);
ELSE
    rSuperficialVaporVel_ms := 0.165;
END_IF;
rVaporDensity_kgm3 := (rVoted_ColumnHeadPress_bar * 100.0 * rMolarMass_Ar_kgkmol) / (rIdealGasConstant_R * rVoted_TopTemp_K);
IF rVaporDensity_kgm3 > 0.1 THEN
    rFFactor_Packing_Pam05 := rSuperficialVaporVel_ms * SQRT(rVaporDensity_kgm3);
ELSE
    rFFactor_Packing_Pam05 := 1.258;
END_IF;

(* Flooding Boundary Estimation: Critical F-factor = 2.1 Pa^0.5 *)
rFloodingPercent := (rFFactor_Packing_Pam05 / 2.10) * 100.0;
IF rFloodingPercent > 100.0 THEN rFloodingPercent := 100.0; END_IF;

(* Dynamic Height Equivalent to a Theoretical Plate (HETP) via Onda Packed Bed Model *)
rColumnHETP_m := 0.160 + 0.035 * (rFFactor_Packing_Pam05 / 1.50) + 0.00025 * rVoted_DiffPress_mbar;
IF rColumnHETP_m < 0.140 THEN rColumnHETP_m := 0.140; END_IF;
IF rColumnHETP_m > 0.350 THEN rColumnHETP_m := 0.350; END_IF;

(* ============================================================================================= *)
(* SECTION 4: CRYOGENIC PELTIER HEAT-PUMP CONDENSER REBALANCE ENGINE                             *)
(* ============================================================================================= *)
(* Peltier Thermoelectric Cooling Capacity Calculation:                                          *)
(* Q_cold = Sm * I * T_c - 0.5 * I^2 * Re - Kth * (T_h - T_c)                                   *)
rPeltierHeatRemoved_kW := (rPeltierSeebeckCoeff_VK * rPeltierCurrentFeedback_A * rPeltierColdFaceTemp_K) -
                          (0.50 * rPeltierCurrentFeedback_A * rPeltierCurrentFeedback_A * rPeltierResistance_Ohm) -
                          (rPeltierConductance_WK * (rPeltierHeatSinkTemp_K - rPeltierColdFaceTemp_K));
rPeltierHeatRemoved_kW := rPeltierHeatRemoved_kW * 0.001; (* Convert W to kW *)
IF rPeltierHeatRemoved_kW < 0.0 THEN rPeltierHeatRemoved_kW := 0.0; END_IF;

(* Thermoelectric Input Electrical Power: P_elec = I^2 * Re + Sm * I * (T_h - T_c) [kW] *)

(* ============================================================================================= *)

FOR rIdxTmp := 0 TO 5 DO

aOutput_y[0] := rPredictedTraceN2_ppm;
aOutput_y[1] := rPredictedTraceO2_ppm;

aOutput_y[3] := rVoted_DiffPress_mbar;

FOR rIdxTmp := 0 TO 3 DO

END_FOR;

FOR rIdxTmp := 0 TO 5 DO

                   (aMatrix_C[rJdxTmp, 0] * aState_x_pred[0] + aMatrix_C[rJdxTmp, 1] * aState_x_pred[1] +
                    aMatrix_C[rJdxTmp, 2] * aState_x_pred[2] + aMatrix_C[rJdxTmp, 3] * aState_x_pred[3] +
                    aMatrix_C[rJdxTmp, 4] * aState_x_pred[4] + aMatrix_C[rJdxTmp, 5] * aState_x_pred[5]));

(* 3. Model Predictive Control (MPC) Projected Gradient Optimization Engine *)
IF (iMachineState = 40) AND NOT bGracefulDegradation THEN

            IF aStep_du[rIdxTmp] < aLimit_du_Min[rIdxTmp] THEN aStep_du[rIdxTmp] := aLimit_du_Min[rIdxTmp]; END_IF;

    IF rPID_Integ_Reflux > 5000.0 THEN rPID_Integ_Reflux := 5000.0; END_IF;
